adhyāyaḥ 34
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 035 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇasya piṇḍādvai brāhmaṇo yo hyajāyata ।।
sa kva gataścakārā'tha kiṃ kiṃ tad brūhi me hare ! ॥ 1 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca --
brāhmaṇaḥ puruṣaścādyo divyaḥ ṣoḍaśahāyanaḥ ।।
pitrā samupadiṣṭo vai sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ ॥2॥
nārāyaṇasamastanvā guṇaiścāpi sa tatsamaḥ ।
rūpeṇa vayasā''kṛtyā nārāyaṇa ivā'paraḥ ॥3॥
astaunnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pitaraṃ svopadeśikam ।।
nārāyaṇa ! gavāṃ nātha ! pitā tvaṃ jagatāṃ guruḥ ॥4॥
kiṃ kāryaṃ me bhavecchādhi pālayāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।।
pāti yaḥ sa pitā proktaḥ putrastvajñāprapālakaḥ ॥5॥
pitā viṣṇuḥ pitā daivaṃ pitāṃ'śo vāsudevajaḥ ।
pitā kṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma pitā tasmāt prapūjyate ।। 6 ।।
pitṛtīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ puṇyadaṃ varam ।।
pitā devo varo devaḥ pitā brahmasanātanam ॥ 7 ॥
pitā bījapradātā yaḥ poṣakaḥ pālakastathā ।
sarvaṃ cārpayitā svasya ko'nyastasmātparo mataḥ ॥ 8 ॥
pitā santoṣito yena tena santoṣito hariḥ ।
pitā ca sevito yena tena saṃsevito hariḥ ॥ 9 ॥
dāna puṇyavratā''tithyayajñahomadamādayaḥ ।
akṛtā api sukṛtāḥ syuḥ pitā yena sevyate ॥1.34.10॥
mahāpāpo'tipāpaśca paśughnaścā''tmaghātakaḥ ।
pitṛpādodakaṃ pītvā brahmaloke mahīyate ॥11॥
pitṛbrahma paraṃbrahma śaraṇyaḥ śaraṇārthinaḥ ।।
dehajñānadhanādīnāṃ pradātā poṣakaḥ prabhuḥ ॥12॥
piturājñā kṛtā yena tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ।
anyannaivā'vaśiṣyena pitrāśīrbhyo vidheyakam ॥13॥
saṃskṛtaḥ saṃskṛto vā na putraḥ pitrā nibhālitaḥ ।।
nirbhayo bhavate mānyo mahadbhiścāpi sarvathā ॥14॥
na viṣṇurna mahādevo na vairājo na ceśvarāḥ ।।
pitṛtulyā bhavantyete pitā hyeva pitā mataḥ ॥15॥
jalā'nnavastravāhādyaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।
vārdhakye pārśvavāsena pituḥ sevāṃ karoti yaḥ ।।16।।
āhvāne vartane cāpi neti na prativakti yaḥ ।।
omityeva karotīṣṭaṃ sa mokṣabhāṅ na saṃśayaḥ ॥17॥
piturmataṃ vinā naiva kiñcitkāryaṃ karoti yaḥ ।।
ājñayaiva prakartā yaḥ sarvathā phalabhāg hi saḥ ॥18॥
āpadbhirnīyamāno yo duḥkhairāmarditaśca yaḥ ।
vighnaiścāpi parābhūtaḥ pitṛbhaktyā hi rakṣyate ॥19॥
tādṛśena suputreṇa pitā vai putravān mataḥ ।।
anājñākaraputreṇa pitā naiva hi putravān ॥1.34.20॥
tasmāttātaḥ karomyājñāṃ yena janmaphalaṃ bhavet ।।
kṛtaṃ sarva sukutaṃ syāt tadājñāṃ dehi satvaram ॥21॥
pitṛbhaktiṃ pradarśyaivaṃ yāvad baddhāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ ।
tāvannārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt pitā prāha suputrakam ।। 22।।
aho putra ciraṃ jīva, vardhito'si śubhāśiṣā ।
pitṛbhaktiparaḥ putre dharmeṇa vardhate'nvaham ।। 23 ।।
īdṛśaste vicāro'sti vartanaṃ pitṛbhaktikṛt ।
pitṛ bhakti vibeke'haṃ varte vai putra siddhidaḥ ।।।24।।
suputraḥ sa hi vijñeyaḥ pitā yena supālitaḥ ।
vanditaḥ sevito nityaṃ pūjitaśca namaskṛtaḥ ।। 25।
prātarutthāya ye putraḥ pitṝndevāngurūँstathā ।
vandante ca namantyāryāste'kṣayā'rthaprabhāgiṇaḥ ।। 25 ।।
teṣāṃ vai cā'kṣayā lokāsteṣāṃ cā'kṣayamamṛtam ।
teṣāṃ vai cā'kṣayaṃ śreyasteṣāmabhyudayaḥ paraḥ ।।।27।।
teṣāṃ dārāḥ sadā sādhvyaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ ।
miṣṭavāṇyo miṣṭadātryo miṣṭabhoga pradāstathā ।। 28 ।।
teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi divyāni smṛddhikoṭibhṛtāni ca ।
rasadravyadharāsampallalitāni bhavanti ca ।। 29 ।।
sevante ye janāḥ pitṝn vastrabhojanavāribhiḥ ।
sevā'nuvṛttiśuśrūṣāparicaryādibhistathā ।। 1.34.30 ।।
teṣāṃ syurakṣayā lokā akṣayāśca vibhūtayaḥ ।
akṣayaṃ ca sukhaṃ divyaṃ nirvighnaṃ cirajīvanam ।।31 ।।
siddhayastatra tiṣṭhanti pitaro yatra satkṛtāḥ ।
samṛddhayastatra cā''yānti pitrāśīrvādayojitāḥ ।। 32 ।।
svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
śayyā mṛdvyo dugdhaphenā gauryo nāryastathā rasāḥ ।। 33 ।।
yānavāhanasaudhāni dīvyanti pitṛsevinām ।
udyānopavanā''vāsasarovihārabhūmayaḥ ।। 34।।
vimānāni ca divyāni gāvo dāsyaḥ sumadhyamāḥ ।
dāsāścājñākarāḥ saumyā bhavanti pitṛsevinām ।। 35।।
pitṛsevā'kṣayo lābho nā'nyo lābhastathā'paraḥ ।
yena lābhena modante putrāścātra paratra ca ।।36 ।।
pūrvaṃ yaistu pitā bhaktyā sevitaḥ paritoṣitaḥ ।
taiḥ padaṃ pārameṣṭhyādi labdhaṃ cā'thā'punarbhavam ।। 37।।
pitṛprasannatāpātraṃ yamo naivā'bhisarpati ।
pitṛprasannatāpātrāt kālaścāpi palāyate ।। 38 ।।
pitṛprasādapātrasya hareḥ prasādapātratā ।
pitṛprasādahīnānāṃ durantā kaṣṭadā gatiḥ ।। 3 9।।
labdhapitṛprasādānāṃ vaṃśo na śīryate kvacit ।
pitṛprasādamāptānāṃ svāsthyaṃ na jīryati kvacit ।।1.34.40 ।।
pitṛprasādamāptānāmītayo yānti dūrataḥ ।
ādhyātmikāni duḥkhāni dṛśyante naiva naiva hi ।।41।।
indriyāṇi sadā teṣāṃ nirogāṇi bhavanti hi ।
pitā bījapradaḥ pūjyo mātā garbhe vivardhinī ।।42।।
bālye tu sevikā mātā sevyā mātā yathā pitā ।
pitā nārāyaṇo bodhyo mātā lakṣmīsvarūpiṇī ।।।42।।
mātṛsevā kṛtā yena sevitā devakoṭayaḥ ।
mātā dadhāti vai garbhe garbhārthaṃ niyame sthitā ।।44।।
iṣṭānbhogyānbhojyapānādikān tyaktvā'pi rakṣati ।
janmadāne paraṃ duḥkhaṃ sahate mṛtimūrchanam ।।45।।
bālaṃ mūtramalopetaṃ nirmalaṃ prakaroti sā ।
nidrāṃ tyaktvā'pi bālārthaṃ cintā grastā bhavatyasau ।।46।।
dhyāyatīśvaravad bālaṃ sevate poṣayatyapi ।
rakṣati svārjitaṃ sarvaṃ dadāti tatkṛte sadā ।।47।।
kiṃ! ṛṇaṃ tūlanāṃ yāti putre mātuḥ ṛṇasya vai ।
putrastatpratikartuṃ na kṣamo varṣaśatairapi ।।48।।
yādṛśau tādṛśau vāpi pitarau brahmavanmatau ।
pūjyau sevyau sadā vandyau putraiḥ puṇyābhilāṣibhiḥ ।।49।।
andhau rugṇau daridrau vā kṛpaṇau vyabhicāriṇau ।
stenau hiṃsāparau vāpi pitarau pūjanārhaṇau ।।1.34.50।।
dhanyo'si tvaṃ sadā putra yanmadājñāṃ karoṣi hi ।
madājñaiva ca dharmaste dharmātmā bhava sarvadā ।।51 ।।
patnīvratamitiprakhyāṃ karomi tava putraka! ।
patnīvratastvamevā'si brāhmaṇo divyasiddhimān ।।52।।
mama kṛṣṇasya rūpastvaṃ mamā'tivallabho yataḥ ।
kṛṣṇavallabha ityākhya ācāryo bhava putraka! ।।।53।।
mamā'vatāra eva tvaṃ bhagavān sarvamokṣakṛt ।
matsṛṣṭyasaṃkhyasādhvīnāmekalaḥ satpatirbhava ।।।54।।
sarvasṛṣṭau divyarūpo bhūtvā vyāpaka eva ca ।
nare nare nivāsaṃ ca kuru koṭiguṇo bhava ।।55।।
śṛṇu patnīvrataṃ te'hamupadiśāmi tattvataḥ ।
tathā nareṣu vṛttyaṃ vai tathāsanmokṣado bhava ।।56।।
patyurbhāgaṃ svake garbhe nayate rakṣaṇāya yā ।
patnī proktā ca sā'pyagnisākṣiṇī sahacāriṇī ।।57।।
tadarthaṃ tatsukhārthaṃ ca tasyāmeva pumarthakam ।
vartanaṃ vratamityevaṃ patnīvratamitīritam ।।58।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pitṛsevāpatnīvratapuruṣātmakabrāhmaṇamahimakathananāmā catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 34 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 034 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 35
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 036 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
patnīvratasya śabdasya samyagartho mayoditaḥ ।
tava patnyāḥ kṛte kiṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ tadvakṣyate mayā ।। 1 ।।
prathamaṃ brahmacāritvaṃ paścādgārhasthyameva ca ।
brahmacārī purā bhūtvā patnyā saha tato vaset ।। 2 ।।
brahmacaryaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ yajñopavītamityapi ।
vedārthāṃśca nibodha tvaṃ paścāt patnīyuto bhava ।। 2 ।।
ityājñapya svakaṃ putraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yauvanonmukham ।
muhūrtaṃ śubhamāsthāya pravṛtto hyupanāyane ।। 4 ।।
tathopanītiṃ putrasya kartumutsukamānasaḥ ।
sarvān sampādayāmāsa saṃbhārānuruvikramaḥ ।। 5 ।।
tadā maṃgalavādyāni hyavādyanta muhurmuhuḥ ।
lakṣmyādayo jagustatra gītānyānandatastadā ।। 6 ।।
kṛcchratrayanimittena dhenutrayapradānakam ।
kāmacārā'śanā'śuddhiśāntaye kṛtamuttamam ।। 7 ।।
tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitam ।
tryahaṃ paraṃ ca nāśnīyācchuddhaṃ kṛcchramudīritam ।। 8 ।।
mātṛkāpūjanaṃ caiva nāndīśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca ।
svastivāco gṛhaśāntiṃ dvijabhojanamityapi ।। 1 ।।
sthaṇḍile tu samudbhavavahnisthāpanamityatha ।
pūjanādi tathā tasya cakāra śrīhariḥ svayam ।। 1.35.10 ।।
snātaṃ bhukta kṛtakeśavāpaṃ ca samalaṃkṛtam ।
dakṣabhāge sthitaṃ saṃskārayāmāsa sutaṃ tu saḥ ।।1 1 ।।
kaupīnaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca navaṃ yajñopavītakam ।
triguṇaṃ sma dadātyājyahomaṃ kṛtvā'vadatprabhuḥ ।। 12।।
sāmākhyaste bhaved vedo gotraṃ śrībrahma vidyate ।
pravarāste trayo nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo haristathā ।। 13।।
śākhā patnīvratākhyā te nāmnā bhaviṣyati hyanu ।
idānīṃ tvaṃ brahmacārī bhavasīti nibodhaya ।। 14।।
śṛṇu dharmāṃstava yogyānkathayāmi samāsataḥ ।
juhudhyagniṃ prātarādāvapośāna tathā kuru ।। 15।।
guroḥ sevāṃ kuru nityaṃ brahmapāṭhaṃ tathā kuru ।
gṛhāṇemaṃ ca gāyatrīmantraṃ japaṃ sadā kuru ।। 16 ।।
oṃ nārāyaṇāyavidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ।
tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayādityāvarttaya mālikām ।। 17।।
brahmadaṇḍaṃ gṛhāṇemamaiṇā'jīnamidaṃ tathā ।
sandhyopāstiṃ vidhehi tvaṃ krodhā'nṛte tu varjaya ।। 18।।
brahmacaryaṃ tathā rakṣa vikṛtiṃ mā''viśa kvacit ।
aśuddhaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ pānaṃ mā''tiṣṭha hananaṃ kvacit ।। 1 9।।
vyasanaṃ mā kuru brahman nindanaṃ mā kuru kvacit ।
snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ।।1.35.20 ।।
ātmajñānaṃ hareḥ pūjāmaṣṭau nityaṃ samācareḥ ।
omityādāya tadvākyamupatasthe raviṃ tathā ।। 21 ।।
agneḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakre bhikṣāṃ jagrāha mātṛtaḥ ।
śrīharirgāḥ svarṇamudrā vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca ।।22।।
īśvarebhyo dadāti sma ye te tatra samāgatāḥ ।
bhojanāni dakṣiṇāśca datvā santarpitāśca te ।।।23 ।।
putraṃ jñānastavātmānaṃ vedamadhyāpayaddhariḥ ।
jaṭākamaṇḍalūdaṇḍacarmavalkaladhāriṇaḥ ।।24।।
patnīvratākhyaputrasya vivāhārthaṃ vyacintayat ।
pativratākhyayā sārdhaṃ rūpayauvanapūrayā ।। 25।।
kanyayā tadvivāhaṃ ca nārāyaṇo hyakārayat ।
dvayorjanmā'kṣare dṛṣṭvā lagnārthaṃ niścikāya saḥ ।। 26।।
muhūrtaṃ ca balaṃ dṛṣṭvā lagnapatraṃ lilekha ca ।
gītiṃ māṃgalikīṃ svastivācanikāṃ vidhāpya vai ।। 27 ।।
mukhaṃ miṣṭaṃ tathā kṛtvā varasyā'kṣatabindukam ।
piṣṭacūrṇairvarasthāṃgaṃ mardayitvā hyapūjayat। ।।।28 ।।
maṇḍapāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā māṇekastaṃbharopaṇam ।
gaṇeśasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkāpūjanaṃ tathā ।। 29 ।।
kalaśasthāpanaṃ kṛtvā yajñakuṇḍamakārayat ।
kare kāmaphalaṃ ( mīṃḍholakaṃ) badhvā varaṃ maṇḍapamānayata ।। 1.35.30 ।।
kanyāṃ tatra samānīya varamālāmadhārayat ।
gārhapatyaṃ ca kuṇḍe'gniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya hyajūhavat ।। 31 ।।
hastayormelanaṃ kṛtvā mukhe miṣṭamadāpayat ।
vastragranthiṃ samābadhya pradakṣiṇā hyakārayat ।। 3 2 ।।
vedavādyadhvaniṃ kṛtvā magalādīnyagāpayat ।
mudrādibhī rāmayitvā hastadravyāṇi cārpayat ।। 23 ।।
saha dharmaṃ caretyuktvā lagnakarmā'samāpayat ।
vighnān śirasa uttārya hyāśīrbhiḥ samayojayat ।। 34।।
brāhmeṇa vidhinā dattvā varakanye hyavāhayat ।
atha nārāyaṇastatra dampatibhyāmaśikṣayat ।। 25।।
patibhinnā na vai patnī patnībhinno na vai patiḥ ।
dvayoḥ premṇorabhinnatvāddvayoraikyaṃ svabhāvajam ।। 36।।
patyurguptaṃ mahāvīryaṃ patnī garbhe dadhāti hi ।
aṃgayośca tayoraikyāddampatyoraikyamaṃgajam ।। 37।।
piturbhāgaḥ sthito garbhe patnībhāgena puṣyate ।
dvayorbālo bhavedekastato hyaikyaṃ dvayorapi ।।38।।
ekasyā'niṣṭatāprāptau dvayorduḥkhaṃ samaṃ bhavet ।
ekasya sukhasampattau dvayoḥ saukhyaṃ samaṃ bhavet ।।39।।
hānirlābhaḥ sukhaṃ dukhaṃ samaṃ dvābhyāṃ nu vedyate ।
ātmā''tmani dvayoḥ saktastasmādaikyaṃ dvayorapi ।।1.35.40।।
ekenāpyarjite dravye'nyasya svatvaṃ pravartate ।
eke na kṛtapuṇyasya dvitīyo bhajate phalam ।।41।।
ekena tu kṛte kārye viśvasityaparo yataḥ ।
ekenopārjitaṃ bhojyaṃ bhuṃkte tu dvayameva vai ।।42।।
divā rātrau sahaikatvaṃ dehayormanasorapi ।
mamā'hante na vai bhinne tasmādaikyaṃ dvayorapi ।।43।।
rodane rudanaṃ yāti harṣaṇe harṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
mūrchane mūrchanaṃ yāti cintane cintanaṃ bhavet ।। 44।।
dvayoraikyādidaṃ sarvaṃ bhinnayornahi jāyate ।
tasmāttu sarvathā bodhyaṃ dampatyoraikyamuttamam ।।45।।
ityevamaikyasāmarthyātpuṇye'pyaikyaṃ bhavatyapi ।
śatrudaṇḍe rājadaṇḍe sahanaikyaṃ bhavatyapi ।।46।।
tīrthe dāne copakāre śubhe puṇye ca dharmaṇi ।
patipatnyoḥ samo bhāgaḥ smṛddhau cā'tra paratra ca ।।47।।
tasmādardhaṃ śarīrasya svasyā'nyasya parārdhakam ।
puṃso'rdhaṃ vāma patnyeva patnyardhaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ patiḥ ।। 48।।
patnyāṃ patiḥ sadā hyāste kānte patnī ca vartate ।
tasmādardhāṃganā patnī patiścā'rdhāṃgano mataḥ ।।49।।
tataḥ svārthaṃ parityajya dvayorarthaṃ vibudhya ca ।
dvābhyāmājīvanaṃ cārthe sthātavyaṃ tu parasparam ।।1.35.50।।
parasparaṃ svakaṃ jñātvā pratibimbaṃ sahāyakṛt ।
prasoḍhvāpi dvayomardaṃ kartavyaṃ kāryamanvaham ।।51।।
patnyā yathā patiḥ sevyo mānyaḥ pūjyaśca devavat ।
patyā tathā sadvā patnī sevyā mānyeva devikā ।।52।
bhojanācchādanā''lāpavihārotsavakhelane ।
śṛṃgārahāsasammānā''sanayānā'dhirohaṇe ।।53।।
vartane vārtane svatve pūjane satkṛte'rhaṇe ।
patnī tu sarvathā hyagre gaṇanīyā nareṇa hi ।।54।।
ramaṇyo yatra pūjyante vasanti tatra devatāḥ ।
ramaṇyo yatra tuṣyanti tatra vasanti sampadḥ ।।55।।
ramaṇyo yatra modante vardhante smṛddhayo'tra vai ।
ramaṇyo yatra tṛpyanti tatrā''kṛṣyanta ṛddhayaḥ ।।56।।
nāryo hyānandayantyatra tatrā''gacchanti siddhayaḥ ।
nodvejyā naiva tāḍyāśca nāryo vaṃśadharā yataḥ ।।।57।।।
janakaṃ tu parityajya yā''gatā pativeśane ।
patyadhīnā patibhāgyā kastāmudvejayed budhaḥ ।।58।।
dāsīvā''jīvanaṃ yā vai bhūjiṣyeva nu vartate ।
dīneva kṛpaṇā bhūtvā patiṃ caivā'nuvartate ।।59।।
govat vā vahyate yatra dīnā vahati tatra vai ।
chāyā tviva śarīrasya kastāṃ buddho nu duḥkhayet ।।1.35.60।।
dattaṃ bhuktaṃ paraṃ vṛṃkte cā'bhiyukte'vaśeṣajam ।
parādhīnā patiṃ dhatte kastāṃ na rakṣayed budhaḥ ।।61।।
kṣudhāṃ tṛṣāṃ prasoḍhvāpi gṛhakāryaṃ karoti yā ।
kaṣṭaṃ kālaṃ sahitvā'pi patikāryaṃ karoti yā ।।62।।
tyaktvā nidrāṃ tathā''lasyaṃ vigaṇayya manaḥ svakam ।
patyuḥ kāmapravṛttyarthamupatiṣṭhatyadho bhuvi ।।6 3।।
tāḍane bhartsane krośe'dhikṣepe tyajane'pi yā ।
nirbalā sahate sarvaṃ kastāṃ duḥkhaṃ pradāpayet ।।64।।
etādṛśyāṃ suśīlāyāṃ patnyāṃ lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhati ।
rādhā ramā jayā padmā śāradā ca sarasvatī ।।65।।
ekādaśī ratiḥ sandhyā mohinī ca jayantyapi ।
etāścānyā mahādevyastatra patnyāṃ vasanti hi ।।66।।
andhā rugṇā daridrā vā kurūpā kubhagā'pi vā ।
kustanī kumukhī kubjā sthūlā śaithilyamadhyamā ।।67।।
kuśvāsā kupadī kuṣṭhā kupriyā kusvabhāvinī ।
api duṣṭā durācārā patnī sevyeva padmajā ।।68।।
na kvāpi duḥkhinnīṃ kuryāt svasya śreyo hyabhīpsatā ।
tasyā niḥśvāsamātreṇa sarvaṃ dahyati tatkṣaṇāt ।।69।।
tasyā duḥkhakṛtocchvāsān nirvaṃśo jāyate naraḥ ।
puṇyaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ naśyet tasyāḥ kalpāntavahninā ।।1.35.70।।
tasmātputra sadā patnīṃ pūjaya tvaṃ yathocitam ।
svasmād daśaguṇaṃ patnyai dehi sarvaṃ tvayā'rjitam ।।71।।
tena gṛhyasukhaṃ labdhvā saha svargaṃ vigāhya ca ।
ante brāhmaṃ padaṃ divyaṃ prayāsyatho'punarbhavam ।।72।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne patnīvratākhyapuruṣasyabrahmacaryagārhasthyadampatītvadharmamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।35।।


← adhyāyaḥ 035 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 36
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 037 →

śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ kamale ! lokavyavahārapraghaṭṭanām ।
yacchrutvā''ścaryameva syātkathayāmi tu tattvataḥ ।। 1 ।।
karmaloke vyavahāro hyādānapratidānajaḥ ।
parasparasahāyena sarvadā bandhanātmakaḥ ।। 2।।
daridrebhyo nirdhanebhyo'śakyebhyo dhanavān sadā ।
dravyaṃ dadāti sāhāyyaṃ dehayātrāpravṛttaye ।। 3 ।।
samayastena kaṭhino niryāti sukhapūrvakam ।
yadā svasya suyogaḥ syātsamayaścāpi lābhadaḥ ।। 4 । ।
tadā tu dhanino dravyaṃ sampradeyamaśeṣataḥ ।
grahītā yadi dadyānna ṛṇyeva mriyate yadi ।। 5 ।।
ṛṇā'pākaraṇārthāya punarjanmani vai tadā ।
manuṣyo yadi jāyeta prāk pitā bhavatīti saḥ ।। 6 ।।
tadānīṃ pūrvadātāraḥ putrā bhavantyakarmaṭhāḥ ।
patnīgarbhe sthitā eva kārayanti bahuvyayam ।। 7 ।।
patnīṃ tu rogiṇīṃ kuryustadarthaṃ dravyanāśakāḥ ।
janmanyapi na sāralyaṃ tadānīṃ dravyanāśakāḥ ।। 8 ।।
janmottaraṃ na susvāsthyaṃ tadānīṃ dravyanāśakāḥ ।
bālye'pi sarvathā duṣṭāḥ kārayanti vyayaṃ bahum ।। 9 ।।
bhojanācchādanāpānavilepanamahotsavaiḥ ।
kurvanti vipulaṃ nāśaṃ pitṛdravyasya putrakāḥ ।। 1.36.10 ।।
roge vyayo vrate vyayo vyasane vyaya eva ca ।
vidyādhyāye vivāhe ca vyayād vyaya itīyate ।। 11 ।।
yāvannopārjanārhāste tāvattu vyaya eva vai ।
yāvadupārjanārthāya samayaḥ pratidṛśyate ।। 1 2।।
tāvad yuvā kṛtaḥ putro'kasmād vā mriyate yataḥ ।
pūrvajanmani dattaṃ yat sarvamādāya yāti saḥ ।। 13 ।।
athavā dīrghajīvī ced vicittonmattavadbhavet ।
tadartha sarvathā dravyavyaya eva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 4।।
ityevaṃ pūrvadātāro jāyante'tra tu putrakāḥ ।
dattaṃ dravyaṃ samāpyaiva yānti karmānusārataḥ ।। 15।।
tasmātpṝvapradātāraḥ putrāḥ jñeyā svake gṛhe ।
ye vā na pratidātāraḥ paśavo'pi bhavanti te ।। 1 6।।
vṛṣā aśvā rāsabhā vā coṣṭrā bhūtvā vahanti te ।
taddvārā svāmino dravyaṃ datvā yāntyanyavigraham ।। 1 7।।
ṛṇamukto bhavedyastu na kiṃcitkasyacicca vai ।
ṛṇaṃ yasyā'vaśiṣyeta sa naivā'patyavān bhavet ।। 18 ।।
tasmātputrāḥ sadā bodhyā dravyanāśārthamāgatāḥ;
satputrāstvāgate yogye samaye lābhadāyakāḥ ।। 1 9।।
karmānubandhisaṃsāre yasya yatra ṛṇaṃ bhavet ।
sa tat tasya samādāya dūraṃ cirāya gacchati ।। 1.36.20 ।।
na kaścitkasyacit putro na kaścitkasyacitpitā ।
ṛṇādānapradānābhyāṃ pitṛputrā''ptayojanāḥ ।। 21 । ।
svapitṛsevanaṃ putrāstyaktvotpathagatā yadi ।
pitṛniḥśvāsasaṃdagdhā yāntyadho'pyadhamāṃ gatim ।। 22।।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi vṛddhaṃ pālyaṃ gṛhād yadi ।
niṣkāsayati kuputro naṣṭapuṇyo bhavatyaram ।। 2 1 ।।
guruṃ hūṃkṛtya tūṃkṛtya pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vadet ।
śmaśāne jāyate vṛkṣaḥ kaṃkagradhropasevitaḥ ।।24।।
mātre pitre vṛddhatāyāṃ yo'nnaṃ naiva dadāti ca ।
devāḥ syustasya vai ruṣṭā annanāśakarāstathā ।।25 ।।
tābhyo vāsaṃ tu vṛddhatve jīvikāṃ na dadāti yaḥ ।
tasya vāsaṃ jīvikāṃ ca haranti devayonayaḥ ।। 26। ।
pitrostu bhartsanaṃ yadvā tāḍanaṃ cā'vamānanam ।
karoti yaḥ kuputraḥ sa pare tattatprapadyate ।। 27।।
kuputrairbhavitavyaṃ na bhavitavyaṃ suputrakaiḥ ।
suputrasya kṛte svargaṃ sampanmokṣo'pi hastagaḥ ।। 28 । ।
sudevā''rādhanaṃ yadvā yābhyāṃ puṇyaṃ purā kṛtam ।
tābhyāṃ tu labhyate putraḥ suputro dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ।। 29।।
sevako mānadātā''jñāpālako'nusṛtaḥ sadā ।
gurvarthaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisahanaḥ paripoṣakaḥ ।। 1.36.30 ।।
satputrajanane yogā apekṣyante śubhāḥ sadā ।
garbhasya dhāraṇe yogāḥ suyogā vai suputradāḥ ।। 31 ।।
ṛtudāne pituryādṛga vicāro vartate hṛdi ।
kāmaḥ krodho'thavā lābho bhartsanaṃ cauryameva vā ।। 32।।
moho daṃbho malinatvaṃ śāṭhyaṃ kauṭilyameva vā ।
śauryaṃ vidyā sāttvikatvaṃ rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ ca vā ।। 33 ।।
dyūtaṃ pānaṃ vyasanaṃ ca yadyadaniṣṭameva vā ।
vartate tanmayo binduḥ putro'pi tanmayo bhavet ।। 34।।
dānadharmadayāpremakomalāntaratāstathā ।
varteran tanmayo bindustatputrastadguṇo bhavet ।। 3 5।।
ṛtudāne śunaḥ śabdā gardabhādestathā'śubhāḥ ।
kleśakalahaśabdā vā śrūyante cettathā tadā ।। 36 ।।
bindavastanmayā bhūtvā garbhe te vai patanti yat ।
putrā api śvakharavat jāyante tadguṇāstathā ।। 37।।
nīcajāteḥ sahavāsāt tadbhāvānāṃ ca vartanāt ।
tādṛśā bindudāne vai jāyante bālakāstathā ।। 38 ।।
gṛhe sarvatra bhittyādau yādṛśyaḥ santi mūrtayaḥ ।
tādṛśā''kṛtayasteṣāṃ putrāṇāntu bhavanti hi ।। 39 ।।
kṛṣṇavarṇāstāmasāśca yuddhāraṃbhāḥ pratārakāḥ ।
caurāśca kāmanāvanto hāsyasadanakārakāḥ ।।1.36.40 ।।
daridrāśca dhanāḍhyaśca vijayinaḥ palāyitāḥ ।
rākṣasāśca tathā pretā bhūtā bhāṇḍāśca nartakāḥ ।।4 1 ।।
naṭā naṭyo yathā yā yā ākṛtayo bhavanti vai ।
gṛhe vā darśane vā'tha smaraṇe bindupātane ।।।42।।
tathā tathā guṇāsteṣāṃ bhavantyeva prajāsu vai ।
tasmānniṣekakārye'pi sukṛtaṃ cintayed budhaḥ ।।।43 ।।
santaṃ dharmayutaṃ bhaktaṃ yaśobhājaṃ ca sukṛtam ।
śvetaṃ puṇyayutaṃ śāntaṃ sadguṇaṃ mānavaṃ tathā ।।44।।
guruṃ patiṃ ca pitaraṃ mātaraṃ devameva vā ।
vidvāṃsaṃ satkriyaṃ śūraṃ surekhaṃ bhāgyaśālinam ।। 45।।
gauraṃ prakhyātakāryaṃ ca śīlavantaṃ tapasvinam ।
lokahitakaraṃ devapūjanā''stikameva vā ।।46 ।।
udyaminaṃ ca nītijñaṃ saumyaṃ devaguṇākaram ।
paropakāraśīlaṃ ca subhagaṃ dānaśālinam ।।7।।
sarvasadguṇasadvāsaṃ pavitraṃ cintayet tadā ।
naraṃ vā'pyathavā nārīṃ devaṃ devīṃ tathāpi vā ।।48 ।।
santaṃ sādhvīṃ bhagavantaṃ tathā bhagavatīṃ ca vā ।
yādṛśaṃ yādṛśīṃ caiva niṣekasamaye tu yaḥ । ।49 ।।
yā ca saṃsmarati tādṛgapatyaṃ labhate tathā ।
ṛtudāne yathā yādṛgbhāvo bhavati dehinoḥ ।।1.36.50 ।।
tathā'patyāni jāyante dampatyorbhāvavanti hi ।
atra sṛṣṭau tu bahudhā svabhāvāḥ saṃkarīkṛtāḥ ।।5 1 ।।
parasparānumiśreṇa śuddhā naiva bhavanti hi ।
tathāpi sukhadaṃ cintyaṃ yāvadbuddhibalodayam ।।52।।
tenā'patyaṃ bhavettasya sukhadaṃ mānadaṃ sadā ।
ārtavastu guṇaḥ sarvā'patyeṣvāviśati dhruvam ।।53 ।।
ṛtvāraṃbhād bhavedgarbhakamalaṃ vyāttasammukham ।
āṣoḍaśadinaṃ paścād garbhaṃ gṛhṇāti naiva tat ।।54।।
madhyarātryuttaraṃ matvā cā''gāmimadhyarātrikam ।
yadā rajaḥ sudṛśyeta taddinādgaṇanā bhavet ।।55।।
rajodināni catvāri vihāyā''ṣoḍaśā'vadhim ।
garbhā''dhānasya yogyatvaṃ bhavatītyavadhārya ca ।।5 6 ।।
yadvā tadvā rajoyuktā rātryaścatasra eva tu ।
hātavyāstapare kāle pañcamī kanyakāpradā ।।57।।
ṣaṣṭhī rātriḥ putradā vai bhavatītyevamaṃkataḥ ।
gaṇayitvā yatheṣṭaṃ tu yogaḥ kāryaḥ phalapradaḥ ।।58।।
putradāstasya yugmāḥ syurayugmāḥ kanyakāpradāḥ ।
ṛturajo'nvitā rātryaścatasrastatra garhitāḥ ।।59।।
tāsu yogo na kartavyo garbhanāśaka eva saḥ ।
tasmāddhairyapado bhūtvā śuddhiṃ kṛtvā tu saṃviśet ।। 1.36.60 ।।
tyaktvā candramasaṃ duṣṭaṃ maghāṃ mūlaṃ vihāya ca ।
śuciṃ sanniviśetpatnīṃ punnāmarkṣe viśeṣataḥ ।।6 1 ।।
patiḥ patnyāḥ saha śuddhiṃ kṛtvā śayyāṃ samāviśet ।
śuciṃ putraṃ prapadyeta pumarthasya prasādhakam ।।62।।
mālinye tu tayoḥ putrā malināḥ syuśca pāpinaḥ ।
nāryā śṛṃgārahāsyādi kāryaṃ maithunakarmaṇi ।।।63 ।।
tenā'patyaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ syāt sukhabhāk saumyadarśanam ।
hāsyayug divyarūpaṃ ca bhavenmānasaraṃjanam ।।64।।
dugdhapākaṃ tathā miṣṭaṃ śuklaṃ bhuktvā tu saṃviśet ।
tenojjvalamapatyaṃ syād rūpāḍhyaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ sadā ।।65।।
śākaṃ bhuṃktvā yadā gacchet striyaṃ tasya tu bālakam ।
kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bhavettasmācchākaṃ bhojyaṃ na taddine ।। 66।।
ujjvalena prabhojyena vīryaṃ bhavati cojjvalam ।
tasmād dvābhyāṃ tadā bhakṣyamujjvalaṃ paya ādikam ।।67।।
tataḥ ṛtuprasaṃgastu kāryaḥ sarvaśubhāvahaḥ ।
śubhe kāle śubhe yoge mūhūrtādau śubhe tathā ।।68 ।।
saṃgaḥ kāryo nā'nyathā tu sadapatyasulabdhaye ।
satsamayaṃ tvanādṛtya kāmavegena ye janāḥ ।। 69 ।।
akāle garbhadātārasteṣāṃ bālāstu durbhagāḥ ।
alpavīryā alpasattvā alpasukṛtakāriṇaḥ ।।1.36.7 0 ।।
buddhihīnā duḥkhadāśca jāyante duḥkhavartanāḥ ।
tasmācchrubhaprajāyāstu lābhāya sarvadā yuvām ।।7 1 ।।
vartethāṃ dharmasadbhāve nā'nyabhāve kadācana ।
tena saukhyaṃ paraṃ bhūyād bhavatorekabhāvayoḥ । ।72।।
lokadvayavijetārau bhavatāṃ, śaṃ bhavatvapi ।
bhūyāstaṃ ca sadā sārthau viyogarahitau tathā ।।73 ।।
dāmpatyasukhamaśnantau nityamānandaśālinau ।
dehasampatkṛtau pṛṣṭau bhūyāstaṃ bhāgyaśālinau ।।74।।
rajasvalārajo doṣo hyaśuddhibhrājako hi saḥ ।
tāvaddūre'nvahaṃ stheyaṃ yāvaddinacatuṣṭayam ।।75 ।।
nāryā rajasvalādharmasthayā spṛśyaṃ na sarvathā ।
gṛhavastvādikaṃ yattatsparśādaśucitāṃ vrajet ।।76।।
ajñānādvā prasaṃgādvā spārśano doṣa udbhavet ।
tannivṛttirbhavedvarṣe tad ṛṣipaṃcamīvratāt ।।77।।
upavāstatra kāryo nāryā devaprapūjanam ।
bhādraśuklasupakṣasya pañcamī ṛṣipañcamī ।।78।।
tadvrate tu phalāhāro hyaśaktānāṃ mataḥ śubhaḥ ।
tathākṛte vratasyāpi bhaṃgo naiva bhavediti ।।79।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ṛṇānubandhasantatidāmpatyaniṣekānurūpasantāna-rājasvalyadoṣaparihārakavratādinirūpaṇanāmā
ṣaṭūtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 36 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 036 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 37
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 038 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
patnīvratapativrate śrīhariṇā vivāhite ।
namaskṛtya paraṃ devaṃ tato lokeṣu ceratuḥ ।। 1 ।।
tābhyāṃ saṃkalpamātreṇa koṭiśo brāhmaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
ete tu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve saṃkalpasiddhayo'bhavan ।। 2 ।।
teṣāṃ na maithunī sṛṣṭirnā'nyasādhanabandhinī ।
na ca puṇyasya sāpekṣā na vā vedhaḥsahāyinī ।। 3 ।।
iyaṃ tu brahmasṛṣṭirvai brāhmaṇā brahmarūpiṇaḥ ।
nārāyaṇasamāḥ sarve nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
brahmā svakīyasṛṣṭyarthaṃ yadā svaṃ tvakarottapaḥ ।
tadā tu samaye sṛṣṭiriyaṃ brāhmaṇamātrajā ।। 5 ।।
prajāpatestu divase prathame brāhmaṇāśca te ।
sarve nārāyaṇī sṛṣṭirna tu vaidhasī sā'bhavat ।। 6 ।।
viprāṇāṃ tatra sarveṣāmāyuṣyaṃ brahmaṇā samam ।
vedhasā ca sahotpannāḥ saha yānti pralīnatām ।।7।।
divyāste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yānti brahmapure pare ।
atha satyātmake sthāne divye vai parameṣṭhinaḥ ।। 8 ।।
tiṣṭhanto brāhmasṛṣṭau tu viprāsta eva sarvaśaḥ ।
brahmarṣayaḥ saṃbhavanti brāhmadivasavartinaḥ ।। 9 ।।
prathamaṃ tu dināraṃbhe satyaloke'pyanantakāḥ ।
tapoloke'pi ta eva jane'pi brāhmaṇāśca te ।। 1.37.10 ।।
maharloke'pi ta eva brāhmaṇā divyamūrtayaḥ ।
svarge caivā'ntarīkṣe ca pṛthvyāṃ pātālasaptake ।। 11 ।।
sarvatra brāhmaṇā divyāścaikarūpaikabhāvanāḥ ।
ekasaṃskṛtabhāṣājñāścaikavarṇaikavṛttayaḥ ।। 12।।
sarve ṣoḍaśavarṣāśca nāryā dvādaśahāyanāḥ ।
samāvasthā vikārādirahitāḥ kāmavarjitāḥ ।।13।।
nā'śuddhirna manojanyo vikāro mithunā'rthitaḥ ।
brahmadhyātāra evaite brahmayajñaparāḥ sadā ।। 14।।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu gamanā'gamanakṣamāḥ ।
ākāśagāminaḥ sarve yatheṣṭarūpadhāriṇaḥ ।। 16।।
dṛśyā'dṛśyasvarūpajñāḥ sūkṣmasthūlādisaṃbhavāḥ ।
ekajñātaya evaite saṃkalpakṛtasādhanāḥ ।। 16।।
bhojanaṃ cāmṛtaṃ teṣāṃ gavāṃ dugdhaṃ phalāni ca ।
gāvaḥ kāmadughāḥ sarvāḥ pradattā hariṇā ca yāḥ ।। 17।।
tā eva saha vartante caturdaśastareṣu yat ।
na nyūnaṃ jāyate teṣāṃ nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇām ।। 18।।
yadyadapekṣyate vastu tattadbhavati tatra vai ।
śīlasantoṣatṛptyādiśālināṃ ca tapasvinām ।। 19।।
nā''san varṇāśramāstatra nāsan grāmādayastathā ।
nāsan bālādijanmāni nāsan maraṇavṛddhatāḥ ।।1.37.20।।
nāsan dehapariṇāmā nāsan gṛhanivāsinaḥ ।
nāsan kṣetrāṇi kṛṣyarthaṃ nāsan vāhanajātayaḥ ।।21।।।
nadīparvatakāsāraguhoccabhūmivāsinaḥ ।
jale kecit sthale kecitkecidvyomanivāsinaḥ ।।22।।
vāyvādhārāḥ starādhārā bāṣpādhārāśca kecana ।
siddhyādhārāstathaiśvaryādhārāḥ sarve nivāsinaḥ ।।।23।।
brahmapūjāparā brahmadhyānādiniratāśca te ।
brāhmaṇāḥ sarvalokānāmanantā yugalāḥ smṛtāḥ ।।24।।
pativratākṛtāḥ sarvāḥ kanyā hyarbudakoṭayaḥ ।
patnīvratakṛtāḥ sarve kumārāścā'bjakoṭayaḥ ।।25।
yāvantaḥ satyaloke te tāvantastāpase jane ।
maharloke ca tāvantaḥ svarge bhuvari bhūsthale ।।26।।
atale vitale tadvatsutale ca talātale ।
mahātale ca pātāle brāhmaṇyo brāhmaṇā hi vai ।।27।।।
vyavasthāstu tadā nā''san keṣāñcitkutracitprathāḥ ।
āsan snānaṃ tathā dhyānaṃ japaḥ śrīharipūjanam ।।।28।।।
ātitheyaśca satkāraḥ svādhyāyaḥ ṣaṭ ca satkriyāḥ ।
saṃkalpenopatiṣṭhanti kimarthaṃ kośarakṣaṇam ।।29।।
sarve vaikuṇṭhagantāraḥ punarāvartanā muhuḥ ।
paraloke pragantāraḥ punarāvāsasaṃgatāḥ ।।1.37.30।।
bhavantyeva yathā muktā muktānyaśca yathā sadā ।
avyāhataśarīrāste'vyāhatā'rthyapadārthakāḥ ।। 31 ।।
apratihatasaṃkalpā avyāhataśriyaśca te ।
vaikuṇṭhe brahmaṇo loke nāsīdbhedo manāgapi ।। 32।।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu nāsīd vaiṣamyamaṇvapi ।
yathā puṃsu tathā strīṣu nāsīd bhedo'ṅgamantarā ।। 32 ।।
divyadṛṣṭyā tu te sarve parasparaprabhālinaḥ ।
divyarūpairvirājante yathāsaṃkalpasaṃpadaḥ ।। 34।।
teṣāṃ tu premabhaktyā yā śrīhareḥ syātprasannatā ।
saiva dharmaḥ sadācāraḥ saivā''nandaprasādhanam ।। 35।।
sarve tu vaiṣṇavā āsannārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।
nārāyaṇaprapannāste muktāviva pariplutāḥ ।। 36।।
vasanti ca jarājanmamṛtivyādhivivarjitāḥ ।
na cintā na ca vopādhirna vighno nāstyariṣṭakam ।। 37।।
na bhāgyā''laṃbanaṃ tatrā''lambanaṃ harireva yat ।
śāsturālambanaṃ naiva śāstā śrīharireva yat ।। 38 ।।
ityevaṃ prathamaḥ kālaḥ samāraṃbhasya vartate ।
vedhaso hi mahādivyaḥ satkālaḥ sa hi vartate ।। 39।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prajāpateḥ prathamadivasīyasarvādibrāhmaṇamātrasṛṣṭinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ । । 37 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 037 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 38
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 039 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavānprabhuḥ ।
sisṛkṣurjīvasaṃghātānabhidhyānamathā'karot ।। 1 ।।
satyaloke mama sṛṣṭirmānasī sāttvikī bhavet ।
ityevaṃ dhyāyatastatra brāhmaṇāḥ sāttvikāśca ye ।। 2 ।।
ūrdhvasrotasa evaite paraṃ cordhvaṃ vyavasthitāḥ ।
vyavartanta yata ūrdhvamūrdhvasrotasa āmatāḥ । । 3 ।।
te sukhaprītibahulā antarbahiśca sadvratāḥ ।
prakāśā bahirantaśca brahmasrotasa eva ca ।। 4 ।।
ṛṣayaste sadā ṛṣerbrahmaṇo jñānasaṃbhṛteḥ ।
ṛṣervedasya vijñānādṛṣayaste sadā matāḥ । । 5 । ।
ṛṣītyeva gatau dhātu śrutau satye tapasyatha ।
etatsanniyatastasmin brāhmaṇaḥ sa ṛṣiḥ smṛtaḥ । । 6। ।
nivṛttisamakālantu buddhyā'vyaktamṛṣiḥ svayam ।
paraṃ hi ṛṣate yasmātparamarṣistataḥ smṛtaḥ । । 7। ।
gatyarthād ṛṣaterdhātornāmanirvṛttirāditaḥ ।
yasmādeṣaḥ svayaṃbhūtastasmācca ṛṣitā matā ।। 8 ।।
īśvarāḥ svayamudbhūtā mānasā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।
yasmānna hanyate mānairmahānparigataḥ puraḥ ।। 9 ।।
yasmādṛṣanti ye dhīrā mahāntaṃ sarvato guṇaiḥ ।
tasmānmaharṣayaḥ proktā buddheḥ paramadarśinaḥ ।। 1.38.1 0।।
brahmacāriṇa evaite santi vedhaḥsamāyuṣaḥ ।
bhavanti brahmaṇā tulyā rūpeṇa viṣayeṇa ca ।। 11 ।।
ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya santyaiśvaryeṇa tatsamāḥ ।
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣayastūrdhvaretasaḥ ।। 12।।।
brahmaṇo mānasāḥ sarve jātāḥ satyanivāsinaḥ ।
teṣāṃ tu nāmadheyāni yathāpekṣaṃ dadhātyajaḥ ।। 1 3।।।
athā'bhidhyāyataḥ sargo jñānasroto'bhyavartata ।
ṛṣayo jñānino divyā jñānātmabalapūrvakāḥ ।। 14।।
saṃnyāsā brahmarandhrāttu brahmaṇaḥ samajajñire ।
vaikhānasā bālakhilyā audumbarāśca phenapāḥ ।। 15।।
kuṭīcakāśca bahvodā haṃsāḥ paramahaṃsakāḥ ।
aṣṭau saṃnyāsino bhedāstatrā''dyāstu sahasraśaḥ ।। 16।।
santi ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi bālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ ।
tadanye koṭiśo bodhyā audumbaraprabhatiyaḥ ।। 17।।
athā'bhidhyāyatastasya ṛbhuragnirbabhūvatuḥ ।
punaśca dhyāyatastasya daśa putrāḥ prajajñire ।। 18।।
lokasantānakartāro jñānavijñānavidvarāḥ ।
marīciratryaṃgirasau pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।। 19।।
bhagurvaśiṣṭho dakṣaśca daśamastatra nāradaḥ ।
utsaṃgānnārado jajñe dakṣoṃ'guṣṭhāttu vedhasaḥ ।।1.38.20।।
prāṇādvaśiṣṭhaḥ saṃjāto bhṛgustvacaḥ karāt kratuḥ ।
pulaho nābhito jajñe pulastyaḥ karṇayorṛṣiḥ ।।।21।।।
aṃgirā mukhato'kṣṇo'trirmarīcirmanaso'bhavat ।
puṇyastu dakṣiṇastanāt pāpo jātastu pṛṣṭhataḥ ।।22।।
chāyāyāḥ kardamo jajñe trayaste'pi ca mānasāḥ ।
athā'bhidhyāyato jajñe svāyaṃbhuvamanustathā ।।23।।।
śatarūpā ca tatpatnī dampatī tau babhūvatuḥ ।
tābhyāṃ mithunadharmeṇa prajā hyedhāmbabhūvire ।।24।।
athā'bhidhyāyatastasya jajñire ṛṣayastvime ।
vaṃśavistārayitāro lokasantānahetavaḥ ।।25।।
yuge tu prathame sarva mānasāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ।
kalpāntare tu te kecijjāyante vaṃśajā api ।।26।।
yonijā'yonijatve tu viṣṇoricchaiva kāraṇam ।
yeṣāṃ yatra yadā'pekṣā tadā tānprerayatyapi ।।27।।
diśaḥ kāvyāni rāgāśca sūkṣmāṇi viṣayāṇi ca ।
indriyāṇi tathā prāṇā brahmaṇo mānasāni vai ।।28।।
ruciragnistathā medhā brahmaṇo mānasāśca te ।
kāvyo bṛhaspatiścaiva kaśyapaścośanāstathā ।।29।।
utathyo vāmadevaśca sayojyaścauśijastathā ।
kardamo viśravāḥ śaktirbālakhilyāstathā'dharāḥ ।।1.38.30 ।।
śvetaśca ṛṣayo jñānānmānasā brahmaṇo matāḥ ।
vatsaro nagrahūścaiva bhāradvājo'nalāyanaḥ ।।।3 1।।
bṛhadukthaḥ śaradvāँśca hyagastyaścauśijastathā ।
ṛṣirdīrghatamāścaiva bṛhadgranthaḥ śaradvataḥ ।।32।।
vājaśravāḥ suvittaśca suvāg veṣaparāyaṇaḥ ।
dadhīcaḥ śaṃkhamāँścaiva rājā vaiśravaṇastathā ।।33 ।।
ete'pi mānasāḥ sarve satyena ṛṣayo matāḥ ।
bhṛguḥ kāvyaḥ pracetāstu dadhīco hyātmavānapi ।।34।।
aurvo'tha jamadagniśca vidaḥ sārasvatastathā ।
adviṣeṇo hyarūpaśca vītahavyaḥ sumedhasaḥ ।।।35।।
vāstuḥ pṛthurdivodāsaḥ paśvāsyo gṛtsamānnabhaḥ ।
atrirarcisanaścaiva śyāmavāँścātha niṣṭhuraḥ ।।36।।
valgūtako munirdhīmāँstathā pūrvātithiśca yaḥ ।
ityete mānasāḥ pūrve mantraiste ṛṣayo matāḥ ।।37।।
aṃgirā vaidhasaścaiva bhāradvājo'tha bāṣkaliḥ ।
amṛtaśca tathā gārgyaḥ śyenī saṃhṛtirityapi ।।38।।
purukutsaśca ṛṣabhaḥ kaṇvaścaivā'tha mudgalaḥ ।
utathyaśca bharadvājastathā vājaśravā api ।।39।।
āpyāyaśca suvittiśca vāmadevastathaiva ca ।
kakṣivānaugajo dīrghatapā vyāsaśca devalaḥ ।।1.38.40।।
kaśyapo vibhramo raibhyo'sitaścaiva parāśaraḥ ।
vaśiṣṭho yājñavalkyaśca maitrāvaruṇa eva ca ।।41।।
indrapramītiḥ kuṇḍiśca kuśaśca pippalāyanaḥ ।
gopālaḥ kambharā ceti dampatī brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ ।।42।।
ityāsan mānasāḥ pūrve paścātte yonijā api ।
anye'pi mānasāḥ paścājātā yonisamudbhavāḥ ।।।43।।
teṣāṃ vaṃśapravaṃśāścā'bhavan yaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat ।
kalpe kalpe prajāyante'nye'nye brahmājñayā punaḥ ।।44।।
lokasaṃgrahakartārastataḥ satyaṃ prayānti te ।
vedhaḥsālokyasāyuṣyasārṣṭibhājo bhavanti ca ।।45।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyalokīyaṛṣyādimānasīsṛṣṭikathanaṃnāmā'ṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।38।।


← adhyāyaḥ 038 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 39
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 040 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi pitṝँstu mānasān bahūn।
brahmaṇaḥ sṛjataḥ putrān jajñire pitaro'sya vai ।। 1 ।।
madhvādyaḥ ṣaḍṛtavaḥ pitaraḥ samajajñire ।
agniṣvāttāstathā bārhiṣadāste mānasāḥ khalu ।। 2 ।।
ājyapāḥ somapāścaite pitaro mānasā api ।
ayajvānastathā teṣāmāsanvai gṛhamedhinaḥ ।। 3 ।।
agniṣvāttāstu ye te vai pitaro'nāhitāgnayaḥ ।
yajvānasteṣu ye te tu pitaraḥ somapīthinaḥ ।। 4 ।।
ye ca bārhiṣadāste vai pitarastvagnihotriṇaḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaite brahmasaṃkalpajā hi te ।। 5 ।।
madhumādhavau rasāktau śuciśukrau tu śuṣmiṇau ।
nabhanabhasyau jivāviṣorjau tu sudhayā plutau ।। 6 ।।
sahasahasyau samanyū tapastapasyau ghorakau ।
ta ime ṛtavo dvandvāḥ kāryakāraṇarūpiṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tatra ye brahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāste'bhimāninaḥ ।
kāryasthalaṃ kalākāṣṭhāmāsasaṃvatsarādikam ।। 8 ।।
sthāninastvabhimānajñāścetanāḥ pitaro hi te ।
saṃvatsaro mahān kālastatputrāḥ ṛtavaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 9 ।।
yugāḥ kalpāstu ye te tu mahattara mahattamāḥ ।
kāryakāraṇarūpā vai pitaro brahmasūdbhavāḥ ।। 1.39.1 0।।
ṛtvātmajā dinādyā ārtavāsteṣāṃ kalādayaḥ ।
ārtaveyāḥ sutāḥ sthāneśvarāḥ sthātmakā api ।। 1 1।।
prajāpatiḥ svayaṃ brahmā saṃvatsarādirūpadhṛk ।
saṃvatsaraḥ svayamagnirṛtamityarthakastu saḥ ।। 1 2।।
ṛtāttu ṛtavastebhyo māsāśca ārtavā matāḥ ।
dvipadāṃ ca catuṣpadāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ sarpatāṃ tathā ।। 1 3।।
sthāvarāṇāṃ ca yatpuṣpaṃ tadvai kālārtavaṃ matam ।
kāryahetvorabhedāśca nāmaikyaṃ pitṛbodhakam ।। 14।।
ityevaṃ pitaro jñeyā ṛtavaścārtavāstathā ।
sarvabhūtāni tebhyo'tha ṛtukālātprajajñire ।। 15।।
tasmādete'pi pitaraḥ ārtavā brahmaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
jajñāte'tha ca pitṛbhyaḥ kanye menā ca dhāraṇī ।। 1 6।।
yoginyau brahmavādinyau pitryau te cāpi sammate ।
bārhiṣadāstu tāṃ menāṃ patnīṃ himavate daduḥ ।। 17।।
maināko menayā jāto dhāraṇyā mandarastataḥ ।
kanyā velā niyatiśca āyatiścāpi jajñire ।। 18 ।।
dhātuścaivā''yatiḥ patnī vidhāturniyatiḥ smṛtā ।
suṣuve sāgarādvelā sāmudrīṃ kanyakāṃ śubhām ।। 19 ।।
sāvarṇinā ca sāmudrī suṣuve daśaputrakān ।
prācīnabarhiṣaste va pracetasa iti daśa ।।1.39.20 ।।
tebhyo'tha kanyakāṃ vārkṣī dadurvakṣāstataḥ param ।
prācetaso'bhavad dakṣaḥ, dakṣāntāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 21 ।।
patnyaśca tāḥ pitryo bahvyastapoloke vasanti vai ।
sarvā sā mānasī sṛṣṭirmanvantare tu yonijāḥ ।। 22।।
athāpi satyalokasthā ye vai ṛṣaya īritāḥ ।
teṣāṃ vaṃśeṣu cotpannāḥ pitaraste'pi kīrtitāḥ ।। 23 ।।
bhṛguraṃgirā marīciḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।
atriścaiva vaśiṣṭhaśca hyaṣṭau te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ । ।24।।
ebhistu mānasaiḥ putrairbrahmaṇā preritaistadā ।
utpāditāstapolokavāsinaḥ pitarastathā ।।25।।
te bhārgavāścāṃgīraso mārīcāśca tathā pare ।
paulastyāḥ paulahāścaiva krātavāśca tathā pare ।। 26 ।।
ātreyāśca tathā vāśiṣṭhā iti lokaviśrutāḥ ।
pitṝṇā te gaṇāḥ proktāstapolokanivāsinaḥ ।। 27 ।।
tatra kecidamūrtāśca prakāśāśca tathā'pare ।
jyotiṣmantastathā cānye bhavanti pitaro hi te ।। 28 ।।
dakṣaputrāśca haryaśvāḥ śavalāśvāstathā punaḥ ।
daśasāhasrasaṃkhyākāḥ sahasrāṇi ca paṃca ca ।। 29।।
te sārdhaikasahasraṃ vai sarve tu brahmavarcasaḥ ।
ete tapaḥpathaṃ prāpya vartante tapāasthitāḥ ।। 1.39.30 । ।
nāradasyopadeśena brahmā'nveṣaṇatatparāḥ ।
tapolokamupāgamya tiṣṭhanti divyakāntayaḥ ।। 31 ।।
ta ete pitaraḥ sarvai prajākalyāṇakārakāḥ ।
ṛbhuḥ sanatkumārādyāḥ kvacittiṣṭhanti tāpase ।। 32।।
tapasi kāryavāhārthaṃ, dhyānārthaṃ tu sati sthitā ।
marīciḥ kaśyapo dakṣo vaśiṣṭhaścāṃgirā bhṛguḥ ।। 33 ।।
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kraturityevamādayaḥ ।
pūrvaṃ tu samprasūyante brāhmaṇo manasā saha ।। 34। ।
tataḥ prajāḥ pratiṣṭhāpya janamevā''śrayanti te ।
yāmādayo gaṇāḥ sarve maharlokanivāsinaḥ ।।35।।
maharlokavināśe tu janamevā''śrayanti te ।
sarve sūkṣmaśarīrāste tatra gatvā bhavanti hi ।।36।।
teṣāṃ te tulyasāmarthyāstulyamūrtidharāstathā ।
janaloke vivartante yāvadrātristu vedhasaḥ ।।37।।
tatrāpi pūrvakalpānāṃ puṇyakhyātibalānvitāḥ ।
prajāpataya ye cā''sannivṛttādhipatitvataḥ ।।38।।
nivṛttavṛttayaḥ sarvai svasthāḥ sumanasastathā ।
tapolokaṃ prapadyante janamutsṛjya taiḥ saha ।।।39।।
manvantarāṇāṃ ca svāyaṃbhuvādyānāṃ jane sthitiḥ ।
vinivṛttādhikārāṇāṃ devānāṃ mahasi sthitiḥ ।।1.39.40।।
śukrādyāścākṣuṣāntāśca manvantarā bhavanti ye ।
te maharlokasaṃsthāśca brahmamānasasaṃbhavāḥ ।।41 ।।
marīciḥ kaśyapo dakṣastathā svāyaṃbhuvoṃ'girāḥ ।
bhṛguḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kraturityevamādayaḥ ।।42।।
lokayātrāpravāhāya maharloke'pi yānti hi ।
prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve vartante tatra taiḥ saha ।।43।।
satyasthā api kāryārthamiha cāyāntyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ ।
kāryaṃ sampādyate sarve punaryānti svakaṃ gṛham ।।44।।
lokāḥ somapadā nāma maharjanamiti smṛtāḥ ।
pitarastatra vartante hyagniṣvāttādayaśca te ।।45।।
vasavaścāpi vartanti amāvasvādayastu te ।
susūkṣmā agnisphulliṃgā te vai pitaro devatāḥ ।।46।।
virajāyāstu ye putrā vairājā nāma te gaṇāḥ ।
agniṣvāttāḥ smṛtāstatra pitaro bhāsvaraprabhāḥ ।।47।।
svadhāputrāstathā svāhāputrā ye jyotibhāsvarāḥ ।
marīcigarbhāste tatra pitaro hyagnirūpiṇaḥ ।।48।।
ājyapā nāma pitaro ye bhavanti vihaṃgamāḥ ।
mānasā nāma tallokā bhavanti yatra te sthitāḥ ।।49।।
virajasya tu putrā ye vairājā nāmato matāḥ ।
bhāsvarāḥ puṇyabhakṣyāśca hyamūrtaya gaṇāstu te ।।1.39.50।।
pitṝṇāṃ yā duhitaro dauhitrāśca tu ye matāḥ ।
pitaro vaṃśavistārā bodhyā bhinnanivāsinaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
pṛthvyāṃ sādhvīsādhurūpā antarikṣe'nilātmakāḥ ।
svarge devātmakā maharjanatapassu mānasāḥ ।।।52।।
pitaraḥ saṃvasantīti mūrtā'mūrtasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
ādidevāstu te sarve mahāsattvā mahaujasaḥ ।।53।।
sarvakāmapradāstṛptā ruṣṭāḥ sarvaharā matāḥ ।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena toṣaṇīyāḥ sadā hi te ।।54।।
maharādau sthitā ye vai teṣāṃ siddhistu mānasī ।
sadyaścotpadyate teṣāṃ manasā sarvamīpsitam ।।55।।
ityevaṃ tu priye lakṣmi! sarve maharṣayaḥ sthitāḥ ।
tapoloke janaloke pitaraḥ sarvathā sthitāḥ ।।56।।
maharloke lokapālā rudrāḥ prajeśvarāstathā ।
manavaḥ pitaraścaiva yathākāryaṃ samasthitāḥ ।।।57।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne maharjanatapolokeṣu mānasīsṛṣṭipitṝṇāṃ nirdeśanāmā ekonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।39।।


← adhyāyaḥ 039 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
pitaraḥ katidhā bodhyāḥ kiṃ deyaṃ kiṃ phalaṃ tathā ।
abhisandhāya pitaraṃ pituśca pitaraṃ tathā ।। 1 ।।
pituḥ pitāmahaṃ caiva triṣu piṇḍeṣu nāmataḥ ।
kāni śrāddhāni deyāni kathaṃ gacchanti vai pitṝn ।। 2 ।।
bhuvi bhuvari svarge vā duḥkhinaḥ sukhino'pi vā ।
pūrvajā dehamāpannā bhaveyuḥ pitaro na vā ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva jīvāścāpi hyanekaśaḥ ।
karmaloke samāgamya kṛtvā karmāṇi bhūriśaḥ ।। 4 ।।
jāyante pitaraste vai pṛthvyādilokavāsinaḥ ।
kecitpṛthvyāṃ saṃvasanti tiṣṭhantyanye bhuvaḥ stare ।। 5 ।।
te tu sarve vāsanābhirjātā''kasmikamṛtyavaḥ ।
kecitsvarge tu gacchanti ye vai puṇyaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 6 ।।
kecinmaharjanatapolokānprayānti puṇyataḥ ।
somalokaṃ sūryalokaṃ vidyullokaṃ tathā pare ।। 7 ।।
agnilokaṃ cendralokaṃ nakṣatrādigrahastarān ।
yānti puṇyānusāreṇa devāste pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 8 ।।
bhavanti pitaro devā devāśca pitaraḥ punaḥ ।
lokāḥ sāntānikā nāma pitṝṇāṃ bhāsvarā matāḥ ।। 9 ।।
yatra kvāpi sthitān pitṝn smaranti vaṃśajāstu yān ।
sāntānikaistu pitṛbhistatrā''gantavyameva yat ।। 1.40.10 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ tu bhavedrājā somaścā'pyaryamā tathā ।
aryamā kiraṇaiḥ somamuttejayati cā'nvaham ।। 1 1।।
somaśca kiraṇaiḥ sarvamāpyāyayati vai jagat ।
tasmāśca pitaraḥ sarve somaṃ tṛpyanti cā''pya vai ।। 12।।
somaṃ tu pitaraṃ śrāddhairāpyāyya tṛptimāpnuyuḥ ।।
somalokanivāsā ye pitaraḥ somajīvanāḥ ।। 13।।
śrāddhairāpyāyitaḥ somo lokonāpyāyayiṣyati ।
kṛtsnaṃ saparvatavanaṃ jaṃgamājaṃgamairvṛtam ।। 14।।
śrāddhāni puṣṭikāmāśca ye kariṣyanti mānavāḥ ।
tebhyaḥ puṣṭiṃ prajāścaiva dāsyanti pitaraḥ sadā ।। 11।।
śrāddhe yebhyaḥ pradāsyanti trīn piṇḍān nāmagotrataḥ ।
sarvatra vartamānāste pitaraḥ prapitāmaham ।। 16।।
teṣāmāpyāyayiṣyanti śrāddhadānena ca prajāḥ ।
sukhino duḥkhino vāpi pitarastu savāsanaḥ ।। 17।।
tebhyo'vaśyaṃ jalamannaṃ deyaṃ śaktyā tu vaṃśajaiḥ ।
pitarastena tṛptāḥ syuḥ sumūrtā vāpyamūrtayaḥ ।। 18।।
teṣāṃ sapta samākhyātā gaṇāstrailokyapūjitāḥ ।
amūrtayastrayasteṣāṃ catvārastu samūrtayaḥ ।। 19।।
upariṣṭāt trayasteṣāṃ vartante bhāvamūrtayaḥ ।
teṣāmadhastād vartante catvāraḥ sūkṣmamūrtayaḥ ।।1.40.20।।
śraddhayā bhāvanayā ca tṛpyanti bhāvamūrtayaḥ ।
annādipuṇyatṛptāste bhavanti sūkṣmamūrtayaḥ ।।।2 1।।
manojavāḥ svadhābhaktāḥ sarvadeya suvastavaḥ ।
annaṃ somaṃ ca saṃlabdhvā''pyāyante tṛptamānasāḥ ।।22।।।
tatra śrāddhe jalānnaiste tṛpyanti dānabhāvanaiḥ ।
jñānino viṣṇubhaktāste brahmārpaṇakriyādibhiḥ ।।23।।
pūrṇayugasahasrānte jāyante brahmavādinaḥ ।
utsṛjya dehajātāni mokṣaṃ gacchantyamūrtayaḥ ।।।24।।
kriyayā gurupūjābhistṛpyanti tu samūrtayaḥ ।
śrāddhe tṛptāḥ punaḥ somaṃ pibanti pitaraśca te ।।25।।
sahasraśastu viprānvai sādhūn bālāँśca bhojayet ।
tṛpyanti pitarasteṣāṃ sādhvīnāṃ bhojanena ca ।।26।।
viprāṇāṃ tu sahasreṇa snātakānāṃ śatena ca ।
anāthānāṃ sahasreṇa vānaprasthaśatena ca ।।27।।
sādhvī caikā sādhureko bhojane tu viśiṣyate ।
sādhuḥ sādhvī harerbālau jñānadhyānamayau yataḥ ।।28।।
divyau mokṣakarau tuṣṭau yoginau brahmatanmayau ।
putraḥ pautraḥ prapautro vā bālau tau bhojayiṣyati ।।29।।
pitarastasya tṛpyanti suvṛṣṭeneva karṣukaḥ ।
alābhe sādhusādhvīnāṃ bhojayed brahmacāriṇau ।।1.40.30।।
tadalābhe tu dauhitraṃ hyatithiṃ cāpi bhojayet ।।
siddhāśca guptarūpeṇa caranti bahudhā'nvaham ॥31॥
sādhusādhvīsvarūpaṃ tamatithiṃ pūjayetsadā ।
urvī sāgaraparyantāṃ devā yogeśvarāstathā ॥32॥
nānārūpaiścarantyete prajādharmaprapālakāḥ ।
siddhāḥ santaśca sādhvyaśca vicaranti mahītale ॥33॥
lakṣmīnārāyaṇarūpāsteṣāṃ pūjanamācaret ।
dadyācca bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ vyaṃjanāni phalāni ca ।।34॥
devāśca pitaraścaica vahriścā'tithirūpakān ।
āviśya bhuṃjate tadvai pūjayeda tithīnsadā ॥35॥
bālānabhyāgatān khinnānsādhūn sādhvīrnirāśrayān ।
bhaktāँśca yācakān jānīyādatithyātmakān sadā ॥36॥
abhyāgato yācakaḥ syādatithiḥ syādayācakaḥ ।
pipāsināya śrāntāya bhrāntāyā'tibubhukṣate ॥37॥
viduṣe sādhave sādhvyai bālāyā'nāśrayāya ca ।
tasmai satkṛtya dātavyaṃ yajñasya phalamicchatā ॥38॥
sādhavaśca mahātmānaḥ śrāddhe satkṛtya pūjitā ।।
mokṣaṃ yogamathaiśvaryaṃ prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ ॥39॥
sarveṣāṃ rājataiḥ pātrairapi vā rajatānvitaiḥ ।
dattaṃ svadhāṃ purodhāya tathā prīṇāti vai pitṝn ॥1.40.40॥
pitṝn prīṇāti vai bhaktyā pitaraḥ prīṇayanti tam ।।
pitaraḥ puṣṭikāmasya pūjākāmasya vā punaḥ ॥41॥
puṣṭi prajāṃ ca susvargaṃ prayacchanti na saṃśayaḥ ।।
vimānāni sahasrāṇi yuktānyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ ॥42॥
sarvakāmaprasiddhāni prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ ।।
prajñāṃ puṣṭiṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ rājyamārogyamityapi ॥43॥
muktāvaidūryavāsāṃsi vājināgā'yutāni ca ।
koṭiśaścāpi ratnāni prayacchanti pitāmahāḥ ॥44॥
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ pitṝṇāṃ pātramucyate ।
rajataṃ rajatāktaṃ vā pitṝṇāṃ pātramuttamam ॥45॥
rajatasya kathā vāpi darśanaṃ dānameva ca ।
anantamakṣayaṃ svargyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dānamucyate ॥46॥
pitṝnetena dānena satpātrāstārayantyuta ।।
kāṃcanaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ dauhitraḥ kutapāstilāḥ ॥47॥
vastraṃ ca pāvanīyāni sādhvī ca sādhurityapi ।
prīyante pitaro yena bhojyena surasena ca ॥48॥
tāni teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradāni vai ।।
śrāddhakāle subhojyāni pitṝṇāṃ toṣaṇāya vai ॥49॥
paramānnaṃ dugdhapākaḥ pūrikāḥ polikāstathā ।
śatacchidrāṇyapūpāśca miṣṭāḥ pūraṇapolikāḥ ॥1.40.50॥
rutalyaśca tathā ghāripūrikāśca praroṭakāḥ ।।
phāphaṭāḥ sthirakāścaiva ghṛtacūrṇā guḍaudanāḥ ॥51॥
śaśkulyaḥ khājakāścaiva saṃyāvo modakāstathā ।
kaṃsāraḥ parpikākhaṇḍāḥ piṇḍakā granthakāstathā ॥52॥
kalikālaḍaḍukāścāpi kalikāḥ sevikāstathā ।
sohālikā maṇḍakāśca vaṭikā ghṛtapūraṇāḥ ॥53॥
pūpāśca mauktikāścaiva śāṭakāḥ sūtrapheṇikāḥ ।।
sukhadāḥ śālipiṣṭāśca mudgamodakaghurgharāḥ ॥54॥
tilaśrṛṃkhā gundrapākaḥ pītasārāśca śarkarāḥ ।।
meśubho mohanasthāla odanaḥ puṣpavaṭṭikāḥ ॥55॥
nivārāśca yavāścaiva rājagarvādayastathā ।।
śrṛṃgāṭakā raktālavo vaṭāṇā dvidalāstathā ॥56॥
vhālāśca parpaṭāścaiva parpaṭyaḥ kvathikā dadhi ।
harinmāṣāśca mudgāśca tuvaryaścaiva dugdhakam ॥57॥
śākāni tvaṅlavaṃgailāsaṃskṛtāni madhūni ca ।
gavāhārā bhiṇḍakāśca raktālavaśca cirbhaṭāḥ ॥58॥
karkaṭyaḥ kāravellāśca kūṣmāṇḍāḥ sūraṇastathā ।
vṛntākaḥ śarkarākandaḥ śimbikākharbujastathā ।।59॥
paṭolā gaṇḍakāścāpi ghṛtaṣoḍhāḥ parāvalāḥ ।।
lūnikā methikā rājñī jīvantī suvamūlakāḥ ॥1.40.60॥
tāṇḍulājyo hyamblalūnī rājagrahaśca dugdhikā ।
kunarāḥ śarkarātiktāḥ patravalyraśca naikadhā ॥61॥
vṛntākabharjanaṃ cāpi caṭanyo navanītakam ।
dhānyākākauthumībuddhihīnānāṃ caṭanī tathā ॥6॥
drākṣākhārikakadalai rājikātiktavastujam ।
dadhyāktaṃ rājikārāddhamāranālānyanekadhā ॥63॥
miṣṭānnāni navānyeva bhojyākāni varāṇi ca ।।
peyāni miṣṭamiśrāṇi sugandhīni rasāni ca ॥64॥
ikṣunāraṃgakadalajambīrāṅgudasanturāḥ।
seturā'mṛtasaphalajananaspatijāmbavaḥ ॥65।।
iṅgudīnārikelā''mrapanasalipsikācikāḥ।
badarāṅgurapūpīyā'nānasā''malakāstathā ॥66॥
rāmaphalapapanasasītāphalasubilvakāḥ ।
phalānyetāni tāmbūlapūgīvarīyasītvacaḥ ॥67॥
jalaṃ tu tīrthasaṃbhūtaṃ puṣpāṇi susugandhayaḥ ।।
deyaṃ śrāddhe viśeṣeṇa pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave ॥68॥
yena pradīyate yasmai yattṛptyarthaṃ ca yatra vai ।।
triṣvatra bhagavān sākṣād dātā grahītā nāyakaḥ ॥69।।
yajamānena svarūpaṃ dātāraṃ vyāpakaṃ harim ।।
vibhāvya pātrarūpāya haraye deyameva ha ॥1.40.70||
sa harirvyāpakaḥ śrīmān pitaryapi suvartate ।।
sarvatra tu hareryogāt tṛptistu pitṛṇāṃ bhavet ।।71।।
pitṝṇāṃ nāma vyāhṛtyaḥ dātavyaṃ haribuddhitaḥ ।।
akṣayyā sā bhavet tṛptiḥ svalpamapyatulaṃ bhavet ॥72॥
kanyakā vidhavā nāryo vṛddhā ādhāravarjitāḥ ।
saubhāgyā bhojanīyāśca śrāddhe phalamanantakam ॥73॥
grāmo dhūmranirodhena bhojanīyāḥ phalārthinā ।
yajñādhikaṃ phalaṃ tasya bhujyante paśupakṣibhiḥ ।।74।।
jalasthaiścāpi bhujyante yatra kīṭādibhistathā ।
śrāddhaḥ sarvāntarātmātmā sārvabhaumaḥ sa kathyate ॥75।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vividhapitṛtatpātra-taddeyānnaphalādi-tatprāptiphalādivarṇananāmā catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 40 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 040 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 41
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 042 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
prīyante pitaro yena japyena niyamena ca ।
stotraṃ teṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
śrāddhakāle pravaktavyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ toṣaṇāya tat ।।
yajamānena putreṇa brāhmaṇena susādhunā ।। 2 ।।
amūrtānāṃ samūrtānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām ।।
namasyāmi sadā tāँstu dhyānino yogacakṣuṣaḥ ।। 3 ।।
indrāderjanayitāro bhṛgumārīcayostathā ।
saptarṣīṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tānnamasyāmi kāmadān ।। 4 ।।
manvādīnāṃ sureśānāṃ sūryācandramasorapi ।
janayitṝnnamasyāmi pitṝn kuśaladāyakān ॥ 5 ॥
nakṣatrāṇāṃ carādīnāṃ pitṝnatha pitāmahān ।।
dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ pitṝँśca namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ ।।6।।
devarṣīṇāṃ janayitan sarvalokanamaskṛtān ।।
abhayasya sadā dātṝn namasye'haṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 7 ।।
prajeśāya kaśyapāya somāya varuṇāya ca ।।
yogayogeśvarebhyaśca namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥ 8 ॥
pitṛgaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu ।।
svayaṃbhuve namastasmai brahmaṇe yogacakṣuṣe ॥ 9 ॥
anena stotravareṇa trīnvarāँllabhate janaḥ ।।
annamāyuḥ sutāँścaiva dadate pitaraḥ sukhāḥ ॥1.41.10॥
yat kiñcitpacyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ bhojyādikaṃ tathā ।
anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ devapitṛbhya ityapi ॥11॥
pitṛbhyo yastu mālyāni sugandhīni ca sarvaśaḥ ।।
sadā dadyācchriyā yuktaḥ sa vibhāti divākaraḥ ॥12॥
gugulādīṃstathā dhūpān pitṛbhyo yaḥ prayacchati ।।
saṃyuktānmadhusarpibhyāṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥13॥
dhūpaṃ gandhaguṇopetaṃ kāntaṃ pitṛparāyaṇam ।
labhate strīṣvapatyāni hīha cāmutra cobhayoḥ ॥14।।
dīpaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ prayataḥ sadā yastu prayacchati ।।
sa loke'pratimaṃ cakṣurlabhate divyadṛṣṭidam ॥15॥
tejasā yaśasā caiva kāntyā cāpi balena ca ।
svayaṃprakāśo bhavati bhrājate ca triviṣṭape ॥16॥
apsarobhiḥ parivṛto vimānāgre tu modite ।।
gandhān puṣpāṇi dhūpāँśca dadyādājyāhutīśca vai ॥17॥
phalamūlanamaskāraiḥ pitṝṇāṃ prītimāvahet ।
śrāddhakāle tu satataṃ vāyubhūtāḥ pitāmahāḥ ॥18॥
āviśanti dvijānsādhūn sādhvīrdṛṣṭvā ca harṣataḥ ।।
vastrairannaiḥ pradānaiśca bhakṣyairbhojyaistathaiva ca ॥19॥
pānairgobhistathā grāmaiḥ pūjayet pātrasaṃsthitān ।
kāśāḥ punarbhavā ye ca barhiṇā upabarhiṇā ॥1.41.20॥
ta eva pitaro devā devāśca pitaraḥ punaḥ ।।
dvijātyabhimukho dadyād darbhān piṇḍaॉśca yatnataḥ ।।21।।
athā''hṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato homo vidhīyate ।
agnaye kavyavāhāya svadhā cāṃgirase namaḥ ।।22।।
somāya vai pitṛmate svadhā cāṃgirase namaḥ ।।
yamāya caivāṃgirase svadhā nama iti bruvan ।।23।।
bahuhavyatvamevā'gnau susamiddhe viśeṣataḥ ।।
vidhūme lelihāne ca hotavyaṃ karmasiddhaye ॥24॥
aprabuddhe sadhūme ca juhuyād yo hutāśane ।।
yajamāno bhavedandhaḥ so'putro bhavatītyapi ॥25॥
alpendhano vā rūkṣo vā visphulliṃgaśca sarvaśaḥ ।।
jvālādhūmo'pasavyaśca sa tu vahnirna siddhaye ॥26॥
durgandhaścaiva nīlaśca kṛṣṇaścaiva viśeṣataḥ ।।
bhūmiṃ vigāhate yatra tatra vidyātparābhavam ॥27॥
arciṣmān piṇḍitaśikhaḥ sarpiṣkāṃcanasaṃbhavaḥ ।।
snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇaścaiva vahniḥ syātkāryasiddhaye ॥28॥
anujñātaḥ kuruṣveti tathaiva dvijasattamaiḥ ।।
patnīmādāya putrāँśca juhuyāddhavyavāhanam ॥29॥
samānaplakṣīnyagrodhaplakṣā'śvatthavikaṃkatāḥ।
udumbarāstathā bilvacandanā yajñagā samidh ॥1.41.30॥
saralo devadāruśca śālaśca khadirastathā ।।
samidarthaṃ praśastāḥ syurete vṛkṣā viśeṣataḥ ।।31।।
viśvedevāśca ye proktā hyete'pi pitaro hyuta ।।
teṣāmājyaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ ca vahnau dadyātprayatnataḥ ।।3।।
puṣpāṇāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca bhakṣyānnānāṃ tathaiva ca ।।
agramuddhṛtya sarveṣāṃ juhuyājjātavedasi ॥33॥
tīrthe homaśca piṇḍāśca śrāddhaṃ kartavyamādarāt ।
devālayo gurorvāsaḥ parvatāḥ saritastathā ।। 34।।
puṇyavṛkṣāstaḍāgāni yatra vā brāhmaṇo bhavet ।।
te te śrāddhārhadeśāḥ syustatra puṇyamasaṃkhyakam ॥35॥
pṛthvīṃ sāgaravelāntāṃ divyāḥ satpuruṣāḥ sadā ।।
nānārūpaiścarantyatra teṣāṃ yogāttu mokṣaṇam ॥36॥
siddhāḥ santaśca sādhvyaśca tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam ।
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaścātra tadrūpeṣu vasatyaram ॥37॥
pipāsitāya śrāntāya kṣudhitāya vivastriṇe ।
satkṛtya kiṃcid dātavyaṃ yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt ॥38॥
śrāddhe sthūlaḥ sthūlamatti pitaro'danti sukṛtam ।
tṛptimātmā svayaṃ bhuṃkte'nvitabrahmasamarpaṇāt ॥39॥
karmaloke tu kṛtvaiva datvaiva ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
pare loke hyavāpyante tasmād deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ॥1.41.40॥
yeṣāṃ dāsyanti piṇḍāँstrīn bāndhavā nāmagotrataḥ ।।
bhūmau kuśottarāyāṃ ca brāhmaṇoktavidhānataḥ ।।41।।
sarvatra vartamānāँste piṇḍāḥ prīṇanti vai pitṝn ।
yadāhāro bhavejanturāhāraḥ so'sya jāyate ॥42॥
yā goṣṭhe pranaṣṭāṃ vai vatso vindati mātaram ।
tathā taṃ nayate mantro janturyatrā'vatiṣṭhate ।।43॥
nāma gotraṃ ca mantraśca dattamannaṃ nayanti tam ।।
api yoniśataṃ prāptāँstṛptistānanugacchati ।।44॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne stotrahomāgnivṛkṣasthānādinirūpaṇanāmā ekacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥


← adhyāyaḥ 041 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 42
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 043 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
atha devavyavasthāṃ tu kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।।
brahmaṇo mānasā devāḥ svarge sarve susaṃsthitāḥ ।। 1 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! pravakṣyāmi tataḥ kiṃ kimabhūditi ।
sattapojanamahasāṃ pitṝṇāṃ puṣṭikārakāḥ ॥ 2 ॥
apekṣitāśca rājānaḥ prajānāṃ paripālakāḥ ।।
lokānāṃ pālakāścaiva manavo'pi nirīkṣakāḥ ।। 3 ।।
teṣāṃ kṛte nivāsāśca prakāśāḥ puṣṭihetavaḥ ।।
vicāryeti svayaṃ brahmā hyabhidhyānamakurvata ।। 4 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ smṛtvā kartavyaṃ pratyapadyata ।।
prathamaṃ tu mahattejaḥ pākaprakāśakārakam ।।5।।
dvitīyaṃ tu mahattejaḥ śakti puṣṭikaraṃ tathā ।
prārthayacchrīharestasmāt samādhau prāṃjalirmudā ।। 6 ।।
tadā prāgeva dakṣādvai netrāttu śrīharestataḥ ।
kaṇastu tejaso jajñe brahmāṇḍānāṃ prakāśakaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tasmātkaṇā hyasaṃkhyātā jātāścogratamāstataḥ ।
te'pi tattadvirañcīnāṃ brahmāṇḍeṣu praveśitāḥ ॥ 8 ॥
tatra tatra ca sūryāste jātāstejomayā iti ।
evaṃ sūryaṃ samāsādya vedhasā parameṣṭhinā ।। 9 ।।
prakāśārthaṃ ca lokānāṃ svarge saṃsthāpito hi saḥ ।।
tasmai cājñāpayāmāsa brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ॥1.42.10॥
sarvadā tvaṃ trilokyāṃ vai bhāskaro bhava tejasā ।
jīvānāṃ netramātrāṇi vastūnāṃ grāhakāṇi na ॥11॥
yatra nāsti prakāśo'tra vastūnāṃ grāhyatā katham ।
tasmāt tejaḥsuyogena draṣṭṛtvaṃ vai bhaviṣyati ।।12।।
tena lokasya yātrāpi sarvā darśanamūlikā ।
sampatsyate tu vai tasmāt tvaṃ divākaratāṃ vraja ॥13॥
evamājñāpitaḥ sūryastejodānena sarvathā ।
śaṃkamānaḥ kṣayaṃ svasya brahmāṇaṃ pratyabhāṣata ॥14॥
devadeva jagatkartastvadājñāṃ pālayāmyaham ।।
api vai mama dehasya tejohāsāt kṣayo bhavet ॥15॥
vināśaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi śīghraṃ yadrakṣako bhava ।
rakṣaṇopāyamatra tvaṃ kuru me syāmavikṣataḥ ॥16॥
brahmaṇā tatsamāśrutya smṛtaḥ śrīhariravyayaḥ ।
sūryasyā''pūraṇārthāya svayamāpūrako bhava ॥17॥
nārāyaṇo haristasya brahmaṇaḥ prārthanāṃ tu tām ।
aṃgīkṛtyā'bravīd devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pūrtidaṃ yathā ॥18॥
brahman dadāmi bhadrante sūryasya mama cakṣuṣaḥ ।।
yathā hyakṣayyabhāvaḥ syāttathā rūpaṃ prapūrakam ॥19॥
ityuccārya hariḥ sākṣāttejorāśirghanāddhanaḥ ।।
hiraṇmayākhyaḥ puruṣo hiraṇyaśmaśrakastathā ॥1.42.20॥
hiraṇyakeśa ānakhātsarva eva suvarṇakaḥ ।
babhūva ṣoḍaśavarṣaḥ svarṇālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaḥ ॥21॥
muñcatsahasraraśmīṃstu lalāṭaṃ yasya kevalam ।।
ūrdhvaṃ muñcallakṣaraśmīn mastakaṃ yasya kevalam ॥22॥
koṭiraśmīnpramuñcadvai śarīraṃ yasya kevalam ।।
romṇi romṇi svarṇamayastejorāśiprapūritaḥ ॥23॥
rūpasaundaryamādhuryakalyāṇaguṇasaṃśritaḥ ।
mukuṭī kuṇḍalī sragvī svarṇaprāvaraṇānvitaḥ ॥24॥
akṣayyatejasa rāśiḥ sūryatejaḥprakāśakaḥ ।।
bhagavānīdṛśo bhūtvā viveśā'rkasya maṇḍalam ॥25॥
pūrayan sarvatejāṃsi svīyatejaḥpravāhakaiḥ ।।
raviṇā brahmaṇā cānyairmaharlokādivāsibhiḥ ॥26॥
pūjito vandito devaḥ ṣoḍaśātmopacārakaiḥ ।
sūryanārāyaṇastasya svarṇapuṃsa upāsanam ॥27॥
karotyavirataṃ lokacakṣurdātṛtvahetave ।।
vakti stotraṃ prārthanāyāmidaṃ tejaḥprapūrtaye ॥28॥
oṃ namaḥ tejaḥprasavitre bṛhate'vyayatejase ।
tejasvibhyo'vyayatejaḥpradātre brahmaṇe namaḥ ॥29॥
yasya gāvo bhūriśṛṃgā ayāso bhānti varṣaṇe ।।
īśanīṣu tadīśeṣu yasya bhrājyo'nvayaṃ yayuḥ ॥1.42.30॥
namo bhrājiṣṇave tasmai gomate goprasāriṇe ।
hṛttamodrāviṇe divyāsāya devāya te namaḥ ॥31॥
prakāśayitṛsamrāje svaprakāśakṛṇe namaḥ ।।
namo bhāvittiviprāya jñānaprabodhasūriṇe ॥32॥
namaḥ śrāṇavidhātaste nama ātmasadātmane ।
namo rājiṣṇave dīvyan saptabhājanudāyine ॥33॥
namo bhaumāya raktāya namo divyāya vidyute ।
namaḥ sūryāya cogrāya namo hiraṇmayāya te ॥34॥
namaḥ khāneyasaddhemne nama udaryatejase ।
nama uḍupabhāvāya namo yāvatprabhātmane ॥35॥
namaḥ kāryasvarūpāya namaḥ kāraṇarūpiṇe ।
hiraṇmayāya devāya brahmaṇe paramātmane ॥36॥
tvaṃ sṛṣṭā tvaṃ poṣayitā saṃhartā'pi tvameva vai ।
tvameva paramaṃ tejastejasvināṃ dṛgagrajam ।।37॥
sadā tejaḥpradānena rakṣa māṃ parameśvara ।।
cakṣuṣmantaśca yāvanto bhajiṣyanti prabhāprabhum ॥38॥
tvameva bhagavān bhāvān prabhāvaॉśca prabhāsvaraḥ ।
tvameva netravān trātā''matrātā cā'vinaśvaraḥ ॥39॥
maharcakṣuḥ svargacakṣurbhuvarcakṣustvameva hi ।
bhaumacakṣuḥ sarvacakṣuścakṣuṣāṃ cakṣuṣe namaḥ ।।1.42.40।।
oṃ oṃ oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ svastat oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyam ।
bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ॥41॥
iti mantraṃ tu yaḥ ko'pi japeddhyāyedatandritaḥ ।
hiraṇmayaḥ paro devaḥ sākṣādyāti tadagrataḥ ॥42॥
ayutaṃ japanāttasya svayaṃ sūryo mahānprabhuḥ ।।
varado bhavate tasya bhagavatvaṃ dadāti ca ॥43॥
divyaṃ karoti taccakṣurudghāṭayati cāntaram ।
uttejayati cātmānaṃ sampādayati brahma tat ।।44॥
tasmāddhayānaparo bhūtvā japet svaśreyase sadā ।
stotraṃ sūryakṛtaṃ svopāstyarthaṃ hiraṇmayasya vai ॥45॥
tato vai brahmaṇā sūryo hiraṇmaya pumanvitaḥ ।।
sarvamadhyāntarāle vai sarvatejaḥprado bhavet ॥46॥
tathā saṃsthāpitaḥ svarge jagaccakṣuḥ sa eva hi ।
cakṣuṣmantastadabhāve hyacakṣuṣkā bhavanti vai ॥47॥
sūkṣmāṇurūpabhābhistu cakṣurdevo bhavatyapi ।
cakṣuṣāṃ svakatejo'ṇupūrakaḥ sa pravartate ॥48॥ |
rātrau divā ca yatkiṃcitprāṇimātraṃ bhaveddhi tat ।।
svalpaṃ vā bahulaṃ vāpi sūryatejasvinetrakam ॥49॥ |
divā ghanaṃ bhavettejo rātrau tu viralaṃ bhavet ।।
taccāpi sūryasaṃbhūtaṃ tadāptā''ptaprabhāmayam ॥1.42.50॥
sūryāya tu jalaṃ deyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ tathā ।।
namaskārāḥ sadā deyā jagannārāyaṇo hi saḥ ।।51॥
hiraṇmayastu puruṣo lakṣmīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ tanum ।।
saha svena ravestatra maṇḍale'rakṣayatsadā ॥52॥ |
kalpānte ca yadā svargavināśo jāyate tadā ।।
sūryo hiraṇmayo lakṣmīrdevyaḥ sūryāṇya ityapi ॥53॥
brahmalokaṃ tu gacchanti paramākṣaramavyayam ।
tatastatra nivāsāya śrīhariṇā svayaṃ kṛtam ॥54॥
hiraṇyākhyaṃ svakaṃ dhāma divyamakṣaradhāmani ।
tatra hiraṇyayā lakṣmyā sākaṃ hiraṇmayaḥ pumān ॥55॥
koṭyarbuda hiraṇyā''bhadāsīdāsaprasevitaḥ।
rājate sarvadā rājādhirājaḥ parameśvaraḥ ॥56॥
tattu divyaṃ paraṃdhāma sūrye'tra sthūlamucyate ।
mūlaṃ brahmagataṃ dhāma tacchāyaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam ॥57।।
puruṣaḥ sa parabrahma svarṇaḥ sūryaśca cākṣuṣaḥ ।
dhyānā'kṣividyayā so'yaṃ labhyate mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ ॥58॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mānasasūryotpattitatstotrahiraṇmayapuruṣādinirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ॥42॥


← adhyāyaḥ 042 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 43
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 044 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yadā tu brahmaṇā dṛṣṭaṃ tejaḥ kevalamulbaṇam ।
sarvaṃ dahyedvinaśyecca puṣyecchiśyeta naiva ca ।। 1 ॥
tatastacchāntikārāya puṣṭyai ca prārthayat prabhum ।
devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tāvannārāyaṇasya mānasāt ॥ 2 ॥
saṃkalpādvāmacakṣuṣṭa udbhūtaṃ teja alpakam ।
śītalaṃ poṣakaṃ tṛptikaraṃ cāmṛtavarṣi yat ॥ 3 ॥
tasmādekātkaṇānnānākoṭyarbudakaṇāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
golakāste mahānto vai jātā vedhasa icchayā ॥ 4 ॥
vedhobhī rakṣitāste vai brahmāṇḍeṣu svakeṣu ca ।।
tatra jātāśca te candrāśca śaityaṃ drāvayantyataḥ ॥ 5 ॥
tasya tejaḥ prapūrtyarthaṃ yācito bhagavān yadā ।
prāha sūryanivāsena kiraṇena mayā sadā ।। 6 ।।
poṣaṇaṃ dāsyate tatra pūrtiste tejaso bhavet ।
ityataḥ svarṇapuruṣastejo'rpayatyaharniśam ॥ 7 ॥
śāntipuṣṭikaraṃ peyamamṛtaṃ sukhasaṃbhṛtam ।
snigdhamānandabhratsarvaṃ tāpanivṛttikāraṇam ।। 8 ॥
uṣṇaduḥkhāttārakatvāttārakaṃ teja eva tat ।
casya śaityasya saṃdānāt cāndraṃ tejo'pi caiva tat ।। 9 ।।
tādṛśaṃ tu paraṃ tejomayaṃ candraṃ vidhāya ca ।।
brahmā rakṣitavān svarge miṣṭā''nandāya dehinām ।।1.43.10।।
candro'pi sarvadā pūrṇaḥ sadaikasthitiko hyabhūt ।
paścātkālāntare strīṣu pakṣapātātkṣayaṃ gataḥ ।।11।।
punaśca śaṃkareṇāpi tadrogādardhatāritaḥ ।
tathaiva tasya yogyatvādardharakṣā kṛtā tadā ॥12॥
śrīlakṣmīruvāca—
kathā candramasaḥ strīṣu pakṣapātitayā ca yā।।
kṣayaṃkarā'bhavattāṃ me śrāvayasva kṛpānidhe ! ॥13॥
kāśca tasya striyaḥ kati kathaṃ tatpakṣapātitā ।।
kathaṃ śāpaḥ kathaṃ muktiḥ kathaṃ cārdhakṣayiṣṇutā ॥14॥
etatsarvaṃ samākṣasva paramāścaryamatra me ।।
devasyā'pīdṛśī pīḍā tava rūpasya he vibho ! ॥15॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca --
śṛṇu sāṃgāṃ kathāṃ tasya vicitrāṃ kāmavegajām ।
śrutvā sāpatnyaduḥkhā'pi tvaṃ māṃ maivaṃ kariṣyasi ॥16॥
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ purā ।
manasā kalpayāmāsa kanyakāḥ sṛṣṭi hetave ।।17।।
saptaviṃśatikanyāstu rohiṇīpramukhā iti ।
dadau candramase yāstu nakṣatrāṇi bhavanti tāḥ ।।18।।
nāmnā'śvinī ca bharaṇī kṛttikā rohiṇī tathā ।।
mṛgaśīrṣā tathā''rdrā punarvasuśca puṣyakam ।।19।।
āśleṣā ca maghā pūrvāphālgunyuttaraphālgunī ।।
hastiścitrā tathā svātirviśākhā cānurādhikā ॥1.43.20॥
jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ tathā pūrvāṣāḍhā cottaraṣāḍhikā ।।
śravaṇaṃ ca dhaniṣṭhā ca śatatārā tathā ca vai ।।21।।
pūrvabhādrapadā caivottarabhādrapadā tathā ।।
revatī ceti candrasya patnyastu saptaviṃśatiḥ ॥22॥
sarvā divyāḥ kāṃcanābhā raktā dvādaśahāyanāḥ ।।
tāsvapi rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyasadguṇorjitā ॥23॥
rohiṇī sarvadā kāmakuśalā prāṇahāriṇī ।।
candro yathā yathā hīcched rohiṇī vartate tathā ॥24॥
netraṃ premabharaṃ tasmai darśayatyeva cittahṛt ।।
mukhaṃ hāsyabharaṃ saumyaṃ sarvaśrṛṃgārataijasam ॥25॥
vakranetrabhruvorbhaṃgaṃ darśayatyapi cittahṛt ।।
raktāvoṣṭhau phullagaṇḍau darśayatyeva śāntidau ॥26॥
puṣpamālāṃ kare dhṛtvā manojñāmarpayatyapi ।।
stanau svalpau sughaṭau ca kaṃcukīdṛḍhatāṃ gatau ॥27॥
ramyau kesararaṃgāḍhyau yuvatī darśayatyapi ।
udaraṃ suvarṇavarṇaṃ kaṭiṃ tanvīṃ sukomalām ।।28॥
nitambau madhyakuṃbhābhau vāsastāralyadarśanau ।
alomakaṃ sūkṣmamadhyaṃ svarṇābhaṃ darśayatyapi ॥29॥
sakthnoḥ suvarṇayormūlaṃ mantharaṃ darśayatyapi ।
āgatya gaṇḍake tālīṃ datvā gacchati satvaram ॥1.43.30॥
parāvṛtya punaḥ kaṇṭhe hastaṃ kṛtvā ca cumbanam ।
spṛṣṭvā guptaṃ mukhaṃ datvā vilāsaṃ bhāvayatyapi ॥31॥
kvacidvāso vinā bhūtvā svātmānaṃ darśayatyapi ।
mano jahāra candrasya lajjāṃ santyajya sarvathā ॥32॥
candraḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣo'pi vīryasyā'kṣayaśevadhiḥ ।
reme reme punā reme tṛptyā reme punaḥ punaḥ ॥33॥
sarvadaiva tu rohiṇyāṃ reme reme punaḥ punaḥ ।
rohiṇyapi navaṃ saumyaṃ rūpaṃ cakre punaḥ punaḥ ॥34॥
ramitvā'pi punā reme nā'nyāḥ sasmāra candramāḥ ।
kvacitkadācidanyābhiḥ saṃreme'pi tathāpi tāḥ ॥35॥
kvācitkādramaṇāttṛptiṃ na yānti rohiṇīva hi ।
sarvāsāṃ yauvane puṣṭe sadṛśe'pi tu candramāḥ ॥36।।
rohiṇīrodhataḥ sarvā bheje samatayā nahi ।
tatastābhiḥ prārthitaḥ svapatiḥ saukhyāya bhāgataḥ ॥37॥
tathāpi rohiṇī tāsāṃ saukhyārthaṃ nā'nvamanyata ।।
svārthamātra parākrāntā pakṣapātamakārayat ॥38॥
tadā tvanyā udāsīnā hyakurvan śokamātmasu ।।
kiṃ nāma kṛtalagnena yāsāṃ patisukhaṃ nahi ॥39॥
vegārūḍhayuvatvā''ḍhyakāmavyāptadvayorapi ।
yadi kāmasukho yogo na syāt kiṃ tena lagninā ।।1.43.40।।
pūruṣasya striyāścāpi yatheṣṭaṃ kāmatarpaṇam ।।
na syād yadi kṛtaṃ tena lagnena viphalārthinā ॥41॥
kāmapūrṇaśarīrā yā navayauvanaśālinī ।।
patyuḥ sukhaṃ labheccenna kiṃ lagnena kṛtena vai ।।4।।
vaidhavyaṃ vā kumārītvaṃ tasmāttu varamucyate ।।
sati patyau na kāmasya sukhaṃ prāpnotyabhāginī ।।43॥
varaṃ tu kūpapatanaṃ varaṃ dahanamagninā ।।
varaṃ tu garalaṃ bhakṣyaṃ kāmadāhanaduḥkhataḥ ॥44॥
varaṃ pitṛgṛhe vāso varaṃ sādhvītvamityapi ।
na tu patyau sati kāmāgninā hyātmapradāhanam ॥45॥
mā vai bhavatu kāsāṃcit patirnapuṃsakaḥ kvacit ।।
vā mā bhavatu duṣpremā vipremā kṣaṇiko'pi vā ॥46॥
mā vā bhavatu sāpatnyaṃ śātravaṃ duḥkhamaṇvapi ।।
evaṃ vilapya bahudhā sarvāstāḥ svapitugṛhe ॥47॥
gatvā nivedayāmāsuḥ patyurduḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।।
pitaḥ kanyā na dātavyā premahīnāya śuṣmiṇe ॥48॥
pakṣapātapragantre ca rogiṇe'nyāsu śāyine ।।
asmābhirnaiva gantavyaṃ candrasya bhavane kvacit ॥49॥
asmān samatayā candro bhajate naiva karhicit ।
pitugṛhaṃ yathā śuṣkaṃ patyugṛhaṃ tato'dhikam ॥1.43.50॥
śuṣkaṃ śuṣkāyate sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ ratisukhaṃ vinā ।।
satyaṃ yathānubhūtaṃ vai vadāmaḥ sarvathā pitaḥ ! ॥51॥
jāmātā rohiṇīṃ te tu sarvadā bhajate muhuḥ ।।
nāsmān kvacitkvaciccedvai tatrāpi naiva pūrṇatā ॥52॥
tato vayaṃ na gantāsmāścandrasya bhavane punaḥ ।।
martavyaṃ naiva gantavyaṃ yatra duḥkhaṃ hi kevalam ॥53॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne candrotpattistato rohiṇyāṃ pakṣapātenā'nyāsāṃ patnīnāṃ dakṣāya nivedanādināmā tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ॥43।।


← adhyāyaḥ 043 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca --
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! tataḥ paścād yadbhūtaṃ tad bravīmi te ।।
pitā dakṣastadākarṇya para khedamavāpa ha ।। 1 ।।
śanaiḥ śvāsaṃ parāmucya kanyāḥ prāha dayāvaśaḥ ।
samāgacchantu candraṃ tu śikṣayāmi punaḥ sa hi ॥ 2 ॥
naivaṃ kuryāt prakuryāttu sarvāsu samakāmanām ।
iti kṛtvā gatāḥ sarve candrabhavanamādarāt ।। 3 ।।
dakṣaḥ prāha śaśindeva ! tvaṃ me śiṣyo'si suvrata ! ।
sujño'si kinnu bahunā vaktavyaṃ te praśikṣaṇam ।। 4 ।।
sarvāḥ samānā me kanyā yuvatyaste'rpitā mayā ।
tava patnyaśca tāḥ sarvāstvayi raktā vilokya tu ।। 5 ।।
sarvā bhaja samānā vai pakṣapātaṃ jahīti ca ।
sarvā nārīrbhajasva tvaṃ samakāmasukhepsayā ।। 6 ।।
naikasyāmanurakto'bhūḥ sarvāsveva rato bhava ।
sarvāśca kāmaya candra ! tāstṛptāḥ syuryathā yathā ।। 7 ।।
nārīṇāṃ kāmadāhasya yaḥ patiḥ śāntatāṃ nayet ।
smṛddhiḥ svargaṃ ca tasyaiva vividhāśca vibhūtayaḥ ॥ 8 ॥
bhavantyakṣatakuśalā vivardhante dine dine ।
patnīnāṃ prāṇadātrīṇāṃ raṃjanād raṃjanaṃ sadā ।। 9 ।।
tāsāṃ hṛtkalpakād duḥkhānnaro narakamāpnuyāt ।
narasyaiva tu saddharmo nārīṇāṃ kāmaśāntanam ।।1.44.10।।
tanna kuryāttadā lagnaṃ kṛtaṃ kevalamṛtyave ।
varaṃ nāryā samaṃ nāryā lagnaṃ kāmadhurojjhitam ।।11।।
yadi lagnaphalaṃ na syānnāryāḥ puṃsaḥ samāgame ।
tadā nāryāśca vā puṃso lagnaṃ bhārāya kevalam ।।12।। |
yadi lagne kṛte'naṃgā''nandaṃ nāpnoti mānavaḥ ।
dvandvārthaṃ tatkṛtaṃ lagnaṃ nā'bhūd ratyarthamityatha ।।13।।
nāryoḥ puṃsośca vā dvandvo lagnataḥ syāt kathaṃ nahi ।।
kathaṃkāraṃ naraṃ nārīṃ racayed bhagavān hariḥ ॥14॥
kathaṃ vā cā'rpyate nārī narāya na naraḥ punaḥ ।
kathaṃ vā tatra gṛhṇāti naro nārīṃ naraṃ tu na ॥15॥
iti candra vicāryyaiva sarvāḥ saubhāgyasampadaḥ ।।
tava patnyaḥ sadā sevyāstvayā saukhyapradāpane ॥16॥
candra omiti sammatvā dakṣaṃ saṃpūjya bhāvataḥ ।
patnīḥ sarvāḥ samāgṛhya bahudhā'ramayacca saḥ।।17।।
punaḥ sarvāḥ samāgṛhya bahudhā'ramayacca saḥ ॥17॥
kāle bahutithe jāte rohiṇyāmeva sarvathā ।
pūrvavat snehabāhulyamanyāsvalpaṃ punarvyadhāt ॥18॥
tadā punaḥ punastābhirdakṣaḥ samyaṅniveditaḥ ।।
bhūtvā dakṣastadā kruddhaḥ prāha candramasaṃ hitam ॥19॥
candra ! tvaṃ śikṣitaḥ samyaṅ śikṣyate ca punarmayā ।
vartitavyaṃ tvayā sarvadāreṣu samabhāvataḥ ॥1.44.20॥
tadā tvaṃ sarvadā smṛddho yogīva bhava śaktimān ।
akṣayyavīryatejaskaḥ sarvāsāṃ samatṛptikṛt ।।21।।
iti te'nugrahaṃ kurve putrīṇāṃ snehatastava ।
yadi śāpaṃ sṛjāmi tvāṃ putrīṇāṃ duḥkhado bhavet ॥22॥
tasmāttvāmanuśikṣyāmi sarvāsu samabhāgbhava ।
sarvāḥ samyak saṃbhajasva yatheṣṭaṃ sukhado bhava ॥23॥
yadi pravartsyasenaivaṃ tadā kṣayamavāpsyasi ।।
śakteśca tejasaścaiva kṣayaṃ duḥkhamavāpsyasi ॥24॥
ekayā kalayā tvaṃ vai jīviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।
evaṃ me vacane yāhi kalāpūrṇaḥ sadā bhava ॥25॥
iti dakṣakathitaṃ tadabhidhyāya punaḥ punaḥ ।।
ramate sarvapatnībhiḥ sarvadā sa muhuḥ samaḥ ॥26॥
rohiṇī tu haṭhāttaṃ vai nirodhayati kāminī ।
svagṛhe eva bahudhā kāmanā'tṛptamānasā ॥27॥
patnyaścānyāḥ pratīkṣante mārgaṃ candrasya cāṃgaṇe ।
na cāyāti yadā nāthaḥ śapantyastāstadā'rudan ॥28॥
nāthe sati vayaṃ patnyo nāpnumaḥ kāmadānatām ।।
anyathā tu tadā kanyā nāthe satyapyanāthavat ॥29॥
asmākaṃ yadi nātho na rohiṇyā api mā bhavet ।।
ityākruśya ca tāḥ sarvāḥ śepurnāthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ॥1.44.30॥
kṣayaṃ yāhi sadā candra ! tejovīryakṣayastava ।
savīrye vā hyavīrye vā tvayi sattve'pi pakṣaga ! ॥31॥
nā'smākaṃ ṛtulābho'pi tasmād vīryakṣayastava ।
rūpakṣayo'pi bhavatu pakṣapātin ! karoṣi kim ! ॥32॥

atibhogakarī ceyaṃ rohiṇī rogiṇī bhavet ।
raktasrāvā pradarārtā rohiṇi ! bhava rogiṇī ॥33॥
itīdaṃ tasya patnīnāmulbaṇaṃ śāpavācanam ।
dakṣasyāpi vacobhaṃgakṛtāptadoṣamulbaṇam ॥34॥
candrasya tu tadaiva drāk kṣīṇaṃ tejaḥ savīryakam ।
ṣaṇḍhaścaikakalāmātrajīvanaḥ samavartata ॥35॥
sadā duḥkhī sadā tyājyo nārībhiḥ samajāyata ।
rohiṇyapi raktasrāvā pradarārtā babhūva ha ॥36॥
candro gṛhaṃ parityajya patnīḥ sarvāśca tatkṣaṇam ।
prāptastapaḥ samākartuṃ saurāṣṭre vāridhestaṭe ॥37॥
tatra varṣaśataṃ tepe tapaḥ paramadāruṇam ।
svasya rogavināśāya rogo naiva nyavartata ॥38॥
śokaṃ jagāma bahulaṃ vimanāiva so'bhavat ।।
rohiṇyapi sadā raktasrāvā'dyāpi ca vartate ॥39।।
athā'tra samaye loke śatavarṣeṣu bhūtale ।
candrāmṛtaṃ vinā sarvā oṣadhayaḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ॥1.44.40॥
kaṇā naiva tu jāyante tuṣeṣu puṣpakeṣu ca ।।
pṛthvyā rasaśca kandeṣu mūleṣu na ca rohati ॥41॥
puṣṭistu sarvadā naṣṭā jīvāstadā tu duḥkhitāḥ ।।
devāścā'pyalabdharasāḥ ṛṣayaścā'mṛtakṣayāḥ ॥4॥
brahmāṇamupasaṃgamya prārthayan duḥkhanāśanam ।।
candrastatra mahādevaṃ śivaṃ saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ ॥43॥
punarvarṣaśataṃ taptvā śaṃkaraṃ cā'prasādayat ।
prasannaḥ śaṃkarastasmai prāha kiṃ te hyapekṣitam ॥44॥
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te sukho bhava sadā śaśin ।
candrastadā''ha nandīśaṃ deva ! someśvaro bhava ॥45।।
mayā prasāditaścātra tapastaptvā sudāruṇam ।
saurāṣṭre paścime prānte vāridhestaṭasannidhau ॥46॥
mama pūjyo mahādevaḥ sadā someśvaro bhava ।।
mama dakṣavacojanyaṃ kṣayaṃ rogaṃ vināśaya ।।47||
tava deva mahādeva ! pratiṣṭhā prakaromyaham ।
brahmādīṃścātra cā''hūya kurve yajñamahotsavam ॥48॥
iti saṃkalpya candreṇa brahmādyā devatāstathā ।
ṛṣayo munayastatra prajānāṃ patayastathā ॥49॥
manavo devagandharvāḥ sūtamāgadhanartakāḥ ।।
śaṃkarasya pratiṣṭhārthamākāritāḥ samāgaman ॥1.44.50॥
bhadrāvatyāstu nadyāstatkṣetraṃ dakṣiṇadigbhavam ।।
ābhadrāyā āsamudraṃ kṣetraṃ mokṣakaraṃ nṛṇām ॥51॥
tatra kuṃkumavāpyākhyanagare saṃvasan dvijaḥ ।
patnīvratākhyaviprarṣirvedān nītvā'gamattathā ॥52॥
parabrahā'vatāro'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svayameva hi ।।
vidhinā somanāthasya pratiṣṭhānamakārayat ॥53।।
pratiṣṭhānottaraṃ brahmā tadā prāha triśūline ।
candrakṣayeṇa yāvatya oṣadhayaḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ॥54॥
tanmūlāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ kṣayaṃ yānti muhurmuhuḥ।
tataścandrakṣayo nāśyo bhavatā sukṛpālunā ॥55॥
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tu tānsarvān gacchāmo dakṣamāturam ।।
kathayāmo hitaṃ kartuṃ yathā syāt susukhaṃ jagat ॥56॥
ityāmantrya prajagmuste dakṣasya bhavanaṃ prati ।।
svāgataṃ kṛtavān dakṣo niṣeduśca yathāsthalam ॥57।।
kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭhavāndakṣo jijñāsāṃ kṛtavānapi ।
mayi prayojanaṃ na syānnispṛhāṇāṃ mahātmanām ॥58॥
tathāpi mama lābhāya kṣemāya ca hitāya ca ।
bhavatāmāgamo bhāvyo dāsaḥ kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ ॥59॥
ityāvedya namaḥ kurvandakṣaḥ prāñjalirāsa vai ।।
somārthaṃ ca tadā śaṃbhuḥ prāha dakṣamidaṃ vacaḥ ॥1.44.60॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dakṣakṛtacandraśikṣaṇaśāparogasomanāthapratiṣṭhāpanādināmā
catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 44 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 044 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 45
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 046 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca---
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā dakṣaṃ candrarogaṃ - vināśaya ।
dakṣaḥ prāha ca me śāpaṃ hariṣyāmi tu śaṃkara ! ॥ 1 ॥
putrīṇāṃ somato nairāśyajaṃ duḥkhaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
ko hariṣyati tadduḥkhaṃ nityajaṃ śaśinaṃ vinā ॥ 2 ॥
sādhvīnāṃ tasya patnīnāṃ duḥkhadāhakṛtaṃ punaḥ ।।
śāpaṃ ko vārayed devo yatheṣṭaṃ kuru śaṃkaraḥ ॥ 3 ॥
ityāśrutya gurorvākyaṃ dakṣasya prayatātmanaḥ ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā candraṃ dakṣaśāpo vinaśyatu ।। 4 ।।
savīryo bhava śītāṃśo maivaṃ pakṣagamo bhava ।।
atha patnīkṛtaśāpavināśāyā'pi śaṃkaraḥ ।।5।।
revatīprabhṛtibhyastatkṣamāṃ yācitavānprabhuḥ ।।
patnībhiśca tadā rogo nāśaṃ yāhīti kīrtitam ॥ 6 ॥
rogo vīryakṣayo naṣṭo na naṣṭastu kalākṣayaḥ ।
pakṣapātitvadoṣasya vināśāya kṣamāpitam ।। 7 ।।
rohiṇyāmeva pātitvaṃ parityaktaṃ himāṃśunā ।
vīryakṣayaprapātitvaṃ śaṃbhunā samvināśitam ।।8।।
sarvāsu samagāmitvamaṃgīkṛtaṃ himāṃśunā ।
kalānāṃ kṣayagāmitvaṃ na nāśitaṃ tu śaṃbhunā ॥ 9 ॥
tadā candraḥ punardevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pratyabhāṣata ।।
pitastejaḥkṣayo duḥkhaṃ sarvaduḥkhādviśiṣyate ।।1.45.10।।
tejastejasvināmātmā tejaḥ sammānamucyate ।
tejaḥ kīrtiyaśo dravyaṃ mahattā tejasi sthitā ।।11॥
nistejā yo bhavelloke gaṇanāto bahiṣkṛtaḥ ।।
tejasvināṃ tu gaṇane tejasvī parigaṇyate ।।12।।
anyaguṇaivihīno'pi tejorūpasamanvitaḥ ।
cakṣuṣāṃ tu priyaḥ syādvai puṣpaṃ kiṃśukajaṃ tathā ॥13॥
naikaguṇairyutaṃ cāpi rūpatejovihīnakam ।
cakṣuḥpriyataraṃ na syātkṛṣṇaṃ vyāptaṃ tamo yathā ।।14।।
śuklaṃ nīlaṃ tathā pītaṃ rakta ca haritaṃ tathā ।
kapīśaṃ karburaṃ ceti saptarūpāṇi tanvate ॥15॥
sarvebhyastatra śuklaṃ vai śreṣṭhaṃ rūpaṃ hi kathyate ।
tataḥ pītaṃ tato raktaṃ kapīśaṃ tadanantaram ॥16॥
haritaṃ ca tataḥ proktaṃ tato nīlaṃ tu gaṇyate ।
karburaṃ citrasaṃjñaṃ tu tataḥ priyaṃ tvihocyate ।।17।।
śuklaṃ tejo brahmaṇastu parabrahmaṇa ityapi ।
muktānāṃ brahmasaṃjñānāṃ golokādisthalījuṣām ।।18।।
rūpaṃ śvetaṃ sadā cakṣuḥpriyatākaramiṣyate ।
mama rūpaṃ sadā śuklaṃ tejāadhārakaṃ matam ॥19॥
vinātejo'pyahaṃ kṛṣṇo lohamṛttikayā samaḥ ।।
tasmāttejo madīyaṃ me śāśvataṃ dehi padmaja ! ॥1.45.20॥
nā'haṃ tejovihīno vai sthātumicchāmi pūrvaja !।
tejohīnaṃ ca māṃ sarve tiraskurvanti sarvathā ॥21॥
nāryaścāpi madīyā na mānayiṣyanti pūrvavat ।।
pūrvaṃ tejaḥsamudrekād vyarājaṃ devasaṃsadi ।।22।।
idānīṃ tejasā hīnaḥ kathaṃ yāmi suragṛhe ।।
tejohīno na jīveyaṃ mriyeya vacmi cāntikam ॥23॥
soma ityabhyarthayati yāvattāvat tu tatra vai ।।
oṣadhayaḥ samāyātā vividhā bhinnalokajāḥ ॥24॥
kāścidoṣadhayastatra kalaikā'mṛtajīvanāḥ ।।
kāścidoṣadhayastatra dvikalā'mṛtajīvanāḥ ॥25॥
trikalā'mṛtapā kaścitkāściccatuḥkalā'mṛtāḥ ।
kāścitpañcakalābhoktryaḥ kāścicchaṭkalanā'mṛtāḥ ॥26॥
kāścit saptakalābhoktryaḥ kāścidaṣṭakalā'mṛtāḥ ।।
kāścinnavakalābhoktryaḥ kāściddaśakalā'mṛtāḥ ॥27॥
kāścidekādaśakalāḥ kāściddvādaśasatkalāḥ ।
kāścit trayodaśakalāḥ kāściccaturdaśā'mṛtāḥ ॥28॥
kāścitpañcadaśakalā'mṛtabhogā''ptatṛptayaḥ ।
prāpte tattaddine tāstā bhakṣayantyamṛtaṃ svakam ॥29॥
evaṃ vibhinnasāmarthyā vibhinnā'mṛtajīvanāḥ ।।
vibhinnakalayā puṣṭā hyāsaँstatra samāgatāḥ ॥1.45.30॥
oṣadhibhirvibhinnābhiḥ prārthitaṃ svārthajīvanam ।।
hrāsavṛddhikalāyuktaścandramā yadi pākṣikaḥ ॥31॥
varteta tu tadā'smākaṃ jīvanaṃ cāpi pauṣṭikam ।।
saphalaṃ sarasaṃ smṛddhaṃ yathābhakṣyasupoṣaṇam ॥32॥
yathāvṛddhi yathāpoṣaṃ yathārtavaṃ sabījakam ।।
yadi pūrṇakalaścandraḥ sarvadā syāttathā tu tāḥ ॥33॥
kalā asahamānāśca naśyāmo vayamaṃjasā ।।
sarvakalā'mṛtasyā'sya śaityāgnidahanā'kṣamāḥ ॥34॥
kumāryaḥ peśalāḥ sarvā nāśamāpsyantyaharniśam ।।
tasmāccandramaso nityaśītatāsahanā'kṣamā ॥35॥
komalā hyaṃkurādeva mā nāśaṃ yāntu vallayaḥ ।
iti tāsāṃ prārthanāṃ tu śrutvā brahmā ca śaṃkaraḥ ॥36॥
candramoṣadhināthaṃ tau prāhatuḥ sukhakṛdvacaḥ ।
candra tvayā'vadhāryaṃ vai vallīnāṃ prārthitaṃ khalu ।।37||
svīkurve tatprasahyā'tra nā'nyo mārgo'tra dṛśyate ।
oṣadhyadhīnamevaiṣāṃ lokānāṃ jīvanaṃ kṛtam ॥38॥
oṣadhīnāṃ jīvanantu kalāḥ ṣoḍaśa te matāḥ ।
bhinnā bhinnāḥ kalāstāṃ tāṃ jīvayatyanvahaṃ yataḥ ॥39॥
kalādhāro bhavānproktaḥ sa cet kṛpāṃ na cācaret ।।
sarvāni naṣṭā bhaveyurvai parasparatayā muhuḥ ॥1.45.40॥
tasmāttejaḥkalālābhe kathayāvastathā kuru ।।
bhava pakṣe vardhamānaḥ pakṣe kṣayamavāpnuhi ॥41॥
pakṣapātitvadoṣaste kalāsveva niveśitaḥ ।।
kalāyāste kṣayaḥ syādvai vīryaṃ te cā'kṣayaṃ bhavet ॥42॥
patnīpradattaśāpo vai vajraḥ kena hi vāryate।।
poṣyavargā'rthyamiṣṭaṃ tu poṣyārthaṃ tyajyate na kim ॥43॥
paropakāraśīlāstu pareṣāṃ sukhahetave ।।
nijārthaṃ svānukūlaṃ ca tyajanti paramārthataḥ ॥44॥
candra ! sarvāsu patnīṣu samānaṃ ramaṇaṃ kuru ।।
mā niḥśvāsaṃ tu tāsāṃ vai gṛhāṇa sukhavān bhava ॥45॥
oṣadhīnāṃ jīvanasya puṇyaṃ gṛhāṇa pakṣadhṛk ।
evaṃ candramasaṃ kṛtvā brahmā ca śaṃkarastathā ॥46॥
devāḥ kalāhrāsavṛddhī tathaivā'sthāpayaँstadā ।
tadārabhya sadā candraḥ pūrṇavīryasusaṃbhṛtaḥ ॥47॥
reme nakṣatrarūpābhiḥ patnībhiḥ samabhāvataḥ ।।
kalānāśavivṛddhī tu hayoṣadhiprārthite sthite ॥48॥
brahmādyāśca tathā devā hyagacchansvaniketanam ।।
atha śaṃbhuryayāce taṃ candraṃ lalāṭabhūṣaṇam ॥49॥
brahmā prādādabdhijaṃ tatkalācandraṃ dvitīyakam ।
atrerjātaśca yaścandraḥ sa tu rājā tṛtīyakaḥ ॥1.45.50॥
te te candrāḥ prabhinnā vai bodhyā vibhinnakāryajāḥ ।
yāvantaḥ śaṃbhavaḥ santi yāvantyaṇḍāni santi ca ॥51॥
tāvantaścandramasaḥ syuḥ kalpabhedāt tvanantakāḥ ।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi ! candre'pi kṣayakāraṇam ॥52॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caṃdrasya tejaḥkalāhrāsavṛddhisthitikāraṇapradarśananāmā
pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 45 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 045 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
atha lakṣmi ! pravakṣyāmi devasṛṣṭaṃ tu mānasīm ।
tatrā'bhimānino devānmānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
ābhūtasaṃplavāvasthān nāmatastānnibodha me।
āpo'gniḥ pṛthivī vāyurantarikṣaṃ diśastathā ॥ 2 ॥
svargaॆ divaḥ samudrāśca nadāḥ śailā drumā latāḥ ।।
oṣadhīnāṃ tathā''tmāno hyātmāno vṛkṣavīrudhām ।। 3 ।।
lavaḥ kāṣṭhā kalā sandhirmuhūrtaॆ ca divāniśam ।।
māsārdhamayanaṃ māsaścābdaṃ yugaśca sādhikā ॥ 4 ॥
sthānābhimānino devā ityetānasṛjat tvajaḥ ।।
nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmabhimantrīśca devatāḥ ।।5।।
aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭīṃśca sasarja sukṛtātmanām ।
vaimānikāstu tāḥ proktā devaloke divaukasaḥ ॥ 6 ॥
devāśca pitaraścaiva munayo manavastathā ।।
teṣāmanucarā ye ca manuputrāstathaiva ca ।। 7 ।।
prasaṃkhyayā trīṇyabjāni koṭyo dvinavatistathā ।
saptalakṣāṇi ca tathā sahasrāṇyaṣṭa santi hi ॥ 8 ॥
devā hyete'bhimantārastattadgolakadevatāḥ ।
ādhipatyaṃ vinā te vai aiśvaryeṇā'jasannibhāḥ ॥ 9 ॥
jaṃgamāḥ sthāvarāścaite brahmaṇo mānasīprajāḥ ।
tuṣitānmarutaḥ sādhyān viśvedevāँśca vidyutaḥ ॥1.46.10॥
stanayitnūँśca bhānūँśca vasūnaṣṭau tathaiva ca । 1
droṇaprāṇadhruvā''gnidoṣavasuvibhāvasūn ॥11॥
siddhān yakṣāँśca gandharvānasurān rākṣasāँstathā ।।
apsarasaścāraṇāँśca piśācapretabhūtakān ॥12॥
vidyādharān kiṃpuruṣānaśvamukhāँśca kinnarān ।
vetālān ḍākinīṃ caiva śākinīṃ yoginīstathā ॥13॥
vināyakaॉśca kūṣmāṇḍān vetālāँśca grahānapi ।
yātudhānāँstathonmādānmātṝrguhyakacāraṇān ॥14॥
prajāpatīnṛṣīṃścaiva nāgānsarpāṃstathoragān ।
khagānmṛgānpaśūnvṛkṣān girīnmartyānsarīsṛpān ।।15।।
sūtamāgadhabandīṃśca bhāṭṭamindraṃ yamaṃ tathā ।
varuṇaṃ ca kuberaṃ ca hīśānaṃ niṛtiṃ tathā ।।16।।
aṣṭasiddhīrnavanidhīn rudrānekādaśā'pi ca ।
daityāśca dānavaॉścaiva mānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ ।।17।।
yajñānpuṇyajanān devavāhanāni paśūnapi ।
gaurajo mahiṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sūkaro gavayo ruruḥ ॥18॥
aviruṣṭrādayaścaite dviśaphāḥ paśavastathā ।
kharo'śvaḥ śarabho gauraścamaryekaśaphā ime ॥19॥
śvā śṛgālo vṛko vyāghro mārjāraḥ śaśaśallakau ।।
siṃha kapirgajaḥ kūrmo godhā ca makarādayaḥ ॥1.46.20॥
kaṃkagradhravaṭaśyenabhāsabhallukabarhiṇaḥ ।
haṃsasārasacakrāhvakākolūkasakukkuṭāḥ ॥21॥
evamādīn nāmatastānmānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ ।
ādyaṃ sargaṃ mahattattvaṃ guṇavaiṣamyamasṛjat ॥22॥
dravyajñānakriyākṛdahamaṃ dvitīyamasṛjat ।
tanmātrāṇi tṛtīyaṃ tu dravyaśaktaṃ samasṛjat ॥23॥
indriyāṇi caturthaṃ tu jñānakarmātma cā'sṛjat ।।
pañcamaṃ tu manodevān ṣaṣṭhamāvidyamasṛjat ॥24॥
saptamaṃ sthāvaraṃ sargaṃ vānaspatyamavāsṛjat ।
aṣṭamaṃ tu gavādīnvai tiryañcaḥ samavāsṛjat ॥25॥
martyaṃ tu navamaṃ devasargaṃ daśamamasṛjat ।
tatra tatrā'pekṣitaṃ ca gauṇasargamathā'sṛjat ॥26॥
dravyaṃ karma svabhāvaṃ ca saha ojo balaṃ tathā ।
prāṇaṃ daśavidhaṃ cakre mānasān sa pitāmahaḥ ॥27॥
aśanāpipāse tālūṃ jihvāṃ vācaṃ hutāśanam ।
ghrāṇaṃ ca nāsikāṃ netre śrotre caiva diśo daśa ॥28॥
romāṇīndraṃ karaṃ pādau gatimānandaśiśnakam ।। ।
rajo yoniṃ ca vāyuṃ ca mitraṃ yajñaṃ sahavyakam ॥29॥
pāyūṃ ca mitrakaṃ caiva bījaṃ vīryaṃ ca raktakam ।।
nābhimapānaṃ mṛtyuṃ ca kukṣimantrāṇi nāḍikāḥ ।।1.46.30।।
tuṣṭiṃ nadīḥ samudrāँśca puṣṭiṃ hṛdayamityapi ।।
manaścandraṃ ca saṃkalpaṃ kāmaṃ tvacaṃ ca carma ca ।।31।।
māṃsaṃ raktaṃ ca medaṃ ca majāmasthi tu bhūtajān ।
ityetānmānasāँścakre prāk sṛṣṭau tatra viśvasṛk ।।32।।
tatra tatra tadāvāse devāँstāँstānatiṣṭhipat ।।
āsye tvagniṃ lokapālaṃ vāṇyādevamatiṣṭhipatu ।।33।।
tālau tatra varuṇaṃ tu jihvādevamatiṣṭhipat ।।
nasyaśvinīkumārau tu ghrāṇadevāvatiṣṭhipat ।।34।।
mahattattve tu vāgīśaṃ buddhidevamatiṣṭhipat ।।
caraṇayostathā viṣṇu pādadevamatiṣṭhipat ॥35।।
akṣṇi tvaṣṭāramādityaṃ cakṣurdevamatiṣṭhipat ।।
karayorindraṃ vārtārthaṃ hastadevamatiṣṭhipat ।।36।।
carmaṇyanilaṃ prāṇāya tvaco devamatiṣṭhipat ।।
karṇayordik yathāyogyaṃ śrotradevamatiṣṭhipat ।।37॥
gude mitraṃ visargāṇaṃ pāyudevamatiṣṭhipat ।।
tvaci kaṇḍūkṛte yāvadoṣadhīn samatiṣṭhipat ।।38॥
guhye meḍhraṃ mahānandaṃ brahmadevamatiṣṭhipat ।।
hṛdi mano vikārāya candramasamatiṣṭhipat ॥39॥
mahattattve mahatsattvamahaṃkāre'bhimānakam ।।
citte vijñānamādhatta mānasān tānakalpayat ।।1.46.40।।
mukhāttu brāhmaṇaṃ brahma bāhvostrāṇaṃ tu rājakam ।।
urvorvṛttiṃ viśaṃ paddhayāṃ sevāṃ śūdrānakalpayat ।।41।।
brahmā svasya śarīre vai sṛṣṭiṃ sasmāra mānasīm ।।
indrādayo bāhavo me diśaḥ karṇau dhvaniḥ śrutiḥ ॥42॥
nāsatyadasrau nāse cā'kṣiṇī dyauścakṣuraryamā ।।
pakṣmāṇyahanī cobhe bhūvijṛmbho hyajadhiṣṇyakam ।।43।।
apastālū raso jihvā chandaḥ śirṣṇastathaiva ca ।।
yamo daṃṣṭrā dvijāḥ snehakalonmādastu hāsyakam ।।44।।
apāṃgamokṣaḥ sargo'yaṃ vrīḍā cottara oṣṭhakaḥ ।।
lobhastvadhara oṣṭhaḥ syāt stanau dharmo matastathā ।।45।।
pṛṣṭhamadharmaḥ ko meḍhraṃ vṛṣaṇau mitrakāviti ।।
kukṣiḥ samudrā girayo'sthisaṃghāḥ śvasitaṃ jagat ॥46।।
nadyo nāḍyastanuruhāṇi bhūruhā gatirvayaḥ ।।
guṇapravāhaḥ karma syāt keśā meghā manaḥ śaśī ॥47॥
avyaktaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāsaḥ sandhyā jñānaṃ mahattvakam !
giritramantaḥkaraṇaṃ nakhānyaśvoṣṭrahastinaḥ ॥48॥
śroṇirmṛgā vayāṃsi tu śaṣphāṇi manīṣā manuḥ ।
martyo nivāso gandharvavidyādhrā'psarasaḥ svaraḥ ।।49॥
smṛtivīryaṃ brāhmaṇāstu mukhaṃ kṣatrā bhujāstathā ।।
viḍūruraṃghriḥ śūdro vai nānādravyāṇi karma ca ॥1.46.50॥
havyakavyā'mṛtānnādiraso jihvā manastu hṛt ।।
vikramo bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca chandāṃsi saptadhātavaḥ ॥51॥
tīrthāni nāḍyaḥ kāmāptiścaraṇaṃ hyudaraṃ mṛtiḥ ।।
kośaśmaśrunakhyāneva śilālohā'bhravidyutaḥ ॥52॥
śiśna ānandaparjanyajalavīryasravā iti ।
pāyuryamaparimokṣamitra ityapi mānasīm ॥53॥
hiṃsā niṛtirnirayo mṛtyurgudamiti pradhīḥ ।
tamo'dharmaparābhūtiḥ pṛṣṭho'sthīni tu parvatāḥ ॥54॥
rakte'vyaktarasāḥ sarve prāk dhyātā mānasā ime ।
svātmanyevaṃ paraṃ dhyātvā mānasīṃ sṛṣṭimityataḥ ॥55॥
yogyasthānāni teṣāṃ vai kṛtvā datvā ca tānyapi ।
tebhyo hyavāsayatsarge devān tārāgrahādikān ॥56॥
bhūvarī yakṣarakṣaḥprabhūtapretapiśācakān ।
rudrān rudragaṇāँścāpi gaṇikāḥ samavāsayat ।
bhuvi martyānpaśūnpakṣigaṇān jantūnanekaśaḥ ।।57॥
parvatādau mahāraṇye gandharvāścāraṇāँstathā ।
kinnarān kiṃpuruṣāँśca vidyādharavihaṃgamān ॥58॥
atalādipañcaloke'suradānavadaityakān ।
mahātale kādraveyān sarpāṃśca pannagāँstathā ॥59॥
pātāle tu mahānāgān brahmā vāsamadāpayat ।
eṣā sarvā mahāsṛṣṭirmānasī prathame yuge ॥1.46.60॥
yadyathā'pekṣyate kāryaṃ tathā sṛṣṭistu kalpyate ।।
brahmā vikalpya sarvaṃ tanmānasād vyākarottadā ॥61॥
aiśvaryasrotasaścā'tra īśvarāḥ satyalokajāḥ ।।
saṃprajñāsrotasaścātra ṛṣayo jñānino'malāḥ ।। 62 ।।
saṃtṛptisrotasaścātra pitaraḥ śrāddhatṛptijāḥ ।।
saṃpuṇyasrotasaścātra devāḥ puṇyādisampadaḥ ।। 63 ।।
sadhyānassrotasaścātra pretā vāsanadhyānajāḥ ।।
samūrdhvasrotasaścāpi rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ ॥64।।
arvākprasrotasaḥ pṛthvyāṃ manuṣyā rājasāḥ sadā ।
tiryasrotasa evā'tra paśukīṭaprapakṣiṇaḥ ॥65॥
tamaḥsrotasa evā'tra nāgasarpādayo matāḥ ।
avidyasrotasaścā'tra parvatāstarugulmakāḥ ॥66॥
ityevaṃ daśasrotaskānsargān dhyānakṛtānpunaḥ ।।
tatra tatra sthale loke brahmā samyagatiṣṭhipat ॥67।।
teṣāṃ tu bhojanaṃ svasmāccharīrātsamakalpayat ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ tu payaḥ chandomayaṃ bhojyamakalpayat ।।68॥
pitṝṇāṃ bhojanaṃ kavyaṃ siddhānāṃ siddhayo'danam ।।
daiteyānāṃ surā proktā dānavānāmathā''savam ।।69॥
gandharvāṇāṃ tu saṃgītamapsarasāṃ tu saubhagam ।।
vidyādhrāṇāṃ nabhovidyāṃ māyināmapyadarśanam ॥1.46.70॥
yakṣarākṣasabhūtādipretānāṃ māṃsaraktakam ।
sarpodīnāṃ tu garalaṃ paśūnāṃ yavasaṃ tathā ॥71॥
daṃṣṭriṇāṃ palalaṃ vṛkṣavallīnāṃ vividhaṃ rasam ।।
girīṇāṃ bhinnadhātūँśca devānāmamṛtaṃ tathā ॥72॥
manuṣyāṇāṃ godhūmādi pakṣiṇāṃ ca vanaspatīn ।
jalajānāṃ jalajantūn sarveṣāṃ pāñcabhautikam ।।73।।
brahmaiva kalpayāmāsa yasya yādṛgapekṣitam ।
teneyaṃ lokayātrā cā' nirvahatbhūtasaṃplavam ।।74॥
evaṃ yuge tu prathame sāṃgopāṃgaṃ tu sarjanam ।
sarva tu mānasaṃ kṛtvā virarāma pitāmahaḥ ।।75॥
sṛṣṭirvivardhate naiva navīnā jāyate nahi ।
