śabde tasya śravaṇaṃ cā''śvineyayośca nāsikām ॥53॥
gandhe tasya prāṇamiddhā'nale tasyā''nanaṃ tathā ।
divi tasyā'kṣiṇī paśyet sūrye tannetramīkṣayet ॥54॥
divārātrau pakṣmaṇī tadbhruvaṃ brahmāsane tathā ।
apsu paśyeddharestālūṃ rase jihvāṃ samīkṣayet ॥55।।
chāndassu tacchiro daṃṣṭrā yame snehe dvijāṃstathā ।।
māyāyāṃ śrīharerhāsaṃ sarge kaṭākṣamokṣaṇam ॥56॥
taduttarauṣṭhaṃ vrīḍāyāṃ lobhe cauṣṭhamadhaḥsthitam ।।
dharme stanamadharme tu pṛṣṭhaṃ hareḥ samīkṣayet ।।57||
meḍhraṃ vedhasi tasyaiva mitrayorvṛṣaṇau hareḥ ।
samudreṣu hareḥ kukṣīn giriṣvasthicayāँstathā ॥58।।
nadīṣu tasya nāḍīṃśca vṛkṣeṣu tattanūdbhavān ।
pavane śvasanaṃ tasya vayasi śrīharergatim ।।59।।
kriyāṃ guṇapravāhe ca keśānmegheṣu tasya vai ।
sandhyāsu tasya vastrāṇi pradhāne tasya sūkṣmatām ॥1.58.60॥
candre harermanaḥ paśyedvijñāne mahanīyatām ।
rudre tadantaḥkaraṇam aśvādiṣu nakhāni vai ॥61॥
kaṭiṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ paśuṣveva taccāturyaṃ tu pakṣiṣu !
svāyaṃbhuve harerbuddhiṃ parṇakuṭiṃ nareṣu ca ॥62॥
gandharveṣu smṛtiṃ tasyā'surasainyeṣu sadbalam ।
brāhmaṇeṣu mukhaṃ tasya kṣatriyeṣu bhujadvayam ।।63।।
vaiśyeṣūrudvayaṃ tadvaccaraṇe śūdramīkṣayet ।।
kāme tasya tu saṃkalpaṃ strīṣu divyaharestanum ॥64।।
nareṣu divyavīryaṃ tasyā''nandaṃ brahmabhāvanam ।
sthūle sūkṣmaṃ mahatyalpaṃ vairāje kṛṣṇamīkṣayet ।।65॥
evaṃ sarvatra ca śrīmannārāyaṇamitīkṣayet ।।
śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ dhyānaṃ tena tatra samāpayet ।।66।।
tadānandaṃ tasya saukhyaṃ tasya miṣṭarasaṃ dhruvam ।।
sarvadaiva bhajato'nyat sarvaṃ tanmayatāṃ nayet ।।67।।
iti mukteḥ kṛte rājan vidheyaṃ te pradarśitam ।।
tena mārgeṇa sākṣādvai hariḥ sannihito bhavet ॥68।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śvetavyāsakṛtopadeśa-saṃhitāpārāyaṇanirdeśabhagavanmūrtidhāraṇā vibhūtyādiharitādātmyadhāraṇādi
kathananāmā'ṣṭapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥58॥


← adhyāyaḥ 058 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 59
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 060 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca --
athāpi vāsanāleśād bahujanmabhramestathā ।
mano yadi punaścāyātsthairyaṃ naiva samāśrayet ।। 1 ।।
tadā tu mana evedaṃ brahma ityapi dhārayet ।
tasmin yadudbhavecchuklaṃ mantavyaṃ kṛṣṇameva vā ।। 2 ।।
tadapi brahma eveti nānyo vai viṣayo hi saḥ ।।
ityevaṃ kalpayet prājño mumurṣurnā'nyamarthayet ॥ 3 ॥
athāpi tatra bhāsaḥ syādvividhānāṃ tu dehinām ।।
paśukalatraputrādidravyabhavanasampadām ।।4।।
sarvaṃ vai brahma ityevaṃ kalpayennānyamarthayet ।
evaṃ tadbrahmabhāvena brahmarūpāṇi tāni vai ।।5।।
bhavantyeva tatastāni naiva bandhakarāṇi hi ।
athāpi tanmano brahmarūpaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ janaḥ ।। 6 ।।
sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ paśyennānyat kiṃcidvilokayet ।
nendriyairnāntarairnaiva vāsanākiraṇena vā ।। 7 ।।
svātmariktaṃ vipaśyeddhi kiṃcidanyadatanmayam ।।
tādṛśaṃ svaṃ manaścaiva mantavyaṃ brahmarūpakam ।। 8 ।।
kṛtvā tataḥ paraṃbrahma dhyāyecchāntarayeṇa vai ।।
tad yathā svaṃ brahma kṛtvā paraṃ brahma sumūrtakam ॥ 9 ॥
cintayet saumyarūpaṃ taṃ sūkṣmaṃ prādeśamātrakam ।।
caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ prabhum ।।1.59.10।।
suprasannamukhāṃbhojaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam ।
kesarapiśaṃgadhautraṃ ratnanaddhasubhūṣaṇam ।।11।।
mahāratnā'ñcitaprāntakalgikirīṭakuṇḍalam
śrīvatsaṃ vakṣasi dadhadvanamālāsukaustubham ।।12।।
raśanā''vṛttakaṭyāḍhyaṃ svarṇanūpurapatkajam ।
komalasvarṇapattrāṇaṃ varaprāvārasaṃvṛtam ॥13॥
suvarṇaśṛṃkhalāyuktā'ṅgulīyakaṃkaṇānvitam ।
snigdhā''bhugnanīlakeśaṃ mandahāsā'mṛtānanam ।।14।।
premarasodgamannetraṃ bhrūcāṃcalyakṛpāparam ।।
ityevaṃ divyatejaskaṃ surūpaṃ cintayennije ॥15॥
tathā nakhaśikhāpūrṇamekaikamaṃgamīkṣayet ।
yāvannasthiratāṃ yāyāt samabhyasyettu tāvatā ॥16॥
sukhasthirāsanasaṃstho jihāsurlokamulbaṇam ।
prāṇānyacchenmano yacched buddhiṃ yacchennijātmani ।।17।।
ātmānaṃ brahmaṇi yacched brahmātmānaṃ parātmani ।
evaṃ kramātparaṃ ruddhaḥ śāntastadrūpatāṃ gataḥ ॥18॥
virameta śanaiḥ kṛtyānna guṇā bandhanapradāḥ ।
kuto'nyatkālamāyādi yatpadaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tu tat ॥19।।
nābhiṃ saṃkucya ca gudaṃ kramāccakrāṇi laṃghayet ।
suṣumṇayā bhruvormūle guruṃ dhyātvordhvamāgataḥ ।।1.59.20।।
mūrdhnaśchidraṃ tato bhittvā muktaiḥ saha parivrajet ।
śuklaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ gatvā sūryaṃ cāndraṃ ca tārakāḥ ।।21।।
paitryaṃ sthānaṃ samullaṃghya ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍalāni ca ।।
satyaṃ lokaṃ samulaṃghyā'ṣṭaiśvarāvaraṇāni ca ।।22।।
samullaṃghya tato gacchedvirāṭnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।
hiraṇyagarbhamullaṃghya mahāviṣṇupadaṃ tataḥ ।।23।।
taccāpi saṃparityajya prādhāne prākṛte pade ।
samapohya brahmalokaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma cāpnuyāt ॥24॥
na mṛtyurna jarā tatra na kālo na ca śocanam ।
nārtirnodvega ityeṣaḥ śrīharerloka ucyate ॥25॥
tanmūrtestu parānandamāpnotyānandatanmayaḥ ।
evaṃ mumukṣuḥ kriyayā dhyānenopāsanena vā ॥26॥
upāsitvā tathā dhyātvā paraṃbrahma samaśnute ।
bhagavatā śrīhariṇā lakṣmyai sṛtī pradarśite ॥27॥
kriyāyogo bhaktiyogo yenātmā mokṣamāpnuyāt ।।
hariḥ sarvatra niyataḥ sarvaṃ caiva harau matam ॥28॥
tena sarvātmanā dhyāyed draṣṭāramantarātmani ।
ataḥ sarvasvabhāvena sarvatra sarvadā harim ॥29॥
śṛṇuyātkīrtayeddhyāyed yena tanmayatāṃ vrajet ।
ye vai kathāmṛtaṃ nityaṃ pibanti harimāśritāḥ ॥1.59.30||
prajvalantyāśayāsteṣāṃ vrajanti tatpadāmbujam ।।
evaṃ vijñānarasanāmāśrito rasavijjanaḥ ॥31॥
kṣitiṃ tu gendukaṃ kṛtvopabarhaṇaṃ bhujadvayam ।
añjaliṃ bhujisatpātraṃ diśo vastraṃ prakalpya ca ॥32॥
vṛkṣādbhikṣāṃ saridy×Vr̤M×śca jalaṃ guhāgṛhaṃ tathā ।
nārāyaṇāttu santoṣaṃ prāpyā''tmaramaṇo muniḥ ।।33।।
kiṃ kasmāttu samīheta nārāyaṇamṛte punaḥ ।
sakāmo vātha niṣkāmo hariṃ dhyāyettadātmanā ॥34॥
pratīkeṣvapratīke vā tattānastanmayo bhavet ।
tenaivaikena devena svasmāt svasya vibhūtayaḥ ॥35।।
bhinnopāsakakāmānāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ prakaṭīkṛtāḥ ।
yato nā'yaṃ janaḥ sarvo mṛtau bhavati nispṛhaḥ ।।36||
subahūn mṛtikāle'pi padārthānīhate punaḥ ।
tatastenāpi tattasmin brahmabhāvanayā muhuḥ ॥37॥
sakāmanayā vicintyamiṣṭadaṃ brahmacaiva tat ।।
vipratejasvitākāmo bhajetpatnīvrataṃ harim ॥38॥
lakṣmīkāmo bhajellakṣmīṃ tvāṃ suvarṇapradāṃ sadā ।
indriyasauṣṭhavamicchan bhajedindraṃ śacīpatim ॥39॥
apatyecchurbhajedatra dakṣādikaprajāpatīn ।
apradhṛṣyatvakāmo'gniṃ dravyakāmo vasūnbhajet ।।1.59.40।।
vīryakāmo bhajedrudramannecchuraditiṃ bhajet ।
svargecchustu bhajet sūryaṃ rājyecchurviśvadevatāḥ ॥41॥
prajāvaśitvakāmastu sādhyadevān yajeta vai ।।
cirāyuricchuraśvinau puṣṭīcchuḥ pṛthivīṃ yajet ॥42॥
pratiṣṭhecchurvyomabhūmī patnīcchururvaśīṃ yajet ।।
rūpakāmastu gandharvān kīrtikāmaḥ kratuṃ yajet ।।43।।
sarvādhipatyakāmastu yajed brahmāṇameva ca ।
dhanasaṃgrahakāmastu varuṇaṃ vai prapūjayet ।।44।।
vidyākāmo yajecchaṃbhuṃ dharmecchurviṣṇumarcayet ।।
dāmpatyapremakāmastu satīmumāṃ sadā yajet ।।45।।
santānakulavṛddhyarthaṃ yajet pitṝnatandritaḥ ।।
sarvathā duḥkhanāśāya yajñān kuryānmuhurmuhuḥ ॥46॥
balecchuko maruddevān rājyecchurmanudevatāḥ ।
bhogecchuḥ śaśinaṃ śatrunāśecchū rākṣasān yajet ॥47॥
muktikāmastu puruṣaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।
bhajeta satataṃ bhaktaḥ kāmā'kāmamayo dhiyā ॥48॥
tameva paramātmānaṃ sarvasvapradamarthayet ।।
tattatkāmaprasiddhiḥ syāt siddhau tṛptistṛṣākṣayaḥ ॥49॥
tato'pi nityasaccidānandasandohamarthayet ।।
vihāre bhojane pāne śrṛṃgāre mehane ratau ॥1.59.50॥
paraśūnāmapi kālo vai pṛthaggacchatyato nu kim ।
taravo'pi hi jīvanti bhastrāścāpi śvasanti vai ॥51।।
kathā naiva śrutā karṇe te'pi tādṛgvidhā janāḥ ।
kathāśrutiṃ vinā karṇau vālmīkau tu bilau matau ॥56।।
saṃkīrtanamṛte jihvā dārdurikyeva bhautikī ।।
mukuṭārhaṃ śiro natimṛte bhārastu kevalaḥ ॥53॥
hareḥ sevāmṛte hastau svarṇārhāvapi cendhanau।
haryadarśanakṛnnetre māyūrabarhacandrake॥54॥
haryamandiragau pādau vṛkṣastambau hi kevalau ।
hareraṃghrirajo lābhaṃ vinā martyo jīvanmṛtaḥ ॥55॥
harervṛndāpuṣpagandhaṃ vinā nāsāpi śāvikī ।
harerbhaktau dravā'bhāve hṛdayaṃ prastaropamam ॥56॥
hareḥ kathāyāṃ yannetre jalaṃ romeṣu harṣaṇam ।
aṃgeṣu pulako bhāvo dravo hṛdi sa sāttvataḥ ॥57॥
sātvatānāṃ hṛdi sākṣānnārāyaṇo vasāmyaham ।
namastasmai pareśāya tajjalāya namo namaḥ ।।58॥
anantaśaktyadhiṣṭhānāntarātmaँste namo namaḥ ।।
adṛśyarūpiṇe'lakṣyavartmane brahmaṇe namaḥ ।।59॥
durītanāśane'khilaprāṇirūpāya te namaḥ ।।
asannirasananāmne sāttvatāmpataye namaḥ ॥1.59.60॥
dīnānāṃ bandhave tubhyaṃ svadhāmni raṃsyate namaḥ ।
nirastātiśayasāmyaguṇaiśvaryavate namaḥ ॥61॥
ayogināṃ vidūrāya svahṛdisthāya te namaḥ ।।
yatkīrtiśravadṛśyarhāsmṛtistotrāṇi sarvathā ॥6॥
kalmaṣāṇi vidhunvanti tasmai bhadrakṛte namaḥ ।।
prapannā yatpadopāstyā mātrāspṛśiṃ vidhūya ca ॥63॥
nirāśayā brahmagatiṃ yānti tasmai ca te namaḥ ।।
śīladānakriyāmantrayajñatyāgatapovratāḥ।।64।।
yadarpaṇamṛte kṣemaṃ vindanti nahi te namaḥ।
śvādamatsyādacarmakṛdyavanā''bhīrasaṃkarāḥ।।65।।
kaṃkaśabarajhallādapāradhirgaṇikāpivāḥ।
kirātakhasaghātāśca pāpāścānye'pi jantavaḥ ॥66॥
yadāśritāśrayācchīghraṃ śuddhyanti te namo namaḥ ।
avatāramayaḥ so'yaṃ sādhusādhvīmayaḥ prabhuḥ ॥67॥
īśeśā'jāmayo devo nārāyaṇaḥ prasīdatām ।
ṛṣipitṛdevamayo mānavāsuranāgadhṛk ॥68॥
patipatnīmayo devo nārāyaṇaḥ prasīdatām ।
naranārīsvarūpo'yaṃ nṛparājñīmayaḥ prabhuḥ ॥69॥
lokadhāmadharādhīhrīśrīpatirme prasīdatām ।
yatpādadhyānadhautāntarhṛdo vindanti yaṃ prabhum ।।1.59.70।।
tadotaprotasadbuddhyā yādṛgrūpaḥ sa dṛśyate ।
tathā taṃ kavayo loke varṇayanti parātparam ।।71॥
brahmavāṇyāṃ brahmarūpo lokavāṇyāṃ rasātmakaḥ ।
ubhavāṇyāṃ miṣṭatikto prasīdatāṃ katheṣṭadaḥ ।।72।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavaddhayāna-brahmalokagamana-tattadvibhūtidhyānādikathananāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥59॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ityevaṃ pratyahaṃ lakṣmi ! hāṭakāṃgadabhūpatiḥ ।।
kathāḥ śvetavyāsamukhācchṛṇoti śrotṛbhiḥ saha ॥ 1 ॥
ṛṣerbālakṛtācchāpātpreritaḥ kuhakaḥ phaṇī ।
samāgacchati daṃśārthaṃ paścimāśāvibhāgataḥ ॥ 2 ॥
viprarūpaṃ sa vai dhṛtvā vratadākhyasarittaṭe।
viśrānto vaṭacchāyāyāṃ yāvattiṣṭhati sarparāṭ ।। 3 ।।
tadā tatra samāyāto vaidyaveṣā'paro dvijaḥ ।।
so'yaṃ dhanvantarirvaidyo viṣanāśakamauṣadham ।।4।।
ādāya gacchati yatra tvasyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ vṛtam ।।
rājño viṣaṃ hariṣye'haṃ lapsye svarṇamayaṃ bahu ।। 5 ।।
pāritoṣikamityevaṃ kṛtvā taṃ hāṭakāṃgadam ।।
rakṣituṃ yāti so'pyatra mahāvaṭataroradhaḥ ॥ 6॥
chāyāṃ suśītalāṃ prāpya (vratadā) kankalāsalilaṃ śubham ।।
pātuṃ viśramituṃ tatra niṣasāda vaṭasthale ॥ 7 ॥
kuhakena paripṛṣṭhaḥ prāha dhanvantaristadā ।
hāṭakāṃgadarājarṣervipraśāpakṛtādbhayāt II 8 II
kuhakadaṃśajanyādva garalātmakavighnataḥ ।
taṃ gacchāmi mocayituṃ pāritoṣikavāñcchayā ।। 9 ।।
kuhakena tu tacchrutvā kathitaṃ śṛṇu bho dvija । ।
kuhakasya garaṃ tīvraṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ vārayiṣyasi ।।1.60.10।।
kurvatraiva vaṭe tasya parīkṣāṃ yāhi bho tataḥ ।।
daśāmyenaṃ vaṭa tvaṃ taṃ kuru pallavitaṃ punaḥ ॥11॥
uktvaivamadaśadvṛkṣaṃ nyagrodhaṃ yāvadeva hi ।।
tāvadāmūlato vṛkṣaḥ śuṣko'bhūd viṣayogataḥ ॥12॥
dhanvantaristadā nadyā jalamādāya cauṣadham ।।
āplāvya tasya mūle tu yāvatkaroti secanam ॥13॥
tāvadvaṭo'pyaṃkuritaḥ patrarasabharo yathā ।
pūrvamāsīttathaiva drāgjāto harita ityapi ।।14।।
āścaryamidamālokya kuhakaḥ prāha taṃ dvijam ।
mā yāhi bho dvijaśreṣṭha kastvaṃ māṃ sannivedaya ॥15॥
dravyaṃ svarṇaṃ parārdhaṃ te dadāmi tatra yāhi mā ।
dvijo dhanvantariḥ prāha nārāyaṇāṃśajo'smyaham ॥16॥
hāṭakāṃgadabhaktaṃ me rakṣituṃ yāmi mānada ।
kuhakaḥ prāha te diṣṭyā brahmaśāpo babhūva ha ।।17।।
bhavāneva kathaṃ tadvai vyalīkaṃ kartumicchati ।
āyuṣastasya sāntatvātsukṛtasya kṣayādapi ।।18।।
tava saṃketakāryatvānnāśaṃ yātu dharāpatiḥ ।।
gṛhāṇedaṃ parārdhaṃ vai svarṇamaṇimayaṃ dhanam ।।19।।
parāgaccha mahārāja yāmyahaṃ daṃśanāya tam ।
kuhakastvevamābhāṣya maṇiṃ svamūrdhna ādadau ॥1.60.20॥
yasmātsvarṇamanantaṃ vai sparśādbhavati lohataḥ ।
dhanvantarirdhanaṃ nītvā gataḥ svasya niketanam ॥21॥
kuhakastu bhāviyogātkathāsthānamagād drutam ।।
vaṭo'mṛtauṣadhiprāptestūrṇaṃ tvamaratāṃ gataḥ ।।22।।
śvetaharitaparṇāḍhyo yāvatkalpaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
dhanvantarivaṭakhyātiṃ loke vai sa gamiṣyati ॥23।।
raivatātparvatānnairṛtyāyāṃ diśi vaṭo'lpakaḥ ।
yojanatritayaṃ dūre vartate sūcayan sthitim ॥24॥
mahālayakṣiteḥ paścād dūraṃ gavyūtirasti saḥ ।।
tīrthaṃ viṣaharaṃ tadvai snānamātrātpraśasyate ॥25॥
vaṭasparśanamātrācca viṣaṃ naśyati dehinām ।
mantro viṣaharaścāyaṃ dhanvantarisamīritaḥ ॥26॥
‘viṣā'pasarpa bhadraṃ te gaccha viṣa ito drutam ।
hāṭakāṃgadarakṣārthaṃ dhanvantaribalaṃ smara' ॥27॥
iti mantraṃ samuccāryā'vatārayati yo viṣam ।।
drāgeva pralayaṃ yāti viṣamulbaṇamulbaṇam ।।28॥
atha saḥ kuhako viprarūpadhṛk sadasi drutam ।।
pracchannaśca samāgamya kathāṃ śṛṇoti nityaśaḥ ॥29॥
prāpte triṃśattame tvahni pūrvaṃ sāyāhna eva tu ।।
pārāyaṇasamāptau vai vyāsapūjottaraṃ tadā ॥1.60.30॥
hāṭakāṃgadabhūpālaṃ yajamānaṃ yadā guruḥ ।।
vyāso jagāma sahāśīrvādadānāya tāvatā ।।31।।
rūpāntaraṃ śalākeva sūkṣmaṃ kṛtvā tu sarparāṭ ।।
hārapuṣpeṣu vai līnaḥ puṣpavarṇa ivā'kaळḥ ॥32॥
hāreṇa saha nṛpateḥ kaṇṭhe tiṣṭhati vāñchayā ।
yāvad rājāpi vadati vyāsadeva namo'stu te ।।33।।
tava prasādād vighno me gata eveti lakṣaye ।
tāvatsa kuhakaḥ kaṇṭhe sūkṣmaṃ daṃśaṃ cakāra vai ।।34।।
viṣaṃ svamulbaṇaṃ tīvraṃ daṃṣṭrayā'siñcadaṇvapi ।
rājñastadbrahmarandhre vai gataṃ nāḍyā tu satvaram ॥35॥
avyāpnottāvadānakhaśikhaṃ hāhādhvanistadā ।
samabhūcca sadasyānāṃ śokodvignadhiyāṃ mahān ॥36॥
rājā tu kṛṣṇasaṃlagnamānasātmeva yogirāṭ ।
divyavigrahavān bhūtvā yayau brahmapuraṃ param ॥37।।
kuhukastu svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayitvā nigūhya ca ।
satvaraṃ paridudrāva jagāma nijamālayam ॥38॥
atha rājñaḥ suputreṇa svarṇāṃgadena yajñarāṭ ।
sarpayajñaḥ kṛto yatra sarpāṇāmanale havaḥ ।।39।।
svapituḥ pratikārāya kṛto roṣanivṛttaye ।
sarpāṇāṃ tu vināśāya sarpamantravidastadā ।।1.60.40।।
samāhūya dvijāँstūrṇaṃ sarpasatraṃ samācarat ।।
agniṃ prājvālya nāmāni sarpāṇāṃ parihṛtya ca ॥41॥
juhāva subahūn sarpān petuścāgnau ca saṃghaśaḥ ।
kuhakastu tadā cendraśaraṇaṃ gatavān kila ।।4।।
prāha rakṣa surādhipa mṛterasyāḥ dayāṃ kuru ।
śrutveti ca tadā hīndro rājā trilokirakṣakaḥ ।।43॥
sarpaṃ rarakṣa pārśve sve na vai patati sarparāṭ ।
dhyānena tu tadā viprairjñāta indrasurakṣitaḥ ॥44
tadā vai brāhmaṇāstatra mantrānuccārya vegataḥ ।।
suparṇadvijamukhyāste prasahyāhūya bhoginaḥ ।।45॥
juhuvuścānale mukhyān gauṇāँścāpi samantataḥ ।।
sendraṃ ca kuhakaṃ mantramuccāryā'pyajuhod yathā ॥46॥
‘omagnaye svāhā kuhakaṃ sendraṃ juhomi' mantram ।
yāvaduccārya sarṣapān juhotyagnau tadā svayam ॥47।।
indraḥ kuhakayukto vai svāsanātpatito bhuvi ।।
agnau sasarpaḥ patitaḥ prajajjvālā''kaṭi drutam ॥48॥
brahmaṇā sa niruddho vai maivaṃ deve'tigaṃ kuru ।।
tadā dvijaḥ suparṇastu dvijāścānye mahābalāḥ ॥49।।
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā nivṛttāḥ karmaṇastataḥ ।।
indraṃ dhanvantariretya tvauṣadhenā'cikitsayat ॥1.60.50॥
nīrujaṃ tu cakārainaṃ jagāma svaniketanam ।।
kuhakastvardhadagdho vai śeṣeṇā''gatya mocitaḥ ॥51।।
jīvitaḥ prāṇasandhinyā samauṣadhyā tataḥ khalu ।
sarpāḥ kuhakajātīyāḥ pṛṣṭhe deśe samantataḥ ॥52॥
kṛṣṇapītasudhūmrādivicitracandrakāḥ sadā ।
dagdhatvacāṃ darśanāni bhavanti tvagnipāśataḥ ।।53।।
ityevaṃ prathamadvāparasya jātaṃ kathānakam ।।
tadānīmindradevasya trāso'bhūnmaraṇasya vai ॥54॥
tadvat trāso bhavatyeva prāṇināṃ ghātakarmaṇi ।।
tasmād ghāto na kartavyaḥ kenacittu dayālunā ॥55॥
ityevaṃ tu kathā divyā proktā kalpādikālajā ।
bhaktyahiṃsādidharmāḍhyā paraśreyaskarī śubhā ॥56॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vratadānanadītaṭīyavaṭacchāyāyāṃ kuhakadhanvantaribalaparīkṣaṇa- sarpadaṃśajahārakāṃgadanidhana-sarpasatrāgnimadhyasendrakuhakahomasuparṇadvijādikṛtahavanagrastendrakuhakā dikaruṇākṛdbrahmaśeṣādivacanadvārakarakṣaṇādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 60 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 060 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 61
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 062 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! pravakṣyāmi tava praśnānusāriṇīm ।
kathāṃ yamasya tatpūryā yatrāsti jīvaniṣkṛtiḥ ॥ 1 ॥
dvāpare prāṇināṃ bhāvāḥ satyahīnā yadā'bhavan ।
pāpe ca kapaṭe buddhiryadā muhuravartata ॥ 2 ॥
pakṣapātastadā cauryaṃ svārtho mithyābhiśaṃsanam ।
prasahye ca parasvādi hartavyamapi dūṣaṇam ।। 3 ।।
hiṃsā droho'vamānaṃ ca nindā'nyā'bhibhavo'rdanam ।
ityādidoṣasahitān lokān dṛṣṭvā prajāpatiḥ ॥ 4 ॥
svayaṃbhūrbhagavān brahmā daṇḍārthaṃ tu vyacintayat ।।
devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dadhyau kṣaṇaṃ tāvaddhariḥ svayam ॥ 5 ॥
prāvirbhūya prasannāsyaḥ prāha kasmādahaṃ smṛtaḥ ।।
brahmā nivedayāmāsa devāya paramātmane ।। 6 ।।
dvāpare khalu saṃprāpte lokāḥ satyavivarjitāḥ ।
parasparasvahartāro mithyāvādāśca nirdayāḥ ।। 7 ।।
teṣāṃ kṛte tu kartavyaṃ kinnu vai bhagavan mayā ।।
daṇḍasteṣāmavaśyaṃ vai kartavyo bhavati prabho ॥ 8 ॥
anyathā tvavyavasthā syāllokā vināśamāpnuyuḥ ।।
bhojanācchādanagṛhāvāseṣvapi baliṣṭhakaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
kṛtādupadravātteṣāṃ sukhaṃ syānna kadācana ।।
tasmātteṣāṃ niyamanaṃ kimapyādhehi śaṃ kuru ।।1.61.10।।
śratvaivaṃ brahmaṇo vākyaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।
sasmāra dharmaṃ śāstāraṃ dharmastatrā''gato drutam ।।11।।
praṇipatya ca saṃpūjya devadevaṃ janārdanam ।।
brahmāṇaṃ cāpi pitaraṃ namaskṛtyā'bravīdidam ।।12।।
kinnu me kāryamāpannaṃ dehyājñāṃ tatkaromyaham ।।
hariḥ prāha tadā dharmaṃ daṇḍakāryaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ।।13।।
lokānāṃ svārjitānāṃ tu karmaṇāṃ phalado bhava ।।
satkarmaṇāṃ satphalado'satkarmaṇāmasatpradaḥ ।।14।।
rūpadvayaṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ daṇḍakāryaṃ kuru dvija ।
brahmaṇā moditaḥ so'pi tatkāryaṃ śirasi nyadhāt ॥15॥
punardharmastadā prāha nārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum ।।
kiṃ kāryaṃ kena rūpeṇa kva sthale kaiśca hetubhiḥ ।।16।।
kathaṃ daṇḍayitavyaṃ tacchādhi śrīparameśvara ।
tadāha bhagavān kṛṣṇo gṛhāṇa tvaṃ tanudvayam ।।17।।
ghorarūpaṃ tu tatraikaṃ trāsadaṃ ca bhayaṃkaram !
aparaṃ saumyarūpaṃ tu sukhadaṃ śāntidaṃ sadā ॥18॥
tadetadrūpalabdhyarthaṃ sūryā'patyaṃ bhavā'ciram ।।
yamarūpo vikarālasvarūpastrāsado bhavā ।।19।।
dvitīyaṃ tu tava rūpamidameva bhavatvatha ।।
tataste vāsayogyaṃ vai sthānaṃ dakṣiṇadigbhavam ॥1.61.20॥
kalpayiṣye viśālaṃ tatpurī saṃyamanīti yat ।
daṇḍākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ dāsye yamadūtāँśca koṭiśaḥ ॥21॥
lekhakāँścāpi saṃdāsye citraguptākhyamukhyakān ।
svakarmaphalabhogāya sthānāni karmiṇāṃ kṛte ।।22।।
vividhāni racayiṣye gaccha sūryasuto bhava ।।
ityādiśya haristasmātsthānāttiro'bhavattadā ॥23॥
brahmāṇaṃ tu namaskṛtya dharmaḥ sūryaṃ viveśa ha !
sūryo'pyaicchattadā patnīṃ putrasantatihāyinīm ॥24॥
atha sarvaguṇopetā prāptā saṃjñābhidhā priyā ।।
viśvakarmasutā divyā raviṇā sā vivāhitā ॥25॥
sūryastu tejasā tīvraḥ saṃjñā mṛdvī svatejasā ।।
sūryatejo'sahamānā raveḥ sevāṃ karotyapi ॥26॥
yadā sūryastu saṃjñāyā mukhaṃ paśyati kāmataḥ ।।
tadā saṃjñā sūryatejaḥpradhṛṣyā bhavati drutam ॥27॥
sūryasya tejasā saṃjñā netre nimilate sadā ।
premṇā paśyantyapi sūryaṃ tejasā'bhibhavāttadā ॥28॥
nahi vivṛttanetreṇa draṣṭuṃ śaktā bhavatyasau ।
sūryaḥ svayaṃ svabhāvāddhi dehe'pyuṣṇatamaḥ paraḥ ॥29॥
saṃjñā sūryasya tattejo hyugraṃ soḍhuṃ śaśāka na ।
yadā yadā tu sūryastāṃ samāśliṣyati vai priyām ॥1.61.30।।
tadā tu sūryaṃ santaptaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca vivaśā hi sā ।।
patiṃ dṛṣṭvā muhuḥ saṃjñā svākṣisaṃyamanaṃ vyadhāt ।।31।।
sūryastu premasamaye priyāṃ saṃruddhalocanām ।।
muhurdṛṣṭvā hyadhīraḥ san roṣādvacanamabravīt ॥32॥
mama yoge sadā bhīru kuruṣe svākṣisaṃyamam ।
tasmānmadvīryataste'pi putro bhavatu saṃyamaḥ ॥33॥
nāmnā yamastu vikhyāto yamarājeti vai mahān ।
jīvānāṃ karmapākasya daṇḍadātā bhaviṣyati ॥34॥
mama krodhavaśāt so'pi krūradharmā bhaviṣyati ।
tava netrasaṃyamanāt sopi tādṛgbhaviṣyati ।।35।।
yadā tu karmapākaṃ vai daṇḍaṃ dāsyati karmaṇe ।
tadā hyākrośato jīvānnaiva drakṣyati netrataḥ ॥36॥
netre sammīlya daṇḍaṃ vai yathākarma pradāsyati ।
yādṛg vai saṃgame pitrorbhāvastādṛk tu bālake ॥37॥
ityevaṃ vadamāne tu ravau saṃjñā yathā tathā ।।
priyacikīrṣayā patyuścaṃcalā'pyabhavattadā ॥38॥
hāvaṃ bhāvaṃ darśayantī sneharatiṃ karoti vai ।।
kāmabhogaṃ ratiṃ rītyā netre conmīlya bhāvataḥ ॥39॥
śaṃ nirvartayate yāvat sūryādgarbhaṃ samādadhau ।।
sūryaḥ prāha tadā saṃjñāṃ priye tvaṃ cañcalā muhuḥ ॥1.61.40॥
vilolitasucāñcalyapūrṇadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ punaḥ ।।
vilokayasi ramaṇād raṃjayasi ca māṃ muhuḥ ॥41।।
tato'patyaṃ dvitīyaṃ te caṃcalaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
sāpi kanyā tvayā tulyā caṃcalā vai bhaviṣyati ।।42॥
ityevaṃ yamakaṃ garbhe dadhāra ravikāmyayā ।
atha prāpte tu samaye suṣuve yamakaṃ tu sā ॥43॥
patipradattavacanāttasyā jajñe yamo yamī ।।
jātamātaṃ tu ṣoḍaśahāyanaṃ samabhūd dvayam ॥44।।
sūryagṛhe tu ramate yamakaṃ tad yamo yamī ।।
putro dvitīyaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ śrāddhadevo'bhavanmanuḥ ॥45॥
yamastu yamarājo'bhūt saṃyaminyāṃ phalapradaḥ ।।
yamī tu yamunā bhaktā nadī kṛṣṇecchayā'bhavat ।।46॥
golokātkṛṣṇacandreṇa preritā'tra samāgatā ।।
sūryaputrī svayaṃ bhūtvā vṛndāvane gamiṣyati ।।47।।
kalindasya sutā paścāt kālindī sā bhaviṣyati ।
yamunā sā mahādevī divyā mokṣapradāyinī ॥48॥
ākalpāntaṃ jalarūpā vṛndāvanavihāriṇī ।।
kṛṣṇakelihradaramyā gopagopīkṛtā''plavā ॥49॥
devadevīmahāpūjyā gokulāgre gamiṣyati ।।
evaṃ putradvayaṃ putraṃ saṃjñā saṃsuṣuve raveḥ । ॥1.61.50॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sūryotpāditasvapatnīsaṃjñāgarbhotpannaśrāddhadevayamayamī
prāvirbhāvakathananāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 61 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 061 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 62
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 063 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! tataḥ paścāt saṃjñāyā yā kathā hyabhūt ।
nityaṃ sūryaprasaṃge'syā jvalanaṃ duḥsahaṃ hyabhūt ।। 1 ।।
evaṃ saṃjñā ravestejomahaduḥkhena bhāminī ।।
asahantīva sā citte cintayāmāsa vai sadā ॥ 2 ॥
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kva yāmi sukhadaṃ sthalam ।।
yadi yāmi vinā hyājñāṃ sūryo me kopavānbhavet ।। 3 ।।
tasmādājñāṃ gṛhītvaiva svapiturgṛhamemyaham ।।
iti sañcintya bahudhā sūryaṃ prāha muhustadā ।। 4 ।।
deva me jāyate nityaṃ vicārastu piturgraham ।।
gantuṃ mīlayituṃ sarvān svasṝrbhātṝnsakhījanān ॥ 5 ॥
ājñāpayatu māṃ nātha yāmi devāya rocate । ।
sūryaḥ prāha na vai devi kālo'yaṃ gamanāya na ।। 6 ।।
putrapālanakālo'yaṃ gṛhasaṃbhālanāya ca ।
patyuḥ sevātilābhāya samayo'yaṃ tava priye ॥ 7 ॥
tatra gatvā nu te lābhaḥ ko vā bhāvī mama priye ।।
māṃ vihāya viyogasthaṃ kathaṃ sthāsyasi tatra vai ॥ 8 ॥
anāhūtā piturge he putrī gacchati vegataḥ ।।
satī śaṃkarapatnīva durdaśāmāpnuyāddhi sā ॥ 9 ॥
tasmānmā gaccha rambhoru gantavyaṃ tvanyadā punaḥ ।।
kanyā vivāhapūrvaṃ vai śobhante tu piturgṛhe ।।1.62.10।।
kṛtodvāhāstu tāḥ paścācchobhante svapatigṛhe ।
khānapānavilepā'bhyaṃjanaprābhūṣaṇādibhiḥ । 11।।
vastravāhanayānodyānopavanavihārakaiḥ।
vividhaiḥ smaraṇottejisādhanaistu navairnavaiḥ ॥12॥
ramayanti patiṃ premṇā tṛpyanti patisaukhyataḥ ।।
nirdhano vā pitā yāsāṃ vyayā'śaktaśca sarvathā ॥13॥
putryastadgṛhamāgatya duḥkhe taṃ yojayanti hi ।।
vastrairdhanairābharaṇaiścānyairbhogyaistu vastubhiḥ ॥14॥
aśakto raṃjane putryā mā duḥkhe pātayantu tam ।
dine deha prayāsena śramyaṃ kāryaṃ vidhāya ca ॥15॥
dhanaṃ svodarapūrtyātma nītvā sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ gataḥ ।।
evaṃ tu pratidivasaṃ svodyogā'rjyā'lpanāṇakam ॥16॥
nītvā krīṇātyannavastraṃ mā taṃ duḥkhe nipātaya ।।
ityevaṃ bahu sandiṣṭā hyanunītā muhurmuhuḥ ॥17॥
saṃjñā tejo'sahaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhartre naiva vadatyapi ।।
paścāttu mohamāpannā vicārya ca muhuḥ svayam ॥18॥
patiryathā na jñāyeta dvitīyaṃ rūpamādadhe ।
seyaṃ tanudvitīyā sā chāyā svasyaiva daihikī ॥19॥
hyabhūttatra tu saṃkalpya cetanaṃ samanodayat ।।
tejasvinī vahnisamā sūryatejaḥsahā tathā ॥1.62.20॥
pārthivāṃśasamakrāntā chāyā'bhūt strīsvarūpiṇī ।
tathā sā cetanavatī nārīrūpā tu sundarī ॥21॥
saṃjñāsadṛśarūpā ca sarvaṃ saṃjñāmayaṃ hyabhūt ।।
piturgṛhaṃ tato gantuṃ kṛtabuddhiryaśasvinī ॥22॥
chāyāmāhūya satkṛtya datvā gṛhadhanādikam ।।
tāṃ provāca tvayā stheyamatra bhānoryathā mayā ।।23।।
tathā samyagapatyeṣu vartitavyaṃ yathā ravau ।
na duṣṭamapi vācyaṃ te yathā bahumataṃ mama ॥24
saṃjñā'hamasmi saiveti vācyamevaṃ tvayā'naghe ।
yadi pṛcchetpatiḥ krodhātpremato vānyakāraṇāt ॥25॥
tvaṃ tu sūryasya tāpaṃ vai sahiṣyase yathā tathā ।
śītalaṃ te śarīraṃ vai bhaviṣyati tathā tathā ॥26॥
tāpasahanayogye vai śāntide jvaranāśake ।
sukhade te śarīre vai tāpaḥ śamiṣyati drutam ॥27॥
uṣṇasya layakaraṇāt sūryo'pi śāntimeṣyati ।
tasmāttvayā sadā sevyaḥ sūryo mayeva bhāvataḥ ॥28॥
bhartsane tāḍane vātha gālīdāne sumardane ।
tvayā nodāsitavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ mama gopanam ॥29॥
chāyā provāca saṃjñāṃ tu sahiṣye sarvamādarāt ।
ākeśagrahaṇāccāhamāśāpācca vacastathā ॥1.62.30॥
kariṣye pālayiṣyāmi yāvatkeśāpakarṣaṇāt ।।
yadā vā maraṇaṃ yāvad duḥkhaṃ paśyāmi tāvatā ॥31॥
na tathāpi kathayiṣye tava vā mama vartanam ।
gaccha devi ! bhagini ! tvaṃ piturgṛhaṃ sukhā bhava ।।3।।
kadāciccittavaiklavye smartavyā'haṃ tvayā svasaḥ ।
ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā saṃjñā yayau piturgṛham ।।33।।
dadarśa tatra tvaṣṭāraṃ tapasaidhitavigraham ।
namaskṛtya ca pitarau niṣasāda tadantike ॥34॥
bahumānācca tenā'pi pūjitā viśvakarmaṇā ।
piturgṛhe sukhaṃ tasthai bahukālamaninditā ।।35।।
patyurgṛhaṃ prati gantuṃ yadā necchati putrikā ।
tataḥ prāha sa dharmajñaḥ pitā putrīṃ ciroṣitām ।।36।।
tvāṃ tu me paśyato vatse dināni su bahūnyapi ।।
muhūrtena samāni syurbālaṃ kasya na rocate ।।37
putro vā yadi vā putryaḥ saguṇā nirguṇāśca vā ।
sucittā vā vicittā vā yathā tathā ca vā punaḥ ॥38॥
tathāpi pitroḥ snigdhāḥ syurāhlādakārakāḥ sadā ।।
tvaṃ putri yauvanavatī raviṇā ca vivāhitā ।।39।।
ciraṃ tvatra nivāsena tava dharmo vilupyati ।
bāndhaveṣu ciraṃ vāso nārīṇāṃ na yaśaskaraḥ ।।1.62.40।।
icchanti bāndhavā dharmaॆ patnyāḥ patigṛhe sthitim ।
sā tvaṃ trailokyanāthena bhartrā sūryeṇa saṃgatā ॥41॥
piturgehe ciraṃ kālaṃ vastuṃ nārhasi putrike ।
patyurgṛhe nivāsaṃ vai kartumarhasi putrike ।।42॥
ato bhartṛgṛhaṃ gaccha dṛṣṭo'haṃ pūjitā ca me ।
punarāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ darśanāya śubhe kṣaṇe ।।43
yadi te manasi kiñcid duḥkhaṃ jāmātṛtaḥ kṛtam ।।
bhavejjñāpayitavyaṃ me satvaraṃ putrike'tra vai ।।44।।
no ced duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ gaccha sevayāṃ'śukaraṃ prabhum ।।
tena tvamatra cāmutra dharmyāṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyasi ।।45।।
ityuktāpi svakaṃ duḥkhaṃ lajjamānā satī tadā ।
novāca pitaraṃ kiṃcid vicāryāpi muhurmuhuḥ ॥46॥
tathetyuktvā ca natvā ca pūjayitvā gurūँstathā ।।
bhrātṝnsvasṝśca saṃśliṣya sā jagāmottarān kurūn ॥47॥
sūryatāpakṛtodvegā tejasastasya bibhyatī ।।
na gatā sā sūryagṛhaṃ gatāraṇyaṃ tapaḥpriyā ॥48॥
tatrā'nyeṣāmaviditā vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī ।
tapaścacāra paramaṃ ghāsagrāsādijīvanā ।।49।।
saṃjñāmityeva manvāno chāyāyāṃ tu divākaraḥ ।
janayāmāsa tanayau kanyāṃ caikāṃ manoramām ॥1.62.50॥
nāmnā tu sāvarṇimanuṃ tāpīṃ śanaiścaraṃ tathā ।।
sāvarṇistu manurbhāvī śanaiścaro graho bhavet ॥51॥
tapatī tu nadī tāpī gaurjare bhāvinī priye ।।
saṃjñāmityeva niścitya chāyāyāṃ ca divākaraḥ ॥52॥
ratyā saṃyujyamāno vai reme subahuvatsarān ।
nā'vidatseyamanyeti tadā daivavaśāttu sā ॥53॥
chāyā divāniśaṃ samyak svasyā'patyasya vai muhuḥ ।।
cakārā'bhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ bhojanācchādanādiṣu ॥54॥
saṃjñāyā na tathā putrīputrayoścā'pyavartata ।
manustatkṣāntavānasyā yamastasyā na cā'kṣamat ॥55॥
prāgabhūdbahumānaḥ sa sapatnyā duḥkhito'dya ca ।।
sapatnyāścāvamānāya krodhaṃ sa tu cakāra vai ॥56॥
tato roṣācca bālyācca bhāvino'rthasya vai balāt ।।
tāḍanāya tu tāṃ chāyāṃ pādastena samudyataḥ ।।57।।
tasyāḥ punaḥ kṣāntamanā na tu dehe nyapātayat ।।
tataḥ śaśāpa taṃ krodhāt sapatnī jananī yamam ॥58॥
kiñcitprasphuramāṇauṣṭhī vicalatpāṇipallavā ।।
patnyāṃ pituryadi mayi pādamudyacchase balāt ॥59।।
bhuvi tasmādayaṃ pādastavādyaiva patatviti ।।
ityākarṇya yamaḥ śāpaṃ mātaryativiśaṃkitaḥ ॥1.62.60।।
abhyetya pitaraṃ prāha praṇipātapuraḥsaram ।
tātaitanmahadāścaryamadṛṣṭamiti ca kvacit ॥61॥
krodhaṃ karoti nityaṃ me subahu bhartsayatyapi ।
mātā vātsalyamutsṛjya śāpaṃ putre prayacchati ।।62।।
nirguṇeṣvapi putreṣu na mātā nirdayī bhavet ।।
yathā mātā tu māṃ cakhyau neyaṃ mātā tathā mama ।।63॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayuga santāne saṃjñāyāḥ svacchāyārūpanārīṃ sūryāya samarpya svapitṛgṛhagamanaṃ chāyāyā yamaṃ prati snehaśūnyavartanaṃ cetivarṇananāmā dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥62।।


← adhyāyaḥ 062 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 63
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 064 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca—
yamasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān lokabhāskaraḥ ।।
hārdaṃ gambhīramevaitajjñātvā provāca vai yamam ॥ 1 ॥
asaṃśayaṃ mahatputra bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam ।
yena tvāmāviśatkrodho mātaraṃ prati tattathā ।। 2 ।।
putraṃ pratyapi mātuśca krodhaḥ samāviśannanu ।
putra tvamasi dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca mānadaḥ ।। 3 ।।
na śakyametanmithyā tu kartuṃ māturvacastava ।।
kṛmayo māṃsamādāya yāsyanti tu mahīṃ tava ।। 4 ।।
tataḥ pādaṃ mahāprājña punaḥ saṃprāpsyase sukham ।
kṛtamevaṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ mātustava bhaviṣyati ।।5।।
śāpasya parihāreṇa tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi ।।
ādityastvabravīcchāyāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai ।। 6 ।।
nyūnādhiko nu tulyeṣu sneho vai kriyate tvayā ।।
kathamevaṃ dvitīyāṃ tu vinā syātpakṣapātitā ।। 7 ।।
kā tvaṃ saiva dvitīyā vā vada yāthārthyameva me ।
sā cāha tanayā tvaṣṭurahaṃ saṃjñā vibhāvaso ।। 8 ।।
patnī tava tvayā'patyānyetāni janitāni me ।।
itthaṃ vivasvatastāṃ tu bahuśaḥ pṛcchato yadā ।। 9 ।।
nā''cakṣe tu tadā kruddho ravistāṃ śaptumudyataḥ ।।
tataḥ sā kathayāmāsa yathāvṛttaṃ vivasvate ॥1.63.10॥
viditārthaśca bhagavān sūryaḥ śaśāpa tāṃ tadā ।
sarvadā tvaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇā chāyā vṛkṣādijā bhava ।।11।।
andhakārasvarūpā tvaṃ madviyogavatī sadā ।।
rodhakavastvāvaraṇā jaḍarūpā sadā bhava ॥12॥
gaccha gehātsadā dūraṃ mā māṃ darśaya te mukham ।।
madraśmirodhakavastvadhastāttvaṃ tu sadā vasa ॥13॥
nirvivāsyeti vai chāyāṃ jagāma tvaṣṭurālayam ।।
tatra saṃpūjayāmāsa tvaṣṭā sūryamupāgatam ।।14।।
bhāsvan ! kiṃ rahitaḥ śaktyā mama gehamupāgataḥ ।।
papracchā'tha ca tasmai sa kathayāmāsa tattvataḥ ।।15।।
prāha tvaṣṭā''gatā sā'tra bhavataḥ preṣitā rave ! ।।
mama gṛhātpunaryātā tava gehaṃ divākara ।।16।।
divākaraḥ samādhau tām vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm ।
tapaścarantīmācaṣṭe cottareṣu kuruṣvatha ॥17॥
tāṃ śaptukāmo bhagavānnāśāya kupito raviḥ ।।
tvaṣṭā tu taṃ yathānyāyaṃ sāntvayāmāsa vai śanaiḥ ॥18॥
deva te sā'sahamānā tejasā hyatipīḍitā ।
vahnyābhanijarūpasya chāyārūpaṃ vimucya ca ॥19॥
ghorāraṇye tu sā gatvā tapaścarati duścaram ।।
ghṛṣṇyauṣṇyād dagdhadehā sā tapaścarati duḥsaham ॥1.63.20॥
yena tvāṃ tejasā'sahyaṃ śarīreṇā'pyasaṃskṛtam ।।
bahuśṛṃgoccadhāraṃ ca khararūkṣocanīcinam ॥21॥
vajrādapi sukaṭhinaṃ draṣṭuṃ soḍhuṃ śaśāka na ।
tavedamativairūpyaṃ naiva bhāti na śobhate ॥22॥
asahā tasya sā saṃjñā vane carati śādvale।
tasmādrūpaṃ vraja mandaṃ tādṛṅnirvartaye tvaham ॥23॥
rūpaṃ vivasvatastvāsīdavyavasthaṃ kharā'ghaṭam ।
ekataḥ prajvālayati cā'nyato'nuṣṇaśītalam ॥24॥
vivasvānatha tacchrutvā vrīḍito'bhūnmuhustadā ।।
anujñātastatastvaṣṭā rūpasamīkarāya vai ॥25॥
bhramimāropya sūryaṃ tu śātayāmāsa śāṇataḥ ।
śṛṃgadeśāstadā tasya dvādaśa śātitāḥ pṛthak ॥26॥
samīkṛtastadā saumyaḥ surūpobhūcca bhāskaraḥ ।।
sahyatejāḥ sparśayogyaḥ sahavāsyo'bhavadraviḥ ॥27॥
dvādaśebhyastu khaṇḍebhyastvaṣṭā''yudhāni nirmame ।।
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇave tatsamārpayat ॥28॥
triśūlaṃ sumahat kṛtvā śaṃbhave tatsamārpayat ।।
śaktiṃ kṛtvā mahālambāṃ kārtikāya samārpayat ॥29॥
vajraṃ kṛtvā'ṣṭadhāraṃ tatsurendrāya samārpayat ।।
daṇḍaṃ kṛtvā mahāghoraṃ yamāya sa samārpayat ॥1.63.30॥
maṇiṃ kṛtvā mahāmūlyaṃ kuberāya samārpayat ।
pāśaṃ kṛtvā tu vaidyutaṃ varuṇāya samārpayat ॥31॥
khaḍgaṃ kṛtvā mahaddhoraṃ devyai kālyai samārpayat ।
kṛpāṇaṃ tu mahāghoraṃ kṛtvā'gnaye samārpayat ॥32॥
phalaṃ kṛtvā mahābāṇe narāya tatsamārpayat ।
ulkāṃ kṛtvā mahādivyāṃ vāyave tāṃ samārpayat ॥33॥
kṛkaśāṃ dantrikāṃ kṛtvā nirṛtāya samārpayat ।
tadanye svalpakhaṇḍāstu hīrakā maṇayo'bhavan ॥34॥
atha susaṃskṛtaḥ sūryo devarūpaṃ dadhāra ca ।
dadarśa yogamāsthāya svāṃ bhāryāṃ vaḍavāṃ raviḥ ॥35॥
gatastatra sthale rūpaṃ pracchādya cā'spṛśattataḥ ।।
aśvarūpeṇa mārtaṇḍaḥ tāṃ cucumba muhurmuhuḥ ॥36॥
pṛṣṭhe gacchannathordhvaṃ tāṃ samārohati kāmataḥ ।
maithunāya viceṣṭantaṃ parapuṃsaṃ viśaṃkya sā ॥37॥
vivṛtya tatsamīpe tu mukhaṃ kṛtvā sthitā'bhavat ।।
aśvarūpo'pi sūryastu kāmavegena cākulaḥ ॥38॥
kaṃdharāyāṃ samutplutya ghrāṇe liṃgaṃ niveśya ca ।
vīryaṃ sarvamasiñcadvai nāsikāyāṃ dvidhā tadā ॥39॥
sā taṃ niradhamacchukraṃ nāsikāśvāsavāyunā ।।
devau tasmātsamutpannāvaśvinau bhiṣajāṃvarau ।।1.63.40॥
nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvāvaśvināviti ।।
atyadbhutaśarīrau tau devavedyau babhūvatuḥ ॥41॥
avaśeṣeṇa vīryeṇa nāsikātastadaiva hi ।।
tṛtīyo'bhūd revatākhyaḥ putro nīlasurūpakaḥ ॥42॥
sa vai tasmāt tapaḥ kartuṃ paścimāyāṃ gato diśi ।।
raivatācalamāsādya tatra vāsaṃ cakāra ha ॥43॥
raivatasya gireḥ so'yamātivāhikadaivataḥ ।।
bhūtvā vasati tatraiva kalpāntaṃ tapa ādadhan ।।44।।
atha sūryaḥ svakaṃ rūpaṃ bhāskaraṃ samadarśayat ।।
tadā saṃjñāpi viśvastā patipādau prapūjya ca ।।45।।
kṣamāpya svāparādhaṃ vai jagāma ravimaṇḍale ।
sarvadā sā mahādivyā devī sūryasarūpiṇī ॥46॥
samāste ramate sārdhaṃ sūryeṇa divi modate ।।
ityevaṃ sūryabālānāṃ navānāṃ divyajanmatā ॥47॥
śrāddhadevo yamo yamī sāvarṇiśca śanaiścaraḥ ।।
tapatī cāśvinībālau revataśca nava smṛtāḥ ॥48॥
tatra yamāya sūryeṇa brahmaṇā ca samarpitam ।।
lokapālatvamevaitya dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ ॥49॥
yamapūrīti sā proktā kṛtānāṃ tu vikarmaṇām ।।
phalabhogāya duḥkhātmaniṣkṛtistatra kāryate ॥1.63.50॥
prāyaścittenā'tra loke pāṃkto bhavati mātrataḥ ।
yamapūryāṃ phalabhogācchuddho bhavati cā''tmataḥ ॥51॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saṃjñāyā vaḍavārūpeṇa tapaścaryā, sūryo'śvo bhūtvā tayā saṃśliṣṭo'śvinīkumārau revataṃ cotpādayāmāsa viśvakarmaṇā śāṇollīḍhasūryasya khaṇḍairdivyacakraśūlādiśastrotpādanamityādivarṇananāmā triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥63॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
yāmyanairṛtayormadhye puraṃ vaivasvatasya tu ।
sarvaṃ vajramayaṃ divyamabhedyaṃ yat surā'suraiḥ ।। 1 ।।
caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ saptaprākāratoraṇam ।
svayaṃ tiṣṭhati tasyā'ntaryamo dūtaiḥ samanvitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ hi pramāṇena tu dṛśyate ।
sarvaṃ ratnamayaṃ divyaṃ vidyunmālārkavarttulam ।। 3 ।।
pañcaviṃśapramāṇena yojanāni samucchritam ।
vṛtaṃ stambhasahasraistu vaidūryamaṇimaṇḍitam ।। 4 ।।
muktājālaṃ gavākṣantu patākāśatabhūṣitam ।
ghaṇṭāśataninādāḍhyaṃ toraṇānāṃ śatairvṛtam ।। 5 ।।
tatrastho bhagavān dharmaḥ āsane niyate śubhe ।
daśayojanavistīrṇe nīlajīmūtasannibhe ।। 6 ।।
dharmajño dharmaśīlaśca dharmanyāyahito yamaḥ ।
bhayadaḥ pāpayuktānāṃ dharmiṇāṃ tu sukhapradaḥ ।। 7 ।।
puramadhye praveśe tu citraguptasya vai gṛham ।
pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyānāṃ yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ ॥ 8 ॥
daśocchritaṃ mahādivyaṃ lohaprākāraveṣṭitam ।
pratolīśatasañcāraṃ patākāśataśobhitam ।। 9 ।।
dīpikāśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ gītadhvanisamākulam ।
citritaṃ citrakuśalaiścitraguptasya vai gṛham ॥1.64.10॥
maṇimuktāmaye divye āsane paramādbhute ।
susthito gaṇapatyāyurmānuṣeṣvitareṣu ca ॥11॥
na muhyati kathaṃcitsaḥ sukṛte duṣkṛte'pi ca ।
janmanopārjitaṃ yāvat sadasadveti tasya tat ।।12।।
dehendriyamanobhiśca kṛtaṃ karma likhatyasau ।
citraguptagṛhātprācyāṃ jvarasyā'sti mahāgṛham ।।13।।
dakṣiṇe cāpi śūlasya lūtāvisphoṭakasya ca ।
paścime kālapāśasya ajīrṇasyā'rucestathā ॥14॥
madhyapīṭhottare jñeyā nānāvidhā visūcikā ।
aiśānyāṃ tu śirorogo vahridiśi tu mūrchanā ॥15॥
nairṛtyāmatisāraśca vāyavyāṃ dāhapīḍanam ।
ebhiḥ parivṛto nityaṃ citraguptaḥ sa vartate ॥16॥
yatkarma kriyate yaiśca tatsarvaṃ tu likhatyasau ।
dharmarājagṛhadvāri dūtāstiṣṭhanti koṭiśaḥ ॥17॥
yamalokasya cā'dhvā vai antaro mānuṣasya ca ।
duḥkhena pāpino yānti yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam ॥18॥
yamaścaturbhujo bhūtvā śaṃkhacakragadābjabhṛt ।
āhūya pāpinaḥ sarvān dūtairdaṇḍaṃ dadāti vai ॥19॥
pralayāmbudanirghoṣo hyaṃjanādrisamaprabhaḥ ।
mahiṣastho durārādhyaḥ sūryatejaḥsamadyutiḥ ॥1.64.20॥
yojanatrayavistṛtadeho । krūro'tibhītidaḥ ।
doṣṇā daṇḍadharo bhīmaḥ pāśapāṇirdurākṛtiḥ ॥21॥
raktanetro'tibhayado darśanaṃ yāti pāpinām ।
aṃguṣṭhamātraḥpuruṣo hāhākurvan kalevarāt ॥22॥
yadeva nīyate dūtairyāmyairyamapurīṃ tadā ।
darśayanti bhayaṃ tīvraṃ dūtāḥ saṃtarjayanti hi ।।23।।
śīghraṃ pracala duṣṭātman yāsyasi tvaṃ yamālayam ।
kumbhīpākādinarakān tvāṃ neṣyāmo drutaṃ kuru ।।24।।
mārge prayāti vai preto . hyasipatravanānvite ।
kaṇṭakaśarkarātaptavālukāviṣakardame ।।25।।
ahanyahani sa preto yojanānāṃ śatadvayam ।
catvāriṃśattathā sapta ahorātreṇa gacchati ॥26॥
trayodaśe'hni sa preto nīyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ ।
tasminmārge vrajatyeko gṛhīta iva markaṭaḥ ।।27।।
saptadaśadinānyeko vāyumārgeṇa gacchati ।
aṣṭādaśetvahorātre pūrvaṃ yāmyapuraṃ vrajet ॥28॥
yāmyaṃ tu prathamaṃ proktaṃ sauripuraṃ dvitīyakam ।

śailapuraṃ pañcamaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ krūrapuraṃ tathā ।
saptamaṃ krauṃcanagaraṃ citrapuraṃ tathā'ṣṭamam ॥1.64.30।।
bahvāpannagaraṃ paścād daśamaṃ duḥkhadaṃ puram ।
daśaikamākrandapuraṃ sutaptanagaraṃ tataḥ ॥31॥

pāpī mṛto bhavetpretaḥ pretadehaṃ tu vindati ।

dehaniṣpattilābhāya piṇḍā deyāḥ pṛthak pṛthaka ।

ṣaṣṭhe kaṭiḥ saptame tu guhyaṃ pūrṇaṃ prajāyate ।
dine'ṣṭame sakthinī ca jānvaṃghrī navame tathā ॥37॥
navabhirdehamāsādya daśame'hni bhavet kṣudhā ।
deharūpaḥ kṣudhitaśca gṛhāgropari tiṣṭhati ॥38॥
daśame'hani taṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyātkṣudhānivartakaḥ ।
ekādaśadvādaśāhe preto bhuṃkte dinadvayam ॥39॥
trayodaśe'hni vai preto nīyate tu mahāpathe ।
saptadaśadinaṃ yāvat vāyumārgeṇa gacchati ।।1.64.40।।
aṣṭādaśe tvahorātre pūrvaṃ yāmyapuraṃ vrajet ।
tatra mahānpretagaṇaḥ puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe ॥41॥
mahānyagrodhachāyāyāṃ preto viśrāmamṛcchati ।
krandati karuṇairvākyaistṛṣārtaḥ śramapīḍitaḥ ॥42॥
śambalastatpurādhyakṣaḥ pretāya saṃprayacchati ।
yadi dattaṃ sutaiḥ putraiḥ snehādvā kṛpayā'thavā ॥43॥

jalaṃ cānnaṃ tatra bhuktvā tatpuraṃ so'tigacchati ।।45।।
māsadvayā''bhyantare vai surendrapuramṛcchati ।
surendro bhīṣaṇastantā'dhiṣṭhātā'smai dadāti hi ॥46॥
māsadvayāntare dattaṃ piṇḍaṃ vā yadi bhojanam ।
vyatikramya puraṃ tacca tṛtīye māsi cāparam ॥47॥
gandharvapuramāsādyā'śnāti piṇḍaṃ trimāsagam ।
tataḥ śailapuraṃ māsi caturthe preta eti ca ।।48॥
patanti tatra pāṣāṇāḥ pretasyopari pṛṣṭhataḥ ।
caturthamāsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā krūrapuraṃ gataḥ ।।49
pañcame māsi tatrasthaḥ piṇḍaṃ pañcamamāsikam ।
bhuktvā yāti krauṃcapuraṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ krauṃcā'dhivāsitam ।।1.64.50।।
sārdhapaṃcamamāsārjyamūnaṣāṇmāsikaṃ tathā ।
śrāddhe dattaṃ tu piṇḍādi bhuktvā viśramya yāti ca ॥51॥
citrapuraṃ saptamaṃ tatpurarājastu citrakaḥ ।
yamā'nujo hyadhiṣṭhātā piṇḍaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ jalam ॥52॥
bhojayatyatha bhuktvā sa mārge gacchati cāgrataḥ ।
āyānti sammukhāstatra kaivartāstu sahasraśaḥ ।।53।।
vayaṃ tvāṃ tārayiṣyāmo mahāvaitaraṇīṃ nadīm ।
śatayojanavistīrṇāṃ pūyaśoṇitapūritām ॥54॥
āmiṣādapatatryahijhaṣakṛkacasaṃvṛtām ।
yena tatra pradattā gauḥ pretaṃ tārayati drutam ॥55॥
na pradattā yadi dhenurvaitaraṇyāṃ sa majjati ।
svasthā'vasthe śarīre tu vaitariṇyā vrataṃ caret ॥56॥
deyā ca viduṣe dhenustāṃ nadīṃ tartumicchatā ।
ṣāṇmāsikaṃ kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra bhuktvā prasarpati ॥57॥
saptame māsi saṃprāpte yāti bahvāpadaṃ puram ।
tatra bhuktvā pradattaṃ yat sāptamāsikasaṃbhavam ।58॥
tatpuraṃ sa vyatikramya puraṃ duḥkhadamṛcchati ।
mahadduḥkhamanubhūya krośatyatra pratāpitaḥ ॥59॥
māsyaṣṭame pradattaṃ yat tatra bhuktvā sa gacchati ।
navamaṃ māsikaṃ bhuṃkte nānākrandapure sthitaḥ ।।1.64.60॥
tatrā'yaṃ śūnyahṛdayaḥ samākrandati duḥkhitaḥ ।
vihāya tatpuraṃ preto yāti taptapura prati ।।61॥
sutaptanagaraṃ prāpya daśame māsi so'śnute ।
bhojanaiḥ piṇḍadānaistu dattaistatra phalaṃ bhavet ॥62॥
māsi caikādaśe pūrṇe raudraṃ puraṃ sa gacchati ।
daśaimāsikaṃ bhuktvā payovṛṣṭaṃ pragacchati ॥63।।
meghāstatra pravarṣanti pretānāṃ duḥkhakārakāḥ ।
nyūnā''bdikaṃ ca yacchrāddhaṃ tatra bhuṃkte paretakaḥ ॥64॥
sampūrṇe ca tato varṣe yāti śītapuraṃ tataḥ ।
mahāśītārditaḥ preta ākrandati muhurjaḍaḥ ॥65॥
śītapuraṃ cātikramya bahubhītipuraṃ vrajet ।
tatra kṣuttṛṭbhayād dagdho yāti dharmapuraṃ tataḥ ॥66॥
yatroṣmaṇā prabāṣpeṇa bharjito bhavate mṛtaḥ ।
khādanti yamadūtāstaṃ mārgaśramāpanuttaye ॥67॥
bahubhītipuraṃ dharmapuraṃ ca dharmakheṭakau ।
dharmarājapurasyaitau śākhāgrāmau samīpagau ॥68॥
atha pretaṃ nayantīme yāmyaṃ dharmapuraṃ param ।
caturaśītilakṣaiśca mūrtā'mūrtairadhiṣṭhitam ॥69॥
yamadūtairmahākrūrairāgatānāṃ prapīḍakaiḥ ।।
pretamatra nyāyasaudhe dūtāḥ kurvantyupasthitam ॥1.64.70॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamapurapariṇāhacitraguptasaudha-mārgīyā'ṣṭādaśapuragamanavat pretadaśāpradarśananāmā catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥64॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca---
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! yāmyapure śrāvaṇā dvādaśo'nugāḥ ।
brahmaputrāḥ pratīhārāḥ manuṣyāṇāṃ tu ceṣṭitam ॥ 1 ॥
śubhā'śubhaṃ tu yatkarma vicāryyaiva punaḥ punaḥ ।
śrāvayanti tadānīṃ vai citragupte yame tathā ।। 2 ।।
naraistuṣṭaiśca ruṣṭaiśca yadyatkarma kṛtaṃ bhavet ।
sarvamāvedayanti sma yathārthaṃ yādṛśaṃ ca yat ।। 3 ।।
dūrāchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrād darśanagocaram ।
svarbhūḥpātālavāsānāṃ ceṣṭājñānaṃ ca dūrataḥ ॥ 4 ॥
evaṃ teṣāṃ śaktirasti martyādau guptabodhinī ।
te vai pretasya yāvaddhi karma gāyanti tatra ca ।। 5 ॥
śrīlakṣmīruvāca--
śrāvaṇāḥ kasya putrāste kathaṃ yamapure sthitāḥ ।
trilokasthaiḥ kṛtaṃ karma kathaṃ jānanti te prabho ! ॥ 6 ॥
kathaṃ śṛṇvanti te sarve kasmājjñānaṃ samāgatam ।
kadā te ca samutpannā brūhi me kānta sarvathā ॥ 7 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
ādau jagatsamutpannaṃ brahmayā nirmitaṃ hi tat ।
mayā tu pālitaṃ tadvai rudraḥ saṃhārakṛt tataḥ ॥ 8 ॥
dharmarājo mayā sṛṣṭaścitraguptena saṃyutaḥ ।
svasvakāryaṃ nirvahanti trayo devāḥ svatantrataḥ ॥ 9 ॥
sarve'pyādye satyayuge svatantrā hyabhavan janāḥ ।
sarve tridevasadṛśā na teṣu kasya śāsanam ॥1.65.10॥
tretāyāmapi tadvacca svatantrāḥ karma cakrire ।
śāstṝṇāṃ tadaviditaṃ śāstṛtvaṃ kutra sārthakam ॥11॥
tadā devāsrtayastatra militāścintanāya vai ।
prāṇināṃ tu svatantrāṇāṃ karmajñānaṃ na no yadi ॥12॥
na jānīmaḥ kathaṃ śāsayitavyāḥ prāṇinastadā ।
vicāryetthaṃ vimamṛśuḥ sraṣṭavyāstādṛśāḥ sutāḥ ॥13॥
tadā brahmā śivaviṣṇvormatamādāya mantrayuk।
gṛhītvā dvādaśakuśān jalaṃ saṃprokṣya tatra ca ॥14॥
dadau dharmāya sajalakuśān dvādaśa cetanān ।
yamo haste gṛhītvā tān saṃkalpayati putrakān ॥15॥
tejorāśīn viśālākṣān dūraśravaṇadarśanān ।
ātmadraṣṭṝrnigitajñān parasaṃkalpabodhakān ॥16॥
adṛśyān dṛśyarūpāँśca so'sṛjad dvādaśātmajān ।
yamaputrā ime loke sarvatra karṇanetragāḥ ॥17॥
yo yaṃ vadati loke'smin yat karoti śubhā'śubham ।
prāpayanti ca te śīghraṃ yamasya karṇagocare ॥18॥
dūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrāddarśanagocaram ।
sarvaṃ śṛṇvanti te sarve tenaiva śrāvaṇā matāḥ ॥19॥
vicaranti vāyurūpāḥ sthitvā cākāśavarmani ।
jantūnāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ jñātvā yamāya pravadanti te ॥1.65.20॥
mṛtyoruttarakāle te yathākarma yathākṛtam ।
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca yadvā mokṣaṃ yathā kṛtam ॥21॥
tathā sarvaṃ prāṇināṃ tu citraguptāya satvaram ।
nivedayanti paścādvai yamāyā''vedayanti ca ।।22॥
śrāvaṇāste bahurūpāṇyapi dhārayituṃ kṣamāḥ ।
caturdaśabhuvaneṣu naikarūpaiścaranti te ॥23॥
dharmacarā janā ye te yānti vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ।
arthadāste'jñapyapsarobhiryānti vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ॥24॥
kāmadānapradātāro yāntyaśvayuktasadrathaiḥ ।
haṃsahastivimānaiśca mokṣabhājaḥ prayānti vai ॥25॥
adhārmikāstu padbhyāṃ vai yānti mārgaṃ suduḥsaham ।
pāṣāṇaiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ hyasipatravanātmakam ॥26॥
taptavālukayā vyāptaṃ pāśabaddhāḥ prayānti vai ।
teṣāṃ sukhapravāsārthaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ yathābalam ॥27॥
chatropānahavastrāṇi mudrikā ca kamaṇḍaluḥ ।।
āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ caiva vāhanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ jalam ।।28।।
annamājyamupavītaṃ gomahiṣyādikaṃ dhanam ।
dātavyaṃ pretamuddiśya mārgaṃ sukhakaraṃ bhavet ।।29॥
mṛtoddeśena yatkiṃcid dīyate svagṛhe priye ।
jalātmā sākṣikastaddhi varuṇo vetti sarvathā ॥1.65.30॥

ahaṃ nārāyaṇastato'rpayāmi bhāskare ravau ॥31॥
bhāskarāt sa ca vai pretaḥ saṃgṛhyā'śnāti cetyataḥ ।
deyaṃ pretasukhārthaṃ vai dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ priye ! ॥32॥
yastu dharmaḥ kṛto naiva dānaṃ paścānna dīyate ।
puṇyaṃ tu nā'rjitaṃ svaiśca narakān yāti dāruṇān ॥33।।
caturaśītilakṣāste narakāḥ santi duḥkhadāḥ ।
teṣāṃ madhye mukhyatamā dhaureyāstvekaviṃśatiḥ ॥34॥
tāmisraścāndhatāmisro mahārauravarauravau ।
kuṃbhīpākaḥ kālasūtramasipatravanaṃ tathā ॥35॥
sūkarāsyamandhakūpaḥ kṛmibhojanamityapi ।
saṃdaṃśastaptasūrmiśca vajrakaṃṭakaśālmalī ॥36॥
pūyodo vaitaraṇī ca prāṇarodho viśaṃsanam ।
ayaḥpānamavīciśca śvādanaṃ lāळbhakṣaṇam ॥37॥
ityete mukhyarūpā vai yamapūryāṃ matāstathā ।
tebhyo'dhastātpare sapta santyanye nāmataḥ śṛṇu ॥38॥
kṣārakardama eko'nyo, rakṣogaṇaprabhojanaḥ ।
śūlaproto dandaśūko'vaṭanirodhanastathā ॥39॥
paryāvartanakaścaiva sūcīmukhamiti pṛthak ।
athā'nye narakagrāmāstatra santi nibodha tān ॥1.65.40॥
talapāto mahājvālaḥ śabalaśca vikartanaḥ ।
adhaḥśirā rudhirāndhaścakṣuḥśūlaḥprapācanam ॥41॥
śailapāto lohaśaṃkupratodanigaḍāstathā ।
lohayantraśca kākolo mṛtajīvanavaiśasau ॥42॥
narakāṇīti cānyāni bhedaprabhedatastathā ।
bhavanti pāpakartṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtyarthaṃ kṛtāni vai ।।43।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvādaśaśravaṇākhyadūtānāmaṣṭāviṃśatyādinarakāṇāmuddeśanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 65 ॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yeṣāṃ tu narake ghore gatānyabdaśatāni vai ।
santatirnaiva vidyeta dūtatvaṃ te prayānti hi ।। 1 ।।
yamena preṣitāste vai mānuṣādermṛtasya ca ।
dine dine pragṛhṇanti dīpamannaṃ ghaṭādikam ।। 2 ।।
pretasyaiva prayacchanti hyannakāmasya sattṛṣaḥ ।
tṛptiṃ prayānti te sarve pratyahaṃ caiva vatsaram ।। 3 ।।
citraguptapuraṃ pūrvaṃ yojanānāṃ tu viṃśatiḥ ।
kāyasthāstatra paśyanti pāpapuṇye ca sarvathā ।। 4 ॥
yojanānāṃ caturviṃśatistu vaivasvataṃ puram ।
tatra gatvā preṣyadūtāḥ pratīhāraṃ vadanti vai ॥ 5 ॥
dharmadhvaja pratīhāre brūte tasya śubhā'śubham ।
yamarājasya dūtāstu bhīṣaṇā yamakiṃkarāḥ ॥ 6 ॥
pāśadaṇḍadharā ghorāḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।
ekaikasya purasyā'gre sahasraikaṃ ca tiṣṭhati ॥ 7 ॥
dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ nyāyaṃ dadātyasmai tu pāpine ।
tatra tatra ca narakān prabhuṃkte tadyathā śṛṇu ॥ 8 ॥
prasahya paravittastryapatyapatyādihārakāḥ ।
patanti tatra tāmisre bhṛśaṃ kṣuttṛṭprabādhitāḥ ॥ 9 ॥
vaṃcayitvā paravittā'patyanāryādibhoginaḥ ।
patanti tvandhatāmitre naṣṭadṛṅmatayastu te ॥1.66.10॥
patanti hiṃsakā mahāraurave tatra dehinaḥ ।
kravyādā ruravo bhūtvā ghātayanti svaghātakam ॥11॥
bhūtadrohaiḥ kuṭumbasya poṣakā yānti raurave ।
bhūtāni ruravaḥ sarpā bhūtvā hiṃsanti hiṃsakān ॥12॥
paśvādirandhakā duṣṭāḥ kuṃbhīpāke patanti vai।
dūtāstāँstaptataileṣu randhayanti muhurmuhuḥ ॥13॥
gurupitṛbrahmasādhusādhvyādiprāṇināṃ druhaḥ ।
yānti vai kālasūtrākhye'yutayojanamaṇḍale ॥14॥
vahnitapte tāmrakhale loṭhayanti dahanti te ।
svadharmahantā pākhaṇḍī vane yātyasipatrake ॥15॥
ubhatodhārakhaḍgaiḥ saṃchidyate mṛdyate muhuḥ ।
anyāyadaṇḍadā yānti sūkarāsyākhyayantrake ॥16॥
niṣpīḍyamānā'vayavāścūrṇībhavanti tatra vai।
īśakalpitavṛttīnāṃ yūkāmaśakapakṣiṇām ॥17॥
jantūnāṃ nāśakartāro hyandhakūpe patanti vai।
tatra dūtā janturūpā drugdhā druhyanti tānpunaḥ ॥18॥
asaṃvibhajya bhoktāraḥ patanti kṛmibhojane ।
bhakṣyante kṛmibhiste ca śatasāhasrayojane ।।19।।
steyādbalātparasvarṇaratnabhvādyapahārakāḥ
saṃdaṃśe yāntyayodaṃśairniṣkṛntanti ca tān yamāḥ ॥1.66.20॥
agamyāँstu narānnārīrbalātkāreṇa kāmukān ।
taptasūrmyāṃ taptaloṣṭhaputalyā''liṃgayanti te ॥21॥
paśvādinaramādāsu prasahya kāmukān janān ।
vajrakaṃṭakaśālmalyāmāropya kartayanti vai ॥22॥
paśvācārā naṣṭaśaucāḥ śleṣmaviṇmūtrapūyake ।
pūyodākhye patantyete hyaśnanti tanmalaṃ tathā ॥23॥
rakṣakā bhakṣakā bhūtvā rakṣyān bhindanti bhītidāḥ।
viṇmūtrapūyaraktātmavaitaraṇyāṃ vahanti te ॥24॥
mṛgayāsaktapaśvādighātinaḥ prāṇarodhane ।
pātayitveṣubhistatra vidhyanti yamapūruṣāḥ ।।25।।
viśaṃsane paśu pakṣimanuṣyādividārakān ।
vidārayanti khādantyasṛk pibanti ca te punaḥ ॥26॥
asaṃkhyajantunāśotthamadirāpānakṛjjanān ।
taptā'yorasapānaṃ vai kārayanti balād yamāḥ ॥27॥
kūṭasākṣyaprakartṝṃścāvīcau yāmyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
gavyūtidviśatocchrāyagirestu pātayanti vai ॥28॥
viṣadānagnidānduṣṭān śvādane'danti kukkurāḥ ।
retaḥprapāyakān lāळ+āḥ pāyayanti yamānugāḥ ॥29॥
pūjyapūjāvyaticārakartā tu kṣārakardame ।
patatyavākśirāstatra tatphalaṃ ca samaśnute ॥1.66.30॥
paśupakṣinaranārīkhādakānāṃ yamānugāḥ ।
khādantyasṛk prāpibanti rakṣogaṇaprabhojane ॥31॥
prāṇināṃ kaṇṭakasūcīśūlaistu vedhakānmuhuḥ ।
śūlaprote pravidhyanti tīkṣṇāgrairyamasevakāḥ ॥32॥
prāṇyudvegaprakartṝṃśca daṃdaśūke śatānanāḥ ।

guhāvivarakusūlabilādau prāṇirundhakān ।
yāmyā rundhanti dhūmādyairvahninā sagareṇa ca ॥34॥
māṃsādikhādakān dūtāḥ khādanti kṣudhitāḥ punaḥ ।
karasparśeṇa jāyante pūrṇāḥ khādanti tānpunaḥ ॥35॥
āḍhyābhimāninaṃ tiryakprekṣakaṃ pāpakāriṇam ।
sūcīmukhe pātayitvā sūtraiḥ parivayanti ca ॥36॥
dīnadurbalasatpātramīkṣate kruddhacakṣuṣā ।

vahnau taṃ bharjayantyeva yamadūtā muhurmuhuḥ ॥39॥
aśuddhaṃ bhojayitāraṃ śamale pātayanti hi ।।
tatrā'śuddhaṃ ca durgandhaṃ bhojayanti yamānugāḥ ॥1.66.40॥
kaṃcukapuṭakaṃ ye cotkṛtya dravyaṃ haranti tān ।

śūlaṃ netre praviśyaiva daṇḍaṃ dadati tatra vai ।।44।।
agninā randhitā jīvāḥ pācayanti ca taṃ tu te ।
pāṣāṇairbhūtahantṝnvai pātayanti śilopari ।।45।।
nirāgaso bandhayitā badhyate nigaḍairyamaiḥ ।
jñātvā jantucūrṇayitā cūrṇyate lohayantrakaiḥ ॥46॥
jīvānduḥkhapradātā tu kākole paripīḍyate ।
ājīvanaṃ duḥkhadātā mithyābhiśaṃsakaśca yaḥ ॥47॥
mārayitvā khādayitvā jīvayitvā yamānugāḥ ।
kṛntanti saṃchedayanti khādayanti hyamuṃ yamāḥ ॥48॥
patnyai duḥkhapradātā yaḥ svāmine duḥkhadā ca yā ।
āśritānāṃ duḥkhadā ye te patanti tu raurave ॥49॥
ityevaṃ rakṣakā yatra bhakṣakā luñcajīvinaḥ ।।
sarve te nārakāḥ pāṭyā jāyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ ॥1.66.50॥
ityevaṃ nirayāḥ santi prāṇināṃ niṣkṛtātmakāḥ ।
yatra śuddhyanti pāpiṣṭhāstato gacchanti janmane ॥51।।
yasya yādṛk janma karma vidyate prāk tu saṃcitam ।
tasya tathaiva mārgeṇa yamaḥ prāpayate janim ॥52॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne catvāriṃśannarakagāmināṃ pāpaphalavarṇananāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 66 ।।
