śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca---
narakāṇāṃ mahākaṣṭamanubhūya tu nārakāḥ ।
svakarmaśeṣabhāgena prāpnuvanti ca vai tanum ।। 1 ।।
daivikīṃ paitṛkīṃ yoniṃ mānuṣīṃ vātha nārakīm ।
prāpya dharmasya vacanānmuktirbhavati vā tataḥ ।। 2 ।।
yathā yathā kṛtaṃ karma tāṃ tāṃ yoniṃ vrajennaraḥ ।
tattathaiva hi bhuñjāno vicaretsarvayoniṣu ।। 3 ।।
yena karmavipākena yathā nirayabhāgbhavet ।
yathā taduttara janma tattanme śṛṇu padmaje ! ।। 4 ।।
yātanā'nte vimuktāste hyanekāṃ jīvasantatim ।
gatvā mānuṣayonau tu pāpacihnā bhavanti te ।। 5 ।।
tatrā'nṛtapravāhī tu galatkaṇṭho'rdhajihvakaḥ ।
yadvā mūko bhavedeva devādīnāṃ vinindakaḥ ॥ 6 ।।
jīvahā tu kṣayī kuṣṭhī śyāvadantastu madyapaḥ ।
svarṇahārī kunakhī duścarmā strībhogakṛd balāt ।। 7 ।।
mātsaryādapi jātyandho janmāndho'nyākṣisaṃharan ।
phalahartā vānaraḥ syāt kākaścauryā'nnabhojanāt ॥ 8 ॥
anyavaṃśaṃ vinindanvai vaṃśahīno'napatyakaḥ ।
dravyahartā bhaved godhā garadaḥ sarpajanmavān ।। 9 ।।
prasahya tu balātkārī jāyate'tra piśācakaḥ ।
cātako jalahartā syād dhānyahartā tu mūṣakaḥ ॥1.67.10॥
jalaprasravaṇabhettā jale matsyo bhavediti ।
vañcanākarmakṛtprāṇī hyulūko jāyate muhuḥ ॥11॥
anyādācchidya bhuṃjānaḥ sārameyo'bhijāyate ।
pratiśrutyā'dadanprāṇī jambūko jāyate vane ॥12॥
cauryaṃ kṛtvā sadā bhuṃjan viḍvarāhaḥ prajāyate ।
pūjyānāṃ tvavamānādvai labhate kācchapī tanum ॥13॥
sarveṣāṃ tu tiraskartā cāṇḍālo jāyate'tra vai ।
syādanyasya ṛṇagrāhī vṛṣo'śvo gardabhaśca vā ।।14।।
rativighnakaraḥ ṣaṇḍho mārjāraḥ paramāṃsabhuk ।
pārakyasya prahartā vai tittiro jāyate vane ।।15।।
prasahya vaśakartāro nārījanma hyavāpnuyuḥ ।
prasahya ratikartāro bhagaliṃgādirogiṇaḥ ।।16।।
gṛhāvāsādihartāro jāyante'raṇyajantavaḥ ।
paśūnāṃ ghātakāścātra jāyante ghātyajantavaḥ ॥17॥
svāmidravyāpahartāro draridrāḥ saṃbhavantyapi ।
vidvannindāprakartāro mūrkhā bhavanti bāliśāḥ ॥18॥
viśvāsayitvā jantūnāṃ bandhakā ghātakā janāḥ ।
pañjarīyapaśupakṣijanmānaḥ saṃbhavanti hi ।।19।।
manuṣyāṇāṃ tiraskartā vicitto jāyate'tra vai ।
śāṭhyakāpaṭyanairghṛṇyapoṣṭā kitavatāṃ vrajet ।।1.67.20।।
manuṣyahā jāyate'tra pāśadhṛk pāradhiśca vai ।
paśuhā ghātakī bhūtvā śatajanmā hyajo bhavet ।।21।।
matsyādo matsyajanmā syāt sarvādo jhaṣa eva ca ।
anyānnavastragehāderhartā vṛkṣomarusthale ॥22॥
gandhacandanasaṃhartā nāsāhīnaḥ prajāyate ।
gurupitṛpūjyanindāśrotā syād badhiro'tra vai ॥23॥
pādahartā bhavet paṅgurhastaghno vṛkṇa eva ca ।
nārīṇāṃ duḥkhakṛtkuṃbhakārasya gardabho bhavet ॥24॥
patyurduḥkhakarī nārī gardabhī saṃbhavettathā ।
karmacāridravyachettā daridro vānaro bhavet ॥25॥
jantujāṃ nāśako bhittijantvadā godhakī bhavet ।
malino makṣikājanma krodhī sarpatvamāpnuyāt ।।26।।
dveṣī grāmyaśunaḥ pipīlikānāṃ janma cāpnuyāt ।
anyāyakāmī vṛṣaṇocchettā syāt ṣaṇḍhagovṛṣaḥ ॥27॥
dharmānnadravyavasvādehartā syādārtikukkuraḥ ।
pārakyānnādibhoktāraḥ kukkuṭīṃ yonimāpnuyuḥ ॥28॥
kāryahantā tu ghūkaḥ syāt kāryaroddhā śṛgālakaḥ ।
pariveṣitapātrāṇāṃ hartā syādvṛkṣavāgulī ॥29॥
nārīhartā rākṣasaḥ syāt māntrikaḥ syāt piśācakaḥ ।
vāsanikastu bhūtaḥ syāt krūradṛṣṭistu śākinī ।।1.67.30।।
samātsaryā ḍākinī syāt piśācinyabhicārikā ।
garbhahantrī gaṇikā syāt kulaṭā patyakāmanā ।।31।।
parā'patyā'sahā'pyatrā'patyahīnā bhavatyapi ।
ṛtudānā'grāhikā tu ṣaṇḍhā bhavati sarvathā ॥32॥
parocchedakarī svīyocchedakartrī bhavetpunaḥ ।
suptanāśaprakartāro hanyante ghātakīgṛhe ॥33॥
parasasya praloptāro bhavantyakṣetravṛttayaḥ ।
parakarmaviloptāro jāyante'karmayoniṣu ।।34
tailahārī tailapāyī pūtivaktrastu sūcakaḥ ।
dhānyahāryatiriktāṃgaḥ piśunaḥ pūtināsikaḥ ॥35॥
brahmahā śvāḥ svaroṣṭaḥ syānmūkaścānte bhavatyapi ।
dravyacauraḥ kṛmiḥ kīṭastṛṇādo gurunāśakaḥ ॥36॥
kṣayarogī śyāvadantaḥ kunakhī svaṇacauryakṛt ।
pakvahartā tvanāhārī mūko rāgā'pahārakaḥ ॥37॥
tulakūṭapramākartā vaṭavāgulikā bhavet ।
vikreyakūṭasāṃkaryakartā śvāsārtiko bhavet ॥38॥
anyeṣāṃ prāṇaroddhā vai kṣayarogārtiko bhavet ।
krayavikrayakauṭilyakartā'rṣarogavānbhavet।
ucchiṣṭajalapātā syānmūtrakṛcchrādirogavān ।
anyavṛttiharo loke bhikṣukaḥ satiraskṛtaḥ ॥1.67.40।।
anyonyā'tyasaho duṣṭaścāṇḍālo vāghgharirbhavet ।
chalachadmaprakartā syād dhīvaraḥ śabaro'pi ca ॥41॥
vastravikrayakāpaṭyatantuvāyo bhavatyapi ।
rathyācatuṣkamālinyakartā malaharo'ntyajaḥ ॥42॥
snānaśuddhiniṣeddhā syād rajako vastraśodhakaḥ ।
anyā'niṣṭecchukacauro mārjāro jāyate rudan ॥43॥
kūṭauṣadhapradātā syānnakūlo nirjane vane ।
kūṭavastuprakartā syāt kūṭastrīputrako'tra vai ॥44।।
svarṇarūpyādisāṃkarye kāpaṭyena karoti yaḥ ।
varṇasaṃkarajanmā syād galatkuṣṭho bhavettathā ।।45।।
kaumāryaduṣakāśca syurājīvanaṃ vidhūrakāḥ ।
svāminyasatpravaktā syānnāpitaḥ kṣurakarmakṛt ॥46॥
āyudhānāṃ tu nirmātā jalaukā saṃprajāyate ।
paśupakṣigavājādimāṃsādāḥ gṛdhraviḍbhujaḥ ॥47॥
siṃhā vyāghrā vṛkā dīpā jāyante māṃsabhojinaḥ ।
kanyāvikrayakartāro jāyante yonikīṭakāḥ ।
rasasāṃkaryakartāro jāyante malakīṭakāḥ ॥48॥
nirādhārapradogdhāro bhavanti māstikīyūkāḥ ।
paṃktibhettodaraṃbharo jāyate cāntrarogavān ॥49॥
dampatīkleśakartāro bhāṃḍā bhavanti nartakāḥ ।
kāmāsaktaviyoktāro vṛndalāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ॥1.67.50॥
kāmasukhaprabhaṃktāro'raṇye śūnyaraṃtimṛgāḥ ।
maṇḍukāścaiva jāyante ratimātsaryavannarāḥ ॥51॥
sādhusādhvīdrohakartā syānmūko badhiro janeḥ ।।
poṣyā'poṣaṇakartṝṇāṃ malamūṣakatā bhavet ॥52॥
dugdhadaprāṇihantṝṇāṃ janma nirjalabhūphaṇam ।
vāgbāṇamarmabhettṝṇāṃ kaṃkiṭakṛkalāsajam ॥53॥
piṣṭacauryaprakartṝṇāṃ janma bhallukarūkṣajam ।
mahaccauryaprakartṝṇāṃ janma tvandhasarīsṛpe ।।54।।
devatīrthagurudrohī dharmāṇāṃ nindakastathā ।
kuṭumbakleśakartā syādaraṇye kākadīpakaḥ ॥55॥
madirāmāṃsasaṃjīvī siṃho'raṇye nṛpo bhavet ।
jālatarkaṭapāśā'śī bahuśrṛṃgo mṛgo bhavet ॥56॥
snānālasastu khaḍgākhyamṛgo genḍo bhavediti ।
bhallukaḥ syāt piṣṭahartā vāgulī guptabhojinī ॥57॥
citrapicchā chalakartrī śilakī syāt svatantriṇī ।
guptapibā gṛhagodhā gavayo guptabhojanaḥ ।।58॥
yathā vā vāsanāyogājjāyante citradehinaḥ ।
caturaśītikhanyantāścitrakarmakarā muhuḥ ॥59॥
jāyante tāmasāḥ kīṭā vṛkṣādyā vā tṛṇaukasaḥ ।
vṛddhāpamānakartāro jāyante māhiṣā vṛṣāḥ ॥1.67.60॥
dāmpatyabhaṃgakartāro vidhurā janmajanmasu ।
malendriyātilubdhāstu kīṭā malagatāḥ sadā ॥61॥
guptaghātāstu jhallādāḥ pāśinaḥ śvapacādayaḥ ।
indriyahā bhavedindriyeṇa hīnaḥ kṣatiśritaḥ ॥62॥
ātatāyijanā yānti bhugnadehān sadārtidān ।
tāmasāḥ saṃprajāyante yavanā daityarākṣasāḥ ॥63॥
patyurhantryaḥ prajāyante vidhavā janmajanmasu ।
śvaśrūduḥkhapradā nārī gardabhī jāyate kṛśā ॥64॥
vadhūdveṣṭrī bhavenmārjārikā kuṣṭhādirogiṇī ।
sāpatnyadveṣakartrī syācchunī kharjanarogiṇī ॥65॥
pakṣapātakarī yāyād daridre pāśavīṃ daśām ।
kāryahantrī bhaved ghūkī kleṣadā kābarī bhavet ॥66॥
anaivedyarasāsvādā bhaved gṛdhrā ca garjukī ।
śyenā bakī bhavet sā yā gṛhe kāpaṭyavartinī ॥67॥
dhūrtā kākī bhavet kṛṣṇā śṛgālī nāpitī tathā ।
jāṃgulikī bhaved dviṣṭā santāne dveṣacāriṇī ॥68॥
ṣaṇḍhā syāt liṃgapātātmā'bhicārādiprayogiṇī ।
mantrābhicārakartrī syād bhūtī piśācikā tathā ॥69॥
bālahā garbhahā bījahantrī tu rākṣasī bhavet ।
antardāhakarī duḥkhapradā syād yavanī khasī ।।1.67.70।।
ityevaṃ bahujanmāno bhavanti nārakā janāḥ ।
punaḥ karma punarjanma lakṣayoniṣu jāyate ॥71॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārakāṇāṃ punarjanmacihnaparicayādikathananāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥67॥


← adhyāyaḥ 067 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 68
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 069 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! pravakṣyāmi janaṃ śārīracihnakam ।
kīdṛgrūpo janaḥ kīdṛkkarmā kīdṛgguṇo bhavet ॥ 1॥
saṃkṣepāttatpravakṣyāmi lokavijñāna hetave ।
śarīrāṇi samānyeva naranārīdivaukasām ।। 2 ।।
ākṛterbhedabhāvo vai paricāyaka eva ha ।
cihnānāṃ bhedabhāvastu karmaṇāṃ paricāyakaḥ ॥ 3 ॥
dhanahīnasya tu pādau śūrpākārau śirālakau ।
vakrau rukṣau ca saṃśuṣkau pāṇḍunakhaudarāṃgulī ।। 4 ।।
vaṃśasya nāśakau pādāvutkamaṭhau kaṣāyakau ।
brahmaghnasya bhavetāṃ tu caraṇau śaṃkusannidhau ।।5।।
nirdhanasya romakūpe ekaika eva romakaḥ ।
nṛpasya śrotriyasyāpi dvau dvau śrīdhīmatāṃ tathā ।। 6 ।।
tryādyairniḥsvā duḥkhabhājo ninditāśca bhavanti hi ।
yasya keśāḥ kuṃcitāḥ syuḥ sa pravāse mriyeta vai ।। 7 ।।
yasya jānū tu nirmāṃsau saubhāgyaḥ sa bhavejjanaḥ ।
nimnā'lpajānumān bodhyaḥ sarvadā strīrato janaḥ ।।8।।
daridro viṣamajānuḥ puṣṭajānurnṛpo bhavet ।
mahajja़+ānurdīrghajīvī vakrajānustu kāmukaḥ ॥ 9 ॥
yasya pādau mṛdutalau kamalodarasannibhau ।
śliṣṭāṃgulī tāmranakhau supārṣṇī va śirojjhitau ॥1.68.10॥
uṣṇau kūrmonnatau gūḍhagulphau sa nṛpatirbhavet ।
yo naro hyalpaliṃgaḥ syādapatyarahitastu saḥ ॥11॥
yastu bhavet sthūlaliṃgaḥ sāpatyo'pi dhanojjhitaḥ ।
meḍhraṃ vāmanataṃ yasya tasya putrārthahīnatā ॥12॥
liṃgamadhonataṃ yasya dāridryaṃ tasya sarvadā ।
dakṣavakraṃ yasya meḍhraṃ putravānsa matau janaḥ ॥13॥
sthūlagranthiyute liṃge śirāle bahuputrakaḥ ।
koṣagūḍhe prajanane nṛpaḥ syādbahuputrakaḥ ॥14॥
dīrghakāṣo bhugnakoṣo dhanahīnaḥ sadā bhavet ।
durbalatvekavṛṣaṇo viṣamavṛṣaṇaścalaḥ ॥15॥
samābhyāṃ nṛpatiḥ proktaḥ pralambena śatābdavān ।
bhavet siṃhakaṭī rājā niḥsvaḥ kapikaṭirnaraḥ ॥16॥
sarpodarā daridrāḥ syurdhaninaḥ sthūlapārśvakāḥ ।
samakakṣāśca bhogāḍhyā nimnakakṣā dhanojjhitāḥ ।।17।।
nṛpāśconnatakakṣāḥ syurjihmā viṣamakakṣakāḥ ।
aśīghramaithunyalpāyurdīrghāyuḥ śīghramaithunī ॥18॥
sukhī syādvistīrṇanābhirduḥkhyatinimnanābhikaḥ ।
valimadhyagato nābhiḥ śūlapīḍāṃ karoti vai ।।19॥
medhāvī dakṣiṇāvarto vāmāvarto vaśī naraḥ ।
pārśvāyatā cirāyuḥ syādupariṣṭhāddhaneśvaraḥ ॥1.68.20॥
ekavaliḥ śatāyuḥ syāt śrībhogī dvivalirnaraḥ ।
trivaliḥ kṣmeśa ācārya ṛjubhirvalibhiḥ sukhī ॥21॥
dakṣiṇāvartaromā syācchāsakaḥ sumahān janaḥ ।
vāmāvartā'nyathāvartaromā preṣyaśca duḥkhitaḥ ॥22॥
anuddhataiścucukaiśca bhavanti subhagā janāḥ ।
uddhatairviṣamairdīrghaiḥ pītāgrairnirdhanā narāḥ ॥23॥
samonnataṃ ca hṛdayamakampaṃ māṃsalaṃ pṛthu ।
nṛpāṇāmadhamānāṃ ca khararomaśirālakam ॥24॥
samavakṣāstu dhanavān pīnavakṣāḥ ramāpatiḥ ।
nirdhano viṣamavakṣāḥ śastreṇa mṛtyumāpnuyāt ॥25॥
viṣamajatruko niḥsvaḥ pīnajatrurdhanādhipaḥ ।
nirdhanaścipiṭakaṇṭhaḥ śirāśuṣkagalaḥ sukhī ॥26॥
śūraḥ syānmahiṣagrīvaḥ śāstrānto mṛgakaṇṭhakaḥ ।
kambugrīvaśca nṛpatirlambakaṇṭho'tibhakṣakaḥ ॥27॥
kakṣā'śvatthadalā śreṣṭhā sugandhirmagaromikā ।।
anyathā tvarthahīnānāṃ dāridryasya ca kāraṇam ॥28॥
samāṃsau vipulau śliṣṭau bhugnālpau pīvarau tathā ।
vṛttāvājānulambau ca bhujau daivau ca rājakau ॥29॥
niḥsvānāṃ romaśau hrasvau śreṣṭhau karikaraprabhau ।
hastāṃgulaya eva syuḥ svarṇavarṇā dhaneśituḥ ॥1.68.30॥
tāśca medhāvināṃ sūkṣmā bhṛtyānāṃ cipiṭāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
susthūlāṃgulayo niḥsvāḥ kapitulyakarāstathā ॥31॥
pitṛdravyavināśī syānnimnakaratalo janaḥ ।
maṇibandho nigūḍhaḥ syād rājyado dhanado vṛtaḥ ।।3।।
karaiḥ karatalaiścaiva lākṣābhai raktakomalaiḥ ।
guravaḥ syuḥ pītarukṣairnidhanā eva sarvadā ।।33।।
tuṣatulyanakhāḥ klībā niḥsvāḥ sphuṭitavakrakaiḥ ।
kunakhaiśca vivarṇaiśca paratarkakarā matāḥ ॥34॥
tāmraiśca vartulairdevā madhyonnatanakhairmatāḥ ।
sayavāṃ'guṣṭhako rājā putrī parvaprapūrṇakaḥ ॥35॥
yugamīnāṃkitakaro bhavetsatraprado naraḥ ।
vajracihnaṃ tu dhanināṃ viduṣo matsyapucchakam ॥36॥
śaṃkhā''tapatraśibikāgajapadmāni bhūbhrati ।
kuṃbhāṃ'kuśapatākāśca mṛṇālaśca nidhīśvare ॥37॥
dāmarekhā gavāḍhye vai svastikaśca nṛpeśvare ।
cakrā'sitomaradhanurdantarekhā nṛpeśvare ॥38॥
ulūkhalasamā rekhā yājñikasya kare matā ।
cakrāṇi bahūni caiva vedīrekhā'gnihotriṇi ।।39।।
vāpīdaivīnadīrekhāstrikoṇo dhārmike kare ।
aṃguṣṭhamūlagā rekhāḥ sukhakṛtsutabodhikāḥ ॥1.68.40॥
kaniṣṭhāmūlataḥ pradeśinīmūlagatā ca yā ।
śatāyurbādhikā rekhā chinnā cet taruto bhayam ॥41॥
niḥsvāśca bahurekhāḥ syurnidhanāścibukaiḥ kṛśaiḥ ।
māṃsalaiḥ raktavarṇaiśca hyadharairdhanavānbhavet ।।42॥
bimbopamaiśca sphuṭitai rūkṣairviṣamakhaṇḍitaiḥ ।
oṣṭhairdhanarahitāḥ syurdantāḥ snigdhā ghanā śubhāḥ ।।43॥
tīkṣṇā dantāḥ samāḥ śreṣṭhā jihvā raktā samā śubhā ।
ślakṣṇā dīrghā tu vijñeyā tāluḥ śveto dhanakṣayaḥ ।।44॥
kṛṣṇā tu paruṣā jihvā raktāgrā rogiṇī matā ।
vaktraṃ saumyaṃ samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ nṛpateḥ smṛtam ॥45॥
viparītaṃ tu duḥkhānāṃ durbhagāṇāmalokakam ।
āḍhyānāṃ vartulaṃ vaktraṃ nirdravyāṇāṃ tu dīrghakam ॥46॥
bhīruvaktraḥ pāpakārī dhūrtānāṃ caturasrakam ।
nimnaṃ vaktraṃ tvaputrāṇāṃ kṛpaṇānāṃ ca hrasvakam ॥47॥
sampūrṇaṃ bhogināṃ kāntaṃ śmaśrusnigdhaṃ śubhaṃ mṛdu ।
saṃhataṃ cā'sphuṭitāgraṃ raktaśmaśru ca caurakam ।।48।।
śaṃkukarṇāstu rājāno romakarṇā gatāyuṣaḥ ।
bṛhatkarṇā dhaninṛpāḥ kṛpaṇā hrasvakarṇakāḥ ॥49॥
bhogī vai nimnagaṇḍaḥ syānmantrī sampūrṇagaṇḍakaḥ ।
śukanāsaḥ sukhī proktaḥ śukanāso'tijīvanaḥ ॥1.68.50॥
chinnāgrakūpanāsastu bahunārīvyavāyakaḥ ।।
dīrghanāsaḥ saubhagaḥ syāccauraḥ kuñcitanāsikaḥ ॥51॥
cipiṭanāsaḥ krūraḥ syāttathā bhāgyavihīnakaḥ ।
svalpachidrā supuṭā cā'vakrā sā nṛpatermatā ।।5।।
krūre dakṣiṇavakrā syād vāmavakrā hyaniṣṭadā ।
vakrāntaiḥ padmapatrābhairlocanaiḥ sukhabhāginaḥ ॥53॥
mārjāralocanaiḥ pāpmā durātmā madhupiṃgalaiḥ ।।
krūrāḥ kekaranetrāśca haritākṣāḥ sakalmaṣāḥ ॥54॥
jihmaiśca locanaiḥ śūrāḥ senānyo gajalocanāḥ ।
gaṃbhīrākṣā īśvarāḥ syurmantriṇaḥ sthūlacakṣuṣaḥ ।।55।।
nīlotpalākṣā vidvāṃsaḥ saubhagāḥ śyāmacakṣuṣaḥ ।।
syurutpāṭanakartāraḥ kṛṣṇatārakacakṣuṣaḥ ॥56॥
maṇḍalākṣāśca pāpāḥ syurniḥsvā syurdīnalocanāḥ ।।
dhanī dīrghasaṃsaktabhrūrdaridrā viṣamabhruvaḥ ॥57।।
viśālonnatabālendūnnatabhruvaḥ sukhāḍhyakāḥ ।
niḥsvo bhavati khaṇḍabhūrdārakabhrūśca nirdhanaḥ ॥58!!
nirdhanā vipulaiḥ śaṃkhairlalāṭairviṣamaistathā ।
ardhendusamabhālaistu dhanavanto matā janāḥ ॥59॥
śuktiviśālairācāryāḥ śirālaiḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ ।
unnatābhiḥ śirābhiśca svastikābhirnareśvarāḥ ॥1.68.60।।
nimnairbhālairvadhārhāśca krūrakarmāratāstathā ।
saṃvṛtaiśca lalāṭaiśca kṛpaṇā unnatairnṛpāḥ ॥61।।
akampaṃ hasitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nimīlitamaghāvaham ।
asakṛddhasitaṃ duṣṭaṃ sadarpaṃ ghātakaṃ bhavet ॥62।।
lalāṭopasṛtāstisro rekhāḥ syuḥ śatavarṣiṇām ।
nṛpaḥ sa syāccatasṛbhiḥ paṃcanavatirjīvati ॥63॥
arekhenā''yurnavatirvicchinnābhistadardhakam ।
keśāntopagatābhiśca hyaśītyāyurnaro bhavet ॥64॥
paṃcabhiḥ saptabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paṃcāśat bahubhistathā ।
catvāriṃśacca raktābhistriṃśad bhrūlagnagāmibhiḥ ॥65॥
viṃśatirvāmavakrābhirāyuḥ kṣudrābhiralpakam ।
chatrākāraiḥ śirobhistu nṛpo bāṇasamo dhanī ॥66॥
ghaṭamūrdhā pāparuciḥ piturmṛtyuścipīṭakaḥ ।
kṛṣṇā''kuṃcitasnigdhāgrā'bhinnāntakeśavān nṛpaḥ ॥67।।
rājñyāḥ pādau mṛdutalau matsyāṃkuśadhvajāṃ'citau ।
vajrābjahalacihnau ca nigūḍhagulphakau matau ॥68।।
aśvatthapatrasadṛśaṃ vipulaṃ guhyamuttamam ।
gūḍhaḥ śukaśva śubhado māṃsalaṃ vartulaṃ mukham ।।69।।
nābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartā madhyaṃ trivaliśobhitam ।
āraktāvadharau śreṣṭhau māṃsalaṃ vartulaṃ mukham ।।1.68.70।।
snigdhanīlāśca mṛdavo mūrdhajāḥ kuṃcitāḥ śubhāḥ ।
strīṇāṃ pādatale yadvā pāṇidvayatale imāḥ ।।71॥
vājikuṃjaraśrīvṛkṣayūpeṣuyavatomarāḥ ।
dhvajacāmaramālāśca śailakuṇḍalavedikāḥ ॥72॥
śaṃkhātapatrakamalamatsyasvastikasadrathāḥ ।
aṃkuśādyāśca rekhāḥ syurdevyastā rājavallabhāḥ ॥73॥
haryaṃśāḥ svastikadhanustriśūladhvajamatsyakāḥ ।
rekhā yā maṇibandhotthā gatā madhyāṃgulīkare ।।74।।
ūrdhvarekhā tu sā proktā haste pāde'thavā bhavet ।
strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ tathā sā syād rājyāya ca sukhāya ca ।।75।।
naracihnavatī nārī naraśca strīsvarūpakaḥ ।
na maṃgalakṛtau syātāṃ vaiparītyakarāvubhau ।।76।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārīdaivīśārīracihnapradarśananāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥68।।


← adhyāyaḥ 068 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 69
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 070 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca---
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! pravakṣyāmi tava cihnāni me priye !
paśya nābhiṃ dakṣiṇāvartāṃ te gāmbhīryaśālinīm ।। 1 ।।
aromāṃ trivalīṃ paśya hṛtstanau romavarjitau ।
madhyāṃśaṃ sarvaśaktyāḍhyaṃ paśyā'ntardṛḍhakuṇḍalam ।। 2 ।।
nābhyadhaḥ paśya rekhāṃ tu svarṇabāṇasya piṃgalām ।
vāmasakthni tathā paśya pādukācihnamagrataḥ ।। 3 ।।
vakṣasi stanayormadhye pādarekhāṃ vilokaya ।
lalāṭe mukuṭākārāṃ gaṇḍe binduṃ ca lokaya ।। 4 ।।
urasī paśya viṣṇuṃ māṃ rekhārūpacaturbhujam ।
vāme bhuje gadācihnaṃ cā'valokaya me priye ।। 5 ।।
hṛdaye vaijayantyāstu rekhāṃ paśya prapauraṭīm ।
gajaṃ karatale dakṣe sapadmaṃ paśya cā'naghe ।। 6 ।।
dakṣiṇe tu pade paśya śaṃkhacihnaṃ sumaṃgalam ।
aṃgulyā mūlake paśya rekhāṃ vimānasadṛśīm ।। 7 ।।
kaniṣṭhāyāḥ paśya mūlādhastvaṃ naukāṃ surekhayā ।
tathā śaṃkhagadārekhāḥ paśya makaralekhanam ।। 8 ।।
tathā madhye suśikhararekhāṃ nibhālaya priye ।
paśya pārṣṇau matsyarekhāṃ madhye tāmbūlavallikām ।। 9 ।।
paśya vāmāṃguṣṭhamūle yavacihnaṃ surekhayā ।
tadadhastu mahāntaṃ vai prāsādaṃ paśya rekhayā ।।1.69.10।।
chatraṃ paśya tadadhastu yutaṃ taccordhvarekhayā ।
kamalarekhāṃ phaṇake dhvajarekhāṃ prapaśya ca ॥11॥
aṃkuśacihnaṃ kumudaṃ paśya śrīphalamityapi ।
sthalīyapadmarekhāṃ ca ghaṭarekhāṃ nibhālaya ।।12।।
dvitīyāyāścandrarekhāṃ daśacakrāṇi paśya ca ।
svarṇarekhāṃ phaṇopari bhāle tāntikalekhanām ।।13।।
cibuke bindukaṃ paśya stane vāme tu cakrakam ।
dakṣe stane hastarekhāṃ kaṇṭhe hāraṃ supiṃgalam ॥14॥
jaghane tu suvarṇāṃ vai dhanūrekhāṃ prapaśya ca ।
svastikaṃ dakṣiṇe hastatale matsyaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā ॥15॥
dhanurvaṃśīmatsyarekhāḥ paśya kalaśarekhikām ।
aṃkuśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cakraṃ paśya dakṣe kare tale ॥16॥
paśya prākārarekhāṃ ca tatra toraṇamityapi ।
paśya lāṃgalacihnaṃ ca tatraiva phaṇake priye ॥17॥
gūḍha śukaṃ paśya lakṣmi ! āraktāvadharau tathā ।
haste dakṣe cordhvarekhāṃ paśya vāme tathaiva ca ॥18॥
pādatalayostūrdhvarekhāḥ prapaśya mama priye ।
pāde tu vājinaṃ caiva kuṃjaraṃ śrīmahādrumam ।।19।।
yūpaṃ bāṇaṃ yavaṃ caiva tomaraṃ paśya rekhayā ।
haste ca mālikārekhāṃ paśya dīpaṃ ca cāmaram ।।1.69.20।।
paśya śailaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ ca vedikāṃ paśya rekhayā ।
mukhanetrabhrūlalāṭauṣṭhanāsikākapolakān ॥21॥
paśya vibhrājamānāँste gaurān svarṇamanoharān ।
tattaccihnaistathā devyo bhavanti bhagavatpriyāḥ ॥22॥
bhaktimatyaśca me nāryo lakṣmīrūpā bhavanti vai ।
mamopāsanasāmarthyāt karomi kamalālayāḥ ॥23॥
brahmalokanivāsinyo golokabhūkṛtālayāḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhavāsamāpannāḥ śvetadvīpagatāśca yāḥ ॥24॥
amṛtadhāmasthāyinyo vahnimaṇḍalamadhyagā ।
sūryalokanivāsinyaḥ candramaṇḍalasaṃsthitāḥ ॥25॥
satyalokanivāsinya īśvarasṛṣṭisaṃbhavāḥ ।
pitṛsargagatā yāśca ṛṣipatnyastathā ca yāḥ ॥26॥
devyaścātha manuṣyāṇyo'devyo nāgādisaṃpriyāḥ ।
sarvāstu māṃ parābhaktyā samāsādyā'bhavan śriyaḥ ॥27॥
tāścā'haṃ naikalokeṣu nārāyaṇasvarūpakaḥ ।
ramayāmi mahālakṣmi ! yathā tvāmatra dhāmani ॥28॥
mana bhaktyā tu sarvāstā lakṣmyo jāyanta eva hi ।
yāśca māṃ na bhajantyanyāḥ tāstu pāpena karmaṇā ॥29॥
gacchanti vividhākārakhaniṣvatra paratra ca ।
yamaloke mahāduḥkhānyanubhūyāpi janmani ॥1.69.30॥
jāyante nahi śubhadā duḥkhāya saṃbhavanti tāḥ ।
yamapuryāstu yā nāryo yātanā anubhūya ca ।।31॥
pāpaleśājjanmavatyo duḥkhadā eva kīrtitāḥ ।
śṛṇu tā api saṃkṣepātprasaṃgātpravadāmi te ॥32॥
kaniṣṭhikā'nāmikā vā yasyā na spṛśate mahīm ।
aṃguṣṭhaṃ vā gatā'tītya tarjanī kulaṭā ca sā ॥33॥
romaśe cātimāṃse ca jaṃghe cātiśirālake ।
vāmāvartaṃ nimnamalpaṃ guhyaṃ yasyā hi duḥkhadā ॥34॥
grīvayā hrasvayā niḥsvā dīrghayā ca kulakṣayaḥ ।
pṛthulayā pracaṇḍā ca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।35॥
kekare piṃgale netre śyāme lole tu cā'satī ।
smite kūpe gaṇḍayośca sā dhruvaṃ vyabhicāriṇī ॥36॥
pralambinī lalāṭe tu devaraṃ hanti cāṃganā ।
udare śvaśuraṃ hanti patiṃ hanti sphicordvayoḥ ॥37॥
yā tu romottarauṣṭhī syānna śubhā bhartureva ha।
stanau saromāvaśubhau karṇau ca viṣamau tathā ॥38॥
karālā viṣamā dantāḥ kleśāya tu bhavanti tāḥ ।
cauryāya kṛṣṇamāṃsābhā dīrghā bhartuśca mṛtyave ॥39॥
kravyādarūpairhastaiśca vṛkakākādisannibhaiḥ ।
śirālairviṣamaiḥ śuṣkairvittahīnā bhavanti tāḥ ॥1.69.40॥
samunnatottarauṣṭhī yā kalahaiḥ rūkṣabhāṣiṇī ।
lambakarṇasvarā śmaśrumatī pāde tu kālikā ॥41॥
netre raktā bhuvi tīvrā svalpabhālā tu ghātinī ।
bahurekhā bahuromā bahubhāṣā'ticañcalā ॥42॥
bahusaṃgā bahunidrā bahvālasyā bahuvyayā ।
sarvathā nirdhanatvaṃ ca dāridryaṃ mantrayatyasau ॥43॥
tasmāt satkarma kartavyaṃ nā'satkarma kadācana ।
susatkarmakṛtātpuṇyāccharīraṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ।।44।।
prāpyate dhanadhānyārthyagṛhodyānādi cottamam ।
kālaḥ pratīkṣate naiva kimanena kṛtaṃ na vā ॥45॥
mriyate jāyate jantuḥ puṣyate ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
maraṇaṃ jananaṃ puṣṭiryā tu mokṣāya nirmitā ।।46।।
sā vai svenaiva kartavyā yadvā putrakuṭumbibhiḥ ।
śubhaṃ jantorbhaved yena tathā''caryyaṃ divāniśam ।।47।।
pṛthvī vāsāya salilaṃ tṛptaye śāntaye marut ।
dehaḥ śramāya cānnāya śreyaḥ kasmānna sādhayet ।।48।।
sarvatrā'tiśayaścāsti vicāryaiva punaḥ punaḥ ।
yathā'pekṣe cātiśayo nāstītyapi vicārya ca ॥49॥
yadṛcchayopapannena nirvāhya svakalevaram ।
nātisaṃsaktamanasā lokayātrāṃ tu nirvahan ॥1.69.50॥
nārāyaṇaṃ bhajennityaṃ yathā tvaṃ kamalekṣaṇe ।
tasya nāsti sukhaṃ śreyo mokṣaśca dūramaṇvapi ॥51॥
sādhusādhvīsvarūpaṃ māṃ bhajet sarvasamarpaṇāt ।
dīnā'tithinirādhārarūpaṃ māṃ sevayenmudā ॥52॥
vidyārthibālabālāsuvṛddhagurvādirūpataḥ ।
vicarāmi kvacid devi ! tadrūpaṃ māṃ prasevayet ॥53॥
tatrastho'haṃ paraṃ śreyaḥ kariṣyāmi yathā svayam ।
bhaktasya tu sadā śreyaḥ kartuṃ dīkṣāṃ vahāmyaham ॥54॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmīcihnāni pramadāntaracihnāni cetyādikathananāmā ekonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥69॥


← adhyāyaḥ 069 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 70
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 071 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! vinā muktiṃ paralokagatiḥ sadā ।
kaṣṭā kaṣṭapradā syādvai hyātma svārjitajīvanaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
mṛtasya yadi kārye'pi yogyapiṇḍādi nārpayet ।
agre gatervilopaḥ syād duḥkhabāhulyamāpatet ॥ 2 ॥
tasmātkarmagatiṃ yāsyan mariṣyaँśca svayaṃ tadā ।
jīvanneva svasaukhyārthaṃ kuryātpuṇyamatandritaḥ ॥ 3 ॥
naro vā yadi vā nārī śarīrendriyayogataḥ ।
sukhaṃ dharmaṃ duḥkhamadharmaṃ kurvanti svabhāvataḥ ।। 4 ।।
sukhārthaṃ dharmamākuryādadharmaṃ tu duḥkhāya vai ।
svena naiva kṛtaṃ kiñcit pāścātyaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ।। 5 ।।
tathāpi snehilo loko janaścāpi tathā vidhaḥ ।
snehādhīnaḥ karotyeva pāścātye'pi janaḥ kvacit ।। 6 ।।
yadā jantuḥ śarīrādvai paralokāya yāti vai ।
tadā prāṇairvihīnaṃ taccharīraṃ śavasaṃjñitam ॥ 7 ॥
aspṛśyaṃ jāyate tūrṇaṃ kṛmiviṭbhasmasaṃjñitam ।
mṛtasyotkrāntisamayāt ṣaṭpiṇḍān kramato'rpayet ॥ 8 ॥
mṛtasthāne śavo nāma piṇḍastatra pradīyate ।
tena bhūmirbhavet tuṣṭā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ॥ 9 ॥
dvāradeśe bhavetpānthastena nāmnā pradīyate ।
tena dattena tuṣyanti gṛhavāstvadhidevatāḥ ॥1.70.10॥
catvare khecaro nāma tannāmnā tu pradīyate ।
tena tatropaghātāya bhūtakoṭiḥ palāyate ॥11॥
viśrāme bhūtasaṃjño'yaṃ tamuddiśya pradīyate ।
piśācā rākṣasā yakṣā ye cānye tatra vāsinaḥ ॥12॥
tasya hotavyadehasya naivā'yogyatvakārakāḥ ।
citāyāṃ sādhako nāma pretastasmai pradīyate ॥13॥
ityevaṃ pañcapiṇḍairhi śavasyā''hutiyogyatā ।
dehadoṣavināśaśca tatognirjvālayeccitām ॥14॥
saṃmṛjya copalipyā'tha ulikhyoddhṛtya vedikām ।
abhyukṣīya samādhāya vahniṃ tatra vidhānataḥ ॥15॥
puṣpākṣataiḥ susampūjya devaṃ kravyādasaṃjñakam ।
svargaṃ mṛtaṃ nayetyuktvā śarīrāhutimācaret ॥16॥
ardhadehe tathā dagdhe dadyādājyāhutiṃ tataḥ ।
yamāya cāntakāyeti mṛtyave brahmaṇe tathā ।।17।।
jātavedomukhe deyā hyekā pretamukhe tathā ।
ūrdhvaṃ tu jvālayed vahniṃ pūrvabhāge citāṃ punaḥ ।।18।।
asau svargāya lokāya svāhā jvalati pāvakaḥ ।
evamājyāhutiṃ datvā tilamiśrāṃ samantrakām ॥19॥
tato dāhaḥ prakartavyaḥ putreṇa kila niścitam ।
roditavyaṃ tato gāḍhaṃ evaṃ tasya sukhaṃ bhavet ॥1.70.20॥
dāhasyānantaraṃ tatra kṛtvā saṃcayanakriyām ।
pretapiṇḍaṃ pradadyācca dāhārtiśamanaṃ kila ॥21॥
tataḥ sacailakaṃ snānaṃ putraiḥ kṛtvā tilodakam ।
śilāyāṃ nāmagotreṇa dadyācca karatāḍanīm ॥22॥
viṣṇurviṣṇuriti brūyāt tatastasya gṛhaṃ janāḥ ।
dvārasya dakṣiṇe gatvā gomayaṃ gaurasarṣapān ॥23॥
nidhāya varuṇaṃ devamantardhāya svaveśmani ।
bhakṣayennimbapatrāṇi ghṛtaṃ prāśyaṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet ॥24॥
aśrupātaṃ na kurvīta datvā cātha jalāṃjalim ।
śleṣmāśru bāndhavairbhuktaṃ preto bhuṃkte yato'vaśaḥ ॥25॥
dugdhaṃ ca mṛnmaye pātre toyaṃ dadyād dinatrayam ।
śmaśānaṃ catvaraṃ gehaṃ paśyan yāmyaiḥ sanīyate ॥26॥
gartapiṇḍān daśāhāni pradadyācca dine dine ।
jalāṃjalayo dātavyāḥ pretamuddiśya nityadā ॥27॥
putro bhāryā ca vā śiṣyo bhrātā kriyāṃ karotu vai ।
pratyahaṃ tu pradattasya piṇḍasyā'rdhe tu dehadam ॥28॥
tṛtīyaṃ yamadūtānāṃ caturthenopajīvati ।
ahorātraistu navabhiḥ preto niṣpattimāpnuyāt ।।29॥
jantorniṣpannadehasya daśame tu kṣudhā bhavet ।
dehabhūtaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭo gṛhopari sa tiṣṭhati ॥1.70.30॥
tatra sthitvā yamamārge gacchantyatha yamālaye ।
duḥkhānyanubhavan paścājjanma prāpsyan praśocati ॥31॥
aho kiṃcinmayā naiva svāsthye mokṣapradaṃ kṛtam ।
na harernāmajapanaṃ na kathāśravaṇaṃ kṛtam ॥32॥
na mayā kīrtanaṃ gītaṃ smaraṇaṃ na hareḥ kṛtam ।
ne kṛtaṃ tvarcanaṃ tasya satāṃ pādābhimardanam ॥33॥
na stotraṃ na namaskāraḥ śarīreṇa kṛtaṃ nahi ।
śarīra tanmadīyaṃ na yanmayā poṣitaṃ bahu ॥34॥
rakṣitaṃ lālitaṃ samyak sevitaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
vṛthaiva tatparityaktaṃ tena kāryaṃ na sādhitam ॥35॥
indriyaiḥ saha sammīlya deho vyarthaṃ prayāpitaḥ ।
samayo mokṣalābhārthaṃ na mayā sārthakīkṛtaḥ ॥36॥
anukūlā'bhavannārī patiścāpyabhavat priyaḥ ।
putra dāsāścānukulāstathā'pyātmā pravañcitaḥ ॥37॥
dhanaṃ cāsīdvipulaṃ me dānārthaṃ vastujātayaḥ ।
kevalena pralobhena mayā mokṣo na cārjitaḥ ।।38॥
sādhusādhvījanānāṃ tu sevā naiva kṛtā mayā ।
duṣkṛtasya phalaṃ bhuṃje kimidānīṃ bhavennanu ।।39॥
mahatā puṇyayogena mānuṣaṃ janma labhyate ।
tanmayā sārthakaṃ naiva kṛtamanyatkṛtaṃ bahu ॥1.70.40॥
krīḍayā yāpitaṃ bālyaṃ yauvanaṃ kṣapitaṃ ratau ।
vārdhakyaṃ cintayā kṣiptaṃ mṛtau kiṃ syādaśaktinā ॥41॥
śarīraṃ tatkalpavṛkṣakāmadhenumaṇiprabham ।
kṣapitaṃ cānyakāryeṣu nā''tmakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ।।42।।
kiṃkaraiḥ pīḍyate'tyarthaṃ parādhīnaḥ karomi kim ।
dānaṃ naiva pradattaṃ vai tapastaptaṃ na vai mayā ।।43।।
vrataṃ vā pālitaṃ naiva hutaṃ sādhumukhe nahi ।
tīrthaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ kiñcid vāpyādi naiva kāritam ।।44।।
gocaraṃ na kṛtaṃ kvāpi sāhāyyaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati ।
kṛtaḥ paropakāro na na kṛtaṃ pāralaukikam ।।45।।
niyamā nādṛtāḥ samyak idānīṃ kiṃ bhavennanu ।
guroḥ pitrostathā sevā naiva kvāpi mayā kṛtā ।।46।।
nārīdeho mahākaṣṭaḥ parādhīnaḥ sadā'śuciḥ ।
bhaktyā vā sevayā naiva mayā vai sārthakīkṛtaḥ ॥47॥
naradeho mahābhāro naikatṛṣṇāvaho'śubhaḥ ।
bhajanena ca puṇyena na mayā sārthakīkṛtaḥ ।।48॥
evaṃ sa yātanāpreto brūte śocati roditi ।
pīḍyate tāḍyate dūtaiḥ krandantyapi muhurmuhuḥ ॥49॥
jāyādhanadharādhāmasukhaṃ smarati duḥkhitaḥ ।
bhṛtyamitrasutāputrakuṭumbaṃ saṃpraśocati ॥1.70.50॥
mārge gantuṃ samartho na dūtairākṛṣyate hyadhaḥ ।
karuṇaṃ vilapatyeva re priye he sutādayaḥ ॥51॥
mocayantu samāgatya māmetadduḥsahā'rdanāt ।
putraḥ pautro bāndhavo vā puṇyaṃ karotu matkṛte ॥52।।
dhenudānaṃ madarthaṃ vai karotu mama putraka !।
vaitaraṇīṃ tariṣyāmyanyathā me tatra majjanam ॥53॥
mayā pātheyamalpaṃ tu na nītaṃ puṇyanāmakam ।
na taptaṃ na hutaṃ japtaṃ na dattaṃ kuta āvrajet ॥54॥
uṣṇenārdreṇa śītena mārgeṇa gamyate yadā ।
mūrchitastrāsitastatra hṛdi śocati kevalam ॥55॥
yadi me bāndhavaḥ ko'pi vastrāderdānamarpayet ।
tadaitaduḥkhanāśaḥ syānnānyathā bhoga eva ha ॥56॥
kiṃkarāstu vadantyenaṃ kva te puṇyaṃ hi tādṛśam ।
tadā hā daiva samprocya dhairyamālabhate kṣaṇam ॥57।।
yadi vai mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ prāpnuyāṃ punareva cet ।
avaśyaṃ muktidaṃ mārgamāśrayiṣye śapāmyaham ।।58॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtaśavasya kriyāpiṇḍadānaśokapretaśokādipradarśananāmā saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 70 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 070 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 71
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 072 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yamapuryāstu duḥkhāni samanubhūya nārakāḥ ।
viniḥsṛtāśca narakādvicaranti yathā śṛṇu ।। 1 ।।
te tu pretā yadi janma kimapyāptumaniścitāḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ svaṃ samanviṣya patnyāṃ putre kuṭumbini ॥ 2 ॥
bāndhave vā kṛtasthānā nivasanti gṛhe jane ।
vicarantyaśarīrāste kṣutpipāsārditā bhṛśam ।। 3 ।।
kvacitkadācidbalato rundhanti mohayanti tān ।
duḥkhayanti mūrchayanti pīḍayanti muhurmuhuḥ ।। 4 ।।
kathaṃ tvayā madarthaṃ vai mokṣaṇārthaṃ kṛtaṃ nahi ।
tasmād vayaṃ pretabhūtāḥ pīḍayiṣyāma ulbaṇam ।।5।।
itiroṣeṇa saṃrabdhā pīḍayanti punaḥ punaḥ ।
pitṛdvārāṇi rundhanti tanmārgarundhakāstathā ।। 6 ।।
pitṛbhāgāँśca gṛhṇanti pathikāँstaskarā iva ।
svaveśmani malamūlotsargādyaśuddhabhūtale ॥ 7 ॥
uṣitvā ca nirīkṣante yaṃ janaṃ syāt sa rogavān ।
pīḍayanti jvararūpaistadbhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayanti ca ।। 8 ।।
pibanti cāpi tadraktaṃ sūkṣmaṃ svalpaṃ kvacitkvacit ।
cintayanti sadā'niṣṭamucchiṣṭādisthalasthitāḥ ॥ 9 ॥
pibanti tatra pānīyaṃ bhojanocchiṣṭayojitam ।
kuṭumbasyā''tmajādīnāṃ cintayanti chalaṃ sadā ।।1.71.10।।
evamaniṣṭamatayaḥ svakān pīḍāṃ prakurvate ।
svakulaṃ pīḍayet pretaḥ paraṃ chidreṇa pīḍayet ।।11।।
jīvan sa snehavānāsīnmṛto duṣṭatvameti hi ।
chidraṃ mālinyamāsādya muhuḥ pīḍāṃ karoti saḥ ।।12।।
sarvakriyāparimṛṣṭaṃ devapūjāvihīnakam ।
aśuddhabhojyabhoktāraṃ janaṃ pretaḥ prapīḍayet ॥13॥
ekasya putranāśaḥ syātputraṃ na labhate'paraḥ ।
ekaḥ santatihīnaḥ syātpretadoṣo'sti tatra vai ॥14॥
santatirgarbhato naśyet samutpanno vinaśyati ।
paśudravyavināśaśca virodho bāndhavaiḥ samam ॥15॥
prakṛtiśca vivarteta suteṣu kalahastathā ।
akasmād vyasanaprāptiḥ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ।।16।।
unmattatā hyanidrā ca bhojanā'pācano jvaraḥ ।
udgārā udaraśūlaṃ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ।।17।।
cauryarucirgṛhakalirdhanadhānyadaridratā ।
sampattestu śanairhāsaḥ pīḍeyaṃ pretasaṃbhavā ॥18॥
bahutpannamapi dravyaṃ viniḥsarati hastataḥ ।
subhikṣe kṛṣināśaḥ syād udyoge viparītatā ॥19॥
hīnakarmā'bhiyānaṃ syāt caurāgnirājabhirbhayam ।
mahārogopapattiśca svadehapīḍanaṃ tathā ॥1.71.20॥
pūrvaṃ tu sevikā patnī paścācchūnīva jāyate ।
gṛhanāśamatirnityaṃ pīḍā sā pretasaṃbhavā ।।21।।
bhāvanā smṛtihīnā ca kāryaṃ mānasavarjitam ।
kalaho'nudinaṃ sveṣu sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ॥22॥
strīṇāṃ garbhavināśaḥ syānna puṣpaṃ dṛśyate tathā ।
puṣpaṃ pradṛśyate'thāpi phalaṃ naiva pradṛśyate ॥23॥
jīvitānāṃ kramānnāśo gṛhe dantakaliḥ sadā ।
bhojane kopasamudvegādinā tṛptiśūnyatā ॥24॥
kalaho ghātakāścaiva putrāḥ śatrorivātmajāḥ ।
na prītirna ca vai saukhyaṃ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ॥25॥
pitrorvākyaṃ na kuruto svapatnīṃ na ca sevate ।
patnī patidṛśiṃ nā''yāt sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ।।26॥
akasmānmṛtikartāraḥ pretā bhavanti pīḍakāḥ ।
vikarmaṇā bhavet preto vidhihīnakriyastathā ॥27॥
tatkāle duṣṭasaṃsargād vṛṣotsargādṛte tathā ।
duṣṭamṛtyuvaśādvāpi hyadagdhavapuṣastathā ॥28॥
dāhakriyādilopācca khaṭvādimṛtidoṣataḥ ।
kṣuttṛṭdāhamṛterdoṣāt pretatvaṃ jāyate priye ॥29॥
vāsanāvaśataḥ kvāpi vāṇīceṣṭāvivarjitam ।
pretatvaṃ susthira bhāvi pretamuktiṃ samācaret ॥1.71.30॥
na yo vai manute pretān mṛtaḥ pretatvamāpnuyāt ।
pretadoṣaḥ kule yasya sukhaṃ tatra na vidyate ।।31॥
matiḥ prītiḥ ratirbuddhirlakṣmīḥ pañcavināśanam ।
tṛtīye paṃcame puṃsi vaṃśacchedo'bhijāyate ॥32॥
daridro nirdhanaścaiva pāpakarmā bhave bhave ।
pretā evaṃ duḥkhayanti svāneva krūrabhāvataḥ ॥33॥
kṣutpipāsārditāḥ pretāḥ praviśeyuḥ svaveśmani ।
praviṣṭā vāyudehena śayānān svasvavaṃśajān ।।34॥
svapne putrakalatrādīn darśayanti svarūpakam ।
gajo hayo vṛṣo bhūtvā dṛśyante vikṛtānanāḥ ॥35॥
mārjāro vanitā sarpo dṛśyantevai kṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ ।
śayanaṃ viparītaṃ vā svātmānaṃ vā viparyayam ॥36॥
utthitaḥ saṃvīkṣate vai yaḥ sa pretena pīḍyate ।
nigaḍairbadhyate svapne pretakṛt tanna saṃśayaḥ ॥37॥
annaṃ tu yācate svapne vadhyate bahuśastrakaiḥ ।
svayaṃ vā hanti manujaṃ tatsarvaṃ pretadarśitam ॥38॥
bhuṃjānasya tu pakvānnaṃ gṛhītvā vai palāyate ।
svasya vā'nyasya salilaṃ tṛṣārtastu pibed balāt ॥39॥
vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ svapne vṛṣabhaiḥ saha vā'ṭanam ।
utplutya vyomagamanaṃ tīrthe vā kṣudhayā gatim ॥1.71.40॥
svakalatraṃ svabandhūँśca svasutaṃ svapatiṃ gurum । ।
vidyamānaṃ mṛtaṃ paśyet tatsarvaṃ pretadarśitam ॥41॥
yastvapo yācate svapne kṣuttṛṣābhyāṃ pariplutaḥ ।
tasya pretasya muktyarthaṃ tīrthe piṇḍānpradāpayet ॥42॥
nirgacchato gṛhād rātrau svapne putrāँstathā paśūn ।
pitṛbhrātṛkalatrāṇi pretadoṣeṇa paśyati ॥43॥
tacchāntyarthaṃ gṛhe tīrthe śrīvṛkṣe tarpaṇaṃ caret ।
kṛṣṇadhānyāni saṃpūjya pradadyād vedapārage ॥44॥
sarvavighnāni santyajya muktyupāyaṃ karoti yaḥ ।
tasya karmaphalaṃ sādhu pretatṛptiśca śāśvatī ॥45॥
ātmaiva śreyasā yujyat pretastṛptiṃ vrajecciram ।
te tṛptāḥ śubhamicchanti svātmabandhuṣu sarvadā ।।46॥
anyathā tu durātmānaḥ kleśayanti svavaṃśajān ।
darśanādbhāṣaṇād yastu ceṣṭanātpīḍanādapi ॥47॥
sadgatiṃ na prāpayati pretaśāpaiḥ prapīḍyate ।
aputrako'paśuścaiva daridro vyādhitastathā ॥48॥
vṛttihīnaśca dīnaśca bhavejjanmani janmani ।
tasmānmuktiḥ prakartavyā pretānāṃ tarpaṇaiḥ sadā ।।49।।
te tṛptā vārayanti – svān jāyamānānupadravān ।
paścātte muktimāyānti kāle prāpte tu putrataḥ ॥1.71.50 ।।
sadābandhuṣu yacchanti ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ ca sampadaḥ ।
pitṝnuddiśya yaḥ kuryānnārāyaṇabaliṃ śubham ॥51॥
kṛtena tena vighnāni vinaśyanti na pīḍyate ।
bhūtapretapiśācādipīḍābhyo mucyate dhruvam ॥52॥
nārāyaṇabaliṃ kṛtvā vṛṣotsargādikaṃ kriyāt ।
sarvopadravarāhityaṃ sarvasaukhyamavāpnuyāt ॥53॥
pitṛmātṛsamaṃ loke nā'styanyad daivataṃ param ।
prabhuḥ śarīrajanmakṛt pratyakṣadaivataṃ pitā ॥54॥
hitānāmupadeṣṭā ca guruḥ pratyakṣadaivatam ।
tasmāt pitāgururmātā vṛddhāḥ pūjyāḥ patistathā ॥55।।
śarīraṃ sampado dārāḥ sutā lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ।
yasya prasādātprāpyante ko'nyaḥ pūjyatamastataḥ ॥56॥
puṃnāmno narakād yasmāt pitaraṃ trāyate tu yaḥ ।
tasmāt putra iti proktastasmāt pitaraṃ tārayet ॥57॥
apamṛtyumṛtau syātāṃ pitā mātā ca kasyacit ।
dharmaṃ tīrthaṃ vivāhādi śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ kriyāt ॥58।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pretānāmaśuddhabhūvāsa-pretakṛta vividhapīḍā-pretakṛtasvapnacihna-tannivṛttyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।71।।


← adhyāyaḥ 071 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 72
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 073 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca----
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! pravakṣyāmi pretān tvakālamṛtyujān ।
pākhaṇḍakān lobhamṛtān cā'saṃskāramṛtāँstathā ।। 1 ।।
cāṇḍālādudakātsarpāt śāpād drumācca vaidyutāt ।
daṃṣṭriśṛṃgipaśubhyaśca mṛtāḥ pretā bhavanti te ॥ 2 ॥
udbandhanamṛtā ye ca viṣaśastrādisaṃhatā ।
ātmaghātina evā''bhicārakarmādisaṃhatāḥ ॥ 3 ॥
mahakaṣṭairmṛtā rogairdasyubhirmāritāśca ye ।
visūcyagnihatā ye ca bhūkhaṇḍādimṛtāśca ye ॥ 4 ॥
asaṃskṛtāḥ pramṛtā ye malinā malamṛtyavaḥ ।
piṇḍaluptā vṛṣotsargakriyāhīnā mṛtāśca ye ।। 5 ।।।
parvatād bhittipātādvā vyomnyevaṃ gamanānmṛtāḥ ।
rajasvalāsthitau vā'tha maithune śaucage mṛtāḥ ।। 6 ।।
antarikṣe hyantarāle sīmni nirjanake mṛtāḥ ।
duṣṭaśalyādinā naṣṭāḥ sūtakādau mṛtāśca ye ।। 7 ।।
tṛṣāyāṃ ye jalā'nāptāḥ kumṛtyuvaśagāśca ye ।
te vai pretāḥ prajāyante tvaṭanti kṣitimaṇḍale ।। 8 ।।
gaupaśugrāsaloptāro jalā''rāmavināśakāḥ ।
devavṛttivineṣṭāro dīnavṛttivibhedakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
dānakarmaviloptāraḥ puṇyakārya prabhañjakāḥ ।
bahūnāṃ duḥkhakartāraḥ pretā bhavanti pāpataḥ ॥1.72.10॥
paradroharatāḥ pāpāḥ pāpamṛtyuvaśaṃgatāḥ ।
kṣutpipāsārditā nityaṃ pretatvamupayānti te ॥11॥
na mātā na pitā pretajanmādau kāraṇaṃ matam ।।
pretatvaṃ karmato yāmyasaṃkalpācca bhavatyataḥ ॥12॥
tatra vai vikṛtākārā lamboṣṭhā vikṛtānanāḥ ।
bṛhaccharīradaśanā vakrā''syāścāpi kecana ।।13।।
sarpāsyāśca biḍālāsyā vividhāsyā bhavanti te ।
nāmāpi yādṛśaṃ karma kṛtvā bhavanti nārakāḥ ।।14।।
tādṛgguṇaṃ bhavatyeva pretasya tu tadā tadā ।
yādṛkpāpaṃ vidhāyaiva pretatāṃ yāti mānavaḥ ।।15।।
tathā tathā kṣudhā tasya pipāsāpi muhurbhavet ।
bhojanaṃ vā jalaṃ vāpi śuddhaṃ naivāpyate kvacit ।।16।।
śuddhe tu bhojane kvāpi jale vā nāstyadhikṛtiḥ ।
śuddha tvannaṃ vasubhiśca śuddhaṃ jalaṃ tu vāruṇaiḥ ।।17।। ।
sarvadā rakṣitaṃ tatra pretānāṃ bhāga eva na ।
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣaiśca recakaiḥ samalaiḥ saha ।।18।।
paryuṣitaistathocchiṣṭaiḥ pretānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhavet ।
śaucahīnaṃ malinaṃ yat pretā bhuṃjanti tatsadā ॥19॥
yasya gṛhe na vai śuddhirna vā devārpaṇaṃ bhavet ।
madyamāṃsamaye duṣṭe pretā bhuṃjanti tadgahe ।।1.72.20।।
lobhakrodhamadālasyanidrāśokabhayāni ca ।
māyākalahakāpaṭyaṃ mālinyaṃ snānahīnatā ॥21।।
dhātvādimalaśuddhirna rajovīryāktamambaram ।
lāळ+āliṭṭamayī bhittirnālikā mūtrasaṃbhṛtā ।।22।।
yatra yatra gṛhe santi pretā bhuṃjanti tatra vai ।
nityaṃ liṃgabhagābhyāṃ ca kṣarat tatpretabhojanam ।।23।।
mṛtyurnityaṃ varaṃ jantoḥ pretatvaṃ mā bhavet kvacit ।
patitānnena bhuktena jaṭharasthena yo mṛtaḥ ॥24॥
pāpamṛtyuvaśād yo vai sa preto jāyate naraḥ ।
devadravyaṃ parasvādi haretpretaḥ sa jāyate ॥25॥
gurudravyaṃ paranyāsaṃ haret pretaḥ sa jāyate ।
viśvāsaghātaḥ kūṭaśca kanyā vikrayakṛjjanaḥ ॥26॥
bhrātṛdhṛk janahā goghnaḥ paśughnaḥ pāradārikaḥ ।
hemahartā bhuvo hartā'nṛtaḥ pretaḥ sa jāyate ॥27॥
mātaraṃ bhaginīṃ bhāryāṃ snuṣāṃ duhitaraṃ sutam ।
pitaraṃ yo vā tyajati sa preto jāyate naraḥ ॥28॥
śiṣṭācāravihīnā ye pitrorbhaktivihīnakāḥ ।
madyamāṃsaratā ye ca paśughātādikarmiṇaḥ ॥29॥
paradrohaprakartāro mahātrāsapradāśca ye ।
ye chidrānveṣiṇo nityaṃ parakalpāntakārakāḥ ॥1.72.30॥
bahuvyavāyasaṃsaktā hārdamāṃsādibhakṣakāḥ ।
krūrā vyasanino duṣṭā niṣiddhācaraṇe ratāḥ ॥31॥
cānye ye tādṛśāsteṣāṃ jāyate hyāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ ।
svalpāyuṣaṃ kuśarīraṃ hitvā pretā bhavanti te ।।3।।
tādṛśena śarīreṇa śreyaḥ svasya prasādhayet ।
puṇyena karmaṇā svargaṃ sādhayenmokṣameva vā ॥33॥
prāktanaiḥ karmapākaistu sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu vindati ।
tadatra janmani saukhyapradaṃ dharmaṃ samācaret ॥34॥
naro vā yadi vā nārī svārthaṃ kṛtvāpi bhūtale ।
parārthaṃ sādhayennityaṃ śreyo mokṣakaraṃ param ।।35।।
anyattu vismaret kāmaṃ mokṣaṃ tu naiva vismaret ।
anyattu vismaretkāryaṃ dharmaṃ tu naiva vismaret ॥36॥
anyattu vismared bhogyaṃ ātmasaukhyaṃ na vismaret ।
kṛtrimaṃ vismared yogaṃ hariṃ hṛtsthaṃ na vismaret ॥37॥
prabhuṃ vihāya sukhadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ bhajate tu yaḥ ।
duḥkhaṃ syāttu phalaṃ tasya nānyat śreyaḥ sa vindati ॥38॥
nārakāstrividhāstasmāt vijñeyāḥ kamalekṣaṇe ! ।
eke yamapurasthāścā''pare tu pretarūpiṇaḥ ॥39॥
anye tu nārakāḥ sarve gṛhe gṛhe'tiduḥkhinaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ gṛhe na vai saukhyaṃ bhojyabhojanavaibhavāt ॥1.72.40॥
nārīputradhanadhānyāt te'tra pratyakṣanārakāḥ ।
yeṣāṃ kuṭumbaṃ bahulaṃ poṣaṇe tu daridratā ॥41॥
vastrānnāni na pūryante te'tra pratyakṣanārakāḥ ।
ekā'dhikastrīpatiryaḥ sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ॥42॥
vyabhicāro gṛhe yasya tadvai pratyakṣanārakam ।
paradāragaṇikādirataḥ pratyakṣanārakaḥ ।।43॥
śvavat svanāryā gaṇitaḥ so'tra pratyakṣanārakī ।
patnī śunīva yā yatra sāpi pratyakṣanārakā ॥44॥
yeṣāṃ hūँ tūँ kṛto dveṣaḥ kleśo gṛhajaneṣu vai ।
na nidrā na sukhaṃ prema te vai pratyakṣanārakāḥ ॥45॥
svajanaścauryakṛt yatra svajano yatra ghātakī ।
svajano vaṃcako yatra tadvai pratyakṣanārakam ॥46॥
ājñākarā na putrādyāḥ premadā vanitā nahi ।
kuṭumba mānadaṃ nāsti tadvai pratyakṣanārakam ।।47।।
bhojanaṃ sarvadā rūkṣaṃ gālīdānādipūrvakam ।
darśanaṃ dveṣanetreṇa so'tra pratyakṣanārakī ॥48॥
sphāṭitāni tu vastrāṇi gṛhaṃ rathyā ca catvaram ।
satkāre tu tiraskāraḥ sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ।।49।।
parādhīnā daśā nityaṃ sevakāḥ kṣepakāstathā ।
svajanaḥ śvajanavacca sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ।।1.72.50॥
ādhivyādhisamupādhikleśagṛhaṃ tu yadgṛham ।
chidraraudradhūrtaśāṭhyāśrayaṃ pratyakṣanārakam ॥51॥
patnī kāmapradā naiva sarvathā pratipakṣiṇī ।
patiḥ ratiprado naiva tāḍakaḥ so'tra nārakaḥ ॥52॥
janmakṣatā janmarogā janmaduḥkhāḥ pratāpinaḥ ।
kleśāḍhyā janmata eva te vai pratyakṣanārakāḥ ।।53।।
narakaṃ tu śarīraṃ vai tatra vāsāttu nārakī ।
narakaḥ khalu saṃsārastatra vāsāttu nārakī ॥54॥
bhaktyā śreyaḥprakartā tu narakānmucyate khalu ।
yāvannaiva pramucyante tāvat sarve tu nārakāḥ ॥55॥
narakasya malānāṃ ca lāळ+ānāṃ dhātuyoginām ।
dvārāṇyālambya ramate so'tra sākṣāddhi nārakī ॥56॥
narakebhyaḥ samutpanno narake sajjate punaḥ ।
puṣṭau narakarūpo'yaṃ ko'nyastasmāddhi nārakī ॥57।।
avamānaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ bandhanaṃ tu tato'dhikam ।
parādhīnaṃ mahātrāsastadvānatraiva nārakī ॥58॥
tṛṣṇākhyaṃ narakaṃ yasya lagnaṃ sa nārakī mataḥ ।
evaṃ tṛtīyanarakaṃ sarvasyātra gṛhe gṛhe ॥59॥
aviśuddhiḥ kṣayaścaivā'tiśayaśca tridoṣakam ।
yasya yasyā'bhavat śliṣṭaṃ sa vai nārakavad bhavet ॥1.72.60॥
ete pretāstu jīvanto mṛtāḥ pretā yamālaye ।
adṛśyā vāyurūpāśca pretāstrayaḥ paretakāḥ ॥61॥
sarve vai duḥkhabhoktāraḥ sarve ca duḥkhadāstathā ।
sarve bhaktivihīnāśca ko bhedo'tra paretake ॥6॥
yāmyāścaiva ca vāyavyā mānavīyāśca te trayaḥ ।
yadi śreyo na kurvanti tarhi pretāḥ samāstrayaḥ ।।63।।
tasmānmānuṣadehena kartavyaṃ mokṣakārakam ।।
tena muktiṃ pragantāraḥ pretatvaṃ naiva yānti hi ।।64।।
nārī tu ḍākinī yasya patirvā bhūtabhītidaḥ ।
putrā rākṣasahantāraḥ pretastasmātpalāyate ॥65॥
yonistu kaṇḍanī yasyāḥ kledinī mūtravīryakaiḥ ।
kardamā''bhaṃ śarīraṃ ca tasyā bhoktā tu nārakī ॥66॥
śvapacā grāmabāhyasthā aśuddhā doṣapeṭakāḥ ।
doghe doṣastu ko deyaḥ pretastatra karoti kim ।।67
pretaṃ preto yathā naiva trāsayenna ca pīḍayet ।
tathā pretasamaṃ duṣṭaṃ pīḍayitvā labheta kim ।।68॥
tādṛśaṃ tu kuṭumbaṃ vai tyaktvā pretāḥ prayānti vai ।
tīrthe'raṇye'thavā'nyatra vasanti nityaduḥkhitāḥ ॥69॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne keṣāṃ pretatvaṃ pretānāṃ vāso bhojanādi pretāstrividhetyādivarṇananāmā dvāsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।72॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
sarveṣāṃ sarvayonyādau sukhaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ kṛtam ।
manuṣyayonau dharmātmā sukhī bhavati sarvathā ॥ 1 ॥
puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vidhijaṃ ca niṣedhajam ।
āgarbhāt pañcavarṣāṇi na vai pāpena lipyate ।। 2 ।।
pañcavarṣottaraṃ dehī tvardhapāpena lipyate ।
dvādaśābdaparo dehī sarvapāpaiḥ pralipyate ।। 3 ।।
yathāvasthaṃ yathāpāpapralepastatpramāpataḥ ।
mṛtasya sūtakaṃ cātrā'dhikaṃ nyūnaṃ ca gamyate ।। 4 ।।
yāvanmāse garbhapātastāvaddināni sūtakam ।
tasya kiñcidapi karma kartavyaṃ naiva vidyate ।।5।।
janmata ācūḍānmṛtyau bālaṃ garte viniḥkṣipet ।
dugdhaṃ deyaṃ yathāśakti bālānāṃ tuṣṭi hetave ।। 6 ।।
ācūḍātpañcavarṣe tu mṛtau dehaṃ dahettataḥ ।
kṣīra bhojyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bālānāṃ bhojanaṃ yataḥ ।। 7 ।।
pūrṇapaṃcamavarṣasya mṛtau karmāṇi sarvathā ।
aurdhvadaihikāni yathāvidhi kāryāṇi sarvathā ।। 8 ।।
kumārāṇāṃ ca bālānāṃ bhojanaṃ vastraveṣṭanam ।
mahādānavihīnaṃ tu kumāre kṛtyamācaret ।। 9 ।।
bāle vā taruṇe vṛddhe ghaṭo bhavati dehinām ।
garne nikṣepaṇaṃ bālamāvarṣadvayameva ha ।।1.73.10।।
tataḥ paraṃ vā sarvasya dehadāho vidhīyate ।
śiśurādantajananād bālaḥ syād yāvadāśikham ॥11॥
tataḥ paraṃ kumāraśca syādāmauñcīprabandhanam ।
pañcavarṣādhike mṛtyau vṛṣotsargavidhiṃ vinā ।।12।।
tathā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vinā hyekādaśe'hani ।
śrāddhāni ṣoḍaśa kuryādudakubhaṃ ca dāpayet ।।13।।
dīpānnajalavastrādisvarṇadānādi bhojanam ।
kāraṇīyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ pretatvavinivṛttaye ॥14॥
putramukhaṃ pitā dṛṣṭvā pituḥ ṛṇātpramucyate ।
ata aurasaputrastu kuryācchāddhaṃ tu pārvaṇam ।।15।।
pautraṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṇatrayānmucyate svargamāpnuyāt ।
anaurasāḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ putrā navavidhā matāḥ ।।16।।
ekoddiṣṭaṃ navabhistaiḥ kartavyaṃ śrāddhameva hi ।
aurasena prakartavyaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ pituḥ ॥17॥
saṃvatsare tu sampūrṇe kuryāt piṇḍapraveśanam ।
varṣānte ca kṛte piṇḍamelane yāti sadgatim ॥18॥
evaṃ kṛte tata eva pretaḥ pitṛgaṇo bhavet ।
bhikṣurbhikṣāṃ na gṛhṇīyād yāvanna syātsapiṇḍanam ।।19।।
svagotreṣvaśucistāvad yāvat piṇḍaṃ na melayet ।
ānantyātkuladharmāṇāṃ puṃsāṃ caivāyuṣaḥ kṣayāt ॥1.73.20॥
asthiratvāccharīrasya dvādaśāhe sapiṇḍayet ।
tripakṣe vā ṣaṇmāse vā vatsare yā sapiṇḍayet ॥21॥
putrā'bhāve priyā kuryāt patnyabhāve sahodaraḥ ।
bhrātā vā bhrātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śiṣya eva vā ॥22॥
sapiṇḍanakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ putrahīnānāṃ putrī kuryāt sapiṇḍanam ।।23॥
ṛtvijaḥ kārayedvāpi purohitamathāpi vā।
kṛtacūḍaiḥ sutaiścāpi pitṛśrāddhaṃ ca kārayet ।।24॥
tena vai pitarastṛptāḥ pretatṛptistathā bhavet ।
pretasya sukhalābhāya sarvaṃ putreṇa kāryate ॥25॥
tārayennarakātputro yadi mokṣo na vidyate ।
aputrasya gatirnāsti svargaṃ naiva ca naiva ca ॥26॥
dāhaḥ putreṇa kartavyo hyagnidātā ca pautrakaḥ ।
tilairdarbhaiśca bhūmyāṃ vaikuṇṭhe tatra matirbhavet ।।27।।
pañcaratnāni vaktre ca tena jīvaḥ prarohati ।
pralepyā gomayairbhūmistilāndarbhāṃśca nikṣipet ।।28।।
tasyāmevā''turo nyastaḥ sarvaṃ dahati duṣkṛtam ।
darbhatūlī nayetsvargamāturaṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ ।।29।।
sarvatra vasudhā puṇyā liptā nirlaṃpajā hyapi ।
yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasāḥ krūrakarmagāḥ ।।1.73.3 0 ।।
alipte hyāturaṃ muktaṃ viśantyete viyonayaḥ ।
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śrīrhutāśana eva ca ।।3 1 ।।
maṇḍale copatiṣṭhanti tasmātkurvīta maṇḍalam ।
anyathā mriyate yaḥ saṃkrīḍate vāyunā sa tu ।।32।।
mama dehasamutpannāstilāḥ lakṣmi! pavitrakāḥ ।
asurā dānavā daityā vidravanti tilaiḥ sthitaiḥ ।।33।।
darbhā romasamutpannāstilāḥ svedādato nyaset ।
darbhamūle sthito brahmā darbhamadhye tu keśavaḥ ।।34।।
darbhāgre śaṃkaraścāste trayo devāḥ kuśe sthitāḥ ।
viṣṇurekādaśī gaṃgā tulasī vipradhenavaḥ ।।35।।
asāre durgasaṃsāre ṣaṭpadī muktidāyinī ।
nivārayanti caitāni durgatiṃ prāptamāturam ।।36।।
viṣṇudehasamutpanno yato vai lavaṇo rasaḥ ।
prāṇayāne tu lavaṇaṃ deyaṃ vai svargamārgadam ।।37।।
dāna vai tatra dātavyaṃ tena puṇyena rakṣyate ।
tilāँśca gāṃ kṣitiṃ hema kārpāsaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ।।।38।।
saptadhānyaṃ tathā lohaṃ hyekaikaṃ pāvayettu tama ।
hemadānātsukhaṃ svargyaṃ bhūmidānānnṛpo bhavet ।।39।।
saptadhānyaistu dhānyāptistṛptāśca yamakiṃkarāḥ ।
lohadānena yāmyāstu nāgacchanti mṛtagṛhe ।।1.73.40।।
kuṭhāro muśalaṃ daṇḍaḥ khaḍgaśca cchurikā tathā ।
pāśaḥ kaśā mudgaraṃ ca yamahastāyudhāni vai ।।41 ।।
kuriṇāḥ sārvasūtrāpāḥ śūṇḍā markāstvanurvarāḥ ।
śabalāḥ śyāmadūtāśca prīṇitā lohadānataḥ ।।।42।।
uddharettu lohadānaṃ hyātmānaṃ pāpasaṃcayāt ।
vaitaraṇīṃ tārayedvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ nayeddhi gauḥ ।।।43।।
gavāṃ sevāṃ mahādevo goloko'pyakaronmuhuḥ ।
śrauharistu gavāṃ sevāṃ sarvadā prakaroti vai ।।44।।
gāvaḥ sarvavidhā lakṣmīḥ goṣu nityaṃ vasāmyaham ।
hemadānātsūryalokaṃ candrasyā'gneśca vaibhavam ।।45।।
dattaṃ tu lavaṇaṃ svargadvāramudghāṭayettathā ।
tiladānaṃ tu martyasya mahāpātakanāśanam ।।46 ।।
tadanyāni ca dānāni vastūpakaraṇāni ca ।
dātavyāni paretasya sukhamokṣaprapattaye ।।47।।
bhūmisthaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyardhonmīlitalocanam ।
svasthānāccalite śvāse dānamāturamucyate ।।48।।
tasmin kāle suto yastu sarvadānāni dāpayet ।
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate kamalāpate ।।49।।
vāsudeva parabrahma svāmin śrīrāma gopate ।
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ kāryaṃ prāṇaprayāṇasaṃgatau ।।1.73.50।।
śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama śrīkṛṣṇa tvaṃ gatirmama ।
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyeti vā japet ।।5 1।।
dadyādāturasanyāsaṃ mantraṃ śrīharirityapi ।
śrīkṛṣṇa ityapi mantraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇetyapi ।।।।52।।
śrīmannārāyaṇetyeva svāminnārāyaṇetyapi ।
rāmakṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa rādhākṛṣṇa omityapi ।।।53।।
nṛsiṃha dattātreya śrīśaṃbho viṣṇo japetyapi ।
jaya govinda gopāla jaya mādhava ityapi ।।54।।
viṣṇurmātā pitā viṣṇurviṣṇuḥ svajanabāndhavāḥ ।
jalaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthalaṃ viṣṇurviṣṇurbhūrvaiṣṇavaḥ kuśaḥ ।।55।।
viṣṇurviprastilā gāvo hema dhānyaṃ tu vaiṣṇavam ।
viṣṇurdātā gṛhītā ca netā prāpayitā'pi saḥ ।।।56।।।
tameva pūjayennityamantakāle tu kīrtayet ।
na tasyā'sadgatiḥ kvāpi pretabhāvo'pi naiva ca ।।57।।
yena santastvantakāle dṛṣṭā natāśca sevitāḥ ।
prasāditāḥ sa vai mokṣaṃ yāti drāk nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।।।58।।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
mṛtasya yathāyogyasūtakasapiṇḍīkaraṇāditilādidānā''turamantrapradānādipradarśananāmā trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।73।।


← adhyāyaḥ 073 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 74
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 075 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
antakāle gavāṃ dānaṃ svargavāsaphalaṃ khalu ।
aśvārūḍhāśca te yānti dadate ye hyupānahau ।। 1 ।।
pretastu chatradānena chāyayā vicaretsukham ।
evaṃ tathā'nnadānena kṣudhāhīnaścaretsukham ।। 2 ।।
tadvadvai dīpadānena prakāśe yāti saukhyataḥ ।
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho dīpo devāgāre kṛto bhavet ।। 3 ।।
āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ dadyāt paralokahitāvaham ।
kamaṇḍalujalaṃ dadyāt tṛṣitaḥ pibatīti vāḥ ।। 4 ।।
ekādaśāhe dātavyaṃ kusumaṃ cāṃgulīyakam ।
bhājanaṃ cānnadānaṃ ca preto yātyuttamāṃ gatim ।। 5 ।।
kuṃbhadānaṃ vastradānaṃ gajāśvarathadānakam ।
mahiṣīdānamityevaṃ dātavyaṃ mṛtanāmataḥ ।। 6 ।।
śayyādānaṃ savastraṃ cānyāni vai śaktitastathā ।
kāryāṇi pretasaṃtṛptisukhaśāntyupalabdhaye ।। 7 ।।
śarīrād vāyumiśraḥ sa ātmā yadā prayāti hi ।
kaṭyūrdhvaromacchidrebhya indriyagolakāttathā ।। 8 ।।
prāṇaḥ puṇyakṛto yātyanyasyā'dhobhāgataḥ saret ।
daśendriyacaturantaḥkaraṇapaṃcamātrakam ।। 9 ।।
sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ puṇyapāpe gṛhītvā yāti yatra ca ।
tatra karmānusāreṇa navaṃ dehaṃ gṛhaṃ matam ।। 1.74.1 0।।
ekaviṃśatilakṣāṇi jarāyujāni tāvatā ।
svedajā udbhijjāścaiva aṇḍajāścāpi tāvatā ।। 11 ।।
ityevaṃ caturaśītilakṣāṇi yonayo matāḥ ।
tatra tatra gataḥ preto punarduḥkhī punastathā ।। 12।।
punargarbhe nivasati janirmṛtiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
hariṃ cā'bhajamānasya garbhe vāsaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 1 3।।
strīṣu puruṣabījena garbhā jāyanta ityataḥ ।
ṛtukāle tu nārīṇāṃ tyajed rātricatuṣṭayam ।। 14।।
saptarātrimadhyagato garbhastu malino bhavet ।
pūrvasaptakamutsṛjya tato yugmeṣu saṃviśet ।। 15।।
ṣoḍaśartuniśāḥ strīṇāṃ garbhadhāraṇakārikāḥ ।
caturdaśyāstu yā rātrirgarbhastiṣṭhati tatra cet ।। 16।।
guṇabhāgyanidhistatra putro jāyeta dhārmikaḥ ।
yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyāstvekāsu rātriṣu ।। 17।।
pañcame'hani nārīṇāṃ gaulmamādhuryabhojanam ।
kaṭukāraṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ ca sājyaṃ yuvatībhojanam ।। 18।।
nāryā tvevā''tapo varjyaḥ śītalaṃ kevalaṃ caret ।
tāmbūlagandhaśrīkhaṇḍaiḥ samaṃ saṃgaḥ śubhe'hani ।। 19।।
niṣekasamaye śukraśoṇitamiśraṇe yathā ।
naranārīpracitte tu bhāvanā tadyutaḥ sutaḥ ।।1.74.20 ।।
caitanyaṃ bījarūpe tu śukre nityaṃ vyavasthitam ।
kāma cittaṃ ca śukraṃ ca yadā hyekatvamāpnuyuḥ ।।21।।
tadā dravamavāpnoti yoṣāgarbhāśaye naraḥ ।
raktā''dhikye bhavennārī śukrādhikye bhavennaraḥ ।।22।।
śukraśoṇitayoḥ sāmye garbhaḥ ṣaṇḍhatvamāpnuyāt ।
ahorātreṇa kalalaṃ budbudṃ pañcabhirdinaiḥ ।।23।।
daśame'hani karkandhurviṃśāhe ghanamāṃsatā ।
tathā māse tu sampūrṇe pañcatattvāni dhārayet ।।24।।
māsadvaye tvacāmedau majjāsthīni tribhistathā ।
caturthe tu gulphakeśāḥ pañcame karṇanāsike ।।।25।।
saptame kaṇṭhaguhyādi hyaṣṭame'ṅgaprapūrṇatā ।
navame bahirjigamiṣā daśame tu prasūyate ।।26।।
pṛthivyāstvagasthināḍīromamāṃsetipañcakam ।
apāṃ lāळ+āmūtraśukramajāraktetipaṃcakam ।।।27।।
vahneḥ kāntikṣudhānidrātṛṣṇā''lasyetipañcakam ।
vāyoḥśvāsagatirodhā''kuṃcaprasārapañcakam ।।।28।।।
rāgadveṣabhayalajjāmohā vā pañca vāyujāḥ ।
vyomno ghoṣāśrayacchidragāmbhīryaśravaṇā guṇāḥ ।।29।।
iḍā piṃgalā suṣumṇā gāndhārī gajajihvikā ।
pūṣā yaśā hyalambuṣā kuhūḥ śaṃkhinī nāḍikāḥ ।।1.74.30।।
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścodāno vyānaśca vāyavaḥ ।
nāgaḥ kūrmaḥ kṛkalaśca devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ ।।3 1।।
hṛdi prāṇo gude'pānaḥ samāno nābhimaṇḍale ।
udānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe syād vyānaḥ sarvaśarīragaḥ ।।32।।
nāgasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ kūrmavāyo saṃkocanaṃ matam ।
śūlaṃ kṛkalajaṃ devadattasyodgāraprabhṛti ।।33।।
dhanaṃjayo vikāsāya mṛte'pi tridivāsthitiḥ ।
karṇākṣināsikānanagudaguhyāni vai nava ।।34।।
nābhirdaśamī brahmarandhramekādaśakaṃ smṛtam ।
strīguhye garbhagarto dvādaśaṃ stanau caturdaśa ।।35।।
romakoṭistathā tisro hyardhakoṭisamanvitā ।
dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ proktā nakhā viṃśatireva ca ।।।36।।
trilakṣakeśā mūrdhanyā mukhasthāśceti vai sthitiḥ ।
trayastu mātṛto romalohitamāṃsasaṃjñakāḥ ।।37।।
pitṛtaśca snāyvasthimajjānaśca koṣaṣaḍvidham ।
māṃsaṃ palasahasraikaṃ raktaṃ palaśataṃ tathā ।।38।।
palāni daśa medaśca majjā palaṃ daśa dvayam ।
raktaṃ palatrayaṃ proktaṃ śukraṃ dvikuḍavaṃ tathā ।।39।।
śoṇitaṃ kuḍavaṃ śleṣmā ṣaṭ viṇmūtraṃ tathā'rdhakam ।
mano buddhirahaṃ cittametatkaraṇamāntaram ।।1.74.40।।
tatsarvaṃ dehasaṃbhūto garbhaḥ prasūtivāyunā ।
niṣkāsito bahiryāti mūrchito janma caiti hi ।।41।।
brahmāṇḍasyā''kṛtiḥ sarvā śarīre samavasthitā ।
satyalokaṃ śirorandhraṃ tapolokaṃ lalāṭakam ।।42।।
janalokaṃ mukhaṃ proktaṃ mahaḥ kaṇṭhamudāhṛtam ।
hṛdyaṃ tu svaraṃ vidyādbhuvarlokamudaryakam ।।।42।।
bhūlokaṃ nābhyadhobhāgo hyatalaṃ kaṭisaṃsthitiḥ ।
vitalaṃ guhyamākhyātaṃ sutalaṃ sakthimūlayoḥ ।।44।।
ūrū talātalaṃ mahātalaṃ jānudvayaṃ tathā ।
rasātalaṃ mate jaṃghe pādau pātālamucyate ।।45।।
kṣārodastvatra tu mūtre dugdhe kṣīrodasāgaraḥ ।
surodadhiḥ śleṣmasaṃstho majjāyāṃ ghṛtasāgaraḥ ।।46।।
rasodadhirmiṣṭarase śoṇite dadhisāgaraḥ ।
svādūdakaḥ kukṣibhāge garbhodaḥ śukrasaṃsthitaḥ ।।47।।
netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca oṣṭhe tu maṃgalaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
budhastu hṛdye bodhyo gururjñāne vyavasthitaḥ ।।48।।
śukre śukraḥ śanirnābhau mukhe rāhurvyavasthitaḥ ।
keturguhye sthitaśceti piṇḍaṃ brahmāṇḍamīritam ।।49।।
āyurvidyā ca vittaṃ ca yaśo nidhanameva ca ।
pañcaivaitāni sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ ।।1.74.50।।
adhomukhaṃ cordhvapādaṃ garbhādāyāti vai bahiḥ ।
rakṣyamāṇo janmakartryā rakṣaँścānyānnijāśritān ।।51 ।।
putraiḥ saṃrakṣitaḥ paścānmṛtaḥ punaḥ sa eva hi ।
bhaktyā hariṃ bhajennityamatandritamanukṣaṇam ।।52।।
tadā muktirbhavedeva svargaṃ sarvasukhāspadam ।
yanna duḥkhena sambhinnaṃ na ca grastamanantaram ।।53 ।।
abhilāṣopanītaṃ ca tatsukhaṃ svaḥpadāspadam ।
so'śnute sarvakāmāṃśca saha brahmaṇā vipaścitā ।।54।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dānaphalaniṣekasamayagarbhanirmāṇaśārīrakoṣabrahmāṇḍaikyatādikathananāmā catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।74।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ ।
mārgo yamapurasyeti sarvaiḥ pātheyamiṣyate ।। 1 ।।
yamagrāme'pi bhojyaṃ tairiṣyate vaṃśajaiḥ kṛtam ।

caturthe saṃcayaṃ kṛtvā gaṃgāsparśo vidhīyate ।

siddhānnaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ śarkarā'pūpakādayaḥ ।। 14।।
śayyādānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ paścāt ko'nupradāsyati ।

ātmā vai hyātmano bandhurātmā caivātmano ripuḥ ।। 16 ।।
ato jīvan hi sarvasvaṃ svahastenaiva dāpayet ।
tasmāt kāṣṭhamayīṃ khaṭvāṃ hemādipaṭṭikābhṛtām ।। 17।।

ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūrāgurucandanam ।। 1 9।।
kuṃkumaṃ dīpakaṃ chatraṃ cāmarāsanabhājanam ।

evaṃ śayyādidānena svarlokaḥ sukhado bhavet ।
upayuktaṃ ca tasyāsīd yatkiñciddhi gṛhe tathā ।। 2 1 ।।
gātre cāpi ca yallagnaṃ vastrabhājanabhūṣaṇam ।
dātavyamupatiṣṭhettadaindre saurye'pi dhāmani ।। 22।।
navakaṃ ṣoḍaśaśrāddhaṃ śayyāṃ saṃvatsarakriyām ।

prayāge naimiṣe yacca kurukṣetre tathā'rbude ।

darbhamayāśca catvāra_ ṛkṣamantrābhipūjitāḥ ।

paṃcakānantaraṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam ।। 38 ।।

sūtakānte tataḥ putraḥ kuryācchāntikṛduttamam ।
tilān gāँśca hiraṇyaṃ ca tasyoddeśe ghṛtaṃ diśet ।।1.75.40 ।।

vikīraśca svadhākāraḥ pitṛśabdo'pravācanam ।।।43 ।।
āvāhanamulmukaṃ cā''sīmāntaṃ ca pradakṣiṇā ।

pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।75 ।।

śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca-
evaṃ suśikha! bhajanāddharernāmānukīrtanāt ।
hāṭakāṃgadarājā'pi kathārasasukho'bhavat ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu priye prasaṃgādvai mayā tu bahu varṇitam ।
lokasyaiva hitārthe tat kathaye'pyadhikaṃ hitam ।। 2 ।।
jīvanneva janaḥ kuryānmokṣamārgāvalambanam ।
mokṣadāni mayā cātra klṛptāni subahūnyapi ।। 3 ।।
jñānānmuktiḥ karmanāśānmuktirvairāgyavegataḥ ।
tīrthānmuktiḥ satāṃ saṃgāddharmānmuktirgurūśrayāt ।। 4 ।।
niṣkāmakarmato muktirmuktiḥ saṃnyāsamārgataḥ ।
sādhvīdharmāśrayānmuktirmuktistyāgācca sevayā ।
svasyā'kartṛtvavijñānānmuktiḥ saṃkīrtanādapi ।। 5 ।।
pitrostu sevayā muktirmuktiḥ patiniṣevayā ।
sarvabrahmātmavijñānānmuktiḥ sarvasamarpaṇāt ।। 6 ।।
paropakārakaraṇānmuktiḥ parasukhārpaṇāt ।
anyārthitapradānācca muktirātmasutoṣaṇāt ।। 7 ।।
vāsanākṣayato muktirmuktirvimalabodhataḥ ।
sarvakārye kṛte'pyātmā nirlepo mukta eva saḥ ।। 8 ।।
ahaṃmamatvarahitaḥ śītoṣṇarahitastathā ।
abrahmasattvarahito mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 9 ।।
visṛjya saccidānandaṃ bhānaṃ mṛṣājaḍārtikam ।
manute svaṃ sa vai baddho na manute sa muktakaḥ ।। 1.76.1 0।।
bhagavadyogatīrthāni puryaśca harinirmitāḥ ।
nadyaśca parvatāḥ puṇyāraṇyāni mandirāṇi ca ।। 11 ।।
śālagrāmaśilā devaśilā bāṇaśca mūrtayaḥ ।
tulasīcandanaplakṣadhātrībimbavaṭadrumāḥ ।। 12।।
ropaṇātpālanātsekānnamaḥsparśanakīrtanāt ।
nirmāṇoddhārakaraṇātpāpakṣapā hi muktidāḥ ।। 13।।
jñānahrade satyajale rāgadveṣamalāpahe ।
yaḥ snāto mānase tīrthe muktiṃ yāyānna saṃśayaḥ ।। 14।।
devaḥ sarvatra vasati yadi bhāvo'sti nirmalaḥ ।
devaḥ kvāpi na vasati nāstikyaṃ yadi rājate ।। 15।।
prātaḥ prātaḥ prapaśyanti gaṃgādyāṃ matsyaghātakāḥ ।
sūryaṃ sarve'pi paśyanti bhāvahīno na muktibhāk ।। 16 ।।
pitṛmātṛsādhusādhvīgurugodevadharmaṇām ।
kṛte prāṇāँstyajan vyaktirniścayaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt ।। 17।।
jīvanaṃ dānabhogābhyāṃ maraṇaṃ raṇatīrthayoḥ ।
avaśyaṃ muktidaṃ syāttad yadvi devārpaṇānvitam ।। 18।।
puṇyakṣetre puṇyatīrthe puṇyajanasamāśraye ।
puṇyasthitau puṇyatithau maraṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet ।। 19।।
kanyādātā bhuvo dātā dātā cā'pyabhayasya yaḥ ।
devaprāsādanirmātā sadmadātā ca muktibhāk ।। 1.76.20 ।।
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāmārāmodyānadharmiṇām ।
jīrṇoddhāraṃ prakurvāṇo muktibhāg saṃśayo nahi ।।2 1 ।।
sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ gṛha dhenuṃ savatsakām ।
kanyāṃ sarvaguṇāḍhyāṃ vai dadan muktimavāpnuyāt ।।22।।
sādhvī pativratā nārī patiṃ vilokya vai mṛtam ।
svāṃguṣṭhādagnimutpādya patyā saha prayāti cet ।।।23।।
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca samāḥ svarge mahīyate ।।
yadi bhaktimatī nārī patiṃ nayati dhāmani ।।24।।
mahāpāpasamācāro bhartā ced duṣkṛto bhavet ।
tasyā'pyanuvratā nārī nāśayet sarvakilbiṣam ।। 25।।
nityamannapradātā yaḥ sadā jñānapradāyakaḥ ।
nityātmasukhadātā yaḥ sa vai mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।26।।
vidyādānapradātā yaḥ kanyādānakaraśca yaḥ ।
jīvanavṛttidātā yaḥ sa vai mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।27।।
sukṛtaiḥ svargamāpnoti svargaṃ mokṣasthalaṃ matam ।
tyaktvā phalgukriyāṃ tasmātsatataṃ mokṣabhāgbhavet ।। 28।।
dānaṃ deyaṃ daridrāya kanyā nirvaṃśakāya ca ।
anāthakāya sadvṛttiḥ sādhave sveṣṭavastukam ।।।29।।
bhāvanā gurave deyā vidyā pātrāya mokṣiṇe ।
jñānaṃ sāttvikaśiṣyāya bhaktirdeyā'ntarātmane ।।।1.76.3 0 ।।
mohajālaṃ tu māyāyai sarvasvaṃ paramātmane ।
muktiśca svātmane deyā svātmā deyaḥ parātmane ।।2 1 ।।
evaṃ mokṣaṃ prapadyeta dātā dānaphalaṃ labhet ।
tasmātsarvaṃ pradātavyaṃ koṭiyajñaphalādhikam ।। 32।।
sarvadānapradātā yaḥ svasminnarakṣakaśca saḥ ।
arthānmukta iti bhāvyo nityamuktaḥ sa sammataḥ ।।।33।।
nāryā kāryaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi! dānaṃ kīdṛgvidhaṃ matam ।
mātre'rpaṇīyaṃ kanyātvaṃ kaumāryaṃ lagnavahnaye ।।।34।।।
dehastu pataye deyaḥ putrāyā'haṃmamatvakam ।
saundaryaṃ tu jarāyai ca vāsanā'rpyā tu mṛtyave ।।35।।
apatyasneho vadhvai ca nanāmikyai tu bandhanam ।
bhāvanā brahmaṇe deyā bhaktirdeyā'ntarātmane ।।36।।
muktiśca svātmane deyā svātmā deyaḥ parātmane ।
iti sarvasvadānaṃ vai kartavyaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ ।।।37।।
vinā vinimayaṃ naiva vastvamūlyamavāpyate ।
sarvasvadānamūlyenā'mūlyamokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।।38।।
ātmā tu nityaśuddho'sti śuddhistasya na śiṣyate ।
śarīreṇā'pyaśuddhena śuddhasyā'śuddhatā katham ।।39।।
pātraṃ naivā'styaśuddhaṃ vai lagnaṃ dravyaṃ tvaśuddhidam ।
lagnadravyādyapasārātpātraṃ tu śuddhameva ha ।।1.76.40।।
hasto nāstyaśuddho vai tu malaṃ cā'śuddhirucyate ।
malāpasaraṇāddhastaḥ śuddha eveti manyate ।।41।।
yadi pātraṃ ca hastaścā'śuddhau bhavataḥ saṃgataḥ ।
tadā nāśyaṃ bhavetpātraṃ hastaśchedyo bhavettathā ।।।42।।
kintu naivaṃ prakurvanti malaṃ niṣkāsayanti vai ।
evamātmā sadā śuddhaḥ svarṇā'gnivyomavanmataḥ ।।।43।।
rāgadveṣamalāstasmādapaneyā dhiyā'gninā ।
bhaktyā''rādhanayā premṇā prītyā snehena bhāvataḥ ।।44।।
malā dhyeyā vināśyāśca nirmalo brahma eva saḥ ।
brahmarūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā parabrahma bhajetsadā ।।45।।
nārāyaṇabalaṃ prāpya nārāyaṇamavāpnuyāt ।
nārāyaṇabalistasya kartavyo nā'vaśiṣyate ।।46।।
nārāyaṇabalaṃ yasya nāsti tasyaiva muktaye ।
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryastadrītiṃ kathayāmi te ।।47।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne muktervividhasādhanāni niṣkāmatayā kṛtāni niṣkāmatayā pradattavastūni ca muktidāni, deyadānāni nijātmaśuddhyādīni ceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।76।।


← adhyāyaḥ 076 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 77
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 078 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tava snehāt priye jñānaṃ proktaṃ bhavanibarhaṇam ।
nārāyaṇabaliṃ brūve lokopakṛtihetave ।। 1 ।।
akasmātādinaṣṭānāmuddhārārthamayaṃ vidhiḥ ।
śubhe tīrthe śubhe kṣetre pavitre devamandire ।। 2 ।।
vāritaṭe puṇyavṛkṣatale nārāyaṇabalim ।
kuryādviṣṇuṃ samuddiśya mantraiḥ paurāṇavaidikaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā pretaṃ viṣṇumiti smaret ।
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa pretamokṣakaro bhava ।। 4 ।।
pūrṇaṃ tu tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ śrāddhānyekādaśāpi ca ।
toyavrīhiyavān dadyād godhūmāँśca priyaṃgavān ।। 5 ।।
haviṣyānnaṃ śubhāṃ mudrāṃ chatroṣṇīṣau ca celakam ।
kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ ca dhānyāni vastre copānahau tathā ।। 6 ।।
bhūmau sthiteṣu piṇḍeṣu gandhapuṣpā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।
dātavyamatha śaṃkhe vā pātre tāmre ca tarpaṇam ।। 7 ।।
prathamaṃ vātadhāreṇa jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ ।
jalārthaṃ cārpayed devamekoddiṣṭaṃ pṛthaka-pṛthak ।। 8 ।।
'āpo devī madhumatī' tvādipiṇḍe prakalpitā ।
'upayāma-gṛhīto'si' dvitīye tu nivedayet ।। 9 ।।
'ye devāsaḥ'-caturthe tu, 'samudraṃ gaccha'-pañcame ।। 1.77.10 ।।
'agnirjyoti, stathā-ṣaṣṭe 'hiraṇyagarbhaḥ'-saptame ।
'yamāya' tvaṣṭame jñeyaṃ, 'yajjāgrannavame' tathā ।। 11 ।।
daśame 'yāḥ phalinī' ti, piṇḍe caikādaśe tataḥ ।
'bhadraṃ karṇebhi,rityādyaiḥ kuryāt piṇḍavisarjanam ।। 12।।
kṛtvaikādaśadaivatyaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryātpare'hani ।
viprānāvāhayedarghyaṃ dadyāddevān vidhāpayet ।। 13 ।।
viṣṇuṃ sarvamayaṃ rudraṃ tāmrajaṃ lohajaṃ yamam ।
brahmāṇaṃ rājataṃ pretaṃ sīsakaṃ darbhakaṃ ca vā ।। 14।।
tato 'yamāya tve,tyādimantreṇa sāmavedinam ।
'agne āyāhi,mantreṇa govindaṃ paścime nyaset ।। 15।।
agnimīletimantreṇa pūrvāśāyāṃ prajāpatim ।
'iṣe tventyādimantreṇa dakṣiṇe sthāpayed yamam ।। 16।।
madhye tu maṇḍale tatra sthāpyo darbhamayo naraḥ ।
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro yamaḥ pretaśca paṃcamaḥ ।। 17।।
pṛthak kuṃbheṣu saṃsthāpyāḥ pañcaratnayuteṣu hi ।
vastrayajñopavītāni mudrāścaiva pṛthakpṛthak ।। 18।।
japaṃ kuryātpṛthak tatra brahmādidevatāsu vai ।
paṃca śrāddhāni kurvīta devatānāṃ yathāvidhi ।। 19।।
jaladhārāṃ tataḥ kuryāt piṇḍe piṇḍe pṛthakpṛthak ।
śaṃkhe vā tāmrapātre vā hyalābhe mṛṇmaye'pi vā ।।।1.77.20।।
tilodakaṃ samādāya sarvauṣadhisamanvitam ।
āsanaṃ mudrikāṃ chatramupānahau kamaṇḍalum ।।2 1।।
pātraṃ bhojyārhadhānyaṃ ca vastrāṇyaṣṭavidhaṃ padam ।
tāmrapātraṃ tilapūrṇaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ sadakṣiṇam ।।22।।
dadyāttu vidhinā tatra mukhyāya brāhmaṇāya vai ।
ṛgvedine tu viprāya dadyāt sasasyamedinīm ।।23 ।।
yajurvedibrāhmaṇāya dadyād gāṃ tu payasvinīm ।
sāmavedibrāhmaṇāya dadyāt sadvastradhautrakam ।।24।।
dadyād yamaṃ samuddiśya tilān lohaṃ ca dakṣiṇām ।
atha puttalakaḥ kāryaḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaḥ ।।25।।
palāśasya ca vṛntānāṃ bhāgaṃ kṛtvā ca tatra vai ।
kṛṣṇājinaṃ samāstīrya kuśaiśca puruṣākṛtim ।।26 ।।
śatatrayaṣaṣṭiyutairvṛntaiḥ prokto'sthisaṃcayaḥ ।
vinyasya tāni badhnīyāt kuśairaṅge pṛthak pṛthak ।।27।।
catvāriṃśacchirobhāge grīvāyāṃ ca daśa nyaset ।
viṃśatiścorasi kṣepyaṃ viṃśatirjaṭhare tathā ।।28।।
bāhudvaye śataṃ dadyāt kaṭyāṃ dadyācca viṃśatim ।
ūrudvaye śataṃ cāpi triṃśacca jaṃghayordvayoḥ ।।।29।।।
dadyāccatuṣṭayaṃ śiśne ṣaḍ dadyād vṛṣaṇadvaye ।
daśa pādāṃgulībhāge evamasthīni klṛptayet ।।3 0।।
śiraḥsthāne nārikelaṃ dadyāttāraṃ ca tāluke ।
āsye dadyātpaṃcaratna jivhāyāṃ kadalīphalam ।।1.77.3 1।।
antreṣu vālukāṃ dadyād vāhlīkaṃ ghrāṇa eva ca ।
vasāyāṃ mṛttikāṃ dadyād gomūtraṃ mūtrake tathā ।।32।।
gandhakaṃ dhātave dadyād haritālaṃ manaḥśilām ।
yavapiṣṭaṃ tathā māṃse madhu śoṇita eva ca ।। 33 ।।
keśeṣu ca jaṭājūṭaṃ tvacāyāṃ ca mṛgatvacam ।
pāradaṃ retasaḥ sthāne purīṣe pittalaṃ tathā ।।।34।।
manaḥśilāṃ tathā gātre tilakalkaṃ ca sandhiṣu ।
karṇayostāḍapatraṃ ca stanayoścaiva guṃjakau ।।35।।।
nāsāyāṃ śatapatraṃ ca kamalaṃ nābhimaṇḍale ।
vṛntākaṃ vṛṣaṇe dadyāt liṃge tu gṛṃjanaṃ śubham ।।36।।
ghṛtaṃ nābhyāṃ pradadyādvai kaupīne tu trapu smṛtam ।
mauktikaṃ stanayormūrdhni kuṃkumena vilepanam ।।37।।
karpūrāgurudhūpaiśca śubhairmālyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ।
paridhāne paṭṭasūtraṃ hṛdaye rukmakaṃ nyaset ।।38।।
ṛddhivṛddhibhujau dvau ca netrayośca kapardikām ।
sindūraṃ netrakoṇeṣu tāmbūlādyupahārakaiḥ ।। 39 ।।
sarvauṣadhiyutāṃ pretapūjāṃ kṛtvā yathoditām ।
sāgnikaiścāpi vidhinā yajñapātrāṇi cārpayet ।।1.77.40।।
'śanno devī punantu me' 'imaṃ me varuṇe' ti ca ।
pretasya pāvanaṃ kṛtvā śālagrāmaśilodakaiḥ ।।41 ।।
viṣṇumuddiśya godānaṃ mahādānaṃ tilāni ca ।
vaitaraṇīṃ pradadyācca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ।।42 ।।
prakuryād vaiṣṇavaṃ śrāddhaṃ pretamuktyarthamātmanā ।
pretamokṣaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhariṃ tatra prakalpayet ।।43 ।।
'tvaṃ viṣṇu' riti saṃsmṛtya pretamagnau dahettathā ।
tridinaṃ sūtake rakṣya daśāhaṃ gatapiṇḍakāḥ ।।44।।
sarvaṃ vai varṣaparyantaṃ kartavyaṃ pretamuktaye ।
svarṇabhūgopradānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mokṣalabdhaye ।।।45 ।।
saṃkrāntau kṛtadānaṃ tu dyupradaṃ saptakalpakam ।
harau sarvasvadānaṃ tu syādanantaṃ pramokṣadam ।।46 ।।
vaitaraṇī bhaved dvedhā ekā vai yāmyamārgagā ।
śatayojanavistīrṇā godānātsā tu tīryate ।।47।।
aparā vāsanā sākṣād vaitaraṇī hṛdi sthitā ।
anantayojanadīrghā jñānabhaktyā hi tīryate ।।48।।।
prathamā tatra durgandhā dvitīyā bhāvagandhinī ।
ādyā rakta pūyatoyā rāgadveṣajalā'parā ।।49 ।
māṃsakardamayuktā''dyā dhātukardamakā'parā ।
vajratuṇḍaiḥ śiśumārairmakarairvajrakartanaiḥ ।।।1.77.50 ।
kṛkacaiḥ kharjakairjīvairyuktā''dyā viṣayaiḥ parā ।
patanti tatra martyāstu krandamānā hi pāpinaḥ ।।51।
payasvinyāśca godānaṃ tārayet pūyaśoṇitam ।
amṛtakṛddharerdānaṃ tārayed vāsanānadīm ।।52 ।।
prāṇāḥ prāghūṇikā bodhyā na yāsyantyātmanā saha ।
atraiva layameṣyanti prāṇadaṃ ta hariṃ bhaja ।।53 ।।
saprāṇaṃ maraṇaṃ nidrā hyaprāṇaṃ maraṇaṃ mṛtiḥ ।
dvayornāstyeva viśvāso jīvasya jīvanāya hi ।।54।
mokṣārthamadya kurvīta yāvanna maraṇaṃ bhavet ।
maraṇaṃ mokṣaparyāyaṃ prāpyaṃ nā'nyābhidhānakam ।।55।।
kaḥ patiḥ kasya vā nārī kaḥ putraḥ kasya vā pitā ।
ṛṇānubandhasaṃsargāḥ santi vaitaraṇīpradāḥ ।।56 ।।
mamedamiti sammatvā ghorayatnaṃ karoti yat ।
tatsarvaṃ tu yatnakṛtaḥ tyaktvā tiṣṭhati dūrataḥ ।।57।।
valgantaṃ naiva valganti mānayantaṃ na manvate ।
snihyantaṃ naiva snihyanti tathāpyajño na paśyati ।।58।।
guṇavantaṃ tu śuṣkārthā janāḥ śaṃsanti vāha vāha ।
rūkṣāḥ svārthaṃ prasādhyaiva yānti dūraṃ na tān saret ।।59।।
ādau sārthastathā madhye yo'nte'pi sārthatāṃ bhajet ।
anyat tyaktvā sadā sārthaṃ sakhāyaṃ saṃbhajeta tam ।।1.77.60।।
yena kartavyamanyadvai nāvaśiṣyeta kiṃcana ।
kartavyaṃ tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sakhā mitraṃ vimokṣyate ।।6 1 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārāyaṇabalikriyānirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।77।।


nārāyaṇa balyupari ṭippaṇī


← adhyāyaḥ 077 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 78
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 079 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
gatayo vividhāḥ karmaprāpyāstu saṃśrutā mayā ।
pretānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ dānaṃ prabhuṇā śrāvitaṃ tathā ।। 1 ।।
prasaṃgādyamarājñastu yamaloko'pi bodhitaḥ ।
dhanvantareḥ kathā cāpi śrotumicchāmi mādhava! ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
pūrve satye tathā tretāyuge saṃkalpasiddhijam ।
sarvamāsīd yatheṣṭaṃ vai yadecchātyupatiṣṭhate ।। 3 ।।
nāsīdapūrṇatā kācitkasyacidvastuno'pi ca ।
sadā tṛptiḥ sadā toṣaḥ sadaivaḥ kāmanāphalam ।। 4 ।।
pañcabhūtāni ca tadā parivartanta icchayā ।
jano yadicchati bhūtāt tattasmāllabhate drutam ।। 9 ।।
sarvalokā hṛṣṭapuṣṭā nīrogāḥ svātmatṛptayaḥ ।
āsanprāpte dvāpare tu jātaṃ tatparivartanam ।। 7 ।।
śaktistu kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ kiñcinnaṣṭā'bhavattadā ।
cintāmaṇīnāṃ sāmarthyaṃ kiṃcinnāśonmukhaṃ gatam ।। 7 ।।
aiśvaryaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ layamāpat kvacitkvacit ।
tadā kṣetravane svatvaṃ janā hyasthāpayan svakam ।। 8 ।।
bhojyādilabdhikā cintā janānāmabhavad hṛdi ।
svatvaparatvabhedena cintāśokaspṛhā''dhayaḥ ।। 9 ।।
adharmavaṃśāḥ svā''vāsaṃ cakrurjanahṛdi drutam ।
janāścintādyākulāstu śuṣkāyante śarīrataḥ ।। 1.78.10 ।।
teṣāṃ vyathāṃ nirbalatvaṃ dūrīkartuṃ tadā khalu ।
hyapekṣā samabhūttatrauṣadhānāṃ baladāyinām ।। 11 ।।
bhojyauṣadhikaṇādīnāṃ bhājānāṃ phalamūlinām ।
janānāṃ bhojyasampattyai kṛṣisiddhyai tadā khalu ।। 1 2।।
apekṣā samabhūdudbhijjātīnāṃ lokavṛttaye ।
kā cauṣadhirbhakṣyaphalakaṇapatrātmiketi vai ।। 13 ।।
kā ca kathaṃ susampoṣyā hyupayojyā kathaṃ bhuji ।
ityevamudbhidvijñānī kaścinnāsīttadā hyajaḥ ।। 14।।
jñātṛguruṃ prasasmāra punarnārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ ।
āgato bhagavāँstatra sarvajñānamayo vibhuḥ ।। 15 ।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ sauvarṇakuṇḍalaḥ ।
suvarṇamukuṭaḥ svarṇamālākaustubharājitaḥ ।। 16 ।।
mandahāsyaṃ sravaँstejaḥ saṃvyāptamukhamaṇḍalaḥ ।
pītāmbaradharaḥ āyurvedasaṃstutasadyaśāḥ ।। 17।।
sarvarasaprapūrṇo hi yāvaddugdhābdhipūjitaḥ ।
yāvacchākarasairvandyaḥ sarvagundrā'bhisannataḥ ।। 18 ।।
divyauṣadhilatāvṛkṣatṛṇakandādisaṃstutaḥ ।
śubhramukho haridvarṇo raktapādakarāmbujaḥ ।। 19 ।।
yuñjan śubhāśiṣā viśvasṛjaṃ prāha dayāmayaḥ ।
brahman kathaṃ tvayā saṃsmārito'haṃ dvāpure yuge ।। 1.78.20 ।।
brahmovāca tadā devaṃ sarvagaṃ bhiṣajāṃ varam ।
namaskaromi deveśa vande yugalapatkajam ।।।2 1।।
namo hyaṇusvarūpāya dvyaṇukāya namo namaḥ ।।
tryaṇukāya namaścaturaṇukāya namonamaḥ ।।।22।।
namaḥ pañcāṇurūpāya rajorūpāya te namaḥ ।
namo dhūlīsvarūpāya namaste kaṃkarātmane ।।23।।
namo grāvasvarūpāya namaste piṇḍanāmine ।
namaḥ piṇḍāḍhyabījāya namo'vyaktāṃ'kurātmane ।।।24।।
namaḥ patrasvarūpāya namaḥ kāṇḍādirūpiṇe ।
namaḥ śākhapraśākhāya namaḥ stambādihetave ।।।5।।
namo nālāya puṣpāya namo rasaphalātmane ।
namaḥ kaṇasvarūpāya namaḥ piṣṭarasātmane ।।26।।
namo'pākajarūpāya pakvarūpāya te namaḥ ।
namo bhakṣyabhojyalehyacośyarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 27।।
namo miśrasvarūpāya nama oṣadhirūpiṇe ।
namaḥ kvāthādirūpāya namaścūrṇādirūpiṇe ।।28।।
namo recakamātrāya namo bhasmādivedine ।
nama āyuḥpradātre te nama oṣadhiśaktaye ।।29।।
namaste parameśāna kṣemakuśalakīrtaye ।
bhoktre bhogyapradānāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ।। 1.78.30 ।।
devadeva śarīrāṇāṃ dhātā tvaṃ poṣako'vitā ।
yuge'smin kalpanāsiddhirlayaṃ prayāti dehinām ।। 31 ।।
saṃkalpitaṃ na cāyāti nopatiṣṭhati nekṣyate ।
tasmādvṛttikaraṃ dhānyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalādikam ।।।32।।।
kaṇaṃ mūlaṃ tathā stambaṃ tṛṇaṃ sasyaṃ payobhṛtam ।
ṣaḍrasaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ pathyaṃ vai sarvadehinām ।।3 3 ।।
mṛgayitvā saṃviśuddhya miśrayitvā mahauṣadhīn ।
bhojyaṃ cā'pyauṣadhaṃ lokān prabodhayitumarhasi ।।34।।
na kaścit tvāmṛte cāsya prodbhidvargasya bodhakaḥ ।
vijñātā'pi bhavennaiva yaḥ sarvaśaḥ sa sarvavit ।।35।।
kāryakāraṇavijñātā yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ ।
tasmād rasāyanaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhojyaṃ peyameva vā ।।36।।
yallehyaṃ mṛdyamāghreyamāsevyaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet ।
āsvādanīyamābandhyaṃ tatsarvaṃ kartumarhasi ।।37।।
yattapyaṃ yacca vai kvathyaṃ yadbhṛjyaṃ cūrṇyameva yat ।
yanmiśryaṃ yatsārarūpaṃ tatsarvaṃ kartumarhasi ।।38।।
ityevamarthito viṣṇurmerostu śikhare svakām ।
kuṭīṃ cakre nivāsaṃ ca tasyāmevā'karotprabhuḥ ।।39।।
devarṣimunipitṛbhyo mānavādibhya eva ca ।
dattāstu mārgaṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣyoṣadhaya ityatha ।।1.78.40 ।।
karṣukāstāḥ sasyarūpā vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
tābhyo vividhadeśeṣu vividhānnāni jajñire ।।41 ।।
tāḥ kṛṣivṛttayo jātā udyānāni ca bhūriśaḥ ।
athāpi prāṇināṃ tābhirvanauṣadhibhirapyayam ।।।42।।
balalābhāya bhagavān āyurvedaṃ lilekha vai ।
tādṛśāḥ saṃprayogāśca vyāptā dhanvantarikṛtāḥ ।।।43।।
rasāyanādiśālāśca kṛtā merau bahuprathāḥ ।
yatrauṣadhaṃ trikālīyaṃ jñātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।।44।।
kartavyaṃ miśraṇaṃ yatrauṣadhīnāṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।
iti tu prathame caturyuge tvevā'bhavaddhariḥ ।।45।।।
svayaṃ dhanvantarirdivyaḥ prabhurbrahmāṇḍarakṣakaḥ ।
athāpi kalimāpannā lokāstu bahuduḥkhitāḥ ।।46।।
tadā vai bhagavān sākṣādavatarītumicchati ।
sa vai dvitīyarūpeṇa dhanvantarirbabhūva ha ।।47।।
vaṃśaparamparājanmā kāśyāṃ so'bhūd bhiṣagvaraḥ ।
śṛṇu tāṃ ca kathāṃ lakṣmi! kasmin vaṃśe babhūva saḥ ।।48।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ādyasatyugīyadhanvantariprādurbhāvakathanādināmā'ṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।78।।


← adhyāyaḥ 078 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 79
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 080 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro'triṛṣirlokaviśrutaḥ ।
kāṣṭhavadūrdhvabāhuḥ saँstapaścacāra duścaram ।। 1 ।।
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyāni vigatāni vai ।
tasyā'nimiṣanetrābhyāṃ tapastejomayaṃ jalam ।। 2 ।।
susrāva dyotayandaśa diśaḥ kāntyā sudugdhayā ।
taṃ tu jalātmakaṃ garbhaṃ diśo vidhyājñayā daśa ।। 2 ।।
dadhustathāpyaśaktāstaddhāraṇe'to jalaṃ hi tat ।
ghanībhūtaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ śītahimasugolakam ।। 4 ।।
patitaṃ vai pṛthivyāṃ tat samādāya tu padmajaḥ ।
rathamāropayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।। 5 ।।
tuṣṭuvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।
bhṛguraṃgirā marīcirvaśiṣṭhāśceti mānasāḥ ।। 6 ।।
ṛgbhiryajubhirbahubhiratharvāṃgirasairapi ।
evaṃ vivardhamānasya tejaḥ somasya bṛṃhitam ।। 7 ।।
ārdrīkurvacca lokāँstrīnsarvatra puṣṭimādadhat ।
śuklaṃ śītaṃ ca tejastatpṛthivīmanvapadyata ।। 8 ।।
oṣadhyastāḥ samudbhūtāstejasā poṣaṇaṃ gatāḥ ।
brahmaṇā'pi ratho vājisahasasahitaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 9 ।।
somāyā'rpita eveti tena proccarite divi ।
evaṃ poṣṭā'bhavad devo jagataḥ sarvadehinām ।। 1.79.10 ।।
tapastepe punaścandraḥ padmānāṃ daśatīrdaśa ।
hiraṇyavarṇā lakṣmyastu dhārayantyātmanā jagat ।। 1 1।।
vibhustāsāṃ dharaḥ somo babhāra tāḥ svatejasā ।
tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ ।।12।।
bījauṣadhiṣu sarvāsu cā'psu vipreṣu rātriṣu ।
sa tatprāpya mahadrājyaṃ somaḥ somavatāṃ prabhuḥ ।। 13।।
yajñaṃ cakre rājasūyaṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam ।
hiraṇyagarbhaścodgātā brahmā brahmatvamāptavān ।। 14।।
sadasyastatra bhagavān harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ ।।15।।
dakṣiṇāyāṃ trilokānvai somo'rpayantu sarvathā ।
taṃ sinī ca kuhūścaiva vapuḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ ।। 16।।
kīrtirdyutiśca lakṣmīśca nava devyaḥ siṣevire ।
prāpyā'vabhṛthamavyagraḥ sarvadevarṣipūjitaḥ ।। 17।।
atirājātirājendraḥ prāpyaiśvaryaṃ tu garvitaḥ ।
patnīṃ bṛhaspatestārānāmnīṃ jahāra kāmataḥ ।। 18।।
sa yācyamāno devaiśca devarṣibhiśca vai punaḥ ।
naiva vyasarjayattārāṃ bṛhaspataya ityata ।। 19।।
śukro bṛhaspaterdveṣādagrahītsāsuroḍupam ।
haro gurusutaṃ snehātsarvabhūtagaṇāvṛtaḥ ।।1.79.20 ।।
sarvadevaguṇopeto mahendro gurumanvayāt ।
jagrāha tena rudro'pi svīyamājagavaṃ dhanuḥ ।।।1 ।।
surā'suravināśo'bhūtsarveṣāṃ kadanaṃ mahat ।
saṃjātaṃ ca tadā daivāstuṣitānāmakāśca vai ।।।2।।
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurādidevaṃ pitāmaham ।
tato nivāryośanasaṃ rudraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca śaṃkaram ।।।23।।
dadau bṛhaspataye tu tārāṃ svayaṃ pitāmahaḥ ।
antarvatnīṃ ca tāṃ tārāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha bṛhaspatiḥ ।।।24।।
tāre! candramaso garbhaṃ samutsṛjya tvimaṃ bahiḥ ।
tārā nā'vasṛjattaṃ tu kumāraṃ dasyuhantamam ।।।25।।
tadā bṛhaspatirgarbhākarṣaṇaṃ tvakarotsvayam ।
jātamātraḥ sacetāḥ sa devebhyo'pyatibhāsvaraḥ ।।26।।।
abhāt sa rūpavān sarvadevādhidevasadṛśaḥ ।
taṃ vilokya bṛhaspatirlulobha putrake nave ।।।27।।
mamā'yamiti jagrāha putraḥ prāha na te'smyaham ।
ahaṃ candramasaḥ putro mā māṃ spṛśa bṛhaspate! ।।।28।।
tadānīṃ brahmaṇā putraḥ somāyaiva samarpitaḥ ।
budha ityakaronnāma tasya putrasya candramāḥ ।।29।।
budhasyelākhyapatnyāṃ tu putraḥ pururavā hyabhūt ।
tasya rūpaguṇaudāryaśīlaujaskaparākramān ।।1.79.30।।
nāradenendrabhavane gīyamānānmahāguṇān ।
śrutvaurvaśī manaścakre purūravasamīkṣitum ।।।3 1।।
mitrāvaruṇau tatrā''stāṃ gāyakau tu tayā saha ।
ūrvaśyā tu manastatra mānuṣe saṃgataṃ param ।।32।।
jñātvā tu mitrāvaruṇau prāhaturūrvaśīṃ priyām ।
devau vihāya mānuṣye svairiṇyāścalate manaḥ ।।33।।
tasmātsvargādadho gaccha nareṇa saṃgatā bhava ।
evaṃ śāpāttu drāgeva svargādūrvaśyadhogatā ।।।34।।।
bhūmau tu mārgayāmāsa purūravasameva sā ।
kokilālāpamadhuravīṇayopavane jagau ।।35।।
tādṛśīmūrvaśīṃ tatra rājā purūravastadā ।
uvāca sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāryā mama bhaveti ca ।।।36।।।
sā'pi tatra sakāmā''sīt tatastaṃ pratyabhāṣata ।
bhavatvevaṃ mahārāja! samayaṃ yadi me bhavān ।।37।।
karotu cennivasāmi karomītyabravīnnṛpaḥ ।
ūrvaśī prāha meṣau dvau putrabhūtau matau mama ।।38।।
yāvad rakṣiṣyasi rājaँstāvadvatsyāmi te gṛhe ।
na nagno dṛśyase rājan kāmādanyatra vai kṣaṇe ।।।39।।
nocchiṣṭaṃ me yāvad dadyāstāvadvatsyāmi te'ntike ।
atsyāmi ghṛtamātraṃ vai ramiṣye ca tvayā saha ।।1.79.40।।
evamastviti rājoktvā jagṛhe tatkaraṃ varam ।
vimāne tāṃ samāropyā'lakāyāṃ tu himālaye ।।41।।
vane caitrarathe pṛthvyāṃ saritsu ca sarassu ca ।
antarīkṣe ca merau ca mānase'pi sarovare ।।।42।।
kamalānāṃ vane kundavane ca raivatācale ।
sarasvatītaṭe tadvad reme vardhitarāgataḥ ।।43।।
ekaṣaṣṭiṃ sa varṣāṇi ramamāṇāṃ hyaraṃjayat ।
sāpi svargaṃ tu vismṛtya tasminneva spṛhāvatī ।।44।।
nā'manyata devalokaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca taṃ vinā ।
atha viśvāvasunāmā gandharvastāṃ vinā''kulaḥ ।।।45।।
tāmānetuṃ svargalokādbhūrlokamagamat kṣaṇāt ।
ūrvaśyā saha rājñastu kṛtaṃ vāksamayaṃ tataḥ ।।46।।
viditvā saha gandharvaiḥ saṃyutaśca niśāntare ।
ūrvaśyāḥ śayanābhyāśājjahāroraṇakaṃ javāt ।।47।।
ūrvaśyāhoraṇaḥ kena gṛhyate tyajyatāmayam ।
purūravāstadā śrutvā vastrahīno vicārya vai ।।48।।
māṃ na nagnaṃ nirīkṣeta devīti na yayau tadā ।
jahārā'nyaṃ tu tanmeṣaṃ vilalāporvaśī tadā ।।49।।
anāthāyā mama bālau gṛhyete taskarairaho ।
nāsti me rakṣakaḥ kaścit kaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ naram ।।1.79.50।।
amarṣavaśamāpannaṃ śrutvā tadvacanaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
khaḍgamādāya nirvastro nagno'dhāvattamomaye ।।51।।
ko duṣṭo harate meṣaṃ kuto yāsi sthiro bhava ।
santiṣṭha matpriyāmeṣāvādāya naiva jīvasi ।।।52।।
tāvadvidyullatā dīptā gandhavairjanitā bhṛśam ।
tatprakāśaistadā devī rājānaṃ vigatāmbaram ।।।53।।
dṛṣṭvā samāptasamayā tadgṛhātsā viniryayau ।
tyaktvā meṣau ca gandharvaścitraratho'pi niryayau ।।54।।
rājā meṣau samādāyā'gamatsvaśayanāntikam ।
ūrvaśīṃ tatra nā''lokya babhrāmonmattavadbhuvi ।।55।।
mārgayannūrvaśīṃ bhūmau kurukṣetramavāpa ha ।
ramye sarovare tatra kamalaiḥ sarvatovṛte ।।56।।
caturbhirapsaraḥstrībhiḥ krīḍamānāṃ vilokya saḥ ।
he jāye kvā''gatā cātra snānārthaṃ māṃ vihāya vai ।।27।।
āgaccha madgṛhaṃ tvehi ramasvāti mayā saha ।
tvāṃ vinā naiva jīveyaṃ priye kasmādihā''gatā ।।।28।।
ityevaṃ lapamānaṃ taṃ provācorvaśikā ṛtam ।
rājarājā'lametena cā''graheṇa tava priya! ।।99।।
tvattogarbhiṇyahaṃ varte ratiṃ naiva karomyaham ।
varṣapūrvaṃ bhavānatra cāyātu putralabdhaye ।।1.79.60।।
putrajanmottaramekāṃ rātriṃ vatsyāmi vai tvayā ।
ityukto nṛpatiḥ prāyāt rājadhānīṃ sacintanaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
ūrvaśī varṇayāmāsa patiṃ kṣmeśaṃ susadguṇam ।
uṣitāsmi sahānena rājñā kāmavaśā ciram ।।62।।
śrutvā tadūrvaśīsakhyaḥ sādhu sādhviti cā'bruvan ।
prāhuḥ sarvā vayamapi raṃsyāmo'nena bhūbhṛtā ।।।63।।
athā'bde tatra rājā'pi yayau taṭākasannidhau ।
ūrvaśīṃ putrayuktāṃ vai dṛṣṭvā'tiharṣamāpa saḥ ।।।64।।
āyuṣākhyaṃ suputraṃ sā dadau tasmai yathā punaḥ ।
sakāmā tena sākaṃ tāṃ rātrimekāṃ nināya vai ।।।62।।
pañcaputrapradaṃ garbhaṃ dadhārovāca taṃ punaḥ ।
gandharvebhyo varān rājan gṛhāṇa manasi sthitān ।।66।।
tāvattatrāpi gandharvā dṛṣṭā rājñā'tha cāha tān ।
ahaṃ sampūrṇakośaśca vijitā'rātimaṇḍalaḥ ।।67।।
ūrvaśyā saha vāsena kālaṃ netuṃ sadā vṛṇe ।
gandharvāstatsamākarṇya svargārohaṇakāriṇīm ।।68।।
agnisthālīṃ striyaṃ rājñe daduḥ procurnṛpaṃ tadā ।
agniṃ tredhā vibhajya tvaṃ yajñaṃ kurvanayā saha ।।69।।
tena tvamūrvaśīlokaṃ prāpsyasī nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
agnisthālīṃ gṛhītvā'tha rājā tasmin vane'nayā ।।1.79.70।।
agnisthālyā striyā sākaṃ reme tṛptamanā alam ।
atha stryagre tu yat pātraṃ sthālīrūpaṃ tadā'bhavat ।।71 ।।
rājā cikṣepa tatpātraṃ vane vyarthaṃ viditya hi ।
tāvat sā strīragnivarṇā tūrṇamadṛśyatāṃ gatā ।।।75।।
pātraṃ cāpi tadā'dṛśyaṃ jātaṃ tadavamānataḥ ।
rājā nirāśatāṃ prāptaścāyayau nijamandiram ।।।73।।
kintu kāmapravegena cintayāmāsa tanmuhuḥ ।
aho nārī gatā pātraṃ gataṃ kṣiptaṃ vane mayā ।।74।।
ūrvaśīlokasaṃprāptyai gandharveṇārpitaṃ hi me ।
tadāhariṣye tatpātraṃ vicāryetthaṃ vanaṃ yayau ।।751।।
gatvā hyārādhanāṃ cakre'gnisthālīpātrayormuhuḥ ।
tāvattatrāgnisthālī sā vṛkṣarūpeṇa codgatā ।।76।।
agninārī śamīrūpā pātraṃ sthālī tu pippalaḥ ।
śamīṃ ca pippalaṃ rājā gṛhītvā gṛhamāyayau ।।77।।
tayorviśvāsamāpannaścorvaśīlabdhidāvimau ।
yadvā nārī tathā sthālī punaḥ syātāmimāviti ।।78।।
gṛhe rājā saṃpratarkya nirmamanthobhayaṃ saha ।
adho'raṇīṃ śamīṃ cakre pippalaṃ cottarāraṇīm ।।79।।
gāyavyakṣarasaṃkhyākāṃgulamānāraṇīdvayāt ।
nirmathanāt samutpannaṃ tatrāgnitrayameva tat ।।1.79.80।।
juhāvāgnitrayaṃ rājā yajñe corvaśikāptaye ।
yajñeṣvagniḥ prasanno'bhūdvimānaṃ cānayat divaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tenaiva divyayānena yajñapuṇyapratāpataḥ ।
ūrvaśīlokamāsādya reme rājā tayā saha ।।।82।।
athendrasya sabhāyāṃ tu nṛtyaṃ surāṃganākṛtam ।
rājā vyalokayat tatrorvaśīnṛtyaṃ muhuḥ kṛtam ।।8 3 ।।
nṛtyābhinayasāmarthyagarvayuktorvaśī tadā ।
purūravasaṃ sānnidhye jahāsātīva modataḥ ।।84।।
rājā prasannatāṃ prāpto jahāsāpi nijāṃ puraḥ ।
nāṭyācāryastumburustau vilokya krodhamāpa vai ।।85।।
asaṃkhyadevasadasi nṛtye vai hasanaṃ vṛthā ।
tasmāttu yuvayostāvadviyogo bhavatu drutam ।।86।।
evaṃ śaptau tadendraṃ tau jagmatuḥ śaraṇaॆ tataḥ ।
indraḥ prāha dayāṃ kṛtvā pṛthvyāṃ vai gandhamādane ।।87।।
parvate tu yuvāṃ gatvā tīrthe sādhyāmṛtābhidhe ।
susnānaॆ kurutaṃ tena śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati ।।88।।
sadā yogaśca yuvayoḥ susampanno bhaviṣyati ।
ityevaṃ kṛtavannau tau tato diviṃ vimānagau ।।89।।
remāte pañcaputrāśca tayorāsan mahābalāḥ ।
eko jyeṣṭhatamastvāyurmilitvā ṣaṭ suputrakāḥ ।। 1.79.90 ।।
gandharvaloke viditāḥ-āyuḥ, dhīmān, amāvasuḥ ।
viśvāyuśca, śatāyuśca, gatāyuścorvaśīsutāḥ ।।9 1।।
rājyaॆ cakruḥ prayāge te pratiṣṭhāne subhūtale ।
tadvaॆśe'bhūddhanvantarirbhagavāṃstaṃ vadāmyatha ।।92।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne atreḥ somastasya bṛhaspatipatnītārāyāṃ budhotpattistasya purūravāstasyorvaśyapsarāyāṃ ṣaṭ putrā
ityādipradarśananāmā ekonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।79।।
