adhyāyaḥ 80
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 081 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
yaḥ purūravasaḥ putra āyustasyā'bhavan sutāḥ ।
pañcā''dyastatra nahuṣaḥ, kṣatravṛddho dvitīyakaḥ ।। 1 ।।
rajastatra tṛtīyastu caturtho raṃbhanāmakaḥ ।
pañcamastu-anenā vai, pitṛtulyaparākramāḥ ।। 2 ।।
kṣatravṛddhasya caiko vai sutahotro'bhavat sutaḥ ।
sutahotrasya dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ ।। 3 ।।
kāśyaḥ kuśo gṛtsamado gṛtsamadasya vai sutaḥ ।
śunakastasya sutaḥ śaunakākhyastasya vai sutāḥ ।। 4 ।।
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścaivā'bhavan śubhāḥ ।
kuśātmajo hyārṣṭiṣeṇaścarantastasya cātmajaḥ ।। 5 ।।
śaunakāścārṣṭiṣeṇāśca kṣatropetā dvijātayaḥ ।
kāśyasya kāśistatputro rāṣṭro dīrghatapāstataḥ ।। 6 ।।
dīrghatapaso bhagavān dhanvantariḥ sutaḥ prabhuḥ ।
so'yaṃ kāśīpurīrājo hyāyurvedapravartakaḥ ।। 7 ।।
yasya nāma smarejjantustasya rogo vinaśyati ।
dvitīyo'yaṃ dhanvantariḥ parameśvara eva ha ।। 8 ।।
prāk tu jātaḥ samudre tu mathyamāne'mṛtārthadhṛk ।
sa provāca tadā nārāyaṇaṃ putro'smi te prabho! ।। 9 ।।
vidhatsva bhāgaṃ sthānaṃ ca mama loke'tra me pitaḥ ।
śrīhariḥ prāha taṃ putraṃ dhanvantariṃ samudrajam ।। 1.80.10 ।।
kṛto yajñavibhāgastu yajñiyairhi suraistathā ।
vedeṣu vidhiyuktaṃ ca vidhihotraṃ maharṣibhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
na śakyastu tvayā homaḥ kartuṃ tattulya eva ha ।
arvāk suto'si he deva! nāmamantro'si vai prabho ।। 1 2।।
tasmādidānīṃ te bhāgo naiva yajñe bhaviṣyati ।
kintu dvitīye tvaṃ tatra janmani khyātimeṣyasi ।। 1 3।।।
aṇimādiyutā siddhirgarbhasthasya bhaviṣyati ।
tenaiva ca śarīreṇa devatvaṃ prāpsyasi dhruvam ।। 14।।
carumantrairghṛtairgandhairyakṣyanti tvāṃ dvijātayaḥ ।
atha ca tvaṃ punaścaiva āyurvedaṃ vidhāsyasi ।। 11।।
avaśyaṃbhāvi hyartho'yaṃ prathamastvaṃ tu mānasaḥ ।
samudrajo dvitīyo vai kāśīrājastṛtīyakaḥ ।। 16।।
ityevaṃ trividhaṃ dhanvantareḥ prākaṭyamasti vai ।
dvāpare tatra samprāpte putrārthaṃ tapa ācaran ।। 17।।
dīrghatapā vyapaśyadvai bhagavantaṃ hariṃ puraḥ ।
prasannāsyaṃ praśāntaṃ ca kiṃciddātuṃ samāgatam ।। 18।।
jagād bhagavān dīrghatapasaṃ vṛṇu cepsitam ।
dārghatapāstadovāca prāṃjalirvinayānvitaḥ ।। 19।।
bhagavān yadi tuṣṭastvaṃ putro me dhṛtimān bhava ।
tatheti samanujñāya prabhurantaradhīyata ।।।1.80.2 0 ।।
tasya dehāt samutpanno lakṣmi! dhanvantarirhariḥ ।
kāśīrājo mahārājaḥ sarvarogapraṇāśakaḥ ।।21 ।।
dhanuścihnakaro devo bhagavān lokarakṣakaḥ ।
poṣakaḥ sarvavastūnāṃ jñānado mokṣadastathā ।। 22।।
āyurvedaṃ sa vai devaścakāra sabhiṣakkriyam ।
tamaṣṭadhā punarvyasya śiṣyebhyaḥ pratyapādayat ।।23।।
dhanvantarisutaścāsīt ketumān sumahāyaśāḥ ।
ketumato bhīmaratho divodāsā'parā'bhidhaḥ ।।24।।
divodāso mahānāsīd bhakto viṣṇusamo balī ।
prajāyāṃ vardhitā tena harerbhaktistu sarvathā ।। 25।।
sthito'pi bhagavān śaṃbhurmandaraṃ cārukandaram ।
kāśīṃ vinā sukhaṃ nā''pa divodāsanṛpoṣitām ।।।26।।
bhagavān śaṃkaro devo vaiṣṇavo'styeva sarvathā ।
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃbrahma bhajatyeva samādhinā ।। 27।।
divodāso'pi tu tadvatparamo vaiṣṇavo mataḥ ।
niṣkāsayitvā taṃ bhaktaṃ vāsamaicchattu śaṃkaraḥ ।। 28।।
śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca-
suśikhaivaṃ śaṃkarasya kathāyogaṃ praśāntidam ।
divodāsasya bhaktasya cāpi śrutvā drutaṃ tadā ।।29।।।
lakṣmīḥ papraccha cākarṇya divodāsaṃ trilocanaḥ ।
kāśīṃ saṃtyājayāmāsa kathaṃ tatrā'gamat nagāt ।। 1.80.3 0।।
kiṃ kṛtaṃ tena devena divodāso yadatyagāt ।
kāśīṃ tu rājadhānīṃ svāṃ śrotumicchāmi mādhava! ।। 31 ।।
hāṭakāṃgad! ityevaṃ lakṣmīḥ pṛṣṭvā patiṃ prabhum ।
ekāgramānasā'bhūt tāṃ nārāyaṇa uvāca ha ।।32 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayuga-
santāne dhanvantaryavatāratrayakathananāmā'śītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 80 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 080 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 81
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 082 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pavitrāṃ tāṃ kathāṃ bhaktacamatkarām ।
divodāso mama bhaktastato'pi bhūtarāṭ svayam ।। 1 ।।
paramo mama bhakto vai tiṣṭhatī mandare girau ।
mandareṇa tapastaptaṃ ghoraṃ paramadāruṇam ।। 2 ।।
tapasā'tiprasanno vai mahādevo jagatpatiḥ ।
mandaraṃ prāha bhūbhṛt! te hṛdye kiṃ nu vidyate ।। 3 ।।
prasanno'smi mahādevo vṛṇu sveṣṭaṃ vadāmyaham ।
mandaraḥ prāha deveśa! tava vāsaṃ vṛṇomyaham ।। 4 ।।
tava vāsena me kāyaḥ pavitraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
tīrthamaurdhanyamāpanno mānyatāṃ saṃvrajiṣyati ।। 5 ।।
sarve devarṣimunayo bhavaddarśanamāgatāḥ ।
svapādajaladānena pāvayiṣyanti māṃ sadā ।। 6 ।।
ityabhyarthanamāsādya śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
uvāsa mandaragirau tadā sarve divaukasaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ṛṣayo munayaścātha yakṣarākṣasapārṣadāḥ ।
sarve'pi mandaravāsaṃ cakruḥ śaṃbhusamāśrayāḥ ।। 8 ।।
kāśyāṃ pūrve ca ye hyāsan skandaviṣṇugaṇādhipāḥ ।
sūryo devyastathā cānye tyaktvā kāśīṃ giriṃ gatāḥ ।। 9 ।।
gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu divodāsaḥ pratāpavān ।
cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvandvaṃ prabhorbhaktibharaṃ śubham ।। 1.81.10 ।।
rājadhānī kṛtā rājñā vārāṇasī suniścalā ।
vardhayāmāsa bhaktyā tāṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan ।। 1 1।।
kāśīvāsāstu ye devāḥ svargiṇaḥ sā'psarogaṇāḥ ।
saṃyamena tu hīnāँstān divodāso vyavāsayat ।।12।।
dharmahīnairvratahīnaiḥ saṃyamena tu varjitaiḥ ।
mama kāśyāṃ na vai stheyaṃ devairanyairapi dhruvam ।। 1 3।।
bhagavadbhaktihīnaiśca viśeṣeṇa na vai kṣaṇam ।
sthātavyaṃ ceti rājā vai devādīn nirakāsayan ।।14।।
sūryavat sa pratapitā durhṛdāṃ hṛdi netrayoḥ ।
candravat suhṛdāmāsīt hṛdi manasi netrayoḥ ।। 15।।
śatrugaṇāḥ palāyante dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu dhanurdharam ।
dharmādharmavivektā sa dharmarāja ivā'paraḥ ।। 16।।
indra iva balī caiva pāśīva vairipāśakṛt ।
kuberaiva dhanavān prāṇa iva prajāgrahaḥ ।। 17।।
rājarājaḥ sa evāsīd rudra iva ripuñjayaḥ ।
viśvadevasamo rūpe hyasādhyo vasunā'dhikaḥ ।। 18।।
dasrato rūpamāpanno marutāmapi rodakaḥ ।
sarvavidyādharo gītikuśalo lokatoṣaṇaḥ ।। 19।।
yakṣarākṣasanāgāśca dānavāstaṃ siṣevire ।
guhyakā guptadāsāstu yasya karmakarāḥ saṭā ।।1.81.20 ।।
pavano yasya cāśvānvai parāṃ gatimaśikṣayan ।
dāninastu gajā yasya dānamanyānaśikṣayan ।।21।।
sabhāyāṃ yasya boddhāro yoddhāraśca raṇājire ।
śāstrairyasya vijetā na na śastraiḥ kenacit kvacit ।।22।।
rājye yasya na vai dveṣyāḥ prajāḥ sukhamayāśayāḥ ।
kalāvāneka evā''sījjanāḥ sarve kalālayāḥ ।।23।।
na ko'pyāsīd gotrabhit tadrājye sva eva gotrabhit ।
nāsīt kopi kṣayī tasya rājye svarge kṣayī śaśī ।।24।।
na tadrājye'vagraho'bhūd grahāstu nava vai diti ।
hiraṇyagarbho divyeko hyasya sarve hiraṇmayāḥ ।।25।।
svarge saptāśva eko'styasya janā bahuvājinaḥ ।
svargāpsarogaṇaśreṣṭhā viṣaye'syā'psarāḥ sadā ।।26।।।
ekaiva padmā vaikuṃṭhe'sya vai padmākarāḥ śatam ।
iti duḥkhāni naivā'sya nāsannupadravāḥ kvacit ।।27।।
vasudhā vasudā sarvā dhanahāstu gṛhe gṛhe ।
evaṃ sukhayato rājyaprajā rājño'yutā'ṣṭakam ।।।28।।
śaradāṃ tu gataprāyaṃ tadā śaṃbhurmano dadhe ।
vārāṇasyāṃ nivāsāya pratīkāraṃ cikīrṣati ।।29।।
devā bṛhaspatiṃ prāpya tena cakruśca mantraṇām ।
vayaṃ bhavadyutāḥ syāmo vipatkartāra eva ha ।।1.81.30।।
yadyapi bhūbhṛtā tena devā yajñaiḥ sumānitāḥ ।
tathāpi mānavā naiva mitrāṇi vastuto matāḥ ।।3 1।।
yadyapi tena cāsmākaṃ nāpakṛtyaṃ vidhīyate ।
tathāpi dyusadāṃ rītiḥ parotkarṣā'sahiṣṇutā ।।32।।
divodāsagṛhe rājye nālpo'pyadharmasaṃgrahaḥ ।
nā'sya parābhavo rājñaḥ kartuṃ kenāpi śakyate ।।।33।।
ekapatnīvratāḥ sarve narāstasya ca maṇḍale ।
pātivratyaparā nāryo vidyante cā'sya maṇḍale ।।34।।
tadrājye'vidyavipro na nā'vīro bāhujastathā ।
nā'nudyogo'pi vaiśyo'sti nā'sevākṛt tu śūdrakaḥ ।।35।।
nā'sya rājye brahmacāryabrahmavrataparāyaṇaḥ ।
nā'pyasatkārakṛdasya gārhasthyamapi maṇḍale ।।36।।
nā'pyavanyavṛttikarā vānaprasthāśca niḥspṛhāḥ ।
na cā'saṃgavihīnāstu sanyāsapathagāminaḥ ।।।37।।
evamanye'pi tadrājye nā'vartmagatikā vṛthā ।
nā'napatyo na cā'bhakto nā'dravyaḥ ko'pi tadbhuvi ।।38।।
nā'vṛddhasevī nā'kāṇḍamṛtirnā'drohaketaraḥ ।
na cāṭā naiva vācāṭā na śaṭhā vaṃcakā nahi ।।39।।
na pākhaṇḍā na vai bhaṇḍā na raṇḍā na ca śauṇḍikāḥ ।
tasya rājye tu sarvatra śrutiśāstrādisevanam ।।1.81.40।।
sarvatra śubhakṛdvāṇī madyamāṃsādihīnatā ।
na dyūtadyotakāstatra ṛṇino na na taskarāḥ ।।41।।
pitṛdevādipūjāpi na vicchinnā kadācana ।
na tadrājye vratalopo nā'tīrthasevanaṃ tathā ।।42।।
patipatnyoḥ sadā snehaḥ kuṭumbaṃ kleśakṛnnahi ।
vandyante vandakairvandyāḥ pūjyante pūjakaiḥ parāḥ ।।43।।
ādriyante tu vidvāṃsaḥ prajābhistatra sarvadā ।
vidvadbhiśca tapaḥśreṣṭhāstāpasaiśca jitānnarāḥ ।।44।।
jitāntarairjñānadhanā jñānibhirbrahmavijjanāḥ ।
brahmavidbhiḥ sarvatattvamīkṣyate brahmarūpakam ।।45।।
viprasādhuprasādhvīnāṃ mukhe devānnamarpyate ।
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ jalānyāpūravanti ca ।।46।।
meghā mehanta aiśānyā sasyavastrā mahī sadā ।
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ prajāstasya śucayo'pyubhaye sadā ।।47।।
mārgayanto'pi chidraṃ tadrājye devā manāgapi ।
nāpnuvannatha devāँstān bṛhaspatiruvāca vai ।।48।।
parābhavo vinā chidraṃ naiva bhāvīti sarvathā ।
upāyaṃ bhedamādāyā'chidro'pi paribhūyate ।।49।।
asmatpakṣā api tatra bhavanti sukhasampadaḥ ।
tathāpi bhedakārye tu sāhāyyāḥ syuratanmatāḥ ।।1.81.50 ।।
iti nirṇayamāsādya tadā'syā'ntarbahiścarān ।
vijñāpya dyusadaḥ sarve cāgnidevaṃ vavandire ।।51 ।।
indro'pyagniṃ tadā prāha tvaṃ kāśyāṃ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
mūrtirūpo bhavāँstatra rājate viṣayāt tataḥ ।।52।।
tāmupāsaṃhara kṣipramevaṃ syādvijayastu naḥ ।
mūrtiśūnye yājakāstu havyakavyādivarjitāḥ ।।53।।
viraṃkṣyante nṛpe tatra prajā apyarthaśūnyatām ।
rājaśabdasya cālokya rūḍhiśaktivihīnatām ।।54।।
prajāstatra viraktāḥ syuḥ kṣīṇaṃ kośabalaṃ bhavet ।
rājā'pi kṣīṇavṛttiḥ syāt trivargaḥ kṣīyate svayam ।।55।।
divodāsastathā kṣīṇo naśyatyathavā yāsyati ।
tena cāsmākamevātra kāśyāṃ vāso hyakaṇṭakaḥ ।।।56।।
atiśayākhyadoṣādyasaṃbhinna eva saṃbhavet ।
ityagnirindrakathitamupāgamya hṛdi smaran ।।57।।
mahādevaṃ svakāṃ mūrtimājahāra sthalāt tataḥ ।
āhavanīyāṃ ca gārhapatyāṃ dākṣiṇakāṃ trikam ।।288।।।
jāṭharāgniṃ cāpi tatratyaprajānāṃ jahāra saḥ ।
rājā prajā na vindanti prātarmadhyāhnakarmasu ।।।59।।
kamapyagniṃ tadā sarve karmaṭhāḥ pācakāstathā ।
cintayāmāsurugraṃ vai kiṃ syātkṛtyaṃ vinā'gninā ।।1.81.60 ।।
rājā mādhyāhnikaṃ kṛtvā praviveśa mahānasam ।
vaiśvadevāya bhojyāya yāvadāgatya tiṣṭhati ।।6 1।।
āndhasikā vepamānāḥ kṣudhārtaṃ taṃ vyajijñapan ।
yadi viśrāvayed rājan bhavānabhayadakṣiṇām ।।62।।।
tadā vijñāpayiṣyāmaḥ kimabhūditi tatvataḥ ।
rājñā tathā kṛtādeśāḥ pācakā hyūcire śanaiḥ ।।63।।
na jānīmo vayaṃ nātha kathamagnirapāsarat ।
purāt kṛśānau vigate kathaṃ pātrādi saṃbhavet ।।64।।
sūryapākena yatpakvaṃ tat kiṃcidānayāmahe ।
tāvadrājā vivedaitaddevānāṃ kṛtyameva ha ।।65।।
tapobalādavetyaitadvicāryā'pyavadattadā ।
agnau gate na me hānirdevānāṃ hānireva vai ।।66।।
mayā tebhyo na rājyaṃ vai labdhaṃ labdhaṃ pitāmahāt ।
svātmabalād racayiṣye vāyumagniṃ jalaṃ bhuvam ।।67।।
prakāśaṃ ceti tatsarvaṃ yadyadvā'pekṣyate'tra tat ।
sarvaṃ kariṣye caitanyājjaḍe me na prayojanam ।।68।।
iti cintayatastasyā''yayurjānapadā janāḥ ।
tameva virāvaṃ kartuṃ dvāḥsthenā'ntaḥ praveśitāḥ ।।69।।
datvopadāṃ yathārhaṃ te niṣedurmānadāsane ।
jagadurduḥkhamatyarthaṃ vahniyātrākṛtaṃ tadā ।।1.81.70 ।।
prāha rājā tadāśrutya sarvasya sukhamāvahan ।
cikīrṣurahamevā''saṃ paurāḥ! kāryamidaṃ purā ।।71।।
paraṃ hyupekṣitaprāyaṃ droho na syāditīcchayā ।
gato'nalo'bhavadbhadraṃ prāṇo'pi yātvito drutam ।।72।।
śaśī sūryo varuṇaśca bhūrākāśo'pi yāntvitaḥ ।
bhagavadyogaprābalyādahamagnirbhavāmyaham ।।।73।।
caturdhā vahnirūpeṇa gṛhṇāmi pācayāmi yat ।
ahaṃ prāṇa svayaṃ bhūtvā jīvayiṣyāmi dehinaḥ ।।74।।
mahāvāyuḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā dhārayiṣyāmi golakān ।
śaśī cāhaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvā''pyāyayiṣyeṃ'kuraṃ jagat ।।75 ।।
tāpayiṣye svayaṃ sūryo bhūtvemāṃ medinīṃ sadā ।
megho bhūtvā svayaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ kariṣye varuṇo'pyaham ।।76।।
sthāsyehaṃ jalarūpeṇa bhūrūpo'pi bhavāmi ca ।
dhārayiṣye jagatsarvaṃ vyomarūpo bhavāmi ca ।।77।।
ityuktvā sāntayitvā svaprajā rājā hyabhūt tathā ।
bahurūpaśca saṃbhūya tattatkāryāṇyavartayat ।।78।।
bhagavallabdhayogena hyekopyanekaśo'bhavat ।
tadā divaukasāṃ rājā śalyarūpo babhūva ha ।।79।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya mandaragirau varadānakṛtāvāsaḥ kāśīto devā api tatra gatāḥ divodāsarājye guṇavarṇanaṃ kāśīto divodāsasya niṣkāsanopāyaracanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।8 1।।


← adhyāyaḥ 081 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 82
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 083 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahādevo mandarācalamandire ।
sukhaṃ nā''pa kāśyayogātsarvathopaskarānvite ।। 1 ।।
sukhadomandarastasya sukhamāndyakaro'bhavat ।
lepārthaṃ candanaṃ tasya pāṃsulendhanamābhavat ।। 2 ।।
kaṃkaṇāni mṛṇālāni kaṃkarāṇyabhavaँstadā ।
bhāla candro'bhavattasya virahā'nalacandrakaḥ ।। 3 ।।
kāśīviyogamūrdhanyatāpaśāntikṛte'munā ।
jaṭāghaṭṭadhṛtā gaṃgā na tyaktā rakṣitā balāt ।। 4 ।।
devaiścāpi na vidito virahāgnivadīśvaraḥ ।
dhyānamagno yathāpūrvamāste mandarabhūbhṛti ।। 5 ।।
hyeṣaiva līlā devasya svamūrtyā tapyate prabhuḥ ।
aṣṭamūrtiḥ svayaṃ yo vai tāpayatyakhilaṃ jagat ।। 6 ।।
viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ kaṇṭhagataṃ no tāpayatyamum ।
kāśīvirahatāpastaṃ tāpayatyativardhitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
api śītalacandrakāntajā nanu mālā vidhṛtā tu vakṣasi ।
virahānnavakāśikākṛtād ravikāntabhramamāvahatyasau ।। 8 ।।
yadapāṃgavimokṣaṇodbhavādanalālūlokasukhāvaho'pyayam ।
nanu mānasabhūśca bhasmasādabhavatso'pyanalena tapyate ।। 9 ।।
śrutimārgamabhidruto'pi yo nijabhaktāntarasaukhyasaṃpradaḥ ।
sa hi śāntarayo viyogajānalatapto bhavatīti vaiśasam ।। 1.82.10 ।।
api kāśisugaṃgajānkaṇānabhisaṃgṛhya samāgato'nilaḥ ।
spṛśate yadi māṃ viyoginaṃ parisaukhyaṃ mama jāyate tadā ।। 11 ।।
api kāśisurathyagaṃ rajo yadi cāyātyanilena vāhinā ।
tadapi prabhu syādviyogajaṃ hyasukhaṃ vārayituṃ balādalam ।। 1 2।।
ityevaṃ śokasaṃmagnaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vīkṣya pārvatī ।
patidevaṃ namaskṛtya prāha cāntarakhedahṛt ।। 1 3।।
kathaṃ deva mahādeva jagatāṃ nātha ceśvara ।
hṛdi santapyase lokasantāpahara śaṃkara! ।। 14।।
vāmā vāmasvarūpā te saṃsthitā'smi tavārcane ।
tāpahārāya me nātha kathamuttapyase tvayā ।। 15।।
bhūvāragnyanilākāśacandrasūryātmamūrtika! ।
sākṣā'numopamāśabdārthāpattyaitihyamānavan! ।। 16।।
anupalaṃbhā'saṃbhavaceṣṭāyogajabhānavan! ।
kathaṃ kāśiviyogaste sarvayogin pradharṣati ।। 17।।
sarvāntarātman sarvajña kāśavadbrahmarūpadhṛk ।
triśūlā'gre'sti te kāśī kastāpastatkṛtastvayi ।। 18।।
tathāpi devayogātsā divyā mokṣakarī ca pūḥ ।
na kāladeśavastukṛtparicchedo'tra vartate ।। 19।।
na vivṛttiḥ pariṇāmo na dhvaṃso na mṛṣātmatā ।
na layo na tirobhāvastvadyogāt kāśikā''śavat ।।1.82.20 ।।
divyā divyagaṇopetā divyatīrthā ca pāvanī ।
divyamokṣapradā kāśī gantavyā nātha! sarvathā ।।21।।
naiva kāśīsamaṃ saukhyaṃ naiva kāśīsamā sthitiḥ ।
naiva kāśīsamā śāntiḥ kāśī sarvārthadāyinī ।।22।।
kaṃ sukhamāpyate kā sā śaṃ sukhamīyate'taḥ śī ।
kāśī sukhamayī tasmāt sarvasevyā bhavatyapi ।।23 ।।
kasya vai brahmaṇo vāsādasya viṣṇoḥ samāśrayāt ।
śasya śaṃbhornivāsācca kāśī tridevamūrtikā ।।2।।
kā tu sarasvatī proktā ā tu lakṣmīḥ ramā svayam ।
śī tu devī pārvatī vai kāśī devītrayātmikā ।।।25।।
na mandaro na himavān nodyānāni vanāni ca ।
vaihāyasāni bhūgāni sukhayanti tu kāśivat ।।26।।
na karmadevo nā'dharmo na yāmyo nāpi nākajaḥ ।
kāśīvāsijanaṃ daṇḍayituṃ śakto bhavediha ।।।27।।
vāsanānāṃ kṣayo yatra maraṇānna punarbhavaḥ ।
nivāsātkarmalepo na kadā dṛkṣye nu tāṃ vibho! ।।28।।।
purāṇi santyanekāni nagarāṇyapi vai tathā ।
pade pade smṛddhimanti na kāśīsadṛśāni vai ।।29।।।
satyasthā bhūmayaḥ sarvāḥ kāśītulyā bhavanti na ।
yathā tvāṃ ca tathā māṃ ca bādhate kāśitāpanā ।।1.82.30 ।।
kāśī tāpaharā yādṛṅ na tādṛṅ mama janmabhūḥ ।
tapoyajñeṣṭapūrtyarhādānadharmavratādibhiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
na tathā prāpyate muktiḥ kāśyāṃ tu dehapātanāt ।
na yogasāṃkhyavedāntakarmakāṇḍātmavittibhiḥ ।।32।।
yathā kāśyāṃ dehapātānmuktirbhavati śāśvatī ।
na vedādhyayanād brahmavratādapi gatistathā ।।33।।
na satye cendraloke vā munīnāṃ nilaye'pi na ।
nā'talādau tathā kvāpi sukhaṃ kāśyāṃ tu yādṛśam ।। 34।।
manasā saṃsmṛtya kāśīṃ yogābhyāsaphalaṃ labhet ।
mānavātkhalu tiryaktvaṃ kāśyāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ sadā ।।35।।।
maraṇādeva muktiḥ syājjñānajanmani kiṃ phalam ।
tasmād yāyāṃ yathā kāśyānandāraṇyaṃ tathā kuru ।। 36।।
śaṃbhuruvāca deveśi! jānāsi mama yadvratam ।
abhuktapūrvamanyena vastūpāśnāmi netarat ।।37।।
brahmaṇā nodito divodāso dharmeṇa tāṃ purīm ।
śāsti tatra kathaṃ gamyamanyaśāstari saṃsthite ।।38।।
divodāsaḥ purīṃ kāśīṃ tyaktvā yāyād yathā tathā ।
kartavyameva sammīlya tato vāsaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ।।39।।
adharmiṇastu vighnāni bhaveyurna tu dharmiṇaḥ ।
dharmasthitasya yo vighnamācaret sa vipadyate ।।1.82.40 ।।
vinā chidraṃ kathaṃ dharmayukto hyutsādyate sthalāt ।
na jarā na mahākālo na mṛtyurvyādhayo'śamāḥ ।।4 1 ।।
na vighnā naiva rogāśca na grahā na piśācakāḥ ।
netayo nāpi bhūtāni bādhante dharmasaṃgraham ।।।42।।
tasmātkaṃ preṣayāmīśe! yastaṃ vidrāvayet tataḥ ।
evaṃ cintayataḥ śaṃbhoryoginīmaṇḍalaṃ puraḥ ।।43 ।।
upasthitaṃ tu taccakraṃ prāha vākyamidaṃ haraḥ ।
satvaraṃ yāta yoginyo yatra rājā'tidhārmikaḥ ।।44।।
divodāsa iti khyātaḥ kāśyāṃ dharmeṇa śāstyayam ।
yathā kāśīṃ tyajecchīghraṃ tathā kuruta māyayā ।।45 ।।
ahaṃ tato navīkṛtya purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām ।
sannivatsyāmi tatraiva śīghraṃ sarvaṃ vidhīyatām ।।46 ।।
ityājñāṃ śirasā tāśca gṛhītvā yayurutsukāḥ ।
pravadantyo dhanyatamā vayaṃ devaprasāditāḥ ।।47।।
preṣitāścāpi kāryārthaṃ śrīmadānandakānanam ।
uḍḍīya mandaradroṇyā vyomni kāśyupari sthirāḥ ।।48 ।।
dadṛśurdivyasaudhāḍhyaṃ puraṃ svargamivā'param ।
patākābhistu mārgasthānpānthānāhvayatīva tat ।।49 ।।
śvetamaṇimahājālairnīlaṃ vyomāpi nirmalam ।
sarvaṃ dhavalayattejaḥpravāhaiḥ svargagāmibhiḥ ।।1.82.50 ।।
atha vyomnyeva sarvābhiḥ svarūpāṇāṃ vivartanam ।
vividhaṃ tu kṛtaṃ tāśca vibhinnajñānavartanāḥ ।।।5 1 ।।
vibhinnaveṣā hyabhavan kāśyāṃ sthale sthale striyaḥ ।
avateruśca yoginyaḥ sundaryaḥ kāryasiddhaye ।।52 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mandarācalaguhāyāṃ śaṃbhoḥ kāśīvirahajatāpottaraṃdivodāsasya vighnārthaṃ yoginīcakrapreṣaṇamityādikathananāmā dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।82।।


← adhyāyaḥ 082 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 83
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 084 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
paśya lakṣmi! kiyadveṣā nāryo svārthārthamudyatāḥ ।
bahurūpāṇi kurvanti yāvatsvārthau na siddhyati ।। 1 । ।
yoginītvaṃ parityajya devītvaṃ cā'vaguhya ca ।
kācit saṃnyāsinī kācit tapasvinī tu mānavī ।। 2 ।।
kācit babhūva sairandhrī kācittu bhikṣukī tathā ।
kācittu mālinī kācit nāpitī sūtikā'bhavat ।। 3 ।।
kācidbhiṣagvarārohā kācit tulāsuvikrayā ।
kācicchākavikrayiṇī kācit sarpādirakṣikā ।। 4 ।।
kācittu nartakī jātā kācid dhātrī ca kiṃkarī ।
-aparā gāyikā jātā'nyā vāditrapravādinī ।। 5 ।।
kācit tālakarī cānyā jātā kārmaṇamantradā ।
kācinmālāgumphanajñā kācittailādivikrayā ।। 6 ।।
parā dyūtavidhānajñā itarā gopavallabhā ।
kācinnaṭī ca kācittu rathyācatvaramārjikā ।। 7 ।।
anyā madhvādivyāpārā rathyācīvaramārgaṇā ।
apatyadā'parā jātā śvapacī carmakāriṇī ।। 8 ।।
sādhvī ca karṣukī dugdharasavyāpārahāriṇī ।
tīrthavāsinī cānyā ca muṇḍinī grāmaṭhā'parā ।। 9 ।।
kācid rekhācihnadraṣṭrī kācillekhanacitrikā ।
vaśīkaraṇamantrajñā kācij jvarapramārjikā ।। 1.83.1 0।।
kācidaṃjanakuśalā guṭikāsiddhibodhikā ।
dhātvādimiśrikā kācid vāstrapattrāṇakāriṇī ।। 1 1।।
puṃmohinī bahurūpā vāgagnistaṃbhabodhikā ।
adṛśyatvakhecaratvā'nyākāratvādimantradā ।। 12।।
uccāṭanā''karṣaṇajñā yuvacittavimohinī ।
cintitārthapradā jyotirvijñā'nyā paśurakṣikā ।। 12।।
dantadhāvanadātrī ca gośakṛtsaṃgrahā'ṭinī ।
mṛttikāyāśca vikretrī kācittu nāgarī tathā ।। 14।।
karmacāriṇi dāsī ca bhūtvā bhūtvā pratigṛham ।
prāviśaँstāśca yoginyo'harniśaṃ vicaranti ca ।। 15।।
vighnārthaṃ chidramalpaṃ vā mārgayantyo'pi nā'labhan ।
tatastā etya gaṃgāyāstīre sametya niṣphalāḥ ।। 16।।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ divodāse prajāsu ca ।
chidraṃ no labhyate kiṃcitkathaṃ dūraṃ prakurmahe ।। 17।।।
kāryasiddhiṃ vinā naiva gantavyaṃ svāminaṃ prati ।
saṃmantryeti tatra tasthurna gatā mandarācalam ।। 18।।
prabhoḥ kāryamaniṣpādya preṣyaḥ ko nikaṭe bhavet ।
prabhuṃ vināpi kāśyāṃ vai jīviṣyāmo'tra sarvadā ।। 19।।
prabhū ruṣṭo hared vṛttyaṃ kāśī tvarthacatuṣṭayam ।
tasmātkāśyāṃ pravastavyaṃ gantavyaṃ nahi mandaram ।।1.83.20।।
ityārabhya ca yoginyaḥ kāśyāṃ tiṣṭhanti sarvadā ।
caritvā dikṣu vidikṣu tiṣṭhantyāgatya tatra vai ।।21।।
nārāyaṇaṃ prabhajantyo divodāsaṃ namanti ca ।
ātmanaḥ paramaṃ lābhaṃ manyante sma ca tāḥ sadā ।। 22।
kāśīsevākṛtātpuṇyādīśo'pyasmān sameṣyati ।
kāśīṃ vinā sa tatrāpi duḥkhito'trā''gato bhavet ।।।23।।
iti niścitya yoginyaḥ śaṃbhorānandakānane ।
atiṣṭhan saṃsmarantyastaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram ।।।24।।
tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇvatra kamalālaye! ।
gajāsyā siṃhavaktrā ca gṛdhrāsyā kākatuṇḍikā ।।25।।
uṣṭrāsyāśvakharagrīvā vārāhasyā śivānanā ।
ulūkākṣī ghoraravā māyūrī śarabhānanā ।।26।।
koṭarākṣī cāṣṭavaktrā kubjā ca vikaṭānanā ।
śuṣkodarī lalajjihvā śvadaṃṣṭrā vānarānanā ।।।27।।
ṛkṣākṣī kekarākṣī ca bṛhattuṇḍā surāpriyā ।
kapālahastā raktākṣī śukī śyenī kapotikā ।।28।।
pāśahastā daṇḍahastā pracaṇḍā caṇḍavikramā ।
śiśughnī pāśahantrī ca kālī rudhirapāyinī ।।29।।
vasāpānā garbhabhakṣā śavahastā''ntramālikā ।
ṛkṣakeśī mahākukṣirnāgāsyā pretapṛṣṭhakā ।।1.83.30।।
dandaśūkadharā krauṃcī mṛgaśṛṃgā vṛṣānanā ।
phāṭitāsyā dhūmaśvāsā vyomapādordhvadṛṣṭikā ।।3 1।।
tāpinī śoṣiṇī schaghoṇoṣṭhā koṭarī tathā ।
vidyullolā balākāsyā mārjārī kaṭapūtanā ।।32।।
aṭṭahāsyā ca kāmākṣī mṛgākṣī ceti tā matāḥ ।
catuḥṣaṣṭistu yoginyaḥ pūjitā navarātrake ।।33।।
duṣṭabādhāṃ nāśayanti garbhabālādirakṣikāḥ ।
na ḍākinyo na śākinyo na kūṣmāṇḍā na rākṣasāḥ ।।34।।
tasya pīḍāṃ prakurvanti nāmānyetāni yaḥ paṭhet ।
raṇe rājakule vāpi vivāde jayadānyapi ।।35।।
balipūjopahāraiśca dhūpadīpasamarpaṇaiḥ ।
kṣipraṃ prasannā yoginyo prayaccheyurmanorathān ।।36।।।
kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrātrāvupavāsī narottamaḥ ।
praṇavādicaturthyantanāmabhirhavanaṃ caret ।।37।।
pratyekaṃ havanaṃ cāsāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ matam ।
sasarpiṣā guggulunā laghubadaramānataḥ ।।38।।
ekāgramanasā śuddhaḥ sveṣṭaṃ vicintya sarvathā ।
yāṃ yāṃ siddhimabhīpsetāṃ tāṃ suprāpnoti mānavaḥ ।।39।।
atheśo yoginīcakre'nāgate ciramityapi ।
sūryaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa jñātuṃ kāśīpravartanam ।।1.83.40 ।।
prāha śaṃbhustu sūryaṃ vai divodāsasya vai rave! ।
dharmakṣatyā nivāsaḥ syāttathā kuru divākara! ।।41 ।।
dharmamārgasthitasyātra bhaktasya yo'vamānanam ।
karoti tasya sarvasvanāśo bhavati bhāskara! ।।।42।।
yāvaddharme sthirā buddhiryāvadbhaktiśca mādhave ।
tāvadvighnodayo nāsti tathāpi kuru ceṣṭitam ।।43।।
raviḥ śaṃbhorvacasā cā'gamatkāśyāṃ manuṣyavat ।
antarbahiścarankāśyāṃ divodāse prajāsu ca ।।44।।
dharmabhaktipravāhe tu manāk kṣatiṃ na caikṣata ।
vatsaraṃ vicaransūryo'tithirbhūtvā''rthayacca tam ।।49।।
sarvaṃ saṃprāptavān paścād bahurūpāṇyadhārayat ।
yācako bahudo dīno gaṇako mantrado'pyabhūt ।।46।।
kadācinnāstiko dhūrto jaṭilaśca digambaraḥ ।
jāṃgaliko viṣavaidyaḥ pākhaṇḍī brahmavādyapi ।।47।।
vratakṛdaindrajālajñaḥ kathākāraḥ kapāladhṛk ।
dvijo jñānī dhātuvettā khagolajñaḥ sumantravit ।।48।।
sādhuḥ sanyāsadharmā vai sanyāsinīsvarūpadhṛk ।
vipraḥ kṣatriyavaiśyau ca śūdro brahmacaro gṛhī ।।49।।
vanasthaḥ saṃkararūpo'thāpi cāṇḍālarūpadhṛk ।
ityevaṃ vicaran kāśyāṃ kvāpi chidraṃ na cāpa saḥ ।।1.83.50।।
tadāhyakṛtakāryo'sau gantuṃ tu mandara punaḥ ।
neyeṣā'vamānabhayād divodāsabalāttathā ।।51।।
kāśyāmeva kṛtāvāso bhaktilagnahṛdantaraḥ ।
anivedanajanyainonāśo bhaktyā bhaviṣyati ।।52।।
dharmo hi rakṣito yena sarvaṃ tena tu rakṣitam ।
ayameva hi saddharmaḥ kāśīsevanasaṃbhavaḥ ।।53।।
putramitrakalatrāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca dhanāni ca ।
pratijanmeha labhyante kāśyekā naiva labhyate ।।54।।
divodāsasamo bhakto naivā'nyatra kvacinmilet ।
tasmādatraiva vastavyaṃ niścityaivaṃ divākaraḥ ।।।55।।
bhūtvā dvādaśarūpo'sau kāśīpuryāṃ vyavasthitaḥ ।
lokārka uttarārkaśca sāmbādityaḥ khakholakaḥ ।।56।।
drupadādityo mayūkhā''dityastathā'ruṇā''hvayaḥ ।
vṛddhārkaḥ keśavārkaśca vimalārko yamāhvayaḥ ।।57।।
gaṃgādityau dvādaśetirūpaiḥ kāśyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ ।।
bhajate śrīhariṃ nityaṃ divodāsasamāgame ।।58।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne divodāsachidrānveṣaṇāya catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīnāṃ rūpāntaradhṛtiḥ kāśyāmeva vāso raveścāpi tathaiva tatkāryārthamāgamanaṃ kāśyāmeva dvādaśarūpairvāsaścetyādipradarśananāmā tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।83।।


← adhyāyaḥ 083 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 84
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 085 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
lakṣmi! devo mahādevo yaṃ yaṃ preṣayati prabhum ।
sa saḥ punarna cāyāti cintāmagno haro'bhavat ।। 1 ।।
nādyāpyāyānti yoginyo nādyāpyāyāti bhāskaraḥ ।
kāśyāṃ vāso na vai syāccet! kālo yāsyati kena me ।। 2 ।।
adhākṣiṣamahaṃ kāmaṃ kāmo māṃ dunuyāttarām ।
kāśīpravṛttimanveṣṭuṃ kaṃ vā prahiṇuyāmitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
iti cintya vidhātāraṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram ।
śivaḥ provāca yoginyaḥ sūryaśca preṣitā mayā ।। 4 ।।
nādyāpi te nivartante kāśyā vijñāya vartanam ।
nābādhiṣṭa tathā kṣveḍaṃ māṃ kāśīviraho yathā ।। 5 ।।
vidhe vidhehi me kāryaṃ yāhi kāśīṃ yatasva ca ।
adyaiva ca mayā satyā gantavyaṃ kintu dhārmikam ।। 6 ।।
divodāsaṃ tu rājānamullaṃghayituṃ notsahe ।
nānyarājye pravastavyaṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ bhojyameva ca ।। 7 ।।
svastimān gaccha panthāste śubhodarko bhavatvalam ।
ādāyā''jñāṃ vidhirdrāgvai kāśīmāyād vihāyasā ।। 8 ।।
haṃsastho'paśyadānandavāṭikāṃ kāśikāṃ śubhām ।
gaṃgā vṛkṣā janāḥ saudhā yatrā''nandamayāḥ sadā ।। 9 ।।
kāśibhūrālocitā yairindriyaistāni santi vai ।
varāṇi tṛṇadhānyāni kāśyāṃ yāni patanti hi ।। 1.84.1 0।।
adya me saphalaṃ cāyuraho me bhāgyagauravam ।
adya me phalito vṛkṣo deho yatkāśidarśanam ।। 11 ।।
mayā sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā sarvā bahudākṣyapuraḥsarā ।
paramanyādṛśī kāśī devena nirmitā svayam ।। 1 2।।
iti hṛṣṭamanā vedhā vṛddhabrāhmaṇaveṣadhṛk ।
avatīrya kṣitau haṃsād divodāsaṃ dadarśa ha ।। 1 3।।
rājñā saṃmānito vṛddhabrāhmaṇaḥ satkṛtastathā ।
upaviśyāsane ramye cāśīrvādān dadau nṛpam ।। 14।।
kośavṛddhiḥ satyadravye'saukhyavṛddhiḥ samāntare ।
gativṛddhiḥ satyamārge kāśavṛddhistavāntare ।। 15।।
rājā prāha kathaṃ dvyarthaṃ bhāṣase vṛddhabhūsura! ।
dharmabhaktyoryatra vṛddhistatra vṛddhiḥ satī sadā ।। 16 ।।
adravye ca amārge ca sati vṛddhirbhayapradā ।
adravye satyaṇḍavṛddhiramārge sati dhāvanam ।। 17।।
varṣāntare hyasaukhyaṃ tu dhārmikasya na saṃbhavet ।
adhārmikasyā''ntare tu asaukhyaṃ sadṛśaṃ bhavet ।। 18।।
stutau prakāśavṛddhiḥ syādantare nānyathā'vile ।
kimicchasi vṛddhavipra! dravyahīnaḥ kumārgagaḥ ।। 19।।
hṛdi me kiṃ daṃbhavṛddhirvarṣapūrvaṃ ca duḥkhabhāk ।
bhavāmyahaṃ divodāsaḥ itīcchasi kimīcchasi ।।।1.84.20।।
kāśyāḥ palāyanaṃ me syāditīcchasi kimicchasi ।
kūṭavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ kūṭaveṣadhṛk ।।21।।
kūṭadharmo bhavettatra kūṭāśīrvādavān bhava ।
brahmā prāhātra kūṭaṃ ca kāpaṭyaṃ śṛṃgagauravam ।।22।।।
śreṣavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ śreṣṭhaveṣadhṛk ।
śreṣṭhadharmo bhavettatra śreṣṭhāśīrvādavānaham ।।23।।
kāpaṭyaṃ yadi śāṭhyaṃ vai tadā tādṛṅ na cā'nyathā ।
śāṭhyavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ śāṭhyaveṣadhṛk ।।।24।।
śāṭhyadharmo bhavettatra śāṭhyāśīrvādavān bhavet ।
rājā prāha tadā vipraṃ brahmāṇaṃ kūṭadharmakam ।।।25।।
yadyevaṃ dharmamūrtistvaṃ kathaṃ śāṭhye pravartase ।
śāṭhye parājayo bhāvyaḥ śāṭhyapādaḥ patatyadhaḥ ।।26।।
ehi vipra! svāgataṃ te karomyaśāṭhyadharmataḥ ।
pādyaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ gāṃgajalaṃ peyaṃ prasādhanam ।।27।।
sarvaṃ gṛhāṇa viprendra! vṛṇu yad hṛdi vartate ।
brahmovāca gṛhītaṃ tat bhaktyā pravardhase nṛpa! ।।28।।
vidyayā satyabodhinyā jayase dharmaṇā nṛpa! ।
rājāno bahavo dṛṣṭā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ ।।29।।
śrotriyā nītinipuṇāḥ sattvaśīlā jitendriyāḥ ।
kṣamādayāsugāṃbhīryadākṣiṇyasaumyabhūmayaḥ ।। 1.84.30।।
paraṃ tebhyastvayi rājan guṇā dvitrā viśeṣataḥ ।
prajā eva kuṭumbaṃ te brāhmaṇā eva daivatam ।।3 1।।
bhaktidharmau sahāyau te tapasvināṃ sahāyakaḥ ।
ete nānyeṣu dṛśyante dhanyo mānyo'si vai satām ।।32।।
sadguṇaiḥ pūjanīyo'si bhaktyā dharmeṇa vardhase ।
devā drohaṃ ca te kartumapi bibhyati dhārmika! ।।।33।।
ahaṃ tu brāhmaṇo rājan yajñān kartumihāgataḥ ।
tvādṛśaṃ bhaktamāsādya mama vāso'tra bhūyatām ।।34।।
anyattu mantritaṃ dūraṃ tatsadā dūramastu vai ।
atra tīrthatrayaṃ rājan! tvaṃ gaṃgā bhūḥ parātparam ।।35 ।।
yatra kṛtānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ saṃvarte'pi na saṃkṣayaḥ ।
saṃcitaṃ yaddhanaṃ yatnād viniyujyeta tanmakhe ।।36।।
iti joṣaṃ sthitaṃ vipraṃ divodāsa uvāca ha ।
hariṃ yiyakṣamāṇasya tava dāso'smi sarvathā ।।37।।
kośād gṛhāṇa me yajñasaṃbhārān samapekṣitān ।
svāmyamātyasuhṛtkośarāṣṭradurgasusainyakam ।।38।।
viniyuṃkṣvā''vaśyakaṃ tatsvārthaṃ tanna manāgapi ।
putraiḥ kalatrairdehena rājā prajāstu raṃjayet ।।39।।
prajāsantāpajo vahnirvajrādapi bhayaṃkaraḥ ।
dvitrān vināśayed vajraṃ tāpo rājyaṃ kulaṃ tanum ।।1.84.40।।
viprapādarajobhistu karomyavabhṛthaṃ sadā ।
viprānane prahutaṃ tanmanye yajñādviśiṣṭakam ।।41।।
ekaivādyāpi jāgarti samīhā brāhmaṇakṛte ।
svadeho'pi tadarthaṃ vai cārpaṇāt saphalo bhavet ।।42।।
adya me saphalaṃ jayema kuru yajñān sudakṣiṇān।
yaja devān kṛtaṃ viddhi sāhāyyaṃ sarvavastubhiḥ ।।।43।।
śrutvā rājño vaco viprabrahmā saṃbhāramāharat ।
iyāja daśabhirgaṃgātīre'śvamedhayajñakaiḥ ।।44।।
yatra sthale ca tattīrthaṃ pūrvāṃ rudrasaro'bhidhām ।
tyaktvā daśāśvamedhākhyāmāpede viśrutaṃ tathā ।।45।।
divodāsasya bhaktasya chidraṃ nā'vāpa kiṃcana ।
kiṃ vadenmandaraṃ gatvā śaṃbhoragre tu viśvasṛk ।।46।।
ato daśāśvamedheśaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ tathā ।
svakāṃ mūrtiṃ ca saṃsthāpya vidhistatraiva cā'vasat ।।47।।
divodāsasya satsaṃgād harerbhakto'bhavat sadā ।
satyaloke ca vairāje vaiṣṇave śāṃbhave pade ।।48।।
mokṣākhyaṃ yadbhavetsaukhyaṃ tadvai kāśiniṣevaṇāt ।
jyeṣṭhaśuklapratipadi snātvā mucyeta bandhanāt ।।49।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam ।
saṃdhyā devārcanaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tatrā'kṣayaṃ bhavet ।।1.84.50 ।।
snātvā daśaharāyāṃ ca liṃgaṃ sampūjya cā''pnuyāt ।
puṇyaṃ daśāśvamedhīyaṃ na punargarbhamāviśet ।।51 ।।
brahmā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa sthito yāvacchivāgamaḥ ।
brahmaṇe tu divodāso brahmaśālāmakārayat ।।52।।
ahalyayā kṛtā tatra brahmapurī suśobhitā ।
ityeṣā bhūḥ sadā brāhmī brahmalokapradāyinī ।।53 ।।
divodāso mahābhaktaḥ kīdṛśo me'bhavat priye! ।
yasya brahmādayo devāḥ pratikartuṃ na cā'śakan ।।54।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne mandarācalataḥ śaṃbhupreṣitabrahmā'pi viprarūpeṇa kūṭaślokadvārā''śīrvādān dadau, tatsaṃvādottaraṃ daśāśva-
medhayajñān kṛtvā kāśyāmevovāsetyādikathananāmā caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।84।।


← adhyāyaḥ 084 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 85
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 086 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahādevi! mandare nivasan haraḥ ।
śuśoca bahudhā tatra gatā nāyānti vai punaḥ ।। 1 ।।
kiṃ vai kāśyāṃ sthitāste vā'kṛtakāryā hataujasaḥ ।
nāyānti yoginīsūryavedhasaḥ prahiṇomi kān ।। 2 ।।
cintayanniti deveśo gaṇānāhūya bhūriśaḥ ।
preṣayāmāsa bho yāta kāśīṃ vivasituṃ drutam ।। 3 ।।
śaṃkukarṇaṃ mahākālaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ mahodaram ।
nandiṣeṇaṃ somanandikālapiṃgalakukkuṭān ।। 4 ।।
kuṇḍodaraṃ mayūrākṣaṃ bāṇagokarṇatārakān ।
tilaparṇaṃ sthūlakarṇaṃ dṛmicaṇḍaṃ prabhāmayam ।। 5 ।।
sukeśaṃ vindatiṃ chāgaṃ kapardipiṃgalākṣakau ।
vīrabhadraṃ kirātaṃ ca caturmukhaṃ nikuṃbhakam ।। 6 ।।
paṃcākṣaṃ bhārabhūtaṃ ca kṣemakaṃ lāṃgaliṃ tathā ।
tryakṣaṃ virādhaṃ sumukhamāṣāḍhiṃ skandameva ca ।। 7 ।।
mahāśākhaṃ viśākhaṃ ca śākhaṃ nandinameva ca ।
bhṛṃgiṇaṃ naigameyaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ।। 8 ।।
ete gaṇā mahābhāgāḥ svāmibhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ ।
kṛtvā māyāṃ bahuvidhāṃ bahurūpā vicakṣaṇāḥ ।। 9 ।।
animeṣakṣaṇāstasthuḥ kṣoṇīśacchidrakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।
dharme satye dayāyāṃ ca daṇḍe prajāprapālane ।। 1.85.1 0।।
rakṣaṇe dānadharme ca rājyadharme śrutau smṛtau ।
varṇāśramavipaddharmadeśakālādidharmasu ।। 11 ।।
pañcayajñajapabhaktisevāsatkāravṛttiṣu ।
kvāpi kutrāpyalabdhvā vai kṣatiṃ truṭiṃ sacchidratām ।। 1 2।।
rājānaṃ cā'parābhavyaṃ divodāsaṃ prapūjya ca ।
sarve gaṇā asiddhasvasvāmikāryāḥ sulajjitāḥ ।। 13 ।।
svasvanāmnā mahādevaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nirantaram ।
kāśyāmeva nivāsān svān cakrire vigatajvarāḥ ।। 14।।
na nivṛttā mandaraṃ te kāśīmāhātmyabodhanāt ।
vārāṇasī na vai tyājyā svargādapi garīyasī ।। 15।।
ānandodyānasaṃlabdhasukhatulyaṃ na cetarat ।
atra kailāsa evāsti vaikuṇṭho'pyatra vidyate ।। 16।।
kārśīṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ kāryā śuṣkā mandarasaṃsthitiḥ ।
vārāṇasīti kāśīti ānandodyāna ityapi ।। 17।।
mukhena yena saṃproktaṃ nāsti tasya yamādbhayam ।
pañcakrośyā parimitā tanustridevasaṃbhavā ।। 18।।
anākalitapuṇyānāṃ parikṣīṇadhanāyuṣām ।
sarvopāyavihīnānāṃ gatirvārāṇasī purī ।। 1 9।।
kāśyāṃ vasanti ye dhīrā āpaṃcatvaviniścayāḥ ।
jīvanmuktāstu te jñeyā vandyā pūjyāsta eva ha ।। 1.85.20 ।।
yatra kāśyāṃ mṛto janturbrahmanārāyaṇādibhiḥ ।
prabaddhamūrdhāñjalibhirnamasyetā'tiyatnataḥ ।। 21 ।।
maraṇaṃ maṃgalaṃ yatra vibhūtiryatra bhūṣaṇam ।
kaupīnaṃ yatra kauśeyaṃ kāśī kutropamīyate ।।22 ।।
apāsya sodarāndārānputraṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ vasu ।
apyaṃgīkṛtya nidhanaṃ vastavyamatra caiva ha ।।23 ।।
iti te nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā kāśyāmeva vyavasthitāḥ ।
atha śaṃbhurgatānkāśyāṃ sthitānpunaranāgatān ।। 24।।
gaṇān jñātvā ca herambaṃ prāhiṇottu gajānanam ।
gaccha putra vinā tvāṃ vai kaścinna pārayennṛpam ।। 25।।
yathābuddhi yathākālaṃ yathāyogyaṃ prakalpya ca ।
divodāsaṃ viniṣkāsya kāśīṃ karagatāṃ kuru ।।26 ।।
tatra sthitopi saṃsiddhyai yatasva sahito gaṇaiḥ ।
nirvighnaṃ kuru cāsmākaṃ nṛpe vighnaṃ samācara ।।27।।।
ājñāmādāya śirasā praṇipatya ca dhūrjaṭim ।
pratasthe tvaritaḥ kāśīṃ gaṇeśaḥ pitṛsiddhaye ।।।28 ।।
śaṃbhoḥ kāśyāgamopāyaṃ cintayanvāḍavo'bhavat ।
sthūlaveṣṭanapaṃcāṃgapatradhṛk śakunaṃ diśan ।। 29 ।।
nakṣatrajño mahājyotiścakravettā''viśatpurīm ।
cacāra pratyavarodhaṃ sthavīro rekhayā diśan ।। 1.85.30 ।।
hastarekhāṃ śakunāni bhāgyaṃ janmākṣarāṇi ca ।
sudṛṣṭvā gaṇitaṃ kṛtvā paurāṇāṃ prītimānabhūt ।। 31 ।।
svayameva niśāyāṃ tu svapnaṃ sadarśayannṛṇām ।
prātasteṣāṃ gṛhaṃ gatvā teṣāṃ vakti śubhā'śubham ।। 3 2।।
praśnān saṃkārayitvā tān phalaṃ svāpnaṃ jagāda tān ।
svapne rātrau bhavān majjan jale majjan taṭaṃ gataḥ ।। 33 ।।
taṭasthakardame magnaḥ punarmagno'si bhūriśaḥ ।
svapnasyā'sya phalaṃ duṣṭaṃ jale ghāto bhavettava ।। 34।।
anyasyāpi gṛhe gatvā phalaṃ svāpnaṃ hyavarṇayat ।
muṇḍī kāśāmbaradharaḥ praikṣi svapne tvayā tataḥ ।। 35 ।।
maraṇatulyaduḥkhaṃ vā maraṇaṃ vā phalaṃ bhavet ।
svapne sūryagraho dṛṣṭo mṛtirvā tatsamaṃ phalam ।। 36 ।।
aindraṃ dhanurdvayaṃ rātrau yadaloki dhruvā matiḥ ।
paścimāyāṃ svayaṃ sūrya udayaṃ prāpya śītagum ।। 37।।
prodyantaṃ vyomamārgādvai pātayāmāsa bhūtale ।
iti svapne tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ rājyanāśo bhaved dhruvam ।।38।।
dhūmaketudvayaṃ yudhyamānaṃ vyomni vyaloki - yat ।
taccāpi rāṣṭrabhaṃgāya phalaṃ svāpnaṃ vināśakṛt ।।39।।
viśīrya tvekadaśanaṃ nīyamānaṃ ca dakṣiṇe ।
ātmānaṃ yat samadrākṣīḥ mṛtiḥ kuṭumbabhīṣaṇā ।।1.85.40।।
tvayaikṣatā'pararātrau prāsādadhvajabhaṃjanam ।
rājyakṣayakaraṃ caitanmahotpātaḥ prajāsu ca ।।41।।
samudreṇa puraṃ caitatplāvitaṃ yadadarśi tat ।
dvimāsā'bhyantare eva mahānāśaḥ puraukasām ।।42।।
svapne vānarayānena tvaṃ prayāto'si dakṣiṇām ।
atastava vināśo vā puratyāgo'thavā dhruvaḥ ।।43।।
rudatī yā tvayā dṛṣṭā nārī rātrau digambarā ।
muktakeśī vyomagā'bhūt phalaṃ rājyaviparyayaḥ ।।44।।
devālayasya kalaśaḥ patan dṛṣṭastvayā yataḥ ।
drāk svalpairdivasaireva rājyabhaṃgo bhaved dhruvam ।।45।।
purīṃ parita āgatya mṛgāḥ śivādayo muhuḥ ।
rorūyamāṇā dṛśyante tanmāse nodvasīṃ kriyāt ।।46।।
ghūkaśyenabakagṛdhrā uḍḍayantyabhitaḥ purīm ।
sūcayanti mahākaṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyatyatravāsinām ।।47।।
gadāmādāya hanumān pṛṣṭhe lagno dhruvaṃ kṣayaḥ ।
yamadūtāḥ pradṛśyante mahiṣā'naḥparasthitāḥ ।।48।।
prajāmādāya gacchanti prajānāśo bhaved dhruvaḥ ।
pararājyabhaṭaścātra''gatyemān tāḍayanti tat ।।49।।
phalaṃ kāśīparibhaṃgo lokānāṃ kadanaṃ bhavet ।
tasmānmāsāntare eva gantavyamitaratra vai ।।1.85.50 ।।
nātra vāso hi sukhado bhavenmāsadvayottaram ।
evaṃ nirvāsayāmāsa śaṃsanbahūn prajājanān ।।51।।
prāyaśo'rdhaṃ prajāyāstu gataṃ deśāntaraṃ prati ।
athāpi grahacāraṃ vai vilokyāha janānpunaḥ ।।52 ।।
ekarāśau sthitāḥ śukraśanirbhaumā vināśakāḥ ।
dhūmaketurayaṃ vyomni bhittvā saptarṣimaṇḍalam ।।53 ।।
saṃyāti paścimāmāśāṃ vaiśyānāṃ nāśako bhavet ।
śaniścaraḥ samullaṃghya rāśiṃ vakraḥ prayāti vai ।।।54।।
rāhuketubhaumayukto mahāvināśakṛddhi saḥ ।
sāyaṃkāle tu bhūkampo'vaśyaṃ nāśakaro bhavet ।।55।।
utarāddakṣiṇāṃ yātā vyomnyulkā garjanākarī ।
līnā cāpi tu saivā'syāḥ sūcayatyeva nāśanam ।।56।।
catvarasthacaityavṛkṣo vātenonmūlito'pi saḥ ।
sūcayatyeva kāśyāśca prajānāṃ kadanaṃ mahat ।।।57।।
prātaḥ sūryodaye prācyāṃ kāko vakti bhayaṃ bhavet ।
kāśīmadhye mṛgau kaucidāraṇyakau praviśya ca ।।58।।
janadṛṣṭiṃ pravicyāvya gatāvudvāsasūcakau ।
śaradi dṛśyate cāmraśālapuṣpaṃ phalāṃkuram ।
mahākālabhayaṃ manye puryāmasyāmakālajam ।।59।।।
sādhvasaṃ janayitveti gaṇeśena dvijena vai ।
uccāṭitā dhanāḍhyāśca bhūmanto'pi kuṭumbinaḥ ।।1.85.60।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
śaṃkareṇa dvicatvāriṃśadgaṇānāṃ preṣaṇaṃ gaṇeśapreṣaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ
tena ca vividhasvāpnapratyakṣādiśakunotpātādivarṇanena
prajānāṃ kāśīto niṣkāsanaṃ kṛtamitivarṇananāmā
pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 85 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 085 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 86
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 087 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tadā strīṇāṃ viśvāsāya samādhinā ।
prāgudantaṃ parijñāya gaṇeśo'ntaḥpuraṃ hyagāt ।। 1 ।।
dṛṣṭārthameva kathayan strīṇāṃ viśvāsabhūrabhūt ।
yadyatpūrvaṃ tu sajjātaṃ tat sarvaṃ kathayatyayam ।। 2 ।।
ekāmāsādya saṃprāha putrāṇāṃ navatistrayam ।
tava jajñe teṣu caiko'śvātpatito mamāra ca ।। 3 ।।
sagarbheyaṃ śubhāṃ kanyāṃ janayiṣyati bhāgyataḥ ।
adyāpi yāvaddurbhāgyā sāmprataṃ subhagā tviyam ।। 4 ।।
rājñā yasyai pradatto'yaṃ muktāhāraḥ suśobhanaḥ ।
seyaṃ rājñiṣu mānyā vai bhavatīvāti jīvavat। ।। 5 ।।
imāṃ rājā'timanute bahusnehāspadāṃ muhuḥ ।
dvau grāmau tu prasādena cāsyai dātumudīritau ।। 6 ।।
anyāṃ rājñīṃ tataḥ prāha kumāro yadi jāyate ।
tadā tubhyaṃ pradāsye vai daśagrāmāँstu vṛttaye ।। 7 ।।
iti rājñā pratijñātaṃ śayyāyāṃ tava sannidhau ।
aparāṃ tu tadā prāha yadi tvaṃ syāḥ suputrakā ।। 8 ।।
ardhaṃ rājyaṃ pradāsye tvāṃ, suputrāyai tato'vadat ।
anyasyai premasamaye rājā prāha madarthakam ।। 9 ।।
tāmbūlaṃ yad rakṣitaṃ tad dehi dāsye puratrayam ।
ityevaṃ pratyakṣajātaṃ samuvāca gaṇādhipaḥ ।। 1 0।।
svapnānapyāha tāsāṃ vai tena viśvāsabhūrabhūt ।
varṇayanti ca rājñyo'sya parokṣe ca guṇān bahūn ।। 1 1।।
aho kaścit sthavīro vai vipraḥ satyavivecanaḥ ।
prāgudantaṃ yathārthaṃ vai vakti sarva pramāṇataḥ ।। 12।।
alolupaḥ sadācāraḥ santuṣṭo bhūtabhāvidṛk ।
prasannāsyaḥ śuciḥ śāstraśrutismṛtiviśāradaḥ ।। 13।।
yadyad vakti jyotiṣā saḥ sarvaṃ satyaṃ pravartate ।
nānyādṛśaḥ svapnavaktā sākṣādvaktā ca dṛggataḥ ।। 14।।
divodāsasya paṭṭāṃgī rājñī līlāvatī svayam ।
prāha rājñe mahārāja vipro brahmasamo nidhiḥ ।। 15।।
kāśyāṃ kaścit samāyāto draṣṭavyo grahabodhane ।
kā daśā kīdṛśaṃ svapnaṃ kaḥ kālaḥ śakunaṃ kimu ।। 16।।
vetti sarvaṃ tadasmādvai praṣṭavyaṃ kiṃ ca bhāvi vai ।
ityākarṇya tadā rājñā hyākārito gaṇādhipaḥ ।। 17।।
samājagāma rājarṣiṃ labdhavān satkṛtiṃ tataḥ ।
samupaviṣṭoviṣṭare hyāśīrbhirabhyanandayat ।। 18।।
kṣemaṃ te kuśalaṃ cāstu śreyo'bhyudaya ityapi ।
śivo dharmo'stu te saudhe tava vāso harergṛhe ।। 19।।
samākarṇya ca rājā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prāha bho dvija! ।
prāptaṃ saṃrakṣitaṃ kṣemaṃ kau pṛthvyāṃ śaṃ sukhāvaham ।।20 ।।
tatsarvaṃ laṃ layaṃ yāyāditi te'sti manorathaḥ ।
mama śreyo'bhyudayaśca śivo śivārthamastviti ।।21।।
abhyudayaḥ śivo yo vai so'pyadharmo bhavatviti ।
mama saudhe śivarājyaṃ mama muktirharāviti ।।22।।
asmātsthānādvināśo me kimicchasi dvijottama ।
divodāsasya sārvajñyaṃ jñātvā''ścaryamavāpa saḥ ।।23।।
saṃgṛhyā'rhāṃ gaṇeśastu svasthānaṃ saṃjagāma ha ।
rājā rājñīṃ tadā prāha vipro'styayaṃ trikāladṛk ।।24।।
prajā yāntyanyaviṣayaṃ svapnaṃ bhāti bhayāvaham ।
udghoṣaḥ śrūyate bhāvivināśonmukhatā sthitā ।।25।।
prātarāhūya praṣṭavyaḥ kiṃ bhaviṣyaditi sphuṭam ।
manye devo viruddho me śaṃkaro'pyastyaśaṃkaraḥ ।।26।।
yadbhāvi tadbhavedeva nārāyaṇasamicchayā ।
prātarāhūya satkṛtya rājā papraccha hṛdgatam ।।27।।
śāsiteyaṃ mahīṃ sarvāṃ bhuktā bhogā vibhūtayaḥ ।
rājyaprajā hyatandriṇā prapālitāḥ svajīvavat ।।28।।
dvijasevā kṛtā pūrṇā nā'pūrṇaṃ me'vaśiṣyate ।
prajāpalāyanaṃ svāpnaduṣṭatāṃ tu vilokya vai ।।29।।
kiṃbhāvīti pramugdho'haṃ dṛṣṭvā tathyaṃ nivedaya ।
gaṇeśaḥ prāha rājānaḥ prāyaḥ karṇaprasādanāḥ ।।30।।
miṣṭaṃ miṣṭaṃ tu śṛṇvanti daṇḍayanti kaṭubruvam ।
ahaṃ miṣṭaṃ kaṭuṃ cāpi tathyaṃ vacmi prasahyatām ।।3 1।।
vikrānto bhāgyavān śūro yaśaḥ puṇyasubuddhimān ।
yādṛśo'si tathā nāsti tridaśeśo'pi vai divi ।।।32।।।
dhiyā gurusamaścāsi prasādena sudhākaraḥ ।
tejasā'si bhānusamaḥ pratāpenāmninā samaḥ ।।।32।।
bale'si vāyunā tulyaḥ śriyā kuberasadṛśaḥ ।
śāstā rudrasamo devo nirṛtisadṛśo raṇe ।।34।।
duṣṭapāśe varuṇo'si daṇḍe tu yamarāḍasi ।
kṣamayā bhūmisadṛśo maryādayā saritpatiḥ ।।35।।
mahattve himavāँścāsi śukro nītyāṃ nṛpasya vai ।
rājāsi manusadṛśastāpahā meghavanmataḥ ।।36।।
pavitro gaṃgayā tulyaḥ kāśīva sugatipradaḥ ।
sṛjipuṣṭirhṛtikārye brahmaviṣṇuharārthavān ।।37।।
sarasvatī mukhe te'sti kamalā te karāmbuje ।
viṣaṃ cāsti tava krodhe'mṛtaṃ vāci tava sthitam ।।38।।
hṛdi nārāyaṇaste'sti macchiṣyāḥ santi na tvayi ।
teṣāṃ vṛttipradānāya hyāgato'smi tavāṃgaṇe ।।39।।
tathyaṃ vacmi na cā'tathyaṃ guptaṃ vacmi na cā'nṛtam ।
svārthaṃ vacmi parārthāḍhyaṃ miṣṭaṃ vacmi phalaṃ kaṭu ।।40।।
ārabhyā'dya dinādbhūpa brāhmaṇo'ṣṭādaśe'hani ।
udīcyaḥ kaścidāgatyā'vaśyaṃ tvāmupadekṣyati ।।41।।
tattathaiva prakartavyaṃ tvaṃ hṛtsthaṃ prāpyase tataḥ ।
adyāhaṃ svagṛhaṃ yāmi pratīkṣasva tadāgamam ।।42।।
ityuktvā śrīgaṇeśastu kāśyāmeva hi tasthivān ।
kīrtaye śrīgaṇeśasya nāmāni mūrtayo yathā ।।43।।
ḍhuṇḍhivināyakaścārkavināyako gaṇādhipaḥ ।
dūrgo'tha bhīmacaṇḍaśca dehalināyakastathā ।।44।।
uddaṇḍaḥ pāśapāṇiśca kharvaḥ siddhivināyakaḥ ।
bāhyāvaraṇagāścaite kāśyāmaṣṭau vināyakāḥ ।।45।।
laṃbodaraḥ kūṭadantaḥ tathā śālakaṭaṃkaṭaḥ ।
kūṣmāṃḍo muṇḍo vikaṭadanto'tha rājaputrakaḥ ।।46।।
praṇavaścāṣṭau dvitīyāvaraṇe tu vināyakāḥ ।
vakratuṇḍo hyekadantaḥ kapisiṃhadvipānanaḥ ।।47।।
pañcāsyo herambanāmā vighnarājo varapradaḥ ।
modakapriya ete'ṣṭau tṛtīyāvaraṇasthitāḥ ।।।48।।।
abhayadaḥ siṃhatuṇḍaḥ kūṇitākṣo gajānanaḥ ।
kṣipraprasādanaścātha cintāmaṇivināyakaḥ ।।49।।
dantahastaḥ piciṇḍila uddaṇḍamuṇḍasaṃjñakaḥ ।
ete'ṣṭau tu gaṇādhīśāścaturthāvaraṇasthitāḥ ।।50 ।।
sthūladantaḥ kalipriyaścaturdanto dvituṇḍavān ।
jyeṣṭho gajastathā kālo nāgeśaḥ pañcamāvṛtau ।।5 1।।
maṇikarṇa āśāvināyakaḥ sṛṣṭigaṇādhipaḥ ।
yakṣākhyagajakarṇaścitraghaṇṭaḥ sthūlajaṃghakaḥ ।।552।।।
maṃgalo mitranāyako'ṣṭau te ṣaṣṭhyāvṛtau matāḥ ।
modaḥ pramodaḥ saṃmodo mahāmodo'tha arthadaḥ ।।53।।
jñāno dvāro vimuktākhyo'ṣṭau saptamāvṛtau sthitāḥ ।
ṣaṭpaṃcāśadgaṇeśāste kāśyāṃ parita āsthitāḥ ।।54।।
nāmānyetāni śrutvā'pi duḥkhebhyo viprahīyate ।
jātu vighnairna bādhyeta pāpebhyo'pi prahīyate ।।55।।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rājño'ntaḥpurastrīṇāṃ viśvāsāya gaṇeśena prāgudanta-svapnādi kathitaṃ divodāsāya bhāvivipadādi
kathitaṃ ṣaṭpaṃcāśadgaṇeśasthityādi kathitaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 86 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 086 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 87
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 088 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
patideva! namastubhyaṃ kṛṣṇātmā tu gajānanaḥ ।
kāśyāmavasthitaḥ paścānmandare'bhūddharasya kim ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śaṃkareṇa tadā viṣṇuḥ proktaḥ kāśīgamāya tu ।
tathā tvamapi mā kārṣīryathā prākprasthitaiḥ kṛtam ।। 2 ।।
viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ prāha yathābuddhibalodayam ।
udyamaḥ prāṇinā kāryaḥ phalaṃ daivakṛtaṃ matam ।। 2 ।।
atīva yadasādhyaṃ tatsusādhyaṃ haryanugrahāt ।
sumuhūrtaṃ saṃvilokya salakṣmīko hariḥ svayam ।। 4 ।।
viṣṇuścaturbhujo'gacchat kāśīṃ snātaśca gaṃgayā ।
sā vai pādodakī gaṃgā kīrtyate bhaktapuṃgavaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
kṛtapādodakasnānaṃ pītapādodakodakam ।
dattapādodapānīyaṃ naraṃ na nirayaḥ spṛśet ।। 6 ।।
viṣṇupādodake tīrthe prāśya pādodakaṃ sakṛt ।
jātucijjananīstanyaṃ pātavyaṃ na bhavediti ।। 7 ।।
sacakraśālagrāmasya śaṃkhena sthāpitasya ca ।
adbhiḥ pādodakasyā'mbu pibannamṛtatāṃ vrajet ।। 8 ।।
viṣṇupādodake tīrthe viṣṇupādodakaṃ pibet ।
sapta sapta tathā sapta svavaṃśāँstārayiṣyati ।। 9 ।।
tatra tīrthe svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ svamūrtiṃ dārṣadīṃ vyadhāt ।
ādikeśavanāmnīṃ tāṃ svayamasthāpayattataḥ ।। 1.87.10 ।।
śvetadvīpaitisthānaṃ tatkāśīsīmni vartate ।
yatra yatra sthitaḥ supto viśrānto nidritastathā ।। 1 1।।
tatra tatra ca tīrthāni jātāni viṣṇusaṃjñayā ।
kṣīrābdhināmakaṃ tīrthaṃ śaṃkhatīrthaṃ tathā param ।। 12।।
cakratīrthaṃ gadātīrtha tīrthaṃ ca padmasaṃjñakam ।
mahālakṣmyabhidhaṃ tīrthaṃ tārkṣyatīrthaṃ tathāparam ।। 13।।
tatra nāradatīrthaṃ ca prahlādatīrthamityapi ।
ambarīṣamahātīrthamādikeśavatīrthakam ।। 14।।
dattātreyamahātīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ ca bhārgavaṃ tathā ।
tathā vāmanatīrthaṃ ca naranārāyaṇābhidham ।। 15।।
yajñavārāhatīrthaṃ ca gopīgovindatīrthakam ।
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhatīrthaṃ ca śeṣatīrthaṃ tathāparam ।। 16।।
śaṃkhamādhavatīrthaṃ ca tīrthaṃ hayānanaṃ tathā ।
matsyodarāmahātīrthaṃ rādhākṛṣṇasumandiram ।। 17।।
kāśīviśveśvarasaudhaṃ tīrthamevamanekadhā ।
viṣṇunā tatra vāsāya sthāpitā nijamūrtayaḥ ।। 18।।
viṣṇunā cātha kāryaṃ vai śaṃkarārthaṃ tu kiṃ kṛtam ।
saugataṃ prathamaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtaṃ trilokimohanam ।। 19।।
lakṣmīstadā tu saṃjātā subhagā parivrājikā ।
garutmānapi saṃjātaḥ śiṣyo hastāgrapustakaḥ ।।1.87.20।।
guruḥ puṇyasūryabhidhaḥ śiṣyo vinayasūrikaḥ ।
lakṣmīrāryasūriṇī ca vivecayanti catvare ।।।2 1।।
vinayasūriḥ papraccha guruṃ dharmaṃ sanātanam ।
puṇyasūrirguruḥ prāha janānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā ।। 22।।
anādisiddhaḥ saṃsāraḥ kartṛkarmavivarjitaḥ ।
svayaṃ prādurbhavedeṣaḥ svayameva vilīyate ।।।23।।
ātmaivaikastu sarvatra nāmānyekasya santi ca ।
śarīraṃ bhūtajaṃ kālakṛtaṃ kālena līyate ।।24।।
āhāro maithunaṃ nidrā bhayaṃ ceti samānakam ।
atra catuṣṭaye sarve tulyāḥ santi vicāryate ।।25।।
karmakṛtaṃ paraṃ sarvaṃ nā'smātkaścitparo mataḥ ।
bhajanaṃ kasya kartavyaṃ nāsti kaścitparo yataḥ ।।26।।
dharmo jīvadayātulyo nāsti pālyaḥ sa sarvadā ।
hiṃsyante jantavaḥ snāne tasmātsnānaṃ na dhārmikam ।।27।।
dahyante jantavo dīpe tasmāddīpo na dhārmikaḥ ।
upavāsaiḥ pramartavyaṃ karmanāśastadā bhavet ।।।28।।
ātmā bhavetparamātmā sarve tathā bhavantviti ।
paṃcakarmendriyāṇyeva paṃcajñānendriyāṇi ca ।।29 ।।
mano buddhiśca saṃpūjyaṃ dvādaśāyatanaṃ śubham ।
na dharmo nā'pyadharmaśca svargaṃ na narakaṃ nahi ।।1.87.3 0 ।।
sukhaṃ svargo duḥkhamanyat tannāśo mokṣa ucyate ।
vṛkṣān chitvā kaṇān hutvā vṛthā vināśya karmaṇi ।।3 1 ।।
dagdhā vahnau tilājyādi yajñastu pāpameva tat ।
na kartavyaṃ na kartavyaṃ karmahiṃsāmayaṃ kvacit ।। 3 2।।
tadvināśāya gantavyaṃ parvatāraṇyabhūmiṣu ।
jñānaśravaṇamityetat kṛtvā'nyepi janāstadā ।।33।।
trayāṇāṃ tatra śiṣyā vai bhavanti bahavo janāḥ ।
prayānti kāśīṃ visṛjya parvatāraṇyabhūmiṣu ।।34।।
atha nārīṣu āryā sā hyupadeśaṃ karotyapi ।
prāha deho manuṣyāṇāṃ svakarmaṇā hyavāpyate ।।35।।
karma tu hiṃsanādyātma na sevātma vicāryate ।
naiko niyāmakaścānyā niyamyeti yathātatham ।।36।।
sevayā cānyadehasya yadi labhyeta nākadam ।
svasya dehasya tāṃ sevāṃ kathaṃ naiva prakurmahe ।।37।।
svārthaiva patisevā'sti na puṇyādikarī matā ।
parādhīnaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ svādhīnaṃ sukhamucyate ।।38।।
tasmānnareṇa patnyāstu sevā kasmānna ceṣyate ।
ataḥ sevā na kartavyā hiṃsā svārthaśca pāpakṛt ।।39।।
ityāryāyā upadeśānnāryaḥ sevāṃ na kurvate ।
dānahomādikāryaṃ ca pratiruddhaṃ na jāyate ।।1.87.40 ।।
devasnānavidhiḥ sarvo vilīnaśca tataḥ punaḥ ।
abhyasyākarṣiṇīṃ vidyāṃ vaśīkṛtimatīmapi ।।41 ।।
narā nāryo vimohena brahmacaryaṃ ca tatyajuḥ ।
evaṃ sarveṣu paureṣu parāṅmukheṣu dharmataḥ ।।42।।
praviṣṭo'dharmapādaśca rājā saṃkalpakuṇṭhitaḥ ।
sāmarthyaṃ līnamevā'sya divodāsasya sarvathā ।।।43 ।।
ajigaṇaddivodāso'pyaṣṭādaśadināvadhim ।
tāvadaṣṭādaśe prāpte divase'gād dvijottamaḥ ।।44।।
sa eva viṣṇuḥ pratyakṣo dvijo bhūtvā samāgataḥ ।
taṃ sa natvā prapūjyā'ntaḥpure nināya cāha tam ।।45 ।।
māsadvaye tu madrājyaṃ nirmālyamiva dṛśyate ।
na śaktirna ca saṃpattirna prajā na ca dhārmikam ।।46।।
kīdṛśo'yaṃ samāyātaḥ samayo na ca vedmyaham ।
citte virāga āyātaścāhaṃ jigamiṣurvanam ।।47।।
sarvaṃ samyak kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bhogyaṃ bhuktaṃ harerbalāt ।
eka evā'parādhastu mayā devāstṛṇīkṛtāḥ ।।48।।
niṣkāsitā mayā rājyāttapobalasulambinā ।
yadeva kathayasvā'dya tattathaiva karomyaham ।।49।।
avanto'pi prajāḥ sarvā nijadharmamanuvratāḥ ।
purā te tripurāḥ śena līlayā bhasmasātkṛtāḥ ।।1.87.50 ।।
baliṃ yajñakṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pātāle nītavān hariḥ ।
vṛttavānapi vai vṛtra indreṇaiva niṣūditaḥ ।।51 ।।
dadhīcivipro devairasthikṛte tu hato'malaḥ ।
tasmādvirodho bhadrāya na bhaved daivataiḥ saha ।।52।।
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tasmai divodāsāya muktaye ।
na bhavatsadṛśo rājā bhavan bhūto bhaviṣyati ।।।53।।
tvayā dharmasya devānāṃ kimapyapakṛtaṃ nahi ।
kāśīviśveśvaro dūraṃ kṛto'parādha eva saḥ ।।54।।।
tacchāntyai liṃgamekaṃ vai kāśīviśveśvarābhidham ।
pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ tvayā paścāt saptame hyadyavāsarāt ।।55।।
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya gantavyaṃ śrīhareḥ padam ।
śrutvā rājā'pyadād deyaṃ vipraṃ praṇamya bhāvataḥ ।।56।।
sarvato mana ākṛṣya liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya śobhanam ।
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyeti saṃjapan ।।57।।
prāyopaveśanavrataṃ gṛhītvā paścime taṭe ।
mahāntaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā samāhūya prajājanān ।।58।।
āhūya paṇḍitānsarvān sāmātyānmaṇḍaleśvarān ।
sarvāṃstattatkṛtādhyakṣān putrān pañcaśatāni ca ।।59।।
purohitaṃ pratīhāramṛtvijo gaṇakān dvijān ।
sāmantān rājaputrāँśca sūpakārāँścikitsakān ।।1.87.60 ।।
bahūn vaideśikāँścāpi bālagopālavṛddhakān ।
sā'ntaḥpurāñca mahiṣīṃ sarvān provāca bhāvataḥ ।।61 ।।
ādyārabhyasaptame'hni maraṇaṃ me bhaved dhruvam ।
mama rājye'bhisiñcāmi kumāraṃ samaraṃjayam ।।62।।
krāśīviśveśvarārthaṃ ca saudhaṃ kurvantu śilpinaḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāsaptāhaṃ śṛṇomyaham ।।63।।।
sārameva ca dravyaṃ me vyayārthaṃ dīyatāṃ muhuḥ ।
atha śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ sarvaṃ maṇḍalaṃ svaṃ nināya ca ।।64।।
viprarūpeṇa kāśyāṃ vai tatkathāyāṃ samagataḥ ।
brāhmaṇastu svayaṃ viṣṇurvedaśāstrārthapāragaḥ ।।65।।
vaktā'bhavat tadā tatra pāṭhakaśca haro'bhavat ।
jāpakā ṛṣayastatra devāḥ prajāḥ sabhāsadaḥ ।।66 ।।
dharmayajño mahān jāto na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।
svayamagniḥ samāptau tu nīrājayati nityaśaḥ ।।67।।
saptame tu dine pūrṇe mandire svarṇaśobhite ।
viśveśvaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya mahatā vidhinā tataḥ ।।68।।
kathāpūrṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā koṭijanānabhojayat ।
rājā yajñaprasādaṃ cā'jighrad vyāsājñayā'tha ca ।।69।।
yāvattiṣṭhati madhyāhne sandhyāyāṃ harisannidhau ।
tāvadvimānamākāśādujjvalaṃ brahmalokajam ।।1.87.70 ।।
alpamavātarad bhūtvā tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ śriyā ।
sahitastatra saptāhasthale pratyakṣatāmagāt ।।71 ।।
rūpānurūpā'vayavaṃ kaṃjanetraṃ kṛpāmayam ।
prasannavadanaṃ hāsyaṃ kurvantaṃ ca manoharam ।।।72।।।
brahmadhāmasthitaṃ divyaṃ svarūpaṃ tarkabhūmyagam ।
āyāhīti bruvantaṃ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ praṇamya saḥ ।।।73।।
divodāsaḥ parābhaktyā vismṛtyā'nyadaho prabho! ।
āyāmīti vadan dehaṃ divyaṃ tameva vartayan ।।74।।
sadehastu mahālakṣmyā brahmavāryabhisiñcitaḥ ।
mahāmukto'bhavad divyo viṣṇutulyaḥ sadehakaḥ ।।75।।
āruroha vimānaṃ tat prārthayāmāsa vai harim ।
yā prajā tava bhaktā'sti naya tāmapi mokṣad ।।76।।
hariḥ prāha divodāsa! yābhiryaiḥ samabhīṣyate ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu samāgantumāyāntu te'nivāritāḥ ।।77।।
śrutvaivaṃ ḍiṇḍimaṃ viṣṇoḥ prajā lakṣapralakṣakāḥ ।
nāgarā deśikāścānye jānapadasabhāsadāḥ ।।78।।
arbudāśca parārdhāśca divodāsena vai samam ।
āruruhurvimānaṃ tā vaikuṇṭhagamanecchayā ।।79।।
sarve divyā divyadehā bhūtvā tyaktvā'navāni vai ।
tāvadvimānamākāśe mahadrūpaṃ vyadṛśyata ।।1.87.80।।
sūryacandrādayo yasya nikaṭe sarṣapā iva ।
koṭipārṣadasaṃjuṣṭaṃ koṭimuktasamanvitam ।।8 1 ।।
ūrdhvamapāsaran tāvatkṣaṇenādṛśyatāṃ gatam ।
kāśyāṃ trilokyāṃ vailokyāṃ jayaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।।82।।
evaṃ rājā divodāso bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhamāptavān ।
etāṃ kathāṃ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyānmukta eva saḥ ।।83।
bhaktyā hyanekajīvāँśca sa vai tārayituṃ śamaḥ ।।
divodāsasamānasya vaikuṇṭho'tra paratra ca ॥84॥
tataḥ sarve'pi devā vai śaṃkaraḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
kāśīṃ cāvāsayan sarvāṃ rājadhānī purā yathā ॥85।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hareṇa kāśīṃ prati viṣṇuḥ preṣitaḥ, viṣṇutīrthāni, viṣṇunā sugatarūpeṇa nāstikopadeśadvārā prajā dharmaśūnyā nāstikā kṛtā, tena divodāsasya pratāpasya hrāsaḥ, tataḥ asyāḥ saṃhitāyāḥ śravaṇam , kāśīviśveśvarasthāpanam , tato divyavimānena divyadehasya divodāsasya prajayā saha vaikuṃṭhagamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।87॥


← adhyāyaḥ 087 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 88
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 089 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca—
mandarādriprārthanena śaṃbhustu gatavānpurā ।
kathaṃ devāparādho vai divodāsasya so'bhavat ! ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! kathāṃ divyāṃ kathaṃ drohastvajāyata ।
puraikadā mahāvṛṣṭirjātā kāśīvināśinī ॥ 2 ॥
vṛṣṭyā kāśyā vināśena deśaviplavajena ca ।
dhyānasthitasya śaṃbhorvai duḥkhenā'ntaradūyata ।। 3 ।।
tadā devo mahādevo meghānāhūya sarvataḥ ।।
sarvān nibadhya jaṭayā samādhyantarhito'bhavat ॥ 4 ॥
gatvā kailāsaśikhare gaṇān saṃsthāpya rakṣakān ।।
daśavarṣaṃ samādhau tu so'bhūt jāgarito nahi ।। 5 ।।
anāvṛṣṭyā tadā deśā vināśaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ।।
divodāsastadā bhakto ghore tapasi saṃsthitaḥ ॥ 6 ॥
pṛthvī rājyavihīnā''sīt devāḥ svargaṃ gatāstadā ।।
manuṣyā naiva dṛśyante lokaviplava āpatat ॥ 7 ॥
avyavasthā caturyonau yajñādayo bhavanti na ।
na bhakṣyaṃ na ca havyaṃ vā patraṃ puṣpaṃ na labhyate ॥ 8 ॥
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi yajñīyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca yat ।
sāvagrahaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ jātaṃ tadā divaukasām ॥ 9 ॥
itastataḥ pradhāvanti manujā rākṣasāstathā ।
devāśca prāṇino bhūtāḥ piśācā vaninastathā ॥1.88.10॥
avyavasthaṃ hyabhūtsarvaṃ mahābhayaṃ tu bhūtalam ।।
bālā nāryo hriyante'nyairdravyaṃ bhojyaṃ na labhyate ।।11।।
arājake tadā deśe duḥkhino devamānavāḥ ।
brahmāṇaṃ tu samārādhya nṛpatiṃ supratāpinam ॥12॥
vavrire devasāhāyyaṃ yathā vai varṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।
mārgayannṛpatiṃ viṣṇusamaṃ brahmā hyuvāca tān ।।13।।
yāntūpāyaṃ kariṣye'haṃ duḥkhanāśāya sarvathā ।
svayaṃ vimānamāruhya jagāma himaparvatam ॥14॥
tapasyantaṃ mahāghoraṃ vidyutprabhaṃ pratāpinam ।।
divodāsaṃ vilokyaiva brahmovāca hitāvaham ॥15॥
paśya rājan svayaṃ brahmā lokarakṣaṇahetave ।।
āgato'smi bhavānatra tāpasaḥ sankaroti kim ।।16।।
paropakārasadṛśaṃ tapo na na ca pauruṣam ।।
na dhyāna na ca homo vā na kriyāntaramityapi ॥17॥
ārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kiṃ
nārādhito yadi haristapasā tataḥ kim ।
niṣkāmatāṃ yadi gatastapasā tataḥ kiṃ
satkāmatāṃ yadi gataḥ phalamāpnuhi tvam ॥18॥
phalaṃ svayaṃ samāgatya haste patati yatsvataḥ ।
na gṛhṇāti nopayuṃkte ko'nyastasmād vicetanaḥ ॥19॥
devāḥ prayojanavaśāt tuṣyanti yasya yogataḥ ।
tānnādriyata ityasmātko'nyastu viphalāyatiḥ ॥1.88.20॥
tapaḥ samāpya nṛpate ! nibodha madvaco hitam ।।
tvāṃ vinā'vagrahaṃ ghoraṃ nānyo vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ ॥21॥
tvāṃ viṣṇuṃ tvāṃ mahārudraṃ brahmāṇaṃ tvāṃ prajāpatim ।।
manye tatkāryakartṛtvāt tatpratīkaṃ tadātmakam ॥22॥
tvadṛśānāṃ tapo dharmo nocito deśaviplave ।
sevādharmaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ rājyaṃ kuru mayā'rpitam ॥23॥
āgaccha tava mūrdhnyatra mukuṭaṃ sthāpayāmi vai ।
abhiṣekaṃ kārayāmi matkamaṇḍaluvāriṇā ॥24॥
idānīṃ śaṃkaro devo hyavimuktaṃ mahāvanam ।
parityajya mahāmeghān badhvā nītvā gato darīm ॥25॥
tvaṃ gṛhāṇa mahārājyaṃ rājadhānīṃ tu kāśikām ।
abhiṣeke tvayi jāte drāgvṛṣṭiḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ॥26॥
prāṇinaḥ sukhinaḥ syuśca haristuṣṭo bhaviṣyati ।
tapasā'pyadhikaṃ janmasāphalyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ॥27॥
ityukte brahmaṇā rājñi netre prānmilya vedhasam ।
praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau vavande hṛdayena vai ॥28॥
pitāmaha namastubhyaṃ pitrājñāṃ pālayāmyaham ।।
prāpte prasannavadane pitari ko na tuṣyati ॥29॥
prāpte kṣaṇe tu devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vā satāṃ janaḥ ।
nājñāvaho bhaved bhāgyavikretā sa na saṃśayaḥ ॥1.88.30॥
pitā pitāmahaścāpi prapitāmaha ityapi ।।
ājñāpayettu yattadvai kāryaṃ putreṇa dhīmatā ॥31॥
ta eva tu trayo devā vedāścāpi ta eva ha ।
ta eva muktidātāra āśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ ॥32॥
kintu nirvāhake putre yadi vighnaṃ tu kiṃcana ।
dṛśyate tannāśanīyaṃ tasmāt kiṃcinnivedaye ॥33॥
devānāṃ devalokeṣu daityadānavabhogiṣu ।
nāsti dharmavyavasthā yā mānuṣeṣviha nirmitā ॥34॥
yadi mānuṣabhinno vā kaścidvasati bhūtale ।।
tadā mānuṣadharmāṇāṃ bādhā syātpramadādiṣu ॥35॥
devāḥ patnīvrataṃ dharmaṃ manvate naiva cetyataḥ ।।
yadi madviṣaye na syū rājyaṃ karomi dhārmikam ॥36॥
brahmā prāha varaṃ rājan vardhase vimalāśayaḥ ।।
gṛhāṇa mukuṭaṃ gāṃgaṃ jalaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca mālikām ॥37॥
devāḥ saṃkalpitāstatra kṣaṇādāyayuragrimāḥ ।।
abhiṣekaḥ kṣaṇājjāta udghoṣaḥ sadasi kṛtaḥ ॥38॥
śṛṇvantu devatāścānye'tratyā'nyalokavāsinaḥ ।
divodāsasya rājye tu nāgatavyamamānavaiḥ ॥39॥
vasanti ye ca taiḥ sarvairdevairgantavyamanyataḥ।।
yo na manvīta me nyāyaṃ sa devebhyo bahiṣkṛtaḥ ॥1.88.40॥
matsṛṣṭeśca bahiṣkārya ityājñā vaidhasī dhruvā ।
sarve tvamānavā devā atalādigṛhāstathā ॥41॥
kāśyā nirgatya nāke'nyaparvatādau gatāstadā ।
na yatra mānavo vāso na devānāṃ ca saṃkaraḥ ।।4।।
śaṃkarastu yayau pūrvaṃ mandareṇārthito yadā।।
gatāḥ svasvāmivāseṣu tridevāstridaśālayāḥ ॥43॥
niṣkāsanena devānāṃ divodāso mahān ripuḥ ।।
devānāmaparāddhā sa vivāsadaṇḍakṛcca vai ॥44॥
nāgantavyaṃ mama rājye devaiḥ kvāpi kadācana ।।
svārthāḥ parārthalubdhāśca paradārasusaṃginaḥ ।।45॥
te rājye me na cā''yāntu tvāgatā nāśamāpnuyuḥ ।
ityudghoṣastato jātastena devā ruṣaṃ gatāḥ ॥46॥
sūryo naiva pratapati candro na śaityado'bhavat ।
pacatyagnirna vai bhojyamindro naiva hi varṣati ।।47॥
na vāti pavanastatra ṛtavo vimukhāstadā ।
evaṃ sarve'pi ruṣṭāste divodāsastadā svayam ॥48॥
nārāyaṇahareryogāt. tapate sūryarūpadhṛk ।
poṣayatyauṣadhīṃścandro bhūtvā dadāti cāmṛtam ॥49॥
agnirbhūtvā pācayati megho bhūtvā pravarṣati ।
vāyurbhūtvā pravātyeva vikāsayati san ṛtuḥ ॥1.88.50॥
yatra yatra ca yatkāryaṃ devādhīnaṃ babhūva ha ।।
tattaddevātmako bhūtvā svayaṃ sādhayati drutam ॥51॥
svayaṃ yajñaḥ prabhūtvā ca bhūtvā taddevamaṇḍalam ।।
svayaṃ nārāyaṇe prārpya svayamaśnāti śeṣajam ॥52॥
nā'nyamāhvayate kaṃciddevaṃ nārāyaṇo'paraḥ ।।
ato'tiruṣṭā devāste nā''yānti tatra ke'pi vai ॥53॥
avagrahakṛto doṣo divodāsena nāśitaḥ ।
ripūnnārāyaṇabalājjayatīti ripūñjayaḥ ॥54॥
itikhyātiṃ samāpanno divo nārāyaṇasya ca ।।
dāsaśceti divodāsa ityevaṃ nāma sārthakam ॥55॥
satyaṃ śīlaṃ brahmacaryamahiṃsā tyāga ārjavam ।
sarvabrahmātmadṛṣṭiśca tathā sarvātmaveditā ॥56॥
sevā satāṃ satīnāṃ ca nārāyaṇena caikatā ।
ityevaṃ sadguṇāstatra santi śīlapurogamāḥ ॥57॥
kāmadughāḥ kalpavṛkṣāścintāmaṇaya ityamī ।।
nityaṃ tadrājyavāstavyaprajānāṃ tu gṛhe gṛhe ॥58॥
rājā tu navadhā bhaktyopāste nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।।
kāmavarṣyabhavattasya svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।59॥
gṛhakāryakarī cāsīllakṣmīrnārāyaṇī ca mā ।।
vaikuṇṭha iva tadrājyaṃ vikāsamagamacchriyā ।।1.88.60॥
kiṃ nyūnaṃ vai bhaved yasya bhāle vasati śrīhariḥ ।
ḍiṇḍimodghoṣitā rājye hyābālayuvavārdhakāḥ ॥61॥
sarve bhajantāṃ govindaṃ nānyaṃ kurvantu tadvinā ।।
pūjayantu ca govindaṃ śṛṇvantu śrīhareḥ kathām ।।62।।
dhyāyantu śrīharermūrtiṃ paśyantu pratimāṃ hareḥ ।।
spṛśantu tatsatāṃ pādān bhakṣayantu niveditam ॥63॥
jighrantu haripuṣpāṇi sevayantu ca tatsataḥ ।
raṭantu harināmāni viharantu tadālaye ।।64॥
ānandayantu haryarthamutsṛjantu viśuddhaye ।
svapantu hariśayyāyāṃ jāgratu harisevane ॥65॥
āntaraṃ cāpi yatkiṃcit kurvantu harigocaram ।।
mā kurvantvanyamudyogaṃ divodāse praśāsati ॥66॥
yadyad yasya bhavediṣṭaṃ tasya tasya tu labdhaye ।।
śrīnārāyaṇamūrtyagre sthitvoccārya ca nāma vai ॥67।।
prārthanīyamamukaṃ me bhūyādviśvaṃbhara prabho ।।
divodāsasya bhaktyā śrīnārāyaṇo dadātu me ।।68॥
ityevaṃ prārthyate yena prāpsyate tena sarvathā ।।
anyathā me bhaved ghātyo dhruvaṃ cetyanuśāsanam ॥69॥
kaṇṭhe srajastulasyāśca bhāle tilakaṃ cāndanam ।।
candrakaṃ kuṃkumāḍhyaṃ ca japārthaṃ karamālikā ।।1.88.70।।
śrīnārāyaṇamūrtiśca sauvarṇī kaṇṭhagā sadā ।।
ityevaṃ pañcacihnāni rakṣennārāyaṇasya vai ॥71।।
yasyaivaṃ naiva mānyaṃ me ghātyaḥ khaḍgena vai sa me ।।
paśuvṛkṣalatāpakṣiprāṇino yasya santi vai ।।72।।
tānsarvān vaiṣṇavān kuryurityasti mama śāsanam ।
nā'vaiṣṇavī prajā me syānna deśo me tvavaiṣṇavaḥ ।।73॥
nā'vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vastu syāditi me śāsanaṃ mahat ।
anivedya na bhoktavyaṃ na pātavyamanarpitam ।।74।।
nodvartyaṃ naiva cābhūṣyaṃ nā''dhāryaṃ cā'nivedya vai ।
nandayantu viharantu rāmayantu sadā prajāḥ ॥75॥
militābhyāṃ jayahariritivācyaṃ na cānyathā ।
vaktavyaṃ yatkimapyetat hareścaritrameva ha ॥76॥
ājñollaṃghayituḥ kaṇṭhe me khaḍgo vicariṣyati ।
ityevaṃ tu divodāso rājyaṃ cakāra vaiṣṇavam ।।77॥
sarvaṃ vaikuṇṭhabhaṃ tvāsīnna nyūnaṃ tu kimapyabhūt ।।
prajāḥ kāmavimānaiśca viharanti sadā'mbare ॥78॥
gṛhe gṛhe vimānāni kāmadughā gṛhe gṛhe ।
kalpavṛkṣāḥ pratigṛhaṃ kalpaśilāḥ pratisthalam ।।79।।
svarṇahariḥ prativyakti sākṣādvaikuṇṭha ityabhūt ।।
evaṃ prabhāvo rājā'sau prajā nītvā hariśritāḥ ॥1.88.80।।
āgātsadeho vaikuṇṭhaṃ ko'nyastadvat prayāsyati ।
ye ye tatrāgatā devāḥ kāpaṭyena ca śāṃkarāḥ ।।81॥
viṣṇunā rakṣitāste ca khaḍgāghātaṃ na lebhire।
ityeṣā bhagavanmāyā kartā kārayitā hi saḥ ॥82॥
yasya lalāṭe vasati tasya sarvaṃ samāvaset ।
prayāti yasya bhālātsa hyapayātyakhilaṃ tataḥ ॥83॥
prasahya vedhaso dvārā devānāṃ yadvivāsanam ।
tadeva tvaparādhaḥ sa yatphalaṃ svasya mokṣaṇam ॥84॥
aparādho'pi mokṣākhyaṃ phalaṃ dadyācchubho hi saḥ ।।
ityevaṃ kathito bhaktapratāpo'nyat kimicchasi ॥85॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne divodāsasya rājyapadottaraṃ devānāṃ kāśīto niṣkāsanamaparādhaḥ, svasya sarvadevavatkāryasāmarthyaṃ vaiṣṇavadharmabhaktipravartanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 88 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 088 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 89
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 090 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca--
bhagavān sarvahṛdvāsa sarvajña bahurūpadhṛk ।।
dhanvantaristṛtīyo vai jajñe ratnākarātkatham ॥ 1 ॥
tāṃ kathāṃ śrāvaya svāminnārāyaṇa jagadguro ।
śrutvā patimukhād vārtāṃ naiva tṛpyāmi mokṣadām ॥ 2 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
dvāpare tu yuge cānte yadā sarve'lpabuddhayaḥ ।
svārthasādhanamātrārthā atṛptasvasvavṛttayaḥ ॥ 3 ॥
lobhamānādyadharmāṃśavyāptā devāśca mānavāḥ ।।
āsaँstadā yuge cendro rājyābhimānavānapi ॥ 4 ॥
rājasena tu bhāvena samāviṣṭaḥ purandaraḥ ।।
tarkayāmāsa manasā dṛṣṭvā kāle sadūṣaṇam ॥5॥
aho satyaṃ tathā tretā kīdṛśau samayau śubhau ।
vyatītau subhagau sarvasampatpradau yatheṣṭadau ॥ 6 ॥
dvāpare gamyamāne'tra mānasāni phalanti na ।
neṣṭaṃ ca prāpyate kiṃcit durāpaṃ jāyate muhuḥ ॥ 7 ॥
doṣo'tra na prajānāṃ syād yathā rājā tathā prajā ।
ato'trā''hūya dikpālān śāsmi kālasya śuddhaye ॥ 8॥
rājño'pi vā kiyān doṣo rājāno guruśāsitāḥ ।
guravo'tra tu dṛśyante lubdhāḥ svārthaparāyaṇāḥ ॥ 9 ॥
tasmād daṇḍyāśca guravaḥ kālaśuddhistato bhavet ।
yādṛśā rājyaguravastādṛśā rājyapālakāḥ ॥1.89.10॥
tasmādāhūya sarvān vai kenā'pyutsavachadmanā ।
vijñāpayāmi saukhyārthaṃ stheyaṃ satyayuge yathā ॥11॥
kālaḥ kaluṣatāṃ neyāt vartantāṃ tattathaiva hi ।
evaṃ vicārya śakreṇa svarge hyākāritā sabhā ॥12॥
śrāvitaṃ ca trilokyāṃ vai svarge cendrasabhāgṛhe ।।
samāgantavyamānāgamartyadevamunīśvaraiḥ
samāje cātra devānāṃ bhaviṣyati mahotsavaḥ ।।
narotpannā'psarasāṃ tu navaṃ nṛtyaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥14॥
dharmasya patnyāṃ mūrtyāṃ yau jātau naranarāyaṇau ।।
pitrorājñāmanuprāpya tapo'rthaṃ kṛtamānasau ॥15॥
tapatastau vighnakartuṃ mayendreṇa praṇoditāḥ ।।
apsaraso mohanārthaṃ tadā nareṇa cājñayā ।।16।।
nārāyaṇasyā''mrapuṣpairūrvaśī prakaṭīkṛtā ।
surūpā yauvanavyāptā rūpamūrdhanyabhāsvarā ॥17॥
yadagre'nyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā nistejaskā ivā'bhavan ।
saivorvaśī tu me dattā sā vai nṛtyaṃ kariṣyati ॥18॥
taddarśanāya sarvaistu samāgantavyameva ha ।।
ityudghoṣayitvendreṇa kṛtā svarge mahāsabhā ॥19॥
nṛtyaṃ karotyūrvaśī ca nṛtye rūpe ca mohitā ।।
kaṇṭhasvare pralīnā ca hyamānā tvabhavatsabhā ॥1.89.20॥
lokapālāśca devāśca ṛṣayo'psarasastathā ।।
gandharvāśca tathā siddhā vidyādhrāścāraṇādayaḥ ॥21॥
devyaścāpi tadā sarvā mugdhāstallagnamānasāḥ ।।
abhavaँstāvadāgacchad devarājaguruḥ sudhīḥ ॥22॥
bahuśiṣyaiḥ parivṛto bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ।
nṛtye saṃvartamāne'tra sabhākṣobho bhavedataḥ ॥23॥
indrastatrā''gataṃ paśyan guruṃ vācaspatiṃ dvijam ।
novāca kiṃcid durmedhā vaco mānapuraḥsaram ॥24॥
nā''hvānaṃ nā''sanaṃ tasya satkāraṃ nā'karottadā ।
devāstu sahasā dṛṣṭvā praṇemustamupasthitam ॥25॥
tadorvaśī svayaṃ tatra guruṃ jñātvā bṛhaspatim ।
nanāma nṛtyaṃ saṃtyajya sabhākṣobho'bhavattadā ॥26॥
indra utthāya yāvadvai kālaḥ śubho bhaved yathā
bhaved yadi śubho rājā so'pi syād cet śubho guruḥ ॥27॥
śubhena guruṇā rājā prajā kālaḥ śubhā matāḥ ।।
ityupadiśati tāvat surācāryoṃ ruṣānvitaḥ ॥28॥
jñātvā śakraṃ pramattaṃ ca madād rājyasya durmatim ।।
tirodhānamanuprāptaḥ kva gato naiva bhālitaḥ ॥29॥
gate devagurau tasmin vaimanasyaṃ gatāḥ surāḥ ।।
yakṣanāgāśca gandharvā apsarasa dvijarṣayaḥ ॥1.89.30॥
nṛtyagānā'vasāne tu hariḥ prāha surāँstadā ।।
kva gato'yaṃ devagururnāradaḥ prāha taṃ tadā ॥31॥
tvayā kṛtā hyavajñā vai gurormānaṃ tu na kṛtam ।।
guroravajñayā rājyaṃ līyate bhayamāgatam ॥32॥
naro yatate saukhyārthaṃ tadeva duk͟hakṛd bhavet ।।
so'yaṃ kālasya saṃvego na rājā kālakāraṇam ॥33॥
na gururna prajā heturyugaḥ kālasya kāraṇam ।
yugaḥ paryāvartayati mānasāni mahātmanām ॥34॥
tathāpi bhadrasantatyai yatitavyaṃ yathābalam ।।
guruḥ kṣamāpanīyo vai sarvabhāvena tu tvayā ॥35॥
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā sadaḥsthai parivāritaḥ ।।
āsanātsahasothāyā'gacchad gehaṃ bṛhaspateḥ ॥36॥
dṛṣṭvā tārāṃ praṇamyāha kva gato hi mahātapāḥ ।
na jānāmītyuvācetthaṃ tārā devān gṛhasthitā ॥37॥
tadā cintānvito bhūtvā śakraḥ svālayamāvrajat ।
airāvataṃ samāruhya gurormārgaṇakāmyayā ॥38॥
vyomamārgātpṛthivyāṃ vai yāvadāgacchati drutam ।।
mārge munirmahākrodho durvāsā rudrakāṃśajaḥ ॥39॥
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāmādāya cāgataḥ ।।
gurościntanajānmohād bhāvibhāgyaparikṣayāt ॥1.89.40॥
kālāvegāttathā tatra turāṣāṇna nanāma tam ।
tathāpi ṛṣiṇā rājñaḥ satkāryadharmagauravāt ॥41॥
mālā vyomnaiva mārgeṇa tvindrakaṇṭhe samarpitā ।।
indrastāṃ tu samuttārya dattavān hastimastake ॥42॥
hastinā sā kareṇaiva phālitā nihitā pade ।।
kaccaritā marditā ca dṛṣṭvā cukrodha tāṃ muniḥ ॥43॥
krodhajvālāparītāṃgo vikarālabhayaṃkaraḥ ।।
oṣṭhau daśan garaṃ netre darśayan sphārayan tharan ।।44॥
uvāca duṣṭa deveśa dūre tiṣṭhatu mānanam ।
pratyuta mānito'pi tvaṃ mālāṃ gaṇayase nahi ॥45॥
viditvā devarājaṃ tvāṃ pūjayitvā tathāpi vai ।।
śaṭharājaḥ prabhūtvā manmālāṃ kṣipasi bhūtale ॥46॥
mardanaṃ hastipādena kārayasyavamānanam ।
puṣpe puṣpe tu ratnāni lakṣmyo vasanti madbalāt ॥47॥
vaikuṇṭhācchrīhareḥ prāsādikī labdhā'rpitā'tra te ।
sā pradattā mayā tāṃ tvaṃ kaccarayasi pattale ।
ratnānāṃ lakṣmīnāṃ cāpi nāśaṃ karoṣi mauḍhyataḥ ॥48॥
tasmāt trilokirājyaṃ te vināśaṃ yātu sarvathā ।
sampadaḥ smṛddhayo lakṣmyo ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥49॥
layaṃ yāntu mahāvārdhau tvamanidro bhava kṣaṇāt ।
durvāsā evamuktaiva kailāsamagamat tataḥ ।।1.89.50॥
ambālikādhvajastatraivā'patadbhūtale tataḥ ।
mukuṭo'pyapatanmūrdhnaḥ kṣauti sma ca karī tadā ॥51॥
aṃkuśaṃ vai vigalitaṃ hastāt hastipakasya tu ।।
etasminnantare svarge tvaniṣṭānyabhavankṣaṇāt ॥52
airāvataścālito'pi svargaṃ prati na gacchati ।
unmattaḥ san devarājaṃ drāvayatyeva cābhitaḥ ॥53॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārāyaṇotpāditorvaśyā nartanotsavasamāje bṛhaspateravamānanaṃ durvāsaso'vamānaṃ rājyalakṣmīnāśakaśāpaścendrasyetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 89॥


← adhyāyaḥ 089 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 90
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 091 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
devaguruḥ svayaṃ yāto kāveryāścottare taṭe ।
homaṃ cakāra cendrasya rājyanāśāya śeṣataḥ ॥ 1 ॥
oṃ namo bhagavati ṛkṣakarṇi caturbhuje ।
ūrdhvakeśi kālarātri vasārudhirabhojane ॥ 2 ॥
indrasya prāptakālasya mṛtyude huṃ phaṭ hana ।
hana daha daha māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ paca paca svāhā ॥ 3 ॥
iti homaṃ prakurvatā kṛtyā krūrā tu nirmitā ।।
sā gatā cendranāśāya dṛṣṭendro vihvalo'bhavat ॥ 4 ॥
palāyito vyomamārgād brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ yayau ।।
kṛtyā parāvṛtā tasmād bṛhaspatimupāgatā ॥ 5 ॥
bṛhaspatyājñayā cendraratnānāṃ nāśanāya hi । ।
gatā svargaṃ tadā sarve bhayabhītā tvitastataḥ ॥ 6 ॥
vināśikāṃ mahāghorāṃ kālānalasamaprabhām ।।
vyāttānanāṃ saśastrāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cakruḥ palāyanam ॥ 7 ॥
durvāsaso muneḥ śāpo mahākāyaḥ karālakaḥ ।।
kṛṣṇaparvatasannibho meghān lihan svajihvayā ॥ 8 ॥
sūryacandranibhe netre visphārayan prabhakṣakaḥ ।।
trilokyāstu vināśāya svargaṃ tu prathamaṃ gataḥ ॥ 9 ॥
karālakaḥ sa puruṣaḥ kṛtyā ṛkṣaśravasyapi ।
vināśayāmāsatuśca svargaratnāni sarvataḥ ॥1.90.10॥
tadā śacī tirodhānaṃ gatā tu kamalekṣaṇā ।
airāvato mahānāgastathaivoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ ॥11॥
pradudruvustathā cānyaratnāni svargataḥ kila ।।
pātālasthena balinā jñātvā śakrasya durdaśām ॥12॥
akāri svargalābhāya yuddhaṃ daityaprasenayā ।
labdhā'marāvatī tena ratnānyāskanditāni ca ॥13॥
saptāṃgaṃ sakalaṃ tasyendrasya nītaṃ talātalam ।
śukraprasādād daityāstu tadā vijayino'bhavan ॥14॥
samudre patitāvuccaiḥśravāirāvataistadā ।
anyānyapi ca ratnāni hyanekāni bahūnyapi ॥15॥
svargānnītāni daityaiśca daityānahārṇi tāni tu ।।
vidrutvā tāni daityebhyaḥ patitāni tu sāgare ॥16॥
candro jaladravo bhūtvā bhūtvā kāmadughā payaḥ ।।
kalpavṛkṣaḥ pārijātaścādṛśyau bījabhāvataḥ ॥17॥
apsaraso nadīrūpā hīrakāḥ kaṃkarāstathā ।
amṛtaṃ tu tadā bhūtvā vārirasamayo dravaḥ ॥18॥
ṛddhismṛddhiramārāmā bhūtvā rūpāntarātmikāḥ ।
jagmuḥ samudramadhyā'dhastale viśrāntimāpnuvan ॥19॥
devabhogyāni ratnāni daityabhogyāni naiva hi ।
tadā sa vismayāviṣṭo balirāha guruṃ prati ॥1.90.20॥
balājjitāni ratnāni peturjalamahārṇave ।।
śukraḥ prāhā'śvamedhānāṃ śatenā''ptvā sureśatām ॥21॥
yastiṣṭhati surarājā''sane ratnāni tasya vai ।।
aśvamedhaśataṃ kṛtvā teṣāṃ bhoktā na saṃśayaḥ ॥22॥
aśvamedhairvinā kiñcitsvargīyaṃ naiva bhujyate ।
gurorvacanamājñāya baliḥ prāha guruṃ tadā ॥23॥
yatiṣye prāptasamaye nedānīṃ samayo'sti saḥ ।
athendro'pi śikṣitaḥ śrībrahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ॥24॥
brahmāṇaṃ lokapālāँśca puraskṛtya surāstathā ।
munīn devāँścā'gamat sa samudraṃ kṣīrasāgaram ॥25॥
prāptā vimṛśya te sarve hariṃ stotuṃ pracakramuḥ ।।
devānāṃ duḥkhaharṣe te kṣīrasāgaravāsine ॥26॥
sarvāntaryāmiṇe tasmai śayānāya namo namaḥ ।।
kālakṛtaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ devānāṃ samupasthitam ॥27॥
pravidhotuṃ ca duḥkhaṃ tat tvamevā'si balānvitaḥ ।
devadeva jagattrātaḥ paramātmannamo'stu te ॥28॥
kṛpālurbhagavan bhūtvā rakṣa surānsvakāndrutam ।
guroravajñayā cāpi durvāsaso'vamānanāt ॥29॥
śatakraturbhraṣṭarājyo'bhavattaṃ vai samuddhara ।।
tadā tu bhagavānāha madaḥ pātityakārakaḥ ॥1.90.30॥
guroravajñayā sarvaṃ nāśaṃ yātyakhilaṃ svakam ।।
pitrorgurostathā patyuḥ patnyāḥ sādhvyāḥ satāṃ tathā ॥31॥
gavāṃ caivāpamānasya kartṝṇāṃ syānmahān kṣayaḥ ।।
kṛtamindreṇa tādṛgvai taddoṣātsakalaṃ jagat ॥32॥
kṣaṇādduḥkhaṃ samāpannaṃ sadya eva nirīkṣyatām ।।
viparīto yadā kālastadā sarvaṃ samāpayet ॥33॥
viparīte tadā kāle dhairyamālambya sandhinā ।
śatruṇā'pi militvaiva svakāryaṃ sādhayet sudhīḥ ॥34॥
ata indra tvayā kāryo daityaiḥ saha samāgamaḥ।
militvā naṣṭaratnāni prāpsyante tūdyamātpunaḥ ॥35॥
sāhāyyado bhaviṣyāmi samudramathane'nvaham ।।
daityā devā militvaiva prāpsyāmaḥ svadhanaṃ punaḥ ॥36॥
ityājñaptastadā cendro jagāma sutalaṃ balim ।
āśrito vinayī bhūtvā nanāma prabalaṃ balim ॥37॥
balinā'pi tadā dṛṣṭo niḥśrīko niṣprabho'madaḥ ।।
vimatsaro gatatejāḥ surarājo mahartimān ॥38॥
nirmadaṃ taṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā dayāpanno balistadā ।।
uvācendraṃ tu sāmānya prahasanniva dākṣyataḥ ॥39॥
kasmādihā''gataḥ śakra ! sutalaṃ prati kathyatām ।
jijñāsamānaṃ jñātāraṃ samayajñaṃ baliṃ tadā ॥1.90.40॥
indraḥ prāha bale ! sarvaratnāni vigatāni vai ।।
yathā vayaṃ tathā yūyaṃ ratnahīnāḥ kaliśritāḥ ॥41॥
mama rājyaṃ tvayā nītaṃ kālavegena vigrahāt ।
na te bhogyaṃ jāyate tadvinendrapadavīṃ nṛpa ! ॥42॥
daityahastagatānyeva ratnāni subahūnyapi ! ।
ayogyānīti tānyeva yatratyāni gatāni tat ॥43॥
idānīṃ rājyaratnādivihīno'haṃ talādhipa !।
tasmātprayatnaḥ kartavyo ratnānāṃ labdhaye tvayā ॥44॥
śaraṇārthamahaṃ prāptaḥ suraiḥ saha tavāntikam ।।
amṛtaṃ tu samudrādvai punarāptavyameva ha ॥45॥
tatra te tu yathāyogyaṃ svatvaṃ dāsye tu labdhijam ।
devā daityā militvaiva samudramathanaṃ muhuḥ ॥46॥
kariṣyāmastadā tatra gatāni yāni tāni vai ।।
lapsyāmahe śaraṇyastvaṃ sāhāyyaṃ dātumarhasi ॥47॥
evamuktastadendreṇa balidaityapatiḥ svayam ।
vimṛśya parayā buddhyā kāryākāryavicakṣaṇaḥ ॥48॥
śakraṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa bahumānapuraḥsaram ।।
śakraḥ saṃsmṛtya vacanaṃ viṣṇoḥ svārthaprasādhanam ॥49॥
prāptavyāni tvayā vīra ratnāni subahūnyapi ।
śīghraṃ coddharaṇe daitya ! yatno manthe vidhīyatām ।।1.90.50॥
evaṃ sa samayaṃ kṛtvā yatnārthamakaronmanaḥ ।।
balirāha tadā śakraṃ kenendra ! mathanaṃ bhavet ॥51॥
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī viṣṇurūpātmikā śubhā ।
uvāca devadaityāṃśca manthata kṣīrasāgaram ॥52॥
mandarācalamanthānaṃ manthanarajjuvāsukim ।।
kṛtvā devāśca daityāśca saṃhṛtya kurutā'rthadam ।।53।।
iti śrutvā tadā daityā udyamaṃ kartumutsukāḥ ।।
pātālebhyo nirgatāste dānavā asurādayaḥ ॥54॥
koṭiśaste tadā cātha devā api tu koṭiśaḥ ।।
udyuktā brahmaviṣṇubhyāṃ yuktā yayuśca mandaram ॥55॥
candraṃ spṛśate yacchṛgaṃ pādāni balisattale ।
śroṇīḥ pṛthvyāṃ tu yasyāsti mandaraṃ taṃ namāmahe ॥56॥
anekadevasaṃvāsa ratnānāmākarākaram ।
sarvauṣadhisamākīrṇaṃ natāḥ smo girimandaram ॥57॥
adre ! surā vayamatra sāhāyyārthaṃ samāgatāḥ ।
balirindro babhāṣāte prastāvasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ ॥58||
amṛtotpādanasyārthe manthastvaṃ bhava gotraja !।
tatheti matvā śailendraḥ prāha tacchṛṇvatāṃ vacaḥ ॥59॥
tvayā vajreṇa pakṣau me śātitau hi sureśvara !।।
kathamāyāmi gacchāmi vyomamārgaṃ vinā taṭam ॥1.90.60॥
tadā mahābalā devā daityāśca militā girim ।
mūlādutpāṭayāmāsurdhṛtvā skandheṣu taṃ tadā ॥61॥
kṣīrābdhitaṭamāptuṃ vai jagmurbahubaleśvarāḥ ।।
devā daityā mandarātibhārākrāntā bahuśramāḥ ॥62॥
mārge eva niṣeduśca mandaraḥ patito bhuvi ।।
tadadhastānmṛtāḥ kecitkecidbhagnā vimūrchitāḥ ॥63॥
punarnetuṃ na vai śaktā mṛtaśokaparāyaṇāḥ ।।
ratnāni tu kadā''psyante hyete tu jīvato gatāḥ ॥64॥
mā'smābhiḥ prāṇahā yatnaḥ kartavyaścāśayā hyayam।
dūre tiṣṭhantu ratnāni parvato'pyatra tiṣṭhatu ॥65॥
vayaṃ svaṃ svaṃ tu vivaraṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sukhāśrayam ।
evaṃ nirāśā bhūtvaivā'bhavaँstūṣṇīṃ kimīkṣakāḥ ॥66॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bṛhaspatisamutpāditakṛtyayā durvāsasaḥ śāpapuruṣeṇa ca svargaṃ parābhūtaṃ ratnāni samudre gatāni brahmendrādayo viṣṇuṃ nītvā balinā daityaiśca sandhāya samudramathanārthaṃ mandarācalā''nayanayatnavanto'bhavannitinirūpaṇanāmā navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥90॥
