adhyāyaḥ 91
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 092 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
paśya lakṣmi ! parvatodvāhane kaṣṭaṃ tu kīdṛśam ।।
asādhye tu mahākārye duḥkhaṃ pūrva tataḥ sukham ॥ 1॥
viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tadā devān daityān prāha hitaṃ vacaḥ ।।
eṣa āyāmi gṛhṇāmi cottolayāmi parvatam ।। 2 ।।
mṛtā bhavantu saprāṇāḥ svasthāśca subalāstathā ।
mā hṛdbalaṃ parityājyaṃ mā kāryā hāsyapātratā ॥ 3 ॥
ityevaṃ procya pakṣīndraṃ garuḍaṃ prāha connaya ।
līlayā tolayitvaiva cañcvā taṃ garuḍastataḥ ॥ 4 ॥
kṣīrodadheruttare tu taṭe nikṣipya tatsthalāt ।
gato vaikuṇṭhameveti devā daityādayastadā ।। 5 ।।
vāsukiṃ varayāmāsū rajjvarthaṃ so'pi cāgataḥ ।
manthanaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā vāsukiṃ rajjumeva ca ॥ 6 ॥
kṛtvā surāsurāḥ sarve mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram ।
devā mukhaṃ parigṛhya yadā tu saṃsthitāstadā ॥ 7 ॥
daityāḥ prāhurvayaṃ pucche na sthāsyāmo'timānitāḥ ।।
kṛtvā devān hariḥ pucche mukhe daityāँścakāra ha ॥ 8 ॥
kṣīrābdhau mathyamāne ca vāsukyasthnāṃ viyojanām ।
tadā jātaṃ vāsukiśca mṛta evopadṛśyate ॥ 9 ॥
atha viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tatra praviṣṭo rajjurūpataḥ ।।
vāsukiśca tadā puṣṭo balamāsādya saṃsthitaḥ ॥1.91.10॥
athāpi mathyamāne'tha parvato'pi gurutvataḥ ।।
vimagno'gāttale nītvā devāndaityānpramanthakān ॥11॥
tadā viṣṇurabhūtkūrmo gatvā vārdhitalāṃ svayam ।।
ūḍhvā taṃ nijapṛṣṭhe sa dadhāreti tadadbhutama ॥12॥
athāpi mathyamāne'tha pārśve namati mandaraḥ ।।
taṃ tu sthiraṃ tadā kartuṃ madhye mūrdhānamāsthitaḥ ॥13॥
viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ caturbhyāṃ vai dorbhyāṃ dhṛtvā vyavasthitaḥ ।।
tadā surāsurāḥ sarve mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram ॥14॥
kaṭhoraṃ kamaṭhapṛṣṭhaṃ kaṭhoro mandarācalaḥ ।।
dvayoḥ saṃgharṣajo vahnirabhūt tatra bhayaṃkaraḥ ॥15॥
jvālāmālāmahāvyāpto didhakṣanniva sāgaram ।।
devā daityāśca taṃ dṛṣṭvā pradudruvuritastataḥ ॥16॥
prāha viṣṇustadā sarvān mā bhayaṃ gacchato'khilāḥ ।।
praśāmyāmi kṣaṇādenaṃ paśyantu mama pauruṣam ॥17॥
saṃkarṣaṇastadā bhūtvā viṣṇurmukhaṃ vivṛtya ca ।
śvāsamekaṃ jagṛhe'tha vahnirudaramāviśat ॥18॥
athāpi mathyamāne'pi viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ hyabhūt ।।
maholbaṇaṃ mahādhūmraṃ mahābāṣpatanūlbaṇam ।।19।।
vyomni sarvatra cā'vyāpnod bāṣparūpaṃ vināśakam ।।
yatra yatra gataṃ tatra prāṇino'nāśayatkṣaṇāt ॥1.91.20॥
śvāsaṃ nītvā tadā sarve mūrchitāḥ śūnyatāṃ gatāḥ ।
mahadviṣaṃ tale cāsīd yāvadvahirna cāgatam ॥21॥
tāvantu tatsthalaṃ tyaktvā viṣṇunāradabodhitāḥ ।
amūrchitā devadaityāḥ śaṃkaraṃ prati cāyayuḥ ॥22॥
bahudhā prārthayāmāsuḥ viṣanāśāya śaṃkaram ।।
māṃgalyaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca devaṃ paśupatiṃ vibhum ।।23॥
sañjīvaya mahādeva tvaṃ trātā tripurāntaka ! ।
rakṣolbaṇādgaralāt tvaṃ kālakūṭānmṛtīśvara ! ॥24॥
evamabhyarthitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ prāha sarvānsurāsurān ।।
matputraṃ vighnahartāraṃ śrīgaṇeśaṃ tu ye janāḥ ॥25।।
na pūjayanti cāraṃbhe kāryasiddhirna saṃbhavet ।।
pratyuta jāyate vighno nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā ॥26॥
asmābhirnirmito devo gaṇeśaḥ kāryasiddhaye ।।
yūyaṃ sarve mahāmagnāḥ pāṇḍityakāṇḍakatthanāḥ ॥27॥
gaṇeśaṃ nā'bhisaṃpūjya kāryāraṃbhakarā yataḥ ।।
kālakūṭaṃ viṣaṃ tasmād vighnārthaṃ samupasthitam ॥28॥
tasmānnamantu taṃ devaṃ pūjayantvadya eva hi ।
vighnaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavet sadyo mā'tra vilambayantu vai ॥29॥
anyathā hi kṛte hyarthe'nyathātvaṃ saṃbhavet kila ।
yadi devo na pūjyeta kāryasiddhikaraḥ sutaḥ ॥1.91.30॥
kāryasiddhirna teṣāṃ vai bhavettu bhavatāṃ yathā ।।
drāgeva śaṃbhuvacanaṃ gṛhītvā te surādayaḥ ॥31॥
pūjayanti gaṇeśaṃ sma kailāse śaṃkaragṛhe ।।
āvāhanaṃ cāsanaṃ ca pādyamācamanārghake ॥32॥
pañcāmṛtakṛtasnānamabhiṣekāplavastathā
vastreṇa mārjanaṃ vastraṃ yajñopavītameva ca ॥33॥
abīraṃ ca gulālaṃ ca sindūrakaṃ ca kuṃkumam ।।
akṣatāśca tathā dūrvāṃkurāṇi dhūpadīpakau ॥34॥
candanaṃ puṣpahāraścā''bhūṣaṇāni prabhojanam ।।
jalapānaṃ laḍḍukāśca tāmbūlā''rārtrike tathā ॥35॥
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca namaskāraḥ stutistathā ।।
phalāni ca kṣamāyāñcā vandanaṃ kusumāñjaliḥ ।।36।।
dvātriṃśadupacāraiḥ saḥ pūjitastejasā jvalan ।
santuṣṭaḥ san gaṇādhyakṣo devānāṃ varado'bhavat ॥37॥
sagaṇeśaḥ tadā śaṃbhuḥ prasanno'bdhiṃ jagāma ha ।।
bāṣpātmakaṃ viṣaṃ tatra grasitvā śvāsavāyunā ॥38॥
hālāhalaṃ mahākṣveḍamākṛṣyā'bdhitalātsvayam ।।
papau brahmapratāpena kaṇṭhe rarakṣa tadviṣam ॥39॥
śuṣkīkṛtaṃ samādhisthayogaiśvaryeṇa śaṃbhunā ।।
tatra tvaci gale kṛṣṇatilaṃ pariṇataṃ tu tat ॥1.91.40॥
kaṇṭhe nīlatilāttasya nīlakaṃṭhā'bhidhā'bhavat ।
viṣapānasya samaye kṣūyamānasya dhūrjaṭeḥ ॥41॥
svalpā viṣakaṇāḥ śvāsād bahirye patitāśca tān ।।
gṛhṇanto dehino jīvā ye te viṣāḍhyajātayaḥ ॥42॥
daṃdaśūkāśca sarpāśca vṛścikāḥ kṛkalāsakāḥ ।।
godhāśca jaळlāळ+āśca kharjanākaṭuvallayaḥ ॥43॥
samabhavaँstato'pyete mamanthurmandarācalam
jalaśaityadyanāvasthahimadehastu candramāḥ ॥44॥
dvitīyāyāḥ kalārūpaḥ pīyūṣasaṃbhṛtastadā ।।
atiśītaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā jagṛhurna surāsurāḥ ॥45॥
śaṃbhurviṣoṣṇatā vyāptaḥ śītāṃśuṃ jagṛhe bhruvi ।।
bhṛguḥ prāha tadā devān grahāḥ sarvepi cottamāḥ ॥46॥
kāryasiddhiṃ praśaṃsanti yatnaṃ kuruta līlayā ।
candraṃ guruḥ samāyāto budhaścaiva samāgataḥ ॥47॥
sūryaścaiva tathā śukraḥ śanirmaṃgala eva ca ।।
tasmāccandrabalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kāryasya siddhaye bhavet ॥48॥
gomantanāmako'yaṃ ca muhūrto'sti jayapradaḥ ।।
etacchrutvā balaṃ te tu dviguṇaṃ prāpya garjitāḥ ॥49॥
mamanthurabdhiṃ tvaritāstāvatsurabhirgauḥ sadā ।।
kāmadughā kapilā sā tūdho bhāravatī śanaiḥ ॥1.91.50॥
jalamārgāttīramāyāt sarvaiḥ saṃpūjitā ca sā ।।
yeṣāṃ dugdhaṃ bhaved bhogyaṃ tairneyā seti nirṇaye ॥51॥
ṛṣibhirdevakāryārthaṃ yajñārthaṃ ca svakīkṛtā ।।
tāvadanyāḥ sitāḥ pītāḥ kṛṣṇā aruṇapāṇḍurāḥ ॥52॥
haridvarṇāścitravarṇā gāvo'nekāstato'bhavan ।
viprāstu munayastā vai jagṛhire pramāṇataḥ ॥53॥
atha sarve susaṃrabdhā mamanthuḥ kṣīrasāgaram ।
kalpavṛkṣastathā pārijāta āmrādayo drumāḥ ॥54॥
jajñire'tha ca tānsarvān taṭe'sthāpayadacyutaḥ ।
punaḥ saṃmathyamānādvai kaustubhākhyaṃ mahāprabham ॥55॥
ratnānāmuttamaṃ ratnaṃ cintāmaṇisamanvitam ।।
hīrakaiśca sahotpannaṃ kaustubhaṃ viṣṇave daduḥ ॥56॥
cintāmaṇiḥ sureśāya daityebhyo hīrakāndaduḥ ।
athāpi mathyamānāttaduccaiḥśravasamadbhutam ॥57॥
bahubhiraśvajātīyairutpannaṃ haraye daduḥ ।।
athāpi mathyamānādvai catuḥṣaṣṭigajānvitam ।।58॥
airāvataṃ mahāratnaṃ caturdantamadānvitam ।
pāṇḍuraṃ śṛṃgisadṛśaṃ turāṣāhe'pi taṃ daduḥ ॥59॥
anye gajāśca bahavo lokapālebhya ārpitāḥ ।
athāpi mathyamānādvai madirā vijayā tathā ॥1.91.60॥
kaṭuśṛṃgī cāhiphenaṃ gṛñjanaṃ laśunaṃ tathā ।।
dhattūraśca tamālaśconmādakā abhavaँstadā ।।61।।
daityaiśca tāmasaistāni gṛhītāni prasahya vai ।।
athāpi mathyamānādvai lakṣmīḥ prādurbabhūva ha ॥62।।
surūpā hāsyavadanā vastrābharaṇabhūṣitā ।।
gauravarṇā divyatanvī yauvanāṃkurasustanī ॥63।।
karāptavanamālā ca nārāyaṇasarūpiṇī ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃ viṣṇuṃ mārgayantīva mohikā ।।64॥
ānvīkṣikī brahmavidyā mūlavidyā sarasvatī ।
ṛddhiḥ siddhiḥ smṛddhiḥ sampadvaiṣṇavī prakṛtiḥ parā ॥65॥
yuktā'nyābhiḥ sudāsībhiḥ sugrīvā cārulocanā ।
bimbauṣṭhī sunasā snigdhā sudatī ca sumadhyamā ॥66।।
nānāratnaprakāśaiśca nīrājitamukhāmbujā ।
saumyapremabhṛtanetrā nūpuraraśanādharā ॥67।।
mūrdhani dhriyamāṇena svarṇachatreṇa rājitā ।
cāmarairvijyamānā ca stūyamānā sakhījanaiḥ ॥68।
pāṇḍuraṃgagajārūḍhā vīkṣitāśca surāsuraiḥ ।।
devāṃśca dānavān siddhāँścāraṇānpannagānnagān ॥69॥
vīkṣya daityānsadoṣānsā yogyaṃ viṣṇumacintayat ।।
sarve tadā vismitāśca mudamāpustadā'dbhutam ।।1.91.70।।
lakṣmyā vṛto mahāviṣṇurlakṣmīstenaiva saṃvṛtā ।
evaṃ parasparaṃ prītyā vavrāte prematatparau ।।71।।
sarvaiḥ sabhājitau ratnairnīrājitau prapūjitau ।
śuśubhāte tadā lakṣmīnārāyaṇau jagadgurū।।72।।
praṇamya saccidānandaṃ ramāyuktaṃ janārdanam ।।
sarve mamanthurvegena jajñe dhanvantaristataḥ ॥73॥
so'yaṃ dhanvantarirvaidyaḥ pūrvaṃ yaḥ kathito mayā ।
tṛtīyo vaidyasāmudro yuvā mṛtyujayo'jitaḥ ।।74॥
sudhāsampūrṇakalaśaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ parigṛhya ca ।
rūpeṇa vayasā kāntyā'dharīkṛtya surā'surān ॥75॥
samudrāttīramāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā tastaṃbhurīśvarāḥ।
na jñātavanto yāvatte sudhāṃ cāsya karasthitām ॥76॥
mathyamānārṇavālāvalakṣamapsarasāṃ śubham ।।
samutpannaṃ sthitaṃ tīre dhanvantarī sumohitam ।।77॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne samudre mandaramanthane viṣṇurūpāṇi, manthanotpannasya vaḍavānalasya saṃkarṣaṇakṛtaṃ pānaṃ śaṃkarakṛtaṃ viṣasyapānaṃ gaṇeśapūjanaṃ vividharatnotpattiśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ekanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥91।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! tvayā tulyāstanvyo dvādaśahāyanāḥ ।
apsarasaḥ surūpāśca śaśiśītalamadhyamāḥ ।। 1 ।।
svargaṃ jagmuḥ svakaṃ sthānaṃ tvājñayā śrīharestataḥ ।।
paśyatāṃ daityavaryāṇāṃ dānavādipramāthinām ।। 2 ।।
dhanvantariṃ tadā prāha dānavendro baliḥ svayam ।
bhagavan kiṃ dhṛtaṃ haste kalaśe'tra prapūritam ।। 3 ।।
svakaṃ vā sārvajanikaṃ sudhā notpadyate kutaḥ ।
dhanvantarirbaliṃ prāha sudhā'tra kalaśe sthitā ॥ 4 ॥
nātaḥ parā samudre vai sudhā svalpāpi śiṣyate ।।
tāvattu daityadhaureyā hartukāmād balād yayuḥ ॥ 5 ॥
vṛṣaparvā mahādaityo ghaṭaṃ nītvā palāyitaḥ ।।
asurāstu tadā sarve jagarjuritibhīṣaṇam ॥ 6 ॥
mandaraṃ vāsukiṃ tyaktvā labdhakāryāḥ svamāninaḥ ।
svārthamātraparāstatrā'mṛtaṃ labdhvāticukruśuḥ ।। 7 ।।।
nārāyaṇo garuḍena mandaraṃ nītavān sthale ।
anyarūpāṇi saṃhṛtya saṃsthito'bdhitare prabhuḥ ॥ 8 ॥
daityāḥ sudhādharaṃ nītvā palāyante payo'rṇavāt ।
ratnānyanyāni devaistu gṛhītānyeva kevalam ।। 9 ।।
tasmātsudhāṃ grahīṣyāmo'nyebhyo dāsyāma eva na ।
ityuccārya sudhāṃ nītvā palāyante tu yāvatā ॥1.92.10॥
tāvadviṣṇuḥ svayaṃ kanyā babhūva mohinī śubhā ।
śvetatejaḥ pūritāṃgā samaṃkuritayauvanā ।।11।।
mitahāsyā kaṃjanetrā hāvabhāvavilāsinī ।
anaṃgapūrṇā netrābhyāmāhvayantī vilāsinaḥ ॥12॥
netrāpāṃgaiḥ sudhāyuktaṃ daityaṃ cānyān vimohitum ।।
teṣāṃ pālāyane mārge samīpe samupasthitā ॥13॥
ślathayantī śanairnīvīṃ vastraṃ hastena bibhratī ।।
sakthistanau darśayantī kāmavyāpteva kāminī ॥14॥
daityā ayatnalabhyāṃ tāṃ parirabdhuṃ prapedire ।
ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ mama bhāryā na vai tava ।।15।।
mayā netreṇa pūrvaṃ vai dṛṣṭā ca dyotitā mayā ।
na tvayeti muhurmugdhāḥ sudhāṃ tyaktvā parasparam ॥16
tadā vivadire devī sudhāyāḥ kalaśaṃ kare ।
dhṛtvā prāha ca tāndaityān matkṛte vivadantu mā ॥17॥
sudhāpānaṃ kārayitvā no bhajiṣye sadā'mṛtān ।
ye vai mayoktaṃ gṛhṇīyustānpāsyāmi sudhāmṛtam ॥18॥
teṣāṃ dāsī bhavāmyeva bhujyatāṃ pramadāmṛtam ।
dhanyā yūyaṃ mahābhāgā vinā yatnena cāgatam ॥19॥
prāpsyatha pramadāratnaṃ sudhāpānottara dhruvam ।
aho mayā'tra saṃsāre narāḥ sarve'valokitāḥ ॥1.92.20॥
bhavatāṃ sadṛśā naiva jñātāro bhadrakāriṇaḥ ।
śāntā vibhajya bhoktāro viśvastā nirmalāntarāḥ ॥21॥
paropakāradharmajñāḥ strīvaconyastanirṇayāḥ ।
strīṇāṃ sukhena sukhinaḥ strīkṛcchāsanamārdavāḥ ॥26॥
strīpradattaprabhoktāro dhanyā yūyaṃ bhavādṛśāḥ ।
vidvāṃso naiva kurvanti viśvāsaṃ pramadājane ॥23॥
vṛthā doṣānkalpayanti māyāsāhasamanṛtam ।
atilobho'timūrkhatvamaśaucaṃ nirdayālutā ॥24॥
asneho dhūrtatā svārthaḥ pracchannakāritādayaḥ ।।
mamāsti yadi viśvāsastadā pibantu matkarāt ॥25॥
sarva tiṣṭhantu paṃktyā vai nā'pāṃkto'mṛtamaśnute !
vāme devāḥ pratiṣṭhantu dakṣiṇe daityadānavāḥ ॥26॥
dvayoḥ pariveṣayitrī bhavāmi nyāyataḥ kramāt ।
eṣā ghaṭaṃ ca gṛhṇāmi dadhatvagre prapāpuṭam ॥27॥
mohinī cetyabhidhāya tūṣṇīmāsīt kṣaṇaṃ hṛdi ।
paścādvicārya provāca hṛdyaṃ sarvābhisammatam ॥28॥
śṛṇvantu cāsurāḥ sarve bhavanto jyeṣṭhapūrvajāḥ ।।
avibhajya na bhoktavyaṃ yallabdhaṃ sārvayatnikam ॥29॥
surāsurāṇāṃ yatnastu samāno'styabdhimanthane ।
kiñcidapi pramāthibhyo nyāyyaṃ deyaṃ sudhāmṛtam ॥1.92.30॥
mahadbhyaścādhikaṃ deyaṃ svalpebhyo nyūnameva ca ।
balābale parijñāyā'vaśyaṃ deyaṃ pramāthine ॥31॥
yatne ye tu sahārthāḥ syuḥ phale tu pakṣapātinaḥ ।।
teṣāṃ pātaḥ sadā bhāvī labdhārtho'pi vinaśyati ।।32॥
asurāṇāṃ yadi mānyaṃ maduktaṃ nyāyato bhavet ।।
tadā surebhyo dātavyamamṛtaṃ bhāgaśaḥ kṛtam ॥33॥
pucche surā mukhe yūyaṃ madhye devo janārdanaḥ ।।
tasmādardhaṃ surebhyaścā'surebhyo'rdhaṃ pradīyate ।।34॥
balistatra pramāṇaṃ vai kāryākāryavicakṣaṇaḥ ।।
evameva baliḥ prāha sarve prāhuśca omiti ॥35॥
athāmṛtavibhāgārthaṃ ghaṭo'nyo'pyarthitastvayā ।।
daityaistu saṃbhramāt tūrṇaṃ ghaṭo rikto'tra yo bhavet ॥36॥
dātavya iti kṛtvaiva madirāyā ghaṭaśca yaḥ ।।
madirāpātṛbhiḥ pītvā madirāṃ tu visarjitaḥ ॥37॥
rikto ghaṭaḥ pradattaḥ sa mohinyā saṃdhṛtastataḥ ।।
madirāyā ghaṭe tasmiँścānamayya sudhāghaṭam ॥38॥
yathā'rdhamamṛtaṃ tatra dīyate dhārayā tathā ।।
mṛṣaiva darśitaṃ sarvaṃ mohinyā svaprabhāvataḥ ॥39॥
dṛśyate cāmṛtaṃ kṣiptaṃ jāyate madirā tu sā ।।
sāpi mṛṣaiva madirā miṣṭā cā'mṛtasadṛśī ।।1.92.40॥
saṃklṛptā madirā mithyā mohinyā māyayā svayā ।।
amṛtaṃ ceti vai tatrā'surāṇāṃ niścayo'bhavat ।।41॥
satyāmṛtaghaṭaṃ vāme mithyāmṛtaṃ tu dakṣiṇe ।
kare dhṛtvā mohinī sā paṃktimadhye cacāra vai ॥42॥
sā mithyāmadirādānaṃ karotyasurapātrake।
satyāmṛtapradānaṃ tu karoti surapātrake ॥43॥
pradadāti samastāँśca mohayatyapi narmaṇā ।
agre tvagre gatā tuṣṭā datvā datvā'surānsurān ॥44॥
praśaṃsantaḥ pibanti sma devā daityādayastathā ।
ghaṭukaṃ ghaṭukaṃ pītvā ḍakārayanti tṛptitaḥ ॥45॥
mohinyapi tadā devān pibatā'mṛtamutsavāt ।
daityān prāhā''svādayantu miṣṭaṃ paramamutsavāt ॥46॥
aho surāṇāṃ paramo bhāgyodaya upasthitaḥ।
yadamṛtaṃ prāpyate'dyā''svādayantu muhurmuhuḥ ॥47॥
aho devā pibantvatrā'mṛtaṃ bhāgyā'valambitam ।।
indra sūrya śaśinnagre jaleśa yama nirṛta ! ॥48॥
kubereśāna vāyo maṃgala cāndra bṛhaspate ।
dharma vasavo rudrāśca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ॥49॥
nidhayaḥ ṛṣayaḥ sādhyā nakṣatrā maruto'pi ca ।
gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ kiṃpuruṣā vidyādhraviśvinaḥ ॥1.92.50॥
saṃvatsarāḥ pāvakāḥ pitaro devyaśca pārṣadāḥ ।
pibantvamṛtamākaṇṭhaṃ divyabhāṇḍātpradīyate ॥51॥
atha daityānprasaṃbodhya mohinī prāha vai śaṭhā ।।
bale rājan vṛṣaparvan namuce śaṃkhabudbudau ।।52।।
sudaṃṣṭra śṛṇu saṃhlāda kālaneme vibhīṣaṇa ।।
vātāpe celvala kuṃbha nikuṃbha praghasa śṛṇu ।।53॥
upasunda bho niśuṃbha śuṃbha bho sunda saṃśṛṇu ।
mātaṃga māhiṣa mahiṣa biḍālāsya ca cikṣura ॥54॥
bahubāho jṛṃbha vṛṣa vibāho ghoradarśana ।
ghorākṣa bho mahādaityāḥ śṛṇvantu pānakālikam ॥55॥
nā'yaṃ lābho bhavetkvāpi mama hastātsukomalāt ।
kumārikākarāt prāptaṃ svādānandaṃ bhajantviha ॥56॥
nāsā netre tu sammīlya gṛhṇantu ghuṭakān bahūn ।
dāsye punaḥ punaḥ peyaṃ mṛṣā deho'yamityataḥ ।।57॥
saṃpibantu mahābhāgā nāmnā'pyamṛtavatsukham ।।
prāptaṃ yasya tu satyaṃ sa jāyate tvamṛtaḥ sadā ।।58॥
vadamānā dadānā ca ramyā'gre yāti mohinī ।।
vākyārthajño rāhunāmā jānanvai svāmṛtaṃ mṛṣā ॥59॥
satyāmṛtaprapānāya devānāṃ rūpadhārakaḥ ।।
upaviṣṭo devapaṃktau madhye candrārkayoḥ kramāt ॥1.92.60॥
mohinī pradadānā cā''gatā tatra kramāgatam ।।
sūryaṃ rāhuṃ tathā candraṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā dadau sudhām ।।61॥
tāvatsūryeṇa saṃdiṣṭo rāhuḥ paṃktau praveśitaḥ ।।
śaśinā'pi sa ādiṣṭo devo nā'yaṃ surārirāṭ ॥62॥
mohinī tu nijaṃ kāryaṃ karotyagre pragacchati ।।
viṣṇurūpaḥ svayaṃ rāhoḥ śiraściccheda cakrataḥ ॥63॥
galordhvaṃ sudhayā vyāptaṃ kabandhaḥ klinatāṃ gataḥ ।।
ekasmāttu sudhāyogād rāhuketū babhūvatuḥ ॥64॥
dvau tau cāmaratāṃ prāptau grahāvabhavatāṃ tataḥ ।।
śiraḥ ketuḥ kabandhastu rāhurgraho'sti daityarāṭ ॥65॥
sūryaṃ parvaṇi grasati kvaciccandraṃ sa rāhukaḥ ।।
tau dvau tadā sudhāṃ tyaktvā paṃktito vai palāyitau ॥66॥
dhūmrarūpo'bhavatpūrvaṃ dhūmrarūpau babhūvatuḥ ।।
ākāśe bhramati so'yaṃ dhūmraketurgraho hi saḥ ॥67॥
diteḥ putrāstathā cānye vyomni vai dhūmraketavaḥ ।
na sūryaṃ na ca candraṃ te grasante na grahā yataḥ ॥68॥
athaitat kautukaṃ vīkṣya śaṃkamānā tu mohinī ।।
tadānīṃ tvaritā paṃktau devānapāyayatsudhām ॥69॥
rāhuṇā dvisvarūpeṇa daityebhyastatra sūcitam ।
yuṣmābhirnā'mṛtaṃ pītaṃ pītā yā madirā tu sā ।।1.92.70॥
nāryā paṃktivibhedastu kṛto nāśakaro mahān ।।
tasmādyuddhaṃ prakurvantu mārayantu surāndrutam ॥71॥
kāpaṭyena tayā dattā madirā'pi mṛṣātmikā ।।
viṣṇunā strīsvarūpeṇa devebhyaścārpitā sudhā ॥72॥
yaugapadyena sarvaistu kṣīrābdhermathanaṃ kṛtam ।।
siddhirjātā hi devānāmasiddhistu surāriṇām ।।73॥
vinā daivena jānīdhvamudyamaṃ hi nirarthakam ।।
tataḥ kopānalo māyāmohitā'suramaṇḍale ॥74॥
prodbhūtastena śastrāstrairyutā yuddhāya niryayuḥ ।।
devāścāpi tathā sajjā babhūvurbhayavarjitāḥ ।।75॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne asurāṇā pratāraṇāya mohinīrūpa viṣṇunā devebhyaḥ sudhā daityebhyo mṛṣāmadirā pāyitā rāhuśiracchedaḥ ketugrahaśca kṛta ityādi nirūpaṇanāmā dvinavatita
mo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 92 ।।

cāmaraiḥ paṭahaiḥ śaṃkhaistūryaiśca dvigalaistathā ॥15॥
tadvat sarve surāścendrapramukhā raṇagāminaḥ ।
pītvā'mṛtaṃ mahābhāgā vāhānāruhya daṃśitāḥ ॥16॥
svasvabalasamāyuktā daityānprati samutkaṭāḥ ।।
gajārūḍho mahendraśca sūryaścoccaiḥśravaḥsthitaḥ ॥17॥
śaśārūḍhaḥ śaśī tadvad yamo mahiṣamāsthitaḥ ।।
nairṛtaḥ pretapṛṣṭhastho varuṇo makare sthitaḥ ॥18॥
pavanastu mṛgārūḍho vṛṣārūḍhaḥ śivastathā ।।
kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho devāścānye balānvitāḥ ॥19॥
vimānasthā lakṣalakṣāḥ pakṣisthāḥ koṭiśastathā ।।
paśumṛgādivāhasthā hyarbudā devakoṭayaḥ ॥1.93.20॥
svasvābhimānasaṃyuktāḥ sarve devāstvarānvitāḥ ।।
chatracāmarasaṃvītāḥ śobhitā vijayaśriyāḥ ॥21॥
viṣṇuṃ praṇamya saṃgrāme raṇe daityānupasthitāḥ ।
bhīmāstatrā'surāḥ sarve surāśca bhīmavikramāḥ ॥22॥
teṣāṃ ghoramabhūd yuddhaṃ daityadānavanākibhiḥ ।।
mahāghoraṃ mahānāśaṃ sarvabhūtabhayāvaham ॥23॥
bāṇavarṣi śastraghāti cā'strakṣepi bhayānakam ।
śabdā hṛnnāśakā jātāḥ śarapātāstathā'bhavan ॥24॥
tīratomaranārācairāhatāstvapatan bhuvi ।
vadhyamānāstathā kecitsamādhiṃ tatra lebhire ॥25॥
bhallairbhagnā nipatitā nārācaiḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ ।
kṣuraiḥ prahāritāḥ kecinmudgaraiśca vipothitāḥ ॥26॥
śastraghātaiḥ prabhinnāśca chinnāśca bāṇapātanaiḥ ।।
daityasainyaṃ mahāmārairbhagnaṃ devāśca prahṛṣuḥ ॥27॥
śaṃkhanādānprakurvāṇāḥ sūcayāṃcakrire jayam ।।
devānprati kṛtāmarṣā dānavāste mahābalāḥ ॥28॥
baliprabhṛtayaḥ sarve saṃśrameṇotthitāḥ punaḥ ।।
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃkāśairanekaistvarayā'nvitāḥ ॥29॥
dvandvayuddhamabhūtteṣāṃ surāṇāmasuraiḥ saha ।।
balinā dānavendreṇa mahendro yuyudhe tadā ॥1.93.30॥
yamo namucinā sārdhaṃ nairṛtaḥ praghasena ca ।
kuṃbhena saha varuṇo nikuṃbhena samīraṇaḥ ॥31॥
sudaṃṣṭreṇa kuberastu śeṣaiḥ śeṣā vavalmire।
rāhuṃ ketuṃ samāyāntau dṛṣṭvā devāḥ palāyitāḥ ॥32॥
ketunā vyomasadṛśaṃ mukhaṃ svasya prasāritam ।
devānāṃ vai bhakṣaṇārthaṃ devāḥ pradudruvustadā ।।33।।
keciddhariṃ smaranti sma kecidbhaktyā vināyakam ।।
kecid durgāṃ tathā śaṃbhuṃ brahmāṇaṃ cā'pare'mṛtam ॥34॥
rāhuśiraḥ puraskṛtya daityā jayonmukhāḥ surān ।
tāḍayāmāsuratyugrāḥ śastrāstraprastarādibhiḥ ॥35॥
devāḥ palāyitā daityā jayaṃ samāpnuvaँstadā ।
keturādau mukhaṃ svaṃ vai vyādāya grasituṃ harim ।।36॥
candraṃ śaktaṃ tathā sūryaṃ taṃ taṃ samīpamāgatam ।
udyukto'bhūdamṛto'sau vajreṇāpi na naśyati ॥37॥
tadā candro mahādevamastaut dhāvan kṛtāṃjaliḥ ।
tvaṃ śaṃbho trāhi māṃ deva śaraṇāgatarakṣaka ॥38॥
devāँstrāhi tathā sarvān ketuduḥkhaṃ vināśaya ।।
evamabhyarthitaḥ śaṃbhurmā bhaiṣṭetyavadatsutān ॥39॥
ketustatrā'gamaccandraṃ grasituṃ yāvadeva hi ।
dhṛtaśca śaṃbhunā keturmuṇḍamālāsu gumphitaḥ ॥1.93.40॥
ketū rūpadvayaṃ kṛtvā jagāma divi tatsthalāt ।।
śaṃbhuṃ tadā puraskṛtya devā yuddhe mano dadhuḥ ॥41॥
surairdaityā hanyamānāḥ śastrāstrabāṇatomaraiḥ ।।
nipeturbahavastatra kṣatā bhagnāśca kartitāḥ ॥42॥
cakrurbhuvaṃ mṛtā daityā māṃsaśoṇitakardamām ।।
nadyo bhayāvahāstatra vahanti mṛtadānavān ॥43॥
dhvajayantrapatākā'nogajavājiśirāṃsi ca ।।
agādhāḥ śoṇitodāśca pravahanti raṇāṃgaṇe ॥44॥
tathā tasminmahāraudre surāsurasamāgame ।।
śaktyā jaghāna devendraṃ vairocaniramarṣaṇaḥ ॥45॥
śaktiṃ tāṃ vaṃcayitvendro baliṃ vajreṇa tatkṣaṇam ।।
jaghāna bāhuṃ ciccheda bhūmāvapātayad baliḥ ॥46॥
vajreṇa ca punarvṛṣaparvāṇamapyapātayat ।।
tatrāpi śatadhāreṇa vajreṇaiva punaḥ punaḥ ॥47॥
anyena hetinā cendro dānavānavadhīdraṇe ।।
śirāṃsi kartitānyevendreṇa prakupitena vai ॥48॥
yamena vāyunā caiva varuṇena tathā'gninā ।
nairṛtena kubereṇa śaṃbhunāpi vidāritāḥ ॥49॥
ityevaṃ kadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kālanemimahāsuraḥ।
siṃhastho daṃśitaścograḥ triśūlena samanvitaḥ ॥1.93.50॥
daityānāmarbudenaiva siṃhārūḍhena saṃgataḥ ।
siṃhasthāṃ daityasenāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā cendrapurogamāḥ ॥51॥
kiṃ kurmo'dya vayaṃ sarve jeṣyāmaḥ kathamāsurān ।
vinā viṣṇuṃ nā'sya jetā kaścidanyo hi lakṣyate ॥52॥
iti viṣṇuṃ smarantaścā'stuvannārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
namastubhyaṃ bhagavate namaste viśvanāyaka ॥53॥
śrīnivāsa namastubhyaṃ suratrātre namo namaḥ ।।
trātumarhasi daityendrakālanemibhayādiha ॥54॥
śrutvā stotraṃ hariḥ śīghramāruhya garuḍe svakam ।
cakrapāṇiḥ samāyāto devānāṃ vijayāya vai ॥55॥
hariṃ dṛṣṭvā kālanemiḥ prahasyovāca roṣataḥ ।
kastvaṃ kathaṃ samāyāto mama śastrasya bhojanam ॥56॥
hariḥ prāha tadā daityaṃ yuddhārthaṃ samupāgataḥ ।
devānāṃ mūlabhūto'haṃ sthiro bhava sumṛtyave ॥57॥
sapakṣasiṃhasainyena kālanemirvihāyasā ।।
yuyudhe sagaruḍena śāṅgapāṇisuviṣṇunā ॥58॥
garuḍena tadā tuṇḍapakṣanakhādihetibhiḥ ।।
siṃhā daityāḥ pāṭitāśca khaṇḍitāśca vināśitāḥ ॥59॥
viṣṇunā svīyacakreṇa nihatāḥ śakalīkṛtāḥ ।
triśūlenā'hanadviṣṇuṃ kālanemiḥ pratāpavān ॥1.93.60॥
vāmahastena saṃgṛhya triśūlaṃ tattu līlayā ।
tenaiva ca triśūlena kālanemiṃ jaghāna ha ॥61॥
mūrchitaḥ patitaścāthotthāyonmīlya svalocane ।
dhṛtvā khaḍgaṃ samadhāvadviṣṇuṃ tāvattu viṣṇunā ॥62॥
cakreṇa kartitaṃ tasya mastakaṃ tatkṣaṇāt khalu ।।
anye daityāstu devaiśca hatā naṣṭā kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ॥63॥
kālanemirhato daityo devā jātā hyakaṃṭakāḥ ।।
tirodhānaṃ gato viṣṇurindrastatrā'karod dayām ॥64॥
patitaklībarūpāṇāṃ bhagnānāṃ bhītacetasām ।
muktakacchaśikhānāṃ ca cakre svāsthyakriyāṃ hariḥ ॥65॥
āyāt triviṣṭapaṃ cātha surasenānvito hariḥ ।।
babhūvurmuditāḥ sarve yakṣagandharva kinnarāḥ ॥66॥
devarṣayo brahmarṣayaḥ procurindro'bhiṣicyatām ।।
sa evendro'marāvatyāmabhiṣiktaḥ śacīyutaḥ ॥67॥
tadā mahotsavo lakṣmi ! devaloke paro'bhavat ।।
śaṃkhapaṭahamṛdaṃgamurajānakagomukhāḥ ॥68॥
bherīdundubhitūryāṇi neduḥ svarge gṛhe gṛhe ।।
jaguśca gāyakāḥ sarve gandharvāḥ kinnarāstathā ॥69॥
tuṣṭuvuśca tadā siddhagandharvacāraṇarṣayaḥ ।
nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇā utsavo'bhūtsthale sthale ॥1.93.70॥
śukrācāryo daityagurustapo'rthaṃ mānasottaram ।
gato'bhūt kṣayamāśrutya jagāma samarāṃgaṇe ।।71॥
saṃjivanyā vidyayā sa mṛtadaityānajīvayat ।।
nidrāpāyagatā yadvadutthitāste tadāsurāḥ ।।7।।
te'pi sarve nivāsārthaṃ pātālamagaman sukham ।।
sudhāpānapralābhena devā naivā'mriyanta ha ।।73॥
vāhanādīni bhagavān saṃkalpenā'pyajīvayat ।
iti devi ! samudrasya manthanaṃ tvabhavatpurā ॥74।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sudhāpānabhedajanyadevā'surasaṃgrāmendrābhiṣekādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥93॥


← adhyāyaḥ 093 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 94
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 095 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca--
nārāyaṇaṃ bhavantaṃ vai tyaktvā gaṇeśapūjanam ।
prathamaṃ vai kathaṃ kena kadā klṛptaṃ taducyatām ॥ 1॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca----
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! kathāṃ ramyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇātmakabodhadām ।
sa cāṃśaḥ kṛṣṇacandrasya tathaivā'yonisaṃbhavaḥ ॥ 2 ॥
mahālakṣmīḥ svayaṃ māyā dakṣakanyā babhūva ha ।।
sā ca nāmnā satī śaṃbhornindayā dakṣajanyayā ।। 3 ।।
dehaṃ tyaktvā menakāyāṃ himālayāttu pārvatī ।
jātā tāṃ parvataḥ putrīṃ śaṃkarāya dadau mudā ।। 4 ।।
tāṃ gṛhītvā mahādevo jagāma vijanaṃ vanam ।।
gārhasthyayogyakuṭyāṃ tu sadā nivasatostayoḥ ॥ 5 ॥
sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ śṛṃgāro hyabhavat sukhaḥ ।
devānāṃ garbhato janma putrāṇāṃ naiva jāyate ॥ 6 ॥
putrā'labdhyā tu pārvatyāḥ sukhaṃ kiñcinna jāyate ।
dine dine gate tasyāḥ putraspṛhā vyavardhata ॥ 7 ॥
rateḥ phalaṃ sukhaṃ putro hyubhayaṃ saṃbhavatyapi ।।
putraphalaṃ vinā''nando vārdhakye duḥkhado bhavet ॥ 8 ॥
putraśūnyaṃ ratimātraṃ bhāvyudvegāya kalpyate ।।
vinā'patyaṃ striyā kālakṣepaḥ kāryastu kena vai ॥ 9 ॥
patyā samaṃ rateḥ kālakṣepo bhavati svalpakaḥ ।।
tadanyakālagamakaṃ striyo'patyaṃ bhavediha ॥1.94.10॥
lālane pālane tasya krīḍanakādikarmaṇi ।।
samayo'tyeti nārīṇāṃ sa eva svarga ucyate ।।11॥
svāmisukhaṃ prathamaṃ ca svargaṃ dvitīyamaṃgajam ।
apatyasukhakṛtsvargaṃ tṛtīyaṃ dhanadhānyajam ।।12।।
caturthaṃ tu bhavetsvargamārogyaṃ paṃcamaṃ yaśaḥ ।
ityetānyeva saukhyāni svargāṇi laukikāni hi ॥13॥
iti cintānvitā nityaṃ reme svasvāminā saha ।
śaṃbhurvijñāya tadhārdaṃ tāṃ papraccha pativratām ।।14॥
kimicchasi priye ! nityaṃ kiṃ te manasi vartate ।
kiṃ vai cintayase ratyāṃ brūhi kriye tavepsitam ॥15॥
pārvatī prāha deveśa ! kiṃ me nyūnaṃ tavāntike ।
sarvadaḥ sarvalokānāṃ kartā labdho mayā yataḥ ॥16॥
yatra bhagavato vāsastatra syuḥ susamṛddhayaḥ ।
na nyūnaṃ nā'pyaśāntiśca nā'lābhaḥ preṣṭhavastunaḥ ।।17।।
ṛtūttaraṃ tu nārīṇāṃ preṣṭhaḥ patistataḥ sutaḥ ।।
mayā patistrilokeśaḥ prāpto'pi nāsti me sutaḥ ।।18।।
putreṣaṇā hṛdaye me jāgarti tava darśane ।
yadā yadā tu deveśa paśyāmi tvāṃ tadā tadā ॥19॥
saṃkalpo jāyate mohād balena cāgrapūjayā ।।
patidevasamāno me kadā putro bhavediti ॥1.94.20॥
kāntānāṃ kāntavicchedaḥ prathamaṃ duḥkhamucyate ।।
kāntasattve yadyaratidvitīyaṃ duḥkhamucyate ॥21॥
duḥkhātirekiduḥkhaṃ ca tṛtīyamanapatyatā ।।
trailokyakāntaṃ kāntaṃ tvāṃ labdhvāpi na ca me sutaḥ ॥22॥
yā strī putravihīnā'syā jīvanaṃ tannirarthakam ।
janmāntarakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ tapodānajapādibhiḥ ॥23॥
tadā putraḥ prajāyeta paratreha sukhapradaḥ ।
suputro nijapitraṃśaḥ pitṛtulyasukhapradaḥ ॥24॥
kuputrastu kulāṃgāro manastāpāya kevalam ।।
prārthayanti janāstasmāt suputro me bhavediti ॥25॥
svāmī svāṃśena sustrīṇāṃ garbhe janma labhed dhruvam ।।
sādhvī strī mātṛtulyā ca satataṃ hitakāriṇī ॥26॥
asādhvī vairitulyā ca śaśvatsaṃtāpadāyinī ।
kimupāyaṃ kariṣyāmi vada putraphalaprada ॥27॥
ityuktvā pārvatī devī tūṣṇīmāsa yadā tadā ।।
prahasya śaṃkaro devo bodhayāmāsa pārvatīm ॥28॥
śṛṇu pārvati ! vakṣyāmi tava bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।।
prayatnataḥ kāryasiddhiḥ sarveṣāṃ khalu jāyate ॥29॥
sarvasiddhipradaṃ hṛdyamupāyaṃ kathayāmi te ।।
harerārādhanaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kuru varānane ॥1.94.30॥
puṇyakavratasaṃjñaṃ tad varṣamekaṃ kariṣyasi ।।
manorathakalpataruṃ sukhadaṃ putradaṃ vratam ॥31॥
sarvavratānāṃ saṃśreṣṭhaṃ harestatpuṇyakaṃ vratam ।
yathā gaṃgā saritśreṣṭhā yathā deveṣu vai hariḥ ॥32॥
vaiṣṇaveṣu yathā cāhaṃ devīṣu tvaṃ mahāsatī ।।
yathā varṇeṣu vipro vai śreṣṭhastīrtheṣu puṣkaraḥ ॥33॥
puṣpeṣu pārijātaṃ ca patreṣu tulasīdalam ।।
tithiṣvekādaśī śreṣṭhā vāreṣu raviruttamaḥ ॥34॥
māseṣu mārgaśīrṣaśca sarvartuṣu vasantakaḥ ।
saṃvatsaro vatsareṣu kṛtaṃ yugeṣu cottamam ॥35॥
pūjyeṣu ca yathā vidvān mātā gurujaneṣu ca ।
patnī yathā hitakṛtsu viśvasteṣu hṛdantaram ।।36॥
yathā dhaneṣu ratnāni priyeṣu ca patiryathā ।।
yathā bandhuṣu satputro vṛkṣeṣu kalpapādapaḥ ॥37॥
tathā harervrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavrateṣu puṇyakam ।।
phaleṣvāmraphalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vane vṛndāvanaṃ yathā ॥38॥
yathā strīṣu śatarūpā hyurvaśyapsarasāṃ yathā ।।
yathā mātṛṣu kamalā sūryastejasviṣūttamaḥ ॥39॥
āhlādakeṣu candraśca sundareṣu ca manmathaḥ ।
śreṣṭhāḥ śāstreṣu vedāśca siddheṣu kapilo yathā ॥1.94.40॥
kīrtideṣu yathā vidyā vyāpakeṣu prabhuryathā ।
śreṣṭhaṃ cakṣuryathāṃgeṣu satyaṃ puṇyeṣu cottamam ॥41॥
tapassu śrīhareḥ sevā gavyeṣu ghṛtamuttamam ।।
śreṣṭhamamṛtaṃ bhakṣyeṣu śuddheṣu ca hutāśanaḥ ॥42॥
taijaseṣu yathā svarṇaṃ miṣṭeṣu priyabhāṣaṇam ।
patattriṣu ca garuḍaḥ kariṣyairāvato yathā ॥43।।
tathā harervrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvavrateṣu puṇyakam ।।
devarṣiṣu nāradaśca yogiṣu sanakādayaḥ ।।44।।
gandharveṣu citrarathastattveṣu cetano yathā ।
kavane jīvane śukraḥ kṣamāvatsu yathā ca bhūḥ ॥45॥
śreṣṭhā lābheṣu vai muktiḥ sampatsu bhaktiruttamā ।
pavitreṣu yathā sādhurvarṇeṣu praṇavo yathā ।।46॥
mantreṣu śrīharermantro goṣu kāmadughā yathā ।
vedeṣu sāmavedaśca tṛṇeṣu kuśa uttamaḥ ॥47॥
sukhadeṣu yathā jñānaṃ sarpeṣu vāsukiryathā ।
akṣareṣu akāraśca yathā tāto hitaiṣiṣu ।।48।।
catuṣpātsu yathā siṃhaḥ śālagrāmaśca mūrtiṣu ।
yathā buddhiḥ karaṇeṣu śaktimatsu hariryathā ॥49॥
nāśavatsu dvayaṇukaśca dadhīcirdātṛṣūttamaḥ ।।
brahmāstraṃ tu yathā'streṣu cakreṣu ca sudarśanam ॥1.94.50॥
sarvasāro yathā kṛṣṇo vrateṣu puṇyakaṃ tathā ।
vrataṃ kuru mahādevi ! śīghraṃ sveṣṭapradāyakam ॥51॥
sarvaśreṣṭhastu putraste vratādeva bhaviṣyati ।
vratārādhyo hariḥ kṛṣṇo golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ ॥52॥
prasannaḥ sarvadātā sa bhuktimuktiprado bhavet ।
jano yatsevayā bandhānmucyate pitṛkoṭibhiḥ ॥53।।
uddhṛtya koṭipuruṣān goloke sukhamṛcchati ।।
bhrātṝnbhṛtyānsahāyāँścāśritānnārīsutādikān ॥54॥
kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ samuddhṛtya sukhaṃ yāti hareḥ padam ।।
tasmād gṛhāṇa girije ! harermantravrataṃ param ॥55॥
kuru vrataṃ japa mantraṃ śīghraṃ siddhirbhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā jalamādāya devyai mantravaraṃ dadau ।।56॥
śaṃbhurvāme girijāyāḥ karṇe mantraṃ jajāpa ।
pārvatī taṃ dīyamānaṃ mantraṃ dadhyau hṛdi tvimam ॥57॥
“oṃ namo harikṛṣṇāya patirūpadharāya ca ।
bījāya garbharūpāyā'patyarūpāya śaṃbhave ॥58॥
saṃkalpagarbhahṛdyāya namaḥ putrapradāya ca ।
vijetre'grā'rcyarūpāya namo dehi suputrakam ॥59।।
sarvavijayinaṃ dehi sarvāgrā'rcyaṃ ca me sutam ।।
puṇyakaṃ te vrataṃ kṛṣṇa kriyate prītaye tava ॥1.94.60।।
nirvighnaṃ saphalaṃ tatsyāt putrātman sutado bhava ।।
tvatsamaṃ me sutaṃ dehi ciraṃjīvi namo namaḥ ॥61॥
itimantraṃ haradattaṃ gṛhītvā pārvatīṃ sati ।
jagāma jāhnavītīraṃ śaṃbhunā saha pāvanam ॥62॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyai putrajijñāsamānāyai śaṃkarapradattabahudṛṣṭāntasamanvitakṛṣṇamantrapradānapradarśananāmā caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrutvā vratasya kartavyaṃ pārvatī hṛṣṭamānasā ।

gacchāmi svasya golokaṃ vrate tandrāṃ tu mā kuru ॥1.96.50॥
satkṛtaḥ pūjito devastathā'nye'pi divaukasaḥ ।।
āśiṣaśca tadā devyaḥ prayuñjya svagṛhān yayuḥ ॥51॥
pārvatī māghaśuklasya dvādaśyāṃ dehaśuddhaye ।।
upavāsena sākaṃ vai sarvaṃ kṛtavatī satī ॥52॥
trayodaśyāmāhnikaṃ yatprātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya tat ।।
sarvaratnamaṇidhānyadravyavastrādibhiḥ saha ॥53॥
maṇḍape tu samāgatya saṃsthitā'pūjayad gurūn ।
natvā sarvāṃstatrasaṃsthān hariṃ natvā'ntarātmanā ॥54॥
saṃsthāpya ratnakalaśaṃ śukladhānyopari sthiram ।
pañcapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalākṣatādiśobhitam ॥55॥
candanā'gurukastūrīkuṃkumādivirājitam ।।
tathā purohitaṃ natvā pūjayitvā tridevatāḥ ॥56॥
samārebhe pūjanaṃ tu svastivācanapūrvakam ।
āvāhyābhīṣṭadevaṃ taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ maṃgale ghaṭe ॥57॥
bhaktyā dadau krameṇaiva copacārāँstu ṣoḍaśa ।।
yāni vrate vidheyāni deyadravyāṇi yāni ca ॥58॥
vedamantreṇa sarvāṇi dattvā homān vyadhāpayat ।।
trilakṣāṇi tadā homān tilaiśca sarpiṣā tathā ॥59॥
mantrajāpaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ smarantī brāhmaṇān bahūn ।
bhojayāmāsa vidhinā pratyahaṃ pūrṇavatsaram ॥1.96.60॥
samāptidivase kṛṣṇaḥ sarvātmā smārito muhuḥ ।।
āgacchatu svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prasannaḥ pūjanasthale ॥61॥
tuṣṭuvustaṃ tadā sarve sāyudhaṃ ca caturbhujam ।।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ koṭimanmathamohanam ।।62॥
prasannavadanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ koṭicandrasamaprabham ।
vāsayāmāsa taṃ devaṃ ratnasiṃhāsane vare ।।63॥
taṃ praṇemuśca śirasā brahmaśaktiśivādayaḥ ।।
svāgatottaramārādhyo vratenāplāvito hariḥ ॥64॥
prāha devi ! vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ tava jātaṃ suputradam ।।
pārvatī ca tadā prāha devadeva mahāprabho ! ॥65॥
putraṃ dehi vijetāraṃ sarvā'grārcyaṃ sutaṃ tathā ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā devīṃ tathāstviti bruvanprabhuḥ ॥66॥
devā daityavināśāya tārakāsurahānaye ।
prārthayanti muhustasmād vijetṝṇāṃ śiromaṇiḥ ॥67॥
putraścaiko bhavitā te dvitīyo'pi sutaḥ śubhaḥ ।।
sarvadevāgrapūjyaśca sarvamaṃgaladastava ॥68॥
bhavitā cetyubhau putrāvayonijau tu vīryataḥ ।।
śaṃkarasya bhavetāṃ vai patiṃ raṃjaya bhāmini ! ॥69॥
śivā prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ karmaṇāṃ phaladāyakam ।।
dhyāyanti yoginaḥ kecicchāntaṃ sākāramadbhutam ।।1.96.70।।
pītāmbaraṃ caturhetiṃ lakṣmīkāntaṃ caturbhujam ।।
kecitkiśoraṃ dvibhujaṃ sundaraṃ ratnabhūṣitam ।।71॥
śyāmaṃ gopāṃganākāntaṃ māyānāthaṃ manoharam । -
ahaṃ putrapradaṃ devaṃ dhyāyāmi kṛṣṇamacyutam ॥72॥
tava preraṇayā nātha ! tava tejoṃśasaṃbhavā ।।
māyayā tava māyā'haṃ mohayitvā'surānpurā ॥73॥
nihatya sarvān śailendramagamaṃ taṃ himālayam ।।
tato'haṃ saṃstutā devaistārakākṣeṇa pīḍitaiḥ ॥74॥
abhavaṃ dakṣajāyāyāṃ śivastrī bhavajanmani ।
tyaktvā dehaṃ dakṣayajñe śivā'haṃ śivanindayā ।।75॥
abhavaṃ śailajāyāyāṃ menakāyāṃ tu kālikā ।।
anekatapasā prāptaḥ śivaścātrāpi janmani ॥76।।
pāṇiṃ jagrāha me yogī prārthito vedhasā muhuḥ ।।
śrṛṃgārajaṃ ca tattejo nā'labhaṃ devamāyayā ।।77॥
staumi tvāmeva deveśa vinā putraṃ tu duḥkhitā ।
vrate bhavadvidhaṃ putraṃ labdhumicchāmi sāmpratam ।।78॥
sarvasenāvijetāraṃ sarvapūjyaṃ ca vā'param ।।
śrutvā sarvaṃ kṛpāsindho ! kṛpāṃ me kartumarhasi ॥79॥
ityabhyarthya tadā devī tūṣṇīmāsa ca pārvatī ।
svasmin kṛṣṇena divyau dvau putrau devyai pradarśitau ॥1.96.80॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne putrārthaṃ vratakartrīṇāṃ dṛṣṭāntāni devarṣiṇāṃ samāgamanamāśīrvādāśca śrīkṛṣṇadarśanaṃ cetyādivarṇananāmā ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥96॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! kṛpāluḥ sa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ ।।
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa prathamaṃ sarvamohanam ॥ 1 ॥
brahmacaryasvarūpaṃ vai sākṣādrūpanidhiṃ param ।
ṣaṇmukhaṃ samayūraṃ ca bahuhetisamanvitam ॥ 2 ॥
bahujñānaṃ bahubalaṃ bahukalaṃ suyauvanam ।।
divyaṃ senāsvāmiyogyacihnaṃ ṣoḍaśahāyanam ॥ 3 ॥
atha dvitīyarūpaṃ svaṃ sthūlaṃ vaṃśakaraṃ param ।।
vanamālāgalaṃ śyāmaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 4 ।।
kiśoravayasaṃ sarpayajñopavītaśobhanam ।।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ mūṣakasthiravāhanam ।।5।।
atīva hṛṣṭaṃ sarveśaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam ।।
dṛṣṭvā rūpe rūpavatī putrau tadanurūpakau ।। 6 ।।
manasā varayāmāsa varaṃ samprāpya tatkṣaṇam ।।
varaṃ datvā tadā kṛṣṇastattejo'ntaradhīyata ॥ 7 ॥
prāptau putrāviti hṛṣṭā jagadambā nirambikā ।
brāhmaṇabhikṣubandibhyo dadau dānāni cāmbikā ।। 8 ॥
tāँstathā bhojayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram ।।
dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ॥ 9 ॥

dugdhapākaṃ pūrikāśca bubhuje svāminā saha ।।
tāmbūlaṃ susugandhāḍhyaṃ bubhuje śaṃbhunā saha ॥11॥
sarvān prāghūṇikān sā tu prasthāpya prayatā punaḥ ।
śrāṃgārika pariṣkṛtya śārīrakaṃ pramodanam ॥12॥
payaḥphenanibhāṃ śayyāṃ ramyāṃ sadratnamaṃcake ।।
puṣpacandanasaṃyuktāṃ kastūrīdānavāsitām ।।13।।
rahasi svāminā sārdhaṃ suṣvāpa parameśvarī ।।
sugandhikusumāḍhyena vāyunā surabhīkṛte ॥14॥
bhramaradhvanisaṃyukte puṃskokilarutāśraye ।।
kailāsadhāmasīmānte ramye candanakānane ।।15।।
gandhamādanabhūbhāge siṣeve surataṃ patim ।।
vyahārṣīt sā surasikā śaṃkareṇa sahāmbikā ।।16।।
dvayoḥ suratamāpannaṃ yad dvayośca tadā'bhavat ।।
skandanaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ prathame vīryapātane ॥17॥
vīryamagnisvarūpaṃ tad bhayakṛcca mahāprabham ।
yonidvāre skhalitaṃ tad bahireva pravāhitam ॥18॥
ayonijasya putrasyotpattaye'bhūddharīcchayā ।।
atha pravāharūpeṇa jvālārūpeṇa retasā ॥19॥
uṣṇatejaḥsamudbhūtoṣmasvarūpeṇa cā'mbare ।
antarikṣe bhūtale ca prāṇino mūrchanāṃ yayuḥ ॥1.97.20॥
tacchāntyarthaṃ svayaṃ brahmā viṣṇuścānye divaukasaḥ ।।
sasmarurmanasā cāgniṃ so'pyājagāma satvaram ॥21॥
devānāmanumatyā ca viveśa suratasthalam ।
tadaṃgaṇamanuprāpya bhikṣāṃ dehīti tūcivān ॥22॥
pāṇipātrasya me hyamba bhikṣāṃ dehi vrajāmyaham ।।
bhikṣāṃ tasmai dadau cāmbā dugdharūpāmupasthitām ॥23॥
paramānnaṃ dugdhapākaṃ pradattaṃ cāṃjalau yadā ।।
tadā ca prāsarad retaḥ śaṃbhorvyomādhvanaścyavat ॥24॥
vahnyaṃjalau prapatitaṃ miṣṭaṃ sugandhi sadrasam ।
nigīrṇaṃ miśritaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vahninā svayam ॥25॥
rasāsvāde mohito'gniranyadreto'pi yattvabhūt ।।
vyomno'ntarikṣādbhūmeśca śayyāyāścā'labheddhi tat ॥26॥
tat sarvaṃ bhikṣayā sārdhaṃ rasalobhācca mohataḥ ।।
svayameva gṛhītvā tanmiśrayitvā muhurmuhuḥ ॥27॥
jagrāsā''svādayandugdhapākaṃ vīryaṃ ca bhāvataḥ ।।
na kiṃcidavaśiṣṭaṃ hi putrārthaṃ pārvatīśaye ॥28॥
tadā cintāparā gaurī rasāsvāde pralobhinam ।
vahniṃ śaśāpa bho vahne rasāsvādapradūṣaṇāt ॥29॥
bījaṃ putrātmakamapi śayyāsthaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tvayā ।।
tasmād bhikṣo mama śāpātsarvabhakṣo bhavā''śu vai ॥1.97.30॥
śāpaḥ prāpto mahadduḥkhamabhavadvahnimānase ।।

pratyuta vahniṃ tadretaḥ prājvālayadatīva ca ।।
vahnirjājvalyamāno vai gatvā gaṃgāmahāhrade ॥3॥

saptarṣipramadāstatra gaṃgāyāṃ snātumāgatāḥ ।।35॥
dṛṣṭvā prajvalitaṃ tatra snātāśca śītapīḍitāḥ ।।
kṛttikāstaptusaṃkalpā hyarundhatyā nivāritāḥ ॥36॥

yāvat tepuśca tāḥ sarvā retasaḥ paramāṇavaḥ ॥37॥
viviśū romakūpeṣu tāsāṃ tatraiva satvaram ।।
sagarbhāstāśca saṃjātāḥ ṣaḍgarbhairjajvalurbhṛśam ॥38॥
śuśucuśca kutastādvai garbhavatyo bhavāma ha ।।
dāhayatyakhilaṃ dehaṃ kimidaṃ tvanalādabhūt ॥39॥
tyajāmaścainamevā'tra nālakhaṇḍauṣadhigrasāt ।।
pītvā rasaṃ ca tadretaḥ utsasṛjurbhuvastale ॥1.97.40॥
aikapadyena tadretaḥ ṣaṇmukhaṃ hāṭakaprabham ।।
apatyaṃ drāgabhavadvai surūpaṃ sukumārakam ॥41॥

tadānīmeva girijā jātā snutapayodharā ।

saṃjāto me mahādeva kimarthastannirīkṣyatām ।
samādhinā mahādevo jñātvā'bravīt suto'bhavat ॥44॥
nāradena tadāgatya kathitaṃ janma tasya tat ।।
śivāya ca śivāyai ca putro jāto'tisundaraḥ ॥45॥
tadākarṇya vaco viprāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pramathāstathā ।।
kailāsaṃ bhūṣayāmāsurvitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ ॥46॥
patākākadalīstaṃbhaiḥ svastimaṃgalamaṇḍanaiḥ ।।
tadā surarṣayaḥ siddhāścāraṇā apsarogaṇāḥ ।।47।।
yakṣāḥ sarpā mānavāśca jagmurgaṃgātaṭaṃ śubham ।।
draṣṭuṃ gāṃgeyamāruhya vṛṣabhaṃ śaṃkarastathā ॥48॥
pārvatyā saha sagaṇo gaṃgātaṭamupāyayau ।।
tathā śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca nedustūryāṇyanekaśaḥ ।।49।।
kecinnṛtyanti gāyanti stuvanti tadguṇārṇavam ।।
yāvatsamīkṣayāmāsurgāṃgeyaṃ śaṃkaropamam ॥1.97.50॥
dadṛśustejasā vyāptaṃ bālaṃ sūryasamaprabham ।।
sumukhaṃ suśriyaṃ ramyaṃ sunāsaṃ sasmitekṣaṇam ।।51॥
prasannaṃ cārudaśanaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram ।।
snigdhālakaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ devā vavandire tadā ॥52॥

brahmā viṣṇurmahendraśca parivārya kumārakam ॥53॥

ityuccārya nanāma svapitarau prāk tato'parān ॥61॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śivaḥ prāha tadā devān kumāro'yaṃ pratāpavān ।
jātamātro yuvā divyo devānāṃ kāryakṛnmataḥ ॥ 1 ॥
tad bhavadbhiḥ sanniyojyo yatheṣṭaṃ balavān kṛtī ।।
devāḥ prāhustadā śaṃbhuṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhahetave ।। 2 ।।
tārakādbhayamastyeva sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ vibho ।।
tasmāt senāpatitve'bhiṣecanīyaḥ sutastvayam ।। 3 ।।
ityevaṃ sammatau tatra śaṃkaraḥ sumuhūrtake ।।
saināpatyapradānāya lilekhotsavapatrikāḥ ॥ 4 ॥
gaṇā maṃgalapatrāṇi yayurnītvā caturdaśa ।।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu ṛṣipitṛdyuvāsinām ।।5।।
yakṣarākṣasagandharvabhūtapretapalāśinām ।।
mānavāsurasarpāṇāṃ kinnaroragabhūbhujām ॥ 6 ॥
pratigṛhaṃ pradadustāḥ patrikāśca śivājñayā ।।
āyayuḥ ṛṣayaḥ satyalokāttu brahmaṇā saha ॥ 7 ॥
pitaraśca tapolokādagniṣvāttādayastathā ।
barhiṣadā ājyapāśca somapā vatsarādayaḥ ।। 8 ॥
pāvanā vahnayaḥ sarve yamapretā digīśvarāḥ ।
samīyuśca sthale tatra manavo marutastathā ॥ 9 ॥
indraḥ kubero varuṇo yamo yamagaṇāstathā ।
bālakhilyāstathā sarve saptarṣayaśca nairṛtāḥ ॥1.98.10॥
adharmadharmasantānāḥ sumedhāḥ stanayitnavaḥ ।
vasantādyā ṛtavaśca kāmo bāṇādinā'nvitaḥ ॥11॥
viṣṇurlakṣmīpatirlakṣmyā pārṣadaiḥ saha cāgamat ।।
devyaḥ sādhvyaścaturdaśalokagārhasthyaśobhanāḥ ॥12॥
vilāsinyaśca nartakyaḥ sevikāśca pativratāḥ ।।
samājagmuśca bhūdevā nadā nadyaśca parvatāḥ ॥13॥
araṇyāni ca tīrthāni puryoṃ dhāmāni mūrtayaḥ ।।
bhūtāni prāṇinastatra sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ॥14॥
mānavā nāgasarpāśca vṛkṣā vallyaśca pakṣiṇaḥ ।।
gaganasthā jalacaryāḥ sthalasthāḥ sthāsnujaṃgamāḥ ॥15॥
divyadehāḥ samājagmuḥ saināpatyamahotsave ।
gāyakā nartakā narmakāriṇo nāṭakaṃvidaḥ ।।16।।
vādakāḥ sevakāścānye ye devā'devajātayaḥ ।
sarve tatra samāhūtā āgatāḥ protsavārthinaḥ ॥17॥
saināpatyasthānayogyaṃ bālakaṃ draṣṭumutsukāḥ ।
vidhiṃ draṣṭuṃ samājagmuḥ prāyo draṣṭuṃ svarakṣakam ॥18॥
samājaṃ ca tathā draṣṭuṃ prāyaḥ sarve samāgatāḥ ।।
śaṃkareṇa tadā svasya kailāsaḥ supariṣkṛtaḥ ॥19॥
maṇḍapo hi mahān svarṇaratnavastrādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ।।
kadalīstaṃbhakalaśatoraṇollecaśobhitaḥ ॥ 1.98.20॥
paṭamaṇḍapalakṣāṇi koṭiśaḥ parṇaśālikāḥ ।।
sabhāsthānāni ramyāṇi vihārodyānagopurāḥ ॥21॥
bhakṣyabhojyānyanantāni lehyacoṣyāṇi koṭiśaḥ ।
peyāni svādumiṣṭāni saugandhīnyapi lakṣaśaḥ ॥22॥
dṛśyāni ca manoraṃjanakānyagaṇitāni vai ।
amṛtāni vividhāni svāduphalānyanekaśaḥ ॥23॥
pakvānnāni sudivyāni sitāsudhājyavanti vai ।।
atitṛptipradānyevaṃ tāmbūlādīni cā'bhavan ॥24॥
sthānopaveśanabṛsyo ratnasiṃhāsanāni ca ।
javanikāsusaudhāni vimānāni hyanekaśaḥ ॥25॥
vāhanāni jalavyomabhūgāmīni ca koṭiśaḥ ।
bhājanāni ca bhogyāni darpaṇāḥ keśadanturāḥ ॥26॥
puṣpāṇi tailasaugandhyacandanāni ca bhūriśaḥ ।।
kuṃkumāni ca dhūpāśca dīpā vādyāni bhūriśaḥ ॥27॥
sthale sthale pṛtanādhipatyasūcakasudhvajāḥ ।।
prasphuranti smāntarīkṣe gīyante jayagītikāḥ ॥28॥
muhūrte'bhijiti prāpte svastivācanapūrvakam ।
vedaghoṣān pracakrurvai bhūdevāḥ ṛṣayastathā ॥29॥
yajñopavītaṃ rakṣāyāḥ sūtraṃ jayamaṇiṃ tadā ।।
dhārayāmāsa taṃ skandaṃ bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ॥1.98.30॥
tilakaṃ sākṣataścandraḥ kauṃkumaśca kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ ।।
guruṇā gāṃgatoyaiśca prokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ śubham ॥31॥
mantrā balapradāstatra yojitā dakṣakarṇake ।
darbhaḥ karṇopari nyasto maṃgalaṃ mastake tathā ॥32॥
dravyaṃ tu prokṣitaṃ mūrdhni mukuṭo brahmaṇā'rpitaḥ ।।
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale datte kubereṇa tadā śubhe ॥33॥
samudreṇa tadā ratnahārāstasya gale'rpitāḥ ।।
himālayena svarṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇānyarpitāni vai ॥34॥
dikpālaistattatpradeśodbhavadvastu samarpitam ।।
varuṇenārpitaṃ chatraṃ śvetaṃ candrasamaṃ tadā ॥35॥
gaṃgayā ramayā tatra cāmare karayordhṛte ।
indreṇa kavacaṃ dattaṃ saināpatyasya rakṣakam ॥36॥
saināpatyasya veṣaśca datto vai viṣṇunā svayam ।
ādityena ratho datto raṇā'kṣatadṛḍhāṃgakaḥ ॥37॥
khaḍgaṃ carma pradatte vai dṛḍhe tu viśvakarmaṇā ।।
śaṃbhunā tu dhanurdattamiṣudhyakṣayyasāyakau ॥38॥
cakraṃ tu hariṇā dattaṃ gadādaṇḍau yamena vai !
vajraṃ tadā'gninā dattaṃ śaktiśca vāyunā'rpitā ॥39॥
mayūrā'śvagajā dattāḥ parvatairvyomagāminaḥ ।।
astraśastrāyudhahetipāśarṣṭitomarādayaḥ ॥1.98.40॥
pradattā vividhairdevaiḥ tadutsavasamāgataiḥ ।
devībhirvividhāstasmai pradattāḥ śaktayo'kṣayāḥ ॥41॥
pārvatyā''śīrvaco dattaṃ sarvadā vijayī bhava ।
senābhogyaḥ parikaro munibhiścārpitastadā ॥42॥
nyūnaṃ sarvaṃ pūritaṃ ca tadā dakṣādirājakaiḥ ।।
tato vijayaghoṣo'bhūtkārtikasya mahātmanaḥ ॥43॥
avādyanta ca vādyāni babhūvurjayaghoṣaṇāḥ ।।
āsannugrāḥ surapakṣāḥ senāpatikṛtāvanāḥ ॥44॥
maṃgalāni vividhāni jātāni surayoṣitām ।
samājastatra lokebhyaścaturdaśabhya āgataḥ ॥45॥
bhojyairmiṣṭairmiṣṭapānaiḥ suvāsyaiśca sutarpitaḥ ।
puruṣāḥ pramadāścaiva vardhayanti sma śāṃkaram ॥46॥
senāpatiṃ mahāśaktaṃ durdharṣaṃ sarvato'dhikam ।।
sainyānyapi suklṛptāni lokapālaistadā tataḥ ॥47॥
tadanyebhyastu saṃdatvā pātheyānyupadāstathā ।।
śaṃbhunā preṣitāḥ sarve svasvadhāmāni te yayuḥ ॥48॥
atha sammilitā devāḥ brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ ।।
mantrayāṃcakruradyaiva divāniśi mahāsuraḥ ॥49॥
diviṣadāṃ tārakākhyastrāsayate mahābalaḥ ।।
ayaṃ skando mahāsatvo haniṣyati tu tārakam ॥1.98.50॥
dināni saptajātāni janmato'sya tathāpi vai ।।
mahāsenāpatirjāto devadattabalairbalī ॥51॥
tasmādadyaiva yāsyāmastārakaṃ hantumudyatāḥ ।।
matvā tatheti sahasā nirjagmustārakāsuram ॥52॥
tadā bheryo mṛdaṃgāśca paṭahā''nakagomukhāḥ ।
avādyanta ca vādyāni tūryāṇi vividhāni ca ॥53॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtikeyasya senāpatitvadhikāratadaṃgāyudhādivarṇananāmā'ṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥98॥


← adhyāyaḥ 098 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 99
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 100 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! tadā loke bhayā'bhaye babhūvatuḥ ।।
devānāmudyamaṃ jñātvā prabalastārakāsuraḥ ॥ 1 ॥
asurasainyakṛtkoṭyā yayau yoddhuṃ surānprati ।
asurā rākṣasā daityā dānavāstatra saṃgatāḥ ।। 2 ।।
ākrośanto mahādarpā niryayuryuddhavāṃchayā ।
tāḍakasya mahatsainyaṃ tvāgataṃ devasannidhau ॥ 3 ।।
tadā devānnabhovāṇī prāha prasannatā'nvitā ।
skandaṃ vijayinaṃ cāgre kṛtvā yāntu jayo bhavet ।। 4 ।।
vijayārthaṃ tu pārvatyā putraḥ sa prakaṭīkṛtaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ skandogrago yuddhe teṣāṃ vai vijayo dhruvaḥ ॥ 5 ॥
śrutvā devā jahṛṣurvai yoddhukāmāśca nirbhayāḥ ।
brahmaṇā tatra tāvadvai noditaikā kumārikā ।। 6 ।।
mṛtyoḥ putrī samāyātā mṛtyusenā'bhidhā tadā ।।
varaṇārthaṃ kumārasya tapaḥ paramamāśritā ॥ 7 ॥
śatrūṇāṃ mārayitrī sā sundarī varamālayā।
kumāra kārtikaṃ tatra varayāmāsa mārtyavī ॥ 8 ॥
tayā yuktastadā skandaḥ senāpatiriyāya vai।
raṇāṃgaṇe tadā ghorā raktottejakagomukhāḥ ॥ 9 ॥
mahādundubhayo nedurḍiṇḍimānyadbhutāni ca ।
raṇakarkaśatūryāṇi mṛdaṃgapaṭahā'nakāḥ ।।1.99.10।।
kharaśrṛṃgāṇi śaṃkhāśca bheryo'vādyanta utkaṭāḥ ।।
aikapadyena cottasthuryoddhukāmāḥ surā'surāḥ ।।11॥
kumāraṃ gajamāropya devendro hyagrago'bhavat ।
surasainyena mahatā lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ॥12॥
yamo'pi svagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ marudbhiśca samīraṇaḥ ।।
yādobhirvaruṇastatra kubero guhyakairvṛtaḥ ॥13॥
śaṃkaraḥ pramathaiḥ sārdhaṃ nairṛto vyādhibhiḥ saha ।।
antarvedyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve gāṅgayāmunamadhyagāḥ ॥14॥
pātālāśca samāyātāstārakasyopajīvinaḥ ।
daityāśca dānavāścaiva rākṣasā asurāśca ye ॥15॥
gajā uṣṭrā eḍakāśca hayā aśvatarāḥ khagāḥ ।।
syandanāni vicitrāṇi vimānāni ca bhūriśaḥ ।।16।।
padātayo bahavaścā'śobhanta sāyudhāstadā ।
khaḍgatomaranārācaiḥ pāśamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ ॥17॥
bāṇaparighacakraiśca śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ ।।
taiḥ suyukte tadā sainye daityānāṃ ca divaukasām ॥18॥
śuśubhāte mahākālavakradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣite ।।
yuddhāraṃbhadhvajau dṛṣṭvā mumucuḥ sāyakāँstadā ॥19॥
bāṇānvavarṣurātīkṣṇān kṣuradhārānsamantataḥ ।
śikhānardhacandrāँśca tridhārānpaṃcadhārakān ॥1.99.20॥
bāṇairācchāditaṃ vyomā'vidhyanta viśikhairbhaṭāḥ ।
praphullakiṃśukā yadvad rājante kartitā bhaṭāḥ ॥21॥
sainye parasparaṃ bāṇaiśchanne garjanti tadbhaṭāḥ ।
bhūmau ca patitāḥ kecitkecinmuṇḍā luṭhanti vai ॥22॥
keṣāṃcidbāhavachinnāḥ kaṃdharāśca vidāritāḥ ।
hṛdayāni vinirbhinnānyanyeṣāṃ cūrṇitā kaṭiḥ ॥23॥
pāśairbhallairaṃkuśaiśca kuntaiśca ṛṣibhistathā ।
bhaṭāśca bahavastatra bhūśayyā hyabhavankṣaṇāt ॥24॥
sadaṃśauṣṭhaśirāṃsyācchādayadvai raṇamaṇḍalam ।
nṛtyamānakabandhāni dhāvantvanyajighṛkṣayā ॥25॥
bhaumaścaivā''ntarikṣaśca saṃgrāmo dāruṇo'bhavat ।।
nāste paricayastatra śastrapātanakarmaṇi ॥26॥
jalpantaṃ śatrumādāya cūrṇayanti gadādibhiḥ ।।
nadyaḥ pravartitā raktapravāhinyaḥ śavastarāḥ ॥27॥
rakte raṇāṃgaṇe raktaśchinnā bhinnā bhaṭāstadā ।।
dvandvayuddhaṃ ca kurvanto jayāya bahavo hatāḥ ॥28॥
kujaṃbho vāyunā sārdhaṃ jaṃbhaḥ sārdhaṃ yamena vai ।।
varuṇena balaścātha kubereṇa saha tripāt ॥29॥
agninā saha saṃhrādo naiṛtena mahāhanuḥ ।।
īśena saha meghābha indreṇa saha tārakaḥ ॥1.99.30॥
yakṣāḥ piśācī uragāḥ pataṃgāḥ pitarastathā । ।
vyādhayaḥ sannipātāśca jvara bhūtāśca guhyakāḥ ॥31॥
yuyudhuḥ pramathā astraśastraiśca bahubhistadā ।।
evaṃ yuddhe sutumule devadānavasaṃkule ॥32॥
tārakeṇaiva devendraḥ śaktyā paramayā hataḥ ।।
sadyaḥ papāta nāgādvai pṛthivyāṃ mūrchito'bhavat ॥33॥
svastho drāgeva saṃbhūtvā vajramādāya vegataḥ ।।
vivyādha tārakaṃ vakṣasthale daityo'patad bhuvi ॥34॥
mūrchitaśchinnahṛdayo bhinnapṛṣṭhā'sthidaṇḍakaḥ ।।
śukreṇa sandhinīvallībalena sandhitaḥ punaḥ ॥35॥
utthitaśca jaghānendraṃ brahmāstraṃ prāṇanāśakam ।।
viṣṇurnārāyaṇastadvai jagrāsa jihvayā drutam ॥36॥
indrastato mahāroṣānmahākālā'stramādadhe ।
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tvindraṃ mā mā māraya taṃ hare ! ॥37॥
tasya hantā kumāro'yaṃ samudbhūtaḥ śivātmajaḥ ।
tasmādbhavadbhiḥ sthātavyaṃ bālena yudhyatā saha ।।38॥
senānītāḍakau cograu yuddhayamānau mahābalau ।
śuśubhāte'tisaṃrabdhau prahārairjarjarīkṛtau ॥39।।
mahāँstatra gaṇo vīro vīrabhadro ruṣānvitaḥ ।।
gaṇaiḥ subahubhiryuktastārakaṃ hantumudyataḥ ॥1.99.40॥
triśūlairṛṣṭibhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ parighapaṭṭiśaiḥ ।।
jaghnatuḥ samare'nyonyaṃ surā'suravimardane ॥41॥
tārako vīrabhadreṇa triśūlena hato bhṛśam ।
papāta sahasā tatra kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa ca ॥42॥
utthāya ca muhūrtādvai śaktyā tu tārako balī ।।
śivasyā'nucaraṃ śūlaṃ vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna ha ॥43॥
triśūlena tu ghoreṇa vīrabhadro'pi tārakam ।।
jaghāna hṛdaye vegāttārakaḥ pothito bhuvi ।।44॥
hariḥ prāha tadā vīrabhadraṃ tu tārako'suraḥ ।।
kārtikeyasya vadhyo'sti mā kuru tvaṃ pariśramam ॥45॥
na rocate'sya tadvākyaṃ tārakasya vadhaṃ prati ।
vīrabhadro ruṣāviṣṭo jagarja jaladopamaḥ ॥46॥
atārakāṃ mahīṃ cā'dya kariṣye nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।।
tāvatkapardino'neke jaṭājūṭavibhūṣitāḥ ॥47॥
vṛṣārūḍhā daśahastāḥ śūrāḥ krūrāstrilocanāḥ ।
pañcāsyā nīlakaṇṭhāśca gaṇā vai candraśekharāḥ ॥48॥
yuyudhuste mahādaityaistārakāsurajīvibhiḥ ।।
devadānavadaityānāṃ sannipāto mahānabhūt ॥49॥
aśvavārāśca vājisthān gajino gajinastathā ।
jaghnū rathasthān rathino vyomagā vyomagāminaḥ ॥1.99.50॥
vīrabhadrastārakaṃ saṃgṛhya vai pādayostadā ।
bhrāmayitvā'ntarīkṣe'tha pothayāmāsa bhūtale ॥51॥
kṣayaṃ praṇītā bahavo'pare yātā rasātalam ।
palāyamānā bahavo bhītāḥ prāṃjalayo'pare ॥52॥
śaraṇyāśca raṇādbhagnā mṛtāḥ kecidbhuvastale ।।
nipetuḥ śikharāṇīva vīrabhadrādināśitāḥ ॥53॥
evaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ svakaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai tāḍa़kāsuraḥ ।।
bhujānāmayutaṃ kṛtvā hantuṃ devagaṇān yayau ॥54॥
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā skandaṃ nā'nyo hantā'sti kartika !।
tasmāt tvayaiva netavyastārako yamasādanam ॥55॥
tārakeṇa purā vīra ! tapastaptaṃ bhayāvaham ।
tapasā tena cogreṇa hyajeyatvamavāptavān ॥56॥
jitā indrādilokeśāstrailokyaṃ ca jitaṃ tathā ।
tasmāt tvayā nihantavyaḥ śāntiḥ syācca tadā parā ॥57॥
ityāśrutya tadā skaṃdaḥ śaktimādāya pāragām ।
adhāvattārakaṃ tāvattārakaḥ śaktimādade ॥58॥
provāca daityo garviṣṭho devānavigaṇayya tu ।।
indraḥ palāyito'thāpi yūyaṃ devā gatatrapāḥ ।।59।।
kumāraṃ yatpuraskṛtya raṇāgre'tra vyavasthitāḥ ।।
maruto ghātitā garbhe dharṣitā gautamapriyā ॥1.99.60।।
viśvarūpo hato vipro vṛtro yena niṣūditaḥ ।।
kārayituṃ kumārasya ghātaṃ kva pragato hariḥ ॥61॥
dakṣayajñe tvanekeṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ nāśako hyayam ।
na bālo vai vīrabhadraḥ sannidhau mama tiṣṭhatu ।।6।।
vīraṃ cendraṃ kumāraṃ ca nayāmi yamasādanam ।।
uktvaivaṃ tu tadā śaktitrayaṃ jagrāha tārakaḥ ।।63॥
tāvadindro bahudhāraṃ vajraṃ cikṣepa tārake ।
patito'pi samutthāya śaktyendraṃ prāharadruṣā ॥64॥
patitaṃ cendramālokya gatvā padā nipīḍya ca ।
vajraṃ tasyā'haratpaścādyāvadindraṃ jighāṃsati ॥65॥
tāvat triśūlamudyamya vīrabhadreṇa tāḍitaḥ ।।
patitaścāsuro bhūmau drāgeva punarutthitaḥ ॥66॥
prajaghāna triśūlena vīravakṣasi vegataḥ ।।
vīrabhadrastataḥ kruddhastriśūlena jighāṃsati ॥67॥
kumāreṇa niṣiddho yat mama nāśyo hyayaṃ tviti ।।
atho jayetyabhiprokto devairākāśasaṃsthitaiḥ ॥68॥
jagarja ca mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ ।।
mūrdhni kaṇṭhe codare'pi jānvoścaiva kaṭibhramau ॥69॥
vakṣasi pṛṣṭha urasi tvanyonyaṃ pravijaghnatuḥ ।
na vavau ca tadā vāyurniṣprabho'bhūddivākaraḥ ॥1.99.70॥
cacāla vasudhā sarvā saśailabahukānanā ।।
himālayādayaḥ sarve parvatāśca cakampire ॥71।।
kumāraḥ prāha pāpiṣṭha devānāṃ duḥkhadāyaka ।
ghātayāmi mahāśaktyā smara sveṣṭaṃ sthiro bhava ॥72॥
iti kṣiptā mahāśaktistīkṣṇāgrā'ṣṭapradhārikā ।
tārake vakṣasi śīrṇe pāraṃ pṛṣṭhe jagāma sā ।।73।।
tārakaṃ viddhamādāya pṛthvyāmardhā viveśa sā ।
viśīrṇastārakaścāyaṃ punaḥ skandena māritaḥ ॥74।।
dadṛśustaṃ suragaṇāḥ ṛṣayo guhyakāḥ khagāḥ ।
kinnarāścāraṇāścāpi siddhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ॥75॥
parameṇa praharṣeṇa tuṣṭuvustaṃ kumārakam ।।
vidyādharyaśca nanṛturgāyakāśca jagustathā ॥76॥
devā nirāmayā jātāḥ santuṣṭāśca śivādayaḥ ।।
girijā harṣamāpannā svāṃkamāropya cātmajam ॥77॥
pariṣvajya śubhāśīrbhiryuyoja jayinaṃ sutam ।
pariśramaṃ kṣataṃ dehe sphāṭitaṃ vā praphullitam ॥78॥
pārvatī svakarasparśānnīrujaṃ tvakarotkṣaṇāt ।
devāḥ kalyāṇarūpāya namaścakrustadā mudā ॥79॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtyuputryā senayā vṛṇītena kārtikeyena yuddhe tārakāsuro hata ityabhivarṇananāmā navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 99 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 099 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 100
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 101 →

śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca
evaṃ suśikha ! sannaṣṭaṃ tārakaṃ lokahārakam ।।
naṣṭaṃ śrutvā svayaṃ lakṣmīrnārāyaṇamuvāca ha ॥ 1 ॥
śrīlakṣmīruvāca--
nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo daityaḥ sa tārakāsuraḥ ।।
ka āsīcca kathaṃ kasmādvaraṃ prāpto'tra me vada ॥ 2 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu caikahṛdā devi ! vajrāṃgasutatārakam ।
mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putro dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ ।
tena kanyā ditirdattā kaśyapāya mahātmane ॥ 3 ॥
tasyā garbhe marutdevā mahendreṇa vikartitāḥ ।
ekonapañcāśajjātā devāste maruto matāḥ ।
kintu ditisturāṣāho vināśāya tapo'karot ॥ 4 ॥
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tena vajrāṃgadaḥ sutaḥ ।
samutpanno janmataḥ sa vajrasāramayāṃ'gakaḥ ॥ 5 ॥
jātamātro mahāyoddhā śastraśāstraprapāragaḥ ।।
uvāca mātaraṃ bhaktyā mātaḥ kiṃ karavāṇyaham ॥ 6 ॥
mātā prāha surendreṇa sutā me bahavo hatāḥ ।
teṣāmapacitiṃ cikīrṣāmi śakravadhādaham ।। 7 ।।
bāḍhamityevamuktvā sa jagāma tridivaṃ tadā ।
pādenā''kṛṣya caivendraṃ māturantikamānayat ।। 8 ।।
brahmā tāvatkaśyapaśca procaturmuñca vajriṇam ।
avamānaṃ mṛtyurasya tvayā māturvacaḥ kṛtam ॥ 9 ॥
tathā piturvacaḥ kāryaṃ muñcā'muṃ tu sureśvaram ।।
natvā sa pitroścaraṇe taṃ mumoca śatakratum ॥1.100.10॥
vajrāṃgadastato yāto vane kartuṃ tapo mahat ।।
brahmaṇā ca tadānīṃ tu varāṃgī kanyakā'rpitā ॥11॥
tāṃ patnīṃ tu samādāya vajrāṃgo hyagamadvanam ।
ūrdhvabāhuḥ sa daityendro'tiṣṭhadabdasahasrakam ।।12।
tāvannadhomukhaḥ kālaṃ tāvatpaṃcāgnisādhakaḥ ।
tataḥ so'ntarjale cakre tapo varṣasahasrakam ॥13॥
tatpatnī sarasastīre tapastepe pativratā ।
indro vibhīṣaṇāścakre bhūtvā vai markaṭaḥ svayam ॥14॥
jalakuṃbhaṃ babhaṃjā'syā meṣarūpo bhayaṃ dadau ।
sarparūpastato bhūtvā babandha caraṇāvubhau ॥15॥
gomāyūśca tato bhūtvā rauti sannidhimāgataḥ ।।
agnirūpastato bhūtvā tasyā dadāha vastrakam ।।16॥
vāyurbhūtvā cakarṣaināṃ siṃho bhūtvā hyabhīṣayat ।
tāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu vyatītaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ॥17॥
āyayāvatha vajrāṃgo dharmavṛttiṃ tato'vṛṇot ।
evamastviti datvā tadvaraṃ brahmā tirodadhe ।।18॥
śokārtāṃ svāṃ striyaṃ rājā vajrāṃgo'paśyadāha ca ।
kiṃ te kāryaṃ dadāmīha mā śokaṃ kuru bhāmini ॥19॥
patnī prāha kṛpā cenme putraṃ duḥkhasya tārakam ।
dehi cendraḥ sadā māṃ tu trāsaṃ dadāti cetyataḥ ॥1.100.20॥
vajrāṃgastu virakto'pi hyanukampyā priyeti yat ।।
matvā tatheti jāyāyai punastapaścakāra ha ॥21॥
yāvadabdasahastraṃ vai nirāhāraṃ tapo'karot ।।
brahmā prāha punastasmai kathaṃ vidhīyate tapaḥ ॥22॥
prāha daityo dehi putraṃ gīrvāṇadarpanāśakam ।।
brahmovāca tava patnyāṃ putro vai duḥkhatārakaḥ ॥23॥
devasīmantinīnāṃ yo dhammilakavimokṣakaḥ ।।
bhaviṣyatīti tatsthānāt daṃpatī tau prajagmatuḥ ॥24॥
svāśramaṃ cātha sā garbhaṃ ditirdadhāra tārakam ।
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu dadhārodara eva vai ।।25॥
tato jāte suputre tu pracacāla vasundharāḥ ।।
celurdharādharāḥ sarve vavurvātāḥ prabhīṣaṇāḥ ॥26॥
sūryādyāśca jahuḥ kāntiṃ nīhārācchāditā diśāḥ ।।
viṣaṇṇamanaso devā dānavāstu mahotsavāḥ ॥27॥
jātamātrastu daityendro hyabhiṣikto'surādibhiḥ ।।
mahārājye'tha sarvānsa prāha surajigīṣayā ॥28॥
surāstu śatravo'smākaṃ jayyāste tapaso balāt ।
tapaḥ kartuṃ tu gacchāmi pāriyātragirerdarīm ॥29॥
tatra gataḥ śivaṃ dhyātvā śivamantraṃ jajāpa saḥ ।।
nirāhāraḥ pañcatapāstathāvarṣā'yutaṃ gatam ।।1.100.30।।
tataḥ svadehādutkṛtya karṣaṃ karṣaṃ dine dine ।
māṃsasyā'gnau juhāvaiva tato nirmāṃsatāṃ gataḥ ॥31॥
dehaścāgnimayo jātastena bhūtāni jajvaluḥ ।।
brahmā tasmai varaṃ dātuṃ suprasanno jagāma ha ॥32॥
brahmovācottiṣṭha putra ! varaṃ vṛṇīṣva cepsitam ।
tārakaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā varaṃ vavre tadepsitam ।।33।।
jātivaireṇa devāstu sarvadā trāsayanti naḥ ।
ato daityasamuddhartā bhaveyamiti me matiḥ ॥34॥
avadhya sarvabhūtānāmastrāṇāṃ ca mahaujasām ।
syāmahaṃ cā'maraścaiṣa varo deyo madīpsitaḥ ॥35॥
brahmā prāha ca taṃ mṛtyumṛte dehī na jāyate ।।
jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyustasmādanyad vṛṇu priyam ।।36।।
mohito'pi sa daityendraḥ śiśorāsaptavāsarāt ।।
vavre mṛtyuṃ tathetyāha brahmā śaṃkaravākyataḥ ।।37
daityo jagāma rājye sve mahārṇavataṭottare।।
sarvasmṛddhipariṣvakto modate sa sabhājitaḥ ॥38।।
sarvā'strajñaśca śastrajño yuddharītiviśāradaḥ ।।
sarvāndaityāndānavāँścā'surānnītvā svarāyayau ॥39।।
dikpālān lokapālāँśca jitvā devāngrahāँstathā ।।
trilokyāśca svayaṃ rājyaṃ cakre devān vyavāsayat ।।1.100.40॥
svayamindro nimirvahniḥ kālanemiryamo'pi ca ।।
jambhaśca niṛtisthāne mahiṣo varuṇastathā ।।41।।
meṣo vātā'dhikāraśca kujaṃbho dhanado'bhavat ।
anyeṣāṃ cādhikārāँśca daityebhyastārako dadau ।।42।।
evaṃ viprakṛtā devā mahendrasahitāstadā ।।
yayuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ dhāma tuṣṭuvuḥ parameṣṭhinam ।।43।।
namo jagatprasūtyai te hetave pālakāya ca ।
saṃhartre ca namastubhyaṃ tārakād rakṣaṇaṃ kuru ।।44।।
brahmā prāha tadā sarvān jāne yuṣmān vivāsitān ।।
tasya hantā ca nādyāpi sa jāto bhuvane pumān ॥45॥
sa ca vavre vadhaṃ daityaḥ śiśutaḥ saptavāsarāt ।
sa vai saptadino bālaḥ skandākhyaḥ śaṃkarodbhavaḥ ॥46॥
kālarātrirmama tanuḥ dakṣaputrī satī ca yā ।
tanuṃ tyaktvā punaḥ sā ca pārvatī saṃbhaviṣyati ।।47॥
vivāhaḥ śaṃbhunā tasyā bhaviṣyati yadā tadā ।
skandākhyaḥ khalu putro yo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ॥48॥
saptadino haniṣyati senānīstārakāsuram ।
prāpte tu samaye sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati harīcchayā ॥49॥
ityanenāgate kāle senānyā ca raṇāṃgaṇe ।।
hato vai tārako daityaḥ śāntimāpustadā surāḥ ॥1.100.50॥
atha senānyanujasya gaṇeśasya ca tāṃ kathām ।।
śṛṇu vacmi tato lakṣmi ! śrīkṛṣṇasmārikāṃ śubhām ॥51॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tārakāsurasya brahmaṇo varadānajanmādikathananāmā śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥100॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca---
tato vasantasamaye śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।।
kokilākūjitaṃ śrutvā ghrātvā saugandhikaṃ dravam ।। 1 ।।
dṛṣṭvā śrāṃgārikaiḥ puṣṭaṃ yauvanaṃ ratisaṃbhṛtam ।
patnīṃ svāṃke nidhāyeśo ramate sma ciraṃ ciram ।। 2 ।।
śatavarṣasamaḥ kālo yayau ratikriyāparaḥ ।।
viṣṇurvaraṃ pradattaṃ prāk smṛtvā tatrāgamatsvayam ॥ 3 ॥
pārvatyā cāgrapūjyo vai vṛtaḥ putro madātmakaḥ ।।
ayonijaḥ sa evāhaṃ bhaveyaṃ miṣataḥ svayam ।। 4 ।।
iti vicintya kṛṣṇaḥ sa vipro babhūva tatkṣaṇam ।।
retaḥpātanakāle ca sa viṣṇurnijamāyayā ।।5।।
vidhāya viprarūpaṃ tadājagāma ratigṛham ।।
jaṭāvantaṃ vinā tailaṃ kucailaṃ bhikṣukaṃ tathā ।। 6 ।।
atīva śukladaśanaṃ tṛṣṇāvyāptahṛdantaram ।
atīva kṛśagātraṃ ca bibhrattilakamujjvalam ।। 7 ।।
bahugharghasvaraṃ dīnaṃ dainyāt kutsitamūrtikam ।
karadaṇḍāvalambaṃ ca vārdhakyādatidurbalam ॥ 8 ॥
etādṛśena rūpeṇa ratikāle'nnayācakaḥ ।।
bhūtvā sthito vadan svasti yajamānasya cāstviti ॥ 9 ॥
punarāha mahādeva kiṃ karoṣi śaraṇyada ! ।।
paśya vṛddhaṃ jarāgrastaṃ kṣuttaṣādyatipīḍitam ॥1.101.10॥
saptarātrivrate'tīte pāraṇā''kāṃkṣitaṃ ca mām ।
vitraṃ saṃbhojayitvā'tra rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ॥11॥
māṃtaruttiṣṭha me'nnaṃ tvaṃ prayacchā'dya śivaṃ jalam ।
anantaratnayukputri ! rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।।12।।
mātarmātarjaganmātarehi dehi subhojanam ।।
sīdāmi kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ kasmāt sthitāyāmātmamātari ।।13॥
iti dīnaṃ svaraṃ śrutvā śivasyottiṣṭhato drutam ।।
papāta vīryaṃ śayyāyāṃ yonimukhād bahirgatam ।।14।।
pārvatī tatra śayyāyāṃ nā'vait patitavīryakam ।।
svapityeva muhuḥ pārśve parāvartayati sma sā ।।15॥
dhātuḥ sarvopi pārvatyāḥ pṛṣṭhe pārśve tanau tadā ।।
lagnaḥ śuṣko'bhavaddivyo rājato varṇataḥ khalu ॥16॥
na jānati śarīre me kiṃ lagnaṃ vai pariśramāt ।।
svāpnanidrābhibhūtā sā svapityeva pariśramāt ।।17।।
śaṃkarastu bahidvāramājagāma dadarśa tam ।।
yācantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dīnaṃ jarayā paripīḍitam ॥18॥
vṛddhaṃ jarjaramātraṃ ca bibhrataṃ daṇḍamānatam ।
tapasvinamaśāntaṃ ca kurvantaṃ namanaṃ muhuḥ ॥19॥
śaṃkaraḥ prāha viprarṣe kimicchasi kuto bhavān ।।
āgato'sti svāgataṃ te mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ ॥1.101.20॥
adya me saphalaṃ janma brāhmaṇo madgṛhe'tithiḥ ।
atithiḥ śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ pūjitaḥ pūjitaṃ jagat ॥21॥
devāstiṣṭhantyatithiṣu brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyadāḥ sadā ।
atitheḥ pādapātreṣu vasanti tīrthajātayaḥ ।।22।।
atitheḥ pādasalilāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ।
prāpyate gṛhasaṃsthānairlabhyante smṛddhayo'kṣayāḥ ।।23॥
snātāni sarvatīrthāni yajñā nirvartitāstathā ।
mahādānāni dattāni yenā'tithiḥ susatkṛtaḥ ॥24॥
vedaśāstrādivarṇyāni satkarmāṇi ca yāni vai ।।
tāni cātithisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ॥25॥
asatkṛto'tithiryasya gṛhādvai vinivartate ।।
pāpāni gṛhiṇe datvā puṇyamādāya gacchati ॥26॥
atitherasamarhāyāṃ viyanti pitṛdevatāḥ ।।
sādhoḥ sādhvyā asatkāre gṛhī devairasatkṛtaḥ ॥27॥
sarvasampadvihīnaḥ syātpāpaṃ bhuṃkte darībharam ।।
vipraḥ prāha śubhaṃ bhūyād brahmaँste'tithibhāvataḥ ॥28॥
jānāsi cedatithirme vedoktaṃ kuru pūjanam ।।
manogataṃ ca dātavyaṃ nirāhārāya cārtiṇe ॥29॥
nānāvidhaṃ tu miṣṭānnaṃ dīyatāṃ me sutṛptikṛt ।
tṛptaścā'haṃ bhavatputro bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ॥1.101.30॥
sarvāgryā'rcyo bhaviṣyāmi bhaviṣyati bhavān pitā ।
tātāḥ pañcavidhāḥ proktā mātarastvaṣṭadhā matāḥ ॥31॥
putrāḥ pañcavidhāḥ sādho tanmadhye'haṃ bhavāmi vai ।
vidyādātā'nnadātā ca bhayatrātā ca janmadaḥ ॥32॥
kanyādātā brahmaṇoktā narāṇāṃ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।।
guroḥ patnī garbhadhātrī stanyadātrī pituḥ svasā ।।33॥
svasā mātuḥ sapatnī ca putrabhāryā'nnadāyikā ।
etā aṣṭavidhā mātā pūjanīyā suputrakaiḥ ॥34॥
bhṛtyaḥ śiṣyaśca poṣyaśca vīryajaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ।।
pañca putrāḥ sadā bodhyā vīryajo'tra viśeṣakaḥ ॥35॥
kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ suparītāṃgaṃ putraṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।
piṣṭakaṃ paramānnaṃ ca supakvāni phalāni ca ॥36॥
ikṣurasaṃ śarkarāṃ ca kṣīraṃ śālyannamityapi ।
laḍḍūkāँścūrṇagodhūmān vyañjanāni tilāni ca ॥37॥
preyāṃsi peyakhādyāni picchalaṃ madhuraṃ dadhi ।
mama priyāṇi vastūni sudhayā tulyakāni ca ॥38॥
tāmbūlaṃ ca varamelāpūgīkarpūramiśritam ।
rasamiṣṭasugandhāḍhyaṃ dravyāṇyetāni dāpaya ।।39॥
svāmī tvaṃ trijagatkartā pradātā sarvasampadām ।।
mahālakṣmīsvarūpā te patnī caiśvaryadāyinī ॥1.101.40॥
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyamamūlyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam ।
vahriśuddhāṃśukaṃ cāru pradāsyasi sudurlabham ।।41॥
sudurlabhaṃ harermantraṃ harau bhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ।।
sarvasiddhipradaṃ nāma kimadeyaṃ sutāya te ।।42॥
icchayā kurute karma tato bhogo bhavatyapi ।
sukhaduḥkhe sadā lagne dehināṃ viramedataḥ ।।43॥
karma nirmūlayantyeva santo hi satataṃ mudā ।
harismaraṇaśīlānāṃ nā'yuryāti satāṃ vṛthā ।।44॥
na teṣāmīśvaraḥ kālo nānye vā tanniyāmakāḥ ।।
ciraṃ jīvanti te bhaktāḥ svacchandaṃ sarvagāminaḥ ।।45॥
jātismarā harerbhaktā jānanti janmanāṃ śatam ।
kathayanti kathāṃ janma labhante svecchayā ca te ॥46॥
paraṃ punanti te pūtāstīrthāni svīyalīlayā ।।
puṇyakṣetre'tra sevārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca bhramanti te ।।47॥
vaiṣṇavānāṃ padasparśāt sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ।।
gurorāsyād viṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśatyapi ॥48॥
taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthapūtaṃ kathayatyeva mādhavaḥ ।
puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvamuddharanti śataṃ param ॥49॥
līlayā parayā bhaktyā sodarān pitaraṃ tathā ।
mātāmahānāṃ puruṣāndaśa pūrvāndaśā'parān ॥1.101.50॥
mātuḥ prasūmuddharanti dāruṇāt yamatāḍanāt ।।
bhaktadarśanamāśleṣaṃ mānavāḥ prāpnuvanti ye ॥51॥
te yātāḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitāḥ ।।
na liptāḥ pātakairbhaktāḥ santataṃ harimānasāḥ ॥52॥
trikoṭijanmanāmante prāpnoti janma mānavam ।।
prāpnoti bhaktasaṃgaṃ sa mānuṣe koṭijanmataḥ ।।53॥
bhaktasaṃgād bhaved bhakteraṃkuro jīvito hara ! ।।
aṃkuraścāvināśī ca vardhate pratijanmani ॥54॥
tattarorvardhamānasya harerdāsyaṃ bhavet phalam ।।
pariṇāme bhaktipāke pārṣadaśca bhaveddhareḥ ॥55॥
tasmādbhaktiṃ harau dehi yathā te śrīharau sadā ।।
gaṇeśarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kalpe kalpe tavā''tmajaḥ ॥56॥
bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ te'stu dehi bhikṣāṃ mama priyām ।।
āgatosmi nivāsāya yadi te'pi mataṃ bhavet ॥57॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyāḥ sahavāse śaṃkaramāhvayan śrīkṛṣṇo brāhmaṇarūpeṇa bhikṣārthamāgatastayoḥ sadbhaktamāhātmyasaṃvādaśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ekādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥101।।


← adhyāyaḥ 101 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 102
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 103 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! tato yadvai sampannaṃ kathayāmyaham ।
ityabhyarthya svapitaraṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram ।। 1 ।।
tūṣṇīmāsa yadā vipraḥ śaṃbhurāśvāsya taṃ dvijam ।।
gṛhāntare gataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ nidritāṃ priyām ॥ 2 ॥
śīghraṃ prabodhayāmāsa bhikṣārthaṃ ca dvijātaye ।।
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa yadyadicchati vāḍavaḥ ।। 3 ।।
pārvatī karapādādi śodhayitvā jalena ca ।
viprepsitāni vastūnyāhārayāmāsa cāṃgaṇe ।। 4 ।।
saṃkalpena tu siddhāni yānyapyanyāni vāñcchati ।
tatsarvaṃ tatra vṛddhāya brāhmaṇāya samarpayat ॥ 5 ॥
na vai nyūnamabhūt kiṃcit tutoṣāti sa vāḍavaḥ ।।
vastūnyādāya vipraḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।6।।
putro bhavitumicchan vai tatraivā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।
pārvatyāstu śarīre yo dhāturlagno'sti śāṃkaraḥ ॥ 7 ॥
tatra dhātau praviṣṭo'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।
pārvatyapi tadā svāṃgeṣvabhilagnaṃ sacetanam ॥ 8 ॥
dhātuṃ dṛṣṭvā śārīraṃ tan malaṃ dhūlyādisaṃbhavam ।
matvā śuddhiṃ tadā naiva cakāra parameśvarī ।। 9 ।।
śarīraṃ bahudhūlyādimalāḍhyaṃ pravilokya ca ।।
snānaṃ viśālaṃ sodgandhaṃ kariṣye'dya dine śanaiḥ ॥1.102.10॥
nirmalaṃ vai śarīraṃ ca nadyāmeva bhaviṣyati ।
evaṃ vicāraṃ dadhatī sthitā prātaḥ śubhāsane ।।11।।
snānayogyavicitrāṇi gandhadravyāṇyakārayat ।।
dāsībhirgṛhakāryāṇi maṃgalādīnyakārayet ।।12।।
atha śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ devanadyāṃ snānāya nirgataḥ ।।
gaṇaiḥ saha sa vai yāto'nye gaṇāstamanudrutāḥ ॥13॥
kelāse pārvatīkṣetre gopure nāsti rakṣakaḥ ।।
sarve gaṇāstadā yātā jñātvā snānotsavaṃ param ॥14॥
śaṃbhumarghyaiścandanaiśca tailaiḥ sugandhibhistathā ।
saurabhaistilapiṣṭaiśca kaisareḥ karpuraistathā ॥15॥
upamṛdya mahādevaṃ snāpayanti sma dhārayā ।।
gaṇānāmapi sarveṣāṃ vihārasnānatāraṇaiḥ ।।16।।
jalakelyādibhistatra sumahānutsavo'bhavat ।
snānānte tu gaṇaiḥ śaṃbhoḥ saṃskṛtā tu śirojaṭā ॥17॥
bhasmapuṣpasugandhyādidravaiḥ saṃprokṣitā'bhavat ।
lalāṭe bālacandrasya rekhayā saha candanam ॥18॥
lekhayā kṛtarekhaṃ tu carcitaṃ puṇḍrakaṃ yathā ।।
karṇapūrau ca rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtau kaṇṭhe ca vāsukiḥ ॥19॥
hāro rudrākṣasampanno muṇḍamālā'pi pauraṭī ।।
karṇayordhatttūrapuṣpe rudrākṣadvayavuṭṭike ॥1.102.20॥
bhujayoḥ sarparājau ca prakoṣṭhe bhujagadvayam ।।
kauśyastu mudrikā ratnaśrṛṃkhaleṃ'gulihastayoḥ ॥21॥
yajñopavītaṃ śubhagaṃ hasticarmasukaṃcukam ।।
siṃhacarmakṛtadhautraṃ kaṭyāṃ ca muñjamekhalā ।।22।।
triśūlaṃ hastasannyastaṃ kaupīnaṃ mṛgacarmaṇaḥ ।।
satkāṣṭhapāduke ramye śarīre bhasma saṃdhṛtam ॥23॥
atha netre dhyānayukte parāvṛtyā'rdhamelite ।।
vyāghracarmaṇā prātarvai sandhyārthaṃ saṃsthito haraḥ ।।24।।
apāṃ kamaṇḍaluḥ pārśve pañcapātrāṇi cāgrataḥ ।।
kuśapuṣpā'kṣatadhūpadīpacandanakuṃkumam ॥25॥
nyastaṃ gaṇaiḥ svayaṃ devo dhyānamagno babhūva ha ।।
samādhiṃ svātmani prāpto nispṛhaḥ sarvathā sadā ॥26॥
yadā tiṣṭhati dhyāne vā samādhau śaṃkarastadā ।।
nāsti kālasya niyamo nispṛhasya tṛṇaṃ jagat ॥27॥
samādhau saṃsthito devo gaṇāstatra tvitastataḥ ।
nṛtyanti ca pragāyanti ramante ca vanādiṣu ॥28॥
vṛkṣeṣvārohā'varohau kurvanti ca svapanti ca ।
phalamūlānyāharanti gṛhṇanti mādakāni ca ।।29।।
puṣpapatrāṇi cinvanti nayanti harasannidhau ।।
nivedya dhyānamagnāya śaṃbhave'tha ca te gaṇāḥ ॥1.102.30॥
phalakandādi khādanti rasānāsvādayanti ca । ।
evamutsavakartṛṇāṃ saṃgavastatra vai gataḥ ॥31॥
gaṇāḥ śaṃbhuṃ vihāyaiva na cāyānti haragṛham ।।
pratīkṣate pārvatī tu nā''yādeko'pi sevakaḥ ।।32।।
tataḥ snātuṃ samīhānā tailasaurabhavāribhiḥ ।।
sugandhitadravairdevī sakeśaṃ snānamicchati ।।33।।
dvāre kaścinmayā sthāpyo dvārapālo nirodhakaḥ ।।
snāne kaścinna cā''gacched rahasīti vicārya vai ॥34॥
svasyā dhūlyādikaṃ lagnaṃ śaṃbhudhātumayaṃ malam ।
svedamiśraṃ dravaṃ matvā viśliṣya kṛtapeśikam ॥35॥
puttalaṃ sundaraṃ tasya sarvāvayavaśobhitam ।।
satyaḥ putro yathā vā syāt tādṛśaṃ viracayya ca ।।36॥
yāvatkareṇa dehaṃ taṃ snigdhacikkaṇatāptaye ।।
parimārjayate mohāttāvat tāvattu tat svayam ॥37॥
caitanye sadrūpe bhāve vivṛtiṃ prāpya śobhate ।
śiraḥ karatalenaiva yāvanmārjayate śivā ।।38॥
tāvattu mastakaṃ tasya sakeśaṃ sūjjvalaṃ hyabhūt ।।
lalāṭe mukhanetrādau yāvaddhastau suyojitau ॥39॥
tāvannetre surūpe sugrāhake'bhavatāṃ tadā ।
kapolau prollasadgolau lalāṭaṃ cārucandrakam ॥1.102.40॥
oṣṭhau raktau mukhaṃ mandahāsyakṛt kalidantavat ।।
sunāsaṃ ca surūpaṃ ca nirvṛttaṃ tatkṣaṇācchubham ॥41॥
tāvattu pārvatī devī sahāsyā svasakhīstadā ।।
āhvayate prapaśyantu bālo'yaṃ nirmito mayā ॥42॥
hasan bālo'pi mandaṃ svanetre tudghāṭya paśyati ।
mātaraṃ tatsakhīśceti sarvānandakaro'bhavat ।।43।।
tato mātrā kṛtaṃ svasti putrasya karayostathā ।
pṛṣṭhe vakṣasi kaṭyāṃ ca sakthnostathaiva jānunoḥ ।।44।।
jaṃghayoḥ pādayoścāṃguliṣu prokṣyadravaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।।
svahastau bhrāmitau tasyāṃgāni pramārjitāni ca ।।45॥
yatra yatra pradeśe ca spṛṣṭe hastatale śubhe ।
pārvatyāstatra tatrāyaṃ bālo bhavati cetanaḥ ॥46॥
surūpaḥ suṣṭhvavayavaḥ puṣṭaśca mātṛjo yathā ।
krīḍayā puttalaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ putro jātaḥ sa cetanaḥ ॥47॥
ityāścaryaṃ mahatprāpya pūjanaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam ।।
sarvāvayavapūrṇatvaṃ kṛtaṃ devyā viśeṣataḥ ॥48॥
saṃsmṛtya pārvatī kṛṣṇapradattaṃ varadānakam ।।
ayonijo'grapūjyaste putraścānyo bhavediti ।।49।।
tadidaṃ varadānaṃ vai kṛṣṇarūpaṃ suputrakam ।
matvā niścayatastasya mahāpūjanamācarat ॥1.102.50॥
sugandhaiḥ snāpito dravyairarcito bhojitastathā ।
śrṛṃgāravastubhiḥ samyaka śobhito bodhitastayā ॥51॥
mama putreti cāhūya cumbanaṃ sā vyadhānmuhuḥ ।
stanyapānaṃ nidhāyāṃ'ke'kārayatprāha pārvatī ॥52।।
mama rakṣākaraḥ putraḥ kṛṣṇo'yaṃ bhagavān svayam ।
prādurbhūto mama kalpavādapaḥ phalito'dhunā ॥53।।
aho sakhyaḥ kumāraṃ me vardhayantu śubhāśiṣā ।।
sakhya āyāntu putraṃ me balaṃ dadatu rakṣakam ॥54॥
aho ālyaḥ kumāraṃ me śirastrāṇaṃ sukaṃcukam ।
yajñopavītakaṃ ramyaṃ hāraṃ kāṃcanajaṃ tathā ।।55॥
ratnahīrakabhūṣāśca dhārayantu yathāsthalam ।
dhautraṃ pītāmbaraṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca kaṭibandhanam ।।56॥
samarpayantu tadyogyaṃ dadatvanyadapekṣitam ।।
kurvantu jayatilakaṃ candrakaṃ sākṣataṃ tathā ॥57।।
evaṃ śrṛṃgāritaścāpi vardhitaśca sakhījanaiḥ ।।
satyā ca bodhito me tvaṃ rakṣako bhava gopure ॥58॥
dattānyasmai mahaddhāryaṃ triśūlaṃ carma khaḍgakam ।
śaktiḥ pāśaḥ kuṭhāraśca rakṣāyā māliketi ca ।।59॥
evaṃ susajjya putraṃ taṃ śaṃbhoranyūnasadbalam ।।
svasnānodyānamārgasya gopure'sthāpayat satī ।।1.102.60।।
tayā''jñapto vayaṃ snāmo devanadyā hṛde śubhe ।।
udyāne saṃsthite tatra jalāgādhe ramāmahe ।।61॥
mama putro gaṇeśastvaṃ mā praveśaya kaṃcana ।
yāvadvayaṃ nivṛttāḥ sma snānādatra gṛhāṃgaṇe ॥6॥
tāvatkaścijjano nāyād gopurāntaramityayam ।।
ādeśo me tvayā rakṣyo mā pumān viśatu sthalīm ॥63॥
yadi prasahya cāgacched balāttaṃ vinivārya vai ।
rakṣaṇaṃ tava mātustu pārvatyā me karotviti ॥64॥
yāvatsnānāni jāyante tāvanna praviśennara ।
evamuktvā dṛḍhayitvā'rpayitvā cā''yudhāni sā ॥65॥
mantrāṇyapi tadā datvā'tiṣṭhipadgaṇanāyakam ।।
so'yaṃ gopuramavati yathādeśamatandritaḥ ॥66॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kṛṣṇātmakaviprasya bhikṣāprāptyuttaramadṛśyatā, pārvatyāḥ śārīradhātumalād gaṇeśotpattiḥ saprāṇagaṇeśasya pārvatyāḥ snānakāle gopurarakṣārthaṃ niyuktiścetyādivarṇananāmā dvyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 102 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 102 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 103
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 104 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu priye sahā''lībhiḥ pārvatī harasundarī ।।
devyaḥ sarvāśca dāsyaśca militvā dyunadīṃ saha ।। 1 ।।
gatāḥ snānārthamityatra niḥśaṃkaṃ snānti vāriṣu ।
sugandhisāratailāni sammṛdyā'tyamṛtāni ca ।। 2 ।।
dadhīni madhubhiścāpi rasyānyapi kaṭūni ca ।
sakhyaḥ snānaṃ kārayanti pārvatīṃ jagataḥ prasūm ।। 3 ।।
ramayanti jale tāṃ vai prāṃjalakṣepaṇādibhiḥ ।।
sugandhi salilaṃ jātaṃ sugandhadravamiśritam ।।4।।
snāne sakhīvihāre'tra tṛptirnāsāṃ prajāyate ।।
snānti caiva punaḥ snānti patanti salile muhuḥ ।। 5 ॥
vinirgatya punaḥ snānti snānāntaṃ naiva yānti hi ।।
saṃgavo vigataḥ kālaḥ śaṃbhurdhyānād bahistadā ।। 6 ।।
āgataḥ svāsanaṃ tyaktvā caikākī svāśramaṃ gataḥ ।।
gaṇāṃścānye na jānanti snānalagnāstadā'bhavan ।। 7 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ svābhāviko dhyānī śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prayāti hi ।।
svāśramasya mahaddvāraṃ yāvat praviśatīśvaraḥ ।। 8 ॥
tāvatpārvatyātmajena niruddho yāhi mā tviti ।।
kastvaṃ kasmātsamāyātaḥ karamādviśasi gopuram ॥ 9 ॥
tiṣṭha vivṛtya taṃ mārgaṃ yāhi yenā''gato'tra vai ।।
nā'tra sthātuṃ pradeyo vai mayā kau'pi jano naraḥ ॥1.103.10॥
ājñā nāstyeva me mātustasmādvigaccha gopurāt ।
tathāpi śaṃkarastasya naiva śrutvā prayāti hi ॥11॥
tāvat krodhasamāviṣṭo gaṇeśo mātṛsevakaḥ ।
prodghuṣya ca samutplutya pradudrāva haraṃ prati ॥12॥
gatvā tanmārgamārudhya mā gacchoktvā hyupasthitaḥ ।
parāgaccha parāgaccha ko'si kva gacchasi drutam ।।13।।
atrodyāne praveśāya manmātrājñā na vartate !
snānaṃ kurvanti sakhyaśca manmātrā saha vāribhiḥ ॥14॥
mā yāhi naiva gantavyaṃ vigaccheto bahiḥ pivan ! ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tamajñātvā ko'si roddhā mama gṛham ॥15॥
mamodyānaṃ tu gacchāmi kastvaṃ roddhā mamāpi ca ।।
gaccha yāhi tvitaḥ sthānāt kayā tvaṃ yojito'tra vai ।।16॥
bahirgaccha mama dvārādgopurānmama rakṣitāt ।
ityākruśya hareṇa svamavijñāya tu bālakam ॥17॥
haste dhṛtvā gopurāt sa bahirniṣkāsito balāt ।
tāvadgaṇeśastaddhastāddhastaṃ svaṃ praviyujya ca ॥18॥
śaṃbhuṃ hastadvaye dhṛtvā cākruśya nītavān bahiḥ ।
prāha śaṃbhuṃ yāhi dūraṃ mā mukhaṃ me pradarśaya ॥19॥
śaṃbhunā'pi tadā jñātaṃ matto'pi balavānayam ।
na vai śārīrayuddhena jetuṃ śakyo bhavedayam ॥1.103.20॥
aho madīyaḥ kailāso gṛhodyānaśca rakṣasā ।।
svāyattīkṛta evaitya kenā'pi dhruvamarthataḥ ॥21॥
kva syād devī mama patnī kimabhūd viparītakam ।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā cādya hyayaṃ tu balavāniti ॥22॥
yadi gatvā gaṇān vakṣye tadā me balahīnatā ।।
hāsyāspadatvamāpnuyāṃ yuddhe cāpi parājayam ॥23॥
svasya mānaṃ dhanaṃ mantraṃ cāvamānaṃ ca maithunam ।
dānaṃ dharmaṃ gṛhakleśaṃ kāryaṃ naiva prakāśayet ॥24॥
tataḥ kimiti vai kāryaṃ bālo'yaṃ balavāniti ।
pārvatī ced vijānīyād yuddhe śaṃbhuḥ parājitaḥ ॥25॥
tadagre ca mayā bhāvyaṃ natakaṃdharavartinā ।
vaktyayaṃ pārvatīputraḥ kimevaṃ saṃbhavediti ॥26॥
sarvasmājjayamicchedvai putrācchiṣyātparājayam ।।
ataḥ sāmnā bodhayitvā gacchāmi mama mandiram ॥27॥
vicāryetthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā yāvadvadati śaṃkaraḥ ।
gaṇeśo'pi tadā dvāraṃ niruddhya pratitiṣṭhati ॥28॥
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mamaiṣo vai kailāso vartate gṛham ।।
patnī bhāryā mama devī pārvatī vartateṃ'gaja ! ॥29॥
mā'haṃ tvayā niroddhavyo gantuṃ dehi mama gṛham ।।
śrutvaitatsa gaṇeśastu prāha taṃ roṣataḥ khalu ॥1.103.30॥
mā vocaḥ śaṭha patnīti bhāryeti cāṃgajeti ca ।।
mārayiṣyāmi ca tvāṃ vai no ced gacchasi dūrataḥ ॥31॥
sthūlo mahānaraṇyastho gaccha dūraṃ na te gamaḥ ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha ca taṃ jñātvā mātṛbhaktaṃ samudyatam ॥32॥
aho bāla ! na te mātā na pitā te'sti kaścan ।
mātā piteti nāmnā vai svārthamātranibandhanā ॥33॥
kathaṃ prāṇān priyāँstyaktumīhase mātṛnāmataḥ ।।
haniṣye tvāṃ triśūlena no cenmuñcasi mārgakam 34
ityuktvā taṃ haraścā'pāsārayat svakareṇa vai ।
gaṇeśo'pi haraṃ cāpāsārayat svakareṇa hi ।।35।।
gopurānnirgatau bāhye deśe yuyudhatuśca tau ।।
keśākeśi muṣṭāmuṣṭi daṇḍādaṇḍi nijaghnatuḥ ॥36॥
bahubalena pāśena bāhubhirjānubhistathā ।
kaphoṇikābhiranyonyaṃ tāḍayāmāsaturmuhuḥ ॥37
tayostu tāḍanaṃ tatra tvākaṇṭhāgraṃ yadā hyabhūt ।।
gaṇeśastu tadā śaṃbhumūrdhvamuttolya vegataḥ ॥38॥
bhuvi prakṣipya tadvakṣaḥ prapīḍyopari saṃsthitaḥ ।।
yuvā kruddho gaṇeśastaṃ mūḍhamāramamārayat ॥39॥
śaṃbhuḥ prāha aho hā hā mṛto'smi muñca māṃ yadi ।
tadā te laḍḍukāndatvā pūjayiṣyāmi cāgrataḥ ।।1.103.40।।
gaṇeśastu tadā tyaktvā śaṃbhuṃ pārśve sthito'bhavat ।
śaṃbhurjaṭāṃ samāṃ kṛtvā dhulīrdehādamārjayat ॥41॥
svastho bhūtvā ca yāvadvai gopurāntarvivikṣati ।।
triśūlaṃ tu gaṇastāvat samādāya ruṇaddhitam ॥42॥
śaṃbhuścāpi mahākruddhaḥ prāha bālamaninditam ।।
kathaṃ prāṇān vihātuṃ tvaṃ mayā virodhamicchasi ।।43॥
gacchā'ntaḥ pṛccha jananīṃ śaṃkaraḥ ko bhavettava ।।
yadi sā kathayenmāṃ svapatiṃ dehi praveśanam 44॥
gaṇeśaḥ prāha dhūrtastvaṃ vadhyo bhavasi śastrataḥ ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha varākastvaṃ vadhyo bhavasi śūlataḥ ॥45॥
gaṇaḥ prāha svamātrārthaṃ yadi prāṇāḥ paretakāḥ ।।
tadāpi me śubhaṃ bhūyāt svargaṃ vindāmi sevayā ॥46॥
mātrarthaṃ janakārthaṃ ca patnyarthaṃ ca satāṃ kṛte ।।
prāṇādyarpayitā yāti svargaṃ vā mokṣamityapi ॥47॥
yadi prāṇā mama yānti mātrarthaṃ saphalaṃ januḥ ।
hato yadyajñātapitrā tathāpi saphalaṃ januḥ 48।।
evamuktvā namaḥ kṛtvā jagrāha ca triśūlakam ।
śaṃbhūrapi varaṃ putrahastānmṛtyumupasthitam ।।49।।
yāvadajñātacaryau svastāvat snehaḥ kuto mataḥ ।।
mṛtyurbuddhimatā'pohyo yāvadbuddhibalodayam ॥1.103.50॥
vicāryetthaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā jagrāha svatriśūlakam ।।
parasparaṃ prajaghnaturdayāṃ kṛtvā tu pṛṣṭhataḥ ॥51।।
gaṇeśena tadā śaṃbhostriśūlaṃ parigṛhya ca ।
dvivṛttaṃ valayaṃ kṛtvā kṣepitaṃ bhūtale drutam ॥52॥
dṛṣṭvā bālabalaṃ śaṃbhuḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ sumohitaḥ ।
punaḥ paraśumādāya jaghāna gaṇakaṃdhare ॥53॥
gaṇastaṃ paraśuṃ svasya kuṭhāreṇa babhaṃja vai ।।
dvedhā jātaṃ tu paraśuṃ tyaktvā śaktimupādade ॥54।।
gaṇeśo'pi tvaritaḥ san utplutya vyomavartmani ।
śaktiṃ vidhṛtya ca balācchaṃbhuṃ tayā jaghāna saḥ ॥55॥
mūrchito roṣamāpanno niṣasāda haro bhuvi ।।
punarutthāya yāvadvai khaḍgaṃ gṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ ॥56॥
gajastāvat triśūlena khaḍgaṃ dvedhā babhaṃja ha ।।
śaṃkaraścātikhinnaḥ san mahākālasurūpadhṛk ॥57।।
gaṇasyaiva triśūlaṃ tvāskandya prāmārayad gale ।।
chinnaḥ kaṇṭho gaṇeśasya patitaṃ mastakaṃ bhuvi ॥58॥
kṛṣṇe tallīnatāṃ prāptaṃ kabandho vartate'tra tu ।
śaṃbhuḥ saroṣatāmrākṣaḥ snātvā svāṃ pārvatīṃ prati ॥59।।
tatra sthāne gato yāvad dṛśyate kālarūpadhṛk ।
pārvatī bhayamāpannā drāgeva pādayorgatā ॥1.103.60।।
kṣamāpaya mahādeva ! kiṃ krodho deharaktatā ।
kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatā svāmin kathaṃ raktapluto bhavān ॥61।।
kva yuddhaṃ kena sākaṃ vā jātaṃ cā'niṣṭamāgatam ।
śaṃbhustadā priyāśliṣṭaḥ śānto bhūtvā'bravīdidam ।।62।।
ko'yaṃ gopurasaṃroddhā tvayā rakṣita ujjaḍaḥ ।
kiṃ kiṃ deva kṛtaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ jātaṃ vada me bhramaḥ ॥63॥
tava putro gaṇeśaḥ sa bahunā tapasā'rthitaḥ ।।
mayā snānaprakālasyetarapraveśarodhakaḥ ॥64
niṣāditaḥ kimaniṣṭaṃ jātaṃ prāṇada me vada ।
iti kṛtvā gale lagnāṃ śaṃbhuḥ prāha mṛto hyayam ॥65॥
mayā triśūlaghātena nāśitaḥ kādviyojitaḥ ।
pārvatī tu samāśrutya roditī kurarīva sā ॥66॥
aho putrajaneḥ saukhyaṃ nidhane duḥkhamityapi ।।
patiṃ tyaktvā satvaraṃ so dudrāva gopuraṃ prati ॥67।।
patitaṃ tatkabandhaṃ tu svāṃke sthāpyaruroda ha ।।
svātmābhimānajaṃ duḥkhaṃ sati jñāne nivartate ॥68॥
putraṃ śocāmi kiṃ vā me patiṃ śocāmi nāśakam ।
gṛhe hantā ca ghātyaśca kaṃ śocāmi gṛhiṇyaham ॥69॥
re putra tvaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo ha janimṛtireva ha ।
na vai te maraṇaṃ yogyaṃ hyevaṃ cecca mriye'pyaham ।।1.103.70।।
yadi tvāṃ na jīvayate śaṃkaraste vināśakaḥ ।।
anāhāravrataṃ kṛtvā yātrāpāraṃ karomyaham ॥71॥
ityuktvā hyaśanaṃ tyaktvā vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ ।।
saṃgṛhya gopurasthāne kabandhaṃ tatra saṃsthitā ।।72॥
aho ho lokamātā sā hyaśokā'pi śucānvitā ।
loko'yaṃ dehasambaddho jñānināmapi śokakṛt ।।73॥
kṣaṇaṃ bhavati saṃmohādbhrāmakaḥ kā vicitratā ।
śrutvā vilāpaṃ pārvatyāḥ sakhyastatra samāgatāḥ ॥74॥
śaṃbhuśca kārtikeyaśca brahmaviṣṇusurādayaḥ ।
gaṇāśca prāyayuḥ sarve vilopaṃ cakrire tadā ।।75॥
caturdaśasu lokeṣu śoko'yaṃ prasṛto drutam ।।
ājagmustatkṣaṇe tatra caturdaśabilasthitāḥ ॥76॥
śokārtāṃ pārvatīṃ devyo bodhayanti narāstathā ।
śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ vicāraṃ saṃcakre tajjīvanāya ca ।।77।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśaśaṃkarayoryuddhe gaṇeśamastakacchedatajjanyaśokaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 103 ॥

adhyāyaḥ 104
