śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
etasminnantare tatra vāg babhūvā'śarīriṇī ।
mā śokaṃ kuru deveśi ! sutaste kṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ ।। 1 ।।
yattejo yoginaḥ śaśvad dhyāyanti satataṃ mudā ।
dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavā devā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ॥ 2 ॥
yasya pūjyasya sarvāgre kalpe kalpe ca pūjanam ।
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvavighno vinaśyati ।। 3 ।।
nāsīt sa bhikṣuko vipraḥ sa āsīdvai janārdanaḥ ।।
kiṃ vā vilāpaṃ kuruṣe na nāśastava śāṃkareḥ ॥ 4 ॥
eṣāṃ sarasvatīṃ śrutvā dhairya cālambya yatnataḥ ।।
tathāpi virahāt sā'bhūd vilapya kṣaṇamūrchitā ॥ 5 ॥
vismitāste surāḥ sarve putradehoparipragām ।।
mṛtāmiva prapaśyanti citraputtalikāṃ yathā ।। 6 ।।
devyaścaiva surāścaiva sarve'pi duḥkhamūrchitāḥ ।।
tānsarvāṃstu tadavasthān dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ । 7 ।।
sadvākyairbodhayāmāsa śītādbhirvyajanaistathā ।।
sukhayitvā'karot tatra prastāva śāṃkarikṛte ॥ 8 ॥
kiṃ kāryamasya bālasya mastakasya suyojane ।
prāṇa ātmā tu pārvatyāḥ śaktyā nihita eva vai ।। 9 ।।
sa cātra punarāgacchetpārvatyāstu prabhāvataḥ ।।
mastakaṃ tu gaṇeśasya kṛṣṇe vilīnatāṃ gatam ॥1.104.10॥
tasmād dvitīyamāptavyaṃ mastakaṃ tu śivādibhiḥ ।।
gaṇeśo jīvito bhūyādasmābhiḥ pūjito bhavet ॥11॥
brahmā prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ bhavān sarvajña ucyate ।।
karmaṇāṃ gativettā tvaṃ ṛṇānubandhabhānavān ॥12॥
kasya kena samaṃ karma bhogyaṃ vetti na cā'paraḥ ।।
vṛkṣaśākhā paricchinnā bhuvi nyastā'pi rohati ॥13॥
tatra bījaṃ vinā jīvaḥ karmabalāt suyujyate ।
kecid bījācca kecidvai dehāt kīṭādayo'pare ॥14॥
pārthivakardamādanye stambāt kāṇḍācca māṃsataḥ ।।
annādanye dehayogāddhātuyogāt tathā'pare ॥15॥
jāyante jantavasteṣāṃ svasvakarmānusārataḥ ।।
tasmāt tvameva vijñātā mastakaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet ॥16॥
yasmā'nena śarīreṇa mastakasyaṛṇaṃ bhavet ।
tasyaiva mastakaṃ tvatra kabandhe yojyameva vai ।।17।।
brahmā prāha tadā sarvān yamo gacched vanāntare।
prathamaṃ yo milet prāṇī tadā tasyaiva mastakam ।।18॥
gṛhītvā ca samāgatya gaṇaskandhe niyojayet ।।
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tatra mama śṛṇvantu devatāḥ ॥19॥
uttarasyāṃ diśi puṣpabhadrāyāḥ saritastaṭe ।
asya ṛṇānubandhyeko hastī vartata ityamum ।।1.104.20।।
hastinaṃ prati gatvā'haṃ mastakaṃ tasya śobhanam ।।
kabandhaitatpariṇāhamānagrīvasumaṇḍalam ॥21॥
chitvā sudarśanenaiva nayāmi tatra yāmi ca ।।
ityāśvāsya ca tānsarvānāruhya garuḍaṃ hariḥ ॥22॥
jagāma puṣpabhadrāyāstaṭe yatra sa ībharāṭ ।
sughaṭṭavṛkṣavallyādisaṃvṛte tatra kānane ॥23॥
gajendraṃ divyavapuṣaṃ śvetaṃ svahastinīyutam ।
tathodakaśirasaṃ ramyaṃ sukhinaṃ surataśramāt ॥24॥
paritaḥ śāvakān kṛtvā paramānandamānasam ।।
dadarśa bhagavāँstaṃ vai prāha cainaṃ gajādhipam ॥25॥
sukhito'si kuṭumbena dārāpatyajanādibhiḥ ।।
athottaraṃ mahatsaukhyaṃ labhyaṃ dānādikarmabhiḥ ॥26॥
gajaḥ prāha bhavān ko'sti me'tithiḥ prasamāgataḥ ।।
kadalīvanajātāni svarṇāni kadalāni vai ॥27॥
dāsye bhuṃkṣva paraṃ śreyaḥ kurvasmākaṃ vanaṃjuṣām ।।
paśūnāṃ nedṛśo lābho kadāpi bhavati prabho ॥28॥
pūrvajātismarāt tvāṃ vai manye kṛṣṇaḥ samāgataḥ ।
matpūrvakarmaṇaḥ pāśād bandhanaṃ pāśavaṃ mayā ॥29॥
jñātaṃ ca jñāsyate yadvai bhāvi tadapi me kuru ।।
bhagavānapi taddattaṃ jagrāha yāvadarhaṇam ॥1.104.30॥
tvarā me'sti mama prārthyaṃ dehi śreyo bhaviṣyati ।
gajaḥ prāha prabhuḥ sākṣānmadarthaṃ tu samāgataḥ ॥31॥
tasmātputraiḥ striyā cānyairmā śokastu vidhīyatām ।।
nātha gṛhāṇa yanneyaṃ śīghraṃ kuru prasannatām ॥32॥
tava yogānmama muktiḥ kuṭumbasyāpi vai dhruvā ।।
iti procya praṇamyā'tha samīpe samupasthitā ॥33॥
hariḥ sudarśanenaiva cicchede tacchiro mudā ।।
garuḍe sthāpayāmāsa rudhirāktaṃ manoharam ॥34॥
vicchinnāṃgaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda hastinī priyā ।
ruruduḥ śāvakāratasya vilapya ca śucāturāḥ ॥35॥
sā tuṣṭāva ramākāntaṃ śāntaṃ sasmitamāsthitam ।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ harim ॥36॥
garuḍasthaṃ jagannāthaṃ bhrāmayantaṃ sudarśanam ।।
saṃsārasukhadātāraṃ taddhartāraṃ namāmyaham ॥37॥
anāthinyai punarnāthapradātāraṃ namāmyaham ।
bhaktāyāḥ sukhakartāraṃ namāmi patijīvanam ॥38॥
prabhustatstavanāttuṣṭastasyai prāha praharṣitaḥ ।
tava kāryaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā jīvayitvā patiṃ tava ।।39॥
tato gamiṣye bhadraṃ te kṣaṇaṃ śokaṃ parityaja ।।
ityuktvā ca mahāraṇyaṃ jagāma tatra yūthapaḥ ॥1.104.40॥
prāptaḥ kālavaśācchubhro mṛto'bhūtkaścidībharāṭ ।
akhaṇḍitaśarīrasya tasyaiva mṛtamastakam ॥41॥
pṛthakkṛtya yuyuje'trā''gatya kabandhamaṇḍale।
yadyapi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasāmarthyavān vibhuḥ ॥42॥
gaṇeśasya mastakaṃ vai yoktuṃ tadeva cārhati ।।
navaṃ vā mastakaṃ tatra cāṃkurayitumarhati ॥43॥
hastino'pi mastakaṃ tad dvitīyaṃ kartumarhati ।।
tathāpi yatkṛtaṃ cātra svecchāyā ṛṇabandhanāt ।।44॥
evaṃ taṃ jīvayāmāsa hastinaṃ caraṇāṃbujam ।।
sarvāṃge yojayāmāsa parivāraṃ pavitrayan ॥45॥
tvaṃ jīvā''kalpaparyantaṃ parivāraiḥ samaṃ gaja ।
ityuktvā ca garuḍena kailāsaṃ hyājagāma vai ॥46॥
kabandhaṃ tu gaṇeśasya nītvā svasyaiva vakṣasi ।
ruciraṃ tacchiraḥ samyag yojayāmāsa bālake ॥47॥
jīvayāmāsa taṃ śīghra huṃkāroccāraṇena ca ।।
sarve prasannāḥ saṃjātāḥ kaṇṭhe tu sandhinīṃ dadhau ॥48॥
gaṇeśaḥ putrarūpo'sau praṇanāmā''gatānmuhuḥ ।
sarvaiḥ sabhājito devairāśīrbhiścirajīvitā ॥49॥
pradattā'tha tato viṣṇuruvāca pārvatīṃ satīm ।।
brahmādikīṭaparyantaṃ phalaṃ bhuṃkte svakarmaṇaḥ ॥1.104.50॥
śubhā'śubhaṃ kṛtaṃ yadyat pratiyonau prapadyate ।
indraḥ svakarmaṇā kīṭayonau janma vrajet sati ! ॥51॥
kīṭaścāpi bhavedindraḥ pūrvakarmaphalena vai ।।
siṃho'pi makṣikāṃ hantumakṣamaḥ prāktanaṃ vinā ॥52॥
maśako hastinaṃ hantuṃ kṣamaḥ prāktanakarmaṇā ।।
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokamānandaḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ॥53॥
sukarmaṇaḥ sukhaṃ harṣamitare pāpakarmaṇaḥ ।।
ihaiva karmaṇāṃ bhogaḥ paratra ca śubhāśubhaiḥ ॥54॥
golokanāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ।।
tava putraḥ samutpannaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭā ca pārvatī ॥55॥
stanaṃ dadau ca śiśave taṃ praṇamya gadādharam ।।
tuṣṭāva prāṃjalirbhaktyā viṣṇuṃ taṃ kamalāpatim ॥56॥
āśiṣaṃ yuyuje viṣṇuḥ śiśuṃ ca śiśumātaram ।
dadau kaṇṭhe bālakasya kaustubhaṃ ca svabhūṣaṇam ॥57॥
brahmā dadau mukuṭaṃ ca dharmo vai ratnabhūṣaṇam ।
siddhāsanaṃ dadau dharmastasmai vedhāḥ kamaṇḍalum ॥58॥
śaṃkaro yogapaṭṭaṃ ca tattvajñānaṃ sudurlabham ।।
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ śakraḥ sūryaśca maṇikuṇḍale ॥59॥
māṇikyamālāṃ candraśca kuberaśca kirīṭakam ।।
vahniśuddhaṃ ca vasanaṃ dadau tasmai hutāśanaḥ ॥1.104.60॥
ratnachatraṃ ca varuṇo vāyū ratnāṃgulīyakam ।।
kṣīrododbhavasadratnaracitaṃ valayaṃ varam ॥61॥
mañjīraṃ cāpi keyūraṃ dadau lakṣmīrharipriyā ।।
kaṇṭhabhūṣāṃ ca sāvitrī bhāratī hāramujjvalam ॥62।।
krameṇa sarve devāśca devyaśca yautakaṃ daduḥ ।
munayaḥ parvatāṃcaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca ॥63॥
vasundharā dadau tasmai vāhanāya ca mūṣakam ।
krameṇa devā devyaśca munayaḥ parvatādayaḥ ॥64॥
gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā manavo mānavāstathā ।
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi svādūni madhurāṇi ca ॥65॥
pūjāṃ cakruśca te sarve kramādvai bhaktipūrvakam ।
pārvatī jagatāṃ mātā smerānanasaroruhā ॥66॥
ratnasiṃhāsane putraṃ vāsayāmāsa jīvitam ।
kartuṃ pūjāṃ tatastasya viśeṣeṇopacakrame ॥67॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vyomavāṇyā śrīkṛṣṇo'yaṃ gaṇeśa iti vijñāpite śrīhariṇā hastimastakasandhānaṃ kṛtaṃ brahmādibhi
rupadādānaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।104॥


← adhyāyaḥ 104 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
sarvatīrthodakaiḥ ratnakalaśāvarjitaiḥ stutaiḥ ।
snāpayāmāsa vedoktamantreṇa munibhistadā ॥ 1।।
agniśuddhe ca vasane dadau tasmai satī mudā ।।
godāvaryudakaiḥ pādyamarghyaṃ gaṃgodakena ca ।। 2 ।।
dūrvābhirakṣataiḥ puṣpaiścandanena samanvitam ।
puṣkarodakamānīya dadāvācamanīyakam॥3॥
madhuparkaṃ ratnapātraiḥ supeyaṃ śarkarānvitam ।
snānīyaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ ca svarvaidyābhyāṃ vinirmitam ॥ 4 ॥
amūlyaratnaracitaṃ cārubhūṣākadambakam ।
pārijātaprasūnānāmanyeṣāṃ śatakāni ca ॥5॥
mālatīcampakādīnāṃ puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca ।
pūjārhāṇi ca patrāṇi tulasīsahitāni ca ॥ 6 ॥
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāni ca sādaram ।।
ratnapradīpanikaraṃ dhūpaṃ ca parito dadau ॥ 7 ॥
naivedyaṃ tatpriyaṃ caiva tilalaḍḍukaparvatān ।
yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ ca parvatān ॥ 8 ॥
pakvānnānāṃ parvatāँśca susvādusumanoharān ।
parvatān svastikānāṃ ca susvāduśarkarānvitān ॥ 9 ॥
guḍāktānāṃ ca lājānāṃ pṛthukānāṃ ca parvatān ।
śālyannānāṃ piṣṭakānāṃ parvatān vyañjanaiḥ saha ॥1.105.10॥
payobhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca lakṣāṇi pradadau mudā ।।
lakṣāṇi dadhipūrṇānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca pūjane ॥11॥
madhubhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca trilakṣāṇi ca pārvatī ।।
sarpiḥsuvarṇakuṃbhānāṃ paṃcalakṣāṇi sādaram ॥12॥
dāḍimānāṃ śrīphalānāmasaṃkhyāni phalāni ca ।
kharjurāṇāṃ kapitthānāṃ jambūnāṃ vividhāni ca ॥13॥
āmrāṇāṃ panasānāṃ ca kadalīnāṃ phalāni ca ।
anyāni paripakvāni kāladeśodbhavāni ca ।।14॥
dadau tāni mahādevī svādūni madhurāṇi ca ।।
svacchaṃ sunirmalaṃ caiva karpūrādisuvāsitam ॥15॥
gaṃgājalaṃ ca pānārthaṃ punarācamanīyakam ।
tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ॥16॥
suvarṇapātraśatakaṃ bhakṣyapūrṇaṃ ca sā dadau ।
śailarājapriyā'mātyāḥ pupūjuḥ śailajātmajam ॥17॥
viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ pupūjainaṃ hyupahārairanuttamaiḥ ।।
sarvāgre tava pūjā ca mayā dattā surottama ॥18॥
sarvapūjyaśca yogīndro bhava vatsetyuvāca tam ।।
vanamālāṃ dadau tasmai brahmajñānaṃ ca muktidam ॥19॥
sarvasiddhiṃ pradāyaiva cakārā''tmasamaṃ hariḥ ।।
dadau dravyāṇi cārūṇi copacārāँśca ṣoḍaśa ॥1.105.20॥
nāmabhiḥ stavanaṃ cakre munibhiśca samaṃ suraiḥ ।।
vighneśaśca gaṇeśaśca herambaśca gajānanaḥ ॥21॥
lambodaraścaikadantaḥ śūrpakarṇo vināyakaḥ ।
etānyaṣṭau ca nāmāni sarvasiddhipradāni ca ॥22॥
yadyatkāryaṃ bhavet kiṃcinmahadvā tatra sarvadā ।।
pūjanaṃ tu gaṇeśasya kāryaṃ prathamameva vai ॥23॥
tato'nyeṣāṃ tu devānāṃ mamāpi pūjanaṃ bhavet ।।
gaṇeśapūjanādīni vihāya kopi sādhakaḥ ॥24॥
yadyanyatkurute kāryaṃ na syāt siddhaṃ dhruvaṃ hi tat ।
ṛṣibhirmunibhiḥ pitṛdevamanvantarādibhiḥ ॥25॥
dikpālairlokapālaiśca yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ ।
bhuvarantarīkṣasadbhirmānavairatalādijaiḥ ॥26॥
caturdaśastarāvāsaiḥ sarvaireva sadā kṛtau ।।
gaṇeśaḥ prathamaḥ pūjya iti brahmānuśāsanam ॥27॥
ityagrapūjyatā dattā sabhāyāṃ tatra vedhasā ।।
śrīkṛṣṇena svayaṃ tatra prathamaṃ pūjitaśca saḥ ॥28॥
atha pūjottaraṃ tasyāśīrvādā devasatkṛtāḥ ।
viṣṇuḥ prāha śivatulyajñānī cirāyurīśvaraḥ ॥29॥
parākrame ca me tulyaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhava ।
brahmovāca yaśaḥkīrtikhyātibhistvatigo bhava ॥1.105.30॥
sarveṣāmagrataḥ pūjā jāyatāṃ te'tidurlabhā ।
dharmaḥ prāha mayā tulyo dharmiṣṭho bhava bhaktimān ॥31॥
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mayā tulyo dātā bhakto harerbhava ।
vidyābuddhisupuṇyāḍhyaḥ śānto dāntaḥ sadā bhava ॥32॥
lakṣmīḥ prāha mamā''vāso gehe dehe bhavettava ।।
pativratā mayā tulyā kāntā tava bhavatviti ॥33॥
vāṇī prāha mayā tulyā kavitā dhāraṇā smṛtiḥ ।
vivecanā sumedhā sacchaktirbhavatu te sadā ॥34॥
sāvitryuvāca vatsa tvaṃ vedajñānī japī bhava ।
śailaḥ prāha harau kṛṣṇe bhaktirbhavatu te sadā ॥35॥
śrīkṛṣṇatulyo guṇavān bhava kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।।
menovācā'bdhitulyastvaṃ gāṃbhīrye'naṃgarūpavān ॥36॥
śrīyuktaḥ śrīsvāmitulyo dharme dharmasamo bhava ।
pṛthvī prāha mayā tulyaḥ kṣamayā sarvaratnavān ॥37॥
śaraṇyo vighnanighnaśca pāraṇyo bhava śobhanaḥ ।
umovāca mahāyoge tātatulyo'rthasiddhidaḥ ॥38॥
mṛtyuñjayaśca bhagavān bhavatvativiśāradaḥ ।
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve yuyujurāśiṣaḥ ॥39॥
brāhmaṇā bandinaścaiva yuyujuḥ sarvamaṃgalam ।
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tatra koṭiratnāni pārvatī ॥1.105.40॥
aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca ।
bandibhyaḥ pradadau tatra dānāni vividhāni ca ॥41॥
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa sādhūn sādhvīśca bālakān ।
vedāँśca pāṭhayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ।।42।।
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ gaṇeśāya brahmarūpāya cārave ।
sarvasiddhipradeśāya vighneśāya namo namaḥ ॥43॥
itimantreṇa saṃpūjya datvā dravyāṇi bhaktitaḥ ।
sarve pramuditāstatra brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ ॥44॥
dvātriṃśadakṣaro mālāmantro'yaṃ sarvakāmadaḥ ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phaladaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ ॥45॥
pañcalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirhi mantriṇaḥ ।।
vighnāni ca palāyante tannāmasmaraṇena vai ॥46॥
yātrākāle paṭhitvā yo yāti tadbhaktipūrvakam ।।
tasya sarvābhīṣṭasiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ॥47॥
rātrau dṛṣṭaṃ tu duḥsvapnaṃ susvapnamupajāyate ।
kadāpi na bhavetpāṭhādgrahapīḍāpi dāruṇā ॥48॥
śatrunāśo buddhivṛddhirlakṣmīvṛddhiḥ sadā bhavet ।
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva śokāścaiva bhayāvahāḥ ।।49॥
nāśaṃ yānti na cāyānti gaṇeśasyā'rcanātstavāt ।
vināyakasya kavacaṃ sarvāpadvinivārakam ॥1.105.50॥
kathayāmi mahālakṣmi ! sarvalokeṣu śāntikṛt ।।
uktaṃ kauthumaśākhāyāṃ sāmavede manoharam ॥51॥
kavacaṃ bibhratāṃ mṛtyurna bhiyā yāti sannidhim ।
nā''yurvyayo nā'śubhaṃ ca brahmāṇḍe na parājayaḥ ॥52॥
daśalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ tu kavacaṃ bhavet ।
saṃsāramohakasyā'sya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ॥53॥
ṛṣiśchando bṛhatī ca devo lambodaraḥ svayam ।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ॥54॥
oṃ gaṃ huṃ śrīgaṇeśāya svāhā me pātu mastakam ।।
dvātriṃśadakṣaro mantro lalāṭaṃ me sadā'vatu ॥55॥
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gamiti vai satataṃ pātu locane ।
tālukaṃ pātu vighneśaḥ satataṃ ca dharātale ॥56॥
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīmiti paraṃ santataṃ pātu nāsike ।
oṃ gauṃ gaṃ śūrpakarṇāya svāhā pātvadharau mama ।।57॥
dantāँśca tāluke jihvāṃ pātu me ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ ।।
oṃ laṃ śrīṃ lambodarāyeti svāhā gaṇḍau sadā'vatu ।।58॥
oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ vighnanāśāya svāhā karṇau sadā'vatu ।।
oṃ śrīṃ gaṃ gajānanāyeti svāhā skandhaṃ sadā'vatu ॥59॥
oṃ hrīṃ vināyakāyeti svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।।
oṃ klīṃ hrīmiti kāṅkalaṃ pātu vakṣaḥsthalaṃ param ॥1.105.60॥
karau pādau sadā pātu sarvāṃgaṃ vighnanāśakṛt ।।
prācyāṃ lambodaraḥ pātu cāgneyyāṃ vighnāyakaḥ ॥61॥
dakṣiṇe pātu vighneśo nairṛtyāṃ tu gajānanaḥ ।।
paścime pārvatīputro vāyavyāṃ śaṃkarātmajaḥ ॥62॥
kṛṣṇasyāṃśaścottare ca paripūrṇatamasya ca ।।
aiśānyāmekadantaśca herambaḥ pātu cordhvataḥ ।।63॥
adho gaṇādhipaḥ pātu sarvapūjyaśca sarvataḥ ।।
svapne jāgaraṇe caiva pātu māṃ yogināṃ guruḥ ॥64॥
ityetatkavacaṃ kṛṣṇo goloke'dātsvayaṃ tu me ।।
mayā nārāyaṇenātra yamādisurasannidhau ॥65॥
śanaiścarāyā'rpitaṃ tat sarvasaṃkaṭatārakam ।।
tadevedaṃ mahālakṣmi ! sarvebhyaḥ śrāvitaṃ mayā ॥66॥
gurumabhyarcya vidhivat kavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ।।
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so'pi viṣṇusamo bhavet ॥67॥
sarvatra vijayī pūjyo bhavedgrahaṇamātrataḥ ।।
bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍā brahmarākṣasāḥ ॥68॥
ḍākinīyoginīyakṣavetālā bhairavādayaḥ ।।
bālagrahā grahāścaiva kṣetrapālādayastathā ॥69॥
varmaṇaḥ śabdamātreṇa palāyante tu bhīravaḥ ।।
ṛjave gurubhaktāya svaśiṣyāya prakāśayet ॥1.105.70॥
atha gaṇeśadevasyā'ṣṭakaṃ vakṣye sukhapradam ।।
yatpāṭhakaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo gaṇeśo'vati sarvadā ॥71॥
oṃ namo'ntaḥsusattvāya śivasattvāya te namaḥ ।।
oṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇarūpāya śailajāṃ'gāya te namaḥ ॥72॥
oṃ namo vṛddhaviprāya sattvasaṃsthāya te namaḥ ।
oṃ namaḥ piṇḍarūpāya nyastacittāya te namaḥ ॥73॥
oṃ namaḥ siddhyadhiṣṭhāya sarvavidyāya te namaḥ ।
oṃ namo gopuratrātre mātrājñāpāya te namaḥ ॥74॥
oṃ namo'stvalakṣyapitre pitṛśastyāya te namaḥ ।
oṃ namaḥ skandharūpāya karyānanāya te namaḥ ।।75॥
oṃ namaḥ śivaputrāya sarvapūjyāya te namaḥ ।
oṃ namaścāgrajārcāya laḍḍukā''dyāya te namaḥ ॥76॥
oṃ namo vighnanāśāya mūṣakāsanine namaḥ।
oṃ namo hetilābhāya cirajīvāya te namaḥ ।।77॥
oṃ namo divyavarṣmaṇe bhavyavarmaṇe te namaḥ ।
oṃ namaḥ kavacā''pyāya vaco'vyayāya te namaḥ ॥78।।
oṃ namo maṃgalāḍhyāya bhaktidārḍhyāya te namaḥ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya śrīkṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ ॥79॥
iti stutvā naro bhaktyā'maro bhavati mokṣagaḥ ।
gaṇeśavṛttamityuktaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।1.105.80॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśasya viśeṣāgrapūjā''śīrvādamantrakavacastotrādi pradarśananāmā paṃcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥105।।


← adhyāyaḥ 105 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 106
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 107 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
gaṇeśasya śironāśaḥ kathaṃ vai kena karmaṇā ।
gajamastakasandhānaṃ kathaṃ vai kena karmaṇā 1 ॥ 1॥
paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānparamātmā parātparaḥ ।।
golokanāthaḥ svāṃśena pārvatīputratāmagāt ॥ 2 ॥
āścaryaṃ śrīharestasya mastakacchedanādikam ।
vighneśasya kathaṃ vighnaṃ saṃbhavetparamātmanaḥ ॥ 3 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
sāvadhānā śṛṇu lakṣmi ! samaitihyaṃ purātanam ।
ekadā śaṃkaraḥ sūryaṃ jaghāna paramaṣṭadhā ।। 4 ।।
sumālimālihantāraṃ śūlena ca tadā raviḥ ।।
jahau svacetanāṃ sadyo rathācca nipapāta ha ॥5॥

dadarśa kaśyapaḥ putraṃ mṛtavattūrdhvalocanam ।
kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ śokādvilalāpa bhaśaṃ muhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
andhībhūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ babhūva bhayakātaram ।
niṣprabhaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā cā'śapat kaśyapaḥ śivam ।। 7 ।।
matputrasya yathā tejaśchinnaṃ śūlena vakṣasi ।
tvatputrasya śiraśchinnaṃ bhaviṣyati sataijasam ।। 8 ।।
śivaśca galitakrodho jīvayāmāsa taṃ ravim ।
vakṣaḥ sandhānayāmāsa pūrayāmāsa tejasā ।। 9 ।।
sūryastu cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau pituḥ puraḥ ।
sūryo yayau nijā''vāse brahmaṇā kṛtamaṃgalaḥ ।।1 0।।
mālī sumālī daityau tu vyādhigrasto babhūvatuḥ ।
śvitrau galitasarvāṃgau śaktiśūnyau hataprabhau ।।1 1।।
sūryakopena malinau brahmovāca tadā tu tau ।
'oṃ hrīṃ namo bhagavate sūryāya paramātmane svāhā' ।। 12।।
ityanena tu mantreṇa sāvadhānaṃ divākaram ।
bhaktyā saṃpūjya saṃdattvā tūpacārāँśca ṣoḍaśa ।। 13।।।
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvad dhruvaṃ muktau bhaviṣyathaḥ ।
atha sūryasya kavacaṃ bibhrato vyādhayo nahi ।। 14।।
prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā raviḥ ।
vyādhipraṇāśe saundarye viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 15।।
oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīsūryāya svāhā me pātu mastakam ।
aṣṭādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kapālaṃ me sadā'vatu ।। 16।।
vakṣaḥ pātu raviḥ śaśvannābhiṃ sūryaḥ sadā'vatu ।
kaṃkālaṃ me sadā pātu sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ।। 17।।
karau pātu sadā bradhnaḥ pātu pādau prabhākaraḥ ।
vibhākaro me sarvāṃgaṃ pātu santatamīśvaraḥ ।। 18।।
ityetatkavacaṃ dhṛtvā nīrujau tu bhaviṣyathaḥ ।
stavanaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ sauryaṃ vyādhivināśakam ।। 19।।
sarvapāpaharaṃ sāraṃ dhanārogyakaraṃ param ।
tatastau rākṣasau gatvā puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam ।।।20 ।।
dhṛtvā varma raviṃ stotramantreṇārādhya bhāvataḥ ।
tataḥ sūryād varaṃ prāpya nijarūpau babhūvatuḥ ।।21।।
gaṇeśamastakacchedavighnaṃ śāpoṃ'śumālinaḥ ।
jātastu śaṃkarāyeti kāraṇaṃ kathitaṃ tava ।।22।
atha hastikathāṃ vacmi śiraḥsambandhabodhinīm ।
sthiteṣvanyeṣu bahuṣu jantuṣvapi gajasya yat ।।23।।
mastakaṃ yojitaṃ tasya kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu padmaje ।
ekadā devarājo vai puṣpabhadrānadīṃ yayau ।।24।।
tattīre'tirahaḥsthāne puṣpodyāne sugandhini ।
dadarśa kāmukīṃ raṃbhāṃ candralokātsamāgatām ॥25॥
hāvabhāvā'naṃgaceṣṭāsvedakaṭākṣacaṃcalām । ।
āhvayantīmiva rantuṃ provācendro gaje sthitaḥ ॥26॥
raṃbhoru ! vāmanāśliṣya na gantumiṣyate mayā ।।
raṃbhovāca na cāhaṃ te santoṣajananī matā ॥27॥
kṛtakāryajanānāṃ tu dhūrtānāṃ kā nu mitratā ।।
nārī svāduttamaṃ yāti madhu tyaktveva makṣikā ॥28॥
kāmukī kākavallolā phalaṃ bhuktvā prayāti vai ।।
yuvānaṃ rasikaṃ śāntaṃ suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ priyam ॥29॥
guṇinaṃ dhaninaṃ svacchaṃ kāntamicchati kāminī ।
duḥśīlaṃ rogiṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ ratiśaktivihīnakam ।।1.106.30।।
adātāramavijñaṃ ca naiva vāñcchanti yoṣitaḥ ।।
tavā''jñākāriṇīṃ dāsīṃ gṛhāṇā'tra yathāsukham ॥31॥
ityuktvā''gatya devendraṃ kaṇṭhe lagnā babhūva sā ।।
puṣpabhadrātaṭe tatra tayoḥ ratisamāgame ॥32॥
etasminnantare tena vartmanā śaṃkarālayam ।
vaikuṇṭhād yāti durvāsā dṛṣṭaścendreṇa mānitaḥ ॥33॥
pārijātaprasūnaṃ tu durvāsā haraye dadau ।
puṣpaṃ yasya gṛhe caitallakṣmīstaṃ na jahāti vai ॥34॥
tasmādrakṣa sadaivaitadamlānaṃ smṛddhivardhanam ।
sarvavighnaharaṃ nārāyaṇaprasādalabdhikam ।।35।।
mālayā sahitaṃ mūrdhni yasya tasya jayaḥ sadā ।
puraḥ pūjā ca sarveṣāṃ devānāmagraṇīrbhavet ॥36॥
tacchāyeva mahālakṣmīrna jahāti kadāpi tam ।
jñānena tejasā buddhyā vikrameṇa balena ca ॥37॥
sarvadevādhikaḥ śrīmān viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ ।।
bhaktyā mūrdhni na gṛhṇāti yo'haṃkāreṇa mānavaḥ ॥38॥
naivedyaṃ ca hareratra sa naṣṭaśrīḥ svajātibhiḥ ।
durvāsāstu tataḥ sthānādagacchacchāṃkaraṃ girim ॥39॥
indro raṃbhāntike vegī tat tāṃ cikṣepa hastini ।।
kuṃbhayoḥ patitāṃ puṣpamālāṃ hastī nije pade ॥1.106.40॥
śuṇḍhenā''ptvā mamardā'pi taddṛṣṭvā śrīrvinirgatā ।
tathā raṃbhā divaṃ yātā gajo'raṇyaṃ viveśa ca ॥41॥
pāvanaṃ mastakaṃ tasya mālāpuṣpaprasaṃgataḥ ।
chitvā nītvā haristadvai yojayāmāsa bālake ।।42।।
evaṃ śvetagajasyāsya gaṇeśasthaṃ śiraḥ sadā ।।
lakṣmi ! prapūjyatāṃ yātaṃ tvairāvatasya kaṃ hi tat ॥43॥
atha kaśyapaśāpena preritastu śaniścaraḥ ।।
saṃjñāsūryātmajo vakradṛṣṭimān duḥkhadāyakaḥ ॥44॥
tatra vyomapathā''yāto dadarśa gaṇanāyakam ।।
gopure sa yadā devyā rakṣārthaṃ sthāpitastadā ।।45॥
śaṃkareṇa saha tasya gaṇeśasyā'bhavadraṇaḥ ।।
savyalocanakoṇena sandadarśa śiśormukham ।।46॥
śanestu dṛṣṭimātreṇa cicchide mastakaṃ haraḥ ।
ityevaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra śanerdṛṣṭiḥ raveḥ śapiḥ ॥47॥
gajakuṃbhaḥ pārijātamālā lakṣmīranantakā ।
trayaṃ tvekasya bhāgye na devānāmapi durlabham ॥48॥
sarve svakarmaṇā sādhvi ! bhuṃjate vividhaṃ phalam ।।
koṭikalpairapyaluptaṃ karma kartāramīyate ।।49॥
karmaṇā brahmarudrādyā mānavāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ ।।
rājā bhṛtyāśca vaikuṇṭhavāsino'pi svakarmabhiḥ ।।1.106.50॥
vyādhiviṣayasaundaryadhanadāridryaśālinaḥ।
sudārāputrasukhavān bandhukuṭumbakaṇṭakaḥ ॥51॥
adārāputraduḥkhāḍhyā jāyante karmabhirjanāḥ।
vibhinnakarmaṇāṃ teṣāṃ mūrtiḥ śaniścaraḥ svayam ॥52॥
tattatkarmānusāreṇa vakradṛṣṭyā sa paśyati ।
śaniścaro'pi duḥkhena jīvatītyapi karmaṇā ॥53॥
śaniścarāya kanyāṃ svāṃ dadau citrarathastataḥ ।।
ṛtusnātā suveṣaṃ svaṃ vidhāya manmathā'rditā ॥54॥
śaniṃ smarati dānārthaṃ śanirnaiva smaratyapi ।
ṛtunāśād ratyalābhāt kopataḥ sā śaśāpa tam ॥55॥
na dṛṣṭā'haṃ tvayā yena na kṛtaṃ ṛturakṣaṇam ।।
tasmāt sadaiva te dṛṣṭiḥ sukhadā naiva jāyatām ॥56॥
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ bhavedvastu tatsarvaṃ vai vinaśyatu ।।
itiśāpācchanirvakradṛṣṭyā paśyati yad yadā ॥57॥
tadvai naśyati sarvaṃ drāk tattatkarmānuyogataḥ ।
śaniḥ prakṛtinamrāsyo vinā karma na paśyati ॥58॥
karmaṇā prerito vai saḥ kartāramabhipaśyati ।
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।59॥
gajāsyayojanāyāśca kāraṇaṃ gahanaṃ mahat ।
yajjñātvā sukhaduḥkhādau śubhā'śubhe na muhyati ॥1.106.60।।
aṃśenātmāntarasthasya kṛṣṇasyātmāntarakṛtāt ।।
karmaṇo naiva lepyatvaṃ bhuṃkte tvātmāntaraḥ kṛtam ॥61॥
avatārāḥ sadā sarve nirlepāḥ santi padmaje ।।
yatrātmanyavatīrṇāste sa ātmā karmabhogabhāk ॥62॥
sakhāyau sayujau dvau ca suparṇau karmadrusthitau ।।
tayoḥ karmakṛdaśnātyakarmakṛto na tatspṛśiḥ ।।63॥
tasmāt kṛṣṇasya naivāsti kaṇṭhacchedakṛtivyathā ।
sā tu tatrānyabhoktuḥ syādātmāntaraṃ hi tanmatam ॥64॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśopari śanidṛṣṭiḥ śivasya sūryaśāpaḥ indrasya śvetakarikṛtaṃ durvāsaḥpradattaprasādipuṣpamālāmardanaṃ tanmālāpuṣpasparśajanyakuṃbhamastakapāvanatāprayojya gaṇeśamastakayojanāpūjyatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥106॥


← adhyāyaḥ 106 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 107
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 108 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
gaṇeśasya śrutā nātha ! kathā citraparākramā ।
bhādre kṛṣṇe caturthyāṃ tu candrodayā''dyayāmake ॥ 1 ॥
gaṇeśastu samutpannastadā tasya vrataṃ matam ।।
sāṃgadevo niraṃgo vā pūjyaḥ kiṃ tattu me vada ॥ 2 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
patnīputravāhanaiśca sahito'rcyo gaṇeśvaraḥ ।
mātṛpitṛsamaścāpi sadā pūjyo gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 3 ।।
skando gaṇapatiścaitau mātāpitroḥ sukhau sutau ।।
tayorvivāhakāryārthaṃ śivāśaṃbhū samūcatuḥ ॥ 4 ॥
vivāhaśca kathaṃ kāryaḥ putrayorubhayoḥ śubhaḥ ।।
ṣaṇmukhaḥ senayā''ptaśca gaṇeśo me priyojjhitaḥ ।।5।।
gaṇeśasya vivāhārthaṃ yatnaḥ kāryaḥ śubho mataḥ ।
kārtikeyasya vāñcchā'sti vivāhāya punastathā ॥ 6 ॥
hārdaṃ kanyāpradānāya viśvarūpaprajāpateḥ ।।
dvābhyāṃ kanyādvayaṃ deyaṃ vartate'tastathā bhavet ॥ 7 ॥
kintu deyaṃ gaṇeśāya kanyāratnadvayaṃ varam ।
kadācittau samāhūya kathayāmāsatustadā ॥ 8 ॥
śṛṇutaṃ susutau prītyā kathayāvo yathārthakam ।।
ekaḥ sadāro jyeṣṭho'si gaṇeśo dāravarjitaḥ ॥ 9 ॥
yuvayorvai vivāhasya sukhado niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
samau dvāvapi satputrau viśeṣo nā'tra labhyate ॥1.107.10॥
tasmātpaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ śaṃdaḥ putrayorubhayorapi ।
yaścaiva pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ krāntvā pūrvamupāvrajet ॥11॥
tasyaiva prathamaṃ kāryo vivāhaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ।।
śrutvaitadvacanaṃ pitroḥ kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ ॥12॥
jagāma mandirāttūrṇaṃ śikhivāhanasaṃsthitaḥ ।।
pṛthivyāstu bahuvegāt parikramaṇahetave ॥13॥
gaṇanāthastu tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ suvicārya vai ।।
vāhanaṃ mama tu pṛthvyāṃ gatimannaiva dhāvati ॥14॥
vyomamārgeṇa gantā kva kvāhaṃ pṛthivīmārgagaḥ ।।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ svayaṃ sthūlaśarīrakaḥ ॥15॥
krośamātraṃ gate cāgre śramādgantuṃ na śakyate ।
kiṃ punaḥ pṛthivīṃ krāntvā vijayāśā viḍambyate ॥16॥
ityevaṃ suvicāryaiva gṛhaṃ snātvā praviśya ca ।।
praṇamya pitarau devo gaṇeśaḥ samuvāca tau ॥17॥
mātā pṛthvī pitā svargaṃ gaustu brahmāṇḍamucyate ।
mātā me pārvatī devī pitā me śaṃkaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥18॥
gaustayorvāhanaṃ cāsti vṛṣabho'yaṃ sudharmarāṭ ।
gaustu pṛthvīsvarūpā me mātā'pīlāsvarūpiṇī ॥19॥
pitā me śaṃkarastasya śarīraṃ vasudhā matā ।।
pūjā trayāṇāṃ kartavyā mayā yātrāsusiddhaye ॥1.107.20॥
āsane sthāpite cātra pūjārthaṃ bhavatostathā ।।
atiṣṭhataṃ gurū cātra pūrayataṃ manogatam ॥21॥
itiśrutvā vacastasya tatpūjāgrahaṇāya tau ।।
asthātāmāsane tau ca pupūja gaṇanāyakaḥ ॥22॥
pradakṣiṇaṃ tayoḥ saptavāraṃ putreṇa satkṛtam ।।
praṇāmāścāpi vihitāḥ sapta evārpitaṃ tataḥ ॥23॥
gaṇeśaḥ prāha mātarme śīghraṃ vivāhanaṃ kuru ।।
mātā prāha drutaṃ putra pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāṃ kuru ॥24॥
kumārātpūrvamāyāhi vivāhaḥ prathamo bhavet ।।
gaṇeśaḥ prāha re mātaḥ śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama ॥25॥
mayā tu pṛthivī krāntā saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।।
mātā prāha kadā putra tvayā krāntā vasundharā ॥26॥
gaṇeśaḥ prāha bhavatoḥ kṛtaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ mayā ।
tena vai sā samudrāntā mayā pradakṣiṇīkṛtā ।।27॥
mātā dharā pitā dyauśca dvayordharmasvarūpatā।
vṛṣabho vāhanaṃ dharmastasya vāmādharka tu gauḥ ॥28॥
ityuktvā vṛṣabhaṃ tātaṃ mātaraṃ ca pradakṣiṇām ।
cakre tena tadā jātaṃ pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ ॥29॥
pitarāvūcatuḥ hṛṣṭau bāḍhaṃ putra tvayā kṛtam ।
prāptaṃ tena samagrāyāḥ pṛthvyāḥ pradakṣiṇāphalam ॥1.107.30॥
śraddhayā'vāpyate dharmaḥ śraddhayā'vāpyate hariḥ ।
śraddhayā'vāpyate siddhiḥ śraddhayā'vāpyate phalam ॥31॥
mātā pitā gṛhe tīrthaṃ gaṃgā tu gṛhiṇī sadā ।
yadi śraddhā na tatrā'sti vyarthaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ॥32॥
pitrostu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā prakrāntiṃ ca karoti yaḥ ।।
tasya vai pṛthivīkrāntijanyaṃ sampadyate phalam ॥33॥
apahāya gṛhe yo vai pitarau tīrthamāvrajet ।
na tīrthaphalabhāgī syādasevādoṣabhāg bhavet ॥34॥
putrasyātra mahattīrthaṃ pitroścaraṇapaṃkajam ।
idaṃ sannihitaṃ tīrthaṃ sulabhaṃ dharmasādhanam ॥35॥
patnyāstīrthaṃ patiḥ proktaḥ putrasya pitarau tathā ।।
patyuḥ pativratā patnī tīrthāni tārakāṇi vai ॥36॥
yadi satyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭaṃ sadā pṛthvīpradakṣiṇam ।
jātaṃ prāha gaṇeśo me na cecchāstramasatyakam ॥37॥
pitṛbhaktirasatyā syāt sarvā sā niṣphalā bhavet ।
mātṛbhaktirgavāṃ bhaktiḥ sarvathā niṣphalā bhavet ॥38॥
tasmāt pradakṣiṇaṃ pṛthvyāḥ sarvathā'tra mayā kṛtam ।
śīghraṃ ca bhavitavyo me vivāhaḥ kriyatāṃ śubhaḥ ॥39॥
iti śrutvā vacastasya prasannau pitarau ca tam ।।
prāhatuḥ putra śāstrajña buddhiste śāstragāminī ॥1.107.40॥
kairapi śāstramaryādā'nyathākartuṃ na śakyate ।
upasthite tvagamye vai kārye śraddhā tu śāstrajā ।।41॥
yujyate ca tathā duḥkhe yasya buddhirviśiṣyate ।।
tasya duḥkhaṃ vinaśyettu buddhiprajñāprabhāvataḥ ॥42॥
buddhiryasya balaṃ tasya nirbuddhestu kuto balam ।
kūpe siṃho madonmatto gomāyunā nipātitaḥ ॥43॥
samyak kṛtaṃ tvayā putra pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtam ।
gomātṛpitṛkramaṇāt kṛtaṃ dharmasya pālanam ॥44॥
kārtikastu na cāyāti parādhāvati vegataḥ ।
mārge tvagre mūṣakasthaṃ yāntaṃ paśyati cānujam ॥45॥
yato gaṇeśaḥ pitrostu yadā'karotpradakṣiṇām ।
tasya puṇyasya lābhena gaṇeśasyā'nyarūpakam ॥46॥
bhūtvā dhāvati cāgre vai kārtikeyasya vegataḥ ।।
kārtikeyastu taddṛṣṭvā śuśoca paramaṃ tadā ॥47॥
aho'yamunduruḥ svalpastatra sthūlo gaṇeśakaḥ ।
kīdṛśena ca vegena tvagre prāgre pradhāvati ॥48॥
mayā mayūrabarhāṇi kaśayā vāyunā tathā ।।
pātitāni hi sarvāṇi vegārthaṃ tāḍito muhuḥ ॥49॥
mayūro'pi tathā yāvadbalenoḍḍīyate'dhunā ।।
tathāpi na gaṇeśaṃ vai saṃprāpnomi krameta kaḥ ॥1.107.50॥
ullaṃghanaṃ prāggamanaṃ svapne'pi naiva dṛśyate ।
tasmānnā'yaṃ vivāho'nyo mayā kāryaḥ śape tviti ॥51॥
iti kṛtvā parāvṛtyā'gacchad yatra gṛhaṃ svakam ।
śānto bhūtvā praviśya senayā śramamapānudat ॥52॥
gaṇeśasya vivāhārthaṃ pitarāvudyatau tadā ।।
kārtikeyasya mārgaṃ ca pratīkṣantau pratiṣṭhataḥ ॥53॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśakārtikeyavivāhe gaṇeśena pṛthivīpradakṣiṇāphalārthaṃ mātāpitṛgopradakṣiṇā kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśata
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 107 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 107 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 108
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 109 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! jaganmātā pārvatī bahuharṣitā ।
snuṣādvayaṃ bhaviṣyanme cakre tat bahumaṃgalam ॥ 1॥
etasminnantare tatra viśvarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।।
dve putryau svasya dānārhe nītvaiva vidhinoditaḥ ॥ 2 ॥
ekā varāya dātavyo gaṇeśāya guṇābdhaye ।
anyā skandāya dātavyā yadvā kanyāmataṃ matam ॥ 3 ॥
dṛṣṭvā skandaṃ vadhūyuktaṃ vavrāte na dvayaṃ tu tam ।
gaṇeśaṃ kanyake dṛṣṭvā vavrāte rūpasadguṇam ॥ 4 ॥
siddhirbuddhirubhe patnyau gaṇeśasya babhūvatuḥ ।।
mahotsavo vivāhasya tadā jāto'tiharṣakṛt ॥ 5 ॥
devagāndharvavidyādhrakinnarāguhyakādayaḥ ।
santuṣṭāśca trilokasthāstadvivāhe samāgaman ॥ 6 ॥
sahadharmaṃ caretāmityādipurohitasya vāk ।
saphalā tatra saṃjātā gaṇeśasya vivāhane ॥ 7 ॥
gaṇeśastu sadā saukhyaṃ tābhyāṃ vai prāptavān param ।
loke sāpatnaśatrutvaṃ duḥkhadaṃ khalu jāyate ॥ 8 ॥
yasya bhāgyaṃ bhaved bhagnaṃ loke'sya strīdvayaṃ bhavet ।
dvibhāryastu naraścārdhaṃ mṛto'styeva viniścayaḥ ॥ 9 ॥
na vai taṃ śatravo ghnanti dvibhāryastu mṛto yataḥ ।
ekā svapiti yāvadvai dvitīyā dveṣṭi vai krudhā ॥10॥
anyā sevāṃ karotyatra prathamā cerṣyati krudhā ।।
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe dvibhāryasya krodhāgāraṃ gṛhaṃ matam ॥11॥
ekayā putrasampattyā dvitīyāṃ tu ghṛṇāyate ।
dvitīyā dhanasampattyā prathamā vai tṛṇāyate ।। 12।।
ekayā rūpasampattyā dvitīyā notsavāyate ।
dvitīyā snehasampattyā prathamāṃ kutsitāyate ।। 13।।
śayane bhojane yāne vilāse vastradhāraṇe ।
hāve bhāve tathā māne cotsave narakaṃ dvayam ।। 14।।
tatrāpi kākajātīye śvajātīye yayā striyau ।
tadā sākṣāttu vai kuṃbhīpākākhyaṃ narakaṃ hi te ।। 15।।
yadi bhārye kuṭumbinyau suniṣekabhave tadā ।
kleśo naiva bhavet tatra svargavācyaṃ gṛhaṃ matam ।। 16।।
parasparaṃ sahāyinyau sukhaduḥkhasamakriye ।
parasparapradāyinyau naikāṃ vihāya tiṣṭhataḥ ।। 17।।
nā'nyonyā'ntarabhedinyau dyekakriyaikamānase ।
parasparopakāriṇyau samaśīlavratā'rthike ।। 18।।
apatyeṣvekabhāvinyau tathopakaraṇaikate ।
svargasukhaṃ patistatra bhuṃkte tābhyāṃ pramoditaḥ ।। 19।।
siddhirbuddhiśca tādṛśyau patnyau śaṃde babhūvatuḥ ।
kiyatā caiva kālena gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ ।।1.108.20।।
siddhergaṇeśapatnyāstu kṣemanāmā'bhavatsutaḥ ।
buddherlābhābhidhaḥ putraḥ samajāyata śobhanaḥ ।।21।।
atha śrīnāradaścāyāt skandasya gṛhamadbhutam ।
prāha vacmi matsarānna nā'satyaṃ na chalena ca ।।22।।
pitṛbhyāṃ te kṛtaṃ yādṛk tādṛk nānyaḥ kariṣyati ।
niṣkāsya tvāṃ prādakṣiṇye miṣamutpādya tadvidham ।।23।।
gaṇeśasya varo'kāri vivāhaḥ strīdvayena yat ।
palayordvayorgaṇeśo'sau lebhe putradvayaṃ śubham ।।24।।
mātāpitrormatenaiva sukhaṃ bhuṃkte nirantaram ।
bhavatā pṛthivī krāntā tayorvai chalakarmaṇā ।।25।।
yadi mātā ca vā tātaśchaladharmeṇa putrakam ।
vañcayatyanyalokasya kā vārtā chaladharmaṇi ।।26।।
asamyagvai kṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ tvatpitṛbhyāṃ hi karma tat ।
vicāryatāṃ tvayā'pīha maccitte na śubhaṃ matam ।।27।।
dadyād yadi garaṃ mātā vikrīṇīyād pitā yadi ।
rājā harati sarvasvaṃ ko'nyo rakṣākaro bhavet ।।।28।।
yenaivedaṃ kṛtaṃ karma svaputre pakṣapātajam ।
kaḥ śāntimān sudhīḥ putrastādṛktātagṛhe vaset ।।29।।
iti nītirmayā proktā yathecchasi tathā kuru ।
ityuktvā nāradastasmād yayau satyapuraṃ tataḥ ।।1.108.30 ।।
skandaḥ śokaṃ samudvegaṃ samāpanno gṛhāttataḥ ।
vinirgatya ca pitarau praṇamya krodhapūritaḥ ।।3 1।।
jagāma parvataṃ kraucaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ vārito'pi san ।
yadyevaṃ kapaṭaṃ prītinapahāya kṛtaṃ mayi ।।32।।
gaṇeśasya sulagnasya kāryaṃ sāralyataḥ kṛtam ।
ahantu ghorapanthārthaṃ gṛhānniṣkāsitastataḥ ।।33।।
mayā nā'tra gṛhe yāvajjīvaṃ sthātavyameva hi ।
mayūraṃ svaṃ samāruhya senāṃ tyaktvā piturgṛhe ।।34।।
yayau krauṃce mahāśaile nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।
paramo vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā bhajatyaniśamacyutam ।।35।।
svāmitvaṃ sa samāpannaḥ sādhutāmagrahīttataḥ ।
brahmavrate sadā tiṣṭhan vartate sādhuśīlavāt ।।36।।
kārtikasvāmināmā'sau pūjyate krauṃcaparvate ।
kārtikyāṃ tu sadā devā ṛṣayaśca satīrthakāḥ ।।37।।
darśanārthaṃ kumārasya gacchanti ca munīśvarāḥ ।
athomā duḥkhamāpannā skandasya virahe sati ।।38।।
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ dīnā tatra gaccha mayā saha ।
tatsukhārthaṃ svayaṃ śaṃbhurgataḥ svāṃśena parvate ।।39।।
mallikārjunanāmā sa śaṃbhuḥ satyā sahā'vasat ।
kārtikastadravrataṃ jñātvā virajyā'nyatra gacchati ।।1.108.40।।
tāvad devādibhistatra prārthito hyavasat khalu ।
yojanatrayamutsṛjya sthitaḥ skandaḥ suśīladhṛk ।।41।।
putrasnehāturau tau vai śivau parvaṇi parvaṇi ।
darśanārthaṃ kumārasya snehilau cāpi gacchataḥ ।।42।।
amāvāsyādine tatra svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ prayāti hi ।
pūrṇimāyāṃ svayaṃ yāti pārvatī senayā yutā ।।43।।
ityevaṃ śrīgaṇeśasya siddhirbuddhiśca vai priye ।
kṣemo lābhaśca putrau dvau saha taiḥ pūjanaṃ kriyāt ।।44।।
etadākhyānamanaghaṃ yaśasyaṃ sukhavardhanam ।
āyuṣyaṃ svargyamatulaṃ śivabhaktivivardhanam ।।45।।
kathitaṃ te mahālakṣmi! mātṛsevāvivardhanam ।
apavargapradaṃ proktaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।46।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvarūpaprajāpatinā siddhibuddhināmakakanyādvayaṃ śrīgaṇeśāya vivāhavidhinā'rpitaṃ, tataḥ kṣemo lābhaśceti putrotpattiḥ kārtikeyasya krauṃcādriṃ prati sadā gamanamityādikathananāmā'ṣṭādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 108।।


← adhyāyaḥ 108 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 109
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 110 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan devadeveśa śrāvitaṃ paramā'dbhutam ।
kathānakaṃ gaṇeśasya kārtikeyasya vai tathā ।। 1 ।।
atra me bhagavan kācijjijñāsā bhavatīti te ।
pṛcchāmi devadeveśa śrutvā śamaya tāṃ prabho ।। 2 ।।
kārtikeyastu pitarau tyaktvā'gāddūrameva yat ।
tadyogyaṃ na bhavelloke śāstre'pi saṃbhavennahi ।। 3 ।।
mātuḥ piturguroḥ sevā kāryeti mokṣadā śubhā ।
sevāṃ tyaktvā gato dūre duritaṃ tatkṛtaṃ bhavet ।। 4 ।।
duritasya tu pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ tathā kṣayaḥ ।
phalaṃ syāditi kasmāttatkārtikeye babhūva na ।। 5 ।।
mātuḥsevā muktikaro mātā bahuvidhā matā ।
stanadātrī garbhadhātrī bhakṣyadātrī gurupriyā ।। 6 ।।
abhīṣṭadevapatnī ca pituḥ patnī ca kanyakāḥ ।
sagarbhā bhaginī cāpi putrapatnī priyāprasūḥ ।। 7 ।।
māturmātā piturmātā sodarasya priyā tathā ।
mātuḥ pituśca bhaginī mātulānī tathaiva ca ।। 8 ।।
janānāṃ vedavihitā mātaraḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ ।
tā vai pūjyā namaskāryāḥ sevyāḥ stutyāḥ suputrakaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
tāsāṃ tvāśīrvaco'pyatra putraṃ rakṣati kilbiṣāt ।
tāsāṃ sevā kṛtā yena sa yāti brahma śāśvatam ।। 1.109.10 ।।
tāsāṃ tu sevayā putro bhāgyavān bhavati dhruvam ।
tāsāṃ hṛdayaduḥkhena bhāgyaṃ dahyati vai śubham ।। 11 ।।
puṇyaṃ naśyati sallakṣmīstaṃ tyaktvā'nyatra yāti ca ।
tatkathaṃ kārtikeyena tyaktā mā jagadīśvarī ।। 1 2।।
senā pativratā patnī kathaṃ tyaktā priyā nijā ।
pativratāyāstyajane narakaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ ।। 13 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi mayā sarvaṃ puraiva vihitaṃ tathā ।
mayā'jaśaṃbhupitrarṣidevāśryaṇḍaṃ vinirmitam ।। 14।।
ādye satyayuge sarve brāhmaṇā brahmatejasaḥ ।
paramātmasamā hyāsan sakalpasmṛddhayo'bhavan ।। 15 ।।
tretāyāṃ nyūnasāmarthyā hyabhavankālabhedataḥ ।
dvāpare tu viśeṣeṇa sāmarthyahīnatāṃ gatāḥ ।। 16 ।।
sāmarthyaṃ tu tapomūlaṃ tapohānau vinaśyati ।
prajāyāṃ tapaso hāsātsāmarthyahīnatā'bhavat ।। 17।।
yathā yathā ca sāmarthyaṃ hīyate tu tathā tathā ।
adharmavaṃśasāmarthyaṃ vardhate tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।। 18।।
adharmeṇa prajāstatrā'satyalobhamadānvitāḥ ।
parasparaṃ duḥkhadātryo'bhavankālasya vegataḥ ।। 19।।
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ brahmaṇā tāvannārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ ।
smṛtastatra prajārakṣopāyārthaṃ śrīharistadā ।।1.109.20।।
brahmadhāmasthitaḥ sākṣāllokarakṣaṇahetave ।
sakalpaṃ vedhaso jñātvā drāgeva cāyayau hariḥ ।।।21।।
brahmā prāha tadā devaṃ natvā stutvā punaḥ punaḥ ।
mahārāja kṛpāsindho hyadhamoddhārakāraka ।।।2।।
yugabhedātprajāḥ samyaṅ na vartante tapaḥpriyāḥ ।
tapo'bhāvānna vai puṇyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ।।23 ।।
tadabhāvācca duḥkhāḍhyā mānavā daivavarjitāḥ ।
kathaṃ mayā rakṣaṇīyāḥ prabho! bhaktā mumukṣavaḥ ।।।24।।
śuṣkeṇa sākaṃ sarasaṃ dahyatyapi nirāgasam ।
tadrakṣaṇāya bhagavan kamupāyaṃ karomi vai ।।25।।
bhaktānāṃ tapaso yogād bhajanātparameśvara ।
sarve jīvāḥ prasukhino bhavantyeva hi niścitam ।।26।।
kālayogācca bhaktā vai tapaḥsādhanavarjitāḥ ।
bhavanti cettadā jīvā rakṣyante kena karmaṇā ।।27।।
tasmātprajānāṃ saukhyārthamupāyaṃ parikalpaya ।
yugeṣu yena sarveṣu bhaktāḥ syuḥ sukhinaḥ sadā ।।28।।
iti vedhaḥkṛtāṃ jīvarakṣāgarbhitarādhanām ।
śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān paraṃbrahma svayaṃ hariḥ ।।29।।
brahmāṇaṃ prāha deveśa! mā cintā vaha padmaja ।
tava brahmāṃḍajīvānāṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ tu rakṣaṇam ।। 1.109.30 ।।
ahameva kariṣye'tra nānyastādṛgbhavedataḥ ।
mayaiva tatsamācintya yāvadbrahmāṇḍasaṃsthitiḥ ।।3 1।।
tāvattu rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ mama bhaktā yataḥ priyāḥ ।
yadyanyaṃ rakṣakaṃ tatra yojayāmi tadā tu saḥ ।। 32 ।।
kālavegena galito duḥkhaṃ pratyuta cāpnuyāt ।
tasmādahaṃ svayaṃ sākṣātparabrahma parātparaḥ ।।।33 ।।
akṣaraṃ brahma nītvaiva sākaṃ prajāvanāya vai ।
nivasāmyatra loke tachreyaḥ syājjagatāṃ param ।।34।।
dharmadevānmama janma mūrtyāṃ saṃkalpamātrataḥ ।
svīkṛtyātra bhaviṣyāmi naranārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।।।35।।
yāvajjīvaṃ brahmacārī brahmatapasi saṃsthitaḥ ।
tapasaiva prajā rakṣan kariṣye'vanamādarāt ।।36।।
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahmā'kṣaraṃ brahma naraḥ smṛtaḥ ।
ubhau brahmavratāḍhyau vai tapasi kṛtamānasau ।।37।।
vartiṣyāmaha ityetatsādhanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ param ।
brahācaryavrataṃ me'sti priyaṃ priyatamaṃ sadā ।। 38।।
tadvrataṃ sarvadā brahmaloke saṃpālayāmi vai ।
tatraiva divye badarikāśrame pālayāmi ca ।।39।।
īśvarāṇāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ sadā tapasi saṃsthitaḥ ।
atrā'pyāgatya himavacchikhare yogamāsthitaḥ ।।1.109.40 ।।
sarvendriyapratirodhātmake tapasi saṃsthitaḥ ।
tapaḥpuṇyapradānena rakṣiṣyāmi janānmama ।।41।।
cintāṃ mā kuru padmastha tapasā rakṣyate jagat ।
bhavanti vividhānyeva tapāṃsi rakṣaṇāya vai ।।।42।।
ghrāṇenā'nyanna ghrātavyamityetattapa ucyate ।
tato'pi ca tvacā cānyanna spraṣṭavyaṃ viśiṣyate ।।45 ।।
tato'pi cakṣuṣā cānyanna draṣṭavyaṃ viśiṣyate ।
tato'pyanyanna śrotavyaṃ śrotreṇeti viśiṣyate ।।44। ।
tato rasanayā cānyanna rasyaṃ vai viśiṣyate ।
tato vācā na vaktavyaṃ tapo vai śreṣṭhamucyate ।।45। ।
ūrdhvahastaścaikapādo nirāhārastapaḥsthitaḥ ।
maunādapyadhikaḥ proktastāpasaḥ kaṣṭamāsthitaḥ ।।46।।
tato'pi nirjalaḥ śreṣṭhastato'pyakalpitakriyaḥ ।
śreṣṭhastato'pi sarvasmānniṣkāmaścordhvavīryavān ।।47।।
ūrdhvaretā brahmacārī ratyabhāvādviśiṣyate ।
sarvendriyebhyo liṃgasya nirodho balavattapaḥ ।।48।।
rasanāyā nirodhaśca manonirodha ityapi ।
dhātornirodhastvagrodho rodhāścatvāra īritāḥ ।।49।।
brahmacarye nirodhāste catvāraḥ saṃbhavanti vai ।
tasmātkaṣṭataro rodho nā'nyo'sti balavān khalu ।।1.109.50 ।।
yena brahmavrataṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ saṃpālitaṃ tu saḥ ।
mūrtimān vai parabrahma harirnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ।।51 ।।
brahmacaryavratasthasyā'nyatkartavyaṃ na śiṣyate ।
kāntākanakasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ।।52।।
tāsu teṣu virakto yo dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
brahmacaryabalāt so'tra tārayatyakhilaṃ jagat ।।53।।
ahamanne nivasāmi śuddhasattvamayaḥ prabhuḥ ।
jāṭhare'haṃ nivasāmi parātṛptipradaḥ prabhuḥ ।।94।।
dhātuṣvahaṃ nivasāmi rajovīryātmakaḥ prabhuḥ ।
tasyā'vanaṃ kṛtaṃ yena mama tenā'vanaṃ kṛtam ।।55।।
kāmabhogasya saṃkalpaḥ kartavyo naiva sarvathā ।
kāmabhogāya vārtāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kāryameva na ।।5 6 ।।
kāmabhogasya vacanaṃ noccāryaṃ sarvathā yataḥ ।
kāmabhogasya saṃsparśo vidheyo naiva sarvathā ।।5 7।।
kāmabhogakṛte kāmidarśanaṃ kāryameva na ।
kāmabhogakṛte guptasaṃketaḥ kārya eva na ।।5 8 ।।
kāmabhogā'dhyavasāyo naiva kāryaḥ kathaṃcana ।
rajovīryaprapātaśca naiva kāryaḥ kadācana ।।59।।
ityevaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vai sarveṣāṃ duṣkaraṃ matam ।
mithunībhūtajīvānāṃ duṣkaraṃ cā'tapasvinām ।।1.109.60 ।।
tādṛśaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tu naranārāyaṇamṛte ।
nā'nyatrā'stīti tadrūpaṃ dhṛtvā dhāsye paraṃ tapaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
tadvratena prajāṃ sarvāṃ rakṣiṣyāmi tanuṃ mama ।
pāpāduddhārayiṣye tāṃ sukhayiṣye samantataḥ ।।62।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne svaprajārakṣaṇāya brahmacaryatapaḥkaraṇāya nārāyaṇena brahmaṇe naranārāyaṇāvatārāvaśyakatetikathitamiti-
pradarśananāmā navādhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ ।। 109 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 109 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 110
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 111 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ityevaṃ tu mayā lakṣmi! pratijñātaṃ tu vedhase ।
tataścāhaṃ tataḥsthānād drāgevā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।। 1 ।।
mamākṣare pare dhāmni brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ ।
varte yadvatsarvathaiva varte badrīvane tathā ।। 2 ।।
divyaṃ cā'kṣaradhāmnastu prāntabhāge tadāśrame ।
tathaiva ca prasaṃkalpya dharmadeve praviṣṭavān ।। 3 ।।
akṣarabrahmaṇā sākaṃ dharmānmūrtau praviṣṭavān ।
mūrtyā mama jananyā ca tadā saṃkalpamātrataḥ । । 4 ।।
bālau pravirbhāvitau tau naranārāyaṇātmakau ।
jātamātro ṣoḍaśābdau surūpau kāmamohanau ।। 5 ।।
supuṣṭahṛṣṭasarvāṃgau mālā pustikarābjakau ।
koṭikoṭyarkasaṃkāśau projjvalau parameśvarau ।। 6 ।।
sūkṣmasvarṇatantutulyajaṭāśobhitamastakau ।
kaupīnācchādanau vṛkṣaśālākanthākamaṇḍalū ।। 7 ।।
sopavītau brahmacaryavratapūrṇau tapasvinau ।
anyatra puruṣe nārībhāgau tu bhavato yathā ।। 8 ।।
pūruṣasya vāmabhāgo nyūnaśaktyāśrayo bhavet ।
mayi nārāyaṇe vāme nyūnaśaktirna vai manāk ।। 9 ।।
vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ sarvāḥ samānā eva śaktayaḥ ।
nyūnaśaktyātmako nārībhāgo mayi na vidyate ।। 1.110.1 0।।
vidyete vakṣasi cihne stanayostu mamaiva te ।
stanacihnasya virahe mūrtau me nyūnatā bhavet ।। 11 ।।
sarvāṃgapūrṇatā na syāt tataścihne tu rakṣite ।
nare'tha mama rūpe vai vidyete na stanau yataḥ ।। 1 2।
tasminnare mayā nārībhāvaleśasya hīnatā ।
darśitā na tu sāmarthyanyūnādhikyamubhāṃ'gayoḥ ।। 1 3।।।
nistanastu naro bodhyaḥ sastano'haṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।
mayā lakṣmīḥ sadā rakṣyā stano vai rakṣitau tataḥ ।। 14।।
nararūpe tu lakṣmyāste susattve na prayojanam ।
brahmacaryasvarūpe me patnyā nāsti prayojanam ।। 15।।
ityato nararūpaṃ me brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ matam ।
tādṛgrūpau samutpannāvājānubhujapaṃkajau ।। 16 ।।
dṛṣṭvā tu pitarau samyakprasannau ca pracakratuḥ ।
saṃskārau jātasaṃśuddhathai samājñaptau tapaḥkṛte ।। 17।।
tadā hyāvāṃ naranārāyaṇau tau ca vavandatuḥ ।
sevārthaṃ na tapo'rtha vai sevā pitrostu durlabhā ।। 18।।
sevāyāṃ tu sadā samyagvartanīyaṃ suputrakaiḥ ।
loke sṛṣṭau sadā mātā putraṃ garbhe surakṣati ।। 1 9।।
tannimittaṃ sadā kaṣṭaṃ sahate jananī mahat ।
prasave cāpi kaṣṭaṃ ca pālane kaṣṭamityapi ।। 1.110.20।।
rātryahaṃ cānusandhānaṃ kṣālanaṃ malamūtrayoḥ ।
prāṇavad rakṣaṇaṃ śaśvatstanyapānena poṣaṇam ।।21।।।
aṃke kaṭyāṃ ca vahanaṃ svamabhuktvā prapoṣaṇam ।
lālanaṃ raṃjanaṃ sevā mātrā tu kriyate sadā ।। 22।।
tasyā jananyā ājanma āmṛti sevayā'pi vai ।
na putro nirṛṇo vai syādasevakasya kiṃ bhavet ।।23 ।।
sevāhīnasya putrasya mātṝṇaṃ na nivartate ।
tasmātsevā prakartavyā cetyāvābhyāṃ prarocate ।।24।।
mātṛsevāvihīnastu putro na putra ucyate ।
sa tvaputra iti prokto mātṛbhārakaro hi saḥ ।।25 ।।
tasmātsevāṃ kariṣyāvo hyubhau pitrostu sarvadā ।
asevakasya putrasya narake niyatā gatiḥ ।। 26 ।।
kālapāśena baddhaḥ syātpretaścāpi bhavettathā ।
ṛṇadānāya vividhāṃ yoniṃ gacchecca yātanām ।।27।।
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet ।
saṛṇasya gatirnāsti na svargaṃ nā'punarbhavaḥ ।।28।।।
pitṝṇaṃ putramutpādya devarṇaṃ yāgakarmaṇā ।
ṛṣyṛṇa vidyayā'pohya manastapasi yojayet ।।29।।
tasmātsevāṃ kariṣyāvo'nyathā'dhogatimāpnuvaḥ ।
vṛddhau tu pitarau putraiḥ pālanīyau samantataḥ ।।1.110.3 0।।
anujāḥ pālanīyāśca rakṣyāḥ svasāra ityapi ।
vivāhanīyāḥ satataṃ dattvā sāhāyyamarthajam ।। 3 1।।
kuṭumbapoṣaṇaṃ kāryamudyamaśca dhanārjane ।
sukhaduḥkhe same cohye sambandhibhirgṛhasthitaiḥ ।।32।।
pitrorāsvargavāsaṃ vai sevanīyau tu tau matau ।
putro yuvā bhaviṣyanvai rakṣiṣyati ca nau tadā ।।33।।
sukhinau vai bhaviṣyāva iti pitroḥ prakalpanam ।
bhaṃktvā yāyādvane putrau na putraḥ sa tu rākṣasaḥ ।।34।।
vane phalaṃ na vai tasya bhavetpratyuta pātakam ।
pitrorāśīrvacoyuktān puṇyasaṃghānna yo'rjayet ।।।35।।।
sa svargaṃ vā'tha sāmrājye sthito'pi nārakī mataḥ ।
tasmāttu yuvayoḥ sevāṃ kariṣyāvastu sarvathā ।।।26।।
mātṛsevā kṛtā yena tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ।
dānaṃ yajñastapo homo vedādhyayanameva ca ।।37।।
devatāḥ pūjitāstena dhyānaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ।
tapastaptaṃ ca vividhaṃ brahmavidyā'pi cārjitā ।।38।।
sāmrājyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena svargaṃ hastagataṃ kṛtam ।
pāramaiṣṭhyapadaṃ labdhaṃ yena mātā prasevitā ।।39।।
pitarastarpitāstena ṛṣayaḥ pūjitāstathā ।
atithayo'rcitāstena yena mātā susevitā ।।1.110.40 ।।
gamitāni ca tīrthāni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni vai ।
vihitānīṣṭapūrtāni yena mātā prasevitā ।।41।।
nāsti sevāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ sāṃkhyayogādicarvaṇe ।
nāsti mātṛsamā devī nāpi pitṛsamo hariḥ ।।42।।
mriyamāṇo'pi bālo vai pitṛbhyāṃ ca nirīkṣitaḥ ।
tathāpi svargamāpnuyāt kastau devau parityajet ।।43।।
indraḥ sūryaḥ śaśī viṣṇurgaṇeśaḥ śaṃkaro'bjajaḥ ।
varuṇo'gnistathā cānye devāstu janake sthitāḥ ।। 44।।
janakasya sutaḥ samyaksevayā labhate'nvaham ।
devapūjāphalātkoṭiguṇaṃ satphalamakṣayam ।।45।।
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī sandhyā sāvitrī ca satī tathā ।
gāyatrī rohiṇī saṃjñā vāruṇī vaiṣṇavī tathā ।।46।।
sarvāśca pūjitāstena yena mātā susevitā ।
tāsāṃ pūjākṛtapuṇyāt koṭipuṇyaṃ prasūsthitam ।।47।।
sarvāstā jananīmūrtau tiṣṭhantyeva na vai pṛthak ।
tasmānmātuśca sevāṃ vai pituścāpi prasevanam ।।48।।
kariṣyāvo'tra pitrostu pādayorvāsamāsthitau ।
pitroḥ sevāmahimānaṃ vijānantau narācyutau ।।49।।
mahāpāpābhibhūtasya pitṛsevāratasya tu ।
putrasya nayane dūtā yamasya prabhavo na vai ।।1.110.50।।
mṛtikāle yadi pitrornetrābhyāṃ netramelanam ।
kriyate tu suputreṇa tadāpi sadgatirbhavet ।।51 ।।
mṛtyukāle suputreṇa mukhe vṛndādalaṃ jalam ।
dīyate'pi ca tanmātrāt pitrostu sugatirbhavet ।।।52।।
yasya gehe bhavetputraḥ pratuṣyanti pitāmahāḥ ।
putrahīnaṃ kuṭumbantu śapantyeva pitāmahāḥ ।।।53।।
vaṃśe śrāddhaprakartāramadṛṣṭvā prapitāmahāḥ ।
muñcantyuṣṇapraṇiḥśvāsān bhāvinīraśanārditāḥ ।।54।।
svasāraścāpi niḥśvāsān muñcantyabhrātrya ityataḥ ।
nā'smabhyaḥ kaṃcukīdātā bhrātā'pi vidyate iti ।।55।।
lokā vadantyanapatyānanaṃ dṛśyaṃ na maṃgalam ।
kanyāṃ vadanti nabhrātrīṃ nirvaṃśyo'yaṃ jano vadet ।।56।।
putraśūnyaṃ gṛhaṃ saudho vimānaṃ ca śmaśānavat ।
putraśūnyāḥ khānapānābharaṇādivibhūtayaḥ ।।57।।
kṛṣṇāhiviṣavadbodhyā nānandāya bhavanti tāḥ ।
devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarpā nāgāścāṇḍajajātayaḥ ।।58।।
sarve'pīcchanti satputrān janmā'putraṃ nirarthakam ।
tasmādbhāvyaṃ suputreṇa susevakena sarvathā ।।।59।।
ato hyāvāṃ kariṣyāvaḥ sevāṃ pitrostu sarvadā ।
tatraḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ bhāvyaṃ sevā muktipradāyinī ।।1.110.60 ।।
iti pitrormahimānamuktvā naranarāyaṇau ।
tūṣṇīṃ babhūvatustatra sevādharmaratau yadā ।।61।।
pitṛbhaktimayau mātṛsevākṛtaviniścayau ।
tutuṣaturmūrtidharmau śubhāśīrvādayojinau ।।।62।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ janmottaraṃ pitroḥ sevādharmapraśaṃsananāmā daśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 110 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 110 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 111
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 112 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato dharmadevaḥ sevāviniścayau ।
putrau prāha paraṃ dharmaॆ paro yasmānna vidyate ।। 1 ।।
sarvadharmasamāveśo yatra dharme pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
taṃ dharmaॆ prathamaṃ dhāmni hariṇā saṃpradarśitam ।। 2 ।।
sarvaśreyaskaraṃ dharmamṛṇā'bādhyaṃ pramokṣadam ।
śrutaṃ nārāyaṇamukhānmuktidaṃ sādhanottaram ।। 3 ।।
dharmaḥ prāha śṛṇutaṃ vai putrau paramaśobhanau ।
dharmavantau pitṛbhaktau yaduktaṃ tatsuśobhate ।। 4 ।।
lakṣaṇaṃ tatsuputrasya mātāpitroḥ susevanam ।
tattato'pyadhikaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇutaṃ hariṇoditam ।। 5 ।।
brahmacaryasamo dharmo nāsti nāstyeva naiva hi ।
anye sarve tu dharmāṇaḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 6 ।।
brahmacaryaṃ brahmadharmo brahma vai sa svayaṃ matam ।
brahmarūpaṃ brahmamūrtirbrahmātmā brahmarūpadaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tuṣṭe brahmaṇi sarveśe sarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ sadā bhavet ।
sevā ṛṇāni dānāni tadagre svalpamātrakam ।। 8 ।।
yajñaprāpyaṃ tu yatproktaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
tasmād yajño brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā ।। 9 ।।
iṣṭāpūrtena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
tasmādiṣṭaṃ brahmacarye sampratiṣṭhati sarvadā ।। 1.111.10 ।।
yadidaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ brahmacaryamiti smṛtam ।
paraṃ tatsarvadharmebhyastena mokṣaḥ pralabhyate ।। 11 ।।
brahmacarye sthito dharmo brahmacarye sthitaṃ tapaḥ ।
brahmacarye sthitā ye te brahmadhāmni sthitā matāḥ ।। 1 2।।
yogena jāyate siddhiḥ siddhyā kīrtiḥ pravartate ।
kīrtiḥ siddhiśca tapasā tapo brahmaṇi caryayā ।। 13।।
indriyanigraho'sādhyo brahmacaryeṇa sādhyate ।
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā brahmaloko hyavāpyate ।। 14।।
brahmacaryapravṛttasya brahmaloko'pi kāmadaḥ ।
kiṃ punardevalokādyā brahmādhānaṃ hi tattataḥ ।। 15।।
sattrāyaṇena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
sattrāyaṇaṃ brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā ।। 16।।
maunavratena labhyaṃ yadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
maunaṃ tato brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā ।। 17।।
anāśakāyanenā''pyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
anāśakāyanaṃ brahmacarye tiṣṭhati sarvathā ।। 18।।
araṇyayanasaṃprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate।
araṇyāyanamapyatra brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 19 ।।
tyāgāyanena saṃprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
dṛṣṭānuśravike tyāgo brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 1.111.20। ।
ahiṃsayā ca yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
ahiṃsā sārvabhaumā sā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 21 ।।
satyavratena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
satyaṃ tasmād brahmacarye trividhaṃ pratitiṣṭhati ।। 22।।
asteyena ca yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
asteyaṃ sarvathā dvedhā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 23 ।।
aparigrahalabhyaṃ yadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
aparigraha evāpi brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 24।।
śaucena prāpyate yadvai brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
śaucaṃ dvedhā brahmayogād brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 25।।
santoṣāllabhyate yattadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
santoṣaḥ sarvathā''tmīyo brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 26।।
tapaścaryā vividhā yā brahmacaryeṇa pūryate ।
tatastapomahākāṇḍo brahmacarye samāpyate ।। 27।।
svādhyāyena ca yallabhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
svādhyāyaḥ sarvatovyāpto brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 28 ।।
īśvarasya praṇidhānaṃ brahmacarye pravartate ।
tata īśapraṇidhānaṃ brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 29।।
gorakṣādīnyāsanāni brahmacarye phalanti vai ।
tasmādāsanakūṭastu brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 1.111.30 ।।
prāṇāyāmena yallabhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
prāṇāyāmaścaturdhā'to brahmacarye vyavasthitaḥ ।। 31 ।।
pratyāhārastvindriyāṇāṃ sati brahmavrate phalet ।
tasmādindriyarodho vai brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 32।।
dhyānena yadbhavellabhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
dhyānaṃ pratyayaikatānaṃ brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 33 ।।
dhāraṇā yatra kartavyā brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
tasmāttu dhāraṇā sarvā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।। 34।।
samādhiryatra kartavyo brahmacaryeṇa siddhyati ।
tasmāddvedhā caturdhā sa brahmacarye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।। 35।।
damaśāntititikṣehoparamādibhirāpyate ।
yacca tadvai brahmacaryāllabhyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।। 3 6।।
vivekācca vibho kāccā'bhyāsātsatkriyayā tathā ।
kalyāṇāccā'navasādādanuddharṣācca yadbhavet ।। 37।।
tatsarvaṃ tu brahmacaryāllabhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
jñānāddharmācca vijñānādbhaktyā vividhayā tathā ।।38।।
tattvajñānānmṛṣāprajñālopāccāpi tu yadbhavet ।
tatsarvaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।39।।
śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ paraṃbrahmādhigacchati ।
śabdabrahmātra vistārād brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।।1.111.40 ।।
brahmavimarśasadbindunādadhvānagiro'pi ca ।
pravartante brahmaṇastadbrahmacaryaphalaṃ matam ।।41।।
aṇimā mahimā prāptirgarimā laghimā tathā ।
prākāmyamīśitā sarvavaśitā'pi ca siddhayaḥ ।।42।।
tārasutāratārātāraramyakasalilakāḥ ।
pramodamuditamodamānāścāpi ca siddhayaḥ ।।43 ।।
ūhaḥ śabdo'dhyayanaṃ ca duḥkhaghātāstrayastathā ।
suhṛtprāptirjñānasiddhiścāpyaṣṭau siddhayaśca yāḥ ।।44।।
dūraśravaṇadarśanādānagamanā'dṛśyatāḥ ।
siddhayaśca tathā sarvā labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ।।45।।
netyā dhotyā ca bastyā ca kuṃjarakriyayā tathā ।
yadāpyate tvāpyate tadbrahmacaryeṇa sarvathā ।।46 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇāt śrāddhād yadāpyate tadāpyate ।
brahmacaryeṇa śrāddhādi brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।।47।।
putrotpattyā vidyayā'gnihotreṇā''rādhyate tu yat। ।
tatsamārādhyate brahmacaryeṇaiveti nirṛṇam ।।48।।
śrutyā smṛtyā ca yallābhastalābho brahmacaryataḥ ।
pratīkopāsanālabhya yanmataṃ dhāma tatkhalu ।।49 ।।
brahmacaryeṇa samprāpyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
mātṛpitṛkuṭumbānāṃ lokānāṃ sevayā ca yat ।।1.111.50 ।।
labhyate tadbrahmacaryāllabhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
goviprāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ mahatāṃ tathā ।।5 1 ।।
sādhūnāṃ sevayā labhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।
pativratāyā lokāste labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ।।।52।।।
karmaṭhānāṃ śarmavatāṃ dharmiṣṭhānāṃ ca yā gatiḥ ।
tato'pyuccatarā sā vai brahmacaryeṇa labhyate ।।।53।।
puṇyātmanāṃ dānināṃ ca yā gatirjāyate śubhā ।
tato'pyuccatarā prāptirbrahmacaryavato bhavet ।।54।।
yakṣarakṣobhūtavaināyakakūṣmāṇḍamātaraḥ ।
piśācapretavetālāstrasyanti brahmacaryataḥ ।।55।।
ḍākinīśākinīśūlāyoginītālikāstathā ।
vidravanti brahmacāribalānnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ।।56।।
mānuṣā bhūtayaḥ sarvā devānāṃ smṛddhayastathā ।
labhyante brahmacaryadvai brahmacarye pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।।57।।
aindraṃ ca vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ kauberaṃ saumameva vā ।
sauryaṃ ca gāṇapatyaṃ ca bhaumaṃ svargyaṃ ca paitṛkam ।।58।।
vairājamaiśvaraṃ vārṣaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ ca vā ।
labhyate brahmacaryeṇa brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati ।।59।।
āgneyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ ca hiraṇmayam ।
prākṛtaṃ pauruṣaṃ mauktaṃ labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ।।1.111.60।।
avyākṛtaṃ ca golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā ।
kṣairaṃ śvaitaṃ bādrikaṃ ca labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ।।6 1 ।।
brahmacaryaprabhāveṇa jīvo'pi yāti śaṃbhutām ।
yo'yamātmā hatapāpmā viśoko mṛtyuvarjitaḥ ।।62।।
akṣudhaścātṛṣaścāpyajaraḥ satyamanorathaḥ ।
satyaphalo bhavatyeva brahmacaryapratāpataḥ ।।63।।
parabrahmasamo bhūtvā sarvatadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ।
samaśnute sarvakāmān brahmacaryapratāpataḥ ।।64।।
āprakṛṃtipūruṣaṃ yad dāsa''yogasthamaṇḍalam ।
kiṃkaraṃ caraṇe bhūtvā patati brahmacāriṇaḥ ।।65।।
apraskhalitadhātostu brahyacaryavataḥ sadā ।
tadūrdhvaretaso devā dāsā bhavanti kiṃkarāḥ ।।66।।
brahmacārikṛte lokā vartante śāśvatāḥ sadā ।
pragacchedyena mārgeṇa brahmacārī janastadā ।।67।।
vighnāḥ kṛtyā grahā daityāḥ śūlāścā'maṃgalāni ca ।
prayāntyapaśakunāni dūrādbrahmapratāpataḥ ।।68।।
yatra mārge brahmacārī pragacchati pratāpavān ।
samīpe svāgatārthaṃ taṃ samāyānti surādayaḥ ।।69।।
lokapālā diśāmpālāḥ prajeśā manavaśca tam ।
abhiyānti brahmacaryapratāpaṃ brahmacāriṇam ।।1.111.70 ।।
samvatsarāśca ṛtavo māsāśca divasā niśāḥ ।
abhiyānti svāgatārthaṃ brahmacaryapratāpinam ।।91।।।
viśvedevā marutaśca vidyādhrāḥ kinnarādayaḥ ।
devyaścābhiprayāntyenaṃ brahmacaryapratāpinam ।।72।।
agnayo dakṣiṇāhomāvasathagṛhiṇo janāḥ ।
abhiyānti brahmacaryabalinaṃ brahmacāriṇam ।।73।।
sādhyāḥ kiṃpuruṣāścaiva gandharvāścāraṇādayaḥ ।
brāhmaṇāścā'pyabhiyānti brahmacārijanaṃ mudā ।।74।।
naranārīmithunāni brahmāṇḍe santi koṭiśaḥ ।
tāni pavitratāṃ yānti brahmacāripadāśrayāt ।।75।।
brahmacārī svayaṃ brahma brahmacaryabalena vai ।
pṛthvījalāditattvāni parāvartayituṃ kṣamaḥ ।।76।।
brahmacārī svayaॆ svasya prāṇasya rakṣaṇe tathā ।
visarjane samartho vai na kālastatra vai prabhuḥ ।।77।।
mahākālo yāti dūraॆ yamo yamānugāstu ke ।
vālakhilyāḥ sanakādyā siddhā yogeśvarāstathā ।।78।।
haryaśvāḥ śabalāśvāśca sādhavaḥ sādhvikāstathā ।
brahmacaryapratāpena brahmabhāvamito gatāḥ ।।79।।
hanumānkārtikeyaśca vartete brahmacāriṇau ।
bhagavatyo mahābhāgāḥ sarasvatyādikāstathā ।।।1.111.80।।।
brahmacāriṇya evaitā brahmabhāvamito gatāḥ ।
tasmātputrau brahmacarye tiṣṭhantau kurutaṃ tapaḥ ।।8 1।।
brahmacaryapratāpena ṛṇaṃ sarvaṃ nivartate ।
brahmacaryasamaṃ nānyattapo bhavati duṣkaram ।।82।।
brahmacāriśarīre vai brahma sākṣāddhi vartate ।
brahmacāripūjanena parabrahma prapūjitam ।।।83।।
brahmacāribhojanena parabrahma subhojitam ।
brahmacāridarśanena parabrahmapradarśanam ।।84।।
brahmacārisparśanena parabrahmaspṛśirmatā ।
brahmacārinamaskāre parabrahmanamaskṛtiḥ ।।।85।।।
brahmacāriparicaryā brahmaśuśrūṣaṇaṃ matam ।
brahmacārijalapāne brahmaṇā pīyate jalam ।।86।।
brahmacāripārśvavāse brahmaṇyāvāsa ucyate ।
brahmacāripranetrābhyāṃ brahmaiva saṃprapaśyati ।।87।।
brahmacārināsikayā brahmajighrāti vai mudā ।
brahmacārijihvayā vai brahma vaktyeva sarvathā ।।88।।
brahmacārirasanayā brahmaivāsvādayatyapi ।
brahmacāryānanadvārā bhuṃkte brahmaparaṃ sadā ।।।85।।
brahmacārikarapādā brahmaṇaḥ karapatkajāḥ ।
brahmacārimanovṛttyā manute brahma sarvathā ।।1.111.90।।
brahmacārikṛtabhogaṃ brahmabhogyaṃ tu tanmatam ।
brahmacārikṛtāvāso brahmavāso mataḥ sadā ।।91।।
ūrdhvaretā naiṣṭhikaścopakurvāṇo hariḥ svayam ।
mātā'pi pūjitā tena pitā saṃsevitastathā ।।92।।
brahmacaryavrataṃ yena rakṣitaṃ brahmarūpiṇā ।
brahmacārikṛtaṃ sarvaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtameva tat ।।93।।
tasmād brahmaparo dharmo brahmacaryānna śiṣyate ।
avatārā harerye vai brahmacāriṇa eva te ।।94।।
brahmacāriṇa āmuktiḥ sadā karatale sthitā ।
atiṣṭhataṃ brahmacaryaṃ putro naranarāyaṇau ।। 95।।
ityājñā pitṛbhyāṃ dattā gṛhītvā tau naro hariḥ ।
natvābhivandyaśaityādriṃ taptuṃ tu duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।। 96 ।।
jagmatustatra badryādiśobhite śikhare sadā ।
badryadhastāttapo lokasukhārthaṃ kuruto hi tau ।। 97। ।
tathā'yaṃ kārtikeyo'pi tapatyeva dṛḍhaṃ tapaḥ ।
brahmacārivrato bhūtvā viṣṇuṃ bhajati nityaśaḥ ।। 98 ।।
nāstyato yogyatā tatrā'parādhasyāpi leśataḥ ।
brahmacaryatulāyāṃ tvasevā'kiṃcitkarī matā । । 99 ।।
asevā vai na sā bodhyā sevā tapaḥsvarūpiṇī ।
brahmacaryatapoyogāduddhārayati yatsvakau ।। 1.111.100 ।।
mātāpitarau sā sevā nā'nyatulyā'lpikā matā ।
yatkṛtena sadā mātuḥ pituḥ prasannatā bhavet ।। 101 ।।
tatkṛtaṃ sarvadā sevā nā'nyā sevā viśiṣyate ।
kārtikena kṛtā sevā brahmavratatapomayī ।। 102।।
iṣṭaṃ tapastu pārvatyāstathā śaṃbhorapi dhruvam ।
loke yogyaṃ ca śāstre'pi tapaḥ kāryamiti prathā ।। 103 ।।
brahmavrataṃ tapo lakṣmi! mokṣadaṃ duritaṃ na tat ।
mātā śivā prasannā''sīt pitā śaṃbhuḥ prasādavān ।। 1 04।।
senāpatitvamāpyaiva tārakāsuranāśanam ।
kṛtaṃ pitrorvacana tat tvājñāsevātmakaṃ param ।। 105 ।।
mayaiva vihitā ceyaṃ skandasthitiranuttamā ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।। 106 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmacaryamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakakārtikeyā'duritatādipradarśananāmā ekādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 111 ।।

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nārāyaṇa harekṛṣṇa prāṇanātha mahāprabho ।
bhavatoktaṃ mahādevo vaiṣṇavāgryo'sti sarvathā ।। 1 ।।
kathaṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ proktastatkathāṃ śrotumutsahe ।
kva kadā vaiṣṇavo jātaḥ śrāvayā'dya mama priya! ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu devi! kathāṃ divyāṃ mahāvaiṣṇavakāriṇīm ।
mokṣadāṃ viṣṇusambaddhāṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।। 3 ।।
santi pṛthvyāṃ parvatāśca devādivāsadāyinaḥ ।
teṣāṃ priyatamaḥ śaityaprado mokṣapradastathā ।। 4 ।।
himālayaḥ sadā śāntastatra badarikāśramam ।
puruṣau tatra vartete naranārāyaṇāvubhau ।। 5 ।।
tatraikaḥ śvetapuruṣaścānyaḥ kṛṣṇastu rūpataḥ ।
anujaḥ piṃgalaḥ proktaḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 6 ।।
dvibāhuśca caturbāhurnaro nārāyaṇaḥ kramāt ।
tatra devā vasantīha ṛṣīṇāṃ cāśramāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 7 ।।
gaṃgā yatrā'lakanandā divyā vahati sarvadā ।
ekasminvatsare tatra maheśastaptavāँstapaḥ ।। 8 ।।
tadā nārāyaṇo devo bhaktanāmabhayaṃkaraḥ ।
suprasanno'bravīcchaṃbhuṃ varaṃ varaya śaṃkara ।। 9 ।।
yaṃ yamipsasi deva tvaṃ taṃ taṃ kāmaṃ dadāmyaham ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā nārāyaṇaṃ tu karuṇākaram ।। 1.112.10 ।।
ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi bho deva yadi dātuṃ tvamicchasi ।
dvau varau mama dīyetāṃ suprasanno janārdana! ।। 1 1।।
tava bhaktiḥ sadaivā'stu bhaktarājo bhavāmyaham ।
sarvaloke prasiddhaḥ syāṃ śivo bhakto mahāniti ।। 12।।
viṣṇubhakta itikhyātirlokeṣu bhuvaneṣvapi ।
jāyatāṃ sarvadā viṣṇu! nārāyaṇa! jagatprabho! ।। 13 ।।
atha ye māṃ bhajiṣyanti grahīṣyantyāśrayaṃ mama ।
tasya tava prasādena muktidātā bhavāmyaham ।। 14।।
yasyāhaṃ varadātā syāṃ tasya muktirbhaved dhruvā ।
viṣṇubhakto muktidātā syāṃ me dehi varadvayam ।। 15।।
iti śrutvā svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prāha śaṃbhuṃ guṇākaram ।
bhava śaṃbho mama bhakto dātā mukteśca saṃbhava ।। 16।।
evaṃ varau tadā labdhvā śaṃkaraḥ prāha taṃ harim ।
dehi dīkṣāṃ ca me nātha vaiṣṇavaśca bhavāmyaham ।। 17।।
nā'vaiṣṇavo bhavedbhakto muktido nā'pyavaiṣṇavaḥ ।
bhuktirmuktiśca te yogādvaiṣṇavatve sati dhruvā ।। 18।।
vaiṣṇavena tato bhāvyaṃ dehi dīkṣāṃ kṛpāṃ kuru ।
viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devaḥ śrutvā prāha tu śaṃkaram ।। 1 9।।
sādhu saṃkalpitaṃ śaṃbho sarvalokahitārthi yat ।
gṛhāṇa śaṃbho prathamaṃ mantraratnaṃ śubhāvaham ।।1.112.20 ।।
'brahmāhaṃ brahmabhaktosmi japasvainaṃ nirantaram ।
mantraratnamidaṃ nāma prapāti śaraṇāgatam ।।21 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ sarvaphalapradaḥ ।
śrīmannārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ।।22।।
svāminārāyaṇaśceti mantro mokṣapradaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
naranārāyaṇaśceti mantro brahmagatipradaḥ ।।23।।
harinārāyaṇaśceti mantro duḥkhavināśakaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśceti mantro vibhūtidāyakaḥ ।।24।।
mantro vāsudevanārāyaṇastvaiśvaryadāyakaḥ ।
rāmanārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ pāpavināśakaḥ ।।25।।
oṃ śrīnārāyaṇo mantro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ ।
mantraḥ prapattidastveṣaḥ-'śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।।26।।।
ityevaṃ mantradaśakaṃ deyaṃ bhaktebhya uttamam ।
oṃ namo bhagavata vāsudevāyeti mantrarāṭ ।।27।।
mantrarājaṃ mantraratnaṃ daśamantrāँśca śaṃkara! ।
etān dvādaśamantrāँstvaṃ dehi śiṣyajanāya vai ।।28।।
mantroccāraṇamātreṇa cātituṣṭo'smi nityadā ।
mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve ye me bhaktā mumukṣavaḥ ।।29।।
jñānino yoginaścānye jaḍā nāryastathā''śritāḥ ।
bhaktiśraddhānvitāḥ sarve mānavā hyadhikāriṇaḥ ।।।1.112.30 ।।
brahmāṇḍe ye'tra tiṣṭhanti surādyāścādhikāriṇaḥ ।
tebhyo'nyatamamantro vai dātavyaḥ śreyase bhavet ।।3 1।।
śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ gṛhāṇa bhujayostathā ।
taptamudrāṃkanaṃ caitaccandanāṃkanameva vā ।।32।।
gṛhāṇa śaṃbho bāhvostadviṣṇurūpatvadāyakam ।
pañcaviṃśatyakṣarāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ ca gṛhāṇa vai ।। 33 ।।
oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ।
tanno brahma pracodayāditi japyā'nvahaṃ tvayā ।।24।।।
dhyāyasva māṃ surūpaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ vā caturbhujam ।
dvibhujaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ brahmadhāmani saṃsthitam ।।35।।
sarvāvatārasaṃdhartṛ parabrahmātmakaṃ śubham ।
cakrahastaṃ tathā'bhayapradahastaṃ dvihastakam ।।।36।।
hārakuṇḍalamālākaṭakamukuṭabhūṣaṇam ।
pītāmbaraṃ ṣoḍaśābdaṃ prasannaṃ parameśvaram ।।37।।
caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakarānvitam ।
vāmāṃkasthaśriyā sārdhaṃ rūpaṃ dhyāyasva hṛdgamam ।।38।।
atha māṃ ṣoḍaśadivyopacāraiḥ pūjayasya ca ।
āvāhanaṃ svāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ tataḥ param ।।39।।
ācamanaṃ tathā snānaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathā'mbaram ।
candanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam ।।1.112.40।।
yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dehi me bhaktibhāvataḥ ।
sugandhyarkaṃ karpūraṃ ca sugandhaṃ dehi me'nagham ।।41 ।।
kuru pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca namaskriyāḥ kuru ।
stutiṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dehi kṣamāṃ yācasva mat tathā ।।42।।
visarjaya bahiṣṭo māṃ sve hṛdi sthāpayā''tmani ।
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ caiva smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam ।।43।।
arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam ।
dhyānaṃ samādhiraikyaṃ ca kuru bhajasva sādhanaiḥ ।। 44।।
ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ ca tilakaṃ lalāṭe kuru śaṃkara ।
bāhvośca hṛdaye cāpyūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tilakaṃ kuru ।।45।।
candanena sugandhena satkesarayutena ca ।
tanmadhye candrakaṃ tena kuṃkumenā'thavā kuru ।।46।।
kaṇṭhe gṛhāṇa tulasīgraiveyaṃ dvisaraṃ śubham ।
kaṇṭhī sā tu sadā dhāryā na tu tyājyā kadācana ।।47।।
tulasīmālikāṃ cāṣṭottaraśatārthapūritām ।
gṛhāṇa japakāryāya maṇyādinirmitāṃ ca vā ।।48 ।।
īśvarāntaṃ ca te nāma prakaromi maheśvaram ।
pālakena ramayā ca kṛtastvaṃ 'parameśvaraḥ' ।।49।।
pareṇa ca mayā lakṣmyā kṛtastvaṃ 'parameśvaraḥ' ।
paṃ viṣṇuṃ raṃ ramāṃ maśca mimīte bhajate tu yaḥ ।।1.112.50 ।।
aiśvaryāśraya ityuktastvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ 'parameśvaraḥ' ।
īśvarāntāni nāmāni tava śaṃbho bhavantu vai ।।51 ।।
evaṃ lakṣmi! mayā dīkṣā dattā śrīśaṃkarāya vai ।
tadārabhya sadā śaṃbhurbhajate māmananyabhāg ।।52।।
dīkṣāmādāya śaṃbhu sa gato vai gandhamādane ।
svīyāvāse tu kailāse bhajate māmaharniśam ।।53।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ kandaṃ toyaṃ grāhyaṃ ca yadbhavet ।
tatsarvaṃ māmanivedya naiva gṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ ।।54।।
karoti tilakaṃ sthāne māṃ ca japati mālayā ।
tiṣṭhati dhyānamagno'sau mama mūrtāvanīhayā ।।55।।
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ bhaktiṃ śaṃkaraṃ prāha pārvatī ।
kasya dhyānaṃ ca mālābhirjapaśca tilakādikam ।।56 ।।
kriyate lokanāthena parameśvararūpiṇā ।
bhavāneva parabrahma parātparataraḥ svayam ।।57।।
ityevaṃ pūrṇarūpasya kasya dhyānaṃ japaśca vai ।
iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ pārvatīṃ prāha tāttvikam ।।58।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne badarikāśrame nārāyaṇena śaṃkarāya vaiṣṇavīdīkṣāpradānaṃ tadaṃgakalāpādipradarśana ceti nirūpaṇanāmā
dvādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 12।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
pārvatyā vacanaṃ śrutvā vaiṣṇavaśca maheśvaraḥ ।

saṃpravaktuṃ samārebhe tajjijñāsānivṛttaye । । 1 । ।
śṛṇu sati! pravakṣyāmi viṣṇuṃ bhaje'hamaṃjasā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ parabrahma pareśvaraḥ । । 2 । ।
bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyo japanīyaśca sarvadā ।
mayā dīkṣā tadīyā vai grahītā badarīvane । । 3 । ।
taṃ vai pareśvaraṃ nityaṃ dhyāye bhajāmi bhāvataḥ ।
pārvatī prāha deveśa! vistarāt tadyathātatham । । 4 । ।
māmapi śrāvaya sarvaṃ yadi grāhyaṃ mayā bhavet ।
yenā'hamapi govindamāśritya śreya āpnuyām । । 5 ।।
kathaṃ nā'dyāpi me nātha! kathitaṃ nahi tatkvacit ।
etāvatkālaparyantaṃ śrīharerbhajanaṃ vinā । । 6 ।।
divasāḥ sarvathā vyarthā gamitā me hariṃ vinā ।
yadyahaṃ te devadeva! satpātra sammatāsmi vai । । 7 । ।
tadā māmapi bhaktāṃ śrīhareḥ saṃdīkṣaya prabho ।
gururbahmā gururviṣṇurgurudevo janārdanaḥ ।। 8 ।।
guruḥ svasyāḥ patiḥ proktaḥ patyau sarvaṃ samāsthitam ।
patyuḥ sevā parā sevā patyurbhaktiḥ parā matā ।। 9 । ।
patidharmaḥ paro dharmastaṃ dharmaṃ dehi śaṃkara ।
patistu vaiṣṇavo yasyāḥ patnī yadi na vaiṣṇavī । । 1.113.10 ।।
avaiṣṇavyā kṛtā sevā bhaktiḥ sarvāpi niṣphalā ।
avaiṣṇavyā kṛtaṃ bhojyamaśuddhaṃ pāvanaṃ nahi ।। 11 । ।
avaiṣṇavyāḥ karajalaṃ hyapeyaṃ pāvanaṃ nahi ।
avaiṣṇavyā gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ śmaśānamiti gīyate ।। 1 bhe ।।
avaiṣṇavyā gṛhāllakṣmīrniḥsarati sarvathā ।
tasmādahaṃ svāmidharmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvanaṃ param । । 13 । ।
saṃgrahītuṃ samicchāmi vistarādbrūhi tattvataḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ pārvatīgāthāṃ prāha śaṃbhurmaheśvarīm । । 14 ।।
nādyāpi pātratā te'bhūt tasmānna kathitaṃ mayā ।
bahūnāṃ janmanāṃ puṇyaiḥ pātratā prāpyate khalu ।। 12 । ।
etajjanmani pātratvaṃ puṣṭiṃ yāti kathāśravāt ।
satāṃ tu sevayā cātmā divo bhavati nityaśaḥ । । 16 । ।
pātivratyena patyuśca sevayā''tmā balaṃ vrajet ।
balavānbhāgyavānsādhusevako yo bhavejjanaḥ । । 17 । ।
tasyaiva nirmalā vṛttirbhavatyāntarabāhyajā ।
nairmalyaṃ tu bhavedbījaṃ śraddhāyāḥ sarvathā priye ।। 18 । ।
tato bhavati jijñāsā tayā cā'pyadhikāritā ।
tathā sati guroryoge sarvaṃ phalati yatkṛtam ।। 1 9।।
tavedānīṃ tu tatsarvaṃ samutpannaṃ ca yojitam ।
hyupasthitaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ tasmāt tvaṃ pātramuttamam ।। 1.113.20 ।।
jātā'syadya mahādevi! prasannaśca bhavāmyaham ।
aho mama priyā patnī vaiṣṇavīṃ sthitimicchasi ।। 2 1 । ।
asmāt kinnu mahadbhāgyaṃ paraṃ mama kṛte bhavet ।
atyatīva prasanno'smi śrutvā te hṛdayaṃ priye । । 22।।
sarvaṃ te 'haṃ pradāsye vai yatastvaṃ vaiṣṇavī bhava ।
devi! cādyāpi paryantaṃ bhojyaṃ peyaṃ yadarpitam ।। 2 3 ।।
viṣṇave tatsamarpayya paścād bhuktaṃ mayā hi tat ।
kiṃ vacmi devadeveśi! hyadyā''nandamayo mahān ।। 24।।
sūryodayaḥ suvarṇasya mama jāto'sti sarvathā ।
patisevāphalaṃ sarvaṃ sakhi! te bhavatu priye! ।।25।।।
gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ mama bhūyādvaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgyavānaham ।
adya devi! dehaśuddhyai kārtike śuklapakṣake ।। 26 ।।
daśamyāṃ tu nirāhāramupavāsaṃ kuru priye! ।
dehaśuddhyarthamevātra paṃcagavyaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।। 27।।
maṇḍapaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjākṛte racaya śobhanam ।
kadalīstaṃbhasannaddhamaśokadalatoraṇam ।। 28 ।।
saptadhānyakṛtaṃ tatra sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।
racaya tvaṃ mahābhāge tatra sthāpaya sadghaṭam ।। 29 ।।
aṣṭadikṣu ghaṭānpārśve sthāpayā'ṣṭau navāँstataḥ ।
kaṇṭhe veṣṭaya vastrāṇi mukhe paṃcārdrapallavān ।। 1.113.3 0 ।।
nārīkelaphalānyaṣṭa kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca tatra vai ।
madhye ghaṭe svarṇapātre pratiṣṭhāpaya bhāvataḥ । । 31 ।।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ tataḥ ।
lakṣmyāśca pūjanaṃ nārāyaṇena saha kārayā ।। 32।।
nivedaya varāṇyeva hyupacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāḥ prātaḥ snānaṃ tathā kuru ।। 33 ।।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pratipūjaya ।
tatra samāgataṃ dīkṣāvidhijñātārameva ca ।। 34।।
ācāryaṃ māṃ śraya pūrvaṃ haryāśrayaṇasiddhaye ।
ācinoti ca śāstrārthānācāre sthāpayatyapi ।। 25।।
svayaṃ tvācarate yasmāt brahmādhyāpayati dhruvam ।
mantraṃ jānāti viṣṇośca bhaktiṃ karoti sarvathā । । 36।।
śrīmannārāyaṇasampradāyavidyāṃ tu vetti yaḥ ।
tārayati svakaṃ śiṣyamācāryaḥ sa mato guruḥ ।। 37।।
tadvākyeṣu suviśvāsaḥ śiṣyo bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।
gṛhṇīyānmantraratnaṃ tadekādaśyāṃ tu kārtike ।।38।।
gṛhāṇa devi! dīkṣāṃgaṃ śaṃkhacakrasumudraṇam ।
paṃcāmṛtaiḥ prasaṃsnāpya śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ prapūjya ca ।।39।।
agniṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinā juhayājyaṃ vidhānataḥ ।
ghṛtapāyasayorhomamaṣṭottaraśataṃ kuru ।।1.113.40 ।।
śaṃkhacakre pratapte ca kuru hyagnau tato guruḥ ।
ahaṃ śaṃbhurgurustvāṃ vai cakreṇa jalajena ca ।।41।।
aṃkayāmi dvayorbāhvoḥ punaḥ prapūjya taddvayam ।
kalaśasthajalenā'trā'bhiṣekaṃ kuru mastake ।।।42।।
nūtanāṃ śāṭikāṃ dhṛtvā jalenācamanaṃ kuru ।
lalāṭe tilakaṃ cordhvapuṃḍraṃ sacandrakaṃ kuru ।।43।।
candanena kuṃkumena tato mantraṃ gṛhāṇa me ।
'brahmāhaṃ brahmabhaktā'smi' trivāraṃ tad gṛhāṇa me ।।44।।
tato māṃ prapūjayā'dritanaye! māṃ namaskuru ।
gṛhāṇa tulasīkaṇṭhīṃ kaṇṭhe dhāraya cādrije ।।45।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśceti mantraṃ gṛhāṇa cādrije! ।
maheśvarīti te nāma parameśvarī cetyapi ।।46।।
bodhyaṃ tataḥ kuru dhyānaṃ śrīhariṃ dvibhujaṃ tathā ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ divyaṃ dhyāne gṛhāṇa sarvadā ।।47।।
parasmād brahmaṇo nārāyaṇād devo'sti no paraḥ ।
tasyaiva cāparo mantraḥ 'śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ mama' ।।48।।
gṛhāṇainaṃ śive'dya tvaṃ jātā pūjyā suvaiṣṇavī ।
kuru bhaktiṃ harernityaṃ gurorme sevanaṃ kuru ।।49।।
śiṣyapraśiṣyaśākhāśca mantradānena vardhaya ।
lakṣmyāvāsastvayi prāpto mayi nārāyaṇasya ca ।।1.113.50।।
āvāṃ bhaktiṃ kariṣyāvo nārāyaṇasya sarvadā ।
sevāṃ tasya kariṣyāvo yena muktirdhruvā bhavet ।।51।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kailāse śaṃbhunā pārvatyai śrīvaiṣṇavīdīkṣādattetyaṃgabhūtakāṇḍanirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśā'dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 11 3।।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato devyā vaiṣṇavyā prārthitaṃ punaḥ ।
śaṃbhoragre kathayāmi śravaṇārhaṃ paraṃ yataḥ ।। 1 ।।
pārvatyuvāca deveśa mahādeva sureśvara।
viṣṇubhaktiṃ mamā''cakṣva muktidāṃ vistarātpunaḥ ।। 2
nārāyaṇasvarūpāṇi mantrapūjāvidhīṃstathā ।
tadvibhūtiguṇādīṃśca taddhāmagatisādhanam ।। 3
dhāmnastasya svarūpaṃ ca cihnamāhātmyamityapi ।
vistareṇa mayi prītyā brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ ।। 4 ।
iti pṛṣṭo mahādevyā śaṃbhuvaiṣṇavasattamaḥ ।
uvāca paramapremṇā natvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।। 5 ।
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi! sarvajīvahitaiṣiṇi! ।
bhaktavarye! śīlarūpaguṇopete! maheśvari! ।। 6 ।
parituṣṭo'smi te praśnād dhanyā'si vaiṣṇavi! priye! ।
kṛtapuṇyā'si bhaktā'si prabhornārāyaṇasya ca ।। 7 ।
vakṣyāmyahaṃ ca te devi! bhagavadbhaktimuttamām ।
nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ ca mantrapūjāvidhiṃ tathā ।। 8 ।
parabrahma paramātmā parameśvara eva saḥ ।
sarveśvaro mahāmukteśvaro'kṣaraparaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 9 ।।
paramaḥ puruṣaḥ puruṣottamaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।
bhagavānakṣarātīto vāsudevo'cyutaḥ paraḥ ।। 1.114.1 0।।
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo deveśvaro viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ।
īśeśvaro mahāmāyeśvaraḥ sākṣī sadāśivaḥ ।। 1 1।।
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ śrīmān śrīyajño nārāyaṇo naraḥ ।
lakṣmīpatiḥ svāmyanantaścātmārāmo guṇātigaḥ ।। 1 2।।
sarvanetrasarvavijñaḥ sarvahṛtstho ya niyāmakaḥ ।
guṇākaro divyamūrtiḥ śyāmalo hṛdayaṃgamaḥ ।। 01 3।।
nityaṃ bhakteṣu vasati rakṣatyapi svakān janān ।
śeṣavedopavedādyaiḥ sabṛhaspatidevataiḥ ।। 14।।
māhātmyaṃ tasya devasya vaktuṃ naiva hi pāryate ।
tasya bhaktikalāpaṃ te vacmi śṛṇu pṛthakpriye ।। 15।।
mūrtirhareḥ sadā dhyeyā svātmanyeva muhurmuhuḥ ।
tasya cakrasya śaṃkhasya hyaṃkana prathamaṃ matam ।। 16।।
dhāraṇaṃ cordhvapuṃḍrāṇā tanmantrāṇāṃ parigrahaḥ ।
arcanaṃ tajjapo dhyānaṃ tannāmasmaraṇaṃ muhuḥ ।। 17।
kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ tasya vandanaṃ caraṇārhaṇam ।
caraṇāmṛtapānaṃ ca tanniveditabhojanam ।। 18।।
tadīyānāṃ satāṃ sevā dvādaśyekādaśīvratam ।
tulasīropaṇaṃ caiva bhaktiḥ ṣoḍaśadhā hi sā ।। 19।
atha śrīmandire tasya mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā ।
kṣālanaṃ dhūpanaṃ caivāndolanaṃ dīpanaṃ tathā ।।1.114.20
-2 vījanaṃ mardanaṃ raṃgaraṃjanaṃ cāṃjanaṃ tathā ।
sugandhanaṃ tathā vastupradāpanamanuvratam ।।21।।
hāsanaṃ vārtanaṃ caiva svāpaṇaṃ ṣoḍaśā'parāḥ ।
bhaktibhedā bhavantyeva kriyārūpā hareḥ kṛte ।।।22।।
etaiḥ sevāprabhedaiśca bhababandho vinaśyati ।
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ devīnāṃ ca mamāpi ca ।।23।।।
sādhūnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
pūjanīyo harirnityaṃ vidhivatpūjayeddhi tam ।।।2।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmāṃkanaṃ vai bāhumūlayoḥ ।
dhārayitvaiva vidhivad brahmapūjāṃ samācaret ।।।25।।
pāpāni kṣālayitvā sa yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।
cakrāṃkanavihīnena kṛtā pūjā nirarthikā ।। 26।।
viṣṇucakravihīnena bhuktaṃ śrāddhe nirarthakam ।
nirāśāḥ pitaro yānti tadā dṛṣṭvā tvavaiṣṇavam ।।।27।।
deyaṃ gobhūhiraṇyādi cakrāṃkitabhujāya vai ।
cakrahīnāya yaddattaṃ tadgṛhṇantyasurā balāt ।।।28।।
taptacakrāṃkitaṃ bāhumūlā yānti hareḥ padam ।
cakracihnitabhakteṣu tīrthayajñā vasanti vai ।। 29।।
cakracihnavihīnastu brāhmaṇaḥ prākṛtau mataḥ ।
na tasya kiṃcidaśnīyādapi kratusahasriṇaḥ ।।।1.114.30।।
cakraṃ nārāyaṇasyaiva saṃsāracakranāśakam ।
taptaṃ vā cāndanaṃ cakra dhāryaṃ karmaprasiddhaye ।।।3 1।।
śrautasmārtādisiddhyarthaṃ mantrasiddhyarthameva ca ।
harerarcanasiddhyarthaṃ vaiṣṇavattvasya siddhaye ।।।32।।
jñānasya siddhaye caiva cakraṃ dhāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
acakradhāriṇaṃ vipraṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ।।।33।।
vāhane taṃ samāropya bahiḥ kuryātsvapattanāt ।
śvapākamiva nekṣeta loke vipramavaiṣṇavam ।।।34।।
dakṣiṇe tu bhuje vipro bibhṛyācca sudarśanam ।
vāme śaṃkhaṃ tu bibhṛyāditi bodhyaṃ pareśvari! ।।35।।
govindasyā''yudhānyaṃge bibhran suśroṇi! vai dvijaḥ ।
turīyaṃ dhāma tadviṣṇormahiṣṭhaḥ prāpnuyāditi ।।36।।
camūṣacchyenaḥ śakuno bibhṛtveti ṛgabravīt ।
brāhmaṇe tu śatapathe taptaṃ cakraṃ dvihastayoḥ ।।।37।।
dhāryamagnihotrameva bhavati brahmamuktidam ।
taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryaṃ viṣṇulokagatirbhavet ।।38।।
sudarśanaṃ tu sandhāryamityūrdhvapuṃḍramityapi ।
dvirekhaṃ bhavati veda brahmasāyujyameti saḥ ।।39।।
taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryaṃ brahmasāyujyamicchatā ।
taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryaṃ tatpuruṣapareṇa hi ।।1.114.40।।
devāsaḥ pitarau yena vidhūtena ca bāhunā ।
sudarśanena prayatātsvargaṃ lokaṃ yadaṃkitaḥ ।।41।।
manavo lokasṛṣṭiṃ vai vitanvanti tadaṃkitāḥ ।
taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhāryamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ samālikhet ।।42।
dvirekhaṃ bhavati tena punarāgamanaṃ nahi ।
viṣṇudaivataptaṃ taccakraṃ dhāryaṃ bhujadvaye ।।।43 ।।
taptaṃ cakraṃ bhuje dhṛtvā devā gacchanti keśavam ।
brāhmaṇā dhārayantyūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ dvirekhamīśadam ।।44।।
nicakṣepa suṣaṇaṃ bhidyamānaṃ madhye bāhumadadhat sudarśanaṃ ca ।
viṣṇoridaṃ bhūridaṃ bhūritejo divānaktaṃ bibhṛyustajjanāsaḥ ।।45 ।।
pavitramityagnirnemiḥ sahasrārastanneminā ।
taptatanūrbrāhmaṇo vai brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt ।।46।।
cakraṃ bibharti vapuṣābhitaptaṃ balaṃ devānāmamitasya viṣṇoḥ ।
sa eti nākaṃ duritāni vidhūya prayānti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ।।47।।
ebhirvayamuruvikramasya cihnai-
raṃkitā loke nu subhagā bhavāmaḥ ।
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padamakṣarākhyaṃ
ye gacchanti lāṃchitāstaiḥ parasmin ।।48।।
pra te viṣṇo hyabjacakre pavitre
janmāṃbhodhiṃ tartave carṣaṇīndrāḥ ।
mūle bāhvordadhate'nye purāṇā
liṃgānyaṃge tāvakānyarpitāni ।।49 ।।
dhṛtordhvapuṃḍraḥ kṛtacakradhārī
viṣṇuṃ paraṃ dhyāyati yo mahātmā ।
svareṇa mantreṇa sadā hṛdisthitaṃ
parātparaṃ yanmahato mahāntam ।।1.114.5 0।।
ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ tathā cakraṃ nityaṃ dhārayate janaḥ ।
tena tasyā'śubhaṃ naśyecchubhamasya vivardhate ।।5 1।।
upavītādibaddhāryāḥ śaṃkhacakragadādayaḥ ।
mahāpastu prarakṣanti viṣṇuriva tadāyudhāḥ ।।5 2।।
sudarśanena yasyāṃgaṃ lāṃchitaṃ tu bhavetsadā ।
dehe tasya vasennityaṃ śriyā yuktaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।।।53।।
cakrāyudhāṃkitaṃ dṛṣṭvā yamo'pi hṛdi śaṃkate ।
praṇāmaṃ dūrataḥ kṛtvā viṣṇubhaktaṃ prayāti vai ।।54।।
paśuputrādikaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhopakaraṇāni ca ।
aṃkayecchaṃkhacakrābhyāṃ nāma kuryācca vaiṣṇavam।।55।।
aṃkayecchaṃkhacakrābhyāṃ nāma kuryācca vaiṣṇavam ।।55 ।।
patnī patiśca kuryātāṃ saṃskārapaṃcakaṃ yadā ।
sadharmiṇau bhavetāṃ tu tadā bhaktau na cānyathā ।।56।।
vaiṣṇavā munayaḥ sarve sudarśanena mudritāḥ ।
teṣāṃ pādodakaṃ pītvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ।।57।।
dhṛtordhvapuṃḍraḥ parameśitāraṃ
nārāyaṇaṃ sāṃkhyayogādhigamyam ।
dhyātvā vimucyeta naraḥ samastaiḥ
saṃsārapāśairiha caiti viṣṇum ।।58।।
dhṛtordhvapuṃḍro dhṛtacakralāṃchano
nārāyaṇaṃ pūjayati sma lakṣmīm ।
arghyādibhiḥ pauruṣasūktamantraiḥ
sa prāpnuyādviṣṇupadaṃ mahātmā ।।।59।।
tatpriyārthaṃ śubhārthaṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ muktilabdhaye ।
sadbhakto dhārayennityamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ bhayāpaham ।।1.114.60।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakhaḍgaśārgāṃdicihnitaḥ ।
tulasīcandanairliptaḥ kuryātsandhyāmupāsanām ।।6 1 ।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sandhyā svādhyāyakarma ca ।
yaśaḥ pitṛkriyordhvapuṃḍraṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ matam ।।62।।
ataptatanurna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa vai ।
idvahantastatsamāśata vṛttadīrghe karādhikṛṇmahe ।।63।।
asya viṣṇostaptatanavaḥ tareyuḥ pātakāṃbudhim ।
pavitraṃ caraṇaṃ nemihareścakraṃ sudarśanam ।।64।।
dīrghaṃ samūrdhvatilakaṃ kṛtvā yānti paraṃ padam ।
tena taptā tanuryeṣāṃ te yānti paramākṣaram ।।65।।
sahasrāraṃ prākṛtaghnaṃ brahmadvāraṃ mahaujasam ।
pavitramarcivadagne brahma tena punīhi naḥ ।।66।।
yena devāḥ pavitreṇa hyātmānaṃ punate sadā ।
tena sahasradhāreṇa pavamānyaḥ punantu mām ।।67।।
prājāpatyaṃ pavitraṃ tacchatodyāmaṃ hiraṇmayam ।
vayaṃ brahmavidastena pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe ।।68।।
sanemicakraṃ satataṃ cākṣarasya mahātmanaḥ ।
tasmiँścakravṛte dehe mahonnatipadaṃ laset ।।69।।
divaspateḥ suvitataṃ pavitraṃ yasya dakṣiṇe ।
na tapyate bhuje samyaktasya śocanti vai kriyāḥ ।।1.114.70।।
ye vahanti bhuje cakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca vidhinā janāḥ ।
parānapi vilomasthāṃste rakṣanti hareḥ priyāḥ ।।71 ।।
dvividhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ proktaṃ bāhyamābhyantaraṃ tathā ।
śaṃkhacakrādibhirbāhyamāntaraṃ harirakṣaṇam ।।72।।
aṃge cakrādihetīnāmaṃkanaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ purā ।
bhaktyā hṛdi sadā śrīmannārāyaṇasusevanam ।।73।।
tadetaddvayayuktatve vaiṣṇavatvaṃ bhuvaṃ bhavet ।
ityevaṃ cakramāhātmyaṃ vaidikārthapuṣaṃ bahu ।।74।।
tasmāddhāryaṃ mahādevi! pārvatī! tatsudarśanam ।
yena rakṣā tathā muktirubhayaṃ jāyate dhruvam ।।75।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ṣoḍaśavidhabhaktitaptacakrapuṃḍrādimahimavarṇananāmā
caturdaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 14।।
