śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tato devīṃ pārvatīṃ svapriyāṃ priye! ।
śruṇu śaityādrisatputri! mahimānaṃ tathā'param ।। 1 ।।
ūrdhvapuṃḍrasya saṃvakṣye dhāraṇānmuktiriṣyate ।
ūrdhvaṃ brahmaparaṃ lokaṃ puṃse dadyād vimuktaye ।। 2 ।।
rakṣayecca jagadbandhāttadūrdhvaṃ puṃḍramīritam ।
madhye tu candrakaṃ lakṣmī puṃḍre devo janārdanaḥ ।। 3 ।।
dvayorvāso lalāṭāgre yasya so'kṣayamokṣabhāk ।
tasyaiva darśanātprātarjvalanti tvaghaparvatāḥ ।। 4 ।।
yasya dehe cordhvapuṃḍraṃ sa nārāyaṇamandiram ।
ūrdhvapuṃḍralalāṭasya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet ।। '9 ।।
sarvayajñaphalaṃ cāpi ceṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ bhavet ।
sarvadānaphalaṃ cātha sarvayogaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 6 ।।
ūrdhvapuṃḍralalāṭaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate ।
namaskṛtya vimānastho yāti brahmapadaṃ param ।। 7 ।।
śrāddhe cordhvapuṃḍradharaṃ bhojayiṣyati yo janaḥ ।
ākalpakoṭi pitarastṛptā hṛṣṭā bhavanti vai ।। 8 ।।
sordhvapuṃḍradharādevakṛtaśrāddhe gayāphalam ।
yajñadānajapātithyasatkriyāhomatāpanam ।। 9 ।।
sordhvapuṃḍrabhaktakṛtaṃ tasya puṇyamanantakam ।
ūrdhvapuṃḍravihīnena kṛtaṃ yajñādikaṃ vṛthā ।। 1.115.1 0।।
anūrdhvapuṃḍrako dehaḥ śmaśānasadṛśo bhavet ।
anūrdhvapuṃḍrakasyātra puṇyaṃ sandhyāhijāpanam ।। 11 ।।
haranti rākṣasāstadvai svayaṃ doṣeṇa lipyate ।
anūrdhvapuṃḍrako yāyānnaijapāpādyamakṣayam ।। 12।।
sakesarasugandhāḍhyacandanenā'thavā mṛdā ।
pāṇḍurayā piśaṃgyā vā kuṃkumenā'thavā kriyāt ।। 13।।
lalāṭabhūṣaṇaṃ tadvai caturdhā bodhyameva ha ।
ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ ca puṃḍraṃ ca paṭṭapuṇḍraṃ tripuṇḍrakam ।। 14।।
ūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ dvirekhaṃ syādekarekhaṃ tu puṇḍrakam ।
paṭṭasthūlaṃ paṭṭapuṃḍraṃ suptatryaṃkaṃ tripuṇḍrakam ।। 19।।
devādipūjane daivakārye dvirekhamādṛtam ।
rājyābhiṣekaprabhṛtau tilakaṃ dīpavatsmṛtam ।। 16 ।।
aśūnyakalalāṭārthaṃ paṭṭākāramaharniśam ।
śṛṃgārahāsaliṃgādipūjane tu tripuṃḍrakam ।। 17।।
cāndanaṃ cordhvapuṃḍraṃ vai kauṃkumaṃ tilakaṃ matam ।
śvetamṛdā tu paṭṭākhyaṃ bhasmanā tu tripuṃḍrakam ।। 18 ।।
viṣṇubhaktairmānavairvai kāryamūrdhvaṃ tu puṇḍrakam ।
ekāntino mahābhāgavatāstu sāttvatāḥ sadāḥ ।। 19 ।।
kurvanti sāntarālaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ haripadākṛti ।
madhye sacandrakaṃ tadvai śrīharermandiraṃ smṛtam ।। 1.115.20 ।।
ṛju saumyaṃ suśalākaṃ manohāri suśobhanam ।
tanurekhaṃ kesaraṃ tadūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ sacandrakam ।। 11 ।।
naranārībhirādhāryaṃ darśane maṃgalāvaham ।
sāntarāle cordhvapuṃḍre madhyakuṃkumacandrake ।। 22।।
madhye lakṣmyā saṃyuktaḥ śrīharistatra virājate ।
nirantarālātta tataḥ saśrīharirnivartate ।। 23 ।।
nirantarālaṃ niḥśrīkaṃ sāntarālaṃ śriyā'nvitam ।
mṛdaṃ rpigataḍāgasya vaikuṇṭhākhyahradasya ca ।। 24।।
śvetāṃ piśaṅgīṃ vā''dāya kuryādūrdhvaṃ tu puṇḍrakam ।
tīrthaprāsādikīṃ bhūmiṃ mṛdāmādāya śodhayet ।। 25।।
tulasīmūlabhūmermṛdūrdhvapuṃḍre praśasyate ।
śrīkṛṣṇelābhuvaścāpi gaṃgāyamīpratīrayoḥ ।। 26।।
gomatītīrabhūmestūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ tīrthapuṇyadam ।
yajñāgnihotrayorbhasma harikṣetrādimṛttikā ।। 27।।
kuṃkumaṃvāpikāmṛdvai pāvanī hariṇīsamā ।
bilvapippalatulasīvaṭāmalakyudambarāḥ ।। 28।।
devavṛkṣāstadadhobhūḥ pavitrā tilakārhaṇā ।
nagāgrasthā saritsaṃsthā jalāntaḥsthā ca sindhujā ।। 29।।
valmīkasthā mandirasthā kṣetrasthā bhūmigarbhagā ।
devasnānajalaiḥ siktā'raṇyasthā vṛṣṭivāhitā ।। 1.115.3 0 ।।
mṛttikā sarvatīrthānāṃ dhāmnāṃ purīvanādijā ।
haryavatārodbhavabhūrbhagavadvāsayoginī ।। 31 ।।
pāvanī ca tayā kāryamūrdhvapuṃḍraṃ sumokṣadam ।
kṛṣṇaṃ nu śāntidaṃ raktaṃ vaśyakṛnmokṣadaṃ sitam ।। 32 ।।
pītaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ proktaṃ dhūsaraṃ śrīvināśakam ।
vicchinnaṃ vā bahusthūlaṃ vakraṃ tiryagadarśanam ।।।33 ।।
tathā'samāntarālaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ vā viṣamāntaram ।
hrasvadīrghādirekhaṃ ca sthūlasūkṣmādirekhakam ।।34।।।
prāntalagnāntaravyāsaṃ vicchinnamūlakaṃ tathā ।
ardhaṃ tryardhaṃ lambamānaṃ śuṣkaṃ nisteja ātatam ।।35।।
kudṛśyaṃ vartulaṃ cordhvapuṃḍraṃ hānikaraṃ smṛtam।
nāsāmūlaṃ samārabhya bhruvoḥ saṃlagnake tu vai ।।36।।
dve rekhe'ṅgulavistāre ākeśaprāntake gate ।
nāsāmūle nimnabhāge dvitīyācandravadyuje ।।37।।
sampadyetordhvapuṃḍraṃ tad brahmadhāmapradāyakam ।
lalāṭe tu parabrahma lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi ।।38।।
dakṣe bāhau vāsudevaṃ vāme naranarāyaṇau ।
smṛtvā viṣṇujaladrāvairdravyaiḥ kāryāṇi sarvadā ।।39।।
nārāyaṇaṃ samudare govindaṃ kaṇṭhakarkaṭe ।
viṣṇuṃ vai dakṣiṇe pārśve vāmanaṃ vāmapārśvake ।।1.115.40 ।।
trivikramaṃ kaṃdhare tu smṛtvā dāmodaraṃ trike ।
pṛṣṭhe smṛtvā padmanābhaṃ vāsudevaṃ tu mūrdhani ।।41 ।।
evaṃ dvādaśapuṃḍrāṇi mahābhāgavataścaret ।
lalāṭe bhujayugme ca trike kaṇṭhe ca pṛṣṭhake ।।42।।
caturaṃgulakaṃ mānaṃ pārśvayostu daśāṃgulam ।
kaṃdhare mūrdhnyudare vakṣasyaṣṭāṃgulaṃ kriyāt ।।43।।
sabījaṃ sāntarālaṃ tu śriyāḥ kuṃkumacandrayuk ।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu catvāri lalāṭe bhujayorhṛdi ।।44।।
viśāṃ bhāle hṛdye dve bhālaikaṃ śūdrayoṣitoḥ ।
girije! tava bhaktānāmaśvatthadalasadṛśam ।।45।।
mama śaṃbhostu bhaktānāṃ padmakuḍmalasadṛśam ।
gaṇeśādiprabhaktānāṃ veṇupatrādisadṛśam ।।46।।
harerbhāgavatānāṃ tad ūrdhvaṃ haripadākṛti ।
kiraṇākāramūrdhvaṃ tu puṇḍraṃ mokṣakaraṃ sadā ।।47।।
madhye haridrākuṃkumabindurlakṣmīnivāsabhūḥ ।
bhālamadhye rekhayoraspṛṣṭo ghaṭṭasamastaraḥ ।।48।।
hāridraḥ kauṃkumo binduścandravacchrīpradaḥ sadā ।
bindūrdhvapuṇḍrakau bodhyau lakṣmīnārāyaṇau sadā ।।49।।
bhāle hṛdi tathā bāhvoryasya tasya jayaḥ sadā ।
tacchūnyasya pare cātrā'nupadaṃ tu parājayaḥ ।।1.115.50 ।।
iti te kathito gauri । hyūrdhvapuṃḍrādinirṇayaḥ ।
nārāyaṇena mahyaṃ yaḥ kathitaḥ sarvathā śubhaḥ ।।51।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ devīdevatapasvinām ।
bhaktā ye svairiṇo bhāvyā maniṣyante tu narmavat ।।52।।
te tu nārīsamānāsyāḥ kabarīkeśaveṣiṇaḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti pumāṃso'pi nārīśrāṃgārikakriyāḥ ।।।53।।
nārīvadvastradhartāro nārībhāvasvadarśakāḥ ।
nāryo narādiveṣasthā nararūpasvadarśikāḥ ।।54।।
svasvadharmādihīnāḥ syuḥ svasvamokṣasya ghātakāḥ ।
acihnāste vicihnā vai yāsyanti narakānmuhuḥ ।।55।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ūrdhvapuṃḍrādimāhātmyanirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 115।।


← adhyāyaḥ 115 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 116
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 117 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataḥ śaṃbhurmantramāhātmyamuttamam ।
pārvatīṃ prāha sarvārthaṃ sabījaṃ ca savistaram ।। 1 ।।
avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭena mantreṇa naiva siddhyati ।
mokṣo vā kāryamevāpi tasmādvaiṣṇavamāśrayet ।। 2 ।।
vaiṣṇavācāryadatto vai mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ।
guruṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ kuryānnā'vaiṣṇavaṃ kadācana ।। 3 ।।
vaiṣṇavasya guroryogācchuddhā bhavanti mānavāḥ ।
baiṣṇavastu guruḥ prokto nārāyaṇasvarūpakaḥ ।। 4 ।।
nārāyaṇasamo devo gururvai tārayejjanān ।
gururnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānmantrado mokṣadastathā ।। 5
na vai nārāyaṇānnyūno nārāyaṇasukhapradaḥ ।
nārāyaṇasamo dehe nārāyaṇasamo guṇe ।। 6 ।।
nārāyaṇasamo mokṣe nārāyaṇa ivārthadaḥ ।
tasmādvaiṣṇavamūrdhanyādgurorgrāhyaḥ sumantrakaḥ ।। 7 ।।
sahasraśākhādhyāyī ca sarvayajñādhikāravān ।
viprādijanmavāँścāpi na guruḥ syādavaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 8 ।।
gurumāśritya mantrārthaḥ samyag jñātavya eva ca ।
śaṃkhacakrādicihnāktaḥ kṛtordhvapuṃḍracaṃdrakaḥ ।। 9 ।।
kaṇṭhasthatulasīmālo mantrārthaṃ cintayed budhaḥ ।
nyāsaścāṣṭākṣaro mantro 'brahmāhaṃ vrahmabhakto'smi' ।। 1.116.10।।
anye'pi vaiṣṇavā mantrā 'lakṣmīnārāyaṇā' dayaḥ ।
nyāso mantro mantrarūpaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ paraṃ matam ।। 1 1।।
tadanye vaiṣṇavā mantrāstārakāḥ santi dehinām ।
nyāsārthe tu parijñāte jñātavyārtho na śiṣyate ।। 12।।
tasmācchṛṇu mahādevi! mantraratnārthameva ca ।
brahmāhaṃ brahmabhakto'smi tatra catuṣpadāni vai ।। 13।।
brahatvād bṛṃhaṇatvācca vyāpakaṃ brahma cocyate ।
tadvai brahma bhaved dvedhā sākāraṃ ca nirākṛti ।। 14।।
sākāraṃ mūrtimatsevādharmavaddhāmni saṃsthitam ।
sevaka cākṣaraṃ brahmā vartate pārṣadā yathā ।। 15।।
kadācinmama muktākhyaṃ kadācicchrīsvarūpakam ।
nararūpaṃ kadācittu kadācit siṃhamāsanam ।। 16।।
tasya dharmo'nanyasevā pātivratyena sevanam ।
sevādharmo brahmadharmo tadvad brahmasumūrtikam ।। 17।।
dvitīyaṃ tu nirākāraṃ brahmalokaḥ sa ucyate ।
akṣaraṃ dhāma cetyuktaṃ śrīharervyomadhāma tat ।। 18।।
atitejomayaṃ śāntaṃ ramyamāhlādasaukhyadam ।
tejomayaḥ pradeśaḥ sa vyāpakaṃ dhāma cocyate ।। 19।।
parabrahmanivāsāya muktānāṃ vāsahetave ।
sarvadā śāśvataṃ rūpaṃ vartate divyabhūstaraḥ ।।1.116.20।।
saccidānandatattvaṃ tat cidākāśākhyameva vai ।
tatra divyo hariḥ sākṣātpuruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ।।21।।
vasatyeva pare dhāmbi cākṣarākhye sukhāśraye ।
tasya dhāmno bhavatyeva dharmo nirlepitātmakaḥ ।। 22।।
māyātattveṣu sarveṣu vyāpakaṃ cā'pyalepi tat ।
māyādharmairna lepo'sti tasmādalepi kīrtyate ।।।23।।।
ityevaṃ dvividhau dharmau sevā nirlepatā tathā ।
sevakaścāpi nirlepo brahmaśabdārtha ucyate।।।
ahaṃśabdaḥ śarīryarthamātmānaṃ bodhayatyapi ।
viśeṣadehamāpannaścetanaścāhamucyate ।।25।।
mumukṣustādṛśo hyātmā dehabhinnastadāśritaḥ ।
ahaṃpadena boddhavyo nāmarūpopalakṣitaḥ ।।26।।
puṃstrīśārīrāatmāhaṃ nirlepaḥ sevakastava ।
iti brahmāhamityasya tātparyortho'vadhāryatām ।।27।।
brahmabhaktapade vrahma parabrahmapada pareśvaraḥ ।
paramātmā'kṣaraparaḥ puruṣottama ucyate ।।।28।।
tasya vai vividhā bhaktiḥ pātivratyasamāhvayā ।
tadāśrayaḥ sadā bhaktaḥ prapannaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ।।29।।
bhaktiḥ prapattiḥ śaraṇāgatiḥ ṣaḍrūpadhāriṇī ।
viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ ca sthirā matiḥ ।।1.116.3 0।।
anuvṛttiśca bodhyā sā ṣaḍvidhā śaraṇāgatiḥ ।
patnī dehaḥ patiścātmā tayoraikyena vartanam ।।3 1।।
pātivratyaṃ bhaveddharmaḥ sā bhaktiḥ patisevanam ।
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ tasya smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam ।।32।।
arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam ।
iti bhaktiḥ premapūrvā sevā vai svāmisevanam ।।।3 3।।
nipatya pādayostasya yatkarotu kuruṣva me ।
ityarpaṇaṃ sarvathā sā prapattiḥ prāṇanārpaṇam ।।34।।
vyāpyā'dhīnā'samarthādidharmī yo'haṃpadāśrayaḥ ।
so'haṃ patyuḥ svāminaśca prāṇapriyasya sevanam ।। 35।।
kāromītyeva traikālā'bādhyasevāśrayo'bhavam ।
samaṣṭyarthastu 'brahmāhaṃ brahmabhakto'smi mantrajaḥ ।। 36 ।।
vyāpyā'dhīnā'samarthādidharmyahaṃ sevako hareḥ ।
nirlepaḥ san pātivratyaśravaṇādikabhaktimān ।। 37।।
śāśvatikapadāvāso'bhavamityartha īritaḥ ।
enaṃ vai mantraratnārthaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ vicārya ca ।।38।।
brahmānande sumagnena bhāvyaṃ bhakte na sarvathā ।
nārāyaṇaṃ vinā naiva sukhado mokṣado'paraḥ ।। 3 9।।
tasmāt tatraiva sarvasvaṃ sthāpyaṃ cārpyaṃ samantataḥ ।
mantrādau brahmaṇo nāma niyojyaṃ omiti dhruvam ।।1.116.40 ।।
akārokāramavarṇā vedāstrayastu vai khalu ।
akāreṇa svayaṃ viṣṇurukāreṇocyate'bdhijā ।।41 ।।
makāreṇa tayorbhakta omititraya eva te ।
akāro vāsudevaḥ syādukāraḥ śrīprabodhakṛt ।।42।।
makāreṇa tayordāsa omityeva trayo matāḥ ।
akārastu parabrahma ukāro brahma kathyate ।।43 ।।
makāreṇa tayorbhaktaḥ sevādāsa iti smṛtaḥ ।
bhāskarasya prabhevāsti nityaṃ tato'napāyinī ।।44।।
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇatanuḥ patnī viṣṇormanoramā ।
jagatāmīśvarī nityā mātā jagadvidhāriṇī ।।45।।
jñāno jñānaguṇo jñānāśrayaḥ sūkṣmo hṛdisthitaḥ ।
cetanānandasandohāśraya ātmā hyahaṃ mataḥ ।।46।।
śeṣabhūto dāsabhūto bhaktaḥ śrīmaddharermataḥ ।
svasvatvaṃ tu harau nyasya tadāyattātmajīvanaḥ ।।47।।
nārāyaṇasya sāmarthyānnā'labhyaṃ cātmano bhavet ।
narāṇāṃ tu samūho vai nārā ātmāna eva te ।।48 ।।
tatrāyanaṃ bhavedasya tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
sarvacidacitattveṣu vyāpakaḥ śrīharistu saḥ ।।49 ।।
narājjātaṃ jalaṃ nāraṃ tatrāyanānnarāyaṇaḥ ।
narāṇāṃ tragatāṃ yatra pralaye'yanamucyate ।।1.116.5 0 ।।
tasmānnārāyaṇo devaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ ।
yatra sarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaśca sarvaṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।।।51।।।
anantacakṣuścaraṇo'nantaśīrṣā'mṛtādhipaḥ ।
hiraṇyagarbho viṣṇurvai bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ ।।52।।
brahmasṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭāvapi sthitaḥ ।
tripālloke hyekapāda vyāpya tiṣṭhati yo hariḥ ।।।53।।
parabrahmā'kṣaraṃbrahma vāsudevo hiraṇmayaḥ ।
vairājo viṣṇurīśeśo yajño vai savitā śivaḥ ।।54।।
sa ca vai sarvataspṛtvā bhūmimāvṛtya tiṣṭhati ।
dityadityau tato jāte ye ke cobhayatodataḥ ।।।55।।।
grāmyāraṇyāstato jātāḥ sādhyāśca ṛṣayaśca ye ।
yajñasūtrāstathā'sūtrāstata evāgnayastathā ।।56।।
kṛtāḥ paridhayastenā''nakhacūḍāmayaṃ jagat ।
diśāṃpālāstathā lokālokapālāstato'pi hi ।।57।।
jāyante ca tastasmiँstasya bhakto bhavāmyaham ।
ityarthaṃṃ parivijñāya siddhiṃ vindati sevakaḥ ।।58।।
bhaktabhūtaṃ dāsabhūtaṃ dehabhūtaṃ sadā jagat ।
bhajanīyaṃ sevanīyaṃ dehinaṃ taṃ samāśrayet ।।59।।
athā'nyamantrasatyārtharahasyaṃ śṛṇu sundari! ।
lakṣmaṃ mohakaraṃ cihnaṃ pārāvārakṛpā tu sā ।।1.116.60 ।।
tayā yuktā mahāśaktiḥ sā vai lakṣmīrudāhṛtā ।
nārāyaṇastayā yukto lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।6 1 ।।
śrīḥ proktā divya sampattiḥ sā yasyā'stīti sa prabhuḥ ।
śrīmannārāyaṇaḥ proktastatkṛpā sampadāmpradā ।।62।।
avyāhataṃ svamaiśvaryaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ cāṣṭadhā'pi ca ।
sarvajñātā nityatṛptiḥ saphalecchā'hanākṛtiḥ ।।6 3।।
nityānando niyāmakateti ṣaṭ santi tatra vai ।
āhatapāpmatā'śokatā'vijighatsatā tathā ।।64।।
tathā'pipāsatā caiva vijaratvaṃ vimṛtyutā ।
satyasaṃkalpatā satyakāmatetiguṇāṣṭakam ।।65।।
yatrā'sti sa svayaṃ svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
naṃ brahmacaryaṃ rāti yo naro nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।66।।
harati bhaktaduḥkhāni harinārāyaṇaḥ sa hi ।
māyāṃ nikṛṣya nayate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi ।।67।।
vasati dīvyati cāntaryāmī yaśca prakāśakaḥ ।
vāsudevaḥ sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ śreyaskaraḥ prabhuḥ ।।68।।
ramante yogino yatra rāmanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi ।
omityuktaḥ parabrahma śrīrityuktā haripriyā ।।69।।
tābhyāṃ yukto narasaṃghastatrāntaryāmitā hareḥ ।
aiśvaryaṃ ca tathā vīryaṃ yaśo lakṣmīśca vijñatā ।।1.116.70 ।।
vairāgyaṃ ceti ṣaṣṇāṃ vai bhagasaṃjñā prakīrtitā ।
tadvate vāsudevāya nama utkṛṣṭavān bhava ।।7 1 ।।
jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsi yatra ca ।
santyayaṃ bhagavān śrīmān parabrahmaparātparaḥ ।72।।।
ātmāyanāya jānāmi dhyāyāmyantaḥsthitaṃ harim।
vyāpakaḥ sa prabhustvasmānmokṣakārye pravartayet ।।73 ।।
gāyatrīmantramityarthaṃ jñātvā yo bhajate harim ।
tasya muktiḥ sadā devi! hastamadhye kṛtāspadā ।।
śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ me'sti prapattirarthasaṃbhṛtā ।।74।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayuga-
santāne vaiṣṇavagurupradattavividhaśaraṇāgati-
mantrāṇāmarthapradarśananāmā ṣoḍaśā-
dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 16।।


← adhyāyaḥ 116 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 117

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
pārvatī prāha deveśaṃ vaiṣṇavāgryaṃ maheśvaram ।
nātha brūhi yathā nārāyaṇarūpasya gauravam ।। 1 ।।
muktidaṃ cāmṛtaṃ pītvā na vai tṛpyati mānasam ।
kathametāvatā dīrghakālenāpi na bodhitam ।। 2 ।।
etatta parama śrāvyaṃ parabrahmā'mṛtā'mṛtam ।
śravaṇīyaṃ mayā nityaṃ nūtanaṃ tu śrave śrave ।। 3 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm ।
śṛṇu devi! mamā'pyeṣā nārāyaṇamayī kathā ।। 8 ।।
nūtanā surasā bhāti tadāhlādo vivardhate ।
yathāsmaryaṃ kathayāmi hyavāṅgocaramastyapi ।। 5 ।।
parabrahma svayaṃ sākṣāddivyo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
rājate sarvadā dhāmni svayaṃ rājādhirājakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
anantaśīrṣā puruṣaścānantākṣo'pyasaṃkhyapāt ।
sa sṛṣṭiṃ sarvataspṛtvā'pyatiṣṭhatkeśamātrake ।। 7 ।।
sa vai sarvatra saṃbhāti mokṣeśāno'tiṛddhimān ।
nānyo'to'sti paraḥ kaścinna samo nāpi dāyabhāg ।। 8 ।।
pratallokacaturthāṃśe sarvā jīveśasṛṣṭayaḥ ।
vyaṃśastu brahmaloko'tra brāhmaṇā vyomni vai pare ।। 9 ।।
nāsti tatra vijighatsā no pipāsā pravartate ।
kṣutpipāsāśrayā māyā tadadhastādvikāsate ।। 1.117.10 ।।
tasya dhāmni ca dhāmāni paramāṇi bhavanti vai ।
muktānāṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ manāṃsi saḥ ।। 1 1।।
svasmin vai dhārayan divyo deva eko virājate ।
evaṃ bṛhatsvarūpo'yaṃ brahmaṇā saharājate ।। 12।।
anantakoṭimuktaiśca pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ ।
īśvarībhistathā śrībhiḥ śaktibhiścātisevitaḥ ।। 13।।
niḥsīmadivyabhogāḍhyadivyamaṃgalarūpavān ।
yuvā'cyutamahāsattvaḥ sukumārāṃ'gakomalaḥ ।। 14।।
jagajjananīśrīpūrṇajyotsnāmūrtikayauvanaḥ ।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyā'kṣayapremaprapūritaḥ ।। 19।।
śriyaḥ saṃkalpasiddhyarthaṃ vaikuṇṭhakṛtamaṇḍalaḥ ।
rādhāyai sukhadānārthaṃ goloke śyāmalaḥ sthitaḥ ।। 16।।
muktasaukhyapradaṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ brahma sadā matam ।
bhogārthaṃ parame vyomni vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhenulokakam ।। 17।।
līlārthaṃ bhaktavāsārthaṃ trisṛṣṭamakhilaṃ jagat ।
sukhabhogapralīlākhyā bhūmikāstā vibhūtayaḥ ।। 18।।
tisro bhavanti tasyaiva vibhūtitrayameva tat ।
līlākhyā sakalā sṛṣṭirbhogārthaṃ dhāma taddvayam ।। 19।।
muktasaukhyapradānārthaṃ paramaṃ dhāma cāsthitam ।
yadā līlāṃ mahāsṛṣṭiṃ saṃharate janārdanaḥ ।।1.117.20 ।।
tadā bhogavibhūtau vai nityā sthitistu vidyate ।
tato'pyanyā mahānandā parā mūrtimayī sthitiḥ ।।2 1।।
līlā bhogastathā saukhyaṃ trayaṃ tasyaiva śaktayaḥ ।
tripāt tatparamaṃ dhāma nityaṃ śāśvatamaiśvaram ।।।22।।
tasyaiva prāntabhāgeṣu dhāmānyanyāni nityadā ।
tāni sarvatra bhaktānāṃ sevābhogārthamātanot ।।।22।।।
amṛtaṃ dhāma badarīdhāmā'vyākṛtamityapi ।
lakṣmīdhāma śvetadhāma sevābhogārthamātanot ।।।24।।
taporthaṃ cāpi vyatanollokarakṣaṇahetave ।
tripāttattu śāśvataṃ vai pādamekamaśāśvatam ।।25।।
acyutaṃ brahmarūpāḍhyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gavāṃsthalam ।
amṛtaṃ śrīpuraṃ ceti rādhikāyāḥ śriyastathā ।।26।।
anyāsāṃ prabhupatnīnāṃ krīḍārthāni kṛtāni vai ।
bhagavānśrīharistatra nityaṃ yauvanamāśritaḥ ।।27।।
nityaiṣā ca jaganmātā lakṣmīśca rādhikā tathā ।
yathā sarvagato viṣṇustathā lakṣmīśca rādhikā ।।।28।।।
īśāno bhūtabhavyasya tatheśānī maheśvarī ।
śrīśca lakṣmīśca rādhā ca viṣṇoścaivā'napāyinī ।।।29।।।
sarvatohastacaraṇā sarvato'kṣiśiromukhā ।
nārāyaṇī ca kṛṣṇā ca viṣṇupatnī jaganmayī ।।1.117.3 0।।
mahāmāyā jagatkartrī sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇī ।
yadapāṃgasthitaṃ sarvaṃ jaḍacetanamiśraṇam ।।।3 1 ।।
meṣonmeṣakṛtaṃ yasyā layodbhavamayaṃ jagat ।
nityā'jā vāmabhāgā mā mahālakṣmīḥ pareśvarī ।।32।।
avyaktā vyaktarūpā sā samavyāpyā vyavasthitā ।
pṛthvyāṃ rasā sudhā svarge puṇyā sā pitṛmandire ।।3 2 ।।
jale miṣṭā'nale pākā lakṣmīśca dhanarūpiṇī ।
saundaryaṃ kāntisaubhāgye rūpaṃ lāvaṇyamityapi ।।34।।
nārīṇāmakhilaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā evāsti saṃgatam ।
tayā brahmapadaṃ śaivaṃ māhendraṃ yāmyamityapi ।।35।।
sauryaṃ kauberamāgneyaṃ cāndraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ samṛddhimat ।
mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīrlakṣmīḥ śrīḥ rādhikā priyā ।।26।।
kamalā śāradā padmā vidyā mā paramā ramā ।
abdhiputrī satī śyāmā mahādevī ca vaiṣṇavī ।। 357।।
nārāyaṇī mahāvidyā viṣṇupatnī maheśvarī ।
gaurī sarasvatī śāntiḥ prabhā svāhā svadhā ratiḥ ।।38।।
sāvitrī kaṃbharādevī pārvatīti dviṣoḍaśa ।
nāmānyasyāḥ pratiprātaḥ pāṭhyāni bhūtilabdhaye ।। 39।।
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ hiraṇyarajatātmikām ।
cāndrīṃ svarṇamayīṃ lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇo ma āvaha ।।1.117.40 ।।
dhanāṃ dhānyāṃ gosvarūpāṃ vāhanīṃ puruṣātmikām ।
nārāyaṇo ma āvaha lakṣmīmanapagāminīm ।।41।।
tṛptiṃ tejasvinīṃ svarṇaprākārāṃ bhāsvarāṃ śriyam ।
daivīṃ varcasvinīṃ vārkṣīṃ kīrtiṃ kṛṣṇo ma āvaha ।।42।।
sugandhāḍhyāmanādhṛṣyāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm ।
sarveśvarīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇo ma āvaha ।।43 ।।
ākūticitisaṃkalpasiddhiṃ harirma āvaha ।
hiraṇyadāsadāsīdāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam ।। 44।।
yairevaṃ prastutā lakṣmīsteṣāmanapagāminī ।
harervakṣasi nityāptā sa hariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।45 ।।
sarveśvaraḥ sarvasvāmī nārāyaṇo guṇākaraḥ ।
sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktyāḍhyaḥ pūrṇakāmaḥ suhṛtsukhī ।।46 ।।
karuṇāsāgaraḥ śrīmān śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ ।
svargāpavargavibhavastasya dāsyaṃ karomyaham ।।47।।
sarvadā sarvathā sarvāvasthāsu taṃ bhajāmyaham ।
dāsyaṃ tasya karomyeva dāsabhūtamidaṃ hareḥ ।।48।।
śrīmān nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī sevyaḥ prāpyaḥ paro'kṣarāt ।
sa eva jananī bhrātā pitā putraśca bāndhavaḥ ।।49। ।
śaraṇaṃ cāśrayo vāso gatirnidhanameva saḥ ।
sarvadivyaguṇairyukto māyāguṇādivarjitaḥ ।।1.117.50 ।।
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ।
nārāyaṇaḥ parojyotirātmā nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ।।51।।
nārāyaṇaparo dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ।
yacca kiṃcijjagatsarvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate'pi vā ।।52।।
antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ ।
hṛdye jīvamadhye sa paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ ।।।53।।
sa vai tatra pare dhāmni śrīyuṅnārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ ।
tasya śaktyā śriyā mūlaprakṛtyā racitaṃ mahat ।।54।।
tato virāḍabhūdbhūmirgrāmyāraṇyāśca jīvinaḥ ।
yadāsyabāhūrupādā varṇā vai saṃbhavanti hi ।।55।।
praviprakṣatraviḍḍāsā hyajāyanta makho hi saḥ ।
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca hotā ca bhāgabhuk samidhaśca saḥ ।।56।।
yajñaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devā ayajanta ca tāḥ kriyāḥ ।
prāgevā''san pare dharmā ārādhanādibhaktayaḥ ।।57।।
pūrve muktāḥ pare dhāmni mahimānaṃ sacanta vai ।
taddāsabhaktikartāro yānti nārāyaṇaṃ padam ।।58।।
te vai divyā sadā siddhā muktā vasanti dhāmani ।
māyāpāre pare loke brahmasādharmyamāsthitāḥ ।।59।।
na vai māyāmahākālapāpakarmayamādibhīḥ ।
yadgatvā na parāvṛttistaddharerdhāma cākṣaram ।।1.117.60 ।।
māyā jaganmayī nityā triguṇā prakṛtirhi sā ।
avidyā yoganidrā ca pradhānā'vyaktaśāśvatī ।।6 1 ।।
dhāmacchāyāsvarūpā sā jñānaghanasvarūpiṇī ।
lūtātantusamaṃ cāṇḍamanityaṃ prakaroti hi ।
tayā''vṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sā brahmatejasā''vṛtā ।।।62।।
māyābrahmasambandhaśca sīmā dhāmnaḥ samucyate ।
sarvavyāpi tvasīmaṃ tat tūpacārāt sasīmakam ।।62।।
māyāntare gataṃ sarvaṃ saṃkocaṃ ca vikāsanam ।
tiraḥprāvirbhavatyeva bhaktā gacchanti tadbahiḥ ।।64।।
tadā sīmni brahmahade tejāanandacetane ।
snātvā yānti brahmatanuṃ parajyotiḥpratāpataḥ ।।65।।
niṣpadyante tadātmānaḥ svena rūpeṇa mūrtayaḥ ।
naro vā yadi vā nārī bhaktyā yānti yadā'kṣaram ।।66 ।।
sīmni brahmahade snānti tanurbrāhmī svayaṃ bhavet ।
nā'nyadravyavibhūtervā yogo dehe'sti kaścana ।।67।।
ātmā sudṛk harirūpā'nurūpo dṛśyate svayam ।
na yogo na vibhāgo vā na yogidravyasākṛtiḥ ।।68।।
ekātmatattvamūrtyātmā sumūrtaḥ sa hariryathā ।
mahāmāyā tu virajā sā tu vaikuṇṭhagāminām ।।69।।
vaikuṃṭhamāyayormadhye nārāyaṇadravātmikā ।
dṛśyate tatra saṃsnātvā śrīryathā pārṣadā yathā ।।1.117.70।।
niṣpadyante dāsadāsyastathā nityā vikuṃṭhake ।
yantu jyotiḥparaṃ vyomā'kṣaraṃ brahma sanātanam ।।71 ।।
saccidānandatattvaṃ taddivyaṃ vai brahmasaṃjñitam ।
koṭisūryāgniromaikamajaraṃ layavarjitam ।।72।।
svapnādiśūnyamānandavārdhiśītalaśāntikṛt
yadakṣaraṃ vedaguptaṃ niṣedurmuktakoṭayaḥ ।।73।।
tanna viduḥ ṛcastasya vidastatra samāsate ।
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatprapaśyanti sūrayaḥ ।।74।।
vairājā api yallokaṃ na vai paśyanti yatpadam ।
yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṃgā āyatāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ।।75।।
tadvai dhāma paraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇasya gosukhāvaham ।
ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastādyānti tadvidaḥ ।।76।।
tatra pūrve hyanādinaḥ sādhyā muktā vasanti hi ।
viśve viśvādgatā devā muktāḥ sacanta tatsukham ।।77।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parabrahmā'kṣaradhāmavibhūtilīlābrāhmītanunārāyaṇanārāyaṇīgauravaprabhṛtivarṇanaṃnāmā saptadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 117।।

śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca-
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tato devīṃ brahmadhāmavibhūtikāḥ ।
kathayiṣye samāsena śṛṇu parvataputrike! ।। 1 ।।
akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ brahmavyoma paraṃ sadā ।
rājate taddhi sarvatra śvetatejomayaḥ staraḥ ।। 2 ।।
yāvantastārakāḥ sarve sūryāḥ syurdivi saṃsthitāḥ ।
pṛthvī sṛṣṭisuyuktā ca divyakācamayī bhavet ।। 3 ।।
parasparaṃ ca tadyogādyādṛśaṃ tejaudbhavet ।
tādṛśaṃ tu ghanaṃ tejo mahat satye tu vedhasaḥ ।। 4 ।।
tādṛgvedhastarātsatyāt koṭiguṇaṃ tu taijasam ।
vairājaikakaṇṭhamaṇau vartate'tha tato'pi vai ।। 5 ।।
koṭiguṇaṃ mahattejo mahāviṣṇoḥ śiromaṇau ।
tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ tejo vāsudevasya vai maṇau ।। 6 ।।
tādṛśāścāpyanantāśca maṇayo'vyākṛte stare ।
badaryāmamṛte śvete śrīpure ca vikuṇṭhake ।। 7 ।।
goloke ceti tejāṃsi teṣāmādāya piṇḍakam ।
kuryāccettattvakṣarākhyadhāmnaḥ pūgīphalasthale ।। 8 ।।
līnatāṃ tu samīyādvai pūrṇaṃ tatkīdṛśaṃ bhavet ।
tādṛśākṣaradhāmnaśca muktānāṃ tejasāṃ tathā ।। 9 ।।
samūho līnatāṃ gacchecchrīharerekaromṇi yat ।
tadā pūrṇaharau tatra tejaḥ kīdṛgbhavenmahat ।। 1.118.10 ।।
api śakyaṃ nānumātumagamyaṃ teja aiśvaram ।
ahantu nahi sākṣādvai draṣṭā kintu samādhinā ।। 1 1।।
brahmāṇḍapiṇḍabrahmākhyadhāmagaṃ śrīhariṃ prabhum ।
ekīkṛtyātmani svasminpaśyāmyalaukikena vai ।। 12।
tattadā sannikarṣeṇa dṛśyate'pārameva yat। ।
mantuṃ cintayituṃ boddhaṃ nainaṃ śakyamagocaram ।। 13 ।।
kathaṃ tarhi bhavedvaktuṃ śakyaṃ cāvaihi sundari! ।
tādṛśo'nantatejasvī tathā'sīmaguṇārṇavaḥ ।। 14।।
saundaryarūpasaumyeṣaddhāsyā'pāramahodadhiḥ ।
koṭimuktacakorā'kṣisthiravṛttyekacandramāḥ ।। 15।।
rājādhirājo bhagavān paramātmā parātparaḥ ।
virājate mahāsiṃhāsane ṣoḍaśahāyanaḥ ।। 16।।
rūpānurūpāvayavo mandahāsyalasanmukhaḥ ।
koṭikoṭyarkacandrāgnilīnamāṇikyakuṇḍalaḥ ।। 17।।
asaṃkhyamaṇiratnādinaddhakirīṭakalgikaḥ ।
divyahīrakasadratnā'mūlyahāṭakahāradhṛk ।। 18।।
yāvattejaḥkhanivrātikaustubhaujjvalakaṇṭhakaḥ ।
naikatejaḥprasaratsatkiraṇodbhavamaṇḍakaḥ ।। 19।।
divyaprakāśasaṃrājanmadhyabhālasubhāsvaraḥ ।
meghaghaṭṭasadānīlaklṛptakesarakuntalaḥ ।।1.118.20।।
naikakāmakṛtavakradhanuḥprāntabhruvānvita ।
svarṇasūkṣmanimeṣāḍhyapuṭaromālinetrakaḥ ।।21।।
divyaśvetasphaṭikāgryasatkoṇanetragolakaḥ ।
raktasūkṣmasukiñjalkabhāsavatpārśvanāyanaḥ ।।।22।।
madhyadivyaghaṭṭarūpasphurattejasvikṛṣṇikaḥ ।
tatrāpi grāhyasāmarthyasphuratkṛṣṇakanīnikaḥ ।।।23 ।।
śaratsarojapatrābhā''karṇāntavyāsanetrakaḥ ।
komalasaptavalayaśaṣkulīpītakarṇaka ।।24।।
divyapuraṭasatphullacampakaśṛṃgalāśravāḥ ।
golaphullāḍhyakārpāsapiṇḍakomalagaṇḍakaḥ ।।25।।।
tilapuṣpapiśaṃgadvipuṭanatāntanāsikaḥ।
sūkṣmasvarṇatantukalparekhārājitaśmaśrukaḥ ।। 26 ।।
madhyāgrāṇikavakrāntadhanūrekhottarauṣṭhakaḥ ।
premapātrasarinmūrtikāmasthānā'dharauṣṭhakaḥ ।।27।।
raktasthalābjapatrābharasasetūbhayauṣṭhakaḥ ।
abahiracipīṭāgranimnasughaṭacībukaḥ ।। 28।।
kundaśubhrasutīkṣṇāgryā'viralasthiradantakaḥ ।
raktarasāḍhyadāḍimabījacaṃcaddaṃtasthaliḥ ।।2।।
svarṇamukhyamaṇiprāptaśaṃkhatulyakṛkāṭikaḥ ।
merumūlasamasthūlāraṃbhadyudharakandharaḥ ।।1.118.3 0 ।।
yugacandrakalāvyastā''skandhādhiṣṭhitajatrukaḥ ।
tattvapūrabalā''baddhonnataskandhasupuṣṭakaḥ ।। 31 ।।
yogidhyānasadāyogyaromadrukukṣikandaraḥ ।।
śeṣabhogasamākārasvarṇapuṣṭasubāhukaḥ ।। 32
citsupuṣṭalasadraktakaṃcanābhobhasadbhujaḥ ।
dhruvacakrabhramibindusthirakīlakaphoṇikaḥ ।।3 3 ।।
kramavṛttapuṣṭatanusughaṭobhayahastakaḥ ।
dhṛtakārtasvarasaumyaśṛṃkhalākaṭakāṃgadaḥ ।। 34।।
ratnahīrakamaṇyāḍhyormikābhūṣāñcitāṃguliḥ ।
nakhacandrasphuratkāntidyotisadbhaktamaṇḍalaḥ ।। 35।।
supeśalasuraṃgāḍhyamakhamallāṃgarakṣakaḥ ।
svarṇaprāntakṛtaśobhottarīyā'bhyanvitāṃ'sakaḥ ।। 36।।
divyarājatsvarṇarekhaśrīvatsoraḥsulāṃchanaḥ ।
saptaviṃśatisrakklṛptasvarṇamaṇyāḍhyamekhalaḥ ।। 37।।
brahmakūpasamānābhiprasarattrivalodaraḥ ।
kramavṛttakariśūṇḍhojjvalakāmāḍhyasakthikaḥ ।।38 ।।
karikuṃbharacanārhapuṣṭagaddikaśroṇikaḥ ।
aṣṭasiddhyakṣayavīryasamavartulaliṅgakaḥ ।। 39।।
yuvatīvrātamadhvatyānandarasaratipradaḥ ।
svarṇaromāvalīrājatsvarṇavarṇapaṭodaraḥ ।
samavartulaśobhāḍhya kaṭhinojjvalajānukaḥ ।।1.118.40 ।।
puṣṭatanunālīpaścimā'sthitārhasujaṃghakaḥ ।
antarekabahiḥsattrighūṭikāmaṇibandhanaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
upamuktikṛtanimno'dhodhanurdaṇḍavakrapat ।
svarṇaraktanakhakānticandrasacchaviśobhanaḥ ।।42।।
puṣṭipṛṣṭhaḥ svastiguptaścottamottamamūrtikaḥ ।
virājate mahādhāmni hariḥ siṃhāsanasthitaḥ ।।43 ।।
sarvaiśvaryakriyāśaktijñānayogādibhiryutaḥ ।
siṃhāsanaṃ catuṣpādaṃ pauraṭaṃ ca suśobhitam ।।44।।
saptasopānakaṃ cāste kammānikā'bhitolitam ।
makhamallamahāgaddīpārśvatakkīyarājitam ।।।45।।।
upari saṃdhṛtaṃ chatraṃ śalākāviṃśativṛtam ।
pauraṭaṃ komalaṃ divyaṃ vastraṃ chatre niyojitam ।।46।।
svarṇanirmitakalaśaṃ ratnādyañcitadaṇḍakam ।
parito maṇayo baddhāḥ svarṇakiṃkaṇikāstathā ।।47।।
samantataḥ saptarūpidivyajhallarikāyutam ।
cāmare tadbhave śvete vyajano darpaṇastathā ।।48।।
divyā muktāstathā santi sevādharmasusaṃsthitāḥ ।
chatroparimahāmuktaḥ sahasraphaṇarājitaḥ ।।49।।
mahadrūpaṃ phaṇī dhṛtvā phaṇābhiḥ kṛdvitānakaḥ ।
sevate śrīhariṃ paścāttiṣṭhandhāmanibho mahān ।।1.118.50।।
tatra siṃhāsane paścādbhāge divyamahāpaṭaḥ ।
svarṇatantumayo muktaścitraraṃgādisevanaḥ ।।।51।।।
kamalākāramagryaṃ yatstaṃbhā divyāstathā sthitāḥ ।
muktānāṃ ca maṇīnāṃ ca maṇḍalāni ca teṣu vai ।।52।।
saccidānandarūpāśca śukasārasamenakāḥ ।
vṛkṣavallyādayastatra staṃbheṣu kṛtasusthalāḥ ।।53।।
śobhante cetanāḥ sarve parabrahmaprasaṃginaḥ ।
citraśilpakalāramyaṃ pīṭhikākomalāstaram ।।54।।
tejovārdhiriva dṛśyaṃ ratnakoṭivirājitam ।
nakhacandramaṇikāntidyotitānantamuktakam ।।55।।
siṃhāsanaṃ svayamakṣarākhyaṃ dhāma na cetarat ।
tatra mūrtau mahātejaḥparidhirvartulo mahān ।।।56।।
miṣṭaśaityasaumyatejo'nantagovyāptapārśvakaḥ ।
saptarūpaḥ saptabhūmiḥ paridhiḥ sopi muktakaḥ ।।57।।।
daśadikṣu harestejo mahāsiṃhāsane'bhitaḥ ।
vyāpnotyeva na cā''nto'sti gāvastā bhūriśṛṃgikāḥ ।।58।।
yatra siṃhāsane tadvai maṇḍapaḥ samayojanaḥ ।
tatra divyamahāstaṃbhā hyakṣarāḥ kadalīkṛtāḥ ।।59।।
haridvarṇā haritpatrā haritkadalamaṃgalāḥ ।
śatastaṃbhāḥ svarṇavarṇā vastraveṣṭitaśobhanāḥ ।।1.118.60।।
teṣāṃ kammānikāḥ śilpakalāvyāptivicitritāḥ ।
nānāvidhā gajāḥ śvetāḥ makarā haṃsasārasāḥ ।।61 ।।
menāśukaśvetapārāvatacakrakacātakāḥ ।
sarve muktā bhavantyeva saccidānandavigrahāḥ ।।।62।।
divyasusvaramādhuryakṛtagītikamaṃgalāḥ ।
tatratyasaṃskṛtavāṇyā gāyanti guṇakīrtanam ।।63।।
naikakoṭimahāmuktamaṇḍalāni tu maṇḍape ।
pratiṣṭhanti sthale bhūmau madhye copari cāntare ।।64।।
sṛṣṭisṛṣṭyantare yāni rūpāṇi saṃdhṛtāni vai ।
hariṇā tāni sarvāṇi maṇḍape sthāpitāni hi ।।65।।
śobhante vividhākārā vividhaiśvaryacihnakāḥ ।
tattajjanmā'vatārādicaritrodbodhahetayaḥ ।।66।।
vṛttāntabodhakākārā bhagavanto vibhūtayaḥ ।
sarve tiṣṭhanti tatraiva maṇḍapāgrordhvamadhyataḥ ।।67।।
tatratyā muktamūrdhanyāḥ sūryacandrādidarpaṇāḥ ।
bhūtvā bhūtvā teṣu teṣu staṃbheṣu saṃvasanti vai ।।68।।
ullecastatpramāṇāḍhyo yatra muktātmatārakāḥ ।
lagnāḥ samyakprakāśante śītakāntipravartakāḥ ।।69।।
muktāśca toraṇāstatra maṇihīrakarūpakāḥ ।
kācakāntikarā naikadivyadīpakacandrakāḥ ।।1.118.70 ।।
ūrdhvamadhastathā pārśve dikṣu sarvavidikṣu ca ।
maṇḍapāt kiraṇā yānti projjvalā vyomamārgagāḥ ।।7 1 ।।
tādṛśo maṇḍapastādṛk siṃhāsanamathāpi vā ।
nānyadhāmasu vidyete kā varṇyā taccamatkṛtiḥ ।।।72।।
śobhā divyāpi nānyatra na varṇyā jāyate mayā ।
maṇḍapopariprāsādaḥ śrīharestaṃ śṛṇu priye! ।।73।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne'kṣaradhāmasthaparabrahmatatsiṃhāsanatanmaṇḍapavarṇananāmā'ṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 18।।

adhyāyaḥ 119
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 120 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śaṃbhuḥ prāha punardevīṃ śrīharermaṇḍapopari ।
prāsādaṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi! na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।। 1 ।।
lakṣayojanavistāraḥ sahasrayojanocchrayaḥ ।
sahasrastaṃbhapaṃktyekā sahasrapaṃktayastathā ।। 2 ।।
kammānikācatuṣkīvatsarvatra protthitāḥ śubhāḥ ।
madhye mahān ghūmmaṭaśca dikṣu catvāra eva ca ।। 3 ।।
catuṣkoṇeṣu catvāri śikharāṇi lasanti vai ।
śikharāṇi sapta taṃ vai ghūmmaṭaṃ dhruvametya ca ।। 4 ।।
trīṇi dakṣe ca vāme'pi trīṇi madhye mahattamam ।
yatkolyāṃ maṇḍapastatra yadadhaḥ siṃhamāsanam ।। 5 ।।
saudhopari koṣṭhalo'pi sahasrayojanocchrayaḥ ।
koṣṭhalopari śikharaṃ sārdhasahasrayojanam ।। 6 ।।
tatra sthitā padmaśilā pañcaśatasuyojanam ।
tatra sthalīśilā cāste śatayojanamucchrayā ।। 7 ।।
tadūrdhvaṃ divyasauvarṇakalaśāḥ śatameva ca ।
taduparyekakalaśī tatastadgarimo mataḥ ।। 8 ।।
tai vai pañcaśatocchrāyā dhvajadaṇḍastataḥ param ।
sahasrayojanocchrāyo vaṃśaścāpi tathocchrayaḥ ।। 9 ।।
dhvajastatrā''mūlapucchaṃ pañcaśatasuyojanaḥ ।
saptaraṃgo dvipucchaśca koṭisūryasamojjvalaḥ ।। 1.119.1 0।।
ta eta cetanā muktāḥ sevārtharūpadhāriṇaḥ ।
cihnadehāḥ sadā muktāstathā tiṣṭhanti sevane ।। 1 1।।
śikhare sāṃkhyayoginyo yoginyo dikṣu santi vai ।
siṃhāścānye narasiṃhā hyavatārā bhavanti vai ।। 12।।
gavākṣāstatra śikhare muktākṣāḥ saṃvasanti vai ।
puttalikāstathā cānyā muktānyaḥ saṃvasanti tāḥ ।। 1 3।।।
dhvajadaṇḍe pāṭalikā sādhvī muktā tu sā matā ।
ghaṇṭiṇyastāśca muktānyo divyāḥ śrīharisevikāḥ ।। 14।।
dīpastatra mahādīpo mahāmukto na cāparaḥ ।
mahato'pi mahīyānvai dīpaḥ sarvottamo hi saḥ ।। 15।।
anyeṣvapi tu śṛṃgeṣu sarve muktā vasanti vai ।
saudhopari ghummaṭo'pi sahasrayojanocchrayaḥ ।। 16।।
divyo'yaṃ vai mahāsaudho vyomagastaijasaḥ svayam ।
yatheṣṭaśrīhareḥ kāmādgacchatyeva samantataḥ ।। 17।।
tatrarṣīṇāṃ vimānāni kāmagāni bhramanti vai ।
pradakṣiṇāṃ mandirasya tāni kurvanti bhaktitaḥ ।। 18।।
divyāḥ śītoṣṇajaladā vahnikuṇḍāśca śāśvatāḥ ।
anityāḥ śītagandhāśca prakāśā dugdharūpiṇaḥ ।। 19।।
pradīpāḥ satyasaṃkalpā upaskarāśca kāmajāḥ ।
vastrabhojanabhūṣādipānavāhāśca kāmajāḥ ।।1.119.20 ।।
gṛhā gṛhopasampattiḥ sevakāḥ sevikāstathā ।
divyā divyavapuṣmanto muktā mūrtaya eva te ।।21।।
mahāsaudhe svakaṃ ramyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tu madhyage ।
tatpārśve dharmadevasya bhakteśca vasatirdhruvā ।।।2।।
vāmapārśve tu mukteśca rateśca vasatirdhruvā ।
jñānasya dharmapārśve tu viraktervasatirdhruvā ।।23।।
muktipārśve upāsteścā''jñāyāśca vasatirdhruvā ।
ājñāpārśve mumukṣāyāḥ prapattervasatirdhruvā ।।24।।
jñānapārśve kathāyāśca vārtāyā vasatirdhruvā ।
vārtāpārśve dāsatāyā dīkṣāyā vasatirdhruvā ।। 25।।
itisaptaśikharā'dhovāsaste kīrtito mayā ।
ghummaṭe vartulaṃ pradakṣiṇāyāṃ gotramaṇḍalam ।।।26 ।।
saptakuṭumbakauṭumbitattadvāsā bhavanti vai ।
vartulagopure vidyā parā tadāpyate yayā ।।27।।
vartulastu mahānsvarṇadivyaprākāra ucyate ।
paritastatra rājante saudhā anādimuktajāḥ ।।28 ।।
nityaṃ teṣāṃ tu saudhāste vimānānīva cetanāḥ ।
kāmagāḥ kāmacārāste sarvasmṛddhiprapūritāḥ ।। 29।।
bhojyapānavilepārghyasarvarasasukhāśrayāḥ ।
tejasvinaḥ sadā divyā muktāḥ śrīharirūpiṇaḥ ।। 1.119.30 ।।
yatheṣṭasarvasāmarthyā yatheṣṭotpādabhāvanāḥ ।
teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣye tvāṃ śṛṇu pārvati susthirā ।। 31 ।।
guṇātītaśca gopālo brahma muktaḥ śukaḥ śata ।
suvrato niṣkulo bhūmā vidhātā vāsudevakaḥ ।। 32।।
nityo'cintyaśca śāntaśca kṛṣṇastyāgaḥ kṛpastathā ।
parahaṃso virāgaścinmayaścākṣara īśanaḥ ।। 3 re ।।
svaprakāśaśca kaivalyo viraktaścetanastathā ।
cidrūpaśva naraścaiva śrīcaraṇaśca pāvanaḥ ।। 34।।
dhīro mahāpūruṣaśca śivaścādhāra eva ca ।
caitanyo vaiṣṇavo viśvātmako nirguṇa eva ca ।। 35।।
sūriḥ kalyāṇa īśeśo hyarūpo'mṛta eva ca ।
gopaḥ padmadharāḥ śveto vaikuṇṭho deva ityapi ।। 36।।
prakāśaśca prasādaśca sudharmaśca sukhaśrayaḥ ।
sukharūpaśca santoṣo jñāno vijaya ityapi ।। 37।।
badrikaśca nivṛttaśca nayo dhyānaśca śāntanuḥ ।
śamaḥ sukho mahāsukho'cintyo'moghaḥ pramodakaḥ ।। 38 ।।
gavendro'nubhavaścādityo'calo viśvarūpakaḥ ।
prajño bodhaśca vedānto mukundaḥ kṣema ityapi ।। 3 9।।
puṇḍarīko vidhātā cā'grāhyaḥ śāśvata ityatha ।
dhruvo'meyaḥ pavitraśca sthaviṣṭhaśca ṛṣīkakaḥ ।।1.119.40 ।।
prabhūto niyamo yogo jagadīśo dayālayaḥ ।
suro dharmo munirnāro balabhadraḥ prakāśanaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
sidḥ sukhakaraścaiva viśrāmaḥ keśavastathā ।
kapilaḥ svayaśo draṣṭā sajjanaḥ sāṃkhya ityapi ।।42।।
bhāskaraśca prabhaścāpi ṛṣabhaḥ saguṇastathā ।
nirdvandvaśca nṛsiṃhaśca videho deva ityatha ।।43 ।।
nirālambaśca viśvāso nirvikāraḥ pradīpanaḥ ।
nirapekṣo nirannaśca sattvo lakṣmaṇa ityapi ।।44।।
nirmoho bhūdharaścaiva bhadro mānad ityapi ।
haṃsaḥ pradyumna ānando maṃjulaśca pratoṣaṇaḥ ।।।45।।
bhajano nirmalaḥ śāntaḥ praśānto dhanya ityatha ।
savitā dharaṇaḥ sujñaḥ satyeśo jyotiṣastathā ।।46।।
prabodhaśca prabhuścaiva padmaḥ tāpasa ityapi ।
turīyaśca svarūpaśca viveko vāmanastathā ।।47।।
nivāso maṃgalaścaivā'kṣayaḥ suvrata eva ca ।
abhedaśca turīyaśca kṣemakaśca dṛḍhavrataḥ ।।48 ।।
nirviśeṣo vicāraśca jiṣṇurmadhuśca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
avyayo muktigaścaiva varada saṃśitastathā ।।49।।
vallabhaśca suparṇaśca viśvadhro durlabhastathā ।
dhanaścaiva prasādaśca śyāmaśca daharastathā ।।1.119.50 ।।
aiśvaryaścāvadātaśca rādhaśca dharmarūpaṇaḥ ।
vrajo bhāgavato bālaḥ upaśamaśca svastikaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
saṃkarṣaṇaḥ śrīdharaścāmṛto yajño hiraṇyakaḥ ।
īśānaḥ prabhavaḥ pūto bhūgarbhaḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇaḥ ।।52।।
saṃvatsaraḥ kṛtaḥ śivaḥ kṛtajñaśca sureśvaraḥ ।
budho vṛṣo vasuḥ sāma guṇo'dhyakṣaḥ pravedanaḥ ।।53।।
loko vyūhaḥ sarvagaśca bhrājiṣṇuścaraṇastathā ।
sahiṣṇuścaturo'naghaścorjitaḥ kāraṇastathā ।।24।।
upendraśca dhṛtaścaiva sattvaḥ sāttvata ityapi ।
utsāho viśrutaścaivā'nirdeśaścā'nimeṣaṇaḥ ।।55।।
udāraśca subhūṣaścā'nilaśca vikramastathā ।
satkāraḥ saṃvṛto vṛtto viśiṣṭaḥ siddhimāँstathā ।।56।।
vardhanaśca viviktaśca bṛhadrūpaḥ pṛthuḥśravaḥ ।
aśokaśca sudāmaśca sānukūlo'tulastathā ।।57।।
ādidevaḥ śrīgarbhaśca nirvāṇo bhājanastathā ।
vyavasāyaśca santoṣo virāmo nanda ityatha ।।58।।
sthiraḥ sudarśanaścaiva viśālo dakṣa ityapi ।
dharmayūpastathejyaśca makhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ pramāṇakaḥ ।।59।।
brahmaṇyo vatsalaścaiva śubhāṃgaśca purātanaḥ ।
sandhānaśca pramodaśca nandanaśca supuṇyakaḥ ।।1.119.60 ।।
durjayaḥ kumudaścaiva sulabhaḥ śuddha ityapi ।
yogīśaśca suvidyaśca sākṣyo dhanaṃjayastathā ।।6 1 ।।
akhaṇḍaśca trilokaśca suhṛd bhūmā hiraṇmayaḥ ।
bhavo bhāvaḥ kratuścaiva samārādhana ityapi ।।62।।
vatsalo vātsalaścaiva susnehaśca kuberajit ।
somo'larkaśca śūraśca mantro mañcaśca mūlajit ।।63।।
tilakaḥ kuṇḍalaścaiva kirīṭaḥ kaṭakoṃ'gadaḥ ।
naktakaḥ kaustubhaścaiva prāvāraḥ kaṃcukastathā ।।64।।
ityevaṃ pārṣadāstatra prākāre kṛtasaṃśrayāḥ ।
sadā tiṣṭhanti saudheṣu prathamāvaraṇe hi te ।।65।।
anādinaśca te muktā vasanti harisevinaḥ ।
asaṃkhyātāśca te santi dvitīyā'varaṇe'pi ca ।।66।।
sarve mūrtisamākārā mūrtitulyaiśvarāśca te ।
sarve paśyanti sāmyena śrīharermandiraṃ kare ।।67।।
na nyūnādhikabhāvo'sti tatraiśvaryādisadguṇe ।
yathecchanti bhavantyeva nityasārvajñyacākṣuṣāḥ ।।68।।
koṭiyojanavistāraḥ prākāraḥ prathamo hi saḥ ।
abjayojanavistāraḥ prākāro dvitvasaṃkhyakaḥ ।।69।।
parārdhayojanāyāmaḥ prākārastu tṛtīyakaḥ ।
tatra ceśvaralokebhyo gatā mukta vasanti vai ।।1.119.70।।
turyaḥ parārdhaguṇitaparārdhayojanāyataḥ ।
prākārastatra muktānāṃ gatānāṃ santi sṛṣṭayaḥ ।।71।।
tatastu paṃcamaṃ tatrāvaraṇaṃ syādanantakam ।
asīmaṃ tatra goloko vaikuṇṭho'mṛta ityapi ।।72।।
avyākṛtastathā śveto badrikāśrama ityapi ।
mātsyalokaḥ kūrmaloko vārāho loka ityapi ।।73।।
kāpilaṃ dhāma hāreyaṃ vāsudevagṛhaṃ tathā ।
pārthavaṃ ca padaṃ dattātreyadhāma ca hāṃsakam ।।74।।
nṛharerdhāma ca yadvadāryamaṃ vāmaneyakam ।
paraśurāmalokaśca yājñaṃ sāketamityapi ।।75।।
kaumāraṃ dhāma ca hāyagrīva nāradadhāma ca ।
rājarājeyadhāmāni vyāsāśrayāṇi yānyapi ।।76।।
bauddhaṃ dhāma tathā'nyānyasaṃkhyadhāmāni santi vai ।
anantā hyavatārāścānantā brahmāṇḍakoṭayaḥ ।।77।।
anantasṛṣṭayastatrāvatārāṇāṃ na saṃkhyanam ।
atastattaddhāmnāṃ vai saṃkhyā naiva ca naiva ca ।।78।।
paṃcamāvaraṇasyāpi saṃkhyā naiva ca naiva ca ।
tatrāraṇyāni nadyaśca pārvatā muktakoṭayaḥ ।।79।।
udyānāni vihārāṇi bhūmayo'kṣarasaṃjñikāḥ ।
dhātavaḥ khanayaḥ khātā ucchrayāḥ śikharāṇi ca ।।1.119.80।।
vimānānyeva sarvāṇi tattatsevakajātayaḥ ।
gāndharvā nartakāstatrā''khyānakā vaṃśabodhakaḥ ।।8 1।।
sevakā yājñikā sāmnāṃ stāvako vyavasāyakāḥ ।
kalākārāśca śrāṃgārā muktānīmuktamaṇḍalāḥ ।।।82।।
asaṃkhyātā na saṃkhyātuṃ ko'pi nārāyaṇamṛte ।
so'pi prāha mama dhāmno muktānāṃ nāsti saṃkhyanam ।।83।।
avatārāṇāṃ ca dhāmnāṃ naivā'sti gaṇanaṃ tathā ।
evaṃ divye'kṣare dhāmni vibhūtau tripadi prathe ।।84।।
vartante dhāmadhāmāni śrīharerlīlayā tataḥ ।
mahāmāyākṛtā sṛṣṭirbhavantīśvarakoṭayaḥ ।।85।।
nānto nāntaṃ varṇane'pi kartuṃ śakyo hi kaścana ।
kathamahaṃ tadantena varṇanaṃ pārayāmi vai ।।86।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīhariprāsādaparikaratatprāvaraṇatanmuktapārṣadatadavatāra-dhāmādisāmānyaviśeṣoddeśanāmā ekonaviṃśā-
dhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 119 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 119 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 120
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 121 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tato lakṣmi! jagadbandhuḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
pārvatīṃ kathayāmāsa golokaparivarṇanam ।। 1 ।।
golokaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛṣṇabhagavato nivāsanam ।
sarvasmṛddhivilāsādidāsīdāsādyanantavat ।। 2 ।।
avadhāraya deveśi! samādhau darśitaṃ tu me ।
virajāyā mahānadyāḥ pāre prākāravān giriḥ ।। 3 ।।
śataśṛṃgaśca paṃcāśatkoṭiyojanavartulaḥ ।
koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ vyāso daśakoṭiyojanaḥ ।। 4 ।।
tasyaikaśṛṃge rāsamaṃḍalaṃ tu daśayojanam ।
tato vṛndāvanaṃ tadvad dvātriṃśacca vanāni vai ।। 5 ।।
tato'gre tvakṣayavaṭo gopagopyādisṛṣṭayaḥ ।
tata ūrdhvaṃ cidākāśe golokaṃ ca tato'kṣaram ।। 6 ।।
vicitraṃ subhagaṃ dhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ hi tat ।
brahmaṇā dhāryamāṇaṃ ca nirmitaṃ svecchayā hareḥ ।। 7 ।।
naiva varṇayituṃ śakyaṃ tathāpi varṇaye tvaṇu ।
virajāyāḥ pṛthutīrau mayā dṛṣṭau samādhinā ।। 8 ।।
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśau suvistīrṇau manoharau ।
muktāmāṇikyaparamamaṇiratnākarānvitau ।। 9 ।।
kṛṣṇaśubhraharidraktamaṇirājivirājitau ।
suprakāśapravālau tau kutracitsumanoharau ।। 1.120.10।।
paramā'mūlyasadratnākararājivibhūṣitau ।
anyādṛśyamahāścaryasvarṇanidhyākarānvitau ।।11।।
padmarāgendranīlānāmākarau kutracit priye ।
kutracicca marakatākaraśreṇīsamanvitau ॥12॥
syamantakākarau kutra kutracid rucakākarau ।
amūlyapītavarṇābhau maṇiśreṇyākarānvitau ॥13॥
ratnākarau kutracicca kutracit kaustubhākarau ।
kutra nirvacanīyānāṃ maṇīnāmākarau śubhau ॥14||
kutraciddivyasadramyavihāraprasthalau matau ।
tādṛśī virajā ramyā sarit tīraiḥ suśobhitā ।।15।।
saṃveṣṭaya vartulā cāste śataśṛṃgaṃ tu parvatam ।
divyasvarṇamayaṃ koṭisūryaprasaradujjvalam ॥16॥
pārijātatarūṇāṃ ca vanairdīrghairvirājitam ।।
nānākalpataruvyāptaṃ kāmadhenusumaṇḍitam ॥17॥
koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca vyāse daśaguṇottaram ।
śailadairghyaṃ mitaṃ tatra pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam ॥18॥
prākārākāramasyaikaśikhare rāsamaṇḍalam ।
daśayojanavistīrṇaṃ vartulākāramuttamam ॥19॥
naikapuṣpodyānakoṭisugandhipuṣpavāsitam ।
kāmottejakavastvādirājitaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ॥1.120.20॥
tatra ratyarthasaudhādiratnamaṇḍapakoṭayaḥ ।।
sopānaniḥśreṇīmaṇḍitā naikabhūmayaḥ ॥21॥
sadratnasvarṇakalaśairmaṇistambhaiḥ suśobhitāḥ ।
stambheṣu khacitā harinmaṇayaśca manoharāḥ ॥22॥
sindūravarṇamaṇaya indranīlāḥ prabhākarāḥ ।।
naddharatnaprabhedāśca maṇibhedāḥ sudarśanāḥ ॥23॥
tasya maṇḍapavaryasya catvāro gopurāstathā ।
dṛṣṭāḥ kapāṭaśobhāḍhyā divyā gaganacumbinaḥ ॥24॥
rajjugranthisamāyuktarasālapallavānvitāḥ ।
kadalīstambhanivahā yatra śobhanta āditaḥ ॥25॥
sthale sthale maṇḍape'tra śobhā klṛptā navā navā ।।
śukladhānyaparṇajālaphaladurvāṃkurānvitā ॥26॥
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitā ।
ramante gopakanyānāṃ samūhāḥ koṭiśo'tra vai ॥27॥
ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyā ratnamālāvirājitāḥ ।।
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūraratnanūpurabhūṣitāḥ।।28।।
ratnakuṇḍalatroṭyādigaṇḍasthalavirājitāḥ ।
ratnāṃgulīyalalitahastāṃgulivirājitāḥ ।।29।।
ratnapāśakabhūṣāḍhyapadāṃgulisuśobhitāḥ ।
ratnabhūṣābhūṣitāśca sadratnamukuṭojjvalāḥ ।।1.120.30 ।।
gajendramuktālaṃkārarājitaśubhanāsikāḥ ।
alakā'dhaḥsthalojjvalakṛtasindūracandrakāḥ ।।3 1।।
pītacampakavarṇābhāścandanadravacarcitāḥ
pītāmbaraparīdhānā bimbādharamanoharāḥ ।।32।।
śaratpārvaṇacandrotthaprabhojjvalamukhāmbujāḥ ।
śaratpraphullapadmāgryadalaśobhitalocanāḥ ।।33।।
netrapuṭadvayalagnaprāñjitakajjalonmadāḥ ।
praphullamālatīmālājālakaṃbaraśobhitāḥ ।।34।।
gajahaṃsagatiśreṣṭhamantharāgatimohanāḥ ।
vakrabhrūbhaṃgasaṃyogaślakṣṇasmitasamanvitāḥ ।।35।।
pakvadāḍimabījābhadantapaṃktivirājitāḥ ।
khagendracañcuśobhāḍhyanāsikonnatibhūṣitāḥ ।।36।।
gajendragaṇḍayugmābhasvarṇastanabharā''natāḥ ।
nitambakaṭhinaśroṇīpīnabhārabharā''natāḥ ।।37।।
kandarpadarpavilasanmānasā madavihvalāḥ ।
darpaṇe pūrṇacandrāsyasaundaryadarśanotsukāḥ ।।38।।
rādhikākṛṣṇacaraṇasevāsaktamanorathāḥ ।
sundaryaḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣā bharayauvanamārgaṇāḥ ।।39।।
viharanti mahādivye rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍape ।
kriyāsarāṃsi lakṣāṇi puṣpodyānāni koṭiśaḥ ।।1.120.40 ।।
lohitaśvetaraktābhapadmakoṭyanvitāni vai ।
divyamadhupasannādaguñjitatīravanti ca ।।41।।
puṣpaśayyāgarbhakuṃjakuṭīrakoṭiśobhitaḥ ।
maṇḍapaḥ parito ratnapradīpakiraṇojjvalaḥ ।।42।।
bhogadravyasakarpūratāmbūlavastrasaṃyutaḥ ।
śvetacāmaradarpaṇavicitrapuṣpahārakaḥ ।।43।।
bhavyastu śobhate rāsamaṇḍapo'tha tataḥ param ।
vicitraśobhaṃ ramyaṃ ca sudivyaṃ vartate vanam ।।44।।
vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma rādhāmādhavayoḥ priyam ।
tayoḥ krīḍāvihārārthaṃ kalpadrumamayaṃ param ।।45।।
mandavāyuprakampena śobhate cetanaṃ sadā ।
kamalasthalapadmādikastūryādisugandhitam ।।46।।
kokilākūjanairnūtnapallavaiśca manoharam ।
ramaṇārthaṃ kadambānāṃ kuṃjaiḥ sukamanīyakam ।।47।।
bakulakundamandāracandanasvarṇacampakaiḥ ।
tattatsugandhisatpuṣpaiḥ paritaḥ surabhīkṛtam ।।48।।
nāgaraṃgapanasā''mratālaśrīphaळkharjuraiḥ।
jambūbadarikāgurvākāmrātakasudāḍimaiḥ ।।49।।
jambīrakadalīnārikelairyuktaṃ manoramam ।
śālmalyaśvatthatintiḍīnimbapippalisarjakaiḥ ।।1.120.50 ।।
saṃkulaṃ vividhairvṛkṣaiḥ sarvadā phalapuṣpadhṛk ।
mallikāmālatīsvarṇāketakīmādhavīyutam ।।5 1।।
yūthikācitrapuṣpyādivallyullocavirājitaiḥ ।
cārukuṃjakuṭīraiśca paṃcāśatkoṭibhiryutam ।।52।।
ratnadīpāḥ koṭikoṭyo dhūpāstatra sugandhinaḥ ।
śṛṃgāradravyasammiśrā'nilā vānti samantataḥ ।।53।।
sugandhyarkacandanāktapuṣpaśayyāḥ sthale sthale ।
divyamuktadhṛtarūpadvirepharavanādite ।।54।।
ramye vṛndāvane gopyo ratnālaṃkāraśobhitāḥ ।
paṃcāśatkoṭigopyastā vasanti rādhikājñayā ।।55।।
tatrābhyantarabhūmau dvātriṃśadvanāni santi vai ।
kalpadrupārijātākhyakadambādikanāmabhiḥ ।।56।।
tattadvṛkṣaviśeṣaiśca vanāni santi vartule ।
tato vṛndārakaṃ sthānaṃ gopagopīkṛtagṛham ।।57।।
goṣṭhānāṃ gopagopīnāṃ nagarāṇi vasanti vai ।
puṣpodyānasahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi bhavanti ca ।।58।।
pañcāśatkoṭigopīnāṃ gṛhebhyo'pyuttamāni vai ।
saudhāni santi pratyekaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasyeva rūpataḥ ।।5 9 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇatulyarūpāśca sarvā dvādaśahāyanāḥ ।
arbudā'rbudasaṃkhyākā rūparūpātirūpaṇāḥ ।।1.120.6 0 ।।
gopyo gopā hyasaṃkhyātā vṛndārake vasanti hi ।
ratnahīrakamāṇikyamaṇisvarṇādibhūmike ।।61 ।।
divye vṛndārake tatra smṛddhayaḥ santyanantaśaḥ ।
tata ārabhya goloko brahmadhāmni sthito'ntare ।।62।।
tasya vai parito gopagopīnāṃ maṇḍalāni vai ।
vṛndārake cābhitastu golokasyābhitastathā ।।63।।
vasatayo vartule vai vṛndārake vasanti hi ।
vṛndārakāṇāṃ vāsānāṃ madhye golokamuttamam ।।64।।
pūrve vṛndārakaṃ bhāge tatrā'kṣayavaṭo'sti vai ।
pañcayojanavistīrṇo daśayojanamūrdhvagaḥ ।।65 ।।
sahasraskandhasaṃrohaśākhākoṭisamanvitaḥ ।
raktapakvaphalāḍhyaśca navapallavaśobhitaḥ ।।66 ।।
sughaṭṭachāyāsuravadastadadho ratnavedikāḥ ।
santi tatra kṛṣṇarūpā ramante gopabālakāḥ ।।67।।
pītāmbaradharā krīḍālagnamānasasadrasāḥ ।
candanottamasaugandhyānvitagātrasurūpiṇaḥ ।।68।।
pārṣadāste kṛṣṇatulyarūpayauvanabhāsurāḥ ।
sarvabhūṣāsuśobhāḍhyā ramante viharanti ca ।।69।।
tataḥ pārśve dvitīyastu bhāṇḍīravaṭasaṃjñakaḥ ।
rādhayā saha kṛṣṇasya yogaḥ saṃjāyate'tra vai ।।1.120.70 ।।
vaṭo'sti paṃcayojanavistāro dviguṇocchrayaḥ ।
sahasraskaṃdhakoṭiśākhāpraśākhāsudivyakaḥ ।।71 ।।
tadadho ratnakhacitasvarṇavedimayāni vai ।
gopīnāṃ kanyakānāṃ vai vihārāṇi bhavanti hi ।।72।।
sarvāśca gopakanyāstā rādhāvadrūpabhāsurāḥ ।
viharanti ramante tāḥ sarvā dvādaśahāyanāḥ ।।73 ।।
kṛṣṇaṃ nityaṃ pratīkṣante cāyānti yānti koṭiśaḥ ।
kṛṣṇaṃ prāṇādhikaṃ labdhvā sevitvā ca prayānti vai ।।74।।
tayostu vaṭayormadhye rājamārgo manoharaḥ ।
rādhākṛṣṇamahāsaudhaṃ prati gacchati dūrataḥ ।।75।।
pārśve pārśve tu sindūramaṇinirmitavedikāḥ ।
kvacidindranīlaklṛptā rucakairhīrakaistathā ।।76 ।।
padmarāgaiḥ sphaṭikaiśca nirmitā vedikāḥ kvacit ।
viśrāntimaṇḍapā dharmaśālāśca pārśvataḥ kvacit ।।77।।
kvaciccandanakastūrīkuṃkumadravaśobhitaḥ ।
kvacit lājāphalapuṣpadadhidurvādimaṇḍitaḥ ।।78।।
svarṇacampakamandārapārijātādipārśvakaḥ ।
navapallavapuṣpādismṛddhavṛkṣavirājitaḥ ।।79।।
raṃbhāvanāni śobhante śobhante phaliśākhinaḥ ।
suratnāñcitagargaryo mastakasthāḥ suśobhanāḥ ।।1.120.80 ।।
jalāharaṇakāryārthā gopīnāṃ bhānti vāribhiḥ ।
ghaṭāstāsāṃ kaṭitaṭe sthāpitā bhānti pauraṭāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
sindūrakuṃkumāktāśca gandhasugandhavāsitāḥ ।
bhūṣitāḥ puṣpabhūṣābhiḥ yato gacchanti gopikāḥ ।।82।।
mārgānmārgāntaraṃ rathyārūpaṃ gacchanti kanyakāḥ ।
svasvasaudheṣu ramyeṣu ratnasopānavartmasu ।।83 ।।
vahniśaucāṃśukadharāḥ svarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitāḥ ।
śvetacāmaradarpaṇapuṣpatalpe svapanti tāḥ ।।84।।
tena mārgeṇa gopāśca gopyo yānti susundarān ।
pārśvasthānsvīyasaudhānvai puṣpamālyasutoraṇān ।।85।।
ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyuktaprākārapariveṣṭitān ।
paritaḥ parikhāyuktān dvārapālaiśca rakṣitān ।।86।।
ityevaṃ rājamārgaḥ saḥ pārśvadvayasuśobhitaḥ ।
prākāradvāramāviśya yāti śrīkṛṣṇamandiram ।।87।।
prākārāntarvasatayo bhavanti koṭiśastathā ।
prākāro vartulākāraḥ koṭiyojanavistṛtaḥ ।।88 ।।
goloko'yaṃ mahādivyo mahāgolokasaṃjñakaḥ ।
nijagoloka ityevaṃ rādhāgoloka ityapi ।।8 9 ।।
nāmnā paricayastasya kurvanti gopagopikāḥ ।
atha te mukhyagolokaṃ kathayāmi śive! śṛṇu ।। 1.120.90 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne goloke virajāśataśṛṃgarāsamaṇḍapavṛndāvanā'kṣayavaṭa-
bhāṇḍīravaṭarājamārgavṛndārakādivarṇananāmā viṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 120 ।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tato lakṣmi! mahādevaḥ pārvatī prāha śobhanam ।
saprākāraṃ tu golokaṃ mandirādisthalānvitam । । 1 । ।
tasya prākāravistāraḥ koṭiyojanamucyate ।
caturdvārānvitaścaivākāśavimānasaṃśritaḥ ।। 2 ।।
gopasamūharakṣāḍhyo dvārapālasamanvitaḥ ।
prāsādā ratnakhacitā bahubhogyārthasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 3 । ।
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvapaṃcāśatkoṭigopikāḥ ।
santi vasanti tatratyaprāsādeṣu ca tāḥ priyāḥ ।। 4 ।।
tatrāśramāśca bhaktānāṃ gopānāṃ śatakoṭayaḥ ।
vṛkṣavallībhogyajātaprapūritasukhapradāḥ ।। 5 ।।
tato'pyadhikavistārā ratnamaṇicamatkṛtāḥ ।
āśramāḥ pārṣadānāṃ ca bhavanti daśakoṭayaḥ । । 6 । ।
,sarvasiddhiprapūrṇāśca na nyūnaṃ vidyate'pyaṇu ।
dvādaśahāyanāḥ kanyāḥ kumārāḥ ṣoḍaśābdikāḥ ।। 7 । ।
tato'pi pārṣadavarāḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpadhāriṇaḥ ।
prāsādakṛtavāsāste vartante koṭiśo'pare । । 8 । ।
naiteṣāṃ śrīkṛṣṇavāsānnivāse nyūnatā'lpikā ।
prāsādādā rādhikāśuddhabhaktagopījanairyutāḥ ।। 9 ।।
ratnamaṇisvarṇakṛtā dvātriṃśatkoṭayo'pare ।
rādhābhaktapragopīṇāṃ kiṃkarīṇāṃ tathā gṛhāḥ ।। 1.121.10 । ।
bhavanāni vicitrāṇi santi vai daśakoṭayaḥ ।
divyāḥ svarṇamayā ratnamaṇihīrakanirmitāḥ ।। 11 ।।
golokāntargatāḥ sarve prāsādāḥ santi kāmadāḥ ।
śatajanmatapaḥpūtā haribhaktiratāśca ye ।। 12।।
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvā rādhākṛṣṇetijāpakāḥ ।
yānti golokadhāmaite prākāre pravasanti ca ।। 1 3।।
teṣāṃ nivāsāḥ sadratnamaṇimāṇikyanirmitāḥ ।
puṣpaśayyāpuṣpamālāśvetacāmaraśobhitāḥ ।। 14।।
ratnadarpaṇaśobhāḍhyā harinmaṇipraśobhitāḥ ।
amūlyaratnakalaśavrātaprānvitaśekharāḥ ।। 15।।
amoghavīryasaṃbhṛtadivyapuṣṭaśararikāḥ ।
gopagopīgaṇā bhaktāḥ sūkṣmavastravibhūṣaṇāḥ ।। 16।।
vividhā'mṛtabhogāśca vasanti koṭikoṭayaḥ ।
tato madhye mahodyāne rāseśvaryāḥ paro mahān ।। 17।।
āśramo vartate vyasto rādhāyāḥ smṛtisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
devādhidevyā gopīnāṃ varāyāścārunirmitaḥ ।। 18।।
prāṇādhikāyāḥ kṛṣṇasya ramyadravyamanoharaḥ ।
sucāruvartulākāraḥ ṣaḍgavyūtipramāṇakaḥ ।। 19।।
śatamandirasaṃyukto jvalito ratnatejasā ।
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ cayairviracito varaḥ ।।1.121.20।।
durlaṃghyābhirgabhīrābhiḥ parikhābhiḥ suśobhitaḥ ।
kalpavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtāḥ puṣpodyānaśatāntaraḥ ।।।2 1 ।।
sumūlyaratnakhacitaprākāreṇa suveṣṭitaḥ ।
sadratnavedikāgarbhasaptadvāraiḥ suśobhitaḥ ।।22।।
vartulaḥ sumahāँstatra tūdyāno vartate'bhitaḥ ।
sarvatastatra tatrāpi vṛkṣavallīsamanvitaḥ ।।23 ।।
āntarodyānamadhye'tra prākāro vartate'paraḥ ।
sarvatastatra tatrāpi ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyutaḥ ।। 24।।
sahasradhanurūrdhvotthaḥ kalaśaśṛṃgamaṇḍitaḥ ।
tejasā prajvalan ramyo vimānaśatamaṇḍitaḥ ।।25।।
prākāraṃ paritastaṃ ca kṛṣṇaprāsādasadṛśāḥ ।
gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca śatasaudhamitāśramāḥ ।।26।।
prākārāntargatastatrodyāno divyaphalānvitaḥ ।
divyapuṣpānvitaścaiva divyavārisukuṇḍakaḥ ।।27।।
divyaṃ sarovaraṃ ramyaṃ vartate tatra dakṣiṇe ।
tattīre nṛpasaudho'sti yatra nṛtyanti nartakāḥ ।। 20।।
sutānaṃ cārusaṃgītaṃ rādhākṛṣṇaguṇānvitam ।
gāyanti gītapīyūṣaṃ vādakā gāyakāstathā ।।29।।
nānāveṣadharāstatra gopikāśca manoharāḥ ।
sthāne sthāne pradṛśyante kṛṣṇaprasādalālasāḥ ।।1.121.3 0।।
kāścinmṛdaṃgahastāśca kāścidvīṇākarāstathā ।
kāściccāmarahastāśca karatālakarāḥ parāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
kāścid vāditrahastāśca kāścinnūpuraśobhitāḥ ।
kiṃkiṇībhūṣaṇaiḥ kāścicchabdayanti tu maṇḍapam ।।32।।
kāścitkuṃbhān gṛhītvā tu karayormastake tathā ।
puṃveśanāyikāstatra nṛtyanti bahuvedhataḥ ।।33।।
kuṣṇaveśadharāḥ kāścid rādhāveśadharāḥ parāḥ ।
kāściddūraṃ sthitāḥ kāścit kṛṣṇāliṃganatatparāḥ ।।34।।
krīḍāsaktāśca gopyastāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajanta ityapi ।
tatpārśve sarasastīre saudhāḥ santi varā varāḥ ।।35।।
rādhāsakhīnāṃ te gehā vartante bhavyadarśanāḥ ।
trayastriṃśadvayasyāstā rādhāyāḥ pūrayauvanāḥ ।।36।।
rūpeṇaiva guṇenaiva veṣeṇa yauvanena ca ।
saubhāgyenaiva vayasā sadṛśyo rādhayā ca tāḥ ।।37।।
nāmāni śṛṇu girije trayastriṃśattu mukhyataḥ ।
candrakalā suśīlā ca yamunā mādhavī ratiḥ ।।38।।
kadambamālā sukuntī jāhnavī ca svayaṃprabhā ।
padmamukhī ca sāvitrī gāyatrī sumukhī sudhā ।।39।।
padmālayā pārijātā sugaurī sarvamaṃgalā ।
kālikā kamalā durgā bhāratī ca sarasvatī ।।1.121.40 ।।
gaṃgā'mbikā madhumatī campā'parṇā ca sundarī ।
kṛṣṇapriyā brahmasatī nandinī nandanā tathā ।।41।।
etāsāṃ tāni saudhāni kṛṣṇasaudhasamāni hi ।
ratnadhātubhogyavastusvarṇakalaśavanti vai ।।42।।
yatra yatra kanyakāśca gopyaḥ sakhyaśca gopakāḥ ।
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvāstatra tatra gṛhe gṛhe ।।42 ।।
naikarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇo vartate ramate tayā ।
tayā tayā ca preyasyā tena tena ca sarvathā ।।44।।
rādhākṛṣṇasya saudhasya ye prākāre tu ṣoḍaśa ।
gopurāḥ santi tatrādirgopuro maṇiratnajaḥ ।।45।।
vedikāyugmasaṃyukto vajraratnakapāṭakaḥ ।
vartate dvārapastatra vīrabhānuḥ suyauvanaḥ ।।46 ।।
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।
pītāmbaradharo ratnamukuṭojjvalamastakaḥ ।।47।।
yasyājñāyāṃ sārdhadvayalakṣagopā bhavanti hi ।
dvitīye gopure tatra tato'pyadhikasundare ।।48।।
dvārapālaścandrabhānuḥ kiśoraḥ śyāmalo'sti hi ।
svarṇavetradharo ratnasiṃhāsanasamasthitaḥ ।।49 ।।
yasyājñāyāṃ paṃcalakṣagopā vartanta īśvarāḥ ।
tṛtīye gopure tatra tato'timaṇitaijase ।।1.121.50।।
dvārapālaḥ sūryabhānuḥ kiśoro muralīdharaḥ ।
ratnadaṇḍakaraḥ svarṇamaṇikuṇḍalarājitaḥ ।।51 ।।
yasyājñāyāṃ navalakṣagopāḥ śyāmalasundarāḥ ।
caturthe gopure tebhyo vilakṣaṇavibhūṣite ।।52।।
vasubhānurdvārapālaḥ kiśoro'sti vrajeśvaraḥ ।
maṇidaṇḍadharo ratnasiṃhāsanakṛtāsanaḥ ।।53 ।।
pakvabimbādharauṣṭhaśca sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ ।
yasyājñāyāṃ navalakṣagopāḥ santi manoharāḥ ।।54।।
paṃcame gopure vajrabhitticitrapracitrake ।
dvārapālo devabhānuścārusiṃhāsanasthitaḥ ।।55।।
mayūrapicchacūḍaśca ratnamālāsukuṇḍalaḥ ।
yasyājñāyāṃ daśalakṣagopāḥ santi vyavasthitāḥ ।।56।।
ṣaṣṭhe tu gopure vajrabhittikapāṭaśobhite ।
dvārapālaḥ śukrabhānuḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।।57।।
yasyājñāyāṃ daśalakṣagopāḥ santi vyavasthitāḥ ।
saptame gopure ṣaḍbhyaścātiśobhe vilakṣaṇe ।।58।।
dvārapo ratnabhānuḥ śrīhareḥ priyatamo yuvā ।
puṣpacandanabhūṣāḍhyo siṃhāsanasthavetradhṛk ।।59।।
yasyājñāyāṃ tu vartante gopā dvādaśalakṣakāḥ ।
aṣṭame gopure tebhyaḥ saptabhyo'pi vilakṣaṇe ।।1.121.6 0।।
dvārapālaḥ supārśvo'sti ratnadaṇḍasubhūṣaṇaḥ ।
ratnakuṇḍalaśobhāḍhyo bandhujīvā'dharauṣṭhakaḥ ।।61 ।।
yasyājñāyāṃ sadā santi gopā dvādaśalakṣakāḥ ।
navame gopure vajraratnāḍhye citramālake ।।62।।।
dauvārikaḥ subalo'sti lalitākṛtibhūṣaṇaḥ ।
yasyājñāyāṃ tathā santi gopā dvādaśalakṣakāḥ ।।63।।
daśame gopure ramye'nirvācyavarṇane pare ।
dvārapastu sudāmā'sti kṛṣṇatulyamanoharaḥ ।।64।।
daṇḍahasto yadājñāyāṃ gopā viṃśatilakṣakāḥ ।
ekādaśe gopure sucitraramye tathādbhute ।।65।।
dvārapālaḥ śrīdāmā'sti ratnasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ ।
pītavastradharo'mūlyabhūṣācandanaśobhitaḥ ।।66 ।।
kuṇḍalakaṭakapuṣpamālāmukuṭasūjjvalaḥ ।
yasyājñāyāṃ koṭigopāstena rājendrasadṛśaḥ ।।67।।
dvādaśe gopure'mūlyaratnavedicatuṣṭaye ।
vicitracitrasadvajrabhitticitramanohare ।।68।।
dvārapāstatra gopyo vai santyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।
navayauvanasampannāḥ kabarībhārabhūṣitāḥ ।।69।।
pītaraktādyambarāstāḥ sugandhipuṣpadhammilāḥ ।
ratnasvarṇamaṇibhūṣābhūṣitāḥ svarṇakaṃkaṇāḥ ।।1.121.70 ।।
keyūranūpurakuṇḍalyāgryaśobhitavigrahāḥ ।
pīnaśroṇībharānamrā nitambabhāramantharāḥ ।। 71 ।।
śatagopyo hareḥ preṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhāstiṣṭhanti gopure ।
tāsāṃ tu sevikāḥ koṭigopyaḥ santi haripriyāḥ ।।72।।
trayodaśe caturdaśe paṃcadaśe ca gopure ।
gopyastu dvārapāḥ santi prodbhinnanavayauvanāḥ ।।।73 ।।
śreṣṭhā manoharā ramyā varā dhanyāḥ suśobhanāḥ ।
rādhāpriyāḥ subhūṣāḍhyāḥ kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamaṃgalāḥ ।।74।।
koṭyabjagopikāstāsāmājñākaryo bhavanti hi ।
ṣoḍaśe gopure mukhyāstrayastriṃśattu gopikāḥ ।।75।।
santi tu dvārapāstāsāṃ rūpaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate ।
na pārvatī na vai lakṣmīrnorvaśī rādhikā kimu ।।76 ।।
tādṛśyastā ratnabhūṣābhūṣitā dṛḍhayauvanāḥ ।
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūrasvarṇanūpurabhūṣitāḥ ।।77।।
sakiṃkiṇīraśanābhirmadhyadeśe subhūṣitāḥ ।
ratnakuṇḍalatejobhirgaṇḍasthalasamujjvalāḥ ।।78 ।।
praphullamālatīmālāmaṇihārādiśobhitāḥ ।
śaratpārvaṇacandrārhamukhamaṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ ।।79।।
pārijātaprasūnādimālāhāralasatstanāḥ ।
pakvabimbādharauṣṭhyaśca smerānanasaroruhāḥ ।।1.121.8 0 ।।
pakvadāḍimabījāgryakundadantasupaṃktayaḥ ।
svarṇacampakasadvarṇāstanūdaryaḥ kaṭikṛśāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
gajamauktikasaṃsaktasvarṇavālikanāsikāḥ ।
śukacañcunimnanāsāḥ kaṭhinastanabandhanāḥ ।।82।।
-pīnaśroṇībharāḥ kṛṣṇacaraṇāsaktamānasāḥ ।
svarṇatārāñcitadīrghapaṭakapāṭatoraṇe ।।।83 ।।
gopure vedikāyukte tāstiṣṭhanti haripriyāḥ ।
gopurāntaḥsthalaṃ sarvaṃ maṇiratnādibhūṣitam ।।84।।
haritsindūramaṇibhirbhittidvayavirājitam ।
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālābhiśca suvāsitam ।।85।।
tadantastatra puṣpāṇāmudyāno vartate mahān ।
tatra rādhāmahāsaudhaḥ kṛṣṇamandirameva saḥ ।।86 ।।
mandirāṇāṃ ca madhyasthaḥ śataśālo manoharaḥ ।
vimānaiḥ saptakaiḥ kāmyaiḥ śālāsu gamyate tu saḥ ।।87। ।
kevalaiḥ ratnasāraiśca racito divya eva saḥ ।
nānāratnamaṇistambhairvajrayuktaiśca bhūṣitaḥ ।।88।।
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiśca rājitaḥ ।
muktāmāṇikyahīrakakṛtabhittimanoharaḥ ।।89।।
śvetacāmaradarpaṇavyajanaiḥ kalaśairyutaḥ ।
paṭṭasūtragranthiyuktaśrīkhaṇḍapallavānvitaḥ ।।1.121.90।।
maṇistaṃbhasamūhaiśca ramyaprāṃgaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।।
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
śuṣkadhānyaśuklapuṣpapravālaphalataṇḍulaiḥ ।
parṇadurvā'kṣatalājākuṃbhahāravirājitaḥ ।।92।।
vividhagandhasaṃsaktapavanaiḥ surabhīkṛtaḥ ।
adṛṣṭā'śrutamagryaṃ yad brahmāṇḍe durlabhaṃ ca yat ।।93।।
tattadvastuśobhitaśca prāsādo rādhikākṛte ।
ratnamaṃcāḥ sulalitāḥ sūkṣmavastraparicchadāḥ ।।94।।
koṭiśo ratnakubhāśca ratnapātrāṇi santi vai ।
amūlyacāruvividhatattadvastuvibhūṣitaḥ ।।95।।
nānāprakāravādyānāṃ miṣṭanādairnināditaḥ ।
svarayantraiśca vīṇābhirgopīsaṃgitasuśrutaḥ ।।96।।
mohano vādyaśabdaiśca gāyikāgītibhistathā ।
gopānāṃ kṛṣṇatulyānāṃ samūhaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।।97।।
rādhāsakhīnāṃ gopīnāṃ bahuvṛndairvirājitaḥ ।
rādhākṛṣṇaguṇodrekapadasaṃgītasuśrutaḥ ।।98।।
śrūyate madhuraṃ gītaṃ dṛśyate nṛtyamuttamam ।
āpyate paramānandaḥ kṛṣṇalīlāraso'drije! ।।99।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne golokaprākāraprāsādodyānāntaḥpuraprākāraprāsādodyānaṣoḍaśagopuradvārapālādivarṇananāmaikaviṃśatyadhika-
śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 121 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 121 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 122
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 123 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu priye! tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ prāha svasya priyāṃ satīm ।
rādhikākṛṣṇaprāsāde ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ varam ।। 1 ।।
dhanuḥ śatapramāṇaṃ ca parito vartulākṛti ।
uccāvacaiḥ svarṇaghaṭaiḥ śobhitaṃ śikharādiṣu ।। 2 ।।
divyabhaktāputtalikāpremadāsīprabhūṣitam ।
koṭyarkadyutisaṃvyāptaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ saptatālavat ।। 3 ।।
'dbhutaṃ sarvatejasvipadārthādhikasundaram ।
tejastejo'mbaraṃ tejorāśistejaḥkhanipratham ।। 4 ।।
divyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tadvai yatheṣṭaṃ vyomni gacchati ।
siṃhapādaṃ vallicitrāṇyanantagopagopikāḥ ।। 5 ।।
gāvo vatsā vatsataryastathā bhaktā priyāstathā ।
siṃhāsane ca sopāne staṃbhe dvāri ca toraṇe ।। 6 ।।
vādakā nartakāścaiva gāyakāḥ pārśvabhāgake ।
puttalikāsvarūpāste klṛptāḥ sarve vibhānti vai ।। 7 ।।
mayūrāḥ sārasā haṃsāścātakāḥ śukamenakāḥ ।
śubhāḥ puttalikāścaitā yathāsthānaṃ vyavasthitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
divye siṃhāsane tejorāśau kṛṣṇo virājate ।
varo vareṇyo varado varadānāṃ ca kāraṇam ।। 9 ।।
sarvamaṃgaladaḥ sākṣānmaṃgalānāṃ sumaṃgalam ।
nirlepaśca nirīhaśca ḍhivyaiśvaryaguṇāśrayaḥ ।। 1.122.10 ।।
sanātanaśca sākāraḥ kalāvibhūtidhārakaḥ ।
sarvādhāraḥ sarvarūpaḥ sarvabījo hyatīndriyaḥ ।। 11 ।।
jaḍacetanadehaśca svatantradivyamūrtikaḥ ।
sarvasākṣī sarvadarśī saccidānanda īśvaraḥ ।। 12 ।।
sarveśo'nādinidhano vidhātā janakaḥ pitā ।
ekaikaromavivare brahmāṇḍamekamekakam ।। 1 3।।
yasyaiva mahato viṣṇoḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśajaḥ ।
yaṃ vai dhyāyanti yogajñāḥ sevante dāsatāṃ gatāḥ ।। 14।।
kiśoraḥ sundarataraḥ kāntānāṃ kamanīyakaḥ ।
navīnajaladaśyāmaḥ pītāmbaradharo varaḥ ।। 15।।
dvibhujo muralīhastaḥ sasmitaḥ sumanoharaḥ ।
mayūrapicchacūḍaśca mālatīmālamaṇḍitaḥ ।। 16।।
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitaḥ ।
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ sārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।। 17।।
amūlyaratnaracitakirīṭamukuṭojjvalaḥ ।
śaratpraphullapadmānāṃ prabhāmoṣyāsyacandrakaḥ ।। 18।।
pakvabimbasamānena hyadharauṣṭhena rājitaḥ ।
pakvadāḍimabījābhadantapaṃktimanoharaḥ ।। 1 9।।
susmitaparamāhlādaḥ trailokyacittamohanaḥ ।
gaṇḍasthalakapolābhyāṃ jvalanmakarakuṇḍalaḥ ।।1.122.20 ।।
sadratnanūpurābhyāṃ ca caraṇāṃbhojarājitaḥ ।
vahniśuddhaharidrābhāmūlyavastravirājitaḥ ।।21 ।।
maṇisvarṇādidivyābhūṣaṇavaryairvibhūṣitaḥ ।
vinodamuralīyuktabimbādharamanoharaḥ ।।22।।
prasannatāprapūrṇaśca bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ।
sadratnaguṭikāyuktakavacoraḥsthalojjvalaḥ ।।23।।
kaustubhāsaktasadratnapradīptatejasojjvalaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sa parabrahma kiśoro dīvyati prabhuḥ ।।।24।।
tasya vāme tu cārvaṃgī sakhī tiṣṭhati rādhikā ।
paśyantaṃ sasmitaṃ kāntaṃ paśyantī vakracakṣuṣā ।।25।।।
muktāpaṃktiparotkarṣadantapaṃktivirājitā ।
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā śaratpaṃkajalocanā ।।26।।
śaratpārvaṇacandrātirekabhā''syamanoramā ।
bandhujīvapramādhikyādharauṣṭharucirānanā ।।27।।
raṇanmaṃjīrayugmena pādāmbujavirājitā ।
maṇīndrāṇāṃ prabhāmoṣanararājivirājitā ।।28।।
kuṃkumābhāsamācchādya padādhorāgabhūṣitā ।
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ raśanāśroṇibhūṣitā ।।।29।।
hutāśanaviśuddhāṃśukā'mūlyajvalitojjvalā
mahāmaṇīndrasārāṇāṃ kiṃkiṇīmadhyasaṃyutā ।।1.122.30 ।।
sadratnahārakeyūrakarakakaṃṇabhūṣitā ।
ratnendrasāraracitakapolojjvalakuṇḍalā ।। 3 1।।
karṇopari maṇīndrāṇāṃ karṇabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।
khagendracañcunāsāgragajendramauktikānvitā ।।32।।।
mālatīmālayā vakrakabarībhāraśobhitā ।
mālayā kaustubhendrāṇāṃ vakṣaḥsthalasuśobhitā ।।33।।
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājvālojjvalāṃbarā ।
ratnāṃgulīyanikaraiḥ karāṃgulivibhūṣitā ।।34।।
prataptasvarṇavarṇābhā kanakojjvalavigrahā ।
nitambaśroṇilalitā pīnastanasuśobhitā ।।35।।
saundaryabhūṣitā sarvairbhūṣaṇaiścāpi bhūṣitā ।
padmapatradīrghanetrā premabhārasumantharā ।।36।।
kṛṣṇakāmanidhānāsā sarvayauvanasāgarā ।
sarvarūpaparākāṣṭhā dhavalā raktasūjjvalā ।।37।।
premapravāhaprasaratkṛṣṇacittamanoharā ।
kṛṣṇasparśaṃ vinā naiva kṣaṇamātraṃ kṛtasthitiḥ ।।।38।।
kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā naiva kāntā tiṣṭhati kevalā ।
ityeva śobhayā yuktau rādhākṛṣṇau pratiṣṭhataḥ ।। 39।।
divye siṃhāsane tatra rājādhirājaśobhayā ।
kiṃ vai nyūnaṃ bhagavato bhagavatyāḥ samāgame ।।1.122.40।।
pūrṇasya brahmaṇaḥ pūrṇabrahmaṇyāḥ kā nvapūrṇatā ।
goloke tiṣṭhatāṃ yadvai kṣaṇaṃ yāti sukhāvaham ।।41 ।।
tanmātre tu kṣitau yānti saptamanvantarāṇi vai ।
tādṛśe sarvadādīrghānandabhūmau tu tatra vai ।।42।।।
gāvaḥ surabhayaḥ kāmadhenavo nīlagovṛṣāḥ ।
caturdantā hastinaśca śvetāḥ svarṇādibhūṣaṇāḥ ।।42 ।।
pramadavarṣiṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhihāyanā vyomagāminaḥ ।
śyāmakarṇāśca turagāḥ sapakṣā vyomasaṃcarāḥ ।। 44।।
mayūragaruḍahaṃsāśca śukasārasamenakāḥ ।
vividhāḥ pakṣiṇastatra vṛkṣāvallyaśca bhūriśaḥ ।।49।।
ḍaṃkāniśānāḥ śibikāguptakātāvadānakāḥ ।
mānavavāhāḥ śataśo nijecchāvāhanāni ca ।।46।।
vividhāḥ smṛtayastatra vāyvaptejāṃsi sevakāḥ ।
ṛtavaśca rasagandhaśabdarūpādisevakāḥ ।।47।।
upatiṣṭhanti goloke yatheṣṭaṃ bhogalabdhaye ।
divyā rathā vyomagāśca divyāstādṛgvibhūtayaḥ ।। 48 ।।
kiṃ vai divyasya kṛṣṇasyā'divyaṃ vai saṃbhavettadā ।
kṛṣṇo divyo mahārājo divyā rājñī ca rādhikā ।।49 ।।
virajā dravadivyā vai pārṣadā gopagopikāḥ ।
prāsādā vastumūrdhanyāḥ sarve divyā vasanti hi ।। 1.122.50 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇasya rathastatra rājata divyavigrahaḥ ।
maṇiratnendrasāreṇa hīrakeṇa vibhūṣitaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
śvetacāmaralakṣeṇa śobhito darpaṇā'yutaiḥ ।
sūkṣmakāṣāyavastreṇa vahniśuddhena bhūṣitaḥ ।।52।।।
sadratnakalaśānāṃ ca sahasreṇa suśobhitaḥ ।
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālāsaṃghairvirājitaḥ ।।।53 ।।
pārṣadapravarairyuktaḥ śātakuṃbhamayaḥ śubhaḥ ।
tejastejaḥsvarūpaśca śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ ।।54।।
kṛṣṇaḥ kvacidrathe tatra nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ।
bhūtvā tiṣṭhati lokādvai lokāntaraṃ pragacchati ।। 55 ।।
tadā sa puruṣaḥ śyāmaḥ sundaraḥ kamanīyakaḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ pītāmbarāmbaraḥ ।। 56।।
kirīṭī kuṇḍalī divyavanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ।
candanāgarukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitaḥ ।।57।।
caturbhujaḥ smeravaktro bhaktānugrahakātaraḥ ।
maṇiratnendrasārāṇāṃ sārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।।58 ।।
mahālakṣmyā mahādevyā sarvadā kṛtasevanaḥ ।
bhavatyaiśvaryadhṛksarvadevadevīpravanditaḥ ।। 59 ।।
tadvāme ca rathe ramye śuklavarṇā pratiṣṭhati ।
ratnālaṃkāraśobhāḍhyā śobhitā pītavāsasā ।। 1.122.60 ।।
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyā śaratpakajalocanā ।
pakvabimbādharauṣṭhī ca smerānanā ca kāmadā ।।61।।
veṇuvīṇāgranthahastā bhaktānugrahakātarā ।
vidyādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca jñānarūpā sarasvatī ।।।62।।
dakṣiṇe tu supārśve vai śatacandrasamaprabhā ।
prataptasvarṇavarṇābhā sasmitā sumanoharā ।।63।।
sadratnakuḍalābhyāṃ ca sukapolavirājitā ।
amūlyaratnakhacitā'mūlyavastreṇa bhūṣitā ।।64।।
amūlyaratnakeyūrakarakaṃkaṇaśobhitā ।
sadratnasāramaṃjīrakalaśabdasamanvitā ।।65।।
maṇīndrakiṃkiṇīguṃjanmadhyakaṭisamanvitā ।
pārijātādipuṣpāṇāṃ hārairvakṣasthalojjvalā ।।66 ।।
praphullamālatīmālāprotakabarikāyutā ।
śaraccandrātitejasvimukhamaṇḍalaśobhitā ।।67।।
kastūrībindusammadhyasindūratilakānvitā ।
sucārukajjalaśliṣṭaśaratpaṃkajalocanā ।।68।।
sahasradalaśobhāḍhyamahatkamalahastagā ।
nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyantī vakracakṣuṣā ।।69।।
tiṣṭhanto rathamadhye'pi viharanti trayo'pi te ।
anyo'pi surathastasya nirmito viśvakarmaṇā ।।1.122.70 ।।
paṃcāśadyojanordhvaśca caturyojanavistaraḥ ।
svarṇasāravikāraśca nānāratnaparicchadaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
maṇīndrasārasaṃyukto vahniśuddhāṃśukānvitaḥ ।
śvetacāmarasaṃyukto bhūṣito darpaṇānvitaḥ । ।72।।
sadratnasārakalaśo mālāhāravirājitaḥ ।
sahasracakrasaṃyukto manoyāyī manoharaḥ ।।73।।
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍatulyatejāḥ sudarśanaḥ ।
muktāmāṇikyavajrādihīrakaiśca samujjvalaḥ ।।74।।
citraputtalikāpuṣpasaraḥkānanacitritaḥ ।
ratiyogyavadhūyuktaḥ śobhate ratimandiraiḥ ।।75।।
tatra śrīkṛṣṇasevārthaṃ mahāmāyā'pi tiṣṭhati ।
svarṇasārātisatkāntiratnālaṃkārabhūṣitā ।।76।।
mahātejo'dhikakāntā prabhāvāridhisadṛśī ।
sahasrabhujasaṃyuktā nānā''yudhādidhāriṇī ।।77।।
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā kṛṣṇakelikṛte sthitā ।
gaṇḍasthalakapolasthasvarṇaratnasukuṇḍalā ।।78।।
ratnendrasāraracitakvaṇanmaṃjīramaṃjulā ।
sanmaṇinaddhasauvarṇaraśanākaṭiśobhitā ।।79।।
ratnāktasvarṇakaṭakakeyūraśṛṃkhalānvitā ।
mandārakalpaprasūnamālārājivirājitā ।।1.122.80।।
nitambakaṭhinaśroṇīkarkaśastanabhaṃgurā ।
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyā tejaḥparidhisūjjvalā ।।8 1।।
satkajjalaraktarekhānvitapaṃkajalocanā ।
cāndanakaisaradravyakṛtapatralalāṭikā ।।82।।
muktādāḍimakundābhaśubhradantavirājitā ।
vibhinnapuṣpakabarīyuktadhammilamantharā ।।।83।।
śukagaruḍacañcvābhanāsānimnatvaśobhitā ।
sāmudraphenasaiṃhādimauktikadhṛtamālikā ।।84।।
ujjvalāmbarakaṃcukīsvarṇatārasucandrakā ।
kṛtordhvatilakā devyastathānyāḥ santi sevane ।।85।।
rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca tathā jāmbavatī priyā ।
kālindī mitravindā ca satyabhāmā tathā'parā ।।86।।
bhadrā ca lakṣmaṇā ceti mahiṣyastatra santi vai ।
śataṃ ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ patnīnāṃ maṃḍalaṃ mahat ।।87।।
kṛṣṇasevāṃ prakurvadvai rājate kṛṣṇasannidhau ।
anyāsāmapi nāntosti sarvaṃ kṛṣṇavaśaṃ jagat ।।88।।
ekaviṃśatyabjagopyaḥ kṛṣṇasyaiva bhavanti vai ।
anyāścāpi na saṃkhyātāḥ sarvaṃ taddāsyavadyataḥ ।।89।।
trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca hyaṣṭapaṭṭāṃganāstathā ।
rādhā ceti pramukhyā vai bhavanti gokule priyāḥ ।।1.122.90। ।
vasudevo devakī ca nando yaśovatī tathā ।
uddhavaḥ sātyakirgargo'krūraścānye ca sātvatāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
gokule tu prahāre- tattatprākārabhūmiṣu ।
sodyāneṣu mahādivyaprāsādeṣu vasanti vai ।।92।।
kṛṣṇasamānasaṃbhogā na kiṃcinnyūnamasti hi ।
kṛṣṇāśritasakhīnāṃ tu bhramaṇārthaṃ mahānrathaḥ ।।।93।।
caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ ūrdhve ca pañcayojanaḥ ।
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśo ratnasāravinirmitaḥ ।।94।।
amlānapārijātānāṃ mālājālavirājitaḥ ।
maṇīnāṃ kaustubhānāṃ ca bhūṣaṇena vibhūṣitaḥ ।।95।।
amūlyaratnakalaśo hīrahāravirājitaḥ ।
manoharaiḥ pariṣvaktaḥ sahasrakoṭimandiraiḥ ।।96।।
sahasradvayacakraśca sahasradvayaghoṭakaḥ ।
sūkṣmavastrācchāditaśca gopīkoṭibhirāvṛtaḥ ।।97।।
kimanyadvarṇaye tasya kṛṣṇasya śrīhareḥ prabhoḥ ।
mahānasāni ramyāṇi bhojyāgārāṇi yāni ca ।।98।।
snānāgārāṇi śṛmagārabhūṣāgārāṇi yāni ca ।
kelyāgārāṇi mitrāṇāṃ sabhāgārāṇi vai tathā ।।99।।
nṛtyāgārāṇi ca samājotsavāgārakāṇyapi ।
krīḍāgārāṇi ca vihāraratyāgārakāṇi ca ।। 1.122.100।।
śayyāgārāṇi sucandraśālāḥ sahasrabhūmayaḥ ।
yāni yānyeva santyatra nānyadhāmasu tāni vai ।। 101 ।।
svayaṃ śrīhariṇā kṛṣṇarūpeṇa sukhadena vai ।
sukhadānāya bhaktānāṃ nārīṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ।। 1 02।।
dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ rājasaṃ cāmoghavīryaṃ balaṃ hi tat ।
tatra kiṃ nāma vaktavyaṃ nyūnaṃ svalpaṃ ca vā nahi ।। 10 3।।
paripūrṇasya sarvatra kā nāmā'pūrṇatayā bhavet ।
iti te kathitaṃ devi! kiñcidgolokamaṇḍalam ।। 1 04।।
sarvathā naiva vaktuṃ vai ceṣṭe kṛṣṇo'pi tat svayam ।
ya imaṃ kṛṣṇagolokaṃ śroṣyati vā paṭhiṣyati ।। 1 05।।
sudurlabhāṃ dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇe sa hi lapsyate ।
aṇimādikasiddhiṃ ca sālokyādicatuṣṭayam ।। 106।।
ihaiva kṛṣṇatulyatvaṃ vāksiddhiṃ ca yaśo mahat ।
putraṃ vidyāṃ kavitvaṃ ca niścalāṃ kamalāṃ tathā ।। 1 07।।
patnīṃ pativratāṃ sādhvīṃ suśīlāṃ susthirāṃ prajām ।
kīrtiṃ ca cirakālīnāṃ tvante kṛṣṇāntike gatim ।। 1 08।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ratnasiṃhāsanaśrīkṛṣṇarādhikātatsmṛddhirathacaturbhujarūpasarasvatīmahāmāyārūpamahālakṣmīrādhāśata-
sahasrāṣṭapaṭṭāṃganātatsaudhādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāya ।। 122।।

adhyāyaḥ 123
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 124 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrutvā golokasaṃsthānaṃ pārvatī bahuharṣitā ।
śrotuṃ divyāṃ kathāmuktvā prāha vai śaṃkaraṃ varam ।। 1 ।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrotumicchāmi divyaṃ dhāma ramākṛte ।
nārāyaṇena divyaṃ yannirmitaṃ śrīdhareṇa vai ।। 2 ।।
śrutvedaṃ yuktayogīndro mahādevo'smaraddharim ।
nārāyaṇaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā dṛṣṭvā vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।। 3 ।।
varṇayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ kramaśo bhaktibhāvataḥ ।
śṛṇu me vaiṣṇavi patni varṇane svādyate rasaḥ ।। 4 ।।
rasaṃ vinā harerbhakteḥ rasāścānye mṛṣā matāḥ ।
tripādvibhūterlokā vai hyasaṃkhyātā bhavanti hi ।। 5 ।।
brahmadhāmamayāḥ sarve brahmānandasukhāśrayāḥ ।
śāśvatā nirvikārāśca heyadoṣavivarjitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
sarve divyasuvarṇābhāḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhāḥ ।
nārāyaṇapadāṃbhojabhaktisadrasasevitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
bhagavatsāmagānādipūrṇasukhapradā matāḥ ।
sumūrtapārṣadamuktavedaśāstrādivarṇitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
divyavidyātmanārībhirbrahmapuṃbhiradhiṣṭhitāḥ ।
premajñānasucidrasasarobhirupaśobhitāḥ ।। 9 ।।
śrutyākhyapramadābhiśca smṛtyākhyastrījanaistathā ।
śāstrākhyadivyapuruṣaiḥ sarvadāvāsavardhitāḥ ।। 1.123.10 ।।
sarvaṃ vai brahmalokeṣu bhogyaṃ bhojyaṃ tathā param ।
cetanaṃ brahmatattvotthaṃ caitanyaṃ tveva vidyate ।। 11 ।।
na māyā na jaḍaṃ kiṃcinna duḥkhaṃ naiva nāśavat ।
na tamo na samutpannaṃ na nāśi kintu śāśvatam ।। 1 2 ।।
akṣarabrahmaṇaḥ sīmni yathā golokasaṃsthitiḥ ।
tathā'kṣaradhāmasīmni vaikuṃṭhasyāpi saṃsthitiḥ ।। 13 ।।
māyāpāre mahādivyā patnī vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ।
nārāyaṇasya premṇo vai samyakpātraṃ hi yā matā ।। 14।।
nārāyaṇa raterbhaktyā hyatyānande kṛtā''plavā ।
svabhānaṃ vismṛtavatī dravarūpā hyajāyata ।। 15 ।।
nārāyaṇasya saṃyogāt kāmarase vilīnanāt ।
nārāyaṇasya mūrtau sā koṭyānandapravāhakaiḥ ।। 1 6।।
saraiḥ svasyāḥ svarūpairvā yunakti harimīśvaram ।
vilīnā bhavate nityamānandaparikāṣṭhitā ।। 1 7।।
haristāmānandasarairyunaktyapi nijātmani ।
tataḥ sā sarayūrūpā sarijjātā vikuṇṭhake ।। 18 ।।
māyāpāre ca sā divyā vartulā sumahānadī ।
brahmarasaprapūrṇā sā nityānandapravāhiṇī ।। 1 9।।
vartate svarṇamatsyā sā śreṣṭharajatavālukā ।
divyakāśakuśavyāptā sūryatejaḥsamojjvalā ।। 1.123.20 ।।
maṇihīrakaśuktyādicākacakyamanoharā ।
divyakiraṇasaṃyogātkoṭisūryasamaprabhā ।। 21 ।।
sadratnahīrakādyaiśca kṛtasopānaghaṭṭanā ।
viśālasnānakāyārhā'vatārā'saṃkhyabhūṣitā ।। 22 ।।
vaikuṇṭhavasatisnānavihārādisukhapradā ।
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśatīradvayasuśobhitā ।। 23 ।।
kṛṣṇaśubhraharidraktavicitramaṇibhāsurā ।
kutracidujjvalasaumyapravālasapaṭānvitā ।।24।।
kutracidrajatasvarṇaprabhṛtidhātusaṃdharā ।
kvacidindranīlapadmarāgākarasuśobhitā ।।25।।
kutracidvai mārakatamīṇeśreṣṭhakṛtastarā ।
kvacidvihārasnānādisthalībhirupaśobhitā ।।26 ।।
kutracicchādvalā ramyā vanarājivirājitā ।
kvacidvai kāmadhenūnāṃ maṇḍalaiḥ kṛtaviśramā ।।।27।।
vividhābhistu naukābhirdivyābhirbahudarśanā ।
divyagaruḍahaṃsādidevapakṣisamāśritā ।।28।।
yajjalenā'bhiṣiktā vai prāṇino nityarakṣaṇāḥ ।
muktā vaikuṇṭhalokasthā śāśvatā''vāsakāriṇaḥ ।।।29।।
bhavanti tattaṭe ramye vanaṃ kausalamasti vai ।
sarayūmanu taccāpi vartulākārameva ha ।।1.123.3 0 ।।
divyavṛkṣamayaṃ pārijātādibahusaddrumam ।
kalpavṛkṣakalpavalīdīrghavanavirājitam ।।3 1 ।।
dairghyaṃ parimitaṃ tasya tvarbudā'rbudayojanam ।
kvacitkalpadrumāḥ santi kvacidvai pārijātakāḥ ।। 32।।
kvacit saumarasā vallayaḥ kvacittvāmrā rasālakāḥ ।
kvacidvai madhukāḥ santi jambuvṛkṣāstvasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।।33।।
kvacittu karmadāḥ santi kvacit ṭimburupādapāḥ ।
śrīvṛkṣāṇāṃ samūhāśca tilakā gaganaspṛśaḥ ।।34।।
kvacittu navaraṃgāṇāṃ jambīrāṇāṃ ca jātayaḥ ।
santi kvacitkadalyo vai kvaciddāḍimapādapāḥ ।।35।।
kvacid drākṣālatā nāgavallyastiktasuvallikāḥ ।
kvacit tvagvṛkṣakā nārīkelakharjūrakhārikāḥ ।।36।।
kvacit seturapuṣpīyāḥ kvacid rāmaphalādayaḥ ।
badāmabadarīsarjapippalībakulādayaḥ ।।37।।
kvacitkesaravṛkṣāśca kadambanīpanimbakāḥ ।
panasāścampakāśokavṛkṣāścandanapādapāḥ ।।38।।
śrīphalaśālmalītālatintiḍīmādhavīdrumāḥ ।
mallikāmālatīsvarṇāyūthikā'śvatthakundakāḥ ।।39।।
santi vṛkṣā vividhā vai sarve vaikuṇṭhayoginaḥ ।
kvacitsarāṃsi satkūpāḥ pallavāni ca dīrghikāḥ ।।1.123.40 ।।
kvacit vividhāḥ sarito dugdhamiṣṭajalāvahāḥ ।
kvacicchṛṅgāṇi cādrīṇāṃ kvacitsthalyo vanaukasām ।।41 ।।
kvaciddevāṃganāramyavihārārthakṛtagṛhāḥ ।
anantāḥ sṛṣṭayastatra vane santi vanaukasām ।।42।।
nārāyaṇaprasaṃgena kalpe kalpāntare ca ye।
prāṇino muktimāpannāḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ ।।।43 ।।
muktāste kosale tatra vane vasanti śāśvatāḥ ।
nārāyāṇecchayā teṣāṃ kāmarūpatvamasti vai ।।44।।
kvacid yāne vimāne vā cāntarīkṣe prayānti hi ।।
kvacid devāḥ kvacinmuktāḥ kvacit tattatsujātayaḥ ।।45।।
bhavantyeva vasantyeva phalapānāditṛptikāḥ ।
divyā bhogapānarasāḥ phalāni vividhāni ca ।। 46 ।।
kausalyākhyavanasthānāṃ kṛte viṣṇuvinirmitāḥ ।
vane tatra sukuṃjāstu vṛkṣāṇāṃ santi bhūriśaḥ ।।47।।
vaṭānāṃ gundrakāṇāṃ cāmalakīnāṃ tathā śubhāḥ ।
kiṃśukodumbarāṇāṃ ca pippalānāṃ ghaṭāsu ca ।।48।।
śobhanāḥ svarṇasaṃkāśāḥ piśaṃgāḥ vallayastathā ।
vṛkṣeṣu lagnāḥ śobhante kuṃjārthaṃ kṛdvitānakāḥ ।।49।।
maṇḍapāḥ santi sadratnamaṇihīrakabhūmayaḥ ।
divyasopānasanmārgārohaṇārthavimānikāḥ ।।1.123.50 ।।
sahasrabhūmayaste vai gagane gatasudhvajāḥ ।
sūryakalaśasampannā vividhodyānasaṃvṛtāḥ ।।51 ।।
śītoṣṇajalakuṇḍāḍhyā vahnimaṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ ।
naisargikavasturamyā bhavanti kācadīpakāḥ ।।।52।।।
gāvastatra kāmadughā viharanti caranti ca ।
tathā vasatayo divyā vaikuṇṭhavanavāsinām ।।53।।
lakṣmyo ramāsamā rāmāḥ ṣoḍaśābdasuyauvanāḥ ।
surūpāḥ sasvāmikāśca svakuṭumbasamanvitāḥ ।।54।।
acyutagotrakāḥ sarvā vasanti bhaktimānasāḥ ।
krīḍāvihāraramyā''syavusībaṃkaṭamaṃcikāḥ ।।55 ।।
śayanārhavihārārharamaṇārhā bhavanti vai ।
saprākārāśca sodhānāḥ savārivahnisādhanāḥ ।।56।।
vyajanaiścāmarairyuktā naikadarpaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।
bhojanācchādanālāpanṛtyavādanamaṇḍitāḥ ।।।57।।
saudhāśca maṇḍapāḥ santi ratnapradīpasuprabhāḥ ।
dhūpāḥ sugandhinastatra kuṭīreṣu bhavanti vai ।।58।।
śṛgāradravapavanāḥ śītalā vānti saukhyadāḥ ।
ramaṇārthaṃ ramaṇīnāṃ cetanaṃ kausalaṃ vanam ।।।59।।
pañcāśatkoṭayastatra kuṃjakuṭīramaṇḍapāḥ ।
snātvā sarayvāṃ bhūtvā ca muktadeho vrajettataḥ ।।1.123.60 ।।
kausalaṃ tadvanaṃ ramyaṃ yadi sthātuṃ samīhate ।
tatraiva vāsamādāya ramate muktavaddhi saḥ ।।61 ।।
ito'pyagre mahārakṣāsthānaprākāra aiśvaraḥ ।
mahāprākāravaryaḥ sa bhavatyarbudayojanaḥ ।।62।।
vartulākāra evaiṣo lakṣayojanamūrdhvagaḥ ।
taducchraye mahādivyāḥ santi prāsādakoṭayaḥ ।।।63 ।।
sarve vihāyasā yānti vimānaireva pauraṭaiḥ ।
śataikayojanocchrāyā vyāse sāhasrayojanāḥ ।।64।।
santi vimānatulyāste prāsādā vyomagāminaḥ ।
sarve vaikuṇṭhasadṛśā narā nāryaśca kāmagāḥ ।। 65।।
yuvatyaśca yuvānaśca dvādaśaṣoḍaśābdajāḥ ।
kabarīkeśaśobhāḍhyāḥ puṣpamālādharāstathā ।।66।।
kaṭakāṃgadakeyūraśṛṃkhalāmukuṭānvitāḥ ।
ūrmikākaustubhamaṇisvarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitāḥ ।।67।।
kāmanotkaṭabhrūbhāgāḥ premapravāhasaṃvahāḥ ।
puṣṭāḥ śvetāruṇarūpāḥ svarṇavastrāntagātrakāḥ ।। 68 ।।
svarṇarūpāḥ sadā ramyāḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhāḥ ।
śaraccandrasamaśaityāḥ sukhānāmākarā iva ।।6 9 ।।
bhavantyeva tu paṃcāśatkoṭibhaktāṇya eva tāḥ ।
bhaktāśca śāśvatāste'pi paṃcāśatkoṭayastathā ।।1.123.70 ।।
nivasanti tathā'nye'pi prākāre tatra vartule ।
tasya dvārāṇi catvāri caturdikṣu bhavanti vai ।। 71 ।।
bhagavatpārṣadaistatra kṛtā vai dvārapālatā ।
ralabhūṣābhūṣitaiśca sadratnamukuṭojjvalaiḥ ।।72।।
divyahetidharaiḥ sarvaiḥ kirīṭakaṭakānvitaiḥ ।
divyaiḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣaiścā'vitaṃ dvāracatuṣṭayam ।।73 ।।
evaṃ durgottamavyāptā vartulākṛtikaiva ca ।
tadante vartate divyā sāketākhyā subhūmikā ।।74।।
nityā sāketadhāmākhyā naikavasatisaṃśritā ।
udyānā bahavastatra vāṭikāścāpyanantakāḥ ।।75 ।।
brahmarasamahānadyaḥ śailaśrṛṃgāṇi bhūriśaḥ ।
sukṣetrāṇyapyasaṃkhyāni vanānyupavanāni ca ।।76 ।।
vaiṣṇavānāṃ vihārārthaṃ vinodārthaṃ vadhūmatām ।
dārāṇāṃ ca nivāsārthaṃ tatra vasatayaḥ kṛtāḥ ।।77।।
grāmāstatra sadurgāśca prā'rbudā'rbudakoṭayaḥ ।
nagarāṇi vicitrāṇi koṭilakṣāṇi santi vai ।।78 ।।
sāketanagaragrāmāḥ sadratnamaṇibhūmayaḥ ।
maṇīnāṃ maṇḍapāstatra ratnahīrakasadgṛhāḥ ।।79 ।।
muktāmāṇikyasaudhāśca sphāṭikasṛtibhittayaḥ ।
divyā gāvaśca vatsāśca vatsataryaḥ śubhāḥ śubhāḥ ।।1.123.80 ।।
saudhāśca ghummaṭāścaiva bhūrīṇi śikharāṇi ca ।
candraśālā hyasaṃkhyātāstathā viśrāntibhūmikāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
deśamārgā rājamārgā vimānarathavāhanāḥ ।
garuḍā yānahaṃsāśca vṛṣahastipraghoṭakāḥ ।।82।।
smṛddhayo vividhāḥ sarvāḥ pramadāḥ pramadottamāḥ ।
dvādaśahāyanāḥ sarvāḥ kiṃcidudbhinnayauvanāḥ ।।83 ।।
arbudārbudabhaktānyo vaiṣṇavyaśca vasanti tāḥ ।
kāmottejakasaddravyaiḥ rājitā ratiśāradāḥ ।।84।।
ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyā ratnamālāvirājitāḥ ।
rannakaṃkaṇakeyūraratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।।85।।
ratnasatkuṇḍalādyaiśca gaṇḍasthalasamujjvalāḥ ।
ratnakhacitasvarṇāṅgulīyadhṛtāṅguliprabhāḥ ।।86।।
muktāmauktikasadrājatpauraṭābhūṣaṇānvitāḥ ।
raktacacatkuṃkumādikṛtabhālasucandrakāḥ ।।87।।
lalantikāvālikātantikātroṭivirājitāḥ ।
prakoṣṭhakāṭakīśobhā baṃgiḍīśrṛṃkhalānvitāḥ ।।88 ।।
raśanārājatkaṭayaḥ sakiṃkiṇīnupūrakāḥ ।
śratpārvaṇacandrāsyāḥ padmapatrasulocanāḥ ।।89।।
kabarīkeśaveśāktasugandhipuṣpamālikāḥ ।
manojamantharagativakrabhrūlatikānvitāḥ ।। 1.123.90 ।।
kaṭhinasvalpasustanyo nārāyaṇasamarpitāḥ ।
pītacandanasvarṇābhāḥ pītāmbarapravāraṇāḥ ।। 91 ।।
sudatyaḥ susvarā saumyāḥ premapātrāṇi vai hareḥ ।
nāryo ramāsajātīyāḥ ramātulyasumastakāḥ ।।9 2 ।।
sarvā''likāḥ satilakāḥ sataptamudracihnitāḥ ।
narāścaturbhujāḥ sarve śaṃkhacakragadābjakāḥ ।। 93 ।।
kaustubhamālabhūṣādiśobhitāḥ śvetapāṇḍurāḥ ।
śāśvatāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣavayaskāḥ pūrayauvanāḥ ।। 9 4।।
siddhayo yatra tiṣṭhanti kalpavṛkṣā gṛhe gṛhe ।
saṃkalpamaṇayastatra sākete pratimuktakam ।। 95 ।।
divyāśca smṛddhayaḥ sarvā bhojyapānavilepanāḥ ।
snānadānavihārādinṛtyaramaṇavādanāḥ ।। 96 ।।
samājotsavapariṣatpūjāsatkārasatkriyāḥ ।
sarvā bhavanti divyāścā'mṛtakuṇḍapravāhaṇāḥ ।। 9 7।।
phalapuṣpottamarasasugandhidravaparvatāḥ ।
na nyūnaṃ vidyate kiṃcitsākete dhāmni vāsinām ।। 9 8।।
mahālakṣmyājñayā sarvaṃ sāketaṃ bhaktavāsitam ।
divyadṛṣṭyā darśanārhaṃ māyānetreṇa nekṣyate ।।99।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mahāvaikuṇṭhe divyasarayūkausalavanatatratyavasatitadantardurgavartulavasatitatsāketabhūmikāramārāmā-
vaiṣṇavādinivāsaprabhṛtivarṇananāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāya ।। 123।।
