adhyāyaḥ 143
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 144 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tatra vastrāpathe lakṣmi! kārtikyāṃ kurute tu yaḥ ।
yātrāṃ vigāhya tattīrthe kṛtamokṣaḥ prajāyate ।। 1 ।।
dāmodare saritproktā svarṇarakṣābhidhā śubhā ।
brahmakuṇḍaṃ tatra tīrthaṃ tathā brahmeśvaraḥ śivaḥ ।। 2 ।।
kālameghaśca saṃprokto bhavo dāmodarastathā ।
gavyūtidvitaye dūre kālikā śikharopari ।। 3 ।।
indreśvaro vāyudiśi mṛgīkuṇḍo bhavāntike ।
kṛte sāraṇikaṃ tīrthaṃ tretāyāṃ hemamārakam ।। 4 ।।
paścime unnabīleti kṣetraṃ yojanadūragam ।
tatra tīrthānyanekāni siddhasthānāni ṣoḍaśa ।। 5 ।।
sūryakuṇḍastatra tīrthaṃ gaṃgeśo maṃgalaṃ tathā ।
siddheśvaramahādevo gavyūtiḥ paści me pure ।। 6 ।।
indreśvare cakratīrthaṃ hāṭakeśastu paścime ।
yakṣeśvarī mahādevī tata uparikṣmādharaḥ ।। 7 ।।
somaliṃgeti madhyaḥ sa yatra tīrthānyanekaśaḥ ।
gajendrasya padaṃ tatra tatraiva rasakūpikā ।। 8 ।।
kuṇḍānāṃ ca śataṃ tatra hyambikā śikharopari ।
pradyumnaśca tathā sāmbastathā gorakṣako'pi ca ।। 9 ।।
gaṇeśo hanumāँścāpi rāmalakṣmaṇamādhavāḥ ।
vasanti vanamadhye te tattannāmnā vanāni ca ।। 1.143.10 ।।
bhavastatra samāyātaḥ kathayāmi kathāmimām ।
kailāsaśikhare ramye śivasya sannidhau kvacit ।। 11 ।।
brahmaviṣṇusurendrādyā devāstatrā''yayurdrutam ।
viṣṇuḥ provāca taṃ śaṃbhuṃ daityānāṃ ca varapradam ।। 12।।
nāhaṃ pālayituṃ śaktastvaṃ dadāsi varān bahūn ।
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca rakṣasā ca maheśvara ।। 13।।
vikṛtiṃ yānti paścāt te kaṣṭavadhyā bhavanti me ।
śrupvovāca tadā śaṃbhurvaraṃ yadi dadāmi na ।। 14।।
tadā tu tapasā daityāḥ sarvaṃ kuryurhi bhasmitam ।
tvayā'haṃ brahmaṇā devairvaradānāya yojitaḥ ।। 15।।
madīyā prakṛtistveṣā tāṃ kathaṃ tyaktumutsahe ।
yena kena prakāreṇa prajāḥ pālyāstvayā prabho ।। 16।।
kṣantavyaṃ me varadānakarmāpi bahudaṃ bhavet ।
tvāṃ vinā śrīhare viṣṇo daityānāmantako hi kaḥ ।। 17।।
mayā vā brahmaṇā vāpi varadānena yojitāḥ ।
daityā vā dānavā vā ca rākṣasā vāpi ye ca ke ।। 18।।
tvayā yuktyā prahantavyā nānyathā kuśalaṃ bhavet ।
aparādhastu soḍhavyaḥ karuṇāsāgaro bhavān ।। 19।।
jālandharo hiraṇyākṣo hiraṇyakaśipustathā ।
anye cāsuramūrdhanyā yuktyā tvayaiva ghātitāḥ ।।1.143.20 ।।
yathā yuktiṃ bhavānvetti tathā jānāti nā'paraḥ ।
vayaṃ tu varadāsteṣāṃ bhavāँsteṣāṃ tu śāntikṛt ।।।21 ।।
ityasmābhiścālitaṃ vai saṃsāracakrakaṃ mahat ।
tathaivaitat saṃcalati kṣamasva puruṣottama ।।22।।
ahaṃ vyakto vicarāmi tenā''gacchanti devatāḥ ।
daityāśca varalābhārthaṃ tato'vyakto bhavāmyaham ।।।23।।
devīṃ tu pārvatīṃ rakṣa gacchāmyaviditasthalam ।
iti kṛtvā mahādevastatraivāntaradhīyata ।।24।।
kailāsaṃ tu parityajya raivatācalamāgataḥ ।
girīṇāṃ madhyamāsthāya tyaktvā divye ca vāsasī ।।25।।
gajā'jitaṃ parityajya tyaktvā mūrtaṃ surūpakam ।
bhittvā bhūmitalaṃ śaṃbhuḥ sthāṇurūpo babhūva ha ।।26।।
yasmātsvayaṃ babhūveti bhaveśvaraḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ ।
svayaṃbhūrvai bhavo jāto bhaveśvarataḍāgake ।।।27।।
atrāntare tu kailāse te na paśyanti śaṃkaram ।
tato devāḥ pracalitāḥ kṛtvā gaurīṃ puraḥsarām ।।28।।
nandibhadrādayaḥ sarve devā indrādayastathā ।
putreṇa sahitā devī siṃhārūḍhā svayaṃ yayau ।। 29।।
adhiruhya garutmantaṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ।
haṃsādhirūḍho bhagavān brahmā cāyāti pṛṣṭhataḥ ।। 1.143.30 ।।
airāvataṃ samāruhya devarājo gataḥ svayam ।
gaṃgā sarasvatī devī yamunā ca śaradvatī ।। 31 ।।
devatāścāgatāḥ sarvā nāgā yakṣāśca kinnarāḥ ।
adhiruhya gireḥ śṛṃgamambādevī vyavasthitā ।।32।।
brahmā viṣṇustathā devā mārgayāṃcakrurīśvaram ।
dadṛśustaṃ taḍāgasya nimnabhūmau maheśvaram ।।33।।
kimarthaṃ vā kathaṃ cātrā samāyātāḥ surādayaḥ ।
mayā tvatraiva vastavyaṃ bhaveśvarasurūpataḥ ।। 34।।
bhavanto yadi santuṣṭāḥ surā nadyaśca sevakāḥ ।
girau raivatake viṣṇurambā sarve'tra vāhakāḥ ।।35।।
siṃhādayo'pi tiṣṭhantu kailāso'nya ivātra vai ।
suvarṇā bhagavatpatnī svarṇarekhā nadī matā ।। 6।।
tatra gaṃgāsarasvatyādayo vasantu sarvadā ।
parvate svarṇarakṣā sā svarṇarekhā tu sā bhuvi ।।37।।
evaṃ śaṃbhurbhaveśākhyo viṣṇurdāmodaraḥ svayam ।
brahmā svayaṃbhūstatrāsti cendra indreśvare sthitaḥ ।। 38।।
anyā'nye yatra sāralyaṃ tatra tatra vyavasthitāḥ ।
tata etanmahattīrthaṃ mṛtyusaṃsāratārakam ।। 39।।
bahurātraṃ haristatra kṛtvā daityanibarhaṇam ।
samāgatya ca viśrāntiṃ nayatyeva dayānidhiḥ ।।1.143.40 ।।
reme raivatake viṣṇuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ।
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā gatvā ca raivate girau ।।41।।
śarabhaṃ śivamāskandya nārasiṃhaṃ mumoca saḥ ।
hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathā hatvā gatvā raivatake girau ।।।42।।
vane vyāghramavaskandya vārāhaṃ samumoca vai ।
pṛthvīṃ kṛtvā samāṃ devaḥ pṛthuścovāsa raivate ।।43 ।। 1
jayamālā pṛthunā dāmodarāṃse niveśitā ।
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ ।।।44।।
svarṇarakṣājale snāto mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ।
bhavadāmodarā'mbānāṃ darśanādyāti dhāma tat ।।45।।
vāmanastu baliṃ prāpya jitvā raivatake sthitaḥ ।
kailāsaparvataṃ tyaktvā devīṃ devāṃśca saṃgatān ।।46।।
vaiśākhe paṃcadaśyāṃ tu bhūmiṃ bhittvā bhavo'bhavat ।
tasminneva dine lakṣmi! svarṇarakṣānadījalāt ।।47।।
panthānaṃ vāsukiḥ prāpa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।
airāvatapadākrānta ūrjayanto mahāgiriḥ ।।48।।
susrāva toyaṃ bahudhā gajapādodbhavaṃ śuci ।
vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya pramāṇaṃ śṛṇu padmaje ।।49।।
harasya bhramato bhūmau patitaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇam ।
tāvanmātraṃ hi tatkṣetraṃ devairvastrāpathaṃ kṛtam ।।1.143.50।।
uttareṇa nadī bhadrā pūrvaṃ kuṃkumavāpikā ।
dakṣiṇe ca baleḥ sthānamūrjayantīnadīmanu ।।5 1।।
paścimāyāṃ paraṃ nadyoḥ saṃgamo vāmanātpuraḥ ।
etadvastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam ।।52।।
jñeyaḥ kṣetrasya cāyāmo yojanānāṃ catuṣṭayam ।
kṣetrasya dīrghatā yojanānāṃ dvādaśakaṃ matā ।।53।।
bhūmau luṇṭhandaṇḍavacca kṛtvā prakrāmati kramāt ।
daṇḍapramāṇabhūmervā prakramed dhūlikāṃ vahan ।।।54।।
sa saptasāgarāṃ pṛthvīṃ śāsitvā'nne hareḥ padam ।
śatabhaumavimānastho divyadeho vrajatyatha ।।।55।।।
vidhāya bhujabandhaṃ vā pādau badhvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
maunena mānuṣo yāyād dāmodaraṃ bhaveśvaram ।।56।।
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyeta mokṣamante hyavāpnuyāt ।
vastrāpathe mahākṣetre nagare vāmanasthale ।।57।।
vaśiṣṭho bhagavāँstaptuṃ tapastatrājagāma ha ।
īśānakoṇe nagarāt svarṇarekhānadījale ।।58।।
snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ devaṃ praṇanāma muniryadā ।
tadā hariharau tatra samāyātau tamūcatuḥ ।।59।।
tvaṃ vai varṣaśataṃ cātra ghore tapasi saṃsthitaḥ ।
maharṣe tava tuṣṭau svaḥ kiṃ te prārthyaṃ vadasva tat ।।1.143.60।।
vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha deveśau yadi deyo varo mama ।
tadā bhavadbhyāmatraiva stheyamācandratārakam ।।61।।
mamāpi darśanaṃ sevā yuvayoḥ sarvadā bhavet। ।
atra ye pāpino lokā jalaṃ pītvā kṣaṇaṃ ca vā ।।।62।।
grahīṣyanti ca viśrāmaṃ teṣāṃ pāpalayo bhavet ।
hyetadvāsiṣṭhasaṃjñaṃ ca tīrthaṃ khyātaṃ bhavetsadā ।।63।।
tathāstviti samuccārya devau cāṃśena tiṣṭhataḥ ।
svarṇadurge tu nagare kṛṣṇāyā uttare taṭe ।।64।।
dātārasya tu daityasya vināśāya sudarśanam ।
cakraṃ vai prahitaṃ tacca dagdhvā 'suramupāgatam ।।65।।
tadā nārāyaṇo yatra viśrāmaṃ prāptavān hariḥ ।
tatra trivikramo devaḥ siddheśvaraśca śaṃkaraḥ ।।66।।
śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā sākaṃ gaṇeśo hanumāँstathā ।
devāścānye samāyātā nārāyaṇadidṛkṣayā ।।67।।
parvatīyajanaiḥ śuddhaiḥ kalyāṇīyasumārgagaiḥ ।
divyadṛṣṭyā tu te devā dṛṣṭāstatra samāgatāḥ ।।68।।
tairbhaktapuṃgavairdevāḥ sāttvataiḥ samapūjitāḥ ।
namaskṛtāstathā devāḥ prasannā jagaduśca tān ।।69।।
bhaktyā tu bhavatāṃ tuṣṭā vadantu kimapekṣitam ।
prāhuste tu tadā devān yadi deyo varo bhavet ।।1.143.70 ।।
vasantu cātra saṃsthāne kalyāṇāya tu dehinām ।
parvatīyāstathā'raṇyavāsino'pi tvadīkṣaṇāt ।।71 ।।
muktiṃ yāsyanti tasmādvai saṃprayacchantu tadvaram ।
tathāstviti varaṃ datvā sthitāścāṃśaistu mandire ।।72।।।
suvarṇasiṃharājñā vai kārite'tra mahattare ।
suvarṇakalaśaiḥ svarṇā''sanadvāraiḥ suśobhite ।।73।।
raktapītaiḥ śvetanīlairmaṇibhiḥ kṛtabhūmike ।
sphāṭikādyaiśca suklṛptasopānabhittimaṇḍale ।।74।।
atrāgatya tu ye lokā kariṣyantīkṣaṇādikam ।
dānaṃ puṇyaṃ japa homaṃ sādhusādhvyāditarpaṇam ।।75।।
śrāddhaṃ tathotsavaṃ daivaṃ teṣāṃ puṇyamanantakam ।
udyāpanaṃ kariṣyanti jīrṇoddhāraṃ ca ye janāḥ ।।76।।
naivedyaṃ phaladānādi satāṃ sevāṃ dhanādibhiḥ ।
tanubhiśca kariṣyanti te yāsyantyakṣaraṃ padam ।।77।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne raivate vastrāpathe vividhatīrthabhaveśvaradāmodarasvayaṃbhūtrivikramavāsiṣṭhasvarṇarakṣādinivāsakāraṇapradarśanādināmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 143।।


← adhyāyaḥ 143 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 144
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 145 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ahaṃ vasāmi sattīrthe lokoddhāraṇahetave ।
sarvatrāpi nivasāmi cāntaryāmitvahetave ।। 1 ।।
mūrtau mūrtau sadā varte sevāgrahaṇahetave ।
tattatsthāne vasāmyatra bhaktasauhārdahetave ।। 2 ।।
kvacidbhaktā''grahād yadvā mama saṃkalpakāraṇāt ।
kvacitkāryāvaśyakatvānnivasāmi sthale sthale ।। 3 ।।
bhārate paścime bhāge yāvatsāgarasaṃgate ।
raivatādrisamaṃ tīrthaṃ nānyad divyaṃ hi vartate ।। 4 ।।
tatraiva dakṣiṇe'raṇye somanāthasya saṃsthitiḥ ।
uttare svarṇanagare'nādikṛṣṇasya saṃsthitiḥ ।। 5 ।।
pūrve kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca gopālakṛṣṇasaṃsthitiḥ ।
paścime vāmanasthalyāṃ trivikramasya me sthitiḥ ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ sarvatra taddeśe nivasāmi sthale sthale ।
mahatyāṃ vai rājadhānyāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasthitiḥ ।। 7 ।।
prānte prānte janoddhārahetave nivasāmyaham ।
yugānte mama saudhāni vivartante tvitastataḥ ।। 8 ।।
vilīyante tu jīrṇāni kāryante nūtanāni ca ।
yathā bhaktā bhavantyeva tadvatpunarbhavāmyaham ।। 9 ।।
nānto'smi mama divyānāṃ sthānānāṃ yugabhedataḥ ।
bhūmirdeśāsta eva syurahamapyasmi caiva saḥ ।। 1.144.10 ।।
arcakasya tapaḥśraiṣṭhyād bhaktabhaktibalāttathā ।
mūrtīnāmatisaundaryādahaṃ varte samakṣavat ।। 1 1।।
balerbhaktiṃ vilokyaiva kaśyapasya tapastathā ।
dīrgho'pi vāmano bhūtvā'vasaṃ vai raivatācale ।। 12।।।
kaśyapena mahograṃ vai tapastaptaṃ nadītaṭe ।
ojasvatyāścottare vai cūtavṛkṣābhisaṃvṛte ।। 13।।
ūrjayantyā jalaṃ pītvā tatra varṣasahasrakam ।
putrārthaṃ nirjane sthāne yatrāste vāmanasthalī ।। 14।।
tatrā'dityā saha tena kaśyapena hariḥ svayam ।
prasāditaśca putratve vṛtto'to vāmano'bhavam ।। 15।।
tatkāraṇaṃ tu te vacmi śṛṇu lakṣmi! manogatam ।
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā nṛsiṃho bhagavān svayam ।। 16।।
dadāvindrāya trailokyaṃ prahlādāyā'talādikam ।
kāle haripadaṃ prāptaḥ prahlādaḥ sāttvatāgragaḥ ।। 17।।
prahlādasya sutaḥ śreṣṭho virocana itīritaḥ ।
sa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ vai rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ yayau ।। 18।।
tasya putro mahābāhuḥ sātvatānāṃ varo baliḥ ।
satyapratijño dharmiṣṭho bhaktaḥ priyatamo hareḥ ।। 19।।
sa jitvā lokapālāṃśca dikpālāँśca samantataḥ ।
trīṃllokānsvavaśe kṛtvā rājā'bhūt tribhuvāṃ patiḥ ।।1.144.20 ।।
ekātapatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ baliścakre balaitinaḥ ।
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī bahusasyaphalapradā ।।21 ।।
gandhavanti ca puṣpāṇi rasavanti phalāni ca ।
āskandhaphalino vṛkṣā puṭake puṭake madhu ।।22।।
gāvaḥ pūrṇadughāḥ sarvā balau rājye praśāsati ।
svadharmaniratāḥ sarve narāḥ pāpavivarjitāḥ ।।।23 ।।
arcayanti hṛṣīkeśaṃ satataṃ vaiṣṇavīprajāḥ ।
indrāditridaśāstasya kiṃkarāḥ samupasthitāḥ ।।24।।
aiśvaryaṃ triṣu lokeṣu bubhuje baladarpakṛt ।
caturvedā dvijāstasya rājye yajñādikāriṇaḥ ।।21।।
kṣatriyā rakṣaṇe saktā yuddhaśāstrārthakovidāḥ ।
goṣu sevāparā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ ।।26।।
dāridryaduḥkhamaraṇairvimuktāścirajīvinaḥ ।
maṇidīpaprakāśāstu diveva niśi santi yat ।।27।।
sarve kuṭumbino hṛṣṭāḥ sukhinaḥ sveṣṭavastubhiḥ ।
nityaṃ vaivāhavāditrairgarjanti yūpamaṇḍapāḥ ।।।28।।
yajñe santoṣitā devā nā'to yuddhaṃ parasparam ।
sāpatnikakalirnāsti paśupakṣijaneṣvapi ।।29 ।।
maitrībhāvaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam ।
tadā tu nārado yuddhaṃ trailokye nahi paśyati ।।1.144.30 ।।
tāvattasyodare pīḍā mahatī samajāyata ।
kiṃ tarpaṇena snānena japahomādibhiśca kim ।।3 1 ।।
tat snānaṃ yatra yuddhyante gajā dantavighaṭṭanaiḥ ।
sandhyā yatra raktairbhūḥ kabandhānāṃ tu pāṭalā ।। 32।।
kravyādā yatra tṛpyanti tarpaṇaṃ tanmama priyam ।
pūjā kṣatriyaśastraughairhanyante kṣatriyā raṇe ।।33 ।।
sa homo yatra hūyante hanyante narapuṃgavāḥ ।
yuddhaṃ vinā trilokyāṃ me śūnyaṃ tu dṛśyate'nvaham ।।34।।
tathā kariṣye cendrasya balinā kalaho bhavet ।
nāradastadvicintyaiva yayāvindraṃ prati drutam ।।35।।
indro dadarśa cāyāntamudāsīnaṃ tu nāradam ।
siṃhāsanaṃ parityajya samutthāyā'grataḥ sthitaḥ ।। 36 ।।
svāgatenā'bhivandyā'tha babhāṣe nāradaṃ hariḥ ।
maharṣe kuśalo'syadya kuto vā''gamyate tvayā ।।37।।
snāne sanghyārcane home kuśalaṃ svinnu vidyate ।
iti pṛṣṭo vihasyā'tha nāradaḥ prāha taṃ prati ।।38।।
baliryāvanmahāँścakravartī bhavati sarvagaḥ ।
tatra kiṃ kuśalaṃ me'sti te'pi pṛcchāmi tanmṛṣā ।।39।।
kuśalaṃ tu tadā mahyaṃ praṣṭavyaṃ yadi saṃyuge ।
devānāṃ vijayaṃ drakṣye baleścādhogatiṃ tathā ।।1.144.40।।
ādityādyā grahāḥ sarve baliṃ namanti yojitāḥ ।
baleryajñaistathā meghā varṣanti haviṣā bhuvi ।।41 ।।
rogādimaraṇaṃ nāsti kiṃ yamasya prayojanam ।
trilokīśo mahendraśca dikpālo lokapālakaḥ ।।42।।
surādhipaṃ baliṃ tvadya stuvanti mānavā api ।
tvāṃ tu hasanti daityendrā jalpanti nirbalānsurān ।।।43।।
vasundharāṃ svarṇamayīṃ svāyattīkṛtya sarvathā ।
balirna manute tvāṃ vai sureśvara iti svayam ।।44।।
surāḥ sarve balyadhīnā balikratusubhojinaḥ ।
raṃbhā tiṣṭhati balyagre manute tvāṃ na menakā ।।।45।।।
tilottamā baliṃ yāti tūrvaśī ca balervaśā ।
sukeśī matrjughoṣā ca nirīkṣete baliṃ sadā ।।46।।
pulomā pulakodbhedaṃ na karoti baliṃ vinā ।
paulomī ca baliṃ stauti namati dyaurbaliṃ sadā ।।47।।
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva hāhā hūhūśca tumburuḥ ।
baleḥ rājyaṃ praśaṃsanti te kimasti prayojanam ।।48।।
bṛhaspatiryadācaṣṭe na tadvācyaṃ mayā tava ।
indrāṇī tu baliṃ cendraṃ matvā prātaḥ prapaśyati ।।49।।
iti śrutvā mahendrastu kopajvalitamānasaḥ ।
gajaṃ vajraṃ prāha sūtau rathamānayataṃ drutam ।।1.144.50।।
sūryaṃ rudraṃ yamaṃ vāyuṃ susajjān kurutaṃ tathā ।
raṇavādyāni vādyantāṃ prayāntu tvaritā bhaṭāḥ ।।51 ।।
itīndraṃ kruddhamālokya bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ।
prāha sāmādyupāyena balirjayyo na cānyathā ।।।52।।।
yadadhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ viṣṇuṃ surasurakṣakam ।
mantrayantu samāhūyā'nutiṣṭhantu tadāritam ।।।53।।
athavā rājate viṣṇuḥ kāryārthaṃ mandare girau ।
gacchāmastatra ṛṣayaḥ sendrā brahmapurogamāḥ ।।54।।
gautamo'trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro'tha kaśyapaḥ ।
jamadagnirvaśiṣṭhaśca bālakhilyāśca nāradaḥ ।।55।।
gatāḥ sarve tadā viṣṇurbālakhilyāँstu vāmanān ।
jahāsā'ṅguṣṭhaparvābhān bhāvikāryabalāddhariḥ ।।56।।
tadā sarve bālakhilyā uccairūcuḥ parasparam ।
asmān hasasi tasmāttvaṃ vāmano vai bhaviṣyasi ।।97।।
vastrāpathe raivatādrau devakāryaṃ vidhāya ca ।
vāmanatvaṃ parityajya dāmodaro nivatsyasi ।।58।।
ityukto bālakhilyaiḥ sa viṣṇuḥ svāgatamācarat ।
indro balestrilokādhipatyaṃ prāha suduḥsaham ।।99।।
vaśīkṛtaṃ tu balinā daityā yajñabhujaḥ kṛtāḥ ।
tasmādbalirbhraṣṭarājyaḥ pātālamadhitiṣṭhatu ।।1.144.60।।
sūryasomānvaye kaścid rājā bhavatu bhūtale ।
ityāśrutya svayaṃ prāha kariṣye ca tathā hariḥ ।।6 1।।
ṛṣayastatra gacchantu kārayantu mahāmakham ।
ahaṃ tatra samāgatya sādhayiṣyāmi taṃ balim ।।62।।
ityuktā munayaḥ sarve svasvasthānaṃ yayustadā ।
kālaṃ pratīkṣamāṇāste pratīkṣante harerjanim ।।63।।
kaśyapo'pi sutaṃ tvindraṃ bhraṣṭarājyaṃ vilokya ca ।
ādityā saha saurāṣṭre tapastepe payovṛtam ।।64।।
arcayāmāsa deveśaṃ padmanābhaṃ janārdanam ।
śarīre tu tayostatra pipīlikābhirāvṛte ।।65।।
tejo mahattayovyāptaṃ saurāṣṭre paritastadā ।
lokāstu vismitāstena tau stuvanti punaḥ punaḥ ।।66।।
harirvarṣasahasrānte prasannastapasā tayoḥ ।
tatraivāvirabhūt tasya devyā saha sanātanaḥ ।।67।।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam ।
indīvaradalaśyāmaṃ sarvābharaṇaśobhitam ।।68।।
kirīṭahārakeyūrakuṇḍalaśṛṃkhalānvitam
pītāṃbaraṃ śrīvatsāṃkakaustubhahāravakṣasam ।।69।।
lakṣmīyuktaṃ garuḍasthaṃ prasannaṃ jagadīśvaram ।
harṣanirbharahṛdayastuṣṭāva kaśyapo harim ।।1.144.70 ।।
namo namaste lakṣmīśa sarveśa bhuvaneśvara ।
svāśritānāṃ sukhadātre bhaktakāryakṛte namaḥ ।।71 ।।
ādimadhyāntarahitanityarūpāya te namaḥ ।
namaḥ sarvatrāṇakṛte vedavedāṃgacakṣuṣe ।।72।।
sūkṣmāya sthūlarūpāya nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ।
kalyāṇaguṇapūrṇāya parātmane ca te namaḥ ।।73 ।।
namaste yogigamyāya bhaktecchāpūrakāya te ।
nityamuktaikabhogāya paradhāmeśvarāya ca ।।74।।
caturātmannamastubhyaṃ vyūhātmane ca te namaḥ ।
paṃcapaṃcasvarūpāya paṃcasaṃskāriṇe namaḥ ।।75।।
nārāyaṇāya kṛṣṇāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ ।
śārṅgiṇe viśvarūpāya dhātre trātre ca te namaḥ ।।769।।
viṣṇave jiṣṇave tubhyaṃ śuddhasatvāya te namaḥ ।
balerbalaṃ mahajjātaṃ tanniṣūdaya mādhava ।।77।।
devāstadā sukhinaḥ syuriti cābhyarthanā'sti me ।
yadyapi balirājo'sau bhakto'sti suramelanaḥ ।।78।।
kintu surātikramaṇaṃ māstu daityasya mādhava।
tasmāt trilokagaṃ rājyaṃ tvindrasyaiva sadā'stu vai ।।79।।
balestvāsurarājyaṃ ca pātālādau yathāstu ca ।
tathā'styabhyarthanīyaṃ me yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।1.144.80 ।।
uktvā tu kaśyapastatra virarāma hareḥ puraḥ ।
aditiḥ prāha deveśaṃ natvā stutvā jagatprabhum ।।8 1।।
he nātha yadi devānāṃ śāstṛtva cāsure bhavet ।
tadā'smatputrabāhulye nāsti kiñcitprayojanam ।।।82।।
yadi śṛgālāḥ kākāśca syurdevasya vibhūtayaḥ ।
kiṃ siṃhena ca haṃsena tadā vai mahimā tava ।।83।।।
yadi daityāḥ sārvabhaumā bhrātaraste ca kiṃkarāḥ ।
alaṃ tarhi jīvitena tvadityā ramayā śriyā ।।84।।
yadi bhavānmahaiśvaryo daityo'pi tādṛśo bhavet ।
alaṃ bhagavatā tarhi daityo vai mādhavo bhavet ।।85।।
tasmātpātrādhikāreṇa deyā smṛddhirhi nā'nyathā ।
yadi lauhaṃ gale nyastaṃ śobhate rūpabhāsuram ।।86।।
kṛtaṃ tarhi suvarṇena vyartha sṛṣṭaṃ hi hāṭakam ।
yadi daityau bhavedindro vyarthā hyasarasastathā ।।87।।
rājamātaro rākṣasyaścedindrāṇyā hyalaṃ tadā ।
kiṃbahūktena me nātha vyavasthāṃ kuru keśava ।।88।।
ityabhyarthita evā'yaṃ śrīpatiḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
prāha tau vai varārthāya kaśyapaḥ prāha taṃ tadā ।।89।।
putratvaṃ mama deveśa saṃprāpya traidaśaṃ hitam ।
prakuruṣvendrāvarajo bhūtvopendro mama priyaḥ ।।1.144.90।।
yena kenāpyupāyena baliṃ nirjitya līlayā ।
trailokyaṃ dehi devāya śakrāyeti sukhaṃ kuru । ।9 1।।
ityuktastena vipreṇa tathetyāha janārdanaḥ ।
aditiḥ kaśyapaścainaṃ pūjayāmāsaturbahu ।।92।।
devaiḥ saṃstūyamānaḥ śrīharistvantaradhīyata ।
aditiḥ kaśyapaścaitau madhyadeśaṃ gatau tadā ।।93।।
himālayasya bhūmau vai kaṃcitkālaṃ samūṣatuḥ ।
etasminneva samaye kaśyapasya mahātmanaḥ ।।94।।
adityā garbhamāgacchad bhagavān mādhavaḥ svayam ।
prāvirbhāvamagamat sa devastryaṃguladehavān ।।95।।
daśavarṣavayaskaḥ sa vitastidehavānabhūt ।
mātre pitre vane tatraikadā hyāsurasainyapaḥ ।।96।।
adṛśyata baliḥ pṛthvyāṃ jetuṃ sarvān samāgataḥ ।
tato devān munīn pitṝn jetuṃ yāsyati yāvatā ।। 17।।
tāvatā hyaditiḥ prāha kaśyapaṃ prāṇavallabham ।
baliḥ sainyena devānvai jitvā smṛddhiṃ hariṣyati ।।98।।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mama putro'dyāpi vitastimātrakaḥ ।
rakṣaṇaṃ durlabhaṃ cāsya devānāṃ tu kathaṃ hi tat ।।99।।
tathā bhavatu yadbhāvi hariḥ rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ।
iti dīnāṃ mātṛvācaṃ saṃśrutvā guptamādhavaḥ ।। 1.144.100 ।।
tadā prādarśayanmātre vitastivigrahe śubhe ।
anantānantasṛṣṭyaṇḍakoṭīryāścāṇurūpiṇīḥ ।। 10 1।।
uḍḍīyante sma cāṇḍāni saptāvaraṇavanti tu ।
lokālokaśca meruścā'drayo'nye tatra darśitāḥ ।। 102।
āpagāścābdhayaścāpi nakṣatragrahatārakāḥ ।
meghā vanāni pātālālayāsteṣāṃ gṛhāṇi ca ।। 10 3।।
uccāvacāni sarvāṇi sthalāni darśitāni vai ।
tatra himagiristasya vanāni tatra kaśyapaḥ ।। 104।।
aditiśca svayaṃ kṛṣṇo vitastimātravigrahaḥ ।
baleḥ sainyaṃ tathā sarvaṃ darśitaṃ tatra vāmane ।। 1 05।।
vāmanena mahādīrghe dehe pradarśya tattanum ।
kṣaṇāttirohitaṃ tatrā'bhavadvitastimānakaḥ ।। 1 06।।
athaivaṃ darśane jāte pitrorāśvāsanaṃ hyabhūt ।
devānāṃ bhayahartā'yaṃ prāpte kāle bhavediti ।। 1 07।।
tataḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣo'yaṃ hastamātrapramāṇakaḥ ।
prāptamaśrusvarṇarekhaḥ kaustubhena virājitaḥ ।। 1 08।।
svarṇāntameghavatsnigdhakeśayūthasumastakaḥ ।
padmapatranibhanetraścandrojjvalāsyaśobhanaḥ ।। 1 09।।
sudṛḍhapakvaśarīraḥ komalaḥ karapattalaiḥ ।
haste svalpaṃ tvātapatraṃ yaṣṭikā ratnapauraṭī ।। 1.144.11 0।।
mālikā śuklamaṇibhiḥ kṛtā karagatā śubhā ।
candanasyordhvapuṃḍraṃ ca bhāle kuṃkumacandrakaḥ ।। 11 1।।
suvarṇavarṇaṃ svalpaṃ suyajñopavītamaṃsake ।
raktorṇāyāḥ paṭaṃ mūrdhni kaustubho hṛdaye tadā ।। 1 12।।
svarṇaprāntaṃ śvetavastramuttarīyaṃ ca kaṃcukam ।
kaṭyāṃ tu komalā cārdrā śubhā muñjasya mekhalā ।। 11 3।।
pītāmbaraṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ pāduke svarṇabhūṣite ।
kāṣṭhakamaṇḍalurhaste rajjūḥ kārpāsanirmitā ।। 1 14।।
kare puruṣaviṣṇunārāyaṇasūktapustakam ।
pūjārthaṃ vaṃśapātraṃ ca grathitaṃ rājate kare ।। 1 15।।
āsanaṃ cājinaṃ kukṣau dhṛtvā natvā ca pādayoḥ ।
pitrorāśīḥ samādāya vijayāyā'bhijitkṣaṇe ।। 1 16।।
tatsthalātsa viniryāto yātrānimittamacyutaḥ ।
athāpi balibhūpaḥ saḥ pṛthvīṃ jitvā divaṃ tathā ।। 1 17।।
ājagāma bhuvaṃ ramyāṃ raivatācalayoginīm ।
raivatādrernirṛtāyāṃ dakṣiṇe vāmanātpurāt ।। 1 18।।
āmrāraṇyaṃ nadīṃ cojasvatīṃ deśaṃ supallavam ।
jalasthalatarucchāyāsukhaṃ sarvaṃ vilokya ca ।। 11 9।।
uvāsa yajñakhātāni kārayāmāsa vai baliḥ ।
balikhātapradeśaḥ so balimakheti viśrutaḥ ।। 1.144.120।।
bhūmiṃ tāṃ saṃskṛtāṃ kārayitvā ca makhamaṇḍapam ।
dvādaśāhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ prārabhat sarvadakṣiṇam ।। 121।।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārāyaṇasya sattīrthavāso baliguṇavarṇanaṃ nāradasyendraṃ prati gamanaṃ baleḥ pātanamantraṇā kaśyapādityoḥ saurāṣṭre tapaścaryā nārāyaṇādvaraprāptirvāmanajanma-balidigvijayaḥ saurāṣṭre balimakhāraṃbhaścetivarṇananāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 144।।


← adhyāyaḥ 144 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 145
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 146 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! vāmano'pi tīrthāni vyacaradbhuvi ।
yayau saḥ prathamaṃ hariharakṣetraṃ tataḥ purīm ।। 1 ।।
kapilāśramamāsādya brahmaputrānadṃ yayau ।
kāmarūpasya kāmākṣīṃ dṛṣṭvā paśupatiṃ tathā ।। 2 ।।
kedāreśvaramāsādya yayau badarikāśramam ।
hanumattīrthamāsādya kailāsādrimupāyayau ।। 3 ।।
agāttato haridvāraṃ kurukṣetraṃ tataḥ param ।
prayayau yāmunaṃ vṛdāvanaṃ gokulamityapi ।। 4 ।।
tato'yodhyāpurīṃ gatvā sarayūṃ ca prayāgakam ।
gayāṃ godāvarīṃ gatvā kāverīṃ gatavāँstataḥ ।। 5 ।।
kāṃcīṃ gatvā ca kṛṣṇāṃ ca tāmraparṇīṃ kumārikām ।
setubandhaṃ cāpi janārdanaṃ ca malayācalam ।। 6 ।।
aruṇācalamāsādya padmākṣetraṃ varāhakam ।
bhūtapurīṃ tataḥ siṃhāraṇyaṃ ca narmadāṃ tataḥ ।। 7 ।।
tāpīṃ siddhapadaṃ paścātpuṣkarākhyaṃ sarastataḥ ।
sindhuṃ nārāyaṇasaraḥ suvarṇadvārikāṃ tataḥ ।। 8 ।।
samudre gomatīsaṃge yāvat snāti tu vāmanaḥ ।
tāvattatra samāyātāḥ snānārthaṃ munayo'pi ca ।। 9 ।।
gautamo'trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro'tha kaśyapaḥ ।
jamadagnirvasiṣṭho nārado'paśyanpareśvaram ।। 1.145.10 ।।
vāmanaṃ lakṣaṇairjñātvā nemustaṃ parameśvaram ।
hariḥ prāha ca tānsarvān gacchantu balikhātakam ।। 1 1।।
ṛṣayastatra gacchantu kārayantu mahāmakham ।
ahaṃ tatrā''gamiṣyāmi sādhayiṣyāmi taṃ balim ।। 12।।
ityuktāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve gatāste yajñamaṇḍape ।
dvādaśāho mahāyajñaḥ prārabdhaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ ।। 13।।
śukreṇā''mantritāḥ sarve munayo yajñakarmasu ।
patnīvrataḥ samāyāto brāhmaṇo yajñakarmaṇi ।। 14।।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā munayo yakṣarākṣasāḥ ।
daityāśca dānavā nāgāḥ sarpā uragajātayaḥ ।। 15।।
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca vaināyakāśca kinnarāḥ ।
sūtāśca māgadhāścaiva bandinaścāraṇāstathā ।। 16।।
gāndharvā nartakāścaiva naṭāścāṭā bahirgṛhāḥ ।
kūṣmāṇḍāścaiva vetālā aśuddhāḥ śuddhajātayaḥ ।। 17।।
dyaurgrahāḥ ketavaścāpi tattvānyapi ca śaktayaḥ ।
siddhayo yoginīcakraṃ sādhvyaśca sādhavastathā ।। 18।।
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstathā sevakajātayaḥ ।
nadyaśca parvatāścāpi kṣetratīrthāni sāgarāḥ ।। 19।।
sarāṃsi cāpyaraṇyāni caitāni cāṇḍajāni ca ।
yāni kāni ca divyāni puṇyarūpadharāṇi ca ।।1.145.20।।
caturdaśastarasthāni balirājye sthitāni ca ।
tāni tvākārayāmāsa balistrailokyarājyakṛt ।।2 1।।
lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśastatra pṛthvyāṃ divi ca parvate ।
samudre'raṇyadeśe ca nūpuretya samantataḥ ।।22।।
sarveṣāṃ tu kṛte rājyasamāḥ saudhā vinirmitāḥ ।
antarīkṣavimānāni nagaryo jalavāsinām ।।23 ।।
vāyoḥ stare ca saudhāni meghasthabhavanāni ca ।
parvate'raṇyavṛkṣādau bhūmau bhūmyantare tathā ।।24।।।
yathā yathā ca yeṣāṃ vai vāse dehānukūlatā ।
tathā tathā ca teṣāṃ vai bhavanānyakaronnṛpaḥ ।।25।।
viśvakarmā mayaścātha kāravaḥ śilpinastathā ।
catuḥṣaṣṭhikalāḥ sarvāḥ śilpavidyāḥ sumūrtikāḥ ।।26।।
nagarāṇi tathā grāmā mūrtimanta upasthitāḥ
kāraṇāni ca kāryāṇi ṛtavo māsavatsarāḥ ।।27।।
agnayo marutaḥ sarve dikpālā lokapālakāḥ ।
mūrtimanti ca tattvāni bhūtāni viṣayāstathā ।।।28।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca pārṣadā dāsakoṭayaḥ ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ śivabhaktāśca tathā'nye daivasāttvatāḥ ।।।29।।
yajñe tvākāritāstatra śakunā'śakunāni ca ।
kāmadughāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo garuḍādayaḥ ।। 1.145.30।।
amṛtāni ca dugdhāni vividhānnāni sarvaśaḥ ।
peyānyanekajātīni bhakṣyabhojanaparvatāḥ ।।3 1।।
rasāśca vividhāstatra madyapalalamādakāḥ ।
rūkṣā ārdrāstathā snigdhāḥ khecarānnāni bhūriśaḥ ।।32।।
nivārāśca yavāścaiva godhūmacaṇakā'kṣatāḥ ।
tilā javarikā māṣā havīṃṣyannāni bhūriśaḥ ।। 33।।
na dṛṣṭāni śrutānyeva caturdaśasu bhūmiṣu ।
yāni yeṣāṃ subhojyāni phalapatrādikāni ca ।।34।।
abdhijānyagnijānyatra sambhārottamajāni ca ।
pātravastravibhūṣādiyānavāhanapaṃktayaḥ ।।35।।
vidyuddīpāḥ koṭiśaśca jalayantrāṇyanekaśaḥ ।
kūpā vāpyo vastrasaudhā rasavatyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।36।।
sūdāśca yājñikāstatra ṛtvijā lakṣaśaḥ kṛtāḥ ।
jāpakāḥ pūjakāṃstatra gāyakā vaidikāstathā ।।37।।
vṛtāśca koṭiśaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāstathā'pare ।
vidvāṃso devaguravo daityānāṃ guravastathā ।।38।।
yajñasya vividhe kārye tathā'ṅge yojitāstadā ।
devyo gaṅgādisaritaḥ śāradā ca sarasvatī ।। 39।।
sāvitryādyāstathā cānyā gītakīrtipragalbhikāḥ ।
ṛco vedāśca śāstrāṇi mūrtimanti bhavanti ca ।।1.145.40 ।।
tatra kā nyūnatā vai syād yatra trailokyapālakaḥ ।
mahābhāgavato rājā balirvai yajñakārakaḥ ।।41 ।।
pravarṣantīcchayā yasya sadā lokāścaturdaśa ।
mahāyajñe tadā'trā'bhūt sarvaṃ vai vāmanaṃ vinā ।।42।।।
kāmo vasanto bāṇāśca ratiścāpi samāgatāḥ ।
rāgiṇyaśca tathā rāgā grāmāśca mūrchanā yayuḥ ।।43।।
manvantarāṇi dharmasya vaṃśajāḥ sadguṇādayaḥ ।
vasavo nidhayo rudrā diśā ādityadevatāḥ ।।44।।
candramasaśca nakṣatrā grāmāḥ kheṭāśca kharvaṭāḥ ।
oṣadhyo jalajāścāpi sthalajā mūlajāstathā ।।45।।
amṛtavallikā nāgavallyaśca jīvavallikāḥ ।
bhūgolajñāḥ khagolajñā daivajñā gaṇakāstathā ।।46।।
muhūrtāni tathā yogāḥ sarve ye te samāyayuḥ ।
mallā naṭā bahurūpā nāṭakāni ca khelakāḥ ।।47।।
pradarśanāni divyāni vahnisphoṭāni bhūriśaḥ ।
paśuyuddhāni ramyāṇi naravyāyāmakāṇi ca ।।48।।
vyākhyānāni kathakāśca tyāgisanyāsisādhavaḥ ।
brahmacārijanā bālakhilyāstathordhvaśīlinaḥ ।।49।।
yatkiṃcidvai jagattattvaṃ sarvaṃ tatra samāgatam ।
balinā bahumānena svāgatenā''dṛtaṃ jagat ।।1.145.50।।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ tadā sarvaṃ prajādevamayaṃ hyabhūt ।
antarīkṣaṃ jalaṃ sthānaṃ prāghūrṇikasupūritam ।।5 1 ।।
yathā vā nūtanaṃ tatra brahmāṇḍamiva dṛśyate ।
nedṛśastu samājo vai bhūto bhāvī na vā punaḥ ।।52।।
yajñasya maṇḍapastatra śatagavyūtimānataḥ ।
ā ca svarṇadvārikāta ā ca someśvarāvadhi ।।53।।
ā ca makarālayata ā ca kuṃkumavāpikam ।
bhūmistu maṇḍapaiḥ sā śobhate dyauriva nūtanā ।।54।।
yajñakuṇḍo yojanaṃ tu kamalākāravatkṛtaḥ ।
araṇyebhyaḥ pippalāpāmārgodumbarakiṃśukāḥ ।।।55 ।।
homakāṣṭhāni cānyāni samidhāṃ parvatāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
ājyanārīkelaraṃbhādrākṣādiphalaparvatāḥ ।।5 6 ।।
tilaśāliyavadhānyanivārāṇāṃ ca parvatāḥ ।
puṣpapatramūlaśākhāmañjarībījaparvatāḥ ।।57।।
śarkarā dugdhapākāśca pāyasānnāni bhūriśaḥ ।
hūyante puṣkalānyeva vedaghoṣāśca nākagāḥ ।।58।।
bhojanāni prabhujyante yajñaśiṣṭāni nityadā ।
miṣṭapānāni pīyante yajñaprāsādikāni vai ।।59।।
īśvarāṇāṃ ca devānāmāgamo gama ityapi ।
maṇḍape vartate tatrā'vyavacchinnapravāhaṇaḥ ।।1.145.60।।
ekataśca dvitaścāpi tritaśceti ṛṣitrayam ।
tattaddevādimantraiśca navamutpādyate'rthakam ।।6 1 ।।
arko dvitīyarūpeṇa dvitīyaścandramāstathā ।
prakāśete sadā tatra divārātryorna vai bhidā ।।62।।
avyavacchedyadhārābhirghṛtānāmagnisammukhaiḥ ।
bhuṅakte harirvāmano'yaṃ vyāpakaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।।63।।
evaṃ satatamāgneyaṃ karma sampadyate śubham ।
kimu tatra varṇanīyaṃ śeṣo'pi śramamāptavān ।।64।।
śramamāpurdarśakā vai varṇakānāṃ tu kā kathā ।
bhagavadbhaktiyuktasya sarvaṃ smṛddhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।।65।।।
prabhorbhakteḥ pratāpādvai tvanantāḥ smṛddhayo baleḥ ।
nityaṃ homasya bhojyasya pānasyā'rthyarpaṇasya ca ।।66।।
dakṣiṇāyāṃ suvarṇasyā''nantyasyānto na dāpane ।
dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ ceti bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ tathā ।।67।।
pīyatāṃ pīyatāṃ ceti nīyatāṃ nīyatāṃ tathā ।
svāgataṃ svāgataṃ vaśca pañcakaṃ nātra śāmyati ।।68।।
vedaghoṣā gītighoṣā nāmavoṣā harestathā ।
vādyaghoṣāḥ kīrtighoṣāḥ pañcakaṃ nātra śāmyati ।।69।।
atihṛṣṭo baliryajñe dadau dānaṃ parārdhakam ।
suvarṇānāṃ hīrakāṇāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ ca koṭikāḥ ।।1.145.70।।
gavāṃ dānaparārdhāṇi vastradānā'rbudārbudam ।
vibhūṣāṇāṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ mudrāṇāṃ tvabjakoṭayaḥ ।।71 ।।
chatrāṇāṃ pādukādīnāṃ pātrāṇāṃ ca parārdhakam ।
yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca hastīnāṃ vājināṃ tathā ।।72।।
rathānāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca koṭikoṭyarbudāni ca ।
dānānyevaṃ dadau sākṣād viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇa ivā'paraḥ ।।73।।
vasavo dānakārye'tra mukhyāścaivā'bhavaँstadā ।
lakṣmīḥ ramā mahālakṣmīḥ mukhyāḥ svarṇādidāpane ।।74।।
dyauśca pṛthvī kṛte mukhye ratnabhojyādidāpane ।
merustatra mahāmukhyaḥ pātrapaśvādidāpane ।।75।।
samudrāśca kuberaśca himādryādaya ityapi ।
araṇyāni viśvakarmā mayaścānye divaukasaḥ ।।76।।
ratnabhūṣāvibhūtyādiyānavāhanadāpane ।
mukhyāḥ kṛtāśca te sarve daduḥ sarvasvameva yat ।।77।।
uddhoṣo'bhūccaturdaśalokeṣu sarvato diśi ।
trilokeśo baliryajñe dadau dānāni koṭiśaḥ ।।78।।
svarṇapātreṣu sarvebhyo dīyate bhojanaṃ bahu ।
atithirbrāhmaṇo vidvān sarvasvenāpi pūjyate ।।79।।
sarvalokanivāsinyaḥ prajāstatrā''yayurmakhe ।
gacchantu pratigṛhṇantu dānaṃ bhuñjantu bhojanam ।।1.145.80 ।।
paśyantu kīdṛśo yajño na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।
saurāṣṭradeśe vikhyāto raivatācalasannidhau ।।8 1।।
kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ khyātaṃ tatrā'yaṃ vaiṣṇavo makhaḥ ।
paścimād dakṣiṇe bhāge balerasti mahāmakhaḥ ।।82।।
ityuddhoṣaṃ paraṃ śrutvā vāmano'pi mahāprabhuḥ ।
sarvajño'pyasarvajñavat evaṃ cedyāmi labdhaye ।।83।।
iti kurvan caturvedī brāhmaṇastīrthayātrayā ।
raivatādrau samāyāto lokairajñātaceṣṭitaḥ ।।84।।
mahodaro hrasvabhujo hrasvapādo mahāśirāḥ ।
mahāhanuḥ sthūlakaṇṭhaḥ sthūlajaṃgho'tilālasaḥ ।।85।।
baddhaśikho dhṛtavastracchatropānatkamaṇḍaluḥ ।
vastrāpathe samāyātaḥ svarṇarakṣānadītaṭe ।।86।।
vāmanaścintayāmāsa somanāthaṃ bhaveśvaram ।
dāmodaraṃ tathā dattātreyaṃ raivatakaṃ girim ।।87।।
dṛṣṭvā dattaṃ tato yāmi baleryajñasthalaṃ khalu ।
iti kṛtvā gataḥ someśvaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ dadarśa ca ।।88।।
somanātho mahādevo viṣṇuṃ provāca vāmanam ।
siddhastvaṃ sarvathā viṣṇo kāryasiddhirbhaviṣyati ।।89।।
taṃ natvā ca yayau yatra harastvāste bhaveśvaraḥ ।
samprāptastadvanaṃ divyaṃ ramyaṃ raivatake girau ।।1.145.90 ।।
yatra vṛkṣā naikavidhā dīrghaśākhāḥ phalānvitāḥ ।
vaṭodumbarabilvāśca sarjā'rjunakadambakāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
palāśāśvatthajambvaśca dhavādyā vāruṇadrumāḥ ।
śamīkaṃkolanimbāśca bījapūrāśca dāḍimāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
badaryaśca bakāḥ pūgā śivāḥ kamalaśalyakāḥ ।
hintālāśca śirīṣāśca bījakā vaṃśakhādirāḥ ।।13।।
ajamodā nikuṃbhāśca iṅgudyaśca karīrakāḥ ।
dhāmārgavāḥ kurabakāḥ karaṃjāśca punarnavāḥ ।।94।।
aṃkolāḥ pāribhadrāśca kambalyaḥ panasāstathā ।
utpalāśca haridrāśca gaṇḍīrā vāyasīdrumāḥ ।।95।।
tamālakā rasālāśca kharjūryaḥ karamardakāḥ ।
sevatīśālmalīśālā madhūkāśca bibhītakāḥ ।।96 ।।
harītakyaḥ kandarālā vaṭāścaivāṭarūṣakāḥ ।
vikaṃkatāḥ kapitthāśca rohiṇīvetrapāṭalāḥ ।।97।।
madanāścaiva nirguṇḍyaḥ kadalyaḥ śiṃśapādayaḥ ।
elālavaṃgalavalīsaralāgurupādapāḥ ।।98।।
śrīkhaṇḍakaravīrāśca kalpavṛkṣā mahottamāḥ ।
vāmanena tadā dṛṣṭāḥ chāyāvṛkṣāḥ surārcitāḥ ।।99।।
udayāstamane yeṣāṃ chāyā na pratihanyate ।
dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣāँstaḍāge ca snātvā mūlaṃ gireryayau ।। 1.145.10 0।।
vāpikāyā jalaṃ pītvā yāvadviśrāntimicchati ।
kṣetrapālāḥ pañca tāvad darśanāya samāgatāḥ ।। 101 ।।
ekapādabhidho girestaṭe vasati sarvadā।
giridāruṇanāmā'sau dvitīyo vartate girau ।। 1 02।।
ūrjayantagirermūrdhni meghanādastṛtīyakaḥ ।
bhavānīśikhare ramye siṃhanādaścaturthakaḥ ।। 103।।
svarṇarakṣānadītīre kālamegho vasatyapi ।
vāmanasya darśanaṃ ca kṛtvā te svasthalaṃ gatāḥ ।। 104।।
ekādaśīṃ samārabhya yāvadvai pūrṇimātithiḥ ।
tadbhīṣmapaṃcakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kārtike mokṣakṛddhi tat ।। 1 05।।
pradakṣiṇā prakartavyā svarṇarakṣāplavastathā ।
darśanaṃ sarvathā kāryaṃ dāmodarabhaveśayoḥ ।। 1 06।।
atha nṛsiṃho bhagavān vāmanaṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ ।
stutvā sthitastadā taṃ vai vāmanaḥ prāha nṛhare! ।। 1 07।।
dāmodarāgre bhavatā stheyaṃ vai vacanānmama ।
sadātra rakṣā kartavyā sarveṣāṃ tīrthavāsinām ।। 108।।
devasyā'gre sadā stheyaṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।
evamastviti tatraiṣastīrtharakṣāṃ karoti vai ।। 109।।
tato vai vāmano devo bhavānīṃ skandamātaram ।
draṣṭuṃ sa ca hariryāto śikhare gaganāśrite ।। 110 ।।
dṛṣṭvā bhavānīṃ tāmambāmūrdhvabāhurvyavasthitaḥ ।
nirīkṣya medinīṃ sarvāṃ paścime sāgarāmbarām ।। 11 1।।
tato gatau gorakṣasya śikhare svayamacyutaḥ ।
tatastṛtīye śikhare dattātreyaṃ vyalokayat ।। 112।।
uḍu+īya pūrvasyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
kukumavāpīṃ gatvā kaṃbharāgopāladarśanam ।। 1 13।।
kṛtvā patnīvratatīrthamāyāduḍḍīya raivatam ।
tato maṇipuraṃ cāyāt tataḥ sa vāmanaṃ puram ।। 1 14।।
āsure'tra pure tatra vāmanastu gṛhād gṛham ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ śubhaṃ gatvā nityaṃ bhikṣāṃ tu yācate ।। 1 15।।
catuṣpatheṣu ramyeṣu devatāyataneṣu ca ।
āste parivṛto lokaiścālayan sthūlayaṣṭikām ।। 1 16।।
vidhunoti śiraḥ sthūlaṃ nṛtyati bālalīlayā ।
kvacidyāti hrasvapādairgāyatyatimanoharam ।। 1 17।।
vedānadhīte caturo ghanacchaṭāvibhūṣitān ।
daityānāṃ tanujāḥ sarve brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 1 18।।
vāmanaṃ parito yānti divārātraṃ tu narmabhiḥ ।
vicitraṃ vāmanaṃ rūpaṃ draṣṭumāyānti mānavāḥ ।। 1 19।।
kumārairbahubhirnīto vāmano yajñamaṇḍape ।
yatrāsti dānakartā vai yajamāno balirnṛpaḥ ।। 120।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāmanasya tīrthayātrā, baliyajñe caturdaśabhavānāṃ koṭyabjādisamājaikatrībhavanaṃ, yajñamaṇḍapakuṇḍahomadānāni, vāmanasya raivatācalayātrā, vāmanapurasthitistato
yajñamaṇḍape baliṃ pratyāgamanamiti nirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ।। 145।।


← adhyāyaḥ 145 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 146
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 147 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi mamāścaryakaraṃ vāmanadarśanam ।
vilakṣaṇaṃ tu sarvebhyo dṛṣṭvā jātaṃ kutūhalam ।। 1 ।।
mahān kolāhalo jātaḥ kaściddhrasvaḥ samāgataḥ ।
rūpeṇa tejasā viṣṇusamo dehena chadmakṛt ।। 2 ।।
brāhmaṇairbahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ vedānuccārayan sthitaḥ ।
praviṣṭairdaityabālaiḥ sa daityāya viniveditaḥ ।। 3 ।।
draṣṭuṃ samāgato'yaṃ vai brāhmaṇo vāmano'dhvaram ।
balirhṛṣṭo'bravrīdvākyaṃ mama bhāgyodayo hyayam ।। 4 ।।
nirīho vāmano devo yācate naiva kiṃcana ।
pūjayiṣyāmi viprendraṃ dāsye cāsya yadīpsitam ।। 5 ।।
abhyāgataḥ svayaṃ viṣṇustasmai deyaṃ yadicchati ।
kiṃcidvedamayaṃ pātraṃ kiṃcitpātraṃ tapomayam ।। 6 ।।
pātraṃ satyaṃ samāgatya balimuddhārayiṣyati ।
yajñe pravartamāne tu dātavyā dakṣiṇā mayā ।। 7 ।।
sahasrapūrakaścāyaṃ yajño me'ntima eva vai ।
sarvasvamatra dātavyaṃ yācakebhyo'vicārya yat ।। 8 ।।
indrapadapralābhāya śataṃ tu kratavo matāḥ ।
pārameṣṭhipadalābhaḥ sahasrakratubhirbhavet ।। 9 ।।
tasmādayaṃ mahāyajño mā bhūnnakārasaṃkaraḥ ।
dātavyameva dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ sarvathaiva hi ।। 1.146.10।।
nakāro naiva vaktavyo dehastryapatyavastuṣu ।
dhanyo'smi kṛtakṛtyo'smi saphalaṃ mama jīvitam ।। 1 1।।
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā niveśya kusumāsane ।
praṇipatya namaskṛtvā prāha gadgadayā girā ।। 12।।
tvāṃ samabhyarcya viprendra kiṃ karomi tava priyam ।
āgato'si yadarthaṃ tvaṃ māmuddiśya dvijottama ।। 13।।
tatprayacchāmi te śīghraṃ brūhi vedavidāṃ vara ।
hrasvaḥ prahṛṣṭamanasā tamuvāca mahīpatim ।। 14।।
agnikuṇḍasya pṛthivīṃ dehi daityapate mama ।
mama trivikramamitāṃ pṛthvīṃ tvaṃ dātumarhasi ।। 15।।
sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ bhūmidānaṃ mahottamam ।
yo dadāti mahīṃ rājan viprāyā'kiṃcanāya vai ।। 16।।
aṃguṣṭhamātrāmapi vā sa bhavetpṛthivīpatiḥ ।
na bhūmidānasadṛśaṃ poṣakaṃ ceha vidyate ।। 17।।
bhūmiṃ yaḥ pratigṛhṇāti bhūmiṃ yaśca prayacchati ।
ubhau tau puṇyakarmāṇau niyatau svargagāminau ।। 18।।
tasmād bhūmiṃ mahārāja prayaccha tripadīṃ mama ।
etāmalpāṃ mahīṃ dātuṃ mā viśaṃka mahīpate ।। 1 9।।
jagattrayapradānena nāma bhūpa bhaviṣyati ।
tataḥ prahṛṣṭahṛdayastathetyāha mahīpatiḥ ।।।1.146.20।।
tasmai mahīpradānaṃ tu kartuṃ mene vidhānataḥ ।
tāvattasya guruḥ śukro vārayāmāsa taṃ balim ।।21।।
anyadvai dīyatāṃ dāna mā rājan dīyatāṃ mahī ।
kintvanyacchrūyatāṃ rājannakāryaṃ kriyate tvayā ।।22।।
bahiḥ pūjyā dvijā ye syurdīnāndhakṛpaṇādayaḥ ।
badhirā vāmanāḥ kubjā vṛkṇā rugṇāśca niṣṭhurāḥ ।।।22।।।
kratukuṇḍāntike naiva khāṇḍāste'rhanti pūjanam ।
suvarṇarajatairvastrairvāmanaḥ pūjyatā bahiḥ ।।24।।
caturṇāṃ tu vṛthā janma vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa ।
aputrāṇāṃ vṛthā janma hyadharmiṇāṃ vṛthā janiḥ ।।25।।
parā'nnināṃ vṛthā janma parastraiṇī vṛthājaniḥ ।
vyarthamabrāhmaṇe dānamanūḍhe patite tathā ।।26।।
sandhyāhīnanāmavipre kuṭile taskare tathā ।
guroścā'prītijanake pitṛmātṛparāṅmukhe ।।27।।
brahmabandhau kṛtaghne ca vedavikrayiṇi tathā ।
svagrāmayācake strīnirjite ca vṛṣalīpatau ।।28।।।
vyālagrāhe nindake ca vṛthādānāni ṣoḍaśa ।
atrāntare balirbrūte naivaṃ vācyaṃ tvayā guro ।।29।।
vedānadhīte yaḥ kaścit sa me viṣṇusamo mataḥ ।
na vilambastu kartavyaḥ śrotriye gṛhamāgate ।।1.146.30।।
abhyutthānena vacasā pādaprakṣālanena ca ।
yathāśaktyā pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ gṛhamedhinā ।। 3 1।।
apūjito yadā yāti vāmano yajñamaṇḍapāt ।
tadā'yaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti yajñaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ ।।32।।
tasmādenaṃ dvijaṃ channaṃ vāmanaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam ।
prakāśamānaṃ vapuṣā piṃgalaṃ sūryasannibham ।। 33।।
yatheṣṭaṃ tasya dāsye vai rājyaṃ kiṃ na samicchati ।
dhanyo'haṃ yasya me yajñe prāpto viṣṇusamo dvijaḥ ।।।34।।
iti kṛtvā dadau tasmai ṣoḍaśopacarāṇi vai ।
madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ tasmai satvaraṃ sa nyavedayat ।।।35।।
āghrāya madhuparkaṃ ca gaurhrasvena namaskṛtā ।
yajñaṃ yajñagatān sarvānnamaskṛtya ca vāmanaḥ ।। 36।।
ahamarthī samāyāto dīyatāṃ vada kiṃ bale ।
vāsārthaṃ mama daityendra dayitāṃ me kramatrayam ।।37।।
vidhāya kuṭikāṃ divyāṃ śiṣyānadhyāpayāmyaham ।
dattaṃ kramatrayaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhītaṃ vāmano'bravīt ।।38।।
mā dehītyavadacchukro viṣṇureṣaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
baliḥ prāha tadā śukraṃ pātraṃ syāt kimataḥ param ।।39।।
savyaṃ kṛtvā balirdarbhān sākṣatān dakṣiṇe kare ।
prayogaṃ na guruścakre na muṃcati jalaṃ kare ।।1.146.40 ।।
sabhāsadaśca hotāro vismitā ṛṣayastathā ।
viprāḥ surāstathā lokā daityāstasya kuṭumbinaḥ ।।41।।
dattaṃ gṛhītamityukte kasmāttoyaṃ na muñcati ।
vāmanāya kare toyaṃ kalyāṇāya pradīyate ।।42।।
yad dānaṃ vacasā dattaṃ karmaṇā nopapadyate ।
dātāraṃ niraye kṣiptvā tatkuṭumbaṃ nikṛntati ।।।43।।
uśanāḥ prāha daityendraṃ vāmano harirityayam ।
eṣa viṣṇuḥ pareśo'tha devaiḥ samprārthito hariḥ ।।44।।
kenāpi daivayogena tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ samupāgataḥ ।
vañcayitvā mahīṃ sarvāṃ tvattaḥ prāptumihāgataḥ ।।45।।
apriyaṃ vā priyaṃ vāpi na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati ।
tasmānmahī na dātavyā tasmai rājanmahātmane ।।46।।
anyamarthaṃ samādatsva vacanānmama bhūpate ।
tataḥ prahasya rājā'sau taṃ guruṃ prāha dhairyataḥ ।।47।।
jānāmyahaṃ daivabalād viṣṇoranugrahāttathā ।
yajñastu pūrṇatāṃ ceyād dvijaiḥ pūrṇo bhavatyapi ।।48।।
ahamindro dvijo viṣṇurdravyamādityadevatā ।
tatkathaṃ na mayā deyaṃ viṣṇave prīyatāmiti ।।49।।
ityuktvā sa dadau toyaṃ vāmanāya kare baliḥ ।
hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ kimidaṃ rājan kriyate yogyameva na ।।1.146.50।।
ityuccārya tadā śukraḥ saṃsthito maṇḍapādbahiḥ ।
prītaye vāsudevasya sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ।।51।।
adya dhanyo'smyahaṃ viṣṇuḥ svayamevā''gato yadi ।
tasya pradeyamevā'dya jīvitaṃ ca mahāsukham ।।52 ।।
tasmādasmai prayacchāmi trilokīmapi ca dhruvam ।
pariṇīya namaskṛtya pādau prakṣālya bhaktitaḥ ।।53।।
caraṇāmṛtamevā''sye balinā mūrdhni ca dhṛtam ।
prahṛṣṭenātmanā tena datvā vai dakṣiṇaṃ vasu ।।54।।
dhanyo'smi kṛtakṛtyo'smi prāha datvā mahīṃ tadā ।
yatheṣṭaṃ tava viprendra tadgṛhāṇa mahīmimām ।।55।।
api cedicchasi rājyaṃ svarṇaṃ vā hīrakādikam ।
naikadhāni ca ratnāni dāsadāsīśatāni ca ।।56।।।
godhanaṃ ca tadanyacca prāsādā bhavanāni ca ।
sādhanāni vimānāni dadāmīcchasi ced yadi ।।57।।
ahaṃ vā rājapatnī me putrapautrādikaṃ ca yat ।
sarvaṃ dadāmi deveśa tvadarthaṃ mama yad bhavet ।।58।।
anantajanmatapasā nā''pyate'pi paraḥ pumān ।
kṛpayā sa yadi prāptaḥ kiṃ me dārādhanādibhiḥ ।।59।।
ityuccārya balirbhakto'luṃṭhad vāmanapādayoḥ ।
vāmanaḥ prāha bhaktendra sarvaṃ padatraye sthitam ।।1.146.60 ।।
tava bhaktyā prasanno'smi rājaँstava samīpataḥ ।
māpayāmi padenā'dya pṛthivīṃ tava paśyataḥ ।।61।।
ityuktvā baṭurūpaṃ tad vihāya parameśvaraḥ ।
vavṛdhe vāmano'tīva kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam ।।62।।।
vardhamānaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāḥ ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ ।
tuṣṭuvurgagane jātaṃ bhagavantaṃ janārdanam ।।63।।
jaya viṣṇo jaya viṣṇo jaya bhaktakṛpākara ।
jaya hrasva jaya dīrgha jaya bhikṣuka vāmana ।।64।।
jaya devakṛpākartṛ jaya bhaktasya gocara ।
jaya yajña jaya havya jaya vahne jayā'cyuta ।।65।।
jayā'rthin dātṛ netṛ tvaṃ jaya brahmāṇḍakṛdvapuḥ ।
jaya matsya namastubhyaṃ jaya kūrma dharādhara ।।66।।
jaya vārāharūpadhṛk nṛsiṃhāya namo'stu te ।
jaya kṛṣṇa jaya śrīmannārāyaṇa namo'stu te ।।67।।
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya kambharāgopālāya namo namaḥ ।
namaḥ patnīvratākhyāya lakṣmīnāthāya te namaḥ ।।68।।
varṇitaṃ bahudhā śāstre dṛṣṭaṃ naiva kadāpi yat ।
dṛśyate'dya kṛpāleśāccaturdaśadharāsthitaiḥ ।।69।।
vairājaṃ te mahadrūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭāḥ sma tāritāḥ ।
yoginaḥ sanakādyā ye te stuvanti janārdanam ।।1.146.70।।
gaganārdhaṃ gate kṛṣṇe vardhamāne baleḥ puraḥ ।
ūrdhvavaktrāḥ sthitāḥ sarve nirīkṣante divaṃ gatam ।।71।।
chatraṃ yaṣṭirmṛgacarma kamaṇḍaluśca pāduke ।
yad yadabhūddhareragre sarvaṃ vai vavṛdhe saha ।।72।।
dṛṣṭacchatrākṛtistāvat paścādūrdhvagato hariḥ ।
cūḍāmaṇirivā''bhāti bhāskaro harimastake ।।73।।
tataḥ punarvavṛdhe'tha lalāṭe tilakāyate ।
athāpi vardhito hariḥ sūryaḥ sa kuṇḍalāyate ।।74।।
uccairgato haristasmāt sūryaḥ sa kaustubhāyate ।
agre gatvā mahendreṇa vanamālā gale'rpitā ।।75।।
pṛthivī kampate bhārāt svargasthaṃ grahamaṇḍalam ।
nāśameṣyati daityāste bhītāḥ paśyanti vāmanam ।।76।।
athāpi vavṛdhe kṛṣṇo nābhau padmāyate raviḥ ।
pañcāśatkoṭivistīrṇāṃ sasamudramahīdharām ।।77।।
sasāgarāṃ sadvīpāṃ ca sadevāsuramānuṣām ।
pādenaikena puruṣo jagrāha madhusūdanaḥ ।।78।।
tatpadaṃ pṛthivīṃ sarvāmākramya padmaje śubhe ।
atiriktaṃ samabhavacchatayojanamāyatam ।।79।।
divyaṃ cakṣurdadau tasmai daityeśāya sanātanaḥ ।
tadviśvarūpaṃ devasya dṛṣṭvā daityośvaro baliḥ ।।1.146.80 ।।
praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe sānandāśrupariplutaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ namaskṛtya stutvā stutibhireva ca ।।8 1 ।।
prāha gadgadayā vācā prahṛṣṭenā'ntarātmanā ।
dhanyo'smi kṛtakṛtyo'smi tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśvaram ।।82।।
lokatrayaṃ tvamevaitad gṛhāṇa parameśvara ।
atha sarveśvaro viṣṇurdvitīyaṃ padamacyutam ।।83।।
ūrdhvaṃ prasārayāmāsa brahmalokāntamacyutaḥ ।
pādo na paripūrṇo'bhūdacyutasya śubhānane ।।84।।
vegenotkṣipya hariṇā nīto brahmāṇḍamastake ।
brahmāṇḍaṃ jarjaraṃ jātaṃ pādāṃguṣṭhābhidhātanāt ।।85।।
bhinnaṃ cāsmin samāyātaṃ bāhyaṃ toyaṃ jagattraye ।
viṣṇupādodbhavā gaṃgā tatsthānāt prasṛtā tadā ।।86।।
pitāmaho hareḥ pādaṃ cakrapadmādicihnitam ।
jñātvā kamaṇḍaluṃ bhṛtvā tatastajjalavāribhiḥ ।।87।।
muhuḥ prakṣālayāmāsa śrīhareścaraṇāmbujam ।
tat toyamakṣayyameva jātaṃ kṛṣṇaprabhāvataḥ ।।88।।
tattīrthaṃ meruśikhare papāta salilaṃ śubham ।
jagataḥ pāvanārthaṃ vai caturdikṣu pravāhitam ।।89।।
pūrve sītā dakṣiṇe sā'lakanandeti kīrtitā ।
paścime cakṣurityākhyā bhadrākhyā cottare matā ।।1.146.90।।
tatra cālakanandāpi tridhā nāmnā'bhavat tadā ।
ūrdhve mandākinī proktā madhye gaṃgā prakīrtitā ।। 9 1।।
pātāle sā yadā prāptā hyajo bhogavatī matā ।
svardhunī procyate svarge gaṃgā tu gāṃ gatā satī ।।।92।।
pātāle tu gatā sā'bhūnnāmnā tripathagā'pi ca ।
sevitā pūjitā dṛṣṭā spaṣṭā pītā'vagāhitā ।।93 ।।
prajvālya sarvapāpāni muktiṃ dadāti dehine ।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā merumadhyāttu prasravantīṃ śubhānane ।।94।।
ativegapravāhaiśca patantīṃ dhārayettu kaḥ ।
mahāpravāhavegaṃ bhūrdṛṣṭvā bhītā vidāraṇāt ।।95।।
prārthayāmāsa śaṃbhuṃ tāṃ dhārayituṃ jaṭāvane ।
ātmanaḥ pāvanārthāya mūrdhnā śaṃbhuradhārayat ।।96।।
divyavarṣasahasraṃ sā jaṭāyāmeva saṃsthitā ।
tato bhāgīrathī rājā gautamaśca mahātapāḥ ।।97।।
prasādya tapasayā śaṃbhuṃ gaṃgārthaṃ samayācata ।
sarvalokahitārthāya tābhyāṃ dattā tu śaṃbhunā ।।98।।
gautamena samānītā gautamīti prakīrtitā ।
bhagīrathena cāyātā bhāgīrathīti cocyate ।।99।।
jahnunā pīyamānā sā jānośca prakaṭīkṛtā ।
jāhnavīti samākhyātā samudrāntā hi pāvanī ।। 1.146.10 0।।
kapilasyā''śrame dagdhān sagarasyātmajān bahūn ।
uddhārayitvā ṣaṣṭisāhasrānabdhāvavāpatat ।। 10 1।।
evaṃ vṛddhiṃ gato viṣṇurjagṛhe ca padadvayam ।
sthānaṃ nāsti tṛtīyasya brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ hṛtam ।। 10 2।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāmanasya yajñasthale praveśaḥ, bhūmiyācanā, śukrakṛnniṣedhe'pi tripadabhūmidānaṃ, vāmanavardhanaṃ, dvitīyapadenā'ṇḍakaṭāhād gaṃgodbhava ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo'-
dhyāyaḥ ।। 146 ।।
