adhyāyaḥ 154
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 155 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! maṇivrāte raivate divyataijase ।
mandarādriḥ samāyātaḥ svarṇapāṣāṇamiśraṇaḥ ।। 1 ।।
divye tejomaye tatrā'ntargatvā sthūlabhāvataḥ ।
militvā saṃsthitastena maṇestejo na dṛśyate ।। 2 ।।
kumudādristathā tatrā''yāto raivatake girau ।
so'pyantarbhūya sthaulyena vartate raivatācale ।। 3 ।।
śṛṇu divyāṃ kathāṃ tāṃ vai pūrvakṛtayugodbhavām ।
purā kṛtayuge sarve sapakṣāḥ parvatāḥ kṛtāḥ ।। 4 ।।
uḍḍayanto mahākāyā nipatanti yadṛcchayā ।
merumandarakailāsā brahmaṇā vāritāḥ sthirāḥ ।। ।9 ।।
anye tu vāritāścāpi sthāyino na yadā'bhavan ।
tadendreṇa svavajreṇa pakṣāsteṣāṃ nikṛntitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
merordakṣiṇaśṛṃge tu kumudo nāma parvataḥ ।
divyaṃ sapakṣaḥ sauvarṇo divyodyānasamṛddhimān ।। 7 ।।
sarvā vaikuṇṭhasadṛśī sthalī smṛddhā suśobhanā ।
tatropari purī divyā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇunā kṛtā ।। 8 ।।
tanmadhye ca mahān viṣṇo prāsādo ramayā yutaḥ ।
meroḥ śṛṃge mandarākhye purī śivasya śobhanā ।। 9 ।।
sauvarṇā ca sabhā tatra bhavānī modate sadā ।
brahmaṇaścāpi nagarī prāsādaśca supauraṭaḥ ।। 1.154.10।।
ratnahīrakamaṇyāḍhyaḥ śṛṃge tasyā'ruṇācale ।
vartate yatra te devāstrayaḥ kurvati mantraṇām ।। 1 1।।
kumude vaiṣṇave sthāne sauvarṇā vallayo'bhavan ।
puṣpāṇyapi piśaṃgāni sauvarṇāni ca saurabhaḥ ।। 1 2।।
sugandho dīyate nityaṃ puryāṃ pauṣpaḥ suvāyunā ।
vṛkṣāścāpi sugandhāḍhyapatramañjarikānvitāḥ ।। 13 ।।
sugandhaṃ vāhayantyeva pratisaudhaṃ ca vāyavaḥ ।
ekadā bhagavān rudraḥ kumude tu samāgataḥ ।। 14।।
gṛhāgataṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇunā paripūjitaḥ ।
lakṣmyā ca pūjitā gaurī harṣitā satkṛtā hyati ।। 15।।
ekāsanopaviṣṭau tau mantrayantau parasparam ।
tāvadvai kumudastatra mandaraścāpi parvataḥ ।। 16।।
nararūpaṃ sudhṛtvā vai sevāyāṃ samupāgatau ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha hariṃ tatra balistu balavān yataḥ ।। 17।।
tvayā neyastu sutalaṃ pṛthvītaḥ sarvathā hare! ।
vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya girau tu raivatācale ।। 18।।
mayāpi tatra gantavyaṃ girau vai raivatācale ।
baleḥ sutale vāsaṃ ca kārayitvā tu chadmanā ।। 19।।
punaścātrā''gamiṣyāmaḥ kṛtakāryau divaukasām ।
saṃprāha mādhavastam om tāvattau parvatau mudā ।।1.154.20 ।।
kumudamandarau hariharau prārthayataḥ puraḥ ।
āvāṃ saha gamiṣyāvastatra yatra harirharaḥ ।।2 1।।
tathā'stviti varaṃ prāpya bhūbhṛtau tau tirogatau ।
hariharau sapatnīkau jagmaturvedhasaṃ prati ।।।22।।
aruṇācalaśikhare purī yatra prajāpateḥ ।
baleḥ sutalavāsārthaṃ kṛtvā vai mantraṇāṃ tataḥ ।।23।।
tau pratyājagmatuḥ svasvapuryāṃ svasvagirau punaḥ ।
prāpte tu samaye viṣṇurvāmanaḥ saṃbabhūva ha ।।24।।
jagāma ca baleryajñe śaṃkaro'pi jagāma ca ।
saurāṣṭre raivate deśe tadā kumudamandarau ।। 25 ।।
āyayatuḥ sapakṣau tāvuḍḍayitvā'ntarīkṣagau ।
tāvanyān bahunakṣatragaṇānākṛṣya vegataḥ ।। 26।।
ājagmatuḥ svarṇarekhānadīsthe raivatācale ।
tadā tayostadanyāyaṃ jñātvā deveśvaraḥ svayam ।। 27।।
gṛhītvā ca svakaṃ vajraṃ pakṣanāśanahetave ।
vimānavaramāruhya jagāma yatra tau girī ।।28।।
yāvad vajraṃ prahiṇoti tāvat tau parvatau muhuḥ ।
prāñjalī prāhaturdevau rakṣaṇāya harā'cyutau ।।29।।
drāgevendraḥ stambhitaśca savajrahastakastadā ।
mā hantavyāvimāvadrī prāhatustaṃ harācyutau ।।1.154.30 ।।
indrastau prārthayāmāsa staṃbhanasya vimuktaye ।
varayāmāsa kumudamandaroḍḍayanakṣayam ।।3 1 ।।
tathā'stviti varaṃ datvā mahendrastaṃbhanaṃ tadā ।
nivārya ca kumudādriṃ mandarādriṃ tu raivate ।।32।।
taijase'drau hariharau sthāpayāmāsatuḥ sadā ।
ambāyā mandaraḥ so'yaṃ kumudastu samantataḥ ।।।3 3 ।।
kamalākāratāṃ prāpto dvādaśapatrabhedataḥ ।
tāvimau parvatau śailau dṛśyete taijase maṇau ।। 34।।
raivate taijase tattve pārthivau tau niṣedatuḥ ।
tatra dāmodaro viṣṇurbhavaḥ śaṃbhurniṣedatuḥ ।।35।।
brahmā'ruṇācalaṃ nītvā samājagāma tatra vai ।
mandarāt pūrvadigbhāge'sthāpayat so'ruṇācalam ।। 36।।
tatra brahmā svakaṃ vāsaṃ kṛtvovāsa kamaṇḍalum ।
yatra vai mandare kuṇḍe babhāra sa jalāśayaḥ ।। 37।।
jātaḥ kamaṇḍalukuṇḍastīrthamakṣayapuṇyadam ।
aruṇādrau prathame tu śṛṃge brahmā hyuvāsa yat ।। 38।।
sthala tad brahmakuṭyākhyaṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ tu mokṣadam ।
aruṇādrau dvitīye ca dattātreyo mahān prabhuḥ ।। 39 ।।
dāruṇaṃ vai tapastepe tīrthaṃ mokṣakaraṃ ca tat ।
evaṃ vedhohariharāstiṣṭhanti revatāśrite ।।1.154.40 ।।
mandare kumude caivā'ruṇādrau prakṣiṇi priye ।
prāpte laye gamiṣyanti merau tai parvatāstrayaḥ ।।41।।
sapakṣā vai gamiṣyanti tāvat sthāsyanti tatra vai ।
teṣu triṣu trayo devāstrayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ ।।42।।
devā vasanti tatrāpi rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ priye ।
raivatasya prakramaṇo kṛtaṃ merupradakṣiṇam ।।43।।
raivatasya pūjane ca kṛtaṃ meroḥ prapūjanam ।
raivatasya darśane tu kṛtaṃ merośca darśanam ।।44।।
triṃśatkrośaṃ raivatādriṃ ye prayānti pradakṣiṇam ।
kṛtaṃ merośca pṛthvyāśca pradakṣiṇaṃ tu tairiha ।।45।।
mandarāruṇayoryaistu kṛtaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tu taiḥ ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtaṃ satyakailāsābhidhalokayoḥ ।।46।।
kumudasya dvādaśaparvatānāṃ tu pradakṣiṇam ।
yena kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vaikuṇṭhasya pradakṣiṇam ।।47।।
yadā devāstrayaścā'tra nivāsāya samāgatāḥ ।
naranarāyaṇau tatra boriyākhye vane gatau ।।48।।
brahmakamaṇḍalukuṇḍād gaṃgā guptā tu jāmbavī ।
patatyadho boriyākhye bhūgate badrikāśrame ।।49।।
naranārāyaṇau sarvarṣibhiryuktau tu tāpasau ।
janā'dṛśyau hi vartete dṛśyete puṇyaśālibhiḥ ।।1.154.5 0।।
dakṣiṇe mandarādgaṃgāmūle tau vasataḥ sadā ।
uttare mandarāt tatra bhavantyāmravanāni vai ।।5 1 ।।
vaikuṇṭhātparamād vāryāvaraṇasthāt samāgataḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ sītāpatiścāmravanaiḥ saha ।।52।।
ātmā muktāḥ śāśvatā vai sarvadā phalaśālinaḥ ।
sughaṭāpatraśākhābhiḥ sāketānāṃ niketanam ।।5 3।।
sughaṭṭaṃ ca vanaṃ tatra sītāvanamitīritam ।
lakṣmaṇasya vanaṃ rāma vanaṃ kīśavanaṃ tathā ।।14।।
sītāpaṭī vanakṣmā ca divyā dhāmasamāsti sā ।
yatra sūryo na vai bhāti na bhāti śaśitārakam ।।55 ।।
vidyuto yatra no bhānti hyagnirbhāti kutastadā ।
tādṛśaṃ tanmahādivyajalaprasravaṇānvitam ।।56।।
svarṇarūpyagairikādidhātubhūkhanikā'nvitam ।
sarvartusukhadaṃ divyaṃ viśālaṃ vanamasti yat ।।57।।
śāśvate tatra sākete vane prasravaṇātmikā ।
sarayūrbhinnasalilanirjharaṇairvahatyapi ।।।58।।
hanumān vartate tatra vane rakṣaṇakāraṇāt ।
tīrthametat mahat proktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param ।।59।।
pūrve ca raivate bhāge'ruṇā'calasamīpataḥ ।
indradyumnasarastatra samāgatya pratiṣṭhati ।।1.154.60 ।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāṃśca naranārāyaṇaṃ tathā ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ sītārāmaṃ śrutvā samāgatān ।।6 1 ।।
puruṣottamapuryāstu jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ ।
nīlākhyaṃ parvataṃ nītvā vaṭavṛkṣaṃ tathā'bdhijam ।।62।।
samāgato'tra vāsāya nyūṣuste prāgdiśi dhruvam ।
ṭīmburuphalajātāni jāmbvāmalakakarmadāḥ ।।53।।
āmrāśca rāvaṇāścaiva badaryaścāmṛtāni ca ।
sītāphalāni bahuśaḥ santi yatra vanāni vai ।।64।।
dugdhasamaṃ jalaṃ yatrā'mṛtasvāduphalāni ca ।
sukhaṃ svargasamaṃ yatra prāgbhāgeraivatācale ।।656।।
kṛṣṇā ca mṛttikā yatra svarṇarasasumiśritā ।
vibhinnā dhātavaḥ santi viṃśatikrośabhūmayaḥ ।।66 ।।
tataḥ pūrve śubhaṃ kṣetramaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
ciñcāṃ'gūdīvanaṃ ramyaṃ śubhā kuṃkumavāpikā ।।67।।
śatrūñjitānadī saumyā kaṃbharākṣetramucyate ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśca kaṃbharāgopālasaṃjñayā ।।68।।
pūjyate vandyate devairbhūsurairmānavaistathā ।
patnīvratasya viprasya vaṃśastatrāpi tiṣṭhati ।।69।।
kuṃkumavāpikāyāścottare krośadvayāt param ।
kṣetraṃ puṇyamaraṇyādiyutaṃ ramyaṃ ca vidyate ।।1.154.70 ।।
laṃkācatuṣṭakīkṣetraṃ yatra guptā sarasvatī ।
prakāśā vartate cāpi sudivyasalilānvitā ।।71 ।।
himācalād yadā devī sarasvatī mahānadī ।
vāḍavā'gniṃ samādāya yātā paścimavāridhim ।।72।।
tadā'rbudācalāt siddhakṣetraṃ śrīnagaraṃ tathā ।
gatvā virāṭanagaraṃ sāraṃgaṃ durgametya ca ।।73 ।।
unmattagaṃgāṃ bhogāṃ ca bhadrāṃ samprāpya vai tataḥ ।
laṃkācatuṣṭakīkṣetraṃ prāptvā jayantamāgatā ।।74।।
bhadreśvaranṛsiṃhākhyaghaṭṭaṃ gatvā taduttaram ।
skandapuraṃ tathā kālīvaṭaṃ ca nagaraṃ gatā ।।79 ।।
ājyāṃ prakāśamāsādya suvarṣādvārikāṃ gatā ।
tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge barāṭākhye tu parvate ।।76।।
bilveśaṃ harṣadāṃ prāpya navanītādrimāgatā ।
vāmanasthalamāsādya vastrāpathamumāgatā ।।77।।
raivatādriṃ parivīya parvataṃ ca kṛtasmaram ।
prajvālya balikhātaṃ ca gatvā prācīsthapippalam ।।78।।
ekatarṣisthalaṃ prāpya somanāthaṃ samāgatā ।
vyāghrāraṇye śubhaṃ guptaprayāgaṃ prāpya sā tataḥ ।।79।।
siṃhāraṇye divyabhūmau gatvā'ro'bdhau viveśa sā ।
vāḍavā'gniṃ samutsṛjya punaḥ sā raivatācale ।।1.154.80।।
sarvadā saṃsthitā devī pratisthānaṃ sarasvatīṃ ।
kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthitā devī janakalyāṇahetave ।।8 1।।
hanumannāmavikhyātāḥ kapayo raivatācale ।
sītāmaḍhī ca hanumanmaḍhī santamaḍhī tathā ।।82।।
vyāghreśvarī mahādevī māhiṣākhye girau sthitā ।
śrīrāmapādukātīrthaṃ bilveśaṃ hāṭakeśvaram ।।83।।
evamanyāni tīrthāni santi lakṣmi! tu raivate ।
tārakāṇi prāṇināṃ vai bhuktimuktipradāni ca ।।84।।
yathākathañcikchraddhādyaiḥ svārthenāpi prahelayā ।
kṛtāni yena tīrthāni dṛṣṭapītāni vā tathā ।।85।।
snātāni tajjaladhūlīkardamāni dhṛtāni vā ।
teṣāṃ pāpavināśena bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhruvam ।।86।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtayugasantāne taijasaraivatācale kumudamandarā'ruṇanīlādiparvatānāṃ
badrikānaranārāyaṇalakṣmīnārāyaṇasītārāmajagannāthasarasvatīṃprabhatitīrthānāmāgamananirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 154।।



← adhyāyaḥ 154 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 155
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 156 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahālakṣmīḥ paravaikuṇṭhavāsinī ।
yathā nārāyaṇenaiva sahā''jagāma raivate ।। 1 ।।
baliryadā hariṇā vai baddhastadā'tra raivate ।
maṇḍape tu baleḥ patnī sasmāra parameśvarīm ।। 2 ।।
mahālakṣmīṃ tadā stotrairbalerbandhanivṛttaye ।
mahāvaikuṇṭhadhāmastho prahvībhāvena hṛdgatām ।। 3 ।।
sandhyāvalī prāñjalistāṃ natvā hṛdi jagāda ca ।
namo mātre mahālakṣmyai trāhi bhaktaṃ ca me patim ।। 4 ।।
namaḥ prakṛtisaṃjñāyai mūlāyai te namonamaḥ ।
saṃhartryai brahmamātre te kukṣisṛṣṭyai namonamaḥ ।। 5 ।।
vāmanā vāpi dīrghāśca nārāyaṇāstu te mukhe ।
mahākālādayaścāpi santi grāsāśca te namaḥ ।। 6 ।।
saṃkarṣaṇāstathā rudrā yamāścaiva tavā''nane ।
daṃṣṭraikacarvaṇāḥ sarve mahāmātre namonamaḥ ।। 7 ।।
vāsudevastathā bhūmā nārāyaṇāśca pūruṣāḥ ।
tvatpallatātāḍitāste mahāśaktyai namonamaḥ ।। 8 ।।
tvatto lakṣmīḥ samutpannā mahāviṣṇustvadaṃkajaḥ ।
brahmāṇḍāni ca te romṇi rakṣa lakṣmyai namonamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
mahāgnayastu te gupte tvatsvede vāḍavā'nalāḥ ।
bhagavantaśca te garbhe caṇḍalakṣmyai namo'vatu ।। 1.155.10।।
jṛmbhe te pralayāḥ santi caṇḍe kālaḥ prakampate ।
cūrṇāyante mahāṇḍāni pṛṣṭhamnīḍe namo'stu te ।। 1 1।।
rakṣa rakṣa mahāmāye patiṃ me parameśvari ।
caṇḍī taṇḍī mahāmuṇḍī ghamaṇḍī ḍiṇḍikādikāḥ ।।।12।।
kālīkarālīprajvālīlihālīraktilādikāḥ ।
śaktayaste raktaleśaḥ pāhi kāntaṃ drutaṃ kuru ।। 13 ।।
pāhi śīghraṃ cānyathā tvāṃ galaṃ nikṛtya pūjaye ।
yadyahaṃ vidhavā syāṃ cet pūrvaṃ tvaṃ vidhavā bhava ।। 14।।
yadyahaṃ rājyaśūnyāṃ syāṃ tvaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vinā bhava ।
yadyavamānito rājā syātpatiste'pyamānitaḥ ।। 15।।
madyajñe ced bhavet vighnaṃ tava yajñe tathā'stu vai ।
vadatyevaṃ caṇḍavegā dravṛṇvantyapi sabhāsadaḥ ।। 16।।
mā metyevaṃ tadā devā nivārayanti tāṃ striyam ।
tāvat tatrāgatā patnī mahālakṣmīrmahāprabhoḥ ।। 17।।
sāntvayitvā ca tāṃ rājñīṃ patitā kharvapādayoḥ ।
mā maivaṃ deva cātyantaṃ mā bhaktasya hara prabho ।। 18।।
vāmanaśca tadā prāha nainaṃ vai mārayāmyaham ।
rājyabhraṣṭaṃ ca naivā'haṃ karomyenaṃ susevakam ।। 19।।
sandhyāvalī sadevā'stu susaubhāgyavatī priye ।
daityo'yaṃ daityarājyaṃ vai karotu sutale priye ।।1.155.20।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ yadyahaṃ tyakṣye nivatsye tadbalergṛhe ।
tvayā saha mahālakṣmi rājñī sevāṃ karotu me ।।2 1।।
devarājyaṃ tu devebhyo daityarājyaṃ tu tadbalau ।
dattvā nidhāya gantavyaṃ sandhyāvalyāḥ śubhaṃ bhavet। ।।22।।
tadā tu daityavaryaiḥ sā mahālakṣmīḥ prapūjitā ।
devaiśca pūjitā mātā sarvasaubhāgyarakṣikā ।।23।।
vāmanena samaṃ sā'pi raivate'bhyarthitā ca taiḥ ।
sadoṣitā mahālakṣmīḥ sarvasaubhāgyahetave ।।24।।
raivatātpaścime tatrocchrāye nitya vyavasthitā ।
mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīḥ prāṇarakṣaṇakāriṇī ।।25।।
vanditā pūjitā puṣpakuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ ।
sindūraśrīphalavastraśāṭītailasugandhibhiḥ ।।26।।
tathā saubhāgyadravyaiśca bhojanairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
ābharaṇakaṭakormiśṛṃravalātroṭikādibhiḥ ।।।27।।
peyairnānāvidhaiścaiva kaṃcukīśāṭikādibhiḥ ।
maṃgalasūtrakarṇādibhūṣaṇādibhirādarāt ।।28।।
prasannā sā mahālakṣmīrdīpotsavadine sadā ।
asaubhāgyamamāṃgalyamanarthaṃ ceti hasti sā ।।29।।
dadāti kuśalaṃ rājyaṃ kāntaṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ tathā ।
pūjanārthaṃ mahālakṣmyā mūrtiḥ kāryā caturbhujā ।। 1.155.30।।
pauraṭī susvarūpā ca ramyā ṣoḍaśahāyanā ।
padmāmṛtaghaṭakarā pūjāpātrakarā tathā ।।3 1।।
abhayadānahastā ca dakṣayorvāmayoḥ kramāt ।
ṣoḍaśopaparicāravastubhiḥ pūjayet tu tām ।।32।।।
naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūlaṃ dattvā nīrājayet tataḥ ।
bhojanāni vividhāni dātavyāni ca dakṣiṇāḥ ।।33।।
dānāni ratnahīrakamaṇisvarṇamayāni ca ।
vastrāṇāṃ ca dukūlānāṃ kambalānāṃ gavāṃ tathā ।।।34।।
tasyā'kṣayaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ mahālakṣmīpratāpataḥ ।
ante vaikuṇṭhavāsaḥ syād bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ ।।35।।
kanyakā dvādaśavarṣapūrvā lakṣmīsvarūpikāḥ ।
pūjanīyā yathālakṣmīrvastrānnadhanadāpanaiḥ ।।36।।
bhojanīyāstathā bhūṣālaṃkāradravyaśobhitāḥ ।
vividhairmiṣṭapakvānnapāyasānnādisadrasaiḥ ।।37।।
bhojanīyāstathā sādhvyo viraktāḥ sāṃkhyayogagāḥ ।
pūjanīyāśca dātavya vividhaṃ dānamiṣṭakṛt ।।38।।
sati vai vibhave tatra sāpatyasadhavāḥ striyaḥ ।
vidhavāścāpi dīnāśca śaraṇyāśca nirāśritāḥ ।। 39।।
bhojanīyāḥ pūjanīyā dāpanīyāśca dakṣiṇāḥ ।
sammānanīyāḥ satataṃ yattṛptau śrīśca tṛpyati ।।1.155.40 ।।
mahālakṣmyāṃ prasannāyāṃ sarvā smṛddhirvivardhate ।
nyūnaṃ kiñcidbhavennaiva yadyattvapekṣate milet ।।41 ।।
alakṣmīṃ drāvayatyeṣā gṛhāt sarvāṃ prapūjitā ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ te'tra samudramathane tu yā ।।42।।
jātā tāṃ kathayāmyadya prasaṃgātsukhadāyinīm ।
durvāsasā pradattāṃ tu pārijātasumālikām ।।43।।
indraścikṣepa kariṇo mūrdhni gajena pattale ।
kaccaritāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śaśāpa dyupatiṃ ṛṣiḥ ।।44।।
mālā'vamānakartuste lakṣmīrnaṣṭā bhavatviti ।
antardadhe kṣaṇāllakṣmīḥ petuḥ ratnāni vāridhau ।।45।।
taduddhārāya dugdhā'bdhirmathito devadānavaiḥ ।
mandarādristadā pṛṣṭhe kūrmātmahariṇā dhṛtaḥ ।।46।।
manthanādudabhūt pramavai kālakūṭaṃ mahāviṣam ।
tatsarvaṃ pītavānīśo mamanthuḥ punareva tam ।।47।।
tasmin pramathyamāne tu mayā devaiśca padmaje ।
jyeṣṭhā devī samutpannā raktasragvāsasā''vṛtā ।।48।।
alakṣmīḥ sā bhaginī te jyeṣṭhā dehe'pyasundarī ।
kirātīsadṛśī rūpe dhīvarīsadṛśī mukhe ।।49।।
kṛkalāsasamā karṇe nālikābhā tathā nasi ।
mahiṣīsadṛśī netre rākṣasīva tu mastake ।।1.155.50।।
khagrāsasadṛśī bhāle maṣītulyā tu gaṇḍayoḥ ।
śūlāgrasadṛśī dante uṣṭrīnibhā tu coṣṭhayoḥ ।।5 1 ।।
hastinīsadṛśī kaṇṭhe gardabhīsadṛśī svare ।
varburadrunibhā hastaṃ valmīkābhā stanadvaye ।।।52।।
kusūlatulyā'pyudare śilātulyā tu pṛṣṭhake ।
tailiyantrasamā kaṭyāṃ kharjūradrunibhā pade ।।53।।
jalaukābhā cāṃgulīṣu kṝmapṛṣṭhanibhā nakhe ।
dardurībhā tu jihvāyāṃ svabhāve tu śunīsamā ।।54।।
daridrābhā prasāde ca hāsye kaṃgālasadṛśī ।
carmakārīnibhā vastre caṇḍālābhā nivāsane ।।55।।
riktajalanikhātābhā jambhaṇe mroḍane khaniḥ ।
bhāṇḍīnibhā sahavāse vivāhe kṣārabhūnibhā ।।56 ।।
saṃvāde raṇabhūsāmyā vaimanasye samṛddhibhā ।
dṛṣṭvaināṃ tatrasustatra devadānavamānavāḥ ।।57।।
vicāraṃ cakrire keyaṃ sarvā'maṃgalabhūṣaṇā ।
kālarātrirmahāmāriḥ kiṃvā pralayakṣut tviyam ।।58।।
haste mālāṃ śaṃkhalānāṃ gṛhītvā patimicchati ।
gacchatītastatastāvatpatiṃ mṛgayituṃ yadā ।।59।।
dṛṣṭvā surā'surāḥ sarve dūraṃ dhāvanti necchukāḥ ।
neyaṃ neto yāhi mā māmanyaṃ gacchetivādinaḥ ।।1.155.60।।
yadā kaiścit svīkṛtā na varamālā nirīhayā ।
nirāśā prāha me vāso dīyatāṃ kvāpi yatra nu ।।61।।
utpannā'haṃ nirarthā'haṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayeti ca ।
tāmabruvaँstadā devīṃ surā'suragaṇā drutam ।।।62।।
yeṣāṃ gṛhāntare nityaṃ kalahaḥ saṃpravartate ।
tatte sthānaṃ prayacchāmo vasa tatrā'śubhānvitā ।।63।।
yasya gehe'bhicārārthaṃ kapālā'sthiprapūjanam ।
paruṣaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ yatra mantratantrābhimāraṇam ।।64।।
anṛtaṃ sāhasaṃ dyūtaṃ pānaṃ ca mṛgayā madaḥ ।
mātāpitrorasevā ca guroścaivā'vamānanam ।।65।।
strībālānāṃ ca niḥśvāsāḥ kleśaḥ kuṭumbibāndhave ।
vyabhicāraśca yatrāsti paṃktibhedo'sti yatra ca ।।6 6 ।।
teṣāṃ veśmani santiṣṭha duḥkhadāridryadāyinī ।
gavādisvavaśaprāṇiniḥśvāsā yatra santi vai ।।67।।
āśritānāṃ pālanaṃ ca yatra nītyā na jāyate ।।
śvaśrūśvaśurayoścaiva patipatnyośca putrayoḥ ।।68।।
putrapitrośca bhrātrośca mātṛputryoḥ parasparam ।
svasroryatra vaimanasyaṃ tatra saṃtiṣṭha hānide ।।69।।
kuṭumbijanavargeṣu cauryeṇa vyayaśīlatā ।
svasvasvattvapravṛttiśca gṛhe yatra kuṭumbini ।।1.155.70 ।।
svagṛhamapi pārakyaṃ svajano manute tu yat ।
ālasyaṃ kāryakaraṇe cānyādhārā ca jīvikā ।।71 ।।
vṛddhānāṃ vacanaṃ yatra mānyaṃ bhavati naiva ca ।
snānaṃ devasya pūjādi japo yatra na vidyate ।।72।।
utsavā mānuṣā daivā vārṣikā yatra santi na ।
lobho'dharmavyayo yatra tatra tiṣṭha sukhī bhava ।।73 ।।
prāṇināṃ hiṃsanaṃ yatra satāṃ yatra ca nindanam ।
dharmadrohaśca nāstikyaṃ vasa tatra kalipriye ।।74।।
yatra nā'tithisatkāro yatra śuddhirna vidyate ।
mālinyaṃ vartate yatra tathā yatra nirudyamaḥ ।।75।।
yatra kṣaṇe kṣaṇe krodho yatra viṣayatṛṣṇikā ।
yatra jaihvyaṃ tathaupasthyaṃ vyasanaṃ sīmavarjitam ।।76।।
dāsadāsīkarmacāripīḍanaṃ nyāyato bahiḥ ।
paśupakṣigomahiṣīgajāśvādiprapīḍanam ।।77।।
gṛhajaneṣvaviśvāsastatra vāso vidhīyatām ।
yatra śrāddhaṃ na bhavati na ca piṇḍapradānakam ।।78।।
svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārakriyā yatra na vidyate ।
bhūtayajño brahmayajño devayajño na yatra vai ।।79।।
dārā'patyagṛhasvāmyamātyabhṛtyeṣu cā'nṛtam ।
lucābhakṣyaṃ bhavedyatra yatra drohaḥ parasya ca ।।1.155.80 ।।
rakṣyasyā'rakṣaṇaṃ yatra poṣyasyā'poṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
daṇḍyasyā'daṇḍanaṃ yatra tatra vāso vidhīyatām ।।8 1 ।।
devadvijagavāṃ vṛttihārakāṇāṃ gṛhe sadā ।
anāthakṛpaṇā'ndhānāṃ duḥkhakṛto gṛhe vasa ।।82।।
sādhusādhvīyatiyogiviraktadrohakṛdgṛhe ।
dānadharmaniṣedhasya kartṝṇāṃ ca gṛhe vasa ।।83।।
dehacauryamanaścauryahṛccauryasya gṛhe vasa ।
anyāyopārjayituśca kṛṭatulādharasya ca ।।84।।
kṛṭasākṣyakṛto gehe sadā vāso vidhīyatām ।
viduṣāmavamānayiturgṛhe vasa sarvadā ।।85।।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu yatrā'nyāyo'vivekitā ।
pūjyapūjāvyatikramastatra vāso vidhīyatām ।।86।।
paṇye kapaṭasammiśre vyāpāre kapaṭānvite ।
ācāre kapaṭā''diṣṭe sadā vāso vidhīyatām ।।87।।
yatra rājā dharmapakṣī prajā sāhasabhakṣiṇī ।
rāṣṭraṃ hṛdayabhakṣi syāt tatra vāsaḥ sadā tava ।।88।।
yatra kanyāvikrayasya jīryate hyudare dhanam ।
nārīvikrayavṛttiśca tatra vāsaḥ sadā tava ।।89।।
śīlavrataṃ na yatrāsti hṛdayaṃ naiva nirmalam ।
padakramo'pi kāpaṭyāt śāṭhye vāsaḥ sadā tava ।।1.155.90।।
rāgadveṣaprayukto vai divaso yasya gacchati ।
adharmasya ca yatrāsti vaṃśastatra sadā vasa ।।91 ।।
kṛtaghnasya vañcakasya pāśakasyā''tatāyinaḥ ।
agnidasya garadasya hanturanyāyatastathā ।।92।।
vidharmasthasya sadane dhruvavāso vidhīyatām ।
paraguptaprakāśakagṛhe vāsaḥ duṣṭagṛhe tathā ।।93।।
annavastrabhuvāṃ dānā'karturgṛhe sadā vasa ।
piśūnasya bhedakasya kleśakṛto gṛhe vasa ।।94।।
rājye rāṣṭre tathā'raṇye vāṭikāsu vaneṣu ca ।
udyāne ca kṛṣikṣetre parvate ca sthale jale ।।95।।
vṛkṣe sasye tathā bīje ratne svarṇe rase raṇe ।
saṃgrāme cotsave daive mānuṣe vā sthale jale ।। 96।।
tīrthe bhojye vyavahāre kraye ca vikraye tathā ।
vidyāyāṃ ca kalāyāṃ ca śilpe ṛtau ca varṣaṇe ।।97।।
yatrā'dhipaḥ śaṭho dhūrtaḥ kitavaścaura ulbaṇaḥ ।
duṣṭo'nyāyī mahāpāpī tatra tatra sadā vasa ।।98।।
kiṃ bahunā tvaduktena yatra hiṃsā'nṛte tathā ।
steyavyavāyagṛdhnāścā'śuddhistṛṣṇā vinindanam ।।99।।
tatra vāsaḥ sadā te'stu lakṣmyā vāso na yatra ca ।
ityuktvā tāṃ daduḥ devā uddālakāya carṣaye ।। 1.155.100 ।।
visarjayāmāsa patyā sahā'lakṣmīṃ tataḥ punaḥ ।
te sarve manthanaṃ cakruḥ kṣīrābdheḥ susamāhitāḥ ।। 101 ।।
tataśca vāruṇī devī samutpannā śubhānanā ।
ananto nāgarājo'tha tāṃ jagrāha sulocanām ।। 102।।
tataśca gāruḍī devī samutpannā sulakṣaṇā ।
vainateyasya bhāryā'bhūt sarvalakṣaṇaśobhitā ।। 1 03।।
tato'psarogaṇā divyā gandharvāśca mahaujasaḥ ।
jajñire rūpasampannā madhugāyanatatparāḥ ।। 1 04।।
airāvatastato jajñe tathaivoccaiḥ śravāhayaḥ ।
dhanvantariḥ pārijātaḥ surabhiḥ sarvakāmadhuk ।। 1 05।।
etān sarvān sahasrākṣo jagrāha sarvamānitaḥ ।
tataḥ prabhātasamaye dvādaśyāmudite ravau ।। 10 6।।
utpannā śrīrmahālakṣmīrmathyamāne mahodadhau ।
tataścandrastato jātā tulasī yā haripriyā ।। 107।।
tulasyā saha mā lakṣmīrvarayāmāsa keśavam ।
tataḥ provāca bhagavān sarvāścaiva mahāmunīn ।। 1 08।।
ekādaśī mahāpuṇyā sarvopadravanāśinī ।
tasmāttu sarvadā puṇyā dvādaśī mama vallabhā ।। 10 9।।
adyaprabhṛti ye lokā ekādaśīmupoṣya ca ।
dvādaśyāmudite bhānau śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ।। 1.155.110 ।।
ye pūjayanti māṃ bhaktyā tulasyā ca śriyā saha ।
sarve te bandhanirmuktāḥ prāpnuvanti padaṃ mama ।। 11 1।।
nārcayanti ca ye vai māṃ dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam ।
tānpāpānviṣayairbaddhvā mama māyā duratyayā ।। 1 12।।
kṣipatyajasraṃ saṃsāre nāstikānmatparāṅmukhān ।
samudrātsā yadā lakṣmīrdvādaśyāṃ samajāyata ।। 112 ।।
tadāprabhṛti ṛṣayo devā brahmapurogamāḥ ।
siddhā ye mānuṣāścaiva yogino munisattamāḥ । । 1 14।।
viṣṇorājñāṃ puraskṛtya bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ ।
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha bhaktyā caiva janārdanam । । 1 15।।
dvādaśyāmarcayāmāsurlakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tu mām ।
dvādaśīvāsaraste'sti mamāpi vāsaro hi saḥ ।। 1 16।।
harivāsara ityukto lakṣmīvāsara ityapi ।
dampatyostu sadaivaikyāt kimanyachrotumicchasi ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne raivatācale mahālakṣmyāgamanaṃ tasyāḥ pūjanadānādi, samudramathane
'lakṣmyā utpattistatsvarūpaṃ tannivāsasthānāni, tato lakṣmītulasīprādurbhāve dvādaśīmahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 155।।


← adhyāyaḥ 155 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 156
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 157 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi dvādaśyāśca vidhānakam ।
viṣṇoḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ ca yathā prabho ।। 1 ।।
tasyāḥ puṇyaprabhāvaṃ ca samācakṣva mama priya ।
mama vrataprabhāvastu śrotavyaḥ sarvathā mayā ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi tava janmadinavratam ।
tava vratasya saṃkalpāt santuṣṭaḥ syāmahaṃ sadā ।। 3 ।।
ekādaśī mama patnī mamāṃ'gebhyo vyajāyata ।
tathaiva tvaṃ mama patnī mama vāmāṃgasaṃbhavā ।। 4 ।।
punaḥ samudrato jātā hyabdhijā kathyase tadā ।
aruṇādrau ca padmākhyā bhṛgoḥ putrī tu bhārgavī ।। 5 ।।
premṇo jātā kaṃbharā tvaṃ khanerjātā suvarṇikā ।
vāraṃ vāraṃ prasūtāpi ramā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ।। 6 ।।
mama patnī sadā divyā yatrā'haṃ tvaṃ ca tatra vai ।
gṛhe gṛhe sthitā tvaṃ tu māṃ vinā naiva tiṣṭhasi ।। 7 ।।
yadā mayā pare dhāmni parabrahmasvarūpiṇā ।
svasmād rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ vai ramaṇārthaṃ samīhitam ।। 8 ।।
tadā tvaṃ mama vāmāṃgasthitā'dṛśyā madicchayā ।
matsvarūpādiṣadannyūnā sevikā samajāyathāḥ ।। 9 ।।
rūpe guṇe tathaiśvarye sukhe bhoge vilāsane ।
na nyūnā pramadābhāve puṃbhāvanyūnatā tu yā ।। 1.156.1 0।।
saivā'sti nyūnatā nāryā nānyā vai nyūnatā mama ।
mamaikādaśasaṃkhyākendriyāṇāṃ śaktayastu yāḥ ।। 11 ।।
tāḥ saṃbhūya ca bhavatī jātā vai dvādaśī mama ।
patnīrūpā hyato bodhyā dvādaśīti tvameva sā ।। 12।।
tava prāvirbhāvarūpaṃ dvādaśaṃ samajāyata ।
tasmāt tvaṃ dvādaśī proktā mama patnī mamāṃganā ।। 13।।
mamāṃgaṃ tvaṃ harervāsād rakṣaṇāt harivāsaraḥ ।
dvādaśī tvaṃ mama patnī mama vāsararūpiṇī ।। 14।।
mama rūpaṃ mama vāso ratistvayi sadā mama ।
tatastvameva harivāsaro dvādaśī matā ।। 15।।
ityetattu rahasyaṃ vai guptaṃ tubhyaṃ mayoditam ।
tataḥ punaḥ samudrasya manthane dvādaśīdine ।। 16।।
prātastvaṃ vai samutpannā tato'pi dvādaśī tava ।
janmajayantī prakhyātā sarvatra samajāyata ।। 17।।
yatra yatra ca samaye harernārāyaṇasya me ।
prākaṭyaṃ cāpi te lakṣmyāḥ sa kāle balavān bhavet ।। 18।।
harerbalāt samayo'pi balavān puṇyado bhavet ।
mama janma tava janma yadā vai jāyate'tra hi ।। 1 9।।
tatra tatra mahotsāhāḥ kartavyā dānabhojanaiḥ ।
gītavāditranṛtyaiśca pūjākīrtanabhaktibhiḥ ।।1.156.20 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ sadāptāyāṃ samupoṣyeha mānavāḥ ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktā yānti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।।21।।
ekādaśyā vratasyā'tra pūrṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tadā bhavet ।
dvādaśyāmāvayoḥ pūjāṃ tataḥ kuryācca pāraṇām ।।22।।
saptajanmā'rjitaṃ pāpaṃ jñānato'jñānataḥ kṛtam ।
kṣaṇādeva layaṃ yāti dvādaśyāṃ nau prapūjanāt ।।।23।।
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca ।
ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।24।।
dvādaśī puṇyadā dravyapradā kāmaprapūriṇī ।
mokṣadā sarvalokānāṃ yatrā'haṃ tvaṃ ca pūjitau ।।25।।
ekādaśī ca yā devī mamendriyamahadbalam ।
vrataṃ tayā'rthitaṃ tadvai nirannameva sarvathā ।।।26।।
tatrānnaṃ naiva bhoktavyaṃ cānne pāpaṃ pratiṣṭhati ।
ekādaśīsamaṃ kiñcit pāpatrāṇaṃ na vidyate ।।27।।
ekādaśendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ yatkṛtaṃ bhavati priye ।
ekādaśyupavāsena tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet ।।28।।
ekādaśyapi me patnī mama vāsara ucyate ।
upavāsena tatrā'haṃ prasannaḥ syāṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।।।29।।
dvādaśyāṃ mama naivedyaṃ kṛtvā kuryācca pāraṇām ।
tenā'haṃ sarvadā tṛptaḥ prasanno'pi bhavāmi vai ।।1.156.3 0।।
mayi tṛpte jagattṛptaṃ sarvatṛptiphalaṃ bhavet ।
raṭanti saṃhitāstvatra bhūyo bhūyo mama priye ।।3 1 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte harivāsare ।
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca strībālānāṃ sadā priye ।।32।।
ekādaśyāmupavāsaḥ kartavya eva sarvathā ।
ekādaśyāṃ yadi śrāddhaṃ mātāpitrormṛte'hani ।।33।।
dvādaśyāṃ tatpradātavyaṃ nopavāsadine kvacit ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhaṃ nā'dantyekādaśīdine ।।34।।
daśamīmiśritāṃ tāṃ tu prayatnena vivarjayet ।
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ dvādaśīmiśritā bhavet ।।35।।
tāṃ tyaktvā dvādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ prakuryādavicārayam ।
trayodaśyāṃ tadā prātaḥ kṛtvā snānādi sattvaram ।। 36।।
trayodaśīkalā cettu sūryodyāne pravartate ।
tarhi tu dvādaśībhāge pūrvaṃ sūryodayācca vai ।। 37।।
pāraṇaṃ khalu kartavyaṃ na tu trayodaśīpale ।
dvādaśyāmupavāsaśca dvādaśyāmeva pāraṇam ।। 38।।
niśā madhyagatā jāgaraṇayuktā tu tadvratam ।
harivāsara ityuktaḥ sarvaśreṣṭho mama priyaḥ ।।39।।
vratametatparityajya yo hyanyadvratamācaret ।
karasthaṃ sa mahārājyaṃ tyaktvā bhaikṣyaṃ tu yācate ।।1.156.40 ।।
kalā'pyekādaśī yatra dvādaśyāmudite ravau ।
sarvāmekādaśīṃ tyaktvā tatraivopavased vratī ।।41 ।।
trayodaśyāṃ kalāyāṃ ca sūryasyodayanaṃ bhavet ।
pūrvadine tadā śuddhā dvādaśyeva vrataṃ matam ।।42।।
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād rātrāvanaṃgavarjitaḥ ।
pṛthivīśayanaḥ prātardhātrīphalavilepanaḥ ।।42।।
snāyīta sandhyāṃ kurvīta pūjāṃ me vidadhīta ca ।
upavāsī sāyamekādaśyāṃ saṃpūjayecca mām ।।44।।
gandhapuṣpairdhūpadauparvastrābharaṇabhojanaiḥ ।
japaiḥ stotrairnamaskāraiḥ pūjayenniśi bhaktitaḥ ।।।45।।
lakṣmīṃ ca pūjayed rātrau saubhāgyadravyavastubhiḥ ।
keśān saṃsādhayet tatra puṣpamālāṃ tu dhārayet ।।46।।
grathnīyāt keśaveśaṃ ca kabarīṃ kārayet tataḥ ।
sindūragandhitailādi dadyāt keśeṣu mastake ।।47।।
lalāṭe candanakuṃkumā'kṣatādīn suśṛṃkhalām ।
tantrikāṃ pauraṭīṃ dadyāt candrakaṃ śobhanaṃ kriyāt ।।48।।
karṇabhūṣānāsikāsubhūṣaṇānyapi dhārayet ।
kajjalaṃ netrayordadyādauṣṭhayoḥ rañjanaṃ kriyāt ।।49।।
gaṇḍayoḥ patrikāṃ dadyāt kapole sūkṣmatillikām ।
kaṇṭhe svarṇavibhūṣāँśca puṣpahārān sudhārayet ।।1.156.50 ।।
bhujayoḥ kaṭake dadyāt prakoṣṭhe ratnabaṃgiḍīḥ ।
aṃguliṣūrmikā dadyāt kausuṃbhī kaṃcukīṃ dharet ।।51।।
śāṭikāṃ svarṇasūtrāntāṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kaustubham ।
lalantikāṃ phullapatrīṃ svarṇapaṭṭīṃ gale dharet ।।।52।।
kaṭyāṃ suvarṇaraśanāṃ kausuṃbhīṃ ghargharīṃ dharet ।
pādayoḥ kiṃkiṇīnaddhajharjharān svarṇatroṭakān ।।53।।
rūpyacchaṭān pradadyācca'laktakaṃ pattale'rcayet ।
aṃguliṣūrmikākarṭān dhārayet pādayostu vai ।।54।।
svarṇatārabhṛte makhammalīyamṛdupāduke ।
gandhasārasugandhena vāsayed bahumānataḥ ।।55।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇayoścā''rārtrikaṃ pañcavartibhiḥ ।
kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavat namaḥ stutikīrtanam ।।56।।
naivedyaṃ śarkarāghṛtaphalādyaṃ ca nivedayet ।
pānīyaṃ mukhaśuddhiṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ cārpayet tataḥ ।।।57।।
śayyāṃ sukhapradāṃ dadyāt komalagendukādikām ।
śvetāṃ tūlapaṭīṃ citrāṃ rājāyanīṃ kabarhaṇam ।।58।।
śayyāyāṃ ca vikīryeta kausumāni dalāni vai ।
vyajanenā'nilaṃ dadyātpādasaṃvāhanaṃ kriyāt ।।59।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇayoścājñayā'ṅgamardanaṃ kriyāt ।
svāpayitvā ca devau tau prātaḥ surabhivāribhiḥ ।।1.156.60 ।।
prabodhya snāpayedbhaktyā dantadhāvanapūrvakam ।
vastreṇa mārjayed devau nūtnavastrāṇi dhārayet ।।6 1।।
tulasīmiśrasalilaistarpitvā pitṛdevatāḥ ।
pūjayejjagatāmīśaṃ lakṣmyā saha janārdanam ।।62।।
komalaistulasīpatraiḥ kamalaiḥ sthalapadmakaiḥ ।
sugandhyakṣatapuṣpaiḥ saubhāgyamaṃgalakārakaiḥ ।।63।।
jalaistathopakaraṇairvibhūṣābhiśca ratnakaiḥ ।
dīpānnīrājayettatra śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tataḥ ।।64।।
śatapatrakṛtāṃ mālāṃ tābhyāṃ samyaṅ nivedayet ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayet ।।65।।
śarkarāsahitaṃ divyaṃ pāyasānnaṃ sakesaram ।
sasujātīphalayuktaṃ cailācūrṇasugandhitam ।।66।।
pūrikāṃ polikāṃ śākān pakvānnāni hyanekaśaḥ ।
takraṃ dadhi payaḥ sūpaṃ kvathikāmodanaṃ tathā ।।67।।
parpaṭān piṇḍakān dadyādāranālānyanekaśaḥ ।
phalāni salilānyalpāṃ mukhaśuddhiṃ ca dakṣiṇām ।।68।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ kṣamāpanamathāpi ca ।
pūjottaraṃ vṛṇuyādvai varaṃ sveṣṭaṃ sukhapradam ।।69।।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sadā''rogyaṃ vastraṃ vāhanameva ca ।
yānaṃ pātrāṇi bhūṣāśca kṣetraṃ sadvāṭikāṃ tathā ।।1.156.70।।
gomahiṣīvṛṣabhādīn patipatnīsukhaṃ tathā ।
apatyaṃ dīrghajīvitvamavighnaṃ kāryamityapi ।।71।।
abhyudayaṃ mahāsattāṃ rājyaṃ gṛhaṃ ca rāṣṭrakam ।
kuṭumbaṃ sukhasampattiṃ svargaṃ cānyad yadiṣṭakam ।।72।।
vṛṇīta devayoḥ sarvāṃ sukhasaubhāgyasampadam ।
pīḍāmupadravaṃ duḥkhaṃ kleśaṃ cintāṃ vimocaya ।।73।।
vaidhavyamanapatyaṃ ca mā bhūnme vai kadācana ।
putrapautraprapautrādikuṭumbaṃ sukhavad bhavet ।।74।।
ājyena juhuyād vahnau śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tathā ।
bhaktyā puruṣasūktena śrīsūktena ca pāyasam ।।75।।
pratyṛcaṃ juhuyādbhaktyā viprān sādhūṃśca bhojayet ।
svayaṃ cā''śritavargaṃ vai bhojayitvā'danaṃ kriyāt ।।76।।
saṃhitādiśravaṇena kṣapayecca dinaṃ śubham ।
brahmacārī bhūmiśāyī nindādi varjayettathā ।।77।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādevaṃ dvādaśikāvratam ।
kuryāt prasanno bhagavān sarvā'bhīṣṭaprado dhruvam ।।78।।
harivāsaravratakṛdgṛhe'ṣṭau vasavo diviṃ ।
nārāyaṇasya lakṣmyāśca varadānādvasanti vai ।।79।।
āmo bhavaśca somaśca dharaścaiva nalo'nilaḥ ।
pratyūṣaśca prabhāvaśca vasavo'ṣṭau vasanti hi ।।1.156.8 0 ।।
yatra tīrthe tava pūjā gṛhe yatra tavā'rcanam ।
yatrāraṇye smṛtiste ca yatrā'bdhau te'bhidhākathā ।।81।।
yatra loke śravaste'sti tatra sarvatra saṃvasa ।
yatra brāhmamuhūrte te me ca dhyānaṃ tu mānasam ।।82।।
nāmasmṛtiśca bhajanaṃ tatra sākaṃ mayā vasa ।
yatra prātarbālavargaḥ prasannau vartate sukhī ।।83।।
na ca rauti nākrośati tatra sākaṃ mayā vasa ।
prātaryatra ca dampatyorna kleśastatra saṃvasa ।।84।।
prātaryatra dehaśuddhiḥ snānaprakṣālanādibhiḥ ।
śayyāśuddhirvastraśuddhirnairmalye tatra saṃvasa ।।85।।
jalena mārjanenāpi lepanena gṛhā'cchatā ।
raṃgolyā svastikenāpi māṃgalyaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।।86।।
pradīpasya cullikāgneḥ prātaryatra prakāśanam ।
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭaṃ pakvānnaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।।87।।
piṣṭānnaṃ saktukānnaṃ ca taṇḍulādi surandhitam ।
prātargodhūmapolyādi yatra tatra sadā vasa ।।88।।
prātaḥ kūpataḍāgādijalaṃ gṛhagataṃ bhṛtam ।
udakuṃbhau jale tatra sadā pūjājale vasa ।।89।।
snānaṃ prātaḥ sadā yatra dhyānaṃ devādipūjanam ।
pūjyānāṃ pūjanaṃ mānaṃ vṛddhānāṃ tatra saṃvasa ।।1.156.90।।
yatrā'ṅganaṃ ca goṣṭhādi mārjitaṃ prātareva ca ।
paryuṣitādiśuddhiśca tatra lakṣmi! sadā vasa ।।9 1 ।।
yatra prātarbrāhmaṇasya darśanaṃ ca satāṃ tathā ।
sādhvīnāṃ haribhaktānāṃ pitrośca tatra saṃvasa ।।92।।
viduṣāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca satīnāṃ puṇyaśālinām ।
devānāṃ ca gavāṃ prātardarśanaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।।93 ।।
puṇyaṃ ca candrako bhāle kajjala netrayostathā ।
puṣpaṃ sugandhadravyaṃ ca yatrā'sti tanmukhe vasa ।।94।।
agnihotraṃ ca gāyatrī viṣṇupūjā śivārcanam ।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ prātarnaivedyaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।।95।।
kāṣṭhena dantaśuddhiśca śaucaṃ tu mṛjjalādibhiḥ ।
snānaṃ saubhāgyabhūṣādi yatra tatra sadā vasa ।।96।।
bālānāṃ stanyapānādi vatsādīnāṃ ca sevanam ।
paśūnāṃ tṛṇatoyādi sevā tatra sadā vasa ।।97।।
śukādipakṣiṇāṃ sārameyādīnāṃ ca rakṣaṇam ।
saṃbhāvanā'nnatoyābhyāṃ yatra tatra sadā vasa ।।98।।
vṛṣabhāśvagajoṣṭrāṇāṃ vāhe trāso na yatra vai ।
tathā'nyapaśusaṃtrāso yatra no tatra saṃvasa ।। 99।।
gṛhodyānadrumavallīprabhṛtyudbhijjajātayaḥ ।
jalaṃ khādyaṃ cāpnuvanti tatra tvaṃ sarvadā vasa ।। 1.156.100 ।।
kīṭapipīlikādibhyo yatra piṣṭakaṇādikam ।
prāpyate gṛhamedhibhyastadgṛhe tvaṃ sadā vasa ।। 101 ।।
grāmasya paśavo yatra tāḍyante na vṛthā janaiḥ ।
dayālūnāṃ gṛhe tatra vāmaste'stu mama priye ।। 10 2।।
abhyāgatā'tithayo bhikṣukāḥ prāghūṇikāstathā ।
yatra tṛpyantyannajalairvāṇyā ca tatra saṃvasa ।। 103 ।।
svārthaṃ na bhojanaṃ yatra parārthaṃ devaśeṣitam ।
paṃktibhedo na ca yatra na svārthastatra saṃvasa ।। 1 04।।
śrāddhaṃ vratotsavā yatra dhārmikaṃ nṛtyagāyanam ।
samājo jñātibhojyaṃ ca parārthaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।। 105 ।।
sādhūnāṃ bhajanaṃ yatra santoṣo dānaśīlatā ।
mahatāṃ cāpi sammānaṃ dīnānāṃ tatra saṃvasa ।। 106 ।।
annavastrajalā''vāsaiḥ santoṣo'nāthadehinām ।
bahūnāṃ jīvikā nyāyyā yatrāsti tatra saṃvasa ।। 1 07।।
sādhūnāṃ brahmacārāṇāmanāthānāṃ ca yadgṛhe ।
sevayā bahusantoṣaḥ sarvasve tatra saṃvasa ।। 108 ।।
yadgṛhe naiva kāpaṭyaṃ na kleśo na pratāraṇā ।
na śāṭhyaṃ naiva ca krauryaṃ suśāntistatra saṃvasa ।। 109 ।।
lobho roṣo mahodvego matsaro'dharmavṛttitā ।
īrṣyā'sūyā yatra daṃbho na santi tatra saṃvasa ।। 1.156.110 ।।
tṛṣṇā nindā ca paiśūnyaṃ droho madaśca garvitā ।
paradoṣaprakāśitvaṃ na santi tatra saṃvasa ।। 111 ।।
anyāyā'nnaṃ bhikṣukānnaṃ parānnaṃ pāpināṃ tathā ।
duṣṭānnaṃ pacyate naiva yatkukṣau tatra saṃvasa ।। 112।।
vyāpāro nyāyato yatra nyāyyaśca vikrayaḥ krayaḥ ।
kāpaṭyaṃ na tulāmāne'rjane dāne sadā vasa ।। 113 ।।
jīrṇe ca nūtane yatra kāpaṭyaṃ miśraṇe nahi ।
vāgdāne ca hṛdo dāne śāṭhyaṃ na tatra saṃvasa ।। 1 14।।
paropakārapuṇyārthaṃ yajñārthaṃ rāṣṭrasvastaye ।
dravyavyayo bhaved yatra parārthaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।। 115 ।।
parādhīnapaśupakṣiprāṇināṃ hiṃsanaṃ tathā ।
trāso yatra na vidyete tatra lakṣmi! sukhaṃ vasa ।। 116 ।।
bālānāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ tathā ।
dīnā'nāthadaridrāṇāmannasatre sadā vasa ।। 1 17। ।
vāpyāṃ kūpataḍāgādau nadyāṃ sarovare bhuvi ।
khāte prasravaṇe'khāte prapāyāṃ ca sadā vasa ।। 118 ।।
udārāḥ svāmino yeṣāṃ sasyodyānavanasvinām ।
parvatānāmaraṇyānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ tatra saṃvasa ।। 119 ।।
dānayajñāḥ kriyāyajñā yogayajñāśca yadgṛhe ।
bhaktiyajñā jñānayajñā yatra tatra sadā vasa ।। 1.156.120 ।।
bhūtayajñā brahmayajñā devayajñāśca yatra vai ।
svādhyāyayajñā bhaktiśca sevā tatra sadā vasa ।। 1 21 ।।
madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā cauryamanyāyastryādisevanam ।
vyasanāni vṛthā yatra na santi tatra saṃvasa ।। 122 ।।
jīve duṣṭo hṛdi duṣṭo vāci duṣṭaśca karmaṇi ।
svārthe cāpi parārthe vā nāsti yastatra saṃvasa ।। 123 ।।
pātivratyaṃ yatra dharmaḥ patnīvrataṃ ca śīlatā ।
viśvāsitvaṃ kṛtajñatvaṃ yatra tatra sadā vasa ।। 1 24।।
nītyā vai karmakāritvaṃ nītyā dravyapradānatā ।
prajāyā rakṣaṇaṃ nītyā nītimatsu sadā vasa ।। 1 25।।
prajāyāḥ śoṣaṇaṃ yatra nārīṇāṃ krandanaṃ tathā ।
dīnānāmardanaṃ yatra nāsti tatra sukha vasa ।। 1 26।।
ramaṇīnāṃ ca sammānaṃ paropakāriṇāṃ tathā ।
saphalīkṛtayatnānāṃ gṛhe dhyeye sadā vasa ।। 1 27।।
putravatsvaprajāpālakānāṃ prāṇārpiṇāṃ tathā ।
dhārmikāṇāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ rājñāṃ rāṣṭre sadā vasa ।। 128 ।।
śatrusāhasikastenastabdhalubdhakavañcakāḥ ।
śaṭhā dhūrtāśca pākhaṇḍā na yadrāṣṭre sadā vasa ।। 1 29।।
svāmyamātyarājaputrarājñīmantripurohitāḥ ।
senāpatyaṭavīpālā na duṣṭāstatra saṃvasa ।। 1.156.130 ।।
kārāgārapatirdharmā'dhyakṣaprākārarakṣakāḥ ।
antaḥpurapratīhārā na duṣṭāstatra saṃvasa ।। 131 ।।
śreṣṭhiratniprabhūtānnisvarṇiśilpiprakarmiṇaḥ ।
saṃviśāstrinyāyinaśca na duṣṭāstatra saṃvasa ।। 132 ।।
āśrameṣu ca varṇeṣu nārīṣu ca nareṣu ca ।
grāmyeṣu vaniṣu naiva duṣṭatvaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।। 133 ।।
bhṛtyeṣu cāravargeṣu śiṣyeṣu cāśriteṣu ca ।
guruṣu rājasu naiva duṣṭatvaṃ tatra saṃvasa । । 1 34।।
pātāle bhūstare bhūmau khanau svarge'ntarīkṣake ।
satye ṛtau ca garbhe ca dauṣṭyaṃ na tatra saṃvasa ।। 135 ।।
bhakṣye bhojye tathā peye'laṃkāre pācane'nale ।
vāyau rūpe rase gandhe dauṣṭyaṃ na tatra saṃvasa ।। 136 ।।
yatra nāsti manodauṣṭyaṃ netṛdauṣṭyaṃ janacchalam ।
rājadauṣṭyaṃ gurordauṣṭyaṃ strīdauṣṭyaṃ tatra saṃvasa ।। 137।।
yatra nāsti tvayi dauṣṭyaṃ mayi dauṣṭyaṃ pratāriṇām ।
nāstikānāṃ vṛttidauṣṭyaṃ na yatra tatra saṃvasa ।। 1 38।।
yatphalaṃ devanaivedye yallābho devakarmaṇi ।
upayujyeta sarvatra tatra vāso'stu te sadā ।। 1 39।।।
kiṃ bahunā vistareṇa saṃkṣepātkathayāmyaham ।
yatra dharmaśca bhaktiśca tathā nārāyaṇo'pyaham ।। 1.156.140 ।।
yatra santo dharmavaṃśastatra vāso'stu te sadā ।
iti te sthānabāhulyamākhyātaṃ vāsakāmyayā ।। 141 ।।
paropakaraṇe tatra vastavyaṃ me yathā hṛdi ।
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ yatra yatra cā'peyapānakam ।। 142।।
akāryakaraṇaṃ yatra yatrā'nācārabhraṣṭatā ।
nāsti cāsti satyayugastatra sākaṃ mayā vasa ।। 143।।
īśvareṣu ca jīveṣu dharmavaṃśo mama priyaḥ ।
tatra vāsaḥ sadā kāryo yathā raivatake girau ।। 144।।
sāyaṃ yatra devapūjā kathā ca kīrtanotsavāḥ ।
virāmaḥ prāṇināṃ yatra tatra vāsaḥ sadā tava ।। 145।।
yatrā'styacyutagotrāṇāṃ sādhūnāṃ bahupūjanam ।
tatra tvayā sadā vāsaḥ kāryo lakṣmi! mamā''jñayā ।। 146।।
vedaśāstrādidharmāṇāṃ sadā yatrāsti pālanam ।
nāstikyaṃ daivakārye na vāsastatrā'stu te sadā ।। 147।।
āprātarudyamo yatra cā''sāyaṃ vartate jane ।
tatra tvayā hyavaśyaṃ tu vastavyaṃ sarvathā priye ।। 148।।
yatra svatve parasvatvaṃ kiñcidapi na vidyate ।
tatra svatve sadā stheyaṃ kiṃ bahūktyā śubhānane ।। 149।।
tava bhaktā janā devā daityā nāgāstatheśvarāḥ ।
ṛṣayo munayo'devāḥ sarve sṛṣṭinivāsinaḥ ।। 1.156.150 ।।
tava pūjāparā nityaṃ tavā''gamasukāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।
tavārthaṃ kṛtayatnāśca prāṇārpaṇaṃ ca te kṛte ।। 151 ।।
tavehayā tu kaṣṭāni sahante'pi videśake ।
tavārthaṃ svajanaṃ tyaktvā gacchantyanyatra nirjane ।। 152।।
tava prāptirbhavenmā vā mṛteḥ prāptistu jāyate ।
dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ tapastatra vasa te yadi rocate ।। 153।।
tattatprayatnasadṛśī vasa tattadgṛhe sadā ।
tattatkāryakṛtāṃ haste yathāpekṣaṃ vasa priye ।। 154।।
yatra kvāpi yāhi bhadre punarāgaccha madgṛham ।
nā'nyadgṛhaṃ śāśvataṃ vai vasitavyaṃ mayā vinā ।। 155।।
mayā klṛptaṃ tava gṛhaṃ hṛdyaṃ me sadā'naghe ।
maddhṛdayaṃ saha nītvā yatra kvāpi vasa priye ।। 156।।
yatheṣṭaṃ vasa sarvatra spṛśā mā tadgrahādhipam ।
pātivratyaṃ sarvathaiva rakṣitavyaṃ ca me priye ।। 157।।
yatra yatra ca te vāsastatrā'ntaryāmitā mama ।
sarvatraiva vyāpako'smi nivasāmi mama priye ।। 158।।
ataḥ sarvatra māmeva pātivratyād bhajasva vai ।
na te pativratādharmo lupto bhavati kaścana ।। 159।।
yasya gehe ca te vāsastadbhāle vasatirmama ।
vastrā'laṃkārarūpā tvaṃ bhāle tejasvitā'pyaham ।। 1.156.160 ।।
yatra te bhaginī jyeṣṭhā hyalakṣmīrvasati gṛhe ।
tadgṛhe'rdhe'pi sammīlya vāsaṃ tu kurutaṃ hyubhe ।। 161।।
na vai sarve salakṣmīkāḥ sarve nā'lakṣmikāstathā ।
ardhe lakṣmīścārdhabhāge'pyalakṣmīrvartate gṛhe ।। 162।।
kiñcinnyūnaṃ duḥkhadaṃ ca kiñcicchreṣṭhaṃ sukhapradam ।
ekasminneva gehādau sarvaṃ sarvasya nottamam ।। 163।।
tādṛśe ca jane gehe hyalakṣmyā saha śāntitaḥ ।
kṛtvaiva sahanaṃ sarve vartitavyaṃ tvayā'naghe ।। 164।।
ekakoṇe tvayā stheyamanyakoṇe'grajātayā ।
alakṣmyā jyeṣṭhayā stheyaṃ na kāryaḥ kalahaḥ kvacit ।। 165।।
balā'bale tu draṣṭavye bhāgyarekhānusārataḥ ।
nirbalena sthalaṃ deyaṃ prabalāyeti śāsanam ।। 166।।
nītirastītisarvatra sukhāyaivopakalpitā ।
aya tvāṃ kathayiṣye'nyatīrthāni raivatācale ।। 167।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
dvādaśyā harivāsaratve kāraṇatā, lakṣmyā vidhivatpūjanaṃ
tatphalaṃ, lakṣmyā nivāsasthānāni cetyādinirū-
paṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 156।।


← adhyāyaḥ 156 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 157
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 158 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
revatīkuṇḍaityuktaṃ kā vā sā revatī hyabhūt ।
tajjijñāsāṃ praśāmyaiva tatastīrthāni me vada ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tadākhyānaṃ satyayugīyamucyate ।
yathā yā revatī jātā yannāmnā kuṇḍatīrthakam ।। 2 ।।
dakṣasya duhitā yā tu patnī candramaso'sti hi ।
sā nakṣatrasvarūpā'sti revatī divi rājate ।। 3 ।।
sūryāt saṃjñānāsikātaścotpanno raivataḥ sutaḥ ।
pañcamaḥ sa manurdevi raivato nāma viśrutaḥ ।। 4 ।।
yā hyadhyātmatayā śaile raivate jīvavatsthitaḥ ।
raivatākhyamanoḥ putraḥ kṛtavākmanurucyate ।। 5 ।।
kṛtavāco gṛhe putrajanmā'bhūttu yadā tadā ।
nakṣatraṃ revatīsaṃjñaṃ janmarkṣaṃ tadabhūt nṛpaḥ ।। 6 ।।
putrajanmotsavaṃ cakre jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ ।
dānāni vividhānyeva dadau viprebhya eva saḥ ।। 7 ।।
tathānyānsamayaprāptān saṃskārān kṛtavānnṛpaḥ ।
putrajanmasamaye vai nṛpasyā'bhūjjvaro mahān ।। 8 ।।
svapne'pi dadṛśe svasya śakaṭyākarṣaṇakṛtim ।
vāmāṃgaṃ prāsphurattasya kākaḥ krośati mastake ।। 9 ।।
kośātsvarṇamayīmudrāḥ yānti devā tu vṛścikāḥ ।
śivā svābhimukhaṃ rauti śvā bhaṣatyabhisammukham ।। 1.157.1 0।।
mukuṭaḥ patito mūrdhnoyaṣṭikā patitā karāt ।
kṛtavāk patitaḥ saudhasopānebhyo luṭhan bhuvi ।। 1 1।।
ityevaṃ cā'śakunāni putre jāte'bhavannatha ।
yataḥ prabhṛti jāto'sau tataḥ prabhṛtyasau nṛpaḥ ।। 12।
dīrgharogaparāmṛṣṭo mātā'bhūtkuṣṭharogiṇī ।
jagāma cintāṃ nṛpatiḥ kimetaditi duḥkhitaḥ ।। 1 3।।
mūrkhaśca mandabhāgyaśca putraḥ piturhi duḥkhada ।
amārgago viśeṣeṇa duḥkhādduḥkhaprado bhavet ।। 14।।
aputratā manuṣyāṇāṃ śreyase na kuputratā ।
suhṛdāṃ nopakārāya pitṝṇāṃ nopatṛptaye ।। 15।।
mātāpitrorvināśāya kuputro vai dine dine ।
antatastu svamevā'tra nāśaṃ yāti kuputrakaḥ ।। 16।।
varaṃ cā'lagnakaraṇaṃ ṛtvanabhigamo varaḥ ।
varaṃ nāryāśca vandhyātvaṃ varo garbhasya saṃkṣayaḥ ।। 17।।
varo mṛtaprasavo vā varā bālamṛtistathā ।
varaṃ vivāsanaṃ kinnu kuputro na varo mataḥ ।। 18।।
mṛtānāṃ tu bhavecchokaḥ svalpo yāvatsmṛtistadā ।
kuputrāṇāṃ tu mūrkhāṇāṃ śokastāpaḥ pade pade ।। 19।।
anirvṛttaṃ nirānandaṃ duḥkhaśokapariplutam ।
karoti hṛdyaṃ pitroḥ śatrūṇāṃ tu sadāmudam ।।1.157.20।।
akāle tu jarāṃ putraḥ kuputraḥ kurute pituḥ ।
narakāya na svargāya nā''tmane'pi hitāya ca ।।21।।
suputro hṛdayaṃ vetti mātāpitrordine dine ।
dhanyāste tanayā yeṣāṃ marvalokābhisammatāḥ ।।।22।।
paropakāriṇaḥ śāntāḥ sādhukarmaṇyanuvratāḥ ।
kuputriṇaśca dhigjanma dhigrājyaṃ saṃpadaśca dhik ।।23।।
evamatyantaduṣṭasya putrasya caritena saḥ ।
vṛddhagargamapṛcchacca kṛtavāg dagdhamānasaḥ ।।।24।।।
suvratena purā vedā adhītā vidhinā mayā ।
samāpya vidyā vidhivat tato dāraparigrahaḥ ।।25।।
dharmaḥ samyagdhṛtaḥ sarvo nā'dharme vai manaḥ kṛtam ।
putrārthaṃ janitaścāyaṃ kuputraḥ kathamīdṛśaḥ ।।।26।।
so'yaṃ kiṃ nijadoṣeṇa māturdoṣeṇa vā mama ।
asmadduḥkhāvaho jāto duḥśīlo duṣṭalubdhakaḥ ।।।27।।
hiṃsako madyapaḥ steno duḥkhadāridryakṛtsadā ।
pitroḥ sadā'vamantā ca sevādharmavivarjitaḥ ।।।28।।।
asya janmottaraṃ lakṣmīrgṛhādbahirviyāti hi ।
asya prātarmukhā''loke'vaśyaṃ kalirbhavatyapi ।।29।
bhojanaṃ bhraṣṭatāṃ yāti dinaṃ gacchati durdinam ।
mama bhāryā ca kuṣṭhena rugṇā jātā tataḥ tadā ।।1.157.30।।
ahaṃ ca jvararogeṇa rugṇo jāto'smi nityadā ।
anye'pi mama poṣyāste hānau vartanta eva tat ।। 31।।
kāryaṃ yacca karomyetat saphalaṃ naiva jāyate ।
sāphalye'nyā dviguṇā ca hāniḥ samupatiṣṭhati ।।।32।।।
tasmād vicārya viprarṣe bhavet kimatra kāraṇam ।
tasya śāntiṃ kārayiṣye yadi saukhyaṃ labhe vada ।।।33।।
gargaḥ provāca revatyāṃ nakṣatre'yaṃ sutastava ।
jāto'sti duṣṭasamaye tena duḥkhāyate hyayam ।।34।।
vyatītaprāyā revatī kālo duṣṭo hi kathyate ।
revatyante yasya janma tatsarvaṃ duḥkhadaṃ bhavet ।।35।।
na putrasya na vai māturna vā te'sti pradūṣaṇam ।
paraṃ dauḥśīlyahetutvaṃ revatyante tu yajjaniḥ ।।36 ।।
revatyaśvinīmadhyaṃ yadāśleṣāmaghayostathā ।
jyeṣṭhāmūlayorapyuktaṃ gaṇḍāntaṃ tad bhayāvaham ।।।37 ।।
gaṇḍatraye samutpannā naranārīturaṃgamāḥ ।
tiṣṭhanti na ciraṃ gehe tiṣṭhanto'pi bhayāvahāḥ ।।38।।
evamukto'tha gargeṇa cukrodha kṛtavāk tadā ।
uvāca mama putrasya revatyante samudbhavaḥ ।।39।।
revatī kiṃ na jānāti māṃ vipraḥ śāpayiṣyati ।
prajvalyamānā gaganāt tasmātpatatu revatī ।।1.157.40।।
tenaivaṃ vyāhṛte vākye vismayā''viṣṭacetasaḥ ।
paśyataḥ sarvalokasya revatyantaṃ papāta ha ।।41 ।।
īśvarecchāprabhāveṇa kumudādrau samantataḥ ।
revatyanto nipatitaḥ khaṇḍaḥ parama ujjvalaḥ ।।।42।।
sa vai khaṇḍa ūrjjayantanāmā śailaḥ prakathyate ।
kumude mūrdhni patitaḥ śāntaśca kumude tathā ।।43।।
bhāsayāmāsa sahasā vanakandaranirjharam ।
kumudena samaṃ maitrīṃ kṛtavānūrjayan giriḥ ।।44।।
ūrjjayan revatīkhaṇḍaḥ kumude hyavasat sadā ।
tasmādapi kumudo vai raivatako'bhidhīyate ।।45।।
ābhūtasaṃplavam yāvat saṃsthitau tau parasparam ।
kumudādriśca tatkhaṇḍāt khyāto raivatako'bhavat ।।46।।
ūrjjayanto vahnivarṇaḥ kumudaścandravarṇakaḥ ।
dvayośca miśraṇe gairikāvarṇo raivatācalaḥ ।।47।।
athāpi revatīkhaṇḍaḥ kumudā''bhyantare'sti vai ।
jvālāmukhī kadācitsa bhaviṣyatyeva raivataḥ ।।48।।
mandaro hyaruṇaścāpi revatīkhaṇḍayogataḥ ।
jvālāmukhau kadācidvai layagrāhe bhaviṣyataḥ ।।49।।
ūrjjayantaśca kumudo mandaraścā'ruṇācalaḥ ।
kṛtasmaraśca pañcaite militvā raivatācalaḥ ।।1.157.50।।
vartate sumahān divyaḥ svarṇābho raivatācalaḥ ।
sa paścājjanayāmāsa kanyāṃ raivatako giriḥ ।।51।।
revatīkāntisadṛśīṃ revatīsadṛśānanām ।
khaṭvāṃgākhyasuvarṇāṃgadasvasā revatī śubhāḥ ।।।52।।।
nāmnā tu kathitā tatra tapasyatā dvijarṣiṇā ।
pramucākhyena pitṛvadvartamānena tadgirau ।।53।।
pitṛvadrevatīnāmā'karot pramucasanmuniḥ ।
raivato'pi revatīti nāmnā'juhāva tāṃ sutām ।।54।।
sā ca tatra kṛtasthānā vartate girikandare ।
tejomayaṃ ca tatsthānaṃ sarvatīrthajalāśrayam ।।55।।
gaṃgājalapravāhaśca yāmunaṃ salilaṃ tathā ।
sārasvataṃ ca salilaṃ tatra garteṣu tat trayam ।।।56।।
gartaḥ sa kandarāgrastho revatīkuṇḍa ucyate ।
tatra vai kandare bālā vardhitā pramucarṣiṇā ।।57।।
yauvanaṃ tu tayā prāptaṃ tatra raivatake girau ।
tāṃ ca yauvanasampannāṃ dṛṣṭvā saḥ pramuco muniḥ ।।58।।
ekānte cintayāmāsa ko'syā bhartā bhaviṣyati ।
hutvā hutvā sa papraccha guruṃ vahniṃ dvijottamaḥ ।।59।।
prasādaṃ kuru me brūhi ko'syā bhartā bhaviṣyati ।
asyā asti sadṛśo vā varo nāsti ca ko'pi vā ।।1.157.60 ।।
tadā'gnikuṇḍādutthāya mūrtimān hutabhuk svayam ।
prāha śṛṇu ca me vākyaṃ ko'syā bhartā bhaviṣyati ।।61।।
priyavratānvayotpanno mahābalaparākramaḥ ।
putro vikramaśīlasya kālindījaṭharodbhavaḥ ।।62।।
durdamo nāma bhavitā bhartā hyasyā mahīpatiḥ ।
atrāntare samāyāto durdamaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ ।।63।।
mṛgayāvyājatastatra kandarāṃ tāmapaśyata ।
dṛṣṭvā sa durdamaḥ kanyāmuvāca vidhiyogataḥ ।।64।।
priye pitā'sti te kutra darśanaṃ me bhavenna vā ।
tatrā'gniśālāsaṃsthaḥ saḥ śuśrāva tadvaco muniḥ ।।65 ।।
priye-ityāmantraṇasya kartā ko'yaṃ vicārya ca ।
ājagāma bahiryāvad rājānaṃ sa dadarśa ha ।।66।।
jaharṣa durdamaṃ bhāvijāmātāraṃ vilokya saḥ ।
śiṣyaṃ ca gautamaṃ prāhā'smai dehyarghyādikaṃ śubham ।।67।।
jāmātā'yaṃ daivayogāt syācca jāyā sutā mama ।
tamāsanagataṃ vipro gṛhītārghyaṃ mahāmuniḥ ।।68।।
pramucaḥ prāha rājendra kuśalaṃ te pure kimu ।
kośe bale ca mitre ca bhṛtyā'mātyeṣu śaṃ kimu ।।69।।
svāgataṃ te karomyatra daivayogātpravāsinaḥ ।
ātmani kuśalaṃ cāsti yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।।1.157.70।।
bhāryāste kuśalā rājan brūhi sarvaṃ yathāsthitam ।
durdamaḥ prāha pramuca! tvatprasādātsadā mama ।।71।।
rājyaṃ dārāśca kuśalāstvāṃ vilokya viśeṣataḥ ।
subhadrā śāntapāpā ca kāverītanayā tathā ।।72।।
surāmā jānujātā ca kadambā ca varaprajā ।
vipāṭhā nandinī cānyā bhāryā me kuśalāḥ sadā ।।73 ।।
pramucaḥ prāha durdama! priye ityuktavān bhavān ।
sā me śiṣyā revatī vai priyetyuktā priyā tava ।।74।।
tadanyathā na bhavitā yadṛcchāvacanaṃ tava ।
gṛhāṇemāṃ śubhāṃ kanyāṃ patnītvena mamājñayā ।।75 ।।
ityādivacanaiḥ rājā bhāryāyai pratipāditaḥ ।
viprastathodyataḥ kartuṃ vivāhaṃ vidhipūrvakam ।।76 ।।
tāvattu revatī prāha kiñcinme śrūyatām ṛṣe! ।
raivatyarkṣe vivāhaṃ me durdamena karotu vai ।।77।।
raivatarkṣaṃ vinā lagnaṃ viphalaṃ me bhaviṣyati ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha tadā śiṣyāṃ nāstīndū revatīyutaḥ ।।78।।
anyarkṣaṃ vartate cā''dya tat karomi yathā vada ।
kanyā prāha tapoyogāt kurvinduṃ revatīyutam ।।79।।
evaṃ bhavatu bhadrante pramucaḥ prāha tāṃ sutām ।
āropayāmīndumārge revatyarkṣaṃ kṛte yuvām ।।1.157.80।।
tatastapaḥprabhāveṇa raivatyarkṣaṃ mahāmuniḥ ।
candrasaṃyojitaṃ cakre vivāhaṃ kṛtavāँstataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
jāmātāramuvācarṣirudvāhikaṃ dadāmi kim ।
duṣprāpamapi dāsyāmi vidyate me mahattapaḥ ।।।82।।
rājā prāha tadā vipraṃ śṛṇu vai durghaṭaṃ vacaḥ ।
sūryasya saṃjñā yā patnī vaḍavā''sītsvarūpataḥ ।।।83।।
tadā tasyā aśvarūpasūryayoge nasastadā ।
raivato yaḥ samutpanno'dhyātmā'tra kumudācale ।।84।।
adṛśyo vartate tatra raivatarkṣaṃ samāgatam ।
seyaṃ tu revatī kanyā jātā me gṛhiṇī tu sā ।।85।।
tasyāṃ sa raivataḥ putro madyogādbhavatātpunaḥ ।
manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasyā'hamutpannaḥ santatau mune ।।86।।
manvantarādhipaṃ putraṃ tvatprasādād vṛṇomyaham ।
sa eva janma labdhā vai tato manvantaro bhavet ।।87।।
pañcamaḥ sa eva manurbhūyāditi vṛṇomyaham ।
tathā'stviti ṛṣiḥ prāha bhaviṣyati tathā manuḥ ।।88।।
revatī revatīkuṇḍe snātvā putraṃ pradāsyati ।
manoraṃśaḥ sa vai putro manureva bhaviṣyati ।।89।।
revatāṃśasamutpanno raivatākhyo bhaviṣyati ।
parvatākhyaśca manvākhyo dvedhā sthāsyati sarvadā ।।1.157.90।।
itiprāptavaro rājā saṃsnāto revatījale ।
revatyapi tathā snātā yogātputramajījanat ।।91 ।।
raivateti kṛtaṃ nāma sa vai manurajāyata ।
evaṃ yau revatīkuṇḍe snāsyatastadgṛhe sutaḥ ।।92।।
bhāgyavān rājyavān vijñaḥ khyātakīrtirbhavennanu ।
snāsyanti pramadā yāstā duḥkhadāridryavarjitāḥ ।।।93।।
lapsyante taijasaṃ putraṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam ।
iti te kathitaṃ tīrthaṃ revatīkuṇḍasaṃgatam ।।94।।
athā''rarādha tapasā revatī vāmanaṃ harim ।
dāmodaraḥ prasannaḥ sa revatīṃ pratyuvāca ha ।।95।।
jāyatāṃ te yathāpūrvaṃ yogastu śaśinā saha ।
anyad vṛṇohi tuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ manasi te sthitam ।।96।।
revatī prāha me nātha kandarāyā mukhe'tra vai ।
kuṇḍe yatra mayā snātaṃ svarṇarekhānadīyute ।।97।।
tatra snāsyanti ye teṣāṃ naśyantvaghasuparvatāḥ ।
svargaṃ yāntu sukhaṃ yāntu putrāँśca prāpnuvantu te ।।98।।
kiṃ cānyadvai samudrasya manthanaṃ tu yadā'bhavat ।
tadā tu mathyamānādvai pārijātādayo drumā ।।99।।
samudbhūtāstadā tatra druma āmardako'bhavat ।
āmarde sarvadevānāṃ jātā āmardakī smṛtā ।। 1.157.100।।
hariṇātvarpitā candramase svargaṃ tu gacchatā ।
candramāḥ snehabāhulyād dadau mahyaṃ tadā divi ।। 101 ।।
raivatīkhaṇḍago vṛkṣo'patat tatkhaṇḍasaṃsthitaḥ ।
kṛtavāco yadā śāpāt papāta kumude yadā ।। 10 2।।
mayā sākaṃ sa vai vṛkṣo raivate'drau samāgataḥ ।
divyaḥ sugandhapuṣpāḍhyo lakṣmīvāsamayo'sti saḥ ।। 1 03।।
asmin vṛkṣe sthitā lakṣmīḥ sevyate surasattamaiḥ ।
devairbrahmādibhiḥ sarvairvṛkṣo'sau vaiṣṇavo'rcitaḥ ।। 1 04।।
asya vṛkṣasya yātrāṃ ye kariṣyanti harerdine ।
phālgunaśukle dvādaśyāmekādaśyāṃ tathā priye ।। 1 05।।
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca bhaviṣyanti guṇādhikāḥ ।
ante viṣṇupure vāso jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 106।।
phālgunasya site pakṣe ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ ।
snātvā hyekādaśī devī pratimāyāṃ girau vane ।। 107।
pūjyā puṣpaiḥ śubhaiḥ rātrau kāryaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ janaiḥ ।
aṣṭādhikaiḥ śataiḥ kāryaṃ phalaistasyāḥ pradakṣiṇam ।। 1 08।।
kartavyastatphalāhāro ghaṭo deyau jalānvitaḥ ।
mukhe śrīphalasaṃyukto dīpaḥ kāryaśca sarpiṣā ।। 10 9।।
haviṣyānnaṃ tathā deyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca phalādikam ।
tathā jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ kathāśravaṇatatparaiḥ ।। 1.157.110 ।।
mucyante manujāḥ pāpaiḥ kaṭhinaiḥ kāryasaṃbhavaiḥ ।
dehānte te narāḥ sarve pūjyante harimandire ।।1 1 1।।
athāpi revatī devī kṛtavācaṃ samāgatam ।
jagāda parayā prītyā jvarakuṣṭhau vinaśyataḥ ।। 1 12।।
putraste suguṇaścā'stu yāmyahaṃ vai punardivam ।
aṃśena revatītīrthe sthāsyāmyākalpamatra ca ।। 11 3।।
iti proktvā divaṃ yātā saṃgatā śaśinaṃ tathā ।
tīrthaṃ tu sarvatā sā'bhūt revatīkuṇḍasaṃjñakam ।। 1 14।।
atha vai brahmaṇaḥ putro marīcistasya kaśyapaḥ ।
tasya putro vivasvāँśca tasya śaryātirucyate ।। 1 15।।
tasya tvānartasaṃjño'bhūt yena paścimavāridhau ।
tapastaptvā tu golokācchrīkṛṣṇāt khaṇḍa āhṛtaḥ ।। 1 16।।
so'yaṃ saurāṣṭra ityukto maṇeḥ khaṇḍo'pi cāhṛtaḥ ।
sa divyaḥ prathamaścādrirānartasya suputratām ।। 1 17।।
prāptavānaṃśatastasya raivatākhyā kṛtā tadā ।
raivataḥ saḥ svarṇanadyāṃ yātrārthaṃ samupāgataḥ ।। 118।।
kṛtavācā tu putrārthaṃ snāpito revatījale ।
raivataḥ prāha viprarṣe tvatsamo me'stu vai sutaḥ ।। 1 19।।
tathā'stu prāha viprarṣistato yātrāṃ vidhāya ca ।
raivataḥ svapiturānartasya purīṃ kuśasthalīm ।। 1.157.120।।
ānartanirmitā tatra jagāma tadgṛhe tadā ।
viprarṣiḥ kṛtavāk putrarūpeṇāṃ'śena cā'bhavat ।। 121 ।।
revatyā ca śrutaṃ svarge gururvai nidhanaṃ gataḥ ।
ānartasya suputrasya raivatasya suputrakaḥ ।। 122।।
saṃjāto'sti tataḥ snehād revatyapi samāgatā ।
revatasya suputrasya kakudmī nāma cā'bhavat ।। 123।।
kakudmino gṛhe kanyā revatī cāṃśato'bhavat ।
rūpaguṇavayoyuktāṃ varayogyā vilokya ca ।। 124।।
revatīsadṛśaṃ kāntaṃ yadā naivopalabdhavān ।
tadā varaṃ paripraṣṭuṃ satyalokaṃ jagāma ha ।। 125।।
revatyā saha rājāsau kakudmī vedhasaḥ sadaḥ ।
jagāma yatra gāndharvagāyanaṃ nṛtyamiśritam ।। 1 26।।
pravartate devakoṭisaṃjuṣṭasadasi nṛpaḥ ।
kṣaṇaṃ sthito'labdhakṣaṇastadante brahmaṇe tu saḥ ।। 127।।
namaskṛtya savinayaṃ svābhiprāyaṃ nyavedayat ।
brahman pṛthvyāṃ tu rājāno santi vai bahavaḥ khalu ।। 128।।
suvarṇāṃgadabhūpālo maruttvān rukmabarhiṣaḥ ।
ikṣvākuścāpīndrasenastathā'nye cakravartinaḥ ।। 129।।
kasmai deyā mayā kanyā brūhi yat tatkaromyaham ।
tacchrutvā tu tadā brahmā prahasya tamuvāca ha ।। 1.157.1 30।।
aho rājan mṛtāste tu kālena tvatsamāyuṣaḥ ।
tatputravaṃśavaṃśyānāṃ nāmagotrāṇi santi na ।। 13 1।।
satyaloke kṣaṇe kāle caturyugaikaviṃśatiḥ ।
bhuvo yāti mahākālo naṣṭā ye te hṛdi kṛtāḥ ।। 1 32।।
parāvṛtyā'rdhakṣaṇataḥ punaryāsyasi tvaṃ yadā ।
tadā tu tatrā'ṣṭāviṃśo dvāparaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 133।।
tadante vartamānāya śeṣāvatārarūpiṇe ।
balabhadrāya dātavyaṃ kanyāratnamidaṃ tvayā ।। 1 34।।
śīghraṃ gatvā kakudmī tattathaiva balayogine ।
dāsyati svasutāratnaṃ tapase yāsyati vanam ।। 1 35।।।
revatī sā punastīrthaṃ kariṣyati tu raivate ।
patyā saha punarnāśe golokaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ।। 136।।
evaṃ sā revatī pūrvā hareḥ patnī prakīrtitā ।
punardakṣasya duhitā sthitā nakṣatrarūpiṇī ।। 1 37।।
punaśca raivatādreḥ sā putrī kandarasaṃsthitā ।
punaḥ kakudminaḥ putrī balapatnī prakīrtitā ।। 1 38।।
tīrtharūpā sadā tatra raivate sannivatsyati ।
ekasyāpi vibhūtestu janmakarmāṇyanekaśaḥ ।। 139।।
caritrāṇi ca divyāni samakāle bhavanti vai ।
tāni sarvāṇyahaṃ vedmi kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।। 1.157.140 ।।
evaṃ kalpāntare'pyeṣāṃ prāvirbhāvāstathaiva hi ।
bhaviṣyantīti vijñeyaṃ tava prāviḥsvabhāvavat ।। 141 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne revatīnakṣatrakhaṇḍasya pṛthivīpatananimittaṃ raivatācale pañcaparvatātmake revatyā janma, candre saṃyojitarevatīnakṣatre durdamena saha vivāhaḥ, revatyāṃ punaḥ revatajanma, revatīkuṇḍamahimā, āmardakavṛkṣamahimā, punarānartaputrarevataputrasya kṛtavācākhyakakudmino gṛhe revatījanma, brahmasabhāgamanaṃ, balabhadreṇa vivāhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 157।।


← adhyāyaḥ 157 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 158
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 159 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmīstathā nārāyaṇaśca raivate priye ।
nivasataḥ sadā devau draṣṭavyau kārtike site ।। 1 ।।
tatra dāmodaraṃ dṛṣṭvā prapūjya ca vidhānataḥ ।
puruṣottamapuryāstu yātrāphalamavāpnuyāt ।। 2 ।।
māghe māsi bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā na punarjāyate bhave ।
vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre kuśasthalyāṃ janārdane ।। 3 ।।
yatphalaṃ tannimiṣārdhe dṛṣṭvā dāmodaraṃ ramām ।
pretatvaṃ narakaṃ vā na vastrāpathe mṛtasya vai ।। 4 ।।
dhanyānāmapi te dhanyā devānāmapi devatāḥ ।
vastrāpathe mṛtiryeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ hare harau matiḥ ।। 5 ।।
godānaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam ।
piṇḍadānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ kalpāntaṃ tṛptikārakam ।। 6 ।।
dāmodaro bhavaḥ svarṇarekhā brahmeśvarastathā ।
brahmakuṇḍaḥ kālamegho nārāyaṇahradastathā ।। 7 ।।
kālikendreśvaro mṛgīkuṇḍaunnabilastathā ।
maṃgalaśca tathā siddhāḥ siddheśvaraśca revatī ।। 8 ।।
revatīkuṇḍa ityuktaścakrodyānaṃ parīsaraḥ ।
ityevamāditīrthāni smṛtvā pāpaṃ vināśayet ।। 9 ।।
dhanyo dāmodaraḥ kuṇḍo mṛtānāṃ mokṣadaḥ sadā ।
yatrā'sthi patitaṃ pāpakṛto'pi taṃ ca tārayet ।। 1.158.10 ।।
yatra vai patitaṃ bhasma dehinaṃ mokṣayet sadā ।
yajjalānāṃ kaṇamātraṃ mukhe patitameva ca ।। 1 1।।
prajvālayati pāpāni janmāntarakṛtāni vai ।
yattīre kṛtadānasya śrāddhasyā'sīmakaṃ phalam ।। 12।।
avaśyaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ śrāddhaṃ muktipradaṃ tathā ।
dhanyo nārāyaṇahrado yatra śrāddhaṃ praśasyate ।। 1 3।।
tattattithau hi śrāddhasya phalaṃ vai kīrtayāmi te ।
pitṝnabhyarcya pratipadyāpnuyātsugṛhe priyāḥ ।। 14।।
dvitīyāyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe putryo jāyanta ujjvalāḥ ।
tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe jāyante vājinaḥ śubhāḥ ।। 15।।
caturthyāṃ tu kṛte śrāddhe chāgā'jāḥ paśavo gṛhe ।
pañcamyāṃ tu kṛte śrāddhe putrā jāyanta aiśvarāḥ ।। 16।।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śrāddhe kṛte sarve nīrogā dyutibhāginaḥ ।
saptamyāṃ tu kṛte śrāddhe kṛṣiprāptirbhavennanu ।। 17।।
aṣṭamyāṃ tu kṛte śrāddhe vāṇijye lābhamāpnuyāt ।
navamyāṃ tu kṛte śrāddhe bhavatyekaśaphaṃ bahu ।। 18।।
daśamyāṃ tu kṛte śrāddhe gomahiṣyādikaṃ bahu ।
ekādaśyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe vastrapātrādikaṃ bahu ।। 1 9।।
brahmavarcasvinaḥ putrā jāyante ca prabhāviṇaḥ ।
dvādaśyāṃ tu kṛte śrāddhe vittaṃ svarṇā'dikaṃ bahu ।।।1.158.20 ।।
trayodaśyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe jñātiśreṣṭhotimānitaḥ ।
caturdaśyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe yuddhe vijayavān bhavet ।।21।।
amāyāṃ sekṛte śrāddhe sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ।
pūrṇimāyāṃ kṛte śrāddhe bahudhā smṛddhimān bhavet। ।।22।।
kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau varjayitvā caturdaśīm ।
tithayaḥ śrāddhakarmādau praśastā na tathetarāḥ ।।।23।।
yathā caivā'paraḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvapakṣādviśiṣyate ।
tathā śrāddhasya pūrvāhṇādaparāhṇo viśiṣyate ।।24।।
tilairvrīhiyavairmāṣairadbhirmūlaphalaistathā ।
dattena samyak prīyante śrāddhena pitaraḥ priye ।।।5।।
sarveṣveva tu śrāddheṣu tilāḥ prādhānyataḥ smṛtāḥ ।
miṣṭānnāni bahūnyeva sarpirgavyaṃ ca pāyasam ।।26।।
āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ gavyamannaṃ ca peyamuttamam ।
yatkiṃcinmadhusamiśraṃ śrāddhe'nantasutṛptidam ।।27।।
nakṣatreṣu phalaṃ śrāddhe kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ।
apatyakāmo rohiṇyāṃ tejaskāmo mṛgottame ।। 28।।
krūrakarmā tathā''rdrāyāṃ dhanakāmaḥ punarvasau ।
puṣṭikāmastathā puṣye cā''śleṣāyāṃ sutecchukaḥ ।।।29।।
jñātyagryecchurmaghāyāṃ tu phālgunyāṃ subhagecchukaḥ ।
apatyabhāguttarāsu haste kāryaphalecchukaḥ ।।।1.158.3 0।।
suputrecchustu citrāyāṃ svātau vāṇijyakāmukaḥ ।
rājyecchuranurādhāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryānnaraḥ sadā ।।3 1।।
bahuputrecchukaḥ śrāddhaṃ viśākhāyāṃ pravartayet ।
adhipatīcchurjyeṣṭhāyāṃ mūle tvārogyakāmukaḥ ।।32।।
pūrvāṣāḍhāsu tu yaśaskāmaḥ śrāddhaṃ samācaret ।
uttarāsu tvaṣāḍhāsu vītaśokecchukaścaret ।।33 ।।
bhiṣagicchurabhijiti śravaṇe sadgatīcchukaḥ ।
rājyecchuko dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ kuryācchrāddhaṃ vidhānataḥ ।।34।।
bhiṣaksiddhīcchukaḥ śatabhiṣaji śrāddhamācaret ।
ajā'vīcchuḥ pūrvabhādrapadāyāṃ śrāddhamācaret ।। 35।।
gavecchukaścottarāyāṃ revatyāṃ vittakāmukaḥ ।
aśvinyāmaśvasaṃkalpo bharaṇyāmāyuricchukaḥ ।।36।।
śrāddhaṃ kuryād revatādrau dāmodarasamīpataḥ ।
nārāyaṇahrade caiva kuṇḍe dāmodare tathā ।।37।।
ye tu dharmavyapeteṣu cāritryā'pagateṣu ca ।
havyaṃ kavyaṃ prayacchanti teṣāṃ tatpretya naśyati ।।38।।
vidyāvedavratasnātāḥ sadācāraparāstathā ।
mātāpitroḥ sevakāśca satyadharmaparāstathā ।। 39।।
puṇyatīrthā'bhiṣiktāścā'vabhṛthasnāyinastathā ।
akrodhanāstathā kṣāntāḥ samarthāśca jitendriyāḥ ।।1.158.40।।
yatayo mokṣadharmajñā yogajñāḥ suvratāstathā ।
ye cetihāsaṃ prayatāḥ śrāvayanti janānsadā ।।41 ।।
vedavedāṃgavettāraḥ śāstradarśanasadvidaḥ ।
dharmaśāstrapurāṇajñāḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavastathā ।।42।।
acyutagotrā ye syuste sarve vai paṃktipāvanāḥ ।
sarvabhūtahitānsarvān śrāddheṣvetān nimantrayet ।।43।।
teṣu vai bhuṃjamāneṣu pitarastatra bhuṃjate ।
devāstu pitaro nāma nirmitā ye svayaṃbhuvā ।।44।।
saptakaḥ pitṛvaṃśastu pūrvadṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā ।
viśve cāgnimukhā devāstān pravakṣyāmi nāmataḥ ।।45।।
balaṃ dhṛtirvipāpmā ca puṇyakṛt pāvanāstathā ।
pārṣṇiḥ kṣemā samūhaśca divyasānustathaiva ca ।।46।।
vivasvān vīryavān hrīmān kīrtimān kṛta eva ca ।
jitātmā munivaryaśca dīptaromā bhayaṃkaraḥ ।।47।।
anukarmā pratītaśca pradātā'tyaṃśumāँstathā ।
śailābhaḥ paramakrodhī dhīroṣṇī bhūpatistathā ।।48।।
srajo vajrī varī caiva viśvedevāḥ sanātanāḥ ।
vidyudvarcāḥ somavarcāḥ sūryaśrīśceti nāmataḥ ।।49।।
somapaḥ sūryasāvitrī dattātmā puṇḍarīyakaḥ ।
uṣṇīnābho nabhodaśca viśvāyurdīptireva ca ।।।।1.158.50।।
camūharaḥ sureśaśca vyomāriḥ śaṃkaro bhavaḥ ।
īśaḥ kartā kṛtirdakṣo bhuvano divyakarmakṛt ।।51।।
gaṇitaḥ pañcavīryaśca hyādityo raśmivāँstathā ।
saptakṛtsomavarcāśca viśvakṛt kavirityapi ।।52।।
anugoptā sugoptā ca naptā ceśvara eva ca ।
kīrtitāste mahābhāgāḥ kālasya gatigocarāḥ ।।53।।
pitāmahaḥ pulastyaśca vasiṣṭhaḥ pulahastathā ।
aṃgirāśca kratuścaiva kaśyapaśca mahānṛṣiḥ ।।54।।
mahāyogeśvarā ete pitaraḥ pūrvajāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi bālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ ।।55।।
anye gotrapravarāśca saśākhāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।
agniṣvāttā barhiṣadā ājyapāḥ somapāstathā ।।56।।
gaṇaścaturvidhaścāyaṃ pitaraste'pi pūrvajāḥ ।
brahmaṇā nirmitā devapitaraste cirāyuṣaḥ ।।57।।
śravaṇāḥ pretakā yāmyā nārakāḥ pitaraśca te ।
sāṃvatsarāśca āgneyā janmāptāḥ pitaraśca te ।।58।।।
tadānye vaṃśakartāro mṛtāste brahmalokagāḥ ।
aiśvarāḥ pitaraścaite vijñeyā bhāgakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।।59।।
ta ete satsu pātreṣu bhuṃjate yānti tṛptikam ।
tebhyaścānnaṃ havirmṛṣṭaṃ phalaṃ jalaṃ ca pāyasam ।।1.158.60 ।।
vividhaṃ vai pradātavyaṃ tṛptā rakṣanti vaṃśajān ।
dāmodare'rpayetpiṇḍān svarṇarekhānadītaṭe ।।61।।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।
mātā pitāmahī ceva tathaiva prapitāmahī ।।62।।
mātāmahastatpitā ca pramātāmahakādayaḥ ।
teṣāṃ piṇḍo mayā datto hyakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām ।।6 3 ।।
asmatkule mṛtā ye ca gatiryeṣāṃ na vidyate ।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya piṇḍamenaṃ dadāmyaham ।।64।।
bandhuvargakule ye ca gatiryeṣāṃ na vidyate ।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya piṇḍamenaṃ dadāmyaham ।।65।।
ajātadantā ye kecid ye tu garbhe prapīḍitāḥ ।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya piṇḍamenaṃ dadāmyaham ।।66।।
agnidagdhāśca ye kecicchītanaṣṭāstathā'pare ।
anagninaṣṭā ye cānye tebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।67।।
vidyuccaurahatā dāvadāhe ye ca mṛtāstathā ।
hiṃsavyāghrahatā ye ca tebhyaḥ piṃḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।68।।।
daṃṣṭriśṛṃginakhikṣveḍiśastripāśihatāśca ye ।
ātmaghātikṣud ghātinastebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।69।।
vane'raṇye vartmamadhye tṛṣayā kṣudhayā hatāḥ ।
bhūtapretapiśācaiśca tebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।1.158.70।।
raurave ye ca tāmisre kālasūtre ca ye sthitāḥ ।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya piṇḍamenaṃ dadāmyaham ।।71।।
anekayātanāsaṃsthāḥ pretalokaṃ ca ye gatāḥ ।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya piṇḍamena dadāmyaham ।।72।।
durgatiṃ samanuprāpya ye'bhiśāpādinā hatāḥ ।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya piṇḍamenaṃ dadāmyaham ।।73।।
narakeṣu samasteṣu yamadūtavaśaṃgatāḥ ।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya piṇḍamenaṃ dadāmyaham ।।74।।
paśuyonigatā ye ca pakṣikīṭasarīsṛpāḥ ।
api ye vṛkṣayonisthāstebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।75।।
jātyantarasahasreṣu ye bhramanti svakarmabhiḥ ।
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ yeṣāṃ tebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।76।।
divyantarīkṣabhūmiṣṭhāḥ pitaro bāndhavādayaḥ ।
asaṃskṛtamṛtā ye ca tebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।77।।
ye kecitpretarūpeṇa vartante pitaro mama ।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu piṇḍenā'nena sarvadā ।।78।।
abāndhavā bāndhavā ye tathā'nyajanibāndhavāḥ ।
teṣāṃ piṇḍo mayā datto hyakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām ।।79।।
pitṛvaṃśe mṛtā ye ca mātṛvaṃśe ca ye mṛtāḥ ।
guruśvaśurabandhūnāṃ ye cānye bāndhavā mṛtāḥ ।।1.158.80।।
luptapiṇḍāḥ kule ye me putradāravivarjitāḥ ।
kriyālopagatā ye ca jātyandhāḥ paṃgavaśca ye ।।8 1 ।।
virūpā āmagarbhāśca jñātā'jñātāḥ kule mama ।
teṣā piṇḍo mayā datto hyakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām ।।।82।।
ā brahmaṇaḥ pitṛvaṃśamātṛvaṃśabhavāśca ye ।
jātāḥ kuladvaye ye me tebhyaḥ piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।।83।।
ye kecitpretarūpeṇa vartante pitaro mama ।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu saktubhistilamiśritaiḥ ।।84।।
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ yatkiṃcitsacarācaram ।
mayā dattena piṇḍena tṛptimāyātu sarvaśaḥ ।।85।।
kuṇḍe dāmodare snānaṃ karomyātmaviśuddhaye ।
sūryalokādisamprāptisiddhaye pretamuktaye ।।86।।
snātvā'tha tarpaṇaṃ kuryād devādīnāṃ yathāvidhi ।
ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ।।87।।
vairājā brahmamārgasthāstathā'nye puṇyalokagāḥ ।
tṛpyantu pitaraḥ sarve mātṛmātāmahādayaḥ ।।88।।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।
mama tṛptiṃ prayāntvadya homādhyāsitamūrtayaḥ ।।89।।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।
mama tṛptiṃ prayāntvadya vipradeheṣu saṃsthitāḥ ।।1.158.90 ।।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।
tṛptiṃ prayāntu piṇḍeṣu mayā datteṣu bhūtale ।।91 ।।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।
tṛptiṃ prayāntu me bhaktyā yanmayaitadudāhṛtam ।।92।।।
mātāmahastṛptimetu tṛptimupaitu tatpitā ।
viśve devā yāntu tṛptiṃ tṛptiṃ yātu hariḥ prabhuḥ ।।93।।
yasya śrāddhe yatirbhuṃkte tasya bhuṃkte hariḥ svayam ।
yasya śrāddhe harirbhuṃkte tasya bhuṃkte jagattrayam ।।94।।
sādhavo vaiṣṇavāḥ śrāddhe bhojanīyā viśeṣataḥ ।
sādhvyaśca bhojanīyā vai puṇyamakṣayyatṛptikṛt ।।95।।
yo vai yatīnanādṛtya bhojayeditarān dvijān ।
vijānan vasato grāme kavyaṃ tadyāti rākṣasān ।।96।।
harerbhakto yatiryatra śrāddhe bhuṃkte tadā tu tat ।
prasaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavet śrāddhaṃ vināpi śrāddhasampadam ।।97।।
annakṣīraghṛtakṣaudrairaikṣaveṇa ca tarpitāḥ ।
prāpnuvantyakṣayāṃ tṛptiṃ sarve pitṛgaṇā api ।।98।।
nirdoṣaṃ pāyasaṃ cānnamṛṣidhānyāni cābdhije ।
arpayet sarvapitṛbhyastena tuṣyanti te sadā ।।99।।
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ navanītaṃ gavāṃ tu pāvanam ।
mahiṣīṇāṃ ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na tu tatpaya ucyate ।। 1.158.1 00।।
mātāmaho'tha dauhitro bhāgineyaśca mātulaḥ ।
mātṛṣvaseyastajjaśca mātuleyastathaiva ca ।। 10 1।।
jāmātā śvaśuraścaiva bhāryābhrātā ca tatsutaḥ ।
ṛtviggururupādhyāya ācāryaḥ śrotriyastathā ।। 102।।
suvratāḥ sādhusādhvyaśca hyete śrāddheṣu pāvanāḥ ।
yugānurūpadharmajñā vidyācārādirakṣakāḥ ।।1 03।।
kālaḥ kutupasaṃjñaśca tathā nepālakambalaḥ ।
raupyaṃ darbhāstilāḥ śrāddhe dauhitraśceti pāvanāḥ ।। 1 04।।
ahno muhūrtā vikhyātā daśapaṃca ca sarvadā ।
tatrā'ṣṭamo muhūrto yaḥ sa kālaḥ kutupaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 105।।
agastyaṃ bhaṃgarājaṃ ca tulasī śatapatrikā ।
campakaṃ tilapuṣpaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ vallabhāni ṣaṭ ।। 1 06।।
piṇḍamātraṃ pradātavyamasattve dravyaviprayoḥ ।
śrāddhīyā'hani saṃprāpte śrāddhaṃ śaktivadācaret ।। 107।।
udakuṃbhaṃ pradadyādvā phalaṃ kadalameva vā ।
tṛṇāni vā gave dadyānna tu śūnyaṃ dinaṃ nayet ।। 1 08।।
vaiṣṇavaistu kramātprāptaṃ śrāddhamekādaśīdine ।
dvādaśyāmapi kartavyaṃ pitaro vaiṣṇavā yataḥ ।। 10 9।।
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā copavasedāghrāya pitṛsevitam ।
śrāddhe prāpto'tithirbhojanīyaḥ syācchrāddhapūrṇatā ।। 11 0।।
arogo'vikalo bhoktā cirāyuḥ putrapautravān ।
arthavānarthabhogī ca śrāddhakartā vivardhate ।। 11 1।।
deve śrāddhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ syānmartye bhojyaṃ paśau tṛṇam ।
nāge vāyuryatra yonau prete tadbhojanaṃ bhavet ।। 1 12।।
tattadannatayaivetthaṃ śrāddhānnaṃ sarvayoniṣu ।
prāpyate prāṇibhistasmācchrāddhaṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 1 13।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne revatācale dāmodarakuṇḍe śrāddhe tithiphalaṃ nakṣatraphalaṃ satpātraṃ vividhapitarastaddeyasāmānyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 158।।
