adhyāyaḥ 159
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 160 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
nārāyaṇahrado lakṣmi! yatra nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
lakṣmyā sākaṃ garuḍenā''gatya saṃsnātavān hariḥ ।। 1 ।।
purā kṛtayuge lakṣmi! bhaktidharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
kuṃkumavāpīvāstavyo vipro nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ ।। 2 ।।
patnīvrato brahmadevaḥ kārtikyāmāgataḥ svayam ।
yātrārthaṃ revatādreśca snāto dāmodare hrade ।। 3 ।।
śrāddhaṃ dāmodare kṛtvā mahāpūjāvidhānataḥ ।
dāmodaraṃ pūjayitvā nṛtyotsavamakārayat ।। 4 ।।
bhaktyā saṃbhojayāmāsa dvādaśyāṃ bhūsurān sataḥ ।
dāmodaraḥ prasanno'bhūdaicchaddātuṃ svadarśanam ।। 5 ।।
dāmodaraṃ praṇamyaiva yāvadagre pravartate ।
tāvaddāmodaro devo viprarūpeṇa cā'gragaḥ ।। 6 ।।
tairthikasya svarūpeṇa militaḥ prāha oṃ namaḥ ।
parasparaṃ namaskṛtya viprau tau parvataṃ prati ।। 7 ।।
yāvadagre prayātaśca tāvattairthikayātriṇā ।
uktaṃ brahmannuparyatra hrado'sti subhago mahān ।। 8 ।।
jalaṃ pātālajharaṇaṃ svarṇarekhānadīmayam ।
parvatodarasambaddhamakṣayaṃ cāmṛtopamam ।। 9 ।।
jalaṃ pītvā gamiṣyāvo bhavasya bhavanaṃ prati ।
ityāmantrya gatau viprau hrade nārāyaṇe jalam ।। 1.159.1 0।।
agādhaṃ vai samālokyā'raṇyaṃ gāḍhaṃ ca śākhinām ।
prasannamanasau jātau viśrāmaṃ kṣaṇamāpatuḥ ।। 1 1।।
tairthikarṣerdarśanena cittaṃ patnīvratasya tu ।
yogābhyāsagatau śāntaṃ yathā tadvadajāyata ।। 12।।
tairthikastu jalaṃ tasmād hradāt svasya kamaṇḍalau ।
bhṛtvā tīre tato gatvā patnīvratamapāyayat ।। 1 3।।
tāvatpatnīvratasyaitajjalapānena tatkṣaṇāt ।
indriyavrattayaḥ śāntā upājagmuḥ parāvṛtim ।। 14।।
karmajñānendriyāṇāṃ vai vṛttayo mānasaṃ prati ।
līnāstanmānasī vṛttirahaṃbhāve layaṃ gatā ।। 15।।
ahaṃbhāvastadā tasya buddhau tu līnatāṃ gataḥ ।
buddhirjīvātmatattve tu līnabhāvaṃ gatā yadā ।। 16।।
tāvattenātmanā svasya brahmatvaṃ cāvalokitam ।
rūpaṃ tejomayaṃ divyaṃ vyāpakaṃ sīmaśūnyakam ।। 17।।
koṭikoṭyarkasaṃkāśaṃ svātmarūpaṃ vilokitam ।
ātmanā cakṣuṣā cātmā svenaiva svo vilokitaḥ ।। 18।।
anantā''nandasandoho hyanantasukhaśevadhiḥ ।
anantāścaryasampūrṇo hyaprasaṃkhyacamatkṛtiḥ ।। 19।।
anantaiśvaryasampanno hyanantadhāmadarśanaḥ ।
anantā'bjāṇusadṛśabrahmāṇḍakoṭiromakaḥ ।।1.159.20 ।।
ātmā svaṃ dṛṣṭavān vipraḥ patnīvratastadantare ।
tadā tatrā'kṣaraṃ brahma dhāma tejomayaṃ mahat ।।।21 ।।
dadarśā'sīmataijasvi parabrahmanivāsavat ।
tatrā'yaṃ tairthiko vipro nārāyaṇasvarūpavān ।।22।।
saṃsthito divyasauvarṇamaṇisiṃhāsane śubhe ।
anantā'nantamuktaiḥ saṃsevito dharmabhaktibhiḥ ।।23 ।।
asaṃkhyasvapriyādivyatanvībhiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
tatratyaiḥ satkṛtāṃ pūjāmādāyā''gacchatāmubhau ।।24।।
brahmadhāmni sabhā divyā kathā yatra pravartate ।
tatrāgatau ca tau devau sadasyaiḥ satkṛtau sthitau ।। 25।।
upaviṣṭau tadarthaṃ saṃklṛptā''sanavareṇyayoḥ ।
kathāyāṃ vācyamānāyāṃ nārāyaṇahradāplavam ।।26 ।।
kṛtaṃ tena ca teṣāṃ vai dhāmnyatra muktiriṣyate ।
tatrā'smān brahmadhāmasthān muktān smaranti ye janāḥ ।।27।।
ye bhaktāstaddhrade snānti pibanti salilaṃ ca ye ।
teṣāṃ phalaṃ sadā'kṣayyaṃ dhāmnyatra saṃprajāyate ।।28 ।।
asmān saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya jalaṃ pāsyanti ye pitṝn ।
teṣāṃ te pitarastatra muktiṃ yāsyanti dhāmani ।। 29।।
nārāyaṇamanusmṛtya jalaṃ pāsyanti ye janāḥ ।
teṣāṃ satkāryataścātra svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।1.159.30 ।।
prasanno bhavati tṛptastena tṛptā vayaṃ sadā ।
ityādikīṃ varāṃ gāthāṃ śrutavantāvubhau surau ।। 31 ।।
tatratyaiḥ satkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhītvā yayatustataḥ ।
golokaṃ dhāma paramaṃ kṛṣṇagopījanāvṛtam ।। 32।।
koṭīnāṃ gopagopīnāṃ madhye kṛṣṇasvarūpataḥ ।
saṃsthitastairthiko vipro dṛṣṭaḥ patnīvratena vai ।। 33।।
tatratyaiḥ pūjitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śuśrāva rasakīrtanam ।
nārāyaṇahradasnānabalādvai kṛṣṇamandiram ।। 34।।
āyānti bahavo muktāstṛpyanti kaṇayogataḥ ।
tatra snānotsavādibhyaḥ kṛṣṇo yāti prasannatām ।। 35।।
kṛṣṇe prasanne golokaḥ sarvastṛptaḥ sadāsti yat ।
śrutvaitat tau gatau devau vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma yanmahat ।। 36।।
tatratyairvanditau tadvat svāsane sanniṣāditau ।
tatra tau dvau divyaviprau nārāyaṇau babhūvatuḥ ।। 37।।
nāṇvapi nyūnatā tatra dvayornārāyaṇātmanoḥ ।
caturbhujau ca tau jātau naikalakṣmīniṣevitau ।। 38।।
satkṛtau sevitau tau dvau dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ parasparam ।
śrutavantau stutiṃ divyāṃ lakṣyādigaditāṃ śubhām ।।39।।
nārāyaṇahrade snānaṃ pānaṃ tathā ca tarpaṇam ।
kṛtaṃ yena yadarthe vai te syurvaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।।1.159.40 ।।
tatkṛtāṃ mahatīṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇātyeva hariḥ svayam ।
nārāyaṇaḥ sadā śrīmān prasanno bhavati dhruvam ।।41 ।।
tasya prasannatālābhe vayaṃ tṛptāḥ sadā sma om' ।
ityānandamayīṃ vācaṃ śrutvā'mṛtaṃ tu jagmatuḥ ।।42।।
dhāmnyamṛte tannivāsipradatte hyāsane vare ।
samupatiṣṭhatastau dvau satkṛtau mānitau muhuḥ ।।43।।
śrutavantau ca tatratyāṃ kathāṃ lakṣmīniveditām ।
raivatākhye mahādivye svarṇarekhānadījale ।।44।।
nārāyaṇahrade snānātpānāttadvacca tarpaṇāt ।
bhūmānārāyaṇastṛptaḥ prasanno bhavati dhruvam ।।45।।।
tasya prasannatātṛptyā vayaṃ tṛptāḥ sadā matāḥ ।
śrutvā nārāyaṇau tau dvau loke prākṛtapauruṣe ।।46।।
prādhānapauruṣe loke gatvā cā'vyākṛte tataḥ ।
loke hairaṇyakośākhye vairāje ca tathā gatau ।।47।।
śvetadvīpe badaryāṃ ca kṣaire dhāmani vaiṣṇave ।
sādāśaive tathā māyāloke cāvaraṇeṣu ca ।।48।।
gatau caiśvaralokeṣu tatratyaiḥ pūjitau tathā ।
vanditau satkṛtau tatra śrutavantau kathāṃ śubhām ।।49।।
nārāyaṇahrade snānāt dānāt pānācca tarpaṇāt। ।
nārāyaṇaḥ prasanno vai jāyate tatkṛpāvaśāt ।।1.159.50।।
vayaṃ tṛptāḥ sadā smo'trā'mṛtamaiśvarameva tat ।
nārāyaṇahrado brahmadhāma cā'kṣarameva tat ।।5 1 ।।
tajjalaṃ taddhāma tṛptirānandadrava eva saḥ ।
tadvai nārāyaṇamūrteḥ sukhamānandameva yat ।।।52।।
tena tṛptāḥ sadā smo'tra vayaṃ hareḥ prasādataḥ ।
iti tau brāhmaṇau nārāyaṇāvīśvarabhūmikāḥ ।।53।।।
dṛṣṭvā''yātau satyaloke vairājākhye stare tadā ।
tatratyairbahubhistatrarṣipitṛmunibhistathā ।।54।।
brahmaṇaśca sabhāyāṃ vai sarasvatyādibhistathā ।
gāyatryā caiva sāvitryā'siknyā ca sandhyayā tathā ।।55।।
paliknyā ca viriṇyā ca śatarūpādibhistathā ।
ratyā sṛṣṭyā ca mohinyā kadrūvā tāpasikājanaiḥ ।।56।।
vanditau pūjitau devau satkṛtau viṣṭaraṃgatau ।
śrutavantau kathāṃ divyā dhanyo nārāyaṇo hradaḥ ।।57।।
yatra vai tarpaṇādasmān poṣayanti ca bhūsurāḥ ।
kārtikyāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tatraikavāraṃ yena saṃkṛtam ।।।58।।
abjavarṣā'rbudānyasmattṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ।
athāpi ye dvijāḥ patnīvrataprakhyā bhuvi sthitāḥ ।।59।।
śrāddhaṃ tatrārcanaṃ tadvat kariṣyanti ca tarpaṇam ।
tenā'kṣayyā punastṛptirbhavitaiva sukhaṃ sukham' ।।1.159.60 ।।
śrutvaitattau tadā''yātau kailāse śivasannidhau ।
tatra sa pārvatīśaṃbhugaṇaiḥ saṃpūjitau ca tau ।।61 ।।
sthāpitāvāsane śreṣṭhe śrutavantau ca tatkathām ।
nārāyaṇahrade divye bhaveśvarasusannidhau ।।62।।
svarṇarekhājale pūrve yuge satye tu bhūsuraiḥ ।
tarpitāstu vayaṃ tṛptā idānīṃ yāvadatra vai।।63 ।।
athemau brāhmaṇau gatvā tarpaṇaṃ prakariṣyataḥ ।
tadā punarmahātṛptiṃ gamiṣyāma iti dhruvam ।।64।।
atha dhruvopari viṣṇuloke ca sauryamaṇḍale ।
vāhneyamaṇḍale maharjanayostapasi stare ।।65।।
svarge ca dikprapālānāṃ lokeṣu ca gatāvubhau ।
bhuvarloke gatau tatra śuśravatuḥ sutarpaṇam ।।66 ।।
nārāyaṇahrade pūrve tarpaṇena kṛtena vai ।
idānīṃ yāvat। tṛptāḥ sma punaścemau kariṣyataḥ ।।67।।
tarpaṇaṃ tena tṛptiṃ vai prāpsyāmaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।
śrutvaitaddakṣiṇaṃ mārgaṃ jagmatustau dayālayau ।।68।।
śrāvaṇāḥ pitaro dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭāśca pretapitṛkāḥ ।
yāmyāśca pitaro dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭāśca yamabhūmayaḥ ।।69।।
tatra tatra ca te jīvā nārāyaṇāṃgasaṃgamāt ।
vāyoḥ saṃsparśanenātra sukhino hyabhavan kṣaṇāt ।।1.159.70 ।।
atyārtāścā'bruvaँstau te hyuddhāraṃ kurutaṃ prabhū ।
bhavantau dvau dvijau puṇyau puṇyadau dṛṣṭigocarau ।।71 ।।
nārāyaṇahrade'smākaṃ tṛptyarthaṃ kurutaṃ śubhau ।
śrāddhaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ snānaṃ tṛptiṃ yāsyāma aiśvarīm ।।72।।
tatastau cāgatau bhūmau tatra catuḥkhaniṣvapi ।
sthitairjīvaiḥ prārthitau tau tarpaṇārthaṃ dayālayau ।।।73 ।।
evaṃ pātālaparyantaṃ nārāyaṇena sarvathā ।
patnīvratāya sarvaṃ tat darśitaṃ susamādhinā ।।74।।
tatratyavāsibhistatra prārthitaṃ duḥkhanāśanam ।
nārāyaṇahrade divye svarṇarekhājale tu yau ।।75।।
asmākaṃ ca kṛte devau tarpaṇaṃ saṃkariṣyathaḥ ।
tenā'smākaṃ śāśvatī vai tṛptirbhāvyā'tha mokṣaṇam' ।।76।।
ityarthanāṃ ca tau śrutvā hyāgatā tu kṣaṇāntare ।
nārāyaṇahrado yatra tatra patnīvrato dvijaḥ ।।77।।
samādherbahirāgacchat tāvadāścaryamāptavān ।
aho kiṃkiṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kvā'haṃ kva ca gatā nu te ।।78।।
ko'yaṃ ca yātriko vipraḥ kimetat svapnamāgatam ।
tāvannārāyaṇastatra jātaścaturbhujo hariḥ ।।79।।
garuḍāṃ'saṃsthito devo lakṣmīkṛtāṃ'kasaṃsthitiḥ ।
pārṣadairvardhito jayaprabhatimāṃgalaiḥ padaiḥ ।।1.159.80।।
dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tadā lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tutoṣa saḥ ।
namaskṛtyā'rhaṇaṃ kṛtvā pādayorapatat suraḥ ।।8 1।।
prahvībhūtahṛdā vipraḥ prāha gadgadayā girā ।
kimetaddarśitaṃ deva! kathaṃ viprastu tairthikaḥ ।।।82।।
kimatra kāraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa! tārito'haṃ kṛpālunā ।
aho me bhāgyasaubhāgyaṃ yaddharerdarśanaṃ gataḥ ।।83।।
kimasmādadhikaṃ manye tīrthayātrāphalaṃ mama ।
svayaṃ nārāyaṇo dāmodaro'sti bhagavān bhavān ।।84।।
maduddhārāya jagrāha bhavāँstairthikarūpaṇām ।
nato'smyanugṛhīto'smyarthito'smyabhimato'smi ca ।।85।।।
nāsti me mokṣaṇe nyūnaṃ yatra sārtho bhavānmataḥ ।
sākṣānnārāyaṇo mahyaṃ milito raivate sthale ।।86।।
darśitā ca samādhau vai brahmasṛṣṭistathā'parā ।
īśasṛṣṭiśca dhāmāni lokasṛṣṭistathetarā ।।87।।
yamasṛṣṭirnāgasṛṣṭirdraṣṭuṃ yannāvaśiṣyate ।
sarvaṃ vai darśitaṃ mahyaṃ śādhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ।।88।।
nārāyaṇastadā prāha dvijaṃ patnīvrataṃ tadā ।
śṛṇu brāhmaṇa te gāthāṃ ko bhavāniti varṇaye ।।89।।
goloke yaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo rukmiṇī cāpi tatpriyā ।
kuṃkumavāpyāṃ tau devau janakalyāṇahetave ।।1.159.90।।
prakaṭitau mānasau kambharāgopālasaṃjñakau ।
rukmiṇī kambharā jātā kṛṣṇo gopālasaṃjñakaḥ ।।91।।
aśvapaṭṭamahattīrthe tatroṣitau kṛte yuge ।
tvaṃ vai nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvaikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ ।।।92।।
pativratākhyāṃ patnīṃ tāṃ lakṣmīṃ nītvā ca tatsthale ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇastvaṃ vai prādurbhūto'tra bhūtale ।।।93।।
mayā pūrvamubhau tau vai bhavantau brāhmaṇau kṛtau ।
yadā bhūmau sṛṣṭimūlaṃ bhavānekastu mānasaḥ ।।94।।
prakaṭī'bhūttataste vai vaṃśapravaṃśavistaraḥ ।
akṣare ca gavāṃ loke vaikuṇṭhe'vyākṛte tathā ।।95।।
amṛte śvetavibhave kṣīre cā'bdhau virājake ।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu tava vaṃśyā bhavanti vai ।।96।।
te mayā darśitā tubhyaṃ tvaṃ tu nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
śāśvataḥ sṛṣṭijīvānāṃ tarpaṇāt tṛptido vibhuḥ ।।97।।
iti te darśitaṃ mukhyaṃ yadbhavān pitarau ca yau ।
athā''gatya ca me pūjā tarpaṇādikamatra vai ।।98।।
dāmodare kṛtaṃ tena prasanno'haṃ hariḥ svayam ।
iyeṣa darśanaṃ dātuṃ tato'haṃ nītavānitaḥ ।।99।।
ramye nārāyaṇahṛde mama tīrthe suśobhane ।
nirjane'haṃ tvayā dṛṣṭo hyeṣo'nugrahasāgaraḥ ।। 1.159.10 0।।
mama bodhyastvayā vipranānyastvaṃ tvahameva hi ।
ahaṃ kṛṣṇo bhavān viṣṇurdvāvapi lokapoṣakau ।। 101 ।।
jagatāṃ tṛptidau tasmādatra nārāyaṇe hrade ।
sarveṣāṃ tṛptaye śrāddhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kāryamityapi ।। 102।।
bhavān gururahaṃ cātra yajamāno bhavāmi vai ।
gāvaḥ santi ca me pārśve goloke dugdhadāstathā ।। 103।।
vṛkṣā vallyaśca phaladā dhānyadā pṛthivī matā ।
sarvaṃ dākṣiṇakaṃ dravyaṃ madagre bahu vartate ।। 104।।
kārayā'tra mahacchrāddhaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sārvabhaumikam ।
ityājñapya ca tau devau snātau tatra hrade śubhe ।। 1 05।।
tāvattatra tadā devā devyaścāpi samāgatāḥ ।
lokapālā diśāṃpālā nadyaśca parvatāstathā ।। 106।।
kāmadhenavo'saṃkhyātā golokātsamupāgatāḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhācca ramāḥ sarvāstathā'nye sādhavo'khilāḥ ।। 1 07।।
maharṣayaśca munayo vṛkṣā vallyaśca vārdhayaḥ ।
śrāddhopakaraṇānyādāyātra sarve hyupasthitāḥ ।। 1 08।।
śrīkṛṣṇastu svayaṃ dāmodaro vai yajamānakaḥ ।
patnīvrataḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śrāddhakaro'bhavat ।। 1 09।।
śraddhayā dīyate yattacchrāddhaṃ vai pūjanaṃ matam ।
nārāyaṇātsamārabhya sarveṣāṃ tadbhavetkhalu ।। 1.159.11 0।।
sarvasamarpaṇā bhaktiḥ śrāddhaṃ nārāyaṇādike ।
tṛptyarpaṇātmikā bhaktiḥ śrāddhaṃ pretādike matam ।। 11 1।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne patnīvratākhyaviprasya raivatācale tīrthayātrāyāṃ dāmodarapūjanādinā sākṣāddarśanaṃ samādhau sarvadhāmasarvalokadarśanaṃ svasya nārāyaṇāvatārapradarśanaṃ nārāyaṇahrade śrāddhārthamāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaṣaṣṭhyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 15 9।।


← adhyāyaḥ 159 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 160
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 161 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato nārāyaṇo dvāvapi bhūsurau ।
tulasīkānane nārāyaṇaghaṭṭe niṣedatuḥ ।। 1 ।।
śrāddhārthaṃ kṛtasaṃkalpau sarvopaskarasaṃyutau ।
darbhapiṇḍaphalapuṣpapāyasānnādisaṃyutau ।। 2 ।।
nārāyaṇadvayahastācchrāddhaṃ yatra vitīryate ।
uddharet saptagotrāṇāṃ kulānyekottaraṃ śatam ।। 3 ।।
pitā mātā ca bhāryā ca bhaginī duhitā tathā ।
pitṛmātṛsvasā caiva sapta gotrāṇi tāni vai ।। 4 ।।
caturviṃśatirvai pituḥ viṃśatirmāturityapi ।
bhāryāyāḥ ṣoḍaśa bodhyā bhaginyā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। 5 ।।
ekādaśa duhitṛśca daśa pitṛsvasustathā ।
aṣṭau mātṛsvasurbodhyā kulānyekottaraṃ śatam ।। 6 ।।
nārāyaṇe hrade snātvā tāvubhau dvijasattamau ।
tarpaṇaṃ cakratustatra sṛṣṭitrayasukhāptaye । ।। 7 ।।
brahmasṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭau ca cetanāḥ ।
tṛpyantāṃ bhagavadbrahmeśvarajīvādijātayaḥ ।। 8 ।।
parabrahmā'kṣaradhāmasthitaṃ sarveśvaraṃ harim ।
prīṇayāmi jalenaiṣastṛpyatāṃ śāśvatī samāḥ ।। 9 ।।
paramātmā'kṣarātītaḥ puruṣottama ātmagaḥ ।
yena sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ tasmai piṇḍaṃ dadāmyaham ।। 1.160.10 ।।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacoṣye hyannaṃ caturvidhaṃ tu yat ।
tasmai śrīharaye dattaṃ tṛptimāyātu vai hariḥ ।। 11 ।।
akṣaraṃ yaddhāma coktaṃ vyāpakaṃ sevakaṃ ca yat ।
tasmai dhāmne jalaṃ dattaṃ tṛptimāyātu śāśvatīm ।। 12।।
dattaṃ caturvidhaṃ cānnaṃ pāyasaṃ kadalādikam ।
etatpiṇḍātmakaṃ dattaṃ brahmaṇe hyupatiṣṭhatāt ।। 1 re।।
muktā hyanādino ye syuścādino ye ca tadgatāḥ ।
bhāvino ye ca yāsyanti mūrtau bāhye ca ye sthitāḥ ।। 14।।
muktā yathā tathā devyo muktānyo yāśca tatsthitāḥ ।
te ca tāstṛptimāyāntu jalenānena śāśvatīm ।। 15।।
teṣāṃ pāyasamukhyānnaiḥ kadalyādiphalai saha ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacoṣye hyannaṃ caturvidhaṃ tu yat ।। 16।।
eṣaḥ piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste'kṣarottama! ।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।।17।।
aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi guṇāścaiva vibhūtayaḥ ।
divyacihnāni mūrteśca bhūṣaṇāni tu yāni ca ।। 18।।
hetayaśca samagrā vai tejāṃsi vividhāni ca ।
śaktyo'nekarūpāśca mūrtau harestu yāḥ sthitāḥ ।। 19।।
mūrtā'mūrtasvarūpābhyo jalaṃ yacchāmi śraddhayā ।
prīṇayāmi jalenaitāstṛpyantāṃ śāśvatīsamāḥ ।।1.160.20 ।।
tāsāṃ pāyasamukhyānnaiḥ kadalyādiphalaiḥ saha ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacoṣye hyannaṃ caturvidhaṃ tu yat ।।21।।
hyeṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana! ।
dehi tābhyaśca sarvābhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।।22।।
tāśca te tṛptimāyāntu śrāddhenā'nena śāśvatīm ।
harestṛptyā haristhānāṃ tṛptirbhavatu śāśvatī ।।।23।।।
dhāmnyakṣareca ca mukteṣu yāścaiśvaryavibhūtayaḥ ।
sāmarthyaśaktayaścānye guṇāśca smṛddhayaśca yāḥ ।।24।।
bhogyaṃ bhogopakaraṇaṃ bhogasādhanameva ca ।
saudhaprākāragoprāṇyudyānakṣetrasukhasthalam ।।25।।
yadyat sarvaṃ brahmadhāmātmakaṃ muktātmakaṃ ca yat। ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacośye hyannaṃ caturvidhaṃ tu yat ।।26।।
divyaṃ ca cetanaṃ yadyat tatratyaṃ vartate sadā ।
tatsarvaṃ tṛptimāyātu jalenānena śāśvatīm ।।27।।
tasmai pāyasamukhyānnaiḥ kadalyādiphalaiḥ saha ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacośyaṃ hyannaṃ caturvidhaṃ śubham ।।28।।।
hyeṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana ।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।।।29।।
nārāyaṇo'kṣaraṃ dhāma tanmuktāstadvibhūtayaḥ ।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu śrāddhenānena śāśvatīm ।। 1.160.30।।
tatra yāḥ sāṃkhyayoginyo bhaktiścopāstirityapi ।
muktirājñā mumukṣā ca kathā vārtā ca dīkṣaṇā ।।3 1 ।।
parā vidyā ramā sevā jayādyā yāśca sevikāḥ ।
tatrāraṇyāni nadyaśca parvatā muktakoṭayaḥ ।।।32।।
udyānāni vihārāśca bhūmayo'kṣarasaṃjñikāḥ ।
dhātavaḥ khanayaḥ khātā ucchrayāḥ śikharāṇi ca ।।33।।।
vimānānyapi sarvāṇi tattatsevakajātayaḥ ।
gāndharvā nartakāstatrā''khyānakā vaṃśabodhakāḥ ।।34।।
sevakā yājñikāḥ sāmnāṃ stāvakā vyavasāyakāḥ ।
śrāṃgārikāḥ kalākārā muktānīmuktamaṇḍalāḥ ।।35।।
evaṃ divye'kṣare dhāmni yāni ye yāśca santi tān ।
prīṇayāmi jalenaite tṛpyantāṃ śāśvatīsamāḥ ।। 36।।
teṣāṃ pāyasamukhyānnaiḥ kadalyādiphalaiḥ saha ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacośyaṃ hyannaṃ caturvidhaṃ ca yat ।। 27।।
hyeṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana ।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।।।28।।
atha śrīkṛṣṇadevāya rādhayā virajādibhiḥ ।
rukmiṇyā cābhiyuktāya golokā''vāsakāriṇe ।।39।।
idaṃ jalaṃ mayā dattaṃ tṛptyarthamupatiṣṭhatām ।
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ pāyasānnaṃ cāpi phalādikam ।।1.160.40।।
hyeṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana ।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu śrāddhenānena śāśvatīm ।।41 ।।
vasudevo devakī ca nando yaśovatī tathā ।

vānaprāsthyaśca sānyasyo bhauma udarya ityapi ।। 155।।
divya ākarajaścaiva śāvaḥ śmāśānikastathā ।
dāvo davaśca makhajo jvālāsyo vāḍavastathā ।। 156 ।।
hyete ye pitaraḥ proktāstathā vaiśravaṇādayaḥ ।
pretāśca pitaro yāmyā nārakāḥ śrāvaṇāstathā ।। 157।।
dūtāśca pitarastvanye yātanāḥ pitarastathā ।
vaṃśajāścā'nyavaṃśādijanmānaḥ sthāvareṣu ye ।। 158 ।।
jaṃgameṣu tathodbhūtā vāyujāḥ pitaraśca ye ।
prabhinnāḥ pratikalpaṃ munyṛṣyaryamādikāśca ye ।। 1 59।।
pitaraste jalairetaistṛpyantāṃ śāśvatīsamāḥ ।
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ pāyasānnaṃ phalādikaṃ tathā ।। 1.160.160 ।।
munyannaṃ caiva yogyānnaṃ cārpayāmi kare hareḥ ।
ete piṇḍā mayā dattāstava haste janārdana ।। 161 ।।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।
diśāṃpālā lokapālāḥ svargapālāstathā ca ye ।। 162 ।।
indrādyaṣṭāvaṇimādyāścāṣṭau vai siddhayastathā ।
āyādyā vasavaścāṣṭau diśaścāṣṭau navagrahāḥ ।। 163 ।।
nidhayaśca nava ye vidyādhrāḥ ṣaṇmātaraḥ khalu ।
tārāśca ketavaḥ kṣudratārakā dhūmraketavaḥ ।। 1 64।।
sūryāśca dvādaśādityāścandratrayaṃ ca tatkalāḥ ।
saptaviṃśatibhānyeva trayastriṃśacca devatāḥ ।। 165 ।।
maruto vidyutaścaiva sādhye viśve ca devatāḥ ।
siddhacāraṇagandharvāḥ sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ।। 166 ।।
kiṃpuṃsaḥ kinnarāstṛptiṃ yāntu pradattavāribhiḥ ।
annaṃ cāmṛtadugdhānnaṃ pakvaṃ pakvaphalādikam ।। 1 67।।
sarvaṃ caturvidhaṃ bhojyaṃ peyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā ।
ete piṇḍā mayā dattāstava haste janārdana ।। 16 8।।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu śrāddhenānena śāśvatīm ।। 169 ।।
bhuvarlokagatā ye ca ye'ntarīkṣagatāstathā ।
vāyvādhārā vāyudehā yakṣāstathā ca rākṣasāḥ ।। 1.160.170 ।।
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍāśca vināyakāḥ ।
vetālā bhairavāścānye mārakā janakāstathā ।। 171 ।।
mātulā rāhavaścānye kālavarṇāśca kālikāḥ ।
ḍākinī śākinī caiva yoginī bhakṣiṇī tathā ।। 172 ।।
vetālinī khañjinī ca śītalā mātṛkā tathā ।
mārikā bālikī kṛtyā hikkā tathā ca tānikā ।। 173 । ।
ākarṣiṇī mahāmārī jvarāḥ śītāstathoṣṇakāḥ ।
rogāśca rājarogāśca prottāpāśca jarādayaḥ ।। 1 74।।
avasthāḥ śaktayo'śaktiviśeṣā rogiṇī tathā ।
mantrāstantrāśca yantrāśca śapathā bandhanāni ca ।। 175।।
pāśā astrāṇi śastrāṇi vidyuto durdinaṃ tathā ।
diṅbhramo'lātacakrāṇi meghāścābhrāṇi cāndhayaḥ ।। 176।।
tṛṇāvartāstathotpātā bhūkampā vātavṛṣṭayaḥ ।
ītayaścātatāyinyo rajovarṣādayaśca ye ।। 177।।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu tairthikairvāribhiḥ sadā ।
prīṇayāmi jalairarthaistṛpyantā śāśvatīsamāḥ ।। 178।।
māṣānnaṃ kṛśarānnaṃ ca khecarānnaṃ ca tāmasam ।
vividhānnaṃ rājasaṃ ca pāyasānnaṃ caturvidham ।। 179।।
annaṃ tathā phalaṃ peyaṃ yogyaṃ yogyaṃ dadāmyaham ।
tattadannairmayā dattāḥ piṇḍāśca karayorhareḥ ।। 1.160.180 ।।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।
sarve bhavantu tṛptāste śrāddhenānena sarvadā ।। 18 1।।
bhūlokasthā jarāyūjā aṇḍajāḥ svedajāstathā ।
udbhijāścetanāḥ sarve brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāstathā ।। 182।।
vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ saṃkarāśca cāṇḍālāḥ patitāstathā ।
anulomā pratilomā alomā ardhamānavāḥ ।। 183 ।।
naiṣṭhikāḥ sagṛhā vānaprasthāḥ sannyāsinastathā ।
śaivāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ śāktā vaidikāśca tadanyakāḥ ।। 184।।
goromajāśca jalajāḥ sthalajā vyomajāstathā ।
kṣudrā jīvā mahāntaśca kīṭāḥ pataṃgapakṣiṇaḥ ।। 185 ।।
ātṛṇastambaparyantāstathā gṛhapradevatāḥ ।
grāmadevā vanadevāḥ kṣetrapālāstathaiva ca ।। 186 ।।
dehe ṣaṭcakradevāśca kapāle gurudevatāḥ ।
vanāni parvatāścaivā'raṇyāni saritastathā ।। 187।।
nadyaścāpi taḍāgāścā''rāmāścaiva sarāṃsi ca ।
khātāścaiva tathā'khātānyabdhayo hyucchrayāstathā ।। 188।।
raṇāśca marudeśāśca devasthānāni sarvaśaḥ ।
caityavṛkṣāścaityakoṣṭhāścaityāni pulināni ca ।। 189 ।।
devyālayāśca jīrṇā bhūrgrāmāḥ kheṭāśca kharvaṭāḥ ।
nagarāṇi rājadhānī purāṇi ca purī tathā ।। 1.160.190 ।।
ye tatra cetanāḥ santi tadadhiṣṭhātṛcetanāḥ ।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu dattairebhirjalaiḥ sadā ।। 191 ।।
teṣāṃ ca vividhairannairāgneyairvāyavīyakaiḥ ।
jalīyaiḥ pārthivaiścaiva vṛṣṭijairvikṛtaistathā ।। 19 2।।
caturannairbhakṣyayogyaiḥ pāyasādibhirityapi ।
bāṣpaiśca meghakaṇakairvārkṣarasaiśca kardamaiḥ ।। 193।।
śaityaiścandrakaraiḥ sauryairviṣairanyaiḥ phalādibhiḥ ।
phenaiścāpi karomyatra śrāddhaṃ tṛptā bhavantu te ।। 194।।
prīyaṇāmi jalairete tṛpyantāṃ śāśvatīsamāḥ ।
teṣāṃ tṛptipradāḥ piṇḍā dattā harikare mayā ।। 195।।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।
mātṝrmātāmahīścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahīḥ ।। 1 96।।
pitṝn pitāmahāँścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahān ।
bhrātṝn svasṝrbhrātṛjāyārjāmātṝn mātulādikān ।। 1 97।।
bhātṛputrādikān patnīḥ śvaśurasya kuṭumbinaḥ ।
pitṛsvasṝrmātṛsvasṝrduhitṛśca suyoginīḥ ।। 198।।
tatputraputrīpautryādīḥ prīṇayāmi jalādibhiḥ ।
tathā pāyasamukhyānnaiścaturannaistathā phalaiḥ ।। 199।।
teṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ karomyete tṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।
ete piṇḍā mayā dattāstava haste janārdana ।।।1.160.20 0 ।।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।
prīṇayāmi jalānnaiste tṛpyantāṃ śāśvatīsamāḥ ।। 20 1।।
prācetasānnāciketānmārutānkālakeyakān ।
yāmyān saṃśaptakānvārkṣān bhūjātān śalabhādikān ।।।202।।
tathā'talādilokasthān daityadānavarākṣasān ।
sarpānsarīsṛpānnāgān ye'nye vasanti tānapi ।।20 3 ।।
prīṇayāmi śītamiṣṭajalānnaphalapāyasaiḥ ।
piṇḍāँstebhyaścārpayāmi tṛpyantāṃ śāśvatīsamāḥ ।।204।।
iṣṭadevaṃ tathābrahma praguruṃ ca guruṃ tathā ।
prīṇayāmi tīrthajalaiḥ pāyasānnaiḥ phalaistathā ।।205 ।।
te sarve tṛptimāyāntu śrāddhenānena śāśvatīm ।
eṣa piṇḍo mayā dattastava haste janārdana ।। 206 ।।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastaptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।
īśāvāsyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tṛpyatāṃ parameśvara! ।।207।।
bhūtabhāvivartamānā gatyagatigatāśca ye ।
prīṇayāmyannasalilaistṛpyantāṃ śāśvatīsamāḥ ।।208।।
merugatāstathā lokālokācalasamāśritāḥ ।
tṛptimāyāntu te dugdhapākaiḥ phalajalādibhiḥ ।।209।।
asmṛtāścā'navadhānā anāgatāśca ye'savaḥ ।
prīṇayāmi ca tānsarvān phalānnasalilaistathā ।।1.160.2 10 ।।
ete piṇḍā mayā dattāstava haste janārdana ।
dehi tebhyaśca sarvebhyastṛptimāyāntu śāśvatīm ।। 2 11 ।।
nārāyaṇakṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ nārāyaṇena kāritam ।
sṛṣṭitrayaṃ sutṛptaṃ vai śāśvataṃ sukhamāpa tat ।।212।।
ye ca tatrā''gatāḥ sarve tṛptimādāya śāśvatīm ।
lokaṃ svaṃ svaṃ gatāḥ sarve śrāddhaṃ pūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ ca tat ।। 212 । ।
tarpaṇāt satataṃ teṣāṃ tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ।
puṣṭyaiśvaryaṃ śrāddhakarturāyuḥ santatirityapi ।। 214 । ।
vicitrā bhajate lakṣmīrmokṣastaṃ bhajate kramāt ।
devatābhyaśca pitṛbhyo mahāyogibhya ityapi ।। 215 ।।
svāhāyai ca svadhāyai ca namo nityaṃ bhavatyuta ।
śrāddhe jāpyo bhavenmantraḥ śrīrāyurbalavardhanaḥ ।। 216 ।।
prīyante pitaro yena japyena niyamena ca ।
saptārciṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham ।। 2 17। ।
amūrtānāṃ samūrtānāṃ pitṛṇāṃ dīptatejasām ।
namasyāmi sadā tebhyo dhyānibhyo yogicakṣuṣām ।। 218 ।।
indrādīnāṃ janetāro bhagumārīcayostathā ।
saptarṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tānnamasyāmi kāmadān । । 219 ।।
manvādīnāṃ sureśānāṃ sūryācandramasostathā!
tānnamaskṛtya sarvān vai pitṝn kuśaladāyakān ।। 1.160.220 ।।
nakṣatrāṇāṃ carādīnāṃ pitṝnatha pitāmahān ।
dyāvāpṛthivyośca tathā namasyāmi kṛtāṃjaliḥ ।। 221 । ।
devarṣīṇāṃ janayitṛnsarvalokanamaskṛtān ।
abhayasya sadā dātṝnnamasye'haṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 222 ।।
prajāpateḥ kaśyapāya somāya varuṇāya ca ।
yogayogeśvarebhyaśca namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 223 ।।
pitṛgaṇebhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu ।
svayaṃbhuve namaścaiva brahmaṇe yogacakṣuṣe' ।। 224।।
anena vidhinā yuktastrīnvarāँllabhate janaḥ ।
annamāyuḥ sutāँścaiva dadate pitaro bhuvi ।। 225 ।।
bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ ।
saptārṣicaṃ japed yaḥ sa pṛthivyāmekarāḍ bhavet ।। 226 ।।
kinnvadhikaṃ pravaktavyaṃ sarveṣāṃ muktidaṃ sthalam ।
śṛṃgibhirdaṃṣṭibhirvyālairviṣavahnistriyā jalaiḥ ।। 227।।
krīḍāṃ kurvanmṛto yaścā'gatikaḥ pretayonijaḥ ।
nāgānāṃ vipriyaṃ kurvan hataścāpyatha vidyutā ।। 228 ।।
nigṛhītaḥ svayaṃrājñā cauryadoṣeṇa vai mṛtaḥ ।
paradārān ramantaśca dveṣāt tatpatibhirhatāḥ ।। 22 9।।
asamānaiśca saṃkīrṇaiścāṇḍālādyaiśca vigraham ।
kṛtvā tairnihatāstāँśca cāṇḍālādīn samāśritāḥ ।। 1.160.230 ।।
gavā'gniviṣadāścaiva pāṣaṃḍāḥ krūrabuddhayaḥ ।
krodhātprāyo viṣaṃ vahniṃ śastramudbandhanaṃ jalam ।। 231 ।।
girervṛkṣātpapātaṃ ca ya kurvanti suduḥkhitāḥ ।
kuśilpajīvino ye ca pañcasūnādhikāriṇaḥ ।।।232।।
makhe sarpāsu ye kecid dīnaprāyā napuṃsakāḥ ।
sādhudaṇḍahatā ye ca ye cāpi brāhmaṇairhatāḥ ।।।233।।
mahāpātakino ye ca patitā ye ca saṃkarāḥ ।
mṛtā vā jīvino vāpi svayaṃ vā'nyakṛtena ca ।।।234।।।
snānena śuddhimāyānti nārāyaṇahradā'psu vai ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi hradamāhātmyamuttamam ।।।235।।।
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ pitṝṇāṃ bhuktimuktidam ।
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā śrāddhe parvaṇi vā'nvaham ।।236 ।।
śrāvayedvā varārohe । so'pi syād brahmalokabhāg ।
idaṃ svastyayanaṃ puṇyaṃ dhanyaṃ svargatidaṃ nṛṇām ।।।237।।
yaśasyamapi cā''yuṣyaṃ putrapautravivardhanam ।
pūjāśrāddhātmakaṃ divya karma haridvayā'rpitam ।।238।।
snātvā dāmodare kuṇḍe mṛgīkuṇḍe tathā punaḥ ।
nārāyaṇahṛde snātvā śrāddhaṃ kuryāditisthitiḥ ।।239।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvayornārāyaṇayornārāyaṇahradajale brahmadhāmagolokavaikuṇṭhaśvetabadrikāśramā'mṛtā'vyākṛtakṣīrasāgarādigolakhagolabhūgolasthānāṃ sārvabhaumaśrāddhatarpaṇakaraṇam saptārcistavanaṃ phalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭhyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 160 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 160 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 161
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 162 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato devau dāmodaranarāyaṇau ।
samāgatān bhojayitvā sarvān brahmasurāँstataḥ ।। 1 ।।
jagṛhatuḥ prasādaṃ taṃ haryarpitaṃ ca pāyasam ।
dāmodarastataḥ prāha mahimānaṃ narāyaṇam ।। 2 ।।
idaṃ guptatamaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvaprāṇisukhāvaham ।
mokṣadaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śaivameva vā ।। 3 ।।
vrahmaghno goghnamātṛghnagurughnā'rbhakaghātakāḥ ।
strīghnaścātra hrade snātvā mucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
snātvā'tra sukṛtī bhūtvā mṛto yāyātparaṃ padam ।
kṣetre'tra nivasanto ye bhaktāḥ sukṛtino hareḥ ।। 5 ।।
anyoddhārasamarthā vai nārāyaṇasamā matāḥ ।
bhittvājanmabandhajālaṃ prāpayanti hareḥ padam ।। 6 ।।
iḍā ojasvatī bodhyā bhadrā tu piṃgalā matā ।
svarṇarekhā suṣumṇā'sti tayā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।। 7 ।।
anāyāsena vai yatra mokṣaprāptiḥ prajāyate ।
nānāvarṇā vikarmāṇaścāṇḍālā ye jugupsitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
kilbiṣaiḥ pūrṇadehāśca prakṛṣṭaiḥ pātakaistathā ।
bheṣajaṃ paramaṃ teṣāṃ kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ matam ।। 9 ।।
duṣṭāndhādīnakṛpaṇānpāpānduṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ ।
ahantu dayayā sarvānnayāmi paramāṃ gatim ।। 1.161.10 ।।
vastrāpathaṃ gatā ye vai mahāpuṇyakṛto narāḥ ।
akṣayyā hyajarāścaiva videhāśca bhavanti te ।। 11 ।।
ajñānājjñānato vāpi nāryā vā puruṣeṇa vā ।
yatkiṃcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ cāpi kubuddhinā ।। 12।।
vastrāpathe praviṣṭasya tatsarvaṃ bhasmasādbhavet ।
sadā yajati yajñena sadā dānaṃ prayacchati ।। 13।।
sadā tapasvī bhavati raivatādrau sthito naraḥ ।
sarvātmanā tapaḥ satyaṃ prāṇināṃ raivatācale ।। 14।।
na sā gatiḥ kurukṣetre gaṃgādvāre na puṣkare ।
yā gatirvihitā puṃsāṃ raivatādrinivāsinām ।। 15।।
raivatādrau sthitā nityaṃ pāṃśubhirvāyuneritaiḥ ।
spṛṣṭā duṣkṛtakarmāṇo yānti vai paramāṃ gatim ।। 16।।
revatādrau vased yaśca saṃyatātmā samāhitaḥ ।
trailokyamapi bhuṃjāno vāyubhakṣasamaḥ smṛtaḥ ।।17।।
raivatādrau vasenmāṃsaṃ laghvāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।
cāturmāsyavṛtānyeva kṛtāni syuśca tena vai ।। 18।।
janmamṛtyubhayaṃ jītvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।
niḥśreyasagatiṃ puṇyāṃ tathā yogagatiṃ vrajet ।। 19।।
nahi brahmagatirlabhyā janmāntaraśatairapi ।
prāpyate raivatabalāt prabhāvācchrīharestathā ।। 1.161.20 ।।
ekāhārastu yastiṣṭhenmāsaṃ tu raivatācale ।
yāvajjīvakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ māsenaikena naśyati ।।।2 1।।
vighnairāhanyamāno'pi raivataṃ yastu na tyajet ।
sa muṃcati jarāmṛtyū janma caitaddhi naśvaram ।।22।।
ādehapatanād ye tu sevante raivatācalam ।
te mṛtā haṃsayānena divyān lokān prayānti hi ।।23।।
saṃsāravyāptacitto'pi tyaktamokṣakriyo janaḥ ।
raivatādrau mṛtaḥ so'pi saṃsāraṃ na punarviśet ।।24।।
svargā'pavargayorheturetattīrthavaraṃ bhuvi ।
yastatra paṃcatāṃ yāti tasya muktirna saṃśayaḥ ।।25।।।
janmāntarasahasreṇa yogī yatpadamāpnuyāt ।
raivatādrau paraṃ mokṣaṃ maraṇādadhigacchati ।।26।।
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca varṇasaṃkarāḥ ।
kṛmayaścaiva ye mlecchāḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ।।।27।।
kīṭāḥ pipīlikāścāpi ye tvanye mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ।
kālena maraṇaṃ prāptāste'pi deveśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ ।।28।।
akāmo vā sakāmo vā tiryagyonigato'pi vā ।
raivatādrau tyajanprāṇān muktibhāṅ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।29।।
raivatādrau kṛtavāsāḥ svarṇarekhājalā'plavāḥ ।
dāmodaraprāṇacittā jīvanmuktā na saṃśayaḥ ।।1.161.30।।
raivatādrau mṛtyukāle harirdāmodaraḥ svayam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamantraṃ karṇajāpyaṃ prayacchati ।।।3 1।।
atiprasannacittena raivatādrinivāsine ।
mumūrṣordakṣiṇe karṇe yasya kasyāpi vā svayam ।।32।।
upadekṣyāmi manmantraṃ sa mukto bhavitā dhruvam ।
dāmodare mṛtaḥ ko'pi na yāti narakaṃ kvacit ।।33।।
vāmanānugṛhītāste sarve yānti parāṃ gatim ।
prāṇāniha janāstyaktvā joṣante na punaḥ kvacit ।।34।।
prathamo revatīkuṇḍastato dāmodarāhvayaḥ ।
nārāyaṇākhyastṛtīyo mṛgīkuṇḍaścaturthakaḥ ।।35।।
pañcamo bhavakuṇḍaśca ṣaṣṭho gaṃgā tu gomukhī ।
kamaṇḍaluḥ saptamaścā'ṣṭamo bhairavanāmakaḥ ।।36।।
mārkaṇḍeyaśca daśamo hyekādaśastu dattakṛt ।
ete snātāśca pītāśca dṛṣṭāścā''cāmitā api ।।37।।
spṛṣṭā api janān śuddhān kṛtvā mokṣaṃ nayanti hi ।
anantā sā gatisteṣāṃ yā gatiryogināṃ matā ।।38।।
teṣu muktiḥ samuddiṣṭā patitānāṃ tu pāvanī ।
tatrāpi sarvakuṇḍānāṃ śreṣṭho nārāyaṇo hradaḥ ।।39।।
yathā nārāyaṇahradastathā dāmodaro hradaḥ ।
yatra nītyaṃ śrīhareśca sānnidhyaṃ vāmanasya ca ।।1.161.40।।
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ yajñānāṃ yatphalaṃ smṛtam ।
tadavāpnoti dharmātmā tatra snātvā na saṃśayaḥ ।।41 ।।
upavāsaṃ tu yaḥ kṛtvā viprān sādhūँśca tarpayet ।
sa sautrāmaṇiyajñasya phalamāpnoti niścitam ।।42।।
tatra dīpapradānena jñānavatsphuratīndriyam ।
ārārtrikapradānena nairogyaṃ jāyate sadā ।।।43।।
kimatra bahunoktena dharmādīṃstu prakurvataḥ ।
śrīhariṃ vai samuddiśya tadanantaphalaṃ bhavet ।।44।।
daśāśvamedhikaṃ puṇyaṃ puṣpadāne prakīrtitam ।
agnihotraphalaṃ dhūpe gandhe bhūdānajaṃ phalam ।।45।।
mārjane gopradānasya phalamatra prakīrtitam ।
anulepe daśaguṇaṃ mālye daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam ।।46।।
gīte sahasraguṇitaṃ vādye lakṣaguṇaṃ matam ।
dāmodaraṃ raivatādrāvarcayanti stuvanti ye ।।47।।
sarvapāpavimuktāste vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti śāśvatam ।
kalpakoṭiśataiścāpi teṣāṃ nāsti punarbhavaḥ ।।48।।
ye tu dhyānaṃ samāsādya muktātmānaḥ samāhitāḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ jāpaṃ kurvanti niyatendriyāḥ ।।49।।
raivatādrau sthitā nityaṃ kṛtārthāste janottamāḥ ।
tārayitvā'nantajīvān viṣṇulokaṃ prayānti te ।।1.161.50।।
māghyāṃ tathā ca kārtikyāṃ sādhvyaśca sādhavastathā ।
dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭā natāścaivā'rcitāḥ saṃbhojitāstathā ।।51 ।।
śuśrūṣitā marditāśca sevitā vāhitāstathā ।
yena kena prakāreṇa yairjanaiḥ samprasāditāḥ ।।52।।
prasāditā ramā taiśca nārāyaṇaḥ prasāditaḥ ।
tatra lakṣmīstathā nārāyaṇo vai vartate sadā ।।5 2 ।।
sādhvīsādhusvarūpeṇa lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
vastrāpathe vicarati janakalyāṇahetave ।।54।।
tayoranugrahātkāryaṃ sarve siddhyati mānasam ।
aihikaṃ ca pāralaukikaṃ ca siddhyati vai dhruvam ।।55।।
dehena manasā vācā sevayā bhojanena ca ।
arpaṇena ca yairatra vastrāpathe tu raivate ।।56।।
sādhavaḥ sevitāḥ samyak sevitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।
hariḥ svayaṃ prasevito mokṣaṃ dadāti sevine ।।57।।
vastrāpathaṃ mahattīrthaṃ sādhūn sādhvīṃśca devatāḥ ।
nindiṣyanti janā ye te yāsyanti narakaṃ dhruvam ।।58।।
bhagavatā nṛsiṃheṇa cāgatya raivate girau ।
yatra svarṇanadīpārśve guhāyāṃ vāsa ādṛtaḥ ।।59।।
tatsthalaṃ mokṣadaṃ puṇyaṃ rajo'pyaghavināśakam ।
kiṃ bahunā'tra sattīrthe pratyekaṃ raja ityapi ।।1.161.60।।
vastrāpathe raivatādrau patraṃ puṣpaṃ tṛṇādikam ।
sarvaṃ divyaṃ ca pāpaghnaṃ muktidaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।61 ।।
rājñā''nartena golokāt khaṇḍaḥ saurāṣṭrasaṃjñakaḥ ।
sthāpito madhyabhavane punastatra harergalāt ।।6 2 ।।
kaustubhakhaṇḍāanītastaijaso raivatācalaḥ ।
punaśca revatīnakṣatrasya khaṇḍo'pi saṃsthitaḥ ।।63 ।।
punarmerostu śikharaṃ mandaraṃ kumudaṃ tathā ।
aruṇaṃ ceti divyāni ūrjayanto giristathā ।।64।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānā yatra tiṣṭhanti nityadā ।
svarṇarekhā nadī divyā ojasvatī tathā śubhā ।।।65।।
kṛṣṇā bhadrā tathā'nyāśca hareḥ patnyaḥ saridrūpāḥ ।
sarasvatī tathā''kāśagaṃgā śṛṃgeṣu vartate ।।66।।
ko'sya raivatarājasya mahimnaḥ pārameti nu ।
sarve divyāḥ samuditāstasmānmokṣasthalaṃ hi tat ।।67।।
bhuvastalād bahiryāvān tato daśaguṇastu saḥ ।
pṛthvīgarbhe praviṣṭo'sti raivatācalabhūdharaḥ ।।68।।
vastrāpathe pradṛśyante ye prakīrṇakaparvatāḥ ।
tāni tu śikharāṇyeva dṛśyante na tu parvataḥ ।।69।।
yadā hyāgatya patito vivare raivatācalaḥ ।
daśayojanamucchrāyo hyabhūtsa raivatācalaḥ ।।1.161.70 ।।
vegenaivā'patanmāndyādyadā pṛthvyāmavātarat ।
yojanānāṃ śataṃ tatra gagane bhramaṇaṃ hyabhūt ।।71।।
pūrvottaradiśābhāgāt punaḥ punarbhramiṃ yadā ।
nyūnavegāṃ hyakarot sa tadā tanmūrdhabhāgataḥ ।।।72।।।
dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi vegācchikharāṇāṃ sahasrakam ।
bhaṃktvā viyujya cotkṛtya patitaṃ bahuvistaram ।।73।।।
vyāghrāraṇye patitāni raivataśikharāṇi vai ।
tathaiva tāni sthāsyanti yāvadācandratārakam ।।74।।
somanāthaṃ samārabhya bhīmanāthāvadhi kṣitau ।
śikharāṇi patitāni vyāghrāraṇyasthalāntare ।।75।।
tadatra raivate bhāge bhavaṃ dāmodaraṃ tathā ।
smṛtvā mṛtiṃ ca yāsyanti yāsyanti muktimeva te ।।76।।
māhātmyamityupādiśya harirdāmodaraḥ svayam ।
samāśliṣyā'tha taṃ vipraṃ muhuḥ patnīvrataṃ muhuḥ ।।77।।
prāha tīrthāya gamane tirodadhe svayaṃ tadā ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pūrvaṃ yaccaritaṃ mayā ।।78।।
paṭhitaṃ pāṭhitaṃ yadvā śrāvitaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā ।
naitādṛśaṃ bhavedanyat kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।79।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne raivatādrivastrāpathakṣetratīrthamahimavarṇananāmaikaṣaṣṭhyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 161 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 161 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 162
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 163 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
satī ca pārvatī devī gaṇeśajananī prabho ।
bhavatā kathitā pūrvaṃ kathaṃ satī kadā hyabhūt ।। 1 ।।
yā tu nārāyaṇamūrtau sattā ca sārvabhaumikī ।
satīrūpā samudbhūtā seyaṃ vā'nyeti kā satī ।। gra ।।
saiva satī pārvatī vā pārvatyanyā śivapriyā ।
iti me saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chindhi nārāyaṇā'cyuta ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
samīcīnaṃ tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ guhyaṃ cānādikālikam ।
jānanto'pi na jānanti cānye vṛttāntamīdṛśam ।। 4 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi yāthātathyena tatkathām ।
yacchrutvā te'pi bhānaṃ syāt satī kimātmikā'sti yat। ।। 5 ।।
sarvaiśvaryasarvaśaktiyutaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
mahatyeva pratisarge'kṣare dhāmnyeka eva saḥ ।। 6 ।।
virājate tadanyadvai sarvaṃ saṃhṛtya cātmani ।
rājādhirājo bhagavānekākī ramate nahi ।। 7 ।।
ciraṃ dvitīyamaicchatsa mūrtervāmāṃgatastadā ।
muktāndhāmānyanekāni guṇānaiśvaryapārṣadān ।। 8 ।।
avatārānīśvarāँśceśvarāṇīrdivyamūrtikān ।
dāsīṭadāsānanekāँśca trīnguṇānśāśvatāँstathā ।। 9 ।।
prāduścakāra bhagavān sarvasattādhipo hariḥ ।
sarvaniyāmikā sārvabhaumā sattā ca yā harau ।। 1.162.10 ।।
anādinī sthitā cāsītprādurbhāvamavāpa sā ।
triguṇātmā ca sā sattā sarvasṛṣṭijananyatha ।। 11 ।।
mahāmāyā sattvarajastamāatmā hyabhūddhi sā ।
sāmyāvasthā ca sā māyā brahmarūpā haripriyā ।। 12।।
rādhārūpā mahālakṣmīrūpā ramāsvarūpiṇī ।
lakṣmīrūpā ca sāvitrīrūpā bhavati vai muhuḥ ।। 13।।
vairājasya lalāṭādvai yadā rudro bhavāmyaham ।
rudrāṇī ca tadā māyā patnī me jāyate hi sā ।। 14।।
so'haṃ śivasvarūpeṇa tatra prāvirbhavāmi tu ।
tatra tatra mayā sākaṃ jāyate me sahāyinī ।। 15।।
saiva madaṃganā mātā śivā sā satīrūpiṇī ।
yathā janmavatī jātā tatsarvaṃ śṛṇu me priye ।। 16।।
vairājasya yathā patnī brahmādīnsuṣuve tu sā ।
tadā mānā tu sā devī brahmādīnāṃ hyabhūt khalu ।। 17।।
brahmaṇaśca lalāṭādvai rudraḥ śaṃbhurajāyata ।
yadā tadā śaṃbhupatnī snuṣā sā brahmaṇo hyabhūt ।। 18।।
dakṣaputrī yadā jātā tadā sā brahmaṇaḥ khalu ।
putrasya putrī samabhūt sattārūpā tu sā satī ।। 19।।
bhrātā tu brahmaṇaḥ śabhurvirāṭputro'bhavadyadā ।
tadā sā bhrātṛjāyā vai brahmaṇaḥ parikīrtitā ।। 1.162.20।।
ityevaṃ tu mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīsvarūpiṇī ।
yathākāryaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvā vartate sṛṣṭidhāriṇī ।।।2 1।।
vairājanābheḥ kamalād brahmā yadā tvajāyata ।
tadā tasya tapo dṛṣṭvā viṣṇurbhrātā hyajāyata ।।22।।
dvayormahattve kalaho'bhavat tasya nivṛttaye ।
madhye tu śrīharestejaḥkiraṇaṃ hyabhūt ।। 22।।
tadā tatra tu kiraṇe śivo'dṛśyata sa prabhuḥ ।
tenāpi saha māyā sā śivā'dṛśyata vai tadā ।।।24।।।
brahmaṇā tu tadā tau dvau prārthitau svasahāyakau ।
sa eva prārthitaḥ sadāśivo vairājabhālataḥ ।।25।।।
samutpannaḥ śaṃbhurūpastadā śivāpi cāṃganā ।
samaṃ śivena sañjātā śivavāme vyavasthitā ।।26।।
ardhanārīnararūpaḥ śivo vai vartate tadā ।
atha kāryavaśānnārīrūpā pṛthak śivā tvabhūt ।।।27।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi yathā'bhūd daityanāśinī ।
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthamāvirbhavati sā yadā ।।58।।
utpanneti tadā loke sā nityā'pyabhidhīyate ।
ekadā tu svayaṃ brahmā prathame vai kṛte yuge ।।।29।।
tapasi sthita evā'bhūt kamale'tha tadā śivaḥ ।
samādhau dhyānamagno'bhūt sṛṣṭicintanavarjitaḥ ।।1.162.30 ।।
viṣṇustu śeṣaśayane virāme'bhūcca yogivat ।
prātaḥ sṛṣṭeḥ samāraṃbhe prāyaḥ kāle hyupasthite ।।।3 1 ।।
jāgradbhāve tadā viṣṇoḥ karṇayormalayogataḥ ।
kaṇḍūḥ punaḥpunastatra samajāyata padmaje! ।।32।।
viṣṇunā ca tadā svarṇaśalākāprāntayojanāt ।
kaṇḍūrnirasitā karṇamalāttu guṭikādvayam ।।।33।।
bahirniṣkāsya ca dve te prakṣipte guṭike jale ।
tato dvāvasurau ghorau vikhyātau madhukaiṭabhau ।।34।।
karṇamalātsamutpannau mahābalaparākramau ।
viṣṇumānamya sahasā jalopari samāgatau ।।35।।
tābhyāṃ tatrā''lokitaṃ vai kamalaṃ brahmaṇā yutam ।
vicitraṃ tadvilokyaitau hantu brahmāṇamudyatau ।।36।।
brahmā tadā bhayaṃ prāpya tuṣṭāva tu janārdanam ।
ekāgramānaso bhūtvā santuṣṭāva muhurmuhuḥ ।।37।।
muhuraprārthayat svasya rakṣaṇāya tadā punaḥ ।
samutthāya tatastābhyāṃ yuyudhe bhagavān hariḥ ।।।38।।
pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi bāhupraharaṇo vibhuḥ ।
tadā tāvasurau mohayituṃ ca bhagavān hariḥ ।। 39।।
sasmāra tu mahāmāyāṃ tāṃ śivā''rdhāṃgasaṃsthitām ।
drāgeva śivamūrteḥ sā pṛthaṅnārīsvarūpiṇī ।।1.162.40 ।।
bhūtvā dāsīva deveśī samāgatya puraḥsthitā ।
bhagavāँstāṃ tadā svasya netrayoḥ svīcakāra hi ।।41 ।।
uvācaināṃ mahāmāye! mayi vyāpnotu sarvathā ।
netrā''syanāsikābāhuhṛdayorvaṃghriṣu drutam ।।।42।।
māṃ yathā tau prapaśyetāṃ nārīṃ mohakarīṃ śubhām ।
svīkṛtyā''jñāṃ yathā māyā śivā mohamayī svayam ।।।43 ।।
viṣṇumūrtau tadā jātā mayā javanikā yathā ।
antarviṣṇurbahirmāyā viṣṇugarbhā ca mātṛvat ।।44।।
dṛśyate ca tadā tāvat dadṛśāte ca tāṃ ca tau ।
daityau mumuhaturtāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tejaḥsvarūpiṇīm ।।45।।
tau tadā'tibalonmattau mahāmāyāvimohitau ।
uktavantau varo'smadbhyāṃ vṛṇu tvaṃ śubhadarśane! ।।46।।
pracchanno bhagavāँstatra māyājavanikāgataḥ ।
uvāca tau mahāpremṇā tayorākarṣayanmanaḥ ।।47।।
bhavetāmadya me tuṣṭau mama vadhyāvubhāvapi ।
kimanyena vareṇātra mama tvetāvatā kṛtam ।।48।।
mohitau kāmasaṃkalpāt vaṃcitau jñānamārgataḥ ।
bhānahīnau tadā jātau kāryā'kāryāvivekinau ।।49।।
brahmakamalavāsātmajalaṃ dṛṣṭvā samantataḥ ।
ūcaturjahi yatrāsti jalahīnā kṣitistu nau ।।1.162.50 ।।
tāvadādye kṛtayuge jalaṃ vai līnatāṃ gatam ।
pṛthivī jalaśūnyā cādṛśyata golakātmikī ।।51 ।।
tadā bhagavatā tatra śaṃkhacakragadābhṛtā ।
kṛtvā cakreṇa vai chinne jaghane śirasī tayoḥ ।।52।।
seyaṃ mohakarī māyā mohanī nāmato'bhavat ।
tasyai prasanno bhagavān brahmā tuṣṭāva sāṃjaliḥ ।।53।।
namo mātre namaḥ svasre duhitre'stu namonamaḥ ।
namo'stu bhrātṛjāyāyai śivāyai te namonamaḥ ।।54।।
namaḥ patnyai namaḥ kāryasādhikāśaktaye namaḥ ।
namo'stu vaiṣṇavīdevyai vāmāṃgāyai namonamaḥ ।।55।।
lakṣmīstvaṃ sā ca sāvitrī tvaṃ devī jananī parā ।
tvayaiva dhāryate sarvaṃ tvayaitatsṛjyate jagat ।।56।।
tvayaitatpālyate devi! tvamatsyante ca sarvadā ।
mahāvidyā mahāmāyā mahāmedhā mahāsmṛtiḥ ।।57।।
mahāmohā ca bhavatī mahādevī mahāsurī ।
tvaṃ śrīstvamīśvarī tvaṃ brahmāṇī devasahāyinī ।।58।।।
khaḍgaśūlagadācakraśaṃkhacāpakṛtā''yudhā ।
bhuśuṇḍīparighaprāśabāṇasattomarāyudhā ।।59।।
yacca kiñcit kvacidvastu sadasadvā'khilātmakam ।
tasya sarvasya yā śaktistvametatkāryasādhikā ।।1.162.60 ।।
śaṃbhorardhāṃganā tanvī viṣṇorardhāṃganā ramā ।
vedhaso'rdhāṃganā brāhmī sṛjyadeveṣu saṃvasa ।।61।।
ityarthyamānā sā devī brahmaviṣṇupinākiṣu ।
mohinī mohikā svasya nivāsamakarottathā ।।62।।
adṛśyabhāvamāpannā yayau viṣṇuḥ payonidhim ।
brahmā viṣṇostanau sṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā prāgvat। sasarja tām ।।63।।
ṛṣīn munīṃstathā pitṝn devān surāँśca mānavān ।
daityān sarpān sthāvarāँśca teṣu mohinyuvāsa sā ।।64।।
tejobalaprasaundaryarūpiṇī sā'vasat khalu ।
indriyeṣu mahāmāyā sarvakāryaprasādhikā ।।65।।
tattajjātīyarūpāṇi vyatanod dehasundarī ।
saundaryaṃ naranārīṣu vyajāyata tayaiva tat ।।66।।
atha kālāntare sā ca mahiṣāsuranāśinī ।
prādurabhūtsurakāryakāriṇī jagadīśvarī ।।67।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parabrahmaṇo'rdhāṃganātmakamahāmāyayā dhṛtarādhālakṣmīsāvitrīśivādirūpāṇāṃ varṇanaṃ madhukaiṭabha-
nāśārthaṃ dhṛtamohinīsvarūpavarṇanaṃ cetyādi nirūpaṇanāmā dviṣaṣṭhyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 162।।


← adhyāyaḥ 162 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 163
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 164 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kadā kathaṃ mahiṣākhyo hyasuraḥ samapadyata ।
devīkṛtavināśaṃ ca śrotumicchāmi me vada ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu ko'yaṃ mahiṣo'bhūt kathamāsuratāṃ gataḥ ।
vināśaśca kayā rītyā kṛto devyā nibodha me ।। 2 ।।
purā daityau mahāraudrau jagatkṣobhakarāvubhau ।
raṃbhaścāpi karaṃbhaśca putrārthaṃ tepatustapaḥ ।। 3 ।।
bahūnvarṣagaṇānekaḥ karaṃbhaḥ salile sthitaḥ ।
grāho bhūtvā mahendrastaṃ jale jaghāna daṃṣṭrayā ।। 4 ।।
naṣṭe bhrātari raṃbho'bhūdatikrodhapariplutaḥ ।
vahnau svaśīrṣaṃ saṃchidya hotumaicchanmahā'suraḥ ।। ।5 ।।
khaḍgamādāya yāvadvai chettumudyukta eva saḥ ।
tāvanniṣiddho vai vahnirnaiva mā sāhasaṃ kuru ।। 6 ।।
mā mriyasva yatheṣṭaṃ te dadāmi vada mā ciram ।
raṃbha prāha bhavet putrastrailokyavijayī mama ।। 7 ।।
sarvadevairajeyaḥ syāttathā tvattejasā'dhikaḥ ।
kāmarūpī kṛtā'strajño mahābalaparākramaḥ ।। 8 ।।
vahniḥ provāca taṃ bāḍhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।
yasyāṃ cittaṃ ca te lagnaṃ tayā mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ।। 9 ।।
ityevamukto raṃbha sa yayau mālavaṭābhidham ।
yakṣaṃ draṣṭuṃ tadā mālavaṭasya paśumaṇḍale ।। 1.163.1 0।।
gajāśca mahiṣāścā'śvā gāvo'jā avayastathā ।
vartante bahavastatra mahiṣyāmakaronmanaḥ ।। 11 ।।
sā samāgācca daityendraṃ kāmayantī trihāyanā ।
sa cāpi mahiṣo bhūtvā maithunaṃ tvācarad balī ।। 1 2।।
sagarbhāṃ tāṃ mahiṣīṃ sa gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ gataḥ ।
pātāle dānavaistatra parityakto vikarmakṛt ।। 1 3।।
punaḥ sa mahiṣīṃ nītvā yakṣaṃ mālavaṭā'bhidham ।
samājagāma vāsāya suṣuve mahiṣī sutam ।। 14।।
śubhraṃ tu mahiṣaṃ kāmarūpiṇaṃ sumahābalam ।
putramāsādya raṃbhaḥ sa mumude vai muhurmuhuḥ ।। 15।।
athā'nyo mahiṣaḥ kaścinmahiṣīmṛtusaṃsthitām ।
tāmeva kāmayāmāsa sā ca raṃbhaṃ jagāda tat ।। 16।।
tadā raṃbhamahiṣayoryuddhaṃ paramadāruṇam ।
abhūttadā tu tīkṣṇābhyāṃ śṛṃgābhyāṃ hṛdi tāḍitaḥ ।। 17।।
nirbhinnahṛdayo raṃbhaḥ papāta ca mamāra ca ।
mahiṣī ca tato yakṣaśaraṇaṃ saṃjagāma ha ।। 18।।
yakṣaiśca rakṣitā sā ca nivārya mahiṣāntaram ।
mṛtaṃ ca taṃ tadā raṃbhaṃ yakṣā mālavaṭādayaḥ ।। 19।।
citāmāropayāmāsuḥ sā'pyāruroha tatra ha ।
tato'gnimadhyāduttasthau puruṣo raudrabhīṣaṇaḥ ।।।1.163.20।।
khaḍgapāṇistadā yakṣān vyadrāvayacca tatsthalāt ।
mahiṣān ghātayāmāsa putraṃ pupoṣa bhāvataḥ ।।21।।
so'yaṃ raṃbhasya putro'bhūd raktabījaśca nāmataḥ ।
mahābalo hyavadhyaśca kāmarūpadharaḥ sadā ।।22।।
yuvā sa yuyudhe devaistathānyairlokapālakaiḥ ।
dikpālā lokapālāśca grahāstena jitā yudhi ।।23।।
tadā'jaṃ śaṃkaraṃ nītvā devā jagmurjanārdanam ।
nyavedayan mahiṣasya raktabījasya ceṣṭitam ।।।24।।
prabho'śvisūryacandrāṇāṃ jalavāyvagnivedhasām ।
kuberendrādidevānāṃ rājyānyāskanditāni vai ।।।25।।
nākānnirākṛtā devā vayaṃ pṛthvyāṃ vasāmahe ।
yadi viṣṇuśca vā śaṃbhurno cedrakṣāṃ kariṣyase ।।26।।
tena saṃkālyamānāśca vrajāmo hi rasātalam ।
śrutvaivaṃ bhagavāँstatra kopaṃ suduḥsaham ।।।27।।
tāvatprabhostadā''syādvai śaṃbhośca brahmaṇastathā ।
indrādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ mahattejo viniḥsṛtam ।।।28।।
yā madhukaiṭabhau devī mārayitvendriyeṣu vai ।
sarveṣāṃ balarūpā''sīt tejastadeva niḥsṛtam ।। 29।।
tatsarvaṃ tu śailatulyaṃ saṃhataṃ duḥsahaṃ param ।
kātyāyanamaharṣeścā''śrame tattejasā'nvitam ।।1.163.30।।
tasmājjātā viśālākṣī kātyāyanī maheśvarī ।
śaṃbhutejo'bhavadvaktraṃ vahnitejastrinetrakam ।।3 1 ।।
yāmyatejo'bhavankeśā harestejo'bhavan bhujāḥ ।
aṣṭādaśaprasaṃkhyātā bāhavaḥ saṃprajajñire ।।32।।
saumye yugmaṃ stanayorvakṣaścaindreṇa tejasā ।
ūrū jaṃghe nitambau ca madhyaṃ candrasya tejasā । ।33 ।।
brahmatejo'bhavatpādyugalaṃ komalā'ruṇam ।
sūryasya tejasā'ṅgulyo dantāḥ prajeśatejasā ।। 34।।
yakṣatejo'bhavannāsā śravaṇau vāyutejasā ।
sādhyatejo'bhavad bhrūśca kāmabāṇāsanā nu kim ।।35।।
evaṃ tejāṃsi devānāṃ tatra saṃbhūya sundarī ।
nāmnā kātyāyanī jātā mahiṣakṣayahetave ।।36।।
dadau triśūlaṃ śaṃbhuśca hariścakraṃ dadau tadā ।
śaṃkhaṃ dadau jaleśaśca dadau śaktiṃ hutāśanaḥ ।।37।।
vāyuścāpaṃ ca tūrṇaṃ cā'kṣayyabāṇān gabhastimān ।
vajraṃ ghaṇṭāṃ dadau cendro yamo daṇḍaṃ dadau tathā ।।38।।
gadāṃ kuberaḥ pradadau brahmā'dāttu kamaṇḍalum ।
akṣamālāṃ dadau tasyai kālo'siṃ carma saṃdadau ।। 39।।
somo hāraṃ cāmare ca mālāmabdhiḥ samujjvalām ।
himālayo mṛgendraṃ ca vāhanaṃ pradadau śriyai ।।1.163.40 ।।
viśvakarmā kuṭhāraṃ cā'rdhacandraṃ kuṇḍale tathā ।
cūḍāmaṇiṃ dadau citraratho'dāt pānapātrakam ।।41।।
śeṣo bhujaṃgahāraṃ cartavo'mlānasumasrajam ।
dadurdevāścāyudhāni śṛṃgārāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ ।।42।।
devī tadā'tituṣṭā'bhūdaṭṭahāsaṃ cakāra vai ।
sarvadevairāśiṣā vardhitā'gāt vindhyaparvatam ।।43।।
uccaśṛṃgekṛtā''vāsā tiṣṭhate hṛdayaṃgamā ।
mahiṣāsuradūtau tāṃ caṇḍamuṇḍāvapaśyatām ।।44।।
ūcaturmahiṣaṃ gatvā kanyāṃ sarvāṃgasundarīm ।
svastho bhavān kathaṃ śete kanyāṃ bhajatu cāgatām ।।45।।
kīdṛśī mukhacandrābhā keśā jīmūtasannibhāḥ ।
tryagnayastrīṇi netrāṇi kaṃbuḥ kaṇṭhasthito'sti kim ।।46।।
suvṛttau ca stanau nimnacūcukau kuṃbhasadṛśau ।
aṣṭādaśabhujāstasyāḥ pīnāḥ śastrānvitāḥ śubhāḥ ।।47।।
udaraṃ trivalīvyāptaṃ madhyaṃ romavinākṛtam ।
saundaryabhājane jaṃghe sakthinī svarṇaśobhane ।।48।।
karapādatale ramye sthalapadmanibhe śubhe ।
netre kamalapatrābhe sarvā saundaryabhājanā ।।49।।
patnītvena gṛhāṇa tvaṃ kanyāṃ tāṃ surasundarīm ।
tāṃ vinā śobhate naiva tavā'yaṃ divyavigrahaḥ ।।1.163.50।।
tāṃ vinā te mṛṣā rājyamindrarājyamapi prabho ।
gatvā vindhyācale paśya kuruṣvābhimataṃ kṣamam ।।।5 1 ।।
śubhāśubhe kṛte puṃsāṃ paścāt vrajata eva hi ।
madarthe mama bhāgyāttatkanyāratnamupasthitam ।।।52।।
vicāryetthaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ ca namaraṃ bāṣkalaṃ tathā ।
caṇḍaṃ viśālanetraṃ ca kapilaṃ vikṣuraṃ tathā ।।53।।
ugrāyudhaṃ raktabījaṃ tvādideśa sa daityarāṭ ।
vindhyācalaṃ pragacchantu sajjībhūtā mahāsurāḥ ।।54।।।
tata āgamya te vindhye śibiraṃ viniveśya ca ।
tadā tasthurmayaputro dundubhiḥ prāha ceśvarīm ।।55।।
kumāri! raṃbhaputrasyā dūto'smi mahiṣasya vai ।
śṛṇu matsvāmināthasya yatheṣṭaṃ ca tataḥ kuru ।।56।।
dundubhiḥ prāha kanye tvaṃ māṃ vai varaya sarvathā ।
amarā mama bhṛtyāśca vartante vijitā mayā ।।57।।
ābrahmabhuvanā lokā lokapālā vaśīkṛtāḥ ।
ahamindro'smi rudro'smi sūryo'smi rajanīkaraḥ ।।।58।।
lokeśo'smi mahārājo māṃ bhajasva jagatpatim ।
strīratnamāgryaṃ bhavatī madarhaṃ hi bhajasva mām ।।59।।
devī prāha tadā śrutvā dūtasya vacanaṃ prati ।
kule me vartate dharmaḥ śulkākhya iti niścitaḥ ।।1.163.60 ।।
taṃ ceddadyānmahiṣo me bhajāmyadya patiṃ tu tam ।
dundubhiḥ prāha śulkaṃ tat kīdṛśaṃ tvaṃ nivedaya ।।61 ।।
tvadarthe mastakaṃ dadyānmama svāmī tataḥ kimu!
devyāha ca tadā śulkaṃ kanyāṃ yo jeṣyati mṛdhe ।।62।।
tasyāḥ patiḥ sa eva syāditi tasmai nivedaya ।
śrutvā dundubhirāgatya kathayāmāsa tadyathā ।।63।।
mahiṣo'pi mahātejāḥ sarvadaityapuraḥsaraḥ ।
śrutvā'bhyāgācca vindhyādrimāvṛtya samupasthitaḥ ।।64।।
tatra senāpatirdaityo cikṣuro nāma nāmataḥ ।
senāgragāmī namaraścaturaṃgabalānvitaḥ ।।65।।
anye daityā dānavāśca svasvasainyasamanvitāḥ ।
ājagmustatra yuddhārthaṃ mahiṣāsurayojitāḥ ।।66।।
atha devyā sahāyārthaṃ sūryacandrādayastataḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśendrajaleśādyāstadā''gatāḥ ।।67।।
devānāmatha daityānāṃ sainyāni tu parasparam ।
vindhyācale tadogrāṇi hyāsan bhayaṃkarāṇi hi ।।68।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne raṃbhāsuraputramahiṣāsurotpattyāditadvināśikākātyāyanyutpattyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭhyadhika-
śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 163 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 163 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 164
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 165 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tatasteṣāṃ yuddhāraṃbho babhūva ha ।
sannaddhāḥ sainikāḥ sarve samutpeturudāyudhāḥ ।। 1 ।।
mahiṣaśca tadā devīṃ dadarśā'gnisamojjvalām ।
hetusūryacamatkārāṃ dhanurjyāsvanakāriṇīm ।। 2 ।।
kṣobhitā'śeṣasainyāṃ tāṃ kirīṭollikhitā'mbarām ।
diśo bhujasahasreṇa parito vyāpya saṃsthitām ।। 3 ।।
mumoha bahudhā daityo vijetuṃ kṛtanirṇayaḥ ।
yuddhaṃ pravavṛte ghoraṃ diviṣadāṃ suradviṣām ।। 4 ।।
śastrāstrerbahudhā muktairvyāptaṃ jātaṃ digantaram ।
mahiṣāsurasenānīścikṣuro yuyudhe'maraiḥ ।। 5 ।।
rathānāmayutaiḥ ṣaḍbhirudagro yuyudhe'maraiḥ ।
ayudhyatā'yutānāṃ ca sahasreṇa mahāhanuḥ ।। 6 ।।
asilomā ca yuyudhe pañcāśanniyutaistadā ।
bāṣkalo yuyudhe tatrā'yutānāṃ ṣaṭśataistadā ।। 7 ।।
gajavājirathā'saṃkhyasādhanairvyomacāribhiḥ ।
biḍālo yuyudhe tatrā'yutānāmayutaiḥ rathaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
anye'pi tatra daiteyā dānavāścā'yutā'yutaiḥ ।
hayairnāgaiḥ rathairyānaiḥ śastrāstraiḥ pattibhistathā ।। 9 ।।
yuyudhuḥ saṃyuge devairdevyā saha ca te'surāḥ ।
tomarairbhindipālaiśca muśalairasibhistathā ।। 1.164.1 0।।
gadābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ khaḍgaiḥ paraśubhiśca paṭṭiśaiḥ ।
yuyudhe dānavā devā yathābuddhibalodayam ।। 11 ।।
devīṃ devāँstadā hantuṃ cikṣipurdānavā muhuḥ ।
śastrāṇi tāni ciccheda līlayā sā nijāyudhaiḥ ।। 1 2।।
kṣiprahastā ca sā śastrāṇyastrāṇyasurasainyake ।
mumoca caṇḍikā śīghraṃ jaghānā''surasainyakam ।। 13 ।।
viprakīrṇaṃ samastaṃ ca daityadānavamaṇḍalam ।
ciccheda prāyaśo devī sasyānīva tu karṣukaḥ ।। 14।।
athā'nye dānavāḥ saṃjīvanyā vai vidyayā tadā ।
chinnā apyutthitā bhūtvā tayā yuyudhire saha ।। 15।।
devāstānnāśayāmāsurbāṇaughaiḥ śastravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।
devī dhanuḥ samākṛṣyā'hanadvai dānavaṃ balam ।। 16 ।।
bāṇaughairdivyatīkṣṇāstraiściccheda bahudhā balam ।
kāँścittu gadayā tīkṣṇā'sinā kāँścittu tomaraiḥ ।। 17।।
pāśena kāँścittatraiva śaktyarṣṭiparighaistathā ।
cakreṇa kāँścid devī tān nijaghāna maheśvarī ।। 18।।
kāँścittu kuliśaiḥ kāँścinmuśalena jaghāna sā ।
yudhyamānā raṇe devī niḥśvāsān mumuce bahūn ।। 1 9।।
te sarve tu tadā devīśvāsotpannāḥ gaṇeśvarāḥ ।
yuyudhire'straśastraiśca nijaghnurdaityadānavān ।।1.164.20 ।।
mumudire ca paṭahānavādayaँśca gomukhān ।
śaṃkhānmṛdaṃgān bherīścā'vādayaँste raṇāṃgaṇe ।।।2 1 ।।
tadā ca kesarī kruddho vidhunvan kesarān muhuḥ ।
mahākālakarālaḥ san niṣūdayati dānavān ।। 22।।
khaṅgaiḥ kecit triśūlaiśca dvedhā bhinnā hi dānavāḥ ।
bāṇaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ keciccherate bhinnavakṣasaḥ ।।।23 ।।
vipothitāśca gadayā patitā bhuvi śerate ।
muśalaiśca hatāḥ kecid rudhiraṃ vemurāsurāḥ ।।।24।।।
sainikāḥ koṭiśastatra bāṇaiḥ prāṇāṃśca tatyajuḥ ।
cakraiśchinnabhujāśchinnakaṃdharāḥ patitāḥ pare ।।25 ।।
kecidvidāritā madhye khaḍgairbhāgena śerate ।
vidāritā ardhabhāgāḥ svapanti bhuvi cāpare ।।26।।
vibhaktāḥ kaṭibhiścānye dvedhā bhūmau patanti hi ।
kecidekākṣibhujapātkabandhāśca dvidhākṛtāḥ ।।27।।
kabandhā patitāstatrotthāyotthāya punaḥ punaḥ ।
yuyudhurnanṛtuścānye khaḍgā'siśaktipāṇayaḥ । । 28 । ।
petuścānye madonmattāśceluśca tatyajuḥ raṇam ।
durgāṃ tāṃ kālarātriṃ ca manyamānā vidudruvuḥ । । 29 । ।
agamyā sā'bhavat pṛthvī pātitai raṇagāmibhiḥ ।
visusruvurmahānadyaḥ śoṇitā'dbhistadantare । । 1.164.30 । ।
evaṃ kṣayo mahān jāto hyasurāṇāṃ tadā bhuvi ।
gajavājikharoṣṭrāṇāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ raṇāṃgaṇe ।। 31 ।।
hataṃ sainyaṃ svakaṃ dṛṣṭvā senānīścikṣurastadā ।
kārmukaṃ dṛḍhamākṛṣya vavarṣa śarajālakam । । 32 । ।
tasya śarāँstadā devī ciccheda svaśarairmuhuḥ ।
sauvarṇapuṃkhānaparān śarān jagrāha ṣoḍaśa । । 33 । ।
jaghāna turagān bāṇaiścaturbhiścaturāँstathā ।
hatvā sārathimekena dhvajamekena cicchide ।। 3 4। ।
cicchedaikena cāpaṃ ca rathaṃ babhaṃja mudgaraiḥ ।
sa chinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ । । 35 ।।
abhyadhāvata khaḍgaṃ ca carma prādāya vegataḥ ।
śaraiścaturbhiściccheda khaḍgaṃ carma maheśvarī । । 36 । ।
tato jagrāha śūlaṃ ca prādravatpunarambikām ।
cikṣepa ca tatastattu bhadrakālyāṃ sa daityarāṭ ।। 37 ।।
khaḍgaṃ cā'nyaṃ samādāya jaghāna śāṃkarībhuje ।
babhaṃja khaḍgo dvedhā'bhūt śūlaṃ tu śatadhā'bhinat ।। 38 । ।
devyā śūlaṃ prahitaṃ svaṃ vakṣasi vidadāra tam ।
pādau karau ca śīrṣaṃ ca sā ciccheda varāsinā । । 39 ।।
evaṃ senāpatiścikṣuro'patat ṣaḍvibhāgataḥ ।
senānyaṃ naṣṭamālokya namaraḥ sainyamūrdhagaḥ । । 1.164.40 । ।
samāgamya ca vegena devyāṃ śaktiṃ mumoca ha ।
huṃkārā'bhihatāṃ śaktiṃ bhasmasādakaroddhi sā । । 41 ।।
daityastriśūlamāsādya siṃhāya prāhiṇodraṇe ।
devī kṣurapradhāraiśca bāṇaistadapi cā'cchinat । ।42 । ।
tataḥ siṃhaḥ samutpatya gajakuṃbhāntarasthitam ।
namaraṃ jagṛhe kaṇṭhe daṃṣṭrābhistīkṣṇadhāribhiḥ । । 43 । ।
gatāsuṃ kuṃjaraskandhāt kṣiptvā devyaiḥ niveditaḥ ।
gṛhītvā namaraṃ savyapāṇinā''bhrāmya mastake । । 44।।
avādayatpaṭahavat sā'ṭṭahāsaṃ tato'karot ।
hāsyāt samudgatā nānā bhūtā vikṛtavigrahāḥ । । 45 । ।
vyāghrāsyāśca vṛkāsyāśca hayāsyā mahiṣānanāḥ ।
varāhāsyāḥ kukkuṭāsyā ākhvāsyā avyajāmukhāḥ ।।46 । ।
nānāvaktrā'kṣicaraṇā nānā''yudhasamanvitāḥ ।
gāyantyanye hasantyanye krīḍantyanye tu miśritāḥ ।।47।।
vādayantyapare tatra stuvantyanye maheśvarīm ।
śātayāmāsa bhūtaiḥ sā śeṣaṃ yaddānavaṃ balam ।।48 ।।
samādravata vegena tadogrāsyo mahāsuraḥ ।
bāṣkalaścoddhataścaiva biḍālanayano'paraḥ ।।49 ।।
durdharo durmukhaścaiva yuyudhire'tivegataḥ ।
devyā raṇe hyudagrastu śilāvṛkṣādibhirhataḥ ।।1.164.5 0 ।।
dantamuṣṭiprahāraiśca bāṣkalo'pi nipātitaḥ ।
gadāpātaistadā devī cūrṇayāmāsa coddhatam ।।5 1 ।।
biḍālaṃ bhindipālena tathā bāṇaiśca durdharam ।
durmukhaṃ gadayā saṃcūrṇayāmāsa karālakam ।।52 ।।
tāmraṃ tathā'ndhakaṃ cogravīryaṃ mahāhanuṃ tathā ।
trinetrā triśūladhāraistān jaghāna pareśvarī ।।।53 ।।
evaṃ kṣaye gate sainye mahiṣo daityarāṭ tadā ।
māhiṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya trāsayāmāsa tān gaṇān ।।54।।
kāँścit tuṇḍaprahāreṇa kṣurakṣepaistathā'parān ।
kāँścillāṃgulaghātaiśca kāँścicchṛṃgavidāraṇaiḥ ।।55।।
kāँścidvegena nādena bhramaṇena tathā'parān ।
netrāgnibhiśca phutkārairnipātya pramathān bahūn ।।56।।
abhyadhāvat prahantuṃ so'suraḥ siṃhaṃ tu tatkṣaṇe ।
kopādbalānmahāvīryaḥ kṣurakṣuṇṇamahītalaḥ ।।57।।
śṛṃgābhyāṃ parvatānuccāँścikṣepa ca nanāda ca ।
vegabhramaṇaghātena pṛthvī tatra vyaśīryata ।।58 ।।
samudro lāṃgūlaghātādudvelo'plāvayajjagat ।
śṛṃgapucchaviphāṇaiśca meghāśchinnā yayurlayam ।।59 ।।
śvāsairhatāstu girayo nipeturvyomamārgataḥ ।
brahmāṇḍanāśasandehaṃ tadā hyajanayad balī ।। 1.164.60 ।।
ityevaṃ balasarvasvaṃ darśitaṃ tena śatruṇā ।
tadā devī tasya kāyaṃ pāśena prababandha vai ।। 61 ।।
tadā tatyāja rūpaṃ tanmāhiṣaṃ ca kṣaṇātpunaḥ ।
siṃho'bhavattadā devī yāvacchinatti mastakam ।। 62।।
tāvat sa puruṣo bhūtvā khaḍgapāṇiradṛśyata ।
yāvaddevī śaraistaṃ saṃvivyādha tāvadeva saḥ ।। 63 ।।
khaḍgacarmadharaḥ śailasadṛśo hyabhavadgajaḥ ।
śuṇḍhādaṇḍena siṃhaṃ taṃ cakarṣa ca jagarja ca ।।64 ।।
nirakṛntata tacchuṇḍhāṃ khaṅgenaiva maheśvarī ।
māhiṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya sa daityaścaṇḍikāṃ prati ।।65।।
cikṣepa parvatān svīyaśṛṃgābhyāmatha caṇḍikā।
cūrṇayāmāsa gadayā parighaistomaraistadā ।।66।।
madhupānaṃ papau kruddhā babhūvā'ruṇalocanā ।
balaujomadagarviṣṭā provāca mahiṣāsuram ।।67।।
garja garja kṣaṇaṃ daitya madhu yāvat pibāmi ca ।
mayā tvayi hate'traiva garjiṣyantyāśu devatāḥ ।।68।।
garja garja kṣaṇaṃ bhīsstha śakṛt yāvanna muṃcasi ।
mayā tvayi hate'traiva mariṣyantyāśu dānavāḥ ।।69।।
evamuktvā śūlamasya vyasṛjaddhṛdi vegataḥ ।
śūlaṃ babhaṃja daityasya vakṣo'sthighaṭṭanābalāt ।।1.164.70।।
atha cikṣepa śaktiṃ sā kuṇṭhitā'grā'patad bhuvi ।
atha cakraṃ prahitaṃ tat kuṇṭhadhāraṃ tadā'patat ।।71।।
atha kṣiptā gadā sāpi dvedhā bhinnā'patad bhuvi ।
atha pāśastathā daṇḍaḥ kṣiptau bhinnau ca tāvubhau ।।72।।
vajraṃ gale hataṃ tatra kṣudratvamagamat tadā ।
atha kruddhā mahādevī samutplutya mahāsuram ।।73 ।।
samārūḍhā pṛṣṭhabhāge daityo'pi pupluve tadā।
sāpi mamarda padbhyāṃ taṃ cakāra balavarjitam ।।614।।
kaṇṭhaṃ bibheda śūlena nirjagāmā'sidhṛk pumān ।
sa evā'suravaryo'bhūt māhiṣātmā mahāsuraḥ ।।75।।
niṣkrāntamātraṃ hṛdye pattalena prahatya ca ।
kopāt kaceṣu saṃgṛhya śiraściccheda cā'sinā ।।76।।
tato hāhākṛtaṃ daityabalaṃ śeṣitamityapi ।
nanāśa pramathaiḥ prāyaḥ pātālaṃ praviveśa tat ।।77।।
devāḥ praharṣaṃ jagmuśca tuṣṭuvustāṃ tu caṇḍikām ।
gandharvāśca jaguḥ kīrtiṃ nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।।78।।
vāditrāṇi hyavādyanta vijayadhvanayo'bhavan ।
devā ūcurmahādevi! mahimānto na te'sti vai ।।79।।
sa aikṣata bahu syāṃ sā cecchā tvaṃ pārameśvarī ।
sundaratā haremūrtau bhavatī sā prakīrtitā ।।1.164.8 0।।
ārādhanā tathā bhaktirmuktiḥ sā tvaṃ pareśvarī ।
nārāyaṇī mahālakṣmīrbrahmāṇī tvaṃ maheśvarī ।।8 1 ।।
triguṇātmā mahāmāyā prakṛtistvaṃ kṛtīśvarī
tvaṃ ramā tvaṃ ca vairājñī lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ sukṛtigṛhe ।।82।।
tvamalakṣmīḥ puṇyahīnagṛhe buddhirhṛdambare ।
tvaṃ śraddhā tvaṃ hrīśca bhīśca tvaṃ svāhā kratukarmaṇi ।।8 ।।
tvaṃ svadhā pitṛdoṣāya vidyā paramamuktaye ।
tvaṃ vāṇī tvaṃ ca gāyatrī sāvitrī tvaṃ trayīmayī ।।84।।
vṛttirmedhā ca durgā ca gaṃgā cā'bhyudayapradā ।
sarvendriyeṣu śaktistvaṃ tasyai cā'syai namonamaḥ ।।85 । ।
pāhyasmān sarvadā mātaḥ śastrāstraiḥ sarvadikṣu ca ।
jahyasurāna sadā devi! devavighnakarān sadā ।।8 6 ।।
stutvaivaṃ divyakusumairarcitā gandhalepanaiḥ ।
dhūpadīpanivedyādibhūṣāṃ'śukādipūjitā । ।87।।
prasannā prāha devāँśca vriyatāṃ cābhivāñcchitam ।
devāḥ prāhuḥ saṃsmṛtā tvaṃ hiṃsayasva mahāpadaḥ ।।88 ।।
dhanavittardhivibhavaputradārādisampadām ।
vṛddhaye'smatprasannā tvaṃ bhava vāribhavānane ।।8 9 ।।
tathetyuktvā surān sarvānāśvāsya ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
prabhaviṣyāmyamarārthaṃ coktvā viveśa tānsurān ।। 1.164.90 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne mahiṣāsurasainyadevasainyayoryuddhaṃ devyā''surasainyavināśana mahiṣāsuravināśanaṃ devakṛtastutyādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 164। ।
