adhyāyaḥ 165
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 166 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhūyo'syāḥ saṃbhavaṃ priye ।
śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaprabhṛtidhvaṃsāya tvāditaḥ śṛṇu ।। 1 । ।
vairājāt kamale jāto brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ vinā sthitaḥ ।
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ kiṃ vidheyaṃ ca mayā'tra kamalenvitaḥ । । 2 ।।
tāvattasyā'bhavatpūrvabhavīyasmaraṇaṃ tadā ।
bījaṃ vinā na tūtpattistasmād bījaṃ juhomyaham । । 3 ।।
svaśarīrasthitaṃ śukraṃ juhāvā'gnau prajāpatiḥ ।
brahmaṇo juhvatuḥ śukramagnau pūrvaṃ prajepsayā ।। 4 ।।
ṛṣayo jajñire vahnāvaṣṭau tānnāmataḥ śṛṇu ।
bhṛgvaṃgirā marīciśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ ।। 5 ।।
atriścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca hyaṣṭau te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।
jvalanto vapuṣā yuktāḥ saprabhāvaiḥ svakairguṇaiḥ ।। 6 । ।
hute cā'gnau sakṛcchukre jvālāṃ bhittvā tu saṃgataḥ ।
bhṛgustvaṃ ceti tannāma cakāra sa prajāpatiḥ ।। 7 ।।
śivenā'bhyarthitaḥ putrecchayā dattaśca vedhasā ।
varaṇād vāruṇaḥ śaivaścāgneyo brahmaṇo bhṛguḥ । । 8 । ।
dvitīyaṃ ca nijaṃ śukramaṃgāreṣvajuhotprabhuḥ ।
aṃgāreṣvaṃgiroṃ'gāni saṃhatāni tatoṃ'girāḥ । । 9 । ।
āgneyo hyaṃgirā nāmnā dvitīyo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।
ṣaṭkṛtvā tu punaḥ śukre hate ṣaḍabhavan sutāḥ । । 1.165.10 ।।
marīcibhyaḥ samutpanno marīcistu tṛtīyakaḥ ।
home kratau yato jajñe ṛtuḥ so'yaṃ caturthakaḥ ।। 1 1।।
ena tu viṣṇunā trātaḥ putratve'tristu paṃcamaḥ ।
pubhiḥ keśairlasito yo dehe pulastya ityayam ।। 12।।
keśairlambaiḥ samudbhūtaḥ pulahaḥ saptamo mataḥ ।
vasuragnistadutpanno vaśī vasiṣṭha ucyate ।। 1 3।।
brahmaṇaḥ prathame hyete putrāḥ sabījamānavāḥ ।
sarve prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve cāpi tapasvinaḥ ।। 14।।
teṣvatharvavijñātraṃgirasaḥ putrā daśā'bhavan ।
surūpāyāṃ ca te nāmnā hyādhāryurāyurityapi ।। 15।।
danurdakṣo damaḥ prāṇo haviṣyān haviṣṇustathā ।
ṛtaḥ satyaśca tatrā'yaṃ dakṣo bodhyaḥ satīpitā ।। 16।।
dakṣo maithunabhāvena sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ ।
asiknīmāvahadbhāryāṃ vīraṇākhyaprajāpateḥ ।। 17।।
sutāṃ tasyāṃ samutpannāścaturviṃśatiputrikāḥ ।
dharmāya dattā dakṣeṇa śraddhādyāstu trayodaśa ।। 18।।
śraddhā lakṣmīrvṛtistuṣṭi puṣṭirmedhā tathā kriyā ।
buddhirlajjā vasuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśa ।। 19।।
tābhyaḥ śiṣṭā yavīyasya ekādaśa sulocanāḥ ।
khyātiḥ satī ca saṃbhūtiḥ smṛti prītiḥ kṣamā tathā ।।1.165.20 ।।
sannatiścānurūpā ca ūrjā svāhā svadhā tathā ।
bhṛgurbhavo marīciśca tathā caivāṃgirā muniḥ ।। 21।।
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kraturatrirvaśiṣṭhakaḥ ।
vahniśca pitaraścaite dakṣajāmātaraḥ kramāt ।।।22।।
pūrvaśāpavaśāccaiva brahmā''jñāprabalādapi ।
tārakādivināśārthaputrotpattisakāraṇāt ।।23।।
bhāvino niyatatvācca satī dakṣagṛhe'bhavat ।
śṛṇu devyāḥ pūrvaśāpaḥ kathaṃ jāta iti priye! ।। 24।।
mahiṣāsuranāśāya sarvadevaistu nirmitā ।
kātyāyanī mahāmāyā vināśyā''surapuṃgavam ।।25।।।
punaradṛśyatāṃ prāptā deveṣu vilayaṃgatā ।
yadā tadā triśūlāgre rudreṇa rakṣitā tu sā ।।26।।
satī nāmnā triśūlāgre sadā rudreṇa rakṣitā ।
janmāntarasahasreṣu śivānnahi viyujyate ।।27।।
tayā yadā māhiṣākhyo hyasuro vinipātitaḥ ।
tadā pativratā tasya patnī kuṇḍhīti viśrutā ।।28।।
vilapya ca muhurdevyai śaśāpā''rtihṛdā yathā ।
yathā'patyādirahitā patināśātsuduḥkhitā ।।29।।
prajvalāmi citāgnau ca tathā tvaṃ cāpi duḥkhitā ।
tava bharturmaraṇācca tathā'napatyaduḥkhitā ।।1.165.3 0।।
prajvaliṣyasi kālāgnau jaḍā ca duḥkhinī bhava ।
iti śāpastadā devyai mahiṣyā vihitastataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
kātyāyanī satī devī mlānāsyā hyabhavat kṣaṇam ।
brahmādayastadā dṛṣṭvā devīṃ prāhuḥ śubhānane ।। 32।।
mā khidaste patirnaiva mariṣyati kadācana ।
vayaṃ devāḥ śubhāśīrbhirvardhayiṣyāmahe haram ।।3 3 ।।
kintu mṛtyusamaṃ duḥkhaṃ tava patyurbhaviṣyati ।
mahatāṃ mānahānistu mṛtyureva mato budhaiḥ ।। 34।।
kāmadevanimittena bhāvipūjābalena ca ।
liṃgotpattinimittena kāmotpattau ca śaṃkare ।। 35।।
ṛṣipatnīsamāje vai yadā śaṃbhurvivastrakaḥ ।
yāsyati liṃgamutthāpya ceṣṭāṃ kurvaṃśca kāmagām ।। 36।।
tadā tu brāhmaṇāstatra mantrajñā ṛṣayo'malāḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā taṃ kāminaṃ nagnaṃ protthaliṃgaṃ haraṃ tu te ।।।37।।।
darbhaśalākayā mantradvārā liṃgaṃ tu mūlataḥ ।
pātayiṣyantyavamānaṃ kariṣyanti muhurmuhuḥ ।। 38।।
puṃstvanāśo liṃganāśaḥ puṃso nāśaḥ prakīrtyate ।
ityetanmṛtyutulyaṃ vai duḥkhaṃ yāsyati śaṃkaraḥ ।। 39।।
tato liṃgaṃ tvayi sthāle sthāpayiṣyanti bhūsurāḥ ।
pūjayiṣyanti tadvāṇaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ।।1.165.40 ।।
jyotirliṃgamitiprakhyaṃ bhaviṣyati tato haraḥ ।
kartitaṃ liṃgamādāya sandhiṃ sthāne kariṣyanti ।।41 ।।
punaḥ saliṃgaḥ puruṣastava yogyo bhaviṣyati ।
iti nimittamevaitajjātaṃ śokaṃ ca mā kuru ।।42।।
parabrahmasvarūpe'tra śokasthānaṃ kuto bhavet ।
śṛṇu devyaparaṃ cāpi dakṣo yajñaṃ kariṣyati ।।43 ।।
śaṃkarasya tatra yajñe sthānaṃ naiva kariṣyati ।
ityeṣā mānahāniśca dakṣācchaṃbhorbhaviṣyati ।।44।।
tannimittaṃ tadā te ca vahnau prajvalanaṃ bhavet ।
anapatyā duḥkhitā ca śāpādiphalasammukhī ।।45।।
dagdhā tvaṃ ca jaḍā kālī śailaputrī bhaviṣyasi ।
śaṃkareṇa vivāhaste punastatra bhaviṣyati ।।46।।
iti mā kuru śokaṃ tvaṃ bhāvi bhavati nā'nyathā ।
tato dakṣagṛhaṃ gaccha dakṣasya duhitā bhava ।।47।।
tārakāsuramukhyāstu dānavā vai mahābalāḥ ।
janiṣyante ca teṣāṃ tu varadānānurūpataḥ ।।48।।
putrasyotpādanārthaṃ tvaṃ dakṣasya duhitā bhava ।
tatra rudreṇa putraste kārtikeyo bhaviṣyati ।।49।।
taddvārā'suranāśo'pi bhaviṣyatīti tatkṛte ।
gaccha dakṣagṛhe devi dakṣasya duhitā bhava ।।1.165.50 ।।
evaṃ niyogamāsādya prādurāsītprajāpateḥ ।
niyogād brahmaṇo devī jātā putrī prajāpateḥ ।।51 ।।
niyogād brahmaṇo dakṣo dadau rudrāya tāṃ satīm ।
dākṣīṃ rudro'pi jagrāha svakīyāmeva śūlabhṛt ।।52।।
daityārditānāṃ devānāṃ tejorāśisamudbhavā ।
devī saṃhṛtya daityaughān dakṣakanyā babhūva ha ।।53 ।।
sā'tra nāmnā satī devī svāmino nindayā tataḥ ।
dehaṃ santyajya yogena pārvatī saṃbhaviṣyati ।।54।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dakṣagṛhe putrā jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
sarve te bhrātaraḥ satyāstapobhirdhautakilbiṣāḥ ।।55।।
niyutamekasahasraṃ ca nāradasyopadeśataḥ ।
gatā brahmapadaṃ dhāmā'punarāvṛttilakṣaṇam ।।56।।
haryaśveṣu vimukteṣu tadanye śabalāśvakāḥ ।
pañcasahasraṃ pañcaśataṃ putrā jātāśca te'pi vai ।।57।।
nāradasyopadeśena gatā muktipadaṃ dhruvam ।
pitrā tu yojitāḥ sṛṣṭau nāradena pravrājitāḥ ।।58।।
ato dakṣaḥ sukopaḥ san śaśāpa nāradaṃ tadā ।
nāśamehi garbhavāsaṃ vasa tvaṃ brāhma nārada ।।59।।
tato'bhisandhiṃ cakre vai dakṣastu kaśyapena hi ।
nārado mama kanyāyāṃ tava putro bhavediti ।।1.165.60 ।।
śaśāpa taṃ nārado'pi dakṣaṃ cāṃgirasaṃ tadā ।
yathā'haṃ brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ śāpātte kāśyapo yadā ।।6 1 ।।
bhaveyaṃ ca tadā tvaṃ mānuṣo rājā bhavā''ditaḥ ।
prācīnabarhiṣaḥ pautraḥ putraścaiva pracetasām ।।62।।
dakṣa! tvaṃ māriṣāṃ patnīṃ vṛkṣakanyāṃ gṛhīṣyasi ।
tasyāṃ duhitaraḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ śraddhāprabhṛtayastava ।।63 ।।
bhaviṣyanti daśa tāsāṃ dharmāya vitariṣyasi ।
saptaviṃśatiṃ śaśine kaśyapāya trayodaśa ।।64।।
catasraḥ pararūpāya tārkṣyāya vitariṣyasi ।
bhagvaṃgiraḥkṛśāśvebhyo dve dve ca vitariṣyasi ।।65 ।।
iti śāpānusāreṇa kāle prāpte prajāpatiḥ ।
dakṣaḥ svasya sutāḥ prādāt kaśyapāya trayodaśa ।।66।।
tasmāt sa nārado jajñe punaḥ śāpabalādṛṣiḥ ।
iti brāhmo nārado'pi kāśyapo'jāyatā'tra vai ।।67।।
evamāṃgiraso dakṣaḥ prācetaso hyajāyata ।
tasya gṛhe mahāmāyā janma jagrāha yāvatā ।।68 ।।
tāvatā samayenāpi madhye daityau mahābalau ।
niśuṃbhaśuṃbhau lokānāṃ duḥkhadau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ।।69।।
kaśyapasya danurnāmnā bhāryā yā dakṣaputrikā ।
tasyāṃ putratrayaṃ jātaṃ mahābalaparākramam । ।1.165.70 ।।
jyeṣṭhaḥ śuṃbha iti khyāto niśuṃbhaścāparo'suraḥ ।
tṛtīyo namucirnāma devaduḥkhakaraḥ sadā ।।7 1 ।।
namuciṃ duḥkhadaṃ hantumindro vajramupādade ।
bhayāt tāvannamucistu praviveśa rathaṃ raveḥ ।।।72 ।।
bahirnā''yāti sūryasya rathādvai tāḍito'pi saḥ ।
sūryeṇa ca muhuḥ kṣiptastāḍitaḥ pādalattayā ।।73 ।।
bahistathāpi nā''yāt sa indravajrabhayāttadā ।
taṃ śaraṇāgataṃ matvā sūryo rarakṣa vāsavāt ।।74।।
tataḥ sa samayaṃ cakre raviṇā vāsavena ca ।
nā'haṃ sthāsyāmi vai pṛthvyāṃ svarge naiva kadācana ।।75।।
pātāle tu nivatsyāmi mucyatāṃ jīvadānataḥ ।
tato muktaḥ surendreṇa tato vavre varaṃ yathā ।।76।।
avadhyatvaṃ varaṃ dehi śastrairastraiḥ sureśvara ।
indrastathāstviti prāha varamādāya dānavaḥ ।।77 ।।
svasyā'vadhyatvamājñāya śastrairastraiḥ sa dānavaḥ ।
bhāskarasya rathaṃ tyaktvā samudraṃ prāviśaddrutam ।।78 ।।
sa nimajjannapi vārdhau sāmudraphenamuttamam ।
apaśyad dānavapatistaṃ pragṛhya sthito jale ।।79 ।।
mukhanāsādikarṇādīn samāpūrya sthito jale ।
tasmin śakro'sṛjad vajramantarhitamathā'pi tam ।।1.165.8 0 ।।
phenātmavajraprahataḥ sa papāta mamāra ca ।
phenātmavajrasaṃruddhanāsā''syaḥ sa mamāra vai ।।8 1 ।।
tato'sya bhrātarau vīrau kruddhau śuṃbhaniśuṃbhakau ।
udyogaṃ tu paraṃ kṛtvā devanāśārthamāgatau ।।8 2 ।।
devā api ca yuddhārthaṃ niryayurindramāśritāḥ ।
yuddhaṃ sutumulaṃ jātaṃ jitāstvākramya devatāḥ ।।83 ।।
agresarāśca daityābhyāṃ jitāḥ sabalavāhanāḥ ।
śakrasya tvāhṛto hastīyāmyaśca māhiṣo hṛtaḥ ।।84।।
jaleśasya maṇicchatre hṛte hṛtā gadā hareḥ ।
nidhayaḥ śaṃkhapadmādyāḥ kuberasya hṛtā balāt ।।85।।
kṛtāḥ trilokā vaśagāḥ svārājyaṃ vaśīkṛtam ।
diśāṃpālā lokapālāḥ prāyaśaśca vaśīkṛtāḥ ।।86।।
bhuvaṃ cāgatya rājānaḥ prāyaśaśca vaśīkṛtāḥ ।
tatra revātaṭe rājyaṃ kurvantaṃ prāpya tāvubhau ।।87 ।।
prāhatuḥ raktabījākhyaṃ ko bhavāniti so'bravīt ।
mahiṣasya sacivo'haṃ daityo'smi raktabījakaḥ ।।88 ।।
karomi rājyaṃ pracchannaṃ devyā bhītivaśādiha ।
sacivau dvau mahiṣasya caṇḍamuṇḍau tu nāmataḥ ।।8 9 ।।
vartete salile magnau bhayāddevyā mahābhujau ।
ityasmākaṃ sthitistūktā jñātavyā bhavatorapi ।। 1.165.90 ।।
iti pṛṣṭhau ca tau śuṃbhaniśuṃbhāvūcatuśca tam ।
ahaṃ śuṃbha iti jyeṣṭho niśuṃbho'yaṃ kaniṣṭhakaḥ ।। 91 ।।
danoḥ putrau kāśyapau svo jitavantau surādikān ।
anyānapi mahāpālān jitavantau bhuvaṃgatān ।। 92 ।।
itthaṃ tayostu vadatornarmadāyāstaṭe tadā ।
jalāvāsādviniṣkrāntau caṇḍamuṇḍau ca dānavau ।। 93 ।।
parasparaṃ sahāyāste militāḥ pañca dānavāḥ ।
mahiṣasya namuceśca vairaniryātanāya te ।। 94।।
mantraṇāṃ kṛtavantaste satyāḥ parājayāya vai ।
vayaṃ vivāhayiṣyāmo ratnabhūtāṃ satīṃ tu tām ।। 95।।
ityāmantrya satīṃ mārgayituṃ vindhyācalaṃ yayuḥ ।
adṛśyā dṛśyate sā na tato yātā himālayam ।। 96 ।।
tatra snānāya gacchantīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu pārvatīṃ satīm ।
prāhurvaraya cāsmān vai pārvatī prāha tāँstadā ।। 97।।
ahaṃ vindhyācalī devī tīrthārthamiha cāgatā ।
maivaṃ vācyaṃ tu sattīrthe gacchantvito yathāgatāḥ ।। 98 ।।
vindhyādrau me nivāso'sti tatra vācyaṃ hṛdi sthitam ।
tīrthe kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi yūyaṃ gacchata tatra vai ।। 99 ।।
iti daityāँśca śuṃbhādīn preṣayitvā ca pārvatī ।
snānārthaṃ devagaṃgāyāṃ yāvadagre pragacchati ।। 1.165.100 ।।
tāvat tatra samāgatya saṃgatya ca sureśvarāḥ ।
prathamato'stuvan devīṃ svaduḥkhravinivṛttaye ।। 101 ।।
tvayā'smākaṃ varo datto hyāpatkāle smṛtā satī ।
duḥkhaṃ vai nāśayiṣyāmi hyāpatkāla upasthitaḥ ।। 102 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vedhasā svavīryahomenā'ṣṭamaharṣisamutpattiḥ, āṃgirasadakṣagṛhe devyāḥ satījanmakāraṇam, prācetasadakṣodbhavanakāraṇam, brāhma-nāradasya kāśyapanāradodbhavanakāraṇam, dakṣasya putrāḥ putryaḥ, śuṃbhaniśuṃbhādidanuputrotpattiḥ, devānāṃ parājayaḥ, devīprārthanā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 65 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 165 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 166
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 167 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tato lakṣmi! stutiṃ cakrurdevā dhyātvā maheśvarīm ।
gaṃgātaṭe ca saṃhatya śrūyatāṃ kathayāmi te ।। 1 ।।
namo mātre mahāmātre jananyai te muhurnamaḥ ।
namo māyai mahāmāyai māyāyai te namonamaḥ ।। 2 ।।
brahmāṇyai cā'kṣarāṇyai te muktānyai te namonamaḥ ।
vāsudevyai ca prakṛtyai pradhānāyai namonamaḥ ।। 3 ।।
bhūmnai kālyai mahākālyai mahālakṣmyai namonamaḥ ।
hiraṇyāyai sugarbhāyai vairājyai te namonamaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vareṇyai vararūpāyai golokyai te namonamaḥ ।
nārāyaṇyai ca kṛṣṇāyai vaikuṇṭhāyai namonamaḥ ।। 5 ।।
śvetāyai ca badaryai ca mārtaṇḍāyai namonamaḥ ।
pāvanyai pavamānāyai cā'vyākṛtyai namonamaḥ ।। 6 ।।
sāvitryai cāpi gāyatryai raudrāyai te namonamaḥ ।
dhātryai gauryai ca vaiṣṇavyai jyotsnāyai te namonamaḥ ।। 7 ।।
brahmacāripravaryāyai vīryāyai te namonamaḥ ।
mahatyai cābhimānāyai cākūtyai tai namonamaḥ ।। 8 ।।
cittyai vṛttyai pravṛttyai ca pralayāyai namonamaḥ ।
svargāyai satyalokāyai lokapāyai namonamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
ramāyai ca jayāyai ca vijayāyai namonamaḥ ।
rādhāyai sarvakāriṇyai lakṣmyai te'stu namonamaḥ ।। 1.166.10 ।।
nairṛtyai sukhasampattyai saumyāyai te namonamaḥ ।
vārkṣyai bījasvarūpāyai ratyai devyai namonamaḥ ।। 11 ।।
yā devī sarvasattveṣu viṣṇumāyā vyavasthitā ।
nyāsastasyai natistasyai namastasyai namonamaḥ ।। 1 2।।
cetanā buddhirūpā yā nidrārūpā ca yā sthitā ।
chāyārūpā kṣudhārūpā śaktirūpā ca yā sthitā ।। 13 ।।
tṛṣṇā kṣāntiḥ dayā proktā tasyai tasyai namonamaḥ ।
lajjā śāntistathā śraddhā kāntirvṛttiḥ smṛtistathā ।। 14।।
tuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiśca yā proktā tasyai tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।
dhātryai caiva vidhātryai te mātre devyai namonamaḥ ।। 15।।
āsurāṇāṃ mahānadya vartate samupadravaḥ ।
antaḥ sthitvā pradraṣṭryai te vāraṃvāraṃ namonamaḥ ।। 16 ।।
ityevaṃ stūyamānā sā pārvatī parameśvarī ।
snānasṛtyā''gatā tatra yatra devā stuvanti te ।। 17।।
praṇatā ca tadā devaiḥ prasannā prāha tān surān ।
mama dehādviniṣkṛṣya kośarūpāṃ tu sundarīm ।। 18 ।।
dadāmi devarakṣārthaṃ surā gṛhṇantu māmakīm ।
surūpāṃ divyaśobhaḍhyāṃ mūrtiṃ gṛhṇantu māmakīm ।। 19।।
devāstu kauśikīṃ kanyā nītvā vindhyācalīṃ yayuḥ ।
kauśikī ca tadā vindhyācalyāṃ devyāṃ vyavasthitā ।।1.166.20।।
devāścāsuranāśārthamudyamaṃ cakrire tadā ।
pārvatyāḥ kośarūpā sā kṛṣṇakāntimayī tanuḥ ।।21।।
kṛṣṇavarṇā'bhavat kālī kālikā nāmataḥ smṛtā ।
apa vindhyācale daityā jagmurdevyuktyanusṛtāḥ ।।।22।।
mantraṇāṃ kārayāmāsurdūtaiḥ patnyarthamatra te ।
sugrīvaṃ preṣayāmāsurdūtaṃ vindhyācalīṃ prati ।।23।।
dūtaḥ prāha mahādevi! śuṃbhena preṣito'smyaham ।
śuṃbhaścāsti mahārājastrailokyeśvara ekarāṭ ।। 24।।
tvayyāraktamanā rājā sa yadāha śṛṇuṣva tat ।
mayā tu nirjitā lokāḥ sadikpālāścaturdaśa ।।25।।
trailokye yāni rājyāni madadhīnīkṛtāni ca ।
ratnāni yāni trailokye sāmprataṃ tāni me gṛhe ।।।26 ।।
airāvatādayaḥ santi dvipāstu mama mandire ।
uccaiḥśravādayaścāśvā vartante mama mandire ।।27।।
kalpadrupārijātāśca sugandhayanti me gṛham ।
haṃsayuktavimānāni devagandharvanākinām ।।।28।।
mahāpadmādinidhayo vartante madgṛhe khalu ।
ratnākarasya ratnāni chatracāmaramālikāḥ ।।।29।।
syandanāni vicitrāṇi ratnaśreṣṭhāni yāni ca ।
vividhāśca rasāḥ śreṣṭhā nityayauvanapuṣṭidāḥ ।।1.166.3 0।।
evaṃ dāsāśca dāsyaśca kāmabhūṣāśca naikadhā ।
sarvaṃ prākāmyavaśagaṃ siddhayaḥ santi me gṛhe ।। 3 1।।
parvatāḥ saritaḥ saptā'bdhayo'raṇyāni devatāḥ ।
prabhūtāni dyumaṇayaḥ santi matsevakā gṛhe ।।32।।
rājñyaḥ santi yathākāmaṃ sevikāśca sahasraśaḥ ।
sarvāstāstava dāsīrvai kariṣye yadi me bhava ।।।33।।
tvaṃ prakhyaṃ sundarīratnaṃ vayaṃ ratnabhujo yataḥ ।
māṃ vā mamā'nujaṃ devi! bhaja ratnottamā'si yat ।।34।।
mahārājñīṃ kariṣye tvāṃ matparigrahatāṃ vraja ।
nararatnaṃ ca māṃ devi! tvayā kasmānna gṛhyate ।। 35।।
ityuktā sā mandahāsyā gabhīrāntā jagād tam ।
satyamuktaṃ tu śuṃbhena trailokyavijayena vai ।।36।।
kintvasmākaṃ ca devīnāṃ kulāgataparamparā ।
yuddhe jayati kanyāṃ yastasya sā saṃbhavet priyā ।।।37।।
tadāgacchatu vikhyātastādṛśaḥ śubha eva ha ।
niśuṃbho vā raṇabhūmau samāgacchatu māṃ jayet ।। 38 ।।
kiṃ cireṇātra paṇye vai pāṇiṃ gṛhṇātu tadvidham ।
dūtaḥ prāha tato devīṃ mā'valiptā bhavātra vai ।। 3 9।।
caturdaśabhuvāṃ bhūpā nirjitāstena garviṇā ।
sā tvaṃ gaccha mayā sārdhaṃ susvāgatapuraḥsarā ।।1.166.40 ।।
keśā''karṣaṇajātā'vamānaṃ mā gamanaṃ tava ।
devyuvāca yathārthaṃ tvaṃ kathayatyeva gauravam ।।4 1 ।।
kintu devīkuladharmo'nyathābhāvī na karhicit। ।
tadvai vyācakṣva śuṃbhāya yathāyuktaṃ karotu saḥ ।।42 ।।
dūto natvā gataḥ śuṃbhaṃ prāha vistaratastu tat ।
śrutvā kruddho mahāgarvaḥ prāha dhūmrākṣamānataḥ ।।43 ।।
śīghraṃ sasainyo gaccha tvaṃ keśākarṣaṇapūrvakam ।
ānayā'tra ca tāṃ duṣṭāṃ rakṣakān saṃpramāraya ।।44।।
dhūmrākṣastadvacaḥ śrutvā ṣaṣṭisahasradānavaiḥ ।
sahitaḥ sa jagāmāśu vindhyācalanivāsinīm ।।45 ।।
prāhā''gaccha ṛjurītyā śubhaṃ patiṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।
no ced balānnayāmyeva yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।46 ।।
devī prāha tadā daityaṃ vinā raṇaṃ na me paṇaḥ ।
balavān balayukto'si yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।47।।
śrutvaivaṃ so'sahamāno balāddhartuṃ samāgataḥ ।
devyā tatraiva hūṃkāravahninā bhasmasātkṛtaḥ ।।48 ।।
atha sainyaṃ mahākruddhaṃ devīnāśārthamāgatam ।
vavarṣa sāyakaiḥ śastrairastraiḥ śaktiparaśvadhaiḥ ।।49।।
devīṃ te chādayāmāsurvṛṣṭyā śaravipūlayā ।
devyājñayā tadā siṃho garjanāṃ pracakāra ha ।।1.166.50 ।।
garjanāphenabindubhyaḥ siṃhāścānye sahasraśaḥ ।
utpannāḥ kesarasaṭāḥ nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhāstadā ।।5 1 ।।
sabalā yauvanopetā vyomoḍḍayanaśaktayaḥ ।
nipeturdhūmranetrasya sainye ṣaṣṭisahasrake ।।52 ।।
kāँścitkaraprahāraiśca kāँściddaṃṣṭrābhirityatha ।
lāṃgulaiśca nakhaiḥ kāँścidākramairjaghnurāsurān ।।।53 ।।
keṣāṃcitpāṭayāmāsurudarāṇi śirāṃsi ca ।
rudhiraṃ ca papusteṣāṃ jagdhurāntrāṇi bhūriśaḥ ।।54।।
sainyaṃ tairnāśitaṃ sarvaṃ raktā bhūmirvyarājata ।
śrutvā cukopa śuṃbhaḥ saḥ kopaprasphuritā'dharaḥ ।।।।55।।।
prāha caṇḍaṃ tathā muṇḍaṃ gacchataṃ śīghrameva yat ।
keśeṣvākṛṣya baddhvā ca sā samānīyatāṃ mṛgī ।।56।।
yadi vaḥ saṃśayaḥ prāṇe hanyatāṃ sā mṛḍamṛgī ।
hanyantāṃ kesariṇaśca sūcanāṃ kurutaṃ ca mām ।।57 ।।
daityāścaṇḍādayastvevamājñaptāḥ samudāyudhāḥ ।
caturaṃgabalopetā yayurvindhyācalīṃ prati । ।58 ।।
dūrātprāhuśca taṃ devi! samāgaccha tvarāṃ kuru ।
ehyehi śubhabhartāraṃ śuṃbhamicchasva kauśiki! । । 59 । ।
na ced balāddhi neṣyāmaḥ keśākarṣaṇavihvalām ।
tāvatkopaṃ cakārograṃ kauśikī tānarīnprati ।। 1.166.60 ।।
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ cakre caṇḍamuṇḍau vilokya ca ।
atikrodhaplutā jātā karālavadanā tadā ।।6 1 । ।
kṛṣṇakālanivāsādhibhrukuṭyā krodhamiśrayā ।
mahākālī samudbhūtā yoginī śastradhāriṇī ।। 62 । ।
karavāladhṛtahastā khaṭvāṃgakaraśobhanā!
asipāśāṃkuśagadāghaṇṭāmudgarabhūṣitā ।। 63 ।।
siṃhacarmaparidhānā muṇḍamālāvibhūṣitā ।
sphāranetrā lalajjihvā bahirdaṃṣṭrā guhāmukhā ।। 64 । ।
saśastrā sā mahākālī nijaghāna surāriṇaḥ ।
kāँścit khaḍgena ciccheda khaṭvāṃgenā'parāsurān ।। 65 ।।
nyaṣūdayadraṇe'śvāँśca gajān rathagadānavān ।
parvataprāyarūpaṃ sā dadhārātha raṇāgatān । । 66 । ।
uṣṭrāँśca kuṃjarān sāśvarathān pattīṃśca kauśikī ।
mahākālī svavadane kṣiptvā carvayate balam । । 67 । ।
kāँścijjagrāha muṇḍeṣu kāँścitkaṭyāṃ ca pādayoḥ ।
prāṇāt viyojayāmāsa sainyayoddhṝn samantataḥ । ।68 । ।
ruruḥ sainyātpradudrāva vindhyācalaguhāँ prati ।
anududrāva taṃ kālī dharṣaṇārthaṃ mahāsuram ।। 69 ।।
devī mūrdhnyājaghānāti khaṭvāṃgena mahābalāt ।
mastakaṃ kūrcitaṃ tasya mṛtiṃ jagāma tatkṣaṇāt । ।1.166.7 0 ।।
kālī rurośarīrasya kośamutkṛtya mūrdhajān ।
nijān babandha sā devī śuśubhe cāti kiṃśukā । । 71 ।।
ekāṃ jaṭā pṛthakkṛtyotpāṭya kālyakṣipadbhuvi ।
sā tadā kanyakā jātā kṛṣṇā śuklā'rdhavarṣmaṇā । ।72 ।।
kālī prāha ca tāṃ kanyāṃ caṇḍamuṇḍāvihā''naya ।
svayaṃ tau mārayiṣyāmi sā'bhyadravata tāvubhau ।।73 ।।
caṇḍamuṇḍāvapi bhayāt dudruvatuśca dakṣiṇām ।
caṇḍamārī samāruhya rāsabhaṃ bahuveginam । । 74।।
yato gatau tu tau daityau tatraivānuyayau ruṣā ।
mārge dadarśa mahiṣaṃ pauṃḍrābhidhaṃ yamasya sā । ।75 ।।
tasyotpāṭya viṣāṇaṃ tu dānavānanvagājjavāt ।
caṇḍamuṇḍau tadā bhūmiṃ tyaktvā gaganamāśritau ।। 76।।
karkoṭakastadā nāgo gacchan devīdṛśiṃ gataḥ ।
garutmāँśca tathā dṛṣṭaḥ picchānyādāya tasya sā ।। 77।।
karkoṭakaṃ tathā nītvā vegenā'bhyapatacca tau ।
dharṣitau mardito baddhau karkoṭakātmarajjubhiḥ ।।78 ।।
ānītau sannidhau kālyāstasyai nyavedayacca tau ।
caṇḍamuṇḍau tadā devyā viśiraskau kṛtāvubhau । ।79 ।।
rurucarmaguṇe tatrā'surāṇāṃ mastakāni tu ।
tārkṣyapatrāṇi citrāṇi grathitāni hi kṛṣṇayā ।।1.166.8 0 ।।
kṛtvā srajamanopamyāṃ caṇḍikāyai nyavedayat ।
rurucarmakṛtāṃ cātha ghargharīṃ tāṃ nyavedayat ।।8 1 ।।
anyāṃ srajaṃ ca tārkṣyasya patrāṇāṃ viracayya ca ।
kālī dadhe svaśirasi dhammile'tha tutoṣa ca ।।82।
dānavānāṃ ca rudhiraṃ papau cā''tṛpti puṣkalam ।
caṇḍamuṇḍau mṛtau devyā śekharau śirasaḥ kṛtau ।।8 3 ।।
śekharau caṇḍamuṇḍāderyasmācchirasi saṃdhṛtau ।
tasmāttadgaṇayogātsā cāmuṇḍākhyā'bhavat tataḥ ।।84 ।।
cāmuṇḍā ca tathā kālī kauśikī caiti tāstadā ।
tisro militvā daityānāṃ cakrurnikandanaṃ bahu । ।85।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kailāse devakṛtapārvatīstutiḥ pārvatīdehotpannā kauśikī vindhyācalīṃ gatā, tatra śuṃbhapreṣitasugrīvadūtāgamanam, dhūmrākṣanāśaḥ, kālīprādurbhāvaḥ, caṇḍamuṇḍādināśanimittakacāmuṇḍākhyetyādikathananāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 166 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 166 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 167
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 168 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tato lakṣmi! svayaṃ śuṃbho yoddhakāmo hyavapasthitaḥ ।
raktabījaṃ prāha daityaṃ mārayaitāḥ kharīsamāḥ ।। 1 ।।
raktabījastadā triṃśatkoṭisainyasabhājitaḥ ।
kātyāyanyā ca kauśikyā kālyā cāmuṇḍayā tathā ।। 2 ।।
yoddhuṃ samāgato vīro raktabījo mahāsuraḥ ।
yuddhavāditraśabdāśca dikṣu vyāptāstadā'bhavan ।। 3 ।।
tadā catasrastā devyo mahānādān pracakrire ।
tāsāṃ tu mukhabhāgebhyo brahmāṇyaḥ koṭiśo'bhavan ।। 4 ।।
māheśvaryaśca trinetrāstriśūlinyastathā'bhavan ।
mahā'hivalayā raudrāḥ kuṇḍalinyastathā'bhavan ।। 5 ।।
barhipatrayutāstatra kaumāryaḥ koṭiśo'bhavan ।
mayūravāhanāstatra śaktayaḥ koṭiśo'bhavan ।। 6 ।।
bāhubhyāṃ garuḍārūḍhā vaiṣṇavyaḥ koṭiśo'bhavan ।
vārāhyaḥ pṛṣṭhato jātāḥ śeṣayānā hi koṭiśaḥ ।। 7 ।।
nakhinyo nārasiṃhyastu hṛdo jātā hi koṭiśaḥ ।
etāsāṃ tu mahānādā brahmāṇḍadhvaṃsakārakāḥ ।। 8 ।।
samabhavaँśca tān śrutvā tvājagāma hi śaṃkaraḥ ।
śivā'pi saha cāyātā dṛṣṭo daityakṛtodyamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
śivā prāha tadā śaṃbhuṃ gaccha daityena śaṃkara ।
brūhi śuṃbhaṃ niśuṃbhaṃ ca yadi jīvitumicchathaḥ ।। 1.167.10 ।।
tadgacchataṃ svakānnītvā saptamaṃ hi rasātalam ।
vāsavo labhatāṃ svargaṃ devāḥ santu gatavyathāḥ ।। 11 ।।
devī tadā tu nāmnā'taḥ śivadūtītyajāyata ।
te ca dūtavacaḥ śrutvā sarve garvasamanvitāḥ ।। 12 ।।
yatra kātyāyanī kālī kauśikī tatra dudruvuḥ ।
aṃkuśaiḥ śaktibhirbāṇaistomaraiśca bhūśuṇḍibhiḥ ।। 13 ।।
paṭṭiśaiḥ parighaiḥ prāsaistriśūlaiśca paraśvadhaiḥ ।
kātyāyanīṃ vavṛṣuste sāpi ciccheda vegataḥ ।। 14।।
samagrāṇi tu śastrāṇi tīkṣṇadhārapatattritrabhiḥ ।
jaghāna ca mahābāṇaiḥ raṇamattānmahāsurān ।। 15 ।।
raṇacaṇḍī tu cāmuṇḍā jaghānā'yutadānavān ।
kātyāyanī mahāmārī triśūlairnijaghāna tān ।। 1 6।।
kauśikī cāpi ca brāhmī kumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā ।
khaṭvāṃgairjalapāśaiśca śaktibhisstanayitnubhiḥ ।। 17।।
nijaghnurvīrakarmasthānayutā'yutadānavān ।
caṇḍī vajraiśca vārāhī tuṇḍaiścakrairjaghāna tān । । 18 ।।
daṃṣṭrānakhairnārasiṃhī śivadūtī tu vahninā ।
karavālaistathā kālī jaghānā''surasainikān ।। 19 ।।
evaṃ devīkulaistatra hanyamānāśca dānavāḥ ।
pātyamānāścāsurāste petuḥ prāṇān vihāya vai ।। 1.167.20 ।।
anye bhayādraktabījaṃ jagmurvai śaraṇaṃ tadā ।
raktabījastadopetya varāstrairmātṛmaṇḍalam ।। 21 ।।
jaghāna bahudhā kopād viveśa madhyabhūmikām ।
mātaraśca tadā sarvā nijaghnustīkṣṇahetibhiḥ ।। 22।।
raktabījasya raktasya yāvanto bindavo bhuvi ।
patanti samajāyante tāvanto raktabījakāḥ ।। 23 ।।
raktabījaśarīrādvai tadā sainyāni cā'bhavan ।
kātyāyanī tadā kālīṃ prāha khādaya dānavam ।। 24।।
raktabījaṃ yena sainyotpattiḥ ruddhā bhaved drutam ।
mahākālī mukhe drāk taṃ prākṣipad raktabījakam ।। 25।।
carmamuṇḍā tadā śailasamā bhūtvā darīmukhe ।
raktabījajasainyāni prākṣipat pracakhād ca । । 296 ।।
tadā tu dānavāścānye hā bhrātastāta cukruśuḥ ।
chinnā'rdhadehā'vayavā niśuṃbhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।। 27।।
niśuṃbhaḥ sahasā khaḍgamādāya hantumicchati ।
kintu devī svarūpe sa mohitaḥ staṃbhita kṣaṇam ।। 28 ।।
devī prāha niśuṃbha tvaṃ mohena jetumicchasi ।
gaccha jitā tvayā daitya mugdho māṃ na vijeṣyasi । । 29 ।।
prāha daityastadā devi! sukumāraśarīriṇī ।
kathaṃ mayā nihantavyā tasmāt hanmi na sundarīm । । 1.167.30 ।।
śastrapātaṃ vinā yuddhe jetuṃ śaknomi naiva ca ।
śastrapāte tu te nāśo bhavet kāryaṃ na me bhavet ।। 31 ।।
iti kiṃkartavyatayā mūḍhatvaṃ tu mayā dhṛtam ।
śastrapāte na me lābhaḥ śastrā'pātepi naiva ca ।। 32 ।।
tasmātte maraṇe ko'yaṃ lābho bhavati sundari! ।
nivartaya matiṃ yuddhād bhāryā me bhava bhogadā । । 33 ।।
śrutvā devī niśuṃbhaṃ tu vihasya prāha dānavam ।
nā'jitā'haṃ raṇe vīra bhāryā bhavāmi kasyacit । । 34 ।।
yadi vā maraṇaṃ te syād yadvā me maraṇaṃ bhavet ।
yuddhātpalāyanaṃ cāpi maraṇādatiricyate । । 35 । ।
tatrāpi nārīgarvād yo naro yuddhānnivartate ।
sa nārībhirmūlyahīno gaṇyate tu napuṃsakaḥ । । 3 6।।
nārīṃ yuddhena jetuṃ vai samīhante narādhamāḥ ।
na yuddhajayyāḥ nāryaḥ syuḥ patnyaḥ kvāpi śrutaṃ na tat ।। 37 ।।
yā nārī yasya vai patnīṃ bhavituṃ naiva cecchati ।
saiva yuddhaṃ tena puṃsā samicchati vināśakṛt । । 38 । ।
yuddhe tvekasya nāśo'sti nā'balā hastagā bhavet ।
prasahya hastagā syāccet naraṃ nāśayati dhruvam । । 39 ।।
nā'syā mitraṃ cā'manaḥstho manaḥsthaḥ śatrureva na ।
me manaḥstho yathā syāstvaṃ viśā'talaṃ drutaṃ kuru । । 1.167.40 । ।
bhavānicchati bhāryāṃ māṃ tato māṃ jaya saṃyuge ।
napuṃsakasya mugdhasya bhāryā naiva bhavāmyaham ।। 41 । ।
ityukto roṣatāmrākṣaḥ khaḍgamudbhrāmya dānavaḥ ।
pracikṣepa mahāvegāt sā cicchedā'sinā tu tat । । 42 । ।
gadāṃ cikṣepa daityaśca yāvat tāvattu kālikā ।
kṣurapreṇa karau tasya cicchedāṃsata eva yat ।। 43 ।।
aśākhastambavaddaityaḥ śirasā'pi pṛthakkṛtaḥ ।
niśuṃbhanāśe caṇḍādyāścakruḥ kilakilādhvanim ।।44।।
jaya devi surāḥ procurmumucuḥ puṣpavarṣaṇam ।
vāditrāṇāṃ ninādaśca vijayakhyāpako'bhavat ।।45।।
athā'paśakunānyasya bhrātuḥ śuṃbhasya cā'bhavan ।
śivā praviśya śivire rauti sā kusvaraṃ niśi ।।46 ।।
tiṣṭhanti śibire kākā divārātraṃ virāviṇaḥ ।
sarpāḥ sarpanti vāseṣu kṛṣṇā raudrā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।।47।।
kākā gṛdhrā bakā bhrāntā bhramanti śibiropari ।
jātāśca vimukhā garbhāḥ strīṣu goṣu mṛgīṣu ca ।।48।।
ghṛtaṃ dugdheṣu naivāsti tile tailaṃ na vidyate ।
janāḥ svaśibire tatra yodhayanti parasparam ।।49 ।।
kṛṣṇavarṇā vivadanta dīrghakeśā'ndhalocanā ।
ajñātā rudatī yāti dānaveśasthalaṃ prati ।।1.167.5 0 ।।
kopayuktastadā kaścittapasvī bhasmaguṇṭhitaḥ ।
maunī nagno yatiḥ kaścit। śibire dṛśyate bhraman ।।5 1 ।।
ḍamarūṃ vādayitvā hūṃkāraṃ nagnaḥ karoti ca ।
akālā'bbhraṃ jalaṃ muñcad vidyuddhoṣaṃ karoti ca ।।5 2।।
karakāḥ patitā meghādgarjanā jāyate muhuḥ ।
samajāyata bhūkampo digdāhaścā'pyajāyata ।।5 3 ।।
ūrdhvāsyāḥ śvagaṇā rātrau rudanti pramukhe sthitāḥ ।
divā ghūkāḥ śabdayanti diviṃ ketūdayo'bhavat ।।54।।
ādityamaṇḍalaṃ tatra sacakraṃ dṛśyate vṛtam ।
kabandhā vyomni dṛśyante candramā na prakāśate ।।2 5 ।।
nakṣatrāṇi divā svarge dṛśyante dānavaistadā ।
dānavīṣu tadā garbhā dṛśyante bhūtajātayaḥ ।।5 6 ।।
hreṣante'śvāḥ sadbhayāśca kariṇaḥ pṛṣṭhapātinaḥ ।
mantriṇo nirmanaskāśca dṛśyante śibire tadā । । ।57 । ।
agnirjvalati cullyāṃ na vātaścaṇḍaḥ pravāti ca ।
dhvajā jvalanti sainyeṣu nabho bhavati dhūsaram । ।58 । ।
śuṃbhasya hṛdyaṃ svapne sakampaṃ samajāyata ।
kabandhānmastakaṃ svasya pṛthak dṛṣṭaṃ raṇāṃgaṇe ।।59 । ।
meṣayāne niṣadyā'yaṃ diśaṃ yāti ca dakṣiṇām ।
nagnā ca dānavī kācit karoti tailamardanam । । 1.167.60 ।।
raktāmbaraṃ dhṛtavatyāśleṣṭuṃ prayatate ca sā ।
madyaṃ pāne dadātyeva dadāti cūmbanaṃ tathā । । 61 । ।
muṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścād rauti yāti ca dakṣiṇām ।
śibiraṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vyāghraiścaiva vināśitam ।। 62 ।।
nagnābhiḥ kūrcitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ marditaṃ svasya varṣma yat ।
svasya raktasya pānaṃ ca śuṃbhenā''svāditaṃ tathā ।।63।।
śuṃbhapatnyā citāyāṃ svadehaḥ kṣipto vilokitaḥ ।
ityevaṃ śuṃbhadaityasya svapne jāgrati sarvathā ।।64।।
dṛśyante nāśacihnāni tena glānimagāt sa hi ।
tāvanniśuṃbhamaraṇaṃ śrutavān sainyamardanam ।।65।।
ruroda bahudhā tatra mumoha ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
athāpi tāmasādbhāvādrāgācca kāmamūlakāt ।।66।।
punaḥ smṛtiṃ samālebhe vairaniryātanāya ca ।
mahāgajaṃ samāruhya prāsapāṇiḥ samabhyagāt ।।67।।
yāvadabhyāgataḥ krodhādraṇe hantuṃ ca kauśikīm ।
raṇabheryo ḍiṇḍimāni hyavādyanta muhurmuhuḥ ।।68।।
sainyāni caturaśītiḥ kambūnāṃ niryayustataḥ ।
asurāṇāṃ ca paṃcāśatkulāni niryayustadā ।।69।।
śataṃ kulāni dhūmrāṇāṃ niryayuśca tadā'pare ।
kālakānāṃ daurhṛtānāṃ mauryāṇāṃ kulakoṭayaḥ ।।1.167.70।।
karisthaṃ śuṃbhamālokyā''gataṃ vai raṇamaṇḍale ।
aṣṭabhujaṃ mahāhetiṃ devā śaṃkhamavādayat ।।71।।
dhanuṣṭaṃkārayāmāsa vādayāmāsa ghaṇṭakam ।
pūrayāmāsa kakubho raṇaśabdaistadā'mbikā ।।72।।
siṃhastu garjanāṃ cakre tyājitebhamahāmadām ।
siṃhāḥ sahasraśastatra garjanābhirdivastalam ।।73।।
pūrayāmāsuratyugrapratidhvaninināditam ।
devyaḥ sahasraśastatra samājagmuḥ raṇāṃgaṇe ।।74।।
mahādevyājñayā sarvā rājñyo'pi raṇacaṇḍikāḥ ।
yā devyo brahmaṇo dāsyo yāścendrabaladāsikāḥ ।।76।।
varuṇasya tathā dāsyo yamadāsyaśca koṭiśaḥ ।
kuberadāsadāsyaśca īśānadāsadāsikāḥ ।।76।।
agnidāsyo'yutā'yutā nairṛtadāsikāstathā ।
vāyośca dāsikākoṭirdikpālānāṃ ca dāsikāḥ ।।77।।
lokapālasamastāgryadāsyaḥ sainyakṛtaśramāḥ ।
yuddhaśastrāstrakuśalā arbudā'rbudakoṭayaḥ ।।78।।
anantaśastrayānādidivyavāhanaśobhanāḥ ।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu ratnabhūtāśca suśrutāḥ ।।79।।
yuddhasaṃgrāmavedinyaḥ sainyanāryaḥ samāgatāḥ ।
asurāṇāṃ samastānāṃ nāśo'vaśyamapekṣyate ।।1.167.80।।
anyathā surakoṭīnāṃ sukhaṃ kvāpi na saṃbhavet ।
śirasāṃ vinipātena paṇena sukhamāpyate ।।8 1 ।।
sakavacaśirastrāṇāḥ sainyaveśasuśobhanāḥ ।
sayauvanapūrabalā abalā balavartanāḥ ।।82।।
susajjasarvayuddhāṃgā raṇāgaṇamupasthitāḥ ।
sarvābhyaḥ pāyitaṃ mahendreṇā'mṛtaṃ raṇāṃgaṇe ।।83।।
sandhinī jīvanī caiva viśalyakaraṇī tathā ।
virāmadāyinī mūrchāhāriṇī raktarodhinī ।।84।।
vividhauṣadhayo'śvinīkumāreṇāhṛtāstadā ।
dvedhā bhinnaśarīrāṇāṃ khaṇḍānāṃ sandhikārakāḥ ।।85।।
drāgeva prāṇasañcārā rasāstatrā''hṛtāstadā ।
amṛtāni bhojanāni pānānyamṛtakāni ca ।।86।।
rakṣitāstatra saṃgrāme śibireṣu surādibhiḥ ।
nārīsainyaprarakṣārthaṃ devaiḥ sampāditaṃ navam ।।87।।
jaye yuddhe dhruvaṃ syācca syānna romṇo'pi nāśanam ।
devīpakṣasya kasyāpi mṛtiḥ kṣatirna vai bhavet ।।88।।
ityevaṃ sañcitaṃ sarvaṃ kuśalaiḥ kāryavedibhiḥ ।
śuṃbhenāpi yathā rakṣā bhavet klṛptaṃ tadantike ।।89।।
atha yuddhasamāraṃbhasūcakaḥ sumahān dhvaniḥ ।
raṇaśṛṃgasya bheryāśca vyomamārge kṛtosuraiḥ ।।1.167.90।।
tato yuddhamatīvāsī''d devyāḥ śuṃbhasya sainyayoḥ ।
devyastadā'rbudārbudasaṃkhyākā jaghnurāsurān ।।91 ।।
koṭyarbudābjā asurā jaghnurdevīmayaṃ vanam ।
bheryaścā'surakoṭīnāmūcuḥ śṛṇvantu bho'surāḥ ।।92।।
daityadānavavaṃśānāṃ nāśārthaṃ cā'balājanaḥ ।
samāgato'sti saṃgrāme yuddhaṃ kuruta jīvahṛt ।।93।।
mā vai pṛṣṭhaṃ nirīkṣantāṃ mā kurvantu dyāṃ raṇe ।
nārīyamiti matvā tāṃ mā tyajantu raṇāṃgaṇe ।।94।।
adya bhūrāsurī syādvā syādvā devamayī dhruvam ।
dvayorekasamastitvaṃ jāyatāṃ nobhapakṣakam ।।95 ।।
surā jīvantu yadvā cā'surā jīvantu kevalam ।
mā surā'suramiśraṃ vai sarjanaṃ ceṣyate'dhunā ।।96।।
vidhurāḥ santu devā vā dānavyo vidhavāśca vā ।
yadbhavatu bhavatyeva mā kuruta palāyanam ।।97।।
mārayantu nāśayantu ghātayantu ca caṇḍikā ।
dharṣayantu mardayantu cūrṇayantu ca caṃcalāḥ ।।98।।
iti dānavabheryaśca bodhayanti raṇāṃgaṇe ।
śaṃkhastadā tu devīnāṃ ghoṣayanti raṇāṃgaṇe ।।9 9 ।।
bhakṣayantu jakṣayantu dhvaṃsayantu ca dānavān ।
dārayantu pārayantu mārayantu ca mohakān ।। 1.167.100 ।।
asurāḥ sarvathā devān trāsayanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
trāsayantu hrāsayantu grāsayantu mamāgrataḥ ।। 10 1।।
bhavatīnāṃ sahāyārthaṃ devāḥ sarve upasthitāḥ ।
mā paścapādaṃ kurvantu naśyantu nāśayantu ca ।। 1 02।।
ityevaṃ tu tadā jātā bodhadā vyomagarjanāḥ ।
bherīśaṃkhakṛtāḥ śabdāḥ śrūyante kālanoditāḥ ।। 1 03।।
yuddhe mṛtānāṃ svargaṃ ca jīvitānāṃ kṣitīśatā ।
nivṛttānāṃ na vai kiñcittasmāt martavyamatra hi ।। 104।।
ityevaṃ raṇaśṛṃgāṇi bodhayanti bhaṭān bhaṭoḥ ।
tāvatpravartitā ghātāḥ śastrāṇāṃ pātanāni ca ।। 1 05।।
niśitaiśca śarairbāṇairnārācairjaghnuragrimān ।
kṣuraprairardhacandraiśca śūlairjaghnuḥ parasparam ।। 1 06।।
kātyāyanyā ca kauśikyā kālyā cāmuṇḍayā tathā ।
bāṇairācchāditaṃ sainyaṃ dānavānāṃ nabhastale ।। 107।।
kambukaiḥ kālakairdhaumraiḥ kālakeyaiśca daurhṛtaiḥ!
bāṇairācchāditaṃ sainyaṃ devīnāṃ ca nabhastale ।। 1 08।।
cicchidurbāṇasaṃghātān bāṇairjaghnustathā'paraiḥ ।
akṣayyasāyakāstatra tuṇīrāḥ kṣīṇatāṃ yayuḥ ।। 1 09।।
vinaṣṭā jvalitā bhagnāḥ khaṇḍitāḥ sāyakā yadā ।
dhanuṣo daityadevīnāṃ babhaṃjuḥ śūlaghātanaiḥ ।। 1.167.110 ।।
hatāśca lakṣaśo daityāḥ pothayanti bhuvastale ।
chinnapādo chinnahastāśchinnakaṃdharavakṣasaḥ ।। 111 ।।
devyaśca lakṣaśastatra mūrchayanti raṇāṃgaṇe ।
vāhanāni vinaṣṭāni bhagnā mṛtā gajādayaḥ ।। 11 2।।
siṃhāśca mahiṣāstatra mayūroṣṭrā mṛtā raṇe ।
devairdaityaiḥ prāṇarasairmantraiśca jīvitāḥ punaḥ ।। 11 3।।
atha śastraiśca bhallaiśca triśūlaiśca bhūśuṇḍibhiḥ ।
parīghaiśca gadābhiśca prāsaiśca tomaraistathā ।। 1 14।।
khaḍgaiśca śaktibhistīkṣṇakaravālaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ ।
yuddhaṃ cānyonyamabhavannikandanakaraṃ tadā ।। 1 15।।
chidyante dehatastatra bhidyante vakṣasastathā ।
kaṭitaśca viyujyante khaṇḍyante hastatastathā ।। 1 16।।
mriyante kaṇṭhatastatra pātyante śakthitastathā ।
ākṛṣyākṛṣya hanyante śliṣṭvā''śliṣyā'rdayanti ca ।। 1 17।।
pādaṃ pādaṃ samagṛhya pāṭayanti dvidhā raṇe ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt ko'yaṃ keyaṃ na budhyate ।। 1 18।।
yadago cāgataṃ varṣma dvedhā bhavati tatkṣaṇe ।
ityevamandhavego vai saṃgrāmo mūrchanābharaḥ ।। 1 19।।
jātaḥ koṭyabjakoṭyaśca naṣṭāḥ sainyabhaṭāstadā ।
pṛthivī raktavarṇāḍhyā devīdaityaśavānvitā ।। 1.167.120।।
raktanadīśatairvyāptā dehāraṇyā''gatisṛtiḥ ।
śailābhadantidehāḍhyā kharoṣṭrādiśavānvitā ।। 12 1।।
mṛtāsaṃkhyaśavavyāptā prāleyakāladṛśyadā ।
ye patitāścārdhahatāḥ pānaṃ pānaṃ vadanti ca ।। 122।
kabandhāstatra nirvastrāścotthāyotthāya bhūtale ।
vidravanti saśastrāśca punaḥ patanti bhūtale ।। 123।।
na kaścit kasyacittatra tadā sāhāyyado'bhavat ।
komalāḥ koṭiśo devyo daityāśca navayauvanāḥ ।। 124।।
saṃgrāme svarṇarūpāste mṛtā dīvyanti candravat ।
raṇe vipothitā naṣṭā mahākālakṛtaṃ hi tat ।। 125।।
darśakānāṃ hṛdayānāṃ hṛtsu trāso'pyabhūnmahān ।
tato vai brahmaṇā tatra vibhāvaryai niveditam ।। 126।।
nidrāstraṃ yojaya tvaṃ ca kāle tad yujyate priye ।
vibhāvaryā tadā nidrāmantrādhikṛtadaivatam ।। 127।।
astraṃ śarāgre saṃyujya vimuktaṃ sainyayostadā ।
devīdānavasainyāni nidrābhibhavavanti ca ।। 128।।
jātānyeva suṣuptau ca viśrāmyanti tu sarvathā ।
atha daityaistadā devīsainyopari pravarṣaṇam ।। 129।।
amṛtasya kṛtaṃ caivauṣadhīnāṃ jīvadāyinām ।
devyaḥ siṃhā vāhanāni cetanāni ca yāni vai ।। 1.167.13 0।।
tāni sarvāṇyamṛtasya vṛṣṭyā saṃjīvitāni hi ।
daityāścāpi tadā mantrairdaityān prājīvayaँstadā ।। 13 1।।
saṃjīvanyā ca sandhinyā viśalyayā virāmayā ।
mūrchānāśikayā raktarodhinyā prāṇadaiḥ rasaiḥ ।। 132।।
yathā cikitsitaṃ sainyaṃ jīvitaṃ nīrujīkṛtam ।
sarvaṃ svasthaṃ tadā jātaṃ svāpāt yathotthitaṃ bhavet ।। 133।।
tathā devīmahāsainyaṃ punaḥ sajjaṃ babhūva ha ।
daityānāmapi tādṛgvai punaḥ sajjaṃ babhūva ha ।। 1 34।।
brahmaṇā ca tadā''jñaptā svake sainye vibhāvarī ।
nidrāstraṃ cā''hṛtavatī sukhaṃ sainyobhaye'bhavat ।। 135।।
brahmā prāha tadā śaṃbhuṃ dānavānāṃ vināśanam ।
astraireva prakartavyaṃ yuddhyantāṃ caṇḍikādikāḥ ।। 1 36।।
śastraṃ phutkṛtya roṣeṇa śatrūn dhyātvā prayojayet ।
kālakavalamantro'yaṃ devībhyo dīyatāṃ tvayā ।। 137।।
o mṛtermṛtyormahāmṛtyo mṛtyā saha sthiro bhava ।
o mṛtimṛtyo mahāmṛtyau svamṛtyā santiro bhava ।। 138।।
iti phutkārapūrvaṃ vai śastraṃ śarādikaṃ ca yat ।
saṃprakṣipecchatrudehe mṛtvā punarna jīvati ।। 139।।
bahubhirauṣadhibhiśca mantraiścikitsanairapi ।
na punarjīvati mṛtyormahākālaprabhāvataḥ ।। 1.167.140।।
mahākālākhyarudreṇa brahmaṇaścājñayā tadā ।
upadiṣṭaśca devībhyaḥ kālakavalamantrakaḥ ।। 141।।
kṣaṇamātreṇa siddho'yaṃ mahākālapratāpataḥ ।
brahmaṇo vāṃchayā caiva mūrtimāँstatra saṃsthitaḥ ।। 142।।
vikarālaḥ kālakālaḥ saśastrā'surabhakṣakaḥ ।
jīvanāni bhakṣayansa dṛṣṭo devībhirutthitaḥ ।। 143।।
kṣaṇādanantarūpaścā'bhavaddevīṣu tatkṣaṇe ।
susthitaścā'bhavattāsāṃ jihvāsu kāryasammukhaḥ ।। 144।।
daityairetanna vijñātaṃ brahmarudraviceṣṭitam ।
utthitāḥ svā'mṛtatvaṃ sammanvānā yuddhamācaran ।। 145।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne raktabījadaityayuddhe'nantadevīraktabījotpattiḥ, mūlaraktabījanāśo niśuṃbhanāśaḥ śuṃbhā'paśakunāni, dānavasamārohaḥ, caturdaśabhuvanīyadevīsainyāgamaḥ, saṃjīvanyādyupasthitiḥ, savāditraśastrāditumulayuddhakṛnmahāvināśe vibhāvarīmuktanidrāstraṃ sainyajīvanaṃ devīnāṃ
kālakavalamantraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 167।।

adhyāyaḥ 168
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 169 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi nirbhīkaṃ maraṇe punaḥ ।
dvayośca sainyayoryuddhaṃ prāvartatā'punarbhavam ।। 1 ।।
brahmā jānāti śaṃbhuśca devyo jānanti kālakṛt ।
vināśo daityakoṭīnāṃ samupasthita eva yat ।। 2 ।।
śuṃbhājñayātha kambūnāṃ caturaśītikoṭayaḥ ।
yuyudhire'straśastraiśca parvatairvanabhūruhaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
śilāvarṣairagnivarṣaiḥ śarairyuyudhire'surāḥ ।
devyo vārāhya evaitān pratiyuddhaṃ tadā vyadhuḥ ।। 4 ।।
astraiḥ śastraiḥ śilāvarṣaiḥ parvatairdantabhūruhaiḥ ।
agnivarṣaiḥ śaraiḥ kālakavalamantrayojitaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
nārasiṃhstathā tāsāṃ sāhāyye yuyudhustadā ।
nakhairdaṃṣṭrābhirugrābhiḥ pucchairhastaiḥ plavaistathā ।। 6 ।।
mantritairmukhaphenaiśca śastrairyuyudhire muhuḥ ।
śastrā'straprastaravukṣaśaraphenādilakṣitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
kālamantrahatā daityā nottiṣṭhanti mṛtāḥ punaḥ ।
athā'surāṇāṃ paṃcāśatkulakoṭyo yudhi sthitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
dikpālinyastathendrāṇyaścārbudārbudakoṭayaḥ ।
yodhayanti sma kālākhyamantrādhiṣṭhitahetibhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
naṣṭā mṛtā āsurāste nottiṣṭhanti tadāhave ।
athāgatāśca dhaumrāṇāṃ śatābjakulakoṭayaḥ ।। 1.168.10 ।।
yuddhyanti sma mahāmārīdevībhiścaṇḍikādibhiḥ ।
kālamantrābhisaṃsṛṣṭahetibhirye mṛtiṃ gatāḥ ।। 1 1।।
punaste na śvasantyeva mṛtāste sarvathā gatāḥ ।
kālakeyāḥ kālakāśca daityā koṭikulā'rbudāḥ ।। 12।।
protthitāḥ sabalāstatra devīnāśanahetave ।
kuṇḍalinyastriśūlinyaḥ koṭyo yuyudhire ca taiḥ ।। 13 ।।
kālamantrā'bhibhūtāste jāgrati prāṇato na hi ।
mauryāśca daurhratāścaiva saṃgrāmaṃ cakrire'tigāḥ ।। 14।।
kulakoṭyastadā teṣāṃ lakṣasiṃhairvināśitāḥ ।
utthitāścauṣadhaiste vai kumārībhiḥ punarhatāḥ ।। 15।।
kālakavalamantrāktaśastranaṣṭāḥ śvasanti na ।
athānye śaṃbarā daityā sāmudrā pārvatāstathā ।। 16।।
pātālā bhūstarāścānye nāgā vārkṣā jarāvṛtāḥ ।
devīrūpāṇi vīkṣyaiva mumuhuścakrire raṇam ।। 17।।
śaktinyaḥ śivadūtinyo jaghnurmantritahetibhiḥ ।
mṛtāḥ punarna vāyānti gatāścātyantajīvanāt ।। 18।।
koṭyarbudānyasurāṇāṃ daityānāṃ kharvakoṭayaḥ ।
padmāni dānavānāṃ ca śaṃkavaśca prakīrṇakāḥ ।। 19।।
hatā gatā mṛtā naṣṭā nāmarūpābhivañcitāḥ ।
raktaḥ samudrasteṣāṃ cā'sraksaridbhiḥ samudgataḥ ।।1.168.20 ।।
nādyāpi śuṣkatāṃ yāti vivarṇo na vibhāti ca ।
vyomni caitanmahāyuddhaṃ paścimottaradigbhavam ।।21 ।।
khyāpayiṣyati raktābdhibhūśca raktapramedinī ।
atha śuṃbhāsuraḥ śaile vindhyādrau vyomavardhite ।।।22।।
rāhuketuspṛśiśṛṃge tiṣṭhan paśyati mardanam ।
hatasainyairmahāpṛthvī vyāptā'bhūt sarvatodiśi ।।23 ।।
naitādṛśaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ punaryuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
devīnāṃ dānavānāṃ ca vyomamārgātiyodhinām ।।।24।।
sa ca śuṃbho vindhyaśṛṃge lakṣayojanadṛṣṭimān ।
kailāsaṃ badrikāśraṃ ca dagdhumaicchat tadastrataḥ ।।25।।
vindhyaśṛṃgādvaidyutāstraṃ kṣiptaṃ haraharopari ।
yasmācca koṭiśo jātāścāgnayaḥ stanayitnavaḥ ।। 26 ।।
meruṃ ca mandaraṃ caiva didhakṣanto bhuvaṃ gatāḥ ।
kailāsaṃ badrikādhāma prājvalan vyomamārgataḥ ।। 27।।
tadā tatra maheśānyā muktaṃ tāmrāstramātalam ।
vidyutastatsamākṛṣyā'talaṃ lokaṃ samāviśat ।। 28।।।
tadā sainyāni devīnāṃ vindhyottare'ntarīkṣake ।
kṣaṇaṃ virāmaṃ gṛhṇanti teṣvagnyastraṃ prayojitam ।। 29।।
prājvālayad grahāndevānvāyvādhārānpiśācakān ।
dyāvāpṛthvyoḥ rodasī dve dhekṣyatpapāta śāṃbhave ।। 1.168.30 ।।
kailāse ca badaryāṃ cā'nalānprāvartayadbahūn ।
devyā dṛṣṭvā ca vāruṇyā'nalāstradhvaṃsakṛttadā ।। 31 ।।
prahitaṃ śītaśailāstraṃ śītavṛṣṭiśilāmayam ।
himavṛṣṭiḥ śītavṛṣṭistena petuḥ śiloccayāḥ ।। 3 2।।
śāntaṃ cā'gnyastramevāpi himaprastaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।
suvarṇādristadārabhya himādriḥ samabhūnmahān ।। 33 ।।
athaitāsāṃ vināśāya nirodhāstraṃ mumoca saḥ ।
vāyavyā ca tadā devyā śvāsarodhavināśakṛt ।। 34।।
vāyvastraṃ prahitaṃ drākca nirodhāstraṃ nanāśa ha ।
atha rākṣasamantraiśca homaṃ cakāra daityarāṭ ।। 35।।
rākṣasāḥ parvataprāyāḥ samutpannāstu koṭiśaḥ ।
devī sainyopari vyomnaḥ petuḥ śastrāstrapāṇayaḥ ।। 36।।
varṣartāvabhrasaṃghātairivaibhirvyāma saṃstṛtam ।
vanaṃ vṛṣṭibhirevaitad devīnāṃ sainyamarditam ।। 37।।
dṛṣṭvā devyo naiṛtānyaḥ sasṛjurnirṛtāstrakam ।
nairṛtāstata utpannā bhakṣayanti sma rākṣasān ।। 38 ।।
yathā timīn timīṃgilā bhakṣayanti sma tāँstathā ।
atha śuṃbhaḥ sasarjā'nyat pretāstraṃ kṣudhitaṃ bahu ।। 39 ।।
koṭiśaḥ pretasainyāni samutpannāni tatkṣaṇe ।
yāmyā devyaḥ sasṛjuśca yamāstraṃ yamadūtakṛt ।।1.168.40 ।।
vikarālā yamadūtāḥ pretānabhakṣayaँstadā ।
avīcyākhyaṃ sthalaṃ yāmyadūtānāṃ kalpitaṃ tataḥ ।।4 1 ।।
nārakāँśca jvarān śuṃbho janayāmāsa koṭiśaḥ ।
vaiṣṇavyā ca tadā devyā jvarāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।42।।
vaiṣṇavainarikāstāpā hyavīciṃ drāvitā yayuḥ ।
brahmāstraṃ prahitaṃ devīsainyeṣu dānavena yat ।।43 ।।
mahātejāṃsi ghoṣāśca śarā vajrāṇi niryayuḥ ।
mahākālāgnayastasmādutpetuḥ sṛṣṭibhasmakāḥ ।। 44।।
trilokāstrāsitāstebhyo devyo dagdhā vidudruvuḥ ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt tadā devyo vimūrchitāḥ ।।45।।
brahmāṇyā satvaraṃ tatra brāhmāstraṃ pratiyojitam ।
dvayoryuddhaṃ mahāvyomni sūryamārge hyajāyata ।।46।।
cāndryā devyā candrakāntamahāmantreṇa kaumudī ।
mūrchādūrakarī tāsu tadā saṃyojitā'mṛtā ।।47।।
atyuṣṇatākṛtā mūrchā vinaṣṭā'mṛtavṛṣṭibhiḥ ।
tāvadvyomnaḥ samākṛṣṭe brahmāstre dve tu vedhasā ।।48 ।।
śuṃbho riktastadā jātaḥ śastrāstrairhīna eva saḥ ।
tadā kālyā mahākālyā yamadaṇḍābhimantritaḥ ।।49।।
preṣitastadvināśāya śuṃbho māyāṃ cakāra vai ।
naikakoṭigaṇāḥ śuṃbhāḥ prādurbhūvāstamo'ntare ।।1.168.50 ।।
gāḍhāndhakāre māyāyāḥ śuṃbho jagrāha caṇḍikām ।
karavālastadā śuṃbhe caṇḍyā yāvannipātitaḥ ।।51।।
tāvacchuṃbho na caivāsti mithyāśuṃbhastu so'bhavat ।
śastrāghāto vṛthā jātaḥ śuṃbho jagrāha kālikām ।।52।।
kālyā tadā mahākhaḍgo daityamūrdhni nipātitaḥ ।
tadā daityo nacaivāsti khaḍgaghāto vṛthāgataḥ ।।53।।
yāvatsa kauśikī dhṛtvā surūpāṃ ca palāyitaḥ ।
tāvaccāmuṇḍayā mūrdhni khaṭvāṃgena nipātitaḥ ।।54।।
kauśikī dṛśyate tatra śuṃbhaḥ patanna dṛśyate ।
mithyārūpaiḥ sa devīnāṃ dharṣaṇaṃ prakaroti vai ।।।55।
kātyāyanīṃ ca kāmena dharṣaṇāya stane'spṛśat ।
raudryā tīkṣṇaṃ triśūlaṃ tanmūrdhni kaṇṭhe prapātitam ।।।56।।
tāvattatrāpi śuṃbho'yaṃ tirobhūd dūrataḥ sthitaḥ ।
rudrāṇī prāha śarvāṇīṃ śivadūtīṃ vihasya ca ।।57।।
mṛṣārūpo hyajitvā māṃ kātyāyanīṃ stane'spṛśat ।
tasmādadharmanaṣṭo'yaṃ nāśametvacirād dhruvam ।।568।।
evaṃ śāpe pradatte tatsāmarthyaṃ līnatāṃgatam ।
napuṃsaka iva tatra patito dharaṇitale ।।19।।
tāvatkoṭisvarūpā ye mṛṣā yuddhe pravartitāḥ ।
mṛṣā śuṃbhā nipetuste pṛthvyāṃ napuṃsakā iva ।।1.168.6 0 ।।
vicittaṃ mūrchitaṃ śrāntaṃ tavā'smīti ca vādinam ।
pibantaṃ mehayantaṃ cā'śastraṃ yuddhe na ghātayet ।।6 1।।
ato na ghātitaḥ śuṃbho devyā prāpte kṣaṇe'pi ca ।
mithyāśuṃbhāstato līnā līnaṃ māyātamo'pi tat ।।62।।
mūrchitaśca tadā śuṃbho dṛśyate patito bhuvi ।
kātyāyanyā tadā sarvāḥ svasṛṣṭā devya eva tāḥ ।।63।।
svastane līnatāṃ nītā devapatnīrvinā'marīḥ ।
tāvatsaṃjñāmavāpyā'yaṃ śuṃbho jagarja tāṃ prati ।। 64।।
punarmāyāmayīṃ vātavṛṣṭirātriṃ cakāra saḥ ।
kātyāyanīṃ mahādevīṃ pradharṣayitumāyayau । । 65 ।।
saḥ sparśaṃ kṛtavān daityo hṛdaye stanamaṇḍale ।
tāvattaṃ cāpi sā devī talenorasyatāḍayat ।।66 ।।
kruddhaścotpatya saṃgṛhya devīṃ gaganamāśritaḥ ।
hastinaṃ svakamāruhya palāyanaparo'bhavat ।। 67 ।।
tāvaccotplutya gagane devyā keśeṣu saṃdhṛtaḥ ।
unnīya bhrāmayāmāsa cikṣepainaṃ tu sā kṣitau ।। 68 ।।
papātopari sā devī śūlamādāya tatkṣaṇam ।
tadvakṣo dārayāmāsa bhedayāmāsa tadgalam ।। 69 ।।
muhuścikṣepa daityendraḥ karapādau tadā bhuvi ।
pavartaprāyarūpo'bhūt kampayan sakalāṃ mahīm ।।1.168.7 0 ।।
uttānaḥ patitaścorvyāṃ karapādau prasārya ca ।
vikṣipya bahudhā dhūlyāṃ virarāma mamāra ca ।।7 1 ।।
gaganaṃ nirmalaṃ jātaṃ vātavṛṣṭiḥ śamaṃ yayau ।
devā devyastadā kātyāyanīṃ harṣitamānasāḥ ।।।72।।
jayāśīrbhimudā saṃvardhayāmāsurathā'rhaṇām ।
cakrurnaikopadābhiśca gandharvā lalitaṃ jaguḥ ।।7 3 ।।
nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇā vāditrāṇi hyavādayan ।
vātā vavuśca sukhadāḥ sūryastepe prabhānvitaḥ ।।74।।
agnayo jajvaluḥ śāntāstrailokyaṃ sukhabhāgabhūt ।
rājyabhāgāstadā'jena yathāyogyaṃ samarpitāḥ ।।75।।
yāvadbhyastatra devebhyaścopadā arpitāstadā ।
devībhyo yuddhakartrībhyo brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā ।।76 ।।
śaṃbhunā cārpitā hārā lalantikāśca mudritāḥ ।
vijayākhyavibhūṣāśca tantikāśca sumudrikāḥ ।। 77।।
mukuṭakaṭakajhaṃjhrīvaṃgadāraśanāstathā ।
kalgyaḥ śekharaścairiṇyaḥ karṇapūrāśca kaṃcukīḥ ।।78 ।।
ghargharīśāṭikāsvarṇamayī ratnamayībṛsīḥ ।
ratnahīrakasauvarṇavijayākhyaprapatrikāḥ ।।79 ।।
bhojanāni ca pānāni yānāni vāhanāni ca ।
daityagṛhasthitānyanyaratnāni vividhāni ca ।।1.168.8 0 ।।
upadāyāṃ pāritoṣikākhyaṃ hārdaṃ dhanaṃ bahu ।
yathāyogyaṃ yathākāryaṃ pradattaṃ tatra parṣati ।।8 1 ।।
devyo mauktikahārāḍhyāḥ sakalgimukuṭāvahāḥ ।
prasannāśca tadā prāhurdevān yaddhṛdayaṃgamam ।।82।।
devā vā mānuṣā vātha tiryañco'tha surā'surāḥ ।
gṛhadevīrgṛhapatnīḥ svasṝḥ putrīḥ snuṣāstathā ।।83।।
mātṝśca pramadā dāsīṃnayiṣyanti bhāvataḥ ।
tadiṣṭaiḥ sukhayiṣyanti pūyiṣyanti vastubhiḥ ।।84।।
khānapānāmbarabhūṣāśṛṃgāradravyasānaiḥ ।
hārdikasnehavṛttyā prasannayiṣyanti sarvadā ।।85।।
teṣāṃ gṛhe vayaṃ devyo nivatsyāma'balāsu vai ।
sukhayiṣyāma aiśvaryairdhanaputramṛddhibhiḥ ।।86।।
rakṣiṣyāmaśca tānsarvān devāniva janānsvakān ।
bhogyabhogāvihārādīn dāpayiṣyāma eva tān ।।87।।
sukhinaḥ santu te sarve yatra nārījanaḥ sukhī ।
asukhāḥ santu te sarve yatra nārījano'sukhaḥ ।।88।।
evaṃ sarvāgryadevībhirdevaiścāśīḥ prayuṃjitaḥ ।
kātyānī mahādevī pūjitā bahudhā tata ।।89।।
atha devāḥ stutiṃ cakre samāje vijaye tat ।
kātyāyani! namastubhyaṃ kauśiki! te namonamaḥ।।1.168.90।।
kālike kāli te'jasraṃ cāmuṇḍe te namonamaḥ।
mahāmāri namastubhyaṃ te brahmāṇi namonamaḥ ।।9 1।।
cāndri ca vāruṇi kuṇḍalini tubhyaṃ namonamaḥ ।
triśūlini namastubhyaṃ kaumāri śaktini! namaḥ ।।।92।
nārasiṃhi śivadūti! vaiṣṇavi! te namonamaḥ ।
vārāhi caṇḍike caṇḍe carmamuṇḍe ca te namaḥ ।।93।।
raudri siṃhi yamadāsi yāmye devi ca te namaḥ ।
īśāni dikprapāle te nairṛtāni ca te namaḥ ।।94।।
aindri ca vāyavi bhadre bhagavatyastu te namaḥ ।
namo'stvanantarūpe te namaste rājyadāyini! ।।95।।
namaste daityadarpaghni namo'ṣṭādaśabāhavi ।
namo nārāyaṇi brāhmi cakradhāriṇi te namaḥ ।।96।।
namo vajradhare hastidhvaje te'stu namonamaḥ ।
mayūravāhini te'stu namaste haṃsavāhini ।।97।।
muṇḍamāle namaste'stu sukeśini namo'stu te ।
trinetre varade devi namaste'stu prasīda ca ।।98।।
prapannā''rtihare devi mātaḥ prasīda pāhi ca ।
mahīrūpe sadādhāre jalarūpe ca tṛptide ।।99।।
bījarūpe moharūpe muktirūpe namo'stu te ।
vidyārūpe samastastrīsvarūpe te namonamaḥ ।। 1.168.100 ।।
svargamokṣaprade devi nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।
kālarūpe tattvarūpe kāryakāraṇarūpiṇi ।। 10 1।।
triguṇe nirguṇe devi mahāmāye hṛdisthite ।
sarvā'ntaryāmiṇi devi nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।। 1 02।।
brahmāṇi haṃsayānasthe śivāni vṛṣabhasthite ।
vaiṣṇavi garuḍasthe te nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।। 1 03।।
mātṝūpe stanyayukte patnīrūpe sagarbhike ।
ratirūpe jīvaśānte nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।। 1 04।।
yuge yuge mahāsuropadravanāśanaṃ kuru ।
devānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।। 105।।
śaraṇyānāṃ sadā bādhāghātanaṃ kuru sarvathā ।
triśūlaṃ sarvadā bhīteḥ pātu devi namo'stu te ।। 1 06।।
ghaṇṭā pātu ca pāpebhya khaḍgaḥ sukhaṃ karotu ca ।
pāśādyāste sadā pāntu naśca devi namo'stu te ।। 1 07।।
sṛṣṭau sadā tvayā kāryamevameva tu rakṣaṇam ।
rakṣaṇāya sadā devi prasannā'stu namo'stu te ।। 1 08।।
iti stutvā tato devaiḥ kusumāṃjalirarpitaḥ ।
namaskṛtā prasannā ca prāha devān vihasya sā ।। 109।।
bhavatāṃ vai prasādāttu prāpto'yaṃ vijayo mayā ।
punarbhavatprasādācca haniṣyāmyeva dānavān ।। 1.168.11 0।।
gṛdhrāsuraṃ tathā garjāsuraṃ harjāsuraṃ tathā ।
jaṭhrāsuraṃ tathā magnāsuraṃ ca suravairiṇaḥ ।। 111 ।।
vaipracitān haniṣyāmi raktadantikarūpayā ।
śatākṣī ca bhaviṣyāmi punaḥ śākaṃbharī tataḥ ।। 1 12।।
śtavārṣikadurbhikṣe dāsye śākaṃ janāँstadā ।
śatairnetrairnirīkṣye'haṃ śatākṣī kīrtyate tadā ।।1 13।।
bhīmarūpeṇa bhīmā'haṃ rakṣobhyo munipuṃgavān ।
himādrau rakṣayiṣye ca bhīmā devī bhavāmyaham ।। 1 14।।
aruṇākṣavināśāya bhrāmaraṃ rūpamāsthitā ।
bhrāmarīti bhaviṣyāmi rakṣayiṣye janāँstadā ।। 1 15।।
yadā yadā ca madyogyaṃ kāryaṃ copasthitaṃ tadā ।
bhaviṣyāmi tathārūpā nānto me nāmarūpayoḥ ।। 1 16।।
kālasya ca tathā sṛṣṭernānto'sti mama karmaṇām!
āsurāṇāṃ ca nānto'sti mamāpyanto na vidyate ।। 1 17।।
matstotrairmāṃ pratyahaṃ yaḥ stoṣyati śraddhayā'nvitaḥ ।
tasya pīḍāṃ nāśayiṣye trividhāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 18।।
madhukaiṭabhamahiṣaśuṃbhaniśuṃbhanāśanam ।
śroṣyanti caritaṃ me ye gāsyanti ca samāhitāḥ ।। 119 ।।
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ caika cetasaḥ ।
dāridryāpattiduṣkarmā'niṣṭaśastrabhayādikam ।। 1.168.120।।
śatrudasyunṛpadaṃṣṭritoyā'nalabhayādikam ।
nāśayiṣye kariṣye ca teṣāṃ svastyayanaṃ dhruvam ।। 121।।
upasargamahāmārīrogotpātārtibandhanam ।
nāśayiṣye kariṣye ca saubhāgyapuṣṭivardhanam ।। 1 22।।
madgṛhe balinaivedye pūjāyāṃ havanotsave ।
navarātre caritraṃ me pāṭhyaṃ śrāvyaṃ ca bhāvataḥ ।। 123।।
dāsye parākramaṃ tasmai kalyāṇaṃ bhītiśūnyatām ।
dhanadhānyasuvarṇādistrīputrapautrasampadaḥ ।। 124।।
śāntikarmaṇi duḥsvapne grahaduḥkhe'rbhakagrahe ।
gṛhakleśe mitrakalau durvṛtte bhūtapīḍane ।। 125।।
roge daityādije duḥkhe yuddhe vairiṇi prāntare ।
dāvānale tathā'raṇye deśabhaṃge'rinigrahe ।। 1 26।।
stenā''vṛtaṃ gajavyāghrasiṃhāvṛte vanabhrame ।
bandhane vātavege ca pote mahājale raṇe ।। 127।।
nigaḍe śastrasampāte vedanāyāṃ hṛdantare ।
dasyuvairisamākrānte paṭhedvā śṛṇuyāttathā ।। 128।।
śrāvayeccāpi me bhaktyā caritaṃ vividhaṃ mama ।
mahāpūjā kārayecca bhojayedbhūsurānbahūn ।। 1 29।।।
tatra tatra sthale kāle bādhāyāṃ karmaṇi sthitau ।
rakṣayiṣye janaṃ bhaktaṃ sarvavidhaprasaṃkaṭāt ।। 1.168.13 0।।
ityāśīrbhirvardhayitvā sabhājayitvā tānsurān ।
teṣāṃ ca paśyatāṃ kātyāyanī tvantaradhīyata ।। 13 1।।
devāḥ svarga yayū rājye nirātaṃkā vyavasthitāḥ ।
asurāḥ śeṣabhāvāśca jagmuḥ pātālameva te ।। 1 32।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! saiva tuṣṭā lakṣmīvṛddhikaro gṛhe ।
ruṣṭā yadā tadā saivā'lakṣmīrvināśakāriṇī ।। 1 33।।।
saiva stutā'rcitā dadyāddhanadhānyasutādikam ।
śrutā ca kīrtitā dadyātsukhasampadgṛhādikam ।। 1 34।।
dhyātā ca saṃśritā dadyādaiśvaryā''tmabalādikam ।
ārādhitā ca sā dadyāt jñānamuktipadādikam ।। 135।।
prasāditā ca sā dadyāt svāṃ ca nārāyaṇādikam ।
tasyai cidacidvyāptāyai nārāyaṇyai namonamaḥ ।। 1 36।।
iti te kathitaṃ devīsāmarthyaṃ daityanāśakam ।
kathayiṣye prasaṃge'nyat kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi! ।। 1 37।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'nekavidhadevīnāmanekavidhāsurāṇāṃ ca sainyayoḥ kālakavalamantritaśastrāstrādibhirbhūvyomayuddhaṃ, brahmāstraprayogaḥ śuṃbhasya mṛṣamāyā, śuṃbhanāśaḥ, devīstutyupadāstotraphalādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 168।।

adhyāyaḥ 169
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 170 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śrutaṃ devyāścaritraṃ vai mahābalaparākramam ।
atha śrotuṃ samicchāmi satīcaritamadbhutam ।। 1 ।।
dakṣagṛhe satījanma satīlagnaṃ ca śaṃbhunā ।
dakṣayajñe tathā satyā vahnisnānaṃ sakāraṇam ।। 2 ।।
himādrermenakāyāṃ ca satījanmogratattapaḥ ।
madhye śaṃbhorliṃgapāto mahaccānyatparākramam ।। 3 ।।
tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi kṛpayā tava keśava! ।
ityarthitaḥ śriyā svāmī lakṣmīṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame ।। 4 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kaśyapena purā snehāt ditiḥ proktā svabhāvataḥ ।
vajrasāramayairaṃgaiḥ putro devi bhaviṣyati ।। 5 ।।
vajrāṃgaṃ nāma sā devī suṣuve vajraduścidam ।
sa jātamātra evā'bhūt sarvayuddhaviśāradaḥ ।। 6 ।।
prāha svajananīṃ mātaryadājñā karavāṇi tat ।
ditiḥ prāha mahendreṇa putrā me bahavo hatāḥ ।। 7 ।।
teṣāmapacitiṃ kartuṃ gaccha śakraṃ divi sthitam ।
sahasrākṣaṃ sa baddhvā svamāturagre nināya saḥ ।। 8 ।।
brahmaṇā mocitaḥ paścādgatastvindraḥ svamālayam ।
vajrāṃgasya varāṃgyāṃ tārakāsura iti balī ।। 9 ।।
suto'bhavat mahāduṣṭo devāṃścakre vaśān raṇe ।
lokapālānindramukhyān baddhvā pāśaiḥ paśūniva ।। 1.169.1 0।।
nināya meruśikharaṃ yatrāsti svakamālayam ।
kālanemiḥ surānbaddhvā prādāya dvāri tiṣṭhati ।। 1 1।।
yatheṣṭaṃ tārakaḥ prāha drutaṃ kārāgṛhe kṣipa ।
kevala vāsavaṃ tvekaṃ muṇḍayitvā vimocaya ।। 1 2।।
evaṃ kṛtaṃ tadā devāḥ samājagmuḥ pitāmaham ।
tārakasya vināśāya prārthayāṃcakruraṃjasā ।। 13 ।।
niśāṃ sasmāra ca brahmā sopatasthe pitāmaham ।
brahmovāca mahatkāryaṃ vibhāvari! upasthitam ।। 14।।
tārakāsuranāśārthaṃ satī dakṣasutā bhava ।
tava skandaḥ sutaḥ saptadineṣveva mahāsuram ।। 15।।
kārtikeyastārakākhyaṃ haniṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
tvaṃ kālarātriniḥśeṣabhuvanāvalivāsinī ।। 16।।
śaṃbhukaṇṭhagrahā''nandadāyinī tvaṃ vibhāvarī ।

ityuktā tu niśādevī yayau vai dakṣamandiram ।
tatrā''sīnāṃ mahāharmye ratnabhīttisamāśrayām ।। 18 ।।
dadarśa dakṣapatnīṃ cā'siknīṃ viraṇakanyakām ।
camatkṛtiprabhāvyāptā''pāṇḍurā''nanavārijām । । 19 ।।
kiṃcitkṣāmāṃ mukhodagrastanabhārāvanāmitām ।
mahauṣadhigaṇairmantrairaiśvaryairabhisevitām । । 1.169.2 0 ।।
udvahatsvarṇasannaddhajīvacakrāṃ surūpiṇīm ।
maṇimālāmahājyotiṣparidhicakrakā''nanām । । 21 ।।
svarṇatārā'bhigrathitaprāntacañcalaśāṭikām ।
tailacandanasaugandhyadravyaśṛṃgāraśobhitām । । 2 2 ।।
svarṇakalaśacīnāṃśukakāraktacchatrachāyitām ।

namaskṛtya niśovāsā'siknībhrūromarājiṣu ।

sphuṭāloke candramasi kṛtamanasijā''dare ।
gāḍhakaṇṭhagrahālagnasamaye dakṣasannidhau । । 25 । ।
ratikāle pakṣapatnīnetrayoḥ prāviśanniśā ।
āviveśa mukhe rātrirdakṣeṇā'dbhutasaṃgame । । 26 । ।
śvāsasṛtyā tadā'siknyāḥ krameṇa jaṭharāntare ।
āviveśa sthitā bīje dakṣakṛtaniṣecane । । 27 । ।
dakṣapatnī tadārabhya dauhṛdā'śobhatā'tigam ।
ādhānādiprasaṃskārā dakṣeṇāpi nivartitāḥ ।। 28 । ।
prāpte prasūtisamaye'dīpayadgrahamandiram ।
brāhme muhūrte subhage prāsūyata vibhāvarīm । । 29 । ।
mahātejasvinīṃ devīṃ kanakojjvalamūrdhajām ।
padmapatrābhanayanāṃ sthalapadmaguṇālayām । । 1.169.30 । ।
lakṣmīcihnātiśobhāḍhyā'vayavāṃ ca trinetrakām ।

svastikacakraḍamarūpadma hārakarānvitām ।
ūrdhvarekhānāgavallīdalamīnādipattalām । । 32 ।।
sāmrājyacihnasahitāṃ daivīrekhāsamanvitām ।
dṛṣṭvā dakṣastathā'siknī mumudaturhṛdantare । । 32 ।।
tasyāṃ tu jāyamānāyāṃ jantavaḥ sthirajaṃgamāḥ ।
abhavan sukhinaḥ smṛddhā taṃ sarvalokakṛtālayāḥ । । 34। ।
nārakāṇāmapi svargasamaṃ jātaṃ tadā sukham ।
cetāṃsi krūrarasattvānāṃ suśāntānyabhavaँstadā । । 35 ।।
jyotiṣāmapi sutarāṃ tejo'vardhata cāmbare ।
devāḥ praharṣamatulaṃ lebhire devatāyutāḥ ।। 36 । ।
araṇyauṣadhayaḥ svāduphalapuṣpasugandhayaḥ ।
diśaḥ praseduratyarthaṃ vimalaṃ ca nabho'bhavat । । 37।।
mārutaśca sukhasparśo mandasugandhaśītalaḥ ।
sarvartuphalayugapadudbhavā hyabhavandrumāḥ । । 38 ।।
sasyalakṣmīdharā pṛthvī rasā''virbhāvaśobhanā ।
jalaprasravaṇā bhūmau prākaṭyamanulebhire । । 39 ।।
vismṛtāni ca bodhāni smṛtermārgaṃ prapedire ।
tīrthasāmarthyamatyutkarṣatāṃ prāptamakāśata । । 1.169.40 । ।
jīvāścaturdaśalokasthitāḥ śāntiṃ gatāstadā ।
sāttvikānāṃ śakunāni suśubhānyabhavaँstadā ।।4 1 ।।
svapnānyapi mahotsavakarāṇyāsan dyumanti ca ।
mānaseṣu janānāṃ ca protsāhāḥ prābhavaँstadā ।।।72 ।।
antarīkṣe'marāstvāsan vimāneṣu sahasraśaḥ ।
brahmā saptarṣayo manvantarāṇi dikprapālakāḥ ।।।43 ।।
lokapālāśca munayaḥ santaḥ sādhvyo maharṣayaḥ ।
pitaro vahnayaḥ sādhyā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ । ।44 ।।
kinnarāśca kiṃpuruṣā devā devyaśca koṭiśaḥ ।
siddhāśca cāraṇā sūtā māgadhā vandinastathā । ।45 । ।
sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tathā pātālavāsinaḥ ।
dakṣagṛhopari vyomno mumucuḥ puṣpavarṣaṇam ।।46 ।।
jagurgandharvamukhyāśca nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।
vāditrāṇi hyavādyanta stāvakāścakrire stutīḥ । । 47।।
parvatāśca samudrāśca sarāṃsi saritastathā ।
vanā'raṇyāni mūrtāni samājagmuśca sarvaśaḥ । ।48 । ।
mūrtimanti ca tattvāni guṇā mūrtā vibhūtayaḥ ।
tatra mahotsave jagmurdivyā upadapāṇayaḥ । । 49 । ।
dakṣagṛhaṃ tadārabhya tīrthībhūtamakūparam ।
nityaṃ koṭijanāstatra yānti darśanalabdhaye । । 1.169.50 । ।
yā parabrahmaśaktiḥ sā catūrūpā vyavasthitā ।
śāntirvidyā pratiṣṭhā ca nivṛttiśceti tāḥ smṛtāḥ । ।5 1 ।।
vāsudeve'niruddhe ca pradyumne samakarṣaṇe ।
kramaśaḥ saṃsthitāścātra tatra sṛṣṭau kṛtādarāḥ । । 52 ।।
tā eva cāpi vairāje hyaje viṣṇau maheśvare ।
tiṣṭhantyeva ca śāśvatyo yogibhiḥ svātmasu dhṛtāḥ । । 53 । ।
pramāṇaviparyayavikalpanidrātmikāśca tāḥ ।
śābdikaistu parā paśyā madhyamā vaikharīti tāḥ । । 54। ।
vimarśabindunādadhvanyātmikāścāpi tāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
śāntaṃ jāgrat tathā svapnaṃ suṣuptaṃ cāpi tā matāḥ । ।55।।
garbho bālyaṃ yuvatvaṃ ca hāso'vasthāśca tāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
bījaṃ cotpattirapyatra sthitirlayaśca tā matāḥ ।।56 ।।
aṛturvārṣṭikama śaityaṃ cauṣṇya cāpi matāśca tāḥ ।
ajā īśā tathā devī cāsurāṇī ca tā matāḥ ।।57।।
śāntā krūrā vyavasāyā śūdrī vṛttaya eva tāḥ ।
brāhmaṃ prāptastathā sāyaṃ niśā cāpi ca tā matāḥ ।।58।।
kimu vaktavyametāsu catasra eva sarvathā ।
ekaiva vidyate kāryakāraṇā'bhinnarūpiṇī ।।59।।
tasmāttu prāṇinaḥ sarve ākṛṣṭiṃ yānti tatra vai ।
nityaṃ tatra samāyānti darśanārthama mahotsavaḥ ।।1.169.60 ।।
dakṣagṛhe sadā jāto devīvāsena sarvathā ।
jñānaśaktirbhaktiśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiśca muktikā ।।61 ।।
catūrūpāṃ janā draṣṭuṃ samāyānti ca koṭiśaḥ ।
atha dakṣaṃ prāha patnī paśya bālāṃ suśobhanām ।।62।।
sarvabhūtādhivāsāṃ ca rājīvadalalocanām ।
tryambakāṃ ca caturvaktrāṃ taruṇādityasannibhām ।।63।।
śrutvaivaṃ tu pitā dakṣo yāvatpaśyati putrikām ।
tāvaddivyaṃ darśanaṃ vai piturjātaṃ kṛpākṛtam ।।64।।
dakṣo'paśyat mahātejastatra siṃhāsanottame ।
nārāyaṇasya vāmāṃke sthitāṃ lakṣmīṃ dadarśa vai ।।65।।
atha līnāṃ punastatra kṛṣṇaṃ rādhāṃ dadarśa saḥ ।
atha līnāṃ ca tatraiva śivāṃ śivaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।।66।।
śivāṃke saṃsthitāṃ devīṃ candrāvayavabhūṣaṇām ।
trinetrāmaṣṭahastāṃ ca satriśūlādicihnitām ।।67।।
tejoparidhisaṃvyāptāṃ carmacakṣuralabdhikām ।
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau dakṣaḥ provāca ceśvarīm ।। 68।।
kā tvaṃ devi viśālākṣi! mahātejo'bhisaṃbhṛtā ।
na me cakṣuḥ kṣama tvasya tejasaste grahe'sti vai ।।69।।
na jāne tvāmahaṃ vatse svarūpaṃ brūhi me sute ।
devyuvāca ca māṃ viddhi brahmaśaktiṃ pareśvarīm ।।1.169.70।।
ajāmekāṃ lohitāṃ ca śuklāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ ca nirguṇām ।
bahvīḥ prajāḥ sṛjamānāṃ sarūpāśca catūrūpām ।।71 ।।
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram ।
uktvaivaṃ dakṣanetre svakarābhyāṃ sā tvamārjayat ।।72।।
divye kṣaṇāttadā jāte kṣame trisṛṣṭilokane ।
svaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa divyaṃ tatpārameśvaram ।।73।।
koṭisūryasamā''bhāvattejobimbaṃ sukhāśrayam ।
svarṇamālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ divyāmbaravibhūṣitam ।।74।।
saumyaṃ śāntaṃ tataḥ samyak pravṛttaṃ rājasaṃ śubham ।
tataḥ paścāt tadevātra mahākrūraṃ bhayānakam ।।75।।
jvālāmālā'yutavyāptaṃ kālānalaśatānvitam ।
daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣaṃ jaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ।।76।।
gadāhastaṃ samukuṭaṃ śaṃkhacakradharaṃ tathā ।
mahātriśūlahastaṃ ca ghoraṃ layabhayānakam ।।77।।
candrarekhāḍhyabhālaṃ cānantāścaryādisaṃyutam ।
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ nūpurairupaśobhitam ।।78।।
kāmyaṃ kṛttidhṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ divyagandhānulepanam ।
sarvaśaktyāśrayaṃ śubhraṃ sarvādhāramanāmayam ।।79।।
brahmendropendrayogīndrairvandyamānapadāmbujam ।
sarvataḥ pāṇipādāntaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham ।।1.169.80।।
sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhantaṃ sarvataḥ śrutimatparam ।
etādṛśīṃ mahādevīṃ dadarśa parameśvarīm ।।81 ।।
tuṣṭāva cāṣṭa ca śataṃ nāmnāmuccārya dakṣarāṭ ।
parabrahmāṇyakṣarāṇi śāśvatī parameśvarī ।।82।।।
muktānī sarvagā māyā satyā lakṣmīniraṃjanā ।
sarvāntarasthā cicchaktistārā'mṛtapradā ramā ।।83।।
vyomarūpā'cyutā kāryakāraṇātmā kalāmayī ।
prāṇeśvarī mahāmātā pradhānā prakṛtistathā ।।84।।
vidyā vibhūtirākāśā śābdī nādamayī prasūḥ ।
sarvayoniḥ purāṇā ca kūṭasthā pauruṣī śivā ।।85।।
kṣetrajñā vyāpinī vyaktā cā'vyaktā triguṇā layā ।
bhūntīcā'vyākṛtiryonirvaidyutī mohinī tathā ।।86।।
mūrtiśca vaiṣṇavī buddhirmahatī mānasī kṛtiḥ ।
īśvarāṇī ca śarvāṇī bhavānī cāmbikā tathā ।।87।।
pativratā ca rudrāṇī yoginī śrīḥ sumaṃgalā ।
sāvitrī kamalā gaṃgā pārvatī ca sarasvatī ।।88।।
vāṇī kīrtiścānnapūrṇā svadhā svāhā jagadbharā ।
sudhā siddhiḥ stutirmedhā śrutirnītiḥ smṛtistathā ।।89।।
haṃsā kālī kauśikī ca kātyāyanī ca caṇḍikā ।
durgā sādhvī ca gaurī ca trinetrā brahmacāriṇī ।।1.169.90।।
vibhāvarī ca dīkṣā ca gītirdhenuśca mohinī ।
avidyā dakṣiṇā bhargā sandhyā dhātrī prabhā ca bhūḥ ।।9 1 ।।
sa stutvā'ṣṭottaraśatanāmabhirdakṣarāṭ svayam ।
bhūyaḥ praṇamya deveśīṃ provācedaṃ kṛtāṃjaliḥ ।।95।।
dṛṣṭaṃ te caiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ rūpaṃ saumyaṃ pradarśaya ।
saṃhṛtya darśayāmāsa rūpamanyattadā punaḥ ।।93।।
dvādaśābdaṃ tadā saumyaṃ gauraṃ vikasitākṛti ।

dṛṣṭvā dakṣaḥ suhṛṣṭātmā babhāṣe parameśvarīm ।

adya me puṇyakallolāḥ putrīrūpā upasthitāḥ 1
nārāyaṇyā jagaddhātryā darśanaṃ me'dya jāyate ।।99।।
śivāyāḥ prakṛterdevyā darśanaṃ me'dya jāyate ।

adya me nu jaganmāturdarśanaṃ tava jāyate ।
mama putrī svarūpā tvaṃ jaganmātā samāgatā ।। 101 ।।

tvaṃ hi sā paramā śaktiranantā parameṣṭhinī ।। 1 02।।
tvameva paramānandā tvamevānandadāyinī ।

namaste'stu mahādevi! namaste parameśvari! ।

tvanmayo'haṃ tvadādhārastvameva ca gatirmama ।

mayā nāsti samo loke devo vā dānavo'pi vā ।

eṣā tavā'mbā'siknī vīrakanyakā'pyaho ।

pāhi māmamareśāni cāsiknyā saha sarvadā ।

aho me sumahadbhāgyaṃ mahādevīsamāgamāt ।
ājñāpaya mahādevi kiṃ kariṣyāmi śāṃkari ।। 1.169.11 0।।
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tadā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।

dhyātavān svasutāṃ devīṃ parabrahmātmikāṃ satīm ।

ādimadhyāntarahitāṃ tamasaḥ parataḥ sthitām ।
jagatprasūtiṃ vedāntavijñānagamyavigrahām ।। 1 13।।
ānandamātrāṃ praṇavābhidhānāṃ śaraṇapradām ।

sahasrakarapādāsyāṃ jale nārāyaṇātmikām ।। 1 17।।
saṃhāradharmasaṃdhartrīṃ yugāntakṣayasaṃjñitām ।
