ādimadhyāntasaṃsthāṃ ca jñātavān dakṣarā ṭ parām ।। 119 ।।
tato'mbikā śivaṃ smṛtvā pitaraṃ prāha sasmitam ।
bhaktyā tvananyayā tāta madbhāvaṃ gantumarhasi ।। 1.169.120 ।।
sarvayajñatapodānaistadrūpamāpyate nahi ।
yanme sākṣātparaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ dṛṣṭamadbhutam ।। 121 ।।
tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadeva śaraṇaṃ vraja ।
tadeva manasā paśya taddhyāyasva yajasva tat ।। 1 22।।
ahaṃ tvāṃ parayā bhaktyā caiśvaraṃ yogamāsthitam ।
saṃsārasāgarādasmāduddharāmyacireṇa tu ।। 122 ।।
dhyānena karmayogena bhaktyā jñānena caiva hi ।
prāpyā'haṃ te prajāpate! nānyathā karmakoṭibhiḥ ।। 124।।
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ samyak karma varṇāśramātmakam ।
adhyātmajñānasahitaṃ muktaye satataṃ kuru ।। 125 ।।
dharmātsaṃjāyate bhaktirbhaktyā saṃprāpyate param ।
śrutyudito yajñadharmo vedāddharmo hi nirbabhau ।। 126 ।।
mamaivaiṣā parā saṃjñā vedarūpā purātanī ।
na ca vedādṛte kiñcicchāstraṃ dharmābhidhāyakam ।। 1 27।।
varṇānāmanukampārthaṃ manniyogādvirāṭsvayam ।
svāyaṃbhuvo manurbhūtvā vedadharmān sa uktavān ।। 128।।
antarhiteṣu dharmeṣu yugānteṣu maharṣayaḥ ।
brahmaṇo vacanāttāni darśayanti yuge yuge ।। 129 ।।
brahmaṇā saha te sarve saṃprāpte pratisaṃcare ।
harerante kṛtātmānaḥ praviśanti paraṃ padam ।। 1.169.130 ।।
tasmātsarvaprayatnena dharmārthaṃ vedamāśrayet ।
dharmajñānayutā bhaktiḥ paraṃbrahma prakāśayet ।। 131 ।।
etādṛśaṃ mayā rūpaṃ kathaṃ sandarśitaṃ śṛṇu ।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ brahma nārāyaṇī tathaiva ca ।। 132।।
bāhyadṛṣṭyā tayorbhedo na tvāntaradṛśā manāk ।
sa eva tu paraṃbrahma kvacitkṛṣṇaḥ prajāyate ।। 13 2।।
sa eva rādhā bhavati yatheṣṭaṃ viharatyapi ।
sa eva ca paraṃbrahma nārāyaṇo bhavatyapi ।। 1 34।।
nārāyaṇī ramā lakṣmīḥ sa eva saṃprajāyate ।
yatheṣṭaṃ ca viharati nāsti bhedo manāgapi ।। 1 35।।
paraṃbrahma sa vai brahmā brahmāṇī jāyate tathā ।
sa eva viṣṇurbhavati vaiṣṇavyapi sa eva saḥ ।। 1 36।।
śivo rudraḥ sa evāsti rudrāṇī ca śivaiva saḥ ।
ahaṃ satī śivā raudrī tava gehe prakāśitā ।। 1 37।।
parabrahmasvarūpā'smi śivārthaṃ tyāgatāsmi ca ।
parabrahmasvarūpaśca śivo'pi bhagavān svayam ।। 1 38।।
kailāse rājate devo devyahaṃ te gṛhe sthitā ।
tasmātsarvaprakāreṇa madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 39।।
māmevā'rcaya sarvatra manasā śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।
yadyatsvarūpaṃ me tāta manaso gocaraṃ tava ।। 1.169.140 ।।
tanniṣṭhastatparo bhūtvā tadarcanaparo bhava ।
saḥ śivaśca tvayā tātā'bhyarthanīyo madarthakaḥ ।। 141 ।।
dātavyā ca śivāyaiva śāśvatī te sutā śivā ।
dharmasaṃsthāpanārthāya niyogād brahmaṇastathā ।। 142।।।
asiknyāśca samutpannā tvāmeva pitaraṃ śritā ।
pradāsyase mahendrāya prasīdati sa śaṃkaraḥ ।। 143।।।
tena devādayaḥ sarve tvāṃ namasyanti bhāvataḥ ।
arpitayā mayā sākaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।। 144।।
ityupadiśya dakṣāya satī bālā hyajāyata ।
dakṣastutoṣa paramaṃ sutāṃ jñātvā pareśvarīm ।। 145।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vibhāvaryāḥ satījanma, maṃgalamahotsavaḥ, dakṣāya divyasatīdarśanaṃ, stutiḥ sutādhyānam, śivāśivayoḥ parabrahmaṇaikyaṃ
cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ ।। 169 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 169 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 170
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 171 →


śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nanu vibhāvarī keyaṃ yā satī dakṣaputrikā ।
jātā brahmātmikā devī saṃśayaṃ chindhi me hare ।। 1 ।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi satī vibhāvarī rātriryathā'bhavat ।
goloke dhāmni bhagavān śrīmān kṛṣṇo virājate ।। 2 ।।
parabrahmasvarūpaḥ sa golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
mahāmāyā ca yā mūlā prakṛtirbrahmavāmagā ।। 3 ।।
kṛṣṇavāme sthitā kvāpi līnarūpā virājate ।
naikākī ramate kṛṣṇaḥ sa tadaicchad dvitīyakam ।। 4 ।।
tadā kṛṣṇasya vāmāṃgādāvirāsa sukanyakā ।
dhāvitvā''nīya kusumaṃ rājacampakavṛkṣajam ।। 5 ।।
kṛṣṇasya caraṇe nyasya svayaṃ rāse dadhāra ca ।
tena rādhā tadā proktā kāryasiddhikarī tu sā ।। 6 ।।
kāntaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saha nītvā vṛkṣakuṃje viveśa sā ।
ratyānandaṃ dadātyasmai so'pi ratipramūrchanām ।। 7 ।।
avāpa cāpi ca nidrāṃ supravṛtte mahāsukhe ।
rādhā prāha tadā kṛṣṇaṃ kiṃ na kṛṣṇaḥ praceṣṭase ।। 8 ।।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha priye nidrā samāyātā kṣaṇaṃ śramāt ।
rādhā kruddhā tadā nidropari nidrāpi bālikā ।। 9 ।।
bhūtvā pārśve sthitā namrā kṛṣṇanetre vihāya vai ।
dṛṣṭvā prāha tadā rādhā re nidre ratikhaṇḍike ।। 1.170.10 ।।
mā'stu golokavāsaste gaccha vairājapūruṣe ।
sarvānandanāśayitrī tāmasī rudrasaṃgatā ।। 11 ।।
bhava tāmasabhāvā tvaṃ devī saṃhāriṇī sadā ।
abhāvapratyayādhārā vṛttirnidrā vināśinī ।। 12।।
ghorā hyāsuranāśāya paryāptā bhava sarvadā ।
daityasainyeṣu nityaṃ tvaṃ sannaddhā bhava tāmasī ।। 13।।
sṛṣṭau sarvatra jīvānāmindriyeṣu virāmikā ।
bhava sthitiṃ kṛtavatī rudrāṇī rudrasaṃgatā ।। 14।।
rānārthasya hi bhānasya antrī rātrirbhaviṣyasi ।
bhānaṃ ca vigataṃ yasmādvibhāvarī bhaviṣyasi ।। 15।।
vairājaputrīṃ tvāṃ brahma svayaṃ sṛṣṭau grahīṣyati ।
sa ca vibhāvarīṃ devīṃ dakṣāya putrikātmikām ।। 16।।
dāsyati pravarāṃ kanyāṃ dakṣaḥ satīṃ tu śaṃbhave ।
sā kālī caṇḍikā devī hyasurān nāśayiṣyati ।। 17।।
sā tvaṃ kālī tathā rātrirvibhāvarī ca nidrikā ।
rudrasahacarī bhūtvā vihariṣyasi tāmasī ।। 18।।
ityādeśāddhareḥ kāmādbhāvikāryavaśāttathā ।
vibhāvarī satī rātrirdakṣakanyā babhūva sā ।। 1 9।।
śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nanu śaṃbhuryadotpanno vairājātpuruṣāttadā ।
sahaiva śāṃbhavī śaktiḥ protpannā śrūyate tu yā ।।1.170.20 ।।
tasyāḥ śivāyā asyāśca rātryā bhedo'sti vā na vā ।
śivā tu sarvadā patnī rātrirjāyā'parā'sti kim ।। 21।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
yogyaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi gahanaṃ mama ceṣṭitam ।
nānyaistu jñāyate caitatkadā kiṃkimabhūditi ।। 22।।
śṛṇu pūrvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ jñātavyaṃ bhavatīti yat ।
kathayāmi kathāśeṣaṃ śivasyā'nādibhāvanam ।।23।।।
nārāyaṇaḥ sarvapatiḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।
akṣare ca pare dhāmni rājate muktasevitaḥ ।।24।।
yathecchati yadā sṛṣṭiṃ tadā tāṃ sṛjjati dhruvam ।
tadā tena kṛtaṃ kīdṛk prasaṃgātkathayāmi te ।।25।।
parabrahmaṇa evāṃgād rādhā yadopajāyata ।
tadarthaṃ dhāma golokaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rūpaṃ cakāra ca ।।26।।
sā ca kṛṣṇasya patnyāsītprāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ।
devī ṣoḍaśavarṣīyā prodbhinnanavayauvanā ।।27।।
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā komalāṃgī samujjvalā ।
puṣṭanitambabhārārtā sundarī sumanoharā ।।28।।।
raktamṛdusundarauṣṭhā pīnaśroṇipayodharā ।
muktāpaṃktisamacaṃcaddantapaktimanoharā ।।29।।
koṭipārvaṇacandrātiriktatejobharānanā ।
padmapatrāyatanetrā keśaveśādimaṇḍitā ।।1.170.30।।
tilapuṣpaśukacañcusamanāsā'tisundarā ।
svarṇavarṇasamagaṇḍayugmakāntibahūjjvalā ।।3 1 ।।
dhṛtasvarṇamaṇiratnabhūṣākarṇasuśobhanā ।
candanā'gurukastūrīsindūrakuṃkumādibhiḥ ।।32।।
kapālayoḥ kṛtapatrā puṣpagrathitadhammilā ।
kṛtasṛtisasindūrarekhākabarīmastakā ।।33।।
sthalapadmadalakāntilasaccaraṇasacalā ।
haṃsahastigatidyotadvakṣaḥpiṇḍobhamantharā ।।34।।
ratnahārānmaṇihārān vanamālāṃ manoharām ।
hārān hīrakanirmāṇān ratnakeyūrakaṃkaṇam ।।35।।
sadratnasāranirmāṇavalayān ratnavaṃgadāḥ ।
svarṇakiṃkiṇikāguṃjadraśanāṃ dadhatī satī ।।36।।
amūlyaratnanirmāṇakvaṇanmaṃjīraraṃjitā ।
nānāprakāraratnāḍhyapadmakaṃ paribibhratī ।।37।।
alaktaspṛśakarapattalanakhauṣṭhamaṃjulā ।
uvāsa sasmitā bhartuḥ ratnasiṃhāsanā'rdhake ।।।38।।
athā'syā lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyo gopāṃganāgaṇaḥ ।
veśarūpākṛtibhistatsamaḥ susthirayauvanaḥ ।। 39।।
lakṣakoṭipramātaśca goloke gopikāgaṇaḥ ।
prāvirbabhūva vai śaśvatkṛṣṇadāsīsamāhvayaḥ ।।1.170.40 ।।
kṛṣṇasya lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyo gopagaṇo'pyatha ।
āvirbabhūva vai śaśvadrūpaveśādibhiḥ samaḥ ।।41।।
triṃśatkoṭipramātaśca kṛṣṇadāsagaṇaḥ sa hi ।
kṛṣṇasya lomakūpebhyaḥ sadyaścāvirbabhūva ca ।।42।।
bahuvarṇo gogaṇaśca śaśvatsusthirayauvanaḥ ।
surabhyaśca balīvardā vatsataryaśca vatsakāḥ ।।।43।।
śobhanā maṃgalakarā hyāsan prādustadā śubhāḥ ।
teṣāmekaṃ balīvardaṃ koṭisiṃhasamaṃ bale ।।44।।
śaṃbhuvāhanalābhārthaṃ kṛṣṇo'rakṣanmanoharam ।
kṛṣṇāṃghrinakharandhrebhyo haṃsapaktiḥ supāṇḍurā ।।45।।।
āvirbabhūva śaśvatstrīpuṃlakṣmātisundarā ।
teṣāmekaṃ rājahaṃsaṃ vedhovāhanalabdhaye ।।46।।
kṛṣṇo'rakṣatsudhavalaṃ mahābalaparākramam ।
kṛṣṇasya vāmakarṇasya vivarātsumanoharaḥ ।।47।।
gaṇaḥ śvetaturaṃgāṇāmāvirbabhūva nityakaḥ ।
teṣāṃ śvetatamaṃ tvekaṃ dharmavāhanalabdhaye ।।48।।
kṛṣṇo'rakṣaddadau cānyānsurebhyo bhagavān svayam ।
kṛṣṇasya dakṣakarṇasya vivarācchobhanākṛtiḥ ।।49।।
prāvirbhūtā sihapaṃktirmahābalaparākramā ।
teṣāmekaṃ dadau kṛṣṇo vibhāvaryai mahābalam ।।1.170.50 ।।
bhogyaṃ yadyat tadā'pekṣya kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇena yoginā ।
tathā sarvagataṃ divyaṃ cakāra rathapaṃcakam ।।51 ।।
vividharatnakhacitaṃ manoyāyi mahattaram ।
lakṣayojanāyataṃ ca śatayojanamūrdhvagam ।।52।।
lakṣacakraṃ vāyuraṃho lakṣakrīḍāgṛhānvitam ।
bhogyaśṛṃgāratalpādivihārodyānarājitam ।।53।।
ratnapradīpalakṣāṇāṃ prakāśāśca gṛhe gṛhe ।
divyatoraṇakalaśadhvajacitrādibṛṃhitam ।।54।।
ratnadarpaṇacāmarachatramuktāgavākṣakam ।
maṇīndramuktāmāṇikyahīrahārasuśobhitam ।।55।।
nīlaraktapiśaṃgapāṇḍurapaṃkajaśobhanam ।
ekasteṣu pradatto vaikuṇṭhavāsisvarūpiṇe ।।56।।
aparo'vyākṛtavāsibhūmne'rpitaḥ svarūpiṇe ।
tṛtīyastu mahāviṣṇusvarūpāya svarūpiṇe ।।57।।
caturtho rādhikāyai ca paṃcamaḥ svāya rakṣitaḥ ।
āvirbabhūvuḥ kṛṣṇasya guhyadeśāttu guhyakāḥ ।।58।।
kubero guhyakeśaśca sundarī guhyakī tathā ।
atha kṛṣṇasya mukhato hyāvirbhūtāśca pārṣadāḥ ।।59।।
pītavastrā vanamālādharāḥ śyāmāścaturbhujāḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakirīṭaratnakuṇḍalāḥ ।।1.170.60 ।।
nārāyaṇāya vaikuṇṭhe dadau caturbhujān bahūn ।
dvibhujāḥ śyāmalā kṛṣṇasadṛśāḥ pārṣadāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
vaiṣṇavā dāsyadāsāśca kṛtāḥ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।
rakṣitāḥ svīyasevāyāṃ dhyāyantaścaraṇāmbujam ।।62।।
āvirbabhūva kṛṣṇasya vāmanetrāt triśūladhṛk ।
śvetavarṇastāmasaśca trinetro bhālacandrakaḥ ।।63।।।
vyāghracarmadharo haste ḍamaruṃ dhārayan jaṭī ।
sa īśāno mahābhāgo dikpālānāmadhīśvaraḥ ।।64।।
tathā triśūlapaṭṭīśadharāśca candraśekharāḥ ।
trinetrāśca mahākāyā gaṇāścānye babhūvire ।।65।।
surāstrikoṭisaṃkhyātāḥ kṛṣṇamūrteḥ pratisthalāt ।
prādurbabhūvuḥ sarve te yathāsthānamavasthitāḥ ।।66।।
ratirmūrtiśca sāvitrī manoramā sarasvatī ।
mahālakṣmīḥ satī lakṣmīrbabhūvurhṛdayāmbujāt ।।67।।
nārāyaṇāya pradadau mahālakṣmīṃ sarasvatīm ।
sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇe prādāt mūrtiṃ dharmāya sādaram ।।68।।
ratiṃ kāmāya rūpāḍhyāṃ kuberāya manoramām ।
lakṣmīṃ ca viṣṇave prādāt satīṃ śivāya cārpayat। ।।69 ।।
śivaḥ prāha tadā yogī praṇataḥ kṛṣṇamacyutam ।
adhunā'haṃ na gṛhṇāmi prakṛtiṃ prākṛto yathā ।।1.170.70।।
yogajñānabrahmacaryadāsyabhaktivirodhinīm ।
muktīcchābandhakartrī ca sakāmāṃ kāmavardhinīm ।।71 ।।
tapasyānāśinīṃ cittasantoṣabhakṣikāṃ kṣudhām ।
bhavakārāgrahe ghore dṛḍhanigaḍarūpiṇīm ।।72।।
śaśvadvibuddhijananīṃ sadbuddhicchedakāriṇīm ।
sadā bhogārthasārāṃ ca viṣayecchāvivardhinīm ।।73।।
malamūtramayīṃ vallīṃ dehataruprabandhanām ।
ratikāryā'dhikakākṣepiṇīṃ svārthatanmayīm ।।74।।
svātantryanāśinīṃ śokamohasthānamayīṃ dṛḍhām ।
dhāraṇādhyānaguptāṃgāṃ brahmadhyānavirodhinīm ।।75।।
necchāmi gṛhiṇīṃ nātha varaṃ dehi madīpsitam ।
tvadbhaktau dāsabhāve ca prema saṃvardhate'niśam ।।76।।
tvannāmajapane pādasevane'rcanakarmaṇi ।
śravaṇe kīrtane stotre smaraṇe mitrabhāvane ।।77।।
sarvadā jāgrati svapne tvayyeva prabhramāmyaham ।
tṛptirjāyeta naiva tvaddhyāne yoge tapassu ca ।।78।।
tavā''vāhanāsanācāmanābhisnānasevane ।
gandhapuṣpadhūpavastradīpacandanacarcane ।।79।।
naivedyajalatāmbūlā''rārtrikastutivandane ।
namaskārapradakṣiṇā'laṃkṛtisatphalārpaṇe ।।1.170.80 ।।
samarpaṇe cātmanaśca nityaprasādabhojane ।
tṛptiryathā na jāyeta tathā dehi dayānidhe ।।8 1 ।।
sārṣṭisālokyasārūpyasāmīpyasāmyalīnatāḥ ।
tava bhaktisukhāṃśasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।82।।
aṇimā laghimā prāptiḥ prākāmyaṃ mahimā tathā ।
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca sarvakāmāvasāyitā ।।83।।
sārvajñyaṃ dūradarśitvaṃ dūrasaṃśravaṇaṃ tathā ।
parakāyapraveśaśca vāksiddhiḥ kalpavallitā ।।84।।
janināśamahāśaktiḥ tathā'maratvamityapi ।
siddhayaḥ ṣoḍaśa bhakteḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।85।।
yogāstapāṃsi dānāni vratānyanaśanāni ca ।
yaśaḥ kīrtirvacaḥsatyaṃ dharmastīrthaṃ surārcanam ।।86।।
devārcādarśanaṃ sarvabhūmimaṇḍalaprakramam ।
sarvasvargasukhā''bhogaḥ sarvā'bdhisnānamityapi ।।87।।
avabhṛthāni sarvāṇi brahmaviṣṇumaheśatā ।
vairājatā cāpi tato'nyavidhāḥ smṛddhayaśca yāḥ ।।88।।
tava bhaktikalāṃśasya kalāṃ nā'rhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।
tasmād bhaktiṃ vinā cānyannaiva prārthyaṃ mayā vibho ।।89।।
na satī na śaṭhī me cāpekṣyate prakṛtī hyubhe ।
viraktau yādṛśaṃ saukhyaṃ sānurāge na tādṛśam ।।1.170.90 ।।
śrutvaivaṃ śāṃkaraṃ vākyaṃ bhagavānprāha sasmitam ।
yadīdānīṃ tvayā śaṃbho neṣyate prakṛtiḥ satī ।।9 1।।
sā vasatu mama netre yoganidrāmayī śivā ।
yadā''vaśyakatā te syāttadā dāsye vibhāvarīm ।।92।।
tāvatkālaṃ mama sevāṃ netrayoḥ saṃkariṣyati ।
ityabhidhāya bhagavān jagrāha netrayoḥ śivām ।।93।।
śaṃbhuṃ ca dāsyasevāyāmarakṣadvaiṣṇavaṃ sutam ।
prāha kṛṣṇastadā śaṃbhuṃ matsevāṃ kuru sarvathā ।।94।।
yāvat te'vaśyakāryaṃ ca sṛṣṭau naivopatiṣṭhate ।
tapasvisiddhayogijñasuravaiṣṇavapūjitaḥ ।।95।।
vasā'trā'marabhāvaṃ ca labha mṛtyuṃjayo bhava ।
vedaśāstrādisārvaśyasiddhiṃ prāpnuhi madvarāt ।।96।।
asaṃkhyabrahmaṇāṃ nāśaṃ līlayā'traiva paśya vai ।
jñānena tejasā śaktyā vayasā yaśasā śriyā ।।97।।
parākrameṇa tapasā mahasā matsamo bhava ।
mama prāṇādadhikastvaṃ preyān bhaktottamaḥ śiva ।।98।।
mamoktaṃ vacanaṃ sārthaṃ kāle kartuṃ tvamarhasi ।
tava vākyaṃ pālayāmi putra tvaṃ madgṛhe vasa ।।99।।
madvākyaṃ ca svavākyaṃ ca pālanīyaṃ kariṣyasi ।
kāle gṛhītvā prakṛtiṃ śṛṃgāraṃ ca kariṣyasi ।। 1.170.10 0।।
na kevalaṃ tapasvī tvaṃ ceśvaro matsamo mahān ।
kāle gṛhī tathā kāle tapasvī bhava vāñchayā ।। 101 ।।
duḥkhaṃ tu dārasaṃyoge yat tvayā kathitaṃ śṛṇu ।
kustrī dadāti duḥkhaṃ ca svāmine na pativratā ।। 1 02।।
mahatkulaprasūtā yā satkulā kulamāninī ।
karoti sukhinaṃ kāntaṃ sevayā''tmārpaṇāhvayā ।। 103 ।।
patirbandhuḥ patirbhartā patiḥ paramadaivatam ।
patireva paraṃbrahma patiḥ svaṃ kulayoṣitām ।। 1 04।।
patito'patito vāpi kṛpaṇaśceśvaro dṛḍhaḥ ।
śithilo vāpi sarvasvaṃ patirvai kulayoṣitām ।। 1 05।।
asatkulaprasūtā yā pitrorduḥśīlamiśritā ।
dhruvaṃ sā parabhogyā syāt patinindā parā sadā ।। 1 06।।
patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patirviṣṇuḥ patiḥ śaṃbhuḥ sadā mama ।
patideve sarvadevā dṛśyante kulayoṣitām ।। 1 07।।
etādṛśī tu te sādhvī śivā'sti mahatī satī ।
bhavitā sā śivā śaivī prakṛtirvaiṣṇavī śiva! ।। 1 08।।
goloke vasa deveśa yāvatsṛṣṭau na te kṛtiḥ ।
matsamādhau sadā magno mama sevāparaśca vā ।। 1 09।।
ityabhidhāya kṛṣṇastaṃ svasevāyāmarakṣayat ।
golokasyaikadivase vairājānāṃ sahasrakam ।। 1.170.11 0।।
naśyati tatra kā saṃkhyā kṣudrabrahmāṇḍavedhasām ।
yadā vairājadehācca brahmā viṣṇurbhaviṣyataḥ ।। 111 ।।
tadā tejaḥpravāhe vai bhaviṣyati sadāśivaḥ ।
tejo liṃgaṃ śivo mūrtirloke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ।। 11 2।।
śivapārśvagatā sādhvī śivā saha bhaviṣyati ।
tataḥ kālāntare dakṣaputrī satī bhaviṣyati ।। 11 3।।।
bhagavāṃśca tataḥ prāha śivāṃ netrādhivāsinīm ।
adhunā tiṣṭha vatse tvaṃ goloke mama netrayoḥ ।। 1 14।।
kāle bhajiṣyasi śaṃbhuṃ virāṭputraṃ śivāyanam ।
tejaḥsu sarvadevānāmāvirbhūya tataḥ punaḥ ।। 1 15।।
saṃhṛtya daityānsarvāṃśca bhavitā vindhyavāsinī ।
bhavitā dakṣakanyā ca suśīlā śaṃbhugehinī ।। 1 16।।
tataḥ śarīraṃ santyajya yajñe bhartustu nindayā ।
menāyāṃ śailabhāryāyāṃ bhavitā pārvatīti ca ।। 1 17।।
bahukāryakarī krūrā caṇḍikā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
bahunāmnī bahurūpā tāmasī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।। 1 18।।
paṃcāyatanadeveṣu śivā śivaśca tatsutaḥ ।
mukhyāḥ sarveṣu viśveṣu bhaviṣyantyeva madvarāt ।। 1 19।।
grāmeṣu nagareṣveva pūjitā grāmadevatā ।
bhavatī bhavitā tatra bhinnanāmādidhāriṇī ।। 1.170.120।।
bhaviṣyanti mahāntaśca tatra te paricārakāḥ ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ siddhārthaphalalipsavaḥ ।। 1 21।।
ye tvāṃ tatra bhajiṣyante pṛthvyāṃ puṇye sutīrthake ।
teṣāṃ yaśaśca kīrtiścaiśvaryaṃ vardhiṣyate bahu ।। 122।।
ityāśīrbhiḥ śivāṃ śarvaṃ toṣayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
śarvaṃ rarakṣa sevāyāṃ śivāṃ rarakṣa netrayoḥ ।। 1 22।।
netrasthatvācchivā jātā nidrā sukhakarī sadā ।
nidrā vibhāvarī rātriścaikaiva nā'parā tu sā ।। 124।।
sā kṛṣṇahṛdayājjātā śivā netradvaye sthitā ।
rādhikāvacanāt nidrā gatā vairājanetrayoḥ ।। 125।।
sārdhaṃ ca śaṃbhunā tatra śivā nityā'bhivyaṃjitā ।
saiva nārāyaṇasyendriyeṣu dugdhābdhike sthitā ।। 126।।
saiva sarvā'gryadevānāmindriyavrātasaṃsthitā ।
saiva śeṣaśayānaśrīnārāyāṇendriyāditaḥ ।। 127।।
śivā śaktiryoganidrā rātrirvibhāvarī satī ।
kātyāyanī kauśikī caṇḍikā kālī ca pārvatī ।। 128।।
kramayogādyathāpekṣaṃ yathākāryaṃ prakāśitā ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! satīrūpaṃ sadātmakam ।। 1 29।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīcaritre goloke rādhāratau kṛṣṇanetranidrāyai śāpaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇāṃgebhyo rādhāgopagopīgogaṇahaṃsaśvetaturagasiṃha- rathapaṃcakaśivaśivāmahālakṣmīsarasvatīratimūrtisāvitryādyāvirbhāvaḥ, satyāḥ śivārpaṇe śivavairāgyaṃ, kṛṣṇanetrasthaśivāyā vairājaputrītvaṃ tato devendriyajakātyāyanītvaṃ dakṣaputrīsatītvaṃ himālayaputrīpārvatītvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikaśatatamo'
dhyāyaḥ ।। 170।।


← adhyāyaḥ 170 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 171
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 172 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha vairājapuruṣāt nābhau padme'bhavat tvajaḥ ।
viṣṇuśca hṛdayājjātastadā vai viṣṇupadmajau ।। 1।।
mahāmahaṃ mahāँścāhamitiśraiṣṭhyavivādinau ।
tayormadhye mahattejaḥkiraṇaṃ samabhūttadā ।।2।।
tatra devastṛtīyo vai śaṃbhuḥ prādurbabhūva ha ।
golokātpreṣitaścāsyā'ṇḍasya devādhivṛttaye ।।3।।
śrīkṛṣṇena svayaṃ cātra preṣitaḥ śaṃkaro mudā ।
vaiṣṇavo bhaktavaryaśca samutpanno harīcchayā ।।4।।
harestadaiva kiraṇaṃ mūrterverājanetrayoḥ ।
samāgatya babhūvātisthiraṃ tasya prabhāvataḥ ।।5।।
lalāṭātsa samutpannaḥ kiraṇāḍhyo maheśvaraḥ ।
kiraṇaṃ divyabāṇaṃ vaiṃ brahmaṇaścihnameva tat। ।।6 ।।
maheśastatra vairājātmajo jātaḥ sutāmasaḥ ।
śivā ca tasya dehe vai vāmabhāge'prakāśitā ।।7।।
kṛṣṇājñayā samāyātā śivo vetti na tāṃ tadā ।
śivo jānāti caikaṃ svaṃ devaṃ tatra śivāṃ vinā ।।8।।
kintvadṛśyā śivā śaṃbhorvāme śaktisvarūpiṇī ।
āsīd yā kṛṣṇanetrasthā saivā''sīcchivanetrayoḥ ।।9।।
brahmaṇā preritā rātriḥ sā saṃbabhūva dākṣiṇī ।
satītināma saṃcakre tasyā dakṣastadājñayā ।। 1.171.10 ।।
atha tāṃ ca sutāṃ mātā susaṃskṛtya yathocitam ।
śiśupānena vidhinā tasyai stanyādikaṃ dadau ।। 1 1।।
pālitā sā'tha vīriṇyā'siknyā dakṣeṇa vavṛdhe ।
tasyāṃ susadguṇāḥ sarve viviśuḥ śaiśave'pi vai ।। 12।।
sakhīmadhyagatā krīḍācaraṇe'pi svabhāvataḥ ।
lilekha śaṃbhudevasya pratimāṃ vai kvacitkvacit ।। 13 ।।
bālyociteṣu gīteṣu jagau rudraṃ haraṃ muhuḥ ।
hare tvevaṃ bhaktimatī sasmāra smaranāśakam ।। 14।।
tasyāṃ pitroḥ sukaruṇā vavṛdhe'tīva nityadā ।
bālā'pi guṇavṛddhā sā toṣayāmāsa janmadau ।। 15 ।।
ekadā nārado brahmā jagmaturdakṣamandiram ।
dṛṣṭā tābhyāṃ dakṣapārśve tvāsīnā sā satī śubhā ।। 16 ।।
pitrā namaskṛtau cobhau satyā cāpi namaskṛtau ।
praṇāmānte satīṃ vīkṣya dakṣadattaśubhāsane ।। 17।।
sthitāvātithyavidhinā satkṛtāvūcaturmudā ।
brahmā prāha muniṃ paśya nāradevaṃ maheśvarī ।। 18।।
kasya bhāryā suyogyā syād rekhāḥ paśyā'tha māṃ vada ।
nāradastatra deveśīṃ natvā prāha sukanyake ।। 1 9।।
ehi paśyāmi te hastarekhāḥ kā bhavasīti yat ।
vihasya kanyayā hastatale sandarśite tadā ।।1.171.20 ।।
dhanurmīnastathā ketuḥ svastikaśca triśūlakam ।
pradīpaḥ kamalaṃ bāṇoṃ'kuśaḥ śaṃkhaśca cakrakam ।। 21 ।।
paraśuḥ sāyakaḥ śaktiḥ ṣaḍvāme ṣaṭ ca dakṣiṇe ।
kramāddhaste nāradena dṛṣṭānyetāni rekhayā ।।022।।
lalāṭe'kṣi tṛtīyaṃ ca kalā candrasya vakragā ।
hṛdye śivamūrtiśca svarṇarekhāmayī śubhā ।।23।।
nābherūrdhvaṃ carmacihnamadhaśca karavālakam ।
dhanurbāṇena yuktaṃ ca padoḥ siṃho vṛṣastathā ।।24।।
śikharaṃ vallikā nāgadalaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tathā ।
ūrdhve rekhe sarpaphaṇā dṛṣṭānyetāni rekhayā ।। 25 ।।
kathitaṃ brahmaṇe cāpi dakṣāya nāradena tu ।
neyaṃ vai mānavī putrī nāpi daivī na cā'parā ।।26।।
jaganmātā gurūṇāṃ ca gurvī parā tu vaiṣṇavī ।
kṛṣṇāṃganā ca vā nārāyaṇavāmā pareśvarī ।।27।।
brahmāṃganā ca vā viṣṇoraṃganā parameśvarī ।
śivāṃganā bhavedyadvā nānyā syājjagadaṃbikā ।।।28।।
manye'syā hṛdi śarvo'sti netracandrau lalāṭake ।
kare triśūlarekhā'sti caraṇe vṛṣabho hariḥ ।।29।।
ataḥ śivasya ratnaṃ syānnānyasya kasyacid dhruvam ।
salajjā'dhomukhī śrutvā bhūtvā vihasya satvaram ।।1.171.30 ।।
gṛhāntare jagāmātha mātre nyavedayacca tat ।
asiknyā ca gṛhāttatra bahirāgatya tau tadā ।।3 1 ।।
namaskṛtau jalabhojyaphalādyaiśca prapūjitau ।
dakṣeṇa vanditau vṛddhau satī tāvadgṛhātpunaḥ ।।32।।
bhargacitraṃ svalikhitaṃ nītvā bahirupāgatā ।
sahāsā darśitavatī omityarthaṃ maharṣaye ।। 33।।।
nanāma nāradaṃ sā ca brahmāṇaṃ praṇanāma sā ।
brahmā prāha tadānīṃ mastake datvā karāṃjalim ।।34।।
yastvāṃ kāmayate yaṃ tvaṃ tathā kāmayase sati! ।
tamāpnuhi patiṃ devaṃ sarvajñaṃ jagadī śvaram ।।35।।
yo nānyāṃ jagṛhe nāpi gṛhṇāti na grahīṣyati ।
jāyāṃ sa te patirbhūyādananyasadṛśaḥ śubhe ।।36।।
ityuktvā suciraṃ tāṃ vai sthitvā dakṣālaye punaḥ ।
visṛṣṭau tena saṃyātau svasthānaṃ tau samudraje ।।37।।
dakṣo'bhavat tadā prīto manyamānaḥ svadhanyatām ।
satī ca vardhamānā''pa kiṃcidyauvanabhāvanām ।।38।।।
dakṣaśca cintayāmāsa satīyogyaṃ varaṃ śivam ।
bālyaṃ vyatītaṃ putryā me kaumāryaṃ vigataṃ tathā ।।।39।।
prodbhinnāntarvayoyuktāmudvāhā'rhasukanyakām ।
tapobhiḥ svarṇarūpāḍhyāṃ dāsye bhargāya sarvathā ।।1.171.40।।
satī svayaṃ tathā bhargaṃ prāptumaicchat hṛdantare ।
pituśca nirṇayaṃ jñātvā mātaraṃ prāha sā satī ।।41।।
śaṃkarasya kṛte mātastapovratādi darśaya ।
tavā'jñayā vrataṃ kurve śivasantoṣaṇāya vai ।।42।।
māturājñāṃ tu sā labdhvā śivaṃ prāptuṃ dṛḍhavratā ।
gṛhe tvārādhayāmāsa vrataiśca vividhaiḥ satī ।।43 ।।
īṣaśuklā'ṣṭamīnandātithāvānarca śaṃkaram ।
guḍaudanaiḥ salavaṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ ।।44।।
kārtikasya caturdaśyāmapūpaiḥ pāyasairapi ।
ṣoḍaśādyupacāraiśca pupūja śaṃkaraṃ satī ।।45।।
mārgaśīrṣe'sitāṣṭamyāṃ satilaiḥ sa yavaudane ।
ṣoḍaśādyupacāraiśca pupūja śaṃkaraṃ satī ।।46।।
pauṣe tu śuklasaptamyāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi ।
prātaḥ sā kṛśarānnena pupūja śaṃkaraṃ satī ।।47।।
māghe tu pūrṇamāsyāṃ sā kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi ।
ārdravastrā nadītīre'karocchaṃkarapūjanam ।।48।।
phālgune śivarātryāṃ ca vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ niśi ।
śailūṣaiḥ ṣoḍaśārthaiśca sā''narca taṃ divāniśam ।।49।।
caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ palāśairdamanaiḥ śivam ।
ṣoḍaśādyupacāraiśca divā rātrāvapūjayat ।।1.171.50।।
rādhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ tilāhārayavaudanaiḥ ।
navaiśca ṣoḍaśāthaiṃścā'pūjayacchaṃkaraṃ satī ।।5 1 ।।
jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimārātrau nirāhārā ca śaṃkaram ।
vasanairbṛhatīpuṣpairapūjayadvrate satī ।।।2।।
āṣāḍhasya caturdaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ kṛṣṇa vāsasā ।
bṛhatīkusumaiḥ śaṃbhumapūjayadvrate satī ।।।5 3 ।।
śrāvaṇasya sitāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca sā śivam ।
yajñopavītairvāsobhiḥ pavitrairapyapūjayat ।।54।।
bhādre kṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ bahupuṣpaphalaiḥ satī ।
pūjayitvā caturdaśyāṃ cakāra jalabhojanam ।।55।।
nānāvidhapatrapuṣpaphalaistatkālajaiḥ satī ।
cakre suniyatā''hārā'dhikamāse śivavratam ।।56।।
nityaṃ ca sarvamāseṣu śivapūjāparāyaṇā ।
dṛḍhavratā'bhavadadevaṃ nānyat sasmāra taṃ vinā ।।57।।
itthaṃ nandāvrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ samāpya tāpasī satī ।
dadhyau śivaṃ vyavasthāsu yoginīva kṛtādarā ।।58 ।।
kṛśākṛśāṃgī tapasā tejomūrtiḥ surūpiṇī ।
jātā śivamayī saumyā śivāṃ'kā'rhaṇatāṃ gatā ।।59 ।।
janmajayantyāṃ satyāśca dvādaśābde mahotsave ।
dakṣeṇā''kāritā devā manavo'nye maharṣayaḥ ।। 1.171.60 ।।
tadā tu sarvato devā munayaścākhilāḥ priye ।
ahaṃ brahmā ca dikpālā lokapālāḥ surādayaḥ ।। 61 ।।
āśīrvādān pradātuṃ ca jagmurdakṣagṛhe tadā ।
satkṛtāśca mahatyāṃ vai sabhāyāṃ sarvadevatāḥ ।।62 ।।
āśīrvādān daduḥ satyai praṇanāma satī ca tān ।
pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭā satī puṣṭā tapasā'rdhāpi nāsti yat ।।6 3 ।।
dṛṣṭvā satītapastādṛk jñātvā śivārthameva tat ।
prasannāḥ sarvadevādyāścakrurdevyai natiṃ muhuḥ ।। 64।।
prāhuḥ sati! tapaścātikaṣṭapradaṃ tu mā kuru ।
avaśyaṃ te patiḥ śarvo mahādevo bhaviṣyati ।। 65।।
āśīrvādānprayujyaivaṃ gṛhītvā'rhaṇamityatha ।
praśaśaṃsustapastasyāḥ siddhāvasthāṃ gatāṃ satīm ।। 66 ।।
dakṣoktiṃ ca satīcchāṃ ca samprāpya munayaḥ surāḥ ।
pūjāṃ prāpya satīṃ natvā jagmuḥ kailāsabhūbhṛtam ।। 67।।
sāvitrīhito brahmā lakṣmīnārāyaṇastathā ।
ramayā sahito viṣṇurdevībhiḥ sahitāḥ surāḥ ।। 68। ।
saptarṣayaḥ svapatnībhiḥ sahitā manavastathā ।
jagmuḥ kailāsaśikharaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ।।69।।
gatvā śaṃbhuṃ praṇamyaiva dṛṣṭvā śāntaṃ ca yoginam ।
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbaddhāṃjalipuṭā mudā ।।1.171.70 ।।
namo'kṣarasvarūpāya kṛṣṇanetrātmane namaḥ ।
namaḥ sadāśivākhyāya tejaḥpūjāya te namaḥ ।।7 1।।
vairājaputrarūpāya brahmacaryāya te namaḥ ।
namo brahmasvarūpāya sadā śāntāya te namaḥ ।।।72।।
nirguṇāya guṇāḍhyāya vaiṣṇavāya namonamaḥ ।
avyaktarātridehāya nirvikārāya te namaḥ ।।73।।
maheśāya pareśāya śivā'dhipataye namaḥ ।
kvacicchāntikṛte kādācitkasaṃhāriṇe namaḥ ।।74।।
namaḥ śeṣāya saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpāya te namaḥ ।
namo vairāgyavāsāya satīrāgāya te namaḥ ।।75।।
na yasya devā ṛṣayaḥ siddhāḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ ।
viduḥ padaṃ svarūpaṃ ca tasmai śivāya te namaḥ ।।76।।
padaṃ didṛkṣavo yasya yatante yoginaḥ sadā ।
tasmai namaḥ pareśāya yogasthāya namonamaḥ ।।77।।
anantasiddhiyuktāya girāṃ dūrāya te namaḥ ।
nama ātmaprakāśāya nirvāṇasthāya te namaḥ ।।78।।
jñānine te namaścāstu niṣkriyāyā''tmavedine ।
tapasā drāk prasannāya sarvadātre ca te namaḥ ।।79।।
trinetrāya sacandrāya sarvādhyakṣāya te namaḥ ।
śaraṇāyātaprārthyārthalābhadāya ca te namaḥ ।।1.171.8 0।।
aiśvaryāṇāṃ pradātre te mokṣadāya ca te namaḥ ।
bhakteṣṭapūrakāyā'mnāyodadhaye ca te namaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
svaprakāśāya nityāya pratyakdraṣṭre ca te namaḥ ।
sakāmā vātha niṣkāmā bhaktāste śaraṇāgatāḥ ।।82।।
aprāpya siddhiṃ yasmānna nivartante ca te namaḥ ।
kācitkanyā tvadarthaṃ vai karoti tapa utkaṭam ।।83 ।।
tvaṃ kathaṃ cā'karuṇo'si prasanno bhava te namaḥ ।
lokakāryapravāhārthaṃ vicāraṃ kuru śaṃkara ।।84।।
adhyātmayogagamya tvāṃ praṇamāmaḥ stumo vayam ।
na tvaṃ devo'suro martyo na tiryaṅn dvijaḥ paśuḥ ।।85।।
na strī na ṣaṃḍho na pumān yo'si so'si ca te namaḥ ।
viśvalayakṛte viśvadhāriṇe praṇatā vayam ।।86 ।।
sāṃkhyā jñānena paśyanti samādhau yoginaśca yam ।
bhaktāḥ kṛpayā paśyanti trayīmayaṃ ca te namaḥ ।।87।।
namo bhaktoddhārakartre namaste gūḍhavarcase ।
namaḥ pratyakṣadevāya cā'parokṣānubhūtaye ।।88।।
kālarātrivilāsāya dakṣaputryārthitāya ca ।
pravṛttāya namastubhyaṃ nivṛttāya ca te namaḥ ।।89 ।।
bhaktecchāpūraka! svāmin pūrayecchāṃ ca vedhasaḥ ।
tūṣṇīmāsannitistutvā śrutvā śaṃbhurjahāsa vai ।। 1.171.90 ।।
dṛṣṭvā devamunīṃścānyān sastrīkāँśca yathocitam ।
svāgataṃ cātitheyaṃ ca kṛtvā papraccha kāraṇam ।। 91 ।।
he viṣṇo he vidhe devā he munipravararṣayaḥ ।
nijāgamanahetuṃ vai kathayadhvaṃ yathārthataḥ ।। 92।।
sastrīkā āgatāḥ sarve kiṃ kāryaṃ vidyate mama ।
iti pṛṣṭāstadā brahmā viṣṇunā parinoditaḥ ।। 93 ।।
prāha śaṃbhuṃ miṣṭavāṇyā deva te'viditaṃ nahi ।
tathāpi lokadharmatvātkathanīyaṃ śṛṇu prabho ।। 94।।
viśeṣataḥ sahārthārthā vayaṃ suranarādayaḥ ।
asurā vahudhā sṛṣṭau jāyante ca muhurmuhuḥ ।। 95।।
tatra kecinmama vadhyā harervadhyāśca kecana ।
atikrūrāstava vadhyā devīvadhyāstathā'pare ।। 96 ।।
anye tvadvīryaputrasya vadhyāścāpi bhavanti vai ।
anāśayitvā tānduṣṭān jagatsvāsthyaṃ na nirbhayam ।। 97।।
tvayi rāgadveṣaśūnye yogamārge sthite sati ।
dayāmātrasvabhāve te naṣṭā na syuḥ kadācana ।। 98।।
tapaḥ prakurvatāṃ teṣāṃ varaiḥ puṣṭiryadi dhruvā ।
tadā tu sātviko sṛṣṭiḥ kathaṃ susthā bhaviṣyati ।। 99 ।।
ataśca bhavitā yuktamayukteṣūcchriteṣu vai ।
sṛṣṭisthityantakarpāṇi kāryāṇyasmābhireva ha ।। 1.171.100 ।।
vayaṃ tvekasvarūpā hi bhinnāḥ kāryasya bhedataḥ ।
kāryabhedo na siddhaśced rūpabhedo'prayojanaḥ ।। 101 ।।
ahaṃ viṣṇuśca sastrīkau sujātau kāryahetutaḥ ।
tathā tvamapi sastrīko bhava viśvahitāya vai ।। 10 2। ।
parigṛhṇīṣva bhāryārthe rāmāmekāṃ suśobhanām ।
striyaṃ vivāhya lokasya kuru kāryaṃ mahattamam ।। 103 ।।
yathā padmālayā viṣṇoḥ sāvitrī ca yathā mama ।
tathā sahacarīṃ śaṃbho kāntāṃ gṛhṇīṣva kāminīm ।। 1 04।।
śaṃbhurvihasya brahmāṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca prāha tāttvikam ।
he brahman he hare me stho yuvāṃ priyatarau sadā ।। 1 05।।
yuvayordarśanādadyā''nando me jāyate'dhikaḥ ।
bhavadbhyāṃ tu madarthaṃ yanniścitaṃ vyāvahārikam ।। 10 6।।
yuktameva bhavet kintu me hṛdi rocate nahi ।
tapasvino viraktasya yogamārgā'tigasya ca ।। 1 07।।
jñāninaḥ kāmaśūnyasya svātmārāmasya sarvathā ।
nivṛttasyā''tmadraṣṭuśca kāminyā kiṃ prayojanam ।। 108 ।।
ātmano yogalagnasya mamā''nandaḥ sadā'sti vai ।
nānyasaṃsargasaṃprāptā''nandaśeṣī bhavāmyaham ।। 1 09।।
vivāho bandhanaṃ raudraṃ dvayoreva parasparam ।
yoginastatkimarthaṃ vai nirāśasya balānnayet ।। 1.171.110 ।।
tasmātpatnyā rucirme no satyaṃ vaḥ pravadāmyaham ।
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā śrutvā śaṃbhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇadarśitam ।। 11 1।।
goloke yatpratijñātaṃ sṛṣṭau kāryaṃ yadā bhavet ।
yadāvaśyakatā te syāttadā dāsye vibhāvarīm ।। 1 12।।
kāle gṛhītvā prakṛtiṃ śṛṃgāraṃ ca kariṣyasi ।
kāle gṛhī tathā kāle tapasvī bhava vāṃcchayā ।। 11 3।।
vidhuro maṃgalāyā'tra kalpyate nahi kutracit ।
vidhurasya sastrīkeṣu vāso'pi bhayado bhavet ।। 1 14।।
samo bhūtvā sameṣveva mānyo bhavati nā'samaḥ ।
sameṣu viṣamo naśyet naśyeyurviṣamātsamāḥ ।। 1 15।।
sṛṣṭiśāsanakartṝṇāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ samānatā ।
sadā cāpekṣyate tasmāt sapatnīko bhavā'dhunā ।। 11 6।।
nahi vai vidhuro bhrātā strīṣu viśvāsabhūmikaḥ ।
nahi yajñādipaitryādikārye yogyo vinā strīyam ।। 1 17।।
amaṃgalaḥ sadā nārīśūnyo bhavati karmaṭhaḥ ।
akarmaṭhastathā nārīyuktaścā'maṃgalo bhavet ।। 1 18।।
sūṣṭikāryādhikṛtastvaṃ śaṃbho mā'maṃgalo vasa ।
sadā sumaṃgalo bhūtvā tiṣṭhā'smatsu vicārya ca ।। 11 9।।
saṃsmṛtya kṛṣṇavacanaṃ sadāro bhava śaṃkara ।
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ viṣṇoḥ smṛtvā kṛṣṇoktimityatha ।। 1.171.120 ।।
nityasiddhaśivāprāptiṃ dharmaṃ vicārya śaṃkaraḥ ।
prāha viṣṇo kariṣyāmi bhavaduktaṃ sadā hitam ।। 121 ।।
matvā vaco gariṣṭhaṃ vo niyogaṃ śrīharestathā ।
kariṣyāmi vivāhaṃ vai kṛṣṇavaśyo'smyahaṃ sadā ।। 122।।
parantu yādṛśīṃ kāntāṃ grahīṣyāmi śṛṇuśva tām ।
yā me tejo grahītuṃ dhārayituṃ sudṛḍhā bhavet ।। 1 23।।
ahaṃ yogī yathā jñānī sāpi matsadṛśī bhavet ।
raṇe yoge ca vijñāne guṇaiśvarye ratau samā ।। 124।।
evaṃ na cedvinodvāhaṃ sthātavyaṃ sukhataḥ sadā ।
tasmājjāyāṃ prādiśa tvaṃ matsamā vartate yadi ।। 125।।
tatrāpyekaḥ paṇo me syāt tayā bhāvyaṃ tathā mayi ।
aviśvāso madukte cet mayā tyaktā bhaviṣyati ।। 126।।
iti śaṃbhorvacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇurbrahmā vihasya tam ।
prāhaturyādṛśī preṣṭhā te'styasmābhiḥ sumārgitā ।। 127।।
goloke kṛṣṇahṛdayāt yā śivā netrayoḥ sthitā ।
vairājanetrayoḥ sthitvā devendriyeṣu taijasī ।। 128।।
sthitā yā śeṣaśāyiśrīharerindriyama ṇḍale ।
rātrirvibhāvarī śaṃbho yā śivā vāmagā ca te ।। 129।।
apṛthaksiddhasambaddhā sā satī dakṣaputrikā ।
tvādṛśī sā bhaved bhāryā'dhikatejobalānvitā ।। 1.171.13 0।।
sā tapasyati deveśa tvadarthaṃ hi dṛḍhavratā ।
tvāṃ patiṃ prāptukāmā sā dakṣagehe'sti kanyakā ।। 131 ।।
dātuṃ gaccha varaṃ tasyai kṛpāṃ kuru maheśvara ।
tāṃ vivāhaya suprītyā varaṃ dattvā yatheṣṭadam ।। 132।।
atrāgatānāṃ devānāṃ saṃkalpaṃ paripūraya ।
maṃgalaṃ paramaṃ bhūyāt paśyāmaśca tadutsavam ।। 133।।।
śrutvā tu śaṃkaraḥ prāha omiti svīkṛtaṃ mayā ।
yāmi tapaḥphalaṃ dātuṃ bhavanto yāntu bho surāḥ ।। 134।
punarvo darśanaṃ bhāvyaṃ vivāhotsavakarmaṇi ।
ityājñaptāḥ satkṛtāśca brahmaviṣṇusurādayaḥ ।। 135।।
datvā''śīrvādavacanaṃ 'saphalo'stu manorathaḥ' ।
jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketaṃ te sastrīkāścātiharṣitāḥ ।। 1 36।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃbhorvairājalalāṭādutpattiḥ, śivāyā dakṣagṛhe prākaṭyottaraṃ brahmanāradāgamaḥ, nāradakathitacihnarekhābhiḥ śivapatnī-
tvaniścayena satyā vārṣikatapovratakaraṇam, dvādaśe vārṣikasatījanmajayantyā utsave brahmaviṣṇusurāṇāṃ sastrīkānāmāgamanaṃ, satītapaḥ prekṣya brahmādīnāṃ kailāsagamanaṃ, satīpāṇigrahaṇavaradānārthaṃ śaṃkarāyopadeśa ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 171 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 171 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 172
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 173 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ me priye lakṣmi priyārthaṃ śaṃbhurutsukaḥ ।
gantu dakṣagṛhaṃ cintāṃ cakārodbuddhabhāvanaḥ ।। 1 ।।
atho satī punaḥ śuklapakṣe'ṣṭamyāmupoṣitā ।
āśvine pūjayāmāsa ṣoḍaśārthaiśca śaṃkaram ।। 2 ।।
itthaṃ nandāvrate pūrṇe navamyāṃ divase haraḥ ।
sarvāṃgasundaro devaḥ pratyakṣamabhavacchivaḥ ।। 3 ।।
gauravarṇaḥ paṃcavaktrastrinetraścandraśekharaḥ ।
prasannātmā nīlakaṇṭhaścaturbāhuḥ savāsukiḥ ।। 4 ।।
triśūlarudrākṣavarakamalabhasmaśobhitaḥ ।
gaṃgayā śobhitajaṭaḥ sarvāṃgasvarṇasannibhaḥ ।। 5 ।।
mahālāvaṇyasaundaryasaukumāryaśarīrakaḥ ।
koṭikāmātikāntaśca koṭicandrasamānanaḥ ।। 6 ।।
udbhinnayauvanākrāntaḥ sarvathā strīmanoharaḥ ।
pratyakṣaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā satī matvā svakaṃ dhanam ।। 7 ।।
atīva hṛdi saṃhṛṣṭā sulajjāvanatānanā ।
vavande caraṇau śaṃbhoścakṣurbhyāmapibanmukham ।। 8 ।।
manasā'rpitasarvasvā'manyata svāṃ mahodayām ।
tato harastu bhāryārthamicchannapi manaḥpriyām ।। 9 ।।
satyāḥ hṛdayabhāvotthāṃ prītiṃ vettaṃ tu śāśvatīm ।
śrotuṃ priyāṇi vākyāni satīṃ prāha kṛtavratām ।। 1.172.1 0।।
surūpāṃ subhagāṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ prāptālpayauvanām ।
svārpitāṃ ca svakāṃ patnīṃ kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoha ca ।। 1 1।।
jagāda suvrate kanye! prīto'smyanena dakṣaje ।
nandāvratena saṃdāsye varaṃ varaya cepsitam ।। 12।।
tadā satī trapāyuktā'bhavatpremapariplutā ।
yajñopavītaṃ saṃgṛhya hṛtsthaṃ vaktuṃ śaśāka na ।। 13।।
jñātvā hārdaṃ sadākāntaḥ prasanno'tīva śaṃkaraḥ ।
varaṃ brūhi varaṃ brūhi varaṃ brṛhi punaḥ punaḥ ।। 14।।
sāptapadīnamevā'tra maitryamicchan jagāda tām ।
satī prāha-vrataṃ prekṣya, tapaḥ prekṣya, vilokya hṛt ।। 15।।
dṛṣṭvā'vasthāṃ, prekṣya bhargacitraṃ yallikhitaṃ mayā ।
jñātvopavītagrahaṇaṃ, dūrācca bhavadāgamam ।। 16।।
sāptapadīnaṃ yanmaitryaṃ varaṃ dehi yadicchasi ।
tato vākyasyābhihārdamanuprāpya sphuṭaṃ haraḥ ।। 17।।
gāha vākyaprapūrtyarthaṃ -'dehi te'rdhāṃganātmakam ।
kathaṃ na vākyaśeṣārthaṃ priye jñāpayasi drutam ।। 18।।
dattaṃ maitryaṃ mama bhāryā bhaveti varadānakam ।
prāpya śaṃbhorvaco miṣṭaṃ premamagnā'bhavat satī ।। 19।।
tūṣṇīṃ tasthau ca muditā varaṃ prāpya manogatam ।
satṛṣṇamānasā cāruhāsyayuktānanā satī ।।1.172.20।।
akaronnijabhāvāँśca hāvānpremavivardhakān ।
hāvabhāvavilāsāँśca samāśritya tayorhṛdi ।।21।।
śṛṃgārapremarasaḥ saṃviveśā''śu tayostadā ।
kā'pyabhikhyā prādurāsīllokalīlā'nukurvatoḥ ।।22।।
reje satī haraṃ prāpya candraṃ prāpyeva śarvarī ।
sukhaṃ vakṣasi saṃśliṣya ciraṃ sparśaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 23 ।।
satyuvāca haraṃ premṇā karau badhvā natānanā ।
devadeva patideva vivāhavidhinā prabho ।।।24।।
piturme gocarīkṛtya gṛhītvā yāhi māṃ vibho ।
sāgrahaṃ tadvacaḥ śrutvā śaṃkaraḥ sarvaśaṃkaraḥ ।। 25।।
tathāstviti pratibhāṣya nirīkṣya premataśca tām ।
śanairbhāvīti matvā'sau kṣaṇaṃ cintāṃ jagāma saḥ ।। 26।।।
tāvat satī haraṃ natvā gṛhītvā''jñāṃ sasaṃbhramā ।
śaṃkarāgamanaṃ mātre śaṃsituṃ satvaraṃ gatā ।। 27।।
asiknī kanyayā proktaṃ viditvā satvaraṃ bahiḥ ।
bhāvijāmātṝūpaṃ saṃdraṣṭuṃ yāvatprayāti vai ।। 28।।
tāvacchaṃbhuṃ manāk dṛṣṭvā sphaṭikojjvalavarṣmakam ।
atīva mumude'siknī śaṃbhustvadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।29।।
jāmātaraṃ sutāyogyaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvinamuttamam ।
dhyātvā tameva hṛdaye paraṃ bhāgyamamanyata ।। 1.172.30 ।।
haro'pi svīyakailāsaṃ gatvā praviśya cāśramam ।
brahmāṇaṃ cintayāmāsa lokarītyanusārataḥ ।। 31 ।।
brahmā tūrṇaṃ sarasvatyā sahitastatra cā''yayau ।
dṛṣṭvā tu vedhasaṃ śaṃbhuḥ premabaddho hyuvāca tam ।। 32।।
ahamārādhitaḥ satyā dakṣaputryā'tibhaktitaḥ ।
tasyai varo mayā datto nandāvrataphalātmakaḥ ।। 33।।
satyā'rthitaṃ patideva vivāhavidhinā prabho ।

śīghraṃ yathā tathā taṃ ca pravakṣyāmi ca śaṃ kuru ।
kailāse brahmaṇā śaṃbhorevaṃ vārtā pravartate ।। 3 9।।
etasminnantare'siknī dakṣaṃ prāha satīvratam ।
tapastaptvā varaṃ prāpya mano'bhilaṣitaṃ satī ।।1.172.40 ।।
śaṃkaradarśanaṃ labdhvā kṛtakṛtyā hyajāyata ।

dakṣe jijñāsite sarvaṃ samācakhyau satīvratam ।

mātā pitā ca vṛttāntaṃ sarvaṃ śrutvā satīmukhāt ।
ānandaṃ paramaṃ lebhe cakre ca paramotsavam ।।।43 ।।
satī nandāvratasyā'nte lebhe śaṃbhoḥ pradarśanam ।
tannimittaṃ vratapūrtau mahotsavamakārayat ।।44।।
dadau dānāni viprebhyo dravyaratnā'mbarāṇi ca ।
anyebhyaścāndhadīnebhyo vīriṇyapi dadau dhanam ।।45।।
satī ca svavayasyābhyaḥ kanyābhyo bhojanaṃ dadau ।
dhanavastra'bhyaṃjanādidravyāṇi ca dadau mudā ।।।46।।।
vīriṇī tā samāliṃgya svaputrīṃ siddhabhāvanām ।
mūrdhnyupāghrāya muditā praśaśaṃsa muhurmuhuḥ ।।47।।
dakṣo'tha cintayāmāsā''gato'pi śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
pratinivṛtto me kanyāmagṛhītvā kathaṃ gataḥ ।।48 ।।
āgato'pi mahādevaḥ prasanno nirjagāma ha ।
punarevaṃ kathaṃ so'pi sutā'rthe'trā''gamiṣyati ।।49।।
kena yogena deyeyaṃ svasutā śaṃbhave'dhunā ।
prasthāpyo'tha mayā kāścicchaṃbhornikaṭamaṃjasā ।।।1.172.50 ।।

śaṃbhurbhavatu madbhartetyevaṃ punaravāpnuyāt ।

sarasvatyā sahitaścopasthito bhāvatastadā ।
dakṣastaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyā'vanato'bhavat ।।53 ।।
dadāvāsanamagryaṃ cā'rhaṇāṃ cakretibhaktitaḥ ।
papracchā''gamane hetuṃ snehaṃ kāryaṃ ca vā param ।।54।।
brahmovāca śṛṇu dakṣa yadarthamahamāgataḥ ।
tava putryā tapastaptvā mahādevaṃ prasādya ca ।।55।।

varadānottaraṃ rudrastvatsutā hṛdye sthitām ।।57।।
dhyātvā smṛtvā punaścemāṃ na śarma labhateṃ'jasā ।

satīṃ vicintayannāste vyākulaḥ prākṛto yathā ।
prakṛtāṃ sārthakāṃ vāṇīṃ parityajya gaṇān kvacit ।।59 ।।

mayā tvayā ca kāmena kṛṣṇena ṛṣibhistathā ।। 1.172.60 ।।
pūrvaṃ yadvāñcchitaṃ cāsīt siddhaṃ tadadhunā dhruvam ।
tvatputryārādhitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ śaṃbhunā''rādhyate satī ।।6 1 ।।
tasmāddakṣa sutāṃ svīyāṃ śaṃbhvarthaṃ parikalpitām ।

satīṃ tasmai saṃprayaccha vivāhavidhinā suta ।।63 ।।
dakṣaḥ śrutvā piturvākyaṃ tatheti prāha harṣitaḥ ।

tasmāttvaṃ nāradaṃ caiva marīcyādīṃśca sanmunīn ।

anye ca vāhane bhinne bhinne sthitāḥ śivecchayā ।

rathasthāḥ sūryacandrādyā gajasthā indradevatāḥ ।।88 ।।
vimānayānavāhasthāḥ ṛṣayo munayastadā ।

śobhitā divyanārībhirdevamūrticamatkṛtā ।
prāpad dakṣarājadhānīsamope śaṃbhvadhiṣṭhitā ।।92।।

dakṣālayaṃ tadā prāpyā''saneṣu munayaḥ sthitāḥ ।

dhārmikāṇāṃ janānāṃ ca rakṣārthaṃ ca gavāṃ satām ।

agnikāryaṃ yathoddiṣṭamakārṣīcca suvistaram ।

tiṣṭhantyeva ca tatraiva sadā brahmavratā hi te ।। 1 46।।
athā'nye ca kaṇā vastre saṃlagnāste tadā punaḥ ।
bālakhilyāśca vai ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇyabhavaँśca te ।। 147।।
aṃguṣṭhaparvamātrāśca sūryasya kiraṇāni vai ।
pibantaḥ sūryasāmmukhye dhāvanti pṛṣṭhapādataḥ ।। 148 ।।
mandehānāmarakṣāṃsi nāśayanti ca te'nvaham ।
nityaṃ brahmavaradānājjīvanti nāśayanti tān ।। 149 ।।
atha tadbhagavān śaṃbhurjñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā ।
kimetadvihitaṃ brahman kopādetaduvāca ha ।। 1.172.150 ।।
ityeṣa hantuṃ brahmāṇaṃ śūlamudyamya śaṃkaraḥ ।
sannaddhaḥ sa niṣiddhaśca pratiruddho maharṣibhiḥ ।। 151 ।।
śikṣitaśca tadā sarvaiḥ trayāṇāmaikyamityapi ।
na brahmā bhavato bhinno na bhavo brahmabhedavān ।। 152।।
na viṣṇurdvayato bhinnastrayāṇāmaikyamasti hi ।
śirogrīvādibhedena yathaikasyaiva varṣmaṇaḥ ।। 153 ।।
aṃgāni ca tathā devāstrayo'bhinnāḥ parātmanaḥ ।
svasvarūpe brahmaṇi te śaṃbho kopo na yujyate ।। 154।।
śrutvaivaṃ śaṃkaraḥ śāntaḥ saṃprāha vedhasaṃ punaḥ ।
svaśiraḥ spṛśa hastena madājñāṃ kurvasaṃśayam ।। 155।।
brahmā nijakareṇa svaṃ śiraḥ spṛśati yāvatā ।
tāvadbrahmo'bhavatsadyo vṛṣabho vāhanaṃ param ।। 156।।
tatpṛṣṭhe ca svayaṃ śaṃbhurniṣasāda niyāmakaḥ ।
āhā'nena svarūpeṇa madadhiṣṭhitakena ca ।। 157।।
tapaḥ kuru ca te khyātiḥ rudraśiro bhaviṣyati ।
brahmāṃśo vṛṣabhastatra śaṃkarāṃśo niyāmakaḥ ।। 158।।
bhūtvā vivāhavedyāṃ ca sarvadā tau vyavasthitau ।
atha mūlasvarūpeṇa brahmā śaṃbhvājñayā tadā ।। 159।।
śeṣaṃ vaivāhikaṃ karma samāptimanayat drutam ।
papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca śivāśivaśiraskayoḥ ।। 1.172.160 ।।
vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu gāyamāneṣu teṣu ca ।
paṭhatsu vipravargeṣu vedān bhaktyanviteṣu ca ।। 16 1।।
raṃbhādiṣu purandhrīṣu nṛtyamānāsu sādaram ।
mahotsavo mahānāsīt devapatnīṣu padmaje ।। 162।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tvayā brahman kṛtaṃ vaivāhikaṃ ca yat ।
gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇāṃ koṭiṃ svācāryo'si sulagnakṛt ।। 163।।
gṛhītā dakṣiṇā cātha brahmaṇā prārthitaṃ tadā ।
gantavyaṃ svagṛhaṃ sarvaiḥ sthātavyaṃ naiva śiṣyate ।। 164।।
tato dakṣa samāmantrya patnyā satyā saheśvaraḥ ।
gantumanā hyabhūt tāvat dakṣastuṣṭāva śaṃkaram ।। 165।।
surāśca munayo viprā ṛṣayo viṣṇusevakāḥ ।
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ sūryaścandra indrādayastathā ।। 166।।
svasvakuṭumbaparivārānvitā yayurīśvaram ।
āropya vṛṣabhe śaṃbhuḥ satīṃ dakṣājñayā mudā ।। 167।।
cālayāmāsa vṛṣabhaṃ kailāsaṃ svālayaṃ prati ।
kecidvādyānvādayanto gāyantaḥ susvaraṃ pare ।। 168।।
śivaṃ śivayaśaḥ śuddhamanujagmuḥ śivaṃ mudā ।
madhyamārgādvisṛṣṭo hi dakṣaḥ prītyā'tha śaṃbhunā ।। 169।।
svadhāma prāpa sagaṇaḥ śaṃbhuḥ premasamākulaḥ ।
tatra gatvā'khilān devān munīnapi parāँstathā ।। 1.172.170।।
mudā visarjayāmāsa bahu sammānya sādaram ।
śaṃbhumābhāṣya bhojyādi gṛhītvā kṛṣṇadevatāḥ ।। 171 ।।
viṣṇvādyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ dhāma yayurmudā ।
śivo'pi mudito'tyarthaṃ navavadhvā samaṃ muhuḥ ।। 172।।
kailāsācalasaṃstho hi vijahāra yathāsukham ।
iti lakṣmi! śaṃkarasyā''khyāto vivāhasūtsavaḥ ।। 173।।
vivāhasamaye yajñe prāraṃbhe vā śṛṇoti yaḥ ।
tasyā'vighnaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ karma vaivāhikaṃ śubham ।। 174।।
kanyā ca sukhasaubhāgyaśīlācāraguṇānvitā ।
sādhvī syātputriṇī dhanyā sarvasmṛddhiyutā gṛhe ।। 175।।
athā'yaṃ śaṃkaro yogī viveśa girikandaram ।
gaṇānniryāpayāmāsa nandyādīn prāha tāṃstadā ।। 176।।
yadāhaṃ ca smarāmyatra smaraṇādaramānasāḥ ।
samāgamiṣyatha tadā matpārśvaṃ me gaṇā drutam ।। 177।।
kailāse te gaṇāḥ sarve nānāsthāneṣu saṃyayuḥ ।
śaṃbhurvadhvā samaṃ reme vinā kāmaratiṃ tadā ।। 178।।
kvacidgṛthitvā puṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ satyai nyavedayat ।
kvacicca darpaṇe satyā sahā''nanaṃ vyalokayat ।। 179।।
kadācitkuṇḍale satyāḥ karṇayorapyadhārayat ।
kadācitpattale cāsyā raktenā'raṃjayaddharaḥ।।1.172.180
keśaveśaṃ kadācitsveṃ'ke niṣādya hyakalpayat ।
lalāṭe patrikāṃ śaṃbhuścandanenā'karotkvacit ।। 18 1।।
āhṛtya padmapuṣpāṇi ramyapuṣpāṇi śaṃkaraḥ ।
sarvāṃgeṣu karoti sma puṣpā''bharaṇamādarāt ।। 182।।
evaṃ bahuvidhairmārgaiḥ reme satīṃ vinodayan ।
tayā vinā sma no yāti nā''sthito na sma ceṣṭate ।। 18 3।।
tayā vinā kṣaṇamapi śarma lebhe na śaṃkaraḥ ।
agamaddhimavatprasthaṃ sasmāra svecchayā smaram ।। 184।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyai śaṃkaradarśanaṃ, bhāryā bhaveti varadānaṃ, śaṃbhoḥ kailāsagamanaṃ, brahmaṇo dakṣagṛhaṃ prati preṣaṇaṃ, kailāsaṃ pratyāgamanaṃ ca, śaṃkarasya janavāhinyā dakṣagṛhaṃ prati gamanaṃ, satīvivāhaḥ, satyāṃ rūpe mohitabrahmaṇo retaḥpatanaṃ, tena meghānāṃ vālakhilyānāmutpattiḥ, janavāhinyāḥ kailāsaṃ pratyāgamanam, janavāhavargavisarjanaṃ, kailāsakandare satīśaṃkarayorviharaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 172 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 172 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 173
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 174 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi himādrau tu tayorviharatostadā ।
kāmasmṛtyā kāmadevaḥ praviṣṭastatra sannidhau ।। 1 ।।
tasminpraviṣṭe śaṃbhau ca satyāṃ ca kāmanā śubhā ।
samabhavattadā śaṃbhorbhāvaṃ vijñāya sarvathā ।। 2 ।।
vasantaḥ svasya kartavyaṃ samārebhe harāntike।
mandasugandhaśaityāḍhyo vavau ca malayo marut ।। 3 ।।
vṛkṣāśca puṣpitāḥ sarve latāśca puṣpitāstadā ।
virejire palāśāśca kiṃśukaiḥ raktakomalaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
kamalāni vicitrāṇi saraḥsvapi virejire ।
padmapuṣpāḍhyapavano vavau tatra harāntike ।। 5 ।।
nāgakeśarapuṣpāṇi svarṇavarṇasugandhibhiḥ ।
manojñānyabhavaँstatra śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 6 ।।
sugandhagandhasaṃpṛktā nāgavallī ca mārutam ।
satī śaṃkaranikaṭe prairayanmohakārakam ।। 7 ।।
kokilāśca tadānīṃ susvaraṃ jagurmanoharam ।
āmrāḥ praphullitāḥ patramaṃjarībhirbabhustadā ।। 8 ।।
jalāni nirmalānyabhirejuśca phullakāśakāḥ ।
jyotiścakrāṇi saṃrejurvāsantikaprabhādibhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
kaumudyā saha raktāśca vibhāvaryo'bhavan priyāḥ ।
śādvalāḥ supradeśāścā'bhavan kāmasukhapradāḥ ।। 1.173.1 0।।
nadīṣu ca nikuṃjeṣu kandarīṣu sthalīṣu ca ।
reme satyā samaṃ śaṃbhurvireje śaṃbhunā satī ।। 11 ।।
ramayāmāsa deveśaṃ vividhābhistu kelibhiḥ ।
harastu puṣpamālābhiḥ priyāṃ śṛṃgārayatyapi ।। 1 2।।
kabarīkaraṇairaṃke svāpanaiścūmbanaistathā ।
santoṣayati cālāpairhāsyavīkṣaṇamardanaiḥ ।। 12 ।।
tadvaktraśaśyadharā'mṛtapānamattatāṃ gatā ।
nānāvidhāsanasetumādideśa priyai tadā ।। 14।।
satyā vaktrasugandhena saundaryeṇa ca narmaṇā ।
premṇā ratyā subaddho'yaṃ śaṃkaraḥ saṃtutoṣa ha ।। 15 ।।
ityevaṃ himavacchṛṅge ramayitvā satīṃ śivaḥ ।
kailāsamagamat svasya nivāse śāntimāvahat ।। 16 ।।
tāpakālo vyatītaśca yadā meghāgamo'bhavat ।
satī prāha tadā śaṃbhuṃ śṛṇu me vacanaṃ priya ।। 17।।
ghanāgamo'yaṃ samayo meghā varṣanti sarvadā ।
pravānti vātā hṛdyaṃ kampayantyativeginaḥ ।। 18 ।।
sthalyaḥ sarvatra saṃklinnāḥ kardamāḍhyā anāśrayā ।
vṛkṣā vallyaḥ prabhinnāśca samārdrā jalasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 19।।
meghānāṃ garjanā vidyudvilāsāḥ prabhavanti ca ।
meghacchannau na dṛśyete sūryācandramasau divi ।। 1.173.20।।
vātāhatā mahāvṛkṣāḥ patanti trāsadā bhuvi ।
vyāghrāḥ siṃhā mahākrūrā viṣavantaśca dehinaḥ ।।21 ।।
bhramanti nirjane'raṇye śītoṣṇā'nilavahnayaḥ ।
ete cānye duḥkhadāśca vighnā bhavanti sarvadā ।। 22।।
tasmāt kvacinnivāsārthaṃ gṛhaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā'dhunā ।
yatracchāyā sukhaśayyā pānabhojanavaibhavāḥ ।। 23 ।।
rakṣituṃ ca bhaveyurvai śakyāḥ sāmayikāḥ sadā ।
yadi virāmalābhāya saudhaṃ nāsti janasya tu ।। 24।।
tadā ko dāravahane lābho'sti vanavāsinaḥ ।
cakravākakapotādyā pakṣiṇo'pi nirāśrayāḥ ।।25।।
prāpte kāle prakurvanti gṛhāṇi vṛkṣakoṭare ।
pipīlikāmūṣakādyāḥ kurvanti bhūgṛhāṇyapi ।। 26 ।।
tasmādgārhasthyadharmasyāṃgabhūtā'patyarakṣaṇam ।
gṛhe vai syānnirābādhaṃ sarvartusukhade dṛḍhe ।।27।।
anyāsāṃ madbhaginīnāṃ bhavanāni mahānti vai ।
divyānyasaṃkhyasmṛddhīni vartante nāsti me gṛham ।।28।।
prathame gṛhaśūnyatvaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃsārasāgare ।
dvitīyaṃ dhānyahīnatvaṃ tṛtīyaṃ dhanaśūnyatā ।।29 ।।
caturthaṃ nirapatyatvaṃ mālinyaṃ paṃcamaṃ matam ।
ṣaṣṭhaṃ rogakṛtamaitryaṃ saptamaṃ cā'gavādikam ।। 1.173.3 0।।
aṣṭamaṃ ca gṛhe kleśaḥ siṃhavṛṣabhabhoginām ।
etadduḥkhāṣṭakaṃ me'sti kiṃ gārhasthyena yoginaḥ ।। 31 ।।
yogī syānna bhavedbhogī bhogī syāt kintu yogitā ।
tasmādyogaphalaṃ duḥkhāṣṭakanāśe prayujyatām ।। 32।
paśyā'raṇye ca dāvāgnirbahudhā jāyate'tra vai ।
prarohanti ca sasyāni nibīḍāni nivāsane ।।33 ।।
śyāmalā rājatā raktā viśadāstṛṇajātayaḥ ।
āsanasthalabhūmau vai prarohanti prakardamāḥ ।। 34।।
asamaśrīśca kuṭilā sthalī sevyā'tiduḥkhadāḥ ।
nidrāyāṃ ratiyoge vā madhyarātrau bhayaṃkarāḥ ।।35 ।।
śabdāḥ śrūyanta ugrāśca kāryadhvaṃse'tiduḥkhadāḥ ।
madhyāhne tūlbaṇastāpo varṣādhārāśca duḥkhadāḥ ।।36 ।।
paśya me pādayostīkṣṇakaṇṭakānāṃ ca śāśvatī ।
kuṭikā saṃgatā tatra kaṇṭakāḥ santi kīdṛśāḥ ।।37।।
śarīre paśya me meghakarakāṇāṃ ca durnayam ।
patitvā chādayantyeva śarīraṃ śaityaduḥkhadam ।। 3 8।।
etasmin viṣame kāle nīḍaṃ kākāścakorakāḥ ।
kurvanti tvāṃ vinā gehān kathaṃ śāntimavāpsyasi ।। 39।।
mahatīvā'dya me bhītirmeghotthā jāyate hṛdi ।
tato yatasva saudhārthaṃ mā ciraṃ vacanānmama ।।1.173.40।।
bhāryā rakṣyā vane stheyaṃ ratiḥ svādyā na bhojanam ।
etatsarvaṃ vināśāya no sukhāya prajāyate ।।4 1 ।।
kailāse vā himādrau vā gaṃgātīre'thavā kṣitau ।
yatra kvāpi vāsayogyaṃ bhavanaṃ kuru śaṃkara ।। 42।।।
prāghūṇikāḥ samāgatya śāntā bhaveyurāśrame ।
dhanadhānyasmṛddhimati yathāpekṣaṃ tathā kuru ।। 43 ।।
śrutvā satīvyāhṛtaṃ ca matvā manasi sārthakam ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devyai rañjayanmānasaṃ muhuḥ ।।44।।
vada devī yatra meghā gacchantyeva nahi kvacit ।
tatra saudhaṃ kārayeyaṃ yadi te rocate śive ।।45 ।।
meghā nitambaparyantaṃ saṃcaranti mahīdhare ।
merau vā tādṛśe śṛṃge kurve te yadi rocate ।। 46।।
kailāsasya tathā devi nitambe prāyaśo ghanāḥ ।
varṣāsvapi pracaranti kurve te tatra rocate ।।47।।
aruṇācalaśṛṃgai ca nitambe prāyaśo ghanāḥ ।
saṃcaranti na gacchanti tata ūrdhvaṃ kadācana ।।48 ।।
saurāṣṭre raivate śaile svargaśṛṃge sutaijase ।
yatra meghā nitambasthā na gacchantyuparīti vā ।। 49 । ।
himālaye śivaśṛṃge meghā gacchanti naiva yat ।
yatrāsti candrajaṃ śaityaṃ kurve saudhaṃ tu rocate ।।1.173.5 0 ।।
ityeteṣu girīndreṣu tvayā dṛṣṭeṣu prāgbhave ।
manorucirbhavedyatra tamācakṣva drutaṃ hi me । । 5 1 । ।
yatra haime proccaśṛṃge siddhapatnyo vasanti vai ।
tatra te yadi vāñchāsti kurve tatra mahālayam ।।52 ।।
svarṇaśṛṃge yatra devyo nivasanti sakautukāḥ ।
tatra te yadi vāñcchā syāt kurve saudhaṃ suvarṇajam ।।5 3 ।।
āruṇe maṇikuṭṭe vā lokāloke'tha raivate ।
nāgakanyā girikanyāḥ kinnaryaḥ phaṇikanyakāḥ ।।।54।।
gāndharvyaścā'psaraso vidyādhryaḥ pravasanti ca ।
yatra tatra ruciste'sti kurve svargopamaṃ gṛham ।।61 । ।
sarvāstāḥ satataṃ sevāṃ kariṣyanti tava priye ।
anumodaiḥ sahayānaiḥ sahakrīḍādibhiḥ sadā ।।56 ।।
rūpaṃ tavedamatulaṃ vadanaṃ cāru vīkṣya tāḥ ।
tava dāsyo bhaviṣyanti helayitvā nijaṃ vapuḥ ।।5 7 ।।
yadvā himālaye menā bahurūpaguṇānvitā ।
tatra te sā manomodaṃ kariṣyatyatisevayā ।।58 ।।
girīṇāṃ kanyakā haime śikṣārthaṃ yānti nityadā ।
tatra vai śikharaṃ ramyaṃ śivākhyaṃ yadi rocate ।। 59 ।।
vicitraiḥ kokilālāpamodaiḥ kujagaṇāvṛtam ।
sadā vasantaprabhavaṃ vastumicchasi kiṃ priye ।। 1.173.60 । ।
nānājalasaroyuktaṃ sarojā'saṃkhyatākulam ।
kalpavṛkṣā'mṛtavallīkāmadhenusamanvitam । । 61 । ।
praśāntaśvāpadagaṇaṃ yatisādhususevitam ।
sphāṭikasvargahīrakarājatairupaśobhitam । । 6 2 । ।
mānasatālahaṃsā'śvavyomahastiniṣevitam ।
hiraṇmayai ratnajālaiḥ paṃkajairmukulaiḥ sumaiḥ । । 63 । ।
nīlotpalādibhiḥ puṣpairmaṃjulaiḥ suniṣevitam ।
kuṃkumaiḥ sarvagandhaiśca lasadgandhajalaistathā । । 6 4। ।
śādvalaistaruṇaistuṅgairvaṃśavṛkṣaiḥ suśobhitam ।
nṛtyadbhirvṛddhamayūrairguṃjadbhirbhramarādibhiḥ । । 65 । ।
sārasaiḥ kokilābhiśca madhurā''rāvibhiryutam ।
gāyanaiḥ satataṃ teṣāṃ śabdāyamānamanvaham । । 66 ।।
sahelībhiḥ sadāyuktaṃ kāmoddīpanakārakam ।
nūtnanūtnasakhīyukta vastumicchasi kiṃ priye । । 67 । ।
yadvā meroḥ suśikhare sārabhūte mahāśubhe ।
saṃvihartuṃ sakhīyuktā sā'psarogaṇamaṇḍitā । ।68
samicchasi tatra rantuṃ kurve bhavanamuttamam ।
nityaṃ śacī kariṣyati tava sevāṃ sahāyatām ।। 69 । ।
jaleśasya kuberasyeśānasya ca yamasya ca ।
agnernairṛtadevasya mārutasya parasya vā । । 1.173.70 । ।
purībhiḥ śobhite śṛṃge meroruccasurālaye ।
śacīraṃbhāmenakādiraṃbhorugaṇasevite । । 71 । ।
tvamicchasi savihartuṃ kurve tatra mahālayam ।

anivedyamabhakṣyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhakṣyameva hi ।
evamaśnāti yo bhaktyā pārṣadapravaro bhavet ।। 185।।
amṛtaṃ sarvavastūnāmiṣṭasāraṃ sudurlabham ।
viṣṇorniveditānnasya kalāṃ nā'rhati ṣoḍaśīm । । 186 ।।
hantyakālikamṛtyuṃ tadamṛtaṃ mūḍharaṃjanam ।
naivedyaṃ ca harereva haritulyaṃ karotyaho ।। 187 । ।
yadṛcchayā tannaivedyaṃ yo bhuṃkte sādhusaṃgataḥ ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ prāpnoti tapasaḥ phalam ।। 188 ।।
yo nivedya hariṃ bhuṃkte bhaktyā bhaktaśca nityaśaḥ ।
sa paṃktipāvano bodhyaḥ sa harestejasā samaḥ ।। 189 । ।
nā'haṃ vedavidhātryasmi kimahaṃ vaktumīśvarī ।
suciraṃ tu tapastaptvā mayā labdhastvamīśvaraḥ ।। 1.173.190 ।।
tvayā viṣṇoḥ prasādena vaṃcitā'haṃ kathaṃ prabho! ।
ityabhidhāya durgā tvaṃ rodanaṃ kṛtavatyasi ।। 191 । ।
tato'haṃ tvāṃ parapremṇā kṛtvā vakṣasi sādaram ।
kareṇa cakṣuṣornīraṃ saṃmṛjyā'bodhayaṃ muhuḥ । । 192 ।।
parituṣṭā tadā tvaṃ māṃ bhartāramuktavatyasi ।
kalevaraṃ ca tyakṣyāmi naivedyena vinā hareḥ । । 193 । ।
bibharmi dehaṃ satataṃ tava saubhāgyavardhanam ।
kathaṃ vahāmi saubhāgyarahitaṃ tu kalevaram । । 1 94।।
apūrvaṃ harinaivedyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam ।
mahyaṃ dattaṃ na vai yasmātpaśya dehaṃ tyajāmyaham । । 195 । ।
ityuktvā tvaṃ mahādevi dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā ।
tadā mayā stutā tvaṃ vai mahādevi! sthirā bhava । । 196 । ।
mamā'parādhamakhilaṃ kṣantumarhasi sundari! ।
māṃ bhṛtyaṃ tapasā krītaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari । । 197 ।।
icchaiva śrīhareḥ sākṣānnā'haṃ dātumapi kṣamaḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ śrīharericchāṃ durgā tuṣṭā babhūva sā । । 198 । ।
tato jagāma tūrṇaṃ svarṇadīṃ snānārthamityatha ।
snātvā sampūjya bhaktyā ca kṛtvā pakvānnamityatha ।। 199 । ।
naivedye me'rpitavatī tadā nārāyaṇo'pyaham ।
gatvā sarvamahaṃ bhuktvā tasyai datvā'bhivāñchitam ।। 1.173.200 ।।
ājagāma ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ lakṣmi! prasādameva tam ।
bhartre datvā ca śeṣaṃ yad durgā bhuktavatī ca tat ।। 201 । ।
evaṃ śivāśivau bhaktau prāgbhavīyau hi vaiṣṇavau ।
vartete sarvadā magnau yanmūrtau yoginau parau । । 202।।
na saṃvasāmi goloke vaikuṇṭhe tava vakṣasi ।
sadā śivasya hṛdaye nibaddho bhaktipāśataḥ । । 203 । ।
svarasiddhaṃ sutānena pañcavaktreṇa śaṃkaraḥ ।
śaśvadgāyati madgāthāṃ tenā'haṃ taddhṛdi sthitaḥ । । 204 ।।
mama bhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca muktiṃ ca sarvasampadaḥ ।
mayyevāyaṃ sarvasiddhīḥ samarpayati śaṃkaraḥ । । 2 05 ।।
pañcavaktre mannāma yo hi gāyatyaharniśam ।
madrūpaṃ dhyāyati śaśvanna bhaktaḥ śaṃkarātparaḥ ।। 206 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīśivayorhimācale vihāraḥ gṛhanirmāṇārthaṃ satīprārthanāgṛhayogyaparvatādināmāni, himālaye kailāsapurīnirmāṇaṃ, satīkṛtasaṃsārataraṇapraśraḥ śivoktaharinavadhābhaktiḥ śivakṛtapūrvakalpīyatapasā haridarśanaṃ, haribhogyaṃ śivasyā'bhogya-
mitidhattūrabhasmādidhāraṇaṃ, pārvatyoktaharinaivedyamahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 173 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 173 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 174
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 175 →

śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi sutāsnehāt svayaṃ dakṣaprajāpatiḥ ।
sutāsaṃbhāvanārthaṃ vai samāyācchaṃkaragṛham । । 1 । ।
samāyāntaṃ mahādevo dakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathocitām ।
dakṣāya pradadau pūjāṃ satkāraṃ ca yathocitam ।। 2 । ।
dakṣastu mānavān śaṃbhurmānahīno munīśvaraḥ ।
dvayostu mīlane dakṣa iyeṣādhikasatkṛtam । । 3 । ।
śaṃbhunā munitulyaṃ vai sammānaṃ tasya saṃkṛtam ।
kintu cotthāyā'bhiyānaṃ tatra nācaritaṃ tadā । । 4 । ।
tatra heturmahānāsīcchṛṇu lakṣmi! hitāvaham ।
tapasā cātha dharmeṇa yogena śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ ।। 5 ।।
svāpekṣayā'pakṛṣṭasyā''game notthānamācaret ।
śreṣṭhe samutthite'lpasya sarvapuṇyakṣayo bhavet ।। 6 । ।
vicāryetthaṃ harastatra dakṣaṃ prati na cotthitaḥ ।
kintu dakṣastamobhāvaṃ prāpya cukopa cāntare ।। 7 ।।
bālo'yaṃ śaṃkara iti matvā novāca kiṃcana ।
evameva prakupito gṛhaṃ jagāma maunataḥ । । 8 ।।
atha satīṃ gṛhaṃ prāptāṃ dakṣaḥ prāha sudurmanāḥ ।
anye jāmātaraḥ śreṣṭhā bhartustava pinākinaḥ ।। 9 ।।
sarve hyutthāya sammānaṃ kurvanti mama cādarāt ।
śaṃbhurutthāya sammānaṃ na karoti sute mama । । 1.174.10 ।।
avyāvahārikaḥ śaṃbhurbāliśaḥ pratibhāti me ।
astu śokaṃ na vai kurve bāle kā nāma dharṣaṇā ।। 11 ।।
ityuktvā svīyaputryāḥ saḥ sammānaṃ vidadhe bahu ।
satī satkāramādāya kailāse svagṛhaṃ gatā । । 12 । ।
proktavatī śaṃbhave tattadā vai śaṃbhunā priyā ।
bodhitā spaṣṭarūpeṇa mā naśyed dakṣasukṛtam ।। 13 ।।
satī jñātvā ca taddhārdaṃ kiṃcinnovāca tatra vai ।
piturlābhāya śarveṇa kṛte tatsukhadaṃ matam । । 1 4।।
athāpi śaṃbhunā śaptaṃ dakṣo hyāṅgiraso dvijaḥ ।
sammānaṃ cecchati matto'dhikaṃ cā'ghaṭitaṃ bahu ।। 15 ।।
tasmātsa kṣatriyāṃ yoniṃ yātu prācaitasāṃ gṛhe ।
prācetasaḥ kṣatriyaḥ sa bhavatu yatra neṣaṇā ।। 16 । ।
sammānasyā'dhikā matsadṛśādbhavet kadācana ।
iti śaṃbhoḥ kṣudraśāpo'bhavad dakṣaprajāpateḥ । । 17 ।।
nāradasyāpi śāpo'bhūt punarjanmagrahe yataḥ ।
dakṣo dvitīyaṃ janmedaṃ prācetasāṃ gṛhe'labhat । । 18 ।।
tathāpi pūrvasaṃskāro vartate dakṣamānase ।
prāgbhavīyajanako'haṃ satyā asmīti mānayan । । 19 । ।
vartate sarvathā mānī saṃskāro naiva naśyati ।
janmāntare ca kaḥ kasya śvaśuro jananī pitā । । 1.174.2 0 ।।
śaṃbhunaiva gaṇayate bhave'tra śvaśuraṃ nijam ।
lokapālaṃ gaṇayati kṣatriyaṃ bahumāninam । । 21 ।।
athāpi satyāḥ śaṃbhośca jātismarastu vartate ।
dakṣaḥ pūrvaḥ evā'yaṃ satāpitā punarbhavaḥ ।। 22 । ।
tathāpi cātra kiṃ me'sti gataṃ pūrvabhave'khilam ।
iti matvā na vai śaṃbhurmanute śvaśuraṃ nijam ।। 23 । ।
athaikadā punastādṛk prasaṃgaḥ samabhūt priye ।
śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ svakailāse nagarāyā'vicārayat । । 24 । ।
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya puro ramyaṃ susmṛddhimat ।
svīyasurabhiśālāyāṃ kārayāmāsa sundaram । । 25 । ।
bhavanaṃ vistṛtaṃ samyak tatra siṃhāsanaṃ varam ।
tatra chatraṃ mahādivyaṃ sarvathā'dbhutamuttamam । । 26 ।।
tadvāstukaraṇārthaṃ vai cakāra sumahotsavam ।
śakrādīnājuhāvā'śu samastān devatāgaṇān । । 27 ।।
siddhagandharvanāgādīnupadeṣṭṛँśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ।
devānmunīnāgamāँśca vidhiṃ śiṣyaiḥ ṛṣīnapi । । 28 । ।
devīḥ sarvā apsarobhirnānāvastubhiranvitāḥ ।
devānāṃ ca tatharṣīṇāṃ siddhānāṃ phaṇināmapi ।। 29 ।।
ānayanmaṃgalahastāḥ kanyāḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa ।
vīṇāmṛdaṃgapramukhavādyānnānāvidhāँstathā । । 1.174.30 । ।
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa vādayitvā sugāyanaiḥ ।
rājyābhiṣekayogyāni dravyāṇi sakalauṣadhaiḥ । । 31 ।।
pratyakṣatīrthapāthobhiḥ paṃcakubhāँśca pūritān ।
tathā'nyāḥ saṃvidhā divyā ānayat svagaṇaistadā ।। 32 ।।
brahmaghoṣaṃ mahārāvaṃ cakrustatra tu bhūsurāḥ ।
haro hariṃ sanmuhūrte nūtne sihāsane vare ।। 33 ।।
upāveśya bahuprītyā bhūṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।
ābaddhya ramyamukuṭaṃ kṛtakautukamaṃgalam । । 34 ।।
viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭāva taṃ śaṃbhuḥ svatantraṃ bhaktavatsalam ।
anyaṃ sarvaṃ samājaṃ ca namaskṛtya haraḥ sthitaḥ । । 35 ।।
dakṣo'tra mānavānāyāt prajāpatibhiranvitaḥ ।
śaṃbhunā satkṛtāḥ sarve dakṣo'pi saha satkṛtaḥ ।। 36 ।।
bhojanācchādanapānamānayānavihārakaiḥ ।
satkṛtāḥ sarvathā sarve dakṣaścaicchadviśeṣataḥ ।। 3 7।।
sammānaṃ tu nijaṃ tatra śvāśuryasyā'bhiyogataḥ ।
dakṣaḥ śaṃbhorgṛhamadhye jagāma svasutānanam ।। 38 ।।
draṣṭuṃ praṣṭuṃ sukhaṃ śāntiṃ tadā śaṃbhustu notthitaḥ ।
dakṣastadā''ntare'tīva mānī cukopa vai punaḥ ।। 3 9।।
satīmāpṛcchya kuśalaṃ sukhaṃ cā'nāmayaṃ tathā ।
dakṣo jagāma harmyaṃ svaṃ cānye'pi svagṛhān gatāḥ ।।1.174.40 ।।
pratyakṣaṃ tadidaṃ cā'bhūdavamānaṃ prajāpateḥ ।
anāhūte'paricite hyanāgamanamuttamam ।।4 1 ।।
evaṃ manasi sandhārya tadāpi dakṣa ātmani ।
avamānaṃ rarakṣaiva bahirnaivā'prakāśayat ।।42 ।।
atha kālāntare naimiṣāraṇye ca tapodhanāḥ ।
dīrghasatraṃ prakurvanto bhṛgvādyāstu maharṣayaḥ ।।43।।
āsannekatritāstatra samājagmurharādayaḥ ।
āgatāँste ca dadṛśurmunayo dīrghasatriṇaḥ ।।44।।
uttasthuryugapatsarve saharṣāśca samutsukāḥ ।
datvā'rghyapādyaṃ satkṛtya munayo vītakalmaṣāḥ ।।45 ।।
paśyanti sma haraṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ pulahādikān ।
manavaścāgatāstatra tathā dakṣo'pi cāgataḥ ।।46।।
yadṛcchayā samāpannaḥ pūjitaśca maharṣibhiḥ ।
stutibhiḥ praṇipātaiśca tathā sarvaiḥ surā'suraiḥ ।।47।।
abhipūjita evāsau niṣasāda sabhāntare ।
rudreṇa na kṛtā tasyā'bhyutthānanatisatkriyāḥ ।।48।।
viśeṣataḥ svasya mānaṃ na jātaṃ rudrasatkṛtam ।
cukopa rudraṃ tvaritaṃ tadā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ।।49।।
uvāca paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ rudramuddiśya tatra vai ।
ete namanti sarve māṃ viprāḥ surā'surādikāḥ ।।1.174.50 ।।
abhyutthānādinā sarve mānayanti bhṛśaṃ ca mām ।
kathaṃ durjanavaccāyaṃ naivottiṣṭhati bhūtapaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
śmaśānavāsī nistrapaḥ pretapiśācasaṃyutaḥ ।
anuttamo mattasakhā karoti na natiṃ ca me ।।52।।
jātyā ca karmabhirhīnaḥ pākhaṇḍī durjanapriyaḥ ।
pāpaśīlaścoddhataśca nindako'śucireva ca ।।5 3 ।।
tyājyo'yaṃ sarvadā sadbhirbahiṣkāryaśca sarvathā ।
yadā yadā gṛhaṃ tasya gato'haṃ mūrkharāḍayam ।।54।।
naivottiṣṭhati sāmīpye me'vamānaṃ karoti vai ।
tasmādayaṃ yajñabāhyo bhavatvadyadinātsadā ।।55।।
rudrasyā'nucarāṃ ye ca te'pi vedbahiṣkṛtāḥ ।
pākhaṇḍavādasaṃyuktāḥ śiṣṭācāravivarjitāḥ । 56।।
kapālinaḥ pānaratāḥ kālānanā bhavantviti ।
nandī niśamya tadvākyaṃ dakṣaṃ prati ruṣānvitaḥ ।।57।।
śaśāpa dakṣaṃ tatpakṣān brāhmaṇāँścānyavarṇinaḥ ।
vedavādaratā yūyaṃ nānyadastītivādinaḥ ।।58।।
kāmātmānaḥ svargaparāḥ krodhalobhasamanvitāḥ ।
vaidikavidhinā viprā bhavantu śūdrayājakāḥ ।।59।।
daridriṇo bhavantvatra pratigraharatāstathā ।
asatpathagatāḥ sarve bhavantu brahmarākṣasāḥ ।।1.174.60 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ śāntastadā prāha nandinaṃ svasya sevakam ।
kopaṃ nā'rhasi vai kartuṃ brāhmaṇānprati sarvadā ।।61 ।।
ko'yaṃ kastvaṃ kva cā'haṃ vai kasmācchaptāstvayā dvijāḥ ।
prapaṃcaracanāṃ tyaktvā prabuddho bhava sevaka ।।62।।
śātiṃ ca prāpitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇusurādibhiḥ ।
dakṣo gato gṛhaṃ svasya svā'vamānaṃ smaran muhuḥ ।।63 ।।
tataḥ kāle mahān yajñaḥ samārabdhaśca tena vai ।
dakṣeṇa dīkṣitenātivistārastatra carṣayaḥ ।।64।।
āhūtāśca vaśiṣṭhādyāstapasvinaḥ samāyayuḥ ।
kaśyapo'trirvāmadevo hyagastyaśca bhṛgustathā ।।65।।
parāśaro dadhīcaśca vyāsaśca gautamaḥ sitaḥ ।
gargaḥ pailo bharadvājo bhārgavaḥ kakupaḥ kṛtiḥ ।।66।।
tathā'nye ṛṣayo devā lokapālā diśādhipāḥ ।
gandharvāḥ kinnarā vidyādharāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ।।67।।
satyalokānsamānītaḥ sāvitrīsaṃyutastvajaḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhācca tato viṣṇurlakṣmīramādisaṃyutaḥ ।।68।।
indrastatra samānītaścendrāṇyā saha svargataḥ ।
tathā candro'pi rohiṇyā vāruṇyā varuṇastathā ।।69।।
kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho māruto mṛgavāhanaḥ ।
pāvako bastayānaśca nairṛtaḥ pretavāhanaḥ ।।1.174.70।।
dārāḥ putrāśca śiṣyāśca pārṣadā mantriṇastathā ।
parivārāstathā vedāsteṣāṃ teṣāṃ samāgatāḥ ।।71 ।।
evamanye samāyātā dakṣayajñe kṛtādarāḥ ।
satkṛtāstena dakṣeṇa sarve te bahuvastubhiḥ ।।।72।।
bhavanāni mahārhāṇi suprabhāṇi mahānti ca ।
tvaṣṭrā kṛtāni divyāni tebhyo dattāni tena vai ।।73।।
teṣu sarveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu yathāyogyaṃ ca te sthitāḥ ।
sammānitā arājaँste sakalā viṣṇunā mayā ।।74।।
athā'siknī satīmātā pūrvadakṣavivāhitā ।
dakṣaṃ jātaṃ punarjñātvā tatrā''gatyā'vasat sadā ।।75।।
sā cā'siknī tatra śaṃbhuṃ yadarthamatapatsatī ।
na dadarśa samāyātaṃ tadā prāha prajāpatim ।।76।।
dakṣaṃ natvā'vadatprahvīkṛtā'ntaḥkaraṇā natā ।
kathaṃ satī tathā śaṃbhurdṛśyete nātra tūtsave ।।77।।
dakṣaḥ prāha tadā'siknīṃ tayornāsti prayojanam ।
satī tu sarvadā snigdhā pitrormānābhilāṣiṇī ।।78 ।।
śaṭhaḥ śarvo na vai snigdho me'vamānaprakārakaḥ ।
atīva garvito jātaḥ satīṃ me prāpya kanyakām ।।79 ।।
kasyacinnā'pyasau prāyo na kaścidasya vā priyaḥ ।
kiṃvaṃśyastveṣa kiṃgotraḥ kiṃdeśīyaḥ kimātmakaḥ ।।1.174.8 0 ।।
kiṃvṛttiḥ kiṃsamācāro viṣādī vṛṣavāhanaḥ ।
na prāyaśastapasvyeṣa kva tapaḥ kvā'stradhāraṇam ।।8 1 ।।
na gṛhastheṣu gaṇyo'sau śmaśāne tiṣṭhate sadā ।
nā'yaṃ tu brahmacārī syād yataḥ satyā vivāhitaḥ ।।8 2।।
vānaprāsthyaṃ na caivāsminnaiśvaryamadamohite ।
na jāne brāhmaṇo nāsti vedaścainaṃ na vetti yat ।।8 3 ।।
na jāne kṣatriyo nāsti prāyaḥ śastrāstrasaṃgrahāt ।
kṣatāttrāṇaṃ nāsti cāsminsarveṣāṃ pralayapriye ।।84।।
nirdhano'raṇyaratimāna vaiśyo'pi naiva bhāti me ।
kathaṃ śūdre samāveśo nāgayajñopavītinaḥ ।।85 ।।

udaḍīyata gagane yayau kailāsaparvatam ।
tadā saṃkalpā bhīrūṇāṃ palāyanakṛtau'bhavan ।। 197।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dakṣasya śaṃbhugṛhe trivāragamanaṃ, punaḥpunaravamānam, naimiṣāraṇye bhṛgvādīnāṃ parasparaśāpadānaṃ, dakṣakṛtaśaṃbhunindā, kanakhale dakṣayajñe devādīnāmāgamanaṃ, śaṃbhoranāgamane dadhīcasya dakṣāya śāpādikamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 174।।


← adhyāyaḥ 174 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 175
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 176 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kalahasya gṛhaṃ rudragṛhaṃ gatam ।
dvayorvai gṛhayoraikye kimaniṣṭaṃ na jāyate ।। 1 ।।
nārado vyomamārgeṇa prāpya vai dhāma śāṃkaram ।
kṣaṇaṃ tatra mahodyāne kailāse'vātaradbhuvi ।। 2 ।।
viśaśrāma hariṃ dhyāyan satī tadantare bahiḥ ।
tasminnevodyānavarye'viharat svasakhīyutā ।। 3 ।।
tayā dṛṣṭāni vyomnyeva svargātpṛthvīṃ patanti vai ।
vimānāni bhaginīnāṃ dāsadāsīyutāni ca ।। 4 ।।
patibhiḥ kṛtaśṛṃgāraprabhṛtīnāṃ mahānti hi ।
svasakhīṃ vijayāṃ prāhā''lokya satī tu rohiṇīm ।। 5 ।।
re sakhīpravare paśya rohiṇī bhaginī mama ।
candrayuktā vimānasthā kva yāti pṛccha satvaram ।। 6 ।।
śīghraṃ tu vijayā''pṛcchya jñātvā yajñotsavādikam ।
dakṣagṛhe vartate'tastatra yātīti cāha tām ।। 7 ।।
tāvadanyavimānāni prayānti vyomamārgataḥ ।
tānyapyālokya bahudhā satī cetasyacintayat ।। 8 ।।
dakṣaḥ pitā mama mātā hyasiknī vīriṇī tathā ।
āhvānaṃ me na kurvanti vismṛtāḥ kiṃ satīṃ sutām ।। 9 ।।
pṛccheyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra śaṃkaraṃ sarvamādarāt ।
vicāryetthaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ satī tu śaṃkarānvitam ।। 1.175.1 0।।
satkṛtā śaṃkareṇā'tha satyuvāca prabhuṃ tadā ।
piturmama mahān yajño bhavatīti mayā śrutam ।। 11 ।।
tatrotsavo mahānasti samavetā maharṣayaḥ ।
tatra kathaya gamanaṃ kasmāttava na rocate ।। 12।।
āvābhyāṃ tatra gantavyaṃ bahūnāṃ darśanaṃ bhavet ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha sati dakṣo mama drohī viśeṣataḥ ।। 1 3।।
pitustavā'dhvare prāptā mānino jñānavarjitāḥ ।
tatra yajane me sthānaṃ nāsti yāvaḥ kathaṃ sati ।। 14।।
anāhūtāstu ye yānti paragṛhaṃ tu te janāḥ ।
prāpnuvantyavamānaṃ yanmaraṇādatiricyate ।। 15।।
parālayaṃ gato'pīndro laghurbhavati vai yataḥ ।
tasmāt tvayā mayā cāpi na gantavyaṃ hi tadgṛham ।। 16।।
śatruśaraiḥ praviddho'pi na tathā vyathate janaḥ ।
yathā svajanarūkṣoktairmarmabhedibhirardyate ।। 17।।
mamopari tapastaptaṃ tasmānmayā vivāhitā ।
na cet taptaṃ mādṛśastu kathaṃ pāśe'tra saṃpatet ।। 18।।
vidyaiśvaryādibhirjāte garve khalāḥ satāṃ guṇān ।
gaṇayantyeva nahite nā''driyante mahājanān ।। 19।।
śrutvaitatsahasā devī prāha svaprāṇarakṣakam ।
kathaṃ dakṣeṇa nā''hūtau jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ ।।1.175.20।।
anujñāṃ dehi me nātha gantuṃ dakṣamakhe'dya vai ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha satīṃ sādhvi gantuṃ te prabalā ruciḥ ।।21।।
yadyastyāruhya vṛṣabhaṃ sajjaṃ bhūṣitameva ca ।
mahārājñyupacārāṇi kṛtvā nītvā gaṇānbahūn ।।।22।
subhūṣitā gaccha yajñaṃ chatracāmaralakṣitā ।
ityetadantare tatra nārado'pyāgato haram ।।।23।।
dṛṣṭvā śivau praṇamyātha śaṃbhunā satkṛtā''daraḥ ।
tatpradattāsane ramye hyupāviśanmahāmuniḥ ।।24।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha kathaṃ dattaṃ darśanaṃ bhavatā mune ।
asti kiṃcidvicitraṃ cedbrūhi śīghraṃ ca mā ciram ।।।25।।
ityājñāṃ prāpya devarṣiḥ vṛttaṃ tatprāha śaṃkaram ।
adya nīlagireścā'haṃ haridvārasamīpataḥ ।।26।।
apūryamiva saṃvīkṣya pariprāptastavāntikam ।
trailokye yacca puṃjātaṃ sakalatrasutādikam ।।27।।
sālaṃkāraṃ samānaṃ ca sānandamukhapaṃkajam ।
dṛṣṭaṃ dakṣādhvare kintu bhavaddvandvaṃ na lokitam ।।28।।
prāyo viṣādajanakaṃ tatra yuṣmadadarśanam ।
dakṣasya marmabhedīni vacanāni śrutāni vai ।।।29।।
tāni vaktuṃ na śakyāni śrutvā tvadgarhaṇāgiraḥ ।
mayā tu pihitau karṇau pratyuktāni dadhīcinā ।।1.175.30।।
dakṣaḥ śaptaḥ kratuṃ tyaktvā durvāsaḥ pramukhā dvijāḥ ।
śaṃbhunindāṃ samākarṇya kiyantastu viniryayuḥ ।।3 1।।
prāvartata mahāyāgo dakṣapakṣātipātibhiḥ ।
bhaginyastatra yāste tāḥ svasvāmiparicārikāḥ ।।32।।
dakṣato gauravaṃ prāptāstadvaktuṃ nāhamutsahe ।
tatro'trārthe vidheyaṃ tadvidhīyetāṃ prayāmyaham ।।33।।
gate tu nārade devī prāṃjaliḥ prāha śaṃkaram ।
vijayasvā'ndhakadhvaṃsin! dehyanujñāṃ mama prabho ।।34।।
gatvā paśyāmi duṣṭatvaṃ kathamāvāṃ nirākṛtau ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha priyāṃ yajño gantavyārtho na bhāti me ।।35।।
kimapūrṇaṃ tavā'styatra mā parīkṣākṛte'pyagāḥ ।
kuto māṃ hātumicchestyaṃ gamane śaṃ na dṛśyate ।।36।।
satī prāha mano me te pādayoḥ sthāsyati dhruvam ।
kratuṃ draṣṭuṃ pituryāmi naikṣi yajño mayā kvacit ।।37।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāhā'dharekṣā cedāharāmi tataḥ kratum ।
kratuṃ kriyāṃ tathā yajñapuruṣaṃ lokapālakān ।।38।।
anyānāśu vidhehi tvamṛṣīnārtvijya karmaṇi ।
satī prāha niṣedhīrmā draṣṭavyaḥ pituradhvaraḥ ।।39।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ nārīhaṭhādhirohitām ।
adya devi paścimāyāṃ dikśūlaṃ vāsaro'śubhaḥ ।।1.175.40।।
tithinakṣatrayogāśca viparītā bhavanti vai ।
mā gā devi gatā'dya tvaṃ nahi drakṣyasi māṃ punaḥ ।।41 ।।
tadā satī babhāṣe yat yadi nāmnā'smyahaṃ satī ।
tadā tanvantareṇāpi kariṣye tava dāsatām ।।42।।
tadā bhavaḥ punaḥ prāha ko vā vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ ।
haṭhavyāptamanovṛttiṃ striyaṃ vā puruṣaṃ ca vā ।।43।।
mā yāhi devi māṃ hitvā gatā tvaṃ na miliṣyasi ।
paraṃ na devi gantavyaṃ mahāmānadhanecchubhiḥ ।।44।।
anāhūtatayā kānte mātāpitṛgṛhānapi ।
punarna darśanaṃ devi mama satyaṃ bravīmyaham ।।45।।
devyuvāca yadi raktā tava pādāmbujadvaye ।
tathā tvameva me nātho bhaviṣyasi bhavāntare ।।46।।
ityuktvā niryayau devī haṭhā'ndhīkṛtamānasā ।
na nanāma tadā śaṃbhuṃ na ca cakre pradakṣiṇam ।।47।।
ata eva hi sā devī gatā na punarāgatā ।
devo'pi tāṃ satīṃ yāntīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu vivyathe hṛdi ।।48 ।।
gaṇānprāha saha devyā gacchantu sainyaśālinaḥ ।
vimānaṃ śāṃkaracihnamāruhya yātu vaiṃ satī ।। 49 ।।
devī vimānamāruhya yātā yajñasthalāṃ'gaṇam ।
suchatracāmarādīni sadvastrābharaṇāni ca ।।1.175.50 ।।
mahārājñyupacārāṇi dattāni śaṃkareṇa vai ।
gaṇāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi raudrā jagmuḥ śivājñayā ।।5 1 ।।
hetisajjāḥ sayānāśca kutūhalotsavānvitāḥ ।
nabho'ṅgaṇādvimānasthā sā tu vegādavātarat ।। 52 ।।
āviśadyajñavāṭaṃ ca harṣastasyā vyavardhata ।
śivapriyāyāḥ satkāro vāmadevādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ।।53 ।।
kutūhalaṃ gaṇāścakruḥ śivayoryaśa ujjaguḥ ।
pupluvuḥ kūrdanaṃ cakrurākāśe gaṇapuṃgavāḥ ।।54।।
jayā'mbike jaya śaṃbho hyārāvaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat। ।
dākṣāyaṇī gatā tatra yajñasthale mahāprabhe ।।65 ।।
surā'suramunīndrādikutūhalasamanvite ।
namaskṛtyā'gnidevaṃ ca samājaṃ maṇḍapasthitam ।।56 ।।
jagāma jalapānāya svapiturbhavanaṃ tataḥ ।
dadarśa suprabhaṃ cāru nānāścaryasamanvitam ।।।57।।
mātṛsvasṛduhitṛtatsutāsutādisaṃśritam ।
āgatāṃ ca satīṃ dṛṣṭvā'siknī ca vīriṇī tathā ।।58 ।।
cakruḥ samādaraṃ tasyā bhaginyaśca yathocitam ।
daduḥ salilapānādi cāsanaṃ sukhaśāntidam ।।59 ।।
viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ natvā mātaraṃ bhaginīstataḥ ।
avaruhyāsanāt śīghramekaivā'gacchadadhvaram ।।1.175.6 0 ।।
tatra svapitaraṃ natvā tathā'nyānvṛddhapuṃgavān ।
kṛtamaṃgalanepathyāḥ prasūścānyāḥ kirīṭinīḥ ।। 61 ।।
sabhartṛkāśca bhaginīrnavā'laṃkṛtiśālinīḥ ।
jyeṣṭhāḥ kaniṣṭhāḥ sāścaryāḥ sānandāśca kuṭumbinīḥ ।।।62।।
satī cāho samāyātetyāścaryeṇa prapaśyatīḥ ।
sarvā natvā vṛddhamātṛsamāśca haravallabhā ।।63 ।।
maṇḍapasthasamāje sā gatā dakṣāntikaṃ satī ।
pitrā pṛṣṭā ca mātrā ca bhadraṃṃ jātaṃ tavāgame ।। 64।।
ehi tiṣṭha priyaputri! jāmātā svidanāmayaḥ! ।
te'pi svargyaṃ sukhaṃ nityaṃ nirābādhaṃ svidasti vai ।। 65।।
satyuvāca yadi vṛddhau sukhinau cāsmi sukhyaham ।
yuvayoścāpi jāmātā śivaḥ sukhī sadā'sti vai ।।66।।
duḥkhamātraṃ prasaṃge'tra yadadarśanameva yat ।
yena yajñaḥ paripūrṇo bhavet so'tra na vidyate ।।67।।
yadi bhadraṃ janetarme samāgamanato bhavet ।
kathaṃ śaṃbhurahaṃ naivā''hūtau cātra mahotsave ।।68 ।।
anye jāmātaraḥ putryaḥ samāhūtāḥ prasaṃgataḥ ।
satīṃ śaṃbhuṃ parityajya kuto bhadraṃ śubhaṃ tava ।। 69 ।।
abhadraṃ hyaśubhaṃ cātra paśyāmi ca kṣaṇāntare ।
iti saṃbhāṣya mumocā'śrubindūn piturantike ।।1.175.7 0 ।।
dakṣaḥ prāha ayi putri mahādhanye'timaṃgale ।
tava doṣo manāṅnāsti mā śokaṃ kuru mānasam ।।7 1 ।।
jahyudvegaṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭha mama doṣo'sti sarvathā ।
yanmayā'buddhinā kanyāratnaṃ śarve'pavarjitam ।।72 ।।
yadahaṃ tatsamājñāsyamīśo'panīśa āntare ।
tadā kathamadāsyaṃ tvāṃ māyādhipataye śubhe ।।73 ।।
ahaṃ śivābhidhānena vañcito'śivakarmaṇi ।
brahmaṇā bahudhā so'yaṃ praśaṃsito mamā'grataḥ ।।74।।
śaṃkaro'yamayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ śivaḥ sārthakanāmavān ।
dehyasmai ca satīṃ kanyāṃ tadyogyā sarvathā'sti sā ।।75 ।।
śrīkaṇṭho'sau maheśo'sau sarvajño vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ।
dhanvī sārthakanāmā'sau dehyasmai te satīṃ sutām ।।76।।
iti viśvāsamādhāya dāpitā tvaṃ hi vedhasā ।
na jñātaḥ sa virūpākṣa ukṣago viṣabhakṣakaḥ ।।77।।
pitṛkānanasaṃvāsaḥ śūladhṛkca kapāladhṛk ।
dvijihvasaṃgasubhago jalādhāraḥ kapardavān ।।78 ।।
kalaṃkikṛtamauliśca dhūlīdhūsaracarcitaḥ ।
kvacitkaupīnavasano nagno vātūlavat kvacit ।।79 ।।
kvacittu carmavasanaḥ kvacidbhikṣāṭanapriyaḥ ।
virūpabhūtā'nucaraḥ sthāṇurugrastamoguṇaḥ ।।1.175.8 0 ।।
rudro raudraparīvāro mahākālavapurdharaḥ ।
nṛkaroṭīparikaro jātigotravivarjitaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
brahmaṇā guṇavānukto jānāno'haṃ pratāritaḥ ।
kimbahūktena tanaye samastanayaśālini! ।।8 2 ।।
kva pāṃsulapaṭacchanno mahāśaṃkhavibhūṣaṇaḥ ।
prabaddhasarpakeyūraḥ pradhūsarajaṭāsaṭaḥ ।।8 3 ।।
ḍamaḍḍamarukavyagrahastāgraḥ khaṇḍacandrabhṛt ।
tāṇḍavā''ḍambararuciḥ sarvā'maṃgalaceṣṭitaḥ ।।84।।
evaṃvidho haraḥ kvā'yamadhvaro maṃgalālayaḥ ।
ata eva samāhūtau yuvāṃ na maṃgale'dhvare ।।85 ।।
dukūlānyanukūlāni ratnālaṃkaraṇāni ca ।
hāraśreṣṭhā vibhūṣāśca prāgeva tvatkṛte mayā ।।86 ।।
rakṣitāstānpaśya putri! sarvān śreṣṭhān gṛhāṇa ca ।
śaṃkarārthamapi putri yadyannetuṃ samīhase ।।87 ।।
tatsarvaṃ saha netavyaṃ yajñapūrtyuttaraṃ sati! ।
yāvadetāstava sakhyaḥ svasāraścoṣitā makhe ।।88 ।।
tāvat tato'pyadhikaṃ tvaṃ vasātra tava rocate ।
śrutvā'tidūnahṛdayā satī vaktuṃ pracakrame ।।89 ।।
bhāgānapaśyad devānāṃ haryādīnāṃ tadadhvare ।
śaṃbhubhāgamanālokya kaṣṭaṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame ।। 1.175.90 ।।
nā''karṇitaṃ mayā kiṃcit prabrūvati pitastvayi ।
padadvayīṃ samākarṇya tāṃ ca te kathayāmyaham ।। 91 ।।
māyā'dhipatirevā'yaṃ jānāno'pi pratāritaḥ ।
etatsatyaṃ tvayā''khyāyi māyā'dhipatireva saḥ ।। 92।।
parabrahmaparamātmā śivarūpeṇa vartate ।
māyānvitaśca māyāyā vyatiriktaḥ śivaḥ sa vai ।। 93 ।।
tvaṃ ca pratāritaḥ pūrvamadhunā'pi pratāritaḥ ।
ajñātvā dattavān kanyāṃ dattvā'sambaddhamucyate ।। 94।।
tādṛśo manyate śaṃbhuḥ kuto māmadadāstadā ।
na hetuste matistatra heturmatpuṇyagauravam ।। 95।।
yena pūtamidaṃ viśvaṃ samagraṃ sacarācaram ।
yajño yajñavidāṃ śreṣṭho yajñāṃgo yajñadakṣiṇaḥ ।। 96 ।।
yajñakartā svayaṃ śaṃbhustaṃ vinā tu kathaṃ makhaḥ ।
makhaḥ syānmama dehasya paśya dakṣa kṣaṇāntare ।। 97।।
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvaṃ pūtaṃ bhavatyaho ।
taṃ tu śaṃbhuṃ vinā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ cā'kṛtameva tat ।। 98 ।।
dravyamantrādikaṃ sarvaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yanmatam ।
śaṃbhunā hi vinā kṛtamapavitraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 99। ।
kiṃ śivaṃ surasāmānyaṃ matvā'kārṣīranādaram ।
bhraṣṭā buddhistava jātā vārdhakye iva sarvathā ।। 1.175.100 ।।
viṣṇubrahmādayaḥ sarve yaṃ jānanti pareśvaram ।
tva na jānāsi taṃ śaṃbhuṃ mā jānīhi tathottaram ।। 101 ।।
ete kathaṃ samāyātā viṣṇubrahmādayo'dhvare ।
jānanto'pi vinā śaṃbhuṃ lajjante na mukhadṛśaḥ ।। 102 ।।
he viṣṇo tvaṃ mahādevaṃ tyaktvā yajñe'tra dṛśyase ।
na lajjase sadā mitraṃ vismṛtyā'tra pravartase ।। 103 ।।
re brahmaँstvaṃ paṃcamukho'bhūrgarviṣṭho haraṃ prati ।
kṛtaścaturmukhastena vismṛto'si tadadbhutam ।। 1 04।।
yadi kruddho mahādevaścatvāryapi vineṣyati ।
he sūrya candra cendrāde na svijjānatha śaṃkaram । । 105 । ।
vaśiṣṭhādyāśca munayo na vai jānatha śaṃkaram ।
vajraṃ prajvālitaṃ yena kāmaḥ prajvālitastathā । । 106 । ।
dāruvane liṃgapāte yena prajvālitaṃ jagat ।
prāgbhavīyāँścamatkārān kiṃsvid vismarathā'tra hi ।। 107 ।।
sa yadi krodhamāpanno yuṣmākaṃ kiṃ bhaviṣyati ।
sarve kāṃ mūrkhatāṃ prāptā vinā śaṃbhuṃ pratiṣṭhatha । । 108 ।।
iti tvekavidhā vāco'gadanmakhe maheśvarī ।
kaupānvitā satī tatra hṛdyena vidūyatā ।। 109 ।।
maunī bhūto'bhavacchrutvā samājo bhayavihvalaḥ ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato dakṣaḥ kruddho'bravīt kṣayakaram । । 1.175.110 ।।
tava kiṃ bahunoktena na te kāryaṃ hi sāmpratam ।
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā putri kasmāccātra samāgatā । । 111 ।।
sarvapūjyā'vamānaṃ tvaṃ karoṣyāgatya cā'dhvare ।
gaccha maunaṃ vasa vā'tra nā''hūtā'si vilajjike ।। 112 ।।
amaṃgalastu te bhartā bhūtapretapiśācarāṭ ।
akulīno vedabāhyaḥ nā''hūto'tra mayā tadā । । 113 ।।
devarṣisaṃsadi vedhaḥpreritena mayā'rpitā ।
mandabhāgyena rudrāyā'viditārthāya kiṃ bhavet । । 11 4।।
kopaṃ mā vraja rudrāṇi! svasthā bhava śucismite ।
yadyāgatā'si me yajñe dāyaṃ gṛhṇīṣva cātmanā ।। 115 ।।
śrutvā'tha sā satī śaṃbhornindāmacintayat hṛdi ।
dāyaṃ nītvā'pi kiṃ me syātkathaṃ vai yāmi śaṃkaram ।। 116 । ।
śaṃkareṇa yadi pṛṣṭā tatra vakṣye kimuttaram ।
tasmādatraiva martavyaṃ prāpsye dehāntare haram ।। 117 ।।
iti nirṇīya pitaraṃ niḥśvasantī hyuvāca ha ।
kiṃ jīvitena me tāta! śṛṇvantyā patigarhaṇām ।। 118 ।।
yo nindati mahādevaṃ nindyamānaṃ śṛṇoti vā ।
tāvubhau narakaṃ yātau yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 119 ।।
yadi śakto nindakasya jihvāṃ chindyātprasahya vai ।
yadyaśaktaḥ supidhāya karṇau gacchet sthalāntaram । । 1.175.12 0 ।।
śaṃbhunā tu niṣiddhā'pi prasahyā'tra samāgatā ।
phalaṃ tasyā'tra me prāptaṃ kva gantavyaṃ mayā'dhunā ।। 12 1 ।।
asmaracchāṃkaraṃ vākyaṃ paścāttāpamavāpa sā ।
sā saṃkruddhya munīndevān dakṣaṃ niḥśaṃkamāha yat ।। 1 22।।
tāta tvaṃ nindakaḥ śaṃbhoḥ paścāttāpaṃ gamiṣyasi ।
mā'yaṃ dhūmro tava yājño vṛṣṭiheturbhavediha ।। 123।।
aśruheturbhavedevā''gatānāṃ yajñabhoginām ।
sphuṭaṃ bha vantaḥ śaṃbhostu pratīpā militāḥ khalu ।। 1 24।।
pratīpānāṃ pratīpaṃ saṃkariṣye yajñamārjanam ।
śaṃbhuṃ vinā na yajñaḥ syāt kariṣye'gnipratoṣaṇam ।। 125।।
dakṣaḥ svīyaṃ juhotyagnau svīye'pi gaṇanā mama ।
svaṃ svīyaṃ ca juhotyagnau kariṣye havanaṃ mama ।। 1 26।।
kiṃ bahūktena vacasā dakṣo hare sadā kudhīḥ ।
tadudbhavena dehena na me kiṃcitprayojanam ।। 127।।
tajjanma dhik yanmahatāmavajñāpādakaṃ bhavet ।
parityājyo viśeṣeṇa janmasamvandha eva vai ।। 128।।
vaimanasye sadā śaṃbhurdākṣāyaṇīti vakti mām ।
tasmāddakṣāṃgajaṃ caitatkuṇapaṃ garhitaṃ sadā ।। 129।।
vyutsṛṣṭavyaṃ nūnamatra projjhitavyaṃ tu vahnaye ।
yāvajjīvitanāthasya na śrotavyā vigarhaṇā ।। 1.175.130।।
satyantimaṃ vacaḥ prāha naśyantu śivanindakāḥ ।
ahaṃ tu krodhadīptāgnau mahādevasvarūpiṇi ।। 13 1।।
juhomi dehasamidhaṃ prāṇarodhavidhānataḥ ।
evamuktvā satī prāṇāyāmaṃ cakre śanaistadā ।। 1 32।।
prāṇarodhaḥ kṛtaḥ satyā sudṛḍhastāvadeva vai ।
sarveṣāṃ ca surādīnāṃ prāṇarodho'bhavattadā ।। 133।।।
nāgnirjajvāla ca tathā yathā''jyāhutibhiḥ purā ।
mantrāḥ kuṇṭhitasāmarthyāstatkṣaṇādeva cā'bhavan ।। 134।।
mahājhanjhānilaḥ prāptaḥ parvatāndolanakṣamaḥ ।
makhamaṇḍapabhūstena kṣaṇataḥ sthapuṭīkṛtā ।। 135।।
akāṇḍataḍidāpāto jāto'bhūdbhūprakampanaḥ ।
divaścolkāḥ prapatitāḥ piśācā nṛtyamādadhuḥ ।। 136।।
āpatadgradhrairupari gagane maṇḍalāyitam ।
tatra purastādaśivaṃ śivāḥ krūramarāriṣuḥ ।। 137।।
meghā rudhiravarṣābhistatrāhuścātyamaṃgalam ।
nirghātaniḥsvano bhūmerutthito hṛtprakampanaḥ ।। 138।।
divyāyudhāni ca mitho yuddhyanti smā'tibhīṣaṇam ।
havanīyaṃ mahādravyaṃ dūṣitaṃ kroṣṭṛbhiḥ śvabhiḥ ।। 1 39।।।
satyāḥ prāṇanirodhāśca sarvarodhena tattadā ।
śmaśānavāṭavajjātaṃ niṣkriyaṃ makhabhūtalam ।। 1.175.140 ।।
yadyatrā'bhūcca vinyastaṃ tattatraiva vyavasthitam ।
citranyastamivā''sīśca prāṇarodhabalāttathā ।। 141।।
sujaḍā iva saṃjātāstadā cakradharādayaḥ ।
devī prāṇaṃ bahirnītvā śamayāmāsa bhīṣikām ।। 142।।
camatkāro darśito'yaṃ devyā tathāpi dakṣarāṭ ।
śaṃkarā''hvānavacanaṃ novāca mānanaṣṭadhīḥ ।। 143।।
maunībhūtā satī smṛtvā śaṃbhuṃ svapatimādarāt ।
pṛthvyāṃ punaḥ sā sahasā niṣasāda praśāntadhīḥ ।। 144।।
jalamācamya vidhivat saṃvṛtā vāsasā śuciḥ ।
dṛṅnimīlya patiṃ smṛtvā yogarītimupādade ।। 145।।
kṛtvā samāne hyanilau prāṇāpānau tathā punaḥ ।
utthāpyodānasamānau nābhicakrātparaṃ gatā ।। 146।।
hṛdisthāpyorasi nītvā nītvā kaṇṭhād bhruvoḥ satī ।
madhyamānīya dyurandhraṃ sā jagāma tvarānvitā ।। 147।।
agnimutpādayāmāsa brahmarandhrasthitā satī ।
brahmarandhrāgninā deho jājvalyamāna eva vai ।। 148।।
ākāśamutthito vyomnā cāgnikuṇḍe hyavātarat ।
bhasmasādabhavat kuṇḍe satī samājagocarā ।। 149।।
tatpaśyatāṃ ca khe bhūmau hāhākāro vyavartata ।
hāhābhūcca jagatsarvaṃ bhītā viṣṇusurādayaḥ ।। 1.175.150।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyā vyomnā svasṛvimānāvalokanam, dakṣayajñe gamanāya śaṃbhorājñā, kailāse nāradāgamanaṃ, yajñāddadhīcinirgamaḥ,
yajñe satī gamanaṃ, śaṃkarā''sanā'darśanaṃ,satīdakṣavākyāni, satīdehatyāgaityādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 175।।
