adhyāyaḥ 176
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 177 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi! kīdṛśaṃ trāsakṛddhi tat ।
anātmyaṃ tu pitustasyā nānyastathā kariṣyati ।। 1 ।।
bhasmībhūte satīdehe dṛśyaṃ sakaruṇaṃ tadā ।
samabhūcca samāje'nyonyavāṇī karuṇāvahā ।। 2 ।।
hanta priyā parā śaṃbhorahādasūnprakopitā ।
dakṣeṇa paśyataitasya daurātmyaṃ tu prajāpateḥ ।। 3 ।।
carācaraṃ prajā yasya tasyāpi hṛdayaṃ sadā ।
kṣubdhaṃ ruṣṭaṃ kharaṃ śuṣkamaho saṃsārakaṣṭatā ।। 4 ।।
śaṃkarasya priyā'bhīkṣṇaṃ mānayogyā satāṃ sadā ।
dakṣeṇa vimanā sā'bhūt tatrāpi sumahotsave ।। 5 ।।
tasmāddurmarṣahṛdayo brahmadhik ca duhitṛdhṛk ।
mahatīmapakīrtiṃ saḥ prāpsyatyakhilasṛṣṭiṣu ।। 6 ।।
yaḥ svāṃgajāṃ sutāṃ śabhudviṭ nyaṣedhatsamāgatām ।
mahānarakabhogī sa putrīhā no'parādhataḥ ।। 7 ।।
vadatyevaṃ jane dṛṣṭvā satyāścā'suviyojanam ।
drāgeva pārṣadāḥ krūrā hyudatiṣṭhannudāyudhāḥ ।। 8 ।।
ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi te sarve saṃvṛtya makhabhūmikām ।
mā kaścid bahirnigacchedghātayantu makhasthale ।। 9 ।।
hāhākārairvikrośanto dhigdhikdakṣetivādinaḥ ।
mārayantu nāśayantu mardayantu makhāṃ'gaṇe ।। 1.176.10 ।।
gaganaṃ ca tadā hāhākārairvyāptamabhūt priye ।
devāḥ prāpan bhayaṃ sarve munayo'nye'pi ye sthitāḥ ।। 11 ।।
akāṃḍayuddhaṃ saṃprāptaṃ pralayo vai bhaviṣyati ।
dakṣayajñā''gatānāṃ te hyakurvan hananaṃ bahu ।।12।।
śastrairaghnanparāṃgāni sutīkṣṇaiḥ prāṇanāśibhiḥ ।
dakṣapakṣaistathā tatra ghātitā dve'yute tadā ।।1 3।।
anye śastrairdakṣanāśaṃ kartuṃ yātā udāyudhāḥ ।
teṣāmāpatatāṃ vegaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhagavān bhṛguḥ ।। 14।।
yajñaghnaghnena yajuṣā dakṣiṇāgnau tadā''juhot ।
hūyamāne samutpetuḥ ṛbhavaśca sahasraśaḥ ।। 15।।
alātaśastrāste sarve bhṛguvahnibalānvitāḥ ।
yuyudhuḥ pramathaistatra prāṇārpaṇasamīhayā ।। 16।।
ṛbhubhiḥ prabalaistatra hanyamānāḥ satīgaṇāḥ ।
dve'yute cā'pare tatra mṛtāḥ śeṣāḥ palāyitāḥ ।। 17।।
dakṣapakṣasya sainyānāṃ lakṣaṃ yamagṛhaṃ gatam ।
tatkāle ye gurujanā viṣṇubrahmarṣayo'malāḥ ।। 18।।
na hantavyā iti kṛtvā na hatā bhūsurāstathā ।
tadā te ṛṣayo devāḥ śakrādyāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ ।। 19।।
viśve'śvinau lokapālāstūṣṇīmāsan grahādayaḥ ।
svasvavimānayāneṣu vyomamārge vyavasthitāḥ ।।1.176.20।।
udvignāḥ prārthayantaśca vighnā'bhāvaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।
dakṣajāmātaro dakṣakanyā dakṣakuṭumbinaḥ ।।21 ।।
viṣṇubrahmarṣisainyaistu rakṣitā bahuyatnataḥ ।
yajñabhūmistadā śuddhāṃ kṛtā śavavivāhanaiḥ ।।22।।
yajñabhūmau punardakṣā'grahātsarve vyavasthitāḥ ।
yajñapūrtīcchayā śīghraṃ homakarmā'bhavattataḥ ।।23।।।
etasminnantare tatra vyomavāṇī jagāda ha ।
re re dakṣa durācāra daṃbhācāra mahākhala ।।24।।
kimidaṃ kṛtavān mūḍha bhāvyanarthakaraṃ tava ।
dadhīciste makhācchāpaṃ datvā yāto na buddhavān ।।25।।
gṛhā''gatāṃ jyeṣṭhaputrīṃ yogyāṃ mānitavānnahi ।
jñānahīna! śivau pūjyau garvātpūjitavānnahi ।।26।।
putrīṃ matvā satīṃ phaladāmārādhitavānnahi ।
sarvasaubhāgyadāṃ sādhvīṃ samprasāditavānnahi ।।27।।
bhaktamaṃgaladāṃ devīṃ tvaṃ samarcitavānnahi ।
sarvabhītiharāṃ śaktiṃ natvā raṃjitavānnahi ।।28।।
mano'bhīṣṭapradāṃ prahvāṃ premṇā drāvitavānnahi ।
kīrtisampatpradāmīśāṃ dhyātvā yājitavānnahi ।।29।।
bhuktimuktipradāṃ dhātrīṃ prasaṃbhojitavānnahi ।
rakṣikāṃ poṣikāṃ hantrīṃ hṛdi dhāritavānnahi ।।1.176.30।।
sarvasṛṣṭiprajananīṃ śāntiṃ nayitavānnahi ।
śaṃbhorbhāgaṃ śaṃbhupatnyai yajñe cārpitavānnahi ।।3 1।।
tapyate hi tapaḥ siddhaiḥ sādhvībhirdarśanecchayā ।
yujyate yogibhiryogairetaddarśanakāṃkṣayā ।।32।।
tayoḥ sarvajagatpitroḥ satkāraṃ kṛtavānnahi ।
ata evā'dhvarasyā'sya vināśo bhavitā dhruvam ।।33।।
satkāryau satkṛtau naiva kathaṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati ।
daurbhāgyaṃ tvayi saṃkrāntaṃ saṃkrāntāstvayi cāpadaḥ ।।34।।
anabhyarcya śivāṃ śaṃbhuṃ kalyāṇaṃ prāpnuyāmiti ।
kiṃ te garvaḥ samāyāto garvaste'dya vinaṃkṣyati ।।35।।
śaṃkarādvimukho bhūtvā deveṣveteṣu kastava ।
sāhāyyado bhavedatra na taṃ paśyāmi kaṃcana ।।36
devā vā yadi vā cānye'dhunā ye te sahāyinaḥ ।
dhruvaṃ te nāśamāpsyanti vahninā śalabhā iva ।।37।
śiraste jvalitaṃ cāstu yajñopadā jvalantvapi ।
tvatsahāyā amāṃgalye viśantu prajvalantu ca ।।38।।
viniryāntu surāḥ svokaścāsmādadhvarabhūsthalāt ।
adyā'trasthāyināṃ dhvaṃso bhavitā'tra kṣaṇāntare ।।39।।
bālā vṛddhāḥ striyaścānye svakā niryāntu cā'dhvarāt ।
viṣṇo vidhe puṣpavantau niryāntu cā'dhvarasthalāt ।।1.176.40।।
anyathā bhavatāṃ nāśo bhavitā vai kṣaṇāntare ।
sarvān saṃśrāvya vyaramat nabhovāṇī tathāpi vai ।।41।।
yajñabhūmigatā bhāvidaivanaṣṭā na niryayuḥ ।
yajñakālaḥ saśoko'pi yajñapūrtyarthameva te ।।42।।
kurvanti havanaṃ śīghraṃ yajñakāryaṃ pravartate। ।
atha śrīnārado devaḥ satīdāhottaraṃ drutam ।।43 ।।
satīvṛttāntamakhilaṃ harāyā''śaṃsituṃ yayau ।
kailāse śaṃbhunikaṭe gatvā natvā haraṃ śvasan ।।44।।
duḥkhaṃ ca darśayan śokaṃ vaimanasyaṃ pradarśayan ।
kāruṇyaṃ cātijanayan bhayamāvedayaँstathā ।।49। ।
netrādaśru vimuñcaśca prakampan prāha śaṃkaram ।
amāyikasya māyāyā bādho naiveti dṛśyate ।।46।।
sarvasvamapi naśyeta kā cintā yogino'tra vai ।
nāpacīyeta te kiṃcinnopacīyet te'thavā ।।47 ।।
avyayatvācca pūrṇatvāt hānivṛddhī kutastvayi ।
dakṣeṇā'dya tavaiśvaryamāskanditaṃ padena vai ।।48 ।।
yasya mānā'vamānena nindāstutī same tathā ।
hānyahānī na gaṇite kiṃ tadagre raveṇa vai ।।49 ।।
svasya nāśe'pi yatkeśaḥ kampate nahi sarvathā ।
kiṃ vṛthā saṃbhṛtastena bhāraścaiśvaryakośajaḥ ।1.176.50
nā'bhimānadhanaṃ yasya nā'vajñājanyaśocanam ।
tasyāgre kathanaṃ sarvaṃ mahiṣyagre kathā yathā ।।5 1 ।।
abhimānarahitāgre sābhimānāṃganā varā ।
dhanyā nirabhimānasya sābhimānā tu sā satī ।। 12 ।।
śrūyate svapyate kiṃvā karṇau sto vā na vā mune! ।
tava nindāśravātsādhvī tṛṇīcakre svajīvitam ।।1 3 । ।
ityākarṇya tadā śaṃbhurmahākāla ivā'paraḥ ।
rudraścātīva rudro'bhūt bahukopāgnidīpitaḥ ।। 5 4।।
vikarālānanastatrā'vocattu nāradaṃ drutam ।
huँ huँ huँ kimabhūt tatra tṛṇīcakre svajīvitam ।।55 ।।
ho nārada! kiṃ bravīṣi satī tatyāja jīvitam ।
ḍūँh ḍūँh ḍūँh ḍūँh ḍūँh ḍamāk ḍaṃ ḍūँh ḍamarūṃ ninādya śaṃkaraḥ । 56 ।
jaṭāṃ saṃbhramya bhūpṛṣṭhe balāt tāḍitavān ruṣā ।
praghaṭṭanānmahādhūmraḥ samutpannaḥ kṣitiṃ khanan ।।57।।
tanmadhyāttu samutpanno mahājvālodayo giriḥ ।
girideva tato jātaḥ kālamṛtyuprakampanaḥ ।।58 ।।
pratyakṣaḥ pratimākāro rudra iva bhayaṃkaraḥ ।
vīrabhadro'paro rudraḥ śatarudraparākramaḥ ।।59 । ।
yasya haste mandarādrisamā cāsīt gadā tadā ।
bhūśuṇḍī vindhyavaddīrghā parighaṃ raivatādrivat ।।1.176.6 0 ।।
netre prasphārite tasya sūryācandramasāviva ।
lalajjihā jvalajjvālāmukhipaṭṭābhisadṛśī ।।6 1 ।।
arbudācalavattasya vakṣaḥsthalamaśobhata ।
pādāṃ'guṣṭhāṃ'gulībhyāṃ sa madhye saṃgṛhya satvaram ।। 62 । ।
himādreḥ śṛṃgamutpāṭya dhṛtvā kukṣau kapardavat ।
natvā śaṃbhuṃ tadovāca ki dāsyaṃ karavai tava । । 63 ।।
karavāṇyekakavalaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram ।
pibāmi sakalānabdhīnekenāṃ'jalinā''jñayā ।। 64 । ।
pātālāni vinimayya nayāmyadho uparyapi ।
ihā''naye lokapālān keśaiḥ pragṛhya sendrakān । । 61 । ।
kālaṃ mṛtyuṃ tathā vadhvā hyānaye tu tvadantikam ।
daityadānavasaṃgrāme prabalaṃ praṇihanmyaham ।। 66 ।।
paśya matpādapatanāt kampate kṣoṇimaṇḍalam ।
dorbhyāṃ tu parvatānsarvān cūrṇayāmi ca te balāt । । 67 । ।
kiṃ bahūktena dehyājñāṃ mamā'sādhyaṃ na kiṃcana ।
tvatpādabalamāsādya kṛtaṃ viddhyadya cintitam । । 68 ।।
ityuktvā vīrabhadraḥ saḥ pronnato doḥsahasravān ।
yāvacchaṃbhoḥ pādadhūlīṃ dadhāra mūrdhni sannidhau । । 69 ।।
tāvattatra rudantaśca samāyātā makhādgaṇāḥ ।
procurdeva mahādeva! pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān । । 1.176.70 ।।
saṃśṛṇvādarato nātha satīvārtāṃ pravistarāt ।
garvitena tu dakṣeṇa satyā anādaraḥ kṛtaḥ । ।7 1 ।।
tubhyaṃ bhāgamadānno saḥ devebhyaśca pradattavān ।
durvacāṃsyavadat proccaiḥ śrutvā'kupyat satī makhe । । 72 । ।
vinindya bahuśastātamadhākṣītsvatanuṃ makhe ।
caturayutasaṃkhyākā gaṇā naṣṭā tadā'dhvare । । 73 ।।
lajjayā raṇasaṃgrāmaṃ kṛtvā cāpi hatā makhe ।
yajñanāśaprakartāro'smatpakṣāśca gaṇāstadā । । 74। ।
bhṛguhomotpāditaiśca ṛbhubhirvai hatā makhe ।
lakṣayoddhāra evānye dakṣasya tu hatā gaṇaiḥ । । 75 । ।
tathāpi makhabhūmeste śuddhiṃ kṛtvā vitanvate ।
yajñaṃ dakṣastathā dakṣapakṣagrāhāḥ surarṣayaḥ ।।76 ।।
satīśokaṃ na kurvanti śaṃbhuṃ naiva smaranti ca ।
vihasanti satīnāśāt dantān kurvanti vaḥ prati । ।77 ।।
apamānaṃ tava satyāstasmin yajñe viśeṣataḥ ।
dakṣādyāste'khilā duṣṭā akurvan garvitā ati । । 78 ।।
naṣṭānāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ tu saṃjīvanārthameva vai ।
mantraṃ bhasmobhayaṃ dehi dehi no'mṛtabuṭṭikām । । 79 । ।
tatra bhṛgvādayaścānyāna navānutpādayanti tān ।
vināśayituṃ roddhuṃ ca dehi śaktiṃ mahālayām ।।1.176.8 0 ।।
brahmaṇā śaṃbhave dattaḥ kālakavalasaṃjñakaḥ ।
sa mantraḥ śaṃbhunā datto vīrabhadrāya dhīmate ।।8 1 ।।
śastraṃ phutkṛtya roṣeṇa śatrūn dṛṣṭvā prayojayet ।
kālakavalamantraḥ sa hyanyebhyo'pi pradīyatām ।।82।।
'oṃ mṛtemṛtyo mahāmṛtyo mṛtyā saha sthiro bhava ।
oṃ mṛtimṛtyo mahāmṛtyau svamṛtyā saँstiro bhava' ।।।83।।
iti phutkārapūrvaṃ vai śastraṃ śarādikaṃ ca yat ।
prakṣipecchatruśarīre mṛtvā punarna jīvati ।।84।।
vīrabhadreṇa tatkāle śaṃkarādeva śikṣitaḥ ।
sādhitaścāpi tatreva śaṃkarasya nideśataḥ ।।85 ।।
śarīre bhasma sammṛdya homā'yutaṃ tadā'nale ।
lakṣajapān sa tatraiva kṛtvā'yutasuvarṣmabhiḥ ।।86।।
sādhayitvā kālamantraṃ śarīrāṇi vilīya ca ।
ekākyeva punarbhūtvā vīrabhadro mahākṣayaḥ ।।87।।
sajjo'bhūdgamanāyaiva nideśamārthayaddharāt ।
haro'pi ca satīdehaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ tu nāradāt ।।88।।
gaṇebhyaśca nijāṃ nindāṃ dakṣasyātipragarvitām ।
śrutvā dakṣasya sarvasya nāśārthaṃ svajaṭāṃ kṣitau ।।89।।
prāsphālayāmāsa roṣāt tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ ।
mārjayāmāsa saṃkrodhāddhūnayāmāsa sarvataḥ ।।1.176.90।।
prāsphālane jaṭābhyaśca mahālayākhyaśaktitaḥ ।
tāḍane ca jvarā jātā mārjane kālikāhvayāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
dhūnane ca gaṇā jātā arbudārbudakoṭayaḥ ।
hastatālikayā mahābhayadā bhūtakoṭayaḥ ।।92।।
devyo mahālayāstatra koṭirarbudamityapi ।
saśastrā aṣṭasaddhastā navayauvanagarvitāḥ ।।93 ।।
atibhayaṃkarākārā yuddhakarmakṛtaśramāḥ ।
jvarā mūrtidharāḥ krūrāstrayodaśābjakoṭayaḥ ।।94।।
saśastrā nāśakāryāntā ripvapunarāvartikāḥ ।
kālikādimahācaṇḍyo raṇāṃgaṇapranartikāḥ ।।95।।
saśastramantrabuṭṭyāḍhyā mahākālyo bhayaṃkarā ।
gaṇāḥ sarve parārdhāśca parārdhasya parārdhakāḥ ।।96।।
saśastrakavacā'strādijñātāro yuddhakovidāḥ ।
prārthayanto haraṃ śīghraṃ prajvalanto diśo daśa ।।97।।
sajjā vai tvarayāṃcakruḥ śaṃbhvājñāvāṭadarśinaḥ ।
sainyaṃ tvasaṃkhyamevātra kailāse samabhūnnavam ।।98।।
vīrabhadro haraṃ prāha śīghramājñāpaya prabho ।
śoṣaṇīyā mayā śaṃbho kṣaṇārdhenaiva sindhavaḥ ।।99।।
peṣaṇīyā mayā tatra kṣaṇārdhenaiva parvatāḥ ।
kṣaṇena bhasmasātkuryāṃ brahmāṇḍamuta devatāḥ ।। 1.176.100 ।।
sarve lokā vyasavaśca kimu kāryāśca me vad ।
praṇato'smi mahādeva bhūyo'pi praṇato'smyaham ।। 101 ।।
spando'pi jāyate'savyāṃgānāṃ te vijayapradaḥ ।
harṣotsāhaviśeṣopi jāyate'pūrva eva me ।। 1 02।।
śīghraṃ preṣaya māṃ śaṃbho kiṃ kāryaṃ brūhi satvaram ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā vīrabhadraṃ tāmravilocanaḥ ।। 103 ।।
dakṣo makhaṃ karotyāśu madvirodhena garvataḥ ।
tanmakhaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā sayāgaparivārakam ।। 1 04।।
punarāyāhi kailāsaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvarāṃ kuru ।
madviruddhāḥ surā yadvā gandharvā munayo'pare ।। 1 05।।
ṛṣayo bhūsurā yadvā ye kecittatra saṃgatāḥ ।
tānapyadyaiva sahasā bhasmasātkuru satvaram ।। 1 06।।
yadi viṣṇuśca brahmā ca mahendro vā yamo'pi vā ।
dakṣasya pakṣapātī syād bhasmasāt tānvidhehi vai ।। 107।।
dadhīcimatamullaṃghya ye dakṣapakṣapātinaḥ ।
tiṣṭhanti cādhvare tāँstvaṃ bhasmasātkuru bhadraka ।। 108।।
ākāśavāṇyā bodhitāstathāpi yānti no bahiḥ ।
yajñasthān me drohiṇastān bhasmasātkuru bhadraka ।। 1 09।।
dakṣamakhā''ptadraviṇān dakṣaśraiṣṭhyapravādinaḥ ।
satīśaṃbhurghrāṇanastān bhasmasātkuru bhadraka ।। 1.176.110 ।।
dakṣapakṣagatāścāpi mṛtyubhayaṃ vilokya ye ।
syustāvakāḥ kṣaṇikā bhasmasātkuru tānapi ।। 111 ।।
devā vā devaputrā vā manavo manuputrakāḥ ।
brāhmā vā brahmaputrā vā tatpautrā vāpi ye khalāḥ ।। 11 2।।
sastrīkāśca saputrāśca satīśaṃbhuvirodhinaḥ
bhasmasātkuru tānsarvān paścāśca salilaṃ piba ।। 113 ।।
ityukto vīrabhadrastu raktāveśo bhavan muhuḥ ।
rudrāveśastathā kālāveśo'bhavat pracaṇḍakaḥ ।। 1 14।।
adṛśyaścā'pradhṛṣyaśca nārāyaṇena vedhasā ।
babhūva pralayāveśo bhayāveśo bhayaṃkaraḥ ।। 1 15।।
mastakāttasya kālāgnisamudrāḥ prābhavaँstadā ।
brahmāṇḍaṃ jvālayannatvā śaṃkaraṃ pracacāla saḥ ।। 1 16।।
nārado'pi kaliṃ samyagudbhāvyā'gre makhaṃ gataḥ ।
prāha viṣṇuṃ ca śakraṃ ca vedhasaṃ ca tathā surān ।। 1 17।।
vīrabhadraḥ samāyāti vināśaḥ syādbhayaṃkaraḥ ।
tasmādato'pasarpantu mā paśyantu yamagṛham ।। 1 18।।
kālo nā'yaṃ kuṭumbasya sambandhasyāpi locakaḥ ।
tasmātpralayavegebhyo'pasartavyaṃ subuddhibhiḥ ।। 1 19।।
śrutvā viṣṇuyamavedhomahendrabhūsurādayaḥ ।
dakṣapakṣā'vamantāro makhāttasmādviniryayuḥ ।। 1.176.120 ।।
sastrīkā saparīvārāḥ svasvavimānasaṃsthitāḥ ।
vyomamārgeṇa yātāste dūraṃ dūraṃ prayānti vai ।। 121।।
bhṛguṇā tu tadā jñātvā sainyāni homakarmabhiḥ ।
ṛbhuśṛṃbhudharāṃbhvādigaṇānāmarbudāni ca ।। 122।।
parārdhāni navānyeva kṛtāni dakṣapātataḥ ।
saśastrāḥ sāgnikā svecchārūpavirūpadhārakāḥ ।। 123।।
yuddhamātranipūṇāste mantreśūnyā najīvanāḥ ।
sajjāḥ samabhavan bhūmau gagane yakṣarakṣakāḥ ।। 1 24।।
pravartate yajñakāryaṃ pūrṇatvamavaśiṣyate ।
pūrṇāhutistu madhyāhne bhāvinīti ca satvaram ।। 125।।
yājakā yajñakāryāṇi kurvanti tvaritāstadā ।
kintu satīpraśāpena dadhīcivacanena ca ।। 1 26।।
pūrṇo yajño na vai bhāvī madhyāhnapūrvameva yat ।
vīrabhadraḥ samāyāto'rbudā'rbudaprasainyavān ।। 127।।
śatayojanataḥ pūrvaṃ sainyaśabdaṃ samāgataḥ ।
daśayojanataḥ paścāddhūlīprādrirvyadṛśyata ।। 128।।
kṣayāntare'drisadṛśāḥ samadṛśyanta śāṃkarāḥ ।
gaṇā bhayakarā raudrā yoddhāro'māpavigrahāḥ ।। 129 ।।
avaterurnipetuśca ṛbhusainyeṣu cāmbare ।
śṛṃbhusainyeṣu pṛthvyāṃ ca dharāmbhupṛtanāsvapi ।। 1.176.130 ।।
atha śaṃbhurvīrabhadrānugāँścānyān mahāgaṇān ।
svaniśvāsasamudbhūtān śatakoṭīnavāsṛjat ।। 131 ।।
ambaraṃ taiḥ samākrāntaṃ celuḥ pārśve ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ।
śṛṃgāgrāṇi girīṇāṃ ca kaiścidutpāṭitāni vai ।। 13 2।।
kaiścittvācūḍamūlāśca parvatā vai samuddhṛtāḥ ।
kecanotpāṭya vai śālavṛkṣānādāya saṃyayuḥ ।। 133 ।।
pārṣadāḥ kālakālasya sarve rudrasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
ayutā'yutasiṃhāśca śārdūlā makarā gajāḥ ।। 134।।
koṭilakṣāṇi yānāni vāhanāni pragṛhya ca ।
gatāni tatra sainyāni puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūdgatau ।। 1 35।
kālī kātyāyanīśānī cāmuṇḍā muṇḍamardinī ।
bhadrakālī tathā bhadrā kauśikī vaiṣṇavī tathā ।। 136 ।
etābhirnavadurgābhiryuktā ghorasvarūpiṇī ।
mahākālī yayau dakṣavināśāya tu satvarā ।। 1 37।।
ḍākinī śākinībhūtagaṇapramathaguhyakāḥ।
kūṣmāṇḍāḥ parpaṭāścaiva caṭakā brahmarākṣasāḥ ।। 138 ।।
bhairavāḥ kṣetrapālāśca vetālāśca vināyakāḥ ।
niryayustvaritaṃ vīrā dakṣayajñavināśakāḥ ।। 139 ।।
tathaiva yoginīcakraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭigaṇānvitam ।
niryayau sahasā kruddhaṃ koṭivetālinīyutam ।। 1.176.140 । ।
abhyayācchaṃkukarṇaśca daśakoṭyā gaṇeśvaraḥ ।
daśabhiḥ kekarākṣaśca vikṛto'ṣṭābhirityapi ।। 141 ।।
catuḥṣyā viśākhaśca navabhiḥ pāriyātrikaḥ ।
ṣaḍbhiḥ sarvāṃkako vīrastathaiva vikṛtānanaḥ ।। 142।।
jvālakeśo dvādaśakoṭibhirjīmāँstu saptabhiḥ ।
dudrubho'ṣṭābhiḥ koṭibhiḥ kapālīśastu paṃcabhiḥ ।। 143 ।।
ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃdārako yāyāt kokuṇḍaḥ koṭikoṭibhiḥ ।
viṣṭaṃbho'ṣṭā'ṣṭabhiryāyāt koṭibhirgaṇasattamaḥ ।। 144।।
sahasrakoṭibhiryāyāt śaṃnādaḥ pippalastathā ।
āveśānastathā'ṣṭābhiraṣṭābhiścandratāpanaḥ ।। 145 ।।
mahāveśaḥ sahasreṇa koṭinā gaṇapastathā ।
kuṇḍī dvādaśakoṭibhistathā parvatako yayau ।। 146 ।।
kālaśca kālakaścaiva mahākālastathā gaṇaḥ ।
koṭīnāṃ śatakenaiva yajñanāśaṃ yayuḥ prati ।। 147।।
agnikṛcchatakoṭyā ca koṭyā'gnimukha ityapi ।
ādityamūrdhā koṭyā ca tathā koṭyā ghanāvahaḥ ।। 148 ।।
sannāhaḥ śatakoṭyā ca koṭyā ca kumudo gaṇaḥ ।
amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva koṭikoṭyā gaṇādhipaḥ ।। 149।।
kāṣṭhāgūḍhaścatuḥṣaṣṭyā sukeśī vṛṣabhastathā ।
sumantrako gaṇādhīśastathā yajñaṃ viniryayuḥ ।। 1.176.150 ।।
kākapādodaraḥ santānakaśca ṣaṣṭikoṭibhiḥ ।
mahābalaḥ puṃgavaśca navabhiḥ koṭibhistathā ।। 151 ।।
madhupiṃgaḥ pūrṇabhadro navatikoṭibhiryayau ।
virūpākṣastālaketuḥ ṣaḍāsyaḥ paṃcavaktrakaḥ ।। 152।।
saṃvartakaḥ kulīśo daityānto lokāntakastathā ।
bhṛṃgīriṭiḥ śṛṃgiriṭiraśanirbhālakastathā ।। 153 ।।
catuḥṣaṣṭyā sahitāste pratyekamadhvaraṃ yayuḥ ।
bhūtakoṭisahasrāṇi śvagaṇastisṛkoṭibhiḥ ।। 1 54।।
nyapatadvyomamārgeṇa dakṣasyā'dhvarabhūmiṣu ।
tayā bheryaśca śaṃkhāśca paṭahāścāpi gomukhāḥ ।। 155।।
śṛṃgāṇi vividhānyeva nineduśca raṇotsave ।
dakṣavāmākṣi bāhūruvispandaḥ samajāyata ।। 156।।
bhūkampo'bhūcca madhyāhne dakṣo'paśyannakṣatrakam ।
diśo malīmlucastvāsan nistejo'bhūddivākaraḥ ।। 157।।
pariveṣaiḥ saptabhiśca parivṛto bhayapradaḥ ।
nakṣatrāṇi patanti smā'kālikastanayitnavaḥ ।। 158।।
nakṣatrāṇāmabhūdvakrā gatiścādhomukhī tadā ।
gṛdhro dakṣaśiraḥ spṛṣṭvā yayau nītvā śiraḥpaṭam ।। 159।।
vavāśire ca jambūkāḥ kharā vātā vavustadā ।
ulkāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṃsuvṛṣṭiḥ śvetavṛścikavarṣaṇam ।। 1.176.160 ।।
arbudā'rbudaśalabhā dṛśyante sma makhāṃ'bare ।
nītaśca pavanairūrdhvaṃ dakṣasyā'dhvaramaṇḍapaḥ ।। 16 1।।
vemuḥ raktaṃ yājñīyāste sakampā babhūvustadā ।
asṛgvṛṣṭirdiśāṃ dāhastimirāvṛtikā diśaḥ ।। 162।।
evaṃvidhānyariṣṭāni cādrākṣurdakṣayajñagāḥ ।
bhuvi te mūrchitāḥ peturhā hatāḥ smeti cairayan ।। 163।।
etasminnantare tatrākāśavāṇī jagāda tān ।
dhik dakṣa dhik surādyā vo'nivāryaṃ duḥkhamāgatam ।। 164।।
tāvattu śaṃbhusainyāni praviṣṭāni makhāṃgaṇam ।
bhayā''viṣṭastadā dakṣo hyagacchaccharaṇaṃ hareḥ ।। 165 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīpārṣadānāṃ yuddhaṃ, dakṣāya vyomavāṇī, nāradasya punaḥ kailāsagamanaṃ, śaṃbhujaṭāto vīrabhadrotpattiḥ, avaśeṣagaṇānāṃ kailāsāgamanam, kālikājvaragaṇabhūtasiṃhādisainyasarjanam, yajñaṃ prati preṣaṇam, nāradasya yajñaṃ pratyāgamaḥ, dakṣāderapaśakunāni cetyādi nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 176 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 176 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 177
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 178 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
dakṣastadā bhayodvigno viṣṇuṃ sasmāra padmaje ।
devadeva harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa jagadguro ।। 1 ।।
mama rakṣā vidhātavyā makhasya ca janasya ca ।
makhabhaṃgo mā bhavatu makhātmakastvamacyuta ।। 2 ।।
brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tasya śrutā vai prārthanā tadā ।
haṃsaṃ garuḍamāruhya svasthānātpunarāgatau ।। 3 ।।
papāta pādayostayorbhayavyākulamānasaḥ ।
utthāpya ca tato viṣṇurdakṣaṃ viklinnamānasam ।। 4 ।।
prāha dakṣa śṛṇu tattvaṃ sarvathā hitakṛdvacaḥ ।
avajñā hi kṛtā dakṣa tvayā tattvamajānatā ।। 5 ।।
īśasyā'vajñayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati niṣphalam ।
viphalaṃ kevalaṃ naiva vipattiśca pade pade ।। 6 ।।
apūjyā yatra pūjyante pūjanīyo na pūjyate ।
trīṇi tatra bhavantyeva dāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ bhayam ।। 7 ।।
asatkṛtānmahādevāt mahadbhayamupasthitam ।
śaṃkaro vaiṣṇavo devo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 8 ।।
nārāyaṇasya bhaktasya hyaparādhaḥ kṛtastvayā ।
bhaktāparādhino rakṣāṃ kartuṃ svāmī na vai kṣamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
śivasya śaraṇaṃ yāhi sa vai rakṣāṃ kariṣyati ।
ahaṃ bhaktaparādhīnaḥ satīnāśena duḥkhyaham ।। 1.177.10 ।।
krūrasya kṛtakāryasya phalaṃ prāpnuhi kiṃ bhavet ।
dakṣastadvacanaṃ śrutvā vivarṇavadano'bhavat ।। 11 ।।
prāha ca śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇa yajñāraṃbho bhavadbalāt ।
kṛto'yaṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣin vedadharmasya siddhaye ।। 1 2।।
tasmād rakṣā vidhātavyā yajñasyā'sya mama prabho!
tvāṃ vinā rakṣituṃ yajñaṃ cā'smān śakto na vidyate ।। 13 ।।
viṣṇuḥ prāhā'dhvararakṣā vidhātavyā mayā dhruvam ।
khyāto mama paṇaḥ sarvo dharmasya paripālanam ।। 14।।
maryādā vedadharmasya rakṣaṇīyā mayā sadā ।
yajñe devatrayāṇāṃ ca tathā'nyeṣāṃ mahātmanām ।। 15।।
surādīnāṃ ca bhāgo'sti vedo vakti na cā'nyathā ।
tvayā vyatikramastasya mānenācarito'dhvare ।। 16।।
vada dakṣa dharmapaṇaḥ kathaṃ tyājyo mayā bhavet ।
kathaṃ satīśivau yajñe tvayā nā'kāritau purā ।। 17।।
kathaṃ yajñasya maryādā hyullaṃghitā vijānatā ।
kiṃ karma kimakarmeti na kiṃ paśyasi durmate ।। 18।।
devenaikena śūnyo'yaṃ yajño naiva phalapradaḥ ।
kevalaṃ jñānamāśritya mānamāśritya yājakāḥ ।। 19।।
īśvaraṃ ca parityajya kevale karmaṇi sthitāḥ ।
te nu karmamayaiḥ pāśairbadhyante bahujanmasu ।।1.177.20।।।
nirayeṣu prapacyante hīśvarasya'vamānakāḥ ।
ekatra tu śivākhyasya bhrātuḥ sainyamupasthitam ।।21।।।
aparatra ca dakṣādeḥ putrapautrādivāhinī ।
sarve sambandhino devāḥ kuṭumbaṃ tvekameva ha ।।22।।
kutra sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ moktavyaṃ vada me'dhunā ।
kuṭumbināṃ sevakānāṃ sarvathā ca mahātmanām ।।।23।।
nāśa upasthitaste'tra śivā'vamānadoṣataḥ ।
nāśa āmantrito buddhyā gṛhanāśa upasthitaḥ ।।24।।
ayaṃ rudragaṇādhīśo vīrabhadro'rimardanaḥ ।
sarvavināśanārthaṃ vai cāgato'sti na saṃśayaḥ ।।।25।।
evaṃ bruvati govinde sainyamāpatitaṃ tadā ।
parito'dhvarabhūmau tad vyapaśyan vai surādayaḥ ।।26।।
indrastadā hasan rudraṃ vīrabhadraṃ tathā gaṇam ।
vajraṃ dhṛtvā kare yoddhuṃ sajjo'bhūt surasainyakaḥ ।।27।।
indraḥ svagajamārūḍho vastārūḍho'nalaḥ svayam ।
yamo mahiṣamārūḍho nirṛtiḥ pretavāhanaḥ ।।28।।
varuṇo makarārūḍho mṛgārūḍho'nilastathā ।
kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho yuyudhe śaṃkaraiḥ saha ।।29।।
tathā'nye surayoddhāro yakṣacāraṇaguhyakāḥ ।
āruhya vāhanānyeva yuyudhire pratāpinaḥ ।।1.177.3 0।।
devānāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ ca tadāsītsamaro mahān ।
neduḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca mahādundubhayastathā ।।3 1।।
ḍiṇḍimāḥ paṭahā neduḥ raṇaśṛṃgāṇi gomukhāḥ ।
tīkṣṇatomaranārācaiḥ surā jaghnurgaṇān bahūn ।।32।।
indrādyairlokapālādyairgaṇāḥ śaṃbhorvinirjitāḥ ।
bhṛgormantrajasainyaiśca nirjitāśca palāyitāḥ ।।33।।
uccāṭanaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ bhṛguṇā yajvanā tadā ।
caṇḍikānāṃ ca sainyāni makhe tatrā''patanti ca ।।34।।
mahālayānāṃ sainyāni yuddhyanti ṛbhusaṃgare ।
kālānāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ ca bhūtapretādidhanvinām ।।35।।
sainyāni devasainyeśca śṛṃbhusainyaiḥ raṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ।
nipātitāni sarvāṇi ṛbhuśṛṃbhudharāṃbhubhiḥ ।। 36।।
abjārbudaparārdhāni gamitāni yamakṣayam ।
araṇyaṃ ca śarīrāṇāṃ samabhūt raṇapātinām ।।।37।।
parājitān svakān dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro'drisannibhaḥ ।
bhūtapretapiśācāँśca kṛtvā tāneva pṛṣṭhataḥ ।।38।।
mahāgaṇānpuraskṛtya samāpatadraṇāṃgaṇe ।
mahātriśūlamādāya pātayāmāsa nirjarān ।।।39।।
devānsādhyagaṇānyakṣāँścāraṇānguhyakānapi ।
śūlaiśca tomaraiḥ śaktipravaraiste prajaghnire ।।1.177.40 ।।
keciddvedhā kṛtāḥ khaḍgairmudgaraiśca vipothitāḥ ।
anyaiḥ śastraistathā'straiśca surā bhinnā mahāgaṇaiḥ ।।41 ।।
kālakavalamantraiśca svabhaṭā jīvitāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
dakṣabhaṭā vinaśyanti ko'pi tajjīvako'sti na ।।42।।
sarve parājitā devāḥ palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ ।
yuddhasthānaṃ parityajya gatāḥ sarve triviṣṭapam ।।43।।
kevalaṃ lokapālāste śakrādyāstasthurutsukāḥ ।
vīrabhadro'bravītsarvāndakṣapakṣaprapātinaḥ ।।44।।
sarve yūyaṃ bāliśatvādavadānārthamāgatāḥ ।
avadānaṃ prayacchāmi samāgacchata me'ntikam ।।45।।
he śakra he guro bhāno śaśin yama dhaneśvara ।
vāyo varuṇa nirṛte śeṣa sūryādayaḥ surāḥ ।।46।।
samāgacchata sānnidhye prayacchāmyavadānakam ।
evamuktvā tīkṣṇabāṇaiḥ śastrairastraiśca parvataiḥ ।।47।।
nirjaghāna surānsarvān dikpatīndrasureśvarān ।
te ca palāyanaparā vidudruvurdiśo daśa ।।48।।
atha palāyitāndṛṣṭvā yajñanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
nārāyaṇo naro bhūtvā dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ mahāsvanam ।।49।।
śrutvā taṃ śaṃkhanirhrādaṃ devāste punarāyayuḥ ।
nandinā yuyudhe śakro vahnistatrā'śmanā saha ।।1.177.50।।।
kuṣmāṇḍāgreṇa dhanarāṭ yuyudhe prāṇadānataḥ ।
yamena ca mahāloko muṇḍastu varuṇena vai ।।5 1।।
nairṛtena tu caṇḍaśca bhṛṃgiṇā vāyurityapi ।
yoginīcakrasaṃyukto bhairavīnāyako mahān ।।।52।।
vidāryā'paradevānvai papau śoṇitamuṣṇakam ।
kṣetrapālā jajakṣustānkālī ca rudhiraṃ papau ।।53।।
avaśiṣṭāstadā devāḥ pracakrire palāyanam ।
viṣṇurbrahmā svasvalokaṃ jagmatuḥ prāk tato'dhvarāt ।।54।।
vināśo'rbudakoṭīnāṃ tadā'bhūdadhvarasthale ।
praviṣṭāśca gaṇā yajñe mardanaṃ vai pracakrire ।।।55।।
kaiścidutpāṭitā yūpāḥ kecitkuṇḍānyapūrayan ।
kaiścittu maṇḍapā dhvastā vedāśca khanitāḥ paraiḥ ।।56।।
kaiściddhavīṃṣi bhuktāni pītānyājyāni cā'paraiḥ ।
kaiściddhvastāni cānnāni pītāni pāyasāni ca ।।57।।
pakvānnāni prabhuktāni kṣīrāṇyāsvāditāni ca ।
cūrṇitāni ca bhagnāni yajñapātrāṇi sarvathā ।।58।।
bhagnāśca śakaṭāḥ kaiścit srucaḥ sruvāśca moṭitāḥ ।
paśavaḥ khāditāḥ kaiścit kuṇḍāgnayo vināśitāḥ ।।59।।
dukūlāni ca ratnāni kaiściddhṛtāni tatsthale ।
tamupadravamālokya yajño mṛgarūpadhṛk ।।1.177.60 ।।
bhītaḥ palāyito vyomnā vīrabhadreṇa saṃdhṛtaḥ ।
tataścālātacakreṇa viśiraskastadā kṛtaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
nandī bhagasya netre dve samujjahāra yo bhagaḥ ।
śapantaṃ dakṣaṃ netrābhyāmasūsucatpunaḥ punaḥ ।।62।।
caṇḍaścotpāṭayāmāsa pūṣṇo dantānpravegataḥ ।
śapamāne hare pūrvaṃ yo'hasad darśayandataḥ ।।63।।
sarasvatyāśca nāsāgraṃ ciccheda vīrabhadrakaḥ ।
aditeroṣṭhapuṭakau cicchedaścānyabhadrakaḥ ।।64।।
vyapothayad bhṛguṃ pṛthvyāṃ maṇibhadro mahābalaḥ ।
padā''kramyorasi tasyā'kārṣīdvai śmaśruluṃcanam ।।65।।
aryamṇo bāhuyugalaṃ tadotpāṭitavānparaḥ ।
agnerutpāṭayāmāsa jihvāmanyo gaṇastadā ।।66।।
ciccheda vāyorvṛṣaṇau gaṇo'nyo balavardhanaḥ ।
gaṇo yamaśirāḥ kaścit yamaṃ babandha rajjubhiḥ ।।67।।
śṛṃgī ca nairṛtaṃ vṛkṣe babandha jaṭayā tadā ।
atolayacca śākhāyāṃ tāḍayāmāsa kaṭyadhaḥ ।।68।।
kuberaṃ padayordhṛtvā rajjvā badhvā hyadhomukham ।
tolayāmāsa yūpordhvaṃ gaṇo dharābhunāmakaḥ ।।69।।
rudrāstu vāmayāmāsurbhakṣakānadhvarāhutīḥ ।
varuṇodaramāpīḍyodgīrayāmāsurājyakam ।।1.177.70।।
indro mayūrarūpeṇoḍḍīya cchanno'bhavad girau ।
prathamāḥ kālayāmāsuranyānapi ca yājakān ।।71 ।।
pragṛhyāriṣṭaneminamaṃgirasaṃ ca kaśyapam ।
dattaṃ kṛśāśvaṃ pādena jaghāna mūrghni bhadrakaḥ ।।72।।
tato'nyānapi devādīn vidārya pṛthivītale ।
munīnṛṣīn vīrabhadrādayaḥ śāntiṃ na vai yayuḥ ।।73 ।।
viḍambitāḥ svadhā svāhā dakṣiṇā'nyāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
mantrāstantrāstathā cānye vastuśeṣā vināśitāḥ ।।74।।
vavṛṣuste purīṣāṇi vinānāgnau ruṣā gaṇāḥ ।
pramathaiḥ sā kṛtā yajñabhūmiḥ śmaśānasannibhā ।।75।।
atiśocyadaśāpannā vīrabhadro jagau gaṇān ।
kva sa dakṣo durācāraḥ kva ca yajña bhujaḥ surāḥ ।।।76।।।
sarvānānayata dhṛtvā yāta drutataraṃ gaṇāḥ ।
ityājñayā dhāvatastān dṛṣṭvā kruddho janārdanaḥ ।।77।।
kṛtavān śaktihrāsaṃ yat gaṇāḥ śuṣkatṛṇāyitāḥ ।
tena kruddho vīrabhadro dadarśa śārṅgiṇaṃ harim ।।78 ।।
prāha dakṣaṃ samānīya dehi yuddhyasva vā mayā ।
hariḥ prāhā'hamapyatra dakṣarakṣaṇadakṣadhīḥ ।।79।।
paśyāmi tava sāmarthyaṃ kathaṃ dakṣaṃ hariṣyasi ।
iti kṛtvā dhṛtaṃ cakraṃ mumoca vīrabhadrake ।।1.177.80।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt lagnaṃ bhadragale tadā ।
yāvat kṛntati kaṇṭhaṃ ca kaṇṭhe śaṃbhuḥ samāsthitaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kaṇṭhaṃ tyaktvā samāyātaṃ vipṇuhastagataṃ hyabhūt। ।
garuḍaśca tadā kruddhastvekaikaṃ pramathaṃ nakhaiḥ ।।82।।
dārayāmāsa lakṣāँste prāpuḥ śobhāṃ tu kaiṃśukīm ।
sarvāngaṇāँstato viṣṇuḥ staṃbhayāmāsa tatsthale ।।83।।
vīrabhadravināśāya yāvatsudarśanaṃ hariḥ ।
prairayacca punastāvad vyomavāṇī jagād tam ।।84।।
hare sāhasaṃ mā'kārṣārvīrabhadre haraḥ sthitaḥ ।
haranāśāya te yatno lajjāvaho nivartaya ।।85।।
dakṣaḥ karmaphalaṃ yātu mā'nyaḥ kaścit tathā''caret ।
śrutvaitāṃ ca hariścakraṃ na mumoca punastadā ।।86।।
antarvedyāntaragataṃ nilīnaṃ prāpya dakṣakam ।
vīrabhadro vinadyoccaiḥ prāha dhikśaṃbhunindakam ।।87।।
yasyedṛgasti sampatiryatra devāḥ sabhāsadaḥ ।
saḥ kathaṃ seśvaraṃ yajñaṃ na kuryāddakṣatāṃ dadhan ।।88।।
yenā''syenā'pavitreṇa bhavatā ninditaḥ śivaḥ ।
chedayāmi tadāsyaṃ te tīkṣṇadhārā'sinā drutam ।।89।।
evamuktvā'sya mūrdhā'tra khaṇḍitastvasinā'pi saḥ ।
kabandhād bhinnatāṃ nāpto yato'bhedyo hi yogataḥ ।।1.177.90।।
abhedyaṃ tacchiro matvā śastrāstrairapi sarvaśaḥ ।
cūrṇayāmītyabhidhāya capeṭābhiracūrṇayat ।।9 1।।
karābhyāṃ troṭayāmāsa padbhyāmākramya corasi ।
agnikuṇḍe ca tatkṣiptvā vīrabhadro juhāva ha ।।92।।
athā'nyānapi yajñasyāndhṛtvā saṃmṛdya tatra ca ।
tarūnprajvālya tatraiva jvālayāmāsa bhūsurān ।।93 ।।
athā'ṭṭahāsamakarot pūrayaँśca jagattrayam ।
tatastvaditimukhyānāṃ militānāṃ mahotsave ।।94।।
troṭayāmāsa karṇādīnyaṃgapratyaṃgakāni ca ।
veṇīdaṇḍāँśca kāsāñcit tena chinnā tadā ruṣā ।।95।।
kāsāṃcicca karāśchinnāḥ kāsāṃcitkartitā bhujāḥ ।
nāsikāśca tathāṃ'gulyaḥ chinnā kāsāṃcideva ha ।।96।।
jihvāḥ karṇāstathā chinnā nindoktā vā śrutā yayā ।
candro dharmo bhṛguścaiva mārīcādyāḥ sutādhavāḥ ।।97।।
atyantamapamānasya bhājanaṃ tena kāritāḥ ।
tāni kuṇḍāni te yūpāste staṃbhāḥ sa ca maṇḍapaḥ ।।98।।
tā vedyastāni pātrāṇi tāni havyānyanekadhā ।
te ca vai yajñasaṃbhārāste te yajñapravartakāḥ ।।99।।
te rakṣapālāste mantrā vineśuḥ śivahelayā ।
kṣaṇatulyena kālena āsan nā''san babhūvire ।। 1.177.100 ।।
mahatāṃ helanāllakṣmi! kṣīyate'rjitasukṛtam ।
tannāśe sarvanāśaḥ syād yathā dakṣasya sampadām ।। 101 ।।
tasmāddroho na kartavyo'lpīyasāmapi dehinām ।
paraduḥkhaphalaṃ svasyā'vaśyaṃ bhoktavyamāpatet ।। 102 ।।
atha viṣṇuryayau vyomni vimānasthaṃ tu vedhasam ।
prāha brahman śaṃkaraṃ vai nītvā''yāhyatra satvaram ।। 103 ।।
vidhihīnaṃ makhadhvasa paśyedāgatya śaṃkaraḥ ।
adhvarasya ca dakṣasya nistāro'pi bhavettadā ।। 10 4।।
śrutvaivaṃ satvaraṃ brahmā kailāsaṃ prajagāma ha ।
uvācā'dhvaravṛttāntaṃ śaṃbhumādāya vai drutam ।। 1 05।।
ājagāmā'dhvarasthānaṃ sarvaṃ dhvastaṃ vilokya ca ।
trāsadaṃ dṛśyamālokya dayāleśānvito haraḥ ।। 106 ।।
kṣaṇaṃ śarvastu saṃpaśyan dūyamānamanā hyabhūt ।
vīrabhadro'pi natvaiva saṃsthito bahulajjitaḥ ।। 1 07।।
brahmā prāha haraṃ tatra prasādya ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
aparādhyapyayaṃ dakṣaḥ samprasādyaḥ surottama ।। 108 ।।
yathāpūrvaṃ punaramūn sarvānkāraya śaṃkara ।
yathā vidhiḥ pravarteta vaidikaḥ punareva saḥ ।। 109।।
tathā''jñā dīyatāṃ śaṃbho karma siddhyati seśvaram ।
anīśvarāsu sarvāsu kriyāsu vai maheśvara ।। 1.177.110 ।।
evameva bhavantyeva vighnajātāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
devabhakto'pi dakṣo'yaṃ devaṃ tyaktvā'karot kratum ।। 111 ।।
loke vigarhaṇāṃ prāptā nidarśanāya so'bhavat ।
īśaṃ tyaktvā ca kāryāṇi kariṣyanti janā yadi ।। 112।।
tadantaṃ te na paśyanti lokā gāsyanti dakṣavat ।
tato magaladaṃ devaṃ vihāyā'nyo janaḥ kvacit। ।। 113 ।।
svārthaṃ cāpi padārthaṃ ca daivaṃ vā'daivamityapi ।
karma naiva kvacitkiṃcit śrutvaitatpravidhāsyati ।। 11 4।।
brahmaṇoktaṃ vicāryaiva prahasya śaṃkaraḥ punaḥ ।
vīramājñāpayāmāsa yathāpūrvaṃ prakalpaya ।। 115।।
tadā gaṇān svasainyāni prairayanmārjanāya tat ।
sthalaṃ bhūtairmārjitaṃ ca bhūmirvipraiḥ susaṃskṛtā ।। 116 ।।
ujjīvitā mṛtā mantraiḥ saṃjīvanyā'mṛtādibhiḥ ।
ye sainyārthaṃ dvayoḥ pakṣe nūtnāścotpāditā bhaṭāḥ ।। 1 17।।
śaṃbhunā bhṛguṇā svasvamantrairlīnīkṛtāśca te ।
koṭyarbudāni sainyāni parārthalakṣakāṇi ca । । 118 ।।
asaṃkhyadevadevīnāṃ paśūnāṃ pṛtanāstathā ।
sarvaṃ līnīkṛtaṃ tatra bhṛguṇā śaṃbhunā tathā ।। 119 ।।
aṃganāśāśca nārīṇāṃ dravyanāśāḥ kratostathā ।
dehanāśā makhasthānāṃ punarujjīvya sandhitāḥ । । 1.177.120 ।।
viṣṇunā brahmaṇā candramasā ca śaṃbhunā makhe ।
kumāreṇā'śvinījena dhanvantariyutena ca । । 121 ।।
sūryeṇa guruṇā yoginībhiḥ śrībhistathā tadā ।
munibhiḥ ṛṣibhiścaiva svasvasāmarthyasaṃyutaiḥ । । 122 । ।
yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cotpāditaṃ tu mānasam ।
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ dāravaṃ caurṇamikṣujam ।। 123 ।।
pāyasaṃ vallijaṃ sasyajanyaṃ kārpāsakaṃ tathā ।
annajaṃ jalajaṃ codbhijjātaṃ hrasva mahacca yat ।। 124 ।।
svalpaṃ pracūrakaṃ cāpi havyaṃ cānyacca yaddhyabhūt ।
vinā dakṣasya vadanaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ samīkṛtam । । 125 ।।
śaṃkarādyā''jñayā''gṛhya yajñīyameṣamastakam ।
tena meṣamukhaṃ dakṣaṃ vīrabhadragaṇo vyadhāt ।। 126 ।।
dakṣasya yajñaśīrṣṇaḥ syāt sadā hyajamukhaḥ śiraḥ ।
mitranetreṇa saṃpaśyet yajñabhāgaṃ bhagaḥ suraḥ ।। 127 ।।
bhagnadantaḥ suraḥ pūṣā bhavatu yajñapiṣṭabhuk ।
bastaśmaśrurbhavedeva bhṛguḥ śivavirodhakṛt । । 128 ।।
devāḥ prakṛtisarvāṃgā bhavantveva sadā svayam ।
bāhubhyāmaśvinau pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ kṛtavāhakaḥ ।। 129 ।।
bhavantvadhvaryavaścānye yathāpūrvaṃ śivājñayā ।
abhavaँste tathā sarve sarvaṃ svasthamabhūttadā ।। 1.177.130 ।।
atha yajñakriyāstatra prāvartanta punaḥ suraiḥ ।
pūrṇāhutiḥ pradattā'vabhṛthasnānaṃ kṛtaṃ surān ।। 131 ।।
viprānabhyāgatānputraduhitṛsvasṛbāndhavān ।
bhāgineyāndeyapātravarānsatkṛtya sarvathā । । 132 ।।
dānāni dattavāँstebhyo dakṣo bastamukho'rthinām ।
tṛptiṃ cākārayat bhakṣyabhojyapānā'mbarādibhiḥ ।। 133 ।।
sarve svānsvānsvatvabhāgānnītvā yātā nijālayān ।
viṣṇuryayau ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmā satyaṃ jagāma ha ।। 1 34।।
dikpālā lokapālāśca surā munyādayaśca ye ।
gatāḥ sarve tṛptahṛdo dānamānārhaṇādibhiḥ ।। 1 35।।
atha śaṃbhurvidhuro vai kva yāmīti vicārayan ।
himālayasya śikharaṃ tapase saṃjagāma saḥ ।। 136 ।।
vānaprasthakriyādharmaṃ jagrāha śaṃkarastadā ।
anāśramavatā puṃsā yataḥ kālo manāgapi ।। 137।।
vyarthaṃ kalayitavyo na vane śreyastapaḥśramaḥ ।
tapaścacāra śarvaḥ sagaṇaḥ śṛṃge śivābhidhe ।। 1 38।।
kailāsasya ca rakṣārthaṃ vīrabhadramayojayat ।
dakṣo'pi pāpaśāntyarthaṃ kāśīṃ jagāma caikalaḥ ।। 1 39।।
tapasā''rādhayacchaṃbhuṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya satvaram ।
prāvirbhūtvā svayaṃ śaṃbhurdakṣapāpaṃ hyamārjayat ।। 1.177.140 ।।
prāha brūhi varaṃ dakṣa dāsyāmi manasepsitam ।
prāha dakṣo haraṃ deyo varo mama yadi tvayā ।। 141।।
tava bhaktiḥ sadā cāstu kṣantavyo me'parādhakaḥ ।
dakṣeśvare tvayā stheyaṃ liṃge tu sarvadā prabho ।। 142।।
dattamiti tathā cā'nyad gṛhāṇa dakṣa me'grataḥ ।
parārdhadvitīyaprānte tato mokṣamavāpsyasi ।। 143।।
iti haro dadau tasmai varadānaṃ pramokṣaṇam ।
dakṣasya yajñabhaṃgaḥ sa na hareṇa kṛtaḥ khalu ।। 144।।
paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati ।
pareṣāṃ kadanaṃ karma na kāryaṃ tat kadācana ।। 145।।
paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati ।
iti sambodhitaṃ tasmād drohaṃ parasya nācaret ।। 146।।
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī caiva caturthakaḥ ।
caturvidhā bhajante'jaṃ caturtho'tra viśiṣyate ।। 147।।
kevalaṃ karmaṇā yo vai saṃsāraṃ tartumicchati ।
na ca pāramavāpnoti madhye vighnena lupyate ।। 148।।
harerbhakto haraṃ nindet harabhakto hariṃ tathā ।
tayoḥ śāpā bhaveyuste tattvaprāptirbhavennahi ।। 149।।
hariharau sadā caikatattvaṃ brahmāpi tanmayaḥ ।
haro brahmā ca viṣṇuśca jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ param ।। 1.177.150 ।।
haransṛjaँstathā rakṣandadhe saṃjñāḥ kriyocitāḥ ।
advitīye pare tasmin brahmaṇyātmani kevale ।। 151।।
ajñaḥ paśyati bhedena bhūtāni brahma ceśvaram ।
ityetadbrahmarūpasya satyāśca śaṃkarasya ca ।। 152।।
caritraṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā śrāvayedbhaktimān janān ।
sarvasaukhyaṃ labhedatra paratra paramāṃ gatim ।। 153।।
yaḥ paṭhetpāṭhayedvāpi satyākhyānamidaṃ śubham ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ sarvārthasampradāyakam ।। 154।।
svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaputrapautraphalapradam ।
sa ca bhuktvā'khilān bhogānante mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।। 155।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhītadakṣaprārthanā, viṣṇunyāyavākyaṃ, surādīnāṃ gaṇādīnāṃ
ca yuddhaṃ, yajñādidhvaṃsaḥ, ṛtvijāmaṃgabhaṃgāni, cakreṇa śivāviṣṭavīrabhadrā'nāśaḥ, śaṃkarāgamanaṃ, sarveṣāṃ punaḥ sajīvanaṃ, yajñasamāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 177।।


← adhyāyaḥ 177 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 178
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 179 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi pareśo vā maheśo vā janārdanaḥ ।
lokarītiśca prakṛtirbādhate tānapi kvacit ।। 1 ।।
mānā'vamāne devasya bādhete brahmaṇo yadi ।
tarhi tatra ca dakṣādeḥ kā kathā kṣudradehinaḥ ।।2 ।।
satīdehe pradagdhe ca śaṃkaro mohamāptavān ।
kalatraśoko balavān svātmārāmaṃ parātparam ।। 3 ।।
bādhate jñāninaṃ cāpi yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum ।
satīdehasya yadbhasma cāsthipuṣpāṇi yāni ca ।। 4 ।।
gṛhītvā śaṃkarastāni vilalāpā'śrunetrakaḥ ।
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha subhage sati prāṇeśvari priye ।। 5 ।।
śaṃkaro'haṃ tava svāmī paśya māṃ nikaṭāgatam ।
sarvātmānamatidīnaṃ śavatulyaṃ tvayā vinā ।। 6 ।।
yaśca śaktiṃ na jānāti jñānahīnaśca nindati ।
taṃ tyaktumucitaṃ vijñe kathaṃ māṃ tyajasi priye ।। 7 ।।
sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca vadāgatya sudhopamam ।
madhurābhāsadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ dagdhaṃ siktamācara ।। 8 ।।
prāṇādhike samuttiṣṭha rudantaṃ māṃ na paśyasi ।
parityajya ca naḥ prāṇān gantuṃ nārhasi sundari ।। 9 ।।
pativrate samuttiṣṭha kathaṃ māṃ nā'dya sevase ।
ityuktvā ca satībhasma dehe śaṃbhuradhārayat ।। 1.178.10 ।।
gaṃgātaṭe rurodoccaiḥ sati sādhvītyudīrya ca ।
trinetranetranīraiśca saṃbabhūva saraḥ tanuḥ ।। 11 ।।
tadvai netrasaro nāma tīrthaṃ jātaṃ tapaḥsthalam ।
satyasthimālikāṃ kṛtvā dadhāra kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam ।। 12।।
nityaṃ tadbhasma bhaktyā ca cakāra gātralepanam ।
sati prāṇeśvarītyuktvā punarmūrchāmavāpa saḥ ।। 1 3।।
tadā devāḥ sapārṣado nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ।
brahmā śeṣaśca dharmaśca surāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ ।। 14।।
mūrchitaṃ ca samutthāya rudantaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tadā ।
ucitaṃ bodhayāmāsurviṣṇuḥ prāha taduttaram ।। 1 5 ।।
śaṃbho māyāguṇāḥ sarve hetavaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।
viṣṇumāyā balavatī guṇayuktaṃ prabādhate ।। 1 6।।
duḥkhaṃ śoko bhayaṃ śaṃbho guṇātīte bhavennahi ।
manvate sukhaduḥkhāni svapnānīva vipaścitaḥ ।। 1 7।।
jñānaṃ labha mahādeva svastho bhava maheśvara ।
cetanāṃ kuru bhadraṃ te satīṃ prāpsyasi niścitam ।। 18 ।।
sudinaṃ durdinaṃ śaśvad bhavatyeva bhave bhave ।
tābhyāṃ harṣaśca śokaśca jāyate prākṛte jane ।। 19 ।।
śubhena cā'śubhena karmaṇā sudinadurdine ।
tatra karma śubhaṃ kāryaṃ sadā sattvasvabhāvajam ।। 1.178.20 ।।
sattvaṃ saṃsargasādhyaṃ ca saṃgaḥ puṇyabalādbhavet ।
puṇyaheturmano bodhyaṃ māna'sehaṃ hariḥ sthitaḥ ।। 21 ।।
mayā ca hariṇā sarvaṃ kāryate śocanaṃ tyaja ।
atha caikaṃ parabrahma dvividhaṃ bhavatīcchayā ।। 22 ।।
nityaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ caiva śarīraṃ dvividhaṃ hi tat ।
nityaṃ vināśarahitaṃ naśvaraṃ prākṛtaṃ sadā ।। 23 ।।
ahaṃ tvaṃ cāpi bhagavānnāvayornityavigrahaḥ ।
āvayoraṃśabhūtā ye prākṛtā naṣṭavigrahāḥ ।। 24।।
rudrādayastadaṃśāśca madaṃśā viṣṇurūpiṇaḥ ।
mamāpyevaṃ dvidhā rūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ ca caturbhujam ।। 25।।
caturbhujo'haṃ vaikuṇṭhe padmayā pārṣadaiḥ saha ।
goloke dvibhujo'haṃ ca gopībhiḥ saha rādhayā ।। 26।।
evaṃ sa bhagavānāste nityaḥ saḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
nityā ca prakṛtistasya hyuttamā pauruṣī matā ।। 27।।
mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīrmaheśvarī ca saiva ha ।
sadā tau dvau ca saṃśliṣṭau sarveṣāṃ pitarau śiva ।। 28।।
satīmicchasi cecchaṃbho prakṛteḥstavanaṃ kuru ।
śokaṃ tyaja svīyamāyāṃ bhaja smara jagatprasūm ।। 29।।
śokanāśo jāyatāṃ te śivaṃ syācca mamā''śiṣā ।
dūraṃ viplavahetuśca yātustrīvirahajvaraḥ ।। 1.178.30 ।।
ityuktvā śroharirmaunamāsasādātha śaṃkaraḥ ।
snātvā natvā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ baddhapuṭāṃjalistataḥ ।। 31 ।।
stavanaṃ kartumārebhe brahmaśakteḥ sabhaktikaḥ ।
'brāhmi brahmasvarūpe tvaṃ māṃ prasīda sanātani ।।32।।
paramātmasvarūpe ca paramānandarūpiṇi ।
oṃ prakṛtyai namo bhadre māṃ prasīda bhavārṇave ।।33।।
sarvamaṃgalarūpe ca prasīda sarvamaṃgale ।
vijaye śivade devi māṃ prasīda jayaprade ।। 34।।
vedavedāṃgarūpe ca vedamātaḥ prasīda me ।
śokaghne jñānarūpe ca prasīda bhaktavatsale ।।35।।।
sarvasampatprade māye prasīda jagadambike ।
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇakroḍe sraṣṭurvakṣasi bhāratī ।।36 ।।
mama kroḍe mahāmāyā vipṇumāye prasīda me ।
kālarūpe kāryarūpe prasīda dīnavatsale ।। 37।।।
kṛṣṇasya rādhike bhadre prasīda kṛṣṇapūjite ।
samastakāminīrūpe kalāṃśena prasīda me ।।38।।
sarvasampatsvarūpe tvaṃ prasīda sampadāṃ prade ।
yaśasvibhiḥ pūjite tvaṃ prasīda yaśasāṃ nidhe ।। 39 ।।
carācarasvarūpe ca prasīda mama mā ciram ।
mama yogaprade devi prasīda siddhayogini ।।1.178.40 ।।
sarvasiddhisvarūpe ca prasīda siddhidāyini ।
adhunā rakṣa māmīśe pradagdhaṃ virahāgninā ।। 41 ।।
svātmadarśanapuṇyena krīṇīhi parameśvari ।
ityuktvā virataḥ śaṃbhurdadarśa gaganasthitām ।।42।।
taptakāṃcanavarṇābhāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām ।
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śatabhujāṃ ca tāṃ satīm ।।43।।
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ virahāsaktaḥ punastuṣṭāva satvaram ।
duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa prarudan virahodbhavam ।।44।।
darśayāmāsā'sthimālāṃ svāṃgasthaṃ bhasma bhūṣaṇam ।
kṛtvā bahuparīhāraṃ toṣayāmāsa sundarīm ।।45।।
babhūva parituṣṭā sā śaṃbhumuvāca bhāvataḥ ।
sthiro bhava mahādeva prāṇādhika mama prabho ।।46।।
bhavānātmā ca yogīśaḥ svāmī janmani janmani ।
ahaṃ śailendrakāminyāṃ labdhvā janma maheśvara ।।47।।
tava patnī bhaviṣyāmi muñca tvaṃ virahajvaram ।
ityuktvā śivamāśvāsya cāntardhānaṃ cakāra sā ।।48।।
svanivāsānsurā jagmuḥ kailāsaṃ ca yayau haraḥ ।
nanarta sagaṇastūrṇaṃ santyajya virahajvaram ।।49।।
etatpaṭhecchṛṇuyācca na viyogajvaro bhavet ।
na bhavetkāminībhedastasya janmani janmani ।।।1.178.5 0 ।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tūktvā menāyāṃ janmakāmukī ।
jagāma himavaddeśe'dṛśyarūpā cacāra sā ।।51।।
kurvāṇā ca tapo divyaṃ śivasya vyacarat sakhī ।
śivaṃ śivaṃ bhajamānā samayaṃ taṃ pratīkṣate ।।52।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīdāhottaraṃ bhasmāsthīni samādāya śaṃkarasya gaṃgātaṭe śokaḥ satīstotraṃ satīdarśanaṃ pārvatī-
janmavacanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ ।। 178 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 178 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 179
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 180 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi vidhuraḥ śaṃkaraḥ kvacit ।
himālaye vicacāra śailapatnīṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। 1 ।।
sādhusvarūpaḥ saumyaśca prasannatāṃ prakāśayan ।
śaṃbhuruvāca mātarme bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me ।। 2 ।।
menā pakvānnamādāya yāvaddadāti śaṃbhave ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā menāṃ bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me ।। 2 ।।
iyaṃ pakvānnabhikṣā tu naikasyaiva kṛte bhavet ।
tatrānyeṣāṃ vibhāgo'stita bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me ।। 4 ।।
yatra nānyasya bhāgo'sti vṛṇe bhikṣāṃ tu tādṛśīm ।
menā prāha tadā sādhuṃ sādho kimicchasi priyam ।। 5 ।।
yathecchasi tathā dāsye sphuṭaṃ vada dadāmyaham ।
menāṃ śaṃbhustadā prāha dadāmītyucyate yadi ।। 6 ।।
prāpnomītyeva ca prāptā prāpsyāmyavasarā''game ।
mātastadā''gamiṣyāmi bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me ।। 7 ।।
menā tvāścaryamālokya patitā pādayostadā ।
uvāca dāsye'vaśyaṃ te yadi yogyā kṛte tava ।। 8 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathāstveva mātaḥ paśya tayā vinā ।
vicarāmi mahāraṇye priyayā śivayā vinā ।। 9 ।।
tava gehe satī dakṣaputrī janma grahīṣyati ।
sā matkṛte bhavedbhikṣā śaṃkaro'haṃ samāgataḥ ।। 1.179.1 0।।
menā śrutvā tvatyatīva prasannā'bhūd hṛdantare ।
bhojitaḥ pūjitaḥ śaṃbhurjagāma ca yathecchayā ।। 1 1।।
tata ārabhya menā sā sasmāra bhāviputrikām ।
śaṃbhuṃ jāmātaraṃ caiva mumoda hṛdayāmbare ।। 12।।
prāgbhavīyabhaktivaśāt śive bhaktirvyavardhata ।
śivāṃ dhyātvā śivāmātā bhaviṣyati samudraje ।। 1 3।।
lakṣmīruvāca-
menakā sā śivāmātā kā''sīttacchrīhare vada ।
hariḥ prāha śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।। 14।।
vedhaḥputrasya dakṣasya kanyāḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।
tāsāṃ vivāhamakarot sa varaiḥ kaśyapādibhiḥ ।। 15।।
tāsāṃ madhye svadhānāmnī pitṛbhyo dattavān sutām ।
tisro'bhavan sutāstasyāḥ subhagāḥ dharmasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।। 16 ।।
jyeṣṭhā madhyā kaniṣṭhā ca menā dhanyā kalāvatī ।
etāḥ pitṛmānasotthāstisraścā'yonijā hi tāḥ ।। 17।।
avyāhatagatikāstā yoginyaḥ kāmarūpagāḥ ।
ekasmin samaye tisro bhaginyastīrthavāñcchayā ।। 18।।
śvetadvīpaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ jagmurdarśanahetave ।
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya gatāstāḥ kāmagaṃ śubham ।। 1 9।।
vimānādavatīryaiva cakrurviṣṇoḥ stutiṃ natim ।
tasthustadājñayā śvete susamājo mahānabhūt ।।।1.179.2 0 ।।
samāje tatra pañcahāyanā brahmasutāstadā ।
sanakādyāḥ samājagmuḥ stutvā natvā hariṃ tataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
samāje viṣṇuvacanāt tasthuste sanakādayaḥ ।
samājaśca tadottasthau munisvāgatamācaran ।।22।।
devīsatīyoginīnāṃ samājo'pyutthitastadā ।
tisro bhaginyaḥ paścātsthā nottasthurmohato yathā ।।23।।
tāstisro yoginīnāṃ madhyapṛṣṭhe saṃsthitā yataḥ ।
pāścātyā naiva paśyanti paurvāste'pi ca tāँstathā ।।24।।
naḥ tisra naiva paśyanti samājāgrasthitā yataḥ ।
kimutthāya ca kartavyaṃ matvaivaṃ notthitā yataḥ ।।25।।
saiṣā māyā''lasyarūpā pramādātmakamohinī ।
bhūtvā tadvaśagāstā vai na cakruryogyamarhaṇam ।।26।।
yadyapi jñāninaḥ santo na krodhavaśagā nanu ।
kintu bhāviprabalena preritāḥ krodharaśminā ।।27।।
tāsāṃ tātkālikīṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntopi yogīśaḥ kṛtim ।
sanatkumāro muktātmā śāpaṃ daṇḍakaraṃ dadau ।।28।।
yūyaṃ tisro bhaginyo vai pitṛkanyā api dhruvam ।
śiṣṭācāravihīnāḥ sthā'bhyutthānanativarjitāḥ ।।29।।
kṣudramānavakṛtyāḍhyāḥ dūrā bhavatu vai divaḥ ।
narastriyaḥ saṃbhavatu labhadhvaṃ svakṛteḥ phalam ।।1.179.3 0।।
tisra ākarṇya sādhvyastāḥ patitvā pādayormuneḥ ।
prāhurmune dayāsindho prasanno bhava sarvathā ।।3 1 ।।
tvādṛśānāṃ satāṃ bhāvo hṛdaye'smākamasti vai ।
pramādānna natirabhyutthānādisatkriyāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।32।।।
phalaṃ labdhaṃ kṛteḥ svasyāḥ kuruṣvānugrahaṃ mune ।
tavaiva vacanād brahman labhema svargatiṃ punaḥ ।।।33 ।।
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā ṛṣistatra provāca prītamānasaḥ ।
śāpoddhāraṃ karomyeva mahatkāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।34।।
tvannimittaṃ ca sukhadaṃ yatrā''śleṣo harerbhavet ।
jyeṣṭhā menā hareraṃśabhūtasya himabhūbhṛtaḥ ।। 35।।
patnī bhavatu te kanyā pārvatī saṃbhaviṣyati ।
yāṃ śaṃbhave pradāyaiva prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ।।36।।
ante śivā'śivā''śīrbhirmuktiṃ kailāsamāpsyasi ।
madhyā dhanyā siradhvajajanakasya priyāṃ'ganā ।।37।।
bhavatu te sutā mahālakṣmīḥ sītā bhaviṣyati ।
yāṃ rāmāya pradāyaiva prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ।।38।।
ante sītārāmasya kṛpayā vaikuṇṭhamāpsyasi ।
kalāvatī kaniṣṭhā ca vṛṣabhānuviśo gṛhe ।।39।।
patnī bhavatu te kanyā rādhikā saṃbhaviṣyati ।
yāṃ kṛṣṇāya pradatvā tvaṃ prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ।।1.179.40।।
ante ca rādhākṛṣṇakṛpayā golokamāpsyasi ।
sukarmiṇāṃ gate duḥkhe prabhaved durlabhaṃ sukham ।।41।।
yūyaṃ pitṛsutāḥ sarvāḥ sadā svargavilāsikāḥ ।
etannimittamālambya mokṣagāḥ saṃbhaviṣyatha ।।42।।
paścātsanatkumārādyāḥ samājātsvālayaṃ gatāḥ ।
menādikāstisra īyuḥ svapitṛbhavanaṃ tataḥ ।।43।।
athaikadā kurukṣetre snātvā hīndrādayaḥ surāḥ ।
āṣāḍhe māsi mārgarkṣe candrakṣayatithirhi sā ।।44।।
dadurindrādayastasyāṃ piṇḍān pitṛbhya ādarāt ।
tilānmadhu supakvānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ haviṣyamityapi ।।45।।
tataḥ prītāstu pitaro devānāha sutṛptitaḥ ।
vṛṇuta kiṃ vitarāmo devāḥ prāhustadā pitṝn ।।46।।
sarve śṛṇuta no vākyaṃ pitaraḥ prītamānasāḥ ।
kartavyaṃ tattathaivā''śu devakāryepsavo yadi ।।47।।
yūyaṃ smaratha kanyānāṃ śvetadvīpe vṛtaṃ ca yat ।
sanatkumāraśāpaṃ taṃ smaratā'thocitaṃ matam ।।48।।
menā nāma sutā yā vo jyeṣṭhā maṃgalakāriṇī ।
tāṃ vivāhya ca suprītyā himākhyena tu bhūbhṛtā ।।49।।
sarve bhavantu sukhino lābhavantaḥ pade pade ।
yuṣmākamamarāṇāṃ ca duḥkhahānirbhaviṣyati ।।1.179.50 ।।
surāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā smṛtvā śāpaṃ purā bhavam ।
omiti procuḥ pitaro dadurmenāṃ himādraye ।।51।।।
himādriḥ parvato divyo mahātejāḥ samṛddhimān ।
dvirūpo vartate loke jaṃgamasthirabhedataḥ ।।52।।
pūrvāparau toyanidhī suvigāhya sthitaḥ sthiraḥ ।
tuṣāravidhiratyugro devarṣisiddhasaṃśritaḥ ।।53।।
tapaḥ siddhipradaṃ śīghraṃ pāvanaśca mahātmanām ।
sa eva divyarūpo hi ramyaḥ sarvāṃgasundaraḥ ।।54।।
viṣṇvaṃśaśca mahābhaktaḥ śailarājaḥ sumūrtimān ।
sa eva svakulasthityai dharmavardhanahetave ।।55।।
svavivāhaṃ kartumanā pitṛdevahitecchukaḥ ।
menāpāṇiṃ ca jagrāha vivāhavidhinā tadā ।।।56।।
samutsavo mahānāsīt tadvivāhe sumaṃgale ।
haryādayo'pi te devā ṛṣayo munayo'drayaḥ ।।57।।
ājagmustatra vaivāhe praśaśaṃsurhimācalam ।
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsurdadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ।।58।।
mahāmodānvitā devāḥ pitṝndivyānpraśasya ca ।
saṃjagmuḥ svasvadhāmāni prāpya satkārapūjanam ।।59।।
menāṃ tu yuvatīṃ prāpya himavān gṛhadharmataḥ ।
prītimānabhavattatra reme kāmād yathecchayā ।।1.179.60।।
atha dakṣasutā kāle satī tu himaparvate ।
yadā''sīcchaṃbhunā sārdhaṃ tadaiva tāṃ tu menakā ।।61।।
mama gehe kṛtāvāsā matsutā vai satī matā ।
iti sutāsamāṃ jñātvā siṣeve mātṛvarcasā ।।62।।
evaṃ nityaṃ dhyāyamānā sevate menakā satīm ।
satī ca dakṣayajñe svatanuṃ tyaktvā'smaratprasūm ।।62।।
tasyāmahaṃ sutā syāmityavadhārya satī hṛdā ।
samayaṃ prāpya prītyā sā menakāputrikā'bhavat ।।64।।
pārvatī sā tapaḥ kṛtvā patiṃ prāpa śivaṃ punaḥ ।
menāyāṃ kanyakāstisro jātā rūpaguṇānvitāḥ ।।65।।
rāgiṇī kuṭilā kālī tisraḥ kanyā yathākramam ।
raktāṃgī raktanetrā ca raktāmbaravibhūṣitā ।।66।।
rāgiṇī nāma saṃjātā jyeṣṭhā menāsutā priye ।
śubhāṃgī padmapatrākṣī nīlakuṃcitamūrdhajā ।।67।।
śvetamālyāmbaradharā kuṭilā nāma madhyamā ।
nīlāṃjanacayaprakhyā nīlendīvaralocanā ।।68।।
rūpeṇā'nupamā kālī jaghanyā menakāsutā ।
sunābha iti ca khyātaścaturthatanayo'bhavat ।।69।।
jātāstāḥ kanyakāstisraḥ ṣaḍabdāt purataḥ priye ।
kartuṃ tapaḥ prayātāśca devāstā dadṛśuḥ śubhāḥ ।।1.179.70।।।
tato divākaraiḥ sarvairvasubhiśca tapasvinī ।
rāgavatī nāma kanyā divaṃ nītā suraistadā ।।71 ।।
brahmaṇā sā kṛtā sandhyārāgavatī suvigrahā ।
mahiṣāsuranāśāya sandhyāsamayarūpiṇī ।।72 ।।
pratīcchukī kṛttikābhāge sadā tiṣṭhate divam ।
kuṭilā brahmalokaṃ tu nītā devaiḥ śaśiprabhā ।।73 ।।
brahmā prāha mahiṣasya vināśārthamiyaṃ sutā ।
śārvaṃ dhārayituṃ tejo na vai śaktā hi dṛśyate ।।74।।
ataśceyaṃ brahmaloke satye kṛtālayā sadā ।
āpomayī plāvayantī nadī tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe ।।75 ।।
iti gate kanyake dve jñātvā menā tapasvinīm ।
tṛtīyāṃ putrikāṃ menāṃ tapaso'vārayadyataḥ ।।76 ।।
u mā tapaḥ kuru putrītyevamumā'bhidhā'bhavat ।
ityetatkathitaṃ svalpaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।77।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne menāyai śaṃbhunā satījanmārthasūcanam, menā dhanyā kalāvatī tisraḥ pitṛkanyāḥ śvetadvīpaṃ jagmuḥ
tatra sanatkumāraśāpaḥ, kramaśo himagireḥ sīradhvajajanakasya vṛṣabhānuvaiśyasya ca patnyo jātāḥ, kramaśastatputryaḥ śivā sītā rādheti, menāyāṃ sandhyārāgiṇī kuṭilābrahmanadī kālī ceti putrītrayaṃ sunābhaputraścetinirūpaṇanāmaikonā'śītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 179।।


← adhyāyaḥ 179 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 180
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 181 →

śrīlakṣmī uvāca-
kālījanmakathāṃ divyāṃ vada me parameśvara ।
kālī punaḥ kathaṃ gaurī jātetyapi kathāṃ vada ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi satī dehaṃ tyaktvā'vyaktā'bhavattataḥ ।
himālayapradeśeṣu guptā'dṛśyā vyavartata ।। 2 ।।
devāḥ kailāsamāsādya susthāne praṇipadya ca ।
sasmaruśca praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvuśca tadā satīm ।। 3 ।।
devyubhe omiti tvaṃ vai gāyatrī parameśvarī ।
pūjitā brahmamunibhirūrjitā rājabhirnṛpaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
tvaṃ bhūritiviḍbhi pṛthvī śūdraiḥ śiveti pūjitā ।
kṣāntirmunīnāmakṣobhyā dayā niyamināmapi ।। kā ।।
tvaṃ mahopāyasandohā nītirnayavisarpiṇām ।
paricitistvamarthānāṃ tvamīhā prāṇihṛcchrayā ।। 6 ।।
tvaṃ muktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ matiḥ sarvadehinām ।
itistvaṃ raktacittānāṃ prītistvaṃ hṛdi dehinām ।। 7 ।।
tvaṃ kīrtiḥ satyabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ śāntirduṣṭakarmaṇām ।
tvaṃ bhrāntiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ kratuyājinām ।। 8 ।।
tvaṃ samudramahāvelā tvaṃ ca līlā vilāsinām ।
saṃbhūtistvaṃ padārthānāṃ sthitistvaṃ lokapālinām ।। 9 ।।
tvaṃ kālarātrirniḥśeṣabhuvanāvalivāsinī ।
priyakaṇṭhagrahānandadāyinī tvaṃ vibhāvarī ।। 1.180.1 0।।
rakṣikā tvamanāthānāṃ darśanaṃ dehi cāmbike ।
anekairvividhairloke rūpairdevi tvamarcitā ।। 11 ।।
sadā śivapriye durge tvāṃ namāmo maheśvari ।
śrīśaktiṃ pāvanīṃ puṣṭiṃ mahadavyaktarūpiṇīm ।। 12।।
vayaṃ namāmahe bhaktyā śuddhāṃ brahmaparāyaṇām ।
antarvidyāsuvidyābhyāṃ suprītāṃ tvāṃ namāmahe ।। 1 3।।
tvaṃ dīdhitiḥ sūryagatā kaumudī candrasaṃgatā ।
āpyāyayasi brahmāditṛṇāntaṃ tvāṃ namāmahe ।। 14।।
gāyatrī tvaṃ vedamātā tvaṃ sāvitrī sarasvatī ।
tvaṃ vārtā sarvajagatāṃ tvaṃ trayī dharmarūpiṇī ।। 15 ।।
tvaṃ nidrā sarvabhūteṣu kṣudhā tṛptistvameva ha ।
tvaṃ lakṣmīḥ puṇyakartṝṇāmalakṣmīḥ pāpināṃ tathā ।। 16 ।।
tvaṃ śāntiḥ sarvajagatāṃ tvaṃ dhātrī prāṇapoṣiṇī ।
gītistvaṃ sāmavedasya granthistvaṃ yajuṣāṃ hutiḥ ।। 17।।
ṛgvedasya tathā mātrā'tharvaṇasya parā gatiḥ ।
samastagīrvāṇaśaktirduḥkhanistārakāriṇī ।। 18।।
śive rudrāṇi sannidre caṇḍe kātyāyani sati ।
kauśiki caṇḍike kāli nārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।। 19 ।।
tapaḥpriye sadādṛśye pārvati te namonamaḥ ।
prasannā bhava deveśi darśanaṃ dehi suvrate ।।1.180.2 0।।
menāyāṃ labha putrītvaṃ mahādevi namo'stu te ।
itthaṃ devaiḥ stutā devī durgā durgatināśinī ।।21।।
āvirbabhūva devānāṃ purato jagadambikā ।
babhūvā''nandasandohaḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām ।।22।।
punardevāḥ praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvuśca viśeṣataḥ।
śive śarvāṇi kalyāṇi vijñaptiṃ śṛṇu cāmbike ।।23।।
dakṣasutā surakāryakṛte jātāpi śāṃkarī ।
nahi jātaṃ prapūrṇaṃ tat devakāryaṃ maheśvari ।।24।।
pūrṇaṃ kuru mahādevi nirjarāṇāṃ manoratham ।
sanatkumāravacanaṃ saphalaṃ syāttathā kṛte ।।25।।
bhūtvā tvaṃ menakāputrī rudrapatnī punarbhava ।
sarve bhavantu sukhino duḥkhaṃ naśyatu kṛtsnaśaḥ ।।26।।
śrutvaitatprāha śarvāṇī prasannā'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
menāputrī bhaviṣyāmi svaṃ sukhaṃ labhatāṃ haraḥ ।।27।।
sarve gacchata dhāma svaṃ sadā smarāmi śaṃkaram ।
mama hetormahāduḥkhī vartate sa kuveṣabhṛt ।। 28।।
vidhāya mālāṃ suprītyā mamā'sthnāṃ virahākulaḥ ।
dehe mama citābhasma dhārayatyaniśaṃ prabhuḥ ।।29।।
ataścāvatariṣyāmi rudrasantoṣahetave ।
bhaktāḥ śaṃbhupriyā bhūtvā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduḥsaham ।।।1.180.3 0 ।।
surakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi satyaṃ svaṃ gacchata gṛham ।
ityuktvā'ntardadhe devī jagāma himavadgṛham ।। 31 ।।
surāstaddiśi natvaiva svasvadhāmani saṃyayuḥ ।
himādrirmenakā cobhau tepāte paramaṃ tapaḥ ।। 3 2।।
śivāmārādhayāmāsatuśca bhaktyāḍhyacetasā ।
dānaṃ dadaturviprebhyaḥ sadā tattoṣahetave ।। 33।।
caitramāsaṃ samārabhya saptaviṃśativāsarān ।
śivāṃ sampūjayāmāsa putryarthinī tu menakā ।।34।।
aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā'dānnavamītithau ।
modakairbalipiṣṭaiśca pāyasairgandhapuṣpakaiḥ ।।35 ।।
gaṃgāyāmauṣadhiprasthe kṛtvā mūrtiṃ mahīmayīm ।
umāṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa nānāvastvarpaṇādibhiḥ ।। 36 ।।
nirāhārā jalāhārā vāyvāhārā kvacitkvacit ।
nināya menakā saptaviṃśativāsarān vrate ।। 37।।
vratapūrṇe satī cā''virbabhūva parameśvarī ।
menāṃ dadarśa santuṣṭāṃ tejomaṇḍalamadhyagām ।। 38।।
uvāca suprasannā sā menāṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gatā ।
varaṃ brūhi mahāsādhvi yatte manasi vartate ।। 39।।
dāsye te'haṃ prasannā'smi tapovratasamādhibhiḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā ca praṇanāmaitāṃ provāca menakā satīm ।।1.180.40 ।।
praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ sarvakāmārthadāyinīm ।
praṇamāmi sadā siddhāṃ paramātmasvarūpiṇīm ।।4 1 ।।
praṇamāmi sadānandāṃ vanitābuddhirūpiṇīm।
praṇamāmi karuṇāḍhyāṃ vidhehi mama vāñchitam ।।।42।।
yoṣāṇāṃ satpriyakartrī brahmasukhapradāyinī ।
bhaktecchāpūraṇī śaktirnārāyaṇi namo'stu te ।।43।।
iti stutā satī prāha menāṃ varaya vāṃchitam ।
menā prāha tadā devīṃ varayogyā'smyahaṃ yadi ।।44।।
prathamaṃ śataputrā me bhavantu jagadambike ।
tatastisraḥ sutāścāpi sadguṇaścaikaputrakaḥ ।।45।।
tatra tisṛsutāmadhye kaniṣṭhā mama putrikā ।
bhava mama snehapātraṃ sukhasthānaṃ sadā mama ।।46 ।।
rudrapatnī bhava tathā līlāṃ kuru mamā'ntike ।
devyuvāca ca tacchrutvā tathāstviti tu menakām ।।47।।
kathayitvā tirodhānaṃ jagāmāśu harapriyā ।
atha menā svapataye śaśaṃsa varadānakam ।।48।।
śrū+utvā himagirirhṛṣṭaḥ praśaśaṃsa priyāṃ prati ।
kālakrameṇa ca tayoḥ pravṛtte surate priye ।।49।।
garbho babhūva menāyā vavṛdhe pratyahaṃ ca saḥ ।
asūta menā mainākaṃ putraṃ sarvaguṇaṃ śubham ।।1.180.5 0।।
tataḥ krameṇa vai cānyānputrān sā suṣuve samān ।
kanyādvayaṃ ca suṣuve tataḥ satīprasādataḥ ।।51 ।।
samadhatta tadā menā garbhaṃ gireḥ satī tanum ।
giripriyāṃ sarvajagannivāsāsaṃśrayā'dhikam ।।52।।
vireje sutarāṃ menā tejomaṇḍalaśobhitā ।
priyāprīteśca manasaḥ svārjitadraviṇasya ca ।।53।।
samunnateḥ śruteḥ śailaḥ kriyāścakre yathocitāḥ ।
dadarśa kāle menāṃ sa pratītaḥ prasavonmukhīm ।।54।।
vyatīte navame māse daśame māsi pūrṇataḥ ।
ardharātre vyatīte'tha menā śūlāyate tanau ।।5 5 ।।
vasantartau madhau māse navamyāṃ mṛgadhiṣṇyake ।
brāhme muhūrte śubhage prāsūyata suputrikām ।।56।।
divyā devī samutpannā sā lakṣmīriva sāgarāt ।
tejasā vyāptamabhavanmenāgṛhaṃ samantataḥ ।।57।।
tadā susamayaścāsīcchāntabhagrahatārakaḥ ।
nabhaḥ prasannatāṃ yātaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvadikṣu ca ।।58।।
mahī maṃgalabhūyiṣṭhā savanagrāmasāgarā ।
sarassravantīvāpīṣu puphulluḥ paṃkajāni vai ।।59।।
vavuśca sukhadā vātāḥ śītalāśca sugandhinaḥ ।
babhūva puṣpavṛṣṭiśca toyavṛṣṭipuraḥsarā ।।1.180.60।।
jajvaluścāgnayaḥ śāntā jagarjuśca tadā ghanāḥ ।
mumuduḥ sādhavaḥ sarve jagurgandharvasattamāḥ ।।61 ।।
vidyādharastriyo vyomni nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।
tadotsavo mahānāsīt devādīnāṃ nabhastale ।।62।।
tasminnavasare devī brahmaśaktiḥ satī śivā ।
āvirbabhūva purato menāyā nijarūpataḥ ।।6 3।।
āvirbabhūva tadgarbhāt śrīlakṣmīriva sāgarāt ।
śivapriyā samutpannā gaṃgeva śaśimaṇḍalāt ।।64।।
himavannagare tatra sarvaṃ duḥkhaṃ kṣayaṃgatam ।
abhavansukhinaḥ sarve sarvalokanivāsinaḥ ।।65।।
nārakāṇāmapi tadā sukhaṃ svargasamaṃ hyabhūt ।
abhavatkrūrasattvānāṃ cetāṃsyapi mṛdūni vai ।।66 ।।
jyotiṣāmapi tejāṃsi prabhāvantyabhavanbahu ।
vanāśritāścoṣadhayaḥ susvādaphalasaṃbhatāḥ ।।67।।
meruprabhṛtayaścāpi mūrtimanto mahācalāḥ ।
tasminmahotsave prāptā divyaprasṛtapāṇayaḥ ।।68।।
sāgarāḥ saritaścaiva samājagmuśca sarvaśaḥ ।
ṛṣayo munayaḥ śāntā viṣṇvādyā sakalāḥ surāḥ ।।69।।
ājagmuḥ sukhinaḥ prītyā dadṛśurjagadambikām ।
tuṣṭuvustāṃ śivāmambāṃ śivārthadhṛtavigrahām ।।1.180.70 ।।
jagadambe mahādevi sarvadā tvāṃ namāmahe ।
devānāṃ maṃgalaṃ kāryaṃ kuru tvaṃ bhaktavatsale ।।71 ।।
menāmanorathaḥ pūrṇaḥ kṛtaḥ kuru śivasya ca ।
puṣpāñjalīn prakīryaiva devāḥ svadhāma saṃyayuḥ ।।72।।
himaśailo'bhavalloke tadā sarvacarācaraiḥ ।
saṃsevyaścādhigamyaśca sāśrayaścācalottamaḥ ।।73।।
tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā divyarūpāṃ janmabālāṃ suvarṇabhām ।
api varṣmaṇi śyāmāṃ tāṃ nīlotpaladalaprabhām ।।74।।
mudramāyāti menātituṣṭā stutiṃ cakāra sā ।
jagadambe kṛtā'mbe māṃ kṛtātikaruṇā tvayā ।।75।।
āvirbhūtā mama gehe sadā putri sthirā bhava ।
namaskaromi praṇayapūrṇahṛdayavihvalā ।।76।।
ityānandaprapūrṇāśrunetrābhyāṃ sā papau sutām ।
tāvaddevī samabhavaddivyāṣṭabhujadhāriṇī ।।77।।
prodbhinnāvayavā rūparūpānubhṛtayauvanā ।
dvādaśottaravarṣāyā ūnaṣoḍaśahāyanā ।।78।।
svarṇābhūṣaṇaśobhāḍhyā divyavastrātisūjjvalā ।
hāsyapūrṇānanā saumyapremapūritalocanā ।।79।।
rājādhirājasampattyā śobhayā''śritavigrahā ।
śivayogyā'bhavaddvivyā kṛpayā darśanaṃ dadau ।।1.180.80 ।।
mātre coktavatī devī mātaste'stu muhurnamaḥ ।
tvayā cārādhitā bhaktyā pūrvaṃ dātuṃ varaṃ tadā ।।8 1 ।।
yācitā'haṃ samāyātā svaputryarthaṃ tvayā tataḥ ।
omityuktvā tirodhānaṃ gatā'haṃ parameśvarī ।।82।।
sāhaṃ divyā satī cāsmi śivapatnī tava gṛhe ।
putrī jātā'smi mātastvaṃ madyogātsaṃmukhī bhava ।।83।।
divyarūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ hyetat yatte matsmaraṇaṃ bhavet ।
anyathā martyabhāvena tavā'jñānaṃ bhavenmayi ।।84।।
yuvāṃ māṃ putrikārūpadivyabhāvena sarvadā ।
cintayantau me pitarau yātau stho madgatiṃ parām ।।85।।
devakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi līlāṃ kṛtvā'dbhutāṃ kṣitau ।
śaṃbhupatnī bhaviṣyāmi tārayiṣyāmi sajjanān ।।86।।
ityuktvā sā mahādevī sutā bhūtvā mahādyutiḥ ।
cakāra rodanaṃ tatra laukikīṃ rītimāśritā ।।87।।
śrutvā tadrodanaṃ ramyaṃ gṛhasthāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।
jahṛṣuḥ saṃbhramāt menāgṛhaṃ yayurmudānvitāḥ ।।88।।
girirhimācalaścāpi putrījanmanivedine ।
dadau ratnāni vastrāṇi dhanaṃ ca pāritoṣikam ।।89।।
dṛṣṭvā divyatanuṃ kanyāṃ mumuhurdarśakāstadā ।
tathotsavo mahānāsīnnedurvādyāni bhūriśaḥ ।।1.180.90।।
babhūva maṃgalaṃ gānaṃ nanṛturvarayoṣitaḥ ।
himācalo dadau dānaṃ viprebhyo jātakarma ca ।।9 1।।
vidhāpya bahirāgatya bhikṣubhyo draviṇaṃ dadau ।
nāmā'karot sutāyāśca kālītyekādaśe'hani ।।92।।
nityaṃ sā vardhate kālī śukle candrakalā yathā ।
janaḥ kulocitanāmnā pārvatītyājuhāva tām ।।93।।
kandukaiḥ kṛtrimaiḥ putraiḥ sakhīmadhyagatā satī ।
gaṃgāsaikatavedībhirbālye reme muhurmuhuḥ ।। 94।।
samaye sadgurorvidyā yatacittā papāṭha ca ।
nityaṃ śaṃbhordhyānaparā taporucimatī hyabhūt ।।95।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne himagirāvadṛśyasatyāḥ devakṛtastutiḥ, satījanmavaradānam, menāhimādryostapaḥ, menāgarbhaḥ, kālījanma, divyadarśanaṃ, mahotsavaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'śītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 18 0।।


← adhyāyaḥ 180 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 181
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 182 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ekadā nārado devo yāyāddhimagirergṛham ।
cakāra śailo devarṣeḥ saparyāṃ bahubhāvataḥ ।। 1 ।।
nāradāṃ'ghryoḥ svatanayāṃ pāvitryārthamapātayat ।
prāha ca matsutābhāgyaṃ brūhi devarṣisattama ।। 2 ।।
nāradastatsutāhastaṃ sarvāṃgāni viśeṣataḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā'vocadgire kanyā pitroḥ prītivivardhinī ।। 3 ।।
svapateḥ sukhadā'tyantaṃ mahāsādhvī pativratā ।
bhaviṣyati mahādivya mahārājñīva pūjitā ।। 4 ।।
aṃguṣṭhamadhyasandhau ca rekhayā hīśvarī bhavet ।
haste hastidhvajapadmaśūlarekhābhirīśvarī ।। 5 ।।
kare cihnaṃ mahaccihnaṃ rājñī saiṣā bhaviṣyati ।
lalāṭe candracihne yamīśapatnī bhaviṣyati ।। 6 ।।
kare'syāḥ svastikaṃ cihnaṃ kārye vijayinī bhavet ।
netre karṇāntalagne'syā brāhmī kācitpareśvarī ।। 7 ।।
hṛdaye cāsya śaṃbhurvai dhavalāṃkamayo'sti vai ।
yataḥ śaktirmahādevī bhaviṣyatyeva bhūdhara ।। 8 ।।
udare'dhobāṇarekhā pūjyā devī bhaviṣyati ।
caraṇe'syā nāgavallī devapatnī bhaveddhruvam ।। 9 ।।
ekā vilakṣaṇā rekhā hyaṃguṣṭhopari vartate ।
lalāṭe ca tathā rekhā vartate tatsahārthikā ।। 1.181.1 0।।
tayoḥ phalaṃ śṛṇu śaila! bhavedvā na bhavettathā ।
tyāgī nagno guṇahīno mātṛtātavivarjitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
akāmo'śivaveṣaśca patirasyā bhavediti ।
menāhimālayau śrutvā kṣaṇaṃ duḥkhamavāpatuḥ ।। 12।।
pūrvāṃ śivasmṛtiṃ labdhvā sukhamatyantamāpatuḥ ।
pārvatī tu vacaḥ śrutvā jaharṣā'ti muhurhṛdi ।। 13 ।।
daivarekhā brahmalipirna mṛṣā jāyate kvacit ।
tādṛśo'sti varaḥ śaṃbhurnānyo'sti tādṛśaḥ patiḥ ।। 14।।
iti matvā śailaputrī smaratyaharniśaṃ haram ।
nāradaḥ satkṛtiṃ labdhvā gacchanvai śivamandiram ।। 15।।
smārayāmāsa śailendraṃ satīṃ prati haroditam ।
na tvāmṛte'nyāṃ varaye dākṣāyaṇi sati priye ।। 16।।
bhāryārthaṃ na grahīṣyāmi satyametadbravīmi te ।
iti śarvavacaḥ śailaṃ smārayitvā''ha nāradaḥ ।। 17।।
siṃhāsanaṃ tava putryāḥ śaṃbhorūrau bhaviṣyati ।
śaṃbhorūrvāsanaṃ prāpya mahārājñī bhaviṣyati ।। 18।।
ityuktvā sa gato brahmalokaṃ devarṣināradaḥ ।
putrīṃ bālāṃ ca pitarau ramayāmāsatuḥ sadā ।। 19।।
vivardhamānā girijā vivāhārhasuyauvanā ।
samabhavat tadā cendraḥ sasmāra nāradaṃ punaḥ ।।1.181.20 ।।
sa tu drāgeva samagāt mahendrabhavanaṃ muniḥ ।
indra utthāya pādyādyaiḥ pūjayāmāsa nāradam ।।21 ।।
prāha vai kuśalaṃ svasya jñātavānnāradasya ca ।
kathaṃ smṛto'hamityukto mahendraḥ prāha nāradam ।।22।।
yuvatī śailajā jātā yogaṃ yāyācca śaṃbhunā ।
śīghraṃ tathodyamaḥ kāryaḥ sarvaṃ tādṛgvidhīyatām ।।23।।
śrutvā tu nāradaḥ śīghraṃ jagāma śailaketanam ।
vṛddhaviprasvarūpeṇa jyotiḥpatraṃ kare dadhan ।।24।।
śailārpitāsane ramye niṣasādātha bhūsuraḥ ।
śailārpitā'rhaṇāṃ saṃgṛhyā'vadacchūlakṣṇayā girā ।।25।।
kuśalaṃ śailarājā'tra tapasaḥ sarvadā kimu ।
śailaḥ prāha suvṛddhānāṃ kṛpayā kuśalaṃ mama ।।26।।
kintu putrī varayogyā jātā'sti vada tatphalam ।
tāvanmenā duhitrā'nuyātā''jagāma bhūsuram ।।27।।
vavande vipracaraṇau menā ca śailaputrikā ।
putrīṃ vilokya viprarṣirāśīrbhistāṃ vyavardhayat ।।28। ।
provāca vismitā''syaḥ sa vākyaṃ bhāgyaṃ vilokya ca ।
na jāto'syāḥ patirbhadre lakṣaṇaiśca vivarjitā ।।29।।
uttānahastā nitarāṃ caraṇau vyabhicāriṇau ।
svacchāyāṃ ceti bodhyaṃ vai kimanyadvācyamatra vai ।।1.181.3 0 ।।
śrutvaitatbhramamāpannaḥ śokamagno himālayaḥ ।
pūrvaṃ nāradakathitaṃ vismṛtyovāca bhūsuram ।।3 1 ।।
karmarekhā'tidurgamyā'vaśyaṃbhāvi phalapradā ।
janmāntaramanuyāti vicitrabhūtajātiṣu ।।32 ।।
striyā virahitā sṛṣṭiḥ prāṇināṃ naiva jāyate ।
strījātistu prakṛtyaiva kṛpaṇā dainyabhāginī ।।3 3।।
tāsāmavajñā ca mā bhūditi vicārya vedhasā ।
daśaputrasamā kanyā vaṃśakṣetramudīritā ।। 34।।
durbhagā kṛpaṇā kanyā piturduḥkhakarī sadā ।
tatrāpi patiputrārthasaubhāgyavidhurā'dhikā ।।25।।
tvaṃ coktavānmama putryā durguṇāneva sarvathā ।
aho duḥkhaṃ mahajjātaṃ śrutvā tvanmukhato'dya me ।।36।।
athāpi kiṃcitsaubhāgyaṃ vārdhakye'syā bhavediti ।
tarhyapi vipra vaktavyaṃ duḥkhaṃ mārjaya me'ghajam ।।।37।।
striyastu brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ puruṣāṇāṃ sukhāya vai ।
tāsāṃ janma patilābhe sārthakau viphalo'nyathā ।।38।।
patipitṛkulānāṃ cehā'mutroddhārikāḥ striyaḥ ।
satpatiprāptimatyo'troddhārikāḥ kīrtitā hi tāḥ ।।।39।।
durlabhaḥ satpatiḥ strīṇāṃ viguṇo'pi patiḥ kila ।
na prāpyate vinā puṇyaiḥ sujaḍo'pi patiḥ striyā ।।1.181.40 ।।
asādhano'pi saddharmaḥ putraprāptyātmikā ratiḥ ।
dhanamājīvanaṃ bhāgyaṃ nāryāḥ kānte pratiṣṭhitam ।।41 ।।
nirdhano durmukho mūrkhaḥ sarvalakṣaṇavarjitaḥ ।
bhāgyaṃ tu paramaṃ nāryāḥ patireva sadā mataḥ ।।।42 ।।
yā nārī matsarād dveṣādīrṣyayā vā svabhāvataḥ ।
anyaratisukhaṃ hanti tatphalaṃ patihīnatā ।।43 ।।
yā'nyakāmasukhaṃ dveṣṭi kāme vighnaṃ karoti ca ।
kāmena sukhinornindāṃ karoti nā'pnuyātpatim ।।44।।
vivāhitā'pi pataye kāmabhikṣāṃ dadāti na ।
ratyadātryāḥ kāmukasya patiprāptirhi durlabhā ।।45।।
bahusaṃcitapuṇyānāṃ phalaṃ kāmasukhādikam ।
manuṣyebhyaḥ sadā dattaṃ pāpināṃ tadbhavennahi ।।46।।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścāpi kāmā''saktā viyojitāḥ ।
yayā tasyāḥ kāmasukhaṃ patisukhaṃ na jāyate ।।47।।
dharmakāmā narā yābhistiraskṛtya tṛṇīkṛtāḥ ।
tāsāṃ satkulajanmāpi patyalābhāt tṛṇīkṛtam ।।48।।
yāsāṃ kāmasukhaṃ nāsti tāsāṃ kāmāgnidagdhatā ।
dukhaṃ satatasaṃlagnaṃ taptasūrmī hi sā'tra vai ।।49।।
kāmā'vighnātmakaṃ dānaṃ nānyaddānaṃ hi vidyate ।
trasya puṇyaṃ sadā prāptiḥ satpaterbhavatīti vai ।।1.181.50।।
kāmadānamahatpuṇyaṃ yasyā bhavati saṃcitam ।
tasyā mānuṣajanmā'tra bhavati nityakāmadam ।।51 ।।
pārāvatacaṭakādyāḥ pakṣiṣu nityakāminaḥ ।
prākpradattakāmadānaphalaṃ bodhyaṃ na cānyathā ।।52।।
paśūnāṃ gomahiṣīṇāṃ kāmanā viralā tu sā ।
prāgapradattakāmasya phalaṃ svalpaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ।।5 3।।
vṛkṣeṣvapi narayogājjāyante tu phalāni hi ।
vallīṣvapi puṣpayogo phalaṃ naiva ca dṛśyate ।।।54।।
tatsarvaṃ tu pradattasya kāmā'kāmasya vai phalam ।
mama putryā kīdṛśaṃ vai kṛtaṃ karma purā bhavet। ।।55।।
yena nā'syāḥ patirjāta ucyate bhūsura tvayā ।
etad daurbhāgyamatulamasaṃkhyaduḥkhabhājanam ।।56।।
kiṃ cottānitahasteyaṃ tvayoktā nityadāṃ hyataḥ।
uttānahastatā bhikṣāṃ yācatāmeva saṃbhavet ।।57।।
śubhodayānāṃ bhāgyānāmadātārau daridrakau ।
succhāyayā'syāścaraṇau tvayoktau vyabhicāriṇau ।।58।।
tatrāpi śreyasī hyāśā na me'syā vai sudṛśyate ।
pūrvaṃ tu nāradenoktaṃ bhūsura śrāvayāmi tat ।।59।।
tyāgī nagno guṇahīno mātṛtātavivarjitaḥ ।
akāmo'śivaveṣaśca patirasyā bhavediti ।।1.181.60।।
tadatra bhrāmaṇe satyaṃ kiyadgrāhyaṃ mayā'nagha ।
brūhi jānāsi ced deva duḥkhaṃ me līnatāṃ vrajet ।।6 1 ।।
nārado vṛddhaviprātmā prāha śailaṃ suduḥkhitam ।
harṣasthāne tu mahati duḥkhaṃ te bhrāntijaṃ yataḥ ।।62।।
śṛṇu śaila na jāto'syāḥ svāmī tvajaḥ sadāśivaḥ ।
nityaḥ sa śāśvataḥ sthāṇuracalo'sti sanātanaḥ ।।63।।
anyeṣāṃ karmajanmāno dehā nāsya tathā hyajaḥ ।
śṛṇu vai lakṣaṇaireṣā varjiteti vivicyate ।।64।।
lakṣaṇaṃ karmajanyāṃ'kaṃ cihnaṃ śārīramucyate ।
taccā''yurdhanasaubhāgyasampanmṛtipradarśakam ।।65।।
iyaṃ tu brahmarūpā'sti karmaśūnyā maheśvarī ।
nāsyāḥ karmakṛtaṃ dehaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vidyate iti ।।66।।
svābhāvikāni daivāni cihnānyasyā bhavanti hi ।
śṛṇu cottānakaratāṃ hyuttāno varadaḥ sadā ।।67।।
hasto'syāśca mahādevyā bhaviṣyatyeva sarvathā ।
surā'suramuniprāṇivaradātrī bhaviṣyati ।।68।।
śṛṇu cāsyāstu caraṇau svacchāyau vyabhicāriṇau ।
caraṇau padmasaṃkāśau svacchāvasyā nakhojjvalau ।।69।।
surāsurāṇāṃ namatāṃ kirīṭamaṇikāntayaḥ ।
viśiṣṭā abhitaścāriṇyaḥ praviṣṭā yayorhi tau ।।1.181.70 ।।
tādṛśau bhavataścāsyāścaraṇau bhāgyasevitau ।
śivapatnyāstu kiṃ vastu nyūnaṃ śaila bhaved vada ।।71।।
pūrvaṃ yaduktaṃ tyāgī ca patirasyā bhaviṣyati ।
śivastu sarvadā rāgaśūnyastyāgī mato dhruvam ।।72।।
nagno'pimāyayā hīno māyāvastravihīnakaḥ ।
guṇahīnaśca māyāyā guṇatrayavihīnakaḥ ।।।73 ।।
parabrahmasvarūpasya na mātā janakastathā ।
mātṛtātavihīnatvaṃ śivasya ghaṭate sadā ।।74।।
akāmaḥ kāmanā gradhnā tṛṣṇā tayā vihīnakaḥ ।
aśivastāmaso bhāvaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ ।।75।।
sa cātra veśarūpeṇa kāryārthaṃ sandhṛtaḥ khalu ।
raudraḥ saṃhārako veṣo hyaśivaveṣa ucyate ।।76।।
citābhasmajaṭājūṭavyāghracarmā'sthidhāraṇam ।
aśivaveṣa ityevaṃ loke'pi śaṃkare'sti hi ।।77।।
sa śaṃbhuḥ svaḥ paraṃbrahmāvatāro bhagavān haraḥ ।
patirasyāstava putryā bhāgyodayād bhaviṣyati ।।78।।
tatropāyaṃ śṛṇu prītyā kṛtvā yaṃ lapsyase sukham ।
tatra śaṃbhau lakṣaṇāni śubhānyaśubhavanti vā ।।79।।
sukhadānyeva bodhyāni sukhamūrtiryato haraḥ ।
ravipāvakagaṃgānāṃ tatra grāhyaṃ nidarśanam ।।1.181.80।।
tasmāttvamapi śailendra dehi śivāya kanyakām ।
śīghraprasādaḥ sa haro grahīṣyati sutāṃ tava ।।8 1।।
śivasya tapasā prāptiḥ kuryāttapaḥ sutā tava ।
samartho'pi tava putryā vaśaṃ yāsyati sarvathā ।।82।।
kulipirapi sulipirbhaviṣyati tapobalāt ।
avaśyaṃ bhāvinī patnī tava putrī śivapriyā ।।।82।।
śaṃbhościttaṃ vaśe caiṣā kariṣyati susevayā ।
so'pyenāṃ te sutāṃ tyaktvā nānyāmudvāhayiṣyati ।।84।।
nā'nayoḥ sadṛśī prītiranyayorbhūtabhāvinī ।
anayormelane devakāryāṇi subahūni vai ।।85।।
kartavyāni suvidyante tasmād dehi harāya tām ।
anayā kanyayā śaṃbhurardhanārīśvaro'sti vai ।।।86।।
vivāhavidhinā khyātiṃ tādṛśīṃ tu gamiṣyati ।
tapasā ca haraṃ samyagārādhya tava putrikā ।।87।।
kṛṣṇarūpaṃ vidhūyaiva gaurarūpā bhaviṣyati ।
gaurīti vai tathā nāmnā vidyudgaurī bhaviṣyati ।।88।।
nāmānyasyāstathā'nyāni bahūni santi tāni ca ।
śṛṇu tubhyaṃ kathayāmi bhaviṣyanti yathātathā ।।89।।
kālī tārā mahāvidyā ṣoḍaśī bhuvaneśvarī ।
bhairavī chinnamastā ca vidyā dhūmāvatī tathā ।।1.181.90।।
bagalāmukhī siddhavidyā mātaṃgī kamalā tathā ।
caṇḍī ca bhairavī saiṃhītyevaṃ nāmāni santi vai ।।9 1 ।।
nānyasmai tvamimāṃ dātuṃ kvacitsaṃkalpamācareḥ ।
idaṃ copāṃśu devānāṃ na prakāśyaṃ ca kutracit ।।92।।
śailaḥ prāha tadā vṛddhabrāhmaṇaṃ śṛṇu madvacaḥ ।
śivastu sarvadā dhyānī devānāmapyagocaraḥ ।।93।।।
tyaktasaṃgo virāgaśca dhyānayogaparaḥ sadā ।
brahmārpitā'ntarātmā saḥ kathaṃ sādhyo bhaviṣyati ।।94।।
nirguṇo nirvikāraśca nirāmayo nirīhakaḥ ।
akṣaro brahma paramaḥ kathaṃ sādhyo bhaviṣyati ।।956।।
yasyāntarvartate viśvaṃ bāhyaṃ naiva nirīkṣate ।
saḥ kathaṃ tapasā putryā'nayā sādhyo bhaviṣyati ।।96।।
brāhmaṇaḥ prāha tacchrutvā cintā kāryā na vai tvayā ।
devadevo nirīho'pi tvatputryāmīhayā yutaḥ ।।97।।
tapasā'vaśyameva syādato'sādhyaṃ na vidyate ।
kālī svayaṃ mahākālaṃ haraṃ tu prāpsyati dhruvam ।।98।।
gacchāmyahaṃ tu śailendra vivāhakaraṇaṃ kuru ।
itikṛtvotthito vipro gamanāya mano dadhe ।।99।।
śailastāvatsusatkārā'rhaṇāṃ tasyā'karonmudā ।
vṛddhaviprasvarūpaṃ ca tirodhāyā'pi bhūsuraḥ ।। 1.181.100 ।।
devarṣirnāradaṃ rūpamāsthāya vyomamārgagaḥ ।
nārāyaṇaṃ raṭanpremṇā paśyatośca tayordvayoḥ ।। 101 ।।
menakāśailayoḥ śīghraṃ jagāmendrapurīṃ prati ।
menāśailau mahāścaryaṃ gatau dṛṣṭvā tu nāradam ।। 1 02।।
niścitā śaṃbhupatnīyaṃ sutā bhāgyavatī sadā ।
ānanditā ca sā kanyā prasannau pitarau tathā ।। 103 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vṛddhaviprarūpeṇa nāradasya himagirigṛhāgamanaṃ, pārvatyā rekhābhiḥ aguṇasya patnītvamuktam, himālayacintā, aguṇādiśabdārthasphuṭatā, śivapatnī bhāvinīti nirṇayaḥ, vṛddhabrāhmaṇatvaṃ vihāya nāradarūpeṇākāśapathā mahendrapurīṃ prati gamanamityādi-
nirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 181 ।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
athālpasamaye kānte menā mohavaśā priye ।
uvāca haimaṃ śailendraṃ prahvībhūtamanomayī ।। 1 ।।
daridrāya na dātavyā dātavyā dhanine sutā ।
vivāhaṃ kuru kanyāyāḥ sundareṇa vareṇa hi ।। 2 ।।
prāṇapriyā mama putrī komalā bhāgyaśālinī ।
vardhitā vividhairbhogyaiḥ sukhasampatsamṛddhibhiḥ ।। 3 ।।
ato'syāśca vivāho'pi sarvasampanmaye gṛhe ।
vareṇa sulakṣaṇasatkulodbhūtena yujyate ।। 4 ।।
sadvaraṃ prāpya sukhinī yathā syāttattathā kuru ।
śrutvā menāṃ tu śailendraḥ prāha śaṃkānivṛttaye ।। 5 ।।
bhramaṃ tyaja priye patni dātavyā śaṃkarāya vai ।
yadyasti te pratītirvai tadā dāsye'nyathā nahi ।। 6 ।।
yadi snehaḥ sutāyāste sutāṃ śikṣaya sādaram ।
śivopari tapaḥ kuryāt tapasā sādhyate śivaḥ ।। 7 ।।
prasannaśca haro bhūtvā kālyāḥ pāṇiṃ grahīṣyati ।
sarvaṃ vai śaṃkare cāsti sukhaṃ dravyaṃ smṛddhyādikam ।। 8 ।।
amaṃgalāni sarvāṇi maṃgalāni śive sadā ।
sarvavidhāni saukhyāni vartante ca śive sadā ।। 9 ।।
akhaṇḍavīryatā śaṃbhau svāmitā suranākinām ।
pūjyatā lokināṃ śaṃbhau hetutā bhūtadehinām ।। 1.182.10 ।।
pṛthvī jalaṃ tathā tejaḥ pavano gaganaṃ tathā ।
sūryacandrādayo yasya tanavaḥ santi sarvadā ।। 1 1।।
śaṃbhostasya tanuṣveva nihitāḥ sarvasmṛddhayaḥ ।
śivārthaṃ tapase putryai vinirdiśa śubhaṃ bhavet ।। 1 2।।
menā śrutvā tapaḥ drākca sutāṃ saṃlokya komalām ।
kṣaṇaṃ tu vivyathe sutāmupadeṣṭuṃ śaśāka na ।। 1 3।।।
atha sā pārvatī jñātvā provāca jananīṃ tadā ।
mātaḥ śṛṇu mayā dṛṣṭaḥ svapno brāhmamuhūrtake ।। 14।।
viprastapasvī suprītaḥ provāca vihituṃ tapaḥ ।
śaṃkarasyetyupādiśya kṛtvā bhāle sucandrakam ।। 15 ।।
karau manmastake datvā dhṛtvā māṃ vakṣasi svake ।
āśīḥ prayujya gatavān surūpaḥ śaṃkaro yathā ।। 16 ।।
tasmāttapaḥ kariṣye'haṃ smṛtvā taṃ puruṣaṃ hṛdi ।
śrutvaitatsvapnamevārthaṃ kathayituṃ jagāma sā ।। 17।।
giriṃ tāvat girīndro'pi svakaṃ svapnamuvāca ha ।
śṛṇu mene'dya me svapne tapasvī jana āgataḥ ।। 1 8।।
nāradoktasvarūpaḥ saḥ puropakaṇṭhamādarāt ।
tapaḥ kartuṃ pravṛttaśca tatrā'haṃ nītavān sutām ।। 19 ।।
mayā tu lakṣaṇairjñātaḥ śaṃkaro'yamiti dhruvam ।
sevāyāṃ pārvatīṃ tasyopādiśyā'haṃ tapasvinaḥ ।। 1.182.20।।
prārthitavāँśca taṃ bālaṃ nāṃgīcakāra vai yadā ।
mayā vedāntavijñānairbahudhā vāda ādṛtaḥ ।। 21 ।।
yathākathaṃcit sa tato bālāṃ jagrāha sevane ।
sāpi premṇā pārvatī taṃ sevate lokitaṃ mayā ।। 22।।
tato'sti samayaḥ prāptaḥ samīpe phaladāyakaḥ ।
pārvatīṃ tapase mene śikṣayā'cirasiddhaye ।।2 3 ।।
śrutvā menā'bhavad hṛṣṭā śikṣayāmāsa pārvatīm ।
sāpi śaṃbhuṃ sadā dhyātvā tapase saṃsthitā satī ।।24।।
phalāni bhojane devī gṛhṇātyekasubhaktake ।
yoginīva triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ śaṃkarapūjanam ।।25।।
mālikāyāḥ sahasraṃ tu śaṃbhunāmnā'nuvartanam ।
netre sammīlya svastikāsane niṣadya cintanam ।।26।।
prātaḥ sāyaṃ śaṃkarasyā''rārtrikaraṇamarthanā ।
stotrasya raṭaṇaṃ paścāt kiṃcijjāgaraṇaṃ tathā ।। 27।।
svāpaḥ pṛthvyāṃ tṛṇāḍhyāyāṃ tathā valkaladhāraṇam ।
maunaṃ cā'darśanaṃ pārśve tapaścaivaṃ cakāra sā ।।।28।।
śaṃkaro'pi svayaṃ vetti tapaḥ karoti yatsatī ।
vicaran vidhuraścamatkārāँścakre hyalaukikān ।।29।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satītapaḥ, satīhimālayayoḥ svapne śaṃbhunā tāpasaveṣeṇa dattadarśanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā
dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 182।।।
