śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kīdṛśāँśca camatkārāँścakre vai śaṃkarastadā ।
satīṃ vinā tapaḥ kurvan vicaraँśca kṣitau sukham ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
camatkārā mahābhāgavatasya śaṃkarasya me ।
bhaktasyā''san bahavo'pi dvitrāँste kathayāmi vai ।। 2 ।।
satīdāhottare kāle pārvatyudvāhapūrvake ।
ekadā śaṃkaraḥ satīvirahāgnipratāpitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
kailāse maunamāsthāya priyāvirahakātaraḥ ।
sasmāra svapriyāṃ patnīṃ guṇāँśca premavardhanān ।। 4 ।।
varṇayāmāsa bahudhā darśayan laukikīṃ gatim ।
vairāgyavegena gārhasthyasya rītiṃ vihāya ca ।। '9 ।।
digambaraḥ subabhrāma sthale vane hyaraṇyake ।
kvāpi śāntiṃ na ca lebhe satīvirahaduḥkhitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
mano niyamya kailāse samādhiṃ kṛtavān haraḥ ।
samādhau bahuvarṣāṇi vyatīyuśca punastadā ।। 7 ।।
brahmāgninā brahmarandhraṃ lalāṭaṃ cātapat bahu ।
tapoyogoṣmaṇā bhāle cā'bhavat svedabindukaḥ ।। 8 ।।
sthūlo bhūtvā'patat pṛthvyāṃ tapodhātuvimiśritaḥ ।
tasya babhūva pṛthvyāṃ vai bālo raktapravarṇakaḥ ।। 9 ।।
caturbhujo'ruṇo ramyo'laukikadyutimān śubhaḥ ।
sa ca ruroda tasyaiva tadā śaṃbhostu sannidhau ।। 1.183.1 0।।
śaṃbhuḥ samādhimagno'sti jñātvā devī vasundharā ।
āvirbabhūva tatraiva dhṛtvā sustrītanuṃ navām ।। 1 1।।
bhūmirbālaṃ nidhāyāṃ'ke stanyaṃ sā'pāyayat sutam ।
cucumba tanmukhaṃ snehāt samakrīḍayadātmajam ।। 12।
śaṃbhurantaḥsthito devo jñātvā sarvaṃ samādhinā ।
utthitaḥ sahasā tatra samādheśca vihasya tām ।। 13।।
bhūmiṃ prāha prasannaḥ san dhanyāsi dharaṇe priye! ।
prītyainaṃ rakṣitavatī tvayi jātaṃ sutaṃ mama ।। 14।।
mama svedodbhūtabindujanyo'yaṃ bālakastava ।
nāmnā khyāto bhavelloke bhūmidātṛguṇādimān ।। 15।।
bhaumo'yaṃ maṃgalakaro maṃgalaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
mamāpi sukhadātā'yaṃ gṛhāṇainaṃ sutaṃ tava ।। 16।।
bhūmirjagrāha taṃ bālaṃ śivaṃ saṃpūjya vai tataḥ ।
āśīrvacanamādāya svasthānaṃ sasutā yayau ।। 17।।
rūpāntareṇa sā bhūmiḥ sutamādāya sarvadā ।
kāśyāṃ vāsaṃ kṛtavatī suto'bhūd yauvanā'nvitaḥ ।। 18।।
sa ca jānāti pitaraṃ devaṃ śaṃbhuṃ sadā smaran ।
kāśyāṃ mūrtau mahādeve siṣeve śaṃkaraṃ sadā ।। 19।।
yuvānaṃ ca sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitā prāhā'dya sevayā ।
prasanno'smi vṛṇu kiṃcit dāsye tvadabhivāñcchitam ।। 1.183.20।।
putraḥ prāha mayā labdhaṃ sarvaṃ labdhā prasannatā ।
pitṛprasannatātulyaṃ nahi kiṃcid bhavediti ।।2 1।।
sarvalabdhavyabhogyeṣu śreṣṭhā pitṛprasannatā ।
sā yadyadhigatā putraiḥ sarvaṃ cādhigataṃ bhavet ।।।22।।
pitṛsevāphalaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaścā'punarāvṛtaḥ ।
sarvavighnavināśaśca sarvasampatkaraḥ smṛtaḥ ।।23।।
sūryacandrādirājyāni bhaumānyatalajāni vā ।
pārameṣṭhyapadānyatho pitṛprasannatāphalam ।।।24।।
tava sevā sadā kāryā na me'styanyamanorathaḥ ।
ityuktvā hṛdgadabhāvāt patito harapādayoḥ ।।25।।
śaṃbhuḥ karau bhaumamūrdhni kṛtvā prāha suputrakam ।
sthāpaye tvāṃ gṛhamadhye maṃgalākhyo graho bhava ।।26।।।
yāvat dyauḥ sthāsyati sṛṣṭau tāvat tvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi ।
ityāśiṣaṃ ca samprāpya natvā śaṃbhuṃ vasundharām ।।27।।
divyaṃ lokaṃ jagāmā'śu śukralokātparaṃ varam ।
tatra rājyaṃ mahallebhe bhaumagolakanāmakam ।। 28।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi bhaumasyotpattilakṣaṇam ।
śaṃkarasya caritaṃ vai satīvirahakālikam ।।29।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya lalāṭasvedabindormaṃgalagrahasyotpattiritinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikaśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 183।।


← adhyāyaḥ 183 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 184
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 185 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ataḥ paraṃ śṛṇu prītyā hanumaccaritaṃ priye ।
ādyayuge yadabhūttad rudrasya caritaṃ śubhe ।। 1 ।।
brahmaṇaścāpi caritaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mohinīṃ tadā ।
dhātavo nyapatan śaṃbhorvedhasaścāpi yadyathā ।। 2 ।।
ekadā vidhuraḥ śaṃbhuḥ śaradi himaparvate ।
śṛṇvan vai kokilālāpān candrikādhavalīkṛte ।। 3 ।।
surabhyanilasaṃvyāpte mayūraiścāpi nādite ।
śaityavyāptanikuṃjāḍhye sasmāra dakṣajāṃ satīm ।। 4 ।।
aho nāsti mama kāntā kīdṛśī me'sti vai gatiḥ ।
sakhīṃ vinā śaratkālaḥ kathaṃ niryāpito bhavet ।। 5 ।।
devānāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca parabrahmasvarūpajaḥ ।
bādhakaḥ samayo'vaśyaṃ bhavati prāṇadhāriṇām ।। 6 ।।
yadyapyasmi nirīho'haṃ tathāpi varṣmayogataḥ ।
tātkālikehayā cātra smarāmi dakṣajāṃ satīm ।। 7 ।।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi vinā satīṃ sahāyinīm ।
tāṃ vinā bādhate śaityaṃ smaro'pi bādhate'dya vai ।। 8 ।।
brāhmamuhūrtaprāraṃbhe cintāmagno haro'bhavat ।
atīva sasmāra satīmutthāyotthāya tiṣṭhati ।। 9 ।।
niṣīdati viharati kāmajvarasamākulaḥ ।
āmravṛkṣaṃ samāśritya nirāśī niṣasāda saḥ ।। 1.184.10 ।।
tāvad viditvā deveśī himālayasutā satī ।
yogabalaṃ samāsādya dhṛtvā rūpaṃ dvitīyakam ।। 11 ।।
vyomni tatra samāgatyā''kāśavāṇyā'vadat priyā ।
re brahma tvaṃ parabrahmakṛṣṇamūrteḥ kṛtodbhavaḥ ।। 12।।
parabrahmasvarūpo'si gaccha golokadhāma yat ।
tatra sakhyo hyanantāste viharasva yathāsukham ।। 13।।
kathamatrā'raṇyabhūmau vṛthā śocasi dīnavat ।
tatra kṛṣṇastava kartā duḥkhaṃ te nāśayiṣyati ।। 14।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'tha maunaṃ tiṣṭhati taddrume ।
śaṃkaro'pi tadāśrutya cakito'bhūd hṛdantare ।। 15।।
vicārya bahudhā citte samutthāya ca tatsthalāt ।
jagāmākāśamārgeṇa golokaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।। 16।।
satī cāpi priyā śaṃbhoradṛśyā cūtasaṃsthitā ।
pṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhe jagāmā'pi golokaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।। 17।।
yāvatkumārikā cāsti tāvannecchati śaṃkaram ।
vivāhe saṃvṛte paścāt sadā cecchati śaṃkaram ।। 18।।
iti kṛtvā gatā patyuḥ śāntyarthaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam ।
gatvā śaṃbhustu golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇanāma saḥ ।। 19।।
svāgataṃ kṛtavān śaṃbhoḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
prayojanaṃ papracchāpi tadā novāca śaṃkaraḥ ।।1.184.20।।।
lajjito'bhūt tato devī satī kamalalocanā ।
praviveśa harau kṛṣṇe śaṃkarānandakāriṇī ।। 21 ।।
provāca hṛdayaṃ jñātvā harasya kṛṣṇasaṃsthitā ।
priyo'si me sadā śaṃbho satīṃ nā'nītavān katham ।।।22।।
śrutvaitat kṛṣṇavacanaṃ netrāśrūṇi mumoca saḥ ।
śanairdhairyaṃ samālambya prāha satīpraṇāśanam ।।23 ।।
svasya vaidhuryamapi ca duḥkhadaṃ cā'nivedayat ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā śaṃbhumāśvāsya sukhadaṃ vacaḥ ।।24।।
manmūrtestvaṃ samutpannaḥ satī manmūrtisaṃbhavā ।
mama putro'si deveśa cāgato'tra śubhaṃ kṛtam ।।25।।
golokaṃ yanmama sarvaṃ tatsarvaṃ ca tathāpi vai ।
yatheṣṭaṃ vasa goloke viharasva yatheṣṭakam ।।26।।
dāsyo dāsā aneke vai kariṣyanti tvadarhaṇā ।
sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva sadā śaṃbho yatte manasi vartate ।।27।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā kṛṣṇaṃ bhakto'smi nātha te'pyaham ।
tava bhogyaṃ mamā'bhogyaṃ vṛtaṃ me'sti sadā hare ।। 28।।
tasmānnānena rūpeṇa vicariṣyāmi mādhava ।
yadi te'sti kṛpā śiṣye bhavāmi vṛṣabho'tra vai ।।29।।
gavāṃ madhye nivasāmi vihariṣyāmi goṣu vai ।
ityājñāṃ dehi me nātha kṛpāṃ kuru mayi prabho ।।1.184.30।।
yāvatkālaṃ prabhorājñā tāvattiṣṭhāmi cātra vai ।
paścāt punargamiṣyāmi himavadgṛhamuttamam ।।3 1 ।।
tathā'stviti jagādainaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
kṛṣṇecchayā tadā śaṃbhurvatso yuvā'bhavad drutam ।।32।।
gāvaśca mohitā dṛṣṭvā surūpaṃ vatsamuttamam ।
lelihānā jihvayā taṃ siṣevire muhurmuhuḥ ।।।33।।
jṛṃbhamāṇā dhāvamānāḥ sparśamagnāḥ siṣevire ।
dṛṣṭvā devī satī tāsu goṣu yogasamādhinā ।।34।।
praviveśa ca sarvāsu yāḥ sevante haraṃ vṛṣam ।
satīpraveśasāmarthyāt gāvastāḥ śaṃkaraṃ vṛṣam ।।35।।
sevante bahudhā premṇā yathā śaṃbhuḥ sukhī bhavet ।
evaṃ viharato goṣu tṛpto'bhūt vṛṣaśaṃkaraḥ ।।36 ।।
tṛptistu śāśvatī jātā yathā necchati gāṃ vṛṣaḥ ।
tataḥ satī gavāṃ dehād viniḥsṛtya ca mādhave ।।37।।
praviśyā''ha haraṃ gaccha himaśailaṃ satīpate ।
śaṃbhustadā vṛṣarūpaṃ vihāya śaṃkaro'bhavat ।। 38 ।।
prapūjya parameśānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hṛdaye smaran ।
vidhuraḥ pṛthivīṃ yātuṃ nā'karonmana eva saḥ ।।।35।।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā śaṃbho kiṃ te manasi vartate ।
brūhi dadāmi te sarvaṃ mahābhāgavatāya hi ।।1.184.40 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha hare kṛṣṇa vidhuro yāmyahaṃ katham ।
vaidhuryaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sarvaṃ sarasaṃ nīrasāyate ।।41 ।।
tasmādatraiva tiṣṭhāmi yogī bhūtvā tavāntike ।
omityāha tadā kṛṣṇaḥ śaṃbhuścāpi vaṭāntike ।।।42।।
niṣadyā'vatatārā'ntaḥsamādhau dhyeyamādhave ।
na jānātyākūticiticāpalyavedanādikam ।।43।।
satī cāpi tadā śaṃbhoḥ pārśve rakṣatyavyaktikā ।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇā'dṛśyena śaṃkarapriyā ।।44।।
atha himālayaputrī pārvatī tapasi sthitā ।
śaṃbhuṃ pratīkṣate nityaṃ kadā''gacchenmaheśvaraḥ ।।45।।
evaṃ pratīkṣate nityaṃ śaṃbhuścātrā''gato bhavet ।
śaṃbhuḥ samādhimāpanno jāgartyeva nahi kvacit ।।46 ।।
samā bahvyastadā tatra vyatītāḥ parameśvarī ।
satī tvadhairyamāpannā kṛṣṇaṃ prāha na tā muhuḥ ।।47।।
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa prāṇadātarbhaktaste brahmaṇi sthitaḥ ।
bahiḥ samādhernāyāti samā yānti nirarthikāḥ ।।48।।
ahaṃ tu pārvatī bhūtvā tapaḥ karomi parvate ।
pratīkṣe'haṃ mahādevaṃ kadā''gacchenmamāntikam ।।49।।
tasmādenaṃ samādhestvaṃ bahirānaya mādhava ।
prāpaya yatra śailendro himavān vartate bhuvi ।।1.184.50।।
yatra mayā vivāhaḥ syāt tacchīghraṃ kuru keśava ।
satyuktāṃ prārthanāṃ śrutvā śaṃbhorjāgaraṇāya vai ।।51।।
prerayāmāsa gopīnāṃ rāsamaṇḍalameva saḥ ।
gopībhiḥ saṃkṛte rāse bahughoṣasamanvite ।।52।।
satataṃ vādyatālādinṛtyagītipramiśrite ।
racite'pi mahāyogī bahirnāyātsamādhitaḥ ।।53।।
gopyo devyaḥ pariśrāntā viramuḥ rāsakhelanāt ।
jagaduḥ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śaṃbhurjāgarti naiva ca ।।54।।
nā'smākaṃ tatra sāmarthyaṃ pravartate mahāyatau ।
spṛśāmo nahi devaṃ taṃ dāhasya bhītito vayam ।।55।।
tasmāddeva yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ gatvotthāpaya yoginam ।
śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra gatvā paśyati śaṃkaram ।।56।।
kṛṣṇe svaṃ paṃcaviṃśākhyaṃ saṃvilīya sthitaṃ haram ।
utthāpayituṃ sūpāyaṃ klṛptayāmāsa keśavaḥ ।।57।।
tūrṇaṃ tu mohinīrūpaṃ yoginīdhāryameva saḥ ।
dadhāra ca svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃyamaṃ kṛtavān śive ।।58 ।।
ātmānaṃ paṃcaviṃśaṃ taṃ samādherbahirānayat ।
tadā netre samunmīlya śaṃbhurdadarśa sannidhau ।।59।।
tāvatsurūpāṃ yuvatīṃ dadarśa mohinīṃ haraḥ ।
mohinyātmakakṛṣṇena hāvabhāvavilāsanaiḥ ।।1.184.60।।
ākarṣakamṛdusparśacūmbanālāpaliṃganaiḥ ।
saṃbhāvito mahādevo mumoha mānase manāk ।।61 ।।
satī tāvat sthitā tatra praveśamakaroddhare ।
viśeṣeṇa harastatra mohinyāṃ pramumoha ca ।।62।।
utthitaḥ sahasā bhrānto mohinīṃ dhartumicchati ।
tāvattāvanmohinī sā paścātpaścātpragacchati ।।63।।।
brahmāṇḍe mohinī yāti haro'pyanuyayau ca tām ।
virajāṃ ca samullaṃghya tvāyātau mohinīharau ।।64।।
prakṛtyāvaraṇe tatra satī niṣkramya śaṃkarāt ।
pṛthaksthitā'bhavat tāvacchaṃkaro mohinīṃ prati ।।65।।
provāca yāsi kaṃ lokaṃ gaccha yaṃ prati gacchasi ।
nā'haṃ yāsye tvayā sākaṃ yoginā kiṃ prayojanam ।।66।।
ahaṃ sthāsye'tra śāntyāḍhye nirjane sukhade sthale ।
dhyāne magno bhaviṣyāmi gaccha yatra pragacchasi ।।67।।
na mayā yoginā kāryaṃ yuvatyā saha vidyate ।
yuvatīrnarakadvāraṃ yogavighnakarī hyati ।।68।।
viśvāso naiva kartavyo yoginā pramadājane ।
yogābhyāsādviyujyaiva saṃyojayati svātmani ।।69।।
svakāryaṃ sādhayatyeva parakāryaṃ dhunoti ca ।
jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ guṇānsarvān dhvaṃsayatyeva sarvathā ।।1.184.70।।
surūpaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvasvaṃ pradadāti sā ।
kintu cātmasukhaṃ brahmasukhamākṛṣya yāti vai ।।71।।
tasmātsakhyaṃ na vai kāryaṃ mayā vijānatā'dhunā ।
gaccha mohaprade ramye nā'haṃ sahacarastava ।। 72।।
ityuktvā niṣasādaiva harastatra vinirjane ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā''veśayituṃ netramiṣeṇa tām ।।7 ।।
satī punaḥ praviveśa śaṃkare so'tha mohitaḥ ।
utthāyā'nujagāmāpi parirabdhuṃ tu mohinīm ।।74।।
mohinī tatsthalāt satyalokaṃ prati sasarpa vai ।
śīghraṃ jagmuḥ satyalokaṃ satī śaṃbhuśca mādhavaḥ ।।75।।
tatra brahmasabhāṃ tvālokayāmāsuḥ prapūritām ।
mohinīṃ pravilokyaite brahmādyāḥ kṣobhitā hyati ।।76।।
apsarasaśca sāvitrī devyaśca kṣobhitāḥ kṣaṇam ।
mohinyāstatparaṃ rūpaṃ rādhāto'pi pralaukikam ।।77।।
sabhā sarvā devadevyātmikā kṣubdhā dravaṃgatā ।
kimu vaktavyamevā'tra sākṣātkṛṣṇe pramohake ।।78।।
kṣaṇāntare tu mohinyā mohaḥ saṃkucitastadā ।
sabhājano'bhavat svasthaḥ śaṃbhoḥ svāgatamācarat ।।79।।
satī punaḥ śarvadehāt bahirnirgamya saṃsthitā ।
adṛśyā sarvadevaiśca viśaśrāmā'tha mohinī ।।1.184.80 ।।
jagāma śaṃkaraṃ spraṣṭuṃ nirvikāraṃ guṇākaram ।
tāvat tāṃ prāha śaṃbhurmā tavāsti me prayojanam ।।8 1 ।।
brahmāṇaṃ gaccha deveśi yadi tatra prayojanam ।
tāmājñāṃ lokanāthasya gṛhītvā''gādajaṃ prati ।।82 ।।
savyahastaṃ brahmaṇaśca kaṇṭhe kṛtvā cucumba sā ।
sparśamātreṇa kāmādvai brahmasattvaṃ samaskhalat ।।83।।
brahmāsane tu tatsattvaṃ guptyarthaṃ vastramarditam ।
kaṇāḥ lakṣaṃ tato jātā siṃhāsanasamantataḥ ।।84।।
tebhyo jātāśca paryākhyā brahmasarasaḥ kanyakāḥ ।
apsarobhyaścātirūpāḥ striyo brahmasaro'bhidhāḥ ।।85।।
rūpalāvaṇyasaundaryaujjvalyasaumyaguṇākarāḥ ।
prodbhinnayauvanonmukhyaḥ sarvadaikatanusthitāḥ ।।86।।
ye ye chatradharā rājādhirājā devatottamāḥ ।
taddevīnāmupadevyastābhyaḥ pratyekamarpitāḥ ।।87।।
tāśca brahmasaraḥsṛṣṭiḥ paryaḥ proktā hi vedhasā ।
athāyaṃ śaṃkaro devo netre sammīlya saṃyame ।।88।।
antarjagāma tatraiva sabhāyāṃ brahmasannidhau ।
antarvṛttirapi bahirvṛttiḥ śṛṇoti śaṃkaraḥ ।।89।।
mohinī kathayāmāsa trailokyacittamohinī ।
nibodha sādho me vākyaṃ kāminyāste sukhapradam ।। 1.184.90।।
tyaktvā kaṭhoratāṃ gupte bhaja māṃ sukhadāyinīm ।
tvaṃ vareṣu varaḥ sṛṣṭau varārhā'haṃ svayaṃvarā । ।9 1।।
vidagdhāyā vidagdhasya durlabho navasaṃgamaḥ ।
stanayoryugmamūrvorme sundaraṃ mukhapaṃkajam ।।92।।
hāsyabhrūbhaṃgasahitaṃ dṛṣṭvā ko na laset sukham ।
strīrasaḥ sukhasāraśca munīnāmabhivāñcchitaḥ ।।92।।
rasikāsukhasaṃbhogaḥ paryāptaścātidurlabhaḥ ।
tyaja dhyānaṃ suraśreṣṭha bhuṃkṣvemāṃ tapasaḥ phalam ।। 14।।
svayamupasthitāṃ kāntāṃ na bhajedyo jitendriyaḥ ।
saḥ tasyāstu viniḥśvāsā'gninā dagdho vinaśyati ।।95।।
śaṃbhuḥ śrutvā tathāvākyaṃ hitaṃ tathyamuvāca tām ।
śṛṇu kānte pravakṣyāmi pariṇāmasukhāvaham ।।96।।
kuladharmocitaṃ satyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tapasvinām ।
svayoṣiti yogyakāle ratirdharmaḥ praśasyate ।।97।।
yatra kvāpi labdhajanmā jano yaḥ parayoṣiti ।
ratiṃ yāti gṛhāttasya lakṣmīḥ ruṣṭā prayāti vai ।।18।।
grāhyā copasthitā nārī gṛhiṇāṃ na tapasvinā ।
tyāge doṣo gṛhasthānāṃ śāpabhākpāpabhāggṛhī ।। 99।।
brahmā jagadvidhātā'sti sastrīko na viraktimān ।
tyāge doṣo bhavettasya nā'smākaṃ tyāgināṃ kvacit ।। 1.184.100 ।।
svabhāryāṃ tu parityajya yo gṛhṇāti parastriyam ।
yaśodhanāyuṣāṃ hānistasyātrāmutra cā'gatiḥ ।। 101 ।।
susampadā striyā sāmrājyena vā kiṃ tapasvinaḥ ।
niṣkāmena ca mattena mayā kiṃ te prayojanam ।। 10 2।।
suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ puṣṭaṃ yuvānaṃ gaccha sundari ।
ityevaṃ tyajanaṃ śrutvā provāca vinayānvitā ।। 10 3।।
cārucampakavarṇābhaḥ kandarpasamasundaraḥ ।
tapaḥprabhāvāt sastrīkaḥ sughaṭaḥ sammataḥ striyāḥ ।। 104।।
tvayā vinā'nyaṃ kaṃ yāmi ko vā'sti tvatparaḥ pumān ।
mādṛśī tvāṃ parityajya kva vā gacchet smarāturā ।। 105।।
śīghraṃ māṃ bhaja yogīndra dagdhāṃ kāmāgninā parām ।
na cecchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi satvaraṃ vā gṛhāṇa mām ।। 1 06।।
dagdhāḥ prāṇā mano dagdhaṃ svātmā ca dahyate'dhunā ।
navaśṛṃgārapīyūṣapānanirvāṇatāṃ kuru ।। 1 07।।
svāntarduḥkhena duḥkhārtā yā yaṃ śapati niścitam ।
śāpaṃ khaṇḍayituṃ śakto na vidhātā na śaṃkaraḥ ।। 1 08।।
samuttamābhāṃ māṃ paśya pradagdhāṃ madanānalaiḥ ।
prodbhinnanavasārāṃ cā'kṣatāṃ kenā'pyadharṣitām ।। 109।।
sindūrabinduṃ dadhatīṃ kastūrībindunā saha ।
cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ satataṃ sthirayauvanām ।। 1.184.110 । ।
bṛhannitambayugalāṃ pīnaśroṇipayodharām ।
śaratpārvaṇaśubhrāṃśuprabhāmuṣṭakarānanām ।। 111 ।।
sūkṣmavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitām ।
sarvaṃ mohayituṃ śaktāṃ kaṭākṣaireva līlayā ।। 112 ।।
tvādṛśaṃ kāmayamānāṃ gajendramadagāminīm ।
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgīṃ mūrchāsanmukhayāyinīm ।। 113 ।।
gṛhāṇa tvaritaṃ tvaṃ māṃ śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukām ।
ityevaṃ mohinī śarvaṃ vacanairmohayatyapi ।। 114 ।।
śivo mohaṃ na cāpnoti dhyānaṃ naiva vimuñcati ।
tāvattatra samāgatya raṃbhayā'psarasoditam ।। 1 15।।
śṛṇu cā'li! yuvayogisamākarṣaṇamantraṇām ।
yadi te'sti mano yuvapuruṣe rantumarthanā ।। 116 ।।
kāmadevasahāyena kuru kāryaṃ nijepsitam ।
brahmā'yaṃ dāsyati kāmaṃ sopakaraṇamarthanāt ।। 117 ।।
yadyatra nāsti te rāgo'nyaṃ yuvānaṃ vimārgaya ।
kṛtvā veṣamapūrvaṃ vā pūrvaṃ prayujya manmatham ।। 118 ।।
tena sārdhaṃ svayaṃ gatvā mohaṃ kuru ca mohini! ।
jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇātmakam ।। 119। ।।
vinā kāmasahāyena kā śaktā jetumīśvaram ।
atra pārśve kṛtāvāsaṃ kāmaṃ saṃvraja mohini ।। 1.184.120 ।।
sadyaḥ sahāyo bhavitā dayāluryoṣitāṃ prabhuḥ ।
ityuktā mohinī tatra gatā yatra smaragṛham ।। 121 ।।
kāmo'pi mohito dṛṣṭvā mohinīṃ kṣobhamāptavān ।
skhalitaḥ sahasā kāmaḥ kṣaṇaṃ jaḍa ivā'bhavat ।। 1 22।।
tatsattvāt dvau sutau jātau śṛṃgāraka-vasantakau ।
mohinīsamarūpāḍhyau sarvasaundaryabhājanau ।। 123 ।।
drāgeva yauvanodbhedau kāmasāhāyyadau sutau ।
jātau tau sahanītvaiva kāmo'pi mohinīkṛte ।। 1 24।।
sahāyārthaṃ prārthitaḥ san samāyāt yatra śaṃkaraḥ ।
dadarśa saṃyamasthaṃ ca mohinī yoginaṃ haram ।। 125 ।।
tameva mohitaṃ kartuṃ samārebhe puraḥsthi tā ।
kṣaṇaṃ nanarta ruciraṃ sugānena kṣaṇaṃ jagau ।। 126।।
satīsambandhisaṃgītaṃ bhaktānāṃ cittamohakam ।
vinetā jagatāṃ tasyāḥ śrutvā saṃgītamīpsitam ।। 1 27।।
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgo netre pronmīlya paśyati ।
kāmāviṣṭo harastasyāṃ mumoha sāśrulocanaḥ ।। 128 ।।
dṛṣṭvā mugdhaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ mohinī hṛṣṭamānasā ।
kalāpramāṇaṃ bhāvaṃ ca cakāra tatra līlayā ।। 129।।
svāṃgāni darśayāmāsa smerabhrūbhaṃgapūrvakam ।
kā lajjā tasya saṃsāre yaḥ kāmahatacetanaḥ ।। 1.184.130 ।।
tathāpi śaṃkarastatra netre sammīlya dhairyavān ।
virato yogamārgeṇa na dadarśa tu mohinīm ।। 131 ।।
kintu sā mohinī śaṃbhościtte samāruroha vai ।
dhyāne'pi dṛśyate cāntaḥkaraṇe mohakāriṇī ।। 1 32।।
bahiḥsthitaṃ tadā kāmaṃ prairayat mohinī kṣaṇam ।
sarvendriyāṇāṃ pravaraṃ viṣṇoraṃśaṃ ca mānasam ।। 1 33।।
ratibījaṃ paṃca bāṇaṃ śaśvadyoṣidadhiṣṭhitam ।
sugandhivātasacivaṃ madhuśṛṃgāravegitam ।। 1 34।।
athā'yaṃ kāmadevo'pi sajjībhūto harīcchayā ।
cakāra śarasandhānamantarīkṣe sthitaḥ svayam ।। 135।।
mantrapūtaṃ mahāstraṃ ca cikṣepa śaṃkaropari ।
babhūva caṃcalaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kāmāstreṇa tu kāmukaḥ ।। 1 36।।
kṣaṇaṃ nirīkṣaṇaṃ cakre mohinyāsye punaḥpunaḥ ।
sasmite vakranayane kāmabhāvapravarṣiṇi ।। 1 37।।
etasminnantare kāmaḥ samayajñaḥ suyogavit ।
āvirbhūya paṃcabāṇānnicikṣepa ca śaṃkare ।। 1 38।।
sammohanaṃ tu prathamaṃ sampravegaṃ dvitīyakam ।
unmattavīryaṃ tṛtīyaṃ jvalajjvara caturthakam ।। 1 39।।
paṃcamaṃ cetanaharaṃ prakṣipya vyomamārgataḥ ।
kiṃkarānpreṣayāmāsa kokilāṃ ca vasantakam ।। 1.184.140।।
bhramarān gandhavātaṃ ca svayaṃ cāpi gato hare ।
puṃskokilaḥ kalaṃ rāvamuvāca tatsamīpataḥ ।। 141 ।।
ṣaṭpadaḥ sundaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ juguñja purataḥ sthitaḥ ।
śaśvad vavau gandhavaho mando'tiśītalaḥ priye ।। 142।।
satataṃ muditastatra babhrāma ca madhuḥ svayam ।
kāmaśca mānase sthitvā tadvikāraṃ cakāra ha ।। 143।।
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgo babhūva yogiśaṃkaraḥ ।
dadarśa mohinībhāvaṃ vihasya ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 144।।
provāca vakranayanā kāmāstrahatacetanā ।
iṅgitenaiva nārīṇāṃ sadyo mattaṃ bhavenmanaḥ ।। 145।।
karotyākṛṣya saṃbhogaṃ yaḥ sa evottamo mataḥ ।
nāryāḥ sphuṭamabhiprāyaṃ jñātvā hyākāritastu yaḥ ।। 146।।
paścāt karoti śṛṃgāraṃ puruṣaḥ sa tu madhyamaḥ ।
kāmārtayā striyā yaścā''kārito vai punaḥ punaḥ ।। 147।।
dhṛtvā prasahya saṃliptaḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ sa pumānmataḥ ।।
tayā na lipto rahasi sa klībo na pumānaho ।। 148।।
uttiṣṭha jagatāṃ nātha pāraṃ kuru smarārṇave ।
nimagnāṃ dustare ghore karṇadhāra bhayānake ।। 149।।
satataṃ tvanmanaskāṃ māṃ dāsīṃ janmani janmani ।
krīṇīhi ratipaṇyenā'mūlyaratnena satvaram ।। 1.184.15 0।।
ityuktvā mohinī tatra samīpamabhisṛtya vai ।
vicakarṣa karaṃ śaṃbhoḥ sasmitā kāmavihvalā ।। 151 ।।
śaṃbhuścāpi samutthāya parirabdhuṃ samicchati ।
tāvatprāha satī kṛṣṇaṃ nayainaṃ himavatsthalam ।। 152।।
mohinīśaḥ karagrāhaṃ kṛtvaikāntaṃ sthalāntaram ।
jigamiṣurapasarpan ' cāgre yātyanuśaṃkaraḥ ।। 153।।
kṣaṇāntare mohinī taṃ nināya himavatsthalam ।
kāmajaḍaṃ ca nirlepaṃ kiñcillepaṃ haraṃ hariḥ ।। 154।।
kailāsasannidhau nānāvṛkṣavallīsamanvite ।
mandasugandhaśaityāḍhyavāyuvyāpte suśītale ।। 155।।
supuṣpāñcitaśākhānāṃ nikuṃje tu manohare ।
prasravajjalajharaṇāntike nirjanake sthale ।। 156।।
mohinī prāha śaṃbhuṃ vai kānta smaraśayī bhava ।
ehyatra ratibhedairvā ramāvo bahubhedataḥ ।। 1517।।
netramiṣeṇa ca satīṃ prāha kujāntarasthitā ।
paśya līlāṃ bhagavatordvayoranupamāṃ sakhi ।। 158।।
ityuktvā mohinī puṣpaśayyāṃ mṛdvīṃ cakāra vai ।
śaṃbhuṃ dhṛtvā vakṣasi sve suṣvāpa kāmasundarī ।। 159।।
śaṃbhukāmottejakāni sādhanāni smarastadā ।
susajjāni preritāni cakāra sarvato diśi ।। 1.184.16 0।।
parirebhe mohinīṃ saḥ kṛṣṇarūpāṃ susundarīm ।
kāmabāṇahataḥ śaṃbhuḥ kṣubhito dhairyavarjitaḥ ।। 161 ।।
yāvattu saṃgamaṃ kartumicchati tāvatā bahiḥ ।
vīryaṃ caskanda vai sarvaṃ niroddhaṃ+u na śaśāka saḥ ।। 162।।
sarvaṃ tu pātayāmāsa puṣpaśayyātmake sthale ।
mohinī drāk samutthāyā'dṛśyatāṃ prāpya tatsthalāt ।। 16 3।।
satīṃ kāmaṃ parirabhyā''jñāpya gantuṃ svakaṃ sthalam ।
golokaṃ prāpa śrīkṛṣṇo bhūtvā gopīgaṇānvitam ।। 164।।
śaṃkaraścakito bhūtvā jñātvā kṛṣṇaviceṣṭitam ।
nā'vamānaṃ svakaṃ mene yayau kailāsameva vai ।। 165।।
satyalokāccaritraṃ tat draṣṭuṃ saptarṣayastadā ।
āsansamāgatāstatra dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ rahaḥsthitāḥ ।। 166 ।।
rāmakāyārthamevaitadvīryaṃ patre nidhāya te ।
saṃrarakṣuḥ patrapuṭāntare nirvighnatā yathā ।। 167।।
etasminnantare putrī kesarasyāṃjanī śubhā ।
araṇye nirjane tatra tapaḥ karoti duṣkaram ।। 168।।
putrecchayā tapaḥkartryai vyomavāṇyā samīritam ।
tapasaste phalaṃ putro vāyubalo bhaviṣyati ।। 169।।
vāyudevaḥ svayaṃ cātrā''gatya bījaṃ pradāsyati ।
niḥśaṃkaṃ tadgṛhāṇa tvaṃ tāpasyapi śubhānane ।। 1.184.170 ।।
na te tatra bhaveddoṣo rāmakāryaṃ yato'sti tat ।
akṣatatve'pi te putro bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ।। 171।।
tathāstviti jagādaiṣā drutaṃ nanāma taddiśi ।
vyomavāṇī nivṛttā'bhūt sā tu bījaṃ pratīkṣate ।। 172।।
tāvad vāyuśca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣubhito'tīva rūpataḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā tu nirjane kanyāmāgato divyarūpadhṛk ।। 173 ।।
saptarṣayo'pi tatraiva cāgatā daivayogataḥ ।
vāyurlajjāṃ gatastatra tān ṛṣīnsaṃvilokya vai ।। 174।।
tadā maharṣayaḥ prāhurdevakāryārthamatra vai ।
tvayā kāryaṃ mahatkāryaṃ rāmakāryārthameva yat ।। 175।।
gṛhāṇa śāṃkaraṃ bījaṃ gacchāṃ'janīṃ tu kaisarīm ।
svastho bhūtvā tadā vāyurvīryaṃ jagrāha śāṃkaram ।। 176।।
patrapuṭaṃ samuddhāṭya vāyuḥ paśyati tadyadā ।
tāvat vahnisamaṃ dīptaṃ jvālābhūtaṃ puṭāntarāt ।। 177।।
ūṣmābhūtaṃ bhavatśīghraṃ vāyudehe viveśa ha ।
vāyuścāpi tadā''dhātuṃ na saṃśakto babhūva ha ।। 178।।
prajajvālodare dehe prādravat tatsthalātsthalam ।
tanmārge cāṃjanī yatra tāpasī saṃsthitā sthale ।। 179।।
pṛthvyāṃ khātaṃ ca ākaṇṭhaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhati sarvadā ।
upari śādvalaṃ śītaṃ bhūtalaṃ yatra dṛśyate ।। 1.184.180 ।।
dṛśyate na ca deho'syā mastakaṃ dṛśyate'kalam ।
vāyustu kesarī bhūtvā prādhāvat cāpalastadā ।। 181 ।।
vāyurdhāvansthale tatra patitaḥ pādasaṃskhalāt ।
śītaṃ ca śādvalaṃ jñātvā hyāśliṣṭo mastakaṃ ca tat ।। 182।।
liṃgaṃ vāyordaivayogādaṃjanyāḥ karṇamāviśat ।
vīryaṃ ca śāṃbhavaṃ vāyusaṃsthaṃ yat tattu sarvathā ।। 183 ।।
skhalitaṃ cāṃjanīkarṇāntare tatkaṇṭhato hyadhaḥ ।
avātarat samagraṃ ca garbhakoṣṭhe gataṃ sthiram ।। 184।।
daivecchayā'bhavattadvai garbhaṃ dadhāra kaisarī ।
aṃjanī ca śarīre sā prajajvāla viśeṣataḥ ।। 185।।
bhūmerbahirvinirgatya saṃsthitā śādvale jale ।
kṣaṇāntare samutpannaḥ putro daivaprabhāvavān ।। 186।।
meṣasūrye caturdaśyāṃ citrānakṣatrayogake ।
suvarṇamukharīnīre prādurāsā'nilātmajaḥ ।। 187।।
vāyutulyo bale śaṃbhusamaścaiśvaryasiddhiṣu ।
kṛṣṇatulyo brahmacarye ṛṣiścārādhane tathā ।। 188।।
ākṛtau vānaratulyastapasvī cāṃjanīsamaḥ ।
rūpe kāmasamo bhaikṣye vasantartusamastathā ।। 189।।
kīśajātisamaḥ sarvauṣadhijñāne viśeṣataḥ ।
tāpasīsadṛśaḥ śānto nirdvandve saṃyamī yathā ।। 1.184.190 ।।
sainye'raṇyasamo mohinīsamaścirajīvane ।
romṇi vasantasadṛśo nakheṣu vanisannibhaḥ ।। 19 1।।
bhrūkuṭau rudrasadṛśastanau himādrisadṛśaḥ ।
rākṣasānāṃ yathākāmaṃ garvabhaṃjanakārakaḥ ।। 192।।।
hṛdaye śādvalasamo dārḍhye pṛthvīsamaḥ sadā ।
rakṣaṇe puṭatulyaśca vīratve vīryasatprabhaḥ ।। 193 ।।
bhūtādijvālane tvagnisadṛśaḥ saṃbabhūva saḥ ।
tatraiva samaye mātā hanuṃ vīkṣya tu lambinīm ।। 194।।
hanumānitināmnaiva samājuhāva taṃ śiśum ।
vavṛdhe tatkṣaṇādeva parvataprāya eva saḥ ।। 195।।
jaharṣa mātā nitarāṃ dṛṣṭvā balaparākrame ।
prātaḥ svamātaraṃ prāha prāṃjaliḥ śiśurūpataḥ ।। 196।।
kṣudhā me bādhate mātardehi jāṭharaśāntikṛt ।
śiśuṃ cāṃke nidhāyaivā'pāyayat stanyameva tam ।। 197।।
tathāpi na kṣudhā śāntā dadarśa phalamambare ।
ravibimbaṃ tadā netumākāśe cauḍuyatprage ।। 198।।
devaprārthanayā taṃ so'tyajat jñātvā raviṃ suram ।
prāpya divyānbhaktimiśrāndattānvarānsurarṣibhiḥ ।। 199।।
svajananyantikaṃ prāgādatha so'ti praharṣitaḥ ।
hanumān sarvamācakhyau tasyai tadvṛttamādarāt ।।1.184.20 0।।
tadājñayā tato dhīraḥ sarvavidyādiśevadheḥ ।
sūryātpapāṭha kīśaḥ saḥ gatvā nityaṃ tadantikam ।।20 1।।
mātre ca prājalirbhūtvā sevārthaṃ prārthayanmuhuḥ ।
mātā prāha tu me vāso vaikuṇṭhe ca yathā bhavet ।।202।।
tathā sevāṃ kuru putra! nā'nyanme rocate'tra vai ।
putraḥ prāha tadā mātarniṣīd skandha eva me ।।20 3।।।
nayāmyanena dehena vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvāṃ tu śāśvatam ।
samāruroha mātā tatskandhaṃ kapirvimānavat ।।204।।
vyomni balātsamuḍḍīya prathamaplavanena saḥ ।
sūryamullaṃghya pāścātyapādenā''pīḍya taṃ ravim । । 2 05।।
dvitīyaplavane dhruvamullaṃghyā''pīḍya taṃ dhruvam ।
tṛtīyaplavane satyaloke brahmasabhāṃ gataḥ ।। 206 ।।
caturthaplavane gaṃgādvāraṃ tvaṇḍakaṭāhakam ।
bhittvā pṛthvīṃ padā''pīḍya vegājjalā'nalā'nantare ।। 207 ।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ dvitīyaṃ dhāma prapede sa mahābalaḥ ।
mātaraṃ tatra rāmasya caraṇe'rpayya bhaktitaḥ । । 208 ।।
prāpya rāmāya namo vai mantraṃ mālāṃ ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
bhūtvā prāpya varān rāmāvatāradāsyabodhakān ।। 209 ।।
samāgacchatpunaḥ pṛthvīṃ padā tatāḍa saḥ śanim ।
janmakāle vakradṛṣṭyā paśyantaṃ duḥkhadaṃ tadā ।। 1.184.210 ।।
śanistatpallatāghātātpapāta pṛthivītale ।
brahmacārī kapiḥ soyaṃ nārīṃ na spṛśatīti saḥ ।। 211 ।।
śanirnārīsvarūpaṃ tu dhṛtvā dudrāva cāmbare ।
tāvaddhanumatā mūrdhnaḥ keśānākṛṣya pātitaḥ । । 212 । ।
prasahya sa śaniḥ svasya vaśe syāditi nityaśaḥ ।
pattale marditaḥ samyak yāvaccandradivākarau ।। 213 ।।
pādayoḥ sa natiṃ kṛtvā prārthayāmāsa vāyujam ।
vimocanāya naijaṃ ca gṛhaṃ saṃgamanāya ca । । 214 ।।
tadā prāha kapīśastaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā dvitīyakam ।
gaccha svagolakaṃ cātra pratijñāya tu sarvathā ।। 215।।
yatrāsti hanumatstotraṃ hanumatpūjanādikam ।
tatra tatra tasya śanidṛṣṭikṛtā pīḍā na saṃbhavet ।। 21 6।।
nārīrūpaṃ sadā te'stu mama pādatalārditam ।
yatrāsti hanumatpādastatrā'kiṃcitkaraḥ śaniḥ ।। 217 । ।
nārīrūpasya śāṭhyasya phalaṃ te'stu ca nigrahaḥ ।
pannatiste nāma kurve sadā'stu mama pattale ।। 218 ।।
gaccha dvitīyarūpeṇa grahastho bhava sūryaja ।
sūryaputraṃ parijñāya na tvā badhnāmi jīvataḥ । । 219 ।।
mama chāyāṃ parityajyā'nyatra parākramī bhava ।
iti kṛtvā pratijñāṃ sa śanaiścaro grahaṃ gataḥ ।। 1.184.220 ।।
'oṃ namo hanumate duḥkhabhaṃjanāya kṣaḥ phaṭ svāhā ।
iti ṣoḍaśavarṇātmamantraṃ jayati nityaśaḥ ।। 221 । ।
na tasya duṣṭagrahajā pīḍā tu jāyate kvacit ।
himālaye yatra janma sa tatra kadalīvane ।। 222 ।।
sarvadā cirajīvī sa hanumān vasati dhruvaḥ ।
rāmadāsyaṃ prakurvansa rāmāgre nivasatyapi ।। 223 ।।
iti te kathitaṃ devi hanumajjanma śaṃkarāt ।
āyuṣyasukhadaṃ pāpanāśakaṃ balabhaktidam ।।224।।।
śrīkṛṣṇamohinījanyaṃ duḥkhaghnaṃ paṭhanācchravāt ।
kīrtanātpāvanakaraṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ।।225।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne himālaye vidhuraśaṃkarasya satīsmaraṇaṃ, vyomavāṇyā golākaṃ gatvā vṛṣabharūpeṇa viharaṇaṃ, satyāḥ himādrau śaṃbhvānayanāya kṛṣṇaprārthanā, mohinīrūpakṛṣṇena saha śaṃbhoḥ satyalokāgamanaṃ, mohinīṃ dṛṣṭvā skhalitasya brahmaṇo vīryāllakṣabrahmasarasaḥ puryo jātāḥ, skhalitasya kāmadevasya tu śṛṃgārakavasantakau jātau, mohinī śaṃkareṇa saha himādrāvāgatya śaṃbhuṃ parirabdhā, śaṃbhudhātoḥ skhalitāt vāyupraviṣṭāt vānararūpavāyunāṃ'janīkarṇapraviṣṭāt hanumadutpattiḥ, saḥ sūryaṃ phalaṃ jñātvā dadhāra, aṃjanīṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ nināya, tatra vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā''gacchan śaniṃ padā
tāḍayan pātayāmāsa pannatinārīrūpaṃ pattale rarakṣa-cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 184 ।।

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
hare himālayaṃ prāpte pārvatyā śaṃbhulabdhaye ।
kṛtaṃ kiṃ śaṃbhunā cāpi kiṃ kṛtaṃ tad vadasva me ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
satī tepe harārthaṃ ca harastepe satīkṛte ।
dvayoryatno'bhavadvegānmahālakṣmi nibodha me ।। 2 ।।
kāँścid gaṇavarānśāntānnandyādīnavagṛhya saḥ ।
gaṃgāvatāramagamat himavatprasthamīśvaraḥ ।। 3 ।।
yatra gaṃgā brahmalokātprathamaṃ patitā girau ।
tapaḥprāraṃbhamakarot sthitvā tatra vaśī haraḥ ।। 4 ।।
ekāgraṃ cintayāmāsa svātmānaṃ brahma yatparam ।
dhyānasthitā gaṇāḥ kecitkecitsevāparāstadā ।। 5 ।।
ke'pi maunaparāścāsan dvārapāḥ kecanā'bhavat ।

jñātvā'nanyaṃ tava dāsaṃ cājñāṃ dehi yadi prabho ।
tvatsevāṃ tu sadā prītyā kuryāṃ dāsyavidhānataḥ ।। 13 ।

kariṣye'haṃ tathā sevāṃ dāsavanniyatasthitaḥ ।। 1.185.20 ।
devendrādadhikaṃ manye svamanugrahabhājanam ।

no'nyo'sti puṇyavānmatto yatpṛṣṭhe tapasi sthitaḥ ।

vāmabhāge sthitaṃ kāmaṃ dadarśā''kṛṣṭabāṇakam ।। 119।।
tāvacchaṃbhormahākrodhaḥ saṃjātastatkṣaṇe priye ।
kāmo'pyuḍḍīya vyomasthaścikṣepā'moghamārgaṇām ।। 1.185.120 ।।
amoghamapi moghaṃ tajjātaṃ kruddhe maheśvare ।
manmatho bhayamāpā''śu cakampe bhayavihvalaḥ ।। 121।।
sasmāra tridaśānsarvān te'pyāyayuśca tuṣṭuvuḥ ।
tathāpi ca mahākrodhānalavyāptānane sati ।। 122।
netratrayaṃ ca bhālaṃ cā'niyamyā'nalapūritam ।
jātaṃ raudraṃ vikarālaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ lalāṭakam ।। 1 23।।
prasahya vahninā netraṃ tṛtīyaṃ jāgrataṃ kṛtam ।
rudrasya raudravapuṣo jagatsaṃhārabhairavāt ।। 124।।
lalāṭamadhyagānnetrāttṛtīyātpūravegataḥ ।
niḥsasāra mahāvahniḥ pralayāgnisamaprabhaḥ ।। 125।।
jajvālordhvaśikho dīpto jvālāpravāharūpakaḥ ।
yaddiśaṃ cekṣate śaṃbhustatrotpatya nipatya ca ।। 126 ।।
bhrāmaṃ bhrāmaṃ yathādṛṣṭi dhāvatyagre mahānalaḥ ।
etasminnantare śaṃbhurdadarśa pārśvagaṃ smaram ।। 1 27।।
maccittavikṛteḥ kartā kāmo'yamiti taṃ prati ।
bhālanetramatisphāraṃ vyasphārayata śaṃkaraḥ ।। 128।।
tadutthavahninā kāmaṃ bhasmasāt kṛtavān haraḥ ।
abhavanmarutāṃ vācaḥ kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāmiti ।। 129 ।।
sa tu taṃ bhasmasāt kṛtvā jagad dagdhuṃ vyajṛmbhata ।
tato bhavo jagaddhetorvyabhajajjātavedasam ।। 1.185.13 0।।
sahakāre madhau candre sumanaḥsvapareṣvapi ।
bhṛṃgeṣu kokilāsyeṣu vibhāgena smarānalam ।। 131 ।।
dagdhe tasmin smare vīre devā duḥkhamupāgatāḥ ।
sasakhī pārvatī mlānā svapiturmandiraṃ yayau ।। 13 2।।
patitā ca ratistatra visaṃjñā'bhūnmṛtaiva sā ।
jātāyāmatha saṃjñāyāṃ sākrośaṃ vilalāpa ha ।। 133 ।।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kiṃ kṛtaṃ daivatairiha ।
matpatiṃ te samāhūya nāśayāmāsurīśvarāt ।। 1 34।।
hā hā nātha smara svāmin prāṇapriya sukhaprada ।
idannu kimabhūdatra hā me bhāgyaṃ vidāritam ।। 135।।
itthaṃ vilāpinī hastau pādau prasārya bhūtale ।
keśānatroṭayat tvāghātayan śaśvat svamastakam ।। 136 ।।
tasyā ākrandanaṃ śrutvā'bhavan sarve suduḥkhitāḥ ।
āgatya suvicāryaiva devā āśvāsanaṃ daduḥ ।। 1 37।।
kiṃcidbhasma gṛhītvā saṃrakṣa yatnāt bhayaṃ tyaja ।
jīvayiṣyati śaṃbhuḥ saḥ prāpsyasi tvaṃ punaḥ patim ।। 1 38।।
atha devāḥ śivamūcuḥ saṃprasādya punaḥ punaḥ ।
kāmenaitatkṛtaṃ tatra na svārthastasya vidyate ।। 139 ।।
tārakapīḍitairdevairakhilaiḥ kāritaṃ tu tat। ।
tvayā kāmapradāhena sastrīkā niṣphalīkṛtāḥ ।। 1.185.140 ।।
kathaṃ jagatpravāho nirvahedevaṃ kṛte sati [
ratimāśvāsaya śarva kuru śokāpanodanam ।। 141।।
ratiścāpi tadā śaṃbhuṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ tataḥ ।
uddhūlyagātraṃ śubhreṇa hṛdyena smarabhasmanā ।। 142।।
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā provāca duḥkhasāgarā ।
namo'stu śaṃbhave nāmnā karmaṇā duḥkhadāya ca ।। 143।।
namaste pārvatīsmartre ratyā vilāpakāriṇe ।
satīmṛgāya namaḥ kādācitkayogine namaḥ ।। 144।।
namo māyādyadhiṣṭhāya māyāhīnāya te namaḥ ।
namo brahmasvarūpāya kṛṣṇarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 145।।
namo vairājarūpāya sadāśivāya te namaḥ ।
namaḥ śivāya rudrāya liṃgarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 146।।
namo jyotiḥsvarūpāya śatarudrāya te namaḥ ।
namaste koṭirudrāya namaḥ kailāsavāsine ।। 147।।
namaste dvisvarūpāya duḥkhavirahiṇe namaḥ ।
satīnāthāya śāntāya yogine te namonamaḥ ।। 148।।
namo vṛṣabharūpāya śarabhāya ca te namaḥ ।
namaḥ kirātarūpāya vivastrāya ca te namaḥ ।। 149।।।
brāhmaṇīṣu bhikṣukāya ratirāmāya te namaḥ ।
anaṃgāya mahāṃgāya jīvanāya ca te namaḥ ।। 1.185.150।।
namaste'stu sakāmāya dhvastakāmāya te namaḥ ।
namaste'stu śaraṇyāya bhakteṣṭadāya te namaḥ ।। 151 ।।
namo'stvasahyakopāya priyā''ptidāya te namaḥ ।
prayaccha kāmadravyaṃ me kathaṃ jīve patiṃ vinā ।। 152।।
iti stutvā punastatra vilāpaṃ tvakarodratiḥ ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha prasanno'smi jīvayiṣyāmi cā'ntare ।। 153 ।।
rate mā khedamāpnuhi sadā manasi cetasi ।
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ kāmo'dṛśyo nityaṃ nivatsyati ।। 154।।
vasa tvaṃ pramadāvarge'naṃgo vasatu puṃjane ।
dvayoryoge yuvatyośca sadāyogo'stu cāntaraḥ ।। 155 ।।
matkopena ca yajjātaṃ tattathā nānyathā bhavet ।
anaṃgastāvadeva syānnānyathā syādratīśituḥ ।। 156 ।।
kṛṣṇastvādyadvāparānte hiraṇyeśo bhaviṣyati ।
sa hiraṇyāṃ pradyumnākhyaṃ kāmaṃ cotpādayiṣyati ।। 157।।
kāmāvatāraṃ pradyamnaṃ śaṃbaro vai hariṣyati ।
saḥ prakṣipya samudre taṃ nagaraṃ svaṃ gamiṣyati ।। 158।।
tāvat tvaṃ śāmbarapure rate! vāsaṃ sukhaṃ kuru ।
tadā tatra saśarīraḥ kāmastvāṃ sammiliṣyati ।। 159।।
kāmaśca śaṃbaraṃ hatvā dravyaṃ nītvā tvayā saha ।
gamiṣyati svakaṃ nityaṃ nagaraṃ satyalokajam ।। 1.185.160।।
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ tatra sukhinau saṃbhaviṣyathaḥ ।
ityuktā śirasā''vandya śaṃkaraṃ kāmavallabhā ।। 161 ।।
jagāmopavanaṃ cānyadratistuhinaparvate ।
ruroda cāpi bahuśo dīnā ramye sthale sthale ।। 1 62।।
evaṃ ratistvaraṇyeṣu vicacāra ciraṃ samāḥ ।
tato gatvā tu nagaraṃ śambarāsurapālitam ।। 163।।
dāsī bhūtvā samuvāsa patijanmehayā sadā ।
pratīkṣamāṇā taṃ kālaṃ rudrādiṣṭaṃ yugātmakam ।। 164।।
atha krodhamayaṃ vahniṃ dagdhukāmaṃ jagattrayam ।
taṃ vāḍavatanuṃ brahmā saumyajvālāmukhaṃ priye ।। 165।।
sāgaraṃ samagāllokahitāyā''dāya vāḍavam ।
prāha kṣārārṇavaṃ brahmā nirdiśāmi gṛhāṇa tat ।। 166 ।।
ayaṃ krodho maheśasya vāḍavaṃ rūpamāśritaḥ ।
jvālāmukhastvayā dhāryo yāvadābhūtasamplavam ।। 167।।
bhojanaṃ toyametasya tava nityaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktaḥ sāgaro vahnimaṃgīcakre tu vāḍavam ।। 1 68।।
tataḥ praviṣṭo jaladhau sa vāḍavatanuḥ śuciḥ ।
vāryaughānsudahaṃstasya jvālāmālātidīpitaḥ ।। 169।।
tatpītamiṣṭasalilā meghā varṣanti bhūtale ।
svāsthyaṃ prāpa jagatsarvaṃ nirmuktaṃ vāḍavādbhayāt ।। 1.185.1 70।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṃgāvatāre śaṃbhostapaḥ, pārvatyāḥ sevā, indrapreṣitakāmakṛtabāṇaprayogaḥ, tṛtīyanetravahninā kāmadāhaḥ, rativilāpaḥ, anaṃgasya pradyumnātmakabhāvisadehasya varadānam, rateḥ śambaragṛhe vāsaḥ, krodhāgnirūpavaḍavānalasya samudre vāsa
ityādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcāśītyadhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 185।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādevo kāmaṃ dagdhvā svamālayam ।
kailāsamagamatpaścātpārvatī khinnamānasā ।। 1 ।।
piturgṛhe tato gatvā militvā mātaraṃ svayam।
punarjātaṃ tadā mene svātmānaṃ vikalā bhṛśam ।। 2 ।।
nininda ca svarūpaṃ sā lebhe śarma na kutracit ।
svāpe pāne krame snāne yāne viharaṇe śivā ।। 3 ।।
gamane ca sakhīmadhye na kiṃcitsukhamāpa vai ।
dhiksvarūpaṃ madīya ca tathā janma ca karma ca ।। 4 ।।
śuśocāti śivā nityaṃ mumoha ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
sukhaṃ na lebhe kiṃcidvā'bravīcchivaśiveti ca ।। 5 ।।
athāpi jātanaiṣphalye mahendreṇa tu nāradaḥ ।
smārito devakāryārthaṃ jagāmendraṃ tadā ca saḥ ।। 6 ।।
preṣayāmāsa śailendraṃ nāradaṃ devarāṭ tadā ।
nāradaścāgataḥ śailaṃ jagrāha pūjanādikam ।। 7 ।।
śuśrāva kāmadahanaṃ pārvatīduḥkhamityapi ।
śrupvovāca tadā kālīṃ nārado duḥkhabhaṃjanaḥ ।। 8 ।।
śṛṇu kāli sevitaḥ saḥ tvayeha tapasā vinā ।
viraktaśca sa te svāmī smaraṃ dagdhvā visṛṣṭavān ।। 9 ।।
tvāmataḥ sutapoyuttā ciramārādhayeśvaram ।
sopi tapati satyarthe dvayoryogo bhaviṣyati ।। 1.186.10 ।।
na siddhyati kriyā kāpi sadgurorhi kṛpāṃ vinā ।
'śivāya nama iti mantraṃ dadāmi japa sarvadā ।। 11 ।।
śravaṇāt mantrarājasya śaṃkaraḥ suprasīdati ।
anenārādhitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 12।।
cintayamānā tadrūpaṃ japa mantraṃ tapaḥ kuru ।
tapasyeva phalaṃ sarvaiḥ prāpyate nānyathā kvacit ।। 13 ।।
evamājñāpya devarṣirnirjagāma sthalāntaram ।
satī sakhyau samādāya jayāṃ ca vijayāṃ tathā ।। 14।।
apracchayat sakhībhyāṃ sā mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tadā ।
himādre! tava putrīyaṃ dehasya ca kulasya ca ।। 15 ।।
tapaḥsādhyaṃ haraṃ prāpya sāphalyaṃ kartumicchati ।
devā''jñā girijā gatvā vanaṃ karotu sattapaḥ ।। 16 ।।
śailaḥ prāha rocate me menāyā rocatāṃ punaḥ ।
gatvā'tha menakāṃ natvocaturdevi! namo'stu te ।। 17।।
śivārthaṃ taptakāmeyaṃ prāptā'nujñā pitustataḥ ।
tvadājñā yadi labhyeta mātaste paripṛcchati ।। 1 8।।
nāṃgīcakāra menā sā kiṃ tvabhūt khinnamānasā ।
tataḥ prāha karau badhvā pārvatī svīyamātaram ।। 19 ।।
durbhagena śarīreṇa ko lābho me patiṃ vinā ।
kathaṃ labhyeta śaṃbhuḥ saḥ sukhado me patiḥ sadā ।। 1.186.20।।
tapobhiḥ prāpyate'bhīṣṭaṃ nā'sādhyaṃ tu tapasyataḥ ।
durbhagatvaṃ vṛthā loko vahate sati sādhane ।। 21 ।।
mātastaptuṃ gamiṣyāmi prātaḥ prāptuṃ maheśvaram ।
anujānīhi māṃ gantuṃ tapase'dya tapovanam ।।22।।
menā prāha śive pūrvatapasā''ptavatī ca kim ।
pratyuta duḥkhitā bhūtvā labdhaṃ janmātra madgṛhe ।।23।।
tapaścara gṛhe'dya tvaṃ na bahirgaccha pārvati! ।
sarve devāśca tīrthāni vasantyasmadgṛhe sadā ।।24।।
kartavyo na haṭhaḥ putri gantavyaṃ na bahiḥ kvacit ।
śarīraṃ komalaṃ te'sti tapastu kaṭhinaṃ mahat ।।25।।
mā gantavyaṃ mama putri strīṇāṃ taducitaṃ nahi ।
iti mātrā niṣiddhā sā umānāmnā'bhavattataḥ ।।26।।
sādhayāmi patiṃ śaṃbhuṃ pātayāmi tu varṣma vā ।
dehyājñāṃ tapase mahyaṃ no cennāstīha pārvatī ।।27।।
ityāgrahaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā nideśaṃ sā dadau tataḥ ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ natvā sakhībhyāṃ saha niryayau ।।28।।।
hitvā bhogyāni sarvāṇi vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ।
dhṛtvā ca valkalānyāśu mauṃjī badhvā ca mekhalām ।।29।।
hitvā hāraṃ tathā carma dhṛtvā mṛgasya śobhanam ।
śailajā prayayau prasthaṃ gaṃgāvataraṇaṃ prati ।।1.186.3 0 ।।
yatra sthitvā purā śaṃbhuḥ satyarthe taptavāँstapaḥ ।
haraśūnyaṃ ca taṃ prasthaṃ vilokya himabhūbhṛtaḥ ।।3 1।।
hā hareti kṣaṇaṃ tatra smṛtvā'bhūt śokasaṃplutā ।
gaurīśikharamevaitat śikharaṃ khyātimāptavat ।।32।।
puṇyaṃ gaṃgāvataraṇaṃ nānādhātuvibhūṣitam ।
divyapuṣpalatāvyāptaṃ dvirephasvanitadrumam ।।33।।।
śītanirjharaṇaṃ divyaṃ paśupakṣisamāśritam ।
jalajasthalajābjaistat praphullitaiḥ sugandhitam ।।34।।
gabhīrakandarāgarbhaṃ divyavāsā''layānvitam ।
kalpadrumalatāvallītṛṇaśākhiharitprabham ।। 35।।
sarvartupuṣpakalikāphalakiṃjalkasamṛddham ।
niyamāyā'bhavat tatra dīkṣitā pārvatī satī ।।36।।
tayā śreṣṭhā drumāstatrā''ropitā vardhitā jalaiḥ ।
bhuvaṃ saṃskṛtya vedīṃ ca svayaṃ nirmāya pārvatī ।।37।।
triḥsnātā prārabhat śuṣkapatrāhārā mahattapaḥ ।
nigṛhya manasā sarvāṇīndriyāṇi sahā''ntare ।।।38।।
saṃsthitā vṛttimākṛṣya svātmanyeva śivātmani ।
grīṣme ca parito vahniṃ prajvalantaṃ divāniśam ।।39।।
kṛtvā tasthau ca tanmadhye paṃcāgnimatapattapaḥ ।
paṃcākṣaraṃ sadā mantraṃ japamānā'ntare haram ।।1.186.40 ।।
varṣāsu vṛṣṭidhārāyāṃ śilāsu susthirāsanā ।
śīte śaśvajjalamadhye tasthau śivāgnitatparā ।।41।।
jhaṃjhāvātātitāpeṣu nīhāreṣu niśāsu ca ।
dadhyau tapaḥ prakurvāṇā śivaṃ bhāvipatiṃ hṛdi ।।42।
prathamaṃ phalabhogena dvitīyaṃ parṇabhojanaiḥ ।
tṛtīyaṃ caikaparṇena sahasraṃ yāpitaṃ tayā ।।।43।।।
tataḥ parṇānyapi tyaktvā aparṇā tapasi sthitā ।
ekapādasthitā vāyvāhārā saṃsmṛtya śaṃkaram ।।44।।
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi jagmuḥ kālyāstapovane ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi yatra tepe tapo haraḥ ।।45।।
duḥkhaṃ ca trividhaṃ satyā gaṇitaṃ nā'gataṃ gatam ।
harasthale kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā cintayāmāsa sā satī ।।46।।
niyamasthā mahādeva ki māṃ jānāsi nā'ghunā ।
yadi sarvasvānuraktā tarhi prasīda me pate! ।।47।।
yadi bhaktyā kṛto mantrastarhi prasīda me pate ।
yadi tavā'smi jānāsi tarhi prasīda me pate ।।48।।
yadi grāhyāsmi te nātha tarhi prasīd me pate ।
pratyahaṃ ceti saṃprārthya tiṣṭhati tapase satī ।।49।।
pārvatītapasastatra prabhāveṇa nisargajāḥ ।
virodhinaḥ prāṇino'pi nā'bādhanta parasparam ।।1.186.50।।
vṛkṣāśca sakalāstatra tṛṇāni śādvalāni ca ।
puṣpāṇi ca vicitrāṇi patrāṇi komalāni ca ।।51।।
sadā'jāyanta ityevaṃ vanaṃ kailāsasannibham ।
jātaṃ tasyāstapoyogāt siddhirūpaṃ sadā'bhavat ।।।52।।
evaṃ tapantyāṃ pārvatyāṃ varṣapaṃcasahasrakam ।
vyatīyāya tadā śailaḥ samāgatya jagāda tām ।।53।।
yena bhasmīkṛtaḥ kāmo vihāya tvāṃ susevikām ।
gataḥ kruddho haraḥ putri nāgamiṣyati nirguṇaḥ ।।।54।।
vṛthā mohaṃ gatā putri tvāṃ na prārthayati prabhuḥ ।
tasmāduttiṣṭha caihi tvaṃ svagṛhaṃ pārvati drutam ।।।55।।
evameva kathitā sā menayā meruṇā tathā ।
sahyena mandareṇāpi mainākakrauṃcabhūdharaiḥ ।।56 ।।
bhrātṛbhiḥ svasṛbhiścānyaistathāpi nā'tyajattapaḥ ।
sādhayāmi haraṃ yadvā pātayāmi nijaṃ vapuḥ ।।57।।
ekā'styeva pratijñā me kathaṃ nāyāsyati prabhuḥ ।
bhadraṃ tena smaro dagdhastyaktvā māṃ nirguṇo gataḥ ।।58।।
yadi bhaktāsmi tasyāhaṃ samāneṣye tapobalāt ।
sarve bhavantī+o gacchantu nāhaṃ cāyāmi tadgṛham ।।59 ।।
nītvaiva svāminaṃ śaṃbhumāgamiṣyāmi tadgṛham ।
ityuktvā girijā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva priyabhāṣiṇī ।।1.186.6 0 ।।
jñātvā dārḍhyaṃ mahāsatyā jagmuḥ sarve nijālayān ।
śaṃśamānāḥ saṃdadānā āśīrvādānsuvismitāḥ ।।।6 1 ।।
satī sakhībhiḥ sahitā ghoraṃ tapaścakāra sā ।
tena taptamabhūtsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ।। 62।।
tadā surā'surāḥ siddhā yakṣakinnaracāraṇāḥ ।
guhyakā munayaḥ sādhyā vidyādharamahoragāḥ ।।6 3 ।।
asurā mānavāḥ prajāpatayo lokapāstathā ।
auṣṇyaṃ kaṣṭatamaṃ prāptāḥ kāraṇaṃ na viduśca te ।।64।।
tato gatvā vedhasaṃ papracchustāpasya kāraṇam ।
brahmāpi pārvatītapojanyaṃ vijñāya tāpanam ।। 65।।
haraye tatkathayituṃ yayau devagaṇānvitaḥ ।
kṣīrābdhau vilasantaṃ taṃ susaṃstūya praṇamya ca ।। 66।।।
provāca prāṃjalistrāhi trāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān ।
satītāpena taptāḥ sma kuru śāntiṃ jagadguro ।। 67।।
śrutvā prāha hariḥ sarvān gacchāmaḥ śaṃkaraṃ prati ।
prārthayāmaḥ satīpāṇigrahaṇāya tataḥ sukham ।।68 ।।
iti saṃhatya devādyā jagmurdraṣṭuṃ satītapaḥ ।
praṇemustāṃ jagaddhātrīṃ tato jagmurharaṃ prati ।। 6 9।।
dadṛśuḥ sukhamāsīnaṃ prasannaṃ bhaktavatsalam ।
yogapaṭṭasthitaṃ natvā tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ ca te ।। 1.186.70 ।।
namo'stu tāpanāśāya śāntidāya namonamaḥ ।
pārvatītapasāṃ samyak phaladātre namonamaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
yadi tvaṃ rāgahīnaḥ sanpārvatīṃ na grahīṣyasi ।
tarhi sā tapasā sarvaṃ dhakṣyatyetaccarācaram ।।।72।
kiṃca pāṇigrahe tasyā devakāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
tasmāttasyai vaco datvā taporodhaṃ kuru drutam ।।73 ।
śrutvā prāha ca tān śaṃbhuḥ mahatkāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ।
kāmo dagdhaśca niṣkāmāstiṣṭhantu brahmacāriṇaḥ ।।74।
paramānandasaṃyuktā nirvikārā bhavantu vai ।
satīgrahe satī kāmaṃ jīvayiṣyati sā punaḥ ।।75।
kāmātsyuḥ krodhasammohasmṛtibhraṃśādayastathā ।
duḥkhadāstāpadāḥ sarve tāँstyajantu sadā surāḥ ।।76 ।।
mahānigaḍasaṃjñāsti nārī yadi vivāhitā ।
kusaṃgā bahavaḥ santi strīsaṃgo'sti tato'dhikaḥ ।।77।।
mucyate sakalairbandhairna strībandhātpramucyate ।
strīyogātkāmanābhāvā vardhante yogino'pi vai ।।78।।
yadīcchedbrahmanirvāṇaṃ strīpāśaṃ dūratastyajet ।
puruṣasya kṛte nārī sitāliptendravāruṇī ।।79।।
nāryāḥ kṛte pumāँścāpi sitāliptendravāruṇam ।
parasparaṃ viṣaṃ bodhyaṃ tathāpi bhavatāṃ vacaḥ ।।1.186.80।।
pālayiṣyāmi devānāṃ vipattiharaṇāya tat ।
yūyaṃ svasvālayaṃ yāta nirbhayāstiṣṭhatā'niśam ।।8 1 ।।
gamiṣyāmi satītapaḥpraśāntyarthaṃ hitāya ca ।
śrutvā natvā surāḥ sarve yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ tadā ।।।82।।
vaśiṣṭhādīnmunīnsapta tataḥ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ ।
prasannavadanāḥ sapta munayaḥ śīghramāyayuḥ ।।8 3।।
natvā hyupāviśana sarve satkṛtāḥ śaṃbhunā bahu ।
uktāśca pārśvato tapaścaratyakhaṇḍamānasā ।।84।।
sarvān kāmān vihāyaiva māṃ patiṃ prāptulālasā ।
tatra gacchata kuruta premadārḍhyaparīkṣaṇam ।।85 ।।
ityājñaptā yayuḥ sarve yatra tapati sā satī ।
natvā śailasutāṃ prāhuḥ kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ ।।86।।
vada devi yatheṣṭaṃ te kariṣyāmo yathātatham ।
satī natvā ṛṣīn proce nāradoktavidhānataḥ ।।87।।
rudro me syātpatiśceti nirṇīya tapasi sthitā ।
tadāśāṃ śaṃkarasvāmī pipartu bhaktavatsalaḥ ।।88।।
śrutvā vihasya ṛṣayaḥ procuḥ chalavaco mṛṣā ।
kalipriyaḥ kleśakartā viśvasto nāradaḥ katham ।।89।।
sarvathā kūṭabhāvī saḥ kleśe jananiyojakaḥ ।
jānāsi dakṣaputrāँstu tena te parivrājitāḥ ।।1.186.90 ।।
jānāsi citraketuṃ sa rājyamatyājayatkhalaḥ ।
vetsi hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prahlādaṃ sa vyabhedayat ।।9 1 ।।
nāradasya khalavidyā yatkarṇe patitā manāk ।
sa svagehaṃ vihāyā''śu duḥkhī bhavati tvaṃ yathā ।।92।।
nārado malinātmā'sti bahirujjvaladehavān ।
jānīmastaṃ viśeṣeṇa vayaṃ tatsahavāsinaḥ ।।93।।
bakaṃ sādhuṃ varṇayanti na matsyānatti sarvathā ।
sahavāsī vijānīyāccaritraṃ sahavāsinaḥ ।।94।।
api tvaṃ tasya vāṇyāṃ vai viśvasya tapasi sthitā ।
vaṃcitā'si mahādevi! yāhi gehaṃ tapastyaja ।। 95।।
yadarthaṃ duḥkhamāpnoṣi sa tu tvayi virāgavān ।
sadodāsī ca nirllajjo'maṃgalo'sadano'kulī ।।96।।
bhūtapretapiśācābhijano nagnaḥ kuveṣadhṛk ।
tena śūlabhṛtā dhūrtamūrdhanyenā'si vaṃcitā ।।97।।
varaṃ datvā gataḥ pañcavarṣasahasrake punaḥ ।
nāyāti kīdṛśaḥ snehī tavakevalavaṃcakaḥ ।।98।।
vicāraṃ kuru deveśi prathamaṃ dakṣajāṃ satīm ।
vivāhya pālanaṃ naiva kṛtavān kiṃ kariṣyati ।।99।।
sa evāsti tathā krodhī nirvāhaṃ na kariṣyati ।
tvāmeva tu punardoṣaṃ datvā tyakṣyati vaṃcakaḥ ।। 1.186.10 0।।
yasya hṛdi kṛpā nāsti kumārīṃ nahi paśyati ।
sukhadaṃ dagdhavān kāmaṃ kathaṃ tena jīviṣyasi ।। 101 ।।
asmadvākyaṃ tu sammānya gṛhaṃ yāhi kumārike ।
avyavasthitacittasya prasādehā khapuṣpavat ।।1 02।।
tvādṛśī sundarī viṣṇugṛhe śobheta sarvathā ।
tvayi sarve guṇāḥ santi viṣṇau santi mahāguṇāḥ ।। 10 3।।
gṛhaṃ tasya mahat smṛddhaṃ divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।
dāsadāsīkoṭijuṣṭaṃ vimānodyānaśobhitam ।। 1 04।।
taṃ laśmīśaṃ rameśaṃ vā rādheśaṃ bhaja sundari ।
tena te kārayiṣyāmo vivāhaṃ tyaja śaṃkaram ।। 1 05।।
varṣe caturdaśe kanyāvivāho yogya ucyate ।
tvayā tatra yogyakāle kṛtā sevā tathā'rthitaḥ ।। 1 06।।
tathāpi svaratāyāste pāṇiṃ jagrāha naiva saḥ ।
paṃcavarṣasahasrāṇi vyatītāni taduttaram ।। 107।।
tathāpi naiva gṛhṇāti sa mūrkhastvaṃ tato'dhikā ।
tasmāt haṭhaṃ parityajya sukhitā viṣṇunā bhava ।। 1 08।।
na syāt tṛptistṛṣitānāṃ marumarīcikājalāt ।
dvividhaṃ tu sukhaṃ putri loke bhavati dehinām ।। 109।।
dehasya dehasaṃyogaścetasi nirvṛtiḥ parā ।
dehaṃ yathā kumāryā vai komalaṃ surūpaṃ śubham ।। 1.186.110 ।।
tathā dehaḥ kumārasya bhavet cet dehajaṃ sukham ।
syādeva patipatnyośca nā'nyathā dehajaṃ sukham ।। 111 ।।
prakṛtyā sa tu digvāsā bhīmo bhastrāsthibhūṣaṇaḥ ।
kapālī bhikṣuko nagno virūpākṣo'sthirakriyaḥ ।। 11 2।।
pramattonmattatākāro bībhatsakṛtasagrahaḥ ।
mūrtimān sā'yamanartho bhūtāvalisabhājitaḥ ।। 11 3।।
sravannaravasā'sthidhṛk sarpaphutkārabhīṣaṇaḥ ।
śmaśānasthaḥ śvapacavat kathamiṣṭaḥ sute tava ।। 1 14।।
harirasti jagaddhātā yajñabhuk pākaśāsanaḥ ।
devodhidevo jvalāno vāyuḥ prāṇaśca dehinām ।। 1 15।।
kuberaścandramāḥ sūryo varuṇaścāpare surāḥ ।
kāmabhujaḥ kāmarūpāḥ kāmasmṛddhaya eva te ।। 1 16।।।
ebhya ekatamaṃ kasmāttvaṃ na saṃprāptumicchasi ।
śivasya prāptaye kleśaḥ sa cāpi niṣphalastaruḥ ।। 1 17।।
tasmādāgaccha putri tvaṃ gṛhe sthitvā sukhī bhava ।
anyaṃ varaya kalyāṇi kṛtaṃ kvāpi phaliṣyati ।। 1 18।।
ityādi vistaraṃ śrutvā vihasyovāca pārvatī ।
yathājñānaṃ bhavaduktaṃ manye yadyapi yuktimat ।। 1 19।।
nirbalāyā aśraddhāyā adṛḍhāyāḥ kṛte hi tat ।।
ahaṃ jātyā śailaputrī kaṭhinā sabalā dṛḍhā ।। 1.186.120।।
sthirā'pradhṛṣyā haṭhinī miledvā na milet haraḥ ।
na tyajāmi tapaḥ saumyaṃ yadasmākaṃ nisargajam ।। 121।।
miliṣyati variṣye taṃ nocet sthāsye nirīndhanā ।
dukhaṃ tapo vanaṃ raukṣyaṃ śailajāternisargajam ।। 1 22।।
yatheṣṭaṃ taddhi me sarvaṃ māṃ niṣeddhuṃ na cārhatha ।
nāradasya vacaḥ pathyaṃ jātyanukūlameva me ।। 123।।।
sampatsyate dhruvaṃ śailavāsinī vanavāsinā ।
gurūṇāṃ vacane niṣṭhā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ jayaḥ sadā ।। 124।।
aniṣṭhānāmihā'mutra duḥkhameva na śaṃ kvacit ।
vittha kasya tanurvyoma kasyā'gniḥ kasya mārutaḥ ।। 125।।
kasyendraḥ kasya varuṇaḥ kasya netre'rkacandrakau ।
yathonmādādiduṣṭānāṃ matireva hi sā bhavet ।। 126।।
iṣṭāneva padārthānvai viparītān hi manvate ।
viparītān yathā svalpān kṣudrān śreṣṭhāँstu manvate ।। 1 27।।
gṛhe vasāmi śūnye vā nopayāmi tadanyakam ।
guṇālayo vihārī susmṛddho viṣṇuḥ sadāsti yat ।। 12 8।।
sa laukikīṃ prabhutāṃ vai sandarśayati mānavān ।
śaṃbhustu nirguṇo nirvikāro mānādivarjitaḥ ।। 1 29।।
avadhūtaḥ paro haṃsaḥ parānandaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।
bhūṣaṇādirucirmāyāliptānāṃ brahmaṇo na ca ।। 1.186.13 0।।
cet śivaḥ sa hi me viprā vivāhaṃ na kariṣyati ।
avivāhā'vadhūtāni sadā'haṃ syāṃ śivāṇyapi ।। 131 ।।
nā'haṃ tṛṣṇāvatī kāme na kāmārthaṃ tapāmyaham ।
yūyaṃ yadarthaṃ tapatha tadarthaṃ tu tapāmyaham ।। 1 32।।
yadi me sa karaṃ śarvo grahīṣyati sukhaṃ dvayam ।
na grahīṣyati cetpāṇiṃ sukhaṃ sādhvyāstatodhikam ।। 133 ।।
idānīṃ sādhyate śubhraṃ sādhayiṣye'dhikaṃ tataḥ ।
miledvā na miledatra mokṣe'vaśyaṃ miliṣyati ।। 1 34।।
yat karomi vicāryaiva na hānirlābha eva vā ।
kasmādanyaṃ patiṃ kāṃkṣye nāsti kāme spṛhā hi me ।। 1 35।।
yāce kṣamāṃ tvadhikoktergṛhṇantu satkriyāṃ mama ।
yojayantu śubhāśīrbhirhaṃsā haṃsaṃ miled yathā ।। 1 36।।
bhavatāmāśīrvacanairmārkaṇḍeyaściraṃbhavaḥ ।
bhavatkṛpayā śvapaco jātā'rundhatī carṣiṇī ।। 137।।
bhavatāṃ kṛpayā viśvāmitro brahmarṣitāṃ gataḥ ।
tathā yuṣmatkṛpāleśācchailī śarvāṇikā bhavet ।। 138।।
ityuktvā tān praṇamyātha prapūjya divyavastubhiḥ ।
virarāma śivaṃ smṛtvā'napāyiśaivadharmiṇī ।। 1 39।।
ṛṣayo'pi śubhaṃ bhūyādastu pūrṇo manorathaḥ ।
tapaḥphalaṃ drutaṃ bhūyādbhūyācchaṃbhusamāgamaḥ ।। 1.186.140 ।।
vivāhastvarito bhūyādbhūyādasmatprapūjanam ।
janavāhā vayaṃ syāmo bhūyātsarvaṃ sumaṃgalam ।। 141 ।।
ityāśīrbhiḥ śivāṃ samyak vardhayitvā yayurharam ।
prasannā devakāryārthaṃ sadāśāḥ samparīkṣakāḥ ।। 142।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyāḥ śoko nāradopadeśastaponiṣedhastathāpi gaurīśṛṃge paṃcasahasravarṣāṇi tapaḥ, śailarṣibhirniṣiddhe'pi tapasi sthitā gaurī saptarṣibhiḥ parīkṣitā''śīrbhiryojitā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 186 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 186 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 187
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 188 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ṛṣayaḥ prāhuravyagrā deveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ priye ।
pārvatī śaṃkarārthaṃ vai prāṇaglahaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 1 ।।
nirbhīkā ca nirālambā nirāśā niṣparigrahā ।
nirguṇā ca nirīhā ca tapatyābhūtasaṃplavam ।। 2 ।।
miledvā na milecchaṃbhustapaḥ śailanisargajam ।
milet syādubhayaṃ saukhyaṃ na milenmokṣajaṃ tataḥ ।। 3 ।।
sukhaṃ bhavatyadhikaṃ vai tapo nāsti nirarthakam ।
sādhayāmi śivaṃ yadvā pātayāmi śarīrakam ।। 4 ।।
śaṃbhumudvāhayiṣye vā sthāsye kumārikā sadā ।
neṣye ca brahmacaryātvaṃ grahīṣyāmi pravrajyikām ।। 5 ।।
mariṣyāmi naiṣṭhikatve yāsyāmi brahmaśaṃkaram ।
iti vai nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ karoti sā satī ।। 6 ।
athā'tra yadvidheyaṃ syātkartavyamīśvareṇa vai।
iti nivedya vṛttāntaṃ prāpyā''jñāṃ svagṛhaṃ yayuḥ ।। 7 ।।
śaṃkarastu tapo devyā aicchan parīkṣituṃ tadā ।
parīkṣākāmuko rūpaṃ dhṛtvā jāṭilamuttamam ।। 8 ।।
sthaviro vipracihnāḍhyo daṇḍacchatrānvito dvijaḥ ।
bhūtvā yayau tu tacchṛṃgaṃ prajvalaँstejasā'bhitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
mṛgājīnadharaṃ muñjamekhalaṃ sakamaṇḍalum ।
sopavītaṃ mahāvṛddhaṃ sajaraṃ bhasmavigraham ।। 1.187.10 ।।
pratyāśramaṃ paryaṭantaṃ kālyāśramamupāgatam ।
dṛṣṭvā''yāntaṃ bhikṣukaṃ sā samutthāya nanāma ca ।। 11 ।।
upakaṇṭhaṃ yayau prītyā pādayorapatat satī ।
apūjayattathā sarvātīthyasatkāravastubhiḥ ।। 12 ।।
brahmacārisvarūpaṃ taṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ satī ।
kasmādāgamyate vipra kutra sthāne tavā''śramaḥ ।। 13 ।।
kāṃ diśaṃ parigantā'si viśrāmaṃ kuru cātra vai ।
bhikṣuruvāca tīrthebhya āgacchāmyatra tāpasi ।। 14।।
vārāṇasyāṃ nivāso me yāsye pṛthūdakasthalam ।
mayā snāta prayāge ca kubjāmre caṇḍikeśvare ।। 15।।
banghuvṛnde kurukṣetre haridvāre kanakkhale ।
kedāre badarīkuṇḍe tato'bhyāgāṃ tavāśramam ।। 16 ।।
atra tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyāmi pṛthūdakam ।
ahamicchābhigāmī ca tapasvyanyasukhapradaḥ ।। 17।।
niṣkāyayātrākuśalastapasviduḥkhabhaṃjanaḥ ।
nirdvandvo'smi mumukṣuśca devānāṃ pūjako'smi ca ।। 18।।
vṛddho'haṃ tapasā''tmānaṃ śoṣayāmi yathocitam ।
pṛcchāmi yadahaṃ tvāṃ vai tatra me vaktumarhasi ।। 19 ।।
kimarthaṃ bhavatī raudraṃ prathamāśramasaṃsthitā ।
tapaḥ karoṣi kalyāṇi duḥkhānubhavakāriṇi ।। 1.187.20 ।।
kā tvaṃ kasyā'si tanayā kimarthaṃ vijane vane ।
tapaścarasi durdharṣaṃ munibhiścāpi duṣkaram ।। 21 ।।
na bālā na ca vṛddhā'si taruṇī bhāsi śobhanā ।
prauḍhā patiṃ vinā kasmāt tīkṣṇaṃ karoṣi vai tapaḥ ।। 22।।
madhyame vayasi strīṇāṃ saha bhartrā vilāsitā ।
subhogā''yojitāḥ kālā vrajanti sthirayauvane ।।23 ।।
kiṃ tvaṃ tapasvino bhadrā kasyacitsahacāriṇī ।
tapasvī sa na puṣṇāti devi! tvāṃ sa gato'nyataḥ ।। 24।।
vada kasya kule jātā kaḥ pitā tava kā vidhā ।
mahāsaubhāgyapātraṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ te'sti taporatiḥ ।। 25 ।।
kiṃ tvaṃ vedaprasūrlakṣmīḥ kiṃ ramā kiṃ sarasvatī ।
manye rūpajanaiśvaryasmṛddhimatī bhavatyapi ।।26।।
tatkimarthamapāsyaitānalaṃkārān jaṭā dhṛtāḥ ।

kasya kimarthe kā ceti yogyo'smi vinivedaya ।

śaṃkarārthaṃ tapaḥ kurve patiṃ vindāmi śaṃkaram ।
purā dakṣasutā yogamayī tvāsaṃ satī tataḥ ।।29।।
dagdhadehā śailaputrī jātā'smyadya kumārikā ।
tapasyataścātra śaṃbhoḥ sevāyāṃ saṃsthitā'bhavam ।।1.187.3 0 ।।
māṃ tyaktvā bhasmasātkṛtvā manmathaṃ sa jagāma ha ।
ahaṃ tu tapase cā'trā''yātā'pyaprāpya śaṃkaram ।।3 1।।
tapo'nte'gnau vivikṣantī tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃsthitā kṣaṇam ।
gaccha tvaṃ praviśāmyagnau janmāntare śivārthinī ।।32।।
ityuktvā pārvatī vahnau tatpuraḥ praviveśa hi ।
babhūva tatkṣaṇe vahniḥ śītaścandanapaṃkavat ।। 33।।
atha kṣaṇāntare vahnerutthāya vyomavartmanā ।

aho tavātitapasaḥ pratāpo vartate mahān ।

kamicchasi varaṃ subhru mā gopyaṃ vai manāgapi ।।36।।
tvayi sarvaṃ tu sāmarthyaṃ cā'sti kiṃ tapasā tava ।

īdṛśaṃ rūpasaundaryaṃ kathaṃ vyarthaṃ prayāpitam ।

gṛhaṃ tyaktvā vanaṃ labdhaṃ vāsāya duḥkhadaṃ sadā ।

śrutvaitadvijayāṃ vaktuṃ sakhīṃ prairayatā'mbikā ।
vijayā''ha vṛddhavipra! suteyaṃ himabhūbhṛtaḥ ।।1.187.40 ।।
nāmnāsti pārvatī kālī varaṃ śaṃkaramicchati ।
ūḍheyaṃ na ca kenāpi kumāryevāsti me sakhī ।।41 ।।
pañcavarṣasahasrāṇi tapasyasyā gatāni vai ।

sarvadā susthiraṃ cāsti na jarā palitāni na ।

śaṃkarārhaṇayogyāste kṛtāḥ santi hṛdā sadā ।
sarvaṃ samarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā sadā tapasi tiṣṭhati ।। 46 ।।

iti mayā ca te khyātaṃ pārvatyā mānasaṃ vṛtam ।।47।।
jaṭilo'pi hasan prāha sakhyukte viśvasīmi na ।
yathārthaṃ cet navai hāsaḥ svamukhenābhibhāṣatām ।।48 ।।
pārvatī manasi jñātvā śaṃbhusambandhinaṃ janam ।
prasannamānasā'vocat sakhyuktaṃ tattathaiva yat ।।49। ।
manasā vacasā kṛtyā vṛto vai śaṃkaro mayā ।
jānāmi durlabhaṃ śaṃbhuṃ matvā sulabhameva tam ।।1.187.50 ।।
karomi tapa ājanma viśvāso'pi tathāsti me ।
bāhyato na miledvāpi hyāntare milito'sti saḥ ।।5 1 ।।

jānāmyahaṃ kṛpāleśaḥ prerito'sti dayālunā ।।54।।
brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīd-vipro vaktīti tanmukham ।
vaktītyevahi jānāmi gūḍho'sti śaṃkarastvayi ।।55 ।।
tasmai cārpyaḥ praṇāmo me saṃyujya tatpade śiraḥ ।
yathā'haṃ te caraṇayoḥ saṃyujya mastakaṃ natā ।।16।।
vipraḥ prāha ca tacchrutvā śṛṇu kanye harapriye ।
yogyaṃ subhrū yathāyogyaṃ sarvaṃ vadasi suvrate ।।57 ।।
jānāmyahaṃ mahādevaṃ sāvadhānatayā śṛṇu ।
kvacinnagnaḥ kvacidvyāghragajacarmadharo haraḥ ।।58 ।।
vṛṣadhvajo bhasmadigdho jaṭājūthavirūpakaḥ ।
kapālāsthikarakaṇṭhaḥ sapairgātreṣu veṣṭitaḥ ।।।5 9।।

sūryatejaḥ parityajya khadyotadyutimicchasi ।

lokapālān vihāyaiva bhūtapālaṃ kiṃmicchasi ।।67।।

śaśāṃkavadanā kā tvaṃ kvā'sau paṃcā'nalānanaḥ ।
śiroveṇīmatī kā tvaṃ kva jaṭājūṭamastakaḥ ।।69।।
kva tvaṃ candanayogyāṃgā kva citābhasmalepanaḥ ।
kva mṛdusnigdhasadvastrā kva vyāghragajavastrakaḥ ।।1.187.7 0 ।।
svarṇabhūṣaṇayogyā kva kva krūrasarpaśekharaḥ ।
kva ṛṣyannapriyā devī kva bhūtabalisupriyaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
kva tantrīmiṣṭavādaśca kva taḍḍamaruḍḍuhḍḍaṃhaḥ ।
kva te kaṇṭhasya mādhuryaṃ kva vṛṣabhasvaraḥ kharaḥ ।।72।।
kva te sthalābjamṛdutā kvā'sya rūkṣakharaspṛśiḥ ।
nā'sya dravyaṃ manāgasti prāpyate nāpi cāmbaram ।।73।।
nāsya smṛddhirmanāgasti balīvardoragau vinā ।

nā'sya saumyā janāḥ santi bhairavavīrakān vinā ।

nā'sya cauṣṭhe premaraso vinā saṃhāraniṣṭhurām ।।77।।
nā'sya pārśvaṃ komalāṃgaṃ kāṣṭhapāvaṭikāṃ vinā ।
nā'sya bimbaṃ suvarṇābhaṃ kṛṣṇabhasmādikaṃ vinā .।।78 ।।
nāsya guptaṃ bhavedvā na kartitaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ purā ।
pumānvā'yaṃ tṛtīyaḥ syāt strīrūpo bhāti naiva ca ।।79।।
tasya nāsti prasannā strīḥ tṛtīyaprakṛtirbhavet ।
tṛtīyaprakṛtiguptyai kāmo'nena hi bhasmitaḥ ।।1.187.80 ।।
anādarastadā te vai kṛto hitvā'nyato gataḥ ।
tasyodare mahāṇḍāni bhavanti kākapakṣivat ।।8 1 ।।
tasyā'ṇḍavṛddhi rogo'sti jñātaṃ nāsti tvayā tu tat ।
mahārātrāvapi māyāṃ svapituṃ na dadāti saḥ ।।8 2।।।
patnīto'pi viśeṣeṇa bhuṃkte duḥkhākaroti saḥ ।

sati! tyajā'sya nāmā'pi śivo'pitvaśivaḥ sadā ।
jātirnāsti kulaṃ nāsti mātā nāsti kutaḥ pitā ।।84।।
jñānaṃ saujanyamāstikyaṃ nāsti kiṃciddhi śaṃkare ।
śarīre dṛśyate rakṣā kaṇṭhe sandṛśyate viṣam ।।85।।
āntare dṛśyate krodho rāgaleśo'pi nāsti vai ।

kva hārayogyaṃ vakṣaste kva tasya muṇḍaghaṭṭitam ।
kvāṃ'garāgaśca saundaryaṃ kva rakṣādhūlikā'ñcitam ।।87।।

manye kenā'bhicāreṇa mantreṇaiva vibhrāmitam ।

gaccha gacchasi ced vipra kutaḥ pādo'tra te'spṛśat ।। 91 ।।
nindakasyā'pavitrasya pādo'pi puṇyanāśakaḥ ।

nā'laṃkṛto'laṃkṛto vā yādṛśastādṛśaśca vā ।

durguṇo nirguṇo vāpi saguṇo viguṇo'pi vā ।।94।।

bahuvāramahaṃ jātā adhavā sadhavāpi ca ।। 10 1।।

kā cintā te mamā'saukhye gaccha vipra yathāsukham ।। 1 02।।
na te lābho mama saukhye duḥkhe naiva ca bhāgavān ।
vṛthā nindasi śaṃbhuṃ māṃ tapaścā''śīviṣo bhavan ।। 103।
etāvaddhi mayā jñāto bhavān yātrālurāgatāḥ ।
tāpaso hitakartā ca na jñāto viparītakṛt ।। 104।।

sadvitīyasya jātiḥ syānaikasmin jātirasti vai ।। 107।।
vyakterabhedo jātitve sarvathā bādhako'sti hi ।

yāsyāvaste pituḥ saudhaṃ vivāhavidhilabdhaye ।। 13 9।।
ityādṛtā satī śīghraṃ harāṃke niṣasāda sā ।
patyarpitā pramuditā tapaḥkaṣṭaṃ jahau satī ।। 1.187.140।।
phale labdhe śramaḥ pūrvo naśyatyatipurātanaḥ ।
pratyuvāca mahāsādhvī harāṃkasukhasāgarā ।। 141 ।।
atīva sukhitā cātiprītyutphullānanā śivā ।
sukhātipulakitāṃgā navā''nandapariplutā ।। 142।।
tvaṃ nātho mama deveśa tvayā kiṃ vismṛtaṃ purā ।
gārhasthyaduḥkhamāptena kiṃ vairāgyaṃ dhṛtaṃ tvayā ।। 143।।
dakṣayajñavināśaṃ vā vicārya ca satīhaṭham ।
gārhasthyaṃ duḥkhadaṃ matvā kiṃ vairāgyaṃ dhṛtaṃ tvayā ।। 144।।
nārīgrahe nāryadhīnaṃ narasya yāti jīvanam ।
parādhīnāmitijñātvā kiṃ vairāgyaṃ dhṛtaṃ tvayā ।। 145।।
nārīyogād brahmayogaḥ khaṇḍito jāyate yateḥ ।
tenā'mokṣa iti matvā kiṃ vairāgyaṃ dhṛtaṃ tvayā । । 146।।
nāryā'patyādivistāro jāyate gṛhamedhinaḥ ।
kaṣṭaṃ tatpoṣaṇaṃ matvā kiṃ vairāgyaṃ dhṛtaṃ tvayā ।। 147।।
patnīyogena sambandho laukiko vardhate sadā ।
jhaṃjhāvātaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā kiṃ vairāgyaṃ dhṛtaṃ tvayā ।। 148।।
dhyānakāle praśāntau ca nidrāyāṃ cātmacintane ।
nārī vighnamiti jñātvā na smṛtā'haṃ tvayā nu kim ।। 149।।
na jāne brahmarūpasya lakṣakālaḥ kṣaṇāyate ।
jānāmi svārthacittāyāḥ kṣaṇakālo yugāyate ।। 1.187.150।।
kathaṃ kālo mayā nītaḥ paṃcavarṣasahasrakaḥ ।
vinā patiṃ priyaṃ prāṇamityuktvā'śrūṇyapātayat ।। 15 1।।
prāha śāntiṃ punarlabdhvā sa tvaṃ sā'haṃ satī purā ।
menāputrī bhavāmyadya patirbhava vacaḥ kuru ।। 152।।
śrutvā śaṃbhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ mlāno bhūtvā'bhūd vigatajvaraḥ ।
satyāḥ śiraḥ karābhyāṃ saṃpramṛtyā''śliṣya cā''nanam ।। 153।।।
cucumba smaraṇārthaṃ tadduḥkhavismaraṇāya ca ।
prāha devīṃ priye gaccha svameva bhavanaṃ pituḥ ।।154।।
tavārthāya praheṣyāmi maharṣīn himavadgṛhe ।
omityājñāṃ samādāya prāha prānte ca pārvatī ।। 155।।
bhikṣurbhūtvā samāyāhi māṃ yācasva himālayāt ।
piturme saphalaṃ sarvaṃ kuruṣveva gṛhāśramam ।। 156।।
ṛṣiproktaṃ pitā me tu satvaraṃ saṃvidhāsyati ।
dakṣakanyā yadā deva tvayā vivāhitā tadā ।। 157।।
vidhau vyu×Vr̤M×tkramadoṣeṇa grahadoṣeṇa bhasmitā ।
tasmāt yathoktavidhinā vivāhaṃ kartumarhasi ।। 158 ।।
bahuvidhyutsavapūrvaṃ vivāhaṃ kuru śaṃkara! ।
sarvarītirvivāhasya kartavyā paripūrṇataḥ ।। 159 ।।
caturdaśabhuvanasthā janavāhā bhavantu vai ।
jānātu himavān samyak jānantu bhuvaneśvarāḥ ।। 1.187.160 ।।
carā'caraṃ prajānātu pārvatyā'pi kṛtaṃ tapaḥ ।
yādṛśaḥ prāpaṇe yatno bhāvyastādṛṅmahotsavaḥ ।। 161 ।।
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭyantare gāthāṃ pragāyeyurjanā yathā ।
pārvatyā tapasā labdho'nālabdho yo maharṣibhiḥ ।। 1 62।।
pārvatyā tu haṭhāt krīto na krīto vedavādibhiḥ ।
sākṣāllabdhaḥ sa pārvatyā na labdho yastu sādhubhiḥ ।। 163 ।।
pārvatyā svāṃgaṇe labdho na labdhastīrthayāyibhiḥ ।
premṇā labdhaḥ sa pārvatyā na labdho yogibhiśca yaḥ ।। 1 64।।
pārvatyā vidhinā labdhaḥ na labdho yājñikairapi ।
pārvatyā parvate labdho na labdhaḥ svargasādhanaiḥ ।। 1 69।।
pārvatyā vakṣasi prāpto na prāpto hṛtsamādhibhiḥ ।
pārvatyā sa kṣaṇāllabdho na labdho vedhasā yugāt ।। 1 66।।
pārvatyā sa punarlabdho'pyapunarbhavalakṣaṇaḥ ।
iti gāsyanti dhavalaṃ yaśo mokṣapradaṃ śivam ।। 1 67।।
iti yāsyanti paramaṃ sādhanaṃ cāpi mokṣadam ।
vivāhasya vidhirloke pravartsyate yathā''vayoḥ ।। 168 ।।
śrutvā priyāyāḥ priyakṛt samuvāca pratipriyam ।
gaccha devi sumāṃgalyaṃ drāk vidhehi yathocitam ।। 169 ।।
ahaṃ svayaṃ na vai pūrvaṃ gacchāmi bhikṣuko yathā ।
mahāguṇairgariṣṭho'pi mahātmā yadi bhikṣukaḥ ।। 1.187.170 ।।
dehīti vacanāt sadyaḥ puruṣo yāti lāghavam ।
tatastvāṃ bhikṣuko bhūtvā na yāceya kathaṃcana ।। 171 ।।
kintu saptarṣayaḥ preṣyā mayā pūrvaṃ tvadarthakam ।
vākdānanirṇayaṃ kuryustato yāsyāmi te gṛham ।। 172।।
tava tapaḥprabhāveṇa yāciṣye tvāṃ pitustava ।
ityuktvā pārvatīmukhā''śleṣaṃ vidhāya śaṃkaraḥ ।। 173 ।।
vijayāyai jayāyai ca karau datvā tu mastake ।
tatkṛtā praṇatiṃ labdhvā prāgevā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।। 1 74।।
kailāsaṃ prayayau vṛttaṃ nandyādibhyaḥ sa ūcivān ।
bhairavādyā gaṇāḥ śrutvā cakrustatra mahotsavam ।। 1 75।।
kṛtvā samāptiṃ tapaso'bhivandya vanacetanān ।
sasakhī pārvatī hṛṣṭā jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ ।। 176 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saptarṣibhiḥ pārvatyāḥ prāṇaglahatapaḥ śaṃkarāya niveditam, vṛddhajaṭilavipraveṣeṇa śaṃkarasya pārvatīṃ pratyāgamanam, śaṃbhoraguṇaviguṇādivarṇanam,pārvatyāḥ śaṃbhoḥ sarvasadguṇaparatāgrāhyatvam ,śaṃbhunā svasvarūpeṇa darśanam, parasparaṃ sukhavārtālāpaḥ, vivāhārthaṃ nirṇayavacanaṃ, tapaḥsamāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 187।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu suprītito lakṣmi yajjātaṃ tadanantaram ।
pārvatyāgamanaṃ śrutvā menāyukto himācalaḥ ।। 1 ।।
yojayitvā suyānāni prayayau harṣavihvalaḥ ।
purohitaśca paurāśca sakhyaścāpi kumārikāḥ ।। 2 ।।
sambandhinastathā cānye bhrātaro harṣavihvalāḥ ।
jayaśabdaṃ prakurvanto jagmustāṃ tāpasīṃ prati ।। 3 ।।
sumaṃgalaghaṭān nyasya rājamārge samīkṛte ।
candanā'gurukastūrīphalaśākhādiśobhite ।। 4 ।।
purodhovipramunibhirbrahmarṣibhiśca saṃkule ।
nārībhirnartakībhiśca gāyikābhiśca ghoṣite ।। ।5 ।।
gajendrāśvamahāhaṃsayānavāhanapūrite ।
aśokacūtapatrāditoraṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛte ।। 6 ।।
raṃbhāstaṃbhādisaṃklṛptamaṇḍapādivibhāsite ।
patiputravatīyoṣitsamūhaiśca ninādite ।। 7 ।।
śatasahasradīpānāṃ prakāśairdhavalīkṛte ।
maṃgaladhvanikartṛbhirdvijavṛndairvilāsite - ।। 8 ।।
nānāvādyadhvanivyāpte svāgatalakṣaṇāṃkite ।
deśābhijanavṛndāśca yayurvai pārvatīṃ prati । । 9 । ।
etasminnantare durgā''jagāma gopurāntikam ।
viśamānā nagaraṃ prāk dadarśa pitarau hṛdā ।। 1.188.10 । ।
suprasannau sāśrunetrau harṣavihvalamānasau ।
putrīṃ dṛṣṭvavā pradhāvantau nanāma sā''libhiḥ satī । । 11 । ।
tau sutāṃ vakṣasi kṛtvā yuyujatuḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।
bhrātṛstrīprabhatināryo dṛḍhāliṃganamādadhuḥ । । 1 2। ।
sādhitastapasā kulatārakaḥ pāvitā vayam ।
iti praśaṃsya nemustāmānarcuḥ puṣpacandanaiḥ ।। 13 ।।
vyomadevāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ cakrurnemuśca tuṣṭuvuḥ ।
puraṃ praveśayāmāsurbahuvādyamahotsavaiḥ ।। 14।।
atha viprāḥ purodhāśca sakhyo'nyāśca striyaḥ satīm ।
gṛhaṃ praveśayāmāsurbahumānapuraḥsaram ।। 15।।
sakhyo nirmañcchanaṃ cakrurvṛddhā yuyujurāśiṣaḥ ।
menire saphalaṃ janma kuputrāt putrikāṃ varām ।। 16।।
sādhubrāhmaṇabandibhyo himādrirūpadā dadau ।
maṃgalāni vividhāni gāpayāmāsa sotsavaḥ । । 17। ।
savādyagāyane pravartite vṛddhāśca jāmayaḥ ।
bhrātaro jñātayaḥ paurāḥ samūṣurmaṇḍape priye । । 18।।
nāryo vṛddhāśca yuvatyaśca kanyā bālāstathā'parā ।
śṛṇvanti sma śubhaṃ gānaṃ paśyanti sma ca nṛtyakam ।। 1 9।।
etasminnantare tatra svecchayā śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
sunartakanaṭo bhūtvā maṇḍapaṃ praviveśa saḥ ।।1.188.20 । ।
śṛṃgaṃ vāme kare dhṛtvā dakṣiṇe ḍamaruṃ tathā ।
pṛṣṭhe naṭīyacitrāḍhyāṃ sakaṃcukāṃ paṭīṃ dadhan । ।21 । ।
raktavastro nṛtyagānakuśalaḥ sannanarta ha ।
cakre manoharaṃ gānaṃ premarasapracūrakam ।।।21 ।
aṃgaṃ ca ḍamarū tatra vādayāmāsa ghurghurān ।
kiṃkiṇīḥ ṭhammayāmāsa nartayāmāsa kalginam । ।23। ।
nārīrākarṣayāmāsa bhāvayāmāsa pārvatīm ।
narānsandarśayāmāsa nṛtyacāturthamekalam ।।।24।।
menakāṃ jñāpayāmāsa tāpasī lagnamānasam ।
nāgarānbodhayāmāsa pātraṃ mahotsavasya saḥ । 25। ।
taṃ ca vilakṣaṇaṃ draṣṭumājagmurnāgarāḥ pare ।
mumuhuśca narā nāryaḥ pārvatīmudamāpa ca ।।96।।
hṛ+āeda dadarśa śaṃbhuṃ taṃ triśūlādisamanvitam ।
vibhūtibhūṣitaṃ cāsthimālaṃ trilocanaṃ haram ।।27।।
sacandraṃ kṛtanāgopavītaṃ vyāghragajājinam ।
sajaṭaṃ dhavalaṃ puṣṭaṃ yuvānaṃ ṣoḍaśābdakam ।। 28।।
varaṃ vṛṇvityuktavantaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā praṇanāma tam ।
varaṃ vavre mānasaṃ sā patirme tvaṃ bhaveti ca ।।29।।
varaṃ datvā tirobhūya bahirnanarta bhikṣukaḥ।
menā dadau tu ratnāni pāritoṣikasaṃjñayā ।।1.188.3 0।।
tāni na svīcakārā'sau bhikṣāṃ yāce tu pārvatīm ।
menā cukopa cātyugraṃ bhartsayāmāsa bhikṣukam ।। 3 1।।
tataḥ sa darśayāmāsa camatkāraṃ himādraye ।
viṣṇurūpadharaṃ śailo dadarśa vanamālinam । । 3 2। ।
kirīṭakuṇḍalopetaṃ pītavastraṃ caturbhujam ।
yadyatpuṣpādikaṃ dattaṃ pūjākāle gadābhṛte ।। । 33 । ।
gātre śirasi tatsarvaṃ bhikṣukasya dadarśa ha ।
tato dadarśa tatraiva brahmāṇaṃ sa caturbhujam ।ḥ 34। ।
paṭhantaṃ śrutisūktāni savedṃ sakamaṇḍalum ।
tataḥ sūryasvarūpaṃ ca jagaccakṣuḥsvarūpakam । । 35। ।
tato dadarśa śaṃbhuṃ taṃ pārvatīsahitaṃ prabhum ।
tatastejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca jyotirliṃgasvarūpakam । । 36 । ।
punā rūpāṇi saṃkṣipya nanarta bahudhā jagau ।
datteṣu bahuratneṣu na jagrāha satīṃ vinā । । 37।।
yayāce pārvatīṃ bhikṣāṃ na dadau himavāँśca tām ।
tataḥ śivāṃ manāk vīkṣya tatraivā'ntardadhe haraḥ । । 38 । ।
tataścendrādayaścintāṃ cakrire bahudhā tadā ।
yayāce śaṃkaro bhikṣāṃ na dadau parvatastu tām । । 39 । ।
menayā'pi na dattā'ho hānirvai samayacyutiḥ ।
jānāti menakā cāpi jānāti ca himācalaḥ । ।1.188.40 । ।
putrīyaṃ śaṃbhave deyā vismṛtaṃ taddhi sarvathā ।
pātre rudre yanna dattaṃ hāniśceyaṃ mahatyapi । ।4 1 । ।
aho māyā śaṃkarasya moho vitanyate'nayā ।
deyeti pratiśrutyā'pi na dadāmyabhimanyate ।।42 । ।
bhūtaṃ yadbhūtamevaitadatha kiṃ nu bhaviṣyati ।
punaḥ kālaḥ pratīkṣyaḥ syādasmatpuṇyā'balānnanu । ।43 । ।
vicāryeti māsakālaṃ vinirgamayya te surāḥ ।
yayuḥ kailāsamānamya śaṃbhuṃ tuṣṭuvurutsukāḥ । ।44। ।
devadeva mahādeva vayaṃ te śaraṇāgatāḥ ।
dīnoddhāra kṛpāsindho kṛpāṃ kuru namo'stu te । ।45 । ।
ekāntabhaktyā śailaścetkanyāṃ te sa pradāsyati ।
puṇyāt pṛthvīṃ parityajya śailo mokṣamavāpsyati । । 46 । ।
anantaratnāḍhyaśailaśūnyā pṛthvī bhaviṣyati ।
vayaṃ rantuṃ vasituṃ ca kva gamiṣyāma īśvarāḥ । । 47। ।
tavāpi śaṃbho! kailāsaṃ śikharaṃ mokṣagaṃ bhavet ।
tasmādevaṃ na kartavyaṃ kartavyaṃ lābhadaṃ tu yat । 48 । ।
śailaḥ pṛthvyāṃ sadā tiṣṭhet pārvatī ca haro'rjayet ।
asmallābho bhavennityastathā kuru trilocana । । 49 । ।
devanindāśravaṇena puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ।
kuru nindāṃ svakīyāṃ tvaṃ tatra gatvā maheśvara । ।1.188.5 0 । ।
paranindā puṇyahā syāt svanindā yaśase bhavet ।
tava nindāṃ sa saṃśrutvā'nicchuḥ putrīsamarpaṇe ।।5 1।।
bhaviṣyati tataḥ kanyā tvāṃ prasahya variṣyati ।
tvāṃ vihāya satī durgā varaṃ nānyaṃ variṣyati ।।52।।
etattu niścitaṃ sarvaṃ tasmādgaccha maheśvara ।
kanyādāne tathā'nicchornaiva puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।53।।
tādṛk yena sa nirvāṇaṃ dhruvaṃ yāyāddhimācalaḥ ।
lapsyate bhūmijīvitvaṃ yaśaḥ pūjyatvamityapi । ।54।।
tathāstviti haraḥ proktvā jagāma himabhūbhṛtam ।
daṇḍī chatrī svarṇavāsā bibhranpuṃḍraṃ samūrdhvagam ।।55।।
kare tulasīsanmālāṃ śālagrāmaṃ gale dadhan ।
japannārāyaṇakṛṣṇaharināmāni bhaktitaḥ ।।56।।
sādhuveṣadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā śailaḥ satvaramutthitaḥ ।
nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau bhaktyā'tithimapūrvakam ।।57।।
nanāma pārvatī jñātvā tapobalāttu śaṃkaram ।
madhuparkādikaṃ śailārpitaṃ jagrāha vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।58।।
āśiṣaṃ yuyuje vipraḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ nagaḥ ।
sthānāsanādikaṃ cāpi prayojanaṃ nirāmayam ।।59।।
pratyuvāca tadā vipro vaiṣṇavo'haṃ tu vṛttaye ।
bhramāmi yajamāneṣu sarvajño'smi gurorbalāt ।।1.188.60 ।।
mayā jñātaṃ harāya tvaṃ svaputrīṃ dātumicchasi ।
imāṃ padmasamāṃ divyāṃ kiṃjalkakomalāṃgulīm ।।6 1 ।।
gṛhadvāravihīnāya dhanahīnāya roṣiṇe ।
śmaśānavyavasāyāya sarpamitrāya lobhine । ।62। ।
vivastrāya kugātrāya kuśīlāya ca bhasmine ।
ajñātakulagotrārthavayonāmne jaṭālave । ।63।।
kumārgagāmine vyasanine bhramatprabhikṣave ।
etādṛśāya kasmādvai jñāninā dīyate sutā । ।64। ।
kva te kulaṃ dhanayaśaḥkhyātaṃ kva saḥ śmaśānaluṭh ।
yadi mahājanaḥ kaścit śroṣyati sa hasiṣyati । ।65। ।
bāndhavān menakāṃ vṛddhān pṛccha tvaṃ pārvatīṃ vinā ।
pitā'bhijanamanvicchenmātā cecchedgṛhaṃ smṛddham । ।66।।
kanyā tvicchedvaraṃ rūpaṃ miṣṭānnamitaro janaḥ ।
śaila! śaṃbhornābhijano mene! śaṃbhorna vai smṛddhiḥ । ।67। ।
sati! śaṃbhuḥ kurūpo'sti miṣṭānnāśā kathaṃ mama ।
tyajatāmīdṛśo mūrto grāvāṇasadṛśaḥ khalaḥ ।।68। ।
rogiṇo auṣadhaṃ pathyaṃ rocate kintvapathyakṛt ।
ityuktvā bhojanaṃ labdhvā nirjagāma haro dvijaḥ ।।69।।
menā prāha patiṃ deva! śrutaṃ śaṃbhorviceṣṭitam ।
na tādṛśe mayā deyā khāte kṣepyā na putrikā ।।1.188.70।।
na manyase vacaścenme mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।
tyakṣyāmi ca gṛhaṃ sadyo bhakṣayiṣyāmi vā viṣam ।।71 । ।
gale badhvā mama putrīṃ yāsyāmi gahanaṃ vanam ।
mahāmbudhau nimaṃkṣyāmi tasmai dāsyāmi no sutām । ।72।।
śailo'manyata yogyaṃ tanna kṣepyā nirguṇe sutā ।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi putryāgrahaṃ karoti vai । ।73 ।।
vivāhyā śaṃkareṇaiva nānyena kenacittvaham ।
anyathā tu mariṣyāmi vā jīviṣyāmi vanyakā । ।74।।
yacca bhāvi tadbhavatu na me rucistu vidyate ।
śaṃkarāya pradātuṃ vai yathābhāgyaṃ prayātu sā ।।75 ।।
ityudāsīnatāṃ prāptau menāśailau haraṃ prati ।
iṣṭaṃ jātamiti matvā hṛṣṭā hyāsansurādayaḥ । ।76।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne taponivṛttapārvatīsvāgatam, maṇḍape śaṃbhornaṭaveṣeṇa nartanam, pārvatyā yāñcā, menāśailābhyāṃ sā nāṅgīkṛtā, punaḥ śaṃbhorvaiṣṇavaveṣeṇāgamanam, śivāya na deyeti nindanam, menāśailayorabhāvāvirbhāva ityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāśītyadhikaśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 188। ।


← adhyāyaḥ 188 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 189
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 190 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kailāse saṃsthito rudraḥ sasmāra jñānasāgarān ।
arundhatyā sahitāँśca saptarṣīn kamalekṣaṇe । । 1 ।।
samājagmuśca te sarve kailāsaṃ śaṃkarāśritam ।
tānāgatānsamīkṣyā'bhyutthāyā'bhipūjya śaṃkaraḥ ।। 2 ।।
sthīyantāṃ prāha ca svarṇavarṇamṛdubṛsīṣvatha ।
kaśyapā'tre vāruṇeya gādheya śṛṇu gautama ।। 3 ।।
bharadvāja śṛṇuṣva tvamaṅgirastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva ca ।
yūyaṃ gacchata śailendraṃ himādriṃ prati sattamāḥ ।। 4 ।।
pārvatīṃ tu madarthāya śailendro yācyatāṃ himaḥ ।
dātukāmāvabhūtā tau svasutāṃ vedarītitaḥ ।। 5 ।।
devapreraṇayā'haṃ vai kṛtavānasmi nindanam ।
tacchrutvā tau sunirviṇṇau cātidīnau babhūvatuḥ ।। 6 ।।
svakanyāṃ necchato dātuṃ mahyaṃ hi munayo'dhunā ।
saptarṣayo namaskṛtya tūrṇaṃ jagmurhimālayam ।। 7 ।।
śaṃbhurarundhatīṃ prāha śailaṃ gacchasva sundari ।
purandhryo hi purandhrīṇāṃ sukāryasya gatiṃ viduḥ ।। 8 । ।
ityājñaptā yayau saptarṣibhiḥ sārdhamarundhatī ।
gatvā himādrinagaramoṣadhiprasthasaṃsthitam । । 9 । ।
viviśuste tathā sunābhādyadristrīgaṇo'pi ca ।
gandharvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣaistathā'nyaistatpuraḥsaraiḥ ।। 1.189.10 ।।
himādrerbhuvanaṃ ramyaṃ viśālaṃ hāṭakojjvalam ।
himācalaḥ samutthāya samādāyā'rghyamuttamam । । 11 ।।
svayamabhyāgamat dvāri pupūja parameśvarān ।
samānīya sabhāsthānaṃ kṛtāsanaparigrahān । । 12 । ।
sāphalyaṃ janmano jñātvā provāca smitasundaraḥ ।
anabhravṛṣṭiḥ kimiyamutā'ho'kusumaṃ phalam । । 13 ।।
apratarkyamacintyaṃ ca bhavadāgamanaṃ śubham ।
dhanyo'smi saṃpāvito'smi yad bhavanto mamā'jiram ।। 14।।
asatsaṃsargasaṃśuddhaṃ kṛtavanto dayālavaḥ ।
pūrṇakāmāḥ parārthāya vicaranti mahītale ।। 15।।
mama kasyāpi kāryasya siddhaye samupāgatān ।
manye cā''jñāpitaścāsmi kiṃkarā'rhaṃ taducyatām । । 16 । ।
aṃgirāḥ prāha śailendraṃ trinetreṇa śivena vai ।
vayaṃ cātra preṣitāḥ sma śṛṇu no yācyameva yat ।। 1 7। ।
iyaṃ yā tvatsutā kālī sarvanārīṣu sundarī ।
tāṃ vai duhitaraṃ sākṣāt pinākī tava mṛgyati ।। 18 । ।
tacchīghraṃ pāvayā''tmānaṃ kanyakā śaṃkare'rpaya ।
kāryaṃ hi tacca devānāṃ suciraṃ parivartate । । 1 9। ।
jagaduddhāraṇāyaiṣo vidhātavyaḥ samudyamaḥ ।
sa eva dhanyo hi pitā yasya putrī haraṃ patim । । 1.189.20 । ।
devadeveśvarādhīśaṃ prāpnoti tapaso balāt ।
devadeveśvarāḥ sarve namantu pārvatīṃ haram ।। 21 ।।
yācitāro vayaṃ śarvo varo dātātvamapyumā ।
vadhūḥ sarvajaganmātā kuru yacchreyase tava ।। 22 । ।
tacchrutvā''nandavacanaṃ himādrirnijabāndhavān ।
mervādyānparvataśreṣṭhānājuhāva samantataḥ ।। 23 ।।
te'pyājagmurviviśuśca sauvarṇeṣvāsaneṣu ca ।
udayo hemakūṭaśca ramyako mandarastathā ।। 24।।
uddālako vāruṇaśca varāho garuḍāsanaḥ ।
śuktimān vegasānuśca dṛḍhaśṛṃgaśca raivataḥ । । 25 ।।
citrakūṭastrikūṭaśca śṛṃgavāँścānyabhūbhṛtaḥ ।
tato girīśaḥ svāṃ bhāryāṃ menāmāhūtavān svayam ।। 26 ।।
tato himālayaḥ prāha sarvānābhāṣya susvaram ।
ime sarṣaptayo yācitāraḥ putryā mamādya vai ।27।।
maheśvarārthaṃ kanyāṃ tu taccāvedyaṃ bhavatsu vai ।
tadvadadhvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ jñātayo yūyameva me ।। 28।।
śrutvā prāhuśca mervādyā yogyaṃ bhavati sarvathā ।
yācitāraśca munayaḥ śaṃkaraśca varaḥ svayam ।। 29।।
dīyatāṃ śaila kālīyaṃ jāmātā'bhimato hi naḥ ।
etadvacanamākarṇya jñātīnāṃ himaparvataḥ ।। 1.189.30।।
praṇamyarṣīnkarau badhvā girirājo'vravīdidam ।
saptarṣayo mahābhāgā bhavadbhiryadudīritam ।।3 1 ।।
tatpramāṇīkṛtaṃ me hi matpatnyāścāpi sarvathā ।
idānīmeka āgatya vipro vaiṣāvadharmavān ।।32।।
śivoduḥkhakhanirasti na deyeti vaco'bravīt ।
sutāvivāhaṃ rudreṇa necchati sā na cāpyaham ।।33।।
sutā sukhāya dātavyā na duḥkhibhikṣukāya vai ।
kṣamāṃ yāce bhavadbhyo yat sutā duḥkhe na me patet ।। 34।।
ityuktvā śailarājaḥ sa tūṣṇīṃ babhūva sarvathā ।
menakā tu gṛhamadhyaṃ gatvā svapiti niścalā ।।35।।
ṛṣayaḥ preṣayāmāsurmenakāṃ pratyarundhatīm ।
arundhatīṃ vilokyaiva natvovāca hi menakā ।। 36 ।।
aho'dya kimidaṃ puṇyamasmākaṃ puṇyajanmanām ।
pativratā vaśiṣṭhasya vadhūryā'tra samāgatā ।।37।।
kimarthamāgatā devi! dāsyai mahyaṃ nivedya ।
śrutvā cārundhatī prāha priye yadarthamāgatā ।।38।।
śṛṇu mene! susāphalyaṃ janmano labhatāṃ sakhi ।
śivāya pārvatīṃ dehi śivo'sti brahma eva saḥ ।। 39 ।।
tasya smṛddhestu nā'nto'sti kena tvaṃ bhrāmitā vṛthā ।
bhāgyahīnasya yā bhāryā sā baddhā gavaye bhavet ।। 1.189.40।।
sarvabhāgyasya yā patnī sā bhavet sarvavanditā ।
śaṃkaro'sti mahātyāgī yāvannāsti gṛhe vadhūḥ ।।41 ।।
savadhūtve racayetsa vaikuṇṭhānnagarottamam ।
tava putryāścaraṇau tu yatra spṛṣṭau sthale vane ।।42।।
tatra susmṛddhayaḥ santi śivo'pi smṛddhimān bhavet ।
kenā'nutsāhitā mene! mā śucaḥ susthirā bhava ।।43 ।।
jagatpūjyasya pūjyā tvaṃ śvaśrūrbhava suśāśvatī ।
ityuktvā tāṃ samādāya saptarṣīn prati cāyayau ।।44।।
saptarṣayo'pi śailendraṃ prāhurhitakaraṃ tadā ।
śivāya pārvatīṃ dehi saṃhartuḥ śvaśuro bhava ।।45 ।।
vidheḥ prārthanayā śaṃbhustava kanyāṃ grahīṣyati ।
śailaḥ prāha na paśyāmi śaṃbhorvai rājavaibhavam ।।46।।
kaṃcidāśrayamaiśvaryaṃ kaṃ vā svajanabāndhavam ।
varāyā'nanurūpāya pitā kanyāṃ dadāti cet ।।47।।
kāmānmohādbhayāllobhāt sa naṣṭo narakaṃ vrajet ।
kanyāpi duḥkhitā śāpaṃ dadātyājīvanaṃ tadā ।।48।।।
vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha śailendra vacanaṃ trividhaṃ matam ।
ahitaṃ sarvathā cā''dyaṃ sukhāntaṃ tu dvitīyakam ।।49।।
ādyantasukhaṃ tṛtīyaṃ gṛhṇīyāt saṃvicārya vai ।
asatyamahitaṃ paścātsāmprataṃ śrutisundaram । ।1.189.50 ।।
subuddhiśatrurvakti tat। hitaṃ naiva kadācana ।
ādāvaprītijanakaṃ pariṇāme sukhāvaham । ।51 ।।
dayālurdharmaśīlo hi bodhayatyeva bāndhavaḥ ।
śrutimātrāt sudhātulyaṃ sarvakālasukhāvaham । ।52।।
satyasāraṃ hitakartuṃ vacanaṃ śreṣṭhamīritam ।
gṛhī dadāti putrīṃ svāṃ rājyasampattiśāline ।।53। ।
kanyakāṃ duḥkhine datvā kanyāghātī bhavet pitā ।
ko veda śaṃkaro duḥkhī kubero yasya kiṃkaraḥ । ।54। ।
bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā sṛṣṭiṃ sraṣṭuṃ hartuṃ kṣamo hi saḥ ।
brahma yatparamaṃ proktaṃ sa evāsti tu śakaraḥ ।।55। ।
tasya ca trividhā mūrtirbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
brahmā tu sarjakaḥ satye viṣṇuḥ poṣṭā vikuṇṭhake । ।56। ।
haro hartā ca kailāse smṛddhā brahmavibhūtayaḥ ।
brahmaṇaḥ prakṛtistredhā vāṇī lakṣmīśca pārvatī ।।5 7। ।
pārvatī harapatnīyaṃ śaila! janmani janmani ।
dakṣaputrī satī dagdhā dhatte tadbhasma śaṃkaraḥ ।।58।।
atastvaṃ svecchayā kanyāṃ dehi nityavarāya vai ।
athavā sā svayaṃ kāntasthāne yāsyati dāsyataḥ । ।59। ।
duhituste tapaḥsthānaṃ gatvā cāśvāsya pārvatīm ।
bhūtvā tu bhikṣukaścātra yayāce tvāṃ ca pārvatīm ।।1.189.60 ।।
prasthāpitā vaya tena saha nītvā'pyarundhatīm ।
śikṣayāmo vayaṃ tvāṃ vai dehi rudrāya pārvatīm ।।6 1 ।।
bhavitā tadvivāho'tra bhavitavyabalena vai ।
varaṃ dadau sa pārvatyai tapatyai śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।।62।।
nahīśvarapratijñātaṃ viparītāya kalpate ।
ekaṃ dattvā hi śailendra rakṣyāḥ sarvā hi sampad ।।63।।
ekā'dāne tu śailendra nāśyāḥ syuḥ sarvasampadaḥ ।
pārvatyadāne saṃhartā sarve bhasmīkariṣyati ।।64।।
kiṃ bahunā dehi putrīṃ śaṃkarāya sukhaṃ bhavet ।
adya vā'bdadinānte vā dātavyā kanyakā bhavet ।।65 ।।
varapātrāya cā'nyasmai kasmaicidvā viśeṣataḥ ।
budhvā brahma sutāṃ dehi pārvatīmīśvarāya ca ।।66 ।।
kuruṣaṃ tyaja śailendra menayā svastriyā saha ।
menā prāha tadā sarvān pārvatyāṃ śaṃkarāttu yaḥ ।।67।।
putraścotpatsyate senastārakaṃ sa haniṣyati ।
dātavyā śaṃbhave yogyā yogyāya sukhalabdhaye ।।68।।
atha putrīṃ pitā śailaḥ provāca śravaṇā''turām ।
putri dattā'si śarvāya tvaṃ mayā menayā tathā ।।69।।
ṛṣīnuvāca vaḥ kālī stauti śaṃbhuvadhūrmudā ।
arundhatī tadā kālīmāśvāsyā''śiṣa ādadau ।।1.189.70 ।।
saptarṣayastataḥ prāhuḥ śailarāja niśāmaya ।
jāmitraguṇasaṃyuktāṃ tithiṃ puṇyāṃ sumaṃgalām ।।7 1 ।।
saptāhe samatīte tu durlabhe'tiśubhe kṣaṇe ।
lagnādhipe ca lagnasthe candre svatanayānvite ।।72 ।।
mudite rohiṇīyukte viśuddhe candratārake ।
mārgamāse candravāre sarvadoṣavivarjite ।।73 ।।
sarvasadgrahasaṃsṛṣṭe'sadgrahadṛṣṭivarjite ।
sadapatyaprade jīve patisaubhāgyadāyinīm ।।74।।
kanyā pradāya śarvāya kṛtī tvaṃ bhava parvata ।
tasthāṃ tithau haraḥ pāṇiṃ grahīṣyati samantrakam ।। 75।।
anye ca parvatāścāpi procuḥ śaila tathā kuru ।
atha menā pārvatīṃ tu śivānītyāha hārdataḥ ।।76 ।।
munīnarundhatīṃ śailaṃ bhojayitvā bubhoja ca ।
pārvatīṃ bhūṣayitvā ca ṛṣyutsaṃge nyaṣādayat ।।77।।
ayaṃ bhāgaḥ śaṃkarāya dātavya iti niścitam ।
śaṃkaro bhikṣuko brahma svayaṃ dātā himālayaḥ ।।78 ।।
bhaikṣyaṃ ca pārvatī brāhmī kimataḥ paramuttamam ।
atha maharṣayastasyai dattavantaḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।।79।।
spṛṣṭvā kareṇa tāṃ tatra kalyāṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।
saubhāgyaṃ sarvadā te syādakhaṇḍitamathojjvalam ।।1.189.8 0 ।।
ityuktvā munayaḥ sarve dattvā himācalāya tu ।
phalayuktāni puṣpāṇi pratyayaṃ cakrire tadā ।।8 1 ।।
arundhatī śaṃbhuguṇairlobhayāmāsa menakām ।
haridrākuṃkumaiḥ śailaśmaśrūṇi pratyamārjayat ।।82।।
laukikācāramādhāya maṃgalāyanamuttamam ।
tataśca te caturthe'hni sandhārya lagnamuttamam ।।8 3 ।।
parasparaṃ ca santuṣya saṃjagmuḥ śivasannidhim ।
prāhuśca saphalaṃ sarvaṃ vākdattā tena te sutā ।।84।।
udvāhāya pragaccha tvaṃ himācalaśubhālayam ।
vivāhaya yathā rītiḥ pārvatīmātmane hara ।।85 ।।
śivaḥ prāha vivāho naivā'bhyastaḥ prāg vilokitaḥ ।
āraṃbhāditiparyantaṃ vidhiḥ kāryo maharṣibhiḥ ।।86।।
pratyūcuḥ ṛṣayo viṣṇuṃ sasamājaṃ ca vedhasam ।
indramuṣigaṇānyakṣagandharvasiddhakinnarān ।।87।।
vidyādhrāँśca surānsādhyadevādīnsamarudgaṇān ।
apsarasāṃ gaṇānānayasva brahmasarogaṇān ।।88 ।।
sarve vyavahṛtisujñāḥ sastrīkā gṛhidharmiṇaḥ ।
yogyaṃ saṃsādhayiṣyanti tvatkāryaṃ tvakṣataṃ yathā ।।8 9 ।।
ityuktvā ṛṣayo natvā yayuḥ pūjāṃ pragṛhya ca ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha vivāhe me samāgantavyamādarāt ।। 1.189.90 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śivapreritasaptarṣīṇāṃ himālayagṛhagamanam, parvatānāmāhvānaṃ, pārvatyā vākdānārthaṃ mantraṇā, vākdānaṃ lagnadinanirṇayaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 18 9।।
