adhyāyaḥ 190
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 191 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tato lakṣmi himagirirgargeṇa svapurodhasā ।
lekhayāmāsa mervādīnāmantrya lagnapatrikām ।। 1 ।।
śivāya preṣayāmāsa sasāmagrīsupatrikām ।
vipro dadau ca tilakaṃ vidhāya śaṃkarāya tām ।। 2 ।।
tataḥ sammānito'tyarthamājagāma giriṃ dvijaḥ ।
śailo nimantrayāmāsa bandhvādīn sarvadiksthitān ।। 3 ।।
kārayāmāsa vividhottamasvannādisaṃgraham ।
bhinnajātīyasāmagrīrudvāhakaraṇocitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
taṇḍulānāṃ caṇakānāṃ pṛthukānāṃ bahūn bahūn ।
godhūmānāṃ yavānāṃ dvidalādīnāṃ tu parvatān ।। 5 ।।
guḍānāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ ca lavaṇānāṃ suparvatān ।
laḍḍukānāṃ śaṣkulīnāṃ khājakānāṃ ca parvatān ।। 6 ।।
śāṭakānāṃ ghṛtabhrāṇāṃ śatacchidrādiparvatān ।
mauktikānāṃ piṇḍakānāṃ parpīṇāṃ cāpi parvatān ।। 7 ।।
pūrīṇāṃ polikānāṃ ca bharjikānāṃ mahatstarān ।
phullavaṭīparpaṭānāṃ śṛṃgāṇi vividhāni ca ।। 8 ।।
svastikānāṃ śarkarāktakaṇānāṃ śikharāṇi ca ।
dugdhānāṃ ca ghṛtānāṃ ca dadhnāṃ pramiṣṭavāriṇām ।। 9 ।।
amṛtekṣurasānāṃ cā''savānāṃ dīrghikāstathā ।
vividhadravapānānāṃ tathā vāpīścakāra saḥ ।। 1.190.10 ।।
kṣīrasāratarahaiyaṃgavīnānāṃ samucchrayān ।
valmīkān kārayāmāsa bahupakvānnaparvatān ।। 11 ।।
naikasaṃskāravastūni śākapatrādikāni ca ।
rājikārāddhabhājā''ranālādīni bahūnyapi ।। 12।।
amūlyasvarṇavastrāṇi bṛsīsiṃhāsanāni ca ।
bhūtūlikollecamukhyavitānāni mahānti ca ।। 13 ।।
maṇiratnaprakārāṇi suvarṇarajatāni ca ।
naikadhāni ca pātrāṇi yānāni vāhanāni ca ।। 14।।
evamādīni cānyāni saṃgṛhya surabhīṇi ca ।
maṃgalaṃ kartumārebhe śailo maṃgalakṛddine ।। 15।।
vidhipūrvakasaṃskāraṃ pārvatyāḥ parvatastriyaḥ ।
kārayāmāsuratha tāṃ bhūṣayāmāsurājaguḥ ।। 16 ।।
maṃgalairbhūṣaṇairmāṃgalikadravyaiśca cakrire ।
paurastriyo'pi saṃhṛṣṭā lokācāraṃ pracakrire ।। 17।।
bandhuvargā''gamahṛṣṭaḥ śailo'pyācāramaṃgalam ।
sotsavaṃ sarvabhāvena cakre maṃgalamaṃgalam ।। 18।।
āyātastatra vai mūrto divyo devālayo giriḥ ।
mahāratnāni cādāyā'narghyopakaraṇāni ca ।। 19।।
naikahīrakasadratnamaṇibhrājatsamājayuk ।
mandarādriḥ sābhijanaḥ sopāyanaḥ samāyayau ।।1.190.20।।।
sālaṃkṛtakuṭumbā'stācalaḥ sopada āyayau ।
sasambandhijanaḥ svarṇabhūṣāratnamaṇibhṛtaḥ ।। 11 ।।
udayādri samāyācca bahvānandaprapūritaḥ ।
ājagāma malayādriḥ saratnaparivārakaḥ ।। 22।।
divyaśobhaḥ sakalatrādirājagāma darduraḥ ।
saparicchadasaparivāro niṣadha āyayau ।। 23।।
sastrīputrahiraṇyādirgandhamādana āgataḥ ।
mahāsmṛddhaḥ karavīro mahendraścājagāma ha ।।24।।
sasutastrīdāsadāsīkuṭumbijanasaṃyutaḥ ।
pāriyātro maṇiratnakhanistatra samāyayau ।।25।।
sabhṛtyaparivāropāyanaḥ krauṃcaḥ samāgataḥ ।
puruṣottamaśailaścājagāmopāyanādiyuk ।।26।।
nīlādriḥ saparivāropāyanādiḥ samāyayau ।
strīputrādiyutastatra raivatādriḥ samāyayau ।।27।।
uralaḥ sainyasahito vindhyaścāpi tathāvidhaḥ ।
bahuratnopaskarādisahitastatra cāyayau ।। 28 ।।
trikūṭaścitrakūṭaśca veṃkaṭaḥ śrīgiriḥ śubhaḥ ।
gokāmukho nāradādrirāyayau svāśritādibhiḥ । । 29 ।।
kālaṃjaraśca sagaṇaḥ kailāso divyavigrahaḥ ।
anye'pi bhūbhṛto ye ca pṛthvyāṃ dvīpeṣu saṃsthitāḥ । । 1.190.30 ।।
samudreṣu cāntarīkṣe graheṣvapi nagāśca ye ।
himādriṇā nimantritāḥ sastrīputrasutādibhiḥ ।। 3 1 ।।
dāsadāsībhṛtyasenāparivārakuṭumbibhiḥ ।
sadratnamaṇihīrakasvarṇarūpyādivastubhiḥ ।। 32 ।।
bhūṣāmbaravimānaiśca naikā'mūlyopadādibhiḥ ।
āyayurbahusaṃharṣā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti । । 33 । ।
ghargharaḥ śoṇabhadraśca brahmaputro mahānadaḥ ।
anye nadāḥ samāyātā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti । । 34।।
godāvarī ca yamunā triveṇī ca sarasvatī ।
āyayurdivyabhūṣāḍhyā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti । । 35 । ।
mahāmodā narmadā ca gaṃgā ca rudrakanyakā ।
mahāprītyā''yayurdivyā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti ।। 36 ।।
sindhustapatī kāverī tuṃgabhadrā mahīnadī ।
ojasvatī svarṇarekhā bhadrā sābhramatī tathā । । 37 ।।
śatrujitā gomatī ca bhogavatī ca gaṇḍakī ।
tāmraparṇī devanadyastathā'nyā āpagāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 38 । ।
putraputrīparivārakuṭumbijanasaṃkulāḥ ।
bhūṣāratnaparihārā'rpaṇasāmagrikāyutāḥ । । 39 ।।
divyā devīsvarūpāḥ surūpāḥ kanakasūjjvalāḥ ।
ṣoḍaśanyūnavarṣāḍhyāḥ sarvā lāvaṇyamūrtayaḥ । । 1.190.40 ।।
samājagmurmahānandā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti ।
mahākālavanaṃ sundarākhyaṃ madhuvanaṃ vanam । ।4 1 । ।
vṛndāvanaṃ tathā'nyāni vanānyāyayurādarāt ।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ tathā dharmāraṇyaṃ naimiṣamityapi । । 42 ।।
anyānyapi samṛddhānyaraṇyānyāyayurādarāt ।
kurukṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ brahmakṣetrādikāni ca । । 43 । ।
susmṛddhānyāyayuḥ premṇā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti ।
svarṇapūryādayaḥ puryo divyāni nagarāṇi ca ।। 4 4।।
bhuvanāni samājagmurvivāhaḥ śivayoriti ।
svarṇaraupyābhūṣaṇāni divyāni vasanāni ca । ।45 ।।
sugandhādīni sarvāṇi mardanārhāṇi yānyapi ।
amlānaphalapuṣpāṇi sadratnamaṇihīrakān ।। 46 ।।
pātrāṇi ca vicitrāṇi bhūrīṇi hyāsanāni ca ।
vāhanāni suyānāni vimānāni mahānti ca ।।47।।
mauktikānāṃ divyahārān divyopakaraṇāni ca ।
śṛṃgārāṇi vividhāni veṣānaśravadarśanān ।।48।।
sūryasamojjvalāndivyān bhāmanto'sīmakāntikān ।
upāyanāya saṃgṛhya vivāhaḥ śivayoriti ।।49।।
āgataistaistataḥ sarvaiḥ sarvato himabhūbhṛtaḥ ।
saṃkulā''sītpurī divyā bahuśobhānvitā tadā ।।1.190.50 ।।
gopurāḥ śobhitāḥ ketudhvajavitānatoraṇaiḥ ।
ghaṭairvastraiḥ kalīhāraiḥ kadalīsvastikaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।।5 1 ।।
raṃgavallīvicitraiśca dīpavāditramaṇḍitāḥ ।
rājamārgāścatuṣkāśca rathyāḥ saudhā vihārakāḥ ।।52।।
udyānasthalabhāgāśca mārjanā''secanarddhibhiḥ ।
saṃskṛtā gandhitāścālaṃkṛtā vai svargasannibhāḥ ।।53।।
succhāyā maṇḍapā nivṛttārkatāpā vidhāpitāḥ ।
pānabhojanaśālāśca virāmabhūmikāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।54।।
naṭanartakagandharvamallacāraṇaparṣataḥ ।
vyākhyānaraṃjanakrīḍāpradarśanakathānakāḥ ।।55।।।
kāritā vividhānandakarāḥ prāghūṇikārthakāḥ ।
kiṃ nyūnaṃ bhūdharo yatra śvaśuro bhavatīti vai ।।56।।
bhagavān śaṃkaro yasya jāmātā''yāsyati gṛham ।
jagadambā mahāmāyā vadhūrbhavati yatra ca ।।57। ।
yathā svargaṃ bhaveddivyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamaparaṃ ca vā ।
yathā vā brahmaṇo lokastathā divyati vai purī ।।।58। ।
himālayo mahāprītyā bhāvataḥ śraddhayā''darāt ।
samāgatānāṃ sammānaṃ cakārāti yathāyatham । ।59।।
sarvān saudheṣu ramyeṣu sapreṃkhodyānavāriṣu ।
sadolāśayanāgārāsanavastuvibhāsiṣu ।।1.190.60।।
svarvimānasvarūpeṣu dadau vāsān pṛthaka-pṛthak ।
dāsadāsīśca sevāyāṃ nyayuṃkta lakṣaśastadā ।।6 1।।
sāmagrībhiranekābhiriṣṭābhiḥ śailarāṭ ca tāna ।
toṣayāmāsa dānaiśca bhogyaiśca kṛtsnaśo giriḥ ।।62।।
svapuryāṃ svāṃgaṇe kārayāmāsa racanāṃ śubhām ।
dvāri dvāri tu raṃbhādimaṃgalāni kṛtāni vai ।।63 ।।
prāṃgaṇaṃ racayāmāsa rabhāstaṃbhasamanvitam ।
paṭṭastaṃbhasunibaddharasālapatratoraṇam ।।64।।
mālatīmālyahārālikṛtakāṃgarikānvitam ।
caturdikṣu mahāmaṃgaladravyādivibhūṣitam ।।65।।
puraskṛtya girirgargaṃ prastāvārhasumaṃgalam ।
svaputryarthaṃ mudā cakre sarvaṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ tadā ।।66 ।।
pṛthvī devī samāgatya maṇḍapārthaṃ bhuvaṃ dadau ।
antarīkṣagatā bhūḥ sā tadā dyauriva śobhate ।।67।।
āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ kārayāmāsa maṇḍapam ।
pauraṭaṃ cātivistīrṇaṃ vedikādimanoramam ।।68।।
himālayopatyakāyāṃ bahuyojanavistṛtam ।
naikacamatkṛtiyuktaṃ vyomasthaṃ tu yathādivam ।।69।।
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ sarvaṃ sādṛśyena parasparam ।
darśakabhrāntijanakaṃ haṃsapārṣadamiśritam ।।1.190.70 ।।
jaṃgamaṃ sthāvareṇātra śobhayā vijitaṃ tadā ।
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamenāpi jitaṃ viśiṣṭaśobhayā ।।7 1 ।।
jalena tu jitā bhūmiḥ sthalena ca jitaṃ jalam ।
kiṃ sthalaṃ kiṃ jalaṃ tatra nā'buddhyata yathārthataḥ ।।।72।।
dvāre kammānikāpārśve kvacit siṃhāstu kṛtrimāḥ ।
kvacittu sārasā haṃsāḥ kvacit tatra tu hastinaḥ ।।73।।
kvacit śikhaṇḍinastatra śukā menāśca sārikāḥ ।
kokilāśca kvacittatra kṛtrimāścetanā iva ।।74।।
kvacitkammānikordhve ca nṛtyantyaḥ puruṣaiḥ striyaḥ ।
mohayantyo darśakāँśca paśyantyaḥ kṛtrimāśca tāḥ ।।75।।
kvacidagrordhvake bhāge paryaścāpsarasastathā ।
sapuṣpamālāḥ pakṣāḍhyā divyāstāḥ kṛtrimāḥ sthitāḥ ।।76।।
sopānagopurāgreṣu dvārapālā dhanuryutāḥ ।
saśastrāḥ sadhūṣkṛtayo bhūśuṇḍīsahitāstathā ।।77।।
ghṛtākṣayaśca tiṣṭhanti sthāvarā jaṃgamopamāḥ ।
dvāri sthitā mahālakṣmīrupari kṛtrimā śubhā ।।78।।
gajairghaṭaiḥ sakamalairabhiṣiktā dvipārśvataḥ ।
sarasvatī kṛtrimā ca tanvyā gāyati vādikā ।।79।।
catuṣke'mbālikāyuktā'laṃkṛtāḥ kṛtrimā gajāḥ ।
aśvāḥ sālaṃkṛtāścāśvavārā gajapakādayaḥ ।।1.190.80 ।।
rathā rathibhirākṛṣṭavāhanāgrasuśobhinaḥ ।
vāhanāni garuḍāśca haṃsā yānāni bhūriśaḥ ।।8 1।।
pattayaśca vimānāni kṛtrimānyakṛtopamāḥ ।
tasya sabhāgrahe kṛtrimodyāno drumarājimān ।।।82।।
kṛtrimāśca naṭā naṭyo nartakā bahurūpiṇaḥ ।
apsarorāsakartrīṇāṃ maṇḍalāni kṛtāni ca ।।83।।
evaṃ vimohanārthaṃ ca maṇḍape'pi kṛtaṃ bahu ।
munyṝṣīṇāṃ ca devānāṃ nadīnāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ tathā ।।84।।
nadānāṃ cāpyaraṇyānāṃ kṛtrimāḥ rūpapaṃktayaḥ ।
jagamabhrāntidāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtā vai viśvakarmaṇā ।।85।।
ye ye tatrā''gatāścānye samāyāsyanti ye ca tām ।
kṛtrimān maṇḍape sthalyāṃ viśvakarmā cakāra ha ।।86 ।।
janavāhāḥ śaṃkaraśca varaveśo vṛṣopari ।
kṛtrimaśca kṛto viśvakarmaṇā śaṃbhutuṣṭaye ।।87।।
mahādvāri tathā nandī sphaṭikā bho mahān kṛtaḥ ।
nandyupari tvantarīkṣe kakudādhārakaṃ mahat ।।88।।
ratnāḍhyaṃ puṣpakasaṃjñaṃ vimānaṃ kṛtrimaṃ kṛtam ।
suchatracāmarādarśapatratoraṇaśobhitam ।।89।।
divyapradīpatārādhivāsitaṃ śaśisūjjvalam ।
kadalīpallavapuṣpaphalamālādyalaṃkṛtam ।।1.190.90 ।।
vāmapārśve gajau svarṇavarṇau sā'mbālikau kṛtau ।
caturdantau ṣaṣṭivarṣau madayuktau giriprabhau । ।91।।
tathā'śvau dvau sūryavaṇau hyalaṃkṛtau tu kṛtrimau ।
kṛtau cānye pratīhārāḥ svarṇavetradharā janāḥ ।।।92।।
kṛtrimāśca hasantaśca lokapālāḥ śubhāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
sarve devīyutā devāḥ kuṭumbasahitāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।93।।
upadevā guhyakāśca siddhacāraṇakinnarāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaiva manavaścāpi kṛtrimāḥ ।।94।।
ayojitātmamātrāste dṛśyante cetanā iva ।
viṣṇurlakṣmīyuto nārāyaṇaśca ramayā yutaḥ ।।95।।
vāṇyā yutastathā brahmā garuḍo haṃsa ityapi ।
pārṣadāśca kuṭumbāni tattadīyāni sarvathā ।।96।।
vedāśca sanakādyāśca pāṭhakāḥ karapustakāḥ ।
kṛtrimāśca kṛtāḥ sarve prītena viśvakarmaṇā ।।97।।
airāvatasthitaścendraḥ patnīputrādisaṃyutaḥ ।
anye ca dhanadādyāśca dikpālā lokapālakāḥ ।।98।।
kṛtrimāśca kṛtāstatra viśvakarmeśvareṇa vai ।
bahūktena ca kiṃ lakṣmi! hyubhayoḥ pakṣayostu yaḥ ।।99।।
samājaścāgataścāthā'gamiṣyati mahājanaḥ ।
te sarve tāśca sarvāśca kṛtrimā viśvakarmaṇā ।। 1.190.100 ।।
nirmitā akṛtanibhā āścaryārthaṃ dvayostayoḥ ।
ityatra maṇḍape mañcā bṛsyaścopari paṭṭikāḥ ।। 10 1।।
dugdhā''bhā sphaṭikābhāśca darpaṇābhāḥ kṛtāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sthalyaścandranibhā ramyā haritāḥ śādvalātmikāḥ ।। 1 02।।
kṛtrimāścitritāstatra muhyeyurbhrānticetanāḥ ।
svayaṃbhuvo nivāsārthaṃ kṛtrimaḥ satyalokajaḥ ।। 1 03।।
saudhaḥ sudharmā susabhā kṛtrimā cādbhutā kṛtā ।
viṣṇornivāsanārthāya vaikuṇṭhaṃ bahusmṛddhimat ।। 1 04।।
divyaṃ divyāścaryamayaṃ vireje viśvakarmakṛt ।
indrapurī kṛtrimā ca kṛtā yadvat divi sthitā ।। 1 05।।
tathā'nyadikprapālānāṃ puryo nivāsanāya hi ।
lokapālamanūnāṃ ca puryaśca viśvakarmaṇā ।। 1 06।।
kṛtrimāstatra racitāstattadvāsāya cāmbare ।
sadanāni nivāsāya mahādivyā'dbhutāni ca ।। 1 07।।
racitāni mahābuddhyā kṣaṇato viśvakarmaṇā ।
saudhānāṃ paṃktayo rājaprākārāḥ kṛtrimāḥ kṛtāḥ ।। 1 08।।
tathā divyaṃ ca kailāsaṃ racayāmāsa sūjjvalam ।
sarvasmṛddhimayaṃ gehaṃ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 1 09।।
badarikāśramastatra śvetaśca kṣīrasāgaraḥ ।
golokaścitritastatra kṛtrimaśca dravaiḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 1.190.11 0।।
evaṃbhūtāḥ kṛtā viśvakarmaṇā racanāḥ śubhāḥ ।
śarvaharyādayaḥ sarve prasannāḥ syuritīcchayā ।। 11 1।।
sarvaṃ sajjaṃ śobhitaṃ ca kṛtaṃ ca kāritaṃ mudā ।
putryā vivāhaśobhābhivṛddhaye himabhūbhṛtā ।। 11 2।।
evaṃ susajya sarvārthaṃ lokarītiṃ vivardhya ca ।
paryaikṣiṣṭa mudā śaṃbhvāgamanaṃ sa himācalaḥ ।। 11 3।।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne himālayena pakvānnaratnopakaraṇānāṃ rāśayo, maṃgalāni ca kāritāni
nimantritaparvatanadanadītīrthāraṇyadevadevyādyāgamanam, nagaramaṇḍapādiśobhā viśvakarmadvārā kāritā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikaśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 190।।

adhyāyaḥ 191
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 192 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu priye pravakṣyāmi śaṃbhuḥ kiṃ kiṃ cakāra ca ।
kailāse saṃsthito devaḥ prāpya maṃgalapatrikām ।। 1 ।।
mānaṃ vyadhād vācayitvā svīcakāra vidhānataḥ ।
satkṛtya patrikāvāhaṃ yāpayāmāsa cādarāt ।। 2 ।।
viṣṇuprabhṛtidevānnimantrayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ।
sarve āyāntu sotsāhā sastrīputrasutādayaḥ ।। 3 ।।
nāgamiṣyanti ye tvatra madvivāhotsave tu te ।
svakīyā naiva mantavyā ye ke'pi syurmahājanāḥ ।। 4 ।।
nāradaṃ preṣayāmāsa caturdaśasu bhūmiṣu ।
nimantrya mānataḥ sarvān tvāyayau śaṃkaraṃ muniḥ ।। 5 ।।
atha prāghūṇikānāṃ ca sanmānāya tu śaṃbhunā ।
racitaṃ nagaraṃ divyaṃ kailāsamaparaṃ navam ।। 6 ।।
saudhāni yatra lakṣāṇi gṛhāśca koṭiśastathā ।
udyānāni sahasrāṇi vāṭikāḥ śataśastathā ।। 7 ।।
vāpyaśca dīrghikāścaiva vimānāni ca maṇḍapāḥ ।
rasaśālāḥ sūdaśālā nṛtyaśālā vihārikāḥ । । 8 ।।

varavāhinyāgamādisūcanārthaṃ drutaṃ yayau ।। 115 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkareṇa lagnapatrikā prāptā, caturdaśalokasthānino nimantritā āyayuḥ, śivasya varayogyaṃveṣaḥ maṇḍapasthāpananāndīprabhṛtirmaṃgalakarma, varayātrākramavyavasthā, prathamaṃ nāradaḥ preṣitaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 191 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 191 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 192
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 193 →

śṛṇu lakṣmi tato gatvā nārado vismito'bhavat ।
dṛṣṭvā''ścaryakarāṃ viśvakarmaṇā racitāṃ kṛtim ।। 1 ।।
kṛtrimeṣu mohitaḥ sannāradaḥ prāha bhūbhṛtam ।
varavāhinī prāgevā'yātā'tra kimu vidyate ।। 2 ।।
śailaḥ pratyāha devarṣe vismayaṃ tyaja kṛtrimam ।
viśvakarmakṛtaṃ caitaddṛśyaṃ devādimaṇḍalam ।। 3 ।।
bhojitaḥ pūjitaḥ prārthitaḥ śaṃbhorāgamāya ca ।
nāradastvarito gatvā prāha śaṃbhuṃ surādikān ।। 4 ।।
pratīkṣate himādriścā''yātu vai varavāhinī ।
tatra vimohanārthaṃ ca samāścaryārthamityapi ।। 5 ।।
citramayī kṛtā māyā yatra trailokyamāhitam ।
brahmaviṣṇumahendrādyāḥ sarve devāḥ sucitritāḥ ।। 6 ।।
kṛtrimāścitrarūpeṇa na kiṃcidavaśeṣitam ।
jaḍaṃ tu cetanaṃ yadvad dṛśyate sakriyaṃ hi tat ।। 7 ।।
śrutvaitacca varādyā āturā hyāsan nirīkṣitum ।
śivājñayā varayātrā vāhinī nirjagāma ha ।। 8 ।।
ājagāmopahemādripuraṃ tu haravāhinī ।
ākarṇyaitattu hemādriḥ preṣayāmāsa parvatān ।। 9 ।।
viprāँścāpi svayaṃ cāpi yayau saṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
senayā sahitaḥ śailaḥ saṃbhāṣāṃ kartumīśvaram ।। 1.192.10 ।।
śailendrāṇāṃ mahāsenāṃ śaivānāṃ ca tato'dhikām ।
dṛṣṭvobhapakṣagāste tu vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ।। 11 ।।
virajeturmilitvaiva pūrvapaścimasāgarau ।
haimo śailāśca viprādyāḥ praṇemurvaraśaṃkaram ।। 12।।
vṛṣavimānasaṃsthaṃ suprasannāsyaṃ subhūṣitam ।
divyāvayavasatkāntiprakāśitadigantaram ।। 13।।
ratnabhṛte sureśaiśca sevitaṃ chatracāmaraiḥ ।
vāmasthitahariṃ dakṣasthitabrahmāṇamityapi ।। 14।।
pṛṣṭhasthitamahendraṃ ca tato devagaṇānvitam ।
atha satkṛtya hārādyairjalapānādibhirvaram ।। 15।।
varapakṣāँśca saṃsthāpya viśrāntibhavaneṣu ca ।
śivājñayā himaśailo yayau ca vidhivedikām ।। 16।।
kartuṃ tvatha varācāramāhūtāḥ seśvarāśca te ।
gamanaṃ cakrurīśādyā agragā girirāṭgṛham ।। 17।।
tasminnavasare menā śivadarśanalālasā ।
nāradaṃ pārśvataḥ kṛtvā candraśālāṃ samāgatā ।। 18।।
śivo'pi svacamatkāraṃ darśayituṃ samicchati ।
prāha vai vedhasaṃ viṣṇuṃ yātaṃ yūpaṃ pṛthak-pṛthak ।। 1 9।।
senāṃ kramayasārāṃ ca kṛtvā yāmaḥ sudarśanām ।
menā vyavasthitāṃ ramyāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa ca । । 1.192.20 ।।
prathamaṃ ca giridvāraṃ gandharvāḥ sundarāḥ prabhāḥ ।
divyālaṃkāravastrāḍhyāḥ subhagā vāhanairyutāḥ ।। 2 1 ।।
vādayantaśca vādyāni hyapsarobhiḥ svarāyitāḥ ।
patākājayapaṭṭaiśca yutāḥ praviviśustadā ।। 22।।
atha vasupatiṃ dṛṣṭvā śivo'yamiti sā'bravīt ।
nāradaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ sa hyete vai śivakiṃkarāḥ ।। 23 ।।
atha dviguṇaśobhāḍhyayakṣasenādhipaṃ tu sā ।
maṇigrīvābhidhaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudroya'miti sā'bravīt ।। 24।।
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ sa hyete'pi śivasevakāḥ ।
athadviguṇaśobhāḍhyasenāmadhyagato'nalaḥ ।। 25।।
dṛṣṭo hyāyāta ityayaṃ śivāsvāmīti sā'bravīt ।
nāradaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ saḥ śivanetrānalo hyayam ।। 26।।
atha tato'pi dviguṇaśobhāvān yama āgataḥ ।
taṃ svasenāyutaṃ dṛṣṭvā menā śivo'yamabravīt ।। 27।।।
nāradaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ saḥ sūryaputrastvayaṃ yamaḥ ।
athā''yāntaṃ nirṛtiṃ svasenānvitaṃ vilokya sā ।। 28 ।।
yamāddviguṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ puṇyajanamahāprabhum ।
śivo'yamabravīnmenā nāradaḥ prāha neti saḥ ।। 29 ।।
athā''yāntaṃ varuṇaṃ dviguṇaśobhānvitaṃ ca sā ।
senāmadhyagataṃ dṛṣṭvā'bravīdrudro'yameva kim ।। 1.192.30 ।।
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ tāvadvāyuḥ samāgataḥ ।
tato'pi dviguṇaśobhaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ sainyamadhyagam ।। 31 ।।
menā'bravīcca rudro'yaṃ nāradaḥ prāha naiva saḥ ।
athā''yāt taddviguṇādhiśobhānvito dhanādhipaḥ ।। 32 ।।
sainyamadhyagataṃ dṛṣṭvā menā prāha śivo hyayam ।
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ sa guhyakādhipatistvayam ।। 33 ।।
athāta īśāna āyāt svasainyaparivāritaḥ ।
tato dviguṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā menakā'bravīt ।। 1 4।।
rudro'yamiti tāṃ nāradaḥ prāhā'yaṃ na śaṃkaraḥ ।
athendraḥ sainyaśobhāḍhyo dviguṇasmṛddhirāyayau ।। 35 । ।
dṛṣṭvā taṃ harṣitā menā prāhā'yaṃ macchivāpatiḥ ।
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ kintvindro'yaṃ surādhipaḥ ।। 3 6। ।
atha candraḥ samāyātastato dviguṇaśobhitaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā svasainyamadhyaṃ taṃ menā'bravīcchivo hyayam ।। 37।।
nāradaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ saḥ kintu tadbhālacandrakaḥ ।
atha sūryaḥ samāyātsvasainyamadhyagataḥ svarāṭ ।। 38 । ।
tato dviguṇaśobhaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā''hā'yaṃ śiveti sā ।
nāradaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ saḥ kintvayaṃ tattanū raviḥ ।। 3 9। ।
athā''yayuśca bhṛgvādyāḥ ṛṣayastejasā'dhikāḥ ।
svaśiṣyagaṇasainyāḍhyāstanmadhyastha bṛhaspatim ।।1.192.4 0 ।।
tato dviguṇaśobhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā''hā'yaṃ śiveti sā ।
nāradaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ saḥ kintvayaṃ devadeśikaḥ । । 41 । ।
atharṣimaṇḍalaistejorāśibhiḥ pūjito hyajaḥ ।
tato'pi bahuśobhāḍhyaḥ samāyādvai pitāmahaḥ ।।42 । ।
dṛṣṭvā tato bahuśobhaṃ menā harṣavatī hyabhūt ।
provāca śaṃkaro'yaṃ syāt nāradaḥ prāha naiva saḥ ।। 43 ।।
kintu brahmā viśvasṛṣṭā menā''ścaryagatā'bhavat ।
atha viṣṇurbahurūpo'tyatilakṣmīramāyutaḥ ।।44 ।।
sarvaśobhānvito meghaśyāmaḥ svarṇasamujjvalaḥ ।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaḥ pītāmbaraścaturbhujaḥ ।।45 ।।
cakrādicihnavān vakṣaḥsthalarājatsukaustubhaḥ ।
mukuṭakaṭakādyuktaḥ padmapatrābhalocanaḥ ।।46 ।।
lāvaṇyasaundaryanidhiraprameyaprabhojjvalaḥ ।
anantadāsadāsīnāṃ sainye garuḍarājitaḥ । ।47।।
praviveśa tamāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā'tiharṣavihalā ।
cakitā'kṣyabhavanmenā'bravīdayaṃ sa eva saḥ । । 48 ।।
nāradaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ tvattsutāsvāmī hi menake ।
śivabhrātā hyayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śivakāryādhikāryayam । ।49 ।।
vaivāhike mahā'mātyo'nuvaro varapārśvagaḥ ।
śivastvasmādadhiko'sti rūpasmṛddhacādivaibhavaiḥ ।। 1.192.50 । ।
athaikādaśakoṭyaśca rudrāṇāṃ viviśustadā ।
sarve śaṃbhusamākārā viṣṇutulyavibhūṣaṇāḥ । । 51 । ।
athā''dityā dvādaśakoṭyaśca saṃviviśustadā ।
sarve viṣṇusamākārā nārāyaṇasumūrtayaḥ । । 5 2 ।।
dṛṣṭvā menā matyagamyān bhāgye svaṃ bahvamanyata ।
vāraṃ vāraṃ paryapṛcchannāradaṃ kvā'sti śaṃkaraḥ ।। 53 ।।
tāvat praviviśustatra vairājāścordhvaretasaḥ ।
nārāyaṇādapyadhikarūpatejo'bhisaṃvṛtāḥ ।।।54।।
caturviṃśatikoṭyaste mahāviṣṇustadantare ।
rājādhirājalakṣmyā sa rājate sarvato'dhikaḥ ।।55 । ।
tamanu sādhavaḥ sarve yogino'rbudakoṭayaḥ ।
āyayuśca puradvāraṃ mahāviṣṇusvarūpiṇaḥ । । 56 । ।
dṛṣṭvā tatra mahāviṣṇuṃ menā harṣapariplutā ।
atyutsāhavatī prāha so'yaṃ śivaḥ samāgataḥ । ।57 । ।
aho bhāgyaṃ mama putryā yogyaṃ tapaḥ kṛtaṃ tayā ।
arjitaścedṛśaḥ svāmī sukhī bhavatu putrikā ।58 । ।
nāradaṃ prāha meneyaṃ na śivastvacchivāpatiḥ ।
kintu śivaḥ sadāśivo rājate īśasṛṣṭiṣu ।।59। ।
tasya bhrātā mahāsamrāṭ mahāviṣṇurayaṃ kila ।
ato'tirūpavān samṛddho vartata pārvatīpatiḥ ।।1.192.60 । ।
varṇayituṃ tu tacchobhāṃ mayā naiva hi śakyate ।
mā tvarā tvaṃ kuru mene paśyainaṃ ko'yamāgatā । ।6 1 । ।
tāvacchrīkṛṣṇacandraḥ śrīrādhākṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ ।
āyayau koṭikoṭyabjā'rbudadāsādimaṇḍitaḥ । ।62। ।
nāradaḥ praṇanāmainaṃ menā'pi praṇatā'bhavat ।
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa sā । ।63। ।
tanmūrtidarśanasaukhyāplutā''kṛṣṭā''ntarā tadā ।
samādhisukhamāpannā hyutthitā ca kṣaṇāntare ।।64। ।
prāha nārada! pārvatyāḥ patiścāyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
nārada prāha mene'yaṃ śivāpatipitā'sti hi । ।65। ।
śivastvasmātsamutpannaścā'syā'sti dāyabhāk sadā ।
ayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paraṃbrahma golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ । ।66 । ।
tanmūrteśca samutpanno mānasastanayaḥ śivaḥ ।
mahāvairāgyamūrtiḥ sa varṇayituṃ na śakyate । ।67।।
āyātyanantaraṃ paśya rūpaguṇamahākhaniḥ ।
menā svasyāśca jāmāturdṛṣṭvā tu pitaraṃ tadā ।।68 ।।
niḥsandehā'bhavaccātiprahṛṣṭā'pyabhavanmuhuḥ ।
draṣṭuṃ samutsukā'bhūcca tāvacchaṃbhuḥ samāyayau ।।69।।
idānīṃ yāvacchṛṃgāraḥ kṛtsnaḥ kṛṣṇasamo'bhavat ।
nāsīnnyūnaṃ tu śobhāyāṃ vare śobhā'styato'dhikā ।।1.192.70 ।।
varayātrāpravāhinyāṃ varaśobhā viśiṣyate ।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyasaundaryakāntisūjjvalam ।।7 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇasadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā menā'tiharṣitā ।
ātmasvārpaṇabhaktyā sā'bhavacchuddhā'drirāḍapi ।।7 1 ।।
mene'pyaho mayā dṛṣṭā sarve'pi devanāyakāḥ ।
eteṣāṃ yaḥ patiḥ so'tra patiḥ putryā bhaviṣyati ।। 73 ।।
svabhāgyamadhikaṃ mene putryāścāpi tato'dhikam ।
yatpatiṃ prāpya me putrī jaganmātā bhaviṣyati ।। 74।।
kuṭumbamapi sarvaṃ me yaśobhāk saṃbhaviṣyati ।
varṇayantīti bhāgyaṃ svaṃ kṛṣṇaśaṃbhuṃ dadarśa sā ।।75 ।।
evamevā'bhavacchaṃbhuḥ kintu menāhimālayau ।
tādṛksuśobhitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ paśyetāṃ bhāvato yadi ।।76 ।।
manvīyātāṃ kṛtakṛtyau putrīdānena bhāvataḥ ।
sarvato bhāvanābhaktyā prāpnuyātāṃ ca śuddhatām ।।77।।
śaṃbhormāhātmyavijñānāt pāramārthikaniścayāt ।
muktiṃ drāgeva gacchetā śailaśca līnatāṃ vrajet ।।78।।
tathāsati mahadduḥkhaṃ śvaśuradhvaṃsasaṃbhavam ।
śvaśrvāścāpi nidhanasya duḥkhaṃ cātyadhikaṃ bhavet ।।79।।
raṃge bhaṃgo bhaveccāpi bhavet kailāsanāśanam ।
bhavecca devakoṭīnāṃ sthānanāśo mṛte hime ।।1.192.80 ।।
himācalavināśena pṛthvī riktā bhavettadā ।
asaṃkhyauṣadhayaḥ sarvā vinaṣṭāḥ syustathā tadā ।।8 1 ।।
iti sarvaṃ tvāpatecca tanmābhūditivāñcchayā ।
menāhimācalādīnāṃ bhāvabhaktinivṛttaye ।।82।।
avaguṇagrahārthāya śailabhūvāsalabdhaye ।
śaṃkaro hi tadā rūpaṃ parivyavartayat svakam ।।83।।
kṛṣṇākṛtisamaṃ rūpaṃ vivṛtya rudramūrtikam ।
śāṃbhavaṃ rūpamāsthāya menāyai darśanaṃ dadau ।।84।।
himālayāya tadvacca śailādibhyastathaiva ca ।
dadau hi darśanaṃ svasya bhasmāktaṃ muṇḍamālikam ।।85।।
sajaṭāsarparudrākṣatriśūlacarmarājitam ।
kadarūpaṃ tathā'tītā'rdhā''yuṣkaṃ rūkṣavigraham ।।86 ।।
sapinākaṃ pañcavaktraṃ vyāghracarmasudhautrakam ।
daśahastaṃ saḍamaruṃ raudrarūpaṃ ca dhūrjaṭam ।।87।।
duḥśmaśru romasarvāṃgaṃ bhūtapretādisevitam ।
sakapardaṃ sakapālaṃ draṣṭurbhayakaraṃ mahat ।।88।।
gaṃjāpānarataṃ netre ghūrṇite cā'pyadarśayat ।
tundilaṃ pīnamatyartha śyāmavarṇaṃ ca vāmanam ।।89।।
menā prāha tadā ko'yaṃ kva gataḥ kṛṣṇarūpadhṛk ।
surūpo vilayaṃ yāto raudrarūpo'sti ko'tra vai ।।1.192.90 ।।
paśya nārada jāmātā kvā'sti me darśayā'tra mām ।
nāradaḥ prāha paśyantīṃ kurūpaṃ menakāṃ tadā ।।91।।
yo'yamāyāti rudrāṇāṃ senāyā madhyage vṛṣe ।
niṣīdan pretabhūtādigaṇāvṛtamahāprabhuḥ ।।।92।।
yasya sainye vātarūpāḥ patākā marmarūpiṇaḥ ।
vakratuṇḍā virūpāśca karālāḥ śmaśrulāstathā ।।93।।
khañjā hyalocanā daṇḍapāśamudrarapāṇayaḥ ।
śaṃkhaḍamarugomukhavādino nartakā iva ।।94।।
viruddheṣu vāhaneṣu pucchābhimukhamāsthitāḥ ।
kecittu vimukhāḥ pṛṣṭhamukhā bahumukhāstathā ।।95।।
akarā vikarāḥ kecitkecidbahukarāstathā ।
aśirā viśirāścāpi kuśirāśca vinetrakāḥ ।।96।।
anetrā bahunetrāśca bahukarṇā akarṇakāḥ ।
anāsāḥ chinnanāsāśca vṛkṇāśca kekarākṣakāḥ ।।97।।
piṃgalāḥ dhūmravarṇāśca prordhvaromāṇaityapi ।
hyete sarve mahāvīryāḥ santi śiṣyāstriśūlinaḥ ।।98।।
paśya mene! tava jāmātaraṃ sevanta ādarāt ।
ime sarve nirātaṃkā niṣparigrahavigrahāḥ ।।99।।
nirdvandvāśca nirīhāśca prabalāstāpasāḥ śivāḥ ।
paśyaitān tava jāmātṛgaṇān jāmātaraṃ tathā ।। 1.192.100 ।।
ityaṃgulyā vinirdiśya nāradastamadarśayat ।
raudraṃ rūpaṃ mano'bhāvyaṃ vīkṣya bhītā śivāprasūḥ ।। 101 ।।
duḥkhitā'bhūt vañcitā'haṃ cetyuktvā mūrchitā'bhavat ।
putryāpi vañcitā nāradena tvayāpi vañcitā ।। 102।।
saptarṣibhirvañcitā ca kṣiptā hyamānuṣe sutā ।
vigartā'rdhaparā''yuṣye'sughaṭe śmaśrule'guṇe ।। 1 03।।।
prāyo'sukhakare netrā'raṃjane cā'manohare ।
rūkṣe vṛkṣe kaṃṭakāḍhye tyaktā puṇyalatā mayā ।। 1 04।।
ityevaṃ mānase menā muhuḥ śocati khidyati ।
sāśrunetre tadā kṛtvā sakhībhirupasevitā ।। 105 ।।
kṣaṇād dhairyaṃ samālambyodvegājjajalpa kālikam ।
aniṣṭotthasagadgadakaṇṭhā tāpāturā hyabhūt ।। 106 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne varayātrāyāṃ varavāhinījanavāhānāṃ śobhā, menākṛtavāhinovarapratīkṣaṇaṃ, śaṃkaradarśanānmenāyāḥ śokaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1 92।।


← adhyāyaḥ 192 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 193
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 194 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tadā raṃge bhaṃgo'bhūnmenakākṛte ।
śāṃkare darśane raudre śokābdhiḥ sulabho'bhavat ।। 1 ।।
kapālayoḥ karau kṛtvā netre pramṛjya khedataḥ ।
bhagnahṛdā bhāvahīnavacanānyavadanmuhuḥ ।। 2 ।।
yaiśca yābhiśca śarvāya deyā putrīti bhāṣitam ।
prastāvitaṃ jñāpitaṃ ca vā'ṅgīkāritamityatha । । 3 ।।
avagamitaṃ prayatitaṃ tattathā'pyanumoditam ।
tān sarvānatisaṃkṣubdhā tiraskaromi vai śaṭhān ।। 4 ।।
nārada tvaṃ pariṇāme kleśado'si śaṭho'si ca ।
tvayā svarṇasamā putrī kardame vinipātitā ।। 5 ।।
phalaṃ caitanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ viparītamanarthakam ।
prasahya preritā cāpi sarvathā vañcitā tvayā ।। 6 ।।
phalaṃ tvasya tavāpi syācchapāmi tvāṃ punaḥpunaḥ ।
sati yoge'pi lagnasya mā kanyāṃ labha durmukha! ।। 7 ।।
aho putri tapastaptvā tvīdṛśo vānaraḥ katham ।
ārādhito'sahyaroṣo bhūtapretapiśācarāṭ ।। 8 ।।
kiṃ kāryaṃ tvadya saṃjāte samāje cā''gate gṛham ।
tathāpyahaṃ sutāmātā samarthā'smi vyapohitum ।। 9 ।।
yadi putrī prakathayennā'yaṃ yogyo'sti me varaḥ ।
mayā kṛte'pi yatne ca putrī na manute yadi ।। 1.193.10 ।।
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mama vyarthaṃ kiṃ karomi kuputrike ।
kulādikaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ me vihitaṃ jīvanaṃ mama ।। 11 ।।
kva gatāḥ ṛṣayasteṣāṃ śmaśrūṇi troṭayāmi vai ।
kvā'sti dhūrtā'rundhatī sā yayā sarvaṃ viṣīkṛtām ।। 1 2।।
īdṛśāḥ svārthakapaṭāḥ nānyanāśaṃ pracakṣate ।
tasmātkanyājanmadātrī svayaṃ gatvā vilokayet ।। 13 ।।
varaṃ gṛhaṃ tathā smṛddhiṃ samācaraṇamityapi ।
nānyaviśvāsamālambya kanyā deyā kvacijjanaiḥ ।। 14।।
re putri padmapatrāsye grāvā vai rādhitastvayā ।
krītaḥ kāco hema datvā kiṃ tvayā gavayo'rthitaḥ ।। 15 ।।
tyaktvā tu candanaṃ putri hyarthitaḥ kledakardamaḥ ।
adṛṣṭvā haṃsavayāँśca kākaḥ sarvottamo mataḥ ।। 16 ।।
hitvā dugdhābdhikā''svāda kṣārābdhisvāda arthitaḥ ।
sūryaṃ hitvā ca khadyotastapaso'nte'rthitastvayā ।। 17।।
hitvā bījāni satputri kiṃ kṛtaṃ tuṣabhakṣaṇam ।
ājyamiṣṭānnamāmuktvā karīṣaṃ bhuktamāditaḥ ।। 18।।
haricchāyāmanādṛtya śivāchāyāmadhiśritā ।
muktvā brahmamayīṃ vidyāṃ bhāṇḍavidyā'rthitā tvayā ।। 19 ।।
yajñabhūtimanālambya citābhasmā'valambitam ।
are cintāmaṇiṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ vai kaṃkaro dhṛtaḥ ।। 1.193.20 ।।
dugdhapākaṃ parityajya pīto nīmbarasaḥ katham ।
aho putri kubuddhiste pañcavarṣasahasrakam ।। 21 ।।
tapastaptaṃ tvayā cā'sya śmaśānasthasya labdhaye ।
nārībuddhirna vai buddhirnārībuddhiḥ parāśrayā ।। 22।।
saguṇo vā nirguṇo vā yaḥ śliṣyati so'syā mahān ।
tasmātkanyā na svabuddhyā saṃvivahetkadācana ।।2 3 ।।
vivāhayet pitā mātā kanyāṃ dṛṣṭvā'nuyugvaram ।
tapo buddhiṃ ca caritaṃ rūpaṃ vṛttaṃ tavā'stu dhik ।। 24।।
nāradaṃ ca ṛṣīn pitāmahaṃ surāँstathā'stu dhik ।
matkulaṃ me kriyādākṣyaṃ dhikkṛtaṃ ca yaśastvayā ।। 25 ।।
kulaṃ dagdhaṃ tvayā vivāhayeyaṃ na mriye'tra vai ।
saptarṣayo nāradaśca himādriśca pitāmahaḥ ।। 26 ।।
ke'pi mā''yāntu nikaṭe darśayantu mukhāni na ।
kimatra sādhitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pratyuta ghātitaṃ kulam ।। 27।।
militvā kālakavale pātitā mama putrikā ।
varamasmāttu vandhyātvaṃ varaṃ vā garbhagālanam ।।28 ।।
varaṃ vā janmato mṛtyurvaraṃ vā rākṣasā'danam ।
kumārītvaṃ cāpi varaṃ na śreṣṭhaṃ kuvarā'rpaṇam ।। 29 ।।
gṛhaṃ samāgatā nagnabhūtapasya tu vāhinī ।
daheyaṃ vā mriyeyā'tra gaccheyaṃ vā kriye'tra kim ।। 1.193.30 ।।
na dātavyā na dātavyā varo yātu nijālayam ।
janavāhāstu gacchantu prāghūṇikāḥ prayāntvapi ।। 21 ।।
ahaṃ tu putrikāṃ nītvā gacchāmi mama paitṛkam ।
yāntu sarve viśīryantāṃ riktaṃ kurvantu madgṛham ।। 32।।
himālayo vanaṃ yātu na deyā'smai tu pārvatī ।
iti vilapya putrīṃ svāṃ gatvā''śliṣya muhurhṛdi ।। 23 ।।
vakṣasyākṛṣya hastābhyāṃ dṛḍhīkṛtya sthitā gṛhe ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt tadā prāghūṇikeṣu vai ।। 34।।
śrutvaitatprathamaṃ tatra jagāma tu pitāmahaḥ ।
drāk dṛṣṭvā holikāśabdān brahmāṇaṃ prāha menakā ।। 35।।।
gaccha duṣṭa mattabuddhe puṣpa prajvālitaṃ tvayā ।
nirlajjo naskaṭo bhūtvā kanyānāśāya yatnitaḥ ।। 3 6।।
kā āhvayati tvāmatra jaraṃ viśvāsaghātinam ।
brahmā stabdho'bhavacchrutvā caṇḍīmātā'pi caṇḍikā ।।।37।।।
iti vicārya mauno'bhūt tāvatsaptarṣayo yayuḥ ।
devāścāgraprapūjyāścā''gatā menāpraśāntaye ।। 38 ।।
ūcurmenāṃ rudrarūpaṃ śaṃbhornāstīti vāstavam ।
līlayā saṃdhṛtaṃ caitat kṣaṇikaṃ nahi śāśvatam ।। 3 9।।
paśyottiṣṭha haṭhaṃ tyaktvā dehi putrīṃ śivāya ca ।
ayaṃ vai paramo lābhaḥ paraṃbrahma sadāśivaḥ ।।1.193.40 ।।
kṛṣṇaputraḥ kṛṣṇarūpaścāgatastava mandiram ।
dānapātraṃ tava putryā tapasāṃ phalamarjitam ।।41 ।।
śrutvaitanmenakā prāha śaṭhāḥ sarve prapaṃcitāḥ ।
rūpamasyā jīvanaṃ ca vyarthīkartuṃ samudyatāḥ ।।42।।
śastrādyairghātayiṣye'haṃ na dāsye ghorakarmaṇe ।
dūraṃ gacchata sarve'smānnāgantavyaṃ mamāntike ।।43।।
varaḥ śaṭho bahurūpī varavāhāḥ śaṭhāstathā ।
śaṭhaiḥ śaṭhāḥ sammilitāḥ prāṇahārāḥ parasya vai ।।44।।
śrutvā sarve mukhāṃ'gulyo'bhavan stabdhāḥ patanmukhāḥ ।
himālayastadā prāyād bodhanāya sutākṛte ।।45।।
bahuśreṣṭhajanamadhye patiṃ novāca kiṃca sā ।
śuśrāva śailarāḍuktaṃ mṛdu sāmayikaṃ vacaḥ ।।46।।
śṛṇu priye yathādṛṣṭastādṛgbhavedvaro yadi ।
na deyā dayitā putrī noced deyā vicāraya ।।47।।
śrīkṛṣṇabrahmaviṣṇvarkacandrasūryendradevatāḥ ।
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ sādhyāḥ surāṇāṃ guravastathā ।।48।।
devyaśca koṭiśo mahālakṣmyādyāḥ sādhvya ādarāt ।
lokapālā diśāṃpālā rājādhirājakeśvarāḥ ।।49।।
nāgaccheyurnimnaśaṃbhorvāhinyāṃ menakāgṛham ।
vicārayeti vai patni yasya vāhe tvime gatāḥ ।।1.193.50।।।
sa kīdṛśo bhavecchreṣṭhaḥ saṃpaśya hṛdi sundari! ।
śivā jānāti taṃ śarvaṃ prāgbhavāt sahacāriṇī ।।51।।
tayoḥ prītiḥ śāśvatī cettatra kā vedanā tava ।
susmṛddhāvapi cetpatnyā mano no ramyate vare ।।52।।
viṣavajjīvanaṃ tasyā guṇarūpāḍyake'pi kim ।
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tava putrī sukhyasti syāt sukhī sadā ।।53।।
yasyāsti deyā tasmai sā vikalā mā bhava priye ।
keke samāgatā gehaṃ paśya mā ninda tān priye ।।54।।
enaṃ dvāragataṃ śaṃbhuṃ divyarūpadharaṃ priye ।
paśya kṛṣṇasamaṃ rūpe uttiṣṭha kīrtivardhini ।।55।।
virarāmā'tha śailendrastaṃ menā prāha tatkṣaṇam ।
mayā dṛṣṭo yathā rudrastādṛśo yadi cedbhavet ।।56।।
dhṛtvā kaṇṭhe subadhvā tāṃ kartāsmyadhaḥprapātanam ।
tvaṃ tu putrīṃ ca māṃ nītvā dayāṃ tyaktvā'tha sāgare ।।57।।
nimajjya sukhī syāśca dāsye putrīṃ harāya na ।
prasahya dāsyasi tasmai tyakṣyāmyadya kalevaram ।।58।।
atha sā pārvatī māturdṛṣṭvā duḥkhamapāragam ।
kintvakāraṇamauḍhyotthaṃ vicāryāṃkasthitā śanaiḥ ।।59।।
netrāśrūṇi pramṛjyaiva snehaṃ kṛtvā rudīhi mā ।
śāntiṃ labheta saṃprocya prāha miṣṭaṃ yathā bhavet ।।1.193.60।।
mātarvaraḥ surūpo'sti sarveśo'sti hareḥ paraḥ ।
sarvāśca smṛddhayastasya sahasraguṇitāḥ parāt ।।6 1।।
yathā dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo mahāviṣṇurvilokitaḥ ।
viṣṇuryathā tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ sūryaścandraḥ sureśvaraḥ ।।62।।
tathā tato'pyuttamo'sti rūpasainyasamṛddhibhiḥ ।
mayā duṣṭo hi kailāso vaikuṇṭhādapi śiṣyate ।।63।।
yauvanaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṣṇādviśiṣyate ।
atra tvayā tu yad dṛṣṭaṃ na taddṛṣṭaṃ mayā kvacit ।।64।।
na jāne darśitaṃ kasmāt rūpaṃ te vikṛtaṃ bahu ।
nānārūpadharaścāyaṃ mahākālo'pi jāyate ।।65।।
saṃhṛtya viśvanetṝँśca dīvyati ramate śubhaḥ ।
dharmāvalambanā bhūtvā mā vāgdharmaṃ jahāhi yat ।।66 ।।
atrā''gatāstu ye devāḥ kiṃkarā hi śivasya te ।
tava dvāri madarthaṃ sotsavāste kimataḥ param ।।67।।।
dehi māṃ tvaṃ śivāyā'smai jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ kuru ।
manovāṅkarmabhirmātarmayā vṛto vṛto haraḥ ।।68।।
siṃhabhāgo vrajet siṃhaṃ na vṛṇe'nyamahaṃ varam ।
mriyeya dāsyasi no cet yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।69।।
evaṃ śrutvā viparītaṃ putryuktaṃ sarvasannidhau ।
menā dhabāk dhabāk putrīṃ muṣṭibhiḥ kūrparaistathā ।।1.193.70।।
tāḍayāmāsa tāṃ divyāṃ mahāroṣānvitā tadā ।
ṛṣayastāṃ paricchidya ninyurdūraṃ tu pārvatīm ।।7 1।।
menā prasārya pādau ca hastau cāpi śiroruhān ।
utpāṭya kṣmāṃ śiraḥ svasyā ghātayāmāsa mattavat ।।72।।
jalpayāmāsa bahudhā mārayiṣye sutāṃ svakām ।
dāsye vā garalaṃ kūpe kṣepsye chetsye'tha khaṇḍaśaḥ ।।73।।
mariṣyāmyapi kanyāṃ na dāsye vikaṭarūpiṇe ।
anayā duṣṭayā cāṭaḥ kīdṛśo mārgito varaḥ ।।74।।
mātuḥ pituḥ kule cogra upahāsaḥ prakāritaḥ ।
na mātā na pitā tvasya nā'nujo nā'grajastathā ।।75।।
na kuṭumbaṃ na vai gotraṃ na gṛhaṃ rūpamārjavam ।
na bhūṣā na ca vastrāṇi vāhanaṃ svasamo vṛṣaḥ ।।76।।
na dhanaṃ na vayo yogyaṃ na vidyā ca pavitratā ।
kiṃ vilokya mayā putrī deyā'smai duḥkhidehine ।।77।।
brahmā siddhāśca sanakādikā devāḥ prajeśvarāḥ ।
vyarthīkurvanti matputryā jīvanaṃ rudrakoṭare ।।78।।
svahastairhanyatāṃ putrī śāntirbhavakṛtā bhavet ।
na deyā na ca vai deyā na dātavyā kadācana ।।79।।
śavavāhāya ghorāya daridrāya ca bhaṅgine ।
śmaśānasthāya nagnāya malināya na cārpyate ।।1.193.80 ।।
sarve prapañcinaḥ putrīṃ mārayituṃ samudyatāḥ ।
vṛṣabhāya mahīṣāya bahurūpadharāya ca ।।8 1 ।।
pāṣaṇḍine na vai deyā na deyā sarvakhaṇḍine ।
viyāntu me gṛhadvārāt kiṃ hyanāthā vilokitā ।।82।।
iti prajalpya maunā'bhūt rurodoccaiśca vihvalā ।
pārvatyapi mātṛvatsā tadā'śrūṇi vyamuñcata ।।83।।
tadā brahmādayaḥ sarve cakitā vismayaṃ gatāḥ ।
nirāśā abhavansarve tāvadviṣṇuḥ samāgataḥ ।।84।।
prāha mātastyaja śokaṃ kurmahe tava sammatam ।
yādṛśaśca tvayā śaṃbhurdṛṣṭo vai tādṛśo bhavet ।।85।।
tadā putrī na vai deyā mamāsti sammatistathā ।
mātaḥ śṛṇu kathaṃ tādṛgrūpaṃ śarveṇa darśitam ।।86।।
prathamaṃ yādṛśaṃ divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasamamujjvalam ।
susmṛddhaṃ rūpamatyarthā''nandasandohadāyakam ।।87।।
dṛṣṭaṃ tvayā'sti cet tādṛk darśayecca tathā punaḥ ।
tadā tvaṃ tvatpatiścaiva premabhaktiprapūritau ।।88 ।।
ātmanivedinau bhūtvā'kariṣyataṃ sutārpaṇam ।
tatpradānaprabhāveṇa śuddhau bhūtvā bhuvaḥ sthalam ।।89।।
parityajya brahmadhāmā'gamiṣyataṃ sumuktike ।
tadā pṛthvī śailahīnā devasthānalayaṃkarā ।।1.193.90।।
oṣadhināśinī tadvat kailāsanāśinī bhavet ।
tanmā bhūditi kṛtvaiva kāraṇaṃ tu vicārya ca ।।9 1 ।।
jāmātuḥ śaṃkarasyaiva droho yathā bhavettathā ।
rūpaṃ tu śaṃbhunā dhāryaṃ sarvaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ param ।।92।।
amanaskatayā putrīdāne mokṣo na vai phalam ।
tadanyattu phalaṃ daśaputrodvāhakṛtaṃ bhavet ।।93 ।।
tatphalaṃ te bhavenmene na vai mokṣaphalaṃ bhavet ।
tatsvāvaguṇadoṣasya grāhārthaṃ śaṃbhunā tathā ।।94।।
darśitaṃ vikaṭaṃ rūpaṃ nāsti tādṛk tu śāśvatam ।
ehi paśya mahādevaṃ mahādevagaṇāँstathā ।।95।।
sarve viṣṇusamākārāḥ susmṛddhāḥ santi sarvathā ।
evaṃ prabodhitā menā kathaṃcitkomalā'bhavat ।।96।।
athāpi viṣṇunā nidarśanaiḥ saṃbodhitā punaḥ ।
yūyaṃ ca ka parṇaḥ- stho vai pāṣāṇarūpadhāriṇaḥ।।।97।।
tathāpi kīdṛśāḥ saumyā devarūpadharāstviha ।
kvacit samrāṭsvarūpāśca kvacitpakṣadharāstathā ।।98।।
evaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ matsyavārāhasiṃharūpadhṛk ।
yathā dharmo vṛṣabho'pi yamo'pi bhavati kvacit ।।99।।
yathā nadyo jalarūpā nārīrūpā bhavanti ca ।
yathā menā pakṣirūpā parvatātmāpi jāyate ।। 1.193.10 0।।
idānīṃ tvaṃ pramadā'si tathā sarve bhavanti vai ।
kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve bhavāmo devajātayaḥ ।। 101 ।।
mohastatra na kartavyaḥ śoko'pi tyajyatāṃ tathā ।
paśya śaṃkarasainyānāṃ rūpāṇi śaṃkarasya ca ।। 1 02।।
kāryārthaṃ tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ dhārayatyakhileśvaraḥ ।
mayāpi śivamohārthaṃ mohinīrūpamāpyate ।। 10 3।।
naropi pramadābhāvaṃ gṛhṇāmi kāryasiddhaye ।
tathā viddhi ca mātastvaṃ haṭha tyaktvā ca śaṃ kuru ।। 1 04।।
pārvatyā yattapastaptaṃ taddhi yogyaṃ kṛtaṃ tayā ।
śaṃkarastoṣito varaṃ dadau yogyaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ।। 1 05।।
vāgdānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ putryāstadetad yogyamityapi ।
śaṃkaraścāpi gṛhṇāti sutāṃ te yogyameva tat ।। 1 06।।
śaṃkaro hyabhavadraudro yogyaṃ tenāpi tatkṛtam ।
tvayā putryarthamātmā svastāpito yogyameva tat ।। 107।।
mātā yadi svīyaputryāḥ kṛte yogyaṃ karoti na ।
tadā'nye ke kariṣyanti haṭho yogyaḥ kṛtastvayā ।। 108 ।।
athāpi devatāḥ sarve'dhikṣiptāśca tvayā hi yat ।
tadapi yogyamevaitad vaivāhike tu karmaṇi ।। 10 9।।
athāpi paśya deveśaṃ surūpaṃ śaṃkaraṃ punaḥ ।
yadi smṛddhaḥ surūpaśca tvanmate'bhimato bhavet ।। 1.193.11 0।।
tadā putrī tvayā deyā nānyathā tu kadācana ।
yadi tvaṃ śaṃkarāyaiva naiva dātuṃ samicchasi ।। 11 1।।
tadā'haṃ saṃgrahīṣye te putrīhastaṃ śucaṃ tyaja ।
itibahuprakāreṇa bodhitā menakā tataḥ ।। 1 12।।
svasthā'bhavat samutthāya draṣṭuṃ śaṃbhuṃ gatā bahiḥ ।
uvāca ca hariṃ menā yadi ramyatanurharaḥ ।। 1 13।।
sarvathā saparikaro mamābhiprāyato bhavet ।
tadā sutā mayā deyā nā'nyathā koṭiyatnakaiḥ ।। 1 14।।
etasminnantare viṣṇurnāradaṃ pairayad drutam ।
anukūlayituṃ śaṃbhuṃ gatvā so'bodhayaddharam ।। 1 15।।
sandeśaṃ prāpya dhṛtavān śaṃmabhū rūpamalaukikam ।
viṣṇorapyadhikaṃ rūpo yauvane ṣoḍaśābdikam।। 116।।
mṛdutve pārvatīsāmyaṃ tanutve sughaṭaṃ śubham ।
puṣṭatve yogyasāpekṣaṃ taijase kṛṣṇato'dhikam । । 1 17।।
lāvaṇye cātha saundarye koṭimanmathato'dhikam ।
bhūṣāsu vastraveṣe ca sarvebhyaścādhikaṃ param ।। 118 ।।
parikareṣu sarveṣu sainyeṣvapi tato'dhikam ।
sarvaṃ bhūtāvalīrūpaṃ tirodhāya navaṃ navam । । 119 ।।
golokasthaṃ yathārūpaṃ vaikuṇṭhasya yathāparam ।
vairājasthaṃ yathā śreṣṭhaṃ sūryacandrendravaibhavam ।। 1.193.120 । ।
tatsarvaṃ ca tato'pyati darśayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ ।
tadānīṃ tatra vāhinyorubhayoḥ pakṣayorapi ।। 121 । ।
nāsti kaścicca yenopamīyeta śaṃkaraṃ tadā ।
santi kecinna vai yaiścopamīyeta ca tajjanam ।। 122 ।।
tāvanmenā candraśālāmāyācca saha viṣṇunā ।
dadarśa śivarūpaṃ tatparamānandasaṃbhṛtam । । 122 । ।
koṭisūrya pratīkāśaṃ mahatsaundaryabhājanam ।
divyavastravibhūṣāḍhyaṃ hāsalāvaṇyavarṣi yat ।। 124 । ।
devīnāṃ kṣobhakaṃ jātaṃ mohinyā api mohakṛt ।
adhairyāḥ skhalitāstatra devyo māyāviḍambitāḥ ।। 125 । ।
sūryeṇa chatritaṃ cāmaritaṃ candreṇa mastake ।
bhūṣitaṃ ca kubereṇa dharmeṇa vāhitaṃ tadā ।। 1 26।।
vyajitaṃ gaṃgayā yamyā nartitaṃ siddhibhistadā ।
uttejitaṃ tathā devairjayetibhāṣitaṃ gaṇaiḥ ।। 127 ।।
gāyitaṃ ca viśvāvasvapsarovrātaiḥ śivāgrataḥ ।
gṛṇitaṃ ca paraṃbrahma munibhiḥ ṛṣibhistathā । । 128 । ।
nārāyaṇāyitaṃ sarvairgaṇaiśca sainikaistadā ।
caturbhujāyitaṃ taiśca tathā samukuṭāyitam ।। 1 2 9 । ।
bhūtapretapiśācādyaistirobhūtāyitaṃ tadā ।
yāvadbhiḥ śaṃkarasainyairviṣṇujanāyita tadā । । 1.193.130 । ।
yāvatībhiśca nārībhirlakṣmīramāyitaṃ tadā ।
vāhanaiścāpi sarvaiśca sadgaruḍāyitaṃ tadā ।। 131 ।।
kimahaṃ varṇaye lakṣmi! sarvaṃ madāyitaṃ tadā ।
dṛṣṭvā tu menakā śokaṃ visasmārā'tiharṣitā । । 132 । ।
hariḥ prāha vinā bhānaṃ tvayā śokāyitaṃ vṛthā ।
paśya śarvaṃ varaṃ mene! kiṃ deyā vā na vā sutā । । 133 ।।
menā prāha prasannāsmi deyā deyā dhruvaṃ dhruvam ।
athā''jagāma tvaritā śailadvāryabhiśaṃkaram ।। 1 34।।
vardhasveti ca saṃbhāṣya saṃstūya śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ ।
duḥkhahānyaṃjalibhiśca samāśīrbhiḥ prayujya ca ।। 1 35।।।
kṣamasveti ca saṃprārthya menā lajjāparā'bhavat ।
puravāsinya āpustaṃ dṛṣṭvā netraphalaṃ tadā ।। 1 36।।
ūcuścāho tapatyā vai sādhitaḥ kīdṛśaḥ patiḥ ।
yadīdaṃ yugalaṃ brahmā na yuñjyācchivayostadā ।। 1 37।।
kṛto'pi saphalo'pyasya śramo niṣphalatāṃ vrajet ।
itthamuktvā nu vanitāścandanaiścā'kṣataistadā ।। 138 ।।
śivaṃ sampūjayāmāsurlājānvavṛṣurādarāt ।
atha śaṃbhurgirerdhāma praviveśa suraiḥ saha ।। 139 ।।
menāpi caṃcalā śīghraṃ svagṛhā''bhyantaraṃ yayau ।
nīrājanārthaṃ śaṃbhośca dīpapātrakarā satī ।। 1.193.140 ।।
vanitābhiḥ saha cābhijagāma dvāramādarāt ।
dṛṣṭvā campakavarṇābhaṃ caikavastraṃ kirīṭinam ।। 141 ।।
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyaṃ ratnasvarṇādibhūṣitam ।
mālatīmālayā yuktaṃ valayāṃgadabhūṣitam ।। 142 ।।
svarṇacamatkṛtidivyavastrottamātirājitam ।
candanā'gurukastūrīcārukuṃkumabhūṣitam ।। 143 ।।
atīva taruṇaṃ sākṣādviṣṇutulyaṃ caturbhujam ।
kāminīkāntacandrāsyaṃ koṭikandarpamohanam ।। 144।।
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā punardṛṣṭvā menā mene kṛtārthatām ।
praśaśaṃsa svakaṃ bhāgyaṃ putrībhāgyaṃ gireḥ kulam ।। 145।।
nīrājanaṃ cakārādau jaharṣa ca punaḥ punaḥ ।
paraṃ vismayamāpannā punaḥ svagṛhamāviśat ।। 146।।
kanyakāḥ kāmayāmāsurīdṛśo'smatpatirbhavet ।
jagurgandharvamūrdhanyā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।। 147।।
vādakā bahuvādyāni vādayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।
himācalastadā snigdho dvārācāramathā'karot ।। 148 ।।
menā kṛtvā parapucchāṃ muditā svagṛhaṃ yayau ।
śarvo nivedinaṃ sthānaṃ jagāma janavāhakaiḥ ।। 149 ।।
tadā nāryaśca kanyāśca vanitā draṣṭumīśvaram ।
sthiranetrā rājamārgapārśvatastasthurādṛtāḥ ।। 1.193.150 ।।
sthānaṃ prāpya viśaśrāma pānatāmbūlabhojanam ।
jagrāha yoganidrāṃ ca svīcakāra haraḥ kṣaṇam ।। 1 5 1 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne menakāyāḥ paramodvegaprayuktapralāpāḥ, menāśokanāśāya viṣṇunā sadṛṣṭāntabahurūpadharatvaṃ sahetukamityupadiṣṭam, harasya viṣṇurūpatā gaṇānāṃ vaiṣṇavarūpatā parāvartitā, menāśailakṛtavardhanādidvārācāraścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 193 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 193 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 194
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 195 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato durgāṃ śailā'ntaḥpuracārikāḥ ।
bahirjagmuḥ pūjayitumādāya kuladevatām ।। 1 ।।
śaṃbhornivāsasaudhasya rājamārgeṇa pārvatī ।
vinirjagāma sā padbhyāṃ cāriṇī spaṣṭadarśanā ।। 2 ।।
tatra tāṃ dadṛśurdevā nimeṣarahitāstadā ।
kāntiścāndrī śāradīva projjvalā svarṇabhūṣaṇā ।। 3 ।।
tāmraraktā suvarṇābhā sthalapadmasvarūpaṇī ।
kamalakusumamṛdvī tejaḥparidhimaṇḍitā ।। 4 ।।
koṭikoṭiratigarvaśobhālāvaṇyasaṃbhṛtā ।
dṛśyate ca caturdaśā'varavarṣā hi kanyakā ।। 5 ।।
brahmatejaḥsusaṃrājatpratyekāṃgottamottamā ।
ramālakṣmīmahālakṣmīndrāṇītejo'dhikaprabhā ।। 6 ।।
dṛśyate sarvanārīṇāṃ devīnāmuttamaśriyā ।
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā sakaṭākṣā manoharā ।। 7 ।।
sucārukabarībhārā bhālapatrakasatprabhā ।
sindūrakuṃkumakastūrikābindusumaṇḍitā ।। 8 ।।
maṇisadratnahīrakasphaṭikasvarṇamālikā ।
ratnakeyūravalayavaṃgiḍīkaṃkaṇānvitā ।। 9 ।।
sadratnakuṇḍalaphullakarṇapūrakaṭānvitā ।
sucandraṭapakīrājaccārugaṇḍasthalojjvalā ।। 1.194.10 ।।
svalpamaṇikalikāvaddantarājivirājitā ।
madhubimbādharauṣṭhā sadratnayāvakasaṃyutā ।। 11 ।।
kāśmīrarasasaktālaktakāḍhyakarapattalā ।
ratnadarpaṇahastā cormikādhṛgaṃgulīvarā ।। 12 ।।
raśanāmitratāprāptaśroṇīdeśāticaṃcalā ।
candanā'gurukastūrīkuṃkumā''vāsacarcitā ।। 13 ।।
kvaṇatkiṃkiṇikārājajjhāṃjharāḍhyaprakoṣṭhakā ।
svarṇamañjirasaṃśobhajjaṃghā'dhogulphakaṇḍikā ।। 1 4। ।
svarṇamālānvitā raṃgakrīḍāpadmavibhūṣitā ।
sarvasamājanetrābjaviṣayā gatimantharā ।। 15 ।।
vikasatsvalpastanayugīṣatprodbhinnayauvanā ।
svarṇatārāvalirājadvastralajjāvaguṇṭhitā ।। 16 ।।
śuśubhe svasakhīkanyāpramadāvargamadhyagā ।
dhyāne'dhomukhadṛṣṭyāḍhyā hṛdi cordhvaṃ harābhigā ।। 17।।
caraṇābhyāṃ tu mārgasthā manohṛdbhyāṃ harāntikā ।
sthūladehena bhūmisthā sūkṣmadehena śaṃbhugā ।। 18 ।।
yadā śaṃbhorvāsasaudhapārśvamārgata āgatā ।
śuśubhe sundarī ramyā sarvadṛṣṭyaikapātrikā ।। 19।।
surāḥ praṇemuḥ śirasā yāntīṃ devīṃ sumenakām ।
trinetro netrakoṇena dṛṣṭvā virahavedanām ।।1.194.20 ।।
jahau sarvaṃ visasmāra harṣād gaurīgalocanaḥ ।
atha kālī bahiḥ puryā gatvā prārcya kulāmbikām ।।21 ।।
prapūjyā''vṛtya janakā''layaṃ viveśa sāṃganā ।
tataḥ śailavaraḥ puṇyā prītyā yajñopavītakam ।।22।।
kārayāmāsa sotsāhaṃ vedamantraiḥ śivasya ca ।
atha devāḥ samunayaḥ praviśyā'ntargṛhaṃ gireḥ ।।।23।।।
śrutyācāra bhavācāraṃ vidhāya ca yathārthataḥ ।
dadurvastravibhūṣāśca śivādhāraṇahetave ।।24।।
prathamaṃ snapayitvā tāṃ bhūṣayitvā'tha kanyakāḥ ।
nīrājayitvā śṛṃgāraṃ kārayāmāsuruttamam ।।।25।।
divyasvarṇamayī mṛdvī ghargharī saṃdhṛtā tathā ।
svarṇaratnānvitā divyā kaṃcukī śāṭikā śubhā ।।26 ।।
vidhṛtā ca tathā devī śobhate sūryasūjjvalā ।
sandhṛtaḥ subhago hāro divyaratnasamanvitaḥ ।।।27।।
valayāni mahārhāṇi pauraṭāni dhṛtāni ca ।
anyānyānakhakeśāntaṃ bhūṣaṇāni dhṛtāni ca ।। 28 ।।
yathāpekṣaṃ yathāyogyaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇasaddravaiḥ ।
evaṃ śivāmalaṃcakruḥ śivapreṣitabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।।29।।
dānaṃ babhūva vividhaṃ sādhuviprebhya ādarāt ।
gītavādyavinodāśca babhūvuścotsavottamāḥ ।। 1.194.30 ।।
atha gargaḥ sudaivajño himavantamabhāṣata ।
śaṃbhuṃ pāṇigrahārthaṃ tvamānaya svīyamaṇḍapam ।। 31 ।।
śailastadā mahāśailān patnīvratamukhān dvijān ।
preṣayāmāsa suprītyā śivasyā''nayanāya ca ।। 3 2।।
savāditramahāghoṣaiḥ ramyamaṃgalapāṇibhiḥ ।
śailairvipraiśca sahitān brahmaghoṣakarān dvijān ।।।3 3 ।।
dṛṣṭvā samāgatān sarve śaṃbhupakṣīyasevakāḥ ।
sajjāścā''san śivaścāpi sasnau sugandhavāriṇā ।।34।।
tāvadāgatya śailasya mantriṇaḥ śaṃkaraṃ tathā ।
viṣṇvādīn janavāhāँśca kṛṣṇaṃ ca vanitāstathā ।।35 ।।
prārthayāṃcakrurādaravinītabhāvanābhṛtāḥ ।
kanyādānocitaḥ kālo vartate gamyatāmiti ।।36 ।।
śivo māṃgalikairdravyaiḥ snātaḥ śṛṃgāritastathā ।
vastrabhūṣāmukuṭādivaraveṣādiśobhitaḥ ।।37।।
āropito vṛṣaskandhe taiḥ sarvai parivāritaḥ ।
nītaḥ śailagṛhaṃ viprairjayaśabdaiśca vardhitaḥ ।।38।।
puro vādyānyavādyantā'gragāścāsan dvijā'drayaḥ ।
tataḥ kṛṣṇabrahmaviṣṇudevakoṭyo yayuḥ śanaiḥ ।।39।।
śaṃbhurbabhau suchatreṇa saṃdhṛtena tu mūrdhani ।
cāmarairvyajanairvījyamānaśca sadvitānakaḥ ।।1.194.40 ।।
vikīryamāṇaḥ kusumairyayau śanaiḥśanaiḥ śivaḥ
tadā śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ ।।41 ।।
punaḥpunaravādyanta vāditrāṇi varotsave ।
tadā tu gāyakāścāgre jaguḥ sanmaṃgalāni vai ।।42।।
nartakyo nanṛtuḥ sarvā nānātālasamanvitāḥ ।
evaṃ samājamadhyasthaḥ prāpa śailāṃgaṇaṃ haraḥ ।।43 ।।
vṛṣāduttārayāmāsurmaheśaṃ parvatādayaḥ ।
saṃpūjitastataḥ śaṃbhuḥ praviṣṭo yajñamaṇḍapam ।।44।।
ninyurgṛhāntaraṃ śaṃbhuṃ praṇemuḥ pupujustathā ।
himālayaśca vidhivannīrājanamathā'karot ।।45 ।।
surādīnsaṃpraṇamyā'tha sammānamakaronmudā ।
prāṃgaṇe sthāpayāmāsa ratnasiṃhāsaneṣu tān ।।46।।
menā nīrājanaṃ cakre sarvanārīsamanvitā ।
gargeṇa madhuparkādi yatkṛtyaṃ tatkṛtaṃ tadā ।।47।।
sumaṃgalaṃ ca yatkarma prastāvasadṛśaṃ kṛtam ।
antarvedyāṃ mahādevo himaśailena veśitaḥ ।।48।।
hutabhuksahitāṃ vedīmāruroha ca śaṃkaraḥ ।
atha śṛṃgāritā strībhiḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ।।49।।
bhrātā sunābhaḥ śaṃbhoścā'bhyāśaṃ kālīṃ nināya tām ।
vedikāyāṃ pārvatī ca niṣasāda nanāma tam ।।1.194.50।।
tatropaviṣṭo gargaśca pratīkṣan ghaṭikāṃ tadā ।
yāvaccheṣā ghaṭī tāvatkṛtavānpraṇavasvaram ।।।51 ।।
puṇyāhaṃ pravadan gargaḥ samādadhre'kṣatāñjalim ।
pārvatyupari vavṛṣe vavṛṣe ca śivopari ।।52।।
tayā saṃpūjito rudro dadhyakṣatakuśāṃbubhiḥ ।
samānarca śivāṃ śaṃbhurlaukikācārasaṃrataḥ ।।53।।
evaṃ parasparaṃ tau tu pārvatīparameśvarau ।
arcayantau śuśubhāte nirīkṣantau parasparam ।।54। ।
nīrājitau ca lakṣmyādistrībhirdevyādibhistadā ।
atha sthālyāṃ mahatyāṃ ca muktāsvarṇormikādibhiḥ ।।55।।
raṃgātmajalamagnaiśca remāte vijayāya tau ।
atha gulālapuṃjaiśca kṣaṇaṃ cikriḍatuśca tau ।।56 ।।
atha gargeṇa cājñapto himavān menayā saha ।
haimaṃ kalaśamādāya sajalaṃ sākṣatādikam । ।57। ।
purohitoktavidhinā vastracandanabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
pādyārghyādibhiśca varaṃ varayāmāsa bhāvataḥ । ।58। ।
tithyādikīrtanaṃ cakruḥ kālajñā dvijasattamā ।
patnīvratastadā vipraḥ sasvastisalilaṃ tadā । ।5 9 । ।
prokṣitavān varavadhvoḥ śirasoḥ sākṣataṃ mudā ।
himācalastadā prāha śaṃbhuṃ gotraṃ kulaṃ vada ।।1.194.6 0 ।।
pravaraṃ nāma vedaṃ ca śākhāṃ śrāvaya sarvathā ।
niruttaramukhaḥ śaṃbhurmaunamāśritya saṃsthitaḥ ।। 61 ।।
tadā tu nāradaḥ prāha gotraṃ nādo'sya vidyate ।
kulaṃ brahmakulaṃ bodhyaṃ vedaḥ satyasaṃkalpatā ।। 62 ।।
pravarāstu trayo'syā''dyāḥ harirnārāyaṇo virāṭa ।
śākhā sadāśivā bodhyā pitā kṛṣṇo yato janiḥ ।।6 3 ।।
mātā kṛṣṇamahecchā ca nānyajjānāmi kiṃcana ।
atha himālayaḥ śrutvā prasanno'bhūcchivopari ।। 6 4।।
yogināṃ kulagotrapravarairvā kiṃ prayojanam ।
evaṃ vadansvakanyādānaṃ cākarodvidhānataḥ ।। 65 ।।
matputrī bhagavan kālīṃ pārvatīṃ girivaṃśajām ।
pitṛṇāmapi dauhitrīṃ pratīcchemāṃ mayā'rpitām ।। 66 । ।
imāṃ kanyāṃ tubhyamahaṃ dadāmi parameśvara ।
