tau ca tapo vidhātuṃ vai sthitau ca nagayordvayoḥ ।
pitroḥ samājñayā śaśvat tepāte dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ।।43।।
prajārakṣārthamevaitau dharmarakṣārthamityapi ।
indrastattapasā bhīto rājyanāśābhiśaṃkitaḥ ।।44।।
preṣayāmāsa sagaṇaṃ kāmaṃ vasantapārśvakam ।
harṣaḥ premā tathā bāṇāḥ dhanuścāpsarasastathā ।।45।।
pavanaśca sugandhāḍhyaḥ śītalo modakṛttathā ।
meghakaṇairmiśritaśca niśāyāḥ samayaḥ śubhaḥ ।।46।।
cāndrajyotsnāpi dhavalā kokilāścātakāstathā ।
mayūrā gāyakāścaiva nartakā vādakāstathā ।।47।।
evaṃ sarve militvaiva na nyūnaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavet ।
tathendrasyā''jñayā sarve kāmena saha saṃgatāḥ ।।48।।
yayuryatra naranārāyaṇau tapataḥ sanmunī ।
prathamaṃ candramāstatra jyotsnāṃ vistārayan sthitaḥ ।।49।।
sarvaṃ śāntaṃ ca dhāvalyadhautamivā'bhavattalam ।
niśā'pi rājasaṃ vegamacchatimirabhāsayā ।।1.208.50 ।।
samaprāsārayattatra samayo'pi ca rājasaḥ ।
rajaḥsaṃkalpamādadhan prottejako'bhavanmuhuḥ ।।5 1।।
kokilā devalokasthā menāścaiva mayūrakāḥ ।
kūjanāni miṣṭaśabdān kekāścārebhire śanaiḥ ।।5 2।।
āmrāḥ puṣpairmañjarībhiḥ śobhante kāmabodhakāḥ ।
vasanto vṛkṣavallīṣu surabhipuṣparūpabhāk ।।53 ।।
sugandhāḍhyāstadā jāto mandaśca śītalo'nilaḥ ।
gāyakā nartakāḥ sarve vādakāścānurūpataḥ ।।54।।
gāyanaṃ nartanaṃ vādyaṃ hyakurvan kāmamiśritam ।
harṣaḥ premā viviśaturnaranārāyaṇau tadā ।।55।।
dhanuṣā mohanādyāśca bāṇāḥ kṣiptā manobhuvā ।
apsarasāṃ gaṇo divyo hāvabhāvavilāsakṛt ।।56।।
vividhāṃgapracālanapradarśanapramohanam ।
cakāronapañcadaśavarṣarūpadharastadā ।।57।।
naranārāyaṇayośca pādau mamarda bhāvataḥ ।
cucumba bahudhā pārśve gatvā gatvā punaḥ punaḥ ।।58।।
kāmasparśāṃstathā cakre gaṇḍahastakasakthiṣu ।
kāmo mumoca vai bāṇān pariśramamagāt tataḥ ।।59।।
sarvavikārayoge'pi naranārāyaṇau yathā ।
sthitau tu niścalanetrau tapasyeva tathā sthitau ।।1.208.60।।
manāgapi na calitau dhyānamagnau tathā sthitau ।
samājaśca tadā kāmadevasya niṣphalo'bhavat ।।61।।
tapodhvaṃsaṃ prakartuṃ te samarthā nā'bhavanyadā ।
vimanaskā gatāḥ sarve mahendramūcurasthirāḥ ।।62।।।
na tatrā'smadbalaṃ kiñcidvikramate hi niṣphalam ।
sarvaṃ jātaṃ kṛtaṃ yadyat kūrmaścājñāṃ yathā hareḥ ।।63।।
indraḥ śrutvā ca tānsarvān nītvā tatsthalamāyayau ।
punaḥ kāmaprayogāँśca kārayāmāsa tāँstathā ।।64।।
niṣphalā abhavan samyak samādhisthahareḥ puraḥ ।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ dhyānādutthāyā''ha samāgatān ।।65।।
kimarthamāgatā yūyamātithyaṃ gṛhyatāmiti ।
ityuktvā phalamūlāni tebhyo dadau sa bhūriśaḥ ।।66।।
nārāyaṇastataḥ prāha naraṃ paśyendramaṇḍalam ।
apsarobhirmahendro'yaṃ garvaṃ karoti mānase ।।67।।
naitādṛśyo'nyatra santi mohikā vai surāṃganāḥ ।
na ca jānātyayaṃ me tvaiśvaryaleśaṃ vimohitaḥ ।।68।।
mayaiva racitāḥ sarvā mayi līnā bhavanti ca ।
mayaiva poṣitā rūpavatyo jānāti naiva saḥ ।।69 ।।
tasmādānaya cāmrāṇāṃ mañjarīrgaccha mā ciram ।
tāśca vāmena sakthnā tvaṃ mardayā'tra hi sannidhau ।।1.208.70।।
naraiṇaivaṃ kṛte tatrotpannā nārī mahojjvalā ।
ūrorjātā corvaśī sā dvādaśādvāpi kāmukī ।।71 ।।
rūpānurūpā'vayavā yadagre'psaraso'sitāḥ ।
nistejaskāstadā jātāḥ kāmo'pi garvakhaṇḍitaḥ ।।72।।
indro mlānānano jāto dṛṣṭvorvaśīṃ navīkṛtām ।
yasya sparśena puṣpādvai śreṣṭhaṃ trilokasundaram ।।73।।
nārīratnaṃ samutpannaṃ kastaṃ mohayituṃ kṣamaḥ ।
matvaivaṃ ca kṣamāyācanārthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ yayau ।।74।।
patitaḥ pādayoḥ śīghraṃ trāhi kṛtāparādhataḥ ।
uvāca vihvalo bhūtvā cāparādhīva mānavaḥ ।।75।।
nārāyaṇastadā prāha tava kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ।
gaṇayāmi nā'parādhaṃ svargaṃ yāhi sukhī bhava ।।।76 ।।
tapaścarāmi lokānāṃ prasukhārthaṃ na tṛṣṇayā ।
rājyasya tava cānyasya pārameṣṭhyasya vā kṛte ।।77।।
na me tṛṣṇāsti rājyasya na te rājye spṛhā mama ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cidacitsarvaṃ mama rājyaṃ hi śāśvatam ।।78।।
mayā kṛtamidaṃ viśvaṃ nāhaṃ muhyāmi tatra vai ।
tvaṃ yathā prākṛtaṃ matvā mohayituṃ ca tāpasam ।।79।।
kṛtavānvai śramaṃ sarvaṃ vṛthā nārāyaṇe mayi ।
indro nārāyaṇaṃ natvā mohito corvaśīmaye ।।1.208.80।।
māyākārye surūpe ca yayāce tāṃ hareḥ punaḥ ।
bhagavannīdṛśaṃ ratnaṃ tāpasānāṃ ca vighnakṛt ।।8 1 ।।
svargayogyaṃ ca me bhāti nā'nayā te prayojanam ।
dehi tasmācca me nātha yāce'haṃ kiṃkarastava ।।82।।
punarnaivā'parādhaṃ vai kariṣye te tapovidhau ।
nārāyaṇena śrutvaitaddattorvaśī ca sundarī ।।।83।।
indrāya so'pi hṛṣṭaḥ san yayau svargaṃ samaṇḍalaḥ ।
yatrorvaśī samutpannānarasakthipramardanāt ।।84।।
tatsthale jalasampannamurvaśīkuṇḍatīrthakam ।
tatra snātvā vidhānena hyupoṣya rajanīdvayam ।।85।।
pūjayitvā hariṃ tatra naro nārāyaṇo bhavet ।
sakāmasya corvaśīsannibhā devī bhaved divi ।।86।।
urvaśīkuṇḍamāsādya kāmanāprabalo janaḥ ।
urvaśīlokamāpnuyāt snānamātreṇa bhāvataḥ ।।87।।
sadaiva bhagavāँstatra corvaśīkuṇḍasannidhau ।
prāṇināṃ kampayan śreyastapomūrtirvyavasthitaḥ ।।88।।
kīṭāḥ pataṃgāḥ śakuntā hasanti divi devatāḥ ।
bhuktimuktisamāyuktā vayaṃ yūyaṃ vimuktidāḥ ।।89।।
urvaśīkuṇḍamāsādya dinamekaṃ vasennaraḥ ।
urvaśīdakṣiṇe bhāge hyāyudhāni jagatpateḥ ।।1.208.90।।
vidyante darśanātteṣāṃ na śastrabhayabhāgbhavet ।
bahūni santi tīrthāni girau nārāyaṇāśrite ।।91 ।।
tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi nānyo vai prākṛto janaḥ ।
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā śrāvayedvā samāhitaḥ ।।92।।
paṭhedvā pāṭhayettasya tattattīrthaphalaṃ bhavet ।
sarvapāpāni nirdhūya sālokyaṃ prāpnuyāddhareḥ ।।।93।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne somakuṇḍatīrthādityatīrtha catuḥpuruṣārthatīrthorvaśīsamutpattitīrthādivarṇananāmā'ṣṭā'dhikadviśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 208 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 208 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 209
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 210 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi yayau paścānnārado merusaṃjñakam ।
sthalaṃ tīrthaṃ śubhaṃ brahmakuṇḍāddakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ।। 1 ।।
narā''vāsagirirmeruḥ sthāpito hariṇā'tra saḥ ।
yadā bhagavatā vāso viśālāyāṃ kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tadā meruṃ vihāyaiva savidyādharacāraṇāḥ ।
devā maharṣayaḥ siddhā harerdarśanalālasāḥ ।। 3 ।।
viśālāyāṃ sadā sthātuṃ samāyātāḥ samutsukāḥ ।
bhagavaddarśanalabdhitiraskṛtatadālayāḥ ।। 4 ।।
merurdevādihīno 3 jātaḥ śokaṃ cakāra ha ।
bhūtvā dīno yayau nārāyaṇaṃ prārthanahetave ।। 5 ।।
prāha he bhagavan sarve tava darśanalālasāḥ ।
māṃ vihāyā'tra saṃyātā vinā'haṃ vasatiṃ śubhām ।। 6 ।।
śobhe nāto mayā tatra naiva vastavyameva ha ।
ahamapyatra vasitumicchāmi caraṇe tava ।। 7 ।।
bhagavāँśca tadā prāha naivaṃ kṣemāya vai bhavet ।
tava sthityā caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ sthitirmatā ।। 8 ।।
tasmāddevādibhistatra sthātavyaṃ vai madājñayā ।
dvitīyasvasvarūpaiśca sthātavyamatra caiva yat ।। 9 ।।
tvayā'pyatra dvitīyena svarūpeṇa mamāśrame ।
sadā sthātavyamevā'tra matsevā lābhasaṃbhavāt ।। 1.209.10 ।।
ityājñāṃ samanuprāpya meruśṛṃgāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
rūpaṃ dvitīyamāsādya samāyātāni sūkṣmataḥ ।। 1 1।।
tāni kāṃcanarūpāṇi hariṇā svakareṇa hi ।
gṛhītāni sthāpitāni sarvavāsāya tatra vai ।। 1 2।।
sarve cālokya śṛṃgāṇi svarṇarūpāṇi harṣitāḥ ।
prasannāstuṣṭuvurdevaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛpākaram ।। 13 ।।
dayālurbhagavān devo divānāṃ sukhahetave ।
meroḥ 'śṛṃgāṇyānināya tasmai namo vidhema ca ।। 14।।
bhaktakṛpālpabhaktestu bahudhā phalado'sti yaḥ ।
so'yaṃ kṛpālayo devastuṣyatāṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।। 15।।
sakaruṇaḥ sadā śikṣāṃ piteva vidhāti naḥ ।
karuṇāsāgaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prapāyād vipado'pi naḥ ।। 16।।
vidyādharāṇāṃ siddhānāmṛṣīṇāṃ mānaseṣṭadaḥ ।
sadā rakṣatu naścātra bhagavān bhaktarakṣakaḥ ।। 17।।
tatastuṣṭo hi bhagavān varaṃ vṛṇudhvamāha tān ।
devāḥ prāhurmeruśṛṃgāṇi paśyanti ca ye janāḥ ।। 18।।
teṣāṃ tava prasādena merau vāsau hi jāyatām ।
tvayā naitatsthalaṃ tyājyaṃ merustyājyo na vai tathā ।। 19।।
merau vāsaṃ ca labdhānāṃ bhogā'nte'stu layastvayi ।
evamastviti saṃbhāṣya tatraivā'ntarhito hariḥ ।।1.209.20।।
tataḥ prabhṛti devādyā naranārāyaṇāśrame ।
kvacinmerau kvacitsvarge kvacidvai raivatācale ।।21।।
nirviśaṃkā nivasanti yatra nārāyaṇo naraḥ ।
evaṃ vai nārado merutīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayau tataḥ ।। 22।।
lokapālairadhiśritaṃ tīrthaṃ saumyaṃ saroyutam ।
hariḥ svayaṃ gato merau dṛṣṭāstatra ca devatāḥ ।।23।।
ṛṣayaścātha munayo lokapālāḥ surādayaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā''ha lokapālānsaḥ yūyaṃ rājāna eva vai ।। 24।।
ṛṣyādivasatau vāso na yogyau bhavatāṃ kṛte ।
āgacchantu mayā klṛpte sthāne yogye bhavatkṛte ।।25।।
nivasantu ca tatraiva mama sānnidhyamāśritāḥ।
ityānītā lokapālā merumadhyapradeśataḥ ।। 26।।
sthāpitāstatsukhārthaṃ ca jalāśayo mahān kṛtaḥ ।
daṇḍena ca bhuvaṃ hatvā krīḍāpuṣkariṇī kṛtā ।।27।।
lokapālāśca gandharvā gīrvāṇāḥ pramadāyutāḥ ।
vicarantyanumodante pragāyanti ca sarvadā ।।28।।
vanāni kusumāmodaramyāṇi ca kṛtāni vai ।
bhagavānapi sarveṣāmatyānandaṃ samāvahan ।।29।।
dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca svayamāyāti majjane ।
dṛśyate paramaṃ tejo jale madhyāhnakālataḥ ।।1.209.3 0।।
sarvatīrthāvagāhasya phalaṃ tatraiva labhyate ।
daṇḍapuṣkariṇītīrthamihā'mutra phalapradam ।।3 1 ।।
piṇḍadānācca jāyeta gayāto'ṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam ।
dvādaśyāṃ śuklapakṣasya jyeṣṭhamāse'tra puṣkare ।।32। ।
yajñaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyo bhavejjanaḥ ।
akṣayyaṃ phalamaśnāti mokṣaṃ yāti tataḥ param ।।33।।
badarītīrthamadhye tu guptametaddhi vartate ।
bahuprasūtapuṇyā vai paśyantyetanna cetare ।।34।।
iti daṇḍodakaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā ca nārado yayau ।
gaṃgāyāṃ mānasodbhedasaṃgame tīrthasūttame ।।35।।
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi prayāge tapasaḥ phalam ।
tatphalaṃ mānasodbhede tīrthe snānakṛtaṃ bhavet ।।36।।।
saṃgamāddakṣiṇe bhāge dharmasya bhavanaṃ śubham ।
yatra mūrtyāṃ janma cāptau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।।37।।
yatra dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ satyaṃ yajñastapastathā ।
dānaṃ ceti vartate smā'nuṣṭhitasyā'kṣayaṃ phalam ।। 38।।
tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge urvaśīsaṃgamābhidham ।
kūrmoddhārastatastīrthaṃ snānātsattvasya śuddhikṛt ।। 39।।
brahmāvartastatastīrthaṃ brahmalokapradaṃ hi tat ।
evaṃ bahūni tīrthāni bhavanti badarīvane ।।1.209.40।।
darśanātsmaraṇātsnānātpānādācamanāttathā ।
mārjanātpāpahantṝṇi mokṣadāni ca yogataḥ ।।41।।
kṛtvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni nāradaḥ punarāyayau ।
narasyā''śramamādivyaṃ sthitvā naramukhāttataḥ ।।42।।
śuśrāva kṣetramāhātmyaṃ śāntyaikāgradhiyā''rttihṛt ।
badaryākhyaṃ hareḥ kṣetraṃ triṣu lokeṣu durlabham ।।43।।
smaraṇāścāsya pāpāni naśyanti dāruṇānyapi ।
anyatīrthe kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ badaryāḥ smaraṇādbhavet ।।44।।
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ vāyubhojyasya yatphalam ।
kṣetrāntare badaryāṃ tu tatphalaṃ kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।।45।।
kṛte muktipradā nāmnā tretāyāṃ yogasiddhidā ।
viśālā dvāpare nāmnā kalau badryāśramo hi saḥ ।।46।।
mukteḥ pradā ca yogasya siddhidā sarvathā yathā ।
śālātmakasya dehasya viśālā tu vināśanāt ।।47।।
badarītaruyogāddhi badarikāśramo hi saḥ ।
tyajetsarvāṇi tīrthāni kāle yugāntare'pi ca ।।48।।
badarīṃ tu harirnārāyaṇo muñcati naiva hi ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi yogātkāśyāṃ tu yatphalam ।।49।।
badaryā tu dinaikena tatphalaṃ samavāpyate ।
devatīrtharṣīṇāṃ śālā viśiṣṭāḥ santi yatra hi ।।1.209.50।।
viśālā ca matā sārthā śālā jñānasya vestathā ।
viśālā'nādisiddhā sā yathā vedā harestanuḥ ।।5 1।।
anyatra maraṇānmuktiḥ svadharmavidhipūrvakāt ।
badarīdarśanādeva muktiṃ puṃsāṃ kare sthitā ।।52।।
dharmādharmau vijityā'tha badarīśaṃ narāyaṇam ।
dṛṣṭvā muktiṃ tūpayāti vinā''yāsaṃ jano'tra vai ।।53।।
sarvayugeṣu bhagavān vaikuṇṭhasadṛśīṃ śubhām ।
badarīṃ samanuprāpya sākṣādevā'vatiṣṭhate ।।54।।
vinā jñānena yogena tīrthāṭanapariśramaiḥ ।
ekena janmanā jantuḥ kaivalyapadamaśrute ।।55।।
janmāntarasahasraiśca yena cārādhito hariḥ ।
sa gacched badarīṃ draṣṭuṃ yatra gatvā na śocati ।।56।।
badarībadarītyuktvā prasaṃgānmuktibhāgbhavet ।
viśālāṃ badarīṃ dṛṣṭvā puṃso mṛtyubhayaṃ kutaḥ ।।57।।।
saśailakānanā pṛthvī daśadhā dakṣiṇīkṛtā ।
hareḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ bhūmau badaryāṃ tu pade pade ।।58।।
aśvamedhasya yajñasya vājapeyaśatasya ca ।
hareḥ pradakṣiṇāyāśca puṇyaṃ pade padetra vai ।।59।।
badaryāṃ bhagavānatti yadannaṃ divyatāṃ gatam ।
tatsattvaśuddhaye sarvairbhoktavyamavicāritam ।।1.209.60।।
amarā harinaivedyaṃ bhoktuṃ bhavanti tatparāḥ ।
bālyayauvanavārdhakye kṛtaṃ prāṇāntapātakam ।।6 1।।
viṣṇorniveditaṃ bhuktvā badaryāṃ tannivartate ।
naivedyabhakṣaṇādatra sālokyaṃ labhate hareḥ ।।62।।
hṛdi rūpaṃ mukhe nāma naivedyamudare hareḥ ।
pādodakaṃ sanirmālyaṃ mastake yasya so'cyutaḥ ।।63।।
brahmahatyādipāpāni naśyanti caraṇāmṛtāt ।
kiṃ dānaistapasā tīrthairniyamaiśca pariśramaiḥ ।।64।।
badaryā viṣṇupādāderbindumātraṃ miled yadi ।
sūryagrahe kurukṣetre mahādānaphalaṃ hi yat ।।65।।
badaryāṃ grāsamātreṇa cāturmāsyaphalādhikam ।
vedāntaśravaṇātpuṇyaṃ badaryāṃ caraṇāmṛtāt ।।66।।।
badaryāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ ye gṛhṇanti jaḍā api ।
muktiḥ karatale teṣāṃ bhūmikādarśanādapi ।।67।।
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayeccāpi pāṭhayet ।
paṭhedvā pāpamuktaḥ saḥ padaṃ viṣṇoḥ prapadyate ।।68।।
rājā vijayamāpnoti sutārthī labhate sutam ।
kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ kanyā vindati satpatim ।।69।।
dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti vyādhyādhyadhananāśanam ।
daurbhāgyā'pamṛtyugrahaduḥsvapnādivināśanam ।।1.209.7 0 ।।
śrutvā natvā naranārāyaṇau bhuktvā prasādakam ।
yayau satyaṃ brahmalokaṃ vivāhārthaṃ sa nāradaḥ ।।7 1।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne merutīrthadaṇḍapuṣkariṇīmānasodbhedanaranārāyaṇajanmasthānadharmorvaśīsaॆgamakūrmoddhārabrahmāvartāditīrtha-
tatkṣetraprasādacaraṇāmṛtamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā navā'dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।209।।।


← adhyāyaḥ 209 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 210
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 211 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi! nārado haribhaktimān ।
jagāma bhavanaṃ svasya brahmā tuṣṭo'bhavad bahu ।। 1 ।।
tīrthayātrāṃ vidhāyā'bhyāgatasya nāradasya ca ।
yogyamutsavamāreme samāhūya surādikān ।। 2 ।।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo viṣṇuścāpi ramāpatiḥ ।
śivaścānye lokapālāḥ ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ ।। 3 ।।
brahmasabhā tadā divyā śuśubhe brahmadhāmavat ।
brahmā putraṃ nāradaṃ vai sabhāyāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satām ।। 4 ।।
nāradaṃ prāha dharmyaṃ sadvacaḥ śaṃkarasannidhau ।
upabarhaṇagandharvaḥ paṃcāśatkāminīpatiḥ ।। 5 ।।
janmāntare bhavānāsīdadhunā brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।
tāsvekā ca satī mālāvatī tapasā śaṃkaram ।। 6 ।।
ārādhya ca varaṃ lebhe vāñchitaṃ nāradaṃ patim ।
sā ca sṛṃjayakanyā'sti svarṇaṣṭhīvīsahodarā ।। 7 ।।
tāṃ vivāhaṃ kuruṣveti śaṃkarājñāṃ prapālaya ।
sundarīṃ sundarīṣveva pātivrataparāyaṇām ।। 8 ।।
kamanīyāṃ haravarāt śaśvatsusthirayauvanām ।
vidhātrā likhitāṃ bhāle vivāhaya ca nārada ।। 9 ।।
tvayā pūrvaṃ yathoktaṃ vai tīrthayātrottaraṃ tathā ।
vivāhabhāgyamāpannaṃ prāktanaṃ kena vāryate ।। 1.210.10 ।।
nā'yuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kālakoṭiśatairapi ।
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham ।। 1 1।।
brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā pitrājñāpālakastadā ।
nārado vinayaṃ kṛtvā nanāma sarvadevatāḥ ।। 12।।
pitrā''diṣṭaṃ sadaivedaṃ dhāryate ca mayā punaḥ ।
bhavatāṃ kṛpayā tatra bandhanaṃ me bhavennahi ।। 1 3।।
varaṃ vṛṇomi bhagavadbhaktimanmānasaṃ bhavet ।
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ śivaścāhustathāstviti ।। 14।।
praṇamya prayayau devān nāradaḥ sṛṃjayālayam ।
dṛṣṭvā sa mohito ramyāṃ divyāṃ sṛṃjayakanyakām ।। 15 ।।
tapasvinīṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇuvrataparāyaṇām ।
svīkṛtya manasā tāṃ ca śubhāṃ provāca nāradaḥ ।। 16 ।।
bāle jānāsi māṃ vā na tvāṃ jānāmi tu pūrvajām ।
mālāvatītivikhyātāṃ gandharvapramadottamām ।। 17।।
śrutvā mālāvatī dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ ca mumoha ca ।
pratyabhijñāya pūrvasya janmanaḥ patimeva ca ।। 18।।
pādayoḥ patitā śīghraṃ cucumba varaṇāya sā ।
nārado'pi yayāce tāṃ tatpituḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ ।। 1 9।।
mālāvatyabhiprāyaṃ ca jñātvā śrīsṛṃjayaḥ svayam ।
vākdānena dadau tasmai nāradāya svaputrikām ।। 1.210.20 ।।
tilakaṃ bhojanaṃ kṛtvā vastraśāṭīṃ pradāya ca ।
nāradaḥ śvaśuraṃ natvā śvaśrūṃ pṛṣṭvā priyāṃ tathā ।। 21 ।।
yayau brahmasabhāṃ ramyāṃ sarvadevādhivāsitām ।
praṇamya pitaraṃ śāntaḥ sarvaṃ tattvamuvāca tam ।। 22।।
brahmā prahṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrutvā vākgdānamaṃgalam ।
cakre samutsavaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvānāhūya ceśvarān ।। 23 । ।
munīnṛṣīṃstathā pitṝn devān daityāṃśca dānavān ।
kāśyapīśca prajāḥ sarvāścakārā''hūya maṃgalam ।। 24।।
sṛṃjayaḥ preṣayāmāsa vipreṇa lagnapatrikām ।
brahmā svīkṛtya tāṃ putraṃ lokācāramakārayat ।। 25।।
vivāhasya muhūrtaṃ ca vācayāmāsa tatra vai ।
bhojanāni vividhāni kārayāmāsa viśvasṛṭ ।। 26 ।।
dānayānopakaraṇapeyā''dheyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ।
bhojyajātāni vastūni kārayāmāsa viśvasṛṭ ।। 27।।
śubhe kṣaṇe svayaṃ brahmā koṭyabjā'rbudakoṭibhiḥ ।
surāsurairjanavāhaistattannārīsamanvitaiḥ ।। 28 ।।
sahito ratnayānaiśca varayātrāmakalpayat ।
putraṃ kṛtvā ca purato janasenāṃ suśobhitām ।। 29 ।।
mahīmānā'rbudakoṭikoṭyarbudasamanvitām ।
nītvā śaṃbhvacyutayukto yayau sṛṃjayamandiram ।। 1.210.30 ।।
sṛṃjayaḥ satkṛtaye'bhiyayau svajanabāndhavaiḥ ।
varasya vāhinīṃ svasyodyāne cāsthāpayatkṣaṇam ।। 31 ।।
jalapānaṃ ca viśrāntiṃ kārayitvā ca bhojanam ।
varaṃ sāyaṃ bhūṣayitvā nināya maṇḍapaṃ prati ।। 32।।
kanyāyāśca kṛte vastrabhūṣagāni bahūni ca ।
preṣayāmāsa ramyāṇi brahmā vai svānurūpataḥ ।। 32 ।।
dvāre pūjāṃ śiṣṭācāraṃ vidhāya sṛṃjayaḥ ।
lokācāraṃ vidhāyā'thā'pūjayannāradaṃ varam ।। 34।।
mukhyāgnivedikāyāśca samīpe'tiṣṭhipadvaram ।
kanyāṃ śṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyāmānayāmāsa tatra ca ।। 35 ।।
brāhmaṇairmunibhistatra saptarṣibhiśca bhūsuraiḥ ।
māṃgalyamantrāḥ paṭhitā dehaśuddhiśca kāritā ।। 36 ।।
vastragranthiṃ bandhayitvā varamālāṃ samarpya ca ।
kanyāhastaṃ varahaste dadau sṛṃjayarāṭ svayam ।। 37।।
vedaghoṣāstadā jātā vādyānyavādayaँstathā ।
vadhūḥ kavalamādāya nāradāsye dadau tadā ।। 38।।
nārado'pi navavadhvā mukhe grāsaṃ dadau śubham ।
agneḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā homakāryaṃ cakāra vai ।। 39 ।।
śiṣṭācāraṃ paraṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।
vivāhakāryaṃ sarvaṃ saḥ samāptamakarottadā ।।1.210.4 0 ।।
kanyāyāśca yautadravyaṃ varasyāpi prapūjanam ।
dattaṃ kṛtaṃ janaiḥ sarvairbhojanaṃ svīkṛtaṃ tataḥ ।।4 1 ।।
nidrāṃ kṛtvā samājaśca prātarmaṃgalavādanam ।
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gandharvāpsarasāṃ vyalokayat ।।42 ।।
bahudānāni dattāni bhojanāni ca sarvathā ।
kāritāni sṛṃjayena prāghūṇikāḥ samānitāḥ ।।43 ।।
sarvasvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā maṇimuktādikaṃ tathā ।
puṭāṃjaliyuto bhūtvā parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।।44।।
sṛṃjayaśca śubho rājā kanyāṃ samarpya bhāvataḥ ।
vāhinīṃ yāpayāmāsa vinayena mudānvitaḥ ।।45 ।।
sṛṃjayastasya patnī ca kanyāviyogasaṃbhavam ।
sehāte na tadā duḥkhaṃ rurudāte kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।। 46 ।।
kanyāpi rurude snehād viyogārtisumiśritāt ।
praṇamya pitarau kanyā rudantau mātaraṃ tathā ।। 47।।
āśliṣya dhairyamādāya cā''ruroha rathaṃ vidheḥ ।
gṛhītvā ca sabhāryaṃ taṃ putraṃ dhātā mudānvitaḥ ।।48 ।।
lokācāraṃ ca satkṛtya brahmalokaṃ yayau sukham ।
ṛṣīnmunīṃstathā devān pitṝn siddhāँśca mānavān ।। 49।।
viprāँśca bhojayāmāsa sāṃ'ge maṃgalakarmaṇi ।
dānāni dāpayāmāsa vādayāmāsa dundubhim ।।1.210.5 0 ।।
yāpayāmāsa sarvāṃśca mahīmānānsurā'surān ।
nāradastu muniśreṣṭho likhitena svakarmaṇā ।।5 1 ।।
suramye puṣpatalpe ca sugandhicandanārcite।
sa reme ramayā sārdhaṃ bubudhe na divāniśam ।।52।।
ekadā nāradastatra vaṭamūle vyavasthitaḥ ।
tatrā''jagāma nagnaśca prajvalan brahmatejasā ।।।53।।
sanatkumāro bhagavān bālakaḥ pañcahāyanaḥ ।
acūḍo'nupanītaśca vedasandhyāvihīnakaḥ ।।54।।
kṛṣṇamantraṃ japan tribhirbhrātṛbhiḥ sahitastadā ।
vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśo jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ ।।55।।।
nārāyaṇo gururyasya darśanānmuktido muniḥ ।
ārād dṛṣṭvā nāradastaṃ bhrātaraṃ ca satāṃ varam ।।56।।
natvā ca daṇḍavat bhūmau dadāvāsanamuttamam ।
uvāca bālakastatra prahasya nāradaṃ śubham ।।57।।
aye bhrātaḥ kiṃ karoṣi kuśalaṃ yuvatīpate ।
strīpuṃsorvardhate prema kāmavegānnavaṃ navam ।।58।।
argalaṃ jñānamārgasya bhaktimārganirodhakam ।
mokṣamārgavyavadhānaṃ śaśvadbandhanadaṃ matam ।।59।।
nārāyaṇā'mṛtaṃ tyaktvā viṣaṃ viṣiyajā'mṛtam ।
viṣaye'tiprasakto vai matvā bhuṃkte'timūḍhavat ।।1.210.60।।
sudhāṃ tyaktvā viṣaṃ cā'tti māyāmohavaśaṃgataḥ ।
tvaṃ tu bhaktaścātmavettā jīvanmukto'si sarvadā ।।6 1।।
nirgaccha tapase bhrātarmāyāṃ patnīṃ vihāya vai ।
sthite nārāyaṇe pṛthvyāṃ bhaja taṃ tapasā sadā ।।62।।
gṛhāṇa mama mantraṃ ca kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam ।
nārāyaṇānmayā labdhaste mantraṃ taṃ dadāmyaham ।।63।।
ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ dadau śubhāśiṣaṃ tathā ।
golokaṃ prayayau draṣṭuṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 64।।
nārado mālayā nityaṃ japati dvyakṣaraṃ manum ।
śrīkṛṣṇe niścalāṃ bhaktiṃ pūrvakarmanikṛntanīm ।।65।।
cakārā'bhyāsavairāgyasahitāmātmavedinīm ।
bhāryāṃ dvilakṣavarṣāṇi bhuktvā sutāḥ sutāँstathā ।।66 ।।
lakṣānutpādya gandharvān gandharvīrlakṣakanyakāḥ ।
sarvāpatyāni gāndharvaloke saṃsthāpya śaktitaḥ ।।67।।
sarvāṃśca vaiṣṇavān kṛtvā bhaktiṃ nirdiśya mādhave ।
patnīṃ ca rāgarahitāṃ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ pradiśya ca ।।68।।
tatkauśalyaṃ sutebhyaśca vinirdiśya yayau muniḥ ।
kṛtamālānadītīre tapase sa mano'karot ।।6 9।।
tatra dadarśa śaṃbhuṃ saḥ pūrvaguruṃ sanātanam ।
dṛṣṭvā ca nārado mūrdhnā praṇanāma śivaṃ gurum ।।1.210.70।।
śivaḥ provāca dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ prasanno'haṃ bhavāmi vai ।
bhaktānāṃ darśanaṃ yatra sudinaṃ taccharīriṇām ।।7 1 ।।
ayaṃ hi paramo lābho bhaktānāṃ saṃgamo yadā ।
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yo dadarśa ca vaiṣṇavam ।।72 ।।
goloke kṛṣṇadatto vai mantro dvyakṣara eva yaḥ ।
kṛṣṇa iti mayā prāpto dharmeṇa brahmaṇā tathā ।।73 ।।
dharmo nārāyaṇāyā'rthasahitaṃ pradadau tataḥ ।
brahmā sanatkumārāya tubhyaṃ dattaśca tena vai ।।74।।
mantragrahaṇamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet ।
pañcalakṣajapenā'sya puraścaraṇamucyate । ।75 ।।
dhyānaṃ ca pāpadahanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyettu vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
kiśoramūrtiṃ jīmūtasamavarṇaṃ manoharam ।।76 ।।
pītāmbaraṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram ।
amūlyaratnakhacitābhūṣaṇādivibhūṣitam ।।77।।
candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam ।
mayūrabarhacūḍaṃ ca ratnamālāvirājitam ।।78 ।।
prasannahāsyavilasanmukhaṃ saundaryabhājanam ।
bhaktānugrahakartāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sarvadā bhaje ।।79 ।।
śaṃbhurevaṃ smārayitvā'dṛśyabhāvaṃ gatastataḥ ।
nārado'pi hariṃ smṛtvā tapaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam ।।1.210.8 0 ।।
bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ prāpya dehaṃ divyaṃ vidhāya ca ।
nityamuktasvarūpo'bhūt golokādyahatasṛtiḥ ।।8 1 ।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! nāradasya vivāhanam ।
yacchrutvāpi virajyeta kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।82 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāradasya brahmasabhāgamanaṃ, brahmaṇā vivāhāya kathitam, sṛṃjayasya putryā mālāvatyā vivāhāya nāradasya varayātrā, lagnaṃ, lakṣaputrān lakṣaputrīṃścotpādya dvilakṣavarṣottaraṃ kṛtamālātīre tapase gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā daśā'dhikadvi-śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 210 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 210 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 211
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 212 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
agnayo vai brahmamukhā brahmāṃśā yajñadevatāḥ ।
kadā kasmātsamutpannāstatkathāṃ śrāvaya prabho ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
uṣṇasparśavataścāgneḥ kāryātmakasya kāraṇam ।
devaḥ sa cetano vahnirbrahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ ।। 2 ।।
agnyabhimānidevaḥ saḥ tasmāt svāhā vyajāyata ।
pāvakaḥ pavamānaśca śuciśceti trayaḥ sutāḥ ।। 3 ।।
sauraḥ śucirbhavatyeva pāvakā vaidyutā matāḥ ।
śrāddhe vahniḥ pavamānastatsutaḥ kavyavāhanaḥ .।। 4 ।।
pāvakasya suputro'bhūt saharakṣābhidhastathā ।
śuceḥ putro havyavāho devānāṃ bhojanapradaḥ ।। 5 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ kavyavāhaścā'surāṇāṃ saharakṣakaḥ ।
eteṣāṃ putrapautrāśca catvāriṃśattathā nava ।। 6 ।।
vaidyutasya brahmaudanastatsuto bharatāhvayaḥ ।
tasya vaiśvānaravahnistasya kāvyo hyapāṃ rasaḥ ।। 7 ।।
puṣkarodadhimathanādatharvā'gnirajāyata ।
tasya sutaśca dadhyaṃgo bodhyo vai vahnimaṇḍale ।। 8 ।।
atharvā ca bhṛguḥ prokto'ṅgirāścā'tharvaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।
ataśca bhārgavoṃ'girā laukikāgniḥ prakathyate ।। 9 ।।
pavamānastu nirmathyo gārhapatyo'pi nāmataḥ ।
tasya putradvayaṃ śaṃsyaḥ śukraśceti pranāmataḥ ।। 1.211.1 0।।
śaṃsyastvāhavanīyo'gniryo havyavāṭ kriyātmakaḥ ।
tathā sabhyā'vasathyau dvau śaṃsyasyā'gneḥ sutau matau ।। 11 ।।
śaṃsyastu ṣoḍaśanadīścakame pramadāvarāḥ ।
kāverīṃ kṛṣṇaveṇīṃ ca narmadāṃ yamunāṃ tathā ।। 1 2।।
godāvarīṃ vitastāṃ ca candrabhāgāmirāvatīm ।
vipāśāṃ kauśikīṃ caiva śatadruṃ sarayūṃ tathā ।। 13 ।।
sītāṃ sarasvatīṃ caiva hrādinīṃ pāvanīṃ ca tāḥ ।
tāsūtpannā hyagnayo ye dhiṣṇayaste prakīrtitāḥ ।। 14।।
ṛtuḥ pravāhaṇognīdhraḥ samrāḍagniḥ kṛśānukaḥ ।
samrāḍagnayastvaṣṭau ca parṣannāmnā nabhastathā ।। 15।।
vasuśca havyasūryaśca viśvasyāyaśca paṃcamaḥ ।
ṛtudhāmā'jaikapāccā'hirbudhnaśceti te smṛtāḥ ।। 16 ।।
śaṃsyasutā hyupastheyā viharaṇīyāstatsutāḥ ।
aṣṭau viharaṇīyāḥ syuḥ śāntiḥ pracetāḥ satyakaḥ ।। 17।।
viśvadevaścā'vakṣuśca hyacchāvāka uśīrakaḥ ।
vyaratniśceti te bodhyāḥ yajñe savanasaṃkramāt ।। 18।।
apāṃ garbhe pāvako'vabhṛthastasya ca hṛcchrayaḥ ।
jāṭharasya suto manyustasya ghorasaṃvartakaḥ ।। 1 9।।
samudre sa vaḍavākhyastatsutaḥ saharakṣaka ।
tasya kṣāmastasya kravyādo'gniḥ pāvakavaṃśajāḥ ।। 1.211.20।।
śuceścāraṇeyavahnirāyurnāmā sa ucyate ।
tasya mahimān putraśca tasya śāvānsuto mataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
tasyāpi savanaḥ putrastasyāpyadbhuta ucyate ।
adbhutasya viviciśca tasyā'rkaḥ suta ucyate ।।22।।
arkasyā'nīkavān vāsṛjavāśca rakṣohā tathā ।
pitṛkṛt tathā surabhiḥ rukmavāँśceti vahnayaḥ ।।23।।
manvantareṣu sarveṣu bhavanti jātavedasaḥ ।
prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve jyotiṣmantaśca te smṛtāḥ ।।24।।
iti te kathitā lakṣmi vahnayo mukhyanāmataḥ ।
homādyaiḥ phaladāḥ sarve mantrasiddhikarāḥ sadā ।।।25।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vahnivaṃśavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।2 1 1।।


← adhyāyaḥ 211 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 212
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 213 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
dvāparānte tadā cā''dye kāśyapeyīṃ ca maithunīm ।
sṛṣṭiṃ śrotuṃ samicchāmi vada me parameśvara ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu kaśyapadāyādān vacmi te tu yathākramam ।
dakṣeṇa svasya putrstu kaśyapāya caturdaśa ।। 2 ।।
dattā vivāhavidhinā tāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu ।
aditirdevamātā'bhūt daityamātā ditistathā ।। 3 ।।
kadrūśca sarpamātā'bhūd vinatā pakṣisūstathā ।
surabhiśca gavāṃ mātā paśūnāṃ cāpi sā prasūḥ ।। 4 ।।
sārameyādisattvānāṃ saramā sūścatupadām ।
danuḥ prasūrdānavānāṃ timiryādogaṇaprasūḥ ।। 5 ।।
tāmrā sūḥ śyenagṛdhrāṇāṃ munirapsarasāṃ prasūḥ ।
krodhavaśā prasūḥ sarpadandaśūkādiroṣiṇām ।। 6 ।।
ilā prasūḥ pādapānāṃ surasā yātudhānasūḥ ।
gandharvaprasūrariṣṭā yāsāṃ prajāmayaṃ jagat। ।। 7 ।।
indraśca dvādaśādityā upendrādyāḥ surāstathā ।
kathitāścāditeḥ putrā mahābalaparākramāḥ ।। 8 ।।
indraputro jayantaśca patnyāṃ śacyāmajāyata ।
śanaiścarayamau sūryāt saṃjñāyāṃ yamunā tathā ।
upendravīryāt pṛthvyāṃ tu maṃgalaḥ samajāyata ।। 9 ।।
upendrarūpamālokya kāmārtā ca vasundharā ।
vidhāya sundarīveṣaṃ śayyāyāṃ samupasthitā ।। 1.212.10।।
upendrastanmano jñātvā śṛṃgāraṃ pracakāra ha ।
vīryādhānaṃ ca yajjātaṃ durbalā rakṣituṃ ca tat ।। 11 ।।
pravālapatre patitaṃ kumāraḥ samapadyata ।
tejasā sūryasadṛśo nārāyaṇasutaḥ svayam ।। 12।।
maṃgalākhyaḥ sa hariṇā graheṣu sthāpitaḥ śubhaḥ ।
atha diterhiraṇyakaśipurhiraṇyanetrakau ।। 13।।
kanyā ca siṃhikā jātā saihikeyaśca tatsutaḥ ।
nirṛtiḥ siṃhikā sā ca tena rāhuśca nairṛtaḥ ।। 14।।
vārāheṇa hiraṇyākṣo jalamadhye yuvā hataḥ ।
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahlādo vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ।। 15।।
virocanaśca tatputrastatputraśca baliḥ svayam ।
balerbāṇo mahāyogī ditivaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 16।।
atha kadrvā sutāḥ sarpāḥ kālīyo vāsukistathā ।
karkoṭako dhanañjayastakṣakaḥ padma ityapi ।। 17।।
airāvato mahāpadmaḥ śaṃkuḥ śaṃkhastathā'paraḥ ।
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saṃvaraṇo durdharṣo durjayastathā ।। 18।।
durmukhaśca balaścaiva gokṣo gokārmukastathā ।
virūpaśceti pravarāḥ sarvā vai sarpajātayaḥ ।। 1 9।।
jaratkārvīti vai kanyā jaratkārustu yatpatiḥ ।
āstīkatanayo viṣṇutulyaguṇaparākramaḥ ।।1.212.20।।
eteṣāṃ nāmamātreṇa nāgabhītirna vai bhavet ।
atha danordvimūrdhā ca śaṃkukarṇo nirāmayaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
mahāviśvo gaveṣṭhiśca dundubhiraṃgirāvṛtaḥ ।
marīcirakṣakaścaiva mahāgārgyo hyajāmukhaḥ ।।22।।
śilo vāmanasaścaiva vikṣobhyaḥ suhṛdastathā ।
suketuśca suvīryaśca cendrajit viśvajittathā ।।23।।
suravimardanaścaikacakraśca tārakastathā ।
mahābalaḥ suvāhaśca pulomā ca pravīṇakaḥ ।।24।।
vaiśvānaro mahāśirāḥ svarbhānurmuṇḍakastathā ।
vṛṣaparvā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ sūkṣmaśca tāpinastathā ।।25।।
ūrṇanābho mahāgirirasilomā sukeśakaḥ ।
sadaśca balakaścaiva kuṃbhanābho mahodaraḥ ।।26 ।।
pramodāho vyomamūrdhā kupatho hayamastakaḥ ।
asuraśca virūpākṣaḥ śatamāyuśca śambaraḥ ।।27।।
śarabhaḥ śalabhaścaiva danoḥ putrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।
teṣāmaparisaṃkhyeyaṃ putrapautrādyanantakam ।।28।।
siṃhikāyāmathotpannā vipracittisutāstvime ।
śatagālaśca balavān nyāsaḥ śāmbastathā'paraḥ ।।29।।
ilvalo namuciścāpi vātāpī dasṛyājakaḥ ।
harakalpaḥ kālanābho bhaumaśca narakastathā ।।1.212.30 ।।
rāhuścaite saiṃhikeyā daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
bhavantyeva vaṃśaparamparājātāḥ surāriṇaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
citrasena ugrasena ūrṇāyuranaghastathā ।
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ pulomā ca sūryavarcāstathaiva ca ।।32।।
yugapat tṛṇapat kāliditiścitrarathastathā ।
bhramiśirāśca parjanyaḥ kaliśca nāradastathā ।।33।।
ityete devagandharvā mauneyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।
miśrakeśī tathā cāśī parṇinī cā'pyalambuṣā ।।34।।
māricī putrikā caiva vidyudvāṇī tilottamā ।
adrikā lakṣaṇā caiva devī raṃbhā manoramā ।।35।।
suvarā ca subāhvī ca pūrṇitā ca pratiṣṭhitā ।
puṇḍarikā sugandhā ca sudantā surasā tathā ।।36।।
hemā śāradvatī caiva suvṛttā kamalā tathā ।
subhujā haṃsapādā ca laukikyo'psarasastathā ।।37।।
gandharvā'psaraso hyetā mauneyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।
suyaśāyā duhitaraścatasro'psarasaḥ smṛtāḥ ।।38।।
lauheyī bharatā caiva kṛśāṃgī ca viśālikā ।
viśālena ca tābhyastu yakṣā utpāditā yathā ।। 39।।
lauheyā bharateyāśca kṛśāṃgeyā viśālajāḥ ।
śivā ca sumanā caiva kanye dve'pi sulocane ।।1.212.40 ।।
tābhyāṃ viśravasā vidyādharā utpāditāḥ samam ।
vikrāntena ca tenaivotpāditāḥ kinnarā api ।।41।।
samudrasenaḥ kālindo mahānetro mahābalaḥ ।
suvarṇaghoṣaḥ sugrīvo mahāghoṣaśca vīryavān ।।42।।
hayānanānāmevaṃ ca kinnarāṇāṃ gaṇastathā ।
naramukhāḥ kinnarāścotpāditāḥ śāṃśapāyanāḥ ।।।43।।
hariṣeṇaḥ suṣeṇaśca vāriṣeṇaśca vīryavān ।
rudradattendradattau ca candradrumamahādrumau ।।44।।
binduśca bindusāraśca candravaṃśā hi kinnarāḥ ।
lauheyā duhitā suravindeti nāmadhāriṇī ।।45।।
bhūtāstasyāḥ samutpannā āveśakaniveśakāḥ ।
sutāraḥ kālabhavanā'nirdeśakavideśakāḥ ।।46।।
vṛkṣāgramātramākāśaṃ te caranti tarusthitāḥ ।
paiśācena vivāhena sudatyāṃ buddhavāhanaḥ ।।47।।
kanyādvayaṃ janayāmāseti te hi picāśike ।
brahmadhanā jantudhanā tābhyāṃ piśācakoṭayaḥ ।।48।।
rākṣasāścāpi cotpannāḥ koṭikoṭyarbudāśca te ।
yakṣamātā kratusthalī cāpsaro hi matā śubhā ।।49।।
yakṣo rajatanābhastu guhyakānāṃ pitāmahaḥ ।
catvāro viṃśatiścaiva puṇyāḥ puṇyajanā matāḥ ।।1.212.50।।
maṇibhadrātpuṇyajanyāmete puṇyajanāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
evaṃ maṇivarasyaite yakṣāśca guhyakāḥ sutāḥ ।।51।।।
khaśāyāśca praputrāste rākṣasāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।
vikacāyāṃ ca rākṣasyāṃ nairṛtinā piśācakāḥ ।।52।।।
pūtanāścotpāditāste bālanāśakarā matāḥ ।
krodhāyāṃ kanyakā jātā dvādaśa hyātmasaṃbhavāḥ ।।53।।
mṛgī ca mṛgamandā ca haribhadrā irāvatī ।
bhūtā kapiśā daṃṣṭrā ca niśā tiryā tathaiva ca ।।54।।
śvetā caiva svarā caiva surasā ceti viśrutāḥ ।
mṛgyāstu hariṇāḥ putrā mṛgāścānye śaśāstathā ।।55।।
nyaṃkavaḥ śarabhā ye ca ruravaḥ pṛṣatāśca ye ।
mṛgarājā mṛgamandā gavayāścāpare tathā ।।56।।।
mahiṣoṣṭravarāhāśca khaṅgagauramukhāstathā ।
harestu harayaḥ putrā golāṃgulāstarakṣavaḥ ।।।57।।
vānarāḥ kinnarāścaiva vyāghrāḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā ।
irāvatyāḥ suto gaja airāvata iti smṛtāḥ ।।58।।
dvidantāśca caturdantā aṣṭadantāstathā'pare ।
tatputrapautrādayo'pi gajā jātā anantaśaḥ ।।59।।
atha bhūtyāḥ sutā bhūtāḥ sarve te hyūrdhvaretasaḥ ।
bhavabhaktāśca te sarve bhāryāputravihīnakāḥ ।।1.212.60।।
kuṣmāṇḍī kapiśānputrān kapiśebhyaḥ piśācakān ।
suṣuve ṣoḍaśānyeṣāṃ yugmāni piśitāśinām ।।61।।
chagalaḥ chagalī caiva vakro vakramukhī tathā ।
sūciḥ sūcīmukhī caiva kuṃbhī ca kuṃbhapātrakaḥ ।।।62।।
vajradaṃṣṭraśca dundubhiḥ upacāro'pacārikā ।
ulūkhalī ulūkhalo hyanakā'narka ityapi ।।63।।
kukhaṇḍikā kukhaṇḍakaḥ pāṃśuḥ pāṃśumatī tathā ।
pāṇipātraḥ pāṇipātrī nipuṇā nipuṇastathā ।।64।।
nituṇḍaśca nituṇḍī ca praskandaḥ skandikā tathā ।
chalādoccheṣaṇā caiva gaṇāścānantavaṃśagāḥ ।।65।।
ajāmukhā bakamukhāḥ kuṣmāṇḍānāṃ gaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
sarvāṃgakeśā vṛttākhyā daṃṣṭriṇo nakhinastathā ।।66।।
tiryaṃgāḥ puruṣādāśca piśācāste hyadhomukhāḥ ।
ṛṣāyāśca mīnā mātā vṛttā parivṛttā tathā ।।67।।
anuvṛttā duhitaraḥ tāsāṃ vai śṛṇuta prajāḥ ।
sahasradantā makarāḥ pāṭhināstimirohitāḥ ।।68।।
ete maino gaṇaḥ prokto grāhāśca śiśumārakāḥ ।
vṛttā kūrmavikārāṇi janayāmāsa śaṃkhalān ।।69।।
maṇḍukānāṃ vikārāṇi hyanuvṛttā hyajījanat ।
aiṇeyān śaṃbūkāँścaiva śuktīn varāṭakāँstathā ।।1.212.70 ।।
tathā śaṃkhavikārāṇi parivṛttā vyajījanat ।
svedāyāḥ putrapautrādyāḥ koṭikoṭyaṃśavaṃśajāḥ ।।71। ।
jalajā nṛkṣajāstiryagjātāścetanajāstathā ।
pṛthivījalajātāśca varṣāyogasamudbhavāḥ । ।72। ।
tathā śuṣkavikārebhyo gomayādibhya eva ca ।
kardamādisamutpannāḥ sūryoṣmāsaṃbhavāstathā ।।73।।
kāśyapīyaṃ prajā yonijanyāścā'yonijāstathā ।
saramāyāḥ prajā tūlātśvakaḥ kolaḥ śivā tathā ।।74। ।
śyāmaśca śabalaścaiva hyarjuno haritastathā ।
kṛṣṇo dhūmrāruṇaścaiva tūlā'lābūśca kadrukāḥ ।।75।।
surasā'jījanatputraśatamekaṃ śiromṛtān ।
sarpān takṣakamūrdhanyān nāgān vāsukiśobhanān ।।76 ।।
tāmrāyāṃ pulahasutāt śyenī bhāsī śukī tathā ।
dhṛtarāṣṭrī tathā krauṃcī jajñire śyenirāruṇāt ।।77।।
sampātiṃ ca jaṭāyuṃ cājījanat pakṣisattamau ।
jaṭāyuṣastu putrādyāḥ kākagṛdhrāśca karṇinaḥ ।।78।।
śukī garutmataḥ putrān suṣuve garuḍān bahūn ।
caturdaśasahasrāṇi vistaraḥ pannagāśinām ।।79।।
bhāsīputrāḥ smṛtā bhāsā ulūkāḥ kākakukkuṭāḥ ।
mayūrāḥ kalaviṃkāśca kapotā lāvatittirāḥ ।।1.212.80 ।।
krauṃcī vārdhīṇasād śyenī kurarān sārasān bakān ।
dhṛtarāṣṭrī tu haṃsāँśca kalahaṃsāँś bhāminī ।।8 1।।
cakravākāṃśca vihagān tayā dvijānantakān ।
ilāyāstisraḥ putryaśca latā vallī ca vīrudhā ।।82।।
latā vanaspatīn putrān hyapuṣpān pulinasthitān ।
evaṃ puṣpaphalavṛkṣāँścāpi hyudyānasaṃsthitān ।।83 ।।
atha vallī tu gulmāṃśca tvaksārāँśca tṛṇādikān ।
virudhā virudhān putrān patrasārāँśca mūlakān ।।84।।
etāsāṃ ca prajānāṃ vai deśakālavigauṇake ।
rūpakriyāvibhedaiśca vairūpyaṃ saṃprajāyate ।।85।।
kṣetrabhede tu bījasya rūpaṃ saṃkaratāṃ vrajet ।
bījabhede ca garbhasya rūpaṃ rūpāntaraṃ vrajet ।।86।।
latāvallīvirudhānāmanekayogasambhave ।
vividhāstā bhavantyeva nāntastāsāṃ hi vidyate ।।87।।
vṛkṣadrumatarūṇāṃ ca vibhinnayogasambhave ।
rūpāt rūpāntaraṃ tatra jāyate'nekajātikam ।।88।।
devarṣimānavānāṃ ca yakṣarākṣasaroṣiṇām ।
sāṃkarye ca prajāścānyā bhinnarūpā bhavanti hi ।।89।।
pārthivānāṃ jalīyānāṃ taijasā cāpi dehinām ।
yathāvikṛtirūpāṇi vibhidyante navāni vai ।।1.212.90।।
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭyantare golāntare pralayajāntare ।
kati kidṛk kiṃ ca jātaṃ pāraye'haṃ na padmaje ।।9 1।।
saṃkṣepāt kāśyapī sṛṣṭirmayā proktā prasiddhigā ।
sṛṣṭervistārasattve'pi varṇane na prayojanam ।।92।।
kālo hyayaṃ niravadhiḥ sṛṣṭeścānto na vidyate ।
mukhyaṃ mukhyaṃ kathitaṃ te kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।93।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne diteraditeḥ kadravā vinatāyāḥ surabheḥ saramāyā danostimestāmrāyā muneḥ krodhāyā ilāyāḥ sura-
sāyā ariṣṭāyāśca kāśyapīprajāyāścaturdaśabhuvanīyāyā nirdeśanāmā dvādaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 212 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 212 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 213
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 214 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
ṛṣivaṃśamaha śrotumicchāmi pāvanaṃ prabhau ।
saṃkṣepāt tata samākhyāhi śrutvā hṛt pāvanāyate ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kaśyapo gotrakāmastu cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
gotrasūtrau sutau me ca bhavetāmityacintayat ।। 2 ।।
asito'pi ca vatsāro vrahmarūpau babhūvatuḥ ।
vatsārasya nidhruvaśca raibhyaśceti sutāvubhau ।। 3 ।।
raibhyāśca ṛṣayo raibhyāḥ saṃjātā bahukīrtayaḥ ।
nidhruvasya sumedhāśca jātāśca kuṇḍapāyinaḥ ।। 4 ।।
asitasyaikaparṇāyāṃ brahmiṣṭhaḥ samajāyata ।
nidhruvāḥ śāṇḍilā raibhyāstrayaḥ ete tu kāśyapāḥ ।। 5 ।।
devalasya varā prakhyā ṛṣayo hyabhavaँstathā ।
mānasasya ca riṣyantastasya dama iti smṛtaḥ ।। 6 ।।
damasya tṛṇabinduśca maharṣiḥ samajāyata ।
tṛṇabindusutā tviḍavilā pulastyasaṃpriyā ।। 7 ।।
tasmācca viśravā jātastatpatnī devavarṇinī ।
bṛhaspaterbṛhatkīrtistasyaiṣā kanyakā matā ।। 8 ।।
tasyāṃ vaiśravaṇaḥ kubero vai jātaḥ kurūpakaḥ ।
atrerdattaśca durvāsāścadraśceti trayaḥ sutāḥ ।। 9 ।।
kaśyapānnāradaścaiva parvato'rundhatī tathā ।
arundhatyāṃ vaśiṣṭhasya śaktiḥ putro'bhavacchubhaḥ ।। 1.213.1 0।।
pulastyasya rāvaṇaśca kuṃbhakarṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।
tadvaṃśā rākṣasā jātā brāhmaṇā api sākṣarāḥ ।। 11 ।।
bhṛgoḥ khyātirajījanat dhātṛvidhātṛsaṃjñakau ।
ekāṃ kanyāṃ śrīṃ ca patnī jyeṣṭhā nārāyaṇasya sā ।। 1 2।।
sādhvi! nārāyaṇīyau ca balotsāhau sutau mama ।
dhāturbhāryā niyatiśca vidhātustvāyatirmatā ।। 1 2।।
tayoḥ putrau kramāt pāṇḍurmṛkaṇḍuśca sanātanau ।
mṛkaṇḍośca manasvinyāṃ mārkaṇḍeyo vyajāyata ।। 14।।
tasya vedaśirāḥ putro mūrdhanyāyāṃ vyajāyata ।
tasya vaṃśo'bhavat sarvo mārkaṇḍeya itiprathaḥ ।। 15।।
pāṇḍoḥ puṇḍarikāyāṃ ca dyutimān sṛjamānakaḥ ।
tayoḥ putrāḥ prapautrāśca bhārgavāste prakīrtitāḥ ।। 16।।
patnī marīceḥ saṃbhūtiḥ pūrṇamāsama vyajījanat ।
kuṣṭiṃ puṣṭiṃ tviṣāṃ cā'pacitiṃ kanyācatuṣṭayam ।। 17।।
pūrṇamāsaḥ sarasvatyāṃ virajaṃ parvasaṃ sutau ।
virajasya sudhāmā'bhūt tasya vairājanāmakaḥ ।। 18।।
gaurīputraḥ sudharmā ca lokapālo'bhavat tadā ।
parvasaḥ parvasāyāṃ tu yajñavāmaṃ ca kāśyapam ।। 1 9।।
āṃgirasaḥ smṛtirvyajījanat kanyācatuṣṭayam ।
sinīvālīṃ kuhūṃ rākāmanumatiṃ ca kanyakāḥ ।।1.213.20 ।।
bharatāgniṃ kīrtimantaṃ putrau dvau lokaviśrutau ।
agneḥ putrastu parjanyaḥ sahatyāṃ samajāyata ।।1 1 ।।
hiraṇyaromā parjanyāt mārīcyāṃ samabhūtsutaḥ ।
kṣamā tu suṣuve putrān pulahasya prajāpateḥ ।।22।।
kardamaścāmbarīṣaśca sahiṣṇuśceti te trayaḥ ।
ūrjāyāṃ tu vasiṣṭhasya vāsiṣṭhā bahavo'bhavan ।।23।।
vāśiṣṭheṣu kāśyapeṣu tathā bhagvaṃgiro'triṣu ।
pañcasveteṣu jāyante gotreṣu brahmavādinaḥ ।।24।।
kratoḥ putrā vālakhilyā bhṛgoḥ śukraḥ suto'bhavat ।
tvaṣṭā varūtrī śaṇḍaścā'markaśceti kaveḥ sutāḥ ।।25।।
yajanyāṃ devayānī ca śukrasya duhitā' bhavat। ।
triśirā viśvarūpastu tvaṣṭuḥ putro'bhavanmahān ।। 26।।
yaśodharāyāmutpanno viśvakarmā'nujaḥ sutaḥ ।
pracetasaścyavano'bhūt cyāvaneyāstato matāḥ ।। 27।।
bhārgavasya ātmavāँśca dadhīcaścetyubhau sutau ।
ātmavataścorudeśādaurvaḥ prasamajāyata ।। 28 ।।
ṛcīkasya jamadagniḥ satyavatyāṃ vyajāyata ।
jamadagneḥ parśurāmo reṇukāyāṃ vyajāyata ।। 29।।
atharvaṇasya dāyādo bṛhaspatiśca dhiṣṇukaḥ ।
saṃvartaśca vicittiśca hyutathyo vāmadevakaḥ ।। 1.213.30 ।।
utathyasya śaradvāँśca hyete ātharvaṇā matāḥ ।
bṛhaspaterbharadvājo bhāradvājaśca tatsutaḥ ।। 31 ।।
marīcestvariṣṭanemiḥ kaśyapaśceti vai sutau ।
somasya tu budhaḥ putro budhasya tu purūravā ।। 3 2।।
tasya hyamāvasurattasya bhīmastasya ca kāṃcanaḥ ।
tasya suhotrastasya jahnuryajjānostu jāhnavī ।। 33 ।।
jahnorbhāryā ca kāverī tasyāṃ jātaḥ suhotrakaḥ ।
tasyā'jakaśca tasyāpi balākāśca itīritaḥ ।। 34।।
tasya kuśastasya sutaḥ kuśiko gādhināmakaḥ ।
tasya viśvāmitraḥ putro brahmarṣirabhavatpurā । । 35।।
viśvāmitrasya putrastu devarāta iti smṛtaḥ ।
kauśikā bahavo jātāḥ ṛṣayo vai tapodhanāḥ ।। 3 6।।
viśvāmitraśca māndhātā saṃskṛtiśca kapistathā ।
kapestu purukutsaśca satyaścānṛhavānṛthuḥ ।। 37।।
ārṣṭiṣeṇo'jamīḍhaśca bhāgānyo'nyastathaiva ca ।
kākṣīvaścaiva śijayastathā'nye ca mahārathāḥ ।। 38 ।।
rathītaraśca rundhaśca viṣṇuvṛddhādayo nṛpāḥ ।
kṣatropetāḥ smṛtā hyete tapasā ṛṣitāṃ gatāḥ ।। 3 9।।
pururavasastvāyustasya sutahotrasaṃjñakaḥ ।
tasya gṛtsamadastasya śunakastasya śaunakaḥ ।।1.213.40 ।।
suhotrasya śalastasya hyārṣṭiṣeṇastaponidhiḥ ।
suhotrasya sutaḥ kāśastasya dīrghatapāḥ sutaḥ ।। 41 ।।
dīrghatapasaḥ suputro vidvān dhanvantariḥ prabhuḥ ।
dhanvantare ketumāँśca divodāsaśca tatsutaḥ ।।42।।
tasya pratardanaḥ putrastasya gargaśca vatsakaḥ ।
vatsaputro hyalarkaśca sannatistasya cātmajaḥ ।।43 ।।
tasya vaṃśe ca gārgyo vatsasya vātsyo'bhavadṛṣiḥ ।
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāścaite maharṣayo'bhavaṃstathā ।।44।।
marutto hyabhavadrājā maharṣiḥ sātvataḥ paraḥ ।
nahuṣasya yayātyādyā dhārmikā hyabhavan nṛpāḥ ।।45।।
ūśijo mamatāyāṃ ca dīrghatamā hyajāyata ।
baleḥ kṣetre sudeṣṇāyāṃ dīrghatamo'karotsutam ।।46।।
sa kakṣīvānabhavacca tatputrāstu sahasraśaḥ ।
ātreyo vaṃśajo medhātithiḥ kāṇṭhāyanā dvijāḥ ।।47।।
vṛhaspatermamatāyāṃ bharadvājo'bhavat sutaḥ ।
tasya vaṃśe'bhavat trayyāruṇirnāmarṣipuṃgavaḥ ।।48।।
bṛhatkṣatrasya putro'bhūt suhotrasaṃjñakaḥ ṛṣiḥ ।
tasya vaṃśe'bhavanmedhātithirnāma ṛṣirmahān ।।49।।
pauravaśca kauthumo'bhūt sāmavedasya śākhayā ।
rikṣasya mudgalaḥ putro maudgalyāstasya vaṃśajāḥ ।।1.213.50।।
ahalyāyāḥ śatānandastasya sutaśca suvrataḥ ।
cyavanasyoparicaravasustasya kuśāgrakaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
kuśāgrasya sutaḥ ṛṣabhākhyastasyārṣabharṣayaḥ ।
brahmakṣatrā ime proktāḥ ṛṣayo lokapāvanāḥ ।।52।।
bhavantyanye'pi pṛthivyāmṛṣayo vedabodhakāḥ ।
tāpasāścāpi jāyante tairvai saṃrakṣitaṃ jagat ।।53 ।।
karmakāṇḍaparāḥ kecit kecidbrahmaparāstathā ।
kecidyogaparāścānye tapomātraparāstathā ।।54।।
siddhiparāstathā cānye hyupāsanāditatparāḥ ।
bhavantyeva paraśreyaḥ pradāste puṇyaśālinaḥ ।।55।।
mukhyā hyete maharṣayo madaṃśasaṃbhavāḥ khalu ।
kathitāste mahālakṣmi! kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।56।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmakṣatrarṣāṇāṃ vaṃśādipradarśananāmā trayodaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।213।।


← adhyāyaḥ 213 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 214
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 215 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca -
kalpānmanūँśca saṃkṣepācchrotumicchāmi mādhava ।
dvāparānte kalerdharmān śrotumicchāmi tadvad ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! caturdaśamanūnpratyahajāँstathā ।
daśaśatāni jāyante kalpā varṣe tu vedhasaḥ ।। 2 ।।
daśaśatāni ca yugacatuṣṭayāni kalpake ।
eṣa kalpastu vijñeyaḥ sarvakalpeṣu sadṛśaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vārāhaḥ prathamaḥ kalpo lokādau prathitaḥ khalu ।
dvitīyastu bhuvaḥ kalpastṛtīyastapa ucyate ।। 4 ।।
bhavaścaturtho vijñeyaḥ paṃcamo raṃbha ucyate ।
ṛtukalpastathā ṣaṣṭhaḥ saptamastu kratuḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 5 ।।
aṣṭamastvabhavad vahnirnavamo havyavāhanaḥ ।
sāvitro daśamaḥ kalpo bhāvastvekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 6 ।।
uśiko dvādaśastatra kuśikastu trayodaśa ।
caturdaśastu gandharvo gāndhāro yatra vai svaraḥ ।। 7 ।।
ṛṣabhastu tataḥ kalpo jñeyaḥ pañcadaśaḥ priye ।
ṣaḍjastu ṣoḍaśaḥ kalpaḥ ṣaḍjanā yatra carṣayaḥ ।। 8 ।।
śiśiraśca vasantaśca nidāgho varṣa ityapi ।
śaraddhemanta ityete mānasā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।। 9 ।।
tataḥ saptadaśaḥ kalpo mārjālīya iti smṛtaḥ ।
tatastu madhyamo nāma kalpo'ṣṭādaśa ucyate ।। 1.214.1 0।।
tatastvekonaviṃśastu kalpo vairāgyasaṃjñakaḥ ।
vairājo yatra samabhūt manurvai brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।। 11 ।।
tato viṃśatikaḥ kalpo niṣādaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।
ekaviṃśatikaḥ kalpo vijñeyaḥ pañcamaḥ priye ।। 12।।
brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrāḥ pañcaprāṇāḥ svaro'bhavat ।
dvāviṃśastu tathā kalpo vijñeyo meghavāhanaḥ ।। 1 3।।।
trayoviṃśatikaḥ kalpo vijñeyaścintakastathā ।
caturviṃśatikaścāpi hyākutiḥ kalpa ucyate ।। 14।।
paṃcaviṃśatikaḥ kalpo vijñātiḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।
ṣaḍviṃśastu tataḥ kalpo mana ityabhidhīyate ।।15।।
saptaviṃśatikaḥ kalpo bhāvo vai kalpasaṃjñitaḥ ।
aṣṭāviṃśatikaḥ kalpo bṛhadityabhisaṃjñitaḥ ।। 16 ।।
ekonatriṃśakaḥ kalpo vijñeyaḥ śvetalohitaḥ ।
tatastriṃśattamaḥ kalpo rakto nāma prakīrtitaḥ ।। 17।।
ekatriṃśattamaḥ kalpaḥ pītavāsā iti smṛtaḥ ।
dvātriṃśattamakalpastu sitakalpo hi nāmataḥ ।। 18।।
trayastriṃśattamaḥ kalpaḥ kṛṣṇakalpo hi nāmataḥ ।
catustriṃśattamaḥ kalpo viśvarūpastu nāmataḥ ।। 1 9।।
evamete bhavanānāmṛtūnāṃ nāmatastathā ।
kratūnāṃ nāmataścaiva vahnīnāṃ nāmatastathā ।।1.214.20।।
svarāṇāṃ nāmataścaiva prāṇānāṃ nāmatastathā ।
ākūtīnāṃ tathā śaṃbhorviṣṇośca nāmatastathā ।।2 1।।
kalpā hyete catustriṃśatproktāstadyogataśca te।
saptarṣīṇāṃ nāmataśca saptakalpāstathā pare ।।22।।
aṣṭavasvabhidhānāśca hyaṣṭau kalpāstathā pare ।
navagrahasamāyogānnavakalpāstathetare ।। 23 ।।
aṣṭānāṃ dikprapālānāṃ kalpā hyaṣṭau tathā'pare ।
brahmaṇaśca svīyakalpaścaikaḥ kalpastathā mataḥ ।। 24।।
triguṇānāṃ ca devānāṃ trayaḥ kalpāstathā'pare ।
ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāmekādaśa ca kalpakāḥ ।। 25 ।।
caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca nāmnā kalpāścaturdaśa ।
caturdaśamahendrāṇāṃ tathā kalpāścaturdaśa ।। 26 ।।
saptaviṃśatinakṣatranāmnā tāvanta eva te ।
ekonapañcāśanmarunnāmnā tāvanta eva te ।। 27।।
caturviṃśatyavatāranāmnā kalpāstathā'pare ।
ekonapaṃcāśadvahnikalpāstāvanta eva te ।। 28 ।।
catūrṇāṃ dharmapādānāṃ nāmnā catvāra eva te ।
vidyānāṃ ca trayīnāṃ ca nāmnā kalpāstrayastathā ।। 29 ।।
ityevaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃraṃbhe yadyadyogo bhavetpurā ।
brahmaṇaḥ smṛtimārge ca yasya yogo bhavetpurā ।। 1.214.30 ।।
tattannāmnā ca kalpāste divasā brahmaṇo matāḥ ।
sahasraṃ saṃbhavatyeva kalpā hi brahmavatsare ।। 31 ।।
ta ete brahmaṇaḥ sarve punarvarṣāntare tathā ।
evaṃ viparivartante śatavarṣīyajīvane ।। 32।।
kalpāstu vedhasaścātra sṛṣṭau pravāhalīlayā ।
ete hyeva prajāyante nāstīti niyamo'pi vai ।। 33 ।।
anye'pi nāminaḥ kalpā lakṣmīkalpā bhavantyapi ।
ramākalpāstathā padmākalpāḥ śrīkalpakāstathā ।। 34।।
śivākalpā yoginīnāṃ kalpāḥ satīprakalpakāḥ ।
śacikalpāstathā kālīkalpāḥ śaktidināni ca ।। 35 ।।
vidyākalpāstathā cānye tvādyavyaktidināni ca ।
bhavantīśvarakalpāśca devakalpāstathā'pare ।। 36।।
devīkalpā apsarāṇāṃ kalpā bhaktadināni ca ।
tattvakalpāstathā cādyakāryakalpā bhavantyapi ।। 37 ।।
yannavaṃ vedhasaḥ prātardṛśyate mukhyamuttam ।
tannāmnā te tu kalpā vai brahmaṇā hi pradhāritāḥ ।। 38 ।।
indrāśca manavaḥ kalpe caturdaśa caturdaśa ।
eko manurdīrghakālaṃ bhuṃkte hyekaṃ tu saptatim ।। 39 । ।
catuṣkīnāṃ catuṣkī tu caturyugaṃ samīritam ।
dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi caturyugaṃ viduḥ surāḥ ।।1.214.40 ।।
catuṣkīṇāṃ sahasraṃ tu kalpe gacchati vedhasaḥ ।
catuṣkīṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca rātrau gacchati vedhasaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
dve sahasre catuṣkīṇāṃ brahmaṇastaddivāniśam ।
etatkrameṇa vedhāstu śatavarṣāṇi jīvati । 42। ।
vairājasyaikadivasastadā vai parikalpitaḥ ।
hyetatkrameṇa vairājaḥ śatavarṣāṇi jīvati ।।43।।
mahāviṣṇorekadinaṃ tadā vai parikalpitam ।
etatkramānmahāviṣṇuḥ śatavarṣāṇi jīvati ।। 44।।
pradhānapuruṣasyaikadinaṃ tatparikalpitam ।
etatkramāt pradhānanā śatavarṣāṇi jīvati ।।45।।
prakṛtipuruṣasyaikadinaṃ tatparikalpitam ।
puṃprakṛtestasya sṛṣṭiḥ śatavarṣaṃ pravartate ।।46।।
tato mahāpralayo vā''tyantikalaya āpyate ।
tato brahmamuktiloko vartate sapareśvaraḥ ।।47।।
tāvati samaye yāte īkṣate sa punastathā ।
bahu syāmiti sṛṣṭyarthaṃ prakṛtipūruṣakramāt ।। 48।।
kalpe kalpe manūnāṃ ca tathaivā'sti prabhāvanam ।
brahmāṇḍānāṃ bhuvanānāṃ tathaivā'styutsubhāvanam ।।49।।
caturdaśamanūn nāmnā kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ।
kratusaṃjñe'tra vārāhe kalpe ca prathamo manuḥ ।।1.214.5 0 ।।
svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ prokto brahmaṇaḥ putra eva saḥ ।
svārociṣo dvitīyo vai manuragneḥ suto'bhavat ।।51 ।।
auttamaśca tṛtīyo vai priyavratasuto manuḥ ।
tāmasaśca caturtha uttamabhrātā ca vai manuḥ ।। 52।।
raivataḥ pañcamaḥ prokto manustāmasasodaraḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhaśca cakṣuṣaḥ putraḥ cākṣuṣo nāma vai manuḥ ।।53 ।।
svārociṣottamau caiva tāmaso raivatastathā ।
priyavratā'nvayā hyete catvāro manavo matāḥ ।।54।।
uttānapādasya vaṃśe cākṣuṣo manurucyate ।
kaśyapasyā'diteḥ putrā dvādaśādityasaṃjñakāḥ ।।55।।
tatra vivasvataḥ putraḥ śrāddhadeva iti śrutaḥ ।
vaivasvato manuḥ so'yaṃ saptamo manurucyate ।।56।।
chāyāyāṃ sūryaputraśca sāvarṇiścāṣṭamo manuḥ ।
navamo dakṣasāvarṇirmanurvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ ।।57।।
daśamo brahmasāvarṇirupaślokasuto manuḥ ।
manurvai dharmasāvarṇirekādaśaḥ samucyate ।।58।।
bhavitā rudrasāvarṇirnāmnā dvādaśako manuḥ ।
manustrayodaśo devasāvarṇiḥ sunṛtāsutaḥ ।।।59।।
satyasahaso dāyādo vedasāvarṇireva saḥ ।
manuśca hīndrasāvarṇiścaturdaśaḥ sa ucyate ।।1.214.6 0।।
priye caturdaśaitāni kalpe kalpe bhavanti vai ।
proktairebhirmitaḥ kalpo yugasāhasraparyayaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
akalpaśca niśā tasya yugasāhasraparyayā ।
yugacatuṣṭaye yugaśabdo'tra bodhya eva vai ।।62।।
evaṃ kalpāntaro cā'nye manavaśca caturdaśa ।
indrāstathā bhavantyeva hyanye'nye vai caturdaśa ।।63 ।।
ṛṣayaśca bhavantyanye sapta sapta tathāvidhāḥ ।
dikpālā lokapālāśca bhavantyanye tathākriyāḥ ।। 64।।
vedavyāsāḥ praticaturyugaṃ bhavanti cāpare ।
avatārā hareḥ praticatuṣkī caturviṃśatiḥ ।। 65 ।।
aṃśā''veśakalāṃ'śāṃśāstvanantāḥ pratisādhikām ।
bhavantyevā'vatārāśca lokakalyāṇahetave ।।66।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bahūnāṃ kalpānāṃ caturdaśamanūnāṃ ca nirdeśanāmā caturdaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 214 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 214 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 215
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 216 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dvāparāntān kalerdharmāṃśca sarvaśaḥ ।
prathame dvāpare prāpte sṛṣṭistu yugalodbhavā ।। 1 ।।
mithunadharmajanyā sā naranārīprasaṃgajā ।
prāvartata yadā tatra kāmajanyāśca durguṇāḥ ।। 2 ।।
gopyakarma cauryakarma roṣakarma nijārthatā ।
hiṃsā'nṛtaṃ tathā steyaṃ vīryanāśaḥ parigrahaḥ ।। 3 ।।
aśuddhistṛṣṇikā bhogo vyavasāyo'tilubdhatā ।
dehadaihikacidacidahantāmamatādayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
pravartante prativyaktiṃ svārthapravāhavardhitāḥ ।
apuṇyā alpapuṇyāśca jāyante dehinastataḥ ।। 5 ।।
mana kāluṣyamāpnoti buddhirviparitāyate ।
asatsaṃkalpā jāyante pravartante'pyasatpathe ।। 6 ।।
dyūtaṃ pānaṃ striyaḥ sūnā adharmādhisthalāni vai ।
suvarṇamanṛtaṃ kāmo mado vairaṃ rajastathā ।। 7 ।।
kleśasthānāni pañcaiva kalervāsakṛtāni hi ।
mlecchaprāyā janāḥ sarve'dharmā'nṛtaparāstathā ।। 8 ।।
strībālagodvijaghnāśca paradāradhanādarāḥ ।
uditā'stamitaprāyā phalgudāstīvramanyavaḥ ।। 9 ।।
asaṃskṛtāḥ kriyāhīnā alpasattvā'lpakāyuṣaḥ ।
rajasā tamasā vyāptā mlecchaprāyā dhanādhipāḥ ।। 1.215.10 ।।
tannāthāśca janapadāstacchīlācāratatparāḥ ।
dharmaḥ satyaṃ dayā kṣāntiḥ śaucamāyuḥ smṛtirbalam ।। 11 ।।
prakṣayaṃ yāntyanudinaṃ kaleḥ prābalyasaṃkrame ।
sarvaprakārake śraiṣṭhye vittamevodayapradam ।। 1 2।।
dharmanyāyavyavasthāyāṃ vittaṃ heturbalaṃ bhavet ।
dāmpatye'bhirucirvittaṃ viṣayo vāpi kāraṇam ।। 13 ।।
vipratve sūtrakaṃ liṃgaṃ luṃcāyāṃ vijayo mataḥ ।
pāṇḍitye tu vitaṇḍā syāt dāridryaṃ tyāgayogini ।। 14।।
daṃbhī sādhurmahān bhāvyo vivāhe svīkṛtirdvayoḥ ।
bahiścamatkṛtiḥ snānaṃ mṛṣātejaḥ prasādhanam ।। 15।।
dūre vāri bhavettīrthaṃ keśaveṣo vibhūṣaṇam ।
udaraṃbharatā puṇyaṃ cā'pradhṛṣyaṃ tu satyatā ।। 16 ।।
svakāryasādhanaṃ dākṣyaṃ yaśo'rthaṃ dānasevanam ।
dviśataṃ ca śataṃ caiva pañcāśat paṃcaviṃśatiḥ ।। 1 7।।
pañcadaśāntaṃ sattveṣu kṣīṇeṣvāyustadāntimam ।
cauryā'nṛtavṛthāhiṃsāvyavāyādiprasevinaḥ ।। 18।।
yuvatyaścāvivāhitāḥ svalpavastrāḥ kalau yuge ।
sarvasparśā narā nāryaḥ sarvasvāpakarāstathā ।। 1 9।।
mlecchāprāyāḥ sarvavarṇāśchāgaprāyāśca dhenavaḥ ।
dārāmayā āśramāśca dhanaprāyāśca bāndhavāḥ ।। 1.215.2 0 ।।
tṛṇaprāyā oṣadhayaḥ prāṃśulabhyā mahīruhāḥ ।
kṣaṇavṛṣṭikarā meghā vastuhīnagṛhāṇi ca ।। 21 ।।
kṛte satyaṃ dayā dānaṃ tapo nāsti kalau tu tat ।
santuṣṭāḥ karuṇā maitrāḥ śāntā dāntāstitikṣavaḥ ।। 22 ।।
ātmārāmāḥ samadṛśaḥ sarve'pi tu kṛte janāḥ ।
tretāyāṃ dharmapādāṃśāḥ pādonāste hrasanti vai ।। 23 ।।
viśantyadharmapādāścānṛtaṃ hiṃsā ca tṛṣṇikā ।
vigrahaśca janāstatra pravartante svabhāvataḥ ।। 24।।
kintu janāstaponiṣṭhā nātihiṃsrā na lampaṭāḥ ।
dharmārthakāmanāprāyā bhavanti tritasaṃyuge ।। 25।।
varṇā brahmottarāścāpi jāyante vṛttidūṣitāḥ ।
tapaḥsatyadayādāneṣvardhaṃ hrasati dvāpare ।। 26।।
hiṃsātṛṣṇā'nṛtadveṣairnindāmātsaryabhartsanaiḥ ।
kalau vṛṣāśasturyo'pi naśyatyadharmadurguṇaiḥ ।। 27।।
nirdayā vairiṇo lubdhāḥ satṛṣṇāḥ sarvabhakṣiṇaḥ ।
durācārā sarvapeyabhogyavyasanasūtsukāḥ ।। 28 ।।
bhavantyeva prajāḥ sarvā jaihvaśaiśnaprayojanāḥ ।
kāpaṭyaṃ cānṛtaṃ nidrā''lasyaṃ dveṣo viṣādanam ।।29 ।।
śoko moho bhayaṃ dainyaṃ pratyahaṃ tu kalau jane ।
dravyahīnā vyayadhauryā madyapānāḥ kudṛṣṭayaḥ ।।1.215.3 0 ।।
narā nāryaḥ svārthaparāḥ kāmamūlāśca sarvaśaḥ ।
deśā dasyumayā vedā devāḥ pākhaṇḍanāśitāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
prajābhakṣāśca rājāno janāḥ śiśnodaratṛpāḥ ।
vratahīnāśca kāṣāyāḥ sadārā bhikṣukāstadā ।।32।।
tapa kāpaṭyalābhārthaṃ nyāsopyarthapralabdhaye ।
vāmanāścātibhojyāśca bahvapatyā bahustriyaḥ ।। 33।।
striyo'pi gālikāmiṣṭabhāṣiṇyo nagnavastrikāḥ ।
kūṭakāryapaṇāḥ kṣudryo'satpathapremapāṃsulāḥ ।।34।।
patiṃ tyajanti nirdravyaṃ hitvā kuṭumbamityapi ।
pitṛbhrātṛsuhṛdaśca tyaktvā prayānti kāmukam ।।35।।
sarve dānaṃ pragṛhṇanti sarve vai yājakāstathā ।
sarve mantrādhikārāśca mlecchā brāhmābhimāninaḥ ।।36।।
upadiśanti ca śaṭhāḥ śiṣyān śāṭyasamanvitān ।
śaṭhaṃ guruṃ śrayantyeva śaṭhāḥ śiṣyāḥ svabhāvavat ।।37।।
adharmiṇo dharmavāco bhavanti ca vidharmiṣu ।
svadharmiṣu sadā dveṣanindāmātsaryakāriṇaḥ ।। 38।।
annadhanāmbarahīnā gṛhahīnā hyabhojanāḥ ।
mriyante tu vinā mṛtyuṃ prāpte ghore kalau yuge ।।39।।
anāvṛṣṭiratiśatruratirogāturā janāḥ ।
svalpasvārthasya siddhyarthaṃ ghātino vai kalau yuge ।।1.215.40 ।।
na vṛddhau pitarau putrā rakṣayanti kalau khalāḥ ।
na patnīṃ vā satīṃ bhāryāṃ rakṣayanti khalā varāḥ ।।41 ।।
yatheṣṭaṃ viṣayānandāṃ rakṣayanti striyaṃ kalau ।
dhanadaṃ ratidātāraṃ tvāśrayanti striyo janam ।।42।।
kapardikākṛte kleśaṃ prakurvanti biḍālavat ।
prāṇāścaivā'pyanṛtārthe tyajantyapi kalau janāḥ ।।43 ।।
saṃpraghnanti svakāँścāpi svalpārthe svārthaghātinaḥ ।
ācāryā guravaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pākhaṇḍavyāptacetasaḥ ।।44।।
na sukhaṃ nāpi nirvāṇaṃ na śāntiṃ yānti vai kalau ।
kālagrastāḥ prajāḥ śīghraṃ sadodvegā vināśagāḥ ।।45।।
alpaprasādā anṛtā mahākrodhā adhārmikāḥ ।
prajāyante mānavā vai yavanaiḥ parimiśritāḥ ।।46।।
strīṇāṃ bālavadhenaiva hatvā caiva parasparam ।
yugadoṣadurācārā bhuñjate mānavāḥ kalau ।।47।।
uditodita vaṃśāśca hyuditā'stamitāstathā ।
cāṇḍālabhojyāḥ sarve vai nṛpā viprāḥ śvapākavat ।।48 ।।
dharmakāmārthahīnāśca mlecchācārāśca sarvaśaḥ ।
tadā vināśamāpannāḥ prajā nāstikatānvitāḥ ।।49।।
tadā'lpanaravarge ca bahustrīke kalau yuge ।
lavāllavaṃ bhraśyamānā āyūrūpabalaśrutaiḥ ।।1.215.5 0 ।।
mlecchaiścopahatā mlecchāḥ prayānti vai kṣayaṃ muhuḥ ।
hatasvā vyādhibhūyāṃso'nāvṛṣṭyādivināśitāḥ ।।5 1 ।।
anāthā vṛttihīnāśca bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ ।
puragrāmādināśaśca bhraṣṭasnehāstathā mithaḥ ।।।52।।
sāṃkaryamāśritāḥ kubjāḥ saritparvatasaṃśrayāḥ ।
dhīvarā iva jāyante'raṇyagā matsyabhojinaḥ ।।53 ।।
mṛgairmīnairvihaṃgaiśca śvāpadaistarkṣubhistadā ।
madhuśākaphalairmūlairvartayanti ca jantubhiḥ । ।54।।
cīraṃ parṇaṃ ca vividhaṃ valkalānyajināni ca ।
dhārayanti ca kaupīnaṃ pāśavaṃ jīvanaṃ śritāḥ ।।55।।
ajaiḍakaṃ kharoṣṭraṃ ca pālayanti nadīśritāḥ ।
bahvapatyā annahīnāḥ śaucācāravivarjitāḥ ।।56।।
hīnāddhīnān tadā'dharmān svīkurvanti paśuśritān ।
viprāḥ śūdrātmakā mantrābhicārādividhāyinaḥ ।।57। ।
nārīsanmantriṇī gehe śyālakāśca pradhānakāḥ ।
dāmpatyaṃ vikrayādhīnaṃ nirmanastvaṃ viyogagam ।।58।।
tīrthāni yavanā''rtāni devāścāṇḍāladharṣitāḥ ।
mlecchairnaṣṭānyāyatānyekākāraṃ kalau yuge ।।59 ।।
na yogī naiva siddho na jñānī vā brahmabhāvanaḥ ।
śāṃḍhyena śūnyaḥ kaścinna paśya lakṣmi! kalerbalam ।।1.215.60।।
annahīnā janapadāḥ kathāvikrayiṇo dvijāḥ ।
rāmā rativikrayiṇyo bhavantyeva kalau sadā ।।6 1 ।।
sarve tvaghāsurāyante sārahīnāḥ śaṭhāḥ khalāḥ ।
padārthāstuṣamātrā vai kaṇaśūnyā niraṃkurāḥ ।।62।।
śrūyate ca kathā sarvaiḥ pālyate nahi kenacit ।
kalau śrāvaṇakalyāṇe kathāsāro gato bhavet ।।63।।
snānti tīrthe nivasanti pālayanti vratāni na ।
kalau tairthikakalyāṇe kathāsāro gato bhavet ।।64।।
kāmakrodhabhayalobhatṛṣṇāvyākulacetasām ।
kalau tāpasakalyāṇe tapaḥsāro gato bhavet ।।65।।
manasaścā'jayāllobhāddaṃbhātpākhaṇḍasaṃśrayāt ।
kalau dhyānajakalyāṇe dhyānasāro gato bhavet । ।66।।
vastusāro layamevaṃ prayātyeva sthale sthale ।
yugabalāddhi tatsarvaṃ nāsti kasyāpi dūṣaṇam ।।67। ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kaliyugasvabhāvaguṇadoṣapravartanadarśananāmā pañcadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 215 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 215 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 216
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 217 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kaleḥ pañcasahasre ca gate varṣe bhuvaḥ sthalāt ।
gagādyāstīrthamūrdhanyāḥ prayānti śrīhareḥ padam । । 1 ।।
śālagrāmo harermūrtirjagannāthaśca devatāḥ ।
tataḥ svalpe gate kāle prayāsyanti hareḥ pakṣa ।। 2 ।।
dīkṣāśca devamantrāśca vidhayaḥ śrāddhatarpaṇam ।
sāttvikāni ca karmāṇi prayāsyanti hareḥ padam ।। 3 ।।
hareḥ pūjā harasyāpi tannāmaguṇakīrtanam ।
tattvajñānāni sarvāṇi prayāsyanti hareḥ padam । 4 ।।
vrataṃ tapasyā'naśanaṃ svāgataṃ grāmadevatāḥ ।
sūtakā'dyabhimantāro na bhavanti yuge kalau ।। 5 ।।
krūrā'haṃkārasaॆyuktā ghātakā vai mahājanāḥ ।
puṃsāṃ bhedo mitho naiva strīṇāṃ naiva ca vai kalau ।। 6 ।।
sarvapṛthvyāṃ strīvaśāśca puṃścalyaśca gṛhe vane ।
tarjanairbhartsanauḥ śaśvat hanti jāraṃ tathā patim ।। 7 ।।
gṛheśvarī ca gṛhiṇī gṛhī bhṛtyā'dhiko'dhamaḥ ।
ceṭibhṛtyāsamā vadhvo bhavantyeva kalau yuge ।। 8 ।।
kartāro balino gehe yonisambandhibāndhavāḥ!
śvaśrūśca śvaśuraścaiva gṛhe mukhyāḥ kalau yuge ।। 9 ।।
vidyāsambandhibhiḥ sārdhaॆ saṃbhāṣāpi na vidyate ।
svakīyā bāndhavādyāstu yathā paricitāḥ pare ।। 1.216.1 0।।
mlecchavidyāṃ prapaṭhanti dehadaihikavādinaḥ ।
uttamāḥ sārahīnāśca śūdrāṇāṃ sevakāḥ kalau ।। 11 ।।
brahmasūtravihīnāśca trāṇaśūnyāḥ kṛṣikṛtaḥ ।
dharmahīnā dvijā mlecchakarmakarāḥ kalau yuge ।। 1 2।।
phalahīnāśca taravo'patyahīnāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
dugdhahīnāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ ghṛtavivarjitam ।। 13।।
dampatī premaśūnyau ca sthāninaḥ sukhavarjitāḥ ।
bhūpāḥ sattāvihīnāśca prajāśca karakarṣitāḥ ।। 14।।
jalahīnā nadā nadyo vāpyaḥ kūpāḥ sarāṃsi ca ।
lakṣeṣu puṇyavān kaścin miledvā na miledapi।। 19।।
kutsitā vikṛtākārā narā nāryaśca bālakāḥ ।
kuvārtāḥ kutsitapathāḥ prajāyante kalau yuge ।। 16।।
na nagarāṇi na vai grāmā vṛkṣagartanivāsinaḥ ।
śaśavat parṇabhojyāśca bhavantyeva kalau ciram ।। 17।।
araṇyāni prajāyante grāmanagarabhūmiṣu ।
sarittaḍāgasasyāni kṣetrāraṇyāni vai kalau ।। 18।।
dhanaṃ na dṛśyate kvāpi pāśavīṃ vṛttimāśrite ।
dhūrte satyasya viśvāsaḥ pāpe puṇyasya mānyatā ।। 19।।
aśiṣṭā ye te tu śiṣṭā lampaṭāste jitendriyāḥ ।
puṃścalyastāḥ satīpūjyā gaṇyante vai kalau yuge ।। 1.216 .20।।
jārā brahmavratāstatra sarvastrīkāśca naiṣṭhikāḥ ।
tāpasā ye guptapāpā nindakāḥ satyamāninaḥ ।। 2 1।।
ghātakā ye kāruṇikāścaurā ye sādhubhūṣagāḥ ।
bhikṣukā ye vaṃcakāste jāyante vai kalau yuge ।।22।।
nīcasevā mahatsevā dveṣākhyānaiśca raṃjakāḥ ।
hāsyapradā jaḍā vyādhāḥ pūjyāste vai kalau yuge ।।23।।
bālye vyādhijarāyuktāḥ palitāḥ svalpakālajāḥ ।
mahāvṛddhāḥ pañcadaśavarṣeṣveva kalau yuge ।।।24।।
pañcavarṣā tu yuvatī rajoyuktā sutānvitā ।
ṣaḍmāsānte prasūtā strī dvādaśe vṛddhatānvitā ।।।5।।
prāyaśo bahuśo vandhyā hatagarbhāḥ durodarāḥ ।
kanyāvikrayiṇaḥ putravikrayiṇaśca sarvaśaḥ ।।26।।
mātṛjāyāvadhūnāṃ ca jāropārjanatatparāḥ ।
kanyānāṃ bhaginīnāṃ ca jāropārjanajīvinaḥ ।।re7।।
harernāmnāṃ vikrayiṇaḥ kīrtyarthaṃ dānakāriṇaḥ ।
devavṛtterbrahmavṛttergurorvṛtteśca hārakāḥ ।।28।।
snuṣāśvaśrūkanyakāsapatnībhaginībhoginaḥ ।
bhrātṛjāyābhoginaścā'gamyāgamanakāriṇaḥ ।।29।।
janmayoniṃ parityajya viharanti kalau narāḥ ।
patnīnāṃ niścayo nāsti bhartṝṇāṃ ca kalau yuge ।।1.216.30।।
prajānāṃ caiva vastūnāṃ grāmāṇāṃ vā'dhikāriṇaḥ ।
alīkavādinaḥ sarve caurā yānti balaṃ kalau ।। 31 ।।
narāṇāṃ mārakā sarve'balānāṃ mārakāstathā ।
gurūṇāṃ mārakā dharmamārakā vai kalau janāḥ ।। 32।।
lākṣāloharasānāṃ ca vyāpāraṃ lavaṇasya ca ।
putrāṇāṃ cātha patnīnāṃ prakurvanti kalau yuge ।। 33।।
puṃścalī vārdhuṣā'vīrā kuṭṭinī ca rajasvalā ।
raṇḍāśca randhanāgāre prabhavanti hi yācikāḥ ।। 34।।
annānāṃ nirṇayo nāsti yonināṃ nāpi nirṇayaḥ ।
liṃgānāṃ nirṇayo nāsti bālānāṃ sutarāṃ nahi ।।35।।
bhūruhā hastamānāśca vitastimānamānavāḥ ।
ardhavitastipaśavo bhavantyante kalestadā ।। 36।।
sādhūnāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca vadhaścaiva tapasvinām ।
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ śaśvaddeśānāṃ viplavastathā ।।।37।।
viṣoṣmamaraṇāścāpi vahnigolakanāśinaḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ samastāśca yugapannāśinaḥ kalau ।।38।।
duriṣṭairduradhītaiśca duṣkṛtaiśca durāgamaiḥ ।
viprāṇāṃ karmadoṣaiśca prajānāṃ patanaṃ kalau ।। 39।।
hiṃsā māyā tatherṣyā ca krodho'sūyā'kṣamā nṛṣu ।
tiṣye bhavanti lokanāmugrā rāmaśca lubdhatā ।।1.216.40।।
saṃkṣobhāḥ kalayaḥ kleśāḥ kalau tatra jane jane ।
sarveṣāmantyayoneśca sambandhāḥ suptibhojanaiḥ ।।4 1 ।।
āyurmedhā balaṃ rūpaṃ kulaṃ caiva praṇaśyati ।
ḍākinyaścāpi māriṇyo māntrikyaḥ pramadāḥ kalau ।।42।।
śvāpadānāṃ prabalatvaṃ gavāṃ tatra hyupakṣayaḥ ।
sampradāyavināśaśca kalau ghore pravartite ।।43।।
citravarṣī tadā devaścitrāpatyā janā api ।
kūṭamānāḥ paṇyajanā kuśīlā vyādharūpiṇaḥ ।।44।।
bahuyācanako lokaḥ pratyupakāravarjitaḥ ।
naṣṭacittāḥ sāhasāśca muktakeśastrīveṣiṇaḥ ।।45।।
sasyacaurā vastracaurāścaurāṇāṃ caurakā api ।
hartṝṇāṃ cāpi hartāro bhavantyeva kalau yuge ।।46।।
kīṭamūṣakasarpāśca dharṣayanti tu mānavān ।
strībālagovadhaṃ kṛtvā hatvā'nyadvā parasparam ।।47।।
apahatya kulaṃ naijaṃ mārgayanti sukhaṃ kalau ।
duḥkhādromādadharmāccā'nītervai tāmasāḥ kalau ।।48।।
tretāyāmābdhiko dharmo dvāpare māsikaḥ sa vai ।
nāstikānāmaśaktānāṃ kalau divasamātrakaḥ ।।49।।
dīkṣālopo brahmalopaḥ saṃskārayajñalopanam ।
rājasvalyasūtakā'spṛśyatālopaḥ kalau sadā ।।1.216.50।।
pakvā'pakvādiśuddhiśca mukhagaṇḍuṣaśodhanam ।
śavaśmaśānaśaucādi vinaśyanti kalau yuge ।।।51।।
mandirāṇi pratimāśca pūjyatā mahatāṃ tadā ।
paropakārasatrāṇi vinaśyanti kalau yuge ।।52।।
sadhavāvidhavābhedā gṛhyagṛhivibhāgagāḥ ।
mānyamaryāditabhedā vinaśyanti kalau yuge ।।53।।
daṇḍyā'daṇḍyavivekāśca pālyā'pālyapraṇālikāḥ ।
sevyā'sevyavivekāśca vinaṃkṣyanti kalau yuge ।।54।।
nāryo gāvaśca kanyāśca yugandharāḥ kalau tadā ।
nyāyālaye'pi nāryaśca śvapacāśca nṛpāsanāḥ ।। 55।।
sarvaṃ śvapacasāmrājyaṃ jāyante vai kalau tadā ।
luṃcārājyaṃ yaunarājyaṃ svārtharājyaṃ kalau sadā ।।56।।
balirājyaṃ śaṭharājyaṃ nagnarājyaṃ kalau bhavet ।
dṛṣṭa satyaṃ tadanyaccā'pramāṇaṃ vai kalau matam ।।57।।
dravyasāmyaṃ saudhasāmyaṃ dāyasāmyaṃ kalau drutam ।
janasāmyaṃ kriyāsāmyaṃ nagnasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ।।58।।
nārīsāmyaṃ narasāmyaṃ vṛddhasāmyaṃ ca guhyake ।
karmasāmyaṃ varmasāmyaṃ duḥkhasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ।।59।।
mukhasāmyaṃ keśasāmyaṃ stanasāmyaṃ ca mastake ।
nagnasāmyaṃ sakthisāmyaṃ garbhasāmyaṃ kalau tadā ।।1.216.60 ।।
tailaghṛtasnehasarpirvārisāmyaṃ ca raṃkatā ।
dugdhadadhihaiyaṃgavīnādisāmyaṃ tadā kalau ।।6 1।।
ikṣukandaphalamūlasitāgūḍādiśarkarāḥ ।
miṣṭakṣārakaṭutiktarasāstulyāḥ kalau yuge ।।62।।
vāṇīsāmyaṃ kriyāsāmyaṃ rūpasāmyaṃ ca veṣatā ।
devamānavayakṣārtināgasāmyaṃ kalau samā ।।63।।
utsavaśokaśṛṃgārayānāsanasamānatā ।
bālayuvasthavīrādimanaḥsāmyaṃ kalau tadā ।।64।।
svaparānyasuhṛcchatrusvārthahānisamānatā ।
hrāsasāmyaṃ vyayasāmyaṃ kṣudhāsāmyaṃ kalau yuge ।।65।।
ṛtusāmyaṃ varṣasāmyaṃ niśādivasusāmyatā ।
nidrājāgradavasthānāṃ suptisāmyaṃ kalau tadā ।।66।।
mañcakhaṭvābṛsīkusūlodakumbhīsamānatā ।
durgaprākāragopurāṃganasāmyaṃ mataṃ tadā ।।67।।
vanodyānāraṇyaṇyakheṭagrāmavāsasamānatā ।
manuṣyapaśupakṣyādeḥ kīṭasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ।।68।।
ājñopadeśavidhyāderjalpavitaṇḍikāḥ samāḥ ।
saddhetūnāṃ niyamānāmasiddhisāmyatā kalau ।।69।।
sarasvatyāśca lakṣmyāśca vidhavāsāmyatā kalau ।
viduṣāṃ svātmavṛttīnāṃ klībasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ।।1.216.70 ।।
vṛṣṭīnāṃ vyomasāmyaṃ ca kṛṣīṇāṃ kālasāmyatā ।
bhuvaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhasāmyaṃ bhavatyeva hi tiṣyake ।।71 ।।
mukhānāṃ grahaṇaiḥ sāmyaṃ hṛdāṃ phoṭarasāmyatā ।
premṇāṃ raṇena sāmyaṃ vai bhavatyeva kalau yuge ।।72।।
dhārmikakarmaṇāṃ vṛddhendriyasāmyaṃ hi tiṣyake ।
āstikatve nānyataracihnasāmyaṃ kalau yuge ।।73।।
punaḥ kṛtayuge prāpte jagat sajīvanaṃ punaḥ ।
hareryogāt tathābhāvi brahmaśaktyanvitaṃ sukham ।।74।।
sarvasmṛddhimayaṃ sarvadharmakarmaguṇānvitam ।
iti te kathitaṃ kalpaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।75।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kalidharmāṇāṃ viśeṣato nirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśādhikadviśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ ।। 216 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 216 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 217
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 218 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi prathame dvāpare ca yā ।
bhūmikā''nartarājñā svatapasā'tra samāhṛtā ।। 1 ।।
yatra śrīkṛṣṇadevena svavāsaḥ sthāpitaḥ sadā ।
tasyāstīrthasumāhātmyaṃ setihāsaṃ vad prabho ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kalau yuge mahāghore bahupākhaṇḍasaṃśrite ।
taraṇāya mahattīrthe kathayāmi nibodha me ।। 3 ।।
paścimasya samudrasya tīramāśritya tiṣṭhati ।
kuśasthalīti yā rājñā kuśena nirmitā bhavet ।। 4 ।।
tato'pi pūrvamānartarājñā''nītā bhuvaḥ sthalī ।
ānartanagarī saiva sarvābhyaḥ prāg babhūva sā ।। 5 ।।
gomatī yatra vahati sāgareṇa ca saṃgatā ।
dvārāvatī ca sā puryānartānāmnā prakīrtyate ।। 6 ।।
tatra vasati viśvātmā sadā muktiprado hariḥ ।
kalāṣoḍaśasaṃyukto mūrtidvādaśabhiryutaḥ ।। 7 ।।
dvārikā sā tu dhanyaiva yatra kṛṣṇaścaturbhujaḥ ।
janā muktiṃ prayāsyanti tatra gatvā yuge yuge ।। 8 ।।
ānarto vai mahānbhakto śaryāterātmajo'bhavat ।
pitrā vibhajyamāne ca rājyaṃ vāgrahīt svakam ।। 9 ।।
upādideśa pitaraṃ bhaktimānartakastathā ।
mamā'yaṃ mānuṣo deho mokṣāyaiva hi kevalam ।। 1.217.1 0।।
nā'yaṃ rājye kṣayitavyo durlabhaḥ kalpabhūruhaḥ ।
cintāmaṇisamenātra sādhyo mokṣo mayaiva hi ।। 11 ।।
śrutvā pitrā tadaivoktaṃ na yogyaṃ manyase ca yat ।
mama vaṃśe na cā'rājyakaro me rocate sutaḥ ।। 12।।
gṛhāṇa rājyabhāgaṃ vā yadvā gacchānyabhūtale ।
ānartastatpituḥ śrutvā natvā'gacchacca paścimam ।। 1 3।।
raṇaṃ kṣāraṃ samudrasya vālukāvyāptabhūtalam ।
tapastepe bahukālaṃ kṛṣṇanāmnā bhajan harim ।। 14।।
prasannaśca tadā kṛṣṇaḥ sametya bhaktasannidhau ।
ānartaṃ prāha me bhakta! kiṃ te manasi vartate ।। 15।।
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dadāmi yadabhīpsitam ।
praṇamya daṃḍavat prāha golokaṃ naya māṃ prabho ।। 16।।
na me'sti kāpi tṛṣṇā vā na cāsti varṣmavāsanā ।
nā''daraśca tapo'rthe me vinā tvatpādasevanam ।। 17।।
prahasya bhagavān prāha śṛṇu bhakta! tavā'rthakam ।
vivāsitastava pitrā tapaḥ karoṣi matkṛte ।। 18।।
mayā deyaṃ mahadrājyaṃ te'tipitṛvaśaṃgatam ।
āgaccha ca mayā sārdhaṃ divyaṃ dadāmi bhūtalam ।। 1 9।।
iti kṛtvā saha nītvā yayau golokadhāma saḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svasya golokād divyaṃ khaṇḍaṃ vibhajya ca ।।1.217.20।।
ānartāyā'rpitavāँśca gṛhāṇemaṃ maṇiṃ śubham ।
divyaṃ gaccha ca bhūloke yatra taptaṃ tapastvayā ।।21 ।।
tatrainaṃ maṇikhaṇḍaṃ vai sthāpayā'bdhitaṭe śubhe ।
so'yaṃ rājyapradeśo vai svatantraste bhaviṣyati ।।22।।
ityāśāṃ samanugrahya nītvā golokakhaṇḍakam ।
samājagāma cānartaḥ paścimābdhitaṭasthalam ।।23।।
tatra yāvanmaṇirmuktastāvad viśālatāṃ gataḥ ।
śatayojanavistāro divyabhūstara uttamaḥ ।।24।।
navīnaṃ bhūtalaṃ jātaṃ divyaṃ rājyaṃ babhūva tat ।
ānartena tadā kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā''nartapurī tataḥ ।।25।।
vinirmitā rājadhānī kṛṣṇoddiṣṭā yathā tathā ।
śrīkṛṣṇastatra cāgatya pūjākāle jagād tam ।। 26।।
mayā dvāparasaṃprānte vastavyaṃ cātra yattataḥ ।
śreṣṭhāṃ purīṃ ramaṇīyāṃ sanniveśaya matsthitām ।।27।।
ānartenāpi sāśreṣṭhā kṛṣṇoktavartmanā śubhā ।
purī sanniveśitā ca divyā golokadhāmabhā ।।28।।
evaṃ prasādarūpeyaṃ bhūmikā''nartasevitā ।
so'yaṃ tīrthamayo bhāgo mokṣado'sti surāṣṭrakaḥ ।।29।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataḥ kālāntare sāmudravāribhiḥ ।
bahuvāraṃ layaṃ yātā nagarī vāryupaplavaiḥ ।। 1.217.30 ।।
dvāparānte yadā kṛṣṇastatrā''yātuṃ mano dadhe ।
tadā na vidyate grāmo nagarī vā'tisusthalī ।।3 1।।
paścāt kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ bhrātrā saṃkarṣaṇena saṃyutaḥ ।
praṇamya pitarau svasya sasmāra garuḍaṃ hariḥ ।।32।।
madhupuryāṃ sthito vaṭamūle sasmāra sāgaram ।
sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ nṛpaveṣaṃ dadhāra ca ।। 33 ।।
gopaveṣaṃ parityajya cakraṃ sasmāra śāśvatam ।
sudarśanaṃ cājagāma sūryakoṭisamaprabham ।।34।।
tejasā kṛṣṇatulyaṃ ca sarvaśatruniṣūdnam ।
avyarthamastramastrāṇāṃ dadhāra tatsudarśanam ।। 35।।
ratnayānaṃ puraskṛtya garuḍaścāpyupasthitaḥ ।
viśvakarmā kārubhiśca jagmuḥ sāgarasannidhim ।।36।।
jaladhiḥ kampitastāँśca dṛṣṭvā natvā hyupasthitaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha jaladhe sthalaṃ te daśayojanam ।।37।।
dehi me nagarārthaṃ ca mama golokakhaṇḍakam ।
drāgeva ca samudreṇa tāvadbhūrnirjalā kṛtā ।।38।।
śuśubhe divyagolokasthalī sā tu yathā'parā ।
viśvakarmāṇamevā''ha samīkāraya bhūsthalīm ।।39।।
nagaraṃ kuru me kāro triṣu lokeṣu śobhanam ।
ramaṇīyaṃ mahādivyaṃ kamanīyaṃ ca yoṣitām ।।1.217.40।।
vāñcchitaṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ paraṃ golokasadṛśam ।
sarveṣāmapi svargāṇāṃ mūrdhanyaṃ mannivāsakam ।।41 ।।
divāniśaṃ garuḍa tvaṃ sannidhau viśvakarmaṇaḥ ।
sthitiṃ kuru vastukṛte yāvannirmāti matpurīm ।।42।।
divāniśaṃ ca matpārśve sudarśana sthitiṃ kuru ।
ityādiśya svayaṃ kṛṣṇo madhupuryāṃ jagāma ha ।।43।।
sāyaṃ sāyaṃ sadā viśvakarmā kṛṣṇaṃ prayāti vai ।
kāryaṃ niṣpannamākhyāti nūtanaṃ cintayatyapi ।।44।।
śrīkṛṣṇo viśvakarmāṇaṃ nirmāṇakramamāha ca ।
daśayojanaparyantaṃ nagaraṃ sumanoharam ।।45।।
padmarāgairmarakatairindranīlā'tinīlakaiḥ ।
rucakaiḥ pāribhadraiśca palaṃkaiśca syamantakaiḥ ।।46।।
gandhakairgālimaiścāpi sūryakāntādibhistathā ।
candrakāntamaṇibhiśca svarṇavarṣisuhīrakaiḥ ।।47।।
sphaṭikaiśca haridvarṇaiḥ śyāmairgauramukhaistathā ।
gorocanābhiḥ pītaiśca dāḍīmabījarūpakaiḥ ।।48।।
ārasaiḥ padmabījaiśca nīlaiḥ kamalavarṇakaiḥ ।
śyāmaiśca kajjalatulyaiḥ svacchairmaṇibhirujjvalaiḥ ।।49।।
śvetaiścampakavarṇābhaistaptakāṃcanasannibhaiḥ ।
bahumūlyairbahuguṇairāraktapītaśobhanaiḥ ।।1.217.50 ।।
gariṣṭhaiśca variṣṭhaiśca sadratnamaṇihīrakaiḥ ।
yathāvidhi yathāyogaṃ yatra yacca yadīpsitam ।।51 ।।
kuru divyaṃ nu ṣoḍaśasahasrayoṣitāṃ mama ।
anyapatnījanasyāpi cāṣṭādhikaśatasya ca ।।52।।।
śibiraṃ śreṣṭhaparikhaṃ proccaprākāraveṣṭitam ।
dvādaśaśālābhiyuktaṃ siṃhadvārasuśobhitam ।।53।।
triraṃgādisucitritakapāṭādisvalaṃkṛtam ।
nākīyadrumasūdyānavartulādisuśobhitam ।। 54।।
sulakṣaṇaṃ ghaṭīyantraṃ candravedhaṃ ravigṛham ।
nakṣatracakravijñānabhūtajñānartucakrakam ।।55।।
sabhāśālaṃ vaidhaśālaṃ bhūśālaṃ vyomaśāli ca ।
śrāvyayantrapraśālaṃ ca dūraśrāvaṇaśālikam ।।56।।
dūradṛśyapraśālaṃ ca vidyucchālādisaṃyutam ।
ṛtujñānaṃ pavijñānaṃ vāyujñānaṃ tathā bhavet ।।57।।
bhūstarasya pravijñānaṃ cotpātajñānaśālikam ।
tatsarvaṃ tatra nagare sthale yogye prakalpaya ।।58।।
yadūnāmāśramānramyān kiṃkarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca ।
karmacārigṛhodyānavihārāṇi ca kāraya ।।59।।
sarvasaudhātigaṃ svargyaṃ cograsenasya bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
hyāśramaṃ bhavanaṃ sarvabhadraṃ kāraya śobhanam ।।1.217.60।।
tathā siddhiprasiddhibhiryuktaṃ divyaṃ viśālakam ।
kārayā''śramamūrdhanyaṃ vasudevasya matpituḥ ।।6 1 ।।
viśvakarmā hariṃ prāha vṛkṣaprāśastyavātrcchayā ।
kete vṛkṣāḥ praśastāśca niṣiddhāśca tathā ca ke ।।62।।
bhadrā'bhadrapradāḥ ke ca tānvadasva jagadguro ।
keṣāmasthiniyuktaṃ ca śibiraṃ ca sukhāsukham ।।63।।
kutra diśi jalaṃ bhadramabhadraṃ ca vada prabho ।
kutra diśi ropitaśca vṛkṣo bhadraṃ dadāti vai ।।64।।
gṛhāṇāṃ prāṃgaṇānāṃ ca pramāṇaṃ kiṃ vada prabho ।
kutra diśi tarudyānaṃ puṣpodyānaṃ ca bhadrakṛt ।।65।।
prākārāṇāṃ parikhāṇāṃ dvārāṇāṃ ca pramāṇakam ।
bhavanānāṃ ca saudhānāṃ pramāṇaṃ vada me prabho ।।66।।
kasya kasya ca vṛkṣasya kāṣṭhaṃ śubhaṃ gṛhe prabho ।
abhadraṃ ca bhavet keṣāṃ taccāpi vada me prabho ।।67।।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tadā kāruṃ śṛṇu dhyānaṃ vidhāya ca ।
āśrame nārikelaśca gṛhiṇāṃ syāddhanapradaḥ ।।68।।
śibirasya yadīśāne pūrve putrapradastaruḥ ।
sarvatra maṃgalakarastarurājo manoharaḥ ।।69।।
rasālavṛkṣaḥ pūrvasmin nṛṇāṃ sampatprado bhavet ।
bilvaḥ panaso badarī sukhadāḥ sarvadā matāḥ ।।1.217.70।।
prajāpradāśca pūrvasmin dakṣiṇe dhanadāśca te ।
sampatpradāśca sarvatra tebhyo vivardhate gṛhī ।।71 ।।
jambūvṛkṣo dāḍimaśca kadalyāmrātakastathā ।
bandhūpradāśca pūrvasmin dakṣiṇe mitradāśca te ।।72।।
suvāko dakṣiṇe tadvat paścime sukhaharṣadaḥ ।
dhanaputrapradaścaiva sarvatra gṛhapārśvagaḥ ।।73।।
gṛhapārśve campakastu sarvatra bhadrabhadradaḥ ।
īśāne sukhadaścaiva svarṇādyāpādakastathā ।।74।।
alābuścāti kuṣmāṇḍamāyāmbuśca sakiṃśukaḥ ।
kharjūrī karkaṭī cāpi śibire maṃgalāyanāḥ ।।75।।
vāstūkakārabilvaśca vārtākaśca sukhapradaḥ ।
latāphalaṃ ca sukhadaṃ gṛhapārśve tu vardhitam ।।76।।
phalavṛkṣāstathā puṣpavṛkṣā maṃgaladāḥ sadā ।
phalavallyastathā puṣpavallyo maṃgaladāstathā ।।77।।
gandhapuṣpaphalavṛkṣalatātṛṇāni sarvathā ।
maṃgalānyeva jāyante putradravyarddhidāni vai ।।78।।
vicitraraṃgapatrāyaṇi citrapuṣpāṇi yāni ca ।
stambānyapi ca saumyāni sukhadāni bhavanti ca ।।79।।
praśastāni kathitāni niṣiddhāni niśāmaya ।
vanyavṛkṣā niṣiddhāśca phalapuṣpavihīnakāḥ ।।1.217.80 ।।
gṛhe saudhe samudyāne nagare gopure tathā ।
araṇyataravo vyarthā niṣiddhā na śubhā matāḥ ।।8 1।।
yatra gṛdhrakaṃkadhūkavāso bhūtapiśācakāḥ ।
vasanti yatra ca te vai niṣiddhā gandhahīnakāḥ ।।82।।
vaṭo niṣiddhaḥ śibire nityaṃ caurabhayapradaḥ ।
nagareṣu viśālāyāṃ bhūmau dṛṣṭastu puṇyadaḥ ।।83।।
śivire nagare grāme śālmalirna praśasyate ।
kṣitipānāṃ tu satataṃ duḥkhadaḥ parigaṇyate ।।84।।
grāme .vā nagare vā ca na niṣiddho bahiḥ sthale ।
vidyāsthale niṣiddhaśca satataṃ duḥkhado yataḥ ।।।85।।
tintiḍīdrurdhanahānikaraḥ prajāvināśakaḥ।
śibiretiniṣiddhaśca nagare kiñcideva saḥ 86।।
na niṣiddhaḥ kvacit siddhā grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca ।
vidyā'sthale niṣiddhaśca prājñastadvarjayet sadā ।।87।।
kharjuraśca gahuścaiva niṣiddhau śibire hyubhau ।
grāme vā nagare vā ca niṣiddho na bahiḥ sthale ।। 88 ।।
vṛkṣāśca caṇakādīnāṃ dhānyāni maṃgalāni vai ।
grāme vā nagare vāpi śibire ca gṛhe'bhitaḥ ।।89।।
ikṣudaṇḍāḥ śubhakarāḥ satataṃ smṛddhivardhakāḥ ।
aśokaśca śirīṣaśca kadambaśca śubhapradaḥ ।।1.217.90 ।।
haridrā śubhadā bodhyā hyārdrakāḥ śubhadāstathā ।
harītakyaśca śubhadā āmalakyaḥ śubhapradāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
gajānāmasthi śubhakṛt vājināmasthi saukhyakṛt ।
vānarāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ gavāmapi ।।95।।
kukkuṭānāṃ śṛgālānāṃ mārjārāṇāmabhadrakam ।
bheṭakānāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ tvasthi vastau śubhapradam ।। 93।।
īśāne ca tathā pūrve paścime cottare tathā ।
śibirasya jalaṃ bhadramanyatrā'bhadrameva tat। ।।94।।
nimne prasthe'samāne viṣame kuryānna mandiram ।
caturasre gṛhe saudhe gṛhiṇāṃ dhananāśanam ।।95।।
dairghye śūnyena rahitaṃ trayeṇa rahitaṃ tathā ।
bhadraṃ gṛhaṃ ca nagaraṃ śūnyaॆ śūnyapradaṃ nṛṇām ।।96।।
prasthe hastadvayātpūrvaṃ dīrghaṃ hastatrayaṃ tathā ।
gṛhāṇāṃ śubhadaṃ dvāraṃ prākārasya gṛhasya ca ।।97।।
na madhyadeśe kartavyaṃ kiñcinyūnādhike śubham ।
caturasraṃ candravedhaṃ śibiraṃ maṃgalapradam ।।98।।
abhadradaṃ sūryabhedaṃ śibiraṃ maṃgalā'pradam ।
abhadradaṃ sūryabhedaṃ prāṃ'gaṇaṃ maṃgalā'pradam ।।99।।
śibirābhyantare bhadrā ropitā tulasī sadā ।
dravyāpatyapradātrī ca dharmadā mokṣadā tathā ।। 1.217.100 ।।
mālatī yūthikā kundo mādhavo ketakī tathā ।
nāgacampako mallikā dhattūro bakulaḥ śubhāḥ ।। 101 ।।
śubhadahā cā'parājitā tāsāmudyānamarthadam ।
pūrve ca dakṣiṇe caiva śubhadaḥ sukhadastathā ।। 1 02।।
ūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśahastebhyo naiva kuryād gṛhaṃ gṛhī ।
ūrdhvaṃ viṃśatihastebhyaḥ prākāro na śubhapradaḥ ।। 103।।
tailakāraṃ svarṇakāraṃ hīrakādikrayārthinam ।
sūtradhāraṃ vāṭikāyāṃ grāmamadhye na vāsayet ।। 1 04।।
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ sacchūdro gaṇakaḥ śubhāḥ ।
bhadraṃ vaidyaṃ puṣpakāraṃ sthāpayet śibirāntike ।। 1 05।।
prākāre parikhāpānaṃ śatahastaṃ praśasyate ।
śibirāṇāṃ paritastu daśahastaṃ praśasyate ।। 1 06।।
guptaṃ ca parikhādvāraṃ sasaṃketaṃ praśasyate ।
tintiḍyaścāpi śālmalyo hintālāḥ sindhuvārakāḥ ।। 1 07।।
nimbāścodumbarā dhattūrā eraṇḍā vaṭāstathā ।
na śubhā duḥkhadāstasmācchibire tanna vardhayet। ।। 1 08।।
vṛkṣaṃ tu vajrahastaṃ ca rājā tu varjayet sadā ।
putradāradhanaṃ hanyāt tasmānna sthāpayettu tam ।। 1 09।।
ityādeśaṃ hareḥ prāpya viśvakarmā vaṭasthale ।
abdhitīre ca suṣvāpa svapne dadarśa dvārikām ।। 1.217.11 0।।
viśvakarmāṇamālokya devakāryasukāravaḥ ।
prasvapantaṃ hasanti sma dvārikā yaistu nirmitā ।। 111 ।।
rātrāveva suniṣpannā svapne dṛṣṭā yathā tathā ।
prātaḥ prabudhya kārustu paśyati dvārikāṃ śubhām 11 2।।
buddho dadarśa pūrṇāṃ tāṃ viśvakarmā vilajjitaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇena yathoktāṃ ca daśayojanavistṛtām ।। 113 ।।
brahmādīnāṃ nagarīśca vijityotkarṣarājitam ।
dvitīyāṃ dyāṃ ca tejobhī ratnarāśipariṣkṛtam ।। 1 14।।
etasminnantare lakṣmi! dvārāvatīṃ vilokitum ।
samājagmuścaturdaśalokeśāḥ prātareva yat ।। 115 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikāmāhātmye śaryātiputrā''nartā''nītagolokakhaṇḍātmakasaurāṣṭre śubhā'śubhavṛkṣavalyādisahita-
dvārikānirmitanirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 2 17।।


← adhyāyaḥ 217 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 218
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 219 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha purīṃ samādraṣṭuṃ brahmā patnyā sahā''yayau ।
bhavo bhavānyā sahito'nanto dharmaśca bhāskaraḥ ।। 1 ।।
hutāśaśca kuberaśca varuṇaḥ pavano yamaḥ ।
rudrāścaikādaśa candro mahendro vasavastathā ।। 2 ।।
ādityāḥ kinnarā daityā gandharvā āyayustadā ।
vimānasthairvaṭamūle sthitaḥ kṛṣṇaśca vanditaḥ ।। 3 ।।
stutastairdvārikā dṛṣṭā ramyā cātimanoharā ।
muktāmāṇikyahīrakaratnarājivirājitā ।। 4 ।।
paritaścaturasrā ca daśayojanavistṛtā ।
sāptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca gaṃbhīrābhiḥ suveṣṭitā ।। 5 ।।
prākārairnavabhiryuktā jalakrīḍāsarovaraiḥ ।
vividhairjalapadmaiśca kalhāraiḥ kamalaistathā ।। 6 ।।
sarvatobhadravṛkṣaiśca puṣpodyānaiḥ samantataḥ ।
śobhitā phullapuṣpaiścā'nilaiśca surabhīkṛtā ।। 7 । ।
mandacandanavṛkṣaiśca tulasīdrubhirañcitā ।
āmoditā sugandhibhiḥ pavanairmandaśītalaiḥ ।। 8 ।।
nārikelataruṣaṇḍaiḥ pūgābhiratiśobhitā ।
lakṣādhiguṇaguvākadrumaiścāpi vibhūṣitā ।। 9 ।।
tato'pi ca caturguṇacūtavṛkṣaiḥ sumaṇḍitā ।
prakāśitā paritaśca tāvadbhiḥ panasadrumaiḥ ।। 1.218.10 ।।
tathā tāladrumairyuktā'śvatthabadarikādibhiḥ ।
vaṭairāmrātakairbilvairjambūkadambavaṃśakaiḥ ।। 11 ।।
śālmalītintiḍīnāgaraṃgairjambīradāḍimaiḥ ।
campakairbakulairnāgeśvarairarjunakharjuraiḥ । । 1 2।।
ikṣubhiḥ kāṃcanairharītakīdhātrībhirindubhiḥ ।
śālaiḥ priyālairhintālaiḥ śiśiraiḥ saptaparṇakaiḥ ।। 13 ।।
vallībhiḥ parito vyāptā svarṇakalaśamaṇḍitā ।
navalakṣaiḥ ramyasaudhaiḥ ramyoccamandirairyutā ।। 14।।
ratnendrasāranirmāṇamuktāmāṇikyabhūṣitā ।
māṇikyahīrakaratnasvarṇakalaśamandirā ।। 15 ।।
maṇinirmitasopānakapāṭabhittikāyutā ।
harinmaṇikṛtastambhaśvetasphaṭikasattalā ।। 16 ।।
citravicitrasusūkṣmavastracāmaradarpaṇā ।
padmarāgapariklṛptaprāṃgaṇā śvetasadgṛhā ।। 17। ।
indranīlamaṇivyāptarathyāvīthīsamanvitā ।
ratnakhacitamadhyādirājamārgādiśobhitā ।। 18 ।।
grīṣmamadhyāhnasūryābhā jvalitā ratnatejasā ।
gavākṣalakṣasaṃyuktamahatsaudhādipaṃktikā ।। 1 9।।
hastiśālā vājiśālā haṃsagaruḍajālikā ।
dṛṣṭaivaṃ dvārikā ramyā devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāgataiḥ ।। 1.218.20 ।।
ānartaḥ śuśubhe deśaḥ śatayojanabhūtale ।
dvārikayā militaśca dviguṇavat sa lakṣyate ।। 21 ।।
atha kṛṣṇaḥ prasasmāra vasudevaṃ ca devakīm ।
ugrasenaṃ yādavāँśca pāṇḍavāँśca samātṛkān ।। 22।।
nandaṃ yaśodāṃ gopālān gandharvān kinnarān munīn ।
āyayuḥ saṃsmṛtāḥ sarve kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetivādinaḥ ।। 23 ।।
kṛṣṇapratāpād divyāste divyavyomagatiprabhāḥ ।
vidyādharyaśca kinnaryo nartakyo gāyikāstathā ।।24।।
gāyakā vādyabhāṇḍāśca bhaṭṭā gaṇakabhikṣukāḥ ।
anekadeśavāsīyā bhūpā vaidyāśca bhūsurāḥ ।।25।।
nyāsino yatayo vānaprasthāśca brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
avadhūtāstathā siddhā āyayurmunayastathā ।। 26।।
sanandaḥ sanakaḥ sanātanaḥ sanatkumārakaḥ ।
sanatsujātaśca voḍhā pañcaśikhastathā''suriḥ ।। 2 7।।
brahmacaryavratapālā āyayurlakṣaśo janāḥ ।
daśasāhasraśiṣyāḍhyo durvāsāstatra cāyayau ।। 28 ।।
patnīvrato mahābrahmasvarūpo bhagavānsvayam ।
lakṣaśiṣyasahitaścāyayau kṛṣṇaniketanam ।। 29 ।।
lakṣaśiṣyaiḥ kaśyapaśca vālmokaśca sahasrayuk ।
lakṣaśiṣyairgautamaśca koṭidevairbṛhaspatiḥ । । 1.218.30 ।।
śukro'pi koṭiśiṣyaiśca bharadvājaḥ salakṣakaḥ ।
aṃgiro'yutaśiṣyaiśca vasiṣṭho'yutaśiṣyakaḥ ।। 31 ।।
pracetāḥ śataśiṣyaiśca pulastyaśca sahasrayuk ।
agastyo'yutaśiṣyaśca pulahaśca sahasrayuk ।। 3 2।।
śataśiṣyaḥ kratuścā'trirbhṛguścāpi tathā'nugaḥ ।
tathā sahasraśiṣyaśca marīcistatra cāyayau ।। 33 ।।
pañcaśatānugaḥ śatānandaśca pāṇinistathā ।
sahasraśiṣyairyuktaśca ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।। 34।।
kātyāyanastathā yājñavalkyaḥ sahasravān yayau ।
sahasraśiṣyakairvyāso gargaḥ śiṣyaiḥ śatādhikaiḥ ।। 35 ।।
gālavaśca śatenāpi saubharirviṃśatirjanaiḥ ।
lomaśo daśalakṣaiśca mārkaṇḍeyastrilakṣakaiḥ ।। 36 ।।
sāndīpanirdevalaśca svaśiṣyaiśca śataiḥ śataiḥ ।
boḍhuḥ pañcaśikhaścaitau ṣaṣṭiśiṣyapraśiṣyakaiḥ ।। 37।।
naro nārāyaṇaścaitau tāpasairbahusaṃkhyakaiḥ ।
viśvāmitrastathā vatsaḥ yayau śiṣyasahasrakaiḥ ।। 38 ।।
jaratkārurāstīkaśca parśurāmaśca dakṣakaḥ ।
saṃvarto jaiminiścāpi pailaścāpi nijānugaiḥ ।। 39 ।।
upamanyuḥ śukadevaḥ kaco gauramukhastathā ।
lālāyanādyāścāpyanye'śvatthāmā droṇa ityapi ।।1.218.40 ।।
kṛpo bhīṣmaśca karṇaśca tathā'nye yugadevatāḥ ।
sudivyau kambharāgopālākhyau śiṣyaiḥ samāyayuḥ ।।4 1 ।।
sādhyā viśve marutaśca yakṣāśca vāstukarmaṇi ।
cāraṇāḥ pitaro rudrā mātṛkā dikprapālakāḥ ।।42।।
catuḥkhanijadehyādyāḥ pātālādigatāstathā ।
grahanakṣatratārāśca kṛṣṇavāstau samāyayuḥ ।।43। ।
vasavo nidhayaścaiva pare saptarṣayastathā ।
prajāpatayo manavo vālakhilyāḥ samagrata ।। 44।।
dharmā'dharmakulotthāśca vasantādyāḥ ṣaḍartavaḥ ।
kāmādyāścāpsarasaśca paryo devyaśca dāsikā । ।45।।
sādhavo yatayaḥ sādhvyaḥ sanyāsinyo virāgikāḥ ।
sāṃkhyayoginya eveyuḥ kṛṣṇo vāstuṃ karoti vai ।।46।।
avadhūtyastathā caṇḍyo durgā māyā ramādikāḥ ।
lakṣmyo jayāvijayādyāḥ sakhyo māṇikyakanyakāḥ । ।47।।
prabhā ca pārvatī gāyatrī sāvitrī sarasvatī ।
gopyo gopā golokasthāstathā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ । ।48।।
kumāryaśca kumārāśca brahmacāriṇya ityapi ।
śaktayaḥ smṛddhayaḥ siddhimūrtayaścāyayustadā । ।49।।
tattvāni vedaśāstrāṇi vidyāśca vividhāḥ śubhāḥ ।
guṇā aiśvaryasāmarthyamuktamuktānya āyayuḥ ।।1.218.50 ।।
catvāra āśramā varṇā dīnā anāthadehinaḥ ।
lokā'lokā āyayurvai kṛṣṇo vāstuṃ karoti yat ।।51।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yatra sarvatīrthatīrtheśvareśvarāḥ ।
samāyayuśca sā bhūmirvarṇanīyā mayā kimu ।।52।।
sarvatīrthaparā śreṣṭhā dvārikā bahupuṇyadā ।
yasyāṃ praveśamātreṇa janmamṛtyuvināśanam ।।53 ।।
dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ devapūjā'nantaguṇaphalapradam ।
tīrthānāṃ tīrtharūpaṃ tat kiṃ tīrthaṃ dvārakāparam ।।54।।
ugraseno mahārājaḥ sadā kṛṣṇājñayā'vasat ।
svālayaṃ dvārakāmadhye mahendrabhavanātparam ।।55।।
sahasrairdvārapālaiśca dvāraṃ dadarśa rakṣitam ।
abhyantaraṃ ca śibiraṃ dvārebhyaḥ ṣaḍbhya eva ca ।।56।।
mandirāṇāṃ śatakaiścaratnaphalaśaśālinām ।
mattāyutagajendrāṇāṃ turagāṇāṃ tathā'yutam ।।57।।
uṣṭrāṇāmayutaṃ cāpi rathānāmayutaṃ tathā ।
ardhalakṣaṃ sārathīnāṃ dadarśa rājapuṃgavaḥ ।।।58।।
dadarśābhyantare ramye devaughamunisaṃsthitām ।
sudharmākhyāṃ sabhāṃ divyāṃ svarṇasiṃhāsanānvitām ।।59।।
śuddhāṃśukaiḥ pariṣkṛtāṃ ratnatejaḥsamujjvalām ।
praviveśa sabhāṃ ramyāṃ śuśrāva śaṃkhasaddhvanim ।।1.218.60 ।।
ninādaṃ ca dundubhīnāṃ munīnāṃ vedaghoṣaṇām ।
śrutvā sabhāṃ praviśantaṃ hyugrasenaṃ harirbalaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
brahmā śivastathā viṣṇuḥ śeṣaśca devapuṃgavāḥ ।
samuttasthuḥ surāḥ sarve munayo mānavāstathā ।।62।
ratnasiṃhāsane ramye samuvāsa nṛpeśvaraḥ ।
ugrasenaśca devānāṃ harergargasya cā''jñayā ।। 63 ।।
saptatīrthodakapūrṇakuṃbhena tatra nāradaḥ ।
cakāra vedamantraiśca nṛpasyāpyabhiṣecanam ।। 64।।
tasmai vastrayugaṃ dattaṃ varuṇena mahātmanā ।
mālyaṃ ca pārijātānāṃ candanaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam ।। 65।।
ratnachatrādikaṃ tasmai baladevo dadau pṛthak ।
dadau kamaṇḍaluṃ brahmā triśūlaṃ ca maheśvaraḥ ।।66 ।।
pārvatī ratnamālyaṃ ca mukuṭaṃ kṛṣṇa eva saḥ ।
svarṇabhūṣāśca rājendrāḥ prajāścopāyanāni ca ।। 617 ।।
anye caturdaśalokavāsāśca yautakaṃ daduḥ ।
vasudevo dadau tasmai śvetaṃ tu cāmaradvayam ।।68 ।।
