ekādaśī tu sampūrṇā dvādaśī vṛddhigāminī ।। 128।।
tasyāṃ śataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇā ।
evaṃ vrataṃ janaḥ kuryāt phalabhāṅ mokṣabhāgbhavet ।। 129 ।।
na gaṃgā na gayā naiva kāśī puṣkarameva vā ।
na cāpi vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ tulyaṃ haridinena vai ।। 1.234.130 ।।
iti kṛtvā praśaṃsāṃ ca patnīṃ nītvā yayau hariḥ ।
yatra candrāvatī rājadhānī murakṛtāsti vai ।। 131 ।।
tatra nigaḍabandhasthān devān vyamocayaddhariḥ ।
svargaṃ devātmasātkṛtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau prabhuḥ ।। 1 32।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vratamāhātmyamuttamam ।
ekādaśyāstrispṛśāyāḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।। 133 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne muradānavayuddhanimittakaikādaśyutpattivratādivaradānanirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।234।।


← adhyāyaḥ 234 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 235
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 236 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
hare kathaya ṣaḍviṃśatyekādaśīvratāni me ।
kathaṃ kāryāṇi vidhinā pūjanīyaṃ ca yadyathā ।। 1 ।।
kāni nāmāni patayaḥ phalaṃ karma vidhistathā ।
ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ pṛthaktvenopavarṇaya ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ tāsāṃ pāvanīṃ mokṣadāṃ tathā ।
mama yogavatīṃ divyāṃ vaikuṇṭhādipradāyinīm ।। 3 ।।
unmīlanīṃ tathā pakṣavardhinīṃ cāpi me śṛṇu ।
jāgaraṇaphalaṃ cāpi mano datvā nibodha me ।। 4 ।।
ekādaśī hyahorātraṃ prabhāte ghaṭikā bhavet ।
unmīlanī tu sā bodhyā hareścātipriyā'sti sā ।। 5 ।।
trailokye yāni tīrthāni yāni puṇyasthalāni ca ।
tapo vedā makhāstraite koṭyaṃśenāpi tāni vai ।। 6 ।।
unmīlanīpratulyāni bhavantyeva na vai kvacit ।
unmīlanīsamaṃ kiñcinna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।। 7 ।।
na kāśī na gayā naiva prayāgaḥ kurubhūmikā ।
puṣkaraṃ na saro nārāyaṇaṃ no himavān giriḥ ।। 8 ।।
raivato na ca vindhyādrirmalayo merurapyatha ।
kuṃkumavāpī naimiṣaṃ kālakṣetraṃ vanaṃ na vā ।। 9 ।।
candrabhāgā na kāverī sarayūśca na gomatī ।
godāvarī narmadā na svarṇalekhā na vedikā ।। 1.235.1 0।।
na tāpī nāpi vai bhadrā na ca sindhurna candanā ।
śatruṃjitā na cojasvatī vipāśā na gaṇḍakī ।। 1 1।।
na śoṇo no tuṃgabhadrā tathā nāpi sarasvatī ।
anyānyapi ca tīrthāni nonmīlanīsamāni vai ।। 12।।
nonmīlanīsamaṃ puṇyaṃ na devaḥ śrīhareḥ paraḥ ।
unmīlanīdinaṃ prāpya yaiḥ kṛtaṃ haripūjanam ।। 1 2।।
pāpapuñjaṃ vidhūyaiva yānti te dhāma cākṣaram ।
yanmāse syādunmīlanyekādaśī tu śubhā tithiḥ ।। 14।।
māsanāmnā svarṇamayo hariḥ kāryastamarcayet ।
śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā bahubhiḥ sūpacārakaiḥ ।। 15।।
pavitrajalasaṃyuktaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitam ।
gandhapuṣpākṣatairyuktaṃ kuṃbhaṃ sragvastrabhūṣitam ।। 16 ।।
nārīkelādiphalakaṃ sthāpayenmadhyamaṇḍale ।
sarvatobhadrasaṃjñe'tra mūrtiṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet ।। 17।।
pātraṃ godhūmapūrṇaṃ ca nānāratnasamanvitam ।
nānāgandhasamāyuktaṃ mallikāmodavāsitam ।। 18।।
jātīkusumasaṃyuktaṃ sthāpayedvaṭasannidhau ।
śvetākṣaistaṇḍulaiścaiva pūritaṃ pātramityapi ।। 19।।
sthāpayettu ghaṭapārśve pūjayecca hariṃ muhuḥ ।
pradadyādvastrayugmaṃ ca sottarīyopavītakam ।।।1.235.20। ।
upānahau cātapatraṃ sthālīṃ jalakamaṇḍalum ।
saptadhānyaprapātrāṇi tilān dadyācca bhūriśaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
rūpyaṃ svarṇaṃ pradadyācca kārpāsaṃ pāyasaṃ tathā ।
mudrikā ūrmikāścaiva dhenūrdadyācca śobhanā । । 22।।
alaṃkārān pradadyācca pātrāṇi vividhāni ca ।
svarṇaśṛgīṃ raupyakhurīṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhīṃ sajhullikām ।।23।।
kāṃsyadohāṃ ratnapucchāṃ gāṃ dadyād gurave tadā ।
śayyāṃ dadyāt saparyaṃkāṃ gendukopaskarānvitām ।।24।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ phalaṃ patrādi cārpayet ।
tulasīpatrakamalapuṣpāṇi vividhāni ca ।। 25।।
pūjāyāṃ haraye dadyād dakṣiṇā vividhāstataḥ ।
cintayecchrīharermūrti pratyaṃgaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।।26।।
māsanāmnā tu caraṇau viṣṇunāmnā ca jānunī ।
śrīśanāmnā praguhyaṃ ca kṛṣṇanāmnā kaṭiṃ smaret। ।।27।।
brahmanāmnā smarennābhimudaraṃ viśvapākhyayā ।
hṛd vai jñātrākhyayā kaṇṭhaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsivācinā ।।।28।।
lalāṭaṃ gurunāmnā ca pareṇa brahmaṇā śiraḥ ।
sarvāṃgāni tathā'ntaryāmināmnā saṃsmared budhaḥ ।।29।।
āyudhāni vibhūṣāśca vastrālaṃkaraṇāni ca ।
dhyānaṃ kṛtvā pūjayed vai bhaktyā'rghyādīni cārpayet ।। 1.235.30 ।।
śaṃkhopari phalaṃ kṛtvā gandhapuṣpākṣatānvitam ।
sūtreṇa veṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā dadyādarghyaṃ ca bhāvataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
evaṃ vai ṣoḍaśavastupravaryaiḥ pūjayeddharim ।
prārthayecca hariṃ natvā samuddhara mahārṇavāt ।। 32।।
samuddhārāya kiñcidvai kṛtaṃ no sukṛtaṃ mayā ।
tathāpi tvaṃ mama svāmī samuddhara mahārṇavāt ।।33।।
unmilinyā vratenātra pūrvajānme samuddhara ।
viyoniṃ ca gatānpāpān vimṛtyaṃ gamitāँstathā ।।34।।
atītān bhāvinaścānyān samuddhara mahārṇavāt ।
pretānsarvānmahāmuktiṃ dehi śrīkṛṣṇa mādhava ।।35।।
ārtasya mama mūrtau te bhaktiṃ dehi ca śāśvatīm ।
evaṃ dhūpaistathā dīpairnaivedyairjalabhojanaiḥ ।।36।।
stotrairnīrājanairnṛtyaiḥ śrīhariṃ sampratoṣayet ।
vastradānaiśca godānairbhojanaiḥ sevanaistathā ।।37।।
guruṃ santoṣayed bhakto yathā santoṣamāpnuyāt ।
tathā tathā vidhātavyaṃ gurau tuṣṭe phalaṃ mahat ।।38।।
lokānāṃ tāraṇārthāya dhātrā sṛṣṭo gururyataḥ ।
ataḥ sarvasvasevādyairguruṃ santoṣayet sadā ।।39।।
guroḥ pūjā prakartavyā mokṣado'sti gururhariḥ ।
ahitaṃ mocayed yo vai suhitaṃ darśayet sadā ।।1.235.40।।
jñānadānena cā'jñānaṃ nāśayet sukhado bhavet ।
anādibandhanaṃ chindyāt śāśvataṃ sukhamarpayet ।।41।।
dharmārthakovidaṃ taṃ vai guruṃ hariṃ sadā''śrayet ।
sevayet sarvadā bhaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cācaret ।।42।।
guroḥ prasādaḥ prāptavyaḥ paripūrṇaṃ vrataṃ bhavet ।
dvādaśyāṃ ca kṛtasnāno bhakto hariṃ prapūjayet ।।43।।
guruṃ ca bhojayet paścād bahūn viprāँśca bhojayet ।
sādhūn sādhvīrbhojayitvā pāraṇāṃ svaḥ samācaret ।।44।।
kṛṣṇakathānakaiḥ kālo netavyo vratakāriṇā ।
dānaṃ jñānasya dānaṃ vai nānyat tattulyamasti hi ।।45।।
pradātavyaṃ sadā jñānaṃ nityaṃ śāstrakathādibhiḥ ।
viṣṇurjñāne pradātavyo dātā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।46।।
evaṃ yaḥ kurute conmīlanyaikādaśikāvratam ।
anantakalpakālaṃ sa vaikuṇṭhe vasati dhruvam ।।47।।
vaiṣṇavaṃ vratamevaitallakṣmi tubhyaṃ prakīrtitam ।
yacchrutvā pāpinaḥ sarve muktimāyānti tatkṣaṇāt ।।48।।
unmīlanīvratakartā svarge loke mahīyate ।
devāśca pitaraścaiva divyāṃ gatimavāpnuyuḥ ।।49।।
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ sarvasmṛddhikarāṃ śubhām ।
ekādaśyā vrataṃ viṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ vaiṣṇavārcanam ।।1.235.50।।
sādhusādhvīsusevā ca durlabhaṃ taccatuṣṭayam । -
etasyāḥ śravaṇānmucyedājanmamṛtyubandhanāt ।।51।।
viṣṇuśca vaiṣṇavāścaiva nā'pakāryāḥ kadācana ।
pūjayitvā bhojayitvā tato bhojanamācaret। ।।।52।।
śālagrāmaḥ samabhyarcyo vaiṣṇavo'pi viśeṣataḥ ।
dhūpamārārtrikaṃ śakhodakaṃ dadyācca viṣṇave ।।53।।
naivedyaṃ viṣṇave dadyād vaiṣṇavebhyastato'pi ca ।
hyekādaśīvratakartā tato bhojanamācaret ।।54।।
dīpaṃ dadyāttathā gītaṃ nityaṃ kuryācca vandanam ।
śyāmāṃ'kuraiḥ pūjanaṃ ca kuryātpremapariplutaḥ ।।55।।
pṛṣvīdānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ dūrvayā pūjane kṛte ।
śyāmāṃkuraiśca dūrvāyāḥ pūjanaṃ cātivallabham ।।56।।
nāsti loke'tra dūrvāyā aṃkuraiḥ sadṛśaṃ śubham ।
taiśca saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ viṣṇusāyujyamicchatā ।।57।।
dūrvābhiśca yavaiścā'pyakṣataiḥ sampūjayeddharim ।
pakṣe pakṣe ca vidhivad dvādaśyāṃ pūjanaṃ prage ।।58।।
mokṣadaṃ sukhadaṃ caiva tathā''yuṣyapradaṃ śubham ।
etadviṣṇuvrataṃ proktaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ samṛddhidam ।।59।।
gṛhasthānāṃ tu sukhadaṃ yatīnāṃ muktidāyakam ।
sarvarogādiśamanaṃ dehatrayaviśodhanam ।।1.235.60 ।।
daśamīvedharahitaṃ mahattūnmīlanīvratam ।
sajāgaraṃ prakartavyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param ।।6 1 ।।
tulasīpatralakṣaiśca pūjayetparameśvaram ।
gopīcandanacandraṃ ca tilakaṃ puṇḍramūrdhvagam ।।62।।
dhārayetpūjanārthāya darśanānmokṣadaṃ hi tat ।
astraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ varma dhārayed duḥkhanāśakam ।।63।।
brahmahā hemahārī ca madyapo māṃsabhakṣakaḥ ।
agamyāgo mahāpāpo nindā'nṛtaprabhāṣakaḥ ।।64।।
te pāpānmuktimāyānti tūrdhvapuṃḍrasya dhāraṇāt ।
kaṇṭhe dhātrīphalamālāṃ tulasīmālikāṃ tathā ।।65।।
dhārayed vaiṣṇavo bhakto pūjādīkṣāṃgarūpiṇīm ।
cakraśilāṃ dvārakāyā gaṇḍakyā viṣṇumityapi ।।66।।
tulasyā pūjayennityaṃ bhuktimuktiphalaṃ bhavet ।
savedho vāsaro viṣṇornopoṣitavya eva vai ।।67।।
savedho vāsaro yasya rājño rājye pravartate ।
rājā ca lipyate tena pāpena nārakī bhavet ।।68।।
vedhaṃ sarvavidhaṃ tyaktvā samupoṣya harerdinam ।
kulakoṭisamuddhāro viṣṇudhāmagatirbhavet ।।69।।
pañcapañcāśaddhaṭikā daśamyudayato'sti cet ।
paradinaikādaśī sā viddhaikādaśikocyate ।।1.235.70।।
ekādaśī tvahorātraṃ daśamīghaṭikā'pi cet ।
sā tithirna hyupoṣyā vai dvādaśīvratamiṣyate ।।71।।
ekādaśīdvaye prāpte paropoṣyā na pūrvajā ।
dvādaśīdvitaye prāpte pūrvopoṣyā tu dvādaśī ।।72।।
ekādaśyāḥ kṣaye prāpte hyupoṣyā dvādaśī vrate ।
daśamyāśca kṣaye prāpte hyupoṣyā dvādaśī vrate ।।73।।
daśamī yugale prāpte hyupoṣyaikādaśī tadā ।
dvādaśyāśca kṣaye prāpte hyupoṣyaikādaśī bhavet ।।74।।
iti jñātvā vrataṃ kuryāt hariryāti prasannatām ।
vratakartā harerdhāma yāti śrīharivāñchayā ।।75।।
dvādaśyāṃ ca prabhāte yā'ruṇodayottaraṃ bhavet ।
ekāṭaśī ghaṭikā'pi dinonmīlanakālinī ।।76।।
manuṣyāṇāṃ tathonmīlanārthaprabodhakālinī ।
tasmāttasyā unmīlanī nāma proktaṃ mayā priye ।।77।।
ut ūrdhvaṃ brahmavaikuṇṭhaṃ paraṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ tathā ।
golokaṃ melayet sonmīlanī saṃkathitā mayā ।।78।।
ut ūrdhvaṃ vai paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
melayedyā vratācārāt sonmīlanī samucyate ।।79।।
ajñānaṃ pāparūpaṃ ca bhayaṃ mṛtyuṃ vidārya yā ।
ūrdhvaṃ lokaṃ prakāśaṃ ca melayet sārthakā hi sā ।।1.235.80।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne unmīlanīnāmaikādaśīvratapūjādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 235।।


← adhyāyaḥ 235 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 236
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 237 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣye tvāṃ pakṣavardhinikā'bhidhām ।
ekādaśī priyāṃ me'ti yayā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।। 1 ।।
ekādaśī prapūrṇā ca daśamīvedhasaṃyutā ।
ekadaśīvedhayuktā dvādaśyarkodaye ca yā ।। 2 ।।
evaṃkramādamāvāsyā pūrṇimā vā'rkaprākkṣaṇe ।
sampūrṇā nāḍikāṣaṣṭiḥ pratipacca tathāvidham ।। 2 ।।
ekādaśī samārabhya pratipaddivasāvadhi ।
sampūrṇā nāḍikāṣaṣṭiryadā tvahnaḥ pramāṇatā ।। 4 ।।
saikādaśī tadā jñeyā pakṣavardhinikā'bhidhā ।
dvādaśī sā samupoṣyā vrataṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ ।। 5 ।।
aśvamedhā'yutaistulyā sā bhavet pakṣavardhinī ।
yāṃ kṛtvā tu mahālakṣmi! phalā''nantyamavāpnuyāt ।। 6 ।।
pūjite cā'rcite viṣṇau vaikuṇṭhaṃ phalamāpyate ।
pūjāṃ tatra pravakṣyāmi yayā tuṣyati keśavaḥ ।। 7 ।।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ saptadhānyaiḥ prakārayet ।
madhye ghaṭaṃ ca sauvarṇa sajalaṃ sthāpayennavam ।। 8 ।।
tāmraghaṭaṃ ca yadvā'tra pañcapallavaśobhitam ।
pañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ śvetavastrapraveṣṭitam ।। 9 ।।
candanārcitamevainaṃ puṣpahārābhiveṣṭitam ।
ghaṭe tatra mahatpātraṃ sagodhūmaṃ tu tāmrajam ।। 1.236.10 ।।
saphalaṃ sanārikelaṃ samiṣṭānnaṃ suyojayet ।
sauvarṇaṃ kārayet kṛṣṇaṃ māsasaṃjñābhidhānakam ।। 1 1।।
snāpayecca tathā paṃcāmṛtena vidhinā harim ।
abhiṣekaṃ tīrthajalaiḥ kārayellepayettataḥ ।। 12।।
kuṃkumā'kṣatakastūrīcandanāttarakarpuraiḥ ।
vastrayugmaṃ copavītaṃ kaustubhaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca ।। 13 ।।
alaṃkārāḥ pradātavyāḥ puṣpahārādayastathā ।
kaṭakāṃgadamukuṭaśṛṃkhalāraśanormikāḥ ।। 14।।
siṃhāsanaṃ pradātavyaṃ chatropānahasaṃyutam ।
sugandhadravyamatyugraṃ pradātavyaṃ ca bhāvataḥ ।। 15।।
lakṣmīstatra ca saṃsthāpyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ।
sarvālaṃkārasaubhāgyadravyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।।16।।।
pūjanīyā hareḥ pārśve tvekādaśī svarūpiṇī ।
pūjayecchrīhariṃ tatra kuṃbhapātropari sthitam ।। 17।।
dhyāyecca padmanābhaṃ vai pādau tatra vicintayet ।
viśvamūrtiṃ vicintyaiva jānunī saṃsmarettataḥ ।।18।।
jñānagamyaṃ ca saṃsmṛtya hyūrū tatra vicintayet ।
jñānapradaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā kaṭiṃ cāpi vicintayet ।। 1 9।।
viśvanāthaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā hyudaraṃ saṃvicintayet ।
śrīdharaṃ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā hṛdayaṃ cintayeddhareḥ ।।1.236.20।।
sakaustubhaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā kaṇṭhaṃ samyag vicintayet ।
kṣatrāntakāriṇaṃ smṛtvā bāhū samyag vicintayet ।।21।।
cidākāśaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā lalāṭaṃ cintayettataḥ ।
sarvarūpaṃ hariṃ dhyātvā śiraḥ samyag vicintayet ।।22।।
kṛṣṇanāmnā ca śastrāṇi sarvāṃgāni ca cintayet ।
evaṃ dhyātvā tataścārghyaṃ nālikereṇa dāpayet ।।।23।।
saṃsārasāgarāt kṛṣṇa māṃ samuddhara keśava ।
pūjāmarghyaṃ gṛhāṇeśa harikṛṣṇa namo'stute ।।24।।
ṣoḍaśavastuvaryāṇi deyāni paramātmane ।
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyājjalaṃ dadyāttu śītalam ।।25।।
tāmbūlaṃ susugandhaṃ sudravyaṃ dadyācca bhaktitaḥ ।
ghṛtenā'pyatha tailena dīpa kuryācca bhaktitaḥ ।।26।।
ārārtrikaṃ namaskāraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ ca saṃstavam ।
kṣamāpanaṃ ca yāceta puṣpāñjaliṃ prakalpayet ।।27।।
hareḥ pūjāṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā guroḥ pūjāṃ prakārayet ।
candanādyarpaṇavastrabhūṣādānādinā tathā ।।28।।
kañcukoṣṇīṣahārādisugandhādi pradāpayet ।
dakṣiṇāṃ cānnadhānyādi tathā mudrādi cārpayet ।।29 ।।
bhojanaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ datvā''cāryaṃ pratoṣayet ।
yathāvittaṃ yathāśakti kāryaṃ utsava uttamaḥ ।। 1.236.30 ।।
sāyaṃ cāpi tathā pūjā kartavyā bhaktibhāvataḥ ।
tato jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgītanṛtyasamanvitam ।।।31।।
prācyākhyānakathāyuktaṃ hāsyāhlādasamāyutam ।
śrīṃ pakṣavardhinīnāmnīṃ pūjayet kṛṣṇasannidhau ।। 32।।
tanmāhātmyaṃ saṃśṛṇuyādvratasya phalamāpnuyāt ।
paṃcāgnisādhane puṇyaṃ yattu syāttīrthakoṭiṣu ।। 33।।
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti viṣṇorjāgaraṇājjanaḥ ।
upavāse kṛte tatra hatyākoṭikṣayo bhavet ।।34।।
kartavyā tu viśeṣeṇa vaiṣṇavairjñānayogibhiḥ ।
na tīrthāni na cāraṇyakṣetrāṇi kulaparvatāḥ ।।35।।।
tārayanti janān yadvattārayetpakṣavardhinī ।
site candre kalāvṛddhistathā'syāṃ puṇyavardhanam ।।।36।।
sūryodaye tamonāśastathā'jñānavināśinī ।
pakṣavivardhinī seyaṃ mokṣapakṣavivardhinī ।।37।।
muktikalāpradā ṣoḍaśādikalāprapoṣikā ।
kāśīsamā sadā muktau dvārakāsadṛśī tathā ।। 38।।
kuṃkumavāpikātulyā vāṃchitaṃ pradadātyasau ।
bhaktānāṃ tu sadā muktipakṣaṃ vardhayatīva sā ।।39।।
jñānaṃ dharmaṃ tathā bhaktiṃ vardhayatyeva sarvathā ।
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā vibhedaṃ naiva kārayet ।।1.236.40।।
santārayati kartāraṃ daśapūrvāndaśā'parān ।
santārayati vratinaṃ dvādaśyubhayataḥ kṛtā ।।41 ।।
vārāṇasyāṃ bhavedvāsaḥ ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrakam ।
yajñadānaṃ kurukṣetre somaparvasahasrakam ।।।42।।
vidhṛtyādisuyogeṣu lakṣadānottamottamam ।
sūryacandragrahadānaṃ kurukṣetre kṛtaṃ śatam ।।43।।
prabhāse vā kṛtaṃ dānaṃ somayāgasahasrakam ।
yatilakṣaṃ gṛhe bhuṃkte tatphalaṃ nityameva yat ।।44।।
kedārajalapānasya janmā'darśanakaṃ phalam ।
ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।45।।
gosahasrapradānādvai sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam ।
sādhūnāṃ pūjane proktaṃ tasmād daśaguṇaṃ phalam ।।46।।
brahmaniṣṭhaprapūjāyāṃ tato daśaguṇaṃ punaḥ ।
devārthaṃ bhūmidātuśca kanyādātustatastathā ।।47।।
tato'pi daśaguṇakaṃ yajñāvabhṛthapāvane ।
tato'nantaṃ bhavedekādaśīvratini vai phalam ।।48।।
upavāse tu yatpuṇyaṃ tato'rdhaṃ naktabhojane ।
naktasyā'rdhaṃ bhavedekabhukte vā phalabhojane ।।49।।
ekabhuktena naktenopavāsena phalena ca ।
yatpuṇyaṃ labhate tacca rātrau jāgaraṇe kṛte ।।1.236.50।।
ekādaśyupavāsasya puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate ।
pratyekāyāśca māhātmyaṃ pravadāmi nibodha me ।।51 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pakṣavardhinyekādaśīvratapūjādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 236 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 236 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 237
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 238 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śruṇu lakṣmi mahānidrā puṇyakṣayavidhāyinī ।
sarvathā parihartavyā vratarātrau divā'pi ca ।। 1 ।।
nidrāvṛttirmahāghorā tāmasī cittadhūmriṇī ।
abhāvapratyayālambanātmikā''lasyakāriṇī ।। 2 ।।
svāpnadoṣādikartrī ca bhaktisevāvighātinī ।
kadāciddoṣabāhulye rājase puṣṭatāṃ gate ।। 3 ।।
brahmacaryavratabhaṃgapradasrāvādikāriṇī ।
vratanāśakarī syāt sā vāyuvīryajavādinā ।। 4 ।।
tasmājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vratasya niśi sarvathā ।
bahvāhāre'nnasaṃbhāre prāyaḥ śārīradhātavaḥ ।। 5 ।।
puṣṭā bhavanti tadyogāt kvaciddhātukṣaye'vaśāt ।
brahmacaryavratabhaṃge tūpavāso nirarthakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
tasmāt tadā phalāhārādikaṃ saṃkṣepato matam ।
annāhāraḥ sadāvarjyo vratasya divase janaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
nidrā tu sarvathā varjyā sattvavṛttivināśinī ।
puṇyakṣayapradā sarvadoṣādhārā'titāmasī ।। 8 ।।
vijetavyā prayatnena bhaktena vratinā khalu ।
vratapuṣṭikaraṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ ।। 9 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ janaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpūjya premato niśi ।
vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha sammīlya kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vrate ।। 1.237.10।।
gītavādyābhinṛtyādi saṃhitākathanādinā ।
vārtayā bhagavapkīrtyātmikayā sevayā ca vā ।। 11 ।।
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ bhakto vratasāphalyahetave ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ puṣpaṃ gandhānulepanam ।। 1 2।।
phalamarghyaṃ tathā śraddhāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ premabhāvanam ।
vinidraṃ ca vrataṃ sarvaṃ dadyātkuryācca bhaktitaḥ ।। 13।।
sa sarvapāpā'tisaṃśuddho jāyate pārṣado hareḥ ।
vrate jāgaraṇe prāpte sotsāhā vaiṣṇavāstadā ।। 14।।
sopavāsaṃ vrataṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryuḥ satāṇḍavam ।
tadvrataṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ vai kuryurnāmnāṃ ca kīrtanam ।। 15।।
manasā śrīhariṃ dhyātvā muhurnāma vadanti vai ।
te tu dhanyatamā loke tārakā mama pārṣadāḥ ।। 16।।
praśvāse ca tathā śvāse harernāma caturguṇam ।
prahare nāmaraṭaṇaṃ phaladaṃ koṭisadguṇam ।। 17।।
caturyāme nāmabhaktistvasaṃkhyaphaladā matā ।
jāgaraṃ nimiṣārdhaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mūrteśca sannidhau ।। 18।।
tatphalaṃ koṭikoṭyabjaguṇitaṃ syādanuttamam ।
kṛṣṇāgre nartanaṃ kuryāt sāścaryaṃ premasaṃbhṛtam ।। 19।।
sotsāhaṃ ca pramādālasyādivarjitameva ca ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā kuryāt namaskāraṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।।1.237.20।।
ārārtrikaṃ tathā kuryād yāme yāme punaḥ punaḥ ।
cetasā cārdrabhāvena paśyanmūrtiṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।। 11 ।।
tālikāvādanaṃ kuryādityevaṃ jāgaraṃ bhavet ।
evaṃ bahuguṇairyuktaṃ kuryād yo jāgaraṃ vrate ।।22।।
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na ca kuryānna lobhaṃ pūjane tathā ।
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā na punarjāyate bhuvi ।।।23।।
jāgaraṇaṃ prakurvan vai vratī viṣṇau hi līyate ।
nāstikatvena cātmānaṃ vrate naiva pratārayet ।।24।।
nārāyaṇavrate jāgaraṇe tu hyupahāsakṛt ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate ( kṛmiḥ) ।।25।।
vedavettā ca yo vipro nartane copahāsyakṛt ।
doṣalipto bhavedatra cāṇḍālādadhamo hi saḥ ।।26।।
kṣaṇaṃ vā praharaṃ vāpi jāgaraṃ nartanānvitam ।
karoti yo bhāvayuktaścaturvargaphalaṃ vrajet ।।27।।
yājako vaidikaścāpi jāgare pravinindakaḥ ।
ekaviṃśatikulayuk narakaṃ pratipadyate ।।28।।।
nāstikabhāvasarpeṇa daṃṣṭāḥ svapanti vai vrate ।
māyayā mohitā naiva kurvanti jāgaraṃ hi te ।।29।।।
vinaṣṭāste na sandeho mokṣātpracyavitā hi te ।
netrahīnā jñānahīnāḥ pumarthavigatā hi te ।।1.237.30 ।।
jāgare vācake prāpte hareḥ kathāṃ prakārayet ।
śrāvayed vividhān divyāँścamatkārān harermuhuḥ ।।3 1।।
vācakasyā'pralābhe tadkīrtanaṃ kārayenmithaḥ ।
gāyanaṃ nartanaṃ kuryāt hāsyādi hariyogajam ।।32।।
utsavo rāsaramaṇaṃ kṛṣṇalīlāṃ pragāpayet ।
aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyā'yutasya ca ।।33।।।
puṇyaṃ bhavet koṭiguṇaṃ vrate jāgaraṇe kṛte ।
vinā jāgaraṇaṃ vrate vratapuṇyakṣayo bhavet ।।34।।
pitṛpakṣā mātṛpakṣā bhāryāpakṣāstathā yujaḥ ।
śataśaścoddharantyeva vrate jāgaraṇe kṛte ।।35।।
upoṣaṇasya rātrirvā dinaṃ vā nidrayā yadi ।
vidhyate tadvrataṃ viddhaṃ cāsuraṃ vratameva tat ।।36।।।
phalaṃ tvāsurabhāvātma śāpātmakaṃ ca tadbhavet ।
viṣṇustatra na cāyāti tvāgatyāpi vigacchati ।।37।।
harirnidrākṛte sthāne śāpaṃ dattvā vigacchati ।
kṛte tu jāgare sthāne lakṣmīruddhopi vai hariḥ । ।38।।
samāgacchati dṛṣṭaḥ san bhakteṣu nṛtyati svayam ।
premapūrṇaprabhakteṣu praviṣṭo'tīva hṛṣyati ।।39।।
yāvad vratāni kurute jāgaraṃ harisannidhau ।
tāvad yugāni vratakṛd viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।।1.237.40।।
ekādaśyādivratāhe śaśvannidrālusadgṛhe ।
asurā rākṣasā yāmyā nṛtyantyaniṣṭakārakāḥ ।।41।।
harervratadine gānaṃ pāṭhaṃ japaṃ samācaret ।
mūkavannirgame saptajanmasu mūkatā bhavet ।।42।।।
hareragre nartanaṃ yo nācaratyatilajjayā ।
paṃgutvaṃ tasya vijñeyaṃ cātra paratra janmani ।।43 ।।
gītanṛtyajapajāgaraṇakartustu matpadam ।
vāsāya vaiṣṇavaṃ sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ mayā vinirmitam ।।44।।
kārayeccānyabhaktān yo jāgaraṃ vai harerdine ।
animeṣo mama pārṣadāgryo vaset sa dhāmani ।।45।।
nidrāluṃ jāgrati bhāve yojayedyo harerdine ।
vasecciraṃ tu vaikuṇṭhe pitṛkoṭibhiranvitaḥ ।।46।।
matiṃ dadāti yaḥ kṛṣṇavrate jāgaraṇaṃ prati ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śvetadvīpe vaseddhi saḥ ।।47।।
kāmadoṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ janmanyanyatra vāṃ kṛtam ।
śrīharerjāgare sarvaṃ niśi nāśaṃ pragacchati ।।48।।
hareścāgre tathā śālagrāmasyāgre prajāgaram ।
kurvanti tu phalaṃ teṣāṃ koṭitīrthakṛtaṃ bhavet ।।49।।
anyathā sukṛtaṃ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva hi nidrayā ।
nindayāpi vrataṃ naśyatyeva phalaṃ kṛto bhavet ।।1.237.50।।
pūruṣārthāḥ sampadaśca putrā kīrtirdhanādikam ।
śāśvatāḥ svargalokāya labhyante jāgare vrate ।।51।।
vinā jāgaraṇaṃ naiva viṣṇoḥ prasannatā bhavet ।
yajñāyutaiḥ śāśvato vai loko naivāpyate kvacit ।।।52।।
vrate ca jāgare labdhe labhyate dhāma śāśvatam ।
jāgarārthaṃ gacchataḥ syātpade'śvamedhajaṃ phalam ।।53।।
pādayoḥ pāṃsavaḥ saktāstāvadvarṣasahasrakam ।
jāgarī tiṣṭhate divye vaikuṇṭhe ca pare divi ।।54।।
vratarātrau jāgarārthaṃ gantavyaṃ harimandiram ।
pādalagnarajaḥsaṃkhyayugavāso harergṛhe ।।55 ।।
ekādaśyāstathā dvādaśyāśca rātrau prajāgaram ।
prakartavyaṃ prayatnena jīvā'jñānavidhūtaye ।।56।।
uttamaṃ ca madhyamaṃ ca kaniṣṭhaṃ ceti vai matam ।
tridhā jāgaraṇaṃ tatra cottamaṃ kāryameva tat ।।57।।
kathāyuktaṃ gānayuktaṃ nṛtyayuktaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
sāttvikībhāvanāyuktaṃ jāgaraṃ tūttamaṃ matam ।।।58।।
gāndharvaharikīrtyādiyutaṃ tālādisaṃyutam ।
dīpadhūpādiśobhāḍhyaṃ jāgaraṃ cottamaṃ matam ।।59।।
bhaktibhāvasamāyuktaṃ nāmoccārasamanvitam ।
nairmalyatuṣṭijanakaṃ jāgaraṃ cottamaṃ matam ।।1.237.6 0।।
lokaraṃjanakotsāhaprotsavādisamanvitam ।
naivedyaphalapānādiyutaṃ jāgaramuttamam ।।6 1 ।।
harerārārtrika yatra hareryatra pradakṣiṇam ।
hareragre rāśayogastadvai jāgaramuttamam ।।62।।
śāstrajñānaṃ guroḥ sevā devasevā ca yatra vai ।
smaraṇaṃ pādasevā ca jāgaraṃ cottamaṃ hi tat ।।63 ।।
sarvabhāvā harau yatra vaiṣṇavāgryāśca yatra vai ।
tajjāgaraṃ hi kartavyaṃ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ ।।64।।
vratadānatapohomasvādhyāyādibhirityapi ।
kiṃ cānyaiḥ puṇyakāryairvā na vrate jāgaraṃ yadi ।।65।।
pravāse ca vane kṣetre'raṇye grāmāntare'pi ca ।
vāṭikāyāṃ samāje vā nadyāṃ śaile'tige raṇe ।।66 ।।
khinnā'vasthā'tikāle vā parādhīne mahāpathe ।
jāgaraṇaprakartā me vrate so'tīva me priyaḥ ।।67।।
yasya kasyāpi bhakto vā mama bhakto'pi sarvathā ।
vrate'hni sarvathā nidrātyāgaṃ kuryād vrajet phalam ।।68।।
śaivaḥ sauraśca śāktaśca gaṇeśabhakta ityapi ।
mama vibhūtibhakto'pi vrate jāgaraṇaṃ caret ।।6 9 ।।
nidrālustu paśurjñeyaḥ indriyārāma eva saḥ ।
vipriyaṃ me kṛtaṃ tena vrate no jāgaraṃ kṛtam ।।1.237.70।।
nidrā ca bhojanaṃ caivendriyāhārān karoti yaḥ ।
vrate me sa bhavet tiryagyonau pratikaṇaṃ muhuḥ ।।7 1 ।।
nihatāḥ pitarastena devānāṃ ca vadhaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
puṇyarekhā hatā tena saubhāgyaṃ nāśitaṃ tayā ।।72।।
sampado vipadāṃ pātraṃ kṛtaṃ tenātimāninā ।
jāgaraṃ ca vrataṃ yena kṛtaṃ naiva harerdine । ।73। ।
satālīvādanaṃ kurvan gālavādyaṃ ca vādayan ।
nṛtyan gāyan kautukaṃ darśayan vai jāgaraṃ caret । ।74। ।
caritrāṇi smārayaiśca raṃjayan vaiṣṇavān janān ।
romāṇi premapūrṇāni saṃprahṛṣṭāni darśayan । ।75। ।
ālāpān janayan ramyān miṣṭān bhāvān prakāśayan ।
hāvān vyaṃgyān śaktalakṣyān kīrtanārthān vivecayan ।।76। ।
evaṃ vrate prakurvan jāgaraṃ prema pradarśayan ।
nimiṣe nimiṣe tasya puṇyaṃ syānnaimiṣaṃ tathā । ।77।।
tīrthakoṭiphalaṃ tasya yajñakoṭiphalaṃ mahat ।
svargakoṭiphalaṃ caiva dānakoṭiphalaṃ mahat । ।78। ।
śāntena manasā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nīrājanaṃ tathā ।
kuryācca jāgaraṃ rātrau saptadvīpādhipo bhavet ।।79।।
mahāpāpātipāpāni koṭihatyāsamāni vai ।
sajāgare vrate samyag vilayaṃ yānti khaṇḍaśaḥ ।।1.237.80।।
ekataḥ sarvapuṇyāni caikato vratajāgaram ।
jāgarasya mahatpuṇyaṃ viśiṣyate'nyapuṇyataḥ ।।8 1।।
kāśī dvārāvatī raivatācalaḥ somapāṭṭaṇam ।
arbudaścāruṇaścaiva mandaro himaparvataḥ ।।82।।
sahyādrirnavalakṣaśca vindhyo droṇācalastathā ।
mahākālavanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ cāvantikā tathā ।।83।।
puṣkaraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca revā svarṇā yamasvasā ।
gayā ca gokulaṃ godāvarī gaṃgā ca bhadrikā ।।84।।
gaṇḍakī tāmraparṇī ca brahmaputrādayo nadāḥ ।
kukumavāpikā māyā kāṃcī śrīpuruṣottamā ।।85।।
sarve te tīrthavidhinā kṛtā api na te tathā ।
phalaṃ yacchanti vai yādṛk phalaṃ haridinavratāt ।।86 ।।
sajāgarāt kṛtāt puṇyaṃ sarvapuṇyātigaṃ yataḥ ।
tīrthāni parvatā nadyaḥ sāgarāśca vanāni ca ।। 87।।
araṇyāni ca caityāni dvīpāśca pṛthivī tathā ।
tattvāni devāḥ ṛṣayo munayaḥ pitaro'gnayaḥ ।।88।।
gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ nāgāścāraṇā brāhmasṛṣṭayaḥ ।
vaimānikāśca vairājāḥ - kālābhimānikeśvarāḥ ।।89।।
ye kecittārakāḥ proktāste sarve lokadhārakāḥ ।
ekādaśyā jāgare vai samāgacchanti sarvataḥ ।। 1.237.90 ।।
tato jāgarakartāro devā eva na saṃśayaḥ ।
tatra samāgatān devān prasādaiśca sutarpayet ।। 91 ।।
prāsādikaṃ sunaivedyaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ।
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇāyāṃ tad bhakṣaṇīyaṃ vratārthinā ।। 92।।।
prātaḥkāle brāhmabhāge snātvā hariṃ prapūjya ca ।
samarpayedupavāsaṃ jāgaraṃ vratamityapi ।।93 ।।
haraye cārpayet sarvaṃ vrataṃ ca phalamityapi ।
prasīda śrīhare me tvaṃ vratenā'nena sarvathā ।। 94।।
ityuccārya jalaṃ dadyāt pṛthivyāṃ harisannidhau ।
jñānado muktido bhaktasukhado bhava sarvathā ।। 95।।
ityuktvā ca tato natvā bhojayedvaiṣṇavān vratī ।
pāraṇāṃ ca tataḥ kuryād yathāsaṃbhavamagrataḥ ।। 96 ।।
dānaṃ dadyātsarvatobhadrākhyamaṇḍalamityapi ।
sadhānyaṃ gurave dadyād ghaṭādikaṃ samūrtikam ।। 97।।
prātaryadā dvādaśī tu svalpāpi na bhavettadā ।
rātrau tu pāraṇāṃ kuryād dvādaśyāmeva sarvathā ।। 98 ।।
na tatra rātridoṣo'sti niṣedho nāsti pāraṇe ।
niśi snānaṃ pāraṇaṃ ca tatra doṣapradaṃ nahi ।। 99 ।।
tatpūrvāparayāmābhyāṃ dinavat karma kārayet ।
yarhi bhavati svalpāpi dvādaśī pāraṇādine ।। 1.237.100 ।।
uṣaḥkāle dvayaṃ kuryāt prātarmadhyāhnikaṃ tadā ।
sādhitā dvādaśī yena phalaṃ tasya hyanantakam ।। 101 ।।
evaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ yena sādhitaṃ sakalaṃ bhavet ।
dvādaśīṃ ca vrataṃ kṛtvā sādhayitvā harerdinam ।। 102 ।।
bahavo vaiṣṇavā divyā gatā vaiṣṇavadhāma yat ।
nāsti hareḥ samo devo na tithirdvādaśīsamā ।। 103 ।।
vrataṃ naikādaśītulyaṃ trayaṃ mokṣapradaṃ yataḥ ।
hareryogācca tatsarvaṃ bhavet pūrṇaṃ ca śāśvatam ।। 10 4।।
bhaktānāṃ vallabhaṃ kuryād bhaktānāṃ vallabho hariḥ ।
vratajāgaraṇapūjāprakartā vallabho hareḥ ।। 1.237.1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ekādaśīvratajāgaraṇādimahimanirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 237 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 237 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 238
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 239 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahādevaścaikadā māmupāgataḥ ।
pṛṣṭhavān sa ca māhātmyaṃ pratyekādaśikābhavam ।। 1 ।।
dvādaśyāścāpi māhātmyaṃ tasmai saṃkathitaṃ mayā ।
yacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve phalaṃ prāpya divaṃ gatāḥ । । 2 ।।
taccāhaṃ te pravakṣyāmi koṭisvargaphalapradam ।
ekādaśī sadā ṛkṣayogena cottamā matā ।। 3 ।।
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī ca matottamā ।
ekādaśyāṃ yadā ṛkṣaṃ śuklapakṣe punarvasū ।। 4 ।।
nāmnā sā tu jayā bodhyā vratārthaṃ tithiruttamā ।
yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ bhavet । । 5 ।।
vijayā sā samākhyātā sahasraguṇitaṃ phalam ।
yadā ca śukladvādaśyāṃ prājāpatyaṃ bhavettadā ।। 6 ।।
jayantīnāma sā sarvapāpanāśakarā tithiḥ ।
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ śuṣkaṃ cārdraṃ vināśayet ।। 7 ।।
yadā vai śukladvādaśyāṃ puṣyaṃ bhavati karhicit ।
mahāpuṇyā ca sā bodhyā sarvottamā ca sā tithiḥ ।। 8 ।।
tilaprasthapradānaṃ yaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ karoti hi ।
upavāsaśca tasyāṃ yaḥ kuryādasyā'dhikaṃ phalam ।। 9 ।।
asyā vratasyā'nuyogāt svayaṃ tuṣṭo bhaveddhariḥ ।
pratyakṣadarśanaṃ yāti mokṣadaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet ।। 1.238.1 0।।
vācikānmānasāddehātpāpātsaptajanukṛtāt ।
puṣyayuktāmupoṣyaivāpnuyānmuktiṃ tathā parām ।। 11 ।।
ekādaśīsahasrasya phalaṃ ca labhate vratāt ।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam ।। 1 2।।
akṣayyaphaladaṃ cāsyāṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet ।
svarṇāṃgadena rājñā vai patnīvratadvijāya vai ।। 13 ।।
pṛṣṭhaṃ kṛtayuge pūrve mokṣaprāptiprakāmyayā ।
upavāsasya naktasya caikabhuktasya kiṃ phalam ।। 14।।
viṣayebhya upāvṛttendriyāṇāṃ vāsa aiśvare ।
mūrtau vā sa bhavelloke hyupavāsaḥ phalapradaḥ ।। 15।।
nirjalo vā sajalo vā hyupavāsaḥ samucyate ।
saphalo vā payaḥpānayukto'pi saḥ prakathyate ।। 16 ।।
daśamyāṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca kṛtvā vrataṃ samācaret ।
daśamyāṃ vā tathā naktaṃ bhuktvā vai vratamācaret ।। 17।।
divasasyā'ṣṭame bhāge mandībhūte divākare ।
bhojanaṃ naktamityuktaṃ na naktaṃ niśi bhojanam ।। 18।।
nakṣatradarśane naktaṃ vyāpṛtasya bhavet khalu ।
vyavasāyijanasyaikādaśyāṃ naktaṃ ca bhojanam ।। 19।।
nāsya niṣedhanaṃ yasmāt karmacārī jano'sti saḥ ।
madhyāhne caikabhuktaṃ vā kṛtvāpi vratamācaret ।।1.238.20।।
abalasya durbalasya kṛte'yaṃ bhojanādaraḥ ।
tataḥ prabhātasamaye caikādaśyāṃ vratī janaḥ ।।2 1।।
pragṛhṇīyācca niyamaṃ viṣayebhyo nivartane ।
pūjayecca hariṃ prātaḥ ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।।22।।
prārthayecca hariṃ sampūrṇaṃ vrataṃ me bhavediti ।
mā vighno me bhavettatra mā śraddhānāśa ityapi ।।23।।
vyavahāramayaṃ tatra vrate naiva samācaret ।
āvaśyakaṃ prakuryācca yanna vratavidhāyakam ।।24।।
payo jalaṃ phalaṃ mūlaṃ patraṃ śākaṃ rasastathā ।
oṣadhaṃ ca gurorvākyaṃ brahmavākyaṃ vivaśyatā ।।25।।
ekādaśāni caitāni hyavrataghnāni santi vai ।
bhojanaṃ cā'pyaśaktasyā'vrataghnaṃ bodhyameva ca ।।26।।
madhyāhne'pi jalasnānaṃ kuryācca pūjayeddharim ।
adhamaṃ kūpake snānaṃ vāpyāṃ tu madhyamaṃ hi tat ।।27।।।
taḍāge vātha nadyāṃ vā snānaṃ vai cottamaṃ matam ।
tīrthe vāpi mahānadyāṃ samudre cottamottamam ।।28।।
gṛhe snānaṃ hyaśaktasya smṛddhasyāpi bhavet khalu ।
aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare ।।29।।
mṛttike tvāṃ śarīre me lepayāmi kṣamāṃ kuru ।
hara pāpāni sarvāṇi puṇyāni kuru sāmpratam ।।1.238.3 0 ।।
ityuktvā lepayed dehe śuddhyarthaṃ mṛttikāṃ janaḥ ।
maunamādāya kṛṣṇasya smarannāma jale śubhe ।।3 1 ।।
snāyāttathā ca haraye naivedyaṃ tatra kārayet ।
jalaṃ tathā'rpayet kālaṃ kathayā kṣapayed vratī ।।32।।
bhaktyā bhagavataḥ pūrṇaṃ dinaṃ tu gamayed vratī ।
rātrau tathā mahadbhāvabhṛtairvastubhirādarāt ।।33।।
pūjanaṃ devadevasya kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi ।
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā vidhinaivaṃ prakārayet ।।34।।
ekādaśīdinaṃ vandhyaṃ vratahīnaṃ na yāpayet ।
evaṃ vratavidhāturvai bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ।।35 ।।
prasanno bhavati svasya dhāma nayati taṃ janam ।
phalaṃ ca śāśvataṃ pūrṇānandarūpaṃ dadātyasau ।। 36 ।।
saṃkrāntīnāṃ caturlakṣaṃ yo dānaṃ pradadāti vai ।
ekādaśyupavāsasya taddhi naikakalāsamam ।। 37।।
prabhāse kurubhūbhāge candrasūryagrahāplave ।
yatphalaṃ ca tataḥ śreṣṭhamekādaśyupavāsinaḥ ।। 38।।
kedāre ca jalaṃ pītvā punarjanma na vidyate ।
tathā caikādaśīpuṇyavato janma na vidyate ।।39 ।।
aśvamedhādiyajñebhyo'dhikaṃ puṇyaṃ vrate bhavet ।
tapasvināṃ sahasraṃ ca pratyahaṃ yadgṛhe'bdakam ।।1.238.40 ।।
bhuṃkte ca tatphalācchreṣṭhaṃ caikādaśyupavāsinaḥ ।
gosahasrādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ śatordhvaṃ saṃprajāyate ।।41।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāḥ saṃvasantyekādaśīkṛtaḥ ।
dehe devasvarūpo'yaṃ vratī bhavati keśavaḥ ।।42।।
rukmiṇīsvāminaḥ sevāpuṇyasyā'nto na vidyate ।
ekādaśīvratasyāpi puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate ।।43।।
upavāsena pūrṇaṃ vai tadardhaṃ naktabhojanāt ।
ekabhuktāttadardhārdhaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃjāyate vrate ।।44।।
tāvadgarjanti tīrthāni dānāni niyamāni ca ।
yāvannopoṣayejjanturvāsaraṃ harivallabham ।।45।।
ekādaśīsamaṃ nāsti mahāyajñasahasrakam ।
mahādānasahasraṃ ca mahāsvargaśataṃ tathā ।।46।।
bhavatyekādaśīpuṇyāt mokṣārthaṃ hi matā tu sā ।
mārgaśīrṣe kṛṣṇapakṣe cotpannā'to mama priyā ।।47।।
utpannatvācca sā nāmnotpattirekādaśī matā ।
utpattiṃ ca vidhānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ cācared vratī ।।48।।
abhayā sāpi saṃproktā pūjyaḥ sulakṣaṇāyutaḥ ।
kṛṣṇastu tilapuṣpaiśca naivedye ca guḍaudanaḥ ।।49।।
deyaṃ skandhaphalaṃ tvarghye vṛṣadānaṃ ca sammatam ।
tathaiva dakṣiṇā deyā kṛṣṇāya svarṇamudrikāḥ ।।1.238.50।।
utpattistatra kartavyā vidhinā vai vratotsave ।
prātarnārāyaṇo nidrāvaśo'sti gahvare yathā ।।51 ।।
siṃhavatīpranāptayeva parvate himavartini ।
himācalaguhā kāryā tadantaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।।52।।
supto'stīti praktvaptavyaṃ kartavyo muradānavaḥ ।
ekādaśī tathā kanyārūpā divyā suvarṇajā ।।5 3 ।।
kartavyā śastrasampannā tathā yuddhaṃ pradarśayet ।
muranāśastathā nārāyaṇajāgratsvabhāvatā ।।54।।
prakartavyā gahvare ca tayostatra prapūjanam ।
ekādaśyā hareścaiva tadā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।।55।।
sarvatobhadranāmā'tra saptadhānyaiśca maṇḍalam ।
kāraṇīyaṃ ca tanmadhye sauvarṇastāmrajo'thavā ।।5 6 ।।
ghaṭaḥ pañcasuratnādivastrapallavaśobhitaḥ ।
phalayuktaḥ sthāpanīyastatra sthālī tilānvitā ।।57।।
sthāpanīyā tatra mūrtidvayaṃ sthāpyaṃ hi mantrataḥ ।
pūjanaṃ vidhivat kārya pūrvoktavidhinā śubham ।।58।।
suśayyā sthāpanīyā saparyaṃkā sukhasaṃpradā ।
vrataṃ kāryaṃ divārātrau jāgaraṃ kāryamityapi ।।59।।
rātrau ca pūjanaṃ tatra hareḥ kartavyamaṃjasā ।
prātaḥ snānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca godānaṃ bhūmidānakam ।।1.238.60 ।।
svarṇadānaṃ yathāśakti gurave brāhmaṇāya vā ।
kāryaṃ visarjanaṃ paścāt pāraṇāṃ parivartayet ।।61।।
sādhūn sādhvīrarbhakāṃśca viprān dīnān subhojayet ।
mūrtidānaṃ ca gurave kuryād bhaktiprapūrvakam ।।62।।
yathādravyaṃ yathāśakti vistāraḥ kārya eva ca ।
rājyadānaṃ grāmadānaṃ kṣetradānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ।।63।।
kanyādānaṃ paśordānaṃ ratnamaṇipradānakam ।
hastidānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ yānavāhanadānakam ।।64।।
annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ jñānavidyāpradānakam ।
yatsāmarthyo bhaved dātā tathā dānaṃ mataṃ sadā ।।65।।
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na prakartavyaṃ dhaninā ca nṛpeṇa ca ।
phaladānaṃ kāṣṭhadānaṃ tiladānādi vāpi ca । ।66।।
nirdhanenāpi kartavyaṃ sevā vā dehasaṃbhavā ।
vācā vā manasā vātha karābhyāṃ sevanaṃ tathā ।67।।
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ vāryāharaṇaṃ pādamardanam ।
mandire dāsyavat vartyaṃ phalānantyādyavāptaye ।।68।।
bhāvayuktena bhagavān sevanena pratuṣyati ।
śṛṇu tatra śubhākhyānaṃ śravaṇādapi tārayet । ।69।।
purā tu vedhasastṛtīye kalpe marudeśajaḥ ।
rājā''sīttu maruddhanvā svārthamātraparāyaṇaḥ ।।1.238.7 0 ।।
kalpasyā'nte kalau rājā pravṛtto viṣayeṣvati ।
kāmalobhotthadoṣaiśca prajā jātāpi tādṛśī ।।71 ।।
prajāyāṃ doṣabāhulye rājā doṣeṇa lipyate ।
rājñaḥ pāpācca vai vṛṣṭirjāyate nahi tadṛtau ।।72।।
evaṃ vṛṣṭipratibandhe prajāḥ sarvāḥ prapīḍitāḥ ।
anyonyaṃ svaṃ cāharanti vastra cānnādi sarvathā ।।73।।
nīyate ca balātsarvaṃ nyāyastatra na vidyate ।
yathā yathā vinā vṛṣṭiṃ samayo vyeti tattathā ।।74।।
prajāḥ niṣpīḍya rājā saḥ dhanānnāni vikarṣati ।
nārīśca gāśca tatsarvaṃ prasahya nayati nṛpaḥ ।।75।।
hiṃsā'nṛtasteyabalātkārādipāpadūṣite ।
deśe prajākṣayo jāto rājāpi dhvaṃsasanmukhaḥ ।।76।।
atipāpaṃ mahāpāpaṃ cakāra bahudhā muhuḥ ।
evaṃ saptā'bdaparyantaṃ vṛṣṭirnaivā'bhavattataḥ ।।77।।
rājño bhāryā'nnarāhityād rogapīḍā'tisaṃbhavāt ।
mṛtyūnmūkhī tathā putro mṛtyūnmukho'bhavat yadā ।। 78।।
ākrośati sma rājā'sau paramātmā samuddhara ।
pāpānyatikṛtānyeva na puṇyaṃ cārjitaṃ mayā ।।79।।
phalaṃ prāptaṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ nāśo'pi mastake dhṛtaḥ ।
ataḥ paraṃ na kiñcidvai kartuṃ śaknomi mādhava ।।1.238.80।।
samuddhara mahāduḥkhāt kṣudhayā prāṇanāśayā ।
ityākrośan hariṃ dhyāyan rauti vilāpapūrvakam ।।8 1।।
tāvadākāśavāṇyāsīnmā rājan rodanaṃ kuru ।
paścāttāpena pāpāni dagdhāni matsmṛtestathā ।।।82।।
gṛhāṇedaṃ jalaṃ varṣābhavaṃ patrādikaṃ tathā ।
khādaya prāṇarakṣā vo bhaviṣyati sukhī bhava ।।83।।
ataścāgre tṛtīye ca dine tvekādaśī mama ।
priyā tithiḥ samupāvartate tasyā vrataṃ kuru ।।84।।
vṛṣṭiḥ sarvatra rājye te bhaviṣyati sukhāvahā ।
prajāḥ punaśca te rājye pravartsyanti sukhārthikāḥ ।।।85।।।
dhanadhānyamayo deśo bhaviṣyati ca tatphalam ।
prāpsyante ca prajāste'pi kurvantvekādaśīvratam ।।86।।
ityuktvopararāmeyaṃ rājā rājñī sutastathā ।
vrataṃ ca nirjalaṃ cakrurmahatpuṇyamabhūttataḥ ।।87।।
vrate kṛte mahāvṛṣṭirjātā deśaśca sasyavān ।
prajāvāsastato jāto rājñī nīrujatāṃ gatā ।।88।।
suto'pi sukhavān jātastasmai dadau dhuraṃ nijām ।
tatra varṣe kṛtāḥ sarvairekādaśyo hi vatsaram ।।89।।
tāvadākāśamārgeṇa vimānadvayamāgatam ।
rājñyarthaṃ ca nṛpatyarthaṃ vaimānikairadhiśritam ।।1.238.90 ।।
prāhuḥ svargīyadūtāstau samāgacchatamatra yat ।
yuvayorvratatajanyaṃ vai puṇyaṃ sahasranākadam ।।9 1।।
vartate tatsahasrayugavyāptaṃ bhogyameva hi ।
tatpuṇyena marunnāmā devaḥ kalpe caturthake ।।92।।
bhaviṣyasi kṣmāpate sabhāryastvaṃ svargṛhāṇa vai ।
ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūmīśo dehaṃ tyaktvā sabhāryakaḥ ।।93।।
yayau svargapradaṃ so'yaṃ kalpāntare punaḥ punaḥ ।
devo bhūtvā ca bhogāṃśca bhuktvā bhuktvā'tibhāvataḥ ।।94।।
svarṇāṃgado mahābhāgavato bhūtvā'tidāsavat ।
prasevya ca hariṃ prāpto dhāmā''vṛtivivarjitam ।।95।।
tato mārgā'sitapakṣotpattyaikādaśikāvratam ।
prayatnena prakartavyaṃ svargātsvargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।।96।।
ityutpattyabhidhaikādaśikāvratena sarvathā ।
rājyaputradhanalābhaścā''rogyaṃ sarvadā bhavet ।।97।।
sarvaṃ ceṣṭaṃ milet svargaṃ mokṣaścāpi bhavet tataḥ ।
sakāmaiścāpi niṣkāmaiḥ kartavyaṃ tadvrataṃ mahat ।।98।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mārgaśīrṣakṛṣṇapakṣotpattyekādaśīvratavidhyāditatphalaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭātriṃśadadhikadviśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।238।।


← adhyāyaḥ 238 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 239
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 240 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
vande'haṃ devadeveśaṃ sarvajīvasukhapradam ।
antaryāmiṇamārādhyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ।। 1 ।।
pṛcchāmi bhagavan viṣṇo lokānāṃ kṣemakāmyayā ।
pāpināṃ pāpanāśāya sakāmānāṃ samṛddhaye ।। 2 ।।
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī śubhā ।
kiṃ phalaṃ ko vidhistasyāḥ ko devastatpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 3 ।।
vistareṇa yathārthaṃ tat samācakṣva mama prabho ।
śrupvaitacchrīhariḥ prāha bhaktānāṃ hitakṛtprabhuḥ ।। 4 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi mārgaśīrṣasitaikādaśikāvratam ।
asyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 5 ।।
daśamyāṃ naktabhojī syād rātrau bhūśayanaṃ caret ।
brahmacārī bhavet krodhādikān doṣān parityajet ।। 6 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ brāhmasaṃjñe muhūrte jāgratiṃ labhet ।
smared dāmodaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ mokṣadāyāḥ patiṃ prabhum ।। 7 ।।
sarvapāpaharā mokṣapradā mokṣābhidhānikā ।
mokṣadā nāmataḥ proktā kṛṣṇena nijavāñcchayā ।। 8 ।।
dāmodarasvarūpeṇa svīkṛtā raivatācale ।
dāmodaro hyataḥ pūjyo bhagavāँśca tayā saha ।। 9 ।।
prātaḥ smareddhariṃ dāmodaraṃ sanmokṣadā priyām ।
saṃkalpayenmayā kāryaṃ vrataṃ caivādya muktaye ।। 1.239.1 0।।
smṛddhaye vāpi sarvasmai kāmāyeti gṛhī janaḥ ।
tataḥ śaucādiśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā snātvā sutīrthake ।। 1 1।।
ācamya ca hareḥ pūjāsāmagrīḥ samapādayet ।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayet saptadhānyakaiḥ ।। 12।।
sauvarṇaṃ vātha tāmrasya ghaṭaṃ madhye nidhāpayet ।
paṃcapallavavastrādipañcaratnaphalābbhṛtam ।। 1 3।।
nyasyetpātraṃ tilājyaṃ ca sthālīṃ vā tatra saddhare ।
mūrtiṃ dāmodaramokṣapradayoḥ svarṇanirmitām ।। 14।।
sthāpayetpūjayet ṣoḍaśopacārairvidhānataḥ ।
tulasyā mañjarībhiśca dhūpadīpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ ।। 15।।
mālatīpuṣpamālābhiḥ śriyā saha ca keśavam ।
arghyaṃ phalaṃ tu nāriṃgaṃ naivedye modakāstathā ।। 16।।
saptadhānyāni deyāni viśeṣaphalalabdhaye ।
yavagodhūmadhānyāni tilāḥ kaṃgūstathaiva ca ।। 17।।
śyāmākaṃ cīnakaṃ ceti saptadhānyāni tāni vai ।
deyāni tu yathāśakti dāne śreṣṭhāni sarvathā ।। 18।।
śriyā saha patiṃ vai keśavaṃ ca prārthayettadā ।
mayā vratamidaṃ mokṣadāyāḥ kṛtaṃ tvadāptaye ।। 19।।
yathāśakti mayā pūjā kṛtā vai tava keśava ।
prasanno bhava deveśa sarvasmṛddhikaro bhava ।।1.239.20।।
mokṣado bhava me svāmin saṃsārārṇavatāraka ।
iti saṃstūya naivedyaṃ phalaṃ vāri samarpya ca ।।21।।
tāmbūlaṃ ca sugandhaṃ ca dadyātpaścānnamaskriyām ।
kuryāccārārtrikaṃ caivottārayed vandanaṃ stavam ।।22।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet ।
yāni kāni ca pāpāni jñānā'jñānakṛtāni ca ।।23।।
vilayaṃ yāntu deveśa tava pūjāvratādinā ।
ityuccārya punarnatvā visarjanamathācaret ।।24।।
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ devāya saṃpradāpayet ।
sāyaṃ niśāmukhe pūjāṃ ṣoḍaśābhisuvastubhiḥ ।।25।।
kārayecca tato jāgaraṇaṃ bhaktaiḥ prakārayet ।
dvādaśyāṃ ca tathā prātaḥ snātvā sampūjya keśavam ।।26।।
visarjayecca dānāni vividhāni pradāpayet। ।
bahudravyādi gurave dadyācca bhojanādikam ।।27।।
evaṃ vrataprakartā syād bhuktimuktipratāpavān ।
pitṝṇāṃ tārakaḥ sa syācchatavaṃśārtiśālinām ।।।28।।
śṛṇu pūrvakathāṃ lakṣmi! mokṣadāyāḥ phalārpaṇāt ।
adhoyonigatāḥ sarve pitaro muktimāgatāḥ ।।29।।
campāpūryāṃ bhūpatiśca mahān vaiśvānarābhidhaḥ ।
mahāvaiṣṇavatāṃ paścātprāpto'bhūt pitṛtārakaḥ ।।1.239.30 ।।
prajāḥ putrasamāḥ sarvā rakṣati sma sa bhūpatiḥ ।
vaiṣṇavā bahavo viprā vasanti sma ca tatpure ।।3 1।।
vedavedāṃgavijñānāḥ satkarmādiparāyaṇāḥ ।
smṛddhāśca vibhavairyuktāḥ prajāśca sampadādibhiḥ ।।32।।
sukhapūrṇāḥ samāsaँśca rājño vaiśvānarasya vai ।
yadyapi puṇyapuñjena tapasā prākkṛtena ca ।।33।।
rājyaṃ smṛddhaṃ mahallabdhvā sadā rājyamadānvitaḥ ।
na karoti vrataṃ dānaṃ nāstikatvena bhūpatiḥ ।।34।।
na ca śrāddhaṃ karotyeva nānnavāryādidānakam ।
na puṇyapradakāryaṃ vā kārayati sma karhicat ।।35।।
puṇyaṃ na jāyate navyaṃ pitarastena duḥkhitāḥ ।
annavārivihīnāste pitṛlokādadhogatāḥ ।।36 ।।
svavaṃśajaṃ ca rājānaṃ śrāddhādihīnakarmakam ।
dṛṣṭvā'tiduḥkhino jātā uṣṇaśvāsātidurbalāḥ ।।37।।
niraye patitā rājño nāstikatvādipāpataḥ ।
te tu rātrau samāgatya svapne pratyakṣatāṃ gatāḥ ।।38।।
rudantaśca śvasantaśca rugṇāḥ saṃkṣudhitāstathā ।
tṛṣātiśuṣkakaṇṭhāścā'śaktā naṣṭabalāstathā ।।39।।
tejohīnāstathā śuṣkaśirāḥ kṛṣṇānanāstathā ।
krośanto'tidaridrāśca duḥkhino bhikṣukā iva ।।1.239.40 ।।
parasparaṃ kathayanto duḥkhāni duḥsahāni vai ।
aho rājye sthitaścāsmadvaṃśajo'pi sa nāstikaḥ ।।41।।
na śrāddhaṃ kurute cāyaṃ vaiśvānaropi vāri vā ।
dadātyeva na vai kāle pitṛpakṣe manāgapi ।।42।।
piṇḍānnaiva dadātyeva jalaṃ naiva dadāti ca ।
tarpaṇaṃ na karotyeva kārayatyeva naiva ca ।।43।।
tena duḥkhena santaptā duḥkhinaḥ sarvadā vayam ।
adhogatiṃ gatāḥ sarve niraye patitāstathā ।।44।।
rājāyaṃ nāstiko jātaḥ kiṃ tena kusutena vai ।
varaṃ nirvaṃśatā yadvā varaṃ tvāstikaputratā ।।45।।
varaṃ mokṣagatiścāpi na varā tu kuputratā ।
anye naiva pradāsyanti putro naiva dadāti ca ।।46।।
kathaṃ kasmāt kutaḥ prāpyamannaṃ vāri ca vā manāk ।
yadi cāyaṃ jalaṃ piṇḍān dadyāt syāmaḥ sukhānvitāḥ ।।47।।
ityuktvā'ntarhitāḥ sarve rājā'bhūd vismayānvitaḥ ।
kathayāmāsa prātastadvṛttāntaṃ svapnajaṃ dvijān ।।48।।
mayā svapitaraḥ svapne dṛṣṭā nirayapātitāḥ ।
uktavantaśca putra tvaṃ tārayā'smānadhogatān ।।49।।
evaṃ bruvāṇāḥ saśvāsaṃ rudantaśca vikrandanam ।
dṛṣṭā mayā ca tān smṛtvā sukhaṃ me na bhavatyapi ।।1.239.50।।
adya me rājyamṛddhaṃ ca tathā rājñī gajā'śvakam ।
na kiñcit sukhadaṃ bhāti rocate me na bhojanam ।।51।।
śaśvajjvalatyāntaraṃ me putrāghaṃ rocate nahi ।
kiṃ karomi hṛdayaṃ me dūyate pitṛjāgninā ।।52।।
kva gacchāmi samuddhārāyaiva teṣāṃ dvijottamāḥ ।
mucyante yena pitarastattapo vratamucyatām ।।53।।
yogo yajño'thavā'nyo'pi dānajādyutsavo mahān ।
yatkiṃcidvā mahatsvalpaṃ samuddhārakamucyatām ।।54।।
putre yogye samarthe ca jīvati pitarau yadi ।
duḥkhino niraye ghore phalaṃ sutasya kiṃ tadā ।।55।।
teṣāmuddhāra evātra tveṣṭavyo mama sarvathā ।
mā saṃkocaṃ prakurvantu dvijāḥ satyaṃ vadāmyaham ।।56।।
śrutvā rājñaḥ suvacanaṃ dvijā hṛṣṭā bhṛśaṃ tadā ।
procustaṃ pitṛkalyāṇaprayatnaṃ brāhmaṇāśritam ।।57।।
rājannasmatsu madhye'yaṃ samartho hi mahāmuniḥ ।
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vijānāti jaigīṣavyo'tiyogavān ।।58 ।
sa ca te sarvamājñāya samādhau divyadṛṣṭimān ।
nivedayiṣyati drāk sat pitaro'dhogatāḥ katham ।।59 ।।
jaigīṣavyo'bhyarthitaśca pitṝn dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
uvāca taṃ nṛpaṃ tatra jaigīṣavyo mahāmuniḥ ।।1.239.60 ।।
rājanna kevalaṃ cāsti nāstikatvaṃ tu kāraṇam ।
kintu te janakasyāsti nāstikatvaṃ ca kāraṇam ।।6 1 ।।
śṛṇu tathyaṃ kathayāmi mā kruddho bhava śaṃ bhaja ।
jāne'haṃ tava pitṝṇāṃ sarvaṃ pūrvaṃ viceṣṭitam ।।62।।
tava pituḥ kathayāmi śṛṇu cāvahito bhava ।
rājye tvāsīd yadā so'yaṃ tadā nāstikabhāvataḥ ।।63 ।।
vṛttiṃ jahāra devasya yā dattā pūrvajaittava ।
śāstradharmaṃ tathā cāsau gaṇayāmāsa naiva ca ।।64।।
rājyasya madamāsādya puṃścalīṣu pravartate ।
grāmāntare gataḥ so'yaṃ puṃścalyā vārayoṣitā ।।65।।
ṛtukāle'pi te māturnā''yāto nijamandiram ।
na dattaṃ tava mātuśca ṛtudānaṃ tu dhārmikam ।।66।।
evaṃ muhurvartayitvā pāpalipto'bhavad bahu ।
śrāddhakāle tathā śrāddhaṃ na kṛtaṃ dharmalopinā ।।67।।
tena pāpaprabhāveṇa pātayitvā svakān pitṝn ।
narake vāsayitvā ca nāstikyabhāvapūritaḥ ।।68।।
antimam ṛtudānaṃ ca tava māturvidhāya ca ।
kālena nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ patito niraye'pi saḥ ।।6 9।।
pitṛbhirnijapāpena sahito niraye'patat ।
svapatnyartupradānaṃ ca puṃścalīgamanaṃ tathā ।।1.239.70 ।।
nāstikatvaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhādyakaraṇaṃ tathā ।
svargalokānmahāsaukhyāt pitṛpātanahetavaḥ ।।71।।
ta ime patitāścaivehante tūddharaṇaṃ sutāt ।
suto'pi tvaṃ tathotpanno niṣekānnāstikasya vai ।।72।।
niṣeke yādṛśī vṛttiḥ putre bhavati tādṛśī ।
nāstikena samutpanno hyadhārmikeṇa yadbhavān ।।73।।
atastvaṃ nāstiko jātaḥ śrāddhaṃ naiva karoṣi ca ।
devavṛttiharastātaste'bhūt tasya pratikriyā ।।74।।
prāyaścittaṃ na caivāsti kalpakoṭiśatairapi ।
devavṛttirna vai hāryā pūrvairdattā nṛpaiḥ kvacit ।।75।।
tena pāpena narake duḥkhasyā'nto na jāyate ।
devavṛttiharasyā'tra padayoḥ raja ityapi ।।76।।
syād yasyopari patitaṃ saptakalpāḥ sa nārakī ।
ityuktaṃ prāṅ mahendrāya cāṇḍālyā gacchate puraḥ ।।77।।
ekadā kācidabalā cāṇḍālī tu śmaśānake ।
grāmaśūkaravakṣo'sthikṛtacūllyāḥ uparyatha ।।78।।
nṛmuṇḍaṃ pākapātraṃ ca dhṛtvā tatra śvamāṃsakam ।
madirātmajale kṣiptvā randhayati citāgninā ।।79।।
tāvattatpārśvatastatra mahendro nirgato yadā ।
pākapātraṃ tathā śīghraṃ chāditaṃ samupānahā ।।1.239.80।।
viśaṃkya tu tadā hīndrastāṃ papraccha paṭīyasīm ।
śuno māṃsaṃ surāpakvaṃ nṛmuṇḍe'tra citāgninā ।।8 1।।
sarvaṃ cāśuddhamevaitat carmaṇā chāditaṃ katham ।
pratyuvāca tadā sā vai cāṇḍālī śṛṇu devarāṭ ।।82।।
devadvijagavāṃ vṛttiṃ haranti hārayanti ye ।
teṣāṃ pādarajobhītyā carmaṇā chāditaṃ nvidam ।।83।।
yadi tvaṃ tādṛśo'bhūścenme pāko'śuddhatāṃ vrajet ।
na me bhojyaṃ bhavet tadvai vṛttighnā'ghapradūṣitam ।।84।।
indraḥ prāha kathaṃ yoṣit pātakaṃ cedṛśaṃ mahat ।
cāṇḍālī prāha madvākyaṃ nibodha ca yathārthataḥ ।।85।।
devā vai pitaraḥ proktā mātaro devatāstathā ।
devāśca vṛṣṭidātāro devāḥ saṃrakṣakāḥ sadā ।।86।।
yogakṣemaprakartāro lokānāṃ sarvadevatāḥ ।
jīvikāvṛttihā jīvahantā vai procyate khalu ।।87।।
vinā vṛttiṃ jīvanaṃ na vinā vṛttiṃ mṛto bhavet ।
devavṛttiharastasmāt pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā ।।88।।
devahā dharmahā tadvadātmahā svargahā hi saḥ ।
vṛṣṭihā lokahā caiva goghātī brahmaghātakaḥ ।।89।।
devaghātī vṛṣṭighātī sarvaghātī bhaveddhi saḥ ।
tasya pādarajaścāpi mahāpāpakaraṃ malam ।।1.239.90 ।।
tat śvamāṃse patitaṃ cenna me bhojyaṃ malaṃ hi tat ।
tasmānmayā tu pātraṃ taccarmaṇā chāditaṃ hi yat ।।9 1 ।।
yadi tvaṃ devavṛttīnāṃ dātā kartā'si cedyadi ।
tadā te padadhūlyā'tra pāvitaṃ palalaṃ bhavet ।।।92।।।
na me'styācchādane bhītirgaccha pūjya yathāsukham ।
indro'pi svasabhāyāṃ ca surarṣipitṛmānavaiḥ ।।93।।
śobhitāyāṃ taduktaṃ ca vṛttighnā mā bhavantviti ।
vṛttihārasya na cāsti niṣkṛtiḥ kathitā kvacit ।।94।।
tadārabhya trilokeṣu vṛttidānaṃ praśasyate ।
tasmād rājaँstava pitrūddhārakaṃ karma nāsti vai ।।95।।।
yenoddhāro bhavetteṣāṃ hareḥ sambandhamantarā ।
hareścāpi susambandho vratenaivopajāyate ।।96।।
mokṣadāyā vrataṃ mokṣapradaṃ prabhāvato hare ।
agatīnāṃ gatiḥ proktaṃ niṣkṛtirvajrapāpinām ।।97।।
sarvaṃ ca nirjalaṃ kāryaṃ pitṛbhyo dīyatāṃ phalam ।
mokṣadaikādaśījanyavratapuṇyaiḥ pramokṣaṇam ।।98।।
bhaviṣyatīti tatsarvaṃ gṛhītvā cābhipūjya ca ।
satkṛtya sādhūn viprāँśca gṛhān gantuṃ nyavedayat ।।99।।
mārgaśīrṣe'tha samprāpte site caikādaśī ca yā ।
rājñā copoṣitā pūjā harervidhānataḥ kṛtā ।। 1.239.100 ।।
sarvatobhadrakaṃ kṛtvā saikādaśīhari ca saḥ ।
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।। 10 1।।
jāgaraṇaṃ ca kṛtavān prātaḥsnānādikaṃ tathā ।
kṛtvā ca puṇyamevaitad datvā pitṛbhya ityapi ।। 1 02।।
pāraṇāṃ kṛtavān vaiśvānaro rājā vidhānataḥ ।
mokṣadaikādaśīpuṇyadānena pitarastadā ।। 10 3।।
svapitrā sahitāḥ sarve śīghraṃ vai mokṣamāviśan ।
puṇye datte ca pitṝṇāṃ muktau vaimānikāḥ surāḥ ।। 1 04।।
cakruḥ kusumavṛṣṭiṃ ca procuḥ puṇyā girastathā ।
svasti svasti ca putraste vayaṃ devāḥ samāgatāḥ ।। 1 05।।
ekādaśyāḥ puṇyadānāt pitarastāritāstvayā ।
te sarve mokṣamāpannā prāhurvai pitaro'pi te ।। 106।।
vayaṃ mokṣaṃ samāpannāḥ putra te kuśalaṃ bhavet ।
sukhī bhava sadā saukhyapradātā bhava dehinām ।। 1 07।।
śrāddhakartā yajñakartā devānāṃ pūjako bhava ।
mātāpitṛprasevādikartā bhava sadā'nagha ।। 108।।
dīrghajīvī cāstikastvaṃ patnīvrataparo bhava ।
devavṛttipradātā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ prapūjakaḥ ।। 10 9।।
satāṃ sevā prakartā ca sādhvīnāṃ vratarakṣakaḥ ।
gobhūrakṣākaro nityaṃ smṛddhaḥ syāḥ sarvadā suta ।। 1.239.11 0।।
ityevamāśīrvādaiśca saṃyujya pitaraḥ surāḥ ।
praśaṃsanto mokṣadāyā vratapuṇyaprabhāvakam ।। 11 1।।
gatā yathāmataṃ sthānaṃ bruvantaḥ svasti vai muhuḥ ।
rājāpi pāpanāśena mokṣadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।। 1 12।।
mahābhāgavato jātaḥ sakuṭumbaḥ samāstikaḥ ।
yajñayāgakaro nityaṃ viprasādhuprapūjakaḥ ।। 11 3।।
devapūjākaraścaiva dharmavān doṣavarjitaḥ ।
tasyā'bhūcca mahān dhārmirvaiṣṇavo hutabhuk sutaḥ ।। 1 14।।
rājyaṃ sutāya dattvā saḥ paraṃ mokṣamavāptavān ।
hutabhuk cāpi jaṭhare prāṇināṃ devatātmakaḥ ।। 1 15।।
mahāँśca vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā vahnirūpeṇa tiṣṭhati ।
mokṣadāyā vrataiśvaryaṃ bodhyaṃ taddevabhāvadam ।। 1 16।।
evaṃ yaḥ kurute lakṣmi mokṣāmekādaśīṃ śubhām ।
tasya pāpāni naśyanti mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।। 1 17।।
nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcid vajrapāpavināśakam ।
mokṣadaṃ cā'bhavat kiṃcinnārāyaṇaprabhāvavat ।। 1 18।।
asyā na puṇyasaṃkhyāsti priyaṃ tvetadvrataṃ mama ।
cintāmaṇisamā mokṣapradā sā me bahupriyā ।। 1 19।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratatulyaphalapradā ।
putrasmṛddhipradā bhuktimuktidā mama vallabhā ।। 1.239.120।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mārgaśīrṣaśuklapakṣīyamokṣadaikādaśīvratavidhāne vaiśvānara-
nṛpativṛttāntatatpitruddhārādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 239 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 239 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 240
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 241 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
pauṣakṛṣṇaikādaśī ca kiṃnāmnī ko vidhistathā ।
kiṃ phalaṃ kā ca lakṣmīśca ko devaḥ pūjyate vada ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi pauṣaikādaśikāvratam ।
ekādaśīvratenāhaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmi sarvathā ।। 2 ।।
pauṣasya kṛṣṇapakṣīyā saphalā nāmato hi sā ।
tasyāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ saṃkarṣaṇākhyaṃ svāminaṃ prabhum ।। 3 ।।
sunandāpatnikāyuktaṃ pūjayed bhāvanāyutaḥ ।
pūjāyāṃ munipuṣpāṇi naivedye guḍalaḍḍukāḥ ।। 4 ।।
atrā'rghye cāmṛtaphalaṃ svarṇadānaṃ ca śasyate ।
prāguktavidhinā kāryā daśamyekādaśī tathā ।। 5 ।।
dvādaśīpāraṇaṃ caiva kartavyaṃ coktarītitaḥ ।
prātarvai sarvatobhadramaṇḍale vratavāsare ।। 6 ।।
ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya ca hariṃ phalaiśca vividhairvratī ।
nārīkelaphalaiścaiva kramukairbījapūrakaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
jambīrairdāḍimaiścaiva tathā dhātrīphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
lavaṃgairbadaraiścaiva tathā''mraiśca viśeṣataḥ ।। 8 ।।
yatra yatphalalabdhiḥ syāt tattatphalaiḥ prapūjayet ।
ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ pūjanaṃ mahadācaret ।। 9 ।।
dīpadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa saphalāyāṃ prakārayet ।
dhānyadānaṃ vastradānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ gavārpaṇam ।। 1.240.1 0।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmilitairvaiṣṇavaiḥ saha ।
yadi nimeṣamātraṃ yaḥ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi ।। 11 ।।
yajñādhikaṃ phalaṃ sarvatīrthāplāvanaja phalam ।
varṣasahasratapasāṃ phalādhikaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 12।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathā māhiṣmatasya nṛpateḥ purā ।
satyayuge samajātā saphalāvratasaṃśrayāt ।। 13।।।
narmadāyāstaṭe'raṇye parvataprāyabhūtale ।
bhārate dakṣiṇe madhye purī māhiṣmatī śubhā ।। 14।।
māhiṣmatasya rājñastadrājyaṃ cābhūnmahattaram ।
tasya saumyāḥ pañca putrā hyāsan sarve kumārakāḥ ।। 15।।
dhīmān śrīmān dhṛtimāṃśca kīrtimān śaktimāniti ।
teṣāṃ madhye tu dhīmān vai jyeṣṭhaḥ pāparato'bhavat ।। 16।।
yauvanaṃ prāpya madyādi piban māṃsaṃ prabhakṣayan ।
veśyāṃ ca gamayan dārāḥ parā atyabhimarṣayan ।। 17।।
cauryaṃ ca pararāṣṭreṣu prasahya kārayan svakaiḥ ।
pāpātipāpaduṣṭātinikṛṣṭācāravānabhūt ।। 18।।
dyūtaṃ pānaṃ ca mṛgayā pramadā māṃsamityamūn ।
doṣān sa poṣayan dravyaṃ nāśayāmāsa vai pituḥ ।। 19।।
gamitaṃ maṇiratnādi svarṇādi pāpakarmabhiḥ ।
bubhukṣitastato jāto malino vedanindakaḥ ।। 1.240.20 ।।
asadbhāvo brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ dharmasya nindakaḥ ।
vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devānāṃ viśeṣānnindako'bhavat ।।21।।
prajāyāṃ sarvathā copadravaṃ piśācavaddhi saḥ ।
nityaṃ karotyato rājñā tvāhūto lumbhakābhidhaḥ ।।22।।
pitrā ca bāndhavaiḥ sarvairlumbhakastyakta eva hi ।
niṣkāsitaśca rāṣṭrādvai prajābhistāḍanādibhiḥ ।।23।।
yatra gacchati lumbho'sau tiraskāraṃ sa vindati ।
na ca saukhyamavāpnoti na ko'pi satkaroti tam ।।24।।
nirdhano gatasattāko veśyayāpi viniṣkṛtaḥ ।
paryaṭan vanavṛkṣeṣu kṣudhātṛṣārditaḥ svayam ।।25।।।
duḥkhaṃ tapaḥsvarūpaṃ vai ghoraṃ sehe'tidāruṇam ।
paścāttāpaṃ karoti sma muhuḥ svārjitakarmaṇām ।।26 ।।
tyakto'haṃ bāndhavaiḥ pitrā prajābhirveśyayā tathā ।
rājyānniṣkāsitaścāpi sarvaiścāpi tiraskṛtaḥ ।।27।।
varaṃ cātra vane vāsaḥ paraṃ vairaṃ na śāmyati ।
vairasya yāpanāyaiva vairiṇo'haṃ nihanmi vai ।। 28।।
pituśca nagaraṃ sarvaṃ ghātayiṣyāmi sarvathā ।
lopayiṣyāmi saudhāँśca hariṣyāmi dhanādikam ।। 29।।
śanaiḥ śanairidaṃ kāryaṃ dhanaṃ hartavyamuttamam ।
vane gupte pravastavyaṃ syāṃ na hastagato yathā ।।1.240.30 ।।
iti pāpamatiṃ kṛtvā dāruṇe gahane vane ।
jīvaghātarato nityaṃ steyahiṃsādiniṣṭhuraḥ ।।3 1।।
vasan rātrau ca nagaraṃ gatvā śastrairjanānbahūn ।
ghātayitvā dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ vastraṃ prabhūtamityapi ।। 32।।
nayati sma mahāraṇye khādati hlādate muhuḥ ।
sarvaṃ ca nagaraṃ tena muṣitaṃ pāpavṛttinā ।। 33।।
trāso mahān prajāyāṃ ca vartate sma nirantaram ।
akasmāddhanaharaṇaṃ prasahya śreṣṭhino janān ।।34।।
karoti sma kvacid vakrān mārayatyapi jīvataḥ ।
ekadā sa gṛhe rājamantriṇaḥ praviveśa ha ।।35।।
dhanaṃ bahu hṛtaṃ tena tathā khādyaṃ ca khāditam ।
pramadāśca tathā bhuktāstathā bālāśca tāḍitā । ।।36 ।।
gṛhaṃ prajvālitaṃ tasya kṛtaścopadravo mahān ।
tāvattatra samāyātaiḥ rājabhaṭairniśācaraiḥ ।।37।।
gṛhīto nigaḍe baddho raśmibhirhastayordhṛtaḥ ।
uvāca tān suto'haṃ vai rājño māhiṣmatasya vai ।।38।।
mocanīyo'hamevā'tra tvanyathā vaḥ sukhaṃ nahi ।
hariṣye bhavatāṃ prāṇān nāśayiṣyāmi śastrakaiḥ ।।39।।
kariṣye vo nāśameva dhanadārāgṛhārthinām ।
rājñaḥ suto na dhartavyaḥ kadācana sukhepsubhiḥ ।।1.240.40 ।।
dharṣaṇīyo na vai sarpo vipraḥ kṣatriya eva ca ।
vināśaphaladāste vai rakṣakāstu natāḥ sadā ।।41।।
iti śrutvā ca tairmukto gato'raṇye punarhi saḥ ।
āmiṣaṃ bhakṣayannityaṃ vārkṣaphalāni bhakṣayan ।।।42।।
prāṇayātrāṃ sa nirvāhayati kandādibhistathā ।
cauryeṇāpi svanirvāhaṃ karoti vanavāsavān ।।43।।
vane tatrā'bhavajjīrṇaṃ viṣṇusthānaṃ vinirjanam ।
aśvatthasya ca vṛkṣasyā'dhomūle naṣṭabhittikam ।।44।।
naṣṭadvāraṃ naṣṭaśālaṃ naṣṭacchāyaṃ nirāśrayam ।
tatrā'nena tu bhagnayā mūrterviṣṇorhi vedikā ।45।।
āśrayārthaṃ svīkṛtā''sīd viśrāntirlabhyate'tra ca ।
aśvattho'pi jīrṇaśākhastambaśca bahuvārṣikaḥ ।।46।।
devabhāvena vṛkṣo'yaṃ viṣṇuyogāddhi vartate ।
tatra vāsāllumbhakasya devisthānapratāpataḥ ।।47।।
buddhistu sāttvikī jātā vicāraṃ cākaroddhi saḥ ।
aho mayā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bahu yasya na niṣkṛtiḥ । ।48।।
athāpi na mayā kāryaṃ hiṃsanaṃ prāṇaghātakam ।
kandādyattvā ca nirvāhaṃ kariṣye pippalāśrayaḥ । ।49।।
viṣṇuścātra vasatyeva mūrtau tu pippale tarau ।
kariṣyati mama śreyaḥ pāpaṃ prajvālayiṣyati ।।1.240.50।।
ityevaṃ kṛtabuddhiḥ saḥ śaityakāle'pi bhūtale ।
vṛkṣastambāśraye rātriṃ nirgamayati kaṣṭataḥ ।।51।।
tāvattatra samāyātāścaurāścānye vanāśrayāḥ ।
lumbhakasya ca vastrādi prajahruḥ pauṣakṛṣṇake ।।52।।
pauṣasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu daśamyāṃ prātareva saḥ ।
phalānyāhṛtya bubhuje kathaṃcid divaso gataḥ ।।।53 ।।
rātrau tvākasmikaṃ śaityaṃ himāḍhyaṃ pravavarṣa ha ।
yatrāgnitāpanenāpi rakṣaṇaṃ na yathā bhavet ।।54।।
tathā śītapravāhasya bhogabhūto'bhavaddhi saḥ ।
vastrahīno vivṛttākṣo milanmukho'bhavajjaḍaḥ ।।55। ।
nidrāsukhaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ ca gataprāṇa ivā'bhavat ।
miladdaśanajihvā''syo hastapādajaḍatvavān ।।56।।
śavavat sa tadā jātaḥ śaityena paripīḍitaḥ ।
kintu prāṇā gatā naiva gataceṣṭo'bhavaddhi saḥ ।।57।।
āntare smarati viṣṇuṃ rakṣakaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
prātarjātaṃ saphalāyā ekādaśyāstathāpi saḥ ।।58।।
bhānūdaye'pi śītārdro na lebhe cetanāṃ tadā ।
ravau madhyagate so'yaṃ saṃjñāṃ lebhe hi lumbhakaḥ ।।59।।
itastato vilokyaiva vyutthito hyabhavattataḥ ।
viṣṇuṃ vṛkṣaṃ raviṃ natvā skhalan padbhyāṃ vane gataḥ ।।1.240.60 ।।
khañjavat saśanairgacchan kṣutkṣāmaḥ śaktihīnakaḥ ।
vepamānāṃgakaścāpi satphalānyājahāra saḥ ।।6 1।।
viṣṇave cārpaṇīyāni tato grāhyāṇi vai mayā ।
ityācintya samāgatya vṛkṣamūle nidhāya ca ।।62।।
yāvattiṣṭhati vṛkṣādho luṃbhako'tīva nirbalaḥ ।
tāvadastaṃgataḥ sūryaḥ kaṣṭaṃ śuśoca vai tadā ।।63।।
aśrūṇi vinimucyaiva kā bhaviṣyati me daśā ।
śaityaṃ ca bādhate samyag bhavet parṇairna rakṣaṇam ।।64।।
śaityapravārakaṃ puṣṭaṃ valkalādi na vidyate ।
na gūhā na ca tārṇaṃ vā kaṭaṃ cāpyatra vidyate ।।65।।
tathāpi tṛṇapuṃje'trāśrayaṃ kṛtvā svapimyaham ।
iti vicintya nikaṭe tṛṇānyādātumutsukaḥ ।।66।।
phalāni viṣṇumūrteśca samīpe vinidhāya ca ।
uccārya ca phalairebhiḥ śrīpatistuṣyatāṃ hariḥ ।।67।।
tato yāto'tinikaṭe tṛṇā''nayanahetave ।
kintu balaprahīṇaḥ saḥ vedikāyāḥ samīpataḥ ।।68।।
punarmūrcchāmavāpaiva nārāyaṇa iti smaran ।
kṣaṇāntare samutthāya tṛṇānyādāya pippale ।।69 ।।
stambādhāre svayaṃ yāvadāgatya ca niṣīdati ।
tāvanmūrchā punarjātā punaścaitanyamāptavān ।।1.240.70।।
viṣṇuṃ smṛtvā lumbhakaḥ sa nidrāṃ lebhe na śāntidām ।
prātaḥ phalāni bhokṣyāṇītyevaṃ niśāṃ nināya saḥ ।।7 1।।
evaṃ vivaśataḥ prāptaṃ vratāhaṃ cā'vidannapi ।
sopavāsaṃ sajāgaraṃ kṛtavān śītapīḍitaḥ ।।72।।
tatphalaiḥ pūjanaṃ mene naivedyaṃ cāpi keśavaḥ ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ mene viṣṇustasya durātmanaḥ ।।73।।
saphalāyā vrataṃ mene tapaḥ svāśrayajaṃ tathā ।
viṣṇuḥ prasannatāṃ prāpto dayālurdīnavatsalaḥ ।।74।।
lumbhakasyā'karod bhāgyaṃ puṇyāḍhyaṃ śāśvataṃ śubham ।
akasmādvratamevaitatkṛtavān vai sa lumbhakaḥ ।।75।।।
dvādaśyāṃ ca tadā prātaḥ phalānyattvā hareḥ puraḥ ।
stutiṃ cakāra devasya saṃsārādrakṣaṇaṃ prati ।।76।।
sūryasyodayanaṃ yāvat tāvadviṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ ।
saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpeṇa prāvirbabhūva tatpuraḥ ।।77।।
divyāvayavaśobhāḍhyo divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।
divyamandaprasannāsyahāsyalāsādiśobhitaḥ ।।78।।।
dakṣahastena lumbhaṃ taṃ spṛṣṭvā ca mastake'vadat ।
rājyaṃ prāpsyasi bhakta tvaṃ saphalāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।।79 ।।
gaccha svanagaraṃ tatra te pitā nidhanaṃ gataḥ ।
anye parasparaṃ putrā viruddhyantyabhiṣecane ।।1.240.80।।
parasparaṃ viruddhāste rājyamukuṭavañcitāḥ ।
rājyaṃ ca nāpnuvan mantriprajābhiranadhikṛtāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tavā''gamaṃ pratīkṣante prajāste bhāgyavardhanāt ।
kālo'yaṃ te punaryāto hyekādaśīphalodayāt । ।82। ।
yaiḥ pūrvaṃ tāḍyate tiraskriyate kālavegataḥ ।
taireva punariṣyate hyaho kālabalaṃ mahat । ।83।।
bhāgyahānermahatkaṣṭaṃ sukhaṃ bhāgyodaye punaḥ ।
bhāgyodayo vṛtādyaiśca jāyate kāryameva tat ।।84।।
tasmād gaccha svakaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhāṇa mā ciraṃ kuru ।
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇustatra tvantarjagāma ha ।।85।।
lumbhakaḥ pippale viṣṇuṃ natvā tejo hyavāptavān ।
divyarūpasvarūpaḥ san bhūtvā svanagarīṃ yayau ।।86।।
mantriprajāgragaiḥ sammānitaḥ svāgatavardhitaḥ ।
divyābharaṇaśobhābhiralaṃkṛto'tha vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।87।।
bhūtvā rājyābhiṣekaṃ svapitṛparamparāgatam ।
prāpto hareḥ prasādena saphalāyā vratena ca ।।88।।
bhāgyodayena rājā sa lebhe rājyamakaṇṭakam ।
śubhaṃ rājyaṃ prajārakṣāpālanādividhānataḥ ।।89।।
śatavarṣaṃ ca tadrājyaṃ kṛtvā''rādhya hariṃ tathā ।
prajāśīrvādamāsādya putraṃ mānajitāhvayam ।।1.240.90 ।।
rājye'bhiṣicya ca vanaṃ yāto yatrā'bhavatpurā ।
viṣṇumārādhya ca tatra nirmāya viṣṇumandiram ।।91 ।।
harerarcāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sevitvā ca tathā'nvaham ।
tapasā yogasāmyena kṣapayitvā''ntarāśayān ।।92।।
gataḥ kṛṣṇasya sānnidhyaṃ vimānena sutejasā ।
pārṣadāśca harestatra vimāne taṃ pragṛhya ca ।।93।।
yayurdhāma harerdivyaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati ।
tatra golokasaṃjñe vai dhāmni lumbhakabhūpatiḥ ।।94।।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sevate nityaṃ pārṣadairabhipūjitaḥ ।
evaṃ yaḥ kurute loke saphalāvratamuttamam ।।95।।
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya mṛto mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।
dhanyāste mānavā loke saphalāvratakāriṇaḥ ।।96।।
teṣāṃ tu saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ ca dhanādikam ।
saphalāyā vrataṃ yaistu kṛtaṃ vai bhāvapūrvakam ।। 97।।
saphalaikādaśī rājyalakṣmīrūpaphalapradā ।
muktidā ceti sā kāryā bhuktimuktisamīpsubhiḥ ।।98।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccaiva vratasya karaṇāttathā ।
rājasūyasya yajñasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।। 99।।
putrān pautrān dhanaṃ smṛddhiṃ sampadṃ rājyamityapi ।
vidyāṃ puṣṭiṃ tathā''rogyaṃ muktiṃ ca labhate vratī ।। 1.240.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pauṣakṛṣṇasaphalaikādaśīvratavidhipāpilumbhakanṛpakumāra-
rājyaprāptyākhyānādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।240।।


← adhyāyaḥ 240 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 241
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 242 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nārāyaṇa namastubhyaṃ purāṇapuruṣottama ।
mokṣakaraṃ ca jīvānāṃ phaladaṃ ca vrataṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
śrāvayase yena pāparāśayaḥ prajvalanti vai ।
pauṣaśuklasya ca yā vai bhavedekādaśī śubhā ।। 2 ।।
kathayasva prasādena kiṃnāmnī ko vidhistathā ।
ko devaḥ pūjyate tatra phalaṃ cāpi kiyanmatam ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
lokānāṃ hitalābhāya kathayāmi priye ca tām ।
pauṣasya śuklapakṣasyaikādaśī putradā'bhidhā ।। 4 ।।
sarvapāpaharā bhaktaiḥ kartavyaiṣā prayatnataḥ ।
sānandāpi ca sā proktā putrānandapradāyinī ।। 5 ।।
nārāyaṇo'dhidevo'tra pūjyaśca padmayā saha ।
sarvasiddhiprado devaḥ putrakāmaprapūrakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
guggulapuṣpakaiḥ pūjyastathā'nyaiḥ kālasaṃbhavaiḥ ।
cūrṇalaḍḍukanaivedyaṃ dadyācca paramātmane ।। 7 ।।
arghyaṃ ca dāḍimaphalaṃ phalānyanyāni cāpi vai ।
ghṛtapūrṇaghaṭo. deyaḥ śrīpadmāpataye tathā ।। 8 ।।
dakṣiṇāścāpi dātavyā svarṇarūpā viśeṣataḥ ।
daśamyāṃ naktabhojī yo vratī pṛthvyāṃ śayīta ca ।। 9 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle samutthāya hariṃ smaret ।
snātvā pūjopacārāṇi saṃgṛhya pūjayeddharim ।। 1.241.10 ।।
satpātre ca samasthāpya paṃcāmṛtena vāriṇā ।
snāpayed devadeveśaṃ vastrabhūṣādi dhārayet ।। 11 ।।
lepayed dravyagandhādi puṣpahāraiśca śobhayet ।
dhūpadīpā'kṣatapuṣpasāmagrībhiḥ prapūjayet ।। 1 2।।
naivedyaṃ miṣṭabhojyādi jalapānādikaṃ dadet ।
nīrājanastutipradakṣiṇādibhiḥ prasādayet ।। 13।।
vratārthaṃ prārthayed devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
putradāyā vrataṃ cāhaṃ karomi pūrṇatā vrajet ।। 14।।
ityabhyarthya tataḥ saptadhānyaiśca racayecchubham ।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kartavyaṃ tatra vai ghaṭaḥ ।। 15।।
sthāpanīyaḥ pallavādiyutastadupari sthale ।
tilapūrṇaṃ śubhaṃ pātraṃ tatra mūrtirharestathā ।। 16।।
pratiṣṭhāpya ṣoḍaśabhirvastubhiḥ pūjayetprabhum ।
ārārtrikaṃ ca puṣpāṇāmaṃjaliṃ cārpayet tataḥ ।। 17।।
prārthayet phalalābhāya tathā dānāni dāpayet ।
madhyāhne'pi tathā pūjānaivedyādi samarpayet ।। 18।।
sāyaṃkālottaraṃ cāpi viśiṣṭaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
jāgaraṇaṃ prakuryācca dvādaśyāṃ ca tathāvidham ।। 1 9।।
pūjanaṃ vastudānaṃ ca kuryād vratī tato janān ।
dvijān sādhūṃśca sādhvīśca bhojayetpāraṇāṃ svayam ।।1.241.20।।।
kuryāccaiva vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ phalaṃ mokṣādikaṃ bhavet ।
putradāyā vratameva yaḥ kuryād bhaktino janaḥ ।।21।।
putraputrīgajago'śvadhānyakṣetrādikaṃ śubham ।
prāpnuyāccāpi muktiṃ ca śrīhareḥ kṛpayā vratī ।। 22।।
atrārthe śṛṇu lakṣmi! te pravakṣyāmi kathānakam ।
putradāphalalābhātmasmṛddhidaṃ sukhadaṃ param ।।23।।
purā yuge tu saurāṣṭre bhadrāvatyabhidhe pure ।
rājā''sīt ketumāँstasya rājñī cumpā'bhidhā'bhavat ।।24।।
vārdhakyātisunaikaṭyaṃ gatasyāpi ca bhūpateḥ ।
putro nā'bhūd yato'putraḥ śocatyanudinaṃ nṛpaḥ ।।25।।
kālo yāti na cāśāsti putrārthe svastriyā api ।
tābhyāṃ pracintitaṃ putraprāptidaṃ dānapūjanam ।।26।।
kṛtaṃ ca vividhaṃ yādṛg viprairvai darśitaṃ tathā ।
bahubhirbahudhā proktaṃ kṛtaṃ tad vividhaṃ śubham ।।।27।।
naivātmajaṃ nṛpo lebhe vaṃśakartāramapyatha ।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi vārdhakyaṃ dṛśyate puraḥ ।।28।।
kathaṃcitprāntakālepi sutaprāptiryathā bhavet। ।
tathopāyāḥ prakartavyā niścityeti nṛpaḥ punaḥ ।।29।।
yāti bahusthalaprakhyān sāmarthyāḍhyān sato janān ।
āśīrvādāँśca gṛhṇāti viphalāśca bhavanti te ।।1.241.3 0 ।।
na rāṣṭrasya na rājyasya sukhaṃ lebhe suketumān ।
sādhvyā rātryā samaṃ nityaṃ duḥkhito vartate bhṛśam ।।3 1। ।
cintāśokaparābhyāṃ ca tābhyāṃ dattaṃ jalādikam ।
śrāddhe tu pitaraḥ sarve kavoṣṇamupabhuṃjate. ।।32। ।
ketumati mṛte paścād vaṃśajaṃ tarpaṇāya naḥ ।
paśyāmo nahi kiṃ kurmo yo'smākaṃ tarpayiṣyati । । 33।।
ityevaṃ duḥkhitā sarve pitaro yānti niḥsukhāḥ ।
na ca bandhujanā mitrajanā amātyamantriṇaḥ ।।34।।
suhṛdaśca prajā dāsā dāsyaḥ samṛddhayo gajāḥ ।
rocayantyasya rājño vai svapne'pi duḥkhakāriṇaḥ । । 35।।
nityaṃ tasya mano'svasthaṃ nairāśyena vidūyate ।
aputrasya janasyātra khalu tatrāpi bhūpateḥ ।।36।।
smṛddhasya rājyabharturvai nāstyeva janmanaḥ phalam ।
aputrasya gṛhaṃ dārāḥ smṛddhiḥ śūnyaṃ hi dṛśyate ।। 37।।
sutaṃ vinā ṛṇaṃ pitṛdevarṣīṇāṃ na mucyate ।
aurasaṃ sutamāsādyā'nṛṇatvaṃ paitradaivatam । । 38।।
labhyate ca yaśastvatra paraloke śubhā gatiḥ ।
putreṇa jāyate tasmāt sutamutpādayejjanaḥ ।।39।।
putrastu puṇyakartṝṇāṃ jāyate sukhadaḥ sadā ।
āyuṣyārogyasampattidhanadhānyapravardhakaḥ ।।1.241.40 ।।
hareḥ kṛpāṃ tathā puṇyaṃ vinā putrajanirna vai ।
na ca puṇyakṛtāṃ lokaprāptiścāpi sutaṃ vinā ।।41।।
putro dhanaṃ mahatproktaṃ putro vai sampaducyate ।
putro gṛhaṃ sutaḥ sambandho'pi lokeṣu gīyate ।।42।।
sutaṃ vinā na sambandho na taṃ vinā kuṭumbitā ।
tāṃ vinā na yaśo loke tadvinā na svaravyayam ।।43।।
rātriṃdivā svayaṃ rājā cintayan labhate na śam ।
ātmanāśaṃ cet karomi tvātmaghāte'tidurgatiḥ ।।44।।
anaśane'pi loke'tra hāhākāraśca durgatiḥ ।
tasmānmayā ca kiṃ kāryaṃ vicāryaivaṃ divāniśam ।।45।।
varaṃ tapasā dehasya kṣapaṇaṃ cetimānasaḥ ।
rātrāvaśvaṃ samāruhya jagāmāraṇyamekalaḥ ।।46।।
na jānanti prajāścāsya gṛhadārādayastathā ।
kva gato'yaṃ mahārāja ityabhūvan vicintitāḥ ।।47।।
cintāparā'tiduḥkhāste yayustanmārgaṇāya vai ।
aśvapādapravinyāsān dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā yayurvanam ।।48।।
śādvale'tighane deśe vājipādāvalekhanam ।
yadā dṛṣṭaṃ na tairbhūmau tadā te svapuraṃ prati ।।49।।
āyayuḥ śokacintāśca preṣayāmāsurāśritān ।
vanyān vane mārgaṇāya tairapyāpto na bhūpatiḥ ।।1.241.50 ।।
vanādanyavanaṃ rājā tatopi gahanaṃ vanam ।
dūraṃ dūraṃ siṃhahastisevitaṃ praviveśa ha ।।51।।
bhāgyayogānna vai kaiściddhiṃsairvyāpādito nṛpaḥ ।
nāśvo'pi maraṇaṃ prāpto daivayogāddhi jīvataḥ ।।52।।
vanavṛkṣānvaṭān bilvānkadambānpanasāndhavān ।
kharjūrān pippalānsvarṇacampakāँśca vilokayan ।।193।।
tathā tālānsarjatarūँstamālāँsūtilakān vaṭān ।
bakulānsaptaparṇāṃśca tintiḍīśca vilokayan ।।54।।
iṅgudīrbadarīścaiva jambūँśca karamardakān ।
vaṃśānaśokānkadalīnāryaṃgānnārikelakān ।।55।।
paśyan yayau vanaṃ ghoraṃ paśyansiṃhānmṛgānkhagān ।
analānhaṃsakāraṇḍabakāँścamarīgośaśān ।।56।।
vyāghrāँśca bhallukān genḍānśṛṃgamṛgāँśca śallakām ।
gajāँśca gavayānvanyamahiṣānbhujagāँstathā ।।57।।
paśyannāścaryasaṃyukto'dṛṣṭapūrvāṃśca dehinaḥ ।
śṛṇvannulūkajambūkarkṣamṛgādirutāni saḥ ।।58।।
vanyāni bhakṣayan puṣpaphalāni ca yayau nṛpaḥ ।
tṛṣitaścintayāmāsa saḥ śuṣkagalakandharaḥ ।।59।।
mārgayāmāsa salilāśayaṃ pakṣirutānugaḥ ।
tatra divyajalaṃ suṣṭhu saro dṛṣṭvā nisargajam ।।1.241.6 0।।
aśvapaṭṭaitikhyātaṃ raivatādreḥ prapūrvagam ।
mīnamakaramatsyādiśobhitaṃ kamalairyutam ।।61 ।।
haṃsaiḥ kāraṇḍavaiścakravākaiścānalapakṣibhiḥ ।
śobhitaṃ paridṛṣṭvaiva yayāvānandamuttamam ।।62।।
jagāma tvarito bhūpo jalapānārthamutsukaḥ ।
tadā netraṃ karo vakṣaḥ prāsphurad dakṣiṇaṃ śubham ।।63।।
jale tu snānakartṝn sa divyāndevānvyalokayat ।
gatvā tatra nanāmāsau hayāduttīrya cāgragaḥ ।।64।।।
pṛthakpṛthagvavande'sau devānmunisvarūpiṇaḥ ।
japataḥ śrīharerjāpānvratakarṣitavigrahān ।।65।।
baddhāṃjalirgadgado'bhūddaṇḍavatpracakāra ca ।
āśīrvādaiḥ plāvito'yaṃ nṛpaḥ papraccha tānsurān ।।66।।
ke bhavanto'tra gahane nirjale'raṇyake jale ।
snātuṃ samāgatāḥ santi yatra vāso na mānuṣaḥ ।।67।।
yāthātathyaṃ vadantvatra yena me'pi śubhaṃ bhavet ।
duḥkhino duḥkhanāśāya satāṃ vai darśanaṃ matam ।।68।।
iti pṛṣṭāśca te devāḥ prāhustaṃ bhāgyasanmukham ।
viśvedevā vayaṃ rājan devāḥ svarganivāsinaḥ ।।69।।
munisvarūpaiścā''yātāḥ snānārthaṃ putradāvrate ।
adyaivaikādaśī cāsti putradānāmanāmataḥ ।।1.241.70।।
tatra snātuṃ vayaṃ yātā tīrthe'smin raivatācalāt ।
snātvā svargaṃ gamiṣyāmo vrataṃ cādyāsti vai mahat ।।71।।
kathaṃ bhavānsamāyāto nirjane gahane vane ।
śrutvā rājātisaṃhṛṣṭo kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ duḥkhito'pi san ।।72।।
svānukūlaṃ sukhaṃ matvā jalaṃ naiva papau tadā ।
vrataṃ naisargato jātaṃ matvā putraphalapradam ।।73।।
uvāca tānmunīn rājā hyaputro'haṃ sutecchayā ।
kṛtavānbahupuṇyāni sutaṃ tathāpi nā'labham ।।74।।
tataḥ śokaparītāṃgastapase'tra samāgataḥ ।
kariṣye ca tapaścātra putrārthaṃ kṛpayātra vaḥ ।।75।।
munayaśca tadā prāhurbhūpate putradāvratāt ।
putraprāptikaraṃ puṇyaṃ jātaṃ te mā tapaḥ kuru ।।76।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāḥ prātaḥ sampūjya keśavam ।
jalasya pāraṇāṃ kṛtvā patrapuṣpādinā tathā ।।77।।
yāhi gṛhaṃ ca te putro bhaviṣyati narādhipaḥ ।
ityevaṃ daivayogena vratasya karaṇāttathā ।।78।।
āśīrvādāँśca devānāmupalabdhvā gṛhāgataḥ ।
rājñī garbhaṃ dadhau kāle putro jāto'tibhāgyavān ।।79। ।
dīrghajīvī prajāpālo babhūva sa narādhipaḥ ।
nāmnā ca kuṃkumān yasya saurāṣṭraṃ kaṃkasaṃjñayā ।।1.241.80।।
rājyaṃ khyātamabhūttasya vaṃśopi vaiṣṇavo hyabhūt ।
tasmāllakṣmi! prakartavyaṃ putradaikādaśīvratam ।।8 1 । ।
lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya mayaitat kathitaṃ tava ।
ye'tra janāḥ kariṣyanti putradāyā vrataṃ śubham ।।82। ।
putrānprāpyeha loke te svargaṃ yāsyanti vai mṛtāḥ ।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ paśūn putrān dīrghamāyuṣyamityapi ।।83।।
patnīṃ śubhāṃ patiṃ saumyaṃ kṣetraṃ smṛddhiṃ mahattamām ।
prāpsyantyavaśyamevaitadvratasya karaṇājjanāḥ । ।84।।
asyāśca paṭhanāllakṣmi! śravaṇātsmaraṇāttathā ।
putraprāptiphalaṃ tadvaccāgniṣṭomaphalaṃ bhavet ।।85।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne pauṣaśuklaputraikādaśīvratamāhātmyaketumādrājarṣiputra-lābhanirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo-
'dhyāya ।।241।।


← adhyāyaḥ 241 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 242
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 243 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
mahāviṣṇo hare vāsudeva lakṣmīpate prabho ।
anugrahaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā vada māghā'site dale ।। 1 ।।
ekādaśī ca kiṃnāmnī kaścādhipatirīśvaraḥ ।
vidhiḥ phalaṃ ca dānāni vaiśeṣikaṃ ca yadbhavet ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu priye māghakṛṣṇaikādaśī ṣaṭtilābhidhā ।
nāmnāsti tatpatirvāsudevaḥ śrīpriyayā saha ।। 3 ।।
pūjanīyaḥ sthalapadmairgulābjaiḥ komalaistathā ।
naivedye ghṛtapūrāśca prārghyaṃ drākṣāphalāni ca ।। 4 । ।
ūrṇāvastrāṇi deyāni kambalādīni bhāvataḥ ।
methikāpākabhakṣyāṇi māṣalaḍḍukabhojanam ।। 5 । ।
anyatpuṣṭikaraṃ dravyaṃ śītahārakakaṃcukam ।
evamādīni deyāni pūjādānādikarmasu । । 6 । ।
tiladeyaṃ samākhyātā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī ।
dālbhyaṃ prāha pulastyaḥ prāg vratamasyāḥ sukhapradam ।। 7 ।।
manuṣyā yauvanopetā dāridryaduḥkhakarṣitāḥ ।
jīvikārthaṃ ca pāpāni kurvanti tvavaśāśca ye । । 8 ।।
brahmahatyābālahatyāstrīhatyāgovadhādikam ।
hiṃsanaṃ paradravyāpahāraṃ ca vyasanāni ca ।। 9 ।।
svadāreṣvaprasakiṃ ca parasmṛddhivināśanam ।
prasahya duḥkhadāyitvaṃ gurūnindā'nṛtāni ca । । 1.242.1 0।।
duṣṭakarmaprajīvitvaṃ kanyāvikrayaṇaṃ tathā ।
rasā'niṣṭavimiśratvaṃ viśvāsaghātavañcanam । । 11 । ।
evamādīni pāpāni nareṣu yāni rāgataḥ ।
bhavanti cātha jāyante teṣāṃ nāśakaraṃ vratam ।। 12।।
tiladaikādaśīrūpaṃ sarvapāpapradāhakam ।
prabalaṃ māghamāse tadvrataṃ kṛṣṇe dale kṛtam ।। 13 । ।
śodhayeccāntaraṃ jantoḥ pāpāni kṣālayettathā ।
naitādṛśaṃ vrataṃ cānyad drāgeva jantuśodhakam ।। 14।।
māghasnāyī vratī māghe kṛṣṇe daśamīvāsare ।
ekabhukto bhavet paścād rātrau pṛthvyāṃ śayīta ca । । 15।।
brahmacārī bhaveccaivaikādaśyāṃ brāhmasaṃjñake ।
muhūrte ca samutthāya smarennārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi । । 16। ।
gṛhṇīyācca varīṣṭhānāṃ satāṃ ca sātvatāṃ tathā ।
nāmāni ca harernāmabhajanaṃ kṣaṇamācaret ।। 17।।
tālikāṃ vādayitvā ca mūrtiṃ smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ ।
hare rāma ghanaśyāma svāmin nārāyaṇa prabho ।। 18।।
tavāsmi nityadā bhakte mayi tiṣṭha pramokṣada ।
iti stutvā tato yāyācchaucārthaṃ bahireva ca ।। 1 9।।
mṛdā jalena śuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā gaṇḍūṣakāँścaret ।
tilacūrṇaṃ tato dehe samyagudvartayed vratī ।।1.242.20।।
satilasalilenātha snāyānnāma harergṛṇan ।
tilahomaṃ prakuryācca tilavāri pibettathā ।।21 ।।
tiladānaṃ prakuryācca tilabhojanamācaret ।
tilasnāyī tilodvartī tilahomī tilodakī ।।22।।
tiladātā tilabhoktā ṣaṭatilā pāpanāśinī ।
tilaprarohājjāyante yāvacchākhāstilāni ca ।।23।।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ।
kṛṣṇatilā matāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ snāne dāne prapūjane ।।24।।
snātvā vratī tiladāyāḥ prātareva prapūjayet ।
vāsudevaṃ śriyā yuktaṃ navaiḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।।25।।।
puṣpāṃjalipradāne ca prārthayecchaṭtilāvratam ।
kariṣye nātha nirvighnaṃ me tadastu phalapradam ।।26।।
tava kṛpākaṇenāpi vratasampūrṇatā bhavet ।
kāmakrodhādyahaṃlobhapaiśunyādi na me'stu vai ।।27।।
ityabhyarthya guruṃ natvā smṛtvā śrīharimeva ca ।
prātaśca sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ kārayed vratī ।।।28।।
tanmadhye svarṇajaṃ yadvā tāmrajaṃ ghaṭamuttamam ।
pañcapallavasadratnajalādyaiḥ saṃprapūritam ।।29।।
sthāpayettaṃ ca vastreṇa sūtreṇāpi ca veṣṭayet ।
pūjayettaṃ tatastasyopari kṛṣṇatilabhṛtam ।।1.242.30 ।।
sthālīpātraṃ sthāpayecca tatra mūrtiṃ suvarṇajām ।
vinyasyed vāsudevasya śrīpriyāṣaṭtilāyutām ।।3 1।।
pañcāmṛtajalaistāṃ ca snāpayedabhiṣecanaiḥ ।
vastrādi ca vibhūṣādi tvalaṃkārāँśca dhārayet ।।32।।
gulālakuṃkumā'bīracandanā'kṣatahārakaiḥ ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlasatphalaiḥ ।।33।।
kūṣmāṇḍairnārikelaiścā'mṛtaiśca bījapūrakaiḥ ।
pradakṣiṇādaṇḍavatsunamaskārastavādibhiḥ ।।34।।
pūjayecchrīvāsudevaṃ kṣamāpayetpunaḥ punaḥ ।
naivedyaṃ bhojayetpāne salilaṃ miṣṭamarpayet ।।35।।
tāmbūlaṃ karpūragandhailātvaṅlavaṃgayuk dadet। ।
paryaṃkaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ darpaṇaṃ vyajanaṃ tathā ।।36।।
cāmaraṃ puṣpagucchāṃśca bhaktitaḥ prasamarpayet ।
nīrājayennavavāraṃ tato natvā ca keśavam ।।37।।
svavyāvahārikaṃ kuryād vrate vighnaṃ yathā na vai ।
madhyāhne haraye dadyān miṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ subhojanam ।।38।।
jalaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ dadyānmukhaśuddhikalīṭikām ।
sugandhasāraṃ gandhāḍhyasthalapadmārkavāri ca ।।39।।
sāyaṃ cāpi hareḥ samyak pūjanaṃ tvācared vratī ।
ārārtrikādikaṃ sarve bhojanaṃ cāpi kārayet। ।।1.242.40 ।।
pūrvaṃ daśadinebhyaśca vratī snāto janaḥ svayam ।
bhūmyapatitaṃ saṃgṛhya gomayaṃ tatra sa vratī ।।41।।
tilānprakṣipya kārpāsaṃ piṇḍikāścaiva kārayet ।
aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyāḥ yataḥ śuṣkā bhavanti te ।।42।।
atha māghe kṛṣṇapakṣasyaikādaśyāṃ ca mūlabhe ।
ārdrāyāṃ vā niśi homaṃ harernāmatrirācaret ।।43।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād viṣṇupadyāni gāpayet ।
dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvā pūjanamācaret ।।44।।
vastubhiḥ ṣoḍaśavidhairdānaṃ śrīgurave'rpayet ।
kuṃbhaṃ svarṇamayīṃ mūrtiṃ mudrāḥ svarṇāśca rājatīḥ ।।।45।।।
tilapātraṃ ca śayyāṃ ca vastrāṇi dhānyasadrasān ।
chatropānahapātrāṇi dadyānme prīyatāṃ hariḥ ।।46।।
kṛṣṇā dhenuḥ pradātavyā tilapātraṃ prapūritam ।
gurave'rpaṇamatroktaṃ viprāya vā kuṭumbine ।।47।।
svargādau tvannapānādi labhyate tiladānataḥ ।
mokṣe'pi śāśvatī tṛptirjāyate muktibhāginaḥ ।।48।।
kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ na kṛtaṃ cedannadānaṃ tilārpaṇam ।
tadā'mutra milet sarvamannaṃ naiva milettataḥ ।।49।।
tilānnādi pradātavyaṃ sarvaṃ dātavyameva ca ।
yadyat tvapekṣyate cātra strīputragṛhavāṭikāḥ ।।1.242.50 ।।
udyānāni gomahiṣyo gajā'śvājādayastathā ।
vāhanāni vimānāni gṛhopakaraṇāni ca ।।51 ।।
daihāni sādhanānyatra dharmārthakāmanādayaḥ ।
svarṇabhūṣāśca bhojyāni peyāni vividhāni ca ।।52।।
dṛśyānyathāpi bhogyāni śravyāṇi raṃjanāni ca ।
deyānyekādaśīlābhe dānāni vividhāni ca ।।53।।
tāni lakṣaguṇānyeva prāpsyante'mutra puṇyataḥ ।
tasmādekādaśīkarttā dātavyāni viśeṣataḥ ।।54।।
śṛṇvatrārthe kathāṃ prācyāṃ brāhmaṇyā romaharṣaṇām ।
purā kṛtayuge nāmnā kapilā brāhmaṇī satī ।।55।।
vidyāvatī kumārī sā brahmacaryaparāyaṇā ।
ātmajñānavatī devapūjāprītimatī sadā ।।56।।
svargādiphalavāñcchāḍhyā vartate smā'parigrahā ।
śarīraṃ kleśitaṃ caiva tayopoṣaṇasadvrataiḥ ।।57।।
yadyadupārjyate vidyājñānādyaiśca gṛhādikam ।
tattatsamarpyate dāne satpātre samaye śubhe ।।58।
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kumārīṇāṃ satāṃ tathā ।
sādhvīnāṃ brahmaniṣṭhānāṃ pradadānā gṛhāṇi sā ।।59।
anyānyupakaraṇāni pradadānā mahāsatī ।
vartate sarvadā devapūjau sukhakāmyayā ।।1.242.60 ।
atitṛṣṇāmahāmohavyāptā nārīsvabhāvataḥ ।
ātmajñānaṃ ca kurute sukhecchāṃ na jahāti sā ।।61।
annaṃ tu sulabhaṃ jñātvā dadātyannaṃ na bhikṣuke ।
sādhavastarpitā naiva bālakā na ca bhojitāḥ ।।62।
anyatsarvaṃ pradattaṃ vai na dattaṃ tvannamaṇvapi ।
na dattā bhikṣuke bhikṣā kevalā'jñānaleśataḥ ।।63 ।
ekadā mama bhaktāyāstasyā me'bhūt sucintanam ।
śuddhamatyāḥ śarīraṃ hi vrataiḥ kṛcchrairna saṃśayaḥ ।।64।
pūjitaśca harirdevo bahubhirvastubhirmuhuḥ ।
arcito vaiṣṇavo lokaḥ kāyakleśena tattvataḥ ।।65।
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ sakāmaṃ sakāmanayā'nayā śubham ।
svargaṃ tasyāḥ kṛte tvasti parantvatrā'nayā kvacit ।।66।।
na kṛtaṃ tvannadānaṃ hi nirmūlyaṃ vigaṇayya ca ।
tato'syāḥ svargalokeṣu bhavennānnamupasthitam ।।67।।
annadānena bhojyaṃ cāmṛtaṃ svarge hyavāpyate ।
dattaṃ vai prāpyate tatra yena tṛptiḥ parā bhavet ।।68।।
tasmānmayā svabhaktāyāḥ saukhyārthaṃ tatra sarvathā ।
bhikṣukasya svarūpeṇa yācanīyaṃ hi bhojanam ।।69।।
annaṃ dāsyati mahyaṃ sā svarge tatphalamāpsyate ।
evaṃ lakṣmi! vicintyā'haṃ martyalokamupāgataḥ ।।1.242.70।।
kapilasvāmirūpeṇa bhikṣārthaṃ tadgṛhaṃ gataḥ ।
bhavatī bhikṣāṃ dehīti bhikṣāṃ yācitavānaham ।।71 ।।
sā manmūrteśca madhyāhne pūjāyāṃ vyāpṛtā'bhavat ।
vighnaṃ jñātvā'tha pūjāyāṃ bhikṣāphalaśatojjhitā ।।72।।
roṣavegācca tatkāle nāvocat kiṃcideva hi ।
punareva mayā proktā dehi bhikṣāṃ tu sundari! ।।73।।
pūjāprasattayā tatra tulasīmṛttikā tathā ।
gṛhītā jalasiktā ca piṇḍarūpā svabhāvataḥ ।।74।।
tataḥ kopena mahatā mṛtpiṇḍastāmrabhājane ।
mama pātre tayā kṣipto na dattaṃ tvannamaṇvapi ।।75।।
mayā'nnaṃ bhikṣitaṃ nāmnā nārpitaṃ tu tathāpi me ।
gālīdānādinā cāhaṃ tayā niṣkāsito bahiḥ ।।76।।
gato'haṃ svasya vaikuṇṭhaṃ mṛtā kālena tāpasī ।
brahmacaryaprabhāveṇa gṛhadānādinā tu sā ।।77।।
devī bhūtvā gatā svargaṃ devībhiḥ satkṛtā divi ।
mṛtpiṇḍikāpradānasya phalaṃ prāptaṃ gṛhaṃ śubham ।।78।।
sarvasmṛddhibharaṃ kintu dhānyarāśivivarjitam ।
gṛhaṃ divyaṃ paśyati sma bhojyaṃ kiñcinna dṛśyate ।।79। ।
gṛhāttasmādviniṣkrāntā cāgatā mama mandiram ।
jalopari dvitīyaṃ yadvaikuṇṭhaṃ me'sti tatra vai । ।1.242.80 ।।
brahmacaryaprabhāvā sā kapilā sūryasadṛśī ।
krodhāviṣṭā hyavocanmāṃ bhojyaṃ kinna gṛhe mama ।।8 1।।
annahīno mahāsaudho labdho divyastriviṣṭape ।
yatra nāstyamṛtaṃ kiñcit khādyaṃ peyaṃ na vidyate । ।82।।
bhogasthale mahāsvarge jīvitavyaṃ mayā katham ।
tasmād dehi mahāviṣṇo bhaktāyai bhojanaṃ prabho । ।83।।
anyathā na mayā stheyaṃ śmaśānasadṛśe gṛhe ।
mayoktaṃ ca tadā tasyai nā'nnaṃ dattaṃ tvayā kvacit । ।84।।
brāhmaṇebhyo'thavā sadbhyaḥ sādhvībhyo vā na cārpitam ।
mayā bhikṣā'rthitā tvatto mṛtpiṇḍastvarpitastvayā । ।85।।
smaryate vā navā sādhvi! tatphalaṃ nā'nnamāpyate ।
karmabhūmau kṛtaṃ dattaṃ phalaṃ svarge tvavāpyate ।।86।।
tvayā'nnaṃ na pradattaṃ vai prapadyeta kuto divi ।
tathāpi bhaktā tvaṃ hyanugrāhyā sadā mayā ।।87।।
mṛttikādānato bhikṣā phalaṃ te mṛttikā'pi vai ।
annarūpeṇa bhavatu sadā bhuṃkṣyāmṛta phalam ।।88।।
tvayā vrataiśca kṛcchraiśca sūpavāsairanekaśaḥ ।
pūjābhirarcitaścāhaṃ tatphalaṃ te gṛhe'mṛtam ।।89।।
bhavatānmā gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ sadā me bhavatu priyā ।
gaccha svargaṃ nūtanāṃ tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ kautuhalānvitāḥ ।।1.242.90 ।।
āgamiṣyanti devyaśca ṣaṭtilāvratakārikāḥ ।
dvāraṃ nodghāṭanīyaṃ ca tvayā stheyamadarśane ।।9 1 ।।
yadi tāsāmāgrahaścet tava darśanakāraṇe ।
vācyaṃ tābhyastadā devyo yadi darśanamiṣyate ।।92।।
dadata ṣaṭtilāpuṇyaṃ bhavatībhistu prākkṛtam ।
udghāṭayāmi dvāraṃ ca māṃ paśyantu haripriyām ।।93।।
tābhirdattaṃ tadā puṇyaṃ ṣaṭtilaikādaśībhavam ।
udghāṭitaṃ tato dvāraṃ dṛṣṭā tābhirharipriyā ।।94।।
na devī na ca gāndharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī ।
nānyāpi tādṛśī divyā svarge'bhūt kapilā yathā ।।95।।
hareryogānmahālakṣmi! tvatsamā sā'bhavad divi ।
rūpakāntisamāyuktā vaiṣṇavī mama vallabhā ।।96 ।।
ṣaṭtilāphalalābhena saudho'nnāmṛtasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
samabhavattadā drākca nānyatrā'to'dhikaṃ hyabhūt ।।97।।
bhavanaṃ bahusampannaṃ ṣaṭtilāpuṇyalābhataḥ ।
dhanadhānyasuvastrādisvarṇarūpyādisaṃbhṛtam ।।98।।
bhuktaṃ ca kalpaparyantaṃ tataḥ kapilayā tayā ।
nitye laye samāyātā kapilā mama mandiram ।।99।।
caturbhujābhavattatra ramārūpā mama priyā ।
bhajate māṃ sakhī te sā sevanānme'tibhāvataḥ ।। 1.242.10 0।।
tato yaistu kṛtaṃ sākṣāt ṣaṭtilāvratamuttamam ।
kiṃ kiṃ tena na cāpyeta sarvaṃ prāpyeta sarvathā ।। 101 ।।
labhed bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca madyogāttiladāvratī ।
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ lobhaḥ kāryo na tu kvacit ।। 1 02।।।
dānaṃ sarvavidhaṃ deyaṃ dattaṃ prāpyeta bhāvini ।
ātmavittānusāreṇa tilān dhānyāni dāpayet ।। 1 03।।
vastrānnavāhanayānagṛhavāryupasādhanam ।
nairogyaṃ labhate'mutra dadate yo'tra janmani ।। 1 04।।
na dāridryaṃ na ca kaṣṭaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ na śūnyatām ।
na bhinnatvaṃ vrajed bhaktaḥ ṣaṭtilāyā upoṣaṇāt ।। 1 05।।
tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ tiladānaṃ vidhānataḥ ।
pātakairmucyate bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca labhate'tigām ।। 1 06।।
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād yadvā śrāvayecca paṭhecca vā ।
tasya puṇyaṃ ṣaṭtilāyā vratajaṃ bhavati priye ।। 1 07।।
nāśubhaṃ śiṣyate kiṃcitparatrā'tra virodhakṛt ।
ātmapuṇyaṃ vrajedvipro vijayaṃ kṣatriyo vrajet ।। 108।।
dhanasmṛddhiṃ vrajed vaiśyaḥ sukhaṃ cānyo lasetparam ।
dharmaṃ prāpnoti dharmārthī kāmārthī pramadāṃ labhet ।। 1 09।।
dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti putrārthī satsutaṃ laset ।
yaśovipulamāpnoti jñātimūrdhanyamityapi ।। 1.242.11 0।।
acaṃcalā śriyaṃ labdhvā śreyaḥ paramavāpnuyāt ।
bhayanāśo bhavatyasya tejovīryaṃ ca vindati ।। 11 1।।
ṣaṭtilāvratasampannā nārī priyapatiṃ laset ।
putrapautradhanadhānyā'khaṇḍasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।। 1 12।।
labdhvā kāmasukhaṃ cātra divi devī pramodate ।
vaiṣṇavī ca ramā bhūtvā hareḥ śayyāsu modate ।। 1 13।।
vaikuṇṭhe cātha goloke yauvanārthasukhāni 3 ।
aśnute svapatikṛṣṇahariṇā saha sarvadā ।। 1 14।।
ṣaṭtilāyāḥ samaṃ cānyad vrataṃ nāsti sukhapradam ।
padmayā ca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sā tvaṃ lakṣmīrmamā'si vai ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māghakṛṣṇaṣaṭtilaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vratapuṇyāt kapilānāryā devītvaṃ ramātvaṃ cetyādinirū-
paṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 242 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 242 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 243
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 244 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
hare kṛṣṇa kṛpāsindho jagaduddhārakāraka ।
māghaśuklaikādaśīṃ me kathayasva prasādataḥ ।। 1 ।।
ko vidhiḥ ko'dhidevo'tra vratasya phalamityapi ।
kathayasvodyāpanaṃ ca vratino bhuktimuktidam ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi māghaśukle jayānāmetipuṇyadā ।
pāpahantrī mokṣakartrī kāmadātrī sukhapradā ।। 3 ।।
ekādaśī samākhyātā kartavyā vratinā śubhā ।
brahmahatyādihantrī ca piśācatvādināśinī ।। 4 ।।
sarvasampatkarī rājñāṃ saṃgrāme jayadāyinī ।
svarge jayapradā loke vyavahāre jayapradā ।। 5 ।।
yatra kutrāpi kārye sā kṛtā jayaphalā matā ।
tatphalaṃ jayadaṃ proktaṃ triṣu lokeṣu yāyinām । । 6 ।।
etasmātkāraṇāllakṣmi kartavyā sā prayatnataḥ ।
