śṛṇu me vacanaṃ bhadre śāpānugrahakārakam ।। 121 ।।
kiṃ karomi tvayā sākaṃ kṣayaṃ nītaṃ mahātapaḥ ।
gataṃ tattu gataṃ tveva naṣṭaṃ nāyāti vai punaḥ ।। 122 ।।
punaḥ saṃpādayiṣyāmi tavāpi śubhamastu vai ।
caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu bhavatyekādaśī śubhā ।। 1 2 3 ।।
pāpamocanikā nāma sarvaśāpakṣayaṃkarī ।
tasyā vrate kṛte subhru piśācītvaṃ viyāsyati ।। 1 24।।
śrutvaitanmañjughoṣā sā yayau vanāntaraṃ tadā ।
piśācī tu babhūveyaṃ yāvaccaitro na saṃgataḥ ।। 125 ।।
prāpte caitre mañjrughoṣā vrataṃ jātismarā tadā ।
cakāra vidhinā caitrakṛṣṇaikādaśikādine ।। 126 ।।
pupūja parayā bhaktyā śrīhariṃ mānase hi sā ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 127 ।।
piśācītvādvinirmuktā pāpamocanikābalāt ।
divyarūpadharā sā vai gatā svarge svake gṛhe । । 128 ।।
medhāvyapi tayā tyakto jagāma piturāśramam ।
cyavanasya ṛṣerdivyaṃ tapastejo'tiśobhitam ।। 129 ।।
nistejaskaṃ ciraṃ yāntaṃ vilokya cyavanaḥ pitā ।
prāhaitat kiṃ kṛtaṃ putra tvayā puṇyakṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 1.246.130 ।।
kathaṃ na dṛśyate tejastapobāhulyasaṃbhavam ।
medhāvī prāha tātā'sminvane tu tapasā mayā ।। 131 ।।
prāptā'psarā tayā sārdhaṃ pātakaṃ vai kṛtaṃ bahu ।
ramitā bahukālaṃ sā tapo naṣṭaṃ mamā'dbhutam ।। 132 ।।
prāyaścittaṃ brūhi tāta yena pāpakṣayo bhavet ।
pitā prāha tadā putraṃ vrataṃ vacmi nibodha me ।। 133।।
caitrasya tvasite pakṣe nāmnā tu pāpamocanī ।
ekādaśī matā hyasyā vrate tu vidhitaḥ kṛte ।। 134।।
pāparāśiḥ kṣayaṃ yāyānmuktiṃ cānte vrajed vratī ।
iti śrutvā piturvākyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vratottamam ।। 135।।
gataṃ pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ tasya tapovṛddhirbabhūva ca ।
tejo vyāpto'bhavacchīghraṃ pāpamocanikāvratāt ।। 1 36।।
yathāpūrvaṃ tapoyukto hyabhūd×Vr̤M× babhūva vai tathā ।
pāpamocanikāṃ lakṣmi! ye kurvanti janā bhuvi ।। 137।।
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ tu yatkiṃcit sarvaṃ vilayatāṃ vrajet ।
vājapeyasahasrasya phalaṃ tasyāpi jāyate ।। 1 38।।
bhuktirmuktirmahāmuktiḥ sarvaṃ caikavratena hi ।
prāpyetaitādṛśī śaktā phaladāne tviyaṃ tithiḥ ।। 1 39।।
brahmahā hemahārī ca surāpo gurutalpagaḥ ।
vratasya cāsya karaṇānmukto bhavati tadvratī ।। 1.246.140 ।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇātkīrtanādapi ।
bahupuṇyapradaṃ caitad gosahasraphalapradam ।। 141 ।।
kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi śāpapāpanivṛttaye ।
nātaḥ parataraṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ sacarācare ।। 142।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caitrakṛṣṇapāpamocanyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ medhāvinā tapasvinā sahasravatsaraṃ bhuktāyā majjughoṣākhyā'psarāyāḥ ṛṣiśāpātpiśācītvamanugrahād vratakaraṇān muktiśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 246।।


← adhyāyaḥ 246 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 247
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 248 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavantaṃ vinā nātra loke tūddhārakaḥ paraḥ ।
vinā ca sātvatān loke na paraḥ pāvano'paraḥ ।। 1 ।।
sādhūn vinā ca jīvānāṃ nā'paraḥ pāpanāśakaḥ ।
vrataṃ vinā tathā loke nānyadbhuktipramuktidam ।। 2 ।।
ekādaśīṃ vinā nānyacchāpapāpapraṇāśakam ।
svargadaṃ siddhidaṃ dravyaputradaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ।। 3 ।।
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamāgrataḥ ।
caitrasya śuklapakṣīyā kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā ।। 4 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
caitrasya śuklapakṣe tu kāmadā nāma nāmataḥ ।
ekādaśī puṇyatamā pāpendhanadavānalā ।। 5 ।।
vimalākhyā'pi saivoktā sarvavāñchitadāyinī ।
ramayā sahito viṣṇurasyāḥ patirhi pūjyate ।। 6 ।।
ṣoḍaśopacārakaistu yathāvittaṃ yathāvidhi ।
phalaṃ cārghye cirbhaṭādi cūtapuṣpāṇi pūjane ।। 7 ।।
naivedye saktavo laḍḍukāśca pakvānnamityapi ।
arpaṇīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa vratinā phalasiddhaye ।। 8 ।।
daśamyāmekabhaktaṃ vā vratī naktaṃ vrataṃ caret ।
rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryād rakṣayed brahmacāritām ।। 9 ।।
prātastvekādaśīkāle samutthāya hariṃ smaret ।
dhyāyecca śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ snātvā devaṃ prapūjayet ।। 1.247.10 ।।
snāpayedamṛtaiḥ pañcabhirjalaistīrthasaṃbhavaiḥ ।
arpayedatimūlyāni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca ।। 11 । ।
śṛṃgārayed vastubhiḥ śrāṃgārikaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ।
puṣpairhāraistathā dhūpadīpanaivedyasatphalaiḥ ।। 12।।
jalapānamukhavāsatāmbūlailālavaṃgakaiḥ ।
ārārtrikaiḥ stutipradakṣiṇādyaiśca prasādayet ।। 13।।
kṣamāpayet tvavarān vai tataśca stavanaṃ caret ।
ekādaśyā vrataṃ kṛṣṇa karomi phalasiddhaye ।। 14।।
kṛpayā tava tatpūrṇaṃ bhavatvavighnakaṃ mama ।
ityabhyarthya tato dhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।। 15।।
kṛtvā svarṇaghaṭaṃ tatra yadvā tāmraghaṭaṃ śubham ।
pañcaratnairnavapatrairjalairvastreṇa candanaiḥ ।। 16।।
akṣataiśca phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjanārthaṃ nyadhāpayet ।
tilapātraṃ ghaṭe tatra tatra mūrtiṃ harestathā ।। 17।।
ramāyāḥ kāmadāyāśca sthāpayed vidhinā vratī ।
āvāhanādimantraiḥ saṃpūjayetsnāpayejjalaiḥ ।। 18।।
pūjādravyaiḥ pūjayecca vastrābhūṣaṇahetibhiḥ ।
śṛṃgārayeddhariṃ viṣṇuṃ ramāṃ śāṭyādibhistathā ।। 19।।
bhūṣāśṛṃgārakairdravyairvividhairabhibhūṣayet ।
yathā viṣṇuṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ bhūṣayed bahubhūṣaṇaiḥ ।।1.247.20।।
keśānprasādhayettailasugandhidravavastubhiḥ ।
dhammilaṃ racayettatra bhūṣaṇaṃ stabakaṃ tathā ।।21।।
catuḥsaraṃ vā dvisaraṃ keśagranthanamācaret ।
sūtraṃ puṣpāṇi .cipiṭaṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalikāṃ tathā ।।22।।
trisaraṃ granthanaṃ sarvaṃ kārayettu caturvidham ।
agre kuryāttu kabarīṃ sindūraṃ dāpayecchubham ।। 23 ।।
lalāṭe kesaricandanadravaistilakaṃ tathā ।
madhye kuṃkumabindvīṃ ca bhāle kuryāt suśobhitām ।। 24 ।।
yadvā madhye tilabindvīḥ pañca sūkṣmāḥ samācaret ।
gaṇḍayoḥ puṇḍrapārśve ca patrikāviralāṃkanāḥ ।। 25। ।
madhye sūkṣmātisūkṣmābhirbindvikābhiḥ prapūritāḥ ।
racayedraṃjayedbhālaṃ lakṣmīvāsamivā'param । । 26।।
netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadyāt suvarṇasya śalākayā ।
pāṇḍurāraktagandhāḍhyacūrṇaṃ dadyānmukhopari । । 27।।
rūpalāvaṇyasamabhivyañjanārthaṃ samastaram ।
kapole ṭibakī kuryāt raktavarṇaṃ suśobhitām । । 28 । ।
cibuke'pi tathā kuryād bindvīṃ svalpāṃ suraktakām ।
oṣṭhayoḥ sthalapadmasya rūpaprākaṭyahetave । । 29 । ।
raṃgaṃ dadyāttathārūpaṃ nāsikāyāṃ tu natthikām ।
karṇayoḥ karṇapūrādīn kuṇḍale śṛṃkhale'rpayet ।। 1.247.30 ।।
suvarṇaje tvairane'pi sadratnāḍhye samarpayet ।
kaṇṭhe hārānsvarṇapauṣpān kaustubhādisuhīrakān ।। 31 ।।
bhujayoḥ kaṭake ratnajaḍite samadhārayet ।
prakoṣṭhayoḥ śṛṃkhale ca baṃginīśca suvarṇajāḥ ।। 32 । ।
dadyāccāṃguliṣu svarṇormikā ratnādiyojitāḥ ।
hastatale raṃjanārhadravyeṇa raṃjayennakhān ।। 33 ।।
vakṣasi tvarpayeddivyaṃ candanaṃ stanayorapi ।
svarṇahārānpuṣpahārān kaṃcukīṃ stanabandhanīm ।। 34।।
kaṭyā samarpayet ramyāṃ raśanāṃ svarṇanirmitām ।
śāṭikāṃ bahumūlyāṃ ca prāntasvarṇasutārakām ।। 35।।
triraṃgīṃ netrasukhadāṃ susparśāṃ dhārayettathā ।
ghargharīṃ sūkṣmavastrīyāṃ raṃgarañjitacitritām ।। 36 । ।
prāntaraṃgāntaravyāptasubhaṃgībhiḥ sudarśanām ।
dadyāttu dhāraṇārthaṃ vai naktakaṃ peśalaṃ kare । । 37 ।।
kamalākṛti sauvarṇaṃ pātraṃ sadvyajanaṃ tathā ।
cāmare cāpi subhage chatraṃ copānahau tathā ।। 38 ।।
pādaprakoṣṭhabhūṣāśca śṛṃkhalāḥ kiṃkiṇīyutāḥ ।
kaḍḍalikāḥ kāmbikāścāṃgulyarthaṃ karaṭāँstathā ।।39 । ।
datvā sapūjayellakṣmīṃ hariṃ tvekādaśīṃ ramām ।
ekādaśyai tathā dadyād ramāvaccopabhūṣaṇam ।।1.247.40 ।।
yathā ramā tathā tvekādaśī patnī hareḥ priyā ।
sarvopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ suvastukam ।। 41 ।।
sarvālaṃkaraṇaṃ cāpi dadyāttasyai phalāptaye ।
evaṃ tu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā candanādi sugandhakam ।।।42।।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlapānakam
dadyād devāya devyai ca carennīrājanaṃ tataḥ ।।43।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣamāyāñcāṃ stutiṃ namaskriyāṃ tataḥ ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ tato dadyādevaṃ prātarvidhiṃ vratī ।।44।।
sarvatobhadramadhyasthaharimūrtau vidhāya ca ।
tato gacched gṛhaṃ naijaṃ bhajanārthaṃ japaṃ caret ।।45।।
madhyāhnepi tathā pūjāṃ kṛtvā naivedyamarpayet ।
jalaṃ tāmbūlamanyacca sarvaṃ dadyāttu pūrvavat ।।46।।
sāyaṃ cāpi tathā pūjāṃ kuryādārārtrikādikam ।
sarvaṃ sotsavamagryaṃ ca vrataṃ kuryāt supuṇyadam ।।47।।
rātrau tu maṇḍapaṃ kuryāt kadalīstambhaśobhitam ।
pallavaistoraṇaṃ kuryād dolāṃ vai bandhayet drume ।। 48।।
āndolayeddhariṃ viṣṇuṃ vimalākāmadāyutam ।
naivedyaṃ jalapānādi dadyād devāya sa vratī ।।49।।
rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryād nṛtyagītamahotsavaiḥ ।
hariṃ prasādayet sarvārpaṇena vidhinā vratī ।।1.247.50।।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā janārdanam ।
dānaṃ ca vividhaṃ datvā nīrājayitvā mādhavam ।। 51।।
ārdravastraṃ bhrāmayitvā śaṃkhenottārya vai jalam ।
tulasīdalasaṃyuktaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ vyaṃjanādikam ।।52।।
bhojayitvā hariṃ viprān sādhūn sādhvīśca bālakān ।
visarjayitvā kuryācca vratī vai pāraṇāṃ tataḥ ।।53।।
evaṃ kṛtena vidhinā puṇyaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ।
aihikaṃ paralokotthaṃ yadicchet tadbhaved dhruvam । ।54।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ ramyāṃ gandharvadvayamuktidām ।
purā nāgapure ramye hemaharmyānvite śubhe ।।55।।
gandharvāḥ puṇḍarīkākhyajñātayaḥ sma vasanti hi ।
madoddhatā mahākrūrā mahāmadabalānvitāḥ ।।56।।
gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā vidyādhrāḥ kiṃjanāstathā ।
satparyo'psaraso devyaḥ kumāryaḥ sma vasanti ca ।।57।।
tasminpure nṛpaḥ puṇḍarīko rājyaṃ cakāra ha ।
nāmnā pauṃḍra iti khyātastenotsave suyojite ।।58।।
gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtā māgadhā bandinastathā ।
kiṃpuruṣā gāyakāśca vyākhyātāro'pi cāraṇāḥ ।।59।।
śrotrīyavargā viprāśca rājasā daivayonayaḥ ।
tatrotsave samāyatā gāndharvavedapaṇḍitāḥ ।।1.247.60।।
nṛtyaṃ pravartate tatra samāje raṃgamaṇḍape ।
gāyanti sma svaradhanā vādayanti ca vādakāḥ ।।6 1।।
nṛtyanti nartakījanāḥ paśyanti cetare janāḥ ।
pātālānnāgalokācca kāmarūpā bhujaṃgamāḥ ।।62।।
daiteyā dānavāścāpi samājagmustadutsave ।
te'pi devasamā rūpe bhūtvotsave vyavasthitāḥ ।।6 3 ।।
anyeṣāṃ gāyakānāṃ ca nṛtye gīte vyavasthite ।
nartakīnāṃ tathā nṛtye gīte nirvartite tataḥ ।।64।।
pauṃḍrasya rājño gandharveśvaro'tikuśalāgraṇīḥ ।
lalito nāma gandharvo raṃge hyavātatāra ha ।।65।।
lalitā nāma gandharvapatnī tu gṛhakāryataḥ ।
nāyātā tatra raṅge vai lalitastvekalastadā ।।66।।
gītaṃ gānaṃ prakurute lalito dayitā vinā ।
dayitāyāstadā'nupasthityā tu lalitaḥ khalu ।।67।।
pārśvahīnaśca sāhāyyarahito manasā tu tām ।
smaran gāyati nṛtyaँśca vādayati yathākalam ।।68।।
hṛdye tasya lalitā nityaṃ vasati bhāminī ।
prasaṃge tu viśeṣeṇa susmṛtā sā bhavatyapi ।।69।।
lalitāyāstu hṛdye patirvasati nityadā ।
ubhau rāgeṇa saṃraktau dampatī premabandhanau ।।1.247.70 ।।
remāte sma gṛhe yadvat tat lalitena saṃsmṛtam ।
raṅge patnyāḥ smaraṇena vyagramānasanartakaḥ ।।7 1।।
pādabandhaḥ skhalajjihvo babhūva lalitāṃ smaran ।
pādabandhacyutirjātā jātaṃ svarā'varohaṇam ।।72।।
gandharvāṇāṃ sabhāmadhye hāsyapātraṃ tu so'bhavat ।
pauṃḍrasyāpi yaśohānistadā jātā hi tatkṣateḥ ।।73।।
tadā pauṃḍraḥ puṇḍarīko babhūva krodhapīḍitaḥ ।
śaśāpa lalitaṃ raṅge gāyanta ca smarāturam ।।74।।
rākṣaso bhava durbuddhe kravyādaḥ puruṣādanaḥ ।
yataḥ patnīṃ smaraँścātra gāyamāno mahotsave ।।75।।
samāje'navadhānāt tvaṃ kalāyāṃ kṣatimāptavān ।
hāsyapātraṃ tvaṃ tathā'haṃ samājena kṛtāvubhau ।।76।।
tasmāttvaṃ rākṣaso bhūtvā duḥkhaṃ paśya ciraṃ samāḥ ।
iti pauṃḍrasya vacanād rakṣārūpo babhūva saḥ ।।77।।
raudrānano virūpākṣo dṛṣṭamātro bhayaṃkaraḥ ।
bahuyojanavistīrṇo mukhe kandarasannibhaḥ ।।78।।
sūryadvayanibho netre grīvāyāṃ parvatopamaḥ ।
nāsāyāṃ parvatamālānibho randhre guhāsamaḥ ।।79।।
oṣṭhayorgavyūtikalpa ucchrāye yojanadvayam ।
īdṛśo rākṣaso bhūtvā bhuṃjānaḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ।।1.247.80 ।।
yayau gṛhaṃ ca lalitā svakāntaṃ vikṛtākṛtim ।
ālokya cintayāmāsa patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ।।8 1 ।।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi patiḥ pāpena pīḍitaḥ ।
jñātvā sarvaṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ patisevāparāyaṇā ।।82।।
cacāra patinā sārdhaṃ lalitā gahane vane ।
pūrvaṃ saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya manasā śarma nā'labhat ।।83।।
babhrāma vipine durge kāmarūpadharāpi sā ।
kāmarūpadhareṇāpi patinā saha sarvadā ।।84।।
lalito vipine durge kāmarūpī bhavannapi ।
nirghṛṇaḥ pāpanirato virūpaḥ puruṣādakaḥ ।।85।।
na sukhaṃ labhate rātrau na divā pāpapīḍitaḥ ।
lalitā duḥkhitā'tīva patiṃ dṛṣṭvātiduḥkhinam ।।86।।
babhrāma tena sārdhaṃ sā kṣuttṛṣādyatimarditāḥ ।
patirvai rākṣasarūpaḥ patnī gandharvarūpiṇī ।।87।।
vicitraṃ tu tayoryogaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai vanavāsinaḥ ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurbhītāśca dudruvuḥ sthalāt। ।।88।।
atha śātātapamunerāśramaṃ tāvavāpatuḥ ।
śīghraṃ jagāma lalitā namaskṛtyā'grataḥ sthitā ।।89।।
dayāluḥ sa muniḥ prāha kā tvaṃ kasmādupasthitā ।
lalitovāca gāndharvī vīradhanvasutā'smyaham ।।1.247.90।।
lalitānāma me tvasti patyarthamiha cāgatā ।
bhartā me lalitaprakhyaḥ pauṃḍraśāpena rākṣasaḥ ।।9 1।।
bhūtvā bhramatyaraṇye'smin dṛṣṭvā taṃ nāsti me sukham ।
yena puṇyena me svāmī rākṣasatvādvimucyate ।।92।।
tādṛśaṃ puṇyakṛtyaṃ me śādhi śātātapa prabho ।
śrutvā śātātapaḥ prāha śāpapāpaharā śubhā ।।93।।
kāmadaikādaśī caitraśuklasya puṇyasaukhyadā ।
vrataṃ tasyā vidhānena kuru tvaṃ bhāmini dhruvam ।।94।।
bhaviṣyati phalaṃ puṇyaṃ tat svabhartre pradīyatām ।
datte puṇye kṣaṇāttasya śāpadoṣaḥ prayāsyati ।।95।।
śātātapamunervākyaṃ śrutvā sā harṣitā'bhavat ।
tatrāśrame'vasaccaikādaśīpratīkṣaṇāya sā ।।96।।
patistasyā vane tatrā'bhito vasati nityadā ।
kāmadaikādaśī prāptā nirjalā samupoṣitā ।।97।।
jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ rātrau dvādaśyāṃ prātareva ca ।
śātātapasya nikaṭe harermūrteśca sannidhau ।।98।।
vākyamuvāca lalitā svapatyustāraṇāya vai ।
mayā tvetadvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ kāmadāyā upoṣaṇam ।।99।।
tasya puṇyaprabhāveṇa naśyatvasya piśācatā ।
lalitāvacanāttasmin kṣaṇe eva piśācatā ।। 1.247.10 0।।
gatā rākṣasatā tasya jātā gandharvatā punaḥ ।
gatapāpaḥ sa lalito divyadeho babhūva ha ।। 101 ।।
svarṇaratnasamākīrṇo reme lalitayā saha ।
tau vimānasamārūḍhau pūrvarūpādhikau śubhau ।। 102।।
dampatī cānyaśobhetāṃ gatau nāgapuraṃ hyubhau ।
kāmadāyā vratajanyapuṇyenaivaṃ piśācatā ।। 1 03।।
vinaṣṭā śāpanāśaśca svasvarūpasamāgamaḥ ।
iti jñātvā mahālakṣmi! kartavyaiṣā'tibhāvataḥ ।। 104।।
vrahmahatyādipāpaghnī piśācatvavināśinī ।
paṭhanāchravaṇāccāpi vājapeyaphalapradā ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caitraśuklakāmadaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ lalitalalitāgandharvayoḥ pauṃḍrasya śāpena jātasya piśācatvasya vratena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।247।।


← adhyāyaḥ 247 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 248
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 249 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
mokṣadātarhare kṛṣṇa janoddhārakara prabho ।
pāpināṃ śāpināṃ cāpi śāpināṃ pāpanāśaka ।। 1 ।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ tvayā pradarśitaṃ vratam ।
śrutvā śrutvā praharṣāmi śravaṇe jāyate ruciḥ ।। 2 ।।
vada nātha kṛpāsindho vaiśākhakṛṣṇapakṣake ।
kiṃnāmnyekādaśī tasyāḥ ko devaḥ ko vidhistathā ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
saubhāgyadāyinī putrapautrasampatpradāyinī ।
atra paratra sukhadā smṛddhidā pāpanāśinī ।। 4 ।।
vaiśākhakṛṣṇapakṣīyā nāmnā cāsti varūthanī ।
tasyā vratena vratinaḥ saukhyaṃ bhavati sarvathā ।। 5 ।।
pāpahāniśca bhavati saubhāgyaprāptirityapi ।
durbhagā'pi vratakartrī sarvasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।। 6 ।।
vratināṃ tvatra sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinī ।
sarvapāpaharā puṇyapradā janmaharā śubhā ।। 7 ।।
vāsanānāśinī nityānandamuktipradāyinī ।
śāśvatyāśca sthiterdātrī kartavyā vratinā hi sā ।। 8 ।।
māndhātṛdhundhumārādyā vratinaḥ svargatiṃ gatāḥ ।
nandayā sahitaḥ śaktyā tvatrārcyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
jātiphalādi pūjāyāṃ naivedye vaṭakāḥ śubhāḥ ।
campakādini puṣpāṇi kundasya kalikāstathā ।। 1.248.10।।
sthalapadmāni deyāni deyaṃ dānaṃ bhuvastathā ।
anyatsvaśaktyā kartavyaṃ vratinā pūrṇabhāvataḥ ।। 11 ।।
daśamyāmekabhaktaṃ vā naktaṃ bhuktvā'tha bhūśayaḥ ।
brahmacārī bhaveccaiva prātaḥ smareddhariṃ vrate ।। 12।।
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrāँśca caṇakān kodravāँstathā ।
śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune ।। 13 ।।
vaiṣṇavo vratakartā ca daśamyāṃ daśa varjayet ।
dyūtakrīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam ।। 14।।
parāpavādapaiśūnye steyaṃ hiṃsāṃ tathā ratim ।
krodhaṃ tvanṛtavākyāni hyekādaśyāṃ vivarjayet ।। 15।।
kāṃsyaṃ māsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ patitabhāṣaṇam ।
vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune ।। 16।।
tāmasānnaṃ masūrānnaṃ dvādaśyāṃ parivarjayet ।
ekādaśyāṃ vratī prātaḥ snātvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 17।।
pūjayennūtanadravyaiḥ ṣoḍaśottamavastubhiḥ ।
āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtavilepanam ।। 18।।
śuddhatīrthodakasnānaṃ vastrābhūṣaṇadhāraṇam ।
śrāṃgārikadravādeśca dānaṃ kajjalakāṃjanam ।। 1 9।।
kuṃkumādimāṃgalikabhūrṇatilakacandrakam ।
gucchaṃ pauṣpaṃ tathā hārān pauṣpāṃśca śekharādikān ।।1.248.20।।
arpayeddharaye tatra dhūpadīpādi kārayet ।
nīrājayitvā natvā ca pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca ।।2 1।।
stutvā kṣamāpayitvā vai puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet ।
evaṃ prātaḥ pūjayitvā mahāpūjanamācaret ।।22।।
kṛtvā dhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadrākhyaṃ vai maṇḍalaṃ śubham ।
kadalīmaṇḍape yadvā śubhe śrīkṛṣṇamandire ।।23।।
maṇḍale madhyadeśe ca pañcaratnasupallavam ।
jalacandanatandulapuṣpaphalasamanvitam ।।24।।
svarṇajaṃ tāmrajaṃ yadvā kalaśaṃ sthāpayennavam ।
tatra ghaṭe tilasthālīṃ sthāpayet pūritāṃ navām ।।25।।
puruṣottamamūrtiṃ ca nandayā sahitāṃ tathā ।
varūthinyā ca sahitāṃ sthāpayet tilamaṇḍale ।।26।।
pūjayedvidhinā tāṃ ca candanādibhirarcayet ।
āvāhanādi kuryācca pañcāmṛtābhiṣecanam ।। 27।।
tīrthajalaistathā snānārpaṇaṃ bhūṣāmbarārpaṇam ।
saśṛṅgārā'laṃkaraṇaṃ sugandhitailakārpaṇam ।। 28 ।।
candanādyarpaṇaṃ puṃḍrakajjalakuṃkumārpaṇam ।
puṣparatnādimālādyarpaṇaṃ naivedyakārpaṇam ।।29।।
jalatāmbūlamiṣṭāgryaphalādyarpaṇamityapi ।
nīrājanaṃ namaskārān pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣamārthanam ।। 1.248.30 ।।
prakuryācca vratasiddhyai prārthanāṃ vighnanāśinīm ।
dānaṃ śayyāgendukādivastūnāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ parām ।। 31 ।।
dadyāccaiva samāpyaiva bhaktikāryaṃ tataścaret ।
madhyāhnepi vidhinaivaṃ pūjayedbhojayeddharim ।। 3 2।।
hariṃ sāyaṃ pūjayitvā samārārtrikamācaret ।
bhojayejjalapānādi kārayejjāgaraṃ tathā ।।3 3 ।।
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ vādanaṃ ca kathāṃ kuryācca kīrtanam ।
prātarvicintya lakṣmīśaṃ pūjanaṃ ca tataścaret ।। 34।।
aśvadānaṃ gajadānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ tilārpaṇam ।
svarṇadānaṃ tvannadānaṃ kanyādānaṃ gavārpaṇam ।। 35।।
jñānadānaṃ tathā dadyād dānaṃ tvabhayasaṃjñakam ।
evaṃ varūthinīṃ kāryā vāñchitārthapradāyinīm । 3 6।।
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapastapati yo naraḥ ।
tattulyaṃ phalamāpnoti varūthinyā vratānnaraḥ ।। 37।।
sarvadānaphalaṃ vratyāpnoti kṛtvā varūthinīm ।
lakṣmi pūrve kṛtayuge kathā jātā'tipāvanī ।। 38।।
yāṃ śrutvā tu varūthinyā māhātmyaṃ jñāyate mahat ।
varūtho nāma vipraṣirbrahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ ।। 39 ।।
viṃśatinyūnavarṣīyo vedādyadhyayanavrataḥ ।
gurusevāparaḥ śuddho marīcerāśrame vasan ।।1.248.40 ।।
nirmāno nirahaṃkāraḥ svacchamānasadarpaṇaḥ ।
brahmadhyānarato nityaṃ gururbrahmetipūjakaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
gurorvākyaṃ vedavākyaṃ vedo gurumukhodgatam ।
gururviṣṇurgururbrahma gururvedo vidhirguruḥ ।।42।।
gururdharmo gururmuktirgururjñānaṃ gururmakhaḥ ।
gurureva parabrahma gurvājñā baidikī śrutiḥ ।।43 ।।
yena kena prakāreṇa toṣaṇīyo gururyataḥ ।
gurau tuṣṭe brahma tuṣṭaṃ nāsti kaścid guroḥ paraḥ ।।44।।
brahmatattvaṃ gurustvasti nāsti tattvaṃ guroḥ param ।
gurorājñā paro dharmo gurvājñā svargamatra hi ।।45 ।।
gurvājñā lokadharmaśca dharmaśca pāralaukikaḥ ।
nānyaḥ kaścitparo dharma iti matvā'tibhāvataḥ ।।46।।
gurubhakto'bhavacchreṣṭho guroḥ sevāṃ karoti ca ।
yathā yathā gururvadet tathā tathā karoti saḥ ।।47।।
gurukaiṃkaryavṛttyaiva vartate sukhapūrvakam ।
marīceḥ sevayā nityamānandena pariplutaḥ ।। 48।।
vartate brahmasaṃsthaḥ saḥ śarīrabhānavarjitaḥ ।
ātmārāmo'bhavat so'yaṃ gurorgehe vasan dvijaḥ ।। 49।।
guroḥ sevāṃ guroḥ patnyāḥ kalāyāḥ sevanaṃ tathā ।
karotyabhinnabhāvena gurureva tu sā tviti ।।1.248.5 0 ।।
kalā marīcapatnī tu marīcārdhāṃganā hi sā ।
gurutvaṃ ca dvayorasti kalāyāṃ ca marīcake ।।5 1 ।।
dampatyorgṛhasevā ca mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā ।
jalāharaṇaṃ pūjopakaraṇāharaṇaṃ tathā ।।52 ।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ bhojanottaraṃ pātramañjanam ।
śayyāvitānakaraṇaṃ śayyāsaṃharaṇaṃ tathā ।।53 ।।
vastraprakṣālanaṃ keśaprasādhanaṃ ca kajjalam ।
netrayoraṃjanaṃ hastatalā'laktakaraṃjanam ।। 54।।
tailena mardanaṃ dehe jalena snāpanaṃ tathā ।
vastreṇa mārjanaṃ cāpi sugandhārpaṇamityapi ।।55।।
vastrapuṣpavibhūṣādisaṃprasādhanamanvaham ।।
dampatyoḥ prakarotyeva saguṇabrahmabhāvataḥ ।।।56।।
dehaṃ na manute so'yaṃ tvātmānaṃ manute'tra hi ।
dehānyadātmano rūpaṃ nirvikāraṃ niraṃjanam ।।57।।
pāpapuṇyavihīnaṃ tadātmarūpaṃ nirāmayam ।
pāpena badhyate nātmā pāpena lipyate na ca ।।58 ।।
gurorbhaktiḥ paraṃ puṇyaṃ nānyatpuṇyamataḥ param ।
guruṃ vihāya nānyasya pūjanaṃ dhyānameva vā ।। 59।।
karoti sa kadācidvai tṛptiṃ matvā gurau sadā ।
mūrtiṃ na manute viṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ na karoti ca ।। 1.248.60 ।।
naivedyaṃ viṣṇave naivā'rpayatyeṣo jalaṃ na ca ।
na ṣoḍaśopacārādyairarcayatyacyutaṃ harim ।। 61 ।।
aprasādaṃ samaśnāti pibatyanarpitaṃ jalam ।
valkalaṃ kandapuṣpādi gṛhṇātyanarpitaṃ svayam ।।62 ।।
haryanarpitabhogena buddhiḥ kaluṣatāṃ gatā ।
rajobhāvena saṃvyāptā'bhavad bhogānugāminī ।।63 ।।
haryanarpitamannādi tvabhakṣyaṃ sarvamucyate ।
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇāccāsya jātā dehātmabhāvanā ।। 64।।
deharūpo'bhavaccāyaṃ hīndriyārāmasadṛśaḥ ।
indriyaṃ balavaccāsya jātaṃ dehātmavādinaḥ ।।65।।
nāstikyaṃ yauvanaṃ guroḥ patnyāḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
nityayogād gamayanti smarajvarātitāpanam ।।66।।
tathāpi saṃyamaṃ so'pi rakṣati mānasād balāt ।
evaṃ bahutithe kāle yāte saptarṣayaḥ khalu ।।67।।
śaṃkarasya vivāhārthaṃ dakṣaputryā samaṃ tadā ।
brahmaṇā saṃsmṛtāḥ satye loke te brahmaparṣati ।।68।।
yayustadā varūthaṃ tu marīciḥ prāha putraka ।
yathā madvacajaṃ samyak pālyate kriyate tathā ।।69।।
kalāyāśca vacaḥ pālyaṃ kartavyaṃ sā yathā vadet ।
madgṛhaṃ sarvathā rakṣyaṃ tvayā śiṣya yathā mayā ।।1.248.70।।
ājñāṃ datvā yayau brahmasabhāṃ prati marīcikaḥ ।
brahmaṇā preṣitā saptarṣayo dakṣagṛhaṃ prati ।।71 ।।
satyāstu śaṃbhunā yoge vākpradānavinirṇaye ।
yayuḥ sthitāḥ punaḥ satyaṃ cāyayuśca punaryayuḥ ।।72।।
evaṃ bahutithaḥ kālo vyatītastatra nirṇaye ।
kalā'pi cātituṣṭā'bhūd varūthasya prasevayā ।।73।।
varūthasya sahayogātsevane dehamardane ।
pādasaṃvāhane caikaśayyāsanasuvartane ।।74।।
rajobhāvena saṃsaktā'bhavadvarūthavarṣmaṇi ।
yuvānaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ prāpya tvekāntagṛhasevayā ।।75।।
prahvībhūya kalā prāha varūtha bhaja māmiha ।
smaratāpena saṃdagdhā śāntiṃ cārpaya me'nagha ।।76।।
varūtho'pi gurorvākyaṃ manvānaśca kalāvacaḥ ।
rājasībhāvajāyuktaḥ siṣeve tāṃ kalāṃ rahaḥ ।।77।।
kāmakārye vinirvṛtte śāntirjātā tayoryadā ।
kalā''śīrvacanānyāha svargaṃ te tvakṣayaṃ bhavet ।।78।।
evaṃ kāmabalenaitau bhoginau kāmanānvitau ।
remāte kāmabhāvena marīcervacanāśrayāt ।।79।।
tāvatkāryaṃ harasyārthe kṛtvā saptarṣayo gṛham ।
yayustadā marīciścāyayau svasyāśramaṃ śubham ।।1.248.80।।
marīcervartamānena varūthaśca kalā tathā ।
maryādayā hi vartete kāmanāvarjitāvubhau ।।8 1 ।।
tathāpi gurupatnyāśca varūthasya ca bhālayoḥ ।
āyurekhā'bhavatpūrvaṃ pūrṇā yā sā kṣatiṃ gatā ।।82।।
vicchinnā'bhūt paridṛṣṭā pratyakṣeṇa marīcinā ।
marīciḥ prāha tau tatra kathaṃ tvāyuḥ kṣayaṃ gatam ।।83।।
prāhatustau yathā tathyaṃ marīcirvismayaṃ gataḥ ।
akṛtaṃ tu kṛtaṃ hyābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ vai vacanānmama ।।84।।
nirdoṣaṃ tad gurorbhaktakṛte vākyaṃ guroḥ sadā ।
anena pālitaṃ vākyaṃ madīyaṃ kintu hānidam ।।85।।
brahmasvaharaṇaṃ gurutalpagāmitvamityapi ।
viśvāsaghātitā kṛtaghnatā hyāyurvināśakāḥ ।।86।।
ābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tattu mayā kāryaṃ śubhaṃ tayoḥ ।
yāvadevaṃ cintayati tāvad yamasya sevakāḥ ।।87।।
āyayustau samānetuṃ purīṃ yāmyāṃ prati dhruvam ।
marīcistatra nā'vocad yāmyā nītvā yayurdrutam ।।88।।
marīciranuyātaśca tadā tanaiva varṣmaṇā ।
dūtaistau dharmarājasya purataḥ saṃkṛtāvubhau ।।89।।
daṇḍaśca taptalohasya sūrmyā yogo'nayoḥ kṛtaḥ ।
marīciḥ prāha dharmeśaṃ tvayā yogyaṃ kṛtaṃ vibho ।।1.248.90 ।।
kintu madvacanātsarvaṃ kṛtaṃ doṣo na vai tayoḥ ।
duṣṭaṃ yadi gurorvākyaṃ doṣapātraṃ bhavāmyaham ।।9 1 ।।
yamasmṛtau tathā coktaṃ gurorvākyaṃ na doṣakṛt ।
yamavākyaṃ tu cetsatyaṃ mamavākyaṃ na doṣakṛt ।। 92।।।
mama vākyena saṃsaktau kathaṃ tau doṣasaṃyutau ।
tasmānnaitau daṇḍapātre yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।93।।
yāvadetau na muñcethāstāvannaiva jalādikam ।
gṛhṇāmyatra tavātithyaṃ yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।94।।
dharmastu pitṛvṛddhasya marīcervacanaṃ tadā ।
śrutvā vicārayāmāsa naṣṭaṃ tvāyurvikarmaṇā ।।95।।
sandhīyetā'nayoḥ kenopāyena prabalena tu ।
madvākyaṃ ca gurorvākyaṃ supramāṇaṃ bhavettathā ।।96।।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mama tvatra viruddhe viṣaye khalu ।
yadi vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ me naitau daṇḍārhaṇau tadā ।।97।।
yadi daṇḍārhaṇau tvetau nā'smadvākyapramāṇatā ।
tasmāt kimatra kartavyaṃ tvāyuḥsandhānakarmaṇi ।।98।।
varūthena tadā tatra saṃkalpitaṃ gurorbalam ।
yadyahaṃ gurubhakto'smi gurvājñāṃ prakaromi ca ।। 99।।
tadā gurvātmakaḥ kṛṣṇo gurorvākyāt prarakṣatu ।
smaratyevaṃ tu yāvat saḥ varūtho gururūpiṇam ।। 1.248.10 0।।
hariṃ tāvattadā tatra vyomavāṇī babhūva ha ।
dharmarāja śṛṇu tvaitau nirjalau nā''ptabhojanau ।। 10 1।।
marīciścāpyannajalavihīno vartate'dya vai ।
gururūpo'smyahaṃ cāpi guruṃ tau smarato yataḥ ।। 102।।।
etairmadāśrayaṃ manye kṛtaṃ tvekādaśīvratam ।
kalāvarūthayorāyūrekhā pūrṇā'dya jāyatām ।। 1 03।।
varūthasyoddharaṇena nāmnā tvekādaśī tvapi ।
varūthinī prasiddhā'stu varūthoddhārakāriṇī ।। 1 04।।
kalā''yuṣaḥ pratisandhānena saṃjīvanī tu sā ।
ānandapradayā vyomavāṇyā hyānanditā hyapi ।। 1 05।।
nandayā sahitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmyasyāḥ saṃbhavāmi ca ।
nandayā sahitaṃ māṃ tu ye'rcayiṣyanti mānavāḥ ।। 106 ।।
gurudāraratāścāpi bhaviṣyanti hi pāvanāḥ ।
śiṣyaratiprakartryaśca śuddhiṃ yāsyanti yoṣitaḥ ।। 1 07।।
varūthinyā vratinaśca niṣpāpā vai narāḥ striyaḥ ।
cirāyuṣkā bhaviṣyanti naṣṭāyuṣo'pi madbalāt ।। 1 08।।
paradravyaharā ye ca paradāraprasaṃginaḥ ।
varūthinīvratapūtā bhaviṣyanti dyuvāsinaḥ ।। 1 09।।
yamarājabhayaṃ teṣāṃ na syānnāyurvināśanam ।
na vaidhavyaṃ na vai duḥkhaṃ vidhuratvaṃ na vā bhavet ।। 1.248.11 0।।
sūryaputrādatibhīto janaḥ kuryād varūthinīm ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim ।। 111 ।।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kartavyā pāpabhīrubhiḥ ।
śravaṇāt paṭhanāttvasyā gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet ।। 112।।
ajñānācca haṭhāccāpi varūthinyā vrataṃ caret ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ nayāmyaham ।। 113 ।।
tasmādetau pramuñca tvaṃ yamarāja varūthakam ।
kalāṃ cātharṣivaryaṃ ca marīciṃ tvatithiṃ kuru ।। 1 14।।
satkāraṃ kuru datvaiva patnīṃ śiṣyaṃ sukhī bhava ।
anyathā vratapuṇyena śāpaṃ dāsyati cedṛṣiḥ ।। 1 15।।
bhasmībhūtaṃ tu te sarvaṃ sthalaṃ yāmyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
varūthinyā vratakarturgṛhaṃ mā yāntu te carāḥ ।। 116 ।।
varūthinīdine copoṣitāraṃ cāpyamānakam ।
mā prayāntu ca te dūtā yato me vratakṛddhi saḥ ।। 1 17।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau vyomavāṇī harikṛtā ।
yamarājo'pi tau pūrṇāyuṣau dṛṣṭvā mumoca ha ।। 1 18।।
nirdoṣau guruvākyasthau doṣā'liptau kalāruthau ।
marīcinā samaṃ yātau nijā''vāsaṃ yamālayāt ।। 119 ।
evaṃ te kathito lakṣmi! varūthinīvratotsavaḥ ।
kṛtvā śrutvā paṭhitvā taṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।। 1.248.120 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiśākhakṛṣṇavarūthinyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ marīceḥ patnyāḥ kalāyāḥ varūthena śiṣyeṇa gurupatnīvākyabhaktena saṃgadoṣe'pi vratena taduddharaṇādītinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 248।।


← adhyāyaḥ 248 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 249
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 250 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan devadeveśa bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara ।
āyuḥpradaṃ vrataṃ samyak śrāvitaṃ bhavatā vibho ।। 1 ।।
śrutvā varūthaviprasya mahāpātakanāśanam ।
prasannaṃ jāyate cetaḥ kṛpāsāgara keśava ।। 2 ।।
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃ nāmnyekādaśī matā ।
kiṃ phalaṃ ko vidhistatra ko devo vada mādhava ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
padmaje kathayiṣyāmi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yadvratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ।। 4 ।।
vaiśākhasyā'rjune pakṣe nāmato mohinī tu sā ।
bhavedekādaśī lakṣmi! sarvapātakanāśinī ।। 5 ।।
pāpajālāni naśyanti moho naśyati tadvratāt ।
mahāduḥkhāni naśyanti sukhaṃ bhavati tadvratāt ।। 6 ।।
yasyāḥ kartavyatābhāvādapi pāpaṃ vinaśyati ।
daśamyāmekabhaktena naktenāpi vratārthinā ।। 7 ।।
vartitavyaṃ tathā rātrau brahmacaryavratena ca ।
prātarutthāya kṛṣṇaśca smartavyo vratinā sadā ।। 8 ।।
snātvā hariḥ supūjyaśca pūjanīyo vratārthinā ।
nityavidhyanusāreṇa vratārthaṃ prārthanāṃ kriyāt ।। 9 ।।
adyāhaṃ devadeveśa kariṣye vratamacyuta ।
tavānugrahaleśena saṃpūrṇaṃ tadbhavediti । । 1.249.10 ।।
evaṃ tu pūjanaṃ nityatayā prāptaṃ samāpya ca ।
kārayet sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ taṇḍulādibhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
tanmadhye sughaṭaḥ sthāpyaḥ suvarṇasyā'tha vā navaḥ ।
tāmrajaḥ sajalaḥ pañcaratnayuk pañcapallavaḥ ।। 1 2।।
vastraveṣṭitakaṇṭhaśca candanākṣatapūjitaḥ ।
phalaṃ nyasyennārikelaṃ pārśve tasyāntarā'bbhṛtam ।। 13 ।।
nyasyenmukhopari ramyāṃ sthālīṃ tilaprapūritām ।
tatra nyasyet svarṇarūpyatāmradravyaṃ ca śarkarām ।। 14।।
kārayitvā kanakasya mūrtiṃ tvekādaśīpateḥ ।
madhusūdanadevasya mādhavyā saha śobhitām ।। 15।।
mohinyā ca yutāṃ tatra sthālyāṃ vai sthāpayettu tām ।
svarganiḥśreṇikāṃ kūpyamayīṃ nyasyetprapūjayet ।। 1 6।।
svastikaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca candrakaṃ tilakaṃ tathā ।
svarṇaraupyaṃ kārayitvā ghaṭapārśve nidhāpayet ।। 17।।
phalāni vividhānyeva pūgīphalādikāni ca ।
elālavaṃgatvaksārajātīphalāni cūrṇakam ।। 18 ।।
śarkarāṃ gūḍadhānādīn navavastūni dāpayet ।
paryaṃkaṃ gendukaṃ guptadorakaṃ pārśvakaṃ tathā ।। 1 9।।
darpaṇaṃ vyajanaṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ yaṣṭikāṃ śubhām ।
pāduke keśasaṃskartrīṃ sugandhadravyasaṃyutām ।। 1.249.20 ।।
sajalaṃ mṛdghaṭaṃ navyaṃ pakvānyāmraphalāni ca ।
vinyasyet pūjanaṃ kuryād vidhinā vratakārakaḥ ।। 21 ।।
puṣpeṣu mallikāṃ dadyānnaivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ śubham ।
arghyaṃ phalaṃ tu panasaṃ śayyādānaṃ samuttamam ।। 22।।
prathamaṃ tilapātre taṃ madhusūdanamacyutam ।
āvāhayet tato dadyādāsanaṃ cottamottamam ।। 23 ।।
pādaprakṣālanavāri tathā'rcanajalaṃ śubham ।
ācamanārthe salilaṃ dadyād devāya bhāvataḥ ।। 24।।
dantadhāvanamārdraṃ ca dadyāccūrṇaṃ sugandhavat ।
mukhaprakṣālanaṃ tasya kārayet tīrthavāriṇā ।। 25 ।।
śaucādikalpayeddhastapādaśuddhiṃ prakalpayet ।
paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca śuddhodakena tatparam ।। 26 ।।
vastrairāmārjanaṃ kuryāt suvastrāṇi samarpayet ।
dhautraṃ sūkṣma śubhaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ śvetaṃ navaṃ tathā ।। 27।।
arpayeccandanaṃ tailaṃ sugandhaṃ dravyamattaram ।
gandhasāraṃ maṇiṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kajjalādikam ।। 28 ।।
kuṃkumaṃ tvarpayeccābīraṃ gulālaṃ śubhākṣatān ।
puṣpāṇi kundakalikārūpāṇi puṣpamālikāḥ ।। 29।।
vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi śṛṃgāradravyamuttamam ।
alaṃkārāṇi ramyāṇi tvarpayeddharaye tadā ।। 1.249.30 ।।
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle kārayeccandanena vai ।
lepayeccābhito varṣmaṇi vratī hṛdayādike ।। 31 ।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dadyānmiṣṭānnamuttamam ।
śārkaraṃ dadhisāraṃ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ dadyāttu pūrikāḥ ।। 32।।
śārkaraṃ śītasalilaṃ phalaṃ cāmraṃ ca bīṭikām ।
nāgavallīparṇakṛtāṃ dadyāttvanyattu yat kṛtam ।। 33 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ namaskāraṃ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā ।
daṇḍavacca kṣamāyāñcāṃ phalapūrṇatvayācanām ।। 34 ।।
puṣpāñjaliṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyāt paścād visarjayet ।
kuryāccāvaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ vratī bhaktyātmakaṃ tadā ।। 35 ।।
madhyāhne pūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ bhojanaṃ kārayed bahu ।
ṣaṭpaṃcāśatprabhogāँśca dadyādarthānvitastadā ।। 36 ।।
jalapānaṃ pradadyācca tāmbūlaṃ mukhaśodhakam ।
dadyācca taṃ namaskṛtya vratī bhaktyādikaṃ caret ।। 37।।
sāyaṃ cārārtrikaṃ kuryānnaivedyaṃ ca jalārpaṇam ।
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaiḥ kārayed bandhayecca saḥ ।। 38 ।।
preṃkhāṃ suśobhitāṃ ramyāṃ navapallavatoraṇām ।
āndolayeddhariṃ tatra sthāpayitvā svayaṃ vratī । । 39 ।।
pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastūttamairnirvartayedvratī ।
rātrau bhaktiyutaṃ kālaṃ bhaktaiḥ saha tu yāpayet ।।1.249.40 ।।
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmahotsavapuraḥsaram ।
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gītiṃ tālamānādisaṃyutām ।।4 1 ।।
smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ cāpi kathākhyānāni kārayet ।
gāpayet kṛṣṇapadyāni narā nāryaśca sarvathā ।।42।।
harikīrtanayuktāśca kuryurjāgaraṇaṃ tathā ।
prātaḥ smareddhariṃ snātvā punaḥ pūjanamācaret ।।43 ।।
vratī dānāni dadyācca gurave'tisubhāvataḥ ।
bhojayed brāhmaṇān sādhūn sādhvīrbālāँca pūjayet ।।44।।
dīnān kṛpaṇān bālikāśca parādhīnāँśca bhojayet ।
āśritān karmacārāँśca pramadāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ।।45।।
pūjyāँśca bhojayenmiṣṭaṃ mātṛँśca janakāँstathā ।
vṛddhāँśca bhojayennamrabhāvanāṃ ca pradarśayet ।।46।।
tato vratī svayaṃ kuryātpāraṇāṃ tu hariṃ smaran ।
śayyādānaṃ gajavājigodānaṃ bhūgṛhārpaṇam ।।47। ।
susatpātre prakuryāttu yānavāhadhanārpaṇam ।
evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kurvannāpnoti paramaṃ padam ।।48 ।।
śāśvataṃ ca sukhaṃ svarge yatheṣṭaṃ kṛpayā hareḥ ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ vaiśyasya pāvanīm ।।49।।
saurāṣṭre tu sarasvatyāḥ prācyā nātividūrake ।
uttare tu pradeśe vai bhadrāvatyāstu dakṣiṇe ।।1.249.5 0 ।।
bhāṇḍīrākhyanagaryāṃ vai dhṛtisiṃho'bhavannṛpaḥ ।
tasya śreṣṭhī dhanapālo hyabhavaddhanaśevadhiḥ ।।5 1 ।।
dhanapālaḥ sadā khyātaḥ puṇyakāryapravartane ।
prapākūpamaṭhārāmataḍāgagṛhakārakaḥ ।।52।।
viṣṇubhaktaḥ sādhusevī paropakṛtisadvrataḥ ।
kathāśravaṇasuśraddhaḥ sarvadā bhaktitatparaḥ ।।53।।
putrāstasyā'bhavan pañca śreṣṭhino dhanaśālinaḥ ।
sumanā dyutimāँścaiva medhāvī sukṛtistathā ।।54।।
catvāraḥ puṇyapātrāṇi pañcamaścātipāpakṛt ।
dhṛṣṭabuddhiriti khyātaḥ parastrīsaṃgasaṃrataḥ ।।।55।।।
dyūtādivyasanāsakto vārastrīratikārakaḥ ।
devapūjāvihīnaśca pitṛtarpaṇanāstikaḥ ।।56।।
dvijānāṃ nindako vedanindako nyāyavarjitaḥ ।
duṣṭātmā svapiturdravyanāśako madirāpibaḥ ।।57।।
abhakṣyabhakṣaka pāpī sarvasampatkṣayaṃkaraḥ ।
cauryādikarmanirato duṣṭasaṃgo hyakarmakṛt ।।58।।
pitrā catuṣpathe dṛṣṭo veśyāskandhasthahastakaḥ ।
pāpācārarataścaivaṃ vijñāto bandhubhistataḥ ।।59।।
pitrā niṣkāsito gehād bāndhavaiśca vivāsitaḥ ।
dāyabhāgena yatkiṃcillabdhaṃ nirvāhakaṃ dhanam ।।1.249.60 ।।
sarvaṃ nītaṃ kṣayaṃ tena veśyāsaṃgena nityadā ।
ābhūṣaṇāni pātrāṇi vastrāṇyupaskarāṇi ca ।।61 ।।
kṣayaṃ nītāni tenaiva gaṇikāsaṃgakāriṇā ।
dhanahīnaḥ parityakto gaṇikābhistataḥ sa tu ।।62।।
cintāturobhavad vastradhanahīnaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ ।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi jīvanopāyavarjitaḥ ।।63।।
tasmāt kāryaṃ taskaratvaṃ cauryaṃ kāryaṃ prasahya ca ।
luṇṭhanāpaharaṇe ca kṛtvā jīvāmi nānyathā ।।64।।
evaṃ balā'paharaṇaṃ karoti vanage pathi ।
pitustu nagare rātrau taskaratvaṃ karoti ca ।।65।।
surāṃ pibati nityaṃ sa māṃsaṃ khādati nityadā ।
cauryaṃ nityaṃ karotyeva puṃścalīsaṃgatiṃ gataḥ ।।66।।
rātrau cauryaṃ suvarṇasya kṛtaṃ tena tu tatkṣaṇe ।
rājadūtairdhṛto rātrau kintu svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ tadā । ।67।।
luṃcārūpaṃ rājadūtebhyo'rpayitvā vibandhanaḥ ।
muktiṃ prāpya gato'raṇye punaścauryaṃ cakāra saḥ ।।68।।
punardhṛto rājadūto punarluṃcāpradānataḥ ।
bandhanānmuktimāsādya gato'raṇyaṃ punastathā ।।69।।
punaścauryaṃ samārebhe dhanāpaharaṇaṃ tathā ।
janānāmardanaṃ cakre saṃghānāṃ luṇṭanaṃ tathā ।।1.249.70।।
punaśca nagare caurye kartuṃ rātrau yayau tadā ।
manuṣyaiḥ sa durācāro nibaddho raśmibhirdṛḍhaiḥ ।।7 1 ।।
nigaḍairdaṇḍito rājñā kaśāghātaiśca tāḍitaḥ ।
kārāgāraṃ yathādaṇḍaṃ kṣapayitvā punarhi saḥ ।।72 ।।
nirbandho vanamāsādya bhojanārthaṃ pradhāvati ।
siṃhavadghātayatyugro mṛgaśūkaravānarān ।।73 ।।
āmiṣāhāranirato vane bhramati sarvathā ।
kare dhanuḥ samāgṛhya dhṛtvā pṛṣṭhe niṣaṃgakam ।।74।।
āraṇyakān paśūn patatriṇo hanti padā caran ।
cakravākānkapotāँśca pārāvatāँśca tittirān ।।75।।
kukkuṭān sārasān hanti mayūrānmūṣakānapi ।
varāhān gavayāँścaiva garuḍān hanti haṃsakān ।।76।।
etānanyān hinastyugro dhṛṣṭabuddhirhi nirdayaḥ ।
pūrvapāpaiḥ pāpamārge pravṛttaḥ pāpakarmasu ।।77 ।।
duḥkhāviṣṭaḥ sukhaleśarahito'bhūdaharniśam ।
evaṃ vṛkṣeṣu śaileṣu durge cāraṇyabhūmiṣu ।।78।।
anāsano'ṭati daivāt prāptaḥ kuṇḍinanāmakam ।
puraṃ hyudyānaśobhāḍhyaṃ nikaṭe vanabhūmikam ।।79।।
nātidūre vane tatra kauṇḍinyākhyo mahānṛṣiḥ ।
svāśrame vartate nityaṃ pānthānāṃ śāntisampradaḥ ।।1.249.8 0 ।।
atithīn satkarotyeṣo bhakṣyapānāsanādibhiḥ ।
gato'yaṃ tvāśramadvāre muniṃ śrutvā tapodhanam ।।8 1 ।।
vaiśākhe māsi sarasi kṛtasnānaṃ tapodhanam ।
āsasāda dhṛṣṭabuddhiḥ svoddhārodayasanmukhaḥ ।।8 2।।
pādayoḥ patitaḥ prahvībhāvenaivā''rdramānasaḥ ।
tāvadṛṣerārdravastrabindavaḥ patitāstadā ।।8 3 ।।
mastake dhṛṣṭabuddhestu skandhayoḥ karayostathā ।
nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ।।84।।
vadato munirājasya śabdo'pi śravaṇe gataḥ ।
evaṃ mantreṇa ṛṣiṇā salilena tu pāvitaḥ ।।85 ।।
caraṇasparśamātreṇa naṣṭapāpo babhūva saḥ ।
mumukṣutāṃkurodbhedo jātastatra kṣaṇe'sya ca ।।86 ।।
kauṇḍinyasyā'grataḥ sthitvā samuvāca kṛtāṃjaliḥ ।
bho bho brahmanmokṣadātardayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ।।87।।
yena puṇyaprabhāveṇa muktirbhavati pāpinaḥ ।
tādṛśaṃ puṇyakāryaṃ me vrataṃ vā vada mokṣadam । ।88 ।।
mahātmanāṃ prasaṃgena mahāpātakino'pi ca ।
taranti pāvanā bhūtvā pāvayantyaparānapi । ।8 9।।
tasmāccauryasurāpānā''miṣabhakṣaṇamaithunam ।
kṛtvā pāpadurācārān patito'smi ca sarvataḥ । । 1.249.90 । ।
pāvayitvedṛśaṃ māṃ ca mokṣabhājaṃ kuru prabho ।
śrutvā prāha tadā kauṇḍinyarṣistaṃ śaraṇāgatam । ।9 1 । ।
vaiśākhasya site pakṣe mohinī nāma viśrutā ।
ekādaśī bhavatyeṣā vrataṃ tasyāḥ samācāra ।।92।।।
merutulyāni pāpāni kṣayaṃ yāsyanti tadvratāt ।
bahujanmārjitānyāśu naśyanti vratino dhruvam ।।93 ।।
iti kauṇḍinyasadvācaṃ śrutvā dhṛṣṭasudhīstadā ।
vrataṃ cakāra vidhivat kauṇḍinyāśramasannidhau ।। 94।।
dhautapāpo'bhavacchuddho vāsanā'sya layaṃ gatā ।
āyuścāpi gataṃ tvantaṃ karmaleśo na vidyate ।। 95।।
dvādaśyāṃ saḥ phalapatrāhāraḥ san sarasastaṭe ।
supto muniṃ smaran kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhajan raṭan ।।96 ।।
śarīraṃ bhautikaṃ tyaktvā divyadeho babhūva saḥ ।
jagāma vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ garuḍopari saṃsthitaḥ ।। 97।।
evaṃ lakṣmi! mohinīsadvrataṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ।
nātaḥ parataraṃ kiñcit trailokye sacarācare ।।98।।
yajñāditīrthadānāni kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।
vratasyā'syā'ghaharturvaiṃ mokṣadāturharerbalāt ।।99 ।।
māyāmohaprasaktānāṃ mohinī mohanāśinī ।
brahmapūjātiriktānāṃ mohinī mohanapradā ।। 1.249.100 ।।
mohaṃ nāsti yato yasyāṃ mohinī procyate tataḥ ।
mohī pāpī yayā dhāmni svarge vā nīyate tu sā ।। 101 ।।
mohinī kṛṣṇasambandhātprocyate nityasaukhyadā ।
koṭiyajñaphalādhikyaphaladātrī vratena sā ।। 102 ।।
pālanīyā prayatnena svargamokṣaphalapradā ।
pūrvajanmakṛtā'nekakarmapāpāpanuttaye ।। 103 ।।
vaiṣṇavena viśeṣeṇa kartavyā mohaśāntaye ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapādāmbujamohābhilabdhaye ।। 1 04।।
putrapautradhanadārāsmṛddhiyānagṛhādikam ।
sakāmo labhate sarvaṃ vratenā'syāḥ kṛtena yat ।। 105 ।।
labheddhanaṃ dhanahīno hyabuddho buddhimāpnuyāt ।
yadyatsaṃkalpayeccāpi saṃprāpnuyāttu tadvratī ।। 106 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiśākhaśuklamohinyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ dhṛṣṭabuddhināmnaḥ pāpivaiśyasya kauṇḍinyopadeśād vratakaraṇena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāya ।। 249 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 249 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 250
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 251 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
loke ca prāṇināṃ rītirnaisargikī tu keśava ।
bhakṣye pāne tathā''nande'laṃkāre viṣaye priye ।। 1 ।।
mānavāstu tathā martye vidhiṃ vismṛtya mānavam ।
yānti te pāśave mārge dehendriyā'sutarpaṇāḥ ।। 2 ।।
teṣāṃ muktikaraṃ saumyaṃ vrataṃ nārāyaṇa prabho! ।
ekādaśyā vratādanyannāsti drāṅ mokṣadaṃ khalu ।। 3 ।।
śrutvaitanmānasaṃ me'tiprasannaṃ bhavati prabho ।
śrotumicchāmi māhātmyaṃ vidhiṃ prapūjanaṃ vratam ।। 4 ।।
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇaikādaśikātithestad vad keśava ।
kiṃ nāmnyekādaśī ko'syā devaḥ pūjyaśca kiṃ phalam ।। 5 ।।
nārāyaṇa uvāca-
ekādaśī tvaparākhyā mahāpātakanāśinī ।
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇadalīyā vai putrapautrapradāyinī ।। 6 ।।
asyā adhipatirdevo hariḥ svayamadhokṣajaḥ ।
patnyā trayyākhyayā yuktaḥ pūjanīyo vidhānataḥ ।। 7 ।।
ketakairarcanīyo'sau tathā'nyaiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
arghye bahuphalaṃ deyaṃ dugdhaudanādi bhojane ।। 8 ।।
śārkaraṃ tu jalaṃ śītaṃ pānārthaṃ deyamuttamam ।
savatsāyāśca gordānaṃ gurave'tra prakīrtitam ।। 9 ।।
daśamyāmekabhuktena naktena nirvahed vratī ।
rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryād rakṣayed brahmacāritām ।। 10 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ samutthāya brāhmakāle hariṃ smaret ।
svarṇakeśaṃ padmanetraṃ tilapuṣpasunāsikam ।। 1 1।।
sakuṇḍalaṃ samukuṭaṃ keyūrakaṭakānvitam ।
raktādharaṃ sucibukaṃ vartulānanaśobhitam ।। 12।।
hasantaṃ kundakalikāpaṃktibhāsuradantakam ।
prodbhinnayauvanopetaṃ tejomaṇḍalamaṇḍitam ।। 13। ।
hāraratnābharaṇādibhūṣitaṃ sevitaṃ janaiḥ ।
rūpānurūpāvayavaṃ prasannamukhapaṃkajam ।। 14।।
ceto harantaṃ bhaktasya kaṭākṣaśarakāriṇam ।
divyānandabharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram । । 15।।
dhyāyedevaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paramātmānamīśvaram ।
tataḥ snātvā pūjayecca vidhinā svāminaṃ prabhum ।। 16 ।।
āvāhanādiṣoḍaśavidhānaiḥ pūjayetprabhum ।
puṣpāṃjalipraparyantaṃ naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ vratī ।। 17।।
vidhāya prārthayedante vratavighnapraśāntaye ।
aparāyā vrataṃ tvadya kariṣye parameśvara ।। 18।।
avighnaṃ tatprapūrṇaṃ me bhavatviti tato vratī ।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayedakṣatādibhiḥ ।। 19।।
ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya sauvarṇaṃ sajalaṃ tāmramityatha ।
pañcaratnādisaṃyuktaṃ vastrapallavaśobhitam ।।20 ।।
pūjayettaṃ ca tīrthāni jale tvāvāhayet tataḥ ।
mūrtiṃ trayyā sahā'dhokṣajasya kundananirmitām ।।।21 ।।
ghaṭamūrdhni tilapātre prasaṃsthāpya prapūjayet ।
āvāhanātsamārabhya yathā visarjanāvadhim ।। 22।।
snānālaṃkārasaugandhyanaivedyajalavīṭikām ।
ārārtrikastutipuṣpāṃjalikṣāntisamarthanām ।।23।।
nirvartayitvā dānāni vividhāni tu dāpayet ।
madhyāhne'pi tathā kuryāt pūjanaṃ homamityapi ।। 24।।
trayyā'dhokṣajanāmnā vai hyaṣṭottaraśataṃ vratī ।
naivedyaṃ miṣṭamarpayya tāmbūlādi samarpayet ।।।25।।
sāyaṃ tu maṇḍapaṃ ramyaṃ haritaṃ kadalīkṛtam ।
navapallavapuṣpāḍhyaphalayuktoraṇānvitam ।।26।।
savitānaṃ suraṃgālicitraśobhācamatkṛtam ।
kārayet tatra dolāyāmāndālayettu mādhavam ।।27।।
jalaphuvvārasaṃsiktaśītalodyānamadhyagam ।
siṃhāsanasthitaṃ cādhokṣajaṃ viñjyāt tato vratī ।।28।।
kṛtvaivaṃ tu mahāpūjāṃ harerniśi prakārayet ।
ārārtrikādikaṃ cātha naivedyaṃ dadhiśarkaram ।।29।।
āmramiṣṭarasāḍhyaṃ ca pūrikādiyutaṃ śubham ।
arpayet naktabhojyaṃ ca tāmbūlādi samarpayet ।।।30 ।।
kalpayecchayanārthaṃ ca paryaṃkaṃ preṃkhayānvitam ।
nimbavṛkṣapraśākhāyāṃ vyomni baddhaṃ sudolakam ।।3 1 ।।
komalaṃ gendukādyaṃ cāstaraṇaṃ cāpi kalpayet ।
bhagavantaṃ ghṛtadīpaprakāśe tatra dolayet ।।32।।
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca smaraṇaṃ bhajanaṃ tathā ।
kuryurjāgaraṇaṃ bhaktā militvā harisannidhau ।।।33।।।
ekādaśyāḥ kathāṃ tatra śṛṇuyācca paṭhecca vā ।
līlādīni harestatra śrāvayed vadanādinā ।।34।।
akhaṇḍanāmabhajanaṃ saśabdaṃ niśi kārayet ।
bhaktebhyo miṣṭasalilaṃ tathā phalādi cārpayet ।।।35।।।
payo dadyātkaṇṭhaśāntyai dadyāttvanyadapekṣitam ।
sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ yogināṃ tathā ।।।36।।
sevanaṃ pādasaṃvāhaṃ kuryācchramāpanodanam ।
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnindāṃ kutsāṃ vivarjayet। ।।37।।
divyāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ prakuryāccā'dhokṣajaṃ cintayeddhṛdi ।
śubhaṃ sarvaṃ caredekādaśījāgaraṇavratī ।।38 ।।
ālasyapṛṣṭhabhaṃgādi nāśayed rāsakarmaṇā ।
kūrdanaṃ gāyanaṃ nṛtyaṃ hāsyaṃ kuryātpunaḥ punaḥ ।।39।।
nidrā''lasyavināśārthaṃ dhāvanaṃ sapradakṣiṇam ।
kuryācca khelanaṃ bhakto bhakteṣu samavartiṣu ।।40 ।।
kṛṣṇalīlāṃ rāsalīlāṃ dānilīlāṃ prakhelayet ।
gopīlīlāṃ rādhayā saṃvihāraṃ ca vane'ṭanam ।।41।।
padmayā saha lagnaṃ ca bhārgavyā ramayā saha ।
nārāyaṇasya lagnaṃ ca protsavātmakamācaret ।।42।।।
rātrau mahotsavaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇasya gopikākṛtam ।
pārvatyā prabhayā māṇikyā lakṣmyā sākameva vā ।। 43।।
vaivāhikotsavaṃ kuryād brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ ।
pragāyejjanmapadyāni śaktyutpattyutsavāँstathā ।।44।।
kīrtayejjāgaraṇe ca prātaḥ snātvā prapūjayet ।
ṣoḍaśakopacārādyaiḥ pūjayeccāpyadhokṣajam ।।45।।
trayīṃ tvekādaśīṃ cāpi guruṃ prapūjayettataḥ ।
gurostu mastake kṛṣṇamastaka vartate sadā ।।46।।
gurornetre kṛṣṇanetraṃ gurvāsye tvānanaṃ hareḥ ।
guroḥ karṇe kṛṣṇakarṇaḥ harerjihvā gurormukhe ।। 47।।
guroḥ kaṇṭhe hareḥ kaṇṭho gurvoṣṭhe mādhavādharaḥ ।
gurorvakṣasi kṛṣṇoro hyudaraikyaṃ harerguroḥ ।।48।।
gurorhaste harerhasto guroḥ kaṭyāṃ hareḥ kaṭiḥ ।
guroḥ pṛṣṭhe hareḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ hṛdayaikyaṃ harerguroḥ ।।49।।
gurorbuddhau harerbuddhirgurorvāci harestu vāk ।
gurorgupte harerguptaṃ guroḥ sakthnorharerurū ।।50 ।।
gurostvakṣu harestvag vai gurordehe harerbalam ।
gurorjānvorharerjānū nakhaikyaṃ ca gurorhareḥ ।।51 ।।
guroḥ pāde kṛṣṇapādo nakhaikyaṃ ca gurorhareḥ ।
gurau kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tvāste nānyaḥ kṛṣṇo guroḥ paraḥ ।।52।।
guruḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇo gurustasmai śrīgurave namaḥ ।
iti dhyātvā guruṃ samyak pūjayet kṛṣṇabhāvataḥ ।।53।।
arpayeccāpi gurviṣṭaṃ gurau tuṣṭe sa toṣitaḥ ।
gurostu sevane kṛṣṇasevāpuṇyaṃ bhaveddhruvam ।।54।।
bodhyaṃ gurvarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ।
ahaṃ lakṣmi! praśiṣyāṇāṃ gururūpo bhavāmi hi ।।55।।
gurau sthitvā divyasevāṃ gṛhṇāmi bhattasatkṛtām ।
yena kena prakāreṇa dānenā'bhyarcanena vā ।।56 ।।
namanenārpaṇenāpi sevanena stavena ca ।
pādasaṃvāhanenāpi priyavastvarpaṇena vā ।।।57। ।
gṛhādikaṃ samarpyāpi toṣaṇīyo guruḥ sadā ।
tasmādekādaśīvastudānaṃ śrīgurave'rpayet ।।58 ।।
patiṃ patnīṃ sutaṃ putrīṃ kuṭumbaṃ sarvamityapi ।
tārayeddhi gurustuṣṭastasmātkṛṣṇātmako guruḥ ।।59 ।।
evaṃ jñātvā dvādaśyāṃ vai dānaṃ tu gurave'rpayet ।
pāraṇāṃ kārayed viprān sādhūn sādhvīśca bhojayet ।। 60 ।।
bālān kanyā bhojayecca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।
evaṃ vratī bhuvi svarge vairājake'pi vā ।। 61 ।।
aiśvare'vyākṛte cāpi śāśvataṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ।
loke prasiddhatāṃ yāti tvaparāṃ yastu sevate ।। 62 ।।
brahmahatyāgotrahatyābhrūṇahatyākarastathā ।
strīhatyāmitrahatyādipāpakṛnmucyate vratāt ।। 63 ।।
parāpavādanirataḥ parastrīratikastathā ।
aparāvratalābhena vipāpmā jāyate janaḥ ।। 64 ।।
kūṭasākṣī kūṭamātā kūṭakapaṭakārakaḥ ।
kūṭavāk piśunaścaite mucyante pāpato drutam । । 65 ।।
kūṭavedaḥ kūṭaśāstraḥ kūṭajyotirgaṇastathā ।
kūṭāyurvedako vaidyo mucyate'syā vratena vai ।। 66।।
brāhmaṇā brahmapatitāḥ kṣatriyā rakṣaṇāccyutāḥ ।
vaiśyāḥ parāṅmukhā dānānmucyante'syā vratena te ।। 67।।
dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ śūdrāḥ śiṣyā gurvādinindakāḥ ।
putro mātāpitṛhāpi mucyante'syā vratena vai ।। 68 ।।
makarasthe ravau māghe prayāge yatphalaṃ nṛṇām ।
kāśyāṃ ca prāpyate puṇyaṃ śivarātryā vratena yat ।। 69 । ।
gayāpiṇḍena puṇyaṃ yat pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ matam ।
siṃhasthite bṛhaspatau godāvaryāṃ ca yatphalam ।।7 0 ।।
kedāradarśanātpuṇyaṃ badarītīrthajaṃ phalam ।
kurukṣetre ravigrāhe sarvatīrthaprasevanāt ।।7 1 ।।
gajāśvahemadānena yajñaṃ kṛtvā sadakṣiṇam ।
yatphalaṃ tatphalaprāptiraparāvratasevanāt ।।72 ।।
aghavṛkṣakuṭhārīyaṃ doṣāraṇyadavānalaḥ ।
pāpā'ndhakārataraṇirduritamṛgasiṃhikā ।।73 ।।
muktidā bhuktidā yāvadiṣṭadā hyaparā matā ।
asyā vratena yatpuṇyaṃ paraṃ yasmānna śiṣyate । ।74।।
aparā kṛṣṇayogātsā sārthakā vratakāriṇām ।
anyāsāṃ tu vratairatra khaṇḍapuṇyaṃ hi labhyate । ।75 ।।
aparāyā vratenātra sārvabhaumaphalaṃ bhavet ।
nāsti yadvratinaścātrā'labhyaṃ kiñcid bhavediti ।।76 । ।
śrotā ca pāṭhako lakṣmi! gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ।
vratī pāpāni nirdhūya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।। 77 ।।
parāścānyā yadagre vai svalpā bhavanti tejasā ।
aparā sā yataḥ proktā nāsti yasyāḥ paraṃ param । । 78 ।।
aparāṃ samupoṣyaiva pūjayitvā tvadhokṣajam ।
trayīpatnyā sahitaṃ ca vajralepātpramucyate ।।79 ।।
niṣkṛtiśūnyapāpānāṃ niṣkṛtiriyamucyate ।
agatikasya jīvasya gatirevā'parāvratam ।।8 0 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! samākhyānaṃ śalabhāyāḥ kṛte yuge ।
yatinyāḥ saṃbabhūvāścaryānvitaṃ mokṣadaṃ śubham । ।8 1 ।।
śalabhānāmayatinī dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ gatā ।
sādhvī nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ bhajatyeva divāniśam ।।82 ।।
araṇye parvate sā cā'rbudākhye puṣkarāntike ।
vicaratyaniśaṃ tvekākinī yogabalāttu sā ।।8 2 ।।
ābālyātsā sanakasyā'bhavacchiṣyātiyoginī ।
lakṣavarṣe gate kāle yauvane'tibale gate ।।84।।
vane vanapaśusiṃhasiṃhikāmaithunakriyām ।
vīkṣya cānyāraṇyavāsikāmayogān punaḥ punaḥ । ।85 । ।
kāmadevasya saukhye'syā manovṛttirajāyata ।
vānaraṃ raktavarṇaṃ vai vanyaṃ sā svāśramasthitam ।।86 ।।
dhṛtvā taṃ ramayāmāsa nityadā kāmabhāvataḥ ।
vānarasya tu yogena garbho jāto vyavardhata ।।87।।
paśoryogena sāṃkaryaṃ pātakaṃ muktināśanam ।
śrutvā vaśiṣṭhaśiṣyātsā vedaśrutābhidhāttadā ।।88 ।।
paścāttāpaṃ para prāptā sanakasyāśramaṃ gatā ।
śiṣyāyāstvantarvatnītvaṃ dṛṣṭvā''ha sanakastu tām ।।8 9 ।।
kimidaṃ vai sute jātaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vilopitam ।
tathāpi gurave sarvaṃ hyakāpaṭyena varṇitam ।। 90 ।।
saṃkarīkaraṇasyāsya pātitvasyā'pyaghasya tu ।
yena nāśo bhavecchuddhiryathā jāyeta tadvada ।।9 1 ।।
ityabhyarthya sagarbhā sā ruroda khinnamānasā ।
garbhapāte'tipāpitvaṃ bhrūṇahatyādipātakam ।। 92।।
kathaṃ me mama garbhasya nairdoṣyaṃ saṃbhavediti ।
vicā ' vidadhānāṃ tāṃ sanakaḥ prāha saṃśṛṇu ।। 93 ।।
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇā'paraikādaśyā vrataṃ nirjalaṃ kuru ।
pātakaṃ te vinaṣṭaṃ syātprārabdhaṃ pūrṇatāṃ vrajet ।। 94।।
muktiścāpi sulabhā syātprasavāt prāg vrataṃ kuru ।
iti śrutvā guruṃ natvā gatvā svāśramamarbude ।। 99।।
cakāra vidhivatsarvam aparāyā vrataṃ śubham ।
tena śuddhiṃ gatā tasyāḥ pātityaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ।। 96।।
āyuśca sāntamabhavat sthiravṛttyā tvadhokṣaje ।
ātmānaṃ yojayitvā ca brahmarandhreṇa sā tataḥ ।। 97।।
brahmalokaṃ gatā nītvā garbhādhānasthacetanam ।
dehaṃ tyaktvā parāṃ muktimaparāvratato gatā ।। 98 ।।
aparāyā vrataṃ tvevaṃ pāpasāṃkaryanāśanam ।
kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi! sadā nāryā'pi śuddhaye ।। 99 ।।
yatinā brahmaniṣṭhena yoginā nyāsinā'pi ca ।
saṃkarīkaraṇā'ghasya śāntaye kāryameva tat ।। 1.250.100 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇā'paraikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ saṃkarīkaraṇādipātakanāśakaitadvratakaraṇena vānarayogāt garbhavatyāḥ śalabhāyatinyā nirdoṣatā muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 250 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 251
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 252 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
asāre'smiँstu saṃsāre sārastu bhagavān svayam ।
yaṃ bhajitvā narā yānti nirvāṇapadamakṣaram ।। 1 ।।
kṛṣṇayogāt kṛṣṇatithiḥ kṛṣṇatulyaphalapradā ।
yadvrataṃ vidhivat kṛtvā dehī yāti parāṃ gatim ।। 2 ।।
jyeṣṭhaśuklapakṣīyaikādaśī kimabhidhā matā ।
tasyā devo vratavidhirdānaṃ phalaṃ ca kīdṛśam ।। 3 ।।
vad me śrīhare kṛṣṇa kṛpānātha ramāpate ।
svīyānāṃ cā'hetukā'nugrahakartā'sti yadbhavān ।। 4 । ।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
jyeṣṭhaśukladalīyaikādaśī vai nirjalābhidhā ।
padmākṣyā sahitastrivikramākhyaḥ pūjya iṣyate ।। 5 ।।
yūthikākusumaiḥ pūjyaścārghye tvāmraphalaṃ matam ।
dadhibhaktādi naivedyaṃ chatradānādi ceṣyate ।। 6 ।।
daśamyāmekabhaktena naktena nirvahed vratī ।
rātrau śayīta pṛthvyāṃ ca brahmacārī bhaved vratī ।। 7 ।।
prātarutthāya lakṣmīśaṃ dhyāyedaṃgāni cintayet ।
snātvā taṃ pūjayedbhakto bhāvayuktaistu vastubhiḥ ।। 8 ।।
āvāhanaṃ samārabhya snānaṃ paṃcāmṛtādinā ।
śṛṃgāraṃ kārayitvā'pi vastrabhūṣāsugandhibhiḥ । । 9 । ।
patrakuṃkumakastūrīhārāliśekharādibhiḥ ।
ārārtrikasunaivedyapānatāmbūladakṣiṇaiḥ । । 1.251.10 ।।
namaḥstutikṣamāvākyaiḥ puṣpāṃjalyādinā hareḥ ।
pūjāṃ kṛtvā tato dhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam । । 11 । ।
kārayetsthāpayenmadhye ghaṭaṃ kāṃcananirmitam ।
tāmrajaṃ vā ghaṭaṃ tadvadaṣṭadikṣu ghaṭāṣṭakam ।। 12 । ।
sthāpayitvā paṃcaratnaphalapallavataṇḍulān ।
vastraṃ sthālīṃ tilayuktāṃ sugandhaṃ candanādikam । । 1 re । ।
vinyasyettu kalaśeṣu mūrtiṃ trivikramasya ca ।
padmākṣyā nirjalayā ca sahitāṃ kanakodbhavām । । 1 4। ।
pūjayed vidhinā bhakto vratārthaṃ ca vicārayet ।
karomi pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇa nirjalāvratasiddhaye । । 1 '9 । ।
kṛpayā paripūrṇaṃ te jāyatāṃ sarvakāmadam ।
ityabhyarthya tataḥ kṛṣṇāvatāraṃ gaṇanāyakam । । 16 । ।
pūjayed dūrvayā sindūrā'gurucandanā'kṣataiḥ ।
modakānarpayet paścāt trivikramaṃ samarcayet। । । 17 ।।
āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtaiśca gobhavaiḥ ।
śuddhodakena saugandhayuktena snapayeddharim ।। 1 8। ।
arpayecchuklavastrāṇi brahmasūtrādikāni ca ।
mukuṭā''bhūṣaṇādīni hārakeyūrakāṇi ca ।। 19 । ।
sugandhitailadravyādikajjalālaktakānyapi ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlakāni ca । । 1.251.20 । ।
ārārtrikastutipradakṣiṇāprakramaṇāni ca ।
kṣamāyācanakusumāṃjalivisarjanāni ca । । 21 । ।
evaṃ sarvavidhānena śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayed vratī ।
tataḥ kuryāt svakaṃ kāryaṃ madhyāhne'pi tathā''caret ।। 22 । ।
śrīkhaṇḍasāraṃ naivedye pūrikā tvāmrasadrasam ।
jalaṃ śītaṃ śarkarailāsugandhaṃ bhāvagarbhitam । । 23 ।।
dadyād devāya tu paścāt sāyaṃ dolādhirohaṇam ।
kārayecchrīhariṃ puṣpodyāne druvāṭikābhuvi ।। 24।।।
jalasiktaśītalārdraśādvale mṛdulasthale ।
vihārayeddhariṃ sāyaṃ śītavāyuprasevite । । 25 ।।
niśi tvārārtrikaṃ kuryāt stutyādyaṃ ca yathākramam ।
takraṃ ca taralā dadyānnaivedye saghṛtāṃ śubhām । । 26 ।।
pānīyaṃ miṣṭasāraṃ ca dadyātpānārthamuttamam ।
mukhaśuddhikaraṃ dravyaṃ pradadyācchayanaṃ śubham ।। 27।।
bhakto jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmilitvā'nekasātvataiḥ ।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ natvā pūjayitvā tataḥ param ।। 28 ।।
anyānpūjyān bhojayitvā kuryādvai jalapāraṇām ।
tato vratī prakuryāttu bhojanaṃ haraye'rpitam ।।29।।
dānāni vividhānyeva dadyātsatphalalabdhaye ।
nṛpo dadyādgajādīṃśca ratnāni nagarāṇi ca ।। 1.251.30 ।।
vipro dadyātpustakādi vaiśyo dhānyadhanāni ca ।
śūdro dadyātkalālabhyavastūni nūtanāni tu ।। 31 ।।
sarvo dadyād yathāśakti yatsvāgre deyamasti tat ।
gavāṃ dānaṃ ca bhūdānaṃ dānānyanyāni cācaret ।। 32।।
yad yasyāgre svakaṃ sthāttatsatpātrāyā'rpayed vratī ।
brahmaṇe tvarpayāmīti matvā dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe ।। 33 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇāyaiva dadyācchrīgurave tathā ।
anāthāya daridrāya dadyāccāpyasahāyine ।। 34।।
nāryai dadyādvidhavāyai hyanāthāyai tathā'rpayet ।
bālakebhyo bālikābhyaḥ pradadyāccharkarādikam ।। 35।।
bhikṣāṃ sadbhyaśca sādhvībhyo dadyādvratī ghṛtānvitām ।
miṣṭānnāni tathā'nyāni bhojyānyapi samarpayet ।। 36।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhakto yāti svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।
vratametatsukhopāyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ mahāphalam ।। 37।।
alpakleśaṃ svalpavastusādhyaṃ yacchraddhayā bhavet ।
api pāpadurācārāḥ pāpiṣṭhā dharmavarjitāḥ ।। 38 ।।
nirjalāyāṃ na bhuṃjanti no pibanti jalādikam ।
harerbhaktiṃ prakurvanti na te yānti yamāntikam ।। 39 ।।
śṛṇu vratakathāṃ tvasyā yā'bhūtpūrve kṛte yuge ।
brahmaṇā bhavanaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ yugādime ।। 1.251.40 ।।
prathame tu dine tatra satyayuge ṛṣiḥ kratuḥ ।
agnimukhaḥ kratuḥ putro vedhaso bahubhojyabhūt ।।41 ।।
yadyad bhakṣayati prāptaṃ bhasmībhavati tatkṣaṇe ।
samakāle sahasrāṇi lakṣāṇi bhojanānyapi ।। 42।।
asīmāni pradattāni bhuṃkte drāgeva caikalaḥ ।
jīryanti tāni sarvāṇi ghaṭikānte bubhukṣitaḥ ।।43 ।।
jāṭharāgnikṛtadāvānalavyāpto bhavatyapi ।
samicchatyatibhojyāni nāpyante tu yadā tadā ।।44।।
vanaṃ himālayāraṇyaṃ mervaraṇyaṃ mahattamam ।
gacchatyeva ca tatratyaṃ sarvaṃ khādatyaharniśam ।।45।।
jalārthaṃ tu kṣīramiṣṭasāgare tu patatyayam ।
pānīyaṃ pibati yāvat tṛptirbhavati tattathā ।। 46 । ।
evaṃ tu gamyamānāyāṃ yātrāyāṃ varṣmaṇaḥ kratuḥ ।
kvacitpurukṣudhāviṣṭo brahmāṇaṃ saṃjagāma ha ।।47।।
prārthayaccā''tṛptibhakṣyaṃ nityaṃ me prāpyatāmiti ।
brahmā prāha kratuṃ putra tṛptiṃ tubhyaṃ dadāmyaham ।। 48 । ।
yaḥ kopi cetanastubhyaṃ yajamānasvarūpakaḥ ।
yajñe dāsyati yāvatyā bhakṣyaṃ bhāvanayā'tulam ।।49 ।।
tāvatī te kṣudhā tatra jāyatāṃ pācanāya vai ।
bhāvanāyā abhāve tu kṣudhānāśopi te bhavet । । 1.251.5 0 ।।
tṛptistu tatra bhavatu yathābhāvanameva te ।
ita ārabhya putra tvāṃ kṣudhā bādhiṣyate nahi ।।5 1 ।।
yathā hotaḥ prāgbabādhe tathā bādhiṣyate nahi ।
kintu kratusvarūpāya havirdāsyanti te'dhikam । । 52 ।।
bahubhiḥ samakāle te hyapathyaṃ mā tadā bhavet ।
itihetoḥ kṣudhā te vai svecchayā saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 53 ।।
kaściddāsyati yāvatte tāvatte'stu tadā kṣudhā ।
na dāsyati tadā kṣutte śamiṣyatīti sarvadā ।।54। ।
sukhī bhava krato putra mā jihvālolyamīyatām ।
sa kraturbrahmaṇā''śīrbhiryojito niryayau tataḥ ।। 55 ।।
sa tvagnihotriṇāṃ nityā''vāseṣūvāsa śāntahṛt ।
bhakṣayatyaniśaṃ tvagnau hotṝṇāṃ homakarmasu ।। 56 । ।
havyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ prātarmadhye sāyaṃ ca naityakam ।
bhuktvā bhuktvā kṣudhā tvasya nityamāhāramicchati ।। 57। ।
ityabhyāsavaśāttasya trivāraṃ bhojanaṃ dhruvam ।
tato'pyadhikakālaṃ vā kartavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam । । ।58 ।।
evaṃ sa bhojanābhyāsāt kāle kāle samicchati ।
bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ havyaṃ hyadattaṃ dattameva vā ।।5 9 ।।
jihvālaulyād bhojanecchā jāyate tu muhurmuhuḥ ।
svecchayā ca kṣudhā tvasya vardhate bahuveginī । । 1.251.60 ।।
evaṃ kratoḥ sthitau dakṣamarīcyādyā maharṣayaḥ ।
yayurbadarikāraṇyaṃ draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ naram ।। 61 ।।
mandākinyāṃ ca te snātvā dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
niṣīduḥ śrīharestatra sānnidhye badarīvane । । 62 ।।
rūpābhirūpāvayavaṃ himagrāvasamojjvalam ।
brahmavratasvarūpaṃ ca tapomūrtiṃ pareśvaram । । 63 ।।
bhṛgurnatvā hariṃ smṛtvā papraccha parameśvaram ।
dīnabandho kṛpāsindho baddhoddhārakara prabho । । 6 4। ।
namāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptāstvāṃ hṛtsthaṃ ca bahiḥsthitam ।
vadā'smān saralaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhuktipramuktidam ।।61।।
vrataṃ yenā'nnajā doṣā naśyeyuḥ sarvatomukhāḥ ।
parānnajāstathā śuddhirahitānnasamudbhavāḥ ।।66।।
sūtakānnakṛtāścāpi saṃsṛṣṭānnagrahodbhavāḥ ।
bhikṣānnajāstathā paryuṣitānnodbhavitāśca ye ।।67।।
te naśyeyuryathā doṣā jñānā'jñānakṛtāḥ prabho ।
anarpitānnajā doṣāḥ svārthapaṃktiprabhedajāḥ ।।68।।
te doṣā yena naśyeyustādṛśaṃ brūhi sattapaḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ śrīhariḥ prāha śṛṇuta brāhmaṇottamāḥ ।।69।।
vrataṃ vratottamaṃ tvekādaśyā matamupoṣaṇam ।
tapastapaḥpradhānaṃ ca pāpasaṃhārakārakam ।।1.251.70।।
annāśritānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śodhakaṃ param ।
saralaṃ sulabhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vrataṃ sarvaphalapradam ।।7 1।।
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṃjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi ।
sūtake'pi na bhoktavyaṃ nā''śauce'pi maharṣayaḥ! ।।72।।
yāvajjīvaṃ vratametatkartavyaṃ śreya icchatā ।
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ vāñcchatā'pi kartavyaṃ tad vrataṃ śubham ।।73।।
annāśritā'saṃkhyadoṣā vratakarturbhavanti na ।
ekādaśyā avratānāṃ mokṣo naiva ca naiva ca ।।74।।
api vāpadurācārāḥ pāpiṣṭhā dharmavarjitāḥ ।
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṃjanti na te yānti yamāntikam ।।75।।
ekādaśyāṃ tu bhoktāro'nnādā yānti yamālayam ।
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kampito hṛdayāmbuje ।।76।।
kratuḥ prāha mahābhakṣyo naranārāyaṇaṃ prati ।
bhagavannaiva śakto'smi bubhukṣā duḥsahā mama ।।77।।
prātarme bhojanā'labdhau madhyāhne maraṇaṃ bhavet ।
nā'haṃ kṣudhāṃ samartho'smi soḍhuṃ vai kālapaṃcake ।।78।।
prātardevamukhairadmi pūrvāhṇe'gnimukhena ca ।
madhyāhne cāparāhṇe cā'tithibhikṣukasanmukhaiḥ ।।79।।
sāyaṃ sarvamukhairadmi rātrau sthāvarajaṃgamaiḥ ।
evaṃ vai bhojanaṃ me'sti sarvathā parinirmitam ।।1.251.80।।
kṣudhāpi bādhate yāvadabhyāsasamaye'nvaham ।
tasmād dānāni dāsyāmi pūjayiṣyāmi keśavam ।।8 1 ।।
anyatpuṇyaṃ kariṣyāmi na kariṣyāmyupoṣaṇam ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau prāha nārāyaṇastadā ।।।82।।
yadi svargo'styabhīṣṭaste narako neṣyate tvayā ।
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi ।।83।।
kratuḥ prāha hariṃ nātha tathyaṃ vacmi tavā'grataḥ ।
ekabhukte na śakto'smi tūpavāse kutaḥ kṣamaḥ ।।84।।
kro nāmā tvanalaḥ saptajihvastudati jāṭharaḥ ।
nāmnā bhavāmi lakṣmīśa! kratureva yathārthataḥ ।।85।।
kraḥ krūraḥ sa mahānagnirativelaṃ ca bhojanam ।
atisnigdhaṃ yadā'śnāmi tadā so'pi praśāmyati ।।86।।
sarvāsāmupavāse tu mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।
tasmātkuru kṛpāṃ kṛṣṇa kartuṃ śaknomyahaṃ yathā ।।87।।
yenaiva prāpyate svargastatkartā'smi tavā''jñayā ।
mokṣaścāpi bhavedyena tadekaṃ vada matkṛte ।।88।।
yadahaṃ sugamaṃ kurve yena śreyo'hamāpnuyām ।
śrutvā nārāyaṇastasya dayālurbhaktavatsalaḥ ।।89।।
prāha yogyaṃ vicāryaiva tādṛśānāṃ kṛte vratam ।
vṛṣasthe mithunasthe'rke yadā tvekādaśī bhavet ।। 1.251.90।।
jyeṣṭhamāse prayatnena sopoṣyā jalavarjitā ।
gaṇḍūṣācamanaṃ vāriṃ varjayitvā jalaṃ param ।।91 ।।
upabhuṃjīta naivātra nirjalā sā kṛtā bhavet ।
nirjalāyāṃ jale graste vrataṃ nyūnabalaṃ bhavet ।।92।।
udayādudayaṃ yāvad varjayitvā jalaṃ vratī ।
dvādaśaikādaśyupoṣaṇotthaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt ।।93।।
vrataṃ tu nirjalaṃ devārcanayuktaṃ sajāgaram ।
kṛtvā prātardvādaśyāṃ ca jalasnānaṃ prapūjanam ।।94।।
sajalaṃ sasuvarṇaṃ ca ghaṭaṃ datvā dvijātaye ।
annadānāni datvā ca bhuṃjīta pāraṇāṃ svakaiḥ ।। 95।।
sādhūn sādhvīrbālikāśca bālān sabhojayed vratī ।
saṃvatsaraikādaśīnāṃ phalaṃ vai vratino bhavet ।।।96।।
sarvānvādānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet ।
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ sarvapāpāt pramucyate ।।97।।
ekādaśyāṃ na bhuṃjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi ।
tatrāpi jyeṣṭhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ vai nirjalo bhavet ।।98।।
ekasyā api puṇyaṃ saṃvatsaraikādaśībhavam ।
upoṣitā hi sarvāḥ syurekādaśyaḥ sitā'sitāḥ ।।99। ।
dhanadhānyapradā tveṣā putrārogyādisampradā ।
upoṣitā manovāñchitārthalābhapradā śubhā ।। 1.251.100 ।।
yamadūtā mahākāyāḥ karālā vikaṭānanāḥ ।
daṇḍapāśadharāḥ krūrā vratīnaṃ nābhiyanti hi । । 101 ।।
pītāmbaradharāḥ saumyāścakrahastā manojavāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ saṃnayantyenaṃ hyante purīṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm ।। 1 02।।
tasmātsarvaprayatnena krato tvaṃ tāṃ samācara ।
nirjalāṃ śraddhayā putra vidhehyadbhirvivarjitām ।। 1 02। ।
tena te jāṭharastīvro niyamastho bhaviṣyati ।
utsāhena prakartavyā sā'vadhānena nirjalā ।। 1 04। ।
svapne'nnabhakṣaṇaṃ vāripānaṃ vā jāyate yadi ।
tadā me hyaparādho na vratabhaṃgo'tra mā'stu me ।। 1 05। ।
svapnadoṣe'pi me nātha vratabhaṃgo hi mā'stu me ।
nidrālasyanimitte'pi vratabhaṃgo'pi mā'stu me ।। 106 । ।
bhokṣye pare'hni deveśa hyaśanaṃ vāsarāddhareḥ ।
ityabhyarthya hariṃ kṛṣṇamupavāsaparo bhavet ।। 1 07। ।
merulokālokatulyaṃ striyā puṃsā ca yatkṛtam ।
sarvaṃ tadbhasmatāṃ yāti pāpamekādaśībalāt ।। 1 08।।
jaladhenuḥ pradātavyā dvādaśīpāraṇādine ।
sakāṃcanaḥ pradātavyo sughaṭo jalasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 109।।
jalaṃ naiva hi pātavyaṃ hyasyāṃ yo niyamaṃ caret ।
phalaṃ koṭisuvarṇānāṃ yāme yāme bhavettadā ।। 1.251.110 ।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ karoti svalpakaṃ vratī ।
tatsarvaṃ śāśvataṃ puṇyaṃ dadātyacyutavāgbalāt ।। 11 1। ।
kimanyena tu kṛtyena nirjalaikādaśī vinā ।
suvarṇamannaṃ vāso vā yadasyāṃ saṃpradīyate । । 1 12।।
yo nirjalaṃ tūpavaset vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma yāti saḥ ।
yena yena kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ cāpyakṣayaṃ bhavet । । 1 13।।
ye tu dāsyanti dānāni dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇādine ।
jyeṣṭhe site vratinaste prāpsyanti paramaṃ padam । । 1 14। ।
brahmaghno madyapaścauro gurudveṣī vyavāyakṛt ।
mucyante pātakairete yadi dvādaśyupoṣitā । । 115। ।
krato śṛṇu viśeṣaṃ tvaṃ nirjalaikādaśīdine ।
śraddhāyuktanarastrībhirjalaśāyī hariḥ svayam । । 1 16।।
pūjanīyastathā deyā dhenurjalamayī tadā ।
pratyakṣā vā savatsā vā deyā muktipradā bhavet ।। 1 17।।
śreṣṭhābhirdakṣiṇābhiśca miṣṭānnaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ।
toṣaṇīyā dvijāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo bālāśca bālikāḥ ।। 1 18।।
teṣu tuṣṭeṣu kṛṣṇo'haṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmi mokṣadaḥ ।
yairna vrataṃ kṛtaṃ tvasyā ātmaghnāste na saṃśayaḥ ।। 119 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ dine yo'nnaṃ bhuṃjate'ghabhujo hi te ।
pāpātmāno durācārā muṣṭāste nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 1.251.120 ।।
śāntairdāntairdānaparairarcayadbhistathā harim ।
kurvadbhirjāgaraṃ rātrau yaireṣā samupoṣitā ।। 121 ।।
kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi hyatītānāṃ tathā śatam ।
ātmanā saha tairnītaṃ vāsudevasya mandiram ।। 1 22।।
annaṃ gāvo mahiṣyaśca vastraṃ śayyāsanaṃ jalam ।
daṇḍaḥ kamaṇḍaluśchatraṃ pātraṃ svarṇaṃ tilādikam ।। 123।।
upānahau tathā'nyadvā kiṃcitpātre dadāti yaḥ ।
sa sauvarṇena yānena svargaloke mahīyate ।। 124।।
niyamena tu kartavyaṃ vrataṃ nirjalameva hi ।
dvādaśyāṃ devadeveśaḥ pūjanīyastrivikramaḥ ।। 125।।
saśarkarā jalakuṃbhā dātavyā viṣṇusannidhau ।
bhojayitvā tato viprān svayaṃ bhuṃjīta pāraṇām ।। 126 ।।
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pūrṇāṃ dvādaśīṃ pāpanāśinīm ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam ।। 127।।
śrutvā natvā kratuḥ svasyāśramaṃ yāto mudānvitaḥ ।
vrataṃ cakāra vidhivannirjalāyā dine tu saḥ ।। 128।।
phalaṃ tu prāptavānsarvaṃ tathā'nyo'pi kariṣyati ।
prāpsyatyeṣaścaturviṃśatyekādaśīkṛtaṃ phalam ।। 129।।
yaścemāṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā yaścāpi parikīrtayet ।
ubhau tau dyāmāpnuyātāṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।। 1.251.130।।
yatphalaṃ tu sinīvālyāṃ rāhugraste divākare ।
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā japedyattat syādasyāḥ śravaṇādapi ।। 13 1।।
paṭhanātpāṭhanāccāpi vratatulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ।
vratāttu śāśvataṃ svargaṃ muktiśca śāśvatī bhavet ।। 1 32।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāryāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jyeṣṭhaśuklanirjalaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ bubhukṣitasya kratorvratena sopākhyāna kṣudhāśāntyādi phala-
prāptyādicetinirūpaṇanāmaikapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 251 ।।
