adhyāyaḥ 252
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 253 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kṛpāsindho sadā''lasyānvitānāṃ bhavapārakṛt ।
tāritā vai tvayā nātha nirjalāvratavarṇanāt ।। 1 ।।
yena muktiṃ tathā bhuktiṃ sarvaikādaśikāphalam ।
vratinaḥ prāpnuvantyatra kāraṇaṃ karuṇā tava ।। 2 ।।
saṃkalpastava jīvānāṃ kathaṃcidvai bhavedyathā ।
niḥśreyaḥ paramaṃ yadvā mokṣo vā svargameva vā ।। 3 ।।
jananīvadrakṣaṇaṃ syād bhavasāgaravāridheḥ ।
tathā tvaṃ yatase nātha kṛpā kevalakāraṇam ।। 4 ।।
vada me'ṣāḍhakṛṣṇaikādaśyā vrataphalaṃ vidhim ।
devaṃ pūjāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ kṛpālo dānamityapi ।। '9 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
aṣāḍhakṛṣṇapakṣīyā yoginīsaṃjñikā matā ।
kṣemaṃkaryā sahā'trā'rcyo nṛsiṃhākhyo hariḥ prabhuḥ ।। 6 ।।
bhṛṃgarājo'tra puṣpeṣu tathā'rghye jāmbavaṃ phalam ।
naivedye piṇḍakā deyā dāne tu jalagaurmatā ।। 7 ।
viśeṣo'yaṃ vidhiḥ proktaḥ kāryaṃ vrataṃ vratottamam ।
sarvapāpakṣayakṛcca sarvabhuktipradāyakam ।। 8 ।।
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ potarūpaṃ sanātanam ।
jagattraye sārabhūtaṃ yoginīvratamuttamam ।। 9 ।।
daśamyāmekabhaktena naktena vratinā khalu ।
bhūśāyinā vartitavyaṃ brahmacaryādinā tathā ।। 1.252.10।।
ekādaśyāṃ vratī prātarutthāya śrīhariṃ smaret ।
dhyātvā snātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।। 1 1।।
prārthayed bhagavan kṛṣṇa yoginyā vratamuttamam ।
karomyadya tu nirvighnaṃ sampūrṇaphaladaṃ bhavet ।। 12।।
kṛpayā tava bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara mādhava ।
ityabhyarthya tato dhānyaiḥ kārayet sarvataḥ śubham ।। 13।।
maṇḍalaṃ raṃgacitrādiśobhitaṃ maṇḍalāntare ।
madhye saṃsthāpayetsvarṇakalaśaṃ ratnagarbhitam ।। 14।।
phalapallavayuktaṃ ca jalavastrasamanvitam ।
candanākṣatasatkuṃkumā'rcitaṃ navadhātujam ।। 15।।
śaṃkhaṃ ca pūjayettatra ghaṇṭāṃ prapūjayettathā ।
śālagrāmaṃ pūjayecca gaṇeśaṃ pūjayettathā ।। 16।।
pūjādravyaiḥ pūjayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ narasiṃhakam ।
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā svarṇanirmitamūrtikam ।। 17।।
tilasthālyāṃ sthāpayitvā pūjayedakṣatādibhiḥ ।
āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtaiḥ sugandhicandanaiḥ ।। 18।।
sadvastraiśca vibhūṣābhiḥ śṛṃgāradravamardanaiḥ ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlavāribhiḥ ।। 19।।
ārārtrikastutipuṣpāṃjalyādibhiḥ samarcayet ।
kṣamāparādhaṃ tvabhyarthya svakāryaṃ cet kriyāt tataḥ ।।1.252.2 0।।
madhyāhnepi sunaivedyaṃ tvāmrarasaśrīkhaṇḍakam ।
śītalaṃ madhuraṃ vāri pūrikā dadhi śarkarām ।।21 ।।
āranālaṃ ca kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍapākaṃpayorasam ।
bhojayenmukhavāsaṃ ca pūgīphalaṃ ca vīṭikām ।।22।।
dadyātsāyaṃ tathā saumyaṃ kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ navam ।
tatra dolāṃ bandhayitvā sthāpayitvā hariṃ tataḥ ।।23 ।।
āndolayetsamudyāne vihārayeditastataḥ ।
śādvale śītale bhāge viśramayejjanārdanam ।।24।।
pūjayed vividhaiḥ śreṣṭhairvastubhiśca tataḥ param ।
nīrājayennarasiṃhaṃ stutiṃ kuryācca saiṃhikīm ।। 25।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛsiṃhapadagāyanaiḥ ।
prātarutsāhapūrvaṃ taṃ dhyātvā snātvā prapūjayet। ।। 26 ।।
vidhivadvastubhiḥ sarvairnivedya miṣṭamiṣṭakam ।
jalaṃ dadyāttato bhaktaḥ kuryādvai pāraṇāṃ śubhām ।। 27।।
jaladānaṃ jaladhenuṃ svarṇadhenuṃ ghṛtādikam ।
dadhi dugdhaṃ navanītaṃ śarkarāṃ gūḍamityapi ।।28 ।।
dadyād dānaṃ supātrāya yānaṃ vāhanamarthakam ।
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād ghaṭaṃ mūrtiṃ harestathā ।।29।।
miṣṭānnāni tathānyāni dāpayet sadbhya eva ca ।
gṛhakṣetrapaśūdyānadāsadānāni kārayet ।। 1.252.3 0।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhakto yoginyā_ śraddhayā yutaḥ ।
yogilabhyaṃ phalaṃ svargyaṃ kaivalyaṃ cāpi saṃlaset ।। 31 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ ramyāṃ daivīṃ pāpavināśinīm ।
alakāyāṃ nagaryāṃ vai kuberaḥ śivabhaktimān ।। 32।।
yadā śaṃbhoḥ prapūjāyāṃ vartate tu tadā sadā ।
svānucaro mahāyakṣo hemamālīti nāmataḥ ।। 33 ।।
samānayati puṣpāṇi pārśvodyānabhavāni vai ।
evaṃ nityaṃ śaṃkarasya pūjopakaraṇāni saḥ ।। 34।।
upasthāpayati tatra sadā kuberasannidhau ।
sa kintu yauvanodbhedāt kāmapūreṇa saṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 35।।
svapatnyā tu viśālākṣyā saha kāme viśeṣataḥ ।
kāmabāṇena cākṛṣṭo vartate divase'pi ca ।। 36।।
kāryaṃ cāpi parityajya kāmanāyāṃ pravartate ।
evaṃ cātīva kāmārthī patnyā saha kvacitkvacit ।। 37।।
kusumādīni cānetuṃ gacchatyeva drumādiṣu ।
ekadā tu kubereṇa mānasākhyasaraḥ prati ।।38 ।।
preṣito hemamālī saḥ kamalānayanāya vai ।
so'pi nūtnaṃ saro ramyaṃ dṛśyārhaṃ tvabhimatya ca ।। 39 ।।
patnyā saha gatastatrā''netuṃ su kamalāni tu ।
jalaṃ ca śādvalaṃ sūkṣmavālukācākacakyatām ।।1.252.40 ।।
ramaṇīyapradeśaṃ ca sugandhikusumādikam ।
rājasaṃ vividhaṃ bhāvaṃ vihārakṣobhakārakam ।।4 1 ।।
dṛṣṭvā vikṛtimāyāto visṛjya kusumāni ca ।
patnyā saha tadā reme mānase tu sarovare ।।42।।
patnyā muhurdhṛtaḥ kāme saṃsakto na nivartate ।
tṛptāpi tu punaḥ patnī pravṛttā na nivartate ।।43।।
evaṃ parasparaṃ prāptau kāmabhāvau viśeṣataḥ ।
punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttau tau vividaturna mohitau ।।44।।
kālātikramaṇaṃ jātaṃ pūjāyāśca tathāpi tau ।
puṣpāṇyādāya nā''yātau kubero'pi pratīkṣate ।।45।।
kāmapremarasāsaktau na kuberālayaṃ gatau ।
kubero devasadane karoti śivapūjanam ।।46 ।।
prātaḥ kālo vyatītaśca madhyāhnasamaye tataḥ ।
kuberaḥ pūjanārthaṃ tu puṣpāgamasamīkṣakaḥ ।।47।।
cintayāmāsa vighnaṃ vai yato nāyāti yakṣakaḥ ।
dvitīyo yakṣakastatra preṣito'nveṣaṇāya yat ।।48।।
sa gatvā ramamāṇaṃ taṃ dadarśa hemamālinam ।
hemamālī tu salile ramate kāntayā saha ।।49।।
preṣyastau prāha puṣpāṇi sa kāṃkṣati kuberarāṭ ।
śīghraṃ vai tatra gantavyaṃ madhyāhne pūjanaṃ bhavet ।।1.252.50।।
iti kṛtvā gatau puṣpāṇyādāya rājarājakam ।
kuberaṃ tau tato natvā yayācāte kṣamāṃ muhuḥ ।।5 1।।
yakṣarāṭ pratyuvācā'tha kālātikramakopitaḥ ।
vanitākāmukaṃ jñātvā ramamāṇaṃ nijecchayā ।।52।।
āḥ pāpa duṣṭa durvṛtta kāmāsaktatayā tvayā ।
anādāya tu puṣpāṇi kṛtaṃ vai devahelanam ।।।5 3 ।।
kāmabhogo mahān vighnaḥ sa ca doṣo mahānmataḥ ।
daṇḍastatra pradātavyo na kartavyā mayā kṛpā ।।54।।
bhavāṣṭādaśakuṣṭhī tvaṃ viyukto kāntayā tayā ।
asmātsthānādapadhvasto gacchasvā'dhama bhūtalam ।।55।।
ityukte vacane yakṣastasmātsthānātpapāta ha ।
mahāduḥkhābhibhūtaśca kuṣṭhaiścitritavigrahaḥ ।।56।।
galatkuṣṭhaḥ śvetakuṣṭho raktakuṣṭho'bhavattadā ।
carmakuṣṭho lalatkuṣṭho durgandhapūyakuṣṭhakaḥ ।।।57।
evaṃ jātaḥ śarīre sa hemamālī svakarmaṇā ।
divā sukhaṃ na labhate na nidrāṃ labhate niśi ।।58।।
chāyāyāṃ vā nidāghe vā gṛhe kuṃje ca gahvare ।
kuṭyāṃ bhūmau latāmadhye labhate na sukhaṃ kvacit ।।।59।।
dāhena pīḍyate cāti kharjanena jvalatyapi ।
pātakenābhibhūtopi pūrvakarma smaratyasau ।।1.252.60।।
śivārpitasu puṣpādiphalaprābalyato nanu ।
patitasyā'bhibhūtasya smṛtistasya na lupyati ।।61।।
himālaye mahāraṇye ghorarūpa itastataḥ ।
bhramamāṇo yayau devān mārkaḍeyāśramaṃ śubham ।।62।।।
taponidhiṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ brahmadhyānaparāyaṇam ।
yasyā''yurvidyate lakṣmi! brahmaṇo dinasaptakam ।।63।।।
vavande caraṇau tasya dūrataḥ kuṣṭhavigrahaḥ ।
mārkaṃḍeyo dayāṃ kṛtvā kampitaṃ duṣṭavigraham ।।64।।
paropakaraṇārthāya samāhūyedamabravīt ।
kasmātkuṣṭhābhibhūtastvaṃ kuto nindyatamo hyasi ।।65।।
śrutvā prāha tadā sopi muniṃ pāpavināśakam ।
rājarājasyānucaro hemamālīti nāmataḥ ।।66।।
udyānātpadmanicayaṃ tvānīya pratyahaṃ mune ।
śivapūjanavelāyāṃ kuberāya samārpayam ।।67।।
ekasmindivase patnyā sahito'haṃ kṛpālunā ।
saṃpreṣitaḥ kubereṇa tvānetuṃ kamalāni hi ।।68।।
atisugandhicitrāṇi mānasākhyasarovaram ।
dṛṣṭvā tu nūtanaṃ ramyaṃ bhūtalaṃ sajalaṃ śubham ।।69।।
kāmasukhaprasaktābhyāṃ kālaścā'vidito gataḥ ।
puṣpaṃ vinā śivapūjā prātarjātā tato hyaham ।।1.252.70।।
atikruddhena śapto'smi rājarājena vai mune ।
kuṣṭhābhibhūtaḥ saṃjāto viyuktaḥ kāntayā tayā ।।7 1।।
bhramamāṇo'tra sānnidhye prāptohaṃ me śubhaṃ kuru ।
satāṃ svabhāvataścittaṃ paropakaraṇe kṣamam ।।72।।
iti madarthaṃ bhagavan kuru saukhyaṃ bhaved yathā ।
śrutvā tathyaṃ tadovāca mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ।।73।।
śṛṇu vratopadeśaṃ te kathayāmi śubhapradam ।
āṣāḍhe kṛṣṇapakṣasyaikādaśīvratamācara ।।74।।
yoginīvratapuṇyena kuṣṭhaṃ yāsyati vai dhruvam ।
punaḥ prāpsyasi patnīṃ tvaṃ lapsyase śāśvataṃ sukham ।।75।।।
itivākyamṛṣeḥ śrutvā daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi ।
āśīrbhirvardhitastena babhūvā'tīva harṣitaḥ ।।76।।
yoginyekādaśīṃ cakre vratī tvāśramasannidhau ।
mārkaṃḍeyasya kṛṣṇasya pūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।।77।।
munervacanataḥ samyag vrate cīrṇe'bhavatsukhī ।
aṣṭādaśaiva kuṣṭhāni tanau naṣṭāni sarvathā ।।78।।
gato natvā svakaṃ lokaṃ yakṣo bhūtvā yathāyatham ।
labdhvā patnīṃ punastvevā'lakāyāṃ nyavasatsukham ।।79।।।
evaṃ śāpanivṛttirvai yoginīvratato bhavet ।
kuṣṭhādiroganāśaśca patnī naṣṭāpi labhyate ।।1.252.8 0।।
lokaḥ sthānaṃ gṛhaṃ smṛddhirnaṣṭaṃ vai prāpyate punaḥ ।
yoginyā vratapuṇyena yogalabhyaṃ lased vratī ।।8 1 ।।
idṛgvidhaṃ mahālakṣmi! kathitaṃ yoginīvratam ।
nāryā bhūtvā tu yoginyā yoginā tu nareṇa ca ।।82।।।
kartavyaṃ yogaphaladaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ vratam ।
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi sādhūn bhojayate tu yaḥ ।।83।।
tatsamaṃ phalamāpnoti yoginyā vratavānnaraḥ ।
yogābhyāsaphaladātrī yogilokapradāyinī ।।84।।
kṛṣṇayogānmokṣadātrī hyupoṣyā yoginītithiḥ ।
paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsyāḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ।।85।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āṣāḍhakṛṣṇayoginyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ hemamāliyakṣasya kuberaśāpena jātakuṣṭhādirogasya vratakaraṇena nāśa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvipaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 252 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 252 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 253
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 254 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kālo māyā tathā''tmānaḥ śaktayaḥ santi yasya tāḥ ।
namastasmai bhagavate śaktisvāmiparātmane ।। 1 ।।
yoginīphaladātre te yogapuṇyaphalātmane ।
yogilabhyāya yogāya yoginīpataye namaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tvameva phaladātā'si tvamevā'si ca muktikṛt ।
tvamevā'dhipatiścāsi namastasmai mahātmane ।। 3 ।।
sarvadevasvarūpastvaṃ sarvatīrthātmako'si ca ।
sarvavratātmakastvaṃ vai tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ ।। 4 ।।
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet ।
ko devaḥ ko vidhistvasyāḥ phalaṃ dānaṃ ca me vada ।। 5 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kathayāmi mahāpuṇyāṃ svargamokṣapradāyinīm ।
śayanīṃ nāma nāmnā tu sarvapāpavināśinīm ।। 6 ।।
niyamāṃ bhāmikāṃ cāpi tāmeva viddhi nāmataḥ ।
yasyā vratena pāpātmā pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ।। 7 ।।
yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet ।
ataḥ parā na cānyāsti svargamokṣapradā śubhā ।। 8 ।।
asyāstvadhipatirdevo vāmano'sti haristataḥ ।
kamalākhyapriyāyuktaḥ pūjanīyo hi vāmanaḥ ।। 9 ।।
vāmanaḥ pūjito yena kamalaiḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ ।
niyamākhyaśayanyāṃ tu tenārcitaṃ jagattrayam ।। 1.253.1 0।।
trayo devāḥ pūjitāśca pūjitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।
kṛtā tvekādaśī yena harivāsara uttamaḥ ।। 11 ।।
āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ śete kṣīranidhau hariḥ ।
sarvendriyapravāhāँstu parāvṛtyātiyogataḥ ।। 12 ।।
tasya pūjā tvapāmārgaiḥ pūrikādinivedanaiḥ ।
nālikerīphalādyaiśca svarṇagodānapūrvikā ।। 13 ।।
kartavyā vratinā bhaktyā niyamagrahaṇaṃ tathā ।
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi! kathā puṇyapradāyinī ।। 14।।
balirvai dānavaḥ pūrvamāsīt tretāyuge priye ।
pūjayaँścaiva māṃ nityaṃ madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ ।। 15।।
yajñaistu bahubhirdaityo vidhinā yajati sma mām ।
parayā snehasadbhaktyā vratopoṣaṇapūjanaiḥ ।। 16।।
evaṃ puṇyaprabhāveṇa mamopāsanayā tathā ।
rasātalātsamāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sa nṛpo'bhavat ।। 17।।
pṛthvyāṃ cāpi mama pūjābalena vardhito'bhavat ।
svargaṃ tenaiva dehena yayau puṇyaprabhāvataḥ ।। 18।।
kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vaśe svasya svargabhūlokasaṃyutam ।
indrādayo'pi tasyā'gre tvabhavannirbalāḥ surāḥ ।। 19।।
dānavā vardhitāḥ puṣṭāstrilokyāmabhavannṛpāḥ ।
indrādibhistadā devairarthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।1.253.20।
hariḥ śaṃbhustathā brahmā taistu yuktiḥ parā kṛtā ।
baliḥ karotu yajñaṃ ca dātā bhavatu cādhvare ।। 21 ।।
bhūtvā tu bhikṣukaḥ kṛṣṇo mahībhikṣāṃ karotu saḥ ।
evaṃ tu samayaṃ kṛtvā yajñārthaṃ prairayad balim ।।22।।
ṛṣayo munayo devā hyahaṃ sarve gatāḥ kṛtau ।
revatācalasānnidhye yatra yajñaḥ pravartate ।।।23।।
tatra vāmanarūpeṇa hyavatāre hi paṃcame ।
atimahatsvarūpeṇa sarvabrahmāṇḍayoginā ।।24।।
vākchalena jito dātā satyamāśritya yaḥ sthitaḥ ।
śukrastaṃ vārayāmāsa yannārāyaṇa ityaham ।।25।।।
yācitā vasudhā lakṣmi mayā sārdhapadatrayā ।
saṃkalpodakamātre tu kare tenaiva cārpite ।।।26।।।
rūpaṃ brahmāṇḍapūrṇaṃ vai tadā lakṣmi mayā kṛtam ।
bhūrloke caraṇau nyasya bhuvarloke tu jānunī ।।27।।
svarloke tu kaṭiṃ kṛtvā maharloke tadodaram ।
janaloke tu hṛdayaṃ tapoloke galaṃ tathā ।।।28।।
satyaloke mukhaṃ nyasya vairāje mastakaṃ nyadhām ।
sūryacandragrahatārā nakṣatradhūmraketavaḥ ।।29।।
devāḥ sendrāśca nāgāśca yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ ।
astuvanvedamantraiste sūktaiśca vividhaistadā ।। 1.253.30।।
baliṃ dhṛtvā kare tatra padenā''pūritā mahī ।
dvitīyena svarāptaṃ cāṇḍakaṭāhasamanvitam ।।3 1।।
tṛtīyaṃ tu baleḥ pṛṣṭhe tadā nyastaṃ padaṃ mayā ।
gato rasātalaṃ lakṣmi dānavo mama pūjakaḥ ।।32।।
nyasto rasātale rājye so'pi māmabhajattataḥ ।
prārthayanmāṃ bhavane sve sadā sthātuṃ sa bhaktarāṭ ।।33।।
tadā'haṃ vinayī bhūtvā nijabhaktaparāyaṇaḥ ।
akurvityubhayaṃ rūpaṃ tvekena tadgṛhe sthitaḥ ।।34।।
apareṇa svarūpeṇa śeṣe śayanamāsthitaḥ ।
aṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ śayanaṃ śramanuttaye ।। 35।।
naimittikaṃ gṛhītaṃ vai mayā tasmāddināttataḥ ।
bhaktāstāṃ śayanīṃ prāhustvekādaśīṃ supuṇyadām ।। 36।।
ityevaṃ śeṣapṛṣṭhe vai kṣīrasāgaramadhyataḥ ।
svapimyahaṃ mahālakṣmi yāvadāgāmikārtikī ।। 37।।
cāturmāsyaṃ tu tatproktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param ।
śayanīvratakṛccāpi bhuktiṃmuktimavāpnuyāt ।।38 ।।
śayanīṃ tu samārabhya cātumāsyāvadhiṃ pumān ।
tāvadbhavetsudharmātmā vratādiniyamī yamī ।। 39।।।
nā'taḥ parataraṃ kiṃcidvrataṃ yāvadvratottamam ।
yatra svapiti deveśaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ।।1.253.40 ।।
evaṃ yaḥ kurute lakṣmi! śayanyāstu vratottamam ।
sarvapāpaharaṃ cāpi bhuktimuktipradāyakam ।।41 ।।
sa tu kṣudro'pi me loke jāyate me priyaṃkaraḥ ।
daśamyāmekabhuktena naktenāpi suvartayet ।।42।।
rātrau ca brahmacārī syātprātarvai brāhmasaṃjñake ।
kāle tūtthāya bhagavatsmaraṇaṃ saṃvidhāya ca ।।43।।।
snātvā devārcanaṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।
pūjāyā naityakaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyātha svayaṃ vratī ।।44।।
kārayennavadhānyaistu sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।
madhye svarṇaghaṭaṃ pañcaratnapallavasaṃyutam ।।45।।
jalavastraphalāḍhyaṃ vai sthāpayet taṃ prapūjayet ।
tilapātraṃ sthāpayitvā vāmanaṃ tatra pūjayet ।।46।।
kamalāṃ śayanīṃ cāpi pūjayed bahuvastubhiḥ ।
āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtasusecanam ।।47।।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādihāracandanakajjalam ।
sarvaśṛṃgārarāgāँśca tvarpayettilakādikam ।।48।।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlasatphalam ।
nīrājananamaskārastutibandikṣamāpanam ।।49।।
visarjanāṃ'jaliṃ datvā svīyavratasya pūrtaye ।
nirvighnaṃ me vrataṃ cāstu prārthayedevameva ha ।।1.253.50 ।।
baladravyānusāreṇa mahāpūjādi kārayet ।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayedramyaṃ rājyamaṇḍapasannibham ।।51 ।।
vaiṣṇavānpūjayetprātardānāni prā'rpayettathā ।
sādhūnāmagrataḥ sthitvā cāturmāsyavratāni ca ।।52।।
dhārayenniyamāँścāpi sukhamokṣakarāँstadā ।
jaihvaśaiśnaniyamān saṃgṛhṇīyāttu tapaḥkṛte ।।53।।
haryagre vā guroragre gṛhṇīyānniyamān vratam ।
śārīraniyamauṃstadvanmānasānsayamāँstathā ।।54।।
bhogyabhautikaniyamānmuktidānniyamānapi ।
vratāni dānaniyamāngṛhṇīyātprātareva hi ।।15।।
indriyāṇāṃ manasaśca vṛttīnāṃ saṃyamastapaḥ ।
abhyāsena tu kartavyaścāturmāsye viśeṣataḥ ।।56।।
viṣayāḥ parihartavyāḥ kṣobhakā vighnakāriṇaḥ ।
rasapuṣṭirna vai kāryā yataḥ sā kṣobhikā matā ।।57।।
raso jaihvyo mahān doṣaḥ sarvendriyasupuṣṭikṛt ।
jetavyaḥ sa viśeṣeṇa cātumāsyavratārthibhiḥ ।।58।।
phalāhāraḥ payaḥpānaṃ hyekānnamekabhojanam ।
śākāhāraḥ śākavarjyo ghṛtatyāgo'thavā tapaḥ ।।59।।
dadhityāgastilatyāgo dadhiprāśastilādanam ।
kandāhāraḥ kaṇāhāro bhājāhāro dalādanam ।।1.253.60।।
jalāhāraḥ śarkarāyāstyāgo gūḍhasya nīrasaḥ ।
śrāvaṇe śākavarjyaṃ ca bhādre dadhivivarjitam ।।6 1।।
āśvine dugdhahīnaṃ ca kārtike dvidalojjhitam ।
bhuñjīta mūlakaṃ kandaṃ vṛntākaṃ na kaliṃgakam ।।62।।
varjayed vratamevoktaṃ cāturmāsye śubhe tapaḥ ।
dhāraṇāpāraṇākhyaṃ vā vrataṃ proktaṃ mahāphalam ।।63।।
maunaṃ dhāryaṃ kathā kāryā harernāmnā ca mālikāḥ ।
uccāraṇena yuktāścā''vartanīyāḥ śataṃmitāḥ ।।64।।
rūpāṇāṃ darśanaṃ nātikartavyaṃ cakṣuṣorvratam ।
śabdānāṃ śravaṇaṃ nātikartavyaṃ karṇayorvratam ।।65।।
gandhāstu rājasā nātigrāhyāstannāsikāvratam ।
nārīnaramithaḥsparśo nātikāryastvaco vratam ।।66।।
cāturmāsye sadaikatra vastavyaṃ pādayorvratam ।
patraśākhādyabhaṃgaśca hastayoḥ paramaṃ vratam ।।67।।
vīryādeḥ rakṣaṇaṃ tvetad brahmacaryaṃ mahad vratam ।
vātulaṃ tāmasaṃ nā'danīyaṃ daihyaṃ mahattapaḥ ।।68 ।।
pañcāgnitapanaṃ vṛkṣālambanaṃ sūryadarśanam ।
ekapādena saṃsthānaṃ hastasyordhvavidhāpanam ।। 69।।
adhomastakatādhāro nakhādyakartanaṃ tapaḥ ।
keśānāṃ vardhanaṃ bhasmadhūlīkardamamardanam ।।1.253.7 0 ।।
anupānattayā stheyaṃ vivastreṇa viśeṣataḥ ।
jaladhārātale stheyaṃ jale stheyaṃ tathā''tape ।।7 1 ।।
avitāne sadā stheyaṃ vṛkṣādhovāsa ityapi ।
bhūmau vāso bhūśayanaṃ vālukāśayanaṃ tathā ।।72 ।।
bāṇaśayyā lohaśayyā kaṇṭake śayanaṃ tathā ।
aśayanamanidrā ca jalapānaṃ tu no punaḥ ।।73 ।।
snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ caiva mūrteścāpi vicintanam ।
dhyānaṃ ca smaraṇaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ pañcadhā dine ।।74।।
mantrajapastadarthasyābhidhyānaṃ mānasaṃ tapaḥ ।
aikāgryaṃ dhāraṇā ceti kartavyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ।।75।।
ahiṃsā manasā vācā śarīreṇāpi sarvathā ।
jātyā deśena kālena prasaṃgenāpi varjitā ।।76 ।।
tṛṇacchedopi no kāryo vrataṃ cā'hiṃsanaṃ hi tat ।
adrohaḥ sarvabhūtānāmanindā ca mahadvratam ।।77।।
anyavṛttā'navalokanādikaṃ paramaṃ vratam ।
satyaṃ priyaṃ hitaṃ tathyaṃ sukhakṛdvacanaṃ tapaḥ ।।78 ।।
asteyaṃ sarvathā sarvairindriyairmanasā tapaḥ ।
kāmanāyā vicārasyānudbhavaḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।।79।।
agrāhyaṃ tu na rakṣyaṃ vai kiṃciccāpi mahattapaḥ ।
bhikṣānirvāha evāstu dehayātrā paraṃ tapaḥ ।।1.253.8 0 ।।
yadṛcchayā tu saṃlābhe tvanāsaktirmahattapaḥ ।
parasaukhyapradātṛtva paropakaraṇaṃ tapaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
parārthaṃ ca dayālutvaṃ dehenāpi paraṃ tapaḥ ।
śaucaṃ jñānajalābhyāṃ ca nairmalyaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।।82 ।।
akāpaṭyaṃ hṛdi vāci kriyāyāmekatā tapaḥ ।
santoṣo nātitṛṣṇatvamanāśā paramaṃ tapaḥ ।।8 3 ।।
svīye tṛptiḥ parakīye praudāsīnyaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ ।
mokṣamārgāvalambastu tapasāṃ tapa uttamam ।।84।।
akleśaḥ sarvadā śāntirakrodhastu mahadvratam ।
anudvego'nadhikṣepo nā''krośo nakalittapaḥ ।। 85।।
aluṃcāgrahaṇaṃ nānyadravyāśā mānasaṃ tapaḥ ।
īśadatte sadā tṛptiḥ parakīye na vāñcchanā ।।86 ।।
bhogyaṃ nāryādikaṃ tyājyaṃ khaṭvāgendukapārśvakam ।
sugandhastailamardādi bhūṣaṇaṃ ca surūpaṇam ।।87।।
vastraśṛṃgārasantyāgo bhogatyāgo viśeṣataḥ ।
bhogyasādhanasaṃtyāgo dehināṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।।88 ।।
yānavāhanadhūmrādipānadyūtasunāṭanam ।
vyasanaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ ca tyājyaṃ ceti paraṃ tapaḥ ।।89 ।।
cāturmāsye pratipātaḥ sādhūnāṃ caraṇāmṛtam ।
pātavyaṃ ca prasādaśca bhakṣaṇīyaṃ itivratam ।। 1.253.90 ।।
sādhūnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
pādayormardanaṃ tvaṃgavāhanaṃ muktidaṃ vratam ।। 91 ।।
dehena manasā vāṇyā dhanenānnena vāsasā ।
putreṇa priyayā sākaṃ toṣaṇaṃ vai mahadvratam ।। 92।।
darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ nityaṃ namanaṃ pādasevanam ।
pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ sādhostoṣaṇaṃ tanmahadvratam ।।9 3 ।।
satāṃ nikaṭe saṃvāsaḥ snānajñānakriyādiṣu ।
śuśrūṣaṇaṃ sadā kāryaṃ pāvanāḥ sādhavo yataḥ ।। 94।।
devasevā pitṛsevā sādhusevā mahāvratam ।
patnītoṣaḥ svāmisevā vrataṃ patyuḥ pratoṣaṇam ।। 95।।
yasyāpekṣitamevaitaddātavyaṃ premagarbhitam ।
akṣayaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ syāt tasmānnāsti paraṃ vratam ।। 96।।
svāśritānāṃ toṣaṇaṃ ca svarṇā'nnajñānakā'rpaṇam ।
grāmakṣetramaṇiratnodyānā''layajalārpaṇam । ।97 ।।
dehena sevanaṃ nityaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ vrataṃ bhavet ।
kṣamā dayā'nasūyā cā'nīrṣyā doṣavivarjanam ।। 98।।
guṇagrāho yaśaḥkīrtikāritā paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
amānitvaṃ mānadatvaṃ samānātmā'valokanam ।।99।।
anauṣṇyaṃ vaiparītye'pi śaityaṃ nāpyanukūlake ।
harṣā'marṣabhayodvegavarjanaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।। 1.253.100 ।।
phaladhānyadalapatrapuṣpakaṇatṛṇādikam ।
arpaṇīyaṃ śrīharaye navaṃ nityaṃ vrataṃ mahat ।। 101 ।।
kāṣṭhakarīṣaśākhāpraśākhānālakaraṇḍakam ।
pratyahaṃ tvarpaṇīyaṃ tad yathāyogyaṃ śubhaṃ vratam ।। 10 2।।
śākapākasumiṣṭānnalavaṇārdrakadhānakam ।
bharjitaṃ taṇḍulādyaṃ ca deyaṃ nityaṃ tu tad vratam ।। 103 ।।
khādyaṃ peyaṃ bhakṣyabhojye coṣyaṃ svādyaṃ ca lehyakam ।
dugdhaṃ dadhi raso miṣṭaḥ kaṇā deyā vrataṃ mahat ।। 10 4।।
vastraṃ bhūṣā kajjalaṃ candanaṃ cāttaramuttamam ।
kastūrī kuṃkumaṃ cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ tvalaktakaṃ vratam । । 105 ।।
etāni svargadānyatra sukhadāni vratāni vai ।
śrīhareḥ smaraṇaṃ bhaktiḥ pūjanaṃ ca nivedanam ।। 106 । ।
dvātriṃśadbhirupacārairarcanaṃ muktidaṃ vratam ।
paropakaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇabuddhyā puṇyapradaṃ vratam ।। 1 07।।
yajanaṃ vividhairyajñairdīnānāṃ ca sahāyatā ।
kūpānāṃ khananaṃ vṛkṣāropaṇaṃ cāpi tad vratam ।। 108 ।।
mārgāṇāṃ cāpi nirmāṇaṃ tvāśramasthalabandhanam ।
āśrayasatraśālādinirmāṇaṃ svargadaṃ vratam ।। 109 । ।
kalākauśalyaśikṣā ca kṛṣyuttejanamityapi ।
yantravāhopakārādi svargadaṃ sukhadaṃ vratam ।। 1.253.110 । ।
matsyapipīlīkādīnāṃ piṣṭadānaṃ sadāvratam ।
vṛkṣāṇāṃ jalrasekaśca tṛṣitānāṃ jalārpaṇam । । 111 । ।
kṣudhitānāṃ bhojyadānaṃ nagnānāṃ vāsaso'rpaṇam ।
ārtānāṃ vividhānāṃ tu tadārtiśamanaṃ vratam ।। 11 2 ।।
rogiṇāmoṣadhadānaṃ vṛttidānaṃ ca jīvikā ।
poṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ cāpi rakṣaṇaṃ paramaṃ vratam । । 113 । ।
nityamadhyātmayogasyā'bhyasanaṃ śāstravācanam ।
kṛṣṇakathāśravaṇaṃ ca mokṣadaṃ paramaṃ vratam । । 114 ।।
daṇḍavacca namaskārāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ ca tad vratam ।
dīpadānaṃ vāridānaṃ naivedyādyarpaṇaṃ vratam । । 115 ।।
nityaṃ phalārpaṇaṃ dhānyārpaṇaṃ cāpi rasārpaṇam ।
śarkarākhaṇḍikāgūḍamadhvādyarpaṇakaṃ vratam । । 11 6। ।
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ svacchīkaraṇaṃ maṃjanaṃ vratam ।
pātravastrakṣālanaṃ ca nīrājanasamarpaṇam ।। 11 7।।
netrairmūrteḥ prapānaṃ ca prapāsatrādicālanam ।
mandirāgryayasusaudhādinirmāṇaṃ paramaṃ vratam ।। 118 । ।
citrādyaṃ śilpitādyaṃ ca vayanaṃ bhagavatkṛte ।
grathanaṃ grantharacanaṃ chandaślokādivarṇanam ।। 119 ।।
vyākhyānaṃ kathanaṃ bhaktavāñcchāpūraṇakaṃ vratam ।
sukhadaṃ svargadaṃ mokṣapradaṃ copakṛtirvratam । । 1.253.120 ।।
vratānyanyāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi! tapāṃsi vai ।
cāturmāsye kathā śravyā bhojanīyāśca sādhavaḥ ।। 121 ।।
nityaṃ kāryā mahāpūjā vratatrayaṃ susiddhidam ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya mahāpūjā nityaṃ kāryā mahadvratam । । 122 ।।
śatādisaṃkhyayā mālā''vartanaṃ mama nāmataḥ ।
bhaktapūjā havirhomo'rcāsevā mokṣadaṃ vratam ।। 123।।
ahantāmamatātyāgo brahmacaryaprapālanam ।
pāyasaikṣavalāvaṇyaphāleyavarjanaṃ vratam ।। 124।।
kṛṣṇasambandhidharmo yastadavrataṃ me paraṃ matam ।
kṛtena vratinā yena bhagavāँstajjanāstathā ।। 125।
prīyeraँstadvrataṃ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ tu tadeva yat ।
kārtike śuklapakṣe'tha dvādaśyāṃ devapūjanam ।। 126।।
kṛtvā bhagavatastvagre nivedyaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ ।
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā deva kṛtaṃ tvatprītaye prabho । । 127।।।
nyūnaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ yātu tena tuṣṭo bhavermayi ।
evaṃ samāpya niyamān pāraṇāmācarettataḥ ।। 128।।।
prātaḥsnānaṃ devapūjāṃ nityaṃ vṛddhābhivandanam ।
saṃvibhajyā''śritānāṃ ca bhojanādividhāpanam ।। 129।।
akleśaśca sumelaśca kuṭumbe snehitā tvati ।
miṣṭaṃ ceṣṭaṃ gṛhaṃ yasya svargaṃ tasyāsti bhūtale ।। 1.253.130 ।।
vrateṣu yadvrataṃ cāturmāsye'tivāñchitam bhavet ।
kartavyaṃ tacchayanīprabhātamārabhya sarvathā ।। 131 ।।
madhyāhṇe haraye dadyād bhojanaṃ sujalaṃ tathā ।
tāmbūlaṃ miṣṭapānaṃ ca sāyaṃ cāpi tathā''caret ।। 1 32।।
ārārtrikaṃ stavanaṃ ca dolārohaṇamityapi ।
āndolayeddhariṃ tatra bhojayeddugdhapūrikāḥ ।। 1 33।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyagītakathāmṛtaiḥ ।
dvādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle ca snātvā kṛṣṇārcanaṃ caret ।! 134
dānāni svarṇamukhyāni dadyāt kuryācca pāraṇām ।
bhojayettu sataḥ sādhvīstoṣayedvinayānvitaḥ ।। 135।।।
evaṃ tvāṣādaśuklāyā vrataṃ saniyamaṃ śubham ।
kartavyaṃ sarvayajñānāṃ phaladaṃ bhuktimuktidam ।। 136 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āṣāḍhaśuklaśayanyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vāmanāvatārakṛtaśayanaṃ cāturmāsye cāpi yamaniyamasaṃyamavratadamanatapaḥśoṣaṇatyāgasevanadānopakārādisadvratādi ceti nirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 253 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 254
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 255 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śrīkṛṣṇasya hareryogāt sarvaṃ bhavati nirguṇam ।
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi caturbāhusvarūpadam ।। 1 ।।
yatkiṃcitkarma kāmyaṃ vā phalecchāvidhuraṃ ca vā ।
kṛṣṇatuṣṭyai kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ golokapradameva tat ।। 2 ।।
tadvrataṃ sā kriyā ramyā sa dharmastattu pūjanam ।
yena tuṣṭo bhavetsvāmī harikṛṣṇaḥ satāṃ patiḥ ।। 3 ।।
cāturmāsyavrataṃ tadvai yena tuṣyati mādhavaḥ ।
yamāśca niyamāste vai yena tuṣṭo hyadhokṣajaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vada śrāvaṇakṛṣṇe me kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā ।
ko devaḥ ko vidhistasyāḥ kiṃ puṇyaṃ kathaya prabho ।। 5 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! ca te vakṣye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।
śrāvaṇaikādaśī kṛṣṇā kāmikā nāma nāmataḥ ।। 6 ।।
acyuto vijayāyuktaḥ sampūjyastatra bhaktitaḥ ।
puṣpeṣu pārijātāni bilvamarghye phalaṃ matam ।। 7 ।।
śatacchidrādi naivedye dānaṃ strīpuṃsuvastrayoḥ ।
deyaṃ tu vratinā sarvamacyutapremakārakam ।। 8 ।।
na gaṃgāyāṃ na ca kāśyāṃ naimiṣe na na puṣkare ।
satphalaṃ labhyate yadvai phalaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjanāt ।। 9 ।।
godāvaryāṃ gurau siṃhe vyatīpāte ca daṇḍake ।
yatphalaṃ labhyate tasmādadhikaṃ phalamucyate ।। 1.254.10 ।।
sasāgaravanopetāṃ yo dadāti vasundharām ।
kāmikāvratavāṃstasmādadhikaṃ phalamaśnute ।। 11 ।।
dhenuṃ sopaskarāṃ dadyād yastu cobhayatomukhīm ।
tato'dhikaṃ phalaṃ tasya jāyate kāmikāvratāt ।। 12।।
śrāvaṇe śrīdharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayed yo vratī janaḥ ।
tena saṃpūjitā devā gandharvoragapannagāḥ ।। 1 3।।
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ kāmikāvratamuttamam ।
tatpāraprāpakaṃ potaṃ vidyate harinirmitam ।। 14।।
adhyātmavidyāprāpyaṃ ca phalaṃ vai kāmikāvratāt ।
sajāgaraṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā durgatiṃ naiva gacchati ।। 15।।
na paśyati yamaṃ raudraṃ kuyoniṃ naiva vindati ।
kāmikāvratapuṇyena kaivalyaṃ yogino yayuḥ ।। 16।।
tulasīprabhavaiḥ patrairyo janaḥ pūjayeddharim ।
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāṃbhasā ।। 17।।
suvarṇaṃ bhāramekaṃ ca rajataṃ ca caturguṇam ।
arpyate tatphalāvāptistulasīdalapūjanāt ।। 18 ।।
raktamauktikavaidūryapravālādibhirarcitaḥ ।
na tuṣyati tathā kṛṣṇastulasīdalato yathā ।। 1 9।।
tulasīmaṃjarībhiḥ saṃpūjito yena mādhavaḥ ।
anekajanmapāpāni tasya yānti hi saṃkṣayam ।। 1.254.20 ।।
yā dṛṣṭā pāpaśamanī spṛṣṭā dehasya pāvanī ।
stutā roganirasanī siktā'ntakanivāriṇī । । 21 ।।
ropitā kṛṣṇacaraṇapratyāsattividhāyinī ।
arpitā muktiphaladā tattulasyai namo namaḥ ।। 22।।
ityuktvā tulasīṃ dadyād devāya paramātmane ।
kṛṣṇāgre dīpako yasya jvalatyekādaśītithau ।। 23 ।।
pitarastasya tṛpyanti hyamṛtena divi sthitāḥ ।
dīpadānaṃ tu śikhare kartavyaṃ vai harerdine ।। 24।।
tasya puṇyasya saṃkhyāṃ tu viṣṇuścāpi na vettyalam ।
ghṛtasya tilatailasya dīpī deyo hi mandire ।। 25 ।।
dātā prayāti dyulokaṃ dīpakoṭiśatojjvalaḥ ।
brahmahatyāpaharaṇī mahāpuṇyaphalapradā ।।26 ।।
tridivasthānadātrī ca bhrūṇahatyādināśinī ।
kartavyaikādaśī kāmapūraṇī śraddhayā priye ।। 27।।
vratakartā pāvano vai bhūtvā bhaktisamanvitaḥ ।
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti bhuṃkte sukhaṃ tu śāśvatam ।। 28 ।।
daśamyāmekabhojī syād bhūśāyī ca bhavenniśi ।
brahmacārī bhaveccaiva prātarutthāya ca vratī ।। 29 ।।
snātvā nityārcanaṃ kṛtvā maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham ।
dhānyaiśca sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayettataḥ ।।2.254.30 ।।
acyutasya svarṇamūrtiṃ vijayāsahitasya vai ।
pūjayedvidhinā tatrā''vāhanādibhirādarāt ।। 31 ।।
pañcāmṛtairjalaiścāpi snapayenmārjayettataḥ ।
vastrabhūṣādyalaṃkāraśṛṃgāraiśca praśobhitām ।। 32 ।।
sthāpayitvā tilapātre nyasyetpātraṃ ghaṭopari ।
pañcaratnasupallavaphalavārisamanvitam ।। 33 ।।
bhojayed vividhairbhojyaistāmbūlādi samarpayet ।
nīrājayet stutiṃ pradakṣiṇāṃjalī samarpayet। ।। 34।।
nirvidhnaṃ me vrataṃ bhūyādityevamarthayeddharim ।
madhyāhne'pi sumiṣṭānnaistarpayedacyutaṃ vratī ।। 35।।
sāyaṃ cāpi tathā kuryānmahāpūjādikaṃ vratī ।
bhojayetpūjayedāndolayedaṃgāni mardayet ।। 36।।
jāgaraṇaṃ prakuryācca dvādaśyāṃ prātareva tu ।
snātvā'rcayitvā dānāni dadyācca vividhāni vai ।। 37।।
sataḥ sādhvīrbhojayecca bālān kuryācca pāraṇām ।
sukāmikāvrataṃ tvevaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ।। 38 ।।
dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti putrārthī labhate sutam ।
bhāryārthī tvāpnuyād bhāryāṃ svāmikāmā patiṃ labhet । । 39 ।।
gṛhakṣetrapaśusmṛddhidhānyārthī labhate tu tat ।
kīrtyārogyasusammānarājyasattārthī tallabhet । 2.254.40 ।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthī vrataṃ kṛtvā'rjayettu tat ।
śatrūpadravavighnāttikṣayārthī tatkṣayaṃ vrajet । । 41 ।।
evaṃ sarvapradaṃ tvetat kāmikāvratamuttamam ।
svargadaṃ satyadaṃ tadvai tathā vairājalokadam ।।42।।
golokadaṃ vrataṃ caitadakṣarapradamuttamam ।
sarvasiddhipradaṃ tvasyā ākhyānaṃ śṛṇu pūrvajam । । 43 । ।
śravaṇāḥ pitaraḥ pūrvaṃ dharmarājakulodbhavāḥ ।
dharmeṇa yojitāḥ prāṇivṛttāntānayanāya te । ।44 । ।
yatra gacchanti jīvānāṃ vṛttāntānayanāya te ।
na śṛṇvanti na paśyanti karma sūkṣmāt susūkṣmakam ।।45। ।
na jānanti ca vṛttāntaṃ tvānayeyuḥ kathaṃ tu te ।
ajānanto yama te nivedayeyuḥ kathaṃ tadā । ।46 ।।
iti cintāparā sarve militvā''huryamaṃ puraḥ ।
sūkṣmakarmakṛtāṃ sarvaṃ yathā vidmo vayaṃ tathā । । 47 ।।
dharmarāja vidhehyeva jānīmo jīvakarma yat ।
vayaṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyākā jīvāścāsaṃkhyakoṭayaḥ । ।48 ।।
kathaṃ kutra bhaved vyāptirasmākaṃ siddhimantarā ।
tasmāt siddhiṃ pradehi tvaṃ yadvā darśaya tattapaḥ । । 49 । ।
yena syāma tavāgre vai sarvā''vedanaśaktayaḥ ।
śrutvā yamastu tānprāha sevadhvaṃ kāmikāvratam ।।2.254.50 ।।
śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapakṣe sā kāmikaikādaśī matā ।
sarvakāmasusaṃsiddhiyātrī tvaiśvaryasamprada । । ।5 1 ।।
vidhiṃ śrutvā kāmikāyā vratasya śravaṇāstataḥ ।
cakrurvrataṃ kāmikāyā dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ।।5 2 ।।
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇākāle prasanno dharmarājakaḥ ।
svayaṃ viprasvarūpeṇā'tithirbhūtvā samāgataḥ ।। 53 ।।
bhikṣāṃ dehīti sūccārya tasthau tvaṃgaṇabhūtale ।
śravaṇairarpitāṃ bhikṣāṃ jagrāha bahubhāvataḥ ।।54 ।।
varaṃ vṛṇuta bho kṣatrāḥ prasanno'smi vratena vaḥ ।
ityāha tān dharmadevo'cyutasya janakaḥ svayam ।।55 । ।
prāhuste śravaṇā taṃ vai jīvānāṃ sūkṣmakarmakam ।
yathā jānīma evātra sārvajñyaṃ dehi tadvidham । ।56 ।।
dūraśravaṇamevāpi dūradarśanamityapi ।
guptakartavyavettṛtvaṃ bahurūpadhṛtiṃ tathā ।।57 । ।
sarvadeśādisaṃstheṣu jīveṣu vyāpitāṃ tathā ।
sarveṣāṃ sarvathā sarvavettṛtvaśaktimuttamām । । 58 ।।
śāśvatīṃ tatsmṛtiṃ cāpi yathārthāṃ dehi yadyathā ।
śrutvaivaṃ dharmarājastu samuvāca tu tāँstadā ।। 59 ।।
kāmikāyā vrataṃ yuṣmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tatphalaṃ bahu ।
sarvasiddhimayaṃ ceṣṭapradaṃ labdhaṃ yato hyaham । । 2.254.60 । ।
dadāmi sarvasiddhīśca tathā yūyaṃ bhavantviti ।
īśavatsarvadā sarvajīvānāmitivṛttajam । । 61 । ।
sarvaṃ jñānaṃ bhavatsveva bhavatviti dadāmyaham ।
evaṃ varaṃ paraṃ datvā dharmarājastirodadhe । । 62 ।।
śravaṇā dvādaśasaṃkhyāstata āramya sarvadā ।
asaṃkhyarūpadhartāro jīvakarma nivedakāḥ ।। 63 । ।
sarvajñā iva saṃjātāścitraguptāgrataḥ sadā ।
nivedayanti vṛttāntaṃ mṛtānāṃ pūrvagāminām । । 64।।
sarvakāmaphalaṃ prāptāḥ kāmikāyā vratena te ।
sarvasiddhipradā tasmātkartavyā kāmikā janaiḥ । । 65 । ।
śṛṇu tvanyakathāṃ lakṣmi! raterjātāṃ purā yathā ।
śaṃkareṇa yadā dagdhaḥ kāmadevo himālaye ।। 66 । ।
kāmapatnī ratirjātā vidhavā patimantarā ।
bahu sā pīḍitā jātā vaidhavyā''rttyatikarṣitā । । 67। ।
śaṃkaraṃ prati gatvā sā prāha nātha kṛpāṃ kuru ।
patiṃ vinā tu me prāptaṃ hyamāṃgalyaṃ duḥkhapradam । ।68 । ।
tanme vināśayā''rttinyāḥ śaṃbho śaṃ kuru yoṣitaḥ ।
śrutvā śaṃbhuśca tāṃ prāha kāmikāyā vrataṃ kuru । । 69 ।।
amāṃgalyaṃ sadā te vai dūraṃ yāsyati niścitam ।
adeho'pi patiste vai ratisthāne miliṣyati । । 2.254.70 ।।
avaidhavyamamāṃgalyaṃ sarvaṃ te yāsyati kṣayam ।
kṛṣṇaputrastu vai pradyumnanāmā te patistataḥ । ।7 1 । ।
suśarīro'tisaubhāgyavatyā vai prāpsyate tvayā ।
śrutvaivaṃ sā kāmikāyā vrataṃ cakre ratirmudā ।।7 2 ।।
vidhivacca dadau sarvadānāni bahubhaktitaḥ ।
śaṃbhustu pāraṇākāle bhūtvā bhikṣuka eva ha । ।7 3 ।।
samāyayau subhikṣārthaṃ tayā bhikṣā samarpitā ।
bhuktvā prāha tataḥ śaṃbhurvaraṃ yācasva dadmyaham ।।74।।
kāmikāyā vratenāsmi prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
śrutvā ratistadā prāha patiṃ kāmaṃ pradehi me ।।75।।
tathāstviti samuccāryā'dṛśyo'bhūcchaṃkarastataḥ ।
ratyā labdhaḥ patiḥ svasyā ratyāḥ kāle pratisthale ।।76।।
bhūte bhūte sarvayonau pati prāptaḥ sa maithune ।
mūrtaḥ pradyumnanāmāpi prāptaḥ kṛṣṇasutastataḥ ।।77।।
evaṃ vrataprabhāveṇa ratiḥ saubhāgyatāṃ gatā ।
brahmāṇḍaprāṇiṣu vyāptiṃ prāptā siddhiṃ tu śāśvatīm ।।78।।
vrataṃ tvevaṃ kāmikāyāḥ sarvakāmaprasādhakam ।
sarvasaṃkalpasiddhidhṛk sarvasmṛddhipradāyakam ।।79।।
sarvārttināśakaṃ saumyaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham ।
sarvayajñaphaladātṛ yogasiddhikaraṃ tathā ।।2.254.80।।
naṣṭavastupradaṃ cāpi sadaiśvaryapradaṃ mahat ।
ratidaṃ kāmadaṃ patnīpradaṃ svāmipradaṃ tathā ।।8 1।।
duḥkhaghnaṃ tvārttiśamanaṃ kāmabhogasukhapradam ।
vighnanāśakaraṃ vāñchāpūrakaṃ narayoṣitām ।।82।।
kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi ! cā'vaidhavyakaraṃ param ।
ratiśaktikāmaśaktisiddhidaṃ kāmyamityapi ।।83।।
niṣkāmānāṃ tu vaikuṇṭhaprāpakaṃ puṇyabhājanam ।
lakṣā'śvamedhayajñānāṃ puṇyadaṃ śravaṇādapi ।।858।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrāvaṇakṛṣṇakāmikaikādaśīmāhātmyaṃ śravaṇākhyapitṝṇāṃ sarvasiddhiprāptiḥ rateśca kāmākhyapatiprāptiścetinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 254 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 254 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 255
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 256 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
sarvakāmapradaḥ kṛṣṇo harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
phaladātā sukhadātā vratapūrtikaraḥ sa hi ।। 1 ।।
śraddhayā tvāpyate puṇyaṃ śraddhāyāṃ sa sadā sthitaḥ ।
bhāvanāsahito viṣṇuḥ phalatyeva vratāśrayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
mokṣado mādhavo devaḥ sādhane vasati dhruvam ।
sādhanāni vinā taṃ vai no phalaṃ dadati kvacit ।। 3 ।।
sa eva sarvathā''rādhyo viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
lakṣmīśaśca rameśaśca śrīśo dhvajadhanuḥkaraḥ ।। 4 ।।
kṛpayā vada me matsyasvastikacihnahastaka ।
svāminprabhāṣate pārvatīpate māṇikīśvara ।। 5 ।।
śrāvaṇaśuklapakṣasyaikādaśī nāmatastu kā ।
kau vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ tasyāḥ ko devo'rcyo vrate'tra vai ।। 6 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ekādaśī putradākhyā śrāvaṇasya sitā matā ।
śrīdharaḥ pūjanīyo'tra kāntimatyā saha prabhuḥ ।। 7 ।।
kamalaiḥ pūjanīyo'sau bhojanīyastvapūpakaiḥ ।
arghyaḥ sītāphalaiḥ kṛṣṇo dātavyaṃ pādukādvayam ।। 8 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā dānaṃ mataṃ śubham ।
śrotavyā'syāḥ kathā divyā bhuktimuktipradāyinī ।। 9 ।।
daśamyāmekabhojī syād brahmacārī bhavettathā ।
rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryādekādaśyāṃ prage vratī ।। 1.255.1 0।।
snātvā nityaṃ mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā vai maṇḍapāntare ।
maṇḍale sarvatobhadre sthāpite kānake ghaṭe ।। 11 ।।
pañcaratnāmbaravāripatrā'kṣataphalānvite ।
tilasthālīṃ sthāpayitvā śrīdharaṃ sthāpayettataḥ ।। 12।।
pūjayetsarvabhāvena ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।
āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt paṃcāmṛtābhiṣecanam ।। 13।।
vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārakajjalacandanāttaraiḥ ।
puṣpahārā'kṣatacūrṇaphalatāmbūlabhojanaiḥ ।। 14।।
ārārtrikastutidaṇḍavatpradakṣiṇadīpanaiḥ ।
pūjayitvā hariṃ nirvighnaṃ vrataṃ prārthayet tataḥ ।। 15।।
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ dadyāttāmbūlaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā ।
sāyaṃ dadyād dugdhapākaṃ pūrikāḥ śākamityāpe ।। 16।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt kathākīrtananartanaiḥ ।
dvādaśyāṃ tu prage snā tvā pūjayitvā ca mādhavam ।। 17।।
dadyāddānāni sarvāṇi yathāśakti yathādhanam ।
bhojayet sādhuviprāṃśca sādhvīrbālāँśca bālikāḥ ।। 18।।
tato vai svajanān bhojayitvā svaḥ pāraṇāṃ caret ।
evaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhuktimukti dam ।। 1 9।।
dhanadhānyasutadārākṣetrodyānagṛhādikam ।
ārogyamānakīrtyādi labhate tu vratī śubham ।। 1.255.20 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ divyāṃ yā'bhūsūpūrve kṛte yuge ।
rājā pururavā nāmnā babhūva candrapautrakaḥ ।।21 ।।
budhaputraḥ pururavā rājyaṃ pālayati svakam ।
śrīpure narmadātīre vasati sma nirantaram ।। 22।।
tasya guṇān devamukhācchrutvorvaśī varāṃganā ।
apsarāḥ svayamāgatya patnīrūpā hyupasthitā ।।23।।
bahukāle gate'pyasyāmapatyaṃ na vyajāyata ।
putrahīnasya tasyaiva na tadrājyaṃ sukhapradam ।। 24।।
aputrasya sukhaṃ nāsti loke'smiँśca paratra ca ।
evaṃ cintayatastasya kālo bahutaro gataḥ ।। 25।।
na prāptaśca suto rājñā tena duḥkhāyate sukham ।
svarājyapaṇḍitān vṛddhānāhūyā''veditaṃ hi tat ।। 26।।
iha janmani bho viprā na mayā pātakaṃ kṛtam ।
anyāyopārjitaṃ dravyaṃ mayā kośe na yojitam ।। 27।।
brahmadravyaṃ ca devasvaṃ vidhavā'nāthaḍhabbukam ।
api mayā gṛhītaṃ na dattaṃ pratyuta sarvadā ।। 28।।
putravatpālito lokaḥ prajā dharmeṇa rakṣitā ।
yuddhena vijitā pṛthvī daṇḍo duṣṭeṣu pātitaḥ ।।29।।।
anyāyo na kṛtasteṣu sutabandhuprajāsu ca ।
pūjyāḥ supūjitā nityaṃ sadā vṛddhāstu vanditāḥ ।। 1.255.30 ।।
na dviṣṭā nyāyamārgasthāḥ pūjitā devatāḥ sadā ।
viprāśca sādhavaḥ sādhvyo gāvo dīnāśca pūjitāḥ ।। 31 ।।
dravyayajñā jñānayajñāḥ kṛtāḥ śiṣṭaprasaṃgataḥ ।
tathāpi madgṛhe putro na jātastad vimṛśyatām ।। 32 ।।
itivākyaṃ dvijāḥ śrutvā savṛddhāḥ sapurohitāḥ ।
nṛpaterhitamicchanto jagmuste lomaśamṛṣim ।। 33 ।।
kalpe kalpe gate yasya lomaikantu viśīryate ।
evaṃ lomaśanāmnā sa rūḍhyā prasiddhimāpa ha ।। 34।।
tapantaṃ ghorasutapo nirāhāraṃ nirīhakam ।
śāntaṃ sudharmatattvajñaṃ śāstravedaviśāradam ।। 35 ।।
dīrghāyuṣaṃ trikālajñaṃ jaṭāśmaśrusuśobhitam ।
mahātmānaṃ dvijā dṛṣṭvā bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hi menire ।। 3 6।।
brahmātmānaṃ muniṃ natvā'grataḥ saṃharṣitāḥ sthitāḥ ।
tāṃstathā sāgrajān vīkṣya muniḥ provāca lomaśaḥ ।। 37 ।।
kathaṃ kimarthamāyātā brāhmaṇā vṛddhasevakāḥ ।
yatkiṃcitsumahatsvalpaṃ sādhyaṃ tvasādhyamityapi ।। 38 ।।
labhyaṃ cā'labhyamevāpi brāhmaṇārthe karomyaham ।
asaṃśayaṃ kathayadhvaṃ kariṣye bhavatāṃ hitam ।। 39 ।।
brāhmaṇānāṃ vaco vedaḥ parameśvaranodanā ।
pālayitvā tu vo vākyaṃ tvavāpsye janmanaḥ phalam ।।1.255.40 ।।
paropakṛtaye janma tapasvināṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
aho'dya saphalaṃ janma kariṣye viprasevayā ।।41 ।।
itikṛtvā cakārāsāvātithyaṃ pūjanādi ca ।
jalaṃ phalāsanādīni dadau pūjyo'pi śiṣṭakṛt ।।42 ।।
tato viprāstu taṃ prāhuḥ śrūyatāṃ hṛdgataṃ tu naḥ ।
saṃśayasya nirāsāya vayaṃ svārthaparā prabho ।।43 ।।
iha kāryavaśātprāptāḥ samīpaṃ bhavato vayam ।
satāṃ saṃdarśanātpūrvabhavīyāghādiśevadhiḥ ।।44।।
bhasmībhavati drāgeva kiṃ punaḥ pādasevanāt ।
padmayoniṃ vinā tvanyastvattaḥ śreṣṭho na vidyate ।।45।।
bahujño'si bahukalpī bahuvettā samādhimān ।
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ jāyamānaṃ bahu vetsi tapobalāt ।।46।।
sarvaṃ dātuṃ samartho'si brahmātmaikyabalānmune ।
nṛpaḥ pururavāstvatra putrahīno'sti sāmpratam ।।47।।
vayaṃ viprāḥ prajāstasya putravatpālitāḥ sadā ।
putrahīnaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya duḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ ।।48।।
duḥkhanistārakartustu bhavataḥ pādayorvayam ।
chāyāyāṃ tvāgatāḥ smo'tra yogyaṃ rājñi vidhīyatām ।।49।।
tasya bhāgyena dṛṣṭo'si hyasmābhistvaṃ tapodhana ।
mahatāṃ darśanenaiva kāryasiddhirbhavennṛṇām ।।1.255.50 ।।
vad putraḥ kathaṃ nāsti kenopāyena vā bhavet ।
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā muhūrtaṃ dhyānamāptavān ।।51।।
lomaśaḥ pratyuvācaitān prāgjanma nṛpatestadā ।
pūrvajanmani vaiśyo'sau vardhamānā'bhidho dhanī ।।।52।।
vāṇijyakarmanirato lobhena janaśoṣakṛt ।
grāmādgrāmāntaraṃ yāti vastuvyāpārakāṃkṣayā ।।53।।
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe daśamīdivase tu saḥ ।
madhyāhne tvātape prāpto grāmasīmni jalāśayam ।।54।।
khātṃ tu sajalaṃ caikamātrāvatāraśobhitam ।
tatrāvatāre gatvā sa niṣasāda kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।।55।।
hastapādau mukhaṃ svasya prakṣālayati yatkṣaṇe ।
tāvattatra samāyātā savatsā gaustṛṣākulā ।।56।।
nidāghārtā bhayayuktā ghaṭṭe'vatarati drutam ।
pītagaṇḍūṣamātrāṃ tāṃ vārayitvā tu tāmasaḥ ।।57।।
toyaṃ papau svayaṃ snātvā vastraprakṣālanaṃ vyadhāt ।
ciraṃ tatra sthito mārgaṃ gave pātuṃ dadāti na ।।58।।
savatsā tṛṣitā sā'pi ciraṃ mārgaṃ pratīkṣate ।
tathāpi na dhanī sthānād yayau vai ghaṭikāṣṭakam ।।19।।
vatsā saṃtṛṣitā prāha mātaraṃ janani! mama ।
prāṇā yānti tṛṣāduḥkhād dūraṃ yāsyatyayaṃ kadā ।।1.255.60।।
gomātā prāha tāṃ vatsāṃ yāsyatyayaṃ kṣaṇāntare ।
tāvaddhairyaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ pāsyāvo'mbhaḥ kṣaṇāntare ।।6 1।।
nā'pasṛto dhanī tasmād vatsākaṇṭho'pi śuṣkatām ।
prāpat tadā gavā proktaṃ duṣṭo'yaṃ yāti naiva tu ।।62।।
prāṇāḥ prayānti me putryāḥ pāmi prasahya vai jalam ।
nirṇīyetthaṃ tu vatsāṃ svāṃ nītvā hyavātatāra gauḥ ।।62।।
vardhamāno dhanī tāṃ tu bhṛśaṃ yaṣṭyā hyatāḍayat ।
tadā śapto gavā śreṣṭhin! duṣṭa! tāḍayasi vṛthā ।।64।।
anapatyaḥ sadā janmajanmāntareṣu vai bhava ।
patnyā virahito'raṇye duḥkhito bahudhā bhava ।।65।।
śaptvā padbhyāṃ ca śṛṃgābhyāṃ tāḍayitvā prasahya tam ।
dhaninaṃ dūrataḥ kṛtvā śāntyā gauḥ sujalaṃ papau ।।66।।
vatsā jalaṃ papau śāntyā vaṇijo niryayau tataḥ ।
gavā tu tāḍitaścārto grāmaṃ prāpya mamāra saḥ ।।67।।
mṛtyoḥ pūrvaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ yajñārthaṃ dattavānasau ।
viprairyajñaḥ kṛtaścāpi tena puṇyena vardhanaḥ ।।68।।
jāto'yaṃ nṛpatistvatra nāmnā purūravā iti ।
goḥ śāpenā'napatyo'sti putrabhāgyavihīnakaḥ ।।।69।।
janmajanmāntareṣvasya nāsti putro hi śāpataḥ ।
patnyā saha viyogo'pi bhaviṣyatyasya kālataḥ ।।1.255.70।।
śrutvaitadbrāhmaṇāḥ prāhuḥ pāpakṣayastu puṇyataḥ ।
śāpanivāraṇaṃ cāpi bhavādṛśaprasādataḥ ।।71।।
asādhyaṃ nāsti te kiṃñcitputro bhavatu bhūpateḥ ।
puṇyakāryaṃ śādhi naśca dhruvaṃ rājā kariṣyati ।।72।।
lomaśaḥ prāha tānsarvān vicārya balavadvratam ।
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu putradā nāma viśrutā ।।73।।
ekādaśī vāñchitadā kurudhvaṃ tadvrataṃ dvijāḥ ।
rājā rājñī tathā yūyaṃ vrataṃ kuruta bhāvataḥ ।।74।।
lakṣagavāṃ pradānaṃ ca putradāyā dine prage ।
purūravāḥ prakarotu tataḥ putro bhaviṣyati ।।75।।
ekavrate kṛte lakṣagavāṃ dāne suto'dvayaḥ ।
bhaviṣyatyeva me vākyānnṛpaḥ karotu vāñchitam ।।76।।
ityājñāṃ śirasi dhṛtvā yayuḥ śrīnagaraṃ dvijāḥ ।
rājñā saha vrataṃ cakruryathāvidhisajāgaram ।।77।।
lakṣagavāṃ tadā dānaṃ kṛtaṃ pātrebhya eva ca ।
tena puṇyena sā rājñī garbhaṃ dadhāra śobhanam ।।78।।
kintu pūrvaṃ yadā svargādāyātā'bhūt patikṛte ।
tadā tayā kṛtastvāsītsamayaḥ sthitaye ciram ।।79।।
nagnaṃ nṛpaṃ vilokyā'haṃ gamiṣyāmi gṛhāttataḥ ।
athā'trā'vasare rātrau nṛpaṃ vīkṣya vivastrakam ।।1.255.80 ।।
prayātā sā vanaṃ tatra yayau purūravā hyanu ।
antarvatnī tu sā'raṇye vahnisthālīsvarūpiṇī ।।8 1 । ।
suṣuve susutaṃ jātavedasaṃ hi vibhāvasum ।
ekādaśyā vratenaivaṃ vahniḥ putro'sya cābhavat ।।8 2 ।।
evaṃ vai putradāścaikādaśyaścānyāstu ṣaṭkṛtāḥ ।
lakṣagavāṃ pradānaṃ saḥ pracakāra prativratam । ।8 3 ।।
tena tasyorvaśīgarbhāt ṣaḍāsannātmajāḥ pare ।
āyuḥ śrutāyuḥ satyāyuḥ rayo'tha vijayo jayaḥ । । 84 । ।
teṣāṃ putrāḥ praputrāśca hyāsanvaṃśavivardhanāḥ ।
agninā prajayā rājā lokaṃ gāndharvamāptavān । । 85 ।।
bhuktvā bhogānanekān sa kāle tyaktvā kalevaram ।
svargād yātaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhaṃ caturbhujadharaḥ svayam ।। 86 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! svarṇabhūṣā''nantyaṃ rājya yadicchati ।
kartavyaṃ tena godānapūrvakaṃ vratamuttamam ।। 87 ।।
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe karkaṭasthe divākare ।
dvādaśyāṃ vāsudevāya pavitrāropaṇaṃ caret । ।88 ।।
sūtraiḥ kṣaumairhemarūpyatāmraiḥ kauśeyapadmajaiḥ ।
kuśaiḥ kāśaiḥ sukārpāsaiḥ śaṇajaiḥ śobhanaiśca taiḥ । ।8 9 ।।
tantubhistriguṇitaṃ tat triguṇīkṛtya sūtrakam ।
śodhayet sumaṇidṛśyaṃ kārayetpāvanaṃ hi tat । । 1.255.90 ।।
haraye tvarpayettadvai pavitraṃ svarṇapuṇyadam ।
ekādaśyāṃ dhārayecca rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret ।। 91 ।।
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstathā śūdrā narāḥ striyaḥ ।
harerbhaktau sthitāḥ sarvai śubhaṃ kuryuḥ pavitrakam ।। 92।।
haraye tvarpayeccāpi gurave'pi samarpayet ।
pavitrāropaṇenāhaṃ supavitro bhavāmyaham ।। 93 ।।
svarṇarūpyakṣaumavastrādyalakārāँstathā'rjayet ।
pratyabdaṃ tu putradāyāṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ janaiḥ ।। 94।।
kartavyaṃ tūktamantreṇa dhanāḍhyastena jāyate ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathā''pnoti pavitrāropaṇena ca ।।95।।
na karoti vidhānena pavitrāropaṇaṃ tu yaḥ ।
tasya sāṃvatsarī pūjā niṣphalā bhavati kṛtā ।। 96 ।।
śrutvā putrapradāyāśca māhātmyaṃ mucyate tvaghāt ।
sukhaṃ svargaṃ paraṃ prāpya paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt । । 97।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrāvaṇaśuklaputradaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ pūrvabhavegavāparādhino vaṇijaḥ purūravo'vatāre'putrasya vratakaraṇe ūrvaśyāṃ putralābhaḥ pavitrāropaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 255।।


← adhyāyaḥ 255 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nārāyaṇasmaraṇena janmasaṃsārabandhanam ।
naśyatyeva janānāṃ vai vande nārāyaṇa tu tam ।। 1 ।।
kartāraṃ karaṇaṃ kāryaṃ preritāraṃ vibhuṃ prabhum ।
sukhadaṃ putradaṃ śāntipradaṃ vande patiṃ harim ।। 2 ।।
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa lakṣmīnātha ramāpate ।
māṇikyeśa prabhāsvāmin pārvatīśvara te namaḥ ।। 3 ।।
tvanmukhānme kathālābhe tṛptirnaiva hi jāyate ।
vada bhādrapade kṛṣṇe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā ।। 4 ।।
ko devaḥ kiṃ phalaṃ dāne deyaṃ puṣpādikaṃ ca kim ।
ko vidhistadvratasyā'sti vistarāt kathaya prabho ।। 5 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā lakṣmi! kathayiṣyāmi vistarāt ।
ajānāmnī bhādrakṛṣṇaikādaśī pāpanāśinī ।। 6 ।।
sundaryā tu sahaivā'rcyastasyāṃ devo janārdanaḥ ।
puṣpeṣu pāṭalā deyā tvarghye pūgīphalaṃ matam ।। 7 ।।
dāne tu mahiṣī deyā naivedye gūḍalaḍḍukāḥ ।
yathākālaṃ yathālabhyaṃ tathākāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 8 ।।
daśamyāmekabhuktena tathā bhāvyaṃ vratārthinā ।
svaptavyaṃ bhūtale rakṣaṇīyaṃ vai brahmaśīlakam ।। 9 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ prage dhyātvā nārāyaṇajanārdanam ।
snātvā pūjāṃ naityakīṃ tu kuryāt ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।। 1.256.10 ।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ bahustambhasuśobhitam ।
madhye tu sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayedvratī ।। 11 ।।
tanmadhye svarṇakalaśaḥ pañcaratnajalānvitaḥ ।
savastraphalapatropavītacandanataṇḍulaḥ ।। 1 2।।
sthāpanīyaśca tatpārśve ghaṇṭāṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca rakṣayet ।
pūjayedvidhinā mantraistilasthālī ghaṭe nyaset ।। 13 ।।
mūrtiṃ tu kānakīṃ janārdanasundarikāyutām ।
ajaikādaśikāṃ sthālyāṃ sthāpayed rājatīṃ ca vā ।। 14।।
āvāhanādibhiḥ pañcāmṛtairdravitacandanaiḥ ।
pūjayenmardayet devaṃ snāpayettīrthavāribhiḥ ।। 12 ।।
vastrālaṃkāraśṛṃgārābhūṣāhārādirājibhiḥ ।
sugandhidravyavaryaiśca dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ ।। 16।।
kuṃkumā'gurukastūrītailadravasusaurabhaiḥ ।
kajjalaśvetapāṇḍuracūrṇaśekharanaktakaiḥ ।। 17।।
yaṣṭyrupānahasacchatracāmarairyānavāhanaiḥ ।
ārārtrikastutinamrabhāvadaṇḍavadādibhiḥ ।। 18 ।।
puṣpāṃjalijalatāmbūlailālaṃvagacarvaṇaiḥ 19 ।
kṣamārthanādibhirdevaṃ pūjayedbahubhāvataḥ ।। 19 ।।
śayyāṃ svarṇamayīṃ satkomalāstaraṇasaṃyutām ।
dadyāddevāya cādarśapārśvakavyajanānvitām ।। 1.256.20 ।।
evaṃ samarcya govindaṃ vratārthaṃ prārthayed vratī ।
karomyajāvrataṃ kṛṣṇa nirvighnaṃ pūrṇatāmiyāt । । 21 ।।
dānaṃ dadyād vividhaṃ sadratnasārasuvarṇakam ।
dadyād gomahiṣīprabhṛtyapi dugdhānvitaṃ śubham ।। 22 ।।
madhyāhne'pi hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā nivedayet ।
meśubhaṃ mohanasthālaṃ mauktikāँścūrṇamodakān ।। 23 ।।
apūpāँśca tathā pūpān polikā miṣṭapolikāḥ ।
pūrikāḥ puṣpavaṭikā rājikārāddhamityapi । । 24 ।।
śākāni vividhānyāranālāni svādavanti ca ।
dadhidugdhapramiṣṭaṃ sadrasasārāṇi cārpayet ।। 25 ।।
dadyātphalāni pānīyaṃ mukhavāsādikaṃ tathā ।
sāyaṃ caiva mahatsamyagarcanaṃ kārayedvratī ।। 26 । ।
āndolayeddhariṃ preṃkhāṃ baddhvā vṛkṣādike'mbare ।
rātrau dugdhapracūraṃ vai bhojyaṃ dadyādbalapradam ।। 27 । ।
ārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ kṣāntyarthanaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ tathā ।
arpayedanyayogyaṃ yattvapekṣitamatho hareḥ ।। 28 ।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyagāyanavācanaiḥ ।
harekīrtināmabhaktyā kathāśravaṇakhelanaiḥ ।। 29 ।।
dvādaśyāṃ ca prage snātvā pūjayitvā janārdanam ।
bhojayitvā hariṃ dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca ।। 1.256.30 ।।
anyānsamāśritān miṣṭaṃ bhojayitvā sato dvijān ।
bālāँśca pāraṇāṃ paścāt kuryād vratī vratottare ।। 31 ।।
evaṃ kṛte vrate sarvakāmanā vratinaḥ phalet ।
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca sāmrājyaṃ yadicchet tadvratī vrajet ।। 3 2।।
īdṛgvidhaṃ vrataṃ lakṣmi! ye kurvanti tu mānavāḥ ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktāstridivaṃ yānti śāśvatam । । 33 । ।
śṛṇu kathāṃ vratayuktāṃ duḥkhanāśakarīṃ śubhām ।
hariścandrasya nṛpateḥ sakalatrasutasya vai । । 34। ।
vādau satyaguṇopetaḥ yuge satye babhūva saḥ ।
hariścandrābhidho rājā sāketapurabhūpatiḥ । । 35 । ।
sarayūsaritastīre pañcayojanavistṛtām ।
sāketanagarīṃ śāsan bhūpo rarakṣa tatprajāḥ । । 36 । ।
cakravartī satyasaṃdhaḥ samastāyā bhuvaḥ patiḥ ।
atithīnsma pūjayati yatheṣṭaṃ sma dadāti ca । । 37 । ।
nā'rthī kaścidgṛhāttasya nivartate na satkṛtaḥ ।
arthī yadicchati tattad dadātyeva tu sarvadā । । 38 । ।
viprā miṣṭānnabhikṣādyaiḥ kṣatriyā bahumānakaiḥ ।
vaiśyāḥ sahāyatālābhaiḥ śūdāścāśramamīlanaiḥ । । 39 । ।
devā yajñīyahavyānnaiḥ ṛṣayaścātitheyakaiḥ ।
munayo brahmabhaktyādyaiḥ sakāmā vāñchitārthakaiḥ । ।1.256.40 ।
nāryo vṛttipāla tādyairbālā vidyādiraṃjanaiḥ ।
anye yatheṣṭasamprāptaiḥ pūjyante tena sarvathā । । 41 । ।
tuṣṭāḥ sarve gṛhaṃ yānti sukhaṃ jīvanti tatprajāḥ ।
nā'sya rājye dhanahīno bhaktihīnaśca mānavaḥ ।।42 ।।
pitṛsevāvihīno na pramadāsu ghṛṇākaraḥ ।
vedaghoṣo yajñahomaścārthidānapravāhakaḥ ।। 42 ।।
sarvo dharmo harernāma pañcaka virarāma na ।
evaṃ vartayatastasya kīrtirdikṣu vidikṣu ca । । 44 । ।
vyāptā babhūva trailokye na satyāccalatīti saḥ ।
tadā brahmā hariḥ śaṃbhurviśvāmitrādayaḥ khalu । ।45 ।
parīkṣārthaṃ samāyātāḥ kiyatsatyaṃ nu lambate ।
hariścandreṇa sammānaṃ dvijarūpadhareṣu vai । । 46 ।
kṛtaṃ cātithyasevādi sveṣṭavyārtho niveditaḥ ।
viśvāmitrastataḥ prāha rājyaṃ sarvamapekṣyate । । 47 ।
dīyatāṃ me mahārāja nirṛṇo'haṃ bhavāmyataḥ ।
tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha jalaṃ muktvā dadau tataḥ । । 48 ।
rājyaṃ pragṛhya ca pṛthag yayāce dakṣiṇāṃ muniḥ ।
dakṣiṇārthaṃ pṛthagadrvyaṃ nāsīt tatpūrtaye nṛpaḥ । ।4 9 ।
babhūva rājyabhraṣṭo'sau sevākaiṃkaryamāptavān ।
vikrītvā vanitā putrau sa cakārātmavikrayam ।।1.256.5 0 ।
pulkasasya tu dāsatvaṃ prāpto rājā sa puṇyabhāg ।
śmaśāne satyamālambya mṛtacailāpahārakaḥ । ।।5 1 ।
so'bhavannṛpatipūjyo na satyāccalitaḥ khalu ।
evaṃ vai tasya nṛpaterbahavo vatsarā gatāḥ । । 52।
vetanaṃ tu dadātyeva viśvāmitrāya dakṣiṇām । -
tathāpi dakṣiṇā pūrṇā na jātā ṛṣituṣṭaye ।।5 3 ।
vastraṃ pātraṃ bhavellabdhaṃ sarvaṃ taddakṣiṇākṛte ।
dadātyeva prapūrtyarthaṃ svayaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu vindati ।।54।
evaṃ prapūritā karmacārikaiṃkaryavartinā ।
dakṣiṇā'pi tatā dāsyaṃ vṛttyarthaṃ prakaroti saḥ ।।55 ।
duḥkhasyā'nto na cāyātastataścintāparo'bhavat ।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi duḥkhasyā'ntaḥ kathaṃ bhavet । ।5 6 ।।
patnī vaṇiggṛ'he dāsī putrastvanyatra kiṃkaraḥ ।
ahaṃ śmaśānasevī cā'pyaho cāṇḍālakiṃkaraḥ ।।57।।
kva rājyaṃ kva ca kaiṃkarya cakraṃ māyāmayaṃ nvidam ।.
tathāpi duḥkhanāśaḥ syāttathā yatnaṃ karomi vai ।।58 ।।
iticintayatastasya magnasya duḥkhasāgare ।
ājagāma munistatra jñātvā rājānamāturam ।।59 ।।
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca prajāśīrvādapātraṃ nyāyavartinam ।
gautamākhyaḥ kṛpāluśca paropakṛtikārakaḥ ।।1.256.6 0 ।।
āśīrvādān dadau rājñe sukhī bhaveti sarvathā ।
nṛpo nanāma taṃ vipraṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
kathayāmāsa vṛttāntamātmano duḥkhasaṃbhṛtam ।
śrutvā sarvaṃ gautamastu babhūva cātivismitaḥ । । 62।।
duḥkhanistaraṇopāyaṃ vrataṃ tūpādideśa tam ।
māsi bhādrapade rājan kṛṣṇapakṣe'tipāvanī ।।63 ।।
ekādaśī tvajānāmnī bhavati duḥkhanāśinī ।
asyāḥ kuru vrataṃ rājan duḥkhadhvaṃso bhaviṣyati ।। 6 4।।
tava patnī vratamasyāḥ karotvapi sukhāvaham ।
putraste tvekabhuktaṃ vā vrataṃ kuryāt sukhāptaye ।। 65।।
ityādiṣṭo hariścandraścakārā'jāvrataṃ param ।
muniryayau ca tatpatnīṃ putraṃ nirdiśya tadvratam ।। 66 ।।
jagāma svāśramaṃ rājñī kumāraśca yathoditam ।
cakratuśca yathāśakti tvajāvratamaharniśam ।।6 7।।
kṛte tasmin vrate rājño duḥkhasyā'nto'bhavatkṣaṇāt ।
rājñyāścāpi ca kiṃkaryā duḥkhasyā'nto'bhavatkṣaṇāt ।। 68 ।।
putro mṛto'bhavattatra vratottaraṃ divā'pi saḥ ।
rohito jīvanaṃ prāpa vratasyaiva prabhāvataḥ ।। 69 ।।
tadduḥkhaṃ bahubhirvarṣairbhoktavyaṃ kṣayatāṃ gatam ।
nistīrṇaduḥkho rājā''sīd vratasyā'syāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।। 1.256.70 । ।
patnyā saha samāsaṃgaṃ putrajīvanamityapi ।
putreṇa ca samāsaṃgaṃ hariścandrastvavāpa vai ।। 71 ।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca viśvāmitrādayastadā ।
svasvarūpāḥ samāyātāḥ pratyakṣā duḥkhanuttaye । ।72 ।।
te satyasya parīkṣā'dya pūrṇā jāteti cocire ।
sarve devāśca devyaśca samāyātāstadutsave ।। 73 ।।
āśīrvādapradānārthaṃ hariścandrāya bhūbhṛte ।
divi dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavarṣamabhūd divaḥ ।।74।।
ekādaśyāḥ prabhāveṇa hariścandraḥ saputrakaḥ ।
sadāraśca svakaṃ sarvaṃ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam ।।75 ।।
bhuktvā tu bahuvarṣāṇi kṛtvā bhaktiṃ harestataḥ ।
putraṃ rājye sthāpayitvā patnyā saha virāgavān ।।76 ।।
svargaṃ lebhe hariścandraḥ sapuraḥ saparicchadaḥ ।
anantakālaṃ tad bhuktvā yayau sāketadhāma saḥ ।। 77।।
īdṛgvidhaṃ vrataṃ lakṣmi! ye kariṣyanti mānavāḥ ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sarvaduḥkhavihīnakāḥ ।।78 ।।
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ paraṃ sarve yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇād vāpi tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 79 ।।
tasmādasyāḥ kathā śravyā kartavyaṃ śraddhayā vratam ।
tadaṃgabhūtadānārcāpūjanaṃ vidhivattathā ।।1.256.8 0 ।।
vratakartā tadanyeṣāṃ pāpakṣālanako bhavet ।
svargaṃ prāpayitā cāpi yāmyādibhayavārakaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kimu tarhi svātmakṛte bhuktimuktisamarjane ।
samarthaśceti vaktavyaṃ nārāyaṇaprasaṃgataḥ ।।82।।
asyā vratī punarnaiva jāyate'tastvajā matā ।
ajā muktirbhavedasyā vratādasmādajā hi sā ।।8 3 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhādrapadakṛṣṇā'jaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ, viśvāmitrakṛtā hariścandrasya satyavrataparīkṣā, rājyastrīputrahāniḥ, gautamapradarśitā'jāvratena duḥkhanivṛttirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 256 ।।

śrīlakṣmīruvāca--
duḥkhahārinsukhakārinsampatkārinkṛpānidhe! ।
uddhārastvāṃ vinā naiva pāpināṃ jāyate dhruvam ।। 1 ।।
tava tvadīyabhaktānāṃ bhaved yasyopari kṛpā ।
mahāpāpātipāpo'pi śuddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
kāmātkrodhādbhayāllobhāllābhādvāpi samāśrayet। ।
yastvāṃ mucyeta saṃsāripāśānmuktiṃ labheta saḥ ।। 3 ।।
vrataṃ yajño dayā dānaṃ jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ japastapaḥ ।
tvamevā'si kṛpāsindho tvadyogānmuktidā ime ।। 4 ।।
vada bhādrapade śukle kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet ।
ko devaḥ ko vidhistasyāḥ kiṃ phalaṃ pūjanaṃ katham ।। 5 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
padmānāmnī bhādraśuklaikādaśī muktidāyinī ।
ṛṣikeśo'tra saṃpūjyastvaparājitayā saha ।। 6 ।।
kāśapuṣpāṇi pūjāyāṃ tilapāko nivedane ।
kūṣmāṇḍamarghye vai deyaṃ dāne brahmagṛhaṃ śubham । । 7 । ।
mandiraṃ bhavanaṃ saudhaṃ kārayeddharyadhiṣṭhitam ।
dadyādvai gurave devapūjakāya sumandiram । । 8 ।।
daśamyāmekabhaktena bhāvyaṃ tu vratinā niśi ।
kāryaṃ bhūśayanaṃ brahmavrataṃ rakṣyaṃ tu yatnataḥ । । 9 ।।
iyaṃ pārśvaparivartinyekādaśī harermatā ।
śeṣaśāyī parivartayati pārśvaṃ dine'tra vai । । 1.257.10 ।।
śayanyāṃ pārśvavartinyāṃ prabodhinyāṃ ca mānavaiḥ ।
vrataṃ niraśanaṃ kāryaṃ nirjalaṃ śaktito'pi ca । । 41 ।।
atrā'nnabhojinaḥ śūlaṃ pārśve dadati me'ghṛṇāḥ ।
tasmādannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ phalameva vā ।। 12 ।।
dugdhaṃ peyaṃ saśaktena nirjalaṃ samupoṣaṇam ।
kartavyaṃ tena bhagavāँstuṣyati kamalāpatiḥ । । 13 । ।
ekādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle samutthāya vratī harim ।
smareddhyāyecca nāmāni gṛṇan snānāya saṃvrajet । । 1 4। ।
snātvā ca naityikīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya vai vratī ।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ saddhānyaiḥ kārayecchubham । । 15 । ।
madhye ghaṭaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ tāmrajaṃ sthāpayecca vā ।
pañcaratnā'kṣatapuṣpajalavastraphalānvitam । । 16 ।।
śaṃkhaghaṇṭādisaṃyuktaṃ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ ।
sthālīṃ tilabhṛtāṃ dhṛtvā ghaṭopari tu tatra vai । । 1 7।।
ṛṣikeśā'parājitāpratimāṃ sthāpayed vratī ।
padmāṃ tvekādaśīṃ cāpi sthāpayetpūjayecca tām । । 18 । ।
āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtasnānādibhistathā ।
vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārakajalaiścandanādibhiḥ । । 19 । ।
hārakeyūrakaṭakairmukuṭaiḥ śekharādibhiḥ ।
pādukāyaṣṭinaktakapuṣpagucchāttarādibhiḥ । । 1.257.20 ।।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyairjalatāmbūlasatphalaiḥ ।
ārārtrikastutidaṇḍavannamanapradakṣiṇaiḥ । । 21 । ।
kṣamābhyarthanakusumāṃjalisaddakṣiṇādibhiḥ ।
prapūjya bhagavantaṃ ca vratanirvighnasiddhaye । । 22 । ।
prārthayecchrīhariṃ paścānnatvā kāryāntaraṃ caret ।
madhyāhne'pi bhagavate miṣṭānnānyarpayedvratī ।। 23 । ।
tāmbūlakaṃ vāripānaṃ tvarpayed vācayetkathām ।
aparāhṇe tataḥ sāyaṃ nīrājayedvidhānataḥ ।।24।।
stotraṃ ca kīrtanaṃ kuryād bhojayetpāyasādikam ।
tāmbūlaṃ salilaṃ dadyād dolāyāṃ cādhiveśayet ।।275।।
āndolayetsvayaṃ bhakto bhaktairanyaistu sāttvataiḥ ।
sādhvībhiḥ sādhubhiścaiva brahmacāribhirityapi ।।26।।
miliravā jāgaraṃ kuryāt sotsavaṃ gītipūrvakam ।
nāmadhūnayutaṃ nṛtyaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca kathāmṛtam ।। 27।।
kuryātkṛṣṇasya nikaṭe prātaḥ snātvā prapūjayet ।
bhojayedbhagavantaṃ ca prasādaṃ sātvatān janān ।।।28।।
dadyācca pāraṇāṃ tvanyān kārayitvā tataḥ svayam ।
vratī vai pāraṇāṃ kuryād dvādaśyāṃ dānamācaret ।।29।।
gomahiṣīgajavājiyānavimānavāhanam ।
gṛhodyānapuragrāmakṣetravastrānnasādhanam ।। 1.257.30 ।।
ratnahīrakamāṇikyamaṇisvarṇadhanādikam ।
khaṭvāśakaṭaparyaṃkapeṭāpātrakapāṭakam ।।3 1 ।।
bṛsīkṣaumāsanasiṃhāsanapaṭṭāsanakaṭam ।
preṃkhākusūlagendukaguptadorakarajjukam ।।32।।
granthagṛhopakaraṇaśṛṃkhalākuṇḍikātarūm ।
calavallīcalastambamṛgavyāghrādicarmakam ।। 33।।
vṛkṣattvagāsanavalkalakauśeyadhanādikam ।
yadyacchakyaṃ bhavetsvasya dadyāttaddvādaśīdine ।। 34।।
jalayānaṃ bhūmiyānaṃ vyomayānādikaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
dadyādācāryagurave yantraṃ bahuvidhaṃ tathā ।।35।।
dattaṃ pātre janairyat tatparaloke'bhipadyate ।
jñānadānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ kanyādānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ।।36।।
annadānaṃ jaladānaṃ vastradānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ।
godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ sādhanadānaṃ vratārpaṇam ।।।37।।
puṇyadānaṃ svasvakīyā'tipriyasyārpaṇaṃ tathā ।
svarge vā'nyatra yonau tad dātāramupagacchati ।। 38।।
tasmācchaktau pradātavyaṃ paralokasahāyakṛt ।
ihāmutra sukhadātṛ satāṃ sevanamācaret ।।3 9।।
yayā yayā prabhaktyā vai santastuṣyanti yadyathā ।
tathā tathā sevanīyāḥ santo vai harimūrtayaḥ ।।1.257.40 ।।
santo hareḥ svarūpāvatārā bhavanti bhūtale ।
prasevitā vrate santastuṣyanti yadi cāntare ।।41।।
tadā bhuktistathā muktiḥ sarvaṃ siddhaṃ vratārthinaḥ ।
hareḥ sevā satāṃ sevā sādhvīsevā'cyutārpaṇam ।।42।।
ātmajñānaṃ bhaktiyogo harerguṇānucintanam ।
brahmajñānaṃ yogasiddhiḥ pratyekaṃ mokṣasādhanam । ।43 ।।
vrataṃ tapo japo yogo yajñaścātmasamarpaṇam ।
kṛṣṇaprapattigatiyuk niścitaṃ mokṣasādhanam ।। 44।।
tasmād brahmasusambandhamayaṃ vrataṃ caredvratī ।
sakāmasya bhaved bhuktirakāmasya parā gatiḥ ।।45 । ।
parālayadhvaṃsakartuḥ svālayaṃ naśyati dhruvam ।
paragṛhadhvaṃsakasya svagṛhaṃ dhvaṃsate khalu । । 46।।
parahiṃsāprakartuśca svahiṃsā jāyate dhruvam ।
paraduḥkhapradātuśca svaduḥkhaṃ jāyate dhruvam ।। 47 । ।
anyasukhapradātuśca svasukhaṃ jāyate dhruvam ।
parasampatprahartuśca svasampannaśyati dhruvam ।। 48 । ।
anyanāśayituścātra svanāśo bhavati dhruvam ।
paradravyādihartuśca svadravyadhvaṃsanaṃ dhruvam । ।4 9 । ।
parastrīnāśakartuśca svastrīnāśo bhaved dhruvam ।
pareṣvagniviṣadāturnaije'gniviṣitā dhruvam । । 1.257.5 0 । ।
parapratārayituśca svapratāraṇakaṃ dhruvam ।
paragārhasthyabhaṃktuśca svagārhasthyalayo dhruvam ।।5 1 ।।
parakāmasukhaghnasya svakāmasukhanāśanam ।
paropakāraśīlasya svopakārasahāyanam ।।5 2 । ।
aindriyakasukhadātustvaindriyakasukhāgamaḥ ।
sādhanaistu sukhadātuḥ sādhanānāṃ samāgamaḥ । । 5 3 ।।
vighnakartustu vighnāni sukhadātuḥ sukhāni vai ।
sarvadātustu sarvāṇi hyupatiṣṭhanti niścitam ।। 54 । ।
tasmād dānāni sarvāṇi deyāni punarāptaye ।
dattaṃ vyarthaṃ na vai cātra paratrāpi ca lapsyate । । 55 । ।
adattānāṃ duḥkhitānāṃ dātṛ tvekādaśīvratam ।
kartavyaṃ tatprayatnena vāñchitaṃ dāsyati dhruvam ।।56 ।।
vyaktidoṣakṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ tatsamūhasya saṃbhavet ।
vyaktikṛtaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ samudāyasya jāyate ।। 57 । ।
samudāyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ vā bhavati nṛpe ।
nṛpakṛte puṇyapāpe prajānāṃ spṛśatastathā । । 58 ।।
yasya kasyāpi vai dharmalopena duḥkhitāḥ prajāḥ ।
tāvadduḥkhavināśāya kāryamekādaśīvratam ।। 59 । ।
tena pāpaṃ vinaśyedvai sukhaṃ syādatulaṃ khalu ।
māndhātṛnṛpatestādṛgjātaṃ kṛtayuge śṛṇu । । 1.257.60 । ।
māndhātā nāmarājarṣirvivasvadvaṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ।
udayāstamanakṣetracakravartī babhūva ha ।। 61 ।।
prajāḥ sa pālayāmāsa dharmeṇa svātmajāniva ।
tasya rājye na durbhikṣaṃ nā'dhayo vyādhayo na ca ।।62।।।
dhanadhānyasmṛddhiyuktaṃ rāṣṭraṃ svargamivā'sya vai ।
kośo'pi nyāyalabdhena dhanena śevadhisamaḥ ।।63 ।।
varṇāstathā''śramāḥ puṇyairvidyotante samedhitāḥ ।।
pṛthvī vasundharā kāmagāvaḥ kalpakarā drumāḥ ।।64।।
vāksiddhā brāhmaṇāstasya sādhavo yogabhūmayaḥ ।
nāryaścānandadāḥ śāntimatyo vilāsamaṃgalāḥ ।।65 ।।
ṛtavaḥ kāmakārāśca rāṣṭraṃ svargamivā'param ।
sukhamagnaṃ samabhūdvai bahusaukhyaṃ gatāḥ prajāḥ ।।66।।
brāhmaṇā brahmakarmasthāḥ kṣatriyā rakṣaṇapradāḥ ।
vaiśyā upārjanodyogaparāḥ śūdrāśca sevinaḥ ।।67।।
āsan svadharmayātāro tena rāṣṭramabhūt sukhi ।
tasyaivaṃ kurvato rājyaṃ grahāḥ saumyā sadā'bhavan ।।68 ।।
devā āsanprasannāśca maṃgalāni gṛhe gṛhe ।
athaiko bhaktarāṭ kaścid vṛṣalo rājyavātrchayā ।।69 ।।
samārebhe tapa ugramaraṇye nirjane tadā ।
śūdradharmaparityāgādṛṣidharmagrahāttathā ।।1.257.7 0 ।।
adharmasya vidharmasya praveśenā'sya rāṣṭrake ।
varṣatrayaṃ na vavṛṣurmeghāḥ prajāstu duḥkhitāḥ ।।7 1 ।।
bhagnā mṛtā janāḥ kecid babhūvuḥ kṣudhayā'rditāḥ ।
svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkāravedādhyayanapūjanam ।।72।।
vratopakārasanmānā''tithyadānādikaṃ tathā ।
śubhaṃ karmotsavādyaṃ ca sarvaṃ dhvastaṃ babhūva ha ।।73 ।।
deśastasya vibhāgyena babhūva daivapīḍitaḥ ।
tadā prajāḥ samāgatya prāhurnṛpeśvaraṃ tvidam ।।74।।
śṛṇu rājan vinā vṛṣṭiṃ rāṣṭrocchedo bhavatyayam ।
parjanyarūpo bhagavān viṣṇurvāriṣu saṃsthitaḥ ।।75।।
sa eva kurute vṛṣṭiṃ vṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ ।
vṛṣṭyabhāve mahārāja kṣayaṃ prayānti te prathāḥ ।।76।।
tasmād vidhehi rājendra yogakṣemam yathā bhavet ।
śrutvā prāha mahībhartā yathā kṣemaṃ prajājane ।।77।।
syāttathā prayatiṣye'haṃ rājamūlaṃ sukhaṃ yataḥ ।
nṛpāṇāmapacāreṇa prajānāṃ pīḍanaṃ bhavet ।।78 ।।
nā'hamājanmataḥ kvāpi kṛtavānpātakaṃ tathā ।
tathāpi prayatiṣye'haṃ prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।।79।।
ityuktvā saprajo rājā parimeyaparicchadaḥ ।
pāpā'nveṣaṇasannaddho deśayātrāṃ cakāra saḥ ।।1.257.8 0 ।।
śrutaṃ lokamukhāttena gahane himavadvane ।
śūdrastapati so'yaṃ te rājye vidharma eva yat। । ।8 1 ।।
brāhmaṇānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ dhārmikaṃ tapaḥ ।
śūdrāṇāṃ sevanaṃ dharmastapo vidharma eva yat ।।8 2 ।।
śūdrakṛtatapodoṣādavagraho'dya jāyate ।
so'yaṃ śūdrataporodhe dharmo vṛṣṭimayo bhavet। । ।8 3 ।।
śrutvā mahīpatiḥ śīghraṃ jagāma gahanaṃ vanam ।
cacāra munimukhyāँśca svāśramāँstāpasaiḥ śritān । ।84 ।।
dadarśā'tha brahmaputramṛṣimaṃgirasaṃ nṛpaḥ ।
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptānanaṃ yathā tu padmajam । ।85 ।।
rājā kṛtāṃjalirnamraścakre tatpādayornamaḥ ।
muniḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ rāṣṭre caivā'pyanāmayam । ।86 ।।
dattāsane hyupaviśya māndhātā pratyuvāca tam ।
bhagavandharmavidhinā mama pālayato mahīm ।।87।।
anāvṛṣṭiśca saṃjātā pīḍyante sakalāḥ prajāḥ ।
varṣatrayaṃ vyatītaṃ ca bhavet kimatra kāraṇam ।।88 । ।
śūdrastapaḥ karotīti śrutaṃ lokamukhānmayā ।
tathāpi nirṇayaṃ brūhi bhavet kimatra kāraṇam । । 89 ।।
yogakṣemavidhānena prajānāṃ kuru nirvṛtim ।
aṃgirāḥ prāha nṛpatiṃ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā nijāntare । । 1.257.90 ।।
asmin kṛtayuge dharmaścatuṣpādaḥ pravartate ।
atra brahmaparā lokā brāhmaṇāśca tapaḥparāḥ ।। 91 । ।
tapasyanye'dhikṛtā na panthā hyeṣaḥ kṛte yuge ।
satyeva viṣaye te'tra vṛṣalo'pi tapaḥ paraḥ ।। 92 ।।
tadvidharmaprabhāveṇa na varṣanti balāhakāḥ ।
kuru tasya vadhe yatnaṃ nātidūre vane'sti saḥ । । 93 । ।
evaṃkṛte tvanāvṛṣṭirna syād rājankadācana ।
śrutvā prāha mahābhāgavato rājā dayāparaḥ । । 94 । ।
nā'hamenaṃ haniṣyāmi tapasyantaṃ śubhakriyam ।
taporodhaṃ kariṣyāmi śanaireva miṣāntare । । 95 ।।
yadi syātsādhanaṃ kiñcidanyadvṛṣṭikaraṃ tadā ।
darśayaitatkaromyeva hyupasargavināśanam ।। 96।।
aṃgirā prāha rājānaṃ yadyevaṃ tarhi śobhanam ।
kuruṣva kṣemadaṃ padmābhidhaikādaśikāvratam । । 97 ।।
sarvasiddhipradaṃ caitatsarvopadravanāśakam ।
sarvaśāntikaraṃ yogakṣemadaṃ padmikāvratam । । 98 ।।
kuru padmāvrataṃ rājan saprajaḥ saparicchadaḥ ।
padmāvrataprabhāveṇa suvṛṣṭirbhavitā dhruvam ।। 99 ।।
ityājñāṃ śirasā dhṛtvā pūjayitvā ca taṃ munim ।
śūdrataponirodhāya niyujya karmacāriṇam ।। 1.257.10 0।।
smaran kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdaye sve rājā svagṛhamāgataḥ ।
bhādramāse site pakṣe padmāvratamathā'karot ।। 101 ।।
prajābhiḥ saha sarvābhiścāturvarṇyasamanvitaḥ ।
kṛtvā vrataṃ cakārā'sau dānāni haripūjanam ।। 10 2।।
evaṃ vrate kṛte lakṣmi! pravavarṣa balāhakaḥ ।
bhūmirjalena saṃtṛptā tvabhavatsasyaśālinī ।। 103 ।।
ekādaśīvratapuṇyāt nāśito'vagraho drutam ।
tasmātpadmāvrataṃ kāryaṃ duḥkhā''pannāśanāya ca ।। 104।।
tatra dadhyodanaṃ cāpi vastraratnayuto ghaṭaḥ ।
jalapūrṇaśca kalaśaśchatropānahamityapi ।। 1 05।।
govindabuddhyā dātavyā gurau brahmavidi dvije ।
namaskāryastathā bhojyaistoṣaṇīyo gururdvijaḥ ।। 1 06।।
evaṃ vrataṃ paraṃ kṛtvā janaśceṣṭamavāpnuyāt ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya vratapuṇyaṃ hi labhyate ।। 1 07।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhādraśuklapadmaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ māndhātuḥ rājye satyayuge śūdre tapati vṛṣṭeravagrahaḥ, vratena vṛṣṭirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।257।।
