adhyāyaḥ 258
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 259 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
namo namaste govinda ṛṣikeśa janārdana ।
sākṣinprayojaka svāminnārāyaṇa niyāmaka ।। 1 ।।
dṛśyaprada dṛśerdātardraṣṭṛtvena vyavasthita ।
bījapradāṃ'kurātman prastambapatrādiṣu sthita ।। 2 ।।
kāṇḍanālasupuṣpastha bījātmaka namo'stu te ।
phalaprada phale tiṣṭhan svayaṃ phalasi tadṛtau ।। 3 ।।
karmabījaphalavyāpin vṛṣṭibīja namo'stu te ।
vadā''śvinā'sitapakṣe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet ।। 4 ।।
ko vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ cāsyāḥ kīdṛśaṃ ca vrataṃ matam ।
ko devaḥ pūjyate cātra dānādyaṃ pūjanādi kim ।। 5 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
āśvine kṛṣṇapakṣe'sti tvindirānāmanāmataḥ ।
upendraḥ subhagāyuktaḥ pūjyo dūrvābhiratra vai ।। 6 ।।
āmalakīphalaṃ cā'rghye śaṣkulī tu nivedane ।
kanyādānaṃ pradhānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ sāṃgameva yat ।। 7 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ kartavyaṃ tṛptidaṃ śubham ।
agatīnāṃ gatikṛcca vrataṃ śrāddhādisaṃyutam ।। 8 ।।
daśamyāmekabhukto'syā vratī brahmacaro bhavet ।
bhūśāyī saṃyamī prātastvekādaśyāṃ vrataṃ caret ।। 9 ।।
utthāya śrīhariṃ smṛtvā dhyātvā mūrtiṃ harestataḥ ।
snātvā pūjāṃ prakuryācca naityikīṃ śuddhamānasaḥ ।। 1.258.10 ।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā ca sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।
ghaṭaṃ suvarṇajanyaṃ vā tāmrajaṃ sthāpayennavam ।। 1 1।।
pañcaratnasupallavaphalavāryambarānvitam ।
ghaṭopari tilasthālīṃ sthāpayedvai prapūritām ।। 12।।
pārśvetvāmānnamevātra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ tathā ।
jalaṃ tīrthāhṛtaṃ pātre sthāpayecca kuśāँstathā ।। 1 3।।
śarkarāphalapiṣṭādi vinyasyetpārśvatastadā ।
mūrtiṃ ca kānakīṃ tatropendrasya subhagāyutām ।। 14।।
indirāsahitāṃ tilasthālyāṃ saṃsthāpayedvratī ।
gaṇeśaṃ pūjayitvā ca śaṃkhaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ ghaṭaṃ tathā ।। 15।।
pūjayitvā tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi smṛtvā vicintayet ।
mastake mastakaṃ cāstu netrādau harinetrakam ।। 16।।
hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ cāstu hastādau tatkarādikam ।
kaṭyādau tasya kaṭyādi pādayorharipatkajam ।। 17।।
mamāṃgeṣu hareraṃgāni santvātmani keśavaḥ ।
ityevaṃ sarvatobhāvāt devo bhūtvā'rcayeddharim ।। 18।।
āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt paṃcāmṛtābhiṣecanam ।
śuddhodakā''plavanaṃ ca kārayitvā'mbarārpaṇam ।। 1 9।।
keśaprasādhanādyaṃ cā'ttarasugandhikārcanam ।
gulālakuṃkumā'bīracandanākṣatapūjanam ।।1.258.20 ।।
alaktakā''rdracūrṇādiraṃgakajjalaraṃjanam ।
kuryāddevasya sarvāṃgeṣvatha bhūṣādi dhārayet ।।21 ।।
śṛṃgāraśobhitāṃ mūrtiṃ puṣpahārādibhistataḥ ।
kaṭakamukuṭādyaiśca surūpairūpayedbahu ।। 22।।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlacūrṇakam ।
ārārtrikastutipradakṣiṇadaṇḍavadādikam ।।23।।
dakṣiṇā'kṣatakusumāṃjalidānaṃ kṣamāpanam ।
vidhivatsarvatobhāvayuktena vratī cetasā ।।24।।
dadyāt kuryācca yadyogyaṃ yācetā'vighnatāṃ vrate ।
pitṝnsmṛtvā pradadyācca prasādāḍhyajalāँjalim ।। 25।।
dadyāddānāni vai prātarmadhyāhne'pi prapūjayet ।
bhojayed vividhānnāni devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ।।26।।
madhyāhnottarakāle ca pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret ।
pitṛtīrthena salilaṃ dadyāttattatsunāmabhiḥ ।।27।।
piṇḍān dadyāt phalānyanyat tṛptidaṃ cārpayet pitṝn ।
sāyaṃ nīrājanaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetparameśvaram ।।28।।
bhojayed dugdhapākādi jalapānādi cārpayet ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātsādhusaṃgatimācaret ।।29।।
kathāṃ kuryāttathā bhaktācchṛṇuyācca paṭhecca vā ।
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ prakuryācca samutsāhamahotsavam ।।।1.258.3 0।।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ।
datvā naivedyamīśāya bhojayedvaiṣṇavāँstataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
āśritān bhojayitvā ca sādhūn sādhvīrdvijāँstataḥ ।
pāraṇāṃ ca vratī kuryād dadyād dānāni pātrake ।।32।।
guruṃ ca mātaraṃ vṛddhān pitaraṃ pūjayetpatim ।
āśīrvādāँśca gṛhṇīyāt kuryātkāryaṃ svakaṃ tataḥ ।।33।।
evaṃ kṛte vrate lakṣmi! vāñchitaṃ siddhyati dhruvam ।
pitṛtṛptikaraṃ bhojyaṃ jalaṃ vastrādi dāpayet ।। 34।।
pitruddhārakaraṃ dānaṃ gavāṃ tvanyacca kārayet ।
gṛhodyānapaśukṣetrakanyāvidyāsuvāhanam ।।35।।
svarṇaratnavibhūṣānnavividhopaskarānvitam ।
dāpayet pitṛsantuṣṭibuddhyaiva śraddhayā vratī ।। 26 ।।
gurave haraye dadyāt pitṛmuktikaraṃ bhavet ।
bhuktidānmuktidaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tato muktidamācaret ।।37।।
yasmādyasya bhavedicchāśāntyarthaṃ vāñchanā tvati ।
tena tasya prakartavyā vāñchāyāḥ śāntiranyathā ।। 38।।
vaiparītyaṃ bhavet pitratṛptito vaṃśajasya vai ।
tasmātkāmaphalaṃ cā'pyakāmaphalakamityapi ।।39।।
kuryādvai vaṃśajaḥ pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ kāla āgate ।
iṣakṛṣṇe vrate kuryād viśeṣaphalatṛptikṛt ।।1.258.40।।
svalpaṃ vā vipulaṃ vāpi dadyāt tattatsunāmabhiḥ ।
paralokagatānāṃ tatsukhadaṃ bhavati dhruvam ।।41 ।।
pitaro yadi muktisthāstadā kartuḥ phalaṃ matam ।
kṛtaṃ na niṣphalaṃ yāyāditi kṛtvā''cared budhaḥ ।।42।।
bījaṃ vai cāṃkuraṃ dadyātpatraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam ।
na yāti niṣphalaṃ kṣetre śraddhāvāryabhiṣecanam ।।43 ।।
uṣare kṣīyate bījaṃ kṣetre pātre na naśyati ।
tīrthe pātre satpuruṣe kṣiptaṃ dhruvaṃ prarohati ।।44।।
vrate pātre harau dadyād kṣiptaṃ cāpi na niṣphalam ।
tasmātsvalpaṃ bahulaṃ vā phalasandhānavarjitam ।।45।।
dadyātpratiphalatyeva haryanugrahakāraṇāt ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ ramyāṃ vratena pitṛtṛptidām ।।46 ।।
adhoyonigatānāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ gatidāyinī ।
indiraikādaśī śreṣṭhā vājapeyaphalapradā ।।47।।
indrasenena vai rājñopoṣitā pitṛtāraṇī ।
nārmadākhye mahārāṣṭre candrāvatīpurīpatiḥ ।।48।।
indrasenākhyanṛpatirbabhūva prākkṛte yuge ।
dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrānivaurasān ।।49।।
putrapautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ ।
gajavājiyānayukto viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।।1.258.50 ।।
japan śrīharināmāni muktidāni tu sarvadā ।
kālaṃ nayati bhaktyaivā'dhyātmadhyānavicintakaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
tasyaikadā gṛhe śāntyā''sīnasya purato muniḥ ।
nārado vyomamārgeṇā'vatīrya samupasthitaḥ ।।52।।
āgataṃ nāradaṃ vīkṣya pratyutthāya kṛtāṃjaliḥ ।
kṛtātithyaṃ muniṃ bṛṣyāsane ramye nyaveśayat ।।53।।
provāca svāgataṃ te'haṃ karomi brahmavittama ।
adya me saphalaṃ rājyaṃ janma karma kulaṃ dhanam ।।54।।
dānaṃ kraturjapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ saphalā mama ।
tvatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha bhāgyaṃ dhanyatamaṃ mama ।।55।।
sutapraputradārādidāsadāsīśatāni me ।
gajavājivāhanāni saphalāni tavā''gamāt ।।56 ।।
sādhorvai darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sparśanaṃ pāpanāśakam ।
sevanaṃ svargadaṃ divyamokṣadaṃ tvātmano'rpaṇam ।।57।।
yeṣāṃ gṛhe na sādhūnāṃ caraṇadhūlikārajaḥ ।
tāni śmaśānatulyāni bhavanāni gṛhāṇi ca ।।58।।
tāritaṃ mama sambandhikuṭumbaṃ sarvameva yat ।
prasādaṃ kuru devarṣe nispṛhā''gamakāraṇam ।।59।।
nāradaḥ prāha rājarṣe śṛṇu vismayakārakam ।
brahmalokādahaṃ prāpto yamalokaṃ mahīpate ।।1.258.60 ।।
dharmeṇa satkṛto bhaktyā hyupaviṣṭo varāsane ।
dharmarājaṃ satyaśīlā dhārmikāḥ samupāsate ।।6 1 ।।
teṣāṃ sadasi pṛṣṭhasthaṃ nistejaskaṃ sthitaṃ tava ।
pitaraṃ prahasantyanye bahupuṇyātimāninaḥ ।।62।।
sabhāyāṃ śrāddhadevasya prāha mahyaṃ pitā tava ।
sandeśaṃ duḥkhanāśāya taṃ nibodha mahīpate ।।6 3 ।।
indrasena iti khyātaṃ candrāvatyā nṛpaṃ sutam ।
brahman kathaya sandeśaṃ pitā te candrasenakaḥ ।।64।।
tiṣṭhati dharmarājasya nagaryāṃ puṇyapuṃjataḥ ।
dānaṃ bahukṛtaṃ tena na kṛtaṃ vratameva yat ।।65।।
tena puṇyena dharmasya nagaryāmasti saṃsthitaḥ ।
vratapuṇyena vidhuro nistejasko'tipṛṣṭhagaḥ ।।66।।
niṣīdati sabhāyāṃ vai cātiduḥkhānvitaḥ sadā ।
tasmāt kuryād vrataṃ caikādaśyā uddiśya māṃ sutaḥ ।।67।।
mokṣaṃ kuryātsa me putra indirāpuṇyadānataḥ ।
ityukto'haṃ samāyātaḥ samīpaṃ tava bhūpate ।।68।।
piturmokṣakṛte rājannindirāvratamācara ।
tvatpitā tena puṇyena vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ।।69।।
śrutvā pituḥ sa sandeśaṃ nāradaṃ pṛṣṭhavān vratam ।
vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ kasmin pakṣe tithau tathā ।।1.258.70।।
nāradaḥ prāha rājānamāśvinā'sitapakṣake ।
daśamyāṃ prātarutthāya smṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ tataḥ param ।।71।।
snātvā devaṃ pūjayitvā madhyāhne snānamācaret ।
datvā haraye naivedyamekabhuktaṃ samācaret ।।72।।
sāyaṃ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā rātrau bhūmau śayīta ca ।
ekādaśyāṃ prabhāte'yaṃ vratī nidrāṃ vihāya vai ।।73।।
smṛtvā dhyātvā hariṃ nāma raṭan śaucādikaṃ caret ।
mukhaprakṣālanaṃ kuryājjalairdvādaśadhā muhuḥ ।।74।।
snānaṃ tīrthajalaiḥ kuryād devapūjāṃ samācaret ।
harermūrtiṃ namaskṛtyā''camanādigrahottaram ।।75।।
ṣoḍaśopaskaraiḥ kṛṣṇamupendraṃ pūjayed vratī ।
upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyācca tadagrataḥ ।।76।।
adya sthitvā nirāhāraḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ ।
śvo bhokṣye puṇḍarīkākṣa vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru prabho ।।77।।
evaṃ niyamamāsthāya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।
ghaṭe kṛṣṇaṃ sthāpayitvā mahāpūjanamācaret ।।78।।
samāpya vidhinā pūjāṃ nīrājayecca bhojayet ।
madhyāhnepi svayaṃ snātvā śrīhariṃ bhojayettathā ।।79।।
nīrājayet svāpayeccotthāpayet pāyayejjalam ।
vījayenmardayennāthaṃ sukhayediṣṭadānakaiḥ ।।1.258.80 ।।
śālagrāmaśilāgre ca śrāddhaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi ।
pitṝṇāṃ prītaye śrāddhaṃ kuryāt śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
godhūmacūrṇairyacchrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tanmadhyamaṃ bhavet ।
yavairvrīhitilairmāṣairgodhūmaiścaṇakaistathā ।।82।।
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ vratinā tu taiḥ ।
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vratinā na bhoktavyaṃ pitṛsevitam ।।83।।
vratarakṣaṇalābhāya ghrātavyameva cārpitam ।
paitryamannaṃ samāghrāya gave dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ।।84।।
rātrau mahārcanaṃ kuryājjāgaraṃ sotsavaṃ tathā ।
dvādaśyāṃ prātarevā'yaṃ snātvā samarcya mādhavam ।।85।।
naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle tvarpayitvā tato vratī ।
ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā kṣamāyācanikāṃ tathā ।।86।।
dadyād dānāni bhūrīṇi brāhmaṇādīn prabhojayet ।
sādhūnsādhvīrbhojayecca bandhūn dauhitraputrakān ।।87।।
bhojayitvā ca dīnāndhān svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ।
anena vidhinā rājan kuru vratamatandritaḥ ।।88।।
viṣṇulokaṃ prayāsyanti pitarastava bhūpate ।
ityuktvā nṛpatiṃ lakṣmi! nārado'ntaradhīyata ।।89।।
yathoktavidhinā hīndrasenaścakāra tadvratam ।
antaḥpureṇa sahitaḥ putrabhṛtyasamanvitaḥ ।।1.258.90 ।।
kṛte vrate gavāṃ dāne puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūd divaḥ ।
puṇyārpaṇe kṛte cendrasenasya janakaḥ khalu ।।9 1।।
candrasenastathā'nye tatpitaro'pi vyavasthitāḥ ।
garuḍasthā vimānasthā yayurvai viṣṇumandiram ।।92।।
indraseno'pi kṛtvā tadvrataṃ vaiṣṇavapālitāḥ ।
rājyaṃ tvakaṇṭakaṃ bhuktvā datvā jyeṣṭhasutāya ca ।।93।।
mahīsenāya tatpaścājjagāma tridivaṃ svayam ।
tatra puṇyaṃ samāpyaiva vaikuṇṭhamagamaddhi saḥ ।।94।।
ityevaṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ lakṣmi te kathitaṃ mayā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratapuṇyaṃ bhavedapi ।।9 5।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āśvinakṛṣṇendiraikādaśīvratamāhātmyam, indrasenanṛpapitṛcandrasenaprabhṛtīnāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vratapuṇyabalād yamalokānmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।258।।।


← adhyāyaḥ 258 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 259
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 260 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
sarvapuṇyamayo devastvameva bhagavān svayam ।
dadāsi karuṇāsindhuḥ phalāni karmaṇāṃ yathā ।। 1 ।।
tvāṃ vismṛtyā'nutiṣṭhanti kurvanti mānavāstu yat ।
tatphalaṃ labhyate cātra paratra bhayayuk tu taiḥ ।। 2 ।।
tvāṃ smṛtvā ye'nutiṣṭhanti kurvanti yāni yāni vai ।
tatphalaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityānandamokṣātmakaṃ tvayā ।। 3 ।।
dayite bhagavaँstasmai śaraṇāgatiśāline ।
evaṃ phalapradātā'si sarvakarmamayo'si yat ।। 4 ।।
sarvajño'si kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vada me parameśvara ।
āśvinaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet ।। 5 ।।
ko devastatra saṃpūjyaḥ ko vidhiḥ kiṃphalaṃ tathā ।
kiṃ dānaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ vada sarvaṃ hare'tra me ।। 6 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca -
iṣaśuklaikādaśī tu nāmnā pāśāṃkuśā matā ।
sarvapāpaharā puṇyapradā mokṣapradā tathā ।। 7 ।।
padmanābhaḥ padmavatyā saha pūjyo'tra bhaktitaḥ ।
śamīpatrāṇi pūjāyāmarghye kāmaphalaṃ matam ।। 8 ।।
śālipākastu naivedye dāne taṇḍulamodakāḥ ।
sarvābhīṣṭaphalaprāptyai sarvaṃ deyaṃ janārdane ।। 9 ।।
tapastaptvā cātitīvraṃ ciraṃ muniryatendriyaḥ ।
yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tannatvā padmanābhakam ।। 1.259.10 ।।
bahupāpāni kṛtvāpi mohito mānavo vrate ।
padmanābhaṃ hariṃ natvā na yāti narakaṃ hi saḥ ।। 11 ।।
pṛthivyāṃ tīrthamātrāṇi puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ।
kṛtāni tena sarvāṇi padmanābhaprapūjanāt ।। 12 ।।
devadevaṃ padmanābhaṃ ye prapannā janārdanam ।
na teṣāṃ yamalokasya yātanā'sti kadācana ।। 13 ।।
ekāmekādaśīṃ kṛtvā prasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ ।
yadyapi ghorapāpastho na yāti yamayātanām ।। 14।।
nedṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate ।
yādṛśī padmanābhasyaikādaśī pāpanāśinī ।। 15 ।।
tāvatpāpāni vai vyaktau nirbhayāni vasanti hi ।
yāvannopāvasetprāṇī padmanābhadinavrate ।। 16।।
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca ।
ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।। 17।।
naikādaśīsamaṃ loke pāpakṣālanakārakam ।
svargamokṣapradaṃ tvatra dhanamitrādidāyakam ।। 18 ।।
śarīrārogyadaṃ dārāsutaputrīkulapradam ।
vyājenāpi kṛtaṃ yena na sa yāti yamālayam ।। 19 ।।
na gaṃgā na gayā lakṣmi! na kāśī na ca puṣkaram ।
na cāpi kauravaṃ kṣetraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ harerdināt ।। 1.259.20 ।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ kāryaṃ mahārcanam ।
nirjalaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ harerdine hyupoṣaṇam ।। 21 ।।
tena vai labhyate lakṣmi! śāśvataṃ dhāma vai mama ।
daśaiva mātṛpakṣīyāḥ pitṛpakṣasthitā daśa ।। 22 ।।
daśa patnīpakṣagatā uddharanti vratād dhruvam ।
caturbhujā divyarūpā garuḍāṃ'sakṛtā''sanāḥ ।। 23 ।।
sragviṇaḥ pītavastrāste viṣṇutulyaparākramāḥ ।
nāryo lakṣmīsamā bhūtvā prayānti harimandiram ।। 24।।
bālatve yauvane vāpi vārdhakye pāravaśyake ।
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ dehī naiti pāpo'pi durgatim ।। 25।।
pāśāṃkuśāmupoṣyaiva harerlokaṃ prayāti vai ।
datvā hematilān gāśca jalamannaṃ tathā'mbaram ।। 26 ।।
upānacchatramanyadvā yamalokaṃ na paśyati ।
puṇyavratavihīnasya jīvanaṃ niṣphalaṃ matam ।। 27।।
yasya puṇyavihīnāni dinānyāyānti yānti ca ।
sa lohakārabhastreva śvasannapi na jīvati ।। 28 ।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ dhyānaṃ satrādikaṃ tathā ।
samācaran yathāśakti hyavandhyaṃ divasaṃ nayet ।। 29।।।
dīrghāyuṣo dhanāḍhyāśca kulīnā rogavarjitāḥ ।
dṛśyante mānavā loke puṇyakartāra īdṛśāḥ ।। 1.259.30 ।।
tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ pāśāṃkuśādinātmakam ।
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād brahmacārī bhavettathā । ।3 1 ।।
bhūśāyī syānniśi prātaḥ snātvā svanaityakārcanam ।
kuryāt ṣoḍaśasaṃcārairarthayed vratapūrṇatām ।। 32।।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayetsaptadhānyakaiḥ ।
madhye ghaṭaṃ vāripūrṇaṃ paṃcaratnasamanvitam ।। 33 ।।
dhanapūrṇaṃ ca vā kṛtvā savastraṃ saphalaṃ nyaset ।
ghaṭopari tilasthālīṃ sthāpayetkānakīṃ śubhām ।। 34।।
mūrtiṃ śrīpadmanābhasya padmāvatyanvitāṃ śubhām ।
pāśāṃkuśāsahitāṃ ca sthāpayedarcayettathā ।। 35 ।।
āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtādibhistataḥ ।
tīrthajalairhariṃ saṃsthāpayed vastrāṇi dhārayet ।। 36 ।।
candanā'ttarasaugandhyaṃ tvarpayetkajjalādikam ।
puṣparatnasuvarṇādihārābhūṣāḥ samarpayet ।। 37।।
bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyājjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ samarpayet ।
mukhavāsaṃ phalaṃ datvā nīrājayennamenmuhuḥ ।। 38 ।।
stutvā pradakṣiṇādaṇḍavataḥ kṛtvā'rthayetkṣamām ।
dhūpadīpādisaṃjuṣṭe dolāṃ vyomni prabandhayet ।। 39।।
hariṃ saṃsthāpayettatra madhyāhne'pi subhojayet ।
tāmbūlajalapānādi datvā sāyaṃ tathā''caret ।।1.259.40 ।।
ṣoḍaśopaskaraiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcyārārtrikādikam ।
kuryātsarvaṃ suvidhinā bhojyaṃ peyaṃ samarpayet ।। 41।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād bhāgavateṣu saṃsthitaḥ ।
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gītaṃ kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā ।।।2।।
vandanaṃ caraṇāṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ sevanādikam ।
kuryātprātarhariṃ dhyātvā snātvā saṃpūjya keśavam ।।43।।
bhojayedbhagavantaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ jalamarpayet ।
sādhūn sādhvīḥ svāśritāँśca bhojayenmānayettataḥ ।।44।।
vṛddhānnatvā hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā paṃcamakhān pṛthak ।
tato vai pāraṇāṃ kuryād dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ।।45।।
evaṃ vrataṃ samāpyaiva dvādaśyāṃ vai hariṃ bhajet ।
bhavapāśavināśo'sya vratino bhavati dhruvam ।।46 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ divyāṃ yamapāśavimocanīm ।
āsītpūrve kṛtayuge vāmadevābhidhaḥ ṛṣiḥ ।।47।।
āsan śiṣyā aneke'sya brahmavettṛsamagragāḥ ।
munayastyāginaścānye gṛhasthā brahmavittamāḥ ।।48।।
snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ।
kurvanti sma ravau prāpte ratāḥ prāptaḥ svakarmasu ।।49।।
ekasteṣu karmakāṇḍī ṛṣirvedaśirā iti ।
nāmnā'bhavatsuvaidikakriyāniṣṇāta eva ca ।।1.259.50।।
cāturmāsyaṃ vratī kandāhāraṃ kurvannināya saḥ ।
kandavikṛtijanyo vai rogastasyodare'bhavat ।।51 ।।
jāṭharasyātimandatvamāntrāṇāmuṣṇaphullatā ।
apācanaṃ bhavatyasya yatkiṃcidbhakṣitaṃ bhavet ।।52।।
evaṃ śarīrakṣīṇatve'śaktiḥ samyag vyavardhata ।
ālasyaṃ snānagāyatrījapapūjādike'bhavat ।।53।।
evaṃ nityaṃ kṣīṇabhāvāt tyaktvā snānaṃ ca pūjanam ।
śūdravad vartayandehayātrāṃ karoti vai muniḥ ।।54।।
karmatyāgena ca vedaśirasaḥ pratyavāyakam ।
jātaṃ tatpratyavāyena puṇyaṃ vai kṣīṇatāṃ gatam ।।55।।
āyuṣyāntaḥ samāyāto yāmyā netuḥ samāgatāḥ ।
vedaśirāstadā samyagākulo hyavadattu tān ।।56।।
kathaṃ me yamadūtānāṃ darśanaṃ kena karmaṇā ।
pratyūcuryamadūtāstaṃ vedakarma vihāya vai ।।57।।
yatheṣṭaṃ vartase tvaṃ yatphalaṃ tad yāmyavāsadam ।
utpathapratipannasya brāhmaṇasya yamālayaḥ ।।58।।
prāyaścittārthamevāsti bhuṃkṣva tatpratyavāyakam ।
uktvaivaṃ bedaśirasaṃ yayurnītvā yamagṛham ।।59।।
yamarājastadīyaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā karma yathārthataḥ ।
citraguptaṃ tadā prāha pratyavāyo'sya vai mahān ।।1.259.60 ।।
adhītavedavismārātmakaṃ yatpātakaṃ mahat। ।
brahmahatyāsamaṃ proktaṃ pāśairbadhvā hi nīyatām ।।6 1 ।।
pātyatāṃ narake brahmaghātināṃ kālasūtrake ।
asipatravane tvenaṃ nītvā saṃpraharantvapi ।।62।।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau yamarājastu nītikṛt ।
vedaśirāstadā prāha yamarājaṃ subuddhimān ।।63।।
āpatkāle śarīrasya mayā vedastu vismṛtaḥ ।
tyaktaṃ karmā'pyaśaktyā vai kathaṃ me narakaṃ bhavet ।।64।।
āpatkālasya dharmā vai nā'dharmagaṇanāṃ gatā ।
tasmātpāpaṃ na me tvasti nāsti me yamapūrakam ।।65।।
dharmarājastataḥ prāha yāvadrāgo'pi vidyate ।
tāvadāpatkṛto dharmo rugṇā'bhāve sa no mataḥ ।।।66।।।
svalpāpadi bahutyāgaḥ sa tvadharmo mahānmataḥ ।
na te'sti tādṛśo rogo yena noccāritā śrutiḥ ।।67।।
vismṛtā ca tvayā tvālasyena vai sakalā śrutiḥ ।
pratyavāyastato jātastyaktaṃ karmāpi sarvathā ।।68।।
yathāśaktiprakartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena vijānatā ।
sujānatā tadā sarvaṃ tyaktavyaṃ saṃbhavet katham ।।6 9।।
tasmādālasyadoṣeṇa karmadharmātivarjitaḥ ।
cyuto brahmakriyāmārgād daṇḍamarhati sarvathā ।।1.259.70 ।।
tadā vedaśirāstatra mānase'cintayadgurum ।
vāmadevaṃ mahābrahmāvatāraṃ so'pi cāyayau ।।71 ।।
dharmarājena tu tadā satkṛto vāmadevakaḥ ।
niṣasādā''sane datte śiṣyeṇāpi namaskṛtaḥ ।।72।।
vāmadevena sarvaṃ tatkarma yamamukhācchrutam ।
pratyavāyātmakaṃ tathyaṃ vinā daṇḍaṃ na naśyati ।।73 ।।
vāmadevaḥ kṛpālurvai cintayāmāsa tatkṛte ।
yathā daṇḍo na bhoktavyaḥ karmāpi niṣphalaṃ bhavet ।।74।।
tādṛśaṃ cintayitvaiva kathayāmi taredayam ।
vilokya sarvatastatra prāha śiṣyaṃ yamaṃ tathā ।।75।।
śṛṇutaṃ dvāvapi śiṣyau yama! vedaśirastathā ।
vrataṃ cāsti mahatkālasūtrāsipatranāśakam ।।76।।
āśvinaśuklaikādaśikāvrataṃ balavanmattam ।
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ tatsamānāṃ ca nāśakam ।।77।।
kartavyaṃ śraddhayā'nena prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ।
evamekādaśīnāmamātraśravaṇatastadā ।।78।।
bratasaṃkalpataścāpyāyuṣyaṃ susandhitaṃ punaḥ ।
guroścāpi pratāpena punarāyuṣyamāptavān ।।79।।
gṛhītvā''tīthyasatkāraṃ yayaturyatra vai śavam ।
śiṣyaṃ praveśayāmāsa guruḥ prāha tato vratam ।।1.259.80 ।।
snātvā guroḥ pūjanaṃ ca kṛtvā svāsthyena saṃsthitaḥ ।
āgataṃ ceṣaśuklaikādaśīvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
vedavismaraṇotpannapāpadhvaṃso'pyabhūt kṣaṇāt ।
karmatyāgādipāpānāṃ bhasmabhāvo'bhavattadā ।।82।।
tato vedaśirā dīrghamāyuṣyaṃ cāptavān śubham ।
gurorbalāttu karaṇādekādaśīvratasya vai ।।83।।
yamapāśavināśo'syā'bhavatsevāvratena ca ।
iyamekādaśī tasmātpāśānāmaṃkuśaṃ matam ।।84।।
kariṇāmaṃkuśaṃ yadvat tathā pāśāṃkuśāvratam ।
kartavyaṃ yamapāśānāṃ nāśanāya janaiḥ śubham ।।85।।
svargamokṣapradaṃ sarvasampatkaraṃ sukhapradam ।
ārogyadaṃ trividhānāṃ tāpānāṃ śamanaṃ param ।।86।।
vāsanāpāśabandhānāṃ nāśakaṃ pāpanāśakam ।
dehadaihikapāśānāṃ nāśakaṃ vipadāṃ tathā ।।87।।
ahaṃmamatvapāśānāṃ dhvaṃsakaṃ dveṣarāgayoḥ ।
śamanaṃ subhagadātṛ dārāpatitvadāyakam ।।88।।
kleśadāvānalaśāntikaraṃ śāśvatadhāmadam ।
hareryogapradaṃ vaikuṇṭhadaṃ golokadaṃ tathā ।।89।।
pāśāṃkuśāvrataṃ lakṣmi! prakartavyaṃ prayatnataḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratapuṇyapradaṃ hi tat ।।1.259.90 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āśvinaśuklapāśāṃkuśaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vāmadevarṣi-śiṣyavedaśiraso'jīrṇarogādālasyena dharmakarmādivarjanātpātakabalena yamalokaprāptau smṛtaguruvāmadevopasthityā vratena ca yamapāśavimokṣaṇamityādi nirūpaṇanāmā ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikadvipañcā-
śattamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।259।।


← adhyāyaḥ 259 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 260
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 261 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
mahākālo mahārudro yamo yamasya kiṃkarāḥ ।
yadātmāno jagatsarvaṃ niyamayanti te namaḥ ।। 1 ।।
pāśo vajraṃ gadā śaktirdaṇḍaścakraṃ triśūlakam ।
yadātmānaḥ pravartante tasmai te vibhave namaḥ ।। 2 ।।
dhṛtirdayā sahāyatvaṃ nītikṣamopakāritāḥ ।
yatprayuktā prabhavanti tasmai guṇātmane namaḥ ।। 3 ।।
mamatā paratā naijaṃ sthitiḥ puṣṭirvimokṣaṇam ।
yadātmaka kṛtaṃ syādvai nirguṇaṃ guṇine namaḥ ।। 4 ।।
bhagavaँste kṛpā pārāvāratulyā sadā mayi ।
vada kārtikakṛṣṇaikādaśī kiṃnāmikā bhavet ।। 5 ।।
ko devaḥ pūjanīyo'tra dānaṃ puṇyaṃ vidhiṃ vada ।
vrate'pi kīdṛśaṃ kāryaṃ kartavyamiti me vada ।। 6 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kārtiko'yaṃ māso mokṣaprado'sti vai ।
cāturmāsyāntamāso'yaṃ vratadānādipūjane ।। 7 ।।
māsaḥ śreṣṭhatamaścāyaṃ vartate vratināṃ kṛte ।
tatra sarvaṃ śubhaṃ puṇyaṃ karma kartavyameva yat ।। 8 ।।
tatrā'pyekādaśī śreṣṭhā kṛṣṇapakṣe ramābhidhā ।
hiraṇyayā sahā'bhyarcyo haristasyāmadhīśvaraḥ ।। 9 ।।
puṣpeṣu baṭukundāni tadarghye kadalaṃ matam ।
naivedye śarkarā''jyāktakadalāni ca polikāḥ ।। 1.260.10 ।।
dānaṃ ghṛtaghaṭādīnāṃ yadiṣṭaṃ svasya vai bhavet ।
tatsarvaṃ tu pradātavyaṃ svarṇaṃ lakṣmīvivṛddhaye ।। 11 ।।
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād vratī bhūśayano bhavet ।
brahmacārī bhavet krodhamohadoṣādivarjitaḥ ।। 12।।
prātarutthāya govindaṃ dhyāyetsnātvā prapūjayet ।
pūjāṃ tu naityikīṃ kṛtvā kārayetsaptadhānyakam ।। 13 ।।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ raṃgacitrāliśobhitam ।
tanmadhye tu ghaṭaṃ svarṇaṃ tāmrajaṃ sthāpayecca vā ।। 14।।
pañcaratnasupatrādyakṣatavārisuvastrakaiḥ ।
śarkarāśrīphalapūgīphalacandanasaṃyutam ।। 15।।
tanmukhāgre tilasthālīṃ rājatīṃ sthāpayed vratī ।
nyasyenmūrti tatra hiraṇyāramāśālino hareḥ ।। 16 ।।
āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtā'dbhistailamardanaiḥ ।
sevetā'thā'mbarabhūṣāśṛṃgārādi samarpayet ।। 17।।
puṣpamālāṃ kaṭake ca mukuṭādi samarpayet ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlakādikam ।। 18।।
ārārtrikādyarpayecca kuryāt stotraṃ kṣamārthanām ।
dānāni vividhānyeva dadyācchrīgurave tadā ।। 1 9।।
madhyāhne'pi pūjayecca bhojayejjalamarpayet ।
sāyaṃ snātvā pūjayitvā nīrājanaṃ vidhāpayet ।।1.260.20 ।।
stutyādikaṃ vinirvṛtya bhojayet sevayettathā ।
rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryādbhaktamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ ।। 2 1 । ।
gītanṛtyakathāvārtā''khyānaraṃjanatāṃ caret ।
dvādaśyāṃ tu vratī prātaḥ snātvā samarcya keśavam । । 22 ।।
dadyācchreṣṭhāni dānāni rājā vāpi prajā vratī ।
tyāgī vāpi gṛhī vāpi nārī vāpi naropi vā । । 23 ।।
yathāśakti sataḥ sādhvīrviprān bālān prabhojayet ।
tataḥ kuryātpāraṇāṃ vai vratasiddhiṃ samarthayet । । 24।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī ramātulyā bhaved dhruvam ।
naraḥ kṛtvā vrataṃ devo jāyate mukta eva saḥ । । 25 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! candrabhāgāśaśisenakathāṃ śubhām ।
mucukunda iti khyāto babhūva nṛpatiḥ purā । । 26 ।।
indrakundanasaṃjñaṃ tannagaraṃ dakṣiṇe'bhavat ।
rājadhānyāṃ vasanpṛthvīmekarāṭ praśaśāsa saḥ । । 27 । ।
devendreṇa samaṃ tasya mitratvamabhavad bahu ।
yamena varuṇenaiva kubereṇa tathāgninā । । 28 । ।
bibhīṣaṇena tasyaivaṃ mitratvamabhavattathā ।
yānavimānakaiḥ so'yaṃ trilokyāṃ yāti sarvataḥ । । 29 ।।
viṣṇubhaktaḥ satyasandhaḥ śāsti rājyamakaṇṭakam ।
sarve tu vaiṣṇavāstasya rājye bhavanti mānavāḥ । । 1.260.30 । ।
viṣṇubhaktāḥ prajāstasya saṃprāpte harivāsare ।
annaṃ na bhuṃjate sarvāḥ kurvate samupoṣaṇam । । 31 ।।
paṭahastāḍyate tasya saṃprāpte daśamīdine ।
na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte tu harerdine । । 32 ।।
gajairaśvaiśca kalabhairanyaiśca paśubhistvapi ।
tṛṇamannaṃ tathā vāri na bhoktavyaṃ harerdine । । 33 ।।
evaṃ kārayati sarvān rājyasthān vratamuttamam ।
candrabhāgā nadīśreṣṭhā sutā tasya babhūva ha ।। 38 ।।
samakāle'tha kāveryāstaṭe babhūva bhūpatiḥ ।
candrasenāhvayaḥ puṇyaḥ kanakākhyapurādhipaḥ ।। 35 । ।
tatputrāya śaśisenāhvayāya guṇaśāline ।
candrabhāgā pradattā vai mucukundena bhūbhṛtā ।। 3 6।।
mahābhāgavatī sāpi vrataṃ karoti vaiṣṇavī ।
ekadā patiyuktā sā pitṛgehaṃ jagāma vai । । 37।।
bhartā jvarābhibhūto'syā babhūva tvatidurbalaḥ ।
ekādaśīvrataṃ cāhaḥ samāyātaṃ supuṇyadam । । 38 । ।
samāgate vrate candrabhāgā manasyacintayat ।
kiṃ bhaviṣyati bharturme hyatyaśaktasya vai vrate ।। 39 ।।
kṣudhāṃ na kṣamate soḍhuṃ rugṇaḥ kṛśo'tinirbalaḥ ।
vratasya divase tvatra pitā me tūgraśāsanaḥ । ।1.260.4 0 । ।
saśakto vā'pyaśakto vā vrataṃ karotu śāsanam ।
kenāpyulaṃghyate cet sa daṇḍapātraṃ na saṃśayaḥ । । 41 ।।
yadbhāvi tadbhavatvatra kiṃ kāryaṃ vivaśena vai ।
iti vicintya sā tvāste vratāhaścāpi saṃsthitam ।। 42 ।।
paṭahastāḍyate tasya saṃprāpte daśamīdine ।
na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte tu harerdine । ।43 । ।
macchāsanollaṃghayitā daṇḍārho vai bhaviṣyati ।
śrutvā paṭahanirghoṣaṃ śaśiseno'bravīt priyām । ।44 । ।
kiṃ, kartavyaṃ mayā kānte mariṣyāmi vinā'danam ।
candrabhāgā tadā prāha kāntaṃ cintāturaṃ śanaiḥ । । 45 ।।
matpiturviṣaye kvāpi bhoktavyaṃ nā'dya kenacit ।
mānavairmānavādhīnapaśupakṣisarīsṛpaiḥ । । 46 ।।
tṛṇamannaṃ jalaṃ piṣṭaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ harerdine ।
yadi tvaṃ bhokṣyase kānta tato daṇḍaṃ prayāsyasi । ।47 ।।
prayāsyasi vigarhāṃ ca tasmātkuru mano dṛḍham ।
śrutvā''haśaśisenastāṃ kariṣye'hamupoṣaṇam ।। 88 । ।
daivena vihitaṃ yanme tattathaiva bhaviṣyati ।
evaṃ dṛḍhāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā cakāra nirjalaṃ vratam । ।4 9 ।।
kṣudhātṛṣātisaṃvyāpto babhūva bahuvihalaḥ ।
rātrau mūrchābhibhūtaḥ sa brahmarandhraṃ samāśritaḥ । । 1.260.5 0 । ।
raverudayavelāyāṃ śaśiseno mṛti gataḥ ।
dāhayāmāsa rājā taṃ rājayogyaiśca dārubhiḥ ।। 51 । ।
candrabhāgā harerbhaktermāhātmyabodhavattayā ।
pativratā'pi patinā sahā''tmānaṃ dadāha na । । 52 ।।
kṛtvaurdhvadaihikaṃ bhartustasthau janakaveśmani ।
śaśiseno divyadeho ramāvratasupuṇyataḥ । । 53 । ।
prāptaḥ svarge tu sāmrājyaṃ svatantramaindrasadṛśam ।
bahusmṛddhamanādhṛṣyamasaṃkhyeyaguṇānvitam । । 54। ।
hemastambhamayaiḥ saudhaiḥ ratnavaidūryamaṇḍitaiḥ ।
sphāṭikairvividhākārairvicitrairdivyasūjjvalaiḥ । ।55।।
bhavanairasaṃkhyabhaumaiḥ śobhitaṃ svargamāpa saḥ ।
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ siṃhāsanasamāśritaḥ ।। ।56 । ।
kirīṭakuṇḍalayuto hārakeyūramaṇḍitaḥ ।
stūyamānaśca gandharvadevā'psaraḥparīgaṇaiḥ । । 57। ।
karāttavyajanacchatracāmarābhijanairvṛtaḥ ।
śaśisenaḥ svake svarge rājate modate bahu ।।58 ।।
athaikadā mahendrasya dūtaḥ pṛthvyāṃ samāgataḥ ।
mucukundagṛhe kāryavaśādindreṇa moditaḥ ।।59।।
yadendrasya mahāyuddhaṃ daityaiḥ sahopatiṣṭhati ।
mucukundastadā daityān vijitvendrasahāyavān ।।1.260.6 0 ।।
jayaprado bhavatyeva brahmaṇo varadānataḥ ।
ityarthe tvāgataṃ dūtaṃ bhojitaṃ satkṛtaṃ tathā ।।6 1 ।।
nṛpaḥ papraccha vai svargisurāṇāṃ tu nirāmayam ।
dūto yadarthamāyātaḥ sarvaṃ nivedya vai tataḥ ।। 62।।
nṛpaṃ prāha mayā svargaṃ śaśiseno'valokitaḥ ।
indrādanyūnasāmarthyasmṛddhivaibhavavāridhiḥ ।।6 3 ।।
rūpalāvaṇyasampanno yuvā devo virājate ।
jāmātā tava rājendra dṛṣṭvā''yāntaṃ bhuvaṃ tu mām ।।64 ।।
prāha pṛthvyāṃ śvaśurasya candrasenanṛpasya ca ।
kāntāyāścandrabhāgāyāstathaiva nagarasya ca ।।65।।।
matsakāśāttu kuśalaṃ praṣṭavyaṃ ca nirāmayam ।
mama svasti ca vaktavyaṃ svargyaṃ sarvaṃ yathā'sti me ।। 66 ।।
mama patnī ca vaktavyā patiste tvāṃ pratīkṣate ।
iti rājan hi jāmātuste'sti svarge sukhaṃ bahu ।।67।।
kuśalaṃ vartate tasyā''ścaryaṃ ca vidyate'dbhutam ।
puraṃ vicitraṃ ruciraṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ kenacitkvacit ।। 68 ।।
divyaṃ vyomni sugatimattejo'mbaraprakāśitam ।
amṛtabhogabhogāḍhyaṃ dāsā'psarobhisevitam ।।69 ।।
varṇayituṃ na śaknomi mahāścaryamayaṃ puram ।
tava labdhaṃ hi jāmātrā vratapuṇyena śāśvatam ।। 1.260.70। ।
kārtikasyā'site pakṣe yā nāmaikādaśī ramā ।
tāmupoṣya mṛtaścātra prāptavān svargamīdṛśam ।।7 1 ।।।
śraddhāhīno vratakartā prāpto'pi svargamuttamam ।
tadūrdhvaṃ divyalokaṃ sa gantumicchati nākataḥ ।।72 ।
svīyapatnyā'nuṣṭhitasya ramāvratasya vai balāt ।
śrutvā tatra sthitā candrabhāgā hṛṣṭā''ha vai muhuḥ ।।73 ।
nāthadarśanavegāḍhyā mucukundasya putrikā ।
tatra māṃ naya dūta tvaṃ yatrā''ste me priyaḥ patiḥ ।।74।
neṣye taṃ brahmadhāmā'pi ramāvratasya puṇyataḥ ।
āvayordūta! saṃyogo yathā bhavati tat kuru ।।75।
śrutvā dūto mucukundasyā''jñāṃ prāpya tadā'mbare ।
candrabhāgāṃ divyadehāṃ kṛtvā nītvā jagāma ha ।।76।
sāpi svargasahaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ yauvanamityapi ।
divyaṃ coḍḍayanaṃ prāpya bhartuḥ samīpamāgatā ।।77
bhartuḥ svargaṃ mahārājyaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa sā ।
indraseno jaharṣā'ti dṛṣṭvā kāntāṃ samāgatām । । 78 ।।
samāhūya svake vāme pārśve tāṃ sa nyaveśayat ।
dūtaḥ prāpya susatkāramindraṃ prati jagāma ha । 79 । ।
athovāca priyaṃ harṣāccandrabhāgā priyaṃ vacaḥ ।
śṛṇu kānta! hitaṃ vākyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ vidyate mayi । ।1.260.8 0 ।।
aṣṭavarṣādhikā jātā yadā'haṃ pitṛveśmani ।
tataḥ prabhṛti yaccīrṇaṃ mayā tvekādaśīvratam । ।8 1 ।।
tasya puṇyaprabhāveṇa yāsyāvo dhāma cākṣaram ।
sarvakāmasamṛddhaṃ ca śāśvataṃ śrīhareḥ padam । । 8 2 । ।
bahukālaṃ tu tau svargaṃ bhuktvā puṇyaprabhāvataḥ ।
yayatustvakṣaraṃ dhāma divyamuktau babhūvatuḥ ।।8 3 ।।
cintāmaṇisamā tveṣā kāmadhenusamā'pi vā ।
kalpadrusadṛśī ramābhidhānaikādaśī mama ।।84।।
ekādaśīvratānāṃ ca pakṣayorubhayorapi ।
yathā kṛṣṇā tathā śuklā vibhedaṃ naiva kārayet ।।89 ।।
dhenuḥ śvetā yathā kṛṣṇā cobhayoḥ sadṛśaṃ payaḥ ।
tathaiva tulyaphaladaṃ smṛtamekādaśīdvayam ।।8 6 । ।
sevitaikādaśī nṝṇāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinī ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi vratatulyaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 87। ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇoyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtikakṛṣṇaramaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ mucukundaputryāścandrabhāgāyāḥ patyurindrasenasya vratadine maraṇāt svargaṃ tataḥ patnyāḥ svargagatyuttaraṃ dvayormokṣaṃ ityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 260 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 260 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 261
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 262 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kārtikaścaturo māsān varṣāḍhyān puṇyakāryataḥ ।
antarbhūyā'timāhātmyaśālinaḥ saṃkaroti hi ।। 1 ।।
cāturmāsye na vai jātaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ samarpaṇam ।
kārtike tasya karaṇāccāturmāsyaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 2 ।।
pāpānāṃ nāśakaḥ svargasatyavairājalokadaḥ ।
golokavaikuṇṭhadaścākṣaralokaprado hi saḥ ।। 3 ।।
kārtike yat kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ bhavet ।
tasmādātmakṛte sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ kārtike vratam ।। 4 । ।
kārtikaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā ।
ko devaḥ ko vidhistatra kiṃ dānaṃ ca vrataṃ phalam । । 5 ।।
cāturmāsyāntimamāse vaiśiṣṭyaṃ kiṃ hi gaṇyate ।
yena vai vratino muktiṃ prayāntyapi ca me vada ।। 6 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi kārtikasya site dile ।
nāmnā prabodhinī proktaikādaśī tūttamottamā ।। 7 ।।
yasyāṃ jāgartiṃ lakṣmīśaḥ śeṣaśāyī tu dhārmikaḥ ।
yasyā vrataprabhāveṇa līyate'jñānajaṃ tamaḥ ।। 8 ।।
prakarṣeṇā''tmabodhaśca jāyate'taḥ prabodhinī ।
muktidātrī sukhadātrī svargadātrī ca bodhadā ।। 9 ।।
upoṣyā vidhivattatra pūjyo dāmodaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
rādhayā ca prabodhinyā sahārcyo bahuvastubhiḥ ।। 1.261.10 ।।
kamalaiḥ śreṣṭhapuṣpaiśca pūjanīyo janārdanaḥ ।
naivedye mudgalaḍaḍukā arghye padmaphalāni ca ।। 11 ।।
dāne sopaskaro mañco deyānyanyānyapi priye ।
prabodhinīvrataṃ lakṣmi! pāpaghnaṃ puṇyavardhakam ।। 12।।
tāvattīrthānyaraṇyāni garjantyāyatanāni ca ।
yāvatkārtikamāsasya nāyāti bodhinīvratam ।। 1 3।।
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca ।
vājapeyasahasrāṇi prabodhinīsamāni na ।। 14।।
alabhyaṃ cāpyagamyaṃ cā'sādhyaṃ cā'śakyameva vā ।
dadātyupoṣitā vratyarthitaṃ vai haribodhinī ।। 15।।
vidyāṃ dhanaṃ rājasattāṃ prajāsattāṃ yaśo'malam ।
siddhiṃ ca sampadaṃ dadātyupoṣitā'tra bodhinī ।। 16।।
mahāpāpā'tipāpāni saṃkarīkaraṇāni ca ।
śuṣkārdrāṇi ca sarvāṇyupoṣitā dahati nviyam ।। 17।।
anekajanmasamprāptapāpaduritaparvatāna ।
kṛtaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau dahati bodhinīvrate ।। 18।।
jñātvā'jñātvā'thavā rogādibhiśceyamupoṣitā ।
pāravaśyopoṣitā vā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti sā ।। 19।।
śraddhayā bhāvataścātra vidhivat kṛtameva yat ।
api svalpaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ।।1.261.20 ।।
ajñātenā'pyavidhinā cā'manaskena vā'pi yat ।
nindādrohānvitaṃ merupramaṃ kṛtaṃ tu niṣphalam ।।2 1 ।।
kartavyaṃ khalu svalpaṃ vā nindādrohau na vai caret ।
nindādrohā'pekṣayā nu na kartavyaṃ varaṃ matam ।।22।।
pitṝnsaṃsmṛtya ye tvatra puṇyaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ ।
gacchanti pitarasteṣāṃ tṛptā viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।।23।।
brahmahatyādipāpāni vrate naśyanti jāgarāt ।
aśvamedhādikairyajñairapi duṣprāpyameva yat ।। 24।।
anyaiśca sādhanaiḥ śreṣṭhairalabhyaṃ cāpi yadbhavet ।
prāpyate tatsukhenaiva prabodhinyāstu jāgarāt ।। 25।।
yāvattīrthā'bhiṣekasya mahīsvarṇārpaṇasya ca ।
phalātphalaṃ tvadhikaṃ vai prāpyate vratajāgarāt ।। 26 ।।
sa eva sukṛtī jātaḥ kulānāṃ pāvitaṃ śatam ।
tena yena kṛtā bhāvāt kārtike tu prabodhinī ।। 27।।
vratapuṇyaṃ dhruvaṃ proktaṃ tadanyat sarvamadhruvam ।
vicāryeti prakartavyaṃ vrataṃ samyaggharerdine ।। 28 ।।
prabodhinīvratakarturgṛhe tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ ।
pāvanāni pravasanti tadgṛhaṃ tīrtharājakam ।। 29 ।।
putrapautradhanasampatpradā vai haribodhinī ।
putrādyarthaṃ vrataṃ tvanyat kartavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।। 1.261.30 ।।
prabodhinyā vratakarturbhogo mokṣaḥ kare sthitaḥ ।
jñānaṃ yogastapo homaḥ saṃyamo'pi vrate sthitaḥ ।। 31 ।।
dharmapuṣṭikarī viṣṇoḥ priyā muktipradā nṛṇām ।
garbhavāsādiduḥkhānāṃ nāśayitrī hyupoṣitā ।। 32 ।।
karmaṇā manasā vācā śuṣkaṃ cārdraṃ ca pātakam ।
kṛṣṇaḥ kṣālayati prabodhinyā vrate sajāgare ।। 23 ।।
kṛṣṇamuddiśya bodhinyāṃ snānaṃ homo japo'rpaṇam ।
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ caitatkṛtaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ।। 34।।
mahāvratamidaṃ proktaṃ nedṛśaṃ tu vratāntaram ।
śatajanmārjitā'saṃkhyamahāpāpaughanāśanam ।। 35। ।
prabodhinyā vratenā'tra toṣayitvā janārdanam ।
satkṛtaḥ svargasaṃsthaiḥ saḥ prayāti harimandiram ।। 3 6।।
rūpasaundaryapuṣṭatvasaughaṭyārthibhirādarāt ।
dārāputragṛhakṣetrapatijairogyamicchubhiḥ ।। 37।।
dhanavāhanayānādismṛddhidhenudhanecchubhiḥ ।
kartavyaiṣā prayatnena bodhinī pramadānaraiḥ ।। 38 ।।
bālyayauvanavārdhakyāvasthāyogena vai kṛtam ।
śatajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vratādasyā vinaśyati ।। 39 ।।
sūryacandroparāgasya yatphalaṃ kaurave sthale ।
tataḥ sahasraguṇitaṃ prabodhinyāṃ tu jāgare ।।1.261.40 ।।
yasya prayāti māsastu kārtiko vandhya eva ha ।
tasya bodhyaṃ nṛjanmāpi vandhyaṃ tvatra paratra ca ।।4 1 ।।
janmārjitasya puṇyādikarmaṇaścāpi vai phalam ।
bandhyakārtikamāsasya vyarthaṃ yāti sukhāya na ।।42 ।।
parānnaṃ varjayettasya cāndrāyaṇaphalaṃ bhavet ।
kārtike tu kathākarturyajñāyutaphalaṃ bhavet ।।43 ।।
tuṣyati na tathā yajñairna dānairvā japādibhiḥ ।
yathā śāstrakathābhistuṣyati kṛṣṇastu kārtike ।।44।।
śrotāraścāpi vaktāraḥ kathāyāḥ kārtike tu me ।
pratiślokaṃ labhante te gosahasrārpaṇaṃ phalam ।।45।।
kārtike śreyaso buddhyā keśavā'gre'tibhāvataḥ ।
kathāvācayitā lakṣmi! kulānāṃ tārayecchatam ।।46।।
pratyahaṃ niyamenā'tra kārtike śṛṇuyātkathām ।
hareryogātphalaṃ tasyā gosahasrapradānajam ।।47।।
prabodhinīvrate viṣṇoścaritraṃ śṛṇuyācca yaḥ ।
saptadvīpavatīdānaphalaṃ sa labhate vratī ।।48 ।।
viṣṇubuddhyā kathāṃ śrutvā ye'rcayanti kathāvidam ।
dhanadhānyāmbaraiḥ śaktyā teṣāṃ loko'kṣayo mataḥ ।।49।।
nāmakīrtanabhajanaiścaritraśravaṇādibhiḥ ।
kārtikaṃ kṣapayettasya punarāvarttanaṃ na vai ।।1.261.5 0 ।।
haryagre tu kathāṃ gītaṃ vādyaṃ nṛtyaṃ samutsavam ।
yaḥ karauti vrate prāpte nityaṃ vā muktibhāk sa vai ।।।5 1 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ paṭhecchṛṇuyāttu yaḥ ।
pratyakṣaraṃ bhavedasya kapilādānajaṃ phalam ।।52।।
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ samprāpte harivāsare ।
yataḥ puṇyamasaṃkhyātaṃ dhanadāne bhavatyapi ।।53 ।।
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ san vratī bhūśayano niśi ।
saṃyamī brahmacārī ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ hṛdi saṃsmaret ।।54।।
ekādaśyāṃ prage devo jāgartīti vibhāvya vai ।
dhyātvā snātvā hariṃ ghaṇṭānādaṃ kṛtvā prabodhayet ।।55।।
āvāhanaṃ samārabhya vratī visarjanāntimām ।
pūjāṃ tu naityikīṃ kṛtvā harermaṇḍapamuttamam ।।56।।
śobhitaṃ kadalīstambhapatratoraṇaketubhiḥ ।
kārayecca vitānaṃ saccitraṃ vai bandhayecchubham । ।57।।
catuṣkoṇeṣu kalaśānuparyupari saptakān ।
klṛptayetparitastatra raṃgāvalīśca kārayet ।।58 ।।
madhye tu sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ saptadhānyakam ।
kārayecca ghaṭaṃ tāmrakṛtaṃ vā'tha suvarṇajam ।।59 ।।
maṇḍale sthāpayenmadhye mahattamaśubhaṃ navam ।
parito maṇḍale tatra caturviṃśatisadghaṭān ।। 1.261.60 ।।
sthāpayetsvarṇajān yadvā tāmrajān sajalānnavān ।
paṃcaratnapaṃcapatrapūgīphalā'ñcitaṇḍulān ।।6 1 ।।
vastrasūtranārikelaphalamodakaśobhitān ।
puṣpacandanakuṃkumākṣatavāryabhipūjitān ।।62।।
tanmukheṣu sthāpanīyāstilasthālyastu nūtanāḥ ।
śarkarailālavaṃgāḍhyāḥ phalanaivedyasaṃyutāḥ ।। 63 ।।
madhyasthālyāṃ sthāpanīyo rādhādāmodaraḥ svayam ।
prabodhinyā sahitaḥ śrīmūrtirūpo hariḥ prabhuḥ ।।64।।
pārśve paryaṃka āstheyaḥ śayyāsādhanaśobhitaḥ ।
gendukaṃ kaśipurguptadorakaṃ prāvaraṃ tathā ।।65।।
vyajanaṃ cāmaraṃ chatraṃ pāduke darpaṇastathā
dantakaḥ kalaśaḥ sthālī vāṭikāḥ phulavāṭikāḥ ।।66 ।।
anyānyapi tvapekṣyāṇi phalamiṣṭānnakāni ca ।
sthāpanīyāni tatraiva paryaṃke kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ।।67।।
śrīgaṇeśaṃ sakuṭumbaṃ pūjayecca nivedayet। ।
ghaṇṭāṃ ca kalaśaṃ śaṃkhaṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ।।68 ।।
tīrthānyāvāhayetpaścāddhariṃ tvāvāhayed vratī ।
āsanaṃ ca dadet pādyamarghyamācamanaṃ tataḥ ।।69।।
arpayed dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca śaucaśuddhiṃ prakalpayet ।
gaṇḍūṣānkārayetpaścāttīrthavāryabhiṣecanam ।।1.261.70।।
kārayecca tataḥ paṃcāmṛtasnānaṃ samarpayet ।
punaḥ śuddhodakasnānaṃ tathā vastreṇa mārjanam ।।71 ।।
dukūlārpaṇamaṃgeṣu sugandhyattarakā'rcanam ।
kaustubhaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kaṃcukaṃ śāṭikādikam ।।72।।
dhautraṃ ca kaṃcukīṃ divyāṃ ghargharīṃ prasamarpayet ।
mukuṭaṃ cottarāvastraṃ kuṇḍalairanakādikam ।।73।।
kaṭake śṛṃkhale vyaṅgiḍīśca ratnormikāstathā ।
raśanāṃ jhanjhirāँścāpi tantīṃ natthīṃ ca mālikāḥ ।।74।।
hārānsvarṇamayāँścānyānbhūṣaṇāni samarpayet ।
candanaṃ kajjalaṃ cūrṇaṃ kauṃkumaṃ kaisaraṃ jalam ।।75।।
kastūrikāṃ śvetacūrṇaṃ sindūrakamalaktakam ।
anyatsaubhāgyasaddravyaṃ cārpayet rādhikeśvare ।।76।।
abīraṃ ca gulālaṃ cā'kṣatānpuṣpāṇi cārpayet ।
bahupuṣpairbahuphalaiḥ karpūrā'gurukuṃkumaiḥ ।।77।।
hareḥ pūjāṃ prakuryācca kārtike bodhinīprage ।
phalairnānāvidhairdravyairdhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ ।।78।।
miṣṭānnairvividhaiḥ śākapatraistathā''ranālakaiḥ ।
bhakṣyairbhojyairlehyacoṣyai rasairmiṣṭaiśca pānakaiḥ ।।79।।
phalaiśca vividhairdevaṃ toṣayed bhāvato vratī ।
śaṃkhatoyena vidhivattoṣayettu janārdanam ।।1.261.80।।
ketakyā ekapatreṇa pūjito garuḍadhvajaḥ ।
samāsahasraṃ suprīto jāyate kamalāpatiḥ ।।8 1।।
agastikusumaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayettu vidhānataḥ ।
pūjayiturdarśanācca nirayāgniḥ praśāmyati ।।82।।
munipuṣpārcito viṣṇuḥ kārtike puruṣottamaḥ ।
dadātyabhimatānkāmān divyā'divyāँstathā parān ।।83।।
vihāya sarvapuṣpāṇi munipuṣpeṇa keśavam ।
kārtike yo'rcayed bhaktyā vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet ।।84।।
tulasīdalapuṣpāṇi śamīpatrāṇi lā tathā ।
viṣṇāvarpayitā janmaśatajaṃ kārtike dahet ।।85।।
dṛṣṭā spṛṣṭā'thavā dhyātā kīrtitā nāmataḥ stutā ।
ropitā secitā nityaṃ pūjitā tulasī natā ।।86।।
navadhā tulasībhaktiṃ yaṃ kurvanti dine dine ।
yugakoṭisahasrāṇi tanvanti sukṛtaṃ priye ।।87।।
yāvacchākhāpraśākhābhirbījapuṣpadalairnavaiḥ ।
ropitā tulasī puṃbhirvardhate pṛthivītale ।।88।।
teṣāṃ vaṃśe tu ye jātā ye bhaviṣyanti ye gatāḥ ।
teṣāmākalpasāhasraṃ vāso harergṛhe bhavet ।।89।।
yatphalaṃ sarvapuṣpeṣu sarvapatreṣu yatphalam ।
tulasyekadalenaiva prāptaṃ vai kārtike bhavet ।।1.261.9 0।।
nityaṃ tu kārtike viṣṇustulasīdalakaistathā ।
padmairdhātrīdalaiścaiva pūjanīyaḥ śamīdalaiḥ । ।9 1 ।।
iṣṭvā kratuśatairdevāndattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ।
tatpuṇyaṃ tulasīpatraiḥ kārtike keśavārcane ।।92।।
ārārtrikaṃ namaskāraṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇāstathā ।
dakṣiṇā daṇḍavat puṣpāṃjaliṃ ca kṣamaṇārthanam ।।93।।
vratapūrtiprārthanāṃ ca vratī kṛtvā tataḥ param ।
guroḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ ।।94।।
suvarṇadakṣiṇābhiśca tuṣṭyarthaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ ।
goprabhatīni dānāni dātavyāni bahūnyapi ।।9 5 ।।
madhyāhne pūjayeddevaṃ bhojayedvai vidhānataḥ ।
sāyaṃ cāpi mahāpūjāṃ kārayedbhojayeddharim ।।96 ।।
jalapānādyarpayecca preṃkhāyāṃ sthāpayettataḥ ।
āndolayettoṣayecca pādasaṃvāhanaṃ caret ।।97।।
vratī jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgītavāditranartanaiḥ ।
kathābhī rāsaramaṇairlīlānukaraṇādibhiḥ ।।98।।
prātardvādaśikāyāṃ tu snātvā sampūjya mādhavam ।
bhojayettarpayedārārtrikeṇa vardhayeddharim ।।99।।
stutvā visarjayetsarvān bhojayedbahubhāvataḥ ।
sādhūnsādhvīḥ sātvatāँśca viprān bālān subhojayet । । 1.261.100 ।।
dadyād dānānyanekāni pāraṇāṃ ca tataścaret ।
evamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā ghaṭādi gurave'rpayet । । 101 ।।
evaṃ vrataṃ prapūrṇaṃ ca kṛtvā'kṣaramavāpnuyāt ।
bhuktiṃ bhuktiṃ samāpnoti śāśvataṃ ca sukhaṃ dhruvam । । 102 । ।
śṛṇu vrate prabodhinyāḥ kurvantaṃ harimandire।
kīrtanaṃ tvekacāṇḍālaṃ rākṣasādrakṣitaṃ priye ।। 103 ।।
araṇye raivate kṣetre hyaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tvāsīd viṣṇusthānamanāvṛtam । । 10 4।।
āraṇyakā janā yasya darśanād yānti sadgatim ।
bhadrāvatī taṭāvāsī kaściddīnajanaḥ khalu । । 105 ।।
dvijastu karmacaṇḍālaḥ kāṣṭhahāro'bhavannanu ।
nadīpūreṇa sannaṣṭa gṛhadārādikaḥ sa hi ।। 106 ।।
araṇye'rocatā''vāsaṃ kāṣṭhahāritvakarmataḥ ।
śubhasaṃskārayukto'sau nityaṃ sāyaṃ tu bhāvataḥ । । 107 ।।
viṣṇusthānaṃ prayāti sma kīrtanaṃ prakarotyapi ।
darśanaṃ nayanaṃ cāpi punaryāti nijālayam ।। 108 ।।
kārtike tu prabodhinyāṃ jāgaraṃ kartumutsukaḥ ।
niśi gacchantamenaṃ vai jagrāha pathi rākṣasaḥ ।। 109 ।।
jahāsa karmacāṇḍālo rākṣaso vismayaṃ gataḥ ।
papraccha maraṇe kāle nirbhayaṃ hāsyakāraṇam । । 1.261.110 ।।
karmacaṇḍāla āhainaṃ dhanyo'haṃ mṛtirāgatā ।
ekādaśītithistvadya vrataṃ me'sti prabodhinī ।। 111 ।।
devālayaṃ tu gacchāmi kīrtanāyā'rcanāya ca ।
jāgarāya prayāmyevaṃ mṛtyuryadi samāgataḥ ।। 112 ।।
tadā me sadgatistvasti na hyadho yāti bhaktikṛt ।
yadi te'sti kṣudhā tarhi śīghraṃ bhakṣaya māmiha ।। 113 ।।
vrate yadvā jāgarādi kṛtvā bhakṣaya māṃ prage ।
rākṣasaḥ prāha mṛtyorvai mukhād yo mucyate janaḥ ।। 11 4।।
na cāyāti punarmṛtyusthale tvāsthā name tvayi ।
cāṇḍālaḥ prāha yadyevaṃ samāgaccha mayā saha । । 115 । ।
kariṣye kīrtanaṃ paścād yatheṣṭaṃ māṃ prabhakṣaya ।
kīrtanena bhavenmuktiḥ śravaṇenāpi mokṣaṇam । । 116 ।।
rākṣasaḥ prāha yadyevaṃ tvayā gacchāmyahaṃ saha ।
pūrvaṃ devasvakośasyādhikāre hyāsameva yat ।। 117 ।।
yaśodātrīpurīmadhye devasvaṃ coritaṃ bahu ।
tena pāpena jāto'haṃ brāhmaṇo brahmarākṣasaḥ ।। 118 ।।
yadi vai kīrtanādatra śravaṇādvā pramokṣaṇam ।
bhavatīti mamāpi syānmokṣaṇaṃ nāgraho bhujeḥ । । 119 ।।
vicāryeti yayatustau vrate viṣṇusthale niśi ।
caṇḍālena pragītaṃ vai kīrtanaṃ nṛtyatālitam ।। 1.261.120 ।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ dvābhyāṃ subhāvataḥ ।
prātaḥ śuddhāvabhūtāṃ tau devayānaṃ samāgatam ।। 121 ।।
dehau vihāya tatraiva yayatuḥ svargameva tau ।
bhogān bhuktvā'saṃkhyasamā apsarogaṇasevitau ।। 122।।
paścānmuktiṃ prayātau tau vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇvanugrahāt ।
evaṃ tvasadgatikānāṃ patitānāṃ ca mokṣakṛt । । 123 । ।
vrataṃ prabodhinī śreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ ।
anyānyapi vratānyatra kartavyānyapi me śṛṇu । । 1 24। ।
eteṣvekatame jāte kārtikaḥ pāpakartanaḥ ।
snātavyaṃ brāhmakāle ca kartavyaṃ kṛcchramādarāt । । 1 25। ।
āśvayujyāḥ samārabhya kārtikyavadhiṃ bhaktitaḥ ।
vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyaṃ kāryaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ śubham ।। 1 26।।
tithihrāse kṛṣṇapakṣe grāsānāmalakopamān ।
tyaktvaikaikaṃ prabhuñjīta vardhayecca site dale ।। 1 27।।
tithivṛddhyā śuklapakṣe grāsānāmalakopamān ।
ekaikavṛddhyā bhuñjīta hrāsayecca sitetare ।। 1 28।।
pūrvaṃ pipīlikānāma dvitīyaṃ yavanāmakam ।
madhye kṣīṇaṃ ca puṣṭaṃ ca proktaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ śubham ।। 1 29।।
carurbhaikṣaṃ saktukaṇā yāvakaḥ śākamityapi ।
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ pānīyameva vā ।। 1.261.130 ।।
uttarottaraśastāni havīṣyetāni vai vrate ।
amāyāṃ naiva bhuñjīta tithivṛddhau tu ṣoḍaśa ।। 131 ।।
tithikṣaye tu tadgrāsā grāhyāścaturdaśaiva hi ।
yathākathañcit piṇḍānāṃ catvāriṃśacchatadvayam ।। 13 2।।
māsenaivopabhuñjīta tadapīnduvrataṃ bhavet ।
aṣṭāvaṣṭau samaśnīyād yati cāndrāyaṇaṃ hi tat ।। 133 ।।
prātaścaturaḥ sāyaṃ ca śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ hi tat ।
athānyāni pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi! samāhitā ।। 134 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtikaśuklaprabodhinīvratamāhātmyaṃ vipranimittakakīrtana-vratayogena karmacaṇḍālaviprasya rākṣasasya ca muktiścāndrāyaṇasvarūpaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 261 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 261 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 262
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 263 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kāni vratāni cānyāni kārtike puṇyadāni vai ।
kartavyāni ca me nātha vada sarvāṇi tāni ca । । 1 । ।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ākāśadīpo dātavyo vratinā devamandire ।
tīrthadīpāḥ pradātavyāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ।। 2 । ।
nadyāṃ nade taḍāge ca sarasyapi ca vāridhau ।
kūpe vāpyāṃ jale deyā dīpāḥ svargapradā matāḥ । । 3 । ।
ekabhuktirdīpadānaṃ kārtike vratamityapi ।
dvidalāḥ kārtike deyā naktamuktirmataṃ vratam ।। 4 । ।
trīṃstrīnpiṇḍānsamaśnīyānmāsam ṛṣiśaśivratam ।
gokṣīraṃ saptarātraṃ ca pibetstanacatuṣṭayāt ।। 5 ।।
stanatrayātsaptarātraṃ saptarātraṃ stanadvayāt ।
ṣaḍrātraṃ ca tathaikasmāt trirātraṃ vāyubhugbhavet ।। 6 । ।
etatsomāyanaṃ nāma mahaccāndrāyaṇaṃ matam ।
ekabhaktaistathā naktaistathaivā'yācitairapi ।। 7 ।।
upavāsaiścaturbhiścetyevaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirdinaiḥ ।
mahāpāpadhvaṃsakṛttat kṛcchrākhyaṃ vratamucyate ।। 8 ।।
dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ coṣṇaṃ miśramekadinaṃ pibet ।
upāvasedekadainaṃ taptakṛcchravrataṃ tu tat ।। 9 ।।
uṣṇadugdhaghṛtavāri pratyekaṃ pratyahaṃ pibet ।
caturthe'hni copavaset taptakṛcchrāntaraṃ tvidam ।। 1.262.10 ।।
pratitryahaṃ jalaṃ dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ coṣṇaṃ samīraṇam ।
pibed dvādaśadainātmataptakṛcchravrataṃ hi tat ।। 11 ।।
pibet pratitryahaṃ śītaṃ śītakṛcchravrataṃ ca tat ।
pāne kramātpramāṇaṃ tu tripalaṃ dvipalaṃ palam ।। 12 ।।
ekāhaṃ pañcagavyaṃ saṃpibeddarbhodakānvitam ।
dvitīye tūpavāsena vrataṃ sāntapanaṃ matam ।। 13 ।।
pratyahaṃ gavyamekaikaṃ ṣaṣṭhe kuśodakaṃ pibet ।
saptame'hni tpavasenmadhyasāntapana vratam । । 14। ।
sāntapanaṃ trirāvṛdyaikaviṃśatidinairmahat ।
pratitryahaṃ kramād gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ ca godadhi । । 1 5।।
godugdhaṃ ca gavājyaṃ ca sāntapanaṃ mahattaram ।
tryahaṃ miśraṃ pañcagavyaṃ yatisāntapanaṃ vratam । । 16 ।।
palāśodumbarapadmabilvānāṃ pallavaiḥ pṛthak ।
kuśena kvathitaṃ pratyahaṃ tu vāri pibed vratī । । 1 7।।
pañcāhasādhyamityetat parṇakṛcchravrataṃ matam ।
trirātropoṣitasturye pañcakvāthaṃ pibed yadi ।। 18 । ।
parṇakūrcavrataṃ tvetanmataṃ cāturdinīyakam ।
māsaḥ phalairhi netavyaḥ phalakṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ ।। 19 ।।
śrīphalaiḥ śrīphalakṛcchraḥ padmaiśca padmakṛcchrakaḥ ।
āmalakaiśca śrīkṛcchraḥ pallavaiḥ patrakṛcchrakaḥ ।। 1.262.20 ।।
puṣpaistu puṣpakṛcchraḥ syānmūlaiśca mūlakṛcchrakaḥ ।
jalena jalakṛcchraḥ syād dugdhena dugdhakṛcchrakaḥ ।। 21 ।।
yena māso vyatīyeta tannāmā kṛcchra ucyate ।
ekabhaktena naktenā'yācitenopavāsataḥ ।। 2 2।।
caturbhirdivasaiḥ pādakṛcchraṃ taducyate vratam ।
tryahaṃ madhye tryahaṃ naktaṃ tryahaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ haviḥ । । 2 3 ।।
tatastryahaṃ ca nāśnīyātprājāpatyaṃ vrataṃ tu tat ।
dvādaśāhaścātikṛcchraḥ pāṇipūrānnabhojanaḥ ।। 24।।।
tryahaṃ niraśanaṃ kāryaṃ pādakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ matam ।
tryahaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ grāhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ pādakṛcchrakam ।। 25 ।।
tryahaṃ naktaṃ tathā grāhyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ pādakṛcchrakam ।
tryahaṃ madhyāhnake grāhyaṃ caturthaṃ pādakṛcchrakam ।। 26 ।।
madhye pañcadaśagrāsā nakte tu dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ।
yādṛcchikāścaturviṃśatigrāsā bhojane smṛtāḥ ।। 27।।
ekāhaṃ madhyake grāhyaṃ dvitīyāhaṃ tu naktakam ।
punardvyahaṃ yādṛcchikaṃ tato dvyahamupoṣaṇam । । 28 ।।
vratamevaṃ ṣaḍāhaṃ tadardhakṛchramudīritam ।
ekaviṃśatyahaṃ dugdhaṃ pibet kṛcchrātikṛcchrakam । । 29 ।।
dvādaśāhaṃ jalamātraṃ pibet kṛcchrātikṛcchrakam ।
dvādaśāhopavāsaistu pārākaḥ kṛcchra ucyate ।। 1.262.30 ।
pratyahaṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ ca saktūn takramupoṣaṇam ।
caturdinātmakaṃ saumyakṛcchraṃ vratamudīritam ।। 31 ।
pratyahaṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ ca takraṃ vāri kuśodakama ।
pañcadinopavāsaśca saumyakṛcchrāntaraṃ tu tat । । 32 ।
tilapiṣṭamodananiḥsrāvastakraṃ jalaṃ saktūn ।
upavāsaḥ ṣaḍahaṃ tat saumyakṛcchrāntaraṃ matam ।। 33 ।
tilapiṣṭādikaṃ pratyekaṃ trirātraṃ samabhyaset ।
tulāpuruṣakṛcchraḥ sa bodhyaḥ pañcadaśāhnikaḥ ।। 34।
pañcadaśadinānte tu tryahaṃ vāyuṃ tryahaṃ tataḥ ।
upoṣaṇaṃ caikaviṃśatyahaṃ tulānṛkṛcchrakam ।। 35 ।
śukle corje caturdaśyāṃ jale sthitvā'nilaṃ pibet ।
pūrṇimāyāmupavasejjalakṛcchraṃ vrataṃ matam ।। 36 ।
daśamyāṃ pañcagavyāśī hyekādaśyāmupāvaset ।
viṣṇupūjāṃ prakurvīta harikṛcchraṃ vrataṃ smṛtam ।। 37 ।।
saptamītaḥ pṛthag vāri dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ pibet ।
ekādaśyāmupavaset kṛcchraḥ paitāmaho vratam ।। 38 ।।
ṣaṣṭhītastu tryahaṃ vāri tryahaṃ copavased vratī ।
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇāṃ kuryānmāhendrakṛcchrakaṃ vratam ।। 3 9।।
tṛtīyātastryahaṃ nivārādi tryahaṃ ca yāvakam ।
tatastryahaṃ tūpavased viṣṇukṛcchravrataṃ hi tat ।। 1.262.40 ।।
pratipattaḥ pañcadinaṃ dugdhaṃ paṃcadinaṃ dadhiṃ ।
ekādaśīmupavased bhāskarakṛchra ucyate ।।4 1 ।।
pañcamītaḥ site bhājīṃ yavān śākaṃ payo dadhi ।
ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ kramād grāhyaṃ saptarṣikṛcchrakaṃ vratam ।।।42 । ।
pratipattaḥ kramātpeyaṃ dugdhaṃ vā kvāthitaṃ jalam ।
palāśabilvadarbhā'bjodumbaraparṇakaiḥ pṛthaka ।। 43 ।।
ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣaṇaṃ caitadagnikṛcchraṃ vrataṃ smṛtam ।
saptamītaḥ kramād dugdhaṃ bilvaṃ pakvaṃ ca padmajam ।।44।।
bisatantūn bhakṣayeścaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣaṇam ।
pañcadinātmakaṃ cedaṃ lakṣmīkṛcchravrataṃ smṛtam ।।45 ।।
brahmakūrcavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ।
kṛtena yena mucyante mānavāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ ।।46 ।।
sādhyaṃ tvetat tridivasairvidhiṃ vakṣyāmi tasya tu ।
upavasennavamyāṃ tu pañcagavyaṃ kuśāṃbhasā ।।47।।
saṃpibettu daśamyāṃ ca hyekādaśyāmupāvaset ।
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ dugdhaṃ darbhodikaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ।।48 ।।
pañcagavyaṃ tu tatproktaṃ pavitraṃ dehaśodhakam ।
gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam ।।49 ।।
dugdhaṃ suvarṇarūpāyāḥ nīlāyāstu tathā dadhi ।
kṛṣṇāyāstu ghṛtaṃ yadvā kapilāyāstu paṃcakam ।।1.262.5 0 ।।
suvarṇā kapilā tvekā dvitīyā sā tvapiṃgalā ।
tṛtīyā sā tu raktākṣī caturthī gūḍapiṃgalā । । 51 ।।
paṃcamī karburā sā syāt ṣaṣṭī syāt śvetapiṃgalā ।
saptamī śvetapiṃgākṣī hyaṣṭamī kṛṣṇapiṃgalā । । 5 2। ।
navamī pāṭalā sā syād daśamī pucchapiṃgalā ।
etā daśavidhā proktā kapilā havyadāyinī । ।5 3 ।।
alābhe sarvavarṇānāṃ paṃcagavyaṃ mataṃ śubham ।
gomūtraṃ māṣakāssvaṣṭau gomayasya tu ṣoḍaśa । ।।54। ।
bodhyā dvādaśa dugdhasya dadhno grāhyā daśaiva ha ।
ghṛtasya māṣakāstvaṣṭau catvārastu kuśāṃbhasaḥ ।।55।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇanāmnā gāyatryā vātha mantrataḥ ।
gṛhītvā tadṛcā yadvā gāyatryā vā puṃsūktataḥ ।।।56।।
agnau hotavyameveti pañcagavyamuddhṛtya tu ।
haritā''kuṇṭhitā'gryasaptapatrānvitasaḥkuśaiḥ ।। 57।।
harernāmnāmaṣṭottaraśatena homa iṣyate ।
hutaśeṣaṃ tu pātavyaṃ praṇavenā'bhimantritam । ।58 ।।
praṇavenā''bhiśritaṃ ca praṇavenoddhṛtaṃ ca tat ।
palāśamadhyapatreṇa pibet padmadalena vā ।। 59 ।।
svarṇapātreṇa raupyeṇa brahmatīrthena vā pibet ।
kathito brahmakūrco'yaṃ pāpaghno muktidastathā । । 1.262.60 ।।
dvādaśāhaṃ tilāḥ prāśyā agnikṛcchravrataṃ tu tat ।
gavā tyaktairyavairmāsaṃ nirvahed yavakṛcchrakam । । 61 ।।
gavā tyaktayavasaktūn bhuñjīta māsameva tu ।
yāmyakṛcchraṃ tu tatproktaṃ dehakalmaṣanāśakam ।। 6 2। ।
nityaṃ tu prasṛtimātratilapiṣṭena nirvahet ।
māsamekaṃ tu tatproktaṃ kuberakṛcchrakaṃ vratam । । 63 । ।
gomūtreṇā''caret snānaṃ gomayaṃ bhakṣayedapi ।
gavāṃ madhye nivasecca gopūrīṣe svapettathā ।। 6 4।।
pibenna goṣvapītāsu nā'bhuktāsu tu bhakṣayet ।
utthitāsu samuttiṣṭhedupaviṣṭāsu saṃviśet । । 55 ।।
māsamātraṃ vrataṃ caitad govrataṃ bodhyameva tat ।
sādhuṣu vasatiḥ sādhusevanaṃ sādhuvartanam ।। 66 ।।
sādhoḥ prāsādikaṃ bhojyaṃ peyaṃ sādhuvrataṃ tu tat ।
āmikṣayā tu māsau dvau dugdhena pakṣameva ca । । 6 7।।
dadhnā cā'ṣṭāhamevāpi ghṛtena tryahameva ca ।
nirāhāraṃ tryahaṃ tiṣṭheduddālakaṃ vrataṃ tvidam ।। 68 ।।
śrīkāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaśca svargakāmastathā janaḥ ।
devaprīṇanakāmaśca kṛcchraṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ । । 69 ।।
evametāni kṛcchrāṇi vratāni kathitāni te ।
pāpaghnāni muktidāni sarveṣāmapi padmaje । । 1.262.70 ।।
kurvan kṛcchrāṇi sarvāṇi yatavāṅmānasendriyaḥ ।
dhautavastradharaḥ śāntaḥ snātvā saṃpūjayeddharim ।। 71 ।।
vratadravyāṇi sarvāṇi dugdhādīni sadā vratī ।
aśnīyācchrīhareḥ prāsādikānyeva na cetarat। । ।7 2।।
kurvan kṛcchrāṇi muhyeścen mūrchāṃ yadvā'bhisaṃviśet ।
amṛtaṃ tu gavāṃ dugdhaṃ pāyayettaṃ vratārthinam । ।7 3 । ।
jalaṃ rasaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ takraṃ patraṃ payo dadhi ।
bhājā''mikṣauṣadhaṃ kvāthaḥ kandaḥ śākaṃ gurorvacaḥ ।।74।।
viprājñā'jñātakavalaḥ āpattigrasanaṃ tathā ।
mukhavāsārhasadvastu navanītaṃ ca śarkarā । । 75।।
gūḍo dugdhavikārādyāstailaṃ tilādikaṃ tathā ।
bhivārādi ca munyannaṃ bhūphalī vṛkṣapeśikā ।।76 ।।
lavaṃgailāmarīcatvagārdrakasūṃphagundrakāḥ ।
śilārasaśca kastūrī candanaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ।।77।।
madhu dhūmraścatvāriṃśadavrataghnāni santi vai ।
vratānte bhojayet sādhūn śāśvataṃ tatphalaṃ bhavet ।।78 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtike kartavyakṛcchravratānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvāṣaṣṭathadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 262 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 262 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 263
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 264 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kṛcchre kaṣṭamiti proktaṃ sukhaṃ tvayyarpitaṃ tu tat ।
sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ kṛcchravrataṃ tatte prasaṃgataḥ ।। 1 ।।
vrataṃ puṇyaṃ tathā peyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ sarvaṃ tvameva hi ।
tvāṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ yato nāsti dhruva hi tat ।। 2 । ।
brūhi me bhagavan māse puruṣottamasaṃjñake ।
ekādaśī kṛṣṇapakṣe kiṃnāmnī kiṃ phalaṃ vrate ।। 3 ।।
ko vidhiḥ pūjanaṃ kīdṛk ko devaścātra pūjyate ।
kiṃ dānaṃ ke ca niyamāḥ sarvaṃ brūhi suvistaram । । 4 ।।
kathaṃ snānaṃ ca kiṃ jāpyaṃ kiṃ bhojyaṃ tūttamaṃ matam ।
kiṃ tyājyaṃ cātra māse'pi tanme brūhi janārdana ।। 5 । ।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ekādaśyadhike māsi kamalā nāma nāmataḥ ।
puruṣottama ityuktaḥ pūjanīyaśca tatpatiḥ ।। 6 ।।
lakṣmīyutaḥ suvarṇasya mūrtirūpo hariḥ prabhuḥ ।
dhyeyau vaikuṇṭhatasthānau śrīlakṣmīpuruṣottamau ।। 7 ।।
kamalāyā vratenātra kamalā'bhimukhī bhavet ।
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād rātrau bhūśayano bhavet ।। 8 ।।
brahmacārī bhaveccaiva krodhādyaṃ tu parityajet ।
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya saṃsmṛtya puruṣottamam ।। 9 ।।
snātvā cāpi vidhānena niyamaṃ gṛhaṇīyād vratī ।
puruṣottamamāse vā prātaśca pratipaddine ।। 1.263.10 ।।
gṛhṇīyānniyamānpālyānpāvanān dehināṃ khalu ।
nityaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ vā lakṣaṃ vā niyamo jape ।। 11 ।।
gṛhe tvekaguṇaṃ jāpyaṃ nadyāṃ tu dviguṇaṃ smṛtam ।
sahasraṃ gosthale vahniśālāyāṃ tattu lakṣakam ।। 12।।
devakṣetreṣu tīrtheṣu sādhūnāṃ sannidhau tathā ।
daśalakṣaguṇaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tulasīsannidhau ।। 13।।
viṣṇostu sannidhau jāpyamanantaṃ bhavati dhruvam ।
mālikāvartanaṃ saṃsārā''vartadhvaṃsakaṃ smṛtam ।। 14।।
cāturmāsye tu niyamā māsi te puruṣottame ।
grāhyā aivobhayatrāpi bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ ।। 15।।
grāhyā māsasamāraṃbhe harermūrtestu sannidhau ।
gūḍasya varjanaṃ kāryaṃ tathā tailasya varjanam ।। 16।।
ghṛtasya varjanaṃ tailādestyāgaḥ kaṭuvarjanam ।
sugandhatailasaṃtyāgaḥ puṣpabhogavivarjanam ।। 17।।
kaṭvamblamadhurakṣāratiktakaṣāyavarjanam ।
tāmbūlavarjanaṃ miṣṭaphalādeścāpi varjanam ।। 18।।
pālāśapatre tvaśanaṃ pādābhyaṃgavivarjanam ।
śiro'bhyaṃgaparityāgo dadhidugdhavivarjanam ।। 19।।
kajjalādeḥ parityāgo dvirbhojanavivarjanam ।
maunaṃ grāhma kathā kāryā grāmyavārtāvivarjanam ।।1.263.20 ।।
sthālīpākaparityāgaḥ śākamātravivarjanam ।
annamātraparityāgaḥ phalānyatamavarjanam ।।21 ।।
śilopari prāśanaṃ ca kadalīpatrabhojanam ।
puṣkarasnānakararṇa gṛhasnānavivarjanam ।।22।।
guroḥ pādāmbujasparśo viṣṇoḥ pādābhivandam ।
ekabhaktāśanaṃ naktāśanaṃ niraśanaṃ ca vā ।।23।।
harergṛhe lepanaṃ mārjanaṃ prakṣālanādikam ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ śatamaṣṭottaraśataṃ ca vā'dhikam ।।24।।
gītavāditrasannṛtyaṃ pañcagavyāśanaṃ ca vā ।
śāstrakathāprabodhaśca vyāsākhyānaprabodhanam ।।25।।
tulasīdalapūjā ca prokṣaṇaṃ viṣṇumandire ।
patreṣu bhojanaṃ caiva dvidalādivivarjanam ।।26।।
prasādamātragrahaṇaṃ tāmrapātrādyabhojanam ।
kāṃsyapātrā'bhojanaṃ ca randhitānnā'prabhojanam ।।27।।
jalapakvakaṇamātrādanaṃ pakvakaṇādanam ।
mṛttikāpātrabhojitvamañjalijalapānakam ।। 28।
karapātrā'danaṃ cāpi pṛthivyāmupaveśanam ।
kapilāgopradānaṃ ca padmapatraprabhojanam ।।29।।
bhikṣānnaṃ tvamṛtakalpaṃ vrataṃ mokṣakaraṃ śubham ।
svarṇadānaṃ rūpyadānaṃ vastradānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ।।1.263.30 ।।
nityaṃ yathābalaṃ dānamannādīnāṃ supuṇyakṛt ।
yathā viṣṇustathā sādhurdvāvetau puruṣottamau ।। 31 ।।
teṣāṃ pūjā prakartavyā pratyahaṃ sevanaṃ tathā ।
śūdro vā'pyatha śūdrī vā sevāṃ kuryād gurorhareḥ ।। 22 ।।
gururvai viṣṇurūpo'sti gururdevatrayātmakaḥ ।
dehena sevā kartavyā yathā tuṣṭo bhavedguruḥ ।। 33 ।।
pāñcabhautikametaddhi tvanarthakamudāhṛtam ।
sevayitvā guruṃ tena phalānantyamavāpnuyāt ।। 34।।
dharmo'yaṃ durlabho loke dharmakāmārthamokṣadaḥ ।
ayācitaṃ vrataṃ pālyaṃ drohahiṃsādivarjam ।। 35 ।।
dānaṃ dayā dama iti kāryaṃ vai mahatāmapi ।
gurave ye prayacchanti dehadaihikasampadaḥ ।। 36 ।।
te nu dānaprabhāveṇa viṣṇorvallabhatāṃ gatāḥ ।
madhu tyājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tyājyaṃ tyājyaṃ dugdhādikaṃ tathā ।। 37।।
dāḍimaṃ mātuliṃgaṃ ca nālikeraṃ ca varjayet ।
vrīhityāgo yavatyāgo godhūmānāṃ vivarjanam ।। 38 ।।
padaṃ ślokaṃ ṛcāṃ stotramadhyāyaṃ kīrtanaṃ tathā ।
kāryaṃ geyaṃ hareragre viṣṇordhāmapradaṃ vratam ।। 39 ।।
ratestyāgo maithunasya karmatyāgo vrataṃ mahat। ।
dadhiṃ dugdhaṃ tathā takraṃ gūḍaṃ śākaṃ ca varjayet ।। 1.263.40 ।।
snānamāmalakaiḥ kāryaṃ tilaiḥ kartavyameva vā ।
dhātrīphalaṃ sadā pāpaharaṃ vai pāvanāstilāḥ ।। 41 ।।
sandhyāmaunaṃ vrataṃ rakṣyaṃ rātrāvagnyaprabodhanam ।
maunabhojitvamevāpi vrataṃ śuddhikaraṃ śubham ।। 42।।
upavāsasamaṃ jñeyaṃ phaladaṃ maunabhojanam ।
mithyākrodhaśca paiśūnyaṃ rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ tathā ।।43 ।।
vartanaṃ sarvathā tyājyaṃ māsi vai puruṣottame ।
puṇyakāryaṃ śubhaṃ kāryaṃ tyaktavyaṃ pāpakarma ca । ।44।।
dhyeyaḥ pūjyastoṣaṇīyaḥ smartavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
kṛcchrāṇyapi prakāryāṇi māse vai puruṣottame ।।45।।
kamalāyā vratakartuḥ kamalā jāyate gṛhe ।
kamalāyāstathā lakṣmyāḥ śrīpuruṣottamasya ca ।।46।।
ekādaśyāṃ prage dhyānaṃ kṛtvā snātvā vidhānataḥ ।
naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kuryāt sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।।47।।
ghaṭān dvādaśasaṃkhyākān jalaratnadalānvitān ।
akṣataphalavastrādyaiḥ saṃyutānpūjayettataḥ ।। 48 ।।
madhye ghaṭaṃ suvarṇe vā tāmrajaṃ sthāpayed vratī ।
suvāriphalaratnādyaiḥ sahitaṃ pūjayet tataḥ ।।49।।
ghaṇṭāṃ śaṃkhaṃ kalaśaṃ ca pūjayedvastubhistathā ।
ghaṭopari tilasthālyāṃ vinyasya puruṣottamam ।।1.263.50।।
pūjayed vidhinā sarvavastubhirvratakārakaḥ ।
āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtavilepanam ।।51।।
tīrthajalena ca snānaṃ kārayed varṣma mārjayet ।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādi candanādi samarpayet ।।52।।
kajjalā'gurukastūrīsugandhi tailamarpayet ।
hāraśṛṃgāraśobhādi dhūpadīpādi cārpayet। ।।53।।।
naivedye vividhaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ vāri ca cūrṇakam ।
tāmbūlaṃ subhagaṃ datvā tato nīrājayetprabhum ।।94।।
śaṃkhodakaṃ bhrāmayecca daṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇam ।
stutiṃ namaḥ kṣamāyāñcāṃ kṛtvā śayyādi kārayet ।।55।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuryāt tadānandaṃ vikāsayet ।
dadyād dānāni bhūrīṇi madhyāhne'pi tathā''caret ।।56।।
bhojayedvividhānnāni pūjayeccātibhāvataḥ ।
sāyamārārtrikaṃ kuryāt stutvā saṃbhojayettathā ।।57।।
rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryānnṛtyagītapuraḥsaram ।
dvādaśyāṃ tu prage snātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ tathā ।।58।।
bhojayitvā guroḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā'nyān bhojayed bahu ।
tataḥ svaḥ pāraṇāṃ kuryād dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ।।59।।।
evaṃ vrataṃ prakuryādvai bhuktimuktipradāyakam ।
niyamānāṃ tathā kuryādudyāpanaṃ phalapradam ।।।1.263.60 ।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayedramyaṃ saptadhānyaistu maṇḍalam ।
svastikān kārayeccāpi śayyādānāni dāpayet ।।6 1 ।।
śrīhariṃ ca ramāṃ tatra pūjayed vidhinā vratī ।
gadinaṃ ca gavārcāṃ ca sādhubhyo bhojanaṃ tathā ।।62।।
dadyācca gurave'pekṣyaṃ vastrānnābhūṣaṇādikam ।
ṣoḍaśavastubhirdevamahāpūjottaraṃ tataḥ ।।66।।
dānāni khalu dadyād vai vividhāni svayaṃ vratī ।
udyāpane tu dānāni deyāni vratapūrtaye ।।64।।
udyāpane kṛte sarvaṃ sampūrṇaṃ bhavati dhruvam ।
vrataṃ kṛtvā mahālakṣmi! yadi nodyāpanaṃ caret। ।।65।।
vratavaikalyamāsādya na samyak phalabhāgbhavet ।
vrate yanniyamaḥ svena dhṛtastatpratirūpakam ।।66।।
udyāpane tvavaśyaṃ saṃdadyāddānaṃ vratī svayam ।
tailatyāge ghṛtaṃ dadyād ghṛtatyāge payaḥ smṛtam ।।67।।
maune tilādayo deyāḥ sahiraṇyāstu śārṅgiṇe ।
bhojane bhojanaṃ dadyād dadhyodanasamanvitam ।।68।।
annaṃ miṣṭaṃ suvarṇāḍhyaṃ dadyādvai bahubhāvataḥ ।
pālāśapātrabhojī tu dadyānmiṣṭaṃ ghṛtādikam ।।69।।
naktabhojī pradadyādvai bhojanaṃ ṣaḍrasānvitam ।
ayācite tvanaḍvāhaṃ sopaskaraṃ samarpayet ।।1.263.70।।
māṣatyāgī pradadyāttu savatsāṃ gāṃ sulakṣaṇām ।
dhātrīsnāne vratī dadyāt suvarṇaṃ māṣamātrakam ।।7 1 ।।
phalānāṃ niyame dadyāt phalāni vividhāni vai ।
dhānyānāṃ niyame dadyāt dhānyāni śāligodhūmān ।।72।।
dadyādbhūśayane śayyāṃ satūlāṃ gendukānvitām ।
brahmacaryakṛte dadyād dampatyorbhojanāni vai ।।73।।
śākatyāge tu śākāni nairlāvaṇye rasādikam ।
nityasnāne ca niḥsnehe dadyād ghṛtaṃ ca saktukān ।। 74।।
nakhakeśavrate dadyādādarśaṃ vyajanādikam ।
upānahoḥ parityāge dadyādupānahau mudā ।।75।।
dugdhādisaṃparityāge dadyādvai kapilāṃ tu gām ।
dīpavrate pradadyādvai sauvarṇa dīpapātrakam ।।76।।
maithunānāṃ tu niyame raupyaṃ dadyād dhanādikam ।
evaṃ yadyad vrataṃ sveṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ ca niyamo dhṛtaḥ ।।77।।
tattad datvā niyamasya prapūrtiṃ parikalpayet ।
godānaṃ śarkarādānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ।।78।।
bhūdānaṃ kanyakādānaṃ brahmasūtrapradānakam ।
vidyādānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ svasarvārpaṇamityapi ।।79।।
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
kiṃ bahunā'tra coktena yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet ।।1.263.80 ।।
punaḥ prāptyarthamevā'sya dānaṃ kuryādasaṃśayaḥ ।
svasya svīyasya sarvasya haraye dānamuttamam ।।8 1 ।।
gurave mokṣadātre vā dadyāt sarvasvameva vai ।
adhruveṇa dhruvaṃ mokṣaṃ sādhayet kuśalo janaḥ ।।82।।
kamalāyā vratakarturgṛhe tu kamalā''gamaḥ ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi prāgvṛttaṃ tu kathānakam ।।83।।
haridvāre'bhavat kaścit śākaṭāyanabhūsuraḥ ।
svalpaṃ vai śakaṭaṃ tasya gṛhamāsanamāśrayam ।।84।।
bhikṣāhārastṛṇatūlaḥ kaṭagenduka eva saḥ ।
vartate devagaṃgāyā nikaṭe karapātrakaḥ ।।85।।
ekadā sa gato bhikṣāyācanāya digantare ।
vṛṣṭyā''kasmikayā tasya hṛtaṃ vai śakaṭaṃ priye ।।86।।
asvo dṛṣṭvā hṛtaṃ svasya śakaṭaṃ sa yayau tataḥ ।
padbhyāṃ prayāgarājākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthāya caikalaḥ ।।87।।
kṣutkṣāmo dīnavadanastriveṇyāṃ snānamācarat ।
munīnāmāśramāँstatra gaveṣayan kṣudhārditaḥ ।।88।।
bhāradvājāśramaṃ tatra dadarśa divyamadbhutam ।
puruṣottamamāse vai janānāṃ saṃsad tathā ।।89।।
tatrāśrame tu sulabhāṃ kathāṃ kalmaṣanāśinīm ।
bhāradvājamukhād ramyāṃ śuśrāva kamalāmayīm ।।1.263.90।।
ekādaśyāḥ kathāṃ śrutvā bhuktimuktipradāyinīm ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ proktāṃ dhanapradām ।।9 1।।
śākaṭāyanavipro'sau śrutvā tāṃ kamalākathām ।
vrataṃ taiḥ kṛtavān sārdhaṃ sthitvā munyāśrame tadā ।।92।।
rātraṃ jāgaraṇaṃ cakre kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smaran hṛdi ।
brāhmemuhūrte dvādaśyāṃ lakṣmīstatra samāgatā ।।93।।
divyāṃgā divyatejaskā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ।
prāha varaṃ dadāmyatra prasannā'smi vratānmama ।।94।।
śākaṭāyanavipro'pi papracchāścaryasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
kā tvaṃ kasyāsi rambhoru prasannāpi kathaṃ mama ।।95।।
lakṣmīḥ prāha prasannā'haṃ jātā vrataprabhāvataḥ ।
preritā devadevena vaikuṇṭhādahamāgatā ।।96 ।।
puruṣottamamāsasya kamalāyā vratāttu te ।
kamalāṃ vipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ dātumatra samāgatā ।।97।।
mamavrataṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ prayāge ṛṣiyogataḥ ।
āśiṣo vratavaśagā dade tvāṃ 'dhanavān bhava' ।।98।।
ravāvekādaśī yatra madhyādau dvādaśī tathā ।
trayodaśī niśāśeṣe vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ।।99।।
tatra kratuśanaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe ।
etadvrataṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ prasannā'smi mahāmune ।। 1.263.10 0।।
gṛhāṇemaṃ maṇiṃ divyaṃ yasmātsvarṇaṃ prapadyate ।
ityuktvā kamalā tasmai maṇiṃ datvā tirodadhe ।। 101 ।।
śākaṭāyanavipro'pi maṇiṃ nītvā gṛhaṃ gataḥ ।
nityaṃ svarṇaśataṃ prātardadātyeṣo maṇirmahān ।। 1 02।।
śākaṭāyanavipro'pi datte dānaṃ tvaharniśam ।
evaṃ sa ṛṣivaryo'pi śākaṭāyanabhūsuraḥ ।। 10 3।।
indrādapyadhikāṃ smṛddhiṃ labdhavān kamalāvratāt ।
yācakāya pradātavyaṃ yadyad vāñchati madgṛhāt ।। 1 04।।
evaṃ prakāśitaṃ śākaṭāyanena bhuvastale ।
athaikadā pulastyo vai brāhmaṇo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ ।। 1 05।।
śrutvaivaṃ dānakīrtiṃ ca maṇerbhikṣecchayā svayam ।
śākaṭāyanabhavanaṃ tvājagāma vicārya ca ।। 106।।
yayāce tanmaṇerbhikṣāṃ nispṛho'pi munirdadau ।
pulastyo'pi maṇiṃ nītvā yayau dvīpaṃ tu siṃhalam ।। 1 07। ।
tatra svarṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ cakre puravanādikam ।
tenā'rpitaḥ kuberāya dhanādhipataye maṇiḥ ।। 1 08। ।
rāvaṇastaṃ jahārā'tha svarṇalaṃkāṃ cakāra saḥ ।
evaṃ vai kamalā devī vratena yadi tuṣyati । । 1 09।।
sarvaṃ dadāti bhaktāya vrataṃ yat toṣakārakam ।
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi kamalāyāḥ phalaṃ bhavet ।। 1.263.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsasya kṛṣṇapakṣakamalaikādaśīmāhātmyaṃ niyamāḥ, udyāpanam, śākaṭāyanasya vratena maṇiprāptirlakṣmīprāptistato pulastyakuberarāvaṇa-
suvarṇalābhādiścetikathananāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 263 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 263 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 264
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 265 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śrotṝṇāṃ paramaṃ śrāvyaṃ pavitrāṇāmanuttamam ।
duḥsvapnanāśakaṃ divyaṃ śrotavyaṃ yatnato mayā ।। 1 ।।
māsānāṃ paramo māsaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ।
yasya devaḥ svayaṃ sākṣātpuruṣottama eva vai ।। 2 ।।
svargīyā nirjarāḥ sarve bhūtale janma lipsavaḥ ।
tamarcayanti puruṣaṃ tūttamaṃ tu narāyaṇam ।। 3 ।।
ye japanti sadā bhaktyā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
tānarcayanti satataṃ brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ ।। 4 ।।
tasya te devadevasya māsasya puruṣottama ।
śuklapakṣaikādaśī kiṃnāmnī bhavati me vada ।। 5 ।।
ko vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ dānaṃ ko devo vada me prabho ।
yadvrataṃ manujaḥ kṛtvā prāpnuyātsvargamakṣaram ।। 6 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
puruṣottamamāsasya śuklapakṣe tu dhāmadā ।
bhavatyekādaśī nāmnā yadbhūtaṃ brahmadhāmadam ।। 7 ।।
vidhirbrahmamayaścātra phalaṃ brahmamayaṃ smṛtam ।
brahmadhāmeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patirmataḥ ।। 8 ।।
akṣarātīta evāyaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ।
akṣarayā svapatnyā tu sahito dhāmadāyutaḥ ।। 9 ।।
pūjanīyo muktalatākusumaiścāmṛtaiḥ phalaiḥ ।
dānamupaniṣadvidyāśca vai mokṣadānakam ।। 1.264.10 ।।
dīkṣādānaṃ brahmadānaṃ vedadānaṃ nijārpaṇam ।
sarvasvārpaṇamevā'tra dānānāmuttamaṃ matam ।। 11 ।।
bhagavaddhāmadānāgre dānamanyat samalpakam ।
dhāmaprāptikaraṃ dānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ mataṃ priye ।। 12 ।।
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād bhūśāyī brahmacaryavān ।
prātarutthāya saṃdhyāyedakṣarāṃ puruṣottamam । । 13 ।।
dhāmadāṃ cāpi saṃsmṛtya kuryātsnānaṃ yathāvidhi ।।
naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā mahāpūjāṃ samācaret ।। 14 ।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।
kārayeccā'vraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ ratnagarbhaṃ sakācanam ।। 15 ।।
vastravāriphalayuktaṃ sthāpayenmaṇḍale tataḥ ।
viśālaṃ tāmrajaṃ pātraṃ kuṃbhopari nidhāpayet ।। 16 ।।
kamalaṃ dvādaśapatraṃ kuṃkumaistatra darśayet ।
tatrārcayedakṣarayā sahitaṃ puruṣottamam । । 1 7।।
tathā kamalayopetaṃ sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmahāpūjāṃ samācaret ।। 18 ।।
divyaṃ divyamahāmuktaiḥ sevitaṃ ca prabhādibhiḥ ।
rādhālakṣmyādibhiryuktaṃ dhyāyāmi sundaraṃ varam ।। 19 ।।
bhaktakṛpākaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ manasā''vāhayāmyaham ।
svarṇasiṃhāsane kṛṣṇa niṣīda puruṣottama ।। 1.264.20 ।।
gaṃgodakaṃ jalaṃ pādyaṃ gṛhāṇā'kṣarayā saha ।
gandhapuṣpādisaṃyuktaṃ jalamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ।। 21 ।।
gālitaṃ tīrthasalilaṃ gṛhṇīṣvācamanīyakam ।
dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarāṃ ca janārdana ।। 22 ।।
paṃcāmṛtaṃ snapanārthaṃ kṛpayā pratigṛhyatām ।
vāridheḥ saritāṃ toyaṃ snānārthaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 23 ।।
dhautraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ kaṃcukādikaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।
śāṭīṃ ghargharikāṃ kaṃcukyādikaṃ pragṛhāṇa vai ।। 24। ।
paṭṭasūtraṃ brahmasūtraṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama ।
keyūraṃ kaṭakeṃ'gulīyakaṃ mukuṭanūpure ।। 25 ।।
raśanāṃ tantikāṃ natthīṃ jhaṃjhirairāṇi gṛhyatām ।
ratnaṃ svarṇaṃ puṣpahārān śṛṃgārādi pragṛhyatām ।। 26 ।।
kastūryagurukarpūraiścandanairlepanaṃ kuru ।
kadambaṃ campakaṃ padmaṃ kundaṃ jātīṃ ca gṛhyatām ।। 27।।
dhūpa sugandhadaṃ nārāyaṇa gṛhāṇa bhāvataḥ ।
dīpaṃ ghṛtakṛtaṃ ramyaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama ।। 28 ।।
kuṃkumābīragūlālakajjalāttaramāvaha ।
ārārtrikaṃ suprakāśaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama ।। 29 ।।
annaṃ ca pāyasaṃ śaṣkulyādi goghṛtapolikāḥ ।
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭaṃ gṛhāṇa kamalāpate ।। 1.264.30 ।।
jalaṃ tairthyaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ śītalaṃ piba mādhava ।
pūgyelākhadirāḍhyaṃ tu tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām ।। 31 ।।
kadalā'mrā'mṛtadāḍimaśrīphalaṃ pragṛhyatām ।
dakṣiṇāṃ kāṃcanīṃ kṛṣṇa gṛhāṇa hīrakādikam ।। 32।।
aṃjalisthāni puṣpāṇi hyakṣatāँśca gṛhāṇa vai ।
namaste kamalākānta namo'kṣarādhināyaka ।।3 3 ।।
karomi daṇḍavat tvakṣareśa svāmin gṛhāṇa ca ।
tvāṃ vinā śaraṇaṃ nānyastvameva śaraṇaṃ mama ।। 34।।
vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru śrīśa rakṣa māmakṣareśvara ।
annaṃ vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca śākaṃ śayyāṃ ghṛtādikam ।। 35।।
arpayāmi harerbuddhyā dvijāyaitad gṛhāṇa vai ।
iti saṃpūjya sadbhaktyā divāśeṣaṃ nayed vratī ।। 36।।
dāna dadyād yathāśakti kurvītā'vaśyakīṃ kriyām ।
madhyāhne'pi sumiṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ ca jalādikam ।। 37।।
sāyaṃ cāpi mahāpūjāṃ kārayed bahuvastubhiḥ ।
kuryānnīrājanaṃ tvājyapañcavartisamanvitam ।। 38।।
naivedyaṃ jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ pādamardanam ।
datvā kṛtvā kīrtanaiśca rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret ।। 39 ।।
haryālayaṃ jāgarārthaṃ satāṃ vā tu maṭhaṃ prati ।
gacchato'styaśvamedhasya phalaṃ puṃsaḥ pade pade ।।1.264.40 ।।
prātaḥ snātvā punaḥ pūjāṃ nityāṃ naimittikīṃ tathā ।
kuryācca bhojayed devaṃ tato bhaktāँstu bhojayet ।।4 1 ।।
gurave svarṇamūrtīnāṃ dānaṃ kuryāt vratī tataḥ ।
bahūni tvanyadānāni kuryāṃccābhimatāni vai ।।42।।
sādhūँśca vaiṣṇavān sādhvīrbhojayenmṛṣṭabhojanam ।
haviṣyānnena kurvīta pāraṇāṃ ca tato vratī ।।43 ।।
divānidrāṃ parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune ।
dvādaśyāṃ varjayet tailaṃ tāmasaṃ cāpi bhojanam ।।44।।
pāraṇāhe tu labhyeta svalpāpi dvādaśī yadi ।
tatraiva pāraṇāṃ kuryānna tāmullaṃghayed vratī ।।45 ।।
dvādaśyāḥ prathamaḥ pādo harervāsara ucyate ।
tatra naiva hi bhoktavyaṃ puṇyāsyā'kṣayamicchatā ।।46 ।।
evaṃ dhāmapradāyāśca vrataṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ ।
vimānena ca taṃ bhaktaṃ hyante dhāma nayet prabhuḥ ।।47।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! purā jātaṃ vṛttāntaṃ dhāmadāvrate ।
āsīt kṛtayuge rājā puṇḍarīkasamāhvayaḥ ।।48।।
viṣṇubhaktaścakravartī sarvatra samadarśanaḥ ।
sāghuvatsarvathā dehe daihike niṣparigrahaḥ ।।49।।
ardhaṃ dinaṃ tu pūjāyāṃ śeṣaṃ nyāyapradāpane ।
yāpayati vratāhe tu pūjāmātraṃ karoti vai ।।1.264.50 ।।
rājñī kumudvatīnāmnī tasya tvāsītpativratā ।
patyājñāmeva śāstrājñāṃ matvā saṃsevate patim ।।51 ।।
apṛṣṭvā svapatiṃ kiṃcinnaiva karoti mānasam ।
ekadā''sītpuṇḍarīko dhāmadāvratapūjane ।।52।।
rājñī jvarā'bhibhūtā''sīdantaḥpurādhivāsinī ।
sāyaṃ svāsthyaprarakṣārthaṃ vinā pṛṣṭvā tu tatpatim ।।।53।।
dāsībhiḥ saha vāṭikāyāmudyānaṃ prajagāma sā ।
kṣudhayā cānukūlaṃ tu jvarānuttejakaṃ phalam ।।54।।
navaraṃgaṃ gṛhītvā tadrasaṃ papau pativratā ।
patiṃ tvapāyāyitvā'sau papau pativratā yataḥ ।।55।।
pātivratye'bhavadbhaṃgo jvaraścātivyavardhata ।
tṛṣayā ca jalaṃ pītvā rātrau tatraiva saṃsthitā ।।56।।
prātaḥ patyurnityasevā na jātā'dya dine tathā ।
prātarbharturmukhadarśanaṃ na jātaṃ tathā param ।।।57।।
patyaṃguṣṭhajalapānaṃ prāptaṃ naiva ca naiva ca ।
pāravaśyaṃ gatā rugṇā pātivratyaṃ kṣatiṃ gatam ।।58।।
jvaraścātiprabalo'bhūd varṣma śuṣkāyitaṃ tadā ।
pātivratyasya bhagena rājñī tvapuṇyabhāginī ।।59।।
maraṇasyonmukhī jātā pīḍyate'tīva śoṣitā ।
duritācca kumudvatyāḥ prāṇāḥ prayānti naiva ca ।।1.264.60 ।।
puṇḍarīkaśca śuśrāva rājñyā āmayamityapi ।
vrate pūrṇe samāgatya sevāṃ tasyāścakāra ha ।।6 1 ।।
āyuṣyaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yātaṃ prāṇā niryānti naiva ca ।
tadā rājñā jalaṃ datvā dhāmadāphalamarpitam ।।62।।
śīghraṃ prāṇāstu niryātā vimānaṃ divyamāgatam ।
viṣṇunā ca tathā lakṣmyā pārṣadaiśca suśobhitam ।।63।।
akṣarāsahitaśrīmatpuruṣottamaśobhitam ।
dvitīyaṃ ca vimānaṃ tvāgatamakṣaradhāmadam ।।64।।
prathamaṃ viṣṇunā nītā vimāne sā ramāyute ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpitā paścādārūḍhā'nyavimānake ।।65।।
akṣaraṃ dhāma nītā śrīpuruṣottamadhāminā ।
evaṃ vai dhāmadāyāḥ sā puṇyalābhena dhāmagā ।।66।।
abhavacca kimu tarhi dhāmadāvratinaḥ punaḥ ।
tasmāddhāmapradāyāstu vrataṃ kāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।।67।।
puruṣottamamāsasya śuklaikādaśikāvratam ।
paraṃ dhāmapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sampatpradaṃ tathā ।।68 ।।
śrutvā cāpi paṭhitvāpi vratatulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ।
sakāmānāṃ mahāsmṛddhapārameṣṭhyādi saṃbhavet ।। 69 ।।
yathābalaṃ prakartavyaṃ tadidaṃ śubhakāṃkṣiṇā ।
akṣarā dhāmadā cāsmai bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pradāsyati ।।1.264.7 0 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsasya śukladhāmadaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ puṇḍarīkanṛpasya kumudvatīpatnyāḥ kiṃcitpatisevālābhaśūnyāyā api vratenā'kṣaradhāmaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 264।।
