śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
udyāpanāni sarvāṇi sarvadevaprapūjanam ।
bhagavan kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tanmayā viditaṃ prabho ।। 1 ।।
ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ yadyudyāpanamekalam ।
kartavyaṃ syāttadā vistāraḥ kiyāँstaṃ ca me vada ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi sarvāsāmekalakṣaṇam ।
udyāpanaṃ samastaṃ vai sampūrṇaphaladaṃ yathā ।। 3 ।।
maṇḍape nirmite ramye kadalīstambhaśobhite ।
vidhāya sarvatobhadraṃ tanmadhye sthāpayed ghaṭam ।। 4 ।।
aśvatthodumbaraplakṣacūtanyagrodhapallavaiḥ ।
yuktaṃ ratnairvastrakaṇṭhaṃ tathā salilasaṃbhṛtam ।। 5 ।।
tanmukhe sumahatpātraṃ nidadhyātkuṃkumānvitam ।
kamalaṃ dvādaśapatraṃ daladvādaśakānvitam ।। 6 ।।
kṛtvā madhye ramājuṣṭaṃ vāsudevaṃ suvarṇajam ।
sthāpayetparitaścaturviṃśatyekādaśapatīn ।। 7 ।।
tattatpatnīsametāँśca sthāpayetpūrvataḥ kramāt ।
ādye śrīkeśavau padmānārāyaṇau tato dale ।। 8 ।।
mādhavo nityayā sākaṃ govindaścandrayā saha ।
ramayā saha viṣṇuśca mādhavyā madhusūdanaḥ ।। 9 ।।
trivikramaśca padmākṣyā vāmanaḥ kamalāyutaḥ ।
śrīdharaḥ kāntimatyā ca hṛṣīkeśā'parājite ।। 1.265.10 ।।
padmanābhaḥ padmavatyā rādhādāmodarau tataḥ ।
patreṣu pūrvataḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ saha sunandayā ।। 11 ।।
vāsudevo hariṇyā'tha pradyumnaśca dhiyā saha ।
aniruddhaḥ suśīlāyuk nandayā puruṣottamaḥ ।। 12।।
adhokṣajastrayīyuktaḥ kṣemaṃkaryā nṛkesarī ।
acyuto vijayāyuktaḥ sundaryā ca janārdanaḥ ।। 13 ।।
upendraḥ subhagāyukto hariḥ saha hiraṇyayā ।
kṛṣṇaḥ sulakṣaṇāyuktaḥ sthāpanīyo vidhānataḥ ।। 14।।
paṃcāmṛtena madhyasya snānamabhyaṃgapūrvakam ।
mahābhiṣekaṃ kuryācca vastrābhūṣādi cārpayet ।। 15।।
sarvagandhaiḥ sumanobhiḥ pūjayettulasīdalaiḥ ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ candanaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalamarpayet ।। 16 ।।
modakān khājakāँścaiva cūrṇāni ghṛtapūrakān ।
sohilakāँśca kaṃsāraṃ saktūn sevāँśca polikāḥ ।। 17।।
pūrikāḥ pāyasaṃ dugdhasāraṃ dadhyodanaṃ tathā ।
piṇḍakān vaṭakāँścaiva śatacchidrāँśca śaṣkulīḥ ।। 18 ।।
tilapākaṃ śālipākaṃ mudgacūrṇaṃ guḍaudanam ।
raṃbhāphalaṃ tathā'nyacca miṣṭānnamarpayed bahu ।। 1 9।।
śākāni vividhānyeva phalāni vividhānyapi ।
tāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsādi jalaṃ cāpi samarpayet ।। 1.265.20 ।।
mahānīrājanaṃ kṛtvā dadyātpuṣpāṃjaliṃ tataḥ ।
stutiṃ namo daṇḍavacca kṣamāyācanamityapi ।। 21 ।।
kṛtvā samāpya pūjāṃ ca dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ।
gobhūtilahiraṇyāśvagajavāhāmbarāṇi ca ।। 22 ।।
tato devagṛhe goṣṭhe samidājyatilaudanaiḥ ।
puṣparasānvitairhomamācaret tattadāhvayaiḥ ।। 23 ।।
gāścaturviśatiṃ dadyādekā vā kāṃcanānvitām ।
madhyāhne pūjayettadvad bhojayecca yathāvidhi ।। 24।।
sāyaṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryātpūjayed bhojayettathā ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhāta tvarcayeddharim ।। 25।।
suvarṇanirmitāṃ mūrtiṃ dadyātsvagurave vratī ।
alaṃkārāँśca vāsāṃsi śayyāṃ dadyāttato vratī ।। 26 ।।
caturviṃśatibhūdevān sādhūँśca bhojayet satīḥ ।
ghaṭāँśca viṣṇave dadyāt pradadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।। 27।।।
tataḥ sa pāraṇāṃ kuryād bhojayitvā janānsvakān ।
evaṃ kṛte caturviṃśatyekādaśīphalaṃ bhavet ।। 28 ।।
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyamudyāpanamahotsave ।
lakṣmīkāntaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇastuṣyatyevarddhisampradaḥ ।। 29।।
atha lakṣmi! kathayāmi dhenuśailādikān śṛṇu ।
pūjayitvā tato dadyād gurave bahulaṃ dhanam ।। 1.265.30 ।।
vaibhave vipule dadyād dhenūrdaśavidhā vratī ।
merūndaśavidhāndadyāt śṛṇu tatra vidhiṃ priye ।। 31 । ।
tatra gomayaliptāyāṃ darbhānāstīrya vai bhuvi ।
udakpādāḥ prāṅmukhyaśca kalpanīyāstu gā daśa ।। 32 । ।
guḍadhenuṃ guḍenaiva śataprasthamitena vai ।
pañcaviṃśatisīraiśca tadvatsa kalpayed vratī ।। 33 ।।
yadvā gūḍha yathāśraddhaṃ dhenusthāne nidhāya ca ।
yathāśraddhaṃ ca tadvatsaṃ kṛtvā guḍena vai tataḥ । । 34 ।।
anarghyairvasanaiḥ sūkṣmairveṣṭayitvā ca tāvubhau ।
śuktikarṇāvikṣupādau śuddhamauktikanetrakau ।। 35।।
tāmrapṛṣṭhau kṣaumapucchau śvetorṇākṛtakambalau ।
svarṇaśṛṃgau rūpyakhurau vidrumabhrūkuṭīyutau ।। 2 6।।
nānā''bharaṇaśobhāḍhyau kāṃsyadohanasaṃyutau ।
vidhāyaivaṃ tu govatsau pūjayedvidhinā vratī । । 37 ।।
ghṛtadhenuṃ dugdhadhenuṃ śarkarādhenumuttamām ।
tiladhenuṃ madhudhenuṃ rasadhenuṃ tathottamām ।। 38 ।।
dadhidhenuṃ cāmbudhenuṃ svarṇadhenuṃ vidhāya ca ।
tattadvatsaṃ prathamavat kṛtvā saṃpūjayed vratī ।। 39 ।।
yathāśakti prakuryādvai dhenūँśca vatsakāṃstathā ।
pradadyād gurave sarvāḥ puruṣottamatuṣṭaye ।।1.265.40 । ।
tadvacca parvatān ramyān vṛkṣataḍāgasaṃyutān ।
kalpayitvā daśavidhān caturaḥ koṇaparvatān ।। 41 ।।
pūjayedvidhinā dadyādgurave harituṣṭaye ।
maṇḍape gomayalipte kuśānāstīrya bhūtale ।। 42 ।।
madhye vrīhimayaṃ meruṃ sahasradroṇasammitam ।
kuryād droṇaṃ tu dvādaśaprasthapramitamuttamam ।।।43 ।।
pūrve mauktikahīrakapadmarāgāँśca dakṣiṇe ।
pītaśyāmān paścimāyāmuttare vidrumānnyaset ।। 44।।
ikṣudaṇḍairguhāṃ kuryācchuktibhistu śilādikam ।
ghṛtena prasravaṇāni vastrairmeghāँśca kalpayet । ।45 ।।
śṛṃgāṇi svarṇaraupyāṇi munīndevān hiraṇmayān ।
indrādīn dikpatīn raupyān kuryād vṛkṣāँśca dhātubhiḥ ।।46 ।।
mandāraṃ pārijātaṃ ca kalpadru ca kadambakam ।
kṛtvā saṃśobhayetpuṣpaphalaiḥ sauvarṇarājataiḥ ।।47।।
mandarādriryavaiḥ pūrve godhūmairgandhamādanaḥ ।
vipulādristilaiḥ paśce māṣaiḥ supārśva uttare ।।48।।
kāryāścaite nagāḥ śobhāyuktāḥ svopaskarairyutāḥ ।
svastyayanaṃ vācayitvā tvāvāhya devaparvatān ।।49 ।।
pūjayitvā pradadyācca gurave smṛddhaparvatān ।
gāścaturviśatiṃ dadyād viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।।1.265.50।।
lavaṇādriṃ guḍādriṃ ca hemādriṃ tilaparvatam ।
kārpāsādriṃ ghṛtādriṃ ca ratnādriṃ rājatācalam ।।51।।
śarkarādriṃ yathāśakti nagānnava prakārayet ।
pārśvasthānparvatāँścāpi caturaścaturo yathā ।।52।।
racayitvā pūrvavacca śobhāṃ kuryādanekadhā ।
pūjayedvidhinā sarvān dadyācca gurave tu tān ।।53।।।
godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ kanyādānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ।
yānavāhananagaragrāmadānaṃ vidhāpayet ।।54।।
sarvasvaṃ gurave dadyād viprebhyastu yathārhakam ।
bhikṣukebhyastvannadānamanyebhyo yadapekṣitam ।।55।।
evamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā paścād devān visarjayet ।
sarvaṃ tadgurave dadyād devālayāya vā'rpayet ।।।56।।
vrateṣu tyājyavastūnāṃ gṛhītā niyamāstu ye ।
tattadvastupradānaṃ tu kāryamudyāpane tathā ।।97।।
dattaṃ sarvaṃ milatyevehā'mutra tvanyathā na vai ।
tasmād yathā balaṃ kāryā prapūrṇatā vratottaram ।।58।।
vaivasvatena manunā kṛtamudyāpanaṃ purā ।
bhṛguputryā ramayā ca kṛtamudyāpanaṃ tathā ।।59।।
padmayā dharaṇipuvyā kṛtamudyāpanaṃ tathā ।
prāpya viṣṇuṃ ca vaikuṇṭhe modante sarvadā tathā ।।1.265.6 0।।
pārvatyā ca kṛtaṃ sarvamudyāpanaṃ mahat purā ।
prabhayā ca kṛtaṃ tadvadudyāpanaṃ yathāyatham ।।61 ।।
iti lakṣmi kathitāni vratāni vidhitaśca te ।
ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।62।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sarvāsāmekādaśīnāṃ mahodyāpanavidhisvarūpanirūpaṇanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 265 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 265 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 266
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 267 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
vārṣikāṇāṃ vratānāṃ ca rūpaṃ vistarato vada ।
yatkṛtvā mānavāścāpi prāpnuyurbhogamokṣaṇe ।। 1 ।।
vinā''tmasādhanaṃ tvanyaddhruvaṃ duḥkhasaṃbhṛtam ।
jñātvā yateta nityārthaṃ jano yathā ca tadvada ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi pāvanāni dināni vai ।
vratātmakāni sarvāṇi niḥśreyasapradāni hi ।। 3 ।।
harestasya vibhūtīnāṃ satāṃ yogācca sarvathā ।
kālo'pi divyatāṃ yāti vratātmā muktido bhavet ।। 4 ।।
yasyāṃ tithau vrataṃ yasya yatphalaṃ pūjanaṃ yathā ।
yadvidhānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tatsarvaṃ pravadāmi te ।। 5 ।।
caitre māsi jagatsarvaṃ śuklapakṣe tu viśvasṛṭ ।
dināraṃbhe pratipadi sasarjaitaccarācaram ।। 6 ।।
tatra pratipadi kāryā mahāśāntiḥ sukhapradā ।
sarvotpātapraśamanī dhanasaubhāgyadāyinī ।। 7 ।।
āyuḥpuṣṭipradā ceyaṃ lokadvayasukhapradā ।
kuṇḍaṃ ca maṇḍapaṃ tatra kārayitvā śubhe sthale ।। 8 ।।
vahnivapurdharaṃ brahmāṇaṃ vai samarcayet vratī ।
pādyārghyapuṣpadhūpaiśca vastrālaṃkārabhojanaiḥ । । 9 ।।
homairbalyupahāraiśca sādhusādhvīpratarpaṇaiḥ ।
pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇā'kṣatacandanasadrasaiḥ ।। 1.266.10 ।।
suvarṇapratimāṃ kṛtvā brahmāṇaṃ saṃprapūjayet ।
ṣoḍaśottamakaraṇairbhojanairvividhaistathā ।। 11 ।।
caturmukhaṃ caturhastaṃ dvipādaṃ vedahastakam ।
kamaṇḍalukaraṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ tvabhipūjayet ।। 12 ।।
ārārtrikottaraṃ devaṃ prārthayedvratakṛnnaraḥ ।
vrate phalādikaṃ bhuñjyādathavaikānnamityapi ।। 13 ।।
brahmacaryaṃ rakṣayecca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।
prārthayed vedhasaṃ putrapautravaṃśapravṛttaye ।। 14।।
mūrtidānaṃ tu gurave dadyādajasvarūpiṇe ।
kanyādānamapi dadyād vratī saṃkalpapūrvakam ।। 15।।
vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ tvetadvrataṃ sarvasukhapradam ।
kṛtvauṃkāranamaskāraṃ kuśodakatilā'kṣataiḥ ।। 1 6।।
savastraṃ sahiraṇyaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ ca gavādikam ।
anyaccāpi yathāśaktidhanaṃ dadyāddvijātaye ।। 17।।
dakṣiṇāṃ vedaviduṣe vratasaṃpūrtihetave ।
etadbrāhmavrataṃ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ kāmanārthibhiḥ ।। 18 ।।
asyāmeva tithau tadvat sarasvatīvrataṃ śubham ।
kartavyaṃ saphalāhāraṃ yadvaikāhāramityapi ।। 1 9।।
brahmaṇo vadanātprātaḥ samutpannā hi śāradā ।
dvādaśādhikavarṣīyā savīṇā samayūrakā ।। 1.266.20 ।।
nīlasvarṇamahāmūlyaśāṭikadisamanvitā ।
kartavyā sūjjvalā mūrtiḥ pūjanīyā vidhānataḥ ।। 21 ।।
prātaḥ sampūjya sā devī ṣoḍaśādikavastubhiḥ ।
prārthanīyā brahmavidyālabdhaye vratinā tataḥ ।। 2-2।।
dugdhapākastu naivedye tvarpaṇīyaśca pūrikāḥ ।
taddine kṣīrapākaśca bhojanīyo vratārthinā ।। 23 ।।
dvitīye divase vidyā''raṃbharaṇīyā'rthadā bhavet ।
dānāni vividhānyeva dadyācchrīgurave vratī ।। 24।।
svarṇasarasvatīmūrtiṃ dadyācchrīgurave tataḥ ।
vidyā me rasanāgre tu nartakī syāttadarthayet ।। 25 ।।
visarjayecca dānāni dadyācchaktyanusārataḥ ।
viprānsādhūnpaṇḍitāँśca bhojayetpūjayed vratī ।। 26।।
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu pratipadyabdhimanthane ।
kriyamāṇe surairdaityaiḥ prātaḥ kūrmo'bhavaddhariḥ ।। 27।।
sauvarṇaṃ kūrmarūpaṃ tu vāsudevaṃ samarcayet ।
uttarāṃgaṃ narākāraṃ pūrvāṃgaṃ kūrmarūpadhṛk ।। 28 ।।
śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ bhujayostu dadyānmodakabhojanam ।
śarkarāṃ dadhi ciñcvādyā vāri miṣṭaṃ samarpayet ।। 29।।
utsavaṃ tu mahāntaṃ vai kuryātkūrmakathānakam ।
evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kṛtvā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt। ।। 1.266.30 ।।
atha jyeṣṭhe site pratipadi druṃ karavīrakam ।
svargodyānāt pṛthivyāmāgataṃ prātaḥ prapūjayet ।। 31 ।।
raktatantuparīdhānaṃ dadyād dhūpaṃ vilepanam ।
gandhākṣatān jalaṃ dadyānnāraṃgaṃ bījapūrakam ।। 3 2।।
prarūḍhadhānyaṃ'kurakairabhyukṣya stavanaṃ caret ।
karavīra mahābhāga phalāni yaccha sarvadā ।। 33 ।।
saptadhānyāni saumyāni kusūleṣu vasantu me ।
iti pradakṣiṇīkṛtya datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ vratī ।। 34।।
namaskṛtya jalaṃ datvā paścāt svaṃ bhavanaṃ vrajet ।
evaṃ saṃpūjito vṛkṣo dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti vai ।। 35 ।।
namaḥśukle pratipadi lakṣmībuddhipradāyakam ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sampādakaṃ vrataṃ mahat ।। 36 ।।
bhādraśuklapratipadi vrataṃ maunaṃ prakīrtitam ।
śivaprapūjanaṃ kuryāt kuṃbhopari vidhānataḥ ।। 37।।
sauvarṇaśivamūrtestvarcanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।
phalāni miṣṭapakvāni dadyādviprāya ṣoḍaśa ।। 38 ।।
pakvānnāni ca dānāni dadyācchivāya ṣoḍaśa ।
dhenuṃ dadyāttathā'nyāni dadyād dānāni ṣoḍaśa ।। 3 9।।
idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lakṣmi! devadevasya śūlinaḥ ।
caturdaśābdaṃ dehāntaṃ bhuktabhogaḥ śivaṃ vrajet ।। 1.266.40 ।।
āśvine śuklapratipadvrataṃ cā'śokasaṃjñakam ।
aśokastu samāyātaḥ svargād bhuvi drumottamaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
aśokapūjanaṃ tatra kuryāt ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।
aśoko jāyate tena dhanadhānyaprapūritaḥ ।।42 ।।
vratānte dvādaśe varṣe mūrtiṃ cā'śokaśākhinaḥ ।
samarpya gurave bhaktyā viṣṇuloke sukhī bhavet ।। 43 ।।
aśokaphalavattasya prajā aśokakārikāḥ ।
sukhadāśca dhanāḍhyāśca phalanti phaladā bhuvi ।। 44।।
asyāmeva pratipadi navarātraṃ samācaret ।
navarātraṃ tvekabhuktaṃ vartayeccā'pyayācitam ।।45।।
athavopavasennityaṃ phalaṃ vā bhakṣayed vratī ।
pūrvāhṇe pūjayed durgāṃ ghaṭasthāpanapūrvakam ।।46 ।।
aṃkurāropaṇaṃ kuryād yavairgodhūmataṇḍulaiḥ ।
pūjanaṃ paṭhanaṃ mālājapanaṃ tvanvahaṃ caret ।।47।।
mārkāṇḍeyakṛtaṃ stotraṃ paṭhennityaṃ śubhāvaham ।
rātrau tu pūjanaṃ nityaṃ kuryātprajāgaraṃ tathā ।।48 ।।
kumārīpūjanaṃ kuryāt praśastaṃ bhojanādibhiḥ ।
durgāmūrtiṃ sahasrāḍhyāṃ kuryāt sudhanavān janaḥ ।। 49।।।
antime divase sāyaṃ jale tāṃ tu visarjayet ।
itthaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lakṣmi sarvasiddhyālayo bhavet ।।1.266.50 ।।
bhuktimuktipradā durgā bhavatyasya na saṃśayaḥ ।
vittaśāṭhyaṃ balaśāṭhyaṃ vratinā kāryameva na ।।5 1 ।।
ūrje site pratipadi viṣṇuprītivivardhanam ।
annakūṭotsavākhyaṃ vai vrataṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥ ।।52 ।।
ekottaraśatānyatra miṣṭānnāni nivedayet ।
sarvāṇyapi ca śākāni śrāṇā bhājāśca patrikāḥ ।।5 3 ।।
vaṭikāḥ kandamūlāni daugdhāni śārkarāṇi ca ।
bhakṣyabhojyapralehyānucoṣyāṇi vividhāni vai ।।54।।
arpayed brahmaṇe govardhanaṃ ca pūjayettathā ।
nīrājayet tato bhojyaṃ prasādaṃ prāpnuyād vratī ।।55।।
annakūṭotsavakartā bhuktimuktī samāpnuyāt ।
dhanadhānyarasavastrabhūṣāyānādisampadaḥ । ।56 ।।
asminneva dine prātaḥ pūjayed gāśca vatsakān ।
vṛṣān vatsatarīścāpi haridrākuṃkumādibhiḥ ।।5 7।।
pauṣpairhāraiḥ śṛṃgaraṃgairnūtanairyavasādibhiḥ ।
sampūjya khelayet tāँśca kṛṣṇamandiracatvare ।।5 8।।
mārge site pratipadi śreṣṭhaṃ dhanavrataṃ matam ।
kuryādvai dhanalābhāya naktaṃ viṣṇoḥ samarcanam ।।59।।
lakṣmīyuktasya sauvarṇīṃ mūrtiṃ vai kārayed vratī ।
pūjayitvā tu tāṃ mūrtiṃ sannidhau vahnimaṇḍale ।।1.266.60।।
aṣṭottaraśataṃ homaṃ lakṣmīnāmnā samācaret ।
raktavastrayugacchannāṃ viṣṇuyuktāṃ samarcayet ।।6 1।।
dadyācca gurave mūrtiṃ dānānyanyāni dāpayet ।
evaṃ kṛtvā dhanairdhānyairlakṣmīpūrṇaḥ prajāyate ।।62।।
smṛddho bhūtvā dhūtapāpo viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।
ekabhuktaṃ ca naktaṃ vā phalāhāraṃ cared vratī ।।63।।
pauṣaśuklapratipadi bhānuvratamanuttamam ।
bhānuṃ ṣoḍaśavastvādyaiḥ pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥ ।।64।।
dvādaśātmā'bhavatsūryo hyasminneva dine purā ।
dvādaśātmānamādityaṃ sauvarṇaṃ gurave'rpayet ।।65।।
vratī sūryasamo bhūtvā svargaloke mahīyate ।
sūryanetro bhavatyatra paratra vratakṛnnaraḥ ।।66।।
māghaśuklapratipadi vahnirjāto maheśvarāt ।
vahnimabhyarcya vidhito vahnilokamavāpnuyāt ।।67।।
vahnimūrteḥ pradānaṃ ca homaṃ tilādibhistathā ।
pūjanaṃ vandanaṃ sarvaṃ prakuryād vratavān janaḥ ।।68।।
phālgunaśuklapratipad dhūlidhūsarakaṃ vratam ।
śaṃkareṇa prage tatra satīdehasamudbhavam ।।69।।
bhasma samantato liptaṃ dhūlidhūsarakaṃ vratam ।
atastatra mahādevaṃ devadevaṃ digambaram ।।1.266.70 ।।
dhūlidhūsarasarvāṃgaṃ jalaiḥ saṃprokṣitaṃ vyadhāt ।
tena tuṣṭo haraścāsmai svasāyujyaṃ prayacchati ।।7 1 ।।
sva dehaṃ ca tathā kuryād digambaraṃ sakardamam ।
karmaṇā'nena santuṣṭo dadyācchaṃbhuḥ sukhālayam ।।72।।
phālgune phalgunīnakṣatrayoge tu naro hariḥ ।
naranārāyaṇā''khyo'bhūnmūrtyāṃ vai dharmadevataḥ ।।73 ।।
dharmāśrame nibaddhāyāṃ dolāyāṃ tau samarcya ca ।
devā āndolayāmāsurataḥ kāryo'tra cotsavaḥ ।।74।।
prātaḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta naranārāyaṇaprabhoḥ ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhistulasīvastracandanaiḥ ।।75।।
naivedye pāyasaṃ dadyād badarāṇi phalāni ca ।
raṃgotsavaṃ tathā kṛtvā vratī bhuṃjīta pāraṇām ।।76 ।।
vaiśākhaśuklapratipad viṣṇujanmavrataṃ param ।
tatra viṣṇuṃ samabhyarcya vairājasya sutaṃ śubham ।।77।।
viprān sādhūn bhojayecca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryād bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।।78 ।।
śucau śuklapratipadi brahmā jajñe jagadguruḥ ।
tasyā'tra pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ deyaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇavat ।।79 ।।
ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavet ।
satyalokapradaṃ tvante bhuktimuktipradaṃ bhavet ।।1.266.8 0 ।।
evaṃ pratipaddivase vārṣikāṇi vratāni te ।
uktānyatra brahmacaryaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ phalapradam । ।8 1 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapratipadvrateṣu jagatsarjanasarasvatījanmakūrmajanma-karavīrāgamanalakṣmīvratamaunavratā'śokavratanavarātrā'nnakūṭadhanavratadvādaśabhānuvratavahnyutpattisatībhasmadhūlīvratanaranārāyaṇajanmaviṣṇujanmabrahmajanmavratānāṃ
kathananāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 266 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 266 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 267
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 268 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dvitīyāyā vārṣikāṇi vratāni vai ।
bhogamokṣobhau prāpnuvantīha mānavāḥ । । 1 । ।
caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ brahmā vivāhito'bhavat ।
sāvitryā saha lagnasyotsavaṃ kuryād vrataṃ tathā ।। 2 ।।
mahāntaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryajau tu kānakau ।
pūjayitvā sotsavau ca haviṣyānnaṃ prabhojayet ।। 3 ।।
vratī syādekabhuktaśca sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet ।
kanyādānaṃ ca godānaṃ dadyāt sadvaibhave sati ।। 4 ।।
phalaṃ labdhvā'khilānkāmānante brahmapadaṃ vrajet ।
asminneva dine lakṣmi! candro jātastu vāridheḥ ।। 5 ।।
candravrataṃ hyataḥ kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।
samabhyarcya niśārambhe bālendumuditaṃ mudā ।। 6 ।।
rūpyacandraṃ pradadyādvai dāne vipraṃ ca bhojayet ।
kumudaiḥ pūjanīyaśca vipraścandrapratikṛtiḥ ।। 7 ।।
arthanīyastathā candro dvitīyā jananīva me ।
cullikāṃ bhrāṣṭrasaṃyuktāṃ vṛṣabhau dvau gavāṃ kulam ।। 8 ।।
dhanadhānyayutaṃ gehaṃ samārogyaṃ janeṣu me ।
samādiśatu me nityaṃ dvitīyeśa namo'stu te ।। 9 ।।
bhavauṣadhyannadātā me tejovṛddhiṃ pradehi me ।
bālapuṣṭikaro me'tra sarvadā sukhado bhava ।। 1.267.10 ।।
asminneva dine tvaśvarūpātsūryāttu bālakau ।
saṃjñānāmnyā svapatnyāṃ tvaśvinyāṃ dasrau babhūvatuḥ ।। 11 ।।
aśvinībālakau vaidyau pūjanīyau vrataṃ hi tat ।
kartavyaṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca dāne tvauṣadhamiṣyate ।। 12 ।।
suvarṇarajate netre pra dadyācca dvijātaye ।
aśvinyā vājinaścāpi dānaṃ deyaṃ tu śaktitaḥ ।। 13 ।।
aśvā'śvinīvrataṃ kāryaṃ puṃsā nāryā ca bhaktitaḥ ।
aśvebhyaścaṇakā deyā vratī tvadyād ghṛtaṃ dadhi । 14 ।।
vratametad dvādaśābdaṃ netrāśvadānapūrvakam ।
kṛtvā syād bhūpatiśreṣṭhaścātirūpo nṛpāgraṇīḥ ।। 15 ।।
rādhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ samārebhe tapo hyajaḥ ।
tapovratamidaṃ kuryāt kṛtvā kamalamuttamam । । 16 ।।
brahmāṇaṃ tāpasaṃ tatra vinyasya pūjayed vratī ।
saptadhānyānvitaṃ bhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayecca vā । । 17 ।।
tatra kuṃbhopari viśvasṛjaṃ vinyasya pūjayet ।
kamaṇḍaluṃ tathā dhautraṃ valkalaṃ cāsanaṃ tathā ।। 18 ।।
phalāni bhojanaṃ dadyātpāduke brahmasūtrakam ।
godānaṃ tvanyadānāni dadyād viprāya sādhave । । 19 ।।
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān ।
jyeṣṭhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhāskaro dyumaṇirmahān ।। 1.267.20 ।।
samudbhūto harernetrāt dyotayan bhuvanatrayam ।
caturvaktrasvarūpaṃ ta gāyatrīsahitaṃ harim । । 21 ।
sarathāśvā'ruṇaṃ sūryaṃ samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ ।
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā bhojayitvā'rbhakān sataḥ । । 22 । ।
svarṇasūryapradānaṃ ca hiraṇyārpaṇamityapi ।
kṛtvā vratī susamṛddhaṃ bhāskaraṃ lokamāpnuyāt । । 23 ।।
aṣāḍhaśukladvitīyā proktaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ vratam ।
rāmarūpeṇa jāto'tra śeṣanārāyaṇaḥ svayam । । 24 । ।
bhadrakayā samaṃ rāmaṃ devā vai prathame yuge ।
rathaṃ tvārohayitvā ca parikramya purādikam ।। 25 ।।
jalāśayāntikaṃ gatvā pupūjustamanantakam ।
tato vai mānavaiḥ sarvaiḥ kāraṇīyo mahotsavaḥ । । 26 । ।
tadante devabhavane sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi ।
ārārtrikaṃ namaḥ kuryād brāhmaṇān bhojayed bahūn । । 27। ।
sataśca bhojayetsādhvīrbālān dāne halādikam ।
rathadānaṃ tathā kṣetragrāmadānādikaṃ caret ।। 28 ।।
śrāvaṇaśukladvitīyā viśvakarmavrataṃ śubham ।
viśvakarmā svapityatra hyaśokaśayanaṃ vratam ।। 29 ।।
mūrtiṃ caturmukhīṃ patnīyutāṃ śayyāsthitāṃ śubhām ।
kṛtvā viśvakarmaṇaśca prapūjya jagatāṃ patim । । 1.267.30 । ।
prārthayed viśvakarmāṇaṃ bhagavantaṃ jagatkaram ।
śrīvatsadhārin śrīkānta śrīvāsa śrīpate prabho ।। 31 । ।
gārhasthyaṃ bhavanādyaṃ ca mā nāśaṃ yātu me vibho ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ viyogo mā'stu me kvacit । । 32 ।।
gṛhadānaṃ tathā patnīdānaṃ candrārdhadānakam ।
kanyādānaṃ suvarṇāderdānaṃ kuryād vrate'tra vai ।। 33 । ।
bhādraśukladvitīyāyāmindrajanmā'bhavad yataḥ ।
indraṃ hariṃ prapūjyaiva sarvakratuphalaṃ laset । । 34। ।
tatputraśca jayantyākhyaḥ śacī vimānamityapi ।
sarvaṃ vai kānakaṃ kṛtvā vajraṃ dhanuśca mārgaṇam । । 35 । ।
gajaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ।
sarvaṃ vai gurave dadyādekabhukto vratī bhavet । । 36 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vratī svargaṃ mahendrālayamityatha ।
prāpnuyāccirakālaṃ ca muktiṃ vairājalokagām ।। 37 ।।
āśvinaśukladvitīyāvrataṃ durgākṛtaṃ matam ।
dānaṃ pradattametasyāmanantaphaladaṃ bhavet ।। 38 । ।
ūrjaśukladvitīyāyāṃ yamo yamunayā purā ।
bhojitaḥ pūjito bhrātrā svagṛhe bahumiṣṭakaiḥ ।। 39 । ।
vrataṃ yamadvitīyāyāḥ kuryāt svasā gṛhe gṛhe ।
puṣṭivivardhanaṃ cedaṃ bhaginyālayabho janam ।।1.267.4 0 । ।
bhuktvā bhrātrā'mbarabhūṣāḥ svasre deyā dhanādayaḥ ।
tena svayaṃ bhavetsvarṇadhanadhānyaprapūritaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
asyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājaḥ prabhojitaḥ ।
tasyāṃ svasurhastatalāt sauhṛdena bhunakti yaḥ ।। 42 ।।
sa bhrātā svarṇaratnādidhanadhānyādimān bhavet ।
dānaṃ svasre bhṛśaṃ deyaṃ svasrīyāyā'pi mudrikāḥ ।। 43 । ।
mārgaśukladvitīyāyāṃ pitarastvaryamādayaḥ ।
samutpannā brahmadehāt pitṛśrāddhavrataṃ hi tat । । 44।।
prātaḥ prapūjanaṃ sūryanārāyaṇasya kārayet ।
madhyāhnottarakāle tu śrāddhaṃ kuryācca tarpaṇam । । 45 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ caiva kārayet piṇḍamarpayet ।
vratakartā bhavennaktabhojī dāne tu dhānyakam ।। 46 ।।
bhojanaṃ bhūsurāyāpi dadyād vastrādikaṃ tathā ।
godānaṃ ca yathāśakti kartavyaṃ vratinā tadā ।। 47 । ।
vṛddhānsarvānpūrvajān saṃsmṛtya dvijāya vai namaḥ ।
kuryādārogyamāpnuyāllabhate putrapautrakān ।। 48 ।।
pauṣaśukladvitīyāyāmutpannāḥ kāmadhenavaḥ ।
kāmadhenuvrataṃ kāryaṃ haviṣyāśī bhaved vratī ।।49।।
sarvakāmapradaṃ kuryād gośṛṃgodakamārjanam ।
gośṛṃgodakamṛdbhyāṃ ca saṃsnāyāt pūjayecca gām ।।1.267.50 ।।
dadyāddānaṃ gavādīnāṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye ।
tṛṇādikaṃ pradadyācca gavāṃ grāsādilabdhaye ।।5 1 ।।
bālendudarśanaṃ sāyaṃ prakuryāccārghyasarjanam ।
bhavedevaṃ vratakartā godhano'tighano'pi ca ।।52 ।।
māghaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhāskaro viśvakarmaṇā ।
śāṇopari samanyastaḥ surūpaḥ kṛta eva vai ।।53 ।।
bhānurūpaṃ hariṃ tvatra pūjayedraktapuṣpakaiḥ ।
raktairgandhaistathā svarṇamūrtiṃ nirmāya śaktitaḥ ।।54।।
tataḥ pūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ godhūmaiścāpi taṇḍulaiḥ ।
sūryāya cārpayed bhaktyā jalenā'rghyaṃ samarpayet ।।55।।
mūrtiṃ dadyād sādhave ca dānaṃ viprāya śaktitaḥ ।
evaṃ kṛte vrate lakṣmi! sākṣāt sūrya iva vratī ।।।56।।
durāsado durādharṣo jāyate bhuvi bhūsuraḥ ।
yadvā rājā prajāyeta cakravartī mahānnṛpaḥ ।।57।।
iha kāmānvarān bhuktvā yātyante ca raveḥ padam ।
sarvadevastutastvante yāti vā brahmaṇaḥ padam ।।।8।।
atha phālgunaśuklāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ svayaṃ haraḥ ।
tapase prasthito haime śaile nārāyaṇāśrame ।।59।।
tato harasya sauvarṇīṃ kāryā mūrtirjaṭānvitā ।
puṣpaiḥ śivaḥ samabhyarcyaḥ suśvetaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ।।1.267.60 ।।
puṣpairvitānakaḥ kāryaḥ puṣpālaṃkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
naivedyairvividhairdhūpairdīpairnīrājanādibhiḥ ।।61 ।।
toṣaṇīyo mahādevo vratinā sukhalabdhaye ।
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ vratī vyādhivivarjitaḥ ।।62।।
dhanadhānyasmṛddhiyukto jīvedvarṣaśataṃ dhruvam ।
vrateṣveteṣu homādi kāryaṃ yathādhanādikam ।।63।।
vahnireva pṛthaṅmāssu nānārūpo harervapuḥ ।
pūjanīyo homakṛtā brahmacaryādi rakṣatā ।।64।।
yadvidhānaṃ dvitīyāsu śuklapakṣagatāsu vai ।
proktaṃ tadeva kṛṣṇāsu kartavyaṃ vidhikovidaiḥ ।।65।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadvitīyāvrateṣu brahmasāvitrīlagnacandrotpattyaśvinīkumārotpattibrahmatapaḥsūryotpattisaṃkarṣaṇarāmotpattiviśvakarmā'śoka-
śayanendrajanmadurgāvratayamayamunābhojanā'ryamapitrutpattikāmadhenūtpattisūryaśāṇollīḍhatāśaṃbhutapaiti-vratānāṃ nirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 267।।


← adhyāyaḥ 267 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 268
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 269 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca -
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! tṛtīyāyā vratāni vai ।
yāni kṛtvā naro nārī bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt ।। 1 ।।
caitraśuklatṛtīyāto gauryā tapaḥ sudāruṇam ।
kṛtaṃ śaṃkaraprāptyarthaṃ gaurīvrataṃ hi tanmatam ।। 2 ।।
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā saśaṃkarām ।
sauvarṇāṃ rājatīṃ vāpi tāmrīṃ vā mṛṇmayīṃ ca vā ।। 3 ।।
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairvastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
durvākāṇḍaiśca vidhivatsopavāsā tu kanyakā ।। 4 ।।
varārthinī sutāputrārthinī bhartrarthinī tathā ।
nīrājayenmahāgaurīṃ śāṃkarīṃ śaṃkarānvitām ।। 5 ।।
punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyaiva prārthayenmanasi sthitam ।
sapta navaikādaśa cādhikā vā dvijayoṣitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
bhartṛmatīśca vā kanyā gaurīrūpā sulakṣaṇāḥ ।
samāhūya bahumānapūrvakaṃ tu ca tāstataḥ ।। 7 ।।
sindūrāṃ'janavastrādyairbhūṣābhiḥ prītamānasā ।
vratakartrī pūkayettā tathā dānaiśca toṣayet ।। 8 ।।
miṣṭānnāni piṇḍakādīn phalānyapi samarpayet ।
evaṃ santoṣayitvā tāḥ vratinī phalamāpnuyāt ।। 9 ।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād vratasampūrtikāmyayā ।
prātastāṃ ca punaḥ saṃpūjyā'rpayed gurave mudā ।। 1.268.10 ।।
yadvā visarjayenmūrtiṃ tīrthe vāryāśaye kṣipet ।
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi kṛtvā gaurīvrataṃ śubham ।। 11 ।।
kanyā tu labhate śaṃbhusadṛśaṃ guṇinaṃ patim ।
dhenūrdvādaśa saṃkalpya dadyādvratasya siddhaye ।। 12 ।।
kimatra bahunoktena gaurī saubhāgyadāyinī ।
strīṇāṃ yathā tathā nānyā vidyate bhuvanatraye ।। 13 ।।
dhanaṃ putrānpatiṃ putrīṃ vidyāṃ siddhiṃ yaśaḥ sukham ।
dadāti sarvameveṣṭaṃ gaurī vratena toṣitā ।। 14।।
pārvatyā prabhayā lakṣmyā māṇikyā ramayā kṛtam ।
vrataṃ labdhaḥ patirīśaḥ kṛṣṇo dhvajadhanuḥkaraḥ ।। 15।।
mīnatriśūlacakrasvastikacihnakaro hariḥ ।
tasmādidaṃ vrataṃ rūpasaubhāgyabhogamuktidam ।। 16 ।।
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyā tvakṣayatṛtīyāvratam ।
tithistretāyugādyā sā kṛtasyā'kṣayakāriṇī ।। 17।।
atra tretāyugaṃ svarṇamūrtirūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।
yadvā lakṣmīyutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarcayet ।। 18।।
puṣpadhūpavilepādyairgaṃgāvārbhistathā'kṣataiḥ ।
vividhairbhojanaiścaiva toṣayecchrījagadgurum ।। 19।।
saktūn saṃbhojayed viprān vratītvekādano bhavet ।
evaṃ kṛtavidhestasya vratito'nāśanaṃ phalam ।।1.268.20 ।।
kāryā''rambhopi saphalo nirvighno yāti pūrṇatām ।
naro nārī vrataṃ cāsmin kṛtakāryatvamāpnuyāt ।।21 ।।
vaiśākhasya site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ punarvasau ।
jamadagnigṛhe prādurāsītparaśudhṛk hariḥ ।।22।।
asmin rāmaṃ saparaśu sauvarṇaṃ kārayed vratī ।
madhyāhne tu mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā kurvīta bhojanam ।।23।।
ita ārabhya nityaṃ ca jyeṣṭhapūrṇā'vadhiṃ prabhum ।
dhārayed gandhavāsāṃsi vāsāṃsi ca sitānyapi ।।24।।
uśīratālavṛntaiśca vejayetpratyahaṃ prabhum ।
naivedye śarkarāyuktaṃ dadyādāmrarasādikam ।।25।।
jyeṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ raṃbhā svargād bhuvaṃ gatā ।
rabhāphalaṃ vrate bhakṣyaṃ raṃbhā pṛjyā'kṣatairjalaiḥ ।।26।।
gandhapuṣpāṃśukādyaiśca sabhāryaṃ pūjayed dvijam ।
raṃbhāvrataṃ karotyatra nārī saubhāgyakāmyayā ।।27।।
vittaṃ labhate putrāँśca matiṃ lakṣmīṃ dhanādikam ।
patiṃ gāṃ pṛthivīṃ saudhaṃ tathopakaraṇāni ca ।।28।।।
labhate kadalīsāmyaṃ saukumāryaṃ vratārthinī ।
dāne raṃbhāphalānyatra śarkarāghṛtamityapi ।।।29।।
athā'ṣāḍhatṛtīyāyāṃ samārebhe tapo ramā ।
keśavārthamato lakṣmīvrataṃ kāryaṃ tu yoṣitā ।।1.268.3 0।।
keśavaṃ tu salakṣmīkaṃ suvarṇapratimātmakam ।
ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ pūjayettu vidhānataḥ ।।3 1।।
bhojanaiḥ surabhīdānairvastraiścāpi vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
ārārtrikanamaskārairdakṣiṇābhiśca pūjayet ।।3 2।।
sastrīkaṃ ca dvijaṃ tatra pūjayed bhojayettathā ।
vipravākyairmānayecca toṣayeddharṣayettathā ।। 33 ।।
evaṃ vrate prasādyaināṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ tu bhūsurīm ।
vipraṃ viṣṇusvarūpaṃ ca visarjayecca tau gṛham ।। 34।।
vratakartrī gṛhayuktā nārī saubhāgyavāñcchayā ।
devadevaprasādena dhanadhānyasamanvitā ।। 35 ।।
putrapautrayutā bhūtvā viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt ।
kanyā vindetsurūpaṃ supatiṃ sveṣṭasubhogadam ।। 36 ।।
śrāvaṇaśuklatṛtīyā svarṇagaurīvrataṃ matam ।
kālī tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtvā svarṇagauryabhavad yataḥ ।। 37।।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhavānī pūjayet vratī ।
prārthayedtpūjanānte ca rūpaṃ gauraṃ pradehi me ।। 38 ।।
putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ dehi suvrate ।
anyāँśca vividhānkāmānpūrayā'tra namo'stu te ।। 39 ।।
tato bhavayutāṃ devīṃ vāyanaṃ tu dadecchubham ।
ṣoḍaṣavarṣaparyantaṃ vratametatprakīrtitam ।। 1.268.40 ।।
tadante subhagā nārī kuryādudyāpanaṃ mahat ।
kadalīmaṇḍape sarvabhadrākhyamaṇḍale satīm ।।4 1 ।।
madhye saṃsthāpayetsvarṇaghaṭe ratnādisaṃyute ।
paritaḥ śrīgaṇeśādipaṃcāyatanamarcayet ।।42।।।
kalaśopari tāmrasyā'kṣatayukte supātrake ।
sauvarṇī pratimāṃ śaṃbhubhavānyāḥ pratipūjayet ।।43 ।।
ṣoḍaśabhirvastubhiśca tato homaṃ samācaret ।
veṇupātraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pakvānnaparipūritaiḥ ।।44।।
samarpya satyai naivedyaṃ sādhuṣvetannivedayet ।
vāyanaṃ ca tato dadyāduttamaṃ bāndhavādiṣu ।।45।।
pratimāṃ gurave dadyād dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ।
bahudānāni kurvīta vratasāphalyahetave ।।46 ।।
pūrṇaṃ vindet phalaṃ nārī kanyā vā sadhavā'dhavā ।
dhanadhānyādisusmṛddhā bhūtvā yāti paraṃ padam ।।47।।
bhādraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ vai haratālikam ।
harahastena pārvatyā hastasya melanaṃ hyabhūt ।। 48 ।।
tadidaṃ haratālyākhyaṃ vrataṃ saubhāgyavardhanam ।
kuryād bhaktyā vidhānena pādyārghyārcanapūrvakam ।।49 ।।
atra vai kāṃcane pātre rājate vā'tha tāmrake ।
vaiṇave mṛnmaye vā'tha vinyasyā'nnaṃ sadakṣiṇam ।।1.268.5 0 ।।
bharjitaṃ tilataṇḍulacaṇakādikamityapi ।
phalaṃ vastrādikaṃ bhūṣāṃ vinyasyātraiva pātrake ।।5 1 ।।
dadyāttu gurave tadvai kuryātpaścāttu pāraṇām ।
bhojayed brāhmaṇānsādhūnsādhvīḥ kanyāśca bālakān ।।52 । ।
saubhāgyadravya pātrāṇi vaṃśapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।
pradadyācchraddhayā tvevaṃ viprebhyo vidhinā tathā ।।5 3 । ।
anyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca bhūyasīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām ।
dadyād vratavatī nārī tena saubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।।54।।
evaṃ kṛtavratā nārī bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān ।
vrataprabhāvato'mutra gaurosahacarī bhavet ।।।55।।।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutāṃ putrān labhate'tra paratra śam ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ devīprasādāpyaṃ vrataṃ matam । । 56 ।।
yadā tṛtīyā bhādre'tra bhaveddhastarkṣasaṃyutā ।
sāmagaistvatra kartavyaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam ।।57।।
navaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca dhāryaṃ śākhoktakarmaṇā ।
hastagaurīvrataṃ nāma kartavyaṃ bhūtihetave ।।58 ।।
viṣaprāṇipradaṃśādinivārakamidaṃ bhavet ।
mahiṣāsuranāśārthaṃ koṭirūpadharā yadā ।।59 ।।
babhūva sā tadā durgā koṭīśvarīti nāmataḥ ।
pinākinā svayaṃ proktā koṭīśvarīvrataṃ tu tat ।। 1.268.60 ।।
lakṣacaṇḍīsvarūpāṇi yadā dhṛtavatī hi sā ।
lakṣeśvarī tadā proktā svayaṃ pinākinā satī ।।6 1 ।।
lakṣeśvarīvrataṃ kāryaṃ yāvadvarṣacatuṣṭayam ।
sopavāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣeśvaryāḥ prapūjanam ।।62 । ।
akhaṇḍānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ tilānāṃ vāpi padmaje ।
lakṣamekaṃ viśodhyā'tra kṣiped dugdhe'gnasaṃśrute ।।63 ।।
yāvadvai kaṭhino dravyasāro bhavetsupiṇḍakaḥ ।
tena piṇḍena nirmāya devyā mūrtiṃ surūpiṇīm ।।64।।
gandhapuṣpākṣataratnaromavastravibhūṣitām ।
pārvatīṃ tatra cā''vāhya pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥ ।। 65 ।।
gandhaiḥ puṣpairjalairdhūpairdīpairnaivedyaprārthanaiḥ ।
vividhaiḥ satphalaiḥ śreṣṭhadakṣiṇābhiśca vandanaiḥ ।। 66।।
ārārtrikairdaṇḍavadbhirvardhayecca kṣamāpayet ।
arthayeddhanadhānyādisutāputragṛhādikam ।।67 । ।
tato visarjayed durgāṃ jalamadhye'tha dakṣiṇām ।
datvā śrīgurave paścād rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret ।। 68 ।।
datvā dānāni viprebhyo bhuñjītāyaṃ pare dine ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! koṭilakṣeśvarīvratam । ।6 9।।
vratakartryā gṛhe lakṣmīrdhanadhānyamayī sadā ।
rājate vardhate nityaṃ vratasyā'sya prabhāvataḥ ।।1.268.7 0 ।।
gaurīlokaṃ prayātyante bhogamokṣau hi vindati ।
iṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ bṛhadagaurīvrataṃ matam ।।7 1 ।।
pañcavarṣaṃ prakartavyaṃ koṭikundanamāpnuyāt ।
durgāṃ tu pūjayetprātaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ suvastubhiḥ ।।72।।
suvāsinyaḥ paṃca pūjyā vastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ ।
śāṭīkaṃcukatāṭaṃkakaṇṭhasūtravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।।7 3 ।।
dhātupātrāṇi paṃcaiva vāṭikāsthālikāstathā ।
sindūraṃ jīrakaṃ miṣṭaṃ saubhāgyadravyamaṃjanam ।।74।।
godhūmapiṣṭajātaṃ ca navā'pūpaṃ phalādikam ।
vastrāṇi vividhānyeva vāyanāni ca pañca vai ।।75 ।।
tābhyo dadyād bhojayecca paścād bhuñjīta vāgyatā ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇakīrtanamiśritam ।।76 ।।
phalaṃ tu dhārayetkaṇṭhe pūgīṃ vānyad yadarpitam ।
rātrau kaṇṭhagataṃ sarvakāmasmṛddhipradaṃ phalam ।।77।।
tata prātaḥ samutsāhā sālaṃkārā sakhījanaiḥ ।
gītavādyayutā gacchet saritaṃ snānamācaret ।।78 ।।
gaurīṃ sambodhayettatra prārthanāṃ saṃvadedimām ।
āhūtā'si mayā bhadre pūjitā ca yathāvidhi ।।79 ।।
mama saubhāgyade devi sarvaṃ rakṣaya nityadā ।
nyūnaṃ ca kṣamyatāṃ devi yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ tvayā ।।1.268.8 0 ।।
ityabhyarthya namaskṛtya jayaśabdaiśca vādanaiḥ ।
sotsāhapūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭvā jale gaurīṃ visarjayet ।।8 1 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhaktyā vratī devīprasādataḥ ।
bhuktvā bhogāँstu dehānte gaurīlokamavāpnuyāt ।।82 ।।
ūrjaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ viṣṇugaurīvrataṃ matam ।
gauryā prapūjito viṣṇustapasaḥ phalasiddhaye । ।8 3 ।।
tasmād vratamidaṃ proktaṃ viṣṇugauryabhidhaṃ śubham ।
tatra vai pūjanīyā'sau gaurī viṣṇuyutā mudā ।।84।।
ṣoḍaśabhistūcārairbhojanaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ ।
suvāsinīrūpāṃ gaurīṃ lakṣmīnāmnā prabhojayet ।।85 ।।
pūjayenmaṃgaladravyaiviṣṇugaurīpratuṣṭaye ।
visarjayetpraṇamyaināṃ dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ।।86।।
putraṃ vai labhate nārī vratakartrī na saṃśayaḥ ।
mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ haragaurīvrataṃ matam ।।87।।
haraśayyāgatā gaurī harayogamupāgatā ।
harayogena sā tṛptā'bhavat svāmisukhānvitā ।।88 ।।
haraṃ gaurīṃ vrate tvatra caikaśayyāṃ prakalpya ca ।
svāpayetpūjayed bhaktyā sevayed divyabhāvataḥ ।।8 9।।
etadvrataprabhāveṇa bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān ।
gaurīlokaṃ samāsādya hareṇa saha modate ।।1.268.90 ।।
pauṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ brahmagaurīvrataṃ matam ।
brahmaṇā tu samāgatyā''śīrvādāḥ śaṃkarāptaye ।।91 ।।
pradattā tad vrataṃ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ suvidhānataḥ ।
gaurīṃ ca vedhasaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇasya prapūjayet ।।92।।।
ṣoḍaśabhiścopacārairekabhuktaṃ samācaret ।
dānaṃ dadyād yatheṣṭaṃ tu gurave bhojayed dvijān ।।93।।
brahmagaurīprasādena modate tatra saṃgatā ।
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ lakṣmīḥ saubhāgyasundarī ।।94।।
viṣṇau varamālikāyā arpaṇāt samabhūt priyā ।
tasmāt saubhāgyasundaryātmakaṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ mudā ।।95।।
lakṣmīstatra pūjanīyā nālikerārghyadānataḥ ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmiṣṭānnairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ।।96।।
saubhāgyadā prasannā syāt svīyaṃ dhāma nayatyapi ।
dānaṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ sarvaṃ deyaṃ vastu tu yoṣite ।।97।।
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ hāraścārpyastu viṣṇave ।
prasādamālā sā cā'rpyā patikaṇṭhe tu putradā ।।98।।
phālgunasya site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ niśottare ।
harayogātsatī labdhavatī putrāँstu rudrakān ।।99।।
tasmātsoktā tṛtīyā tu kulasaukhyavratātmikā ।
pūjitā gandhapuṣpādyairgaurī kulakarī bhavet ।। 1.268.100 ।।
evaṃ sarvavrateṣvatra dānaṃ homo visarjanam ।
devadevīprapūjā ca vipraguruprapūjanam ।। 10 1।।
ekabhuktādikaṃ sarvasāmānyaṃ prasamācaret ।
bhaktyā kṛtāni sarvānvai kāmān dadyurmanogatān ।। 10 2।।
sarvadeveṣu tatsarvāntarātmā śrīhariḥ svayam ।
vartate pūjanīyo'sau sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ ।। 103 ।।
yadyad vratyarthayed vastu naro nārī tathā'nyakaḥ ।
samāpnoti ca tatsarvaṃ śrīhareḥ samanugrahāt ।। 1 .4।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikatṛtīyāvrateṣu gaurītapovratā'kṣayatṛtīyātretādya-tithiparśurāmajayantīkadalīvratalakṣmītapovratakālī-gaurīvrataharagaurīlagnavratasāmagaśrāvaṇīkoṭīśvarī-māhiṣaghnalakṣeśvarībṛhadgaurīviṣṇugaurīhara-
gaurīyogabrahmāśīrgaurīviṣṇuvaramālā-kulavṛddhivratādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭa-ṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।268।।


← adhyāyaḥ 268 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 269
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 270 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
lakṣmi! śṛṇu kathayāmi caturthīnāṃ vratāni te ।
yāni kṛtvā naro nārī bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajet parām ।। 1 ।।
golokādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārvatyāḥ śaṃkaragṛhe ।
śarīrāktadhātuyogādutpanno yastvabhūt prabhuḥ ।। 2 ।।
sa vai kṛṣṇaścaturdhā'sti vāsudevasvarūpakaḥ ।
saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpaśca pradyumnarūpakastathā ।। 3 ।।
aniruddhasvarūpaśca tasmāt sa gaṇanāyakaḥ ।
caturmūrtisvarūpo'sti vratānyapi tathā tathā ।। 4 ।।
caitramāsacaturthyāṃ tu vāsudevasvarūpiṇam ।
gaṇeśaṃ samyagabhyarcya datvā suvarṇadakṣiṇām ।। 5 ।।
āvāhanādi cārabhya visarjanāntameva yat ।
kṛtvā vidhānataḥ sarvaṃ viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt ।। 6 ।।
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ bhojye deyāstu laḍḍukāḥ ।
dūrvāsindūrakau deyau pūjane vratinā tathā ।। 7 ।।
anyānyapi ca dānāni deyāni kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ।
svayaṃ tu pāraṇāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ kuryād vratī śubhām ।। 8 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ loke bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt ।
prasādya viṣṇuṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ gacched devābhivanditaḥ ।। 9 ।।
vaiśākhasya caturthyāṃ tu pūjyaḥ saṃkarṣaṇābhidhaḥ ।
āvāhanādvisarjanaparyantaṃ vividhaṃ vidhim ।। 1.269.1 0।।
kṛtvā saṃpūjayed devaṃ gaṇeśaṃ bhojayed bahu ।
śaṃkhadānaṃ tathā cānyaddānaṃ kuryād yathābalam ।। 11 ।।
tena puṇyena vratakṛd bhūtvā divyavapurdharaḥ ।
prāpya saṃkarṣaṇaṃ lokaṃ modate bahukalpakam ।। 1 2।।
jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu pūjyaḥ pradyumna īśvaraḥ ।
ṣoḍaśabhirupacāraiḥ pūjayitvā gaṇādhipam ।। 1 3।।।
phalaṃ mūlaṃ jalaṃ dūrvāṃ datvā vai bhāvato vratī ।
tena puṇyena saṃyāti prādyumnaṃ svargameva vai ।। 14।।
āṣāḍhasya caturthyāṃ tu pūjanīyo'niruddhakaḥ ।
āvāhanātsamārabhya visarjanāntamarcanam ।। 15।।
kuryād vividhapuṣpādyaiḥ phalairbhojyādibhistathā ।
dadyād dānāni bahūni kuryānnīrājanādikam ।। 16।।
kṣamāṃ ca prārthayed dāne'lābupātrāṇi tumbikā ।
kāṣṭhapātrāṇyapi dadyāt sādhave nyāsine vratī ।। 17।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vratī yāyādaniruddhālayaṃ param ।
caturmūrtivratānyevaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśa vatsarān ।। 18।।
mahadudyāpanaṃ kuryānmaṇḍape maṇḍale śubhe ।
suvarṇasya ghaṭaṃ nyasya paṃcaratnādisaṃyutam ।। 19।।
pañcāyatanaṃ gāṇeśaṃ vinyasya vidhinā tataḥ ।
pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastūttamaiḥ kuryād vratī janaḥ ।।1.269.20 ।।
gītavāditranirghoṣairvedamantraiḥ stavaistathā ।
homairjapaistathā bhojyairvastudānādibhistathā ।।21 ।।
mahotsavaṃ śubhaṃ kuryādgaṇeśakṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ।
evaṃ vodyāpane jāte pūrṇaṃ vrataphalaṃ bhavet ।। 22।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo dadātyatra paratra ca ।
yadyadicchati vratakṛt svargaṃ sarvamavāpnuyāt ।।23।।
anyajjyeṣṭhacaturthyāṃ tu satīvratamudāhṛtam ।
brāhmadakṣādasiknyāṃ vai satī jātā purā yataḥ ।।24।।
satījanmotsavaṃ kuryād vratī tvekānnamityapi ।
phalaṃ vā copavāsaṃ vā mahat kuryācca pūjanam ।।25।।
evaṃ satīvrataṃ kṛtvā datvā dānāni viṣṇave ।
vratī gaṇapatermāturloke modeta tatsamam ।।26।।
tathā''ṣāḍhacaturthyāṃ tu vrataṃ cānyad bhavecchubham ।
rathantarā''hvakalpasyā''dyabhūtaṃ vai dinaṃ yataḥ ।।27।।
śraddhāpūtena manasā kalpaṃ rathantarāhvayam ।
kālarūpaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vā prapūjayet ।।28।।
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryāt phalaṃ svargaṃ labhed vratī ।
śrāvaṇasya caturthyāṃ tu prage madhye niśāmukhe ।। 29।।
śrīgaṇeśaṃ pūjayedvai sarvavidhiprapūrvakam ।
candrodaye tathā jāte punastaṃ pūjayed vratī ।।1.269.30।।
arghyaṃ dadyād bhojanādi sindūrādi samarpayet ।
lambodaraṃ caturbāhuṃ trinetraṃ raktapāṇḍuram ।।3 1 ।।
naikaratnavibhūṣāḍhyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ vicintayet ।
āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiḥ samarcayet । ।32। ।
naivedye modakān dadyād gaṇeśatuṣṭidān vratī ।
evaṃ vrataṃ vidhāyaiva bhuktvā prasādamodakān ।।33।।
rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryātprātaḥ samarcayetpunaḥ ।
dānāni dadyād bahūni gaṇeśakṛṣṇatuṣṭaye । । 34।।
vratasyā'sya pratāpena kāmān labdhvā manogatān ।
pare loke paraṃ sthānaṃ gaṇeśapadamāpnuyāt ।।35।।
tasmātkāryaṃ prayatnena kāmānsarvānabhīpsatā ।
nānena sadṛśaṃ tvanyat vidyate vratamuttamam ।। 36।।
asminneva dine lakṣmi! dūrvāgaṇeśapūjanam ।
kartavyaṃ tadvidhānaṃ te vadāmi pūrṇapuṇyakṛt ।। 37।।
suvarṇasya gaṇādhyakṣaṃ vidhāya tāmrapātrake ।
sthāpayitvā ca tatpātraṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।। 38 ।।
nyasyet tadveṣṭitaṃ kuryād raktāmbareṇa vai tataḥ ।
pūjayedraktakusumaiḥ patraiḥ pañcabhireva ca ।। 39 ।।
bilbapatramapāmārgaḥ śamī dūrvā haripriyā ।
etatpatraiśca kusumaiḥ pūjayet satphalādibhiḥ ।।1.269.40 ।।
bhojayenmodakādīni śubhāṃ dadyāttu dakṣiṇām ।
arghyaṃ dadyādupahāraṃ śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tathā ।।4 1 ।।
vighneśātmakagurave satkṛtya vinivedayet ।
kṛtvaivaṃ pañcavarṣāṇi vrataṃ gaṇapateḥ śubham ।।।42 ।।
bhuktveha bhogānakhilān lokaṃ gaṇapatervrajet ।
iha loke bhavetsmṛddhaḥ pare loke mahāsukhaḥ ।। 43 ।।
śrāvaṇe śukla pakṣe tu caturthyāṃ bhaumavāsare ।
madhyāhne brahmaṇo nasto varāho jajña īśvaraḥ ।।44।।
varāharūpaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ pūjayed vratī ।
dhārayet tatra vāsāṃsi kausuṃbhāni ramāpatim ।।45 ।।
naivedye pāyasaṃ dadyādghaṭakāँśca viśeṣataḥ ।
varāhajanmapadyāni gāpayetpūjayettathā ।।46।।
ṣoḍaśā'bhisūpacāraistataḥ kuryāttu bhojanam ।
narāṃgaṃ sūkarāsyaṃ ca caturbāhuṃ ca sāyudham ।।47 ।।
dharāṃ gṛhītvā dantāgre śobhantaṃ dānamācaret ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpnuyād vratī ।।48।।
athabhādracaturthyāṃ tu bahulādhenusadvratam ।
gaṇeśo'pi samutpannaḥ pārvatīśayane sutaḥ ।।49। ।
gaṇeśasya vrataṃ cāpi prakṛṣṭotsavapūrvakam ।
kartavyaṃ vidhinā lakṣmi! dinacatuṣṭayātmakam ।।1.269.5 0 ।।
haritavallikāvṛkṣaśākhākadalītoraṇaiḥ ।
maṇḍapaḥ śobhanaḥ kāryaḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।।।5 1 ।।
kartavyaṃ ca gaṇeśo'pi mṛdā vā dhātunāpi vā ।
suvarṇena ca raupyeṇa tāmreṇa maṇinā'pi vā ।।।52।।
kartavyaścāpi sindūrakuṃkumādibhirityam ।
śobhanīyastathā pūjanīyaḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।।53 ।।
nityaṃ rātrau pūjanīyo vratinā laḍḍukādibhiḥ ।
toṣaṇīyaśca nityaṃ saḥ prārthanīyaḥ sukhāptaye ।।54।।
dānaṃ deyaṃ ca vividhaṃ naktabhojī vratī bhavet ।
ante visarjanaṃ vārṣuṃ kāryaṃ gaṇapatermudā ।।55।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vai prāpnuyād vratī ।
pūrṇe varṣe gate māturājñayā śraddhayā tathā ।।56 ।।
gaṇeśena kṛtā pradakṣiṇā goratra vai dine ।
tasmādvratamidaṃ proktaṃ bahulādhenusaṃjñakam ।।57।।
pūjanīyā'tra yatnena sraggandhayavasādibhiḥ ।
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kuryācchaktaśceddānamācaret ।।58।।
aśaktaḥ punaretāṃ tu namaskṛtya visarjayet ।
paṃcābdaṃ vā daśābdaṃ vā ṣoḍaśābdamathāpi vā ।।59।।
vrataṃ kṛtvodyāpanaṃ ca dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm ।
vrataṃ samāpayetpatnīṃ padminīmāpnuyātphalam ।।1.269.60 ।।
atra bhogānparān bhuktvā satkṛto devatāgaṇaiḥ ।
patnyā putrādinā sākaṃ golokaṃ samavāpnuyāt ।।61।।
atra śuklacaturthyāṃ vai siddhivaināyakavratam ।
kartavyaṃ śrīgaṇeśasya pūjanaṃ vratinā''darāt ।।62 ।।
āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiśca modakaiḥ ।
ekāgramanasā dhyāyed gaṇeśaṃ siddhināyakam ।।6 3 ।।
viśvakarmasutāyāśca ṛddheḥ siddheśca nāyakaḥ ।
vivāhenā'dya saṃjāto gaṇeśaḥ siddhināyakaḥ ।।64।।
tasmāttaṃ pūjayedekadantaṃ suvarṇasannibham ।
pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ devaṃ gajavaktraṃ caturbhujam ।।65 ।।
śūrpakarṇaṃ sindūrādicarcitaṃ tundilaṃ śubham ।
dhyātvā cārghyaṃ samarpyaiva punaśca pūjayed vratī ।।66 ।।
ekaviṃśatipatrāṇi tvekaviṃśatināmabhiḥ ।
samarpayet vratī tāni nāmāni ca yathā śṛṇu ।।67।।
sumukhāya śamīpatraṃ gaṇādhīśāya bhṛṃgajam ।
umāputrāya bailvaṃ tu dūrvāṃ gajamukhāya ca ।।68।।
lambodarāya badarīṃ dhattūraṃ harasūnave ।
śūrpakarṇāya tulasīṃ vakratuṇḍāya śiṃbijam ।।6 9।।
apāmārgaṃ guhabhrātre bārhataṃ tvekadantine ।
herambāya tu sindūraṃ caturhotre tu patrajam ।।1.269.70।।
sarveśvarāya śāntāyā'gastyapatraṃ pradāpayet ।
gandhapuṣpākṣatadūrvāpatrayugmaṃ samarpayet ।।71 ।।
modakapañcakaṃ dadyājjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ samarpayet ।
datvā tāmbūlakaṃ natvā samprārthya ca visarjayet ।।72।।
mūrtiṃ sopaskarāṃ haimīṃ gurave brāhmaṇāya bā ।
arpayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyānmodakādīni bhojayet ।।73।।
ekaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ pañcavarṣāṇi mānavo bhuvi ।
upāsya labhate kāmānehikānpāralaukikān ।।74।।
asyāṃ caturthyāṃ candraṃ tu na paśyedvai kathaṃcana ।
paśyan mithyābhiśāpaṃ tu prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।।75 ।।
atastaddoṣanāśāya mantraṃ tu śāśvataṃ paṭhet ।
'hato hiraṇyakaśipurnṛsiṃhena niśāmukhe । ।76 ।।
śarabheṇa hataḥ siṃhaḥ śarabhaḥ śaṃkaro'bhavat ।
śaṃkareṇa dhṛtaścandro mithyāśāpaṃ haro haret' ।।77।।
ityuccārya na vai mithyākalaṃko jāyate jane ।
namaskuryācchivaṃ candraśekharaṃ bhāvasaṃyutaḥ ।।78 ।।
iṣaśuklacaturṣyāṃ tu kapardīśaṃ vināyakam ।
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena pūjayedupacārakaiḥ । ।79 ।।
tāṇḍulān baṭave dadyād gandhapuṣpārcitāya ca ।
kapardigaṇanātho'sau prīyatāṃ taṇḍulārpaṇaiḥ । । 1.269.80 ।।
bhuktimuktiprado me'stu gaṇeśaḥ kṛṣṇarūpadhṛk ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ dehī dhruvaṃ golokamāpnuyāt ।।8 1 ।।
caturthyāṃ kārtike śukle nāgavratamudāhṛtam ।
sarpadaṃśādināśārtha kartavyaṃ sarvathā janaiḥ ।।82 ।।
prātarvrataṃ tu saṃkalpya dhenuśṛṅgajalaṃ śuci ।
pītvā snātvā'tha madhyāhne śaṃkhapālādipannagān ।।8 3 ।।
śeṣaṃ tvāhvānapūrvaiśca pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ।
dugdhenā''pyāyanaṃ kuryād dugdhaṃ dadyācca bhogine ।। 84।।
kṛte nāgavrate tvevaṃ na vai daśanti pannagāḥ ।
nopadravanti viṣāṇi brahmaṇo varadānataḥ ।।85।।
sarpānprāha purā brahmā 'kārtike vaḥ prapūjakān ।
mā daśantu' iti te'pi naiva daśanti pūjakān । ।8 6 । ।
kārtikakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ karakākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam ।
strīṇāmevā'dhikāro'tra kartavyaṃ tābhireva tat ।।87।।
snātvā dehamalaṃkṛtya pūjayed gaṇanāyakam ।
āvāhanātsamārabhya sarvaṃ vai vidhinā caret ।।88 ।।
tadagre pūrṇapakvānnaṃ vinyasyet karakān daśa ।
kalaśān vā jalapūrṇān nyasyed daśa tadagrataḥ ।।89 ।।
devo me prīyatāmevamuccāryaiva samarpayet ।
suvāsinībhyaḥ kalaśān dadyācca daśaśaṃkhyakān ।। 1.269.90 ।।
miṣṭānnāni pradadyācca tataścandrodaye sati ।
datvā'rghyaṃ vidhinā nārī bhuñjīta miṣṭameva ha ।। 91 ।।
dugdhapūrṇaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ dadyād dvijātaye ।
sapūgā'kṣataratnāḍhyaṃ vratasya paripūrtaye ।। 92 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī ṣoḍaśadvādaśābdakam ।
udyāpanaṃ vidhāyā'tha vrataṃ samāpayettataḥ ।। 93 ।।
yāvajjīvaṃ tu vā nāryā kāryaṃ saubhāgyavāñchayā ।
vratenā'nena sadṛśaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadāyakam ।। 94।।
nānyadvai vidyate loke kartavyaṃ tatprayatnataḥ ।
maṃgalo grahavaryaśca pṛthivyāḥ suta eva yaḥ ।। 95।।
asyāṃ tithau śaṃkarasya bindorutpanna eva saḥ ।
aṃgārakaṃ vrataṃ tasmātkartavyaṃ śreya icchatā ।। 96 ।।
maṃgalaḥ sarvadā tasya bhadraṃ bhadraṃ dadāti vai ।
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ vrataṃ kartavyamādarāt ।। 97।।
maṃgalasya tathā pūjā japaḥ kartavya iṣṭadaḥ ।
raktaratnapradānaṃ ca raktavastrādidānakam ।। 98 ।।
raktagodhūmadānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ vratinā tadā ।
raktatilapradānaṃ ca sarvasmṛddhikaraṃ bhavet ।। 99 ।।
mārgaśuklacaturthyāstu varṣaṃ yāvad vratī janaḥ ।
kṣapayedekabhaktena naktena vatsarāntaram ।। 1.269.100 ।।
ayācitena tṛtīyamupavāsaiścaturthakam ।
evaṃ catvāri varṣāṇi vrataṃ kuryādatandritaḥ ।। 101 ।।
vināyakavrataṃ tvetatkāśyāṃ vināyakodbhavān ।
ṣoḍaśavastusaṃpūjyaḥ sarvāsu ca caturthīṣu ।। 102।।
dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi yathāśakti yathādhanam ।
vatsarānte vratānte vā mahadudyāpanaṃ caret ।। 103 ।।
kārayecchrīgaṇapatiṃ mūṣakaṃ kānakaṃ ratham ।
yadvā tu tāmrajaṃ sarvaṃ kāṣṭhajaṃ mṛttikākṛtam ।। 1 04।।
yathāyogyaṃ kārayitvā yadvā padma supatrakam ।
yadvā tu sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ dhānyanirmitam ।। 105। ।
madhye yogyaṃ ghaṭaṃ nyasya tāmrasthālyanvitaṃ śubham ।
pūrayettaṇḍulaistatra sthāpayecca vināyakam ।। 106 ।।
āvāhanādibhiḥ snānaiḥ sindūracandanādibhiḥ ।
dūrvāpuṣpāmbarabhūṣādhūpadīpasugandhakaiḥ ।। 1 07।।
modakātmakanaivedyaiḥ phalaistāmbūlacarvaṇaiḥ ।
dakṣiṇāstutikusumāṃjalibhirjāgaraistathā ।। 108 ।।
pūjayettoṣayed devaṃ gītavādyakathānakaiḥ ।
prabhāte śarkarāvrīhiyavaghṛtatilādibhiḥ ।। 109 ।।
śrīphalaiḥ sarṣapaiḥ śvetairhomaṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ ।
gaṇo gaṇādhipaścaiva kūṣmāṇḍastripurāntakaḥ ।। 1.269.110 ।।
lambodaraikadantau ca rukmadaṃṣṭraśca vighnapaḥ ।
brahmā yamo'tha varuṇaḥ somaḥ sūryo hutāśanaḥ ।। 111 ।।
gandhamādī parameṣṭhītyevaṃ ṣoḍaśanāmabhiḥ ।
tathā vakrasutuṇḍe'ti nāmato'ṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।। 112 ।।
hūyādvai dahane bhaktyā hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret ।
dikpālān pūjayitvā'tha caturviṃśatibhūsurān ।। 113 ।।
modakaiḥ pāyasaiḥ śākaiḥ pūrikābhiśca tarpayet ।
ācāryāya tato dadyād dogdhrīṃ gāṃ vatsikāyutām ।। 1 14।।
dakṣiṇāṃ ca yathāśakti bhūyasīṃ prārpayettathā ।
anyebhyaścāpi dānāni dadyāt praṇamya bhūsurān ।। 115 ।।
visṛjya bandhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhuñjīta prītamānasaḥ ।
evaṃ vratamidaṃ kṛtvā bhuktvā bhogānihottamān ।। 116 ।।
sāyujyaṃ prāpnuyād viṣṇorvināyakaprasādataḥ ।
etad varavataṃ proktaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।। 1 17।।
pauṣamāsacaturthyāṃ tu prapūjya tu vināyakam ।
vipraikaṃ bhojayeccaiva modakairdakṣiṇāṃ diśet ।। 11 8।।
evaṃkṛte vratī syādvai sarvasampattibhājanam ।
māghaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu gaurīvratamanumattamam ।। 119 ।।
gaurīpūjyā yoginīnāṃ gaṇaiḥ sākaṃ tu bhāvataḥ ।
naraiḥ strībhiḥ kundapuṣpaiḥ raktapuṣpādibhistathā ।। 1.269.120 ।।
raktasūtrairalaktakairdhūpairdīpaiḥ subhojanaiḥ ।
sagūḍalaḍḍukaiścāpi kṣīreṇa pāyasena ca ।। 121 ।।
pūjyāḥ saubhāgyavatyaśca nāryo viprāśca sādhavaḥ ।
saubhāgyavṛddhaye tebhyo dātavyāni viśeṣataḥ ।। 1 22।।
dānāni bhojanānyevāmbarāṇisatphalāni ca ।
idaṃ gaurīvrataṃ lakṣmi! saubhāgyārogyavardhanam ।। 123 ।।
prativarṣaṃ prakartavyaṃ gauryāḥ kṛtaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
ḍhuṇḍhivratamidaṃ bodhyaṃ gaṇeśastatra pūjyate ।। 1 24।।
kāśyāṃ saḥ śāṃbhavānāṃ ḍhuṇḍhanārthaṃ tvāgataḥ sthitaḥ ।
tannimittaṃ vrataṃ tvetat kartavyaṃ śreya icchatā ।। 125 ।।
kuṇḍavrataṃ śāntivratalalitāvratamityapi ।
tilavrataṃ tvetadeva kundavrataṃ ca kīrtitam । । 126 ।।
snāna dāna japā homastarpaṇaṃ yatkṛtaṃ bhavet ।
sahasraguṇitaṃ tatsyād gaurīgaṇeśatoṣaṇāt ।। 1 27।।
māghakṛṣṇacaturthyāṃ tu saṃkaṣṭahārakaṃ vratam ।
upavāsaṃ prakurvīta vīkṣya candrodayaṃ tataḥ ।। 128 ।।
mṛdā kṛtvā gaṇeśaṃ sāyudhaṃ savāhanaṃ śubham ।
pīṭhe nyasya ca taṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ prapūjayet ।। 129 ।।
modakāँstilacūrṇaṃ ca saśarkaraṃ nivedayet ।
arghyaṃ dadyāttāmrapātre raktacandanamiśritam ।। 1.269.130 ।।
kuśān dūrvāḥ kusumānyakṣatān śamīdalān dadhi ।
dadyādarghyaṃ tato visarjanaṃ kuryādatha vratī ।। 131 ।।
bhojayed bhūsurān sādhūn sādhvīśca bālabālikāḥ ।
vratī ca pāraṇāṃ kuryād dadyāddānāni bhāvataḥ ।। 132 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ smṛddhaḥ saṃkaṭaṃ naiva cāpnuyāt ।
dhanadhānyasutāputraprapautrādiyuto bhavet ।। 133 ।।
phālgunaśuklacaturthyāṃ ḍhuṇḍhirāja vrataṃ punaḥ ।।
prakartavyaṃ pūjanīyo gaṇaśaḥ sarvavastubhiḥ ।। 134 । ।
tilapiṣṭaistilaiścaiva dānahomaprapūjanaiḥ ।
toṣayitvā ḍhuṇḍhirājaṃ sarvasampattimāpnuyāt ।। 1 35।।
sauvarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ ca datvā dvijātaye dhanam ।
bahubhogyānavāpnoti vratī nātra vicāraṇā ।। 1856 । ।
yasminkasmin bhavenmāsi caturthī ravivārayuk ।
maṃgalena yutā yadvā sā viśeṣaphalapradā । । 13 7 । ।
yāvatīṣu caturthīṣu vighneśaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha ।
pūjanīyastathā paṃcāyatanaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ ।। 13 8 ।।
udyāpanaṃ vrate kārya niyamaḥ saṃyamastathā ।
brahmacaryaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ phalaṃ vai śāśvataṃ bhavet। ।। 139 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikacaturthīvrateṣu gaṇeśātmakavāsudevasaṃkarṣaṇapradyumnāni-ruddhavratasatījanmavratarathantarakalpavārāhajayantīgaṇeśa-jayantīgopradakṣiṇāsiddhivināyakavratanāgavratakarakā-vratāṃgārakavratakāśīvināyakavrataḍhuṇḍirājavratā-
dīnāṃ nirūpaṇanāmaikonasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 269 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 269 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 270

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! pañcamīnāṃ vratāni vai ।
yāni kṛtvā janā yānti sukhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca sampadaḥ । । 1 । ।
caitraśuklasya paṃcamyāṃ matsyajanmā'bhavaddhariḥ ।
matsyaḥ kāryaḥ suvarṇasya tasya kāryo mahotsavaḥ ।। 2 । ।
matsyo'yaṃ brahmaputro yo hayagrīvaṃ nihatya vai ।
vedān samānayāmāsa sa pūjyo bhūtimicchatā । । 3 ।।
caitraśukla tṛtīyāyāṃ matsyaḥ satyavratāya yaḥ ।
bījāni rakṣituṃ nāvi dideśa pūjya eva saḥ ।। 4 ।।
ardho narākṛtirūrdhvamadho matsyākṛtirhi saḥ ।
sauvarṇo'rcyaḥ kṛtamālānadītīre sasatyakaḥ ।। 5 ।।
vāme śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ dakṣe dadhan mukuṭayuk śubhaḥ ।
naivedye dadhi bhaktaṃ ca dadhyaktānvaṭakāँstathā । । 6 ।।
dadyācca gāpayedgāthāṃ matsyajanmamayīṃ kathām ।
dānāni gurave dadyād bhuñjītā''rārtrikottaram । । 7 । ।
iyaṃ śrīpañcamī proktā śriyā yatra tapaḥ kṛtam ।
śrīkṛṣṇāsyā''ptaye tasmād vrataṃ kāryaṃ śriyo'rcanam ।। 8 ।।
gandhādyairupacāraiśca naivedyaiḥ pāyasādibhiḥ ।
vibhūṣaṇaiḥ phalapuṣpaiḥ śrāṃgārikasuvastubhiḥ ।। 9 । ।
lakṣmyāstu pūjakaṃ pūjikāṃ tu lakṣmīrna muñcati ।
pṛthvī cātra tithau nītā varāheṇa jalopari ।। 1.270.10 ।।
tasyā vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ mūrtyarcanādibhiḥ śubham ।
candravrataṃ tayā cātra kartavyaṃ kṣayanāśanam । । 11 ।।
candrakṣayo vinaṣṭo'bhūt tapasā śaṃbhvanugrahāt ।
hayagrīvāvatāraśca jāto'syāṃ paṃcamītithau ।। 12 । ।
hayagrīvavrataṃ kuryād hayāsyaṃ tu samarcayet ।
sauvarṇaṃ mānavaṃ dehaṃ sāyudhaṃ pṛthivīyutam ।। 13 । ।
hiraṇyākṣasya hantāraṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam ।
pūjayedvidhinā bhṛṣṭāँścaṇakān bhojayettathā ।। 14 ।।
dadyād dānānyoṣadhīnāṃ rasānāṃ vāriśākhinām ।
vratakartā bhavennityaṃ nīrogo dhanadhānyavān ।। 15 ।।
atha vaiśākhapañcamyāṃ śeṣaḥ pūjyo'tra mānavaiḥ ।
tena nāgagaṇairdattamabhīṣṭaṃ labhate phalam ।। 16 ।।
nāgā nopadravaṃ kaṃcit kurvanti vratino gṛhe ।
kṣetre vāṭyāṃ tathodyāne rakṣakāste bhavanti vai । । 17 । ।
atha jyeṣṭhasya paṃcamyāṃ pitṝnabhyarcayet sudhīḥ ।
sarvakāmaphalāvāptirbhavedvai pitṛtarpaṇaiḥ । । 18 । ।
athā''ṣāḍhasya paṃcamyāṃ vāyuvratamudīritam ।
grāmādbahirvinirgatya dharocchrāye samāsthitaḥ ।। 19 । ।
dhvajaṃ ca pañcavarṇaṃṃ vai vaṃśadaṇḍāgrayojitam ।
samucchritaṃ nidadhyācca daṇḍamūlaṃ prapūjayet ।। 1.270.2 0 । ।
dhvajo yāṃ yāṃ diśaṃ yāti vāyunā preritastathā ।
daṇḍamūle taddigīśānāṃ vai kuryāt prapūjanam ।। 21 । ।
prathamādiṣu yāmeṣu yāṃ yāṃ vāyuḥ pravartate ।
tasmai tasmai digīśāya pūjāṃ samyak prakalpayet ।। 22।।
evaṃ sthitvā nirāhāro bahiryāmacatuṣṭayam ।
sāyamāgatya dehaṃ svaṃ bhuktvā svapyād bhuvi kṣaṇam । । 23 । ।
yaḥ svapno jāyate rātrau sa eva bhavitā dhruvam ।
aśubhaṃ dṛśyate cedvai hyupavāsaṃ samācaret ।। 24।।
śivapūjāṃ niśi kṛtvā dvijānaṣṭau tu bhojayet ।
lasecchubhaphalaṃ tena dāne dadyādgavādikam ।। 25 । ।
vratametatsusamproktaṃ śubhāśubhanidarśanam ।
nṝṇāṃ saubhāgyajanakaṃ paratrā'tra sukhāvaham ।। 26 । ।
śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapañcamyāmannavṛddhikaraṃ vratam ।
kartavyaṃ tu janenā'tra sarvānnasmṛddhikṛddhi tat ।। 27।।
caturthyāṃ dinaśeṣe tu sarvāṇyannāni padmaje ।
pṛthakpātreṣu salilairākledayet prage tataḥ ।। 28 ।।
tānyeva salilānyeva dadyāt sūryodaye sati ।
pitṝṣidevatābhyaśca suklinnā'nnāni cāpi vai ।। 29।।
prāsādikāni tānyeva yācakebhyaḥ samarpayet ।
niśi śaṃbhugṛhaṃ gatvā liṃgaṃ gandhādinā'rcayet ।। 1.270.30 । ।
namaḥ śivāya prajapet prārthayedannasiddhaye ।
śāradīyāni cānnāni tathā vāsantikānyapi ।। 31 ।।
yāni syustaiḥ samṛddho'haṃ bhūyāṃ janmani janmani ।
evaṃ samprārthya viprebhyo dattvā'nnāni ca vāgyataḥ ।। 32 ।।
prabhuñjīta ca tānyeva vrataṃ tvannakaraṃ hi tat ।
sarvānnasaṃpajjanakaṃ paralokagatipradam ।। 33 ।।
śrāvaṇe śuklapaṃcamyāṃ mataṃ jīvantikāvratam ।
jīvantīpatrapuṣpādyairindrāṇīṃ pūjayed vratī ।। 34।।
dvārasyobhayato lekhyā gomayena viṣolbaṇāḥ ।
nāgāstānpūjayitvaiva saṃpraṇamya dvijātaye ।। 35 ।।
svarṇarūpyādikaṃ dadyāt tadanantaphalapradam ।
ekabhuktavrataṃ kuryād dārāpatyasuhṛdvṛtaḥ ।। 36।।
bhādrakṛṣṇasya paṃcamyāṃ nāgān kṣīreṇa tarpayet ।
yastasyā''saptamaṃ yāvatkulaṃ sarpāt sunirbhayam ।। 37।।
bhādrasya śuklapaṃcamyāṃ pūjayedṛṣisattamān ।
prage snātvā mṛdā kṛtvā vedikāṃ puṣpaśobhinām ।। 38 ।।
āstīrya ca kuśāँstatra saptarṣīn vai samarcayet ।
gandhaiśca vividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ ।। 39 ।।
ṛṣyannaṃ bhojane dadyānnivārānnaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
naivedyaṃ vipaced vratakṛt śyāmākādyairakṛṣṭajaiḥ ।।1.270.40 ।।
prāsādikaṃ vratī tvadyādācāryān sapta bhojayet ।
pratimāḥ sapta kurvīta jaṭilāḥ sopavītakāḥ ।।4 1 ।।
sauvarṇāstā ghaṭeṣveva tāmreṣu mṛnmayeṣu vā ।
sannyasya snāpayed bhaktyā pañcāmṛtādivāribhiḥ ।।42।।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayitvā'rghyamarpayet ।
homaṃ kuryāt tilahavirvrīhighṛtayavādibhiḥ ।।43 ।।
puṇyairmantrairnāmabhiśca hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret ।
vastrālaṃkārasaṃyuktā dadyād gāḥ sapta vedine ।।44।।
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dānaṃ dadyādvai vratapūrtaye ।
bhojayitvā gurūn viprān praṇipatya visarjayet ।।45।।
prāsādikaṃ svayaṃ tvadyāt saha bandhubhirādarāt ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ sāṃgaṃ bhukiṃ muktiṃ vratī vrajet ।।46।।
nārī kṛtvā vrataṃ rājaṃssvalpāndoṣāndhunoti vai ।
āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha ।।47।।
kuṃkumavāpyāṃ saṃjajñe nimbadevānikālaye ।
kāryaścaturbhujaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūjanīyo vidhānataḥ ।।48।।
utsavastu mahān kāryo vratadānaprabhojanaiḥ ।
kaṃbharālakṣmyā api tatpatnyā yukto'rcya ādarāt ।।49 ।।
āśvine śuklapaṃcamyāmupāṃgalalitāvratam ।
purā vrataṃ lalitayā hareḥ prāptikṛte kṛtam ।।1.270.50।।
tasyāḥ svarṇamayīṃ mūrtiṃ śaktyā nirmāya padmaje ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayettāṃ vidhānataḥ ।।5 1 ।।
pakvānnaṃ phalasaṃyuktaṃ saghṛtaṃ dakṣiṇādikam ।
prāsādikaṃ brāhmaṇāya pradadyād vratapūrtaye ।।5 2।।
kārtike śuklapaṃcamyāṃ jayayā harilabdhaye ।
kṛtaṃ vrataṃ jayāmatra ṣoḍaśādisuvastubhiḥ ।।53।।
pūjayitvā bhojayitvā datvā ca dakṣiṇādikam ।
visarjayettataḥ paścāt svayaṃ bhuñjīta vai vratī ।।54।।
jayāvrate saṃprakuryāttīrthe snānamaghāpaham ।
aśvamedhā'vabhathasya snānasya phalamāpnuyāt ।।55 ।।
aputro labhate putraṃ vandhyā garbhavatī bhavet ।
rogī tvārogyamāpnuyād bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajed vratī ।।5 6।।
mārge śuklasya paṃcamyāṃ nāgānprapūjya bhāvataḥ ।
nāgebhyo hyabhayaṃ labdhvā modate saha bāndhavaiḥ ।।57।।
pauṣe'pi śuklapaṃcamyāṃ pūjyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva ca ।
pitaraśca tathā nāgāḥ pūjyā sukhakarā matāḥ ।।।।58।।।
māghasya śuklapaṃcamyā vasantavratamīritam ।
vasantasya tadā pūjā kartavyā caikabhuktatā ।।5 9 ।।
navagodhūmasasyaiśca badarīpatrakaistathā ।
vanakharjūrakaiścaiva rājikābhiśca sattṛṇaiḥ ।।1.270.6 0 ।।
haritaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā kuṃkumādibhirarcayet ।
kalaśaṃ raṃgasalilairyuktaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī ।।6 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayeccaiva raṃgaiḥ krīḍāṃ vidhāpayet ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lājāṃ kharjūraṃ dāpayejjanām ।।62।।
bhuktimuktisukhaprāptikaraṃ caitadvrataṃ bhavet ।
phālgunakṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ jajñe lakṣmīstu kaṃbharā ।।6 3 ।।
prātaḥ premagṛhe omālaye kāryastadutsavaḥ ।
caturbhujā mahālakṣmīḥ pūjanīyā hi kānakī ।।64।।
vrataṃ sāṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।
phālgunaśuklapaṃcamyāṃ pūjyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva ca ।। 65 ।।
holikādivyaṃgyadoṣān śamayed bhagavāँstataḥ ।
itivratāni kāryāṇi yathāśakti sukhārthinā ।। 66 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapañcamīvrateṣu matsyajayantīśrītapovratavārāhapṛthvī-
vratacandrakṣayanāśavratahayagrīvajayantīnāgapaṃcamīpitṛvrata-vāyuvratā'nnavṛddhivratajīvantikānāgavrataṛṣipaṃcamī-gopālakṛṣṇajayantīlalitāvratajayāvratanāgavrata-
vasantapaṃcamīkaṃbharālakṣmīvratādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 270 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 270 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 271
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 272 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha vārṣikaṣaṣṭhīnāṃ vratāni vividhāni te ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi bhuktimuktipradāni vai ।। 1 ।।
caitramāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ skandajanmā'bhavatpurā ।
kumāravratamevaitatkartavyaṃ pūjanādibhiḥ ।। 2 ।।
ṣaṇmukhaṃ samayūraṃ ca senānīṃ tu samarcayet ।
bhojanāni ca dānāni vratī dadyāt subhaktitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
vratenānena balavān śūraḥ sarvaguṇānvitaḥ ।
ciraṃjīvī prāpyate vai putrastu vratinā dhruvam ।। 4 ।।
śaṃkaraṃ pārvatīṃ skandaṃ sauvarṇaṃ sarvavastubhiḥ ।
śṛṃgāritaṃ dāpayecca gurave vratapūrtaye ।। 5 ।।
vaiśākhe'pi tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kārtikaṃ pūjayed vratī ।
labhate mātṛjaṃ saukhyaṃ lālanaṃ pālanādikam ।। 6 ।।
jyeṣṭhe śukle tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūjayettu divākaram ।
labhate vāñchitān kāmān divākaraprasādataḥ ।। 7 ।।
aṣāḍhaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca kuryāt skandavrataṃ punaḥ ।
labhate'bhīpsitān kāmānputrapautrādisantatim ।। 8 ।।
śrāvaṇe śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca śarajanmānamarcayet ।
labhate'bhīpsitānarthān ṣaṇmukhasya prasādataḥ ।। 9 ।।
atraiva divase kuryāt sūpaudanāśanaṃ vratam ।
haraye tvarpayed bhakto bhuñjīta tatprasādakam ।। 1.271.10 ।।
sūpaudanaṃ vinā nānyad bhoktavyamekabhuktakam ।
vratenānena dadyācchrīhariḥ sūpaudanaṃ tadā ।। 11 ।।
atraiva divase cāhaṃ kalkirūpo bhavāmi vai ।
mama janmavrataṃ kuryāt śvetāśvasthitameva ca ।। 12 ।।
sacchatraṃ sāyudhaṃ svarṇahārāḍhyaṃ pūjayettu mām ।
rakṣāṃ karomi pākhaṇḍaduṣṭaduḥkhād vratārthinaḥ ।। 13 ।।
bhādramāse kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhyāṃ lalitāṃ pūjayed vratī ।
nārī vratārthinī snātvā śuklāmbaradharā satī ।। 14।।
nadyoḥ saṃgamavālukā gṛhītvā piṇḍamācaret ।
vinirmāya ca lalitāṃ paṃkajaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ ।। 15 ।।
nīlotpalairmālatībhiḥ ketakaiśca prapūjayet। ।
aṣṭottaraśataṃ tasyai puṣpāṇāṃ cārpayet tataḥ ।। 16 ।।
prārthayedagrataḥ sthitvā lalitāṃ śrīharipriyām ।
gaṃgādvāre kuśāvarte bilvake nīlaparvate ।। 17 ।।
tathā kanakhale snātvā hariṃ labdhavatī patim ।
mamāpi śrīhareryogaṃ dehi saubhāgyavardhini ।। 18 ।।
samprārthyaivaṃ prapūjyaiva naivedyaṃ purato nyaset ।
nārīkelasukūṣmāṇḍadāḍīmabījapūrakaiḥ ।। 19 ।।
cirbhaṭṭakarkaṭikābhiḥ phalaiḥ saṃśobhayet puraḥ ।
navīnāṃkurapatraiśca dīpāvalyā ca toraṇaiḥ ।। ।। 1.271.20 ।।
dhūpaiḥ sugandhinaivedyairmiṣṭānnairvividhairapi ।
śaṣkulībhirmodakaiśca bhojayedbhāvato vratī ।। 21 ।।
ārārtrikaṃ ca kurvīta rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret ।
gītaivādyairnartanaiśca bhajanairnāmakīrtanaiḥ ।। 22 ।।
sakhībhiḥ sahitā sādhvī na netre saṃpramīlayet ।
saptamyāṃ saritaṃ gatvā snātvā samarcya tāṃ tataḥ ।। 23 ।।
datvā dvijāya dānāni hutvā vaiśvānaraṃ tathā ।
devān pitṝn manuṣyāँśca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ ।। 24।।
brāhmaṇānkanyakāḥ sādhūnsādhvīḥ saṃbhojayed vratī ।
lalitā me'stu suprītā saṃprārthyaitān visarjayet। ।। 25 ।।
naro nārī caredevaṃ vrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ param ।
anyavrataistapobhiśca dānairniyamasaṃyamaiḥ ।। 26 ।।
yatphalaṃ tatsulabhyeta praitya lokaṃ sanātanam ।
modate lalitādevyā sākaṃ vimānago vratī ।। 27।।
bhādramāse śuklapakṣe vrataṃ candanaṣaṣṭhikam ।
tasyāṃ lakṣmīstu saṃpūjyā candanairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ।। 28 ।।
rohiṇīpātabhaumaiśca yuktā ṣaṣṭhī hi kāpilā ।
tasyāṃ raviṃ samabhyarcya ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।। 29।।।
labheta vāñchitānkāmān vratakṛnnātra saṃśayaḥ ।
sūryaṣaṣṭhīyamevāpi bhāskarasya prasādataḥ ।। 1.271.3 0 ।।
japo homastathā dānaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam ।
sarvamevā'kṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ kṛtaṃ yad vratinā śubham ।। 31 ।।
pūjayitvā kapilāṃ gāṃ mālyakuṃkumabhojanaiḥ ।
sopaskarāṃ pradadyādvai gurave ravituṣṭaye ।। 22।।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī labheta sukhamuttamam ।
rasānnaphalabhūṣādismṛddhaṃ gṛhaṃ patiṃ labhet ।।33।।
atheṣaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai pūjyā kātyāyanī priye ।
sugandhamaṃgaladravyairbhojanairmiṣṭasadrasaiḥ ।। 24।।
pārvatī vai svayaṃ proktā kālā kātyāyanī prasūḥ ।
pūjyā'tra saikatīrmūrtiryadvā dvijasatī priye ।।25।।
vastrālaṃkāravān datvā natvā kṣāntvā visarjayet ।
kanyā vratārthinī daivaṃ varaṃ vindet susundaram ।।26।।
putrārthinī labhetputraṃ kātyāyanyāḥ prasādataḥ ।
kārtike śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu ṣaṇmukhena mahātmanā ।। 27।।
devasenābhidhāpatnī labdhā sarvasurārcitā ।
devasenāyutaṃ skandaṃ pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ।।38।।
vahnipūjā tathā homaścāpi kartavya ādarāt ।
evaṃ vratī laset siddhiṃ manobhīṣṭāṃ tu śāśvatīm ।। 35।।
mārgaśīrṣe śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ kārtikeyena dhīmatā ।
nihatastārako daityo brahmādyāḥ skandapūjanam ।।1.271.40।।
akurvan gandhapuṣpādyairvratinā'pi phalādibhiḥ ।
pūjanaṃ paramaṃ kāryaṃ vastrabhūṣāprahetibhiḥ ।।41।।
naivedyaṃ miṣṭamatroktaṃ dānaṃ gobhūmayaṃ smṛtam ।
ravivārayutā seyaṃ cettu śatabhiṣānvitā ।।4।।
campāṣaṣṭhī tadā proktā haraḥ pūjyastadatra vai ।
snānadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtamakṣayyamucyate ।।43 ।।
mahāpūjā prakartavyā harasya ca harestathā ।
dānāni vividhānyeva vratī dadyāttu bhāvataḥ ।।44।।
naro nārī vratenātra saukhyaṃ labdhvākṣaraṃ vrajet ।
pauṣamāse śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ sūrya pūjyaḥ prabheśvaraḥ ।।45।।
viṣṇurūpo jagattrātā jāto vai vedhasaḥ punaḥ ।
nārāyaṇo'yaṃ sākṣāt sarvaprakāśakṛtprabhuḥ ।।46।।
ṣoḍaṣottamavastvādyai pūjanīyaḥ sukhepsubhiḥ ।
netratejo vivardheta dhanasampadgṛho bhavet ।।47।।
brahmaṇā sahitaṃ putraṃ sūryaṃ sumukuṭaṃ vratī ।
sauvarṇaṃ kārayitvaiva dadyāt dānaṃ dvijātaye ।।48।।
māghamāse sitā ṣaṣṭhī varuṇotpattikā matā ।
tasyāṃ pūjyo jaleśo vai viṣṇurūpī sureśvaraḥ ।।49।।
raktagandhāṃśukapuṣpadhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ ।
vratinā pūjito dadyād yatheṣṭān sadrasān śubhān ।।1.271.50 ।।
phālgune śuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca haraṃ paśupatiṃ prabhum ।
mṛnmayaṃ vāpi sauvarṇaṃ kārayitvā prapūjayet ।।51 ।।
saṃsnāpya śatarudreṇa pṛthak paṃcāmṛtairjalaiḥ ।
śvetacandanasaugandhyairālipyā'kṣatapuṣpakaiḥ ।।52।।
śvetairdhattūrapuṣpaiśca phalairbilvasupatrakaiḥ ।
pūjayitvā ca naivedye miṣṭānnāni samarpayet ।।53।।
nīrājayitvā natvā ca kṣamāpyātha visarjayet ।
naro nārī vrataṃ kṛtvā bhogānte śivatāṃ vrajet ।।54।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikaṣaṣṭhīvrateṣu kārtikasvāmijayantīdivākaravrataskanda-
śarajanmotsavasūpaudanāśanavratakalkijayantīlalitā-hariprāptivratacandanaṣaṣṭhīkapilāṣaṣṭhīkātyāyanī-vratadevasenāvratatārakavadhakṛtskandavratacampā-
ṣaṣṭhīviṣṇujayantīsūryajayantīvaruṇa-jayantyādivratanirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 271 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 272
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 273 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
vārṣikasaptamīnāṃ vai vratāni kathayāmi te ।
yāni kṛtvā vratī lakṣmi! bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।। 1 ।।
caitrasya śuklasaptamyāṃ tīrthe snānaṃ samācaret ।
sthaṇḍilaṃ gomayāliptaṃ gauramṛttikayā'nvitam ।। 2 ।।
kṛtvā tatrā'ṣṭadalakaṃ kamalaṃ karṇikopari ।
vibhāvasuṃ sthāpayitvā pūrvapatre raviṃ harim ।। 3 ।।
āgneye cānalaṃ śukraṃ dakṣiṇe maṃgalaṃ yamam ।
nairṛtye nirṛtaṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ vinyasya vai tataḥ ।। 4 ।।
pratīcyāṃ śanivaruṇau vāyavye'nilacandrakau ।
udīcyāṃ budhakuberau aiśānyāṃ ca guruṃ haram ।। 5 ।।
sthāpayitvā'rcayet sarvān gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyatāmbūlaphalacarvaṇaiḥ ।। 6 ।।
aṣṭottaraśataṃ homaṃ ghṛtena kārayed vratī ।
aṣṭāṣṭa cāhutīrdadyātpratyekaṃ nāmamantrataḥ ।। 7 ।।
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ kuryād dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām ।
evaṃ vai dikprapālānāṃ kuryāttu pūjanaṃ vratam ।। 8 ।।
vrataṃ kṛtvā tvekabhuktaṃ sarvaṃ saukhyamavāpnuyāt ।
dehānte maṇḍalaṃ bhānorbhittvā yāti paraṃ padam ।। 9 ।।
vaiśākhaśuklasaptamyāṃ jahnunā jāhnavī purā ।
pītā tyaktā punaścaiva gaṃgāvratamidaṃ matam ।। 1.272.10 ।।
gaṃgāṃ tu jāhnavī snātvā pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ।
ghaṭasāhasradānaṃ vai kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā । । 11 ।।
saptakulaṃ nayetsvargaṃ gaṃgāvratamidaṃ śubham ।
atra tithau tathā bodhyaṃ kamalavratamityapi । । 12 ।।
tilamātrasuvarṇasya kartavyaṃ kamalaṃ śubham ।
vastrayugmāvṛtaṃ kṛtvā gandhadhūpādinā'rcayet । । 13 ।।
sāyaṃ sūryāya natvā'tha padmaṃ dvijāya cārpayet ।
udakuṃbhaṃ ca tatpadmaṃ kapilāṃ gāṃ dvije'rpayet । । 1 4।।
upavāsaṃ prakuryācca pāraṇāṃ tu pare'hani ।
brāhmaṇān bhojayedbhaktyā sādhūn sādhvīḥ satīstathā । । 15 । ।
evaṃ vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ gavāṃ tathā ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajennārī vratakartrī dhanaṃ laset । । 16 । ।
atraiva tithau kāryaṃ nimbavrataṃ śubhāvaham ।
sūryapūjā prakartavyā nimbapatrairviśeṣataḥ ।। 1 7।।
nimbapatraṃ tathā'śnīyād bhūśāyī syādvinā'śanam ।
pare'hni brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ । । 18 ।।
śarkarāsaptamī tveṣā bhūmau sarvarasapradā ।
kartavyaṃ śarkarāyāstu vrataṃ rasārthibhiryataḥ ।। 19 । ।
amṛtaṃ pibato hastātsūryasyā'mṛtabindavaḥ ।
nipeturbhuvi cotpannā śālimudgayavekṣavaḥ । । 1.272.20 । ।
śarkarā cekṣuto jātā raveriṣṭā sadā śubhā ।
havye kavye pavitrā sā dātavyā devatuṣṭaye ।। 21 । ।
atra vai śarkarādānaṃ śarkarābhojanaṃ tathā ।
kartavyaṃ vratinā samyak putrasantativardhanam । । 22 । ।
sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ vājimedhaphalapradam ।
dānaṃ cānyatprakartavyaṃ bhojanīyāśca sādhavaḥ ।। 23 ।।
jyeṣṭhe vai śuklasaptamyāṃ sūryaṃ indro'bhavat svayam ।
sopavāsaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ pūjya indro vidhānata ।। 24।।।
dānamindrasya kartavyaṃ sauvarṇasya dvijātike ।
sādhūn bālān bhojayitvā tatau bhuñjīta vai vratī । । 15 ।।
aṣāḍhaśuklasaptamyāṃ vivasvānnāmabhāskaraḥ ।
rājyābhiṣeka samprāptaḥ pūjā tasya matā vrate ।। 26 ।।
vivasvantaṃ tu sauvarṇa prapūjya kusumādibhiḥ ।
labhate rarhasāyujya divyaṃ sukha ca śāśvatam । । 27 । ।
śrāvaṇe śuklasaptamyām arvyagākhyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam ।
kārpāsaṃ vastrabhevātra dāne deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 28 ।।
hastarkṣasahitā cetsyāt saptamī puṇyadāyinī ।
asyāṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sarvaṃ tvakṣayatāṃ vrajet ।। 29 ।।
śītalāsaptamī ceyaṃ ijyā vai pārvatī satī ।
śītalāyai pradātavyā śāṭī piṣṭādibhojanam ।। 1.272.30 ।।
ārogyaṃ tena vratino bhavedvai sarvadā kule ।
upavāsaḥ prakartavyo deyaṃ dānaṃ phalādikam ।। 31 ।।
bhādre tu śuklasaptamyām amuktābharaṇaṃ vratam ।
candro dhṛto lalāṭe vai śaṃbhunā''bhūṣaṇātmakaḥ ।। 32।।
somasya ca maheśasya pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ ।
prakuryād visṛjennatvā sarvakāmasamṛddhaye ।। 32 ।।
phalasaptamī caiveyaṃ phalasaptātmikī matā ।
nālikeraṃ ca vṛntākaṃ nāraṃgaṃ bījapūrakam ।। 34।।
kūṣmāṇḍaṃ bruhatīpūgaṃ phalānyetāni cārpayet ।
saptatantukṛtaṃ cātra saptagranthisudorakam ।। 35 ।।
samarpya śaṃkarāyātha badhnīyād vāmahastake ।
nārī vāme naro dakṣe haste varṣaṃ surakṣayet ।। 36 ।।
vratāṃte bālakān sapta bhojayitvā tato vratī ।
svayaṃ bhuñjīta nijayug vratasampūrtihetave ।। 3 7।।
phalāni tu dvijebhyo vai dadyāt santuṣṭihetave ।
evaṃ. sapta tu varṣāṇi vrataṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi ।। 38।।
sāyujyaṃ labhate lakṣmi! mahādevasya tadvatī ।
pūjanaṃ tadvrate kārye yathāvidhi yathādhanam ।। 39 ।।
āśvine śuklapakṣe tu pañcagavyavrataṃ smṛtam ।
śubhasaptamī saṃproktā śuddhidā puṇyadā tathā ।।1.272.40 ।।
snātvā devaṃ hariṃ sūrya pūjayitvā vratī tataḥ ।
kapilāṃ gāṃ pūjayitvā prārthayettāṃ śṛṇu priye ।। 41 ।।
dade'haṃ tvāṃ sukalyāṇi! prīyatāmaryamā svayam ।
pālaya tvaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ dharmapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ ।।42।।
evamuccārya natvā ca dravā dvijāya visṛjet ।
mate''bhabhīyātpañcagavyaṃ pare'hi pāraṇā caret ।। 43 ।।
dvijottamān bhojayitvā gṛhṇīyācchiṣṭakaṃ vratī ।
sa 3 iriprasādena bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।।44।।
atha kārtikaśuklāyāṃ śākākhyasaptamīvratam ।
śākāhāro vratī tiṣṭhet saptaśākāni sādhave ।।4 5 ।।
dvijāya saptakāyātha dadyādannaṃ ca dakṣiṇām ।
dvitīye'hni pāraṇāṃ ca kuryātpāpaharaṃ vratam ।।46 ।।
mārgasya śuklasaptamyāṃ mitravratamudāhṛtam ।
adityāṃ kaśyapājjajñe mitro nāmā divākaraḥ ।।47।।
tasya vrataṃ sopavāsaṃ sotsavaṃ kāryamuttamam ।
pūjanaṃ vidhinā kārya madhuraṃ bhojayet sataḥ ।। 48 ।।
suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjecca tato vratī ।
pāraṇāṃ tu pare prātaḥ kuryānnatvā raviṃ punaḥ ।।49।।
kṛtvaivaṃ vratamevātra sūryalokaṃ prayāti vai ।
yaḥ kopi vratakartā'tra satkule janmavān bhavet ।।1.272.50 ।।
pauṣaśuklasya saptamyāṃ vrataṃ cābhayanāmakam ।
dharāsthito vratī sūryaṃ trikālaṃ pūjayettathā ।।5 1 ।।
sopavāso bhaveccānyān brāhmaṇān sapta bhojayet ।
kṣīrānnaṃ modakān prasthamitān dadyād dvijātaye ।।52।।
dakṣiṇāṃ bhūyasīṃ pṛthvīṃ suvarṇaṃ vā'rpayed vratī ।
viprāścāśiṣa evā'smai dadyurabhayadāstathā ।।53 ।।
abhayākhyaṃ vrataṃ tvetat sarvasyā'bhayadaṃ smṛtam ।
mārtaṇḍākhyaṃ vrataṃ caitanmārtaṇḍaṃ pūjayed vratī ।।54।।
māghe tu kṛṣṇasaptamyāṃ vrataṃ sarvāptināmakam ।
ādityapūjanaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam ।।55।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ bhojyā: santaḥ prage tataḥ ।
pāyasānnaistoṣaṇīyā dakṣiṇābhiḥ phalādibhiḥ ।।56 ।।
visṛjya ca tato'dyāt sa vratī ceyādabhīpsitam ।
etatsarvāptidaṃ nāma vrataṃ vai sārvakāmikam ।।57।।
māghaśuklasya saptamyāmacalākhyaṃ vrataṃ matam ।
upoṣaṇaṃ vidheyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ syādacalaṃ dhruvam ।।58 ।।
trilocanaḥ pūjanīyastrilocanānvito haraḥ ।
trilocanājayantīyaṃ sarvapāpaharā kṛtā ।।59।।
rathīyasaptamīyaṃ vai cakravartitvadāyinī ।
hastiyuktarathasthaṃ śrīsūryaṃ sauvarṇamarcayet ।।1.272.60 ।।
bhāskarīsaptamī ceyaṃ prātaścātra vratī svayam ।
arkasya ca badaryāśca sapta sapta dalāni vai ।।6 1 ।।
nidhāya mastake snāyāt saptajanmādyaśāntaye ।
putrapradavrataṃ tvetatkartavyaṃ putramicchatā ।। 62।।
tasya sūryo bhavetputraḥ svāṃśena bhṛśatoṣitaḥ ।
pare dine samupoṣya prātarhomaṃ samācaret ।।6 3 ।।
dadhyodanaṃ payaścāpi bhojayetpūjayet sataḥ ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ putraṃ prāpnuyādvai cirāyuṣam ।। 64।।
phālgunaśuklasaptamyāṃ vratamarkapuṭaṃ caret ।
arkapatrairyajet sūryamarkapatrāṇi bhakṣayet। ।।65।।
arkanāma japecchaśvadarkavratamidaṃ matam ।
dhanaputrasutāsmṛddhipatipatnīpradaṃ śubham ।।66।।
dharmārthakāmadaṃ sarvapāpanāśakamityataḥ ।
kāryaṃ yajñavrataṃ tvetatsarvasaukhyasulabdhaye ।।67।।
bhāskarārādhanaṃ sarvakāmanāsampradaṃ bhavet ।
tasmātsarvāsu saptamītithiṣvarkaṃ prapūjayet ।। 68 । ।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kalaśāropaṇaṃ tathā ।
pañcāmṛtaiḥ snapana cāvāhanādyupacārakam । । 69 ।।
naivedyaṃ taṇḍulapuṣpāṃjalivisarjanāntakam ।
sarvaṃ yathāvidhaṃ kuryād vrate vai vratakṛt sadā । । 1.272.70 । ।
udyāpanaṃ mahatkuryād bhojayed bālakānsataḥ ।
dānaṃ homo japo bhaktiḥ śrīhareśceti vai dhruvam । ।7 1 ।।
kartavyaṃ vratinā yena harestoṣo bhaved bahuḥ ।
bhuktirmuktirbhaveccāpi vratapūrṇaphalaṃ bhavet । । 72 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikasaptamīvrateṣu dikpālavratajāhnavīvratanimbasūryavratendra-
sūryavratavivasvadabhiṣekavratā'vyaṃgaśītalāsaptamīcandrābharaṇavrataśubhaphalasaptamīśākavratamitrārkajayantīmārtaṃḍābhayavratasārvakāmikāptivratatrilocanā
jayantībhāskarīsaptamīputrapradā'rkapuṭavratādinidarśananāmā dvāsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 272 । ।
