śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha lakṣmi! kathayāmi tvaṣṭamīnāṃ vratāni te ।
yāni kṛtvā bhuktimuktimāpnuyāt padmaje vratī ।। 1 । ।
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu caitrasya pārvatījanmasadvratam ।
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhāśokatoraṇamaṇḍitam । । 2 । ।
kṛtvātra sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ tasya madhyagām ।
sauvarṇīṃ pārvatīṃ nyasya pradakṣiṇaśataṃ caret ।। 3 । ।
pūjayet ṣoḍaśavastuśreṣṭhopadādibhojanaiḥ ।
nīrājayedrathe sthāpayitvā śrāṃgārikaṃ caret । । 4 । ।
gītavādyādibhirbhaktaiḥ kāryo yātrāmahotsavaḥ ।
gṛhe gṛhe prapūjyā taṇḍulalājājalaiḥ phalaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
saubhāgyadravyakuṃkumakajjalābharaṇādibhiḥ ।
nārīkelaphalenātha kalaśenāpi vardhayet ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ mahotsavapūrvaṃ jale vā mandire'tha vā ।
ānayitvā pūjayettāmārārtrikamathā''caret । । 7 ।।
bhojayitvā ca deveśīṃ vidhinā tāṃ visarjayet ।
dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi bālābhyo'mbarabhojanam ।। 8 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī saubhāgyaṃ labhate śubham ।
kanyā vrataṃ paraṃ kṛtvā rājñīpadamavāpnuyāt ।। 9 ।।
atraivā'śokakalikā'ṣṭakasyā'danamācaret ।
evaṃ prāśanakartustu na śoko jāyate kvacit ।। 1.273.10 ।।
mahāṣṭamīti saiveyaṃ kartavyā sopavāsikā ।
pārvatyāḥ pūjanaṃ visarjanāntaṃ kāryameva ca ।। 11 ।।
vaiśākhasya sitāṣṭamyāmathopoṣaṇamācaret ।
durgāṣṭamīti sā proktā'parājitāṃ tu pūjayet ।। 12।।
naivedyaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ dadyād dānāni vai tadā ।
kumārīrbhojayeccāpi navamyāṃ pāraṇāgrataḥ ।। 13 ।।
vratī jyotirvimānastho'parājitākṛpāvaśāt ।
svargalokeṣu vicared bhuktimuktiyuto bhavet ।। 14।।
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇāṣṭamīprāptau kuryāt trilocanavratam ।
kailāse saṃvaset kalpaparyantaṃ bahumānitaḥ ।। 15।।
jyeṣṭhaśuklāṣṭamīprātardurgāṃ śuklāṃ prapūjayet ।
śuklādevīprasādena kailāsaṃ labhate vratī ।। 16।।
āṣāḍhadhavalāṣṭamyāṃ devīṃ sampūjayed vratī ।
naivedyaṃ śarkaropetaṃ dadyāt kanyāśca bhojayet ।। 17।।
suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ datvā visṛjyā'dyāt svayaṃ vratī ।
etadvrataṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā durgālokamavāpnuyāt ।। 18।।
nabhaḥśukle tathāṣṭamyāṃ durgāṃ sampūjayed vratī ।
bhojayed vividhairannairvisarjayed vidhānataḥ ।। 19।।
pāraṇāṃ ca tataḥ kuryād vrataṃ santativardhanam ।
bhādramāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ daśāphalamiti vratam ।।1.273.20 ।।
sopavāsaṃ prakuryādvai pūjanaṃ śrīharestathā ।
tulasyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāyā dalairdaśabhirarcayet ।।21 ।।
kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathā'nantaṃ govindaṃ garuḍadhvajam ।
dāmodaraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ padmanābhaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।।22।।
etairvai nāmabhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā dine dine ।
homaṃ kuryācchatamaṣṭottaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanāmataḥ ।।23 ।।
juhuyāccaruṇā puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ śarkarayā tathā ।
evaṃ daśadinaṃ kuryādācāryaṃ pūjayettataḥ ।। 24।।
sauvarṇe vā'nyapātre tu sauvarṇaṃ tulasīdalam ।
pratimāṃ kānakīṃ cāpi nidhāya gurave'rpayet ।। 25।।
gopradānaṃ prakuryādvai vastrālaṃkāraśobhanam ।
daśāhaṃ dugdhapākaṃ ca pūrikāśca nivedayet ।।26।।
svayaṃ prasāda gṛhṇīyāt viprān sādhūँśca bhojayet ।
vratānte daśasādhubhyaḥ pratyekaṃ daśa pūrikāḥ ।।27।।
dadyādevaṃ daśābdaṃ tu kṛtvā vratamanuttamam ।
sarvānsvargānanubhūya kṛṣṇasāyujyamāpnuyāt ।। 28 ।।
naraḥ kṛṣṇapārṣadaḥ syānnārī kṛṣṇapriyā bhavet ।
naitādṛśaṃ vrataṃ tvanyat kṛṣṇasāyujyakṛdbhavet ।। 29 ।।
bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamī kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīvrataṃ purā ।
upavāsena tatkartuḥ saptajanmāghanāśanam ।। 1.273.30 ।।
upavāsī tilaiḥ snātvā nadyādau vimale jale ।
mandiraṃ śodhayet samyaṅ mṛjākṣālanalepanaiḥ ।। 31 ।।
raṃgairnānāvidhaiścitraistoraṇaiḥ śobhayed dhvajaiḥ ।
navīnāँśca vitānādīn badhnīyād rūpakāṇi ca ।। 32 ।।
siṃhāsanaṃ bhagavataḥ pūjopakaraṇāni ca ।
sammārjayed dīpikāśca kuryādāstaraṇaṃ navam ।। 33 ।।
pūjānaivedyavastrādi vratī sampādayettataḥ ।
sabhāmaṇḍapamadhye vā mandirasyā'grato'thavā ।। 34।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ kadalīstambhaśobhitam ।
vastravicitrasatpuṣpapallavaiḥ kalaśairyutam ।। 35 ।।
phaladīpāvalīmālācandanādivirājitam ।
dhūpitaṃ kārayettaṃ ca tanmadhye kalaśaṃ nyaset ।। 36 ।।
tasyopari nyasetpātraṃ tāmraṃ tasyopari sthitām ।
haimīṃ vastrayugacchannāṃ pratimāṃ śrīhareḥ śubhām ।। 27।।
pādyādyairupacāraiśca pūjayed vratakārakaḥ ।
maṇḍape sūtikāgāraṃ devakyā vidadhīta ca ।। 38 ।।
tatra vai devakīṃ bālakṛṣṇena sahitāṃ tathā ।
yaśodāṃ gokule kuryāt sutāyuktāṃ manoharām । । 3 9। ।
vasudevaṃ ca nandaṃ ca gopān gopīśca gāstathā ।
vṛṣān vatsān vatsatarīḥ sauvarṇān kārayed vratī ।। 1.273.40 ।।
maṇḍape sthāpitān dikṣu vidikṣvapi samarcayet ।
vādayet tūryavādyāni maṃgalāni ca gāpayet ।।4 1 ।।
snānapūjādikaṃ mūrte kṛtvā tvārārtrikaṃ caret ।
paṃcāmṛtairardharātre snāpayecchuddhavāribhiḥ ।। 42 ।।
vāsobhūṣāratnahārān śobhanān paridhāpayet ।
kuṃkumakesarāgurucandanakusumāni ca ।। 43 ।।
hārāpīḍāँścāvataṃsān pauṣpāṃśca tulasīsrajaḥ ।
dhūpadīpāँstataḥ kṛtvā mahānaivedyamāharet ।।44।।
ajamāँśca tathā śuṇṭhīṃ dhānyākān śarkarāṃ ghṛtam ।
pañcacūrṇī raupyapātre naivedyaṃ vinivedayet । । 45। ।
pūrīpāyasasaṃyāvaghṛtapakvādi cārpayet ।
jalaṃ samarpayed dadyāt tāmbūlaṃ mukhaśodhanam । ।46। ।
nārīkelaphalaṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ tulasīdalam ।
tato nīrājayet kṛṣṇaṃ caturviṃśatirūpiṇam ।।47।
arghyaṃ dadyāt kṣamāṃ prārthya svāpayitvā vratī tataḥ ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryācchṛṇuyāttatkathānakam ।।48 ।
tadā pibed vratī kṛṣṇacaraṇāmṛtamuttamam ।
saśarkaraṃ dadhiṃ kiṃcinmātraṃ pañcāmṛtaṃ graset ।। 49 ।।
tataḥ prabhāte snātvaiva pūjayed bālakṛṣṇakam ।
kṣīraṃ bhaktaṃ śarkarāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa nivedayet ।।1.273.50 ।
narānāryastatastatra dadhikṣīraghṛtāmbubhiḥ ।
kurvīran krīḍanaṃ tvagre lepakṣepaṇasecanaiḥ ।।।5 1 ।।
snātvā sādhūn bhojayecca sādhvīrbālāँśca bālikāḥ ।
viprān bhaktān bhojayecca dīnāndhakṛpaṇānapi । । 52।
dakṣiṇāṃ pradadedaśnīyāt svajanaiḥ prasādikam ।
prātaḥ sāyaṃ pūjanānte vratinā pālane hariḥ ।।53 ।
āndolanīyo'nudinaṃ yāvadbhādradvitīyakam ।
dārāpatyasuhṛdbhṛtyairevaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ naraḥ ।।54।
sākṣād golokamāpnoti vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ।
trilokyāṃ vai vrataṃ caitatsadṛśaṃ nāsti yatparam ।।55 ।
kṛtena yena labhyeta koṭyaikādaśakaṃ phalam ।
dānānyatra pradeyāni rājayogyāni padmaje । ।56।।
yathāśakti yathāvastu kāryaṃ kārṣṇaṃ vrataṃ priye ।
bhādrapadasitāṣṭamyāṃ rādhikājanma nirmitam ।।57।।
bhagavantaṃ tathā rādhāṃ raktavastrāṇi dhārayet ।
madhyāhne rādhikāmūrtiṃ sakṛṣṇāṃ pūjayed vratī ।।58 ।
laḍḍukān mauktikān dadyānnaivedye'pi phalānyapi ।
yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhavet svasya tattat samarpayed vratī ।।59 ।
rādhikājanmapadyāni gāpayed gopikādibhiḥ ।
ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā suvāsinīśca bhojayet ।। 1.273.60 ।
mūrtyarpaṇaṃ ca gurave kṛtvā bhuñjīta vai vratī ।
upavāsaṃ ca vā kuryād dadyādraktāmbarāṇi vai ।। 61 ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī rādhāparikare vaset ।
kṛṣṇapatnī sadā bhūtvā kṛṣṇasaukhyaṃ sadā'rjayet ।। 62।
dūrvāṣṭamīvrataṃ caitatkartavyaṃ vratinā tathā ।
dūrvārūḍhasthale śaṃbhubāṇaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī ।।6 3 ।
gandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpairdadhyakṣataphalādibhiḥ ।
dūrvābhiḥ pūjayeccāpyarthayed dūrve'mṛte sadā ।।64।
yathā śākhāpraśākhābhirvistṛtā'si mahīstare ।
saubhāgyaṃ vistṛtāṃ dehi santatiṃ cā'jarāmarām ।।65।
viprān sādhūn bhojayitvā śaṃbhuṃ visṛjya vai vratī ।
vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ prakurvīta nārī bhāgyavatī bhavet । । 66 । ।
evaṃ puṇyā pāpaharā santatideyamaṣṭamī ।
dūrvāṃ na pūjayed yā sā vidhavā syāt trijanmasu । । 67 । ।
jyeṣṭharkṣasaṃyutā ceyaṃ jyeṣṭhāṣṭamī vratātmikā ।
mahālakṣmyā vrataṃ caitaditaḥ ṣoḍaśavāsarān । । 68 ।।
punarvasupraparyantaṃ kālāṣṭamyavadhiṃ dhruvam ।
kartavyaṃ vratinā dakṣe kare badhvā tu ḍorakam । । 6 9 । ।
ṣoḍaśagranthisahitaṃ guṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutam ।
nityaṃ prapūjayellakṣmīṃ tata udyāpanaṃ caret । । 1.273.70 ।।
vastramaṇḍapikāṃ kṛtvā sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।
kalaśaṃ deyasya dīpaṃ ca kṛtvottārya ca ḍorakam । । 71 । ।
kuṃbhā'dhastat sthāpayitvā lakṣmyāścatuḥsumūrtikāḥ ।
snapanaṃ kārayetpacāmṛtaiśca salilairvratī । ।7 re । ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśādyaiḥ pūjayitvā prabhojayet ।
niśi jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāccandre'rghya saṃpradāpayet । ।7 3 ।।
kṣīrasāgarasaṃbhūta mahālakṣmīsahodara ।
annauṣadhiprado me'stu śrīkhaṇḍārghyaṃ gṛhāṇa me ।।74।।
kṣīrodārṇavasaṃbhūte kamale kṛṣṇasatpriye ।
viṣṇuvakṣaḥsthalāvāse bhava me sarvakāmadā । ।75 । ।
ekanāthe jagannāthe gopālasya priye'vyaye ।
kambhare trāhi māṃ devi! kṛṣṇamātaḥ śivaṃ kuru ।।76 ।।
evaṃ prārthya mahālakṣmīṃ sampūjya bhaktayoṣitaḥ ।
bhojayitvā juhuyācca bilva padmakapāvasaiḥ । । 77।।
samittilaghṛtaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiśca vividhaistathā ।
viṣṇave candane tālapatraṃ mālāṃ tathā'kṣatān । । 78 । ।
dūrvāṃ kausuṃbhasūtraṃ ca yugalaṃ śrīphalaṃ tathā ।
tulasīṃ śarkarāṃ laḍḍūn dugdhasāraṃ tilān yavān ।।7 9 । ।
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ ceti dadyāddharaye ṣoḍaśa ।
mahālakṣmyai tathā dadyācchūrpeṇācchādya śūrpake । ।1.273.8 0 ।।
lakṣmyai nārāyaṇāyā'pi prasamarpya vratī svayam ।
visarjayetpūjanaṃ ca vrataṃ tadvai samāpayet । । 81 । ।
catasraḥ pratimā dadyāccaturviprebhya eva vai ।
ṣoḍaśasuvāsanībhyo dadyāt ṣoḍaśavastukam ।। 82 । ।
miṣṭānnairāśayitvā tāḥ saṃvisṛjet sadakṣiṇāḥ ।
paścāttu pāraṇāṃ kuryād vratī tvevaṃ vratena vai । । 8 3 । ।
koṭyadhīśo bhavelloke lakṣmīloke vasetpunaḥ ।
ciraṃ bhogān prabhuṃkte vai kaṃbharālakṣmyanugrahāt ।।84।।
eṣā śokāṣṭamī proktā'śokapūjanamācaret ।
ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ramāṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ ।। 85। ।
yatra kutrāpi janma syādaśokaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ ।
āśvine tu site'ṣṭamyāṃ durgāvratamupoṣaṇam । । 86 ।।
ekabhaktaṃ ca vā pūjāṃ kuryāttvetadvidhānataḥ ।
sarvato vibhavaṃ labdhvā modate divi devavat ।।87 ।।
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīkāle karakākhyaṃ vratṃ smṛtam ।
putrecchubhiḥ pūjanīyaḥ umeśo niśi sarvathā । ।88 । ।
dānaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇasya candrodaye nīrājayet ।
vratī prātaḥ pūjayitvā tataḥ kuryāttu pāraṇām । ।8 9 ।।
kārtikakṛṣṇapakṣasyā'ṣṭamyāṃ śrībhagavadvratam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jajñe gopālakaṃbharāgṛhe । । 1.273.90 । ।
devāśca munayaḥ sarve tadā'kurvanmahotsavam ।
vimānāni samāruhyāgatā darśanalālasāḥ । । 91 ।।
puṣpādibhistadā divyairvardhayāmāsurādarāt ।
tadā vai maṇḍapaḥ kāryaḥ prātareva mahārhaṇaḥ । । 92 ।।
saudhamadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastanmaṇḍape tadā ।
sauvarṇaḥ sthāpanīyo'tra sarvatobhadramaṇḍale । । 93 । ।
ghaṭe paṃcasuratnādiphalapallavaśobhite ।
sthālyāṃ tilānvitāyāṃ vai pūjanīyo hariḥ svayam ।। 94 ।।
śriyā yuktastathā pitrā mātrāyukto mahāprabhuḥ ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi tvayā sākaṃ mamārcanaṃ pramuktidam । । 95 । ।
sampatkaraṃ sarvasaukhyapradaṃ sarvepsitapradam ।
tatkartavyaṃ yoṣitā vā nareṇāpi vratārthinā । । 96 ।।
āvāhanāt samārabhya pañcāmṛtajalādikaiḥ ।
snapanaṃ vastrabhūṣādidhāraṇaṃ śobhanādikam । । 97 । ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyārārtrikadakṣiṇādikam ।
stavanārādhanātāmbūlā'danajalamarpayet । । 98 । ।
sarvaśāstramayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarasvatīnivāsinam ।
sarvadevakṛtā''vāsaṃ śrīramādikṛtālayam ।। 99 । ।
prabhālakṣmīpārvatīmāṇikīnāthaṃ smarettathā ।
dadyād dānāni bahudhā jāgaraṃ sotsavaṃ caret । । 1.273.100 । ।
prātaḥ snātvā pūjayitvā bhojayitvā visarjayet ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajayantikam । । 101 । ।
patnīṃ patiṃ sutāṃ putraṃ gāṃ dhanaṃ svarṇamityapi ।
kṣetraṃ ca bhavanaṃ yānamārogyaṃ vindati vratī ।। 102 । ।
vidyāṃ sattāṃ mahākīrtiṃ pūjyatāṃ sarvasampadaḥ ।
vratenā'nenā''pnuyādvai svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati । । 10 3।।
kālabhairavajanmāpi kālāṣṭamīti saiva hi ।
pūjanaṃ tasya yogyopacāraiḥ kāryaṃ vratārthinā ।। 104 । ।
śaṃkaraḥ kālarūpo'yaṃ saṃjāto bhairavaḥ svayam ।
vratino bhairavādīnāṃ bhayaṃ naiva hi jāyate ।। 105 । ।
kārtike dhavale gopāṣṭamī bodhyā'tra vai gavām ।
pūjāṃ gogrāsamevāpi godānaṃ gopradakṣiṇam ।। 106 । ।
kuryāt kṛṣṇo'bhavadgopaścārayāmāsa gā yataḥ ।
govratena sadā lakṣmīrgṛhe rasātmikā vaset ।। 107 ।।
mārgasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vai darbhamithunakaṃ vratam ।
anaghāmanaghaṃ nāmnā kṛtvā darbhamithunakam ।। 108 ।।
sutāsutasamāyuktaṃ sthāpayed gomayādibhiḥ ।
lepite bhūtale gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayecca tat । । 109 ।।
bhojayitvā ca dāmpatyaṃ visṛjellabdhadakṣiṇam ।
naro nārī vrataṃ kṛtvā''pnuyātputraṃ sutāṃ sukham ।। 1.273.110 । ।
atraiva kālabhairavajayantīvratamācaret ।
atha mārgasitāṣṭamyāṃ durgāvrataṃ ravermatam ।। 111 ।।
kāryaṃ kālavrataṃ pūjāhomadānasubhojanaiḥ ।
kālabhairavasānnidhye sajāgaramupoṣaṇam ।। 112 ।।
kṛtvā vai duḥkhadaṃ karma nāśamāyāti tadbalāt ।
atha pauṣasitāṣṭamyāṃ śrāddhamaṣṭakasaṃjñitam ।। 113 । ।
pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ varṣaṃ kulasantativardhanam ।
kartavyaṃ vidhinā sarvaṃ madhyāhnottarameva ha ।। 1 14। ।
śivapūjā prakartavyā bhuktimuktipradā yataḥ ।
māghasya kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vai bhadrakālīvrataṃ caret । । 115 । ।
pūjayed vairivṛndaghnīṃ sarvakāmapradāyinīm ।
aṣṭamyāṃ māghaśuklasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ 116 ।।
divyakāśyāṃ cakārāvataraṇaṃ brahmalokataḥ ।
navamyāṃ sa parāvidyāsaṃcāraṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ । । 117 । ।
avatāravrataṃ vidyāvrataṃ kāryaṃ dinadvayam ।
pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastukṛtaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇakam ।। 118 । ।
dugdhasāraṃ prabhuṃjyācca vidyāṃ bhuktiṃ vratī labhet ।
māṇikīṃ pārvatīṃ lakṣmīṃ prabhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayet । । 119 । ।
kṛṣṇena sahitāḥ sarvāḥ prasannāḥ paṭṭayoṣitaḥ ।
nayanti puruṣaṃ nārīṃ svakaṃ dhāma parākṣaram ।। 1.273.120 ।।
phālgune tvasitāṣṭamyāṃ bhīmādevīvrataṃ matam ।
bhīmāyāḥ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।। 121 ।।
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ phālgunasya śivaṃ śivāṃ samarcayet ।
śītalāṃ pūjayeccāpi pūrvakṛnmiṣṭabhojanaiḥ ।। 1 22।।
digambarāṃ rāsabhasthāṃ mārjanīkalaśānvitām ।
visphoṭanāśinīṃ devīṃ jale japedatandritaḥ ।। 123 ।।
tasya tu śītalā devī syād visphoṭakaśāntidā ।
śītalāyā vratakarturvarṣaṃ śāntimayaṃ bhavet ।। 1 24।।।
caitrasyā'dhavalāṣṭamyāmṛṣabho'haṃ babhūva vai ।
kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ viṣṇorvratinā puṇyadaṃ param ।। 125।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikāṣṭamīvrateṣu pārvatījayantīdurgāṣṭamīdaśāhaphalavrata-kṛṣṇāṣṭamīrādhāṣṭamīṭrūrvāṣṭamījyeṣṭhāṣṭamīkaṃbharālakṣmī jayantīdurgāvratakarakāvrataśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhagavajjayantīkālāṣṭamīgopāṣṭamīdarbhavrataśrāddhāṣṭamī-
bhairavāṣṭamīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāśyavataraṇa vratavidyāvratapaṭṭarājñīkṛtapūjanavrata- bhīmādevīvrataśītalāṣṭamīṛṣabha-jayantyādivratānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃ
nāma trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।273 ।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
kathayāmi vatsarasya navamīnāṃ vratāni tai ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yāni kṛtvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca vindati ।। 1 ।।
caitrasya dhavale pakṣe rāmajanmavrataṃ matam ।
śrīrāmanavamī kāryā sotsāhā bahupuṇyadā ।। 1 ।।
upoṣyā sā'thavā kāryaṃ tvekabhaktaṃ janeḥ param ।
maṇḍapaḥ sumahān kāryaḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।। 3 ।।
kārayitvā ghaṭaṃ nyasya mūrtiṃ sthālyāṃ nidhāpayet ।
mukuṭādi dhanurbāṇau bhūṣaṇādi ca dhārayet ।। 4 ।।
pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastukṛtaṃ nīrājanādikam ।
naivedye kaisaraṃ bhaktaṃ śarkarāṃ dadhi pāyasam ।। 5 ।।
dadyācca jāgaraṃ kuryātpare'hni dānamācaret ।
gobhūtilahiraṇyādi dadyādvai gurave vratī ।। 6 ।।
viprānsādhūँśca santarpya vratī kurvīta pāraṇām ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ viṣṇorvrajet saḥ paramaṃ padam ।। 7 ।।
asyāmeva tithau harijayantīvratamityapi ।
kartavyaṃ dharmabhavane harikṛṣṇo vyajāyata ।। 8 ।।
asminneva dine bhadrakālī tu yoginīvarā ।
śaṃkareṇā'bhiṣiktā sā sarvāsāmādhipatyake ।। 9 ।।
idaṃ mātṛvrataṃ proktaṃ bhairaveṇa samanvitāḥ ।
catuḥṣaṣṭistu yoginyaḥ saṃpūjyāścaṇḍikānvitāḥ । । 1.274.10 । ।
vaiśākhe tu ramāṃ devīṃ pūjayeddhariṇā'nvitām ।
bhuktimuktipradāṃ putravittasaubhāgyadāṃ śubhām ।। 11 ।।
ekabhuktaṃ navamyāstu śuklāyā vratamatra vai ।
kartavyaṃ pūjanādyaṃ ca dānaṃ sauvarṇavastunaḥ । । 12 ।।
jyeṣṭhaśuklanavamyāṃ tu devīmumāṃ sumaṃgalām ।
taponiṣṭhāṃ pūjayedvai vrataṃ naktaṃ mataṃ śubham ।। 13 ।।
kumārīrbhojayecchaktyā naikadānāni dāpayet ।
dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śreṣṭhāmaśnīyātpāyasaṃ vratī । । 1 4।।
lakṣmī! māṣāḍhaśuklasya navamyāṃ pūjayed vratī ।
airāvatasthitāṃ caindrīṃ tadvat saṃpūjayed vratī । । 15।।
sa bhaveddevaloke tu bhogavān devayānavān ।
navamyāṃ śrāvaṇe śukle bhārgavī śriyamarcayet ।। 16 ।।
kumārīṃ duḥkhahāṃ lakṣmīṃ yajennaivedyasadrasaiḥ ।
gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpāmbaranepālakambalaiḥ । । 17 ।।
kumārīrbhojayeccāpi duḥkhahāśrīsvarūpiṇīḥ ।
duḥkhahālakṣmyā vratakṛd yāti kṛṣṇālayaṃ param । । 18 ।।
nakulanavamī ceyaṃ kartavyā vratinā tathā ।
bhādraśuklanavamyāṃ tu nandāvratamudāhṛtam ।। 19 ।।
nandā durgāṃ pūjayedvai vidhivaccopacārakaiḥ ।
aśvamedhaphalaṃ labdhvā vratī vaikuṇṭhago bhavet । । 1.274.20 ।।
aduḥkhanavamī ceyaṃ kartavyā duḥkhanāśikā ।
iyaṃ tvavidhavānavamī kartavyā dhavajīvikā ।। 21 ।।
upavāsaśca kartavyaḥ pūjyā lakṣmīḥ satī tathā ।
āśvinaśuklanavamī mahānavamī ceritā ।
navarātravratānte sā yatra durgā prapūjyate ।। 22।।
mahālakṣmīstathā pūjyā devyaḥ pūjyāstu koṭiśaḥ ।
sarvā devyaḥ prapūjyante sadhavā adhavāśca vā ।। 22 ।।
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādiśrāṃgārikadravādibhiḥ ।
yānavāhanabhojyādivilāsādibhirityatha ।। 24। ।
aparāhne śamīpūjā kartavyā prāgdiśi priye ।
sāyaṃ śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ cakraṃ kamalaṃ ca prapūjayet ।। 25।।
khaṅgaṃ dhanuripūn śaktiṃ śūlaṃ carma ca kheṭakam ।
churikāṃ paraśuṃ pāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ vajraṃ cipīṭakam ।। 26 ।।
chatraṃ dhvajaṃ gajaṃ cāśvaṃ haṃsaṃ vīṇāṃ mayūrakam ।
vṛṣabhaṃ mahiṣaṃ granthaṃ tulāṃ gāṃ mastakādikam ।। 27 ।।
yayā yadrakṣitaṃ svasyāstattatsarvaṃ prapūjayet ।
yasyā yacca bali preṣṭhaṃ tasyaitattvarpayed vratī ।। 28 ।।
pūjāṃ rātrau samāpyaiva prātarviṃsarjanottaram ।
vratī pakvānnamadyād vai tathā viprāṃśca bhojayet । । 29 । ।
datvā ca dakṣiṇāṃ paścād datvā dānāni bhāvataḥ ।
vratapūrtiṃ prakuryādvai pratimāṃ nikṣipejjale । । 1.274.30 ।।
evaṃ vratena lokānāṃ mātaraḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ।
tuṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ poṣayanti bālān lokān dayāśrayāḥ ।। 31 । ।
vratī bhuktvā varānbhogānante svargādikaṃ vrajet ।
mātṛlokaṃ satīlokaṃ devīlokaṃ vrajettathā ।। 32 ।।
kārtikaśuklanavamī yā'kṣayā sā vrataṃ mahat ।
devarṣipitṝṇāmaśvatthamūle tarpaṇaṃ caret । । 33 ।।
sūryāyā'rghyaṃ pradatvātha dvijān bālāँśca bhojayet ।
dānaṃ homaṃ japaṃ kuryād dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ vratī ।। 34 ।।
tīrthe ca mandire sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tattvakṣayaṃ bhavet ।
kūṣmāṇḍadānaṃ dadyādvai mukhyaṃ yajñaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 35 ।।
mārge śukle nandinī tu navamīvratamucyate ।
upoṣito vratī nandālakṣmīṃ saṃpūjayettataḥ । । 36 ।।
dadyād dānaṃ tu kanyāyāḥ phalaṃ syādaśvamedhajam ।
pauṣaśuklanavamyāṃ tu mahālakṣmīṃ prapūjayet ।। 37 ।।
māghamāse navamyāṃ tu mahānandāṃ prapūjayet ।
phālgunasya navamyāmānandālakṣmīṃ prapūjayet ।। 38 ।।
atra snānaṃ japo mālā dānaṃ homa upoṣaṇam ।
sarvamakṣayatāṃ yāti kṛṣṇalakṣmīprasādataḥ ।। re 9 ।।
dānaṃ ca vividhaṃ deyaṃ pātre deśe dine śubhe ।
pātraṃ te vacmi kamale yatpātraṃ tārayejjanān ।।1.274.40 ।।
na vidyayā kevalayā tapasā vā'pi pātratā ।
yatra vṛttaṃ dvayaṃ tadvai satpātraṃ bhaktisaṃyutam । ।4 1 ।।
svādhyāyī niyamī dhyānī tapoyukto jitendriyaḥ ।
kṣamāśīlaḥ śāntabhāvaḥ satyavādī dvijo'thavā । । 42 । ।
śāstrābhyāsī śrutasarvo'droho pratigrahā'rataḥ ।
suvrataḥ sādhuśīlaśca pātra bhakto mahattamam ।।43 । ।
sādhavo dhyānaśīlāśca paropakaraṇe ratāḥ ।
punanti darśanaṃ prāptāḥ kiṃ punaḥ saṃgatiṃ gatāḥ ।। 44 ।।
tebhyo datvā yathāpekṣaṃ prāpnuyuḥ paramāṃ gatim ।
śrotriyāya sudharmāya brahmaniṣṭhāya cārpayet । । 45 । ।
kṣamā dayā spṛhā satyaṃ dānaṃ śīlaṃ tapaḥ śrutam ।
etadaṣṭāṃgamatroktaṃ paramaṃ pātralakṣaṇam ।।46 ।।
yājñikaṃ vācakaṃ paurāṇikaṃ cācāryakaṃ gurum ।
kṛṣṇaṃ strīṣu dayāvantaṃ gosevinaṃ supātrakam ।।47। ।
nagnaṃ vṛttihīnaṃ kṣuttṛṭsahitaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।
satkarmakāriṇaṃ pātraṃ taddattaṃ śāśvataṃ tu tat । । 48 । ।
gobhūtilahiraṇyādi pātre dattaṃ sadā'kṣayam ।
kiṃcidvedamayaṃ pātraṃ kiñcit pātraṃ tapomayam ।। 49 । ।
kiñcidbhaktimayaṃ pātraṃ pātraṃ brahmamayaṃ tathā ।
brahmacārī yatiḥ sādhuḥ sādhvī pātraṃ sadā matam ।।1.274.5 0 ।।
etādṛśaṃ samarthaṃ tu dātāraṃ tārayiṣyati ।
nistārayati dātāramātmānaṃ ca svatejasā ।।51 ।।
śataṃ tvabrāhmaṇe dānaṃ dviguṇaṃ brāhmaṇabruve ।
sahasraguṇamācārye hyanantaṃ sādhuṣu smṛtam । ।52 ।।
vedendhanasamṛddheṣu hutaṃ vipramukhādiṣu ।
santārayati dātāraṃ hutaṃ sādhvīṣu sādhuṣu । ।53 ।।
hṛtasvā hṛtasarvasvā dvijāḥ pātraṃ paraṃ matam ।
atithayo'bhyāgatāśca pātraṃ ca kṛśavṛttayaḥ ।।54।।
dharmaratā jñānaratā bhaktiratā dayālavaḥ ।
taporatā bhaikṣajīvāsteṣāṃ dattaṃ mahāphalam ।। 55।।
sannihitaṃ parityajya pātraṃ deśāntarasthitam ।
abhigacchettu dānārthaṃ dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam । । 56 ।।
yasya caiva gṛhe mūrkho dūre cāsti bahuśrutaḥ ।
tatra nātikramo doṣo hūyate'gnau na bhasmani । । 57।।
bālā bhojanapātrāṇi nāryaḥ śṛṃgārapātrikāḥ ।
yuvā tūnnatipātraṃ syāt sevāpātraṃ sthavīrakāḥ ।।58 ।।
sādhavaścārcanapātramannapātraṃ tu bhikṣukāḥ ।
duḥkhitāstu dayāpātraṃ satyapātraṃ suhṛttamāḥ ।।59 ।।
dīnāścopakṛteḥ pātraṃ rakṣāpātraṃ padāśritāḥ ।
svargapātraṃ dānavantaḥ sukhapātraṃ sutuṣṭayaḥ ।। 1.274.60 ।।
vivāhamekhalābandhapratiṣṭhādikratupradam ।
dīnāndhakṛpaṇāpannādiṣu datta tadakṣayam । । 61 ।।
nindake drohake caure śaṭhe ghātini nāśake ।
krūre sakapaṭe serṣye dharmahīne ca pāpini । । 62 । ।
dhūrte chalinyaniṣṭacintake sāsūyake sulau ।
duḥkhade vyasanāḍhye cātatāyini hyabhaktake । । 63 ।।
hutaṃ dattaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
rodityetad dīyamānaṃ kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ।। 64।।
ūṣare bījamuptaṃ vā bhasmanyapi ca yaddhutam ।
apātrake ca yaddattaṃ tannāśe pariṇīyate ।। 65 ।।
yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhavetsvasya svīyaṃ nyāyyaṃ ca yadbhavet ।
pātre tadvai pradātavyaṃ phalakṛd dānameva tat ।। 6 6।।
saśraddhaṃ savidhiṃ pātre dattasyā'nto na vidyate ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vratadānasupātrakam ।।67।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikanavamīvrateṣu śrīrāmajayantīśrīharijayantībhadrakālī-
vrataramāvratomāvrataindrīvrataduḥkhahālakṣmīvratanakulavratanandā-durgāvratā'duḥkhanavamīvratā'vidhavānavamīnavarātranavamī-
vratā'kṣayānavamīkūṣmāṇḍanavamīnandinīnavamīmahālakṣmīmahānandā''nandāpūjāsatpātrādiceti-nirūpaṇanāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikadviśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 274।।


← adhyāyaḥ 274 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)

[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 276 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
athānyāni daśamyāste vratāni kathayāni vai ।
yāni kṛtvā mahālakṣmi! janaḥ svargaṃ śamāpnuyāt ।। 1 ।।
caitraśukladaśamyāṃ vai dharmarājavrataṃ caret ।
snānapuṣpaphalagandhā'mbarabhūṣābhirarcayet ।। 2 ।।
ekabhakto vratī caturdaśaviprān samarcayet ।
bhojayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt kṛtvaivaṃ svargamāpnuyāt। ।। 3 ।।
vaiśākhaśukladaśamītithau viṣṇuṃ prapūjayet। ।
ṣoḍaśabhistūpacāraiḥ śataṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇāḥ ।। 4 ।।
sādhūn viprān bhojayitvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate dhruvam ।
jyeṣṭhaḥ śukladalaṃ hasto budhaśca daśamī tithiḥ ।। 5 ।।
garānandavyatīpātāḥ kanyenduvṛṣabhāskarāḥ ।
daśayogo mahāpuṇyo daśapāpaharo hi saḥ ।। 6 ।।
gaṃgādaśaharā bodhyā gaṃgā svargāt samāgatā ।
gaṃgāyāṃ vidhinā snātvā prayāti harimandiram ।। 7 ।।
aṣāḍhaśukladaśamī manvādyātithirasti yat ।
asyāṃ snānaṃ japo dānaṃ homo vā svargatipradāḥ ।। 8 ।।
śrāvaṇe śukladaśamī sarvāśāparipūrtidā ।
śivārcanaṃ prakuryādvai dānahomādipūrvakam ।। 9 ।।
bhādraśukladaśamyāṃ ca daśāvirbhāvasadvratam ।
tīrthe snānaṃ tathā kuryād devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam ।। 1.275.10 ।।
daśāvatārapūjāṃ ca kuryāt pṛthag vratī svayam ।
matsyaṃ kūrmaṃ varāhaṃ ca narasiṃhaṃ trivikramam ।। 11 ।।
rāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jāmadagniṃ bauddhaṃ kalkiṃ prapūjayet ।
daśamūrtīstu sauvarṇīḥ pūjayitvā'rpayed vratī ।। 12।
dvijāya caikabhaktaṃ ca kṛtvā sādhūn subhojayet ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhuktvā svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt ।। 13।।
āśvinaśukladaśamī vijayādaśamī matā ।
caturgomayapiṇḍāni prātarnyasya gṛhāṃgaṇe ।। 14।।
cakrarūpeṣu madhye'tra vāsudevasukarṣaṇau ।
pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ ca pūjayeccaturo'pi hi ।। 15 ।।
sapidhānāsu pātrīṣu gomayīṣu catusṛṣu ।
klinnaṃ dhānyaṃ saraupyaṃ ca dhṛtvā śuklāmbarā''vṛtam ।। 16।।
saṃpūjyā'kṣatapuṣpādyairnamaskurvīta vai tataḥ ।
madhyāhne bhojayedbālān miṣṭamadyāttathā vratī ।। 17।।
athā'parāhṇe pūrvasyāṃ śamīmūlasthamṛttikām ।
gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ nītvā saṃpūjyāpi vidhānataḥ ।। 18।।
kṣatriyaścet svakaṃ sainyaṃ sajjīkṛtya ca sarvathā ।
nirgatya pūrvadvāreṇa grāmādbahiranākulaḥ ।। 1 9।।
śatrupratikṛtiṃ tatra nirmitāṃ patrakādibhiḥ ।
manasā kalpitāṃ tāṃ ca svarṇapuṃkhaśareṇa saḥ ।।1.275.20 ।।
vidhyediti bhṛśaṃ prītaḥ prāpnuyāt svagṛhaṃ tataḥ ।
paścād yuddhaṃ prakuryācced vijayī syānna saṃśayaḥ ।।21 ।।
dhanaṃ jayaṃ mahārājyaṃ sutagogajavājinaḥ ।
ajāvikamiha dadyādante svargagatiṃ tathā ।
śrīrāmaḥ prasthitaścādya vijayāyotsavaṃ caret ।।22 ।।
daśamyāṃ kārtike śukle sārvabhaumavrataṃ caret ।
ekabhukto vratī tatra niśīthe'pūpakādibhiḥ ।।23।।
daśa dikṣu baliṃ dadyād gṛhādvāpi purād bahiḥ ।
gośakṛlliptabhūbhāge maṇḍale'ṣṭadale vratī ।। 24।।
balidānaṃ prakurvīta vadannaitādṛśaṃ tadā ।
yanme pūrvagataṃ pāpamindro dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।। 25 ।।
yanme vahnigataṃ pāpaṃ vahnirdhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।
yanme dakṣagataṃ pāpaṃ yamo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।।26 ।।
yanme nairṛtigaṃ pāpaṃ rakṣo dhunotu ceṣṭakṛt ।
yanme paścimage pāpaṃ yādo dhunotu ceṣṭakṛt ।। 27।।
yanme vāyugataṃ pāpaṃ vāyurdhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।
yanme saumyagataṃ pāpaṃ yakṣo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।। 28।।
yanme tvīśagataṃ pāpaṃ ceśo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।
yanme ūrdhvagataṃ pāpaṃ brahmā dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।।29।।
yanme'dhaḥsaṃgataṃ pāpaṃ nāgo dhunotu ceṣṭadaḥ ।
evaṃ datvā baliṃ dikṣu vidikṣu ca vratī tataḥ ।।1.275.3 0 ।।
kṣetrapālāya tadbāhye kṣiped balimatandritaḥ ।
śeṣarātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gṛhaṃ samāgataḥ ।। 31 ।।
prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya lokapālāँstato dvijān ।
dvādaśā'bhyarcya saṃbhojayitvā dadyācca dakṣiṇām । । 32 ।।
itthaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lakṣmi! bhogān bhuktvaihikān śubhān ।
yugaṃ svargasukhaṃ bhuktvā sārvabhaumo nṛpo bhavet । 33 ।।
mārgaśukladaśamyāṃ tvaśvinīkumāramarcayet ।
dhanvantariṃ pūjayeccārogyaṃ bhavati sarvadā । । 34 । ।
pauṣaśukladaśamyāṃ tu viśvedevān samarcayet ।
kratuṃ dakṣaṃ vasūn satyaṃ kālaṃ kāmaṃ muniṃ gurum । । 35 । ।
vipraṃ rāmaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpān samarcayet ।
darbhāsaneṣu sannyasya dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ । । 36 ।।
ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ saṃpūjayitvā tān visarjayet ।
vratī lokadvayasaukhyabhoktā bhavati sarvathā ।। 37।।
māghaśukladaśamyāṃ vai tvāṃgirasānsamarcayet ।
ātmā hyāyurmano dakṣo madaḥ prāṇo gaviṣṭhakaḥ । । 38 ।।
dattaḥ satyaśca varhiṣmān daśā'rcayet suvastubhiḥ ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśādyairmūrtīrdadyād dvijātaye ।। 39 । ।
āṃgirasānparān lokānāpnotyevaṃ vratī vrate ।
phālgunaśukladaśamītithau yamān prapūjayet ।। 1.275.40 ।।
yamaśca dharmarājaśca mṛtyuścaivāntakastathā ।
vaivasvataśca kālaśca sarvabhūtakṣayastathā । ।4 1 । ।
audumbaraśca dadhnaśca nīlaścaiva vṛkodaraḥ ।
parameṣṭhī tathā citraścitraguptaścaturdaśa । ।42 ।।
pūjayettān bhojayecca tarpayecca tilāṃbubhiḥ ।
tataḥ sūryāya cārghyaṃ ca dadyādvai tāmrapātrataḥ ।।।43 ।।
raktacandanasammiśratilā'kṣatayavāṃbubhiḥ ।
bhojayed vāḍavān paścād vratī bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ । ।44।।
evaṃ vratī dharmarājaprasannatāmavāpya ca ।
atra bhogānparān bhuktvā dehānte viṣṇudhāmabhāk ।। 45 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadaśamīvrateṣu dharmarājavrataviṣṇuvratagaṅgādaśaharā-manvāditithisarvāśāpūrtivratadaśāvatārapūjāvijayādaśamīsārvabhaumavratā''rogyavrataviśvedevāṃgirasa-yamavratādipradarśananāmā pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 275 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 275 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 276
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 277 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
prāk kathitāni te lakṣmi! hyekādaśīvratāni yat ।
tāni tridinasādhyāni sampūrṇāni vratāni vai । । 1 । ।
tyajeccatvāri bhuktāni padmaje vai dinatraye ।
ādyantayorekamekaṃ madhyame dvayameva ca ।। 2 ।।
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrānnaṃ caṇakānkodravāँstathā ।
śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithunaṃ ।। 3 ।।
daśamyāṃ daśa vastūni varjayettu vratī sadā ।
dyūtakrīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam ।। 4 ।।
parāpavādaṃ paiśunyaṃ steyaṃ hiṃsāṃ tathā ratim ।
kopaṃ hyanṛtavākyaṃ ca hyekādaśyāṃ vivarjayet ।। 5 ।।
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ viṇmlecchabhāṣaṇam ।
vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune । । 6 ।।
aspṛśyasparśamityetān dvādaśyāṃ daśa varjayet ।
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ kṛtvā'pi vratamācaret ।। 7 । ।
śrāvaṇaśuklaikādaśyāṃ pavitraṃ haraye'rpayet ।
haimaṃ raupyaṃ kauśeyajaṃ kṣaumaṃ kauśaṃ kārpāsajam । । 8 ।।
ṣaṣṭyādhikatriśatatantujaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pavitrakam ।
sādhāraṇaṃ trisūtrotthaṃ madhyamaṃ tu yatheṣṭakam । । 9 ।।
uttamaṃ śatagranthi ṣaḍtriṃśadgranthi kaniṣṭhakam ।
śreṣṭhamājānulambi kaniṣṭhaṃ nābhispṛśaṃ matam ।। 1.276.10 ।।
pūjanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ramayā saha ।
kurvīteha sukhī devā vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpnuyātparam ।। 11 ।।
dvādaśyāmapi gurave śrīkṛṣṇāyāpi cārpayet ।
pavitrāṇi tu ramyāṇi sukhasampatkarāṇi hi ।। 12 ।।
atha bhādrapade māsi śuklaikādaśikādine ।
dānilīlāṃ hareḥ kuryāt kālindyāṃ nāvi tu prabhoḥ ।। 13 ।।
dadhi nītvā vikrayārthaṃ yāntīrgopīrayācata ।
karaṃ dāṇamiti tasya tadā padāni gāpayet । । 1 4।।
naivedye ca dadhiṃ bhaktaṃ dadyāt kṛṣṇāya vai vratī ।
kaṭidānaṃ dadhidānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya prakalpayet ।। 15 ।।
atha kārtikaśuklaikādaśyāṃ dharmārcanotsavaḥ ।
dharmajanmanimitto madhyāhne kāryo vratārthinā । । 16 ।।
svarṇamūrtiṃ racayitvā sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।
maṇḍapāntargate tāmre ghaṭe nidhāya pūjayet ।। 17 ।।
caturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ catuṣpādaṃ sitāmbaram ।
śvetavarṇaṃ kare dakṣe mālāṃ vāme ca pustakam ।। 1 8।।
dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve vyavasāyaṃ sumūrtakam!
vāmapārśve sukhaṃ nyasya sānnidhye bhaktimeva ca ।। 1 9।।
pūjāpātraṃ dhṛtavatīṃ pūjayed bhāvato vratī ।
ṣoḍaśakairupacāraiḥ pūjayitvā'tha bhojayet ।।1.276.20 ।।
visarjayenniśi kṛtvā jāgaraṃ pūjanaṃ prage ।
dadyād dānāni cānyāni dharmabhaktibalaṃ bhavet ।।।2 1।।
dharmeṇa saha tatpatnya śraddhādyā vai trayodaśa ।
dakṣaputryaḥ susaṃsthāpyā bhojyāḥ pūjyā vidhānataḥ ।।22।।
dharmasyemā dharmapatnyaḥ śraddhā śāntirdayā gatiḥ ।
medhā tuṣṭistathā puṣṭirmaitrī lajjā kriyonnatiḥ ।।23।।
mūrtibuddhirdivyarūpā nāmāntareṇa vāpi tāḥ ।
suvarṇamūrtayaḥ kāryāstāsāṃ vaṃśo'pi vistṛtaḥ ।।24।।
pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa paralokaṃ samicchatā ।
tannimittāni dānāni pradeyānyuttamānyapi ।।25।।
ityekādaśikāsādhyaṃ tapo vrataṃ vratī caret ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajed yadyadiṣṭaṃ tatsarvamāpnuyāt ।।26।।।
ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ vratānyuktāni prāgyathā ।
vidhivat tadvratānyatra kṛtau grāhyāṇi sarvathā ।।27।।
udyāpanāni sarveṣāṃ kartavyāni vidhānataḥ ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajet kartā naro nārī napuṃsakam ।।।28।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ekādaśīpālyaniyamapavitrāropaṇavratadānilīlāvratadharma-
jayantyādivratanirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।276 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 276 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 277
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 278 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha lakṣmi! śṛṇu vakṣye dvādaśīnāṃ vratāni te ।
kṛtvā yāni janā yānti śāśvataṃ harimandiram ।। 1 ।।
caitraśukladvādaśīti madanavratamācaret ।
śvetatandulasaṃpūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ phalekṣuśobhitam ।। 2 ।।
vastrayugmayutaṃ svarṇamiṣṭānnasthālikāyutam ।
candanādyarcitaṃ nyasya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale ।। 3 ।।
sthālyāṃ śrīkāmadevasya mūrtiṃ ratisamanvitām ।
sthāpayetpūjayetsarvapuṣparasasugandhibhiḥ ।4 ।।
bhojayecca rājasāni bhojanāni ca pāyasam ।
trayodaśyāṃ prage'bhyarcya visarjayedanaṃgakam ।। 5 ।।
evaṃ varṣaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ śayyāṃ savatsagām ।
svarṇaṃ kāmaṃ ratiṃ dadyād dānaṃ śrīgurave mudā ।। 6 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ pūjayetprārthayettathā ।
prīyatāṃ kāmarūpī me hariḥ saukhyaprado bhava । । 7 ।।
madanadvādaśīvratakartā golokameti saḥ ।
dampatī sukhamāpnoti śāśvataṃ kṛṣṇasevanāt ।। 8 ।।
asyāmeva vrataṃ cānyad bhartṛdvādaśikāvratam ।
maṃḍapaṃ kārayitvā ca sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।। 9 ।।
svāstṛtā sukhaśayyāṃ ca sapuṣpāmupakalpayet ।
ramāyuktaṃ hari tatra sampūjya ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ ।। 1.277.1 0।।
nīrājayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ svāpayedramayā saha ।
vratī jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītavāditrapūrvakam ।। 11 ।।
prātaḥ punaśca sampūjya gandhādyairbhojayecca tam ।
saśayyāṃ śrīhariṃ haimaṃ śrīgurave nivedayat ।। 12 ।।
bhojayitvā dvijān sādhūn visṛjed dakṣiṇāyutān ।
evaṃ vratakṛścātra dāmpatyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet। ।। 13 ।।
saptajanmasu bhuṃkte'tra bhogān svarge stṛto vratī ।
bhartuḥ pūjā prakartavyā patnyā api viśeṣataḥ ।। 14।।
bhartā sākṣād vāsudevaḥ sarvān kāmān dadāti vai ।
daihikaṃ laukikaṃ svargyaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ dadāti saḥ ।। 15 ।।
vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ hariṃ saṃpūjya mādhavam ।
pakvānnaṃ sajalaṃ dadyāt। sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ।। 16 ।।
jyeṣṭhaśukladvādaśyāṃ tu prasaṃpūjya trivikramam ।
miṣṭaṃ dadyāt karakādi sarvān bhogānavāpnuyāt ।। 17।।
aṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāṃ vāmanaṃ pūjayetprabhum ।
śākavrataṃ prakuryāccā'lavaṇavratamācaret ।। 18 ।।
dadyād dānāni dharmātmā vastrabhūṣopavītakam ।
pātramudrormikādhānyadhanāni gurave'rpayet ।। 19 ।।
śrāvaṇaśuklādvādaśyāṃ śrīdharaṃ pūjayed vratī ।
śākavrataṃ samāpyaiva dadhivrataṃ samācaret ।। 1.277.20 ।।
kauśeyajaṃ pavitraṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ śrīgurave'rpayet ।
dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi yathāśakti sukhī bhavet ।।2 1 ।।
bhādraśukladvādaśikā vrataṃ vāmanajanmanaḥ ।
pāyasaṃ haraye dadyāt pūjayet bahuvastubhiḥ ।। 22 ।।
suvarṇasya śubhāṃ kuryād vāmanārcāṃ śubhānanām ।
bālā dvibhujāṃ sacchatradaṇḍakamaṇḍalusrajam ।। 23 ।।
maṇḍape sarvatobhadre madhyāhne pūjayettu tām ।
aditiṃ kaśyapaṃ bhaktaṃ baliṃ devān prapūjayet ।। 24।।
pracurājyasitaiḥ kuryānnaivedyaṃ cūrṇalaḍḍukaiḥ ।
phalāhāraṃ caikabhaktaṃ naktaṃ kuryācca vā vratī ।। 25।।
dvādaśī yadi madhyāhne śravaṇarkṣayutā bhavet ।
vaikādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne yadi dvādaśikā bhavet ।।26।।
śravaṇarkṣa milettatra sa yogo viṣṇuśṛṃkhalaḥ ।
bhuktimuttiprado viṣṇusāyujyaprada utsavaḥ ।।27।।
dvādaśyāmāśvine śukle padmanābhaṃ samarcayet ।
bhojayenmadhurānnaṃ ca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।।28।।
śveta dvīpagatiṃ vinded bhogāँśca vāñchitān śubhān ।
kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe ca govatsadvādaśīvratam ।।29।।
kuryādvai vidhinā tatra kārayed gāṃ tu kānakīm ।
savatsāṃ pūjayet puṣpacandanādibhirādarāt ।।1.277.30 ।।
bhojayecchubhavastūni hyarghyaṃ dadyāttu pādayoḥ ।
māṣādivaṭakān dadyād grāsān dadyāttṛṇādikān ।।3 1 ।।
saṃkalpayecca tānnatvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā ।
sarvadevamayi mātarmamā'bhilaṣitaṃ kuru ।।32।।
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhaṃ dehi mātarmātarnamo'stu te ।
pūjayitveti dadyācca gavāṃ dānaṃ yathābalam ।।33 ।।
taddine goḥ payastakraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ vivarjayet ।
sthālīpakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ vaikṛtaṃ ca vivarjayet ।।34।।
mūrtāṃ vatsatarīyuktāṃ pūjayedvā vratī prage ।
phalaṃ tu bahulaṃ syādvai pratyakṣārcanasevanāt ।। 35।।
dvādaśyāmūrjaśuklāyāṃ devaṃ dāmodaraṃ priye ।
pūjayet ṣoḍaśavastūttamaiśca bhojayeddharim ।। 36।।
kuṃbhāँśca salilaiḥ pūrṇān vastrapallavapūjitān ।
pūgamodakaratnādiphalasvarṇādiśobhitān ।।37।।
dadyād dāne vratī prītyā gurave bhojayet sataḥ ।
evaṃ kṛte priyo viṣṇorjāyate'khilabhogayuk ।।38।।
dvādaśyāṃ bhūbhṛtā kāryaṃ nīrājanottamavratam ।
suptotthito jagannātho hyalaṃkāryo'tivastubhiḥ ।।3 9।।
niśāgame navaṃ vahniṃ kṛtvā cābhyarcya mantrataḥ ।
hutvā ghṛtādi munyannaṃ raupyadīpikayā janaiḥ ।।1.277.40।।
gandhapuṣpādyarcitayā vratī nīrājayeddharim ।
kṛṣṇanārāyanaṃ lakṣmīṃ prabhāṃ ramāṃ ca pārvatīm ।।41 ।।
brahmāṇīṃ caṇḍikāṃ gaurīṃ māṇikīṃ maṃgalāṃ tathā ।
ādityaṃ śaṃkaraṃ yakṣaṃ nandāṃ gaṇapatiṃ grahān ।।42।।
mātṝḥ pitṝnnagānnāgānsarvānnīrājayettadā ।
gavāṃ nīrājanaṃ kuryānnamo jayeti saṃvadet ।।43।।
govṛṣāँśca vājinaśca gajāँśca lakṣaṇānvitān ।
rājacihnāni sarvāṇi chatrādīni navāni ca ।।44।।
nṛpaṃ purodhasaṃ mantribhṛtyā'ntaḥpuravāsinīḥ ।
pūjayitvā yathāyogyaṃ śaṃkhatūryādi vādayet । । 45 । ।
alaṃkṛtastato rājā tiṣṭhet siṃhāsane nave ।
sabhā'pi paripūrṇā syāttadā veśyā kulāṃganā । । 46। ।
śīrṣopari narendrasya vardhayedakṣataistathā ।
kusumaiḥ svarṇamudrābhistato nīrājayennṛpam ।। 47।।
śāntimantrāstadā bhūdevānāṃ śravyāstu bhūbhṛtā ।
evameṣā mahāśāntiḥ kartavyā prativāsaram ।।48 ।।
rājñā dhanavatā vāpi varṣamārogyamicchatā ।
yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre pure grāme kriyate śāntiruttamā ।।49 ।।
nīrājanā'bhidhā lakṣmi! tadrogā yānti saṃkṣayam ।
yathākathaṃcitkartavyā saṃkṣiptā'pi janairiyam ।।1.277.5 0 ।।
asyāmeva tu dvādaśyāṃ kṛto vai viṣṇunā purā ।
kṛtayuge tu tulasīvivāho vratamuttamam ।।5 1 ।।
uṣṇīṣaṃ dhārayetkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kusumbhakam ।
hemasūtramayaṃ raktaṃ kañcukaṃ cāpi dhārayet ।। 52 ।।
hemavarṇāṃ śubhāṃ śāṭīṃ tulasīṃ paridhāpayet ।
vastrābharaṇapuṣpādiśṛṃgārāṇi sudhāpayet ।। 53 ।।
guḍaudanaṃ tathā miṣṭaṃ naivedye tu samarpayet ।
kadalyādikṛte ramye maṇḍape tu niśāmukhe ।।54।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇuṃ tulasīṃ pūjayed vratī ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirgodhūlisamaye'rcayet ।।।55 ।।
svarṇāmbaraṃ kaṇṭhasūtraṃ nāsābhūṣāṃ ca kaṃkaṇān ।
haridrāṃ kuṃkumādīni tulasyai vai samarpayet ।।56 ।।
phalāni cāmṛtādīni sekṣudaṇḍāni cārpayet ।
naivedye pītasārāṇi khājakāni samarpayet ।।57।।
kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ vṛndākṛṣṇayoścāntaraṃ paṭam ।
kṛtvā paṭhitvā māṃgalyaṃ vṛndāṃ śrīviṣṇave'rpayet ।।58 ।।
sādhūn sādhvīrbrāhmaṇāँśca bālāṃśca bālikā janān ।
bhojayecchaktito dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca ।।59 ।।
vṛndāvivāhapadyāni gāpayed rasikāni vai ।
ityevamutsavaṃ kuryādakhaṇḍabhāgyarakṣakam ।। 1.277.60 ।।
dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśuklāyāṃ sādhyavratamanuttamam ।
manobhavastathā prāṇo naro yātaśca vīryavān ।। 61 ।।
citirhayo nṛpaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā ।
vibhuḥ prabhurdvādaśaitān sādhyān devān prapūjayet। ।। 62।।
sauvarṇāṃstaṇḍulasaṃkalpitān gandhādyamarpayet ।
bhojayed bahumiṣṭānnaṃ priyānnārāyaṇastviti ।।6 3 ।।
etasyāmeva kartavyamādityadvādaśīvratam ।
dhātā mitro'ryamā pūṣā śakroṃ'śo varuṇo bhagaḥ ।।64।।
tvaṣṭā vivasvān savitā viṣṇurdvādaśa tān ravīn ।
pratimā dvādaśa haimīḥ kṛtvā saṃpūjya bhojayet ।।65 ।।
pratimāsaṃ tu śuklāyāṃ varṣamekaṃ vrataṃ caret। ।
dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi viprān sādhūṃśca bhojayet ।।66 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ prāpya sūryalokaṃ samujjvalam ।
bhuktvā bhogāँściraṃ tatra bhittvā sauryaṃ tu maṇḍalam ।।67।।
māyāpare paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vrajet ।
athātraivā'khaṇḍavrataṃ janārdanasya kārayet ।।68।।
mūrtiṃ kṛtvā ca sauvarṇīṃ janārdanaṃ prapūjayet ।
bhojayet pratimāsaṃ tu varṣamekaṃ vratī tataḥ ।।69।।
naktāśīstāṃ svarṇamūrtiṃ dhenuṃ vatsayutāṃ śubhām ।
arpayed gurave viprān bhojayetpāyasādikam ।। 1.277.70।।
prārthayecchrīhariṃ kṛṣṇa! vrataṃ cākhaṇḍamastu me ।
saubhāgyaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyamārogyaṃ nityamastu me ।।71।।
dadyād dānāni cānyāni paralokārthameva ha ।
kṛtvaivaṃ svarṇayānena yāti viṣṇoḥ padaṃ vratī ।।72।।
pauṣasya kṛṣṇadvādaśyāṃ rūpavratamudīritam ।
daśamyāṃ vidhivat snātvā gṛhṇīyād gomayaṃ vratī ।।73।।
śvetāyā vaikavarṇāyā antarīkṣagataṃ priye ।
aṣṭottaraśataṃ tasya piṇḍikāḥ śoṣayettataḥ ।।74।।
dhṛtvā tāmre mṛtapātre vā rakṣayet havanāya vai ।
ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso viṣṇumabhyarcya kānakam ।।75 ।।
bhojayejjāgaraṃ kuryād dvādaśyāṃ ca prage punaḥ ।
ghaṭe sthālyāṃ hariṃ nyasya pūjayedupacārakaiḥ ।।76।।
kāṣṭhasaṃgharṣaṇajanyamagniṃ sampūjya piṇḍikām ।
ekaikāṃ homayet tilaghṛtādyuktāṃ tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ।।77।।
śatamaṣṭottaraṃ homaṃ dvādaśākṣaravidyayā ।
nāmabhirvā prakuryād bhojayetpāyasapūrikāḥ ।।78।।
ghaṭamūrtiṃ tu gurave'rpayetsaṃbhojayed dvijān ।
natvā virsajayennārī naro vā vratamādarāt ।।79।।
kṛtvaivaṃ labhate rūpaṃ saubhāgyaṃ cottamottamam ।
pauṣaśuvale sujanmadvādaśīvratamathocyate ।।1.277.80 ।।
snātvā prātaśca gośṛṃgavāri pītvā praṇamya ca ।
pradakṣiṇāṃ tathā kṛtvā gṛhṇīyād vārṣikaṃ vratam ।।8 1 ।।
pratimāsaṃ tataḥ śukle dvādaśyāṃ dānamācaret ।
ghṛtaprasthaṃ pradadyācca vrīhiprasthacatuṣṭayam ।।।82।।
yavaprasthacatuṣkaṃ ca hema dviraktikaṃ vratī ।
tilā''ḍhakārdhaṃ dugdhaṃ tu ghaṭapūrṇaṃ samarpayet । । 83 । ।
raupyasya māsamekaṃ ca miṣṭānnāni bahūni ca ।
chatraṃ māṣārdhahemnaśca prastha phāṇitamuttamam । । 84 । ।
candanaṃ palikaṃ vastraṃ daśahastamitaṃ śubham ।
pratimāsaṃ tathā dānaṃ vratī dadyād yathābalam । ।85 । ।
gomūtraṃ jalamājyaṃ vā pibed vratī praśuddhaye ।
dadhiyuktaṃ yavānnaṃ ca tilājyaṃ tu saśarkaram ।। 86 । ।
kṣīraṃ darbhāmbunā yuktaṃ śākaṃ yatheṣṭameva ca ।
bhakṣayetpratimāsaṃ vai varṣaṃ yāvattu bhāvataḥ । ।87 । ।
raveḥ pratimāṃ sauvarṇīṃ tāmrapātre samarcya ca ।
arpayed gurave tāṃ sadhenuṃ ca praṇamettataḥ । । 88 ।।
viprān sādhūँstathāsādhvīrbhojayitvā visarjayet ।
vratavāँllabhate janma dhanāḍhye hyuttame kule । ।8 9 ।।
sarvasmṛddhimaye bhojyabhojanaujaḥpraśālini ।
ratiśaktyāśraye śreṣṭhāṃganāsaṃsevite kule । । 1.277.90 । ।
tato bhogānasaṃkhyātānatra bhuktvā divi dhruve ।
devabhogān prabhuktvaiva vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti śāśvatam । । 91 ।।
māghasya śukladvādaśyāṃ śālagrāmaṃ prapūjayet ।
raupya pātre prasaṃsthāpya suvarṇaṃ tanmukhe'rpayet ।। 92 ।।
bhojayetpāyasānnena khāṇḍājyasahitena ca ।
pradadyād vedaviduṣe vastrābharaṇabhūṣitam । । 93 । ।
vratī yāyāttu vaikuṇṭhaṃ śāśvatānandabhāg bhavet ।
phālgunaśukladvādaśyāṃ sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ । । 94 । ।
abhyarcya gurave dadyād bhojayed bālabālikāḥ ।
vrataṃ kṛtvā jano yāti śrīkṛṣṇamandiraṃ yataḥ ।। 95 । ।
bhuktvā bhogānalabhyāँśca śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute ।
trispṛśānmīlanī pakṣavardhinī vaṃjulī tathā ।। 96 । ।
jayā ca vijayā caiva jayantī cāparājitā ।
etā aṣṭau sadopoṣyā dvādaśyaḥ pāpahārikāḥ । । 97 । ।
ekādaśī nivṛttā cetsūryasyodayataḥ purā ।
tadā tu trispṛśānāma dvādaśī sā mahāphalā । । 98 । ।
asyā vratenāśvamedhasahasraphalamaśnute ।
yadā'ruṇodaye daśamyā viddhaikādaśī tithiḥ । । 99 । ।
tadā tāṃ samparityajya dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet ।
sonmīlitā rājasūyasahasraphaladāyinī ।। 1.277.100 ।।
yadodaye tu savituryāmyā tvekādaśī spṛśet। ।
tadā vaṃjulikā sā tu sarvakratuphalapradā ।। 101 ।।
kuhūrāke yadā vṛddhe syātāṃ sā pakṣavardhinī ।
sarvaiśvaryapradā sā vai putrapautravivardhinī ।। 1 02।।
yadā tu dhavale pakṣe dvādaśī syānmaghānvitā ।
tadā proktā jayā nāma sarvatra jayadā matā ।। 103 ।।
śravaṇarkṣayutā cetsyād dvādaśī dhavale dale ।
vijayā sā sarvatīrthaphaladā sukhabhogadā ।। 1 04।।
yadā syācca site pakṣe prājāpatyarkṣasaṃyutā ।
dvādaśī sā jayantyākhyā vratadānaphalapradā ।। 1 05।।
yadā tu syāt site pakṣe dvādaśī jīvabhānvitā ।
tadā'parājitā jñānamuktidā pāpanāśinī ।। 1 06 ।।
yadā tvāṣāḍhaśuklāyā dvādaśyāṃ maitrabhaṃ bhavet ।
tadā vratadvayaṃ kāryaṃ na doṣo'traikadaivatam ।। 1 07।।
śravaṇarkṣayutāyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ bhādraśuklake ।
ūrje sitāyāṃ dvādaśyāmantyabhe ca vratadvayam ।।108।।
etābhyo'nyatra kartavyaṃ dvādaśyāmekabhuktakam ।
ekādaśyā sahitaṃ vai vrataṃ dvādaśikādinam ।। 1 09।।
pṛthaṅnodyāpanaṃ kāryaṃ dānaṃ kāryaṃ yathādhanam ।
iti vratāni kamale kāryāṇi dvādaśīdine ।। 1.277.110 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadvādaśīvrateṣu madanavratabhartṛdvādaśīmādhavakarakaśā-
kā'lavaṇadadhivratapavitrāropaṇavāmanajayantīpadmanābhavrata-govatsadvādaśīdāmodaranīrājanavratatulasīvivāha-
sādhyādityarūpavratasujanmadvādaśīśālagrāma-haripūjātrispṛśonmīlanīpakṣavardhinī-vaṃjulījayāvijayājayantyaparājitā-
dvādaśyādinirūpaṇanāmāsaptasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 277 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 277 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 278
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 279 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
athāṃ'taṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi trayodaśīvratāni te ।
lakṣmi kṛtvā tu vidhinā vratī bhogyottamo bhavet ।। 1 ।।
caitraśukla trayodaśyāṃ madanaṃ candanātmakam ।
ratyā yuktaṃ pūjayettaṃ vījayed vyajanena ca ।। 2 ।।
sindūrarajanīrāgaiḥ phalake'naṃgamālikhet ।
ratiyuktaṃ sundaraṃ ca puṣpacāpeṣudhāriṇam ।। 3 ।।
vasantaṃ vājivaktraṃ ca vṛṣadhvajaṃ ca kārayet ।
pūjayet gandhasragbhūṣāmbarairbhakṣyaiḥ supānakaiḥ ।। 4 ।।
madanaṃ hyabhavaṃ kāmaṃ manmathaṃ ca ratipriyam ।
anaṃgaṃ cāpi kandarpaṃ pūjayenmakaradhvajam ।। 5 ।।
kusumahetikaṃ cāpi viṣameṣu manobhavam ।
arcayenmālatīpuṣpairhyajādānaṃ vidhāpayet ।। 6 ।।
ajeyaṃ śaninā yuktā sa mahāvāruṇī matā ।
gaṃgāyāṃ yadi labhyet koṭisūryagrahā'dhikā ।। 7 । ।
śubhayogaḥ śatarkṣaṃ ca śanau kāme madhau site ।
mahāmahetivikhyātā kulakoṭivimuktidā ।। 8 ।।
vasantasamaye prāpte varṣe varṣe mahotsavam ।
pratimāsaṃ ca vā kṛtvā yāvadvarṣaṃ samāpayet ।। 9 ।।
tasya kāmaḥ sadā tuṣṭo dadātyatra varāṃganā ।
ratiśaktiṃ paraloke mahāsaukhyamanaṃgajam ।। 1.278.10 ।।
vaiśākhe ca site trayodaśyāṃ kāmavrataṃ smṛtam ।
tatra gandhādibhiḥ kāmaṃ pūjayecca tathā punaḥ ।। 11 ।।
pratimāsaṃ trayodaśyāṃ pūjayed yogyavastubhiḥ ।
varṣānte gāṃ pradadyācca gurave vratasiddhaye ।। 12 ।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ parāṃ siddhiṃ labheta kāmatoṣaṇam ।
svargasaukhyaṃ varāṃ nārīṃ yatheṣṭāṃ bhogadāyinīm ।। 13 ।।
jyeṣṭhaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ daurbhāgyaśamanaṃ vratam ।
snātvā nadyāṃ pūjayedvai dhūpadīpajalādibhiḥ ।। 14 । ।
śvetamandāramarkaṃ vā karavīraṃ ca raktakam ।
nirīkṣya gagane sūryaṃ prārthayecca tato vratī । । 15 ।।
mandārakaravīrārkā bhavanto bhāskarāṃśajāḥ ।
pūjitā mama daurbhāgyaṃ nāśayantu namo'stu vaḥ ।। 16 ।।
ityarcakasya daurbhāgyaṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
trivikramastathā cātra pūjanīyo vratārthinā ।।17 । ।
santuṣṭaḥ pṛthivīṃ dadyātprayacched bhogavaibhavān ।
sāvitrīvratamevātra prakuryādvaibhavecchayā ।। 18 ।।
sāvitrīṃ vedhasaṃ caiva pūjayed bahuvastubhiḥ ।
ghṛtaṃ ca pāyasaṃ pūrikāśca nivedayet vratī ।। 19 ।।
bhuktimuktiphalaṃ nāryāḥ saubhāgyaṃ sarvadā bhavet ।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ paśuṃ putrādikaṃ vai labhate vratī ।। 1.278.20 । ।
aṣāḍhasya sitāṃ trayodaśīṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ ।
ekabhakto vratī saṃkuryādjjayāpārvatīvratam ।। 21 ।।
haimyau raupyau mṛnmayau ca mūrtī hyumāmaheśayoḥ ।
siṃhokṣasthe devagehe goṣṭhe brāhmaṇaveśmani ।। 22।।
sthāpayitvā ca vidhinā tridinaṃ paripūjayet ।
tṛtīyadivase cārpaṇīyau tau gurave mudā ।। 23 ।।
varṣe varṣe vrataṃ kāryamityevaṃ varṣapañcakam ।
bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca ।। 24।।
vratānte dhenuyugmena sahitau tau pradāpayet ।
na vai dāmpatyavicchedau vratinoḥ saptajanmasu ।। 25।।
śrāvaṇasya sitāṃ trayodaśīṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ ।
upavāsī vratī kuryād ratikāmavrataṃ śubham ।। 26 ।।
kanyā voḍhā ca vā tāmre sauvarṇe rājate mṛdi ।
ratikāmau sthāpayitvā gandhādyaiḥ samyagarcayet ।। 27।।
pūjayed dvijadāmpatyaṃ dadyād vastrādidakṣiṇām ।
bhojayecca vrataṃ caturdaśābdaṃ kārayettataḥ ।। 28 ।।
pratime godvayayute śrīgurave'rpayet ।
kāmanādṃ vrataṃ caitatsaubhāgyakāmasaukhyadam ।। 29 ।।
bhādraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ gotrirātravrataṃ matam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ ca vā ।। 1.278.30 ।।
pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayitvā maṇḍale'ṣṭadale tataḥ ।
pīṭhe nidhāya ca puṣpagandhabhūṣābhirarcayet ।। 31 ।।
nīrājayetpradadyācca bhojanaṃ miṣṭamuttamam ।
annodakānvitaṃ pātraṃ dadyācchrīgurave tataḥ ।। 32।।
evaṃ dinatrayaṃ kuryād vratānte gāṃ prapūjayet ।
pañca gāvaḥ samutpannā mathyamāne mahodadhau ।। 33 ।।
tāsāṃ madhye tu yā nandā tasyai dhenvai namonamaḥ ।
gāvo mamāgrataḥ santu gāvau me santu pṛṣṭhataḥ ।। 34।।
gāvo me pārśvataḥ santu gavāṃ madhye vasāmyaham ।
natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tābhyo grāsān pradāpayet ।। 35।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ śrīgurave samarpayet ।
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca ।। 36 ।।
kṛtvā yatphalamāpnoti gotrirātravratāśca tat ।
iṣakṛṣṇātrayodaśyāṃ bālādiśrāddhamuttamam ।। 37।।
kārayet sarvathā yena sadgatiḥ syāttu ghātinām ।
kaleryugasyā''dyatithiḥ procyate puṇyadā vrate ।। 38 ।।
iṣaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ trirātrā'śokasadvratam ।
haimaṃ tvaśokaṃ nirmāya pūjayitvā suvastubhiḥ ।। 39 ।।
upavāsaparā nārī nityaṃ kuryāt pradakṣiṇam ।
aṣṭottaraśataṃ cāthā'rthayenmāṃ kurvaśokitām ।।1.278.40 ।।
tṛtīyehni haraṃ vṛkṣe samarcyā'rbhakabhojanam ।
dadyād dānāni pātrebhyaḥ kanyābhyaḥ kajjalādikam ।।4 1 ।।
evaṃ vratavatī nārī vaidhavyaṃ nāpnuyāt kvacit ।
putrapautrādisahitā syātsvabhartustu vallabhā ।।42।।
ūrjakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ tailadīpaṃ prakāśayet ।
saṃpūjya ca gṛhadvāre bahiḥ saṃsthāpayettadā ।।43 ।।
yamo me prīyatāṃ dīpapradānena stavaṃ caret ।
evaṃkṛte mahālakṣmi! yamakleśo na jāyate ।।44।।
ūrjakṛṣṇatrayodaśyāṃ dhanapūjanamācaret ।
dhanaṃ lakṣmīrdhanaṃ svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ dārāsutādikam ।। 45।।
dhanapūjanataḥ sthairyamāpnuyānnaiva saṃśayaḥ ।
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tatra suvarṇaṃ pūjayed vratī ।।46 ।।
mandiraṃ śodhayetsarvaṃ maṇḍapaṃ bandhayecchubham ।
suvarṇasya harerlakṣmyā mūrtiṃ kuryāt suśobhanām ।। 47।।
tilakaṃ dhārayet kṛṣṇaṃ kuṃkumena suśobhanām ।
suvarṇaprāntaracitaṃ paṭakaṃ śīrṣṇi bandhayet ।।48।।
anyāmbaravibhūṣāśca dhārayed yogyavarṣmaṇi ।
lakṣmīṃ ca haritāṃ śāṭīṃ kausuṃbhīṃ cārukañcukīm ।।49।।
svanyāmbaravibhūṣādi dhārayecchobhayecchriyam ।
yogyaiḥ ṣoḍaśavastvādyaiḥ pūjayecca nivedayet ।।1.278.5 0 ।।
śaṣkulīkhājakādīni miṣṭānnāni śubhāni vai ।
nīrājayet pradīpāँśca bahūn sarvatra kārayet ।।5 1 ।।
navīnapātravastrāṇāṃ dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ।
dinacatuṣṭayaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaprapūjanam ।।52 ।।
kārayettu viśeṣeṇa lakṣmīvāsaḥ sadā bhavet ।
datvā dānaṃ ca gurave vrataṃ paścāt samāpayet ।।53 ।।
ūrjaśuklatrayodaśyāmekabhojī niśāmukhe ।
pradīpānāṃ sahasraiśca satairvā dīpamālayā ।।।54।।
gṛhaṃ ca mandiraṃ prakāśayet kṛṣṇaṃ prapūjayet ।
ṣoḍaśabhistūpacārairnaivedyaiśca rasānvitaiḥ ।।।55।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃ lakṣmīṃ pārvatīṃ māṇikīṃ prabhām ।
haraṃ sūryaṃ hariṃ cāpi pūjayet tuṣṭihetave ।।56।।
niśāmukhe prapūjyainaṃ nīrājanāṃ vidhāya ca ।
visarjayed bhojayitvā vratī svarṇādimān bhavet ।।57।।
mārgaśuklatrayodaśyāmanagaṃ vidhinā'rcayet ।
ratiṃ ca pūjayet prātarbhojayed dvijadaṃpatīm ।।58 ।।
evaṃkṛte vrate syāttu sarvasaubhāgyabhājanam ।
pauṣaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ samarcya kamalāṃ harim ।।59।।
ghṛtapātraṃ pradadyācca dvijāya smṛddhisiddhaye ।
dhanadhānyādimān kartā vratasya sukhavān bhavet ।। 1.278.60 ।।
māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ samārabhya dinatrayam ।
śītajalena saṃsnānaṃ niśānte sariti priye ।।6 1 ।।
kuryādārdravāsasaiva devaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī ।
janmāntarādipāpāni naśyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 62 ।।
māghasnānaṃ phalaṃ syādvai nānākāmaprapūrakam ।
prayāge māghamāse tu tryahaṃ snānasya yatphalam । । 63 ।।
nā 'śvamedhasahasreṇa tatphalaṃ labhate bhuvi ।
tatra snānaṃ japo homaḥ pūjanaṃ syādanantakam । । 64 ।।
kalpāditithireṣaiva viśvakarmajayantyapi ।
harirbrahmā svayaṃ viśvakarmaṇo janmavānabhūt । । 65 ।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ kalācitraiḥ praśobhayet ।
viśvakarmāṇimānyasya pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ ।। 66 ।।
nīrājayed bhojayecca dadyād dānāni sūriṇe ।
vādyagānairvratī rātrau jāgaraṃ ca samācaret ।। 67 ।।
prātaḥ prapūjya saṃbhojayitvā stutvā visarjayet ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ śilpī prāpnuyād viśvakarmatām । । 68 ।।
dhanadhānyasutāputradārāgosampadādibhiḥ ।
sukhī syāt svakalākīrtiṃ labhetātra paratra ca । । 69 ।।
phālgune kṛṣṇapakṣe ca śivarātristrayodaśī ।
mahadvrataṃ śivatejomahalliṃgodbhavātmakam । । 1.278.70 । ।
nirmalaṃ ca nirāhāraṃ vrataṃ kuryāttadādarāt ।
prātaḥ śaṃbhuṃ pūjayedvai satyā saha suhaimayā । । 71 ।।
madhyāhne bhojayetpakvānnāni sarvāṇi bhāvataḥ ।
śatarudraṃ koṭirudraṃ rudrādhyāyāँśca vācayet । । 72 ।।
sarvān rudrāvatārāँśca pārvatyāścāvatāriṇīḥ ।
pūjayet ṣoḍaśavastūttamairbhaṅgāṃ nivedayet ।। 73 ।।
rudrākṣadhatturapuṣpagaṃjādhūmrādidhūpakaiḥ ।
pañcāmṛtajalaiḥ śītacandanādibhirarcayet । । 74।।
sāyaṃ sampūjayetsarvavidhyupacāravastubhiḥ ।
mahābhiṣekavidhinā rudrasūktena śaṃkaram । । 75 । ।
niśīthe pūjayet prītyā sagaṇaṃ bilvapatrakaiḥ ।
mallikākundapuṣpaiśca dhattūrakaravīrakaiḥ । । 76 । ।
dugdhena snāpayed rudramekādaśasvarūpakam ।
dvādaśātmānamapi ca brahmaikarūpameva ca ।। 77।।
dhūpadīpasuvādyādinīrājanādibhistathā ।
nartanaiḥ kīrtanaiścāpi prasādayecchivaṃ śivām ।। 78 ।।
naivedye kṣairavaṭakān miṣṭānnāni śatāni ca ।
śākāni cāranālāni bhājāścāpi phalāni ca ।।79।।
pāyasāni śārkarāṇi caikṣavāṇi dravāṇi ca ।
peyāni coṣyalehyāni bhakṣyāṇi bharjitāni ca ।।1.278.8 0 ।।
kandamūlakaṇādīni patrapuṣpāṃkurāṇi ca ।
dadyādvai śaṃkarāyaiva śivāyai cātibhāvataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
bhasmatriśūlarudrākṣacandravāsukibhūṣaṇam ।
arpayecchaṃkarāyā'tra gāpayet tatpadāni ca ।। 82 ।।
rātrau samutsavaṃ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ janaiḥ saha ।
prātaśca pūjanaṃ kuryād dānāni dāpayedati ।।8 3 ।।
brāhmaṇānnyāsino yogijanān vai yoginīstathā ।
satīḥ sādhvīryatīn sādhūn bhojayetpūjayettathā ।।8 4।।
gurūn pitṝn gaṇān vṛddhānmātṝrbālāँśca bālikāḥ ।
bhojayedarcayet kanyāḥ suvāsinīśca jaṃgamān ।।।85।।
śaivāँśca vaiṣṇavān brāhmān daivyān raudrān prapūjayet ।
mānayed bhojayed viprān dadyād dānāni sarvathā ।।8 6 ।।
visarjayed vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuryāttu havanaṃ tataḥ ।
avabhṛthaṃ śubhaṃ snānaṃ vratī kuryāttu sotsavam ।।87।।
rudrayajñaṃ mahāyajñaṃ kārayeddhanavān vratī ।
evaṃ śivacaturdaśyāṃ bhojanakratumācaret ।।88 ।।
kṛtvaivaṃ pāraṇāṃ kuryād bhuktiṃ muktiṃ phalaṃ bhavet ।
kailāsaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaṃ tvakṣaraṃ labhet ।।89 ।।
phālgune śuklake trayodaśyāṃ dhanapradaṃ vratam ।
prakuryātpūjayedatra kuberaṃ candanādibhiḥ ।। 1.278.90 ।।
pratimāsaṃ pūjanīyaḥ sauvarṇo yakṣarāṭ svayam ।
sanidhiḥ sagaṇo yakṣeśvaraḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।। 91 ।।
bhojanīyaḥ sumiṣṭānnaiḥ savatsā'rcyā'tra gaurapi ।
guruśca pūjanīyo vai bhojanīyaśca sarvathā ।। 9 2।।
miṣṭānnāni ca dānāni pradeyāni dvijātaye ।
evaṃkṛte vrate tvekabhukte prāpyeta vaibhavaḥ ।। 93 ।।
iha loke tathā svarge sarvasmṛddhisamanvitaḥ ।
sukhasāmrājyamāsādya rājarāja ivā'paraḥ ।। 94 ।।
modate saha kauṭumbijanairvai śāśvatīsamāḥ ।
vrate sarvatra naktaṃ vaikabhuktaṃ vā hyupoṣaṇam ।। 95।।
yathāśakti prakartavyaṃ phalāśanajalāśanam ।
dugdhāśanaṃ dadhiprāśanaṃ vā guḍajalāśanam ।। 96।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikatrayodaśīvrateṣu madanavratadaurbhāgyaśamanatrivikramārcana-
sāvitrījayāpārvatīvrataratikāmavratagotrirātravratabālādi-śrāddhakaliyugāditithitrirātrā'śokavratayamadīpa-dānadhanalakṣmīpūjanaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjanā'-
naṃgavratakamalāharipūjanakalpāditithi-viśvakarmajayantīmahāśivarātridhanadavratādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 278 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 278 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 279
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 280 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi caturdaśīvratāni te ।
kṛtvā yāni vratī cātra paratreṣṭamavāpnuyāt ।। 1 ।।
caitrakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ । purā yuge mahotsavaḥ ।
nārāyaṇena vai śriyā vivāhasya kṛto'bhavat ।। 2 ।।
vratinaikāśanenātra kāryaḥ kadalīmaṇḍapaḥ ।
maṇḍale sarvatobhadre sthāpanīyo ghaṭastathā ।। 3 ।।
tanmukhe tilapātraṃ ca vahnikuṇḍasamīpataḥ ।
sthāpanīyaṃ pūjanaṃ ca kṛṣṇalakṣmyostadantare ।। 4 ।।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kartavyaṃ ca nivedanam ।
tato bahūni vādyāni vādayed vai vratī niśi ।। 5 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇalakṣmyoḥ śobhāṃ prakārayettathā ।
śrāṃgārikadravavastravibhūṣāḥ paridhāpayet ।। 6 ।।
lokācāraṃ kārayitvā varamālāṃ samarpya ca ।
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ sarvaṃ vinirvartyā'bhivandanam ।। 7 ।।
vastrāntaraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kārayeddhastasaṃgraham ।
vahnau homaṃ kārayitvā gāpayitvā ca maṃgalam ।। 8 ।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ kārayitvā dattvā ca yautakaṃ tadā ।
lokācāreṇa saṃpūjya vastūnyuttārya mastakāt ।। 9 ।।
pūrṇaṃ homaṃ samāpyaiva gṛhamadhye niveśayet ।
kṛṣṇalakṣmyorbhojanaṃ kārayitvā svāpayed gṛhe ।। 1.279.10 ।।
prātarjāte granthibandhaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ vai viyojayet ।
dadyād dānāni bahūni gobhūhiraṇyakāni vai ।। 11 ।।
bhojayed brāhmaṇān devān munīn sādhūn satīstathā ।
bālakān bālikādīnān kṛpaṇāndhān nirāśritān ।। 12।।
bhṛtyāँśca bhikṣukāँścāpyanāthān gurūn mahattamān ।
brahmadhāmasugolokavaikuṇṭhāmṛtadhāmagān ।। 13 ।।
śvetadvīpā'vyākṛtasthān vairājān satyanākagān ।
bradrīgānāgatānmuktān viṣṇupatnīśca devikāḥ ।। 14।।
mātṝśca mānuṣīrnārīrbhojayetsa tvatāँstathā ।
śaṣkulīḥ khājakān ramyān śatacchidrāṇi pheṇikāḥ ।। 15 ।।
ghṛtapūrāँśca revālīḥ pītasārāṇi parpikāḥ ।
piṇḍakān śarka railāśca śārkarāँścaṇakāँstathā ।। 1 6।।
meśubhaṃ śāṭakāँścāpi mohanasthālakāँstathā ।
bharjikān granthakāँścaiva praphullavaṭikāstathā ।। 17 ।।
dugdhasāraṃ pāyasānnaṃ dadhiśrīkhaṇḍamityapi ।
śākāni vividhānyeva mauktikāँścūrṇamodakān ।। 18 ।।
dvidalāśca kvathikāśca rājikārāddhakāँstathā ।
śreṣṭhāni tvāranālāni peyāni takrakāṇi ca ।। 1 9।।
bhojayejjalapānāni kārayenmukhaśuddhikām ।
tāmbūlāni dāpayecca dānāni dāpayettathā ।। 1.279.20 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇalakṣmya1 prapūjya ca visarjayet ।
amāyāṃ tu vratī paścāt kuryādvai bhojanaṃ śubham ।। 21 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kṛṣṇalakṣmyorvivāhasaṃbhṛtam ।
tayoranugrahādatra dāmpatyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet ।। 22 ।।
dhāmni cāpi vratino vai dāmpatyaṃ divyamuttamam ।
śāśvataṃ syāttu goloke śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādataḥ ।। 23 ।।
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ mahālakṣmīvrataṃ matam ।
kāryā tvatra mahālakṣmīyātrā pūjyā vidhānataḥ ।। 24।।
jānakyāḥ śivarājasya pūjanaṃ cātra vai saha ।
kāraṇīyaṃ prabhaktāyā bhaktasyāpi viśeṣataḥ ।। 25।।
naktaṃ kāryaṃ vratinātra jāgaraṃ nṛtyagītibhiḥ ।
bhojyāḥ pūjyāḥ punaḥ prātarvisarjanīyā'tibhāvataḥ ।। 26 ।।
evaṃ samarcanaṃ kṛtvā mahālakṣmyā naro vratī ।
nārī। cāpi dhanadhānyaprajāsaukhyaṃ labheta vai ।। 27।।
atrāpi ca caturdaśyāṃ kuṃkumāgurucandanaiḥ ।
gandhādyairvastramaṇibhiḥ kāryaṃ śivasya pūjanam ।। 28 ।।
vitānadhvajachatrāṇi datvā pūjyāśca mātaraḥ ।
aśvamedhādisatpuṇyaṃ labhate mānavo vratī ।। 2 9।।
atraiva damanārcāṃ ca kārayed gandhapuṣpakaiḥ ।
damanaṃ tu śivāyaivā'rpayet pūjottaraṃ vratī ।। 1.279.30 ।।
suvarṇasya mahāliṅgaṃ pātālāt hāṭakāhvayam ।
samāyātaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vai hāṭakeśvara īśvaraḥ ।। 31 ।।
sa evātra pūjanīyaḥ ṣoḍaśādisuvastubhiḥ ।
snānaśṛṃgāranaivedyapūjānīrājanādibhiḥ । । 32 ।
hāṭakeśastoṣaṇīyo hāṭakaṃ vitareddhi saḥ ।
vratī bhogaprasaṃpūrṇo yāyāt kailāsamuttamam ।। 33 ।
vaiśākhasya tu kṛṣṇasya caturdaśyāṃ niśāgame ।
liṃgamabhyarcayed gandhādyupacāraiśca bilvakaiḥ । । 34।
bhojayetpūjayeccāpi prārthayecca visarjjayet ।
evaṃ śivavrataṃ kāryaṃ dhanasantānamicchatā । । 35 ।
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu narasiṃhacaturdaśī ।
nṛsiṃhajanmanaścātrotsavaṃ sāyaṃ prakārayet । । 36 ।.
ekabhojī copavāsī narasiṃhaṃ suvarṇajam ।
ṣoḍaśādyairupacāraiḥ snānaiḥ paṃcāmṛtādibhiḥ ।। 37।
dhūpadīpasupuṣpaiśca bhojanaiḥ pānacarvaṇaiḥ ।
ārārtrikādibhiścaiva pradakṣiṇāstavādibhiḥ । । 38 ।।
pūjayitvā nṛhariṃ ca sthāpayedvai vratī niśi ।
dānāni vividhānyatra tadā dadyād yathādhanam । । 39 । ।
taptahāṭakakeśāntaṃ jvalatpāvakalocanam ।
vajrādhikanakhasparśe divyasiṃhaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।। 1.279.40 ।।
pīnaskandhakaṭigrīvaṃ kṛśamadhyaṃ kṛśodaram ।
siṃhānanaṃ nṛdehaṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ।। 41 ।।
jvālāmālākulā''sya ca lalajjihvāgradaṃṣṭrakam ।
hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣaḥ pāṭayantaṃ nakhāgrakaiḥ ।। 42 ।।
prahlādaṃ ca kayādhūṃ ca punaḥ prātaḥ prapūjayet ।
bhojayed vividhānnāni nīrājayed visarjayet । ।43 ।।
svayaṃ ca pāraṇāṃ kuryād vratī nṛharitoṣaṇāt ।
nakhadaṃṣṭribhayānmukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।।44 ।।
oṃkāreśvarayātrā ca kartavyātra vratārthinā ।
paṃcāmṛtaiśca saṃsnapya liṃgamālipya. kuṃkumaiḥ ।।45 ।।
naivedyaiśca phalairdhūpairdīpairvastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
ārārtrikādibhirliṃgaṃ paiṣṭaṃ saṃpūjayed vratī ।।46 ।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sa labhate mahādevaprasādataḥ ।
yatkuryāt tadbhavet sarvaṃ jñānamokṣapradaṃ nṛṇām ।।47 ।।
jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ snānayātrārthamuttamam ।
jalamāhārayet tasyādhivāsādisamācaret ।।48 ।।
pūrṇimāyāṃ tajjalena snāpayecchrīhariṃ prage ।
pūjayed vividhairdravyaiḥ kārayedutsavaṃ vratī । ।49 ।।
caturdaśyāṃ divā pañcatapā rātrimukhe'rpayet ।
homadhenuṃ rudravratametatkuryātprayatnataḥ । ।1.279.50 । ।
aṣāḍhe tu caturdaśyāṃ rudraṃ sampūjya vai vratī ।
deśakālārjyavastvādyaiḥ sarvasampadamāpnuyāt । । 51 । ।
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ tu śārṅgiṇe ।
pavitrāropaṇaṃ kuryāllakṣmyai cāthā'rpayettathā । । 52 । ।
naro nārī hariṃ lakṣmīṃ sampūjyāpi vidhānataḥ ।
tayoḥ prasannatālabhyāṃ bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।।53 ।।
bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāmanantavratamuttamam ।
anantākhyaṃ tadā śeṣaṃ tathā nārāyaṇaṃ harim । । 54 । ।
sauvarṇaṃ kārayetpaścātpūjayed vidhinā vratī ।
kārpāsaṃ paṭṭajaṃ sūtraṃ caturdaśasugranthikam । ।55 ।।
kṛtvā'bhyarcya kuṃkumādyairbadhnīyāt sve bhuje vratī ।
nārī vāme pumān dakṣe purāṇaṃ tu kṣipejjale । । ।56 । ।
tato godhūmapiṣṭasya prasthaṃ śarkarayā yutam ।
sampacya saghṛtaṃ svādu tvanantāya nivedayet ।।57। ।
bhojayitvā'rbhakāँścāpi tatastvadyād vratī svayam ।
dvisaptavarṣaparyantaṃ vrataṃ taddakṣiṇāyutam । । 58 ।।
prakuryādāvidāyaṃ vai tata udyāpayed vratī ।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ saptadhānyaiḥ prakalpayet। ।।5 9 । ।
tāmraje kalaśe sthālyāmanantapratimāṃ nyaset ।
pūjayed vidhinā tāṃ ca nīrājayecca bhojayet । । 1.279.60 ।।
gaṇeśaṃ mātṛkāḥ kheṭān lokapālān yajet pṛthak ।
homaṃ ghṛtahaviṣyaiśca kṛtvā pūrṇāhutiṃ caret। ।। 61 ।।
śayyāṃ pratimāṃ dhenuṃ ca dadyācchrīmukhe vratī ।
bhojayitvā'rbhakān sādhūn dakṣiṇābhiḥ pratoṣayet। ।। 62 । ।
daded dānāni bahūni sādhūn sādhvīḥ prabhojayet ।
evamanantavratakṛjjāyate bhuktimuktibhāg ।। 63 ।।
kadalīvratamapyatra kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ।
naro nānyatarannārī raṃbhāṃ vanāntarasthitām ।। 64। ।
snātvā sampūjayed gandhapuṣpadhānyāṃkurādibhiḥ ।
dadhidūrvā'kṣatairdīpairvastrapakvānnasaṃcayaiḥ । । 65 ।।
natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tataḥ saṃprārthayecca tām ।
apsaro'marakanyābhirnāgakanyābhirarcite । । 66 ।।
śarīrārogyalāvaṇyabhūtīn dehi namo'stu te ।
tataḥ kanyāścatasraśca suvāsinīḥ satīśca vā । । 67 ।।
bhojayitvāṃ'śukasindūrakairalaktakajjalaiḥ ।
pūjayitvā samāpyaiva vratī svasya gṛhaṃ vrajet ।। 68 ।।
evaṃ kṛte vrate lakṣmi! labdhvā saubhāgyamuttamam ।
laset svargaṃ vimānena paraṃ lokaṃ tato yajet ।। 69 ।।
parībhiḥ sevitaḥ satye mahānandān prabhujya ca ।
yātyante'kṣaradhāmākhyaṃ divyalokaṃ hareḥ padam ।।1.279.70।।
iṣakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ viṣaśastrāmbuvahnibhiḥ ।
sarpaśvāpadavajrādyairhatānāṃ brahmaghātinām ।।71 ।।
śrāddhaṃ kuryād yathāyogyamekoddiṣṭavidhānataḥ ।
bālān saṃbhojayenmiṣṭaiḥ sādhūn sādhvīśca bhūsurān ।।72।।
tarpaṇaṃ ca gavāṃ grāsān balirdānaṃ śvakākayoḥ ।
kṛtvā''camya vratī svīyairbhuñjīyād bandhubhiḥ saha ।।73।।
evaṃ kṛtvā mahacchrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddhṛtya pūrvajān ।
gacchetsanātanaṃ svargaṃ tvante brahmapadaṃ hareḥ ।।74।।
iṣaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ dharmarājaṃ tu kānakam ।
gandhādyaiḥ samyagabhyarcya bhojayenmiṣṭamuttamam ।।75।।
nīrājayed visarjayeddānaṃ śrīgurave'rpayet ।
vratinaṃ trāyate dharmarājaḥ svargaṃ nayettathā ।।76।।
ūrjakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ tailābhyaṃgaṃ vidhūdaye ।
kṛtvā snātvā'rcayed dharmarājaṃ pratarpayed yamam ।।77।।
pradoṣe tailadīpāँśca dīpayed yamatuṣṭaye ।
catuṣpathe gṛhād bāhyapradeśe sthāpayed vratī ।। 78।।
bhojayennamanaṃ kuryād visarjayet yamādhipam ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ svargaṃ narakādabhayaṃ vrajet ।।79।।
athātraiva caturdaśyāṃ kuryāt hanumadarcanam ।
tailasindūrārkapuṣpasraṅmāṣavaṭakādibhiḥ ।।1.279.8 0।।
arcakānāṃ putrapautrā vṛddhimeṣyanti puṣkalām ।
ante vairājalokāँśca prāpsyanti naiṣṭhikāñcitān ।।8 1।।
bhūtapretapiśācāditāmasānāṃ prasādhanam ।
rājasānāṃ ca devānāṃ mantrāṇāmapi sādhanam ।।82।।
laukikānāṃ sāttvikānāṃ viṣāgnijaḍakāriṇām ।
āveśānāṃ ḍākinīyoginīnāṃ ca prasādhanam ।।83।।
śmaśānavāsināṃ cāpi sādhanaṃ bhairavārthinām ।
prakuryāccātra rātrau ca yathādeśaṃ vidhānataḥ ।।84।।
tattadvrataṃ baliṃ pūjāṃ japaṃ nāma visarjanam ।
homaṃ kriyāṃ yathātantraṃ kuryādvai kramato vratī ।।।85।।।
ūrjaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ kāśyāṃ śrīśaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
cakāra vidhinā snātvā śreṣṭhaṃ pāśupataṃ vratam ।।86।।
tataścātra mahāpūjāṃ liṃge gandhādibhiścaret ।
droṇapuṣpairbilvadalairarkapuṣpaiśca ketakaiḥ ।।87।।
puṣpaiḥ phalairmiṣṭapakvairnaivedyairvividhairapi ।
ekabhukto vratī śaṃbhostoṣāt kailāsamāpnuyāt ।।88 ।।
brahmakūrcavrataṃ cātra kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā ।
pañcagavyaṃ pibed rātrau prātardevāँśca tarpayet ।।8 9।।
brāhmaṇāँstoṣayitvā ca bhuñjītāpi vratī svayam ।
sarvapāpāni naśyanti brahmakūrcavratād dhruvam ।। 1.279.90 ।।
kapilāyāstu mūtraṃ vai kṛṣṇāyāstu śakṛttathā ।
śvetāyāstu payo grāhyaṃ raktāyāstu śubhaṃ dadhi ।। 91 ।।
karburāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ kuśādbhistāni melayet ।
tatpānena tu pāpāni naśyantyārdrāṇi mūlataḥ ।। 92 ।।
pāṣāṇavratamapyatra naktaṃ kṛtvā kṛtaṃ bhavet ।
gaurīṃ gandhādibhiḥ prā'rcyā'rpayed ghṛtena pācitam ।। 93 ।।
piṣṭaṃ pāṣāṇasadṛśaṃ piṇḍakākāramityatha ।
aiśvaryasukhasaubhāgyasvarūpāṇyāpnuyād vratī ।। 94।।
mārgaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ vṛṣaṃ svarṇaṃ prapūjya ca ।
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryādatha rātrau maheśvaram ।। 95 ।।
pūjayet kamalaiḥ puṣpairgandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ।
bhojayedbahupakvānnaistato devaṃ visarjayet ।। 96 ।।
dadyād dānāni gurave bhojayettu sataḥ satīḥ ।
evaṃ śivavrataṃ kṛtvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।। 97।।
atraiva ca harirbrahmā śivo datto'trisaṃbhavaḥ ।
ekībhūya trayo devā babhūvurdatranāminaḥ ।।98 ।।
anasūyāṃ tathā'triṃ ca dattātreyaṃ ca kānakān ।
kṛtvā tu maṇḍape bhadramaṇḍale ca ghaṭopari ।। 9 9।।
sthālyāṃ saṃpūjayet samyag bhojayecca visarjayet ।
dadyād dānāni sarvāṇi vratī vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyāt ।। 1.279.100 ।।
pauṣaśuklacaturdaśyāṃ virūpākṣavrataṃ caret ।
snātvā śivaṃ virūpākṣaṃ pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ ।। 101 ।।
bhojayettarpayecchaṃbhuṃ vidhitaḥ saṃ sarjayet ।
dānaṃ dvijātaye datvā kailāse modate vratī ।। 10 2।।
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yamatarpaṇamīritam ।
sūryodayātpūrvakāle snātvā saṃtarpayed yamam ।। 103 ।।
tiladarbhāṃbubhiḥ paścād bhojayedannamuttamama ।
visarjayed dvijān sādhūn bhojayed bhakṣayed vratī ।। 1 04।।
phālgunasya kṛṣṇacaturdaśī śaṃbhuniśāvratam ।
nirjalā śivarātristu tadopoṣyā subhāvataḥ ।। 105 ।।
jyotirliṃgaṃ pārthivaṃ vā mūrtimantau śivāśivau ।
gandhādyairbilvapatrādyairnaivedyai_ pānasadrasaiḥ ।। 106 ।।
pūjayedbhojayennīrājayedvisarjayennamet vratī ।
vratī vrataprabhāveṇa kailāsaṃ samavāpnuyāt ।। 10 7।।
phālgunasya śuklacaturdaśī durgāvrataṃ matam ।
ekabhukto vratī durgāṃ pūjayedbhojayettathā । । 108 ।।
nīrājayennamedvisarjayet kailāsabhāgbhavet ।
udyāpanaṃ vratānāṃ tu kartavyaṃ phalamicchatā ।। 109 ।।
kuṃbhāścaturdaśaivātra sapūgā'kṣatamodakāḥ ।
sadakṣiṇāṃ'śukāstāmrā mṛnmayāścā'vraṇā navāḥ । । 1.279.110 ।।
tāvanto vaṃśadaṇḍāśca pavitrāṇyāsanāni ca ।
pātrāṇi yajñasūtrāṇi tāvantyeva hi kalpitāḥ ।। 111 ।।
maṇḍape sarvatobhadramaṇḍale saphalā ghaṭāḥ ।
sthāpanīyāḥ pūjanīyā bhojanīyāśca devatāḥ ।। 112 ।।
visarjanīyā dātavyā gurave dānarūpataḥ ।
bhojanīyāḥ susantaśca sādhvyo viprāśca bālikāḥ ।। 113 ।।
sotsāhaṃ sarvathā kāryamudyāpanaṃ sahomakam ।
sajapaṃ sāṃgamevā'sya phalaṃ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।। 11 4।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣiṃkacaturdaśīvrateṣu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇalakṣmīvivāhamahālakṣmī-
yātrāśivārcanadamanārcanaśrīhāṭakeśvarajayantīnarasiṃhajayantyoṃkāreśvarayātrāsnānayātrājalāharaṇarudravratapavitrāropaṇānanta-
caturdaśīkadalīvratahatādiśrāddhadharmarājapūjananarakacaturdaśī-yamatarpaṇābhyaṃgasnānahanumadarcanabhūtārcanamantrasādhanā-
pāśupatavratabrahmakūrcavratadattātreyajayantīśivarātri prabhṛtivratanirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhika dviśatatamo'dhyāya । ।। 279 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 280
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 281 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi pūrṇimāyā vratāni te ।
yāni kṛtvā naro nārī prāpnuyāt puṇyasampadaḥ ।। 1 ।।
caitrakṛṣṇā'māvāsyā tu manvādistithirasti hi ।
asyāṃ sānnodakaṃ kuṃbhaṃ pradadyāt somatuṣṭaye ।। 2 ।।
kuryācchrāddhaṃ yathoddiṣṭaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave ।
caitryāṃ dhavalapūrṇāyāṃ hanumattithirucyate ।। 3 ।।
pūjanaṃ tailasindūrairvaṭakādibhiruttamam ।
kartavyaṃ tvatra vaiśākhasnānāraṃbho'pi sammataḥ ।। 4 ।।
vaiśākhā'mātithau śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ pitṛtṛptikṛt ।
vaiśākhaśuklapūrṇāyāṃ kūrmajayantikāvratam ।। 5 ।।
kartavyaṃ vidhinā tatra dvibhujaṃ naramastakam ।
kaṭyadhaḥ kūrmarūpaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ pūjayet prabhum ।। 6 ।।
bhojayed dugdhasāraṃ ca cāṇakodbhūtamodakān ।
nīrājayed visarjayed dadyāddānāni ca vratī । । 7 । ।
evaṃvratakṛto vāso vaikuṇṭhe bhavati dhruvaḥ ।
dharmarājavrataṃ tvatra kartavyaṃ dharmatuṣṭaye । । 8 । ।
śṛtānnamudakuṃbhaṃ ca dadedgāṃ gurave vratī ।
dharmarājaṃ pūjayecca bhojayecca visarjayet । । 9 । ।
śubhaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ dadyāt sakhuraṃ ca saśṛṃgakam ।
satilavastraṃ saṃdadyāt kuṃbhān svacchajalānvitāna । । 1.280.1 0 । ।
phalāni ca hiraṇyaṃ ca dāne dadyād vratī janaḥ ।
modate satyaloke'yaṃ yāvaccandrārkatārakam । । 11 । ।
ante vaikuṇṭhamāpnoti śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute ।
jyeṣṭhāmā bhāvukā proktā śrīhariṃ bhāvayettadā । । 12 । ।
pūjayetsarvathā rātrau bhojayecca visarjayet ।
jyeṣṭhapūrṇātithau kāryaṃ vaṭasāvitrikaṃ vratam । । 13 ।।
sopavāsā vaṭaṃ siñcet salilairamṛtopamaiḥ ।
sūtreṇa veṣṭayeccaiva saśatā'ṣṭapradakṣiṇam । । 14 । ।
pippalaṃ vā veṣṭayecca sāvitrīṃ prārthayed vratī ।
jagatpūjye jaganmātaḥ sāvitri patidaivate । । 1 5 ।।
patyā sahā'viyogaṃ me vaṭasthe kurute namaḥ ।
iti saṃprārthya sāvitrīṃ bhojayitvā suvāsinīḥ । । 16 । ।
svayaṃ bhuñjyād vratakartrī sā syāt saubhāgyabhāginī ।
atra bilvatrirātrākhyaṃ vrataṃ kartavyamādarāt । ।! 17।।
bilvapatraiḥ śaṃbhurarcyo bilvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ vratārthinā ।
bilvasnānaṃ prakartavyaṃ bilvadruḥ pūjya ityapi । । 18 । ।
bilvādhaḥśayanaṃ kāryaṃ bilvadānaṃ tathā matam ।
evaṃ kṛtvā trirātraṃ vai kailāsaṃ prāpnuyād vratī । । 19 । ।
manvāditithireṣāsti manuḥ pūjyo vidhānataḥ ।
deyaṃ dānaṃ tathā bhojyāḥ santaḥ sādhvyaḥ supuṇyadāḥ । । 1.280.20 । ।
jyeṣṭhābhiṣekasaṃsnānayātrā kāryā'tra vai dine ।
tatrā'bhiṣekavidhinā snapanīyo ramāpatiḥ । । 21 ।।
jalairujjvalapātrasthairnirmalaiśca sacandanaiḥ ।
śaṃkhena snapayet kṛṣṇaṃ mantrairvedānusāribhiḥ ।। 22 । ।
tataḥ pītāmbarāṇyatra dhārayecchrīpatiṃ prabhum ।
uṣṇīṣaṃ pāṭalaṃ caiva bhūṣāśca vividhā api ।। 23 । ।
bhaktaṃ sūpaṃ polikāśca vaṭikāṃ kvathikāṃ tathā ।
vyañjanāni ca naivedye miṣṭapeyānyupāharet । । 24। ।
jalakrīḍanapadyāni śroharestvatra gāpayet ।
visarjayaddhariṃ paścād bhuñjīta vratakṛjjanaḥ । । 25 ।।
hariprasādajaṃ saukhyaṃ śāśvataṃ tena cāpyate ।
aṣāḍhā'mātithau śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ pitṛtārakam ।। 26।।
aṣāḍhasya tu pūrṇāyāṃ gurorvyāsasya pūjanam ।
ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ kartavyaṃ vai yathā hareḥ ।। 27।।
candanā'kṣatatulasīsrakphalāmbarakuṃkumaiḥ ।
bhūṣābhojyasumiṣṭānnottamācchādanavāribhiḥ ।। 28 ।।
dravyaiḥ suvarṇarūpyādikṣetrairdravyādibhistathā ।
guruṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathā''cāryaṃ gurvīṃ cā'bhyarcayed vratī ।। 29 ।।
guroḥ pādāṃguṣṭhajalaṃ pibet svādyaviśuddhaye ।
gururhariḥ svayaṃ proktaḥ svamokṣārthaṃ prasevayet ।। 1.280.30 ।।
guroḥ prasannatāprāptaṃ jñānaṃ vā sevanaṃ vratam ।
mokṣadaṃ sukhadaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhuktivimuktidam ।। 31 ।।
aṣāḍhasyātra pūrṇāyāṃ gopadmavratamuttamam ।
caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadā padmavirājitam ।। 32 ।।
prasannāsyaṃ kaṃjanetraṃ ramāgaruḍaśobhitam ।
svarṇavarṇaṃ surūpaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ bhūṣaṇānvitam ।। 33 ।।
sevitaṃ munibhirdevairyakṣagandharvakinneraiḥ ।

bodhyaiṣā dvāparayugādyā tithirmaṃgalāvahā ।। 146 ।।
phālgune pūrṇimāyāṃ tu holikāpūjanaṃ matam ।
kāṣṭhādisaṃcaye vahniṃ hutvā rakṣoghnamantrakaiḥ ।। 147।।
asṛkyābhayasantrastaiḥ kṛtā tvaṃ holi bāliśaiḥ ।
atastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi bhūte bhūtipradā bhava ।। 148।।
itimantreṇa sandīpya parikramya nayed vratī ।
holikāṃ rākṣasīṃ cemāṃ prahlādabhayadāyinīm ।। 149।।
jvālayanti janā yadvat prahlādena subhasmitā ।
saṃvatsarasya dāho'yaṃ pāpānāmiti holikā ।। 1.280.150।।
śaṃkareṇa kṛtaḥ kāmadāho'yaṃ holikā matā ।
kalpabhedena dāhasya bhidyate tu kathānakam ।। 151।।
dolotsavastathā cātra pūrṇāyāṃ vottare'hani ।
uttarāphālgunīnakṣatrayoge raivatācale ।। 152।।
dolāmāropya kṛṣṇaṃ cārjunaṃ dharmāśraye purā ।
āndolayāmāsuratra devāḥ kāryaḥ sa utsavaḥ ।। 153।।
prātaḥ pūjāṃ prakurvīta naranārāyaṇaprabhoḥ ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmahānīrājanena ca ।। 154।।
vastracandanapuṣpādyaistulasīpatrabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
pāyasaiḥ pūrikābhiśca badarādiphalairapi ।। 155।।
vāsantikaiśca puṣpādyaistathā raṃgagulālakaiḥ ।
pūjayedbhojayeccāpi nīrājayecca raṃjayet ।। 156।।
krīḍāṃ ca kārayed yantraistataḥ prasvāpayet prabhum ।
bhaktān bālān bhojayitvā vratī bhuñjīta vai tataḥ ।। 157।।
evamabhyaṃgakasnānamāmrakusumaprāśanam ।
vasantotsavaramaṇaṃ dhūlivandanamityapi ।। 158।।
manvādyatithikaṃ kuryād vrataṃ vistarato vratī ।
naranārāyaṇaṃ prātaḥ prabodhya pūjayed vratī ।। 159।।
bahūni dadyād dānāni vrataṃ cāpi samāpayet ।
dārāḥ putrān dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ svargaṃ yāyācca mokṣaṇam ।। 1.280.160।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapūrṇimā'māvāsyāvrateṣu śrāddhā'bhāvāsyāmanvāditithi-
hanumajjayantīvaiśākhasnānāraṃbhakūrmajayantīdharmarājavratabhāvukāmā-vaṭasāvitrībilvatrirātravratajyeṣṭhābhiṣekayātrāguruvyāsapūjāgopadma-
kokilāvratacāturmāsyaniyamaśivaśayanadīpapūjānārikelapūrṇimā-ṛgyajuḥśrāvaṇīsāmagaśrāvaṇīrakṣābandhanahayagrīvajayantīśivapavitrā-
ropaṇakuśagrahaṇaprauṣṭhapadyumāmaheśavrataśakravratasarvapitṛśrāddhāmārāsalīlākārtikasnānaśaradvratakojāgaravratalakṣmīpūjādīpotsava-
śāradāpūjā'bhyaṃgasnānadevadīpotsavatripurīpūrṇimā-bhaktijayantīskadadarśanamāghasnānā'mbājayantī-
holidaṇḍāropaṇadvāparāditithipayovratadolo-tsavavasantotsavāmrakusumaprāśanadhūlivandanā-dinirūpaṇanāmā'śītyadhikadviśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 280 ।।
