śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha dvādaśamāseṣu yānyanyāni vratāni ca ।
kartavyānyapi te vakṣye śṛṇu puṇyāni padmaje! ।। 1 ।।
caitramāsasya śuklāyāmekādaśyāṃ tu vaiṣṇavaiḥ ।
āndolanīyo bhagavān lakṣmīyukto mahotsavaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
sugandhipuṣpamayyāṃ tu tasyāṃ ta ghaṭikādvayam ।
āndolayitvā nīrājayitvā cottārayetprabhum ।। 3 ।।
bhojayecca vratī natvā taṃ kṣamāpya visarjayet ।
āṣāḍhe śuklake puṣye rathayātrāṃ samācaret ।। 4 ।।
sāśvaṃ rathaṃ sthāpayecca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāgrataḥ ।
vāsāṃsi rājayogyāni dhārayed bhūṣaṇāni ca ।। 5 ।।
śreṣṭhān haimān śastravaryān khaḍgādīn dhārayetprabhum ।
dadhi bhaktaṃ laḍḍukāँśca bhojayitvā rathe'rcayet ।। 6 ।।
hariṃ nīrājayitvā ca caturvāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
uttārayed rathāt tatra gāpayet kīrtanāni vai ।। 7 ।।
tataśca bhojanaṃ kuryād vratī mokṣapradaṃ vratam ।
āṣāḍhakṛṣṇadvitīyādinādārabhya māsikaḥ ।। 8 ।।
śrāvaṇakṛṣṇatṛtīyāvadhiṃ dolotsavo mataḥ ।
vṛṣarāśeścandrabale kuryād dolāṃ svalaṃkṛtām ।। 9 ।।
nityaṃ navīnavastvādyairnavīnāṃ śrīhareḥ priyām ।
sāyāhne pratyahaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nidhārayet ।। 1.281.10 ।।
nīrājayitvā naivedyaṃ samarpyā''ndolayed vratī ।
dolāpadyāni ramyāṇi gāpayennṛtyamācaret ।। 1 1।।
nabhaḥkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ prapūjyottārayeddharim ।
śrāvaṇaḥ sarvathā māso vrataiśca niyamairyamaiḥ ।। 1 2।।
yāpanīyo viśeṣeṇa bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samicchatā ।
kārtiko'pi tathā neyo vratadānajapādibhiḥ ।। 1 3।।
mārgaśīrṣe dhanūrāśau dhanurlagne ravau gate ।
vidhāyā'bhyaṃgamuṣṇena snapayedvāriṇā harim ।। 14।।
dhārayitvā suvāsāṃsi tadagre'gniṣṭikāmapi ।
nidhāya naityakaṃ kuryācchṛṅgāraṃ saśriyaḥ prabhoḥ ।। 15।।
naivedye modakān dadyānnavanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ।
roṭakaṃ taralāṃ bharjitaṃ vṛntākaṃ samarpayet ।। 16 ।।
kvathikāṃ pāyayet kṛṣṇamadhyayanāya yojayet ।
evaṃ vai māsaparyantaṃ śikṣārthaṃ tūtsavaṃ caret ।। 17।।
pauṣamāse makare ca yadā sūryāyanaṃ bhavet ।
catvāriṃśaddhaṭikā vai puṇyakālo viśeṣataḥ ।। 18।।
dānasnānārcanādyaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tilalaḍḍukāḥ ।
miṣṭānnāni ca deyāni hyanāthebhyo viśeṣataḥ ।। 19।।
gavāṃ grāsādi deyaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ puṇyapradaṃ tathā ।
māghamāse tu pañcamyāṃ vasantotsavamuttamam ।।1.281.20।।
tata ārabhya nityaṃ ca holikāvadhikaṃ sadā ।
kuṃkumaraṃgagulālārpaṇapūjanabhojanaiḥ ।।2 1।।
prakuryāt śvetavāsāṃsi hariṃ navāni dhārayet ।
raṃgān lakṣmīharikṛṣṇavāsassu prakṣiped vratī ।।22।।
gulālaṃ sthalapadmāmbu nikṣipecca punaḥ punaḥ ।
śekharaṃ tvāmrapuṣpāṇāṃ dhārayed bhojayeddharim ।।23।।
kaisarāṇyaṃśukāni śrīkṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca dhārayet
holikāntāṃ ca vāsantīṃ krīḍāṃ gāyettu phālgunīm ।।24।।
athā''virbhāvadivasād yāvatṣaṭdivasāvadhim ।
pālane rohayet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamapi vratī ।।25।।
pāyayet taṃ tu dugdhādi hyāndolayetsagītikam ।
sevayed bālabhāvena muhurnāthaṃ prasādayet ।।26।।
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyādinācchrīkṛṣṇamūrtaye ।
kesarāktaiścandanādyairlepanaṃ māsikaṃ caret ।।27।।
sūryacandragrahāhassu kuryātsnānajapādikam ।
āṣāḍhaśuklaṣaṣṭhyāṃ tu kausuṃbhāmbaramarpayet ।।28।।
haraye sūkṣmasusnigdhatantujaṃ komalaṃ śubham ।
āśvinakṛṣṇapakṣe tu śrāddhaiḥ saṃtarpayet pitṝn ।।29।।।
āśvine śuklapakṣe tu mūlenā''vāhayet tathā ।
pūjayedbhojayeddugdhapākādyaṃ tu sarasvatīm ।।1.281.3 0।।
visarjayecchravaṇena vidvān bhavati vai vratī ।
svajanmadivasaḥ sarvairvardhanīyaḥ samutsavaiḥ ।।3 1।।
dānabhojanavṛddhābhivandanairdevadarśanaiḥ ।
ekādaśīto dvādaśyo mokṣadā harivāsarāḥ ।।।32।।
kartavyā bhojanaidānaiḥ pūjanotsavatarpaṇaiḥ ।
prasīdati hariryaistu prayacchatyabhayaṃ padam ।।33।।
yena kenāpyupāyena prasanno yasya vai hariḥ ।
ihāmutra sukhaṃ tasya puṇyavṛddhirvrataṃ bhavet ।।34।।
dvādaśyāṃ mārgaśuklasya pūjayejjalaśāyinam ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśakaiḥ pauṇḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet ।।35।।
dvādaśyāṃ pauṣaśuklasya pūjayet prayato harim ।
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśakairagniṣṭomaphalaṃ laset ।।36।।
māghadhavaladvādaśyāṃ pūjayenmādhavaṃ prabhum ।
ṣoḍaśādyairupacārairvājapeyaphalaṃ vrajet ।।37।।
phālgunaśukladvādaśyāṃ govindaṃ pūjayejjanaḥ ।
vastuṣoḍaśakaiḥ śreṣṭhairgomedhasya phalaṃ jayet ।।38।।
caitradhavaladvādaśyāṃ viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcayet ।
ṣoḍaśādyupacārairvai syādagniṣṭomapuṇyabhāg ।।39।।
vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ pūjayenmadhumūdanam ।
ṣoḍaśottamasāmagryā tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ।।1.281.40 ।।
jyeṣṭhadhavaladvādaśyāṃ pūjayedvai trivikramam ।
ṣaṭdaśabhistūpacārairnaramedhaphalaṃ bhavet ।।41 ।।
āṣāḍhaśukladvādaśyāṃ vāmanaṃ pūjayed vratī ।
ṣoḍaśākhyopacāraiśca śatāgniṣṭomapuṇyabhāg ।।42।।
śrāvaṇaśukladvādaśyāṃ śrīdharaṃ pūjayed vratī ।
ṣoḍaśā''mitavastvādyairvājimedhasahasrabhāk ।।43।।
bhādradhavaladvādaśyāṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ prapūjayet ।
ṣoḍaśā'bhyupacāraiśca brahmamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।।44।।
āśvinaśukladvādaśyāṃ padmanābhaṃ prapūjayet ।
ṣoḍaśābhyupacārādyairīśamedhasahasrabhāk ।।45।।
kārtikaśukladvādaśyāṃ dāmodaraṃ prapūjayet ।
ṣoḍaśābhyupacārādyairdvyaśvamedhasahasrabhāk ।।46।।
homo japastapo dānaṃ sādhuviprādibhojanam ।
dakṣiṇāprārthanājāgaraṇānītyācared vrate ।।47।।
alpaparikarasyā'lpaṃ viśālasya mahat phalam ।
bhaktiyukte vrate jāte phalaṃ prāpyeta mokṣaṇam ।।48।।
vrataṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kuryādudyāpanaṃ vratī ।
prātaḥ snātvā'mbare śuddhe dhṛtvā bhāle supuṇḍravān ।।49।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed bhavyaṃ viśālaṃ caturasrakam ।
ghaṇṭācāmarakalaśā''darśakiṃkiṇikāyutam ।।1.281.50।।
puṣpamālyadhvajatoraṇavitānāmbarā'ñcitam ।
dīpamālācaturdvārakomalāstaraṇānvitam ।।51।।
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kuryāddhānyādyalaṃkṛtam ।
tasyopari nyaset kuṃbhān dvādaśā'mbuprapūritān ।।52।।
śuklāmbaraiśchāditāँśca pañcaratnasamanvitān ।
tatra saṃsthāpayet haimīṃ rājatīṃ tāmrajāṃ ca vā ।।53।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ tilapātre ghaṭopari ।
athāvāhanamārabhya pūjāṃgāni samārabhet ।।54।।
pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca bhūṣāvastrāṇi dāpayet ।
sugandhacandanādīni prāpayet dhūpadīpakān । ।55।।
śrāṃgārikadravān dadyānnīrājayecca bhojayet ।
pānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadyāt prasvāpayet kṣamāpayet ।।56।।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt prātarhomaṃ samācaret ।
pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ vaisarjanaṃ devasya cārpaṇam ।।।57।।
pāraṇāṃ ca svayaṃ kuryād vrataṃ samāpayed vratī ।
pratimāṃ dakṣiṇāyuktāmācāryāya samarpayet ।।58।।
evamudyāpanakartā vratakartā'tra bhogavān ।
trisaptakulasaṃyukto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।।59।।
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāllakṣmi! vratākhyānaṃ ca vācayet ।
sarvavrataphalaṃ labdhvā tvante yāyāddhareḥ padam ।।1.281.60।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikaprakīrṇakavrateṣu dolāvratarathayātrādolotsava-
śrāvaṇakārtikadhanurmāsamakarasaṃkrāntivasantotsava-pālanārohaṇaholikāpuṣpadolakaisaracandanāmbara-śrāddhasarasvatyutsavadvādaśīvrataphalodyāpana-
prabhṛtinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।28 1 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 281 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 282
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 283 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam ।
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ yāvadduḥkhanibarhaṇam ।। 1 ।।
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ tathā ।
samastakāmaphaladaṃ sarvavrataphalapradam ।। 2 ।।
duḥsvapnanāśakaṃ dharmyaṃ duṣṭagrahanivārakam ।
yena cīrṇena pāpānāṃ koṭirāśiḥ praśāmyati ।। 3 ।।
mārgaśīrṣapūrṇimāyāṃ snātvā brāhme muhūrtake ।
śuddhavastradharaḥ śuddhāsanastvācamya vāgyataḥ ।। 4 ।।
smarannārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ kṛtvā devārcanaṃ tataḥ ।
deśakālādisaṃkalpya lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।। 5 ।।
āvāhayetpūjayeccā''sanādyarpaṇamācaret ।
pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ snapayitvā śṛgāramarpayet ।। 6 ।।
gandhacandanapuṣpādimālādhūpapradīpanaiḥ ।
śṛgārairbhojanaiḥ peyaiḥ phalaistāmbūlagāyanaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
nṛtyastavanabhajanaiḥ kṣamāyācanakaistathā ।
toṣayitvā purastasya sthaṇḍile caturasrake ।। 8 ।।
aratnimātraṃ tvanalaṃ sthāpayettu vidhānataḥ ।
ājyabhāgāntaparyantaṃ kṛtvā puruṣasūktataḥ ।। 9 ।।
varuṇā ca tilaiḥ puṣpairvṛtena juhuyāt phalaiḥ ।
rasaiścānyahaviṣyānnairjuhuyādvai yathābalam ।। 1.282.10 ।।
pāpanāśāya śuddhyādiprāyaścittaṃ samācaret ।
homaṃ samāpya ca japecchāntisūktaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ।। 1 1।।
pūjayecchrīhariṃ samprārthayed vrataprapūrtaye ।
nirāhāraśca pūrṇāyāṃ pāraṇākṛtpare'hani ।। 1 2।।
vartiṣye iti saṃkalpya dadyādardhyaṃ tadendave ।
gṛhāṇā'rghyaṃ śuklapuṣpā'kṣatādyukta kṣapākara ।। 13।।।
namaḥ śuklāṃśave tubhyaṃ lakṣmībhrātre namo namaḥ ।
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau kathākīrtananartanaiḥ ।। 14।।
prātaḥ sampūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ brāhmaṇān bhojayet sataḥ ।
dānādidakṣiṇā dadyād bālān sādhvī prabhojayet ।। 15।।
svayaṃ bhṛtyādibhiḥ sārdha kuryādvai pāraṇāṃ vratī ।
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā kārtikīpūrṇimādine ।। 16।।
udyāpanaṃ mahat kuryān maṇḍapaṃ kārayecchubham ।
maṇḍale sarvatobhadre ghaṭe ratnadalānvite ।। 17।।
tilasthālyāṃ pūjayecchrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtādinā''plavam ।। 18।।
gandhabhūṣāmbarairmālādhūpadīpādinā'rcanam ।
bhakṣyabhojyādinaivedyaṃ miṣṭaśītalavāri ca ।। 1 9।।
samarpayecca tāmbūlaṃ phalādyarpaṇamityapi ।
jāgaraṃ nṛtyagānādi tathā nīrājanādikam ।। 1.282.20 ।।
kṛtvā prasvāpayet kṛṣṇaṃ punaḥ prātaḥ samarcayet ।
ācāryāya dadenmūrti dakṣiṇāṃ bhojayed dvijān ।।।2 1।।
kuryāt tilādibhiścāgnau homaṃ dānāni cārpayet ।
bhojayet sādhusādhvyādīn tilādyarpaṇamācaret ।। 22।।
evaṃ kṛtvā vratī samyak lakṣmīnārāyaṇavratam ।
iha bhuktvā putrapautrakuṭumbasahitaḥ sukham ।। 23।।
bhogāṃśca vividhāँścānte yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ।
yogināṃ durlabhaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoti śrīharīkṣaṇāt ।।24।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dhvajāropavrataṃ te'tra vadāmi yat ।
rājyadaṃ jayadaṃ viṣṇuprītikārakamuttamam ।।241 ।।
devasya śrīhareryadvā tadvibhūteśca mandire ।
dhvajadānaṃ prakuryādyaḥ sa syātpūjyo dyuvāsinām ।। 26।।
hemabhārasahasrasya dānajaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ।
gaṃgāsnānasamaṃ puṇyaṃ śivārcanasamaṃ phalam ।।27।।
tulasyarcāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ dhvajāropaṇato bhavet ।
aho'pūrvamaho'pūrvamaho'pūrvamidaṃ vratam ।। 28।।
sarvapāpaharaṃ sarvapuṇyadaṃ dhvajaropaṇam ।
kārtike vā'nyamāse vā daśamyāṃ sitapakṣake ।।।29।।
snātvā svanaityikī pūjāṃ kṛtvaikāśī bhaved vratī ।
bhuvi svapenniśi smarennārāyaṇaṃ prage punaḥ ।।1.282.3 0।।
ekādaśyāṃ ca vidhinā snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ tataḥ ।
śrīviṣṇoḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā bhojanādisamanvitam ।।3 1 ।।
atha vipraiścaturbhiśca svastivācanamarthayet ।
nāndīśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta dhvajastaṃbhau samānayet ।। 32।।
vastrayutau ca tau kṛtvā gāyatryā prokṣayecca tau ।
sūryaṃ candraṃ vidhātāraṃ dhātāraṃ garuḍaṃ tathā ।।3 3 ।।
dhbajadaṇḍau pūjayecca śuklapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।
kuṃkumacandanagandhairharidrāśarkarādibhiḥ ।।34।।
tato gocarmamātraṃ tu sthaṇḍilaṃ copalipya ca ।
ādhāyā'gniṃ vedamantrairājyabhāgādikaṃ tathā ।। 35 ।।
juhuyātpāyasaṃ dhānyaṃ sājyamaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena viṣṇornāmabhirityapi ।। 36 ।।
irāvatīmanuvākamuccārya juhuyād vratī ।
tataśca vainateyāya svāhetyaṣṭāhutīḥ punaḥ ।।37।।
somo dhenumudutyaṃ ca juhuyācca tataḥ punaḥ ।
sauramantrājjapecchāntisūktāni ca vadettadā ।। 38।।
nirjalaṃ tu vrataṃ kṛtvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret ।
dvādaśyāṃ prātarutthāya snātvā'bhyarcya hariṃ punaḥ ।। 39 ।।
maṃgalavādyagītyādyaiḥ sūktapāṭhastavādibhiḥ ।
dhvajaṃ nayeddhareḥ sthānaṃ namaḥ kuryācca vai punaḥ ।।1.282.40 ।।
devasya dvāradeśe vā śikhare staṃbhasaṃyutam ।
saṃsthāpayed dhvajaṃ samyak sthiraṃ nīrājayeddṛḍham ।। 41 ।।
nārikelaphalaṃ tatra kṣipet sāraṃ prasādakam ।
dadyātsarvebhya evātha viṣṇuṃ śṛṃgārayettadā ।।42 ।।
gandhapuṣpākṣatairdevaṃ dhūpadīpasugandhibhiḥ ।
bhakṣyabhojyādimiṣṭaiḥ sannaivedyaiśca hariṃ yajet । ।43 ।।
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vratī kṣamāpayetprabhum ।
yatra yatra hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa dhvajasya te ।।44।।
śikharasya ca chāyāyā gatistatra ca tatra ca ।
duḥkhadāridryadoṣāṇāṃ vināśaḥ sarvadā bhavet ।।45।।
putrapautrādivistāro dhanadhānyādisampadaḥ ।
ārogyotsāhabhūtyādi vṛddhiṃ yāntūttarottaram ।। 46।।
dhvajaḥ sarvopari te'sti māmapi tattathā kuru ।
dhvajapucchaṃ tu vijñānaṃ dhvajaḥ saccitsukhātmakaḥ ।! 47।।
vaṃśāgraṃ brahmasadanaṃ vaṃśaḥ panthā samarciṣaḥ ।
staṃbhāgraṃ satyasadanaṃ paṭṭikā surabhūmikā ।।48 ।।
ghaṇṭikā jyotiṣāṃ cakraṃ staṃbho dharmaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ।
staṃbhamūlaṃ pūruṣārthāstvadātmastaṃbhine namaḥ ।।49 ।।
yamāmananti vai santa saccidānandavigraham ।
salakṣmīkaṃ prabhuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaje'nvaham ।।।1.282.5 0 ।।
itistutvā named viṣṇumācāryaṃ sadguruṃ dvijān ।
pūjayedbhojayeddadyād dakṣiṇāṃ pāraṇāṃ caret ।।5 1 ।।
paṭo dhvajasya kamale yāvaccalati vāyunā ।
tāvanti pāpajālāni naśyantyeva dhvajārpiṇaḥ ।।52।।
yāvaddināni santiṣṭhed dhvajau vai devatāgrahe ।
tāvadyugasahasrāṇi hareḥ sārūpyamaśnute ।।53 ।।
āropitaṃ dhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā ye'bhinandanti harṣitāḥ ।
teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyanti vajralepasamānyapi ।।54।।
dhvajo dhunvanpaṭaṃ dhunotyarpiṇastvaghasaṃcayān ।
dhvajāropakaro yāti vimānena divaṃ param ।।55।।
purā kṛtayuge tvāsīt sumatiḥ somavaṃśajaḥ ।
nṛpo irikathārakto rājñī satyamatistathā ।।।56 ।।
tāvubhau dampatī nityaṃ hareḥ pūjāparāyaṇau ।
jātismarau jalānnadau dharmakāryāṇi tenatuḥ ।।57।।
ropayati dhvajaṃ rājā dvādaśīdvādaśīdine ।
tasya kīrtiṃ jagurdevāḥ śrutvā vibhāṇḍako yayau ।।58।।
kṛtātithyaṃ muniṃ rājā prāñjaliḥ samuvāca ha ।
bhagavan kṛtakṛtyo'smi bhavadabhyāgamena vai ।।59।।
satāmāgamanaṃ sarvasaukhyārthaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ bhavet ।
yatra satāṃ paraṃ prema tatra syuḥ sarvasampadaḥ ।।1.282.60 ।।
tejaḥ kīrtirdhanaṃ dhānyaṃ putrā vṛddhiṃ prayānti ca ।
śreyāṃsyanudinaṃ tatra yatra syādvai satāṃ kṛpā ।।6 1।।
yo mūrdhni dhārayed bhāvāt mahatpādajalaṃ rajaḥ ।
saḥ snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu yajñāvabhṛthakeṣu ca ।।62।।।
mama dārāśca putrāśca sampat tvayi samarpitāḥ ।
māmājñāpaya śīghraṃ kiṃ supriyaṃ karavāṇi te ।।63।।
śratvā kareṇa rājñaśca spṛṣṭvā śiro vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।
prasannaḥ saṃstadā prāha rājan yaduktavān bhavān ।।64।।
sarvaṃ kulocitaṃ te'sti bahuśreyāṃsyavāpnuhi ।
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśceti catuṣṭayam ।।65।।
mahatāṃ sevayā prāṇī labhate śāśvataṃ sukham ।
svasti te satataṃ bhūyād yatpṛcchāmi taducyatām ।।66।।
pūjā bahuvidhāḥ kṛṣṇatuṣṭidāḥ santi tāsu vai ।
dhvajāropaṃ pradhānaṃ tvaṃ matvā karoṣi taṃ katham ।।67।।
bhāryāpi te sadā nṛtyaparā tatra kathaṃ vada ।
śrutvā rājā tu taṃ prāhā''ścaryakāri purābhavam ।।68।।
ahamāsaṃ purā śūdro mālinīnāmako hyaghī ।
madyamāṃsavyabhicāracauryādikārako'ghṛṇī ।।69।।
hatyākṛt matprajābandhuparityakto vanaṃ gataḥ ।
jīrṇaṃ devālayaṃ viṣṇorāśrayaṃ samupeyivān ।।1.282.70।।
phalamūlāśano nityaṃ varṣāṇāṃ viṃśatiḥ sthitaḥ ।
jīrṇasphuṭitasandhānaṃ tasya sarvamakāriṣam ।।7 1।।
svanivāsāya sā bhūmirmayā liptā susaṃskṛtā ।
vṛkṣāścāropitāstatra cābhisiktāḥ sarojalaiḥ ।।72।।
sandhāya jīrṇavastrāṇi dhvajaścāropito mayā ।
śalākārpaṇakāṇḍaiśca viṣṇubhittiḥ surakṣitā ।।73।।
iyaṃ niṣādo nāmnā tu kokilā bandhutarjitā ।
vindhyādrerdārukasutā tvāyātā daivayogataḥ ।।74।।
puṃścalīyaṃ mayā prāptā patnītvenā'bhirakṣitā ।
devasevāṃ prakurvantau dampatībhāvamāśritau ।।75।।
sthitau varṣāṇi daśa caikadā rātrau parasparam ।
madyapānena mattau ca muditau māṃsabhojanāt ।।76।।
tanuvastrā'parijñānau nṛtyaṃ cakṛva mohitau ।
prārabdhakarmabhogāntamāvāṃ yugapadāsthitau ।।77।।
netumāvāṃ tadā''yātā yamadūtā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
tadā svasevakau matvā viṣṇurdevālayasthitaḥ ।।78।।
svadūtānpreṣayāmāsa śaṃkhacakragadādharān ।
te tūcurbho durācārā yāmyā muñcadhvamarcinau ।।79।।
pūjakau mama bhaktau vai madāśritau vanasthitau ।
śrutvocustāँstadā yāmyā imau vai pāpinau parau ।।1.282.80 ।।
yamena pāpino daṇḍyāstanneṣyāmo vayaṃ tvimau ।
śrutvocurvaiṣṇavāstāँśca pāpā''grahaṃ prakurvataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
etau pāpavinirmuktau hareḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratau ।
hariṇā trāyamāṇau tu muñcadhvamavilambitam ।।82।।
eṣā tu nartanaṃ cakre tathaiṣaḥ dhvajaropaṇam ।
hareḥ saudhā'vanaparau svārthe parārthakārakau ।।83।।
antakāle'pi yannāma śrutvoktvāpi ca vai sakṛt ।
labhate mokṣaṇaṃ svargaṃ kimu śuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ ।।84।।
kṛṣṇasevī yatisevī pāpo'pi yāti vaiṣṇavam ।
muhūrtaṃ vā muhūrtārdhaṃ yastiṣṭheddharimandire ।।85।।
so'pi yāti brahmalokaṃ kimu dvātriṃśavatsarān ।
mārjanalepanajīrṇaśīrṇasandhānakārakau ।।86।।
mandire dīpasalilavṛkṣachāyāvidhāyakau ।
kathametau mahāpuṇyau yātanābhogayoginau ।।87।।
ityuktvā saṃprasahyaiva yāmyapāśān nirasya ca ।
gṛhītvā''vāṃ vimānāgrye yayurviṣṇoḥ sukhaṃ padam ।।88।।
tatra divyān mahābhogān bhuktvā yātau mahīmimām ।
atrāpi sadhvajaṃ rājyaṃ prāptaṃ sevāprasādataḥ ।।89।।
anicchayā kṛtenāpi prāptaṃ rājyaṃ mahatphalam ।
smṛtvā tacca mayā keturanayā nṛtyamarpyate ।।1.282.90।।
icchayā''rādhya govindaṃ prāpsyāvaḥ paramāṃ gatim ।
vivaśe'pi phalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kiṃ punaḥ śraddhayā kṛte ।।91।।
vibhāṇḍakastu tacchrutvā tau praśasya yayau vanam ।
iti jānīhi kamale kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।।92।।
paricaryā tu sarveṣāṃ cintāmaṇisamā matā ।
haribhaktiparāṇāṃ hi sarvakāmaprado hariḥ ।।93।।
idṃ pavitramākhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti paṭhettathā ।
harisevāparo vaktā te'pi yānti parāṃ gatim ।। 94।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇavrataṃ tadudyāpanaṃ devālayadhvajāropaṇalepanarakṣa-
ṇādipuṇyaśālinorapi pāpakarmiṇormālinākhyaśūdraśūdryormaraṇe yamadūtāt mocitayoḥ prāptarājyakayoḥ sumati-
nṛpasatyamatirā×Vr̤M×jñyorvibhāṇḍakaṃ prati vṛttāntakathanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 282 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 283
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 284 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca -
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi vikhyātaṃ haripañcakam ।
nārīnarāṇāṃ sukhadaṃ vrataṃ sarvavratottamam ।। 1 ।।
mārgaśukladaśamyāṃ tu snātvā devārcanaṃ caret ।
pañcayajñān vidhāyāpi tvekabhuktaṃ dinaṃ nayet ।। 2 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ prage snātvā hariṃ pañcāmṛtaistathā ।
tīrthajalaiḥ snāpayitvā'rcayed gandhadravādibhiḥ ।। 3 ।।
āvāhanāt samārabhya visarjanāvadhiṃ kriyām ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyatāmbūladakṣiṇānvitām ।। 4 ।।
pūjātmikāṃ vratī kṛtvā śrīhariṃ prārthayet puraḥ ।
pañcarātraṃ nirāhāro hyadyaprabhṛti mādhava ।। 5 ।।
kariṣye haripaṃcākhyaṃ vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ ca me bhavet ।
ekabhukto daśamyāṃ vai rātrau bhūśayano bhavet ।। 6 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ triṣavaṇaṃ arcanaṃ trinivedanam ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād gītanṛtyakathānakaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
dvādaśyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ trikaṃ caret ।
paurṇamāsyāmapi snānārcananaivedyamācaret ।। 8 ।।
paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā rātrau kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī ।
pañcāmṛtādipūjāṃ tu prakuryāddinapañcasu ।। 9 ।।
dugdhena snāpayed viṣṇuṃ paurṇāyāmatha ṣaṣṭhake ।
tilahomaṃ tiladānaṃ pañcagavyāśanaṃ tathā ।। 1.283.10 ।।
kṛtvā viprān bhojayecca pūjayedvidhivaddharim ।
sādhusādhvīrbhojayecca svayaṃ bhuñjīta bandhubhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ pratimāsaṃ vrataṃ śubham ।
udyāpanaṃ mārgaśīrṣe kāryamaudāryapūrvakam ।। 12।।
śuklapakṣavratasyātra śuklaikādaśikādine ।
nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ tu paṃcagavyaṃ grased vratī ।। 13 ।
puṣpādibhirhariṃ caivābhyarcya dadyād dvijātaye।
pāyasaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ phalānvitam ।। 14।।
miṣṭānnaśākapatrādyairanvitaṃ prasamarpayet ।
sugandhajalasadratnadakṣiṇāvastrasaṃyutam ।। 15।।
pūrṇaṃ ca kalaśaṃ dadyādātmavide tu sādhave ।
sarvasvaṃ gurave dadyād bhojayed bālabālikāḥ ।। 16।।
sādhūn sādhvīrbhojayecca svayaṃ bhuñjīta pāraṇām ।
etadvrataṃ tu te proktaṃ haripañcakasaṃjñitam ।। 17।।
tatkartuḥ punarāvṛttirbrahmalokānna vai bhavet ।
gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānasya phalamāpnuyāt ।। 18।।
paṭhedetacca śṛṇuyād vācayecchrāvayecca vā ।
tasyāpi vratapuṇyaṃ syād bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheta ca ।। 19।।
athānyatte pravakṣyāmi vrataṃ māsopavāsakam ।
pārākākhyaṃ mahālakṣmi! yattulyaṃ nānyaducyate ।।1.283.20।।
āṣāḍhe śrāvaṇe vāpi bhādre cāśvinake'pi vā ।
eteṣvanyatame māse śuklasyā''dyadine priye ।।21।।
prāśayet paṃcagavyaṃ ca tiṣṭhedviṣṇusamīpataḥ ।
snātvā dhyātvā prage viṣṇuṃ nityakarma samāpya ca ।।22।।
viṣṇuṃ samarcya saṃkalpaṃ kuryānmāsopavāsakam ।
svastivācanamantrāँśca vācayed brāhmaṇastadā ।।23 ।।
prārthayecca vratī devaṃ tvadyaprabhṛti mādhava! ।
māsamekaṃ nirāhāro bhaviṣyābhīṣṭamāvaha ।।24।।
tataḥ prabhṛti māsāntaṃ nivaseddharimandire ।
nityaṃ paṃcāmṛtairdevaṃ snāpayed dīpamādadet ।। 25।।
apāmārgaśalākāṃ khādayet snāyāt sa cānvaham ।
devaṃ samarcayennityaṃ bālān viprāँśca bhojayet ।।26।।
evaṃ māsopavāsāँśca kuryād dvādaśavatsarān ।
prativarṣaṃ ca godānaṃ viprapitṛpratarpaṇam ।।27।।
dakṣiṇābharaṇānnāni dadyād dānāni śaktitaḥ ।
ekamāsopavāsena rājasūyaphalaṃ bhavet ।।28।।
māsopavāsadvitaye phalaṃ taddviguṇaṃ bhavet ।
māsopavāsatritaye caturguṇaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 29।।
catuḥkṛtvaḥkṛte puṇyamaṣṭāgniṣṭomajaṃ bhavet ।
pañcakṛtvaḥkṛte puṇyamatyagniṣṭomajaṃ bhavet ।।1.283.3 0 ।।
ṣaṭakṛtvaḥsaṃkṛtaṃ jyotiṣṭomā'ṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet ।
saptakṛtvaḥkṛte vājimedhāṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet ।।3 1।।
aṣṭakṛtvaḥkṛte naramedhāṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet ।
navakṛtvaḥkṛte puṇya gomedhāṣṭakajaṃ bhavet ।।32।।
daśakṛtvaḥkṛte brahmamedhāṣṭakaphalaṃ bhavet ।
ekādaśaparāke tu hareḥ sārūpyamaśnute ।।33।।
sadvādaśaparāke tu labhenmukticatuṣṭayam ।
pārākavratakartāro muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ ।।34।।
nārī vā puruṣo vāpi vratakṛnmokṣamāpnuyāt ।
vratākhyānaṃ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyānmokṣabhāg bhavet ।।35।।
nāsti gaṃgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ ।
nāsti viṣṇusamo devastapo nā'naśanātparam ।।36।।
nāsti kṣamāsamā mātā nāsti kīrtisamaṃ dhanam ।
nāsti jñānasamo lābho nāsti dharmasamaḥ pitā ।।37।।
na vivekasamo bhrātā naikādaśyāḥ samaṃ vratam ।
nāsti brahmasamaṃ pātraṃ nāsti patnīsamaṃ priyam ।।38।।
nāsti sādhusamā naukā nāsti pārākavad vratam ।
dānaṃ homādikaṃ kāryaṃ prāpte puṇye'hani priye ।।39।।
tṛtīyā mādhave śuklā bhādre kṛṣṇā trayodaśī ।
kārtike navamī śuddhā māghe pañcadaśī tithiḥ ।।1.283.40।।
etā yugādyāḥ kathitā dattasyā'kṣayakārikāḥ ।
akṣayukchuklanavamī kārtike dvādaśī sitā ।।41 ।।
tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca ।
āṣāḍhaśukladaśamī sitā māghasya saptamī ।।42।।
śrāvaṇasyā'ṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathā'ṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā ।
phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī sitā ।।43।।
kārtikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī sitā ।
manvādayaḥ samākhyātā dattasyā'kṣayakārikāḥ ।।44।।
puṣkarādiṣu tīrtheṣu gaṃgādiṣu saritsu ca ।
ayodhyāyāṃ mathurāyāṃ māyāyāṃ kāśikābhuvi ।।45।।
kāñcyāmavantikāyāṃ dvārakāyāṃ dattamakṣayam ।
atithau vedavidvipre sādhusādhvīsatīṣu ca ।।46।।
deve devasame puṃsi dattamakṣayapuṇyakṛt ।
brahmacāriṣu yaddattaṃ bhabedakṣayapuṇyakṛt ।।47।।
vratinā sarvathā kāryaṃ tapo dānaṃ ca pūjanam ।
kāraṇīyaṃ bhojanādi sarvaṃ cā'kṣayapuṇyadam ।।48।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne haripañcakavratamāsopavāsavratatadudyāpanayugamanvādi-tithidānamāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītya-
dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।283।।


← adhyāyaḥ 283 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 284

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi vāragrahārcanavratam ।
yatkṛtvā tu grahāḥ sarve tuṣṭā dadati sampadaḥ ।। 1 ।।
sūryavāre vrataṃ kāryaṃ naktaṃ ca vaikabhojanam ।
prātaḥ snātvā raviṃ natvā pūjayet sarvavastubhiḥ ।। 2 ।।
kṛtvā tu kānakaṃ sūryaṃ sāruṇāśvarathasthitam ।
saṃjñāchāyāyutaṃ divyamālāmaṇivibhūṣitam ।। 3 ।।
āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtā'bhiṣecanam ।
snapanaṃ vastrabhūṣādidhāraṇaṃ gandhalepanam ।। 4 ।।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlakā'rpaṇam ।
dhyānapradakṣiṇāstotranamanādivisarjanam ।। 5 ।।
kārayecca tato madhyāhne'pi rātrau tathaiva ha ।
pūjanaṃ kārayet sarvaṃ sanīrājanabhojanam ।। 6 ।।
rātrau tu snāpayed devaṃ prātaḥ snātvā prabodhayet ।
pūjayet kamalaiścārkakaravīrādipuṣpakaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
jalaṃ punaḥ punardadyādupasthāpanamācaret ।
dānā'bhayā'bjayugalaṃ dhārayantaṃ kare ravim ।। 8 ।।
kuṇḍalāṃgadakeyūrayutaṃ dhyāyet trayītanum ।
raktāṃbhojaistilairvāpi juhuyād vidhivadvasau ।। 9 ।।
uccārayettu sūryāya svāhetyaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।
bhūrbhuvaḥ svastatsaviturvareṇyam ।। 1.284.1 0।।
bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ।
iti gāyatrikāmantreṇā'ṣṭottaraśataṃ tathā ।। 1 1।।
juhuyāt svāhāsaṃjñāyaichāyāyai cāpi saṃvadet ।
bhojayetpūjayedarghyaṃ dadyād bhāskaramūrtaye ।। 12।।
prāṇānāyamya cācamya hastau prakṣālya pūjakaḥ ।
pātraṃ tāmramayaṃ prasthatoyagrāhi samādadet ।। 1 3।।
kuṃkumaṃ rocanāṃ rājīṃ candanaṃ raktacandanam ।
karavīraṃ japāśālikuśaśyāmākataṇḍulān ।। 14।।
tilaveṇuyavāँścaiva nikṣipet salile śubhe ।
hastābhyāṃ kalaśaṃ vṛtvā jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ ।। 15।।
āmūrdhni pātramuddhṛtyā'mbareṇa varaṇe raveḥ ।
dṛṣṭiṃ cādhāya manasā dadyārghyaṃ jalāṃjalim ।।16।।
datvā puṣpāṃjaliṃ cāpi natvā stutvā visarjayet ।
nityaṃ vā taddine'pyevamarghyaṃ dadyādvivasvate ।। 17।।
tena tuṣṭo dinaśo'smai dadyād vittaṃ yaśaḥ sukham ।
putrān pautrānabhīṣṭaṃ ca yadyat sarvaṃ prayacchati ।। 18।।
sūryārcanavrataṃ tvetadāyurārogyavardhanam ।
dhanadhānyapaśukṣemakṣetramitrakalatradam ।। 19।।
tejovīryayaśaḥkīrtividyāvibhavabhogadam ।
prakuryād vidhinā sūryamaṇḍalāptikaraṃ param ।।1.284.20।।
sūryamūrtiṃ pradadyāttu gurave dakṣiṇāyutām ।
bhojayed brāhmaṇān dugdhasāraṃ tathā supolikāḥ ।।21 ।।
svayaṃ bhuñjīta ca vratī vratameva samāpayet ।
atha candradine candravrataṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ ।।22।।
prātarutthāya saṃsnātvā dugdhapuṣpādi cāharet ।
sauvarṇaṃ samṛgaṃ somaṃ sapatnīkaṃ prapūjayet ।।23।।
saptaviṃśatipatnībhiḥ sahitaṃ candrakaṃ vratī ।
āvāhanāt samārabhya ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।।24।।
pūjayet kumudaiścāpi bhojayed dugdhaśarkarāḥ ।
rātrau nīrājayet pūrṇātithau candrasya darśane ।।25।।
prakāntyāsyaṃ sphaṭikābhaṃ nīlālakaṃ sakuṇḍalam ।
bibhrāṇamiṣṭaṃ kumudaṃ dhyāyenmuktāsrajaṃ vidhum ।।26।।
svāhā candrāya rohiṇyainakṣatrebhyaśca saṃvadet ।
juhuyātpāyasenā'ṣṭottaraśataṃ sasarpiṣā ।।27।।
sthāpayed rājataṃ pātraṃ pūrayet saurabhaṃ payaḥ ।
dadyānniśākarāyā'rghyaṃ sarvābhiṣṭhārthasiddhaye ।।28।।
nityaṃ vā taddine'tyevamarghyaṃ dadyācca pūjayet ।
tuṣṭaḥ kumudinīnātho dadyādauṣadhibhojanam ।।29।।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutāḥ putrān saubhāgyaṃ ca dadāti vai ।
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryād gurave mūrtimarpayet ।।1.284.3 0।।
bālān saṃbhojayet kṣīraṃ pūrikāśca sato janān ।
svayaṃ vrataṃ samāpyaiva prabhuṃjīta tu pāraṇām ।।3 1।।
atha maṃgaladevasya vrataṃ rakṣyaṃ sukhārthinā ।
ekabhuktena kartavyaṃ sarvakāryasya siddhaye ।।32।।
prātaḥ snātvā dharāputradine dhyāyecca maṃgalam ।
meṣasthaṃ raktavastrāṃgaṃ śūlaśaktigadāvarān ।।33।।
karairbibhrāṇamīśānasvedataṃ bhūsutaṃ smaret ।
mārgaśīrṣe'tha vaiśākhe vratāraṃbhaḥ kujeḥ dine ।।34।।
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ bhaumavratamupācaret ।
sutakāmā dhanakāmā smṛddhikāmā vrataṃ caret ।।35।।
utthāya ca radān dhāvedapāmārgeṇa vāgyatā ।
snātvā raktāmbaradharā raktamālavilepanā ।।36।।
naivedyādikasaṃbhārān raktānsarvānprakalpayet ।
ācamya deśakālau ca saṃkīrtyātha vratārthinī ।।37।।
ṣoḍaśādyairupacāraiḥ saṃpūjyā'rghyaṃ nidhāpayet।
dhūpadīpau samarpyātha godhūmānnaṃ nivedayet ।।38।।।
tāmrapātre śuddhatoyapūrite raktacandanam ।
raktapuṣpākṣataphalānyākṣipyā'rghyaṃ samarpayet ।।39।।
bhūmiputra sutārthaṃ tvāṃ prapannā'rghyaṃ gṛhāṇa me ।
dehi putraṃ mahīputra gṛhāṇā'rghyaṃ namo'stu te ।।1.284.40 ।।
tato rekhātrayaṃ pṛthvyāṃ khādirāṃgārakeṇa vai ।
kuryācca mārjayed vāmapādena ca vadettadā ।।41 ।।
duḥkhadaurbhāgyanāśāya putrasantānahetave ।
kṛtarekhātrayaṃ vāmapādena mārjayāmyaham ।।42।।
ṛṇaduḥkhavināśāya mano'bhīṣṭārthasiddhaye ।
mārjayāmyasitā rekhāstisro janmatrayodbhavāḥ ।।43।।
dhyātvā ca maṃgalaṃ puṣpāṃjalihastā stuvīta tam ।
ṛṇahartre namastubhyaṃ nityaṃ saubhāgyado bhava । ।44।।
yo vakragatimāpanno nṝṇāṃ duḥkhaṃ prayacchati ।
pūjitaḥ sukhasaubhāgyaprado bhavati te namaḥ ।।45।।
meṣavāhanaṃ rudrātman dehi putrān dhanaṃ yaśaḥ ।
stutvā natvā tathā nīrājayitvā puṣpamarpayet ।।46।।
yathāśakti pradāya svaṃ gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇāśiṣaḥ ।
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt prabhuñjyāt tanniveditam ।।47।।
evamāvatsaraṃ kuryāt pratimaṃgalavāsaram ।
tilairhomaṃ prakuryācca svāhā maṃgalamūrtaye ।।48।।
bhaumamūrtiṃ svarṇamayīṃ maṇḍalasthe ghaṭe sthitām ।
samabhyarcya japenmantraṃ sutasaubhāgyasiddhaye ।।49।।।
omaṃgārakāya vidmahe śaktihastāya dhīmahi ।
tanno bhaumaḥ pracodayādityaṣṭottarakaṃ śatam ।।1.284.50 ।।
japennametpunaḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā dugdhādi bhojayet ।
śarkarāṃ ca sumiṣṭānnaṃ godhūmānnaṃ samarpayet ।।51।।
jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayet ।
visarjayettu vidhinā rātrau vyomni ca taṃ punaḥ ।।52।।।
natvā dhyātvā jalaṃ datvā'kṣatān puṣpāṇi cārpayet ।
vratapūrtiṃ phalaṃ prārthya bhuñjyāt svapyāt smaret graham ।।53।।।
evaṃ vratārthinī vātha vratī bhaumasya toṣaṇāt ।
labhate sutadhānyādi nirvighnaṃ sukhamuttamam ।।54।।
atha budhe dine vudhavrataṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ।
snātvā mūrtiṃ tu sauvarṇī pūjayettu yathākramam ।।55।।
āvāhanātsamārabhya puṣpāñjalyantameva tu ।
kṛtvā pītāmbaraṃ candraputraṃ sā'bhayapāṇikam ।।56।।
jānusthavāmahastaṃ ca dhyātvā'rghyaṃ ca samarpayet ।
budha cāndra mahāprājña duḥkhaṃ hara sukhaṃ kuru ।।57।।
athāgnau juhuyātsvāhā budhāyāṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।
prapūjya bhojayitvā ca kṣamāṃ prārthyā'ñjaliṃ dadet ।।58 ।।
puṣpākṣatairvardhayitvā tatastaṃ tu visarjayet ।
brāhmaṇān bhojayed vyomni rātrau paśyed budhaṃ vratī ।।59।।
arghyaṃ kamalapuṣpaiśca datvā samāpayed vratam ।
bhojayet sādhusādhvīśca svayaṃ bhuñjīta sādaram ।।1.284.60 ।।
evaṃ vratakṛto grahapīḍā sarvā nivartate ।
putrapaśudhanārogyasampadāṃ vardhanaṃ bhavet ।। 61 ।।
atha gurau prakuryācca gurorvrataṃ samāhitaḥ ।
snātvā suvarṇajāṃ mūrtiṃ guroḥ samarcayed vratī ।।62।।
āvāhanātsamārabhya ṣoḍaśā'bhisuvastubhiḥ ।
puṣpāṃjalipraparyantaṃ pūjayitvā bṛhaspatim ।।63 ।।
dhyāyenyastavāmahastaṃ ratnarāśau ca dakṣiṇāt ।
kirantaṃ sarvaratnāni svarṇakāntiṃ śubhānanam ।।64।।
pītapuṣpādyalaṃkārālepāṃśukādipūjitam ।
sarvavidyānidhiṃ devaguruṃ śāntikaraṃ smaret ।।65।।
bhojayetpāyasānnaṃ ca namet kṣamāpayettathā ।
svāhā bṛhaspataye cetyaṣṭottaraśatā''hutīn ।।66 ।।
daded ghṛtānnapakvānnadugdhasārakalādibhiḥ ।
viṣarogādipīḍāsu kalahe svajanodbhave ।।67।।
pippalotthasamidbhiśca juhuyāttannivṛttaye ।
juhuyāt tridinaṃ cāpi niśāpuṣpairghṛtaplutaiḥ ।।68।।
śīghraṃ tūpadravaśāntirbhavediti punastataḥ ।
pūjayecca named rātrau vyomni taddarśanaṃ caret ।। 69 ।।
dadyādarghyaṃ jalaṃ natvā vidyāṃ ca prārthayed vratī ।
nīrājayet tataḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyād visarjayet ।।1.284.70 ।।
dānaṃ śrīgurave dadyāt samūrtikaṃ sabhojanam ।
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ paścād bhuñjīteti sukhī bhavet ।।7 1 ।।
atha śukradine śukravrataṃ kuryād vidhānataḥ ।
snātvā suvarṇajaṃ śukraṃ dhyāyecchuklāmbaraṃ graham ।।72।।
śuklalepavibhūṣaṃ ca kareṇa dhanadāyakam ।
vyākhyānamudrā vāmena darśayantaṃ smared vratī । ।73 ।।
āvāhanātsamārabhya puṣpāñjalyantamarcayet ।
bhojayetpūjayetkṣamāpayennamettataḥ param ।।74।।
śvetapuṣpaiḥ sugandhaiśca juhuyād bhṛguvāsare ।
aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ homaṃ ghṛtādibhiśca sañcaret ।।75।।
nīrājayed gurave tu dadyādarghyaṃ jalaṃ śubham ।
rātrau vyomni prapaśyecca natvā stutvā visarjayet ।।76।।
dānaṃ śrīgurave dadyād vrataṃ tasya samāpayet ।
ratnamaṇyādi labhate vratakṛcca sukhī bhavet ।।77।।
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ tūpavāsaṃ vrate ca vā ।
prakuryādvā yathāśakti payaḥpānaṃ phalāśanam ।।78।।
atha śanaiścare vāre vrataṃ śaneḥ samācaret ।
snātvā prātarhariṃ natvā hanūmantaṃ ca pannatim ।।79।।
praṇamecca śanermūrtiṃ tvāyasīṃ paripūjayet ।
kṛṣṇamāṣānsaptasaṃkhyānpūjāyāmarpayed vratī ।।1.284.80 ।।
āvāhanāt samārabhya puṣpāñjalyantamādarāt ।
sarvaṃ kuryātpradadyācca kṛṣṇapuṣpaṃ sukajjalam ।।8 1 ।।
kṛṣṇāmbaravibhūṣāśca kṛṣṇānnasya nivedanam ।
kṛṣṇatilādihomaṃ ca svāhā śanaiścarāya vai ।।।82।।
aṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ kuryājjapenmantraṃ yathābalam ।
dhyāyet kṛpāṇahastaṃ taṃ kṛṣṇāmbarottarīyakam ।।83।।
rathasthaṃ tvāyasavarṇaṃ krūradṛṣṭipravaktrakam ।
vakragatiṃ prapaśyantaṃ nameddadyājalārghyakam ।।84।।
kṛṣṇapuṣpakṛṣṇamāṣānvitaṃ śāntiprado bhava ।
śubhāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ kuru saurya sampatsukhāni vardhaya ।।85।।
aniṣṭaṃ mā kuru tvarkin saṃjñāputra namo'stu te ।
yamabhrātargṛhāṇedaṃ kṛśarānnaṃ jalādikam ।।86।।
iti kṛtvā'rcanaṃ tasya kṛṣṇadānāni dāpayet ।
nīrājayennameccāpi vidhinā ca visarjayet ।।87।।
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā prāyo naktaṃ tvatrācared vratī ।
dvitīye vāsare prātaḥ prapūjyaiva śaniṃ hṛdā ।।88।।
bhojayedbālakān kanyā viprān kuryācca pāraṇām ।
evaṃ samvatsaraṃ kṛtvā śanerduḥkhāni saṃjayet ।।89।।
prāpnuyāt sukhasampattiṃ sukhaṃ svargasamaṃ labhet ।
iti vratāni proktāni kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।।1.284.90 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
sūryasomamaṃgalabudhaguruśukraśanivratānāṃ sāṃganirūpaṇanāmā
caturaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 284।।


← adhyāyaḥ 284 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 285
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 286 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāminnātha mādhava keśava ।
pārvatīprabhayornātha lakṣmīmāṇikyayoḥ pate ।। 1 ।।
śuddhaikādaśakā grāhyā vrate viddhā na vai katham ।
vada tatkāraṇaṃ padyāpate'mṛtapate hare ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi brāhmaṃ jātaṃ kathānakam ।
viddhaikādaśikāyāṃ vai prātastiṣṭhati mohinī ।। 3 ।।
vedhaḥputrī puṇyahantrī tasmād grāhyā na sā vrate ।
daśamīvedharahitā sadopoṣyā vrate matā ।। 4 ।।
svargamokṣapradā kṣetrarājyaputrapradāyinī ।
kalatravittadāhārdaśarīrārogyadāyinī ।। 5 ।।
kṣaye vā'pyathavā vṛddhau samprāpte vā dinodaye ।
upoṣyā dvādaśī puṇyā pūrvaviddhā vivarjayet। ।। 6 ।।
pūrvaviddhāṃ prakurvāṇo naro dharmaṃ nikṛntati ।
santatestu vināśāya sampadāṃ haraṇāya ca ।। 7 ।।
pūrvaviddhā purā dattā dānavebhyastu sā tithiḥ ।
pūrvaviddhatithau puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ yātyasureṣvatha ।। 8 ।।
dattaṃ japtaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ sevitaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ ।
viddhatithau kṣayaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ।। 9 ।।
āsīd rukmāṃgado rājā sārvabhaumaḥ surāṣṭrake ।
mahāvaiṣṇavadharmastho harivāsaratatparaḥ ।। 1.285.1 0।।
gaje dhṛtvā paṭahaṃ vādayate harivāsare ।
bhunakti mānavo yo'dya viṣṇorahani mandadhīḥ ।। 11 ।।
sa me daṇḍyaśca vadhyaśca nirvāsyo nagarād bahiḥ ।
pitā vā yadi vā bhrātā putro bhāryā suhṛnmama ।। 12।।
śrīharervāsare bhoktā nigrāhyo dasyuvad bhavet ।
dadadhvaṃ sātvatebhyaśca majjadhvaṃ tīrthavāriṣu ।। 13।।
mamedaṃ vacanaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhantu mama rāṣṭrake ।
etatpraghuṣṭaṃ sammatvā prajā bhajanti keśavam ।। 14।।
gacchadbhiḥ śrīharerdhāmno mārgaḥ saṃkulito janaiḥ ।
tadrājye tu mṛtā ye ye te yānti harimandiram ।। 15।।
yamamārgaṃ na gacchanti pṛthvīto mānavāstadā ।
śūnyāstu nirayā jātāḥ pāpiprāṇivivarjitāḥ ।। 16।।
bhagno yāmyo'bhavanmārgo dvādaśādityatāpitaḥ ।
sarve vai garuḍārūḍhā janā yānti hareḥ padam ।। 17।।
lekhyakarmavinivṛttaścitragupto'pyathā'bhavat ।
mānavā bhajanātpūrvakarmāṇyapi vidhūya vai ।। 18।।
prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma carpaṭā vyarthatāṃ gatāḥ ।
devānāmapi nākādyāste śūnyā hyabhavaँstadā ।। 19।।
śūnye triviṣṭape jāte śūnye ca narake tathā ।
nārado dharmarājaṃ saṃgatvā tvidamuvāca ha ।।1.285.20।।
kathaṃ śūnyaṃ yamakṣetraṃ na cāyānti janāstviha ।
citragupto'pi nivṛttaḥ likhatyeva na vai kṛtim ।।21।।
māyādaṃbhasamākrāntā duṣṭakarmaratā api ।
kathaṃ nātra samāyānti kāraṇaṃ tvatra me vada ।।22।।
yamo dainyānvitaḥ prāha pṛthvyāṃ rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ ।
sārvabhaumaḥ sāmprataṃ sa bhaktimān puruṣottame ।।23।।
prabodhayati paṭahairna bhoktavyaṃ harerdine ।
ye kecid bhuṃjate martyāste me daṇḍyā dhruvaṃ matāḥ ।।।24।।
tadbhayāddhi prajāḥ sarvā harerdinamupāsate ।
prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ vyājenaivāpyupoṣitāḥ ।।25।।
tena rājñā harerbhaktyā śūnyāśca narakāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
svargāścāpi kṛtāḥ śūnyā lekhakā niṣkriyāḥ kṛtā ।।26।।
ekādaśyupavāsena mārjitaṃ likhitaṃ tu yat ।
naśyanti pūrvapāpāni hyabhuktvā harivāsare ।।27।।
kāṣṭhamṛgasamaḥ so'haṃ jāto'smi niṣphalakriyaḥ ।
tyaktakāmo'smyahaṃ tvadya lokapālatvamakriyam ।।।28।।
yāsyāmi brahmaloko vai duḥkhaṃ jñāpayituṃ svakam ।
nirvyāpāro niyogī vetanaṃ dhatte na jīryati ।।29।।
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ mānavo vā yamopi vā ।
evamuktvā mahālakṣmi! nāradaṃ citraguptakam ।।1.285.30 ।।
saha nīravā yayau brahmasadanaṃ yamarāṭ svayam ।
dadarśa ca samāsīnaṃ mūrtā'mūrtajanā''vṛtam ।।3 1 ।।
upāsyamānaṃ vividhairlokapālairdigīśvaraiḥ ।
vedaśāstretihāsādyaiḥ saraḥsaritsamudrakaiḥ ।।32।।
vṛkṣavallītṛṇasasyairvanāraṇyamarudgaṇaiḥ ।
kṣetrabhūbhṛtsthalībhiśca munidevarṣipitṛbhiḥ ।।33।।
kalādinaniśāvarṣayugakalpalayādibhiḥ ।
sukhaduḥkhā'lābhalābhairnāgasākṣiguṇādibhiḥ ।।34 ।।
guṇāguṇairmāyikaiścā'nuktairupāsyate hyajaḥ ।
teṣāṃ madhye'viśatsūryātmajo bhagnahṛdāntaraḥ ।। 35।।
vilokayannadhobhāgaṃ jātahāniṃ vyadarśayat ।
nipapātā'grato brahmaँs trāhi trāhīti saṃvadan ।।36।।
vinivṛtto'smi niṣkāryaḥ kiṃ karomi niyojane ।
nāhaṃ vetanayogyo'smi rājapaṭṭaṃ gṛhāṇa te ।।37।।
ityuktvā rājapaṭakaṃ nicikṣepa vidheḥ puraḥ ।
lekhinīṃ citragupto'pi cikṣepa ca vidheḥ puraḥ ।।38।।
mlānanaṃ yamaṃ tvāśvāsayāmāsa pitāmahaḥ ।
vihvalaṃ bhagnahṛdayaṃ hyāsane sannyaveśayat ।।39।।
papraccha ca śanaiḥ kenā'bhibhūto'si vivāsitaḥ ।
kenā'pamārjito devapaṭastavā'pamānitaḥ ।।1.285.40 ।।
brūhi sarvamaśeṣeṇa duḥkhaṃ te hṛdaye sthitam ।
ime sarve tarkayanti lokān rodayate tu yaḥ ।।41।।
so'yaṃ kena parābhūto mlānā''syo'sti raveḥ sutaḥ ।
athavā satyagātheyaṃ drogdhurvai parato bhayam ।।42।।
atha śrutvā yamaḥ prāha śṛṇu pūrvapitāmaha ।
vetanaṃ yo vinā kāryaṃ gṛhṇāti karmayojitaḥ ।।43।।
nipatatyandhakūpe saḥ yastvanyāyena jīvati ।
karmacārī niyogaṃ na karoti lobhakarṣitaḥ ।।44।।
prabhorvittaṃ samaśnāti sa bhavetkāṣṭhakīṭakaḥ ।
paścāt sa narakaṃ yāti yāvatkalpaśatatrayam ।।45।।
svārthamātraparo yastu svāminaṃ tu vilumpati ।
sa bhaved grāmakhāteṣu hyākhuḥ kalpaśatatrayam ।।46।।
niyogī nispṛho bhūtvā svāmikāryaṃ karoti na ।
svāmivittaṃ samaśnāti gṛhe mārjāratāṃ vrajet ।।47।।
so'haṃ tvayā niyukto'smi daṇḍyā'daṇḍyānpraśāsitum ।
puṇyena puṇyakarmāṇaṃ pāpena pāpakāriṇam ।।48।।
yojayāmīti tatrādya rukmāṃgadena bhūbhujā ।
parābhūto'smyādhikārye kṛto'smi niṣkriyo'dhunā ।।49।।
rukmāṃgadabhayād bhūmiḥ saptadvīpā sasāgarā ।
na bhuṃkte vāsare viṣṇoḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśane ।।1.285.50।।
pāpāśca satkriyāśūnyāḥ sarvadharmavihīnakāḥ ।
prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma hyupoṣya harivāsaram ।।51।।
ye tvāgatā yamapūryāṃ te'pi vaṃśajapuṇyataḥ ।
yamapūrīṃ parityajya dhṛtvā pādaṃ tu mūrdhni me ।।52।।
prayānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ matkṣetraṃ śūnyatāṃ gatam ।
etasya vratapuṇyena śataṃ pitṛparamparāḥ ।।।53।।।
śataṃ mātāmahapuṃsāṃ śataṃ bhāryāpiturjanāḥ ।
śataṃ ca bhāgineyā vai bhrātṛbhāryājanāḥ śatam ।।54।।
śataṃ pitṛbhāgineyaḥ śataṃ mātṛsvasurjanāḥ ।
ekottaraṃ ca pratyekaṃ yānti mokṣapadaṃ hareḥ ।।55।।
etanme paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ mārjayitvā lipiṃ mama ।
anyakṛtena puṇyena yānti tvanye paraṃ padam ।।56।।
ekasya puṇyamāhātmyādanyagotrāḥ paraṃ padam ।
chitvā prayānti matpāśaṃ tena me śiraso rujā ।।57।।
na me prayojanaṃ deva niyogenedṛśena yat ।
ekādaśyupavāsyekaḥ kulasaptakamasya tu ।।58।।
prayāti śrīharerdhāma tyaktvā lokaṃ tu māmakam ।
na yajñairna ca tīrthairvā vratairnāpi japairna ca ।।59।।
jalāgnibhṛgupatanairna gatiṃ yāti tādṛśīm ।
yādṛśīṃ yāti tāṃ harervāsarasya vratena tu ।।1.285.60।।
bhūtvā so'haṃ nirāśo'dya tava pādasaroruham ।
vijñaptiṃ kartumāyātaḥ kuruṣvā'tra yathepsitam ।।61।।
yamakṣetraṃ yamamārgo yamaśāsanamityapi ।
mā syurbhagnā yathā pūrvapitāmaha tathā kuru ।।62।।
na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ kvāpi tvetādṛṅnyāyavarjitam ।
svakarmasthā vikarmasthāḥ śucayo'śucayo'pi vā ।।63।।
upoṣya vāsaraṃ viṣṇordhāma yānti nṛpājñayā ।
so'smākaṃ tu mahān śatrurnirgrāhyaḥ syānna saṃśayaḥ ।।64।।
tena varṣasahasreṇa śāsitaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalam ।
atiduṣṭā janā nītā vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma tadbalāt ।।65।।
āropayitvā garuḍe kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam ।
nayatyaharniśaṃ lokamaprameyaṃ pitāmaha ।।66।।
yadi sthāsyati dīrghaṃ saḥ samastaṃ neṣyate'mṛtam ।
eṣa daṇḍaḥ paro hyeṣastava padbhyāṃ visarjitaḥ ।।67।।
lokapālatvamasmākaṃ vyarthīkṛtamanena vai ।
dhanyā sā jananī garbhe dhṛto'yaṃ mokṣakṛd yayā ।।68।।
kimapatyena jātena mātṛkleśakareṇa vai ।
yena tṛptirna toṣo na na sevā na ripukṣayaḥ ।।69।।
noddhṛtaḥ pitṛnicayo vidyayā vā balena vā ।
yasya na sphurate kīrtirjaneṣvabhijñakeṣvapi ।।1.285.70 ।।
vṛthāśūlā tu tanmātā kukṣiprastararakṣiṇī ।
vṛthājanmā'pi ṣaṇḍhaḥ sa māturjāṭhararogavat ।।71।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu virodhī yo bhavetsutaḥ ।
varaṃ tasmād garbhanāśo duḥkhaṃ tatra samāpyate ।।72।।
dharmahā yo bhavelloke vṛthā tasya tu jīvitam ।
vīraprasūridānīṃ tu yayā rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ ।।73।।
janitaḥ śrīharerbhakto mallipermārjanāya vai ।
naitādṛśaṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ kenāpi paramārcanam ।।74।।
so'haṃ kathaṃ prajīvāmi śṛṇvaँstatpaṭahaṃ sadā ।
lumpamānaṃ mama mārgaṃ vṛthāvetanapāpabhāg ।।75।।
iti nivedayitvaiva virarāmā'tidurmanāḥ ।
brahmā prāha tadā lakṣmi śanaiḥ saurerviśokakṛt ।।76।।
kiṃ tatrāsti tavāścaryaṃ kathaṃ vā khidyate bhavān ।
sadguṇeṣu kathaṃ tāpastava jāto yamādhipa ।।77।।
yannāmoccāraṇād yānti janā mokṣapadaṃ dhruvam ।
tadvrataṃ samanuṣṭhāya kathaṃ neyuḥ paraṃ padam ।।78।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātraikaḥ praṇāmaḥ kṛto bhavet ।
daśāśvamedhaphaladaḥ phalaṃ tu kṣayaśāli tat ।।79।।
punarjanmapradaṃ tacca praṇāmastvantakṛjjaneḥ ।
kāśīgayākurukṣetraiḥ kimastyasya prayojanam ।।1.285.80।।
jihvāgre vartate yasya harirityakṣaradvayam ।
rajasvalāṃ tu cāṇḍālīṃ gacchan bhuñjan surānvitam ।।8 1।।
māsaṃ kurvanmahaccauryaṃ tathāpi sa hi mokṣabhāg ।
viṣṇulokaṃ prayātyeva vidhūya pāpasaṃcayam ।।82।।
yannāmoccāraṇānmokṣaḥ kimūta tadupoṣaṇe ।
yatra saṃkīrtyate vicintyate kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।83।।
ajñānāllīlayā vā'tra helayā'pi gṛṇan harim ।
śṛṇvansmarannupahasannapi yāti parāṃ gatim ।।84।।
kathaṃ tasya prabhakteṣu vratiṣvāśāsanaṃ tava ।
yastvaṃ na cūrṇito baddhaḥ pāṣadaistasya vai prabhoḥ ।।85।।
tadasmākaṃ paraṃ mānaṃ rakṣitaṃ tvaṃ na budhyase ।
niyoginā hi yatnena jñātavyā rājakīyatā ।।86।।
rājānugrahapātrāṇi sāparādhānyapi dhruvam ।
niyoktavyāni naiveha niyogī daṇḍyatenyathā ।।87।।
evaṃ pāpā api kṛṣṇabhaktaniyogamāśritāḥ ।
prayānti śrahirerdhāma mā tatra śāsanaṃ kuru ।।88।।
anyabhaktaiḥ sadoṣaiḥ pūrayiṣye yama! te gṛham ।
na kariṣyāmi sāhāyyaṃ haribhaktaistu te kvacit ।।89।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktanigraho naiva vidyate ।
taiḥ kṛte hyavamāne tu tava nā'smi sahāyavān ।।1.285.90।।
cet te sāhāyyamatrāpi karomi yādi sūryaja! ।
mama dehāntadaṇḍaḥ syād bhraṣṭatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padāt ।।9 1।।
tadātra tava kā vārtā tato maunaṃ gṛhāṇa bho ।
prayāntu te harerdhāma yamakṣetrānna rodhaya ।।92।।
bhavatvādityajanmaँste riktaṃ kṣetraṃ harerbalāt ।
mā śokaṃ vraja cātrārthe kāle tviṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।93।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne daśamīviddhaikādaśīvratā'karaṇe mahābhāgavatarukmāṃgadanṛpākhyāne ekādaśīvratabalād yamapurīriktatve brahmāṇaṃ prati yamasya saśokanivedanamitināmā pañcāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।285।।


← adhyāyaḥ 285 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 286
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 287 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato dharmarājaḥ prāha pitāmaham ।
aho kīdṛśamāścaryaṃ yadi rājā pramokṣadaḥ ।। 1 ।।
devāḥ sarve tadā vyarthāḥ śāsanaṃ ca nirarthakam ।
rukmāṃgadāddharau tatra bhedo na syānmanāgapi ।। 2 ।।
yamapuryā devapuryā brahmapuryā niyāmakaḥ ।
rukmāṃgado bhaved bhaumo harireva bhaveddhi saḥ ।। 3 ।।
tamekaṃ bhojayitvā tu prapūjya harivāsare ।
kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi gṛhāṇa tvatparaṃ vidhe ।। 4 ।।
yadi nāmādyaprabhṛti yairnaraiḥ saṃsmṛto hariḥ ।
upoṣitaḥ stuto vāpi te bāhyā mama śāsanāt ।। 5 ।।
nedṛśaṃ karmacāritvaṃ dvisattākaṃ prarocate ।
anyaṃ niyuṅkṣva sahate bhagnasattākatāṃ tu yaḥ ।। 6 ।।
iti kṛtvāṃ paṭaṃ tyaktvā sthito maunaṃ yamādhipaḥ ।
brahmā tadā sabhāyāṃ vai paṭagrāhaṃ vyacintayat ।। 7 ।।
prakāśaṃ kṛtavāँstatra samutthāya punaḥ punaḥ ।
paṭṭaṃ gahṇantu ye kecid yamarājyaṃ dadāmyaham ।। 8 ।।
rukmāṃgadanṛpājñā tu nollaṃghyeti paṇānvitam ।
yamāsanaṃ pragṛhṇantu paṭaṃ riktaṃ dadāmyaham ।। 9 ।।
śrutvāpi na yadā kaścit svīyaśāsanamāpnavān ।
paraśāsanakaiṃkarye sthātuṃ paravaśe pade ।। 1.286.10 ।।
iyeṣa tu tadā prāha nāradastaṃ pitāmaham ।
mānavādhīnamaiśvaryapadaṃ ko gṛhṇīyātsuraḥ ।। 1 1।।
tasmādatrānyapanthānaṃ vicāraya pitāmaha ।
yena vai yamamārgo vā pratiruddho na vai bhavet ।। 1 2।।
svargamārgo'pi saṃruddho na bhavet tattathā kuru ।
śratvaivaṃ nāradīyaṃ vai vacanaṃ bahugarbhitam ।। 13।।
vaivasvatasya kāryārthaṃ tatsanmānacikīrṣayā ।
cintayāmāsa viśvasṛṭ mokṣe vighnakaraṃ tu yat ।। 14।।
svasmādutpādayāmāsa pramadāṃ lokamohinīm ।
sarvayoṣidvarā devī manasā nirmitā babhau ।। 15।।
iyaṃ brāhmī divyarūpā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ।
prodbhinnayauvanā dṛṣṭā sarvaiścakitamānasaiḥ ।। 16 ।।
mohitāstu tadā sarve saṃsatsthā brahmasṛṣṭijāḥ ।
moho mokṣapratiroddhā mohinī mokṣanāśinī ।। 17।।
samyag jātaṃ kautukaṃ tat prāhemān paśyato hyajaḥ ।
sarāgeṇeha manasā sarāgeṇeha cakṣuṣā ।। 18।।
cintayedvikṣayedvāpi jananīṃ vā sutāmapi ।
vadhūṃ vā bhrātṛjāyāṃ vā gurubhāryāṃ nṛpastriyam ।। 19।।
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃcintya śvapacīmapi ।
dṛṣṭvā tu pramadāmetāṃ yaḥ kṣobhaṃ vrajate janaḥ ।।1.286.20।।
tasya janmakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛthā bhavati putrakāḥ ।
prasaṃge daśasāhasra puṇyamāyāti saṃkṣayam ।।।21।।
pāpena tu tadā prāṇī tiryagyonimavāpnuyāt ।
tasmānna cintayetpaśyed vadet strīṃ manasā'ghinā ।।22।।
strīrna vicintayetpaśyed vadet puṃ manasā'ghinā ।
sābhilāṣeṇa manasā tatkṣaṇātpatate janaḥ ।।23 ।।
evamābhāṣya bahudhā viriñcirjñānacakṣuṣā ।
vilokya mohinīṃ sārthāṃ kṣaṇaṃ vyacintayattataḥ ।।24।।
yatheyaṃ manasā klṛptā mānasonmādakāriṇī ।
tathaiva jātā bandhāya yamastoṣaṃ prayāsyati ।। 25।।
yamamārgo'nayā samyag bhaviṣyati suvāhitaḥ ।
svargaṃ vā narakaṃ vāpi riktaṃ kvacinna patsyate ।।26।।
tāvadāha praṇamyainaṃ mohinī caturānanam ।
paśya mūrchānvitaṃ brahman sabhyaṃ sthāvaracetanam ।।27।।
mohitaṃ mama rūpeṇa nimagnaṃ bandhasāgare ।
sa nāstyadyātra yaḥ kopi dṛśyate mama darśanāt ।। 28।।
svalpaṃ vā bahulaṃ vā'pi na kṣobhaṃ saṃgato mayi ।
sāhaṃ sṛṣṭā tvayā brahman kasyacit kṣobhaṇāya tu ।।29।।
tamādiśa vidhe śīghraṃ kṣobhayiṣye kṣaṇāddhi tam ।
māṃ dṛṣṭvā ca bhuvi kṣmābhṛjjaḍopi drāg vimuhyati ।।1.286.30 ।।
kiṃ punaścetano jīvo mohapātraṃ vinirmitaḥ ।
ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ brahmovāca tu tāṃ mudā ।।3 1।।
satyametad viśālākṣi! tava rūpaṃ vimohakam ।
ime sabhāsadāḥ sarve jaḍā iva tu darśanāt ।।32।।
vidyante tattathaivā'si vijayo'stu sadā tava ।
yannimittā mayā sṛṣṭā tatprasādhaya mohini! ।।33।।
surāṣṭrake mahīdeśe rājā rukmāṃgadosti vai ।
yasya sandhyāvalī patnī tava rūpopamāsti hi ।।34।।
yasyāṃ dharmāṃgadaḥ putro jāto'sti guṇato'dhikaḥ ।
yo na vākyādvicalati sarvadā''jñākaraḥ sudhīḥ ।।35।।
tasya rukmāṃgadasyaiva samīpaṃ yāhi mohini! ।
raivatākhye mahāśaile sa rājā tvāgamiṣyati ।।36।।
mohitastava gītena saṃgaṃ yāsyati sa tvayā ।
tatra devi tvayā vācyaṃ kṛtvā taṃ vivaśaṃ tvati ।।37।।
ahaṃ bhāryā bhaviṣyāmi paṇo rakṣyo yadi tvayā ।
kathayiṣye tvahaṃ kāle tatkartavyaṃ tvayā dhruvam ।। 38 ।।
iti śrutvā mohitaḥ sa tathaiva pratipatsyate ।
tadā taddakṣiṇo hastastvayā grāhyaḥ svake kare ।। 3 9।।
śapathairvacane bandhanīyaḥ samayapālane ।
tataḥ suratakārye saḥ toṣaṇīyo'timugdhavat ।। 1.286.40 ।।
gāḍhe snehe sthire jāte māseṣvapagateṣvatha ।
surate tava cārvaṃgi! yadā mugdho hi lakṣyate ।।4 1 ।।
prahasya nṛpateḥ smārayitavyaṃ svaṃ paṇaṃ vacaḥ ।
yastvayā śapatho rājan kṛto madvākyapālane ।।42।।
tatpālaya mahārāja manye'haṃ samayo'stviti ।
evamukte tvayā rājā mugdho vai satyagauravāt ।।43 ।।
vadiṣyati pālayāmi brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham ।
evamukte tu vacane tvayā vācyastadā nṛpaḥ ।।44 ।।
surate tūpavāsastu mato nairbalyakārakaḥ ।
rateryoge mahān vighno hyupavāsaḥ kṣudhākaraḥ ।।45।।
nopavāsastvayā kāryo jātu vai harivāsare ।
suratasraṃsakārī me hyupavāso'sti vighnakṛt ।।46 ।।
sumugdhāṃ yauvanopetāṃ sevamānāṃ na sevate ।
parvākṣepī durācāro nirdayo yāti rauravam ।। 47 ।।
trirātraṃ tvāṃ vinā rājan! sthātuṃ śaktā kathaṃ nvaham ।
nāhaṃ divasamapyekaṃ sthātuṃ śaktā tvayā vinā । ।48 ।।
upoṣaṇaṃ tava rājan mahāpāpāya jāyate ।
yatrāhaṃ kāmadāhena prajvalāmi tvayā vinā ।।49 ।।
yadi cet taruṇī rakṣyā deyaṃ ratisukhaṃ sadā ।
yadyaśakto raterdāne na rakṣyā taruṇī tadā ।।1.286.5 0 । ।
kāmadāhaviniḥśvāsastaruṇīhṛdayodbhavaḥ ।
vratināmapi puṇyāni prajvālayati mūlataḥ ।।5 1 ।।
tasmād rājanpravārdhakye kartavyā harivāsarāḥ ।
tāruṇye tu mamā'tīte kariṣye harivāsarān ।।52 ।।
evaṃ sambodhyamānopi yadā bhūbhṛdvacastava ।
na kariṣyati cārvaṃgi! tadā vācyaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ ।। 53 ।।
yadi na tyajase rājannupavāsaṃ harerdine ।
svahastena śiraśchitvā svaputrasya varā'sinā ।।54।।
dharmāṃgadasya rājendra mamotsaṃge kṣipa svayam ।
yadyetanmatpriyaṃ rājanna karoṣi vacaḥ kṣateḥ ।।55 ।।
dharmakṣīṇo bhavān gantā hyacirānnarake dhruvam ।
śrutvaitadvacanaṃ devi । na haniṣyati putrakam ।। 56।।
devānumatimādāya bhokṣyate harivāsare ।
tadvā prajāḥ prabhokṣyante tadīyā harivāsare ।।57।।
yāmyamārgo janaistarhi saṃpravṛtto bhaviṣyati ।
nārakāṇāṃ bhālapaṃktipramāṇaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ।।58।।
yadā na bhokṣyate kiṃcid bhaktatvāddharivāsare ।
haniṣyati tadā putraṃ rājyābhiṣiktameva tam ।।59 ।।
tadā prayāsyati kṣmābhṛt strījītatvapradūṣaṇam ।
mūrdhābhiṣiktaghātitvaṃ punnāmanarakārtitām ।। 1.286.60 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ pātayitṛtvaṃ svātmaghātitvamityapi ।
ebhirdoṣairacirāt sa nidhanaṃ prāpsyate nṛpa ।।6 1 ।।
yamamārge svayaṃ gatvā pūrayiṣyati rauravam ।
yadvā vratabalācchīghraṃ harerdhāmni prayāsyati ।।62।।
śāsanaṃ pratiruddhaṃ syājjanā atsyanti vai vrate ।
bhaviṣyati yamamārgaḥ samuddhāṭita eva ha ।। 63 ।।
gaccha śīghraṃ pratīkṣasva rukmāṃgadaṃ tu raivate ।
kṛtakāryā samāgaccha viddhāṃ dāsye tithiṃ gṛham ।।64।।
mohinī tvevamuktā sā praṇamyā'jaṃ sabhāsadān ।
vīkṣyamāṇā'marairmārge pratasthe raivatācalam ।। 65 ।।
tṛtīyena muhūrtena saṃprāptā girimastakam ।
raivato mandarādryātmā saurāṣṭre rājate'calaḥ ।। 66 ।।
ratnānāṃ mandiraṃ hyeṣo bahudhātusamanvitaḥ ।
krīḍābhūmiḥ surāṇāṃ ca tapobhūryastapasvinām ।। 67।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'yaṃ vihārodyānasannibhaḥ ।
svarṇarakṣā nadī yatra vahate kāṃcanaprabhā ।। 68 ।।
bhaveśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ vartate vāmanopi vai ।
dāmodarasvarūpeṇa gahvarāraṇyabhūmiṣu ।।69।।
mṛgīkuṇḍataṭe bālā gatvā pītvā jalaṃ śubham ।
bhuktvā sītāphalaṃ svādu cakre saṃgītamuttamam ।।1.286.70 ।।
mūrchanātālasahitaṃ gāndhāradhvanisaṃyutam ।
klamahānikaraṃ miṣṭaṃ sarvasattvavimohanam ।।7 1 ।।
ciñcādrumaghaṭāchannaḥ śratvā bhaveśvaraḥ śivaḥ ।
tadā bhoktumanāḥ kāmāturaścāti vyajāyata ।।72।।
cacāla mandirātsvasmād yatra gāyati mohinī ।
svarṇarekhā sthirā jātā vanaṃ stabdhaṃ tadā'bhavat ।। 73 ।।
dāmodaro'pi cāyāto vanarājisvarabhramāt ।
vanadevā raivatādriḥ svarā''kṛṣṭāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।74।।
mohinī gītikāmagnā pratīkṣati nṛpāgamam ।
rukmāṃgado'pi vairāgyādaraṇyaṃ gantumicchati ।।75।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamarājasya sattāpaṭṭatyāgamiṣeṇa pitāmahena saṃvādo, mohinīstrīsamutpādanaṃ, śikṣayitvā raivatādrau rukmāṃgadanṛpaṃ prati mohinīpreṣaṇaṃ, mohinīsaṃgītamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 286।।


← adhyāyaḥ 286 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 287
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 288 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
tasminnavasare tveva lakṣmi! rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ ।
bhogāṃstu mānuṣān bhuktvā hariṃ sampūjya keśavam ।। 1 ।।
kṛtvā śūnyaṃ yamapathaṃ jitvā vaivasvataṃ yamam ।
vaikuṇṭhasya tu panthānaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ tu mānavaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
dharmāgadaṃ samāhūya dātuṃ rājyamabhāṣata ।
etāṃ vasumatīṃ putra saptasāgaramekhalām ।। 3 ।।
pālaya tvaṃ rājyadhuraṃ gṛhāṇa ca madarpitām ।
putre yogye suniṣpanne dhuraṃ yo na samarpayet ।। 4 ।।
kleśavāhī sa janako dharmakīrtipravicyutaḥ ।
putraśaktyaprasaṃpoṣṭā nonnatiṃ yāti vṛddhakaḥ ।। 5 ।।
kāryakṣamaḥ sutaścāpi bhāraṃ nodvahate tu yaḥ ।
svakartavyacyutaḥ so'pi duḥkhī bhavati vṛddhakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
pitā yena na tuṣyet sa putro yātyeva rauravam ।
pitā yena tu santuṣṭaḥ sutaḥ saḥ svargabhājanam ।। 7 ।।
kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ prajāścānunītā viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ ।
athā''sādya vinirvṛttiṃ gamiṣye'raṇyamekalaḥ ।। 8 ।।
girīn vanāni saritaḥ sarāṃsi vividhāni ca ।
taptukāmo lokayiṣye bhāraṃ tvayi niveśya vai ।। 9 ।।
śrūtvā dharmāṃgadaḥ prāha pitā prokto janārdanaḥ ।
piturvākye mahat svargaṃ mokṣaścājñākare pituḥ ।। 1.287.1 0।।
na hi putrasyā'nyadharmaḥ pitrājñākaraṇaṃ vinā ।
pitṛvākyamakurvāṇaḥ sudharmiṣṭho'pyadho vrajet ।। 11 ।।
tasmāt kariṣye vacanaṃ bhavatsantoṣahetave ।
gurvīṃ rājyadhuraṃ tāta tvadīyāmuddharāmyaham ।। 12।।
śrutvaivaṃ putravākyaṃ sa rājā tuṣṭo babhūva ha ।
prāha sandhyāvalīṃ patnīṃ sthitāṃ lakṣmīmivā'parām ।। 13।।
śṛṇu patnī tvahaṃ dhanyastvaṃ ca dhanyā sutena vai ।
karṇābhyāṃ śrūyate mokṣaḥ sa prāptaḥ satsutena vai ।। 14।।
putre vinayasampanne vṛttaśauryasamanvite ।
pratāpini praṇiṣpanne piturmokṣo gṛhe dhruvaḥ ।। 1 5।।
śatānandapradaḥ putrastārayatyeva bījadam ।
jananīṃ tārayeccātrā''vābhyāṃ prāptastathā sutaḥ ।। 16 ।।
rājyabhāraṃ nyasya putre tvāṃ cāpi nyasya rakṣaṇe ।
gamiṣye'raṇyavāsārthaṃ saṃsmṛtya prākparamparām ।। 17।।
kālaśeṣaṃ kṣapayiṣye pravāsye'nte harergṛham ।
sukhinī bhava putreṇa jñānenā''tmaviniṣṭhayā ।। 18।।
mā viyoge kuru duḥkhaṃ patyājñāṃ pārameśvarīm ।
matvā strītvād gṛhe tiṣṭha kalyāṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।। 1 9।।
śrutvā sandhyāvalī prāha satyamuktaṃ tvayā nṛpa ।
bhogād vairāgyamāpannaḥ sevasva munisajjanān ।।1.287.20 ।।
prasannā'smi tavā''jñāyāṃ pātivratyaṃ tavā''dare ।
sarvathā'stu tava toṣo manmokṣe vai sahāyakṛt ।। 21 ।।
prajāścāpi samāpṛcchya kṣiptvā dhuraṃ svaputrake ।
dhurāmādṛtya bhūṣālo datvā svaṃ dakṣiṇa karam ।। 22।।
hayamāruhya rājā sa yayau raivatakānanam ।
patnīvratā'bhidhaviprā''śramaṃ tvaśvasaro'ntikam ।। 23 ।।
praviveśātiramyaṃ satkadalīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam ।
aśokabakulopetaṃ punnāgasaralāvṛtam ।। 24।।
āmrarāyaṇajāmbvādikṣīrikākarmadānvitam ।
kapitthapippalīkharjūranārikelaketakaiḥ ।। 25 ।।
śrīvṛkṣatālapanasaiścandanaiḥ sālacampakaiḥ ।
kramukairdāḍimairvaṃśairdhātrīnimbaiśca śobhitam ।। 26।।
stambavallītṛṇairvyāptaṃ sasyadhānyāḍhyabhūtalam ।
samprapaśyan muniṃ rājā dadarśa hutabhukprabham ।। 27।।
patnīvratākhyavipraṃ saḥ praṇanāma tu sādaram ।
muninā''tithyasatkāraiḥ pūjitaḥ prāha bhūpatiḥ ।। 28 ।।
adya me pātaka kṣīṇaṃ prāptaṃ satkarmaṇāṃ phalam ।
dṛṣṭaṃ tava padāmbhojaṃ tvāyatiḥ śreyasā'nvitā ।। 29 ।।
patnīvratastataḥ prāha rājan janma phalīkṛtaḥ ।
tvādṛśenātipuṇyenāśramo me vīkṣito'dhunā ।। 1.287.30 ।।
yamamārgaṃ vinirjitya riktaṃ kṛtvā ca nārakam ।
prāpito yena vai loko vaikuṇṭhapadamavyayam ।। 31 ।।
so'smākaṃ draṣṭukāmānāṃ cakṣuṣorviṣayaṃ gataḥ ।
śvaco'pi mahīpāla viṣṇubhakto dvijādhikaḥ ।। 32।।
tvaṃ tu bhāgavataśreṣṭhaḥ prapūnāsi mahītalam ।
sukhamāsvā''śrame ramye vada vedyaṃ mayā'sti yat ।। 3 3।।
jalapānaṃ kuru kṣmeśa phalaṃ bhuṃkṣvā''śramocitam ।
sarvaṃ te kuśalaṃ nvasti sukhyāśrame vasan bhava ।। 34।।
rājā satkāramādāya tvuvāca munisattamam ।
kṛpayā te ṛṣe sarvaṃ kuśalaṃ modate mama ।। 35।।
putraścā''jñākaraḥ samrāṭ sevako vijayī kṣiteḥ ।
khyāto mamādhiko jātaḥ saptadvīpaprapālane ।। 36।।
ekāhnā pṛthivīṃ sarvāmatītya bahuvistarām ।
punarāyāti śarvaryāṃ matpādābhyaṃgakāraṇāt ।। 37।।
tathā'yaṃ me śubho dehaḥ sarvarogavivarjitaḥ ।
aprameyaṃ mama sukhaṃ vaśagā ca priyā gṛhe ।। 38 ।।
yā vilokayate dṛṣṭyā māṃ sadā manmathā'dhikam ।
yatra yatra padaṃ devī vidadhāti sulakṣaṇā ।। 3 9।।
tatra tatra nidhānāni prakāśayati medinī ।
yasyāstvaṃgaṃ jarāhīnaṃ vartate navayauvanam ।।1.287.40 ।।
vinā'gninā'pi sā vipra! sādhayatyeva ṣaḍrasam ।
annaṃ pacati yatsvalpaṃ tasmin bhuñjanti koṭayaḥ ।।4 1 ।।
vājino vāraṇāścāpi dhanadhānyamanantakam ।
vartate ca janaḥ sarvo mamā''jñayā harervrate ।।42 ।।
ityetat kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ kena puṇyena me'sti vai ।
vada vicārya me puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvatra paratra vā ।।43 ।।
śrutvaitad brāhmaṇaḥ patnīvrataḥ prāgjanmasaṃcitam ।
cintayitvā nṛpaṃ prāha śūdro'bhūtvaṃ purā janau ।।44।।
duṣṭayā bhāryayā sākaṃ dāridryeṇa suduḥkhitaḥ ।
kadācid dvijasaṃsargāt tīrthayātrāṃ gato bhavān ।। 45।।
mathurāyāṃ tu viśrāntighaṭṭe yāmunake hrade ।
snātvā vārāhanilaye kathāṃ śuśrāva puṇyadām ।।46।।
aśūnyaśayanavrataviṣayāṃ haritoṣaṇīm ।
caturbhiḥ pāraṇairyasya vratasya pūrṇatā bhavet ।।47।।
tatkṛtaṃ bhavatā rājan tvatpatnyā ca vrataṃ gṛhe ।
śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya dvitīyāyāṃ mahīpate ।।48 ।।
grāhyametad vrataṃ puṇyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam ।
rājyadaṃ putradārādipradaṃ sampatkaraṃ śubham ।।49।।
ekabhuktaṃ prakartavyaṃ māsaikyaṃ vratinā tathā ।
nityaṃ viṣṇuḥ pūjanīyo lakṣmībhartā prage niśi ।। 1.287.5 0 ।।
phalaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpaiścāruraktānulepanaiḥ ।
śayyādānairvastradānaistathā brahmiṣṭhabhojanaiḥ ।।51 ।।
yadvā māse tu saptāhaṃ pratyupoṣaṇamācaret ।
saptāhānte pāraṇaṃ vai kuryāt sādhvadanottaram ।।52।।
evaṃ tu pāraṇācatuṣṭayaṃ māse vidhāpayet ।
aśaktaścet pratyahaṃ tu dugdhena vartayed vratī ।।53।।
śayane śubhaparyaṃke lakṣmīṃ dadyāttu viṣṇave ।
śayanaṃ tu vinā lakṣmīṃ śūnyaṃ viṣṇorbhavedataḥ ।।54।।
salakṣmīkaṃ tu śayanamaśūnyaśayanaṃ bhavet ।
yathā rājñyāśca rājñaśca sevakā nityamācaret ।।55।।
kaiṃkaryaṃ vividhaṃ sarvaṃ dadyātsarvaṃ śrīviṣṇave ।
tadā sarvaṃ tamāpnoti vratī janmāntare dhruvam ।।56 ।।
tattvayā prāgjanau sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ sodyāpanaṃ yataḥ ।
prāptaṃ tvatra mahad rājyaṃ puṣṭyā dānaphalaṃ hi tat ।।57।।
lakṣmīdānaṃ viṣṇave tu śayane dattavān bhavān ।
rājñī prāptā tvayā tasya phalena devatā yathā ।।58।।
yānavāhanasaudhādi dānārthaṃ kalpitaṃ tvayā ।
na tu dattaṃ tathāpyatra prāptaṃ saṃkalpajaṃ phalam ।।59।।
putraḥ prāptastvayā rājan viṣṇulakṣmīprasādataḥ ।
piturvacanakārī vai manovākkāyaśaktitaḥ ।।1.287.60 ।।
jāyate'syā'hanyahani snānaṃ bhāgīrathībhavam ।
tasmāt pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ dattaṃ paścājjanmani labhyate ।।61।।
iti te kathitaṃ vṛttaṃ kimanyat karavāṇi te ।
śrutvā prāha tadā rājā raivate bhavadarśanam ।।62।।
kartumicchāmi viprendra yadyājñā bhavato bhavet ।
ṛṣiḥ svastyastu te rājan gaccheti prāha cāśiṣā ।।63।।
rājā turaṃgamāruhya natvā śīghragatiryayau ।
raivatādrau bhavanāthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ yatra mohinī ।।64।।
pratīkṣate tu rājānaṃ gānaṃ miṣṭaṃ karoti sā ।
susvaraṃ tanmahārājo lakṣyīkṛtya yayau puraḥ ।।65।।
mṛgīkuṇḍe sthitāṃ taptasuvarṇābhāṃ tu kāminīm ।
ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣīyāṃ vahnijāmiva rūpiṇīm ।।66।।
dṛṣṭvaiva mohamāpanno viddhaḥ kāmaśareṇa ca ।
kāmajvarābhibhūtaḥ saḥ sasarpā'syāḥ samīpakam ।।67।।
jñātvā ceyaṃ ca taṃ kṣmāpaṃ kaṭākṣāni mumoca ha ।
netragaṇḍabhujāvakṣaḥkuṃbhā'dharanitambakān ।।68।।
pradhunvānā sumugdheva jagāma nṛpateḥ puraḥ ।
rukmāṃgadaṃ kāmataptaṃ prāhottiṣṭha vaśe tava ।।69।।
vartāmi ca karomyeva yadā diśa vane'tra mām ।
yadivātrchā surate'sti bhuṃkṣva māṃ ratidāsikām ।।1.287.70।।
rājā prāha tadā nārīṃ tapase yadyapi tvaham ।
samāgato'smyaraṇyeṣu tvāṃ tathāpi vilokya vai ।।71।।
jāto'smi kāmanāyuktaḥ pūrṇacandranibhānane! ।
yādṛśaṃ tvaṃ dhārayase rūpaṃ sarvavimohanam ।।72।।
nedṛśaṃ vai mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tvadyāpi brahmaṇaḥ kṛtau ।
kuru prasādaṃ rambhoru baddhacetasi vai mayi ।।73।।
āgacchāṃ'kaṃ mamā'mūlyaṃ svīyatvenā'pyalaṃkuru ।
ātmānamapi dāsyāmi kiṃ punardhanaratnakam ।।74।।
rājyaṃ veṣṭatamaṃ datvā nivasiṣye tvayā'tra vai ।
nṛpaṃ sā mohitaṃ cāti vijñāyā'vasaraṃ tathā ।।75।।
samuvāca smitaṃ kṛtvā brahmoktaṃ suvicintya ca ।
na rājyaṃ dhanaratnādi varaye vasudhādhipa ।।76।।
yadvadiṣyāmyahaṃ kāle tatkāryamaviśaṃkayā ।
bhajiṣyāmi na sandehaḥ kuruṣva samayaṃ mama ।।77।।
śapathaṃ kuru rājendrā'vaśyaṃ kurve itīraya ।
tadā bhogaṃ pradāsye'haṃ nā'sādhyaṃ te bhaveddhi tat ।।78।।
rājā prāha tadā kāmarūpayauvanamohitaḥ ।
yena santuṣyase devi! samayaṃ te karomyaham ।।79।।
śapathaṃ coccaran vacmi kariṣye vacanaṃ tava ।
mohinyapi ca taṃ prāha dīyatāṃ dakṣiṇaḥ karaḥ ।।1.287.80।।
dharmakarapradānena pratyayo vacane tava ।
bhavenme'tha na vaktā'syanṛtaṃ kāle vinirṇayaḥ ।।8 1।।
dṛḍho jātaḥ paṇo nau vai mārgo'yaṃ dharmasākṣikaḥ ।
rājā prāha ca tāṃ nārīṃ kimebhiḥ pratyayairdṛḍhaiḥ ।।82।।
janmaprabhṛti vāmoru nānṛtaṃ bhāṣitaṃ mayā ।
datto hyeṣa mayā hasto dakṣiṇaḥ puṇyadānakṛt ।।83।।
yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiñcit kṛtamājanma sundari ।
tatsarvaṃ tava vāmoru yadi kuryānna te vacaḥ ।।84।।
antare hyeṣa datto me dharmo bhāryā bhavā'ṅgane ।
rukmāṃgado mahārājaḥ kathayāmi vanāntare ।।85।।
pratyuttarapradānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ।
nṛpeṇaivaṃ samādiṣṭā mohinyāhottaraṃ vacaḥ ।।86।।
ahaṃ brahmabhavā rājan tvadarthaṃ samupāgatā ।
śrutvā kīrtiṃ smaropetā raivataṃ kanakācalam ।।87।।
sampūjayantī deveśaṃ gītadānena śaṃkaram ।
yena tuṣṭena devena hyupakāraḥ kṛto mayi ।।88।।
yadbhavānacireṇaiva prāpto'sīpsitasundaraḥ ।
abhiprīto'si me rājannabhiprītā hyahaṃ tava ।।89।।
mā śaṃkāṃ kuru rājendra kumārīṃ viddhyakalmaṣām ।
udvahasva mahīpāla gṛhyoktavidhinā'tra mām ।।1.287.90 ।।
āśrutya rājñā tatraiva vidhinā sā vivāhitā ।
bhavena viṣṇunā dāmodareṇa sa vivāhitaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
vanyamūlaphalānyattvā dampatīdharmamāśritau ।
remāte vividhairbhāvairnavayauvanagarbhitaiḥ ।।92।।
mohinī taṃ kāmabhāvaiḥ ramayatyatyaharniśam ।
satyalokāttathā svargād bhogyānādāya cottamān ।।93।।
sevate taṃ patiṃ bhuṃkte bhogānamaradurlabhān ।
rukmagrāmo navastatra racito divyanākibhiḥ ।।94।।
divyadāsīdāsabhṛtyaiḥ suramyasaudhapaṃktibhiḥ ।
yānavāhanakodyānaiḥ kāmadhenugajādibhiḥ ।।95।।
tatra bhojyādanapeyopadhāryāmbarabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
rājasairdravavastvādyairna nyūnatvamabhūttadā ।।96।।
kāmabhoge ratayośca tayorvai varṣaviṃśatiḥ ।
samayaḥ samatīto'bhūt tṛpto rājā'pyabhūttayā ।।97।।
aho rūpaṃ madarthaṃ vai brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ śubham ।
hastihastasannikāśe jaṃghe kāṃcanasannibhe ।।98।।
dantapaṃktiścandrapaṃktirgūḍhe gulphe tu mohake ।
netre paṃkajavistāre stanau kāṃcanakuṃbhakau ।।99।।
kaṭirmṛgendrakaṭivat svalpaṃ madhyaṃ susaurabham ।
kṛtā'rtho'haṃ khalvanayā deyaṃ yāciṣyate tu yat। ।। 1.287.100 ।।
durlabhaṃ cāpi dāsyāmi tvadeyamapi sarvathā ।
yāciṣyate jīvitaṃ me dāsyāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 101 ।।
evaṃ suratamūḍhasya rājño rukmāṃgadasya tu ।
catvāri paṃcavarṣāṇāṃ vyatītāni nimeṣavat ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rukmāṃgadaḥ putre rājyaṃ vinyasya vanaṃ jagāma, tatrāśvapaṭṭasarastīravāsipatnīvratarṣikathitasya rukmāṃgadapūrvajanmādeḥ śravaṇam, tato raivatācale mohinyāḥ samāgamaḥ, samayaśapathaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 287 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 287 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 288
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 289 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tadā rājyaṃ cakre dharmāṃgadaḥ sutaḥ ।
piturniyogāt saṃkurvan kārayan harivāsaram ।। 1 ।।
dharme bhāgavate saṃrakṣayan sarvāḥ prajāḥ sutaḥ ।
viṣṇudinavratārthaṃ vādayate paṭahaṃ sadā ।। 2 ।।
rājāpi vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ karoti niyamena vai ।
anyavratāni santyajya bhuṃkte patnīṃ suyauvanām ।। 3 ।।
ekadā''śvinasamaye mohinī sarvabhāvataḥ ।
rājānaṃ ramayāmāsa divyasaukhyaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 4 ।।
pārthivaścātimugdho'pi vrataṃ nopekṣate hareḥ ।
krīḍāṃ tyajati kṣmāpālo daśamyādidinatraye ।। 5 ।।
viṣṇordinaṃ na tyajati janmamṛtyunikṛntanam ।
tāvat prāptaḥ prabodhāya viṣṇormāsastu kārtikaḥ ।। 6 ।।
yasmin kṛtaṃ tu sukṛtaṃ yaiḥ kaiścinmanujairiha ।
akṣayaṃ hi bhavet sarvaṃ viṣṇulokapradāyakam ।। 7 ।।
iti vicārya nṛpatirmohinīṃ vākyamabravīt ।
rataṃ devi tvayā sārdhaṃ mayā samvatsarān bahūn ।। 8 ।।
tavā'pamānabhītena noktaṃ kiṃcidapi kvacit ।
tvayyāsaktasya me subhru! bahavaḥ kārtikā gatāḥ ।। 9 ।।
na vrataṃ kārtike jātaṃ me māsaṃ vā'rdhamāsakam ।
so'haṃ kārtikamicchāmi savrataṃ paryupāsitum ।। 1.288.10 ।।
avrataḥ kārtiko yasya gatastasya vṛthā gatam ।
madyamāṃsavyavāyāḍhyā api kārtikasadvratāḥ ।। 11 ।।
bhūtvā śuddhā gatāste vai śāśvataṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ।
kārtike dīpadānena dātā vai divamāvrajet ।। 13 ।।
paradīpaprabodhena daridro'pi divaṃ vrajet ।
puṣkare pūrṇimāṃ kṛtvā'janmapāpātpramucyate ।। 1 4 ।।
vratopavāsaniyamārcanadānādisatkṛtaiḥ ।
gacchati kārtiko yasya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।। 14 ।।
kārtike kṛcchrasevī yaḥ prājāpatyaparo'pi vā ।
ekāntaropavāsī vā trirātropoṣito'pi vā ।। 15।।
saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā pakṣaṃ māsamupoṣitaḥ ।
phalāhāro naro yāti sa viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ।। 16 ।।
ekabhaktena naktenā'yācitena vratasthitaiḥ ।
dharā dārā suto rājyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyamavāpyate ।। 17।।
kārtiko bhaktidaḥ puṇyo vratadānārcanādibhiḥ ।
tasmin haridinaṃ puṇyaṃ tathaiva dinapañcakam ।। 18 ।।
prabodhinīṃ jāgarāḍhyāṃ kṛtvā muktiṃ prayāti vai ।
kārtike varjayettailaṃ madhu sūpaṃ ca maithunam ।। 19 ।।
niṣpāvān rājasān bhogān varjayettu prayatnataḥ ।
kārtike tvarjitā dīkṣā nṝṇāṃ janmani kṛntanī ।। 1.288.20 ।।
paśuyonimavāpnoti dīkṣayā rahito janaḥ ।
ekādaśyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ dīkṣito yāti cākṣaram ।। 21 ।।
kuṃbhān datvā jalapūrṇān prayāti harimandiram ।
samvatsaravratānāṃ tu samāptiḥ kārtike'rcanam ।।22।।
udyāpanādikaṃ sarvaṃ sampūrṇaphaladaṃ bhavet ।
naktavratī ca ṣaḍrasairbālān sādhūn prabhojayet ।।23 ।।
ayācite tvanaḍvāhaṃ saddvijāya pradāpayet ।
naivedyāśī bhaved yastu gāṃ pradadyātsadakṣiṇām ।।।24।।
dhātrīsnāne jano dadyāt pāyasaṃ picchalaṃ dadhi ।
phalānāṃ niyame tatra phalāni tvarpayettathā ।।25।।।
tailatyāge ghṛtaṃ dadyād ghṛtatyāge payastathā ।
dhānyānāṃ niyame śālīṃstattaddhānyamathāpi vā ।।26।।
bhūśāyitve saparyaṃkāṃ śayyāṃ dadyādalaṃkṛtām ।
patrabhojī pradadyādvai pātrāṇi saghṛtāni vai ।।27।।
maune ghaṇṭāṃ hiraṇyaṃ vā tilānvāpi pradāpayet ।
prātaḥsnāne hayaṃ dadyānniḥsnehe ghṛtasaktukān ।।28।।
nakhakeśā'vapane tu darpaṇaṃ mṛttikāṃ dadet ।
pādatrāṇā'grahe dadyādupānahau ca pāduke ।।29।।।
lavaṇādiparityāge dātavyā gauḥ sudugdhadā ।
dīpadātā pradadyādvai kāṃcanaṃ devamūrtaye ।।1.288.30।।
chatraṃ ca cāmare dadyāt kṣaumavastrāṇi cārpayet ।
trirātravratakartā tu dadyācchayyāmalaṃkṛtām ।।3 1 ।।
saptarātropavāsī tu ' śibikāṃ chatramarpayet ।
pakṣadinopavāsī tu yānaṃ dadyācca hastinam ।।32।।
māsopavāsakartā tu gṛhaṃ sarvasvamarpayet ।
ajāvikaṃ tvekabhakte phalāhāre suvarṇakam ।।3 3 ।।
śākāhāre phalaṃ dadyātpātraṃ vā'nyat samarpayet ।
evaṃ yathā dhanasmṛddhistathā dadyād vratānugam ।।34।।
labhyate vratakartā'tra rājyaṃ dārā dhanādikam ।
tasmānmohini! kartā'smi kārtike vratasevanam ।। 35 ।।
vratopavāsaniyamaiḥ kārtiko yasya gacchati ।
devo vaimāniko bhūtvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।।36।।
tasmānmohaṃ parityajyā''jñāpaya kārtike vrate ।
ahaṃ vratadharaścaiva bhaviṣye haripūjane ।। 37।।
śrutvaitatpratikūlaṃ sā mohinyāha nijārthinī ।
na vrataṃ hi tvayā kāryaṃ yadi māmicchasi priyām ।।38।।
dānaṃ prapālanaṃ yuddhaṃ kāryatrayaṃ tu bhūbhujām ।
vratādikaraṇaṃ rājñāṃ noktaṃ kvāpi nidarśane ।।39।।
muhūrtamapi rājendra na śaknomi tvayā vinā ।
sthātuṃ kamalanābhābha kiṃ punarmāsasaṃkhyayā ।।1.288.40।।
tvayi vrate kṛte'vaśya maraṇaṃ me bhavennanu ।
kariṣyāvastato vārdhakye vrataṃ kārtikasya vai ।।4 1।।
śrutvā prāha tadā rājā mohinyāṃ vacanottamam ।
na kariṣye vrataṃ subhru kariṣye tava sammatam ।।42।।।
śrutvā tu mohinī hṛṣṭā saṃśliṣṭā rahasi sthitam ।
ramayāmāsa tanvaṃgī kāmarītividhānataḥ ।।4 3 ।।
tasyaivaṃ ramamāṇasya samāyātā prabodhinī ।
rukmāṃgadasya karṇābhyāṃ paṭahadhvanirāgataḥ ।। 44।।
prātarharerdinaṃ lokāstiṣṭhadhvaṃ tvekabhojanāḥ ।
akṣāralavaṇāḥ sarve haviṣyānnaniṣeviṇaḥ ।। 45।।
avanitalpaśayanāḥ kāmasaṃgavivarjitāḥ ।
smaradhvaṃ devadeveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।।46।।
sakṛdbhojanasaṃyuktā upavāsaṃ kariṣyatha ।
akṛtaśrāddhanicayā gacchadhvaṃ śrīhareḥ padam ।।47।।
prātaḥ kārtikaśu×Vr̤M×klā'sti tvekādaśī prabodhinī ।
yāstūpoṣya harerdhāma vidhūya pāpajālakam ।।48 ।।
kurudhvaṃ śrīhareḥ pūjāmātmavittena mānavāḥ ।
vastraiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpairvaracandanakuṃkumaiḥ ।।49।।
naivedyaiśca phalairyaṣṭvā gacchadhvaṃ śrīhareḥ padam ।
yo na kuryādvaco rukmāṃgadasya haridhāmadam ।।1.288.5 0 ।।
sa me daṇḍyaśca vadhyaśca dharmāṃgado bravīmyaham ।
iti śrutvā paṭahasya dharmyāṃ vai ghoṣaṇāṃ svakām ।।51 ।।
rukmāṃgada udatiṣṭhanmohinīśayanād drutam ।
prāha prātarharerahni bhaviṣyatyaghanāśanam ।।52।।
saṃyato'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi kṣamyatāṃ kṣamyatāmiti ।
iyamekādaśī kāryā bandhachetrī gatipradā ।।53 ।।
mayā saha viśālākṣi tvaṃ cāpi tamadhokṣajam ।
ārādhaya hṛṣīkeśamupavāsaparāyaṇā ।।54।।
yena yāsyasi nirvāṇaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam ।
punā rājyaṃ punaḥ svargaṃ punaryadvā pramokṣaṇam ।।55।।
mohinyuvāca sādhūktaṃ tvayā vratārcanaṃ hareḥ ।
janmamṛtyujarāchedi kariṣye vai tavā'jñayā ।।56 ।।
pratijñā yā tvayā pūrvaṃ kṛtā'smin raivate girau ।
karapradānasahitā bhavatā sukṛtāṃ'kitā ।।57।।
tasyāstu samayaḥ prāpto dīyatāṃ sahi me tvayā ।
anyathā''janmanaḥ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ te nāśameṣyati ।।58 ।।
śrutvā smṛtvā''ha rukmāṃgaḥ kartā'smi tvanmanogatam ।
nā'deyaṃ vidyate kiñcittubhyaṃ me jīvitāvadhi ।।59।।
kiṃ punā rājyanagaraṃ vittaṃ vā'nyacca bhāmini ।
mohinyuvāca saṃprāptaṃ jñātvā hyavasaraṃ śubham ।।1.288.60।।
nātha kānta priya rājan jīviteśa ratipriya! ।
nopoṣyo vāsaro viṣṇorbhoktavyā yadyahaṃ priyā ।।61 ।।
vinābhūtā bhaviṣyāmi tvatsaṃyogaṃ vinā nṛpa! ।
tasmānmāṃ yadi vāñchethā bhoktumājīvanaṃ priyām ।।।62।।
mayā'vaśyaṃ ca vastavyamāmṛtyuṃ tvadgṛhe nṛpa ।
tadā tyajopavāsaṃ vai bhujyatāṃ harivāsare ।।63।।
eṣa eva varo deyo mayā saṃprārthitaḥ purā ।
na ced dāsyasi mohādvā bhūtvā'nṛtavacā bhavān ।।64।।
yāsyate narake ghore yāvadābhūtasamplavam ।
patnīhānau vratahānau vacohānau balābale ।।65।।
dṛṣṭā'dṛṣṭau vṛṣā'dharmau vicāryeṣṭatamaṃ kuru ।
rājovāca tvayā subhru ruddhaḥ kārtikasadvrate ।।66।।
rodhayasi punarekādaśyāmapi kathaṃ priye ।
vratapuṇyena sukhinau jātau sva iti cintaya ।।67।।
dharmasvasā vidheḥ putrī bhūtvaivaṃ tvayi nocitam ।
dharmarakṣākaro bhūtvā dharmavighnaṃ karoṣi kim ।।68।।
janmaprabhṛtyahaṃ naiva bhuktavān harivāsare ।
sa cā'dyā'haṃ tavā'dhīnaḥ kathaṃ bhoktā harerdine ।।69।।
antime svāyuṣo bhāge svarṇarekhāprasevanam ।
bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ yuktaṃ nityaṃ ca harisevanam ।।1.288.70।।
na kṛtaṃ yanmayā bālye yauvane vaibhave sati ।
tadahaṃ vanamadhye'dya kathaṃ kuryāṃ jugupsitam ।।71 ।।
mā kuruṣva vrataṃ bhaṃgaṃ mā kuruṣvāgrahaṃ tathā ।
yadanyadicchasi subhru dātā'haṃ rājyasampadām ।।72।।
vimānaṃ saṃgṛhāṇedaṃ dolāṃ vyomavihāriṇīm ।
kalpalatārasaṃ bhuṃkṣva mā vrate vighnamācara । ।73।।
ātmamāṃsaṃ naro bhuṃkte yo bhuṃkte harivāsare ।
trailokyaghātinaḥ pāpaṃ maithune harivāsare ।।74।।
gocāralope yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ kūṭasākṣike ।
nikṣepahārake cāpi tathā viśvāsaghātake ।।75।।
hatyākāriṇi yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ gurunindake ।
tatsarvaṃ pātakaṃ tvanne saṃsthitaṃ harivāsare ।।76।।
evaṃ jānan viśālākṣi kathaṃ bhokṣyāmi pātakam ।
evaṃ jñānavatī tvaṃ ca kathaṃ nāśayasi vratam ।।77।।
mohinyuvāca tacchrutvā bādhadharmān nṛpaṃ prati ।
ekabhuktena naktena yadvā tvayārcitena ca ।।78।।
phalairvātūpavāsena dvādaśīṃ na vilaṃghayet ।
gurvīṇīnā gṛhasthānāṃ kṣīṇānāṃ rogiṇāṃ tathā ।।79।।
śiśūnāṃ valigātrāṇāṃ saṃgrāmakṣitisevinām ।
yajñabhogodyatānāṃ ca pātivratyāḍhyayoṣitām ।।1.288.80 ।।
yuvatīstrīpatīnāṃ ca na yuktaṃ samupoṣaṇam ।
kimanyairbahubhirbhūpa vākyālāpakṛtairmayā ।।81।।
bhojane'tra kṛte prītirekādaśyāṃ tvayā mama ।
na prītiryadi me chitvā śiraḥ svaṃ hi prayacchasi ।।82।।
na kariṣyasi ced rājan bhojanaṃ harivāsare ।
tadā tvasatyavacaso dehaṃ na sparśayāmi te ।।83।।
satyena sūryastapati śaśī satyena śobhate ।
satyadharmasthitā bhūmiḥ sarvaṃ dhārayate jagat ।।84।।
vāyurvātyapi satyena satyena jvalate'nalaḥ ।
satyādhāramidaṃ sarvaṃ yathākāryaṃ vyavasthitam ।।85।।
sindhurna calate satyād vindhyaḥ satyānna vardhate ।
vṛkṣāḥ satyasamācārā ṛtumāsādya puṣpiṇaḥ ।।86।।
aśvamedhā'yutebhyo'pi satyameva viśiṣyate ।
asatyavacaso rājan sarvaṃ śīghraṃ vinaśyati ।।87।।
mā bhūt tādṛk ca te rājanśocāmi bahulābhakṛt ।
bahūnāṃ bhojane lābho dṛśyate'to haṭho mama ।।88।।
matpitrāpi tathaivoktaṃ satyenaivocyate mayā ।
yadi cette na viśvāso yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।89।।
mohinītthamabhidhāya pitṛkāryaprasādhinī ।
virarāma yadā lakṣmi! rājā cintāṃ jagāma vai ।।1.288.90।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rukmāṃgadasya samāhātmyakārtiṃkavratecchāyāṃ mohinyā tannirodhanaṃ punaśca svapaṭahaghoṣaṇāyāṃ prabodhinīvratānumatiyācanāyāṃ mohinyā kṛtastadvirodha ityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāśītyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।288।।


← adhyāyaḥ 288 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 289
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 290 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha lakṣmi! daśamyāṃ kārtike dharmāṃgadaḥ prage ।
paṭahaṃ vādayitvā vāraṇopari praghoṣayan ।। 1 ।।
mā bhoktavyaṃ janaiḥ kaiścidekādaśyāṃ harerdine ।
sainyaṃ prajāśca nītvā sa yayau raivatatīrthake ।। 2 ।।
kartuṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ raivatādreḥ sandhāvalīyutaḥ ।
ekādaśīṃ samārabhya pūrṇimāvadhipañcake ।। 3 ।।
kartuṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tatrā''yānti tīrthāni devatāḥ ।
prabodhinyāṃ raivatādrau brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ । । 4 । ।
ṛṣayo vasavaḥ sādhyā maruto munayastathā ।
pitaro nidhayaḥ kāṣṭhā grahā rudrāśca siddhayaḥ । । 5 । ।
kṛttikāścandranakṣatramaṇḍalaṃ surakoṭayaḥ ।
yakṣarākṣasapaiśācā bhūtapretavināyakāḥ । । 6 । ।
kūṣmāṇḍāścāpi vetālā gaṇeśāśca gaṇādayaḥ ।
hanūmanto mahālakṣmyaḥ paryo yoginya ityapi । । 7 । ।
durgāścaṇḍyo mānavāśca devā nadyaḥ sarāṃsi ca ।
samudrāḥ parvatāḥ sthalyo dvīpāḥ kṣetrāṇi kheṭakāḥ ।। 8 । ।
puryo'raṇyāni divasā niśā divā vratānyapi ।
evamanye vyomasaṃsthāḥ pātālasthā bhujaṃgamāḥ । । 9 । ।
satyaḥ sādhvyaśca bhaktānyo nyāsinyaśca kumārikāḥ ।
dehakṛṣṇārpaṇaparā narā nāryaḥ prayānti ca ।। 1.289.10 ।।
cāraṇyaścāpi kinnaryo gāndharvyo dāsikāstathā ।
vaiṣṇavāḥ śāṃkarāḥ saurā gāṇapatyāśca śaktigāḥ ।। 11 ।।
cārvākā bījamārgāśca nārasiṃhāśca rāmiṇaḥ ।
dāttātreyāḥ kāpilāścārhatā bauddhāḥ śivāśritāḥ ।। 12।।
mahānto guravo dharmācāryāścatuḥpumarthakāḥ ।
ābhīrā ūraṇavārā gopālā vāmamārgiṇaḥ ।। 13 ।।
mahābhāgavātā merā nartakā naṭajātayaḥ ।
aghorapathalambāśca gāruḍā bhairavāśritāḥ ।। 14।।
haṃsāḥ paramahaṃsāśca sadaṇḍāḥ kuladevinaḥ ।
vidyādharāśca gaṇikā bahurūpāśca nāṭikāḥ ।। 1 5।।
gorakṣāḥ kāravaḥ sāmbāścāturvarṇyāśramānugāḥ ।
pradakṣiṇārthamāyānti raivatādrau tu kārtike ।। 16।।
jalānnavastradehādyarpakā yatra tvasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
āyānti puṇyamokṣārthaṃ gurvarpaṇavidhāyinaḥ ।। 17।।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīharirnārāyaṇāvirbhāvamūrtayaḥ ।
āyānti janamokṣārtha pradakṣiṇasavotsukāḥ ।। 18।।
saurāṣṭramaṇḍalaṃ tasya tīrthakṣetrasamaṃ tathā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīyugatra parvate ।। 19 ।।
mūrdhni saṃrājate divyaḥ sahagolokamaṇḍalaḥ ।
ekā pradakṣiṇā yena kṛtā tena tataḥ khalu । । 1.289.20 ।।
jīveśabrahmalokānāṃ kṛtā syātsā pradakṣiṇā ।
yatphalaṃ labhyate brahmadhāmnaḥ pradkṣiṇābhavam ।।21 ।।
tadatra labhyate puṇyaṃ saṃsārabhavavārakam ।
iti matvā rājaputro dharmāṃgadaḥ pradakṣiṇām ।। 22।।
kartuṃ daśamyāṃ tvāyāto yoginīparvatāgrataḥ ।
māhīṣaparvatapārśve svarṇarekhānadītaṭe ।। 23 ।।
mahodyāne tvāmravaṇe niśāṃ vyagamayat tataḥ ।
prātardāmodaraṃ dṛṣṭvā snātvā kuṇḍe bhaveśvaram ।। 24।।।
nṛsiṃhaṃ ca tathā dṛṣṭvā mṛgīkuṇḍaṃ vyalokayat। ।
dharmāṃgado janagāthāṃ śrutavāँstatra śobhanām ।। 25 । ।
rājā rukmāṃgadaścātra mohinyā saha rājate ।
brahmaputryā prasevito dharmāṃgadapitā'sti yaḥ ।। 26 ।।
saḥ svapaṭahaghoṣeṇa na bhuṃkte harivāsare ।
nirodhayati taṃ nārī bhoktavyaṃ harivāsare ।। 27।।
kīdṛśī sā brahmaputrī pṛthvyāṃ rājñā vadhūkṛtā ।
tapo'rthaṃ nirgataścāpi vadhūṃ kṛtvā ca yāṃ punaḥ ।। 28 ।।
sevate khalu rukmāṃgo harerdinaṃ jahāti na ।
draṣṭavyā sā devaputrī tvitikṛtvā janā yayuḥ ।। 29।।
dharmāgado'pi sainyena svamātrā sahito yayau ।
suvarṇarakṣāsaritaścottare sarasastaṭe ।। 1.289.30 ।।
yatra divyo mahān saudho vairājasyeva rājate ।
grāmo divyaḥ svaḥpatīnāṃ vimānamiva rājate ।। 31 ।।
brahmaṇā viṣṇunā śaṃbhunā pradattaṃ svaloṃkajam ।
divyopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ satyalokīyavastujam ।। 3 2।।
dāsadāsyastathā divyāḥ sarvaṃ divyaṃ virājate ।
carmacakṣurjanaiḥ sarvamadṛśyaṃ yaddhi vartate ।। 33 ।।
dharmāṃgadena tatsarvaṃ lokitaṃ pitranugrahāt ।
mahadāścaryamāpanno vavande caraṇau pituḥ ।। 34।।
sandhyāvalyā'pi svapatyuścaraṇau vanditau mudā ।
brahmaputrī vavande tāṃ jyeṣṭhā svasāramityatha ।। 35 ।।
svasrā tvāśīrvādamukhyairmohinī cābhivardhitā ।
vṛttāntaṃ kuśalaṃ cāpi jñātvā parasparaṃ tataḥ ।। 36 ।।
premamagnāśca te sarve pradakṣiṇārthaṃ niryayuḥ ।
mohinī tu haṭhāt pradakṣiṇārthaṃ na yayau tadā ।। 37 ।।
atha dharmāgadenā'syāścaraṇau vanditau mudā ।
heturjijñāsito manobhagnatāyāstadagrataḥ ।। 38 ।।
rukmāṃgadena tatsarvaṃ vijñāpitaṃ vratātmakam ।
vratanirodhayitryāstacchratvā''ścaryaṃ yayurjanāḥ ।। 39 ।।
rukmāṃgadastadā prāha tvanunīya śubhaṃ vacaḥ ।
mohini! kuru yātrāṃ tvaṃ raivatādreḥ pradakṣiṇam ।।1.289.40 ।।
vrataṃ harerdinasyāpi prabodhinyāḥ parātparam ।
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi ।।41 ।।
akāryakaraṇejantorgosahasravadhaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
jānannapi kathaṃ devi! bhokṣye'haṃ harivāsare ।।42।।
puroḍāśo'pi vedhoje! samprāpte bhagavaddine ।
abhakṣyeṇa samaṃ proktaḥ kiṃ punaścānnabhakṣaṇam ।।43।।
kṣīṇānāṃ phalamūlādi payāadi prabhojanam ।
prakīrtitaṃ vrate devi! saśaktānāṃ nahi kvacit ।।44।।
saśaktānāṃ vrate'danaṃ narakāyaiva kevalam ।
mā''grahaṃ kuru satyasthe! vratabhaṃgo bhavenmama ।।45।।
yadanyad rocate tubhyaṃ tatkarttā'smi na saṃśayaḥ ।
mohinyuvāca śṛṇvatsu rājñīdharmāṃgadādiṣu ।। 86।।
ṛṣimunisurapitṛjaṃgamasthāvarādiṣu ।
na tvanyad rocate rājan vinā vai bhojanaṃ tava ।।47।।
jīvitasyāpi dānena na me kiṃcitprayojanam ।
na ca vedeṣu dṛṣṭo'yamupavāso harerdine ।।48।।
vedabāhyaṃ kathaṃ dharmaṃ bhavāँścaritumicchati ।
śṛṇvantu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve vedān kṛtvā'yamagrataḥ ।।49।।
satyaṃ vadati rājā kiṃ nā'haṃ bhokṣye harerdine ।
sarvaṃ vai sthāvaraṃ yadvā jaṃgamaṃ tvannajīvanam ।।1.289.50 ।।
mṛtā api diviṣadaḥ prīyante'nnairjalairapi ।
pipīlikādayaścānnaṃ mukhenādāya kaṣṭataḥ ।।5 1।।
cāturmāsyārthamevaite śītartukṣapaṇāya ca ।
praviśanti bile tatra sañcinvantyadanāharṇam ।।52।।
anne vai prāṇināṃ prāṇā annaṃ kasya na rocate ।
rājā khādati nā'nnādi samprāpte harivāsare ।। 93।।
tapasvināṃ tu sādhūnāṃ yujyate'nnavivarjanam ।
upavāsādikaraṇaṃ bhūbhujāṃ kiṃ nu vaidikam ।।54।।
paradharmo na cā''caryo duḥkhadaśca bhayāvahaḥ ।
so'yamadya mahīpālo yaterdharme vyavasthitaḥ ।।55।।
annātprabhavati prāṇaḥ prāṇāddehabalādikam ।
balena nṛpadharmāśca taddhīnaḥ paribhūyate ।।56।।
evaṃ jñātvā mayā rājā bodhyamāno na buddhyati ।
atrārthe brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pramāṇaṃ na tu bhāminī ।।57।।
yāthātathyaṃ vadantvatra vaidikaṃ tat karomyaham ।
patnīvratavaśiṣṭhādyā brāhmaṇā nṛpamabruvan ।।58।।
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyamiti yaḥ śapathastava ।
na kṛto vedadṛṣṭyā vai svabuddhyaiva prakalpitaḥ ।।59।।
sāgnīnāṃ prāśanaṃ proktaṃ havyasya sandhyayoḥ kila ।
pratyahaṃ homaśiṣṭasya bhoktṛtvaṃ vedasammatam ।।1.289.60 ।।
viśeṣeṇa nṛpāṇāṃ tu nityayajñaprakāriṇām ।
vadātra bhūmipālānāṃ kathamuktamupoṣaṇam ।। 61 ।।
vaidiko'vaidikā vāpi yastvayā śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
paripūrṇo bhavatvadya vākyenaiva dvijanmanām ।। 62 ।।
vratabhaṃgo na te'stīha bhuṃkṣva viprādibhiḥ saha ।
paritāpo na te kāryo vipravākyaṃ mahattamam ।।6 3 ।।
vayaṃ hi vedadraṣṭāro brahmavākyaṃ janārdanaḥ ।
yo'nyathā manute viprād rākṣasīṃ yonimāpnuyāt ।। 64।।
śrutvaitad brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vaidikānāṃ vacastataḥ ।
ruvamāṃgadaḥ praṇipatya vedadraṣṭṝnuvāca ha ।। 65।।
yūyaṃ vedapradaṣṭāro vaidikaṃ vadatha dhruvam ।
anādṛtya paraṃ vedamupadeśo na vaḥ kvacit ।। 66 ।।
nāradarṣistathā kātyāyano vaśiṣṭha ityapi ।
brahmācātha mahādevo ye tvanye'tra samāgatāḥ ।।67।।
śṛṇutaiṣāṃ tu vākyāni harerdine vratakṛte ।
nāradasya vacastatra prathamaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥ ।। 68।।
nityaṃ bhaktisamāyuktairnarairviṣṇuparāyaṇaiḥ ।
pakṣe pakṣe ca kartavyamekādaśyāmupoṣaṇam ।। 69 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ tu yo bhuṃkte naro'nnaṃ sa tu pātakī ।
viṇmūtrapūyavāhinyāṃ patatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।1.289.7 0 ।।
anukalpo nṛṇāṃ proktaḥ kṣīṇānāṃ varavarṇini ।
mūlaṃ phalaṃ payastoyamupabhogyaṃ bhavecchubhe ।।7 1 ।।
natveva bhojanaṃ kaiścidekādaśyāṃ budhairmatam ।
śayane ca madutthāne matpārśvaparivartane ।।72 ।।
naro mūlaphalāhārī hṛdi śalyaṃ mamā'rpayet ।
daśamyādi mahīpāla । tridināni vivarjayet ।।73 ।।
gandhatāmbūlapuṣpādi strīsaṃbhogaṃ divāniśam ।
jāgaraṃ viṣṇupūjāṃ ca vinā tvardhaphalaṃ vratam ।।74।।
atastābhyāṃ yutopoṣyā vaiṣṇavena harestithiḥ ।
vratāni viṣṇubhaktānāṃ nityānīmāni saṃjaguḥ ।।75 ।।
ekādaśyo'khilāḥ śuddhā dvādaśī vāmanasya tu ।
śrīrāmādityasajjanmanavamī divyasiddhidā ।।76।।
kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamī cātha nṛsiṃhasya caturdaśī ।
śivarātriścetimukhyavratānyuktāni tattvataḥ ।।77 ।।
iti nāradavākyāni hyatha kātyāyanasya ca ।
sarve śṛṇvantu munayo bhavanto vedadṛṣṭayaḥ ।।78 ।।
ekādaśyāmahorātraṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret ।
ekādaśyāmupavaset pakṣayorubhayorapi ।।79।।
upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ ।
vaśiṣṭhasyāpi vākyaṃ vai śṛṇvantu vedadṛṣṭayaḥ ।।1.289.8 0 ।।
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ rājan dvādaśīdivase tathā ।
tajjapyajapanadhyānatatkathāśravaṇādayaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
upavāsakṛtāmete guṇāścānye dayādayaḥ ।
vedhovākyaṃ tu śṛṇvantu ṛṣayo vedadṛṣṭayaḥ ।। 8 2।।
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca ।
ekenaivopavāsena prabodhinyāṃ labhennaraḥ ।।8 2 ।।
prabodhavāsare viṣṇorvidhivat samupoṣayet ।
tāmupoṣya harerbhaktyā durlabhaṃ na bhavet kvacit ।।84।।
śivavākyaṃ ca śṛṇvantu bhavanto vedadṛṣṭayaḥ ।
na śaivo na ca sauro'sau na śākto gaṇasevakaḥ ।।85।।
yo bhuṃkte vāsare viṣṇorjñeyaḥ paśvadhiko hi saḥ ।
vipriyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena duṣṭenaiva tu pāpinā ।।86 ।।
madbhaktibalamāśritya yo bhuṃkte vai harerdine ।
iti bhavanto vaktāro niṣeddhāro'pi te punaḥ ।।87।।
kathaṃ tatra suviśvāso mayā kāryo vratārdane ।
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ bhavanto mārgadarśinaḥ ।।88 ।।
viparītā yadi syuste jagadāndhyaṃ samāpnuyāt ।
akāryakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ jīveccharadāṃ śatam ।।89।।
yuṣmākaṃ tāni vākyāni brūta cā'vaidikāni kim ।
so'haṃ kathaṃ karomyatra tvabhakṣyā'nnasya bhakṣaṇam ।। 1.289.90 ।।
kathaṃ cāpi vrataṃ tyakṣye vimārgasthajanoktitaḥ ।
bhavadbhirnocitaṃ vaktuṃ pratikūlaṃ vratāpaham ।। 91 ।।
devā vā dānavā daityā gāndharvā rākṣasāśca vā ।
siddhā vā brāhmaṇā vāpi pitā me jananī ca me ।। 9 2।।
harirvāpi haro viṣṇurmohinījanako'pi vā ।
ṛṣayo'pi vadeyuścenno bhokṣye harivāsare ।। 93 ।।
yo hi rukmāṃgado rājā vikhyāto haribhaktimān ।
vratapratijñāṃ viphalāṃ na kadācit kariṣyati ।।94।।
sūryastu kṛṣṇatāṃ gacchenmeruḥ sthānāccaled yadi ।
samudraḥ śuṣkatāṃ yāyād vahniḥ śaityānvito bhavet ।। 95 ।।
viparītā bhavantaḥ syurmohinī mriyate'pi vā ।
tathāpi na tyaje viprā vratamekādaśīdine ।। 96।।
āraṭyatai paṭahena prasiddhirbhuvaneṣu me ।
daṇḍyo vadhyo vivāsyaśca hyannādo harivāsare ।। 97।।
evaṃ khyāte yadi bhoktā'nnasya syāṃ harivāsare ।
amedhyaliptaḥ paṭaho bhaveddhoṣo'nṛtānvitaḥ ।।98 ।।
kīrtiḥ kaluṣatāṃ gacched yāmye vāsaśca me bhavet ।
vṛthā sūtā janitrī syānnirāśāḥ pitaraḥ surāḥ । । 99 । ।
harṣaṃ gacched yamaścāpi vratabhaṃgaśca me bhavet ।
mohinī kṛtakṛtyā syād vāntyāśīva bhavāmyaham । । 1.289.100 ।।
rājā dharmadharo'haṃ so'dharmapoṣṭā kathaṃ bhavet ।
na vedā nāpi santaste munayaḥ ṛṣayo'pi na ।। 101 । ।
ye maṇḍayanti kṛṣṇasya vāsare bhojanakriyām ।
ityabhidhāya natvā ca virarāma nṛpastadā ।। 102 ।।
śrutvaitad brāhmaṇā devāḥ praśaśaṃsurnṛpaṃ mudā ।
kintu kopasuraktākṣī mohinī jvalitāntarā ।। 103 ।।
śṛṇvatsu teṣu sarveṣu bhartāraṃ samabhāṣata ।
svakāryasādhinī viṣṇuvrataghnī ca kṣurāntarā ।। 104 । । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne paṭahaghoṣaṃ kurvato dharmāṃgadasya kārtike raivatapradakṣiṇāraṃbhe svapitṝukmāṃgadasamāgame
mohinyā ekādaśīvratavināśakahaṭhena ṛṣīṇāṃ rājñā vākyasaṃvāda iti nirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 289 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 289 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 290
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 291 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tadā kruddhā sveṣṭasiddhyai tu mohinī ।
atyāgrahaṃ cakārā'sya rājño vāgdānapūraṇe ।। 1 ।।
kopasaṃraktanayanā bhartāraṃ pratyabhāṣata ।
karoṣi cenna me vākyaṃ dharmabāhyo bhaviṣyasi ।। 2 । ।
tvayā mamā'rpitaḥ pāṇirvaradānāya bhūpate ।
cenna dāsyasi kṛtakṛtyā yāsye sarvaṃ mayā'rjitam ।। 3 ।।
na cāhaṃ te priyā patnī na ca tvaṃ me patiḥ priyaḥ ।
dhik tvāṃ dvibhāṣiṇaṃ dharmavacolopakaraṃ naram ।। 4 । ।
