satyāccalitamadya tvāṃ tyakṣye svārthaparāyaṇam ।
ityuktvā satvaraṃ tanvī prasthitā'dhomukhī ruṣā । । 5 । ।
tadānīṃ pitṛbhakto'tra rukmāṃgadasutaḥ svayam ।
dharmāṃgado jananyā vai sammukho'bhūnnanāma tām ।। 6 ।।
namraḥ provāca tāṃ devi! kathaṃ ruṣṭā pituḥ priye ।
prasthānaṃ tu na te yogyaṃ mātaryogyaṃ vadāmyaham । । 7 ।।
dharmāṃgadavacaḥ śrutvā mohinī vākyamabravīt ।
pitā tavā'nṛtī putra hasto yenā'nyathākṛtaḥ ।। 8 ।।
yena kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ vai dhvajāṃkuśāṃ'kitena tu ।
taddhastaṃ ca mama haste vinyasya yadvaco'rpitam ।। 9 ।।
na karotyeṣa te janmapitā kiṃ pravadāmyaham ।
na mayā tvatra vastavyaṃ hyanṛtārthapratāriṣu ।। 1.290.10 ।।
na yāce kāṃcanaṃ dhānyaṃ hastyaśvaṃ grāmavāsasī ।
yena tasya bhaveddhānistādṛg yāce na vai suta ।। 11 ।।
yenā'sau prīṇayed dehaṃ patnīṃ māṃ navayauvanām ।
tanmayā prārthitaṃ putra so'yaṃ mohānna yacchati ।। 12।।
tasya mamopakārāya yācito nṛpasattamaḥ ।
sukhahetoḥ puṣṭihetostaccāpi no karotyayam ।। 13।।
sukhacyutaṃ cyutaṃ satyāt tyaktvā yāmi sukhālayam ।
tacchrutvā mohinīṃ natvā tato dharmāṃgado'bravīt ।। 14।।
divyamātarnivartasva kariṣye'haṃ tavepsitam ।
yasya satye sthitā lokāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ ।। 15।।
vaivasvatagṛhaṃ yena kṛtaṃ śūnyaṃ harerbalāt ।
kīrtiḥ prakāśate yasya vyāpya brahmāṇḍakoṭiṣu ।। 16।।
matpitā sa kathaṃ mayi jīvati hyanṛtī bhavet ।
mamopari dayāṃ kṛtvā nivartasva śubhaṃ bhavet ।। 17।।
etaddharmāṃgadavākyamākarṇya sveṣṭalālasā ।
nyavartata tataḥ prāha tātaṃ dharmāṃgadaḥ sutaḥ ।। 18।।
tātaiṣā jananī me'dya tvāṃ vadatyanṛtī tviti ।
kasmāttvamanṛtī bhūpa bhaviṣyasi mayi sthite ।। 19।।
pradehi sakalaṃ tvasyai yat tvayā samayīkṛtam ।
ahaṃ dāsastava rājan vikrīyatāṃ tṛṇāya mām ।।1.290.20।।
devyai dadasva cedicchejjīvitaṃ me ṛtī bhava ।
kīrtināśo mahānnāśo na nāśaḥ sutayoṣitoḥ ।।2 1 ।।
kīrtilābho mahān lābho na lābhaḥ sutayoṣitoḥ ।
dharmāṃgadavacaḥ śrutvā rukmāṃgada uvāca tam ।। 22।।
kīrtirnaśyatu me putra hyanṛtī vā bhavāmyaham ।
yāmi vā nirayaṃ tvandhaṃ kathaṃ bhokṣye harerdine ।।।2 3 ।।
yadyahaṃ kutsitāṃ yoniṃ vrajeyaṃ krimisaṃjñitām ।
tathāpi naiva kartā syāṃ bhojanaṃ tu harerdine ।।24।।
vratārthaṃ dundubhirvakti vitatho na sa me bhavet ।
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ jīveccharadāṃ śatam ।।25 ।।
asatyaṃ bhavatu proktaṃ na bhokṣye harivāsare ।
dhikkṛto'pi janaistvatra mohinyā rahito'pi vā ।।26 ।।
yadi cenmaraṇaṃ me'sti na bhokṣye harivāsare ।
kathaṃ harṣamahaṃ kuryāṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmyapuraṃ gatān ।।27।।
yāstu śūnyāḥ kṛtāḥ putra mayā narakapaṃktayaḥ ।
janaiḥ pūrṇā bhaveyustā bhukte mayi harerdine ।। 28 ।।
bhojanaṃ vāsare viṣṇoḥ kārayitvāpi te prasūḥ ।
yācate yamarājasya kṣetraṃ pūrayituṃ khalā ।। 29 । ।
tanna dāsyāmi mohinyai devaiḥ śāṭhyamidaṃ kṛtam ।
śaṭhā ceyaṃ śaṭhā devāḥ śaṭhe śāṭhyaṃ prakalpayet ।।1.290.30 ।।
pibedviṣaṃ viśedvahniṃ nipatet parvatāgrataḥ ।
svasyāḥ chindyācchiraścāpi na bhokṣye'haṃ harerdine ।। 31 ।।
mohinī maraṇaṃ yātu yatheṣṭaṃ vā pragacchatu ।
nāhaṃ bhokṣye harerahni janmamṛtyuhare vrate ।। 3 2।।
ekādaśyupavāsena yanmayā puṇyamarjitam ।
saṃcitaṃ ca yaśastadvai bhuktvā vināśaye katham ।। 33 ।।
svapiturvacanaṃ śrutvā dharmāṃgado'tidhārmikaḥ ।
sandhyāvalīṃ tadā prāha mohinīṃ parisāntvaya ।। 34।।
yathā na cyavate satyād yathā bhuṃkte na me pitā ।
tathā vidhīyatāṃ yatra kuśalaṃ tūbhayorbhavet ।। 35 ।।
putravacastu sā śrutvā mohinīṃ prāha pūrvajā ।
anuvartasva rājānaṃ mā''grahaṃ kuru pāpake ।। 36 ।।
nā''svādayati rājā'nnaṃ saṃprāpte harivāsare ।
kāmaṃ varaya satyasthe varamanyaṃ sudurlabham ।। 37।।
kaniṣṭhāyā variṣṭhā'haṃ kariṣye pādavandanam ।
patyurarthe pariṇītā karomi mastakārpaṇam ।। 38 ।।
pariṇītā tu nāsi tvaṃ kuto'nyathedṛśāgrahaḥ ।
vācā śapathadoṣaiśca sannirudhyaṃ pratārya yā ।। 39 ।।
kārayet patimakṛtyaṃ sā pāpā narakaṃ vrajet ।
cyutā ca narakātsapta pañca janmāni śūkarī ।।1.290.40 ।।
tato bhavati cāṇḍālī tataśca kāṣṭhilā bhavet ।
tataśchuchundarī syācca tataḥ kākī śṛgālikā ।।4 1 ।।
godhā bhūtvā tataḥ sā vai gotve naiva praśuddhyati ।
vipakṣasyāpi bhagini! sadbuddhidānamuttamam ।।42।।
yena śreyaḥ paraṃ syādvai sukhaṃ sukhayituḥ sadā ।
sandhyāvalīvacaḥ śrutvā mohinī prāha mānavaḥ ।।43 ।।
mānanīyā'si me jyeṣṭhe karomi vacanaṃ tava ।
yadi cennācared rājā bhojanaṃ harivāsare ।।44।।
kuruṣva tvaparaṃ devi maraṇādadhikaṃ tava ।
mamāpi duḥkhadaṃ tvetad rāṣṭrasyāpi praśokakṛt ।।45।।
kasyeṣṭaṃ maraṇaṃ devi! kasyā'niṣṭaṃ ca jīvanam ।
daivā''viṣṭo janaḥ sarvo'niṣṭaṃ cāpi karoti vai ।।46।।
caturvargacyutaṃ ghoraṃ yaśobhāgyavināśakam ।
karmarekhāprabhagno vai karotyaśubhakarma tat ।।47।।
sā'haṃ pāpadurācārā vratakāmā sanirghṛṇam ।
yādṛgbhāvānvitaṃ bījaṃ tādṛśī jāyate kriyā ।।48 ।।
yādṛśena tu bhāvena yonau śukraṃ samutsṛjet ।
tādṛśena tu bhāvena santānaṃ saṃbhavediti ।।49।।
sā'haṃ rukmāṃgadanāśabhāvena brahmaṇā kṛtā ।
duṣṭabhāvā tathā jātā duṣṭakartrī nṛpasya yat ।।1.290.5 0।।
na lagnaṃ na grahā devi! na horā puṇyadarśinī ।
kintu niṣekabhāvena bhāvitaṃ bālakaḥ bhavet ।।5 1 ।।
na tatra prabalaṃ kvāpi dākṣiṇyaṃ mitratā tathā ।
na ca vrīḍā na ca sneho na dharmo na dayādikam ।।52।।
vakṣye prāṇaharaṃ te'dya nṛpasya ca sutasya ca ।
prajānāṃ ca vadhūnāṃ ca yadakāryaṃ hi sarvathā ।।53 ।।
kartuṃ śakyaṃ na manasā śrotuṃ karṇena nāpi yat ।
tat kathaṃ vai śarīreṇa kartuṃ śakyeta mānavi! ।।54।।
karoṣi ced bhavet kīrtistava rājñaśca sadyaśaḥ ।
svargatistava putrasya praśaṃsā mama dhikkṛtiḥ ।।55।।
mohinīvacanaṃ śrutvā devī sandhyāvalī priye! ।
dhairyamālambya tāṃ tanvīṃ brūhi brūhityacodayat ।।56।।
mā vadaivaṃ navavadhu! bhartrarthe sakalaṃ bhavet ।
ātmano nidhane vāpi putrasya nidhane'pi vā ।।57।।
bharturarthe prakurvantyā rājyanāśe na me vyathā ।
yasyā bhartā bhaved duḥkhī tasyāḥ proktā hyadhogatiḥ ।।58।।
caṇḍike sā tavaivāstu na me bharturmamāpi na ।
matputrasyāpi sā mā'stu yā tvadīyā bhaviṣyati ।।59।।
saṃjāte sukhadāmpatye bhāryā mokṣavirodhinī ।
bhūtvā duḥkhapradā syāccenna bhāryā sā tu rākṣasī ।। 1.290.60 ।।
bhāryā samuddharetpāpātpatantaṃ niraye patim ।
sā bhāryā'nyā karmavallīrūpā saṃsāravardhinī ।।61 ।।
jīvitenāpi vacasā bhartāraṃ vaṃcayettu yā ।
kṛmiyoniśataṃ prāpya puṣkasī jāyate tu sā ।। 62।।
patirhi daivataṃ loke vañcanīyo na bhāryayā ।
sā tvaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi bharturarthe tavepsitam ।।63 ।।
vittaṃ dehaṃ tathā putraṃ yattvanyadvā sudurlabham ।
kimanyad daivataṃ loke strīṇāmekaṃ patiṃ vinā ।।64।।
tasyārthe vā tyajet sarvaṃ jīvanaṃ kiṃ tato'dhikam ।
śrutveti mohinī prāha svārthamohakaraṇḍikā ।।65।।
yadyevaṃ tvaṃ vijānāsi bhartrarthaṃ dhanajīvanam ।
tadāhaṃ yācaye vittaṃ jīvitādadhikaṃ śubhe ।।66।।
dehi putraśiro mahyaṃ yadiṣṭaṃ hṛdayādhikam ।
yadi no bhojanaṃ kuryād rājā vai harivāsare ।।67।।
tadā svahaste saṃgṛhya khaḍgaṃ rājā patistava ।
dharmāṃgadaśiraśchitvā mamotsaṃge dadātu vai ।।68।।
etadvā kuru tadbhadre yadā'nnaṃ na bhunakti saḥ ।
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā mohinyāḥ kaṭukākṣaram ।।69।।
pracakampe kṣaṇaṃ sandhyāvalī matvā tu rākṣasīm ।
śanairdhairyaṃ samālambya dharmavākyānyuvāca ha ।।1.290.70 ।।
dhanaṃ tyajet tyajed dārān jīvitaṃ ca gṛhaṃ tyajet ।
tyajed deśaṃ tyajedbhūpaṃ svargaṃ mitraṃ guruṃ tyajet ।।71।।
tyajettīrthaṃ tyajeddharma tyajetputraṃ bahupriyam ।
tyajedyogaṃ tyajeddānaṃ jñānaṃ puṇyakriyāṃ tyajet ।।72।।
tapastyajet tyajedviśvāṃ siddhiṃ mokṣaṃ tyajet param ।
pakṣayorubhayoścāpi na tyajeddharivāsaram ।।73।।
ekādaśyā vratenaiva tatsarvaṃ prāpyate muhuḥ ।
tatrāpi bhartṛtuṣṭyarthe sarvaṃ jahyāt pativratā ।।74।।
dāpaye tava tuṣṭyarthaṃ patyurvrataprapūtaye ।
dharmāṃgadaśiraścaṇḍe rākṣasī tvaṃ na devajā ।।75।।
na satyāccālaye caṇḍe patyarthaṃ ca vratārthakam ।
ityuktvā vinayātpādau bhartuḥ saṃgṛhya padmaje! ।।76।।
uvāca vacanaṃ rājñī dharmāṃgadaśiraḥkṛte ।
mohinyā moharūpāyā nānyat saṃkocate khalu ।।77।।
bhojanaṃ vāsare viṣṇorbadhaṃ vā tanayasya vai ।
dharmatyāgād varaṃ nātha putramūrdhanikṛntanam ।।78।।
vyāpādya sutaṃ rājan snehaṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ ।
mā satyalaṃghanaṃ kārṣīradharmo mā spṛśet tvayi ।।79।।
mātṛsneho'tra bhartrarthe putre bhavati sārthakaḥ ।
dharmasnehasvarūpo'yaṃ gṛhīto na tu laukikaḥ ।।1.290.80।।
prāṇān datvā priyāṃ datvā putraṃ sarvasvameva vā ।
satyaṃ harervrataṃ rakṣyaṃ hṛṣīkeśārthamatra hi ।।8 1 ।।
tadalaṃ paritāpena satyaṃ pālaya bhūpate ।
satyasya pālanād rājan viṣṇudehena yujyate ।।82।।
manye bhūpāla! devaiḥ sā tvadvrataparipanthibhiḥ ।
śikṣitā preṣitā satyavināśāya harervrate ।।83।।
putravyāpādanād devā bhaviṣyanti tvadhomukhāḥ ।
teṣāṃ mūrdhni padaṃ datvā yāsyase paramaṃ padam ।।84।।
viruddhā vibudhā bhūpa seśvarāstava sadvrataiḥ ।
mokṣamārgaprabhettārastava niścayalopakāḥ ।।85।।
rītirvai devatāḥ paripanthino bhaktimārgiṇām ।
sa tvaṃ bhūpa dṛḍho bhūtvā ghātayasva sutaṃ priyam ।।86।।
mohinyāḥ kuru vākyaṃ vai hyātmanaḥ satyapālanāt ।
pālanāya vrataṃ viṣṇoḥ kuru putrasamarpaṇam ।।87।।
bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā rukmāṃgadastadā ।
sandhyāvalīmuvācedaṃ mohinyāḥ sannidhau priye ।।88।।
putrahatyā mahāhatyā brahmahatyā'dhikā bhavet ।
ghātayitvā sutaṃ tvatra kā paratra gatirbhavet ।।89।।
aprajaṃ tu sutaṃ hatvā kā gatirme bhaviṣyati ।
anyārthe kiṃ sutaṃ hanmi kiṃ hanmi harivāsaram ।।1.290.90 ।।
na bhokṣye vāsare viṣṇorna hanmi tanayaṃ priye ।
ātmānaṃ dārayiṣyāmi mohinī mriyatāṃ ca vā ।।9 1।।
athavā mohinīṃ samyaganunayāmi vai punaḥ ।
yadi śāntaṃ manastasyāḥ sāmnā syācchreyase yataḥ ।।92।।
iti vicārya nṛpatiḥ sandhyāvalyāḥ samīpataḥ ।
rukmāṃgadaḥ sāntvanārthaṃ mohinīmidamabravīt ।।93।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dharmāṃgadakṛto mohinī pratyanunayo rukmāṃgadasya vratadārḍhye sandhyāvalyāpatyarthe kṛtopadeśe'pi mohinyā putraśiraso'bhyarthanaṃ sandhyāvalyāḥ śirodānānumatiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 290 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 290 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 291
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 292 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahābhāgavato rukmāṃgado nṛpaḥ ।
sāmā'ntimaṃ samāśritya yadabravīttu mohinīm ।। 1 ।।
duṣṭāgrahamimaṃ subhru parityaja sutaṃ prati ।
kiṃ phalaṃ bhavitā te'tra hatvā dharmāṃgadaṃ sutam ।। 2 ।।
bhojayitvā dine viṣṇoḥ ko lābho bhavitā tava ।
anyaṃ yācasva subhage varaṃ vṛṇe tavāgrataḥ ।। 3 ।।
prasādaṃ kuru cārvaṃgi! putrabhikṣāṃ prayaccha me ।
durlabho guṇavān putro durlabho harivāsaraḥ ।। 4 ।।
durlabhā''jñākarī patnī hareḥ sevāpi durlabhā ।
kathaṃ putraṃ vrataṃ vāpi hanmi te me paraṃ priyam ।। 5 ।।
mohinyuvāca rājānaṃ na me tatrāsti cāgrahaḥ ।
dharmāṃgado na me śatrurnā'haṃ hanmi sutaṃ tava ।। 6 ।।
tava putro yathā so'yaṃ mama putrastathaiva saḥ ।
kathaṃ hanmi svakaṃ putraṃ trātāraṃ nirayādaham ।। 7 ।।
pūrvameva mayā proktaṃ bhuṃkṣva tvaṃ harivāsare ।
nāhaṃ vyāpādaye putramarthasiddhistu bhojane ।। 8 ।।
mama bhūmipate kāryaṃ putranāśe na siddhyati ।
mama kāryasya saṃsiddhirbhojane harivāsare ।। 9 ।।
yadarthaṃ preṣitā patnīrūpā devaistavā'ntigā ।
tataḥ putraḥ priyo'styeva bhujyatāṃ harivāsare ।। 1.291.10 ।।
satyaṃ saṃrakṣa yatnena kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama ।
evaṃ dṛḍhāgrahāṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmāṃgado'pyuvāca tām ।। 11 ।।
etadeva gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mā śaṃkāṃ kuru mohini! ।
ityuktvā khaḍgamādāya prāha svapitaraṃ sutaḥ ।। 12 ।।
na vilambaḥ pitaḥ kāryastvayā mamanipātane ।
manmāturvacanaṃ satyaṃ kuru bhūpa pratiśrutam ।। 13 ।।
ātmā rakṣyo dhanairdāraiḥ sutābhiśca sutairapi ।
tvadarthe maraṇaṃ me'stu brahmalokapradaṃ bhavet। ।। 14।।
tathāpi śāśvatī muktiḥ svargaṃ vā śāśvataṃ bhavet ।
satyārthe duḥkhamṛtsṛjya kuru vyāpādanaṃ mama ।। 15 ।।
pitrarthe cāpi mātrarthe gavārthe ca hatāstu ye ।
viprasādhu surārthe ca svāśritārthe guroḥ kṛte ।। 1 6।।
dharmārthe ca hatā rājan yānti lokāṃstu śāśvatān ।
jahi māṃ pālaya satyaṃ mā bhuṃkṣva harivāsare ।। 17।।
naramedho'yamāstheyo harervāsarakāraṇāt ।
tatra nāsti manākdoṣaḥ paritāpaṃ ca mā vaha ।। 1 8।।
ityetatsamaye lakṣmi! devāḥ ṛṣigaṇāstathā ।
munayaḥ pitaraścāpi manavaśca diśādhipāḥ ।। 19 ।।
svargīyā vāyavīyāśca bhaumāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ।
dṛśyā'dṛśyaśarīrāśca sthāvarā jaṃgamāstathā ।। 1.291.20 ।।
devyaḥ koṭyarbudāścāpi tīrthayātrārthamāgatāḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca viṣṇukṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ ।। 21 ।।
raivatācalamārgasthāḥ paśyantyāścaryasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
jijñāsamānāḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ vai hanane vā hyupoṣaṇe ।। 22 ।।
dharmatattvaṃ tathā kutra jīvane bhojane'thavā ।
tadānīṃ vyomamārgastho bhagavān kamalekṣaṇaḥ ।। 23 ।।
antardhānagatastasthau bhaktadhairyāvalokakaḥ ।
mohinyuktaṃ bhuṃkṣva rājan putroktaṃ jahi māṃ pitaḥ ।। 24।।
śṛṇvan devaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ satya parīkṣakaḥ ।
rājā praṇamya govindaṃ khaḍgaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā ।। 25 ।।
dharmāṃgado'pi pitarau nītvā raivatadevatāḥ ।
adīnavacano grīvāṃ khaḍgamārge nyadhāpayat ।। 26।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīccākrośastīrthayāyinām ।
cacāla pṛthivī sarvā sasindhunagarāṣṭrikā ।। 27।।
nipeturulkāḥ śataśo dyaurnistejograhānvitā ।
kāluṣyamāpustīrthāni vivarṇā'bhūcca mohinī ।। 28 ।।
devakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva janma nirarthakaṃ kṛtam ।
rājñā bhuktaṃ na cānnaṃ vai tṛṇatulyā kṛtā hyaham ।। 29।।
rājā yāsyati mokṣaṃ vai yāmyaṃ yāsyāmi pāpinī ।
iti śokena mūrchāyāṃ papāta dharaṇītale ।। 1.291.30 ।।
rājñā pracicchide harṣāt khaḍgena putramastakam ।
tāvadvyaktena kṛṣṇena paśyatsu koṭidehiṣu ।। 31 ।।
svakareṇa dhṛto rājā tuṣṭo'smi bruvatā muhuḥ ।
putreṇa tava patnyā ca tvayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mama ।। 3 2।।
madvratārthaṃ kṛtaṃ cedṃ nānyaḥ kariṣyati kvacit ।
vijītā mohinīmāyā yamamūrghni padṃ dhṛtam ।। 33 ।।
tuṣṭo'smi cāgaccha vimānavaryaṃ saputrapatnīsuhṛdādibhiśca ।
trailokyapūjāṃ vimalāṃ gṛhāṇa prayāhi vāsaṃ mayi divyamūrtau ।। 34।।
divyo rājā caturhasto divyā dārasutādayaḥ ।
babhūvuḥ kṛṣṇamūrtau te vilīnāḥ sucaturbhujāḥ ।। 35।।
dharmajayapraghoṣāścā''kāśavāṇyo'bhavaँstadā ।
puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papātāmbarasthadevavisarjitā ।। 36। ।
lokapālaistāḍitā dundubhayo nedurutkaṭāḥ ।
jagurgītāni nanṛturmudā yuktāḥ surāṃganā ।। 37।।
raivatena tathā tīrthayāyibhirvardhito nṛpaḥ ।
sutadārādiyuktasya śāśvataṃ dhāma te'stviti ।। 38 ।।
yātrālubhistadīyaiśca dehā nārāyaṇe hrade ।
vahninā saṃskṛtāścordhvakriyāḥ prātaḥ pravartitāḥ ।। 39 ।।
dhanyavādān prabruvāṇāḥ pradakṣiṇāya te yayuḥ ।
abhuñjānāḥ prabodhinyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ tvekabhojanāḥ ।।1.291.40 ।।
trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ pūrṇāyāṃ caikabhojanāḥ ।
raivatādriṃ parikramya pūrṇāyāṃ te yayuḥ sukhāḥ ।।4 1 ।।
mohinī duḥkhamāpannā savrīḍā cā'yaśasvinī ।
akṛtakāryā cā'raṇye martukāmā babhūva ha ।।42।।
yamo'pi viphalaṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmāṇamāha vai ।
mohinī niṣphalā jātā vandhyāstrī janane yathā ।।43 ।।
lokaḥ prayāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ na māṃ kaścitprapadyate ।
nṛpe mṛte'pi lokānāṃ bhaktau hrāso na vartate ।।44।।
upoṣya vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ sarve yānti paraṃ padam ।
mohinī maraṇodyuktā nāyāti tava sannidhau ।।45।।
nirvyāpārastvahaṃ prāgvat ki, karomi praśādhi mām ।
yamavākyaṃ samāśrutya brahmā provāca sūryajam ।।46 ।।
gacchāmo mohinīṃ bodhayituṃ paścāt tavārthakam ।
kariṣyāmo yathāyogyaṃ daivamanyad vicintayet ।।47।।
iti kṛtvā vane tatra samāyātā ajādayaḥ ।
tejohīnāṃ naṣṭakāryāṃ tvapaśyaँstā divaukasaḥ ।।48 ।।
nirutsāhāṃ namraśīlāmūcurdevā sukālikam ।
mā śokaṃ kuru dharmajñe! pauruṣaṃ hi tvayā kṛtam ।।49 ।।
preṣitā devakāryārthaṃ siddhaṃ tanna tathāpi vai ।
tvayā śoko na kartavyo yayau rājā tu mokṣaṇam ।।1.291.50 ।।
nahi śrīharibhaktānāṃ vighnaṃ kadāpi jāyate ।
hate putre hariṇā svavratabhaktā'vanaṃ kṛtam ।।5 1 ।।
sutaḥ patnī nṛpaścaite sudṛḍhā vratapālane ।
viṣṇunā parituṣṭena nītāḥ svabhavane trayaḥ ।।52।।
teṣāṃ yogaṃ samāpannā nītāścā'saṃkhyadehinaḥ ।
harerbhaktiḥ sadā rakṣākarī mokṣakarī dhruvam ।।53 ।।
phalaṃ karmaṇi cārabdhe yadi devi! na siddhyati ।
sarvayatnairapi cedvai doṣaḥ ko'tra tavā'dhunā ।।54।।
tasmād varapradānāya tava saukhyapravṛttaye ।
samprāptā vibudhāḥ sarve'bhīṣṭayācanikāṃ kuru ।।।55।।
siddhau ca vā'pyasiddhau vā vetanaṃ deyameva ha ।
bhartavyo bhṛtyavargaśca rakṣaṇīyastathā muhuḥ ।।56 ।।
surairevaṃ samādiṣṭā patihīnā'tiduḥkhitā ।
uvāca mohinī naṣṭānanda kulavināśinī ।।57।।
dhigidaṃ jīvitaṃ me'tra yena kāryaṃ na sādhitam ।
na kṛto yamamārgaśca janairgamyastvanargalaḥ ।।58 ।।
harerdine na luptaṃ ca na bhuktaṃ harivāsare ।
rājñā tena prabhaktena hataḥ putro mudā priyaḥ ।।59 ।।
gato mūrghni padaṃ datvā rājā viṣṇordhruva padam ।
sarvasvaṃ me gataṃ tvatra kinnu me jīvitaṃ phalam ।।1.291.6 0 ।।
na sādhayanti ye kāryaṃ svāmināṃ vetanārthinaḥ ।
bhṛtyāste doṣabhoktāro jāyante bhūtale hayāḥ ।।61 ।।
kāryasyā'sādhikā cāhaṃ bhartṛputravināśinī ।
kathaṃ varaṃ pragṛhṇāmi bhavatāṃ nākavāsinām ।।62।।
maraṇaṃ sarvathā śreṣṭhaṃ bhagnamānasya dehinaḥ ।
iti kṛtvā rurodoccairdevā ūcustu sāntvanām ।।63 ।।
pariśramaḥ kṛto devi! tvayā'smatkāryasādhane ।
daivādhīnaṃ phalaṃ jñātvā mā śokaṃ kuru mohinī! ।।64।।
anṛṇāstu bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṛtvā tūpakṛtiṃ tava ।
saukhyārthaṃ yadbhavediṣṭaṃ dāsyāmo brūhi hṛdgatam ।।65 ।।
yatra rukmāṃgadastvāste tatra yātuṃ samīhayā ।
mohinī manasā yāvadvicārayati tāvatā ।।66 ।।
nṛpaterājagāmā'tra purodhāḥ pāvakopamaḥ ।
raivatādrergahvarasthasvarṇarekhāhrade vasuḥ ।।67।।
uṣitaḥ prāṇamāyamya nirgato jalamadhyataḥ ।
jñātvā yogena satsarvamuvāca varadān surān ।।68।।
dhigimāṃ dhik devasaṃghaṃ dhikkarma pāpakārakam ।
kiṃ vicintyā''gatāścāsyai varaṃ dātuṃ dhigīśvarān ।।69।।
sutabhartṛghātinīyaṃ kiṃ pātraṃ gaṇyate surai ।
nā'syā loke bhavecchuddhirvahnau saṃpatane'pi hi ।।1.291.70 ।।
cāṭuvāgbhirmohayitvā bhūtvā svārthaparā priyā ।
sutabhartṛghātinīyaṃ svamokṣasvargaghātinī ।।7 1 ।।
nā'syā vāso niraye'pi kutaḥ svarge harergṛhe ।
lokāntare'thavā śānte vāsahīnā bhramatviyam ।।72।।
lokanindādūṣitāyā loke'pyatra na vai sthitiḥ ।
dhigasyā jīvanaṃ karmagarhitāyā vadāmi kim ।।73 ।।
patiṃ hatvā sutaṃ hatvā sapatnīṃ jananīsamām ।
hatvā dharāṃ samastāṃ ca kāṃ gatiṃ yāsyati nviyam ।।74।।
vacanenāpi dharmasya vidhvaṃsinī hi sarvadā ।
uktavatī sadā rājñe bhujyatāṃ harivāsare ।।75।।
ajñānād vyāhṛte vākye bhujyatāṃ harivāsare ।
tasyāpi niṣkṛtiḥ proktā prāṇāyāmaśatena vai ।।76।।
iyaṃ prasahya saṃbhoktrī harerahno vratasya hi ।
naiṣā spṛśyā'sti deveśā! kathamasyā varapradāḥ ।।77।।
pālanaṃ pāpayuktasya na kurvanti divaukasaḥ ।
devā dharmāśritā dharmo vedavākyasamutthitaḥ ।।78।।
vedaiḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ bhartuḥ strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।
na pituḥ svārthakaraṇaṃ vadhūdharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।।79।।
yad bravīti patiḥ kiṃcitpatnyā kāryamaśaṃkayā ।
śuśrūṣā sā hi vijñeyā yayā syātpatitoṣaṇam ।।1.291.8 0 ।।
bharturājñā hṛtā svasyā ājñāsthāpanavāñchayā ।
svakāryasādhanārthāya śapathairyantrito nṛpaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
ghātinīyaṃ vacobhiśca kriyayā'pi vighātinī ।
kuṭumbaghātinī seyaṃ pāpadehā ca pāpinī ।।82।।
hatyāyutādhikā'dheyaṃ varayogyā kathaṃ bhavet ।
yo'syāḥ pakṣe'pi varteta devo vā dānavo'pi vā ।।83।।
mohinyā rakṣaṇe kaścit prayatnaṃ kurute yadi ।
taṃ cāpi bhasmasāt kuryāṃ kṣaṇena surasattamāḥ ।।84।।
rājā mokṣaṃ gataḥ satyāt pāpamasyāṃ visṛjya vai ।
asyāḥ pakṣaṃ kurvato'pi pāpaṃ tasyāḥ prasajyate ।।85।।
ityuktvā krodhatāmrākṣaḥ saṃgṛhya salilaṃ kare ।
cikṣepa mohinī mūrdhni prajajvālā'nalastataḥ ।।86।।
paśyatāṃ nākavāsānāṃ pradadāha sa mohinīm ।
tāvat। khe mahatāṃ vācaḥ kopaṃ saṃhara saṃhara ।।87।।
babhūvustāvadeveyaṃ bhasmaśeṣā'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।
nirāśā devatāḥ sarve yayurbhagnahṛdo gṛham ।।88।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rukmāṃgadenopadiṣṭasāmottaraṃ krūrāyā icchayā khaḍgena putra-
śiraśchinnamatha deveṣu paśyatsu sutadāranṛpāṇāṃ mokṣagatirmohinyai dhikpravādāḥ purodhaḥśāpena bhasmījātā
mohinīti nirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 291 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 291 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 292
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 293 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dagdhadehā pāpisūkṣmaśarīriṇī ।
yāmyaistu nīyamānā saudghāṭayad yamamārgakam ।। 1 ।।
vāritā sā yameśena yato yamasahāyinī ।
yamamārgodghāṭanārthe duḥkhamāptavatī tataḥ ।। 2 ।।
yamena preṣitā svargaṃ gatā vibudhamandiram ।
bhartsitā devadūtaistu sthitiste'tra na pāpini! ।। 3 ।।
harivāsaralopinyā vāsaste na surālaye ।
tataḥ sā duḥkhitā lakṣmi! mohinī vāsalabdhaye ।। 4 ।।
pātālaṃ prayayau tatra pātālasthairnivāritā ।
suraiśca munibhirdaityairdānavaiḥ ṛṣibhistathā ।। 5 ।।
pitṛbhirmānavairyakṣairbhūtapretapiśācakaiḥ ।
tīrthaiśca parvataiḥ khātaiḥ sāgaraiśca vanaistathā ।। 6 ।।
tattvaiśca lokapālaiśca manubhirjalavāsibhiḥ ।
dṛṣṭā yairyaistīrthakṛdbhiḥ raivatādrau tu mohinī ।। 7 ।।
putrahantrī patihantrī dṛṣṭā jaḍaiśca cetanaiḥ ।
nakṣatraiśca grahairvṛkṣairvallībhiśca tṛṇaistathā ।। 8 ।।
paśubhiḥ pakṣibhiścaiṣā svasvasthānānnirākṛtā ।
na kaiścid rakṣitā tasmāt krośantī brahmaṇaḥ sutā ।। 9 ।।
janakasyā'ntikaṃ gatvā duḥkhaṃ svaṃ sannyavedayat ।
tāta tannāsti me sthānaṃ trailokye sacarācare ।। 1.292.10 ।।
yatra yatra gatā cāsmi tatra tatra kṣipanti mām ।
tiraskurvanti te sarve nirvāsayanti cāśramāt ।। 11 ।।
pitrājñayā mayā gatvā rukmāṃgadagṛhaṃ tataḥ ।
dṛṣṭaṃ vyavasitaṃ caitat sarvalokaghṛṇāspadam ।। 12।।
bhartāraṃ kleśayitvaiva mārayitvā suputrakam ।
sandhyāvalīṃ nāśayitvā pitaḥ prāptā daśāmimām ।। 13 ।।
na gatirvidyate jaive caiśvare mokṣaṇe'pi me ।
viśeṣād vasuśāpena jātāhaṃ duḥkhabhāginī ।। 14।।
yadi tvaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ vasuṃ taṃ śāpadaṃ dvijam ।
prasādayasi matprītyā tarhi me syācchubhā gatiḥ ।। 15।।
vipraśāpapradagdhānāṃ gaṃgā muktipradā bhavet ।
bhāryā rukmāṃgadasyā'haṃ vidhavā pāpakāriṇī ।। 16 ।।
purodhāśca vasurvipro rājñastasmācca me gatiḥ ।
sa māṃ nayettu tīrtheṣu kṣālayetpātakāni me ।। 17।।
śāpaṃ nivartayeccāpi tato me sugatirbhavet ।
tāṃ tathāvādinīṃ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।। 18 । ।
śivendradharmasūryāgnidevādyairmunibhiryutaḥ ।
mohinīmagrataḥ kṛtvā jagāma vasusannidhau । । 1 9। ।
raivatādrau svarṇarekhānadyaraṇye vasuṃ bhavam ।
vāmanaṃ gauraveṇāpi nabhaścakre svayaṃ vidhiḥ । । 1.292.2 0 । ।
asādhyakārye samprāpte yaviṣṭhaścet karoti tat ।
na dūṣitaṃ bhavellakṣmi! yaviṣṭhasyā'bhivādanam । । 21 । ।
vasurdṛṣṭvā samutthāya namaścakre tvajādikān ।
surāḥ sarve'rthayāmāsurmoṃhinyarthe sukhāvaham । । 22। ।
kṛpāṃ kuru tapaḥśreṣṭha mohinīgatido bhava ।
yajamānī bhavatyeṣā te rājño gṛhavāsinī । ।23 । ।
tvayā tvasyā hitaṃ kāryaṃ mama putryāstapodhana ।
preṣitāyā mayaivātra devānāṃ hitakāmyayā । । 24। ।
yamalokastathā svargaḥ śūnyo rukmāṃgadena vai ।
kṛtastayorvasatyarthaṃ mānasī preṣitā mayā । ।25। ।
rukmāṃgadasya mohārthaṃ sa tu prāpa hareḥ padam ।
gati dharmasyā'tisūkṣmā lokā jānanti naiva tām । । 26 । ।
durlabhaṃ harisāyujyamanayā taiḥ samarjitam ।
sadāraḥ sasuto rājā prāpito harimandiram । 27। ।
anayā priyayā'tīva parīkṣya prāpito'cyutam ।
anyairna prāpyate dhāma prāpitaṃ tvanayā hi tat । । 28 । ।
sa vai putraśca sā patnī sutā sā janakaśca saḥ ।
yena vai prāpyate mokṣo bandhuḥ suhṛd guruśca saḥ । । 29 । ।
harerdine na bhoktavyaṃ vrataṃ pratīpakā''grahāt ।
dṛḍhīkṛtaṃ nṛpasyā'tra mohinyā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam । । 1.292.30 । ।
tatkāryaṃ pāparūpaṃ vai gaṇayitvā tvayā vaso ।
śāpadagdhā kṛtā bhasmaśeṣā sūkṣmaśarīriṇī । । 31 । ।
tatpraśāmya kṣamasvaināṃ kuruṣvānugrahaṃ mune ।
śamaṃ bhajasva piṣṭasya peṣo mā'stu sureśvaraiḥ ।। 32 ।।
tyaja krauryaṃ bhaja śāntiṃ prasādaṃ kuru putraka!
śrutvā śāntaḥ kṣamāyukto vasū rājapurohitaḥ । । 33 । ।
prāha mayā vicāryaiva mohinyā vasatirdhruvā ।
nirṇītāsti yadarthaṃ sā nirmitā tatkarotvapi ।। 34 ।।
yamamārgapravāhārthaṃ vratabhaṃgārthamityapi ।
harerdinopoṣitānāṃ brahmadhāmagamāya ca ।। 35 ।।
nirmiteyaṃ mohinīti tayā tatkāryameva ha ।
patiḥ sapatnī putraścā'nayā vaikuṇṭhagāḥ kṛtāḥ ।। 36।।
etādṛśasthale ceyaṃ vāse karotu mohinī ।
asyāḥ sāmīpyata ekādaśīṃ kṛtvā janāḥ sadā ।। 37।।
muktiṃ prayāntu nirvighnāṃ haritoṣaṇasadvratān ।
asyā dine tu ye bhrāntā vrate mugdhā bhavanti te ।। 38 ।।
yāntu pāpā yamalokaṃ yamakāryaṃ bhavettathā ।
eṣā yatra sthitā tadvai vrata bhagnaṃ bhavediti ।। 39 ।।
tadvai vrataṃ mataṃ na syād vratabhaṃgo hi so'stu vai ।
evamatra vicintyārtho mayā samyaṅnirūpitaḥ ।।1.292.4 0 ।।
vidhavāyāstu mohinyā vāsaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ।
sarveṣvapi vrateṣvasyā vāsena duṣṭatā bhavet ।।4 1 ।।
tasmād vratadine tvasyā vāso naiva tu yujyate ।
kintu vratādyadivasaprānte'syā vasatirbhavet ।।42 ।।
ādyadivasaprānto'syā vāsena yātu duṣṭatām ।
vedhaso'syā yato janma tasmādvai vaidhasī matā ।।43 ।।
sā yatra tiṣṭhati titheḥ prānte sa vedha ucyate ।
vedhāśrayā tithistvādyā duṣṭā pāpapradāyinī ।।44।।
vratavidhvaṃsinī bodhyā yamapuryāḥ pradāyinī ।
sūryodaye tu yā nāsti sāyaṃkāle tu vartate ।।45 ।।
sā tithiryadyupoṣyā syād yāmyapūryāḥ pradāyinī ।
vrataṃ tasyāṃ na kartavyaṃ viparītaphalaṃ yataḥ ।।46 ।।
sūryodaye ca pūrvāhṇe saptamī daśamī ca vā ।
caturdaśyaṣṭamī vā ca vartate kramaśastathā ।।47।।
parāhṇe kṛṣṇajanamāṣṭamī caikādaśī tathā ।
pūrṇā vā'mā rāmanavamīti sāyaṃ pravartate ।।48।।
evaṃ kāle kramaśastu saptamyāḥ prāntake tathā ।
daśamyante caturdaśyāḥ prānte'ṣṭamyantake tathā ।।49 ।।
mohinī tatra vasatu tāḥ pāpāstithayaḥ sadā ।
ato vrataṃ kramaśastu saptamyāṃ cāṣṭamīvratam ।।1.292.50 ।।
yamalokapradaṃ proktaṃ vedhapāpāśrayaṃ hi tat ।
daśamyāṃ tu vrataṃ hyekādaśyāvrataṃ tu pāpadam ।।।5 1 ।।
caturdaśyāṃ vrataṃ pūrṇāvrataṃ vā'māvrataṃ tathā ।
pāpadaṃ yamalokasya prāpakaṃ rātrikṛdvratam ।।5 2 ।।
tasmāt sūryodaye yā''dyā sāyaṃ rātrau tu cetarā ।
vratātmikā tithiścet syānnaivopoṣyā kadācana ।।53 ।।
mohinī tatra vasati saptamyādau dināntake ।
saptamyādyā na copoṣyāḥ sāyaṃ vratānvitāstvapi ।। 54।।
yamamārgapravāhārthaṃ mohinyai tvarpitā hi tāḥ ।
tāśca vedhāśrayāḥ pāpāśrayā mohinyadhiśritāḥ । ।55।।
ayaṃ ca nirṇayaḥ sāyaṃvyāpinyā vratavibhrame ।
vrataṃ naiva prakartavyamiti devairdṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ।। 56 ।।
atha sūryodayātpūrvaṃ saptamī daśamī ca vā ।
caturdaśyaṣṭamī vā ca vartate kramaśastathā ।।57।।
sūryodaye kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamī caikādaśī tathā ।
pūrṇā vā'mā rāmanavamīti sūrye pravartate ।।58 ।।
evaṃ kāle kramaśastu saptamyāḥ prāntake tathā ।
daśamyante caturdaśyāḥ prānte'ṣṭamyantake prage ।।5 9 ।।
vasatu mohinī tatra tattithiyogasandhitā ।
sūryodaye tithiryā tu prārabhyate vratātmikā ।।1.292.6 0 ।।
vedhātmamohinīhṛṣṭā viddhā sā bhavatītyataḥ ।
viddhātithivrataṃ svargapradapuṇyakaraṃ bhavet ।।6 1 ।।
iti devairniścitatvād viddhāvrataṃ tu nākadam ।
na tu mokṣakaraṃ tatsyāt kṣayyapuṇyapradaṃ hyataḥ ।।62।।
ato viddhā na kartavyā bhaktaistu mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ ।
kartavyā sarvathā śuddhā'ṣṭamī caikādaśī tathā ।।6 3 ।।
pūrṇimā cāpyamāvāsyā hyevamanyā vratātmikāḥ ।
tithayaḥ sarvadā śuddhā vrate grāhyā na viddhikāḥ ।। 64।।
na vā sāyaṃtanavyāptā nirṇītaṃ tat suraistadā ।
śuddhaṃ haridinaṃ bhakta upoṣya yāti mokṣaṇam ।।65।।
viddhātithiṃ vihāyaiva pare tūpoṣaṇaṃ dine ।
navamyāṃ dvādaśikāyāṃ pratipaddivase tathā ।।66।।
daśamyāṃ kramaśaḥ kāryaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāstathā punaḥ ।
ekādaśyāḥ pūrṇimā'māvasyayoḥ rāmajanminaḥ ।।67।।
vrataṃ śuddhaṃ bhavet tadvai mokṣadaṃ harivāsaram ।
haryāśritaṃ vrataṃ śuddhaṃ viddhantu svargadaṃ matam ।।68।।
mohinyantaṃ yāmyadaṃ vai yathākartā tathāgatiḥ ।
ityevaṃ nirṇayaṃ kṛtvā mohinyai sthānamarpitam ।।69।।
ādititheḥ prāntabhāgaḥ sarvathā yamamārgakṛt ।
yadi tithidvayaṃ syācced vrataṃ kāryaṃ pare dine ।।1.292.70 ।।
titheḥ kṣaye paropoṣyā tithiḥ śuddhā vratārthinā ।
na tu viddhā kṣayā naiśā hyupoṣyā karhicijjanaiḥ ।।71।।
vedho niśīthe yamānāmupakārāya mohinī ।
sūryāt pūrvaṃ surāṇāmupakārāyaiva hi mohinī ।।72।।।
śuddhāviddhāntaritā syādupakārāya mokṣiṇām ।
sarveṣvapi ca lokeṣu yamasya daśamī tithiḥ ।।73।।
tasyāḥ prānte sadā stheyaṃ mohinyeti nivāsitā ।
viddhāvrataphalaṃ tvardhaṃ te vai bhavatu mohini ।।74।।
niśāvrataphalaṃ sarvaṃ te vai bhavatu mohini ।
svāghanāśāya te tāvadalaṃ bhavatu mohini ।।75। ।
bhuvi tīrthāni caiva tvaṃ svāghanāśāya sañcara ।
pāpināṃ pāpanāśāya tīrthāni santi mohini! । ।76।।
hariṣyanti ca te pāpaṃ sthitāstīrthe vrataṃ vinā ।
avratinaśca tīrthasthā vajralepā'ghabhāginaḥ ।।77।।
tava śuddhiḥ sadā teṣu bhaviṣyati punaḥ punaḥ ।
yamasaṃsthāpanārthāya pāpasaṃcayanāya ca ।।78। ।
dattaṃ te mohini! sthānaṃ niśāntasamayāntikam ।
svargasaṃsthāpanārthāya puṇyasaṃcayanāya ca ।।79।।
dattaṃ te mohini! sthānaṃ prātaḥ sūryodayāntikam ।
mokṣiṇāṃ tu kṛte tvaṃ vai sarvathā vasa dūrataḥ ।।1.292.80 ।।
mokṣivrataṃ svadṛṣṭyā tvaṃ mā nibhālaya bhāmini! ।
tathā sati punarnāśaste bhaviṣyati śāpataḥ ।।81 ।।
evaṃ pradiṣṭā brahmādyaistuṣṭā babhūva mohinī ।
mene kṛtārthaṃ tvātmānaṃ sthānena tīrthayātrayā ।।82।।
dehe bhasmāvaśeṣe'pi sūkṣmadehena vai punaḥ ।
yamakāryaṃ surakāryaṃ mokṣakāryaṃ susādhitam ।।83 ।।
iti kṛtārthatāṃ dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣṭā'bhūdatīva sā ।
svakāryaṃ sādhitaṃ rājñā mohinyā sādhitaṃ svakam ।।84।।
yamakāryaṃ devakāryaṃ mokṣakāryaṃ pravartitam ।
atha sūryacandrayostu rāhugrasanakarmaṇi ।।85।।
rāhudṛṣṭipathe kāle vedhe hi mohinī sthitā ।
vedhakālo vaidhasī sā''jñaptā sthātuṃ sureśvaraiḥ ।।86 ।।
tasmād vedhe bhojanādi sarvaṃ pāpamayaṃ smṛtam ।
kṛtaṃ prayāti mohinyai kartā yamapradeśabhāg ।।87।।
bhavatīti yamamārgastayāpi vāhitastathā ।
evaṃ tithīnāṃ vedhāstu vratapūrvaṃ vyavasthitāḥ ।।88 ।।
bhavati kartari pāpaṃ mohinī phalabhāginī ।
iti lakṣmi! vyavasthāṃ ca sthānaṃ prāpya sumohinī ।।89।।
devān praṇamya saṃhṛṣṭā natvā purodhasaṃ svakam ।
prānte sthitā daśamyāderjanamohanakāriṇī ।। 1.292.90 ।।
sūryodayaspṛśā tasmād daśamī garhitā sadā ।
aspṛṣṭamudayaṃ cāpi mohanāyaiva kevalam ।। 91 ।।
iti bruvanto deveśā yayuḥ svasvaniketanam ।
tadā putrī vedhase vai dagdhadehasya labdhaye ।। 92।।।
prārthayāmāsa bahudhā vasuṃ cāpi purodhasam ।
brahmā prāha vasuṃ cāpi sarvalokavidhānakṛt! ।। 93 ।।
vaso! tāta! nibodhedaṃ kiṃ te yājyā bravīti vai ।
tvayeyaṃ mohinī kopāt kṛtā bhasmāvaśeṣitā ।। 94।।
yācate sā sthūlaṃ dehaṃ samutpādya pradehi vai ।
tvayā mayā ca saṃpālyā kṛtakāryā tapasvinī ।। 95।।
kiṃcaviṣṇurdinasyaiṣā vairiṇī pāpakāriṇī ।
yathāśuddhyedupāyaṃ taṃ tvasyāḥ kṛte vidhīyatām ।। 96 ।।
tattu śrutvā purodhāstaṃ dideśa varṣmayojane ।
brahmā kamaṇḍaluvārbhiraukṣanmohinikāsthijam ।। 97।।
bhasma tataḥ punardehaḥ samutpannastu vaidhasaḥ ।
dehayuktā'bhavatsā ca vasuṃ tātaṃ praṇamya vai ।।98 ।।
prārthayāmāsa pāpānāṃ kṣālanāya punaḥ punaḥ ।
tadā vasustīrthayātrāṃ kārayituṃ ca mohinīm ।। 99 ।।
upādideśa gaṃgāditīrthāni tadvidhīṃstathā ।
tato jagāma tīrthāni vasunā saha mohinī ।। 1.292.100 ।।
gaṃgāṃ gayāṃ tathā godāṃ jagannāthaṃ prayāgakam ।
kurukṣetraṃ haridvāraṃ badrikāśramamuttamam ।। 101 ।।
puṣkaraṃ tryambakaṃ rāmeśvaraṃ tathā ca nārmadam ।
vṛndāvanaṃ siddhasārasvataṃ dvāravatīsthalam ।। 102 ।।
prabhāsaṃ kuṃkumavāpīṃ raivataṃ ceti mohinī ।
kṛtvā tīrthāni vasunā sahā''yātā vasusthalam ।। 103 ।।
nārāyaṇahrade snātvā rukmāṃgadapure gatā ।
raivatapaścime vastrāpathe natvā gireḥ sthalīm ।। 104 ।।
yayau vedhogṛhe satye loke tenaiva varṣmaṇā ।
adehā vedhavāsā'sti kālābhimānadevatā ।। 105 ।।
mohinī vidhijā devī viṣṇujaikādaśī tithiḥ ।
viṣṇujātparddhayā dhātrā mohinī sā vinirmitā ।। 106 ।।
sparddhantyekādaśīṃ ceyaṃ daśamyante sthitā sadā ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! viddhāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ mayā ।। 1 07।।
tadarthaṃ nirmitā dhātrā mohinī tatra veśitā ।
sūkṣmadehā vratahantrī kimanyacchrotumicchasi ।। 108 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇāyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmāṇḍe vāsamalabhamānayā mohinyā 'rthitena brahmaṇā vasunā ca vratapūrvatithiprānte dattavāsaṃ
labdhvā sā yamalokasuralokabrahmalokādipravāhaphalavatī viddhāśuddhādiprayojayitrī ca punaḥ sadehā devatā jātetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhika-
dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 292।।


← adhyāyaḥ 292 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 293
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 294 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
māsāstu dvādaśa proktāsteṣu vratadināni ca ।
tebhyo'dhiko'pi trayodaśaḥ sārdhadvayavārṣikaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
cāndrapūrṇatvasampādyo bhavatīti tadīyakam ।
itivṛttaṃ vidhiṃ devaṃ sarve śrotuṃ samutsahe ॥ 2 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ divyāṃ puruṣottamayoginīm ।
cāndramāse yatra sūryasaṃkrāntirnahi jāyate ॥ 1 ॥
ekarāśiprabhogastho'rko na saṃkramate'pare ।
sūryasaṃkrāntiśūnyo'yaṃ māso'dhikatayā mataḥ ॥ 2 ॥
madhye'māvāsyayoścāndramāsaḥ pūrṇaḥ prajāyate ।
sauramāsastu saṃkrāntyormadhye pūrṇaḥ prajāyate ॥ 3 ॥
cāndramāse sāvanāhānyekonatriṃśadityatha ।
ṣaḍviṃśatighaṭikāśca pañcāśatpalikāstathā ॥ 4 ॥
bhujyante'tha ca saure tu triṃśadahāni vai tathā ।
ṣaḍviṃśatiśca ghaṭikāḥ palānyekonaviṃśatiḥ ॥ 5 ॥
vipalānyekatriṃśacca dvāpaṃcāśatkṣaṇāni ca ।
prabhujyante tayoścāndre yaḥ kālaḥ śiṣyate'rkitaḥ ॥ 6 ॥
teṣāṃ tu śiṣṭakālānāṃ samavāya prajāyate ।
pūrṇastrayodaśaścāndramāso'yaṃ tvadhiko mataḥ ॥ 7 ॥
dvātriṃśatsauramāseṣu ṣoḍaśāhādhikeṣu tu ।
trayastriṃśaccāndramāsāḥ ṣoḍaśāhādhikāḥ khalu ॥ 8 ॥
niṣpadyante'dhiko māsaścāndraḥ so'yaṃ mato'dhikaḥ ।
paṃcavarṣeṣvadhimāsau dvau cāndrau prāyaśo matau ॥ 9 ॥
adhimāsaḥ punaḥ so'ṣṭavarṣe vaikonaviṃśatau ।
ekacatvāriṃśadadhike śate vā sa eti vai ॥ 1.293.1 0॥
sa evāyāti cetyevaṃ prāyaśo niyamo'sti hi ।
so'yaṃ puṇyaprakāryārthaṃ niścito munibhiḥ purā ॥ 11 ॥
śṛṇuṣvaināṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi! nau gehādyudbhavā'sti sā ।
malamāsastvayaṃ prokto malaśeṣātmasaṃcayaḥ ॥ 12॥
puruṣottamasaṃyogāt puruṣottamasaṃśrayāt ।
puruṣottamamāso'yaṃ devo'sya puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 13॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān parabrahma parātparaḥ ।
brahmamuktaiḥ sadā sevyo bhagavānakṣarādhipaḥ ॥ 14॥
avatārasvarūpāṇāmavatārī hariḥ svayam ।
yasmād vyūhāḥ prajāyante vāsudevādayo'khilāḥ ॥ 15॥
yasmād golokadhāmādyāḥ prāvirbhavanti cāśrayāḥ ।
yatra sarvaparākāṣṭhā yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ॥ 16 ॥
yasmāt prakāśate sarvaṃ yanmayaṃ jaḍacetanam ।
so'yaṃ śrībhagavān rājādhirājaḥ parameśvaraḥ ॥ 17॥
puruṣottamamāsasyādhidevaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
akṣare parame vyomni muktamaṇḍalasevitaḥ ॥ 18॥
anāthaṃ malamāsaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā kṛpāvaśaḥ prabhuḥ ।
svīcakāra śaraṇyastaṃ śaraṇāgatameva saḥ ॥ 19॥
adhiṣṭhānatayā tasya tato'kṣarasamānatām ।
prāptaḥ śrīmalamāsastu nirmalaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥।1.293.20॥
sarve māsāḥ prathamaṃ tu garjanti sma muhurmuhuḥ ।
nā'smādṛśaṃ kiṃcidasti tārakaṃ bhuvanatraye ॥ 21॥
kintu śrīhariṇā yāvanmalamāsastvadhiṣṭhitaḥ ।
tato dvādaśamāsāste babhūburbhagnagarvakāḥ ॥22॥
kiṃ vaktavyaṃ mahālakṣmi! yatra nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
prasannastiṣṭhate tasya bhāgyaṃ puṇyaṃ kathānakam ॥23॥
anyamāsakṛtātpuṇyājjapāddhomātpradānakāt ।
anantaguṇakaṃ tvatra kṛtaṃ bhavati sarvathā ॥24॥
māso'yamadhikaḥ sarvapuṇyā''dhikyaprado mataḥ ।
gayāgaṃgāharidvārapuṣkarādiṣu yat kṛtam ॥25॥
tatkṛtasyā'dhike māse phalaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ।
kurukṣetre grahaṇe yatsnānasya phalamāpyate ॥ 26 ।
gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānasya pitṝṇāṃ tṛptirasti yā ॥
tatphalaṃ tādṛśī tṛptiradhimāsasya sevanāt ॥ 27।
jagannāthapure syād yad rathayātrāphalaṃ mahat ।
puruṣottamamāse tatphalaṃ tvāplavanād bhavet ॥।28 ॥
yatphalaṃ sarayūsnānāt sākete tīrthadarśanāt ।
tatphalaṃ tvadhike cādyadine snānāddhi jāyate ॥ 29 ॥
yatphalaṃ dvārikāyāṃ tu gomatīsāgarāplave ।
tatphalaṃ malamāse syāt pratipatsnānamātrataḥ ॥ 1.293.30 ॥
yatphalaṃ badarīkṣetre svarṇadyāṃ snānato bhavet ।
malamāsā''dyadivase'dhikaṃ syātsnānataḥ phalam ॥ 31 ॥
yatphalaṃ dakṣiṇe vārdhau rāmasetau jalāplavāt ।
malamāse'dhikaṃ snānāt tataḥ syātprathame dine ॥ 32 ॥
yatphalaṃ raivate svarṇarekhāyāṃ snānato bhavet ।
prabhāse yatphalaṃ vā sannidhāvāplavanādbhavet ॥ 33 ।
tato'dhikaphalaṃ tvādyadine snāne'dhikasya ca ।
yatphalaṃ kuṃkumavāpyāmaśvapaṭṭasarovare ॥ 34॥
tato'dhikaphalaṃ tvādyadivase'dhikamāsinaḥ ।
narmadāyāṃ śuklatīrthe oṃkāreśvaratīrthake ॥ 35 ॥
puṣkare paścime nārāyaṇe sarasi yatphalam ।
taḍāge mānase cāpi prayāge cāpi yatphalam ॥ 36 ॥
yamunāyāṃ mathurāyāṃ gaṇḍakyāṃ cāpi yatphalam ।
yatphalaṃ ca hariśaṃbhukṣetre kapilavāridhau ॥ 37 ॥
godāvaryāṃ tathā kuṃbhalagne kṛṣṇājale ca yat ।
sindhau tāmraparṇikāyāṃ kāveryāṃ cāpi yatphalam ॥ 38 ।
mahodaye tathā somā'māyāṃ parvaṇi paṭṭane ।
snānena yatphalaṃ yadyattvādyehni snānato'tra tad ॥ 39 ।
puruṣottamamāsasya prathamāyāṃ samāhitaḥ ।
brāhme muhūrte sañcintya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ॥1.293.40 ।
snāyānnadyāṃ taḍāge vā sarasi prasrave gṛhe ।
kūpe vāpyāṃ pravāhe vā tatpuṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet ॥4 1 ॥
nahi loke'dhikamāsasadṛśaṃ pāpanāśakam ।
puṇyārjakaṃ tathā tvanyat svargamokṣapradaṃ param ॥42॥
pūrṇimāyāṃ cādye'hani tvamāvāsyādine'pi ca ।
ekādaśe'ntime cāpi māse'hni puruṣottame ॥।43 ॥
snānena sadṛśaṃ tvanyattvakhaṇḍapuṇyakṛnnahi ।
teṣu snānena vai lokā nirdhūya pāpapuñjakam ॥44॥
jāyante puṇyapuñjena pārāvārasamā bhuvi।
snānamātreṇa vai svarge koṭikalpātmakaṃ milet ॥45॥
harestu pūjanāttatra vaikuṇṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ vrajet ।
puruṣottamanaivedyadāne mukticatuṣṭayam ॥46 ॥
labhate'tra na sandehaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo vadati svayam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvaṃ lakṣmīyuktaṃ dadāti vai ॥47॥
malamāsā''dyadivase snātuścārcayitustathā ।
svatvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavaddhāmni goloke'sya pravartate ॥48॥
pūrṇimāyāmamāyāṃ vā prātaḥ snānaṃ saritsu cet ।
kriyate'vabhṛthatulyaphalaṃ viṣṇukratormatam ॥49॥
madhyāhne cetkṛtaṃ snānamaśvamedhāntapuṇyadam ।
snānaṃ sāyaṃ vājapeyayajñasya phaladaṃ bhavet ॥1.293.50 ॥
snātvā vratī hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ suvarṇajam ।
āvāhayet tathā paṃcāmṛtaiḥ saṃsnāpayecchanaiḥ ॥51 ॥
ekādaśīkṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ malamāse tu parvaṇi ।
snānamātreṇa bhavati kimanyat tatkṛte punaḥ ॥5 2॥
lakṣagavāṃ mahiṣīṇāmayutasya śatasya tu ।
vāraṇānāṃ ca dānena kurukṣetre tu yatphalam ॥।53॥
lakṣāśvānāṃ tathā dānādyatphalaṃ kaurave sthale ।
prātaḥsnānānmalamāse tatphalaṃ pratipattithau ॥54॥
dvādaśānāṃ tu māsānāṃ pāpāni malamucyate ।
malaprakṣālanaśakto malamāsaḥ kṛto'sti vai ॥।55॥
snāpayecchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pañcāmṛtaistataḥ ।
śuddhodakaistailasārairmardayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ॥56॥
snāpayed vai tato vastrairmārjayet puruṣottamam ।
pītāmbaraṃ cottarīyaṃ svarṇaprāntaṃ samarpayet ॥57॥
kirīṭaṃ kuṇḍale cāpi candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā ।
kajjalaṃ kaṇṭhahārāँścormikāśca kaṃkaṇāni ca ॥58॥
puṣpahārān raśanāścā''bhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi ca ।
dravyā'laṃkārabhūṣāśca samarpayya prapūjayet ॥59॥
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā''pīḍān śekharān mālikāstathā ।
gucchaṃ kandaṃ svarṇayaṣṭiṃ chatraṃ ca cāmare'rpayet ॥1.293.60 ॥
naivedyāni sumiṣṭānnapakvānnāni phalāni ca ।
mṛṣṭasvādūni peyāni tāmbūlāni jalāni ca ॥61 ॥
samarpayettato nīrājayet kṣamāṃ tu yācayet ।
pradakṣiṇāṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavacca stutiṃ caret ॥62॥
puṣpāñjaliṃ pradatvaiva śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ।
prārthayenmalamāsasya vratasya pūrtaye muhuḥ ॥63॥
upoṣaṇānyekabhuktaṃ naktaṃ phalāśanaṃ ca vā ।
kariṣye malamāse tadvrataṃ te kṛpayā prabho ॥।4॥
nirvighnaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yāyāditi tuṣṭo hare kuru ।
snānaṃ tīrthe'thavā kūpe gṛhe nadyāṃ prage'nvaham ॥65॥
dānaṃ pūjāṃ yathāśakti kariṣye puruṣottama! ।
tatsarvaṃ bhajanaṃ cāpi nirvighnaṃ me bhavediti ॥66॥
kṛpāṃ kuru mahārājā''lasyaṃ nāśaya dehataḥ ।
mānasāni malānyatra prakṣālaya prabhāvataḥ ॥67॥
ātmīyāni ca pāpāni prajvālaya pareśvara ।
ātmamuktiṃ ca me dehi puruṣottama keśava ॥68॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa svāmin lakṣmīnātha prabhāpate ।
pārvatīmāṇikīsvāmin sampatkuru gṛhe mama ॥69॥
evaṃ samprārthya deveśaṃ svāpayedvā visarjayet ।
madhyāhne bhojayet sāyaṃ bhojayet pūjayet tathā ॥1.293.70 ॥
nīrājayecca dolāyāṃ guruṃ tvāndolayeddharim ।
bālakṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harinarāyaṇam ॥71॥
ramayedvā jale ramye tūdyāne bhavane'pi vā ।
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ savādyaṃ ca kārayet tatsamīpataḥ ॥।72॥
annavastrajalapuṣpaphaladānāni vai dadet ।
bhojayed bālakān sādhūn viprān gogrāsamarpayet ॥73 ॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇavārtā puruṣottamamāḥkathām ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāṃ vācayedavratī ॥74॥
mālāṃ kṛṣṇaharikṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇābhidhaiḥ ।
kuryājjapaṃ ca bhajanaṃ smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ muhuḥ ॥75॥
vandanaṃ dāsatāṃ sevāṃ pādayoścāpi mardanam ।
mārjanaṃ paricaryāṃ kṣālanaṃ viṣṇugrahasya ca ॥76॥
guroḥ sevāṃ prakurvīta vratapuṣṭikarīṃ śubhām ।
gurau tuṣṭe vrataṃ pūrṇe bhavedvai manasepsitam ॥77॥
phaletsarvaṃ prasaṃpūrṇaṃ svargamokṣādidāyakam ।
gaurīḥ sādhvīḥ satīrbālān bālikāḥ sadhavā'dhavāḥ ॥78॥
anāthā'nāśritāḥ saṃbhojayed dānāni saṃdadet ।
gṛhaṃ dadyājjīvikāṃ ca kṣetraṃ vāṭīṃ ca vetanam ॥79॥
sāhāyyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād yathā santoṣamāpnuyāt ।
saṃphalet tena vai māsaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ॥1.293.80 ॥
nityaṃ vai mandire dadyād devāya jalagāḥ śubhāḥ ।
āmānnāni ca śākāni lavaṇaṃ śarkarādikam ॥8 1 ॥
phalāni taṇḍulān mudgān dvidalā ghṛtavartikāḥ ।
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ nivārāँśca marīcakān sujīrakam ॥82॥
śuṇṭhīśca methikāṃ dadyād dadhi dugdhaṃ ca takrakam ।
patrāṇāṃ bhājikāṃ kharjūrakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ surājikām ॥83॥
bhūmikandān badāmāँśca kāṣṭhāni mṛttikāstathā ।
iṣṭikā vaṃśapātrāṇi dhātupātrāṇi mṛddhaṭān ॥84॥
ghāsagrāsān gavādyarthe pārāvātebhya ityapi ।
kaṇān dadyātpipīlikādyarthe piṣṭādikaṃ tathā ॥85॥
jalasthebhyaścaṇakāँśca śvādibhyo roṭakāँstathā ।
jalaṃ tu vṛkṣavallībhyo dadyācchrīpuruṣottame ॥86॥
pippalebhyo barburebhyo jalaṃ dadyācchivopari ।
bilvebhyaḥ śrīphalebhyaśca vaṭebhyo jalamarpayet ॥87॥
tulasībhyaḥ kamalebhyaḥ puṣpavallībhya ityapi ।
jalaṃ khādyaṃ pradadyācca kuryādvṛttiṃ surakṣikām ॥88॥
evaṃ dānāni vastrāṇāṃ vastūnāṃ cāpi kārayet ।
bhūśāyī brahmacārī ca śānte bhūtvā'dhike punaḥ ॥89॥
māse vai sādhuvadbhūtvā sādhvīvacca vratānvitaḥ ।
aihikaṃ tvātmanaḥ kuryātpuṇyaṃ paraṃ ca mokṣaṇam ॥1.293.90॥
patiḥ patnī ca dāsī ca sutaḥ sutā ca bāndhavāḥ ।
bandhupatnyo jananyaśca pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ ॥91॥
mātā mātāmahī cāpi bālāśca bālikāśca yāḥ ।
śiṣyā svasā cāśritāśca prāghūrṇikāḥ samāśritāḥ ॥92॥
ye ca gṛhe janāḥ svasyā'bhijanāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ।
sarve te vai vrataṃ kuryuḥ puruṣottamamāsi tu ॥93॥
ekabhaktena naktena phalenā'yācitena vā ।
jalena payasā dadhnā nivārādibhireva vā ॥94॥
śākena bharjitenāpi dehayātrāṃ vidhāya ca ।
puruṣottamamāsasya vrataṃ kuryustu śaktitaḥ ॥95 ॥
ekānnenā'thavā kuryādbhikṣānnenāpi sarvathā ।
uñcchavṛttyā'thavā kuryādājagaryā'thavā caret ॥96॥
devānnaṃ vā grasetsāyaṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam ।
devānāṃ darśanaṃ nityaṃ sādhūnāṃ caraṇāmṛtam ॥97॥
peyaṃ dhāryaṃ mastake ca dhūlyāmāluṇṭhanaṃ tathā ।
hareḥ pādodakaṃ peyaṃ striyā puṃsā vrate sadā ॥98॥
paryaṃkā'śayanaṃ kāryaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjanam ।
kṣauravivarjanaṃ kāryaṃ maithunasya vivarjanam ॥99॥
rasanāyāstapaḥ kāryaṃ tyāgaḥ prāptā'rjitasya ca ।
nāryā tu sparśanaṃ puṃsaḥ puṃsā sparśaśca yoṣitām ॥ 1.293.10 0॥
tyājyo vai sarvathā māse'dhike śrīpuruṣottame ।
gṛhādbahirna gantavyaṃ tīrthārthaṃ gamyameva vā ॥ 101 ॥
vāṭikāyāṃ samudyāne vastavyaṃ kṣetrake tathā ।
vane'raṇye daivabhūmau sādhumadhye satījane ॥ 1 02॥
tyāgibhūmau nivāsaśca tīrthataṭe'tha sīmni vā ।
parṇaśālottamāyāṃ vā vyomni vāso'dhike mataḥ ॥ 1 03॥
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai smṛtiḥ ।
pādayoḥ sevanaṃ cāpi pūjanaṃ vandanaṃ tathā ॥ 104॥
dāsyaṃ cātmātmīyavastvarpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇavicintanam ।
evamādikriyārūpāṃ bhaktiṃ kuryānmale'dhike ॥ 1 05॥
maṃ muktiṃ lāti gṛhṇāti malo'yaṃ māsa ucyate ।
mā māyā līyate yena malo'yaṃ māsa īritaḥ ॥ 106॥
māṃ lakṣmīṃ māti yo māsastasmānmalaḥ prakīrtyate ।
puruṣottamanāmmo vai makārastvantyavarṇakaḥ ॥ 1 07॥
lakṣmyāścādyākṣaro lopi 'malaḥ' kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā yutaḥ ।
maṃ mala līyate yena malakṣālanako hariḥ ॥ 1 08॥
malamāse kṛtaṃ yadyaddānaṃ puṇyaṃ tadīyakam ।
kaṃ sukhaṃ jāyate cādhyadhikaṃ hyadhikamāssa hi ॥ 1 09॥
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pratyahaṃ tu gṛhe gṛhe ।
vyavasthitaḥ śubhāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti puruṣottame ॥ 1.293.110 ॥
māse'tra ramayā lakṣmyā pārvatyā prabhayā tathā ।
māṇikyayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 1 11॥
golokāccāpi vaikuṇṭhādavyākṛtācca dhāmataḥ ।
bhuvane'tra samāyāti lokānāṃ darśanāya vai ॥ 1 12॥
satkarmāṇyarcanādīni pūjanāni vratāni ca ।
ke kurvanti ca me māse snānaṃ pūjāṃ pradānakam ॥ 1 13॥
evaṃ devaḥ sadā prātarvyomamārgeṇa paśyati ।
dṛṣṭvā snātṝn bhaktikartṝn bhaktān devagrahasya ca ॥ 1 14॥
dātṝn saṃpālayitṝँśca niyamānāṃ narān priyāḥ ।
vilokya divyadṛṣṭyā śrīsahitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 1 15॥
prasanno bhavati śreyaḥ kartuṃ yātuṃ ca tadgṛhe ।
sthātuṃ ciraṃ śriyai kṛṣṇaḥ pradiśati toṣitaḥ ॥ 1 16॥
puruṣottamamāsasya vratināṃ bhavanāni vai ।
sarvasmṛddhiprapūrṇāni kuru lakṣmi! mamā''grahāt ॥ 1 17॥
malamāsā'vamantṝṇāṃ gṛhe vāso ca mā tava ।
yatra nāsti mamā''vāsastatra te'pi ca mā'stu saḥ ॥ 1 18॥
ityādiśya hariḥ prātastato madhyāhnake'pi ca ।
naivedyaṃ tvarpitaṃ labdhvā punaryāti svadhāma vai ॥ 1 19॥
sāyaṃ punaḥ svapatnībhiḥ samāyāti hariḥ svayam ।
ārārtrikādikā sevāṃ tvaṃgīkartuṃ gṛhe gṛhe ॥ 1.293.120 ॥
ghṛtadīpaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ subhojanam ।
sarvaṃ prāpya svakaṃ dhāma visarjitaḥ prayāti saḥ ॥ 121 ॥
nityaṃ māse'dhike hyevaṃ paśyati śrīharirvibhuḥ ।
bhaktānukampayā tasmāt pūjyau śrīpuruṣottamau ॥ 1 22॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīpuruṣottamamāsamāhātmye tadādyadivasīyavratatapodāna- snānārādhananiyamādikartavyatānirūpaṇanāmā trinavatya-dhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.293 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 293 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 294
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 295 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
puruṣottamamāsasya svāmī lakṣmi! kṛpānidhiḥ ।
puruṣottamasaṃjño vai yathā jāto vadāmi tat ॥ 1 ॥
ekadā pūrṇamāse śrīnaranārāyaṇāśramam ।
samāyātā darśanārthaṃ śrīharermunayastathā ॥ 2 ॥
ṛṣayo divyavijñānā vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ ।
patnīvato lomaśaśca mārkaṇḍeyaśca nāradaḥ ॥ 3॥
vyāsaḥ pailaḥ sumanturdevalo'sitaśca kāśyapaḥ ।
jābāliḥ sumatiryājñavalkyaśca pippalāyanaḥ ॥ 4 ॥
vāmadevaḥ sutīkṣṇaśca parvato bhuguraṃgirāḥ ।
āpastambaḥ śarabhaṃgaḥ kapilo raibhya āruṇiḥ ॥ 5 ॥
kātyāyano rathītaraḥ ṛbhurmāṇḍavya ekataḥ ।
dvitastrito hyagastyo mudgalaḥ kratuśca gautamaḥ ॥ 6 ॥
kauśiko gālavo babhruratriḥ śaktirbudho vasuḥ ।
bodhāyanaḥ pṛthurdhūmraḥ śaṃkuḥ saṃkṛtirārtihan ॥ 7 ॥
kauṇḍinyaśca śinirvibhāṇḍakaḥ paṃkaśca dhūmapaḥ ।
jamadagniḥ kaṇādaśca gargo maunaśca bhārgavaḥ ॥ 8 ॥
bharadvājaḥ karkaśaśca śatānandaśca śaunakaḥ ।
viśālo viṣṇuvṛddhaśca jarjaraśca tanurjayaḥ ॥ 9 ॥
pāraḥ pāśadharaḥ pūro jaṃgamo jaiminirmakhaḥ ।
uddālako mahāṣeṇa āmalakī - ca piṃgalaḥ ॥ 1 0॥
śāṇḍīrakaḥ prabhuścātri karuṇaḥ śvetaketukaḥ ।
romapādaśca kadruśca jājaliścyavanaḥ śamaḥ ॥ 11 ॥
dīrghatamāḥ pṛthuśravāḥ śvetāśvatara āsuriḥ ।
jaigīṣavyastathā''vaṭyo dharmaśca bharga aiśvaraḥ ॥ 12॥
vasiṣṭhaśca marīciśca pulahaśca pulastyakaḥ ।
ete cānye sahasrāṇi naranārāyaṇāśramam ॥ 1 3॥
samājagmurdarśanārthaṃ brahmiṣṭhāḥ śiṣyakoṭibhiḥ ।
lokānugrahakartāraḥ paropakṛtidharmiṇaḥ ॥ 14॥
nemurnārāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat jayaghoṣaṇām ।
niṣeduḥ purataḥ sarve satkṛtā brahmapāragāḥ ॥ 15॥
te ca nārāyaṇaṃ śāntaṃ saumyaṃ valkaladhāriṇam ।
prasannavadanaṃ turyapuruṣārthāśrayaṃ prabhum ॥ 16॥
aśeṣadivyakalyāṇaguṇā''nandapayonidhim ।
ūrdhvapuṇḍradharaṃ divyajaṭaṃ divyaśriyā''śritam ॥17॥
divyahārādisaṃśobhaṃ tulasīmālikādharam ।
parabrahma japanmālākaraṃ śaraṇyamacyutam ॥ 18॥
jitendriyaṃ tapomūrtiṃ tejaścakrānvitānanam ।
badarīśritasarvasvaṃ paśyanti sma samādhivat ॥ 1 9॥
tatastatra samāyātāḥ surāśca pitarastathā ।
nadyastīrthāni sarvāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca ॥20॥
araṇyāni nagarāṇi sarāṃsi sāgarāstathā ।
siddhāśca yoginaścāpi samājagmuḥ suharṣitāḥ ॥21 ॥
nirāhārāḥ phalāhārāḥ phenāhārāśca kecana ।
vātāmbuparṇakāhārāḥ śvāsāhārāśca kecana ॥22॥
nārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭukāmāḥ dṛṣṭvā śāntiṃ parāṃ yayuḥ ।
te sarve'pi praṇemustaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ mahāmunim ॥23॥
pare brahmaṇi saṃlagnaṃ prāsphuradbahulaprabham ।
dṛṣṭvā niṣeduste sarve purataḥ śrīharestataḥ ॥24॥
yugāśca sandhayaḥ saṃvatsarāśca kratavastathā ।
samāyayustathā māsāḥ pakṣā dināni rātrayaḥ ॥25॥
kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrtāni ghaṭikāḥ praharāstathā ।
samāyayuḥ kuṭumbāḍhyāḥ sasvāminaḥ sumūrtayaḥ ॥26॥
tatra vai kārtiko lakṣmīnārāyaṇādhidaivataḥ ।
mārgaśīrṣo ramāvāsudevādhidaivato'pi ca ॥ 27॥
pauṣaḥ saṃkrāntiśaktiśrīviṣṇavākhyādityadaivataḥ ।
māgho vasantavijayāmādhavādhisudaivataḥ ॥28॥
phālgunaśca mahārātrilakṣmībrahmādhidaivataḥ ।
caitrastu pārthivīśaktisītāśyāmādhidaivataḥ ॥29॥
vaiśākho hetiyugdurgālakṣmīnṛsiṃhadaivataḥ ।
jyeṣṭho gaṃgāmahālakṣmītrivikramādhidaivataḥ ॥3 0 ॥
āṣāḍhaśca mahāvidyālakṣmīvyāsādhidaivataḥ ।
śrāvaṇo vārṣikīdolāramākṛṣṇādhidaivataḥ ॥3 1 ॥
bhādrapado mahāgaurīvāmanabrahmadaivataḥ ।
āśvinaṃ śāradālakṣmīnārāyaṇādhidaivataḥ ॥3 2॥
rājante sma naranārāyaṇāśrame tu seśvarāḥ ।
na teṣāṃ kaścidapyasti hyapūrvaḥ svāmivarjitaḥ ॥33 ॥
svasvāmiyogamāhātmyātsarve saubhāgyaśālinaḥ ।
vartante svasvādhikāre sarvebhyaḥ phaladāyinaḥ ॥ 34॥
tataḥ paścāt samāyāto malamāso nirīśvaraḥ ।
adhikaḥ pucchavatyaścāllagnaḥ sarvairjugupsitaḥ ॥ 35॥
kṛṣṇavarṇo malinaśca pānabhojanavarjitaḥ ।
snānapūjāvihīnaścā'spṛśyaḥ sarvaistiraskṛtaḥ ॥36॥
tamūcuḥ sakalāstatra hyanāthaṃ ca jugupsitam ।
anarho malamāso'yaṃ sūryasaṃkramavarjitaḥ ॥ 37॥
aspṛśyo malarūpatvācchubhe karmaṇi garhitaḥ ।
udyogavilayo naṣṭalābho bhāgyavivarjitaḥ ॥ 38 ॥
samāyātaḥ kutaścainaṃ dūre kurvantu seśvarāḥ! ।
dakṣaścandramase prādāt saptaviṃśatikanyakāḥ ॥ 3 9॥
tataścāyaṃ samutpannastāsāṃ malo'yamasti vai ।
tāsāmucchiṣṭarūpo'yaṃ samutpannastridoṣakṛt ॥38 ॥
sārdhadvivarṣadoṣāntamalo'yaṃ tvapasāryatām ।
śrutvaitadvacanaṃ teṣāṃ cintāgrastaikamānasaḥ ॥4 1 ॥
mumūrṣurabhavattena hṛdayena vidūyatā ।
dūraṃ cā'spṛśyavattasthau paśyanmāṃ badarīsthitam ॥42॥
te sarve darśanaṃ kṛtvā'bhavansamādhiniṣṭhitāḥ ।
malo dhairyaṃ samālambya madīyakarasaṃjñayā ॥43 ॥
prāpto vaikuṇṭhabhavanaṃ yatrā'hamavasaṃ rame! ।
uddhārārtha samāgatya māmasau dṛṣṭavāṃstataḥ ॥44॥
rudan saṃbhagnahṛdayo daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi ।
prāṃjalī ruddhanetro'sau babhāṣe svahitaṃ vacaḥ ॥45॥
api nātha kṛpāsindho dīnānāṃ śaraṇaprada! ।
dīna tiraskṛtaṃ cānyairmalaṃ māṃ rakṣa cāgatam ॥46 ॥
nirīśvaraṃ ca malinaṃ varjitaṃ śubhakarmasu ।
sadaivatairbahirnītaṃ dīnavatsala rakṣa mām ॥47॥
satyavrato gajendraśca dharmaḥ sureśvarādayaḥ ।
avitā bhavitā viṣṇo rakṣa māṃ parameśvara ॥48 ॥
ityuktvā''vilacakṣuṣko maunamāsthāya nimnadṛk ।
babhūva tādṛśaṃ vīkṣya kṛpāpūrṇo harirjagau ॥49॥
vatsa! bhagnamanā mā bhūruddhariṣyāmi mā śucaḥ ।
vada duḥkhaṃ vārayāmi na vai śocitumarhasi ॥5 0 ॥
na me śaraṇyamāpanno duḥkhaleśāya kalpyate ।
aśokā''nandavaikuṇṭhaṃ prāptastvaṃ nāsi śokabhāg ॥5 1 ॥
malamāsaḥ samāśvāsaṃ labdhvovāca naman harim ।
sarvajño'syantarātmā'si vetsi sarvaṃ yathātatham ॥52॥
vacmi tathāpi te nātha duḥkhaṃ mṛtyusamaṃ mama ।
kalā kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca dhaṭikā divasāḥ samāḥ ॥53 ॥
pakṣā māsā yugāḥ sarve modante svāmyadhiṣṭhitāḥ ।
paryuṣitānmamotpattirucchiṣṭācchiṣṭakaccarāt ॥54॥
mālinyaṃ malarūpatvamaspṛśyatvamasatkṛtiḥ ।
asvāmyatvamavamānamaśubhatvaṃ sadā mama ॥55॥
akāryakatvamaphalitvaṃ me nā'dhikṛtiḥ kvacit ।
ṛṣidevā'dhidevādyairbadaryāśramamāgataiḥ ॥56 ॥
māsādibhirbhartsitaścā'spṛśyīkṛto nirākṛtaḥ ।
karmahīnīkṛtaścaiva tarjitaḥ sarvathā'rditaḥ ॥57॥
tasmādvinaṣṭumicchāmi varaṃ mṛtyuḥ kujīvanāt ।
paraduḥkhā'sahiṣṇustvaṃ tūpakārī pumuttamaḥ ॥58 ॥
kuru śreyo mama nāthā'nyathā tu pāmaro'guṇaḥ ।
mariṣyāmi mariṣyāmi mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ॥59 ॥
ityuktvā pādayoḥ śrīnārāyaṇasya papāta saḥ ।
pāhi pāhi jagannātha pāhi kṛṣṇa ramāpate ॥6 0 ॥
pāhi lakṣmīpate nātha śaraṇaṃ māmupāgatam ।
ityuktavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vaikuṇṭhanilayo hariḥ ॥6 1 ॥
provācottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te śokaṃ mā kuru paśya mām ।
samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ golokādhipatiṃ prabhum ॥62 ॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gopīvṛndasthaṃ puruṣottamam ।
ninādayantaṃ muralīṃ dvibāhuँ śyāmasundaram ॥6 3 ॥
kaṃjanetraṃ pārvaṇendumukhaṃ kandarpadhāmakam ।
pītāmbaraṃ vanamālāmaṇikaustubhabhūṣaṇam ॥64॥
candanokṣitavakṣaskaṃ kastūrītilakā'nvitam!
sadratnāḍhyormikāyaṣṭikirīṭakuṇḍalānvitam ॥65॥
śrīvatsaśobhitavakṣaḥsthalaṃ siṃhāsanasthitam ।
gopagopīgaṇākīrṇaṃ purāṇapuruṣottamam ॥ 66॥
gacchāvaḥ sa hariḥ kṛṣṇastvadduḥkhaṃ vyapaneṣyati ।
ityuktvā taṃ kare dhṛtvā goloke gatavān hariḥ ॥67 ॥
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān pūjāsāmagrikāyutaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇārthaṃ rādhikārthe vastūni vividhāni ca ।।68 ॥
ratnāni bhūṣaṇāni vastrāṇi śrāṃgārikāṇi ca ।
sugandhadravaramyāṇi peyāni bhojanāni ca ॥69॥
phalāni mukhavāsāni divyasvarṇādikāni ca ।
asaṃkhyopakaraṇāni rājayogyāni vai prabhuḥ ॥7 0 ॥
saha nītvā tu golokaṃ prāptau kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
virajāyāṃ ca tau snātau śataśṛṃgaṃ gatau ca tau ॥ 71 ॥
malamāsamalānyatra naṣṭāni virajā''plavāt ।
malamāsadvitīyāyāṃ tithau snāturmalāni vai ॥72॥
bahujanmopārjitāni nāśameṣyanti mūlataḥ ।
virajāsnānapuṇyaṃ ca prāpsyante vratino janāḥ ॥73 ॥
snānamātreṇa golokaprāptiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।
rāsamaṇḍalabhūmiṃ cā''lokya vṛndāvanādikam ॥74॥
dhūlīṃ ca mastake kṛtvā'kṣayabhāṇḍīrasadvaṭau ।
vilokya mukhyadurgaṃ ca praviśya gopikāśritām ॥75॥
vasatiṃ ṣoḍaśagopurābhyantaranivāsinīm ।
yayatuśca bhavanāntaḥ rādhākṛṣṇasamīpataḥ ॥76 ॥
vilokya divyaṃ yugalaṃ cakraturdaṇḍavacca tau ।
nematuḥ pādayordvābhyāṃ prasannābhyāṃ sabhājitau ॥77॥
susatkṛtau yathāyogyāsane tau tu niṣedatuḥ ।
nārāyaṇaṃ tadā kṛṣṇo hastenādāya harṣataḥ ॥78 ॥
nimimīla tu bāhubhyāṃ vakṣaḥ kṛtvā ca vakṣasi ।
dhvaje siṃhāsane nārāyaṇaṃ niṣādya vai muhuḥ ॥79 ॥
hāsyaprasannatāyukto jijñāsāṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ ।
hetuścāgamane nārāyaṇena kathitastadā ॥8 0 ॥
pūjitaśca tato nārāyaṇena bhagavān svayam ।
pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpitaśca rādhayā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ॥8 1 ॥
dugdhena snāpitaḥ paścātpayasā snāpitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
vastreṇā''vartitaḥ paścādarcitaścandanādibhiḥ ॥8 2॥
śṛṃgārito vibhūṣābhirdivyavastrādyalaṃkṛtaḥ ।
sadhūpadīpā''rārtrikapradakṣiṇāstavādibhiḥ ॥83 ॥
saratnamaṇisauvarṇasthālopadābhirarcitaḥ ।
phalaiḥ rasairbhojanaiśca vividhaistarpitaḥ prabhuḥ ॥84॥
rādhikādyāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyo yogyopaṭṭābhirarcitāḥ ।
śaktyā'pi malamāsena śrīkṛṣṇaścārcitastadā ॥85॥
prasādaṃ labdhavān māso malaścāpyāśiṣaṃ satīm ।
śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā yuktaḥ prāhā'nugrahapūrvakam ॥86॥
yathā'haṃ pūjitaścātra dvitīyādivase tvayā ।
tathā tava tithau loke dvitīyāyāṃ prage niśi ॥87॥
rādhākṛṣṇaṃ yathāśakti pūjayiṣyanti ye janāḥ ।
tatsarve saṃgrahīṣyāmi rādhayā sahitastadā ॥88॥
godugdhena dvitīyāyāṃ snapanīyo viśeṣataḥ ।
pañcāmṛtairjalairvāpi suvarṇamūrtikaḥ prabhuḥ ॥89॥
suvarṇāmbarabhūṣābhiralaṃkāryo dravādibhiḥ ।
śraṃgārikopakaraṇeralaṃkāryaḥ sarādhikaḥ ॥9 0 ॥
dhūpadīpādibhiḥ pūjyaḥ kaṃkaṇairmukuṭādibhiḥ ।
miṣṭānnaistarpaṇīyaśca ratnabhūṣādibhistathā ॥91 ॥
atyarthaṃ pūjanīyo'haṃ tṛpto bhavāmi sarvathā ।
dāsye pratyupadāṃ tebhyo vividhā'saṃkhyasampadaḥ ।।92 ।।
yathā santi mama loke tathā dāsye na saṃśayaḥ ।
ante dāsye ca golokaṃ smṛddhaṃ sukhaṃ ca śāśvatam ॥ 9 3 ॥
ityāśīrvādamādāya malamāso'pi bhāgyavān ।
nārāyaṇasamakṣaṃ vai jāto'dhikapratāpavān ॥ 94॥
uvāca tu tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tvayā bhāgyena vardhitaḥ ।
yathā sasvāmiko bhūyāsaṃ tathā nātha me kuru ॥ 95 ॥
ajñānāndhatamohartarjñānamārgapradīpaka ।
asaṃkhyagolakotpattivināśādiprakāraṇa ॥ 96 ॥
yogyadṛśya svabhaktābhirdṛśya divyasuvigraha ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahetiścaturbhujārcita ॥ 97॥
asaṃkhyarādhikālakṣmīsamapatnīprasevita ।
indīvaradalaśyāma paṃkajāruṇalocana ॥98 ॥
koṭiśāradapūrṇenduśobhātirocanānana ।
koṭimanmathasaundaryalīlādhāmamanohara ॥99॥
śrīvatsavakṣaḥsaṃrājatkaustubhahārarājita ।
sadratnakoṭisannaddhakirīṭakaṭakojjala ॥ 100 ॥
bhaktamaṃgalakṛdviṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ।
nirasyā'maṃgalaṃ sarve mama maṃgalamāvaha ॥ 101 ॥
iti stutastadā kṛṣṇaḥ prasanno'bhūduvāca ha ।
etatstotraprapāṭhena satphalaṃ prāpsyate janaḥ ॥ 10 2॥
bhaktirbhaviṣyati kṛṣṇo putrapautravivardhinī ।
bhaviṣyatyapakīrteśca kṣayaḥ kīrtirbhaviṣyati ॥ 103 ॥
pūjāyāṃ yāni vastūni tvarpitāni ca tāni tu ।
lakṣaguṇāni bhaktāya pradāsye pravadāmyaham ॥ 1 04॥
adhimāsadvitīyāyāṃ pūjyaścā'hamanantakaiḥ ।
dāsyetvanantakaṃ tasmai yadyadiṣṭaṃ vratārthinaḥ ॥ 105 ॥
jalaṃ vaṭāya dātavyaṃ bhojyaṃ viprāya sādhave ।
śāṭīṃ kanyāpravaryāyai dātavyā phalalabdhaye ॥ 106 ।।
āmānnāni ca deyāni viṣṇubhaktāya sādhave ।
svarṇadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ vidyārthine ca yoṣite ।।107 ।।
dvitīyāyāṃ pradātavyaṃ sarve vai dviguṇaṃ śubham ।
koṭiguṇaṃ prapadyeta phalaṃ cātra paratra ca ॥ 108 ।।
iti kṛṣṇo vadannārāyaṇaṃ prāha punaḥ punaḥ ।
nārāyaṇa hare lakṣmīpate vaikuṇṭhabhāskara ।।109 ॥
malamāsasya vṛttāntaṃ jāne'haṃ sakalaṃ vibho ।
bhavatā śrīpatinā ca kathitaṃ tadviśeṣataḥ ॥ 110 ॥
ayaṃ tvadhikamāso'sti vyapetaravisaṃkramaḥ ।
malino'yamanarho'sti śubhakarmaṇi varjitaḥ ॥ 111 ॥
iti matvā sṛṣṭidevaistiraskṛto'pi madgṛham ।
samāyāto hyataścāyaṃ malino nāsti cā'dyataḥ ॥ 11 2 ॥
divyo'sti pariśuddho'sti pūjanīyo'sti sarvathā ।
kintu tasya bhavet svāmī ko'dya cātra vicāryatām ॥ 113 ॥
anyeṣāmapi māsānāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī bhavāmyaham ।
bhavānapi tathā svāmī bhavatīti vicāryatām ॥ 1 14॥
tasmāttrayodaśe māsi svāmitvaṃ tvāvayornahi ।
tadarthe nanu gacchāmo yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।115 ॥
virājate pare dhāmnyakṣare rājādhirājakaḥ ।
avatārā asaṃkhyātā yasmādbhavanti mādṛśāḥ ॥ 11 6॥
golokādikadhāmāni yaddhāmāṃśā bhavanti vai ।
sa vicāryaiva caitasya svāminaṃ kalpayiṣyati ।।1 17॥
avatārī tvanādiśrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
yojayiṣyati yaṃ tvasmin so'sya svāmī bhaviṣyati ॥ 118 ॥
iti vicārya sahasā kṛṣṇonārāyaṇo'dhikaḥ ।
yayustrayo'kṣare dhāmni yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 11 9॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye badarikāśrame naranārāyaṇadarśanārthamṛṣi muni parvata nadī vṛkṣa vallī sura samvatsara māsādibhirāgatairmalamāsasyā'spṛśyatvena tiraskāre kṛte malamāsasya vaikuṇṭhagamanaṃ tatratyanārāyaṇena saha golokagamanaṃ tatratya śrīkṛṣṇarādhikāpūjanottara sabhāgyatāṃ prāpyāśīrvādān saṃgṛhyā'kṣarabrahmalokaṃ prati sasvāmikatvārthe gamanamiti nirūpaṇanāmācaturnavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.294॥

adhyāyaḥ 295
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 296 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yayuḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo'dhimāstathā ।
golokādupari divyavyomamārgeṇa vai kṣaṇāt ॥ 1 ॥
saccidānandasandohānvitamakṣaradhāma yat।।
brahmahṛde trayaḥ snātvā puruṣottamarūpiṇaḥ ॥ 2 ॥
bhūtvā'valokayantaśca muktānāṃ maṇḍalāni te।
dvibhujāndvyaṣṭavarṣīyān rūpānurūpavigrahān ॥ 3 ॥
koṭinārāyaṇatulyān rūpatejaḥsusiddhibhiḥ ।
golokādapi saundarye teṣu koṭiguṇaṃ ca vai ॥ 4 ॥
vartate tādṛśān dṛṣṭvā puruṣottamarūpiṇaḥ ।
traya āścaryasampannā babhūvuḥ kṛṣṭamānasāḥ ॥ 5 ॥
udyānāni ca saudhāni muktānāmavalokya te ।
vimānānyupakaraṇānyālokya vismayaṃ gatāḥ ॥ 6 ॥
akṣaraṃ vastu cālokya virāgo'bhūt svadhāmasu ।
akṣaradhāmavastūnāṃ tulanāyāṃ svadhāmajam ॥ 7 ॥
vastumātraṃ nirānandamivā''bhātaṃ tadā tu taiḥ ।
nītaṃ yadvastu vaikuṇṭhāt puruṣottamapūjane ॥ 8 ॥
golokādvā ca tatsarvaṃ nirānandamabhāsata ।
nistejaskamivaibhistaddṛṣṭaṃ svadhāmavastukam ॥ 9 ॥
tataste bhagnamanaso hyupadāviṣaye khalu ।
sañjātāstāvatā brahmasarastatra vyalokayan ॥ 10 ॥
anantayojanāyāmaṃ divyavārirasātmakam ।
yatra snānena vastu śrīpuruṣottamabhogyatām ॥ 11 ॥
labhate te trayaḥ snātā brahmasarasi vai mudā ।
upadāḥ prokṣitāstena yogyaṃ vastu tadā'bhavat ॥ 12 ॥
atha dṛṣṭo viśālaśca lakṣayojanavistṛtaḥ ।
prāsādo rakṣakān pṛṣṭvā dvāramuktāँstrayastataḥ ॥ 13 ॥
viviśuryatra vai rājādhirājaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
rājate'saṃkhyadivyātmamuktaiḥ saṃsevitaḥ prabhuḥ ॥ 1 4॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇau vīkṣya tvāgatau puruṣottamaḥ ।
atīva jahṛṣe svāmī namantau tau punaḥ punaḥ ॥ 15 ॥
papraccha kuśalaṃ svasvadhāmnaḥ svasti ca śāśvatam ॥
bhagavatkṛpayā sarvaṃ svastimatkuśalaṃ bahu ॥ 16 ॥
ityuktvā''sanayostau saṃrājitau nṛnarāyaṇau ।
tatīyā'dhikamāso'pi kṛtvā vai pañcadaṇḍavat ॥ 17॥
dāsavat tiṣṭhate pārśve tayostāvatpumuttamaḥ ।
akṣarādhipatistau ca papraccha taṃ tadā prati ॥ 18 ॥
ko'yaṃ 'kimarthamāyāto yuvābhyāṃ dhāmni me tviha ।
manye śaraṇyamāśritya mahālābhārthamāgatam ॥ 19 ॥
evaṃ pṛcchati sarveśe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāvubhau ।
pūjayāmāsaturdivyaiḥ pāribarhairanantakaiḥ ॥ 2 0 ॥
brahmasarojalaiḥ pūrve samyak pādāvanejanam ।
pañcāmṛtairdivyarasairāplavanaṃ taduttaram ॥ 21 ॥
jalaiḥ rasātmakaiścābhiṣecayitvā'kṣarādhipam।
candanādidravaiḥ samyakpūjayitvā tataśca tau ॥22॥
vastrābhūṣaṇa hārādi cārpayāmāsaturmudā ।
chatra cāmara ratnādi pādukā yaṣṭikādikam ॥23॥
ūrmikāṃgada mukuṭa śṛṃkhalā kalgimaṇḍanam ।
svarṇaphullarikā mālā raśanā kaṃkaṇādikam ॥24॥
bhakṣyabhojya lehya coṣya śarkarāvṛtamiśritam ।
bhojyānnapeyasusvādya bhogyacarvaṇakādikam ॥25॥
svarṇāmbarāsana pātra divyaphalarasādikam ।
yadyad yogyaṃ samarpyaṃ cā'bhūttadā'rpayatāṃ tadā ॥26॥
ārārtrikaṃ kṛtavantau stutvā niṣedatuḥ sukham ।
gṛhītātithyasatkārau procatuścādhimāsikam ॥27॥
ayaṃ māso'dhikamāso malamāso'sti dhikkṛtaḥ ।
sarvamāsaiḥ ṛṣibhiśca niṣiddhaḥ śubhakarmasu ॥ 28॥
tadayaṃ vai mayā kṛṣṇenā'sya saubhāgyatā kṛto ।
kintu vinādhidevaṃ sa gaṇanāṃ teṣu nārhati ॥29॥
etadīyaṃ mahadduḥkhamanivārya bhavadṛte ।
ata enaṃ nirātaṃkaṃ sānandaṃ kṛpayā kuru ॥30॥
asmadarthaṃ ca kartavyamasya duḥkhanivāraṇam ।
śrutvaivaṃ tvakṣarātītaḥ prāha śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥3 1 ॥
samīcīnaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇa yadatrāgatavān bhavān ।
nārāyaṇo'pi cātrādyāgatastadapi śobhanam ॥32॥
malamāse kare kṛtvā loke kīrtimavāpsyathaḥ ।
bhavadbhyāṃ saṃdhṛto haste sa mayaiva kare dhṛtaḥ ॥ 33 ॥
ata ena kariṣyāmi sarvopari mayā samam ।
yathā'haṃ svaguṇairyuktastathainaṃ vidadhāmi vai ॥ 34॥
sāmarthyaiścā'rcyabhāvena tathā varaparākramaiḥ ।
mama tulyaṃ vidadhāmi na to'nyat kimapekṣyate ॥35॥
vinaṣṭasarvapāpmatvaṃ satyasaṃkalpadāyitā ।
kāmanāphaladāyitvaṃ matsārūpyapradāyitā ॥36॥
svargādiprāpayitṛtvaṃ mokṣasthānapradāyitā ।
ebhiḥ sāmarthyakairyukto bhavatvadhikamāsakaḥ ॥37॥
mama sarve guṇāścānye'dhimāsāya samarpitāḥ ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñā me vastuṣṭyai cārpitā tathā ॥ 38॥
asya svāmī bhavāmyeva brahmeśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
mama nāmnā jagatsarvaṃ tannāmā'pi grahīṣyati ॥39॥
vidhūya svāni pāpāni pāvanaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ।
matsvarūpo hyayaṃ bhūtvā jagatpūjyo bhaviṣyati ॥40 ॥
sarvavandyaḥ sarvamāsottamo māso bhaviṣyati ।
enamāśritya vai lokā vratino jāpakā'rcakāḥ ॥4 1 ॥
dātāraḥ snānakartāro bhojayitāra ityapi ।
kiṃcitpuṇyasya kartāraścāpi me tu prabhāvataḥ ॥42॥
duḥkhadāridyatāpā'dhivyādhipīḍāvidhūya ca ।
sukhasampaddhanadārā'patyārogyasamṛddhibhiḥ ॥43॥
rājamānasubhavanā bhaviṣyantyutsavānvitāḥ ।
śṛṃgārābharaṇānnārthapātraparicchadādibhiḥ ॥44॥
dāsadāsījanamitrasevakāścitabhūmibhiḥ ।
yogakṣemabalā'dainyairbhaviṣyanti mahotsavāḥ ॥45॥
bhojyapānopabhogyaiśca sattāvidyāprathādibhiḥ ।
udyānayānavāhādyairbhaviṣyanti samanvitāḥ ॥46॥
rasairvṛkṣaphalaiḥpuṣpairgodhanaiḥ svarṇarūpyakaiḥ ।
maṇiratnahīrakādyairbhaviṣyanti sadojjvalāḥ ॥47॥
puruṣottamamāsasya vratino madgatā hi te ।
mattaḥ prāpsyanti sarva te yathā cintāmaṇerjanaḥ ॥48॥
svarge vā vaidhasaṃ vāpi vairājaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vā ।
raudraṃ bhaumaṃ ca vā kṣaira sthalaṃ prāpsyanti yanmatam ॥49॥
patnīḥ patīn gṛhaṃ saudhān suputrān rūpavaibhavān ।
akṣatānavyayān prāpsyantyadhimāsasya sevanāt ॥50 ॥
sakāmā vāpi niṣkāmāḥ prāpsyantīṣṭatamaṃ hyataḥ ।
sakāmaścātha niṣkāmo yathā'haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ॥5 1 ॥
tathā'yaṃ vai janeṣṭasya pūrako mokṣadaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
yathā'haṃ paripūrṇo'smi tathā'yaṃ cā'vyayaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥52॥
evaṃ ye ceṣaṇāvanto yadveṣaṇāvivarjitāḥ ।
pūjayiṣyanti te sveṣṭaṃ labdhvā mokṣamavāpnuyuḥ ॥93॥
enaṃ prapūjya karmāṇi karmiṇāṃ yānti bhasmatām ।
ātmā divyo mahāśuddho māmevaiṣyati cākṣare ॥54॥
madarthaṃ vai mahāyatnā yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
sādhavaśca mahātmāno yoginastāpasāstathā ॥95॥
yoginyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyaḥ sādhvyaḥ satyastathā'dhavāḥ ।
virāgāśca virāgiṇyo nirvāṇasatkṛtādarāḥ ॥56॥
nirmohinyastathā brahmavādinyo nyāsatatparāḥ ।
prayatante vatsarāṇāṃ sahasrātprāsahasrakam ॥57॥
tathāpi naiva yāntyete maddhāma paramātparam ।
puruṣottamabhaktāstu yānti maddhāma māsataḥ ॥58॥
anye tapasvinaḥ śāntā nirāhārā nirāśayāḥ ।
patrapuṣpaphalāhārā jalamātraniṣeviṇaḥ ॥59॥
vāyumātra kṛtāhārā bāṣpabhojina eva ca ।
dhūmrapānā jalāvāsāḥ śītātapasahāstathā ॥6 0 ॥
śuṣkadehā bhagnaśiśnanāḍikā brandharandhragāḥ ।
parakāyapraveśārhā vratadārḍhyayutā api ॥ 61 ॥
mama bhaktiṃ vinā naiva yānti maddhāma te khalu ।
puruṣottamamāsasya vratino ye tu te mama ॥ 62॥
bhaktā mama vratinaste māsamātreṇa matpadam ।
matkṛpayā prayāsyanti śāśvataṃ tvamṛtaṃ padam ॥63 ॥
kṛṣṇa! nārāyaṇa! tasmānmāso'yaṃ bhavatoḥ kṛte ।
kṛto mayā tu mūrdhanyaḥ sarvakāmārthasādhakaḥ ॥64॥
ye janāḥ sevayiṣyanti māsaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ siddhimāpsyanti te janāḥ ॥ 65 ॥
tasmāt saṃsevyatāṃ sarvairmāso'yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
śreṣṭhakṣetranibho māso'dhiko bījaprarohaṇe ॥66 ॥
phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dadāti puruṣottamaḥ ।
svarge bhuktvā punaryāṃti cāturmāsyaprayājinaḥ ॥ 67॥
akṣaraṃ śāśvataṃ yānti puruṣottamayājinaḥ ।
saptā'dhikasaptaśatakulānyuddhārayatyayam ॥ 68 ॥
anyamāsavratakartā punarjanmātigo na vai ।
mama māse vratakartā punarjanmagamo na hi ॥69॥
atra māse tvahaṃ sākṣānnivasāmyadhidaivataḥ ।
mannāmā'pi kṛtaṃ cāsya tasmāttadātmako hyaham ॥ 70 ॥
tadāśritānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pūrayiṣyāmi vāñchitān ।
gaṇayiṣye nā'parādhān bhaktāṃ tvasya sarvathā ॥ 71 ॥
me bhaktyapekṣayā madīyasya bhaktirmama priyā ।
vilambo na madīyamāsabhaktānāṃ manorathe ॥72॥
mama bhaktaṃ vihāyaiva teṣāṃ pūrṇaṃ karomyaham ।
sarvaṃ dadāmi tebhyo vai yato manmāsayājinaḥ ॥73 ॥
mamātivallabhāste vai na tathā muktakoṭayaḥ ।
mama māsaṃ samāsādya japadānādivarjitāḥ ॥74॥
snānapūjāvihīnāśca satkāryaparipanthinaḥ ।
kūpavāpītaḍāgādipūrtayajñavivarjitāḥ ॥75 ॥
devatīrthadvijasādhusādhvīdevālayadviṣaḥ ।
nindakāste bhaviṣyanti kākavarcaskabhakṣiṇaḥ ॥76 ॥
kuṣṭhinaḥ śvaśṛgālāste bhaviṣyanti nirāśrayāḥ ।
durbhāgyānāṃ nindakānāṃ sukhaṃ na syāddivāniśam ॥ 77 ॥
mama māse vratināṃ ye duḥkhaṃ kurvanti cā'dhamāḥ ।
paratāḍanapāśāste bhaviṣyanti pragardabhāḥ ॥78 ॥
tiraskurvanti me māsaṃ ye ca dharmavidūṣakāḥ ।
bhaktimārge'tra vighnasya kartāro ye'pyasūyakāḥ ॥ 79 ॥
vṛkṣavāgūrikāste tu bhaviṣyanti malādanāḥ ।
pratitṛtīyavarṣe ye hyāsādya puruṣottamam ॥8 0 ॥
ātmaśreyo na kurvanti te yāsyanti mamālayam ।
duḥkhadāmānalavyāptāścātra bhūtvā praduḥkhinaḥ ॥8 1 ॥
śrīdaḥ sampatkarastasmādatimṛtyujayapradaḥ ।
vyarthaścāyaṃ na netavyo māso me puruṣottamaḥ ।।8 2 ॥
kanyakā vā yuvatyaśca sadhavāścā'dhavāstathā ।
sapatnyo yoṣito vṛddhāḥ subhagā durbhagā api ॥ 83॥
asukhāḥ susukhāścāpi sveṣṭaprāptyarthameva yāḥ ।
mama māse kariṣyanti vrataṃ dānaṃ madarcanam ॥84 ॥
snānaṃ mālāṃ devasevāṃ puṇyakāryāṇi yānyapi ।
tāsāṃ sarvapradaścāhaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ॥85 ॥
dharmaṃ kāmaṃ tathā dravyaṃ sukhaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāmyaham ।
bhojyaṃ pācanasāmarthyaṃ rateḥ śaktiṃ varaṃ patim ॥8 6 ॥
putraṃ pautraṃ dāsadāsīḥ tattadiṣṭaṃ dadāmyaham ।
bhrātṛpitṛkuṭumbasya sukhadātā bhavāmyaham ॥87॥
yābhirmāso yoṣita(?)śca śūnyo me puruṣottamaḥ ।
tāsāṃ śūnya bhavetsarvaṃ sadbhāgyaṃ śūnyatāṃ vrajet ॥ 88 ॥
dhanāḍhyā ye gṛhasthāśca vinā dānādikaṃ mama ।
māsaṃ śūnyaṃ yāpayanti tatkośaḥ śūnyatāṃ vrajet ॥ 89 ॥
brahmacārivānaprasthā yatayastyāgamārgagāḥ ।
māsaṃ śūnyaṃ vinā bhaktiṃ yāpayanti ca te yadi ॥ 90 ॥
tapasvino'pi te sarve muktiśūnyā bhavanti vai ।
śūdrāḥ striyastathā dāsavargāḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ॥ 91 ॥
gurordevasya ca sevāṃ vinā nirgamayanti cet ।
te'pi sampadvihīnāḥ syurduḥkhadāridryapīḍitāḥ ॥ 92 ॥
guruḥ sevyo hariḥ sevyaḥ sevyāḥ pitrādayo janāḥ ।
gauḥ saṃsevyā patiḥ sevyaḥ satī sevyā yathā hyaham ॥ 93 ॥
tatra tatra sthitaścāhaṃ phala dāsyāmi sarvathā ।
tasmāt sarvātmanā sarvaiḥ sevyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 94 ॥
ātmaśreyaḥ prakartavyaṃ dharmo bhaktiśca mokṣaṇam ।
vidhuratvaṃ ca vaidhavyaṃ malamāsasya nā''vahet ॥ 95 ॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamāsāḥ śṛṇvantu madvaco dhruvam ।
mamājñayā tu ye lokā brahmāṇḍavartinaḥ khalu ॥ 96 ।।
yatra yatrā'styayaṃ māsastatra tatrāpi māmakam ।
adhiṣṭhānasvarūpaṃ māṃ pūjayiṣyanti sarvathā ॥ 97॥
te madbhaktā mama dhāmā'kṣaraṃ prāpsyanti śāśvatam ।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ vāpi caiśvaram ॥98॥
yatheṣṭaṃ kṛpayā te te tattadbhaktāstathā tathā ।
yāsyanti paramaṃ sthānaṃ mama māsaprabhāvataḥ ॥99॥
tṛtīyāyāṃ mama māse yuvābhyāṃ pūjito'smyaham ।
tathā ye pūjayiṣyanti teṣāṃ pūrṇamanorathāḥ ॥ 100 ॥
sarvathaiva bhaviṣyanti snānadānajapādibhiḥ ।
yuvāṃ cintāṃ kurutaṃ mā lakṣmīśa rādhikeśvara ॥ 101 ॥
yātaṃ nijaṃ nijaṃ lokaṃ gṛhītvā puruṣottamam ।
ityādeśamadhiprāpya te praṇamya yayustrayaḥ ॥ 1 02॥
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tṛtīyāyāṃ snāsyanti ye'dhike jalaiḥ ।
teṣāṃ brahmahade snānaṃ tathā brahmasarovare ॥ 10 3॥
kṛtaṃ snānaṃ tu yadvad vai tatpuṇyaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
mama pūjā yathā tābhyāṃ kṛtā tatra yadarpitam ॥ 1 24॥
tathā pūjāṃ mama māse kariṣyanti ca ye janāḥ ।
dānānyapi kariṣyanti tatpuṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet ॥ 1 05॥
tṛtīyāyāṃ mama pūjā kṛtā tābhyāṃ yato mama ।
tṛtīyāyāṃ mahāpūjā kartavyā mānavairapi ॥ 106॥
nārāyaṇasya kṛṣṇasyā'pi puruṣottamasya ca ।
kartavyā mahatī pūjā sukhamokṣādidāyinī ॥1 07॥
yathā'haṃ brahmadhāmnyasmi tathā māsātmako'paraḥ ।
brahmāṇḍe sarvathā cāsmi tathā'smyantarhṛdi sthitaḥ ॥ 108॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāsmi rādhālakṣmyādisevitaḥ ।
ahaṃ sarvaṃ vijānāmi nānye jānanti māṃ tathā ॥ 1 09॥
pārvatyā prabhayā sākaṃ māṇikyā viharāmi ca ।
naikarūpo'pyeka evā'smīti viddhi madaṃgane! ॥ 11 0॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamalamāsānāmakṣara-dhāmagamane brahmahradabrahmasarovarasnānottaraṃ śrīpuruṣottamasya-sannidhigamanaṃ supūjanaṃ svanivedanottaramadhikamāsasya puruṣottamanāmaiśvaryasvāmikatvādiprāptistṛtīyā-tithikṛtpūjanadānādiphalanirūpaṇaṃ kṛṣṇa-nārāyaṇamāsānāṃ punaḥ svasvadhāmā'- 'gamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā-pañcanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥।
1.295॥।


← adhyāyaḥ 295 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 296
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 297 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! trayaste'pi gatvā golokamityatha ।
viśaśramuḥ kṣaṇaṃ paścāt।
kṛṣṇo dvābhyāṃ prapūjitaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
puruṣottamamahimā goloke bahudhā'bhavat ।
kṛṣṇaṃ natvā cāyayaturadhomāsa narāyaṇau ॥ 2 ॥
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cātha tatrāpi māso mahattvamāptavān ।
puruṣottamamāsaṃ ca vāsayāmāsa vai hariḥ ॥ 3 ॥
vāsamāsādya māso'pi ramate viṣṇunā saha ।
māsānāmadhipo bhūtvā gauraveṇa vyavasthitaḥ ॥ 4 ॥
athātra ca mahālakṣmyā gauraveṇa prapūjitaḥ ।
drutaṃ nārāyaṇenāpi pratibrahmāṇḍameva ha ॥ 5 ॥
tṛtīyāyāścāparāhṇe preṣayitvā svapārṣadān ।
samuddhoṣitamevā'yaṃ malamāso mahottamaḥ ॥ 6 ॥
puruṣottamanāmā'sau puruṣottamadaivataḥ ।
puruṣottamanāthena svargado mokṣadaḥ kṛtaḥ ॥ 7 ॥
svaguṇāścārpitā hyasmai na nyūnaḥ puruṣottamāt ।
pūjane vandane jāpe dāne snāne vrate'pi ca ॥ 8 ॥
puruṣottamatulyo'yaṃ puruṣottamayogadaḥ ।
naro nārī suro devī ye'pi sthāvarajaṃgamāḥ ॥ 9 ॥
bhāvato'pyekakāle'pi vrataṃ cātha prapūjanam ।
adhimāsasya sarvāṃgaṃ kariṣyanti madicchayā ॥ 10 ॥
prāpsyanti svepsitaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇo bravīmyaham ।
kimu tarhiṃ trikāle ca vrate vaktavyamasya hi ॥ 11 ॥
māsavrate tu naivaiva vaktavyaṃ śiṣyate mama ।
tasmātpūjyaścaikakālaṃ dvikālaṃ samayatrayam ॥ 12॥
yatheṣṭaṃ prāpsyati nārī naro'pīṣṭamavāpsyati ।
kṣaṇaṃ kṣaṇārdhaṃ ghaṭikāṃ sāyaṃ prātaḥ pramadhyake ॥ 13 ॥
yathāśakti yathāvastu pūjyo'yaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
nārāyaṇo bravīmyatra puruṣottamasākṣikaḥ ॥ 14॥
śrīkṛṣṇasākṣikaścāpi puruṣottamasaṃjñake ।
māse'tra māṃ kṣaṇamātraṃ pūjayiṣyanti bhāvata ॥ 15 ॥
svarge satyaṃ caiśalokaṃ prāpsyanti sveṣṭamityapi ।
prāpsyanti māṃ sukhavārdhi paraṃbrahma parātparam ॥ 16 ॥
nārāyaṇecchayā ye'tra pūjayiṣyanti bhāvataḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhasthaṃ ca te māṃ vai prāpsyantyeva narāyaṇam ॥ 17॥
śrīmatkṛṣṇecchayā ye'tra pūjayiṣyanti bhāvataḥ ।
golokasthaṃ ca te māṃ vai prāpsyantyeva hi mādhavam ॥ 1 8॥
puruṣottamakāmena pūjayiṣyanti ye janāḥ ।
brahmadhāmagataṃ prāpsyantyeva māṃ puruṣottamam ॥ 19॥
yadyadrūpaṃ ca māṃ ye'tra pūjayiṣyanti dehinaḥ ।
tattadrūpaṃ tatra tatra prāpsyanti te tu māṃ tathā ॥20॥
iti praśrāvitaṃ lakṣmi! brahmāṇḍeṣu punaḥ punaḥ ।
mahādundubhibhirdūtaiḥ pārṣadairdivyavigrahaiḥ ॥21 ॥
malamāsastṛtīyāyāṃ niśyeva bahukoṭibhiḥ ।
satkṛtaḥ pūjitaḥ samyagbhojitaḥ śramamāpa vai ॥22॥
caturthyāṃ tu prage saptadvayalokanivāsibhiḥ ।
snānavratārcanadānādyairatīva pratoṣitaḥ ॥23॥
bahavaḥ sthāvarāścāpi cetanā vratakāriṇaḥ ।
samājagmurharerdhāma lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśastathā ॥24॥
caturthyāstu prage koṭidāsīyuktā vimānagā ।
ramādevī samāyātā vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣairasāgarāt ॥25॥
vadhūṭīrūpatāṃ prāptā varamālāsamanvitā ।
lakṣmīsamā tu sarvāṃge na vai nyūnā manāgapi ॥26॥
nārāyaṇā''jñayā sā tu lakṣmyādibhiḥ susatkṛtā ।
sabhājitā tato nārāyaṇenāṃ'ke niṣāditā ॥27॥
lakṣmyādayastadāścarye samprāpustadvilokya vai ।
kathaṃ patnīsvarūpeyaṃ svāmīnāṃ'gīkṛtā drutam ॥28॥
atha lakṣmyā ramā pṛṣṭā taditivṛttavittaye ।
kathaṃ kasmāt samāyātā kathaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ॥29॥
kasya putrī kathaṃ prāptā kiṃ kṛtvainaṃ narāyaṇam ।
vada subhru svasaḥ sarvaṃ parivedyaṃ sukhottaram ॥30॥
lakṣmyā nārāyaṇenāpi bhojitā satkṛtā hi sā ।
samārebhe pravaktuṃ ca svakaṃ vṛttaṃ yathātatham ॥ 31 ॥
varamālāṃ hareḥ kaṇṭhe prasamarpyā'grataḥ sthitā ।
nārāyaṇāṃ'guṣṭhavāri pītvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ॥36॥
kuṃkumataṇḍulaiḥ kṛtvā bhāle śobhanacandrakam ।
varamālā'rdhakaṃ svasyāḥ kaṇṭhe kṛtvā'tha pāyasam ॥33॥
bhojayitvā hariṃ datvā tāmbūlaṃ tatprasādakam ।
gṛhītvā ca svayaṃ nārāyaṇāṃke kusumāṃjalim ॥34॥
sākṣatāṃ ca salājāṃ ca prasamarpyā''sane sthitā ।
patnī bhūtvā jagādedaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi! ramoditam ॥35॥
śṛṇvatsu sarvabhakteṣu bhaktāsu prāha yad ramā ।
mama pūjye mahālakṣmi! tṛtīyārātrisaṃcare ॥36॥
dundubhiḥ suśrutaḥ sarvairnārāyaṇasya nāmataḥ ।
adhimāse pūjakasya pūrayiṣye manorathān ॥37॥
mayā'pi kanyayā kṣīrodadhergṛhe sa saṃśrutaḥ ।
vāñchitaśca patirnārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ॥38॥
malamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ sāyaṃ vai bhojanaṃ vinā ।
vinā jalaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā snātvā cā'pūjayaṃ harim ॥36॥
pṛṣṭvā me janakaṃ kṣīrasāgaraṃ ca tadājñayā ।
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstambhaiḥ śobhitaṃ patratoraṇaiḥ ॥40 ॥
kārayitvā ca tanmadhye dolāṃ ramyāṃ suśobhanām ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtiṃ sauvarṇīṃ ratnarājitām ॥41॥
saṃsnāpya sarvasāmudraiḥ ratnaiḥ prapūjya bhāvataḥ ।
divyavastrairvibhūṣābhiścālaṃkṛtya dravādibhiḥ ॥42॥
sampūjya dhūpadīpaiśca bhojanairjalapānakaiḥ ।
ārārtrikastutipradakṣiṇābhirabhivandya ca ॥43॥
puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradāyaiva saṃkalpya manasā punaḥ ।
patirme bhava viśvātman ramāyāstvaṃ narāyaṇa! ॥44॥
iti saṃstūya caraṇāmṛtaṃ pītvā sukomale ।
paryaṃke śrīhariḥ premṇā mayā prasvāpitaḥ saha ॥45॥
dhyāto mayā sa nidrāyāṃ sevayāmi hariṃ tataḥ ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ tasya karomīti nibhālitaḥ ॥46॥
kṣaṇaṃ svapne harirdṛṣṭo mayā sve śayane saha ।
hasanmāṃ svakaṭākṣeṇā''karṣayanniva bhāvataḥ ॥47॥
vadan śruto vratena tvāṃ svīkaromi priyāṃ rame! ।
prātarnetuṃ mama lokaṃ tvāgamiṣye punaḥ priye ॥48॥
iti drāgeva saṃśrāvya svayamadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
so'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī lakṣmīpatirvirājate ॥49॥
mayā nārāyaṇe yāte muhūrte brāhmasaṃjñake ।
caturthyāmadhimāsasya dhyātvainaṃ puruṣottamam ॥50॥
snātvā śayyāgataṃ devaṃ snāpayitvā'tibhāvataḥ ।
kṣīrādibhistathā vārbhiścandanādi pramardya ca ॥51॥
śrāṃgārikāṇyarpayitvā vivāhavaravat kṛtaḥ ।
dattaṃ pītāmbaraṃ cātimūlyaṃ pītāṃgarakṣakam ॥52॥
prāvāraṃ svarṇatārāḍhyaṃ cottarīyaṃ tathottamam ।
mastake svarṇamukuṭaḥ sakalgiḥ kuṇḍale śrutau ॥53॥
tilakaṃ candrako bhāle kajjalaṃ netrayorbhruvi ।
candanaṃ gaṇḍayorbindū cibuke svalpacandrakaḥ ॥54॥
puṣpaprāvaraṇaṃ bhāle varamālā ca kaṇṭhake ।
vakṣasi svarṇahārāśca kaṃkaṇe karayoḥ śubhe ॥55॥
ūrmikāścāṃguligrāme bhujabandhau bhujadvaye ।
tulasīpuṣpahārāśca khaṅgo haste suvarṇajaḥ ॥56॥
nārikelaphalaṃ cāpi kare kaṭyāṃ ca mekhalā ।
nupūre pādayoścāpi pāduke kānakī śubhe ॥57॥
kāmaphalaṃ prakoṣṭhe vai bhojane pāyasaṃ śubham ।
tāmbūlakaṃ jalapānaṃ phalaṃ drākṣā rasātmikā ॥58॥
pūgīphalaṃ tato dānaṃ dakṣiṇā varamālikā ।
havanāni śataṃ cāṣṭau ghṛtena vahnimaṇḍale ॥59॥
ārārtrikaṃ pañcavarti pradakṣiṇacatuṣṭayam ।
vareṇyo varadaścāsi varo me bhava sadvacāḥ ॥60 ॥
puṣpāṃjalistathā'rghyaṃ ca namaskāraḥ kṣamārthanā ।
visarjanaṃ pādavāripānaṃ ca śeṣabhakṣaṇam ॥61॥
svapnadṛṣṭasya saṃdhyānaṃ pratīkṣā ca kadā''gamaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnā bhajanaṃ cātiharṣaṇam ॥62॥
bhojanaṃ bālikābhyaśca dānaṃ kanyābhya ityapi ।
dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇe dehaḥ kṣīrasāgarake gṛhe ॥63॥
netre vyomni pare mārge hyātmā vaikuṇṭhavāsini ।
ityevaṃ parivārāḍhye'dhimāse pūjite harau ॥64॥
natvā ca janakaṃ kṛtvā pāraṇāṃ payasā manāk ।
yāvat tiṣṭhāmi bhavane tāvannārāyaṇo hyayam ॥65॥
prādurbhūto mamāgretirūpānurūparājitaḥ ।
prasannaścātitejasvī cā'spṛśanmāṃ kareṇa vai ॥66॥
svasamīpaṃ samākṛṣya samāgacchetyuvāca mām ।
malamāse hyekakāle tṛtīyāyāṃ tvayā'rcitaḥ ॥67॥
niśi savāhitaścāpi caturthyāṃ cātipūjitaḥ ।
prātareva tvayā mānye! cārjito'smi vratena vai ॥68॥
yathā bhāvanayā subhru tvayā cādya prapūjitaḥ ।
tathā prāpto'smi kalyāṇi! subhage'si mama priye! ॥69॥
samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ jātā'si śāśvatī vadhūḥ ।
tava vratena te dāsyaḥ sarvā api mama gṛham ॥70॥
samāyāntu mama dāsyo bhāvinyaḥ sarvathā rame ।
iti kṛtvā garuḍaṃ svaṃ darśayāmāsa sadvaraḥ ॥71॥
yānāni vāhanānyatra yāni santi sahasraśaḥ ।
mayā matpitaraṃ gatvā''veditaṃ sarvameva tat ॥72॥
sopi tatra samāgatya dattavān māṃ hareḥ kare ।
pitrājñayā kṛtakṛtyā jātā'ruroha pakṣiṇam ॥73॥
pitrā prasthāpitā sainyayutā satkārapūrvakam ।
yautakaṃ saṃgṛhītvaiva samāyātā hareḥ puram ॥74॥
so'yaṃ nārāyaṇaścātra bhavane'pi vilokitaḥ ।
mayā sahāpi sa eva vartate paśya bhāmini! ॥75॥
adhimāse niśi prātaḥ pūjane'sya phalena vai ।
prāptā'haṃ satpatiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ cātra samāgatā ॥76॥
nītā tenaiva kṛṣṇena prāpitāṃ'kamanena vai ।
kṛtā navavadhūścāpi patnī vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ॥77॥
ramā'smi te sakhī dāsī tvatkṛpākāṃkṣiṇī sadā ।
ityevaṃ cā'dhimāsasya phalaṃ prāptaṃ mayā'naghe ॥78॥
mayā nārāyaṇapūjā kṛtā tadvat kariṣyati ।
kanyakā yuvatī vāpi prāpsyatyenaṃ narāyaṇam ॥79॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cādhimāse saṃpūjya sarvathā ।
caturthyāṃ prātarevāpi madhyāhne vā niśīthake ॥80 ॥
pūjayiṣyanti yadvṛttyā pūrayiṣyatyayaṃ tathā ।
dhanaṃ putrān sukhaṃ dārān patiṃ dhānyāni sadgṛham ॥8 1 ॥
yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ tejo rūpamaiśvaryamuttamam ।
rājyaṃ sattāṃ priyāṃ bhāryā dāsān dāsīśca vaibhavān ॥82॥
bhogyān bhogopasambaddhān bhojyānpeyānanantakān ।
padārthān divyatattvasthān yatheṣṭān suratān ratim ॥83॥
svargān satyaparān lokān pārameṣṭhisthalānyapi ।
vairājāँścāpi vaikuṇṭhabhūmikā dhenubhūmikāḥ ॥84॥
golokaṃ cākṣaraṃ cāpi divyaṃ cā'divyameva yat ।
saṃkalpyā'dhikamāse vai nārāyaṇasya pūjakāḥ ॥85॥
narā nāryo devadevyaścaturdaśastarasthitāḥ ।
prāpsyanti svepsitaṃ sarve puruṣottamavāñchayā ॥86॥
yathā'haṃ svalpayatnena saṃjātā śāśvatīsamāḥ ।
susaubhāgyavatī lakṣmi! tathā'nyāpi bhaviṣyati ॥87॥
vidhavāpi yadi strī vai madvat kṛṣṇasya pūjanam ।
kariṣyatyadhimāse sā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpsyati dhruvam ॥88॥
nārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ labdhvā syāt saubhāgyavatī sadā ।
vṛddhā vā rogiṇī yadvā tiraskṛtā ca bāndhavaiḥ ॥89॥
karmaṇā yā paribhraṣṭā paścāttāpena saṃyutā ।
anāthā caikalā cātyāśritā raṇḍā ca puṃścalī ॥9 0॥
svairiṇī kāminī vāpi yena kenāpi saṃgatā ।
jñātihīnā vratahīnā paśusaṃsargakāriṇī ॥9 1 ॥
jaihvye ratyāṃ sadā lubdhā madyamāṃsādinī kimu ।
rājasvalyādidoṣasthā sāṃkaryadoṣasaṃsthitā ॥92॥
śvapacādyāśrayāpannā susaṃskāravivarjitā ।
yā kāpi vā bhavennārī śubhasaṃskārayogataḥ ॥93॥
śrutvā kathāṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā'dhimāse tu yathābalam ।
hariprāptīcchayā caikabhuktaṃ naktamayācitam ॥94॥
phalāhāraṃ payaḥpānaṃ kṛtvāpi śrīharerbalāt ।
pramārjya sarvapāpātipāpāni cātipāvanī ॥ 95॥
paṃktisaṃpāvanī bhūtvā veśyā vā gaṇikāpi vā ।
nartakī vā prabhaṇḍā vā kuṭṭinī vā prasādhinī ॥ 96॥
yā vā kā vā bhavelloke bhūtvā pavitravigrahā ।
kṣetraṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛpāyāśca bhūtvā kāṃcanasadṛśī ॥97॥
divyā śuddhā pāpahīnā puṇyapuñjānvitā satī ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇukṛpābhiratipāvitā ॥ 98॥
svasamānāstathā'nyāśca pāvayitvā svasaṃgataḥ ।
sanātanaṃ paraṃ dhāma viṣṇoryat tatprayāsyati ॥ 99 ॥
ramā'haṃ saṃsthitā nārāyaṇāṃ'ke lakṣmi! sarvathā ।
kathayāmi punaḥ satyaṃ sā prāpsyati hareḥ padam ॥ 100 ॥
ṣaṇḍho vā ṣaṇḍhatulyo vā ṣaṃḍhā vā ṣaṇḍhasadṛśī ।
anārtavī vicittā vā vānarīva vratacyutā ॥ 101 ॥
yā kāpi vā bhavet sā'pi māse śrīpuruṣottame ।
vrataṃ kṛtvā varaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarjayiṣyati ॥ 10 2॥
niṣkāmo vā'tha niṣkāmā muktatāṃ prāpya sarvathā ।
harerdivyākṣaraṃ dhāma prāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ॥ 103 ॥
kimvadhikaṃ kathayāmi māyā'pyamāyikī bhavet ।
yadyogāttarhi nārīṇāṃ kā kathā muktisaṃgame ॥ 1 04॥
tasmādvrataṃ prakartavyaṃ tvadhimāsasya sarvathā ।
bhuktirmuktistathā svargaṃ sarvaṃ prāpyeta yadbalāt ॥ 1 06॥
ahaṃ cātra sthitā jyeṣṭhe! nibhālyā'nugraheṇa vā ।
ityuktvā praṇanāmaināṃ lakṣmīṃ vātsalyavardhinīm ॥ 106 ॥
nārāyaṇo'pi tāmenāṃ bhavanāni nināya ca ।
ramayāmāsa satkāmaiḥ pūrayāmāsa bhāvanāḥ ॥ 1 07॥
evaṃ priye! ramā jātā kathaṃ nārāyaṇapriyā ।
kṣīrasāgaraputrīyaṃ sā tubhyaṃ kathitā kathā ॥ 108 ॥
asyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa paṭhanena ca pūjayā ।
adhimāsavratajanyaṃ phalaṃ vindettu mānavaḥ ॥ 10 9॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsa māhātmye nārāyaṇādhimāsayorvaikuṇṭhavasatirbrahmāṇḍeṣvadhikamāsavratārthe dundubhighoṣaṇā, tāṃ śrutvā kṣīrasāgaraputrīramayā tṛtīyāsāyaṃ caturthīprātarvratapūjādi-karaṇena vaikuṇṭhe nārāyaṇapatnītvaprāptirityādi-nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikadviśata-tamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.296 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 296 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 297
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 298 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! śāradāyāḥ kathā śubhā ।
adhimāsasya paṃcamyāṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā ca pūjanam ॥ 1 ॥
aiśvaryamatulaṃ prāpa kaumāryaṃ śāśvataṃ ca sā ।
rājasvalyavihīnatvaṃ prasāraṇaṃ mukhe mukhe ॥ 2 ॥
tathā vaikuṇṭhanāthasya patnītvaṃ divyamavyayam ।
avāpa śāradā loke pūjyatāṃ padmajā yathā ॥ 3 ॥
patnītve sati kaumārye kumārītve vadhūtvakam ।
viruddhadharmayoścāsyāṃ sthitiḥ śrīharitoṣaṇāt ॥ 4 ॥
adhimāsabalopetāṃ camatkāramayīṃ kathām ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahāpuṇyāṃ puruṣottamamāsikīm ॥ 5 ॥
brahmadhāmasthitā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃ'gataḥ ।
brahmavidyā śāradākhyā prakaṭībhūya sundarī ॥ 6 ॥
vairājalokamāgatyā''jñayā nārāyaṇasya sā ।
vairāje līnatāṃ prāpya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraiḥ ॥ 7 ॥
sahotpannā kanyakā sā vairājī śāradā sutā ।
bahukālaṃ pitṛgehe vāsaṃ cakre kumārikā ॥ 8 ॥
brahmajñānātmikā nityaṃ vicārayati varṣmaṇi ।
yadarthaṃ brahmaṇā cāhamāviṣkṛtā tu devatā ॥ 9 ॥
vāṅmayī vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭau sthātuṃ pratimukhaṃ khalu ।
tato'haṃ vaidhasī bhūtvā gacchāmi yadi sṛṣṭiṣu ॥ 10 ॥
kumārī cennivatsyāmi hyaśuddhā cāpyasaṃskṛtā ।
aspṛśyā vai bhaviṣyāmi sarvairbahiṣkṛtā sadā ॥ 11 ॥
tadā tu maraṇaṃ tatra śaraṇaṃ me bhaviṣyati ।
kumārikāśarīraṃ vai garbhīyaṃ pāpakaṃ hi tat ॥ 1 2॥
kasyāpi karmaṇo yogyaṃ bhavatyeva na sarvathā ।
mūtrendriyaprajanmā'sau mūtrakukṣau pravardhitaḥ ॥ 13॥
mūtrātmajalamagno'sau mūtradvāreṇa nirgataḥ ।
bālye'pi malamūtrātmā'spṛśyā'śuddhamalāvṛtaḥ ॥ 14॥
yajñopavītasaṃskārahīno dehaḥ sadā'śuciḥ ।
aśuddhakaphaphītādivikṛtipūttalātmakaḥ ॥ 15॥
kumārikāsthitau nārīdehaḥ kathaṃ śubho bhavet ।
vivāhakaraṇe śuddhirnānyathā tu kadācana ॥ 16 ॥
vivāho'pi mahāduḥkhapradaḥ puruṣavaśyatā ।
mūtrendriyaparādhīnamālinyakarmakāritā ॥ 17॥
mūtrakukṣau garbhavāso garbhajanmamalāktatā ।
sūtakaṃ sarvathā cārte raktasrāvo malānvayaḥ ॥ 18॥
malamūtrasamutpattirapānānilasaṃsṛtiḥ ।
mālinyaṃ sarvathā patnībhāve maithunakarmaṇi ॥ 19॥
tasmāt parāśrayaḥ patnībhāvo'tyadhikaduḥkhakṛt ।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ nārī kṛtā parāśrayā ॥2 0 ॥
nārīdehaḥ parādhīnaḥ parabhogyaḥ parārthakaḥ ।
yena tādṛk kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nārītāṃ saḥ prapadyate ॥21 ॥
tanna mayā paranāryā bhavitavyamadhīnayā ।
evaṃ rajasvalādharmo mālinyaṃ pāpakārakam ॥22॥
neṣyate yena tadapi pāravaśyaṃ na me bhavet ।
madiṣṭaṃ yadi naiva syānmariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ॥23॥
amālinyaṃ pavitratvamarājasvalyamityapi ।
patnīdharmavihīnatvaṃ kaumārye ca yathā mama ॥24॥
śāśvataṃ syād yathā yatnastathā kāryo hyataḥ param ।
iti nityaṃ cintayānā mārgayāmāsa sādhanam ॥25॥
śuśrāva dundubhiṃ viṣṇoradhimāsavratāya vai ।
puruṣottamamāsasya vratināṃ vai manorathāḥ ॥26॥
paripūrṇā bhaviṣyantītyāha śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
