ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā pūjayiṣyanti māṃ janāḥ ॥27॥
naro nārī ca ṣaṇḍho vā matkṛpāleśato hi saḥ ।
alabhyalābhavān syācca dāsye sarvaṃ tadīpsitam ॥28॥
kumārī śāradā vairājasya putrī praghoṣaṇām ।
śrupvā'tiharṣamāpannā manaścakre vratārcane ॥29॥
pañcamyāṃ sā tithau prātaḥ śīghraṃ śīghraṃ samutthitā ।
śrutvaivaṃ dundubhiṃ snātvā dhyātvā mūrti harestathā ॥30 ॥
pūjādravyāṇi divyāni saṃgṛhya bhavane svake ।
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ॥3 1॥
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ svarṇaṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ।
āvāhyāsanamāstīrya pādyārghyācamanāni ca ॥32॥
datvā paṃcāmṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ snāpayitvā jalena ca ।
amṛtena rasenāpi sugandhidravavastubhiḥ ॥33॥
sammardya gātramurudhā śṛṃgāramakarottataḥ ।
alaṃkāravibhūṣāśca dhārayitvā'mbarāṇi ca ॥34॥
prapūjya kastūrikābhiścandanākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ।
tulasīpuṣpamandāracampakaiḥ paripūjya ca ॥35॥
dhūpadīpasunaivedyaiḥ phalaiḥ pānaiśca carvaṇaiḥ ।
tāmbūlakaistoṣayitvā''rārtrikaṃ tvakarottataḥ ॥36॥
pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavat praṇanāma sā ।
kṣamā'parādhaṃ svābhīṣṭaṃ prārthayat sā kumārikā ॥37॥
dundubhinā pravaktarhe lakṣmīnārāyaṇa prabho ।
brahmagolokavaikuṇṭhavāsin śrīpuruṣottama ॥ 38॥
satyaṃ dadāsi bhaktāya yatheṣṭaṃ vratakāriṇe ।
tadā mahyaṃ tathā dehi yathā'haṃ pravṛṇomi tat॥ 39॥
kumārītvaṃ śāśvataṃ me rājasvalyaṃ kadāpi na ।
aśuddhatvaṃ ca me māstu tathā satyapi me punaḥ ॥40 ॥
patimattvaṃ sumāṃgalyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ sarvadā'stu me ।
sagarbhātvaṃ ca me māstu patnītve'pi kadācana ॥41 ॥
etadvai durlabhaṃ yāce viruddhaṃ sarvathā tanau ।
yadi satyapravaktā tvaṃ hyekakālavrate kṛte ॥42॥
adhimāse pūjite ced dadāsi dehi me tathā ।
anyathā dundubhiṃ deva mā pravādaya cā'nṛtam ॥43 ॥
chatraṃ dadāmi te nātha cāmare'pi dadāmi te ।
pāduke te pradadāmi śayyāṃ dadāmi komalām ॥44॥
pādasaṃvāhanārthāya mā dadāmi samarpitām ।
śaraṇāgatapāla tvaṃ bhaktavāñcchāprapūraka ॥45 ॥
puṣpāṃjaliṃ gṛhāṇaināṃ karaṃ gṛhāṇa vā na vā ।
dehi madarthitaṃ nātha śāśvataṃ sukhadaṃ hi tat ॥46॥
kumārī naiva patnī syāt patnī syānna kumārikā ।
patnītve bahavo doṣā mā spṛśeyuśca māṃ yathā ॥47॥
kumārītve'pi ye doṣā mā spṛśeyuśca māṃ yathā ।
tathā dehi kṛpānātha satyārtho dundubhiryadi ॥ 48॥
kartuṃ cākartumevāpyanyathākartuṃ prabhostava ।
kimapyaśakyaṃ nāstyevā'nyathā te dundubhirvṛthā ॥49॥
iti stutvā phalairyuktamarghyaṃ samarpya viṣṇave ।
akṣatairvardhayāmāsa kumārī śāradā tataḥ ॥5 0 ॥
devaṃ tu dakṣiṇāṃ svīyasamarpaṇātmikāṃ hṛdi ।
datvā visarjayāmāsa dhyāyamānā narāyaṇam ॥5 1 ॥
tāvannārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
ramāpatirhasanmandaṃ prāvirbabhūva cāgrataḥ ॥52॥
dakṣadoṣṇā'bhayadaśca vāmena mastake spṛśan ।
uvāca śāradaṃ kinte manasyasti prakāśaya ॥53 ॥
pūjayā te prasanno'smi viśvāsavratacāriṇi ।
subhru viśvāsapāśena baddho'smi sarvadā tvayā ॥54॥
dātuṃ sarvaṃ samartho'smi tathāpi śṛṇu me vacaḥ ।
kumārītvaṃ ca patnītvaṃ naikatra kvāpi dṛśyate ॥55॥
anyataraṃ tayostasmād vṛṇu tubhyaṃ dadāmyatha ।
kumārītvaṃ kalakāya loke tvājīvanaṃ bhavet ॥56॥
tasmāt patnītvamevātra vṛṇu saubhāgyadaṃ dade ।
anyaccāpi ca te kāmyaṃ dadāmi vṛṇu kanyake ॥57॥
strīrājyaṃ vā mahadrājyaṃ māyārājyaṃ dadāmi te ।
viruddhaṃ mā vṛṇu kanye brūhi vicārya mā ciram ॥58॥
ityāśrutya harervākyaṃ śāradā prāha keśavam ।
bhakteṣṭapūraka svāmiँstavoddhoṣānmayā'rthitam ॥59॥
svasatyarakṣaṇārthāya yathecchasi tathā kuru ।
nahi bhakte tvāgrahaḥ syādāgrahī nahi bhaktimān ॥60 ॥
ahaṃ tava prapannā'smi bhaktacintāṃ hara prabho ।
tavā'smi tava bhaktā'smi pādayoḥ patitā tava ॥6 1 ॥
nārīduḥkhāni me mā syuriti bhakteṣṭamāvaha ।
ityarthitaśca dṛṣṭaśca spṛṣṭo nataḥ kṛtādaraḥ ॥62॥
pūjito bhojitastatrātyantapremṇā vilokitaḥ ।
bhaktārtihā prabhuḥ svabhaktāyāḥ kṛte vyacintayat॥63॥
kathamasyā manobhīṣṭaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhavediti ।
kayā rītyā pūraṇīyo bhavenmanoratho'pi ca ॥64॥
dadāmyasyai mahāsiddhiṃ vyāpyavyāpakarūpiṇīm ।
naikarūpabhavitrīṃ ca divyāṃ siddhiṃ dadāmi ha ॥65 ॥
iti saṃkalpya bhagavān dadau śaṃkhajalaṃ mukhe ।
tāvatsā sarvasāmarthyanidhirūpā babhūva vai ॥66॥
bhagavāँstu tataḥ prāha śārade śāradātmikā ।
divyarūpā mama patnī sadā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ॥67॥
garbhādidoṣaśūnyā tvaṃ bhavasīti vibhāvaya ।
dattaṃ madīyapatnītvaṃ yaunamālinyavarjitam ॥68॥
malamūtrādyanāspṛṣṭaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ sadā'stu te ।
atha rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa vāṅmayaṃ priye ॥69॥
kumārībhāvasampannaṃ sarasvatīsvarūpakam ।
dadāmi tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sukumāraṃ tathā bhava ॥70॥
gaccha tena svarūpeṇa vedhodvārā prajāsu vai ।
vyāpakaṃ te svarūpaṃ syāṃ vāṇīrūpaṃ mukhe mukhe ॥71 ॥
kumārītvaṃ sadā tatra svarūpe te'stu śārade ।
antarmukhapracāritve tvarājasvalyamastu te ॥72॥
sāttvikatvaṃ kumārītvaṃ sarvadā tattathā'stu te ।
atha tṛtīyarūpega kenacitsanmiṣeṇa vai ॥73॥
sarasvatī nadīrūpā tvantarjalapravāhiṇī ।
arajaskā kumārī tvaṃ sadā tiṣṭhatu śārade ॥74॥
cāñcalyaṃ ca bahirbhāvo rājasvalyaṃ ca mā'stu te ।
pāvitryaṃ sarvadā te'stu ṛtudharmavivarjanam ॥75॥
rājasvalyaṃ vilīnaṃ te mālinyabhāvavarjitam ।
bhavatācchārade! kā'pyaśuddhirmāstu tvayi kvacit ॥76 ॥
sarvaiśvaryavatī pūjyā lokeṣu vyāpinī bhava ।
lokānāṃ rājasaṃ pāpaṃ māstu tvayi sarasvati! ॥77॥
bahirbhāve tvayi rājasvalyādi lokakṛd yadi ।
dṛśyeta taddūṣaṇaṃ tu lokānāṃ na tu tat tvayi ॥78॥
rājasvalyakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vaktṝṇāṃ syādaśuddhatā ।
pāvitryaṃ sarvadā te'stu santu te divyasampadaḥ ॥79॥
kumārītvaṃ ca patnītvaṃ te'stu śuddhaṃ yathepsitam ।
mama patnī śāradā tvaṃ kumārī brahmaputrikā ॥80 ॥
sarvaṃ dattaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ vad tvanyat kimicchasi ।
ityuktā prāha sā devī mama pūjākṛtastu ye ॥8 1॥
sarasvatyāḥ śāradāyā nadyā vāṇyā upāsakāḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ te samāyāntu svāminaste pratāpataḥ ॥82॥
adhimāsasya pañcamyāṃ prātaḥ sampūjya vai kramāt ।
nārāyaṇaṃ yathā prāptā'smyahaṃ pūrṇamanorathā ॥83॥
tathā te pūjakāścādhimāsasya pūjakāstathā ।
narā nāryaḥ samāyāntu vaikuṇṭhaṃ tava pādayoḥ ॥84॥
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadāridryavarjiṃtam ।
śāśvataṃ saccidānandasandohamūrtirājitam ॥85॥
tathāstviti prāha kurvan haridundubhighoṣaṇām ।
sārthakā satyaphaladāṃ tvādhimāsasya puṣṭidām ॥86 ॥
adhimāso'pi tāṃ prāha bhaktā ye yā mayi tvayi ।
teṣāṃ tāsāṃ samuddhartā tvahaṃ vai puruṣottamaḥ ॥87॥
doṣahartā sukhadātā mano'bhīṣṭapradastathā ।
pāvayitā siddhidātā bhavāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ ॥88॥
śāradāyā idaṃ prārthya śroṣyanti ye tu durlabham ।
paṭhiṣyanti ca vā teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ bhavet ॥89॥
apatarkyaṃ sutarkyaṃ syādaprāpyaṃ prāpyatāṃ vrajet ।
abhāvyaṃ bhāvyatāṃ yāyādaniṣṭaṃ ceṣṭatāṃ vrajet ॥90 ॥
bhuvi svarge tathā'nyatra durlabhaṃ sulabhaṃ bhavet ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllabhyetānyasya kā kathā ॥9 1 ॥
nārāyaṇaḥ svakṛpayā dadātyasya vai bahu ।
adhimāsi kṛtasyātrā'saṃkhyaphalaṃ dadāti hi ॥92॥
labdha lakṣmi! yathā devyā śāradāyā vicitrakam ।
tathā vicitrāṃ bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca labhate'rcakaḥ ॥93 ॥
japo homo vrataṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ mālā tapaḥ śrutam ।
pañcamyāṃ tatkṛtaṃ sahasrādiguṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥94॥
ityuktvā śāradāṃ nītvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ harirāyayau ।
sarasvatīsvarūpāṃ tāṃ prāhiṇod vaidhasīṃ prajām ॥ 95॥
amālinyaṃ pavitratvamarājasvalyamityapi ।
patnīdharmā'nabhibhūtiḥ kaumārye ceti rakṣitam ॥ 96 ॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vairājaputryāḥ śāradāyā adhikamāsapañcamyāṃ vratapūjanādikaraṇena nārāyaṇapatnītvaṃ pavitratvam arājasvalyaṃ kumārikātvam agarbhākatvaṃ sarasvatītā cetyādiprāptinirūpaṇādināmā saptanavatyadhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.297 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 297 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 298
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 299 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ divyāṃ sukhasampatpradāyinīm ।
kāmanāpūrikāṃ daivīṃ puruṣottamayoginīm ॥ 1 ॥
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe tu pitṝṇāṃ kanyā āsan susadguṇāḥ ।
tisro nāmnā svadhāputryo menā dhanyā kalāvatī ॥ 2 ॥
sarvasadguṇasampannā yoginyaḥ kāmarūpagāḥ ।
viharantyaḥ pitṛgehe śuśruvurdundubhiṃ hareḥ ॥ 3 ॥
puruṣottamamāso'yaṃ mannāmnā tu mayā''dṛtaḥ ।
ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā tadvratasthamanorathān ॥ 4 ॥
pūrayiṣyāmyahaṃ nārāyaṇo bravīmi vai svayam ।
pitṛgehe tithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātarākarṇya ghoṣaṇām ॥ 5 ॥
tisṛbhiścintitaṃ tvadya vrataṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ khalu ।
yenā'smākaṃ svabhīṣṭaṃ dāsyati nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ॥ 6 ॥
pitṝṇāṃ nityasantoṣastṛptirvai śāśvatī bhavet ।
taddhetuṃ mārgayitvā'tra yācyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 7 ॥
patitvena tu viṣṇuḥ sa yācanīyo na vai kvacit ।
yatastasya tu patnīnāṃ bāhulyaṃ vidyate tataḥ ॥ 8 ॥
sāpatnyaṃ sarvadā duḥkhaṃ sukhanikṛntanaṃ hi tat ।
pitṛtvenā'thavā bhrātṛtvenā'dhyeṣṭavya eva na ॥ 9 ॥
bālikānāṃ tadā'smākamajñānāṃ kiṃ sukhena vai ।
vivāhāvadhivāsastu tadgṛhe vai bhavet tataḥ ॥ 10 ॥
viyogo bāndhavānāṃ ca pituśca duḥkhameva tat ।
putratvenāpi viṣṇuḥ sa yācanīyo na vai kvacit ॥ 11 ॥
tāḍane śikṣaṇe'dhikṣepādau syādaparādhitā ।
śvaśurādisvarūpe tu maryādā duḥkhadā bhavet ॥ 12॥
aparādho'tinaikaṭye'tidūre syādasevanam ।
atiyoge'timaryādā vimaryādā'pi duḥkhadā ॥ 13 ॥
viṣṇustasmād yācanīyaḥ kena rūpeṇa vai bhavet ।
parasparamiti kṛtvā saṃvidaṃ tisra eva tāḥ ॥ 14॥
samādadhuḥ kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ cintayantyo narāyaṇam ।
tāvad vyomagatā vāṇī tā jagād punaḥ punaḥ ॥ 15 ॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jāmātṛtvena vṛṇutā'balāḥ ।
sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhavet tasmai putrīdānena śāśvatam ॥ 1 6॥
putrī mātā svayaṃ proktā putrīmukhena nityadā ।
sukhitā manyate putrīdānaṃ svadānavad bhavet ॥ 17॥
jāmātā putravat syācca dānapātraṃ paraṃ mataḥ ।
pūjanīyastoṣaṇīyo vividhaiḥ sevanairapi ॥ 18 ॥
putryā sevā kṛtā yā tatphalaṃ māturbhavedapi ।
mātrā'nunītayā putryā sevanaṃ yad vidhīyate ॥ 19 ॥
śiṣyakṛte gurorbhāgastadvanmātrā'pi labhyate ।
aihikī sukhasampattiryaśaḥ khyātirdhruvā bhavet ॥2 0 ॥
śreyāṃsi bahurūpāṇi loke jāmātṛvaibhavāt ।
bhavantyeveti niścitya jāmātāraṃ samīcchata ॥ 21 ॥
putrī vaikuṇṭhanāthasya dhāmni yasyā vaset sadā ।
tanmātāpitarau puṇyau kvacid vaikuṇṭhagau matau ॥ 22॥
saptakulaśataikānāṃ bhaveduddharaṇaṃ tathā ।
mātā mātāmahādyāśca bhaveyurmokṣagāstathā ॥ 23 ॥
pitṝṇāṃ sarvadā vāso jāmātṛbhavane bhavet ।
tasmādbhavatyo yācantu jāmātāraṃ hariṃ sadā ॥24॥
putrīṇāṃ tatra sāpatnyaṃ mā bhavedityapi dhruvam ।
yācantvadhikamāsasya vrataṃ kṛtvā tathā'rcanam ॥ 25 ॥
virarāmeti sambodhyā''kāśavāṇī tataśca tāḥ ।
cakitā atisaṃhṛṣṭā vinirṇīya tathaiva tāḥ ॥ 26॥
brahma bhavatājjāmātā jāmātā bhavatāddhariḥ ।
kṛṣṇo bhavatu jāmātetyuktvā vai cakrire vratam ॥ 27॥
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātaśca tāḥ snātvā vyadhustisro'pi pūjanam ।
tisro mūrtīḥ suvarṇasya menā dhanyā kalāvatī ॥ 28॥
vidhāya pūjayāmāsuḥ kramādāvāhanādibhiḥ ।
devān pañcāmṛtaistrīṃśca snapayāmāsurādarāt ॥ 29 ॥
candanādibhirāmardya snapayāmāsurabvaraiḥ ।
sammārjya vastrabhūṣābhiralaṃcakrurdravādibhiḥ ॥ 30 ॥
kuṃkumā'kṣatakastūrīsugandhivastupuṣpakaiḥ ।
hāramālāmukuṭādyairdhūpadīpādibhistathā ॥ 31 ॥
naivedyairvividhairmiṣṭaiḥ pānatāmbūlacūrṇakaiḥ ।
sampūjya trīn chatraśayyācāmaropānahādibhiḥ ॥ 32॥
phalaiśca śarkarābhiśca trīn devānabhivardhya ca ।
arghyaṃ ratnādisaṃyuktaṃ kadalīphalasaṃyutam ॥ 33 ॥
dadustāśca namaskṛtya tataḥ puṣpāñjalīn daduḥ ।
kṣamāṃ samprārthya vavarurjāmātā bhava keśava ॥ 34॥
bhavaddundubhinirghoṣādasmābhirhṛtsu saṃdhṛtaḥ ।
sarvathā sukhado deva putrīdvārā bhavātra naḥ ॥ 35॥
puruṣottamamāsasya ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ pālitā vrate ।
kariṣyāmo vayaṃ naktaṃ punaḥ pūjāṃ vidhāyate ॥ 3 6॥
tato visarjayāmāsustāndevānprātareva ha ।
divāvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tābhirvipradvārā'nale ghṛtaiḥ ॥ 37॥
madhyāhne havanaṃ kārayitvā pupūjurādarāt ।
pitṝn ṛṣīṃstathā devānmunīn janatapaḥsthitān ॥ 38 ॥
pāyasairdugdhasāraiśca piṇḍakaiḥ śākapatrakaiḥ ।
rasairnānāvidhairmiṣṭaistarpayāmāsurīśvarān ॥ 39 ॥
prasannāste śubhāśīrbhiryuyujustisṛkanyakāḥ ।
brahma nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavadvrataphalapradāḥ ॥40 ॥
bhavantu bhavatīnāṃ ca yatheṣṭasukhakāriṇaḥ ।
atha sāyaṃ punastābhirdīpamālāṃ prakāśya ca ॥41 ॥
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstambhapatratoraṇarājitam ।
kārayitvā svarṇapātradarpaṇollekhaśobhitam ॥42 ॥
vastravidyudvicitraṃ saccitraujjvalyamanoharam ।
kārayitvā ca madhye sadratnakhacitakānakam ॥43 ॥
makhamallakaśipvādyairāstṛtaṃ śobhanaṃ mahata ।
siṃhāsanaṃ kārayitvā brahma kṛṣṇaṃ narāyaṇam ॥44॥
mūrtitrayaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya gītavāditrapūrvakam ।
cakruḥ supūjanaṃ tatra suvarṇākṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ॥ 45 ॥
haridrāraktasaddravyaiḥ saubhāgyārhasuvastubhiḥ ।
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cakruḥ kiṃkiṇīnādamiśritam ॥46 ॥
ārārtrikaṃ dhūpadīpau jalamarghyaṃ vidhāya ca ।
pūrikā dugdhapānaṃ ca śākaṃ sarṣapapatrajam ॥47॥
bhojayitvā trayaṃ vāripānamarpayya satphalam ।
pradatvā ca kṣaṇaṃ dhyāne sthitavatyo'bhavaँśca tāḥ ॥48 ॥
tatra dhyāne samāyātā brahmakṛṣṇanarāyaṇāḥ ।
etāsu menayā dṛṣṭaḥ kaṭyambaro'tipuṣṭimāna ॥49 ॥
nihāradhavalo vyāghracarmadhṛk candraśekharaḥ ।
sajaṭaḥ parito vyāpta brahmatejo'tibhāsuraḥ ॥5 0 ॥
yuvā manauhārimūrtirbrahma nirguṇameva yat ।
saguṇatvaṃ samāpannaṃ nararūpaṃ sa eva saḥ ॥5 1 ॥
nirmalāntarvṛttigamyaḥ śaṃkaro bhāvapūrakaḥ ।
prasannatāpravarṣā prakhyāpayan smitahāsyataḥ ॥52॥
tāvattadaṅkamāsīnāṃ putrīṃ svāṃ bhāvinīṃ śubhām ।
apaśyannāhvayantīṃ ca hyambe mā'mbeti vai muhuḥ ॥53 ॥
śaṃkaro brahmarūpo'yaṃ bhagavān prāha menakām ।
menake tvaṃ mamāṃśasya himādreḥ saṃbhaviṣyasi ॥ 54॥
patnī tatra ca kanyeyaṃ pārvatī te bhaviṣyati ।
tāṃ tvaṃ dāsyasi mahyaṃ vai mattaḥ sukhamavāpsyasi ॥55॥
puruṣottamamāsasyaikadinasya vratasya ca ।
taveṣṭaṃ tu phalaṃ sarvasukhadaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ॥56 ॥
ityuktvā'ntarhito devaḥ śaṃkaro brahma yatparam ।
athaiva dhanyayā dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ vai sadhanurhariḥ ॥57॥
jaṭāvalkalaśobhāḍhyaḥ punaḥ sadrājyacihnavān ।
yuvā manoharo devo vāsudevo guṇātigaḥ ॥58 ॥
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptānanahāsyānvitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
caturbhujo dvibhujo'yaṃ siṃhāsanavirājitaḥ ॥59 ॥
tasya pārśve surūpāṃ svāṃ kanyāṃ sītāṃ dadarśa sā ।
āhvayantīṃ ca mo he'mba! iti miṣṭagirā muhuḥ ॥6 0 ॥
śrīrāmo bhagavāँścāyaṃ prasannaḥ prāha dhanyakām ।
dhanye tvaṃ vai janakasya gṛhiṇī bhāvinī tataḥ ॥6 1 ॥
iyaṃ tu te sutā sītā mahālakṣmīrbhaviṣyati ।
tāṃ tvaṃ dāsyasi mahyaṃ vai mattaḥ sukhamavāpsyasi ॥ 62॥
puruṣottamamāsasyaikasyā'hnastu vratasya vai ।
taveṣṭaṃ tu phalaṃ snigdhaṃ bhaviṣyati sukhātmakam ॥ 63 ॥
ityuktvā'ntarhito vāsudevo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
atha dṛṣṭaḥ kalāvatyā kṛṣṇaḥ sudarśanānvitaḥ ॥64॥
mayūrapicchamukuṭaḥ pītavastrauṣṭhaveṇukaḥ ।
gopālabālakaḥ paścāt sa eva nṛpatīśvaraḥ ॥65॥
rājādhirājo bhagavān sarvaśobhātisundaraḥ ।
navajīmūtasatkāntiryuvā bhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ ॥66 ॥
divyasiṃhāsanaśreṣṭhasthito rājādhirājakaḥ ।
dvibhujo mandahāsyena darśayansuprasannatām ॥67॥
tasya pārśve sthitāṃ divyāṃ rūpānurūpaśevadhim ।
putrīṃ rādhāṃ bhāvinīṃ tāṃ sā dadarśa kalāvatī ॥ 68 ॥
kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe nijaṃ hastaṃ dadatī premavihvalām ।
āhvayantīṃ ca mo ambe he'mbeti sadgirā muhuḥ ॥6 9 ॥
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ suprasannaḥ san spṛśan rādhāṃ kalāvatīm ।
prāheyaṃ tava vaiśyatve putrī rādhā bhaviṣyati ॥70॥
tāṃ tvaṃ dāsyasi mahyaṃ vai bhāṇḍīravaṭasannidhau ।
madīyā sā sadā patnī mūrdhanyā syāddhi śāśvatī ॥71॥
mattaḥ sarve sukhaṃ putrīdvārā tvaṃ samavāpsyasi ।
puruṣottamamāsasyaikadinasya vratasya vai ॥72॥
phalaṃ cābhilaṣitaṃ te bhaviṣyati sukhātmakam ।
ityabhidhāya kṛṣṇastatsthalādantarhito'bhavat ॥73॥
athā'cirāttu tisrastāstato dhyānātsamutthitāḥ ।
prasannāsyāḥ kṛtakṛtyā natvā nārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ ॥74॥
vyasarjayan sukusumāṃjalīn datvā'tha tanniśi ।
pāraṇāṃ samakurvaṃstā bhojayantyo'pi kanyakā ॥75॥
brahmanārāyaṇakṛṣṇamūrtidānaṃ pracakrire ।
athā'cirādādyayuge pitṛbhistāḥ kramānnanu ॥76॥
haimajanakagopebhyo menā dhanyā kalāvatī ।
vivāhitā tu vidhinā tāsāṃ putryo'bhavaँśca tāḥ ॥77॥
kramāttu pārvatī sītā rādhā brahmaparātmikāḥ ।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe sādhikāyāmādyāvatārarūpiṇe ॥78॥
śivāya rāmarūpāya kṛṣṇāya tvarpitāśca tāḥ ।
jāmātṝँstān parabrahmāvatārāँścābhipadya vai ॥79॥
sarvānkāmānavāpustā menā dhanyā kalāvatī ।
evaṃ lakṣmi! vrataṃ naktamadhimāse prapūjanam ॥80॥
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kālatraye kṛtvā purāṇapuruṣottamāt ।
prāptaṃ vrataphalaṃ prāptā jāmātāro hariḥ svayam ॥8 1॥
putryastāḥ śaṃbhunā rāmeṇa ca kṛṣṇena śāśvate ।
kailāse cātha vaikuṇṭhe goloke ca ramanti hi ॥82॥
tanmātāpitaraścāpi nityaṃ muktāstadīyakam ।
sukhaṃ tvatyantamāptāśca yatheṣṭaṃ kīrtimityapi ॥83॥
kimvadhikaṃ ca te vakṣye lakṣmi! loke paratra ca ।
mātā svīyāṃ suputrīṃ vai sukhinīṃ kartumicchati ॥84॥
tadā tayā prakartavyaṃ vrataṃ cādhikamāsikam ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrataṃ pūjanaṃ ca yathā menādibhiḥ kṛtam ॥85॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jāmātaraṃ prāpsyati vai tataḥ ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathā cānyat sarve prāpsyaṃtyayatnataḥ ॥86॥
putrīdānasya satpātraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yadi ।
tatra prāptaṃ parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ॥87॥
kartavyaṃ laukikaṃ vā'nyalaukikaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।
sarvaśeṣī hariryatra ramate sutayā saha ॥88॥
sutayā tuṣyati devastasya toṣe nu kiṃ punaḥ।
durlabhaṃ tvathavā'prāpyaṃ bhavet kṛṣṇasya sannidhau ॥89॥
evaṃ te kathitā lakṣmi! kṛpā nārāyaṇasya sā ।
adhimāse vratināṃ mānasāni pūrayatyajaḥ ॥ 90 ॥
yadīcchedguṇasāmarthya rūpavidyādibhiḥ samaḥ ।
kṛṣṇena tulyo jāmātā syāditi cettathā bhavet ॥91॥
yadīcchellokavikhyāto rājasattāpravartaka ।
jāmātā me bhavecceti tadā vai tādṛśau bhavet॥92॥
yadīcchedbhagavadbhakto dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān ।
jāmātā me ciraṃjīvī bhavediti tathā bhavet ॥93॥
yadīcched brāhmaṇaguṇo yadvā kṣatriyadharmavān ।
jāmātā me bhavedeva vratakartryāstathā bhavet ॥94॥
yadīcched gṛhajāmātā sukhado me bhavediti ।
putrapautrādimān syācca vratakartryāstathā bhavet ॥95॥
yathā tu yādṛśaṃ jāmātāraṃ vāñchati taṃ tathā ।
tādṛśaṃ samavāpnoti śvaśrūḥ śrīharyanugrahāt ॥ 96 ॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottama māsamāhātmye pitṛ mānasa kanyābhiḥ menādhanyā- kalāvatībhiḥ adhikamāsadundubhiśravaṇena ṣaṣṭhyāṃ trikāla-vratena kramāt pārvatīsītārādhā'bhidhaputrīlābhe jāmā-tṛtvena śaṃkararāmakṛṣṇānāṃ sambandhopalabdhirūpa-phalaprāptiprabhṛtinirūpatānāmā'ṣṭanavatyadhika-dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.298॥


← adhyāyaḥ 298 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 299
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 300 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dundubhestu ninādena kṛtaṃ vratam ।
satyalokasthitābhyāṃ tu kanyābhyāṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
satyasvargādilokānāṃ rājñāṃ pātālavāsinām ।
nagarāṇāṃ bhavanānāṃ sabhānāṃ yajñakarmiṇām ॥ 2 ॥
maṇḍapānāṃ vinirmātā nārāyaṇāṃśa eva yaḥ ।
tasya kanyā siddhināmnī jyeṣṭhā buddhiḥ kanīyasī ॥ 3 ॥
siddhibuddhī surūpe ca suśīle devapūjike।
nityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā taduttaram ॥ 4 ॥
pitroścaraṇayornatvā brāhmasaṃjñe muhūrtake ।
gṛhe devagṛhe cāpi dīpaṃ prajvālya vai tataḥ ॥ 5 ॥
dhūpaṃ kṛtvā sugandhaṃ ca kīrtanaṃ kurutaśca te ।
devaṃ natvā tu puṣpāṇi jalaṃ ca śarkarādanam ॥ 6 ॥
samarpya gṛhakāryāṇi kurutaścobhaye tataḥ ।
siddhistatra saromadhyājjalaṃ tvāharati drutam ॥ 7 ॥
mārjayitvā gṛhaṃ buddhirvahniṃ prajvālayatyapi ।
cullikāyāṃ jalapātramuṣṇīkaraṇahetave ॥ 8 ॥
sthāpayitvā ca pitaro prasnāpayati bhāvukā ।
siddhistāvadgṛhaśayyādikaṃ saṃgṛhya śayyadhau ॥ 9 ॥
rakṣayitvā'tha paryaṃkān sammārjyonnīya susthale ।
saṃklṛpya rātripātrāṇāṃ mañjanaṃ prakaroti vai ॥ 10 ॥
tāvad buddhiḥ snātayośca pitrorārdrāmbarāṇi tu ।
prakṣālya rajjvāṃ vinyasya gatvodyānaṃ gṛhānugam ॥ 11 ॥
devapūjādikāryārthaṃ puṣpāṇyānayati drutam ।
mātā cātha pitā yāvattūpayāṃti harergṛham ॥ 1 2॥
āsane tāvadāstīrya sandhyādyarthe dadātyapaḥ ।
tulasīpatrakā'mbhojakundacampakamālikāḥ ॥1 3॥
dadāti devapūjārthaṃ pitroḥ paramabhāvataḥ ।
candanā'kṣatakuṃkumapañcāmṛtajalāni ca ॥ 14॥
pātrāṇi pūjanārhāṇi ghṛtavatīśca śarkarāḥ ।
drākṣādāḍimabījāni vividhāni phalāni ca ॥ 15॥
elālavaṃgatāmbūlanaivedyānyānayatyapi ।
pūjāsthāṃ mātaraṃ cātha pūjāsthaṃ pitaraṃ tadā ॥ 16॥
daśa pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā kṛtvā daśa namaskriyāḥ ।
mātāpitṛcaraṇayordhautaṃ pragṛhya vai jalam ॥ 17॥
pārśve tiṣṭhati sevārthaṃ darśanaṃ prakaroti ca ।
tāvattatra samāgatya siddhirapi tathaiva tat ॥ 18॥
pradakṣiṇānamaskārādikaṃ kṛtvā prasādajam ।
jalaṃ pītvā punaryāti cullikāsannidhau gṛhe ॥ 1 9॥
mahānase tu pākārthaṃ sāmagrī sakalāśca sā ।
suśodhayitvā sannyasya buddhimāhūya tāmanu ॥20 ॥
karoti bhakṣyabhojyāni peyāni vividhānyapi ।
dugdhapānaṃ tu sā pitroḥ siddhiḥ kārayati drutam ॥21 ॥
pūjāpātrāṇi sarvāṇi mṛdā saṃghṛṣya vai tataḥ ।
śuddhvā prātarvidheyaṃ yat kṛtvā sarvaṃ tato hyubhe ॥22॥
vidyābhyāsaṃ ca kurute vaiśvadevāntakaṃ tataḥ ।
kṛtvā tau bhojayitvā ca vidhiṃ mādhyāhnikaṃ punaḥ ॥ 23 ॥
kṛtvā cātithigojantubhāgān datvā''śritādanam ।
tataḥ sve bhojanaṃ prāsādikaṃ cakraturādarāt ॥ 24॥
mahānasapraśuddhiṃ ca pātraśuddhiṃ pramārjanam ।
jalāharaṇamannādiśodhanaṃ tvaparāhṇake ॥ 25॥
dehaśrāṃgārikaṃ kṛtvā virāmaṃ prāpnutaḥ kṣaṇam ।
tatastīrthakathādeva darśanādi vidhāya tu ॥ 26 ॥
sāyaṃ kṛṣṇasya saṃpūjā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।
kṛtvā pakvānnamiṣṭāni bhojayitvā'tibhāvataḥ ॥ 27॥
pitarau tu tataḥ śayyādikaṃ saṃstīrya te hyubhe ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ pitroḥ kṛtvā sevanamityapi ॥ 28 ॥
dainaṃ tu yat svakaṃ gosevanaṃ kīrtanamaiśvaram ।
yannyūnaṃ tattu sampūrṇaṃ kṛtvā niḥśeṣamityubhe ॥ 29॥
kiṃcidadhyayanaṃ kṛtvā gṛhṇītaḥ svāpamalpakam ।
brāhmakāle samusthāyā'bhyastāṃ vidyāṃ vicārya ca ॥ 30 ॥
punaśca naityakaṃ kāryaṃ kurutaḥ kanyake hyubhe ।
evaṃ tu sevayā hṛṣṭau pitarau tvatibhāvataḥ ॥ 31 ॥
yuyujatuḥ śubhāśīrbhiḥ 'sukhinyau bhavataṃ hyubhe ।
īśvare premayuktatvānnārāyaṇahariprabhuḥ ॥ 3 2॥
yuvābhyāṃ prāpsyate kāle sevanīyatamaḥ śubhaḥ ।
ityāśīrvādapātre te nityaṃ hṛdi hariṃ muhuḥ ॥ 33 ॥
vāñchataḥ śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇamadhīśvaram ।
evaṃ vrate satyaloke tābhyāṃ me dundubhiḥ śrutaḥ ॥ 34॥
adhimāsasya saptamyāṃ prātarvai vratabodhakaḥ ।
sa tu bodhayate lokān adhimāsavratāni vai ॥ 35॥
kariṣyanti yathāśakti ye brahmāṇḍagatā janāḥ ।
narā nāryo'thavā tvanye teṣāmabhīṣṭadāyakaḥ ॥ 3 6॥
alabhyalābhadātā'smi hyahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
māsikaṃ pākṣikaṃ sāptāhikaṃ dainikameva vā ॥ 3 7॥
naiśaṃ paurvāhṇikaṃ yadvā pārāhṇikaṃ ca madhyagam ।
upavāsān phalāhārān payaḥpānaṃ jalāśanam ॥ 38 ॥
kandāśanaṃ nivārādyaśanaṃ sāyaṃ niśāśanam ।
divāśanaṃ vaikabhuktaṃ tilabhuktamayācitam ॥ 39 ॥
kṛtvā yathābalaṃ puṣpaiḥ sampūjya puruṣottamam ।
jalena vā phalairvāpi mūlena kuṃkumena vā ॥40 ॥
akṣataiścandanenāpi sampūjya puruṣottamam ।
vastreṇa ca sudugdhena gūḍena miṣṭayā'thavā ॥ 41 ॥
śarkarābhirjalapānaistāmbūlenacchadādinā ।
patreṇa vā'tibhāvena premṇā māṃ puruṣottamam ॥42 ॥
santuṣyā'dhikamāse te matto'rjayantu durlabham ।
idānīṃ kṛpayā dāsye kṛte svalpe'pi sādhane ॥43 ॥
anyamāseṣu yat kaṣṭasādhyaṃ bhavati cātra tat ।
svalpasyāpi dadāmyeva koṭiguṇitamadya vai ॥44॥
paścānnaiva pradāsye'haṃ tasmād gṛhṇantu bho janāḥ ।
phalaṃ pūgīphalasyāpi pārameṣṭhyapadādhikam ॥45॥
jalapātravratenāpi kṣīrasāgaraśāyitām ।
ekabhuktavratenāpi golokasyā'dhikāritām ॥46॥
naktamātravratenā'pi nārāyaṇasamānatām ।
patrapuṣpapradāne'pi mahendrapadaśālitām ॥47॥
dīpamātrapradāne'pi sūryacandrādidehitām ।
naro vā yadi vā nārī kumāro vā kumārikā ॥48॥
icchati cenmamalakṣmīmapi māṃ puruṣottamam ।
patnīṃ patiṃ ca vā putraṃ dāsye lakṣmīṃ ca māmapi ॥49॥
pragṛhṇantu varānasmat prakurvantu ca sañcayam ।
mahākṛpāmahāvṛṣṭilabhyaṃ puṇyabalodayam ॥50॥
satyaṃ satyaṃ nā'nṛtaṃ vai ghoṣayatyeva dundubhiḥ ।
adhimāsavrataṃ kṛtvā gṛhṇantu svepsitaṃ prajāḥ ॥51 ॥
ityāśrutya hyubhe kanye saptamyāṃ prātareva ha ।
dundubhiṃ me praṇamyaiva vardhayitvā'ñjalidravaiḥ ॥52॥
pūjayitvā supuṣpaiśca harṣayukte babhūvatuḥ ।
punastāvaddundubheśca kṛpāvākyaṃ śrutaṃ śubham ॥53॥
kumārike yadīcchetāṃ patiṃ māṃ puruṣottamam ।
ekabhuktavratenāpi bhaviṣyāmi patistayoḥ ॥54॥
pūjāṃ mādhyāhnikīṃ kṛtvā yathālabdhopacārakaiḥ ।
miṣṭānnaṃ bhojayitvā māṃ prāpsyataḥ puruṣottamam ॥55॥
ityevaṃ saṃvadantaṃ taṃ matvā svayoḥ kṛte śubham ।
siddhibuddhī viditvā svaṃ bhāgyodayamupāgatam ॥56॥
pūjayitvā svapitarau bhojayitvā vidhānataḥ ।
gṛhakāryaṃ vinirvartya puṣpacandanavāribhiḥ ॥57॥
akṣataiścāpi miṣṭānnairdhūpadīpasucarvaṇaiḥ ।
yānyāsan svagṛhe taistairarcayitvā tu kānakam ॥58॥
nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ devaṃ patiprāptīcchayā śubhe ।
nīrājayāmāsatuśca hyarthe kāmaphalaṃ śubham ॥59॥
datvā saṃprārthayāmāsatuśca nau tvaṃ patirbhava ।
ityuktvā'kṣatasaṃpūrṇāñjalī dadaturādarāt ॥60 ॥
tāvacchrībhagavān sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
yuvā kaṭākṣabāṇena nirīkṣan prāvirāsa vai ॥61 ॥
dvayoḥ prakoṣṭhe saṃgṛhya svakareṇa hariḥ svayam ।
mastakayoḥ karau kṛtvā vakṣasyākṛṣya te hyubhe ॥62॥
priye iti ca saṃbhāṣya nibhālya ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
milito'smi ca jāto'smi milite vidhivat priye ॥63॥
ityuktvā'ntardadhe kṛṣṇaste hyubhe taṃ hariṃ sadā ।
jāgratyapi tathā svapne paśyato vai manoharam ॥64॥
pārvatyaṃkasthitaṃ kṛṣṇamekaśuṇḍhaṃ kvacitpunaḥ ।
aśuṇḍhaṃ muralīyuktaṃ golokasthaṃ vyapaśyatām ॥65॥
varayogyaṃ punastaṃ ca gaṇeśaṃ śaṃkarātmajam ।
saśuṇḍhaṃ ca surūpaṃ ca dadṛśatuḥ kṣaṇāntare ॥66॥
śvetavarṇaṃ sunetraṃ ca subhālaṃ yauvanānvitam ।
kṛṣṇātmakaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā mumūhatuḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥67॥
kvacitsvapne ca te kanye kurvantyau modakān bahūn ।
paśyataḥ sma ca tatraitya gaṇeśaḥ phalakāsane ॥68॥
niṣadyā'rthayate laḍḍūn anye'pi dadatustadā ।
pārśvadvaye hyubhe sthitvā dadaturlaḍaḍū'kān muhuḥ ॥69॥
gaṇeśaḥ svalpa śuṇḍena pārśvadvaye kṛtena ca ।
vāraṃvāraṃ pradattān sulaḍḍūnprāpya nije mukhe ॥70॥
nyasyatyatīva miṣṭāँśca premṇā bhakṣayati drutam ।
praśaṃsati karau datvā kanyayoḥ pṛṣṭhayostadā ॥71॥
ekaikaṃ laḍaḍukaṃ tābhyāṃ datvā saṃbhojayatyubhe ।
hasan hāsyaṃ prakurvan rāmayan saṃramayanmudā ॥72॥
darśayitvaivamātmānaṃ tirobhāvaṃ pragacchati ।
kanye'pi jāgrate bhūtvā muhuḥ saṃsmaratuśca tam ॥73॥
evaṃ hṛdye gaṇapatau jāte kāle'pyupasthite ।
viśvaprakarmaṇā jñātvā prāgvṛttānta tadīyakam ॥74॥
gaṇeśaṃ tu samāhūya vidhinā lagnaśālinā ।
gaṇeśāyā'rpite kanye siddhibuddhī samāhvaye ॥75॥
vivāhottarakāle'tra''ścaryaṃ jātaṃ mahacchṛṇu ।
gaṇeśena kṛte rūpe dve tadānīṃ gṛhāntare ॥76॥
ekaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpaṃ ca gaṇeśātma dvitīyakam ।
kanyayoścāpi rūpe dve dve kṛte sumanohare ॥77॥
rādhātulye tu rūpe dve śrīkṛṣṇo garuḍopari ।
nītvā yayau svakaṃ dhāma golokaṃ śāśvataṃ tadā ॥78॥
tatra vai ramate siddhyā buddhyā ca divyarūpayā ।
evaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ mukyātmakaṃ dattaṃ vratasya vai ॥79॥
athā'nyena svarūpeṇa gaṇeśākhyena tena te ।
ubhe kṛtvā svake tvaṃke premṇā nibhālite muhuḥ ॥80॥
cumbite gaṇḍayoścāpi toṣite'ntargṛhe gate ।
navayauvanabhāvasya phalaṃ vai prāpite rateḥ ॥81॥
iti lakṣmi! phalaṃ tābhyāṃ labdhaṃ kṛṣṇadhavātmakama ।
divyaṃ loke'pi vikhyātiṃ prāptaṃ rūpaṃ dvayaṃ dvayam ॥82॥
pūjyabhāvaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca prāpte'dhimāsa satkṛtāt ।
ekabhuktavratād yadvā prāptavastubhirarcanāt ॥82॥
evaṃ yā kanyakā kuryātpuruṣottamapūjanam ।
saptamyāṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca vāñcchayā kṛṣṇasatpateḥ ॥84॥
sā'vaśyaṃ yatra kutrāpi prādurbhūtaṃ svakaṃ patim ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ divyaṃ mānavaṃ sā tvavāpsyati ॥85॥
bhuktiṃ kṛtvā bahūna lokān samprā'nubhūya śāśvatān ।
tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇagolokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā''psyati dhruvam ॥86॥
tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyamadhimāsaprasaṃbhavam ।
anāyāsena muktiḥ syāt punarjanma na śiṣyate ॥87॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye viśvakarmaṇaḥ siddhibuddhiputrībhyāṃ mātā- pitṛsevayā''śīrvādottaramadhikamāsavrata bodhakadundubhiśravaṇottaraṃ kṛtena saptamyāṃ ekabhuktavratena tayoḥ śrīkṛṣṇadarśanarūpadvayaprāptirgolokavāso gaṇapatyātmakakṛṣṇena saha vivāhaścetyādinirūpaṇa-nāmaikonaśatādhikadviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.299॥


← adhyāyaḥ 299 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 300
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 301 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yugāraṃbhe sṛṣṭyādau yadabhūtpurā ।
ṣaṭkaṃ jātamapatyānāṃ brahmaṇo mānasānniśi ।। 1 ।।
tapasā kleśitasyā'sya lalāṭādabhavanmahān ।
rudraḥ so'pyājñayā'jasya rudrairjagadapūrayat ।। 2 ।।
tāṃstu bhayaṃkarānkrūrān jagadviplavakārakān ।
dṛṣṭvā toṣaṃ na vai lebhe brahmā''jñāmakarotpunaḥ ।। 3 ।।
saṃhārārthaṃ tu rudrāṇāṃ sṛṣṭestadā sutena vai ।
rudreṇa saṃhṛtāḥ sarve jagacchūnyamabhūttataḥ ।। 4 ।।
satyalokaṃ gṛhaṃ svasya śūnyaṃ vilokya viśvasṛṅ ।
audāsīnyaṃ jagāmā'ti bālakākalikāṃ vinā ।। 5 ।।
yatra gṛhe na vai bālo bālānāṃ rodanaṃ na vā ।
krīḍanaṃ kalaho no na śrūyate bālabhāṣitam ।। 6 ।।
tadgṛhaṃ kālarātrervai pherurājagṛhopamam ।
vinā putraṃ vinā putrīṃ svargaṃ tu narakāyate ।। 7 ।।
hīśvarāṇāṃ bhavanāni raṇāyante pragartavat ।
jīrṇavṛkṣāyate saudhaḥ kevalavṛddhamaṇḍalaḥ ।। 8 ।।
anapatyaṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca śuṣkaparvataśṛṃgavat ।
anapatyaḥ pitā dagdhajvālāmukhisthalīsamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
abālakākalīśabdaṃ mahāpralayavadgraham ।
rasā apyarasāḥ saudhe jāyante bālakaṃ vinā ।। 10 ।।
bhojyānyapi kavoṣṇāni jāyante'tṛptidāni ca ।
utsavā yadvinā naiva bhavantyeva navā navāḥ ।। 11 ।।
yadunnatikṛtotsāhā api naśyanti yadvinā ।
śuṣkāyante mukhacandrā grīṣme kardamapiṇḍavat ।। 1 2।।
rūkṣāyante mānasāni tāpe barburakāṣṭhavat ।
tiktāyante ca peyāni jyeṣṭhe nimbarasādivat ।। 13 ।।
sukhadāni tvapatyāni jāyante puṇyaśālinām ।
duḥkhadāni daridrāṇi jāyante duṣprakarmiṇām ।। 14।।
ṛṇānubandha evātra kāraṇaṃ prāgvisargajaḥ ।
nūtanaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ svapatyadāyakaṃ tapaḥ ।। 1 5।।
iti saṃkalpya ca brahmā saṃyamyendriyamaṇḍalam ।
tapaścacāra ghaṭikāmātraṃ samādhisaṃsthitaḥ ।। 1 6।।
apatyārthī svapatyārthī sasmāra tāni vai hṛdi ।
tāvat tanmānasā jātā dundubhighaṇṭakambavaḥ ।। 17।।
trayaḥ putrāḥ sutāstisro ghaṇṭā nīrājanā tathā ।
jhallarī ceti mānasyaḥ paścājjātaṃ trikaṃ punaḥ ।। 18 ।।
kāṃsyaṃ ca pañcapātraṃ ca dhūpadhraṃ ceti mānasam ।
tisraḥ putryastrayaḥ putrāstrayaṃ ṣaṇḍhaṃ prajāpateḥ ।। 19।।
saṃkalpānnavasaṃkhyāni tvapatyāni prajajñire ।
niṣeke vātha saṃkalpe bhāvanā yādṛśī bhavet ।। 20 ।।
tādṛśaṃ jāyate'patyaṃ tathā jātāni padmaje ।
tatra ṣaṭ khalu vācālānyākrośakārakāṇi hi ।। 21 ।।
kamburghaṇṭo dundubhiśca ghaṇṭā ca jhallarī tathā ।
kāṃsyaṃ ca jātamātrāṇi cakruḥ kolāhalaṃ gṛhe ।। 22 ।।
audāsīnyaṃ gataṃ tena śūnyatāpi gatā vidheḥ ।
gṛhaṃ krīḍadapatyaiśca sotsavaṃ samajāyata ।।2 3 ।।
brahmā tena prasanno'bhūt saṃsakto lālane'vane ।
gṛhaṃ sāpatyakaṃ maṃgalāyatanaṃ tvamanyata ।। 24।।
nīrājanā pañcapātraṃ dhūpadhraṃ maunavṛttitaḥ ।
ṣaḍbhistāni ramante vai nartanādyaistadā kṣaṇe ।।25।।
nityaṃ prātastathā sāyaṃ militvā nava tāni vai ।
kurvanti kīrtanaṃ svasva kartavyārthaiḥ prapūjanam ।। 26।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva babhūvurbhaktimanti vai ।
brahmā jaharṣa cātīva svapatyalābhataḥ khalu ।।27।।
evaṃ prayāte samaye'dhimāsasyā'ṣṭamī prage ।
mahādundubhiretaistu śruto viṣṇupadītaṭe । । 28 ।।
prātaḥ snānaṃ prakurvadbhiḥ śrutaṃ tatra śubhāvaham ।
śṛṇvantu cetanāḥ sarve sthāvarāśca jaḍā api ।।29।।
mūrtimanto hyamūrtāśca bālā vā bālikāstathā ।
bālakānyapi śṛṇvantu svalpāyāsa phalottamam ।। 30 ।।
puruṣottamavādyo'haṃ yāthātathyena vacmyaham ।
puruṣottamamāso'yaṃ puruṣottama eva saḥ ।। 31 ।।
sarvamāsātigaḥ prāpayati śrīpuruṣottamam ।
manasā karmaṇā vācā tvādṛtaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 35।।
yena sa tvādṛtaḥ syācchrīpuruṣottamaśārṅgiṇā ।
adya maunaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ caikakālikam ।। 33 ।।
prātaḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ madhyāhne ca tathā niśi ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'dya rūpaṃ dhyātavyamaiśvaram ।। 34।।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ natvā pūjāsāmagrīrānayet ।
suvarṇapratimāṃ viṣṇoḥ sthāpayenmaṇḍale ghaṭe ।। 35।।
pañcāmṛtena dugdhena dadhnā kṣaudreṇa sarpiṣā ।
śarkarayā śuddhavārbhiḥ snāpayet puruṣottamam ।। 36 ।।
vastraiḥ sammārjya dhautrādi dhārayet puruṣottamam ।
ābhūṣaṇāni kaṭakakirīṭādīni dhārayet ।। 37।।।
candanāttarakastūrī kuṃkumādibhirarcayet ।
bhojayed dugdhapākādi tāmbūlādi samarpayet ।। 38 ।।
dhūpadīpanamaskārā''rārtrikādyairvivardhayet ।
pradakṣiṇā daṇḍavadbhiḥ prārthayenmanasepsitam ।। 39 ।।
jalaṃ peyaṃ tathā'rghyaṃ ca phalaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet ।
prārthayecca kṛpānātha puruṣottama keśava ।।40 ।।
vrataṃ tava kṛte cādya puruṣottamamāsikam ।
aṣṭamyāṃ pālitaṃ cāharniśaṃ kṛtvā hyupoṣaṇam ।।41 ।।
ekabhaktaṃ ca vā kṛtvā yathāśakti kṛtaṃ prabho ।
kriyate vā kariṣye vā nirvighnaṃ tat samāpyatām ।।।42।।
yatheṣṭaṃ ca phalaṃ dehi kṛpāsindho janārdana ।
iti saṃprārthya deveśaṃ labhantāṃ manasepsitam । ।4 3 ।।
mahādundubhiṃ śrutvaivaṃ vedhobālāni tatkṣaṇam ।
snātvā''ścaryabharāṇyevā''yayustasyā'ntikaṃ mudā । ।44। ।
papraccha dundubhiḥ svalpo mahādundubhimutsukaḥ ।
ko'si kasmāt samāyātaḥ kiṃ pravakṣi dadāsi kim । ।45। ।
kva te vāsaśca kiṃ kāryaṃ karoṣi tvatprabhuśca kaḥ ।
iti dundubhinā pṛṣṭo mahādundubhirāha tam । । 46 । ।
ahaṃ vaikuṇṭhaputro'smi vaiku×Vr̤M×ṇṭhādāgato'smi ca ।
vaikuṇṭhe me sadā vāso nārāyaṇasya mandire । ।47। ।
kāryaṃ nārāyaṇanīrājanakāle pravādanam ।
mama svāmī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।48 ।।
yasyā''jñayā janako me vaikuṇṭhadhāmarūpadhṛk ।
bhūtvā nityaṃ vartate tu sevāyāmapi sevakaḥ ।। 49 ।।
pitrājñayā tathā nārāyaṇājñayā'pyahaṃ sadā ।
vicarāmi trilokyāṃ vai preṣyakāryakaronvaham । ।5 0 । ।
yā tvājñā jāyate tasya nārāyaṇasya tāmaham ।
pravadāmi ghoṣayāmi punargacchāmi tatra ca । ।5 1 । ।
svarūpe dve mama sto vai caturbāhustu pārṣadaḥ ।
sevāyāṃ sarvadā varte dvitīyo'smi sudundubhiḥ । ।52 ।।
ghoṣayāmi harerājñāṃ daṇḍena tāḍito mudā ।
anekāni svarūpāṇi dhartuṃ śakto'smyanugrahāt ।।53 । ।
sevayā matkṛpayā ca santuṣṭo bhagavān svayam ।
dadāti bhojanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ prāsādikantu me । ।54। ।
udyānāni bhavanāni divyānyupaskarāṇi ca ।
yathā nārāyaṇasyeva me'pi santi ca tānyapi । ।55 ।।
sarve nārāyaṇatulyaṃ nyūnaṃ kiñcinna me'sti tat ।
ānakaḥ paṭaho bherī ḍhakkā rūpāṇi santi me । ।56। ।
yathāpekṣaṃ nivasāmi sevāyāṃ mandireṣu vai ।
dundubhistaṃ samākarṇya tatsukhākṛṣṭamānasaḥ । ।57। ।
papraccha dundubhiśreṣṭhaṃ kathaṃ vai prāpyate hareḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ vā tadīyaṃ ca smṛddhaṃ dhāma tu mādṛśaiḥ । ।।98 । ।
mahādundubhirāhainaṃ jijñāsuṃ svalpadundubhim ।
adhimāse'pyekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālikam । ।59 । ।
yasmin kasmin dine kṛṣṇapūjanaṃ tasya cāptidam ।
upavāsā'yācitādivratenaikā'danena vā । । 60। ।
naktena vā payasā vā kṛtavratena cāpyate ।
kṛtenā'lpena bahu tat phalaṃ vai labhyate janaiḥ ।। 61 ।।
jalamātrapradānena haraye labhyate'pi tat ।
yasyā'gre kiṃcana nāsti bhaktyā tenāpi labhyate ।।6 2।।
devāgre nartanaṃ kāryaṃ gāyanaṃ susvarānvitam ।
tuṣṭastenāpi bhagavān vaikuṇṭhaṃ pradadāti vai ।। 63 ।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpi golokaṃ brahmadhāmā'kṣarāhvayam ।
taduttarottaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadicchati dadāti saḥ ।।64।।
etacchrutvā''ha vai svalpadundubhirdundubhīśvaram ।
kiṃ vaikuṇṭhātparaṃ cāsti golokaṃ vai sthalāntaram ।।65 ।।
golokāt kiṃ paraṃ vrahmadhāmā'styanyat sthalaṃ kimu! ।
kastatra vasati svāmī vayaṃ taṃ prāpnumo na vā ।।66।।
mahādundubhirāha śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
svāmī vaikuṇṭhalokasya yadīṣyetā''pyate sa vai ।।67।।
svāmī golokadhāmnaḥ śrīrādhākṛṣṇo mahān prabhuḥ ।
yadīṣyetā''pyate so'dhimāse kṛtavratena vai ।।68।।
svāmī ca brahmalokasyā'kṣareśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
yasmātparo na vai kaścinna ca yena samo'styapi ।।69।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so'sti pareśvaraḥ ।
yasyā''jñāṃ mastake dhṛtvā ghoṣayāmi vratārcanam ।।70 ।।
adhimāsasya sa svāmī dadāti vratine hi tat ।
vratī yadīhate divyaṃ sarvaṃ dadātyanugrahāt ।।71 ।।
vaḥ samicchā tu yasyāsti kāryaṃ tanmūrtipūjanam ।
vaikuṇṭhāt koṭiguṇakaṃ sukhaṃ golokadhāmani ।।72।।
golokādapyasaṃkhyaṃ ca pare dhāmnyakṣare sukham ।
ānandānāṃ tathā''nantyamaiśvaryāṇāmasaṃkhyatā ।।73 ।।
nānyad vai tādṛśaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavatītyavagamyatām ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ lokāstannirayopamāḥ ।।74।।
gantavyaṃ yadi cet tatrā'rcayantu puruṣottamam ।
adyā'ṣṭamyāṃ yathāśakti yathābhāvaṃ sa pūjyatām ।।75।।
nṛtyaṃ vidhīyatāṃ cāpi gāyanaṃ ca vidhīyatām ।
iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ hariḥ sarvaṃ bhāvānugaṃ pradāsyati ।।76।।
nivāsārthaṃ yadā sarvadhāmasu golakeṣu ca ।
pratyacyutagrahaṃ cāpīṣyate so'pi dadāti tat ।।77।।
śrutvā tvaho hyaho kṛtvā mahāścaryayutāni vai ।
vedho'patyāni tatraiva nṛtyaṃ cakruśca gāyanam ।।78।।
pupūjurdundubhiśreṣṭhamarthayāmāsurādarāt ।
vayaṃ tatrā''gamiṣyāmo yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।79।।
tvayā tasmai kathitavyamasmākaṃ vratapūjanam ।
vrataṃ kurmo vayaṃ tvadyā'ṣṭamyāmupoṣaṇānvitam ।।80 ।।
pūjanaṃ tvakṣareśasya golokeśasya cāpi vai ।
vaikuṇṭheśasya vai kurmo yena sarvatra no gatiḥ ।।8 1।।
dundubhīśaḥ satkṛtastairnītvā vedho gṛhāntare ।
yathā nārāyaṇaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvaistaiḥ pūjitastathā ।।82।।
śṛṃgāritaḥ sevitaśca vibhūṣābhiralaṃkṛtaḥ ।
bhojito marditaścaiva dakṣiṇābhiralaṃkṛtaḥ ।।83।।
pādasaṃvāhito dehe mardito viśramīkṛtaḥ ।
svāpitaśca kṣaṇaṃ paścād bodhitaḥ saṃvisarjitaḥ ।।84।।
sevayā'tiprasannaḥ sa parāvṛtya punaḥ punaḥ ।
dundubhiprabhṛtīn prāha kurvantu vratamādarāt ।।85।।
brahmāṇḍe ghoṣaṇāṃ kṛtvā sāyamāgatya cātra vai ।
militvā bhavataḥ paścād yāsye vaikuṇṭhameva ha ।।86।।
ityuktvā dundubhiśreṣṭho lokān bodhayituṃ yayau ।
dundubhiprabhṛtayaśca prātarmadhyāhnake niśi ।।87।।
snānaṃ kṛtvā triṣavaṇaṃ trikālaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasyāpi rādhākṛṣṇasya vastubhiḥ ।।88।।
akṣarādhipateścāpi divyaiḥ ṣoḍaśakottamaiḥ ।
dugdhapākādibhirdevān bhojayitvā tato mudā ।।89।।
nirṇayaṃ sma prakurvanti bhagavanmūrtisannidhau ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabrahmeśvarāḥ śṛṇvantu nirṇayam ।।90 ।।
bhagavatsadane'smābhiḥ sthātavyaṃ sarvadā dhruvam ।
pūjāyāṃ ca prasevāyāṃ sarvasṛṣṭau hareḥ puraḥ ।।91 ।।
yathāsvābhilaṣitaṃ sa rakṣatvasmān svasannidhau ।
sevāmuktiḥ sadā'smābhirgrahītavyā nahītarā ।।92।।
dāsyaṃ vai sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tat kiṃ na rocayāmahe ।
niyojanaṃ harirvinimayaṃ svāmī karotu naḥ ।।9 3 ।।
iti te prārthanāṃ kṛtvā savādyanṛtyagāyanam ।
kurvanti sma navaivaivaṃ hāvabhāvasvarānvitam ।।94।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabrahmādhipāstuṣṭā dayālavaḥ ।
puruṣottamamāso'pi tatra paśyati bhāvanām ।।95।।
tāvattatra samāyāto dundubhīśo harerniśi ।
dṛṣṭavantaḥ śrutavanto bhaktiṃ sarvātiśāyinīm ।।96।।
navānāṃ vedhaso'patyānāṃ parapremayuñjatām ।
prasannāścātituṣṭāśca sarve te parameśvarāḥ ।।97।।
sākṣād divyasurūpāste prādurbabhūvurantike ।
sarve divyakirīṭāste divyamālādyalaṃkṛtāḥ ।।98।।
koṭividyullatātulyalakṣmīrādhāprabhāyutāḥ ।
divyāmbaradharāḥ chatricāmaribhiḥ susevitāḥ ।।99।।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyasaundaryamṛdutānvitāḥ ।
divyaiśvaryamahāvīryā''nandasaṃbhṛtamūrtayaḥ ।। 10 0।।
prasannavadanāḥ procuḥ kimapatyāni ceṣyate ।
yuṣmadbhaktyā dundubhīśapūjanena ca sevayā ।। 101 ।।
atituṣṭāḥ sma putrā vo yadiṣṭaṃ brūta tacca naḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā tato'patyānyatihṛṣṭāni vedhasaḥ ।। 102।।
prāhuryuṣmadgṛhāṇyasmānnayata śrīpareśvarāḥ ।
niyojayata sevāyāṃ pādayorvaḥ susannidhau ।। 1 03।।
pratigṛhaṃ pratilokaṃ yuṣmākaṃ bhavanaṃ ca yat ।
tatra tatra sadā sevāṃ kariṣyāmo navaiva ha ।। 104।।
vayaṃ samaprajanmānaḥ svasāro bhrātarastathā ।
parasparaṃ tato'smākaṃ viyogo mā bhavet kvacit ।। 1 05।।
yatra yuṣmatsu sevāyāṃ rakṣantvasmān divāniśam ।
tatrā'smān saṃhatāneva rakṣantu parameśvarāḥ ।। 1 06।।
yuṣmatsevāṃ parāṃ muktiṃ labdhvā syāmaḥ sukhālayāḥ ।
vijñāpitaṃ yadasmābhistadāvahata yanmatam ।। 1 07।।
vayaṃ tu kiṃkarā dāsā dāsye tuṣṭā na cā'rthane ।
svāmī tuṣṭo yathā syāttatkartavyaṃ. kiṃkarasya vai ।। 1 08।।
iti teṣāṃ bhāvagarbhaṃ śrutvā te parameśvarāḥ ।
papracchurdundubhīśaṃ kimebhyo deyaṃ vadā''jñayā ।। 1 09।।
mahādundubhirāhā'tra dāyādāḥ sulabhā nanu ।
kiṃkarā dāsavargāśca loke sarvatra durlabhāḥ ।। 11 0।।
dāsavargāya sarvasvaṃ svāmino bhavati dhruvam ।
etādṛśebhyo dāsebhyaḥ kiṃ kiṃ deyaṃ na vidyate ।। 111 ।।
deyaścā'kṣaraloko vai deyo goloka ityapi ।
deyo vaikuṇṭha evāpi dhāmānyanyāni yānyapi ।। 1 12।।
mandirāṇi tathānyāni brahmāṇḍeṣu bhavanti ca ।
yatra yatra tu vo mūrtiravatārādimūrtayaḥ ।। 1 13।।
tatra tatra tu sarvatra vāsa ebhyaḥ pradīyatām ।
mayāpi saha vastavyaṃ hyete bhaktā hi mādṛśāḥ ।। 1 14। ।
eṣāṃ rūpāṇyasaṃkhyāni bhavantu bhavatāṃ yathā ।
bhavadbhiḥ saha tiṣṭhantu jayagāyananartanaiḥ ।। 1 15। ।
ārārtrike ca pūjāyāṃ bhrāmaṇairutsaveṣu ca ।
ghoṣaṇairarghyadānena sugandhādyarpaṇena ca ।। 1 16।।
sāyaṃ prātastu pūjāyāṃ pratyeke mandire tu vaḥ ।
nīrājanā nartanaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ karotu sāgnikā ।। 117 ।।
dundubhiḥ paṭahātmā'yaṃ jayadhvānaṃ karotu vai ।
ghaṇṭī hyanujayaṃ tasya karotu vaśca mandire ।। 1 18।।
kāṃsyaṃ karotu mokṣasya ghoṣaṇāṃ sumanoharām ।
nīrājanādivelāyāṃ bhajantāṃ dehino harim ।। 1 19।।
abhajanto nindakāśca nāstikāśca virodhinaḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti yamairdaṇḍyāḥ karotvityapi ghoṣaṇām ।। 120।।
ghaṇṭā karotu gītiṃ ca nṛtyaṃ vai susvarā kare ।
jhallarī gāyanaṃ lokā''hvānaṃ karotu mandire ।। 121 ।।
kambustīrthajalenaiva karotu bhrāmaṇaṃ puraḥ ।
pañcapātraṃ pādajalaṃ rakṣatvarghyaṃ dadātvapi ।। 122।।
dhūpadhraṃ tu sugandhaṃ vai dhūpaṃ karotu mandire ।
dundubhīśastvahaṃ sarvān dūrasthānāhvayāmi ha । । 123 । ।
āgacchantu mahābhāgā darśanārthaṃ hareriha ।
mumukṣavo narā nāryo duṣṭāstu yāntu dūrataḥ ।। । 124 । ।
evaṃ sarve vayaṃ yuktāḥ kariṣyāmaḥ prasevanam ।
vratasyā'sya phalaṃ tvebhyo dadata śrīpareśvarāḥ ।। 125 । ।
kiṃ ca madvat kilaiteṣāṃ brahmākṣare dvihastatā ।
goloke dvibhujatvaṃ vaikuṇṭhe karacatuṣṭayam ।। 1 26।।
tattatsvāmisvarūpaiśca sāmyaṃ bhavatu divyatā ।
asaṃkhyarūpadhāritvaṃ syādeṣā pratimandiram । । 127 ।।
yuṣmādṛśaṃ ca pāvitryaṃ satkāryatā bhavādṛśī ।
pūjyatā rakṣyatā cāpi sarvadā'stu bhavādṛśī । । 128 ।।
eṣāṃ nindāprakartāro bhavantu nirayaṃ gatāḥ ।
eṣāṃ nāśaṃ tathā cauryaṃ bhartsanaṃ bhañjanādikam ।। 129 ।।
kariṣyanti janā ye te bhavantu nirayaṃ gatāḥ ।
eṣāṃ tvaṃgapraghāteṣu sandhānādiprakāriṇām ।। 130 ।।
eṣāṃ pratimākartṛṇāṃ pratimādānināṃ tathā ।
pratimāpuṣṭikartṝṇāṃ jīrṇoddhārādikāriṇām ।। 131 ।।
puruṣottamalokasya prāptirbhavatu sevinām ।
etadvādyaninādādīn kurvāṇānāṃ tu dehinām ।। 132।।
bhagavaddhāmasamprāptirbhavatviti vṛṇe hyaham ।
mahādundubhinā dundubhyādikṛte tathā'rthitam ।। 133 ।
bhagavadbhiśca tatraiva tathāstviti samarpitam ।
navā'patyāni cā''kṛṣya saṃśliṣya parameśvarāḥ ।। 1 34।।
datvā divyasvarūpāṇi caturdvihastakāni vai ।
niṣādya vāhane naije ninyurdhāma svakaṃ svakam ।। 135 । ।
nīrājanā tathā ghaṇṭā jhallarī divyarūpiṇī ।
tatra lakṣmīsamā jātā harisevāparāyaṇā ।। 136 ।।
anyatra tu yathāpekṣākṛtayastā virejire ।
kamburghaṇṭo dundubhiśca kāṃsyaṃ ca pañcapātrakam । । 137 ।।
dhūpadhra ceti ṣaṭ saumyā divyarūpadharāḥ prabhoḥ ।
muktarūpāśca sevāyāṃ samavartanta dhāmasu ।। 138 ।।
anyatra tu yathāpekṣākṛtayastā virejire ।
evaṃ lakṣmi! pradivyā vai jātā vidhātṛbālakāḥ ।। 139 ।।
puruṣottamamāsasyā'ṣṭamīvratena vai khalu ।
evaṃ ye vratakartāraste'pi yāsyanti dhāma tat ।। 140 ।।
evaṃ vai malamāse'tra kṛtaṃ svalpaṃ phaled bahu ।
alpādānantyalābho yaḥ kṛpā sā pārameśvarī ।। 141 ।।
yāvajjīviṣyati brahmā yāvat sthāsyati medinī ।
tāvat dundubhighaṇṭādyāḥ sthāsyantyacyutamandire ।। 142 ।।
muktau tu sarvadā divyāḥ sthāsyanti keśavālaye ।
tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ naitādṛk syāt pravarṣaṇam । । 143। ।
brahmā vicāramakarot putrā me muktatāṃ gatāḥ ।
athānyānutpādayeyaṃ gṛhaṃ śūnya na me bhavet ।। 144। ।
yogeśvarāḥ sanakādyāḥ ṛṣayaścāpi mānasāḥ ।
utpāditā brahmaṇā hi tato vai brahmavādinaḥ । । 145। ।
evaṃ sṛṣṭiprakartāraścānye'pi prakaṭīkṛtāḥ ।
śānto'bhavatprajā vīkṣya pravāho'pyabhavattathā ।। 146 । ।
etadākhyānakaṃ ye vai śroṣyanti mānavādayaḥ ।
paṭhiṣyanti ca te'ṣṭamyāḥ phalaṃ prāpsyanti vai dhruvam । । 147। ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye brahmaṇo mānasānāṃ dundubhighaṇṭakambunāmnāṃ putrāṇāṃ ghaṇṭānīrājanājhallaryākhyānāṃ putrīṇāṃ kāṃsyapaṃcapātradhūpadhrākhyānāmapatyānāṃ ca mahādundubhighoṣaṇāśravaṇottaramaṣṭamyāṃ adhikamāse vratakaraṇenā'kṣareśagolokeśa vaikuṇṭheśadarśanaṃ, tattaddhāmasu sṛṣṭiṣu ca prati-mandiramanekarūpaiḥ sthāpanaṃ muktirāśīrvādāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 1.300 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 300 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 301
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 302 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! puruṣottamayoginī ।
puruṣottamamāsasya kathā divyā'ghanāśinī ॥ 1 ॥
parabrahmasakāśāttu vāsudevo vyajāyata ।
vāsudevāt samabhavad bhūmākhyaḥ puruṣo'graṇīḥ ॥ 2 ॥
bhūmno'bhavad virāḍasya mukhādagnirajāyata ।
agnerapatyaṃ lokeṣu hiraṇyaṃ viśrutaṃ triṣu ॥ 3 ॥
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe na vai kaścidagneḥ satkāramācarat ।
atyuṣṇatvād dāhakatvāt kṛṣṇavartmakṛtestathā ॥ 4 ॥
āśrayāpayiturbhasmīkaraṇaprakṛtestathā ।
agnimetādṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmādyā api bāndhavāḥ ॥ 5 ॥
bhayaṃ prāptā na satkāraṃ sahavāsaṃ carantyapi ।
bhojane tūtsave pāne dūraṃ kurvanti cā'nalam ॥ 6 ॥
trailokye nā''pa sa kvāpi viśrāntiṃ bhojanādikam ।
sarvadigbhyaḥ sarvadehibhyastiraskāramāpya saḥ ॥ 7 ॥
kebhyaścittu sthalebhyaḥ sa prāptavāँstāḍanādikam ।
ato jvālādikaṃ tūṣṇaguṇaṃ jihvā nigūhya ca ॥ 8 ॥
anyairalakṣito vahnirlokālokācalaṃ yayau ।
kṣudhitaḥ śikharaṃ lokālokācalasya jagdhavān ॥ 9 ॥
udare pacyamānaṃ tad putrarūpaṃ vyajāyata ।
hiraṇyaṃ tattu saṃjātaṃ kāṃcanī bhūmikā tu sā ॥ 10 ॥
lokā'lokācalapārśve prakāśitā vyajāyata ।
evaṃ sa parvate pradakṣiṇāṃ kurvan prayāti vai ॥ 1 1॥
bhavati kṣudhito yatra śṛṃgaṃ tatrā'tti pārvatam ।
pacamānaṃ tu tatputrarūpeṇa jāyate tataḥ ॥ 12॥
evaṃ putrāḥ suvarṇāni samajāyanta sarvataḥ ।
sarvatra kāñcanī bhūmirlokālokācalaṃ tvanu ॥ 13॥
sañjātā vartulākārā paścāt śṛṃgaṃ mahattamam ।
brahmāṇḍasadṛśaṃ bhakṣayitvā pṛthvyāṃ samantare ॥ 14॥
madhyadeśe yayau divyānalastatrā'śramat kṣaṇam ।
pacyamānaṃ mahacchraṃgaṃ putrarūpaṃ vyajāyata ॥ 15॥
suvarṇe tanmahāmerau vyāptaṃ cā'bhūt samantataḥ ।
merustasmāt suvarṇasya prakhyātimagamattataḥ ॥ 16॥
jaḍaṃ sugandhahīnaṃ ca khanigrāvātmakaṃ guru ।
yatra yatra patitaṃ tat tatra tatraiva saṃsthitam ॥ 17॥
vahneriva suvarṇasyāpi na mānaṃ kṛtaṃ janaiḥ ।
kalpavṛkṣajavastvādyairnirvahanti hi dehinaḥ ॥ 18॥
kiṃ suvarṇaṃ ca kau vahnirityevaṃ nā'bhavaddhi dhīḥ ।
kiṃ kāyaṃ vai suvarṇasya kiṃ kāryaṃ cā'nalasya vai ॥ 19॥
apyevaṃ nā'bhavatprajñā kalpavṛkṣabalāttadā ।
suvarṇaṃ cā'nalaścobhau mūlyahīnau śuśūcatuḥ ॥20 ॥
athātra khalu nāsmākaṃ brahmāṇḍesti parīkṣakaḥ ।
vinā prayojanaṃ naiva mūlyaṃ kasyāpi jāyate ॥21 ॥
tṛṇaṃ prāpte'pi samaye koṭisvarṇasamaṃ bhavet ।
agnirvai śaityakalahe bahumūlyo'bhijāyate ॥22॥
tyaktaṃ mayūrapicchaṃ tu goloke kṛṣṇasaṃdhṛtam ।
svasyaiva makuṭe tena pūjyatāṃ mūlyatāṃ gatam ॥23॥
brahmaṇā vidhṛtaṃ gaṃgājalaṃ purā kamaṇḍalau ।
visṛṣṭaṃ mūlyavajjātaṃ mahadbhūtaṃ hi mūlyavat ॥24॥
kaṃkaraḥ khalu kṛṣṇena dhṛto vakṣasi mūlyavāna।
na dhṛtaḥ kardamaḥ kaiścinmūlyaṃ nāpto manāgapi ॥25॥
tasmādahaṃ mahānagnirmama putraḥ suvarṇakam ।
vinā prayojanaṃ yadvā mahadbhiḥ saṃdhṛtiṃ vinā ॥26॥
mūlyavantau na vai syāva duḥkhaṃ tadvai mahattamam ।
guṇināṃ gaṇanāraṃbhe yadyaṃgulirna tiṣṭhati ॥27॥
varaṃ tasyātra mṛtyurvai prāṇanaṃ kleśadaṃ vṛthā ।
vidyā vā rājyasattā vā siddhiraiśvaryameva vā ॥28॥
khyātirvā dhanitā vāpi bhaktirvā jīvane varam ।
tadvihīnena martavyaṃ mariṣyāvastato'dya vai ॥29॥
iti vicārya vahnistatputro yayaturuccakaiḥ ।
merostu śikhare tasmātpātena maraṇārthinau ॥3 0॥
tāvat tatra satyaloke ghoṣayan dundubhirhareḥ ।
tābhyāṃ śruto'dhike māse śokaṃ kurvantu mā janāḥ ॥3 1॥
nārāyaṇaṃ tu saṃsmṛtya navamyāmadya ye janāḥ ।
kariṣyanti vrataṃ pūjāṃ teṣāmiṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥32॥
ekabhuktena naktena tathaivā'yācitena vā ।
phalena payasā tvadya dvikālaṃ tvaikakālikam ॥33॥
vrataṃ kṛtvā'rcanaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya śaraṇāgatāḥ ।
api cette mānahīnā daridrā niṣprayojanāḥ ॥34॥
gaṇanāhīnakāścāpi yāsyanti cottamaṃ padam ।
ahaṃ vai dundubhirvacmi puruṣottamadeśanām ॥35॥
duḥkho vā kleśasandṛbdho'titiraskṛta eva vā ।
asthāno vā'lpamūlyo vā jaḍo vā tūgra eva vā ॥36॥
yaḥ kaściccharaṇaṃ prāpyā'dhikamāse vrataṃ caret ।
vidhūya tasya duḥkhāni kariṣyāmyavanaṃ sadā ॥ 37॥
puruṣottamamāsasya mānakṛnmānya eva me ।
puruṣottamamāse vai puṇyakṛtpūtatāṃ vrajet ॥38 ॥
mamā'rcanaprakartā'tra sarvā'rcyatāmavāpnuyāt ।
yasya vai rakṣitā ko'pi bhavatyeva na vai kvacit ॥39॥
cet sa rakṣatyadhimāsaṃ tathā māṃ puruṣottamam ।
rakṣayiṣye tu tamahaṃ vadāmi puruṣottamaḥ ॥40॥
pūjayantu ca māṃ bhaktyā bhojayantu supāyasam ।
prārthayantu yatheṣṭaṃ ca matto gṛhṇantvabhīṣṭakam ॥41॥
anugraheṇa dātāsmi tvakṛtasyāpi ceṣṭadaḥ ।
alpasya bahudaścāpi gṛhṇantu puruṣottamāt ॥42॥
adya ye na kariṣyanti vrataṃ vā varaṇaṃ ca vā ।
teṣāṃ hāniralābhaśca nānyaḥ kaścidato'dhikaḥ ॥43॥
tasmādāyāntu gṛhṇantu varān kuvantu pūjanam ।
ācarantu malamāse navamyāṃ vratamuttamam ॥44॥
pradātā'smi samṛddho'smi samudāro'smi sarvathā ।
dundubhiḥ pravadāmyatra nārāyaṇāntarātmakaḥ ॥45॥
nārāyaṇasvarūpo'haṃ puruṣottamadeśanaḥ ।
prasannaṃ dāsabhaktaṃ vā karomi puruṣottamam ॥46 ॥
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo mayi sanniyokṣyate ।
ahaṃ tasminniyokṣyāmi śreṣṭhaṃ ratnādikaṃ punaḥ ॥47॥
bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ tathā lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ yo me'rpayiṣyati ।
tasmai koṭiguṇitaṃ tadarpayiṣye'pyahaṃ tathā ॥48॥
yasya draṣṭā''śrayadātā poṣṭā mānayitā'vitā ।
ko'pi nāsti tu tasyā'haṃ sarvakartā'vitā'smi vai ॥49॥
āgacchantu mahābhāgāḥ satkṛtā vā'pyasatkṛtāḥ ।
bālā vā bālikā vāpi yuvatyaḥ sadhavā'dhavāḥ ॥50॥
yuvāno bhāgyavanto vā bhāgyahīnā daridrakāḥ ।
vṛddhā palitavalyaṃgāḥ sucittā vā'pyacittakāḥ ॥51 ॥
tṛtīyaprakṛtivyāptā nāmasaṃjñāvihīnakāḥ ।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ ke'pi jaḍā vā jaḍasannibhāḥ ॥5 2 ॥
tiryañco'pi vivarasthā gartasthāḥ khanikhātajāḥ ।
mukhajāḥ pṛṣṭhajāścāpi malajā amalodbhavāḥ ॥5 3 ॥
malamāsaṃ samāśritya toṣayitvā pumuttamam ।
pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ yāntu yāntu vā'kṣaradhāma tat ॥54॥
svarge sukhaṃ paraṃ yāntu yāntu śrīpuruṣottamam ।
sutaṃ yāntu patiṃ yāntu patnīṃ yāntu ca padminīm ॥55॥
gṛhaṃ kīrtiṃ dhanaṃ yāntu yāntu śāśvatapūjanam ।
sarvādhikyottamasthānaṃ gṛhṇantvanugrahānmama ॥56॥
ityudārāṃ ghoṣaṇāṃ saṃśrutvā'gniśca suvarṇakam ।
lebhāte sma mahādhairyaṃ śokaṃ tatyajatustataḥ ॥57॥
meroḥ śṛṃge satyaloke dundubhiṃ śaraṇaṃ gatau ।
natvā ca dundubhiṃ tasya pūjāṃ cakraturādarāt ॥58॥
vahninā tu sutaṃ svarṇaṃ dundubhestasya pādayoḥ ।
akārayannatiṃ tāvad dṛṣṭvā rūpottaraṃ sutam ॥59॥
dundubhinā samuttolya gṛhītvā karayonije ।
mastake ca tathā skandhe kṣaṇaṃ suvarṇako dhṛtaḥ ॥60 ॥
arpito vahnaye paścād vahniḥ prāha sagadgadaḥ ।
nāvayoḥ rakṣitā ko'pi satkartā'pi na vidyate ॥6 1॥
mahadduḥkhamanubhūya mṛtyvarthaṃ tvāgatāvubhau ।
dundubhe yadi te vākyād vrataṃ kurvo'dya naktakam ॥62॥
pūjanaṃ ca hareḥ kurvo rakṣitā cedbhaveddhariḥ ।
evaṃ saṃvadatornetrādaśravo nyapatan bhuvi ॥63॥
rajataṃ tatsamutpannaṃ sthale sthalyāṃ samujjvalam ।
vīkṣyaivaṃ bhagnahṛdayaṃ dayamānaṃ mahānalam ॥64॥
saputraṃ dundubhistaṃ cā''śvāsayāmāsa sadgirā ।
navamyāṃ adhimāsasya vrataṃ kuruta naktakam ॥65 ॥
pūjāṃ kuruta vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cādya ha ।
sauvarṇīṃ pratimāṃ kārayitvā nārāyaṇasya ca ॥66॥
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya samarcyā'kṣatacandanaiḥ ।
vibhūṣya svarṇabhūṣābhirhārairmālābhirityapi ॥ 67॥
sadratnairambarairdravyairvibhinnairbhojanaiḥ phalaiḥ ।
jalaistāmbūlapānaiśca dhūpadīpapradakṣiṇaiḥ ॥68 ॥
toṣayitvā'rthayed devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
asatkṛtamanādhāramanādṛtamanāśrayam ॥ 69 ॥
kṣudhitaṃ tṛṣitaṃ dveṣyaṃ dāhakaṃ māṃ samuddhara ।
jaḍaṃ nirgandhamatiṃ vai guruṃ prastararūkṣakam ॥7 0 ॥
nirguṇaṃ cetanāhīnaṃ vā'kiñcitkaramityapi ।
samuddhara kṛpāsindho gaṇanāṃ prāpaya prabho ॥7 1 ॥
evaṃ stutiṃ prakuryācca śrīphalārghyaṃ samarpayet ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca natvā nāthaṃ visarjayet ॥72 ॥
madhyāhne'pi tathā kuryāt kuryānniśīthake tathā ।
savādyanartanagītairnīrājayedvisarjayet ॥7 3 ॥
evaṃ kuru kṛśāno tvaṃ hāṭaka tvaṃ tathā kuru ।
nārāyaṇaḥ prasannaḥ san yuvāmuddhārayiṣyati ॥74॥
ityāśrutya mahādundubhyuktaṃ nārāyaṇoditam ।
vahniścakāra sauvarṇīṃ mūrtiṃ nārāyaṇasya vai ॥75॥
lakṣmyā mūrtiṃ cakārā'tha pūjayāmāsatuśca tau ।
pitā putraśca vidhivad vrataṃ nakta pracakratuḥ ॥76॥
rātrau prārthayato yāvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
lakṣmīsamanvitaṃ tāvat prādurbabhūva cāgrataḥ ॥77 ॥
tejaḥparidhi saṃvyāptānanaṃ lakṣmīprasevitam ।
mandaṃ mandaṃ hasantaṃ taṃ vilokya puruṣottamam ॥78 ॥
vahnisvarṇau prārthayataḥ kṛpānātha samuddhara ।
ūṣṇasvabhāvayuktasya dāhakasya mama sthalam ॥79॥
nāsti kutrāpi tannātha dehi me bhojanaṃ tathā ।
mūlyaṃ mūrkhasya putrasya suvarṇasya tu nāsti vai ॥8 0 ॥
prastarasya na satkāro dṛśyate tadyaśaḥ kuru ।
sarvadā tava sevāṃ ca pradehi bhagavan vibho ॥8 1 ॥
śaraṇe te'smi patito māmuddhara saputrakam ।
ityarthito harikṛṣṇo vahniṃ prāha narāyaṇaḥ ॥82 ॥
śokaṃ tyaja kṛśāno tvaṃ tuṣṭo'smi tvadvratena vai ।
mamā''nanāt samutpannaḥ sadā tvastu mamānanam ॥8 3 ॥
varaṃ dadāmyahaṃ putra yajñādau bhojanaṃ tvayi ।
sthāpayiṣyanti ye hoṣyantyanale kuṇḍamadhyage ॥84॥
agnihotrasya havanaṃ tvayi nyasyanti ye janāḥ ।
tvaddvārā tanmayā sarvaṃ jakṣitavyaṃ na cā'nyathā ॥85॥
vahni vinā janā ye me dāsyanti bhojanādikam ।
tadahaṃ na grahīṣyāmi sarvathā'nugrahāt tvayi ॥86॥
adyadinādahaṃ loke'gnimukho bhagavāniti ।
khyātiṃ yāsye janāstena madarthe bhojanādikam ॥87॥
tvayi kṣepsyanti tatsarvaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi tvanmukhāt ।
śamīṣvadṛśyarūpeṇa tava vāso viśeṣataḥ ॥88॥
hīrakādiṣu tadvacca sarvatrā'stu tavā''śrayaḥ ।
yathā vastupradahanaṃ na syādvāsastathā tava ॥89॥
sarvatrā'stu kṛśāno tvaṃ sukhī bhava janādiṣu ।
sammānaṃ sarvathā te'stu satkāraḥ sarvathā tava ॥90 ॥
kalpavṛkṣalaye kāle cūlyādau pācanāya vai ।
prajvālanaṃ tavaivā'stu sarvathaiva gṛhe gṛhe ॥9 1॥
cintāmaṇyādi nāśe tu pradīpasya gṛhe gṛhe ।
sammānaṃ sarvathā te syād dhairyamāvaha tāvatā ॥92॥
dvitīyena ca divyena rūpeṇa pārṣadena me ।
dhāmni sevāṃ vaha nityaṃ vahne mukto'si me'nagha ॥93॥
prathame yugaparyāye vyatīte tvanalaṃ vinā ।
kāryaṃ kimapi sarveṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na vai tadā ॥94॥
tava mūlyaṃ ca sammānaṃ satkārādarapūjanam ।
parākāṣṭhāgataṃ sarve bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥95॥
suvarṇo'yaṃ ca te putro mamā'tivallabhaḥ khalu ।
adyārabhya mayā svasya mastake dhārya eva ca ॥96॥
mukuṭo'yaṃ tu me hyastu bhavatāṃ kuṇḍale mama ।
mama bhūṣāsvarūpo'stu śṛṃkhalākaṭakormikāḥ ॥97॥
raśanāhārapātrāṇi svarṇo'stu sarvavastukaḥ ।
mayā dhṛtastava putro mastake mukuṭātmakaḥ ॥98॥
so'tha sarvatra satkāraṃ yāsyati kālanirgame ।
samūlyaśca sugūhyaśca saṃrakṣyaśca bhaviṣyati ॥99॥
kalpavṛkṣādivilaye kalpadruḥ sa bhaviṣyati ।
kiñca divyaṃ svarūpaṃ vai suvarṇāya dadāmi ha ॥ 100 ॥
mūlarūpeṇa me dhāmni seviṣyate sa māṃ sadā ।
hāṭakākhyaḥ pārṣado me'kṣare dhāmni nivatsyati ॥ 101 ॥
atha kālāntare kāryāvaśyakatve'nalātmakaḥ ।
mahātejomayaḥ so'yaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ ॥ 10 2॥
pātāle ca pṛthivyāṃ ca mahādevo bhaviṣyati ।
mamā'vatāraḥ sarvatra pūjāṃ prāpsyati madbalāt ॥ 10 3॥
bhaktānāṃ muktidātā ca bhaviṣyati maheśvaraḥ ।
sarvabrahmāṇḍasṛṣṭau ca khyātiṃ tvamiva yāsyati ॥ 1 04॥
yathāhaṃ bhagavān vyāptastathā vahniḥ suvarṇakam ।
vyāptiṃ yāsyati sṛṣṭau me satkāraṃ ca prayāsyati ॥ 1 05॥
rakṣaṇaṃ cāpi saṃsthānaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati dhruvam ।
ityuktvā ca tayordivye rūpe kṛtvā hariḥ svayam ॥ 1 06॥
nināya svālayaṃ cānye rūpe vastuṣu vāsite ।
etadrūpaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ parijñāya surādayaḥ ॥ 1 07॥
vahnidvārā bhakṣayanti tṛpyanti tatra bhojanāt ।
suvarṇasya vibhūṣāśca dhārayanti sthale sthale ॥ 108 ॥
evaṃ vahnistathā svarṇo navamīpūjanaṃ vratam ।
kṛtvā muktau praśastau saṃmūlyakau ca babhūvatuḥ ॥ 10 9॥
pāvitryaṃ sarvadā prāptau yatra kvāpi gatau hi tau ।
vṛddhiṃ ca sarvadā prāptau tathā sukhaṃ tu śāśvatam ॥ 110 ॥
navamyāstu vratākhyānaṃ paṭhiṣyanti tu ye janāḥ ।
śroṣyanti vā narā nāryo yāsyanti bhuktimokṣaṇe ॥ 111 ॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye virāṭaputrasya vahnestatputrasuvarṇasya ca dāhakatvajaḍatvādidoṣānvitasya kalpavṛkṣāśritajanatābhiranādare kṛte merau maraṇonmukhasya dundubhiśravaṇe'dhimāsa- navamīvratapūjanakaraṇena yajñādau sarvamānyatābhagavanmukhatā bhagavadābhūṣaṇarūpatā dhāmaprāptirdivyapārṣadatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥1.301 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 301 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 302
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 303 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
athāpi te kathāṃ lakṣmi! kathayāmi surañjanīm ।
adhimāse hareścānugrahā'nto naiva vidyate ॥ 1 ॥
navamyāṃ tu niśi pṛṣṭaṃ dundubhaye tu śārṅgiṇā ।
uddhoṣyate nu sarvatra kiṃ vā kvacitkvacitsthale ॥ 2 ॥
dundubhiḥ prāha sarvatra yāṃ diśāmabhilakṣya tu ।
prātaḥkālād ghoṣayāmi sāyaṃkālāvadhiṃ prabho ॥ 3 ॥
bahavaḥ khalu kurvanti dehino vratamatra vai ।
kṛpālābhaṃ ca gṛhṇanti bhuktiṃ muktiṃ manāk kṛtāt ॥ 4 ॥
tāvat tatra samāyātā pṛthvī samprārthanāya vai ।
bhagavan devadeveśa vaikuṇṭhanātha mādhava ॥ 5 ॥
asaṃkhyaprāṇināṃ mokṣo'dhimāse sāmprataṃ tvayā ।
vidhīyate'tikṛpayā tato'haṃ sukhinī bhṛśam ॥ 6 ॥
mamāpi devadevasya vrataṃ kāryaṃ samādarāt ।
puruṣottamamāsasya vratināṃ saṃpramokṣaṇam ॥ 7 ॥
svargayogastava yogo dhanadhānyādisampadaḥ ।
putrapautrayaśolābhā yadyadiṣṭaṃ bhavecca tat ॥ 8 ॥
kṛpayā dīyataṃ sarve gataṃ vaikuṇṭhatulyatām ।
ahaṃ tu dhanyabhāgyā'smi dundubhistava yanmayi ॥ 9 ॥
muktakaṇṭhena sarvebhyo vijñāpayatyudāratām ।
adhimāse kṛpā yā ca kṛtā tvayā dayālunā ॥ 10 ॥
mayi saiva kṛpā jātā jīvā yatpuṇyabhāginaḥ ।
pāpahīnāḥ pavitrāśca bhaviṣyanti sadā mayi ॥ 11 ॥
pāpabhāreṇa bhagavan kadāpi pīḍitā nahi ।
bhaviṣyāmi bhavadbhaktabāhulyātpuṇyaśālinī ॥ 12॥
sārdhadvayā'bdādhimāse'pyekā'haṃ ca vrataṃ tava ।
kariṣyanti janā ye ye te sarve dhūtapāpakāḥ ॥ 1 3 ॥
anyoddhārasamarthāśca bhaviṣyanti sadā mayi ।
ityahaṃ bahu tuṣṭā'smi bhāvisvāsthyapralābhataḥ ॥ 14॥
asajjanānāṃ bhāreṇa bhavāmi pīḍitā prabho ।
asantaśca janāḥ kāle prabhaviṣyanti bhāvini ॥ 15 ॥
brāhmaṇā vedahīnāśca vedamātṛvihīnakāḥ ।
vaidikaiḥ karmabhirhīnā bhārarūpā mayi prabho ॥ 16 ॥
śaucasantoṣahīnāśca tapobhirvarjitāstathā ।
svādhyāyeśapraṇidhānairhīnā bhārātmakā mayi ॥ 17॥
ahiṃsāvratahīnāśca piśunāḥ satyavarjitāḥ ।
asteyavratahīnāśca vyavāyābhiratāstathā ॥ 18॥
tṛṣṇā''vṛtā parasvāpaharā bhārātmakā mayi ।
dayāhīnāḥ śīlahīnāḥ parāvanaticintakāḥ ॥ 1 9॥
mithyākalaṃkavaktāro nindakā dveṣiṇastathā ।
śraiṣṭhyaunnatyāsahā ye te bhārarūpāḥ sadā mayi ॥ 20 ॥
parātmaduḥkhakartāro guṇe doṣā'bhidhāyakāḥ ।
svārthamātraparā viprā bhārarūpā mayi sthitāḥ ॥ 2 1 ॥
snānasandhyāvihīnāśca devapūjādivañcitāḥ ।
ātmaniṣṭhādirahitā jaḍā bhārātmakā mayi ॥22॥
yajñavighnaprakartāro vaiśvadevavināśakāḥ ।
saṃskārabhāvanāhīnā viprā bhārātmakā mayi ॥ 23॥
sūtakānatimantāro hetuvādāśca nāstikāḥ ।
brahmopāsanayā hīnā viprā bhārātmakā mayi ॥24॥
bhaktibhāvavihīnāśca śūnyā adhyātmavidyayā ।
pitṛtarpaṇaśūnyāśca viprā bhārātmakā mayi ॥25॥
paropakārahīnāśca dānapuṇyavivarjitāḥ ।
jihvāśiśnakṛtā'dharmā viprā bhārātmakā mayi ॥26॥
parakaṣṭapradātāraḥ parakāryaprabhañjakāḥ ।
parāparādhakartāro viprā bhārātmakā mayi ॥27॥
ayogye bījadātāro hyayogyakṣetrakarṣukāḥ ।
chaladharmātighātāśca viprā bhārātmakā mayi ॥28॥
prasahya bhoginaḥ krūrāḥ parākrandanahetavaḥ ।
kūṭacārāḥ kṣveḍaguptā madhuvācaḥ pratārakāḥ ॥ 29॥
vārtayā viṣasektāro bhārarūpāḥ sadā mayi ।
viśvāsaghātakā ye ca kṛtaghnā bālaghātakāḥ ॥3 0॥
ajñapraghātakā ye ca śaraṇāgataghātakāḥ ।
kuṭumbaghātakā mātāpitṛnārīpraghātakāḥ ॥31॥
dharmaghnā mokṣaghātāśca bhārarūpā mayi prabho ।
abhakṣyabhakṣakā jātibhraṃśasaṃkarakārakāḥ ॥32॥
stryapatyanāśakā vṛttidhanaprāṇāpahārakāḥ ।
ātatāyikriyāduṣṭā agnidā garadāstathā ॥33॥
māraṇoccāṭanakṛtyā garbhaghātādikāriṇaḥ ।
asthānatāḍane krūrakarmāḍhyā bhārakā mayi ॥34॥
abrāhmaṇā brāhmaṇatve svakartavyavihīnakāḥ ।
parasaukhyavihantāraḥ sadā bhārātmakā mayi ॥35॥
anudyogāḥ sadālasyā parabhāgyopajīvinaḥ ।
dṛptāścaivā'nadhikāre sadā bhārātmakā mayi ॥ 36॥
amārgagā mṛdūnāṃ svabalenā'rdanakārakāḥ ।
adaṇḍye daṇḍakartāraḥ sadā bhārātmakā mayi ॥37॥
pālyānāṃ pālakā ye na pūjyānāṃ pūjakāśca na ।
mānyānāṃ mānakartāro na ye te bhārakā mayi ॥38॥
paśūnāṃ duḥkhakartāraścāśritānāmarakṣakāḥ ।
dāsānāṃ duḥkhakartāro bhārarūpā sadā mayi ॥39॥
śiṣyapratārakāḥ śikṣakāśca śiṣyā vivartinaḥ ।
bhṛtyapratārakā āḍhyā āḍhyaghnāḥ karmacāriṇaḥ ॥40॥
śiṣyāśca guravaścāpi svasvakartavyavarjitāḥ ।
pratārakāstathā'nyonyaṃ sarve bhārātmakā mayi ॥ 41॥
sevakāḥ svāmihantāraḥ svāminaḥ sevakārdanāḥ ।
dāsā dāsatvahīnāśca sarve bhārātmakā mayi ॥42॥
rājā na rakṣako yatra na prajā puṇyakāriṇī ।
śaṭhāḥ prajāsu ye rājñi sarve bhārātmakā mayi ॥43।
atrātā kṣatriyo'dātā vaiśyaḥ śūdro'pyasevakaḥ ।
svasvadharmahanaḥ sarve bhārarūpā mayi prabho ॥44॥
jananyājñākarī yā na putrī snuṣāpi tādṛśī ।
mātā yā hitakartrī na śvaśrūścāpi ca tādṛśī ॥45॥
dampatyoryatra naikyaṃ ca kalahaśca dvayoḥ sadā ।
patisevāghṛṇā patnī patnīduḥkhakaraḥ patiḥ ॥46॥
putrāḥ pitṛnideśe na pitā putravinindakaḥ ।
sevyasevakatāhīnāste sarve bhārakā mayi ॥47॥
brahmacārī brahmacarye yo na tiṣṭhati rāgataḥ ।
gṛhasthastyāgadharmāśca puraskṛtya pravartate ॥48॥
vānaprastho'pi satṛṣṇaḥ sannyāso nyāsavarjitaḥ ।
anyadharmagrahītāraste sarve bhārarūpiṇaḥ ॥49॥
dadhidugdhaghṛtatailarasasāṃkaryakārakāḥ ।
annapatrakaṇaśākapuṣpasāṃkaryakārakāḥ ॥50॥
khādyapeyasusaṃdhāryabhogyasāṃkaryakārakāḥ ।
jīvaghātakarā vaidyāḥ sarve te bhārarūpiṇaḥ ॥51 ॥
madyamāṃsāśanā martyāḥ parapiṇḍopajīvinaḥ ।
vastrabhūṣādisāṃkaryakarā vai bhārarūpiṇaḥ ॥52॥
kūṭapaṇyāḥ kūṭamānāḥ kūṭatulāpramāpinaḥ ।
kūṭasaṃkhyākarā daivajñā api bhārarūpiṇaḥ ॥53॥
vyāpārā''deyadeyādo pratāraṇakarāḥ khalāḥ ।
prasahya luñcakā martyāḥ sadā bhārātmakā mayi ॥54॥
akarmaṭhā vyasaninaḥ śanigrahasamā bhuvi ।
rāhugrāsasamā ye ca sarpadaṃśasamāstathā ॥55॥
cipīṭakāsamā ye ca badrīkaṇṭakarūpiṇaḥ ।
mīnaśyenasamā ye ca bakamārjārakarmakā ॥56॥
bahiḥ śuklā hṛtsu raktāścātmani kṛṣṇakajjalāḥ ।
martyā devā dānavā vā svargyāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ ॥57॥
sarve te bhārarūpā vai pāpakarmāṇa eva te ।
pīḍayeyuśca māṃ kāle yeṣāṃ māhātmyameva na ॥58॥
nā'dhimāsavrataṃ yeṣāṃ na yeṣāṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
na bhaktiścāstikabhāvaste syurbhārātmakā bhuvi ॥5 9॥
tasmānmayā hare kṛṣṇa kāle kāle ca tādṛśām ।
bhāvināṃ bhāranāśāya prārthyate parameśvaraḥ ॥60 ॥
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā teṣāṃ bhāranāśāya keśava ।
yacchreyastatsamabrūhi bhāvimacchreyaicchayā ॥61॥
ityarthayantyāṃ kṣmāyāṃ tāṃ dundubhiḥ prāha medinīm ।
kiṃ tvayā na śrutaṃ pṛthvi mayoddhoṣitamiṣṭadam ॥62॥
adhimāse vrataṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ vai śāśvataṃ bhavet ।
vidhāsyatyavanaṃ te ca bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ॥63॥
idānīṃ śrīhariḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraprabhuḥ ।
prasannaḥ phaladaścāste daśamyāstvaṃ vrataṃ kuru ॥64॥
vratānte bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ dāsyati darśanam ।
kariṣyatyavanaṃ te ca sarvakāleṣu bhārataḥ ॥65॥
idānīṃ yāhi deveśi satyaloke sthitiṃ kuru ।
vrataṃ daśamyāstatraivādhimāsasyā'dhivartaya ॥66॥
vratānte yadi devaste darśana na dadāti cet ।
śvaḥ sāyaṃ vai tvayā tvatrā''gantavyaṃ cārthanāya vai ॥67॥
ityuktā dundubhinaiva natvā devaṃ prabhuṃ tathā ।
dundubhiṃ ca namaskṛtya satyalokaṃ samāyayau ॥68॥
svanivāse pṛthivyā ca daśamyāśca vrataṃ kṛtam ।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā kṛtvā mūrtiṃ tu kānakīm ॥69॥
pañcāmṛtairhariṃ prārcya snapayitvā jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
sugandhacandanādyaiśca carcayitvā'tibhāvataḥ ॥70॥
vastraiḥ svarṇairvibhūṣābhiḥ kuṃkumā'kṣatasaddalaiḥ ।
tulasīmaṃjarībhiśca kamalairdhūpadīpakaiḥ ॥71 ॥
pūjayitvā sunaivedyaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ haraye dadau ।
jalaṃ tāmbūlamiṣṭeṣṭaṃ phalaṃ cārghyaṃ dadau tataḥ ॥72॥
nīrājayitvā kusumāṃjaliṃ namaḥ stutiṃ tathā ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ cārpayitvā ca tataḥ kṣitiḥ ॥73॥
vavande paramātmānaṃ vrataṃ vai daśamīkṛtam ।
adhimāsasya sampūrṇe sanaktaṃ bhavatānmama ॥74॥
prātarevaṃ pūjayitvā pupūja praharadvaye ।
bhojayitvā yathāpekṣaṃ tvarpayitvā'tha śārṅgiṇe ॥75॥
sāyamevaṃ ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ samapūjayat॥
ārārtrikaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ phalam ॥76॥
dadau kṛṣṇāya kusumāṃjaliṃ satpāyasaṃ dadau ।
tataśca pāyayāmāsa vavande karuṇākaram ॥77॥
sajāgaraṃ nartanaṃ ca gītaṃ cakre'rdharātrikam ।
madhyarātrau hariścā''yāt sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥78॥
vada pṛthvi kimiṣṭaṃ te vratāt tuṣṭo'smi saṃvṛṇu ।
adhimāse vratinastu sarvamiṣṭaṃ karomi vai ॥79॥
iti me'sti vrataṃ tasmāt sulabhaṃ durlabhaṃ tathā ।
yatkiṃcit tat sarvathā'haṃ pūrayiṣye vadā'tra mām ॥80॥
ityuktā sā mahī tatra provāca parameśvaram ।
bhagavan yadi tuṣṭo'si satyavākyakaro'si ca ॥8 1 ॥
sarvaṃ dadāsi cenmahyaṃ sarvo me puruṣottamaḥ ।
vinā necchāmi cānyadvai trātāraṃ puruṣottamam ।82 ॥
ahaṃ sadā tu te nātha sevāyāṃ saṃvasāmi vai ।
tādṛśaṃ me divyarūpaṃ dehi bhūtrāṇakṛt prabho ॥83 ॥
anyacca bhārarūpāṇāṃ vināśāya mahāprabho! ।
adharmā'guṇanāśāya malloke vihara prabho ॥84।
adhimāsaṃ vinā'nyeṣu māseṣu prajayā kṛtam ।
pāpaṃ prajvālayituṃ tvaṃ mayi vāsaṃ prarocaya ॥85॥
yena me sarvadā deva rakṣaṇaṃ syājjanārdana ।
āgaccha divyarūpeṇa bhautikena ca vā prabho ॥86 ॥
bhautikaṃ yadi te varṣma kvacit sviṣṭaṃ susaṃbhavet ।
tadā mātā bhaviṣyāmi pālayiṣyāmi matsutam ॥87॥
lālayiṣyāmi govinda bhojayiṣyāmi bhāvataḥ ।
kariṣyāmi ca te sevāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ dehi cārthitam ॥88 ॥
ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ nanāma puruṣottamam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā pṛthivyā hṛdayodbhavam ॥89॥
divyaṃ rūpaṃ dadau cāsyai vaikuṇṭhe sevanārhaṇam ।
divyā satī surūpā ca caturhastā ramāsamā ॥90 ॥
bhūtvā vasumatī pṛthvī dīvyati smā'tha mādhavaḥ ।
nināya tāṃ vasumatīṃ vaikuṇṭhe salilopari ॥ 91॥
tatra tiṣṭhati nityā sā dāsī bhūtvā'tivaiṣṇavī ।
atha dvitīyaṃ tadrūpaṃ pṛthivyāvaraṇe stare ॥ 92 ॥
pṛthivyā bhavane nityaṃ vāsārhaṃ vidyate sadā ।
sā devī sarvabhūtānāmadhiṣṭhātrī tu bhūrmatā ॥ 93 ॥
nārāyaṇena sā nityaṃ satyalokopari dhruvā।
pṛthivyāvaraṇe sthātumājñaptā tatra vartate ॥ 94 ।
tṛtīyaṃ kāryarūpaṃ yat pārthivaṃ prastarādikam ।
sthalyātmakamidaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ॥95 ॥
tatra pṛthvyāṃ yathā'pekṣaṃ bhāraṃ hartuṃ bhuvo nanu।
hariṇā tu samāgantuṃ pratiśrutaṃ tu vai mṛhuḥ ॥ 96
hariḥ prāha śṛṇu kṣme! tvaṃ prathame yugaparyaye।
vyatīte bhārarūpā vai bhaviṣyanti prajā muhuḥ ।97॥
prathame'pi yuge devakāryārthaṃ tvayi sāmpratam ।
āgamiṣyāmi te bhaktyā varadānena vai muhuḥ ।98॥
avatārān grahīṣyāmi rakṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ।
daśamyāmadhimāsasya vratena toṣito'smyaham ॥99॥
ato yugacatuṣke vai tattatkāryārthameva ha ।
avatārān grahīṣyāmi daśa mukhyāँstato'pi ca ॥ 100 ॥
gauṇānanyāna yathāpekṣaṃ bahūn vai divyavigrahān ।
tena tena svarūpeṇa kariṣyāmi tavā'vanam ॥ 101 ॥
saṃhariṣyāmyadevāँśca nāśayiṣyāmi dānavān ।
daityān vipothayiṣyāmi kariṣyāmi sukhaṃ tava ॥ 10 2 ॥
evaṃ bhāraṃ hariṣyāmi gaccha devi yathāsukham ।
ityābhāṣya haristatra kṣaṇādantaradhīyata ॥ 103 ॥
pṛthvī tuṣṭā'bhavaccāpi dadau puṣpāṃjaliṃ punaḥ ।
vrataṃ samāpya sā devī tato natvā tu dundubhim ॥ 1 04॥
jagāma svālayaṃ pṛthvyāvaraṇe svīyamandiram ।
evaṃ lakṣmi daśamyāḥ sā kṛtvā'dhimāsikaṃ vratam ॥ 10 5॥
nāmnā vasumatī dāsī jātā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī ।
yuge yuge dine cāhni mamā'virbhāvavatyapi ॥ 106 ॥
mayā pratijñayā sarvādhilābhagāminī kṛtā ।
anyāyai na mayaitādṛk lābho'rpitaḥ kadācana ॥ 1 07॥
yadyad vāñchati yaḥ ko'pi svalpenā'pi vratena me ।
tattattasmai pradadāmi nakārastatra nā'sti hi ॥ 108 ॥
yaḥ śroṣyati vasumatīkathāṃ yaśca paṭhiṣyati ।
prāpsyati vratapuṇyaṃ sa daśamyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥ 109 ॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vaikuṇṭhe bhagavantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ prārthanā, bhārarūpāṇāṃ paricayaḥ, daśamīvratena pṛthivī vasumatī bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī jātā, svasyāṃ pratiyuge bhagavadavatārāṇāṃ prākaṭyārthaṃ bhagavatpratijñetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.302 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 302 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 303
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 304 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
adhimāsaikādaśikākathāṃ divyāṃ haripradām ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! samāraṃbhe sṛṣṭerjātā tapomayīm ॥ 1 ॥
brahmaṇo vakṣaso jāto dharmadevaḥ samūrtikaḥ ।
mūrtirdevī tirobhūtā sadā''ste dharmavarṣmaṇi ॥ 2 ॥
sā ca dharme samutpanne sahaivotpadyate'pi sā ।
lokarītyā tu saṃjajñe dakṣaputrīsvarūpiṇī ॥ 3 ॥
punardharmasya sā patnī lokarītyā tu jāyate ।
yadā sā'bhūd dharmadeve hyadṛśyā cāvivāhitā ॥ 4 ॥
tadā lakṣmi! kumārī sā brahmacaryasamanvitā ।
sevate sarvadā bhaktyā svāminaṃ brahmacāriṇam ॥ 5 ॥
satyaloke sthitā vedhogṛhe dharmasahāyinī ।
brahmā jānāti vai sarvaṃ nānye jānanti tāṃ sthitām ॥ 6 ॥
bālā bālasvarūpādvai samārabhyaiva nityaśaḥ ।
snānaṃ pūjāṃ japaṃ homaṃ dhyānaṃ svāmiprasevanam ॥ 7 ॥
karotyeva ca vṛddhebhyo namanaṃ vandanaṃ tathā ।
dayāśāntiprasantoṣā''rjavopakārakādayaḥ ।।8 ॥
satyātimārdavakṛcchraguṇā mūrtau vasanti hi ।
siddhadehā tu sā mūrtistapassu vartate'ti vai ॥ 9 ॥
vṛṣṭau tiṣṭhati varṣāsu śaitye śītajalādiṣu ।
ātape pañcavahnisthā nirāhārā vrateṣu ca ॥ 10 ॥
ārdrāmbarānvitā nityaṃ svarṇadīto gṛhaṃ svakam ।
samāgatya patiṃ natvā karoti kṛṣṇapūjanam ॥ 11 ॥
patiṃ jalādibhiḥ pūrvaṃ snapayitvā samarcya ca ।
dadāti bhojanaṃ cāsmai jalaṃ khādyaṃ phalādikam ॥ 1 2 ॥
svayaṃ tu tulasīpatraiḥ kamalaiḥ pārijātakaiḥ ।
patiṃ nityaṃ pūjayati divyajñānātibhaktitaḥ ॥ 13 ॥
evaṃ prātaḥ sadā snānaṃ devapūjāṃ dhavā'rcanam ।
patisevā bhojanādi kārayitvā vidhāya ca ॥ 14॥
patyurdehe vilīnā sā mūrtirbhavati sarvadā ।
evaṃ nityānuvṛttyā sā premapātrottamottamā ॥ 15 ॥
dharmadevasya vai jātā sukhadā'pi kumārikā ।
dharmadevo'pyanuvṛttisevābhaktyā'titoṣaṇam ॥ 16 ॥
pratyahaṃ samavāpnoti dadātyasyai śubhāśiṣaḥ ।
patisevāparā nityaṃ sukhini mūrtike bhava ॥ 1 7॥
lokarītyā''ptadehena vivāhya sevikā bhava ।
tataḥ saubhāgyasatputrasmṛddhyādisaṃbhṛtā bhava ॥ 18 ॥
nityabhaktiphalarūpaḥ sādhyaste keśavo bhavet ।
hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 19 ॥
ityāśīrvādabhūmiḥ sā mahāpuṇyādhivāsanī ।
adhimāsaikādaśikāprātarutthāya nityavat ॥ 20 ॥
snātuṃ sā svarṇadī yātā tatra śuśrāva dundubhim ।
adyā'styekādaśī devyaḥ puruṣottamamāsagā ॥ 2 1 ॥
asyā vratena santuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
yatheṣṭaṃ dāsyate saukhyamaihikaṃ pāralaukikam ॥ 22 ॥
yad dadāmyadhimāsasya dineṣvanyeṣu vai vratān ।
tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ dāsye phalamekādaśīvrate ॥ 23 ॥
ekādaśīnāmanyāsāṃ vratena yatphalaṃ bhavet ।
tato'rbudaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dāsye hyasyā vratena vai ॥24॥
ahaṃ brahmeśvaraścādhimāsasyāsmyadhidaivataḥ ।
tatrāpyekādaśīnātho'smyahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥25॥
māso'pi puṇyaśca dinaṃ ca puṇyaṃ devo'smi puṇyaśca vrataṃ kṛpāloḥ ।
mamā''jñayā ye'nucaranti bhaktyā tebhyo yatheṣṭaṃ vitarāmi sarvam ॥26 ॥
yathā yathā syānmanasīṣaṇātrayam vratasya kartuśca tathātathā'nvaham ।
parārdhatulyaṃ tu dadāmi tatphalaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca māṃ cāpi ca dhāma māmakam ॥27॥
siṃhāsanaṃ me'pi dadāmi tasmai dadāmi siddhīśca camatkṛtiṃ ca ।
aiśvaryasarvasvamathāpi bhūtiṃ sakaustubhaṃ me mukuṭaṃ ca bhūṣā ॥28॥
yathā'dhimāse kṛpayā pravarṣaye janārthitaṃ pūrayituṃ ca varṣitum ।
tathā na kutrāpi tu naijavāñcchayā pravarṣayiṣye'dhikamāsamantarā ॥29॥
vrataṃ prakurvantu narāḥ striyaśca bālāśca vṛddhāśca sutoṣaṇāya ।
phalaṃ pradāsye mama śāśvataṃ vai padaṃ sudivyaṃ tu parātparaṃ yat ॥ 30 ॥
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāmā'vyākṛtameva vā ।
śvetadvīpaṃ ca vā sauryaṃ tvanye bhaumaṃ tathā'param ॥3 1॥
yadyadicched vrataṃ kṛtvā pradāsyāmi kṛpāvaśaḥ ।
alpāyāse phalānantyaṃ gṛhṇantu vratīno mama ॥ 32॥
nātra yajñāḥ pṛthak kāryā nātra tapyaṃ tapaḥ pṛthak ।
tīrthaṃ nātra pṛthak kāryaṃ hyekāhasya phale hi tat ॥ 33॥
payovrataṃ ca putreṣṭiyajanaṃ neṣyate pṛthak ।
ekādaśyā vratenātra dāsyāmi putramityapi ॥34॥
jyotiṣṭomena yajanaṃ pṛthak sādhyaṃ na veṣyate ।
svargaṃ dadāmi tasmai ya ekādaśyā vrataṃ caret ॥ 35 ॥
na tasya rājasūyena sādhyaṃ kimapi śiṣyate ।
ekādaśīvratenā'tra sārvabhaumaṃ dadāmyaham ॥36॥
agnihotreṇa kiṃ tasya dāsye vairājakaṃ padam ।
ekādaśyāṃ tu me yenārpitaṃ phalajalādikam ॥37॥
śrāddhairvividhakalpaiśca vividhairdevapūjanaiḥ ।
yā tṛptistviṣyate tāṃ vai dāsye caikādaśīvrate ॥38॥
yāṃ muktiṃ yāṃ ca sampattiṃ yāṃ siddhiṃ yogamaiśvaram ।
yadyad vāñcchati yat kṛtvā tad dāsye'tra dine vrate ॥ 3 9॥
yāvajjīvaṃ phalāhārairyat supuṇyaṃ samarjyate ।
tatpuṇyaṃ yāntu vai caikādaśīvratena me janāḥ ॥ 40 ॥
ekabhuktaṃ kṛtaṃ yenā''jīvanaṃ tatphalaṃ tvaham ।
dadāmyadhikamāsaikādaśīvratena meṃ'jasā ॥4 1 ॥
mastake jvaladaṅgārāṅgiṣṭhikāṃ madhyarātrike ।
kāle udūhya yā nārī hyekārdravastrasaṃvṛtā ॥ 42॥
anupānaccaraṇābhyāmasahāyā'pyaraṇyake ।
gatvā kālīṃ prapūjyaiva pratyahaṃ vārṣikaṃ vratam ॥4 3 ॥
ekabhuktaṃ māṣamātrādanaṃ kuryādakhaṇḍitam ।
varṣāyāṃ śītakāle cātapakāle'pi sarvadā ॥44॥
gatvā''pūjya punarāyād gṛhaṃ svaṃ madhyarātrike ।
tato randhitamāṣānnaṃ gṛhṇīyācca jalaṃ sadā ॥45॥
evaṃ kaṣṭataraṃ putraprāptyarthaṃ yanmahadvratam ।
tadvai pṛthaṅ na kartavyamekādaśyā vrate kṛte ॥ 46॥
mahākālīvrataṃ tad yad vārṣikaṃ pratirātrikam ।
yad dadāti phalaṃ putrātmakaṃ tattu vinaśvaram ॥47॥
ekādaśīvrataṃ tvetatputrasvargapramuktidam ।
ekena divasenaiva tadvratādhikapuṇyadam ॥48 ॥
sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ vāyvāhāraṃ vrataṃ tu yat ।
pṛthak tannāsti kartavyaṃ hyekādaśyā vrate kṛte ॥49॥
sahasrakanyakādānaṃ yatra kanyā vibhūṣitāḥ ।
pratyekaṃ svarṇasāhasramudrāśca dakṣiṇāstathā ॥ 5 0 ॥
pratikanyaṃ tu dāsīnāṃ śataṃ svarṇavibhūṣitam ।
pratidāsi ca hastīnāṃ śataṃ tvambālikāyutam ॥ 5 1 ॥
pratihasti turagāṇāṃ śataṃ svarṇavibhūṣitam ।
pratyaśvaṃ govṛṣabhāṇāṃ śataṃ dvandvaṃ rathānvitam ॥ 52॥
rathaṃ rathaṃ prati dogdhrīgavā cāpi śataṃ śatam ।
gāṃ gāṃ prati hyajānāṃ ca śataṃ śataṃ dadettu yaḥ ॥53 ॥
ajāṃ ajāṃ prati vṛttiṃ kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ dadecca yaḥ ।
tasya dātuḥ kurukṣetre phalaṃ sūryagrahe tu yat ॥ 54॥
tasmāllakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dadāmyekādaśīvrate ।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaścāsmi śāśvataḥ puṇyaśevadhiḥ ॥55 ॥
nā'nto'sti mayi puṇyānāṃ gṛhṇantu vṛṣṭivajjanāḥ ।
saṃkalpo me puṇyabhūmirbhaktirme mokṣabhūmikā ॥56 ॥
saṃkalpasya ca bhakteścā'kṣayavārdhirahaṃ hariḥ ।
dadāmyeva dadāmyeva riktatābhayavarjitaḥ ॥57॥
puruṣottamamāsasyaikādaśyāṃ vratakāriṇe ।
sarvaṃ dadāmi conmattatyāgivat kamalāmapi ॥58 ॥
ahaṃ svayaṃ tu māṃ samarpaye kimuta cāparam ।
vṛṇutā'to yatheṣṭaṃ vai vadāmi dundubhirhareḥ ॥59॥
etallābhaṃ na cedīyurnedṛśaḥ śāsyate punaḥ ।
iti śrutvā dundubhiṃ tu puruṣottamaghoṣaṇām ॥60 ॥
cintayāmāsa mūrtiḥ sā janma lagnaṃ sutaṃ harim ।
dundubhīśaṃ samapṛcchannatvā namrā vidhiṃ vrate ॥6 1 ॥
dundubhistu tadā prāha mūrtiṃ tvekādaśīvidhim ।
snātvā brāhme muhūrte ca dhyātvā śrīpuruṣottamam ॥62॥
sarvopacārairanyūnaiḥ pūjayetparameśvaram ।
mūrtiṃ tu pauraṭīṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇasya śobhitām ॥63 ॥
satpātre pañcapātre vai nidhāya sopacārikām ।
tato vratī jalapātraṃ sthāpayejjalasaddhaṭam ॥64॥
pañcāmṛtādi sannyasya pūjāṃ mūrtau samācaret ।
prathamaṃ dehaśuddhyarthaṃ tryācamanāni kalpayet ॥65 ॥
tataḥ pūrve mukhaṃ kṛtvā niṣadya ca śubhāsane ।
mūrtāvāvāhayet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samantrakam ॥66 ॥
ghaṇṭāṃ pravādayedāvāhanakāle śubhasvarām ।
āsanaṃ paṭṭikāṃ sthālīṃ svarṇāṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe ॥67॥
pādaprakṣālanārthāya pādyaṃ dadyājjalaṃ śubham ।
tatastīrthajalaṃ dadyādarghyaṃ pūjānimittakam ॥68 ॥
tatastīrthajalamācamanārthaṃ ca dadecchubham ।
punaścā'tha praśuddhyarthaṃ dadyād darbhajalaṃ śubham ॥6 9॥
tato dantapraśuddhyarthaṃ dadyādvai dantadhāvanam ।
jihvollekhanakāryārthaṃ dadyāt svarṇaśalākikām ॥70 ॥
tataḥ śuddhaṃ jalaṃ dadyād gaṇḍūṣārthe tataḥ punaḥ ।
mukhaprakṣālanārthāya jalaṃ dadyātpunarnavam ॥7 1 ॥
atha śaucaṃ prakalpyaiva dadyājjalaghaṭaṃ tathā ।
mṛdaṃ vāpi pradadyācca karādiśuddhihetave ॥72॥
jalaṃ śuddhaṃ tathā dadyāddhastaprakṣālanāya vai ।
tataḥ śuddhaṃ jalaṃ dadyānmukhādikṣālanāya ca ॥ 73 ॥
svarṇāsanaṃ śubhaṃ dadyāt snānārthaṃ paṭṭikātmakam ।
tailena tu sugandhena mardayetparameśvaram ॥74॥
āmalakaistilacūrṇaistathā saṃmardayeddharim ।
tata uṣṇodakenāpi snāpayetpuruṣottamam ॥75॥
tato dugdhena dadhnā ca ghṛtena madhunā tathā ।
snāpayeccharkarā vārbhiḥ samṛdya puruṣottamam ॥76 ॥
tataḥ śuddhajalairuṣṇaiḥ snāpayetparameśvaram ।
tato nairmalyakāriṇyā proṣṇodakena miśrayā ॥77॥
hariṃ gūṭikayā''mṛdya snāpayedabhiṣecanam ।
kastūrikācandanādipuṣpasārādi lepayet ॥78 ॥
vastreṇa mārjayet kṛṣṇaṃ dhautrāmbarāṇi dhārayet ।
keśaprasādhanaṃ tailaṃ datvā kuryācca dantakaiḥ ॥79 ॥
lalāṭe tilakaṃ candraṃ kuryāccandanakuṃkumaiḥ ।
netrayoḥ kajjalaṃ dadyādoṣṭhayoḥ raṃgarañjanam ॥80 ॥
hastapādatalādīni rañjayed raṃgasudravaiḥ ।
svarṇakirīṭasadratnamālikākuṇḍalādikam ॥8 1 ॥
maṇimauktikahārādi raśanākaṃkaṇādikam ।
ūrmikāśṛṃkhalāsatkiṃkiṇīnupūrakādikam ॥8 2॥
ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi yathāsthānaṃ pradhārayet ।
pādayoḥ pāduke dadyāddhastayoryaṣṭimālike ॥83 ॥
kaṇṭhe satpuṣpahārāँśca tulasīpatramālikām ।
puṣpāṇāṃ śekharān gucchānarpayetparamādarāt ॥84॥
pavitraṃ tvarpayed yajñopavītaṃ yogapaṭṭakam ।
tulasīmaṇimālāṃ ca dadyānmaṃgalasūtrakam ॥85॥
kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ dadyāt tathā rakṣāṃ prakoṣṭhake ।
naktakaṃ hastake dadyāt prokṣayed gandhasārakam ॥86॥
rājādhirājasadveṣaṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kārayetparam ।
chatraṃ ca cāmare dadyād vyajanaṃ vāyudaṃ tathā ॥87॥
darpaṇaṃ mukhalokārthaṃ dadyāt paryaṃkamityapi ।
gendukaṃ pracchadapaṭīṃ kaśipuṃ guptadorakam ॥88॥
kapolakaśipuṃ dadyāt daṃśamaśakarodhinīm ।
dhūpaṃ sugandhaṃ kṛtvā ca dīpaṃ prajvālayettathā ॥89॥
śvetacūrṇaṃ raktacūrṇaṃ kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatān dadet ।
naivedyaṃ laḍḍukān miṣṭaṃ vividhānnaṃ supāyasam ॥9 0 ॥
śākāni cāranālāni dadhi dugdhaṃ saśarkaram ।
sūpaudanādikaṃ dadyāt kvathikāṃ caṭanīṃ tathā ॥9 1 ॥
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacośye peyaṃ dadyājjalaṃ tathā ।
culukaṃ kārayettāmbūlakaṃ cūrṇaṃ samarpayet ॥92॥
elālavaṃgadhānātvagvarīyaḥ pūgikāphalam ।
dadyācca phalamāmrasya jambūpanasakādalam ॥93 ॥
drākṣāśrīphaladāḍīma navaraṃgādikaṃ dadet ।
śuṣkaphalānyapi dadyād badāmakājukhārikāḥ ॥94॥
evaṃ samarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā hariṃ santarpya bhāvataḥ ।
kadalīstambhavaśādikṛte vastrādiśobhite ॥95॥
aśokā''mradalapuṣpaphalatoraṇarājite ।
maṇḍape madhyadeśe vai saptadhānyaiḥ kṛte śubhe ॥96॥
sarvatobhadrake tatra maṇḍale madhyavartini ।
suvarṇasya ghaṭe tāmre tīrthavāriprapūrite ॥97॥
maṇimauktikasauvarṇarūpyatāmrādikānvite ।
vastreṇa veṣṭite cāmrāśokādipallavānvite ॥98॥
suśobhite'kṣatacandanāktakuṃkumapūjite ।
tatra ghaṭe sthāpitā yā sthālī tāmrā ca kānakī ॥99॥
khārikāmraphalaiḥ pūgīśrīphalaiḥ śarkarātilaiḥ ।
pūritāyāṃ tu tasyāṃ vai sthāpayet puruṣottamam ॥ 10 0॥
nīrājayennavavāraṃ ghṛtāktapañcavartibhiḥ ।
vastraṃ ca bhrāmayet paścācchaṃkhodakena vartayet ॥ 10 1॥
dhūpaṃ saṃbhrāmayeccāpi stutiṃ kuryād yatheṣṭadām ।
namecca daṇḍavat kuryāt pañcavāraṃ pradakṣiṇam ॥ 1 02॥
kṣamāṃ yāceta cārghyaṃ vai saphalaṃ punararpayet ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ sākṣataṃ vai dadyācchrīharaye tataḥ ॥ 1 03॥
dakṣiṇāṃ kānakīṃ mudrāṃ rājataṃ cāpyupāyanam ।
iṣṭaṃ vastu pradadyācca haraye tvabhivāñcchitam ॥ 1 04॥
āndolayrecca dolāyāṃ paryaṃke śayanaṃ dadet ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ kuryād daded yānaṃ savāhanam ॥ 105॥
nṛtyaṃ kuryāt tathā gītaṃ vāditraṃ vādayet tathā ।
caraṇāmṛtadānaṃ ca bhaktebhyastatra vartayet ॥ 106 ॥
athāpi jalapānaṃ ca kārayetpunarādarāt ।
tāmbūlakaṃ punardadyādelālavaṃgakādikam ॥ 1 07॥
milet saṃśliṣya bāhubhyāṃ samāpīḍya hariṃ mudā ।
prasthāpayet tato devaṃ dūraṃ gatvā visarjayet ॥ 1 08॥
āgantavyamiti brūyānnatvā tvāyātpunargṛham ।
ityaṣṭottaraśatakopacāraiḥ parameśvaram ॥ 1 09॥
pūjayedbahubhaktyaikādaśyāṃ prātarvratī janaḥ ।
yadi sampadadhikā syāddhomayajñādi kārayet ॥ 11 0॥
dvādaśyāṃ bhojayedviprān satīḥ sādhvī sato janān ।
tataḥ svaḥ pāraṇāṃ kuryāt saṃbhojyāśritavargakān ॥ 11 1॥
dadyācchreṣṭhāni dānāni bhajeta śrīhariṃ mudā ।
evaṃ madhyāhnake kuryāt sāyaṃ kuryāttathaiva ha ॥ 11 2॥
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyagītapuraḥsaram ।
kīrtanaṃ śrīhareḥ kuryānnirundhyādindriyāṇi ca ॥ 1 13॥
evaṃ tvadhikamāsasyaikādaśīvratamatra yaḥ।
kuryāt tena kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ॥ 1 14॥
adhimāsaścātipuṇyaḥ puṇyāḥ tvekādaśī tithiḥ ।
taddevaḥ pāvanaścāhaṃ kiṃ tasmādatiricyate ॥ 1 15॥
adhimāso mama śālā vasāmi puruṣottamaḥ ।
ekādaśī madutpannā kiṃ tasmādatiricyate ॥ 1 16॥
etat trikaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvebhyaḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ gatam ।
tatrāpi matkṛpā prāptā kimasmādatiricyate ॥ 1 17॥
tasmādaṣṭottaraśatavastubhirmāṃ prapūjya ca ।
gṛhṇantu bhavapāraṃ vā gṛhṇantu bhavasāmyatām ॥ 1 18॥
mūrte tvaṃ cādya divase tathāvidhi kuru vratam ।
yena te dāsyate kṛṣṇo dundubhyātmā yathepsitam ॥ 1 19॥
mūrtiḥ prāha tadā hyenaṃ dundubhiṃ vinayena vai ।
na madagre'sti sāmagryaḥ pracchannā'haṃ vasāmi ca ॥ 120 ॥
kathaṃkāraṃ tvaduktaṃ vai pūjanaṃ tu mayā bhavet ।
icchāmyahaṃ śubhaṃ janma vivāhaṃ ca sutaṃ harim ॥ 121 ॥
durlabhaṃ tadvinā pūjā tādṛśī syānna cepsitam ।
ityuktvā bhagnahṛdayā sāśrukaṇṭhā babhūva sā ॥ 1 22॥
ekādaśyā vrataṃ kāryamiti saṃkalpya śocati ।
smṛtvā nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bālā tvaśrūṇi muñcati ॥ 123॥
tāvat kṛpānidhistatra harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā dundubheragrataḥ suprakaṭo'bhavat ॥ 1 24॥
pramārjyā'śrūṇi kanyāyāḥ prāha mātarnamāmyaham ।
śokaṃ mā kuru pūjyāsi yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmyaham ॥ 1 25॥
bhāvenāsmi sadā tuṣṭo nā'bhāve tu kadācana ।
tava bhāvena santuṣṭo dadāmi vṛṇu tadvaram ॥ 1 26॥
arcyate bhāvahīnena sahasravastubhiryadi ।
na santuṣṭo bhavāmyatra bhāvahīne'rthasādhake ॥ 127॥
patrapuṣpajalaiścāpi bhāvabhaktyā madarcanam ।
mama santoṣakṛt tatsyād bhāvasya kṣudhito'smyaham ॥ 128॥
aṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyopacārairapi hārdikaiḥ ।
mātaḥ sampūjaya tvaṃ māṃ dhyānamātreṇa cāntare ॥ 1 29॥
mānasaṃ pūjanaṃ te'haṃ svīkariṣye'tibhāvataḥ ।
phalaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ te dāsye hyadyatanavratasya vai ॥ 1 3 0॥
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
nanāma pādayormūrtermātṛbhāvena putravat ॥ 131 ॥
mātā śokaṃ vihāyaiva prasannā'bhūt hṛdantare ।
provāca śanakaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ janma cecchāmi laukikam ॥ 13 2॥
dharmeṇa patinā sākaṃ lagnamicchāmi vaidikam ।
aṃke lālayituṃ putraṃ sutaṃ cecchāmyalaukikam ॥ 133 ॥
alaukikastvamevāsi vaktuṃ notsahate manaḥ ।
niveditaṃ hṛdayyaṃ me yathecchasi tathā kuru ॥ 1 34॥
ityādiṣṭo hariḥ svābhilaṣitaṃ priyamuttamam ।
mūrtermukhātsamākarṇya jaharṣa bhāvijanmadhṛk ॥ 1 35 ॥
uvācā'tiprasannaḥ san sarvaṃ mātarbhaviṣyati ।
iṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣye'haṃ dadāmi vacanaṃ tu te ॥ 136 ॥
gaccha dakṣagṛhaṃ mūrte dharmamāpṛcchya satpatim ।
bhava putrī tu dakṣasya sa te dharmāya dāsyati ॥ 1 37॥
ahaṃ bālasvarūpeṇa saha bhrātrā tvadaṃkake ।
grahīṣyāmi janu mātaḥ śvo yāhi tvaṃ vratottaram ॥ 138 ॥
mānasī tvaṃ hi dakṣasya putrī vai bhāvinī tataḥ ।
dharmo vivāhya mātastvāṃ himaśaile nivatsyati ॥ 13 9॥
ahaṃ te mānasastatra caturātmā sutaḥ svayam ।
naro nārāyaṇaśceti hariḥ kṛṣṇaśca te gṛhe ॥ 140 ॥
ramiṣye sukhado brahmavrataṃ saṃdhārayan sadā ।
lokakalyāṇasaṃkalpaṃ pūrayastava sannidhau ॥ 141 ॥
ityuktvā ca punarnatvā tiro'bhūtpuruṣottamaḥ ।
mūrtiścāpi vrataṃ kṛtvā'rcanaṃ tatra ca mānasam ॥ 1 42॥
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇaṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ kṛtvā'rcanaṃ hṛdi ।
dharmadevasya saṃgṛhya śubhājñāṃ dakṣasadgraham ॥ 143 ॥
yayau jajñe ca saṃkalpādasiknyāṃ mānasī sutā ।
śraddhāmaitryādikāścānyā dvādaśāpi prajajñire ॥ 144॥
trayodaśāpi dakṣeṇa dattā dharmāya putrikāḥ ।
mūrterjātā naro nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo haristathā ॥ 145॥
lokānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya kurvantastapa uttamam ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi māse vai puruṣottame ॥ 146 ॥
vratasaṃkalpamātreṇa pūrṇaṃ vrataphalaṃ bhavet ।
kiṃ punaḥ sāṃgavidhinā kartuḥ phale'vaśiṣyate ॥ 147॥
tasmādekādaśītulyaṃ vrataṃ nānyad bhaviṣyati ।
śāśvatā'kṣayasatpuṇyapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā ॥ 148 ॥
yathālabdhopacāraistu prātaḥ saṃkalpya pūjanam ।
vrataṃ cāpi kariṣyanti teṣāṃ gṛheṣvahaṃ sadā ॥ 149॥
vatsyāmyeva na sandehastadbhaktyā vaśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
sukhayiṣye suto bhūtvā vratinau dampatī kulam ॥ 150॥

itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmadevasya bhāvyaṃganayā mūrtyādhimāsaikādaśyāmaṣṭottaraśatamānasopacārairnārāyaṇapūjana vrate kṛte sati mūrterdakṣagṛhe janma dharmeṇa saha vivāhastato himālaye naro nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo hariśceti- putracatuṣṭayaphalalābhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥1.303 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 303 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 304
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 305 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! paraṃbrahma sarvāvirbhāvaśaktikṛt ।
puruṣottamasaṃjño'sau savitā jagataḥ patiḥ ।। 1 ।।
svayaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaśca rādhāṃ svasmāt prasṛṣṭavān ।
