rādhā kṛṣṇātmikā śaktiḥ sādhikā bhaktakarmaṇām ।। 2 ।।
kṛṣṇasya savituḥ śaktiḥ prasūte sucarācaram ।
sā rādhā kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ goloke nityamasti hi ।। 3 ।।
svaprasūtasya lokasya prasavārthaṃ nirantaram ।
aicchad rūpāntaraṃ dhartuṃ tāvat kanyā vyajāyata ।। 4 ।।
sā tu nāmnā kṛtā kanyā sāvitrī prasavapradā ।
goloke rādhayā sākaṃ ramate nijamandire ।। 5 ।।
surūpā divyasāmarthyayuktā lokamanoharā ।
yatheṣṭasiddhisampannā guptaiśvaryādiśālinī ।। 6 ।।
yadā rādhā svayaṃ kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ samavartate ।
tadā kanyā tu sāvitrī samādhau samatiṣṭhati ।। 7 ।।
ātmani ramate nityamātmānandamayī prasūḥ ।
ātmasukhātisaṃmagnā dhyāyati brahma vai param ।। 8 ।।
yogābhyāsabalājjanmasiddhyā tvaicchad vilokitum ।
brahmaṇaḥ kīdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ kati vā santi tāni ca ।। 9 ।।
kutra kutra ca vartante kiṃ kāryāṇi vasanti ca ।
tadaiśvaryāṇi teṣāṃ ca kīdṛśyo vai vibhūtayaḥ ।। 10 ।।
ityetatsarvamājñātuṃ prāṇānsaṃkucya cātmani ।
avātaracchanairmūlādhāracakre tu yoginī ।। 11 ।।
atra sthitvā gaṇapatau saṃyamaṃ sā cakāra ha ।
tenā'saṃkhyagaṇeśānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇāṃśasvarūpiṇām ।। 12।।
brahmāṇḍeṣu tvananteṣu dhāmānyālokya sundarī ।
gudāmūlasthitaṃ cakraṃ parityajyāgramāyayau ।। 13 ।।
svādhiṣṭhānābhidhaṃ cakraṃ saṃyamārthaṃ dadhāra sā ।
tatra prajāpatau sthitvā saṃyamaṃ sā cakāra ha ।। 14।।
tenā'saṃkhyaprajeśānāṃ parabrahmasvarūpiṇām ।
brahmāṇḍeṣu tvananteṣu dhāmāni vīkṣya sundarī ।। 15।।
nābhikandasthitaṃ maṇipuraṃ cakraṃ jagāma sā ।
tatra sthitvā tu sarpiṇyāṃ saṃyamaṃ sā vidhāya ca ।। 16।।
ūrdhvamukhyāṃ praviveśā'saṃkhyalokeṣu sundarī ।
tasmād yānti mahānāḍyastejomayyo'pyasaṃkhyakāḥ ।। 17।।
kāścitpātālalokāँśca kāścillokācalātigān ।
kāścitsvargādisatyāntān kāścidāvaraṇādikān ।। 18।।
kāścidīśvaralokāँśca kāścidbrahmagṛhānapi ।
yā yā yadyat sthalaṃ yānti tattanmārgeṇa sundarī ।। 19।।
jagāma bahulokeṣu vilokya divyabhūmikāḥ ।
brāhmāṇḍikavibhūtīśca punarāgatya tatsthalam ।।20 ।।
jagāmordhvaṃ ca hṛdaye cakramanāhatābhidham ।
tatra vai praṇavaṃ śrutvā cakre brahmaṇi saṃyamam ।।21।।
yadātmā cāpyantarātmā brahmātmā khyāyate svayam ।
tatra kṛtena sāvitrī saṃyamenaiśvarīkṛtau ।।22।।
vairājeṣu bhaumaneṣu vaiṣṇaveṣu ca dhāmasu ।
prākṛteṣu tayā sādāśaiveṣvāvaraṇeṣu ca ।।23।।
tattaddhāmasu sāvitrī vilokya divyabhūmikāḥ ।
tatsthalaṃ punarāgatya yayāvūrdhvaṃ tu kaṇṭhagam ।।24।।
viśuddhaṃ cakrameveyaṃ cakre vai saṃyamaṃ balāt ।
vāsudeve'niruddhe ca pradyumne ca sukarṣaṇe ।।25।।
vilokya racanāsteṣāṃ dhāmnāṃ dhāmavibhūtikāḥ ।
kaṇṭhaṃ deśaṃ punarāyādūrdhvaṃ ca bhrūkuṭau tu sā ।।26।।
gatvā''jñācakramāsādya cakāra saṃyamaṃ śanaiḥ ।
dṛṣṭastatra guruḥ sākṣāt parabrahmātmakastayā ।।27।।
lokasaṃcālanārthāya jāto yo viśvasṛḍ vibhuḥ ।
parabrahmasvarūpād yaḥ prāvirbabhūva vedakṛt ।।28।।
sarvalokagururbrahmā prajānāṃ yaḥ pitāmahaḥ ।
tasyāṃ'ke tu sthitāṃ divyāṃ svāṃ sāvitrī vilokya vai ।।29।।
vedhaḥpatnīṃ viniścitya jaharṣātīva sundarī ।
kṣaṇaṃ vicārayāmāsa yā'haṃ golokavāsinī ।।30।।
bhavāmyadya kathaṃ cātra māṃ paśyāmyaṃkasaṃsthitām ।
ajasakthigataṃ yanme rūpaṃ tatkuta āgatam ।। 3 1।।
yadahaṃ saṃprapaśyāmi māṃ vadhūrūpiṇīṃ tviha ।
pitāmahīṃ ca tatsarvaṃ pṛcchāmyatraiva kāraṇam ।।32।।
iti praṣṭuṃ yayāvagre tāvat tirobabhūva sā ।
pitāmahyā samākṛṣṭā līnā babhūva sundarī ।।33।।
tāvatsamādhitaśceyaṃ sāvitrī bahirāyayau ।
kva golokasthitā kanyā kvā'jāṃ'kasthā pitāmahī ।।34।।
ityāścaryānvitā kanyā dṛṣṭārthasya viniścayam ।
sasaṃbhramā yayau kartuṃ rādhikā yatra rājate ।।35।।
sāvitryā svapradṛṣṭārtho rādhikāyai niveditaḥ ।
śrutvā rādhā tu tāṃ prāha kanye tvaṃ matsvarūpiṇī ।।36।।
vartase brahmaśaktiśca brahmārthe jātavigrahā ।
jagatprasūsvarūpā yā māyāśaktiḥ parā matā ।।37।।
sā'haṃ sā tvaṃ ca sāvitrī sūyamānā jagatprasūḥ ।
brahmapatnī brahmatanvī brahmaṇo'rthe vinirmitā ।।38।।
pitāmahena saṃpṛktā nityaṃ jagatpitāmahī ।
vartase'nādikālatvāt pratyajaṃ tu navā navā ।।39।।
bhavasi tvaṃ mahāmāye kanyakā matsvarūpataḥ ।
athārādhaya taṃ devaṃ prāpsyase tapaso balāt ।।40।।
ityāśrutya tu sāvitrī brahmaprāptiṃ vyacintayat ।
tāvattatra dvādaśikādine prātaḥ samaśṛṇot ।।41 ।।
dundubhiṃ devadevasya ghoṣayantaṃ kṛpāvacaḥ ।
adhimāsavrataṃ devyaḥ kurvantu mānasapradam ।।।42।।
hṛdi dṛṣṭaṃ bahirdṛṣṭaṃ loke lokāntare'pi vā ।
dinaikavratamātreṇa dāsyate puruṣottamaḥ ।।।43।।
anantaguṇakaṃ puṇyamadyā'sti harivāsaraḥ ।
trispṛśāvratatastvadya sahasraguṇakaṃ phalam ।।44।।
yatheṣṭaṃ labhyate kṛtvā hyekabhuktaṃ ca naktakam ।
phalāhāraṃ ca vā dugdhapānaṃ dadhiprabhojanam ।।45।।
jalāhāraṃ ca vā ghṛtāhāraṃ tilādanaṃ ca vā ।
yavāhāraṃ ca vā śākāhāraṃ kandādanaṃ ca vā ।।46।।
bharjitā'danamathavā vrataṃ patrādanaṃ tu vā ।
puṣpādanaṃ niradanaṃ pavanādanameva vā ।।47।।
dhūmrādanaṃ ca vā bāṣpādanaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ śubham ।
dvādaśyāmadhimāse'tra labhantāṃ śāśvataṃ sukham ।।48।।
brahmaparaṃ tathā brahma golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ padam ।
avyākṛtaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ māyālokaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।।49।।
sadāśivapadaṃ vāpi bhūmasāmrājyameva vā ।
śrīpuraṃ cāpi vairājyaṃ hairaṇyagārbhikaṃ ca vā ।।50।।
bhaumādyāvaraṇe dhāmānyarjayantu vratena vai ।
satyaṃ vā brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ vahnervā sauryameva vā ।।5 1।।
cāndramasaṃ ca vā sthānaṃ nākṣatraṃ grāhameva vā ।
aindraṃ ca vāruṇaṃ sthānaṃ yāmyaṃ kauberameva vā ।।52।।
aiśānaṃ pāvanaṃ vāpi nairṛtaṃ tārakaṃ ca vā ।
bhuvo rājyaṃ ca vā bhaumaṃ cātaleyādikaṃ nu vā ।।53 ।।
āvaraṇāni divyāni devarājyāni vaibhavān ।
kaumāraṃ brāhmacaryaṃ vā yaugaṃ vā''tmapadaṃ śubham ।।।54।।
śvetadvīpādikaṃ cā'tha sāmudraṃ cāntarīkṣagam ।
rājyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ vā sāmrājyaṃ vāpi mānavam ।।55।।।
maunamārṣaṃ ca paitrādyaiśvaraṃ vā bahusiddhikam ।
strīrājyaṃ vāpi kailāsaṃ kāmarājyaṃ ca śāśvatam ।।56।।
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ rājyaṃ svāmisevātmakaṃ ca vā ।
patnīmattvaṃ patimattvaṃ putraputrīsusampadaḥ ।।।।57।।।
ārogyaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ rasāyanaṃ ca kāyikam ।
yadyadicched vratī tvadya dvādaśyāṃ harivāsare ।।58।।
tatsarvaṃ pradadāmyasmai vadāmi puruṣottamaḥ ।
adya me pūjanaṃ kuryāt prātaḥ snātvā gṛhāntare ।।।59।।।
sthitvā dhyānaṃ ca me kuryāt kuryādāvāhanādikam ।
pañcāmṛtaiśca me snānaṃ śuddhodāplavanaṃ tathā ।।60।।
nirvartayettato vastrabhūṣācandanamarpayet ।
yathāśakti prakuryācca dhūpadīpābhivandanam ।।61।।
naivedye phalamūlādyaṃ miṣṭānnānyathavā'rpayet ।
jāmbūlaṃ jalapānaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ namaṇaṃ caret ।।62।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ cārārtrikaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadet ।
kuṃkumā'kṣatatulasīphalairarghyaṃ samarpayet ।।63।।
punarnatvā punaḥ smṛtvā prārthayet sveṣṭavastukam ।
vrataṃ cāpi prapūrṇaṃ syāt tava keśavapūjanāt ।।64।।
kṣamāpayettathā stutyā mūrtiṃ tu kānakīṃ hareḥ ।
kramā'kramau na viditau na jñātaṃ tvadabhīṣṭakam ।।65।।
yathābuddhi mayā premṇā kṛtaṃ nyūne kṣamāṃ kuru ।
adhimāso'si deveśa! hyadhivarṣākara! prabho! ।।66।।
arthināmadhikaṃ ceṣṭaṃ dadāsi puruṣottama! ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo pārvatīśa prabheśvara ।।67।।
lakṣmīśa māṇikīnātha sāvitrīśa jagatprabhoḥ ।
viśvasṛḍ rādhikākānta kamalākānta keśava ।। 68।।
dvādaśyāṃ me vratenā'dya mānaseṣṭaṃ prapūraya ।
ityabhyarthya hariṃ natvā prātarmadhye niśīthake ।।69।।
bhūtvā tanmaya evāpi tatsamarpitasatkriyaḥ ।
rañjayennṛtyagītaiśca savādyena visarjayet ।।70।।
iti kṛtvā vrataṃ samyagarcanaṃ vratakṛjjanaḥ ।
naro nārī kumārī vā kumāro devatā'thavā ।।7 1।।
sureśvarī ca vā pitṛkoṭikā muniyoṣitaḥ ।
pātālavāsinī yadvā tādṛśā naravargiṇaḥ ।।।72।।।
īśvarā īśvarāṇyaśca muktā muktānya eva vā ।
yadicchanti tvāpnuvanti pratijāne na saṃśayaḥ ।।73।।
yathāśakti yathākāryaṃ vrataṃ ca pūjanaṃ mama ।
bāhyābhāve hṛdi me'pi bhāvabhinnaṃ supūjanam ।।74।।
kuryāttasyāpi bhāvena premṇā tuṣṭo dadāmyaham ।
adyā'dhimāsake tvasmi kṛpāvarṣī pareśvara ।।75।।
na bhūto na bhaviṣyāmi yathā'dya vṛṣṭikṛttathā ।
tasmānme kṛpayā bhaktāḥ kṛtvā kiñcidatho vratam ।।76।।
labhantāṃ śāśvataṃ puṇyaṃ sukhaṃ lokaṃ ca hṛdgatam ।
iti śrutvā tu sāvitrī jaharṣa cāti sundarī ।।77।।
natvā sā dundubhiṃ prāha śṛṇu daivākṛte kṛtin ।
mayā samādhau brahmā vai parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ।।78।।
dṛṣṭastasya ca vāmeṃ'ke sāvitrī ca niṣeduṣī ।
matsvarūpā mayā dṛṣṭā tasyāṃ lilye'pyahaṃ tadā ।।79।।
punaścāhaṃ samādherutthitā'smyatra kumārikā ।
viśvasraṣṭā patiḥ soyaṃ prāptavyo mānase sthitaḥ ।।80 ।।
ato'dhimāsadvādaśyāmekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ mama ।
pūjanaṃ devadevasyā''cariṣyāmi yathābalam ।।8 1।।
anena me śarīreṇa prāptistasya tu durlabhā ।
nityagolokadhāmnaśca vibhūterme'sti varṣma yat ।।82।।
tasyāsti tattvajaṃ vairājātmajaṃ varṣma sañcitam ।
tasmānme brahmaṇo yogo yathā yena ca varṣmaṇā ।।83।।
jāyeta tattathā brūhi karomi dvādaśīvratam ।
iti śrutvā dundubhiśca tāmāha puruṣottamaḥ ।।84।।
śṛṇu sāvitri subhage hyadya śrīpuruṣottamam ।
vahniputrasuvarṇasya mūrtirūpaṃ vidhāpaya ।।85।।
lakṣmīṃ tathā suvarṇasya mūrtirūpāṃ vidhāpaya ।
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā tasya sāvitrīṃ kānakaṃ kuru ।।86 ।।
pūjayitvā yathāśakti dāna kuru supātrake ।
ityevaṃ vai vrate tvadya pūjanaṃ dānamityapi ।।87 ।।
kuru tena prasannaḥ sa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
sarvaṃ vidhāsyate te'rthaṃ mā cintāṃ kuru kanyake ।।88।।
iti śrutvā tu sāvitryā vrate vai dvādaśīprage ।
yogabalena sauvarṇaṃ merorbhāgāt samarjitam ।।89।।
aiśvaryeṇa ca tatraiva lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ca sā ।
brahmāṇaṃ cāpi sāvitrīṃ sauvarṇīṃ mūrtimeva ha ।।90 ।।
kṛtvā tvāvāhya saṃsnāpya bhūṣayitvā prapūjya ca ।
bhojayitvā pāyayitvā prārthya nīrājanaṃ vyadhāt ।।9 1 ।।
kṣamāpayitvā saṃstūya nivedyārthaṃ ca hṛdgatam ।
visarjayati yāvattāndevāँstāvaddhariḥ svayam ।।92।।
prādurbabhūva sāvitryāstvagre lakṣmīyutaḥ prabhuḥ ।
prasannavadanaḥ sarvaśobhāḍhyo varadānadaḥ ।।93।।
prāhā'syai vada kalyāṇi kiṃ te manasi vartate ।
sāvitrī prāha deveśaṃ dehi yogaṃ tu vedhasaḥ ।। 94।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha jātaṃ te manasi sthitam ।
netre pramīlya maddhyānaṃ kuru sāvitri vai kṣaṇam ।।95।।
tāvatte mānasaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati karāgatam ।
nārāyaṇena yatproktaṃ tathaivā''caradādarāt ।।96।।
tāvannārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vyalīyata hi tatkṣaṇam ।
atha prātaḥ prapūjyaivaṃ madhyāhne'pi tathā'karot ।।97।।
sāyaṃ cāpi tathā pūjāmakarojjāgaraṃ tathā ।
dolāyāṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā hyajam ।।98।।
sāvitrīṃ ca nidhāyaiva kanyakā''ndolayanmuhuḥ ।
tāvatprāha punastatrā''gatya śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।99।।
devi! puṣpāñjaliṃ datvā datvā cārghyaṃ phalaṃ jalam ।
visarjanaṃ kuru me'tra gacchāmyakṣaradhāma yat ।। 100 ।।
tvaṃ yāhyadyaiva vairājaṃ yasmād brahmā vyajāyata ।
vairāje sūkṣmarūpeṇa praviśa tvaṃ purā tataḥ ।। 101 ।।
vairājamānasī putrī tannābherbhava kanyake ।
jātamātrā yuvatīṃ tvāṃ vairājo'jāya dāsyati ।। 1 02।।
vidhinā tvaiśvareṇaiva karmaṇā tvāṃ niyokṣyate ।
kalyāṇi gaccha te svasti saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ bhavet ।। 103।।
ityuktvā śrīharirnārāyaṇastatra tiro'bhavat ।
sāvitrīśrīharemūrtyai puṣpāñjaliṃ pradāya ca ।। 1 04।।
arghyaṃ ca śrīphalaṃ prārpyākarod devavisarjanam ।
dānaṃ dadau suvarṇasya mūrtīnāṃ brahmavarcase ।। 105।।
patnīvratākhyagurave golokadhāmavāsine ।
āśiṣaṃ ca tataḥ prāpya bhava saubhāgyasundarī ।। 106 ।।
brahmapatnī jagatāṃ ca prasavitrī bhaveti ca ।
rādhāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tato natvā drāgevā'dṛśyatāṃ yayau ।। 1 07।।
vairāje praviveśā'sya nābhināle samudgatā ।
prasavaṃ prāpya kanyā sā sāvitrī yuvatī tadā ।। 1 08।।
jātamātrā'bhavattāṃ ca viditvā brahmaṇaḥ kṛte ।
samutpannāṃ dadau ceśasamāje vidhinā virāṭ ।। 109 ।।
brahmaṇe caturāsyāya sāpi pūrṇamanorathā ।
jaganmātā'bhavatprāpya brahmāṇaṃ patimīśvaram ।। 110 ।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! dvādaśīvratakāraṇāt ।
sāvitryā brahmapatnītvaṃ yathājātaṃ tadiṣṭadam ।। 111 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye rādhikāyā mūrtantarasāvitryā samādhau jīveśabrahmasṛṣṭivilokane vedhasoṃ'ke sva-sthitiṃ dṛṣṭvā patnīrūpeṇa vedhaḥprāptīcchayā cintane dundubhiśravaṇe dvādaśīvratena vairāja-putryā tayā brahmā patiḥ prāpta ityādi-nirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikatriśata-tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1.304 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 304 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 305
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 306 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca- -
śṛṇu lakṣmi! brahmaṇastu putrīṇāṃ prāk catasṛṇām ।
trayodaśyā adhimāse vratena puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
svayaṃ patirabhūt tābhyo dadau dhāmākṣaraṃ gṛham ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ dadau tābhyaḥ śāśvatīṃ kṛpayā prabhuḥ ॥ 2 ॥
ādye kṛte yuge lakṣmi! sṛṣṭyarthaṃ brahmaṇā purā ।
bālāḥ sanakasanandasanātanasanadbhidhāḥ ॥ 3 ॥
sṛṣṭāścatvāra aiśvaryabalatejaḥsamanvitāḥ ।
dāmpatyarthe ca teṣāṃ vai catasraḥ śaktayaḥ kṛtāḥ ॥ 4 ॥
nāmnā jayā ca lalitā pāravatī prabhā śubhāḥ ।
sadṛśāste sadṛśyastāḥ mānasyo mānasāśca te ॥ 5 ॥
kṛtvā caturyugalāni prasanno'bhūdatīva saḥ ।
jātamātrāṇi caitāni vijñānavanti vīkṣya vai ॥ 6 ॥
niyoktuṃ sṛṣṭikārye tān pratyekaṃ prāha viśvasṛṭ ।
sanaka tvaṃ gṛhāṇaināṃ jayāṃ tvadarthakalpitām ॥ 7 ॥
sanandana gṛhāṇaināṃ lalitāṃ te prakalpitām ।
sanātana gṛhāṇaināṃ dattā pāravatīṃ ca te ॥ 8 ॥
sanat gṛhāṇa te dattāṃ prabhāṃ sahacarīṃ kuru ।
yugalaṃ yugalaṃ bhūtvā catvāri yugalāni vai ॥ 9 ॥
sṛjantu mānasīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ sarvā yugalarūpiṇīm ।
golokādīdṛśī prāptā gṛhadharmaparamparā ॥ 10 ॥
vaikuṇṭhe'pi tathā dṛṣṭā gṛhadharmaparamparā ।
vayaṃ kṛṣṇājñayā gṛhyān dharmān gṛhṇīma ādarāt ॥ 1 1॥
tathā putrā! bhavanto'pi gṛhītvā pitṛsammatān ।
gṛhadharmān pālayitvā bhavantu sukhino'tra vai ॥ 12॥
niyujya bhavataḥ sṛṣṭikārye'pyahaṃ manāk punaḥ ।
sṛṣṭibhāreṇa rahito bhavāmīti kṛtārthakaḥ ॥ 13॥
gṛhadharme sadā putrā vaṃśā bhavanti tārakāḥ ।
gṛhadharme yoṣito'pi bhavanti sukhadāyikāḥ ॥ 14॥
gṛhadharme yajñayāgakriyā jāyanta ādarāt ।
atitheḥ pūjanaṃ devapūjanaṃ sādhupūjanam ॥ 15॥
satkāro'nyāśramiṇāṃ dyupradaṃ dānaṃ ca jāyate ।
kāmadharmo'pyavitaḥ syādarthaścopārjito bhavet ॥ 16 ॥
puruṣārthatrayaṃ mokṣaḥ paścāllabhyeta śāśvataḥ ।
gṛhadharmaṃ vinā guṇapravāhaviramo na vai ॥ 17॥
bālye vā yauvane jñānaṃ jāyate na virāmadam ।
tasmād bhogaṃ pradāyaiva mānasaṃ vai praśāntayet ॥ 18॥
praśāntamānasānāṃ tu mokṣo bhavati śāśvataḥ ।
tasmāt kurvantu kāryāṇi sṛṣṭidhrauvyāṇi putrakāḥ! ॥ 19॥
iti vai brahmaṇaḥ śrutvā vaco viśvasṛjaḥ sutāḥ ।
catvāraḥ pūrvata eva jñānino yoginastathā ॥20 ॥
brahmavettāra evaite mokṣamarthe viniścitāḥ ।
na karmaṇā bhavenmokṣaḥ karma vai bandhanaṃ pitaḥ ॥21॥
tatrāpi gṛhyakarmāṇi bandhanānyeva santi vai ।
nārīdharmo vinivṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ jāyate nahi ॥ 22॥
karmottaraṃ punaḥ karma kārayatyeva rāgataḥ ।
dharmārthakāmanāstatra sāntā bhavanti naiva hi ॥23॥
vinā jñānaṃ pitastasmād gṛhadharmo bhayāvahaḥ ।
gṛhadharmo bhārarūpo yathā tyaktuṃ tvayeṣyate ॥24॥
tathā'smābhiśca taṃ voḍhumādyato naiva ceṣyate ।
putrā yat tārakāḥ proktāstārakaṃ jñānameva ha ॥25 ॥
tadvai putrābhidhānaṃ syāt jñānināṃ yogināṃ tathā ।
karmiṇāṃ tu sutāḥ putrā na cikīrṣālayātmanām ॥26 ॥
vaṃśastu brahmavijñāni muktāḥ santo bhavantu naḥ ।
brahmamārgapradeṣṭāro brahmalokanivāsinaḥ ॥27॥
adhruvasyā'nvayasyā'rthe kariṣyāmo na gṛhyakam ।
yoṣitsaṃgo bahī ramyaḥ pariṇāme'ntare'sukhaḥ ॥28॥
kastāṃ seveta tattvajñaḥ sukhaṃ naijaṃ vihāya vai ।
ātmasukhaṃ paraṃ proktaṃ tadanyatsukhamantakṛt ॥29 ॥
gṛhadharme yajñayāgā ye tu proktāḥ pitāmaha ।
brahmārādhanakāryasya kūlayā'pi samā na te ॥30॥
brahmārādhanamevātra kraturno jñānināṃ mataḥ ।
kṛte brahmārādhane tu kṛtamātithyapūjanam ॥3 1॥
kṛtaṃ ca devapūjādi kṛtaṃ sādhuprapūjanam ।
satkṛte tu harau nityaṃ satkṛtaṃ sarvameva ha ॥32॥
dānaṃ tu brahmavijñānaṃ kṛtaṃ syācchāśvataṃ pitaḥ ।
svarge tallabhyamevā'nyanmokṣasthānaṃ tadeva ha ॥33॥
yanna duḥkhādisaṃbhinnaṃ na cānte grasyate tu yat ।
satyasaṃkalpalabdhikṛt tatsvarge śāśvataṃ padam ॥ 34॥
kāladharmaḥ satṛṣṇasya nā''tmārāmasya kasyacit ।
arthaścānnajalavastrairnānyairarthaiḥ prayojanam ॥35॥
evaṃ vai vartamānasya mokṣaḥ karatale sthitaḥ ।
gṛhadharmeṇa guṇakṛtpravāhasya visarjanam ॥36॥
āśāmātraṃ praboddhavyaṃ magnā vai guṇadharmiṇaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ bālyaṃ na vai cāsti yauvanaṃ tvāgataṃ nahi ॥37॥
sarvadātmani cāstyeva virāmo bhogavarjitaḥ ।
mānasaṃ brahmaṇā samyag rañjitaṃ śāntivigraham ॥38॥
teṣāṃ mokṣaḥ sadehe vā videhe vā na śiṣyate ।
sadā muktaḥ sa vai proktaḥ sadā muktaḥ sa vai mataḥ ॥39॥
harṣā'marṣabhayodvegairaspṛṣṭo mukta eva saḥ ।
tasmānnārhā vayaṃ sṛṣṭau vayaṃ brahmādhikāriṇaḥ ॥40॥
nirdvandvā dvandva śūnyāँśca kariṣyāmo'parānapi ।
ayaṃ vai pitṛtatpitṛpitṛpitṛpituḥ pituḥ ॥41 ॥
puruṣottamasaṃjñasya dharmo'styupaniṣanmayaḥ ।
yāsyāmo yena puratastasyaiva paramātmanaḥ ॥42॥
yadvai paścātprakartavyaṃ tadadyaiva vidhīyatām ।
yadi syāt tadvidhānasya sādhanaṃ svīyakośagam ॥43॥
asmākaṃ tu pituścānugraheṇā''tmani saṃyamaḥ ।
sahottha eva sukhado vartate mokṣasādhakaḥ ॥44॥
tasmādābālyato mokṣe vatsyāmo nānyathā pitaḥ ।
asmanmokṣe tava mokṣo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥45॥
vayaṃ putrāstārakāḥ smo yathārthā iti viddhi vai ।
imāḥ kanyāstu yoginyo jñānavijñānamūrtayaḥ ॥46॥
brahmaiva saṃprapatsyante svalpakālena mā śucaḥ ।
iti saṃbhāṣya putrāste yayurviṣṇupadīṃ prati ॥47॥
jayā ca lalitā pāravatī prabheti kanyakāḥ ।
adhyātmayogasampannāḥ sasmaruḥ puruṣottamam ॥48॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tvārādhayāmāsuḥ sadā''darāt ।
japaṃ cakruḥ oṃśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ॥49॥
evaṃ vai vartamānābhirghoṣaṇā dundubheḥ śrutā ।
satyaloke trayodaśyāṃ prātareva kṛpāmayī ॥5 0 ॥
yā kācid brahmasampannā yadvā brahmaviyoginī ।
sadyojātā kumārī vā varārohā virāgiṇī ॥5 1 ॥
sthavīrā vā subhagā vā suvāsinī vivāsinī ।
sarāgā vā''tmarāgā vā kaivalyehāvatī ca vā ॥5 2 ॥
anāthā vā sanāthā vā saṃskṛtā vā'pyasaṃskṛtā ।
susthānā vā'kṛtasthānā'thavā prasthānaśālinī ॥53 ॥
vāgdānā vā'pyadānā vā dānārhā dānavarjitā ।
dānārthe nirmitā cāpi kuryāt trayodaśīvratam ॥ 54॥
tāsāmabhīṣṭadātā'smi śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
adhimāse'tra yasyai yannavaṃ navamapekṣyate ॥55 ॥
agamyaṃ vā sugamyaṃ vā labhyaṃ cālabhyamityapi ।
puṇyalabhyaṃ dravyalabhyaṃ labhyaṃ yatsādhanairapi ॥56॥
atarkyaṃ vā pratarkyaṃ vā śāśvataṃ cā'dhruvaṃ tathā ।
bhogyaṃ cā'bhogyamevā'nyad yadyad vāñchati yā hṛdi ॥57 ॥
tattatsarvaṃ pradāsye'haṃ prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
trayodaśyāṃ kṛtenaikabhuktena ca vratena vai ॥58॥
niśīthabhojanenaiva phalāhāreṇa vā vratam ।
kuryādvai śraddhayā yukta mama pūjanapūrvakam ॥59॥
tasyā netā gamayitā trātā poṣṭā ca bhadrakṛt ।
āśrayadastathā tvānandayitā'smi pareśvaraḥ ॥ 60 ॥
narā nāryo'thavā cānye pūjayantyadhimāsake ।
trayodaśyāṃ candanādyairyatheṣṭaṃ vitarāmyaham ॥ 61 ॥
aṣṭottaraśatenāpi ṣaṭpaṃcāśadbhireva vā ।
dvātriṃśadbhiścopacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśādyaiśca vastubhiḥ ॥6 2 ॥
yathālabdhaiśca vā patrapuṣpajalānnataṇḍulaiḥ ।
mānasairvā pūjayantu premopāyanakaiśca mām ॥6 3 ॥
puṣpāṃjaliṃ ca vā premāṃjaliṃ dadatu me janāḥ ।
teṣāmapi kariṣyāmi mānasaṃ dānapūritam ॥ 6 4॥
mā saṃkocaṃ prakurvantu vadantu dhārayantu vā ।
saṃkalpayantu hṛdye vitariṣyāmyadhivrate ॥ 65 ॥
śrutvaivaṃ dundubhiṃ prātastrayodaśyāṃ hariśritam ।
jayā ca lalitā tatrā''yayuḥ pāravatī prabhā ॥6 6 ॥
nemustaṃ dundubhiṃ cātha papracchuḥ kiṃ dadāsi vai ।
dundubhiḥ prāha nākaṃ vā dadāmi puruṣottamam ॥ 67॥
trayodaśīvratamūlyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ।
dadāmi saṃpadastasya dhāmā'pyakṣarasaṃjñitam ॥68 ॥
adhimāse'dhikadātā bhavāmi svalpake vrate ।
prakaṭo'hamadhimāsātmako'smi sṛṣṭimaṇḍale ॥ 6 9॥
svarge satyaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ vairājaṃ bhaumanaṃ dhruvam ।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ dadāmi brahmaśāśvatam ॥7 0 ॥
bhavatyaḥ kinnu vāñchanti dadāmi vratasatphalam ।
śrutvā tadā catasrastāḥ prāhustaṃ dundubhiṃ mudā ॥7 1 ॥
jātamātrā vayaṃ sarvā asaṃskṛtāḥ sma vai tataḥ ।
saṃskṛtāḥ syāma kṛṣṇena saṃgatā dhāma saṃgatāḥ ॥72॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so'smānavāpnotu pareśvaraḥ ।
dāsyastasya bhavāmo'dya vratenecchāma eva tat ॥73 ॥
dundubhiśca tadā prāha bhavatyaścādya vai mudā ।
snātvā prātaścārcayantu sauvarṇaṃ puruṣottamam ॥ 74॥
yathālabdhopacāraiśca mānasairbhāvagarbhitaiḥ ।
premakṣudhāśrayaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo grahīṣyati ॥79॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogyā yūyaṃ stha divyavigrahāḥ ।
kṛtvā vratārcane tvadya prāpnuvantu hariṃ varam ॥76॥
ityuktvā dundubhistasmāt sthānādanyatra vai yayau ।
jayā ca lalitā cakruḥ pāravatī vrataṃ prabhā ॥77॥
tāstu snātvā gṛhaṃ gatvā kṛtvā maṇḍapamuttamam ।
trayodaśyāṃ prātareva pupūjuḥ puruṣottamam ॥78॥
madhye siṃhāsanaṃ kṛtvā kānakīṃ pratimāṃ hareḥ ।
tatra vinyasya cāvāhya dadurjalādikaṃ mudā ॥79॥
pañcāmṛtajalaiḥ snānaṃ kārayitvā'mbarāṇi ca ।
ābhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi kuṃkumacandanādikam ॥8 0 ॥
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalapuṣpaphalādikam ।
tāmbūlavyajanacchatracāmarā''rārtrikādikam ॥8 1 ॥
pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ kṣāntiṃ cārghyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ daduḥ ।
devadeva hare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa jagatprabho! ॥82॥
dāsīnāṃ te karā''dānaṃ kuru smo dāsya eva ha ।
evaṃ saṃkalpya kusumāñjalīn sagadgadā daduḥ ॥83 ॥
madhyāhnepyevameveśa prapūjyā'bhojayan harim ।
sāyaṃ cāpi samarcyaiva cakrurnīrājanaṃ hareḥ ॥84॥
daduśca bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ tṛptastuṣṭau'bhavaddhariḥ ।
cakrustā jāgaraṃ rātrau naktaṃ kṛtvā hareḥ puraḥ ॥85॥
nanṛtustā jagurgītiṃ madhurāṃ tālamiśritām ।
tāvat prāvirbabhūveśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ॥86॥
catuḥsvarūpo bhagavān pratyekāṃ tāmupādade ।
catūrūpaiścatasrastā vāme nidhāya mālikāḥ ॥87॥
tābhirdattā nāmayitvā kaṃdharāṃ samupādade ।
prasannaśca muhustāśca pasparśā''śliṣṭavān mudā ॥88॥
agamyaṃ cā'vitarkyaṃ cā'bhūtaṃ cāvarṇyameva ca ।
tābhyo datvā sukhaṃ śīghraṃ nidhāya garuḍopari ॥89॥
natvā tu vedhasaṃ prāpya yautakaṃ cāśiṣastathā ॥
vidhinā brahmaṇā tāśca nārāyaṇāya cārpitāḥ ॥90॥
vivāhayitvā prayayau kṛṣṇakāntaḥ svamandiram ।
yadakṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma brahma vyāpakamuttamam ॥91॥
anyadhāmāni yasmādvai prāvirbhūtāni tadvaram ।
yayau tābhistu patnībhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ॥92॥
jayā ca lalitā pāravatī prabhā'mbare pare ।
vyomni muktānya evaitā jātāḥ patnyo hareśca tāḥ ॥93॥
divyā divyapriyatulyā modante'kṣaradhāmagāḥ ।
evaṃ kṛtvā trayodaśyāṃ vrataṃ śrīpuruṣottame ॥94॥
māsi śrīkṛṣṇapūjāṃ ca kṛtvā'vāpuḥ paraṃ padam ।
svalpasyāpi phalaṃ nityaṃ divyaṃ vai cāpyanantakam ॥95॥
śroṣyantīmaṃ paṭhiṣyantyadhyāyaṃ ye kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ।
teṣāmapi phalaṃ tadvad bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ॥96॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye catuḥsanakādikādyarthamutpāditānāṃ brahmaputrīṇāṃ jayālalitāpāravatīprabhābhidhānānāṃ puruṣo-ttamamāsatrayodaśīvratenaśrīpuruṣottamadhāmni śrīkṛṣṇa-nārāyaṇasya patnītvaprāptiḥ, sanakādīnāṃ tu vairāgya-vṛttirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhika-triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.305 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 305 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 306
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 307 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pare tvādye vaikuṇṭhe prathame tu yat ।
sañjātaṃ vai caturdaśyāṃ caritraṃ dundubhestu yat ॥ 1 ॥
akṣarabrahmadhāmnastu sīmni saṃvidyate tu yat ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ prathamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhaṃ golokasadṛśam ॥ 2 ॥
tatra yuktasvarūpā vai vasanti kalpaśākhinaḥ ।
tatputrī śrīḥ sadā tatra vartate vai kumārikā ॥ 3 ॥
divyabhūmisvarūpā ca divyā vibhūtirasti ca ।
cetanādhiṣṭhitā devī sarvādhārasvarūpiṇī ॥ 4 ॥
tasyā vibhūteḥ putrī ca māṇikyā'sti kumārikā ।
divyadugdhā'mṛtābdhiśca vaikuṇṭhe tatra vartate ॥ 5 ॥
tasya putrī kumārī ca lakṣmīstvadātmikā'sti ca ।
tā etāstisra īśvaryo rājante dhāmni tatra vai ॥ 6 ॥
sakhyastisraḥ savayasyāḥ kumāryo'tīva komalāḥ ।
māṇikyā śrīśca lakṣmīśca brahmavetryo'bhavan sadā ॥ 7 ॥
brahmātmajñānayoginyo bhaktimatyaśca vai harau ।
kurvanti sevanaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ ॥ 8 ॥
tasyaiva pratimāṃ nityaṃ gṛhe dhyāyanti bhāvataḥ ।
divyavibhūtiḥ kalpadruḥ kṣīrābdhiśceti te trayaḥ ॥ 9 ॥
putrīṇāṃ dhyānasevādi dṛṣṭvā tuṣyanti vai muhuḥ ।
vitarantyāśiṣastābhyo bhavantyānandamūrtayaḥ ॥ 10 ॥
anantadhāmasu kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ santi tvanekaśaḥ ।
bhavatyaśca bhavantyeva parabrahmapriyāḥ parāḥ ॥ 1 1॥
rājādhirājarūpiṇyo yābhyo nānyāḥ parāḥ kvacit ।
iti pitrāśiṣaḥ prāptā dīvyanti nityavardhitāḥ ॥ 12॥
prātaḥ snānti hariṃ smṛtvā dhyāyanti ca hariṃ tataḥ ।
kurvanti maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ vidyuttoraṇasūjjvalam ॥ 1 3॥
vicitraratnamaṇibhirnaddhastaṃbhādimaṇḍitam ।
kṛtrimodyānasaṃvyāptaṃ divyāmbaravibhūṣitam ॥ 14॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiśobhitaṃ sarvato diśi ।
madhye siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ maṇisvarṇādirājitam ॥ 15॥
sthāpayanti ca tāstatra tūlikāśca sukhāvahāḥ ।
mūrtiṃ vinyasya tanmadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ ॥ 16॥
snāpayanti kṣīradhārābhiścādbhiḥ snāpayanti ca ।
sugandhaṃ candanaṃ tailaṃ mardayanti ca tā muhuḥ ॥ 17॥
snāpayitvā ca vastrāṇi divyāni dadati prage ।
dhārayanti vibhūṣāśca śṛgāraṃ dhārayanti ca ॥ 18॥
patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistoyaiḥ pūjayanti muhurmuhuḥ ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sugandhaṃ ca kurvanti kṛṣṇasannidhau ॥ 1 9॥
saṃvāhayanti caraṇau gṛhṇanti caraṇāmṛtam ।
jighranti tā bhaktimatyo gandhaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādajam ॥20॥
paśyanti tā hareḥ rūpaṃ spṛśanti kṛṣṇapatkajam ।
āsvādayanti pūjāyāṃ dattaṃ phalādikaṃ tu yat ॥21 ॥
śṛṇvanti bhagavatstotraṃ gītaṃ paraspareṇa yat ।
vadanti guṇacāritryaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ ॥22॥
ādadati hareḥ kārye gacchanti ca pradakṣiṇam ।
vilāsaṃ hāvabhāvādi tathā''nandaṃ ca mānasam ॥23॥
cintanaṃ nirṇayaṃ svatvaṃ kurvanti kṛṣṇayogajam ।
miṣṭānnāmṛtapātrāṇi jalapātrāṇi tatpuraḥ ॥24॥
svarṇasthālāni naivedyapūritāni daduśca tāḥ ।
bhojayanti bhāvapūrṇaṃ rāmayanti hariṃ punaḥ ॥25॥
vāripānaṃ kārayanti ramante tā hareḥ puraḥ ।
vādayanti pravādyāni kurvantyārārtrikaṃ mudā ॥26॥
namanti haraye tāśca praśaṃsanti ca tadguṇān ।
varṇayanti caritrāṇi kathayanti kathānakam ॥27॥
bhāvayanti kṛṣṇahṛccārpayanti hṛdayaṃ harau ।
puṣpāṃjalipradānaiśca toṣayanti narāyaṇam ॥28॥
stuvanti paramātmānaṃ smarantyapyabhidhā hareḥ ।
dāsyaṃ kurvanti satataṃ sakhyaṃ cātmanivedanam ॥29॥
evaṃ bhaktimayaṃ divyaṃ kartavyamācaranti tāḥ ।
madhyāhnepi prapūjyainaṃ śrīḥ phalānyarpayaṃtyapi ॥30॥
kalpadrukanyakā kalpapādapebhyo nayaṃtyapi ।
uttamaṃ cottamaṃ ramyaṃ surasaṃ miṣṭamamblakam ॥3 1॥
navaṃ navaṃ phalaṃ vṛkṣaputrī śrīrarpayatyapi ।
kadalāni supakvāni kadalībhyo'bhigṛhya sā ॥32॥
āhṛtya cāmravṛkṣebhyaścāmrāṇi tūttamāni ca ।
karmadebhyaḥ karmadāni cāmblamiṣṭānyavāpya ca ॥33॥
karkaṭikāśca vallībhya āhṛtya pakvasadrasāḥ ।
kaliṃgāni supakvāni śaityāvahāni yānyapi ॥34॥
kapitthāni ca taddrubhyaḥ pakvānyānīya cāpyatha ।
kājūphalāni miṣṭāni kājū drubhyo'bhihṛtya ca ॥35॥
kaṭīṅgudībhya āhṛtya kaṭīṅgundīphalāni ca ।
iṅgudāni mahāntyeva pakvasnigdharasāni ca ॥36॥
āhṛtyā'rpayati śrīśca bhuṃkte nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
aṃjīrāṇi sumiṣṭāni drākṣāṇi surasāni ca ॥37॥
kharjūrakhārikādīni tālāni śrīphalāni ca ।
bhūphalāni sumiṣṭāni cikkaṇāni phalāni ca ॥38॥
kṣīrikāṇi piśaṃgāni panasāni mahānti ca ।
garjarāṇi vividhāni ghṛtaghaṭāni caiva ha ॥39॥
śiṅgavaḥ pakvāstathā jambūphalāni rāvaṇāni ca ।
amṛtāni sumiṣṭāni ṭiṭīmā miṣṭasadrasāḥ ॥40 ॥
dāḍimāni cekṣudaṇḍān badarāṇi navāni ca ।
ṭimbūravāँśca madhukān badāmān bahubījakān ॥41॥
rāmaphalāni ca sītāphalāni madhurāṇi ca ।
naspatīna santarāँścāpi jambīrāṇi ca puppinān ॥42॥
cirbhaṭāni ca saphalajanāni ṭimṭimāni ca ।
navaraṃgāni cānyāni phalānyāhṛtya śrīrdadau ॥43॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya śrīpuruṣottamamūrtaye ।
bhagavānapi bhāvena samattiśryarpitāni vai ॥44॥
divyavibhūtikanyā tu māṇikyā bhagavatkṛte ।
samānayati ratnāni dhārayatyacyutaṃ svayam ॥45॥
ratnamālāstathā muktāhārān mauktikakaṃkaṇān ।
vajramaṇīn padmarāgamaṇīn marakatān maṇīn ॥46॥
indranīlamaṇīṃścāpi kaustubhān bhīṣmakāँstathā ।
vaidūryānpuṣparāgāँśca karketakān suvarṇakān ॥47॥
hāritān pulakāँścaiva rudhirān sphaṭikāँstathā ।
vidrumāँśca pravālāँśca māṇikyān citrakāँstathā ॥48॥
gomedāँśca mahānīlān kūpyāँścādāya sandadau ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāni maṇiratnamayāni ca ॥49॥
bhūṣaṇāni dhṛtavāँśca prasanno'bhūdatīva saḥ ।
atha kṣīrābdhikanyā vai lakṣmīḥ kṣairāṇi bhāvukī ॥50॥
bhojanaṃ kārayāmāsa pāyayāmāsa tāni vai ।
dugdhasāraṃ pāyasānnaṃ dugdhapākaṃ sataṇḍulam ॥5 1॥
dugdhastaraṃ dugdhamanthaṃ dugdhaghaṭṭa payobalim ।
dugdhakvāthaṃ dugdhapiṇḍān dugdhamallayinīṃ śubhām ॥52॥
dadhi sarpirvṛtaṃ takraṃ navanītaṃ payaḥpuṭam ।
kṣīraudanaṃ payomiśraṃ payaḥpānādikaṃ dadau ॥53॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastattad bhuktavān pītavāँśca vai ।
kṣīrotpannāni ratnāni dadau sā vividhāni ca ॥54॥
śriyā māṇikyayā lakṣmyā yānyarpitāni bhāvataḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāni jagrāha bhāvapūritaḥ ॥55॥
phalāni ratnāni ca pāyasāni bhuṃkte dadhātyatti ca bhāvagarbham ।
śriyaṃ ca maṇikyavarāṃ ca lakṣmīṃ sevāparāṃ vīkṣya haristutoṣa ॥56॥
sāyaṃ ca tāḥ pūrvavadeva pūjanaṃ cakruḥ samārādhanatatparāḥ sutāḥ ।
nīrājanaṃ bhojanamanyadarpaṇaṃ sadaiva cakrurbahubhaktibhāvataḥ ॥57॥
caturdaśyāmadhimāse madhyāhne pūjanottaram ।
śrutastābhirdundubhiśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya hi ॥58॥
kurvantu pūjanaṃ nityaṃ kurvantvārādhanaṃ mama ।
arpayantu ca me kiñcitprāpnuvantu mama gṛham ॥59॥
puruṣottamasaṃjño'haṃ brahmadhāmādhipaḥ pumān ।
adhimāsādhidaivo'haṃ vadāmi tad dadāmi vai ॥6 0॥
golokasthā api yāśca vaikuṇṭhasthā api vratam ।
adhimāse caturdaśyāṃ kurvanti yāśca ye'pi ca ॥6 1 ॥
tāsāṃ teṣāṃ manolabhyaṃ kariṣye bhagavānaham ।
dāsyāmi paramaṃ dhāmā'kṣarātītanivāsanam ॥62॥
phalaiḥ ratnaiḥ pāyasānnaiḥ pūjayiṣyanti māṃ janāḥ ।
prāpsyanti paramaṃ dhāma yatrāsmi puruṣottamaḥ ॥6 3 ॥
anyebhyo dhāmavāsibhyaḥ sthitiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ dadāmyaham ।
gṛhṇantu bhaktimatyo me bhaktāśca paramaṃ padam ॥64॥
nedṛśaṃ tvasti vaikuṇṭhaṃ golokaścāpi naiva ha ।
mama dhāmnā samaṃ tvanyad vidyate naiva naiva ca ॥65 ॥
na matsamo vā'pyadhiko'sti kaścit, na brahmaṇā sannibhamasti kiñcit ।
nānyatsukhe matsukhasāmyamasti, svalpapradānena lihantu cāryāḥ ॥66॥
bhavantu dāsyaḥ prabhavantu bhaktā, ānandamātrāṃ mama mūrtilabdhām ।
bhuñjantu nityaṃ mayi saṃramantu, caturdaśīsadvratakalpanena ॥67॥
mānavyo māṃ samārādhya bhavantu divi devatāḥ ।
devyaśca māṃ samārādhya bhavantvārṣiṇya eva ca ॥68॥
ārṣiṇyo māṃ samārādhya bhavantvīśānya eva vā ।
tvīśānyo māṃ samārādhya bhavantvīśvarya eva ca ॥69॥
īśvaryo māṃ samārādhya nārāyaṇyo bhavantu ca ।
nārāyaṇyaḥ samārādhya gopyo bhavantu māṃ mudā ॥70॥
tāśca sarvāḥ samārādhya māṃ varaṃ puruṣottamam ।
bhavantu puruṣottamyo nityamuktānya eva ha ॥7 1 ॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ māṃ vai saṃrādhya puruṣottamam ।
mamā'kṣaraṃ paraṃ dhāma gṛhṇantu madvratārthinaḥ ॥72॥
caturdaśyāmadhimāse vrataṃ śrīpuruṣottame ।
kṛtaṃ yenā'rjitaṃ tena māmakaṃ sarvameva ha ॥73 ॥
vacmi vacmi punarvacmi hyāgacchantu mayā saha ।
bhavane tvakṣare me vai nivasantu mayā saha ॥74॥
tuṣṭo'smi garjanāṃ kṛtvā kathayāmi punaḥ punaḥ ।
adhimāse caturdaśyāṃ yāntu vratena madgṛham ॥75॥
vaikuṇṭhe dundubhiṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tāḥ ।
saharṣāḥ satvaraṃ tatra yayuryatrā'sti ghoṣakṛt ॥76 ॥
śrīśca hṛṣṭā ca māṇikyā lakṣmīrhṛṣṭā hṛdantare ।
natvā natvā punarnatvā prāhustaṃ dundubhiṃ hareḥ ॥77॥
nārāyaṇasya vaikuṇṭhe vasāmo'tra mahāsukhe ।
tato'tiśreṣṭhasaubhāgyaṃ prayacchati yadi prabhuḥ ॥78॥
kanyakā smo vayaṃ kurmo'rcanaṃ tasya hareḥ sadā ।
adya vrataṃ caturdaśyāḥ kurmo'dhimāsi nirṇayāt ॥79॥
kadā'kṣarādhipaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo miliṣyati ।
kadā neṣyati paramaḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥80 ॥
dundubhistu tadākarṇya prāha tāścā'dya vai prabhuḥ ।
niśi pūjottaraṃ tvāyāsyati kurvantu jāgaram ॥8 1 ॥
stuvantu paramātmānaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ janārdanam ।
bhavatīnāṃ saphalāśca prabhavantu manorathāḥ ॥82॥
ityuktvā'kṣatapuṣpaiśca pūjito dundubhiryayau ।
kanyāḥ pupūjuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ niśīthe pratighasravat ॥83॥
jāgaraṃ tatra kurvantyaḥ śrīścakāra sunartanam ।
vādyaṃ tvavādayattatra māṇikyā tālasaṃyutam ॥84॥
lakṣmīstu gāyanaṃ cakre tisraśca militā jaguḥ ।
susvaraiśca naddhakiṃkiṇikā nūpurakaṃkaṇaiḥ ॥85॥
satya brahmā'kṣaraparamaparaṃ lokeśaṃ paralokeśaṃ, nityaṃ jñānamanantamapāramanekākāraṃ kamaleśam ।
śāntaṃ bhāskarakāntamaghanutaṃ brahmānandamahānandaṃ, parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ॥86॥
dhāmni brahmā'kṣaramukteśvarapārṣadavṛndārcitacaraṇaṃ, caitanyāmṛtadhāmavirājitamukteśaikasudhākaraṇam ।
śrīvatsāṃkaviraṃcigirīśanatāṃ'ghritalaṃ suhṛdānandaṃ, parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ॥87॥
divyā'khaṇḍamanantamunīśvaramaṇḍalamadhyagatākāraṃ, nigamāgamapaṭalairabhivedyaṃ sākāraṃ paramākāram ।
divyavihāramanudbhavarūpamanādiṃ divyaguṇāgāraṃ, parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ॥88॥
saumyābhaṃ cinmālākuṇḍalamukuṭapiśaṃgasuceladharam, sarvajñāmitaśaktiyutaṃ harikṛṣṇamacintyānandakaram।
nigamāgamavanditayaśasaṃ śaṃsantaṃ dharmaṃ vedamatam, parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ॥89॥
lokālokavibhāsivibhūtimalokanivāsamanirvācyaṃ, janmādyasya yato bhagavantamaśaraṇādhāraṃ vṛṣalālam ।
kṛṣṇaṃ karuṇārasamayarūpaṃ dīnadayāluṃ devavaraṃ, parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ॥90 ॥
bhāsvarakārtasvaravidyunmaṇibhāskaracandraviśeṣābhaṃ, sadrūpaṃ ghanavarṇamatarkyamajaṃ hṛtsthaṃ tribhuvananābham ।
śyāmasaroruhadalasamanayanaṃ smerāsyaṃ sarvānandaṃ, parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ॥9 1॥
śyāmaṃ vyāpakamuttamapuruṣaṃ paramātmānaṃ sukhakandaṃ, svāṃghrisarojasamudbhavakāntidyotitayāvajjanavṛndam ।
satyaṃ nārāyaṇaparameśvaramāyeśeśvaramuktavaraṃ, parameśvaramabhivande prāvirbhāveśvaraparamānandam ॥92॥
kalpadrumaduhitā śrīrnityaṃ dhyāyati vallabhamātmānaṃ, divyavibhūtisutā māṇikyā prārthayati svāmyātmānam ।
divyakṣīrābdhiduhitā lakṣmīrapi cecchati patimanaghaṃ, puruṣottamamakṣaradhāmasthaṃ sa tvaṃ bhavasi bhavārthakaraḥ ॥93॥
karān gṛhāṇa cāsmākaṃ mā vai muñca kadācana ।
yāvadvai te'kṣaraṃ dhāma tāvatpatnyo bhavāmahe ॥94॥
śīghraṃ kuru kṛpānātha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ।
varamālā gṛhāṇā'smaddhastebhyaścaikakālikāḥ ॥95॥
iti stutvā ca tāstisro viramustāvadeva tu ।
prāvirbabhūva bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ॥96॥
sarvāvirbhāvaheturyaḥ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।
sarveśeśeśvaraḥ śreṣṭhabrahma śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥97॥
śvetahastiyutaṃ yānaṃ vimānākhyaṃ cidambare ।
vāhayan yojanakoṭivistṛtaṃ muktapūritam ॥98॥
tisra āśvāsya vaikuṇṭhe kalpadrūn divyabhūtikam ।
kṣīrābdhiṃ ca namaskṛtya vidhinā taiḥ samarpitāḥ ॥99॥
pitṛbhistvarthitaḥ kṛṣṇe jagrāha tisṛkanyakāḥ ।
kintvasmābhirviyogo mā syāttathā kuru keśava ॥ 100 ॥
kare karān samādāya grahītā hariṇā tadā ।
śrīśca lakṣmīśca māṇikyā kṛṣṇātulyā virejire ॥ 10 1॥
tāsāṃ dvedve svarūpe ca kārayitvā pumuttamaḥ ।
chāyārūpa trayaṃ tāsāṃ pitradhīnaṃ surakṣya ca ॥ 1 02॥
divyarūpaṃ trayaṃ tāsāṃ puruṣottamayogyakam ।
akṣaradhāmavāsārhaṃ patnīrūpaṃ pragṛhya ca ॥ 103॥
tisra ārohayitvaiva vimāne puruṣottamaḥ ।
yayau divyākṣaraṃ dhāma patnīyuktaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ॥ 1 04॥
evaṃ cādhikamāsasya caturdaśyā vratena tāḥ ।
śrīśca lakṣmīśca māṇikyā tisraḥ patnyo hareḥ sadā ॥ 1 05॥
babhūvuḥ śāśvate dhāmni kimatra khalu durlabham ।
śroturvaktarapi tvevaṃ phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥ 1 06॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vaikuṇṭhe dundubhiśravaṇena kalpadruma- putryāḥ śriyaḥ divyavibhūteḥ putryā māṇikyāyāḥ, divyakṣīrodadhiputryā lakṣmyāśca, adhikamāsasya caturdaśyā vratenā'kṣaradhāmni parabrahmapuruṣottama-śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnītvaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.306 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 306 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 307
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 308 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dharmapatnyā bhakteḥ putryo kathāṃ śubhām ।
adhimāse madhyatithau jātāṃ vai pāvanottamām ॥ 1 ॥
ādau kṛte yuge bhaktermānasyau dve kumārike ।
prāvirbhūte sute nāmnā preyasī śreyasī hyubhe ॥ 2 ॥
sevete pitarau nityaṃ yatra tau tatra te hyubhau ।
pitarau te parityajya prāṇān dhartuṃ na śekatuḥ ॥ 3 ॥
pitṛsevāpare nityaṃ svakartavyaparāyaṇe ।
prātaḥ snātvā ca te pitroḥ pādayornematuḥ sadā ॥ 4 ॥
pitroḥ snānādividhyarthaṃ dadatuśca jalādikam ।
snāpayitvā ca vastrāṇi dadaturdhāraṇāya te ॥ 5 ॥
candanā'kṣatasumanaḥ kuṃkumādyaiḥ pupūjatuḥ ।
sumiṣṭamṛṣṭanaivedyaṃ phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ jalam ॥ 6 ॥
samarpya cakratuścobhe varṣmasaṃvāhanādikam ।
mātāpitroryadiṣṭaṃ cakratuścānyadvihāya te ॥ 7 ॥
śayanāstaraṇādyaṃ ca pātrāṇāṃ maṃjanaṃ tathā ।
gṛhasya mārjanaṃ vastrakṣālanaṃ tvannapācanam ॥ 8 ॥
jalasyā''haraṇaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ dohanādikam ।
annānāṃ śodhanaṃ pūjāpuṣpādyānayanaṃ tathā ॥ 9 ॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantrajapanaṃ devapūjanam ।
pitṛsantarpaṇaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ cātithipūjanam ॥ 1 0॥
dānaṃ jñānaṃ cātmabodhaṃ vijñānaṃ brāhmamityapi ।
evaṃ sarve gṛhakārye pitroḥ sevāṃ muhustathā ॥ 1 1॥
yathāpekṣaṃ tathā'nyacca cakratuśca divāniśam ।
tenā''śīrvādapātre te babhūvaturbahupriye ॥ 12॥
yathā nāma tathā tatra guṇā vāsaṃ pracakrire ।
yathābalaṃ yathāśakti sarvabhāvena sundarī ॥ 1 3॥
anādṛtyaiva dehaṃ svaṃ kaṣṭaṃ yatra divāniśam ।
sarvasvabhogadānena sevayā preyasī sadā ॥ 14॥
atipriyā hyatipremapātraṃ pitrorbabhūva sā ।
preyasī tena sā bhuktiriti khyātiṃ jagāma sā ॥ 15॥
pitroḥ śreyaḥ pareṣāṃ ca śreyaḥkartrī sadā'parā ।
kanyakā''rtijanānāṃ ca vidhūyā''rtīn muhurmuhuḥ ॥ 16॥
sukhaṃ mokṣasamaṃ samyak karotīti sukarmabhiḥ ।
śreyasī tena sā muktiriti khyātiṃ yayāvapi ॥ 17॥
preyasīśreyasīputryau dharmabhaktyoḥ kṛpākaṇāt ।
bhuktirmuktiśceti divye nāmnī dadhyaturarthavat ॥ 18॥
yayoḥ pitā svayaṃ dharmo jananī bhaktiraiśvarī ।
nidhānaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ kimāścaryaṃ tayorguṇe ।।19।।
pitroḥ pavitrayoḥ sevā kaṃ na dhatte guṇottamam ।
pitarau toṣitau yena toṣitastena mādhavaḥ ॥20।।
toṣitāśca surāḥ sarve toṣitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ।
athā'putravatoḥ pitrostoṣadā syāt sutā yadi ॥21॥
sā vai putrasamā proktā pitarau tāritau tayā ।
yayā tvatra svakau vṛddhau pitarau toṣitau dhiyā ॥22॥
sāsti putranibhā putrī dāyabhāgādhikāriṇī ।
dehe yadyapi kanyā sā hṛdaye suta ātmani ॥23 ॥
sutavat sā sadā rakṣyā tayā svarge tayordhruvam ।
tayā dattaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ dānaṃ pitroḥ prayāti hi ॥24॥
yasya santi na vai putrāḥ putrī tasya kriyāścaret ।
yaśaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ॥25॥
sarvaṃ kuryād vidhiṃ putrī dhārayedupavītakam ।
tiṣṭhecca brahmacarye sā yāvat pitroḥ prasevanam ॥26॥
jāte putre'thavā''datte paścāt pitrājñayā'pi sā ।
brahmacaryaṃ prasamāpya vidhinā syād vivāhitā ॥27॥
brahmacaryasthitau jāte rājasvalyādyaśuddhike ।
brahmacaryasya tapasaḥ prābalyena na dūṣaṇam ॥28॥
aśuddhiḥ pālanīyā syād yāvaddinacatuṣṭayam ।
vārṣalyaṃ vānyadoṣo vā pāpaṃ vā nāsti tatkṛte ॥29॥।
brahmacaryāgninā sarvaṃ daihyaṃ saṃyāti bhasmatām ।
brahmacaryasamo dharmo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ॥3 0॥
kanyāṃ vā lagnayuktāṃ vā hyadhavāṃ vā dhavānvitām ।
ayogāṃ vā sayogāṃ vā pāvayed brahmacaryakam ॥3 1॥
brahmacarye brahmabhaktirbrahmavrataṃ ca yatra vai ।
tatra brahmātiriktaṃ vai bhasmasād yāti vaiśasam ॥32॥
bījaghnatvaṃ rajoghnatvaṃ ṛtughnatvādi dūṣaṇam ।
brahmacarye bhūṣaṇaṃ tad bījādi mokṣakṛddhi tat ॥33 ॥
evaṃ te kanyake pitroḥ sevāṃ cakraturādarāt ।
brahmacaryasthite nityaṃ dharmabhaktigṛhe śubhe ॥ 34॥
prātaste satyaloke vai svarṇadyāṃ snātumāgate ।
tābhyāṃ tu dundubhiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya saṃśrutaḥ ॥ 35॥
dhāmnāṃ dhāmnyavatārāṇāmavatārī pumuttamaḥ ।
atrādhike mahāmāse dadāmi puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 36॥
madhyatithervratakartre'kṣaraṃ dhāma ca sampadaḥ ।
matsānnidhyaṃ mama rūpaṃ madaiśvaryaṃ dadāmi ca ॥ 37॥
mama sāmyaṃ mama rājyaṃ mama lokaṃ dadāmi ca ।
mama yogaṃ mama śaktiṃ divyatāṃ me dadāmi ca ॥38॥
madaṃkaṃ mama mūrtiṃ ca matsamakhyātimityapi ।
matsamā pūjyatāṃ caiva śreṣṭhatāṃ ca dadāmi vai ॥39॥
madbhāvaṃ mama divyatvaṃ mama tejo dadāmi ca ।
mama siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ madvad vyāpakatāṃ tathā ॥40 ॥
madātmakatvaṃ tādātmyaṃ madhyāvrate dadāmi ca ।
ahaṃ pūrṇo'rdhamāse'tra vrataṃ puṣṭaphalapradam ॥4 1 ॥
śāśvataṃ satphalaṃ dāsye gṛhṇantu cārjayantu ca ।
puruṣottamamāso'yaṃ mama māso'sti cottamaḥ ॥42॥
tadekadinajaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvebhyo'pyatiricyate ।
aśāśvatāni cānyāni hyetatpuṇyaṃ tu śāśvatam ॥43॥
ahaṃ vai śāśvato devo māso'pi mama śāśvataḥ ।
vrataṃ ca śāśvataṃ me'sti puṇyaṃ gṛhṇantu śāśvatam ॥44॥
mātā santoṣitā yena bhaktyā saṃtoṣitaḥ pitā ।
mātāpitṛprasādena phalaṃ gṛhṇantu śāśvatam ॥45॥
yatheṣṭaṃ kalpayitvaiva kurvantu madhyamāvratam ।
pūrayiṣyāmi saṃkalpān yogyān yogyetarānapi ॥46॥
dundubhiḥ śrāvayitvaivaṃ kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ dadhāra ca ।
kanyādattaṃ patrapuṣpaphalaṃ tvādāya niryayau ॥47॥
kanyake kṛtasaṃkalpe madhyātithervratāya vai ।
gatvā gṛhaṃ ca vidhivat pūjayāmāsatuḥ prabhum ॥48॥
sauvarṇī pratimāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya śobhanām ।
kārayitvā''vāhanaṃ cakratuḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ॥49॥
krameṇa pūjanaṃ yogyaṃ prathamaṃ payāadinā ।
pañcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya kārayāmāsatustataḥ ॥50 ॥
tīrthodakena saṃsnānaṃ mārjayāmāsatustataḥ ।
vastreṇā'ṅgaṃ ca dhautrādi dhārayāmāsatustataḥ ॥5 1 ॥
bhūṣayāmāsaturābhūṣaṇaiścandanakajjalaiḥ ।
śṛṃgārayāmāsatuśca puṣpahārādibhistataḥ ॥52॥
śobhayāmāsatuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dravottamaiḥ ।
nugandhayāmāsatuśca gandhasārādibhiśca te ॥53॥
kuṃkumā'kṣatatulasīpatrādi śekharādikam ।
arpayāmāsatustasmai puruṣottamarūpiṇe ॥54॥
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ sunaivedyaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ pāyasādikam ।
nivedayāmāsatuśca phalaṃ tāmbūlacūrṇakam ॥55॥
pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca namaskāraṃ kṣamāpanam ।
ārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dadaturādarāt ॥56॥
arghyaṃ datvā ca saṃkalpaṃ puruṣottamalabdhikam ।
vijñāpayāmāsatuśca hṛdā prārthanayā muhuḥ ॥57॥
kumārītvaṃ sadākālaṃ yogyaṃ vai brahmadhāmani ।
muktatvaṃ tatra yogyaṃ vai divyāvasthādiśobhitam ॥58॥
brahmacaryaṃ brahmarūpaṃ brahmaiva parameśvaraḥ ।
āvayoḥ rakṣakaścā'stu kṛṣṇanārāyāṇo hariḥ ॥59॥
rakṣakaḥ prerako dhātā vidhātā dhārako hi saḥ ।
poṣakaḥ sahajo nāthaḥ sarveśvareśvareśvaraḥ ॥60 ॥
akṣarādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇo brahmeśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
nāthaḥ pātā taṃ vinā'nyaḥ kaścitpātā'sti nā''vayoḥ ॥6 1॥
kṛpānātha kriyānātha yatnanātha phalaprada ।
varṣmanāthā''tmanornātha sarvanāthā'kṣaraṃ naya ॥62॥
tava svo dāsike kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa hṛdisthita ।
antaryāmin vratapuṇyapradātarhṛdayaṃgama! ॥63॥
hṛnnivāsa hṛdayajña bhāvajña pūrayā''ntaram ।
karau saṃgṛhya nau kṛṣṇa śīghraṃ nayā'kṣaraṃ prabho ॥64॥
iti stutvā dadatuste svakṣatān mūrtaye yadā ।
tāvattatra dayāluḥ sa āvirbabhūva sundaraḥ ॥65॥
kiśoro divyarūpaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
gajapṛṣṭhe sthito divyarūpānuvayavaḥ pumān ॥66॥
yatkeśānāṃ prāntabhāgāḥ koṭividyutsamojjvalāḥ ।
āmūlāt snigdhakṛṣṇābhā mañjulāśca taraṃgitāḥ ॥67॥
camatkṛtiṃbharā bhaṃgīśobhitāstasya mūrdhajāḥ ।
paścāttu karṇayormadhye prānte'pyākarṣakāḥ śubhāḥ ॥68॥
lalāṭaphalakaṃ cordhvarekhācandravirājitam ।
bhrūdhanuḥkoṭikāmānāṃ śubhaṃ garvāpahārakam ॥69॥
bhāle'vicchinnasadrekha brahmamārgaprasūcikā ।
karṇayornikaṣā gatvā lokadvayavibodhikā ॥70॥
śaṣkulīdvayaśobhāḍhyau karṇau mohakarāvubhau ।
suraktapuṇḍarīkābhe netre dve sudalāyate ॥71॥
vidyutsamātisūkṣmābhā rekhāḥ santi manoharāḥ ।
ākarṇāntaṃ sakoṇaṃ ca bhāvagarbhaṃ ca kāminam ॥72॥
ehyāgaccheti hṛdayasthitasya vyañjakaṃ hi tat ।
surakta pronnataṃ hāsyabodhakaṃ netragaṇḍakam ॥73॥
tasyāsīnnāsikā ramyā tilapuṣpasamākṛtiḥ ।
oṣṭhau pakvasuraktāḍhya bimbatulyau babhūvatuḥ ॥74॥
sūkṣma ramyā nātigamyā śmaśrurekhā sma rājate ।
kambukaṇṭhaḥ puṣṭavakṣāḥ skandhau puṣṭau tathā hareḥ ॥75॥
bhujaṃgabhogavaddhastau nakhacandrāvaliśrayau ।
dhvajadhanurmahāmīnabāṇasvastikarājitau ॥76॥
śūlacakrābdhijarekhānvitau karāñjalī hareḥ ।
romarājimayau śubhraraktaraṃgau karāvubhau ॥77॥
śrīvatsakaustubhalakṣmīrekhāhāramuraḥsthalam ।
udaraṃ trivalīśobhaṃ nābhau brahmāsanaṃ śubham ॥78॥
kaṭiḥ kṛśā tathā guptaṃ saccidānandapūritam ।
hastikaropame ramye sakthinī romarājite ॥79॥
jānū ca vartulau tasya jaṅghe puṣṭottare kṛśe ।
gulphatrayaṃ pratipādaṃ madhyonnataṃ prakāśakṛt ॥80॥
ṣoḍaśāṃkasurekhābhī rājannakhamaṇiprabham ।
sarvaṃ dvyaṣṭasamaṃ puṣṭaṃ tejaḥpūritavigraham ॥81॥
surūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya paramādbhutam ।
apaśyatāṃ ca te kanye preyasīśreyasī hyubhe ॥82॥
jaharṣatuśca vai tatra prāpya śrīpuruṣottamam ।
puṣpamāle dhārayāmāsatuḥ kaṇṭhe harerubhe ॥83 ॥
ubhe ca ' sannidhau tasya sthite bhāvā''rdratāṃ gate ।
hariste prāha bhaktyā me vratenā'tha ca bhāvataḥ ॥84॥
vāṃ nayāmi mama dhāmā'kṣaraṃ sukhasupūritam ।
mayi tādātmyabhāvena vāṃ nayāmi ca varṣmaṇī ॥85॥
ityuktvā bhagavāँstatra tirobabhūva tatkṣaṇam ।
te hyubhe cāti saṃvigne hyabhūtāṃ tadviyogataḥ ॥86॥
madhyāhne tādṛśīṃ pūjāṃ sāyaṃ cāpi tathā niśi ।
cakraturvidhinā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya jāgaram ॥87॥
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ divyaṃ cakraturmadhyarātrike ।
tāvatpunaḥ samāyāto drutaṃ rātrau mahāprabhuḥ ॥88॥
svajyotsnāvyāptadhavalaḥ sarveṣāṃ śreyasāṃkaraḥ ।
yathā prāptastathā rātrau rājate sma hariḥ svayam ॥89॥
gṛhe tatrotsave prāptaṃ jñātvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
dharmo bhaktiśca taṃ natvā jñātvā śrīharimāgatam ॥90 ॥
putrīdvayaṃ svakaṃ dhāma netumājñāṃ pracakratuḥ ।
preyasī śreyasī prāpya hariṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ॥9 1 ॥
kṛtakṛtye'tisampanne'kṣare dhāmni virājite ।
bhuktirmuktiśca te khyāte divye dhāmani tatra vai ॥ 92॥
dharmabhaktyośca sevārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena ca ।
dvedhā rūpe ca te kṛtvā'rpite pitrorgṛhe'pi ca ॥93॥
yatra dharmaśca bhaktiśca tatra bhuktiśca muktikā ।
loke'pi dve ca vartaṃte vartete cāpi dhāmani ॥ 94॥
te'śnuvāte sarvakāmān brahmaṇā saha śāśvatān ।
evaṃ te prāptavatyau vai dhāma śrīparamātmanaḥ ॥ 95॥
yaścātra dharmavān bhaktimāँśca syātparameśvare ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sa cāsādya modate brahmaṇā saha ॥96 ॥
preyasīṃ śreyasīṃ prāpya modate'kṣaradhāmani ।
śrotā vaktā'sya labhate pūrṇaṃ vrataphalaṃ priye ॥ 97॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmabhaktyormānasīputryoḥ preyasī-śreyasyoḥ pitṛsevā, māsamadhyamāyāstithervratenā'kṣaradhāmni śrīpuruṣottamaprāptiḥ, bhuktimuktiriti khyātiścetyādi-nirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikatriśata-tamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.307॥


← adhyāyaḥ 307 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 308
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 309 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! brahmaviṣṇumaheśajanakasya vai ।
vairājapuruṣasyāpi vairājñyāptirvratādyathā ॥ 1 ॥
prākṛtapuruṣasyā'sti putraḥ pradhānapūruṣaḥ ।
tasya hiraṇyagarbhākhyo mahāviṣṇuḥ suto'sti vai ॥ 2 ॥
tato virāḍajāyata vairājo vedhasaḥ pitā ।
tasyāyuḥ śatavarṣaṃ vai tasyaiva varṣasaṃkhyayā ॥ 3 ॥
yadā pūrṇaṃ bhavatyeva tasyāsti nidhanaṃ tataḥ ।
vairājo'nyaśca tatpaścād vairājyaṃ pratipadyate ॥ 4 ॥
evaṃ vai kramaśaḥ sṛṣṭau vairājānāmasaṃkhyatā ।
pāramparyapravāheṇa mahāviṣṇordine dine ॥ 5 ॥
ekaikasya vināśo'sti vairājasyeśvarasya vai ।
mahāviṣṇorvarṣamadhye pañcaṣaṣṭyadhitriṃśatam ॥ 6 ॥
vairājānāṃ bhavaṃtyeva krameṇa śatavarṣake ।
ṣaṭatriṃśattu sahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni vai ॥ 7 ॥
vairājānāṃ bhavantyeva tatsarvaṃ vedmyahaṃ priye! ।
asya vai vartamānasya vairājasya kathāṃ śṛṇu ॥ 8 ॥
mahāviṣṇostu sāmrājye aiśvarīsṛṣṭike stare ।
aṣṭāvaraṇapāre vai tvasmātpūrvo virāṭ pumān ॥ 9 ॥
svasyā'ntimasya varṣasyā'ntimāhnastvantimakṣaṇe ।
vartamāne'ntimavedhobrahmāṇḍe'stamanakṣaṇe ॥ 10 ॥
samrāḍāsītsahasrākṣā'bhidhaścakrapravartakaḥ ।
bhaktimān sa sahasrākṣaḥ satye pātālake bhuvi ॥ 11 ॥
vimānena sadā yāti śṛṇoti vyomatantunā ।
svacchadravyeṇa saṃcaṣṭe spṛśati kṣipravāyunā ॥ 1 2 ॥
kṣaṇena sarvalokānāṃ vyavahāraṃ karoti ca ।
sarvasādhanayuktasya gantavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ॥ 13 ॥
sthitvaikatra gṛhe tasya prajāścaturdiśāsthitāḥ ।
vyavaharantīva nikaṣā vidanti karagaṃ yathā ॥ 14॥
sahasrākṣaḥ svayaṃ - satyaloke saṃsadi vedhasaḥ ।
yātyāyāti yathākālaṃ pūritāyāṃ mahājanaiḥ ॥ 15॥
dikpālairmanubhiścāpi sūryeṇa śaśinā tathā ।
ṛṣibhiśca mahādevaiḥ sārvabhaumairnṛpaistathā ॥ 16॥
tatrāsanaṃ svakīyaṃ sa na lebhe prathame sthale ।
iti vaiṣamyadoṣeṇa preritaḥ sa hṛdantare ॥ 17॥
āhūya brahmavijñānān papracchā'bhyudayaṃ prati ।
pārameṣṭhyādadhikaṃ cottamaṃ sthānaṃ milet katham ॥ 18 ॥
viprā vijñāpayāmāsustamadhvaravarān kuru ।
agniṣṭomaṃ vājapeyaṃ rājasūyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ॥ 19 ॥
mahāraudraṃ naramedhaṃ vājimedhaṃ vṛṣakratum ।
sautrāmaṇiṃ suteṣṭiṃ ca vahnihotraṃ japādikam ॥ 20 ॥
etān yajñān mahāraṃbhān śatasaṃvatsarān kuru ।
tena puṇyena te rājan pārameṣṭhyottaraṃ padam ॥ 21 ॥
bhaviṣyati dhruvaṃ rājyaṃ sthānaṃ kāraya tānmakhān ।
śate pūrṇe tvindrapadaṃ sahasre tu raveḥ sthalam ॥ 22॥
dhruvarājyamayute tu lakṣe tu vedhasaḥ sthalam ।
koṭiyajñeṣu pūrṇeṣu śatāsyabrahmaṇaḥ padam ॥ 23 ॥
yajñaparārdhe sampūrṇe vairājapadamāpyate ।
na tathā''yuśca samayaḥ kasyā'pyatra tu golake ॥ 2 4॥
tasmād rājaँstena dattaṃ bhuñjīthā bhava śāntimān ।
tṛṣṇāyāstu piśācinyā anto bhogena nāpyate ॥ 25 ॥
atraivāptān prabhogāँśca saṃprā'nubhūya sarvathā ।
rāgadveṣau mahādoṣau kṣapayitvā hitaṃ kuru ॥ 26॥
śreyaṃ matto mahānasti lakṣmyā buddhyā janaiśca vā ।
iti cintayiturnaiva sukhaprāptirbhavet kvacit ॥27॥
ahamasmi mahānātmā''nandena pūrito hareḥ ।
iti manturna vai duḥkhaṃ tṛṣṇādoṣādijaṃ bhavet ॥28।
anyeṣāmadhikaṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ mantavyameva na ।
svopārjitena yatprāptaṃ tat sukhaṃ śāntidaṃ matam ॥29।
yadṛcchayopapanne tu vastuni tūdyamārjite ।
alaṃbuddhirbhavedyasya sa sadātra sukhī bhavet ॥ 30।
trailokyā'hataśāstisāmrājyaṃ tavāsti vai dṛḍham ।
yadi nāptā tataḥ śāntiradhikāt kā bhaviṣyati ॥3 1।
ayaṃ mama paraśceti draṣṭurnāsti kvacit sukham ।
tāratamyaṃ tu sarvatra māyāloke'sti sarvathā ॥ 32
prakṛtau vikṛtau kārye niratikramavarjite ।
nahi kvāpi parā śāntirlabdhā kenāpi bhūpate ॥33।
na kaścillapsyate śāntiṃ yadi syātprakṛteḥ patiḥ ।
pradhānasya patirvāpi kā'nyasyātra kathā nṛpa ॥34॥
tasmācchāntiṃ labha rājan mā tṛṣṇāṃ vardhaya prabho ।
viremuśceti sandiśya brāhmaṇāḥ pāradarśinaḥ ॥35॥
sahasrākṣastu karṇau tānadatvaiva makhān bahūn ।
kārayāmāsa vidhivat pratyabdaṃ tu mahattamān ॥36॥
etaiḥ puṇyaṃ śatabrahmārjitaṃ prāptaṃ ca tena vai ।
athā''yuṣo'ntime varṣe'dhimāse'parapakṣake ॥37॥
dine pratipadi prātarhareḥ śuśrāva dundubhim ।
yajñeṣu vartamānasya sahasrākṣasya bhūpateḥ ॥38॥
puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiḥ śravaṇaṃ gataḥ ।
adhimāse dvitīye tu pakṣe vai pratipadgate ॥ 39॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarveśvaraḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
yadiṣṭaṃ yasya tad dāsye koṭikalpairalabhyakam ॥40॥
koṭiyajñaiḥ koṭidānairyadalabhyaṃ dadāmyaham ।
atra vrate prakartavyaṃ rājñā dānaṃ yathābalam ॥41।
pūjanaṃ me prakartavyaṃ yathālabdhopacārakaiḥ ।
bhojanaṃ me ca dātavyaṃ yathāyogyānnasadrasaiḥ ॥42।
dakṣiṇā me pradātavyā yathāśraddhā tathā dhanaiḥ ।
paropakāraḥ kartavyaḥ puruṣottamatuṣṭaye ॥43।
yadi samrāṭ sārvabhaumaścaturdaśabhuvāṃ patiḥ ।
yathāvibhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ pūjayeduttamottamaiḥ ॥44।
prātaḥ snānaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā pañcaratnajalena mām ।
sugandhasāravārbhiśca dantaśuddhiṃ prakārayet ॥45॥
sugandhaṃ mañjanaṃ dadyānnūtanaṃ dantadhāvanam।
sugandhajalagaṇḍūṣairjihvāśuddhyādi kārayet ॥ 46 ॥
puṣparasāgryasāraiśca sugandhibhirjalaiśca me ।
śaucādi kārayed rājā hastaśuddhyādi kārayet ॥47॥
candanāktasumṛdbhiścā'vayavānāṃ pavitratām ।
sugandhavāribhiścā'dbhiḥ kārayet snāpayettataḥ ॥48॥
dugdhena dadhnā cāpyekākṣareṇa madhunā tathā ।
śarkarābhiścāmṛtaiśca snāpayed vāribhistataḥ ॥49 ॥
sugandhitailasāraiśca mardanaṃ kārayennṛpaḥ ।
tīrthavārbhiḥ snāpayecca vastraiśca mārjayejjalam ॥5 0 ॥
atisūkṣmātimūlyaiḥ satsuvarṇatāracandrakaiḥ ।
mṛducitraiścātisūkṣmavastrairmāṃ śobhayet tataḥ ॥5 1 ॥
rājyāsanārhasauvarṇairmukuṭaiḥ kaṭakādibhiḥ ।
svarṇormikā śṛṃkhalādyaiḥ kuṇḍalairhāraśekharaiḥ ॥5 2॥
koṭyadhikairmaṇiratnairmauktikairnaddhabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
puṣparāgapravālaiśca vaidūryaiḥ sūryakāntakaiḥ ॥5 3 ॥
candrakāntairmārakatairmāṇikyaiḥ sphaṭikaistathā ।
vajrairgārutmatairmuktābhiśca satpadmarāgakaiḥ ॥54॥
indranīlaiḥ puṣparājaiḥ karketanaiśca bhīṣmakaiḥ ।
pulakaiḥ rudhiraiḥ svarṇai rājatairbhūṣaṇaistathā ॥55 ॥
sāmudrikaiḥ khanijaiśca vahnijaiḥ svarbhavaistathā ।
ratnamālāvibhūṣābhiḥ pūjayetparameśvaram ॥56 ॥
ūrṇāvastrottamaiścānyaiḥ kārpāsakaiśca kauśukaiḥ ।
vārkṣaiḥ suvarṇajaiścānyaiḥ rasajaistvakkṛtaiśca vai ॥57॥
vastraiḥ saṃśobhayet kṛṣṇaṃ tailaiḥ sugandhasārakaiḥ ।
kajjalairnavanītaiśca mardyadravyaiḥ sugandhakaiḥ ॥5 8॥
sagandhaṃ kārayet kṛṣṇaṃ kastūrīcandanādibhiḥ ।
karpūraiḥ kesarairmiśraiḥ pūjayet tilakādibhiḥ ॥5 9 ॥
kuṃkumā'kṣatapuṣpaiśca svarṇacampakakundakaiḥ ।
pārijātasthalapadmaiḥ kamalaistulasīdalaiḥ ॥6 0 ॥
kalpapuṣpaiḥ svarṇavallīkusumaiḥ pūjayetprabhum ।
svarṇākṣatairvardhayecca hāramālāḥ samarpayet॥6 1 ॥
karapādatale gaṇḍau kapolau karṇasīmakau ।
bhujau jaṃghe nakhānoṣṭhau raṃgaiḥ saṃraṃjayeddhareḥ ॥62॥
suvarṇamaṇiratnādinaddhopānadyutau padau ।
naktakayaṣṭikāgucchaśṛṃkhalāsahitau karau ॥6 3 ॥
śobhayet tilakaṃ pītaṃ raktaṃ candraṃ prakārayet ।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ kārayecca bhojanaṃ śatamaṣṭa ca ॥64॥
amblaṃ madhuraṃ lavaṇaṃ kaṭu tiktaṃ kaṣāyakam ।
yathāruci yathāpekṣaṃ svādu sugandhi cārpayet। ॥65॥
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ coṣyalehye peyaṃ cāsvādyamityapi ।
annaṃ śākadvidalāścaudanāni suphalāni ca ॥66॥
pāyasānnaṃ suvarṇaiḥ saṃskṛtāni sadrasāni ca ।
amṛtāḍhyāni miṣṭāni mṛṣṭāni dāpayennṛpaḥ ॥67॥
mukhavāsāni cūrṇāni tāmbūlaṃ cānyacarvaṇam ।
uttejakāni cānyāni tvarpayeddharaye nṛpaḥ ॥ 68 ॥
śītalānyapi peyāni cūrṇitarasavanti ca ।
mādakāni vividhāni tvarpayeddharaye nṛpaḥ ॥6 9॥
gāyanāni tu rājñībhistālavādyasvarānvitaiḥ ।
nartanairhāvabhāvādyavyaṃgyarasaprapūritaiḥ ॥70 ॥
sakhībhiḥ kārayedrājā vardhayed bahubhāvanaiḥ ।
lājābhiścandanakaṇairakṣataiḥ svarṇataṇḍulaiḥ ॥7 1 ॥
maṇiratnādibhirdevaṃ vardhayettu punaḥ punaḥ ।
jayakārān kārayecca nīrājayetprage niśi ॥72 ॥
śataiḥ sahasrakairvartikarpūrādibhirādarāt ।
ākaṭi sapta cāvartān sapta tvāmastakaṃ tathā ॥73 ॥
tataḥ saptā''vartakāँśca pratyekasaptacakrakān ।
tataśca saptalaharīrūrdhvā'dhaḥprasṛtāścaret ॥74॥
vyāvartānpādayoścaivā''vartayet kramaśo harim ।
tato vastreṇa cāvartāṃstrīn hariṃ samavartayet ॥75 ॥
tataḥ śaṃkhajalenāpi vyāvartānavatārayet ।
ārārtrikaṃ tajjalena trivāraṃ samavardhayet ॥76 ॥
dhūpaṃ tatastrivāraṃ cāvartayetparameśvaram ।
ghaṇṭāvādanamanyeṣāṃ vādyānāṃ cāpi vādanam ॥77॥
dundubhijhallarīghaṇṭāpaṭahānativādayet ।
tataḥ stutiṃ namaskāraṃ daṇḍavat prārthanāṃ caret ॥78 ॥
pradakṣiṇādikaṃ kṛtvā puṣpāñjalimathārpayet ।
evaṃ prātaśca madhyāhne niśi samrāṭ prapūjayet ॥79 ॥
śṛṃgārayitvā satsainyaṃ vimāne ca gaje rathe ।
sthāpayitvā rājadhānyudyānādau bhrāmayeddharim ॥8 0 ॥
janatā vardhayet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ।
punastvānīya ca rājasaudhaṃ jalādi cārpayet ॥8 1 ॥
viśrāmayet pādasaṃvāhanādyaṃ vartayennṛpaḥ ।
bhagavattoṣaṇārthe ca bhūridānāni vai dadet ॥82 ॥
hastidānaṃ vājidānaṃ coṣṭraghoṭakadānakam ।
vṛṣabhā'japradānaṃ ca gogaruḍapradānakam ॥8 3 ॥
śukadānaṃ sārikāyā menāyā dānamityapi ।
narāṇāṃ dāsadāsīnāṃ kanyānāṃ dānamityapi ॥84॥
yānānāṃ vāhanānāṃ ca paśūnāṃ dānamityapi ।
kambalāmbaraveṣādyutkṛṣṭavastūni dāpayet ॥85 ॥
bhavanāni nagarāṇi kṣetrāṇi parvatāṃstathā ।
sarovarāṇi khanijān khanīṃścāraṇyakāni ca ॥86॥
dadyād dāne dvijātibhyo'nāthebhyo'nnāmbarāṇi ca ।
vṛkṣān vallīḥ pradadyācca kṣetrāṇi vāṭikāstathā ॥87॥
dadyānnadīrnadāँścaivā'khātān svargaṃ mahastapaḥ ।
satyaṃ lokaṃ pradadyācca pātālāntatalāni ca ॥88॥
deśaṃ pradeśaṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca rājyaṃ dvīpaṃ ca dāpayet ।
dātā brahmāṇḍanetā ced grahītā'pi tathā bhavet ॥89 ॥
milennaiva grahītā cet saṃkalpya haraye dadet ।
viśvaṃbharo viśvapoṣṭā viśvarakṣākaraḥ prabhuḥ ॥90 ॥
gṛhṇātyeva na sandeho bhāvanākṣudhito hariḥ ।
sāmrājyamukuṭaṃ dadyād dadyād rājñīṃ sutāstathā ॥9 1 ॥
sarve dadyāccharmadāya kṛṣṇāya paramātmane ।
kośaṃ sainyāni rāṣṭrāṇi dadyācchrīkeśavāya vai ॥ 92॥
yathāśraddhaṃ pradadyācca sakāmāyā'dhikāriṇe ।
satpātrāya pradadyācca nārībhyo'pi daded bahu ॥ 93 ॥
bālābhyo vidhavābhyaśca sādhvībhyo jīvikāṃ dadet ।
satībhyo yoginībhyaśca raṃkābhyo bhojanaṃ dadet ॥94॥
santarpayed yajñabhāgaistrilokasuramānavān ।
kāśyapān prāṇinaḥ sarvāṃstoṣayedannavāribhiḥ ॥95 ॥
etatsarvaṃ pradadyādvā dadyādekaṃ ca vā nṛpaḥ ।
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na cet kuryād dadyācca śraddhayā yadi ॥96॥
kāṃsyapātrapuṭadānaṃ suvarṇapuṭadānakam ।
aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ caturdaśadalāntaram ॥97॥
suvarṇaratnasaṃvyāptaṃ puṭaṃ dadyātpuṭāni ca ।
tatphalaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatheṣṭakam ॥ 98 ॥
dadāti māsyadhike vai śāśvataṃ bahutṛptidam ।
sakāmaṃ cāpi niṣkāmaṃ dāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 99॥
kurvantu dānaṃ vitarantu lakṣmīṃ kṣipantu pātre bhagavatprabuddhyā ।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa eva dātā vairājakaṃ cāpi dadāmi rājyam॥ 100 ॥
ityevaṃ dundubhirvakti māsi śrīpuruṣottame ।
sahasrākṣaḥ śṛṇotyeva śrīdaṃ taṃ pratipattithau ॥ 101 ॥
prātareva tu rājā'sau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
śrutvā taṃ dundubhiṃ natvā'pūjayacchuddhimānnṛpaḥ ॥ 10 2॥
dundubhinā yathāproktaṃ rājñaḥ śraddhā ca yādṛśī ।
tathā rājñā kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pūjanaṃ savisarjanam ॥ 1 03॥
atha dānaṃ dadau prātaḥ patnīvratadvijanmane ।
āhūya brahmaṇaḥ satye loke saṃsadi taṃ dvijam ॥ 104॥
brāhmamūrte! dvijaśreṣṭha! tvameva puruṣottamaḥ ।
adhimāsādhidaivātman! phaladātā'si mūrtimān ॥ 1 05॥
ahaṃ vai dundubhiṃ śrutvā karomyadya dine vratam ।
vairājapadalabdhyarthaṃ dānaṃ gṛhāṇa sārthakam ॥ 1 06॥
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ rājā'smi ca dadāmyaham ।
svarṇadījalasākṣye'tra vedhasaḥ saṃsadi dvija ॥ 1 07॥
caturdaśabhuvanāni dadāmi phalalabdhaye ।
dattāni ca gṛhītāni pratyuvāca dvijottamaḥ ॥ 1 08॥
tāvatpatnīvratarūpe bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
prāvirbabhūva sahasā koṭibhāskarakāntimān ॥ 1 09॥
prahasaṃstaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ provāca puruṣottamaḥ ।
dānaṃ prāptaṃ mayā rājan dvijarūpeṇa sarvathā ॥ 11 0॥
mayā dattaṃ phalaṃ tasya te vairājapadaṃ dhruvam ।
āyuṣo'nte tu labdhā'si vairājaṃ padamaiśvaram ॥ 11 1॥
iti kṛtvā prasādaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ pradarśya vigraham ।
tirobabhūva sahasā spṛśan mūrdhni nṛpasya saḥ ॥ 1 12॥
rājñā vrataṃ tathā pūjāṃ sarvaṃ vai śraddhayā kṛtam ।
dadau brahmāṇḍadānaṃ sa yatra kiñcinna śiṣyate ॥ 1 13॥
svayaṃ dāso'bhavattasya kiṃkaro brāhmaṇasya vai ।
varṣāntaḥ pūrṇatāṃ prāptaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ samādhinā ॥ 1 14॥
paśyati svakṛte cāgre vairājaṃ padamasti yat ।
pūrvavairājavigame naikaṭye dṛśyate hi tat ॥ 1 15॥
ityevaṃ vartamānena rājñā tena mahātmanā ।
kramayogād daivayogāt tyaktaṃ dehaṃ nṛpātmakam ॥ 1 16॥
sahasrākṣaśarīraṃ ca vihāyemaṃ tu golakam ।
divyamārge yayau ceśasṛṣṭau yatrāsti tatsthalam ॥ 1 17॥
prāptavān sa sahasrākṣo vairājaṃ padamaiśvaram ।
yo'dyāsti nābhikamalaḥ pitā vai vedhasaḥ prabhuḥ ॥ 1 18॥
so'yaṃ vairājasāmrājyaṃ prāptavān pratipadvratāt ।
bhūmnā hairaṇyagarbheṇa tathā'nyairīśvarairapi ॥ 1 19॥
tatrābhiṣikto rājā saḥ yo'sau nārāyaṇo'bhavat ।
yatkamale'bhavad brahmā yallalāṭācchivāpatiḥ ॥ 1 20॥
yasya vai hṛdayādviṣṇuryasyodare tvidaṃ jagat ।
so'yaṃ vrataprabhāveṇa sahasrākṣo nṛpaḥ khalu ॥ 1 21॥
puruṣottamasadbhaktyā jāto nārāyaṇo virāṭ ।
evaṃ tvadhikamāsasya madhyo'rdhvapratipaddine ॥ 1 22॥
vratapūjanadānena phalaṃ te kathitaṃ priye ।
prasannaḥ śrīharistatra kiṃ na dadāti padmaje ॥ 123॥
asya śrāvayitā cāpi pāṭhakartāpi tādṛśam ।
phalaṃ saṃlapsyate lakṣmi! vadāmi puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 124॥
nāstikaścā'śraddadhāno mṛṣāvādī pradūṣakaḥ ।
na prasādaṃ phalaṃ vāpi labhate mama nindakaḥ ॥ 125॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye prāksṛṣṭau sārvabhaumena sahasrākṣa-nāmakarājñā sahasreṣu yajñeṣu kṛteṣu tato'dhikamāsottara-pakṣīyapratipadvratadānādinā prāptaṃ vairājanārāyaṇa-padamityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭādhikatriśata-tamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.308 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 308 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 309
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 310 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ divyāṃ prāksampannāṃ manoharām ।
asmāttu brahmaṇaḥ pūrvo brahmā varṣaśatottaram । । 1 ।।
nidhanonmukhatāṃ prāptastadānīṃ brahmagolake ।
antime'jakṣaṇe rājā pṛthvyāṃ sarvahutābhidhaḥ ।। 2 ।।
babhūva bhagavadbhakto mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ ।
madarthe kṛtasarvasvo madarthe nyastamānasaḥ ।। 3 ।।
mama kaṇṭhīṃ mama mālāṃ mamaiva tilakaṃ śubham ।
dadhāra bubhuje cānnaṃ me prasādātmapāvanam ।। 4 ।।
cāturmāsye vrataṃ tena gṛhītaṃ bahudāyitā ।
saptadvīpeṣu khaṇḍeṣu sāmudradvīpabhūmiṣu ।। 5 ।।
yatra yatrā'bhavat svasya rājyaṃ sarvatra tatra ca ।
mamānnaṃ vai pradātavyaṃ jalaṃ pātavyameva me ।। 6 ।।
yāvattṛptirbhikṣuvargairadanīyaṃ mamaiva ha ।
brāhmaṇairmama bhoktavyaṃ kṣatriyarṣibhirityapi ।। 7 ।।
vaiśyarṣibhistathā śūdrairbhaktikṛdbhirmamānnakam ।
bhoktavyaṃ sarvathā brahmacāribhirvanavāsibhiḥ ।। 8 ।।
yatibhiḥ sādhubhistyāgijanaiḥ sādhvībhirityapi ।
anāthaiścātithiprakhyairyājñikairdevapūjakaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
annārthibhiḥ kadaryaiśca kiṃkarairvṛttivarjitaiḥ ।
mamānnameva bhoktavyaṃ jalaṃ pātavyameva me ।। 10 ।।
vastrāṇi mama dhāryāṇi nānyagrāhyaṃ tu kairapi ।
tadarthaṃ ca mayā rājye pratisthalaṃ kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।। 11 ।।
annasatrāṇi vastrāṇi prapāvārīṇi sarvathā।
saṃsthāpitāni sevāsthā niyuktāśca pratisthalam ।। 12।।
kṣudhito'nnasya pātraṃ syāt tṛṣito jalapātrakam ।
nagnastvambarapātraṃ syād grāhyaṃ tena mudā mama ।। 13 ।।
kadarye hṛdayaṃ yasya yasya tṛṣṇā'sti mānase ।
so'pi tṛṣṇādināśārthaṃ gṛhṇātvannaṃ jalaṃ mama ।। 14।।
ityevaṃ ghoṣitaṃ tena kuḍyaphalakalekhitam ।
cāturmāsye mamānnaṃ vai phalaṃ vāri tathā'mbaram ।। 15।।
grahaṇīyaṃ puṣkalaṃ nā'nyagrāhyaṃ dharmabhikṣukaiḥ ।
ityevaṃ vartamānasya sarvahutasya bhūbhṛtaḥ ।। 1 6।।
agnihotre'nyayajñe ca yatkiñciddhāmikaṃ matam ।
devānāṃ pūjane vastupradānaṃ cāpi tasya vai ।। 17।।
vidyārthināṃ ca vidyāyā dāne vyayo gavāṃ tṛṇe ।
śvaprabhṛtigrāmyapaśupakṣiṇāṃ ca kaṇānnakam ।। 18 ।।
jalaṃ vastraṃ tathā cānyad yathāpekṣaṃ suvastukam ।
āsīt sarvahutasyaivā'tithīnāṃ tṛptikṛttathā ।। 19 ।।
grāmeṣu kheṭeṣu janasthaleṣu kṣetreṣu ghoṣeṣu nadītaṭeṣu ।
vaneṣvaraṇyeṣu ca parvateṣu dvīpeṣu vārdhau raṇanirjaneṣu ।।2 0 ।।
upatyakāyāṃ nagareṣu rājyaviśrāntibhūmau ca karasthalīṣu ।
sarvatra vai sarvahutasya rājño'bhavan susatrāṇi sudānakāni ।। 2 1 ।।
grāmāntarāṇāṃ yugamārgasandhau vanāntarāṇāṃ sṛtimūlayoge ।
nadīnadānāṃ taraṇārthabhūmau kṛtāni satrāṇi tu tena rājñā ।। 22 ।।
sīmāntareṣu prakhanisthaleṣu yānasya mārgeṣu digantareṣu ।
tīrtheṣu yātrālugatāgateṣu sthaleṣu satrāṇi hutasya rājñaḥ ।।23 ।।
devānāṃ pūjane nāma procyate sarvato diśi ।
prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca madhyāhne tasya sarvahutasya vai ।। 24।।
satye tapasi tasyaiva jane mahari svargake ।
bhuvi cāpyatha pātāleṣvasya kīrtirhi gīyate ।। 25 ।।
devāśca ṛṣayaścāpi daityāścānye'pi dehinaḥ ।
sarvahutaṃ lokituṃ vai yayurhaṃsādirūpiṇaḥ ।। 26।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurdṛṣṭvā puṇyojjvalaṃ nṛpam ।
atitejomaṇḍalāḍhyamukhamaṇḍalaśobhitam ।। 27।।
dūre cātipratejaskāḥ sarve śuśubhire surāḥ ।
kintu tannikaṭe gatvā nistejaskā babhūvire ।। 28 ।।
iti puṇyapratāpo'sau sarvahutā'rthasārthakaḥ ।
agniprakhyo'bhavadbhakto devagarvaharo nṛpaḥ ।। 29 ।।
devaiḥ sammānitaḥ sarvairindrārdhāsanayojitaḥ ।
dikpālaiḥ pūjitaḥ so'pi vismayaṃ nāpa vai manāk ।। 30 ।।
rāgaśūnyasya tasyaiva patnyāsīt patisevinī।
audāryaguṇasampannā nāmnā vai goṛtambharā ।।3 1 ।।
devībhyo'pyatirūpāḍhyā kāyākalpātisundarī ।
kāmarūpā kāmabhogā kāmakārā'tisāttvikī ।।32।।
devīṣu tiṣṭhate paścād devadevīsamājake ।
salajjā'vāṅmukhī tatra bhavati kṣaṇamāntare ।। 33।।
tayā svasvāmine proktaṃ mayā paścānniṣadyate ।
yathāpūrvaṃ tūttame hyāsane tiṣṭhāmi tatkuru ।।34।।
indrāṇī vāruṇī sauryā cāndradyo vā'nyasurastriyaḥ ।
praṇameyuśca māṃ svāmin yathā tatkuru bhūpate ।।35।।
rājā prāha satīṃ rājñīṃ mānuṣī bhavasi priye ।
tatrāpi devasaṃghe'smadvāso'styatimahattamaḥ ।।।36।।
mā tṛṣṇāṃ kuru kalyāṇi mānuṣe tu na tadbhavet ।
tathāpi puṇyabāhulye kadācit tadvibhāvyate ।। 37।।
kariṣye stavanaṃ yatnaṃ nārāyaṇasamīpataḥ ।
prāpte yoge tathā syādvai tṛṣṇāśāntistathāpi na ।।38।।
nityaṃ rājñī nṛpaṃ kāle prasmārayati tadvacaḥ ।
rājā'pi samayaṃ prāptaṃ tadarthaṃ vai pratīkṣate ।।39।।
ekadā'dhikamāsasya dvitīyāyāṃ prage'site ।
snātvā devaprapūjāyāṃ tiṣṭhate tāvadeva vai ।।40।।
śrutavān dundubhiṃ ramyaṃ ghoṣayantaṃ harervacaḥ ।
śuśrāva sarvahutasya rājñyapi goṛtambharā ।।41।।
ubhau sthairyeṇa tacchabdamānasau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ।
śuśruvāte dundubhestu ghoṣaṇāṃ hṛdayaṃgamām ।।42।।
adhimāsadvitīyāyāṃ vrataṃ kurvanti ye janāḥ ।
teṣāmabhīṣṭadātā'haṃ māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।43।।
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ phalabhuktirjalāśanam ।
vāyvāśanaṃ ca vā kṛtvā kariṣyanti vrataṃ tu ye ।।44।।
tebhyo dāsye sutadārādhanasampadgṛhādikān ।
yānavāhanahastyādīn vārīkṣetradharādikān ।।45।।
khaṇḍaṃ dvīpaṃ ca sāmudraṃ bhaumaṃ rājyaṃ bhūmaṇḍalam ।
svargaṃ janaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ caindraṃ sauryaṃ ca cāndrakam ।।46।।
sāmrājyaṃ cātalaṃ pātālakaṃ cāpi rasātalam ।
dāsye caturdaśalokādhipatyaṃ pārameṣṭhyakam ।।47।।
vāruṇaṃ vāhnikaṃ caiśaṃ yāmyaṃ tathā ca pāvanam ।
kauberaṃ nairṛtaṃ cāpi dikpālatvaṃ mahatpadam ।।48।।
lokapālapadaṃ dāsye vāsavaṃ grahamaṇḍalam ।
naidheyaṃ cāpi raudraṃ ca mārutaṃ nākapṛṣṭhakam ।।49।।
siddhīraṣṭavidhā dāsye guṇaṃ brahmāṇḍasarjanam।
rakṣaṇaṃ pālanaṃ dāsye sāmarthyaṃ vratine tu me ।।50 ।।
adhimāsasya devo'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
svalpe'pi matkṛte kṛcchre phalaṃ dāsye tvanantakam ।।5 1 ।।
dadāmi nā'nyamāse yat taddadāmyatra puṣkalam ।
atrāhaṃ kṛpayā dātā dātāsmi svecchayā khalu ।।52।।
madvacodhārayatyaddhā mūrdhnā tasmai dadāmyaham ।
upāyanaṃ tathā pāritoṣikaṃ vā svanugraham ।।53 ।।
nātra vinimayo nyāyo nyāyastvatra kṛpā mama ।
kṛpayā'haṃ svayaṃ svāmī vitarāmi tvaśeṣakam ।।54।।
koṭiguṇaṃ vitarāmi vitarāmi tvanantakam ।
yathāsaṃkalpitaṃ tasmād gṛhṇantu puruṣottamāt ।।55 ।।
iti śuśruṣatuḥ sarvahutaśca goṛtambharā ।
tau natvā dundubhiṃ puṣpaiḥ pūjayāmāsatustadā ।।56 ।।
dundubhistu gato'nyatra dampatī dadhyatuḥ prabhum ।
sveṣṭalābhastathā kutra prāpsyate ceti dadhyatuḥ ।।57।।
sarvahutastadā rājñīṃ samprāha goṛtaṃbharām ।
śrutaṃ devi dvitīyāyā vrateneṣṭamavāpyate ।।58 ।।
tavāsti mānasaṃ pūjyasthāne sthātuṃ mahattame ।
caturdaśastarasthānāṃ sarvāsāṃ surayoṣitām ।।59 ।।
tatprāptyarthaṃ vrataṃ kāryamāvābhyāṃ phaladaṃ bhavet ।
dundubhinā taduktaṃ vai svalpe'pi bahulaṃ phalam ।।6 0 ।।
ahaṃ brahmā bhaviṣyāmi bhava tvaṃ sahacāriṇī ।
brahmāṇī mama patnī ca mātā vai surayoṣitām ।।6 1 ।।
tathā sati tavehā tu prapūrṇārthā bhaviṣyati ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devo phalaṃ vratasya dāsyati ।।62।।
evaṃ kṛtvā tu saṃkalpaṃ vrataṃ cakraturādarāt ।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā kārayitvā tu kānakīm ।।63 ।।
mūrtiṃ tatrā'dhikadevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।
āvāhyācamanaṃ datvā''sanaṃ pādyaṃ samarpya ca ।।64।।
tasmai tvācamanaṃ tīrthajalasya dadatuśca tau ।
dugdhena picchaladadhnā ghṛtena madhunā tathā ।।65।।
śakarrābhiśca saṃsnāpya kārayāmāsatustataḥ ।
śuddhajalaiḥ sugandhaiścāplavanaṃ candanānvitaiḥ ।।66।।
mārjayāmāsaturvastraiḥ śobhayāmāsaturharim ।
suvarṇā'mbarabhūṣābhirmaṇiratnottamādibhiḥ ।।67।।
hāraiścandanagandhaiśca dravaiḥ sāradravaistathā ।
kajjalaistailasāraiśca puṣpaiḥ kuṃkumataṇḍulaiḥ ।।68 ।।
pūjayāmāsatuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kirīṭakaṭakādibhiḥ ।
sadratnamaṇihārādyaiśchatracāmarayaṣṭibhiḥ ।।69।।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlacūrṇakaiḥ ।
kārayāmāsatustṛptiṃ śrīhariṃ puruṣottamam ।।70।।
jalaṃ datvā savādyaṃ tau nīrājanaṃ pracakratuḥ ।
pradakṣiṇāṃ stutiṃ namaskārāṃścakraturādarāt ।।71 ।।
prārthayāmāsaturdevaṃ vratenānena keśava ।
prasanno bhava viśvātman gṛhāṇā'rghyaṃ phalādikam ।।72।।
iti kṛtvā dadatustau phalārthaṃ sasuvarṇakam ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadatuśca cakratuḥ sevanaṃ tataḥ ।।73।।
madhyāhne'pi tathā cobhau cakratuḥ pūjanādikam ।
sāyaṃ prapūjya deveśaṃ kṛtvā tvārārtrika niśi ।।74।।
cakraturjāgaraṃ vādyanṛtyakīrtanasūtsavam ।
dānaṃ kṛṣṇāya dadatuḥ siṃhāsanaṃ tu kānakam ।।75।।
chatracāmaravetrādiśobhitaṃ bahulojjvalam ।
maṇiratnasumauktikadāmabhūṣāvirājitam ।।76।।
bhavanaṃ cāpi dadatuścaturdaśaprabhūmikam ।
sauvarṇakūpyavastvāḍhyopaskarādyabhirājitam ।।77।।
śayyāstaraṇabhojyādibhāgabhuvanaśobhitam ।
puṇyasāragṛhaṃ yatra yatrāgnihotrasadgṛham ।।78।।
pitṛtarpaṇabhavanaṃ yatrāsti dānasadgṛham ।
maṇiratnādi pūrṇaṃ ca yatra kośagṛhaṃ tvapi ।।79।।
yānavāhanapūrṇaṃ ca gṛhaṃ cidacidātmakam ।
dāsadāsīvanodyāna nadīnada samanvitam ।।80।।
gṛhaṃ yatrāsti bhūmau ca viśrāntigṛhamityapi ।
suratasya gṛhaṃ caiva bhojanasya gṛhaṃ tathā ।।81 ।।
snānāgāraṃ tathā guptapātālādi susampadam ।
gṛhaṃ yatrāsti kalpānāṃ drumāṇāṃ ca gavāṃ gṛham ।।8 2।।
evamādīni sarvāṇi bhavanāni ca yatra vai ।
vartante tanmahatsaudhaṃ saprākāraṃ suśobhitam ।।83।।
dadatustau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyā'rpaṇameva hi ।
tāvattatra samāyātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।84।।
provāca tau prasanno'smi dānena ca vratena ca ।
dadāmyeṣaḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vṛṇuta varadānakam ।।85।।
dampatī prāhatustatra pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ prabho ।
dehi paścāttavadhāmā'kṣaraṃ mokṣaṃ ca śāśvatam ।।86।।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tathā''ha goṛtambharām ।
bhāvini puṣkare tīrthe pṛthvyāṃ vai kṣatriyo nṛpaḥ ।।87।।
ābhīrāṇāṃ ca gopānāṃ puṣkarāraṇyavāsinām ।
nṛpo bhaviṣyati nāmnā gāyatro vai virāṭsutaḥ ।।88।।
tasya bhāryā ṛṣīnāmnī rājñī puṣkaraputrikā ।
bhaviṣyati tayoḥ putrī ārṣināmnī sukanyakā ।।89।।
seyaṃ tvaṃ bhāvinī gopī gomatī goṛtambharā ।
gāyatrī gokulasevākartrī tatra bhaviṣyasi ।।90।।
ayaṃ rājā sarvahutastatra brahmā bhaviṣyati ।
ādye yuge ca yajñārthe puṣkare sa gamiṣyati ।।91 ।।
surarṣimunipitrādyairmānavaistalavāsibhiḥ ।
caturaśītilakṣātmadehibhiḥ saha viśvasṛṭ ।।92।।
yajñaṃ kariṣyati tvādyaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ jagattraye ।
tatrāgniṣu proddhṛteṣu dīkṣākāle hyupāgate ।।93।।
adhvaryuṇā tadā''hūtā sāvitrī dīrghasūtriṇī ।
sajjī bhūtvā yajñabhūmau tatkāle nā''gamiṣyati ।।94।।
brahmā śakraṃ samāhūya kathayiṣyati kālikam ।
patnīṃ tvanyāṃ madarthe tu śīghraṃ śakra samānaya ।।95।।
yathā pravartate yajñaḥ kālahīno na jāyate ।
tathā śīghraṃ vidhehi tvaṃ nārīṃ patnyarthamānaya ।।96।।
evamuktastathā śakro gāyatrarājakanyakām ।
yajñabhūmivilokāyā''gatāṃ tvāṃ sa hi neṣyati ।।97।।
ārṣiṇīṃ kanyakāṃ ramyāṃ gāyatrīṃ navayauvanām ।
gāndharveṇa vivāhena grahīṣyati sa viśvasṛṭ ।।98।।
prārapsyate tato hotraṃ brāhmaṇairvedapārargeḥ ।
yajño dinasahasraṃ vai puṣkare sa bhaviṣyati ।।99।।
tata ārabhya gāyatrī brahmāṇī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
lokamātā vedamātā sṛṣṭimātā bhaviṣyasi ।। 10 0।।
sarvapūjyā sarvamānyā dvijajāpyā bhaviṣyasi ।
brahmadātrī brahmavadhūrbhaviṣyasi ṛtambhare ।। 101 ।।
ayaṃ sarvahuto brahmā tvaṃ gāyatrī ca dampatī ।
dvitīyāyā vratenaiva kṛpayā me bhaviṣyathaḥ ।। 1 02।।
śatavarṣottaraṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ me prāpsyatho dhruvam ।
mahānagaratulyasya saudhasya dānakarmaṇā ।। 1 03।।
brahmāṇḍākhyaṃ gṛhaṃ rājyaṃ dāsye smṛddhaṃ parātparam ।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastirobabhūva tatsthalāt ।। 1 04।।
pūrvajasya brahmaṇo'pi laye jāte'tha dampatī ।
pārameṣṭhyaṃ padaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāpatuḥ śāśvataṃ ciram ।। 1 05।।
evaṃ sarvahuto rājā tatpatnī goṛtambharā ।
sañjātau daṃpatī brahmā gāyatrī pitarau sṛjeḥ ।। 1 06।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! prāksṛṣṭīyamudantakam ।
puruṣottamamāsasya dvitīyāyāstu sadvratam ।। 107।।
pārameṣṭhyapadadātṛ śroturvaktustathā phalam ।
bhaviṣyati na sandeho vakti śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 1 08।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye prāksṛṣṭau sarvahutarājñā goṛtambharārājñyā ca dvitīyapakṣadvitīyāvratena nagarasamabhavana-dānādinā pūjanādinā ca pārameṣṭhyapade brahmaṇo'va-tāro gāyatryavatāraśca prāptaṃ ityādinirūpaṇa-nāmā navādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।1.309।।


← adhyāyaḥ 309 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 310
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 311 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! prākkalpasya kathānakam ।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe bhuvo bhāge samrāḍāsījjanā'dhipaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
nāmnā brahmasavitākhyastasya patnī pativratā ।
patidharmaparā bhaktā bhūriśṛṃgābhidhā'bhavat ॥ 2 ॥
sevate sā sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ patim ।
dampatī bhagavadbhaktau gṛhadharmaparāyaṇau ॥ 3 ॥
kurvantau dānadharmādi sevayantau gurūn janān ।
vartayantau harermārge viṣṇusevāparāyaṇau ॥ 4 ॥
atithīn pūjayantau ca vṛddheṣu vinayānvitau ।
gavāṃ sevāṃ prakurvantau dayāvantau prajāsu ca ॥ 5 ॥
dīnānāṃ duḥkhahantārau nirdhanānāṃ prapoṣakau ।
satāṃ sevāṃ prakurvantau duṣṭānāṃ tu niyāmakau ॥ 6 ॥
āstāṃ dharmaparau trāṇaparau kaṣṭaharau hi tau ।
rājā brahmasavitrākhyo nityaṃ snātvā nadījale ॥ 7 ॥
sandhyāṃ japaṃ tathā homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ sma karoti vai ।
annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ dravyadānaṃ karoti ca ॥ 8 ॥
devālayeṣu devānāṃ darśanārthaṃ pragacchati ।
naivedyārthe sumiṣṭānnaṃ phalādyarpayati pradhīḥ ॥ 9 ॥
yogye tu samaye pūjāṃ kārayatyeva bhāvataḥ ।
bhojayatyatithīn viprān sādhūn sādhvīryatīn munīn ॥ 10 ॥
dadāti dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇarūpyātmikāṃ sutoṣadām ।
annasatreṣu cānnāni dāpayatyapi kośataḥ ॥ 11 ॥
dāsadāsīpravargāṇāṃ śṛṇoti prārthanāṃ muhuḥ ।
apekṣitaṃ pradatvaiva sukhayatyatidharmavān ॥ 12॥
rājñī cāpi tathā devān pūjayatyaniśaṃ gṛhe ।
darśanārthaṃ ca devānāṃ prayāti yānamantarā ॥ 13॥
anupānaccaraṇābhyāṃ yātrāṃ karoti nityadā ।
jalaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ candanaṃ svarṇadakṣiṇām ॥ 14॥
devāya gurave datvā samāgacchati tadgṛham ।
bhojayitvā janān bhuṃkte sā nṛpo'tti tathottaram ॥ 15॥
cāturmāsye vrataṃ rājñā gṛhītaṃ ghṛtadīpakāḥ ।
dātavyā haraye'khaṇḍāḥ sarvadevālayeṣu vai ॥ 16॥
saptadvīpeṣu khaṇḍeṣu sāmudradvīpakeṣu ca ।
yatra yatrā'bhavan devālayā rājye svake bhuvi ॥ 17॥
parameśāvatārāṇāmīśvarāṇāṃ ca yoginām ।
devānāṃ sarvajātīnāṃ camatkārātmanā tathā ॥18॥
vibhūtīnāṃ ca tattvānāṃ devīnāṃ ca citāṃ tathā ।
tīrthānāmadhidaivānāṃ jaḍānāṃ cetanāvatām ॥ 19॥
caityānāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca jaṃgamānāṃ camatkṛtām ।
yatra yatrā'bhavan surakṣmālayāstatra tatra ca ॥20॥
ghṛtadīpānakhaṇḍān sa sutejaskānakārayat ।
svarṇapātreṣu saṃśuddhagoghṛtāni suvartikāḥ ॥21॥
dhārayitvā prakāśaṃ vai sarvadevebhya ādadau ।
tasya rājye yadi kasmaicidapyarhasurāya cet ॥22॥
anarpitaḥ pradīpaścejjānātyayaṃ nṛpastadā ।
sopavāsaḥ suvarṇānāṃ sahasraṃ ca dadātyapi ॥23॥।
uddhoṣayati sarvatra cāturmāsye vrataṃ mama ।
mama rājye tu sarvatra devebhyo mama dīpakāḥ ॥24॥
pradeyāḥ pūjakaistīrthajalebhyaścaityaśākhine ।
devālayeṣu sarvatra bhavantu mama dīpakāḥ ॥25॥
sarvaparvakārtikādau bhavantvākāśadīpakāḥ ।
gavāṃ ghṛtena me śreṣṭhajyotīṃṣi santu sarvathā ॥26॥
pañcāmṛtāplavanaṃ ca devānāṃ mama bhūyatām ।
miṣṭānnāni mama santu devebhyo vinivedane ॥27॥
upacārāstathā santu sarvathā mama ṣoḍaśa ।
navadhā śrīharerbhaktirjāyatāṃ matprabhojitaiḥ ॥28॥
cāturmāsye tu śākāni dugdhāni ca rasāstathā ।
viprāṇāṃ sādhusādhvīnāṃ devānāṃ bhojane mama ॥29॥
dīnā'nāthakṛpaṇānāṃ bhojanāni bhavantu me ।
gavāṃ grāsāḥ śunakādigrāmyādanāni santu me ॥30॥
kaṇānnādipradānaṃ ca pārāvatādipakṣiṇām ।
pipīlikāprabhṛtīnāṃ piṣṭādyannaṃ samastu me ॥3 1॥
yajñānāṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhiḥ sādhanairastu me tathā ।
ārārtrikādikaṃ devālayeṣu cāstu me'nvaham ॥32॥
jaladānaṃ vastradānaṃ mamāstu vaibhavāt sadā ।
svarṇarūpyādimudrāṇāṃ pradānaṃ cāstu me sadā ॥33॥
ityevaṃ brahmasavitā rājā prāghoṣayad bhuvi ।
bhūriśṛṃgā ca tatpatnī cakre patyā saha vratam ॥34॥
nityaṃ snātvā'rcayati sma śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ।
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstambhaiḥ śobhitaṃ toraṇādibhiḥ ॥35॥
kārayitvā navaṃ nityaṃ pūrayitvā ca maṇḍalam ।
saptadhānyamayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvatobhadranāmakam ॥36॥
kārayitvā ca sauvarṇīṃ mūrtiṃ śrīpauruṣottamīm ।
upacārairbahuvidhaiḥ pupūja bahubhāvataḥ ॥37॥
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ cāpi ṣaṭpaṃcāśadvidhaṃ dadau ।
sāyaṃ nīrājayitvā ca nṛtyati dāsikāyutā ॥38॥
evaṃ karotyanudinaṃ puruṣottamasya, toṣāya mānamahataṃ vigaṇayya rājñī ।
kṛṣṇo'pi nṛtyamavalokya sukaṇṭhamiśraṃ, tuṣṭo bhavatyapi na dṛṣṭipathaṃ prayāti ॥39॥
dampatī tau tathāvṛttau nityabhaktau haripriyau ।
tṛtīyāyāḥ prage tvākarṇayāmāsaturaiśvarīm ॥40॥
ghoṣaṇāṃ dundubhiproktāṃ mahāścaryakarīṃ yathā ।
śṛṇvantu nāgarāstadvadāraṇyakā divaukasaḥ ॥41॥
narā nāryaśca śṛṇvantu vacmi śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
brahmadhāmeśvaraḥ sākṣādadhimāsādhidaivataḥ ॥42॥
parapakṣatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ tu śraddhayānvitam ।
kariṣyanti narā nāryo mama pūjanapūrvakam ॥43॥
ekabhuktena naktena phalenā'yācitena vā ।
rājāno yadi vā rājñyaḥ prāpsyanti paramaṃ padam ॥44॥
prāpsyanti dharmakāmārthamokṣān lokānabhīpsitān ।
putrapautrādivaṃśāँśca kulavistārasadyaśaḥ ॥45॥
aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi prāpsyanti madvratena vai ।
gṛhṇantvekadivasasya vratena śāśvataṃ sukham ॥46 ॥
paramaudāryasampanno dāsye'haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvasampadāmasmi yojakaḥ ॥47॥
adya bhojanadānena dāsye navanidhīn dhruvān ।
adya suvarṇadānena dāsye kuberagaddikām ॥48॥
adya rasapradānena dāsye vāruṇasatpadam ।
adya ratnapradānena dāsye surendratāṃ śubhām ॥49॥
adya puṇyapradānena dāsye vai dharmarājatām ।
adya dhanapradānena dāsye'ṣṭavasuvigrahān ॥50 ॥
adya sarvasvadānena dāsye'ṣṭasiddhivaibhavān ।
adya dīpapradānena dāsye trilokanetratām ॥5 1 ॥
adya payaḥpradānena dāsye śītāmṛtātmatām ।
adyānnajaladānena dāsye sāmrājyamarthavat ॥52॥
adya rathādidānena dāsye svargavimānakam ।
adya vastrapradānena dāsye vārdhyambarā kṣitim ॥53 ॥
adya kanyādidānena dāsye sahasrayoṣitaḥ ।
adya gavāṃ pradānena dāsye pṛthvīṃ rasānvitām ॥54॥
adya gṛhapradānena dāsye brahmāṇḍagahvaram ।
adya phalapradānena dāsye kalpadrumāvalim ॥55॥
adya bhūṣāpradānena dāsye svargaṃ subhūṣitam ।
adya me pūjayā dāsye trilokipūjyatāṃ sadā ॥56 ॥
yadyadicchantu me bhaktastattad dāsye na saṃśayaḥ ।
dundubhistvevamākhyāya kṣaṇaṃ mauno babhūva ha ॥57॥
rājā brahmasavitā ca bhūriśṛṃgā ca tatpriyā ।
natvā taṃ dundubhiṃ pūjāṃ dadau kṛṣṇapradūtakam ॥58॥
adhimāse parapakṣe tṛtīyāyāstu dampatī ।
cakāra vratamekānnaṃ bhuktvā dyumaṇivāñcchayā ॥59॥
cāturmāsye dīpadāne sūryo bhavāmi keśava ।
sapatnīkastrilokānāṃ netrātmā saṃbhavāmyaham ॥6 0 ॥
evaṃ saṃkalpya rājā'sau tatpatnī cakraturvratam ।
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ smṛtvā dhyātveṣṭarūpamujjvalam ॥6 1 ॥
maṇḍape maṇḍale kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ghaṭe śubhe ।
āropyā''narcaturbhaktyā sauvarṇaṃ puruṣottamam ॥62॥
pañcāmṛtaiḥ śuddhavārbhiḥ saṃsnāpyā''diśya cāmbare ।
bhūṣāḥ puṣpāṇi hārādyān samarpayyā'tha candanaiḥ ॥6 3 ॥
dhūpadīpādibhirdevaṃ saṃpūjyā'kṣatakuṃkumaiḥ ।
ṣaṭapaṃ'cāśadvidhaṃ tvannaṃ miṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ jalaṃ phalam ॥ 64॥
arpayāmāsatuścobhau bhaktyā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
nīrājayāmāsatuśca cakratuḥ supradakṣiṇam ॥65 ॥
daṇḍavannamanaṃ kṛtvā cakratuḥ stavanaṃ tataḥ ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadatuśca prārthayāmāsatuḥ kṣamām ॥66॥
madhyāhne'pi tathā sāyaṃ rātrau cakraturarcanam ।
nṛtyaṃ sajāgaraṃ tatra cakraturbahumānavaiḥ ॥67॥
prādurbabhūva bhagavān sarvatejonidhirhariḥ ।
pūjayā ca vratenāpi cāturmāsyavratena ca ॥ 68 ॥
dīpadānena sarvatra prasanno'smyatibhaktitaḥ ।
taveṣṭaṃ yat trilokānāṃ netrasthānaṃ mahattamam ॥69॥
dāsye tvambarasūryatvaṃ sabhāryastvaṃ ravirbhava ।
ityākhyāya haristasmāt sthānādantarhito'bhavat ॥70 ॥
kṛtvā brahmasavitā ca nṛtyaṃ prajāgaraṃ tathā ।
bhūriśṛṃgāsahitaḥ saḥ prātardānāni sandadau ॥7 1 ॥
maṇiratnāni ca gāśca mahiṣīrgajavājinaḥ ।
ajā'vikāstathā svarṇarūpyapātrāmbarāṇi ca ॥72॥
dāsadāsīśca paryaṃkān gṛhāṇi bhavanāni ca ।
kṣetrāṇi vāṭikāścaivodyānāni ca vanāni ca ॥73 ॥
annāni kūpavāpīṃśca bhūmiṃ kārpāsakāni ca ।
kauśeyāni tathaurṇāni dadau cānarghyakāṇi saḥ ॥74॥
brāhmaṇībhyastu śṛṃgāravastūni vividhāni ca ।
yatibhyastu bṛsīpātrakamaṇḍalvādikāni ca ॥75॥
gṛhasthebhyastu gārhasthyayogyavastūni sandadau ।
kṣudhitebhyo dadau bhojyaṃ tṛṣitebhyo jalaṃ dadau ॥76 ॥
tattatsukhārthikebhyaḥ sa dadau tatsukhasādhanam ।
arthibhyaḥ pradadau tvarthān sarvaṃ dadau tu śārṅgiṇe ॥77 ॥
evaṃ lakṣmi! kṛtaṃ brahmasavitrā dānamuttamam ।
kṛtaṃ tathaiva ca bhūriśṛṃgayā patisammatam ॥78॥
bhojayitvā'tha sādhvādīn bhoktuṃ yāti ca dampatī ।
tatrā''yātastadā bhikṣurūpaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥79॥
svarṇarekhātmikā lakṣmīḥ rājate yasya vakṣasi ।
pāṇḍurā'ṅkamayī śrīśca rājate sakthni vāmake ॥80 ॥
kare dakṣe dhvajo matsyaḥ svastikaśca dhanustathā ।
rājante padmapatrākṣa tejaḥparidhikasya vai ॥8 1 ॥
dṛṣṭvā rājñī nṛpo bhikṣuṃ jñātvāṃ'kaistu narāyaṇam ।
bhojayitvā pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakraturādarāt ॥82॥
tāvad dvayostatra mūrtau jātaḥ samādhirāntaraḥ ।
dṛṣṭaṃ brahmasavitrā tu sūryākhyaṃ golakaṃ mahat ॥83 ॥
tatra hiraṇmayaṃ svasya varṣma dṛṣṭaṃ parātparam ।
yena tejomayaṃ sarvaṃ jagad yāti prakāśitām ॥84॥
dṛṣṭaṃ saṃjñāsvarūpaṃ ca svasyā vai bhūriśṛṃgayā ।
hiraṇmayīṃ sūryapatnīṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭiṃ jagāma sā ॥85॥
haristirobhavat tāvadutthitau tau samādhitaḥ ।
āścaryacakitau jātau menāte pūrṇamānasau ॥86 ॥
sevete sma sadā kṛṣṇaṃ pratīkṣete sma sūryatām ।
tāvad babhūva kalpasya nidhanaṃ kramayogataḥ ॥87॥
rājā rājñī layaṃ yātau prāptau sudivyavigrahau ।
yānena sūryakāntena yayatuśca mahasstaram ॥88 ॥
niśāṃ tu kṣapayitvā tau kalpādau sarjanānvaye ।
sūryarūpo babhūvā'yaṃ brahmasavitṛbhūpatiḥ ॥8 9॥
tatpatnī bhūriśṛṃgā ca babhūva viśvakarmajā ।
saṃjñānāmnī sutā sā ca pitrā'rpitāṃ'śumāline ॥ 90 ॥
bhūriśṛṃgāsavitārau saṃjñāsūryau babhūvatuḥ ।
sarvanetrapradau devau ko'nyo labhed raveḥ padam ॥ 91 ॥
iti prāptau paraṃ sthānaṃ yāvatsvargaṃ prakāśate ।
dīpadānaprabhāveṇa tṛtīyāyā vratena ca ॥ 92॥।
tasmād dīpāḥ pradātavyā devālayeṣu ṇityadā ।
anandhatvaṃ prakāśitvaṃ divyatvaṃ tena cāpnuyāt।॥ 93 ॥
yathā brahmasavitā sa prāptavān sūryatāṃ nṛpaḥ ।
śroturvaktuḥ kathāyāśca lābho vai tādṛśo bhavet ॥ 9 4॥
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! sūryanārāyaṇīyakam ।
ākhyānaṃ paramaṃ divyaṃ pāvanaṃ puṇyadaṃ hitam ॥ 95 ॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye pūrvakalpīyasya brahmasavitrākhyarājño bhūriśṛṃgākhyapatnīsahitasya dvitīyapakṣatṛtīyāyā vratena dīpādivividhadānena ca sūryanārāyaṇatāyāḥ saṃjñā-bhidhapannīprāptisahitāyā labdhiritinirūpaṇanāmā daśā'dhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.310 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 310 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 311
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 312 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! pūrvakalpodbhavā kathā ।
saurāṣṭre raivatabhūmau samitpīyūṣanāmakaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
rājā babhūva tatpatnyo babhūvuḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ ।
ūrjāhutiḥ puṣkariṇī padmapatrā karīṣiṇī ॥ 2 ॥
viśvapriyā''dityavarṇā hariṇī hemamālinī ।
vasudhītirvahniśikhā padmākṣī padmamālinī ॥ 3 ॥
prabhāsā jagatī paṃktirbṛhatīḍā piśaṃginī ।
suṣumṇā ca purītatirviśvārciḥ padmanemikā ॥ 4 ॥
hiraṇyavarṇā candrā ca padmavarṇā ca vamrikā ।
vidyullekhā ca tāḥ sarvāḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ ॥ 5 ॥
kurvantyo bhagavadbhaktiṃ dānadharmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
atithīnāṃ ca satkāraṃ kurvantyo bhāvapūrvakam ॥ 6 ॥
snānaṃ dhyānaṃ devapūjāṃ japaṃ kurvanti cādarāt ।
homaṃ daivaṃ tathā paitryaṃ bhautaṃ kurvanti satkratum ॥ 7 ॥
āśritān bhojayitvaiva bhuñjanti ca pibanti ca ।
śatasāhasradāsīṣu satīṣvapi svahastakaiḥ ॥ 8 ॥
viṣṇoḥ sevāṃ dhavasevāṃ kurvanti svīyadharmataḥ ।
viṣṇorarthaṃ pācanaṃ ca taṇḍulādiviśodhanam ॥ 9 ॥
kaṇḍanaṃ vāribharaṇaṃ gṛhamārjanamityapi ।
pātrāṇāṃ devapūjāyā gharṣaṇaṃ kṣālanādikam ॥ 10 ॥
tulasīpatrapuṣpāṇāmāhṛtyādyaṃ ca tāḥ sadā ।
kurvantyeva mahābhaktyā nānyadvārā kadācana ॥ 11 ॥
haryarthaṃ khalu bhaktānāṃ kimakārye bhavennanu ।
sarvasvaṃ tvarpitaṃ yatra varṣmaṇā kiṃ na jāyate ॥ 12 ॥
anityena tu dehena nityaṃ puṇyaṃ samarjayet ।
yena bhuktistathā muktiḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā bhavet ॥ 13 ॥
sa eva sarvathā vandyaḥ pūjyastoṣyaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
yasmāt sarvaṃ prabhavati bhogyaṃ bhojyaṃ sukhādikam ॥ 14॥
sampat smṛddhirdhanaṃ patnī patiḥ sutasutādikam ।
kṣetraṃ svargaṃ mahārājyaṃ yasmāttaṃ vai bhajed budhaḥ ॥ 15॥
yāvat svāsthyaṃ bhaved dehe vaśyamindriyamaṇḍalam ।
jāṭharāgniryuvā paktā daihike sānukūlatā ॥ 1 6॥
tāvadātmahitaṃ sādhyaṃ kāmyaṃ vā kāmavarjitam ।
parameśapadaṃ nityānandapūrṇaṃ tu śāśvatam ॥ 17॥
vigame vikale bhāve na syādvai darśanādikam ।
śrīharestat sadā kāryaṃ darśanaṃ cakṣuṣā mudā ॥ 18॥
vikarṇe badhire bhāve na syānnāmaśravo hareḥ ।
sugame sā'nukūle'smin kāryaṃ śravaṇamācyutam ॥ 1 9॥
vṛkṇe vā vikale sevā na bhavedvai satāṃ hareḥ ।
subale sānukūle ca haste sevyo hariḥ svayam ॥ 20 ॥
prabale sugame pāde gamyaṃ mandiramaiśvaram ।
anudvigne'pramatte ca mānase vājasaṃbhṛte ॥ 2 1 ॥
mantavyo bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sukhapradaḥ ।
antarātmā svātmanā vai samupāsyaḥ sadā prabhuḥ ॥ 22॥
bhagne tu nagare sarve tyaktvā yāsyanti viṣṭayaḥ ।
dṛḍhapādātmake tatra sādhyaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 23॥
evaṃ nirṇīya sarvāstāḥ samitpīyūṣayoṣitaḥ ।
sevante śrīhariṃ nityaṃ mandire nirmite śubhe ॥ 24॥
samitpīyūṣanṛpatiścakre triṣavaṇaṃ sadā ।
trikālaṃ prārcanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sandadhe ॥ 25॥
evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ tāsāṃ kālo mahān gataḥ ।
tatkalpe kārtikakṛṣṇāṣṭamī kṛṣṇāṣṭamī hyabhūt ॥ 26॥
