dīpotsavatitheḥ pūrvaṃ saptāhavyavadhānikī ।
iṣapūrṇāṃ samārabhya cakrustā ekabhuktakam ॥27॥
aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ ca cakrustā nirjalaṃ mudā ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñasya kṛṣṇasya pratimāṃ śubhām ॥28 ॥
kānakīṃ kārayitvā ca tathā kṛṣṇasya mātaram ।
kaṃbharākhyāṃ kānakīṃ ca kārayitvā ca tāstathā ॥ 29 ॥
gopālaṃ kṛṣṇapitaraṃ kārayitvā tu kānakam ।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayitvā cā''narcuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ॥ 30 ॥
nṛtyaṃ savādyaṃ cakrustāḥ kaṇṭhasvaravimiśritam ।
tāvadāvirbabhūva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ॥ 31 ॥
caturbhujaḥ kaustubhāḍhyaḥ pītāmbarādikāmbaraḥ ।
navīnajaladaśyāmaḥ śvetakāntivirājitaḥ ॥ 3 2 ॥
dṛṣṭvā''ścarya tu tāḥ prāpuḥ kṣaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
tatastā mumuhustatra divyamūrtau manohare ॥ 33 ॥
divyā''bhūṣādi cānīyā'rpayāmāsuḥ sasaṃbhramāḥ ।
ūrjāhutī dadau tasmai pauraṭaṃ mukuṭaṃ tadā ॥ 34॥
puṣkariṇī dadau tasmai pauraṭe kuṇḍale śubhe ।
padmapatrā tallalāṭe cakre puṇḍraṃ tu cāndanam ॥ 35॥
karīṣiṇī dṛśostasya cakre satkajjalāṃjanam ।
viśvapriyā svarṇapuṣpahārān dadau tu śārṅgiṇe ॥ 36 ॥
ādityavarṇā pradadau kaṭake bhujabandhakau ।
hariṇī tvarpitavatī hyūrmikāḥ kānakīrnavāḥ ॥ 37॥
hemamālinī pradadau raśanāṃ śṛṃkhalāṃ śubhām ।
vasudhītirdadau svarṇanūpurau kiṃkiṇīyutau ॥ 38 ॥
vahniśikhā'rpitavatī pāduke svarṇanirmite ।
padmākṣī pradadau yajñopavītaṃ yogapaṭṭakam ॥ 39 ॥
padmamālinī pradadau miṣṭānnaṃ śākapāyasam ।
prabhāsā pradadau tasmai pānāya śītalaṃ jalam ॥40 ॥
jagatī tvarpitavatī phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ।
paṃktirdadau sugandhaṃ ca puṣpasāraṃ ca dhūpakam ॥41 ॥
bṛhatī pradadau tasmai ghṛtadīpaṃ sumaṃgalam ।
iḍā chatraṃ dadhārā'sya śirasi svarṇabhāsvaram ॥42॥
suṣumṇā piṃgalā śvete dadhyatuścāmare hyubhe ।
purītat vyajanaṃ dhṛtvā karoti pavanārpaṇam ॥43 ॥
viśvārcirnaktakaṃ ramyaṃ kṛṣṇahaste dadau tadā ।
padmanemirdadau puṣpagucchaṃ kṛṣṇakare tadā ॥44॥
hiraṇyavarṇā pradadau cakraṃ sahasranemikam ।
candrā dadau kṛṣṇahaste padmaṃ suvarṇanirmitam ॥45॥
padmavarṇā dadau śaṃkhaṃ vamrī dadau tadā gadām ।
vidyullekhā dadau cāsmai cūmbanaṃ paramātmane ॥46॥
sā sarvābhyo babhūvā'tipremapātraṃ parātmanaḥ ।
tatpuṇyenā'tyadhikaṃ sā patyuḥ premāspadā punaḥ ॥47॥
candrapatnī rohiṇī sā janmāntare babhūva vai ।
ityevaṃ tūpadāḥ datvā''rārtrikaṃ tāśca cakrire ॥48॥
anyāstu cūmbanaṃ dṛṣṭvā lajjāṃ hṛtsu prapedire ।
phalaṃ tāsāṃ nātimānaṃ candrāt tāstu prapedire ॥।49॥
dāsī sarvajitānāmnī pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vyadhāt ।
sā tu sevāparā yasmāt snehapātraṃ tadā'bhavat ॥।50॥
puṣpā'kṣatāñjalīn cārghyaṃ tāśca sarvā dadustataḥ ।
pradakṣiṇanamaskārastavanādyaṃ pracakrire ॥51 ॥
kṛṣṇastvatiprasannaśca dadau prasādapāyasam ।
gṛhītvā tṛptimāpannā dadhyustaṃ hṛdayāmbuje ॥52॥
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha tu tā devīrbhavantvamṛtabhojanāḥ ।
svarṇaratnamaṇihārā divyā divi kṛtagṛhāḥ ॥53 ॥
ityāśiṣaḥ pradāyaivā'dṛśyo babhūva keśavaḥ ।
tāstu pūjāṃ samāpyaiva patiṃ prāhurudantakam ॥54॥
atituṣṭo babhūvāpi samītpīyūṣabhūpatiḥ ।
nityaṃ patnīyutaḥ svargaṃ vāñchati pūjanottaram ॥55॥
patnyaścāpi tu vāñchaṃti kṛṣṇoktaṃ nākamaiśvaram ।
evaṃ kāle gate kalpaprānte kṛṣṇasya vai śrutaḥ ॥56॥
dundubhirghoṣaṇāṃ kurvan puruṣottamaśāsanām ।
śṛṇvantu vai narā nāryo devā devyopi madvacaḥ ॥।57॥
yāsāṃ yeṣāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ yad dāsyāmi tattathāvidham ।
puruṣottamasaṃjño'haṃ paraṃbrahma sanātanaḥ ॥58॥
pravadāmi kṛpayā vai vinā puṇyasya tolanam ।
svalpe kṛte'pyasaṃkhyātaṃ phalaṃ dadāmi sarvathā ॥59॥
ye janā me phalaṃ puṣpaṃ patraṃ candanamakṣatān ।
arpayiṣyantyadhimāse caturthyāṃ kāmyakarmakṛt ॥60 ॥
teṣāṃ tu kāmanāḥ sarvāḥ pūrayiṣye pumuttamaḥ ।
sarvaṃ me'sti mayi sarvaṃ mayā vyāpta carācaram ॥6 1 ॥
nātiriktaṃ svatantraṃ vai kiñcidasti jaḍājaḍam ।
jaḍaṃ cāpyajaḍaṃ tattvaṃ madīyaṃ tvasti sarvathā ॥62॥
mokṣasthānāni sarvāṇi siddhyaiśvaryasthalānyapi ।
vibhūtayaśceśvarāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca padāni vai ॥63॥
mānavānāṃ tathā pātālasthānāṃ ca samṛddhayaḥ ।
sarvaṃ tvasti mamaivedaṃ yadicchantu dadāmyaham ॥64॥
puruṣottamamāsasya vrataṃ pākṣikamāhnikam ।
naiśaṃ vāpi kṛtaṃ yena tasya kiñcinna durlabham ॥65॥
rājā yathābalaṃ kuryād vrataṃ dānaṃ ca pūjanam ।
prajā yathādhanaṃ kuryād vrataṃ dānaṃ samarpaṇam ॥66 ॥
naro nārī yathādharmaṃ kuryānme'dhikamāsikam ।
vrataṃ te me janaṃ bāhaṃ vismarāmi kadācana ॥67॥
adya kālāntare vāpi yathātoṣaṃ phalaṃ bahu ।
dadāmyeva na sandeho na me bhakto'phalo bhavet ॥68॥
sakāmasya kṛte svargādayo lokāḥ kṛtā mayā ।
akāmasya kṛte brahmaloko'sti rakṣito mayā ॥69॥
sarveṣu sukhabāhulyaṃ brahmaloke tvanantakam ।
dadāmyāśritabhaktāya madarthe vratakāriṇe ॥7 0 ॥
nātra mūlyaṃ svakṛtasya mūlyaṃ tu vacaso mama ।
vaco mama dhṛtaṃ yena phalaṃ tasyā'pyanantakam ॥7 1 ॥
nahi vṛṣṭiprade yajñe kṛte vṛṣṭirhi tādṛśī ।
yādṛśī ghanakāle syādamānā cāpyanantakā ॥72 ॥
svayaṃ varṣāmi bhagavān śrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
kṛpayā ghanarūpo'haṃ puruṣottamamāsi vai ॥73 ॥
yathāpātraṃ yathāpekṣaṃ pragṛhṇantu mayā'rpitam ।
vastraphāle phalaṃ kṛtvā vikīryate'nu yāntu tat ॥74॥
puruṣottamamāsasya kariṣyanti praśaṃsanam ।
ye'pi te'pyarjayiṣyanti yatheṣṭaṃ sukhamuttamam ॥75॥
puruṣottamamāsasya vratārthe tvanyadehinām ।
anumodaṃ pradāsyanti te'pi svaḥsukhabhāginaḥ ॥76॥
adhimāse vratakartuḥ sāhāyyaṃ ye tu mānavāḥ ।
kariṣyanti ca tebhyo'pi dāsye yathepsitaṃ sukham ॥77॥
kimu syād durlabhaṃ cādhimāse bhaktasya me khalu ।
dhāma dāsye dhanaṃ dāsye dārān dāsye sutān paśūn ॥78 ॥
patiṃ dāsye sutāṃ dāsye gāṃ rājyaṃ cirajīvitām ।
ārogyaṃ cendriyānandaṃ dāsye'pi śāśvataṃ sukham ॥ 79।।
iti vai -dundubhiṃ śrutvā samitpīyūṣabhūpatiḥ ।
tatpatnyaścātibhaktisthā api vai saptaviṃśatiḥ ॥8 0 ॥
dāsī ca dundubhiṃ natvā'kṣatapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ ।
sampūjya cakrire kartuṃ caturthīvratamuttamam ॥8 1 ॥
prātaḥ pūjāṃ hareḥ kṛtvā madhyāhne'pi sabhojanam ।
pūjanaṃ kārayitvaiva sāyaṃ cakruḥ prapūjanam ॥82॥
pāyasaṃ pūrikāḥ bhojayitvā''rārtrikamādadhuḥ ।
nṛtyagītapravādyaiścakrire jāgaraṇaṃ niśi ॥83॥
prātaḥ snātvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ ।
dānaṃ dadustu ratnānāṃ rasānāṃ samidhāṃ tathā ॥84॥
haviṣyāṇāṃ cāmṛtānāṃ miṣṭānnānāṃ ca dakṣiṇāḥ ।
svarṇarūpyātmikāścāpi phalavastūni vai daduḥ ॥85॥
candrakāntān daduḥ saumyān śītalān svarṇadāndaduḥ ।
tadā viprasvarūpeṇa śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥86॥
samājagāma satpātraṃ bhūtvā ratnābhilāṣukaḥ ।
samitpīyūṣanṛpatistadā sarvapriyāyutaḥ ॥87॥
dadau ratnāḍhyamālāṃ ca namaścakre'tibhāvataḥ ।
vipraḥ prāha varaṃ rājan yācasva bhavitā tathā ॥88॥
samitpīyūṣa ākarṇya vavre cāndraṃ surājyakam ।
sudhāvarṣitvarūpaṃ vai yayāce samidhāṃ kṛte ॥89॥
patnyaścāpi tathā candrapatnītvaṃ vavrire divi ।
tathāstviti varaṃ datvā tirobabhūva bhūsuraḥ ॥90 ॥
kalpānte pralayaṃ prāpya sṛṣṭyādau sa tu bhūpatiḥ ।
samitpīyūṣanāmno'rthaṃ sārthaṃ kurvan haricchayā ॥9 1॥
amṛtāṃśuścauṣadhīnāṃ poṣakaścandramā divi ।
babhūva tasya patnyaśca dakṣaputryaḥ prajajñire ॥92॥
dakṣeṇa vidhinā dattāstasmai tāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ ।
vidyullekhā babhūvāgryā rohiṇīnāmataḥ priyā ॥93॥
anyāścāpi mṛgaśīrṣā hyārdrā punarvasustathā ।
puṣyā''śleṣā maghā pūrvaphālgunyuttaraphālgunī ॥94॥
hastaścitrā tathā svātī viśākhā cānurādhikā ।
jyeṣṭhā mūlā pūrvaṣāḍhottarāṣāḍhā śravātmikā ॥95॥
dhaniṣṭhā śatabhīṣā ca pūrvabhādrapadā tathā ।
uttarabhadrikā caiva revatī tvaśvinī tathā ॥96॥
bharaṇī kṛttikā ceti militāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ ।
babhūvuśca divi candrapatnyo devyo'mṛtapradāḥ ॥97॥
dāsī devayutīnāmnī jātā'bhijitsamāhvayā ।
madhyāhne'syāḥ kṛto vāsaḥ sarvakāryajayapradaḥ ॥98॥
ākalpaṃ tāśca vartante caturthyā vratapuṇyataḥ ।
tasmāt kāryamadhivāso'paracaturthyupoṣaṇam ॥99॥
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ phalāhāraṃ mamārcanam ।
śrotā vaktā tathā cāsya caturthīvratabhāgbhavet ॥ 100 ॥

iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye samitpīyūṣarājñastatsaptaviṃśatipatnīnāṃ dundubhiśravaṇottaraṃ dvitīyapakṣacaturthīvratakaraṇena divi candrarājyanakṣatrarājyaprāptirdāsyā abhijittva-prāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekādaśā-dhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.311 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 311 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 312
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 313 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! kathā prāksṛṣṭisaṃbhavā ।
vasudhānākhyanṛpateḥ rādhyāsāyāśca yoṣitaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
pūrvasṛṣṭyantime kāle nṛpo babhūva dakṣiṇe ।
vasudhāno mahābhakto mahādevasya sevakaḥ ॥ 2 ॥
rādhyāsā tasya patnī ca mahādevasya sevikā ।
ārādhanāṃ mahādevātmakasya svāminaḥ sadā ॥ 3 ॥
karotyabhinnabhāvena pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
nityaṃ prātaḥ svayaṃ snātvā patiṃ snāpayati prabhum ॥ 4 ॥
mahādevaṃ vividhaistu jalairdugdhādibhistathā ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ vastraṃ sarpaṃ ca śarkarāṃ jalam ॥ 5 ॥
ārārtrikaṃ candanaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ samarpya sā ।
vasudhānasya sevāyāṃ dāsīva samatiṣṭhati ॥ 6 ॥
rājā'pi prātarājñāya tyaktvā nidrāṃ muhūrtakam ।
dhyātvā śrīśaṃkaraṃ brahma snānaṃ pūjāṃ karoti ca ॥ 7 ॥
hṛdi dhyānaṃ tathā pūjāṃ śaṃbhoḥ kṛtvā vibhajya ca ।
annādikaṃ tvāśritebhyo bhuṃktennaṃ strīyuto nṛpaḥ ॥ 8 ॥
rājyakārye prajākāryaṃ kurutastau kṛpānvitau ।
devakāryaṃ dānakāryaṃ kuruto nityamātmavat ॥ 9 ॥
dadato'nnaṃ bhikṣukebhyo vastrāṇi tadapekṣiṇe ।
pātrāṇi dānapātrāya dhanāni ca phalāni ca ॥ 10 ॥
dānaśabdastayordvāri virāmaṃ yāti naiva ha ।
dānakriyāpi ca śāntā naiva bhavatyaharniśam ॥ 11 ॥
yajñānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi ।
tayorgṛhe'rhaṇāṃ śaṃbhoraharniśaṃ prajāyate ॥ 1 2 ॥
gavāṃ dānaṃ rasadānaṃ miṣṭadānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
kurutastau patipatnyau tuṣṭā yathā'rthinastathā ॥ 13 ॥
na tadrājye'vagrahosti vatsaro na kratuṃ vinā ।
na cotsavā vinā kṛṣṇaṃ vinā śaṃbhuṃ na kīrtanam ॥ 14 ॥
pravartayāmāsatustau rājye dharmān śivasya vai ।
śivālayeṣu sarveṣu pūjāṃ kārayataśca tau ॥ 15॥
grāmādhīśān samāhūya sarvāँstau viṣayasthitān ।
ājñāpayāmāsatustau pūjā deyā śivālaye ॥ 16॥
anyathā satyamevedaṃ sa nau daṇḍyo bhaviṣyati ।
pūjādānācchivastuṣṭo bhaviṣyati śivāyutaḥ ॥ 17॥
ghṛtadīpāstvakhaṇḍā vai tatra devāḥ śivālaye ।
yasya yasyābhito grāmaṃ yāvantaśca śivālayāḥ ॥ 18॥
tatra tatrā'khaṇḍadīpo dyotanīyo nṛpājñayā ।
nṛpājñābhaṃgakartustu śiraśchedo bhaviṣyati ॥ 19॥
nṛpapūjā pradātavyā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।
nyūnakartustathā rājā śiraśchetsyatyasaṃśayam ॥20॥
iti sarvatra tābhyāṃ vai lakṣmi! pūjā vinirmitā ।
tayostu bhayato dīpā dīptā pratiśivālayam ॥21॥
jagmatustau mahāśaṃbhu rātryāṃ darśanahetave ।
vyomayānena sarvatra rājye yatra śivālayāḥ ॥22॥
āprātastau tu sarvatra vidhāyā'rcanadarśanam ।
punarāyāta āvāsaṃ kurutaḥ snānapūjanam ॥23॥
cikīrṣataḥ pāraṇā tau niṣīdata sma yāvatā ।
tāvattatra samāyātau bhikṣukau tu śivāśivau ॥24॥
jñātvā vai kṣudhitau sādhū dadatastau subhojyakam ।
riktaṃ tulasīpatreṇa vīkṣyā''hatustu tāvubhau ॥25॥
nārāyaṇaprasādaśced bhokṣyāvahe pavitrakam ।
vaiṣṇavau vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭhau śivāśivau na bhokṣyataḥ ॥26॥
yadi prāsādikaṃ na syācchrīpuruṣottamā'rpitam ।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo dharmo vaiṣṇavatvaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ ॥27॥
vaiṣṇavaistu kṛtaṃ dattaṃ gṛhṇīvo'tīva bhāvataḥ ।
yadi vaiṣṇavadattaṃ na gṛhṇīvo na tu vai kvacit ॥28॥
yuvābhyāmarpyate nityaṃ pūjābhojanadīpakam ।
paśyāvo na tu gṛhṇīvo gṛhṇīvo brahmaṇe'rpitam ॥29॥
ātmanivedibhaktānāṃ dharmo'yaṃ sarvadā mataḥ ।
brahmaṇe'narpitaṃ yat tadbhojyaṃ peyaṃ na vai kvacit ॥30॥
vastraṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ payaścānnaṃ tathā''sanam ।
auṣadhaṃ kaṇamātraṃ vā cūrṇaṃ carvaṇamityapi ॥3 1॥
adya svādyaṃ tathā khādyaṃ bhogyaṃ dhāryaṃ mamā'rghyakam ।
mardyaṃ deyaṃ tathā'rpyaṃ ca sarvaṃ yad brahmaṇe'rpitam ॥ 32॥
tad gṛhṇīvo na cā'nyadvai dharmo'yaṃ tvāvayoḥ sadā ।
sarvaṃ brahmārpaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ gṛhavastradhanādikam ॥33 ॥
jaḍaṃ yadvā cetanaṃ vā svakīyaṃ yaddhi manyate ।
tadvai bhagavate datvā śiṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta bhaktarāṭ ॥ 34॥
gṛhastaṃbheṣu vai vāri kuṃbhīṣu mañjulāsu ca ।
peṣaṇīṣu ca khaṭvāsu paryaṃkādiṣvapi gṛhe ॥35॥।
tulasīkaṇṭhikāṃ baddhvā tūpayoktavyameva tat।
paśūnāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ harmyaśākhināṃ śakaṭasya ca ॥ 36॥
vaiṣṇavatvaṃ vinā naiva kartavyamupayojanam ।
annānāṃ tvatha vastrāṇāṃ cakrāṇāṃ vāhanasya ca ॥ 37॥
jīvikālohabhastrāṇāṃ kośānāṃ paṇyakasya ca ।
vaiṣṇavatvamṛte naiva kartavyamupayojanam ॥ 38॥
vādyānāṃ cāpi śastrāṇāṃ hetīnāṃ vastunāminām ।
ātmanivedinā kāryā bhagavaccihnayogitā ॥ 39॥
sutaḥ sutā dhana dārā dāsā dāsyo gṛhāṇi ca ।
patnī patiḥ kuṭumbaṃ ca sarvaṃ vai haraye'rpayet ॥40 ॥
abhakṣyaṃ tadabhogyaṃ yaddharaye nā'rpitaṃ bhavet ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhogyaṃ tathā peyaṃ haraye'rpitameva yat ॥41 ॥
nibodhata yuvāṃ tadvai badaryāśramamuttamam ।
prāgahaṃ prāptavāँstatra nārāyaṇātsamantrakam ॥42 ॥
vaiṣṇavatvaṃ tato devyai pārvatyai ca samantrakam ।
vaiṣṇavatvaṃ mayā dattaṃ gaṇebhyaścāpi sarvathā ॥43॥
mama putro gaṇeśastu śrīkṛṣṇāṃśo'sti vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
skando'pi vaiṣṇavo jāto rudrā api ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ॥44॥
devyaśca vaiṣṇavīśreṣṭhā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।
kailāsaḥ sarvathā'bhīṣṭo vaiṣṇavo'sti mayā kṛtaḥ ॥45॥
badaryāśramayogena himālayo'pi vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
pitaro vaiṣṇavāsteṣāṃ kanyā menā'pi vaiṣṇavī ॥46॥
kṣīro'pi sāgaro viṣṇudhārako vaiṣṇavaḥ sadā ।
tatputrī śrīḥ ramā lakṣmīścandraścaite'pi vaiṣṇavāḥ ॥47॥
vāmanasya padāṃguṣṭhasparśā gaṃgāpi vaiṣṇavī ।
vāsukiḥ śeṣabandhuśca vaiṣṇavo'sti mayā dhṛtaḥ ॥48॥
triśūlaṃ sūryato jātaṃ dvādaśo viṣṇurarkarāṭ ।
vṛṣabho gokulātprāpto goloke kṛṣṇabhaktarāṭ ॥49 ॥
siṃho nṛsiṃhavaṃśo yaḥ sa cāsti vaiṣṇavo mahān ।
meghā vairājakeśāśca vaiṣṇavā yajñapoṣitāḥ ॥50 ॥
mayūro meghamitraṃ ca picchaṃ mukuṭasaṃśritam ।
kṛṣṇayogānmeghayogād vaiṣṇavatvaṃ sadā'sti vai ॥51 ॥
kimvadhikaṃ pravakṣye vai nṛsiṃhamastakaṃ gale ।
dadhan vai vaiṣṇavaścāsmi viṣṇubhakto'smi sarvathā ॥52॥
viṣṇurvai vyāpakaṃ brahma yattejo'haṃ sadāśivaḥ ।
bāṇarūpo'smi sañjāto dhyāyaँstaṃ mūrtimānapi ॥53॥
sarvātmakaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ ।
tasmādahaṃ tathā sarvaṃ jāyate tatra līyate ॥54॥
tato rājan gṛhāṇa tvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ manumādarāt ।
ahaṃ śaṃbhuḥ pradadāmi rājñyai dāsyati pārvatī ॥55 ॥
ityādiṣṭo vasudhāno jagrāhā'ṣṭākṣaraṃ manum ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'vyānmāmiti jagrāha śaṃkarāt ॥56 ॥
taṃ ca jagrāha rādhyāsā rājñī vai pārvatīmukhāt ।
jagṛhatuśca tulasīkaṇṭhīṃ candrārdhvapuṇḍrakam ॥57॥
nārāyaṇārcanavāri prasādaṃ cācyutasya vai ।
ādadati tu tau tatra prajātau vaiṣṇavau tataḥ ॥58॥
viṣṇave bhojanaṃ peyaṃ tulasīpatramiśritam ।
nivedayāmāsatuśca dadatuścāpi śaṃbhave ॥59 ॥
pārvatyai dadatuścā'tha jagṛhatuśca tau mudā ।
ādaturvāripānaṃ ca cakraturvai sukhānvitau ॥6 0 ॥
tṛptau babhūvatuścāti harṣitau vai śivāśivau ।
āśīrvādān dadatuśca dhanavantāvakhaṇḍitau ॥6 1 ॥
susmṛddhau śāśvatarājyau bhavatāṃ bhṛtyakoṭikau ।
iti kṛtvā kathayitvā'dṛśyau jātau śivāśivau ॥6 2॥
rājñā rātryā ca nityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
śivātmā'yaṃ ceti bhaktyā pūjyate vaiṣṇavīdiśā ॥6 3 ॥
evaṃ tābhyāṃ sadā kṛṣṇe pūjite puruṣottamaḥ ।
māso'tidivyasamayaḥ prāpto vyeti dināddinam ॥64॥
tāvat tābhyāṃ parapakṣapañcamyāṃ dundubhiḥ śrutaḥ ।
śṛṇvantu devatanavo rājadehāśca mānavāḥ ॥65 ॥
surā divyasamṛddhāśca sthāvarā jaṃgamāśca ye ।
puruṣottamamāsasyā'smi dundubhirhareḥ priyaḥ ॥66 ॥
haryājñayoddhoṣayāmi maṇiṃ kapardikāphalam ।
māse'traikadinakṛcchrāt prāpnuvantu vasundharām ॥67॥
alakāṃ hemanagarīṃ tathā bhūmiṃ ca kāṃcanīm ।
golokasthāṃ tathā'nyeṣāṃ dikpālānāṃ tu hāṭakīm ॥68॥
rājadhānīṃ tathā svarṇapurīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ tanum ।
sāmrājyaṃ cāpi vā'nyadvai yatheṣṭaṃ yāntu vai hareḥ ॥69॥
rasādhipatyaṃ sauryaṃ vā cāndraṃ gaura padaṃ ca vā ।
bārhaspatyaṃ tathaiśānaṃ tvāgneyaṃ vānyadeva vā ॥70॥
yeṣāmiṣṭaṃ tu yadvai syād dāsye tannātra saṃśayaḥ ।
adhimāse tu sampūrṇa pākṣikaṃ dainikaṃ ca vā ॥71 ॥
vrataṃ prapūjanaṃ kṛtvā'rjayantu paramaṃ sukham ।
parameṣṭhipadaṃ vāpi vairājaṃ satyamityapi ॥72॥
raudraṃ śaivaṃ ca vā brāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma caityapi ।
gṛhṇantu kṛpayā me'dya pañcamīvratamātrataḥ ॥73॥
ityuktvā dundubhistatra virarāmā'tha tāvubhau ।
natvā taṃ dundubhiṃ dhyātvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ॥74॥
pupūjatustaṃ vādyaṃ vai puṣpākṣataistu kānakaiḥ ।
arthayāmāsatustatra kāṃcaneyaṃ padaṃ mahat ॥75॥
tathāstvevaṃ dundubhiśca vicintya hṛdye tadā ।
anyatra prayayau tau pañcamīvrataṃ pracakratuḥ ॥76॥
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā śaṃbhuṃ natvā tathā''darāt ।
guruṃ prapūjya vidhivaccakraturnaityakārcanam ॥77॥
mūrtiṃ vidhāya sauvarṇīṃ puruṣottamarūpaṇīm ।
āvāhya tatra ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ॥78 ॥
ācamanaṃ pradāyaiva pañcāmṛtena vāriṇā ।
snāpayāmāsatustau ca mārjayāmāsatustathā ॥79॥
mardayāmāsatuścaitau candanārdrasugandhibhiḥ ।
dhārayāmāsatuścaiva vastrāṇi kānakānyapi ॥8 0 ॥
bhūṣayāmāsatuścāpi mukuṭādi vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
śṛṃgārayāmāsatuśca kajjalaiḥ kesarādibhiḥ ॥8 1 ॥
sugandhayāmāsatuśca puṣpadhūpādisārakaiḥ ।
prakāśayāmāsatuśca dīpanīrājanādibhiḥ ॥82॥
prasādayāmāsatuśca stutipradakṣiṇādibhiḥ ।
kṣamāpayāmāsatuścāparādhānarghyakārpaṇaiḥ ॥83 ॥
santarpayāmāsatuśca miṣṭānnapāyasādibhiḥ ।
santoṣayāmāsatuśca tāmbūlailādicarvaṇaiḥ ॥84॥
evaṃ madhyāhnasamaye pūjayāmāsatustathā ।
bhojayāmāsatuścāpi niśyapyevaṃ pracakratuḥ ॥85॥
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaiḥ pāllavaistoraṇaistathā ।
sumanohārakaiścāpi kalaśairdīpakaistathā ॥86 ॥
racayāmāsatū ramyaṃ pūrayāmāsatuśca tau ।
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ madhye dhānyairnavairnavaiḥ ॥87॥
saṃsthāpayāmāsatuśca sauvarṇaṃ kalaśaṃ tataḥ ।
tatra ghaṭe pañcaratnaṃ jalaṃ phalaṃ tathā'mbaram ॥88 ॥
vinyasya tilapūrṇāṃ ca sthālīṃ dadhyaturādarāt ।
tatra mūrtiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pupūjatuḥ suvastubhiḥ ॥89॥
snānaṃ vastraṃ candanaṃ kuṃkumaṃ puṣpāṇi cākṣatān ।
vibhūṣaṇāni hārāँśca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ phalāni ca ॥ 90 ॥
ārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ miṣṭānnabhojanam ।
jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ cakraturarthanām ॥91 ॥
nartanaṃ gītikāṃ vādyasahitāṃ cakratustadā ।
tato jāgaraṇe tatra madhyarātrau pumuttamaḥ ॥92॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīśrīrādhikāpatiḥ ।
pārvatīmāṇikīsvāmī prabheśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥93॥
preyasīśreyasīpātā śrījayālalitāpatiḥ ।
akṣarā'dhipatirmuktapatirgopīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ॥94॥
sarvapatiścāntarātmā maṃgalāyatano hariḥ ।
prādurbabhūva sahasā vihasan kāśayan diśaḥ ॥95॥
prāhā'smyatiprasanno'haṃ pañcamyā vratavartanāt ।
varadānaṃ prayacchāmi vṛṇuta yadyathepsitam ॥96 ॥
bhaktau me vaiṣṇavau jātau tenā'smyatipratoṣitaḥ ।
dadāmi mama sarvasvaṃ kimanyanyat sudurlabham ॥97॥
śrutvā natvā daṇḍavacca prāhatuḥ puruṣottamam ।
vasudhānaśca rādhyāsā prabho nā'viditaṃ tava ॥98॥
caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ dhanādhipatyamalpakam ।
kāṃkṣāvahe na tatsvāmin raṃkatuṣṭikaraṃ hi tat ॥99॥
pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ svāmin kuṃbhakārakriyāmayam ।
necchāvastatpadaṃ tasmādaindraṃ daityaprapīḍanam ॥ 100 ॥
tatpadāni na kāṃkṣāvaḥ kāṃkṣāvastatparaṃ tu yat ।
yāvatāmīśvarāṇāṃ vairājādīnāṃ paraṃ tu yat ॥ 10 1॥
mahāviṣṇoḥ paraṃ yacca hiraṇyādhipateḥ padam।
śrīpurākhyātparaṃ yacca tejo vaikuṇṭhataḥ param ॥ 102॥
viṣṇorvai sthānataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyādhipateḥ padam ।
māhākauberakaṃ puṃso bhūmnaḥ kośamayaṃ tu yat ॥ 1 03॥
īśvarāṇāṃ tu koṭau tad vartate yanmahattamam ।
anantā'ṇḍakuberāṇāṃ tṛptistasya kaṇena vai ॥ 1 04॥
jāyate tanmahārājyaṃ bhūmnaḥ kośādhipātmakam ।
sarveśānāṃ tu vai divyahiraṇyā''ttiryato'sti vai ॥ 105॥
taddhiraṇyādhipatyaṃ vai samicchāvaḥ kṛpā'stu te ।
bhaktānāṃ tu kṛte kiñcidadhikaṃ svāmino'sti na ॥10 6॥
yadyayuktaṃ vāñcchitaṃ cet kṣamyatāṃ puruṣottama ।
nānyat kāṃkṣāvahe kṛṣṇa tuṣṭo yatpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 107॥
ityabhyarthya pādayostau patitau śrīharestadā ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha prāhāpi punareva tau ॥ 108॥
vartamānasya hairaṇyādhipaterāyuṣaḥ kṣaye ।
sargāntare bhavanto vai bhaviṣyathastathāvidhau ॥ 109॥
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastirobabhūva tatsthalāt ।
anantānāṃ hiraṇyādhipatīnāṃ tatra saṃkṣayaḥ ॥ 11 0॥
jāyate vāsudevasya dine dine na saṃśayaḥ ।
tatraikasya hiraṇyādhipaternāśo'bhavattadā ॥ 111 ॥
vasudhānaṃ ca rādhyāsāṃ nināya tatpadaṃ prabhuḥ ।
mahākauberakaṃ caiśaṃ padaṃ tābhyāṃ dadau hariḥ ॥ 1 12॥
hiraṇyādhipatirbhūtvā rājate vasudhānakaḥ ।
rādhyāsā'pīśvarī śreṣṭhā kuberāṇī virājate ॥ 1 13॥
yadasya brahmaṇaścaturmukhasya padmajasya vai ।
pitā virāṭ tasya pitā mahāviṣṇustataḥ paraḥ ॥ 1 14॥
yo nāma pūruṣaśca bhūmanārāyaṇābhidhaḥ ।
tasya kośeśvaro bhūtvā vasudhāno narādhipaḥ ॥ 1 15॥
vartate'yaṃ bhūmakośādhipaḥ sarvādhipo yathā ।
prākṛtapralayaṃ yāvad vartiṣyate dhanādhipaḥ ॥ 1 16॥
sākṣātpratyakṣadarśitvād vedmyahaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
lakṣmi! priye! na cānyo'sti sarvajño māṃ vinā yataḥ ॥ 1 17॥
parabrahmasvarūpo'haṃ vedmi sarvajñasarvavit ।
ityevaṃ vai mayā tābhyāṃ pūrvasṛṣṭyantakālikam ॥ 1 18॥
pañcamyāstu vratasyānte phalaṃ datta hi śāśvatam ।
idṛgvidhaṃ phalaṃ dātuṃ śaktaḥ kaḥ syāddhi māṃ vinā ॥ 1 19॥
sarve vai kālakavalāḥ ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ khalu ।
sarvaṃ sṛṣṭvā praviśāmi vasāmi viramāmi ca ॥ 120 ॥
tathā'pyakuṇṭhavijñāno bhavāmyeko na cāparaḥ ।
tadatra kathitaḥ pūrvasṛṣṭivṛttānta eva te ॥ 121॥
pañcamyāṃ vratakarturhi narasyāpi striyāstathā ।
śroturvaktuḥ phalaṃ tādṛgasya vai bhavate dhruvam ॥ 122॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dvitīyapakṣasya pañcamyāṃ vratakara-ṇena śivabhaktayoḥ pūrvasṛṣṭisthayoḥ rādhyāsārājñīvasudāna-nṛpayoḥ śivapradattavaiṣṇavatvottaraṃ vedhaḥpitṛvairājā-dapyūrdhvamīśvarasṛṣṭau vartamānasṛṣṭau hiraṇyakośādhi-patitvātmakamahākauberapadaprāptivarṇananāmā dvādaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥1.312॥


← adhyāyaḥ 312 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 313
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 314 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! śrīpuruṣottamāśritā ।
kathā sampatpradā saukhyapradā sarveṣṭadā sadā ॥ 1 ॥
pūrve kalpe brahmaṇo vai marudeśe'tidhārmikaḥ ।
dhanāḍhyo brāhmaṇo nāmnā devayavo babhūva ha ॥ 2 ॥
tasya patnī devajuṣṭā'pyāsītpativratā śubhā ।
tayorbhṛtyo girikṣito bhṛtyā cādridyutistathā ॥ 3 ॥
babhūvatuḥ sadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaparāyaṇau ।
svāmikāryaṃ vidhāyaiva kṛṣṇacaryā pracakratuḥ ॥ 4 ॥
brahmakarmaparā nityaṃ ṣaṭkarmādiparāyaṇāḥ ।
catvāraste babhūvurvai kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ॥ 5 ॥
brāhmaṇau svāminau cāpi viprāṇyau sevike ca te ।
haryarthaṃ manasā vāṇyā tanvā ninyuḥ kṣaṇātkṣaṇam ॥ 6 ॥
marudeśādhipatinā rājñā devasakhena vai ।
nagaryāṃ bhāsvatīnāmnyāṃ kāritaṃ viṣṇumandiram ॥ 7 ॥
saptaśikharasaṃśobhaṃ tryagragolamanoharam ।
svarṇastaṃbhāṃganaramyaṃ triprākāramanoharam ॥ 8 ॥
madhye tu śikharā'ntaḥsthasiṃhāsane caturbhujaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇurlakṣmīrādhāsamanvitaḥ ॥ 9 ॥
dakṣaśikharagarbheṣu śrīprabhāpārvatītrikam ।
svasvadāsīsamājuṣṭaṃ pratyekaṃ rājate śubham ॥ 10 ॥
vāmaśikharagarbheṣu māṇikyā lalitā jayā ।
svasvadāsīsamājuṣṭā pratyekaṃ rājate triṣu ॥ 1 1॥
tatsevāyā niyuktāste catvāro vai pṛthak pṛthak ।
devayavo madhyabhāge pūjāṃ karoti sarvadā ॥ 1 2॥
girikṣito bahiścandanādikāryakaro'bhavat ।
devajuṣṭā dakṣabhāge pārvatīśrīprabhārcanam ॥ 13 ॥
adridyutirvāmabhāge māṇikyādyarcanādikam ।
karotyeva vibhāgena rājā dadāti vetanam ॥ 14॥
bhavanaṃ vāsayogyaṃ ca jīvikāṃ vāṭikādikām ।
vārṣikaṃ ca tathā dravyaṃ tathā svarṇasahasrakam ॥ 15॥
vastrānnabhūṣaṇādīni dadāti cotsave'dhikam ।
devapūjāsunaivedyādikaṃ dadāti bhūpatiḥ ॥ 16 ॥
evaṃ vai vartamānena vipradevayavena vai ।
lobhākṛṣṭena manasā gṛhyate ḍhabbukaṃ kvacit ॥ 17॥
kvacittu rūpyakaṃ svarṇamudrā yātrālubhiḥ khalu ।
devāyā'rpitamityetaddevadravyaṃ mumoṣa saḥ ॥ 18 ॥
tena cauryaduritena devadhanena miśritam ।
devayavasya saddravyaṃ dūṣitaṃ tvāsa cañcalam ॥ 1 9॥
iyeṣa gantumanyatra caṃcalā hi śriyo matāḥ ।
devadravyānvitaṃ yattat samūlaṃ nāśameti vai ॥ 20 ॥
yadyapi nyāyalabdhaṃ svaṃ devadravyaspṛśiṃ gatam ।
dūṣitaṃ tad vinaśyedvai lakṣaṃ nītvā pragacchati ॥ 2 1 ॥
annaṃ cāpi surānnādimiśritaṃ naśyati drutam ।
vastraṃ devāmbarayuktaṃ nāśayatyeva dehinam ॥ 22॥
vastumātraṃ cauryalabdhaṃ yanna prasādarūpataḥ ।
pūjakācāryagurubhirdattaṃ devasvarūpi tat ॥23 ॥
yatra kṣiptaṃ tu tat sarva mūlīyamapi dahyati ।
cullīkāṣṭhā'nalo'raṇyagato'raṇyaṃ pradahyati ॥ 24॥
gavāmannaṃ bhikṣukānnaṃ viprānnaṃ pramadānnakam ।
anāthānnaṃ nirādhārānnamagniḥ kupitaḥ sa vai ॥ 25॥
brahmasvaṃ vidhavāsvaṃ ca devasvaṃ bhikṣunāṇakam ।
anāḍhyasvaṃ mahānagniḥ pated yatra sa dahyati ॥ 26॥
devapūjākṛtā kiñcitphalaṃ cānnaṃ ca ḍhabbukam ।
na grāhyaṃ devatātvaṃ ced yato dahati tatkulam ॥ 27॥
pūrvaiḥ pūrvatamaiścāpi muṣitaṃ devanāṇakam ।
tadevānyadapi nyāyyaṃ muṣṇāti muṣakasya vai ॥ 28 ॥
devayavo'pi devasya mandire harisannidhau ।
yātrālubhistvarpitaṃ ca prakṣiptaṃ ḍhabbukādikam ॥2 9॥
puṣṇātyeva svake dravye nikṣipati ca vṛddhaye ।
yena kena nimittena tasya nāśaṃ upāgataḥ ॥ 30 ॥
marukosalayoḥ rājñoryuddhaṃ ghoraṃ babhūva ha ।
kosalasya tu sainyairvai vijito marubhūpatiḥ ॥ 31 ॥
sainyaistu nagarī sarvā bhāsvatī dhvaṃsitā tadā ।
dhanāḍhyānāṃ nāṇakāni hṛtāni vai prasahya taiḥ ॥ 3 2॥
nṛpamānyaṃ dvijaṃ jñātvā sarvaṃ tasya hṛtaṃ dhanam ।
niṣkāsitastataḥ sthānāt sabhāryābhṛtyamātrakaḥ ॥ 33 ॥
yayau sa raivatagirau hiraṇyāyāstaṭe śubhe ।
somanāthasya nikaṣāṃ vane mūlaphalāśanaḥ ॥ 34॥
nirgamayatyahānyeva paryaṭan bhṛtyadārayuk ।
sarasvatīṃ nadī prācīṃ gatvā pippalaśākhinam ॥ 35॥
niṣasāda jalaṃ pītvā viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tadā ।
sasmāra ca hariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum ॥ 36 ॥
cintayāmāsuranyonyaṃ śatrujanyaṃ parābhavam ।
girikṣitastadā bhṛtyaḥ prāha devayavaṃ dvijam ॥ 37॥
yasya vai pūjanaṃ samyak kṛtaṃ tenāpi śārṅgiṇā ।
rakṣitā na vayaṃ śatrorupadrave'pi sevakāḥ ॥ 38॥
sarvasvaṃ vai hṛtaṃ sainyairmandirasyāpi kāṃcanam।
tatrāpi rakṣaṇaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ śrīviṣṇunā tadā ॥ 39॥
parasya rakṣaṇaṃ kasmāt kuryād yaḥ svaṃ na rakṣayet ।
ityukte brāhmaṇo devayavaḥ prāha svabhṛtyakam ॥ 40 ॥
maivaṃ vada tathā nāsti yathā tvaṃ vadasi dvija! ।
rakṣati śrīhariḥ sarvān jīvato rakṣitā vayam ॥4 1 ॥
rakṣā kṛtā caturṇāṃ vai yajjīvāmo'tra saṃyutāḥ ।
devadravyāpahārasya pātakaṃ tvantavarjitam ॥42॥
tatkṛtaṃ vai mayā tacca dravyaṃ svadravyamiśritam ।
tena sarvaṃ gato no vai dravyaṃ matpātakena vai ॥43॥
devadravyaṃ ca devānnaṃ yasya kośe hi jīryati ।
tasya sarvasvanāśāya phalaṃ bhavati niścitam ॥44॥
sarvasvaṃ tadgataṃ yogyaṃ phalamatraiva cārjitam ।
yamaloko'pi bhoktavyo hyadhunā śiṣyate'pi hi ॥45॥
tathāpi sevanasyaitatphalaṃ rakṣati no'tra vai ।
yadvayaṃ ghātitā naiva rakṣitāḥ paramātmanā ॥46 ॥
devadravyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalādikam ।
vastraṃ yānaṃ gṛhaṃ pātraṃ bhoktavyaṃ naiva sarvathā ॥47॥
anyāyenāpi lobhenā'jñānenāpi prasahya vā ।
bhuktaṃ yadi tadā tattu bhokturnāśakaraṃ bhavet ।।48॥
tadvayaṃ nāśitā naiva kṛpā seyaṃ harerdvija ।
atha yatnaḥ prakartavyo yathā yamo na saṃcaret ॥49 ॥
prapannānāṃ haristrātā yamastatra na saṃcaret ।
prapattau ṣaḍvidhatvaṃ vai nārāyaṇena darśitam ॥5 0 ॥
viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ ca sthirā matiḥ ।
ānukūlyasya saṃkalpaḥ prātikūlyavivarjanam ॥5 1 ॥
tatra harirmadarthaṃ yat karoti sakalaṃ tu tat ।
madarthaṃ yogyamevā'sti tvevaṃ viśvāsamācaret ॥52 ॥
tvaṃ mamāsi tavāhaṃ cetyevaṃ varaṇamarthayet ।
sarvasvo'haṃ pādayoste nyasto'smi nyāsamācaret ॥5 3 ॥
satyapi sārvabhaume'pi kārpaṇyaṃ dāsavaccaret ।
sarvanāśe'pi khedaṃ na kuryānmatiṃ sthirāṃ caret ॥5 4॥
tava toṣo mama toṣo nānyatheti sukalpayet ।
ityevaṃ tasya yadramyaṃ ramyameva mamāpi tat ॥5 5 ॥
nānyaditi prakuryādvai matvā bhaktiṃ sadā hareḥ ।
aparādhān kṣamāpyaiva so'smān saṃtārayiṣyati ॥56 ॥
udarārthaṃ pralobhena kṛtaṃ cauryādi pātakam ।
tatsarvaṃ bhagavān bhaktyā dhruvaṃ prajvālayiṣyati ॥57॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brahma vyāharaँstaṃ tvanusmaran ।
yaḥ prayāti tyajanvarṣma sa yāti paramaṃ padam ॥5 8 ॥
tasmādatraiva sattīrthe hyuṣitvā cirameva tu ।
ārādhya taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yāsyāma vai punaḥ ॥59॥
yadvā''yuṣyakṣaye tasya dhāma prāpsyāma īpsitam ।
aparādhasahasrāṇi sa śrīhariḥ kṣamiṣyate ॥6 0॥
iti vicārya catvāraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇābhidhām ।
japayajñaṃ pracakruste prācīsarasvatīsthale ॥6 1 ॥
prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pupūjurnityameva te ।
dalaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ kandādi yadupasthitam ॥62॥
arpayanti haraye te jalārthaṃ prārthanādikam ।
kurvanti sma prage madhye sāyaṃ niśi punaḥ punaḥ ॥63॥
evaṃ vai vartamāneṣu vyomamārgeṇa saṃśrutaḥ ।
dundubhistvadhimāsasya śrīpuruṣottamoditaḥ ॥64॥
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ prātardundubhestu puruṣottamamāsi vai ।
ghoṣaṇā mokṣadā yadvā sakāmānāṃ tu bhogadā ॥65॥
pravartate sma sā karṇapathaṃ prāptā manoramā ।
caturbhistvapi sadhyānāṃ vicārvā'vadhṛtā hṛdi ॥66 ॥
śṛṇvantu mānavāḥ sarve nirdhanāḥ sadhanā api ।
nirāgasaḥ sāparādhāstathā nāryo narā api ॥67॥
pūjāyāṃ me tvaparādhā bhavanti bahavopi vai ।
yadi kaiścit kṛtāstān vai gaṇayiṣye manāṅ na vai ॥68॥
kurvantu vratamadyaiva ṣaṣṭhyāṃ dvitīyapakṣake ।
puruṣottamamāsyasmin kṣamayiṣye nu pātakam ॥69॥
vajralepādikaṃ pāpaṃ kṣālayiṣye'dya vai vratāt ।
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ vinā yāñcāṃ samāgatam ॥70॥
gṛhītvāpi tu ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vai vrataṃ kāryaṃ mamātra hi ।
phalaṃ bhuktvā jalaṃ pītvā grasitvā pavanaṃ ca vā ॥7 1॥
vrataṃ kārya mama ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tasmai dāsye yathepsitam ।
prāk kṛtaṃ me viparītaṃ smariṣye tanna sarvathā ॥72॥
adyā'haṃ kṛpayā dāsye tadiṣṭaṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
puruṣottamamāso'yaṃ vartate bhuvanatraye ॥73॥
īśaloke'pyayaṃ māso mamā''jñayā pravartate ।
sarvamūrdhanyamāso'yaṃ mūrdhanyapuruṣottamāt ॥74॥
mūrdhanyaphaladastasmād vṛṇutepsitamuttamam ।
ityuktvā dundubhistasmāt sthānāt sthānāntaraṃ yayau ॥75॥
catvāro brāhmaṇāste tu dāridryaduḥkhapīḍitāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrataṃ pracakruste śrutvā dundubhiśabditam ॥76॥
dāridryaṃ naṣṭatāṃ gacchet sukhaṃ vaibhavasaṃbhavam ।
pūrvato'pyadhikaṃ syācca viśālā dhanasampadaḥ ॥77॥
yānavāhanasaudhāni dāsā dāsyaḥ samujjvalāḥ ।
rājyādapyadhikaṃ sarvaṃ bhavettarhi sukhaṃ bhavet ॥78॥
ityabhilaṣya taiḥ sarvaistūpavāsavrataṃ kṛtam ।
pūrvaṃ saṃbhoginaḥ paścād vāñchanti bhogasampadaḥ ॥79॥
svabhāvaṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahastu durādharaḥ ।
yāvadvāñcchā na vai śāntā tāvajjñātā pravartate ॥80॥
bhaktānāmapi ceṣṭeṣu bhogyeṣvasti pravartanam ।
rāgaśūnyasya nāstyeva samadraṣṭuḥ pravartanam ॥81 ॥
vicārya viṣavat tyaktaṃ yadi rāgo na līyate ।
tarhi suyoge sampanne punarādātumicchati ॥82॥
tasmādindriyanairbalyaṃ sādhayanti suyoginaḥ ।
tapasā kṣālitapāpabalā jayanti māyikam ॥83॥
anāhāreṇa vijayo bahukleśena vā jayaḥ ।
śaithilyena ca vijayo bhavatyāhāraśālinām ॥84॥
ebhistu brāhmaṇairdārāyuktairna vijayaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
iṣṭaṃ vai māyikaṃ taistu rājyaṃ vai pūrvato'dhikam ॥85॥
pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ yadvā sūryacandrādikaṃ padam ।
indrapadasamaṃ devarājavannā'nyadasti tat ॥86॥
brahmaṇaḥ sarvadā tvasti vārdhakyaṃ svaprajāḥ prati ।
sūryacandrādikā vyomni bhramanti paravaśyagāḥ ॥87॥
pravāsināṃ sukhaṃ nāsti viśrāmo nāsti vai kvacit ।
aviśrāntaḥ sadā kliṣṭastasmādaindrapadaṃ varam ॥88॥
rājyaṃ sarvasurāṇāṃ vai dārādhāmadhanādikam ।
svarge lakṣmīḥ śāśvatī ca smṛddhirindrasya vartate ॥89॥
tasmādaindrapadaṃ grāhyaṃ bhogottamapradaṃ śubham ।
paścād bhaktyā samupārjya vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyasādhanam ॥90 ॥
evaṃ niścitya taiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrataṃ śubham ।
prātaḥ snātvā mṛdo mūrtiṃ kārayitvā harestadā ॥91 ॥
pārśve sphaṭikapāṣāṇaṃ sthāpayitvā tataśca te ।
āvāhayitvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ॥92॥
saṃsnāpya paṃcadugdhādyamṛtena ca jalena ca ।
vastrābhūṣādravaddravyākṣatapuṣpādicandanaiḥ ॥93॥
dhūpadīpasunevedyaiḥ phalapatrajalādibhiḥ ।
saṃpūjyā'rghyaṃ bilvaphalairyuktaṃ datvā namaḥ stutim ॥94॥
prārthanāṃ stavanaṃ puṣpāñjalīnsamarpya viṣṇave ।
āndolayāṃcakrire ca latārajjvādidolane ॥95॥
madhyāhne ca tathā sāyaṃ rātrau pūjāṃ sajāgarām ।
cakruste nṛtyagītādi tatrā''virāsa keśavaḥ ॥96॥
varān vṛṇuta bhaktāḥ stha gataṃ duḥkhaṃ vratena me ।
yatheṣṭaṃ tvarpayituṃ cāgato'smi toṣito'smi ca ॥97॥
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ caturbhujam ।
natvā te pādayoḥ puṣpāṃjaliṃ vāri dadustadā ॥98॥
vavrire devasadanaṃ mahendrapadamṛddhimat ।
tathāstviti varaṃ datvā haristirobabhūva ha ॥99॥
adhimāse sarasvatyāstaṭe prācyāḥ supippale ।
sthale tyaktvā śarīrāṇi catvāro divamāgatāḥ ॥ 1 00॥
prāntendrasyā''yuṣo nāśe daśalokikṣayottaram ।
catvāraste yayuḥ saumye maharloke ciraṃsthitāḥ ॥ 10 1॥
punaḥ kalpāntarāraṃbhe catvāro divamāgatāḥ ।
devayavo mahendro vai babhūva vratapuṇyataḥ ॥ 1 02॥
devajuṣṭā mahendrāṇī saṃbabhūva hareḥ priyā ।
girikṣito babhūvendraputro jayantanāmakaḥ ॥ 1 03॥
adridyutirvijayantapatnī jātā tu mānasī ।
viśvakarmasutā tveṣā snuṣā tvindrasya yā matā ॥ 104॥
pulomajā'bhavadindrāṇīti sā mānasī sutā ।
indrapatnī saṃbabhūva dāsīdāsā'rbudā'nvitā ॥ 105॥
ṣaṣṭhīvratena vipraistairāptaṃ tvaindrapadaṃ śubham ।
sukhaṃ deveśvarapadaṃ prāptaṃ śrīharyanugrahāt ॥ 106॥
imāṃ kathāṃ paṭhed yastu śṛṇuyādvā samāhitaḥ ।
tasya ṣaṣṭhīphalaṃ syādvai tatheṣṭaṃ saṃlabheta ca ॥ 1 07॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye marudeśīyadevayavagirikṣitaviprayostatpatnyordevajuṣṭā''rdradyutyośca devadravyacauryeṇa sarvasva-nāśottaraṃ tvadhikamāsasya dvitīyapakṣasya ṣaṣṭhyā vratena mahendrajayantamahendrāṇījāyantīpada-prāptinirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikatriśata-tamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥1.313॥


← adhyāyaḥ 313 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 314
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 315 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! camatkāraṃ saptamyāstu vratena vai ।
brahmaputryāstu sandhyāyā jāto yastaṃ vadāmyaham ॥ 1 ॥
sṛṣṭikartā svayaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe tu mānasān ।
atriṃ mariciṃ pulahaṃ pulastyāṃgirasau kratum ॥ 2 ॥
vaśiṣṭhaṃ nāradaṃ dakṣaṃ bhṛguṃ ceti mahāprabhūn ।
prasasarja jātamātrān surūpān yauvanānvitān ॥ 3 ॥
kāryadakṣānmanaḥkṣobhakarān divyān yadā tataḥ ।
tadā'jamanaso jātā cārurūpā varāṃganā ॥ 4 ॥
nāmnā sandhyā divakṣāntā sāyaṃ sandhyā japantikā ।
atīva sundarī subhrūrmunicetovimohinī ॥ 5 ॥
mānasyabhūttadā sṛṣṭirna vai kāmādigarbhajā ।
tato dakṣādayo dhyātā vedhasā kāmasāriṇaḥ ॥ 6 ॥
kāmastatrā''virbabhūva brahmaṇo mānasaḥ sutaḥ ।
kāṃcanīkṛtajātābho lolaścandranibhānanaḥ ॥ 7 ॥
āraktapāṇinayanānanapādakarādikaḥ ।
praphullapadmapatrākṣaḥ puṣpakodaṇḍamaṇḍitaḥ ॥ 8 ॥
kāntaḥ kaṭākṣapātena bhrāmayan nayanadvayam ।
taṃ vīkṣya puruṣaṃ ramyaṃ sandhyā dakṣādikāstadā ॥ 9 ॥
autsukyaṃ paramaṃ jagmuścāṃcalyaṃ rājasaṃ tathā ।
indriyānandabhānaṃ ca prāpuste sā''pa kāmanām ॥ 10 ॥
harṣaṇaṃ rocanaṃ cāpi mohanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
drāvaṇaṃ sumano'strāṇi kāmo jagrāha vai tadā ॥ 1 1॥
brahmā prāha tadā kāmaṃ puṣpabāṇaistu pañcabhiḥ ।
mohayanpuruṣānstrīṃśca kuru sṛṣṭisahāyatām ॥ 12॥
ahaṃ vā vāsudevo vā sthāṇurvā puruṣottamaḥ ।
bhaviṣyāmastvadvaśe'tra kimanye prāṇadhārakāḥ ॥13॥
pracchannarūpo jantūnāṃ praviśan hṛdayaṃ sadā ।
sukhahetuḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā sṛṣṭiṃ kuru sanātanīm ॥ 14॥
ājñāpayitvā brahmā taṃ svāsane niṣasāda ha ।
dakṣādayo niṣeduśca sandhyā copāviveśa ha ॥ 15॥
tāvat kāmastutānsarvānparīkṣārthaṃ prayatnataḥ ।
ālīḍhasthānamāsādya dhanurākṛṣya vai balāt ॥ 16॥
kāmārthe puṣpajātairvai yojayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ ।
dakṣādyā mohitāḥ sarve vikāraṃ prāpurāditaḥ ॥ 17॥
sandhyāṃ sarve nirīkṣanto vikṛtiṃ bahudhā yayuḥ ।
tadaiva conapañcāśadbhāvā jātāḥ śarīrataḥ ॥ 18॥
sandhyāpi vīkṣyamāṇā taiścakre bhāvānkaṭākṣagān ।
atha bhāvayutāṃ sandhyāṃ dṛṣṭvā'tivikṛtiṃ gatāḥ ॥ 19॥
sandhyā yūnaśca tāndṛṣṭvā viśiṣṭāṃ vikṛtiṃ gatā ।
madanaśca nije kārye śraddadhe phalabhāvanaḥ ॥।
20॥
yadidaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kāryaṃ mamoddiṣṭaṃ mayāpi tat ।
kartuṃ śakyamiti tvaddhā niścitaṃ saphalaṃ nanu ॥21॥
tadā tu vikṛtāndṛṣṭvā dharmadevaḥ sutaḥ svayam ।
pitaraṃ ca tathā bhrātṝn sandhyāṃ prāha vivekataḥ ॥22॥
dharmārthaṃ madano jāto nā'dharmārthe kadācana ।
kuṭumbaṃ vikṛtiṃ prāptaṃ tvanyonyaṃ madanena hi ॥23॥
naitadyogyaṃ prajānāṃ hi kṣemakṛnna bhaviṣyati ।
yauvane jātamātre ced yadi kāmapraveśanam ॥24॥
tadā mātā ca bhaginī bhrātṛpatnī tathā sutā ।
pitā bhrātā patiḥ putra ityāmnāyo vinaṃkṣyati ॥25॥
jātamātrasya tu kāmo yauvanaṃ na bhavedyathā ।
tathā kuru vidhātastvaṃ yena dharmāvanaṃ bhavet ॥26॥
dharma prāhāpi kāmaṃ ca kṛtavāँstvaṃ hi vaiśasam ।
ayogye cāpyakāle ca tato bhasmī bhaviṣyasi ॥27॥
dharmaḥ prāha ca dakṣādīn yāta badarikāśramam ।
gaṃgāṃ snātvā hariṃ natvā tapastaptvā tu pāvanāḥ ॥28॥
bhavantyatha tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ kurvantu dharmataḥ sadā ।
dharmaḥ prāha ca pitaraṃ yaśaṃ kuru pitāmaha ॥29॥
brahmā sṛṣṭau prathamaṃ tu yajñaṃ cakāra vaidikam ।
tato jātāstu parjanyāstṛptidā annadāḥ sadā ॥3 0॥
dharmaḥ prāha tataḥ sandhyāṃ vikāradoṣayoginīm ।
śvapacasya bhava putrī tataḥ śuddhā bhaviṣyasi ॥ 3 1॥
sandhyā prāha tadā dharmaṃ yatiṣye tapasā yathā ।
jātamātrasya kāmo'yaṃ na bādheta tathā ciram ॥32॥
itivṛttottaraṃ sarve yathoddiṣṭaṃ yayustataḥ ।
sandhyā'pyamarṣamāpannā tadā dhyānaparābhavat ॥33॥
idaṃ vimamṛśe yogyaṃ bhaviṣyatsukhadaṃ bhavet ।
utpannamātrā cāhaṃ suyuvatī kāmamohitā ॥34॥
dakṣādyāśca tathā jātā mayi kāmena mohitāḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ mathitaṃ cittaṃ madanena kuṭumbinā ॥35॥
prāpnuyāṃ phalametasya pāpasya tvagharūpiṇaḥ ।
kariṣyāmyasya pāpasya prāyaścittamahaṃ svayam ॥36॥
tacchodhanaphalaṃ śīghramahamicchāmi sādhanam ।
nijāṃ tapasi hoṣyāmi dharmamārgānusārataḥ ॥37॥
kiṃ tvekāṃ sthāpayiṣyāmi maryādāmiha sarvathā ।
yathā notpannamātrā vai sakāmāḥ syuḥ śarīriṇaḥ ॥38॥
etadarthamahaṃ kṛtvā tapaḥ paramadāruṇam ।
maryādāṃ sthāpayiṣyāmi tyakṣyāmi duṣṭajīvitam ॥39॥
mayā'nena śarīreṇa kuṭumbisvajaneṣu vai ।
udbhāvitaḥ kāmabhāvo na tatsukṛtasādhanam ॥40 ॥
evaṃ vicārya manasā sandhyā yogasamādhinā ।
tenaiva tu śarīreṇa chāyātmakena mānasī ॥41 ॥
sūkṣmībhūya duritasya nāśāya śvapacagṛhe ।
jātismarā sutā jātā jātamātrā sayauvanā ॥42॥
rākhālo janakastasyā mātā mātaṅginī tadā ।
karmacāṇḍālatāṃ prāptau vasataḥ sma himācale ॥43॥
yatra nā'vagrahaḥ kaścinnāsti niṣphalavṛkṣatā ।
nāsti yatra marudeśastādṛśyāṃ vasato bhuvi ॥44॥
dharmaśāpaṃ pūrvajanma smṛtavatyeva nityadā ।
samayaṃ kṣapayāmāsa śuddhikṛttapāadinā ॥45॥
pitarau sevayāmāsa pāpakṣālanaśaktikau ।
pratīkṣamāṇā taṃ kālaṃ yena śuddhirbhaved yathā ॥46॥
tāvadbhūmau vicarantaḥ patitoddhārakārakāḥ ।
saptarṣayastato vyomnā nirjagmurbadarīṃ prati ॥47॥
vane tatra sthale tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā te yogacakṣuṣā ।
avateruśca te bhikṣāmiṣeṇa śvapacagṛham ॥48॥
yadyapi karmacāṇḍālo brahmaputro hyayaṃ khalu ।
phalādyarthe bhikṣaṇīyo yatra bādho na vidyate ॥49॥
apakvānne'pi na doṣaḥ kaṇeṣu nāsti sūtakam ।
yayācire vicāryetthaṃ bhikṣāṃ śvapacavṛkṣataḥ ॥50॥
śvapacastān dvijān jñātvā kanyā'bhijñāya sarvathā ।
saharṣaṃ pradadau bhikṣāṃ vāṇībandhanapūrvikām ॥51 ॥
śvapacaḥ pādayornatvā pītvā pādāmṛtaṃ jalam ।
prārthayāmāsa saptarṣīn jagaduddhārakārakān ॥52॥
bhikṣāṃ phalānnakanyāḍhyāṃ gṛhṇantu munayo'malāḥ ।
kanyāṃ cāsmānuddharantu kanyāṃ bhikṣāṃ dadāmi vaḥ ॥53॥
ṛṣīṇāmānumatyena vaśiṣṭho vedhasoṃ'śakaḥ ।
jagrāha bhikṣāṃ kanyāṃ ca nītvā yayuśca badrikām ॥54॥
tāṃ kanyāṃ te tu saṃsnāpya gaṃgāyāṃ badarīvane ।
kāmadhenuśarīrāntarmukhātpraveśanaṃ tu te ॥55॥
kārayitvā prabhāveṇa mūtradvāreṇa tāṃ tadā ।
bahirniṣkāsayāmāsurjanmāntaragatā'bhavat ॥56॥
babhūva pāvanī sā tu hyupavītenasaṃskṛtā ।
dvijatvaṃ ca tapoyogyaṃ labdhavatī tu kanyakā ॥57॥
athāpi sā tapasā'rthe maryādāṃ kāmayauvanām ।
sthāpayituṃ vācchati sma provāca ṛṣaye smitā ॥58॥
maharṣe lokamaryādā jātamātre tu yauvane ।
rakṣyate naiva bhūtānāṃ tasyāḥ sthāpanahetave ॥59॥
tapaḥ kartuṃ samicchāmi candrabhāgānadītaṭe ।
yadyājñā brahmadevasya vācchāmi carituṃ tapaḥ ॥60॥
jñātvā hārdaṃ tu gambhīraṃ bahviṣṭaṃ tu nijasya vai ।
omityuvāca tāṃ tatra vasiṣṭhastapasāṃ nidhiḥ ॥61॥
vīkṣāṃcakre sarastatra bṛhallohitasaṃjñakam ।
candrabhāgānadīṃ tasmātprākārād dakṣiṇāmbudhim ॥62॥
yāntīṃ dadarśa sā caiva tathā sānugirermahat ।
nirbhidya paścimaṃ sā tu candrabhāgagirernadī ॥6 3॥
pāvayantī janāndeśān śanairgacchati sāgaram ।
tasmin girau candrabhāge bṛhallohitasattaṭe ॥64॥
avatīrya vyomamārgād vaśiṣṭhastāmuvāca ha ।
kurvatraiva tapo devi! rakṣāsūtraṃ gṛhāṇa ca ॥65॥
prakoṣṭhe dhāryamevaitad rakṣaṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā te yayustasmād ṛṣayaḥ satyalokakam ॥66 ॥
tatrā'tapattapo ghoraṃ svayaṃ devī tvarundhatī ।
saubhāgyakāṃkṣamāṇā sā gaurīpūjāparāyaṇā ॥67॥
pāpanāśanayatnā ca kāmaniyamatatparā ।
tapasā svalpakālena gaurī prāvirbabhūva ca ॥68॥
uvāca paramā''rādhyorundhati! puruṣottamaḥ ।
tamekaṃ jagatāmādyaṃ bhajasva puruṣottamam ॥6 9 ॥
oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya onamo'stu te ।
mantreṇānena sarveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja śubhānane ॥70 ॥
tena te sakalā'vāptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
snānaṃ maunena kartavyaṃ maunena haripūjanam ॥71 ॥
jalāhāraṃ phalāhāraṃ kandāhāramupoṣaṇam ।
vāyvāhāraṃ bhojanaṃ vā ṣaṣṭhe kāle samācaret ॥72॥
kuru tvevaṃ tapasyāṃ tvaṃ sarvābhīṣṭamavāpsyasi ।
mālānāṃ tu sahasre dve sahasraṃ vā japo'nvaham ॥73॥
uktamantreṇa kartavyo mūrtiṃ kṛṣṇasya cintayeḥ ।
tāmābhāṣya mahāgaurī tatraivā'ntardadhe tataḥ ॥74॥
sandhyā'pi ca taporītiṃ jñātvā modamavāpa ha ।
tapaścartuṃ samārebhe bṛhallohitatīragā ॥75 ॥
divyajñānaṃ divyacakṣurdivyāṃ vācamavāpa sā ।
divyakarṇau prāptavatī tapaścacāra dāruṇam ॥76 ॥
puruṣottamamāsasya saptamyāṃ parapakṣake ।
śuśrāva dundubhiṃ divyaṃ prātareva tvarundhatī ॥77॥
śṛṇvantu tāpasāḥ sarve tāpasyaśca kṛpāmayam ।
puruṣottamavādyo'haṃ pravadāmyatyabhīṣṭadam ॥78॥
adhikamāsasaptamyāṃ nirāhāraṃ vrataṃ caret ।
pūjayitvā yathālabdhopacārairbhojayeddharim ॥79॥
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryātprātarvai pāraṇāṃ caret।
dānaṃ dadyātphalādīnāṃ jalenārghyaṃ dadettataḥ ॥80॥
visarjayet kṣamāṃ prārthya sa yāyātsukhamuttamam ।
śrutvā tayā dundubheścārcanaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ vratam ॥8 1 ॥
patrapuṣpaphalairvārbhiḥ pūjitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
bhojitaśca phalaiḥ pakvairarthito hṛdayena ca ॥82॥
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prātarbrāhme muhūrtake ।
dhyāne sthitā kṣaṇaṃ yāvattāvaddadarśa taṃ harim ॥83॥
pratyakṣaṃ vīkṣya sā kṛṣṇaṃ tuṣṭāva jagatāṃ patim ।
sthūla sūkṣmaṃ yasya vaśyaṃ naumi tvāṃ puruṣottamam ॥84॥
nityānandaṃ pāvanānāṃ pāvanaṃ tvāṃ namāmyaham ।
śrīdaṃ sveṣṭapradaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ namāmyaham ॥85॥
pradhānapuruṣau yasya kāyatvena vyavasthitau ।
tasmai kṛṣṇāya hṛdyāya vāraṃ vāraṃ namonamaḥ ॥86 ॥
tvaṃ paraḥ paramātmā ca paraṃbrahma pumuttamaḥ ।
striyā mayā kathaṃ varṇyo bhūyo bhūyo namo'stu te ॥87॥
ityāśrutya vacastasyāḥ prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
arundhatyāḥ śarīraṃ tu valkalājinaśobhitam ॥88॥
sajaṭaṃ śāntavadanaṃ nirīkṣyā''ha hariḥ svayam ।
prīto'smi tapasā caiva vratena ca stavena te ॥89 ॥
yena te vidyate kāryaṃ varaṃ varaya sāmpratam ।
tat kariṣye tu bhadraṃ te prasanno'haṃ tava vrataiḥ ॥90॥
iti śrutvā suprasannā sandhyovāca praṇamya tam ।
yadi deyo varaḥ prītyā varayogyā'smyahaṃ yadi ॥9 1 ॥
yadi. śuddhā'smyahaṃ jātā kāmavikṛtipātakāt ।
yadi kṛṣṇa prasanno'si vratena mama sāmpratam ॥92॥
vṛttastadā'yaṃ prathamo varo mama vidhīyatām ।
utpannamātrāste sṛṣṭau sakāmā mā bhavantviti ॥9 3 ॥
dvitīyaśca varo me'stu prathitā sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ।
bhaviṣyāmi yathā'haṃ vai tathā mā'nyā bhavediti ॥94॥
tṛtīyaśca varo me'stu sandhyāyāṃ kāmanāvataḥ ।
pauruṣaṃ nāśamāyātu prajā piśācatāṃ vrajet ॥95॥
caturthastu varo me'stu mama rūpacatuṣṭayam ।
bhavatu prathamaṃ tatra prātaḥ sandhyāmayaṃ śubham ॥96 ॥
dvitīyaṃ tu bhavet sāyaṃ sandhyārūpaṃ supuṇyadam ।
tṛtīyaṃ tu vaśiṣṭhasya patnī svarge bhavāmi vai ॥97॥
caturthe tu tava dāsīrūpaṃ bhavatu dhāmani ।
iti varān samabhyarthya maunāṃ tāmāha mādhavaḥ ॥98॥
yadyad vṛttaṃ tvayā sandhye dattaṃ tadakhilaṃ mayā ।
vratena tapasā sandhye tvatpāpaṃ bhasmatāṃ gatam ॥99॥
prathamaṃ tu varaṃ tatra śṛṇu kāmasya rodhatām ।
prathamaṃ śaiśavo bhāvaḥ kaumārākhyo dvitīyakaḥ ॥ 100 ॥
tṛtīyo yauvano bhāvaścaturtho vārdhakastathā ।
tṛtīye tvatha saṃprāpte yauvane kāmanā bhavet ॥ 10 1॥
iti maryādayā sṛṣṭau ita ārabhya kāmanā ।
sampatsyate jātamātrāḥ sakāmā syurna dehinaḥ ॥ 1 02॥
dvitīyaṃ tu varaṃ khyātiṃ satībhāvena yāsyasi ।
triṣu lokeṣu nānyasyāstathā kīrtirbhaviṣyati ॥ 1 03॥
tṛtīyaṃ tu varaṃ sandhyākāle tvanaṃgasevinaḥ ।
piśācāḥ saṃbhaviṣyanti balapauruṣavarjitāḥ ॥ 1 04॥
caturthaṃ tu varaṃ prātaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyādvayaṃ bhava ।
patiryaste vaśiṣṭho'sti bhavatācchāśvataḥ patiḥ ॥ 105॥
saptakalpāntajīvī ca tapodravyastvayā saha ।
svarge tena saha vāso yatheṣṭaṃ te bhavediti ॥ 1 06॥
atha divyasvarūpeṇa brahmatanvā mayā saha ।
kuru vaikuṇṭhavāsaṃ me bhava dāsyaruṇā'bhidhā ॥ 1 07॥
iti te ye varā mattaḥ prārthitāste'rpitā mayā ।
anyacca śṛṇu kārye'smin kāyākalpaṃ samācara ॥ 1 08॥
etacchailopatyakāyāṃ candrabhāgānadītaṭe ।
medhātithiḥ ṛṣiyajñaṃ karoti tāpasāśrame ॥ 109॥
tapasā tatsamo nāsti na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।
tasya jyotiṣṭomayajñe vahnau janairalakṣitā ॥ 11 0॥
sūkṣmarūpaṃ samāpannā kāyāpariṇatiṃ kuru ।
tadagnau śodhitāṃ varṣmacatuṣṭayaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ॥ 11 1॥
prātaḥsandhyā tathā sāyaṃsandhyā bhūtvā sthirā bhava ।
patiṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ māṃ dhyātvā śreṣṭhaṃ kanyādvayaṃ bhava ॥1 1 2॥
ekā medhātitheḥ putrī vaśiṣṭhasya priyā bhava ।
dvitīyā mama dāsī ca aruṇākhyā priyā bhava ॥ 11 3॥
ayaṃ tu parvataste vai nāmnā syādaruṇācalaḥ ।
mahattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ vai lokamānya bhaviṣyati ॥ 1 14॥
ityabhidhāya bhagavān karau datvā tu mastake ।
premṇā nibhālya tāṃ tatrā'ntarhitaḥ saṃbabhūva ha ॥ 1 15॥
sandhyā'pyagacchattatraiva medhātithimakhasthale ।
smṛtvā kāntaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ ca tathā śrīpuruṣottamam ॥ 1 16॥
sā viveśa samiddhe'gnau na kenā'pyupalakṣitā ।
śarīraṃ malinaṃ tasyā vahninā saṃskṛtaṃ tadā ॥ 1 17॥
śodhitaṃ divyatāṃ prāptaṃ devārhaṃ hrāsavarjitam ।
śuddhaṃ praveśayāmāsa vahnistatsūryamaṇḍalam ॥ 1 18॥
sūryastvardhaṃ vibhajyaitaccharīraṃ tu tadā rathe ।
svake saṃsthāpayāmāsa prītaye pitṛdevayoḥ ॥ 1 19॥
tadūrdhvabhāgo'tyaruṇaḥ prātaḥsandhyā'bhavacchubhā ।
aruṇodayavelā sā devānāṃ prītikāriṇī ॥ 120॥
taccheṣabhāgastasyāstu sāyaṃsandhyā'stame ravau ।
sūryāstamanavelā sā pitṝṇāṃ modakāriṇī ॥ 121 ॥
tasyāḥ prāṇāstadā dhyātā hariṇā tattu śāśvatam ।
brāhmaṃ varṣma babhūvāsyāḥ sā divyā kanyakā'bhavat ॥ 122॥
aruṇā sā brahmadhāmagatā garuḍagāminī ।
atha yajñāvasāne tu muninā vahnikuṇḍataḥ ॥ 123 ॥
prāptā putrī vahnijanyā taptakāṃcanasannibhā ।
arundhatīti tasyāstu nāma cakre sa vai muniḥ ॥ 124॥
na ruddhaṇi yato dharmaṃ sā kasmādapi kāraṇāt ।
asya viṣṇoḥ sadā dharmaṃ ruṇaddhīti hyarudhantī ॥ 125 ॥
atha sā vavṛdhe kanyā guṇairvarṣairmunergṛhe ।
vaśiṣṭhena vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa pitā tataḥ ॥ 126॥
asyā vivāhasatkārye surāśca munayo yayuḥ ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāścā'bhavannāśīrvacaḥparāḥ ॥ 1 27॥
arundhatī mahāsādhvī reje vaśiṣṭhasaṃgatā ।
iti sandhyācaritraṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pāvanam ॥ 128॥
dharmadārḍhyakaraṃ divyaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam ।
adhimāsasya cāntasya saptamyāstu vratena vai ॥ 129 ॥
tapasā ca prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
dadau yayeṣṭaṃ rūpāṇi tvaruṇāyai pumuttamaḥ ॥ 13 0॥
yedaṃ saṃśṛṇuyānnārī naro vā dṛḍhamānasaḥ ।
sarvān kāmānavāpnoti puruṣottamatoṣaṇāt ॥ 13 1॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe dakṣādīnāṃ sandhyāyā brahmaṇaśca kāmena parābhave vikṛtibhāvottaraṃ dharmadevavacanaiḥ sandhyāyāḥ śvapacaputrītvaṃ, bhikṣāmiṣeṇa vaśiṣṭhādisaptarṣibhiḥ sandhyāyā grahaṇaṃ, kāmadhenumukhe nikṣipya mūtradvāreṇa niṣkāsanaṃ, tapo'rthe candrabhāgātīre'vasthānaṃ, gaurīprāvirbhāvaḥ, saptamī- vratena puruṣottamaprāvirbhāvaḥ, kāmadevasya yauvane utpattiriti niyamanaṃ, prātaḥsāyaṃsandhyādvayabhavanaṃ, medhātithiṛṣikṛtayajña- kuṇḍe'dṛśyatayā praveśanaṃ, kāyāśodhanaṃ, divyā'ruṇāyāḥ svarūpeṇa brahmadhāmagamanaṃ, arundhatyākhyāyā vahnikuṇḍotpannasutā- tmikāyā vaśiṣṭhena vivāhottaraṃ svargagamanaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇa-nāmā caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥1.314॥


← adhyāyaḥ 314 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 315
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 316 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ te'pi me'pi jātāṃ purātanīm । puruṣottamamāsasya miṣeṇa janmabodhinīm ।। 1 ।।
yadā nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaścobhau yātau parā'kṣare । malamāsasya sāhāyyaṃ kartuṃ śrīharisannidhau ।। 2 ।।
dhāmnyakṣare tadā rājatpuruṣottamamādhavaḥ । śrutvā'rthyaṃ malamāsāya dattavāँścottamāṃ sthitim ।। 3 ।।
kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ nārāyaṇasya vacanaṃ tathā । malamāsonnatidaṃ tad rakṣitaṃ paramātmanā ।। 4 ।।
svayaṃ jāto'dhidevaśca māso'pi puruṣottamaḥ । tena tuṣṭaḥ paraṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇastutoṣa ca ।। 5 ।।
malamāsasya vai dvābhyāṃ kṛtamuddharaṇaṃ mahat । tannimittaṃ tu goloke gatvā kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā yutaḥ ।। 6 ।।
mahotsavaṃ cakārottamottamaṃ dhāmavāsiṣu । gopagopīgaṇāstasya pārṣadāḥ śaktayaḥ striyaḥ ।। 7 ।।
koṭyarbudaparārdhāni cakrustasya mahotsavam । maṇḍapāḥ koṭiśastatra nihitāḥ svarṇasad drumāḥ ।। 8 ।।
kadalī staṃbhaśobhāḍhyāstoraṇādivilāsitāḥ । kalaśairaṃgacitraiśca paṭaiśca vallikādibhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
pradarśanairbahuvidhairmallakrīḍādibhistathā । anyatra bahuyantraiścānyatra vṛṣabhayodhanaiḥ ।।1 0।।
nāṭakaiḥ pūrvavṛttaiśca kalābhirbhūtanādibhiḥ । saṃgītairnartanaiścāpi kathānakamakhādibhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
evaṃvidhe tatra jāte mahotsave tadā śriyā । rukmiṇyākhyamahālakṣmyā'bhihitaṃ svāmine mudā ।। 12।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parātman puruṣottama । kurūtsava tu me saudhe nṛtyagāyanavādanaiḥ ।। 13।।
omityuktvā śriyāḥ saudhe yojayāmāsa sūtsavam । yathā dhāmnāṃ mahāsamrāṭ samāyātpuruṣottamaḥ ।। 14।।
tatsammāne prakuryādutsavaṃ tadvad yuyoja saḥ । sarvadhāmnāṃ tu yā śobhā viśiṣṭā sā'tra kāritā ।। 15।।
sarvadhāmapatīnāṃ tvāsanasiṃhāsanānyapi । tatra vai maṇḍape cābhisthāpitāni yathārhaṇam ।। 16।।
sarveṣāṃ divyavastūnāmupāyanāni tatra ca । saṃgṛhītāni sarvebhyo dhāmabhyaḥ kṛṣṇaśārṅgiṇā ।। 17।।
citrāṇāṃ śubhadṛśyānāṃ manaḥsnigdhāḥ śubhālayāḥ । saṃklṛptāstatra tatraiva nyastapānasubhojanāḥ ।। 18।।
vidyutāṃ tu pradīpānāṃ prakāśāḥ sarvato'bhavan । krīḍāvidyutsphaṭākāṇāṃ krīḍā'pi sarvato'bhavat ।। 19।।
anantā'tarkyarūpāṇāṃ yāni pradarśanāni vai । nepathyakāravidyābhirvartante sma ca tāni hi ।।20 ।।
gandharvo devagandharvā gāndharvā dhāmavāsinaḥ । gāndharvyo devagāndharvyo gāndharvyo dhāmasaṃsthitāḥ ।।21।।
cakruste gāyanaṃ miṣṭamadhurālāpasusvaraiḥ । gāyakāḥ svarapūrāśca pūrayanti sma nādakaiḥ ।।22।।
nartakāścāpi nartakyo dāsyo dāsāśca sevikāḥ । sevakāśca mahārājñyo rājñyaśca nartanaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।23।।
vādakā naikavādyajñā dhāmānudhāmavāsinaḥ । vādyanti sma vādyāni yatra kiṃcinna gauṇabhāk ।।24।।
rāse pravartamāne ca gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām । tadaiśvaryāṇi bhūṣāśca hetayaḥ pārṣadādayaḥ ।।25।।
mūrtimantastatra rāse yuyujuḥ kṛtanartanāḥ । kṛṣṇā''nandā''plutaṃ sarvaṃ brahmānandaparaṃ hyabhūt। ।।26।।
dṛśyaṃ spṛśyaṃ tathā śrāvyaṃ rasyaṃ cā'dvaitatāṃ gatam । sukhaṃ sukhaṃ parānandaṃ ānandaṃ nandanaṃ hyabhūt ।।27।।
snigdhaṃ premātimodāḍhyaṃ jātamānandameva tat । nānyaḥ paraṃ vijānāti vinā''nandaṃ hi tattvakam ।।28।।
evaṃ samutsave rādhā lakṣmīḥ śrīśca ramādayaḥ । kṛṣṇaṃ vikṛṣya rāse taṃ ramayāmāsa nartanam ।।29।।
sarvasmin tanmaye jāte sarvaṃ rasamayaṃ tvabhūt । kṛṣṇo rasapravegeṇa kūrdan tadramaṇo'bhavat ।।30।।
patnyāḥ patnyantaraṃ yāte kūrdanena satālavat । cacāla mukuṭo'jasraṃ cakampe'timuhurmuhuḥ ।।3 1 ।।
tamadhyātvā mahānandasukhavyāpto mahāprabhuḥ । padātpadāntaraṃ nyasya reme cottolya karṣayan ।।32।।
tāvacchaithilyamāpannaḥ papāta mukuṭānmaṇiḥ । koṭiratreṣu yo naddha ūrdhvasthakalgimūlakṛt ।।।33।।
maṇeḥ pāte saha tena papāta kalgicandrikā । tathāpi naiva kṛṣṇaḥ sa rāsādviramate khalu ।।34।।
pādamardanabhītyā tāvubhau divyasuvigrahau । babhūvaturmaṇiḥ kalgicandrikā rematuśca vai ।।35।।
rāse mūrtidharau jātau remāte smāti maṇḍale । na tau svaṃsvaṃ sthalaṃ prāptau yāvadrāsāntameva ha ।।36।।।
mukuṭe na svayaṃ yātau tāvattatra tu rādhayā । jñāpito nirgatau kṛṣṇamukuṭāditi śārṅgiṇe ।।37।।
kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭvā tu tau prāha kimevaṃ nirgatāvubhau । svasvasthānaṃ na vai yātau mukuṭaḥ śobhate na me ।।38।।
nainaṃ vai dhāraye kalgimaṇiśūnyaṃ kabhūṣaṇam । dhārayiṣye'nyamukuṭaṃ māyūrapicchaśobhitam ।।39।।
ityucyamāne śrīkṛṣṇe'dhimāsasya mahotsave । ānarttākhyo mahān bhakto rājā golokamāyayau ।।40।।
kṛṣṇaprītyarthamevā'yaṃ tapobhaktiṃ cakāra vai । tasmai prasannaḥ sa kṛṣṇo nava rājyaṃ tu ditsati ।।41।।
golokasya divyabhūmeḥ kaṇaṃ tvarpitavān prabhuḥ । kaṇaḥ sa tatra saurāṣṭro deśastvānarttasaṃjñakaḥ ।।42।।
trijalāvṛttasudvīpo rājyamānartabhūbhṛtaḥ । samabhūtpaścimavārdhisaṃlagno bhūmisandhitaḥ ।।43।।
prārthayāmāsa cānarto mama rājyasya me tathā । guptaye rakṣakaṃ dehi tava dūtaṃ pratāpinam ।।44।।
omityuktvā dadau kṛṣṇa ānartāya tu bhūbhṛte । mukuṭasya maṇiryaśca viyukto mukuṭāttu tam ।।45।।
divyaḥ sa pārṣado bhūtvā sa yayau bhūbhṛtā saha । maṇimūlakhacitā yā viyuktā kalgicandrikā ।।46।।
mūlaṃ vinā na vai sthātuṃ śaktā prārthayadīśvaram । vāsaṃ me dehi bhagavanna mūlā na sthitirmama ।।47।।
hariḥ prāha tadā tāṃ tu viyuktā mukuṭād yataḥ । yāhi tvaṃ maṇinā sākaṃ bhūtvā divyasvarūpiṇī ।।48।।
ānartaviṣaye stheyaṃ dvijena maṇirūpiṇā । dvijapatnyā tvayā bhāvyaṃ gururūpau bhaviṣyathaḥ ।।49।।
ānarto'pi hariṃ natvā nītvā kalgiṃ maṇiṃ kaṇam । kṛṣṇā'rpitānmukuṭāccāparān muktān maṇīṃstathā ।।50।।
āyayau paścime vārdhau karmamvāṃ muktavān kaṇam । sa tu drāg vistṛto bhūtvā jātaḥ saurāṣṭrasaṃjñakaḥ ।।51।।
tatra maṇirmukuṭasya tvavātatāra cāmbarāt । anye'pi maṇayastatrā'vaterurvyomamārgataḥ ।।5 2 ।।
mukhyo maṇirdivyadeho nimbadevo'bhavad dvijaḥ । vyāghrāraṇye ramyadeśe'śvapaṭṭasarasastaṭe ।।5 3 ।।
nivāsamakarot tatra parṇakuṭyāṃ sa tāpasaḥ । yā kalgicandrikā sā tu tatraiva sarasastaṭe ।।54।।
divyadehā nivāsaṃ cā'karod dvijaprasevanam । ānartena tadā tābhyāṃ prārthitaṃ bhāvagarbhitam ।।55 ।।
vinā laukikadehaṃ vai janānāṃ śreya icchato । darśasparśādilābhaśca nā'taḥ svīkurutaṃ vapuḥ ।।5 6 ।।
bhaktaprārthanayā tau ca nṝṇāṃ śreyo vicintya ca । dehaṃ grahītumicchantau hariṃ sasmaraturhṛdā ।।57।।
śrīkṛṣṇa āvirāsā'tra saṃkalpya mānasau ca tau । dehau samarpya tatraivā'ntaradhīyata pūjitaḥ ।।।58।।
athaivaṃ tau kaṇalabdhasthaulyaṃ prāptau tataḥ param । sarvagocaratāṃ yātāvaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।।59।।
tapasyantau ca tatraiva lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmikām । saṃhitāṃ vācayāmāsatuśca kālaṃ suninyatuḥ ।।60।।
maṇiḥ sa nimbadevākhyo babhūva khyāta eva ha । kalgiḥ sā khyātimāpannā miṣṭādevīti sarvathā ।।61।।
atha raivatapautro vai khaṭvāṃgadajanādhipaḥ । tapastaptuṃ samāyāto nimbadevāśramāntike ।।62।।
badrītale sūpaviśya jajāpa japamuttamam । oṃśrīlakṣmīpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo'stu te ।।63।।
tasya vai tapasā tatrā''yātau lakṣmīnarāyaṇau । varadānāya taṃ bhūpaṃ rodhayāmāsatustadā ।।64।।
rājñā darśanalābhārthaṃ tayorvāso'bhikāṃkṣitaḥ । tathāstviti prati śrutyā'dṛśyatāṃ tau gatāvubhau ।।65।।
yā lakṣmīḥ sā rukmiṇī śrīrūpā''sīd divyarūpiṇī । nārāyaṇaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇa āsa śrīpatireva saḥ ।।66।।
śriyā juṣṭaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇo dadhyau tu pitarau tadā । kalgimaṇisvarūpau tau dhyātau svenaiva rakṣitau ।।67।।
sthāpitau divyadehena cintayāmāsa tatra ha । miṣṭādevīnimbadevagṛhe kṛṣṇo babhūva vai ।।68।।
yatra jajñe tu gopālastatrā'śvapaṭṭasannidhau । parṇakuṭyāṃ mānasaḥ sa jātamātraḥ sayauvanaḥ ।।69।।
divyo babhūva golokadivyavigraha eva saḥ । gāṃ tu vāṇīṃ pālayati gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva saḥ ।।70 ।।
goḥ pṛthivyāḥ pālakaṃ rājānaṃ lāti ca rakṣati । gopālaḥ sa prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃsthito nṛpasannidhau ।।7 1।।
āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha । kukumavāpyāṃ saṃjajñe nimbadevagṛhe prage ।।72।।
anye ye maṇayastvānartena tyaktāḥ surāṣṭrake । sarve'tra kṛṣṇabhaktāste jātāḥ surāṣṭrake sthale ।।73।।
tatra omālaye śatrūṃjitākṣetre babhūva ha । premamaṇirmahādivyavigrahaḥ sūryasannibhaḥ ।।74।।
premākhyatadvijakṣetre divyā saṃkalpamātrajā । phālgunakṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ jajñe lakṣmīstu kaṃbharā ।।75।।
kaṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ kārṣṇaṃ bibhartīti hi kaṃbharā । jātamātrā yuvatī sā divyā''sa śrīsvarūpiṇī ।।76 ।।
pitā vijñāya tāṃ śrīṃ vai kṛṣṇārhā divyacakṣuṣā । vivāhavidhinā''hūya gopālaṃ kṛṣṇameva ha ।।77 ।।
kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ dadau tasmai koṭidevādisannidhau । ityevaṃ kaṃbharāgopālau śrīkṛṣṇau tu dampatī ।।78 ।।
tāpasau bhagavantau tau divyamūrtī babhūvatuḥ । sāptabhaumakaśobhāḍhye mandire sthāpitau sadā ।।79।।
ekadā dundubhistābhyāṃ tithyaṣṭamyāṃ prage'dhike । māse śrutastvaśvapaṭṭasarovarāntike śubhaḥ ।।8 0 ।।
śṛṇvantu maṇikalgyādyāstathā śrīpatisevakāḥ । puruṣottamasaṃjño'haṃ toṣayituṃ pareśvaraḥ ।।8 1 ।।
akṣarabrahmadhāmastho golokādhipatiṃ prabhum । vaikuṇṭhādhipatiṃ cānyadhāmādhipāँśca keśavān ।।82।।
kṛtavān malamāsaṃ tu nirmalaṃ matsvarūpiṇam । tadasminnadhike māse puruṣottamasaṃjñake ।।83 ।।
ekasyāpi dinasyātra vrataṃ kṛtvā vratī janaḥ । prāpnuyāt kṛpayā me'tra sarvaṃ māṃ dhāma cāpi me ।।84।।
vrataṃ tvadyā'parapakṣā'ṣṭamyāstvanantapuṇyadam । yatheṣṭaṃ tatra dāsye'haṃ vratārthine svayaṃ hariḥ ।।85।।
dundubhiścetyabhidhāya snātvā'śvapaṭṭavāriṣu । natvā kālyāṇikaṃ nimbadevaṃ miṣṭāṃ mahāsatīm ।।86।।
prapūjya kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ gopālamityapi । tābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ susatkāraṃ prāpya vai raivataṃ yayau ।।87।।
kṛtaṃ tvadhikamāsasya parapakṣā'ṣṭamīvratam । kaṃbharayā sopavāsaṃ gopālenāpi nirjalam ।।88।।
prātaḥ saṃpūjitaḥ samyaṅ madhyāhne'pi niśi prabhuḥ । aṣṭottaraśatasāmagrībhiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।8 9।।
ṣaṭpaṃcāśadbhojyāni cārpitāni tathā kṛtam । āṣṭottaraśatavartibhirārārtrikamujjvalam ।।9 0 ।।
lakṣaśo dakṣiṇā dattā rātrau nīrājane hariḥ । āvirbabhūva bhagavān dhāmasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 91 ।।
vihasan hārdikaṃ snehaṃ varṣayan rañjayannabhau । uvācā'smi prasanno'haṃ golokeśa kimiṣyate ।। 92 ।।
śrīriva kaṃbharā lakṣmīḥ kimicchati vratārthinī । yuvayorvasatistvatra madicchayaiva sarvathā ।। 93 ।।
vartate miṣamātraṃ tu khaṭvāṃgatapa eva ha । mukuṭānmaṇikalgyośca viyogo'pi madicchayā ।। 94।।
rāsādikaṃ nimittaṃ ca sarvathā vai madicchayā । tasmād vāṃ varadaścāsmi vṛṇutaṃ tu yathepsitam ।।95।।
tadarthaṃ tvāgato'smyatra sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ । śrutvaivaṃ bhāvagarbhaṃ tu hārdaṃ sarvaparātmanaḥ ।।96।।
ūcatustau praṇamyainaṃ mūlarūpe'bhicintya tau । bhagavaṃste'bhilāṣā cet kāraṇaṃ cātra saṃsthitau ।।97।।
āvābhyāṃ prārthyase tvaṃ vai sarvadā'tra sthiro bhava । puruṣottamasevāyāḥ sarvadā lābha eva nau ।।98।।
anādikṛṣṇayogastu bhāgyahīnasya durlabhaḥ । asmanmūlasvarūpastvaṃ rakṣā'tra sthita eva nau ।।99।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'nādirlakṣmyā śriyā prasevitaḥ । muktaiśvaryaiḥ sevitastvaṃ vasā'tra puruṣottama ।। 1 00।।
lālanaṃ pālanaṃ cāpi krīḍanaṃ poṣaṇādikam । divyasyāpi yathādeśakālānuguṇameva te ।। 101 ।।
kṛtvā sukhaṃ parānandaṃ prāpsyāmo'tra tava sthiram । ityabhyarthya kaṃbharāgopālau śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 1 02।।
nematustaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam । bhagavānapi sarvātmā tathāstvityabhidhāya ca ।। 1 03।।
svapriyāṃ dhāmalakṣmīṃ cā''vedayannetrasaṃjñayā । yā'bhigamya harerhārdaṃ tiro'bhūt puruṣottame ।। 1 04।।
so'yaṃ parātparo brahmaparaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ । bālarūpo'bhavattatra jātamātro yuvā prabhuḥ ।। 1 05।।
babhūvatuḥ prasannau kaṃbharāgopālakṛṣṇakau । putro divyo vratalabhyaḥ svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।106।।
vrataṃ nimittamātraṃ vai kāraṇaṃ tasya mānasam । līlaiva kāraṇaṃ tasya puṃsastu paramasya vai ।। 1 07।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'nādipuruṣottama eva saḥ । śrīramādipārṣadādisamaiśvaryaguṇānvitaḥ ।। 1 08।।
svecchayā dharmarakṣārthaṃ bhaktipravartanāya ca । prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ patnīvratasvarūpa eva saḥ ।। 109।।
goloke yaḥ kṛṣṇamukhātpatnīvratābhidho guṇaḥ । pātivratyābhidhalakṣmyā sahito'bhūt prakāśitaḥ ।। 11 0।।
so'yaṃ dharmasthāpanāya svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ । putro'bhavacchrīkṛṣṇasyā'dhimāse puruṣottamaḥ ।। 111 ।।
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt । nṛtyaṃ tatrā'psarasāṃ ca gāyanaṃ gāyakaiḥ kṛtam ।। 11 2।।
pratidhāmani vāsāśceśvarā devā maharṣayaḥ । avatārāśca taddevyaḥ śaktayo'bjā'rbudāntyakāḥ ।। 113 ।।
jayakāreṇa sahitāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram । brahmāṇḍeṣvapi sarvatra jīveśā'vatarādiṣu ।। 1 14।।
samutsavo mahānāsīdanantabrahmabhojanam । prīṇanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sṛṣṭiprāṇināṃ saṃbabhūva ha ।। 1 15।।
kārtikā'dhavalā'ṣṭamyāṃ punarvasau ghaṭīsthite । sūryā'stottaraghaṭikāpañcake samaye gate ।। 1 16।।
niśāpūrvapade'nādiśrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ । kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jajñe gopālakaṃbharā''laye ।। 1 17।।
prakāśaścātra sarvatra paratrānekasūryavat । tadā jātaṃ iti jñātvā vedā vidyāḥ samastuvan ।। 1 18।।
kṛṣṇasya vallabhaścāti sarvavidyādhiśevadhiḥ । prabhālakṣmīpārvatīmāṇikīśryādipatiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 19।।
camatkārānasaṃkhyāndarśayāmāsa kṛpākaraḥ । ūrjaśuklaikādaśyāṃ sa prāpa dīkṣopavītakam ।। 120 ।।
māghaśuklāṣṭamīprātaḥ kāśyāmavātatāra saḥ । navamyāṃ brahmavidyānāṃ saṃcāraṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ ।। 121 ।।
svapitṛmukhataḥ śrutvā vijñānaṃ svātmani sthitam । vedavidyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmyai hyupādideśa ha ।। 122।।
nibodha lakṣmi! kiṃ vacmi yo hariḥ puruṣottamaḥ । parabrahmā'kṣarā'tīto'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 123।।
sa eva vidyate rādhādhavo golokadhāmani । rukmiṇīnātha evāsau gopālaḥ kaṃbharāpatiḥ ।। 124।।
baikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ so'yaṃ lakṣmīpatirnarāyaṇaḥ । kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so'yaṃ sarveśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 125।।
so'haṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmi! sā tvaṃ lakṣmīrmama priyā । sthalabhedena rūpāṇāṃ bāhulyaṃ ceyate mayā ।। 126 ।।
nigamāgamavidyānāṃ vaktā'haṃ puruṣottamaḥ । śrotṛvyaktirmama dāsī priyā śiṣyā tvamanvasi ।। 127।।
mayā nārāyaṇenātra tubhyaṃ lakṣmi! pradīyate । jñānaṃ vijñānamātmasthaṃ hyaparokṣaṃ sadā mama ।। 128।।
sṛṣṭikalpalayapūrvapūrvataratamā''dijam । lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitātmakaṃ ślokakoṭikam ।। 129 ।।
vairājāya tvayā deyaṃ pañcāśallakṣasaṃkhyakam । yatreśvarāṇāṃ vaiśeṣyaṃ varṇitaṃ ceśasṛṣṭaye ।। 130 ।।
vedhase vai tvayā deyaṃ pañcaviṃśatilakṣakam । yatrā'gaṇitagolādibrahmāṇḍetikathādayaḥ ।। 13 1।।
sārdhadvādaśalakṣaṃ ca pitṛbhyo'rpya tvayā priye! । yatra teṣāṃ sarvakāṇḍāḥ paramārthatayā''dṛtāḥ ।। 1 32।।
pañcalakṣaṃ tvayā deyaṃ divi svargurave priye! । bārhaspatyaṃ surāṇāṃ tajjñānaṃ devānusāri vai ।। 133।।
pañcalakṣaṃ tu daityānāṃ pātālādipravāsinām । śukrāya ca tvayā deyaṃ tāmasādyanusāri yat ।। 134।।
sapādalakṣaṃ dātavyaṃ brāhmamārṣaṃ viśodhakam । tyāgibhyaḥ paramarṣibhyo brahmā'vāptikaraṃ tu yat ।। 135।।
sapādakṣaṃ dātavyaṃ viprebhyo mānaveṣu vai । yadadhītya caturvargān sādhayiṣyanti mānavāḥ ।। 136।।
kālāntare layaṃ yāte bhaviṣyāmi punaḥ punaḥ । tattajjñānaprakāśāya vyāsācāryarṣirūpataḥ ।। 1 37।।
iti te smāritaṃ lakṣmi! prāgvṛttaṃ te ca me tathā । pūrvaṃ pūrvā layaṃ yānti jalasthalavivartanāḥ ।। 138।।
vairājāḥ koṭiśo naṣṭā brahmādīnāṃ tu kā kathā । puruṣottamarūpo'haṃ mahāpralayakṛttathā ।। 139।।
sṛṣṭikṛnnityavijñāno'khilā''tmā'ntarniyāmakaḥ । na vismarāmyaṇvapi tvacintyaśaktinidhirdhruvaḥ ।। 140।।
yatra vai parvatāstatra jalaṃ kālāntare bhavet । jalasthāne sthalaṃ dehyāvāsaṃ vāse vanaṃ tathā ।। 141।।
raṇe'raṇyaṃ tathā'raṇye pattanaṃ vivaraṃ ca vā । vivareṣu mahāsetuḥ staraṃ stare tathā'mbaram ।। 142।।
kva kadā kiṃ bhūtametajjānāmi bhāvi cāpyaham । sarvaṃ mayi bhavatyeva kiṃcinmatto na ricyate ।। 143 ।।
idaṃ sṛṣṭisamāraṃbhe'smaccaritrakathāmṛtam । adhimāsā'parapakṣā'ṣṭamīvratamiṣeṇa vai ।। 144।।
smāritaṃ te mayā lakṣmi! pāvanaṃ śrotṛdehinām । pāṭhakānāṃ svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ vrataprapuṇyadam ।। 145 ।।
atrotsave vratakarturbhuktirmuktirna saṃśayaḥ । putrārthī labhate putraṃ bhāryā bhāryecchuko labhet ।। 146।।
dhanārthī prāpnuyād dravyaṃ kṣetrārthī bhūmimāpnuyāt । dharmārthī puṇyavān syācca sakāmaḥ kāmanāṃ labhet ।। 147।।
yaśaḥ kīrtimavāpnoti satāṃ pradhānatā labhet । aśubhaṃ nāśamāyāti prapāṭhanena sarvathā ।। 148।।
vipro vijñānavān syācca vijayaṃ kṣatriyo labhet । dhanadhānyasmṛddhisampadyukto vaiśyo bhavettathā ।। 149।।
śūdraḥ sarvasamṛddhaḥ syāt sukhī cāsya śraveṇa vai । śreyaḥ śriyaṃ parāṃ vindet tejovīryaṃ samāpnuyāt ।। 15 0।।
balaṃ rūpa guṇān sampad godhanakṣetravāṭikāḥ । dārāḥ sutā dāsadāsīrgṛharājyasvarādikam ।। 151।।
ārogyaṃ ca svatantratvaṃ nirbandhatvaṃ samāpnuyāt । nirbhīkatvaṃ nirāpattvaṃ prāpnuyānmokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।। 152।।
ityaṣṭamīvratajanyaṃ kathitaṃ te phalaṃ priye । vrataṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā prāpnuyāt puruṣottamam ।। 153।।
me'vatārā asaṃkhyātā hyahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ । avatārī mahārājaḥ parabrahma sanātanaḥ ।। 154।।
yāvad brahmā virāṭ vāpi vaikuṇṭhabhūmayastathā । sarvatrā'dhikamāso'haṃ sthāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ ।। 155।।
yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca sthāsyanti medinī tathā । kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatīrthe tāvat sthāsyati śāśvatam ।। 156।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ dhvajaśārṅgādiśobhitaḥ । lakṣmyādisevitastatra sthāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ ।। 157।।

itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye malamāsasyā''dhidaive puruṣottame jāte goloke kṛtamahotsavarāse kṛṣṇamukuṭamaṇikalgicandrikayoḥ mukuṭādviyoge tayorbhuvi ānartadeśe nimbadevamiṣṭādevīrūpeṇā- 'vataraṇaṃ, tayorgṛhe kṛṣṇasya gopālakṛṣṇarūpeṇā'vataraṇaṃ, premamaṇi-gṛhe rukmiṇīlakṣmyāḥ kaṃbharārūpeṇā'vataraṇaṃ, kaṃbharālakṣmī- gopālakṛṣṇayorvivāhottaraṃ dundubhiśravaṇenā'ṣṭamīvrata-karaṇena śrīpuruṣottamasya tayorgṛhe'vataraṇaṃ, koṭiślokasaṃhitākaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।1.315।।


← adhyāyaḥ 315 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 316
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 317 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! navamyāścādhikamāsā'ntitame dale । vratasya pūrvakalpīyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ।। 1 ।।
pūrvāt pūrvatare kalpe babhūvendro dyumerujit । sāyaṃ tasya laye jāte puṇyaśeṣeṇa vai punaḥ ।। 2 ।।
satyaloke niśāṃ bhuktvā kalpā''raṃbhe prage tu saḥ । sṛṣṭau tretāyuge cādye samrāṭ śatamakho'bhavat ।। 3 ।।
dānadharmadayāyukto lokarakṣaṇatatparaḥ । devadānavamartyānāṃ mānakṛd vijitendriyaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vyomayānena viharan trilokyāṃ vicacāra saḥ । gobhūtīrthadvijanyāsisatīsādhuprapūjakaḥ ।। 5 ।।
yasya hastatale vajracchatrakhaṅgāṃkakāni vai । vidyotante sma divyāni devatvāvedakāni vai ।। 6 ।।
tasya patnī mahārājñī dyuvarṇā'bhūt pativratā । patisevāparā nityaṃ devasevāparā tathā ।। 7 ।।
ātithyadharmiṇī dīnā'nāthadāridyanāśinī । kanyānāmunnatikartrī sadā strījātirakṣikā ।। 8 ।।
gāndharvyo nāgakanyāśca devyo dānavya etya ca । kinnaryaścāpi mānuṣyaḥ śikṣārthaṃ sma vasanti vai ।। 9 ।।
sāvitrī cāpi gāyatrī saṃjñā svāhā'pyarundhatī । mahendrāṇī satī lakṣmīḥ rohiṇī pārvatī svadhā ।। 10 ।।
prabhā ca māṇikī śrīśca jayā bhaktirdiśastathā । anyā nadyaḥ kṛttikādyāstasyāḥ sakhyo'bhavaँstadā ।। 1 1।।
campā dayā ramā hemnī muktā godā jayantikā । śāntiḥ śāntā premapātrā dīpotsavī ca nandinī ।। 12।।
ojasvatī suratnā ca damayantī caturmatiḥ । devikā kāntikā revā savitā mūlayoginī ।। 13।।
kastūrikā maṃgalā ca haṃsā ruciśca maṃjulā । nirmalā cāmṛtā rālijaṭinī pānaputtalī ।। 14।।
vanitā miṣṭikā puṣpā manuḥ kṛṣṇā ca dāsikāḥ । kāntā sarasvatī padmā śāradā upadāsikāḥ ।। 15।।
kalpadrumāśca maṇayaḥ kāmadhenava iṣṭadāḥ । kalpavallyo'bhavaṃstasyā rājye prāgjyotiṣāhvaye ।। 16।।
evaṃ śatamakho rājā rājñī dyuvarṇikā tathā । strīnarau rājyadharmeṇa vartete sma bhuvastale ।। 17।।
daivayogena tadrājyamabhūcchītādridurgavat । rājadhānī kṛtā tābhyāṃ sāketā sarayūmanu ।। 18।।
pradhānaṃ rakṣakaṃ kṛtvā yātrārthaṃ kṛtaniścayau । tatastau saṃprayātau vai badrīyātrārthamādarāt ।। 19।।
parimeyacaracārabhṛtyadāsījanau śubhau । tīrthasya niyamānsarvānpālayantau prajagmatuḥ ।।20 ।।
prātaḥ snānaṃ brahmacaryaṃ satyavrataṃ phalādanam । bhūśāyitvaṃ parityaktaśṛṃgārāsanādikam ।।।21।।
ahiṃsanaṃ parivādarāhityaṃ mālikājapam । rāgadveṣavihīnatvaṃ dānaṃ devādipūjanam ।।।22।।
tīrthavṛddhārcanaṃ tīrthagurusāhāyyakāritām । godarśanaṃ hareḥ pādāmṛtapānaṃ kathāśravam ।।23।।
viṣayāṇāṃ parityāgaṃ sādhuvadvartanaṃ tathā । rātrau nārāyaṇadhyānaṃ divā tīrthāṭanaṃ śubham ।।24।।
sāyaṃ nīrājanāstotrakīrtanasmaraṇādikam । jaṃgamānsthāvarānpratyanudvejanaṃ titikṣaṇam ।।25।।
pālayantau tāpasau tau bhūtvā badarikā gatau । devanadyāṃ tadācamya snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tataḥ ।।26।।
dadṛśaturmunīṃstīrthātmakāँstīrthāni cāṃjasā । naranārāyaṇau dṛṣṭvā pūjāṃ kṛtvopacārakaiḥ ।।27।।
sādhuviprānatithīṃśca bhojayāmāsatustadā । rājñā rājñyā naranārāyaṇayostoṣaṇāya vai ।।।28।।
tatraiva tu kṛtaṃ nṛtyaṃ gāyanaṃ mūrtisannidhau । arpitaṃ kānakacchatrayugalaṃ mukuṭadvayam ।।29।।
yugakuṇḍalayugalaṃ cāmarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam । yaṣṭikāyugalaṃ hārāścormikāviṃśatistathā ।।30 ।।
kaṭakadvayayugalaṃ śṛṃkhalāraśanādvayam । pādukādvayayugalaṃ tathā siṃhāsanadvayam ।।।3 1 ।।
dakṣiṇā bhūyasī caiva svarṇapātrottamāni ca । valkalā'jinavastrāṇi phalāni daiśikāni ca ।।32।।
samarpitāni sarvāṇi tava sva iti śabditam । pādau spṛṣṭau jalaṃ pītaṃ caraṇāmṛtamityapi ।।33।।
svarṇamālāpādayoścārpitā naranareśayoḥ । candanādisuvastvādyaiḥ pūjitau parameśvarau ।।34।।
āśīrvādāstadā labdhā putravān bhava pārthiva! । rājñī putravatī bhūyāditi śrutvā praśaṃ gatau ।।35।।
tāvattatrā'dhikamāsanavamyāṃ prātareva ha । saṃśruto dundubhiḥ samyaṅmanovācchāprapūrakaḥ ।।36।।
adya vrataṃ prakurvantu gṛhṇantu vāñcchitaṃ phalam । puruṣottamamāso'yaṃ phaladaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।37।।
hṛdi sthitān śubhān kāmāna gṛhṇantu puruṣottamāt । māṃ ca dhāma vibhūtiṃ ca dāsye smṛddhiṃ vratārthine ।।38।।
agamyaṃ buddhigamyaṃ syādalabhyaṃ labhyameva ca । atarkyaṃ cāpi tarkyaṃ syānnavamīvratakāriṇaḥ ।।39।।
sarvasaṃkalpasiddhiḥ syāt prāptiḥ pumuttamasya ca । dundubhiścetyabhidhāya dṛṣṭvā naraṃ nareśvaram ।।40 ।।
pūjayitvā ṛṣivaryau jagāmottaradigbhuvam । dampatī prasamākarṇya dhyātvā naranareśvarau ।।41 ।।
tallīnau cā'bhavatāṃ drāṅ naro nārāyaṇastadā । tayorhṛdordadṛśāte divyarūpau suśobhanau ।।42।।।
manoharau mañjuvākyau mañjulakeśasajjaṭau । puṣṭau yuvānau divyau ca tāpasau śrīniṣevitau ।।43 ।।
munibhirvanditapādau vaikuṇṭhavāsināvubhau । rājabhavanayogyau tau lālanapālanārhaṇau ।।44।।
padmapatrāyatanetrau sucandrāsyau guṇālayau । ghanaśyāmau hṛdayaṃgamau manojñasundarau ।।45।।
vīkṣya saṃkalpitaṃ putrāvīdṛśau bhavatā tu nau । atha dhyānād bahiryātau rājñīnṛpau vilokya ca ।।46।।
naranārāyaṇaḥ prāha saṃkalpaḥ phalatāttu vām । śrutvā tṛptau cāti jātau tīrthavidhiṃ vidhāya tau ।।47।।
nivartitau tataḥ sthānādāyayaturnadītaṭe । ācamya kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ snātvā pupūjatustadā ।।48।।
gaṃgājalairhariṃ tau saṃsnāpya pramṛjya cāmbaraiḥ । pañcāmṛtaṃ samarpyathā'bhiṣekaṃ cakraturjalaiḥ ।।49।।
saṃpramṛjya suvastrāṇyābhūṣaṇāni samarpya ca । śṛṃgāraśobhāṃ saṃklṛptvā dhūpadīpau samarpya ca ।।50 ।।
candanā'kṣatakuṃkumakajjaladravasārakaiḥ । sugandhayitvā''rārtrikaṃ kārayāmāsatustataḥ ।।51 ।।
bhojayāmāsaturdevaṃ vardhayāmāsatuḥ stavaiḥ । puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayāmāsatuśca phalādikam ।।52।।
tāmbūlacarvaṇaṃ datvā yācayāmāsatuḥ kṣamām । evaṃ sūryodayāt paścāt pañcaghaṭīgate punaḥ ।।53।।
samaye cāpi tau kṛtvā snānārcanastavādikam । naivedyapānatāmbūladakṣiṇādisamarpaṇam ।।54।।
ṛṣidevakṣitidevabhojanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā । nirvartyā'rghyaṃ kusumānāmañjaliṃ cā'kṣatāँstathā ।।55।।
datvā stutiṃ cakratuśca visarjanaṃ pracakratuḥ । evaṃ prapūjya deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ।।56 ।।
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ natvā tīrthavidhiṃ samāpya ca । pūrvaṃ madhyāhnasamayād rājadhānīṃ navīkṛtām ।।57।।
vimānena samāgatya sāketāṃ sarayūmanu । udyāne mahatī saudhe vṛkṣavallīsuśobhite ।।58।।
maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsatustau svarṇādiśobhitam । kalaśairhāraśṛṃgārairvastrabhūṣādhvajādibhiḥ ।।59।।
śobhitaṃ raṃgavallībhiḥ siktaṃ gandhajalādibhiḥ । vahnikuṇḍasamāyuktaṃ vedikāsuvirājitam ।।6 0।।
kaṭaparyaṃkabṛsikāsūrṇāstaraṇaśobhitam । kammānikātoraṇāḍhyaṃ kadalīstaṃbhasaṃdhṛtam ।।6 1।।
ādarśacandrakaḍaṃkā niśāna bherikā''nakaiḥ । jalataraṃgayantraiśca śītavāyupravāhakaiḥ ।।62।।
śobhitaṃ maṇḍitaṃ citrairavatārasurādibhiḥ । jalasthalavyatyayena dṛṣṭirjālairvilakṣitam ।।63।।
dūraśravaṇayantraiśca dūradarśanadarpaṇaiḥ । dūragrahaṇasiddhyādyairalaṃkṛtaṃ vimānavat ।।64।।
tatra maṇḍapamadhye tu sahakāratarū kṛtau । pārśvakoṇeṣu catvāro'śokavṛkṣā vinirmitāḥ ।।65।।
śākhāsu divyadolā ca bandhayāmāsatuśca tau । tatra mūrtimayāndevān śṛṃkhalāsu tu devikāḥ ।।66।।
saṃklṛptayāmāsatuśca komalāstaraṇāni ca । tatra mūrtiṃ kānakīṃ vai puruṣottamarūpiṇīm ।।67।।
āropyā''ndolayāmāsatuśca rājñī nṛpastathā । tatra devasya nikaṣā sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।।68।।
saptadhānyaiḥ sbarṇaratnahīrakādisumiśritam । racayāmāsaturmadhye suvarṇakalaśaṃ śubham ।।69।।
paṃcaratnajalapuṣpaphaladravyāmbarānvitam । sthāpayāmāsatustasyopari sthālīṃ tilānvitām ।।70।।
śrīphalamudrikāyuktāṃ dhārayāmāsatustataḥ । svarṇamūrti dvitīyāṃ śrīpuruṣottamasaṃjñitām ।।71 ।।
tatsthālyāṃ sthāpayāmāsatuśca ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ । pūjayāmāsaturārārtrikaṃ cakraturādarāt ।।।72।।।
nṛtyagītāni tatraiva kārayāmāsatustadā । homaṃ tvagnau kuṇḍamadhye kārayāmāsatustathā ।।73।।
bhojayāmāsaturviprāndevānsādhvīḥ satastathā । dīnā'nāthā'balāvargāndaridrān bhikṣukādikān ।।74।।
dakṣiṇā dāpayāmāsatuśca puṣpā'kṣatā'ñjalīn । arpayāmāsaturyāvat tāvattatra - sumaṇḍape ।।75।।
divyarūpo yuvā nūtnajīmūtavarṇasundaraḥ । śyāmalaḥ sajaṭo devaḥ sānujaḥ samadṛśyata ।।76।।
madhyāhnasamaye divyo mūrto vai puruṣottamaḥ । dibyatejaḥparidhyāḍhyānanahāsyasurañjanaḥ ।।77।।
divyanetrasnehapūrṇaḥ puṣṭaḥ puṣṭānujānvitaḥ । pītāmbaradhanuścarmakhaḍgaśaṃkhajaṭādharaḥ ।।78।।
suvarṇamukuṭāḍhyaśca suvarṇakuṇḍalānvitaḥ । āśīrvādaparahastaḥ sevākṛpāḍhyamānasaḥ ।।79।।
sthitivāñcchābhisaṃceṣṭaścārāmaśāntidaḥ prabhuḥ । ārāme maṇḍape jajñe madhyādityasamujjalaḥ ।।80।।
rāmādityetyanujenā''hūtastatra muhurgirā । ramante yogino yatrā''dityojjvalapareśvare ।।8 1 ।।
rāmādityo hyayaṃ śātamakhī jāto'tra keśavaḥ । ayaṃ rāmāvatāro vai prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।।82।।
dṛṣṭvā taṃ jātamātraṃ ca yuvānaṃ keśavaṃ prabhum । āścaryacakitau rājñī rājā cobhau babhūvatuḥ ।।83।।
rāmastu bhagavān divyau pitarau prāha toṣaṇāt । prasanno'smi varaṃ yācata yatheṣṭaṃ dadāmyaham ।।84।।
mūrtirūpeṇa sevā vāmaṃgīkṛtā mayā tataḥ । prādurbhūya varaṃ dātuṃ pratyakṣo'smi pumuttamaḥ ।।85।।
yo badaryāṃ harirdṛṣṭo nareṇa saha tāpasaḥ । hṛdi yau dadṛśāte ca divyarūpī suśobhanau ।।86।।
so'haṃ tvatra samāyātaḥ svabhrātrā puruṣottamaḥ । narādityo mama bhrātā tāpaso'pi mayā saha ।।87।।
dātuṃ naijaṃ darśanaṃ cātrāgatosti kṛpāvaśaḥ । pravṛṇuta varadānaṃ mā ciraṃ nveṣa yāmyaham ।।88।।
iti śrutvā śatamakho nṛpo rājñī dyuvarṇikā । babhūvatuścātisaṃbhramau saṃvyagramānasau ।।89।।
vandantau tiṣṭhataṃ tiṣṭhataṃ mā yātaṃ na gacchatam । sarvadā dadataṃ tvatra darśanaṃ bhavane prabhū ।।90।।
darśanīyau kamanīyau prāpsyethe na punarharī । gṛhṇītaṃ bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ peyaṃ tāmbūlamarcanam ।।91।।
ramataṃ sarvadā tvatrodyāne dadatamīpsitam । vatsau kiṃ vartate śaighryaṃ yātaṃ mā putrakau mama ।।92।।
ityuktvā rājamahiṣī nisargasnehasaṃbhṛtā । sutau dvau nikaṭe kṛtvā spṛṣṭvā netrajalā'bhavat ।।93।।
snutadugdhastanī jātā tyaktuṃ notsahate sma sā । rājā'pi premapūrṇāṃgaścā'nye'pi mumuhurharau ।।94।।
bhagavantau prāhatuśca tathāstviti sumaṇḍape । kṣaṇaṃ bālau tadā jātau stanyapānakarāvubhau ।।95।।
dyuvarṇā tāṃ pāyayitvā stanyaṃ prāptā kṛtārthatām । rāmādityanarādityābhidhaputravatī satī ।।96।।
sukhinī saṃbabhūvā'trānandotsavo mahāँstadā । rāmāvirbhāvarūpo vai madhyāhne bhūbhṛtā kṛtaḥ ।।97।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca munayaḥ sanakādayaḥ । nāradādyāśca ṛṣayo bhaktā vaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।।98।।
satyalokādivasatiḥ svargadevāśca mānavāḥ । pātālādisthitāścānye jaḍāśca cetanāḥ prajāḥ ।।99।।
tīrthāni saritaḥ śailā araṇyāni vanāni ca । kalpāśca pādapāścintāmaṇayaḥ kāmadhenavaḥ ।। 100 ।।
tatrotsave samāyātā mantrā vedāśca vittayaḥ । tattvāni cetarā sarve brahmaputrāśca mānasāḥ ।। 10 1।।
pitaro devarājāśca pārthivā lakṣakoṭayaḥ । samāyātā navamyāṃ vardhayituṃ cāśiṣā''śiṣā ।। 10 2।।
adhimāsā'parapakṣanavamyāṃ madhyage ravau । rāmādityajayantyāṃ te rāma vīkṣya naraṃ tathā ।। 10 3।।
kṛtārthāścā'bhavan labdhvā satkāraṃ bhojanādikam । rāmaprasannatāṃ prāpya cakrurgānaṃ sunartanam ।। 1 04।।
dānaṃ śatamakhaḥ koṭyarbudāni ca gavāṃ dadau । vardhakā lokapālāśca dikpālāśca surādayaḥ ।। 1 05।।
yayurnijasthalaṃ sarve svasvalokān yayurjanāḥ । madhyāhnapūjanaṃ rājñyā nṛpeṇa tatra maṇḍape ।। 106।।
samāptaṃ vai kṛtaṃ tadvat sāyaṃ niśi prapūjanam । rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cātha prātaḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtam ।। 1 07।।
mūrteḥ saṃpūjanaṃ pātrabhojanaṃ dakṣiṇādikam । kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ suvidhinā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ ।। 108।।
pāraṇā ca kṛtā tena patnyā saha suputriṇā । ānandaḥ samabhūt tasyā'tarkyo vai navamītitheḥ ।। 1 09।।
puruṣottamamāsasya vratena putradāyinā । iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ।। 11 0।।
rāmādityajayantyākhyaṃ vratapuṇyaṃ mahattamam । idaṃ prāgrāmacaritaṃ paṭhet saṃśṛṇuyāttu yaḥ ।। 111 ।।
śrāvayetparayā bhaktyā sa bhaved vratapuṇyabhāk । sveṣṭaṃ labhellabhedrājyaṃ labhet putraṃ dhanādikam ।। 1 12।।
labhet tīrthaphalaṃ cāpi sāketasarayūkṛtam । labhecca balavatputraṃ puruṣottamasannibham ।। 1 13।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sukhaṃ svargaṃ dhāma vaikuṇṭhamityapi । yadyadiṣṭaṃ labhet sarvaṃ kṛpayā paramātmanaḥ ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye sāketanagaryāḥ śatamakharājñaḥ dyuvarṇā rājñyāśca badarikāśramayātrāyāṃ naranārāyaṇadarśano-ttaraṃ dvitīyapakṣanavamīvratakaraṇena sāketanagaryāṃ śrīrāmādityanarādityanāmānau prathamau puruṣottamā-vatārau divyaputrau babhūvaturityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।1.316।।


← adhyāyaḥ 316 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 317
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 318 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! vikuṇṭhā yā goloke rādhikāsutā ।
saṃkalpamātrajā kanyā tasyā vṛttaṃ vratānvitam ॥ 1 ॥
adhimāsasya devo'bhūd bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
rādhayā sahitaḥ kṛṣṇo rāsaṃ cakre tadutsave ॥ 2 ॥
tatrā''yātā gopagopyaḥ kanyāḥ koṭyarbudārbudāḥ ।
kuṭumbinīḥ sakanyāśca rūpalāvaṇyasampadaḥ ॥ 3 ॥
gopīrvīkṣya svayaṃ rādhā tvaputrīyeṣu putrikām ।
gopīnāṃ kanyakā divyā āhvayanti svamātṛkāḥ ॥ 4 ॥
māँ ambe janani caivaṃ hyānandayanti mātṛkāḥ ।
putrīhīnā patiyuktā na pūrṇā sukhinī hi sā ॥ 5 ॥
putrī mātṛsvarūpā'sti māturvai kāryadāsikā ।
sarvathā sāhacaryeṇa sevate mātaraṃ sutā ॥ 6 ॥
bhojane cotsave yāne rahasyāplavane gṛhe ।
śayane vā pravāse vā sāhāyye sevikā sutā ॥ 7 ॥
nārīvargasya nāryaiva śārīrasahasevikā ।
tatrāpi svasutā tulyā na snuṣā nāpi bhṛtyakā ॥ 8 ॥
na vā kuṭumbinī tadvad yathā putrī tu sevikā ।
tasmāt sutāṃ binā nārī tvardhasaubhāgyaśālinī ॥ 9 ॥
prātaḥ putrīmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā svargādapyadhikaṃ sukham ।
jananī vindati loke na tathā putradarśanāt ॥ 1 0॥
pituḥ putre yathā sneho mātuḥ putryāṃ tato'dhikaḥ ।
abalā gosamā putrī kumārī mātṛsevikā ॥ 11 ॥
paścāt patiparā sā syāttasmānmāturviśeṣataḥ ।
pūrṇāyuṣyasukhaṃ putryāḥ kaumārye labhyameva ha ॥ 12॥
ataḥ putrī daśaguṇā preṣṭhā bhavati sarvathā ।
mātuḥ kalāsukauśalyaṃ gṛhakāryādiśikṣaṇam ॥ 13॥
putryātmake nijapātre vasatyeva sadā ciram ।
satputryā jāyate mātā yaśasvinī kuladvaye ॥ 14॥
putrī kīrtiryaśaḥ putrī putrī piṇḍastu mātṛjaḥ ।
svātmikāṃ putrikāṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti mātaraḥ ॥ 15॥
putraḥ pitṛsvarūpo'sti putrī mātusvarūpiṇī ।
suputrī jananī putrīmatsu mānyā bhavatyapi ॥ 16॥
aputrī tu samājādau mlāneva dṛśyate khalu ।
putrīmaṇḍalamadhyasthā mātā tatra prakāśate ॥ 17॥
aputrī tu yathā nidrotthitā tadvaddhi dṛśyate ।
bahvayaḥ suputrikā yasyāḥ sā dhanāḍhyāsu pūjyate ॥ 18॥
putryātmakaṃ dhanaṃ tasyāḥ sarvaśrībhyo viśiṣyate ।
jāmātāro'pi bahavo bahuputryā dhanaṃ mahat ॥ 19॥
putrīputrāśca tatputrā dhanaṃ vistṛtameva tat।
bahuśākhaśca vṛkṣasya chāyāṃ śrayanti lakṣaśaḥ ॥20॥
aśākhasya na vai chāyā nāśritā nahi mānyatā ।
paropakāro nāpyasti tathā'putrī vigaṇyate ॥2 1॥
putrīsukhaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā mātā toṣaṃ prayāti vai ।
na me putrī na vā putraḥ kathaṃ rādhā sukhāśrayā ॥ 22॥
sapatnīduḥkhamāpannā yadi putrīmatī bhavet ।
tadā sāpatnyaduḥkhaṃ vai putrīṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate ॥23 ॥
virajā rukmiṇī lakṣmīḥ ramā śrīḥ pārvatī prabhā ।
jayā ca vijayā bhāmā maṃgalā māṇikī yamī ॥24॥
anyāścā'saṃkhyakoṭyaśca sapatnyaḥ sānti me sadā ।
saputryastāḥ sadā dṛśyā mayā putrīvihīnayā ॥ 25॥
tasmāt putrī mayā prārthyā kṛṣṇāchrīpuruṣottamāt ।
yayā putrīmatīnāṃ maurdhanyaṃ mama yathā bhavet ॥26॥
iti saṃcintya rādhā sā mahotsavottaraṃ nijam ।
bhāvaṃ prakāśayāmāsa rahaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau ॥27॥
putrī me dayitāṃ nātha vinā putrīṃ mṛtirvarā ।
putrīmatīṣu sarvāsu na śobhe'haṃ samutsave ॥28॥
apatyāni vinā nārī śobhate naiva caikalā ।
kadalī śobhate naiva pārśvāpatyāni yatra na ॥29॥
virullatā na śobhante kvacicchākhālatāmṛte ।
hariṇī śobhate naiva bālāpatyāni vai vinā ॥ 30॥
vidyuttu śobhate tatra yatra vṛṣṭiḥ pravartate ।
kulyā vinā mahattvaṃ na nadyāḥ kvāpi prasiddhyati ॥3 1॥
vinā'ṅgulīḥ phaṇā naiva śobhate śobhitā'pi vai ।
śāntiṃ vinā na vā vidyā śobhate sā mahatyapi ॥32॥
muktiṃ vinā parāvidyā śobhate na parā'pi sā ।
tṛptiṃ vinā yathā bhuktirniṣphaleva prajāyate ॥33॥
patnīṃ vinā yathā śayyā yauvanodvegadāyinī ।
putrīṃ vinā tathā mātā vārdhakye duḥkhadarśinī ॥34॥
tasmāt putrīṃ samicchāmi sarvasadguṇaśālinīm ।
mātrājñāpālayitrīṃ ca kuladharmānuyāyinīm ॥ 35॥
mātṛsevākarīṃ divyāṃ gṛhakāryasahāyinīm ।
annavārisamitpatraśākapuṣpādirakṣiṇīm ॥36॥
mārjanaṃ mañjanaṃ vasturakṣaṇaṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā ।
pācanaṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ ca jalāharaṇaprabhṛti ॥37 ॥
kuryāt snigdhā sutā yā syānmātṛvātsalyaśobhitā ।
tasmānmayā suputryatra kṛṣṇa kānta guṇālayā ॥38॥
sarvaśreṣṭhā ca vikhyātā mātāpitṛsahāyinī ।
dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca yāṃ śāntirbhavet samiṣyate hare ॥39॥
yadyahaṃ te priyā patnī mayi tuṣṭo bhavān yadi ।
yadyahaṃ te priyā dāsī priyaḥ kānto'si me yadi ॥40॥
tadā rādhā vṛṇute'tra kṛṣṇātputrīṃ sulakṣaṇām ।
sarvaputrīmatīputrīrvismārayettu yā nu mām ॥4 1 ॥
ityabhyarthya priyā rādhā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
kṛtvā vakṣasi saṃśliṣṭaṃ sevayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ॥42॥
kṛṣṇastvānandayitvā tāṃ dadau tasyai suputrikām ।
divyāṃ rādhāsamākārāṃ rādhārūpātirūpiṇīm ॥43 ॥
saṃkalpamātrajanyāṃ ca jātamātrā suyauvanām ।
divyāṃ divyasahasrābjagopīrūpā'tirūpiṇīm ॥44॥
yathā rādhā tathā sāsti yathā sā rādhikā tathā ।
āntaraṃ naiva sarvātmatulyatayā vibhāsate ॥45॥
mumuhurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaśca mohitāḥ ।
stabdhāśca citritā yadvat tadānīmabhavan kṣaṇam ॥46 ॥
etādṛśī darśanārhā vṛttīnāṃ kuṇṭhitā parā ।
tatraiva putryāṃ sarvāsāṃ sarveṣāṃ cā'bhavattadā ॥47॥
kṛṣṇo'pi rūpasampannāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa vai ।
vṛttīnāṃ kuṇṭhito bhāvo jātaṃ sthairyaṃ yato'tra vai ॥48॥
pitrā kṛṣṇena vātsalyād vikuṇṭheti samādarāt ।
samāhūtā sutā tadvat samāhūtā hi rādhayā ॥ 49 ॥
vikuṇṭhākhyā ca sā kārṣṇī rādheyīnāmato'bhavat ।
golokavasatiḥ sarvā draṣṭuṃ kanyāṃ samāyayau ॥5 0 ॥
praśaṃsanti striyastāṃ tā aho rādhā mahodayā ।
aho putrī divyarādhārūpā'tirūpabhājanā ॥5 1 ॥
aho bhāgyena kasyāpi jāteyaṃ sumanoharā ।
kṛṣṇādapyuttamaṃ bhāgyaṃ tasya syād yasya sā bhavet ॥52॥
vivāhavidhinā bhāryā bhavedyasya tu kanyakā ।
sa vai kṛṣṇottamaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavedvai puruṣottamaḥ ॥53 ॥
ityuktvā''śiṣa āyujya jagmuḥ svasvālayaṃ janāḥ ।
rādhā tāṃ pāyayāmāsa stanyaṃ tatkālasaṃbhavam ॥54॥
kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskārayāmāsa vidhinā bhojanaṃ dadau ।
ramayāmāsa mātā tāṃ lālanaiḥ pālanādibhiḥ ॥55 ॥
atha sā rādhikāsevāṃ karoti smā'tibhāvataḥ ।
gṛhakāryāṇi sarvāṇi nirvartayati śikṣitā ॥56॥
evaṃ vivartamānā sā varārohā'tiyauvanā ।
nityaṃ pitrā samaṃ yāti draṣṭuṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ॥57॥
akṣarādhipatiṃ brahmaparaṃ śrīparameśvaram ।
anantakṛṣṇasaṃsevyaṃ nārāyaṇābjavanditam ॥ 58 ॥
yatkāntyā leśamātreṇa kāntāḥ kṛṣṇādayo matāḥ ।
tamanādibrahmayuktaiḥ sevitaṃ puruṣottamam ॥59॥
prātaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā yāti paraṃ pūjayituṃ prabhum ।
śvetadivyamahāyuktasapakṣahastisaṃsthitaḥ ॥6 0 ॥
upāyanādikaṃ nītvā bhagavān rādhikāpatiḥ ।
nivartate tu sampūjya tadvā kṛṣṇasutā tu sā ॥ 61 ॥
cakame rādhikāputrī dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
tasyā manaḥ samākṛṣya svasmin sthāpayati prabhuḥ ॥62॥
vikuṇṭhā dhyāyati dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
sarvakriyāsu cānādikṛṣṇānārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।63 ॥
gāyati smarati paśyatyapi śrīṣuruṣottamam ।
evaṃ nityaṃ tayā sārdhaṃ samāyāti ca pūjanam ॥6 4।।
kṛtvā kṛṣṇaḥ svakaṃ dhāma gacchati nityameva ha ।
vikuṇṭhā'pi tanmayā'bhūt sarvakriyāsu sarvadā ।।65।।
puruṣottamapatnītvaṃ prāptuṃ dhyāyatyaharniśam ।
tāvattatra tadā'vādīd dundubhiḥ śrīharermahān ॥ 66॥
adyā'sti daśamī ramyā puṇyadā'dhikamāsikī ।
pare pakṣe'tra vratakṛllabhate sveṣṭavastukam ॥67।।
api kanyā ca vā nārī naro vā dīnamānavaḥ ।
