adya vratena vai sveṣṭaṃ prāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।68 ।।
akṣarādhipatyanādiśrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ।
yadyadicchati tatsarvaṃ pradāsye vai vratārthine ।।69 ।।
mā saṃkocaṃ prakurvantu prārthanākaraṇe janāḥ ।
gopyaṃ rakṣyaṃ cā'nivedyaṃ dāsye saṃkalpitaṃ khalu ।।70 ।।
ityāśrutya vikuṇṭhā sā cakre vai daśamīvratam ।
puruṣottamalabdhyarthaṃ sajāgaraṃ divāniśam ।।7 1 ।।
prātastayā kṛtā pūjā śubhā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।
puruṣottamamūrteśca bhojanārārtrikādikam ।।72।।
khānapānasunaivedyaphalapuṣpajalādikam ।
prātarmadhye tathā sāyaṃ rātrau cakāra pūjanam ।।73 ।।
kṛṣṇacandraśītaraśmitejomaye'tisūjjvale ।
virāmākhye niśāvācye samaye puruṣottamaḥ ॥74॥
samāyāt tatra mūrtyākhye svarūpe'kṣaradhāmataḥ ।
koṭikṛṣṇasamaḥ kānto vikuṇṭhābhāgyaniścitaḥ ॥75 ॥
prahasan tāṃ prabhuḥ prāhā''gato'smi vratapuṇyadaḥ ।
tava bhaktyā prasanno'smi vṛṇu kṛṣṇasute'naghe ॥ 76 ॥
adeyaṃ nāsti te kiñcit smṛtavatyai sadā tu mām ।
ananyāyai bhaktimatyai kārṣṇyai deyaṃ yathepsitam ॥77॥
tadā prāha vikuṇṭhā taṃ prasannā lajjitā tathā ।
hṛdaye prāṇanātha tvaṃ vartase'viditaṃ na te ॥78 ॥
tathāpi bhaktavātsalyājjijñāsāṃ tvaṃ karoṣi vai ।
bhagavanmama nātha tvaṃ bhava prāṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ ॥79॥
iyaṃ samarpyate svāmin varamālā''diśa prabho ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tathā prāhā'dhikaṃ hariḥ ॥8 0 ॥
śṛṇu naikasvarūpo'haṃ vasāmi vividhāśrayaḥ ।
vasāmyahaṃ sadā dhāmnyakṣare śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥8 1 ॥
dvitīyo'haṃ vasāmyeva mahāvaikuṇṭhadhāmani ।
tathā jalāvaraṇāntavaikuṇṭhe'haṃ tṛtīyakaḥ ।।82 ॥
śvetadvīpākhyavaikuṇṭhe caturtho'haṃ vasāmyapi ।
kṣīrāntaḥsthe tu vaikuṇṭhe vasāmi paṃcamo'pyaham ॥83 ॥
tasmāt tvayāpi sarvatra vastavyaṃ divyarūpayā ।
naikena vai svarūpeṇa sthātuṃ sarvatra pāryate ॥84॥
tato'nekasvarūpatvaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam ।
kiṃca mātrā tava rādhikayā sevārthamityapi ॥85॥
nirmitā tvaṃ tato tāṃ vai tyaktuṃ nārhasi sundari! ।
rādhāsevārthamevāpi sthātavyaṃ sarvadā tvayā ॥86 ॥
iti rūpāṇi ṣaṭ kṛtvā sthātavyaṃ sarvathā tvayā ।
kṛpayā mama tasmātte rūpāṇi ṣaḍ bhavantu vai ॥87॥
ityuktā sā ṣaṭsvarūpā'bhavattasya kṛpākaṇāt ।
tatraikaṃ tvakṣaradhāmavāsārha sarvato'dhikam ॥88 ॥
puruṣottamayogyaṃ sababhūva nityamuktikam ।
patnītvena vikuṇṭhā tāṃ jagrāha puruṣottamaḥ ॥89 ॥
dvitīyaṃ rādhikāsevāyogyaṃ putrīsvarūpakam ।
goloke tāṃ kumārīṃ vai sthāpayāmāsa keśavaḥ ॥ 90 ॥
vikuṇṭhā kanyakā pūrvaṃ yathā tatraiva tiṣṭhati ।
tṛtīyaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā vyāpakaṃ mūrtimattathā ॥ 91 ॥
rūpaṃ dvedhā'bhavattatra vyāpakaṃ tattu sarvathā ।
vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ dhāmarūpamadhidaivaṃ babhūva tat ॥ 92 ॥
mahāvaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ tad vyāpakaṃ dhāma cocyate ।
tatra nārāyaṇapatnī mahālakṣmīrbabhūva sā ॥ 92 ॥
caturthaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhā'bhavattathā ।
jalāvaraṇavaikuṇṭhaṃ tejomayādhidaivatam ॥ 94॥
vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam ।
vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt ॥ 95॥
pañcamaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhā'bhavattadā ।
śvetadvīpākhyavaikuṇṭhaṃ tejomayādhidaivatam ॥ 96॥
vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam ।
vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt ॥ 97॥
ṣaṣṭhaṃ cāpi vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhā'bhavattadā ।
kṣīravaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ tattejomayādhidaivatam ॥98॥
vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam ।
vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt ॥ 99॥
evaṃ ṣaṇmūrtayastasyāḥ surūpā divyayoṣitaḥ ।
ṣaṭsthaleṣu hi vartante vikuṇṭhā bhagavatstriyaḥ ॥ 10 0॥
vaikuṇṭhāni tu catvāri dhāmāni divyabhūmayaḥ ।
babhūvustadadhiṣṭhātrīdevatāstā harīcchayā ॥ 10 1॥
catasro vyāpikā devyo militvā daśa tāḥ sadā ।
pṛthagrūpā babhūvurvai vratena haritoṣaṇāt ॥ 10 2॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipuruṣottamasatkṛpā ।
kiṃ kiṃ na kurute lakṣmi! sā vikuṇṭhā bhavatyapi ॥ 102 ॥
svātmānaṃ tvaṃ vijānīhi sa cā'ha puruṣottamaḥ ।
ityapi tvaṃ vijānīhi patiṃ te puruṣottamam ॥ 1 04॥
jñātvā māṃ bhajase tatra sarvatrātra ca matpriye ।
ahaṃ jānāmi tatsarvaṃ nityapratyakṣavattayā ॥ 1 05॥
tvaṃ na vetsi tathā sarvaṃ madicchā tatra kāraṇam ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛttaṃ daśamikāvratāt ॥ 10 6॥
vikuṇṭhāyāstava rūpāṇyabhavan daśadhā phalam ।
madicchayā tathā jātaṃ mamānugrahakāraṇam ॥ 1 07॥
paṭhedvā śṛṇuyādvāpi phalaṃ tasyāpi tādṛśam ।
dadāmīṣṭaṃ pūrayāmi kṛpayā puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 108॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇena dattāyā mānasyā rādhikā- putryā vikuṇṭhānāmnyā daśamīvratena santuṣṭapuruṣottama-kṛpayā ṣaṭlakṣmīrūpāṇi catvāri vaikuṇṭhadhāmādhidevatā-rūpāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhika-triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥1.317॥


← adhyāyaḥ 317 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 318
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 319 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi pūrvakalpe bhavāṃ vamryāḥ kathāṃ śubhām ।
rudraputrī kṛte cādye samabhūd vamrikā sutā ॥ 1 ॥
satyāḥ sā mānasī putrī vaṭe tiṣṭhati nityadā ।
mandare parvate rudrāvatāre vaṭapādape ॥ 2 ॥
pitrāśraye kṛtā''vāsā tvāste śuddhā kumārikā ।
satyā cā'prajayā dṛṣṭā vikuṇṭhā rādhikāsutā ॥ 3 ॥
tadā putrīmatī syāṃ cetyārthayacchaṃkarānmuhuḥ ।
tathāstviti prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ saṃkalpamācarat ॥ 4 ॥
yatra vai mandare'raṇye svāvatāravaṭāśraye ।
tatraiva ramaṇāt satyā mānasī divyarūpiṇī ॥ 5 ॥
jajñe koṭicandratejo'dhikatejomayī sutā ।
jātamātrā surūpā suyauvanā yādṛśī satī ॥ 6 ॥
tato'pyadhikasaundaryā sarvadivyaguṇālayā ।
jātamātrā divyabodhā nanāma pādayoḥ pituḥ ॥ 7 ॥
mātṛcaraṇayoścāpi nanāma sevikā yathā ।
satī cātiprasannā'bhūd rudro'pyatitarāṃ sukhī ॥ 8 ॥
anapatyastu sāpatyo bhavatyutsavavardhitaḥ ।
kṛtaḥ satyā śaṃbhunā cotsavastatra sumandare ॥ 9 ॥
devā devyo mānavāśca dikpālā manavastathā ।
maharṣayo'japitaro viṣṇudakṣādayo'pare ॥ 10 ॥
yugalāni yayustatra vamryā janmamahotsave ।
saṃskṛtā vidhinā saptarṣibhiryajñopavītakam ॥ 11 ॥
prārpitaṃ brahmavarcaskaṃ sarvatejodhikā babhau ।
janakaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca tathā sā sevate satīm ॥ 12॥
pitarāviva yogasthā samādhāvapi tiṣṭhati ।
vaṭavāsā vaṭacchāyākṛtaśālā vaṭāśrayā ॥ 13॥
vaṭatvaksaṃ'skṛtavastrā nyagrodhaphalabhojanā ।
nyagrodhadugdhapānā ca nyagrodhaphalabhūṣaṇā ॥ 14॥
nyagrodhasya jaṭātantuśāṭikā vaṭamūlake ।
vedīkṛtahomakāryā vaṭapatrasukaṃcukī ॥ 15॥
vaṭakāṣṭhasuvalayā vaṭarūpā sadā'bhavat ।
tāpasī vaṭaputrī sā sarvasiddhimayī babhau ॥ 16॥
yadyadicchati tatsarvaṃ tatra samupatiṣṭhate ।
sampadaḥ smṛddhayo lakṣmyo rasā bhogyāni vai sudhā ॥ 17॥
amṛtāni vicitrāṇi dugdhāni vividhāni ca ।
sarvavṛkṣarasāstatra sarvaratnāni tatra ca ॥ 18॥
sarvabhogyopakaraṇānyupatiṣṭhanti tadvaṭe ।
sā tu yogabalāt sarvaṃ svasyā agre prapaśyati ॥ 19॥
mūlādhāre gude cakre gatvā gaṇapatiṃ suram ।
dhyāyati smā'sya sāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvathā ॥20॥
svādhiṣṭhāne yonimūle cakre gatvā caturmukham ।
dhyāyati smā'sya sāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvataḥ ॥21 ॥
maṇipūre nābhideśe cakre gatvā tu viṣṇukam ।
dhyāyati smā'sya sāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvathā ॥22॥
hṛdaye'nāhate cakre gatvā dhyātvā śivaṃ sthitam ।
tasyāpi sarvasāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti yoginī ॥23 ॥
viśuddhicakre kaṇṭhasthe svātmani saṃyamaṃ param ।
kṛtvā''tmatattvasāmarthyaṃ vaśīkaroti sarvathā ॥ 2 4॥
ājñācakre bhruvormadhye dhyātvā haṃsaṃ guruṃ tathā ।
vaśīkaroti brahmādi jñānaṃ sārvajñyameti yā ॥ 25॥
brahmarandhre'pi sā gatvā brahmalokaṃ gatā satī ।
paśyati śrīparātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ॥ 26 ॥
kcacitsamādhinā vamrī yāti brahmapuraṃ prati ।
kvacidvaikuṇṭhalokaṃ ca yāti śvetaṃ puraṃ prati ॥ 27॥
golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ dhāma śrīpuraṃ yāti vāsavam ।
kvacicchaivaṃ kvacid brāhmaṃ sauraṃ cāndraṃ ca vāruṇam ॥ 28 ॥
kauberaṃ devalokāँśca prakṛteḥ puruṣasya ca ।

caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ lokān yāti samādhinā ।
asurāṇāṃ ca nāgānāṃ devīnāmālayāँstathā ॥ 30 ॥
bhūgole ca khagole ca brahmāṇḍe yāti yoginī ।
iḍāyāḥ piṃgalāyāśca suṣumṇādeśca vartmanā ॥ 31 ॥
sūryacandrādilokāँśca jagāma yogasaṃśrayā ।
saṃyamanīṃ dharmapurīṃ jagāma yogavartmanā ॥ 32॥
naikarūpadharā bhūtvā vamrī vaṭe'pi tiṣṭhati ।
tiṣṭhatyaparavṛkṣeṣu vaikuṇṭhe śrīpure'pi ca ॥ 33 ॥
kuberasya mahākośe bhūtvā vamrī tu yakṣiṇī ।
tiṣṭhate sā dhanayakṣiṇīti rakṣākarī tathā ॥ 34॥
evaṃ bhūtvā bahurūpā yatheṣṭaṃ ramate hi sā ।
vaṭā'dhaḥ sūyamānatvād vaṭasāvitrikā hi sā ॥ 35 ॥
vaṭaṃ svarṇaṃ tasya rakṣākarī sā vaṭayakṣiṇī ।
vṛkṣeṣu vasamānatvād vārkṣī vamrī sadā'bhavat ॥ 3 6 ॥

sasyā'nnakaṇadhānyādi vārkṣī dadāti pūjitā ।

vamrī satīsutā yogakriyādakṣā sthale sthale ॥40 ॥
yogābhyāsena gatvaiva dadarśa sarvasṛṣṭiṣu ।
yugalāni patipatnīkṛtāni mānasānyapi ॥41 ॥
īśvarāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca mānavānāṃ ca śākhinām ।
divyāni dehayuktāni priye! puṇyātmakānyapi ॥42॥
dṛṣṭvā dharmaṃ vicāryaiva yauvanaṃ vai patiṃ vinā ।
strīṇāṃ doṣakaraṃ śuddhivihīnaṃ bhāti sṛṣṭiṣu ॥43 ॥
tasmānmayā'pi yoktavyaṃ patyā saha sadharmiṇā ।
iti vicārya sā vamrī satīputrī susundarī ॥44॥
niṣasāda vaṭā'dhastād vedyāṃ sā mandare girau ।
tāvattatpārśvato yātā divyāḥ pracetaso daśa ॥45॥
svatulyān rūpasampannān puṣṭayauvanasaṃbhṛtān ।
punastatpārśvato jagmuḥ kṛtvā śaṃkaradarśanam ॥46॥
manasteṣu tadā vamryāḥ kiñcidvai snigdhatā gatam ।
tāneva saṃsmarantyatra vaṭe sā vyagramānasā ॥47॥
śuśrāva dundubhiṃ cādhikamāsavratabodhakam ।

vratakartryā bhavetsveṣṭaṃ siddhaṃ prayatnamantarā ।
puruṣottama kṛṣṇo'haṃ dadāmīṣṭaṃ vratārthine ॥49 ॥
dundubhiḥ saṃvadāmyatra sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
gṛhṇantu varadānaṃ mat yatheṣṭaṃ suramānavāḥ ॥5 0 ॥
narā nāryaḥ surā devyaḥ samāyāntu madantikam ।
ekādaśyā vratapuṇyaṃ dadāmi manasepsitam ॥5 1 ॥
śrutvā vamrī dundubhiṃ taṃ prati śīghraṃ samāyayau ।
saṃpūjya dundubhiṃ kanyā provāca daśavārakam ॥52॥
patiṃ dehi, patiṃ dehi, patiṃ dehi, patiṃ, patim ।
patiṃ dehi, patiṃ dehi, patiṃ dehi, patiṃ, patim ॥53 ॥
śrutvā tathāstviti procya dundubhirniryayau tataḥ ।
vaṭaṃ sāpi yayau śīghraṃ yathā jānāti no satī ॥54॥
prasannā tuṣṭahṛdayā varadānadhanānvitā ।
punaḥ śuśrāva taṃ vādyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ ॥55 ॥
pūjayā toṣitaḥ śīghraṃ mānasaṃ pūrayiṣyati ।
śrutvaivaṃ sā vaṭā'dhastāt pratimāṃ pauruṣottamīm ॥56॥
vidhāya pūjayāmāsa vaṭapatraphalādibhiḥ ।
āvāhyācamanaṃ kārayitvā''sanaṃ samarpya ca ॥57॥
pādyamarghyaṃ sasamarpya dadhnā dugdhena vāriṇā ।
śarkarayā madhunā ca ghṛtenā'snāpayaddharim ॥ 58 ॥
vastreṇa mārjayāmāsa jalānyaṃgebhya īśvarī ।
dhautraṃ vyāghrāmbaraṃ cottarīyaṃ hastyambaraṃ tathā ॥59 ॥
vaṭatvaṅanaktakaṃ yajñopavītaṃ darbhanirmitam ।
samarpyā''bharaṇānīṣṭapauṣpāṇi phālikāni ca ॥ 60 ॥
sauvarṇāni ca raupyāṇi kastūrīcandanā'kṣatān ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyatāmbūlaphalacarvaṇam ॥6 1 ॥
ārārtrikaṃ daṇḍavacca pradakṣiṇāṃ stutiṃ tathā ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpyā'tha jagau saṃkīrtanaṃ tataḥ ॥62॥
madhyāhne'pi tathā sāyaṃ niśi prapūjya keśavam ।
vamrī sajāgaraṃ nṛtyaṃ cakāra harisannidhau ॥63॥
ḍamaruṃ vādayamānā kiṃkiṇīśabdamiśritam ।
gāyanaṃ gītikāyuktaṃ madhuraṃ vai cakāra sā ॥64॥
vanavṛkṣāśca tacchrutvā latāstṛṇāni cāyayuḥ ।
stabakāśca samājagmuḥ śravaṇā''kṛṣṭacetanāḥ ॥65॥
cetanā''raṇyakāḥ sarve sapakṣāḥ pakṣavarjitāḥ ।
api śravaṇasaṃkṛṣṭāḥ samāyātā vaṭasthalam ॥66॥
puruṣottamadevasya pūjāyā jalamamṛtam ।
prāsādikaṃ phalaṃ cānyat patraṃ puṣpādikaṃ tathā ॥67॥
dadau tebhyastu sarvebhyaḥ paścājjagrāha vamrikā ।
satī ca śaṃkaraścaitadbhāgavataprapūjanam ॥68॥
dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ paraṃ prāptau praśaṃsatuśca putrikām ।
dadatuścāśiṣaḥ putri! yatheṣṭaṃ sukhinī bhava ॥69॥
vaiṣṇavī bhava kalyāṇi! vanasaukhyakarī bhava ।
tāpasī brahmaśaktiśca pumuttamapriyā bhava ॥7 0॥
pūjyā vaṭasthitā mānyā vṛkṣarasapradā bhava ।
ityādyāśīrvacanaistāṃ yojayāmāsatuḥ śivau ॥71॥
athaivaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā visarjanaṃ hareḥ ।
vaṭavedyāṃ niṣasāda samājaṃ vinivṛtya sā ॥72॥
tāvattatra samāyāto divyarūpadharaḥ pumān ।
rūpānurūpāya'vayavaḥ koṭiśaṃbhusamojjvalaḥ ॥73॥
candrānanasuśobhāḍhyo yuvā yogyo varo yathā ।
prahasya tāṃ samākṛṣya priyetyāha sakaustubhaḥ ॥74॥
vamrī namramukhī bhūtvā jñātvā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
patitā pādayostasya cakrapadmadharasya vai ॥75॥
vad devi! vratenā'smi prasannaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
varaṃ brūhi dadāmyatra yatte manasi vartate ॥76॥
vamrī tu pādayornatvā jalaṃ dhṛtvā mukhe tadā ।
rajaśca mastake kṛtvā stane kṛtvā padāmbujam ॥77॥
kaṇṭhopari karau sthāpya mano datvā hṛdambare ।

patnīṃ bhāryāṃ tava dāsīṃ gṛhāṇetyavadattu sā ।
paraṃ bhāvaṃ harirjñātvā tathāstvityāha mādhavaḥ ॥79॥
paraṃ prāha ca tāṃ vamrīṃ smara pūrvaṃ tavā'rthitam ।

eko'haṃ te patirbhāvyaḥ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।

khaniṣvapi pṛthivyāṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭha rudrīsvarūpiṇī ।
smara pracetaso dṛṣṭvā manaste snigdhatā gatam ॥84॥
ataste patayo bhāvyā daśa pracetaso'malāḥ ।
kintu nānena dehena tava yogyā hi te matāḥ ॥85॥
tasmād vṛkṣairarthitāsi ye ye'tra pūjanāvadhau ।
upasthitāśca teṣāṃ tvaṃ putrī bhava priye! tathā ॥8 6॥

vṛkṣaputrī bhava devi daśadhā rūpadhāriṇī ॥87॥
śṛṇu tvāṃ kathayāmyatra tattadrūpāṇi saṃkuru ।
vṛkṣāḥ, stambāśca, sasyāni, śākāni ca, tṛṇāni ca ॥88 ॥
nalāśca, vallayaścaiva, daṇḍāḥ, patrāṇi, kandakāḥ ।
daśasveteṣu pitṛtvaṃ svīkṛtya daśadhā bhava ॥89 ॥
saśākhaphalamātreṣu hyaśākhapuṣpamātrake ।
saśākhapuṣpamātreṣu hyaśākhaphalamātrake ॥ 90 ॥
saśākhaphalapuṣpeṣu hyaśākhaphalapuṣpake ।
saśākhā'phalapuṣpeṣu hyaśākha'phalapuṣpake ॥9 1 ॥
saśākhapatramātreṣu hyaśākhapatramātrake ।
putrī bhūtvā rasān dehi daśaputryo bhavantu vai ॥ 9 2॥
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'tibhāvataḥ ।
vamrīrūpaṃ dhāmayogyaṃ kṛtvā nītvā yayau mudā ॥ 93 ॥
ekaṃ putrīsvarūpaṃ tu sthitaṃ vamryāḥ satīkṛte ।
aparāṇi ca rūpāṇi vṛkṣakanyāḥ suyauvanāḥ ॥94॥
niṣpannāstāstadā ninyurvṛkṣā vibhinnajātayaḥ ।
taiḥ pradattāḥ pracetobhyo daśabhya eva dharmataḥ ॥ 95॥
sarvatra rasadāyinyaḥ phaladāyinya eva tāḥ ।
nāradasyopadeśena pracetasāṃ tu mokṣaṇe ॥96॥
vārkṣīṇāmapi mokṣo vai bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
ekādaśīvrataṃ tvevaṃ kṛtvā vamrī satīsutā ॥ 97॥
prapede paramaṃ dhāma tanvā brāhmyā hi śāśvatam ।
puruṣottamapatnītvaṃ prāptā yatheṣṭasaukhyadam ॥ 98॥
devyo vamryastathā vārkṣyo jātāḥ kṛpākaṇāddhareḥ ।
devyo vamryastu rūdrasya vedyāṃ prathamajā vare ॥ 99 ॥
makhasya devajayane babhūvuḥ samidho bhuvi ।
śrāvaṇātpaṭhanāccāsyaikādaśyā vratajaṃ phalam ॥ 100 ॥
labhate vācayed yaḥ sa dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca labhate puruṣottamatoṣaṇāt ॥ 101 ॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye satīrudrayormānasaputryā yoginyā vamryā'dhikamāsaikādaśīvratakaraṇena sveṣṭabrahmā'kṣara-dhāmayogyabrāhmītanurlabdhā, rūpāntarairdaśapracetaḥpatnītvaṃ - vṛkṣakanyātvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭā-daśā'dhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.318 ॥

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! kathāṃ vairājapādajām ।
joṣṭrīṃ devīṃ samudbhūtāṃ sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe tu sevikām ।। 1 ।।
vairājaḥ puruṣaḥ putraṃ brahmāṇaṃ nābhideśataḥ ।
samutpādyā''rpayantasmai joṣṭryākhyāṃ sevikāṃ tataḥ ।। 2 ।।
vairājacaraṇotpannāṃ juṣamāṇāṃ tu vedhasam ।
satyaloke sadā dāsīsamāṃ tvāvāsayaddhyajaḥ ।। 3 ।।
brahmaṇā manasā dhyātā sevikā sā punaḥ punaḥ ।
suṣuve sevikāṃ jātiṃ naikadhā svapnajātyikām ।। 4 ।।
ṛṣiṣvanaśanākhyāṃ svaputrīṃ prasūya saṃdadhe ।
pipāsākhyāṃ sutāṃ pitṛṣu prasūya ca saṃdadhe ।। 5 ।।
aśanākhyāṃ sutāṃ deveṣu ca prasūya sandadhe ।
bhūtapretapiśācādau prasūya vāsanāṃ dadhe ।। 6 ।।
bhūbhṛtsu ca karā''yāṃ saṃprasūya putrikāṃ dadhe ।
mānaveṣu vyavasāyā putrīṃ prasūya sandadhe ।। 7 ।।
dānaveṣu prasahyāṃ ca putrīṃ prasūya sandadhe ।
daityeṣu ca vilāsākhyāṃ sutāṃ prasūya sandadhe ।। 8 ।।
paśupakṣiṣu viśvāsāṃ sutāṃ prasūya sandadhe ।
vṛkṣavallīṣu tāṃ meghāṃ putrīṃ prasūya sandadhe ।। 9 ।।
kīṭapataṃgajantvādau dadhe prasūya kardamām ।
jalavāseṣu putrīṃ kuṃbhikāṃ prasūya sandadhe ।। 10 ।।
evaṃ dvādaśaputrīḥ sā samprasūya yathāprajam ।
pradadau sā prajābhyaḥ sevikā pratyekamādarāt ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ sevāparā joṣṭrī vedhasaḥ sevikā sadā ।
satyaloke vartate sma sevādharme hi nityadā ।। 1 2 ।।
yathā viprasya karmāṇi santi ṣaṭ mokṣadāni hi ।
tathā caturthavarṇasya sevā mokṣakarī matā ।। 13 ।।
yathā trāṇaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ niḥśreyakaraṃ matam।
tathā sevakavargasya sevā niḥśreyasapradā ।। 14।।
yathā dānaṃ tu vaiśyasya śreyaskṛt tūbhayatra hi ।
tathā tu sevikā vargaḥ śreyāṃsi sevayā labhet ।। 15।।
yathā dāsyāḥ sadā''jñāyāṃ vartanaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet ।
tathā sevakavargasya sevā 3 mokṣadā bhavet ।। 16।।
brahmacaryavrate śīlaṃ yathā rakṣaṇadaṃ bhavet ।
tathā sevā sevikāyāḥ sadā rakṣaṇadā bhavet ।। 17।।
yathā gārhasthyadharmasya satkāro rakṣako bhavet ।
yathā sevakavargasya sevā vai rakṣikā bhavet ।। 18।।
yathā vanasthitānāṃ vai tapaḥ sukhakaraṃ matam ।
tathā saukhyaṃ paricaryākarturbhavati sarvadā ।। 19।।
yathā tyāgavatāṃ tyāgaḥ paramānandado mataḥ ।
tathā bhāvena sevā vai sevakā''nandadāyinī ।। 20 ।।
yathā yajñastapo dhyānaṃ japo dānaṃ havādikam ।
ubhayatra sukhadaṃ sevāpi sarvatra saukhyadā ।।2 1 ।।
sevayā prāpyate svargaṃ rājyaṃ lakṣmīrdhanādikam ।
yaśaḥ kīrtistathā puṇyaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣaṇaṃ dhruvam ।।22।।
kṛṣṇasevā mātṛsevā pitṛsevā''tmasevanam ।
devasevā janasevā vṛddhasevā''rttasevanam ।।23 ।।
patisevā satīsevā patnīseveśvarārcanam ।
gobhūdharmā'nāthasevā''śritasevā prajārhaṇam ।।24।।
svāmisevā'tithisevā parātmatoṣaṇādikam ।
ihā'mutra sukhadaṃ ca puṇyadaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet ।।25 ।।
puruṣottamavṛddhyā tu kṛtaṃ mokṣakaraṃ bhavet ।
dehasevā dhanasevā pādasaṃvāhanādikam ।।26 ।।
guṇasevā vastusevā'nnasevā jalasevanam ।
gṛhasevā rugṇasevā lokasevādikaṃ tathā ।।27।।
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ brahmadṛṣṭyā sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet ।
sevādharmastato bodhyo'gamyo vai sarvadehinām ।।।28।।।
sarvamanyadbhavet sevā na bhavecchraddhayā vinā ।
vinā bhāvanayā sevā na bhaved yojitā'pi vai ।। 29।।
mokṣecchayā bhavetsevā bhavetsukhecchayā'pi vā ।
svārthecchayā'pi vā sevā bhavet phalābhikāmyayā ।। 3 0।।
niṣkāmena kṛtā yā tu koṭiguṇārthadā hi sā ।
akāmasya tu kāryasya phaladaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।3 1।।
iti vicārya sā joṣṭrī sarvalokasya sevanam ।
putrībhiḥ kārayāmāsā''ntarātmā yatra tuṣyati ।।32।।
sevayā toṣitāḥ santo dadatyāśiṣa eva ca ।
vṛddhā viprāḥ prayuñjanti samāśiṣastu sevine ।। 33।।
śarīraṃ nāśamāyāti tena sevā kṛtā pare ।
loke sahāyatāṃ yāti tasmāt sevāṃ samācaret ।।34।।
paropakāraḥ kutrāpi viphalo yāti naiva ha ।
sevāpi viphalā naiva kālāntare'pi jāyate ।।35।।
adattaṃ nopatiṣṭheta dattamevopatiṣṭhate ।
asevā nopatiṣṭheta kṛtā sevopatiṣṭhate ।।36।।
dehena manasā vācā pitaraṃ gurumacyutam ।
seveta sarvadā prāṇī phalaṃ tacchāśvataṃ bhavet ।।37।।
iti joṣṭrī sadā satye sevate parameṣṭhinam ।
putrībhiśca prajāsevāṃ karotyanudivaṃ śubhām ।।38।।
ekadā tu samājo'bhūt sudharmāyāmajagṛhe ।
ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ pitaro mānavā drumāḥ ।।39 ।।
piśācādyāstathā kandā vallayo daityadānavāḥ ।
samāyātāścaturdaśabhuvanasthāstu dehinaḥ ।।40 ।।
adṛśyāśca tathā dṛśyāḥ sastrīkā samupāyayuḥ ।
taistaiḥ samājamūrdhanyairāyayurdvādaśāpi tāḥ ।।41 ।।
sevikā dāsikārūpā joṣṭrīputryo'śanādikāḥ ।
samājāḥ sevitāstābhiryogyā yeṣāṃ kṛte tu yā ।।42।।
tāṃ tāṃ sevāṃ vidhāyaiva toṣitāḥ sarvayonayaḥ ।
tuṣṭāstābhyo daduḥ pāritoṣikāṇyāśiṣastathā ।।43।।
sarvā bhavantu sadbhāgyāḥ śāśvatānandapūritāḥ ।
dhanadhānyayaśaḥkīrtisanmānaguṇapūjitāḥ ।।44।।
siddhyaiśvaryayutā ramyarūpadhāriṇya eva ca ।
joṣṭrīvaṃśapravardhinyo mahātejodharāḥ sadā ।।45 ।।
lokaprakāśakāriṇyo devyo yadyapi sevikā ।
bhavantu sarvadā brāhmyaḥ śāśvatasthirayauvanāḥ ।।46 ।।
iti labdhāśiṣaḥ sarvāḥ samāje tu nivartite ।
svasāro dvādaśamāturjoṣṭryā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ kṣaṇam ।।47।।
tatra tāvat satyaloke dundubhiḥ śrīharermahān ।
aśrūyata vadan śabdaṃ puruṣottamadeśitam ।।48।।
atrā'dhike tu me māse dvādaśyāṃ mama pūjanam ।
vrataṃ mamaikaśaraṇaṃ kurvantu dehino yathā ।।49 ।।
bhavanmano'bhilaṣitaṃ dāsye'haṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।
mā'tra pramaditavyaṃ vai kṛcchre svalpaṃ vrataṃ bahu ।।5 0।।
bhāgyaṃ yeṣāmujjvalaṃ vai gṛhṇantu te'ti tatphalam ।
dātā'haṃ kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'smi sarvathā ।।5 1 ।।
siddhīrdāsye dhāma dāsye dāsye vai śāśvataṃ sukham ।
sarvaṃ dāsye ca māṃ dāsye na dāsye nepsitaṃ tu yat ।।5 2।।
ekabhuktena naktena phalāhāreṇa vā vratam ।
jalāhāreṇa dadhnā vā munnyannena ca bhājayā ।।5 3।।
patreṇa kandamūlaiśca vāyubhakṣeṇa vā vratam ।
mama prasādaleśena kṛtaṃ vā yadyapi vratam ।।54।।
takreṇa payasā vāpi tilaiśca māṣamuṣṭibhiḥ ।
yena kenāpi bhāvena dvādaśīvratamāhitam ।।55 ।।
tasyā'haṃ vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ pūrayiṣyāmi sarvathā ।
pūjanaṃ mama kartavyaṃ prātarmadhye niśāmukhe ।।56।।
jāgaraṃ ca prakartavyaṃ deyāni bhojanāni ca ।
dānānyapi pradeyāni yathāśakti yathārjanam ।।57।।
mahyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadyād dadyāttathā'kṣatāñjalim ।
jalāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca dadyācca bhāvanāṃjalim ।।58।।
snehāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca dadyādātmāṃjaliṃ vratī ।
pradadyātsarvataḥ śreṣṭhāṃ sarvasamarpaṇāṃjalim ।।5 9 ।।
bhāvagamyaḥ snehagamyaḥ premagamyo bhavāmyaham ।
vastugamyaḥ svārthagamyo yadvā tadvā bhavāmyaham ।।60 ।।
gamiṣyati ca dīrghāyurgamiṣyati ca yauvanam ।
yāsyanti sampado nāśaṃ matkṛpā śāśvatī matā ।।6 1 ।।
yāsyanti śīrṇatāṃ yogāḥ puṣṭiryāsyati jīrṇatām ।
varṣma yāsyati bhasmatvaṃ matkṛpā śāśvatī matā ।।62।।
utpannaṃ tadvinaṣṭaṃ syāt puṇyaṃ rājyaṃ dhanādikam ।
śāśvatī me kṛpā bodhyā yannāśo naiva vidyate ।।63।।
kṛpāṃ gṛhṇantu kṛpaṇā dūrayāntu daridratām ।
madājñayā vratenaiva śāśvatāḍhyā bhavantu vai ।।64।।
ityevaṃ dundubheḥ śabdaṃ śrutvā tā mātṛvardhitāḥ ।
vrataṃ cakrurhi payasā dvādaśyā dvādaśaiva tāḥ ।।65।।
api joṣṭrī vrataṃ cakre vāriṇā bhāvagarbhitam ।
snātvā prātaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā trayodaśa ।।66।।
svarṇamūrtiṃ vidhāyaivā'pūjayan puruṣottamam ।
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstabhaṃ hyaśokāmrāditoraṇam ।।67।।
puṣpahārāvalijuṣṭaṃ svarṇavastrādiśobhitam ।
raṃgadīpasukalaśairmaṇḍitaṃ toraṇādibhiḥ ।।68।।
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kārayitvā sumaṇḍalam ।
ramyaṃ suvarṇakalaśaṃ pañcaratnasupallavam ।।69 ।।
vastraṃ phalaṃ candanaṃ cā'kṣatān madhye nidhāya ca ।
tanmūrdhni kānakaṃ nyasya pātraṃ satilaśarkaram ।।70।।
tatra nidhāya deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ।
vai ṣoḍaśapadārthaiśca pūjayāmāsurādarāt ।।71।।
āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtaiśca vāribhiḥ ।
saṃsnāpya mārjanaṃ kṛtvā'mbarāṇyābhūṣaṇāni ca ।।72।।
kuṃkumaiḥ kajjalairgandhasārairakṣatacandanaiḥ ।
śṛṃgārayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ vidhāya ca ।।73।।
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ pūrikādikam ।
phalaṃ tvāmrādikaṃ pānaṃ cāmṛtaṃ madhuraṃ jalam ।।74।।
tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ cānyad yadyattvapekṣitaṃ prabhoḥ ।
tattatsarvaṃ pradāyaivā''rārtrikaṃ dadhire ca tāḥ ।।75।।
daṇḍavat namanaṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ sumā'ñjalim ।
aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ cāntimārghyaṃ daduḥ prage ।।76।।
madhyāhne'pi tathā cakruḥ sevanaṃ niśi cāpi tāḥ ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cakrurnartanaṃ gāyanādibhiḥ ।।77।।
dvādaśaiva ca tāḥ kanyā hāvabhāvasamanvitam ।
yathā kṛṣṇaharirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।78।।
śṛṃgārarasabhāvena prasannaḥ syātpumuttamaḥ ।
ākṛṣṭaḥ san dayāluḥ sa darśanaṃ ca dadedyathā ।।79।।
tathā tābhirmahāharṣaiḥ kṛtaṃ nartanagāyanam ।
prātarharirbrāhmakāle prādurbabhūva saṃhasan ।।80।।
yuvā puṣṭaḥ surūpaśca yuvatīmānasāśrayaḥ ।
koṭikāmātisaundaryo vīryasaṃbhṛtagātrakaḥ ।।8 1।।
pratiromarativyāptaḥ pratyaṃgānaṃgabhāsitaḥ ।
prasanno'smi prasanno'smi sevayā saṃvadan muhuḥ ।।82।।
sevikā varadānāni vṛṇuteṣṭāni sarvathā ।
indrāṇītvaṃ śivātvaṃ vā brahmāṇītvaṃ tato'pi ca ।।83।।
kṛṣṇātvaṃ vaiṣṇavītvaṃ ca brāhmītvaṃ tatparaṃ ca vā ।
yadyadicchā bhavet tattad dadāmyadya na saṃśayaḥ ।।84।।
dvādaśātmabhavatībhirjitā lokāḥ parātparāḥ ।
sevayā śraddhayā bhāvanayā snehārdrayā'ṅganāḥ ।।85।।
dāsyo'pi yūyamevā'dyā'dāsyo jātā hi sevayā ।
mānasasthaṃ vṛṇutā'dya mā ciraṃ hṛdayaṃgamāḥ ।।86।।
sevikānāṃ sevako'haṃ śāstrīṇāṃ śāsako'smyaham ।
mitrāṇīnāmahaṃ mitraṃ vāmānāṃ dakṣiṇo'smyaham ।।87।।
snigdhānāṃ snehilaścāsmi śaraṇyānāṃ tu rakṣakaḥ ।
madarthatyaktasarvasvānāṃ tu sarvasvado'smyaham ।।88।।
tathā na toṣamāpnomi dhanairbhṛtyaiśca sevayā ।
yathā santoṣamāpnomi svenaiva kṛtasevayā ।।89।।
sevako'hamahaṃ svāmī yatra sevā na bhidyate ।
yatra bhaktaḥ svayaṃ māṃ vai svayaṃ bhāvena sevate ।।90।।
tasmāt priyāḥ pravadantu kiṃ dadāmi vadāmi kim ।
priyābhyaḥ kiṃ prayacchāmi sarvasvaṃ hṛdayānvitam ।।91।।
priyāḥ prāhurvayaṃ sarvā arpitāḥ paramātmani ।
sarvakānte pare kānte patyau śrīpuruṣottame ।।92।।
dāsīnāṃ tu tathā dharmaḥ sarvārpaṇaṃ tu śāstari ।
priyāṇāṃ tu tathā dharmaḥ kānte sarvārpaṇaṃ priye ।।93।।
svāminaśca tathā dharmo'rpitānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sadā ।
kāntapriyasya dharmo vai kāntānāṃ priyakāritā ।।94।।
priyā priyasya sarvasvaṃ priyaḥ sarvaṃ priyākṛte ।
priyāyāścāpi sarvasvaṃ priya eva dayānidhiḥ ।।95।।
iti cātra mahatyarthe yatheṣṭaṃ kuru keśava ।
mānasaṃ tvayi sarvasvaṃ cārpitaṃ kuru yanmatam ।।96।।
śrutvā prāha tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhūttamaḥ ।
sarvaṃ vedmi tathā sarvāḥ svīkaromi hṛdantare ।।97।।
bāhyato'pi karāndhṛtvā karomi hṛdayaṃgamāḥ ।
bhavantu matkarasparśād divyarūpadharā mama ।।98।।
priyāḥ patnyo bhavantvakṣarākhye dhāmani sarvadā ।
joṣṭrī mama svarūpe'stu tejomayī tu śaktikā ।।99।।
sarvānandapradā devī cinmayī matsvarūpiṇī ।
saccidānandarūpe me cinmayī sā mayā kṛtā ।। 10 0।।
anyāśca dvādaśapatnyaḥ santu śāśvatikā mama ।
tattannāmnā tu tāḥ patnyastatra vasantu madgṛhe ।। 101 ।।
matsamākṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ patnyastā arthato yathā ।
māṃ vinā'nyasukhāderyā'śanaṃ naiva karoti hi ।। 102।।
iti sārthā'naśanākhyā, pipāsāṃ tvarthataḥ śṛṇu ।
madrasaṃ sarvadā pātumicchati nānyameva yā ।। 103।।
sā pipāsā mayā patnī rakṣitā matsvarūpiṇī ।
athā'śanā mama patnī yā samaśnāti māṃ sadā ।। 104।।
sarvān kāmānaśnute sā brahmaṇā viduṣā saha ।
iti sārthā'śanākhyā sā patnī me rakṣitā mayā ।। 1 05।।
yā ca svātmani nityaṃ māṃ paraṃ vāsayate patim ।
sā mayā bhāvapūrṇā vāsanā patnī surakṣitā ।। 106 ।।
yasyā nāmā'tra vaktavyaṃ bhāvanā bhāvitā mayā ।
āyāti matkaraṃ dhṛtvā karāyā me priyā hi sā ।। 1 07।।
kaṃ sukhaṃ matparānandaṃ śaṃ lakṣmīṃ divyasaṃpadam ।
sevayā yāti gṛhṇāti matto yā sā karāyikā ।। 1 08।।
madarthameva sarvasvaṃ kṛtaṃ kriyātmakaṃ yayā ।
iti niścayasārthakyā vyavasāyā priyā mama ।। 1 09।।
soḍhuṃ yogyā mama sarvā kriyā''jñā sā priyā mama ।
prakarṣeṇa sahate yā madratiṃ sā prasahyakā ।। 110 ।।
madarthe sarvathā divyā vilasyati madarthikā ।
vilāsākhyā mama patnī me'nuvilāsakāriṇī ।। 11 1।।
yasyāḥ śvāso vinā māṃ tu sthātuṃ śakto bhavennahi ।
yasyā hyahaṃ ca me sā'sti patirme'sti sukhāya vai ।। 1 12।।
iti viśvāsamāpannā viśvāsā sā mama priyā ।
māṃ vinā jīvanaṃ śvāso nāsti yasyāḥ pratikṣaṇam ।। 11 3।।
mehati varṣate patyau prema varṣayati prabhau ।
mayi snehaṃ karotyeva meghā sā matpriyā matā ।। 1 14।।
sarvaṃ karmaṃ mayi yā svāṃ damayatibhāvataḥ ।
madarthaṃ damanaṃ yasyāḥ karmaṇāṃ kardamā priyā ।। 1 15।।
kuṃ kṣetraṃ svātmakaṃ yā bhāvayati matkṛte'nvaham ।
kuṃbhe jalaṃ yathā tadvanmāṃ bibharti nijātmani ।। 116 ।।
sā patnī kuṃbhikā me'sti yūyaṃ patnyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।
divyā yāstā dvādaśaivā'kṣare dhāmni vasantu me ।। 1 17।।
athā'nyaistu svarūpairdvādaśaśaktyātmikāstu vai ।
vartantāmanyarūpiṇyo mahākālāya cārpitā ।। 1 18।।
tato viśvaṃ saṃvyakrāmat sāśanā'naśane hyabhi ।
pipāsayā pravāhastu dhāvatyagre'sya saṃsṛteḥ ।। 1 19।।
vāsanayā vasatyetajjaḍacetanamiśritam ।
karāyayā bhavatyatra vinimayastu dehinoḥ ।। 12 0।।
dhāryate puṣyate kālavāhayā vyavasāyayā ।
prasahyayā kṣamate tvārtavān dvandvāँśca vatsaraḥ ।। 121 ।।
vilāsayā śramaṃ hāpayitvā jīvān yunakti saḥ ।
viśvāsayā phale lobhātpravartante tu dehinaḥ ।। 122।।
meghayā snehavṛṣṭyā vai rañjayanti prajāḥ samāḥ ।
kardamayā prajā bhūtā mayi tiṣṭhanti kardame ।। 123 ।।
kuṃbheṣvatra golakeṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarvathā ।
tattatsthāne sthāpayitrī kuṃbhikā rakṣikā matā ।। 1 24।।
evaṃ kālasya macchaktibhūtasya śaktayo'nvaham ।
bhavantu kāryakāriṇyo loke kālāya cārpitāḥ ।। 1 25।।
atha yatra joṣṭrikāyāḥ putryaḥ santyuṣitā yathā ।
tāstathaiva tu vedhaḥ kṛdbrahmāṇḍe'pi vasantviti ।। 126 ।।
vasantu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama vācchayā ।
tṛtīyaistu svarūpaiḥ svairjyoṣṭrījananya eva ha ।। 1 27।।
evaṃ trividharūpairvai mayā samyaṅniyojitāḥ ।
kurvantu dāsyamevā'tra mahākāle tathā mayi ।। 128।।।
bhavatīnāmahaṃ svāmī patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
ramantāṃ tu mayā sārdhaṃ svatantrā akṣare pare ।। 129।।
tathā'nyā macchaktirūpamahākālasahāyikāḥ ।
tathā'parā mama sṛṣṭau tattatkāryavahāḥ sadā ।। 130।।
iti tredhā mayā dattaṃ bhavatībhyaḥ prasevanam ।
dvādaśyāstu vratasyaiva phalaṃ dattaṃ hi śāśvatam ।। 13 1।।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।
divyāstāḥ saha nītvaiva vyavasthāpya tathā'parāḥ ।। 1 32।।
mahākālāya datvā'nyā yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ hariḥ ।
vada lakṣmi! kṛpāpārāvāraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।। 133।।
kiṃ kiṃ dadāti kṛpayā svalpasyā'nantakaṃ phalam ।
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ joṣṭrīdevyāḥ kathānakam ।। 134।।
devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī devamindraṃ vayodhasam ।
prāpyā'vardhata bṛhatī brāhmyāsa puruṣottamam ।। 1 35।।
ya idaṃ śrāvayeccāpi śṛṇuyādvā paṭhecca vā ।
tasyāpi tādṛśaṃ syācca phalaṃ vratasya niścitam ।। 136।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vairājaputryā joṣṭryā anaśanādi- dvādaśaputrīṇāṃ sevayā dvādaśyāvratena ca prasannasya puruṣottamanārāyaṇasya prāptistredhārūpadhāraṇādika cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaviṃśādhikatriśata-tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1.319 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 319 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 320
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 321 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! rādhikāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā putrīmatīṃ varām ।
śrīrapi prāha deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram ।। 1 ।।
kānta rādhā yathā putrīmatī saṃśobhate hare ।
mānyatā yāti sarvāsu putrīmatīṣu sarvathā ।। 2 ।।
yathā tathā kadā putrīmatī syāṃ puruṣottama ।
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā tu mahyaṃ vai dehi putrīṃ śubhāśrayām ।। 3 ।।
evaṃ tayā'rthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaṃ tadā ।
tathāstviti varaṃ datvā reme tayā sulīlayā ।। 4 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇasyekṣaṇādeva śriyaḥ paryaṃkaśobhanā ।
divyā kṛṣṇasamā rūpe saundarye śrīsamā sutā ।। 5 ।।
prādurbabhūva sahasā jātamātrā suyauvanā ।
kāmadugheva sampannā sudughā nāmataḥ kṛtā ।। 6 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇena śriyā cāpyāhūtā sā sudugheti vai ।
pradogdhi sarvakāmān sā sudughā kṛṣṇakanyakā ।। 7 ।।
śrītulyā śrīsvarūpā ca śrīrivā'tisamujjvalā ।
sarvāvayavapuṣṭā ca kānakīṃ chavimāśritā ।। 8 ।।
jātamātrā nisargāt sā gavāṃ dohanakarmaṇi ।
vyavasāyamayī rucyā dṛśyate gopriyā tathā ।। 9 ।।
sā tu jātā yadā tatra mahotsavo'pyabhūnmahān ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya śriyā vāse'vatārarṣisurakṛtaḥ ।। 10 ।।
devīnāṃ nartanaṃ cā'psarasāṃ gītaṃ sunartanam ।
gandharvāṇāṃ gāyanaṃ vādanaṃ cābhavanmahotsave ।। 11 ।।
munīnāmāśiṣāmāptirabhūt kanyāsurakṣikā ।
gopagopīgaṇānāṃ ca vāṇyo hyāsan suvardhikāḥ ।। 12 ।।
tathāṃjalikusumāni nipetuḥ sudughopari ।
dugdhavatkāntinivahāṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ tu kanyakāḥ ।। 13 ।।
vayasyā jahṛṣuścāti remire ca tayā muhuḥ ।
rāmayanti ramante ca viharanti tayā tu tāḥ ।। 14।।
atha jijñāsamānā sā dughā kāryaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।
mayā kimatra kartavyaṃ mīmāṃsate hi bhāvataḥ ।। 15।।
pitrā kṛṣṇena cādiṣṭaṃ jñātvā yogabalaṃ tathā ।
ūrjāhuti! dughe! putri! payasendramavardhatām ।। 16 ।।
ityājñaptā'tisaṃhṛṣṭā sudughā pitarau tadā ।
praṇamyendrasya vṛddhyarthaṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ samacintayat ।। 17।।
yatra yatra ca goleṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca yādṛśam ।
māhendraṃ tu padaṃ devasāmrājyaṃ vartate divi ।। 18 ।।
tāni sarvāṇi rājyāni dhyātvā hṛdā padāni ca ।
teṣāṃ śāśvatapuṣṭyarthaṃ cintayāmāsa sādhanam ।। 19 ।।
śrīputrī sudughā cāhaṃ dugdharūpā bhavāmi ca ।
divi dugdhāmṛtaṃ datvā surebhyo nivasāmi ca ।। 20 ।।
maharādau sukṛtātmā'mṛtaṃ bhūtvā vasāmi ca ।
pitṛbhyo vāripiṇḍādi pāyasādi dadāmi ca ।। 21 ।।
paśumānuṣavṛkṣebhyo dugdhāmṛtaṃ rasātmakam ।
datvā puṣṭiṃ kārayāmi bhuve'pi surasāmṛtam ।। 22 ।।
jale snehāmṛtaṃ kṛtvā pravidadhāmi poṣaṇam ।
vahnaye pākamādhuryaṃ dadāmi pācanāmṛtam ।। 2 3 ।।
ātmane dehavāsāya dadāmi viṣayāmṛtam ।
indra ātmendriyāṇyasya śaktayo viṣayāśrayāḥ ।। 24।।।
tābhiramṛtabhoktāro bhavantyātmani eva hi ।
tattvagaṃ navanītaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ sarvakṛte'mṛtam ।।25 ।।
evaṃ bahusvarūpā'haṃ kāryātmikā bhavāmi ca ।
indrasya saukhyalābhāya dughā śaktirvasāmi ca ।। 26।।
yajñe ūrjāhutī cāhaṃ bhūtvā puṣṭiṃ karomi ca ।
indrasya sarvathā rakṣā yathā syāttādṛśī tathā ।।27।।
bhūtvā bhūtvaiva sarvatrādyaiva kuryāṃ praveśanam ।
iti vicārya sā kanyā sudughā bahurūpiṇī ।।28।।
babhūva dṛśyā cā'dṛśyā praviveśa yathāmatam ।
indrasya ruciraṃ svargaṃ tataḥ smṛddhyā vyavardhata ।।29 ।।
sarvā'mṛtāni dugdhāni vyavardhantā'tivegataḥ ।
lokeṣu śrīmayī bhūmiḥ sampadāsīnmanoramā ।। 3 0।।
devā devyo vyarājanta pūrvato'pyadhikā'dhikam ।
vyayamānā bhujyamānā api sarvāḥ susampadaḥ ।।3 1।।
na viyanti manāṅ nāpi kṣīyante sudughā'nvayāt ।
adṛṣṭā cā'śrutā sampad babhūvā''nandasammukhā ।।3 2।।
evaṃ yāte śubhe kāle yāte cādye kṛte yuge ।
ṛṣirmānyo'bhavannāmnā medhāvī yājñiko mahān ।।3 3 ।।
yajñān karoti vidhibhiḥ kārayatyapi vṛṣṭaye ।
putrādyarthaṃ sukhādyartha svargārthaṃ sukṛtāptaye ।।34।।
putraputrīyugalārthaṃ putreṣṭiṃ sa cakāra vai ।
viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bahvāvirbabhūva ha ।।35 ।।
jagrāha svakarābhyāṃ supuroḍāśaṃ tadarpitam ।
uvāca ca prasanno'smi varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ।। 36 ।।
pṛthvīṃ rājyaṃ rasān miṣṭaṃ dugdhaṃ svargaṃ sutaṃ sutām ।
yathecchasi tathā tubhyaṃ dadāmi kuru mā ciram ।।37।।
śrutvā viprastu medhāvī prāha putraṃ pradehi me ।
yajñaḥ putreṣṭināmā'sau putrārthaṃ vartito mayā ।।38।।
bhagavān prāha putraste saptajanmasu nāsti vai ।
putreṣṭyā jāyate putraścirāyuṣṭre tu saṃśayaḥ ।।।3 9।।
janmanā yastu sukhado'nantaraṃ duḥkhado mṛteḥ ।
tasmād vipra vṛṇu putrīṃ yadi cet te prarocate ।। 40 ।।
tava patnyā bhālarekhā putryarthā bhāti cānagha ।
putrādapyadhikā kīrtau sevāyāṃ sā bhaviṣyati ।।4 1 ।।
yayā śoko na vai syācca tathā kuru mahīsura ।
patnīmataṃ samādāya vipro jagrāha tadvacaḥ ।।42।।
tato bhagavatā dattaḥ prasādo bhojanāya vai ।
gṛhītvā''ha hariṃ vipraḥ putrī śrīsadṛśī mama ।।43।।
sukhadā nātha! bhavatu śāntā kāmadugheva sā ।
yā śaktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sudhāpānapradāyinī ।।44।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha prairayacchrīsutāṃ dughām ।
medhāvinastu putryarthaṃ sudughāpi tadājñayā ।।45।।
prāvirbabhūva medhāvibhāryāyāḥ śayane tadā ।
mānasī sā'bhavad divyā śobhate śrīrivā'parā ।।46।।
jātamātrātisaṃśobhiyauvanā puṣṭisaṃbhṛtā ।
rūpalāvaṇyalalitā nayanā'pāṃgamocinī ।।47।।
cāturyādiguṇopetā pitrorekaiva śaṃsthalī ।
ati vai vallabhā pitroḥ sarvasadguṇasundarī ।।48।।
lālitā putravannityaṃ nopālabdhā kadāpi tu ।
nītisāhityakuśalā cātmatattvaviśāradā ।।49।।
sevikā sarvadā pitroḥ sevayā tuṣyataśca tau ।
kālena gacchatā lakṣmi! tanmātā nidhanaṃ gatā ।।50।।
pitrā sā pālitā harṣāt putrasthānāṃ kumārikām ।
sāpi kāle gate cāsīd yoginīva tathāpi tu ।।5 1 ।।
pārśvasthā''lisukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā putrapautrasukhaspṛhā ।
medhāvatī kumārī sā gārhasthyārthamanorathā ।।52।।
tarkayati ca māmeva sukhaṃ bhāgya kathaṃ bhavet ।
guṇabhāgyodayo bhartā sukhadāśca sutāḥ katham ।।53 ।।
tadarthaṃ kaṃ muniṃ yadvā kamupāsye sureśvaram ।
yuvatyahaṃ sakhīmadhye kumārī duḥkhavedinī ।।54।।
nā'haṃ svāmisukhā'bhijñā yathā mama sakhīgaṇaḥ ।
evaṃ cintākulāṃ bālāṃ vijñāyā'pi ca tatpitā ।।5 5 ।।
medhāvī vicacārorvyāṃ vicinvan tatsamaṃ varam ।
aprāpya bhagnasaṃkalpo jvaraṃ tīvramavāpa saḥ ।।5 6 ।।
āgacchanneva bhavanaṃ harau cittamadhārayat ।
sasmāra śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ।।57।।
gṛhāṃgaṇe papātāsau kṛṣṇadūtāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
kare dhṛtvā muniṃ taṃ te yayuḥ kṛṣṇasaroruham ।।58।।
prāṇotkramaṇamālokya hāheti sā sutā'rudat ।
aṃke kṛtvā piturdehaṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitā ।।5 9 ।।
hā hā pitaḥ kathaṃ mātṛhīnāṃ tyaktvā nijāṃ sutām ।
pitṛhīnāṃ tathā kṛtvā hyanāthāṃ kva gato'si vai ।।6 0 ।।
na bhrātā naiva bandhuśca na mātā na ca rakṣakaḥ ।
kathaṃ tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ tāta! mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
ityādirodanaṃ śrutvā tāpasāstatra cāyayuḥ ।
mṛtaṃ muniṃ dadṛśuste saśokā dadahustataḥ ।।62।।
samāśvāsya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ sarve te svālayān yayuḥ।
kanyā dhairyaṃ samālambyā'karocchaktyaurdhvadaihikam ।।63।।
gate kāle bhāgyavaśād durvāsāḥ śāṃkaro muniḥ ।
samāyāttadgṛhaṃ lakṣmi! bhaviṣyadbalanoditaḥ ।।64।।
tamālokya samāyāntaṃ kumārī caraṇau muneḥ ।
vavandā'rghyādibhiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayāmāsa sādaram ।।65।।
namaste'stvatriputrāya kuto'dhigamanaṃ mune ।
mama bhāgyodayo jāto bhavattīrthaniṣevayā ।।66।।
adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ tvadya me vratam ।
adya me phalavatpuṇyaṃ yad bhavādṛśadarśanam ।।67।।
śrutvā''ha tāṃ tu durvāsāḥ sādhu svasti sute! tava ।
kailāsādahamāgacchaṃ gacchāmi badarīvanam ।।68।।
draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tvayā'rthaścennivedyatām ।
medhāvatī ṛṣiṃ prāha nā'nāvedyaṃ prabhormanāk ।।69।।
ataḥ paraṃ śubhaṃ bhāvi tvaddarśanādanugrahāt ।
na mātā na pitā bandhurna kaścid rakṣako'sti me ।।70।।
na māṃ kāmayate kaścit pāṇigrahaṇahetave ।
brahman mumūrṣurasmyeva kiṃ karomi hitaṃ kuru ।।7 1।।
śrutvā munirupāyaṃ suvircāyā'kathayat sutām ।
itastṛtīyaḥ subhage māsastu puruṣottamaḥ ।।72।।
tatra snātā janastīrthe mucyate brahmahatyayā ।
etattulyo na ko'pyanyo māsottamo hi vidyate ।।73।।
sarve māsāstathā pakṣāḥ parvāṇi ṛtavastathā ।
puruṣottamamāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।74।।
sādhanāni samastāni gaṃgā godā''plavāni ca ।
sahasrāṇyadhimāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।75।।
śrīkṛṣṇavallabho māso nāmnā ca puruṣottamaḥ ।
tasmin saṃsevite bāle! sarvaṃ siddhyati vāñcchitam ।।76।।
tasmānniṣevayā''śu tvaṃ māsaṃ taṃ puruṣottamam ।
mayā'pi sevate putri! puruṣottamavat sadā ।।77।।
yadi cediṣṭamāptavyaṃ yathāruci kuru vratam ।
ahaṃ putri! gamiṣyāmi naranārāyaṇālayam ।।78।।
ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ hyatha medhāvatī tataḥ ।
adhimāsapratīkṣāḍhyā tatkālaphaladaṃ śivam ।।79।।
citte dhṛtvā tamuddiśya cacāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ ।
divā paṃcāgnimadhyasthā rātrau śītajalasthitā ।।80।।
anāhārā haradhyānā samādhāviva tiṣṭhati ।
santuṣṭastapasā tasyā bhagavānpārvatīpatiḥ ।।8 1।।
darśayāmāsa bālāyai svaṃ rūpaṃ cākṣigocaram ।
sā vavande haraṃ puṣpādibhiḥ pupūja mānasaiḥ ।।8 2।।
tuṣṭāva bhaktibhāvena hyāśutoṣāya te namaḥ ।
anādhārasutā''dhāraśaṃkarāya ca te namaḥ ।।8 3 ।।
namaḥ sūryāgnisomatrinetrāya mṛtyave namaḥ ।
pārvatītāpasīvāñcchāpūrakāyeha te namaḥ ।।84।।
kumāryāścāpyanāthāyā uddhāraṃ kuru śaṃkara ।
iti stutvā punarnatvā virarāmarṣiputrikā ।।85 ।।
śrutvā prasannavadanastāmuvāca sadāśivaḥ ।
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te prasanno'smi dadāmi te ।।86।।
bālovāca dayāsindho prasannaścenmamopari ।
patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ patim ।।87।।
ityāśrutya mahādevo jagādarṣisutāṃ tadā ।
pañcakṛtvastvayā yasmāt prārthitaḥ patirīśvarāt ।।88 ।।
tasmāt paṃca bhaviṣyanti patayastava dhārmikāḥ ।
yajvānaḥ satyasandhāśca rājanyāstvanmayāḥ sute ।।8 9।।
idānīṃ paṃcasaṃkhyākā indrāḥ prākkalpasaṃbhavāḥ ।
vasanti satyaloke te bhavantu patayaḥ sute ।। 9 0।।
anenaiva hi dehena divyatāṃ prāpitena vai ।
mayā sāhāyyadenā'dyā''gaccha satye tadantikam ।। 91 ।।
ityuktvā śaṃkarastāṃ sudivyadehāṃ vidhāya ca ।
nināya satyalokaṃ vai mārge medhāvatīṃ divi ।। 92।।
śuśrāva dundubhiṃ divyaṃ kurvantu vratamuttamam ।
trayodaśyadhimāsasya yatheṣṭaphaladā bhavet ।। 93 ।।
patiprāptirmama prāptirbhavedekavratena vai ।
śrutvā medhāvatī prāha kṛṣṇaprāptiḥ kathaṃ bhavet ।। 94।।
śrutvā tu dundubhiṃ cainaṃ jijñāsā jāyate mama ।
tathā kuru yathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo milenmama ।। 95 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha śubhe putri! kalyāṇaṃ te'stu sarvathā ।
prasanno'smi tava vākyāt kṛṣṇaprāptiparāyaṇāt ।। 96 ।।
rājyaṃ svargaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ caiśvaraṃ padameva vā ।
sarvaṃ bhavati nissvādaṃ vinā kṛṣṇaṃ pumuttamam ।। 97 ।।
bhaktyā sa labhyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ pumān ।
kuru vrataṃ trayodaśyā yathādundubhibhāṣitam ।। 98 । ।
upavāsaṃ phalāhāraṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।
pūjayetparamātmānaṃ bhojayellālayettathā । । 99 । ।
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ dadet pratoṣitaḥ ।
ityuktvā tāṃ satyalokaṃ gamayitvendrapañcakam । । 100 । ।
datvā patnīsvarūpeṇa punaḥ prāha sutāṃ haraḥ ।
puruṣottamamāsasya trayodaśyā vratena vai । । 10 1 । ।
miliṣyati haristvāṃ vai mānuṣe kṛtavigrahe ।
ayonisaṃbhavā tatra bhaviṣyasi tapobalāt । । 10 2। ।
tatraite pañcabhartāro bhaviṣyanti surāṃśajāḥ ।
dharmamarunmahendrāśvinīkumārāṃśasabhavāḥ । । 103 । ।
śrīpatistu tadā kṛṣṇo miliṣyati ca rakṣakaḥ ।
bhartṛjaṃ sukhamāsādya tato gantrī paraṃ padam । । 1 04। ।
puruṣottamabhaktāstu putrāpautradhanānvitāḥ ।
aihikā''muṣmikīṃ siddhiṃ yātā yāsyanti yānti ca । । 105 ।।
vayaṃ sarve'pi netāraḥ puruṣottamasevinaḥ ।
vadannevaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kṣipramantardadhe haraḥ ।। 106 ।।
medhāvatyā patīn pṛṣṭvā śaṃkarasyopadeśanāt ।
trayodaśyā vrataṃ sopavāsaṃ sajāgaraṃ kṛtam ।। 1 07।।
pañcāmṛtairjalaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsnāpya puruṣottamam ।
vastrālaṃkāranaivedyaphalatāmbūlakādikam ।। 108 ।।
dhūpadīpasupuṣpādyakṣatāṃjali kṣamārthanam ।
ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā yayāce parameśvarāt ।। 10 9।।
darśanaṃ dehi me tāta! bhave sāhāyyado bhava ।
tāvattatra samāyāto garuḍasthaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ ।। 110 ।।
prāhā'smi te sute tuṣṭastrayodaśyā vratena vai ।
rakṣayiṣye sadā putri! saha sthāsye yathā'vanam ।। 111 ।।
punaḥ provāca sā putrī mokṣo me syād yathā guro ।
tathā'nte me bhavettāta! nānyaṃ kāṃkṣe manoratham ।। 11 2।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha prāha cāpi viśeṣataḥ ।
śṛṇu putri dvāparānte kṛṣṇo'haṃ bhagavān svayam ।। 113 ।।
bhūbhāraharaṇārthāyā'vatariṣyāmi vai kṣitau ।
yajñasenākhyanṛpateryajñakuṇḍasya madhyataḥ ।। 1 14।।
bhaviṣyasi tvamudbhūtā kumārī kanakaprabhā ।
yājñasenī ca vairājī kṛṣṇā khyātā bhaviṣyasi ।। 11 5।।
tatraiva ca same kāle pañcendrāḥ svāminastava ।
bhaviṣyanti surāṃśāste patayo'mitavikramāḥ ।। 1 1 6।।
taddvārā tvanmiṣaṃ kṛtvā'surāndaityāँśca dānavān ।
nāśayitvā svakaṃ dhāma yadā yāsye tadā sute! ।। 11 7।।
nayiṣye tvāṃ yathākālaṃ yathākāryaṃ niruddhya ca ।
punastvaṃ prāpsyase dhāma golokaṃ yatra te januḥ ।। 1 18।।
tadā tvāṃ sudughe putri! tanvā brāhmyā'kṣare pare ।
dhāmni saṃprāpayiṣye maccaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ sukham ।। 11 9।।
iti te kathitaṃ putri! bhaviṣyatte kathānakam ।
satye sukhaṃ vasa putri! yāmyahaṃ ca mamālayam ।। 1 20।।
ityuktvā'dṛśyatāṃ yātastadā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
sudughā kṛṣṇaputrī sā yājñasenī bhaviṣyati ।। 12 1।।
adhimāsaparapakṣatrayodaśyā vratena sā ।
prāpsyatīyaṃ paraṃ dhāma puruṣottamavākyataḥ ।। 122।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! śrīputryāstu kathānakam ।
te dhanyā janmavantaśca te pūjyāḥ pāvanāstathā ।। 1 23।।
vividhairniyamairyaistu pūjitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi vratasyā'tra phalaṃ labhet ।। 124।।
labhate kṛṣṇasāhāyyaṃ puruṣottamasammatam ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi naro nārī paro'pi vā ।। 1 25।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye goloke śrīputryāḥ sudughāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñayā indravṛddhyarthaṃ pravṛttāyā rasā'mṛtātmakatā, yājñikasya medhāviviprasya gṛhe'yonijāyāstasyā janma, pitrormaraṇaṃ, durvāsasa āgamanaṃ, puruṣottamamāsavratopadeśaḥ, śaṃkaropari tapaḥ, pañcakṛtvaḥ patiprārthanam, satyaloke pañcendrapatiprāptiḥ, trayodaśīvratena puruṣottamadarśanaṃ, bhuvi pañcapatimatī yājñasenī bhūtvā mokṣaṃ yāsyasītivaradānaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhika-triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।1.320 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 320 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 321
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 322 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! caturdaśyā vratena nṛpasattamaḥ ।
citradharmasya satputro dṛḍhadhanveti viśrutaḥ ॥ 1 ॥
prāpad rājyaṃ putrapautrān lalanāṃ ca pativratām ।
ante ca bhagavallokamavāpa yogidurlabham ॥ 2 ॥
sarvasadguṇasampanno dṛṣṭavān vedapāragaḥ ।
prajārakṣākaraḥ putro babhūveti ca tatpitā ॥ 3 ॥
vicārya citradharmā taṃ svarājye tvabhyaṣecayat ।
atha cārādhayāmīśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ॥ 4 ॥
tadarthaṃ vanabhūmirvai yogyā bhavati sarvathā ।
dhruvāmbarīṣaśaryātiyayātiśaśabindavaḥ ॥ 5 ॥
bhagīratha śibi rantideva rukmāṃgadādayaḥ ।
divodāsā'bhayakhaṭvāṃgadarājarṣisattamāḥ ॥ 6 ॥
ete cānye ca kalpeṣu kalpāntareṣu bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
vanaṃ yayurmahāsattvāstyaktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ ॥ 7 ॥
adhruveṇa dhruvaṃ prāptā ārādhya puruṣottamam ।
ato mayā'pi kartavyamaraṇye harisevanam ॥ 8 ॥
chitvā pāśaṃ vāsanākhyaṃ dārāputragṛhādiṣu ।
iti niścitya manasā citradharmā yayau vanam ॥ 9 ॥
pulahāśramamāsādya tapastepe hariṃ smaran ।
śuddho bhūtvā divyatanurharerdhāma jagāma saḥ ॥ 10 ॥
dṛḍhadhanvā pituścaurdhvadaihikaṃ cākarottataḥ ।
puṣkarāvartanagare rājadhānīṃ vidhāya saḥ ॥ 11 ॥
bhāryayā guṇasundaryā vaidarbhyā saha bhūpatiḥ ।
śaśāsa sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ caturbhistanayaiḥ saha ॥ 1 2॥
citravākcitravāṭcitrakuṇḍalamaṇikuṇḍalaiḥ ।
ekadā niśi suptasya cintā''sīd dṛḍhadhanvanaḥ ॥ 13 ॥
dānaṃ tapo japaṃ homaṃ nā'haṃ vai kṛtavān kvacit ।
tathāpi vaibhavā rājyaṃ kena bhāgyena me nanu ॥ 14॥
brāhme muhūrte utthāya sa rājā mṛgayāmanāḥ ।
jagāmā'śvaṃ samāruhyā'raṇye vai sarasastaṭam ॥ 15॥
samāgamadvaṭe tatra kaścinmānuṣavāk śukaḥ ।
sa tu papāṭha suślokamekameva punaḥ punaḥ ॥ 16 ॥
‘satyapi vaibhave rājye dehādau sukhade tathā ।
na cintayasi lakṣmīśaṃ kathaṃ pāraṃ sameṣyasi' ॥ 17॥
śrutvā rājā kīravākyaṃ mumude bhavatārakam ।
kṛtvā tu mṛgayāṃ rājā kīravākyaṃ vicārayan ॥ 18 ॥
ājagāma gṛhaṃ tāvat tatra vālmīkirāyayau ।
rājā prapūjya vālmīkiṃ papraccha kīrabhāṣitam ॥ 19 ॥
kimuvāca kathaṃ prāha ko'sāvāsīcchuko mune! ।
śrutvā kṣaṇaṃ ca taddhyātvā vālmīkirāha bhūpatim ॥ 20 ॥
śṛṇu rājaँstava pūrvajanmanaścaritaṃ yathā ।
tāmraparṇītaṭe deśe draviḍe tvaṃ dvijo'bhavaḥ ॥ 21 ॥
sudevākhyaśca te patnīṃ gautamī gautamodbhavā ।
aprajā sā patiṃ prāhā'patyaṃ vinā suduḥkhitā ॥ 22 ॥
santatiḥ śuddhavaṃśyā syādatra paratra śarmaṇe ।
tamaprāpya varaṃ putraṃ jīvitaṃ tvatra niṣphalam ॥ 23 ॥
tasmātsatputralābhārthamāvābhyāṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
ārādhanīyaḥ satataṃ tapasā puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 24॥
dharmapatnyā vaco matvā tāmraparṇītaṭe śubhe ।
śuṣkaparṇajalāhārau paṃcame paṃcame dine ॥ 25 ॥
catvāryabdasahasrāṇi ceratuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
lokāścakampire tena prādurbabhūva mādhavaḥ ॥26 ॥
garuḍastho hariḥ prāha sudeva! bhadramastu te ।
gautami! śrīrastu te'pi kurutaṃ mā tapo bahu ॥27॥
śrutvā tau nematuḥ kṛṣṇamūcaturjaya mādhava! ।
sudevaḥ prāha bhagavan! putraṃ dehi hare prabho! ॥28॥
hariḥ prāha lalāṭe te varṇāḥ sarve mayekṣitāḥ ।
tatra naivā'sti te putrasukhaṃ saptasu janmasu ॥29॥
gautamyuvāca bhāgyāgre ramānātho nirarthakaḥ ।
daivamālaṃbanīyaṃ cet! hariṇā kiṃ prayojanam ॥3 0॥
śrutvā hariṃ garuḍastu prāha kṛṣṇaṃ janārdanam ।
bhaktaduḥkhā'sahiṣṇo! tvaṃ haryarthaṃ sārthakaṃ kuru ॥3 1 ॥
tvadārādhanamāhātmyaṃ niṣphalaṃ naiva naiva hi ।
kartumakartuṃ sāmarthyaṃ mā kuru tvaṃ nirarthakam ॥3 2॥
garuḍasyā''grahaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāstvityavadaddhariḥ ।
paraṃ tajjanitaṃ duḥkhaṃ dampatyorbhavitā dhruvam ॥3 3 ॥
ityuktvā garuḍe sthitvā golokaṃ harirāyayau ।
gate kāle sudevasya patnyāṃ putro'bhavacchubhaḥ ॥34॥
vyavardhata gate kāle copanīto'tha pāṭhitaḥ ।
devalarṣiḥ kvacittatra samāyāt pāpanāśanaḥ ॥35॥
karaṃ dṛṣṭvā chatrapadmayavacāmaracihnitam ।
sphuṭadāyuṣyarekhaṃ ca prāhā''dhunvan śirastadā ॥36॥
sudeva! tanayo'yaṃ te dvādaśe hāyane jale ।
mṛtyumeṣyati tasmātte mā'stu śoko'nubhāvini ॥ 37॥
śrutvā śuśūcatustau ca devalo niryayau tataḥ ।
atha prāpte'niṣṭakāle'gacchadvāpīṃ hi tatsutaḥ ॥ 38॥
patito'gādhatoye'sau mamajja ca mamāra ca ।
jñātvā putrasya nidhanaṃ vayasyebhyaḥ pitā prasūḥ ॥39॥
yayatustatra saṃgṛhya śavaṃ rurudaturbahu ।
vilāpaṃ cakratuścāti tatyajaturjalānnakam ॥40॥
śrīkṛṣṇavallabho māsaḥ so'bhavatpuruṣottamaḥ ।
ajānatostayorāsītpuruṣottamasevanam ॥41॥
tenā'tyantaprasannaḥ sanprādurāsīddhariḥ svayam ।
sapatnīko namaścakre daṇḍavacchrīhariṃ dvijaḥ ॥42॥
hariḥ prāha sudeva! tvaṃ bhāgyavānasi sāmpratam ।
dvādaśābdasahasrāyuḥ putraste'yaṃ kṛto mayā ॥43॥
puruṣottamamāhātmyāt prasannena mayā dvija! ।
suciraṃ jīvito'yaṃ hi tanayaḥ sukhado'stu te ॥44॥
gārhasthyamatulaṃ bhuktvā saha putreṇa sarvadā ।
tatastvaṃ brahmaṇo lokaṃ gatvā tatra mahat sukham ॥45 ॥
divyābdavarṣasāhasraṃ bhuktvā gantāsi bhūtale ।
tato rājā cakravartī dṛḍhadhanvā bhaviṣyasi ॥46 ॥
samvatsarāṇāmayutaṃ rājyaṃ bhokṣyasi pārthivam ।
gautamīyaṃ tava patnī nāmnā tu guṇasundarī ।। 47 ।
putrāścatvāra ekā ca kanyā te tatra bhāvinaḥ ।
yadā viramase māṃ tvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ॥48 ॥
ayaṃ te tanayo vipra! śuko bhūtvā tadā vane ।
bodhayiṣyati bhaktestu vākyaṃ kṛṣṇavicintakam ॥ 49 ॥
vālmīkistvāṃ kathāṃ sarvāṃ yathārthāṃ kathayiṣyati ।
tato vairāgyamāpannaḥ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ parāṃ hareḥ ॥5 0 ॥
gamiṣyasi sapatnīko mokṣaṃ paraṃ hareḥ padam ।
vadatyevaṃ mahāviṣṇau samuttasthau dvijātmajaḥ ॥ 51 ॥
dampatī taṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahānandau babhūvatuḥ ।
nanāma śukadevo'pi śrīhariṃ pitarau tu tau ॥ 52 ॥
garuḍo brāhmaṇaścāpi nemurhariṃ sabhāryakaḥ ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prāhā'dhimāsasyā'nāyāsenāpi pālanāt ।5 3 ॥
sutadārāpatipatnīkṣetrarājyasukhāni vai ।
bhavantyeva na sandehaḥ kimu putrasajīvanam ॥54॥
ekamapyupavāsaṃ yaḥ karoti puruṣottame ।
dagdhvā'nantānyaniṣṭāni labdhvā puṇyanidhīn sa tu ।55 ॥
surayānaṃ samāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti dehavān ।
ekataḥ sarvapuṇyāni tvekataḥ puruṣottamam ॥56॥
tolayāmāsa vedho'bhūd gururvai puruṣottamaḥ ।
īśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭau brahmasṛṣṭāvapi svayam ॥ 57 ।
puruṣottamamāsastu sarvatra vartate mahān ।
tasya vai pālanenā'tra vijayaste bhaviṣyati ।58 ।
ityuktvā śrīharirdhāma yayau garuḍavāhanaḥ ।
sudevaḥ saḥ sapatnīkastaṃ māsaṃ samapūjayat ॥59 ।
bhuktvā'tha viṣayān sarvān sahasrābdānyaharniśam ।
jagāma brahmaṇo lokaṃ sapatnīko dvijottamaḥ ।60 ।
tatratyaṃ sukhamāsādya sapatnīko bhuvaṃ gataḥ ।
sa eva dṛḍhadhanvā tvaṃ prathitaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ ॥ 61 ॥
mahiṣīyaṃ tava patnī gautamī guṇasundarī ।
śukadevaśca te putro hariṇā yo'nujīvitaḥ । 62 ॥
dvādaśābdasahasrāyurbhuktvā vaikuṇṭhameyivān ।
sa eva vai śuko bhūtvā'bodhayat tvāṃ smṛtiṃ hareḥ ॥6 3 ॥
punnāmanarakāt trātā putraste sārthako'bhavat ।
ityetat kathitaṃ rājan prāgvṛttaṃ te yathā hyabhūt ॥64॥
śatadhanvā tadā'pṛcchat pūjāvidhiṃ muniṃ tadā ।
vālmīkistvāha taṃ sarvaṃ vidhiṃ vistarato nṛpam ॥65 ॥
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya paraṃbrahma vicintayet ।
tato vrajennairṛtāśāṃ śaucārthaṃ jalabhājanaḥ ॥66 ॥
karṇe kṛtvā brahmasūtraṃ śaucaṃ mūtraṃ visarjayet ।
jalenendriyayugalaṃ prakṣālya mṛjjalādibhiḥ ॥67॥
gandhalepakṣayaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā gaṇḍūṣakān bahūn ।
dantaśuddhiṃ tathā kṛtvā snāyāttīrthādivāriṣu ॥68 ॥
āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajā paśuvasūni ca ।
brahma prajñā ca medhā ca vardhante snāyino'nvaham ॥69॥
śuddhe vastre paridhāya prāṅmukho baddhasaṃśikhaḥ ।
sapavitreṇa hastena kuryādācamana tataḥ ॥70 ॥
ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ sabinduṃ ca kuryāccandanamṛtsnayā ।
śaṃkhacakrādi kuryācca dhārayet tulasīsrajam ॥7 1 ॥
prāṇāyāmaṃ tathā sandhyāṃ gāyatrījapanaṃ caret ।
śucau deśe gomayena maṇḍalaṃ taṇḍulādibhiḥ ॥72 ॥
kārayitvā ca tanmadhye kalaśaṃ sajale nyaset ।
kalaśasya mukhe viṣṇuḥ kaṇṭhe rudraḥ sadā sthitaḥ ॥73 ॥
tasya mūle sthito brahmā madhye tiṣṭhanti mātaraḥ ।
kukṣau tiṣṭhanti bhūdvīpasahitāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ॥74॥
tiṣṭhanti ṛgyajuḥsāmā'tharvāṇo'ṅgayutāstathā ।
gaṃgā godāvarī sauryā kāverī ca sarasvatī ॥75॥
tiṣṭhantvatra jale nadyaḥ pāpanāśavidhāyikāḥ ।
candanā'kṣatapuṣpāṇi samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ॥76 ॥
naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ।
ityabhyarcya tataḥ śaṃkhaṃ pūjayedakṣatādibhiḥ ॥77॥
ghaṇṭāṃ ca pūjayed ramyāmakṣataiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ ।
pātraṃ ghaṭopari nyasyet tilayukśarkarānvitam ॥78॥
pītāmbaraṃ śubhaṃ cāpi haimaṃ rādhāyutaṃ harim ।
puruṣottamamāsasya daivataṃ taṃ prapūjayet ॥79॥
analottāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kurvīta prāṇadhāraṇām ।
spṛṣṭvā dvau tatkapālau tu dakṣiṇena kareṇa vai ॥8 0 ॥
datvā ca hṛdaye'ṅguṣṭhaṃ prāṇāँstatra sudhārayet ।
asyai prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhantu cāsyai prāṇāḥ kṣarantu ca ॥8 1 ॥
asyai devatvayuktāyai svāhā nārāyaṇāya vai ।
dhyāyed devaṃ tata āvāhayennāthaṃ hṛdi sthitam ॥8 2॥
āvāhayāmi rādhāśrīsahitaṃ puruṣottamam ।
āsanaṃ cārpayāmyasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya tu śārṅgiṇe ॥8 3 ॥
samarpayāmi salilaṃ pādaprakṣālanāya te ।
arghyaṃ phalānvitaṃ caivā'rpayāmi paramātmane ॥84॥
tīrthajalānyācamanaṃ te'rpayāmi rādhikāpate ।
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā cārpayāmi te ॥85॥
pañcasnānaṃ jalasnānaṃ tathā te kārayāmyaham ।
pītadhautraṃ cottarīyaṃ samarpayāmi keśava! ॥86॥
kaustubhaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca bhūṣāṃ dadāmi te prabho ।
sugandhatailasārādi candanaṃ cārpayāmi te ॥87॥
kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpāṇi cārpayāni gṛhāṇa vai ।
dhūpaṃ divyarasopetaṃ tvarpayāmi ca te prabho ॥88 ॥
dīpaṃ ghṛtojjvalaṃ tubhyaṃ cārpayāmi hare prabho ।
pāyasādyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ samarpayāmi keśava ॥89॥
ācamanaṃ jalapānaṃ phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ।
karodvartanakaṃ caiva samarpayāmi mādhava ॥90 ॥
suvarṇadakṣiṇāṃ hārā'kṣatān dadāmi keśava! ।
nīrājayāmi deveśaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ karomi ca ॥ 91 ॥
puṣpāṃjaliṃ cārpayāmi namaskāraṃ karomi ca ।
nyūnaṃ te pūjane kiṃcit kṣamasva puruṣottama ॥92॥
homaṃ kuryādakhaṇḍaṃ ca ghṛtadīpaṃ samācaret ।
puruṣottamatuṣṭyarthe sarvārthaphalasiddhaye ॥ 93 ॥
iti nityaṃ pūjayettaṃ dadyāddānāni śaktitaḥ ।
bhojayed bhojyapātrāṇi vṛddhāँśca pādayornamet ॥94॥
haviṣyabhojanaṃ kuryād vratī devaprasādakam ।
godhūmāḥ śālayo mudgā yavāstilāśca śarkarāḥ ॥95॥
kaṅgūkharjūranīvārā drākṣāḥ kandāśca karkaṭī ।
mūlaṃ śākāni patrāṇi khādyapuṣpāṇi mūlakam ॥96॥
kāndakāni kadalāni dadhiṃ dugdhaṃ tathā''rdrakam ।
śuṇṭhī cāmraphalaṃ takraṃ panasaṃ ca harītakīṃ ॥97॥
pippalījīrakaṃ cāmalakaṃ tintiḍikā tathā ।
kramukaṃ caikṣavaṃ sarvaṃ sāttvikaṃ vratibhojanam ॥ 98 ॥
rājasaṃ rājikārāddhaṃ tāmasaṃ cāmiṣādikam ।
vātulaṃ dvidalādyaṃ ca parānnādi vivarjayet ॥99 ॥
brahmacaryamadhaḥśayyāṃ patrāvalyāṃ ca bhojanam ।
ekabhuktaṃ ca kurvīta nindāmātraṃ vivarjayet ॥ 100 ॥
upoṣaṇena dugdhena dadhnā jalena sarpiṣā ।
patreṇāpi phalenāpi kartavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 101 ॥
vratabhaṃgo yathā na syāttathā kāryaṃ prabhojanam ।
tulasīdalalakṣeṇā''rcane puṇyamanantakam ॥ 10 2।
puruṣottamamāsasya vratyapi puruṣottamaḥ ।
caturbhujo bhavedeva vaikuṇṭhe vasati dhruvam ॥ 103 ॥
akhaṇḍadīpo dātavyo māse śrīpuruṣottame ।
saubhāgyanagare rājā citrabāhurabhūtpurā ॥ 1 04॥
tasya candrakalā bhāryā hyubhāvāstāṃ sudhārmikau ।
agastyaśca munistasya bhavanaṃ tvājagāma ha ॥ 10 5॥
pūjayitvā vinayena citrabāhuruvāca ha ।
adya me gṛhasāmrājyajanmādi saphalaṃ khalu ॥ 106 ॥
yastvaṃ samāgato me'dya gṛhe śrīkṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ।
tubhyaṃ sarvaṃ dadāmyadya vaiṣṇavāya mahātmane ॥ 1 07॥
merutulyaphalaṃ syācca manāgapyarpitaṃ tu te ।
viṣṇave viṣṇubhaktāyā'narpito divaso'phalaḥ ॥ 108 ॥
vaiṣṇavā vāṅmanaḥkāyakarmabhiḥ sevanārhaṇāḥ ।
tasya dhanyāḥ prajāḥ sarvā yadgṛhe vaiṣṇavo janaḥ ॥ 109 ॥
vastavyaṃ vaiṣṇave deśe rājye vaiṣṇavabhūbhṛti ।
amaṃgalaṃ tathā kāṇaṃ bodhyaṃ rāṣṭramavaiṣṇavam ॥ 110 ॥
śrīkṛṣṇāśritabhaktasya rājño rājyaṃ vivardhate ।
mune! lakṣmīrvipulaṃ me tathā rājyamakaṃṭakam ॥ 111 ॥
pativratā ca me patnī kena puṇyena me vada ।
śrutvā'gastyaśca taṃ prāha camatkārapure purā ॥ 11 2॥
tvamabhūḥ śūdrajātīyo maṇigrīvo'tināstikaḥ ।
surā māṃsa vyavāyāti caurya durguṇavāridhiḥ ॥ 11 3॥
patibhaktā tviyaṃ bhāryā sadā sadbhāvanāvatī ।
rājñā vivāsitastvaṃ tu gato'raṇyaṃ priyāyutaḥ ॥ 11 4॥
mṛgayājīvanastvaṃ tu vane saṃdṛṣṭavān munim ।
tṛṣitaṃ ca mumūrṣuँ ca hyugradevaṃ dvijaṃ tadā ॥ 1 15॥
utthāyottolya salilaṃ phalaṃ datvā'pramodayat ।
muniḥ prāha susantuṣṭo maṇigrīva! sukhī bhava ।116 ॥
jīvitaṃ dattavāँstvaṃ me brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham ।
maṇigrīvastadā prāha dāridryaṃ naśyatānmama ॥ 1 17॥
atulā vaibhavāḥ santu pūrṇā me syurmanorathāḥ ।
itīcchāmi tadā prāha munistathā bhavantu te ॥ 118 ॥
āgāminyadhimāse vai pāvane puruṣottame ।
dīpo deyo mandire śrīpuruṣottamatuṣṭaye ॥ 11 9॥
na te tīvradāridryaṃ samūlaṃ nāśameṣyati ।
tilatailena vā''jyeneṅgudītailena vāpi ca ॥ 120 ॥
māsamekaṃ sadā snātvā devaṃ natvā pradīpakam ।
dehi tena mahārājyaṃ pṛthvyāṃ te vai bhaviṣyati ॥ 121 ॥
yajñādīni tu karmāṇi kṛcchracāndrāyaṇāni ca ।
vedapāṭho gayāśrāddhaṃ kurukṣetragrahāstathā ॥ 1 22॥
tīrthāni sarvadānāni dharmakāryāṇi yāni ca ।
puruṣottamadīpasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ॥ 123 ॥
adhimāsavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dīpaścāntaḥprakāśakaḥ ।
dhanadhānyapaśuputrapautradārāyaśaskaram ॥ 1 24॥
vandhyātvanāśakaṃ nāryā avaidhavyakaraṃ vratam ।
rājyadaṃ ceṣṭadaṃ bhartṛpradaṃ patnīpradaṃ vratam ॥ 125 ॥
vidyāsiddhikośamokṣapradaṃ dīpārpaṇavratam ।
iti pūrvaṃ tvayā datto dīpaṃ śrīharaye vane ॥ 126 ॥
tena puṇyena sadrājyaṃ lakṣmīṃ patnīṃ pativratām ।
prāptavānasi rājendra! punaḥ kuryā labhiṣyasi ॥ 1 27॥
ityuktvā'gastyaṛṣirāṭ prayāgaṃ saṃjagāma ha ।
rājñā tenāpi vidhinā prāpte śrīpuruṣottame ॥ 128 ॥
kṛtaṃ dīpapradānaṃ ca tato mokṣamavāpa saḥ ।
ityuktvā'rhaṇamādāya vālmīko nirjagāma ha ॥ 1 29॥
tato māse samāyāte śreṣṭhe śrīpuruṣottame ।
caturdaśyāṃ prage kṛṣṇadundubhirdṛḍhadhanvanā ॥ 130 ॥
śrutaḥ kurvantu cā'dyaiva vrataṃ dīpaṃ sajāgaram ।
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ prāpnuvantu tena puṇyena madvarāt ॥ 131 ॥
iti śrutvā dṛḍhadhanvā smṛtvā sarvaṃ vrataṃ tadā ।
sakuṭumbo nirāhāraścakre sadīpajāgaram ॥ 132 ॥
mahāntamutsavaṃ cakre dadau dānāni gobhuvām ।
rātrau samājagāmā'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 133 ॥
sakuṭumbaṃ garuḍena brahmalokaṃ nināya tam ।
kimu kathyaṃ mahālakṣmi! māhātmyamādhimāsikam ॥ 1 34॥
kartā dhartā samuddhartā yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
poṣṭā tuṣṭaḥ pradātā ca bhoktā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 1 35॥
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāllakṣmi! paṭhedvā pāṭhayedapi ।
so'dhimāsaphalaṃ labdhvā brahmalokaṃ prayāti hi ॥ 1 36॥
sakāmaḥ svargamāsādya pārameṣṭhyapadaṃ tathā ।
maheśādipadaṃ prāpya brahmaloke mahīyate ॥ 137 ॥
yaistu saṃpūjito māsaḥ sarvaṃ tairabhipūjitam ।
sarvaṃ prāptaṃ bhavet tena prāptaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 138 ॥
yena nīto'dhimāso'yaṃ vandhyastasya tu sampadaḥ ।
vandhyāḥ puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ sarve vandhyaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥ 139 ॥
ye kecit sukhinaḥ santi suramānavadānavāḥ ।
puruṣottamamāsasya phalaṃ lakṣmi! na cetarat ॥ 140॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dṛḍhadhanvā'raṇye śukoktaślokaṃ śrutvā tadarthaṃ vālmīkaṃ pṛṣṭvā, svīyaṃ prāgbhavīyaṃ sudevadvijatvaṃ putravattvaṃ ca putranidhane ca puruṣottamamāsakaraṇena putrajīvitatvaṃ sa tvayaṃ putraḥ śukaḥ ślokavaktā tvaṃ tvidānīṃ dṛḍhadhanvā jāta iti vṛttāntaṃ jñātavān; puruṣottamamāsapūjāvidhiṃ ca jñātavān, adhikamāse dīpadānena maṇigrīvaśūdrasya janmāntare citrabāhunṛpatitvaṃ rājyaprāptiścāgastyena kathitā, tadapi jñātavān , tataśca caturdaśīvrataṃ kṛtvā dṛḍhadhanvā sakuṭumbo mokṣamavāpetyādinirūpaṇanāmā eka-viṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 1.321 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 321 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 322
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 323 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmyadhimāsānte dine tvakṣaradhāmani ।
kṛtamudyāpanaṃ sarvaiḥ puruṣottamamandire ॥ 1 ॥
rādhākṛṣṇādayaḥ sarve golokasthāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ svaprajābhiḥ samāyayuḥ ॥ 2 ॥
mahāvaikuṇṭhalokasthā vayaṃ nārāyaṇādayaḥ ।
tvayā saha prajābhiśca gatā abhūma cākṣaram ॥ 3 ॥
avyākṛtā'mṛtadhāmabhūmaśrīpuratatstriyaḥ ।
nyāyeśvarādayaḥ sarve mudā tatra yayustadā ॥ 4 ॥
mahāviṣṇuprabhṛtayo hiraṇyagarbhasṛṣṭayaḥ ।
pravairājāścāvaraṇā īśvarā jagmurakṣaram ॥ 5 ॥
viṣṇorjalāvaraṇordhvavaikuṇṭhasthā yayustathā ।
sadāśivasya dhāmasthā mahāmāyāprajā yayuḥ ॥ 6 ॥
evaṃ ta īśvarāścāvatārā gatvā'kṣaraṃ param ।
cakrurudyāpanaṃ tatra puruṣottamamāsikam ॥ 7 ॥
brahmaṇaḥ satyaloke carṣayo munijanāstathā ।
mātṛgaṇāḥ pitaraśca devā jagmuśca vaiṣṇavaḥ ॥ 8 ॥
udyāpanaprakartāro divyā yayurnarādayaḥ ।
tīrthāni devatāḥ sarvā devyo jagmurdiśastathā ॥ 9 ॥
tattvānyapi yayustatra saritaḥ sindhavastathā ।
parvatāśca tathā'khātā dvīpāḥ khaṇḍā yayustathā ॥ 1 0॥
grahāstārāśca nakṣatramaṇḍala vṛkṣavallayaḥ ।
divyā vai bhaktavaryāstu daityā dānavarākṣasāḥ ॥ 11 ॥
oṣadhayastathā sarpā nāgāḥ patattrayo'malāḥ ।
jalavāsāḥ sthalavāsā vāyuvāsā yayustadā ॥ 1 2॥
pātālasthā vivarasthā divyādivyā yayustadā ।
vratinaḥ sahavāsāśca bhaktā udyāpanaṃkṛte ॥ 13 ॥
satye paitāmahe loke sannidhau yayurādarāt ।
puruṣottamamāsasyodyāpanārthaṃ yayuśca te ॥ 14॥
gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtādayaśca suramānavāḥ ।
bhaṭṭacāraṇabhṛtyāśca raudrā api ca śāṃkarāḥ ॥ 15॥
ete cānye vratapūrtiphalārthaṃ cotsave gatāḥ ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tatra tatra yathāśakti yathādhanam ॥ 16 ॥
kṛtamudyāpanaṃ sarvaiḥ sarveṣṭasiddhidāyakam ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ dravyadānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ tu taiḥ ॥ 17॥
śṛṇu taistu kṛtamudyāpanaṃ saṃśrāvayāmi te ।
puruṣottamamāsasya yaduktaṃ hariṇā svayam ॥ 18 ॥
pakṣadvaye caturdaśyāmamāyāṃ pūrṇimātithau ।
ekādaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vā vratāhe'ṣṭamikātithau ॥ 1 9॥
yatra tithau bhavedānukūlyaṃ tatrāpi vā tithau ।
udyāpanaṃ prakuryādvai vratasampūrtihetave ॥ 2 0 ॥
puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiśca sthale sthale ।
uddhoṣayati gatvaiva kurvantūdyāpanaṃ śubham ॥ 2 1॥
puruṣottamamāsasya phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
śrutvā'pi ḍiṇḍamaṃ cānye cakrurudyāpanaṃ gṛhe ॥ 22॥
rātrau bhūśāyino bhūtvā brahmacaryaṃ prarakṣya ca ।
prātarutthāya te sarve cakrurdhyānaṃ harestataḥ ॥ 23 ॥
kṛtvā śaucādikāḥ sarvā daihikīrbāhyataḥ kriyāḥ ।
divyādivyaṃ yathāvarṣma kṛtvā snānādikaṃ tataḥ ॥24॥
japaṃ homaṃ tathā sandhyāṃ svādhyāyaṃ tarpaṇādikam ।
yathālokaṃ yathāvarṣma yathāyogyaṃ vidhāya te ॥ 25 ॥
nityāṃ pūjāṃ vṛddhapūjāṃ kṛtvā pūjyārhaṇādikam ।
ācamya ca bhuvaṃ kṛtvā saṃskṛtāṃ bahuvistarām ॥ 26॥।
cakruśca maṇḍapaṃ tatra bahustaṃbhasamanvitam ।
ratnahīrakahārādyairāmrā'śokāditoraṇaiḥ ॥ 27॥
kadalīstambhapatrādyaiḥ kalpavallyāstaroḥ phalaiḥ ।
kalaśaiḥ raṃgavallībhiścāmbaraiḥ kānakānvitaiḥ ॥ 28 ॥
bandhayitvā pradīpaiśca śobhayitvā sugandhibhiḥ ।
vāsayitvā ca tanmadhye pañcadhānyaiśca saptabhiḥ ॥ 2 9॥
dhānyairvā kārayitvaiva sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam ।
sapatnīkān viṣṇubhaktān nimantrya ca yathābalam ॥ 30 ॥
nyasuścaturaḥ kalaśāँścaturdikṣu ca maṇḍale ।
suvastraśrīphalapūgīnāgavallīdalānvitān ॥3 1 ॥
tatrā'kṣatān pūrayitvā śarkarādravyamiśritān ।
vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ pradyumnaṃ cāniruddhakam ॥3 2॥
īśānataḥ kramānnyasya madhye ca kalaśe śubhe ।
saphale sāmbare pūgīsvarṇamudrā'kṣatānvite ॥ 3 3॥
pañcaratnayute svarṇe nyadhuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
rādhālakṣmyādisahitaṃ sauvarṇe divyarūpiṇam ॥ 34॥
evaṃ tairvratibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sthāpanaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛtam ।
ācāryaśca gurustatra pūjanārthaṃ praveśitaḥ ॥ 35॥
dehaśuddhiḥ kāritā ca yajamānasya tena vai ।
tata āvāhito devaścāsanaṃ ca pradāpitaḥ ॥ 36॥
pādaprakṣālanārtha vai dattaṃ jalaṃ sutīrthajam ।
caturdikṣu kṛtā dīpāḥ sugandhastatra kāritaḥ ॥37॥
arghyaṃ phalādibhiryuktaṃ dampatyā ca samarpitam ।
ācamanīyasalilaṃ dattaṃ devāya tīrthajam ॥ 38 ॥
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā cāmṛtaṃ tathā ।
abhiṣeka jalasnānaṃ dattāni keśavāya vai ॥ 3 9॥
vastreṇa mārjito devau vastrābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।
gandhasārottaratailasugandhādyaiḥ suvāsitaḥ ॥40 ॥
kuṃkumakajjalacūrṇacandanādyaiḥ suśobhitaḥ ।
maṇihīrakamauttikahāropavītabhūṣitaḥ ॥4 1 ॥
kirīṭakuṇḍalakaṭakormikāśṛṃkhalānvitaḥ ।
chatrayaṣṭinaktakacāmarapattrāṇarakṣitaḥ ॥42॥
paryaṃka genduka kaśipvā darśādi pradāpitaḥ ।
puṣpatulasīpadmādyaiḥ puṇḍraiścandraiḥ suśobhitaḥ ॥43 ॥
atha tanmaṇḍape tāmrapātre homaśca kāritaḥ ।
caturthyantairnāmamantraistilairghṛtena satphalaiḥ ॥44॥
aṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ tataśca tarpaṇaṃ kṛtam ।
devāśca pitaraśceti tṛpyantāṃ puruṣottamaḥ ॥45॥
atha nīrājito devo bahuvartyanalaistathā ।
namaskṛtaḥ stutaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtaśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ ॥46॥
daṇḍavatsatkṛtaścāpi dhyātaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
kṣamāpito hariḥ puṣpāṃjalirdattaśca śārṅgiṇe ॥47॥
atha saṃbhojito devo miṣṭānnaistarpito'mṛtaiḥ ।
arpitaśca jalairmiṣṭaphalaistāmbūlacarvitaḥ ॥48 ॥
sugandhairudvartitaśca karayoḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
svāsthyairviśramito devaḥ pādayorabhivāhitaḥ ॥49॥
evaṃ sarvaiḥ pūjitaśca bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
āvirbhūto'dṛśyatāgre phalantvanantakaṃ dadau ॥5 0 ॥
athā''cāryāya saṃdattā dakṣiṇā hemarūpyakā ।
dhenudānaṃ kṛtaṃ cāpi svarṇaśṛṃgārabhūṣitam ॥5 1 ॥
ghṛtavastratilapātraṃ dattaṃ viprāya tatra ca ।
pratimā ca pradattā saṃhitāśāstraṃ samarpitam ॥52 ॥
kāṃsyāni saṃpuṭātmāni triṃśaddattāni vai tadā ।
tadā triṃśattriṃśadapūpaiśca madhye sampūritāni vai ॥53 ॥
etadbrahmāṇḍadānaṃ vai kalpitaṃ puruṣottame ।
pratyaṅgaṃ tu yāvanti chidrāṇi santi padmaje ॥54॥
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi vaikuṇṭhe vasatirbhavet ।
tato vasatirgoloke tato dhāmnyakṣare pare ॥55 ॥
athavā'pūpasāmagryapakvā deyā dvijanmane ।
atha saṃbhojitā viprāḥ santaḥ sādhyaśca bālakāḥ ॥56॥
pāyasānnaiśca miṣṭānnairvyañjanaiścāmṛtādibhiḥ ।
caturdhā bhojanairbhakṣyabhojyalehyasucoṣyakaiḥ ॥57॥
rasairdugdhādibhirvārbhiḥ śarkarailādimiśritaiḥ ।
tato jalaṃ mukhaśuddhistāmbūlakaṃ ca dakṣiṇā ॥58॥
vastrāṇyābharaṇānyuttamottamānyarpitāni vai ।
devībhyo devatābhyaśca gurubhyo'pyarpitāni ca ॥59 ॥
tattallokaja tattvāni dānayogyāni yāni vai ।
bhūtebhya āśritebhyaścātithibhyo'nnaṃ samarpitam ॥ 60 ॥
tato bhuktaṃ svajanaiśca saha vratibhirādarāt ।
phalāhārādikaṃ yogyaṃ vratabhaṃgā'karaṃ hi yat ॥6 1 ॥
madhyāhne'pi kṛtaṃ tadvanniśi rātrau ca vai tathā ।
pūjito bhojito devo jāgareṇa yutairjanaiḥ ॥62 ॥
gītaṃ ca nartanaṃ puṇyaṃ bhajanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ janaiḥ ।
prātaḥ snātvā pūjitaśca kṣamāpyā'tha visarjitaḥ ॥6 3 ॥
ācāryāya pradattaḥ sa mūrtirūpaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
evamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ sarve nijālayam ॥64॥
phalaṃ cānantakaṃ prāptaṃ puruṣottamasevanāt ।
tato lakṣmi! yathāśakti vratametatsamācaret ॥ 65॥
duḥkhadāridryadaurbhāgyanāśaḥ syādiṣṭamāpnuyāt ।
niyamānāṃ parityāgastataḥ kuryād vratī janaḥ ॥66॥
madhyabhojī naktabhojī brāhmaṇān bhojayed vratī ।
ayācite vrate labdhe svarṇadānaṃ samācaret ॥67॥
māsopavāsinā deyā dogdhrī gaurdakṣiṇāyutā ।
dhātrīvratī pradadyācca dadhiṃ kṣīraṃ ca śarkarām ॥68 ॥
phalānāṃ niyame lakṣmi! phaladānaṃ samācaret ।
tailarodhe ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ ghṛtarodhe payo'rpaṇam ॥69॥
dhānyānāṃ niyame dadyād dhānyāni tāni tāni ca ।
bhūśāyitve tu paryaṃkagendukakaśipucchadān ॥70॥
phalapatrādiniyame tāni dadyād dvijanmane ।
maune ghaṇṭāśaṃkhavādyān dadyād devāya padmaje ॥7 1॥
nakhakeśadharo dadyādādarśaṃ keśakarcikām ।
upānahau pradadyācca hyupānadādivarjane ॥72॥
kṣāratyāge rasān dadyād dīpadāne tu dīpakān ।
ekāntaropavāsī ca kuṃbhānaṣṭau pradāpayet ॥73 ॥
rājñāṃ yāvatya iṣṭāśca smṛddhayo'tra bhavanti vai ।
deyā dāne ca tāḥ sarvā yathāśakti yathādhanam ॥ 74॥
ekānnena vratī yāyāccaturbāhuḥ parāṃ gatim ।
ekabhojyupavāsyeva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ॥75॥
pūrvāhṇe bhuṃjate devā madhyāhne munayastathā ।
aparāhṇe pitṛgaṇā naktabhojī naro bhavet ॥76॥
dine dine'śvamedhasya phalaṃ naktādano labhet ।
dvādaśīvratakṛd yāti garuḍena hareḥ padam ॥77॥
yasya yasya niyamaḥ syāttattaddāne niyojayet ।
tena pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ syācca brahmalokapradaṃ bhavet ॥78॥
anityena śarīreṇa sādhyaṃ mokṣapadaṃ sadā ।
puruṣottamatulyaṃ tu nāsti lakṣmi! trilokake ॥79॥
sahasrajanmataptena tapasā'pi na gamyate ।
yatphalaṃ gamyate loke puruṣottamasevayā ॥8 0॥
trirātrasnānataścātra śākhāmṛgo'kṣaraṃ yayau ।
āsīdvai kerale deśe dvijo dhanātilolupaḥ ॥8 1 ॥
tena kadaryanāmnā saḥ khyātiṃ jagāma dehiṣu ।
sadannavastraṃ bhuktaṃ na svāhā svadhā kṛtā na vā ॥82॥
dhanaṃ pṛthvyāṃ rakṣitaṃ ca dharmakāryaṃ kṛta na ca ।
na vrataṃ notsavaścāpi na grahaṇaṃ na kuṃbhanam ॥83॥
kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ bhikṣaṇaṃ tu dhanasyā'ṭan vidīnavat ।
so'gānmālākāravāṭikāyāṃ duḥkhaṃ rudanmuhuḥ ॥84॥
mālākāro dayāṃ kṛtvā rarakṣa svāntike hi tam ।
vāṭikārakṣakaṃ kṛtvā mālī grāme gato bhavet ॥85॥
paścājjaghāsa pakvāni cākrīṇata phalāni saḥ ।
evaṃ stenakriyākarturjagmurayutavatsarāḥ ॥86॥
mamāra ca vane tatra nā'vāpa vahnidāruṇī ।
yamadūtairnīyamānastāḍyamāno yamālayam ॥87॥
gacchannuvāca duṣkarmaphalaṃ prāptaṃ mayā'dya vai ।
mānuṣaṃ janma saṃprāpya na kiñcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtam ॥88 ॥
cauryādisañcitaṃ dravyaṃ sthitaṃ bhūmau nirarthakam ।
na dhṛtaṃ nā'ttameveti puṇyaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ nahi ॥8 9 ॥
na kuṭumbaṃ poṣitaṃ ca bhāryā kaṣṭena yojitā ।
kadaryo vilapannevaṃ gato yamapuraṃ tataḥ ॥ 90 ॥
citragupto'vadaddharmaṃ pāpadvayaṃ bahūgrakam ।
phalacauryaṃ tathā viśvāsaghātitvaṃ paraṃ bahu ॥9 1 ॥
śrutvā prāha yamo dūtān pretamenaṃ vidhattha vai ।
tato'stu vānaro'yaṃ tu muhurnarakayātanaḥ ॥ 92॥
iti dūtaiḥ prāpitaḥ saḥ pretatāṃ nirjale vane ।
tataḥ kapirabhūt kālaṃjare śaile bhayaṃkare ॥ 93 ॥
tatrendreṇa kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kuṇḍo mṛgasutīrthakaḥ ।
tatraiva vānaro jātaḥ pūrvapuṇyāt tadalpakāt ॥94॥
śṛṇu pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ puruṣottamaśaṃsanam ।
citrakuṇḍalavaiśyo'bhūt puruṣottamasadvratī ॥ 95॥
dānakṛt taṃ ca bhikṣārthaṃ kadaryo gatavān purā ।
praśaśaṃsa ca taṃ vaiśyaṃ dhanalobhena bhikṣukaḥ ॥ 96 ॥
puruṣottamamāsasya vrataṃ yad vidhinā tvayā ।
kṛtaṃ tādṛk kṛtaṃ naiva kenāpi tvatra bhūtale ॥ 97॥
kṛtārtho'si tvayā yatsevitaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
dhanyado mokṣadaścāyaṃ māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥98 ॥
dehi mahyaṃ dhanaṃ kiñciditi māsaṃ śaśaṃsa saḥ ।
tena puṇyena tīrthe'tra vānaratvamupāgamat ॥ 99॥
janmatastasya vaktre'bhūtpīḍā'sṛgavraṇasaṃbhavā ।
dantāḥ petuḥ kṣudhā vyāpto jvarātipīḍito'bhavat ॥ 100 ॥
patitaḥ kuṇḍanikaṭe āyānmāḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
daśamīdinataḥ pañcāhāni kuṇḍajale yayuḥ ॥ 101 ॥
vyasustīrthajale jātastena divyavapurdharaḥ ।
caturbhujo'bhavad divyadevīpārṣasevitaḥ ॥ 10 2॥
tīrthamṛtestathā jātaḥ snānāt pañcāhasatkṛtān ।
ajñānācca tathā jātaṃ kiṃ punarvidhinā kṛtāt ॥ 103 ॥
te sadā subhagāḥ puṇyāsteṣāṃ ca saphalo bhavaḥ ।
yeṣāṃ pumuttamo māsaḥ snānadānajapairgataḥ ॥ 104 ॥
tāni koṭiguṇānyeva kṛtāni puruṣottame ।
kapirjagāma golokaṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ॥ 105 ॥
evaṃ kadaryaścauro'pi vānaratvaṃ gato'pi ca ।
puruṣottamayogena prāpto gaulokameva saḥ ॥ 106 ॥
puruṣottamamāsasya kathāyāḥ śravaṇādapi ।
māsopoṣaṇapūjādiphalaṃ pūrṇamavāpyate ॥ 1 07॥
śrutvā dharmaṃ vijānāti śrutvā pāpaṃ ca naśyati ।
śrutvā nivartate mohaḥ śrutvā jñānāmṛtaṃ milet ॥ 108 ॥
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākhyaṃ vedaṃ paṭhed vratī ।
śṛṇuyācchrīpuruṣottamamāse mokṣadā hi sā ॥ 109 ॥
yayā nāryā kṛto naiva māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
tatpatinā''dṛtaścet sā labhet tatphalaṃ varam ॥ 110 ॥
satī nārī sadā pātivratyadharmaparā yadi ।
patirūpo bhavatyasyā māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ॥ 111 ॥
kurūpo vā kuvṛtto vā duḥsvabhāvo'pi madyapaḥ ।
rogī krodhī sthavīro vā mūko'ndho badhiro'pi vā ॥ 11 2 ॥
raudro dīnaḥ kadaryo vā daridraḥ kutsito'pi vā ।
kātaraḥ kitavo vāpi viṣayī lampaṭo'pi vā ॥ 113 ॥
satataṃ devavatpūjyaḥ satyā sādhvyā patirhariḥ ।
vidhavayā kanyayā ca patireva hariḥ sadā ॥ 1 14॥
sevanīyaḥ pūjanīyo dhyātavyo'dhyāsitavya ut ।
vācā ca karmaṇā dehenāpi bhāvanayā tathā ॥ 11 5॥
na patyurviṣamaṃ kāryaṃ nodvejanīya īśvaraḥ ।
bālā yuvatī jaraṭhā patyadhīnā priyā bhavet ॥ 116 ॥
kāmena lobhena balena vāpi dainyena bhāvena samāśrayeṇa ।
rūpeṇa vāsena dhanādinā vā satṛṣṇayā vendriyadhātupuṣṭyā ॥ 1 17॥
sadambarairyānavaraiśca vāhanairābhūṣaṇairhīrakaratnakoṭibhiḥ ।
sunṛtyagītairbahulāsanairapi nānyaṃ bhajet sā khalu sādhulakṣaṇā ॥ 118 ॥
anyasmai darśanārthaṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kurute na vai ।
svānurūpaṃ naraṃ yā na cintayati priyā satī ॥ 119 ॥
surūpaṃ taruṇaṃ ramyaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca vallabham ।
dṛṣṭvā na vikṛtiṃ yāti sā vai bodhyā mahāsatī ॥ 120 ॥
bhuṃkte bhukte yathā patyau duḥkhite duḥkhinā ca yā ।
mudite muditā supte suptā jāgarti jāgrati ॥ 121 ॥
vṛddhabhaktā patikārye'nukūlā nā'dhikavyayā ।
gṛhā''gataṃ patiṃ pratyuttiṣṭhatyāsanavāribhiḥ ॥ 122 ॥
prasannavadanā kāle bhojanādipradāyinī ।
bhuktavantaṃ śrāvayennā'priyaṃ śāntiṃ dadettathā ॥ 123 ॥
sevārthaṃ sarvadā bhāvyaṃ prītyarthaṃ priyayā sadā ।
vastuvyayaṃ na cātyarthaṃ kurvīta gṛharakṣikā ॥ 124॥
śṛṃgāraścātibhūṣādi dhārayet patituṣṭaye ।
tretādau pramadānāṃ syādārtavā'śocameva ha ॥ 1 25॥
tatra caturahānyeva gṛhakāryaṃ na saṃspṛśet ।
snātvā sūryaṃ patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā paścāt kriyāparā ॥ 1 26॥
bhavet, bhavetputrakāmā yugmarātriratipriyā ।
putrīkāmā tvayugmāsu rātriṣu svāmisevikā ॥ 1 27॥
āṣoḍaśarātrikaṃ vai garbhādhānabalaṃ bhavet ।
taduttaraṃ kamalasya dvāraṃ baddhaṃ prajāyate ॥ 128 ॥
na bibhatsā bhavet kvāpi rūkṣavāṇī bhavenna ca ।
śūrpavātaṃ nā''dadīta nopāviśettathāṃ'gane ॥ 1 29॥।
dvāradārau cullikāyāṃ peṣaṇyāṃ niṣadīta na ।
guruṃ vā'tyuṣṇamāhāramajīrṇaṃ na samācaret ॥ 130 ॥
tenā'patyavatī syādanyathā garbhakṣaro bhavet।
sapatnī sthānamirṣyāyāḥ sādhvīrṣyā parivarjayet ॥ 131 ॥
gṛhakleśaṃ na janayed rakṣayet sarvathā gṛham ।
nā''krośet patimālakṣya bhartsayenna vimānayet ॥ 13 2॥
ratyā dadyātsukhaṃ tasmai svāmine rakṣiṇe sadā ।
patyājñayā bahirgacched devadarśanahetave ॥ 13 3॥
patyau deśāntaraṃ prāpte sādhvī varteta sarvathā ।
raṃgarāgavihīnā vai śvaśrvādyājñākarī sadā ॥ 1 34॥
vastrairaṃgaiśca malinā na bhavecchuddhimācaret ।
svāmiśiṣṭaṃ prasādānnajalaṃ bhuñjīta bhāvataḥ ॥ 1 35॥
snāyānna vastraśūnyā vai na nagnā syāt kadācana ।
nolūkhale na musale na ghaṭādau na cāśmani ॥ 1 36॥
na yantre na ca rathyāyāṃ satī tūpāviśet kvacit ।
patipādodakaṃ tīrthaṃ pibet tīrthaphalapradam ॥ 1 37॥
vratopavāsaniyamān patimullaṃghya nā''caret ।
bhartuścaraṇāvabhyarcya bhoktavyaṃ priyayā sadā ॥ 138 ॥
patyākṣeptrī saramā syādulūkī svodaraṃbharā ।
sūkarī cānyapārśvasthā vāgurī guptabhakṣikā ॥ 13 9॥
avamānakarī mūkā sāpatnerṣyā tu durbhagā ।
patyuḥ kaṣṭapradā nārī kurūpā rogiṇī bhavet ॥ 14 0॥
bhartā brahmā haro viṣṇurgurustīrthaṃ vrataṃ japaḥ ।
śuddhiḥ svargaṃ śubhaṃ dānaṃ tasmātpatiṃ susevayet ॥ 141 ॥
jīvahīno'śucirdehā bhartṛhīnā'śuciḥ satī ।
pativratā priyā svasyāḥ patiṃ svargaṃ nayet satī ॥ 142॥।
yamadūtāḥ palāyante satīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dūrataḥ ।
yāvatsvalomasaṃkhyāsti tāvatkoṭyayutāni vai ॥ 143 ॥
bhartrā svargasukhaṃ bhuṃkte ramamāṇā pativratā ।
vidhavayā patiṃ smṛtvā tarpaṇaṃ kāryamanvaham ॥ 144॥
darbhatilodakaiḥ piṣṭaphalairgogrāsakaistathā ।
anyaiśca dānakāryaiśca puṇyaṃ samarjayettu sā ॥ 145 ।
brahmāṇḍaṃ saṃpuṭākāraṃ kāṃsyapātrakṛtaṃ dadet ।
madhyatriṃśadapūpapūritaṃ tantusuveṣṭitam ॥ 146 ॥
pūjitaṃ cākṣatapuṣpakuṃkumairarpayet satī ।
patnīvrato bhavet tadvanpumān patnīparāyaṇaḥ ॥ 147॥
svasya prāṇaṃ tathā dehaṃ kṣetraṃ śāntisthalīṃ śubhām ।
patnīṃ sammānayennityaṃ mādhuryeṇa vilokayet ॥ 148 ॥
miṣṭaṃ dadyācca bhāṣetā''kārayetpremabhāvataḥ ।
tiraskurvīta no patnīṃ tāḍayennā''kṣipenna ca ॥ 149 ॥
vastrabhūṣādyalaṃkārairdravacandanapuṣpakaiḥ ।
tailatantukajjalādyaistoṣayet svapriyāṃ sadā ॥ 150 ॥
nodvejayenna prasahya bhuñjīta na ca rodhayet ।
kṣudhayā tṛṣayā patnīṃ karmaṇā duḥkhayenna ca ॥ 151 ॥
na cā'vigaṇayenmānahīnāṃ dāsīṃ priyāṃ patiḥ ।
vaṃśadāṃ ratidāṃ vallīvadāśritāṃ prapoṣayet ॥ 152 ॥
athecchukīṃ na pravadennetyapi noccaretpatiḥ ।
omityuccārya saṃdadyādapekṣitadhanādikam ॥ 153 ॥
bhojyakāryaṃ gṛhakāryaṃ ratikāryaṃ tanukriyām ।
patikāryaṃ tathā'nyacca kurvāṇāṃ supramodayet ॥ 1 54॥
nānyāṃ nārīṃ samīkṣeta nānyāṃ vyavāyakṛtadbhavet ।
nānyāṃ priyo bhavet kvāpi patnīṃ lakṣmīṃ vihāya vai ॥ 155 ॥
nānyāṃ puṣṭipradaḥ syācca nānyayā ca rameta vai ।
yānavāhanadeśādyutsavasāmājakeṣu ca ॥ 156॥
nānyāparo bhavet kvāpi yadi svargaṃ hi vāñchati ।
evaṃ dharmaparau tvatra dampatī mokṣabhāginau ॥ 157॥
indradyumnaḥ śatadyumno yauvanāśvo bhagīrathaḥ ।
kalpakalpāntare cānye vaiṣṇavā rājabhūsurāḥ ॥ 158 ॥
puruṣottamamārādhya yayurbhagavadantikam ।
puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiryena saṃśrutaḥ ॥ 159॥
tena tena ca sarvatrotsavo'nuṣṭhita eva ha ।
dundubhestu prapūjā ca kṛtā nārāyaṇena ca ॥ 160 ॥
yadā yadā'dhimāso'pi samāgacchet tadā tadā ।
dundubhinā paṭahena kartavyā''jñāpraghoṣaṇā ॥ 161 ॥
dhāmnyakṣare rakṣitaḥ śrīpumuttamena sarvadā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena śrīpuruṣottamaśārṅgiṇā ॥ 162 ॥
rādhayā ca śriyā lakṣmyā pārvatyā prabhayā tathā ।
māṇikyayā jayayā ca ramayā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ॥ 163
pratyahaṃ tvadhimāse'yaṃ pūjanīyaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
bhojanāya sevanīyo dhyātavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 164॥
śrotavyaṃ māsamāhātmyaṃ śloko'dhyāyaḥ prapūrṇakaḥ।
gaṃgādisarvatīrthānāṃ phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ॥ 165
pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāpuṇyaṃ brahmāṇḍoddhārapuṇyakam ।
śravaṇena bhavedasya māsā muktistathā bhavet ॥ 166॥
varṇāstathā''śramavantaḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ sarvathā gatāḥ ।
śrutvā muktiṃ samāyānti paśucaryā janā api ॥ 167 ॥
puruṣottamamāhātmyaṃ lekhayitvā sabandhanam ।
dadyādasya phalaṃ vaṃśatrayaṃ golokago bhavet ॥ 168 ॥
māhātmyapustakādhāre gṛhe tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ ।
vasanti devatāścāpi vartate puruṣottamaḥ ॥ 169॥
śrotā vaktā śrāvayitā varṇayitā praśaṃsakaḥ ।
rakṣako vratakṛd dātā sarve te puruṣottamāḥ ॥ 170 ॥
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'nādiśrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
saṃhitopasamādeṣṭā pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ ॥ 171 ॥
lakṣmīḥ śrutvā cātitṛptā pupūja puruṣottamam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pupūja svapatiṃ harim ॥ 172 ॥
tvanmukhāmṛtapānena kṛtārthā'smītyuvāca sā ।
vyāsaṃ patisvarūpaṃ saṃpupūja ca nanāma ca ॥ 173 ॥
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo vaktā lakṣmīstvaṃ ca narāyaṇī ।
gṛhṇāmi tvatkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ॥ 174॥

iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye'kṣaradhāmni sarvasṛṣṭīśvaraiḥ kṛtaḥ puruṣottamamāsavratodyāpanāvidhiḥ, niyamapūrtyarthaṃ dānāni, dīpadānaphalaṃ, kadaryamuktiḥ, vānaramokṣaṇam, pativratā- dharmāḥ, patnīvratadharmāḥ, kāṃsyasaṃpuṭātmaka brahmāṇḍadānaṃ, dundubhipūjanaṃ, śravaṇādiphalaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1.322 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 322 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 323
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 324 →



śrīlakṣmīruvāca-

nārāyaṇa hare svāmin paramātman parātpara ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo'ntaryāmin parameśvara ।। 1 ।।
puruṣottama cātmeśa prāṇeśa priya mānada ।
yaduktā bhavatā dharmapatnyaḥ santi trayodaśa ।। 2 ।।
kāstāḥ kasmāt kadā kutra samutpannāśca hetunā ।
kena kāryaṃ ca kiṃ tāsāṃ vada vaktavyameva cet ।। 3 ।।
tāritā pāvitā kīrtiṃ gamitā'haṃ kṛpālunā ।
śrāvayitvā kathāṃ devyāṃ puruṣottamayoginīm ।। 4 ।।
dharmapatnīsmaraṇārthaṃ vistarād vada nātha me ।
svargamokṣapradā divyāṃ kathāṃ vai dharmayoṣitām ।। 5 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca---
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dharmapatnīnāṃ kathāṃ mokṣadāṃ śubhām ।
sṛṣṭyādau khalu saṃjātāṃ kathayāmi nibodha me ।। 6 । ।
akṣare tu pare dhāmni vartate puruṣottamaḥ ।
tasmin divyā śaktayaśca santi śatasahasraśaḥ ।। 7 ।।
tadaiko'haṃ bahu prajāyeyeti kalpanā vyadhāt ।
nityo divyaguṇāḥ śaktyātmakā mūrtāstadā'bhavan । । 8 ।।
śraddhā maitrī dayā śāntistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ samunnatiḥ ।
kriyā buddhiśca medhā ca titikṣā hrīśca dvādaśa ।। 9 ।।
mūrtiścetyadhikā bhaktināmnā tatra sadocyate ।
etā hareḥ svarūpādvai jajñire śaktayaḥ striyaḥ ।। 10 ।।
nityā harāvapi chāyā bhavanti lokamuktaye ।
dvitīyarūpamādhāya vasanti jīvajātiṣu ।। 11 ।।
yadā tā rūpayuktāśca saṃbhūtā brahmarūpataḥ ।
tadā tāḥ prārthayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ।। 1 2 ।।
vayaṃ bhavataḥ saṃkalpād yato hutāḥ sma keśava ।
samūrtāśca bhavanmūrtimayya smo nānyagā yataḥ ।। 13 ।।
ājñāpaya yathāyogyaṃ kāryamasmādṛśa prabho ।
iti cābhyarthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।। 14।।
vicārya prāha tāḥ sarvāḥ chāyārūpā bhavantu vai ।
chāyātmakāni yānyatra rūpāṇi vo bhavanti vai ।। 15 ।।
tāni sarvāṇi sṛṣṭau tu dehiṣu vicarantviti ।
ityāśāṃ śrīhareḥ prāpya sṛṣṭau jātā guṇātmikā ।। 16 ।।
vyāpikāḥ śaktayastāstu śroharericchayā'bhavan ।
kintvasureṣu daityeṣu dānaveṣu ca sarvathā ।। 17।।
sukhaṃ tāsāmabhavanna tāmasānāṃ gṛheṣu ca ।
tataḥ sarvā militvaiva yayuḥ śrībadarīvanam ।। 18 ।।
tapastepuratiraudraṃ parameśvaravāñcchayā ।
gaṃgātīraṃ samāsādya nirjalāhārataḥ sthitāḥ ।। 19 ।।
sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ puruṣottamamānasāḥ ।
āvirāsīttadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 20 ।।
prāha tāḥ kiṃ kathaṃ cedṛk tapyate dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ tapaścaryāprabhāveṇā'smi vardhitaḥ ।। 21 ।।
madguṇāḥ śaktayo me ca mama vṛddhiparāyaṇāḥ ।
matpuṣṭidāḥ sukhadāśca bhavatyaḥ santi sarvathā ।। 22।।
sāhāyyārthaṃ bhavatīnāṃ samāyāto'smi vai yataḥ ।
nivedayantvabhimataṃ tapobhiśca kimiṣyate ।।2 3 ।।
ityāvedya haristatra kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ sthitastataḥ ।
ūcustāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabho! dānavadaityake ।।24।।
āsureṣu sukhaṃ naiva bhavatyasmākamīśvara! ।
adharmasya nivāsena vayaṃ tatra hi duḥkhitāḥ ।। 25।।
tata ākṛṣya bhagavan kuru naḥ sukhitā sadā ।
hariḥ prāha tadā tāstu vicintya kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।। 2 6 ।।
puruṣottamamāsāntadivasasya vrataṃ mahat ।
kurutā'tra devanadītīre sveṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 27।।
ityuktvā'ntarhito devaḥ tāpasyaśca yadā punaḥ ।
samayo'dhikamāsasya hyāyātastāstadantime ।। 28 ।।
divase pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vastubhiḥ ।
bhāvaiśca vividhaiḥ sarvāścakruḥ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ ।। 29 ।।
sāyaṃ prāvirbabhūvātra bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
varaṃ vṛṇuta vo devyo yatheṣṭaṃ dātumāgataḥ ।। 30 ।।
cakitāśca tadā tāśca vavrire dharmarakṣaṇam ।
dharmāśritā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣitāḥ syāma sarvathā ।। 31 ।।
tvayā rakṣā prakartavyā sadā śrīpuruṣottama ।
iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha tathāstviti punastataḥ ।। 3 2।।
prāha tāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvā yāntu dakṣagṛhaṃ śubhāḥ ।
asiknī putrikāḥ santu bhavatīnāṃ tataḥ pitā ।। 33 ।।
dakṣo dāsyati dharmāya patnyarthaṃ vai trayodaśa ।
taireva nāmabhiḥ khyātā bhaviṣyatha yathāyatham ।। 34।।
tato'haṃ mūrtito brahmacaryadharmo hariḥ svayam ।
nārāyaṇo narasakhā cotpatsye badarīvane ।। 35 ।।
bhavatīnāṃ adharmāṇāṃ kariṣye rakṣaṇaṃ sadā ।
ityuktvā prayayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilīnatām ।। 36 ।।
tāśca tapaḥ parityajyā'siknyāṃ praviviśustadā ।
dakṣasaṃkalpamātrāt tāḥ kanyakā abhavaँstadā ।। 37।।
jātamātrā yuvatyaśca sundaryo varaṇā'rhaṇāḥ ।
jātismarāḥ surūpāśca dharmārthaṃ kṛtavigrahāḥ ।। 38 ।।
dharmakāṃkṣāvatīrdṛṣṭvā dharmārthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ ।
dakṣaḥ pratīkṣate dharmayogasya samayaṃ śubham ।।39 ।।
tāvat tīrthanimittena badaryāśramamārgagam ।
dakṣagṛhaṃ samālokya dharmo viśrāntaye kṣaṇam ।।40 ।।
yayau dakṣagṛhaṃ jñātvā'tithisatkāraśobhitam ।
brahmaputraṃ bhrātaraṃ ca jñātvā smṛtvā viśeṣataḥ ।।4 1 ।।
dakṣo dṛṣṭvā'tisantuṣṭaścātithyaṃ vidadhe bahu ।
dadau sampūjya tāḥ sarvā dharmāya tu trayodaśa ।।।42 ।।
putryo vivāhavidhinā kṛtakṛtyo'bhavattadā ।
dharmo'pi tāḥ samādāya yayau badarikāśramam ।।43 ।।
gaṃgā pītvā jale snātvā dharmāraṇyaṃ jagāma ha ।
nārāyaṇo narasakhā dharme saṃpraviveśa ha ।।44।।
patnībhiḥ sahito dharmo jagāma vatsarāntare ।
tīrthāni saṃvidhāyaiva sarvāṇi badarīvanam ।।45।।
tatra kṛṣṇecchayā sākṣāt naranārāyaṇāvubhau ।
mūrtestu tapasā jātau puruṣottamasadvratāt ।।46 ।।
dharmaputrau mūrtiputrau jātamātrau mahattamau ।
yuvānau bhagavantau tau brahmacaryaparau sadā ।।47।।
tāpasau lokakalyāṇakarau prāvirbabhūvatuḥ ।
śraddhāyāmatha dharmasya kāmaḥ putro babhūva ha ।।48 ।।
kāmaḥ saṃkalpa ityukto dharmapuṇyaprabhāvavān ।
saṃkalpasya suto jāto vyavasāyā'bhidhānakaḥ ।।49 ।।
maitrī snehaṃ vijajñe copakāraṃ suṣuve dayā ।
śāntiḥ kṣemaṃ sutaṃ jajñe santoṣastuṣṭijaḥ sutaḥ ।।50 ।।
puṣṭyā lābhaḥ suto hyunnatestu cābhyudayaḥ sutaḥ ।
kriyāyāṃ tu nayaḥ putro daṇḍaḥ samaya ityapi ।।5 1 ।।
buddherbodhaḥ sutaścāpi hyapramādaśca tāvubhau ।
medhāputrau śubhaśrutau titikṣāyā virāmakaḥ ।।52।।
hriyāḥ putro niyamaśca mūrternaranarāyaṇau ।
kṛṣṇaharīti catvāro dharmavaṃśo hi badrike ।।53 ।।
vartate sma sukhaṃ lakṣmi! sevānusevane ratam ।
atha vai vedhaso loke satye brahmasabhāsthale ।।54।।
puruṣottamamāsānte puruṣottamapūjanam ।
utsavena ca mahatā saṃbhārairbahukoṭibhiḥ ।।55 ।।
kṛtaṃ devarṣimunibhirmānavaiścānyajātibhiḥ ।
bahubhaktyā'ti bhāvaiśca sarvasvārpaṇapūrvakam ।।56।।
tena dharmaśca tatpatnyaḥ putrāśca puruṣottamaḥ ।
prasannāḥ saṃbabhūvuścāsīma toṣamupāgatāḥ ।।57।।
niśīthe'mādivasānte pūjā nīrojanottaram ।
tadbhaktebhyo vratibhyaśca darśanaṃ dātumicchavaḥ ।।58।।
samājagmuradṛśyāste vyomni gītyupalakṣitāḥ ।
puruṣottamabhaktānāṃ madhye tvāvirbabhūva ha ।।59।।
sahasā tejasāṃ puṃjaḥ sa ca drāgvyāpa cāmbare ।
koṭikoṭīndusadṛśaṃ ghanībhūtaṃ ca tanmahaḥ ।।60।।
prādurbhūtamatha sthairyaṃ prāpa vidyotayad diśaḥ ।
svarā grāmā mūrchanāśca nādāścāsanmanoharāḥ ।।61।।
tadā tatra ca paśyatsu surādyeṣu manoharā ।
yuvatyadṛśyataikā strī divyarūpā manaḥpriyā ।।62।।।
divyakausuṃbhavasanā divyālaṃkāraśobhitā ।
rūpānurūpasaundaryā prasannā svarṇasūjjvalā ।।63।।
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā sarvā''bharaṇabhūṣitā ।
keśabhāradhṛtapuṣpā susmitabhrūvilāsinī ।।64।।
nirmalā'mbarasaṃvītā kāñcīnūpurabhūṣitā ।
