manāṃsi mohayamānā lāvaṇyenāpi yoṣitām ।।65।।
vipañcīṃ vādayamānā sakhyā'nupūritasvarā ।
gītyaiva mānahantrī ca gandharvāpsarasāmapi ।।66।।
anyāśca dvādaśa nāryo gānaṃ nārāyaṇasya ha ।
cakruḥ satālamānaṃ vai harantyo mānasānyapi ।।67।।
tāsāṃ putrāśca sudivyāḥ prasannāḥ kṛtagāyanāḥ ।
savāditrāśca tanmadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।68।।
adhimāsastathā rādhālakṣmyādyā divyayoṣitaḥ ।
sarve'dṛśyanta tatraiva sabhāyāṃ vedhaso gṛhe ।।69।।
akṣarādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇo'nādiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
āśīrvādān vadan devo'dṛśyata padmalocanaḥ ।।70।।
caturhasto dharmadevo'dṛśyata śvetabhāsvaraḥ ।
vedavākyairvadan bhaktān darśayaँśca prasannatām ।।71।।
brahmādayaśca tān dṛṣṭvā cātyadbhutaṃ tadā viduḥ ।
mugdhāstu kṣaṇamātraṃ te hṛṣṭāścātimudā ca tān ।।72।।
nemuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ viditvaiva tathā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
rādhālakṣmyādikāścāpi dharmaṃ mūrtiṃ sutāँstathā ।।73।।
śraddhādikāstathā natvā tuṣṭuvuḥ paramādarāt ।
nārāyaṇa! namastubhyaṃ nārāyaṇyai namonamaḥ ।।74।।
dharmadeva namastubhyaṃ dhārmikebhyo namonamaḥ ।
śraddhādibhyo namaścāstu namo'stu bhaktimūrtaye ।।75।।
rādhāramādiśaktibhyo namaḥ pumuttamāya ca ।
uddharaṇāya lokānāmasmākaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ।।76।।
darśanaṃ dattavantaḥ stha yūyaṃ vai parameśvarāḥ ।
kṛtārthāḥ sma kṛtā devā atha yuṣmābhiratra vai ।।77।।
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā nideśaścejjñātavyaścopadiśyatām ।
śrutvovāca tadā devān brahmādīn puruṣottamaḥ ।।78।।
puruṣottamamāse'tra bhavadbhirlokanāyakaiḥ ।
prajābhiśca mama bhaktiḥ kṛtā'sminpuruṣottame ।।79।।
dharmaḥ kṛtastathā'tyarthe śraddhādyāḥ poṣitāstathā ।
sakuṭumbaḥ poṣito'haṃ bhūtvā dātuṃ svadarśanam ।।80 ।।
samāgato'smi kṛpayā bhadraṃ vo'stu mahattamam ।
nānyathā darśanaṃ me syātpratyakṣaṃ yogināmapi ।।8 1 ।।
varaṃ vṛṇuta tuṣṭo'smi yūyaṃ matsvābhivāñcchitam ।
iti kṛpāvacaḥ śrutvā praṇemuścakrurarcanam ।।।82।।
vavruścāsmaddhṛdayeṣu vasantu sarvadā tathā ।
rakṣantvasmān nideśasthān pāhi kārye guro sadā ।।83 ।।
bhaktān svadhāmaṃ divyaṃ tvaṃ niṣkāmānnaya mādhava ।
sakāmān pūraya sveṣṭaṃ kṛpāṃ varṣaya varṣaya ।।84।।
iti stutvā viremuste tathāstvityāha keśavaḥ ।
sakuṭumbo varaṃ datvā brahmādibhyaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।।85।।
tirobabhūva sahasā tvāścaryaṃ janayaddhariḥ ।
evaṃ bhagavatā tena svabhaktānāṃ manorathāḥ ।।86।।
pūryante sakalā lakṣmi! rakṣyante tu kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।
puruṣottamabhaktānāṃ nānavāpyaṃ hi vidyate ।।87।।
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccaitatpuruṣottamatoṣaṇam ।
tasya sarvamanaḥkāmān pūrayiṣyati vai hariḥ ।।88।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmadevasya tatpatnīnāṃ tatputrāṇāṃ ca prāvirbhāvastato brahmādikṛtapuruṣottamamāsavratena prasannaśrīhariṇā sakuṭumbena brahmādibhyo darśanaṃ varadānaṃ ca dattamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayo-viṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 323।।।


← adhyāyaḥ 323 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 324
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 325 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ahaṃ lakṣmi! prasannaḥ saṃbhavāmyeṣā kṛpā mama ।
puruṣottamamāse me prāptau kṛpaiva kāraṇam ।। 1 ।।
anyamāseṣvatituṣṭaṃ kartumicchati māṃ yadi ।
tulasīpatramātreṇā'pyatituṣṭo bhavāmyaham ।। 2 ।।
mañjarīsahayuktena patreṇa pūjayejjanaḥ ।
mañjarīyuktapatrābhyāṃ mañjarīyuktapatrakaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
śatena vā daśaśatairlakṣeṇa vā prapūjayet ।
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā ca tuṣyāmi tulasīṃ tvāmiva priye ।। 4 । ।
śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kathaṃ nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa puruṣottama keśava! ।
tulasīṃ manyase toṣakāriṇīṃ māmiva prabho ।। 5 ।।
vada sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ yadi gopyaṃ na vidyate ।
gopyaṃ cāpi yadi pātraṃ matā'smi cennu me vad ।। 6 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ pūrvavṛttāṃ vistāraśālinīm ।
yathā vṛndā mama toṣakāriṇī svīkṛtā mayā ।। 7 ।।
saṃśayaṃ tatra kuru mā śrutvā cerṣyāṃ ca mā kuru ।
sarvadā tu tvayā rakṣyaṃ sauhārdaṃ vṛndayā saha ।। 8 ।।
pativratāyā dharmo'sti duḥkhaṃ na gaṇyate kvacit ।
sapatnījaṃ sukhaṃ patiparā tu gaṇayet sadā ।। 9 ।।
śrutvā śrutvā patisukhaṃ svānyanārīsuyogajam ।
svātmānandaṃ paraṃ matvā tuṣyati strī pativratā ।। 1.324.10 ।।
sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi patnīnāṃ me bhavanti vai ।
vṛndāpi ca mayā patnī kṛtā sā'pi ratā mayi । । 11 ।।
śṛṇvākhyānaṃ yathā jātaṃ tathā te vacmi sarvathā ।
kāryasiddhiṃ miṣaṃ kṛtvā vṛndā patnī mayā kṛtā । । 12 ।।
vṛndā patnī mamaivā''sīd goloke rādhikāsamā ।
rādhikayā samaṃ dṛṣṭvā ramantaṃ māṃ patiṃ svakam ।। 13 ।।
īrṣyayā hṛdaye tāpaṃ prāptā rativirodhinī ।
mahyaṃ vaktumaśaktā sā novāca hṛdayasthitam ।। 14।।
tataḥ kṣaṇāntare rantuṃ mayā''hūtā'pi nā'gatā ।
tena doṣeṇa duṣṭeyaṃ na mā sevitumarhati ।। 1 5।।
iti saṃkalpitaṃ yāvanmayā tāvattu sā tataḥ ।
avāpa tadadholoke gatā cā'surabhāvanām ।। 1 6।।
jalaṃdharaṃ patiṃ prāpya duritaṃ svaṃ samāpya sā ।
jalaṃdharamṛterheturūpāṃ bhuktāṃ mayā yadā ।। 1 7।।
tadā pūtā punarmāṃ sā prāptā me pūrvapatnikā ।
śṛṇu vistarato lakṣmi! tadākhyānaṃ yathā'bhavat ।। 18 ।।
ādye kṛtayuge lakṣmi! śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
satīpatirmahādevo līlayā vyacaradvane ।। 19 ।।
digambarasvarūpeṇa vanināṃ pāvanecchayā ।
siṃhāraṇye cacāreśaḥ siṃhavannirbhayo haraḥ ।। 1.324.20 ।।
śivarātridinaṃ jñātvā mahendraśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।।
sākṣācchivasya pūjārthaṃ svargāt pṛthvīṃ prajagmatuḥ ।।21।।
vyomamārgādvilokyaiva carantaṃ śivameva tau ।।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ guruśakrāvavāteraturādarāt ।।22॥
tāvacchaṃbhustayorjñānaparīkṣārthaṃ vicārya ca ।
rūpāntaraṃ vidhāyaiva hyatiṣṭhannikaṣā tayoḥ ।।23।।
mārgamāruddhya tiṣṭhantaṃ jaṭāsambaddhamastakam ।।
mahātejasvinaṃ nagnaṃ puruṣamadbhutākṛtim ।।24।।
mahābāhuṃ mahoraskaṃ mārgarodhakaraṃ dṛḍham ।
purandaro'pṛcchadenaṃ nisargānnetrabhīṣaṇam ॥25॥
kathaṃ mārgaṃ samāruddhya saṃsthito'si bhayaṃkara ।
atra dṛṣṭo'mbarapathagāmibhyāṃ śaṃkaro haraḥ ।।26।।
sa kvā'ste vada vai śīghraṃ pūjākāmau hi sevakau ।
itipṛṣṭaḥ pumānnaivā'vadat kiṃcit tataḥ punaḥ ।। 27||
tathaivendreṇa pṛṣṭo'pi punarmaunaṃ samāśritaḥ ।
novāca sa mahāyogī tūṣṇīmāsa punaḥ punaḥ ॥28॥
pṛṣṭo'pi tāpaso naivovāca cukrodha vāsavaḥ ।।
uvāca vacanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ nirbhartsyodyamya dakṣiṇam ।।29॥
hastaṃ kṛtvordhvamādāya vajraṃ cādhikṣipan hariḥ ।।
re mūḍha pṛcchyamāno'pi nottaraṃ dattavānasi ।।1.324.30||
eṣa tvāṃ hanmi vajreṇa kaste trāṇaṃ kariṣyati ।
ityudīrya krudhā hantuṃ yatate yāvadeva ha ।।31।।
tāvacchrīśaṃkarastasya cakāra staṃbhanaṃ tadā ।
savajrakarayuktaśca sadeho loṣṭakāṣṭhavat ।।3।।
stabdho jāto mahendro vai samadahyata manyunā ।।
haro'pi vikarālākṣo drutameva bhayaṃkaraḥ ।।33।।
prajajvāla pralayāgnisamo dahanniva sthitaḥ ।।
bṛhaspatistadā śaṃbhuṃ śātvā sattvadhiyā hi tam ।।34!!
baddhāṃjalirnanāmeśaṃ papāta daṇḍavadbhuvi ।।
sabhayena hṛdayena haraṃ stotuṃ pracakrame ।।35।।
namo'gamyasvarūpāya svatantrāya kapardine ।
tryambakāya maheśāya digambarāya te namaḥ ।।36।।
namo raudrāya devāya dīnanāthāya śaṃbhave ।।
virūpākṣāya śāntāya bhaktatrātre namo namaḥ ।।37।।
virūpāyā'titejasvisvarūpāya ca te namaḥ ।।
kālāntakāya śarvāya namaste paramātmane ।।38॥
tvamagnistvaṃ mahāvāyurvyoma tvaṃ salilaṃ dharā ।।
sūryastvaṃ candramāstvaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇi tvameva ha ।।39॥
jyotiścakaṃ tvayi cāste viṣṇurbrahmā tvameva vai ।।
indro bṛhaspatiścānye tvadārādhanataḥ sadā ।।1.324.40।।
sukhinaḥ sampadāṃ bhoktāraścopadravavarjitāḥ ।
bhavanti tatkathaṃ nātha staṃbho'tra suranāyake ।।4 1।।
iti stutvā papātā'sya harasya pādayorguruḥ ।।
pātayāmāsa ca śakraṃ vinayenāha vai punaḥ ।।42।।
prasanno bhava lokeśa pāhīndraṃ śaraṇāgatam ।
krodhaṃ saṃhara śāntaśca kṛpāṃ cendropari prabho ।।43।।
śīghraṃ kuru śamaṃ yātu bhālanetrānalo hyayam ।
kṣantavyaścāparādho'syā'jānatā yaḥ kṛto'dhunā ।।44।।
śrutvā ca vinayaṃ jñātvā saḥ krodhānalabhālakaḥ ।
śaṃkaraḥ prāha taṃ bhaktaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ śanairvaram ।।45।। |
krodho'yaṃ nirgato netrānalo mūrto'tidāruṇaḥ ।।
bahiryāto na dhartuṃ taṃ manye yogyaṃ bṛhaspate ! ।।46।।
nahi sarpa ujjhitāṃ kañcukīṃ dhatte punaśca tām ।।
tiraskurvanta mevainaṃ kariṣye bhasmasāddharim ।।47।।
iti śrutvā bhayaṃ prāpto dīno bṛhaspatiḥ punaḥ ।।
provāca bhagavān bhaktā anukampyāḥ sadaiva yat ।।48।।
bhaktavatsalanāmā'si sārthakaṃ kuru śaṃkara ! ।
prāhīndraṃ cānalaṃ kṣeptumanyatrā'rhasi vai jaḍe ।।49।।
athavendraguruṃ māṃ tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhasmasāt kuru ।
paraṃ devapatiṃ mā tvaṃ dagdhumarhasi śaṃkara ! ।।1.324.5 0
iti śrutvā'tivinayaṃ bhaktavatsalanāmadhṛk ।
praṇatā''rtiharaḥ śaṃbhurbṛhaspatimuvāca ha ।।5।।
prītastavā''graheṇā'tra vinayenā'rpaṇena ca ।
jīvadānaṃ mahendrāya dadāmi nirbhayo bhava ।।5।।
indro jīveti saṃyātu tvaṃ ca jīvātviti prathām ।
sukhinau bhavatāṃ cobhau kurutaṃ mama pūjanam ।।53।।
yadarthaṃ vai samāyātau kṛtvā tatpūjanaṃ mama ।
prasannatāṃ samāgṛhyā''dāya nirbhayatāṃ prathām ।।54।।
yātaṃ svargamahaṃ krodhānalaṃ bhālākṣisaṃbhavam ।।
svayaṃ kare gṛhītvaiva tyakṣyāmi lavaṇāṃbhasi ।।55 ।।
iti kṛtvā''kṣipannetrānalaṃ vahnayaśrurūpiṇam ।।
paścime'pāṃnidhau pūjāṃ gṛhītvobhakṛtāṃ tataḥ ।।56
tatraivā'ntardadhe śaṃbhurvidyullekheva bhāsvaraḥ ।
kṛtārthau ca guruśakrau svasvasthānaṃ prajagmatuḥ ॥57।।
atha kṣiptaṃ bhālanetrasamutthaṃ cātidāruṇam ।
jalaṃ tejomalaṃ cāvilaṃ tu yallavaṇāmbhasi ॥58॥
bālabhāvaṃ samāpannaṃ sadya eva vyarājata ।।
bālaśabdaṃ prakurvan sa bālo jalataraṅgake ॥59।।
dolārūḍha iva prāste jalakallolasevitaḥ ।।
jātamātro yuvā kaścid vajrāṃga iva cādbhutaḥ ॥1.324.60||
prahasan sa muhuḥ śabdaṃ prakurvan divibhedinam ।
punaḥ punaḥ prahasaँśca kurvan hāsyaparamparām ॥61।।
nāditavān diśa: sarvāḥ svargaṃ satyaṃ vyakampayat ।।
prākampata kṣitiḥ sarvāḥ prajāśca badhirīkṛtāḥ ।।62।।
tena hāsyātiśabdena sabalenā'talādayaḥ ।
prākampan dānavāścāpi sarve lokāśca tatrasuḥ ।। 63।।
lokapālā vihvalāśca cacāla sacarācaram ।
agragaṇyā surā lokeśvarāścakampire drutam ।।64।।
militvā satyalokaṃ te brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ । ।
ūcurbhayānvitā: sarve pitarbhayamupasthitam ।।65 !
mahāhāsyakṛtaścāyaṃ śabdo lokabhayaṃkaraḥ ।।
trāsakṛtsarvathā bhāti mahākālasya kiṃ bhavet ।।66।।
kaścid brahmāṇḍayattuṃ vā samāyāto'suro mahān ।।
iti bhāti prabho ! tasmādasmān rakṣaya pūrvaja ! ॥67
śrutvaivaṃ surapālānāṃ vākyaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ ।
bhayaṃ gato'pi sarveṣāṃ sāhāyyamabhigamya ca ।।68॥
gantumaicchat sthalaṃ yatra raudraṃ hāsyaṃ vitanyate ।
śabdadiśāmabhilakṣyā'vātaran vai surādayaḥ ।।69॥
śabdamūlamavācīsthaṃ kṣārasāgaravāriṣu ।
abhisandhāya jagmuste vyomni vai paścimāṃ diśam ।।1.324.70।।
tāvad bālayuvānaṃ prahasantaṃ cāti karkaśam ।
samudrasya taraṃgeṣu vicarantaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।।71।।
dadṛśustāvadāyāto jñātvā vārdhiḥ pumān varaḥ ।।
brahmādīnāgatān dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ cakre'tithikriyām ।।72।।
hāsyaṃ vihāya bālo'pi tatrā''gamat samādravan ।
samudrāṃke niṣasāda pitaḥ pitariti gṛṇan ।।73 ।।
brahmaṇā'bdhistadā pṛṣṭaḥ kuto'yaṃ kasya bālakaḥ ।
brahmāṇḍatrāsakṛd yasya hāsyaṃ vyāpnoti dikṣu ca ।।74।।
śaṃkarasya tu bālo'yaṃ vārdhiḥ prāha pitāmaham ।।
tāvad bālaḥ samutthāya dudrāva vedhasaṃ prati ।।75।।
brahmāṇamagrahīt kaṇṭhe nidhanāya yathā bhavet ।।
vidheḥ kaṇṭhavidhūnanānnetrābhyāmagamajjalam ॥76।।
samudreṇa samākṛṣya brahmā tasmādviyojitaḥ ।।
evaṃ balānvito bālo haraputraḥ surādibhiḥ ।।77।।
vilokito jalādhāro jalaṃdharābhidhaḥ kṛtaḥ ।।
jalaṃdharaḥ samudro'sti jālaṃdharo'pi vārdhijaḥ ।।78
jālaṃdhara iti jāto jālaṃdharo jalaṃdharaḥ ।
rudraputro'styato raudro bhaviṣyati parākrame ।।79।।
śāstrajñaḥ sarvajetā ca śastrāstrajño bhaviṣyati ।।
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vinā rudraṃ bhaviṣyati ।।1.324.80।।
ayaṃ daityaguṇaścādya lokyate'tastathāvidhaḥ ।।
daityeśvaro daityarājo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।81।।
brahmā prāha punarbhāgyaṃ tasya dṛṣṭvā tu sāgaram ।।
kṛṇapatnī tu yā rādhādveṣiṇī tasya dhāmani ।।82।।
goloke rādhikākṛṣṇaratyasahā'bhavat khalu ।
sā golokādū bhagavatā bhūtale'tra nirākṛtā ।।83।।
kālanemigṛhe jātā putrī sā'sya priyā satī ।
pativratā śubhā patnī bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||84
jātamātro yuvā cāsāvabhiṣikto yathā bhavet ।
daityānāṃ rājyakartā vai tathā sarvairvidhīyatām ।।85।।
ityājñāṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya cāhūya śukrameva ha।
ādiśya saritāṃ nāthaṃ taṃ rājye tvabhyaṣecayan ॥86।।
punarbhayaṃkaraṃ hāsyaṃ mā kurviti praśikṣayā ।
śāntayantaḥ surāḥ saveṃ yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ॥87।।
samudraḥ sutamādāya svagehamagamanmudā ।
apoṣayanmahopāyaiḥ kālanemiṃ samāhvayat ।।88
vṛndābhidhāṃ sutāṃ tasya tadbhāryārthamayācata ।
kālanemyasuro vārdheryāñcāṃ mene'tivāñcchitām ।।89||
dadau sutāṃ vidhānena jālaṃdharāya tatkṣaṇam ।
tadotsavo mahānāsīd vivāhe ca tayostadā ।।1.324.90
samudro'pi sukhaṃ prāpa putraṃ dṛṣṭvā hi sastriyam ।
daityāḥ pātālalokasthā jālaṃdharaṃ samāśritāḥ ।।91।।
bhuvamāgatya rājyāni sthāpayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।।
devajayāya ca sarve babhūvurdṛḍhamānasāḥ ।।92।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālandharavṛndākhyāne golokasthakṛṣṇapatnīvṛndāyāḥ rādhākṛṣṇaratiṃ vilokya sapatnīdveṣadoṣeṇa golokādapagatya kālanemiputratvaṃ, śaṃkaradarśanārthaṃ samāgatābhyāṃ siṃhāraṇye śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvā'vātaradbhyāṃ bṛhaspatimahendrābhyāṃ kastvamitipraśnottarā'labdhau śaṃkare vajraprakṣepāyottānitahastasahitendrasya staṃbhanottaraṃ śaṃbhulalāṭanetrajakrodhānalasya samudre prakṣepājjālaṃdharotpattiḥ, vṛndayā saha vivāhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
caturviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥324।।


← adhyāyaḥ 324 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 325
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 326 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā jālandharo vṛndāpatiḥ svayam ।
asuraiḥ saha śukrasya pūjanārthaṃ samāyayau ।। 1 ।।
tatrā''yayuḥ pūjanārthamāṣāḍhapūrṇimātithau ।
daityāśca dānavāḥ sarve rāhuketvādayo'pi ca ।। 2 ।।
śukrācāryaḥ pūjitastairnamaskṛtaśca bhāvukaiḥ ।
datvāśīrvacanaṃ tebhyaḥ papraccha kuśalādikam ।। 3 ।।
dattāsaneṣu sarve te niṣeduḥ saṃsadīṣṭakṛt ।
jalaṃdharo'tisaṃhṛṣṭo'paśyadrāhuṃ śiro vinā ।। 4 ।।
papracchā'bdhisutastatrāścaryapūrvaṃ tu bhārgavam ।
kenedaṃ kartitaṃ rāhośchiro brūhi kathaṃ kadā ।। 5 ।।
ityākarṇya śivaṃ smṛtvā śukrācāryaḥ uvāca tam ।
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahlādastasya putrakaḥ ।। 6 ।।
virocanastasya putro balirājo mahābalaḥ ।
vartate ca rasātalarājyaṃ kurvan prabhaktarāṭ ।। 7 ।।
asurāṇāṃ tu sainyāni prabalānyasya saṃvaśe ।
vartante iti jānanti surāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ ।। 8 ।।
athaikadā tu durvāsā vaikuṇṭhāt samavātarat ।
bhuvaṃ nārāyaṇadattapuṣpamālāṃ kare dadhan ।। 9 ।।
dadarśendraṃ viharantaṃ hastinā vyomamārgake ।
ṛṣirdevapatiṃ jñātvendrāya mālāṃ dadau tadā ।। 1.325.10 ।।
vigaṇayanniva mālāṃ kare dhṛtvā tu vāsavaḥ ।
sthāpitavān karikuṃbhe śuṇḍādaṇḍena tāṃ karī ।। 11 ।।
dhṛtvā pattalake kṛtvā mardayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।
durvāsāḥ krodhamāpannaḥ śaśāpa garvahārakaḥ ।। 12 ।।
lakṣmīnāśo bhavatvindra! mālānāśaphalaṃ tava ।
ityukte sa papātendro hastipṛṣṭhād bhuvastale ।। 13 ।।
lakṣmīḥ sarvā vinaṣṭā'bhūt praviveśa samudrake ।
sahasravarṣaparyantamaśrīkā devatādayaḥ ।। 1 4।।
duḥkhinaste surāḥ sarve rameśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।
vinā lakṣmīṃ duḥkhitāḥ sma iti svārthaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 15 ।।
viṣṇudarśitamārgeṇa sandhiṃ cakrustadā'suraiḥ ।
svakāryasiddhaye śūrāśchaladharmaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 36 ।।
viṣṇusahāyakā devā militā hyasuraiḥ saha ।
lakṣmyarthaṃ cāmṛtādyarthaṃ cakruḥ sindhoḥ pramanthanam ।। 17।।
ratnāni te pituryāni tāni sarvāṇi te surāḥ ।
jagṛhuryatnato dṛptāḥ papurapyamṛtaṃ chalāt ।। 18। ।
amṛtāśca surā jātā garviṣṭhā viṣṇupoṣitāḥ ।
amṛtapānasaṃlabdhā'mṛtabhāvabalānvitāḥ ।। 19 ।।
tata ārabhya daityādīn duḥkhayanti surāḥ sadā ।
parābhavaścāsurāṇāṃ sadā bhavati sarvathā । । 1.325.20 ।।
rāhurayaṃ tadamṛtapānārthaṃ devarūpadhṛk ।
sūryacandrāntare viṣṭo'mṛtaṃ saṃpariveṣitam । । 21 ।।
viṣṇunā pibati yāvat tāvattābhyāṃ niveditaḥ ।
drāgeva viṣṇunā cakradhārayā'yaṃ niṣūditaḥ । । 22 । ।
amṛta gaṇḍūṣamātraṃ gale'sya lagnatāṃ gatam ।
tena nā'yaṃ mṛto rāhurdvedhā chinno'pi kaṇṭhataḥ ।। 23 । ।
dvau jātau rāhurityatra kabandho'yaṃ hi jīvati ।
keturiti śirastvasya saśikhaṃ cāpi jīvati ।। 24।।
evaṃ tena parābhūtā viṣṇunā daityadānavāḥ ।
pitā te ca kṛto rikto ratnānyāhṛtya sarvathā ।। 25।।
evaṃ śukroditaṃ rāhoḥ śiraśchedaṃ ca manthanam ।
ratnopaharaṇaṃ daityaparābhavādikaṃ suraiḥ ।। 26 । ।
tadākarṇya mahāśakto jalaṃdharaḥ pratāpavān ।
cukrodha roṣaraktākṣaḥ śrutvā ca pitṛdharṣaṇām ।। 27 ।।
dūtaṃ tadaiva cāhūya ghasmarākhyaṃ śaśaṃsa tat ।
sammānyā'bhayamādatvā preṣayāmāsa śikṣayan ।। 28 । ।
ghasmara gaccha devendraṃ nivedaya madīritam ।
gṛhāṇa śaraṇaṃ yadvā yuddhārthaṃ susthiro bhava ।। 29 । ।
anyadapi ca prāgjātaṃ piturme dharṣaṇādikam ।
jalaṃdharo na sahate vairamārjanamicchati ।। 1.325.30 ।।
ityādyādāya vākyāni jagāma ghasmaro drutam ।
vargācca ghasmaraḥ sarvaṃ devendraṃ vākyamabravīt । । 31 ।।
jalaṃdharo mahāvīro daityeśvaro'bdhiputrakaḥ ।
tasya vīrasya dūto'haṃ ghasmarastannideśakṛt ।। 32 ।।
preṣitastena vīreṇa cāgatastava sannidhau ।
yadāha śatrujidrājā'vyāhatājñaḥ śṛṇuṣva tat । । 33 ।।
kasmāt tvaṃ mama pitaraṃ samudraṃ mandarādriṇā ।
mathitavān nītavāँśca sarvaratnāni matpituḥ ।। 34।।
śaraṇaṃ me gṛhāṇa tvaṃ ratnāni me prayaccha ca ।
anyathā te bhayaṃ prāptaṃ rājyanāśo bhaviṣyati । । 35 । ।
iti dūtavacaḥ śrutvā provāca dyusadāṃ patiḥ ।
yanmayā vihatā śailāstvatpitrā kukṣirakṣitāḥ ।। 36 ।।
anye'pi maddviṣastena rakṣyante'ntaḥ kathaṃ vada ।
na me śatruvaro bhūtvā drohī sthāsyati kaścana ।। 37 ।।
pūrvaṃ hṛtāni ratnāni hariṣye prāṇato'dhunā।
śaṃkhāsuraṃ mama śatruṃ rarakṣa tvatpitā katham ।। 38 ।।
yaṃ śaṃkhaṃ cā'nujo me vai hatavān viṣṇuravyayaḥ ।
gaccha dūta vada jālaṃdharaṃ manthanakāraṇam ।। 39 ।।
nirdoṣaṃ na mahendro vai daṇḍyaṃ karoti kaṃcana ।
nirdoṣastvaṃ yadidveṣaṃ karoṣi mama nūtanam ।।1.325.40 ।।
phalaṃ śīghraṃ pradāsye'haṃ sajjo bhavā'sureśvara! ।
ityukto ghasmaro vai saḥ śīghraṃ tatra jagāma hi ।। 41 ।।
jalaṃdharo'sti yatrā'bdhau tatrāveditavānidam ।
indroktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā roṣatāmrākṣa eva saḥ ।।।42 ।।
dṛṣṭvā'dharo'karod devān jenumudyogamāsuraiḥ ।
sarvadigbhyaḥ samājagmurāsurā daityadānavāḥ ।। 43 ।।
koṭyabjā'rbudasaṃkhyākā divaṃ jagmurjigīṣayā ।
śuṃbhaniśuṃbhanāmānau kṛtvā senādhināyakau । ।44।।
nirjagāma svayaṃ vīro jalaṃdharo'pi vārdhijaḥ ।
prāpa nākaṃ nandanastho dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ raṇāya saḥ ।।45 ।।
vīradaityāḥ praṇeduścā''vṛtyā'marāvatīpurīm ।
vijñāyendro'pi yuddhāya daṃśitaiśca surottamaiḥ ।। 46।।
saha puryā niryayau vai koṭikoṭyabjayodhibhiḥ ।
tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ surā'suraprasenayoḥ । ।47।।
bāṇairastraistathā mantrairmāyābhiścaindrajālikaiḥ ।
pāṣāṇaiḥ parvatairvṛkṣairulkābhiśca śatacchadaiḥ ।।48 ।।
vajraiścakraiḥ śataghnībhirnārācaistomarairdrumaiḥ ।
muśalaiḥ parighaiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ kuntaiśca śaktibhiḥ ।।49।।
gadābhiḥ paraśubhiśca hastibhiśca rathaiḥ karaiḥ ।
pallatābhirmuṣṭibhirbāhubhiḥ kaphoṇikādibhiḥ ।।1.325.5 0 ।।
te'nyonyaṃ jaghnatuḥ sene saṃmardo'bhūdasaṃkhyakaḥ ।
raktanadyo'bhavan bhūmau kṛtavārdhigamormayaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
patitaiḥ pātyamānaiśca gajavājiprapattibhiḥ ।
vyarājata raṇe bhūmiḥ sandhyābhrapaṭalaṃ yathā ।।।52।।
mṛtān mṛtān raṇe daityāndānavān gajavājinaḥ ।
saṃjīvinyā'jīvayadvai śukro mantritavāribhiḥ ।।53 । ।
surānapi mṛtāँstatrā'jīvayacca bṛhaspatiḥ ।
divyauṣadhairdroṇagirerānītairvividhairmuhuḥ । ।54। ।
mṛtotthitān surān dṛṣṭvā jālaṃdharo'tiroṣavān ।
śukraṃ prāha kathaṃ caitā mṛtā jīvanti devatāḥ । । ।55 । ।
manye sañjīvinīvidyā sureṣvapi gatā tava ।
śrutvā śukraśca taṃ jalaṃdharaṃ prāha suniścitam ।।56 ।।
vidyā sañjivinī naiva sureṣvadyāpi saṃgatā ।
kintvauṣadhīḥ samānīya droṇaśailād bṛhaspatiḥ ।।57।।
surān jīvayati drākca tasmād droṇādrimānaya ।
svādhīnaṃ taṃ kuru yadvā samudrāntaḥ praveśaya ।।58।।
yadalābhe surā naṣṭā jīviṣyanti na vai punaḥ ।
tathā kṛte vijayaste bhaviṣyatyanyathā nahi ।।59।।
śrutvā jalaṃdharo gatvā drutaṃ cotpāṭya parvatam ।
droṇācalaṃ samānīya prākṣipatsāgarāntare ।।1.325.60 ।।
tato devān jaghānā'strairjalaṃdharo mudānvitaḥ ।
hatāndevājjīvayitumoṣadhyarthaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 6 1।।
jagāma droṇabhūmiṃ ca tatrādriṃ na dadarśa saḥ ।
nirāśaḥ sa gururbuddhyā jñātvā'driṃ daityasaṃhṛtam ।। 62।।
devānprāha samāgatya palāyadhvaṃ surā itaḥ ।
droṇādrirnāśito jalaṃdhareṇa vā'nyato hṛtaḥ ।।63 ।।
rudrajanyo hyayaṃ daityo jetuṃ kṣamo na sāmpratam ।
palāyadhvaṃ palāyadhvaṃ ye mṛtāste gatā yataḥ ।।64।।
kathaṃciccheṣapatraistān jīvayiṣye mṛtānaham ।
ityuktāśca surāḥ sarve raṇaṃ tyaktvā palāyitāḥ ।।65।।
devānpalāyitān dṛṣṭvā daityā jalaṃdharānvitāḥ ।
śaṃkhabherījayaghoṣairviviśustvamarāvatīm ।।66।।
svargaṃ tyaktvā bhayād devā devyaśca meruparvate ।
gahvarāṇi samāśritya nyavasan svarirakṣayā ।। 67।।
atha daityo mahāduṣṭo jalaṃdharo'timatsarāt ।
devasthāneṣu rikteṣu daityān samabhiṣecayat ।।68।।
svargarājyaṃ vaśe kṛtvā yayau meruvanāni saḥ ।
devānāṃ nāśanārthāya daityasainyasamanvitaḥ । ।69।।
trastāstataḥ surāḥ sarve vihāya gahvarāṇyapi ।
anāhūtā api jagmurbrahmāṇaṃ prati duḥkhitāḥ ।।1.325.70। ।
tāvat tatrāpi tatsthānaṃ riktaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ suraistadā ।
satyaloke'pi daityānāṃ rājyaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradudruvuḥ ।।71 ।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalatejontarāvaraṇe sthitaṃ sthalam ।
jagmurdevāśca devyaśca brahmāpi tatra dṛśyate । ।72। ।
tuṣṭuvuste hariṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prajeśvarāḥ ।
surarakṣaka śāntātman daityanāśaka te namaḥ । ।73 ।।
matsyātmane ca te viṣṇo vedānnītavate namaḥ ।
amṛtamanthane'driṃ bibhrate kūrmāya te namaḥ । ।74।।
pṛthvīṃ dante bibhrate te varāhāya namo namaḥ ।
baliṃ chalāyate vipravāmanāya ca te namaḥ ।।।75।।
namaḥ paraśurāmāya kāpathakṣatranāśine ।
rāvaṇāntakarāyā''śu rāmacandrāya te namaḥ । ।76।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarādhāramāśrīpataye namaḥ ।
namo buddhasvarūpāya daityamohakarāya te ।।77।।
namaḥ kapilarūpāya tattvajñānapradāya te ।
namo haṃsasvarūpāya vidhātre jñānadāya te ।।78। ।
vedavyāsasvarūpāya vidyāśravāya te namaḥ ।
kalidoṣavināśakṛtkalkirūpāya te namaḥ ।।79।।
pārvatyāśca prabhāyāśca māṇikyāḥ pataye namaḥ ।
kaṃbharāyāḥ suputrāya gopālasūnave namaḥ ।।1.325.80।।
śaraṇyāya surarakṣākartre vidyāvate namaḥ ।
sādhurūpāya kṛṣṇāya vallabhāya ca te namaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
jñānācāryāya daivāya dāsatrātre ca te namaḥ ।
daityaduḥkhitabhaktādirakṣakāya namo namaḥ ।।।82।।
sarvanetrāya hṛtsthāya ramānāthāya te namaḥ ।
dhvajapadmāṃkuśavajrayavacihnavate namaḥ ।।83।।
svastikajāmbvaṣṭakoṇordhvarekhādhāriṇe namaḥ ।
dhanustrikoṇakalaśā'rdhacandradhāriṇe namaḥ ।।84।।
goṣpadavyomamatsyādidhāriṇe pattale namaḥ ।
dakṣapāṇau dhvajacakradhanustriśūlasvastikāḥ ।।851।।
mīnadaṇḍayavarekhā yasya tasmai namo namaḥ ।
bāhū netre jānunī ca nāsikā ca stanāntaram ।।86।।
dīrghāṇi santi te pañca tasmai kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।
suhṛsvajaghanapṛṣṭhagrīvājaṅghāvate namaḥ ।।87।।
sūkṣmakeśā'ṅguliparvaradā'sthidhāriṇe namaḥ ।
kakṣā kukṣiśca vakṣaśca ghrāṇaṃ skandho lalāṭakam ।।88।।
yasyonnatāni ṣaṭ santi tasmai śrīharaye namaḥ ।
netraprāntau nakhāstālu jihvoṣṭhau pādayostale ।।89।।
pāṇitale ca raktāni yasya santi ca te namaḥ ।
uraḥ śiro lalāṭaṃ ca yasya tatāni te namaḥ ।।1.325.90 ।।
svara sattvaṃ ca nābhiśca gambhīraṃ yasya te namaḥ ।
vāmasakthni ramācihnaṃ yasyāsti te namo namaḥ ।।9 1।।
hṛdaye dakṣiṇāvartavate kṛṣṇāya te namaḥ ।
satrivalayaśobhāḍhyanābhiyuktāya te namaḥ ।।92।।
śītabhāsvararūpāyā'mṛtapradāya te namaḥ ।
akṣarāyā'vyākṛtanāmne golokāya te namaḥ ।।93।।
vaikuṇṭhāya badrīśāya śvetadvīpāya te namaḥ ।
kṣīrasthānāya jīvāya jīvātave ca te namaḥ ।।94।।
ātmane ca tadātmane sarvātmane namo namaḥ ।
vahnisthāya ravisthāya hiraṇyasthāya te namaḥ । । 95।।
surā'suranivāsāya bhaktārtihāriṇe namaḥ ।
apakṣāya vipakṣāya bhaktapakṣāya te namaḥ ।। 96 ।।
bhagavaँste kathādhāmne vārtādhāmne ca te namaḥ ।
sarvavidyānivāsāya brahmaṇe te namo namaḥ ।। 97।।
bhagavan devadeveśa pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān ।
jalaṃdhareṇa vai svargaṃ nirākṛtya surāँstataḥ ।। 98 ।।
svāyattīkṛtameveti kathaṃ tvaṃ sahase prabho ।
sūryaścandraśca vahniśca śeṣo dharmo nirākṛtāḥ ।। 99।।
śaraṇaṃ te vayaṃ prāptā vadhastasya vicintyatām ।
vayaṃ kṣudrā iva nātha vicarāmo'ṭavīsthalam ।। 1.325.100 ।।
iti stutvā viremuste devā indrādayastataḥ ।
karuṇāsāgaraḥ kṛṣṇo jagāda nirbhayaṃ vacaḥ ।। 101 ।।
bhayaṃ tyajata vo devāstaṃ gacchāmi jalaṃdharam ।
nāśayāmyadya taṃ śatruṃ devānāṃ duḥkhadaṃ param ।। 102।।
ityuccārya samutthāya garuḍārūḍha eva saḥ ।
yāvadgantuṃ prairayat svavāhanaṃ tāvadeva ha ।। 103 ।।
lakṣmīrbhrāturnidhanaṃ vai bhaviṣyatīti duḥkhitā ।
bāṣpanetrā prāṃjaliśca provāca vallabhaṃ harim ।। 104 ।।
mama bhrātā śālakaste kathaṃ vadhyaḥ kṛpānidhe ।
yadyahaṃ te vallabhāsmi mā tannāśaṃ kuru prabho ।। 1 05।।
viṣṇuḥ prāha sureśānāṃ rakṣaṇāya mayā nanu ।
gantavyaṃ sarvathā tatra mārayiṣye na te'nujam ।। 106 ।।
rudrāṃśatvād brahmavākyāt te vākyānna mama priye ।
māraṇīyo'sti te bhrātā mā viṣādaṃ kuru priye ।। 10 7।।
ityuktvā sāntvayitvā tāṃ yayau yatra jalaṃdharaḥ ।
devādīn saha nītvaiva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 108 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne āṣāḍhapūrṇimāyāṃ śukrācāryapūjakā'surasaṃgheṣu rāhuṃ viśirasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkāraṇaṃ samudramathanāmṛtapāne pakṣapātādi vijñāya suraviṣṇuprabhṛtināśārthaṃ jalaṃdharakṛtasurāsurayuddhottaraṃ suraparājaye vaikuṇṭhaviṣṇustavanādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 325 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 326
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 327 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nārāyaṇa hare viṣṇo mama bhrātrā taduttaram ।
viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvā''caritaṃ kiṃ viṣṇunā kiṃ ca me vada ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! pitā putrī sutastathā ।
sarve'pi caṃcalā lolāstatra kiṃ kiṃ na jāyate ।। 2 ।।
viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvā'tisaṃkruddho balagarvasamanvitaḥ ।
yuddhodyataṃ devasainyaṃ vilokyā'tiruṣā jvalan ।। 3 ।।
daityānājñāpayāmāsa samarārthe jalaṃdharaḥ ।
bho bho daityavarāḥ sarve yuddhārthamamaraiḥ saha ।। 4 ।।
nirgacchantu mahāśastrā yuddhaṃ kurvantu dustaram ।
yathā punarnā''gaccheyurdevāstathā'ntakṛnmahat ।। 5 ।।
tadā mauryā lakṣasaṃkhyā dhaumrāśca śatasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
asurāḥ koṭisaṃkhyākāḥ kālakeyāśca koṭayaḥ ।। 6 ।।
kaṃkā lakṣāstathā śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaparirakṣitāḥ ।
tālajaṃghā mahādaityāḥ koṭiśastatra niryayuḥ ।। 7 ।।
rākṣasā dānavāścāpi koṭyarbudapadātayaḥ ।
sandhībhūya tadā''yātāḥ suranāśārthaniścayāḥ ।। 8 ।।
raṇadhvajāstadā vyomni vyadṛśyanta tu netravat ।
bheryaśca raṇaśṛṃgāṇi cakruśurbhayadāni hi ।। 9 ।।
jalaṃdharājñayā daityā yuyudhire suraiḥ saha ।
astrairbāṇaiśca bhūśuṇḍīśataghnībhiśca dūrataḥ ।। 1.326.10 ।।
dhāvanto'trita āgamya gadābhiḥ śūlatomaraiḥ ।
paṭṭiśaiḥ paraśubhiśca khaḍgaiśca mūśalādibhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
vṛkṣaiśca parvataiścāpi vajraiśca śaktibhistathā ।
nārācaiścārdhacandraiśca sītābhiśca parasparam ।। 12 ।।
nijaghnurdaityasaṃghāste cakraiśca devatā api ।
yuyudhuste mahāvīrāḥ kurvantaḥ siṃhavad ravān ।। 13 ।।
kecid bāṇairhatāścānye hatāḥ kṣatāśca tomaraiḥ ।
kecitparaśuśūlaiśca hatā raṇavanāntare ।। 14।।
daityānāṃ kadanaṃ jātaṃ mahad dṛṣṭvā jalaṃdharaḥ ।
nādayitvā raṇaśṛṃgaṃ svayaṃ cākruśya vai balāt ।। 15 ।।
sabalāndānavān kṛtvā'vātarad raṇamūrdhani ।
ato daityā mahāvīryāḥ samutsāhāstadā'bhavan ।। 16 ।।
samāpetuśca saṃgrāme tvandhā bhūtvā'tidāruṇāḥ ।
mārayantu cchedayantu dvaidhīkurvantu devatāḥ ।। 17।।
mardayantu kūrcayantu cūrṇayantu tilāṃśavat ।
mā'pasarpantu saṃgrāmād homaṃ kurvantu cātmanām ।। 18 ।।
śūrāṇāṃ raṇayajño vai punarnāyāti nā''pyate ।
raktaṃ pibantu devānāṃ bhuñjantu tatpriyāstataḥ ।। 19 ।।
ityākrośo mahānāsīttadānīṃ daityamaṇḍale ।
prahārā sabalā hyāsan daityānāṃ suranāśakāḥ ।।1.326.20।।
na prahārastadā kaścit surā'nāśī pravartate ।
yatra vai dṛśyate tatra dṛśyante devatā hatāḥ ।।21 ।।
ararāṭī tadā tvāsīdviṣṇorhṛdantare kṣaṇam ।
vāsavo'pi vidudrāva surāḥ śeṣā vidudruvuḥ ।। 22।
palāyanaparān dṛṣṭvā viṣṇusteṣu viveśa ha ।
sabalān sarvathā kṛtvā hataśeṣān surān hariḥ ।।23।।
yuddhārthamāhvayāñcakre garuḍasthaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
jīvayiṣye surānsarvānnāśayiṣye tu dānavān ।। 24।।।
mā palāyantu saṃgrāmādahaṃ yotsye'grago bhavan ।
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ svasya sudarśanāttadā ।।25।।
sudarśanānāṃ lakṣāṇi racayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।
prerayāmāsa tānyeva hantuṃ senāṃ tu dānavīm ।। 26।।
agnīṃśca lakṣaśaḥ kṛtvā prerayāmāsa cāsurīm ।
senāṃ hantuṃ hariścāpi sudarśanaṃ samairayat ।।27।।
agnicakrāṇyasurān saṃpradehurbhasmasādyathā ।
etadvilokya devāśca nijaghnurvai palāyitān ।।28।।
āhvayanto'tidhṛṣṭāśca jayecchavo'tidāruṇāḥ ।
viṣṇurjalena saṃprokṣya mṛtānutthāpayattathā ।। 29।।
te'pi jaghnurvegiśastrairastraiśca dānavāँstadā ।
viṣṇuḥ paśyati sarvatra dānavā trastatāṃ gatāḥ ।।1.326.30 ।।
chinnā naṣṭāḥ kartitāśca dṛśyante'raṇyavattadā ।
śeṣā vidudruvuḥ svargāt parityajya raṇāṃgaṇam ।। 31।।
evaṃ parājayastatrā'surāṇāmabhavanmahān ।
asoḍhā tasya sāmudro devavṛndabhayaṃkaraḥ ।।32।।।
yoddhumabhyāyayau śukraṃ nirdiśyā''surajīvanam ।
śukraśca vidyayā daityāndagdhānajīvayad drutam ।।33।।
jalaṃdharo mahānādaṃ cakāra karṇadīrṇakam ।
bhayaṃkareṇa nādena tadā cā''pūritaṃ jagat ।।34।।
viṣṇoścāpi praṇādena cakampe sakalaṃ jagat ।
dhanuṣyubhau samādāya ṭaṃkāraravakāriṇau ।।35।।
yuyudhāte svasṛpatiśālākau hi vipakṣagau ।
ākāśaṃ kurvato bāṇaistadā niravakāśavat ।।36।।
viṣṇurbāṇairasurasya dhvajaṃ chatraṃ dhanuśśarān ।
ciccheda ca hṛdaye taṃ bāṇenā'tāḍayad dṛḍham ।।37।।
tāvadutplutya daityendro gadāpāṇirhariṃ prati ।
padbhyāṃ dhāvan balānmūrdhni garuḍaṃ hatavān ruṣā ।।38।।
viṣṇuṃ jaghāna śūlena hṛdaye'tiprasahya vai ।
viṣṇuḥ khaḍgena tīkṣṇena gadāṃ ciccheda śūlakam ।। 39 ।।
tāvad daityaḥ punaścānyad dhanuḥ kṛtvā śarānvitam ।
viṣṇuṃ jaghāna hṛdye khaḍgaṃ cicched cāpi vai ।।1.326.40 ।।
viṣṇuścārdhena khaḍgena chitvā taṃ bāṇamāgatam ।
śārṅge śīghraṃ samādāya prairayad bāṇamulbaṇam ।।4 1 ।।
daityastaṃ sītayā pracyāvya ruṭchinnādharo balī ।
śarāntareṇa 3 śārṅgaṃ dhanuściccheda vaiṣṇavam ।।42 ।।
punarbāṇaiścātitīkṣṇairviṣṇuṃ jaghāna vakṣasi ।
chinnadhanvā hariḥ kaumudakīṃ cikṣepa vai gadām ।।43 ।।
sā vidyudvadapradhṛṣyā sāmudro'pi tathābalaḥ ।
gadayā tāḍyamāno'pi na cacāla hi kiñcana ।।44।।
daityastriśūlamanalāvarṣiṃ vai haraye'kṣipat ।
harirnandakakhaḍgena ciccheda tat triśūlakam ।।45।।
daityaḥ śaktiṃ vajrajanyāṃ lambāṃ yojanamātrakām ।
aṣṭadhārāṃ ca sahasraghaṇṭāṃ śailādināśinīm ।। 4 6।।
samādāya prāhiṇodvai vināśāya harestadā ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt sureṣu vai bhayaṃkaraḥ ।।47।।
daityasya cāntimaṃ vajraṃ tadabhūcchaktirūpakam ।
nāśayāmi yadi cedvai nāyaṃ yuddhaṃ kariṣyati ।।48।।
tasmād garuḍacañcvā taṃ gṛhītvā svavaśe tataḥ ।
dāsye prāpya vijayaṃ ca yena yuddhaṃ bhavetpunaḥ ।। 49 ।।
iti vicārya hariṇā pakṣicañcvā dhṛtā hi sā ।
āyāntī rakṣitā svasya pakṣipakṣaikapicchake ।। 1.326.50 ।।
dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ mahatprāpto'sura āgatya cāmbarāt ।
nipatya hṛdye viṣṇuṃ jaghāna dṛḍhamuṣṭinā ।।5 1 ।।
garuḍasya gale tadvajjaghāna pādalattayā ।
tadā tu viṣṇunā daityo dhṛto śirasi vai dṛḍham ।।52 ।।
garuḍena tu daityaḥ sa dhṛtaścañcvā tu pādayoḥ ।
uttolya kṣiptaḥ patito dūre vai śatayojanam ।। 53 ।।
punarutthāya cāyāto vyomamārgeṇa cābdhijaḥ ।
tāvadviṣṇuścātiruṣṭo jaghāna hṛdi taṃ punaḥ ।।5 4।।
sa ca viṣṇuṃ jaghānaiva hṛdi muṣṭyā punaḥ punaḥ ।
garuḍopari tatraiva yuyudhāte mahābalau ।।।55।।
bāhubhirmuṣṭibhiścaiva jānubhirmaraṇonmukhaiḥ ।
gaṇayitvā na maraṇaṃ daityastu yuyudhe balī ।।56।।
martavyaṃ vā vijetavyaṃ lābho dvaye'pi me'sti hi ।
kva vai viṣṇoḥ karānmṛtyuḥ kva vā viṣṇuvijetṛtā ।।57।।
dvayorlābho mahānasti yadbhāvi bhavatu dhruvam ।
ityālocya matiṃ tasya mṛtyuṃ śaṃbhukṛtaṃ tathā ।। 58 ।।
prahasya bhagavānprāha dhanyastvaṃ raṇadurmadaḥ ।
mamā'gre'pyavināśino vināśāya pataṃgavat ।।59 ।।
yastvaṃ jīvaṃ tathā prāṇānsamarpya raṇamūrdhani ।
samāyātaḥ kṣātradharmaṃ pālayan śaṃkarātmajaḥ ।।1.326.60 ।।
mamā'straistvaṃ na vai bhīto yairvīrā bahavo hatāḥ ।
na dṛṣṭastvatsamo vīro galagrāhaprayuddhakṛt ।। 61 । ।
varaṃ varaya daityendra prīto'smi tava vikramāt ।
adeyamapi deyaṃ te tvādṛśāya raṇāṃgaṇe ।। 62 । ।
varasya samayaṃ jñātvā jalaṃdharo'pi buddhimān ।
pratyuvāca hariṃ lakṣmi! svavaśaṃ gamayan prabhum ।। 63 ।।
yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavan! varaṃ dadāsi ced yadi ।
madbhaginyā mayā sārdhaṃ madgehe sagaṇo vasa ।। 64।।
tacchrutvā ca tathāstviti jagād bhagavān hi tam ।
tato lakṣmyā tathā parivāreṇa sahitaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 65 ।।
jalaṃdharagṛhaṃ gatvā jalaṃdhareṇa pūjitaḥ ।
uvāsa vacanād baddhaḥ pratīkṣan punarardanam ।।6 1। ।।
jalaṃdhareṇa medinyāṃ puraṃ jālaṃdharaṃ kṛtam ।
rājyaṃ ca bahulaṃ pṛthvyāmāsamudrāntamāsthitam ।। 67।।
svargādau dānavāḥ sarve niyuktā adhikāriṇaḥ ।
pātālādau kṛtā daityā adhikāraparāḥ svayam ।।68 । ।
pṛthvyāṃ paścimavārdheśca madhye dvīpe hyuvāsa saḥ ।
devagandharvasiddheṣu yatkiṃcidratnamācitam ।।6 9।।
svāyattīkṛtya tatsarvaṃ bubhuje'kaṇṭakaṃ talam ।
devagandharvasiddheśān sarparakṣonareśvarān ।।1.326.7 0 ।।
svadvīpe nāgarān kṛtvā śaśāsa bhuvanatrayam ।
devā yuddhe mṛtā ye ye tānparyajīvayaddhariḥ ।।7 1 ।।
daityā ye ye hatāstāँśca śukraḥ saṃparyajīvayat ।
devāḥ punargatā mervādyaraṇyādau yathā purā ।।72 ।।
phalaṃ labdhaṃ na vai kiñcittuṣāvaghātavaddhyabhūt ।
sarvatra bhuvaneṣvāsīd vārtā viṣṇuḥ parājitaḥ ।।73 ।।
bhaktyādhīno bhavatyeva vaśī nānyena kenacit ।
lakṣmyā ca śālakenāpi snehena sa vaśīkṛtaḥ ।।74।।
devakāryaṃ vihāyaiva śālakagṛhamāśritaḥ ।
devā nirāśrayā jātā duḥkhitāḥ śaraṇaṃ vinā ।।75।।
devyo'pi duḥkhamāpannā asurairbhūri cārditāḥ ।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ viṣṇurvṛndālatāṃ śritaḥ ।।76 ।।
atha daityavināśo vai śīghraṃ syādityacintayat ।
antarātmagatād devāt kṛṣgānārāyaṇātprabhoḥ ।।77।।
devā devyaśca ye jālaṃdharadvīpe tu nāgarāḥ ।
abhavaँste tathā cānye yathā jñāyet nā'suraḥ ।।78 ।।
tathā vicārya śreṣṭhāste jagmuḥ śaṃkarasannidhau ।
tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ sveṣāṃ duḥkhasya vinivṛttaye ।।7 9।।
athā''hūya mahādevo nāradaṃ kuśalakriyam ।
preṣayāmāsa tatpūryāṃ devakāryacikīrṣayā ।।1.326.80 ।।
nārado'pi yayau śīghraṃ jālaṃdharapure tadā ।
devānpūrvaṃ militvā ca jñātvā duḥkhaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
devakṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ ca gṛhītvā'tithisatkriyām ।
śrutvā sūryaśaśidharmavahniniḥsāraṇādikam ।।82।।
viṣṇoḥ parājayaṃ śrutvā jalaṃdharasya cānayam ।
surānāśvāsayitvā jñāpayitvā kāryasiddhaye ।।8 3 ।।
yathābuddhi devakāryaṃ kariṣye hyabhidhāya ca ।
natvā devān yayau jalandharasabhāmṛṣiḥ svayam ।।84।।
āgataṃ muniṃ jalaṃdharo natvā''sanaṃ dadau ।
saṃpūjya vidhivad daityaḥ prahasyā''ha tu nāradam ।।85।।
kuśalaṃ te muniśreṣṭha! kuta āgamyate itaḥ ।
yadarthamiha cāyāto vijñāpaya karomi tat ।।86 ।।
prasannātmā nāradastacchrutvā provāca cāsuram ।
dhanyastvaṃ balavān rājā rājendro vartase'dhunā ।।87।।
sarvaratnaprabhoktā'si tathā'haṃ śrutavān divi ।
paścācca śrutavān bhogān śaṃkarasyottamottamān ।।88 ।।
yojanā'yutavistīrṇe kalpadrumamahāvane ।
kāmadhenuśatā''kīrṇe cintāmaṇisudīpite 89।।
sarvarukmamaye divye sarvatrā'dbhutaśobhite ।
yānavāhanadāsaiśca dāsībhiḥ paricārite ।।1.326.90 ।।
kailāśaśikhare tatra dṛṣṭavān śaṃkaraṃ hyaham ।
sarvāṃgasundaraṃ gauraṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam ।।9 1 ।।
ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣābhiryuvatībhiḥ susevitam ।
candrapiṇḍakṛtābhirvā sūryasvarṇaniḥsṛtābhiḥ ।।92।।
naikasundarībhiḥ śivo modate tatra parvate ।
athā'vicārayaṃ paścācchrutaṃ jālaṃdharaṃ sukham ।।93 ।।
kīdṛg bhavettathā smṝddhiretādṛśī bhavenna vā? ।
iti vitarkya sāścaryaṃ samāgato'smi te gṛham ।।94।।
tadvilokanakāmo'haṃ tvatsānnidhyamihāgataḥ ।
dvīpaste subhagaścāsti hyudyānavanamaṇḍitaḥ ।।95।।
parīto jalakhātena śobhito'stīti sundaram ।
ityuktavantaṃ daityaḥ sa darśayāmāsa sarvathā ।।96।।
smṛddhimantargṛhā bāhyagṛhā gahvarasaṃsthitām ।
dṛṣṭvā śaśaṃsa munirāḍ vitarkya devalābhakṛt ।।97।।
viṣṇupreraṇayā prāha daityaṃ mohaṃ yathā''viśet ।
aho tava samṛddhestu pāraṃ nāsti jalaṃdhara ।।98।।
trailokyādhipatigṛhe bhavedeva na citrakam ।
bhavanāni vicitrāṇi yānāni vāhanāni ca ।। 99।।
upakaraṇāni ratnapūjāśca maṇiśevadhiḥ ।
mauktikāni hīrakāśca suvarṇaśatabhūmayaḥ ।। 1.326.10 0।।
gajādyā vājinaścāpi nā'nyatra santi te yathā ।
śaktasyairāvataścātra sūryasyoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ ।। 10 1।।
kalpamandāravṛkṣāśca nidhayo dhanadasya ca ।
brahmaṇo haṃsayānaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ garuḍa ityapi ।। 102।।
yamasya mahiṣaścāpi viṣṇoḥ sudarśanaṃ tathā ।
śeṣarājamaṇiścāpi candrasya cāmṛtaṃ tathā ।। 1 03।।
manvantarāṇāṃ chatrāṇi suvarṇayaṣṭayastathā ।
cāmarāṇi digīśānāṃ devīnāṃ kaṃkaṇāni ca ।। 1 04।।
evaṃ sarvāṇi ratnāni bhānti tāni gṛhe tava ।
pramadānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ śreṣṭhatvaṃ cāpi te'sti vai ।। 105 ।।
kintu naikamapi jāyāratnaṃ tai bhāti tādṛśam ।
yādṛśaṃ śaṃkarā'gre'sti tāvān nyūno'sti vai bhavān ।। 106 ।।
śreṣṭhena jāyāratnena sūryacandranibhena vai ।
bhavanāni praśobhante rājño na smṛddhibhistathā ।। 1 07।।
kirātībhistu lakṣābhiḥ śobhate na nṛpagṛham ।
yathā tvaṃ digyaśā bhāsi na tvatpatnī tathā'sti vai ।। 1 08।।
yadvā kiṃ śubhradāsībhiryaśaścenna vivāhitā ।
śuklāṃ jāyāṃ vinā sarvaṃ pherurājagṛhopamam ।। 1 09।।
na vai vivāhitāṃ vinā śobhā rājño bhavetkvacit ।
rājyamātā bhaved devī divyā vaṃśavivardhinī ।। 1.326.110 ।।
nahi dāsīpralakṣāsu kumāro nṛpatermataḥ ।
dāsījāḥ śataśaścāpi nābhiṣekā'rhaṇā matāḥ ।। 111 ।।
tadānetuṃ kumārīṃ tvaṃ strīratnaṃ cārhasi dhruvam ।
ahaṃ gacchāmi lokeṣu ratnānāṃ yatra saṃgrahaḥ ।। 11 2।।
śrutvaivaṃ cāha devarṣiṃ jalaṃdharo'timānavān ।
devarṣe ca yathāsarvaratnānāṃ śraiṣṭhyamasti me ।। 113 ।।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu tādṛk śreṣṭhottamottamam ।
bhavitā yadi vijñātaṃ bhaved darśaya me matam ।। 1 14।।
bhavatā sarvato dṛṣṭā nāryo rājñyaśca kanyakāḥ ।
vedhasāṃ śaṃkarāṇāṃ ca viṣṇūnāṃ cāpi kanyakāḥ । । 115 । ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ cāpi kanyakāḥ ।
mānavānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām ।। 116 ।।
sarvāśca kanyakā mune tvayā dṛṣṭāḥ samantataḥ ।
sarvātiśayasaundaryarūpayauvanasadguṇāḥ । । 117 ।।
yatra vasanti tadratnaṃ pradarśaya nayāmi tat ।
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ rājñīnāṃ saṃsadi mama ।। 118 ।।
patnīrūpaṃ prakāśyeta sūrya iva mahojjvalam ।
yatsamaṃ na bhavedanyadadhikaṃ tu kathaṃ bhavet ।। 119 ।।
tādṛśaṃ darśaya vidvan nayāmi vivahāmi ca ।
yadagre sarvarājñyaśca pataṅgya iva sarvathā ।। 1.326.120 ।।
bhaveyustādṛśaṃ kumārikāratnaṃ vahāmyaham ।
śrutvaivaṃ nāradaḥ prāha vartate tādṛśaṃ khalu ।। 121 । ।
ekamevātra brahmāṇḍe kumārīratnamuttamam ।
yadagre sarvanārīṇāṃ saundaryaṃ bhasmitendhanam ।। 122 ।।
mayā'pi yaddināddṛṣṭaṃ taddināt tadavāptaye ।
prayatyate punargatvā nidrāṃ labhe na śarmadām ।। 123 । ।
hṛdaye cakṣuṣorvṛttau svapne tathā ca jāgare ।
mastake'pi ca sā kanyā ramate smṛtimāgatā ।। 124 ।।
kiṃ saundaryaṃ ca kiṃ rūpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ yauvanaṃ tathā ।
yannakhāgre'pi tejo'sti yatra kṛṣṇāyate śaśī ।। 125 ।।
yanmukhe gaṇḍayorbhāgau tathā cāpi kapolayoḥ ।
klṛptāścatvāra evātra sūryāḥ kiṃ staśca tādṛśau ।। 126 ।।
kiyanmadhyakaṭistasyāḥ kiyatkāmasthalaṃ tathā ।
kiyatprodbhinnabhāvāḍhyastanadvayaṃ kiyat kiyat ।। 127 ।।
vidyullatā yathā tatra tatra vasanti vai kimu ।
mayā na prāpyate rājaँstvayā kathaṃ sa cāpyate ।। 128 ।।
tathāpi kuru yatnaṃ tvaṃ prāpsyate tajjayastava ।
prāptavyaṃ vāpi martavyamiti kṛtvā prayatyatām । । 129 ।।
nā'nyathā tadbhavetkāryaṃ śūrāṇāṃ kimasādhyakam ।
kailāse tadvartate'dya śaṃbhorhastatale sthitam ।। 1.326.130 ।।
śaṃbhoḥ patnīsvarūpeṇa cā'kṣata tena yoginā ।
śaṃbhustu vartate yogī samādhau tiṣṭhati dhruvam ।। 131 ।।
na spṛśati tāṃ nārīṃ kanyārūpāṃ vicintya saḥ ।
atyadbhutāṃ rakṣati sma sarvathā yogasiddhibhiḥ । । 132 । ।
jāyāratnena sadṛśastrilokyāṃ śaṃbhunā khalu ।
nāsti kaściditi manye pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭavān yataḥ । । 133 । ।
yasyāḥ pādāvalokena brahmā reto hyavāsṛjat ।
kāmo'pi tāṃ vilokyaiva mumoha bhasmatāṃ gataḥ ।। 1 34।।
tadratnaṃ tvakṣataṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo bhavātra vai ।
no cet prāṇān vihāyaiva paralokaṃ samāśraya ।। 1 35।।
ityuktvā nārado devapūjyo devahitārthakṛt ।
yayau devāँśca vijñāpya kalāṃ daityavināśinīm ।। 136 ।।
devā api sutuṣṭāśca viṣṇuṃ gatvā sa nāradaḥ ।
sarvaṃ tadabravīnnatvā yayau satyaṃ svakaṃ sthalam ।। 1 37।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne'surasurasainyayuddhaṃ, mṛtā'surasurāṇāmujjīvanaṃ, jalaṃdharaviṣṇvośca yuddhaṃ, prasannena viṣṇunā jalaṃdharagṛhe vāsātmakavarapradānaṃ, punardevānāṃ duḥkhaṃ, śaṃkarāya nivedanaṃ, nāradasya jalandharagṛhaṃ pratigamanaṃ, surūpāyā bhāryāyā pārvatyā ānayanāya jalandharasya mohanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 326 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 327
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 328 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nārāyaṇa mahārāja jalaṃdhareṇa śatruṇā ।
nārade tu prayāte vai tato'nuṣṭhitameva kim ।। 1 ।।
vada vistarato nātha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ।
jalaṃdharo mahādaityaḥ pārvatyarthe kimācarat ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato daityo nāradoktānusārataḥ ।
prayatnaṃ kṛtavān samyak kathayāmi yathātatham ।। 3 ।।
tāmeva cintayan tanvīmanaṃgaśarapīḍitaḥ ।
kālādhīnā'lpabhāgyaḥ saḥ praṇaṣṭadhīrvimohitaḥ ।। 4 ।।
sudūtamāhvayāmāsa saiṃhikeyaṃ vicakṣaṇam ।
āgataṃ taṃ mahārāhuṃ prāha kāryaprasādhaka! ।। 5 ।।
mama kāryasya siddhyarthaṃ kailāsaṃ gaccha parvatam ।
tatra yogī śaṃkaro'sti yo na spṛśati strīvarām ।। 6 ।।
tasya hastagataṃ kanyāratnaṃ cāstīti nāradaḥ ।
māmuvāca ca tadratnaṃ mayā prāptavyameva ha ।। 7 । ।
pārvatītyabhidhānaṃ tanmayā prāptavyameva hi ।
tatra gatvā tu vaktavyaṃ nirbhayena hṛdā tvayā ।। 8 ।।
vanavāsinmahāyogin jāyāratnena kiṃ nu te ।
dehi tanme jalaṃdharanāmne ratnabhuje hara ।। 9 ।।
yāni yāni tu ratnāni trailokye tāni sarvaśaḥ ।
mama gṛhe mayā rājñā cānītāni balāttataḥ ।। 1.327.10 ।।
airāvata uccaiḥśravāḥ kalpaśca pārijātakaḥ ।
haṃsayuktavimānaṃ ca vajra śaktiśca cāmaram ।। 11 ।।
mauktikāni hīrakāśca chatraṃ prakhyātimacca yat ।
tatsarvaṃ mama bhogyaṃ vai mayā''nītaṃ mama gṛhe ।। 1 2।।
nidhayaśca mahāmālā pāśo daṇḍastathā'mṛtam ।
sarvaṃ tanmadgṛhe cāsti kanyāratnaṃ vinā hara ।। 13 ।।
yoginaste navakanyā na spṛśyā dīyatāṃ hi me ।
ityājñāṃ prāpya rāhuśca yayau yatra sa śaṃkaraḥ ।। 14।।
nandinā''diṣṭadūtatvāt sabhāmadhye praveśitaḥ ।
śaṃkaraṃ divyasarvāṃgaṃ divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ।। 15।।
praṇanāma haraṃ tatra gatavān nikaṭaṃ tathā ।
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ cāsmi dūto jalaṃdharasya vai ।। 1 6। ।
trailokyapatinā muktastvatsakāśamihā''gataḥ ।
yoginaṃ tvāṃ samudiśya sa yadāha śṛṇuṣva tat ।। 17।।
kanyāratnaṃ svarṇakāntaṃ candrapiṇḍasamaṃ tava ।
yogino nopayuktaṃ syād dehi me tvaṃ digambara ।। 18 ।।
ahaṃ ratnaprabhoktā'smi tat strīratnaṃ na te bhavet ।
bhikṣāśinaḥ kuto ratnaṃ bhāryāratnaṃ tu bhūbhṛtaḥ ।। 1 9।।
trailokye yāni ratnāni tānyāhṛtāni sarvaśaḥ ।
mayā ceyaṃ śubhā kanyā ceṣyate dīyatāṃ nu me ।। 1.327.20 ।।
svastrīratnaṃ dehi mahyaṃ rājñaḥ sukhakarāḥ prajāḥ ।
trailokyāntargatatvāt tvaṃ prajā bhavasi me hara ।। 21 ।।
paśya lakṣmi! hatabuddhiḥ pitaraṃ prāha mātaram ।
pārvatīṃ me dehi ceti māyā vai kīdṛśī hareḥ ।। 22।।
hatadhiyo'tra loke vai mātṛkāmā'bhicintakāḥ ।
sarve jalandharā bodhyā viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ ।। 23 ।।
satīṣvapi ca dāsīṣu parāṃganāṃ samīhate ।
so'pi jalaṃdharo bodhyo vināśamukhamantritaḥ ।। 24।।
śṛṇu paścāttu yajjātaṃ rāhau vadati tatkṣaṇam ।
samutpanno mahāraudro gaṇastīvrāśanisvanaḥ ।। 2-5 ।।
bhrūmadhyādīśaroṣādvā sajvālanayano mahān ।
siṃhā''syapracalajjihvaścordhvakeśo bhayaṃkaraḥ ।। 26।।
tālajaṃgho'bhidudrāva kṣudhayā rāhumāturaḥ ।
khādituṃ tu samāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā'dhāvacca rāhukaḥ ।। 27।।
tathāpi taṃ saḥ prasahya rāhuṃ dadhāra khāditum ।
ākruśya śaṃkaraṃ prāha rāhuḥ pāhi prapannakam ।।28।।
trāhi trāhi prabho pāhi rakṣa rakṣa kṛpānidhe ।
khādatyayaṃ sevakaste dūtaṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 29 । ।
na khādettu yathāyaṃ māṃ tathā rakṣaya śaṃkara ।
brāhmaṇaṃ māṃ na khādedvai namaste'stu kṛpāṃ kuru ।। 1.327.30 ।।
brāhmaṇeti vacaḥśrutvā śaṃkaraḥ svagaṇaṃ tadā ।
abravīd dūta mā khāda brāhmaṇaṃ rāhunāmakam । । 31 ।।
iti śrutvā dūtavaco mumoca taṃ subhojanam ।
śaṃbhuṃ prāha kṣudhito'smi tyājitaṃ mama bhakṣyakam ।। 32 । ।
kṣudhā māṃ bādhate śaṃbho dehi bhakṣyaṃ maheśvara ।
śivaḥ prāha bubhukṣā te yadyatīva pravartate । । 33 ।।
kṣudhā tvāṃ bādhate'tyarthaṃ svamāṃsaṃ bhakṣayā'tra vai ।
hastapādādikaṃ svasya bhakṣayā'treti cājñayā । । 34 । ।
cakhāda sa gaṇaḥ sarvaṃ svamāṃsaṃ svakabandhajam ।
yadā'bhavacchiraḥ śiṣṭaṃ prasannaḥ śaṃkarastadā ।। 35 ।।
uvāca he mahābhakta madājñāpratipālaka! ।
santuṣṭo'smi vada tubhyaṃ kiṃ dadāmi bhayaṃkara! । । 36 । ।
mayā saha prapūjyatvaṃ kīrtimukhābhidhānakam ।
dadāmi te mahāvīra! vasa dvāri mama gṛhe । । 37 ।।
tadāprabhṛti śaṃbhoścālayadvāri sa tiṣṭhati ।
pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa śaṃbhoḥ santoṣahetave । । 38 ।।
atha rāhurgato yatra jalaṃdharaḥ pratiṣṭhati ।
svasva mṛtyuṃ nivedayāmāsa yathā ca jīvanam । । 39 । ।
jalaṃdharastu saṃkruddhaḥ śrutvā śaṃkaraceṣṭitam ।
dūtā'vamānaṃ gaṇayan svāvamānaṃ mahat kṛtam ।।1.327.4 0 ।।
uvāca daityamūrdhanyān sajjā bhavantu vai kṣaṇāt ।
nirgacchantvakhilā daityāḥ kālanemyādayastathā ।। 41 । ।
śuṃbhaniśuṃbhamukhyāśca koṭayo vīravaṃśajāḥ ।
kaṃbuvaṃśyā daurhṛdāśca kālakeyāśca kālakāḥ ।। 42 ।।
mauryā dhaumrāstathā cānye dānavāścāsurāstathā ।
sajjāḥ samāgatāḥ sarve tānādāya jalaṃdharaḥ । ।43 । ।
nirjagāmāśu daityānāṃ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
agre rāhuśchinnaśiro'maṃgalāya kṛto'bhavat । । 44। ।
śukraḥ kāṇo'maṃgalāya dvitīyo'pyagrago'bhavat ।
śuṃbhasya tu khaḍgo hastātpatito'maṃgalāya saḥ । ।45 ।।
niśuṃbhādeḥ kṣuvanaṃ ca gatau skhalanamityapi ।
jalaṃdharasya śiraso mukuṭo'patadityapi ।।46 ।।
amaṃgalāya tatsarvaṃ prasthāne'bhavadārtikṛt ।
mahānidrāsūcakāścā'śakunānyabhavannapi ।।।47।।
tadā trastāḥ surā guptā agacchan śaṃkaraṃ prati ।
tuṣṭuvurduṣṭanāśāya devānāṃ sukhalabdhaye ।।48 ।।
dhyānamagna mahādeva! samādhistha! namo'stute ।
jalaṃdharastava putro vināśāya samarpitaḥ ।।49 ।।
surāṇāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtvā pārvatyā dharṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
tavā'vamānaṃ kṛtvā ca tato nāśāya kalpitaḥ ।। 1.327.50 ।।
kiṃ vā pūrvaṃ kṛpānātha daityo nāśāya kalpitaḥ ।
kiṃ vai tvayā tathā lakṣmīpatinā'sti praṇiścitam ।।5 1 ।।
viṣaprāśottarāt pūrva varaṃ viṣavināśanam ।
duṣṭakṛddharṣaṇāt pūrvaṃ varaṃ duṣṭe pradaṇḍanam ।।।52 ।।
viṣṇustasya gṛhe śete vṛndayā parisevitaḥ ।
śaṃkaraḥ svagṛhe śete brahmaṇi svasamādhinā ।।53 ।।
pārvatyāścātra kiṃ bhāvi vicāraya prabholaka ।
devānāṃ durdaśāṃ cāpi vilokaya praśaṃkara ।।54।।
brahmā brahmāṇḍaracane nivṛttiṃ naiva yāti ca ।
dikpālā lokapālāśca jalaṃdharavaśaṃgatāḥ ।।55 ।।
rakṣako vidyate naiva lakṣmīstasya sahāyinī ।
tvaṃ bhava rakṣako'smākaṃ sthānabhraṣṭā'kṛtātmanām ।।56 ।।
jahi no rakṣaṇārthāya putra te sāgarātmajam ।
sa cāyāti tvayā kartuṃ raṇaṃ balena garvitaḥ ।।57 ।।
hantumarhasyavilambāt taṃ viruddhārthagāminam ।
duḥkhitaśca surān sarvān pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān ।।58।।
iti devavacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇuṃ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ ।
viṣṇuḥ śīghraṃ samāyāto na jānīyād yathā'suraḥ ।।।59।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha hariṃ viṣṇo! jalaṃdharaḥ kathaṃ tvayā ।
niṣūdito na cādyāpi kathaṃ vasasi tadgṛhe ।।1.327.60 ।।
viṣṇuḥ prāha mahādeva śrībhrātā ca tavātmajaḥ ।
itihetorhato naiva tvamenaṃ jahi śaṃkara! ।। 61 ।।
mayā kṛto raṇastena prāṇagrāheṇa sarvathā ।
lakṣmyā nivāritaścāhaṃ mārayāmāsa naiva tam ।। 62 ।।
na sa vai māritaḥ śaṃbho tava gauravakāraṇāt ।
vareṇa svālaye cāhaṃ vāsito'smi na pakṣagaḥ ।।6 3 ।।
tasya patnī mahābhāgā kṛṣṇagolokavāsinī ।
vṛndā bhavati dharmāḍhyā satī pativratā sadā ।। 64।।
tasyā balena daityo'sau mriyate neti vai mayā ।
hetujijñāsayā cāpi vasatistadgṛhe kṛtā ।।65।।
tajjñātaṃ sarvathā śaṃbho kāraṇaṃ prabalaṃ yataḥ ।
yuddhaṃ kuru mahādeva sāhāyye vicarāmyaham । 66 ।।
vṛndāyāṃ tatra kāpaṭyaṃ kiṃcit kartuṃ bhaviṣyati ।
nyāyenaiva kariṣyāmi nā'nyāyena kadācana । । 67।।
sa ca daityastava patnīṃ kāmenādātumicchati ।
tatra chidre mayā kiṃcit kartavyamupatiṣṭhati । । 68 ।।
avaśyaṃ tasya nāśaḥ syānmātṛduṣṭārthagāminaḥ ।
nā'yaṃ putraḥ kintu śatrurindraṃ dṛṣṭvā tvayā kṛtaḥ ।। 69 ।।
sa evā'nyāyago nāśyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।
etasminnantare daityo mahāsenāsamanvitaḥ । । 1.327.70 ।।
kailāsaprāntamāyāto'varudhyā'driṃ jagarja ha ।
sainyakolāhalaṃ śrutvā cukrodha śaṃkarastadā । । 71 ।।
samādideśa yuddhārthaṃ nandyādigaṇapuṃgavān ।
nandībhamukhasenānīmukhā yuddhaviśāradāḥ । ।7 2 । ।
avaterurgaṇāḥ sarve kailāsāt krodhasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
koṭiśaste gaṇāścaiva koṭiśo daityapuṃgavāḥ ।।7 3 । ।
kurvanto raṇaśabdāँśca kailāsopatyakāsu vai ।
garjanto bhairavaṃ vīrāḥ pramatheśāśca dānavāḥ । । 74।।
śaktitomarabāṇaughairmusalaiḥ pāśapaṭṭiśaiḥ ।
vyarājanta triśūlāstravajramudgaraśastrakaiḥ ।।75 । ।
bherīmṛdaṃgaśaṃkhoghairniḥsvānairvīraharṣaṇaiḥ ।
gajāśvarathaśabdaiśca nāditā bhūrvyakampata ।।76 । ।
senayorubhayostatrā'bhavan śabdā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
garjanayā samaṃ parasparaṃ hananamulbaṇam । । 77।।
prāvartata tadā lakṣmi! nāśanaṃ cātidāruṇam ।
hatā nāgā hatāścāśvā hatā vīrāḥ sahasraśaḥ । ।78 । ।
pramathāhatadaityaughā daityāhatagaṇāstathā ।
mahānidrāṃgatāstaiśca bhūrvyarājata saṃvṛtā ।। 79 ।।
vasā'sṛṅmāṃsapaṃkāḍhyā bhūragamyā'bhavattadā ।
daityānajīvayacchukro mṛtasaṃjīvanībalāt । । 1.327.80 । ।
gaṇā mṛtā nottiṣṭhanti bhayaṃkaramidaṃ mahat ।
śaśaṃsuśca gaṇāstasmai śaṃkarāya vināśanam ।।8 1 । ।
śukrasya ceṣṭitaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā tu cukradhe haraḥ ।
tanmukhāt krodhatāmrākṣo kṛtyā babhūva bhīṣaṇā । । 8 2।।
tālajaṃghā darīvaktrā tāḍāṃgulī giristanī ।
āsasāda raṇabhūmiṃ vicacārā'sureṣu sā । । 83 । ।
bhakṣayamāṇā tāndaityān jagāma bhārgavo yataḥ ।
śukrācāryaṃ gale dhṛtvā yonimadhye'kṣipaddhi sā । ।84।।
svabhage dhṛtvā jagāmā'ntarhitā nabhaḥ ।
daityāḥ pramlānavadanā dṛṣṭvaitacchukranāśanam।। ।।
vinirjagmuryuddhabhūmeḥ prāṇarakṣāparāyaṇāḥ ।
abhajyata mahāsainyaṃ gaṇaiḥ santāḍitaṃ tadā ।।86।।
śuṃbho niśuṃbhanāmā ca kālanemiśca te trayaḥ ।
yuddhaṃ carantaḥ pramathapṛtanāṃ jaghnuraiśvarīm ।।87।।
muñcantaḥ śaravarṣāṇi gaṇasenāmakampayan ।
rurudhuśca gaṇāścāpi daityān mārgaṇavṛṣṭibhiḥ ।।88।।
vasantakiṃśukābhāsā jātā gaṇāśca dānavāḥ ।
atha dānavasainyaṃ tad vyomāśrayaṃ samācarat ।।89।।
rurodha gaṇasainyaṃ tad vyomavṛṣṭyā'tighorayā ।
tadā pramathasainyaṃ saṃbhagnaṃ dudrāva gahvaram ।। 1.327.90 ।।
dṛṣṭvā caitad vaiparītyaṃ nandībhamukhaṣaṇmukhāḥ ।
anyegaṇāścātibalā ākāśamavalambya ca ।।9 1 ।।
sainyānyākāśamālambya nītvā pāṣāṇapuṃgavān ।
āmarṣādabhyadhāvanta saṃhartuṃ daityapuṃgavān ।।92।।।
utplutya cotplutya vijaghnuraiśvarā,
jālaṃdharā''rakṣitadaityapuṃgavān ।
pāṣāṇaśastreratibhagnamastakā,
nipetururvyāmapare tu dudruvuḥ ।।93।।
evamāsurasainyaṃ tadbhagnaṃ vyoma vihāya ca ।
kailāsāraṇyamāśritya pracchannaṃ samabhūt kṣaṇam ।।94।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālaṃdharavṛndākhyāne jālaṃdhareṇa rāhurdūtaḥ śaṃkaraṃ prati preṣitaḥ, sa kīrtimukhena vidrāvitaḥ, tato jalandhara-sainyamāgatam, śukrācāryaḥ kṛtyayā yonau nikṣiptaḥ, ghoraṃ yuddhamabhūccetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 327 ।।
