adhyāyaḥ 336
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 337 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śivastriśūlamādāya candrabhāgānadītaṭe ।
vaṭā'dhastānnivāsaṃ svaṃ tvakarodanyarūpadhṛk ।। 1 ।।
puṣpadantaṃ pārṣadaṃ ca dūtaṃ kṛtvā surāntikam ।
haraḥ prasthāpayāmāsa gangharvottamamādarāt ।। 2 ।।
pārṣado'pi yayau śaṃkhacūḍasya nagaraṃ prati ।
pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ daśayojanamāyatam ।। 3 ।।
sarvasphāṭikapāṣāṇaprākārapariveṣṭitam ।
saptabhiḥ parikhābhiśca sajalābhiḥ surakṣitam ।। 4 ।।
madhye prajānāṃ sugamaṃ śaṃkhacūḍālayaṃ varam ।
dadarśa valayākāraṃ catuḥprākārarakṣitam ।। 5 ।।
rājitaṃ dvādaśadvārairdvārapālābhirakṣataiḥ ।
maṇimuktādarśaratnasvarṇamandiraśobhitam ।। 6 ।।
parito rakṣitaṃ śaśvad dānavaiḥ śūrajātibhiḥ ।
puṣpadanto navadvāraṃ praviṣyā'bhyantaraṃ gataḥ ।। 7 ।।
tadantardvārapenā'yaṃ dūta ityavabodhitaḥ ।
śaṃkhacūḍastamājuhāvā'bhijñātumudantakam ।। 8 ।।
puṣpadantaḥ śaṃkhacūḍālayaṃ dadarśa śobhitam ।
madhye siṃhāsanaṃ svarṇaṃ parito rāsabhūmikāḥ ।। 9 ।।
maṇayaḥ khacitāstāsu ratnapuṣpādiśobhitāḥ ।
koṭiśo dānavā yatra bhramanti śastradhāriṇaḥ ।। 1.336.1 0।।
svarṇasiṃhāsane chatracāmarādisuśobhite ।
rājamānaṃ pūrvamitraṃ śaṃkhacūḍamuvāca ha ।। 1 1।।
rājendra! śivadūto'haṃ puṣpadantābhidhānakaḥ ।
yaduktaṃ śaṃkareṇaiva tad bravīmi niśāmaya ।। 12।।
rājyaṃ dehi ca devānāmadhikārān pradehi ca ।
viṣayaṃ dehi teṣāṃ ca yuddhaṃ vā kuru niścitam ।। 1 3।।
gatvā vakṣyāmi kiṃ śaṃbhuṃ tadbhavān vaktumarhasi ।
prahasya śaṃkhacūḍaśca prāha taṃ yodhanāya vai ।। 14।।
prabhāte tvāgamiṣyāmi gaccha kathaya śaṃkaram ।
puṣpadanto vaṭaṃ gatvā śaṃbhuṃ prāha yathoditam ।। 15।।
śivena tu smṛtāstatra tadā''jagmurgaṇeśvarāḥ ।
skando gaṇeśvaro vīrabhadro nandī subhadrakaḥ ।। 16।।
mahākālo viśālākṣo bāṇaḥ piṃgākṣakampanau ।
virūpo vikṛtirmaṇibhadravikarabāṣkalāḥ ।। 17।।
kapilākṣo dīrghadaṃṣṭro balībhadraḥ kuṭīcaraḥ ।
kālaṃṭakaḥ kālajihvastāmrākṣo durjayo'gamaḥ ।। 18।।
aṣṭau ca bhairavā rudrāścaikādaśāṣṭavāsavāḥ ।
ādityā dvādaśa cāpi vahniścandro'śvinau tathā ।। 19।।
viśvakarmā kuberaśca yamaśca nalakūbaraḥ ।
vāyurjayanto varuṇo budho dharmaśca maṃgalaḥ ।।1.336.20।।
śanirīśaśca kāmaśca tathā'nye gaṇapuṃgavāḥ ।
ugradraṃṣṭrā cogracaṇḍā koṭarī kaiṭabhī tathā ।।।2 1 ।।
bhadrakālī tathā caṇḍī kālī kātyāyanī tathā ।
āyayuśca tadā tatra nṛtyantyaḥ śaṃbhusaṃsmṛtāḥ ।।22।।
triśūlaśaktimudgaraśaṃkhacakragadāśarān ।
vajrakhaḍgacāpacarmamuśalaparighādikān ।।23।।
bibhrantyaste ca bibhrantaḥ prastaropalabarburān ।
vaiṣṇavāstraṃ vāruṇāstramāgneyaṃ nāgapāśakam ।।24।।
nārāyaṇāstraṃ brahmāstraṃ gāndharvaṃ gāruḍaṃ tathā ।
pārjanyaṃ vai pāśupataṃ jṛmbhaṇārthaṃ ca pārvatam ।।25।।
māheśvarāstraṃ vāyavyaṃ daṇḍaṃ saṃmohanaṃ tathā ।
dhārayantyo'tha yoginyo ḍākinyo vikaṭāstathā ।26।।
bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍabrahmarākṣasāḥ ।
vetālāścaiva yakṣāśca rākṣasāścaiva kinnarāḥ ।।27।।
śaṃkhacūḍādināśārthaṃ samājagmurharasthalīm ।
skando natvā haraṃ tatra vaṭādho niṣasāda ha ।।28।।
śaṃkhacūḍo'pi tulasīṃ rātrau dūtoditāṃ kathām ।
śaṃkaraṃ prati yuddhāya prātargantavyamāha tām ।।29।।
tulasī raṇavārtāṃ tu śrutvā śuṣkānanā'bhavat ।
uvāca duḥkhamāpannā hṛdayena vidūyatā ।।1.336.30।।
dakṣāṃgāni sphurantyatra mama nātha na śobhanam ।
duḥsvapnaṃ ca gatarātrau dṛṣṭaṃ mahiṣavāhanam ।।3 1।।
bhavanaṃ mūlato naṣṭaṃ patitaṃ jalapūritam ।
agnistataḥ punarjāto'vaśiṣṭeṣu vane yathā ।। 32।।।
ahaṃ kenāpi nītā ca vṛkṣaśākhālayaṃ gatā ।
nāthā'nto'yaṃ tu samprāptaḥ sampattervā''tmano'pi vā ।। 33।।
āndolayanti prāṇā māṃ mano naṣṭamivā'sti me ।
iti tulasīvākyāni śrutvā bhuktvā nipīya ca ।।34।।
śaṃkhacūḍaḥ prāptakālaṃ hyuvāca tāṃ tu tulasīm ।
kālena yojitaṃ sarvaṃ priye । samupatiṣṭhati ।।35।।
śubhaṃ harṣaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokamamaṃgalam ।
kāle vṛkṣāḥ prajāyante phalanti ca linanti ca ।।36।।
tathā'ṇḍāni prajāścāpi brahmādayo'pi tattathā ।
sṛṣṭā pātā ca saṃhartā kālātmā kṛṣṇa eva ha ।।37।।
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ tulasi tvaṃ bhāvi tad bhavatu dhruvam ।
janmamṛtyuharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhaja priye! ।।38।।
kālasya kālamevainaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।
ko bandhuḥ rakṣakaścānyo bandhuṃ taṃ rakṣakaṃ bhaja ।।39।।
āvāṃ tu karmaṇā tena yojitau sa viyokṣyati ।
ajñānī kātaraḥ śoke vipattau na tu paṇḍitaḥ ।।1.336.40।।
mṛtyau nārāyaṇaṃ kāntaṃ prāpsyasi smara tulasi! ।
tapaḥ kṛtaṃ yadarthaṃ ca purā badarikāśrame ।।41 ।।
mayā tvaṃ tapasā labdhā tvayā'haṃ gaṇaśāpataḥ ।
irerarthe tava tapo hariṃ prāpsyasi kāmini ।।42।।
vṛndāvane tu govindaṃ goloke kṛṣṇameva tam ।
labhiṣyasi tathā cā'haṃ labhiṣyāmi paraṃ prabhum ।।43। ।
dānavīṃ tu tanuṃ tvaktvā muktiṃ yāsyāmi śāśvatīm ।
tatra dṛśyasi māṃ tvaṃ ca tvāṃ ca drakṣyāmi santatam ।।44।।
tvaṃ hi dehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ vidhāya ca ।
hariṃ drakṣyasi kāntaṃ taṃ mā kānte! kātarā bhava ।।45।।
dampatī saṃvicāryaivaṃ krīḍākautukamaṃgalaiḥ ।
sarvaṃ vai naśvaraṃ matvā nimagnau sukhasāgare ।।46 ।।
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgau suprītau suratotsukau ।
sukhasuptau kathayantau kathāṃ rasabharāṃ tathā ।।47।।
hasantau bhuktavantau ca tāmbūlaṃ tu parasparam ।
dadantau nidrayā vyāptau rātriṃ ninyatureva tau ।।88।।
prātarutthāya manasā dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ sa dānavaḥ ।
snātvā vastrāṇi dhṛtvā ca kṛtvā tilakacandrakau ।।49।।
devapūjāṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ gurorvandanamityapi ।
kṛtvā gopūjanaṃ lājādadhimadhvājyadarśanam ।।1.336.5 0 ।।
ratnāmbaramaṇisvarṇādyaṃ dadau sa dvijātaye ।
dadau viprāya śakune muktāmāṇikyahīrakān ।। 51 ।।
gajāśvadhenūḥ pradadau yātrāmaṃgalahetave ।
kośakṣetrapattanāni brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā ।।52।।।
putraṃ kṛtvā ca rājendraṃ sucandraṃ dānaveṣu ca ।
putraṃ samarpya bhāryāṃ ca svarājyaṃ sarvasampadam ।।53 ।।
svayaṃ bhuktvā tathā pītvā prasammīlya sutādikān ।
varma dhṛtvā'straśastrāṇi dhanuṣpāṇirbabhūva ha ।।54।।
āhūya tatra sainyāni samasajjo'bhavattadā ।
aśvānāṃ lakṣamekaṃ dve pañcalakṣaṃ ca hastinām ।।55।।
rathānāmayutaṃ dhānuṣkāṇāṃ koṭitrayaṃ tathā ।
carmiṇāṃ śūlināṃ koṭitrayaṃ pratyekamityapi ।।56।।
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca pattīnāṃ gaṇanā tu na ।
yatra senāpatiḥ sarvaśastrā'stramantramāyikaḥ ।।57।।
vāyuyānavāriyānapātālayānaśāradaḥ ।
trilakṣāṇāṃ sainikānāmakṣauhiṇīśca tatra vai ।।58 ।।
triṃśatkṛtvā śreṣṭhabhaṭamūrdhanyānāṃ mahāsuraḥ ।
bahirbabhūva śibirānmanasā śrīhariṃ smaran ।।59 ।।
śaṃkarasyāpi sainyāni pañcaviṃśatikoṭayaḥ ।
sarvayoddhṛpramukhyānāmabhavaṃstatra padmaje ।। 1.336.60 ।।
anyeṣāṃ tu gaṇanā vai nāsti te śatakoṭayaḥ ।
śaṃkarasyā'bhavat senāpatiḥ skando mahābalaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
śaṃkhacūḍasya tu senāpatiḥ rāhustadā'bhavat ।
tayoravādayaँstatra raṇe vādyāni vai muhuḥ ।।62।।
puṣpabhadrānadītīre śaṃkhacūḍo vimānagaḥ ।
dadarśa vaṭamūle taṃ śaṃkaraṃ yogamāsthitam ।।63 ।।
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vyāghracarmāmbaraṃ varam ।
taptakāṃcanavarṇābhaṃ jaṭājālasuśobhitam ।।64।।
trinetraṃ pañcavaktraṃ ca nāgayajñopavītakam ।
bhaktamṛtyuharaṃ śāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyupatiṃ haram ।।65।।
avaruhya vimānāttu bhaktyā nanāma śaṃkaram ।
mahādevaśca kṛpayā taṃ vai datvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ।।66।।
uvāca brahmaṇaḥ putro marīcistasya kaśyapaḥ ।
tasmai dakṣo dadau kanyāstrayodaśa hi dharmataḥ ।।67।।
aditirditirdanuḥ kālā'riṣṭā surasā tathā ।
surabhirvinatā cāpi tāmrā krodhavaśā irā ।।68।।
kadrūrmuniśca tāsāṃ vai prajā jātā vijātayaḥ ।
aditerdvādaśā''dityā jātāḥ prathamasūnavaḥ ।।69।।
dhātā'ryamā ca mitraśca varuṇoṃ'śo bhagastathā ।
indro vivasvān pūṣā ca parjanyo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ ।।1.336.70।।
tatastvaṣṭā tato viṣṇurete kaśyapaputrakāḥ ।
diteḥ putradvayaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuḥ sahā'grajaḥ ।।7 1 ।।
hiraṇyā'kṣastvaparaścetyubhau putrī ca saṃhikā ।
rāhoḥ sā jananī devī vipracitteḥ parigrahaḥ ।।72।।
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāścatvāraśca mahābalāḥ ।
prahlādaścānuhrādaśca saṃhrādo hlāda ityatha ।।73।।
hiraṇyākṣasya putrāśca ṣaḍ vai sarve mahābalāḥ ।
utkaraḥ śakuniścaiva kālanābhastathā'paraḥ ।।74।।
mahānābhaśca vikrānto bhūtasantāpanastathā ।
danoḥ putrāḥ śataṃ vipracitimukhyāstu dānavāḥ ।।75।।
dvimūrdhā śaṃkukarṇaśca tathā śaṃkunirāmayaḥ ।
śaṃkunāso mahāviśvo gaveṣṭhirdundubhistathā ।।76।।
ajāmukho'tha bhagahṛt śilo vāmanasastathā ।
marīcirakṣakaścāpi mahāgārgyo'ṅgirāvṛtaḥ ।।77।।
vikṣobhyaśca suketuśca suvīryaḥ suhṛdastathā ।
indrajid viśvajiccāpi tathā suravimardanaḥ ।।78।।
ekacakraḥ suvāhaśca tārakaśca mahābalaḥ ।
vaiśvānaraḥ pulomā ca pravīṇo'tha mahāśirāḥ ।।79।।
svarbhānurvṛṣaparvā ca muṇḍakaśca mahāsuraḥ ।
dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sūryaśca candra indraśca tāpanaḥ ।।1.336.8 0।।
sūkṣmaścāpi nicandraśca ūrṇanābho mahāgiriḥ
asilomā sukeśaśca sadaśca balakastathā ।।8 1 ।।
vyomamūrdhā kuṃbhanābho mahodaro mahāhanuḥ ।
pramodāhaśca kupatho hayagrīvaśca vīryavān ।।82 ।।
asuraśca virūpākṣaḥ supatho'tha mahāsuraḥ ।
ajo hiraṇmayaścāpi śatamāyuśca śambaraḥ ।।8 3 ।।
śarabhaḥ śalabhaścāpi pradhānā danusūnavaḥ ।
ete cānye'pi yuddhe vai dānavāste hyupasthitāḥ ।।84।।
kālāyāḥ kālarūpāścā'bhavan putrāḥ kṣaṇādayaḥ ।
ariṣṭāyā āriṣṭeyā vighnāḥ putrāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।85।।
surasāyā nāgasarpā vāsukitakṣakādayaḥ ।
surabhiḥ kaśyapājjajñe rudrānekādaśātmajān ।।86।।
aṃgārakaṃ tathā sarpaṃ nirṛtiṃ sadasaspatim ।
atraikapādahirbudhnāvūrdhvaketuṃ jvaraṃ tathā ।।87।।
bhuvanaṃ ceśvaraṃ mṛtyuṃ kapālaṃ caiva viśrutam ।
vinatāyāstu putrau dvāvaruṇo garuḍaśca ha ।।88 ।।
ṣaḍtriṃśat tu svasāraśca yavīyasyastu tāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
tāmrāyāstu śukī krauṃcī dhṛtarāṣṭrī ca pakṣiṇī ।।89 ।।
śyenī bhāsī tathā cānyā pakṣiṇyo hyabhavan prajāḥ ।
atha krodhavaśāyāstu kanyakā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। 1.336.90 ।।
mṛgī ca mṛgamandā ca haribhadrā irāvatī ।
bhūtā ca kapiśā daṃṣṭrā niśā tiryā tathā'parā ।। 91 ।।
śvetā cāpi svarā cāpi surasā ceti viśrutāḥ ।
atha irā prajajñe vai tisraḥ kanyāḥ sulocanāḥ ।। 92।।
latāṃ vallīṃ virudhāṃ ca tadapatyāni bhūriśaḥ ।
kadrūrnāgasahasraṃ vai kādraveyāśca te smṛtāḥ ।। 93 ।।
atha munestu mauneyā gandharvā'psarasaśca te ।
eteṣāṃ vaṃśavistāro koṭisaṃkhyādhiko'bhavat ।। 94।।
aditirdharmaśīlā'sti balaśīlā ditiḥ smṛtā ।
tapaḥśīlā tu surabhirmāyāśīlā danuḥ smṛtā ।। 95 ।।
muniśca gandhaśīlā vai gatiśīlā tvariṣṭikā ।
kṣudhāśīlā tu kālāsyā kadrūḥ krūrasvabhāvinī ।। 96 ।।
irā'nugrahaśīlā ca ariṣṭā krodhaśālinī ।
vāhaśīlā tu vinatā tāmrā vai pāśaśālinī ।।97।।
dharmataḥ śīlato buddhyā kṣamayā balarūpataḥ ।
mātṛtulyāścābhijātāḥ kaśyapasyā''tmajāḥ prajāḥ ।। 98 ।।
devatā'suragandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ ।
piśācāḥ paśavaścāpi mṛgāḥ patagavīrudhaḥ ।।99।।
śaṃkhacūḍa! vijānīhi tava pakṣe samāgatān ।
te caite'surapakṣīyā daityāśca dānavāstathā । । 1.336.100 । ।
surāṇāṃ te pratipakṣā macchastrā'tithayastu te ।
ye ca devasamāḥ surapakṣagāste mayā'sura! । । 101 ।।
rakṣaṇīyā mayā sarve sajjo bhavā'tra dānava! ।
danoḥ putrasya tu vipraciteḥ daṃbhābhidhaḥ sutaḥ । । 10 2।।
viṣṇubhakto mama sakhā tasyāsi tvaṃ suto mahān ।
putrārthaṃ puṣkare kṛṣṇamantraṃ jajāpa te pitā । । 103 ।।
cacāra tapa ugraṃ ca sahasrābdaṃ tu te pitā ।
tatpratāpena putrastvaṃ sudāmā śaṃkhacūḍakaḥ ।। 1 04।।
kiṃ te vai kalahenā'dya yadi jānāsi māṃ haram ।
yadi jānāsi bhaktaṃ svaṃ sudāmānaṃ tu dānavam ।। 105 ।।
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaikyaṃ harerapi ।
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇanti vaiṣṇavāḥ sevanaṃ vinā । । 106 ।।
kṛṣṇabhaktasya te kiṃ vā rājyena kalahena vā ।
dehi rājyaṃ tu devānāṃ matprītiṃ kuru dānava । । 10 7। ।
sukhaṃ svarājye tvaṃ tiṣṭha devāḥ santu svake pade ।
alaṃ bhrātṛvirodhena sarve hi kaśyapātmajāḥ । । 108 । ।
yāni kāni ca pāpāni jñātidrohasamāni na ।
kāle nāśo bhavatyeva brahmaṇo'pi tavā'tra kim । । 10 9।।
sarvāvasthāsu samatā sarvadā nahi kasyacit ।
tyaja jñānena bhaktendra! mā virodhena dānava! । । 1.336.110 ।।
sūryacandrādayaḥ sarve vardhante'vataranti ca ।
kālena pṛthvī sasasyā kālena śrīviyoginī ।। 111 । ।
kālena tvaṃ mahāsmṛddhaḥ sa te kālo vivartate ।
ahaṃ mṛtyuñjayaḥ kālaḥ saṃharāmi tu dehinaḥ । । 112 ।।
karomi satataṃ kṛṣṇanāmasadguṇakīrtanam ।
tvaṃ tu sarvaṃ parityajya kuru kṛṣṇasya kīrtanam । । 113 ।।
ityuktvā virarāmainaṃ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
tathāpi śaṃkhacūḍasya mataṃ nā'bhūnmanāgapi । । 11 4। ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tulasīvivāhākhyāne triśūlayuktaśaṃkaraḥ puṣpavantaṃ dūtaṃ śaṃkhacūḍaṃ prati preṣayāmāsa, śaṃkhacūḍatulasyorjñānaṃ, śaṃkhacūḍasya prātaryuddhāya yānaṃ, kaśyapasya trayodaśapatnīnāṃ vaṃśe dānavastvaṃ śaṃkhacūḍaḥ sudāmeti śaṃkareṇa smāritam, śaṃbhorupadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ । । 336 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 336 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 337
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 338 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca -
śaṃkhacūḍastato lakṣmi! śaṃkaraṃ prāha naitikam ।
sābhimānaṃ yuddhamūlaṃ vināśakṛddhi tāmasam । । 1 ।।
tvayā kathitaṃ yannātha! sarvaṃ tathyaṃ na cā'nṛtam ।
jñātidrohe mahatpāpaṃ yadi bhavati śaṃkara ।। 2 ।।
kathaṃ gṛhītvā sarvasvaṃ talaṃ prasthāpito baliḥ ।
sabhrātṛko hiraṇyākṣaḥ kathaṃ devaiśca hiṃsitaḥ । । 3 । ।
kathaṃ samudramathane pīyūṣaṃ bhakṣitaṃ suraiḥ ।
kathaṃ tvaṃ dānavān haṃsi na devān na gaṇān svakān । । 4 । ।
kathaṃ satīnimitte tatpitā vihiṃsitastadā ।
kathaṃ sudarśanaṃ viṣṇorasureṣveva sārthakam । । ।5 । ।
sambandhinyoḥ kāśyapeyaprajayoryadvirodhanam ।
jāyate mahatīrlajjā sparddhā'smābhiḥ kathaṃ hara ।। 6 ।।
pitṛvaṃśasamunnetā svargaṃ yāti tu mānavaḥ ।
paravaṃśānusaṃyātā bhavatyadhogatiṃ gataḥ ।। 7 । ।
kālena yadbhavet tadvai bhavatvatra mamā''laye ।
parājayo jayo vāpi kālakṛnmānya eva me ।। 8 । ।
adhunā tvaṃ mahākālo mamā'si pārvatīpate! ।
kālena yadbhavet tatra santuṣṭo'smi raṇaṃ kuru ।। 9 ।।
mṛto yāsye tu goloke jaye bhokṣye tu vaidhasam ।
raṇe hānirna me cāsti na te lābho manāgapi।। 1.337.10 ।।
iti vicārya bhagavan! nivṛtto bhava śaṃkara! ।
alpena saha mahatāṃ hānireva na vardhanam ।। 11 । ।
namaskaromi te śaṃbho! uttiṣṭhāmi raṇāya ca ।
iti kṛtvā yayau yānamāruhya nijavāhinīm । । 12 । ।
tatraite ye'surapakṣā daityāśca dānavādayaḥ ।
surāṇāṃ pratipakṣā ye te tu yuddhe'surānugāḥ ।। 13 । ।
ye tu devasamā divapakṣagāste harānugāḥ ।
sainyeṣu cāgatāḥ sarve śaṃkhacūḍapinākinoḥ । । 14 । ।
koṭyarbudābjayoddhṝṇāṃ sene vārdhisame tadā ।
suśobhe te sma lakṣmi! drāg raṇavādyā'dhite jite । । 15 । ।
nedurdundubhayaḥ svarge puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūva ha ।
skandaḥ senāpatiścātra tatrarāhuśca bhūpatiḥ ।। 16 । ।
dvayoryuddhamabhūd vyomni śataghnībāṇaśaktibhiḥ ।
paraśuparighābhūśuṇḍībhistomaracakrakaiḥ । । 17 । ।
bāṇaiḥ śilīmukhaiścāpi dhūṣkṛtairgolakaistathā ।
prastaraiśca sahasraghnairyuddhamadbhutamulbaṇam ।। 18 ।।
dvayośca senayormadhye mahāpralayasannibham ।
mardanaṃ kūrcanaṃ nikṛntanaṃ dvaidhīvibhedanam ।। 19।।
chedanaṃ cūrṇanaṃ prāṇikarcanaṃ dalanaṃ hyabhūt। ।
śaravṛṣṭiścārdhacandraśūlabhallatridhārakaiḥ ।।1.337.20 ।।
hananaṃ sarvatovyāptamāsīdubhayasainyayoḥ ।
hastīnāṃ ca tathā'śvānāṃ khaccarāṇāṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ ।।21।।
vināśo'bhūd rathināṃ ca pattīnāṃ gaṇanā na vai ।
rathā bhagnāśca yānāni cūrṇitāni sahasraśaḥ ।।22।।
vāhāśchinnā lakṣaśaśca bhaṭeśvarāstu koṭiśaḥ ।
naṣṭāśchinnā vyasavaścā'bhavan śaśvadbhūśāyinaḥ ।।23।।
divāniśaṃ mahāghoraṃ satataṃ pralayātmakam ।
yuddhaṃ pravartitaṃ tatra kṣuttṛṣāgaṇanāpi na ।।24।।
dhanuṣmatāṃ tadā bāṇāḥ śastrāṇi śastriṇāṃ tathā ।
kavacāni varmavatāṃ kṣayamāptāni sarvathā ।।25।।
dānavānāṃ gaṇānāṃ ca layaḥ prākṛtiko yathā ।
yadā jātastadā trastā vidudruvū raṇāṃgaṇam ।।26।।
kārtikaḥ śaravṛṣṭyā vai cakāra kadanaṃ mahat ।
rāhuścāpi śaravṛṣṭyā cakāra kartanaṃ param ।।27।।
parvatānāṃ ca sarpāṇāṃ śilānāṃ śākhināṃ tathā ।
śaśvad vṛṣṭiṃ cakratustau durvāhyāṃ ca bhayaṃkarīm ।।28।।
rāhomārgaṇavṛṣṭyā tu pracchannaḥ śivanandanaḥ ।
dhanuḥ skandasya chiccheda rathaṃ ciccheda vājinoḥ ।।29।।
mayūraṃ jarjarībhūtaṃ divyāstreṇa cakāra saḥ ।
śaktiṃ cikṣepa sūryābhāṃ rāhurvakṣovibhedinīm ।।1.337.30।।
gadayā tāṃ pothayitvā dhanurdivyamupādade ।
skando vavarṣa śastrāṇi rāhornāśāya sarvathā ।।3 1।।
sarpāṃśca parvatāँścāpi vṛkṣāṃśca prastarāँstathā ।
sarvāṃściccheda kopena divyāstraiḥ śaṃkarātmajaḥ ।।32।।
āgneyaṃ vāruṇāstreṇa vārayāmāsa vai guhaḥ ।
rathaṃ dhanuśca ciccheda saiṃhikeyasya līlayā ।।33।।
savāhaṃ sārathiṃ caiva hatvā cikṣepa śaktikām ।
dānavo vakṣasi hato mūrchāmavāpa vai tadā ।।34।।
śaṃkhacūḍaḥ samāyāto rathamāruhya satvaram ।
cakāra śarajālāni māyayā māyināṃ varaḥ ।।35।।
gūhaṃ tvācchādya samare śarajālena śaktikām ।
jagrāha śatasūryākhyāṃ viṣṇutejo'nvitāṃ tadā ।।36।।
cikṣepa kārtike lagnā papāta mūrchitastadā ।
kālī gṛhītvā taṃ kroḍe nināya śivasannidhau ।।37।।
śivaḥ svasainyaṃ devāँśca prerayāmāsa satvaraḥ ।
dānavendraiḥ sasainyaiśca punaryuddhaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।।38।।
samabhūt tatra yuyudhe mahendro vṛṣaparvaṇā ।
bhāskaro yuyudhe vipracittinā pralayāgnivat ।।39।।
daṃbhena saha candraśca kālaḥ kāleśvareṇa ca ।
gokarṇena kṛśānuśca kālakeyena yakṣarāṭ ।।1.337.40।।
mayena viśvakarmā ca mṛtyurbhayaṃkareṇa ca ।
saṃhāreṇa yamaḥ kalaviṃkena varuṇastathā ।।41 ।।
cañcalena pavanaśca ghṛtapṛṣṭhena vai budhaḥ ।
raktākṣeṇa śaniścaiva vasavo varcasāṃgaṇaiḥ ।।42।।
jayanto ratnasāreṇā'śvinau dīptimatā saha ।
nalakūbaro dhūmreṇa dharmo dhanurdhareṇa ca ।।43।।
śobhākareṇaiveśāno maṇḍukākṣeṇa maṃgalaḥ ।
manmathaḥ piṭhareṇāpi yuyudhe'straprahetibhiḥ ।।44।।
ulkāmukhena dhūmreṇa khaṅgenāpi dhvajena ca ।
kāñcīmukhena piṇḍena ghanena saha nandinā ।।45।।
viśvena ca palāśena cādityā yuyudhurbhṛśam ।
ekādaśa mahārudrā yuyudhire bhayāhvayaiḥ ।।46।।
mahāmārī yuyudhe ca progradaṇḍyādibhistadā ।
nandīśvarādayaḥ sarve saha daṇḍyādidānavaiḥ ।।47।।
evaṃ te yuyudhuḥ sainyeśvarāḥ sainyāni sarvaśaḥ ।
śaṃkhacūḍo viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ tadvacca kārtikaḥ ।।48।।
dānavāścāsurā daityā yuyudhire samantataḥ ।
devāścakampire bhītā dudruvurvai diśo daśa ।।49।।
cakāra kopaṃ skandaśca devebhyastvabhayaṃ dadau ।
yuyudhe'yaṃ dānavānāṃ gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ praroṣataḥ ।।1.337.50।।
akṣauhiṇīnāṃ śatakaṃ samare sa jaghāna ha ।
kālī raktaṃ papau kruddhā nanarta samare tadā ।।51।।
daśalakṣaṃ gajendrāṇāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca vājinām ।
samādāya samādāya mukhe cikṣepa līlayā ।।52।।
skandasya śarajālaiśca dānavādyā vidudruvaḥ ।
kālī samaramāsādyā'ṭṭāṭṭahāsāni cākarot ।।53।।
ugradaṃṣṭrā cogradaṇḍā koṭarā yoginīgaṇāḥ ।
ḍākinyaścāsurān khādayāmāsuśca papurmadhu ।।54।।
dṛṣṭvā kālīṃ śaṃkhacūḍo yuddhārthamādravat tadā ।
kālī cikṣepa cāgneyaṃ pralayāgnisamaṃ tataḥ ।।55।।
śaṃkhacūḍo'harattadvai vāruṇāstreṇa līlayā ।
cikṣepa vāruṇaṃ kālī gāndharveṇa tu dānavaḥ ।।56।।
cicchedātha pracikṣepa kālī māheśvarāstrakam ।
jaghāna dānavo vaiṣṇavāstreṇa līlayā tadā ।।57।।
nārāyaṇāstraṃ cikṣepa kālī tatastu dānavaḥ ।
nanāma daṇḍavat bhūmau bhaktyastreṇa śaśāma tat ।।58।।
brahmāstraṃ sā ca cikṣepa brahmāstreṇā'grasaddhi saḥ ।
pāśupataṃ sā cikṣepa pāśupatena so'hanat ।।59।।
devī cikṣepa śaktiṃ tāṃ so'pi śaktyā'vināśayat ।
mahākālī tadā kruddhā mahākālāstrameva sā ।।1.337.60 ।।
mantrapūrvaṃ nikṣipati tāvadākāśavāgabhūt ।
mṛtyurna dānavasyā'sti kaṇṭhe'sya kavacaṃ hareḥ ।।6 1।।
tulasyāśca satītvaṃ vai yāvadasti tu tāvatā ।
jarāmṛtyū na cā'sya sto vinā satītvanāśanam ।।62।।
śrutvā kālī vinivṛttā so'karojjayagarjanām ।
tāvadvaṭe samāyāto viṣṇurbrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk ।।6 3।।
śaṃbho! mayā'rpitāṃ śaktiṃ samādāya raṇasthalīm ।
yāhi daityavināśāya viṣṇurasmi jagadguruḥ ।।64।।
gacchāmyahaṃ bhikṣukaḥ sannarthayāmi tu dānavam ।
kavacaṃ prati bhūteśa! paścād gacchāmi tulasīm ।।65।।
śaṃkhacūḍasvarūpeṇa vīryādhānārthamīśvara! ।
tato dānavamṛtyurvai bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।66।।
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇurvṛddhabrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk ।
dānavendraṃ prati gatvā bhikṣāṃ dehīti cā'bravīt ।।67।।
gṛhāṇa kiṃ tavecchāsti provāca dānavastadā ।
brāhmaṇa prāha kavacaṃ dehi me dānavad bhava ।।68।।
tacchrutvā dānavacchreṣṭho dadau kavacamuttamam ।
gṛhītvā kavacaṃ kṛṣṇo jagāma tulasīṃ prati ।।69।।
śaṃkhacūḍasvarūpeṇa jagāma tulasīgṛham ।
dundubhiṃ vādayāmāsa cakāra jayasadravam ।।1.337.70 ।।
tacchrutvā paramānandā samutthāya sasaṃbhramā ।
rājamārgagavākṣeṇa dadarśa tulasī patim ।।71।।
brāhmaṇebhyo vācakebhyo bhikṣubhyaḥ sā dhanaṃ dadau ।
maṃgalaṃ vācayāmāsa bandibhyo'pi dhanaṃ dadau ।।72।।
avaruhya rathāt kṛṣṇastulasyā bhavanaṃ yayau ।
kāntamāsādya tulasī kṣālayāmāsa tatpadam ।।73।।
nanāmā'timudā svarṇāsanasthaṃ jayakāriṇam ।
samāśliṣat tadaṃgāni mardayāmāsa śāntaye ।।74।।
tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau tasmai karpūrādisuvāsitam ।
adya me saphalaṃ janma paśyāmi vijayaṃ tava ।।।75।।
kathaṃ viśvasya saṃhartrā sārdhamājau jayo'bhavat ।
tanme brūhi prāṇanāyetyuvāca tulasī satī ।।76।।
viṣṇuruvāca devānāṃ dānavānāṃ mahākṣaye ।
brahmā tatra samāgatya kārayāmāsa melanam ।।77।।
devānāmadhikāreṣu devā bhavantu nirbhayāḥ ।
śaṃkhacūḍa! tava rājye sapatnīkaḥ sukhī bhava । ।78।।
iti sandhiḥ kārito vai brahmaṇā cāvayostataḥ ।
āgato'haṃ svabhavanaṃ śivalokaṃ śivo gataḥ ।।79।।
ityuktvā tulasīṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śayanaṃ pracakāra vai ।
reme ramāpatistatra tulasyāḥ śayane ratim । ।1.337.80 ।।
sāpi sukhātirekāccā''karṣaṇādivilakṣaṇam ।
apraskhalitabhāvācca tarkayāmāsa cetaram ।।8 1 ।।
kastvaṃ vada mahārājasvarūpo'syatra māyayā ।
dūrīkṛtaṃ satītvaṃ me bhuktā'haṃ māyayā tvayā ।।82।।
śapāmi vada śīghraṃ me śrutveti śāpabhītitaḥ ।
dadhāra līlayā svīyamūrti nārāyaṇātmikām ।।83 । ।
navīnanīradaśyāmāṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanām ।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām । ।84। ।
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śobhitāṃ pītavāsasā ।
nārāyaṇaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā kāminīṃ kāmamūrchitāṃ ।।85।।
punaśca mohamāpannā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pariṣasvaje ।
tadā tulasyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vīryādhānaṃ cakāra ha ।।86 ।।
śaṃbhustadā triśūlena śaṃkhacūḍaṃ jaghāna vai ।
mṛtasyātmā caturbāhuḥ sudāmā dhāma saṃyayau ।।87।।
punaśca mohamāpannā punaśca prāpya cetanām ।
uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ he nātha! pāṣāṇahṛdayo bhavān ।।88 ।।
dayā nāsti manāstāśca! satībalaprajīvanaḥ ।
chalena dharmabhagena mama svāmī tvayā hataḥ ।।89।।
tasmātpāṣāṇarūpastvaṃ bhuvi devo bhavā'dhunā ।
atastvamekajanuṣi jñānahīno bhaviṣyasi ।।1.337.90 ।।
ityuktvā sā ca tulasī nipatya caraṇe hareḥ ।
ruroda vilalāpaināmuvāca bhagavāँstadā ।।9 1।।
śaṃkhacūḍaṃ ca me bhaktaṃ sudāmānaṃ punarmama ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpayituṃ vai mayā tvayi chalaṃ kṛtam ।।92।।
tannāśāya mayā dattaṃ triśūlaṃ śaṃkarāya vai ।
grīṣmamadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaśatakaprabhamujjvalam ।।93 ।।
nārāyaṇā'dhiṣṭhitāgraṃ brahmādhiṣṭhitamadhyamam ।
śivādhiṣṭhitamūlaṃ ca kālādhiṣṭhitadhārakam ।।94।।
durnivāryaṃ tathā'vyarthaṃ sarvaśastravighātakam ।
śaṃkarakeśavā'nyairdurvahaṃ brahmāṇḍanāśakam । ।99। ।
dhanuḥsahasra dairghyeṇa vistṛtyā śatahastakam ।
sajīvaṃ brahmarūpaṃ ca śaṃbhuścikṣepa dānave ।।96। ।
mayā tvayi kṛtaṃ vīryādhānaṃ daityā mamāra yat ।
babhūva bhasmasācchaṃkhacūḍo rathayutastadā ।।97।।
babhūva ca punardivyo dvibhujo muralīdharaḥ ।
nānāratnasubhūṣāḍhyagopakoṭibhirāvṛtam ।।98।।
golokādāgataṃ yānamāruhya tatpuraṃ yayau ।
atha śūlaśca vegena prayayau śūlinaḥ karam ।।99।।
śaṃkarastena śūlena dānavasyā'sthijālakam ।
premṇā nyakṣepayacchīghraṃ lavaṇode tu sāgare ।। 1.337.10 0।।
śaṃkhajātirjāyate sā śreṣṭhā pūtā surārcane ।
praśastaṃ śaṃkhatoyaṃ ca devānāṃ prītidaṃ bhavet ।। 10 1।।
yatra śaṃkhastatra lakṣmīstulasī tīrthamatra ca ।
śaṃkhatoyaṃ tīrthatoyaṃ yatra śaṃkhastato hariḥ ।। 1 02।।
śokaṃ tyaja mama padme! bhava jātismarā priye! ।
tapastvayā kṛtaṃ sādhvi! madarthe badarīvane ।। 1 03।।
tvadarthe śaṃkhacūḍaśca cakāra puṣkare tapaḥ ।
kṛtvā tvāṃ kāminīṃ kāmī vijahāra ca tatphalāt ।। 1 04।।
gataḥ sa śaraṇaṃ rādhākṛṣṇayoḥ rāsamaṇḍale ।
goloke vartata bhakto mama tvaṃ yāhi sundari! ।। 1 05।।
idaṃ śarīraṃ tyaktveha divyaṃ dehaṃ vidhāya ca ।
rāse me ramayā sārdhaṃ tvaṃ ramāsadṛśī bhava ।। 106।।
tava śāpena pāṣāṇaḥ śālagrāmo bhavāmi vai ।
tvadviyogā'sahamānaḥ śapāmi tvāṃ nadī bhava ।। 1 07।।
iyaṃ tanurnadīrūpā gaṇḍakīti ca viśrutā ।
pūtā mokṣapradā nṝṇāṃ bhavatu puṇyadā''plavāt ।। 1 08।।
tava romasamūhāśca puṇyavṛkṣā bhavantu vai ।
tulasīromajā vṛkṣāstulasyaḥ prabhavantu vai ।। 1 09।।
nadyāmahaṃ śālagrāmo vahāmi jalatulasīm ।
trilokeṣu ca puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇāṃ devapūjane ।। 1.337.11 0।।
pradhānarūpā tulasī sadā bhavatu matpriyā ।
rādhāśāpakṛtaste madviyogaḥ sāntatāṃ gataḥ ।। 111 ।।
kṛpayā me bhava padme dhāmni ramā'tra tulasī ।
vivāhavidhinā vṛndāvane'haṃ tvāṃ sukanyakām ।। 1 12।।
grahīṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi nītvā tvāṃ matsahāyinīm ।
ityuktvā prayayau viṣṇuryatra śaṃbhurmṛdhe sthitaḥ ।। 11 3।।
vavandāte śaśaṃsatuḥ parasparaṃ haro hariḥ ।
devārutthāpitāḥ sarve śivasenā prajīvitā ।। 11 4।।
viṣṇunā śaṃkareṇāpi mṛtā ujjīvitāstadā ।
śukreṇa dānavasenā sañjīvinyā ca jīvitā ।। 115 ।।
cakrurmotsavaṃ tatropadārpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ ।
sarve yayurhareḥ śālagrāmatā yatra bhāvinī । । 116 ।।
gaṇḍakīrūpatā yatra tulasyāścāpi bhāvinī!
tatastadrūpatāṃ prāptau pūjayitvā surādayaḥ ।। 11 7।।
yayurvṛndrāvanaṃ ramyaṃ bhāvinī yatra tulasī
yamunāyāṃ kṛtasnānāścakrustatra mahotsavam । । 11 8।।
tulasīvṛkṣarūpā ca jātā tatra harīcchayā ।
kanyārūpā tathā divyā varārohā'pyabhūttadā ।। 119 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tulasīvivāhākhyāne śaṃkaraṃ prati dānavavacanaṃ, skaṃdarāhutatsenayoryuddhaṃ, kālyāstrakṛtayuddhaṃ, viprarūpaviṣṇukṛtadānavakavacabhikṣā, śaṃkhacūḍarūpaviṣṇukṛtatulasīvīryādhānaṃ, śaṃkhacūḍamaraṇaṃ, tulasyāḥ pāṣāṇaśālagrāmo bhaveti viṣṇostugaṇḍakīnadī tulasīvṛkṣikā ca bhaveti śāpau, yuddhe mṛtānāmujjīvanaṃ, vṛndāvanāgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 3 37।।


← adhyāyaḥ 337 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 338
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 339 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
satpatramañjarīyuktāṃ tulasīṃ pravilokya ca ।
devādyāśca mahāścaryapariplutāstadā'bhavan । । 1 ।।
lakṣmyādayastathā devyo vavandire ca tulasīm ।
nārāyaṇo mahāviṣṇurmahimānamuvāca tān । । veḥ । ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tadā kanyā tulasī divyarūpiṇī ।
mama pārśve sthitā'pyāsīt śṛṇoti sma svagauravam । । 3 । ।
tulanā sīdati yatra sarvaṣāṃ tulasī hi sā ।
svarge martye ca pātāle vaikuṇṭhe'kṣaradhāmani । । 4 । ।
tulasī sarvadā cāstu taravo mama sannidhau ।
goloke virajātīre rāse vṛndāvane bhuvi । । 5 । ।
bhāṇḍīre campakavane'śoke candanakānane ।
mādhavīketakīkundamallikāmālatīvane । । 6 । ।
bhavantu tulasīvṛkṣā yatrāhaṃ tulasī saha ।
tulasīmūlabhūmau ca tīrthavāso bhaviṣyati ।। 7 ।।
tulasīpatrapatanasthale devādyadhisthitiḥ ।
tulasījalasaṃsnātastulasīpatrabhojanaḥ ।। 8 ।।
sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarveyajñeṣu dīkṣitaḥ ।
sarvayātrāsu dāneṣu puṇyabhāk tulasīśrayaḥ ।। 9 ।।
sudhāghaṭapralakṣeṇa na tathā tṛptimānaham ।
yaḥ santoṣo mama devāstulasīpatradānataḥ ।। 1.338.10 ।।
nidhanasya samaye yastulasīvāri saṃgraset ।
sarvapāpavinirmukto vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti bhaktarāṭ ।। 11 ।।
nityaṃ tulasīsaṃspṛṣṭaṃ jalaṃ pibati bhaktitaḥ ।
jīvanmuktaḥ sa vijñeyo gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ।। 12।।
tulasyā mama pūjākṛllakṣāśvamedhapuṇyabhāk ।
tulasīpatramāsye tu dhṛtvā prāṇāँstyajettu yaḥ ।। 1 3।।
tulasīmālikāṃ kaṇṭhe bibhran yo maraṇaṃ vrajet ।
svarge koṭiyugaṃ bhuktvā viṣṇulokaṃ prayāti saḥ ।। 14।।
tulasīnāmadhṛgaśvamedhapuṇyaḥ pade pade ।
tulasītoyakaṇikāṃ bhojane yo labhejjanaḥ ।। 15।।
mṛtyukāle'thavā''pattau labhate tulasīdalam ।
sa ratnayānamāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti madgṛham ।। 16।।
trirātraṃ tulasīpatraṃ śuddhaṃ paryuṣitaṃ surāḥ ।
śrāddhe vrate pradāne ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ surārcane ।। 17।।
bhūgataṃ toyapatitaṃ kṣālayitvā dadettu tat ।
viṣṇave'rpitamevaitad divyaṃ śuddhaṃ prajāyate ।। 18।।
parvasu sandhayoḥ rātrau na chettavyaṃ tu taddalam ।
drumādhidevatā dhāmni tulasī mama supriyā ।। 1 9।।
nadyadhidevatā bhūmau vārnidhergaṇḍakī priyā ।
ramā padmā svarūpā ca vaikuṇṭhe'pi mama priyā ।।1.338.20 ।।
nityaṃ saha mayā rāse ramamāṇā bhaviṣyati ।
tulasyāḥ śāpayogena gaṇḍakīmūlatīragaḥ ।।2 1।।
śailarūpo bhavāmyadya śālagrāmaśilāmayaḥ ।
vajrakīṭāstu kṛmayo vajradaṃṣṭrāśca tāsu te ।।।22।।
mama cakra kariṣyanti kīṭāste pārṣadā mama ।
svarṇarekhātmacakrāḍhyaḥ śilātmā'haṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।।23।।
ekadvāre catuścakraṃ vanamālā vibhūṣitam ।
svarṇarekhānvitaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇābhidhaṃ hi tat ।।24।।।
ekadvāre catuścakraṃ vanamālāṃ vinā yadi ।
svarṇarekhānvitaṃ lakṣmījanārdanābhidhaṃ hi tat ।।25।।
dvāradvaye catuścakraṃ goṣpadena samanvitam ।
raghunāthābhidhaṃ jñeyaṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā ।।26।।
svalpaṃ dvicakrasahitaṃ mālayā svarṇarekhayā ।
prabhākṛṣṇābhidhaṃ bodhyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ tatsukhapradam ।। 27।।
sthūlaṃ dvicakraṃ rahitaṃ mālayā svarṇarekhayā ।
pārvatīkṛṣṇasaṃjñaṃ tat tyāgināṃ sukhadaṃ smṛtam ।। 28 ।।
atikṣudraṃ dvicakraṃ tu dadhivāmanasaṃjñitam ।
rekhāyuktaṃ ca vā mālāyug gṛhiṇāṃ sukhapradam ।। 29 ।।
dvicakraṃ mālayā yuktaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīpradaṃ sadā ।
sthūlaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ rahitaṃ vanamālayā ।। 1.338.3 0 ।।
dvicakraṃ dhānyadhanadaṃ jñeyaṃ dāmodarābhidham ।
kṣetrodyānavāṭikākṛt tathā bodhyaṃ suvastradam ।। 3 1 ।।
madhyamaṃ vartulākāraṃ dvicakraṃ bāṇavikṣatam ।
raṇarāmābhidhaṃ bodhyaṃ śaratūṇasamanvitam ।। 32 ।।
madhyamaṃ saptacakraṃ ca chatratūṇasamanvitam ।
rājarājeśvaraṃ bodhyaṃ rājasampatpradaṃ nṛṇām ।। 33 ।।
dvisaptacakraṃ sthūlaṃ ca phaṇāvadūrdhvakā''syakam ।
anantākhyaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ caturvargaphalapradam ।। 34।।।
madhyaraktaṃ dvicakraṃ tu māṇikīkṛṣṇasaṃjñitam ।
dārā'patyagṛharatnapradaṃ vāhanadaṃ hi tat ।। 35।।
cakrākāraṃ dvicakraṃ saśrīkaṃ sagoṣpadaṃ tu yat ।
madhusūdanasaṃjñaṃ tad bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।। 36।।
sudarśanaṃ tvekacakraṃ guptacakraṃ gadādharam ।
dvicakraṃ hayavaktrābhaṃ hayagrīvaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 3 7।।
pañcavaktraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ prakīrtitam ।
atīva vistṛtāsyaṃ dvicakraṃ nṛsiṃhanāmakam ।। 38 ।।
vairāgyatyāgadaṃ tattu sabhālaṃ cet sukhapradam ।
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhasaṃjñaṃ tad vighnahantṛ tathā matam ।। 3 9।।
dvāradeśe dvicakraṃ ca saśrīkaṃ ca samaṃ ca yat ।
tadvāsudevasaṃjñaṃ vai sarvakāmaprapūrakam ।।1.338.40 ।।
sūkṣmacakraṃ tu suṣire bahucchidraṃ pradyūmnakam ।
gṛhiṇāṃ sukhadaṃ saubhāgyādipravardhakaṃ hi tat ।।4 1 ।।
dve cakre tvekalagne ca pṛṣṭhe tu sthūlapuṣkalam ।
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sukhakṛt sadā ।।4 2 ।।
pītābhaṃ vartulaṃ cātiśobhanaṃ tvaniruddhakam ।
sukhapradaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ sampadāṃ ca pravardhakam ।।43 ।।
śālagrāmaśilā yatra tatra lakṣmīrharistathā ।
vasanti sarvatīrthāni tadarcā pāpanāśinī ।।44।।
chatrākāre tu sāmrājyaṃ vartule sarvasampadaḥ ।
duḥkhaṃ tu śakaṭākāre śūlākāre mṛtirbhavet ।।45 ।।
vikṛtāsye tu dāridryaṃ piṃgale hānireva ca ।
lagnacakre bhaved vyādhirvidīrṇe tu mṛtirdhruvā ।।46।।
śālagrāmaśilātoyaiḥ snāyād yaḥ sa tu mānavaḥ ।
sarvatīrthakṛtasnānaḥ sarvayajñasudīkṣitaḥ ।।47।।
vrataṃ dānaṃ pratiṣṭhā ca śrāddhaṃ ca devapūjanam ।
śālagrāmasya nikaṭe kṛtaṃ koṭiprapuṇyadam ।।48।।
śālagrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ mataṃ pṛthvīpradakṣiṇam ।
vedapuṇyaṃ tapaḥpuṇyaṃ śālagrāmārcanād bhavet ।।49।।
śālagrāmajalapātā jīvanmukto bhavet sadā ।
tatpādasparśamicchanti tīrthāni nikhilānyapi ।।1.338.50 ।।
pṛthvī tatpādapūtā tallakṣavaṃśapramokṣaṇam ।
nidhane tajjalapātā viṣṇulokagato bhavet ।।51 ।।
nirvāṇaṃ labhate viṣṇupādayoḥ sa pralīyate ।
śālagrāme tu vicchedaṃ tulasyāśca karoti yaḥ।।52।।
tasya dāmpatyavicchedaḥ strīvicchedo bhaved dhruvam ।
tulasīpatravicchedaṃ śaṃkhe yastu karoti vai ।।53।।
tasya bhāryāvihīnatvaṃ rugṇatvaṃ saptajanmasu ।
śālagrāmaṃ ca tulasīṃ śaṃkhamekatra caiva yaḥ ।।54।।
karoti rakṣati tasya vicchedo na dhanastriyoḥ ।
nārīcchustulasīṃ dadyācchālagrāmāya sarvadā ।।55।।
tasmād devāḥ sadā mahyaṃ tulasyā pūjayantu vai ।
tulasi! tvaṃ mahābhāge! vṛkṣarūpā bhavā'tra me ।।56।।
divyakanyāsvarūpā ca bhavā'trā'haṃ vivāhaye ।
ityuktvā śrīharistāṃ ca virarāma tataśca sā ।।57।।
pūrvadehaṃ parityajya divyarūpaṃ dadhāra ha ।
yathā śrīśca yathā lakṣmīstathovāsa hṛdi prabhoḥ ।।58।।
śālagrāmaśilārūpo ghanavajjalasaṃsthitaḥ ।
bhūmisthaḥ piṃgalo viṣṇurupatāpena saṃsthitaḥ ।।59।।
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī gaṃgā padmā ca tulasī ramā ।
rādhā śrīśca prabhā vṛndā sarvāstā bhagavatstriyaḥ ।।1.338.60।।
jayā pārvatī māṇikyā pāñcālī lalitā tathā ।
joṣṭrādyāḥ śaktayastasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।।61।।
athātra tulasī kanyā divyarūpā'bhavad yadā ।
kṛṣṇavakṣasi saṃlagnā sehe sarasvatītarāḥ ।।62।।
sarasvatī na vai sehe kaṭākṣeṇa vyalokayat ।
tulasī tadbhayāttatra punaradṛśyatāṃ gatā ।।63 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā bodhayitvā sarasvatīm ।
dhyātvā tāṃ pūjayāmāsa stotraṃ tasyāścakāra ca ।।64।।
śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ aiṃ vṛndāyai tulasyai svāhā'-prasaṃjapan ।
dvādaśākṣaramantraṃ taṃ viṣṇuḥ pūjāṃ cakāra ha ।।65।।
pūjayed yo vidhānena sarvasiddhiṃ labhennaraḥ ।
ghṛtadīpena dhūpena sindūracandanena ca ।।66।।
naivedyena ca puṣpeṇa vastrābharaṇakajjalaiḥ ।
alaktakenopahāraiḥ pupūja parameśvaraḥ ।।67।।
stotreṇāpi ca tuṣṭā sā kanyā''virbhūya taddrumāt ।
prapannā pādayoḥ seyaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ hareḥ ।।68 ।।
varaṃ tasyai dadau viṣṇurjagatpūjyā bhaveti ca ।
ahaṃ tvāṃ ca dhariṣyāmi svamūrdhni vakṣasīti ca ।।69।।
sarve tvāṃ dhārayiṣyanti svayaṃ mūrdhni surādayaḥ ।
tadā surairapi devī tulasī pūjitā yathā ।।1.338.70 ।।
āvāhanaṃ kṛtaṃ tasyā āsanaṃ ca samarpitam ।
pādyamarghyamācamanajalamarpitamityatha ।।7 1 ।।
tailaṃ ca mardanāyāpi tadā devaiḥ samarpitam ।
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā cārpitā tathā ।।72।।
pañcāmṛtasnānatīrthajalasnānaṃ ca kāritam ।
śāṭikāghargharīkaṃcukīprabhati samarpitam ।।73।।
kastūrīgandhasārādicandanakajjalādikam ।
kuṃkumakeśatailādisindūrādi samarpitam ।।74।।
alaktakā''bhūṣaṇāni śṛṃgārābharaṇādikam ।
yajñasūtrapavitrakayogapaṭṭādikaṃ tathā ।।75।।
kaustubhamaṇirakṣāmaṃgalasūtrasutantikam ।
naktakavyajanādarśadorakabindusaddravam ।।76।।
kuṃkumā'kṣatagandhadhūpadīpādyarpitaṃ suraiḥ ।
miṣṭānnapāyasalaḍḍuphalatāmbūlavāri ca ।।77।।
maṇḍape kadalīstaṃbhe toraṇāmbarabhūṣite ।
sarvatobhadrake pañcaratnayukkalaśopari ।।78।।
saphalaṃ ca tulasyāstaiḥ kṛtaṃ cārārtrikaṃ tadā ।
vastraṃ śaṃkhodakaṃ tasyai bhrāmitaṃ dhūpadīkam ।।79।।
namanaṃ saphalaṃ cārghyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliḥ pradakṣiṇam ।
stotreṇa rañjanaṃ caiva tulasyāḥ saṃkṛtaṃ tadā ।।1.338.80 ।।
dvādaśavārṣikā kanyā dhyātā svarṇasamā tu taiḥ ।
haristuṣṭāva ca tataḥ śṛṇu lakṣmi! vadāmyaham ।।8 1 ।।
priyāṃ me sarvadā patnīṃ padmāṃ ca tulasīṃ ramām ।
vṛndāṃ ca gaṇḍakīṃ vanaspatiṃ kanyāṃ bhajāmyaham ।।82।।
goloke me priyā nityaṃ priyāṃ patnīṃ bhajāmyaham ।
yayā ramāmi goloke ramāṃ patnīṃ bhajāmyaham ।।83।।
padmāvatī nadī jātā padmāṃ patnīṃ bhajāmyaham ।
yasyāstulā na viśveṣu tulasīṃ tāṃ bhajāmyaham ।।84।।
vṛndāvane tu vṛndāṃ tāṃ vṛndāvanīṃ bhajāmyaham ।
śālagrāmasamāyuktāṃ gaṇḍakīṃ tāṃ bhajāmyaham ।।85।।
gaṇḍayormadbhālayośca kaṃvatīṃ tāṃ bhajāmyaham ।
vṛkṣarūpāṃ puṣpasārāṃ vanaspatiṃ bhajāmyaham ।।86।।
varārohāṃ kanyakāṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ kṛṣṇo bhajāmyaham ।
ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā tatra tasthau ramāpatiḥ ।।87।।
tadā dadarśa tulasīṃ kanyāṃ svapādayornatām ।
varaṃ viṣṇurdadau tasyai viśvapūjyā bhaveti ca ।।88।।
śirodhāryā ca sarveṣāṃ vandyā mānyā mameti ca ।
viṣṇorvareṇa sā devī parituṣṭā babhūva ha ।।89।।
sasmitā mānayāmāsurlakṣmīrgaṃgā sarasvatī ।
virajā rādhikā padmā śrīśca kṛṣṇasya yoṣitaḥ ।।1.338.90 ।।
kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu tulasyā janma maṃgalam ।
tatra pūjā prakartavyā vihitā hariṇā svayam ।।91।।
kārtike tulasīpatraṃ viṣṇave yo dadāti ca ।
gavāmayutadānasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।।।92।।
putrapriyādhanavastragṛhānnayānavāhanam ।
ārogyā'bhayapuṇyādi stotrasya smaraṇād bhavet ।।93।।
puṣpeṣu tulanā cāsyā nāsti devīṣu vā tathā ।
pavītrīkṛtasarvasvā tulasī viśvapāvanī ।।94।।
iti sammānitā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena kanyakā ।
tulasī vṛkṣikā cāpi prasannā'bhūddharīśvarī ।।95।।
uvāca śrīhariṃ kanyā yadi nātha! tvayā prabho । ।
kṛtā svakīyā vāṇyā vā hṛdayenā''tmanā'nvaham ।।96।।
grahītavyo mama karo vivāhasya vidhānataḥ ।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha devā devyo jagustathā ।।97।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tulasīvivāhākhyāne tulasīśālagrāmasvarūpamāhātmyapūjāstotrādikathananāmā'ṣṭatriṃśadadhikatriśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 338 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 338 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 339
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 340 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
tulasīvivāhaṃ pūrṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi keśava! ।
kanyāpakṣaṃ varapakṣaṃ vivāhotsavamityapi ।। 1 ।।
kanyāyāḥ pitarau cāpi varasya pitarau tathā ।
kva kathaṃ sodvāhitā ca ko'bhavat tatpurohitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi smaraṇācchravaṇāttathā ।
pāpanāśakaraṃ mokṣakaraṃ vṛttaṃ vadāmi te ।। 3 ।।
vṛndāvanaṃ cātiramyaṃ yamunātaṭaśobhitam ।
tulasīviṣṇuvaivāhyavidhisthānaṃ suśobhanam ।। 4 ।।
govardhanātsamārabhya paścimakosalāvadhim ।
kurukṣetrāttathā''rabhya khāṇḍakāraṇyakāvadhim ।। 5 ।।
mahākṣetraṃ vivāhasya sthalaṃ cābhūt tadā kṛtam ।
viṣṇuḥ sasmāra bhūsthalyāḥ śuddhyarthaṃ devakarṣukān ।। 6 ।।
drāgeva te samāyātāḥ saṃskṛtā bhūsthalī tu taiḥ ।
viṣṇuḥ sasmāra ca viśvakarmāṇaṃ sa samāyayau । । 7 ।।
cakāra maṇḍapaṃ mukhyaṃ vṛndāvane'ṣṭayojanam ।
cakāra maṇḍapāँścānyān śatayojanavistarān । । 8 ।।
atha vṛṣadhvajo rājā śivabhakto'bhavad yataḥ ।
tadvaṃśajo dharmadhvajastulasī tasya kanyakā ।। 9 । ।
tasmāt tulasyāḥ pitarau bhavataṃ pārvatīharau ।
ityājñaptau viṣṇunā tau tadvaivāhikakarmaṇi । । 1.339.10 ।।
kanyādānavidhānārthaṃ pitarau tu satīharau ।
sarvamānyāvabhavatāṃ tulasī harṣitā'bhavat ।। 11 ।।
atha viṣṇorvarasyātra jijñāsitau tu pitṛkau ।
rādhākṛṣṇau tu pitarau golokasthau susammatau ।। 12।।।
viṣṇunā smāritau tatrā''yayatuḥ sahamaṇḍalau ।
vaikuṇṭhādhipatirnārāyaṇo viṣṇurvaro'tra vai ।। 1 2।।
viṣṇunā saṃsmṛtaḥ kanyākuṭumbasya purohitaḥ ।
devapurohito vṛhaspatirgururupasthitaḥ ।। 14।।
viṣṇunā ca smṛtaḥ purohito varakuṭumbagaḥ ।
dhaumyaḥ kṛṣṇapurohito gargeṇa saha cāyayau ।। 15।।
maṃgalānyabhavan lokācāraścāpi babhūva ha ।
lagnapatrī kuṃkumāptā likhitā preṣitā'pi ca ।। 16।।
vivāhamaṇḍapastatra caturyojanavistṛtaḥ ।
tulasīnāṃ vane yamītīre tvaṣṭrā kṛto navaḥ ।। 17।।
yajñakuṇḍastathā vedī kalaśasthāpanādikam ।
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ mātṛkādisthāpanapūjanam ।। 18।।
grahāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ māṇikākhyastaṃbhapraropaṇam ।
lokācāraśca kanyāyā haridrādravalepanam ।। 19।।
sadāśivena vidhivat kāritaṃ sarvameva tat ।
svasvasambandhipakṣāँścā''juhuvuśca samantataḥ ।। 1.339.20 ।।
varapakṣaśibīraṃ tu khāṇḍavasya vane kṛtam।
kanyāpakṣaśibīraṃ tu tulasīvanake kṛtam ।। 21 ।।
vṛndāvane mahāmukhye maṇḍape mahīmānakāḥ ।
nyuṣuśca kanyakāpakṣā varapakṣāstu khāṇḍave ।। 22 ।।
rādhākṛṣṇena ca tatra smṛtaḥ patnīvrataḥ suraḥ ।
samāyātaḥ sa vipro'tra vedavidyādipāragaḥ ।। 23 ।।
kuṃkumapatrikāstena likhitāḥ preṣitāstathā ।

kanyā patiṃ labhet kṛṣṇasamaṃ saubhāgyadaṃ sadā ।। 1 35।।
yatheṣṭaṃ saṃlabhet sarvaṃ sampadāṃ pātratāṃ labhet ।
duḥkhināṃ duḥkhanāśaḥ syāt śrāvayet śṛṇuyādidam ।। 1 36।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tulasīvivāhākhyāne vṛndāvane yamunātaṭe dvādaśyāṃ viśrāmamaṇḍapādikaraṇaṃ, khāṇḍavavane viṣṇupitṛśibiraṃ, tulasīvane tulasīpitṛśibiraṃ, kuṇḍamaṇḍapādividhānaṃ, jāmimahīmānādyāgamaḥ, varavāhapakṣānāṃ janavāhavāhinyāgamaḥ,
kārtikapūrṇimāyāṃ tulasyā vivāhavidhayaḥ, hastamelāpaḥ, vidāyādiḥ, tulasīvivāhakaraṇaśravaṇādiphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃśada-
dhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।339।।


← adhyāyaḥ 339 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 340
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 341 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
śālagrāmeti saṃjñā vai kathaṃ viṣṇo: kṛtā sadā ।
kiṃ sthalaṃ tat kathāmetāṃ śrāvaya śrīpate hare ॥ 1 ॥
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrṛṇu lakṣmi ! kathāmenāṃ śālagrāmārthabodhinīm ।
yāṃ śrutvā tādṛśī bhaktirbhavenmuktirbhavettathā ॥ 2 ॥
gaṇḍakīti tathānāmnī yathā jātā mahānadī ।
tatra yadyad yathāvṛttaṃ kathayāmi nibodha me ॥ 3 ॥
tulasyā pūrvato jñātvā śālagrāmākhyabhūtalam ।
śālagrāmaśilā bhavetyacyuta: śāpitastadā ॥ 4 ॥
hareśca tapato gaṇḍadeśayorjalamadbhutam ।
utpannaṃ ca jaladhārā yatpradeśe papāta vai ॥ 5 ॥
tatkṣetraṃ gaṇḍakīkṣetraṃ jñātvā prāg jātameva ha ।
viṣṇunā gaṇḍakī bhavetyabhiśaptaṃ tadā purā ॥ 6 ॥
śālagrāme siddhakṣetre śilā babhūva keśavaḥ ।
gaṇḍakī nirjharaṇe sā nadī jātā tu gaṇḍakī ॥ 7 ॥
śrṛṇu vistarataścaitatkṣetraṃ sālaṃkanirmitam ।
āsīd brahmarṣiparamaḥ sālaṃkāyanasaṃjñakaḥ ।। 8 ।।
pūrve kṛtayuge me tvārādhanāya diśo daśa ।
bhramate sma mahābhakto putreṣaṇāsamanvitaḥ ॥ 9 ॥
putrārthaṃ sa tapastepe meruśrṛṃge samāhitaḥ ।
piṇḍārake tathā lohārgale ca raivate girau ॥1.340.10॥
mama sākṣād vinā tasya śāntirbhavati naiva yat ।
sa tu tatra samāyātastapo'rthe hrimasannidhau ॥11॥
tapastepe bahuvarṣaṃ sālaṃkākhyo muni: sadā ।
tena parṇagṛhaṃ tatra kṛtaṃ patnyarthamalpakam ॥12॥
anye cāpi bhuvo devāḥ sapatnīkāḥ samāvasan।
grāmo'bhūt sālaracitaḥ śālavṛkṣeṣu tadvane ॥13॥
sālavṛkṣe'yanakartā sālaṃkāyana ityabhūt ।
śāleṣu grāmavāsena śālagrāmasthalaṃ tvabhūt ॥14॥
tulasyā tatpūrvavṛttaṃ vijñāyaiva śilātmakaḥ ।
bhava śālagrāmavāsī tvityukto'haṃ tathā'bhavam ॥15॥
tatrāgatya śailarūpo vartāmi vai madicchayā ।
sālaṃkasya tapasyugre prasannena mayā tadā ॥16॥
darśanaṃ svaṃ pradāyaiva putrāśīrvādayojitaḥ ।
saḥ prāha tvatsamaḥ putro bhavatveva mama prabho ॥17॥
mayā tathāstviti proktaṃ tatputraścā'bhavaँstataḥ ।
śālagrāme parvate'haṃ vāsamakaravaṃ mama ॥ 18ll
vartāmi jaḍavat tatra śileva sarvadā priye ।
ṛṣiḥ sālaṃka evā'tra nidhanaṃ prāptavāँstataḥ ॥19॥
śalākākhyā ca me mātā satī tena sahā'bhavat ।
tayormokṣaṃ vidhāyaiva viṣṇurahaṃ tu tatsthale ॥1.340.20॥
adṛśyatāṃ gato nityaṃ śilāpuñje vasāmi ca ।
śaptaśca punarevā'trā''dhikyena nivasāmi vai ॥21॥
tatra kṣetre haro devī matsvarūpeṇa saṃyuta: ।
śālagrāme girau tasmin śilārūpeṇa tiṣṭhati ॥22॥
ahaँ tiṣṭhāmi tatraiva girirūpeṇa nityaśaḥ ।
tasmin śilāḥ samagrāstu matsvarūpā na saṃśayaḥ ॥23॥
sarvāstu pūjanīyāstāḥ kiṃ punaścakralāñchitāḥ ।
liṃgarūpā: śilāḥ śaṃbhurūpā bodhyā'tra parvate ॥24॥
śivanābhāḥ śilāḥ śaṃbhuścakranābhāḥ śilāstvaham ।
sālaṃkāyanakākhyasya munestu tapaso balāt ॥25॥
śaṃbhunā saha sammantrya sthitāvāvāṃ mama priye ! ।
śālagrāmagirirviṣṇuḥ śivaśṛṃgaṃ śivosti saḥ ॥26॥
tayoḥ parvatayoryā vai śilā viṣṇuśivā'bhidhā ।
revayā tu kṛtaṃ pūrve tapa: śivasutuṣṭidam ॥27॥
mama tvatsadṛśaḥ putro bhūyāditi manīṣayā ।
revāyai tena datto vai varo liṃgasvarūpataḥ ॥28॥
garbhe tava nivatsyāmi putro bhūtvā śivapriye ! ।
ityuktvā sa śivaḥ śālagrāmagiriṃ vihāya ca ॥29॥
yayau pāṣāṇarūpo vai liṃgātmā narmadājale ।
narmadāyāṃ tale śivaliṃgaśrṛṃgasya copalāḥ ॥1.340.30॥
sarvāstāḥ śivarūpā vai tathā'trā'haṃ hariḥ svayam ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi ! śālagrāmārthabodhakam ॥31॥
athāpi śrṛṇu vṛttāntaṃ mayā taptaṃ tapo bahu ।
madgaṇḍayoḥ svedajalājjalakulyā'bhavattu yā ॥32॥
sāpi cetanarūpā'bhūt kanyā kamalalocanā ।
tapastepe ca sā tatra dāruṇaṃ putravāñchayā ॥33॥
śīrṇaparṇāśanaṃ kṛtvā vāyubhakṣā'pyanantaram ।
divyavarṣaśataṃ tepe viṣṇucintāparā sadā ॥34॥
tatra sākṣādbhave'haṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
avocaṃ madhuraṃ tāṃ tu prītaḥ praṇatavatsalaḥ ।35॥
gaṇḍaki ! tvāṃ prasanno'smi tapasā vismito'naghe ।
avichinnayā bhaktyā ca varaṃ varaya tāpasi ! |36।
kiṃ deyaṃ tad vadasvāśu prīto'smi varavarṇini ! ।
gaṇḍakyapi puro dṛṣṭvā śaṃkhacakragadā'bjinam ॥37॥
daṇḍavatpraṇatā bhūtvā tataḥ stotuṃ pracakrame ।
“aho deva ! bhavaddaṇḍāt prāvirbhūya jalātmikā ॥38॥
yāvadatra tu vartāmi bhavānadṛdṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
kathamekākinīṃ tvatrā'raṇye vasāmi keśava ! ॥39॥
sa vai punarmayā dṛṣṭo durdarśo yogināmapi |
svāṃ yogamāyāmāviśya rūpatāṃ prāptavānasi ॥1.340.40॥
mūḍhasya jagato madhye sthitā kiṃcidajānatī ।
tvayā kṛtā dhṛtā cāsmi yogyā'yogyamavindatī ||41॥
tvayā mahattāṃ gamitā dṛṣṭā yā'smi tvayā'dya vai ।
yayāce'jñatayodāra ! tanme dātuṃ tvamarhasi ॥42॥
dayālurasi sarvātman dīneṣu tu viśeṣataḥ । .
ityuktvā prāṃjalirbhūtvā yayāce vāñchitaṃ varam ॥43॥
mama garbhagato bhūtvā viṣṇo ! matputratāṃ vraja ।
atha viṣṇustu tāṃ prāha śrṛṇu devi ! vaco mama ।|44||
śālagrāmaśilārūpī tava garbhagataḥ sadā ।
sthāsyāmi tava putratve bhaktānugrahṛkāraṇāt ||45॥
tvaṃ samāgaccha vaikuṇṭhaṃ bālā mā'tra vasā'naghe ! ।।
atrā''yāsyati me patnī tulasī saritātmikā ||46||
gaṇḍakyākhyā bhāvinī sā mahatī mama dhāriṇī ।
ityabhidhāya bhagavān bālāṃ nināya pakṣiṇā ||47||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tāṃ ca tatraiva rakṣitvā tvāyayau punaḥ । ।
yatra sā jalakulyā'sti gaṇḍakī tajjale ca saḥ ॥48॥
śilātmakastu vasati varadānasya kāraṇāt ।
so'haṃ śilāsvarūpo'smi viṣṇurlakṣmi ! sadātanuḥ ॥49॥
matsānnidhyānnadīnāṃ sā hyatiśreṣṭhā'bhavat tataḥ ।
darśanātsparśanātsnānātpānāccaivā'vagāhanāt ॥1.340.50॥
harate sā mahatpāpaṃ vāṅmanaḥkāyasaṃbhavam ।
snāsyati yastu gaṇḍakyāṃ devarṣipitṛtarpakaḥ ॥51il
tārayitvā ca tatpitṝn brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati ।
yadi tatrotsṛjetprāṇān so'pi vaikuṇṭhamāpnuyām ॥52॥
lakṣmīḥ prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ kathaṃ vai bhagavān purā । ।
kaṭhinaṃ vai tapaścakre yadgaṇḍavārigaṇḍakī ॥53॥
nārāyaṇastadā lakṣmīṃ prāha śṛṇu priye ! sadā ।
lokānāṃ hita kāryāya śreyase dharmaguptaye ||54।।
tapaḥ karomi bahudhā kalyāṇārthaṃ ca tuṣṭaye ।
etattīrthaṃ pūrvasṛṣṭāvāsīt kartuṃ tathāvidham ॥55॥
tatrāhaँ tapa ārebhe bahukalyāṇahetave ।
ahaṃ jānāmi tatsarvaṃ nānyo jānāti pūrvakṛt ॥56॥
yadā himālaye lakṣmi ! naranārāyaṇāvapi ।
na caivāstāṃ dharmaputrau tadā lokāvanāya vai ॥57।।
mayā tapa: paraṃ taptaṃ himālayasamīpataḥ ।
śālagrāme mahrākṣetre tanme sthānaṃ tadā'bhavat ॥58॥
tatra tapasyato me vai kāle bahutithe gate । ।
tīvraṃ tejaḥ prādurāsīd yena lokāścarā'carāḥ ॥59॥
tasyoṣmaṇā'ti saṃbhrāntā vismitāḥ sarvatodiśam ।
uṣmaṇā ca samudbhūtaḥ svedapūrastu gaṇḍayoḥ ॥1.340.60॥
tena jātā dhunī divyā lokānāmaghahāriṇī । ।
tasya prabhavamicchanto jñātuṃ neśā: kathaṃcana ॥61॥
devāḥ sarve tato jagmurbrahmāṇaṃ prati sotsukāḥ ।
brahmā'pyajño yayau devaiḥ samaṃ śrīśaṃkaraṃ prati ॥62॥
papracchā'dbhutatejaḥ kiṃ kasmāt kathaṃ prabho vad । ।
śivo dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ pratyuvāca viṣṇustapaḥsthitaḥ ॥63॥
gacchāmo yatra sa cāste iti te tatsthalaṃ yayuḥ ।
śaṃbhuḥ smayannuvācainaṃ tapasyasi kathaṃ prabho ॥64।।
prapūrṇasarvakāmasya kiṃ te tapasi kāraṇam ।
evamukto mahāviṣṇurnamaskṛtya sureśvarān ।।65।।
prāha lokahitārthāya tapastaptuṃ samudyataḥ ।। .
yuṣmaddarśanamāsādya kṛtārtho'bhavamadya vai !|66॥
etatkṣetraṃ devabhūmistīrthaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ bhavet ।। .
tathāśīrvacanairdevāḥ kṛpāṃ kurvantu sarvathā ॥67॥
tacchrutvā tu tadā brahmā śaṃbhustathā'nyadevatāḥ ।
ūcurviṣṇo ! darśanātte muktikṛtkṣetrameva yat ॥68॥
devānāṃ darśanāccāpi muktikṣetramidaṃ bhavet ।
gaṇḍasvedodbhavā yatra gaṇḍakī saritāṃ varā ॥69॥
bhaviṣyati na sandeho yasyā garbhe bhaviṣyasi ।
tvayi sthite jagannāthe tava sānnidhyakāraṇāt ।।1.340.70॥
vayaṃ devāḥ samunayo vedāstīrthāni vai makhāḥ ।
nivatsyāmaḥ sadaivātra gaṇḍakyāṃ jagatāṃ pate ! ॥71॥
kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ yastu snāsyati tajjale !
sarvapāpavinirmukto muktibhāgī na saṃśayaḥ ।। 72॥
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ maṃgalānāṃ ca maṃgalam ।
smaraṇād darśanātsparśād gaṃgādhikaphalaṃ bhavet ॥73॥
eṣā sā paramā puṇyā gaṇḍakī bhuktimuktidā ।
aparā devikā nāmnā gaṇḍakyā saha saṃgatā ॥74॥
pulastyapulahau pūrvaṃ tepāte paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
yatra sṛṣṭividhānārthaṃ kratvā''śramapadaṃ pṛthak ॥75॥
sṛṣṭervidhānasāmarthyaṃ tābhyāṃ labdhaṃ tataḥ param ।
tato'bhavad brahmaputrī gaṇḍakyā militā tu sā ॥76॥
tatra triveṇyāṃ hariṇā gajagrāhau vimocitau ।
sudarśanena cakreṇa grāhāsyaṃ pāṭitaṃ drutam ॥77॥
kṣiptaṃ punaḥ punastattu cakraṃ saṃghaṭayacchilāḥ ।
saṃghaṭanāttu cakrasya śilāścakreṇa lāñchitāḥ ।।78॥
vajrakīṭaistatastadvad devaistā vardhitāḥ sadā ।
atha śālagrāmakṣetre bhaktarakṣārthameva hi ।। 79||
sudarśanaṃ mayā''jñaptaṃ yatra bhramati sarvadā ।
tatra cakreṇa tāḥ sarvā aṃkitā hyabhavan śilāḥ ।।1.340.80॥
muktikṣetrāddhariharakṣetraparyantameva tat ।
dvādaśayojanaṃ kṣetraṃ śālagrāmaśilāmayam ॥81॥
svabhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ mayā yatra sthitiḥ kṛtā ।
tatra sāladrumāścāpi mamāṃśāḥ santi sundari ! ।।82।।
yo'yaṃ vṛkṣastu gaṇḍakyā dṛṣṭaḥ so'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
mama tadrocateṃ sthānaṃ girikūṭaśiloccaye ॥83॥
śālagrāmasthalaṃ khyātaṃ bhaktasaṃsāramokṣaṇamū ।
cakrasvāmisthale cakraśilā tvitastataḥ khalu ॥84॥
dṛśyante tatsthalaṃ sarvaṃ pāvanaṃ mama yogata: ।
gaṇḍakī tulasī vṛndā padmā mattanusaṃśritā ॥85॥
tadāśritān mama lokaṃ prāpayenmadbalāddhruvam ।
śālagrāmasya gaṇḍakyāstulasyāśca mama priye ! ॥86॥
yathāvṛttaṃ kathitaṃ te mamāpi tapasi sthitiḥ ।
tīrthasaṃsthāpanārthāya lokakalyāṇahetave ॥87॥
śilārūpeṇa mūrterme dehināṃ lābhahetave ।
kaṇapatrādirūpeṇa jantūnāṃ lābhahetave ॥88॥
jalapānāśrayādyaiśca sarveṣa lābhahetave ।
mayā mama svarūpāṇi kṛtāni sarjanakṣaṇe ॥89॥
ityeṣā me kṛpā lakṣmi ! prāṇyuddhāraparasya vai ।
eṣo'dhyāyo mahābhāge ! sarvamaṃgalakārakaḥ ॥1.340.90॥
teja: śriyaṃ ca lakṣmīṃ ca sarvakāmān susampadaḥ ।
labhante paṭhamānā vai mama mārgānusāriṇaḥ ॥91॥
yāvanti cākṣarāṇi syuratrādhyāye manasvini ! । ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi mama loke mahīyate ॥92॥
etanmaraṇakāle tu na kadāciddhi vismaret।
ślokaṃ vā yadi vā pādaṃ yadīcchetparamāṃ gatim ॥93॥
etatte kathitaṃ bhadre rahasyaṃ śreyasāṃ padam ।।
mama kṣetraṃ mahābhāge ! kimanyacchrotumicchasi ॥94॥
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śālagrāmakṣetrākhyāne gaṇḍakīśālagrāmanāmārthabodhaka prāgvṛttāntaḥ, sālaṃkāyanarṣikṛta tapastatputrarūpaviṣṇustasya tatraiva śilārūpeṇa sthiti:, revānadyāḥ putrārthaṃ tapaḥ, revāyāṃ putrātmakaliṃgarūpeṇa śaṃbhoḥ sthiti:, śālavṛkṣe tapasyato viṣṇorgaṇḍasthalāt pravāhasya gaṇḍakīti saṃjñā, sā tulasīsvarūpā, gajendramokṣārthaṃ grāhe kṣiptasya cakrasya ghaṭṭanena pāṣāṇakīṭakṛtyo ca cakracihnānītyādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ॥340॥


← adhyāyaḥ 340 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 341
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 342 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śālagrāmaśilāṃ śaṃbhuśilāṃ nadīṃ ca gaṇḍakīm ।
śāladruṃ munisālaṃkaṃ śrutvā satīṃ ca tūlasīm ।। 1 ।।
mānasaṃ me na ca tṛptimāyāti śravaṇaspṛham ।
tīrthāni vada śālagrāmakṣetrasthāni keśava ।। 2 ।।
yacchravaṇena pāpānāmapyuddhāro bhaviṣyati ।
yatkaraṇena cātrāpi dhanadārādimān bhavet ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
aho bhāgyamaho puṇyaṃ śālagrāmakathāśrutiḥ ।
aho daivamaho muktiḥ śālagrāmaśilārcanam ।। 4 ।।
aho svargamaho rājyaṃ śālagrāmasthalasthitiḥ ।
aho smṛddhiraho tṛptirgaṇḍakīvārisevanam ।। 5 ।।
jīvānāṃ bahupuṇyānāmudaye sati padmaje! ।
śālagrāmasthalayogo jāyate na tato'nyathā ।। 6 ।।
śālagrāmasthalaṃ gatvā kariṣye gaṇḍakījale ।
snānatarpaṇamityevaṃ saṃkalpayata aihikī ।। 7 ।।
pitṝṇāmapi tṛptirvai jāyate kurvato nu kim ।
pāpānāṃ pāpanāśārthaṃ svargārthe puṇyaśālinām ।। 8 ।।
sakāmānāṃ samṛddhyarthaṃ muktyarthaṃ bhaktiśālinām ।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe mayā śālagrāmakṣetraṃ vinirmitam ।। 9 ।।
śālagrāmaśilā mūrtiḥ pratimā me mayā kṛtā ।
ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ pūjākartre bhuktiṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।। 1.341.1 0।।
dadāmi cānyadiṣṭaṃ yad dhanadārāgṛhādikam ।
kṛpayaiva mayā prāṇyuddhārārthaṃ tadvinirmitam ।। 11 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! sthale tatra yāni tīrthāni santi ca ।
yathā yathā ca jātāni tāni vakṣyāmi sarvaśaḥ ।। 1 2।।
sālaṃkāyanatīrthe vai śālagrāmākhyaparvataḥ ।
somena sthāpitastatra haraḥ someśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 13 ।।
someśvaragiriścāpi gaṇḍakī kathitāni te ।
someśād dakṣiṇe bhāge bāṇenā'driṃ vibhidya ca ।। 14।।।
rāvaṇena tapaḥ kṛtvā jaladhārā'tipuṇyadā ।
prakāśitā bāṇagaṃgā tīrthe paramapāvanam ।। 15 ।।
someśātpūrvatastatra rāvaṇasya tapovanam ।
tatra rāvaṇanṛtyena prakhyāto nartanācalaḥ ।। 16 ।।
tasya nṛtyena santuṣṭaḥ śaṃbhurvaraṃ dadau tadā ।
bāṇeśvaraṃ bāṇagaṃgā tīrthe svargapradaṃ śubham ।। 17।।
tatra sthitvā trirātreṇa tapasaḥ phalamāpnuyāt ।
snātvā gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjāphalaṃ labhet ।। 18।।
atha triveṇītīrthaṃ vai tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tathā ।
yatra vai devikānāmnī sarit milati gaṇḍakīm ।। 1 9।।
tapasyatāṃ tu devānāṃ taponiyamanāya sā ।
samudbhūtā nadī sā vai devānāṃ mokṣadāyinī ।। 1.341.20 ।।
atha pulastyapulahāśramācca devikā'parā ।
gaṇḍakyā saha militā triveṇī gaṇḍakīti sā ।।2 1 ।।
kāmikaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ param ।
triveṇīti samākhyātaṃ śṛṇu sā''khyānamatra tat ।। 22।।
purā viṣṇustapastepe lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।
himālaye tadā kālo yāto dīrghatamo yadā ।।23।।
tanmūrteranalastīvraḥ prādurāsīddharestadā ।
tasyoṣmaṇā samutpannaḥ svedapūrastu gaṇḍayoḥ ।।24।।
tena jātā dhunī divyā gaṇḍakī sā saridvarā ।
devikākhyā nadī yogaṃ tayā saha gatā tadā ।।25।।
devānāṃ tapasā tatrotpannā sā devikā matā ।
pulastyapulahayostapobhirjātā'parā nadī ।।26।।
sṛṣṭijñānaṃ tatra labdhaṃ tābhyāṃ vai tapasā tataḥ ।
tṛtīyā sā brahmaputrīnāmnī nadī yaśasvinī ।।27।।
gaṇḍakyā tatra militā triveṇīti prakīrtitā ।
tatra snānāt tapaścaryāphalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ।।28।।
athānyatte pravakṣyāmi tatra triveṇikāsthale ।
gajendramokṣaṇaṃ grāhamokṣaṇaṃ kṛtavān hari ।।29।।।
purā vedanidheḥ putrau jayavijaya ityubhau ।
hariṃ prasādya saṃjātau pārṣadau bhagavadgṛhe ।।1.341.30 ।।
tāveva rādhikāśāpāt punaḥ kalpāntare bhuvi ।
samāyātau pṛthivyāṃ ca tṛṇabindoḥ sutāvubhau ।।3 1।।
jātau yajñakarau vedavidyāvedāṃgapāragau ।
pūjayantau hariṃ bhaktyā tanniṣṭhendriyamānasau ।।32।।
pūjākāle harirnityaṃ tayoḥ sānnidhyamṛcchati ।
maruttena kadācittāvāhūtau yajñakarmaṇi ।।33।।
rājñā samāptayajñena toṣitau dakṣiṇādibhiḥ ।
vibhāgaṃ kartumārabdhau dhanādestau parasparam ।।34।।
paspardhāte samo bhāgaḥ kāryo jyeṣṭho'bhyabhāṣata ।
vijayastvabravīccainaṃ yena labdhaṃ hi tasya tat ।।35।।
ahaṃ vai kuśalastasmānmayā labdhaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
tvaṃ tathā na samartho'si na dāsye samabhāgataḥ ।।36।।
jayo'bravīdasāmarthyaṃ manvāno mā bravīṣi kim ।
na dadāsi gṛhītvā yat tasmād grāhatvamāpnuhi ।।37।।।
vijayo'pyabravīnnūnamandhobhūto'si vai dhanaiḥ ।
gajo bhava madāndhastvamiti tau śāpataḥ pṛthak ।।38।।
gajagrāhāvabhūtāṃ vai jātismarau jayo gajaḥ ।
triveṇīkṣetrakāraṇye vijayastu jalāntare ।। 39।।
grāho'bhavad vane tatra gajaṃ snātuṃ samāgatam ।
jalamadhyagatagrāho jagrāha vairamāsmaran ।।1.341.40 ।।
tayoryuddhaṃ samabhavadanekābdaṃ vikarṣaṇaiḥ ।
varuṇena tato vijñāpito bhaktivaśo hariḥ ।।41 ।।
hastikamaladānena triveṇīṃ prasamāyayau ।
sudarśanena cakreṇa grāhāsyaṃ samapāṭayat ।।42।।
gajasyāpi kṛtā muktirgrāhasyāpi pramokṣaṇam ।
sudarśanapraghaṭṭanakriyayā prastarādiṣu ।।43।।
cakracihnāni jātāni mahimā te prakīrtitaḥ ।
evametanpuṇyatīrthaṃ tārakaṃ dehināṃ param ।।44।।
jaleśvaro mahādevastatra virājate priye! ।
mayā cakraṃ yadā kṣiptaṃ pṛthvyāṃ salilamāgatam ।।45।।
tatsthānaṃ vai tvabhūccakramayaṃ tīrthaṃ jaleśvaram ।
pañcadinaṃ vaset tatra bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhejjanaḥ ।।46।।
sālakāyanapautro'bhūnnandīśvaro gaṇaḥ purā ।
vṛndāvane sa vasati godhanaṃ cārayan sadā ।।47।।
ekadā gāḥ samādāya harikṣetraṃ jagāma saḥ ।
nandī haraḥ svayaṃ prokto harikṣetraṃ jagāma saḥ ।।48।।
gaṇḍakyāḥ sa taṭe vāsaṃ cakāra bahurātrikam ।
gāścaranti śādvalāni yatra kṣetre divāniśam ।।49।।
taddinādeva tatkhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ hariharātmakam ।
devānāmaṭanāccaiva devāṭa-ityapi smṛtam ।।।1.341.50।।
ekadā bhagavān śaṃbhurāsthitaḥ pīṭhamuttamam ।
śaṃbhostatra trijaṭābhyo'bhavaँstisraḥ pravāhikāḥ ।।5 1 ।।
gaṃgā ca yamunā puṇyā tathā sarasvatī nadī ।
etat traidhārikaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra śaṃbhuḥ sadā sthitaḥ ।।52।।
diśan jñānaṃ svabhaktānāṃ saṃsārād yena mokṣaṇam ।
snātvā santarjya pitṝn saṃpūjya devān pramucyate ।।53।।
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge haṃsatīrthaṃ hi vidyate ।
kākāstatra kadācidvai samutpeturbubhukṣitāḥ ।।54।।
annaṃ gṛhītvā kākaṃ vai yāntaṃ kāko'parastadā ।
dṛṣṭvā yuyudhe tau tatra kuṇḍe nipetatustataḥ ।।55।।
haṃsau bhūtvā viniryātau gatau vai mānasaṃsaraḥ ।
ityāścaryamayaṃ tadvai haṃsatīrthamiti kṛtam ।।56।।
muktikṣetrāddhaṃsatīrthaṃ kṣetraṃ dvādaśayojanam ।
tairthikānāṃ bhogamokṣobhayadaṃ 3 mayāśritam ।।57।।
atha sālaṃkāyanarṣiryatra tapo'caraddhi tat ।
sālavṛkṣasamūhaḥ saḥ śālagrāmo'bhavatprathaḥ ।।58।।
tatra tīrthani guptāni bhavanti daśa pañca ca ।
tatra bilvaprabhaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ kuṃjacatuḥśrayam ।।99।।
tatra nadyāṃ janaḥ snātvā divāniśaṃ nivāsataḥ ।
caturṇṇāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ।।1.341.60।।
athā'paraṃ cakrasvāmitīrthaṃ cakraśilāmayam ।
triyojanapravistāraṃ trirātraṃ nivasejjanaḥ ।।61।।
trirātrayajñapuṇyaṃ vai prāpnotyeva sutīrthakṛt ।
prāṇatyāge tu saṃjāte vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ।।62।।
atha viṣṇupadaṃ kṣetraṃ dhārāstisro himācalāt ।
patanti yatra tatraiva snānāt tīrthaphalaṃ labhet ।।63 ।।
prāṇatyāge'tirātrāṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ puṇyabhāg bhavet ।
tatra kālīhrado nāma tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ।।64।।
badarīvṛkṣamūlādvai hradasroto vahatyapi ।
snānāt tatra naramedhaphalaṃ prāpya vimucyate ।।65।।
atha śaṃkhaprabhaṃ tīrthaṃ dvādaśyāmardharātrake ।
śrūyante śaṃkhaśabdāśca śrotāro muktibhāginaḥ ।।66।।
atha gadākhyakuṇḍe vai tīrthe dakṣiṇasrotasi ।
snātvā vedāntavidyādi phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ।।67।।
athā'gnisuprabhaṃ tīrthaṃ jalaṃ prāguttaraṃ śubham ।
hemante coṣṇakaṃ vāri grīṣme bhavati śītalam ।।68।।
dhārārūpeṇa patati snātvā pacāgniṣomabhāg ।
atha sarvāyudhaṃ tīrthaṃ saptasrotomayaṃ hi tat ।।69।।
snātvā bhavenmahān rājā saptadināni saṃvaset ।
atha devaprabhaṃ tīrthaṃ caturdhārāsamanvitam ।।1.341.70 ।।
snātvā tatra labhed vedacatuṣṭayavibodhanam ।
atha vidyādharaṃ tīrthaṃ pañcadhārāsamanvitam ।।7 1 ।।
snātvā vidyādharalokaṃ prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
tatra puṇyanadītīrthaṃ śilākuṃjalatāvṛtam ।।72।।।
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta saptadvīpādhipo bhavet ।
ekadhāre tu gāndharvatīrthe snātvā sukhī bhavet ।।73 ।।
modate lokapāleṣu mama lokaṃ ca gacchati ।
atha devahradastīrthaṃ yatra matsyāḥ sacakrakāḥ ।।74।।
sauvarṇāni ca padmāni dṛśyante bhāskarodaye ।
tatra snātā divaṃ yānti śuddhā vākkāyanairmalaiḥ । ।75 ।।
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।
yatra yatra devanadyo saṃgamo jāyate priye! । ।76। ।
tatra devāśca devyaśca tiṣṭhanti tīrtharūpiṇaḥ ।
gandharvā'psarasaḥ paryo nāgakanyāḥ sahoragaiḥ ।।77। ।
devarṣayaśca munayaḥ sarve'pi ca sureśvarāḥ ।
siddhāḥ santaḥ kinnarāśca svargādavātaranti hi ।।78।।
himālaye ca nepāle paśupaterbhuvo'tra vai ।
tebhyastebhyaśca sthānebhyo nadyo vahanti bhūtalam । ।79। ।
śvetagaṃgayā saṃbhūya nānānadyo vanānugāḥ ।
gaṇḍakyā kṛṣṇayā caiva saṃgamāptāḥ śivodbhavāḥ ।।1.341.80 ।।
triśūlagaṃgā sā jātā sarvatīrthakadambakam ।
siddhāśramastathā tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ puṇyavardhanam । ।8 1।।
śaṃbhostapovanaṃ cāpi puṇyanadyośca saṃsrave ।
snānācchatāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ tatra bhaved dhruvam ।।82।।
vaiśākhye tatra cāplāvya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ।
māghamāse punaḥ snātvā prayāgasnānajaṃ phalam । ।83 ।।
kārtike satulāravau snānānmuktirna saṃśayaḥ ।
trirātrasnānatastatra rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।।84।।
yajño dānaṃ tapo homaḥ śrāddhaṃ pūjā hyanantakam ।
śālagrāme mahākṣetre devanadyośca saṃsrave । ।85।।
ahaṃ lakṣmi! pūrvamukhaḥ sadā vasāmi muktidaḥ ।
śivo me dakṣiṇe pārśve brahmā vāme sadā sthitaḥ ।।86। ।
hariharātmakaṃ viṣṇubrahmātmakaṃ sthalaṃ tu tat ।
mṛtā muktiṃ prayāntyeva svargaṃ vai śāśvataṃ dhruvam ।।87।।
muktikṣetraṃ tu prathamaṃ rurukhaṇḍastataḥ param ।
saṃbhedo devanadyośca triveṇī ca tataḥ param ।।88।।
gaṇḍakīkṣetramevedaṃ gaṃgayā militaṃ tu yat ।
gaṇḍakī yatra militā bhāgīrathyā tu gaṃgayā ।।89।।
kṣetraṃ hariharākhyaṃ tanmahimā suradurlabhaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi tīrthasnānaphalaṃ bhavet ।।1.341.90।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śālagrāmakṣetrasthasālaṃkāyanasomeśvaragaṇḍakībāṇagaṃgātriveṇī-devikābrahmaputrīgajagrāhatīrthajaleśvaratraidhārikatīrthahaṃsatīrthaśālagrāmatīrthacakrasvāmitīrthaviṣṇupadaśaṃkhaprabhagadākuṇḍā'gniprabhasarvāyudhadevaprabhavidyā-
dharaikadhāradevahradatriśūlagaṃgāhariharakṣetrāditīrthapradarśananāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 341 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 341 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 342
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 343 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
rurukṣetraṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ rurutīrthaṃ ca kīdṛśam ।
tanme vada kṛpāsindho śrotumicchāmi sarvaśaḥ ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
purā vipro devadatto bhṛguvaṃśodbhavo'bhavat ।
divyaṃ tapo'tapad yatra mṛgākīrṇāśrame purā ।। 2 ।।
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ jātaṃ tapasi vartato muneḥ ।
vyacintayattadā tvindro vighnaṃ kartuṃ tapasyataḥ ।। 3 ।।
kāmaṃ vasantasahitaṃ gandharvān sasakhīn punaḥ ।
pramlocāṃ preṣayāmāsa malayānilamityapi ।। 4 ।।
indrasyā''jñāṃ samādāya yayustasyāśramaṃ prati ।
samīpopavane ramye kokilā''lāpaguñjite ।। 5 ।।
rasālakusumāmodavyāpipavanaśītale ।
bhramaranādasaṃghuṣṭe gandharvagītagarjite ।। 6 ।।
paṃkajanetrasaṃśobhajjalasthalātimañjule ।
praviśya sā tu pramlocā gītaṃ sumadhuraṃ jagau ।। 7 ।।
munirdhyānāduparato gandharvā gītimārabhan ।
kāmo labdhā'vasaraṃ ca vicakarṣa dhanustadā ।। 8 ।।
muniḥ kṣubdha iti jñātvā sāyakān samayūyujat ।
munistato vicacārā''śramaṃ śṛṇvan sugītikām ।। 9 ।।
dūrād dadarśa tanvaṃgīṃ kandukakrīḍanānvitām ।
tasyāḥ samīpamagamat sāpi samīpamāgatā ।। 1.342.10 ।।
sammohito munistāṃ cā'pṛcchat kā tvaṃ kathaṃ vane ।
sā prāha munisevārthamāgatā'smi gṛhāṇa mām ।। 11 ।।
atha tāṃ hasamānāṃ sa ramayāmāsa kāmataḥ ।
bahūnahargaṇānevaṃ ramamāṇo yadṛcchayā ।। 12।।
nirvedaṃ prāptavān sadyastadovāca punaḥ punaḥ ।
aho māyābalaṃ paśya yayā'haṃ bhṛśamohitaḥ ।। 13 ।।
jānannapi tapobhraṃśaṃ prāpto devabalātkṛtam ।
pumān strīdarśanādeva dravate tadvimohitaḥ ।। 14।।
nā'parādhastato nāryāḥ pumān yadajitendriyaḥ ।
evaṃ vicāraṃ kṛtvā tāṃ visasarja munistataḥ ।। 15।।
tyaktvā vighnamayaṃ sthānaṃ gatvā bhṛgvāśramaṃ prati ।
kṛtasnānastu gaṇḍakyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ diśi nirjane ।। 16 ।।
atapyata tapo ghoraṃ bhṛgutuṃge śivopari ।
śivaḥ sākṣāt samāgatyovāca taṃ munisattamam ।। 17।।
viṣṇuśivāvabhedena paśyaँstvaṃ siddhimāpyasyasi ।
etacchivasthale liṃgaṃ samaṃgamiti tatkṛtam ।। 18।।
samaṃgeśvaratīrthaṃ tajjātaṃ vai gaṇḍakītaṭe ।
devadattastathā jñātvā sāyujyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ।। 1 9।।
pramlocāpi munergarbhaṃ pakvaṃ kanyāsvarūpiṇam ।
prāgāśrame parityajya yayau svargaṃ tataḥ priye । ।। 1.342.2 0।।
rurubhirmṛgavaryaiḥ sā kanyā saṃpoṣitā satī ।
yuvabhiḥ prārthyamānā'pi citte kaṃcana nā'dhyagāt ।। 21 ।।
cintayānā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tapasi pratitiṣṭhati ।
māse sā prathame bālā phalāhāraparāyaṇā ।। 22 ।।
ekāntaraṃ dinaṃ prāpya dvitīye tridināntare ।
tṛtīye pañcamadine caturthe saptamāntare ।।23।।
pañcame navarātreṇa ṣaṣṭhe pañcadaśāhake ।
māsena saptame ceti śīrṇaparṇāśanā'ṣṭame ।।24।।
tyaktvā tānyapi sā bālā vāyvāhārā babhūva ha ।
evaṃ varṣaśate yāte tasyāḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ।।25।।
ahaṃ viṣṇuryadā'vocaṃ varaṃ yācaya durlabham ।
sā nanāma ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ ।। 26 ।।
anenaiva svarūpeṇa matsthāne sthātumarhasi ।
mannāmnā kṣetrametacca khyātaṃ bhavatu sarvathā ।।27।।
maddeho'tra tīrthabhūmau rurutīrtho'stu pāvanaḥ ।
mama tīrthe kṛtasnāno dhūtapāpā bhavejjanaḥ ।।28।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathā yāyād varān dehi jagatpate ।
iti datvā varāँstasyai tatraivāntarhitaḥ sthitaḥ ।। 29।।
sāpi kālena sañjātā tīrtharūpā tathā'bhavat ।
tasyā niyamyarṣīkāṇi yataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ।। 1.342.3 0।।
ṛṣīkeśa itikhyātaḥ sthānaṃ cāpi tathāvidham ।
rurukṣetramṛṣīkeśakṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ taducyate ।। 31 ।।
atha goniṣkramaṇākhyaṃ kṣetraṃ vadāmi tacchṛṇu ।
aurvo nāma pūrvakalpe prajāpatirabhūt priye ।। 32।।
atra sṛṣṭau samāgatya tapo ghoraṃ samācarat ।
necchati tatphalaṃ kiñcidevaṃ kālo mahān gataḥ ।। 33 ।।
himādreḥ śikharāt so'pi gaṃgādvāramupāgataḥ ।
padmapuṣpādilabdhyarthaṃ tadā vai śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।। 34।।
taṃ nirgataṃ ṛṣiṃ jñātvā''śramaṃ cakāra bhasmasāt ।
tata āśramamāyātaṃ aurvo dagdhaṃ vilokya tat ।।35 ।।
uvāca krodhatāmrākṣo nirdahanniva dāhakam ।
yenaiṣa āśramo dagdhaḥ sopi tapto'stu sarvathā ।। 36 ।।
tatkṣaṇādeva deveśi! īśopi kāmadāhakaḥ ।
mahaddāhena santaptaḥ śaṃbhurdevīmuvāca ha ।।37।।
aurvasya tu tapo dṛṣṭvā bhītairdevairudāhṛtam ।
dahyate'tra jagatsarvaṃ sa tu kiñcinna cecchati ।।38।।
ko vā pratividhistatra yathā sarvasya saṃbhavet ।
evamukte mayā krodhādīkṣitastasya cāśramaḥ ।। 39।।
dagdho'bhavat kṣaṇenaiva vayaṃ tasmādvinirgatāḥ ।
etadduḥkhena santapto manyunā ca pariplutaḥ ।।1.342.40 ।।
aurvaḥ śaśāpa roṣeṇa tena taptā vayaṃ śive ।
tena dāhena santapto na śaknomi viceṣṭitum ।।4 1 । ।
ato nārāyaṇaṃ prati gacchāmaḥ śāpaśāntaye ।
tato nārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā nivedya sahitāstataḥ ।।4 2 । ।
aurvaṃ gatvā samūcustaṃ śāpatāpaṃ nivāraya ।
aurva uvāca surabhīgaṇamānīya mādhava! ।। 43 । ।
śaṃkarādīn snāpayantu dugdhaiḥ śāpaḥ praśāmyati ।
etasminnantare lakṣmi! mayā gāvo'vatāritāḥ । ।44। ।
saptasaptatiḥ kalyāṇyaḥ saurabheyyaḥ payodharāḥ ।
tenā''plāvitadehāśca parāṃ śāntimupāgatāḥ ।। 45 । ।
śaṃkarādyāstadetadvai goniṣkramaṇanāmakam ।
kṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ puṇyamaurvakṣetraṃ jagurvaram ।। 46 । ।
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta gālokaṃ tena cāpyate ।
śaṃkhacakragadāyukto mama loke mahīyate । । 47 । ।
mūlavaṭasya mūle'tra patanti pañcadhārikāḥ ।
pañcadhārākṛtasnānaṃ pañcayajñaphalapradam । । 48 ।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṣetraṃ pañcadhāraṃ prakīrtitam ।
atha pañcapadaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra pañcamahāśilāḥ । । 49 । ।
matpūrvāṃ diśamāśritya vartante sudṛḍhā yataḥ ।
brahmapadadvayaṃ tatra kuṇḍamadhyagatā śilā ।।1.342.5 0 । ।
urdhvaṃ nālaparīṇāhaṃ tatra viṣṇupadaṃ mama ।
tatra snātāḥ śuddhalokān yānti bhāgavatapriyān । । 51 । ।
idaṃ brahmapadaṃ kṣetraṃ dhārā patati paścimām ।
tatra snātvā brahmaloke modate brahmaṇā saha । । 52 । ।
atha koṭivaṭaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ vāyudiśi dhruvam ।
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta pañcakrośāntarasthite । । 53 ।।
yajñakoṭiphalaṃ bhuktvā mama lokaṃ prapadyate ।
atha viṣṇusaro ramyaṃ pūrvottaraṃ sutīrthakam । । 5 4। ।
pañcakrośasuvistāraṃ parvato'pi tathā''yataḥ ।
tasya pradakṣiṇaṃ kurvan yāvatpadāni sundari! । । 5 5 ।।
bhramamāṇasya jāyante tāvadvarṣasahasrakam ।
pratipadaṃ sa puṇyātmā brahmaloke mahīyate । । 56 । ।
tatra kṣetre mahāścaryaṃ jyeṣṭhe śukle prajāyate ।
dvādaśyāṃ tu gavāṃ śabdāḥ śrūyante vyomamārgataḥ । ।57 । ।
etad gosthalakaṃ tīrthaṃ tāpapāpavināśakam ।
etadadhyāyavaktuśca tasya śrotustathā'naghe! । । 58 । ।
pratyakṣaraṃ sahasraṃ vai varṣāṇāṃ mama dhāmani ।
vāsaḥ syāccaikaviṃśatikuloddhāro bhavettathā ।।।59 । ।
gavāṃ kṣetraṃ mahābhāge! pañcayojanamaṇḍalam ।
gaṃgāyāḥ pūrvato bhāge tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ sadā'tra vai ।।1.342.6 0।।
athā'paraṃ stutasvāmināmakaṃ kṣetramuttamam ।
dvāparaṃ yugamāsādya tatra tiṣṭhāmi sundari! ।।6 1 ।।
śāṇḍilyajājalibhṛgukapilasāyaṇādayaḥ ।
te māṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyanti dharmamūrtiṃ mahīṃ gatam ।।62।।
saṃkarṣaṇo vāsudevaḥ pradyumno hyaniruddhakaḥ ।
te'pi tatra sthitā bhaviṣyanti lokahitāya vai ।।63।।
matprasādena manujāḥ siddhiṃ yāsyanti matparām ।
mātsaryaṃ ye kariṣyanti maddharme mama rūpake ।।64।।
teṣāṃ nā'yaṃ paro loko mātsaryopahatātmanām ।
mātsaryaṃ sarvanāśāya mātsaryaṃ dharmanāśakam ।।65।।
bahukarmasamāyuktā dānādhyayananiṣṭhitāḥ ।
tapasā jñānayuktā vā nityaṃ satkarmasūdyatāḥ ।।66।।
api mātsaryasaṃdagdhā na te paśyanti māṃ kvacit ।
na kartavyaṃ tataḥ sarvairmātsaryaṃ śāntighātakam ।।67।।
mātsaryā'bhidhadoṣeṇa bahavo nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! bhūtagirau pratimā tvāyasī mama ।।68।।
vārāharūpiṇī tvāste hyabhedyā dṛśyate tu sā ।
kecitpaśyanti kāṃsyāṃ tāṃ kecidāyasīmityapi ।।69।।
pāṣāṇīmapare cānye vajrāṃ paśyanti saukarīm ।
kecitpaśyanti tāṃ mūrti maṇipūragirau sthitām ।।1.342.70 ।।
sarvakilbiṣamuktāste yānti vai paramāṃ gatim ।
vārāhakṣetramevaitat pṛthivyuddhārarūpadhṛk ।। 71 ।।
athānyatte pravakṣyāmi pañcārūmetitīrthakam ।
tatra snāturbhavet svarge vāso'psaro'bhisevite ।।।72।।
atha tīrthaṃ bhagukuṇḍo mama dakṣiṇabhūtale ।
tatra snātā bhavenmukto dhruvadeśe pramodate ।।73।।
atha tīrtha maṇikuṇḍo'gādhavārdhiḥ surālayaḥ ।
maṇayo yatra dṛśyante malayaścaṃcalaḥ sthitaḥ ।।74।।
tatra snātvā ratnabhāgī rājā bhūtvā vimucyate ।
mama pūrvaṃ trikrośasthaṃ dhūtapāpetināmakam ।। 75।।
kṣetraṃ kuṇḍe jalaṃ svarṇaprabhaṃ mārakatau+ojjvalam ।
tatra snātā dhūtapāpaścendrarājyaṃ pravindati ।। 76 ।।
vartate ca camatkāro maṇipūre girau mama ।
tāvanna patati dhārā yāvatpāpaṃ na dhūyate ।।77।।
vṛkṣamaśvatthamityuktaṃ nirmalastatra gacchati ।
paścimāyāṃ cāmalakavṛkṣaḥ sarvaphalodayaḥ ।।78।।
pāpāni sparśanāccāpi kṣālayatyatipāpinaḥ ।
devaiḥ stuto mahākṣetre maṇipūrasthito'nvaham ।।79।।
stutasvāmīti me nāma devaireva viniścitam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ nṛṇām ।।1.342.80 ।।
atha lohārgalaṃ kṣetraṃ himālayasamāśritam ।
śreṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśāyāmaṃ samantātpañcayojanam ।।8 1।।
tatrottaradiśi svarṇapratimāyāṃ vasāmyaham ।
devānāṃ duḥkhadāstatra dānavā hyabhavaँstadā ।।82।।
daityāśca mānavāँstatra pīḍayanti sma sarvadā ।
mayā caivāntanaraṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā māyāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm ।।83।।
sīmānamargalaṃ kṛtvā kṣiptvā cakraṃ mahaujasam ।
śatakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānavānāṃ kṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ ।।84।।
tato devā mānavāśca sukhaṃ prāptā hi tatsthale ।
evaṃ lohārgalaṃ nāma kṣetraṃ taddhi mayā kṛtam ।।85।।
evaṃ lohārgalaḥ kuṇḍastīrthaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ śubham ।
tatrā'śvaḥ śuklavarṇo vai dāne deyo divaḥpradaḥ ।।86।।
atha pañcasaraḥ kuṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ gandharvalokadam ।
caturdhārāḥ patantyatra śaṃkhavarṇāśca muktidāḥ ।।87।।
tato nāradakuṇḍaṃ ca tīrthaṃ pañcapravāhavat ।
tato vasiṣṭhakuṇḍaṃ ca tīrthaṃ tisṛpravāhavat ।।88।।
pañcakuṇḍaṃ pañcadhārāyutaṃ tīrthaṃ supuṇyadam ।
saptarṣikuṇḍatīrthaṃ ca saptadhārāprapātanam ।।89।।
śarabhaṃgakuṇḍatīrthaṃ śarabhaṃgānadīyutam ।
kuṇḍamagnisaronāmatīrthaṃ vahnigṛhapradam ।।1.342.90 ।।
bṛhaspatikuṇḍatīrthaṃ dhāraikā himaniḥsṛtā ।
vaiśvānarakuṇḍatīrthaṃ dhāraikā himaniḥsṛtā ।।9 1 ।।
kārtikeyakuṇḍatīrthaṃ dhārāḥ pañcadaśottamāḥ ।
samāpatanti himaparvatāt snānāttu puṇyadāḥ ।।92।।
umākuṇḍamiti kṣetraṃ gaurī yatra januṃ yayau ।
snātvā gaurīṃ prapaśyedvai gauryā loke sa modate ।।93।।
maheśvarasya vai kuṇḍaṃ yatra tūdvāhitā hyumā ।
tatra snātā rudralokaṃ yāti raudryabhisevitaḥ ।।94।।
prakhyātaṃ brahmakuṇḍaṃ ca vedā yatra samutthitāḥ ।
catasro vedadhārāśca prapatanti himālayāt ।।।95।।
pūrve śubhrottare svarṇā paścime nīlavarṇikā ।
dakṣiṇe tvindragopābhā dhārā vedacatuṣṭayam ।।96।।
tatra snāto brahmalokaṃ vindate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
evaṃ lohārgalaṃ kṣetraṃ pañcaviṃśatiyojanam ।।97।।
mayā himālayo devastīrthānāṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛtaḥ ।
yasmād dravanti saritaḥ pāvanyo muktidā nṛṇām ।। .8।।
devāstatra nivasanti ṛṣayo nivasanti ca ।
ahaṃ vasāmi lokānāṃ kalyāṇārthaṃ samudraje! ।।903।।
tattattīrthe kṛtasnānadānadharmā janā dhruvam ।
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ prayāntyeva kṛpayā mama sarvadā ।। 1.342.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rūrukṣetraṛṣīkegoniṣkramaṇapañcapadabrahmapadakoṭivaṭaviṣṇusaraḥ-
stutasvāmivarāhakṣetrapañcāsamabhṛgukuṇḍamaṇikuṇḍalohārgalapañcasaronāradavaśiṣṭhasaptarṣiśarabhaṃgāgnibṛhaspativaiśvānarakārti-
keyomāmaheśvarabrahmakuṇḍāditīrthānāṃ nirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 342।।


← adhyāyaḥ 342 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 343
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 344 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
ānādijñānamārtaṇḍa! sarvasākṣin! sanātana! ।
sarvalokavidhātā'si tvameva tīrthakṛtsadā ।। 1 ।।
tava yogāccetanāni jaḍāni bhūjalāni ca ।
dehinastārayantyeva tvamevaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।। 2 ।।
jīvānāṃ dehalābhe'tra mokṣalābho mahānmataḥ ।
vinā mokṣaṃ kṛtalābhāste sarve nidhanā'nvayāḥ ।। 3 ।।
vṛndāvanaṃ māthuraṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ sanātanam ।
tulasīkṣetrapatyādyaṃ tvayā proktaṃ purātanam ।। 4 ।।
tvayā tatra katiprādurbhāvā labdhā vada prabho! ।
lapsyante cāpi ca kati? kva vā bhūmau? vada prabho! ।। 5 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca -
are lakṣmi! hyasaṃkhyātāḥ prādurbhāvā bhavanti me ।
mānaveṣu ca deveṣu tiryakṣu paśupakṣiṣu ।। 6 ।।
jalajeṣu vanajeṣu munisādhujaneṣu ca ।
ṛṣiṣu satsu satīṣu sādhvīṣu santi bhūriśaḥ ।। 7 ।।
praticaturyugaṃ kṛṣṇo bhavāmi bhuvi padmaje ।
vṛndāvaneṣu deśeṣu māthureṣu yamītaṭe ।। 8 ।।
vicarāmi viharāmi daityānāmantakṛdyathā ।
nārāyaṇāḥ śataṃ pañcaśataṃ ca jalaśāyinaḥ ।। 9 ।।
triṃśatkamaṭharūpāṇi matsyarūpāṇi viṃśatiḥ ।
gopālāśca śataṃ cāṣṭaṃ buddhāḥ santi sahasraśaḥ ।। 1.343.10 ।।
triṃśatparaśurāmāśca rāmā ekottaraṃ śatam ।
anye'pi kāryavaśagā avatārā mama priye! ।। 11 ।।
ākasmikāstvayā sārdhaṃ kevalā vā bhavanti vai ।
brahmāṇḍāni hyanekāni hyanekā daityadānavāḥ ।। 12।।
surāśca tāpasāścāpi hyasaṃkhyāḥ kāmanāyutāḥ ।
ārtānāmārtināśāyā'rthināmarthapradāptaye ।। 1 3।।
sakāmānāṃ kāmapūrtyai saṃbhavāmi sthale sthale ।
kvacidaṃśaḥ kvacitpūrṇaḥ kvacit tvāveśarūpataḥ ।। 14।।
kalayā vā kvacit kvāpi kvacid vibhūtirūpataḥ ।
sādhurūpastathā rājarūpaḥ sadgururūpataḥ ।। 15।।
vyāsarūpaśca vijñānisvarūpaḥ saṃbhavāmi vai ।
viṣṇurūpo'smyahameko muktimaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ ।। 16 ।।
vṛndāvane mathurāyāṃ bahuvāraṃ janiṃ gataḥ ।
tīrthānāṃ tīrthamūrdhanyaṃ mathurākṣetramasti yat ।। 17।।
yuge yuge yamītīre saṃbhavāmi punaḥ punaḥ ।
kṛṣṇarūpo dāsadāsīkoṭyabjecchāprapūrakaḥ ।। 18 ।।
anantasṛṣṭinārīṇāṃ kāmecchābhaktikarṣitaḥ ।
rājarūpaḥ koṭikāmagarvahā saṃbhavāmyaham ।। 19।।
vasuḥ pitā ca me mātā devī bhrātā sukarṣaṇaḥ ।
anye santu na vā santu hyebhiḥ saha vasāmyaham ।।1.343.20।।
prathame tu dvāpare'haṃ saṃkarṣaṇena saṃyutaḥ ।
yugalo vasudevyośca prādurbhūto'bhavaṃ priye ।।21।।
tadā tatrā'surā hyāsan kālanemipravaṃśajāḥ ।
tānahaṃ hatavān sarvān kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīsutāpatiḥ ।।22।।
ratvaṃ tadā''sīḥ kamalākhyā marutputrī mama priyā ।
prathame dvāpare cāhaṃ kamalāpatikṛṣṇakaḥ ।।।23 ।।
kālanaimeyavaṃśyānāṃ nāśako mathurāpure ।
tadārabhya mathurāyāḥ kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ।।24।।
mama pādatalaiḥ śuddha sarvadā vartate priye! ।
taduttaraṃ mama prādurbhāvāḥ santi sahasraśaḥ ।।।25।
tatrā'nyatra ca kamale! tadantaṃ gaṇayāmi na ।
bhaviṣyantyavatārāśca tān pragāsyanti mānavāḥ ।।26।।
vyāsāśca tān yathāyogyaṃ varṇayiṣyanti muktaye ।
śṛṇu priye! pavitraṃ tanmāthuraṃ kṣetramuttamam ।।27।।
na svarge na ca pātāle tīrthe vai mathurāsamam ।
sā ramyā sarvathā divyā janmabhūmiḥ sadā mama ।।28।।
yatra vāsena manujāstathā'nyaprāṇinaḥ priye । ।
svarge ca mokṣaṇaṃ yānti golokamiva me sthalam ।।29।।।
prayāge māghapūrṇāyāḥ phalaṃ nityaṃ yamījale ।
kāśyāṃ varṣasahasrasya phalaṃ tvatra dinena vai ।।1.343.30।।
puṣkare kārtikīpūrṇāphalaṃ tvatra kṣaṇena vai ।
māyāmūḍhā mathurāṃ vihāyā'nyatra bhramānta hi ।। 31 । ।
mathurāśravaṇāccāpi līyante pāpakāṭayaḥ ।
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi ca sarāṃsi ca । । 32 । ।
nadyo nadāstathā pūryo'raṇyāni ca vanānyapi ।
mathurāyāṃ samāyāntyāṣāḍhe supte janārdane । । 33 ।।
mathurāmaṇḍale śrāddhāt tṛpyanti pitaro yugam ।
mathurāvāsino lokā nidhane yānti matpadam ।। 34 । ।
kubjāmrake saukarave janmasthāne viśeṣataḥ ।
vasatāṃ tu vinā sāṃkhyaṃ yogaṃ mokṣosti niścitaḥ । । 35 । ।
annavastrapradātāro narā muktā na saṃśayaḥ ।
bhaviṣyāmi varārohe dvāpare yugasaṃsthite । । 36 ।।
kṛṣṇo'haṃ ca yayātestu vaṃśe daityaniṣūdanaḥ ।
yamunā yatra suvahā vaivasvatasutā priyā ।। 37 । ।
gaṃgāṃ prāpya prayāge yā triveṇīti pravartate ।
sarasvatīṃ ca saṃgṛhya prathitā pāpahāriṇī । । 38 ।।
yamī gaṃgāśataguṇā śreṣṭhā māthuramaṇḍale ।
tatra tīrthāni cānyāni bhaviṣyanti mama priye! । । 39 ।।
yeṣu snānājjalapānānmuktireva na saṃśayaḥ ।
nidhane māthure kṣetre jāyate sa caturbhujaḥ । ।1.343.4 0 ।।
viśrāntisaṃjñakaṃ tīrthaṃ viśrāntighaṭanāpradam ।
sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ snānād golokadaṃ nṛṇām । ।4 1 ।।
sarvatīrtheṣu yatsnānaṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ ।
tatsarvaṃ labhate lakṣmi! viśrāntitīrthadarśanāt । । 42 ।।
na tu yajñairna tapasā na dhyānena na saṃyamaiḥ ।
tatphalaṃ labhate snāto yathā viśrāntighaṭṭake ।। 43 । ।
kālatrayaṃ darśanācca tathā pradakṣiṇadvayāt ।
namaskārapañcakācca viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।। 44। ।
mayā tatra yamunāyā ghaṭṭe viśrāntirāsthitā ।
śāśvatī śāntiratrāsti yathā golokadhāmani । ।45 ।।
athā'nyanme paraṃ tīrthaṃ prayāgaṃ tatra vidyate ।
devānāṃ durlabhaṃ guptaṃ sarvasaṃsāramokṣaṇam । ।46 ।।
yatra snāto mama lokaṃ yātyagniṣṭomapuṇyabhāg ।
sakāmastu mahendraḥ syāttato yāti parāṃ gatim । ।47 ।।
athā'nyanye kanakhalaṃ tīrthaṃ snānāddivaḥ pradam ।
athānyat tindukaṃ tīrthaṃ mama golokadhāmadam । ।48 ।।
pāñcāladeśe kāmpilyaṃ nagaraṃ dhārmikaprajam ।
tatra tindukasaṃjño vai sadā vasati nāpitaḥ । । 49 ।।
kālena nāpitasyaiva kuṭumbaṃ tu kṣayaṃ gatam ।
tataḥ sa mathurāṃ prāpto yamītīre'vasat sadā ।।1.343.5 0 । ।
kuṭumboddhāraṇārthaṃ vai śrāddhādi tena kāritam ।
sa nityaṃ yamunāsnāyī kālena nidhanaṃ gataḥ । ।5 1 । ।
mathurāyāṃ brāhmaṇasya janma tvāsādya vai tataḥ ।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhūtvā yayau golokadhāma saḥ । । 52।।
evaṃ tindukasaṃjño'sau jātismarastu bhūsuraḥ ।
sarvān vijñāpya tattīrthaṃ khyāpayitvā mṛtiṃ yayau । 53।
athānyat paramaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam ।
ārādhitā balinā vai dhanarājyasamīhayā । ।54।।
ūrdhvabāhurnirāhārastatāpā'tra paraṃ tapaḥ ।
tasya prasanno bhagavān sūryanārāyaṇaḥ svayam । । 55 । ।
samāgatya baliṃ prāha kiṃ te tapasi kāraṇam ।
baliḥ prāha trilokasya netraṃ sūryaṃ jagatprabhum ।। 56 । ।
nirdhano'smi na me rājyaṃ dhanārthaṃ tapa ācaram ।
sūryastasmai dadau cintāmaṇiṃ svāt mukuṭāt tataḥ । ।57 ।।
cintāmaṇiṃ sa saṃprāpya gataḥ pātālameva ha ।
sūryo yamījale snātvā hiraṇyamaṇḍalaṃ yayau । । 58 ।।
evaṃ tīrthavaraṃ jātaṃ pāpatāpavināśakam ।
snātvā svargaṃ tato mokṣaṃ vindate syāccaturbhujaḥ ।। 59 ।।
ravivāre ca saṃkrāntau candrasūryagrahe tithau ।
sūryatīrthasnānakartā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 1.343.60 ।।
athā'tra dhruvatīrthaṃ ca yatra tepe dhruvaḥ purā ।
tatra snānena sāmrājyaṃ maraṇena dhruvasthalam ।। 69 ।।
śrāddhenātra pitaraśca taranti yānti mokṣaṇam ।
dhruvasya dakṣiṇe tatra tīrthaṃ vai tīrtharājakam । । 62 । ।
tatra snānena vai lakṣmi! mama golokamāpnuyāt ।
atha taddakṣiṇe lakṣmi! ṛṣitīrthaṃ paraṃ matam । । 63 । ।
snātvā yāyād ṛṣilokaṃ golokaṃ prāṇavarjanāt ।
tato'pi dakṣiṇe tīrthaṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ paraṃ mama । । 64 ।।
yatra snānād bhavenmuktirgolokaṃ cāpnuyānmama ।
tatraiva koṭitīrthaṃ ca devānāmapi durlabham ।। 65 । ।
tatra snānāt tathā dānājjapāddhomācca bhojanāt ।
tarpaṇādupavāsācca brahmaloke mahīyate ।। 66 ।।
tāritāḥ pitarastena koṭitīrthaniṣeviṇāt ।
tathā sapta ca saptātha sapta vaṃśāśca tāritāḥ ।। 67 ।।
atha vai vāyutīrthaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ tārakaṃ param ।
pitṝn piṇḍapradātārastārayantyeva sarvathā ।। 68 ।।
gayāpiṇḍapradānasya phalaṃ tvatra hyavāpyate ।
jyeṣṭhamāse viśeṣeṇa śrāddhāttaranti pūrvajāḥ । ।69 ।।
uktānyetāni tīrthāni bhuktimuktipradāni vai ।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ syuḥ sahasraguṇā hi te । ।1.343.7 0 ।।
tīrthānāṃ smaraṇāccāpi vandanād darśanāttathā ।
jalasya kaṇikāpānānmuktirbhavati śāśvatī । ।71 । ।
athātra tīrthamūrdhanyamavatārasamūhakam ।
śrīkṛṣṇasyā'vatārā ye militvā janmanaḥ kṣaṇe ।।72 ।।
samāyātāḥ kṣaṇaṃ yatra sthitā yamītaṭe śubhe ।
janmabhūmisamīpe tat tīrthaṃ gupta hi vartate । । 73 ।।
snānāttatra vāripānāt prokṣaṇādapi sarvathā ।
pāpapradhvaṃsakaṃ golokavaikuṇṭhādilokadam ।।74।।
tatra vai maraṇānmuktirbhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
ekāhopoṣaṇādvāpi koṭiyajñaphalaṃ bhavet । ।75 ।।
rajaḥkaṇā mathurāyāḥ spṛśanti dehinastu yān ।
te'pi muktiṃ prayāsyanti tiryakkīṭādayo'pi cet ।।76 ।।
deśāntare'pi tannāmagrahītā bhuktibhāṅ nanu ।
yatra sākṣātparabrahma rājate tatra kiṃ na vai । । 77 । ।
dhanadhāmadharādāraputraputrīsamṛddhayaḥ ।
kṣetrodyānādhikāritvarājyasattājaneśatāḥ । ।78 ।।
svarṇarūpyamahālakṣmīśrīsampadbhavanādayaḥ ।
bhavantyeva hareryogād bhaktasyātra kṛpākaṇāt ।।7 9 ।।
tārakaṃ dhārakaṃ yadvad rakṣakaṃ pālakaṃ tathā ।
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi tīrthaṃ māthuramuttamam । ।1.343.8 0 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye bhagavadavatārāṇāmānantyaṃ, prathamadvāpare kṛṣṇāvatāraḥ, viśrāntitīrthaprayāgakanakhalatindukasūryadhruvatīrtharājaṛṣimokṣakoṭivāyvavatāratīrthādipradarśananāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 343 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 343 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 344
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 345 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mathurāyāṃ śivakuṇḍaṃ paraṃ mahat ।
tīrthaṃ śivakṛtaṃ tatra ciraṃ tepe haraḥ svayam । । 1 ।।
tatra kṛṣṇaḥ samāgatya śivaṃ prāha ca mādhavaḥ ।
kathaṃ vai tapyate śaṃbho! tapaḥ paramadāruṇam । । 2 । ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mahārāja! daityairatyarditāḥ surāḥ ।
asurāṇāṃ vināśāyehā'vataritumarhasi ।। 3 । ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yamyāṃ snātvā harastataḥ ।
samāpya tu tapastasmād yayau kailāsameva saḥ ।। 4 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāpi yayau golokameva ha ।
ādye dvāparasaṃyoge jāto'sau kṛṣṇa eva tu ।। 5 ।।
śivakuṇḍamidaṃ tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇāgamanakārakam ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ yatra snātvā vaikuṇṭhamāpyate ।। 6 ।।
śivakuṇḍottare tīrthaṃ saṃyamanaṃ supuṇyadam ।
snānena jāyate bhāgyaṃ saubhāgyaṃ rūpavattvakam ।। 7 ।।
svargaṃ tathā paro mokṣaḥ prāpyete nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
saṃyamano mahātīrthe yadyad vṛttaṃ purātanam ।। 8 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahāścaryakaraṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ।
naimiṣāraṇyavāstavyo niṣādo tuṣṭamānasaḥ ।। 9 ।।
pāpācāraḥ samāyātaḥ kadācinmathurāṃ prati ।
nityaṃ snāti yamunāyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ taraṇena ca ।। 1.344.10 ।।
prati taṭaṃ samāyāti yāti cāpi punastathā ।
evaṃ snāte taratyapi kṛṣṇacaturdaśītithau ।। 11 ।।
tartukāmo niṣādaḥ sa jale papāta yāmune ।
tatāra yamunāṃ so'tha tīrthaṃ saṃyamanaṃ prati ।। 12 ।।
yāvadāyātyabhitīraṃ prāpya saṃyamanaṃ śubhe ।
mamajjā'sau śramito vai nimagno jalamāpapau ।। 13 ।।
aśaktaḥ sa mahāpāpaḥ sadyaḥ prāṇairvyayujyata ।
tīrthaprabhāvataścāsya dhvastaṃ pāpakaraṇḍakam ।। 14।।
puṇyaṃ jātaṃ mahattasya tena jāto bhuvaḥ patiḥ ।
saurāṣṭraviṣaye deśe saurāṣṭrādhipatirnṛpaḥ ।। 15 ।।
bhadrāpattanasāmrājyaṃ cakāra sa dhanurdharaḥ ।
nāmnā yakṣmadhanurnāma kṣatriyo vasudhādhipaḥ ।। 16 ।।
pālayāmāsa vasudhāṃ kṣatradharmaṃ samāśritaḥ ।
raivatādrinivāsānāṃ siddhānāṃ sevako hyayam ।। 17।।
nityaṃ yānena saṃyāti darśanārthaṃ girau mudā ।
pūrvasyāmaśvapaṭṭasya sarasaśca taṭe śubhe ।। 18 ।।
patnīvratāśrame gatvā taṃ dadarśa mahāmunim ।
dadarśa kaṃbharālakṣmīṃ gopālakṛṣṇamīśvaram ।। 19।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāpi dadarśa nityameva saḥ ।
tatpratāpena rājā'sau kṛṣṇabhaktaśca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 1.344.20 ।।
jāto mahān balī yasya rakṣaṇe kaṇṭhamālikā ।
varmātmikā pradattā yā nṛpaṃ rakṣati sarvathā ।। 21 ।।
tayā yuddhe'pi nṛpatī rakṣito vijayī sadā ।
iti hetorgaurjarāṇāṃ marūṇāṃ rājyamāptavān ।।22।।


vaihāyasena yānena kāśīyātrārthameva saḥ ।
yayau kāśīnṛpatinā viditvā vaiṣṇava param ।।23।।
vijayinaṃ kīrtimantaṃ satkṛtyā'smai nijā sutā ।
pradattā pīvarīnāmnī nītvā tāṃ sa yayau puram ।।24।।
bhadrāpattanamāgamya tenoḍhā pīvarī śubhā ।
patnīśatānāṃ mukhyānāṃ pravarā sā kṛtā priyā ।।25।।
tāṃ caiva ramayāmāsa sūdyāneṣu vaneṣu ca ।
prāsādeṣu ca ramyeṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca ।।26।।
prajāḥ pālayatastasya dānāni dadatastathā ।
kālo gacchati rājā'sau putrapautrayuto'bhavat ।।27।।
bhogāsaktasya ca yayurvarṣāṇi tvayutāni vai ।
putrāḥ putryaḥ pañcaśatānyasyā'bhavan suśobhanāḥ ।।।28।।
kanyā vivāhitā sarvā vidhinā tena sarvathā ।
jyeṣṭhe'rpitaṃ mahārājyaṃ madhyameṣu purāṇi vai ।।29।।
kaniṣṭheṣu kṣitiryogyā jīvikārthā'rpitā'tha ca ।
evaṃ svayaṃ sukhaṃ prāpto nivṛtto rājyakāryataḥ ।। 1.344.30 ।।
rājñīnāṃ jīvikāklṛptiṃ cakre'tha śayane kvacit ।
pīvaryā saha suptaḥ san svapne saṃvadate jñavat ।।3 1।।
hāhā ohoho gacchāvaḥ kimatra jīvanena vai ।
smṛtvā tāṃ mathurāṃ bhūmiṃ smṛtvā tīrthaṃ tu saṃyamam ।।32।।
tataḥ pīvarī prāha kimevaṃ bhāṣase nṛpa! ।
priyāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā prāha priyāṃ prati ।।33।।
mattaḥ suptaḥ pramattaśca hyasambaddhaṃ prabhāṣate ।
nidrādhīnasya vacanaṃ nā'vadhāryaṃ tvayā priye! ।।34।।
pīvaryuvāca me nātha śrutaṃ punaḥ punarmayā ।
bahuvāraṃ yatastadvai dṛḍhasaṃskārajaṃ bhavet। ।।35।।
jātismaro mahārāja! me tvaṃ vibhāsi tadvada ।
prāgbhavīyaṃ tvayā rājan procyate vada me'nagha ।। 36 ।।
kathayasva mamā'dya tvaṃ yadyahaṃ vallabhā tava ।
prāṇāँstyakṣyāmyaha rājan gopāyiṣyasi me yadi ।। 37।।
priyāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvāca narādhipaḥ ।
