avaśyaṃ yadi vaktavyaṃ gacchāmo mathurāṃ purīm ।।38।।
prakāśe tvāvayormṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
tatra gatvā prāgbhavīyaṃ kathayiṣye hyudantakam ।।39।।।
dadasva vipulaṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sulocane ।
putrān saṃsthāpya dauhitrān sve sve sthāne nibhālya ca ।।1.344.40 ।।
grāmān kośāṃśca ratnāni putrān vīkṣya vitīrya ca ।
rājā sammānayāmāsa janānpuranivāsinaḥ ।।41।।
pitṛpaitāmaharājyapālanārthaṃ yathākramam ।
putrānāvedya ca tathā kuṭumbibāndhavān priyāḥ ।।42।।
kuśalārthaṃ bodhayitvā dārān niyujya rakṣaṇe ।
atha prāha suhṛnmitrabhṛtyadāsīpradāsakān ।।43 ।।
rājyaṃ sampāditaṃ yadvai bandhanaṃ tattu sarvathā ।
mamā''tmamokṣaṇārthaṃ vai gacchāmi mathurāṃ purīm ।।44।।
santoṣācca tathā tyāgānnāstyanyat paramaṃ sukham ।
nāsti vidyāsamaṃ cakṣurnāsti cakṣuḥsamaṃ balam ।।45।।
nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgātparaṃ sukham ।
yaḥ kāmān kurute sarvān yaścaitān sarvathā tyajet ।।46।।
prāyeṇa sarvakāmānāṃ parityāgo viśiṣyate ।
tasmānmayā pragantavyaṃ tīrthaṃ tu mathurāṃ purīm ।।47।।
ityāvedya janānsarvānputrānniyujya rakṣaṇe ।
yathāpekṣabalopetaḥ samprāpto mathurāṃ purīm ।।48।।
tena dṛṣṭā purī ramyā pīvaryā cāvalokitā ।
tīrthairmuktipradairyuktā puṇyā pāpaharā śubhā ।।49।।
ramyaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ nāma viṣṇusthānamanuttamam ।
yad dṛṣṭvā manujo lakṣmi! kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate ।।1.344.50 ।।
śrāvaṇaśuklaikādaśyāṃ yamīsnātaḥ pramucyate ।
tathā saumyaṃ madhuvanaṃ mama sthānamanuttamam ।।51।।
dvitīyaṃ tadvanaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtakṛtyo hi jāyate ।
vanaṃ kundavanaṃ nāma tṛtīyaṃ caitramuttamam ।।52।।
bhādrakṛṣṇaikādaśikātithau snātaḥ pramucyate ।
caturthaṃ kāmyakavanaṃ mama dhāmapradaṃ śubham ।।।53।।
vimalasya ca kuṇḍe vai snātaḥ pāpātpramucyate ।
yastatra muṃcati prāṇān mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ।।54।।
pañcamaṃ bakulavanaṃ mama vihārabhūsthalam ।
tatra gatvā tathā snātvā vahnilokaṃ pragacchati ।।55।।
yamunāyāḥ pare pāre ṣaṣṭhaṃ bhadravanaṃ mama ।
tatra gatvā tathā snātvā nāgalokaṃ pragacchati ।।56 ।।
saptamaṃ me vanaṃ tatra khādiraṃ yajñasadṛśam ।
pavitraṃ tu naro dṛṣṭvā mama lokagato bhavet ।।57।।
mahāvanaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ me sarvavṛkṣasamanvitam ।
yatra gatvā tu manuja indraloke mahīyate ।।58।।
navamaṃ tu vanaṃ lohajaṃghavanaṃ vanottamam ।
tatra yāturjanasyaitanmahāpātakanāśakam ।।59।।
vanaṃ bilvavanaṃ nāma daśamaṃ devapūjitam ।
tatra gatvā tu manujo brahmaloke mahīyate ।।1.344.60।।
ekādaśaṃ tu bhāṇḍīraṃ yogadaṃ yogināṃ hi tat ।
yatra vai vartate vṛkṣo bhāṇḍīravaṭasaṃjñakaḥ ।।61 ।।
yatra vai rādhayā sākaṃ vivāho me prajāyate ।
tasya darśanamātreṇa jano garbhaṃ na gacchati ।।62।।
rādhākṛṣṇaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā punarjanma na vidyate ।
tulasīvanamevātra vanaṃ dvādaśakaṃ priye ।।63 ।।
kṛṣṇatvaṅmayavṛkṣāṇāṃ mokṣadaṃ me vivāhabhūḥ ।
vṛndāvanaṃ haritānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ vanameva me ।।64।।
tatra gatvā cāvaluṇṭhya patraṃ tvattvā dalaṃ tathā ।
dṛṣṭvā vṛndaṃ tulasīṃ ca smṛtvā māṃ yamunājale ।।65।।
snātvā ca muktimāpano goloke me mahīyate ।
vṛndāṃ tulasīṃ govindaṃ ye paśyanti janāḥ priye ।।6 6।।
na te yamapuraṃ yānti yānti golokameva me ।
svargaṃ sakāmā gacchanti tato vai me padaṃ param ।।67।।
etādṛśaṃ mahat tīrthaṃ mathurāmabhigamya tau ।
mudamavāpatustīrthavidhiṃ cakraturādarāt ।।68 ।।
pīvarī bhojanaṃ kṛtvā kārayitvā patiṃ tataḥ ।
papraccha svāpnavṛttāntaṃ yadguhyaṃ pūrvabhāṣitam ।।69।।।
yaduktaṃ nṛparājena vakṣyāmi mathurāṃ prati ।
tanme vada mahārāja! yadgopyaṃ pūrvabhāṣitam ।।1.344.7 0 ।।
rājā'pyāha svakāṃ patnīṃ yathāprāgbhavajāṃ kathām ।
śṛṇu patni! niṣādo'haṃ naimiṣāraṇyavāsakṛt ।।7 1 ।।
atrāgatya mṛtaḥ saṃyamane tīrthe jalāntare ।
tena puṇyena saurāṣṭre rājā jātaḥ pratāpavān ।।72।।
pannīvratākhyakṛṣṇasya pratāpenā''marukṣiteḥ ।
sāmrājyaṃ labdhamevāpi tvaṃ labdhā kāśīrājataḥ ।।7 3 ।।
jātismaraḥ sadā tīrthaṃ smarāmi śayane tava ।
kadācinnidrayā vyāptaḥ pravadāmi tu tat khalu ।।74 ।।
hāhā ahoho gacchāvaḥ kimatra jīvanena vai ।
ityetanme prāgbhavīyaṃ vṛttaṃ kathitamaṃgane! ।।75।।
śrutvā sāpi svakaṃ prāha vṛttaṃ jātismarā nṛpī ।
ahaṃ tu pīvarī nāma gaṃgātīranivāsinī ।।76।।
āgatemāṃ purīṃ draṣṭuṃ kārtikadvādaśītithau ।
nāvamāruhya yāntīha patitā yamunājale ।।77।।
sadyaḥ prāṇairviyuktā ca kāśīrājasutā'bhavam ।
tvayā vivāhitā rājanna ca māṃ sā'jahāt smṛtiḥ ।।78 ।।
etattīrthaprabhāveṇa rājapatnī tavā'bhavam ।
dhārāpatanake tīrthe mama mṛtyurajāyata ।।79 ।।
punardṛṣṭaṃ mokṣatīrthaṃ mathurāyāṃ prapuṇyataḥ ।
āvayorāyuṣorantaḥ samāyāto'sti bhūpate ।।1.344.8 0 ।।
adyaiva bahudānāni deyāni svakareṇa me ।
ityuktvā yamunātīrthe snātvā dānāni sā dadau ।।8 1 ।।
rājāpi kṛtavān puṇyaṃ dānaṃ viprādibhojanam ।
godānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ ca tiladānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ।।8 2।।
bhūdānaṃ viprakanyānāṃ dānānyapi ca vai mudā ।
yajñopavītadānāni vastrānnadānamityapi ।।8 3 ।।
sarvaṃ kṛtvā tato rājā rājñī cobhau saha sthitau ।
yamunāyāstaṭe vai cāyātā golokapārṣadāḥ ।।8 4।।
vimānena sahitāste pīvarīṃ yakṣmarājakam ।
caturbhujau divyadehau kṛtvā ninyurhareḥ padam ।।85 ।।
evaṃ tau mathurāṃ prāpya snātvā yāmunatīrthake ।
māṃ paśyātau niyamatastatraiva nidhanaṃ gatau ।। 86 ।।
sarvabhāvaṃ vihāyaiva gatau mama salokatām ।
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi! yadāścaryamabhūnmahat ।।87।।
tyaktvā tanuṃ janastīrthe dhārāpātanasaṃjñake ।
nākalokaṃ ca golokamavāpnoti na saśayaḥ ।।88 ।।
yamuneśvaramāsādya tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ ।
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti divyamūrtiścaturbhujaḥ ।।8 9।।
iti lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye śivakuṇḍatīrthaṃ saṃyamanatīrthaṃ mṛtasya niṣādasya saurāṣṭrarājyaprāptiḥ, kāśīrājaputryā vivāhaḥ, tayorjātismarayormathurāyāṃ maraṇaṃ, yamuneśvaramāhātmyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 344।।


← adhyāyaḥ 344 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 345
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 346 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tathā tīrthaṃ tvaparaṃ kathayāmi te ।
nāgatīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrtheṃ nāgo yasmād vivāsitaḥ ।। 1 ।।
atra snātvā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtāste'punarbhavāḥ ।
atha ghaṇṭābharaṇakaṃ tīrthaṃ vai pāvanaṃ param ।। 2 ।।
tatra snātaḥ sūryalokaṃ prayātyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
athā'nyad brahmatīrthaṃ vai vidyate yamunājale ।। 3 ।।
tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā brahmaloke mahīyate ।
athā'nyat somatīrthaṃ vai pavitre yamunāṃbhasi ।। 4 ।।
candramāstatra māṃ dṛṣṭvā pupūja bhāvatastadā ।
tatrābhiṣekaṃ kurvīta somaloke mahīyate ।। 5 ।।
athānyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ sarasvatīprapātanam ।
tatra snāto naro lakṣmi! hyavarṇo'pi yatirbhavet ।। 6 ।।
māthure maṇḍale yamyāṃ trirātropoṣito janaḥ ।
snānamātreṇa vratakṛnmucyate brahmahatyayā ।। 7 ।।
atha daśāśvamedhākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ yamyāṃ tu pāvanam ।
mathurā paścime bhāge tatsthalaṃ cātipāvanam ।। 8 ।।
tatra ye snānti niyatāsteṣāṃ svargo na durlabhaḥ ।
brahmaṇā mānasaṃ tīrthaṃ yamyāṃ vai nirmitaṃ purā ।। 9 ।।
ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ tatra snātvā svargaṃ prayānti vai ।
atha vighnarājatīrthaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham ।। 1.345.10 ।।
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ।
tasmiँstīrthavare snātaṃ na pīḍayati vighnarāṭ ।। 11 ।।
vidyāraṃbheṣu sarveṣu yajñadānakriyāsu ca ।
avighnaṃ kurute tasya satataṃ pārvatīsutaḥ ।। 12 ।।
athā'nyat koṭitīrthaṃ ca snānāt koṭigavāṃ phalam ।
prāṇatyāge somalokaṃ mama lokaṃ ca gacchati ।। 13 ।।
ataḥ paraṃ śivakṣetramardhakrośaṃ hi vartate ।
tatra sthito haro devo rakṣati mathurāṃ sadā ।। 14।।
tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā māthuraṃ labhate phalam ।
athātra muṃcati prāṇān mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ।। 15 ।।
athānyat sudhanaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthānāmuttamaṃ sadā ।
nityaṃ vartāmi tatraiva lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।। 16 ।।
māṃ dṛṣṭvā manujāḥ snātvā muktibhājo bhavanti ca ।
ayane viṣuve viṣṇupadīṣu grahaṇe raveḥ ।। 1 7।।
snātvā'nantaphalaṃ labdhvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ।
rājasūyā'śvamedhotthaphalamāpnoti mānavaḥ ।। 18 ।।
sudhane tīrthake snātaḥ prayāgasnānapuṇyabhāk ।
atrādye dvāparayuge yadvṛttaṃ tacchṛṇu priye! ।। 19 ।।
nāmnā tu sudhano nāma mama bhaktaḥ sadaiva hi ।
dhanadhānyasutadāragogṛhādisamṛddhimān ।। 1.345.20 ।।
śīlasantoṣasatpūjādayādānādilakṣitaḥ ।
putradārasametaḥ sa madbhakto vartate sma vai ।। 21 ।।
gacchanti divasāstasya māsāḥ saṃvatsarāstathā ।
mama bhaktyaiva sādhūnāṃ satīnāṃ sevayā sadā ।। 22 ।।
karoti gṛhakṛtyāni yathālabdhadhanena saḥ ।
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ na karoti kadācana ।। 23 ।।
nityaṃ trikālaṃ kurute mama pūjanamuttamam ।
āvāhanena dugdhādipañcāmṛtena vāriṇā ।। 24।।
snāpanena vibhūṣābhirvividhāmbarasaddravaiḥ ।
puṣpadīpaistathā dhūpacandanāmṛtasatphalaiḥ ।। 25।।
naivedyairatimiṣṭānnairjalaistāmbūlacūrṇakaiḥ ।
evamārātrikairnityaṃ stavanaiḥ kīrtanaistathā ।। 26 ।।
pradakṣiṇairdaṇḍavadbhiḥ sadā pūjayati sma mām ।
ekādaśyāmupavāsaṃ kurute jāgaraṃ tathā । । 27 ।।
nityaṃ yamyāṃ triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ karoti bhāvataḥ ।
kālindyāstīramāsādya mama mūrteḥ samīpataḥ । । 28 ।।
rātripāde nṛtyati sma tato yāti nijaṃ gṛham ।
evaṃ nityaṃ karotyeva tvekādaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ।। 29 ।।
kārtikaśuklaikādaśyāṃ rātrau snātvā sa mandiram ।
prati jāgaraṇārthaṃ sa gato yamyāstaṭaṃ yadā । । 1.345.30 । ।
tāvatkenā'pyāgatena gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā ।
kṛṣṇavarṇamahākāyordhvaromātibhayaṃkṛtā । । 31 । ।
uktaśca rākṣaso'smyatra bhakṣyārthaṃ paryaṭāmi ha ।
dūrāraṇyanivāso'smi bhakṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ । । 32 । ।
bahukālakṣudhito'smi tṛptiṃ yāsyāmi vai ciram ।
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā tathā kṛtvā dhairyaṃ prāha vaṇik tadā ।। 33 ।।
sudhano'haṃ mahābhojyaṃ dāsye te me prasīd yat ।
pratīkṣasva kṣaṇaṃ me'dya dāsyāmi tava puṣkalam ।। 3 4। ।
bahumiṣṭānnasaṃmiśraṃ bhakṣayiṣyasi varṣma me ।
devakāryaṃ vidhāyaiva dāsye te sarvameva tat ।। 35 । ।
jāgaraṃ devadevasya karomi harivāsare ।
vrataṃ me sārvakālaṃ vai yajjāgarmi hareḥ puraḥ ।। 36 । ।
tatra jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte tava sannidhau ।
yatra kathaya tatrā'hamāgamaṣyāmi taṃ vaśaḥ ।। 37 ।।
kṛta jāgaraṇaṃ māṃ tvaṃ khādiṣyasi yathāsukham ।
viṣṇutuṣṭyairvrataṃ kāryaṃ tanme kartuṃ pradehi cet ।। 38 । ।
sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ mokṣadaṃ vratamasti yat ।
mā kuru vratabhaṃgaṃ me kṛpāṃ kuru śubhaṃ bhavet ।। 39 । ।
sudhanasya vacaḥ śrutvā kṣudhito brahmarākṣasaḥ ।
sudhanaṃ prāha mithyā tvaṃ prabhāṣase vaṇig yataḥ ।।1.345.40 । ।
nahi mṛtyumukhānmuktaḥ punarmṛtyumupaiti vai ।
mama pāśādvimuktastvaṃ punaḥ kathaṃ sameṣyasi ।। 41 । ।
rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā vaṇig bhaktottamo'bravīt ।
jagatsarvaṃ satyamūlaṃ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।।42 । ।
sanmūlāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ kṣudhā te'sti satī yadi ।
tadā'haṃ te satyabhakṣyaḥ kṣullope bhakṣyatā katham ।।4 3 ।।।
kṣutpipāse brahmakārye brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ tu sat ।
tadarthe cennirmito'smi siddhiste syānna cānyathā ।।44।।
yadyahaṃ ca vaṇik pūrvaṃ karmaṇā nahi dūṣitaḥ ।
antarātmā hṛdaye me vasatyeva yathā tava ।।45 ।।
bhakto'smi satyadharmo'smi satyena pravadāmi ca ।
śṛṇu matsamayaṃ rakṣo! yenā'haṃ punarāgamam । । 46। ।
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau nṛtyaṃ kṛtvā hareḥ puraḥ ।
punareṣyāmyahaṃ rakṣo! nā'satyaṃ mayi vartate ।।47।।
satyenopārjyate brahma dharmaḥ satyena rakṣyate ।
satyena dīyate kanyā satyavāco hi bhūsurāḥ ।।48 ।।
nṛpāḥ satyena cottīrṇāḥ satyenaṃ dhriyate kṣitiḥ ।
svargamokṣau pralabhyete satyavratena rākṣasa ।। 89 ।।
satyena sūryastapati candraḥ satyena vardhate ।
kālaḥ satyena nayati vṛṣṭiḥ satyena jāyate । । 1.345.50 ।।
ahaṃ satyena jīvāmi nā'satyaṃ kṛtavān kvacit ।
tatsatyaṃ mama naśyedvai yadi nāyāmi vai punaḥ । ।5 1 ।।
prasahya kāmavegena nārīṃ bhuṃkte tu yo janaḥ ।
tasya pāpena lipye'haṃ yadi nāyāmi te puraḥ ।। 52 ।।
bhūgodānādi kṛtvā yaścāpaharati tatpunaḥ ।
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ nāgaccheyaṃ punaryadi ।।5 3 ।।
nārīṃ naraṃ ca vā svārthamātraṃ bhuktvā tatastyajet। ।
parārthaṃ na ca kurvīta tatpāpaṃ nā''game mama ।।5 4।।
satīṃ pativratāṃ bhāryāṃ tyajennirāgasāṃ tu yaḥ ।
tena pāpena lipye'haṃ punastvanāgame mama ।।।55 ।।
paṃktibhedaṃ tu yaḥ kuryādekapaṃktyaśināṃ puraḥ ।
tasya pāpena lipye'haṃ nā''gantā yadi te puraḥ ।। 56 ।।
vratabhaṃgaprakarturyat tatpāpaṃ nā'game tu me ।
parahiṃsakapāpaṃ me nā''gantā yadi te puraḥ ।।57।।
dvijatyāgisatīsādhudevānāṃ nindakasya yat ।
pāpaṃ tanme bhaved rakṣo! yadi me nā''gamaḥ punaḥ ।।5 8 ।।
gurumitrasuhṛddrohakṛto yatpāpameva tat ।
nāgaccheyaṃ yadi te'gre satyaṃ bravīmi rākṣasa! ।। 59 ।।
tīrthe kṛtāni pāpāni me syuranāgame punaḥ ।
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate śaṭhe ।। 1.345.60 ।।
viśvāsaghātake cātatāyini bālaghātake ।
yā gatistāṃ prapadyehaṃ yadi me nāgamaḥ punaḥ ।। 61 ।।
nirāgasāṃ tu prāṇināṃ rodhane māraṇe tathā ।
yatpāpaṃ tad bhavenme'tra yadi me nāgamaḥ punaḥ ।। 62 ।
etajjanmottaraṃ pāpaṃ rakṣojanma prayāmyaham ।
yadyahaṃ satyamutsṛjya nāgaccheyaṃ pratārakaḥ । । 63 । ।
itivākyāni vaṇijaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ ।
viśvāsayati cāpanno gacchetyāyāhi cāha tam ।। 64।।
vaṇik śīghraṃ gṛhaṃ me tu samāgatya pupūja māma ।
mamā'gre nartanaṃ kṛtvā cakre prajāgaraṃ mudā । । 65 । ।
prabhāte sa punarnamonārāyaṇāya vai muhuḥ ।
vadan kurvan muhurdaṇḍavad yayau yamunātaṭe । । 66 । ।
kālindīsnānakṛd bhakto rakṣomārgaṃ prayāti ha ।
ahaṃ dayāparo bhūtvā mārgamābadhya saṃsthitaḥ । । 67 । ।
divyarūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam
vilokya sudhano bhakto māṃ provāca caturbhujam ।। 68 ।।
oṃ namaste bhagavate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ca ।
bhaktamokṣapradāyā'tra divyadarśanadāya ca । । 69 ।।
sa ca pṛṣṭo mayā lakṣmi! kva vaṇik prasthito drutam ।
pratyuvāca sa sudhano gacchāmi rākṣasāntikam । ।1.345.7 0 । ।
mayā nivāritaḥ śrutvā na gantavyaṃ na vai na vai ।
jīvatā tvarjyate dharmo mṛte kiṃ mokṣasādhanam । ।7 1 । ।
tathāpi sa na vai śrutvā natvā māṃ rākṣasāntikam ।
gatvovāca yatheṣṭaṃ bho rakṣo! bhakṣaya mā ciram । । 72 ।।
yathānyāyaṃ vidhānena yathā vā tava rocate ।
satyaṃ mayā sadā rakṣyaṃ bhuṃkṣva rākṣasa! mā ciram । ।7 3 । ।
rākṣasaścaitadāścaryaṃ samākalayya taṃ prati ।
tuṣṭo bhūtvo samuvāca vaṇik tvaṃ jītavānasi । ।74।।
tvayā satyavrato dharmaḥ pālitastena toṣaṇam ।
prāpto'smi me kṣudhā naṣṭā tṛptirjātā ca śāśvatī । । 75 । ।
aho satyavratasyātra kathaṃ drohaṃ karomyaham ।
kintu yāvajjāgarasya mama puṇyaṃ prayaccha vai । ।76 ।।
satyapuṇyaprabhāvena yathā'haṃ muktimāpnuyām ।
sudhanastadvacaḥ śrutvā tadā provāca rākṣasam । । 77 ।।
jānāsi rākṣasa! kīdṛk puṇyaṃ syājjāgarasya vai ।
ghaṭikājāgrateḥ puṇyaṃ māhendrapadadāyakam । । 78 । ।
ghaṭikādvaya jāgratoḥ vedhasaḥ padamuttamam ।
ardharātrijāgrato vai vairājapadamuttamam । । 79 । ।
ūnarātrijāgrato vai vaikuṇṭhapadameva ha ।
āprātarjāgrato muktirbrahmalokapradā bhavet ।। 1.345.80 । ।
ghaṭikārdhaṃ jāgratastu sāmrājyaṃ jāyate khalu ।
jāgrati nṛtyatastvasya goloko jāyate dhruvam । ।8 1 ।।
tasmānnahaṃ pradāsyāmi phalaṃ sampūrṇajāgrateḥ ।
ardhe dehi tadardhaṃ vā tadardhārdhaṃ pradehi me ।।82।।
mā lobhaṃ kuru bhaktendra! mokṣaṃ kuru mamāpi bhoḥ ।
ityarthito'pi sudhano mokṣalobhī dadau na vai ।।83।।
punaśca prārthayāmāsa sudhanaṃ brahmarākṣasaḥ ।
ekanṛtyasya me puṇyaṃ dehi tvaṃ vaṇiguttama! ।।84।
sudhanastaṃ samapṛcchad vada me tava pūrvajam ।
vṛttāntaṃ sakalaṃ paścād dāsye tvekanṛteḥ phalam ।।85।।
kiṃ tvaṃ māṃ na vijānāsi vaṇijaṃ prāha rākṣasaḥ ।
tava gṛhasamīpe'hamagnidattastu bhūsuraḥ ।।86।।
tava mitraṃ samāsaṃ sa evā'haṃ nijakarmabhiḥ ।
brāhmaṇaśchāndasaścāpi rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ ।।87।।
mayā''rabdhaṃ subhavanaṃ dvibhaumaṃ tava bhaumavat ।
tadarthamiṣṭikā rātrau parakīyāḥ sadā'haram ।।88।।
pāpamakaravaṃ cauryaṃ gṛhaṃ pūrṇaṃ ca nā'bhavat ।
jvareṇa pīḍito madhye harmyasya vāsanānvitaḥ ।।89।।
cauryadoṣeṇa vipro'pi brahmarākṣasatāṃ gataḥ ।
so'haṃ mitraṃ vaṇigvarya tavāsmīti vibhāvya vai ।।1.345.90 ।।
mitre prāpte dayāṃ kṛtvā hyupakāraṃ kuruṣva me ।
ekanṛtyasya puṇyaṃ me dehi yena gatirmama ।।9 1 ।।
mokṣamayī bhaved bhakta! muhuścābhyarthayāmyaham ।
śrutvā kṛpārdrahṛdayo vaṇig rākṣasamāha vai ।।92।।
sādhu rākṣasa! dattaṃ te tvekanṛtyaphalaṃ mayā ।
ityuccārya jalaṃ yāvad dadāti rakṣasaḥ kare ।।93।।
tāvadrakṣaḥśarīraṃ vai patitaṃ bhūtale tadā ।
ātmā caturbhujo bhūtvā pārṣadaḥ śrīhareryathā ।।94।।
tathā bhūtvā dvyaṣṭavarṣo vyarājata vaṇikpuraḥ ।
taṃ netumāgato viṣṇurdivyapārṣadaśobhitaḥ ।।95।।
sudhanastaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā pādayordharaṇiṃ gataḥ ।
uvāca svaprabhuṃ tatra bhagavaँstāritau tvayā ।।96।।
rākṣasasya nṛtyaleśād muktido'sti bhavān yathā ।
mamāpi ca tathā muktipradātā bhava mādhava ।।97।।
tadovāca madhuraṃ taṃ devadevo janārdanaḥ ।
ehi tvamapi bhaktendra! viprendro'pi sametu me ।।98।।
sudhanā''śu kuṭumbaṃ te sametu mama vāhane ।
vimānavaramāruhya mama lokaṃ vrajantu vai ।।99।।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sarvān vimānake ।
ārohayitvā suyayau vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।। 1.345.100 ।।
yatrāścaryamabhūt tvaitat tīrthaṃ sudhanasaṃjñitam ।
kārtike dhavale tatra dvādaśyāṃ snānakāriṇaḥ ।। 101 ।।
rājasūyaphalaṃ syācca dānātsvargaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ।
pūrṇimāyāṃ vṛṣotsargakartā kulāni tārayet ।। 1 02।।
śrāddhakartā pūrvajāँśca tārayedatra tīrthake ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! sudhanasya pramokṣaṇam ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye nāgatīrthaghaṇṭābharaṇakatīrthasomatīrtha-
sarasvatīdaśāśvamedhatīrtharājavighnarājakoṭiśivakṣetra-sudhanatīrthānāṃ sudhanapradattanṛtyapuṇyena brahmarākṣasasya muktiścetyādeśca nirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśa-
dadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 345।।


← adhyāyaḥ 345 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 346
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 347 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi-! māthure tu maṇḍale'paratīrthakam ।
vatsakrīḍanakaṃ tīrthaṃ raktaprastaranirmitam ।। 1 ।।
tatra snānena vai yāyād vāyulokaṃ tu mānavaḥ ।
prāṇatyāge tu paramā muktiḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
atha bhāṇḍīrakaṃ tīrthaṃ dampatītvapradaṃ param ।
yatra kṛṣṇena rādhā vai vivāhitā vanasthale ।। 3 ।।
sālatālārjunairyukte tamāleṅgudapīlukaiḥ ।
karīraraktapuṣpaiśca yukte bhāṇḍīrake sthale ।। 4 ।।
snātaḥ pāpavinirmuktaścandralokaṃ prayāti saḥ ।
prāṇatyāge tu golokaṃ prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 5 ।।
vṛndāvanaṃ mama tīrthaṃ yatra gogopagopikāḥ ।
mayā sākaṃ ramiṣyanti vicitrakrīḍanaiḥ sadā ।। 6 ।।
sarveṣāṃ durlabhe sthāne kuṇḍe vṛndāvanasthale ।
bahugulmalatāraṇye snātaḥ svarge'psarogaṇaiḥ ।। 7 ।।
gandharvaiḥ sevamānaśca modate bahuvatsarān ।
tatra cenmuñcati prāṇān vaikuṇṭhe modate dhruvam ।। 8 ।।
atha vṛndāvane keśī daityo yatra nipātitaḥ ।
tatra snātaḥ śataguṇaṃ puṇyamāpnotyasaṃśayam ।। 9 ।।
hariviśrāmatīrthaṃ ca tato'pi śatapuṇyadam ।
tatra piṇḍapradānena gayātulyaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1.346.10 ।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ ca havanaṃ vahniṣṭomaphalapradam ।
atha dvādaśasūryāṇāṃ tīrthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paraṃ matam ।। 11 ।।
kālindīsalile kṛṣṇaḥ kālīyasarpamastake ।
nanarta damanārthaṃ taṃ tatrā''dityā daśojjvalāḥ ।। 1 2।।
mayaiva sthāpitā lakṣmi! varārthaṃ jñāpitāstadā ।
ādityāśca tadā procuryadi deyo varo'sti naḥ ।। 1 3।।
asmattīrthe'tra lokānāṃ snānena mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।
uttare haridevasya kālīyasya tu dakṣiṇe ।। 14।।
madhye ye syurmṛtāsteṣāṃ muktirgolokadhāmani ।
bhavedityarthitaṃ taiśca tathāstviti mayā'rpitam ।। 15।।
atha yamyāḥ pare pāre tīrthaṃ tu malayārjunam ।
paryastaṃ tatra śakaṭaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tatra suvidyate ।। 16।।
tatra snānopavāsābhyāmanantaphalabhāg bhavet ।
dvādaśyāṃ jyeṣṭhaśuklasya snānād dānācca darśanāt ।। 17।।
acyutasya samarcanāt prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim ।
upoṣitaṃ janaṃ sākṣāt kṛṣṇo netuṃ pragacchati ।। 18।।
api cāsmatkule jātaḥ kālindīsalile plutaḥ ।
arcayiṣyati govindaṃ mathurāyāmupoṣitaḥ ।। 19।।
dhanyo'sau piṇḍanirvāpaṃ yamunāyāṃ kariṣyati ।
dvādaśyāṃ jyeṣṭhamāse'tra tṛptirna saṃbhaviṣyati ।।1.346.20।।
iti gāyanti pitaraḥ paralokagatāḥ sadā ।
athātra subhagaṃ tīrthaṃ vanaṃ bahulasaṃjñakam ।। 21 ।।
snāto rudrasya bhavanaṃ prayāti dvādaśī tithau ।
caitraśukladaśamyāṃ tu snāto matpadamāpnuyāt ।।22।।
atha bhāṇḍahradastīrthaṃ pare pāre suvidyate ।
dṛśyante'harahastatra tvādityāḥ supataṅgakāḥ ।। 23।।।
arkakuṇḍe tatra tīrthe snānaṃ yaḥ kurute janaḥ ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryalokaṃ prayāti saḥ ।।24।।
athātra vimalaḥ kūpaḥ saptasāmudranāmakaḥ ।
tatra snātā yatheṣṭaḥ syāt sveṣṭaṃ lokaṃ prayāti saḥ ।।25।।
tatra prāṇaprayāṇe tu mama dhāma prapadyate ।
atha vīrasthalaṃ nāma tīrthakṣetraṃ paraṃ śubham ।।26।।
āsannasalilaṃ caiva padmotpalavibhūṣitam ।
tatra snātā vīralokaṃ prāpyā'nte dhāma yāti me ।।27।।
kuśasthalaṃ tathā kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ paramapāvanam ।
snātvā yāti brahmalokaṃ mṛtvā golokamṛcchati ।।28।।
tatra puṣpasthalatīrthe śivakṣetramanuttamam ।
tatra snānena manujaḥ śivalokaṃ pragacchati ।।29।।
atha gopīśvaramūrtirmahāpātakanāśinī ।
mātalisthāpitā mokṣapradā gopīśatīrthake ।।1.346.30।।
kṛṣṇasya ramaṇārthaṃ hi gopyastatra sahasraśaḥ ।
samāgatāstadā kṛṣṇo jātaḥ sahasrarūpadhṛk ।।3 1।।
gopīṃ gopīṃ prati reme yatheṣṭaṃ sukhadaḥ prabhuḥ ।
mātalistatra cāgatya gopīśvaraṃ vidhāya ca ।। 32।।
gopaveṣadharaṃ devamabhiṣekaṃ cakāra ha ।
ānīya saptakalaśān ratnauṣadhipariplutān ।।33 ।।
gopyo gāyanti nṛtyanti kṛṣṇa! kṛṣṇa! vadanti ca ।
tatra saptakalaśaiśca sthāpayāmāsa kūpakam ।।34।।
sapta sāmudrikaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ golokadhāmadam ।
tatra śrāddhe jaladātrā piṇḍadātrā ca sarvathā ।।35।।
pitarastāritāstena kulānāṃ saptasaptatiḥ ।
somavāre tvamāyāṃ ca śrāddhakartustu pūrvajāḥ ।। 26 ।।
pitarastasya tṛpyanti koṭivarṣaśatāni vai ।
govindasya ca devasya tathā gopīśvarasya ca ।। 37।।
madhye mṛto jano yāti mahendrasya salokatām ।
tathā bahularudrasya govindasya ca madhyataḥ ।। 38।।
tathā vai vedhasaścāpi gopīśasya ca madhyataḥ ।
piṇḍadānasnānakartuḥ kulānāṃ śatamuddharet ।।39।।
vasutīrthaṃ mathurādakṣiṇe phālgunakaṃ tathā ।
tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca mama loke mahīyate ।।1.346.40 ।।
tatra phālgunake tīrthe vṛṣabhāṃjanakaṃ sthalam ।
tatrā'bhiṣekamāpannaḥ suraiḥ saha pramodate ।।41।।
atha tālavanaṃ nāma mathurāpaścimasthitam ।
tatra kuṇḍe snānakartā dātā vāñcchitamāpnuyāt ।।42।।
asti saṃpīṭhakaṃ tīrthaṃ snātā'gniṣṭomapuṇyabhāk ।
kṛṣṇajanmasthale lakṣmi! saptamyāṃ somavāsare ।।43।।
vrataṃ kṛtvā pūjayenmāṃ sā tu putravatī bhavet ।
viṃśatiryojanānāṃ tu māthuraṃ mama maṇḍalam ।।44।।
yatra tatra kṛtasnāno mucyate ghorapātakaiḥ ।
varṣākāle'tra sthātavyaṃ yatsthānaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ।।45।।
saptadvīpeṣu tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ।
mathurāyāṃ gamiṣyanti prasupte tu sadā mayi ।।46।।
suptotthitaṃ ca māṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavanti muktibhājanāḥ ।
yamunāyāṃ kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtakeśavadarśanaḥ ।।587।।
sarvapāpavihīnaḥ sanmamalokaṃ prapadyate ।
pade pade phalaṃ yāti rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ।।48।।
pradakṣiṇīkṛto yena mathurāyāṃ tu keśavaḥ ।
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā ।।49।।
ghṛtadīpaṃ tathā vastraṃ dadyāt kṛṣṇāya mandire ।
pañcayojanavistāraṃ dīrghaṃ ṣaṭpaṃcayojanam ।।1.346.50।।
dīpamālāsamākīrṇaṃ vimānaṃ labhate janaḥ ।
sarvakāmasamṛddhaṃ tadapsarogaṇasevitam ।।5 1 ।।
sarvakāmapradaṃ ramyaṃ sarvatejovirājitam ।
siddhacāraṇamagandharvā yadicchanti divaṃ gatāḥ ।।52।।
yadi puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ syādvai labhyetaitādṛśaṃ gṛham ।
ante mokṣastvapāyyeta mathurāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।।53 ।।
mathurāṃ rakṣati pūrvāmindro yamastu dakṣiṇām ।
paścimāṃ rakṣati vārīśaḥ kuberastathottarām ।।54।।
madhyaṃ rakṣati me bhaktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīpatiḥ ।
mathurāyāṃ gṛhaṃ yo vā prāsādaṃ kurute janaḥ ।। '95।।
caturbhujastu vijñeyo jīvanmukto na saṃśayaḥ ।
mathurāyāṃ mahatkuḍaṃ vimalodakanāmakam ।। 56 ।।
hemante tu bhaveccoṣṇaṃ śītalaṃ grīṣmake bhavet ।
na vardhate ca varṣāsu grīṣme cāpi na hīyate ।।57।।
etattu mahadāścaryaṃ tasmina kuṇḍe paraṃ mama ।
māthure mama kṣetre tu garteṣu ca nadīṣu ca ।।58।।
kūpe hrade devakhāte pravāhe saṃgame tathā ।
snātavyaṃ yatra vā tatra tena syātparamā gatiḥ ।।59 ।।
kārtikasya tu māsasya navamyāṃ mama bhaktarāṭ ।
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ yāti pṛthvīprakramaṇavṛṣam ।। 1.346.60 ।।
na dānairna tapobhiśca na yajñaistādṛśaṃ phalam ।
bhūmeḥ pradakṣiṇāyāḥ syād yādṛśaṃ tīrthasevayā ।। 61 ।।
bhūmyāḥ parikrame samyag yojanānāṃ pramāṇakam ।
ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca ।। 62।।
tatra tīrthāni devāśca gaṇitāḥ pavanenavai ।
brahmaṇā lomaśenāpi nāradena dhruveṇa ca ।।6 3 ।।
patnāvratena vipreṇa garuḍena hanūmatā ।
etairanekadhā devaiḥ savārdhyāvaraṇā mahī ।। 64।।
kramitā balibhiḥ sarvairbāhyamaṇḍalarekhayā ।
yogasiddhaistathā kaiścirnmākaṇḍeyamukhairapi ।।65 ।।
saptadvīpe ca tīrthānāṃ bhramaṇād yatphalaṃ bhavet ।
prāpyate tvadhikaṃ tasmānmathurāyāḥ parikrame ।।66 ।।
yathāvidhānakramaṇaṃ mathurāyāṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ।
pradakṣiṇaphalaṃ samyaganukramavidhiṃ bruve ।। 67।।
sarvadeveṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam ।
sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyamiṣṭāpūrteṣu yatphalam ।। 68 ।।
tatphalaṃ labhyate lakṣmi! māthurasya pradakṣi+iṇe ।
devarṣimunisahitā brahmādyāḥ koṭidevatāḥ ।। 69 ।।
navamyāṃ kārtike śukle cakrūmāthuraprakramam ।
aṣṭamyāṃ mathurāṃ prāpya snātvā viśrāntitīrthake ।।1.346.7 0 ।।
kṛtvā pitṛsurarṣīṇāṃ pūjana yamunārcanam ।
viśrāntidarśanaṃ kṛtvā dīrghaviṣṇuṃ ca keśavam ।। 71 ।।
upavāsaṃ prakṛtvaiva svalpamedhyāśano'thavā ।
brahmacaryaparo bhūtvā maunamāsthāya yatnata. ।।7 2 ।।
tilā'kṣatakuśānnītvā viśrāntau dīpamādadet ।
navamyāṃ prātarevā'smātsthalād yātrāmupākramet ।।73 ।।
brāhme kāle raveḥ pūrvaṃ snāyād dakṣiṇakoṭike ।
prakṣālya pādāvācamya hanumantaṃ prasādayet ।।74।।
sarvamagaladaṃ siddhikartāraṃ phalasākṣiṇam ।
pradakṣiṇasya yātrāyāṃ yātrāsiddhiprado bhava ।।71।।
iti vijñāpya vidhivaddhanūmantaṃ gaṇeśvaram ।
dīpapuṣpopahārādyaiḥ pūjayitvā'gratastataḥ ।।76।।
pūjayetpadmanābhaṃ ca dīrghaviṣṇuṃ sukhapradam ।
dṛṣṭvā vasumatīṃ devīṃ tathā'nyāmaparājitām ।।77।।
āyudhāgārasaṃsthāṃ ca natvā gacchet tato'grataḥ ।
kaṃsavāsanikāṃ tadvadaugrasenāṃ ca carcikām ।।78 ।।
vadhūṭī tatra natvā ca dānavakṣayakāriṇīm ।
jayadāṃ ca tato natvā mātṛँśca devapūjitāḥ ।।79 ।।
gṛhadevīrvāstudevīrdṛṣṭvā'nujñāpya niḥsaret ।
dakṣiṇakoṭikaṃ prāpya snātvā santarpya pitṛkān ।।1.346.8 0 ।।
devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpraṇamya cekṣuvāsāṃ satīṃ vrajet ।
yatra bālakrīḍanakaistīrthaṃ kṛṣṇena vai kṛtam ।।8 1 ।।
vatsaputra tato gacchet tato'rkasthalameva ca ।
vīrasthalaṃ kuśasthalaṃ puṇyasthalaṃ mahāsthalam ।।82।।
pañcasthalāvalokena brahmaṇā saha modate ।
śivaṃ siddhamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā hayamuktiṃ ca lokayet ।।8 3 ।।
aśvo muktiṃ gataścātra sahāyasahito yataḥ ।
rājaputraḥ sthitastatra yānayātrāṃ na cācaret ।।84।।
mallikādarśanaṃ kṛtvā kadambakhaṇḍamāvrajet ।
carcikāṃ yoginīṃ dṛṣṭvā tato gacchettu mātaram ।।85।।
aspṛśyāṃ cā'spṛśāṃ te dve bālarakṣākare hyubhe ।
varṣakhātaṃ tato gatvā kuṇḍaṃ pitṛँśca tarpayet। ।।86 ।।
kṣetrapālaṃ śivaṃ bhūteśvaraṃ gacchet prapūjayet ।
kṛṣṇakrīḍāsetubandhaṃ tato gacched balihradam ।।87।।
tataḥ kukkaṭakrīḍākhyaṃ sthalaṃ gacched gatipradam ।
stambhoccayaṃ suśikharaṃ pūjyettaṃ parikramet ।।88 ।।
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ vrajettu saḥ ।
vasudevasya devakyā ekāntaśayanasthalam ।।89।।
gatvā nārāyaṇasthānaṃ praviśecca parikramet ।
vighnavināyakaṃ natvā kubjikāṃ vāmanāṃ tathā ।। 1.346.90।।
kṛṣṇadāsyau tu viprāṇyau natvā garteśvaraṃ vrajet ।
mahāvidyeśvarīṃ dṛṣṭvā yātrāsiddhiphalaṃ bhavet ।।9 1 ।।
prabhāmallīṃ mahāvidyeśvarīṃ vrajecca pūjayet ।
siddheśvarīṃ tathā saṃketeśvarīṃ ca prapūjayet ।।92।।
yasyāścāgre daityanāśārthaṃ saṃketitavān hariḥ ।
kuṇḍe tvācamanaṃ kṛtvā gokarṇeśvaramāvrajet ।।93।।
sarasvatīṃ nadīṃ dṛṣṭvā vighnarājaṃ samāvrajet ।
gaṃgāṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā spṛṣṭvā gacched rudramahālayam ।।94।।
kṣetrapaṃ taṃ samānatvottarakoṭigaṇādhipam ।
pūjayedyatra kṛṣṇena dyūtakrīḍā kṛtā'bhavat ।।95।।
tato gacchenmahātīrthaṃ vimalaṃ yamunāmbhasi ।
rudramahālayākhyaṃ tat snāyāt pitṝँśca tarpayet ।।96।।
gārgyatīrthaṃ tato gacched bhadreśvaraṃ ca somakam ।
someśvaraṃ prapūjyaiva yātrāphalaṃ labhejjanaḥ ।।97।।
sarasvatyāḥ saṃgame ca devarṣipitṛmānavān ।
santarpya vidhivad datvā kṛṣṇasāyujyamāpnuyāt ।।98।।
ghaṇṭābharaṇakaṃ gatvā tathā garuḍakeśave ।
dhārālopanakaṃ gatvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ khaṇḍavelakam ।।99।।
mandākinīsaṃyamana cāsikuṇḍaṃ ca gopakam ।
muktikeśvaramevā'tha vailakṣagaruḍaṃ sthalam ।। 1.346.100 ।।
gatvā sarvatra pitṝँśca devānsamarpya tarpayet ।
prārthayenmathurāyāśca yātrā me saphalā'stviti ।। 10 1।।
ityevaṃ devadeveśaṃ vijñāpya kṣetrapaṃ śivam ।
viśrāntisaṃjñake snātvā kṛtvā ca pitṛtarpaṇam ।। 102।।
viśrāntiṃ ca parikramya guruṃ natvā hariṃ tathā ।
sumaṃgalāṃ tato gacched yātrāsiddhiṃ prasādayet ।। 10 3।।
yātreyaṃ tvatprasādena saphalā me bhavatviti ।
pippalādeśvaraṃ gatvā parikramedupālipet ।। 104।।
ekaṃ śivaṃ svasya nāmnā sthāpayed yātrikastadā ।
yātrāphalaṃ prapadyeta pūjayetpraṇamet tathā ।। 1 05।।
karkoṭakaṃ tathā nāgaṃ gacched devīṃ ca caṇḍikām ।
vajrānanaṃ tato dhyātvā tataḥ sūryaṃ kuleśvaram ।। 106 ।।
dṛṣṭvā tatraiva dānaṃ ca datvā yātrāṃ samāpayet ।
pratikramaṃ kulānāṃ vai sūryaloke sthitirbhavet ।। 1 07।।
pradakṣiṇaprakartā ca viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।
mama pradakṣiṇakartā goloke ca mahīyate ।। 1 08।।
brahmaghnāśca surāpāśca caurā bhagnavratāśca ye ।
prasahya gamakā ye ca dhanakṣetrāpahārakāḥ ।। 109।।
hiṃsakā duḥkhadātāro nindakāḥ śaṭhadhūrtakāḥ ।
mathurākramaṇaṃ kṛtvā niṣpāpāste bhavanti vai ।। 1.346.11 0।।
anyadeśāgato dūrād yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇam ।
tasya saṃdarśanādanye pūtā bhavanti mānavāḥ ।। 1 1 1।।
yamunāyā vārikaṇaṃ pītvā dūranivāsinaḥ ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।। 112।।
mathurāvāsakartāro madhurātīrthasevinaḥ ।
madhurāvanadraṣṭāro mokṣabhājo bhavanti te ।। 113।।
madhuvanaṃ tālavanaṃ kundavanaṃ tṛtīyakam ।
kāmyakavanaṃ ca bahuvanaṃ bhadravanaṃ tathā ।। 1 14।।
khādiraṃ ca mahāvanaṃ lohārgalavanaṃ tathā ।
bilvavanaṃ ca bhāṇḍīraṃ vṛndāvanaṃ ca dvādaśam ।। 1 15।।
etāni ye prapaśyanti na te yāmyābhigāminaḥ ।
vanayātrāprakartāra indralokaṃ vrajanti vai ।। 1 16।।
mama bhaktāśca ye yātrāṃ madarthaṃ tvācaranti te ।
narā nāryaśca goloke yānti māmeva śāśvatam ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
mathurākṣetramāhātmye vatsakrīḍanakabhāṇḍīrakavṛndāvanahari-
viśrāmasūryatīrthamalayārjunabahulabhāṇḍahradārkakuṇḍavimalakūpavīra-sthalakuśasthalapuṣpasthalagopīśvarasaptasāmudrikavasuphālgunaka-
vṛṣabhāṃjanakatālavanasaṃpīṭhakavimalodakakuṇḍānāṃ nirdeśaḥ, mathurāpradakṣiṇe vidhiḥ, tatratyatīrthānāṃ kramanirdeśo viśrāntighaṭṭāraṃbhaṇasamāptyādi, vanāni
cetyādipradarśananāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 346।।


← adhyāyaḥ 346 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 347
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 348 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
athānyatte pravakṣyāmi mahālakṣmi! śṛṇuṣva tat ।
mathurāyā uttarasthe cakratīrthe'bhavattu yat ।। 1 ।।
jambūdvīpe mahāgṛhodayapattanavāsakṛt ।
brāhmaṇaḥ svasya kanyāṃ ca putraṃ cādāya vedavit ।। 2 ।।
śālagrāmaṃ mahākṣetraṃ yayau yātrārthameva saḥ ।
nivāsamakarot tatra snāyī tīrthasurārcakaḥ ।। 3 ।।
devatānāṃ darśane'sya siddhaḥ kaścid dṛśeḥ pathi ।
samāyātaḥ kalāpākhyagrāmavāsī narākṛtiḥ ।। 4 ।।
siddho nityaṃ darśanārthaṃ samāyāti viyāti ca ।
viprasya parṇaśālāyāṃ viśrāntiṃ labhate'pi ca ।। 5 ।।
varṇayati sma kalāpagrāmasyātivibhūtikāḥ ।
śrutvā viprasya gamane jātā buddhistato dvijaḥ ।। 6 ।।
prāha siddhaṃ mama mitraṃ bhavānadya hi vartate ।
kalāpaṃ māṃ naya mitra! te paśyāmi vibhūtikāḥ ।। 7 ।।
siddhaḥ prāha tu viprendra! tatra te na gatirbhavet ।
śarīraṃ śītavātaistu nāśaṃ yāsyati te dvija! ।। 8 ।।
tathāpi brāhmaṇaḥ prāha tava yogena māṃ naya ।
evamabhyarthitaḥ siddhaḥ kanyāṃ putraṃ ca mitrakam । । 9 । ।
kare saṃgṛhyotpapāta vyomni yogabalena vai ।
kalāpe svāśrame nyastaṃ siddhena brāhmaṇatrayam ।। 1.347.1 0।।
tatra kālena yātena vipro rugṇo'bhavattadā ।
mṛtyuyogyaṃ pitaraṃ ca ninye gaṃgātaṭaṃ sutaḥ । । 1 1।।
sutā cāpi svapitaraṃ sevate pathyavastubhiḥ ।
ekadā parṇaśālāyāṃ pitrarthe pākamācarat । । 12। ।
tadā kaścid brāhmaṇo'pi bhikṣārthaṃ gṛhamāgataḥ ।
pṛṣṭo'sau bhadrayā tayā kva bhavāँstvamihāgataḥ ।। 1 3।।
sa prāha kānyakubjasya vipro'haṃ siddhatāṃ gataḥ ।
vicarāmi mahātīrthe kalāpe'tra sukhī sadā ।। 14।।
kanyayā''veditaḥ pitre bhrātre sa siddhadehavān ।
pitrā dattā vicāryaiva kanyā siddhadvijāya sā । । 15।।
siddho'pyayaṃ hi jāmātā vasati śvaśuragṛhe ।
kālena kṣaṇatāṃ prāptaṃ śvaśuraṃ paryapṛcchata । । 16।।
kathaṃ rogaḥ kadā tvasya vināśo'pi bhaviṣyati ।
yathā rogavināśaḥ syāttathā karomi sevanam ।। 17।।
jāmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā śvaśuraḥ śāntimāvrajat ।
prāha jāmātaraṃ bhavān siddhyā jānāti ced vada ।। 18।।
jāmātā siddhimān dhyātvā śvaśuraṃ prāha bho dvija । ।
kalāpe'tra nivasatā śūdrānnaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tvayā ।। 1 9।।
ajānatā'rpitaṃ tena bhakṣitaṃ cā'pyajānatā ।
tena doṣeṇa rogo'yaṃ vartate varṣmaṇi dvija! ।।1.347.20।।
pādayorvidyate cānnaṃ jānvorūrdhve na vidyate ।
śūdrānnena vihīnasya vipra! mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ।।21।।
jāmātṛvacanaṃ śrutvā''tmānaṃ vipro'tyagarhayat ।
duḥkhena pīḍitaḥ kṣīṇo martumaicchad dvijottamaḥ ।।22।।
atha prabhāte jāmātā sutā putraśca te trayaḥ ।
kāryārtha tu yayurgehād bahistāvat kṣaṇāntare ।।23।।
nirjanāvasaraṃ labdhvā maraṇaṃ pravicārya ca ।
gaṃgātīrāt samuttiṣṭhan diśaḥ sarvā vilokayan ।।।24।।
sannidhāvupalāṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhītvā parṇakṛdgṛhe ।
cūrṇayāmāsa tau pādau pīḍayā duḥkhito dvijaḥ ।।25।।
tataḥ prāṇān parityajya gato'sau svargamuttamam ।
jāmātā ca sutā putraḥ kāryaṃ kṛtvā''yayurgṛham ।।26।।
tāvanmṛtaṃ tu taṃ vṛddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā ruruduratyati ।
sarpaśṛṃgihatānāṃ ca daṃṣṭriprāṇihatasya ca ।। 27।।
ātmaghātakṛtasyāpi nāsti saṃskārayogyatā ।
kathamasya bhaved dāho vicāryeti punaśca te ।।28।।
prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyīta na dadyāccodakakriyām ।
iti vidhiṃ samāśritya cakrurdāhādikaṃ tataḥ ।। 29।।
prāyaścittaṃ tathā cakruryayurgrāmaṃ kalāpakam ।
tatrasthaṃ mṛtaviprasya mitraṃ siddhaṃ praṇamya te ।। 1.347.30 ।।
maraṇādikamāṃvedya kṣaṇaṃ cakruḥ praśocanam ।
kalāpasthaśca siddho'yaṃ prāha jāmātaraṃ dvijam ।।3 1 ।।
brahmahatyā tu te jātā prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kuru ।
vṛddhasiddhavacaḥ bhūtvā jāmātā vākyamabravīt ।।32।।।
na mayā brāhmaṇavadhaḥ kadācidapi vai kṛtaḥ ।
kena doṣeṇa me pūjya! brahmahatyā phalaṃ vada ।।33।।
jāmāturvacanaṃ śrutvā vṛddhasiddhastamabravīt ।
tvayā tatpādayoḥ śūdrasyānnaṃ cāstīti darśitam ।। 34।।।
tadannasya kṣaye mṛtyurityapi darśitaṃ tathā ।
vipreṇa tena ca tadvaccūrṇitau caraṇau svakau ।। 35।।
mṛtyuḥ kṛtastatastatra doṣabhāk tvaṃ tathā'bhavaḥ ।
iti tvayā vadhopāyo nirdiṣṭaśca dvijottama! ।।36।।
tena doṣeṇa viprarṣe! brahmahatyāphalaṃ tava ।
āsannaśayanāccaiva bhojanāt kathanāttathā ।।37।।
pāpaṃ saṃkramate vyaktau sahasaṃcaraṇāttathā ।
tataḥ śuddhiḥ prakartavyā mā'stu vāso mama gṛhe ।।38।।
kalpagrāmaṃ parityajya mathurāṃ yāhi bhūsura ।
nānyatra tava śuddhiḥ syādityavehi prayāhi ca ।।39।।
śrutvā vṛddhasya tadvākyaṃ mathurāṃ te trayo yayuḥ ।
patnī ca śālakastena jāmātrā siddhavidyayā ।।1.347.40 ।।
utpatatā vyomamārge tvānītau mathurāṃ prati ।
brāhmaṇebhyo bahiḥsthāne vasatiṃ cakrurādarāt ।।41 ।।
mathurāyāṃ tadā rājñaḥ satre vai kuśikasya ca ।
viprāṇāṃ dve sahasre tu bhuñjete medhyamanvaham ।।42 ।।
brahmayajñakṛtocchiṣṭaṃ bhuṃjate te trayastataḥ ।
cakratīrthaṃ samāsādya snānaṃ ca kurvate sadā ।।43 ।।
patnī yajñaprasādaṃ svapatiṃ bhikṣā''gataṃ niśi ।
bhojayitvā prabhuṃkte ca varṣārdhaṃ vigataṃ tathā ।।44।।
tato bhikṣārthamāyātaṃ siddhaṃ papracchurādarāt ।
viprā yajñaprakartāraḥ kutra santiṣṭhase dvija! ।।45।।
bhojanaṃ kuruṣe kutra sthitvā vad yathātatham ।
siddhaśca kathayāmāsa vṛttāntaṃ svātmano hitam ।।46 ।।
bhikṣāṃ tvatra gṛhītvā'haṃ bhāryayā śālakena ca ।
sahitaścakratīrthe'tra samāplāvya vibhajya ca ।। 47।।
bhojanaṃ vai karomyatra brahmahatyānivṛttaye ।
tacchrutvā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve ūcuḥ śuddho'si vai dvija! ।।48 ।।
cakratīrthaprabhāveṇa pāpānmukto'si sarvathā ।
viprāṇāṃ vacanāccaiva punaḥ śuddho'si vai dvija! ।।49 ।।
iti viprakṛtāṃ śuddhiṃ cakratīrthakṛtāṃ tathā ।
prāyaścittakṛtāṃ cāpi prasādasyā'śanāttathā ।।1.347.5 0 ।।
prāpya siddhaḥ pramumoda sabhāryāśālakastathā ।
cakratīrthaṃ samāgatya bhikṣāṃ bhoktuṃ vyavasthitaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
patnī hṛṣṭena manasā bhartāraṃ vākyamabravīt ।
bhojanaṃ kuru viprendra! hatyāṃ lakṣyāmi te gatām ।।52।।
cakratīrthaprabhāveṇa hatyā naṣṭā dvijottama! ।
tasmādatra mathurāyāṃ nityaṃ sthātavyameva ha ।।5 3 ।।
te vyavasya trayastatra mathurāyāṃ sadā sthitāḥ ।
kalāpaṃ saṃparityajya mathurā bhuktimuktidā ।।।।54।।
bhadreśvaraṃ tu tattīrthaṃ siddhasevitamityatha ।
kalāpāddhi śataguṇaṃ cakratīrthaṃ hi puṇyadam ।।55।।
ahorātropavāsena brahmahatyā vinaśyati ।
kiṃ tasya tu kalāpena vārāgāsyā'thavāpi kim ।।56।।
mathurā yadi saṃlabdhā cakratīrthaṃ ca sevitam ।
api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā jāyate sa caturbhujaḥ ।।57।।
kāladharmaṃ samāpannāstrayaste brāhmaṇāḥ priye! ।
prāpurme divyagolokaṃ caturbhujā hi śāśvatāḥ ।।58 ।।
śṛṇu cānyat pravakṣyāmi balaṃ vaikuṇṭhatīrthajam ।
mithilāvāsino lokāstīrthārthaṃ mathurāṃ gatāḥ ।।59 ।।
vaikuṇṭhatīrthamāsādya sthitāsteṣāṃ tu bhūsuraḥ ।
kaścidāsīd brahmahatyāpāpena tvatipīḍitaḥ ।।1.347.60 ।।
rudhirasya tu vai dhārā sravantī tasya hastataḥ ।
pratyakṣā dṛśyate bahutīrthasnāne'pi no gatā ।।61।।
kintu vaikuṇṭhatīrthasya snānena vilayaṃ gatā ।
vismayo nātra kartavyo vaikuṇṭhasya phalaṃ hi tat ।।62।।
atra snātā pāpaśūnyo vaikuṇṭhaṃ pratigacchati ।
punaranyat pravakṣyāmi lakṣmi! gandharvakuṇḍajam ।।63 ।।
māhātmyaṃ snānakartā'smin gandharvaiḥ saha modate ।
māthuraṃ maṇḍalaṃ padmaṃ yojanānāṃ tu viṃśatiḥ ।।64।।
karṇikāyāmahaṃ kṛṣṇo mṛtānāṃ muktidaḥ sadā ।
paścime'haṃ harirgovardhanadhārī vasāmi ca ।।65।।
govindaścottare pūrve viśrāntau devaviśramaḥ ।
dakṣiṇe'haṃ varāho'smi mahākāyo'tikeśavān ।।66।।
kṛte yuge nṛpatinā māndhātrā toṣito'smyaham ।
mayā tuṣṭena hi tasmai pratimā mama cārpitā ।।67।।
kapilena bhagavatā taijasī divyarūpiṇī ।
manasā nirmitā ramyā vārāhī pratimā śubhā ।।68।।
indro'pi dhyāyati nityaṃ kapilāt prāpya saukarīm ।
mūrtiṃ svabhavane samarcayati sma samādarāt ।।69।।
rāvaṇo'pi gataḥ śakraṃ vijetuṃ svargamityapi ।
śakraṃ jitvā praviṣṭastadbhavane tatra saukaram ।।1.347.70 ।।
rūpaṃ divyaṃ rāvaṇaṃ vai babandha bahuraśmibhiḥ ।
rāvaṇaśca stutiṃ cakre trātumarhasi mādhava! ।।71।।
mama tvaṃ bhaktiyuktasya prasādaṃ kuru sarvathā ।
tadā prasanno bhagavān mumoca rāvaṇaṃ hariḥ ।।72।।
rāvaṇo'pi tadā mūrtiṃ laṃkāṃ netumiyeṣa yat ।
tāmuddhartumaśakanna tadātivismayaṃ gataḥ ।।73।।
neme tatpādayoḥ prāha laṃkāṃ netuṃ mamā''śayaḥ ।
vārāhaḥ prāha rakṣastvamavaiṣṇavo'si tena vai ।।74।।
nā''gamiṣye tato bhūyā vaiṣṇavaścennayasva mām ।
rāvaṇo vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā nītavānnagarīṃ tu tām ।।75।।
rāmeṇa rāvaṇo nāśaṃ gamitaḥ pratimā tu sā ।
ānītā svanagarīṃ ca pūjitā bahuvatsarān ।।76।।
tena śeṣasvarūpaḥ svabhrātā rakṣovināśane ।
yojitaḥ sa mathurāyāṃ samāgatya tu rākṣasān ।।77।।
nāśayāmāsa ca tatra vārāhīṃ pratimāṃ hi tām ।
ānayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ sthāpayāmāsa vai vidheḥ ।।78 ।।
dhanyeyaṃ māthurī pṛthvī dhanyā lokāśca tadgatāḥ ।
yaiḥ sadā snāpito dṛṣṭaḥ spṛṣṭo dhyāto'nucarcitaḥ ।।79।।
pūjitaśca varāho'yaṃ mokṣaṃ dāsyati sarvathā ।
varāhasannidhau piṇḍadānānmuktāstu pūrvajāḥ ।।1.347.80 ।।
bhavatyeva gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ puṣkarajaṃ phalam ।
śvetaṃ vārāhamālokya viśrāntiṃ lokayettathā ।।8 1 ।।
govindaṃ ca samālokya govardhanadharaṃ tataḥ ।
vilokayediti lakṣmi! kathito mahimā ca te ।।।82।।
ya idṃ śṛṇuyāccāpi paṭhedvā pāṭhayettathā ।
tasya varṇitapuṇyānāṃ prāptiḥ syānmokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।।83।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye cakratīrthe kalāpagrāmavāstavyaviprasya brahmahatyāpātakanāśākhyānaṃ, muktiśca । vaikuṇṭhatīrthe mithi-lāyā viprasya brahmahatyāpātakanāśākhyānaṃ, kapilabhagavatā manasotpāditavārāhasya paramparayā mathurāyāṃ prati-ṣṭhānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 347 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 347 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 348
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 349 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahāpuṇyaṃ sthalaṃ govardhanātmakam ।
mathurāyāḥ paścime tad vartate yojanadvaye ।। 1 ।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṣetraṃ prakramaṇena dehinām ।
hṛdasyatra pāpanāśakaraḥ snānena vai nṛṇām ।। 2 ।।
aindraṃ pūrve yamatīrthe dakṣiṇe vartate priya! ।
paścime vāruṇaṃ tīrthaṃ kauberaṃ tūttareṇa vai ।। 3 ।।
tattattīrthe snānakartā tattalloke mahīyate ।
prāṇatyāge mama smartā mama lokaṃ pragacchati ।। 4 ।।
annakūṭasthalaṃ prāpya tasya kuryātpradakṣiṇam ।
sa yāti paramaṃ lokaṃ dhanadhānyādismṛddhimat ।। 5 ।।
snātvā mānasagaṃgāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā govardhane harim ।
annakūṭaṃ parikramya na janurjāyate punaḥ ।। 6 ।।
somavāre tvamāyāṃ vai gatvāgovardhanasthalam ।
pitṝn santarpayed gayāpiṇḍatṛptistadā bhavet ।। 7 ।।
govardhanaṃ parikramya dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
rājasūyā'śvamedhānāṃ puṇyamāpnotyasaṃśayam ।। 8 ।।
māsi bhādrapade śuklaikādaśyāṃ samupoṣayet ।
snātvā mānasagaṃgāyāṃ brāhme sūryasya darśanam ।। 9 ।।
kṛtvā govardhanaṃ natvā śṛṃge natvā hariṃ sthitam ।
avatīrya sopavāsā kuryād gireḥ pradakṣiṇam ।। 1.348.10 ।।
puṇḍarīkaṃ sthalaṃ gacchet kuṇḍe snānaṃ samācaret ।
pitṛdevānarcayecca puṇḍarīkaṃ prapūjayet ।। 11 ।।
evaṃ vidhānakartā sa prayāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ ।
tataścāpsarase kuṇḍe snāyāt pitṝँśca tarpayet ।। 12 ।।
rājasūyā'śvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ vindettu tena vai ।
tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇe tīrthe snāyāt tarpaṇamācaret ।। 13 ।।
gohatyābrahmahatyādipāpānāṃ vilayo bhavet ।
annakūṭasya nikaṭe śakratīrthe tataścaret ।। 14।।
makhabhaṃgo mahendrasya yatra kṛṣṇena vai kṛtaḥ ।
indro vavarṣa roṣeṇa sarvanāśecchayā tadā ।। 15।।
kṛṣṇena ca gavādīnāṃ rakṣayāya dhṛto giriḥ ।
tatra ca bhojitā devā devyo gāvo maharṣayaḥ ।। 16 ।।
gopā gopyaḥ pataṃgādyāḥ kīṭāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ ।
so'nnakūṭa iti nāmnā khyāto'bhavadgiristathā ।। 17।।
tatra bhojanadānena jalārpaṇena vai tathā ।
tarpaṇena ca yātrāluḥ śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet ।। 18 ।।
tataḥ kadambakuṇḍe vai snātavyaṃ brahmalokade ।
tato devagiriṃ gacchet snāyāt paśyecca bhāvataḥ । 19। ।
mahādevaṃ prapaśyecca kuṇḍe pitṝnpratarpayet ।
vājapeyaphalaṃ prāpya svarge muktvā hariṃ vrajet ।।1.348.20। ।
gaṃgāyāścottaraṃ yāvad devadevasya cakriṇaḥ ।
sthale kṛṣṇasya saṃgrāmo'riṣṭāsureṇacā'bhavat । ।2 1 । ।
vṛṣāsuraṃ harirhatvā snātastatra punaḥ punaḥ ।
rādhayā tu samāgatya kṛṣṇaḥ saṃsnāpitastadā । ।22।
rādhākuṇḍamiti nāmnā khyātaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham ।
tatra snānenāśvamedharājasūyaphalaṃ bhavet ।।23 ।।
gonarabrahmahatyāyāḥ pāpaṃ snānena naśyati ।
mokṣarājākhyatīrthaṃ ca natvendradhvajamāvrajet ।।24।।
indradhvajocchraye tīrthe snātvā natvā samāvrajet ।
pañcatīrthā'bhidhaṃ kuṇḍaṃ gacched yātrāṃ samāpayet ।।25 । ।
yātrāphalaṃ śrīharaye nivedya niśi jāgaram ।
govardhane prakartavyaṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca tataḥ prage ।।26।।
snātvā piṇḍaṃ tu nirvāpya natvā gacched bhajan harim ।
ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ pitṝn sa tārayatyapi ।।27।।
pāpāni saṃvinirdhūya parabrahmā'dhigacchati ।
aṣāḍhe'pi prakartavyamannakūṭaparikramam ।।28।।
etattu śṛṇuyād yaśca paṭhecca pāṭhayettathā ।
yātrāphalaṃ labhet snānaphalaṃ kṛṣṇaprasannatām । । 29। ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! suśīlākhyo vaiśyo vai dakṣiṇāpathe ।
pratiṣṭhānapurāvāso bahuputraḥ samṛddhimān ।।1.348.3 0 ।।
udaraṃbhara evā'sau kuṭumbabharaṇe rataḥ ।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ devārcāṃ na karoti saḥ ।। 31 ।।
satāṃ samāgamaścāpi kadāpi tena na kṛtaḥ ।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ dharmakāryaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ nahi ।।3 2 ।।
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhaktistasya na vidyate ।
pāpamagnasya tu buddhirdharmadānāya nā'bhavat ।।33 ।।
matidātāramābhartsya tiraskaroti sarvathā ।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya kālena maraṇaṃ hyabhūt ।।34।।
nirudakasthale śuṣke pretatvaṃ samupāgataḥ ।
marudeśe kṣudhāviṣṭo bhraman tiṣṭhati duḥkhitaḥ ।।35।।।
marau stambe vasati sma preto raudro bhayānakaḥ ।
dīrghadaṃṣṭro lambahanurbiḍālāsyo mahodaraḥ ।।36।।
tatra gatena mārgeṇa krayavikrayakārakaḥ ।
nirjagāma vaṇik kaścit taṃ nṛtyannabravīttadā ।।37।।
bhakṣyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā tvaṃ vai kvā'dhunā yātumicchasi ।
māṃsaṃ te bhakṣayiṣyāmi pāsyāmi tava śoṇitam ।। 38।।
pretasya vacanaṃ śrutvā dhairyaṃ kṛtvā''ha taṃ vaṇik ।
kuṭumbabharaṇārthāya gacchāmi dhanavāñcchayā ।।39।।
vṛddhaḥ pitā me bhavane mātā patnī pativratā ।
mayi saṃbhakṣite rakṣaḥ! kuṭumba me mariṣyati ।।1.348.40।।
punaḥ pāpena yuktatvaṃ pretabhāvānna mokṣyase ।
ityākarṇya sa pretastaṃ papraccha kuta āgamaḥ ।।41 ।।
vaṇik prāha mathurāyāḥ samāgato'smi te vanam ।
govardhanaḥ śailavaro yamunā ca mahānadī ।।42।।
tayormadhye mathurāyāṃ vasāmi bahuvaṃśataḥ ।
dhanaprāptyai pragacchāmi deśāntaraṃ daridrakaḥ ।।43 ।।
pretaḥ prāha śṛṇu dīna! yadi kāryaṃ kuruṣva me ।
samayena hi mokṣyāmi gaccha tvaṃ mathurāṃ prati ।।44।।
snānaṃ kṛtvā tu vidhivat cātuḥsāmudrike prahau ।
piṇḍadānaṃ kuruṣva tvaṃ mama nāmnā prayatnataḥ ।।45।।
snānasya ca phalaṃ yaccha mama muktirbhaviṣyati ।
tava gṛhe dhanaṃ tvasti! dāridryaṃ nāsti te vaṇik! ।।46 ।।
suvarṇabhāro gartastho gṛhe tiṣṭhati sañcitaḥ ।
nivartasva susantuṣṭaḥ kuru me mokṣaṇaṃ vaṇik! ।।47।।
vaṇik prāha kathaṃ te'sti jñānaṃ kūpaḥ pramokṣakaḥ ।
rakṣaḥ prāha pratiṣṭhāne pure'gastyo mahāmuniḥ ।।48।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāmavācayat ।
sāyaṃkāle kathāṃ śrotuṃ gato'haṃ viṣṇumandiram ।।49।।
śruto mayā tataḥ kūpaḥ pretānāṃ mokṣadāyakaḥ ।
samudrāḥ kila tiṣṭhanti catvārastatra saṃgatāḥ ।।1.348.50।।
itiśrutā kathā tatra vācakāya janairbahu ।
dānaṃ dattaṃ mayā śāṭhyād datto vai tāmraḍhabbukaḥ ।।51 ।।
tato me saṃgate kāle nidhanaṃ samapadyata ।
yamarājaniyogena pūrvakarmabalena ca ।।।52।।
pretatvaṃ samanuprāpto dānahomavivarjitaḥ ।
tadā tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva pitarastarpitā nahi ।।53 ।।
dharmakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ naiva prāpto'haṃ pretatāṃ tataḥ ।
ḍhabbukasya prabhāveṇa kathāyāḥ śravaṇena ca ।।54।।
jñānaṃ tu vidyate'dyāpi gaccha me mokṣaṇaṃ kuru ।
vibhvākhyastu vaṇik prāha kathaṃ jīvasi me vada ।।55।।
rakṣaḥ prāha mayā naijagṛhāṃgaṇe praropitaḥ ।
chāyārthaṃ pippalavṛkṣo jalena vardhitastataḥ ।।56।।
tasya varṣe dvivāraṃ ca bhavantyeva phalāni vai ।
jantavastena jīvanti tatpuṇyena mamāpi ca ।।57।।
tṛptirbhavati me nityā jalānnavihitā yathā ।
śrutvā vaṇik samāśvāsya pretaṃ ca mathurāṃ yayau ।।।58।।।
dravyaṃ niṣkāsya vai bhūmeḥ pretakāryaṃ cakāra ha ।
catuḥsāmudrike kūpe piṇḍadānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।।59।।
preto'sau tatra cāgatya piṇḍān bhuktvā yayau divam ।
vaṇik dravyaṃ tathā prāpya modate sma gṛhe nije ।।1.348.60।।
tīrthe lakṣmi! gṛhe'raṇye devasthāne ca catvare ।
yatra tatra mṛtāḥ piṇḍadānānmuktiṃ prayānti te ।।61 ।।
anyatra kṛtapāpasya tīrthe muktirhi niścitā ।
mathurāyāṃ kṛtapāpasyāpi kūpārṇave kṣayaḥ ।।62।।
mathurāyāṃ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tatraiva tu vinaśyati ।
eṣā purī mahāpuṇyā yasyāṃ pāpaṃ na vidyate ।।63।।
kṛtaghnaśca surāpaśca cauro bhagnavratastathā ।
mathurāṃ yamunāṃ prāpya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ।।64।।
tiṣṭhed yugasahasraṃ tu pādenaikena yaḥ kvacit ।
tato'dhikaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ mathurāyāṃ nivāsinaḥ ।।65।।
mathurāvāsinaḥ sarve divyā devā hi mānavāḥ ।
tīrthasnānaratāste'pi devā vai naramūrtayaḥ ।।66।।
anyatra viprasāhasrapūjanena tu yatphalam ।
ekena pūjitenātra māthureṇa phalaṃ bhavet ।।67।।
anṛg vai māthuro yatra caturvedastathā'paraḥ ।
na tu vedaiścaturbhiḥ syānmāthureṇa samaḥ kvacit ।।68।।
bhavanti sarvatīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ।
maṃgalāni tu sarvāṇi yatra vai māthuro dvijaḥ ।।6 9।।
sarve mokṣāstatra bhūtā bhaviṣyanti ca dehinām ।
yatra vai māthuraṃ tīrthaṃ yamunāyā jalaṃ tathā ।।1.348.70 ।।
mathurāvāsino bodhyāḥ pārṣadā vai caturbhujāḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya caturbāhutvamāpnuyāt ।।71 ।।
śṛṇu tvanyat pravakṣyāmi māhātmyamasikuṇḍajam ।
puṇyanagaravāstavyo rājā'bhūd vimatiḥ purā ।।72 ।।
vimatestu gṛhe tatra tvāgato nāradaḥ kvacit ।
tasmai pādyaṃ tathā'rghyaṃ ca dattavān vimatistadā ।।73 ।।
pratigṛhya tatastaṃ ca nāradaḥ prāha dharmabhṛt ।
ānṛṇyaṃ te pituḥ kartuṃ samartho'si nṛpeśvara ।।74।।
mama mitraṃ pitā te me samāsīnmānadaḥ sadā ।
sumatināmakastasya nidhanottarameva tu ।।75।।
kṛtaṃ tvayā mahādānaṃ puṇyaṃ cāpyatipuṣkalam ।
tīrthayātrā kṛtā naiva tayā''nṛṇyaṃ bhavet pituḥ ।।76।।
pituranṛṇatāṃ kṛtvā putro'sya dharmabhāg bhavet ।
evamuktvā nāradastu yayau vai badarīvanam ।।77।।
rājāpi ca tato'pyaicchat tīrthayātrāṃ pituḥ kṛte ।
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā gacchāmo mathurāṃ purīm ।।78।।
iti niścitya rājā'sau tvāgato mathurāṃ purīm ।
caturo vārṣikānmāsānmathurāyāṃ vasāmi vai ।।79।।
sarvatīrthāni cātraiva cāturmāsye vasanti ca ।
iti vicārya rājā sa vāsaṃ dīrghaṃ cakāra vai ।।1.348.80।।
sahasramānavairyukto dāsadāsīprasevitaḥ ।
bhṛtyāstīrtheṣu sarvatra kurvanti malavarjanam ।।8 1 ।।
dāsā dāsyaḥ śūdravarṇā vratāheṣvapi maithunam ।
kurvanti ca tathā snāntyamaryādaṃ tīrthavāriṣu ।।82।।
prasahya brāhmaṇādīnāṃ nayantyupaskarādikam ।
nindanti sādhūn viprāṃśca kathāṃ ca bhartsayanti vai ।।83।।
mūtratyāgādikaṃ devabhūmau kurvantyarodhinaḥ ।
matsyān khādanti tānpāpān rājā daṇḍaṃ karoti na ।।84।।
tatpāpaṃ duṣṭatārājñaḥ śirasyeva bhavatyapi ।
māse gate ca tīrthāni duḥkhādūcuḥ parasparam ।।85।।
rājā tvasmāt sthalānniṣkāsanīyaḥ sukhahetave ।
yuddhaṃ vimatinā sārdhaṃ svayaṃ kartuṃ na śaknumaḥ ।।86।।
kalpagrāmaṃ vayaṃ gatvā varāhaṃ parameśvaram ।
kaṣṭaṃ nivedayāmaḥ sa yogyaṃ samyak kariṣyati ।।87।।
kalpagrāme gatānyeva prārthayāṃcakrurādarāt ।
jaya viṣṇo jaya pṛthvīpate rājapate jaya ।।88।।
tīrthakaṣṭavināśārthaṃ nārāyaṇa namo'stu te ।
śrutyā varāhabhagavān prāha tīrthāni sādaram ।।89।।
varaṃ vṛṇuta bhadraṃ vo yadvo manasi vartate ।
tīrthānyūcurhare kṛṣṇa no'bhayaṃ dātumarhasi ।।1.348.90।।
supāpinā vimatinā kṛtastrāsaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।
taṃ niyacchasva pāpiṣṭhaṃ māṃsādaṃ pāpisevitam ।।9 1 ।।
śrīvarāhastadā prāha haniṣyāmi mahāripum ।
evaṃ tīrthaniyogena tvāgato mathurāṃ purīm ।।92 ।।
vārāhaḥ svāsinā rājñā yuddhaṃ cakāra dāruṇam ।
sūdayāmāsa rājānaṃ varāhaḥ svāsinā tataḥ ।।93।।
khaḍgaṃ svasya dharāyāṃ ca dhārāgraṃ nihitaṃ bhuvi ।
kṣaṇa viśrāntilābhāya niṣasāda bhuvastale ।।94।।
sā bhūmiḥ pāvanī yatra kuṇḍaṃ devarṣibhiḥ kṛtam ।
asikuṇḍaṃ tu tatproktaṃ tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ।।95।।
dvādaśyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ kuṇḍasnānaṃ hi muktidam ।
tadā varāhatīrthe'haṃ tiṣṭhāmi mokṣadānakṛt ।।96।।
tīrthe tatra pradātavyā mūrtayo me caturvidhāḥ ।
ekā varāhasaṃjñā ca nārāyaṇī dvitīyakā ।।97।।
vāmanasya tṛtīyā ca caturthī rāghavasya ca ।
etāsāṃ darśanaṃ pūjā pratiṣṭhā dānamityapi ।।98।।
kartavyaṃ sarvathā tatra mokṣabhāk sa bhavettataḥ ।
etāścatasro yaḥ paśyet snātvā kuṇḍe'sināmake ।।99।।
catuḥsāgaraparyantā krāntā tena vasundharā ।
māthurāṇāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ phalabhāk sa bhaveddhruvam ।। 1.348.10 0।।
suptotthito'pi dvādaśyāmasikuṇḍāpluto naraḥ ।
mūrtīḥ paśyati yastāstu brahmabhūyāya kalpate ।। 101 ।।
nāsti tatpunarāvṛttirnārāyaṇaprasādataḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya bhuktvā muktiṃ vrajet khalu ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye govardhanā'nnakūṭatadanyatīrthapradakṣiṇam, pretarūpasya suśīlavaiśyasyoddhāraḥ, vārāheṇa vimaternāśe'sikuṇḍaṃ vārāhakṣetramāhātmyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।348।।


← adhyāyaḥ 348 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 349
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 350 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yamunāyā viśrāntighaṭṭanirvacaḥ ।
ujjayinyāmabhūd vipro bhraṣṭācāraḥ praṇāstikaḥ ।। 1 ।।
sadācāraparityāgī na tu snānaṃ karoti saḥ ।
sa na pūjayate devānna sa sādhūnnamasyati ।। 2 ।।
kāmanāvyākulaḥ sandhyāśayanaḥ pitṛnindakaḥ ।
śrāddhakhaṇḍanakartā ca pāpasaṃgaḥ sudurmatiḥ ।। 3 ।।
svakuṭumbodarabharaścauryādibhiḥ sadā niśi ।
ekadā sa niśi cauryaṃ kurvāṇaḥ pāpibhiḥ saha ।। 4 ।।
rājabhaṭairvīkṣyamāṇo dravanvegādvimārgagaḥ ।
palāyamānaḥ sa paramandhakūpe'patattadā ।। 5 ।।
mṛto'sau patitaścātha rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ ।
sa tu pārśvagamārgasthajīrvāvṛkṣe vasan sadā ।। 6 ।।
paśūnpakṣavataḥ prāṇān raktaṃ pibati khādati ।
kadācittena mārgeṇa mahānsārtha upāgataḥ ।। 7 ।।
tanmadhyasthena vipreṇa rakṣoghnamantrarakṣitaḥ ।
sārthaḥ suṣvāpa suśrānto vṛkṣā'dhaḥkūpasannidhau ।। 8 ।।
tatrāgatya ca rakṣastu brāhmaṇaṃ prāha bho dvija! ।
ahaṃ dāsyāmi te dravyaṃ yatte manasi vartate ।। 9 ।।
bahukālena saṃprāptaṃ bhojanaṃ bahumānavam ।
dehi bhakṣayituṃ vipra! gacchānyatra kṛpāṃ kuru ।। 1.349.1 0।।
yenā'haṃ bhakṣaye sārthaṃ yāvat tṛptirbhavenmama ।
vipraḥ prāha kṛtaghno'haṃ na bhavāmi kathaṃcana ।। 11 ।।
duṣṭena mama kā maitrī ko lābho rakṣasā saha ।
rakṣasā mitratālābhau prāṇāntāmantraṇāpradau ।। 1 2।।
sārthena mama lābho'sti na tvayā tu kathaṃcana ।
ekasārthaprayāto'haṃ notsṛjāmi sahārthakam ।। 1 3।।
tasmād rākṣasa! gaccha tvaṃ vihāya mama sārthakam ।
nirīkṣituṃ na śakto'si mama mantrabalena vai ।। 14।।
rakṣaḥ prāha hate bhakṣye me doṣaste bhaviṣyati ।
dayāṃ kuru tvaṃ viprendra! bhojanaṃ mama dīyatām ।। 15।।
evamarthamarthayantaṃ papraccha rākṣasaṃ dvijaḥ ।
kena karmapradoṣeṇa rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ ।। 16।।
rakṣaḥ prakathayāmāsa cauryā'nācāradūṣaṇaiḥ ।
vipro'pi pāpakāryaiśca rākṣasatvamupāgataḥ ।। 17।।
tadā sārthagataḥ kṣmādevo'pi śrutvā kṛpāṃ gataḥ ।
uvāca rakṣo vada me mārjayāmi dvijasya te ।। 18।।
yāni kāni ca pāpāni muktiścāpi yathā bhavet ।
mayā kṛtopakāreṇa priyaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi te ।। 1 9।।
śrutvā''ha rākṣaso vipraṃ tvayā yātrā bahukṛtā ।
mathurāyāṃ tu yat snānaṃ kṛtaṃ viśrāntitīrthake ।।1.349.20।।
tacca snānaphalaṃ dehi yena muktiṃ vrajāmyaham ।
vipraḥ papraccha tacchrutvā rākṣasaṃ prāgudantakam ।।21 ।।
kathaṃ jānāsi rakṣastvaṃ tīrthaṃ viśrāntisaṃjñakam ।
kathaṃ ca tādṛśī saṃjñā sarvaṃ kathaya vitsi cet। ।।।22।।
rākṣasaḥ prāha viprendra! ujjayinyāṃ purā mama ।
puryāṃ vāsaḥ sadā''sīnme tatra vai .viṣṇumandire ।।23।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ tu bhūsuraḥ ।
karoti nityamevātibhāvato janatākṛte ।।24।।
viśrāntitīrthamāhātmyaṃ śrutaṃ dvija mayā tadā ।
tasya śravaṇamātreṇa mama bhaktirhṛdi sthitā ।।25।।
sā tu saṃjñā śrutā tatra viśrānterarthabodhikā ।
vāsudevaḥ paraṃ brahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।26।।
viśrāmaṃ kurute nityaṃ yatra vai yamunātaṭe ।
tatsthānaṃ jalasānnidhye viśrāntisaṃjñakaṃ hyabhūt ।।27।।
tatra snātā koṭiyugānsvargaṃ bhuktvā tataḥ param ।
vairājasaṃjñakān lokān bhuktvā yāti paraṃ padam ।। 28।।।
tasmāt prayaccha viprendra! hyekasnānasya me phalam ।
yena me rākṣasabhāvānmuktiḥ svargagatistathā ।।।29।।
ante muktirbhaveccāpi kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari ।
rākṣasasya vacaḥ śrutvā sārthavipro'bravīttadā ।।1.349.3 0।।
ekasnānasya hi phalaṃ tava dattaṃ tu rākṣasa! ।
ityabhidhāya yāvat sa jalaṃ dadāti rakṣase ।।3 1 ।।
tāvacchuddho divyatanumavāpya sa divaṃ yayau ।
tatra bhogānparān bhuktvā mokṣamavāpa padmaje ।।32।।
tataḥ sārthaḥ sa vipro hi yayau deśaṃ prati svakam ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! purā śaṃbhurharestoṣaṇahetave ।।33।।।
cakārograṃ tapastena prasannaḥ sannahaṃ tadā ।
śaṃkaraṃ tu samāgatya datvā darśanameva me ।। 34।।
varaṃ varaya cetyukto vavre matto varaṃ haraḥ ।
yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavan! mathurākṣetramaṇḍale ।। 35।।
yatra kvāpi ca me sthānaṃ sadā kṛṣṇa! pradīyatām ।
tadā mayā kathitaṃ tvaṃ kṣetrapālo bhaviṣyasi ।। 36 ।।
tvayi dṛṣṭe mahādeva! mama kṣetraphalaṃ bhavet ।
mama kṣetrasya saṃrakṣāṃ kuru śaṃbho! sadā'bhitaḥ ।।37।।
mama kṣetrapraveśe ca saṃsāro vai nivartate ।
yathā vaikuṇṭhanagarī vallabhā mathurā mama ।।38।।
viṃśatiryojanānāṃ hi māthuraṃ mama maṇḍalam ।
pade pade'śvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ madyogato bhavet ।।39।।
atra tiṣṭhanti tīrthāni svargamokṣapradāni vai ।
ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca ।।1.349.40 ।।
iti śrutvā varaṃ prāpya śaṃbhustatraiva saṃsthitaḥ ।
kṣetrapālasvarūpo me bhaktarāḍ vaiṣṇavaḥ paraḥ ।।41 ।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! māhātmyaṃ mokṣadaṃ param ।
ye paṭhanti ca śṛṇvanti te yānti paramaṃ padam ।। 42।।
kulānyapi tārayanti dve śate viṃśayordvayoḥ ।
prāpte ca maraṇe tīrthaṃ smared yo māthuraṃ janaḥ ।।43 ।।
sa gacchet paramāṃ siddhimiha saṃsāranāśinīm ।
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ māthuraṃ paramaṃ mahat ।।44।।
kṛṣṇena krīḍitaṃ tīrthaṃ tacchuddhaṃ hi pade pade ।
dakṣiṇottaravasudhāmaṇḍalaṃ māthuraṃ sadā ।।।45।।।
gṛhānniḥsṛtya maunena yāvatsnānaṃ hi vartayet ।
prapūjānantaraṃ brūyād dhenūrdadyātpayasvinīḥ ।।46 ।।
hiraṇyaṃ ca vasuṃ dadyād bhojayed bhūsurāna sataḥ ।
cāturmāsye mathurāyāṃ vased dādāni vartayet ।।47।।
na tasya punarāvṛttirmama loke mahīyate ।
māthure tu mṛtā lakṣmi! mama lokaṃ vrajanti vai ।।48।।
anyatra ca mṛtānāṃ vai dāhe māthuramaṇḍale ।
kṛte svargaṃ tathā vāso mama golokadhāmani ।।49।।
māthurāṇāṃ tu yadrarūpaṃ tadrūpaṃ me caturbhujam ।
māthureṇa tu tṛptena tṛpto'haṃ vārdhije! sadā ।।1.349.5 0 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yathāvṛttaṃ garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ ।
āgatasya mathurāyāṃ kṛṣgadarśanakāṃkṣayā ।।5 1 ।।
kṛṣṇasyā'gre garuḍaḥ sa stutiṃ cakre nanāma ca ।
jaya lakṣmīpate! kṛṣṇa! jayasva māṇikīpate! ।।52 ।।
prabhāpate! jaya rādhāpate! śrīpārvatīpate! ।
jaya viṣṇo! jaya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa! ramāpate! ।।53 ।।
jaya gopīpate! kṛṣṇa! garuḍādhipate! jaya ।
jaya sarvapate! brahma jaya kṛṣṇa! namo'stu te ।।54।।
ityevaṃ saṃstuto devo garuḍena mahātmanā ।
garuḍasya puraḥ kṛṣṇa sthito'bhūt suśarīravān ।।55।।
uvāca pakṣirāṭ kiṃ te cikīrṣitaṃ tathā''gamaḥ ।
vada śīghraṃ pradāsye'haṃ śrutvā''ha garuḍastadā ।।56 ।।
mathurāmāgataścā'haṃ tava darśanakāṃkṣayā ।
na dṛṣṭaṃ tava rūpaṃ ca māṃ tu mohaḥ samāviśat। ।।57।।
mathurāyāṃ bhavāna lokaiḥ samaṃ dhṛtvā svarūpakam ।
vartate na mayā jñātastato māṃ mohamāviśat ।।58।।।
idānīṃ divyarūpaṃ te dṛṣṭvā śāntirabhūttu me ।
garuḍasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasyovāca mādhavaḥ ।।59 ।।
māthurāṇāṃ svarūpeṇa vartāmyahaṃ dvijottama ।
ye pāpaste na paśyanti madrūprān māthurān janān ।।1.349.6 0।।
ahaṃ vasāmi tatraiva vicarāmi kvacit pṛthak ।
evamuktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇastatraivāntaradhīyata ।।6 1 ।।
garuḍo'pi gataḥ kṛṣṇapade vaikuṇṭhameva ha ।
māthurā mathurāyāṃ vai sthitvā devatvamāgatāḥ ।।6 2।।।
pavitrayanti sarvāṃste yathā kṛṣṇasya pārṣadāḥ ।
api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā tiryagyonisthito'pi vā ।।6 3 ।।
caturbhujā bhavantyeva śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpataḥ ।
atha lakṣmi! śṛṇu tvanyat camatkāraṃ tu māthuram ।।64।।
saurāṣṭrasya raivatādrervāstavyo brāhmaṇo hariḥ ।
patnīvratābhidhānaḥ svakuṭumbena purā yuge ।।65।।
yamunāyāstu yātrārthaṃ gato māthuramaṇḍalam ।
viśrāntau sa yamunāyāṃ snātaścakre pradakṣiṇam ।।66 ।।
mathurāyāstathā govardhanasyā'nyavanasya ca ।
vṛndāvanasya tulasīvanasyāpi pradakṣiṇam ।।67।।
bhojayitvā bahūn viprān nītvā tīrthajalāni ca ।
nyavartata svakaṃ deśaṃ marudeśaḥ samāgataḥ ।।68।।
tatrā'raṇye śamīprāye śuṣke śṛṃgamaye sthale ।
dadarśa ḍākinīśākinīnāṃ sārthaṃ śatottaram ।।69।।
nṛtyantaṃ bhakṣaya khādayeti brūvantamuddhatam ।
vīrūpaṃ ca vivastraṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।।1.349.70।।
kṛtyāsārthaṃ vilokyaiva patnīvratastu tatkṣaṇam ।
cakre sasmāra kṛṣṇasya drāgevopasthitaṃ jvalat ।।71 ।।
pretasvarūpikāstāstaccakraṃ dadāha bāhyataḥ ।
rurudustāścukruśuśca prārthayāṃcakruratyati ।।72।।
trāhi brahman! na bhakṣyāmo mariṣyāmo'tra rakṣa naḥ ।
vayaṃ marunṛpatervai patnyo'bhavan śatottaram ।।73 ।।
madyamāṃsāśanāḥ pāpakāriṇyo dharmavarjitāḥ ।
mahāmārīmahāroge rājā tu nidhanaṃ gataḥ ।।74।।
rājyaṃ hṛtaṃ tripureṇa bhraṣṭāstena kṛtā vayam ।
bhūkampe bhavane bhagne sarvāstatrā'rditā mṛtāḥ ।।75।।
ḍākinīśākinībhautiyoniṃ gatāḥ sma bhūsura! ।
mokṣaṃ kuru tadasmākaṃ tīrthajalena keśava! ।।76 ।।
śratvā patnīvrataḥ so'yaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo brāhmaṇo jalam ।
yamunāyāḥ kare dhṛtvā prokṣayāmāsa tāstadā ।।77।।
pretarūpāṇi santyajya divyāścaturbhujāstu tāḥ ।
ramārūpāstadā jātā natvā tuṣṭuvurādarāt ।।78।।
kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ tvamevā'si hyuddhṛtā duḥkhasāgarāt। ।
naya dhāma svakaṃ kṛṣṇetyukte vimānamāgatam ।।79।।
vipraḥ kṛṣṇasvarūpaḥ sa golokaṃ tāṃ nināya vai ।
punaḥ kuṭumbasahitaḥ svadeśaṃ raivataṃ yayau ।।1.349.8 0।।
iti viśrāntitīrthasya yamunāsalilasya ca ।
pretoddhārakaraṃ divyaṃ māhātmyaṃ te prakīrtitam ।।8 1 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścā'haṃ yamunājalasaṃgataḥ ।
yatra tatra tadā svargaṃ golokaṃ mokṣa eva ca ।।82।।
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāccāpi vācayecchrāvayettathā ।
teṣāṃ lakṣmi! bhavet svargaṃ goloke muktireva ca ।।।।83।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurākṣetramāhātmye ujayinīpurīvāsibhraṣṭācāraviprasya rākṣasatvamupagatasya viśrāntisnānaphaladānānmuktiḥ, śaṃbhukṛtakṣetrasarakṣaṇaṃ, garuḍasya māthurarūpakṛṣṇā'paricaye stavanena divyadarśanaṃ,
patnīvrataviprātmakakṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṛto viśrāntijalaprokṣaṇena ḍākinīśākinīśatottaramokṣaścetyādi- nirūpaṇanāmaikonapañcāśadadhikatriśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 349 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 349 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 350
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 351 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
gokarṇeśvaramāhātmyaṃ mathurāyāṃ yamītaṭe ।
kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi! putrasvargapramokṣadam ।। 1 ।।
āsīd vipraḥ subhadrākhyaḥ pāribhadrasya putrakaḥ ।
vaiśyavṛttisamāyuktaḥ krayavikrayajīvanaḥ ।। 2 ।।
saurāṣṭre viṣaye śatrujitānadītaṭe vasan ।
kṛṣiṃ cāpi karotyatra gavādīn pālayatyapi ।। 3 ।।
tasya bhāryā sadguṇāḍhyā jīvantī nāmataḥ smṛtā ।
bhartuḥ priyakarī sādhvī na prasūtā vayo'dhikā ।। 4 ।।
śokaṃ karoti nityaṃ sā striyo dṛṣṭvā prajāvatīḥ ।
sā yātā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ pitṛgṛhaṃ samutsave ।। 5 ।।
nāmnā kraturmahāyogī viprastasyāḥ pitā'pi tām ।
saśokāṃ paridṛṣṭvaiva papraccha śokakāraṇam ।। 6 ।।
sāpi prāha pitaraṃ cā'napatyatvaṃ tu kāraṇam ।
kratvarṣiśca kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā prāha jīvantikāṃ sutām ।। 7 ।।
āgaccha putri! kṛṣṇāgre kurvastadvinivedanam ।
ghnanti niścitya tau patnīvratakṛṣṇasya mandiram ।। 8 ।।
gatau natvā ca taṃ devaṃ cā'nivedayatāṃ vṛtam ।
asyā nāsti kṛṣṇamune! durbhagāyāḥ prajāsukham ।। 9 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā prāha tāṃ putragarddhinīm ।
kambharāyā mahālakṣmyāḥ prasādena suputrakaḥ ।। 1.350.10 ।।
bhaviṣyatyeva te nūnaṃ kuru yātrāṃ suputradām ।
mathurāyāṃ yamunāyāstīre gokarṇavakeśvaram ।। 11 ।।
tīrthaṃ ramyaṃ putralābhaphalaṃ bhavati suvrate! ।
tamārādhaya śīghraṃ vai saha patyā'bhigamya ca ।। 12।।
snānadīpopahāreṇa stotrairnānāvidhaistathā ।
prasādayā'nutiṣṭhaitajjīvanti! sasutā bhava ।। 13 ।।
ityuktā sā yadā yātā gṛhaṃ natvā patiṃ tadā ।
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa yaduktaṃ hariṇā tu tat ।। 14।।
sa tadvacanamākarṇya suprītaḥ prāha tāṃ priyām ।
mamā'pyetanmataṃ patni! yaduktaṃ hariṇā tataḥ ।। 15।।
gatau vyomnā suyānena mathurāṃ daśamīdine ।
caitre sāyaṃ yamunāyāṃ snātvā natvā ca śaṃkaram ।। 16।।
gokarṇeśvaramevaitau nidrāṃ jagrahaturbhuvi ।
prātarutthāya ca snānaṃ pūjāṃ cakraturādarāt ।। 17।।
tataḥ prasanno bhagavānumāpatiruvāca tau ।
bhaviṣyati yuvāṃ putro guṇarūpadhanānvitaḥ ।। 18।।
ityuktau tau tu devena snānaṃ kṛtvā sarasvatīm ।
yamīṃ natvā saṃgame ca kṣaṇe sthitvā dvijātaye ।। 1 9।।
dravyaṃ bhojyaṃ dadatuśca vastrādyaṃ bahudakṣiṇam ।
ekādaśyāṃ māthure maṇḍale yātrāṃ vidhāya ca ।।1.350.2 0 ।।
vaihāyasā suyānenā''jagmatustau nijagṛham ।
vipraḥ patnyāṃ tu jīvantyāṃ garbhādhānamavindata ।।21 ।।
suṣuve daśame māsi sā putraṃ candramaḥprabham ।
gosahasraṃ tadā datvā sasuvarṇaṃ suvastrakam ।।22।।
bahuśaḥ sarvavarṇebhyaḥ putrajanmamahotsave ।
jātakarma tathā śrāddhaṃ nāmakarma cakāra saḥ ।।23 ।।
gokarṇeśvaradatto'yaṃ gokarṇo nāmato'stu vai ।
sa tu ṣoḍaśasaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtastaruṇo'bhavat ।।24।।
ta sa vivāhayāmāsa bhāryāṇāṃ tu catuṣṭayam ।
aprajā eva tāḥ sarvā ekāpi nahi putriṇī ।।25।।
ato dharmaḥ samārabdho bhāryāyu×Vr̤M×tena tena vai ।
vāpikūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca ।।26।।।
prapāmālāśca satrānnaṃ devasevā''rttisevanam ।
śatrujitātaṭe tatra gokarṇeśvaraśaṃkaram ।।27।।।
gokṣurapattanāt pūrvaṃ sthāpayāmāsa yāmunam ।
prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa paṃcāyatanakaṃ hareḥ ।।28।।
ārāmastatra vistīrṇaḥ puṣpajātyastathaiva ca ।
phalajātyastathā śākapatrakandaprajātikaḥ ।। 29।।।
prākāraṃ kārayāmāsa parikhāmaṇḍalīyakam ।
ghaṭīyantrāṇi kūpeṣu yaiḥ prasiñcettu vāṭikāḥ ।।1.350.3 0।।
puṣpāṇi ca vicinvanti sarvāstasya suyoṣitaḥ ।
snānaṃ pūjādikaṃ bhūmimārjanaṃ dīpakarma ca ।।3 1 ।।
kurvanti devatāgāre tasya patnyastu sarvadā ।
mālākāraḥ svayaṃ nityaṃ viṭapān saṃprasiñcati ।।32।।
jātāḥ supuṣpavantaśca drumāḥ phalasamṛddhayaḥ ।
dīyate bhujyate sarvaiḥ phalādyaṃ nityamutsavāt ।।33।।
pūjyate śaṃkarastena sarvadā bhāvapūrvakam ।
vyāpāraṃ saḥ kṛṣiṃ cāpi karoti kārayatyapi ।।34।।
ekadā manasā kṛtvā vaṇigbhāvaṃ hṛdi sthiram ।
kṛtvā sārthamupāgamya yayau paścimamaṇḍalam ।।।35।।
tatra krītvā supaṇyāni vāmanasthalapattanāt ।
maṇiratnānyaśvaratnāni krītvā raivatācale ।।36।।
svarṇarekhānadītīre cakre nivāsamuttamam ।
tatra niveśya bhāṇḍāni śailaṃ samāruroha saḥ ।।37।।
bahudevādhivasatiṃ siddhagandharvasevitam ।
divyapuṣpaphalopetaṃ bahukandaraśobhitam ।।38।।
tato madhye bhuvyupatyakāyāṃ śṛṇoti gahvare ।
svāgataṃ tatra gatvā'sau śukaṃ paśyati pañjare ।।39।।
tenoktaṃ bho ihā''gaccha svātithyaṃ karavāṇi te ।
phalānīmāni svādūni śītamiṣṭajalāni ca ।।1.350.40।।
gṛhṇantu bho mahābhāgāḥ sārthaviprāḥ śubhaṃ bhavet ।
atitherāgatasyeha pūjāyā vimukho bhavet ।।41 ।।
tadgṛhasthasya pitaro vasanti narake dhruvam ।
pūjite pūjitāḥ svarge modante kālamakṣayam ।।42।।
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhānnivartate yadi ।
ātmano duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai datvā tatsukṛtaṃ haret ।।43 ।।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjyo vai gṛhamedhinā ।
kāle prāptastvakāle vā yathā kṛṣṇastathaiva saḥ ।।44।।
evaṃvidhāḥ śubhā vācaḥ śrutvā gokarṇako'bravīt ।
ṛṣiḥ kastvaṃ sudharmajñaḥ kiṃ vā devo'tha guhyakaḥ ।।45।।
siddho vā raivatavāsī mānavo vad ko'tra bhoḥ ।
tava prasannarūpasya yasyeyaṃ vāgamānuṣī ।।46।।
ityuktaḥ sa śukaḥ sarvaṃ śaśaṃsātmapurākṛtam ।
ahamāsaṃ vāmadevaśiṣyo nāmnā śukodaraḥ ।।47।।
gurorvākyaṃ buddhiyuktaṃ śrutvā'pyahaṃ tadagrataḥ ।
ūhā'pohakaraṃ praśnaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ tu pṛṣṭavān ।।48।।
tena muhurniṣiddho'pi na kṛtaṃ tadvaco mayā ।
tadā tenātikopād vai śāpitastvaṃ śuko bhava ।।49।।
śukatvaṃ tatkṣaṇātprāpto vasāmyatra hi raivate ।
jātismaro bhavāmyatra karomi bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।1.350.50।।
prāptastvatra gṛhāvāsimuninā brahmasūriṇā ।
pañjare rakṣitastena jīvāmi sukhato gṛhe ।।51 ।।
vāmadevo'tidīnaṃ māmuvāca kṛpayā'rthitaḥ ।
mathurāyāṃ mṛteḥ paścād brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ।।52।।
tasmānnityaṃ tu mathurāmathureti vadāmi ca ।
śukasya vacanaṃ śrutvā gokarṇaḥ prāha pakṣiṇam ।।53।।
raivatādrisamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ caitanmokṣagolokadhāmadam ।।54।।
etatsthānaṃ parityajya kathaṃ māthuramaṇḍalam ।
muktyarthaṃ te kṛtaṃ pakṣin! cejjānāsi vadātra me ।।55।।
śrutvā śukastu taṃ prāha rekhā me tādṛśī yataḥ ।
tatraiva maraṇānmuktirnātra me mṛtinirṇayaḥ ।।56 ।।
tasmād vipra! tvayā kāryā mamopakṛtireva sā ।
naya māṃ mathurāṃ śreṣṭhin! yadi kvaciddhi gacchasi ।।57।।
evaṃ tayoḥ kathayatorbrahmasūriḥ samitkaraḥ ।
samāyāto vanāttatra so'pyatithīn vilokya ca ।।58।।
prasannastvabhavat kṛtvā phalādyairātitheyakam ।
kaḥ kutaḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vada kiṃ karavāṇi te ।।59।।
ityuktaḥ sa tu gokarṇo natvā munimayācata ।
śuko'yaṃ pañjarasthastu putrārthaṃ me pradīyatām ।।1.350.60 ।।
mathurāyāṃ gamiṣyāmi tasya mokṣārthameva yat ।
ṛṣiṇā tu prasannena śukastasmai samarpitaḥ ।।61 ।।
natvā ṛṣiṃ sa gokarṇo yayau gokṣurapattanam ।
sarvaratnasamupetaḥ sarvasārthasamanvitaḥ ।।62।
śukaḥ śatruṃjitānadyāstaṭe viprasya vāṭikām ।
phalapuṣpādisaṃyuktāṃ dṛṣṭvā sthātuṃ mano'karot ।।63।।
gokarṇenāpi vāṭyāṃ sa phalapuṣpādibhojanaḥ ।
rakṣitastvekadā patnīścatasraḥ prāha mātaraḥ ।।64।।
kathaṃ putrā na dṛśyante putryaścāpi na vo'tra kim? ।
jalasecanakartryastā ūcustaṃ kovidaṃ śukam ।।65।।
pakṣin! vandhyāścatasraḥ smo vada syustu sutā yathā ।
śukaḥ prāha kathayiṣye yāvatā tiṣṭhatā mayā ।।66।।
evaṃ kāle gate varṣe punarvyāpāravāñchayā ।
gokarṇaḥ saśuko yātaḥ kacchaṃ prati mudānvitaḥ ।।67।।
patnyaścāpi yayuḥ kacchaṃ svāminā sahasevikāḥ ।
nāvā samudramuttīrya nārāyaṇasaro yayuḥ ।।68।।
tatra dṛṣṭā divyadevyo rūpānurūpabhāsurāḥ ।
sahasraśaḥ saromadhye jalavāsā'tisaurabhāḥ ।।6 9।।
kintu śokaparimlānāḥ papracchustāḥ śukaṃ prati ।
kutastvāgamyate kiṃ te kāryaṃ sad vidyate vad ।।1.350.70।।
śukaḥ prāha mama svāmī ratnārthaṃ samupāgataḥ ।
bhavatīnāṃ bhavet kāryaṃ jñāpayantu hi māṃ tadā ।।71 ।।
śrutvā tāśca tadā prāhuḥ śukaṃ paramakovidam ।
duḥkhaṃ tasya samākhyeyaṃ yo vināśayate rujam ।।72।।
āste kuṃkumavāpīti nṛṇāṃ muktipradāyinī ।
aśvapaṭṭasaro yatra rājate surasevitam ।।73।।
gaurjarādhipatirvīraścaturaṃgabalānvitaḥ ।
rājā dharmavīranāmā kārtike raivatasya saḥ ।।74।।
pradakṣiṇādiyātrārthaṃ yayau gacchan śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
mārge kuṃkumavāpyāśca cakre yātrāṃ sarovare ।।75।।
sasnau sa śrāddhakāryāṇi cakāra brahmabhojanam ।
cakre suvarṇaratnaiḥ kaṃbharāgopālapūjanam ।।76।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇordarśanaṃ havanaṃ tathā ।
mandirasya mahodyāne saptabhūmyatiśobhinaḥ ।।77।।
ārāmavāṭikāḥ śubhrā nimnaprākāraveṣṭitāḥ ।
kūpaghaṭyāvartayuktāḥ puṣpajātisuvāsitāḥ ।।78।।
phalavanto drumāstatra sarvartusumanoharāḥ ।
tadabhyāśe sa rājarṣiścakārāvāsamuttamam ।।79।।
sevakairnāśitaḥ sarvaṃ ārāmaḥ saphaladrumaḥ ।
vayaṃ sarvāstu tā vṛkṣavallyaḥ smo devadevatāḥ ।।1.350.80 ।।
ityuktvā ruruduḥ svārttijalpiṇyo hā'tikṛcchrataḥ ।
sarvāsāṃ rudatīnāṃ tu kurarīṇāmiva svanāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
śrūyante duḥkhadāḥ tāśca sāntvayāmāsa vai śukaḥ ।
tāstu prāha punastatra ratnānyādāya sarvathā ।।82।।
gamiṣyati mama svāmī kariṣyati sajīvanāḥ ।।
ityuktamātre vacane tāḥ sarvā labdhacetanāḥ ।।83 ।।
śukasya svāminaṃ tadvai vaktuṃ taṃ vedituṃ tathā ।
aikyabhāvena tāḥ sarvāḥ papracchurvaṇijaṃ prati ।।84।।
asmākaṃ jīvadātā tvaṃ kaḥ kutastviha saṃgataḥ ।
gokarṇaḥ prāha tā devīḥ bhavatyaścārulocanāḥ ।।85।।
sucārvāsyāḥ sucārvaṃgyaḥ kathaṃ śokapariplutāḥ ।
tadā jyeṣṭhā tamāhātha puṣpajātyā svalaṃkṛtā ।।86 ।।
vayamārāmasaṃsthānāḥ khādyasalilabhojanāḥ ।
hṛdyāśca svāminā guptāḥ puṣpavṛddhiratāḥ sadā ।।87।।
rājalokaiḥ pīḍitāḥ sma chedanonmūlanādibhiḥ ।।
kūrcitā bhṛśamudvignāstena śokapariplutāḥ ।।88 ।।
phalapuṣpavihīnāśca mūlāskandhāvaśeṣitāḥ ।
evaṃvidhā hi saṃbhūtā naṣṭasaṃjñāḥ sthitā vayam ।।89।।
aśvapaṭṭasaro divyaṃ sākṣi tatrāsti bhūsuraḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devaḥ sākṣī tvasmākamityapi ।।1.350.90 ।।
puṇyaṃ salilapūrṇaṃ cotphullakamalaśobhitam ।
kalahaṃsasamāyuktaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ parisecakam ।।91 ।।
sarastat taddrumāṇāṃ tu vināśānno vināśitā ।
virūpatā'sti tatra tvaṃ gatvā no jīvitān kuru ।।92।।
iṣṭāpūrttaṃ dvijātīnāṃ prathamaṃ dharmasādhanam ।
iṣṭena labhate svargaṃ pūrtena mokṣameti ca ।।93 ।।
vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca ।
patitānyuddhared yastu sa pūrtaphalamaśnute ।।94।।
bhūmidānena ye lokā godānena ca kīrtitāḥ ।
te lokāḥ samavāpyante pādapānāṃ prarohaṇe ।।95।।
pippalaṃ ca vaṭaṃ nimbaṃ tulasīṃ cāpyudumbaram ।
āmalakaṃ tathā bilvaṃ khadiraṃ caikameva yaḥ ।।96 ।।
puṣpajātīrdaśa dve dve dāḍime cāmrapañcakam ।
tintiḍīmekalāṃ vātra yastu vardhayati dvija! ।।97।।
puṣpaphaladrumaropī na yāti narakaṃ kvacit ।
vardhitāśca drumāḥ putrā ivoddharanti poṣakam ।।98 ।।
indhanaiśchāyayā śrāntyā pathikānāṃ sukhāvahāḥ ।
pakṣiṇāṃ nilayenaiva sukhadā vṛkṣavallikāḥ ।।99।।
patramūlatvagādyairauṣadhaiḥ sukhāstu dehinām ।
kāṣṭhairgṛhāṇi jāyante kṣudrajantugṛhāṇi ca ।। 1.350.1 00।।
evaṃ paropakārāste sevante dehinaḥ sadā ।
phalapatradalaśākhāstambamūlairhi jīvadāḥ ।। 101 ।।
svargadā mokṣadāścāpi devapūjopayojitāḥ ।
tasmād gokarṇaratnāni gṛhāṇeṣṭāni naḥ sthalāt ।। 10 2।।
vaihāyasaṃ vimānaṃ ca samāruhya tathā ca naḥ ।
saha nītvā yāhi tatra yatrodyānaṃ tu naḥ sthitam ।। 103 ।।
asmākaṃ jīvadānena syuḥ putriṇyastu te priyāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti susantānāḥ śuka nītvā prayāhi vai ।। 104 ।।
bayaṃ gopāśca gopyaśca golokasthā api kṣitau ।
kṛṣṇasevāṃ prakurmo'tra vṛkṣavalītṛṇātmikāḥ ।। 1 05।।
vayaṃ dāsyaḥ pārṣadāśca vaikuṇṭhasthā api kṣitau ।
kurmo nārāyaṇasevāṃ kuṃkumavāpikāsthitāḥ ।। 106 ।।
pārṣadānyaḥ pārṣadāśca muktāḥ sāketadhāmagāḥ ।
sāketāyāṃ vṛkṣavallyaḥ smaḥ śrīrāmārcane ratāḥ । । 10 7। ।
vayaṃ dūtāśca dūtyaśca kailāsasthā api kṣitau ।
kāśīkṣetrādisaṃsthānā vallīvṛkṣasvarūpikāḥ ।। 108 । ।
iti hārdaṃ kathitaṃ te'smākaṃ viprā'tra bhautikam ।
śrīkṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛṣṇadāsadāsīmayaṃ smṛtam ।। 10 1।।
ityuktaḥ sa tu gokarṇo ratnānyādāya koṭiśaḥ ।
devīḥ sarvāstathā patnīḥ śuka cādāya saṃyayau । । 1.350.110 ।।
udyānaṃ kṛtavān puṣṭaṃ bījaiḥ khādyairjalādibhiḥ ।
vṛkṣā vallyaśca devyaśca puṣṭā jātā hi sevayā ।। 111 ।।
dhanaṃ ratnādikaṃ tatra sevāyāṃ yojitaṃ bahu ।
mandiraṃ poṣitaṃ cāpi vṛkṣāścāpi prapoṣitāḥ ।। 112 ।।
tena puṇyena ca tasya patnyo garbhadharā api ।
tāśca devyo divyarūpāḥ praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ । । 113 ।।
varaṃ datvā yathākāmaṃ svastītyuktvā tiro'bhavan ।
tatra sthitvā yathānyāyaṃ gokarṇaḥ sarvamaṃgalam ।। 11 4।।
śukaṃ ca mātāpitarau sādhvībhāryācatuṣṭayam ।
samānaṃ sevayāmāsa yathāvibhavaśaktitaḥ ।। 115 ।।
svayaṃ tu kṛtavāṃstatra vaiṣṇavākhyaṃ mahāmakham ।
bhakṣyabhojye brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dānāni nityaśaḥ ।। 116 ।।
kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kṛṣṇasyā''layaṃ jīrṇaṃ navottamam ।
kārayitvā tu tadvāpīṃ navīnāmiva vai punaḥ ।। 117।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi tvābadhya setunā punaḥ ।
taṭe pratiṣṭhāṃ svanāmnā gokarṇeśvarasaṃjñayā ।। 118 ।।
mahādevasya nirvartya brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ ।
yayau gokṣurasaṃjñaṃ vai pattanaṃ svanivāsakam । । 119 ।।
ya idṃ śṛṇuyāccāpi paṭhedvā bhāvatastathā ।
tīrthayātrāṃ prakuryācca putravān dhanavān bhavet ।। 1.350.120 ।।
iti lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
māthurakṣetramāhātmye saurāṣṭradeśīyasubhadranāmakaviprasya mathurāyāṃ gokarṇeśvaradarśanādinā putraprāptiḥ, tannāma gokarṇaṃ iti, tena śatrujitānadītaṭe gokarṇeśvaraḥ sthāpitaḥ, gokarṇasya dhanārthaṃ vāmanapananaṃ gatasya raivatācale śukaprāptiḥ, punargṛhamāgatya dhanārthaṃ kacchaṃ gatasya nārāyaṇasarasi vanadevatānāṃ darśanaṃ,
gaurjararājñā bhagnasyodyānasya kuṃkumavāpyāṃ navīkaraṇam, tīrthasthā vṛkṣavallikā dhāmapārṣadapārṣadānya evetimahimakathanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 350 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 350 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 351
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 352 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tatra pure gokṣure brāhmaṇaṃ śukaḥ ।
provāca yamunāyātrākaraṇārthaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 1 ।।
svasya vai nidhanaṃ yamyāṃ smārayāmāsa vai śukaḥ ।
naya māṃ māthurīṃ bhūmiṃ kuru yātrāṃ priyā''tmajaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
janmanastava sāphalyaṃ kuru gokarṇa sarvathā ।
gokarṇeśvaradevasya tvaddāturdarśanaṃ kuru ।। 3 ।।
śrutvā śukavaco vipro gokarṇaḥ sakuṭumbakaḥ ।
vaihāyasena yānena yayau māthuramaṇḍalam ।। 4 ।।
viśrāntitīrthake snātvā gokarṇeśvaradarśanam ।
kṛtvā ca prakramaṃ bhaktyā mathurāmaṇḍalasya saḥ ।। ।5 ।।
mathurāyāṃ cakārā''śu viṣṇuyāgaṃ sudakṣiṇam ।
vinirvṛtte kratau śukodo mṛtyuṃ yayau śukaḥ ।। 6 ।।
vimānavaramāsādya devo bhūtvā divaṃ gataḥ ।
śukaṃ hṛdi samāśliṣya praruroha sa vai vaṇik ।। 7 ।।
yatra śuko mṛtastatra gokarṇena mahātmanā ।
śukanāmnā kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ śivasyāyatanaṃ mahat ।। 8 ।।
śukeśvaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya divyaṃ satraṃ cakāra saḥ ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ śate dve ca miṣṭānnavarabhojanam ।। 9 ।।
prāpnutaḥ pratimadhyāhnaṃ khyātaṃ tacchukasatrakam ।
satrasya paritastatra phalapuṣpapradaṃ varam ।। 1.351.10 ।।
mathurāvāsibhirlokairudyānaṃ so'pyakārayat ।
yatra tā divyarūpā vai devyo vallīsvarūpikāḥ ।। 11 ।।
samāgatyā'vasaँstatra gokarṇena vilokitāḥ ।
tāsāṃ jalaghaṭīyantraṃ jalāpānārthamāvyadhāt ।। 12।।
gokarṇaśca sarasvatyāḥ saṃgame saṃvidhāya tu ।
snānaṃ prapūjanaṃ cāpi sadārasutabhṛtyakaḥ ।। 13 ।।
vimānavaramāruhya samāyāti gṛhaṃ prati ।
madhye vai puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ kartuṃ vipro mano dadhe ।। 14।।
puṣkarāraṇyamāsādya vimānaṃ tvavatārayat ।
susthalyāṃ puṣkarasaro'ntike vṛkṣaghaṭāsu vai ।। 15।।
nyaṣīdattu kṣaṇaṃ yāvat sadārasutabhṛtyakaḥ ।
gokarṇastatra cā'paśyat pañca pretānsubhīṣaṇān ।। 16 ।।
tāndṛṣṭvā vikṛtākārān trāsamutsṛjya dūrataḥ ।
papraccha dhairyamālambya ke yūyaṃ raudramūrtayaḥ ।। 17।।
pretā ūcuḥ kṣutpipāsāturā nityaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ ।
na jānīmo diśaṃ cāpi vidiśaṃ ca divāniśam ।। 18।।
yadetadduḥkhamāpannaṃ duṣkṛtairnijakarmabhiḥ ।
ahaṃ paryuṣito nāma paraḥ sūcīmukho hyayam ।। 1 9।।
śīghramastu tṛtīyo'sti caturtho rodhako'sti ca ।
pañcamo lekhakaśceti karmanāmnā vayaṃ tathā ।। 1.351.20 ।।
ahaṃ svādu sadā'śnāmi dadmi paryuṣitaṃ dvije ।
tena doṣeṇa sañjāto nāmnā paryuṣitaḥ svayam ।।2 1 ।।
sūcitā bahavo'nena bhikṣukāstvannakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ।
etena karmaṇā cāyaṃ sūcīmukho vyajāyata ।।22 ।।
dānamadhye hyayaṃ śīghraṃ nirodhārthaṃ prayāti ca ।
etena karmaṇā nāmnā śīghragastvabhavat paraḥ ।।23 ।।
bahūn pratārya caikākī dvāre pidhāya vai tataḥ ।
bhuṃkte'yaṃ bhikṣukabhayād rodhakastena cetaraḥ ।। 24 ।।
bhitukairyogyakāle'yaṃ yācito'pyalikhan mahīm ।
na dadāti kvacit kiñcit karmaṇā tena lekhakaḥ ।।25 ।।
paśya vipra gatiṃ no'tra kṛtena pāpakarmaṇā ।
madena lekhako yāti rodhakastu hyavākchirāḥ ।।26 ।।
paṅguḥ san śīghrago yāti sūcīvanmukhavān paraḥ ।
bṛhadvṛṣaṇalamboṣṭhaḥ paryuṣito mahodaraḥ ।।27।।
evaṃ vayaṃ mahāduḥkhā duṣṭabhraṣṭaprabhojinaḥ ।।
yacchutvā nindase vipra! śrotavyā'rhaṃ na vai tu tat ।।28।।
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi bālānāṃ yoṣitāṃ gṛhe ।
kṣetre tyaktānyaśaucāni pretā bhuñjanti tāni vai ।। 29।।
devārpaṇavihīnāni malamūtrabhṛtāni ca ।
aśuddhau randhitānyeva pretā bhuñjanti tāni vai ।। 1.351.30 ।।
kṣiptāni nālikāyāṃ tu bhraṣṭapātrasthitāni ca ।
rājasvalyādiduṣṭāni pretā bhuñjanti tāni hi ।।3 1 ।।
atithyarpaṇahīnāni kalahotpādakāni ca ।
ninditāni tathā'nnāni pretā bhuñjanti sarvadā ।।3 2।।
duṣkarmā'nnaṃ sūtakānnaṃ kledyānnaṃ no'bhitiṣṭhati ।
tathāpi kṣunna hi pretaṃ tyajatyapi kadācana ।।3 3 ।।
jalamaśuddhisaṃspṛṣṭamupayāti ca no'lpakam ।
nānyatra jalapānaṃ syādvāruṇabhṛtyapālite ।।34।।
bhraṣṭānnena tu bhuktena mānavo mriyate yadi ।
tenaiva codarasthena sa preto jāyate dvija! ।।।35।।।
manuṣyādiśiraḥkapālikāyāṃ bhuṃjate tu ye ।
te mṛtāḥ pretatāṃ yānti paśubhiḥ sahabhojinaḥ ।।36।।
madyamāṃsāśano duṣṭavāsanādyatimohitaḥ ।
devavipragurudravyahartā preto'bhijāyate ।।37।।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhrātṝn bhaginīśca striyaṃ sutam ।
aduṣṭān yastyajetpāpaḥ preto bhavati vai dhruvam ।।38।।
duṣṭakarmakṛtāṃ saṃgo pāpātpreto'bhijāyate ।
brahmahā ca kṛtaghnaśca bālaghno goghna ityapi ।।39।।
bhūmikanyādhanahartā gurordveṣṭā ca nāstikaḥ ।
sa pāpo jāyate preta stvāhārādivivarjitaḥ ।।1.351.40।।
tasmāt puṇyaṃ prakartavyaṃ na dveṣṭavyaṃ kadācana ।
paropakārakārī vai preto naiva prajāyate ।।41 ।।
sukhiteṣu sadā maitrīṃ duḥkhiteṣu dayāṃ śubhām ।
puṇyavatsu muditāṃ ca kurvan preto na jāyate ।।42।।।
apuṇyaśāliṣu yo na sajjate vai kadācana ।
upekṣāṃ kurute teṣu na sa preto'bhijāyate ।।43।।।
vrataṃ karoti devānāṃ tathā cāndrāyaṇādikam ।
rāgaśūnyaḥ svacchabuddhirna sa preto'bhijāyate ।।44।।
annajalapradātā yaḥ śraddhayā dharmakāryakṛt ।
sādhudevayatipūjākartā preto na jāyate ।।45।।
paropakārakartā ca parapoṣaṇatatparaḥ ।
sarvabhūtadayāluśca na preto jāyate kvacit ।।46।।
pitṛsurā'tithipūjyapūjāyāḥ kārakastu yaḥ ।
parātmatoṣako vipra! na preto jāyate kvacit ।।47।।
kāmakrodhamahālobhamohatṛṣṇāvivarjitaḥ ।
kṣamādānadayāśīlo na pretaḥ saṃbhavet kvacit। ।।48 ।।
jayantīnāṃ vratakartā kathānāṃ vācakaḥ sadā ।
gobhūviprasatīsādhutīrthamantā sudharmavān ।।49।।
snānasandhyājapahomakartā preto na jāyate ।
mātṛsevāṃ pitṛsevāṃ guroḥ sevāṃ karoti yaḥ ।।1.351.50 ।।
gavāṃ sevā patisevā patnīsaukhyaṃ karoti yaḥ ।
dīnā'nāthādisevākṛnna preto jāyate kvacit ।।51
śuddhyannaṃ śuddhikṛddravyaṃ yaḥ svārthaṃ sayunakti vai ।
sarvāśīrvādasaṃgrāhī na preto jāyate kvacit ।।52।।
pretānāṃ cābhijātānāṃ gatiṃ jānāsi ced vad ।
asmākaṃ kuru coddhāraṃ cet samuddhartumarhasi ।।53 ।।
iti pretavacaḥ śrutvā gokarṇaḥ prāha tāँstadā ।
ye dharmavimukhā mūḍhā dayādānavivarjitāḥ ।।54।।
pretā jātāśca vai teṣāṃ mathurāsaṃgame gatiḥ ।
śravaṇadvādaśīyoge snātvā yamyāṃ tu bhādrake ।।55।।
vāmanārcanamevātha havanaṃ kārayettathā ।
chatropānatsuvarṇānnaṃ vastradānaṃ prakārayet ।।56 ।।
pitṝँśca tarpayet tena pretā yānti paraṃ padam ।
mathurātīrthake snānaṃ janaṃ dhyātvā hariṃ smaret ।।57।।
pretastīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇuyācced gatiṃ labhet ।
vimānavaramāruhya viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ।।58।।
māsi bhādrapade śuddhā dvādaśī śravaṇānvitā ।
tasyāṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ snātaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ।।59।।
yamīsarasvatīsandhau snātvā sampūjya vāmanam ।
kalaśaṃ vidhinā datvā pretabhāvo na vidyate ।।1.351.6 0 ।।
kapilānāṃ śataṃ datvā hiraṇyopaskarāñcitam ।
dvādaśyāṃ tatphalaṃ syādvai snātvā nadyostu saṃgame ।।6 1 ।।
rākṣasatvaṃ bhavennaṣṭaṃ śravaṇadvādaśīvratāt ।
svarge vasati tāvadvai yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।।6 2।।
tataḥ svargād bhuvaṃ yāti vipro bhavati vedavit ।
jātismaro mahāyogī mokṣamārgaparāyaṇaḥ ।।6 3 ।।
dhyānayuktena bhāvena sevayā paramātmanaḥ ।
āśīrvādena pitrośca mukto yātyapunarbhavam ।।64।।
yathālabdhasuvarṇena kārayitvā tu vāmanam ।
upānacchatrasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayedvidhivattu tam ।।65।।
āvāhayet tathā taṃ ca snāpayet pañcakāmṛtaiḥ ।
jalenābhiṣecayecca vastrādi dhārayettathā ।।66।।
alaṃkārān sugandhisaddravyatailādikaṃ dadet ।
candanāni kuṃkumaṃ ca kajjalaṃ copavītakam ।।67।।
arpayecca tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamuttamam ।
phalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ vāri śrīphalaṃ cārghyameva vā ।।68।।
dadyānnīrājayed devaṃ chatracāmaramarpayet ।
dakṣiṇāṃ ca namaskāraṃ godānaṃ karakārpaṇam ।।69।।
stutiṃ kuryācca tasyā'gre tato devaṃ visarjayet ।
evaṃ tu vidhinā kṛtvā pretamuktirbhaved dhruvam ।1.351.70 ।।
yastu sarasvatīyoge yamunāyāḥ susaṃgame ।
karoti vidhinā'nena tasya puṇyaṃ śatottaram ।।71 ।।
śrāvaṇadvādaśīyoge bhādre śukle vrataṃ caret ।
tena muktirbhaved dhrauvyā golokādinivāsadā ।।72।।।
pretā ūcuśca taṃ gokarṇaṃ vipraṃ śaraṇāgatāḥ ।
bho vidvaँstadvrataṃ kartuṃ pretānāṃ śaktireva na ।।73 ।।
tasmātpuṇyapradānena kurvasmākaṃ vimokṣaṇam ।
gokarṇaśca dyāṃ kṛtvā dadau snānajapuṇyakam ।।74।।
dade padorajaścāpi dadau padorjalaṃ tathā ।
tena muktāśca te sarve jātā vai pretayonitaḥ ।। 75।।
ākāśe dundubhidhvānamabhūd devakṛtaṃ tadā ।
pretānāṃ tu samūhāścāgatā draṣṭuṃ samantataḥ ।। 76।।
devadūta uvācedaṃ pretānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā ।
asya viprasya saṃbhāṣātsnānapuṇvasamaparṇāt ।। '' ।।
caraṇasya rajolābhājjalalābhācca sarvathā ।
pretabhāvavimuktaḥ stha tīrthasya śravaṇādapi ।।78।।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kartavyaṃ tīrthasevanam ।
sadbhiḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ satāṃ samyak prasevanam ।।79।।
tīrthaśraddhā vrataśraddhā kathāśraddhā ca mānase ।
kartavyā sarvathā pretāḥ! muktidā'sti tu sā yataḥ ।।1.351.80।।
tīrthābhiṣekipuruṣapādaprakṣālanaṃ jalam ।
pātavyaṃ cāpi muktyarthaṃ yathaiteṣāṃ vimuktidam ।।8 1 ।।
pretānāmakṣayaḥ svargaḥ sarasvatyāśca saṃgamāt ।
prāptaṃ tīrthaprabhāvasya pretairvai śravaṇāt phalam ।।82।।
āgatāni vimānāni pretānāṃ divyavarṣmaṇām ।
devānāṃ ca kṛte pañcā''ruhya te svargamuttamam ।।83।।
gatā lakṣmi! paraṃ lokaṃ vinā sādhanasampadam ।
gokarṇaḥ puṣkaraṃ tīrtha kṛtvā gokṣuramāyayau ।।84।।
yaḥ paṭhetparayā bhaktyā śṛṇuyād bhaktitatparaḥ ।
śrāvayecca smaret tīrthaॆ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।।85।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthurakṣetramāhātmye śukoktyā gokarṇasya mathurāyātrā, śukamokṣaḥ, śukeśvarasthāpanā, mārge parāvṛtasya gokarṇasya pañcapretamilāpaḥ, puṣkare pretā'pretatvakāraṇasaṃvādaḥ, bhādraśukladvādaśyāṃ vāmanapūjā, snānapuṇyadānena pretānāṃ muktiścetyādinirūpaṇa-
nāmaikapaṃcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 351 ।।
