adhyāyaḥ 352
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 353 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kṛṣṇagaṃgātīrthaṃ yāmunavārigam ।
yatra vyāsaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo bhagavān sṛṣṭibodhavān ।। 1 ।।
ādye kṛte yuge snātvā vedānadhyāpayat sadā ।
yāvattu yamunābhūmau sthāsyati tāvadeva saḥ ।। 2 ।।
snāsyati tatsthale nityaṃ kṛṣṇagaṃgājale hariḥ ।
somavaikuṇṭhayormadhye kṛṣṇagaṃgā tu sā matā ।।3।।
tatrāśramapade divye munayo divyavigrahāḥ ।
adṛśyāstu samāyānti cāturmāsyavratārthinaḥ ।। 4 ।।
yeṣāmupari teṣāṃ vai dayālūnāṃ kṛpā bhavet ।
teṣāṃ te ṛṣayo dṛṣṭipathamāyānti nānyathā ।। 5 ।।
cāturmāsye kṛṣṇagaṃgātīrthe vipreṇa vīkṣitam ।
dayāpātreṇa vasunā pāñcālyakulatantunā ।। 6 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi pāpyuddhārakarīṃ kathām ।
pāñcālyo'tha dvijaḥ kaścinnāmnā vasuritiśrutaḥ ।। 7 ।।
durbhikṣapīḍito'tyantaṃ sabhāryo varapattanam ।
yayau bhadrātaṭe bhikṣāvṛttyā vāsaṃ samācarat ।। 8 ।।
tatrasthasya tadā putraḥ kanyā cetyabhavad dvayam ।
kanyā viprāya saṃdattā dhanadhānyasamṛddhaye ।। 9 ।।
kanyāpatistato vipro yauvane rogapīḍitaḥ ।
mamāra bandhuvidhuraḥ kuṭumbarahitastathā ।। 1.352.1 0।।
kanyā'sthīni tu saṃgṛhya mathurāmājagāma ha ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitoktaṃ tvasthiprapātanam ।।1 1 ।।
ardhacandrasthale tatra māthure maṇḍale .kṛtam ।
yasya bhavet sa vai dehī muktiṃ yātīti vātrcchayā ।। 1 2।।
kanyayā'sthīni yamunāsrotasi vidhinā tadā ।
kṣiptāni viprahastena patyurmuktistadā'bhavat ।।13।।
bālaraṇḍā tu sā ramyā nīlakuñcitamūrdhajā ।
surūpā sukumārāṃgī nirādhārā'tiduḥkhitā ।। 14।।
kadalīkāṇḍasaṃkāśe tasyā ūrū sumāṃsale ।
suśliṣṭāॆgulikāpādau nakhāstāmrojjvalāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 15।।
gaṃbhīrā dakṣiṇāvarttā nābhistrivalimaṇḍitā ।
āmodarī samakukṣiḥ pīnonnatapayodharā ।। 16।।
kambugrīvā saṃvṛtāsyā sudatī svadharāhanuḥ ।
sunakhī svakṣiṇī subhrūḥ supramāṇā subhāṣiṇī ।। 17।।
sukaṭiḥ svalpamadhyā ca candrānanā'bjalocanā ।
tena tenaiva sampūrṇarūpeṇa ca tilottamā ।। 18।।
nāmā tilottamā svarṇavarṇā yuvatī sundarī ।
evaṃvidhā tatra tatra tīrthasnānaparāyaṇā ।। 19।।
yaṃ yaṃ paśyati cārvaṃgī yastāṃ cāpi prapaśyati ।
sa sa citra iva nyasto vicetā jāyate kṣaṇam ।।1.352.20।।
tathāvidhā mathurāyāṃ svakaṃ vāsamarocayat ।
tadaivā'vasare kānyakubjadeśādhipo nṛpaḥ ।।21 ।।
mathurāyāṃ devamarteśvare'nnasatramākarot ।
tatra vai brāhmaṇāḥ satyaḥ sādhvyo brāhmaṇya ityapi ।।21 ।।
sādhavo bhikṣukā dīnā anāthā bhuṃjate śatam ।
tatreyaṃ susadā bhuṃkte suśīlā tu tilottamā ।।23।।
bhojanasya samaye tu saṃgītaṃ supravartate ।
vāditrāṇi ca gītāni śakrasya bhavane yathā ।। 24।।
rājñastasya tu yā nṛtyakāriṇyo gāyikāstathā ।
dūtyaśca gaṇikāścāpi tābhiḥ sā pratilobhitā ।।25।।
gītanṛtyādiṣu snigdhā tāsāṃ dharmamupāgatā ।
alpaistu divasaiḥ sādhvī hyasādhvībhiḥ parivṛtā ।। 26।।
rājñaḥ samāgamaṃ prāptā bhogabhogyabhṛtā'bhavat ।
yuvatī kāmadāhena navaṃ navaṃ samicchati ।।27।।
evaṃ sā kāmadharmeṣu vyavāyapathagā'bhavat ।
athatasyāstu yo bhrātā pāñcālo brāhmaṇātmajaḥ ।।28।।
gṛhe sa nirdhano bhūtvā vyavasāyaṃ vicārya ca ।
mathurāyāṃ gate kāle samāyāto nirāśrayaḥ ।।29।।
kasyacicchreṣṭhivaryasya karmacārī tadā'bhavat ।
vyāpārabuddhyā varṣānte so'pi vyāpāralābhavān ।।1.352.3 0 ।।
dhanavān vai bhāgyayogāt saṃjāto vidhuro'pi ca ।
yamunāyāṃ sadā yāti snānārthaṃ snāti yatra sā ।।3 1 ।।
nityaṃ paśyati cārvaṃgīṃ dṛṣṭvā mohavaśaṃ gataḥ ।
tatra tīrthavare snātvā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ।।32।।
devādidarśanaṃ kṛtvā garteśvaraṃ samarcya ca ।
tilottamāyā mārgaṃ vai dhṛtvā paścād yayau śanaiḥ ।। 33 ।।
yatra tadbhavanaṃ tatra dhātreyikāṃ vyalokayat ।
tayā cāpi yuvā mugdha iti tvākārito gṛhe ।।34।।
dhātreyikāyāstasyāśca bahumānapuraḥsaram ।
yayau prasannamanasā yuvatyā bhavanāntaram ।। 35।।
vastrāṇi baddharūpāṇi sauvarṇakaṭakāni ca ।
hārān ratnamayān dravyaṃ dadau tasyai vimohitaḥ ।। 36 ।।
dadāvagurusāraṃ ca sakarpūraṃ sacandanam ।
tasyā gṛhavare tatra vasati sma dine dine ।। 37।।
praharārdhe dine jāte yāti svaśibiraṃ tataḥ ।
snātvā tīrthe samīpe ca kṛṣṇagaṃgodbhave sadā ।।38।।
evaṃ nityaṃ tadāsaktaḥ karoti vartanaṃ svakam ।
sumantumunināṃ nityaṃ gacchan sa cā'valokyate ।।39।।।
athaikadā pragacchan vai snātuṃ vipraḥ sumantunā ।
svāśramasthena divyena dṛṣṭaḥ sa kṛmikīṭavān ।।1.352.40 ।।
kṛmayo romakūpebhyaḥ patamānā anekaśaḥ ।
dṛśyante kurute yāvatsnānaṃ tāvatpatanti vai ।।41 ।।
snāne kṛte na dṛśyante surūpaścābhijāyate ।
evaṃ sumantunā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ bahuvāsaram ।। 42।।
sumantustvāhvayāmāsa papraccha nāma karma ca ।
pāñcālastaṃ tadā prāha tvahaṃ paṃcāladeśajaḥ ।।43 ।।
vipro vāṇijyamāśritya vasāmyatra nu caikalaḥ ।
niśāmuṣitvā śibire tilottamāsurakṣite ।।44।।
prātaḥ snātvā trigarteśaṃ pūjayitvā tamanvaham ।
divā karomi vyāpāraṃ vasāmi śibire niśi ।। 45।।
sumantuśca tadā prāha śṛṇu vipra! yathātatham ।
āścaryaṃ tava dehe'smin nityaṃ paśyāmi niḥsṛtam ।।46।।
asnāte kṛmisaṃpūrṇaṃ snāte nirmalavarcasam ।
asti kiñcinmahatpāpaṃ tava pracchannasaṃbhavam ।। 47।।
asyāṃ tīrthaprabhāveṇa snānād gacchati dūrataḥ ।
trigarteśvarasaṃsparśāt śuddhaṃ dehaṃ tu dṛśyate ।।48।।
nirūpya kathayā'smān vai yatte pracchannakilbiṣam ।
iti muneḥ sumantoḥ sa śrutvā trikālavedinaḥ ।।49।।
svaśibire'ṅganāsaṃgaṃ karomīti nyavedayat ।
gatvā tathā tadaikānte tāṃ tu papraccha mūlataḥ ।।1.352.50।।
kā tvaṃ kasya sutā kaśca deśastvatrāgamaḥ kutaḥ ।
tyākṣyāmi hi priyānprāṇān yadi satyaṃ na vakṣyati ।।।51 ।।
nirbandhaṃ tasya taṃ jñātvā duḥkhenovāca sā svakam ।
pañcālo brāhmaṇo deśe pañcāle varapattane ।।52।।
vartate vasunāmā'khyastatsutā'haṃ tilottamā ।
vivāhitā patirnaṣṭo'sthīni tvādāya māthuram ।।53 ।।
āgatā rāgayogena kānyakubjanṛpā'rthitā ।
vyavāyadharmamāpannā vartāni kāmadharmiṇī ।।54।।।
mama bhrātā tu pāñcālo vartate pitṛmandire ।
bhadrānadītaṭe tatra gṛhaṃ me hyabhavatpurā ।।55।।
atra vasāmyanāthā'haṃ kulaṭādharmamāśritā ।
vada tvaṃ svīyavṛttāntaṃ yadi māṃ vetsi pātrakam ।। 56 ।।
etacchrutvā sa pāṃcālyaḥ sāśrunetro'bhavattadā ।
labdhasaṃjñaṃ kulaṃ tasya papraccha taṃ tilottamā ।।57।।
tatastena svavṛttāntaṃ kathitaṃ kulanāmakam ।
atyativimanā jāto hyagamyāgamanena vai ।।58।।।
prāyaścitte matirabhūnnirviṇṇasya dvijanmanaḥ ।
mātaraṃ gurupatnīṃ ca svasāraṃ putrikāṃ vadhūm ।।59।।
gatvā tu praviśedagniṃ nānyā śuddhirvidhīyate ।
patyātmakaṃ tu pāñcālī jñātvā svabhrātaraṃ tu tam ।।1.352.60 ।।
dvijebhyaḥ pradadau sarvaṃ ratnavastradhanādikam ।
kāliṃjaratrigarteśaṃ datvā bhūṣādhanādikam ।।6 1 ।।
kṛṣṇagaṃgodbhave tīrthe citāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ।
ātmanaḥ sā viśuddhyarthaṃ prajajvāla hutāśanam ।।62।।
pāñcālo'pi svakaṃ dravyaṃ datvā dāne'vaśeṣitam ।
aurdhvadaihikabhāgārthaṃ kalpayitvā yathāvidhi ।।63 ।।
snātvā devāँstathā natvā brāhmaṇāँśca sumantukam ।
ṛṣiṃ gatvā samuvācā'gamyāgamanapātakam ।।64।।
tatpāpasya viśuddhyarthaṃ dehatyāgaṃ karomi vai ।
ityuktvā ca citāṃ kṛtvā samuddīpya ghṛtokṣitām ।।65।।
yāvatpraveṣṭuṃ yātyenaṃ vāguvācā'śarīriṇī ।
bhaginīṃ ca praveṣṭuṃ vai tatparāṃ tāvadeva ha ।।66 ।।
maivaṃ kārṣīḥ sāhasaṃ ca vipāpmānau yato hi vām ।
yatra kṛṣṇasya sañcāraḥ krīḍā jātā yathāsukham ।।67।।
cakrāṃkitapadanyāsāstatthalaṃ divyameva yat ।
brahmarūpaṃ dhāmarūpaṃ yatra pāpakṣayo bhavet ।।68।।
anyatra hi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthamāsādya naśyati ।
tīrthasthāne kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepaṃ bhavedapi ।।6 9।।
tadubhayavināśastu gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame ।
gomatīsāgarayoge yamunāpaṃcatīrthake ।।1.352.70 ।।
pṛthivyāṃ sarvatīrtheṣu snānajaṃ yatphalaṃ matam ।
yamunāyāḥ pañcatīrthasnānena tulyameva na ।।71 ।।
ekādaśyāṃ hi viśrāntau dvādaśyāṃ saukare tathā ।
trayodaśyāṃ naimiṣe ca caturdaśyāṃ prayāgake ।।72।।
pūrṇāyāṃ puṣkare snānāt kārtikyāṃ ca vrate vrate ।
tīrthe tīrthe janaḥ snātvā sarvapāpāt pramucyate ।। 73 ।।
mathurāyāṃ sarvatīrthe viśrāntau pañcatīrthake ।
asikuṇḍe sarasvatīyoge garteśvare tathā ।।74।।
snānajāttu phalād daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ sakṛdapi ।
kṛṣṇagaṃgāsnānato vai jāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।। 75।।
jñānato'jñānato vāpi duṣkṛtaṃ samupārjitam ।
kṛṣṇagaṃgājalasparśe vajrākhyamapi naśyati ।। 76 ।।
mathurā hi kṛṣṇarūpā nadī kṛṣṇamayī tathā ।
narā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇarūpāstatra pāpaṃ na vidyate ।। 77।।
yasya śrotraikadeśe tu hyākāśo leśamātrakaḥ ।
yasya nayanayoḥ prānte tejo līnaṃ -bhavatyapi ।।78।।
yasya śvāse'nilo līno jalaṃ svede vilīyate ।
pṛthvī yasyodare tvaṇvī bhūtvā tiṣṭhati sarvadā ।। 79।।
yatkukṣau vārdhayaḥ sarve līnā bhavanti sarvadā ।
yasmād bhavanti satataṃ brahmāṇḍāni svaromataḥ ।।1.352.80।।
avatārā varāhādyā bhavanti yasya vāñcchayā ।
tasmin kṛṣṇe sthite cātra pāpaleśo na vidyate ।।81 ।।
pṛthvīrakṣākaro devo varāho yatra vidyate ।
tasya sandarśanāttvatra mahāpātakanāśanam ।।82।।
tatkṣaṇādeva viprendra! nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।
navamyāṃ jyeṣṭhaśuklasya kṛṣṇagaṃgodakā''plavāt ।।83।।
sūkare tu trirātraṃ vai mānavo dīpadānataḥ ।
tilottame! mahāvajrāpyatipāpaiḥ pramucyate ।।84।।
kāliṃjare tu dvādaśyāṃ snātvā sampūjya devatām ।
divyacaturbhujo bhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।।।85।।।
evaṃ lakṣmi! devavāṇyā pāñcālaśca tilottamā ।
bodhitau tau gatau divyasumantorāśrame tadā ।।86 ।।
pādayoḥ patitau tasyocatuśca tvaṃ pitā guruḥ ।
brūhi divyadṛśā brahmannatra kiṃ karavāvahai ।।87।।
muniḥ prāha vyomavāṇīṃ yathārthā nā'nṛtā kvacit ।
mayā pratyakṣato dṛṣṭaṃ bhavadgātreṣu pātakam ।।88।।
snānātprāgeva no paścāttato nāstyeva pātakam ।
pañcatīrthe trigarteśe snānaṃ saṃkuruta sadā ।।89।।
āśrame mama nityaṃ ca tiṣṭhataṃ kurutaṃ japam ।
pāpāduparamitau ca yāvatkālaṃ prajīvathaḥ ।।1.352.90।।
mamā''śīrvādataścāpi bhrātā ca bhaginī hyubhau ।
vipāpmānau tu saṃbhūtau brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyathaḥ ।।91 ।।
evaṃ tatrāśrame lakṣmi! suyantvādyā maharṣayaḥ ।
divyadehāḥ pravasanti tatastīrthottamaṃ smṛtam ।।92।।
saṃprāptau divyadehau tau bhrātā ca bhaginī hyubhau ।
ārṣau tatrāśrame jātau darśanādapi muktidau ।।93।।
tato vimānamāruhya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tau ।
śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ yātau golokaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।।94।।
evaṃ prabhāvastīrthasya mathurāyāṃ yamījale ।
kṛṣṇagaṃgāsthalasyāpi tathā kāliñjarasya ca ।।95।।
sūkarasyāpi tīrthasya mahālakṣmi! vadāmi kim ।
pāpaṃ na pāparūpaṃ tad yadi kṛṣṇāya cārpitam ।।96।।
apāpaṃ pāparūpaṃ syād yadi kṛṣṇāya nā'rpitam ।
tasmāt puṇyaṃ mahādānaṃ kāryaṃ yatkiñcideva tat ।। 97।।
mahyaṃ kṛṣṇāya dātavyaṃ nirdoṣaṃ doṣavattu yat ।
kāmaḥ krodho mahān lobho mānaḥ svādaśca mohitā ।। 98।।
sarve kṛṣṇārpitā divyā nirbandhāya bhavanti vai ।
yaḥ śṛṇoti mahālakṣmi! śraddhayā paṭhati dhruvam ।।99।।
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya sarvaṃ vyapohati ।
prātarasyaikavāraṃ vai cāturmāsye tu vācanam ।। 1.352.100 ।।
kariṣyati janastasya phalaṃ gośatadānajam ।
pāpaleśo na vai tasyā'mṛtatvaṃ jāyate dṛḍham ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurātīrthamāhātmyaṃ saurāṣṭrīyasya varapattanavāsinaḥ pāṃcālaviprasya tilottamākhyabhaginyā saha mathurāyāmajānatorjātasyavyavāyabhāvasya vyomavāṇyā sumantunā ṛṣiṇā ca niṣpāpatā pañcatīrthakṛṣṇagaṃgātīrthaprabhāveṇa darśiteti nirūṇanāmā
dvipañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 352 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 352 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 353
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 354 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! caritaṃ vai nārīṇāṃ cañcalaṃ sadā ।
putraṃ rūpayutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitaraṃ vā janāntaram ।। 1 ।।
kṣaṇaṃ saṃkalpavaśagā kvacid bhavati bhāminī ।
cañcalaṃ hi manastadvad rājasī kāmavedanā ।। 2 ।।
parādhīnaṃ karotyeva yathā sāmbaṃ kariṣyati ।
śṛṇu śrīkṛṣṇasya putraḥ sāmbanāmā bhaviṣyati ।। 3 ।।
mātṝṇāṃ tatra mohena śāpapātraṃ bhaviṣyati ।
sāmbasya varṣmaṇi kuṣṭharogo bhaviṣyati tadā ।। 4 ।।
sa mathurāṃ samāgatyā''dityasyopāsanāṃ tathā ।
kariṣyati pratiṣṭhāṃ ca snāsyati yāmune jale ।।5 ।।
tena kuṣṭhavināśo'sya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
etādṛśaṃ tu māthuraṃ tīrthaṃ rogavināśakam ।। 6 ।।
śṛṇu vistarato lakṣmi! bhaviṣyat kathayāmi tat ।
dvārakāṃ vasamānasya putradārasutaiḥ saha ।। 7 ।।
kṛṣṇasya bhavanaṃ tatra samāyānnārado muniḥ ।
yathāyogyaṃ svāgataṃ śrīkṛṣṇastasyā'karonmudā ।। 8 ।।
nāradastu tadaikānte bhijñaptimakaroddharim ।
kṛṣṇa! kiñcidvaktukāmaḥ śṛṇu svarge śrutaṃ mayā ।। 9 ।।
sāmbanāmā kṛṣṇaputro yuvā rūpātiśobhanaḥ ।
spṛhaṇīyaḥ strījanasya kānto nānyo hi tatsamaḥ ।। 1.353.1 0।।
api kṛṣṇasya patnyo'pi spṛhayanti vilokya tam ।
devayonyaśca yāḥ santi sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa ।। 11 ।।
sāmbaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu sarvāsāṃ kṣubhyanti mānasāni vai ।
etat svargādilokeṣu gīyate daivataiḥ katham ।। 12।।
yaśo vai svargavāso'sti narakastadviparyayaḥ ।
tvatpriyārthaṃ samāyātaḥ kathayituṃ mahāprabho ।। 13।
puṇyaṃ saṃśrūyate yāvat tāvatpuruṣa ucyate ।
apuṇyaśravaṇe tasya nirayo vai prakīrtyate ।। 14।।
tasmātsatyamasatyaṃ vā lakṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ hi tat ।
tasmāt sāmbaṃ tathā devīgaṇaṃ saṃsadi cā''hvaya ।। 15 ।।
itiproktastathā kṛṣṇo devīrāhūya sarvaśaḥ ।
niṣādya sāmbamāhūya svapārśve'pi nyaṣādayat ।। 16 ।।
dṛṣṭvā rūpamatīvā'sya sāmbasyātra varastriyaḥ ।
cukṣubhuḥ sakalā devyaḥ kṛṣṇasyaiva tu paśyataḥ ।। 17।।
nāradaṃ tā namaskṛtya jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ।
sāmbastasthau tatra kṛṣṇo lajjayā''vāṅmukho'bhavat ।। 18।।
kṣaṇo nāsti raho nāsti nāstikṛtye vicāraṇā ।
surūpaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣaranti pramadāḥ sadāḥ ।। 19।।
svabhāva eṣa nārīṇāṃ tatra kā parivedanā ।
yathā tvekena cakreṇa rathasya na gatirbhavet ।।1.353.20।।
vinā naraṃ tvagatatyaḥ kṣaranti nṝasāḥ striyaḥ ।
puṃsvādadṛṣṭipātena manyante kṛtakṛtyatām ।।21 ।।
pradyumnaṃ vīkṣya tāḥ sarvā lajjāmāpuḥ supuṣkalām ।
sāmbaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tāḥ sarvā anaṅgena prapīḍitāḥ ।।22।।
uddīpanavibhāvo'yaṃ sāmbastvatstrīvimohakaḥ ।
satyaloke pravādo yastava jāto duratyayaḥ ।। 23 ।।
mayā śrutastu lokebhyo brahmarṣibhyo muhurmuhuḥ ।
sāmbaṃ tyaktvā'yaśastatsammārṣṭumarhasi keśava! । । 24।।
ityuktvā nārado maunamāsthito'tha haristataḥ ।
taṃ tu śaśāpa sāmbaṃ vai virūpo bhava putraka! ।। 25 । ।
tāvatsāmbaḥ kuṣṭhayukto'bhavad virūpa eva ha ।
atha sāmbaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā saśokaṃ prāha nāradaḥ । । 26 । ।
sāmba sāmba kṛṣṇaputra! śṛṇu jāmbavatīsuta! ।
sūryamudyantameva tvaṃ namaskuru sadā'nagha! ।। 27। ।
kuṣṭharogo ravistuṣṭo nāśayiṣyati putraka! ।
mathurāyāṃ ca tvaṃ gatvā ṣaṭsūryaṃ prāpsyase phalam ।। 28 । ।
prātarārādhaya sūryaṃ ṣaṭsūryatīrthake'nagha! ।
madhyāhnepi tathā sāyaṃ sadyaḥ phalamavāpnuhi ।। 29 ।।
kṛṣṇagaṃgodbhave snātvā sūryamārādhya yatnataḥ ।
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kuṣṭhādibhyo vimucyate ।। 1.353.30 ।।
ityuktastu mahālakṣmi! sāmbaḥ kṛṣṇājñayā yayau ।
mathurāṃ doṣaharaṇīṃ muktidāṃ sa dadarśa ha । । 31 । ।
ṣaṭsūryānpūjayāmāsa niyatasnānatarpaṇaḥ ।
brāhmaṃ tathodayanta ca hyūrdhvaṃ yāntaṃ ca madhyagam ।। 32 । ।
namantaṃ cāpyastagataṃ nityaṃ sāmbaḥ samārcayat ।
sūryastuṣṭaḥ svalpakāle sāmbasyā'gre samāgamat ।। 33 । ।
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te gataṃ kuṣṭhādikaṃ tava ।
ityuktvā sāmbasarvāṃge'spṛśat sāmbo'pi tatkṣaṇam ।। 34 ।।
kuṣṭhahīno'bhavatsūryasamakāntirvyarājata ।
sūryo dvitīyarūpeṇa sāmbena saha vartate ।। 35।।
brāhme sūryaṃ virāḍākhyaṃ sāmbaścakre pratiṣṭhitam ।
udayākhyaraviṃ yamyāṃ dakṣiṇe sampratiṣṭhitam ।। 36 ।।
ūrdhvayāntaṃ kālapriyaraviṃ cakre pratiṣṭhitam ।
vaikuṇṭhapaścime cakre raviṃ mādhyandinīyakam ।। 3 7।।
avataranta sāmbārkaṃ mathurāyāṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
astamantaṃ kṛṣṇagaṃgādakṣiṇe'rka pratiṣṭhitam ।। 38 ।।
cakre sāmbastatpūjādividhiṃ sāmbapure sthitaḥ ।
mathurāyāṃ tvabhavat tat sāmbapuraṃ kuleśvaram ।। 39 ।।
māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ divyaṃ sāmbapuraṃ prati ।
rathayātrāṃ sāmbasūryāṃ kariṣyanti tu ye janāḥ ।।1.353.40 ।।
gaccheyustatpadaṃ śāntaṃ sūryamaṇḍalabhedakam ।
kṛṣṇagaṃgāṃ janāḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā ṣaṭasūryamaṇḍalam ।। 41 ।।
pāparogādimuktāśca yāsyanti paramaṃ padam ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! manaḥpāpādināśakam ।।42।।
agamyāgamanasyāpi cāgamyagamanasya ca ।
pāpaṃ prajvālayatyāśu tvādityaṣaṭkatīrthakam ।।43।।।
kāmena yanmanodauṣṭyaṃ vidhunoti tu tad drutam ।
aparādhānapi sarvān mathurāyāṃ hariḥ svayam ।।44।।
na vai gaṇayati kṛṣṇo gopījanakṛtādaraḥ ।
sāmbo'bhavaddhūtapāpastatraivā'ntaradhīyata ।। 45।।
sūryarathe sadā tiṣṭhan bhaviṣyaṃ paripṛcchati ।
tatsarvaṃ tu navaṃ kṛtvā jñātavān kṛṣṇaputrakaḥ ।।46।।
sāmbapuraṃ mathurāyāṃ kṛtvā yāto nijaṃ gṛham ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya ṣaḍādityārhaṇāphalam ।।47।।
labhate sūryalokaṃ ca prāṇānte kṛṣṇadhāma ca ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! bhaktakṛtānaparādhānapi priye! ।।48।।
ajñātaḥ sarvathā śuddho vaiṣamye deśakālayoḥ ।
vinā'parādho manujaḥ sāparādho vijāyate ।।49।।
karmaṇā manasā vācātvaparādhā bhavanti vai ।
snānahīnatvamevātha hiṃsanaṃ mithunakriyā ।।1.353.50।।
malamūtraparityāgo bālajanmādikaṃ tathā ।
śavasparśādikaṃ devapūjane hyaparādhanam ।।51 ।।
mandirasya tathā mūrteḥ sānnidhye patprasāraṇam ।
pṛṣṭhadānaṃ mehanaṃ ca yatheṣṭabhakṣaṇādikam ।। 52।।
malinā'śuddhabhakṣitvaṃ niṣiddhakusumārcanam ।
anuttārya tu nirmālyaṃ pūjākṣīṇe'ndhakāriṇi ।।53।।
kleśanaṃ devatāgāre sopānatko'pasarpaṇam ।
surāmāṃsāśanaṃ devasyāndhakāre prabodhanam ।।54।।
anamaskaraṇaṃ tadvad grāmyajalpavitaṇḍikāḥ ।
dhūmrapānaṃ ṣṭhīvanaṃ cetyādyāḥ karmāparādhakāḥ ।।55।।।
adhyāna cā'smaraṇaṃ cā'dhāraṇaṃ śrīharestathā ।
anyasakalpakaraṇaṃ viṣayādivicintanam ।।56।।
rāgo dveṣastathā tṛṣṇā vāsanā cā'nyanindanam ।
kutarkahetusandehā bhrāntirviparyayastathā ।। 57।।
ālasyaṃ cā'nanusandhānakaṃ garvo'bhimānitā ।
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho mado mātsaryamityapi ।।58।।
īrṣyā'niṣṭavicārādyā mānasā hyaparādhakāḥ ।
mātṛpitṛsuhṛnmitragurudvijasurādayaḥ ।। 59।।
satīsādhvīpriyāpatnībālābālagavādayaḥ ।
tṛṇājantucetanādyāḥ sarve nārāyaṇāntarāḥ ।।1.353.6 0।।
patibhṛtyāśritā naivā'parāddhavyāḥ kadācana ।
asatpralāpo'sadvārtā vyarthabhāṣitvamityapi ।।61 ।।
abhajanaṃ doṣadānaṃ duṣṭaśabdaprayojanam ।
kalahaścākrośanaṃ ca kolāhalaśca pardanam ।।62।।
atiśabdadhvanidhvānaṃ gālīvācanamityapi ।
aślīlavāk samuddhoṣaḥ sakthisphoṭādikaṃ tathā ।।63।।
anargalaprahāyasyādyā vāṇī kṛtāparādhakāḥ ।
na kartavyā vicāryaiva svāniṣṭaphaladāstu te ।।64।।
devatīrthaguruviprasādhusādhvīpativratāḥ ।
sarve ye tārakāsteṣāmaparādhān na cā''caret ।।65।।
sāparādhastu puruṣo viṣṇuṃ naiva prapaśyati ।
rākṣasīṃ tāmasīṃ pūjāṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana ।।66।।।
māṃsamadyārpiṇī pūjā rākṣasī procyate priye! ।
hiṃsādikṛtyayuktā yā pūjā sā tāmasī matā ।।67।।
pāradāryaṃ paradravyaharaṇaṃ ca parārdanam ।
paranāśakaraṃ karma rākṣasaṃ karma kīrtitam ।।68।।
karmakṛtāparādhānāṃ śuddhiḥ snānādinā bhavet ।
tīrthasnānena pañcagavyānāṃ saṃprāśanena ca ।।69।।
upoṣaṇena yajñena dīrghakālagatena ca ।
pañcāmṛtena ca tathā brahmakūrcavratena ca ।।1.353.70।।
devānāṃ sevayā satāṃ sevayā śuddhiriṣyate ।
manaḥkṛtāparādhānāṃ śuddhirdhyānādinā bhavet ।।71 ।।
cittavṛttinirodhena tathendriyanirodhataḥ ।
jñānena doṣatyāgena tapasā puṇyabhāvataḥ ।।72।।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi mananena ca nirṇayāt ।
ātmanastu vicāreṇa cidacitorvivekataḥ ।।73 ।।
puṃprakṛtyordharmabodhānmānasī śuddhiriṣyate ।
vācā kṛtāparādhānāṃ śuddhiḥ syāttu japādibhiḥ ।।74।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa! viṣṇo! hare! mādhava! keśava! ।
lakṣmīpate ramānātha! śrīpate! pārvatīpate! ।।75।।
gopīpate! prabho! māṇikīpate! ca prabhāpate! ।
satpate! cākṣarapate! muktapate! pumuttama! ।।76।।
golokādipate! brahmapara! śrīpuruṣottama! ।
ityevaṃ nāmajapanādoṃkārādijapāttathā ।।77।।
kṣamāyā yācanāccāpi kathāyā vācanāttathā ।
kṛṣṇakīrtanakaraṇāt kṛṣṇamālā''dhivartanāt ।।78।।
satyavratapratiṣṭhānād vācikī śuddhiriṣyate ।
mucyate tvaparādhaistu jano viṣṇoḥ stavaṃ paṭhan ।।79।।
samvatsarasya mapye vai tīrthasnānena śuddhyati ।
kāśyāṃ tathā mathurāyāṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca puṣkare ।।1.353.80 ।
badaryāṃ ca jagannāthapuryāṃ sāketapattane ।
haridvāre ca gaṇḍakyāṃ godāvaryāṃ janārdane ।।8 1 ।
kāveryāṃ setubandhe ca padmāvatyāṃ ca raivate ।
svarṇarekhājale cā'śvapaṭṭasarasi mānase ।।82।
nārāyaṇe cendradyumne kāveryāṃ padmanābhake ।
kāñcyāṃ ca narmadāyāṃ cā'vabhṛthe paṭṭakotsave ।।83 ।
snānātpānāttathā dhyānāt kīrtanād dhāraṇāttathā ।
śravaṇānmananāccāpi darśanāt pātakakṣayaḥ ।।84।
aṭitvā sarvatīrthāni prāyānmāthuramaṇḍalam ।
ātyantikī tu viśrāntirviśrāntighaṭṭake bhavet ।।85।
phalaṃ parārdhaguṇitaṃ mathurāyāṃ prajāyate ।
gateranveṣakāṇāṃ tu mathurā paramā gatiḥ ।।86 ।
yā gatiryogayuktasya sāṃkhyajñānavatastathā ।
sā gatistyajataḥ prāṇān mathurāyāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।।87।
na tīrthaṃ mathurātulyaṃ na devaḥ kṛṣṇasadṛśaḥ ।
na brahmadhāmabhā muktirna paraḥ puruṣottamāt ।।88
yadāśraye kṛte sarvapāpānāṃ vilayo bhavet ।
ātmani yaddhṛte svasyā''tyantikī muktirāmilet ।।89
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi janastatphalabhāg bhavet ।। 1.353.90 ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthuratīrthamāhātmye dvārikāyāṃ sāmbarūpadarśanena kṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ manaḥkṣobhāt kṛṣṇadattaśāpena jātakuṣṭhasāmbasya mathurāyāmādityopāsanayā kuṣṭhanivṛttiḥ ṣaḍādityasthāpanā, kāyikavācikamānasikāparādhāstannivāraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikatriśatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।353 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 353 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 354
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 355 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mathurāyāṃ dhruvatīrthaṃ sumuktidam ।
tarpaṇādannadānācca pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam ।। 1
mathurāyāṃ candraseno rājāsīd dharmakāryakṛt ।
tasya patnī candraprabhā vīrasūrvīraputrakā ।। 2
tasyā dāsīśatasyaikā dāsī tvāsīt prabhāvatī ।
prabhāvatyāḥ pūrvajā vai pitaraḥ śatasaṃkhyayā ।। 3
svadoṣaiḥ patitāḥ sarve narakaṃ prati bhāmini।
karoti tarpaṇaṃ nāpi kārayati prabhāvatī ।। 4 । ।
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ ca vā kiñcit pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave ।
tasyāḥ kuṭumbinaścāpi kurvantyeva na tarpaṇam ।। 5 ।।
tasyāḥ pitṛgaṇo bhraṣṭaḥ kadācid yamunātaṭe ।
sūkṣmaḥ prāṇisamūho vai dhruvatīrthe samāpatan ।। 6 ।।
kṛṣṇavarṇāścaṃkramanto maśakākārasannibhāḥ ।
pitaraḥ ṛṣiṇā dṛṣṭāstrikālajñā'bhidhāyinā ।। 7 ।।
trikalajñaḥ sadā yamyāṃ pitṝn datvā jalāñjalīn ।
tarpayatyeva pitarastṛptā yānti mahaḥsthalam ।। 8 ।।
sa ṛṣiḥ ṣaṣṭhakālāśī payovratī sadāsti vai ।
sūryakiraṇapānāśī sūryagatyā gatisthitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
āgataṃ pitṛsamūhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvaiva mohitaḥ ।
kṛpayā tānnirīkṣaiśca na cakre vratajāpanam ।। 1.354.10 । ।
caturthāṃśāvaśeṣaśca divasaḥ paryavartata ।
eke tatra samāyānti pitaro nabhaso'vanim ।। 11 ।।
anye pūrvāduttarācca dakṣiṇātpaścimāttathā ।
lakṣaśaḥ pitarastatra dhruvatīrthe samāgatāḥ ।। 12 ।।
āyānti pratiyānti ye tānpaśyan vismayaṃ gataḥ ।
tatraikaḥ samūho dṛṣṭo hṛṣṭapuṣṭāṃgatuṣṭimān ।। 13 । ।
putraiḥ kṛtasvadhāprāpto jalaṃ pītvā divaṃ yayau ।
anyaḥ samūho dṛṣṭopi tapasvī kṣāmadehavān ।। 1 4।।
rūkṣaḥ snānarato pītvā jalaṃ bhuvaryayau sa ca ।
atha saṃgho'paro dṛṣṭo vastrālaṃkāraśobhitaḥ ।। 1 5 । ।
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāṃga evā'sau jalaṃ pītvā divaṃ yayau ।
athetaraḥ samudāyo dṛṣṭo nagnaśarīrakaḥ ।। 16 ।।
supuṣṭaḥ sukhasampanno jalaṃ pītvā'mbaraṃ yayau ।
athā'nte bahavo dṛṣṭā vimānavaramāsthitāḥ ।। 17 ।।
bahubhojanapūrṇāni yānānyuccāvacāni ca ।
gṛhītvā vyomamārgeṇa gacchanti maharādikam ।। 18 ।।
atha pare lokitāśca tvīrayantaḥ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।
tṛptā haṃsagaruḍādipṛṣṭhasthā gajavājigāḥ ।। 19 ।।
tadanye vikṛtā dṛṣṭāḥ kruddhāḥ kṣudhātipīḍitāḥ ।
pṛṣṭhalagnodarā mānahīnāḥ śāpapradāyinaḥ ।। 1.354.20 ।।
tato'nye ca tathā dṛṣṭāḥ puṣpahārā'bhipūjitāḥ ।
śrāddhe bhuṃktvā mahotsāhā yathā devāstathojjvalāḥ ।। 21 ।।
kecit piṇḍān kare dhṛtvā kecidattvā phalāni ca ।
kecit ṣoḍaśavastvādyairyuktā yānti janādikam ।। 22 ।।
kecicchayyāsamāyuktā bhogabhogyasamanvitāḥ ।
tuṣṭāḥ prasannamanaso dṛṣṭāstapo'bhiyāyinaḥ ।।23 ।।
kecit samukuṭā rājyacchatracāmaravījitāḥ ।
dṛṣṭā mānayutā yātāḥ satyalokaṃ vimānakaiḥ ।।24।।
yamunāyāṃ navavastrairyutā bhūṣādiśobhitāḥ ।
paribhramanti pitaraścānye dṛṣṭāstathāvidhāḥ ।।25।।
kālindyāṃ dhruvatīrthe vai madhyāhnottarameva ha ।
āsāyaṃ pitaraścaivaṃ trikālajñarṣiṇekṣitāḥ ।।26 ।।
gate pitṛgaṇe putrāḥ sakalatrāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ।
śrāddhakartāra evaite sāyaṃ svasvagṛhān yayuḥ ।। 27।।
nirjanaṃ dhruvatīrthaṃ ca janahīnaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
trikālajño'pi munirāḍ vismitastata utthitaḥ ।।28।।
dadarśaikaṃ kṛśāṃgaṃ ca kṣutkṣāmaṃ gativihvalam ।
pratīkṣantaṃ kampamānaṃ pṛṣṭhalagnalaghūdaram ।।29।।
ūrucarmāsthiruktrastaṃ jṛmbhamāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
koṭarākṣaṃ mlānavaktraṃ kṣudrasvalparavaṃ kṛśam ।।1.354.3 0।।
dayāluḥ sa munistaṃ vai papraccha ko bhavānatha ।
duḥkhito vikṛtākāro veṣṭito maśakairbahu ।।3 1 ।।
na gacchasi na te sthānaṃ nirāśrito'si kiṃ vad ।
mayā'dya bahavo dṛṣṭāḥ koṭiśaḥ pitaro'tra vai ।।32।।
teṣāmālokane kālo gato'dya mama sarvathā ।
na mamādya naityakaṃ vai karmajātaṃ vilokane ।।33।।
atha tvaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kriyā me naśyate khalu ।
paścāt karma kariṣye me naityakaṃ vada me ṛtam ।।34।।
yathāśakti kariṣye vai śaktaṃ syācceddhitaṃ tava ।
śrutvā janturuvācainaṃ muniṃ sarvaṃ yathātatham ।।35।।
bṛhannimittamadyaiva pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam ।
dhruvatīrthe kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ tilodakādikam ।।36 ।।
annaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ śayyādikaṃ tathā ।
upānahau gṛhaṃ chatraṃ bhūṣā dugdhaṃ tathetarat ।।37।।
adya dattaṃ sutadāraputrīpatnīkuṭumbibhiḥ ।
sarvaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ tṛptipradaṃ pitṛpratarpaṇam ।।38।।
dhruvatīrthe dhruvaṃ sarvaṃ dattaṃ bhavati bhūsura! ।
yānaṃ ca vāhanaṃ gauśca vāṭikā kṣetramityapi ।।39।।
dattaṃ nītvā saha yānti svarṇaṃ dravyaṃ tathetarat ।
tilatṛptāḥ sarvatṛptāḥ pitaro'dyā'titoṣitāḥ ।।1.354.40।।
sarve tṛptā divaṃ yānti pitaraścādya putriṇāḥ ।
santānaiḥ puṣṭavapuṣo dattaśrāddhaiḥ kṛtodakaiḥ ।।41 ।।
yeṣāṃ santatirakṣayyā tiṣṭhatyevaṃ prajāvatī ।
te svadhāpūjitaiḥ putrairgacchanti paramāṃ gatim ।।42।।।
adya rājñastu pitaraścandrasenasya pūjitāḥ ।
dṛṣṭāstvayā tathā cānye divyadṛṣṭyā divaṃgatāḥ ।।43।।
brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vaiśyānāṃ śūdrakarmaṇām ।
pratilomānulomānāṃ sarveṣāṃ śrāddhakarmiṇām ।।44।।
pitarastu tvayā dṛṣṭā yeṣāṃ santatiravyayā ।
ahantu saṃpratīkṣanvai śrāddhaṃ tvatra vyavasthitaḥ ।।45।।
āśāpāśaśatairbaddhastṛptyarthaśca bubhukṣitaḥ ।
yonisaṃkaradoṣeṇa pūrvaṃ vai narakaṃ gataḥ ।।46 ।।
nāstikairmama vaṃśyaiśca śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ na me'dya vai ।
pratyabdaṃ tvāgatasyātra prāptiḥ śrāddhasya me nahi ।।47।।
anyapitṛdāsyavṛttiṃ kṛtvā jīvāmi bhūsura ।
adya śrāddhasamārohe śatavarṣairmanāgapi ।।48।।
kuṭumbito mayā naiva labdhaṃ tṛptirna me'dya vai ।
agatirgamane jātā tritāpaiśca suduḥkhitaḥ ।।49।।
balayuktā yayuḥ sarve nirbalasya kuto gatiḥ ।
āgamiṣyanti vai kecit sarvapitṛpratarpakāḥ ।।1.354.50।।
tadā hyavāpya kiñcidvai yāsye'raṇyaṃ samīpagam ।
ime ye mama dehe tu bhavanti maśakāḥ kṛśāḥ ।।51 ।।
santānaprakṣayādete mama dehaṃ samāśritāḥ ।
ahaṃ vai pūrvajasteṣāṃ hyete me vaṃśajā janāḥ ।।52।।
māṃ khādanti kṣudhākāle tantuvicchedaduḥkhitāḥ ।
ekā tantumayī putrī mama vaṃśe'tra vidyate ।।53 ।।
mathurāyāṃ candrasenanṛpateḥ karmacāriṇī ।
mahiṣyāḥ sevane saktā dāsī nāmnā prabhāvatī ।।54।।
tasyāḥ putraḥ karmacārī virūpanidhisaṃjñakaḥ ।
asmākaṃ santatestantustasya śrāddhakṛte vayam ।।55।।
āśayā baddhahṛdayā śrāddhatarpaṇakāmanāḥ ।
sthitā etāvadeva tu tato yāsyāmahe vanam ।।56।।
narake tvapratiṣṭhe vā vārdhau vā bhagnamānasāḥ ।
yadi tantuḥ sa ced dadyājjalaṃ śrāddhaṃ tilāñjalīn ।।57।।
tadā puṣṭā vayaṃ bhūtvā yāmo divaṃ kaniṣṭhakam ।
śṛṇu nikṛṣṭayonyā'pi dattaṃ vai prāpyate haviḥ ।।58।।
tayā dattena santuṣṭā vayaṃ syāmaḥ suputriṇaḥ ।
pūrvakarmavipākena yāṃ yāṃ gatimadhomukhīm ।।59।।
ūrdhvāṃ ca prāptāḥ pitaraḥ putriṇaḥ putrikāśritāḥ ।
śrāddhaṃ piṇḍodakaṃ dānaṃ putrīkṛtaṃ tvavāpyate ।।1.354.6 0।।
nānyā gatiḥ pitṝṇāṃ syāt putryā pitaraḥ putriṇaḥ ।
api syātsa kule'smākaṃ yo no dadyājjalāṃjalim ।।6 1 ।।
nadīṣu bahutoyāsu śītalāsu viśeṣataḥ ।
tīrthamadhye tilamiśraṃ phalayuktaṃ jalāṃjalim ।।62।।
raupyajuṣṭajalenāpi nābhidaghne jale sthitaḥ ।
darbhapāṇiḥ pradadyācca tena tṛptā vayaṃ sadā ।।63 ।।
darbhapāṇistristrigotre pitṛnāma samuccaran ।
tṛpyatāṃ hyamukanāmne svadhā ceti vadan sutaḥ ।।64।।
devebhyaścāṃjaliṃ dadyād ṛṣibhyastvaṃjalidvayam ।
pitṛbhyastryañjalīn dadyāt tṛpyantāṃ samudāharan ।।65।।
pitre prathamato dadyāt mātre dadyāttataḥ param ।
mātāmahāya ca dadyād dadyāt pitāmahāya ca ।।66।।
tatparebhyaśca pitṛbhyaḥ pradadyāt trīn jalāṃjalīn ।
pitāmahyai tathā dadyād dadyācca prapitāmahīm ।।67।।
anena piṇḍadānena te'sūryānnāśayāmyaham ।
idaṃ jalaṃ mayā dattamakṣayyā tṛptirastu te ।।68।।
vāryapi śraddhayā dattaṃ tadānantyāya kalpate ।
gṛhṇānāḥ pitaraḥ kecid bhavantyudvignarūpiṇaḥ ।।69।।
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ vipra! śrāddhaṃ syādviphalaṃ yathā ।
adeśakāle yaddattaṃ vidhihīnamadakṣiṇam ।।1.354.70।।
apātre malinaṃ dravyaṃ tṛptaye naiva jāyate ।
aśraddheyamapāṃkteyaṃ duṣṭaprekṣitamīkṣitam ।।71 ।।
tilamantrakuśairhīnamāsuraṃ tadbhavediti ।
aśucīni gṛhāṇyevā'śuciśrāddhahavīṃṣi ca ।।72।।
krodhāviṣṭāni dānāni vidhipātrā'kṛtāni ca ।
adakṣiṇāni śrāddhāni rākṣasebhyo milanti vai ।।73 ।।
dakṣiṇāhīnayajñasya phalaṃ rakṣo bhunakti hi ।
devabrāhmaṇagurvagre vṛthāśapathakāriṇām ।।74।।
kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ hi pātālavāsino lakṣmi! bhuṃjate ।
aśrotriyāṇi śrāddhāni hutaṃ dattamamantrakam ।।75।।
gurvabhaktasya śiṣyasya kīrtanaṃ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ ।
kariṣyataśca dharmasya prāgeva tu prakāśanam ।।76।।
sarvaṃ pātālavāsānāṃ tṛptyarthaṃ parikalpitam ।
alīkaṃ tu vṛthā''ḍambareṇa yadvai kṛtaṃ vratam ।।77।।
dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ tapo homo rakṣasāṃ tadbhavet kila ।
nopatiṣṭhanti pitṛṇāṃ nagnāḥ pitṛgaṇāstataḥ ।।78।।
muṣitā rākṣasādyairvai dānādiphalabhoktṛbhiḥ ।
aphalāste yathā''hūtāstathā gacchantyabhojanāḥ ।।79।।
maunamāsthāya te sarve kṣudhitāstṛṣitāstathā ।
āyānti ca viyanti ca na vaite puṇyabhāginaḥ ।।1.354.80।।
etat sarvaṃ kathitaṃ te pitṛvairupyakāraṇam ।
navīnaṃ bahumūlyaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ sāraṃ dadāti yaḥ ।।81 ।।
tatpitaraḥ smṛddhimanto yānasthā yānti vai divam ।
jīrṇaṃ kṣudraṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ cā'sāraṃ śrāddhe dadāti cet ।।82।।
tatpitaro daridrā vai padbhyāṃ bhramanti yānti ca ।
daridrāṇāṃ daridrāste smṛddhānāṃ smṛddhisaṃjuṣaḥ ।।83।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau vṛddhaḥ pitṛgaṇastataḥ ।
trikālajño dayāklinnaḥ samuvāca hitāya tam ।।84।।
yāvat tṛptirna te bhūyānna bhokṣye'haṃ sthiro bhava ।
pratīkṣasvā''gamanaṃ me tāmānayāmi putrikām ।।85।।
tadā śrāddhaṃ kārayiṣyāmītyuktvā saṃyayau nṛpam ।
rājā tamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma pādayoḥ ṛṣeḥ ।।।86।।।
dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi madgṛhaṃ pāvanaṃ kṛtam ।
adya me saphalaṃ janma pādyamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa gām ।।87।।
iti saṃvadato rājñaḥ satkāraṃ prāpya cābravīt ।
rājan śṛṇu kuru tacca yenā'haṃ toṣito'bhavam ।।88।।
ānaya rājamahiṣīṃ prabhāvatīsamanvitām ।
rājñā''nītā ṛṣiṃ natvā''sanasthāṃ munirabravīt ।।89।।
dhruvatīrthe mayā''ścaryaṃ yaddṛṣṭaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ ।
koṭiśaḥ pitaraḥ sarve yayuḥ putrārcitā divam ।।1.354.90 ।।
eko vṛddhaḥ śuṣkadehaḥ kṣutkṣāmaḥ śuṣkamāṃsakaḥ ।
nirāśo niraye gantukāmo'sau dhruvatīrthake ।।91 ।।
mayā pṛṣṭhaḥ sukāruṇyāt kastvaṃ kimicchasīti ca ।
sa prāha māṃ mama vaṃśe dāsī prabhāvatī tathā ।।92।।
tantuḥ putro virūpakanidhirnāmnā hi vartate ।
sa kuryād yadi me śrāddhaṃ tṛptiḥ syāditi bhūsura ।।93 ।।
prabhāvatyā sutadvārā kāraṇīyaṃ hi tarpaṇam ।
pitṝṇāṃ tu kṛte dattaṃ dānaṃ vāri phalādikam ।।94।।
svadhā ca pāyasaṃ śrāddhaṃ tṛptidaṃ muktidaṃ bhavet ।
ityuktvā pratyayārthaṃ tāṃ prāharṣirmadavihvalām ।।95।।
kiṃ tvayā pitṛtṛptyarthaṃ kṛtaṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ na vā? ।
sā naivamityuvācā'tha na jānāmi ca tān pitṝn ।।96।।
kriyāṃ karma na jānāmi na karomi kadāpi ca ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha samāyāntu drakṣyathā'dya camatkṛtim ।।97।।
iti kṛtvā yayuḥ sarve dhruvatīrthaṃ tu nāgarāḥ ।
brāhmaṇāśca tathā rājā lokāśca bahavastadā ।।98।।
muninā darśitastebhyo vṛddho vicetanaḥ kṛṣaḥ ।
maśakairveṣṭitaḥ kṣudraiḥ kṣudhayā cātipīḍitaḥ ।।99।।
munistaṃ prāha bho janto! tava santānajā sutā ।
saputrā tvatra cāyātā puṣṭyarthaṃ vad vāñchitam ।। 1.354.10 0।।
agatiśca tadovāca snātvā'tra vidhinā mama ।
karotu tarpaṇaṃ nāmnā tataḥ śrāddhaṃ karotu ca ।। 101 ।।
saraupyavastraṃ satilaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ karotu ca ।
tathā'nyadvai yathāśakti dānaṃ karotu cātra vai ।। 1 02।।
yenātraiva bhavanto hi māmīkṣatha sukhānvitam ।
kārayantu yathāśakti śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ hi tantunā ।। 103 ।।
itiśrutvā rājapatnī śrāddhaṃ subahudakṣiṇam ।
dāsyā vai kārayāmāsa tatputreṇa ca sarvathā ।। 104।।
paṭṭavastraṃ phalaṃ dhūpaḥ karpūrāgurucandanam ।
tilottaraṃ pāyasānnaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ ca sapiṇḍakam ।। 1 05।।
jalaṃ tilodakaṃ sarvaṃ yaddattaṃ tena tṛptimān ।
sukṛtī ca sutejasvī devavad dīptimān babhau ।। 1 06।।
tatsadṛśāstu maśakā api tṛptāḥ surūpiṇaḥ ।
devā iva vyajāyanta śuśubhire'tipuṣṭikāḥ ।। 1 07।।
svargāgatairvimānaiśca chāditaṃ tatra vai nabhaḥ ।
te tu devā iva sarve pitarastuṣṭamānasāḥ ।। 1 08।।
procurasmatkulatanturvṛddhiṃ yātu suvaṃśajaiḥ ।
ye śrāddhairvividhairasmān tārayiṣyanti sarvadā ।। 1 09।।
śṛṇvantu vacanaṃ sarve'smadīyaṃ pitṛtuṣṭidam ।
tīrthāni saritaḥ kūpāḥ parvatāśca sarāṃsi ca ।। 1.354.11 0।।
kurukṣetraṃ gayā gaṃgā sthānānyāyatanāni ca ।
pitṝṇāṃ muktidaṃ tvanyanna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।। 111 ।।
bhādre proṣṭhapadīṃ snātvā pratipatprabhṛti tvatha ।
śuklapratipadantaṃ ca tīrthaṃ prāpya sasatvarāḥ ।। 11 2।।
pitaraḥ śrāddhapiṇḍā'dāḥ āśvine dhruvamāsthitāḥ ।
kṛtvā pretapurīṃ śūnyāṃ svargaṃ pātālamityatha ।। 113 ।।
īhamānāḥ svakānputrān gotratantūn tathā'nujān ।
tiṣṭhāmastvatra sahitāḥ svasvavaṃśajapitṛbhiḥ ।। 1 14।।
kanyāṃ gate savitari yaḥ śrāddhaṃ sampradāsyati ।
tarpaṇaṃ dhruvatīrthe te pitṝṇāṃ ṣoḍaśāhake ।। 1 15।।
sutṛptāḥ smo vayaṃ śaśvad yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim ।
dṛṣṭo bhavadbhiḥ pitṝṇāṃ tārako vai vidhiryathā ।। 1 16।।
dustaraṃ tāritaṃ pāpaṃ trikālajñaprasādataḥ ।
iti saṃśrāvya te sarve rājānaṃ ca janānṛṣim ।। 1 17।।
rājñīṃ dāsīṃ ca tatputraṃ saṃbhāṣya śivamastu vaḥ ।
āruhya varayānāni gatāḥ svargaṃ vṛtāḥ suraiḥ ।। 1 18।।
rājā rājñī suto dāsī prajā nāryo narāstataḥ ।
mahadāścaryapūrvāste yayurnijagṛhānprati ।। 11 9।।
cakruśca sarvadā yogye samaye śrāddhatarpaṇam ।
uddhṛtāḥ pitarastaistu dhruvatīrthaprabhāvataḥ ।। 1.354.120।।
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi! māhātmyaṃ mathurābhavam ।
yatsmaraṇād vinaśyanti pāpāni pūrvūjanmanām ।। 121 ।।
paṭhed yaḥ śṛṇuyāccaiva sa dhruvatīrthapuṇyabhāk ।
mathurāyāṃ yamunāyā jalasnānasya puṇyabhāk ।। 1 22।।
yatra kvāpi jalapārśve sthitvā piṇḍaṃ dadāti vai ।
yamunādhruvasattīrthaṃ smṛtvā tvāvāhya pitṛkān ।। 123 ।।
tatra yāmunajalavat pitṛtṛptiḥ prajāyate ।
vaṃśavṛddhistathā''rogyaṃ smṛddhistasya sujāyate ।। 124।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurātīrthamāhātmye dhruvatīrthe samāgatakoṭipitṛtṛptyuttaraṃ trikālajñābhidharṣiṇā kṣudhite ekasmin pitari dṛṣṭe tadvaṃśe candrasenanṛpatidāsīrūpāṃ putrīṃ vijñāya
taddvārā śrāddhaṃ kārayitvā pitṛmuktidānaṃ śrāddhavidhirmahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 354।।


← adhyāyaḥ 354 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 355
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 356 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śrutametanmayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa! jagatprabho! ।
māthurakṣetramāhātmyaṃ saphalaṃ svargamokṣadam ।। 1 ।।
śrāddhaṃ śrāddhaphalaṃ cāpi śrutaṃ te kṛpayā hare! ।
kena tūtpāditaṃ śrāddhaṃ vistareṇa vadasva me ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu priye! kathayāmi śrāddhotpattiviniścayam ।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe mama nābhipadmād brahmā vyajāyata ।। 3 ।।
sa ca putrātmakānutpādayāmāsa surādikān ।
ādityāँśca vasūn rudrānaśvinau ca marudgaṇān ।। 4 ।।
tāraṇārthaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇān bhuvi sarvaśaḥ ।
kṣatriyān vaiśyavarṇāṃśca śūdravarṇāṃstathā paśūn ।। 5 ।।
pakṣiṇaḥ sthāvarāṃstiryakkīṭādyān samapekṣitān ।
ditidvārā tathā daityāndanūdvārā tu dānavān ।। 6 ।।
evaṃ vaidikavijñānānṛṣīṃścāpi tapodhanān ।
teṣāṃ putrāstathā pautrā jātā yaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat ।। 7 ।।
vedhaso netrato jāto nimimtu mānaso nṛpaḥ ।
tasyāpi mānasaḥ putraḥ śrīmānnāmā hyajāyata ।। 8 ।।
jātimātro yuvā jātismaro vedasmarastathā ।
tapaścacāra paramaṃ samādhāya mano harau ।। 9 ।।
paṃcāgnirvāyubhakṣaśca hyekapādordhvabāhukaḥ ।
śīrṇaparṇāmbubhakṣaśca śiśire tu jaleśayaḥ ।। 1.355.1 0।।
kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kurvan varṣāṇāmayutottaram ।
mṛtyukālamanuprāptaḥ pañcatvaṃ samupāgamat ।। 11 ।।
nimiḥ śokaṃ paraṃ prāptaścintayāmāsa tatkṛte ।
māghaśukladvādaśyāṃ sa sṛṣṭvā viṣayaṃ mānasam ।। 12।।
śraddhayā kalpayāmāsa putrārthe kiṃ karomi vai ।
tāvatputro divyadeho divo vimānamārgataḥ ।। 13।।
nimimāgatya sa prāha dehi dānāni matkṛte ।
jalaṃ dehi phalaṃ dehi miṣṭānnaṃ cāmbarāṇi ca ।। 14।।
bhūṣā yānāni pātrāṇi pāyasānnāni dehi me ।
yāni me syātprabhojyāni mūlāni ca rasāstathā ।। 15।।
yāni me'tīva preṣṭhāni dehi me śākabhājikāḥ ।
iti kṛtvoṣitastatra devadhūnītaṭe hime ।। 16 ।।
nimirāmantrya saptarṣīn śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ ।
dakṣiṇāvartataḥ sarvamakurvan ṛṣisattamāḥ ।। 17।।
saptakṛtvastatra tatra yugapat samupāviśan ।
dadustvannāni śākāni mūlāni ca phalāni ca ।। 18।।
nimirviprān prasaṃpūjya saptakṛtvaśca sundari! ।
kṛtvā tu dakṣiṇāgrāṃśca kuśāṃśca prayatastadā ।। 19।।
pradadau śrīmate piṇḍānnāmagotramudāharan ।
jalaṃ phalaṃ dalaṃ cānnaṃ pāyasaṃ cāmbarādikam ।। 1.355.20 ।।
dadau putrāya divyāya jagrāha sa ca sarvathā ।
pratyakṣaṃ nītavānsarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bubhuje papau ।।2 1 ।।
tathā saptarṣiṣu punaḥ praviśya bubhuje muhuḥ ।
tṛpto'smi cātitṛpto'smītyuccāryā''sādya vastukam ।।22।।
divaṃ vimānamāruhya jagāma śrāddhatoṣitaḥ ।
arke tvastaṃ gate rājā bhāvasandhyāmasevata ।।23 ।।
rātrau cintayituṃ rabdhaḥ putrārthaṃ yatsamācarat ।
kṛtvā sa piṇḍadānādi paścāttāpaṃ cakāra saḥ ।।24।।
akṛtaṃ munibhiḥ pūrvaṃ kiṃ mayā tadanuṣṭhitam ।
nivāpakarma tvaśuci putrārthe viniyojitam ।।25।।
aho snehaprabhāveṇa mayā mṛtyuttaraṃ kṛtam ।
naitatkarma śavakarma garhyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mayā ।।26।।
kiṃ vakṣyanti ca māṃ sarve ye vai pitṛpade sthitāḥ ।
sadevāsuragandharvapiśācoragarākṣasāḥ ।। 27।।
ityevaṃ cintayānasya brāhma prātarabhūttataḥ ।
sandhyā cakāra hutvā'gnīn punaścintāṃ samācarat ।। 28।।
aho me jīvitaṃ vyarthaṃ putro yatra na dṛśyate ।
narakaṃ pūtikākhyaṃ vai hṛdi duḥkhaṃ samucyate ।। 29 ।।
putre sati na vai duḥkhaṃ svargaṃ bhavati sarvathā ।
putreṇa labhate svargaṃ pautreṇa tu pitāmahāḥ ।।1.355.3 0 ।।
atha putrasya pautreṇa modante prapitāmahāḥ ।
putreṇa śrīmatā hīnaṃ nā'haṃ jīvitumutsahe ।।3 1 ।।
etasminnantare lakṣmi! nāradastvājagāma ha ।
tejasā -bhrājamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā pupūja vai nṛpaḥ ।।32।।
satkṛtaścāsane tūpaviṣṭo nārada āha tam ।
nime! śṛṇu mahāprājña! śokaṃ mā kuru śokahan! ।।33 ।।
anityaṃ gatvaraṃ dehaṃ kathaṃ prājña! viśocasi ।
mṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ gataṃ yāntaṃ nānuśocanti saddhiyaḥ ।।34।।
gato nivartate naiva hasanti śokinaṃ janāḥ ।
amaratvaṃ martyaloke paśyāmi na carācare ।।।35।।।
satyātpātālaparyantāḥ sarve kālavaśā janāḥ ।
jātasya sarvabhūtasya mṛtyurnirṇīta eva ha ।।36 ।।
avaśyameva gantavyaṃ tvayā mayā ca vedhasā ।
tava putro mahātmā'bhūcchrīmānnāma śriyo nidhiḥ ।।37।।
pūrṇaṃ tapo mahat kṛtvā yayau sa paramāṃ gatim ।
evaṃ muktasya tu kṛte naiva śocitumarhasi ।।38।।
ityuktaḥ sa nimiḥ pādau praṇamya śirasā muneḥ ।
savrīḍo niḥśvasan bhīto dīnavatprāha nāradam ।।39।।
sānvito'smi tvayā vipra! kintu vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ।
gataḥ sa tu gata eva na cā''yāti gataḥ punaḥ ।।1.355.40 ।।
paraṃ mayā śavapaścāt kalpayitvā ca yat kṛtam ।
na tu śrutaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ na devaiḥ pūrvajaiḥ kṛtam ।।41 ।।
śokasyaiva prabhāveṇa śavamuddiśya yatkṛtam ।
tarpayitvā dvijān sapta tvannādyaiśca phalairapi ।।42।।
paścād visarjitaṃ piṇḍaṃ darbhānāstīrya bhūtale ।
udakānayanaṃ caiva hyapasavyena vāsitam ।।43 ।।
etadvai nūtanaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bibhemi tena vai ।
śrutvā tannāradaḥ prāha na bhetavyaṃ tvayā nṛpa! ।।44।।
adharmaṃ nātra paśyāmi pitaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।
ityuktaḥ sa nimirdhyātvā pitaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।45।।
tāvatputrastapodhanaḥ śrīmānnāmā samāgataḥ ।
uvāca nime! tvatkṛtaṃ kalpitaṃ pitṛyajñakam ।।46 ।।
pitṛyajñātmako dharmo brahmaṇā kalpito'sti vai ।
sa ca karmātmakastvayā manmiṣeṇa prakāśitaḥ ।।47।।
śrāddhadharmaḥ pitṛyajñaḥ kratustvayā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
pūrvapūrvasṛṣṭidharmaḥ śrāddhadharmaścirantanaḥ ।।48।।
kṛtaḥ svayaṃbhuvā pūrvaṃ śrāddhātmā vidhireva saḥ ।
pretakarma śrāddhadharmaḥ kartavyaḥ sarvathā janaiḥ ।।49।।
jātasya vai mṛteḥ paścādavaśyaṃ kvāpi saṃsthitiḥ ।
tatra prāptyarthamaivātra kartavyaṃ śraddhayā'rpaṇam ।।1.355.50 ।।
amokṣasya bhavet tṛptirmuktau tṛptistu śāśvatī ।
mokṣaḥ karmaviśeṣeṇa prāyaścittena ca dhruvam ।।51 ।।
dīrghāyuṣo hyapi yānti kiṃ punaḥ svalpakā''yuṣaḥ ।
alpāyuṣo janāḥ paścād bhaviṣyanti yugāntare ।।52।।
tāmasā rājasāścāpi bhaviṣyanti viśeṣataḥ ।
teṣāṃ tu kugatau śrāddhaṃ gatidaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।।।53 ।।
tāmasaṃ narakaṃ vidyāt tiryagyoniṃ ca rākṣasīm ।
krauryaṃ bhayaṃ viṣādaśca hiṃsā nirlajjatā tamaḥ ।।54।।
ajñānitvaṃ ca paiśācaṃ tāmasānāṃ svabhāvajāḥ ।
tāmasaṃ taṃ vijānīyāducyamāno na buddhyati ।।।55।।
durmadā'śraddhadhānaṃ ca parā'pakaraṇodyatam ।
rājasaḥ prabalo vāṇyāṃ svadhṛtā'tmajanaḥ sadā ।।।56।।
śūraḥ sarvatra vyaktaśca viṣayehāprapūritaḥ ।
eteṣāṃ paraloke vai tṛptyarthaṃ śrāddhamarthitam ।।57।।
sāttviko mokṣabhāgī syāt kṣānto dānto viśuddhahṛt ।
śraddhālustapasā yukto svādhyāyādisamanvitaḥ ।।58।।
eteṣvapi yadi putreṣaṇā lokeṣaṇā tathā ।
dhaneṣaṇā tathā dāreṣaṇā kāmeṣaṇā ca vā ।।59।।
bhavettena pravāheṇa paratra pretatāṃ vrajet ।
tasya tṛptikṛteśrāddhadānahavanakarmaṇām ।।1.355.60।।
kalpanā vedhasā pūrvaṃ kṛtā tvayā prasāritā ।
evaṃ saṃcintayānastu na śokaṃ kartumarhasi ।।6 1 ।।
tyaja śokaṃ mahāprājña! śokaḥ sarvavināśanaḥ ।
śoko dahati gātrāṇi buddhiḥ śokena naśyati ।।62।।
lajjā dhṛtiśca dharmaśca śrīḥ kīrtiśca smṛtirnayaḥ ।
tyajanti sarvadharmāśca śokenopahataṃ naram ।।63।।
evaṃ śokaṃ parityajya viśoko bhava bhūpate! ।
mūḍhaḥ snehaprabhāveṇa yāti saṃsārabandhanam ।।64।।
tasmāt snehaṃ prasaṃyamya buddhiṃ dharme niyojayet ।
dharmo lokahitārthāya sa śrāddhaṃ dānamarcanam ।।65 ।।
satkāro havanaṃ ceti pañcadhā prāyaśo mataḥ ।
mṛtānāṃ tṛptidaṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tu jīvatāṃ sukham ।।66 ।।
pratimāyā arcanaṃ śaṃ satkāraḥ prāṇināṃ sukham ।
havanaṃ dyugatānā śaṃ dātā'pi phalabhāg bhavet ।।67।।
mṛtyukāle yadicchā syāt pūraṇīyā viśeṣataḥ ।
mriyamāṇasya santoṣaḥ paralokagatipradaḥ ।।68।।
kaṇṭhasthānaṃ gate jīve śīghraṃ niḥsārayed gṛhāt ।
kuśāstaraṇaśayyāsthaṃ snehabhāvena vācayet ।।69।।
suvarṇaṃ tanmukhe dadyājjalaṃ dadyād vratādikam ।
puṇyaṃ dadyācca gāṃ dadyātparalokahitāvahām ।।1.355.70 ।।
dogdhrīṇāṃ tu gavāṃ dānācchīghraṃ mucyeta kilbiṣāt ।
tasya karṇe harernāma śrāvayenmuktisādhanam ।।71 ।।
madhuparkaṃ madhu sarpirdadhi dadyāttadoṣṭhayoḥ ।
evaṃ viniḥsṛte prāṇe saṃsāraṃ nādhigacchati ।।72।।
tato'stha ghṛtagandhādyaiḥ kṛtvā vai dehaśodhanam ।
dakṣiṇāyāṃ śiraḥ kṛtvā tīrthasnānaṃ prakārayet ।।73।।
śreṣṭhavanaspatikāṣṭhaiścitāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ।
dakṣiṇaśirasā sthāpya kṛtvā haste hutāśanam ।।74।।
daha tvetasya gātrāṇītyuktvā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ।
pradāpayecchiraḥsthāne bhasmībhāvottaraṃ tataḥ ।।75।।
gātrāṇi vāsasī caiva prakṣālya vinivartayet ।
mṛtaṃ nāma tadoddiśya dadyāt piṇḍaṃ mahītale ।।76।।
gatāyuṣastṛtīye'hni snānaṃ kuryānnadījale ।
piṇḍaṃ sacūraṇaṃ dadyāt trīṃśca dadyājjalāṃjalīn ।।77।।
caturthe pañcame ṣaṣṭhe piṇḍamekaṃ jalāṃjalim ।
saptame'ṣṭamanavamadaśameṣu tathaiva ha ।।78।।
daśame vastrasaṃśuddhirgātraśuddhiśca sarvathā ।
kartavyā gotrajaistilā''malakasnehatastataḥ ।।79।।
piṇḍadānaṃ vinirvartya kṣaurakarma tu kārayet ।
snānaṃ kṛtvā jñātibhiśca tata ekādaśe dine ।।1.355.80।।
snātvā pretaṃ brāhmaṇeṣu yojayetkārayettathā ।
ekoddiṣṭaṃ vipramekaṃ sudravyeṇa hi bhojayet ।।81।।
punaḥ snātvā ca taṃ pretaṃ preteṣu saṃniyojayet ।
ekoddiṣṭaṃ trivarṇeṣu kartavyaṃ pākabhojanam ।।।82।।।
apākadravyaṃ saṃgrāhyaṃ caturthavarṇakasya tu ।
trayodaśe dine pakvairbhojayed brāhmaṇān sataḥ ।।83।।
manasā vāyubhūtastvaṃ viprān sādhūn samāśraya ।
viprasatāṃ kṛtā sevā pretāya sukhadā bhavet ।।84।।
pretabhogaśarīraṃ vai viprasatoḥ prakalpitam ।
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāmudite tu divākare ।।85।।
śmaśrukarma prakartavyaṃ viprasya tu yathāvidhi ।
snāpanā'bhyaṃjane kārye pretasantoṣadāyake ।।86 ।।
sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayed bhūmau pretakāryaṃ samācaret ।
yaṃ deśaṃ tu na paśyanti kukkuṭaśvānasūkarāḥ ।।87।।
śvā cāpohati rāveṇa garjitena tu sūkaraḥ ।
kukkuṭaḥ pakṣavātena cāṇḍālo darśanena ca ।।88।।
tatra kurvanti yacchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ bandhanapradam ।
sthaṇḍile pretabhāgaṃ tu dadyāt pūrvāhṇikaṃ tu tat ।।89।।
kuryācca piṇḍasaṃkalpaṃ nāmagotramudāharan ।
tataścāśnanti gotrāṇi kulajāścaikabhojanāḥ ।।1.355.90।।
evaṃ dattena prīyante pretalokagatā janāḥ ।
chatraṃ dadyādagnibhasmaśilāvṛṣṭyādivāraṇam ।।91 ।।
dadyāccopānahau mārgakaṇṭakādinivārakau ।
dhūpaṃ dadyāt pradīpaṃ ca vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।।।92।।
phalānyapi supakvāni pretabhogyāni vai dadet। ।
evaṃ sarvaṃ vinirvartya pakvānnaṃ bhojayed dvijam ।।93।।
prathamaṃ brāhmaṇastatra pretabhāgaṃ prakalpayet ।
hastaśaucaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vipro miṣṭaṃ hi bhakṣayet ।।94।।
jñātibāndhavamitraiśca brāhmaṇāya punaḥ punaḥ ।
pretabhāgaḥ pradātavyo vāraṇīyo na kenacit ।।95 ।।
nivāraṇe kṛte tatra gṛhṇanti pitaro na vai ।
evaṃ vilupyate dharmaḥ pretastatra na tuṣyati ।। 96।।
tṛpte vipre salilaṃ ca dātavyaṃ śītalaṃ śubham ।
ucchiṣṭaṃ tu saridādau matsyebhyo deyameva hi ।।97।।
dadyācchayyāsanaṃ cāpi tathaivā'ñjanakaṃkaṇam ।
nivāpasthānamāgatya dadyāttilodakaṃ tataḥ ।।98।।
gavāṃ lāṃgūlamuddhṛtya dadyād brāhmaṇahastake ।
pātreṇodumbarasthena kṛtvā kṛṣṇatilodakam ।।99।।
mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ dadyāt toyenā'bhyukṣya vai tataḥ ।
pretaṃ visarjayed viprād dadyād dānaṃ dvijātaye ।। 1.355.1 00।।
pipīlikādibhūtebhyaḥ pretabhāgaṃ prakalpayet ।
dīnānātheṣu bhakteṣu preto bhavati tṛptimān ।। 101 ।।
evaṃ śrāddhātmakaḥ sarvaiḥ pretabhāvaviśodhanaḥ ।
karttavya eva saṃskāro nime! tvayā tu sa kṛtaḥ ।। 1 02।।
ayaṃ śrāddhakriyākalpaḥ kraturekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।
ita āramya lokeṣu pitṛyajño bhaviṣyati ।। 103 ।।
yajñakartā bhavān nime! brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati ।
evaṃ sarvaiḥ pradātavyaḥ pretabhāgastṛtīyake ।। 1 04।।
māse tu saptame navame cāpyekādaśe tathā ।
tataḥ sāṃvatsarīṃ kuryāt kriyāṃ pretasya muktaye ।। 1 05।।
pūrṇe samvatsare yāte pretakāryaṃ kṛte tataḥ ।
prayānti jantavo muktiṃ kecid bhramanti cā'mbare ।। 106 ।।
pitāmahaḥ snuṣā bhāryā jñātisambandhibāndhavāḥ ।
evamete bahavo'tra santi svapnopamāstu te ।। 1 07।।
ruditvā tu kṣaṇaṃ sarve yānti parāṅmukhā hi te ।
snehapāśena baddhāste mucyante ca kṣaṇāntare ।। 108 ।।
kasya mātā pitā kasya kasya bhāryā sutāstathā ।
dine dine vivartante mohapāśaprabandhanāḥ ।। 1 09।।
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca ।
saṃsāreṣvanubhūyante kasya te kasya vā vayam ।। 1.355.110 ।।
svayaṃ bhuvā vidhiḥ proktaḥ pretasaṃskāralakṣaṇaḥ ।
snehabhāvena karttavyaḥ saṃskāro'yaṃ mṛtasya vai ।। 111 ।।
pretakārye nivṛtte tu pitṛtvamupajāyate ।
māsi māsi hyamāyāṃ vai karttavyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam ।। 1 12।।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।
brāhmaṇasya mukhe homāt tṛpyanti sādhubhojanāt ।। 113 ।।
evamuktvā muniśreṣṭho nāradastu divaṃ yayau ।
ityevaṃ niminā rājñā kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ purā yuge ।। 1 14।।
tataḥ prabhṛti śrāddhaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ kurvanti bhūsurāḥ ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! śrāddhapiṇḍodbhavādikam ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthurakṣetramāhātmye niminṛpatinā śrīmānnāmno mṛtaputrasyārthe śrāddhaṃ kṛtam, paścāt kalpitakarmā'pratiṣṭhitamiti jñātvā śokaṃ kurvate nimaye nāradena śrāddhaṃ purātano dharma ityupadiṣṭam, śrāddhakriyākramaścokta ityādi nirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 355 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 356
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 357 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śrutaṃ śrāddhaṃ pretabhojyaṃ kṛpayā tava keśava! ।
nanu viprāḥ pretabhāgaṃ dānaṃ gṛhṇanti bhojanam ।। 1 ।।
aniṣṭaṃ garhitaṃ cāpi pretā''veśena bhojanam ।
bhuktvā pretasya viprastu mucyate kena karmaṇā ।। 2 ।।
kathaṃ sa tārayed garhyo dātāraṃ puruṣottama! ।
iti me saṃśayaṃ chindhi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho! ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
samyak pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā lakṣmi! saṃśayaṃ nāśayāmi te ।
yastu yatirbhaved vipro mahābhāgavatastu yaḥ ।। 4 ।।
mahāyogī mahājñānī siddhyaiśvaryādibhūṣitaḥ ।
mahattapodhano yaśca vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।। 5 ।।
dhyānaṃ ca dhāraṇā yasya samādhiścāpi vidyate ।
trikālajño yamaniyamādisadgumaṇḍitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
ṣaṭkarmanirato nityaṃ haryārādhanatatparaḥ ।
preto yatpadrajaḥsparśād divi devo'bhijāyate ।। 7 ।।
sādhuśīlaḥ sadā śuddho vahnivacchodhako bhavet ।
sa vai pretānnamābhuktvā gṛhītvā dānamityapi ।। 8 ।।
kṛtvā karmāṇi pretasya na taddoṣeṇa lipyate ।
puṃprakṛtyorvivekajño brahmātmaikyaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 9 ।।
pāpakṣālanasāmarthyo na taddoṣeṇa lipyate ।
na śarvarīkṛtaṃ dhvāntaṃ sūryaṃ kvacid vilumpati ।। 1.356.10 ।।
dhvāntaṃ prakāśatāṃ yāti sūryakiraṇasannidhau ।
pretasya pretatā tādṛgyogena devatā bhavet ।।1 1 ।।
pretatvaṃ brahmayogena devatve parivartate ।
pāpaṃ puṇyatamaṃ syācca samarthe nāsti dūṣaṇam ।।12।।
yastu nātmabalāḍhyo vā nāpi brahmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
nāpi brahmavrataṃ puṣṭo na ṣaṭkarmādiyogavān ।। 1 3।।
nā''tmajño na vivekajñaḥ sa vipro lipyate hyaghaiḥ ।
pretabhojī preta eva malino jāyate bhujeḥ ।। 14।।
sa svadehasya śuddhyarthaṃ kuryādekamupoṣaṇam ।
sandhyāṃ prātaḥ sa nirvartya kṛtvā caivāgnitarpaṇam ।। 15।।
tilahomaṃ prakurvīta śāntimantrān paṭhan dvijaḥ ।
prāksrotasaṃ nadaṃ gatvā snātvā ca pañcagavyakam ।।16।।
madhuparkayutaṃ pītvā gṛhaṃ sammārjya prokṣayet ।
agnimukhān surāँstarpayitvā bhūtabaliṃ caret ।। 17।।
viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād godānaṃ prasamācaret ।
evaṃ yaḥ kurute vipraḥ sa śuddho jāyate dhruvam ।। 18।।
evaṃ kṛte tato mṛtyau sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।
anyathā kāladharmaṃ tu yāte pretānnakodare ।। 1 9।।
preta eva bhavet so'pi niraye vāsamāpnuyāt ।
prāpnuyādrākṣasabhāvaṃ tato mucyeta kilbiṣāt ।।1.356.20।।
prāyaścittamanaḥ kāryaṃ dātṛbhoktṛsukhāvaham ।
gohastyaśvadhanaratnakṣetradāsīvibhūṣaṇam ।। 21 ।।
pratigṛhṇan samantraṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ carettu yaḥ ।
sa śuddhottārayeccāpi dātāraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।22।।
daive ca janmanakṣatre śrāddhakāle praparvasu ।
pretakāryeṣu sarvatra vipraṃ ṣaṭkarmaśālinam ।।23 ।।
vedavidyāvratasnātaṃ dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca tapasvinam ।
śīlasantoṣasatyādiguṇayuktaṃ kṣamāyutam ।।24।।
ahiṃsādiyamayuktaṃ bhagavatsuparāyaṇam ।
pātraṃ prāpya prakuryādvai śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ prapūjanam ।।25।।
sa śuddhastārayet sarvānātmānaṃ cāpi tārayet ।
na hi śilā śilā kvāpi tārayet tārakaṃ vinā ।।26 ।।
na hyaśuddhaḥ kvacittvanyān tārayetpāpasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
śuddho vai tārayeccānyāँstasmāt pātre prayojayet ।।27।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! nṛpaḥ pūrvaṃ medhātithirabhūnmahān ।
avantyāṃ tvabhavaccandraśarmā tasya purohitaḥ ।।28।।
rājā gavāṃ śataṃ dānaṃ datvā bhuṃkte dine dine ।
rājñaḥ piturdinaṃ prāptaṃ vaiśākhe śrāddhakarmaṇaḥ ।।29।।
āhūtān brāhmaṇānnatvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ ।
piṇḍānnirvāpya ca śrāddhe kalpitānnaṃ dadau bahu ।।1.356.3 0।।
dānaṃ vastravibhūṣāṇāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tathā ।
tanmadhye brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidbalahīno'tipāpavān ।।3 1 ।।
vyabhicārasamutpannaḥ śūdrabījādimiśritaḥ ।
śrāddhānnaṃ jagṛhe tatra tena doṣeṇa bhūbhṛtaḥ ।।32।।
pitaraḥ patitāḥ svargād bhraṣṭā vane sakaṇṭake ।
kṣutpipāsārditā nityaṃ krandanti vai punaḥ punaḥ ।।33।।
medhātithirdaivayogād bhramaṇārthaṃ vanaṃ gataḥ ।
tānbhramataḥ sa papraccha ke bhavantaḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ।।34।।
pitarastaṃ tadā prāhurasmadvaṃśe hi vidyate ।
nṛpo medhātithistasya vayaṃ smaḥ pitaro vane ।।35।।
patitāḥ sma divo bhraṣṭāḥ śrāddhadoṣeṇa bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
śrāddhānnaṃ tvarthitaṃ tena pāpiṣṭhabrahmabandhave ।।36।।
karmabhraṣṭavyavāyotthanāmamātradvijāya vai ।
tenaiva karmadoṣeṇa narakaṃ gantumipsavaḥ ।। 37 । ।
tatra duḥkhaṃ mahadbhukttā punargacchāmahe divam ।
viprebhyastu gavāṃ dānāt tatpuṇyena punardivam ।। 38 ।।
gamiṣyāmaḥ kintu tatra nāstyanna tṛptidāyakam ।
iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha medhātithirahaṃ hi saḥ । । 39 ।।
bhavatāṃ tāraṇārthaṃ kiṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ vadantu me ।
pitaraḥ prāhurenaṃ te yathā tṛptirbhaveddhi naḥ । ।1.356.40 । ।
tathā śrāddhaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ bhojanīyā dvijottamāḥ ।
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā medhātithiragād gṛham ।।41 ।।
āhūtavān dvijān sādhūn vedapāṭhakṛtaśramān ।
puṇyān dharmaparān kṣāntān suśīlān sutapasvinaḥ ।।42 ।।
yamaiśca niyamairyuktānmahābhāgavatānsataḥ ।
rājā śrāddhaṃ cakārātha piṇḍānnirvāpya sarvathā ।।43 ।।
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa dakṣiṇābhiḥ prapūjya ca ।
natvā visarjayāmāsa tataḥ sa bubhuje nṛpaḥ ।।44 ।।
tato vanaṃ svayaṃ yāto dṛṣṭavāँśca svakān pitṝn ।
hṛṣṭānpuṣṭān balairyuktān divaṃ gantuṃ samudyatān । ।45 ।।
dṛṣṭvā'timumude bhūbhṛt prāhuśca pitaro nṛpam ।
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmaḥ svargalokaṃ prati nṛpa! । ।46 ।।
kadāpi naiva pradātavyaṃ kupātrāyā'tipāpine ।
daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca vā tatra dattaṃ niṣphalameva yat ।।47 ।।
daive pitrye supātraṃ ced brāhmaṇo naiva labhyate ।
saṃkalpitaṃ tadannaṃ tu gobhyo deyaṃ yathāvidhi । ।48 ।।
gavāmabhāve nadyāṃ vā kṣipedanna prayatnataḥ ।
apātrāya na dātavyaṃ nāstikāya gurudruhe । ।49 । ।
golakāya na dātavyaṃ kuṇḍāya saṃkarāya ca ।
ityuktvā pitaraḥ sarve gatāḥ svargaṃ vimānakaiḥ । ।।1.356.5 0 । ।
medhātithirgṛhaṃ prāyād jñātvā pātrabalābale ।
tasmāllakṣmi! dharmaniṣṭhe! eko'pi brāhmaṇottamaḥ ।।5 1 ।।
santārayati durgebhyo viṣayebhyo na saṃśayaḥ ।
tasmācchrāddhe bhojanīyāḥ santo bhāgavatā dvijāḥ ।।5 2 । ।
māse māse'thavā pitṛpakṣe pātratapodhanāḥ ।
devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām ।।53 । ।
tārakā bhojanīyā vai brahmabodhaparā janāḥ ।
sādhvyaḥ satyo bhojanīyā brahmacaryaparāstathā ।।।54। ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! satpātraṃ tārayet pitṝn ।
asatpātra bhraṃśayedvai prāyaścittaṃ tataścaret ।।55 ।।
śrīlakṣmīḥ prāha tacchrutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
pretāḥ svakarmabhiryānti yonyantaraṃ śarīriṇaḥ ।।56।।
paśupakṣimanuṣyādyāḥ kathamāgatya bhuṃjate ।
ka ete pitaraḥ kṛṣṇa! śrāddhaṃ bhokṣyantyupasthitāḥ ।।57।।
mṛtāḥ kecittu narake yamapāśavaśaṃgatāḥ ।
kecittu devavarge vai kuṭumbisuvaśaṃgatāḥ ।।58।।
kecit karmavaśālloke caturaśītiyoniṣu ।
dehino vaśagāstatra bandhane patitāḥ sadāḥ ।।59।।
śrāddhe śaktā na cā''gantuṃ kathaṃ śrāddhaṃ prabhuṃjate ।
iti me saṃśayaṃ nātha! sammārjaya virodhinam ।।1.356.6 0 ।।
vaṃśaparamparāṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyaṃ yena rakṣyate ।
yuge yugāntare cāpi kartavyaṃ yena rakṣyate ।।6 1 ।।
iti śrutvā mahālakṣmīvākyaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
saṃśayaṃ mārjayan lakṣmyāḥ provāca parameśvaraḥ ।।62।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! prabhoktāraḥ pitṛyajñeṣu sarvadā ।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।।63 ।।
traya ete bhavantyeva śrāddhabhoktāra īśvarāḥ ।
pitā tu brahmadaivatyo vedhogātrādvinirmitaḥ ।।64।।
pitāmaho viṣṇudevo viṣṇugātrādvinirmitaḥ ।
prapitāmaho rudreśo rudragātrādvinirmitaḥ ।।65।।
śrāddhe niyojitāste'tra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
prathamaṃ brahmaṇoṃ'śāya dadyācchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam ।।66।।
dvitīyaṃ viṣṇoraṃśāya dadyācchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam ।
tṛtīyaṃ rudrasyāṃśāya dadecchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam ।।67।।
pitre pitāmahāyā'tha hi prapitāmahāya ca ।
tridevarūpatāpannaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ ।।68।।
yatra mṛtā januṃ prāptāstatrāntaryāmibhāvataḥ ।
vyāpakaḥ saṃsthitaḥ kṛṣṇastṛptiṃ tānprāpayatyapi ।।69।।
evaṃ vipreṣu sa kṛṣṇo'ntaryāmī satsu vartate ।
śrāddhakāle yaduddeśastadrūpo bhavati prabhuḥ ।।1.356.70 ।।
śrāddhaṃ piṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā ca preto yatra gato bhavet ।
tatra prāpayati tasmai kṛṣnārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।71 ।।
iti viddhi mahālakṣmi! yonyantaragatārthadaḥ ।
ahameva bhavāmyatra śrāddhe pitrādirūpakaḥ ।।।72।।
athānyacca śṛṇu lakṣmi! vistarātpravadāmi te ।
kecid yajanti vai brahmayajñaṃ mūrtau satāṃ mukhe ।।73 ।।
kecid yajanti vai devayajñaṃ kuṇḍe hutāśane ।
kecid yajanti vai bhūtayajñaṃ paśau gavāṃ mukhe ।।74।।
kecid yajanti manujakratu nare dvijānane ।
kecid yajanti vai pitṝn jale'gnau bhvāṃ dvijānane ।।75।।
sarve te mayi vartante satyametad bravīmi te ।
kiñca sarvavidhe yāge vahnirmukhyo mukhātmakaḥ ।।76।।
vahnimukhena cāśnanti pretapitṝṣidevatāḥ ।
ahaṃ ca bhagavān kṛṣṇaścādmi vahnimukhena vai ।।77।।
kuṇḍasthā'gnirahaṃ cāsmi dakṣiṇāgnirahaṃ tathā ।
ahaṃ cāhavanīyāgniḥ pāvanaḥ pāvakastathā ।। 78।।
vaiśvadevāgnirahaṃ vai gārhapatyo'pyahaṃ tathā ।
bārhaspatyo'pyahaṃ caivā''vasathyo'pyahameva ca ।।79।।
tanmukho'haṃ tridevātmā bhuje sarvakratuṣvapi ।
pitṛyajñe brahmamukhe bhuṃje'haṃ tattrayātmakaḥ ।।1.356.80।।
śrotriyaṃ dharmaśīlaṃ ca mahābhāgavataṃ dvijam ।
śrāddhe saṃbhojayejjītendriyaṃ santuṣṭameva ca ।।81 ।।
datvā hutāśanāyā''dau devatīrthasvarūpiṇe ।
paścād vipramukhe dadyāt pitre pitāmahāya ca ।।।82।।
vai prapitāmahāyāpi smṛtvā dadyātpunaḥ punaḥ ।
pracchannaṃ bhojayed vipraṃ tatra pitṝn samāhvayet । ।83।।
piṇḍāstrayaḥ pradātavyāḥ saha vyañjanasaṃyutāḥ ।
apasavyena dātavyaṃ māsi māsi tilodakam ।।84।।
paramātmā śarīrastho devatānāṃ vahāmyaham ।
evaṃ dattena prīyante pitaraśca na saṃśayaḥ ।।85।।
trayo devāstraya eva pitaro hariniḥsṛtāḥ ।
pitṛdevā bhaviṣyanti bhoktāraśca yuge yuge ।।86 ।।
āyuḥ kīrtiṃ bala tejo dhanaṃ putrān paśūn striyaḥ ।
dadate pitarastasya tvārogyaṃ piṇḍadāyinaḥ ।।87।।
vipre saṃbhojite tṛpte tiryaṅnārakamānuṣāḥ ।
yatra kvāpi sthitāścānye tṛpyanti śrāddhatarpitāḥ ।।88।।
te sāttvikaṃ śuklamārgaṃ tṛptā yānti divaṃ param ।
punaranyat pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tattvena sundari ।।89।।
ajñānatamasā vyāptāḥ pāpā bhraṣṭā mṛtā janāḥ ।
snehapāśaśatairbaddhāḥ pacyante narake'śucau ।।1.356.90 ।।
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca kadācidapi vaṃśajāḥ ।
muñcanti jalabindūँśca amāṃ prāpya jalāśaye ।।91 ।।
tenaiva bhāvitā tṛptisteṣāṃ nirayagāminām ।
tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhamevāpi piṇḍān tilodakaṃ tathā ।। 92।।
samarpyaṃ tārayet pitṝn dvijātirbhaktibhāvataḥ ।
deyo nīlo vṛṣaścāpi narakārtivināśanaḥ ।।93।।
nīlaṣaṇḍasya lāṃgūle toyamapyuddhared yadi ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi pitarastena tarpitāḥ ।।94।।
uddhṛto yadi paṃkasya piṇḍaḥ śṛṃgeṇa tena vai ।
uddhṛtāḥ pitarastena somalokaṃ samāpitāḥ ।।95।।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca ।
somalokeṣu modante kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ tu vivarjitāḥ ।।96।।
evaṃ gṛhasthadharmo'yaṃ putrapautrādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ।
śrāddhātmakaḥ satṛṣṇānāmuddhārāya vinirmitaḥ ।।97।।
pipīlikādibhūtāni jaṃgamāśca vihaṃgamāḥ ।
sthāvarāścopajīvanti gṛhastheṣu na saṃśayaḥ ।।98।।
māsi māsi tu ye śrāddhaṃ prakurvanti gṛhāśrame ।
tithau parvaṇi sadvāre svapitṝँstārayanti te ।।99।।
pitaro nirgatāste vai brahmaviṣṇuśarīragāḥ ।
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ।। 1.356.100 ।।
evaṃ krameṇa te paścāt kāśyapā devatā iti ।
samabhavaँstataste vai śrāddheṣu viniyojitāḥ ।। 101 ।।
pitṛyajñe vipramukhe dattaṃ vai kevalaṃ tadā ।
tadā tvajīrṇatāṃ prāptāḥ pitaro'jīrṇapīḍitāḥ ।। 1 02।।
somena sahitā jagmuḥ praṇamya ca pitāmaham ।
procurvayaṃ hyajīrṇena pīḍitā vāraṇaṃ kuru ।। 1 03।।
yena naśyatyajīrṇaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca sukhaṃ bhavet ।
brahmā prāha tadā yo'sti śāṇḍilyasya suputrakaḥ ।। 1 04।।
dhūmraketurvibhāvasustejasvī jīrṇatākaraḥ ।
śrāddhe tu prathamaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ mānuṣeṣu vā ।। 1 05।।
saha tenaiva bhoktavyaṃ pitṛpiṇḍavisarjitam ।
tāvatsmṛto havyavāhaḥ sarvabhakṣo hutāśanaḥ ।। 1 06।।
yojitaḥ pañcayajñeṣu brahmaṇā sarvakarmasu ।
bhoktavyaṃ prathamaṃ vahne! pitṛpiṇḍavisarjitam ।। 1 07।।
tvayā bhuṃkte prabhokṣyanti devatāḥ pitarastvime ।
śrāddhaṃ dvitīyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ sahaiva vahnipitṛbhiḥ ।। 1 08।।
tṛtīyaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ tu somapitṛhutāśanaiḥ ।
militvaiva prabhoktavyaṃ hyajīrṇaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।। 1 09।।
ityuktāḥ pitṛyajñe te bhuṃjate sahitā sadā ।
vahniḥ pitā pitāmahaḥ prapitāmaha eva ca ।। 1.356.11 0।।
somaśceti bhuṃjate vai pitṛdevahutāśanāḥ ।
apāṃkteyāstadā viprā bhojanīyā na vai kvacit ।। 111 ।।
apāṃkteyān pravakṣyāmi karmato hīnatāṃ gatān ।
napuṃsakāścitrakārāḥ paśupālā vinindakāḥ ।। 112।।
svarṇacaurāstathā kāṇāḥ kuṣṭhino nāstikāstathā ।
nartakā gāyakāścāpi tathā nāṭakajīvinaḥ ।। 113 ।।
vedavikrayiṇaścāpi sarvayājakayājakāḥ ।
bhṛtyakarmakarā rājyakiṃkarāḥ sakarāstathā ।। 1 14।।
saṃskārahīnāḥ patitā śūdrakarmopajīvinaḥ ।
gaṇakā grāmyayājino lekhakā dāṃbhikāstathā ।। 115।।
sarvakarmakarā bhraṣṭā madyamāṃsavyavāyinaḥ ।
anye ye dūṣitāste vai dvijarūpaistu rākṣasāḥ । । 116 । ।
tān bhuṃjataḥ prapaśyantaḥ pitaro duḥkhamāpnuyuḥ ।
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ śīghraṃ kuryācchrāddhaṃ punaścaret । । 117 । ।
ghṛtaṃ tu juhuyādagnāvādityaṃ tvavalokayet ।
punarāvapanaṃ kṛtvā pitaraṃ ca pitāmahān । । 118 ।।
dadyād gandhaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpamarghyaṃ tilodakam ।
viprāya bhojayeccāpi tena pitṛpratoṣaṇam । । 119 । ।
yastu vipro mṛtānnaṃ na bhunakti śuddhimān sadā ।
tasmai dānaṃ pradātavyaṃ vaiśvadeveṣu taṇḍulāḥ । । 1.356.120 । ।
godhūmā ghṛtamityādi śarkarā śākamityapi ।
dugdhaṃ dadhi tathā vastraṃ śrāddheṣu taṃ na yojayet । । 121 ।।
pretānnaṃ bhuṃjamānānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyate ।
māghamāse dvādaśyāṃ tu sarpiyuktaṃ supāyasam । । 1 22।।
lihedvai madhunā sārdhaṃ dehaśuddhyarthamityatha ।
savatsāṃ kapilāṃ dadyādātmanaḥ śuddhaye tathā । । 123 । ।
tīrthe snāyācca gāyatrīsahasraṃ prajapettathā ।
yadvā dehātmanoḥ śuddhikāmaḥ sa śrāddhamācaret । । 1 24। ।

hiṃsito yadbhavet somo devatāḥ pitarastathā ।
prabhāte tena vipreṇa śmaśrunakhādichedanam । । 126 । ।
kāraṇīyaṃ snānamabhyañjanaṃ pakvānnamityapi ।

ṭakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā darbhānāstīrya bhūtale ।

brāhmaṇasya ca haste tu dadyādakṣayamātmavān ।। 133 ।।

praṇamedevaṃ vidhinā tuṣyanti pitṛdevatāḥ । । 13 7।।
dīrghāyuṣyaṃ prayacchanti putrapautradhanāni ca ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! madhuparkaṃ dadyātprāṇaprayāṇake । । 138 । ।
madhuparkaḥ puruṣo vai me dakṣāṃgād viniḥsṛtaḥ ।
mayā sa sarvakāryeṣu bhavamokṣāya yojitaḥ । । 139 । ।
madhuparko bhavedyatra yasya vā tatra mokṣaṇam ।

dadyād viprāya puṇyārthaṃ śavāya mokṣaṇāya ca । । 141 । ।
śrāddhādeḥ karmaṇaścānte śāntipāṭhaṃ prakārayet ।

diśaḥ paśya tvadhaḥ paśya vyādhibhyo rakṣa nityaśaḥ ।

garbhiṇīnāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ ca gavāṃ tathā ।

annaṃ kuru suvṛṣṭiṃ ca subhikṣamabhayaṃ kuru ।
vibho! pravardhatāṃ rāṣṭraṃ śāntirbhavatu nityaśaḥ । । 146 । ।
devānāṃ manujānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ kanyakāsu ca ।

evaṃ śāntiṃ paṭhitvā tu madhuparkaṃ prayojayet ।

alābhe madhunaścātra guḍena saha miśrayet ।

alābhe cāpi dadhnastu kṣīreṇa saha miśrayet ।
dadhiṃ kṣaudraṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva kārayet tatsamaṃ ca vā । । 1.356.150 । ।
samarpayāmi deveśa kṛṣṇa! sarpirghṛtaṃ madhu ।
