yo vai prāṇānpramuñcettu madhuparkaṃ dadenmukhe ।
ayaṃ pavitro vimalaḥ sarvakāmaprapūrakaḥ ।। 152।।
śṛṇoti madhuparkāderākhyānametaduttamam ।
yāti divyāṃ parāṃ muktiṃ mamānugrahakāraṇāt ।।।153।।
rājadvāre śmaśāne vā bhaye ca vyasane tathā ।
ye paṭhanti tvimāṃ śāntiṃ śīghraṃ sveṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 154।।
aputro labhate putramabhāryastu priyāṃ labhet ।
labhetā'patikā kāntaṃ baddho nirbandhano bhavet ।। 155।।
asya saṃsmaraṇāccāpi śrāddhādiphalabhāg bhavet ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! śrāddhādihārdamuttamam ।। 156।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mathurātīrthamāhātmye śrāddhabhoktuḥ prāyaścittena pāvitryam, avantīnagaryā medhātithirājñaḥ kupātrabrāhmaṇabhojane pitṝṇāṃ pātityaṃ supātre śrāddhakaraṇe punaḥ pitṝṇāṃ svargāmitvam, pituḥ pitāmahasya prapitāmahasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśagātrotpannatā, somapitṛhutāśanāḥ sādhau vipre ca sahabhojinaḥ, nīlavṛṣadānam, madhuparkadānam, śāntipāṭhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।356।।


← adhyāyaḥ 356 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 357
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 358 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yamarājaḥ kārtike dhavale dale ।
dvitīyāyāṃ sūryaputryā bhojitaḥ pūjito'grajaḥ ।। 1 ।।
prasannaśca yamo yamīṃ provāca varadānakam ।
tīrthe tvayi jale yadvā pārśve bhūmau tu dehinaḥ ।। 2 ।।
pāpāḥ puṇyāśca ye yonicatuṣṭayagatā api ।
vasanti yogamāpannā na te daṇḍyā mayā svasaḥ! ।। 3 ।।
yamunā''ha tadā jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ yadi te kṛpā ।
adya yamapurīvāsānnirmocaya samantataḥ ।। 4 ।।
ahaṃ snānaphalaṃ tadvajjalapānaphalaṃ bahu ।
vṛndātulasīpatrāṇāṃ dānasya puṇyamityapi ।।5 ।।
dadāmi nārakebhyo vai kuru nirbandhanān hi tān ।
svasurvākyaṃ samagṛhya tathā'stvityabhidhāya ca ।। 6 ।।
yamaḥ sarvānnārakān vai puṇyaṃ datvā yamīkṛtam ।
preṣayāmāsa vai svarga riktāṃ kṛtvā yamasthalīm ।।7।।
atha kāle punaryāte saṃbhūtā pāpibhistu sā ।
lokālokapare pāre gāḍhatamasi nirmitā ।। 8 ।।
jīvānāṃ karmaṇāṃ śubhā'śubhaphalapralabdhaye ।
nyāyālayaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena nirmitaḥ sa hi ।। 9 ।।
pāpibhyaḥ puṇyavadbhyaśca yathānyāyaṃ yamādhipaḥ ।
dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ krūraḥ saumyo vā dadate phalam ।। 1.357.1 0।।
pretā mṛtāḥ sarvajīvāḥ pāpāḥ puṇyāśca karmiṇaḥ ।
tatra gatvaiva gacchanti pare loke'pare'thavā ।। 11 ।।
bahupāpā alpapāpā yathākarma yamagṛhe ।
nārakeṣu karmaphalaṃ bhuktvā yānti bhavāya hi ।। 1 2।।
nārakāṇi tvasaṃkhyāni sthalāni mānasāni vai ।
dharmarājena tatsthalyāṃ nirmitāni bhavanti hi ।। 13 ।।
yathākarma tathā tasmai daṇḍāya pradadāti tat ।
śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi karmapākaphalasthalam ।। 14।।
kīdṛśaṃ kiṃpramāṇaṃ ca kiṃrūpaṃ kena dṛśyate ।।
karmapākaphalaṃ kīdṛṅ mānuṣairupabhujyate ।। 15।।
jano gacchet kathaṃ naiva pretarājaniveśanam ।
etatsarvaṃ samākhyāhi janānāmupakārakam ।। 16।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! purā vṛttāṃ kathāṃ paramaśobhanām ।
pāvanīṃ sarvapāpānāṃ pravṛttau śubhakāriṇīm ।। 17।।
samudramathane jātā tvalakṣmīrdevatādibhiḥ ।
uddālakāya munaye pradattā dharmataḥ priyā ।। 18।।
tasyāṃ jāto mānaso vai suto vedāṃgatattvavit ।
naciketa iti khyātaḥ pitrājñāvartanaḥ sadā ।। 1 9।।
araṇye godhanaṃ tasya daśasāhasrasaṃkhyakam ।
āsīt tasmāt prage nityaṃ naciketo mahāmuniḥ ।।1.357.20।।
prātaḥ kratuṃ vidhāyaiva śataṃ dānaṃ dadāti vai ।
dāne tena kvacittatra gāvo dattā dvijāya tu ।।21 ।।
bhuktabhogā gatāvasthā bhagnadantā jarāntigāḥ ।
jagdhatṛṇāḥ śuṣkadugdhā luptadaurhṛdalakṣaṇāḥ ।।22।।
etādṛśīstu gāḥ prāyo dātantaṃ naciketasam ।
pitaraṃ prāha putrastu nāciketā dayāvaśaḥ ।।23।।
pitargāvo dānayogyā dogdhryo bhavanti sarvathā ।
naitādṛśyo jarjaritā garbhaśaktikṣayānvitāḥ ।।24।।
iti śrutvā pitā prāha śiṣyante vṛddhadhenavaḥ ।
yuvatyo dānasaṃdattā na santyasmadgṛhe'dhunā ।।।25 ।।
śrutvā putro virarāma tato vai divasāntare ।
dhenvarthaṃ tu samāyātaḥ kaścid vipro hi bhikṣukaḥ ।।26 ।।
yayāce dhenubhikṣāṃ sa naciketo'pi godhanam ।
avaśiṣṭaṃ cātivṛddhaṃ dadāti tad dvijāya vai ।।27।।
tadā putro nāciketā muhurjanakamāha yat ।
na dātavyāḥ pitargāvo yā na dugdhāya karhicit ।।28।।
bhārarūpāstu tā gāvo mṛtyumātrā'vaśeṣitāḥ ।
pitā kiñcid vyagramanā bhūtvā putramuvāca tam ।।।29।।
kiṃ tarhi pradadāmyatra tvāṃ dadāmi gavāṃ sthale ।
itiśrutvā punaḥ putro māṃ dadasvetyuvāca ha ।।1.357.3 0।।
tadā pitā tu roṣeṇa prāha putraṃ bhayakaram ।
punaḥ punaryataḥ putra! māṃ nirodhayasi drutam ।।3 1 ।।
māṃ dadasveti vadasi dattastvaṃ mṛtyave mayā ।
ityuktamātre pitari mṛtyustatrā''jagāma ha ।।32।।
putrastathāstu oṃ prāha kṣaṇenā'ntarhito'bhavat ।
mābhūd vākyaḥ piturmiṃthyā gamiṣyāmi yamālayam ।।।3 3 ।।
śrutvā putravacaḥ prāha pitā vai dīnamānasaḥ ।
ekastvamasi vatsaśca nānyo bandhurhi vidyate ।।34।।
yācitastvaṃ mayā putra! gantuṃ vai tatra nā'rhasi ।
roṣeṇa hi mayoktaṃ yad dharmatattvaṃ na tanmatam ।।।35।।।
pitṛvākyaṃ tu tanmānyaṃ yatrā'dharmo na vai spṛśet ।
yadi vaivasvato rājā tvāṃ punarvisṛjennahi ।।36।।
vinaśyeyamahaṃ paśya kulasetuvināśanaḥ ।
narakasya pudityākhyā duḥkhaṃ vai narakaṃ viduḥ ।।।37।।।
putitrāṇaṃ bhavet putrādatra paratra sarvathā ।
hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ pitaraścāpi poṣitāḥ ।।38।।
aputrasya hi tatsarvaṃ moghaṃ bhavati niścayāt ।
tapo vā vipulaṃ taptvā datvā dānāni dharmataḥ ।।39।।
kṛtvā vahnau havanāni japtvā ca mantramālikāḥ ।
aputro nā''pnuyāt svargaṃ mayā devatrayāt śrutam ।।1.357.40।।
putreṇa gaṇyate pitā pautreṇa tu pitāmahaḥ ।
putrasya tu prapautreṇa modate prapitāmahaḥ ।।41 ।।
na hāsyāmīti vatsa! tvāṃ mama vaṃśavivardhanam ।
yācyamānaḥ prayatne na tatra gantuṃ na cārhasi ।।42।।
śrutvā taṃ pitaraṃ prāha nāciketā vinītakaḥ ।
na viṣādaḥ pitaḥ kāryo drakṣyase māmihā''gatam ।।43।।।
yamarājamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathyaṃ kṛtvā bhavadvacaḥ ।
āgamiṣye punastvatra nāsti tasmād bhayaṃ mama ।। 44।।
satyaṃ svargasya sopānaṃ satye tiṣṭhatu vai bhavān ।
satyena labhyate sarvaṃ hitaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam ।।45।।
aśvamedhasahasraṃ ca satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam ।
aśvamedhasahasrāddhi satyameva viśiṣyate ।।46 ।।
sthitaḥ satye mahāvindhyo vardhamāno na vardhate ।
pālayan svavrataṃ satyaṃ baddho vairocano baliḥ ।।47।।
satyadharmo rakṣitaḥ san rakṣati svaprarakṣakam ।
tasmāt satyaṃ kuruṣvā'dya rakṣa tvātmānamātmanā ।।48।।
evamuktvā gato mṛtyuṃ nāciketāḥ prasannadhīḥ ।
prāpto yamagṛhaṃ yatra yamo nāsīttadā gṛhe ।।49।।
lokapālakṛte yajñe gatastvāsīnmahotsave ।
atithirbrāhmaṇo nāciketo'tiṣṭhad gṛhāṃgaṇe ।।1.357.50।।
kṣudhayā tṛṣayā yukto vinā svāgatameva ca ।
ekaṃ dinaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca gataṃ tatsvāgataṃ vinā ।।51 ।।
tṛtīye'hni yamasyā''sīt kṣmāyāṃ mukuṭapātanam ।
tadā jñātaṃ mahajjātaṃ pātakaṃ vidyate kvacit ।।52 ।।
vijñātaṃ kāraṇaṃ tvetad dūtaistatparimārgitam ।
atitherasvāgataṃ vai vijñāya puṇyanāśakam ।।53।।
dūtānprāha yamastatra hyaḥ samāgatavānaham ।
kenāpi dūtavaryeṇā'tithirvijñāpito na hi ।।54।।
svāgataṃ tasya kurvantu viprasya satyaśālinaḥ ।
yasyāṃ'ganetithistvāste jalā'nnā''sanavarjitaḥ ।।55।।
sukṛtaṃ tadgṛhasthasya bhasmībhavati sarvathā ।
ādeyaṃ bhojanaṃ tasmai pādau prakṣālya mastake ।।।56।।
jalaṃ dhāryaṃ gṛhasthena tena puṇyaṃ vivardhate ।
svalpaṃ vā bahu vā deyaṃ śaktipūrvaṃ suśraddhayā ।।।।57।।
yadyatithistu bhagnāśo yasmād gṛhānnivartate ।
gṛhiṇaḥ puṇyamādāya pāpaṃ datvā prayāti saḥ ।।।58।।
vipraḥ sādhuḥ satī sādhvī yatiśca prathamāśramī ।
ete dharmātithayo vai tebhyo dattamanantakam ।।59।।
pretā vṛddhāśca pitaraḥ svāśritā vā nirāśrayāḥ ।
dīnā bālā jaḍā andhā nimittā'tithayastvime ।।1.357.6 0।।
pādāvanejanaṃ kāryamatithergātramardanam ।
snapanaṃ bhojanaṃ vāripānaṃ nivedanaṃ śubham ।।61 ।।
ityupādiśya bhṛtyān sa yamo'pi nāciketasam ।
prati dvāraṃ samāyāto neme papraccha tatsukham ।।62।।
satyāyuṣye samāyāto vipro me bhāgyamuttamam ।
gṛhāṇa sādho miṣṭānnaṃ bhojanaṃ jalapānakam ।।63।।
praviśā'tra gṛhāntarme pādyamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।
āsanaṃ vividhaṃ vastraṃ vibhūṣāśca gṛhāṇa me ।।64।।
kathaṃ kimarthamāyāto vada vipra! dadāmyaham ।
nāciketā yamaṃ prāha kṛpayā tava vai mayā ।।65।।
vastrabhūṣādikaṃ prāptaṃ vadā''tmajñānameva me ।
yamo yogī hariścaite pratyakṣā''tmapradarśinaḥ ।।66।।
tadātmadarśanaṃ yāce dehi me sukṛpā yadi ।
yamaḥ prāha gṛhāṇedaṃ suvarṇaṃ ratnasañcayam ।।67।।
kalpavṛkṣaṃ somavallīṃ cintāmaṇiṃ tanuṃ punaḥ ।
suvarṇabhavanaṃ ramyaṃ dāsān dāsīḥ śatottarān ।।68।।
yānāni gajavājyādivāhanāni suvāṭikāḥ ।
udyānāni suvarṇānāṃ śevadhiṃ ca gṛhāṇa bhoḥ ।।69।।।
na tu pratyakṣātmano vai jñānaṃ dāsye kadācana ।
tathā'stu tvatkṛpayaiva prāptaṃ sarvaṃ mayā prabho ।।1.357.70।
ityuktvā nāciketāstaṃ tvātmajñānāya cārthayat ।
yamaḥ prāha bhuvo rājyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ gṛhāṇa me ।।71 ।।
svargaṃ yadvā ca pātālaṃ satyarājyaṃ ca vedhasaḥ ।
aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi siddhīstvaṇimaprabhṛtīḥ ।।72।।
parakāyapraveśādyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ ca gṛhāṇa bho! ।
mā tvarthayā''tmavijñānaṃ yogināmapi durlabham ।।73।।
tathā'stu tvatkṛpayaiva prāptaṃ sarvaṃ mayā prabho ।
ityuktvā nāciketāstaṃ tvātmajñānamayācata ।।74।।
yamaḥ prāha vṛṇu tvanyad yatte manasi vartate ।
na tu tvātmapravijñānaṃ duṣkaraṃ tat kuyoginām ।।75।।
nāciketāstathāpyevamātmajñānamayācata ।
yamaḥ prāha śṛṇu tvātmā divyadṛṣṭyā vilokyate ।।76।।
dadāmi divyacakṣuste paśyātmānaṃ hṛdi sthitam ।
ityuktvā dharmarājastaṃ dadau vāri supuṇyavat ।।77।।
netrāṃjanena vai nāciketā dadarśa cetanam ।
bhāsvaraṃ saccidānandaṃ sūkṣmaṃ mūrtaṃ guṇākaram ।।78।।
sarvasiddhyāśrayaṃ bhāntamantaḥsthitāntarātmakam ।
dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa cātyantaṃ nāciketāḥ sudivyadṛk ।।79।।
yamastasyā''tmavijñāne dṛṣṭvā dṛḍhāgrahaṃ tataḥ ।
prasannaḥ prāha viprāya vṛṇu tvanyad yathepsitam ।।1.357.80।।
nāciketāstadā prāha śavaṃ me tvakṣataṃ bhavet। ।
yatra me jīvanaṃ śaśvad bhaved divyaṃ vinā kṣayam ।।81 ।।
piturme tvaparādho mā'stviti paśyāmi śāntidam ।
nāciketāitināmnā saṭā vahnirbhavāmyaham ।।82 ।।
kīrtirābrahmabhavanaṃ sarvatrā'stu sadā mama ।
etānvarān prayāce'haṃ pūrvoktāṃśca tvayā'rpitān ।।।83 ।।
tathā'stviti yamaḥ prāhā'tithaye sarvamārpayat ।
svasaudhaṃ karmacārāṇāṃ bhavanāni śubhāni ca ।।84।।
darśayāmāsa pāpānāṃ kārāgārāṇi cāpyatha ।
nārakāṇāṃ daṇḍavāsān puṇyānāṃ svargabhūmikāḥ ।।।85।।
darśayāmāsa pūjyāyā'tithaye yamarāṭ svayam ।
sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ smṛddhiṃ nītvaiśvaryaṃ varātmakam ।।86।।
nāciketā yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ yatrāsti tatpitā ।
śavaṃ cetanayuktaṃ vai samuttasthau sudivyakam ।।87।।
tato hṛṣṭamanā lakṣmi! putraṃ dṛṣṭvā taponidhiḥ ।
pariṣvajya ca bāhubhyāṃ mūrdhanyāghrāya cāha tam ।।88।।
kaccit tvaṃ na hato vatsa! naiva baddho yamālaye ।
kaccitte saśivaḥ panthā gacchatastava putraka! ।।89।।
kaccitte yamasadane vyādhayo nā'bhavan suta! ।
kiṃ tatra kṛtavān gatvā dṛṣṭavāँśca kimu gṛham ।।1.357.90।।
kaccid yamastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ paruṣo vā sukomalaḥ ।
tuṣṭo vā krodhasampanno visṛṣṭo'si kathaṃ drutam ।।91 ।।
kaccid dauvārikaistatra ruddho vā'ntarniveśitaḥ ।
kaccitte puṇyapāpānāṃ phalaṃ nā'bhūttu bādhakṛt ।।92।।
kaccitpanthāstvayā prāpto nirbādho vā susatkṛtaḥ ।
ityuktvā naciketāstaṃ svaputraṃ nāciketasam ।।93।।
hṛṣṭamanāḥ parireme prāhā''ganāँstapasvinaḥ ।
paśyantu mama putrasya prabhāvaṃ vijayapradam ।।94।।
yamasya bhavanaṃ dṛṣṭvā punardehaṃ samāgataḥ ।
pitṛsevāpratāpena guruśuśrūṣayāpi ca ।।95।।
satyena daivadṛṣṭena jīvatputro vilokitaḥ ।
aho bhāgyaṃ mama śreṣṭhaṃ mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā''gataḥ sutaḥ ।।96।।
prasannā devatā me vai ṛṣayaḥ santa īśvarāḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hṛṣṭo yanme vatsaḥ samāgataḥ ।।97।।
iti tvābhāṣamāṇe ca karṇākarṇitayā janāḥ ।
śrutvā vanaukasasttyaktvā vrataṃ japaṃ tathā'rcanam ।।98।।
tapo homaṃ parityajya draṣṭuṃ sarve samāgatāḥ ।
udūrdhvabāhavaḥ kecit kecidekapadasthitāḥ ।।99।।।
kecit sūryābhinetrāśca kecidbhūgatamastakāḥ ।
keciddigambarāścānye dantolūkhalinastathā ।। 1.357.10 0।।
aśmakūṭāśca maunāśca śīrṇapatratṛṇādanāḥ ।
dhūmrapānā vāṣpapānā jalapānāstathā'pare ।। 101 ।।
parivārya tu te sarve papracchurnāciketasam ।
bhorbhoḥ satyavratācāra! guruśuśrūṣaṇapriya ।। 1 02।।
nāciketarbrūhi satyaṃ kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ca śrutaṃ tvayā ।
yadyad yamasya caritaṃ guptaṃ prakāśamityatha ।। 1 03।।
sarvaṃ tvayā pravaktavyaṃ tvatkṛte cāpi yatkṛtam ।
duḥkhaṃ bhartsanamākrośaṃ gopyaṃ prakāśyamityapi ।। 1 04।।
brūhi sarvaṃ lokaśikṣāmayaṃ yadvai bhaviṣyati ।
iha caiva kṛtaṃ yattu tatparatropayujyate ।। 105।।
kṛtasyā'ntaṃ na paśyanti jantavaḥ pāracintakāḥ ।
citraguptastvayā dṛṣṭo na vā kaccit karoti kim ।।1 06।।
dharmarājasya kiṃ rūpaṃ kālarūpaṃ ca kīdṛśam ।
mṛtyurūpaṃ tathā kīdṛg vyādhayaḥ kiṃsvarūpiṇaḥ ।। 1 07।।
karmaphalavipākaśca kīdṛśaścānubhūyate ।
jitātmānaḥ kathaṃ yānti puṇyācārāstathāvidhāḥ ।।1 08।।
pāpinaśca kathaṃ yānti kathaṃ yānti hyudāsināḥ ।
yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathājātaṃ yathānubhūtamityapi ।। 1 00।।
tvayā bhuktaṃ yathā yacca tathā'nyat tvatsmṛtau sthitam ।
vad sarva nāciketaryāthātathyena vistarāt ।।1.357.1 1 0।।
ityuktvā cātisantṛṣṇāḥ śrotuṃ tvalaukikaṃ hi tat ।
abhavan dattahṛdayā nāciketā uvāca tān ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māthurakṣetramāhātmye yamunāpratāpena yamapurīriktatā, punaḥ sā karmibhiḥ prapūritā, nāciketasaḥ svapituḥ śāpena yamasadanagamanaṃ, yamāśīrvādā''tmadarśanayamapūrāvalokanottaraṃ svadehe punarāgamanaṃ, tatra kiṃ kiṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrutamitiṛṣipraśnā
ityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśadadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।357।।


← adhyāyaḥ 357 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 358
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 359 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! nāciketāḥ svānubhūtaṃ jagāda tān ।
kathyamānaṃ mayā viprāḥ śṛṇvantu yamakautukam ।। 1 ।।
yamamārge gacchatā tu mayā dṛṣṭā hiṃ dehinaḥ ।
puṇyāḥ puṇyavimānādivāhanaiḥ sahitāḥ sukhāḥ ।। 2 ।।
pāpāḥ sādhanaśūnyāśca yamadūtaiḥ sutāḍitāḥ ।
mārge tu vikaṭe yānti yamasthānaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ ।। 3 ।।
pāpakṛtān kathayāmi dṛṣṭā ye mārgagā mayā ।
asatyavādinaḥ krūrā jantustrībālaghātakāḥ ।। 4 ।।
sādhubrahmahaṇo duḥkhakarā viśvāsaghātakāḥ ।
śaṭhāḥ kṛtaghnā lolubhāḥ paradārābhihāriṇaḥ ।। 5 ।।
kanyāghātakarā ye ca dharmamārgavināśakāḥ ।
prasahya pāpakartāro madyamāṃsādisevinaḥ ।। 6 ।।
jihmā vinindakā mātṛpitṛgurupraghātakāḥ ।
mātāpitrostyājakāśca satīsādhvīsuduḥkhadāḥ ।। 7 ।।
gurudveṣakarā devadveṣiṇo vaṃcakāḥ khalāḥ ।
gṛhakṣetraharāḥ setubandhanāśakarāstathā ।। 8 ।।
śraddhāhīnā nāstikāśca nirdayāḥ śaucavarjitāḥ ।
dāraputravihīnāśca vratabhaṃgādikārakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
dvijā dvijatvahīnāśca bhraṣṭācārā vidharmiṇaḥ ।
sarvabhakṣāḥ sarvakāryāḥ sarvamithunakāriṇaḥ ।। 1.358.10 ।।
ātatāyijanāścāpi pāpisaṃgakarāstathā ।
patipatnīkleśadāśca patikleśapradāḥ striyaḥ ।। 11 ।।
nārīkleśapradāścāpi vittahāriṇa eva ye ।
kapaṭamānakartāro mithyādoṣakalaṃkadāḥ ।। 12।।
kūṭauṣadhapradātāro vārtābhirvañcakāstathā ।
agniśastraprahātāraścakre tilādipīḍakāḥ ।। 13।।
devālayānnasatrādibhaṃjakā vṛkṣanāśakāḥ ।
kūṭaśāsanakā ye ca sūcakāḥ karṇabhedakāḥ ।। 14।।
tīrthapradūṣakā ye ca kalaheṣṭātiniṣṭhurāḥ ।
narāḥ striyastathākarmakarā dṛṣṭā mayā pathi ।। 15।।
gatāste yamasadanaṃ citraguptādyadhiṣṭhitam ।
ahaṃ drāgeva gatavān yamarājagṛhāṃgaṇam ।। 16।।
satyavratākṣarāṇyeva phālake mama te bhaṭāḥ ।
vācayitvā praṇamanti darśayanti ca mārgakam ।। 1 7।।
yamarājagṛhaṃ ramyaṃ mahāprākāraveṣṭitam ।
dṛṣṭaṃ mayā'sanaṃ tasya gopure divasatrayam ।। 18।।
kṛtaṃ paścād yamaḥ sākṣādāyātaḥ svāgatāya me ।
sammānya ninye māṃ tasya viśālabhavanāntaram ।। 1 9।।
varān datvā tato mahyaṃ dharmarājapuraṃ mahat ।
darśitaṃ tadbhaṭaistasyājñayā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā'bhitaḥ ।।1.358.20।।
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu vistarād dviguṇāyatam ।
dviguṇaṃ pariveṣeṇa parikhābhiḥ samāvṛtam ।।21 ।।
bhavanairāvṛtaṃ divyairjāmbūnadamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।
harmyaiḥ śatottarabhūmiprāsādaiḥ śikharānvitaiḥ ।।22।।
aṭṭālikānvitasaudhaiḥ kalaśānvitamandiraiḥ ।
sauvarṇena ca mahatā prākāreṇābhiveṣṭitam ।।23।।
yatra yamapurībhṛtyāḥ pradhānāścādhikāriṇaḥ ।
śravaṇā yāmyāḥ kālāśca bhaṭādyā vai nivāsinaḥ ।।24।।
tatramiṣṭasalilāśca nadyaḥ sarāṃsi dīrghikāḥ ।
kūpāstaḍāgā nālinyo rājante vallikādrumaiḥ ।।25।।
dāsyo dūtyastathā patnyaḥ sevikā kanyakāḥ sutāḥ ।
vasanti tatkuṭumbāni yamarājaprajātmakāḥ ।।26 ।।
gajavājirājahaṃsoṣṭrakagovṛṣabhādayaḥ ।
nānājātipaśavo'pi vidyante tūpakārakāḥ ।।27।।
śukasārasamenādyāḥ pakṣivrātā vasanti vai ।
sarvajīvaiḥ samākīrṇaṃ yamarājasya satpuram । ।28।।
puṣpodakā nadī vṛkṣavallīṣaṇḍasuśobhitā ।
udyānādilasattīrā svarṇasopānavālukā ।।।29।।
pratisaudhaṃ gatā yasyā nalinyo jalavāhikāḥ ।
tatra miṣṭaśītavārihradeṣu divyavarṣmaṇaḥ ।।1.358.3 0 ।।
gandharvāḥ kinnarā dūtāḥ kinnaryo'pi suśobhanāḥ ।
viśālajaghanā bhūṣācaṃcadgātrā ratipradāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
krīḍanti snānakāle vai kāmarūpadharāḥ striyaḥ ।
rāmayanti narastatra yathākāmaṃ yathāsukham ।32।।
tāṃ nadīṃ kṣobhayantyaśca gāyanti svapriyaiḥ saha ।
divyamauktikaratnādikṛtasopānavistarām ।।33 ।।
vaivasvatīṃ nāmanadīṃ nagaramadhyagāminīm ।
divyatoyāṃ sadā pūrṇāṃ kundābhahaṃsarājitām ।।34।।
padmavallīpuṣpaṣaṇḍavālakhilyādiśobhitām ।
sugandhyamṛtavimalasalilāṃ saṃninādinīm ।।।35।।।
phalapuṣpataruṣaṇḍaiḥ kandamūlādibhiryutām ।
nāryaḥ svarūpā avagāhya krīḍanti madavihvalāḥ ।।।36।।।
tathā gāyanti sahitā gītavāditratālakaiḥ ।
kanyāsamūhā yattīrodyāneṣvārāmakeṣu ca ।।37।।
avatāreṣu ghaṭṭeṣu narā nāryo manoharāḥ ।
viharanti pragāyanti tantrimṛdaṃgagītibhiḥ ।।38।।
gandhaḥ sugandhaḥ pavano'gurucandanavāsitaḥ ।
śītamandaśca harmyeṣu caratyāmodakārakaḥ ।।39।।
vimānāni ca yānāni vaihāyasagamāni ca ।
pracaranti jale vyomni sakāntapramadāni ca ।।1.358.40।।
rājamārgā vasataya ānandānandasaṃplutāḥ ।
yāvadvidhasmṛddhiyuktā āpaṇādivirājitāḥ ।।41 ।।
sabhāgṛhāṇi divyāni divyapradarśanāni ca ।
divyanāṭakanṛtyādigītigṛhāṇi santi ca ।।42।।
evaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yamapuraṃ vistṛtaṃ sukhasaṃbhṛtam ।
puṇyavatāṃ tu dvitīyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamiva bhāṣate ।।43।।
atha tadgopuraṃ ramyaṃ svarṇabhūmivirājitam ।
daśayojanavistāraṃ tato dviguṇamāyatam ।।44।।
prākārobhayapārśvaṃ ca prāsādaśataśobhitam ।
samālikhadivā''kāśaṃ nānāyantraprajālakam ।।45।।
svargamiva prakāśāḍhyaṃ dharmadarśipraveśanam ।
devarṣipuṇyasatkarmakāriṇāṃ supraveśanam ।।46।।
tatraiva vihitaṃ dvāraṃ śāradrābhracayaprabham ।
manuṣyāṇāṃ sukṛtīnāṃ praveśastatra nirmitaḥ ।।47।।
atha dhūmrasamavarṇaṃ bahudoṣasamanvitam ।
āyasaṃ gopuraṃ tatra dakṣiṇaṃ bhīmadarśanam ।।48।।
raudraṃ taptaṃ dāvakaraṃ praveśo yatra pāpinām ।
nṛśaṃsānāṃ ghātakānāṃ kravyādānāṃ durātmanām ।।49।।
pāpānāṃ khalu sarveṣāṃ jīvaduḥkhapradāyinām ।
gopuraṃ paścimaṃ tatra bahuśastrādinirmitam ।।1.358.50।।
audumbaravahnijālasamāliptaṃ vidāhakam ।
duṣkṛtīnāṃ praveśārthaṃ yamena kāritaṃ svayam ।।5 1 ।।
tatra pure sarvaratnamayī divyā sabhā''yatā ।
yamena yojitā sā ca dharmitapasvimānavaiḥ ।।52।।
satyavādijitakrodhā'lubdhā'rāgaiḥ suśobhitā ।
sā sabhā dharmayuktānāṃ sā sabhā pāpakāriṇām ।।53।।
sā sabhā sarvalokasya śubhasyaivā'śubhasya ca ।
karmaṇāṃ nyāyadātrī sā sarvoṣāṃ dharmasaṃhitā ।।54।।
yatra madhyastharūpā nirapekṣā dharmapāṭhakāḥ ।
cintayanti phalānyeva sarvalokahitāya vai ।।55।।
yathānyāyaṃ yathālekhaṃ yathākālanivedakāḥ ।
manurvyāso'trirāpastambaśca śukro bṛhaspatiḥ ।।56।।
nāciketā gautamaśca śaṃkho likhita ityapi ।
pulastyo bhṛguraṃgirā vahnirvāyuryugāstathā ।।57।।
patnīvrataśca pulahastathā'nye dharmapāṭhakāḥ ।
yamena sahitāḥ sarve cintayanti pratikriyām ।।58।।
sarve kāryapracūrāste kuṇḍalāṃgadabhūṣitāḥ ।
brahmadattamukuṭāditejobhirdurnirīkṣaṇāḥ ।।59।।
atha tatpārśvayordivyāḥ ṛṣayo brahmavādinaḥ ।
vedatadaṃgamarmajñāḥ satyadharmapuraskṛtāḥ ।।1.358.60।।
tatra caivaṃ mayā dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ khalu ।
bhavane dharmarājasya pragāyantaḥ purā kathāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
teṣāṃ pārśve mayā dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo mahāhanuḥ ।
ūrdhvākṛtirūrdhvaromā mahādaṃṣṭro bhayānakaḥ ।।62।।
kruddho vāmakare dhṛtvā mahograṃ daṇḍameva ca ।
darśayan svamukhe śaśvad durdṛśyāṃ vikarālatām ।।63 ।।
śikṣārthaṃ dharmarājena sandiṣṭo'nekarūpadhṛka ।
śṛṇoti nirṇayān kālo yunakti dehinastathā ।।64।।
tathā'nye kālasadṛśāḥ kiṃkarā gaṇanāparāḥ ।
phalayoktāra evātra koṭiśaḥ śāsanaṃkarāḥ ।।65।।
yamena satkṛtā samyag divyagandhānulepanaiḥ ।
saṃhartrī sarvalokānāṃ ghorā vai yātanāmayī ।।66।।
bibhyati hyasurāstasyāḥ ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ।
asurāśca surāścaiva yogino'pi mahaujasaḥ ।।67।।
tasyā dehāt samudbhūtā vyādhayaḥ kālanirmitāḥ ।
mahāghorā mahākleśā daṇḍadāne'titatparāḥ ।।68।।
mayā dṛṣṭāstathā dṛṣṭo mahākrodhaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ।
prakṛtyā durvinītaśca jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ ।।69।।
mahāsattvo vikarālo mṛtyurnāmā pumāँstathā ।
divyatejomayo dṛṣṭo sarvapāśasamanvitaḥ ।।1.358.70।।
gāyakā hāsakāścāpi sarvajīvaprabodhakāḥ ।
kālajñāśca mayā dṛṣṭāstejobhūṣāmbarānvitāḥ ।।71 ।।
anekāśca jvarā dṛṣṭā rogāśca vedanāstathā ।
nārīnarasvarūpāśca jīvabhakṣakarā hi te ।।72।।
krodhadāvānaladātryo nānākṛtyā vilokitāḥ ।
tīvraroṣā nāśayitryo nānārūpadharāḥ striyaḥ । ।73।।
tatra halahalāśabdaḥ prāṇiśoṣaṇahetave ।
śruto hyavirataṃ krūro dharmarājasamīpataḥ । ।74।।
kūṣmāṇḍā yātudhānāśca rākṣasā māṃsabhojinaḥ ।
ekapādā dvipādāśca tripādā bahupādakāḥ ।।।75।।
ekabāhurdvibāhuśca tribāhurbahubāhavaḥ ।
śaṃkukarṇāḥ śūrpakarṇā nalakarṇāstathā'pare ।।76 । ।
kṛkalāsamukhāstvanye tathānye makarānanāḥ ।
anye vyāghrabiḍālāsyā vikarālapranetrakāḥ ।।77।।
sakuṭhārāḥ sakuddālāḥ sacakrāḥ śūlahastakāḥ ।
śaktitomarabhūśuṇḍīdhanurmudgarapāṇayaḥ ।।78।।
asikuntadharāstvanye vicitrabhakṣyahastakāḥ ।
athānye puruṣā dṛṣṭāḥ sarvaśobhāvaśobhitāḥ ।।79।।
keyūraśṛṃkhalācitramukuṭakaṭakānvitāḥ ।
sragviṇo vastraśobhāḍhyā sugandhagandhamoditāḥ ।।1.358.80 ।।
vājikuṃjarahaṃsādiyuktāstvanye tu yānagāḥ ।
śarabharṣabhasārasacakramayūrasaṃsthitāḥ ।।81 ।।
tathā saumyā mayā dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭāstvanye bhayānakāḥ ।
ujjvalāścā'pare tatra malinā api sarvathā ।।82।।
navojjvalāmbarāḥ kecit kecijjīrṇāṃśukāstathā ।
sāttvikāḥ sumanasaśca tathā'nye krūramānasāḥ ।।83 ।।
mṛṣṭavacanamādhuryāstathā'nye śatamārakāḥ ।
kaliḥ kṛṣṇā mahākṛtyā kāliścāpyavalokitāḥ । ।84।।
dharmahastā yaśohastāḥ kīrtihastāstathā'pare ।
ete kṛtāntasānnidhye vartante tadvacaḥparāḥ ।।85। ।
paśubhakṣyā narabhakṣyā nārībhakṣyāstathā'pare ।
śavabhakṣyā bālabhakṣyāḥ pakṣibhakṣyā hyanekaśaḥ ।।86।।
āmabhakṣyāḥ pakṣibhakṣyāḥ padmahastā yamānugāḥ ।
mahādaṃṣṭrā vikarālā vahnivāryaparābhavāḥ ।।87।।
agnidehā jaladehā loṣṭhavarṣmāṇa ityamī ।
śastrā'ghātyā mayā dṛṣṭā vāyvaspṛśyāstathā'pare ।।88।।
yamarājabhaṭā hyete siddhimanto'valokitāḥ ।
sakubhakāḥ sapakṣāśca vyomādisarvagāminaḥ ।।89।।
aprāṇarodhavaśagā yamabhṛtyā vilokitāḥ ।
sarvagrāhyā sarvaspṛśyāḥ sarvadṛśyā vilokitāḥ ।।1.358.90।।
yāvantaścātra vai brahmāṇḍe janā bhuvaneṣu ca ।
dehināṃ ca svabhāvā vai yādṛgguṇāstu cetanāḥ ।।91 ।।
jaḍā yādṛgguṇāḥ santi mūrtā'mūrtāni yāni ca ।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāścāpi yayā bhavanti yādṛśāḥ ।।।92।।।
teṣāṃ sarvavidhānāṃ vai daṇḍadānāya te bhaṭāḥ ।
sarvaśaktiyutāḥ sarvasiddhiyuktā niyāmakāḥ ।।93।।
alepāścā'parābhūtāsteṣāmaviṣayāstathā ।
bhavanti kiṃ varṇayāmi pārasteṣāṃ na vidyate ।।94।।
iṣṭarūpadharā iṣṭasiddhisāmarthyayoginaḥ ।
iṣṭatarkakarā daṇḍadāne'pradhṛṣyaśaktayaḥ ।।95।।
kecit sūkṣmaśarīrā vai kecitparvatarūpiṇaḥ ।
kecidbrahmāṇḍatulyatvaṃ gṛhṇanti kāryasaṃgame ।।96 ।।
kecinnadanadīrūpāḥ kecijjvālāsvarūpiṇaḥ ।
kecitsūryasamā uṣṇāḥ kecicchītahimālayāḥ ।।97।।
yādṛśaṃ daṇḍatattvaṃ vai tādṛśāste bhavanti hi ।
mayā dṛṣṭā bahurūpā āścaryaṃ prāptavānaham ।।98।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yāmyacakre mārge dṛṣṭāḥ pāpinaḥ, yamarājasya puraṃ gṛha prākāro gopurāṇi, kṛtāntakālamṛtyukiṃkarakṛtyādīnāṃ rūpādyā- kṛtinirdaśādisāmarthyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭapaṃcāśa- dadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 358 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 358 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 359
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 360 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! nāciketā dṛṣṭavān yamayātanāḥ ।
jagād brāhmaṇān sarvān yathādṛṣṭā vadāmi te ।। 1 ।।
nāciketā dvijānprāha rājā pretapurādhipaḥ ।
sabhāmadhye mayā dṛṣṭo bahukāryavicakṣaṇaḥ ।। 2 ।।
me tvekamṛṣabhaṃ yamaḥ satkārārthaṃ dadau tathā ।
āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca pūjāṃ me vidhinā dadau ।। 3 ।।
nyaṣādayat kāṃcanasyāsane māṃ puṣpaśobhite ।
pūrvaṃ raudramukhaḥ kintu tadā saumyānano'bhavat ।। 4 ।।
lohite tasya netre'pi jajñāte padmasadṛśe ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā mayā tatra viśvastaṃ bhāvanānvite ।। 5 ।।
atha stutiḥ kṛtā tasya suśāntahṛdayena vai ।
tvaṃ vai karmaphaladātā pitṝṇāṃ paramo mahān ।। 6 ।।
śrāddhe dhātā vidhātā ca dharmarāja! namo'stu te ।
kālakāla! karmavettṛn! pretanātha! namostu te ।। 7 ।।
daṇḍapāṇe! pāśahasta! dharmamūrte! namo'stu te ।
sūryavarṇaṃ! kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ! havyakavyād! te namaḥ ।। 8 ।।
surūpa! krūrarūpā'pi nyāyamūrte! ca te namaḥ ।
na tvāṃ cālayituṃ śaktāstāpasā ṛṣayo'pi vā ।। 9 ।।
itistotraṃ śubhaṃ śrutvā yamarāja uvāca mām ।
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ।। 1.359.1 0।।
ahaṃ tadā'vadad tasmai deśaṃ te darśaya prabho! ।
pāpānāṃ ca śubhānāṃ ca draṣṭumicchāmi yātanāḥ ।। 11 ।।
citraguptaṃ pradhānaṃ te draṣṭumicchāmi darśaya ।
yamarājaḥ samāhūya dūtaṃ māṃ cāpyapreṣayat ।। 12।।
citraguptaṃ prati prītyā māṃ dṛṣṭvā citraguptakaḥ ।
pratyutthāya cakārātisvāgataṃ vai kṛtāṃjaliḥ ।। 1 3।।
uvācainaṃ darśayantu bhṛtyāḥ! pretanivāsanam ।
asya rakṣā ca guptiśca bhavadbhiḥ kriyatāmiti।। 14।।
sandiṣṭā māṃ tvaramāṇā dūtā ninyuḥ phalālayam ।
dvārābhyāśe mayā dṛṣṭaṃ śṛṇutaitadbhayāvaham ।। 15।।
yamadūtā bandhayanti nirdahanti ca dehinaḥ ।
pāṭayanti prahāraiśca tāḍayanti punaḥ punaḥ ।। 16।।
veṇuyaṣṭiprahāraiśca praharanti ca pāpinaḥ ।
bhagnā bhinnāḥ chinnagātrā bhagnapṛṣṭhaśirodharāḥ ।। 17।।
rudanti karuṇaṃ ghoraṃ trātāraṃ nāpnuvanti te ।
kecinnarake pacyante dahyante cograpāvake ।। 18।।
tailapāke vipacyante kṣāre klidyanta eva ca ।
kecid yantre prapīḍyante śoṇitaṃ sravate tataḥ ।। 19।।
vaitaraṇī nadī tatra vahati dustarā'ghinām ।
āropyante mahāśūle badhyante pādayostathā ।।1.359.20।।
prakṣipyante vaitaraṇīnadyāṃ daśanti daṃṣṭriṇaḥ ।
adha ūrdhvaṃ jalāvarttabhramitā ūrmiduḥkhitāḥ ।।21 ।।
vilokyante sahasrāṇi śuṣyanti tvapare'nile ।
mañjantaśca vamantaśca mūrchayantaśca dehinaḥ ।।22।।
dṛśyante bahavastatra trātāraṃ nāpnuvanti te ।
athā'nye bahubhirdūtairāropya kūṭaśālmalim ।।23।।
asiśaktiprahāraiśca tāḍyante lohakaṇṭakaiḥ ।
kūṣmāṇḍā yātudhānāśca kāṃścit saṃcūrṇya yānti ca ।।24।।
rākṣasā māṃsabhoktāraḥ khādanti ghnanti cāparān ।
cūṣayitvā'parān kecid visṛjanti kṣitau tathā ।।25।।
tato jīvena saṃyuktāścūṣitā api vai punaḥ ।
yathāpūrvāḥ prajāyante cūṣayanti ca tānpunaḥ ।।26।।
pāpāste pāhi muñceti vadantyapi yamānugāḥ ।
pāpapratiphalārthaṃ vai sūdayanti punaḥ punaḥ ।।27।।
pāṣāṇavarṣaiḥ kecittu pāṃśuvarṣaistathā'pare ।
mṛdyante vidrutāḥ praviśanti bile jvalanti ca ।।28।।
dūtairhatā mahāgnau te pacyante vaṃśatāḍitāḥ ।
jalaṃ pradīyatāṃ ceti bruvate naḥ prasīdatha ।।29।।
taptaṃ jalaṃ dīyate ca pibanti hṛdaye tadā ।
dahyanti cāntaraistāpaiḥ krośanti ca bhayaṃkaram ।।1.359.30।।
atha puṇyavatāṃ bhūmirdṛṣṭā yatra mayā muhuḥ ।
sukhino'pi prāṇino vai dṛṣṭā modabharāstathā ।।31 ।।
yeṣāmagre'nnamiṣṭānnabhakṣyāṇāṃ santi rāśayaḥ ।
dadhikṣīrarasāścāpi kṛsarānnaṃ ca pāyasam ।।32।।
phalānāṃ rāśayaścāpi peyānāṃ kalaśā hradāḥ ।
bhojyacośyasulehyāni bahūni santi sannidhau ।।33।।
dravyāṇi tailapūgādicarvaṇāni vibhānti ca ।
tapo'rjitāni divyāni tiṣṭhanti sukṛtātmanām ।।34।।
mālyāni dhūpagandhāśca vastrabhūṣāparicchadāḥ ।
manoharāstathā kāntā kāntimatyo ramanti ca ।।।35।।
pramadāḥ sarvavibhūṣā yuvatyo bhojanāni vai ।
kāntān svarṇāsane pariveṣayanti vilokitāḥ ।।36।।
gṛhītakuṃbhamaṇikāḥ pātrahastāstathā'parāḥ ।
sumanaḥpādyahastāśca bhojayanti sahasraśaḥ ।।37।।
nūpuraśṛṃkhalāśobhikiṃkiṇījālasusvanāḥ ।
sannidhāya subhogyāni tiṣṭhanti ca manoharāḥ ।।38।।
sevante cātiviśrāntān yūno rūpaguṇākarān ।
brūvate miṣṭamadhurasvaraṃ kāle ca yoṣitaḥ ।।39।।
athopadeśakartāro dūtāścāpyavalokitāḥ ।
nighnantaśca hasantaśca krūrā niṣṭhuravādinaḥ ।।1.359.40।।
bho bhoḥ kṛtaghnā lubdhāśca sarvadānavivarjitāḥ ।
parāpavādaniratāḥ parātmaduḥkhadā janāḥ ।।41 ।।
sulabhāni na dattāni vibhave sati laukike ।
pānīyamatha kāṣṭhāni miṣṭānnaṃ sukhamāgatam ।।42।।
tena vadhyā bhavanto vai jātā yamakarairiha ।
karmaṇāṃ tu kṣayaṃ kṛtvā vimuktā yāntu vai bhuvam ।।।43 ।।
punaḥ pāpaṃ na kartavyaṃ daridrakulajanmibhiḥ ।
puṇyaṃ samyak prakartavyaṃ puṇyāḥ svargaṃ hi bhuñjate ।।44।।
tataḥ satyaratā bhūtvā dayāvantaḥ sudhārmikāḥ ।
gacchantu paramaṃ sthānaṃ pṛthivyāṃ vā mahatkule ।।45।।
kṛṣṇā''rādhanayā bhaktyā bhaviṣyati parāgatiḥ ।
yadvā sundaranārīṇāṃ smṛddhaṃ svargamavāpsyatha ।।46 ।।
iti spaṣṭaṃ mayā tatrā''karṇitaṃ sūpadeśanam ।
athā'pyagre nītavanto bhṛtyā māṃ bhūmikāntaram ।।47।।
ardanaṃ tāḍanaṃ yatra mardanaṃ chedanaṃ tathā ।
cūrṇanaṃ bhedanaṃ yatra dāhanaṃ kaccarādivat ।।48।।
jīvānāṃ vai mayā dṛṣṭaṃ pāpināṃ trāsadāyakam ।
notsahe varṇanaṃ kartuṃ dayārdrahṛdayaṃ yataḥ ।।49।।
tathāpyāgrahayuktatvād ṛṣayaḥ! pravadāmyaham ।
yatra kṣititalaṃ sarvamāyasaiḥ kaṇṭakaiścitam ।।1.359.50।।
viṣamaṃ viṣasaṃlagnaṃ vahnivyāptaṃ tamomayam ।
athātra chinnapādāśca chinnapāṇiśirodharāḥ ।।51 ।।
pāpācārā vapuṣmantaḥ pātyante yamabhṛtyakaiḥ ।
striyaḥ kṛtyāsvarūpāśca pratīkṣante vyavāyinaḥ ।।52।।
āgatān vahnisaṃtapte nikṣipanti śilātale ।
kliśyanti bahavo duṣṭāstrātāraṃ nāpnuvanti te ।।53 ।।
athā'nye tu śvabhirghorairāpādatalamastakam ।
bhakṣyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ prakrośanto muhurmuhuḥ ।।54।।
athā'nye ca mayā dṛṣṭā mahādaṃṣṭrāḥ kṛśodarāḥ ।
kṣudhitāstṛṣitāḥ sūcīmukhā pīḍyanta eva te ।।55।।
annāni bhojyavastūni milanti naiva vāryapi ।
ayaḥsāramayī nārī vahnitaptā hi kṛtyakā ।।।56 ।।
āliṃgati naraṃ tatra dhāvante tvanudhāvati ।
vadatyahaṃ te bhaginī hyahaṃ bhāryā sutasya te ।।57।।
mātṛsvasā pitṛsvasā mātulānī ca te hyayam ।
gurubhāryā sutā te'smi pūrvaṃ prasahya dharṣitā ।।58।।
puṃstvaṃ pāpaphalaṃ pāpa! mokṣyase nahi duṣkṛtāt ।
jvālayiṣye haniṣye'haṃ kathaṃ dhāvasi dūrataḥ ।।59।।
śrāvayanti bodhayanti cābhidravanti pāpinām ।
anupīḍya durātmānaṃ dharṣayanti sudāruṇam ।।1.359.60।।
kiṃ krandasi duṣkarmin tvāṃ pariṣvakto ratiṃ kuru ।
yatra kvāpi dhāvasi tvāṃ na tyakṣye pāradārikam ।।6 1 ।।
etat kutuhalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yuvatyastādṛśānnarān ।
lohayaṣṭiprahārādyaistāḍayanti punaḥ punaḥ ।।62।।
athā'nye duḥkhino dṛṣṭāstāḍitā daṇḍamudgaraiḥ ।
vyāghrasiṃhaśṛgālādyaiḥ rākṣasairgardabhaiḥ śvabhiḥ ।।63।।
bhakṣyanta śvāpadaiḥ kākairgṛdhraiśca kṛkalāsakaiḥ ।
athānye ca mayā dṛṣṭā vidāritā vibheditāḥ ।।64।।।
asitālavane dūtairjvālāvane pradāhitāḥ ।
chinnā dagdhā hanyamānā vidhṛṣṭāśca nadanti te ।।65।।
tān vayāṃsyāyasaistuṇḍairdaṃṣṭrābhiḥ śvādayastathā ।
kravyādā hiṃsakā vyāghrāḥ khādanti ruṣitāstadā ।।66।।
ṛkṣadvīpe mayā dṛṣṭā yamaṛkṣairvipāṭitāḥ
kecinmudgarabhagnāṃgāḥ śūlalagnāstathā pare ।।67।।
anye kṣiptā mayā dṛṣṭā vāpīhradanadīṣu te ।
rudhirasya taḍāgeṣu kūpapuṣkariṇīṣu ca ।।68।।
pūtimāṃsakṛmikīṭā'medhyeṣu ca sarassu ca ।
jighrantaḥ pāpino gandhaṃ majjantaścāvalokitāḥ ।।69।।
asthipāṣāṇarudhiravarṣābhiścūrṇitāstathā ।
dhāvantaśca plavantaśca hā hatāḥ sma prabhāṣiṇaḥ ।।1.359.70।।
krandantaḥ karuṇastatra ruddhā viddhāḥ śrutā mayā ।
sthūlasthāṇuprabaddhāśca kecidudbandhane dhṛtāḥ ।।71 ।।
śilābhirarditāścānye śastraiśca śakalīkṛtāḥ ।
mayā vai duḥkhino dṛṣṭāḥ krandanaṃ dāruṇaṃ śrutam ।।72।।
darśitāśca tato dūtairaṣṭau narakā dāruṇāḥ ।
taptaṃ cāpi mahātaptaṃ mahārauravarauravau ।। 73 ।।
saptatālaḥ kālasūtraṃ tāmisro'ndhatāmisrakaḥ ।
prathame prathamaṃ duḥkhaṃ dvitīyaṃ dviguṇaṃ tvakam ।। 74।।
tṛtīye triguṇaṃ kaṣṭaṃ caturthe tu caturguṇam ।
pañcame pañcaguṇakaṃ ṣaṣṭhe ṣaḍguṇakaṣṭakam । ।75।।
saptame saptaguṇakamaṣṭame'ṣṭaguṇaṃ tvakam ।
duḥkhitānāṃ tatra duḥkhaṃ duḥkhād duḥkhataraṃ tataḥ ।।76।।
duḥkhamevā'tra na sukhaṃ duḥkhairduḥkhaṃ vivṛdhyate ।
upāyastatra naivāsti yena svalpaṃ sukhaṃ bhavet ।।77।।
śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe śārīramānasaiḥ ।
duḥkhāntagāmibhirduḥkhaiḥ pīḍyante pāpakāriṇaḥ ।। 78।।
āyasaiḥ kaṇṭakaistīkṣṇaistaptaistaptā''vṛtā sthalī ।
antarīkṣaṃ khagānīkairagnijihvaiḥ samāvṛtam ।।79।।
bubhukṣā'ti pipāsā'ti uṣṇamatyuṣṇamityapi ।
śītaṃ cāpyatiśītaṃ ca vāyurjvālā'timiśritaḥ ।।1.359.80 ।।
pātukāmo jalaṃ dūtairnīyate sara uṣṇakam ।
prekṣate dhāvati pātuṃ pibatyantaḥ pradahyati ।।81 ।।
tasya pakvāni māṃsāni rākṣasā matsyakādayaḥ ।
avadhṛtya samutpāṭya khādanti ca hasanti ca ।।82।।
atha kṣārodake taiśca kṣipyate vai mahāhrade ।
kṣārahūtā bhakṣayanti samāṃso jāyate punaḥ ।।83 ।।
karīṣagarte santapte kuṃbhīpāke bhayaṃkare ।
peśīṃ peśīṃ supakvāṃ ca samutpāṭya tu dehinaḥ ।।84।।
khādanti yamagāḥ piṣṭvā daśanaiḥ svādavedinaḥ ।
iti dṛṣṭā mayā pāpāḥ krośanto'dūravartinaḥ ।।85।।
atha śṛṃgāṭakasthalyāṃ dṛṣṭāḥ sutaptavāluke ।
sthale dahyante chidyante vidhyante kaṇṭakaiśca ye ।।86 ।।
bhidyante cāpi pātyante pīḍyante yamadūtakaiḥ ।
kṛṣyante ca viśasyante hyutkocyante ca pāpinaḥ ।।87।।
śyāmāḥ śabalāḥ śvapadāḥ khādanti sarpavṛścikāḥ ।
athānyaśca mayā dṛṣṭo narakaḥ kūṭaśālmaliḥ ।।88।।
kṛṣyante pāpinastatra yāvadasthyavaśeṣitāḥ ।
kuṭyante prāṇinastatra dūtaiścūrṇyanta ugrakaiḥ ।।89।।
chinnaṃgāḥ sarvagātreṣu vindanti duḥkhamulbaṇam ।
athānyā ca mayā dṛṣṭā nadī kardamavālukā ।।1.359.90 ।।
agnijvālāpravāhā ca vahneyavyālanakrakā ।
āgneyajhaṣasaṃvyāptā hyuttāryante tu tāṃ marāḥ ।।91 ।।
tathā sarid vaitaraṇī dṛṣṭā lavaṇakardamā ।
carmamāṃsā'sthipaṃkā ca samajjālālalohitā ।।92।।
vajradaṃṣṭrā karkaṭakā vajrajihvāśca jantavaḥ ।
mahāviṣāśca makarā jhaṣāścāpyasthibhedanāḥ ।।93।।
yatra pāpān bhakṣayanti gilanti cotkiranti ca ।
punarvai māṃsalāḥ prāgvad bhavantyeva ca pāpinaḥ ।।94।।
athāgre bhūtale śūnyāgāraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sagahvaram ।
mūṣakā vajradantāśca saviṣā bhakṣayanti tān ।।95।।
mūṣakairjagdhagātrāśca hyasthimātrāvaśeṣitāḥ ।
punarvai vāyunā spṛṣṭā bhavanti māṃsalāstu te ।। 96 ।।
athāgre rukṣakavanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ raudrapatatriyuk ।
māṃsādaiḥ pakṣibhiryatra vṛkṣārūḍho'pi bhakṣyate ।।97।।
nirmāṃso nistvagasthī ca niḥśirājālakastathā ।
nirakṣiśrāvaṇaḥ pāpaḥ kriyate tīkṣṇacañcubhiḥ ।। 98।।
athāgre tu mayā dṛṣṭo vaṭavṛkṣo mahāruṇaḥ ।
vajrakāṣṭho hyapradāhyo dolāsahasrasaṃyutaḥ ।।99।।
yadadho yamacullī vai daśayojanavistṛtā ।
triyojanasugambhīrā nityaṃ prajvālitā hi sā ।। 1.359.100 ।।
pretānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca ।
prakṣipyante'tra satataṃ rākṣasairyamakikaraiḥ ।। 101 ।।
vaṭaśākhāvaddharajjvā pāpinaṃ tvantarālake ।
adhaḥśirasaṃ ta badhvā bharjayanti tvadanti ca ।। 1 02।।
cullyāṃ kṣipanti kaścicca bharjitānapyadanti ca ।
yamabhṛtyāstathā pretā āsvādayanti harṣitāḥ ।। 1 03।।
cullīkukṣeḥ śakunikā'bhidhā nadī tu veginī ।
vasāmedovahā yāti tatra kṣipanti pāpinaḥ ।। 1 04।।
tatrā'tha dṛṣṭamatyugraṃ yātanāsaptakaṃ tataḥ ।
ekaikaṃ dustaraṃ ghoraṃ bhuṃkte pāpī yathākramāt ।। 1 05।।
daśa tatra mahāśūlāḥ kuṃbhīpākāstrayodaśa ।
vahnitapteṣu śūleṣu protāḥ pacyanta eva te ।। 106 ।।
śuṣkodapāne sadhūmre hyadhaḥśīrṣo'valambate ।
taptatailakaṭāhe ca jvālyate pacyate tathā ।। 1 07।।
karīṣagarte nikṣiptaḥ pacyate medavahninā ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭā mayā jīvāḥ pacyamānāḥ pradāhitāḥ ।। 1 08।।
atho yamanadī dṛṣṭā taptatrapupravāhikā ।
tatra nimajjya jīvā vai pacyante pāpakāriṇaḥ ।।1 09।।
atha śītajalā dṛṣṭā dīrghikā śītakānanā ।
yatra śītajalaṃ pītvā kṣaṇaṃ viśrāntirāpyate ।।1.359.1 1 0।।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ yamasvasā yamī dadāti tatra vai ।
tataḥ śūlatraho nāma pāṣāṇaḥ śatayojanaḥ ।। 111 ।।
parvato hi mayā dṛṣṭo jīmūtastatra varṣati ।
jīvāstatra nimajjanti tvagre gacchanti vai tataḥ ।। 1 12।।
tataḥ śṛṃgārakavana dṛṣṭaṃ sadaṃśamakṣikam ।
dṛṣṭaḥ pāpī ca vā spṛṣṭaḥ kṛmirūpo hi jāyate ।। 11 3।।
athānyā bhūmikā dṛṣṭā yatra paśyati bāndhavān ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ putrān dārāँstathā priyān janān ।। 1 14।।
teṣāmagre vadhyamānaḥ krandate trāsadaṃ tadā ।
laguḍairmudgarairdaṇḍairjānubhirveṇubhistathā ।। 1 15।।
muṣṭibhiśca yaṣṭibhiśca kaśābhiḥ śṛṃkhalādibhiḥ ।
athānyā bhūmikā dṛṣṭā pretasthāvaratāpradā ।। 116 ।।
tatra yāto vrajed pretaḥ sthāvaraṃ bhāvameva yat ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi paśubhāve tu vindati ।। 1 17।।
svedajo jāyate paścāt tataḥ pakṣī prajāyate ।
goyonau tu tato gatvā punarbhavati mānavaḥ ।। 1 18।।
yādṛk saṃsāracakraṃ vai tadbhāve tvasti rekhitam ।
tathā tā yātanā bhuktvā viprādiṣu prajāyate ।। 11 9।।
ityantaṃ vai mayā dṛṣṭaṃ yamadūtaiḥ pradarśitam ।
śrāntā matsahitā dūtā yayuste citraguptakam ।। 1.359.1 20।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yāmyacakre nāciketaḥkṛtayamarājastutiḥ, vividhanarakāvalokanāya yamarājā''jñā, duḥkhadanirayayātanāvalokanam, yātanāvarṇanam, nāciketasā sahitānāṃ dūtānāṃ citraguptaṃ pratyāgamanamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।359।।


← adhyāyaḥ 359 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 360
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 361 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! citraguptagṛhe tu nāciketasā ।
yad dṛṣṭaṃ tat kathayāmi nāciketā jagāda tān ।। 1 ।।
śṛṇvantu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve citraguptāṃgaṇe mayā ।
yad dṛṣṭaṃ ca tataścāpi tatsarvaṃ kathayāmi vaḥ ।। 2 ।।
citraguptena cā''diṣṭā mandehā nāma rākṣasāḥ ।
anye dūtāśca vijñaptāḥ karmiṇāṃ yātanākṛte ।। 3 ।।
nānārūpadharā ghorāḥ sāyudhāḥ piśitāśanāḥ ।
bho bho mandehakā vīrāstathā dūtāḥ savikramāḥ ।। 4 ।।
jīvān badhnantu gṛhṇantu pāpakān yātanākṛte ।
mārayantu khādayantu mardayantu yathā kṛtam ।। 5 ।।
ityājñaptā rākṣasāste dūtāśca kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।
sannaddhāstvaritaṃ bhīmā gajāśca siṃharūpiṇaḥ ।। 6 ।।
vyāghraśṛgālamahiṣavyālavṛścikarūpiṇaḥ ।
gṛdhraśyenaphaṇiṛkṣagardabhādisvarūpiṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
śūlaśaktiprahārāste yaṣṭitomarapāṇayaḥ ।
paṭṭiśāsikhaḍgayuktā dūtā ghoraparākramāḥ ।। 8 ।।
bhindhi chindhi ca gṛhṇīṣva vadanti raktalocanāḥ ।
khādanti ghnanti mandehāścitraguptapraperitāḥ ।। 9 ।।
vyādhīnāṃ tu sahasrāṇi dūtānāmayutāni ca ।
jvarāśca kālamuṇḍāśca keṃkarākṣā sahasraśaḥ ।।1.360.1 0।।
ārabdhā mardanaṃ kartuṃ pāpināṃ pāpakarmiṇām ।
dharmarājena sandiṣṭacitraguptasya śāsanāt ।। 11 ।।
yathānyāyaṃ daṇḍayogyā baddhā bandhaistu rākṣasaiḥ ।
agninā tāpitāḥ kecid daśanābhiśca carvitāḥ ।। 12।।
durācārānpāparatānnirghṛṇānpāpacetasaḥ ।
śvānaḥ śvāpadapaśavo bhakṣayanti durātmakān ।। 13 ।।
citraguptaḥ sthitastatra nyāye śrāvayati jvarān ।
dūtāँśca rākṣasāँstadvai mayā pratyakṣataḥ śrutam ।। 14।।
pitṛghnaṃ mātṛgoghnaṃ ca samāropya tu śālmalīm ।
sutīkṣṇaiḥ kaṇṭakairdūtā vipāṭayantu mā ciram ।। 15।।
pācake pakṣiṇāmenaṃ pācayantu narādhamam ।
paśūnāṃ tvanyajantūnāṃ taptatailakaṭāhake ।। 16।।
tāmrataptakhale kṣiptvā pradīpte havyavāhane ।
prāṇināṃ bharjakaṃ cainaṃ bharjayantu yathākṛtam ।। 17।।
śayanāsanahartāraṃ vahnidāyinameva tu ।
vaitaraṇyāṃ prakṣipantu vahnau paścāt kṣipantu ca ।। 18।।
tīrthakṣetradharmakṣetranāśakaṃ pātayantu vai ।
vidhyantu tasya marmāṇi kīlakairvahnitāpitaiḥ ।।1 9।।
piśunasya kūṭasākṣipradasyā'sya tu karṇayoḥ ।
jihvāyāṃ ca nindakasya dīyantāṃ vahnikīlakāḥ ।।1.360.20 ।।
kāpaṭyayājakaṃ dhūrtaṃ śaṭhaṃ dāṃbhikamatra hi ।
baddhvā tu bandhane kīle dīyatāṃ tu na kiṃcana ।।21 ।।
vācā duṣṭasyā'nṛtasya vakturjihvā'sya chidyatām ।
prasahya kāmamohena vyavāyino'sidhārayā ।।22 ।।
chitvā pāpasya liṃgaṃ ca kṣāramagniśca dīyatām ।
anena kṛtvā ṣaḍyantraṃ dāyādā bahavo janāḥ ।।23 ।।
vināśitāḥ svārthahetorbhedayantu śarairhi tam ।
suvarṇasteyinaṃ tvenaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ pitṛnāśakam ।।24।।
goghnaṃ mudgaraiḥ saṃcūrṇya kṣāre'gnau bharjayantu vai ।
imaṃ kanyāharaṃ vipraṃ khādantu kṛtyakā drutam ।।25।।
piśunaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vyāghrāḥ khādantu tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrakāḥ ।
ima pacantu pākeṣu bahudhā marmabhedinam ।।26।।
devāgnipūjayā hīnaṃ vīraghnaṃ devanindakam ।
karkaṭeṣu mocayantu devadravyavināśakam ।।27।।
kṣipantvimaṃ hrade tapte sarvayājanayājakam ।
adānakārakaṃ dharmavikrayiṇaṃ khalaṃ dvijam ।।28।।
toyabhojanahartāraṃ ghnantu daṇḍaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ ।
veṇudaṇḍakaśābhiśca lohadaṇḍaiścipīṭakaiḥ ।।29।।
jalamasmai na dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca kadācana ।
hataṃ viśvāsya hantāraṃ pācayantu mahānale ।।1.360.3 0।।
devadravyaṃ hṛtaṃ yena tamenaṃ pācayantvapi ।
rājñastu mārake gurormārake bālamārake ।।3 1 ।।
yojayantu rājayakṣmarogaṃ kṣipantu kandare ।
kūṭaśālmalivṛkṣe strīghātakaṃ ghātayantu vai ।।32।।
māṃsādaṃ tu varṣaśataṃ bhakṣayantu yamānugāḥ ।
tataḥ pākeṣu ghoreṣu pacyatāṃ sa narādhamaḥ ।।33।।
tato mānuṣatāṃ prāpya garbhastho mriyatāṃ muhuḥ ।
daśagarbhamṛto bhūtvā kleśabhāgī prajāyatām ।।34।।
bubhukṣārugvikāraiśca satataṃ tatra pīḍyatām ।
yantreṇa pīḍyatāṃ tveṣo mitraviśvāsaghātakaḥ ।।35।।
dīpyatāṃ jvalane ghore tato varṣaśatadvayam ।
tataḥ śvayonimāpanno rogī bhavatu sarvadā ।।36।।
tato rogārtadehastho mānuṣo jāyatāmayam ।
rasahartā lavaṇādihartā'yaṃ jāyatāṃ kṛmiḥ ।।37।।
varṣāṇāṃ tu śataṃ pañca viṣṭhākṛmiśca jāyatām ।
tataḥ śakuntastatpaścād vṛko bhavatu nīrase ।।38।।
imamagnipradaṃ vahnau tāpayantu muhurmuhuḥ ।
paścānmṛgo varṣaśataṃ kīṭo varṣaśataṃ tataḥ ।।39।।
tato'tiduḥkhayukto'sau mānuṣo jāyatāṃ ghṛṇī ।
paradravyāpahārāँśca raurave pātayantvimān ।।1.360.40।।
kumbhīpākeṣu saṃpacya kṣipantu rāsabhe kule ।
paścānmalādavārāhe tataścaurakule nare ।।41 ।।
yatra duḥkhaparītāśca kṛtaṃ vai bhuṃjate graḥ ।
paropaghātinaṃ tvenaṃ baddhvā'dhomastakaṃ drume ।।42।।
agninā pācayantvenaṃ kṣipantu lubdhajanmasu ।
tato varṣaśate pūrṇe muñcantvenaṃ yamānugāḥ ।।43 ।।
piśunaṃ vajratīreṇa praviddhya vahane tataḥ ।
kṣipantu sūkarayonau tato nakulajanmasu ।।44।।
imamānṛtikaṃ kṣetrahārakaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇam ।
prakṣipantvandhatāmisre tatastiryakpaśudrume ।।45।।
yathākarma januṃ labdhvā badhiro'ndhaśca mānuṣe ।
mūkaḥ kāṇo vyādhiyukto jāyatāṃ vai punaḥ punaḥ ।।46 ।।
bhūmiharaṃ kṣetraharaṃ baddhvā vai pācayantvimam ।
paścātsa jāyatāṃ pāpo mārjāraḥ kṣudhayā'rditaḥ ।।47।।
imaṃ śākunikaṃ pāpaṃ śvabhirgṛdhraiśca dāruṇaiḥ ।
ghātayantu tataścainaṃ kṣipantu kukkuṭe kule ।।48।।
daṃśayonau maśakeṣu kṣipantu pāpakarmiṇam ।
imaṃ saukarikaṃ pāpaṃ mahiṣā ghātayantu vai ।।49।।
tataḥ sūkarayonau ca mahiṣe kukkuṭe śaśe ।
jambūke kramaśo gatvā bhakṣyo bhavatu tatra saḥ ।।1.360.50।।
tato vyādho bhavatveṣaḥ pāpātmā'raṇyavāsavān ।
athocchiṣṭānnadātāraṃ pacantvaṃgārakairmuhuḥ ।।51 ।।
bhinnacāritraduḥśīlāṃ bharturvyalīkakāriṇīm ।
āyasānpuruṣānsaptā''liṃgayantu samantataḥ ।।52।।
śūnī bhavatu saṃkaṣṭā sūkaro duḥkhitā tvanu ।
paścāddāsījanma labdhvā bahubhogyā bhavatviyam ।।53।।
anena bhṛtyā bahavo vañcito duḥkhitāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
raurave narake tvenaṃ nikṣipantu durāsade ।।54।।
paścādayaṃ krūrajātau sarpādau jāyatāṃ tataḥ ।
sūkare ca śṛgāle ca bake meṣe ca vājini ।।55।।
bhūtvā bhūtvā gardabhādau śvajātau vṛṣajātike ।
tato vai jāyatāṃ dāsavarge duḥkhatare hyayam ।।56 ।।
etatsarvaṃ śrutaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ viprāḥ pratyakṣameva ha ।
anyānyapi ca pāpāni citragupto dideśa tān ।।57।।
dharmavratādihīnānāṃ pāpapakṣānugāminām ।
yamakārāgrahe varṣasāhasraṃ vāsameva ca ।।58।।
kārayantu yamadūtā hiṃsāvihāriṇā tathā ।
sūcakānāṃ ca kāryapradūṣakāṇāṃ gurudruhām ।।59।।
dāvāgnisaṃpradātṝṇāṃ pācanaṃ pāvake bhaṭāḥ ।
kurvantu ca tato garbhe prerayantu ca mānuṣe ।।1.360.6 0।।
alpāyuṣo vyādhigrastā bhaviṣyanti svapāpataḥ ।
garbhe eva mariṣyanti yadvā naśyanti bālakāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
aprāptayauvanāḥ kecid mariṣyanti prahiṃsakāḥ ।
kāṣṭhapāśe śastrapāśe vāyau vahnau jale'thavā ।।6 2 ।।
patanena tathā nāśaṃ te yāsyanti viṣeṇa vā ।
mātāpitṛvadhakaṣṭaṃ prāṇātipatanaṃ tathā ।।6 3 ।।
prāpsyante svajanādduḥkhaṃ hiṃsakā ghātakāstathā ।
lohakāḥ kārukā gartakārakāḥ prāṇihiṃsakāḥ ।।64।।
mūtrāṇḍanāśakā ye ca garadāḥ puradāhakāḥ ।
ye tu pañjarakartāraḥ śūlādyaistu praghātakāḥ ।।65।।
piśunāḥ kalahāścāpi mithyādūṣaṇakāriṇaḥ ।
paśunāśakarā jīvodvejakā ye ca ghātakāḥ ।।66 ।।
paśyantāṃ narake ghore yātanāsu punaḥ punaḥ ।
karmakṣaye januṃ prāptā hīnāṃgāḥ saṃbhavantu te ।।67।।
daridrāḥ karmabhistatra karṇayoḥ chedanaṃ tathā ।
nāsāpracchedanaṃ hastapādapracchedanaṃ tathā ।।6 8।।
prāpnuvantu mānasaṃ śārīraṃ duḥkhaṃ tu sarvadā ।
galaduḥkhāḥ śiroduḥkhāḥ kukṣyāmayā bhavantu te ।।6 9।।
jaḍā'ndhabadhirā mūkāḥ paṃgavaḥ karasarpiṇaḥ ।
ekapakṣahatāḥ kāṇāḥ kunakhāścāmayāvinaḥ ।।1.360.70।।
kubjāḥ khañjā vikalāśca phullapādā ghaṭodarāḥ ।
galatkuṣṭhāḥ śvitrakuṣṭhā vātā'ṇḍāścāṇḍavarjitāḥ ।।71 ।।
pramehamadhumehārtā yoniśūlā'kṣiśūlakāḥ ।
śvāsahṛdguhyaśūlāśca plīhagulmādirogiṇaḥ ।।72।।
bhavantu mānuṣe bhāve svakarmaphalabhoginaḥ ।
mithyāpralāpinaḥ krūrān pācayantu yamānugāḥ ।।73 ।।
karkaśānnindakān dūtāḥ! piśubhānkaṭukāँstathā ।
snehakṣayakarān rūkṣānmarmaghnān vākpradūṣakān ।।74।।
gālīdānniṣṭhurāँstyaktalajjān śaṭhāँśca nirdayān ।
samatsarān serṣyāścaṇḍān bandhayantu narādhamān ।।75।।
tatastiryakkīṭapakṣipaśuṣvetāna kṣipantu vai ।
tato manuṣyabhāve te bhavantu lokanāśakāḥ ।।76 ।।
paribhūtā avijñānā naṣṭacittā akīrtayaḥ ।
anarcyāścāpyanarhāśca svajanairavamānitāḥ ।।77।।
lokadveṣakarā dveṣyā mitrajñātinirākṛtāḥ ।
mithyākalaṃkabhoktāro vajraśastraviṣādibhiḥ ।।78।।
nāśaṃ prāptā bhavantvete mithyākalaṃkadūṣaṇāḥ ।
athā'nyattu śrutaṃ tatra citraguptoditaṃ bahu ।।79।।
steyahāraṃ prahāraṃ ca nītihāraṃ karoti yaḥ ।
steyakarmāṇi kurvanti prasahya haraṇāni ca ।।1.360.80।।
karacaṇḍāśino ye ca rājacchāyopajīvinaḥ ।
pīḍayanti prajāḥ sarvāstānnarā'dhamapāpinaḥ ।।81 ।।
suvarṇamaṇimuktādikūṭakrayānukārakān ।
samaye ca kṛtaghnāँśca svārthamātraparāyaṇān ।।82।।
bhūtapretābhicāraghnān dhātubhedakarāँstathā ।
nyāsārthahārakānmantramohanādikarāँstathā ।।83 ।।
kṣudropādhikarān dīrghaṃ pācayantu prapāpinaḥ ।
dīnanirdhanakṛpaṇaparāśritādikaṣṭadān ।।84।।
nikṣipantu mahāgarte'ndhakāre vṛścikānvite ।
karmakṣaye tu tāँstatra yojayantu janau jane ।।85।।
yatra caurabhayaṃ vārikṣudbhayaṃ rājato bhayam ।
āpadbhayaṃ mahadītibhayaṃ vyādhibhayaṃ tathā ।।86 ।।
dhūrtaprajājano yatra nagaraṃ śaṭhavāsitam ।
upasargāḥ kṣaṇaṃ yatra na tyajanti kadācana ।।87।।
atha śrutaṃ mayā cānyacchṛṇutātra dvijāḥ! punaḥ ।
ta ete pāpakarmāṇo jāyantāṃ yatra pīḍanam ।।88।।
bahuduḥkhaparikliṣṭāṃ garbhavāse'pi pīḍitāḥ ।
ekahastā dvihastā vā vṛkṇāśca vikṛtodarāḥ ।।89।।
rugṇanāḍīkṛtaduḥkhā hīnāṃgā vāyurogiṇaḥ ।
sadā rorūyamāṇāśca dārahīnā vyavāyinaḥ ।।1.360.90।।
apatyahīnā kṛpaṇā bhairavasvanavālakāḥ ।
ucchiṣṭabhojakāścātivedanābhiḥ susaṃvṛtāḥ ।।91 ।।
rūpato guṇato hīnā balataḥ śīlatastathā ।
bhṛtyānāmapi bhṛtyāste tṛṇībhūtā bhavantu te ।।92।।
nityaṃ yatra nṛpadaṇḍo vadho vā kṛcchrameva vā ।
vṛṣṭiśītakṛtodvegāḥ sarvakārye kṣayā''gamāḥ ।।93 ।।
akīrtibhāginaścāpi śubhe'pyaśubhabhāginaḥ ।
suvṛṣṭyāmapi yeṣāṃ vai kṣetraṃ vṛṣṭirvivarjayet ।।94।।
aśanirvā pated yatra kṣetraṃ tadvā vinaśyati ।
na sukhaṃ nāpi maraṇaṃ kleśo yeṣāṃ tu bhālake ।।95।।
tatra bhavantu te pāpāḥ stenādyā lokakaṣṭadāḥ ।
atha prasahya dārādiprasaktānāṃ tu yātanām ।।96।।
śṛṇutā'tra bhaṭā yatra nikṣeptavyā hi pāpinaḥ ।
tiryaṅmānuṣadeheṣu prasahya kāminastu ye ।।97।।
kāmukyo vā viharanti dharmacāritradūṣikāḥ ।
prasahya vā bhayaṃ datvā ye caranti kulāṃganāḥ ।।98।।
varṇasaṃkarakartārastān kṣipantvanale muhuḥ ।
bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi pācayantu tataśca tān ।।99।।
kṣipantu mānuṣe bhāve yatra saṃkīrṇayonijāḥ ।
veśyālaṃghaṭakūṭāśca naikamaithunakukṣijāḥ ।। 1.360.10 0।।
strībandhakāḥ strīvināśāḥ strīveṣāḥ strīvihāriṇaḥ ।
strīdāsāḥ strībhogabhogyāḥ strībhāvāḥ strīprakarmiṇaḥ ।। 101 ।।
bībhatsadarśanā yatra tatra kṣipantu tān janān ।
nāryo'pi tatsvabhāvāśca tadvad bhavantu duḥkhagāḥ ।। 1 02।।
iti śrutaṃ mayā sarvaṃ nāciketā jagāda tān ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! citraguptanideśanam ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne yāmyacakre pāpināṃ daṇḍadānāya citraguptakṛtājñayā vividhayātanāsu mandehādirākṣasaiḥ kṛtanāraki-
pīḍanādipradarśananāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 36 0 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 360 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 361
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 362 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! citraguptanideśanam ।
yattvadhikaṃ punaścoktaṃ nāciketā jagād tān ।। 1 ।।
dūtā! gṛhṇantu taṃ śīghraṃ yathā kālo na vai kramet ।
kā kṛpā kriyate tatra gṛhṇantu ghnantu mā ciram ।। 2 ।।
mā'tra vrīḍā prakartavyā mā tiṣṭhantu parāṅmukhāḥ ।
kiṃ na gacchatha vegena vā mā sta dīrghasūtriṇaḥ ।। 3 ।।
śīghraṃ gacchata tatraiva samānayata satvaram ।
nā'śaktirdarśayitavyā gaṇanīyā na satkriyā ।। 4 ।।
na vivāho na vai tāpasatvaṃ naiṣṭhikatā tathā ।
na navastrīramaṇaṃ vā pātivratyaṃ satītvakam ।। 5 ।।
sādhvītvaṃ bālakatvaṃ vā dānasthatvaṃ ratisthitiḥ ।
rājyakāryaṃ sabhāsthānaṃ vyomayānaṃ prapūjanam ।। 6 ।।
mā gaṇanīyaṃ kimapi yathā kālo'natikramet ।
śīghramatrā''nayadhvaṃ vai yathākarma praśāsanam ।। 7 ।।
śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhava sarpaśca bhava tvaṃ vyāghra ityapi ।
sarīsṛpo jalagrāho bhava tvaṃ kṛmiralpakaḥ ।। 8 ।।
bhava tvaṃ vyādhirūpaśca bhavātisāra ityapi ।
chardiḥ punarbhava tvaṃ ca karṇarogo viṣūcikā ।। 9 ।।
jvaro bhavā'nilavyādhistvaṃ ca bhava jalodaraḥ ।
apasmārastvamunmādo viṣṭaṃbho vibhramo bhava ।। 1.361.1 0।।
drutaṃ dravata vegena sarve gacchata mā ciram ।
yathānyāyaṃ yathākarma yathākālaṃ ca dehinaḥ ।। 1 1।।
dharṣayantu karṣayantu samānayantu mā ciram ।
āyuṣyānte mārayantu yathā kālo na sampatet ।। 1 2।।
jāgrataṃ vā nidritaṃ vā mūrchitaṃ vā suṣuptakam ।
yathāvācyaṃ prakuruta yathākālo na gacchati ।। 13 ।।
yathā''jñāpayati rudro yathā saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
yathā brahmā dharmarājaścitraguptastathā prabhuḥ ।। 14।।
ityājñāpayati citraguptastathā prayānti ca ।
yamadūtā ānayanti dehinastatra sannidhau ।। 15।।
teṣāṃ karmāṇi cālokya daṇḍaṃ diśati tatra vai ।
yamaśca citraguptaśca vadāmi yacchrutaṃ mayā ।। 16 ।।
ayaṃ tu puṇyavān dātā yātu svargaṃ mahīkṣitām ।
ayaṃ bhavatu vṛkṣo vai tīryagayaṃ prajāyatām ।। 17।।
ayaṃ nāgo bhavatveva yātvayaṃ paramāṃ gatim ।
svapūrvajā'vamantā'yaṃ yātu narakaṃ dāruṇam ।। 18 ।।
dāratyāgakaraṃ tvenaṃ kṣapayantu hi raurave ।
mucyantāṃ ta ime cānye mucyantāṃ pāpavarjitāḥ ।। 1 9।।
svargaṃ prayāntu dharmiṣṭhā uṣitvā bahukalpakān ।
sarvasmṛddhimaye bhūmau mānuṣe yāntu sajjanum ।।1.361.20 ।।
brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā rāṣṭrārthe nidhanaṃ gatam ।
śakrasya tvamarāvatyāṃ preṣayantu ca mā ciram ।।2 1 ।।
kalpamekaṃ tatra vāso bhavatvasya sukhāvahaḥ ।
bahudānarataṃ cainaṃ sarvajīvānukampakam ।। 22 ।।
gandhamālyaiḥ pūjayantu samarpayantu copadāḥ ।
vijyatāṃ cāmeraireṣo yānamasmai pradīyatām ।। 23 ।।
vaihāyasena yānena yātvayaṃ tvindrapattanam ।
śaṃkhatūryā'bhighoṣeṇa satkṛto labhatāṃ sukham ।। 24।।
ayaṃ gacchatu sallokaṃ kīrtimatāṃ śubhāspadam ।
guṇaiḥ sevādibhirindrāyuṣyo'stu vai triviṣṭape ।। 25 ।।
ratnasvarṇapradātā'yamaśvinorlokametu vai ।
bahvannadānakartā'yaṃ śivalokaṃ prayātu vai ।।26।।
miṣṭānnasya ca dugdhasya dogdhā gordānakāryayam ।
hemavastrasya sandātā tisraḥ koṭyastriviṣṭape ।। 27।।
tiṣṭhatu cyuta evātra ṛṣivaryo bhavet kṣitau ।
pitṛtarpayitā cāyaṃ satyalokaṃ prayātu vai ।। 28।।
sarvakāmapradaścāyaṃ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ।
kṣiterdātāṃ prayātveva bahukālaṃ triviṣṭapam ।।29।।
evaṃ puṇyakṛto yāntu svargānyatheṣṭabhogadān।
pāpakṛto hyadho yāntu nirayān kleśasaṃcayān ।। 1.361.30 ।।
evaṃ śrutaṃ mayā viprāḥ! śrutaścāpi phalodayaḥ ।
kathayāmi ca tatsarvaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ vai samāhitāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
ayaṃ cātithyasatkartā sarvabhūtānukampanaḥ ।
samānnadānakartā ca śeṣabhojanabhāgayam ।।32।।।
vairājasya padaṃ yātu sarvabhāgyasukhānvitaḥ ।
enaṃ gāsyanti gandharvā gamane'psarasastathā ।।33 ।।
dīyatāmāsanaṃ divyaṃ dīyatāṃ vyomavāhanam ।
yānyānkāmānkāmayate dīyatāṃ mama śāsanāt ।। 34।।
svargakāmānpitṛkāmānsatyakāmānvirājagān ।
samarpayantu vai tvasmai dāsadāsīparicchadān ।।35।।
dattānyanena dānāni ratnasvarṇagavādayaḥ ।
mahiṣīgajaturagāḥ kṣetraṃ codyānavāṭikāḥ ।।36।।
kanyādānāni bahūni cānnadānānyapīha yat ।
prekṣyatāṃ sa mahābhāgo bhoktuṃ divi sahānugaḥ ।। 37।।
yāvat svargād vimānāni samāgacchanti kṛtsnaśaḥ ।
tataḥ sa pravarairyānaiḥ sānugaḥ saparicchadaḥ ।।38।।
devānāṃ bhavanaṃ yātu devatābhiḥ supūjitaḥ ।
tatraiva ramatāṃ puṇyo yāvatsvargaṃ hi tiṣṭhati ।।39।।
athainaṃ yajñakartāraṃ naikakanyāpradāyakam ।
pūjayantu sarvakāmaiḥ padaṃ yātu sa vaiṣṇavam ।।1.361.40।।
tatraiṣa ramatāṃ puṇyaḥ sahasramayutaṃ samāḥ ।
bhūtānukampako hyeṣa kriyatāmasya pūjanam ।।41 ।।
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ divyaṃ tiṣṭhatu diviṃ devavat ।
athā'nena pradattāni chatraṃ pātraṃ tathā'mbaram ।।42।।
upānahau ca bhojyāni tasmai pūjāṃ prayacchatha ।
hastapadmacamatkāro vidyādharo bhavatvayam ।।43।।
mahāpadmāni catvāri svarge tiṣṭhatu sarvadā ।
anenā'nāthadīneṣu dattaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhiṃ ghṛtam ।।44।।
nīyatāṃ rasavatsvargaṃ pūjāṃ tvasmai prayacchatha ।
gorasasya ca pūrṇāni bhājanāni prayacchatha ।।45।।
datvā svabāndhavebhyaḥ sa pītvā svajanabāndhavaiḥ ।
yātvanasūyake svarge ramatāṃ varṣakoṭayaḥ ।।46 ।।
bahusundaranārībhiḥ sevyamāno'maraḥ sadā ।
golokeṣu sadā cāyaṃ vasatu bhogyasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।।47।।
ikṣusārapradātā'yaṃ dugdhasārā'rpako hyayam ।
annasārapradātā ca vastrabhūṣā'rpakastathā ।।48।।
gṛhakṣetrapradātā ca sarvopaskaraṇā'rpakaḥ ।
golokeṣu nīyatāṃ ca vṛṣavāhanasaṃyutaḥ ।।49।।
sarvadevātmikā devyo yatra tiṣṭhanti sevikāḥ ।
amṛtaṃ dhārayantyaśca sevante'harniśaṃ śubhāḥ ।।1.361.50।।
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ puṣṭiḥ pavitraṃ tīrthamamṛtam ।
dadhnā tṛpyanti devādyāḥ kṣīreṇa tu maheśvaraḥ ।।।51 ।।
ghṛtena pāvako nityaṃ pāyasena pitāmahaḥ ।
sakṛd dattena prīyante varṣāṇāṃ tu trayodaśa ।।।52। ।
pañcagavyena pītena vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet ।
gavyaṃ tu paramaṃ medhyaṃ gāvo medhyā hi devatāḥ।।53 ।।
dānteṣu maruto devā jihvāyāṃ tu sarasvatī ।
khuramadhye tu gandharvāḥ khurāgreṣu tu pannagāḥ ।।54।।
sarvasandhiṣu sādhyāśca candrādityau tu locane ।
kakude ca nakṣatrāṇi lāṃgūle dharma āsthitaḥ ।।55।।।
apāne sarvatīrthāni lakṣmīstiṣṭhati śakṛti ।
prasrāve jāhnavī devī staneṣvasyāstu sāgarāḥ ।।56।।
ṛṣayo romakūpeṣu vidyādharāstu romasu ।
tvaci vaikuṇṭhamevā'sti pārśvayorayanadvayam ।।57।।
kṣamā dhṛtiśca śāntiśca puṣṭirvṛddhiḥ smṛtirmatiḥ ।
medhā lajjā vapuḥkīrtirvidyā śāntiśca santatiḥ ।।।58।।
kriyonnatyādikā dharmapatnyo goṣu vyavasthitāḥ ।
yatra gāvastatra devā lakṣmīrdharmaśca rakṣakāḥ ।।59।।
godātā labhate sarvaṃ prāsādān bhavanāni ca ।
strīryuvatīrdāsadāsīḥ śayanāsanapānakam ।।1.361.60।।
bhogyabhogān pānagṛhabhakṣyabhojanasaṃcayān ।
vājino vāraṇān yānavāhanāni ca vāṭikāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
dadata gopradātāraṃ citraguptājñayā'nugāḥ ।
imaṃ tvāmrapradātāraṃ tathodyānasamarpakam ।। 62।।
dadatā''mravaṇaṃ ramyaṃ divyakanyāṃ parīṃ śubhām ।
ityevaṃ bahudhā tatrā''karṇitaṃ dṛṣṭamityapi ।।63 ।।
gṛhād gṛhāntaraṃ sthalāt sthalāntaraṃ tu gacchatā ।
kaṣṭātkaṣṭataraṃ saumyāt sukhātsukhataraṃ tathā ।।64।।
karmahāniḥ karmamahodayo''pyālokito mayā ।
tato'haṃ bhagavān dharmarājasya saṃsadi tvayam ।।65।।
tāvattatra samāyāto nārado dyotitaprabhaḥ ।
yamarājaḥ pūjayitvā taṃ nyaṣādayadāsane ।।66।।
prāha pūtā vayaṃ sarve deśaḥ pūtastavā''gamāt ।
yatkāryaṃ yena vā kāryaṃ prabrūhi bhagavanniti ।।67।।
śrutvā tu nāradaḥ prāha saṃśayaṃ chindhi me param ।
amaratvaṃ kathaṃ yānti dānena niyamena vā ।।68।।
vratena tapasā vāpi japenopāsanena vā ।
kenā'tulāṃ śriyaṃ yānti kīrtiṃ sthānaṃ ca śāśvatam ।।69।।
kena gacchanti narakaṃ pāpiṣṭhaṃ lokagarhaṇam ।
sarvamākhyāhi tattvena bhaviṣyati hitaṃ param ।।1.361.70।।
yamarājastamuvāca śṛṇvatāṃ tatra vartinām ।
dharmeṇa tu janā yānti svargaṃ puṇyasamarjitam ।।71 ।।
adharmeṇa tu nirayān bandhāँśca bahujātikān ।
agnicinnarakaṃ naiva yāti kadāpi nārada! ।।72।।
putravān bhūmidaḥ śūro vedaśāstraviśāradaḥ ।
jñānavān satyavartmā ca patnīvrataḥ pativratā ।।73 ।।
śāṭhyakāpaṭyahīnāśca svāmibhaktāstu dehinaḥ ।
ahiṃsakā akṛtaghnā brahmacaryādiniṣṭhitāḥ ।।74।।
dānino dvijabhaktāśca pitṛbhaktaśca sādhavaḥ ।
satā dāsā pāradāryarahitāśca dayālavaḥ ।।75।।
sarvabhūtātmavettāro na yānti nirayān kvacit ।
yātanāpūrṇakānduḥkhānpāpiṣṭhāँstamasāvṛtān ।।76।।
ye janā jñānavanto'tra ye ca vidyāṃ parāṃ gatāḥ ।
udāsīnā na gacchanti svāmyarthe ca hatā janāḥ ।।77।।
sarvahite ratāḥ śuśrūṣakā dātāra eva ye ।
tilagopṛthivīsvarṇakanyādānakarāstathā ।।78।।
annadā jaladāścāpi satrasaṃcālakāstathā ।
yājinaḥ kṛtinaścāturmāsyavratārthinaśca ye ।।79।।
kārtikādivratavanto gurvājñāvartanāstu ye ।
maunādiguṇavanto'pi nityaṃ svādhyāyakārakāḥ ।।1.361.8 0।।
dāntāḥ saumyāḥ svātmabhāvāḥ parvendriyajayāstathā ।
nivṛttāḥ sarvakāmebhyo nirāśā nirjitendriyāḥ ।।8 1 ।।
na gacchanti nirayāँste'maratvaṃ prāpnuvanti ca ।
bhaktyā'maratvaṃ saṃyānti kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।।82।।
jñānā'bhayapradānena naiṣṭhikaniyamena ca ।
brahmavratena jñānātmatapasā oṃ harirjapāt ।।83।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇopāstyā hyamaratvaṃ tu śāśvatam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevā śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ dadāti hi ।।84।।
satāṃ sevā gavāṃ sevā kīrtiṃ sthānaṃ dadāti hi ।
lokagarhitakāryeṇa yāti sthānaṃ tu garhitam ।।85।।
tapasā prāpyate svargaṃ tapasā prāpyate yaśaḥ ।
āyuḥprakarṣo bhogāśca tapasaiva bhavanti hi ।।86 ।।
jñānaṃ vijñānamārogyaṃ rūpasaubhāgyasampadaḥ ।
dhanapatnīsutadāsāḥ tapasā sarvamāpyate ।।87।।
evaṃ maunena vāksiddhiḥ santoṣātsukhamuttamam ।
upabhogāśca dānena brahmacaryeṇa jīvitam ।।88।।
ahiṃsayā tvanudvego dīkṣayā kulajanma ca ।
phalamūlāśino rājyaṃ svargaḥ parṇāśino bhavet ।।89।।
payobhakṣā divaṃ yānti dravyadā yānti cāḍhyatām ।
guruśuśrūṣayā śrāddhadānena śubhasantatim ।।1.361.90।।
rasadānā gavādyāśca bhavanti tṛṇaśāyinām ।
svayaṃ triṣavaṇād brahma jalapāteṣṭalokabhāg ।।91 ।।
yajñakartā svaḥ prayāti saubhāgyena pramodate ।
annadānena ca prāpnotyannaṃ medhāṃ smṛtiṃ divam ।।92।।
chatradānena sāmrājyaṃ gṛhadānād gṛhādikam ।
rathayānapradānena yānavāhanavān bhavet ।। 93 ।।
vastradātā suśṛṃgārān dhanaputrāँśca saṃlabhet ।
pānīyadātā tṛptiṃ vai śāśvatīṃ labhate divi ।।94।।
annapānādidānena kāmabhogaiḥ sutṛpyate ।
puṣpagandhaphalavṛkṣadātā strīratnavadgṛham ।।95।।
śayanānyanulepāँśca gandhakajjaladhūpakān ।
srajo dadāti yaḥ śayyāmārāmaṃ phalipādapam ।।96 ।।
saḥ strīsmṛddhaṃ gajavājipūrṇaṃ gṛhaṃ prapadyate ।
dhūpadīpapradātā ca prāpnoti vasusāmyatām ।।97।।
gajagovṛṣadānena svargaṃ śāśvatamāpyate ।
ghṛtadānena tejasvī sukumāro hi jāyate ।।98।।
tailadānena vai snigdhaścamatkārakaro bhavet ।
madhumiṣṭaśarkarādidātā tṛptagṛho bhavet ।।99।।
dīpadānād dyutimān syāt pāyasena vapurdṛḍham ।
kṛsarānnāt snigdhasaumyabhāvaṃ labhate surūpitām ।। 1.361.100 ।।
phalaistu labhate putraṃ puṣpaiḥ saubhāgyamityapi ।
rathairdivyaṃ vimānantu yānaṃ vāhanamityapi ।। 101 ।।
abhayasya pradānena prāṇadānena cā'pyatha ।
sarvakāmapradānena sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ।। 1 02।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! phalaṃ yamena bhāṣitam ।
nāradāya tu tatsarvaṃ viprebhyo nāciketasā ।। 103 ।।
śrutvā tu nārado natvā yamarājaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
yayau pūjāṃ gṛhītvā ca satyaloke vihāyasā ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kutayugasantāne yāmyacakre citraguptājñayā pāpināmānayanāya dūtānāṃ pravṛttiḥ, dattadānānāṃ phalodayāḥ, nāradāya dharbharājoktaḥ phalodayaḥ, prāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭayadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।36 1 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 361 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 362
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 363 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tatastatra yajjātaṃ tad vadāmi te ।
nāciketā dvijānāha yad dṛṣṭaṃ tad yathārthataḥ ।। 1 ।।
śṛṇvantu brāhmaṇāstatra dharmarājena dhīmatā ।
dṛṣṭā vimānakaiḥ sūryasamairyānto divaṃ prati ।। 2 ।।
tāpasāḥ siddhimantaste patnīyutāḥ sabāndhavāḥ ।
sānurāgāḥ puṇyapuñjadyotamānānanāśca te ।। 3 ।।
tato drāgeva sañjāto dharmarājo'tiduḥkhitaḥ ।
vivarṇavadano roṣāt prabhātejovivarjitaḥ ।। 4 ।।
etādṛśaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭavānahamaṃjasā ।
api tvaṃ bhrājamānastu kathaṃ vaivarṇyamāptavān ।। 5 ।।
vitapyase kathaṃ rājan! hyetadicchāmi veditum ।
yamarājastadā prāha vivarṇaśokakāragam ।। 6 ।।
yāyāvarā uñchavṛttiparāḥ svādhyāyakāriṇaḥ ।
ātithyasatkriyāvanto yoginaśca jitendriyāḥ ।। 7 ।।
brahmacaryaparā ye tu sādhavaśca satīstriyaḥ ।
te sarve māmanādṛtya gacchantyupari me dvija! ।। 8 ।।
na te yāmupatiṣṭhanti na hi te vaśagā mama ।
mastake mama gacchanti patnīyuktāḥ sahānugāḥ ।। 9 ।।
divyagandhaviliptāṃgā mālyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।
vadantaśca samuddiśya māṃ yathā mlānatā bhavet ।। 1.362.10 ।।
yameśaṃ na gaṇayāmo gacchāmastatparaṃ sthalam ।
mṛtyo! tiṣṭhasi kasyārthe ko vā mṛtyuryamaśca kaḥ ।। 11 ।।
asmatkṛte nirartho'yaṃ yamo yameśvaro'pi ca ।
doṣānvitān sadā haṃsi pāpiṣṭhāndharmavarjitān ।। 12।।
nā'si roddhuṃ samartho'pi yāsyāmaḥ paramaṃ padam ।
iti bruvantaḥ saṃyānti vaimānikāḥ śrutaṃ mayā ।। 1 3।।।
nigrahānugrahau kartuṃ mayā śakyau na yoginām ।
samartho'pi śṛṇomyevaṃ tena tapye dvijottama! ।। 14।।
aśaktiṃ svāṃ teṣu matvā paritapye bhṛśaṃ dvija! ।
ityakathayanmāṃ dharmarājastatra kṣaṇāntare ।। 15।।
kācitpativratā sādhvī vimānenā''yayau puraḥ ।
mahādyutiḥ sānugā sabhartṛkā saparicchadā ।। 16।।
sotsavā dharmarājānamuvāca sukhakṛddhitam ।
dharmarāja! mahāpūjya! mā yāhi mlānatāṃ prabho ।। 17।।
viprāstapasvinaḥ śāntāḥ santaḥ sādhvyaśca tāpasāḥ ।
darśanīyā vandanīyāḥ svabalāt pāragāminaḥ ।। 18।।
eteṣāṃ tapasāṃ dharma! māhātmyaṃ balamityapi ।
mokṣaprāptipradaṃ ceśalokapradaṃ parātparam ।।1 9।।
acintyāḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sādhavo brāhmaṇāstathā ।
brāhmaṇāḥ satataṃ pūjyāḥ sādhavaḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।।।1.362.20 ।।
sattā tatra na yoktavyā mātsaryaṃ varjyameva ca ।
rāgo roṣastathā moho na kartavyaḥ sadā satām ।।21 ।।
evamuktvā namaskṛtya prayātā sā paraṃ divam ।
tato mayā vai saṃpṛṣṭaṃ dharmarājāya kā'bhavat ।।22।।
dharmarājo jagādā'tha kathāṃ māṃ kṛtsnaśastataḥ ।
purā kṛtayuge vipra! nimirnāma mahāyaśāḥ ।।23 ।।
āsīd rājā dharmatejovīryasatyavratānvitaḥ ।
tasya putro mithirnāma mithilā yena nirmitā ।।24।।
mithilāyā janakatvāt janakaścopanāmakaḥ ।
tasya rūpavatī nāma patnī priyapriyaṃkarī ।।25।।
patibhaktā mahāprītyā bharturvacanakāriṇī ।
tayoḥ rājye jarāvyādhimṛtyavaḥ prabhavanti na ।।26।।
vavarṣa satataṃ devo rujārto na janaḥ kvacit ।
uvāca rājñī rājānaṃ vinayāddharmabhṛdvacaḥ ।।27।।
rājaँstvayā kṛtā yajñā bhojitāsteṣu bhūsurāḥ ।
dattaṃ dāna bahuvidhaṃ nālpaṃ dravyaṃ viśiṣyate ।।28।।
bhṛtyānāṃ ca dvijātīnāṃ tathā parijanasya ca ।
yadabhūt draviṇāṃ kiñcitpṛthivyāṃ yadgṛhe ca te ।।29।।
viniyuktaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ dānakārye hyaśeṣataḥ ।
na tvaṃ rājan vijānāsi kuto bhojanamarthayet ।।1.362.3 0।।
nāsti gṛhe na cānyatra kapardikāpi vidyate ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ kandaḥ ṛṣibhyo dattameva ha ।।3 1 ।।
kṣetraṃ ca vāṭikā rājyaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasātkṛtam ।
na vā gavādikaṃ kiñcinna ca vastrāṇi karhicit ।।32।।
na caiva vārṣikaḥ kaścidāyo'sti bhojanasya tu ।
kathaṃ hyudaryaśāntyarthaṃ vartanīyaṃ vada prabho! ।।33।।
iti priyāvacaḥ śrutvā janakaḥ prāha bhāminīm ।
śṛṇu bravīmi saṃśakyaṃ yadi me manyase hitam ।।34।।
haviṣye vartamānānāmidaṃ varṣaśataṃ gatam ।
kuddālena ca kāṣṭhena kṣetraṃ vai kurvahe priye ।।35।।
tato'nnapānavastrādiprāptirdharmo bhaviṣyati ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ tadanyacca labdhvā tvaṃ sukhamāpsyasi ।।36।।
evamuktā tu sā rājñī saṃhṛṣṭā nṛpamabravīt ।
bhṛtyānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi dāsīnāṃ te niveśane ।। 37।।
aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca saurabhīnāṃ ca koṭayaḥ ।
uṣṭrāṇāṃ ca mahiṣāṇāṃ kharāṇāṃ cāpi koṭayaḥ ।। 38।।
vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ koṭayaḥ santi te gṛhe ।
niyukṣva rājan sarvāṃstān kṛṣikārye tavepsite ।।3 9।।
rājā prāha mayā rājñi! dāne dattāni tāni vai ।
balīvardāḥ kharā aśvā gajā uṣṭrāśca mānavāḥ ।। 1.362.40 ।।
sarve niyuktā dāneṣu na me sattā'sti teṣu vai ।
āyasaṃ trāpuṣaṃ tāmraṃ rājataṃ kāñcanaṃ ca yat ।।41 ।।
draviṇaṃ sarvamevātra dāne yajñe niyojitam ।
na vai paśyāmi dharmajñe! gṛhe svarṇaṃ tathā''yasam ।। 42।।
yena kuryāmahaṃ devi! kuddālaṃ kṛṣikarmaṇe ।
evamuktā'tihṛṣṭā sā'bravīd rūpavatī nṛpam ।। 43।।
gacchāvo nṛpa! bhadraṃ syādudyogaḥ sampadāṃpradaḥ ।
evamukto nimiputro yayau kṣetraṃ sabhāryakaḥ ।। 44।।
idṃ bhadraṃ mama kṣetraṃ vanavṛkṣamayaṃ sadā ।
asaṃskṛtaṃ tathā'kṛṣṭaṃ na dattaṃ yannirarthakam ।।45।।
atrā''sva taṃ svalpagulmān kaṇṭakāँśca chinadmyaham ।
atisvalpatṛṇādīṃśca tvametān śodhaya priye! ।। 46 ।।
evamuktā mahārājñī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya tṛṇagulmān nikṛntati ।। 47।।
tāvat tayā pativākyapālinyā puṇyavaibhavāt ।
dṛṣṭaḥ pārśve mahān gulmaḥ sauvarṇaṃ kanakapradaḥ ।। 48।।
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ prasannā sā nṛpāṃganā ।
vṛkṣo'tra dṛśyate pārśve sauvarṇo gulma uttamaḥ ।। 49।।
tāvadvṛkṣastayā tvanyo dṛṣṭaḥ phalādiśobhitaḥ ।
tāvattatra tṛtīyo drurdṛṣṭo bhojanavastuyuk ।।1.362.50।।
na dṛṣṭantu jalaṃ tatra sānnidhye vanabhūtale ।
uvāca hṛṣṭā rājānaṃ prāptaṃ bhojyaṃ na vai jalam ।।51 ।।
kathametaccopapannaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā'pyuvāca tām ।
pūrvaṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ sarvamagre pradhāvati ।। 52।।
kṛtaṃ vai prāpyate sarvaṃ nā'kṛtaṃ tu kathaṃcana ।
jalaṃ cāpi pradattaṃ tadavaśyaṃ sammiliṣyati ।।53।।
ityuktvā śodhayāmāsa kṣetraṃ sabhāryako nṛpaḥ ।
viyanmadhye tadograśca savitā tapate hyati ।।54।।
pravṛddho dāruṇo gharmo rājñī tu tṛṣitā'bhavat ।
snigdhau tāmratalau pādau tasyāḥ santāpamāgatau ।।55।।
pravālaraktau hastau ca śarīraṃ komalaṃ tathā ।
vyathitā sūryatāpena bhṛśamuṣṇena pīḍitā ।।56।।
patitā mūrchayā bhūmau tṛṣāvegena bhāminī ।
patantyā tu tayā dṛṣṭaḥ sūryo vihvalayā dṛśā ।।।57।।
yadṛcchayā patantyā tu sūryaḥ kopena vīkṣitaḥ ।
tena sūryo'titejasvī santrasto gagane'bhavat ।।58।।
gatihīno divaṃ muktvā patito dharaṇītale ।
nistejaskaḥ śāntavarṇaḥ śītalaśca tadā'bhavat ।।59।।
pativratāyāḥ sānnidhye sūryatejo layaṃ gatam ।
rājā sa janakaḥ prāha rakṣa svabhāvaśūnyakam ।।1.362.6 0।।
kimarthamiha tejastvaṃ tyaktvā pṛthvyāṃ samāgataḥ ।
kiṃ karomi hi pūjārthe namaskaromi bhāskara! ।।6 1 ।।
evaṃ bruvantaṃ rājānaṃ sūryaḥ savinayo'bravīt ।
pativratā te gṛhiṇī mamaiṣā ruṣitā manāk ।। 62।।
tasyā roṣaprabhāveṇa patito'haṃ vimūrchitaḥ ।
anayā sadṛśī nārī trailokye naiva vidyate ।।63।।
aho'syāḥ paramā sevā aho'syāḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
aho dhairyamaho śaktistavevā'syāḥ śubhā guṇāḥ ।।64।।
anurūpā viśuddhā ca tava cittānusāriṇī ।
pativratyena tapasā sādhvī tava hite ratā ।। 65 ।।
kalpavṛkṣasamā ceyaṃ sadṛśī te surārcane ।
pātraṃ pātravatā prāptaṃ sukṛtasya mahatphalam ।।66 ।।
anurūpo virūpo vā tvayā kāmastu yaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
vitatho vā bhavedasyāḥ pātivratyaprabhāvataḥ ।।67।।
kuruṣva svepsitaṃ kṣetraṃ yathā manasi dhāritam ।
ahaṃ dadāmi vai vāri daivamamṛtasadṛśam ।।68।।
bhojanaṃ saṃdadāmyetadupānahau sudivyakau ।
chatraṃ śayyāṃ tathā divyāṃ kāmadhenuṃ maṇiṃ śubham ।। 6 9।।
pātraṃ tvakṣayyamevāpi nityaṃ bhojyādipūrakam ।
evamuktvā svayaṃ sūryaḥ sasarja jalabhājanam ।।1.362.70।।
upānahī+au maṇiṃ chatraṃ śayyāṃ sthālīṃ ca gāṃ tathā ।
dadau tasmai maithilāya savitā snehasaṃplutaḥ ।।71 ।।
uvāca sa punarbhūpaṃ dehi rājñyai sukhāṃ kuru ।
kṣetraṃ yaśasyaṃ phaladaṃ bhaviṣyatyapi kāmadam ।।72।।
rājñā sā''pyāyitā devī toyena tu tadā hi sā ।
labdhasaṃjñā luptabhayā rājānamidamabravīt ।।73।।
kena dattaṃ śītatoyaṃ divyaṃ chatramupānahau ।
śayyā dhenurmaṇiḥ pātraṃ bhojyaṃ ceti vadātra me ।।74।।
rājā prāha svayaṃ sūryo devi! tavā'nukampayā ।
etatsarvapradānāya muktvā''kāśamihā''gataḥ ।।75।।
ityuktvā pūjitaḥ sūryo dvābhyāṃ sūryeṇa satkṛtau ।
arthayāmāsatuḥ sūryaṃ kiṃ kurvo bhagavaṃstava ।।76।।
evamukto vivasvān sa jagād svā'vanā'rthakam ।
abhayaṃ me sadātvastu pativratābhya eva ha ।।77।।
pativratābhyaḥ saṃkleśaḥ strībhyo me mā bhavet kvacit ।
sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā rājñī prāha tathāstviti ।।78।।
abhayaṃ te sarvanetra! yathā tvaṃ vṛtavānasi ।
ityuktaḥ sa yayau svasya maṇḍalaṃ divi bhāskaraḥ ।।79।।
saiṣā pativratā rūpavatī janakabhāminī ।
pātivratyaprabhāveṇa sarvamāptavatī vane ।।1.362.80 ।।
mayā'pi pūjyate svāmivratā sūryasya sūnunā ।
na tasyā niyamo vipra! svatantraṃ nahi vai tapaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
upavāso na dānaṃ vā na devo vā patimṛte ।
prasupte yā prasvapiti jāgarti vibudhe sati ।।।82।।।
bhuṃkte tu bhojite patyau sā mṛtyuṃ jayati dhruvam ।
maune maunā sthite sthitimatī mṛtyuṃ jayatyapi ।।82 ।।
ekadṛṣṭirekamanā bharturvacanakāriṇī ।
tasyā bibhīmahe sarve devā daityāśca dānavāḥ ।।84 ।।
devānāmapi pūjyā sā sādhvī santoṣasadvratā ।
bhartrā cābhihitā yā na tatpratyākhyāyinī bhavet । ।85।।
sevāyāṃ vartamānā sā pratyākhyātā priyeṇa tu ।
na daivataṃ saṃprayāti patyuranyaṃ kadācana । ।86 ।।
sā na mṛtyumukhaṃ yāti tvevaṃ yā strī pativratā ।
evaṃ yā tu bhavennityaṃ bhartuḥ priyahite ratā । ।86।।
sā tu nityaṃ svabhartāraṃ chāyeva tvanugacchati ।
sā tu mṛtyumukhadvāraṃ na vai gacchet kadācana ।।88।।
eṣa mātā pitā bandhureṣa me daivataṃ param ।
patiṃ śuśrūṣave caivaṃ sā māṃ vijayate sadā । ।89।।
bhartāramanudhyāyantī bhartāramanugacchatī ।
bhartāramanuśocantī mṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ।।1.362.90।।
gītavāditranṛtyāni naikapradarśanānyapi ।
na śṛṇoti na paśyed yā mṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ।।91 ।।
snāntī vā tiṣṭhatī vāpi kurvantī vā prasādhanam ।
pratyāhūtā copatiṣṭhenmṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ।।92 ।।
devatā arcayantaṃ vā bhujyamānaṃ patiṃ tu yā ।
cittānnaṃ tyajate kvāpi mṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati । ।93 ।।
nānyaṃ yā manasā paśyenmṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ।
bhānau tvanudite nityaṃ gṛhaṃ mārjayate tu yā ।।94।।
bharturmukhaṃ prapaśyed yā bhartuścittānukāriṇī ।
vartate tu hite bharturmṛtyudvāraṃ na paśyati ।।।95।।
cakṣurdehaśca bhāvaśca yasyā nityaṃ susaṃvṛtam ।
śaucācārasamāyuktā sā tu mṛtyuṃ na paśyati ।।96 ।।
etāḥ kīrtimatāṃ loke dṛśyante divi devatāḥ ।
mānuṣāṇāmapi bhāryā dṛśyante divi devatāḥ । ।97।।
ādityena mama pitrā pūjitāstāḥ pativratāḥ ।
mayā tasmāttu pūjyante sarvadaiva pativratāḥ । ।98।।
evaṃ pativratā nityaṃ mārgeṇā'nena yānti vai ।
bahūnuddhārya satataṃ pūjyante tā mayā sadā ।।99।।
ruddhyante na mayā tāstu nā'haṃ śakto'smi rodhane ।
janakasya tu sā bhāryā kṣaṇārdhaṃ jalakāmyayā ।। 1.362.100 ।।
atrā''gatā'bhavattāvatsūryastasyai jalaṃ dadau ।
gṛhītvā matkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ yayau drāk svāminaṃ svakam ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yāmyacakre pativratāmāhātmye mithināmajanakapatnyā rūpavatyāḥ pātivratyaprabhāveṇa vane'pi sūryadvārā phalānnajalasvarṇādisarvasmṛddhiprāptiḥ pativratādharmakathanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 362 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 362 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 363
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 364 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
nāciketā pātivratyadharmaṃ śrutvā yamānanāt ।
yamaṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ sarvalokahitāvaham ।। 1 ।।
śṛṇu vacmi yathā pṛṣṭaṃ lakṣmi! vai nāciketasā ।
dharmarāja! mahābāho! kathayasva mahātapāḥ ।। 2 ।।
kāṃkṣante sarvajanatā sukhaṃ tapovratādibhiḥ ।
evaṃ kṛcchrāśritānāṃ dhīḥ kathaṃ pāpe prajāyate? ।। 3 ।।
nānāvrataśatopāyāḥ śreyodharmā hi mānavāḥ ।
kasyaitacceṣṭitaṃ pāpaṃ kartā kārayitā tu kaḥ ।। 4 ।।
kathaṃ dveṣe matiryadvā kathaṃ rāge prajāyate ।
kaḥ karṣati jagattveko bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ।। 5 ।।
śrutvā prāha yamo devo brahmarṣe! śrūyatāṃ tu tat ।
mānavā brahmaṇā sṛṣṭāḥ śreyorthaṃ tveva kevalam ।। 6 ।।
anyayonigatā duḥkhāḥ sukhinaḥ khalu mānave ।
dharmajñānaparā bhūtvā bhaktyā śreyaḥparāyaṇāḥ ।। 7 ।।
tapasā vratadānaiśca svargaṃ mokṣaṃ prayāntviti ।
aindriyikaṃ sukhaṃ tatra rāgiṇāṃ sukhalabdhaye ।। 8 ।।
pradattaṃ dhanadārādi sparśādi sārvakālikam ।
santuṣṭāśca sadā tṛptā ātmasmaraṇakārakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
nākṛṣyante'ti tadvege nirvartante yataḥ sukhāḥ ।
upabhogena tṛṣṇā syād balaṃ tasyāḥ prajāyate । । 1.363.10 ।।
nyāyamārgaṃ parityajya tayā pāpe pravartate ।
tṛṣṇayā svārthabuddhyā ca kāmakrodhādimiśrayā ।। 11 ।।
mṛgatṛṣṇārūpayā ca svāpnārthahāditulyayā ।
prāyo niṣphalayā bandhaphalayā''vriyate'vaśaḥ ।। 12 ।।
nānyasya ceṣṭitaṃ pāpaṃ satṛṣṇasyaiva ceṣṭitam ।
kartā kārayitā nānyaḥ svatṛṣṇāmantarā bhavet ।। 13 । ।
iṣṭā'lābhe bhaved dveṣṭā lābhe rāgī prajāyate ।
tṛṣṇayā tatra saṃkṛṣṭo'vivekyagre pravartate ।। 14। ।
karoti kāryaṃ cākāryaṃ tat sañcitaṃ prajāyate ।
ātmānaṃ pātayatyātmā bhuṃkte karma kṛtaṃ svayam ।। 15।।
āgataṃ bhajate pūrvaṃ sukṛtaṃ vā'tha duṣkṛtam ।
ātmā śatruśca bandhuśca svasya bhavati bhūsura! ।। 16 ।।
svasya bhogyaṃ parikleśaṃ nirmitaṃ pūrvakarmabhiḥ ।
jagatyāmupabhuṃkte vai jīvo yoniśataṃ gataḥ ।। 1 7। ।
antarātmā hṛdayastho jagatsarvaṃ prapaśyati ।
saṃkalpena tathā śaktyā jīvakarmānusārataḥ ।। 18 ।।
prakāśate yathākālaṃ śubhaṃ vā'pyathavā'śubham ।
jñānaṃ kriyāṃ hi jīvānāṃ tābhyāṃ kurvanti karma ca ।। 19 ।।
jñānakriye tu jīvasthe jīvāyatte hi pakṣiṇī ।
pakṣābhyāṃ viṣaye deśe dhāvatyagre hi tṛṣṇayā ।। 1.363.2 0 ।।
sādhukārī bhavatyeva sādhuḥ svargādipuṇyabhāk ।
asādhukārī bhavatyasādhurnirayapāpabhāk ।। 21 ।।
māyayā varṣmaṇopādānatvaṃ tu brahmaṇo bhavet ।
kālena tu mahāśaktyā sahakāritvamucyate । । 22 ।।
saṃkalpena harestatra nimittamātratā'sti vai ।

putrotpāde hyupādānatvaṃ jīvasya śarīriṇaḥ ।
ṛtukāle samāgṛhya sahakāritvamityapi ।। 24। ।
kāmanāyuktajīvasya nimittamātratāpi ca ।
evaṃ sarvatra jīvānāṃ hetutā phalabhāgitā ।। 25 ।।
tasmācchāstrādibhirjñātvā śreyaḥ karma samācaret ।
aśreyaḥ sarvathā jñānayatnābhyāṃ vai parityajet ।। 26 ।।
yathā yathā kṣayaṃ yāti hyaśubhaṃ tu janasya vai ।
tathā tathā śubhā buddhirvardhate ca pravartate ।। 27।।
kleśakṣayaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubhaṃ karma karoti ca ।
arjite vimale puṇye hyamareṣu mahīyate ।। 28 ।।
phalaprakāśanaprāptiścāntaryāmikṛtā'sti vai ।
svargaḥ śubhaphalaprāptirnirayaḥ pāpasaṃbhavaḥ 29।।।
nāciketaḥ śṛṇu tatra svakṛte śubhavartmani ।
manasā karmaṇā vācā tapasā caritena vā ।। 1.363.30।।
śubhamevā'valambena pāpebhyaḥ sa pramucyate ।

paropakārakartā ca paraduḥkhānnivartate ।
pareṣāṃ sukhado nityaṃ sa pāpebhyo vimucyate ।।।32।।
tattvārthaṃ vetti yaḥ samyag jaḍa cetanaṃ tadguṇān ।
mohaśūnyo'napekṣaśca padaṃ prāpnoti śāśvatam ।। 33 ।।
guṇā'guṇaparijñātā kṣayā'kṣayavivekavān ।
ātmadhyānaparo jñātā sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।। 34।।
svadehe paradehe ca svārthaparārthasadṛśaḥ ।
ahiṃsāvratavān vijñaḥ sa mucyetainasā dhruvam ।। 35।।
anudvegakaro yastu tṛṣṇākrodhādivarjitaḥ ।
nyāyamārgānusārī yaḥ sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।।36 ।।
prāṇāyāmaparo nityaṃ dhāraṇādhyānavāँśca yaḥ ।
vinirvṛttamanā yaśca sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।। 37।।
yasya kutrāpi nā''śā'sti lolupo neṣṭavastuṣu ।

śraddhāvān surapūjādau pitṛsevāparāyaṇaḥ ।
paradravyā'nabhilāṣī sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।। 39 ।।
guruśuśrūṣaṇaparo'nasūyo'matsaro'ghṛṇī ।
udāracarito'kṣudraśīlo mucyeta bandhanāt ।।1.363.40।।

utthāya pitaraṃ devaṃ mātaraṃ ca guruṃ dvijam ।
santaṃ sādhvīṃ namaskuryāt sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।।43 ।।
dātā nā''pnoti duḥkhaṃ vai prahartā sukhavānna vai ।

saralaṃ kṣaṇasādhyaṃ ca nā''yāso yatra vidyate ।

satya_ sādhvyo brahmacaryaśīlā bhāgavatāśca ye ।।47।।
teṣāṃ tu pādayordhāryaṃ śiro'rpyaṃ hṛdaye manaḥ ।
tadājñāyāṃ vartanīyaṃ bhāvyaṃ sevāpareṇa ca । ।48 ।।
santo yathā yathā yena kenāpi karmaṇā muhuḥ ।

somaṃ sūryaṃ ca gāyatrījapena smartureva ca ।

guru pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād dhyāyet taṃ samprapūjayet ।

prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ।

sampūrṇau vimalau samyag bhrājamānau prapaśyati ।

sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya sa pāpebhyaḥ pramucyate ।। 57।।

sarvapāpakṛtā doṣā dahyante drāṅ na saṃśayaḥ ।।58 ।।

gāṃ sūryaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ santaṃ satīṃ prātarnamaścaret ।

dvijaṃ śuśrūṣate śūdrastasya pāpaṃ praṇaśyati ।

dāṃbhikā bhinnamaryādā vedabrāhmaṇanindakāḥ ।

na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte harivāsare ।

tasyāmārādhya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ parameśvaram ।
prāpnoti sakalaṃ caitad dvādaśadvādaśīphalam ।।8 1 ।।
pūrvābhādrapadāyuktadvādaśyāṃ kṛtamakṣayam ।
uttarābhādrayuktāyāṃ tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam ।।82।।

janmāntarasahasreṣu samārādhya pareśvaram ।
vaiṣṇavatvaṃ labhedvipra! sarvapāpakṣaye sati ।।87।।
vaiṣṇavā hi mahābhāgāḥ punanti sakalaṃ jagat ।

visarjayāmāsa vibhuḥ suprītenā''ntarātmanā ।
