satyavānutthito drāgvai jīvito'bhūt suṣuptitaḥ ।। 103 ।।
ānandaḥ sarvathā tatra samabhūt। pattane gṛhe ।
sāvitrī satyavantaṃ ca vṛttāntaṃ tu yathākramam ।। 1 04।।
anyāँśca kathayāmāsa śrutvā''ścarya yayuśca te ।
sāvitrījanakaḥ putraśataṃ prāpa yathākramam ।। 1 056।।
śvaśuraścākṣuṣī rājyaṃ prāpadāridrathanāśakam ।
sā ca satyavataḥ putraśataṃ prāpa krameṇa ca ।। 106 ।।
evaṃ lakṣmi! pātivratyaprabhāveṇa satīvarā ।
mṛtyuparājayaṃ cakre pratyuta prāpa sampadam ।। 1 07।।
pātivratyaṃ pālitaṃ cet kāmadhenusamaṃ hi tat ।
kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ cāpi cintāmaṇyadhikaṃ tathā ।। 1 08।।
yogināṃ yogasampatteḥ pātivratyaṃ viśiṣyate ।
na caurahāryaṃ na kleśyaṃ na viyojanadharmakam ।। 1 09।।
sadātmani dṛḍhe dharme sthitaṃ nigūḍhameva tat ।
sā tu bhuktvā sukhaṃ lakṣavarṣaṃ bhūmau mahāsatī ।। 1.371.11 0।।
jagāma svāminā sārdhaṃ golokaṃ divyarūpiṇī ।
vaihāyasā vimānena yayau devaiḥ suvanditā ।। 111 ।।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa savituścādhidevikā ।
vedānāṃ cāpi sāvitrī mantrādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā ।। 1 12।।
saiva jātā'nantarūpā puruṣottamabhaktitaḥ ।
iti te kathita lakṣmi! sāvitryākhyānamuttamam ।। 11 3।।
yā cedaṃ śṛṇuyānnārī satītvaṃ tvāpnuyād dhruvam ।
pātivratyaṃ vinā tvanyaṃ dharmaṃ mukhyaṃ na vai caret ।। 1 14।।
sarvaṃ patipratimāyāṃ muktirbhaktiśca vidyate ।
sarvāśca siddhayaḥ patyurbhaktau tiṣṭhanti dāsikāḥ ।। 1 15।।
aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi dhanadhānyāmbarāṇi ca ।
svarṇaraupyamaṇiratnābharaṇāni ca sarvathā ।। 1 16।।
patyuḥ pādajale santi patyaṃguṣṭhe samṛddhayaḥ ।
patyānane mahadbrahma patyaṃgeṣu sukhāni vai ।। 1 17।।
patyustoṣe mahātoṣaṃ ānandaḥ patikhelane ।
patyurhaste mahālakṣmīḥ patyudare svaravyayam ।। 1 18।।
patyurnāḍyāṃ ca tīrthāni patiprāṇe hi mokṣaṇam ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca patyurdehe vyavasthitāḥ ।। 11 9।।
tasmāllakṣmi! parabrahma patireva satīkṛte ।
patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।। 1.371.1 20।।
patirviṣṇurvāsudevaḥ patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
sarve devāstathā vedā yajñā japāśca mālikāḥ ।। 121 ।।
dakṣiṇādānarītayo jñānāni vividhāni ca ।
yogāḥ paropakārāśca tathā'hiṃsādayaḥ śubhāḥ ।। 122।।
śubhakarmāṇi kāryāṇi pūjā vratāni sarvathā ।
snānāni coparāgāśca saṃkrāntayaśca sarvathā ।। 123 ।।
puṇyāhāni ca sarvāṇi tathotsavāḥ śubhāni ca ।
vaivāhikāni kāryāṇi daivāni cetarāṇyapi ।। 1 24।।
yātrāśca devayānāni santi lakṣmi! patiprabhau ।
patireva paraṃbrahma jñātvā bhajetpativratā ।।125।।
etasya paṭhanāccāpi śravaṇāt kīrtanācca vā ।
smaraṇānmānanāccāpi bhuktirmuktiḥ kare sthitā ।। 126 ।।
patyurdharmānnānyadharmaḥ satyāścātra viśiṣyate ।
satīdharmaḥ parodharmo hareḥ sevātmako hi saḥ ।। 127।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye ṣaḍaśītinarakakuṇḍaparimāṇāni, sāvitryai yamaproktaṃ jñānabhaktyādikaṃ, satyavato jīvanaṃ, patidharmaśraiṣṭhyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।371 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 371 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 372
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 373 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! ca padmāyāścaritraṃ pāpanāśakam ।
anaraṇyasya putryāstaddharmaśāpātmakaṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
pātivratyaṃ pālayantyā pitrājñāvartamānayā ।
padmayā yugabhedena dharmahrāsaḥ kṛtaḥ purā ।। 2 ।।
jātamātraṃ yauvanaṃ ca tayaiva viphalīkṛtam ।
bālyaṃ kumāratā paścād yauvanaṃ vṛddhatā tataḥ ।। 3 ।।
ityādikaṃ tayā loke kṛtaṃ lakṣmi! kramāgatam ।
manuvaṃśodbhavo rājā so'naraṇyo mahāyaśāḥ ।। 4 ।।
ciraṃjīvī dharmaśīlo vaiṣṇavo vijitendriyaḥ ।
maṃgalā'raṇyaputraḥ sa indrasāvarṇivaṃśajaḥ ।। 5 ।।
dharāraṇyasya putro'bhūnmaṃgalāraṇya eva ha ।
aputrako dharāraṇyastapase puṣkaraṃ gataḥ ।। 6 ।।
suciraṃ ca tapastaptvā varaṃ labdhvā pareśvarāt ।
samprāpto vaiṣṇavaṃ putramanaraṇyaṃ jitendriyam ।। 7 ।।
datvā tasmai sa rājyaṃ svaṃ jagāma tapase vanam ।
anaraṇyastataścakre bhṛguṇā tu purodhasā ।। 8 ।।
yajñānāṃ śatakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tasthau vairāgyavṛttikaḥ ।
tucchaṃ matvā ca śakratvaṃ na lebhe naśvaraṃ padam ।। 9 ।।
babhūvuḥ śataputrāśca sarve pitṛsamā guṇe ।
kanyaikā sundarī ramyā padmā padmālayāsamā ।। 1.372.1 0।।
tasyā yogyavarā'nveṣaṇārthaṃ yatnaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
tāvat tapovane pippalādarṣistatra nirjane ।। 11 ।।
strībhiḥ ramantaṃ gandharvaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai kāmuko'bhavat ।
athā'yaṃ puṣpabhadrāyāṃ snātuṃ gacchanmunīśvaraḥ ।। 12।।
dadarśa padmāṃ yuvatīṃ padmāvatārarūpiṇīm ।
manoramāṃ vilokyaiva dārasaṃgrahabhāvanaḥ ।। 1 3।।
keyaṃ kasyeti papraccha samīpasthāँstapasvinaḥ ।
te ca nivedanaṃ cakruḥ padmā'naraṇyajā tviti ।। 14।।
muniḥ snātvā'bhīṣṭadevaṃ sampūjya puruṣottamam ।
jagāma kāmī bhikṣārthamanaraṇyasabhā'jire ।। 15।।
rājā dṛṣṭvā muniṃ śīghraṃ praṇanāmā'tibhaktitaḥ ।
madhuparkādikaṃ datvā pūjayāmāsa sādaram ।। 16।।
munirvijñāpito rājñā yatheṣṭaṃ varaṇāya vai ।
pippalādastadā padmāṃ yayāce kanyakāṃ śubhām ।। 17।।
śrutvā maunī nṛpo jātaḥ kiñcinnirvaktumakṣamaḥ ।
muniḥ prāha tadā taṃ vai dehi kanyāṃ nṛpottama! ।। 18।।
athavā bhasmasāt sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi kṣaṇena vai ।
sarve babhūvurācchannā bhṛtyāśca munitejasā ।। 1 9।।
śuśoca rājā rājñī ca dṛṣṭvā vṛddhaṃ jvarānvitam ।
mahiṣyaḥ śuśucuḥ sarvā itikartavyatā'kṣamāḥ ।।1.372.20 ।।
kanyāmātā vilalāpa kanyāduḥkhaṃ vicintya vai ।
tadvilokya pippalādo bodhayāmāsa bhūmipam ।।2 1 ।।
mahiṣīṃ nṛpaputrāँśca bhṛtyāँśca kanyakāṃ tathā ।
adya vā'nyadivase vā dātavyā kanyakā bhavet ।।22।।
yasmai kasmai pradātavyā dehi viprāya me nṛpa! ।
satpātraṃ brāhmaṇādanyanna paśyāmi jagattraye ।।23।।
parāya viprādanyasmai naiva tvaṃ dātumarhasi ।
sutāṃ datvā ca me rājan rakṣasva sarvasampadaḥ ।।24।।
kanyānimittaṃ sarvasvaṃ mā te bhasmagataṃ bhavet ।
ityetadvākyamatyugraṃ śrutvā kanyāpi śobhanā ।।।25।।।
piturhitaṃ cintayānā gauravaṃ tapasāmṛṣeḥ ।
sarvasampadavighnatvaṃ prāha rājñe pradehi mām ।।26।।
tataḥ sālaṃkṛtāṃ padmāṃ rājā rājñī dadau mudā ।
kāntāṃ prāpya pippalādo muditastapasā jvalan ।।27।।
darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ yauvanaṃ yogakṛdbalāt ।
aṣṭādaśasamāyogyaṃ kanyāyogyaṃ hi kāmadam ।।28।।
rājādayo'tisaṃhṛṣṭāḥ kanyā tutoṣa cāntare ।
yautakaṃ ca tathā kāntāṃ gṛhītvā munirāḍ yayau ।।29।।
anaraṇyaḥ pūrṇamanā jagāma tapase tataḥ ।
mano mokṣe dadhau tatra cintayan rādhikeśvaram ।।1.372.3 0 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāpya golokaṃ saṃjagāma ha ।
kīrtyaraṇyo jyeṣṭhaputro rājyaṃ tasya cakāra vai ।।3 1 ।।
athā'naraṇyasya kanyā siṣeve bhaktitaḥ ṛṣim ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ yathā ।।32।।
pātivratyaparā nityaṃ sevate śrīhariṃ yathā ।
aṃgasaṃmardanaṃ muneḥ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ muhuḥ ।।3 3 ।।
kāmecchāpūraṇaṃ śaśvaccakre'nuvṛttimāśritā ।
snātvā snāpayati bhuṃkte bhojayitvā dvijaṃ patim ।। 34
svāpayitvā svapityeva cānutiṣṭhati karmasu ।
yathā vai tāpaso vṛddho rājaso'tha yuvā muniḥ ।।।35
prasannaḥ syāttathā sevāṃ karotyaharniśaṃ satī ।
manyamānā svakaṃ bhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhatamaṃ sadā ।।।36
yadahaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prāptāstatrāpi munitāpasam ।
pavitraṃ puṇyarūpaṃ ca nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇam ।।।3 7
yoginaṃ cātmavettāraṃ kā'nyā dhanyā mayā samā ।
pavitrā'haṃ sadā jātā hyarthitā ṛṣiṇā svayam ।। 38
mama bhāgyasya pāraṃ na puṇyapāraṃ na vidyate ।
anekajanmapuṇyaiśca prāpyate bhagavānpatiḥ ।।।39
so'yaṃ sākṣāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo labdhaḥ patirmayā ।
tasyaiva sevayā muktistasya toṣe'kṣaraṃ padam ।।1.372.40
tasyaiva hṛdaye brahma brahma labdhaṃ mayā tataḥ ।
nā'tra me mokṣaṇe tvanyatsādhanaṃ pariśiṣyate ।।।41 ।
mama pitrā śubhaṃ dattā svastyastu janakasya me ।
svastyastu mama mānuśca yā'haṃ jātā sukhā'nvitā ।।42।
sarvaṃ labdhaṃ mayā tvatra pippalāde ṛṣīśvare ।
jñānatṛptī ratitṛptirbhogatṛptiśca labhyate ।।।43 ।
yaśastṛptiḥ khyātitṛptiḥ pūjātṛptiśca labhyate ।
rājyabhāro duḥkhado'ti mahiṣītvaṃ tato'dhikam ।।44।
mahiṣīṇāṃ na vai śāntiḥ pañjarapakṣiṇāṃ yathā ।
dharmo'rthaḥ kāmanā'traiva bhujyate sukhato mayā ।।45 ।
na tathā taptacittābhirmahiṣībhiḥ prabhujyate ।
śubhaṃ jātaṃ tu yajjātaṃ sarvaṃ daivaṃ mayā'rjitam ।।46 ।
madyamāṃsādanṛpatikare na patitā'smyaham ।
tadeva puṇyaṃ me cātra prahṛṣṭaṃ rakṣakaṃ mama ।।47।।
kumārikā na jānanti rājasyo rājapīḍanam ।
paścāt patitvā śocanti vayaṃ kva niraye gatāḥ ।।48।।
sādhuśīlo devaguṇaḥ patiḥ sarvatra durlabhaḥ ।
bhogako mārakaḥ śveva patiḥ sarvatra cāpyate ।।49 ।।
bhogairdehaṃ kṣapayati puṇyaṃ nāśayati tvaghaiḥ ।
yamalokaṃ prāpayati sulabhastādṛśaḥ patiḥ ।।1.372.5 0 ।।
svārthamātraparo yaśca paralokā'sahāyakṛt ।
na patiḥ sa yathārtho'sti yadyogānnarakaṃ dhruvam ।।5 1 ।।
tasmādatra paratraiva cā'rdhāṃgamiva rakṣati ।
sṛṣṭau mokṣe sukhe duḥkhe sahagāmī patiḥ patiḥ ।।52।।
etādṛśaṃ patiṃ prāpya yā na prasevate tu tam ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā sā bhaved vañcitā sadā ।।53।।
kulasya guṇajālasya rūpasya buddhidharmayoḥ ।
mānaṃ na sarvathā rakṣyaṃ patyagre kulayoṣitā ।।54।।
dehaṃ patirmanaḥ svāmī tvabhimānaṃ patirmama ।
kāryakāraṇasaṃghātaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ patirmama ।।।55।।
bhojyaṃ bhogobhoktṛvṛttirbhogyaṃ sarvaṃ patirmama ।
viśvāso varadānaṃ ca nyāsaścāpi patirmama ।।56।।
dīnatā śreṣṭhitā sthairyaṃ cānukūlyaṃ patirmama ।
vrataṃ dharmastathā puṇyaṃ tīrthaṃ dānaṃ patirmama ।।57।।
svādhyāyapāṭhapūjāśca sandhyādharmaḥ patirmama ।
utsavaśca samājaśca pradarśanaṃ patirmama ।।58।।
yānaṃ ca nāṭakaṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyaṃ gānaṃ patirmama ।
bhavanaṃ rājyasamṛddhirgajavājaṃ patirmama ।।59।।
gururbrahmā haro viṣṇuḥ sarve devāḥ patirmama ।
vaiśvadevo'titheḥ pūjā prāghūrṇikaḥ patirmama ।।1.372.6 0 ।।
garbhaḥ putro ratiḥ prītirnaiḥśreyasaṃ patirmama ।
dhāma kṣetraṃ dharā rājyaṃ yatsarvasvaṃ patirmama ।।6 1 ।।
niṣedhaśca vidhiścāpi svairiṇītvaṃ patirmama ।
iti tṛptiṃ parāṃ matvā sevāṃ karomi vai ṛṣeḥ ।।62।।
evaṃ nityānandatṛptā lakṣmi! sā rājakanyakā ।
siṣeve tamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ sākṣānnārāyaṇaṃ yathā ।।6 3 ।।
tasyā dharmaparīkṣārthaṃ dharmadevo hyacintayat ।।
kīdṛśīyaṃ pātivratyaparā vartata eva nu? ।।64।।
ekadā svarṇadīṃ snātuṃ prayātāṃ sasmitāṃ satīm ।
dadarśa pathi dharmastu māyayā nṛpaliṃgakaḥ ।।65।।
svarṇaratnarathārūḍhaḥ svarṇaratnādibhūṣitaḥ ।
navayauvanarūpāḍhyaḥ kāmadeva ivā'paraḥ ।।66।।
surūpāṃ sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā padmāmuvāca māyayā ।
aho surūpā kānteyaṃ kva ca kva jarjaro muniḥ ।।67।।
ayi! sundari! lakṣmīva rājayogye'ti sūjjvale! ।
prakṛṣṭayauvanasthe! ca kāmagarvahare! śubhe! ।।68।।
jarādagdhasya vṛddhasya samīpe kiṃ virājase? ।
kāṣṭhapāṣāṇatulyasyā'sthimātraśeṣitasya ca ।।69।।
rājayogyā'si rājendri! rājase rājavakṣasi ।
candanāguruliptāṃgā svarṇaratnādibhūṣitā ।।1.372.70।।
dāsadāsīśatairyuktā sukhinī bhava sundari! ।
vipraṃ tapaḥkṛśaṃ śuṣkaṃ brahmonmukhaṃ kṣiṇāyuṣam ।।71 ।।
vihāya paśya rājendraṃ ratau śūraṃ bhuvāṃ patim ।
svargasukhasmṛddhaṃ samāvasthaṃ ca mādṛśam ।।72।।
kiṃ parṇakuṭyāṃ sukhamasti kiṃcit,
kiṃ kaṃdhare pakṣijaṭe'sti saukhyam ।
kiṃ cā'sthibhastrāmavalambase tvam,
āyāhi cintāmaṇiracyute'tra ।।73।।
prāpnuhi cinmaṇimacyute mayi,
tvaṃ kalpavallī bhavasīti saṃvṛṇe ।
ratnaṃ pinaddhaṃ kanake praśobhate,
na śaṃkhayogye khalu pāśave gale ।।74।।
prāpnoti sundaraṃ puṇyāt saundaryaṃ pūrvajanmataḥ ।
saphalaṃ tadbhavet sarvaṃ rasikā''liṃganena tu ।।75।।
yathā kāntā tathā kāntaṃ kāmakāryaviśāradam ।
kiṃkaraṃ kuru māṃ kānte! sarvaṃ dāsyāmi te'naghe ।।76।।
sajalo nirjane ramye vane'raṇye ca parvate ।
nadyāṃ nade samudyāne puṣpite gandhaśālini ।।77।।
yāne vimāne sāmrājye malaye raivate girau ।
anye candanavṛkṣāḍhye vihariṣyāmi vai tvayā ।।78।।
kāmajvarapradagdhāyāḥ śāntiṃ kartumahaṃ kṣamaḥ ।
viharasva mayā sārdhaṃ janmedaṃ saphalaṃ kuru ।।79।।
ityuktavantaṃ rājānaṃ kare gṛhītumutsukam ।
nikaṭaṃ tu samāyāntaṃ dharmaṃ prāha pativratā ।।1.372.80।।
dūraṃ gaccha gaccha dūraṃ pāpacintāparo hyasi ।
māṃ cet spṛśasi kāmena sadyo bhasma bhaviṣyasi ।।8 1 ।।
ahaṃ vivāhitā nārī pippalādarṣibhāminī ।
pativratā na paśyāmi hṛdā'pi vai narāntaram ।।82।।।
kathaṃ spṛśāmi pāpāṃśaṃ strījitaṃ lampaṭaṃ nṛpam ।
adharmisparśamātreṇa sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ vinaśyati ।।83।।
paranārīṃ prasahyātra dharṣituṃ tvaṃ samudyataḥ ।
na bhūmau pātakī tvādṛganyo bhavati bhūpatiḥ ।।84।।
ahaṃ brāhmaṇapatnyasmi tatra vṛddhatapasvinaḥ ।
tāṃ mātaraṃ strībhāvaṃ kṛtvā yena bravīṣi mām ।।85।।
bhaviṣyati kṣayaste'tra dharṣiturmama śāpataḥ ।
kṣayaṃ yāhi dhruvaṃ rājan hṛdā pāpena karmaṇā ।।86।।
śrutvā dharmaḥ satīśāpaṃ nṛparūpaṃ vihāya tu ।
dharmadevaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā'dṛśyata prāha tāṃ ca saḥ ।।87।।
mātarjānīhi māṃ dharmaṃ dharmajñānāṃ gurorgurum ।
parastrīmātṛbuddhiṃ ca kurvantaṃ lokarakṣakam ।।88।।
ahaṃ tavā'ntarvijñātuṃ samāgato'smi padmike! ।
parīkṣituṃ rājarūpaṃ dhṛtavānasmi dhārmike! ।।89।।
tathāpi svakṛtaṃ kiñcidakarmaṃ bhuṃjate janāḥ ।
mayā kṛtaṃ cā'vamānaṃ tava vākyaistu niṣṭhuraiḥ ।।1.372.90।।
tatphalaṃ saṃprabhoktavyaṃ mayā nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ।
kṛtaṃ me damanaṃ tvatra na viruddhaṃ yathocitam ।।91 ।।
sarvathā me mṛtirmāstu sati! tatprārthaye sadā ।
śāstiḥ samutpathasyānāmīśvareṇa vinirmitā ।।92।।
śāsanaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ cāstu yathāsahyaṃ tu me sati! ।
padmovāca tadā dharma sākṣī tvameva dehinām ।।93 ।।
kathaṃ parīkṣituṃ tvetadrājarūpa dhṛtaṃ tvayā ।
yannimittaṃ mayā śaptaścāparādho'bhavannu me ।।94।।
sādhvīśāpo na vai mithyā jāyate tu kadācana ।
tava nāśe sṛṣṭināśo bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।95 ।।
tasmād yathā jīvanaṃ te śāpaśca sārthako bhavet ।
tathā vadāmi dharmendra! śṛṇu mānavabhedataḥ ।।96 ।।
satye jane catuṣpādo bhava tvaṃ dharma! sarvathā ।
tretāvyāptajane tvaṃ tripād bhava vṛṣa sarvathā ।।97।।
dvāparavyāptamanuje dvipādo dharma! saṃbhava ।
kalivyāptajane tvekapādaḥ śeṣe'stu te layaḥ ।।98।।
paśuprāye jaḍe dharma! tvamācchanno bhaviṣyasi ।
sāttvike pūrṇatā te'stu rājasādāvapūrṇatā ।।9 9 ।।
yadyat sthalaṃ tavādhāraṃ śrūyatāṃ vṛṣa! vacmi tat ।
haribhakteṣu sarveṣu vaiṣṇaveṣu viśeṣataḥ ।। 1.372.10 0।।
sādhvīṣu sādhuṣu yatimuniṣu brahmacāriṣu ।
pativratāsu prājñeṣu vānaprastheṣu bhikṣuṣu ।। 101 ।।
dharmaśīleṣu sarveṣu vaiśyakṣatriyajātiṣu ।
dvijaseviṣu śūdreṣu satāṃ saṃge sthiteṣu ca ।। 1 02।।
aśvaḥvaṭabilveṣu tulasīcandaneṣu ca ।
dīkṣāparīkṣāśapathagoṣṭhagopadabhūmiṣu ।। 103 ।।
vivāheṣu ca sarvatra puṣpeṣu vṛkṣajātiṣu ।
devālayeṣu tīrtheṣu satāṃ geheṣu sarvadā ।।1 04।।
vedā''mnāyavicāreṣu kṛṣṇakīrtanakāriṣu ।
vratapūjātathonyāyayajñasākṣisthaleṣu ca ।। 105 ।।
goprāṇiṣvatha haṃseṣu garuḍeṣu satīṣu ca ।
kṛśatā tena bhavitā satyasthaleṣu sarvathā ।। 106 ।।
kṛśatā tu tadanyeṣu sthaleṣu bhavitā śṛṇu ।
puṃścalīṣu tu sarvāsu naraghātigṛheṣu ca ।। 1 07।।
nīcamūrkhakhalanindāpareṣu ca śaṭheṣu ca ।
devatāguruvipreṣṭapālyānāṃ dhanahāriṣu ।। 1 08।
dhūrteṣvasatsu duṣṭeṣu caureṣu vyavāyiṣu ।
durodarasurāmāṃsakalahā'tikrameṣu ca ।। 1 09।।
śālagrāmasādhutīrthakṣetrasevāpraghātiṣu ।
dasyukarmaṇi garviṣṭe maṣījīvyasijīviṣu ।।1.372.110 ।।
bhartṛninditanārīṣu jīvahiṃsopajīviṣu ।
dīkṣāsandhyādharmabhaktihīneṣu ca kalaṃkiṣu ।। 111 ।।
kanyāyoṣitsuragranthavidyāvikrayiṣu nṛṣu ।
mitradrohikṛtaghneṣu satyaviśvāsaghātiṣu ।। 112।
śaraṇāgatadīnā'ndhāśritaghneṣu mṛṣoktiṣu ।
śaśvanmithyoktiśīleṣu tathā sīmāpahāriṣu ।। 113 ।।
mithyāsākṣiṣu ca mithyānyāyadeṣu ca rājasu ।
puṇyarodhiṣu sarveṣu na sthātuṃ śakyate tvayā ।। 1 14।।
śuddhasāttvikaśānteṣu catuṣpāt tvaṃ sadā vasa ।
sattvamiśrarajovṛddhau tripāt tvaṃ tritako vasa ।। 1 15 ।।
rajomiśratamovṛddhau dvipāt tvaṃ dvāparo vasa ।
tamomātrahṛdayeṣu tvekapāt tvaṃ kalirvasa ।। 116 ।।
satyaṃṃ makhastapo dānaṃ catuṣpādāḥ purā tava ।
ahiṃsādamanā''stikyadānānyadya padāni te ।। 11 7।।
bhāvikāle bhaviṣyanti śīlaṃ śaucaṃ ca sevanam ।
kīrtanaṃ ceti pādāste kramāt hrāse tathā vasa ।। 118 ।।
ityuktvā virarāmaināṃ dharma āśiṣa ādadau ।
dhanyāsi patibhaktāsi svasti te'stu hi santatam ।। 119।।
yuvā bhavatu bhartā te rūpavān sthirayauvanaḥ ।
cirajīvī bhavatveva mārkaṇḍeyādato'dhikam ।। 1.372.120 ।।
dhanaiśvaryavatī tvaṃ ca saṃbhava sthirayauvanā ।
mātā tvaṃ daśaputrāṇāṃ bhava saṃcirajīvinām ।। 121 ।।
śrutvā padmā vṛṣaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇamya ca ।
yayau svaṃ mandiraṃ sādhvī dharmo'pi svasthalaṃ yayau ।। 1 22।।
prativratāṃ praśaśaṃsa pratisaṃsadi saṃsadi ।
pativratāpi sā padmā pātivratyabalāt khalu ।। 123 ।।
śataputravatī jātā sarvasaubhāgyasaṃbhṛtā ।
evaṃ pativratā nārī dharmaṃ hantuṃ ca rakṣitum ।। 1 24।।
svayameva samarthā'sti ko'nyastāṃ dharṣayejjanaḥ ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! padmāyā vai kathānakam ।। 1 25।।
dharmapuṣṭikaraṃ śaśvatpātivratyabalapradam ।
svargamokṣapradaṃ cāpi sarvadharmapradaṃ tathā ।। 126 ।।
patisevāpradaṃ caitatsaṃsāraśamanaṃ param ।
bhaktyā śṛṇuyānnārī pātivratye dṛḍhā bhavet ।। 1 27।।
śroturvaktustathā rakṣāṃ dhruvaṃ dharmo vidhāsyati ।
pātivratyaṃ prapattiśca samāno dvau vṛṣau sadā ।। 1 28।।
ekenaivā''pnuyātsarvaṃ dvitīyā'pekṣaṇaṃ nahi ।
yatrobhau tatra vai lakṣmi! kimu vaktavyamātmanā ।। 1 29।।
pātivratyaṃ dāsadharmaḥ prapattiḥ snehadharmiṇī ।
dāsyaṃ snaihyaṃ paraṃ labdhvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।। 1.372.13 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye'naraṇyaputryāḥ pativratāyāḥ padmāyāḥ pippalādena lagnaṃ, dharmakṛtaparīkṣāyāṃ dharmasya śāpaścatuṣpādānāṃ kālakrameṇa hrāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 372 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 372 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 373
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 374 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ te'pi pātivratyaparāyaṇām ।
vaikuṇṭhe samabhūd yā vai garvanāśāya sarvathā ।। 1 ।।
vaikuṇṭhā'dhipatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ svayam ।
rājate sma sabhāmadhye naikapārṣadaveṣṭitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
dāsadāsīvaiṣṇavaiśca sevitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।
akṣarādhipatervakṣaḥ sthalotpannā mahāsatī ।। 3 ।।
sampatkartrī mahecchā śrīhareḥ saṃkalparūpiṇī ।
lakṣmīḥ svāṃ muktarūpebhyo vilokyā'ntarvilakṣaṇām ।। 4 ।।
prārthayāmāsa sarveśaṃ lajjayā śrīhariṃ tadā ।
mama vāsasya yogyaṃ vai bhavanaṃ racaya prabho! ।। ।5 ।।
yathāhaṃ pātivratyena siṣeve tvāṃ pareśvaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt parātmā parameśvaraḥ ।। 6 ।।
śrutvā yogyāṃ prārthanāṃ ca jñātvā nārīṃ svasevikām ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ racayāmāsa yugalārthaṃ navaṃ śubham ।। 7 ।।
svayaṃ caturbhujo jāto mahālakṣmyabhilāṣayā ।
patirūpaḥ parabrahma śaṃkhacakragadādimān ।। 8 ।।
aṣṭādaśavayovarṣaḥ kamanīyo'tikāntimān ।
sarvāṃgavīryasampūrṇo lakṣmīḥ ṣoḍaśavatsarā ।। 9 ।।
kamanīyā patisevāyogyā muktā'tisundarī ।
sustanī svānanā ramyā sumadhyā svarṇavarṇikā ।। 1.373.10 ।।
sarvāṃgaśobhāsampūrṇā sarvasiddhisamāśritā ।
sarvaiśvaryamahānandā saṃkalparūpadhāriṇī ।। 11 ।।
kāminī ratikuśalā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ।
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā divyavastrādibhūṣitā ।। 1 2।।
sarvaśṛṃgārasaddravyacūrṇakajjalamaṇḍitā ।
anaṃgaścā'bhavattasyāṃ dehā'bhinna iva sthitaḥ ।। 13 ।।
tasyāḥ saṃkalpapūrttyarthaṃ nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ।
caturbhujāṃ svakāṃ patnīṃ lakṣmīṃ nītvā yayau hariḥ ।। 14।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ svakṛtaṃ dhāma yatra nā'nyad dvayaṃ vinā ।
tṛtīyaṃ vyaktirūpaṃ na yugalaṃ tatra modate ।। 15।।
saṃkalpasiddhayastatra prodgatā vai sahasraśaḥ ।
dāsikāstā mahālakṣmyāḥ sarvāḥ pañcadaśābdikāḥ ।। 16।।
tāsāṃ kṛte kṛtāstatra saudhāścandrasamāḥ sukhāḥ ।
svakṛte bhavanaṃ divyaṃ mandiraṃ ca kṛtaṃ navam ।। 17।।
prākāro'tiviśālaśca pattanaṃ dīrghavistaram ।
jalapuṣkariṇīvṛndaṃ cakāra tatra śrīhariḥ ।। 18।।
nadān nadīstaḍāgāni vāṭikodyānabhūmikāḥ ।
vihārāṇi vicitrāṇi rasaśālāśca dīrghikāḥ ।। 1 9।।
bhojyaśālāstathā prasannatāśālā ratisthalīḥ ।
sabhāsthale mahaddivyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ parātparam ।।1.373.20 ।।
upakaraṇavastvāḍhyabhavanānāṃ tu paṃktikāḥ ।
vinirmāya svayaṃ tatra modate yugalaṃ sadā ।।21 ।।
nārāyaṇo yadā lakṣmyā sākaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate gṛhe ।
premamagnastadā dāsyaḥ samāgacchanti bhāvataḥ ।। 22।।
bhagavatpremasampannā rajoratisamāhutāḥ ।
vilāsārthaṃ samāgatyā''śliṣyanti parameśvaram ।।23 ।।
haristu bahurūpāṇi dhṛtvā ramate tāsvapi ।
mahālakṣmīścāpi tatra ramate bhavane svake ।।24।।
sahasrāyutasaṃkhyāsu samakāle hariḥ svayam ।
ramate bahubhāvena koṭirūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ ।।25।।
evaṃ vaikuṇṭhabhavane vaikuṇṭhe pūrṇadhāmani ।
nārāyaṇaṃ vinā nānyo naraḥ kaścitpravartate ।।26 ।।
koṭikoṭyastu dāsyaśca vartante sevikāḥ sadā ।
tatraikadā hi sarvāsu sarvarūpadharo hariḥ ।।27।।
cakre vai ramaṇaṃ dāsīkoṭitṛptikaraṃ prabhuḥ ।
mahālakṣmīḥ svabhavane nārāyaṇe pravalgitā ।।28।।
mahā''nande'timagnā''sīt tallīneva tadā'bhavat ।
tatraivā'vasare nityā muktāḥ sanatkumārakāḥ ।।29।।
jñātvā yogabalenāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtam ।
nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ ca lakṣmīsvarūpamityapi ।।1.373.3 0 ।।
dāsīkoṭisvarūpāṇi bhavanāni navāni ca ।
sākṣād draṣṭuṃ kṛtahṛdo muktā bālasvarūpiṇaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
ratibhāve'kṛtayogā ajānanta iva striyam ।
strīyogaṃ cā'pyajānanto vighnaṃ jānanti caiva na ।।32।।
darśanārthaṃ kṛtayatnā vyomamārgādavātaran ।
prākārāntaḥsthalīṃ gatvā saṃviviśū ratigṛham ।।33।।
nārāyaṇaṃ samāśliṣṭāṃ lakṣmīṃ vilokya te tadā ।
gatvā pārśve dvayordehau vāhayāmāsurādarāt ।। 34।।
pādasaṃmardanaṃ cakruḥ sevayāmāsurīśvarau ।
aśaṃkamānasāḥ sarve paṃcavarṣāḥ kumārakāḥ ।।35।।
lakṣmīrānandamāsādya sevayitvā narāyaṇam ।
śuddhā bhūtvā tu tānbālān bhojanādi dadau satī ।।36।।
bhojitāḥ pūjitā dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭā natāśca saṃyayuḥ ।
tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ mahālakṣmīḥ prāha nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।37।।
bhagavan sarvadā naivamucitaṃ darśanaṃ tava ।
bālāstu doṣarahitāstathā bhānavivarjitāḥ ।।38।।
kintu cānye mahātmānaḥ ṛṣayaśca surādayaḥ ।
ita ārabhya bālebhyo vijñāya darśanotsukāḥ ।।39।।
āyāsyanti sadā te'tra darśanārthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।
akāladarśane nau vai vighnaṃ tu satataṃ bhavet ।।1.373.40।।
dāsyastatra niyoktavyā gopurādau tu pālikāḥ ।
yadvā yatheṣṭaṃ bhagavan yathecchasi tathā kuru ।।41 ।।
śrutvā nārāyaṇo yogyaṃ yuyoja dvārapālikāḥ ।
niyuktā api tāḥ kvāpi kvacit premātirekataḥ ।।।42।।
tyaktvā dvāraṃ hariṃ yānti dvāraṃ śūnyaṃ bhavatyapi ।
ṛṣayo munayo jñātvā samāyānti tu bhāvukāḥ ।।।43।।
vaikuṇṭhasya vilokārthaṃ darśanārthaṃ harestathā ।
tadā lakṣmyā punaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ samarthitaḥ ।।44।।
bhagavan dvārapālatvaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhaktāya dīyatām ।
sakhyastu tāḥ snehamagnā dvāre tiṣṭhanti naiva yat ।।।45।।।
ye tu syurdvārapālatve kṛtayatnā bhavantu te ।
iti śrutvā haristatra sasmāraiśvaryasadguṇān ।। 46।।
aiśvaryāṇi guṇāścāpi pārṣadā rūpasundarāḥ ।.
narākārāścatuḥkarāḥ bhūtvā'ntikamupāyayuḥ ।।47।।
stutvā nārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ natvā prāhuśca deśanam ।
darśayā'tra mahārāja! kartuṃ jātāḥ sma te dhiyā ।।48।
tatra jayaṃ vijayākhyamaiśvaryaṃ prāha keśavaḥ ।
dvārapālatvamevā'tra kartavyaṃ mama deśanam ।।49।
evaṃ nandasunandau ca puṣpadantaṃ ca sāttvatam ।
kumudaṃ kumudākṣaṃ ca niyuyuje'pi gopure ।।1.373.50।।
aṣṭaiśvaryātmakapārṣadāste rakṣanti gopurān ।
lakṣmīdāsīkoṭiyuktā niḥśaṃkā sevate patim ।।51 । ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa yathā chāyā svadehinam ।
nānyaṃ naraṃ vijānāti nārāyaṇātparaṃ samam ।।52। ।
nānyaṃ paśyati puṃvargaṃ dvārapālamapi kvacit ।
nānyaiḥ sā bhāṣate lakṣmīrnānyaṃ spṛśati vai kvacit ।।53 । ।
nānyāṃ ratiṃ prajānāti harervaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ ।
nānyasattāṃ vijānāti caturbhujanarāyaṇāt ।।।54।।
nānyaguṇān kathayati nārāyaṇaguṇān ṛte ।
nānyaṃ dhyāyati smarati manute niścinoti na ।।।55।।
nārāyaṇaḥ parabrahma nārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
nārāyaṇaḥ sarvadraṣṭā nānyastasmātparaḥ prabhuḥ ।।56 । ।
iti sarvātmanā tatra līnā bhavati vidyate ।
pativākyakarī svāmisukhadā pativartinī ।।57। ।
svāpe ca ramaṇe snāne śayane bhojane'rhaṇe ।
viharaṇaṃ prakāryaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ patiparāyaṇā ।।58 ।।
sevate śrīhariṃ tatra śayyāyāṃ vai narāyaṇī ।
tāvattatra punaryātā darśanāya kumārakāḥ ।।59।।
sanakādyā brahmaputrā nityasiddhā hi bālakāḥ ।
evameva hareste ca darśanārthaṃ samāgatāḥ ।।1.373.6 0 ।।
prākāraṃ cātha ca dvārāṇyapahāya mahā'mbarāt ।
avatarurbrahmarūpā yayurnārāyaṇāntikam ।।61 ।।
pūrvavat sevanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca darśanaṃ muhuḥ ।
prasannāḥ pañcavarṣīyā yayuste tṛptamānasāḥ ।।62।।
iti jāte prasaṃge ca mahālakṣmyā tu vai tataḥ ।
ājñaptā dvārapālādyā nirodhāya gatikṛtām ।।63 ।।
āgaccheyurvinā''jñāṃ na praviśeyurna vai ca te ।
ye ke'pi syustathā dvārapālatvaṃ kāryameva hi ।।64।।
ityājñaptā mahālakṣmyā sarvadikṣu prapālinaḥ ।
vinā''jñāṃ tu mahālakṣmyāstathā harerapi kvacit ।।65।।
praveśaṃ na dadatyeva yadyapi syurharādayaḥ ।
evaṃ sevāparā nityaṃ lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prasevate ।।66।।
aśaṃkā cātisammugdhā dāsīkoṭibhirarcitā ।
pātivratyaparā nityaṃ sevate śrīnarāyaṇam ।।67।।
yoganidrottaraṃ yoganidrāṃ gṛhṇāti padmajā ।
svapane śayane nityaṃ karoti tvaṃgamardanam ।।68।।
yoganidrāṃ hareḥ pūrvaṃ vihāyaiva jalāmṛtam ।
dadātyānanaśuddhyarthaṃ dantaśuddhyarthacūrṇakam ।।69।।
snānādyarthaṃ jalaṃ coṣṇaṃ sugandhicandanānvitam ।
vastraṃ cābhūṣaṇādyaṃ ca kusumādi dadāti ca ।।1.373.70।।
śṛṃgārarasapuṣṭyarthaṃ karotyābhūṣitaṃ harim ।
bhojyaṃ miṣṭaṃ dugdhapānaṃ kārayatyeva sarvadā ।।71 ।।
śītaleṣṭajalapānaṃ phalaṃ mukhapraśodhanam ।
tāmbūlādyaṃ dadātyevā'mbarakṣālanamityapi ।।।72।।
kṛṣṇabhojyādipātrāṇāṃ mañjanaṃ svakareṇa vai ।
āsanādipradānaṃ ca keśaveśādisādhanam ।।73।।
kastūrīkajjalakuṃkumākṣatādisamarpaṇam ।
vyajanenā'niladānaṃ śayyāstaraṇamityapi ।।74।।
evaṃ tadaṃgakāryāṇi karotyeṣā pativratā ।
vrataṃ pūjā japo homaḥ paṭhanaṃ stotramityapi ।।75।।
kṛṣṇājñayaitatsarvaṃ vai karotyeṣā pativratā ।
nārāyaṇasya sevāyāṃ nārāyaṇī pravartate ।।76।।
athaikadā mahālakṣmīrdāsīsahasravāritā ।
yayāvudyānake ramye manorañjanakāmyayā ।।77।।
tatra vibhinnaśākhāḍhyavṛkṣarājivirājite ।
śādvale puṣpagandhāḍhye mṛdule subhage sthale ।।78।।
saṃreme sakhābhiḥ sārdhaṃ praśaśaṃsa svakaṃ sukham ।
bahumānyaṃ praśaśaṃsa garvamavāpa sundarī ।।79।।
sakhyo nārāyaṇo devaḥ sarveśvaro'pi sarvadā ।
mamā'bhiprāyamāsādya karotyeva kriyāṃ sadā ।।1.373.80।।
mayā tu sevayā nātho vaśīkṛto'sti mādhavaḥ ।
māmantarā na vai sthātuṃ kṣaṇaṃ saudhe pravartate ।।81 ।।
hikkānvitā prapaśyantu māṃ hi smarati keśava ।
āyāsyati kṣaṇenātra yadvā gacchāma eva tam ।।82।।
madvākyaṃ narmayuktaṃ vā yathārthaṃ vā na lumpati ।
yathā vacmi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ karoti tattathā ।।83।।
mayaiva gṛhavānasti mayaiva śobhate sadā ।
mayaiva ca bhavatyo'pi dattāstasmai parātmane ।।84।।
nānyo matsadṛśī mānyā dhanyā cātra sahelikāḥ ।
evaṃ garvaṃ samāpannā jñātā nārāyaṇena sā ।।85।।
pātivratyaparā ceyaṃ smayamāptā'tibhāvataḥ ।
darpayuktā mahālakṣmīḥ sakhībhiḥ saha tatsthalāt ।। 86।।
gṛhaṃ pratinivṛttā ca samāyātā tu gopuram ।
harirjaye vijaye ca viveśa garvagañjanaḥ ।।87।।
viśamānā vibhordvāraṃ viśālaṃ sā sakhīvṛtā ।
nivāritā sā dvārāttu jayena vijayena ca ।।88।।
parābhūtā mahālakṣmīstena dvayena sā tataḥ ।
natvā''tmanastiraskāraṃ sābhimānā mahāsatī ।।89।।
smṛtyā hareḥ pādapadme dehaṃ tyaktu samudyatā ।
atha tatra darśanārthamāyātāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।।1.373.90।।
pitāmaho maheśaśva viṣṇudharmaśca bhāskaraḥ ।
candraśca kāmadevaśca vaiśvānaro dhanādhipaḥ ।।91 ।।
ṛṣayo munayaścāpi manavo vighnanāyakāḥ ।
mahendro varuṇaścāpi jagatprāṇo hutāśanaḥ ।।92।।
gopure saṃsthitāḥ sarve mahālakṣmīṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ ।
kṣamasva bhagavatyambe! kṣamāśīle! parātpare! ।।93।।
śuddhasattvasvarūpe ca sādhvīdevīprapūjite ।
tvayā vinā jagatsarvaṃ mṛtatulyaṃ ca niṣphalam ।।94।।
sarvasampatsvarūpā tvaṃ tvatkalāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।
tvāṃ janā ye pūjayanti sarvasṛṣṭiprapūjitām ।।95।।
abhāryo labhate bhāryāṃ vinītāṃ ca sutāṃ satīm ।
suśīlāṃ suṃdarīṃ ramyāmatipriyasuvādinīm ।। 96।।
aputro labhate putraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ cirajīvinam ।
pautraṃ ca guṇasampannaṃ vidyāvantaṃ yaśasvinam ।। 97।।
bhraṣṭarājyo labhed rājyaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīrlabhate śriyam ।
kīrtihīno labhed kīrtiṃ dhanabhraṣṭo dhanaṃ labhet ।।98।।
tādṛśī tvaṃ mahāyogaiśvaryavatī hi vartate ।
mā devi! nidhane hārdaṃ kṛthā bhava kṛpāvatī ।। 99।।
iti śrutvā tu devānāṃ mahālakṣmīruvāca tān ।
tyajāmi dehaṃ na krodhānna vairāgyeṇa sāmpratam ।। 1.373.1 00।।
idaṃ hṛdi samālocya devāstacchrūyatāṃ śubham ।
yatra patyau sadīśe vai samatā tṛṇaśailayoḥ ।। 101 ।।
bhṛtye patnyāṃ matsamatā kiṃ kāryaṃ jīvanena vai ।
kṛṣṇapatnīpradhānā'haṃ nirastā dvāriṇā'munā ।। 1 02।।
yā strīrbharturasobhāgyā sā'saubhāgyā ca sarvataḥ ।
śayane bhojane tasyā na sukhaṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।। 103 ।।
yasyā nāsti priyaprema tasyā janma nirarthakam ।
tatkiṃ putre dhane rūpe sampattau yauvane'pi vā ।। 1 04।।
yasyā bhaktirna vai kānte sā'saubhāgyā tu svāmini ।
sā'śucirdharmahīnā ca sarvakarmavivarjitā ।। 1 05।।
patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ gurureva saḥ ।
sarvasmānna paraḥ svāmī na guruḥ svāminaḥ paraḥ ।। 106 ।।
pitā mātā suto bhrātā svalpaṃ dadāti vai dhanam ।
sarvasvadātā svāmī tu patnīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ patiḥ ।। 1 07।।
kācideva vijānāti svāmimāhātmyamuttamam ।
atisadvaṃśasañjātā mahāsādhvī tapasvinī ।। 1 08।।
asadvaṃśaprasūtā yā duḥśīlā dharmavarjitā ।
svārthamātraparā duṣṭā patiṃ nindati kopataḥ ।। 1 09।।
yā strī svasvāminaṃ dveṣṭi patiṃ viṣṇusamaṃ gurum ।
kuṃbhīpāke patet sā tu brahmaṇo dinamānakam ।। 1.373.110 ।।
vrataṃ cānaśanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ puṇyaṃ tapaściram ।
patibhaktivihīnāyā bhasmībhūtaṃ nirarthakam ।। 111 ।।
ataḥ kiṃcinna vakṣyāmi niṣṭhuraṃ matpatiṃ prati ।
harerbhṛtyatiraskāraiḥ prāṇāँstyakṣyāmi niścitam ।। 11 2।।
patidoṣe mahāsādhvī patiṃ na niṣṭhuraṃ vadet ।
yadi soḍhumaśaktā syāt prāṇāँstyajati dharmataḥ ।। 113 ।।
patisevā vrataṃ strīṇāṃ patisevā paraṃ tapaḥ ।
patisevā paro dharmaḥ patisevā surārcanam ।। 114।।
patisevā paraṃ satyaṃ dānatīrthānukīrtanam ।
sarvadevamayaḥ svāmī śuciḥ puṇyasvarūpakaḥ ।। 1 15।।
yā satī bharturucchiṣṭaṃ bhuṃkte pādodakaṃ sadā ।
tasyā darśamupasparśaṃ nityaṃ vāñcchanti devatāḥ ।। 116 ।।
satyāḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni punanti pāpino hyaghāt ।
iti śrutvā svayaṃ brahmā satīmuvāca bhaktimān ।। 1 17।।
bhaviṣyati na bhadraṃ ca jayasya vijayasya ca ।
tvayā na śaptau tau bhṛtyau svāmyaparādhabhītayā ।। 1 18।।
sāparādhaṃ tu dharmiṣṭhaḥ kṣamayā na śaped yadi ।
sarvanāśo bhavettasya niścitaṃ mā ciraṃ sati! ।। 11 9।।
yadi śaptuṃ na śaktaśca na daṇḍaṃ kartumīśvaraḥ ।
sāparādhe tu puruṣe dharmo daṇḍaṃ karoti hi ।। 1.373.120 ।।
sarvaṃ kṣamasva he mātargaccha gaccha priyā'ntikam ।
asmākamapi lābhaḥ syāddarśanasya hareriha ।। 121 ।।
prāha lakṣmīstadā devā! yadi cāsmi pativratā ।
patidharme yadi lubdhā patyarthaṃ prāṇadāyinī ।। 122 ।।
pātivratyaparā nityamacalā yadi svāmini ।
madukteṣu tu dharmeṣu vartamānā sadā yadi ।। 123 ।।
pātivratyabalenā'tra samāyātu narāyaṇaḥ ।
gopure darśanaṃ dātuṃ samāyātu patirmama ।। 1 24।।
yadyahaṃ prāṇataḥ patnī hareḥ snehāspadā sadā ।
tyaktasarvasvaharyarthā samāyātu haristadā ।। 1 25।।
yadyahaṃ jīvataḥ patnī tadātmikā pativratā ।
tadā nārāyaṇastvatra samāyātvanyathā mriye ।। 126 ।।
ityuktvā tu mahālakṣmīragnirutpādya pādataḥ ।
yāvad dagdhuṃ manaścakre tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ samāgataḥ ।। 127।।
dhṛtvā vakṣasi tāṃ lakṣmīṃ cucumbā''śliṣṭavānapi ।
kṣamasva devi! krauryaṃ me ityuktvā'bhūd galadravaḥ ।। 128 ।।
sāśrunetro jagādaināṃ satyā'si tvaṃ pativratā ।
pātivratyaprabhāveṇa tvāgato'haṃ hi gopure ।। 1 29।।
āyāhi sati! mā ruṣṭā bhava sādhvi! mayā tvidam ।
parīkṣārthaṃ garvaśāntyai praviśya bhṛtyakāritam ।। 1.373.130 ।।
bhakte kalatre bandhau ca sarvatra samatā mama ।
viśeṣato'pi madbhaktaḥ kalatrātpara eva ca ।। 131 ।।
madbhaktau tava pujau ca dvārapālau kathārthakau ।
kṣama māmaparādhaṃ ca tayośca bhaktipūrṇayoḥ ।। 132.।।
ityuktvā jagatāṃ nāthaḥ surebhyo nijadarśanam ।
ratvā lakṣmīṃ hṛdi kṛtvā yayā svabhavanāntaram ।। 133 ।।
dvārapālaṃ samāhūya hariḥ prāha tadā sukham ।
mā bhairvatsa sukhaṃ tiṣṭha bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite ।। 134 ।।
madbhaktānāṃ tu kaḥ śāstā gaccha vatsā''sana svakam ।
mayā vai cintitaṃ bījaṃ lokeṣu gamanāya yat ।। 135 ।।
tadarthe kāritaṃ caitad gāsyanti mānavā hi tat ।
caritraṃ me ca bhaktānāṃ mokṣaṃ yāsyanti tena vai ।। 136 ।।
devānprāha haristatra śṛṇvantu sarvathā'malam ।
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmastenā'nayā vaśīkṛtaḥ ।। 137।।
siṃhāsanaṃ parityajya gopuraṃ ca samāgataḥ ।
pātivratyabalenaiva sarvādhāro'pi devatāḥ ।। 138 ।।
tasmānnaitatsamo dharmo bhuktimuktiprado'sti vai ।
naro nārī ca vā bhaktaḥ pātivratyena sevate ।। 139 ।।
sa matpadamavāpnoti gacchāmi prati taṃ surāḥ ।
nivasāmi gṛhe teṣāṃ tadadhīno'smi sarvathā ।। 1.373.140 ।।
ityuktāstu surā natvā saṃpūjya svagṛha yayuḥ ।
satī sevāparā jātā śroturvaktuśca tatphalam ।। 141 ।।
jayaśca vijayaḥ pūrve hareraiśvaryarūpiṇau ।
pūrvasṛṣṭau vedanidheḥ putrau vratena pārṣadau ।। 142 ।।
jātau tau rādhikāśāpāt tṛṇabindoḥ sutāvubhau ।
maruttayajñakartārau dhanārthe śāpato mithaḥ ।। 143 ।।
gajagrāhau tu sañjātau tau vaikuṇṭhātprahāpitau ।
hariṇā svecchayā niḥsāritau tau pārṣadau punaḥ ।। 144।।
jātāvatreti vijñeyau śāpād daityau punaḥ punaḥ ।
punaśca pārṣadāvante tvaiśvaryākhyau bhaviṣyataḥ ।। 145।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye vaikuṇṭhamahālakṣmyā garvanāśārthaṃ gopure ruddhāyāstasyāḥ pātivratyapralāpena nārāyaṇasya gopuraṃ pratyākarṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 373 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 373 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 374
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 375 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tathā śacyāḥ pātivratyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ yathā ।
caturdaśasu cendreṣu hyāgateṣu gateṣu ca ।। 1 ।।
teṣveva pātivratyaṃ vai tvindrāṇyā āsa sarvathā ।
ekadā tu samāyāto bṛhaspatirhi saṃsadi ।। 2 ।।
mahendrasya ca devānāmāśīrvādaparāyaṇaḥ ।
indro darpāt sabhāyāṃ tu ratnasiṃhāsanadvarāt ।। 3 ।।
nottasthau svaguruṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmiṣṭhaṃ vai bṛhaspatim ।
anye sabhāsadāḥ sarve samuttasthurvavandire ।। 4 ।।
tānāśiṣaḥ saṃprayujya mahendraṃ samupekṣya ca ।
gururjagāmā'tiruṣṭaḥ svā'pamāne samatsaraḥ ।।5 ।।
na śaśāpa mahājñānī dhairyamālambya dhārmikaḥ ।
vinā śāpenendragarvaścūrṇībhūto babhūva ha ।। 6 ।।
sakilbiṣaṃ sāparādhaṃ na śapeccenmahājanaḥ ।
aparādhastaṃ phalati dharmo hantyaparādhinam ।। 7 ।।
yadi hiṃsraṃ sāparādhe śapet kopena dhārmikaḥ ।
sāparādho vinaśyettu dhārmikaḥ krodhavān bhavet ।। 8 ।।
krodhitasya kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ naśyati mūlataḥ ।
tasmāt krodho na kartavyaḥ kutracicchreya icchatā ।। 9 ।।
sāparādhe'pi vai jantau kṣamā rakṣyā supuṇyadā ।
kṣamāśīlasya saddharmaḥ svayaṃ karoti rakṣaṇam ।। 1.374.10 ।।
avamānād guroreva brāhmaṇasya tapasvinaḥ ।
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ jāyate tvaparādhinaḥ ।। 11 ।।
pratiṣṭhitasya hananaṃ tvapamānaṃ prakīrtyate ।
tenā'dharmeṇa śakrasya brahmahatyā babhūva ha ।। 1 2।।
sā tu pāpātmikā cendraṃ vavalge mastake tadā ।
pramatta iva saṃjāta unmatta iva bhāntimān ।। 12 ।।
bhītaścendrapadaṃ tyaktvā prayayau puṣkaraṃ saraḥ ।
tatra vai kāmale sūtre cakre vāsaṃ nigūḍhavat ।। 14।।
rājyaṃ riktaṃ tadā jñātvā devāśca munayo'khilāḥ ।
nahuṣaṃ nāma rājarṣiṃ cakrustvindrapradhānakam ।। 15।।
indrāsanasya pārśvastho nahuṣo nāma bhūpatiḥ ।
indrasattāpratirūpāṃ sattāmāsādya cendravat ।। 16।।
rājyaṃ saṃcālayatyeva caturdaśabhuvāṃ tadā ।
kvacitkadācidindrasya tvardhāsane'pi tiṣṭhati ।। 17।।
indrasya bhavane cāpi yāne vāṭyāṃ ca vāhane ।
udyāne yāti nahuṣo viharapyapi garvataḥ ।। 18।।
dṛṣṭvā śacīṃ varārohāmanapatyāṃ ca sundarīm ।
navayauvanaśobhāḍhyāṃ bahurūpasamanvitām ।। 1 9।।
sukomalāṃ ca sudatīmanindre śokavāsitām ।
mahāsatīṃ mahārājñīṃ patiśūnyāṃ manoharām ।।1.374.20।।
mūrchā samprāpa nahuṣaḥ kāmena yauvanena ca ।
uvāca tāṃ puraḥ sthitvā vinayena svakāmiva ।।2 1 ।।
dhāturgatirvicitrā'ho na bodhyā sā satāmapi ।
pārameṣṭhyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ caindraṃ kṣaṇaṃ sarvatra buddhyate ।। 22।।
yauvanaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ rājñi! bhaja māmindrasannibham ।
tvādṛśīṃ strīṃ parityajya kathamindro maheśvaraḥ ।। 23 ।।
narāṇāṃ yoṣiti gantā'halyāyāṃ ceṭikāstriyām ।
īdṛśī sundarī yasya parabhāryāsu tanmanaḥ ।।24।।
naitadāścaryamatrā'sti kāmo vāñcchati nūtanām ।
asyā agre tu kā raṃbhā korvaśī kā tilottamā ।।25।।
kā vā menā ghṛtācī vā ratnamālā kalāvatī ।
etāścāpsarasaścānyā naitattulyā bhavanti vai ।।26 ।।
iti praśaṃsya nahuṣo māṃ bhajasvā''ha bhāvataḥ ।
ahamindrapadaṃ prāptaḥ pūrvendro'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।। 27।।
tato bhava tvaṃ saubhāgyā me vakṣasi sukhālayā ।
līlayā ca sahasrendrān jetuṃ śakto'hamīśvaraḥ ।।28।।
māṃ gṛhītvā kuru ratiṃ puṣpacandanacarcitam ।
brahmaṇastu varairdevi! jarāmṛtyuvivarjitam ।।29।।
māṃ kuruṣva patiṃ bhadre nityasusthirayauvanam ।
na me spṛhā parastrīṣu tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā lolupaṃ manaḥ ।। 1.374.30।।
tatrāpīndro bhavāmyadya tvaṃ ca patnī nisargataḥ ।
bhāvinī me bhava cādya prārthitā na prasahya vai ।।3 1 ।।
ityevamuktvā nahuṣo jijñāsati taduttaram ।
uvāca taṃ śacī sādhvī dāsaṃ nṛpaṃ tu mānavam ।।32।।
śṛṇu rājan! nyāyayuktaṃ pātivratyaṃ sadā mama ।
brahmaṇā nirmitā cāhaṃ yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।।33।।
caturdaśānāmindrāṇāṃ patnī bhavāmi vai kramāt ।
caturdaśasu madhye tvaṃ nā'si vai gaṇitaḥ khalu ।। 34।।
tasmānna tvaṃ patitve me yogyaścāsi kathaṃcana ।
mānavo'si mahārāja! devyahaṃ ca tato'pi vai ।।35 ।।
nā'haṃ yogyā tava patnī na devī mānuṣaṃ bhajet ।
śṛṇu tvanyanmahārāja! mahendrapadameva yat ।।।36।।
bhavate nā'rpitaṃ devaiḥ kāryamātraṃ samarpitam ।
na tvindratvaṃ cārpitaṃ te bhṛtyatvaṃ te samarpitam ।।37।।
indrānupasthitau kāryamindrasya kuru tadyathā ।
pradhānasattayā kāryamātraṃ tubhyaṃ samarpitam ।।38।।
nendrāṇī nā''sanaṃ naiva bhavanaṃ nendratā tathā ।
munibhistvarpitā tubhyaṃ mā vṛthā garvamāvaha ।।39।।
śṛṇu tvanyanmahārāja! prajāpālanadharmavān ।
gaṇyate tu pitātulyastvaṃ yātaḥ pitṛtulyatām ।।1.374.40 ।।
devānāṃ pitṛtā tvindre rājatvena virājate ।
tathā tvayi samāpannā pitṛtā mādṛśīṃ prati ।।41 ।।
nā'haṃ vivāhitā te'smi na tvadarthaṃ prakalpitā ।
na hi tasmāt tava bhogyā vṛthā māṃ mā''grahaṃ kuru ।।42।।
kiṃ ca rājan! śṛṇu tattvaṃ pūrvendre vigate sati ।
pūrvaṃ dehaṃ satīrūpaṃ dagdhvā dadhāmi nūtanam ।।43।।
evaṃ trayodaśakṛtvaḥ karomi nūtanāṃ tanūm ।
gṛhṇāmi tvaparaṃ cendraṃ tenā'smi saṃpativratā ।।44।।
tvaṃ rājaँścet samartho'si tyaja dehaṃ hi mānuṣam ।
gṛhāṇa nūtanaṃ daivaṃ tataścaindrapadaṃ punaḥ ।।45।।
caturdaśasu gaṇanāṃ labha devarṣisaṃsadi ।
paścād brahmādibhirdattā syāṃ bhavāmi tava priyā ।।46।।
nānyathā bhāminī te'smi nā'smi bhogyā kathaṃcana ।
yāvadindraḥ sāsurasti proṣitaḥ puṣkare'bjake ।।47।।
tvaṃ cāsi karmabhūmervai rājā na tu divaḥ punaḥ ।
bhayatrātā bhaved rājā sarvoṣāṃ pālakaḥ pitā ।।48।।
bhraṣṭaśrīśca mahendro'dya guroḥ kopād bhuvaṃ gataḥ ।
tvaṃ tu kārye yojito'si prajānāṃ hi pitā yathā ।।49।।
kāryabhāre yojito'si nendrāṇī yojitā tvayi ।
pūrvarājñaḥ pṛthivyāṃ vai yo'nyaḥ rājā'bhiṣicyate ।।1.374.5 0।।
sa tatputrastasya śiṣya iti pṛthvyāṃ prasiddhyati ।
pūrvabhūpasya yā patnī rājamātā hi gaṇyate ।।51 ।।
nūtanasya tu rājñaśca patnī rājñīti gaṇyate ।
iti rītyā mahārāja! rājamātā bhavāmi te ।।52।।
na rājñī te bhavāmyevaṃ jñātvā mā lālasāṃ kuru ।
gurupatnī rājapatnī devapatnī tathā vadhūḥ ।।53।।
pitroḥ svasā śiṣyapatnī bhṛtyapatnī ca mātulī ।
pitṛpatnī bhrātṛpatnī śvaśrūśca bhaginī sutā ।।54।।
garbhadhātrīṣṭadevī ca puṃsaḥ ṣoḍaśamātaraḥ ।
tvaṃ naro devabhāryā'haṃ mātā te sarvathā'smi vai ।।55।।
gaccha vatsā'ditiṃ rantuṃ yadi cecchasi mātaram ।
sarvoṣāṃ niṣkṛtistvasti na vatsa mātṛgāminām ।।56।।
kuṃbhīpāke prapacyante yāvatte brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।
tato bhavanti kṛmayaḥ kalpāḥ sapta tataḥ param ।।57।।
kuṣṭhimlecchāḥ saptajanau tataḥ pāpa praṇaśyati ।
kiṃ rājaँste mano yāti mātṛyonau vadā'tra me ।।।58।।।
santyehā'psaraso bahvyo yadi devīḥ pravāñchasi ।
kledeṣu ca malāḍhyeṣu durgandhinilayeṣu ca ।।59।।
subahuṣvanubhūteṣu tathāpi hṛdi vāsanā ।
sadṛśeṣu kathaṃ te'sti strībhageṣvatra māṃ vada ।।1.374.6 0।।
kulapradīpe svargeśe tvayi jāte sudharmiṇi ।
kathamicchasi rājendra! mūtragūhyaṃ parastriyāḥ ।।।6 1 ।।
svargaṃ prāptaṃ tathā'pyatra tṛṣṇā kiṃ na nivartate ।
sādhūnāṃ kiṃ sukhaṃ sādho! strīṇāṃ yoniṣu māṃ vad ।।62।।
vrataṃ pativratānāṃ ca patyuḥ sevāparaṃ tapaḥ ।
yathā putraḥ parapatireṣa dharmaśca yoṣitām ।।63 ।।
pālayanti yathā bhūpāḥ prajāḥ putrānivaurasān ।
prajāstriyaṃ ca paśyanti rājāno mātaraṃ yathā ।।64।।
yajñaṃ kurvanti rājāno devabrāhmaṇarakṣakāḥ ।
nivāraṇaṃ ca duṣṭānāṃ śiṣṭānāṃ paripālanam ।।65।।
satīnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cāpi kurvanti bhūbhṛtaḥ khalu ।
viparītaṃ kathaṃ rājan! gṛhṇāsi vartanaṃ tviha ।।66।।
ityuktvā tu mahendrāṇī virarāma pativratā ।
uvāca nahuṣo rājā śacīṃ garviṣṭhavākyavān ।।67।।
śṛṇu śaci! nyāyayuktaṃ grāhyaṃ te yadi rocate ।
bhūmau śubhā'śubhaṃ karma kṛtvā tvādāya tatphalam ।।68।।
anyatra mānavo bhuṃkte svargādau vedabodhitam ।
bhūmau kṛtvā mahatpuṇyaṃ svargaṃ gacchati puṇyavān ।।69।।
gṛhītvā sarvakanyāśca ciraṃ svarge pramodate ।
svargamāyāti manujo vihāya mānavīṃ tanum ।।1.374.70 ।।
svaśarīreṇā''gāto'haṃ matpuṇyaṃ paśya sundari! ।
anekajanmapuṇyena tvāgataḥ svargamīpsitam ।।71 ।।
tato'pyadhikapuṇyena mahendrapadamāptavān ।
tadidaṃ me mahatpuṇyaṃ darśanaṃ me tvayā saha ।।72।।
nahi karmasthalaṃ cedaṃ svarbhogasthalameva yat ।
bhogasthale bhogyavastu nahi tyaktuṃ praśakyate ।।73।।
tvaṃ tu bhogyā mahendrasya sthito'smyahaṃ tadāsane ।
asvāmikā'dhunā tvaṃ ca mama bhogyā prajāyase ।।74।।
nirmitā tvaṃ mama bhogye yenā'hamaindramāsthitaḥ ।
tava bhāgye likhito'haṃ yataścaindrapade sthitaḥ ।।75।।
tvaṃ ca kānte! mama yogyā yāvadindro bhavāmyaham ।
tyakte tvindrapade tvāṃ na lokayiṣyāmi vai punaḥ ।।76 ।।
ehi kānte! bhavanā'ntargṛhe raṃsye tvayā saha ।
tyaja dvaidhaṃ tu manaso modasva mānave sure ।।77।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau śacī śrutvā śuśoca ha ।
acetanasya mūḍhasya kāryā'kāryamajānataḥ ।।78।।
śroṣyāmyadya kathāṃ katividhāṃ kāmāturasya ca ।
vāyumattaḥ surāmattaḥ kāmamatto vicetanaḥ ।।79।।
mṛtyuṃ na gaṇayet kāmī kāmena hṛtamānasaḥ ।
prāha vai nahuṣaṃ tatra nyāyyaṃ pratyuttaraṃ punaḥ ।।1.374.80।।
svargaṃ bhogasthalaṃ tvasti karmaphalaṃ hi bhujyate ।
tvayā nāsti kṛtaṃ tādṛg bhogyā bhavāmi yena te ।।8 1 ।।
pṛccha vai dharmarājāya pṛcchā'nyagurave tathā ।
tiṣṭhantīndrāsane rikte makṣikā jantavo'pi ca ।।82।।
na te bhavanti cendrā vai bhogyā teṣāṃ bhavāmi na ।
indra eva patirme'sti makṣikā jantavo nahi ।।83।।
tvaṃ tu rājaँstathābhūto mā''grahaṃ kuru vai mṛṣā ।
śṛṇu rājaँstathā gopyaṃ yadasmyadya rajasvalā ।।84।।
ṛtoḥ prathamo divaso hyadya me vartate nṛpa! ।
prathame divase nārī cāṇḍālīvat tvaśuddhigā ।।85।।
dvitīye divase mlecchāsamā'to rajakīsamā ।
tṛtīye'tha caturthe sā śuddhā bhartrarthameva vai ।।86 ।।
tataḥ sā daivapaitryādikāryayogyā bhavatyapi ।
ādye rajasvalāgantā brahmahatyāṃśapāpavān ।।87।।
dvitīye divase bhoktā gohatyāpāpako bhavet ।
tṛtīye divase bhoktā bhrūṇahatyāghavān bhavet ।।88।।
caturthe patiyogyā sā snātvā saṃjāyate satī ।
ṛtudānaṃ patirdadyād vidhirvedairnirūpitaḥ ।।89।।
ayugalāsu rātriṣu dāne kanyā prajāyate ।
yugalāsu tu rātriṣu dāne putraḥ prajāyate ।।1.374.90।।
āṣoḍaśarātryantaँ śaktirgarbhadhṛterbhavet ।
taduttaraṃ praśāntistu garbhadhṛtirna vai bhavet ।।9 1 ।।
tatra patnī na gantavyā bījahatyā'bhidūṣaṇāta ।
evaṃ dharmaḥ racito'sti tvaṃ tu dharmaṃ vihāya vai ।।95।।।
kāmāturo bhavatyadya gaccha rājñīṃ nijāṃ bhuvi ।
śāntiṃ labha mahārāja! vrataṃ dīrghaṃ carāmyaham ।।93।।
śacyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya nahuṣastadā ।
uvāca dharmavidhuraṃ kalpitaṃ bhogakāṃkṣayā ।।94।।
devapatnī sadā śuddhā rājasvalyaṃ na vidyate ।
rajasvalākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhūloke nātra vai divi ।।95।।
candravaṃśyo bhavāmyatra mahendro devapaṃktigaḥ ।
rājasvalyena me nāsti bādhastvāyāhi sundari! ।।96।।
ṛtupāpaṃ mayi syāccet! tava kiṃ rama śobhane! ।
ramaṇārthaṃ kuru śayyāṃ bhavatvadya samāgamaḥ ।।97।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau rājā kurvan pratīkṣaṇam ।
śacī prāha śṛṇu rājan! buddhiste vilayaṃ gatā ।।98।।
pātivratyamapradhṛṣyaṃ dhṛṣye dhṛṣṭurvināśakam ।
itijñātvā vada cāgre pravṛtto'bhūrvicārya vai ।।99।।
tvāṃ śapāmi cet tvatra rakṣakaḥ ko'pi nāsti te ।
pātivratyaṃ mahān dharmo nārāyaṇasvarūpavān ।। 1.374.100 ।।
nārāyaṇo haro brahmā viṣṇurvairāja īśvarāḥ ।
bibhyatyeva parāddharmāt pātivratyāddhi kaṃpitāḥ ।। 101 ।।
sūryaścandro varuṇaśca yamo mṛtyurjarādayaḥ ।
kālaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo rudro bibhyatyeva pativratāt ।। 1 02।।
meghaḥ śaniścaro rāhurdānavā rākṣasā api ।
daityā devā vahnayaśca vārdhayaḥ parvatāstathā ।। 103 ।।
kampante pātivratyād vai vicāraṃ kuru mānase ।
pativratā subhāryā vai patiṃ jīvayati mṛtam ।। 1 04।।
jalānāṃ pralayaṃ saiva śamayatyeva sādhvikā ।
agnīnāmuṣṇatāṃ śītāṃ karotyeva pativratā ।। 1 05।।
mahākālaṃ parāvṛtya jīvatyeva pativratā ।
sūryacandragatirodhau karotyeva pativratā ।। 106 ।।
vṛkṣapuṣpaphalasmṛddhiṃ karotyeva pativratā ।
viṣṇoḥ sudarśanaṃ śastraṃ brahmāstraṃ lokanāśakam ।
śamayatyeva saṃkalpād drāgeva tu pativratā ।। 1 07।।
sāparādhasya puṇyānāṃ nāśaṃ karoti sādhvikā ।
brahmāṇḍapralayaṃ cāpi kartuṃ śaktā pativratā ।।1 08।।
jale sthalaṃ sthale vāri vyomni bhūmiṃ bhuvo'mbaram ।
nārīṃ naraṃ naraṃ nārīṃ kartuṃ śaktā pativratā । । 109 । ।
kiṃ na jānāsi rājendra! kā te buddhirūpasthitā ।
yamapāśān suvicchetuṃ śaktā nārī pativratā । । 1.374.110 । ।
tasmād rājan bhuvaṃ yāhi mā manaḥ kaluṣaṃ kuru ।
iti jāte vivāde'tra vṛhaspatirupāgataḥ । । 111 ।।
rājātvindrasvarūpatvāt satkāraṃ susamācarat ।
śacī yayau salajjā svabhavanāntarameva yat । । 112 ।।
nahuṣāt satkṛtiṃ labdhvā dattvā''śīrvādamityatha ।
yayau śacīgṛhaṃ tatra śacyā datte śubhāsane ।। 113 । ।
niṣasāda guruḥ śacyā vivādārtho niveditaḥ ।
prārthito'pi guruḥ samyak śacyā tu dīnayā tadā ।। 114 ।।
rakṣa rakṣa mahābhāga! nimagnāṃ śokasāgare ।
dūrīkṛto mama patistvayā śiṣyaḥ svarājyataḥ ।। 115 ।।
sampacchūnyamāśramaṃ me nahuṣaścendratāṃ vahan ।
svapatnīṃ māṃ vidhātuṃ sa karotyāgrahamulbaṇam । । 116 ।।
ahaṃ pativratā nārī necchāmyanyaṃ patiṃ guro! ।
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmamutsraṣṭuṃ notsahe guro ।। 117 ।।
rājā tathā guruścobhau mānyau pūjyau sadā matau ।
sāmnā yāvadvirodhasya śāntiḥ syāttāvadeva tu ।। 118 ।।
sādhvyā śāpo na vai deyaḥ sarvathā'pi samarthayā ।
iti vicārya ca mayā śapto na ṇahuṣo nṛpaḥ ।। 119 । ।
patyurviprakarastvaṃ ca śapto nā'si tu gauravāt ।
yadi coktaṃ mayā samyaṅ na bhaviṣyati vai guro । । 1.374.120 । ।
śapāmi tvāṃ ca nahuṣaṃ sarvanāśo bhaviṣyati ।
tathāpi mahatāṃ nāśe māstu me mānase tvarā । । 121 ।।
iti kṛtvā''vedayāmi śāntiṃ kuru guro! sukham ।
yathā patirmahendro me samāyāt svagṛhaṃ prati ।। 122 । ।
nahuṣastu bhaved bhraṣṭastathā kāryaṃ vidhīyatām ।
datvā caraṇareṇūँ staṃ mahendraṃ dehi cāśiṣaḥ ।। 123 ।।
sarveṣāṃ tu gurūṇāṃ ca janmadātā paro guruḥ ।
pituḥ śataguṇā mātā pūjyā vandyā garīyasī ।। 1 24। ।
vidyādātā mantradātā jñānado haribhaktidaḥ ।
pūjyo vandyaśca sevyaśca mātuḥ śataguṇo guruḥ । । 125 ।।
ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāṃ'janaśalākayā ।
cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ ।। 126 । ।
janmadātā'nnadātā ca tathā'nye guruvo matāḥ ।
āropitāśca guravaḥ prasahya guruvastathā ।। 1 27।।
tathopaguravaḥ santi śikṣakā guruvo'pi ca ।
pāraṃ kartuṃ na śaktāste ghorasaṃsārasāgare । । 128 ।।
vidyāmantrajñātadātā nipuṇaḥ pārakarmaṇi ।
sa śaktaḥ śiṣyamuddhartumīśvaraśceśvareśvaraḥ ।। 129 । ।
gururviṣṇurgururbrahmā gururdevo maheśvaraḥ ।
gururdharmo guruḥ śeṣaḥ sarvātmā keśavo guruḥ ।। 1.374.130 ।।
sarvatīrthādhivāsaśca sarvadevādhivāsitaḥ ।
sarvadevātmako divyo gururūpī hariḥ svayam ।। 131 । ।
abhīṣṭadeve vai ruṣṭe guruḥ śakto hi rakṣitum ।
gurau ruṣṭe'bhīṣṭadevo na vai śaktaśca rakṣitum ।। 132 । ।
gurau ruṣṭe grahā ruṣṭā ruṣṭā devāśca sarvathā ।
bhāgyānyapi ca ruṣṭāni guruṃ ruṣṭaṃ na kārayet ।। 133 । ।
na guroradhikaścātmā priyaḥ putraḥ priyo'pi na ।
dhanaṃ patnī tapo dharmaḥ puṇyaṃ satyaṃ na vai priyam ।। 134 । ।
guroḥ paro na vai śāstā rājā bandhurna vai paraḥ ।
mantro vidyāgururdevaḥ pūrvalabdhaḥ patistathā ।। 135 । ।
parātparaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ sarveṣāmupari sthitaḥ ।
mātā vandyā pitā vandyo vandyaśca tvādṛśo guruḥ ।। 136 ।।
viprāṇāṃ tvaṃ variṣṭho'si gariṣṭhaśca tapasvinām ।
brahmiṣṭho'si brahmavitsu dharmiṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmiṇām ।। 137 । ।
devānāṃ sarvathā pūjya iti jānāmi sarvadā ।
tataḥ kṣamāṃ yayāce'haṃ śapāmi naiva madgurum । । 138 । ।
tuṣṭo bhava muniśreṣṭha! śakramānaya mā ciram ।
nahuṣaṃ tvindrabhavanācchīghraṃ prakṣipa bhūtale ।। 139 । ।
ityuktvā tvāntare tṛptā bahiḥ saumyā śacī tadā ।
maunamālambya dhairyeṇa phalaṃ ceyeṣa sattvaram । । 1.374.140 । ।
vṛhaspatistadā prāha dhanyā'si tvaṃ pativrate! ।
śaptuṃ tvaṃ vai samarthā'si rakṣito'haṃ nṛpo'pi ca । । 141 ।।
nāryo bhavantu tādṛśyo yathā rakṣākarī śacī ।
ityuktvā prāha cendrāṇyai sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 142 । ।
sadyaḥ prāpsyasi bhartāraṃ mahendraṃ tvaṃ mamāśiṣā ।
yathā kacasya patnī me tathā tvamapi śobhane! ।। 143 । ।
yathā putrastathā śiṣyā na bhedaḥ putraśiṣyayoḥ ।
tarpaṇe piṇḍadāne ca pālane paritoṣaṇe । । 1 44।।
yathā'gnidātā putraśca tathā śiṣyo'pi niścitaḥ ।
pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiśuśca'nāthabāndhavāḥ ।।1 45।।
ete puṃsāṃ nityapoṣyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
kurute mānavīṃ buddhiṃ mātāpitrostathā gurau ।। 146 । ।
ayaśastasya sarvatra vighna eva pade pade ।
karoti sampanmatto yaḥ svagurostu parābhavam ।। 147।।
acirātsarvanāśo'sya bhavet svasyāpi niścitam ।
māṃ tu dṛṣṭvā sabhāmadhye nottasthau pākaśāsanaḥ ।। 148।।
bhunakti tatphalaṃ tvindraḥ paśya sādhvi tu sāmpratam ।
ahaṃ karomi mokṣaṃ ca samartho'smi pativrate! ।। 149 ।।
pātivratyabalātte ca nahuṣo'pi vinaṃkṣyati ।
indrastvāyāsyati śīghraṃ sarvaṃ yuktaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 1.374.150।।
bhaviṣyati prabhāvaste durgāyāśca samaḥ sati! ।
lakṣmīsamā pratiṣṭhā ca yaśastadyaśasā samam ।। 151 ।।
saubhāgyaṃ rādhikātulyaṃ tatsamaṃ prema bhartari ।
tattulyaṃ gauravaṃ mānyaṃ prītiprādhānyamucyate ।। 15 2।।
rohiṇyāstu samā hṛdyā pūjyā sarasvatīsamā ।
śuddhā bhaviṣyasi śaśvatsāvitrīsadṛśī sadā ।। 153 ।।
ityuktvā tāṃ gurustatra śikṣayāmāsa rakṣaṇam ।
vad sādhvi! nahuṣaṃ taṃ śacīṃ ced bhoktumicchati ।। 154।।
apūrvaṃ yānamāruhya niśāyāmāgamiṣyasi ।
saptarṣīṇāṃ yadi skandhe dattvā svaśibikāṃ śubhām ।। 155 ।।
tāmāruhya samāyāhi śacīṃ bhoktuṃ tadā'rhasi ।
śacyāvākyāni tānyevā''veditāni tu bhūbhṛte ।। 156 ।।
prahasya nahuṣaścāpi kiṃkaraṃ prāha satvaram ।
gaccha gaccha tvaran gaccha saptarṣīn śīghramānaya ।। 157।।
ityuktaḥ prayayau dūtaḥ saptarṣīṃstvānayad drutam ।
rājā dṛṣṭvā tu tānsarvānnanāmovāca sādaram ।।158।।
yūyaṃ tu brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ paropakaraṇe ratāḥ ।
mohamātsaryahīnāśca darpā'haṃkāravarjitāḥ ।। 159 ।।
nārāyaṇasamāḥ sarve jvalanto brahmatejasā ।
mama kāryakaraṇārthaṃ kṛpāvanto bhavantu vai ।। 1.374.160 ।।
prāhustaṃ munayaḥ śrutvā vṛṇīṣva manasi sthitam ।
sarve dātuṃ vayaṃ śaktāstvadarthaṃ mā ciraṃ kuru ।। 161 ।।
nahuṣaḥ prāha tāँstatra yūyaṃ vai bhaktavatsalāḥ ।
adhunā datta me tūrṇaṃ śacīdānamabhīpsitam ।। 16 2।।
saptarṣivāhanaṃ kāntaṃ śacīcchati mahāsatī ।
enameva varaṃ me'dya niṣpannaṃ kurutā'ciram ।। 163 ।।
iti śrutvā tu munayo jahasurmohitaṃ nṛpam ।
cakruḥ skandhe'sya śibikāṃ yayau rājā śacīṃ prati ।। 164।।
jarjaritāstu munayaḥ śanairyānti tadā nṛpaḥ ।
śīghraṃ sarpantu munayaḥ samāḥ prāha munīn muhuḥ ।। 165 ।।
śrutvā krodhaṃ samāpanno durvāsāstvagrago'vadat ।
sarpantviti pravaktā tvaṃ sarpastvajagaro bhava ।। 166।।
evamukto drutaṃ rājā mahānajagaro'bhavat ।
patitaḥ śibikātaśca stutiṃ cakre tapasvinām ।। 167।।
ṛṣayastu nṛpaṃ prāhurdharmaputrasya darśanāt ।
mokṣo bhaviṣyati sarpād vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gamiṣyasi ।। 168।।
ityuktvā prayayuḥ satyaṃ ṛṣayastu dayālavaḥ ।
śacī jagāma tacchratvā guruṃ namāma cādarāt ।। 169।।
yayau brahaspatiḥ śīghraṃ puṣkare padmatantuṣu ।
yatra vai rājate tvindraścājuhāva sureśvaram ।। 1.374.170।।
ayi vatsa tvamāgaccha guruste'haṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।
śrutvā gurusvaraṃ saukṣmyaṃ hitvā tvindraḥ samāyayau ।। 171 ।।
papāta daṇḍavat taṃ ca mudorasi cakāra saḥ ।
nītvā yajñaṃ kārayitvā somaṃ taṃ tvamarāvatīm ।। 172।।
pradadau paramaiśvaryaṃ pūrvasmāttu caturguṇam ।
śacī samprāpa bhartāraṃ pātivratyaprabhāvataḥ ।। 173।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! śacyāḥ satītvamatra te ।
brahmahatyāpraśamanaṃ somayāgaphalapradam ।। 174।।
varṣaṃ somalatāpānaṃ yajamānaścakāra san ।
varṣamekaṃ phalāhāraṃ jalapānaṃ tu vatsaram ।। 175।।
traivārṣikaṃ vrataṃ cendraścakārā''sa punaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sarvasādhyo na yajño'yaṃ bahvanno bahudakṣiṇaḥ ।। 176।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye bṛhaspatyavamānena bhraṣṭendrasyapuṣkaranālavāse nahuṣeṇendrapratinidhinā'rthitāyāṃ śacyāṃ saptarṣiyānamāruhya gacchatā sarpatā prāptetyādigarbhakapātivratyabalakathananāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 374।।


← adhyāyaḥ 374 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 375
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 376 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pativratā'halyāsāmarthyamadbhutam ।
gautamasya ṛṣeḥ patnī tvahalyā'bhūt pativratā ।। 1 ।।
kumāre śarīre yasyāstejorāśiḥ samantataḥ ।
abhūccandrasya paridhiryathā tathā'tra sarvadā ।। 2 ।।
gaṃgātīre'vasatkāśyāṃ gautamo jñānavānṛṣiḥ ।
brahmapuryāṃ parṇakuṭyāṃ samucchrāye sthale sadā ।। 3 ।।
ekadā himaśaile'bhūnmuśaladhāravarṣaṇam ।
jalapūrāṇi taṭayormaryādā sarito jahuḥ ।। 4 ।।
vipatheṣu pravāhāśca dadruvurvai bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
grāmān kheṭān kharvaṭāँśca nītvā pūrāṇi cāvahan ।। ।5 ।।
kāśīmabhitaḥ salilaṃ paryavartata cocchrayam ।
ṛṣayo munayaścānye prajāśca nimnabhūmigāḥ ।। 6 ।।
jale magnā mṛtāḥ sarve hāhākāro babhūva ha ।
lakṣaśaḥ koṭiśastatra magnā jānapadasthitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
mānavāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣasahāyā vaninastathā ।
gautamo dhyānamagnaśca dṛṣṭavān viplavaṃ layam ।। 8 ।।
dhyānād bahiḥ samāgamya prāha patnīmahalyikām ।
are! paśya layaṃ vārikṛtaṃ sarvasvanāśakam ।। 9 ।।
jalānyetāni gaṃgāyā gṛhaṃ te'bhidravantyapi ।
ucchraye'pi pradeśe vai samāgacchanti vegataḥ ।। 1.375.10 ।।
parṇaśālā tathā'haṃ tvaṃ bahiṣyāmaśca dhenavaḥ ।
bahudhā pralayo jāto nā'dyā'pi sa nivartate ।। 11 ।।
kiṃ kāryaṃ vada kalyāṇi! jalaṃ sopānamāgatam ।
paśya vatsā vatsataryaḥ krośanti jaladarśanāt ।। 1 2।।
kuru śīghraṃ tathā yatnaṃ jīvāmastu yathā vayam ।
nā'smadgṛhādaparo'trocchrayadeśo gṛhaṃ vinā ।। 13 ।।
manuṣyā drumamālambya jīviṣyanti yathākatham ।
gavāṃ kā vā dṛśā sādhvi! mahākaṣṭamupasthitam ।। 14।।
ityuktvā gautamo devaḥ śuśocā'śrubhṛdīkṣaṇāḥ ।
ahalyā prāha taṃ svāmin! yadbhāvi tadbhaviṣyati ।। 15।।
paraṃ patimupaspṛśya calo prayatāmi vai ।
ityuktvā prayayau sādhvī śīghraṃ parṇagṛhāntaram ।। 16 ।।
agniṃ prajvālayāmāsa ghṛtena homamācarat ।
sasmāra gaṃgāṃ cāhalyā pātivratyabalena vai ।। 17।।
ehi gaṃge! bhagini! me kathaṃ nāśaṃ karoṣi vai ।
yadi nā''yāsi kalyāṇi! karomi tvāṃ hi bhasmasāt ।। 18।।
gaṃgā bhītā samāyātā mūrtirūpā sukanyakā ।
vavande kiṃkarī bhūtvā'halyāṃ gautamayoṣitam ।। 1 9।।
ahalyā prāha tāṃ tūrṇaṃ kā gaṃge durdaśā kṛtā ।
pralayaṃ te jalānyadya kurvanti prāṇināmati ।।1.375.20।।.
śīghraṃ vāryupasaṃhāraṃ kuru gaṃge'nyathā kṣaṇāt। ।
havanaṃ te kariṣyāmi mṛtā yāsyasi vai layam ।। 21 ।।
cakampe tatsamāśrutya prāha dīnā satīṃ prati ।
kiṃ karomi mahāsādhvi! na me doṣo'tra vidyate ।।22।
himālayo viśālādrirjalāni na ruṇaddhi hi ।
rakṣatyeva nahi svasmiṃstenā'yaṃ viplavo'sti vai ।।23।।
śrutvā'hasya''ha tāṃ gaṃgāṃ tiṣṭha sundari madgṛhe ।
āhvayāmi himādriṃ ca tadupāyaṃ karomyapi । । 24 ।।
ityuktvā gautamapatnī sasmāra vahnisannidhau ।
himālaya! samāyāhi tvanyathā havanaṃ tava । । 25 ।।
kariṣye mā ciraṃ paśya prāṇināṃ kadanaṃ mahat ।।
tāvaccakampe girirāṭ mūrtimān samupāgataḥ ।। 26 ।।
kāśyāmahalyā yatrā'sti natvā provāca tāṃ satīm ।
vada devi! kathaṃ cā'haṃ smṛtaścātra drutaṃ diśa । ।। 27 ।।
paśya vāripralayaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ vāri na rakṣasi ।
nirodhaṃ kuru cā'raṇye vārīṇāṃ parvateṣu ca । ।। 28 ।।
himālayastadā prāha mātaḥ śakto'smi tatra na ।
nāsti tatra mama doṣo mayā rakṣyaṃ jalaṃ sadā । । 29 ।।
śikhareṣu jalaṃ me'sti droṇīṣu ca guhāsu ca ।।
udare cocchraye cā'dhityakopatyakikāsvapi । । 1.375.30 ।।
araṇyeṣu vaneṣūrdhvaṃ nadīṣvapi sthalīṣvapi ।
yāvacchakyaṃ jalānyeva dhārayāmi samantataḥ । । 31 ।।
kintu vṛṣṭirativṛṣṭiḥ satataṃ saptavāsarāt ।
divāniśaṃ patatyeva muśaladhārasadṛśī । । 32 ।।
ahaṃ jale nimagno'smi kiṃ karomi na śaktimān ।
matpramāṇājalānyadya vardhante'tipatanti ca । । 33 ।।
na saṃharanti meghā vai vṛṣṭiṃ pralayakāriṇīm ।
yadi meghāḥ saṃhareyurjalāni saṃyayuḥ kṣayam । । 34 ।।
śrutvā'halyā tamuvāca tiṣṭhā''hṛyāmi vārdharam ।
āhutyā jaladaṃ tatra sasmāra drutamānasā । 35 । ।
meghā mṛtyubhayodvignāstūrṇaṃ tatra samāyayuḥ ।
prakampantaḥ pratasthuśca tānāha gautamapriyā । । 36 ।।
re re meghā ghātakāḥ stha kiṃ prālayo vicāritaḥ ।
jalānāmupasaṃhāraṃ kurvantu drāṅ na cenmṛtāḥ । । 37।। ।
bhayaṃkaraṃ tu tacchrutvā kampamānāstu tāṃ satīm ।
prāhurmātarna no doṣo doṣastvindrasya vidyate । । 38 ।।
vayaṃ tu kiṃkarāstasya varṣāmo vai tadājñayā ।
trastāḥ śāntāḥ pariśrāntā jalahīnāḥ krudhā'pi nu । । 39।।
vajreṇa nihatāḥ sarve varṣāmo'tra kṣamasva naḥ ।
sadā'kiṃcitkarāścendranideśakṛtajīvanāḥ । । 1.375.40 ।।
na tadājñāṃ vinā kiṃcit kartuṃ śaktāḥ sma sādhvike ।
iti śrutvā ca meghānāṃ vacanāni mahāsatī । । 41 । ।
indraṃ sasmāra mantreṇa vahnimadhye juhāva ca ।
tāvadindrāsanādindraḥ patito mantrakarṣitaḥ ।।42। ।
vyomamārgeṇa tu śīghraṃ parṇakuṭyāṃ samāpatat ।
mṛto'haṃ nāśito'haṃ ca rakṣantu devatāgaṇāḥ ।।43 ।।
iti bruvan parṇakuṭyāṃ tasthau sādhvīpratāpataḥ ।
natvovāca mahāsādhvī mahendraṃ devabhūbhṛtam ।।44।।
are cendra! pṛthivyāṃ vai prāṇināṃ kadanaṃ mahat ।
jātaṃ vṛṣṭyā'nayā kasmāt। saṃhāraṃ na karoṣi vai ।।45 ।।
jalasaṃhāramevā'dya śīghraṃ vai rodhanaṃ kuru ।
anyathā te vahnimadhye kariṣye havanaṃ sura! ।। 46 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa mahākruddhaḥ kintu dṛṣṭvā pativratām ।
vināśaṃ kṣaṇamadhye ca samupasthitamīkṣya ca ।।47 ।।
samayaṃ taṃ pravijñāya namratāyāḥ purandaraḥ ।
provāca vai tadā meghān śīghraṃ kurvantu rodhanam ।।48 ।।
meghāḥ saṃkucitāstatra himādrau ca tathāpi vai ।
jalānāṃ nimnatā nāsīt tadā prāha pativratā ।।49 ।।
indra! meghāḥ! gire! gaṃge! kathaṃ nāvataranti vai ।
nimnagāni na dṛśyante jalāni pravadantu mām । ।।1.375.50।।
indraḥ prāha mahāsādhvi! varuṇo vāriṣu sthitaḥ ।
sa saṃkocaṃ jale kuryāt syurniṃmnagāni vai tadā ।।5 1 ।।
sasmāra tu tadā sādhvī varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim ।
jalādhidevarūpaṃ ca tāvatso'pi samāgataḥ ।।5 2।।
prāhā'halyā jaleśaṃ taṃ naiva paśyasi mardanam ।
kīdṛśo'yaṃ layo jātaḥ saṃkocaya jalāni vai ।।5 3 ।।
anyathā te bhavenmṛtyurvahnau nātra vicāraṇā ।
tāvatso'pi drutaṃ natvā prāṇāyāmāँścakāra ha । ।54।।
tāvajjalāni saṃvegājjātāni ghaṭṭakāni hi ।
nimnagāni babhūvuśca saṃkucitāni sarvataḥ ।।55।।
atha dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitān vai mṛtān sambandhibāndhavān ।
dayāvatī tadā'halyā vahniṃ papraccha jīvanam ।।56।।
mṛtānāṃ vai punaścātra bhavedupāya ucyatām ।
vahniścendro varuṇaśca gaṃgā meghāśca parvataḥ ।।57।।
sarve prāhuryamarājo jīvā'jīvaprado mataḥ ।
ahalyā taṃ prasasmāra samāyāto yamastadā ।।58।।
samuvāca prāṃjalistāṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ me'tra sādhvike! ।
tamuvāca satī śīghraṃ jale'tra pralaye'tige ।।59।।
mṛtān manuṣyān vanino gṛhiṇo'raṇyavāsinaḥ ।
paśūṃśca prāṇinaḥ pakṣijātīścānyān sarīsṛpān ।।1.375.6 0।।
sarvānakālānidhanān samujjīvaya madbalāt ।
yadi nojjīvayeścādya tava mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ।।61 ।।
hoṣyāmi tvāṃ tṛṇamātraṃ śīghraṃ jīvaya vai mṛtān ।
so'pi cakampe yamarāṭ provāca dīnamānasaḥ ।।62।।
ahaṃ rudrādhīnasattvaḥ saṃkarṣaṇānugaḥ sadā ।
maraṇaṃ vai tadadhīnaṃ yathākarma ca dehinām ।।63 ।।
satī sasmāra rudraṃ taṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca tatkṣaṇāt ।
kālakālau samāyātau satīṃ natvā hyupasthitau ।।64।।
satī prāha mṛtānsarvānujjīvayatāṃ ceśvarau ।
anyathā pātivratyena hariṣye vāṃ prajīvanam ।।65।।
rudraḥ saṃkarṣaṇaścāha sṛṣṭiḥ puṣṭirvināśanam ।
bhavatyeva kramāttvatra nārāyaṇavinirmitam ।।66।।
vayaṃ kartuṃ tathā'kartumanyathākartumityapi ।
na samarthā bhavāmo'tra samarthaḥ śrīhariḥ paraḥ ।।67।।
satī sasmāra ca tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
pātivratyapratāpena haristatrā''yayau kṣaṇāt ।।68।।
hariṃ prāha satī natvā mahāvinayamānasā ।
aho nārāyaṇa! svāmin! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa! prabho! ।।69।।
mahāvṛṣṭilaye cātra koṭiśaḥ prāṇino mṛtāḥ ।
mānavāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣijātayo jantavastathā ।।1.375.70 ।।
jīvayaitān hare kṛṣṇa tvakālamṛtyumāsthitān ।
bhagavāँstāṃ tadā prāha kuru saṃkalpameva ha ।।71 ।।
yadi dharmaḥ pātivratyātmakaḥ saṃpālito mayā ।
tadā vṛṣṭipravegena mṛtā jīvantu jantavaḥ ।।72।।
ityājñayā harestatra tayā'halyākhyayā kṛtaḥ ।
saṃkalpastāvadevaite jīvitā dehino'khilāḥ ।।73 ।।
teṣāṃ yatra śavānyāsaँstatra tatra samutthitāḥ ।
āsamudrapraparyantaṃ yāvanto jīvitāstadā ।।74।।
tāँstu haryājñayā gaṃgā meghāścendrādayaḥ surāḥ ।
himādriḥ salileśaśca rudraḥ saṃkarṣaṇastathā ।।75।।
nārāyaṇo yamaḥ kālo mṛtyuśca pārṣadā hareḥ ।
sarvānnītvā yathāpūrvasthānaṃ teṣāṃ gṛhāṇi ca ।।76।।
prāpayāmāsureveśāḥ pātivratyaprabhāvataḥ ।
surūpāṃ susamarthāṃ tāṃ navayauvanasundarīm ।।77।।
natvā sarve yayurdevāstato naijālayāँstadā ।
januṣā jīvitā ye jātāḥ sukhina eva te ।।78।।
indro dṛṣṭvā mumohā'tra gautamasya tu yoṣiti ।
pativratāyāṃ devendro dūraṃ gatvā''jagāma ha ।।।79।।
tadā dṛṣṭvā'pi paścāttāṃ nā'paśyad devarāḍ yataḥ ।
yayau nirāśaḥ svargaṃ vai punaḥ kālāntare'gamat ।।1.375.80 ।।
tadāpi parṇakuṭyāṃ tāṃ sthitāṃ naiva dadarśa saḥ ।
yato malinahṛdayo na dadarśa pativratām ।।81 ।।
punargatvā tataḥ svargaṃ kālāntare sa āyayau ।
tadāpi tāṃ parṇakuṭyāṃ naivā'paśyat sthitāmapi ।।82।।
pāpānāṃ cā'pyaśuddhānāṃ malinā'guṇaśālinām ।
nāryaḥ pativratāḥ kvāpi nā''yānti dṛṣṭigocaram ।।83 ।।
evamindro bahuvāraṃ samāgato gato'pi ca ।
dharṣaṇārthamahalyāyāḥ kampamāno'pi mūrchitaḥ ।।84।।
kāmāndho na vijānāti mṛtyuṃ svasya parasya ca ।
tataḥ kālāntare rātrau samāyāto bhuvastalam ।।85।।
yatrā''ste sā dharmamayī sādhvyahalyā pativratā ।
tatra rātrau tvandhakāre paritaḥ prāsaranmahat ।।86 ।।
tejo dṛṣṭaṃ mahendreṇa gautamasyā''śramā'bhitaḥ ।
so'vātaratpṛthivyāṃ vai tejaḥ paśyati kevalam ।।87।।
yathā vai pūrṇimācandrakaumudīmaṇḍalaṃ nvidam ।
tatrā'halyāṃ na cā'paśyat punarnākaṃ yayau tadā ।।88 ।।
candrāya kathayāmāsa mānasīṃ vikṛtiṃ tathā ।
tejomayaṃ divyarūpaṃ bhogyāhaṃ ciravāñchitam ।।89 ।।
candreṇā''veditaṃ tasmai bhavān gautamarūpadhṛk ।
ahaṃ bhavāmi brāhmasya sūcakaḥ kukkuṭaḥ khalu ।।1.375.90 ।।
gacchāvo yatra sā cāste kurvaṃśchadmaṃ phalaṃ bhavet ।
na bhaveccedbhavenmṛtyurnātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।।91 ।।
iti sammantrya tāvāstāṃ tadā biḍālakukkuṭau ।
ardharātrottaraṃ gatvā gautamasya gṛhāntikam ।।92।।
jagau tu kukkuṭaścandro brāhmamuhūrtakūjanam ।
gautamastattadā śrutvā yayau snānāya svarṇadīm ।।93 ।।
biḍālastu mahendro vai praviveśa gṛhe nalāt ।
dhṛtvā gautamarūpaṃ sa jagāma śayane priyāḥ ।। 94।।
ahalyā tu patiṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmabhāvena cāgatam ।
cūmbanaṃ tvarpitavatī kāmabhogehayā''dṛtā ।।95।।
tāvattu gautamāya dyunadyā drāk saṃprabhāṣitam ।
na brāhmo'yaṃ ṛṣe! kālo gṛhe te kapaṭaṃ bhavet ।। 96।।
yāhi śīghraṃ satīṃ paśya śrutvaitat gotamo drutam ।
samāyāt svagṛhaṃ yāvattāvadbhoktuṃ sthitaṃ harim ।।17।।
indraṃ svarūpamāpannaṃ dadarśa kapaṭānvitam ।
gautamastaṃ turāṣāhaṃ bhagalubdhaṃ vibhāvya vai ।।98।।
muniḥ śaśāpa śakraṃ ca bhagāṃgastvaṃ bhaveti hi ।
ahalyā'pi jñātavatī patyanyaṃ taṃ tathāpi sā ।। ।। 99 ।। ।
patipratimārūpaṃ taṃ na śaśāpa pativratā ।।
nā''liṃganaṃ dadau yāvad gautamā'nyaṃ viveda sā । । 1.375.100 । ।
gautamāya svarūpāya daṇḍayogyāya cāpi sā ।
samarthāpi mahādaṇḍaṃ na dadau patirūpiṇe ।। 101 ।
patireva samāyāti jānāti gautamaḥ svayam ।
yāvannā''liṃganaṃ kurve tāvad daṇḍaṃ pradāsyati ।। 102 । ।
iti kṛtvā tadā'halyā patirūpā'timāninī ।
na dadau śāpamindrāya pratirdaṇḍaṃ dadau svayam । । 103 । ।
indro yonisahasrāḍhyo yayau svargaṃ malānvitaḥ ।
candro guptatayā tasmād dudrāva bhayavihvalaḥ ।। 104 । ।
gautamaḥ svāṃ tadā patnīṃ prāha saumye! kimicchasi ।
nātirūpaṃ sukhadā tu nārīmattvaṃ ca duḥkhadam ।। 105 । ।
tvaṃ priye! dharmamūrdhanyaṃ pālayasyeva sarvathā ।
ahaṃ taptumanāḥ śaśvat dvayoḥ sāhyaṃ na saukhyadam ।। 106 । ।
yadi tyajāmi vairāgyād duḥkhitā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
yadi rakṣāmi matpārśve cintedṛśī hi jāyate ।। 107 ।।
tasmād vada priye! tvāṃ vai kiṃ karomi yathā punaḥ ।
mama cintā na te dharmavighno mā ca bhavetpunaḥ ।। 108 । ।
iti patyuḥ satī śrutvā patiṃ prāha pativratā ।
nivasāmi sadā svāmin! sthālyāmatrā''tmapārvatī ।। 109 । ।
tathā tavā''sanarūpā hyupalā saṃvasāmyaham ।
nityaṃ tavā''śritā svāmin! tvayā'dhiṣṭhitabhūmikā ।। 1.375.11 0 । ।
bhavāmi tena te cintā na syānna dharmavighnatā ।
pātivratyaṃ sadā me ca rakṣitaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 111 । ।
samuddhāraśca vai svāmiṃstava yogādbhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā sā patiṃ natvā'bhiṣiktā svāminā drutam ।। 112 । ।
babhūva hyupalā tatra patipādāśrayā sadā ।
patiḥ prāha dayitā svāṃ rāmaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।। 113 । ।
āgamiṣyati cātraiva viśrāntiṃ yāsyati tvayi ।
tadā mayā saha patni! vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam ।। 114 ।
tāvattatra mano'bhīṣṭaṃ tapaḥ karomyahaṃ sadā ।
nirāśino mahāśāntirmama te ca sadā'tra vai ।। 115 । ।
āśāvantaḥ sadā duḥkhasāgarābdhau nimajjitāḥ ।
pāraṃ yānti na saṃsārivāsanānāṃ kadācana ।। 116 । ।
muktiḥ pāṣāṇakalpā ca priye! vighnādivarjitā ।
tvayā labdhā patisevā śilāsanamayī sadā ।। 117 ।।
ahaṃ sthāsye śilāmūrdhni kariṣye'tra tapaściram ।
tretāyāṃ rāmayogena yāsyāvaḥ paramaṃ padam ।। 1 18।।
divyarūpeṇa tu sādhvi! dvitīyena sadā mama ।
sevāyā susthirā bhūtvā vartasvedaṃ mamepsitam ।। 11 9। ।
ityukto sā'bhavattatropalā'halyā pativratā ।
svāmī tasyā upalāyāṃ tepe tu gautamastapaḥ ।। 1.375.120 ।।
tretāyāṃ rāmayogena matau tau paramaṃ padam ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tvahalyaiśvaryamadbhutam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pātivratyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhavet ।। 121 । ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyāṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye'halyāyāḥ pātivratyapratāpenā'tivṛṣṭau kāśīsamplave gaṃgāhimādrimeghendravaruṇarudrasaṃkarṣaṇayama-nārāyaṇādyāgamo'tivṛṣṭiśamanaṃ mṛtānāṃ jīvana-mindrasyā'halyāsparśamātre bhagāṃgatā'halyāyā
upalātvaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 375।।


← adhyāyaḥ 375 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 376
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 377 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pātivratyaṃ sītāyāścāpi kīdṛśam ।
patyarthaṃ jīvanaṃ datvā duḥkhaṃ tvājanma vai mahat ।। 1 ।।
anubhūya mahāraṇye rākṣasādigṛhādiṣu ।
ante pṛthvyāṃ nimagnā'bhūllakṣmīrūpā'pi sā satī ।। 2 ।।
kuśadhvajasya sā poṣyā kanyā dharaṇikukṣijā ।
dhanurbhaṃgaṃ tu rāmo vai kṛtvā tāṃ pariṇītavān ।। 3 ।।
sāketākhyanagaryāṃ vai nṛpaḥ śatamakho'bhavat ।
tasya putraḥ śātamakhī rāmādityo babhūva ha ।। 4 ।।
narādityastu tadbhrātā dyuvarṇāto babhūva ha ।
brahmaṇā prārthito viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।। 5 ।।
vāsudevo'bhavad bhūmau rāmā''dityo'tidhārmikaḥ ।
dyavarṇāyāṃ ca bhagavāँstretāyāṃ prathame'bhavat ।। 6 ।।
viśvāmitrapreṣitastu rākṣasānāṃ vadhāya saḥ ।
narādityena sahitaḥ prayayau ṛṣiṇā saha ।। 7 ।।
dṛṣṭvā pāṣāṇarūpāṃ tāṃ gautamenā'pyadhiśritām ।
pativratāmahalyāṃ vai svamārge divyanetrakaḥ ।। 8 ।।
viśvāmitraṃ tu papraccha kāraṇaṃ jagadīśvaraḥ ।
pūrvavṛttaṃ tadā śrutvā rāmo bhuvanapāvanaḥ ।। 9 ।।
divyarūpeṇa tāṃ jñātvā patisevāparāyaṇām ।
pasparśa pādāṃgulibhiḥ sā babhūva tu padminī ।।1.376.1 0।।
sā ca rāmāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā prayayau svāminā saha ।
vimānena paraṃ lokaṃ satyaṃ svapatisaṃśritā ।। 11 ।।
śubhāśiṣaṃ dadau rāmādityāyā'pi tu gautamaḥ ।
agre vāmanapādāँ'kapāvanaṃ bhūsthalaṃ tataḥ ।।1 2।।
dadarśa rāmastatraivā'luṇṭhad rajodhṛtīcchayā ।
pāvanaṃ tu rajo dehe tatra pramṛdya bhāvataḥ ।। 1 3।।
viśvāmitrāśramaṃ gatvā hatvā mārīcarākṣasam ।
gatvā tu mithilāṃ śaṃbhudhanurbhaṃgaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 14।।
cakāra pāṇigrahaṇaṃ sītāyā lakṣmi! tatra ca ।
kṛtvā vivāhaṃ bhagavānayodhyāṃ prayayau mudā ।। 15।।
rājā putraṃ nṛpaṃ kartumiyeṣa kṛtasādaram ।
taptatīrthodakaṃ tūrṇamānīya munipuṃgavān ।। 16 ।।
kṛtādhivāsaṃ rāmārkaṃ sarvamaṃgalasaṃyutam ।
dṛṣṭvā tu kalahānāmnī rā×Vr̤M×jñī pūrvavacobalāt ।। 17।।
vārayāmāsa rājānaṃ pūrvamaṃgīkṛtaṃ varam ।
rāmasya vanavāsaṃ ca rājatvaṃ svasutasya vai ।। 18।।
ayogyasyāpi tasyaiva kālaheyasya sarvathā ।
varaṃ dātuṃ mahārājo neyeṣa nyāyamārgagaḥ ।। 1 9।।
rāmārkastaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha dharmasatyānvitaṃ sudhīḥ ।
taḍāgaśatadānena yatpuṇyaṃ tu tato'dhikam ।।1.376.20 ।।
vāpīdānena loke'tra labhyate mānavaiḥ pitaḥ! ।
daśavāpīpradānena yatpuṇyaṃ ca tato'dhikam ।।2 1 ।।
yajñenaikena labhyeta sarvathā mānavairbhuvi ।
śatayajñaprapuṇyena yatsukhaṃ ca tato'dhikam ।।22।।
putrā''syadarśanenā'tra labhyate karmabhūmiṣu ।
darśane śataputrāṇāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ ca tato'dhikam ।।23।।
satyasya pālanād rājan labhate puṇyavāñjanaḥ ।
nahi satyāt paro dharmo nā'nṛtātpātakaṃ param ।।।24।।
nāsti dharmātparo bandhurnāsti dharmātparaṃ dhanam ।
satyadharmātparaḥ ko vā svadharmaṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ ।।25।।
svadharme rakṣite rājan śaśvatsarvatra maṃgalam ।
yaśasyaṃ supratiṣṭhāṃ ca pratāpaḥ pūjanaṃ param ।।26 ।।
caturdaśābdaṃ dharmeṇa tyaktvā gṛhasukhaṃ bhraman ।
vanavāsaṃ kariṣyāmi satyasya pālanāya te ।।27।।
kṛtvā satyaṃ tu śapathamicchayā'nicchayā'thavā ।
na kuryātpālanaṃ yastu bhasmāntā tasya niṣkṛtiḥ ।।28। ।
kuṃbhīpāke pacyate sa yāvadvai brahmaṇo dinam ।
tato mūko bhavet kuṣṭhī mānavaḥ saptajanmasu ।।29।।
ityuktvā pitarau natvā dhṛtvā jaṭāṃ savalkalām ।
yāvad gacchatyaraṇyaṃ sa rāmādityo narārkayuk ।।1.376.3 0।।
sītā pativratā cāpi pratasthe svāminā saha ।
rāmārkastāṃ jagādedaṃ priye tiṣṭhā'tra vā''vraja ।।3 1 ।।
duḥkhāni bahulānyeva vane santi pade pade ।
tvamaśaktā'si soḍhuṃ tānyakhilāni tu jānaki! ।।।3 2।।
sītā prāha kumārāṃgī patiprāṇā patipriyā ।
patidharmaparā sādhvī pātivratyasurakṣiṇī ।।33।।
janakenā'rpitā tubhyaṃ nā'nyasmai tvarpitā'smi vai ।
patyājñā pālanīyā me dharmo'styeva tathāpyaham ।।34।।
prārthayāmi kṛpāsindho! tvāṃ vinā maraṇaṃ dhruvam ।
mamā'tra syād gatirnaiva bhavenme matpatiṃ vinā ।।।35।।
araṇye maraṇaṃ śreyaḥ patyuḥ sānnidhyameva me ।
patiṃ vinā gatirnāsti patnīnāṃ pāralaukikī ।।36।।
aihikī ca gatirnaiva vidyate patimantarā ।
sukhaṃ sukhe duḥkhe duḥkhaṃ prasanne tu prasannatā ।।37।।
kṣudhite kṣudhitā sādhvī tṛpte tṛptā satī bhavet ।
svārthānandaparā pakṣapātinī narakaṃ vrajet ।।38।।
patibhāgyena saubhāgyavatī bhavati sādhvikā ।
patihīnā sapatikā sajīvāpi mṛtaiva sā ।।39 ।।
nārī pārśvaṃ svāmino'sti cārdhaṃ sā'haṃ tavā'smi tu ।
na viyoktuṃ tu yogyā'haṃ svargaṃ me patireva yat ।।1.376.40।।
duḥkhinaṃ svāminaṃ tyaktvā sukhaṃ vāñcchati svairiṇī ।
pativratā mahāsādhvī duḥkhabhāgān pravindati ।।41 ।।
sarvasvasya pradānena yadi svāmī sukhī bhavet ।
prāṇairdehena vā nāryā sukhanīyaḥ patiḥ sadā ।।42।।
rakṣaṇīyaḥ patirnāryā dehaṃ vikrīya vā''padi ।
dhanaṃ yaute gataṃ kṛtvā rakṣyaḥ svāmī suyoṣitā ।।43।।
svāmī svasyāḥ paraṃbrahma dharmaḥ svāmī sukhaṃ vidhiḥ ।
sarvaṃ svāmī na cānyo vai sukhayogaḥ kathaṃcana ।।44।।
tasmānmayā prabhoḥ chāyārūpayā cānunītayā ।
sahaiva sarvadā stheyaṃ nātra stheyaṃ kathaṃcana ।।45।।
yatra patistatra svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
rājyaṃ sampat parā smṛddhirdharmaḥ śṛṃgāra ityapi ।।46 ।।
patiṃ vinā gṛhaṃ rājyabhavanaṃ pherurāḍgṛham ।
bhogyānyapi ca sarvāṇi viṣatulyāni sarvathā ।।47।।
na svargaṃ svargamevoktaṃ patiḥ svargaḥ sadā striyāḥ ।
na vrataṃ vratamatroktaṃ patireva vrataṃ striyāḥ ।।48।।
na dharmo dharma evoktaḥ patirdharmaḥ sadā striyāḥ ।
dānaṃ japastathā pūjā saubhāgyaṃ śāntireva ca ।।49।।
svāmipārśvasthitapatnyāḥ sarvaṃ siddhyati nānyathā ।
na phalaṃ labhate svāmiśūnyā proṣitabhartṛkā ।।1.376.50।।
paśya kānta! striyā bhāgyaṃ patyau deśāntaraṃ gate ।
nistejastvaṃ bhavatyevotsāhaśaktivivarjitam ।।51 ।।
patiśūnyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ rājyaṃ vai muṇḍikāsamam ।
patiyuktā parṇakuṭī māhendrapadato'dhikā ।।52 ।।
nāryā vanaṃ vanaṃ naiva bhavanaṃ bhavanaṃ na vai ।
vanaṃ sapatikaṃ svargaṃ niḥsvāmibhavanaṃ vanam ।।53 ।।
dehaḥ sapatiko divyo patiśūnyaḥ śavātmakaḥ ।
na bhūṣā bhūṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ patireva hi bhūṣaṇam ।।54।।
apatikā''bhūṣaṇāni gaṇikāṃ khyāpayanti tām ।
jalaṃ cānnaṃ cā'mbarāṇi saubhāgyadravyamaṃjanam ।।55।।
patiyuktaṃ satejaskaṃ tvanyathā dūṣaṇapradam ।
tasmātpatnyā sadā sārdhaṃ vastavyaṃ svāminā prabho ।।56।।
patiṃ pārśve vinā patnī vināśāya hi kalpyate ।
mā me nāśo bhavet kānta! viyuktāyā gṛhe'tra vai ।।57।।
tathā kṛpāṃ parāṃ kartuṃ tvamevā'rhasi keśava! ।
ityuktvā sāśrunetrā sā dhṛtavalkalavastrakā ।।58।।
hārdaṃ rāmasya vijñāya sajjā'bhūd gamanāya vai ।
rāmaḥ prāha vane sādhvi! kṣudhā'sahyā bhaviṣyati ।।।59।।।
sītā prāha gṛhe svāmin kṣudhā me na śamiṣyati ।
rāmaḥ prāha vane sādhvi tṛṣā mṛtyu nayiṣyati ।।1.376.6 0 ।।
sītā prāha gṛhe svāmiँstvattṛṣā mārayiṣyati ।
rāmaḥ prāha vane kānte! sihādyaistvaṃ mariṣyasi ।।6 1 । ।
sītā prāha gṛhe kāntaviyogo māṃsamatsyati ।
rāmaḥ prāha vane patni! cātapo'sūn hariṣyati । ।6 2 ।।
sītā prāha gṛhe rāmavirahāgnirjvaliṣyati ।
śaityāgnirvanikaḥ śreṣṭho gṛhaśaityāgnimānataḥ ।।6 3 ।।
rāmaḥ prāha vane daityaḥ kadācittvāṃ hariṣyati ।
sītā prāha tadā rāmo dhyeyakāryo bhaviṣyati ।।64। ।
rāmaḥ prāha tato nā'yaṃ sakalaṃkāṃ grahīṣyati ।
sītā prāha tadā satyāḥ dharmaḥ prakāśameṣyati ।।65।।
rāmaḥ prāha tataḥ paścādviyogaṃ satī ceṣyati ।
sītā prāha tataḥ sītā vaikuṇṭhe yogameṣyati ।।66।।
rāmaḥ prāha śarīreṇa sukhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na vai bhavet ।
sītā prāha tvayā sākaṃ duḥkhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na vai bhavet ।।67।।
rāmaḥ prāha vane sīte! duḥkhadā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
sītā prāha gṛhe tyaktvā'tyatiduḥkho bhaviṣyasi ।।68।।
ardyamānā vane sītā kliśyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ।
patyādhārā duḥkhaśabdaṃ śvāse'pi na gadiṣyati ।।69।।
ānukūlyasya saṃkalpaṃ prātikūlyavivarjanam ।
sītā pativratā'raṇye sarvathaivā''cariṣyati ।।1.376.70।।
vahninā rakṣitā cā'tha rāmeṇā'pyanumoditā ।
chāyayā rākṣasaṃ kṣiptvā pātivratyamaviṣyati ।।।71 ।।
bhrāmayitvā sākṣarānvai rākṣasān chāyayā satī ।
sītā sitatvasaṃyuktā punā rāmaṃ miliṣyati ।।।72।।
chāyā vahnau vilīnā vai bhaviṣyati patīcchayā ।
dharmarakṣākaraṃ vākyaṃ matvā patyuḥ punaḥ satī ।।73।।
patyuḥ priyaṃkarī sītā satī saṃśikṣayiṣyati ।
gurvāśramo'thavā'raṇyaṃ svargaṃ mānyaṃ patīcchayā ।।74।।
patyurvākyaṃ paro dharmaḥ patiḥ śrīparameśvaraḥ ।
sītādvārā patī rāmo hatvā rākṣasakoṭikān ।।75।।
ājñāpayiṣyati patnīṃ hṛdi rakṣitumicchukaḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhe divyarūpā ca sākete hṛdayasthitā ।।76।।
janairadṛśyā sīte! tvaṃ sevāṃ kuru sadā mama ।
ityājñāṃ sā samāgṛhya dharaṇyāṃ vai pravekṣyati ।।77।।
tāmimāṃ jānakīṃ bālāṃ sākaṃ netuṃ tvamarhasi ।
ityuktvā vanavāsaṃ vai gantuṃ protsāhasaṃyutā ।।78।।
divyarūpā'bhavat sītā māyā mārgapradarśikā ।
agragā sā'bhavattatra rāmaḥ paśyati tāṃ tadā ।।79।।
mānuṣyā dṛśyatanvā tu rāmapṛṣṭhaṃ yayau satī ।
evaṃ sevakarūpo'sau narā''dityo'pi saṃyayau ।।1.376.80।।
prayayau tu vanaṃ rāmādityaḥ sītānarārkayuk ।
putraśokācchatamakhastatyāja svatanuṃ priye! ।।81 ।।
pālanāya pituḥ satyaṃ rāmo babhrāma kānane ।
kālāntare mahāraṇye bhaginī rāvaṇasya ca ।।82।।
dadarśa rāmaṃ kāmārttā brāhmaṇī rākṣasī hi tam ।
prāha śūrpaṇakhā rāma! rūpadhāma! gṛhāṇa mām ।।83।।
rāmaḥ prāha sabhāryo'hamabhāryaṃ gaccha me'nujam ।
ekapatnīvrataścā'haṃ duḥkhamanyāparigrahaḥ ।।84।।
śrutvā sā tu narādityaṃ māṃ bhajasvetyuvāca vai ।
narādityo brahmacārī tāmuvāca hi rākṣasīm ।।85।।
na me dāragrahaḥ kālo gaccha saumye! janāntaram ।
kruddhā śūrpaṇakhā prāha yadi tyajatho māṃ vṛthā ।।86 ।।
yuvayostu vipattirvai bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
mama śāpādayaṃ rāmo hṛtabhāryo bhaviṣyati ।।87।।
rākṣasīmityuktavatīṃ miṣaṃ vai rakṣasāṃ vadhe ।
kartuṃ śastreṇa ciccheda narārko nāsikāṃ striyāḥ ।।88।।
tannimittena vai caturdaśasahasrarākṣasān ।
narādityo yamamārge preṣayāmāsa saṃgare ।।89।।
śūrpaṇakhā tapaḥ kṛtvā kubjā jātā tapasvinī ।
kṛṣṇaṃ prāpa patiṃ sā vai vedhovaramavāpya yat ।।1.376.90।।
atha śūrpaṇakhā siṃhalākhyaṃ dvīpaṃ jagāma ha ।
tannṛpaṃ rāvaṇaṃ sā vai jagāda ceṣṭitaṃ hareḥ ।।91 ।।
rāvaṇo'pi śūrpaṇakhāvākyāt krodhitamānasaḥ ।
jñātvā sītāṃ satīṃ hartuṃ cakre tu mānasaṃ dṛḍham ।।92।।
mandodaryā tasya patnyā niṣiddho rāvaṇo bahu ।
paranāryāstatra pativratāyāstu pradharṣaṇam ।।93 ।।
sarvathā nāśaphalakaṃ mā yāhi siṃhaleśvara! ।
evaṃ saṃprārthitaścāpi sītāṃ jahāra māyayā ।।94।।
rāmaḥ sugrīvasāhāyyo varaṃ datvā hanūmate ।
datvā'ṅgulīyakaṃ viśvāsasthānaṃ vānareśvaram ।।।95।।
hanūmān prayayau vyomnā siṃhaladvīpameva tu ।
aśokakānane sītācchāyāṃ dadarśa śokitām ।।96।।
nirāhārāmatikṛśāṃ rāmanāmajapasthitām ।
rūkṣajaṭābhārayutāṃ dhyāyamānāṃ patiṃ prabhum ।।97।।
praṇamya mātaraṃ ratnāṅgulīyakaṃ dadau jagau ।
rāmasandeśamevā'tha bhasmīcakāra siṃhalam ।।98।।
rāmadūtaṃ ca sovāca sāśrunetrā pativratā ।
aye! jīvati me rāmo macchokārṇavadāruṇāt ।।99।।
api me kuśalī nātho na śokena hataḥ prabhuḥ ।
api jātā vane tasya svāmino duḥkharūpigī ।। 1.376.100 ।।
madarthe kati duḥkhaṃ vā samprāpa sa madīśvaraḥ ।
kimāhāraśca kiṃ bhuṃkte mama prāṇā'dhikaḥ priyaḥ ।। 101 ।।
api drakṣyāmi taṃ rāmaṃ samudrāntikamāgatam ।
api sevāṃ kariṣyāmi pādapadme punaḥ prabhoḥ ।। 1 02।।
patisevāvihīnāyā mūḍhāyā jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।
ayi! me dharmaputrastu narādityaḥ prajīvati ।। 1 03।।
macchokasāgare magno devakalpastu devaraḥ ।
hanūmāँstāṃ sarvanirāmayaṃ vijñāpya cāmbarāt ।। 1 04।।
prayayau kathayāmāsa rāmādityaṃ satīvratam ।
sa ca vānarasainyaiśca setuṃ badhvā yayau hariḥ ।। 1 05।।
siṃhalādhipatiṃ hatvā cakre sītāpramokṣaṇam ।
yayau puṣpakayānena sāketaṃ sītayā saha ।। 106 ।।
vijayasyotsavaṃ kṛtvā sītāṃ kṛtvā tu vakṣasi ।
jahaturvirahajvālāṃ sītā rāmārka ityubhau ।। 1 07।।
babhūvatū rāmaputrau dhārmikau ca kuśīlavau ।
vālmikasyāśrame jātau sūryavaṃśakarau śubhau ।। 1 08।।
sītā tu dharaṇau magnā sāketapattane tataḥ ।
varṣadvādaśasāhasraṃ rāmo rājyaṃ cakāra ha ।। 1 09।।
tato yātaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhaṃ dharmaṃ saṃsthāpya bhūtale ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! sītācaritramuttamam ।। 1.376.11 0।।
pātivratyaparaṃ krūrāraṇyarākṣasapīḍitam ।
śrīrāmacaritaṃ tvetad bhuktimuktipradaṃ sadā ।। 111 ।।
na jāto rāmasadṛśo dayālurdhārmikaḥ śuciḥ ।
na ca janiṣyate paścāt kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vinā ।। 11 2।।
nāpi sītāsamā patnī duḥkhaṃjīvā pativratā ।
bhaviṣyati svāmijīvā na jātāpi śrutā'parā ।। 113 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śatamakhadyuvarṇāputravadhvāḥ sītāyā rāmādityena saha vanavāsakaṣṭādikaṃ patyarthameveti pātivratyadharmaparatvamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 376 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 376 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 377
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 378 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! svayaṃ rādhā golokasthā haripriyā ।
putrīṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā gaṃgāṃ sarasvatīṃ ca padmikām ।। 1 ।।
prāha dharmān pātivratyaparān prabhāṃ śivāṃ tathā ।
śṛṇvantu ca sutāḥ sarvā dharmān vadāmi śāśvatān ।। 2 ।।
strīṇāṃ dharmāḥ pātivratyaṃ nā'smātparo'sti kaścana ।
tatra bhuktirmahāmuktirātmānandaśca śāśvataḥ ।। 3 ।।
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca tyāgināṃ gṛhiṇāmapi ।
vidhavānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ strīṇāṃ ca sarvathā ।। 4 ।।
putrāṇāṃ cāpi kanyānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ bhṛtyaśālinām ।
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ prajānāṃ sarvathā sutāḥ! ।। 5 ।।
dhyānapūtā sadā nārī kurute patisevanam ।
nityaṃ bhuṃkte tatprasādaṃ kṛṣṇe nivedya sarvathā ।। 6 ।।
viṣṇuprasādabhoktrī ca jīvanmuktā satī bhavet ।
nityaṃ tapasyāniratā śuddhā śāntā dhiyā yutā ।। 7 ।।
vratatīrthāśritā nārī sarvadā'sti pativratā ।
viṣṇumantraṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā sadgurusevanam ।। 8 ।।
prāpyā''śiṣo guroḥ śiṣyā sampadyate pativratā ।
gurvājñā tu sadā pālyā sarvaṃ tasmai nivedayet ।। 9 ।।
sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ pitā cāsti mahān guruḥ ।
pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇaḥ suraḥ ।। 1.377.10 ।।
mantradaḥ sadgurustatra surāṇāṃ vai caturguṇaḥ ।
nārāyaṇaśca bhagavān guruḥ pratyakṣa īśvaraḥ ।। 11 ।।
patireva gururdevaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।
pratyakṣabhoktā svaguruḥ svayaṃ dehī janārdanaḥ ।। 1 2।।
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgurureva svayaṃ śivaḥ ।
gurau patyau sarvadevāstiṣṭhanti satataṃ mudā ।। 13 ।।
gurau tuṣṭe haristuṣṭastasmiँstuṣṭe ca devatāḥ ।
guroḥ pādodakaṃ pītvā tīrthasnātā bhavet satī ।। 14।।
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokāya kalpate ।
sā snātā sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitā ।। 15।।
patipādodakairyā strī hyabhiṣekaṃ svayaṃ caret ।
gaṃgājalād daśaguṇaṃ śālagrāmajalaṃ śubham ।। 16।।
tato'pi daśadhā śreṣṭhaṃ patipādodakaṃ matam ।
nityaṃ yā sevate patnī jīvanmuktā suropamā ।। 17।।
sādhvīnāṃ nityakṛtyaṃ tu svāmiprasādabhojanam ।
yatnena pūjanaṃ tasya tatpādodakasevanam ।। 18।।
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni patipādodake priye! ।
tiṣṭhanti patnikāsevāphalasiddhyai hi sarvadā ।। 1 9।।
patipādodakaklinnā yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī ।
tāvatpatnī mahālakṣmīsvarūpā pūjyate suraiḥ ।।1.377.20 ।।
svāmiprasādabhoktrī vai pavitrāṃ kurute mahīm ।
tīrthāni ca prajāścāpi jīvanmuktā yato hi sā ।। 21 ।।
patiṃ prati padā gacched vratānāṃ phalabhāginī ।
pade pade'śvamedhasya labhate sā phalaṃ satī ।। 22।।
vahnivāyusamā pūtā tejasā bhāskaropamā ।
vaikuṇṭhe modate paścātpatyā ca hariṇā samam ।। 23 ।।
viṣṇumantropāsikā yā vaiṣṇavī patisevinā ।
na hi tasyāḥ parā devī pāvanī vidyate bhuvi ।। 24।।
harerbhaktā mahāsādhvī svāmisevāparāyaṇā ।
vaiṣṇavī yā bhavettasyā mukhānnārāyaṇeti vai ।। 25 ।।
nirgalitaṃ harernāma mantrarūpaṃ prajāyate ।
yasya karṇaṃ viśet so'pi mahāpūtaḥ prajāyate ।।26 ।।
bhittvā brahmāṇḍamakhilaṃ sopi yāyāddhareḥ padam ।
pūrvānsapta parānsapta sapta mātāmahādikān ।।27।।
sodarānuddharedbhaktā tatprasūँ tatprasūprasūm ।
aikāntikī vaiṣṇavī tu puṃsāṃ lakṣaṃ samuddharet ।।28।।
vayohīnā jñānahīnā vidyāhīnā'pi sarvathā ।
jātihīnā kriyāhīnā pātivratyaparā yadi ।।29।।
sarvaśreṣṭhā ramātulyā koṭidharmānvitā hi sā ।
uddhārayati lokāँśca pātivratyabalātsatī ।।1.377.3 0।।
vayohinastathā'lpāyurjñānahīno'pyapaṇḍitaḥ ।
vidyāhīno jātihīno mūrkhānmūrkho'tipātakī ।।3 1 ।।
anāśramī yaśohīno rogī vyādhisamanvitaḥ ।
nirvaṃśo vaṃśahīnaśca bhāryāhīno daridrakaḥ ।।32।।
viṣṇubhaktivihīnaśca dharmakarmādivarjitaḥ ।
udāsīno durācāro dhanahīno'pi mānavaḥ ।।33 ।।
satyāḥ pativratāyāśca sādhvyā āśīrvayobalaiḥ ।
svargaṃ sveṣṭaṃ sukhasmṛddhiṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prapadyate ।।34।।
sannyāsārjanamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet ।
patisevāpralābhena nārī nārāyaṇī bhavet ।।35।।
pūrvakarmāṇi dagdhvā ca parakarmanikṛntanam ।
kurute sadhavā sādhvī gacchati harimandiram ।।36।।
sannyāsināṃ padasparśāt sadyaḥ pūtā dharā yathā ।
satīnāṃ tu padasparśāttathā pūtā vasundharā ।।37।।
sadyaḥ punanti tīrthāni vaiṣṇavī vai pativratā ।
pativratānāṃ vacanānniṣpāpā jāyate prajā ।।38।।
pativratāṃ bhojayitvā tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।
natvā tāṃ bhāvato dṛṣṭvā rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।।39।।
phalaṃ sannyāsināṃ tulyaṃ yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।
pativratānāṃ sādhvīnāṃ vaiṣṇavīnāṃ sadā sutāḥ ।।1.377.40।।
brāhmaṇī patihīnāpi bhavenniṣkāminī sadā ।
ekabhuktā dinānte sā haviṣyānnaratā bhavet ।।41 ।।
na dhatte divyavastraṃ ca gandhidravyaṃ sutailakam ।
srajaṃ ca candanaṃ cāpi śaṃkhasindūrabhūṣaṇam ।।42।।
sadā'rājasavastrā syānnityaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ bhajet ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāṃ kuryāttu nityameva sā ।।43 ।।
tannāmoccāraṇaṃ putryaḥ! kuryācca bhaktitaḥ sadā ।
putratulyaṃ ca puruṣaṃ paśyed vaidhavyadharmataḥ ।।44।।
na tathā'dyācca miṣṭānnaṃ kāmavṛddhikaraṃ tu yat ।
vaibhavānnopayuñjyācca patiṃ nārāyaṇamṛte ।।45।।
sāpi pativratātulyā patikṛṣṇaparāyaṇā ।
śṛṇuyāttu satāṃ dharmān guroḥ sevāṃ samācaret ।।46।।
pātivratyaparā sādhvī mucyeta bhavabandhanāt ।
putryaḥ śṛṇuta sādhvīnāṃ kartavyaṃ pravadāmi vai ।।47।।
nityaṃ tu bhartaryautsukyāt hṛdā stheyaṃ tu yoṣitā ।
tasya pādodakaṃ bhaktyā bhoktavyaṃ tadanujñayā ।।48।।
vrataṃ tapasyāṃ devārcāṃ kuryātpatikṛtā''jñayā ।
kuryāccaraṇasevāṃ ca stavanaṃ paritoṣaṇam ।।49।।
patyājñārahitaṃ kāryaṃ kuryānnaiva pativratā ।
nārāyaṇādadhikaṃ vai kāntaṃ dhyāyettu vai satī ।।1.377.50।।
parapuṃsāṃ rajobhāvaprasaṃgaṃ nā''caret satī ।
yātrotsavaṃ nartanaṃ ca gāyanaṃ krīḍanaṃ tathā ।।51 ।।
patyarthamācaret sādhvī nānyārthaṃ vai kadācana ।
yadbhakṣyaṃ svāmino nityaṃ sādhvīnāṃ tu tadeva vai ।।52।।
na tyajetpatisaṃgaṃ sā sādhvī sevāparāyaṇā ।
