anyathā vāsanāvattve nidhane'dhogatirdhruvā ।।3 3।।
ityuktā sā satī sādhvī natvā patyuḥ prapādayoḥ ।
aho bhāgyamahobhāgyaṃ patyustoṣaṃ karomi vai ।।34।।
gaṇikāṃ prāpnuyāt svāmī yathā tadvai karomyaham ।
patnī sadbhāgyayuktā sā bodhyā puṇyakarī tathā ।।35।।
yā''diṣṭā svāminā tuṣṭyai drāk tuṣṭiṃ pradadāti sā ।
yayā svāmī bhavet tuṣṭaḥ sevā sā netarā kvacit ।।36।।
ityuktvā prayayau sādhvī pṛṣṭvā patiṃ tu tadgṛham ।
gaṇikāṃ pādayornatvā prāha sādhvī priyaṃ kuru ।।37।।
mama patyurasi mānyā smaratyaharniśaṃ svasaḥ! ।
tvāmeva hṛdaye dhyātvā vipro nidrāṃ karoti na ।।38।।
ahaṃ te kiṃkarī bhūtvā kariṣye te'tisevanam ।
raṃjaya me patiṃ śreṣṭhe yadicchasva dadāmyaham ।।39।।
ityuktā sā brāhmaṇasya papraccha nāma vai dhanam ।
sarvamāveditaṃ tasyai sādhvyā sa gaṇikā tadā ।।1.391.40।।
sādhvī prāha prarugṇasya kathaṃ saṃgaṃ dadāmi vai ।
tathāpi dhanalobhena rañjayiṣye patiṃ tava ।।41 ।।
dehi nityaṃ śataṃ mudrā rājatīrniśithe'tra me ।
gṛhe tvānīya śayane kuru te tu patiṃ mama ।।42।।
nityaṃ kuṣṭhāktavastrāṇi kuṣṭhahastau tathetarat ।
tvameva kṣālaya cedvai dāsye kāmakriyāṃ tadā ।।43।।
dehi suvarṇabhūṣāśca kāmabhogaṃ karotu saḥ ।
ityādiṣṭā satī cātiprasannā'bhūt hṛdantare ।।44।।
tāvad dravyaṃ dadātyeva nītvā svaskandhayoḥ patim ।
saṃyojayati sundaryeṣṭayā gaṇikayā samam ।।45।।
bahubhirvāsaraiḥ svāmī tṛpto'bhūt kāmadevataḥ ।
patnīṃ prāha sati! te'stu satīloko'tra śāśvataḥ।।46 ।।
adyā'ntimaniśāyāṃ māṃ nītvā bhogaṃ prakāraya ।
paścāt tṛptaḥ sadā jāto necchāmi gaṇikāgṛham ।।47।।
ityuktā sā satī bhāryā skandhe nidhāya satpatim ।
rātrāvandhatamovyāptamārgeṇa gaṇikāṃ yayau ।।48।।
tāvanmadhye mahadvighnaṃ samutpannaṃ priye! śṛṇu ।
māṇḍavyākhyo maharṣirvai rātrau vṛkṣatale sthitaḥ ।।49।।
tatra tenaiva mārgeṇa corā rājadhanaṃ bahu ।
corayitvā nirgatāstān rājabhaṭāḥ samantataḥ ।।1.391.50।।
baddhvā rājagṛhaṃ ninyurmāṇḍavyaṃ jagṛhuśca te ।
pathi śūle tadā protamacauraṃ cauraśaṃkayā ।।51 ।।
māṇḍavyaṃ taṃ tathāvidhaṃ śūlamāropya kiṃkarāḥ ।
gatavanto gṛhaṃ naijaṃ māṇḍavyo duḥkhito'bhavat ।।52।।
pativratā suśīlā'tha skandhayoḥ kauśikaṃ patim ।
kṛtvā duḥkhārtamāṇḍavyaśūlaṃ spṛṣṭvā tamomaye ।।53 ।।
mārge yāvajjagāmā'sau tāvatskandhagataḥ patiḥ ।
māṇḍavyamatiduḥkhārtaṃ cālayāmāsa sa dvijaḥ ।।54।।
pādāvamarṣaṇāt kruddho māṇḍavyastamuvāca ha ।
sūryodaye mṛtistasya yenā'haṃ cālitaḥ padā ।।55।।
tacchrutvā prāha tadbhāryā sūryo nodayameṣyati ।
yadyahaṃ syāṃ patibhaktimatī svāmiparāyaṇā ।।56।।
patisevāprapuṇyena sūryamārgo nirudhyatām ।
etayā tu yathoktaṃ vai tattathaiva pravartitam ।।57।।
tataḥ sūryasya vai cāśvāḥ preryamāṇā api dhruvāḥ ।
sthairyamāptā jaḍībhūtā gatiṃ nāgre samālabhan ।।58।।
tataḥ sūryodayā'bhāvādabhavat satataṃ niśā ।
sā tu satī patiṃ nītvā veśyābhogaṃ pradāya ca ।।59।।
patiṃ tṛptaṃ kārayitvā yayau svasyā gṛhaṃ punaḥ ।
patiṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā kuṣṭhaṃ prakṣālya varṣma ca ।।1.391.60 ।।
svayaṃ snātvā patiṃ sugandhādyaiḥ sā'mardayattathā ।
vastrabhūṣāpuṣpamālādhūpadīpādi saṃdadau ।।6 1 ।।
dugdhapānaṃ dadau sādhvī sarvāṃ pūjāṃ cakāra sā ।
patistṛpto gṛhasmṛddhiḥ sarvā veśyāvaśaṃgatā ।।62।।
satī tvacintayallakṣmīṃ lakṣmīstatrā samāgatā ।
vanditā pūjitā satyā dadau cintāmaṇiṃ tataḥ ।।63।।
āśīrvādavaco datvā yayau lakṣmīrnijaṃ gṛham ।
satī cintāmaṇidvāro'racayaddhanadhānyakam ।।64।।
gṛhopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ bhūṣaṇāni ca mudrikāḥ ।
rasān divyāँstathā bhogān miṣṭānnajalavaibhavān ।।65।।
atha sūryā'nudayane tato devā bhayaṃ yayuḥ ।
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmustānūce padmasaṃbhavaḥ ।।66।।
pativratāyā māhātmyānnodgacchati divākaraḥ ।
pativratātapastejaḥ sūryatejo'dhikaṃ yataḥ ।।67।।
sūryasyā'nudayānnāśo martyānāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ।
sandhyāpūjārcananaivedyaṛtunāśanaṃ bhavet ।।68।।
devānāmṛṣivaryāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ cāpi bhojanam ।
vinā sūryodayaṃ luptaṃ bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।69।।
tasmāt pativratāṃ sādhvīṃ kauśikasya hi sevikām ।
prasādayata vai patnīṃ bhānorudayakāmyayā ।।1.391.70।।
ityājñāṃ brahmaṇo labdhvā devā munijanarṣayaḥ ।
yayustatra yatra kuṣṭhī tvāste patnyā samaṃ gṛhe ।।71 ।।
āgatā mlānavadanāḥ satkṛtāste hi yoṣitā ।
arcitā vanditāścāpi pṛṣṭāścāgamakāraṇam ।।72।।
sarve svāsanapādyādyaiḥ pūjitāḥ sukhahetave ।
vavandire satīṃ hetuṃ vinivedya punaḥ punaḥ ।।73।।
devi! māṇḍavyaśāpaste svāmine yatkṛto'dhunā ।
tvayā sūryā'nudayaścetyubhau vai lokanāśakau ।।74।।
kimatra devyā kartavyaṃ yathā lokahitaṃ bhavet ।
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā kuru sādhvi! yathā kāryadvayaṃ bhavet ।।75।।
patyāyuḥ sūryadevasyodgamaśca sukhado bhavet ।
māṇḍavyavacanaṃ cāpi yathā satyaṃ bhavettathā ।।76 ।।
atreḥ patnī tadā tatrā'nasūyā lokavanditā ।
kauśikasya gurupatnī suśīlāṃ prāha sā satī ।।77।।
śṛṇu putri! trayaṃ kāryaṃ yathā bhaved vadāmi te ।
devāstvatrāgatāsteṣāṃ prārthanā hitakāriṇī ।।78।।
kartavyā sarvathā mātrā tvayā cāpi mayāpi ca ।
brūhi dhṛtvā jalaṃ haste yātu sūryaḥ samudgamam ।।79।।
brūhi putri! devavaidyau kurutaṃ nirujaṃ patim ।
patyuḥ rogasya nāśo'tra patināśaḥ prakalpyatām ।।1.391.80।।
kāyākalpaḥ svāminaste nidhanaṃ parigaṇyate ।
yuvā divyasvarūpo vai devavat te patirbhavet ।।81 ।।
kṛtvādityodayaṃ rugṇaṃ patiṃ kāntaṃ prajīvaya ।
iti prasāditā patnī sūryodayamakārayat ।।82।।
patiṃ sūryasya putrābhyāṃ navaṃ devamakārayat ।
kṛtvādityodayaṃ caivaṃ svabhartāramajīvayat ।।83 ।।
kauśikaḥ sabalovīryaśaktibhṛto'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।
aśvinīsukumārābhyāṃ rasāyanena saṃskṛtaḥ ।।84।।
apūjayata sarvadevān visasarja tataḥ satī ।
siṣeve kāntikāntaṃ taṃ lebhe brahmasukhaṃ mahat ।।85।।
māṇḍavyo yamarājaṃ ca prāha me karmaṇaḥ phalam ।
yamaḥ prāha tvayā bālye pañcavarṣeṇa khelane ।।86।।
tṛṇaśukī praviddhā'bhūt tīkṣṇaśūlena mohataḥ ।
tatphalaṃ śūlavidhyatvaṃ labdhaṃ tvayā'tra mā śucaḥ ।।87।।
māṇḍavyastu tadā dharmaṃ prāha nyāyamayaṃ vacaḥ ।
pañcavarṣasya bālasya kāmacārasya sarvathā ।।88।।
dūṣaṇaṃ pātakaṃ daṇḍaḥ sarvaṃ nāstyeva bodha me ।
pitrostatpātakaṃ paścādarthaṃ daśasamā'vadhim ।।89।।
daśavarṣāttaraṃ śikṣā pātakaṃ cobhayaṃ bhavet ।
mama tatpātakaṃ nāsti kasmācchūle'bhiropitaḥ ।।1.391.90।।
tasmāt tvaṃ tatphalaṃ bhuṃkṣva bhava dharmaścaturyuge ।
tretādharmeṇa viddhastvaṃ dvāpareṇāpi viddhakaḥ ।।91 ।।
viddhaśca kalinā duḥkhamavāpsyasi gataḥ kṣitau ।
adharmaśūlaviddhasya śudratā te'stvaharniśam ।।92।।
iti śapto dharmarājaḥ śūlāttamavaropayat ।
kṣamāṃ yayāce śūlasya vṛṇaṃ dasreṇa nīrujam ।।93 ।।
sandhāya pūrayitvā ca yathāpūrvamakārayat ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! camatkāraparāyaṇam ।।94।।
pātivratyaṃ vrataṃ yatra pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ prajāyate ।
adharmo dharmatāṃ yāti yogaiśvaryādivat priye! ।।95।।
pātivratyaṃ mahaddharmaḥ pāvanaḥ sarvadehinām ।
dvijenā'nena vai pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ dīnasya duḥkhakṛt ।।96।।
ghātaṃ tenaiva ghātena kuṣṭhījāto'tra janmani ।
purā tena kṛtaṃ dānaṃ gaurīkanyātrayasya vai ।।97।।
tena puṇyena viprasya gehe patnī pativratā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktiḥ sukhaṃ bhavet ।।98।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye kuṣṭhinaḥ kauśikaviprasya gaṇikātṛṣṇasya gaṇikāyojanaṃ tatpativratayā suśīlayā kāritaṃ, māṇḍavyasya śūlasthasya pādaghaṭṭanena kauśikasya ravyudayapūrvaṃ nidhanamiti śāpe suśīlayā sūryasyā'nudayanaṃ kṛtam, tato devānāṃ prārthanayā suśīlayā śāpādinivṛttiḥ kṛtā, dharmasya tu pratidaṃḍarūpaṃ yugeṣu tattadyugadharmaviddhatvamiti ca nirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 391 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 391 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 392
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 393 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ākarṇaya mahāpadme lakṣmi! pāpavināśinīm ।
kathāṃ śāntikarīṃ ramyāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ mokṣakāriṇīm ।। 1 ।।
pūrve yuge mahāvīryaḥ śatrujinnāmabhūpatiḥ ।
babhūva yajñakṛt yatra tuṣṭā devāḥ savāsavāḥ ।। 2 ।।
tasya putro mahāvīryo babhūva devavīryavān ।
ṛtadhvaja itikhyāto vyomacārī sa yogirāṭ ।। 3 ।।
siddhibhiḥ sevitaḥ śaśvadvijñānaguṇasāgaraḥ ।
yasya nā'viditaṃ kiñcit pāṇḍityaṃ sarvato'dhikam ।। 4 ।।
tasya kīrtiṃ parāṃ śrutvā caturdaśastarā'dhipāḥ ।
ṛṣayo munayo nāgā āyānti darśanāya vai ।। 5 ।।
kasyacittvatha kālasya nāgalokānmahītalam ।
kumārāvāgatau nāgau putrāvaśvatarasya tu ।। 6 ।।
brahmarūpapraticchannau taruṇau priyadarśanau ।
darśanaṃ satkṛtiṃ kṛtvā yayatuścāgatau punaḥ ।। 7 ।।
evaṃ nityaṃ bahuprītyā''yayaturyayatuḥ sadā ।
sa ca tābhyāṃ nṛpasutaḥ paramānandamāptavān ।। 8 ।।
vinā tābhyāṃ na bubhuje na sasnau na papau madhu ।
na rarāma na jagrāha kiñcittābhyāṃ vinā sutaḥ ।। 9 ।।
api tau bahulaṃ kālaṃ kumārāgre hi ninyatuḥ ।
ekadā tatra pātāle pitā tau nāgabālakau ।। 1.392.1 0।।
papraccha martyaloke nau mitratā kena vartate ।
yatra yuvāṃ bahukālaṃ yāpayathaḥ suputrakau ।। 11 ।।
tāvūcatuḥ śatrujitaḥ putro nāmnā ṛtadhvajaḥ ।
rūpavānārjavopeto vidvānmaitro guṇākaraḥ ।। 1 2।।
prabhorbhaktaścātitheyastena copahṛtaṃ manaḥ ।
tadviyogena naustāta! na sukhaṃ jāyate'tra vai ।। 1 3।।
pitā prāha sa dhanyo'sti yasyaivaṃ guṇakīrtanam ।
parokṣasyāpi guṇibhiḥ kriyate dhanyajīvanam ।। 14।।
yasya mitraguṇān mitrāṇyamitrāṇi parākramam ।
kathayanti sabhādau vai putravāँstena vai pitā ।।15।।
tasya niṣpāditaṃ putrau kiñcittoṣāya cetasaḥ ।
madgṛhe yatsuvarṇādi ratnaṃ vāhanamāsanam ।। 16।।
yattvanyat prītaye tasya taddeyamaviśaṃkayā ।
upakārakṛto devāstasyecchanti sadonnatim ।। 17।।
āhatuśca sutau tāta! yāni ratnāni tadgṛhe ।
vāhanāsanayānāni bhūṣaṇānyambarāṇi ca ।। 18।।
tāni santi na trailokye jñānaṃ nānyatra tatsamam ।
ekaṃ tasyāsti kartavyaṃ tattvasādhyaṃ prabhuṃ vinā ।। 1 9।।
pitā prāha kimasādhyaṃ durlabhaṃ vyavasāyinaḥ ।
udyatānāṃ na tvagamyaṃ nā'prāpyaṃ divi ceha vā ।।1.392.20 ।।
tasmāt kathayata putrāvavagacchāmyasādhyakam ।
prāhatuḥ pitaraṃ putrau kadācid gālavo dvijaḥ ।।21 ।।
samāyayau śatrujitaṃ gṛhītvā turagottamam ।
prāhāśrame mama kaścid daityaḥ khādati prāṇinaḥ ।।22।।
tathā karoti vighnāni dhyāne maune ca me'pi saḥ ।
bhasmīkaromi kopena yadi tarhi tapaḥkṣayaḥ ।।23 ।।
rājñā tasmāddhi daityānāṃ nāśaḥ kāryo hi dharmataḥ ।
ekadā sa mayā rājan daityaṃ nirīkṣya duḥkhataḥ ।।24।।
niḥśvāsaḥ prahitastāvadvyomnaścāyaṃ turaṃgamaḥ ।
sūryeṇa preṣitaścāyāt trailokyā'hatasañcaraḥ ।।25 ।।
parvateṣu samudreṣu pātāleṣvanaleṣu ca ।
nityaṃ bhūvalayaṃ sarvamaśrānto'yaṃ cariṣyati ।।26 ।।
ataḥ kuvalayo nāmnā khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati ।
daityaṃ cainaṃ samāruhya ṛtadhvajo haniṣyati ।।27।।
putramājñāpaya rājan yathā dharmo na lupyate ।
sa tasya vacanād rājā taṃ vai putramṛtadhvajam ।।28 ।।
tamaśvaratnamāropya kṛtakautukamaṃgalam ।
apreṣayat muninā saha munyāśramaṃ yayau ।।29।।
ṛtadhvajaśca vighnāni nāśayāmāsa cāśrame ।
daityaḥ sa śaukaraṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā dharṣayitumṛṣim ।।1.392.3 0 ।।
āgatasta samālakṣya śīghramāruhya taṃ hayam ।
anvadhāvad varāhaṃ taṃ ṛtadhvajaḥ śarāsanī ।।3 1 ।।
bāṇāhato mṛgo dhāvan praviveśa mahāṭavīm ।
trastaḥ papāta vivare timiraughasamākule ।।32।।
tamanu rājaputro'pi hantuṃ papāta vājiyuk ।
varāho'dṛśyatāṃ prāpto rājaputrastu śobhitam ।।33 ।।
pātāle samapaśyadvai sauvarṇasaudhasaṃkulam ।
saprākāraṃ puraṃ riktamapaśyattad viveśa saḥ ।।34।।
tatra yoṣidvarā dṛṣṭā sā taṃ ninye gṛhāntaram ।
tasmai bhavanabhūmau vai paryaṃke sarvakāṃcane ।।35।।
darśayāmāsa yuvatīṃ kanyāṃ pīnapayodharām ।
bimbādharauṣṭhīṃ tanvaṃgīṃ nīlotpalavilocanām ।।36 ।।
raktatuṃganakhīṃ mṛdvīṃ svarṇavarṇāṃ śubhālakām ।
sā bālāpi rājasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śobhānvitaṃ tadā ।।37।।
mumoha kṣobhamāptā sā samaicchannṛpatiṃ patim ।
ṛtadhvajena saṃpṛṣṭā vṛttāntaṃ naijamāha sā ।।38।।
viśvāvasuriti khyāto divi gandharvarājakaḥ ।
tasyā'hamātmajā rājan nāmnā khyātā madālasā ।।39।।
pativratā patiprāṇā patyarthaṃ sarvadā sthitā ।
pratīkṣe matpatiṃ prāṇasamaṃ yogyaṃ hi mānavam ।।1.392.40 ।।
ahamudyānagā cā'saṃ puṣpārthaṃ tāvadeva mām ।
pātālaketurdanujo'pahṛtya nītavāniha ।।41 ।।
āgāminyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ matpāṇigrahaṇāya saḥ ।
samudyato'sti taṃ rājan vārāharūpamāśritam ।।42।।
kenāpi viddhaṃ bāṇaiśca munīnāṃ trāṇakāraṇāt ।
pracchannaṃ vartamānaṃ taṃ hatvā māṃ naya bhūpate ।।43 ।।
kastvaṃ ko'si vada śīghraṃ jñāto'pi tu viśeṣataḥ ।
svīyavṛttaprakāśena premapātraṃ bhaviṣyasi ।।44।।
devo daityo nu gandharvaḥ pannagaḥ kinnaro'pi vā ।
tat tvamākhyāhi yāvadvai yathā me'vitathaṃ manaḥ ।।45।।
tataḥ prasannaḥ kuvalayāśvaḥ ṛtadhvajo jagau ।
rājñaḥ śatrujitaḥ putro gālavāśramamāgataḥ ।।46 ।।
śaukararūpadaityasya mannārācahatasya ca ।
pṛṣṭhaṃ pradhāvya garte'tra pātāle patito'smyaham ।। 47।।
ṛtadhvajo'smi nāmnāhaṃ kuvalayāśva ityapi ।
ityetat kathitaṃ vṛttaṃ na devo'haṃ na dānavaḥ ।।48।।
na pannago na gandharvaḥ kinnaro na śucismite! ।
manuṣyo'smi tava rakṣāṃ kariṣye daityataḥ priye! ।।49।।
ityāśrutya tu kanyā sā prahṛṣṭā pulakāñcitā ।
yadarthaṃ nirmitā cā'haṃ so'yaṃ prāpto mumoda sā ।।1.392.50 ।।
prāha cainaṃ hṛdayaṃ me tvayi sthairyaṃ prapaśyati ।
jātismarāpya'haṃ rājaँstavaivā'smi smarāmi ca ।।51 ।।
candramevopaiti kāntiḥ samupaiti raviṃ prabhā ।
bhūtirdhanyaṃ dhṛtirdhīraṃ kṣāntirabhyeti sajjanam ।।52।।
gṛhāṇa māṃ priyāṃ kānta! śīghraṃ nāśaya rākṣasam ।
ṛtadhvajastadā prāha paravānahamasmi vai ।।53 ।।
kiṃ karomi vinā''jñāṃ tu pitrornā'smi tathākriyaḥ ।
satī madālasā prāha sādhayāmi piturvacaḥ ।।54।।
ityuktvā sā jalaṃ nītvā kare sasmāra tumburum ।
tumbururdrāk samāyāto natvā prāha satīṃ kutaḥ ।।55।।
smṛto'haṃ vad deveśi! sādhayāmi kṣaṇena tat ।
madālasā kulaguruṃ tumburumavadad guro! ।।56 ।।
tūrṇaṃ yāhi śatrujitaṃ nivedaya madālasām ।
ṛtadhvajaṃ patiṃ kartuṃ samicchatyanumodaya ।।57।।
tumbarurvyomamārgeṇa tvantardhānākhyavidyayā ।
śatrujitaṃ prati gatvā vinivedya hyudantakam ।।58।।
ājñāṃ tasya samāgṛhya pragṛhītasamitkuśaḥ ।
madālasāyāḥ samprītyā prāptastatra punaḥ kṣaṇāt ।।5 9 ।।
prajvālya pāvakaṃ hutvā mantravit kṛtamaṃgalām ।
kanyāṃ vivāhavidhinā dadau ṛtudhvajāya saḥ ।।1.392.6 0।।
jagāma tapase tumbururmuniḥ svāśramaṃ punaḥ ।
kanyā''ha tāṃ striyaṃ śāntāṃ kṛtārthā'smi varānane! ।।6 1 ।।
ājñāpaya ca māṃ mātargantuṃ patyurgṛhaṃ prati ।
kuṇḍalā sā tadovāca kṛtārthā syāḥ pativrate! ।।62।।
tīrthā'mbudhūtapāpā'pi bhavitrī nedṛśī yathā ।
saṃyuktā'nena saṃpūtā jātā saṃsāratāriṇī ।।63 ।।
kathayāmyatha nau kiñcat snehabhārapraṇoditā ।
bhartavyā rakṣitavyā ca bhāryā hi patinā sadā ।।64।।
dharmārthakāmasaṃsiddhyai bhāryā bhartṛsahāyinī ।
yatra bhāryā ca bhartā ca mithomitho'nuvartinau ।।65।।
tatra dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasyā'pyasti saṃgatiḥ ।
bhāryā tathaiva bhartāramṛte dharmādisādhane ।।66 ।।
mokṣārthe vā divi satye vairāje vā bhuvastale ।
na samarthā yato dharmacatuṣṭayamubhāśritam ।।67।।
devatāpitṛbhṛtyānāmatithīnāṃ ca pūjanam ।
naikena śakyate kartuṃ dāmpatyaṃ tatra kāraṇam ।।68।।
prāpto'pi cārtho manujairānīto'pi nijaṃ gṛham ।
kṣayameti vinā bhāryā kubhāryāsaṃśraye'pi vā ।।69।।
etanmayoktaṃ yuvayordāmpatyaṃ śāśvataṃ tathā ।
vardhatāmanayā sārdhaṃ dhanaputrasukhāyuṣā ।।1.392.70 ।।
tvaṃ tu kanye! madālase! tyaktvā patyurmadālasā ।
bhavā'nena ca kāntena sārdhaṃ svargād garīyasī ।।71 ।।
ityuktvā virarāmaiva ṛtadhvajo madālasā ।
kuṇḍalāṃ tāṃ pariṣvajya samāruhya turaṃgamam ।।72।।
utpapātā'mbaramārge daityā dṛṣṭvā vicukruśuḥ ।
kanyāratnaṃ yadānītaṃ hriyate hriyate divam ।।73 ।।
tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti jalpanto vavṛṣuḥ śarajālakam ।
ṛtadhvajo'pi ciccheda śarajālaṃ tu līlayā ।।74।।
tato'straṃ tvāṣṭramādāya cikṣepa prati dānavān ।
tena te dānavāḥ sarve sphuṭadasthicayāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।75।।
strīratnena saha tūrṇaṃ samāgacchat svakaṃ puram ।
praṇipatya ca tatsarvaṃ sa svapitre nyavedayat ।।76।।
pitā śrutvā''ha taṃ premṇā pariṣvajya suputrakam ।
satputreṇa tvayā putra! tārito'haṃ mahātmanā ।।77।।
bhayebhyo munayastrātāḥ kanyā'pi rakṣitā''hṛtā ।
yadupāttaṃ yaśaḥ pitrā dhanaṃ vīryamathā'param ।।78।।
tadvīryādadhikaṃ kuryād vardhayed yastu śaktimān ।
navaṃ niṣpādayatyenaṃ pravadanti narottamam ।।79।।
taddhanyo'smīdṛśaṃ putraṃ prāpyāha puṇyaśālinām ।
suślāghyo'smyadya saṃjātastvayā saddharmaśālinā ।।1.392.80।।
yaḥ svaparākramairhīnaḥ prajñādānavṛṣādibhiḥ ।
dhigjanma tasya yaḥ pitrā loke vijñāyate janaḥ ।।81 ।।
ātmanā khyātimān śreṣṭho madhyaḥ pitṛpitāmahaiḥ ।
mātṛpakṣeṇa mātrā ca khyātimeti narādhamaḥ ।।82।।
tatputra! dhanavīryaistvaṃ vivardhasva sukhena tu ।
gandharvatanayā ceyaṃ mā tvayā vai viyujyatām ।।83।।
iti pitrā ca mātrā ca priyamuktaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
gālavenarṣiṇā cāpi hyāśīrvādāḥ samarpitāḥ ।।84।।
putraśca bhāryayā sārdhaṃ rājyadharmān gṛhāśramam ।
pālayan vardhayan snehaṃ reme sādhvyā samaṃ sukhī ।।85।।
śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau praṇipatya madālasā ।
pativratā satī reme jātismarā svarakṣiṇā ।।86।।
evaṃ kāle bahutithe gate rājā punaḥ sutam ।
prāha gacchāśu viprāṇāṃ trāṇāya cara medinīm ।।87।।
aśvamenaṃ samāruhya bhramaṇaṃ kuru maṇḍale ।
durvṛttebhyo dānavebhyo munīnāṃ ca satāmapi ।।88।।
na syād bādhā yathā putra! rakṣaṇaṃ tvaṃ tathā kuru ।
sa tu pitruktarītyaiva cacāra medinīṃ muhuḥ ।।89।।
yamunāyāstaṭe daityaṃ tālaketuṃ dadarśa saḥ ।
vārāharūpadaityasyā'nujaṃ munisvarūpiṇam ।।1.392.90।।
sa daityaḥ prāha taṃ tatra pūrvavairamanusmaran ।
rājaputra! muniścāsmi yakṣye yajñena tatra ca ।।9 1 ।।
hiraṇyaṃ dehi me kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ tava yadvaram ।
rakṣa mamā''śramaṃ cemaṃ yāvadantarjale'pyaham ।।92।।
varuṇaṃ vaidikairmantrairabhiṣṭūyaimi cāśramam ।
ityuktavate munaye saḥ prādāt kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam ।।93 ।।
prāha sthāsyāmyatra tāvad yāvadāgamanaṃ tava ।
ityuktaḥ saḥ kapaṭarṣirdaityo mamajja vāriṇi ।।94।।
madālasāyāḥ pratyakṣamudgataścoktavān rudan ।
vīraḥ kuvalayāśvaḥ sa mamāśramasamīpataḥ ।।95।।
kenāpi duṣṭadaityena bhinnaḥ śūlena vakṣasi ।
mṛto dadau tu me kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇaṃ bhasmitaḥ sa ca ।।96 ।।
aśvaṃ jahāra daityaḥ saḥ sarvaṃ mayā'valokitam ।
gṛhāṇa devi! te bhūṣāṃ kriyatāṃ cottarakriyām ।।97।।
ityuktvotsṛjya tadbhūmau sa jagāma yathāgatam ।
madālasā tathānye ca śrutvā cakrurvilāpanam ।।98।।
nirgamya ca bahiḥsnātā daduḥ putrāya vāryapi ।
pativratā tu sañcintya vinā patimamaṃgalām ।।99।।
kṛtvā samādhiṃ hṛdye vahnimutpādya cāntaram ।
śarīraṃ vilayīkṛtya svargaṃ yātā hi sundarī ।। 1.392.100 ।।
vicinvānā patiṃ naijaṃ nā'vāpa tatra sā tataḥ ।
yamarājaṃ prati gatvā papraccha kvā'sti me patiḥ ।। 101 ।।
dharmarājastadā prāha jīvito'sti yamītaṭe ।
tava saṃjīvanārthaṃ ca pātāle tvatpatipriyaḥ ।। 1 02।।
suhṛnnāgastapaścaryāṃ karoti śaṃkaropari ।
tāvadadṛśyarūpā tvaṃ mama dharmālaye vasa ।। 103 ।।
iti sā coṣitā dharmabhavane cātra bhūtale ।
tālaketuḥ sa daityastu nirgatya yamunājalāt ।। 1 04।।
rājaputraṃ samuvāca kṛtārtho'haṃ tvayā kṛtaḥ ।
gaccha gṛhamidānīṃ tvamiti śrutvā sa taṃ ṛṣim ।। 1 05।।
praṇipatya samāruhya tvaśvaṃ prāyāt puraṃ svakam ।
janān dadarśodvignān prāk prahṛṣṭāsyāँstataḥ punaḥ ।। 1 06।।
aho vighnaṃ gataṃ tvasya vidyate jīvavānayam ।
mṛtyuvārtā mṛṣā jātā ciraṃ jīva kumāraka! ।। 1 07।।
iti śrutvā pauravācaḥ praviveśa piturgṛham ।
mumudire pitā mātā bāndhavāḥ suhṛdo janāḥ ।। 1 08।।
madālasāmanādṛṣṭvā papraccha pitaraṃ sutaḥ ।
jñātvā vṛttāntamaghaṭaṃ śuśoca kṣaṇameva saḥ ।।1 09।।
punaḥ sa cintayāmāsa parisaṃstabhya mānasam ।
mṛteti sā mannimittaṃ tyajāmi yadi jīvitam ।। 1.392.11 0।।
kiṃ mayopakṛtaṃ patnyā patinā pāralaukikam ।
ato'tra manye kartavyastyāgo bhogasya yoṣitaḥ ।। 111 ।।
tasyā muktiryathā syādvai tatkartavyaṃ japādikam ।
anyā bhāryā na kartavyā brahmacaryadhṛtā mayā ।। 1 12।।
yadi madālasā nātra bhāryā me'sti tato dhruvam ।
anyāyāśca patirnāsti patnīvrataḥ ṛtadhvaja ।। 11 3।।
tāmṛte mṛgaśāvākṣīṃ gandharvatanayāmaham ।
na bhokṣye yoṣitaṃ kāciditi satyaṃ vadāmyaham ।। 1 14।।
saddharmacāriṇīṃ patnīṃ tāṃ muktvā''haṃ pativratām ।
kāṃcinnāṃgīkariṣyāmītyetat satyaṃ vadāmyaham ।। 1 15।।
iti śrutvā putrayośca vacanaṃ nāgarāṭ svayam ।
tapaścaryāṃ parāṃ kṛtvā varaṃ prāpya ca śaṃkarāt ।। 1 16।।
ṛtadhvajāya dātavyā punā rājñī madālasā ।
yatra sṛṣṭau tu sā tvāste tasmādādāya sarvathā ।।1 17।।
iti pratijñāṃ kṛtavān putrāvāpṛcchya vai tataḥ ।
tīrthaṃ himavato gatvā tapastepe sudāruṇam ।। 1 18।।
aśvataraḥ sa nāgendrastuṣṭāva tapasā haram ।
prātarniśāyāṃ madhyāhne sandhyayoścāpi tatparaḥ ।। 11 9।।
tasya kālena mahatā prāheśo gṛhyatāṃ varaḥ ।
praṇamyā'śvataraḥ prāha varamenaṃ prayaccha me ।। 1.392.1 20।।
mṛtā kuvalayā'śvasya patnī sādhvī madālasā ।
tenaiva vayasā sadyo duhitṛtvaṃ prayātu me ।। 121 ।।
jātismarā yathāpūrvaṃ tadvatkāntisamanvitā ।
yoginī yogamātā ca madgehe jāyatāṃ satī ।।122।।
haraḥ prāha tathā'stvetat sarvaṃ te vai bhaviṣyati ।
matprasādādasandigdhaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuru tadicchayā ।। 123।।
bhakṣayethāḥ prasādaṃ ca tataste madhyamāt phaṇāt ।
samutpatsyati kalyāṇī patidharmā madālasā ।।1 24।।
sā tu sādhvī dharmarājabhavane'dya virājate ।
pratīkṣate punarjanma jātismaraṃ patiṃ punaḥ ।। 1 25।।
sā ca te bhāvinī putrī ṛtadhvajasya kāminī ।
ityuktvā śaṃkarastatra tirodadhe'tha sarparāṭ ।। 126 ।।
rasātale gṛhaṃ gatvā cakāra śrāddhamarpitam ।
piṇḍaṃ ca madhyamaṃ tadvad yathāvadupabhuktavān ।। 127।।
tāvattāṃ dharmarājo'pi prāha gaccha rasātalam ।
tatrā'śvataranāgeśaḥ smaratyeva suputrikām ।।1 28।।
bhava divyā manojanyā jātamātrā suyauvanā ।
varārohā sukanyā cā''pnuhi sveṣṭamṛtadhvajam ।। 129।।
ityuktā śrāddhataḥ paścāt sā''gatā ca janiṃ gatā ।
śuśubhe dvyaṣṭavarṣāvadyathāpūrvā hi sundarī ।। 1.392.130।।
pratīkṣate tu sā kāntaṃ tryavasthāsu madālasā ।
tadā sa nāgarāḍaśvataraḥ prāha svaputrakau ।। 131 ।।
sa rājaputro yuvayorupakārī mamāntikam ।
kasmānnānīyate vatsau dṛṣṭavyo'sti mamā'pi saḥ ।। 1 32।।
evamuktau sutau gatvā kṛtvā kiñcitkathāntaram ।
abrūtāṃ praṇayopetaṃ svagehagamanaṃ prati ।। 133।।
ṛtadhvajaḥ svakaṃ matvā samutthāya varāsanāt ।
pitaraṃ pādayornatvā yayau nāgapuraṃ saha ।। 134।।
tābhyāṃ nāgakumārābhyāṃ nagarī darśitā śubhā ।
kumāraistaruṇairvṛddhairuragairdivyavarṣmabhiḥ ।। 1 35।।
mohakṛnnāgakanyābhiḥ krīḍantībhiḥ suśobhitā ।
tataḥ ṛtadhvajastābhyāṃ praviveśa niveśanam ।। 1 36।।
dadarśa mitrapitaraṃ maṇikuṇḍaladhāriṇam ।
divyamālāmbarabhūṣaṃ surūpaṃ divyadevavat ।। 1 37।।
svacchamuktāphalalatāhārihāropaśobhitam ।
keyūriṇaṃ mahāśreṣṭhāsane sarvasukāñcane ।। 1 38।।
maṇividrumavaiḍūryajālāntaritarūpake ।
samāsīnaṃ suputrābhyāṃ ṛtadhvajāya darśitam ।। 139।।
rājaputro nanāmainaṃ mitrayoḥ pitaraṃ muhuḥ ।
rājaputraṃ balādgāḍha nāgendraḥ pariṣasvaje ।। 1.392.140।।
mūrdhni cainamupāghrāya ciraṃ jīvetyuvāca saḥ ।
nihatā'mitravargaśca pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ kuru ।। 141 ।।
vatsa dhanyasya kathyante matputrābhyāṃ tu te guṇāḥ ।
jīvitaṃ guṇinaḥ ślāghyaṃ jīvanneva mṛto'guṇaḥ ।। 142।।
devatāḥ pitaro viprā mitrārthibāndhavā'hitāḥ ।
svepare'nye tathecchanti jīvitaṃ guṇinaściram ।। 143 ।।
parivādanivṛttānāṃ durgateṣu dayāvatām ।
guṇināṃ saphalaṃ janma tvādṛśānāṃ nṛpātmaja! ।। 144।।
evamuktvā snāpayitvā śṛṃgārayitvā bhāvataḥ ।
madhupānādisaṃbhogān dāpayitvā'danaṃ tathā ।। 145।।
tarpayitvā'nnapeyādyairviśrāntiśayanaṃ dadau ।
sevārthaṃ nāgakanyāśca preṣayāmāsa nāgarāṭ ।। 146 ।।
pariśrānto'tha nṛpajaḥ suṣvāpa sukhanidrayā ।
sevayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kanyāḥ saṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।। 147।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śatrujitputrasya ṛtadhvajasya aśvataranāgaputrābhyāṃ mitratā, daivivājiprāptiḥ, gālavāśrame vighnakartāraṃ daityaṃ hantuṃ pātāle praveśaḥ, sa tatra nagare madālasāmapaśyat, pātālaketuṃ daityaṃ jaghāna, madālasāmudvahat, tumburuṃ kuṇḍalāṃ
cāpṛcchya svagṛhāgamanam, yamunātaṭe tālaketuṃ kapaṭinaṃ jaghāna, madālasāmaraṇam, kumāratapaścaryā, madālasāyā aśvataragṛhe'vataraṇam, ṛtadhvajamāhūya punarmadālasādānamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvānavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।3 92।।


← adhyāyaḥ 392 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 393
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 394 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha prātarnṛpaputraḥ ṛtadhvajaḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ ।
vādyaiśca gītibhiścāpi pātālākhyānakaistathā ।। 1 ।।
nāgakanyābhiratyarthaṃ miṣṭasvaraiḥ prabodhitaḥ ।
snāpito'mbaritaḥ śṛṃgārito'rcito vibhūṣitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
bhojitaḥ pāyitaścāpi susparśaiḥ raṃjito muhuḥ ।
vijñāpitaśca bahudhā ratnādigrahaṇāya saḥ ।। 3 ।।
rajataṃ vā suvarṇaṃ vā vastraṃ vāhanamāsanam ।
yadvā'bhimatamatyarthaṃ grahaṇārthaṃ niveditaḥ ।। 4 ।।
ṛtadhvajastadā prāhā'śvataraṃ nāgayoginam ।
tava prasādād bhagavan ratnādyasti gṛhe mama ।। 5 ।।
tāte varṣasahasrāṇi śāsatīmāṃ vasundharām ।
na nyūnaṃ vidyate kiñcitsvargamanyad gṛhe'sti me ।। 6 ।।
tatrāpi sāttvatānāṃ tu tṛṇavanmāyikaṃ khalu ।
tatra lubdhā janā nūnaṃ dhātṛmāyāsuvaṃcitāḥ ।। 7 ।।
tavā'nayā sumadhurayā vāṇyā satkṛtiśīlayā ।
kṛtakṛtyo'smi bhāvena saphalaṃ jīvanaṃ tu me ।। 8 ।।
pitrā vai jīvanaṃ sārthaṃ mātrā ca jīvanaṃ sukham ।
ārogyeṇa ca rājyena vṛddhānāṃ sevayā tathā ।। 9 ।।
tvādṛśānāṃ kṛpābhiśca jīvanaṃ sārthakaṃ mama ।
aśvatarastadā prāha gārhasthyaṃ bhāryayā sukham ।।1.393.1 0।।
tat tavāsti na vā saumya! vada kiṃ brahmavānasi ।
iti pṛṣṭaḥ samuvāca bhāryā mama pativratā ।। 11 ।।
sutā gandharvarājasya nāmnā khyātā madālasā ।
kenāpi kṛtavaireṇa vipralabdhā'tyajat tanum ।। 1 2।।
tata ārabhya loke me pratijñāṃ kṛtavānaham ।
nānyā bhāryā bhavitrī me varjayitvā madālasām ।। 13 ।।
ityārabhya sadā cāsmi brahmacaryavratānvitaḥ ।
brahmacaryeṇa vai lokā vairājāḥ santi nirmitāḥ ।। 14।।
muktiloko brahmacaryaparasyā'sti vinirmitaḥ ।
mānuṣasya janerlābhaḥ saṃhitāyāṃ prapaṭhyate ।। 15।।
sa lābho'sti madarthaṃ vā'pyekapatnīvratasya ca ।
aśvatarastadā prāha śṛṇu rājakumāraka! ।। 16 ।।
bhāgyena vardhase nityaṃ caikapatnīvratena vai ।
pātivratyena te patnī saubhāgyena pravardhate ।। 17।।
yā sā madālasā rājñī śrutvā patyurvināśanam ।
samādhinā layaṃ prāptā gatā svaryāmyakaṃ puram ।। 18।।
patimanveṣituṃ naijaṃ dharmarājaśca tāṃ jagau ।
patiste vartate sādhvi! jīvito yamunātaṭe ।। 1 9।।
yogāyā'śvatarastasya yatate tiṣṭha vai kṣaṇam ।
ityuktā soṣitā tatra mayā taptvā harātkhalu ।।1.393.20 ।।
varadānaṃ paraṃ prāpya putrīrūpā tava priyā ।
āsāditā divyarūpā jātamātrā sukāminī ।।।21 ।।
tādṛśī tava yogyā ca pūrvaṃ yādṛśyabhūddhi sā ।
tvadarthaṃ mānasī kanyā madgehe vartate satī ।।22।।
tubhyaṃ dānāya saumyā'tra mayā'sti niścitaṃ yataḥ ।
tasmāt paśyeha vatsa tvaṃ satīṃ ced draṣṭumicchasi ।।23।।
anugrāhyo bhavān gehaṃ bālo'pyabhyāgato guruḥ ।
ityuktvā tvānayāmāsa tasya putrīṃ madālasām ।।24।।
prāha seyaṃ na vā vatsa! bhāryā te yā madālasā ।
sa dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sammukhaṃ drāk hṛṣṭaromā babhūva ha ।।25।।
ruroda pūrvāṃ saṃsmṛtya premapūritamānasaḥ ।
aśvatarastadā kāmaphalaṃ baddhvā kare'sya vai ।।26 ।।
agniṃ prajvālya vidhivat kanyāratnaṃ dadau punaḥ ।
prāpya bhāryāṃ satīṃ so'pi yautakaṃ ca dhanaṃ bahu ।।27।।
nāgakanyāstathā'nyāśca dāsīrdāsāँśca sevakān ।
maṇīn hiraṇyabhūṣāँśca madālasāṃ navīkṛtām ।।28।।
pratilabhya praṇamyātha nāgeśaṃ śvaśuraṃ muhuḥ ।
śālakau dvau samāśliṣya śvaśrū natvā tathā'parān ।।29।।।
nirgataḥ svāyayau naijaṃ puraṃ yānena vāyunā ।
āgamya svapuraṃ pitrornatvā sarvamaśeṣataḥ ।।1.393.3 0 ।।
kathayāmāsa tanvaṃgī punaḥ prāptā yathā tathā ।
nanāma sā ca caraṇau śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ satī ।।3 1 ।।
anyāṃśca pūjayāmāsa yathānyāyaṃ yathāvayaḥ ।
tato mahotsavo jātaḥ paurāṇāṃ sarvathā priyaḥ ।।32।।।
ṛtadhvajaśca suciraṃ tayā reme sumadhyayā ।
atha kālena mahatā śatrujinmaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।।33 ।।
ṛtadhvajo'bhavadrājā patnīvrataḥ sudhārmikaḥ ।
madālasā'bhavad rājñī rājamātā pativratā ।।3 4।।
śatasāhasradāsīṣu satīṣvapi madālasā ।
lakṣmīvat svapatiṃ nityaṃ siṣeve'ṅgakriyādiṣu ।।35।।
patiṃ matvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpaṃ hariṃ prabhum ।
sampanmokṣakaraṃ nityasambaddhaṃ sevate sma sā ।। 36।।
bhojayitvā sadā bhuṃkte vastu samarpya sevate ।
yuṃkte sā ca svake kārye patiprāsādikaṃ sadā ।।37।।
prātardhyānaṃ hareḥ pūjāṃ dānaṃ cātmavimarśanam ।
atitherbhojanaṃ datvā svātmārthaṃ yukta eva sā ।।।38।।
brahmārpaṇaṃ brahmasevāṃ brahmadhyānaṃ tu sāttvatī ।
mahābhāgavatī sādhvī niṣpādya vartate pare ।। 39।।
divāniśaṃ harerlīlākīrtanaṃ sā karoti vai ।
anyān śrāvayati hareścamatkārān muhurmuhuḥ ।।1.393.40।।
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāḥ saṃjajñe prathamaḥ sutaḥ ।
tasya cakre pitā nāma vikrānta iti dhīmataḥ ।।41 ।।
tutuṣustena vai sarve jahāsa ca madālasā ।
yasyā brahmasvarūpāyāṃ harṣaśokau samau yataḥ ।।42।।
putraṃ tu vikramaṃ sādhvī bālamuttānaśāyinam ।
rudantamabhiśāntyarthamullāpanamiṣeṇa sā ।।43।।
smṛtvā hariṃ tathātmānaṃ nityaśuddhaṃ nirañjanam ।
putraṃ muktaṃ dehadharmahīnaṃ prāha madālasā ।।44।।
śuddhaḥ svayaṃ brahmasurūpavānasi
prakalpitaṃ nāma ca te'dya kṛtrimam ।
apūrvadehādikamāptavānasi
hyaśokano rodiṣi kasya śokavān ।।45।।
hānau sadā roditi dehadharmavān
sā na tvayi brahmanirañjane'sti vai ।
sadā'si pūrṇo nijatṛptisaṃbhṛtaḥ
sadā prataptasya kathe nu rodanam ।।46।।
āgantukā ye tu guṇāḥ sukhādayo
niyojayantyeva tadiṣṭavedane ।
tataḥ pravṛttau ca phale śubhā'śubhe
asāracakre hi muhuḥ kṣipanti te ।।47।।
śāntāśca ghorāśca tathā pramūḍhā
dehā viśeṣāḥ parivarttayanti ।
tadvegavegī guṇavegahīno
mamatvabhāk tāpavibharjitaḥ syāt ।।48।।
nānena dehena tu kiṃcidasti
prāptavyamarthaṃ na ca śāśvataṃ vā ।
yenā'sti labhyaṃ sa tu nityapūrṇaḥ
kathaṃ prapūrṇasya nu rodanaṃ te ।।49।।
labdhaṃ gataṃ sarvamanityametad
dṛṣṭaṃ mayā janmani cātra tatra ।
gatisvabhāvaṃ puru naśvaraṃ ca
śokāspadaṃ tvaṃ nahi tādṛśo'si ।।1.393.50।।
āste jalaṃ jāyate vardhate ca
santiṣṭhati kṣīyate nāśameti ।
ete tu dharmā hi bhūteṣu santi
na te kathaṃ kasya hānerhi śokaḥ ।।51 ।।
na te'sti vṛddhirna ca te'sti hāni-
stādṛksvabhāve'tra na kaṃcuke tvam ।
śokaṃ vrajethāḥ kuru cātmavittiṃ
naisargikānandamayīṃ praśastim ।।52।।
tāteti kiñcit tanayeti kañci-
dambeti kāṃcid dayiteti kāṃcit ।
mameti kiṃcinna mameti kiṃcid
bhūtātmakaṃ mā tvayi mānayethāḥ ।।53 ।।
bhogaḥ sadā miśrita eva vartate
miṣṭastathā'miṣṭa iti pratītitaḥ ।
vijñasya miṣṭe'pi na miṣṭatā'sti vai
mūḍhasya duḥkhe'pi na duḥkhatā'sti ca ।।54।।
ahaṃmametyasti kṛtaṃ navaṃ navaṃ
gataṃ gataṃ vakti na te'styahaṃmamaḥ ।
vṛthā mataṃ duḥkhakaraṃ hi bālyataḥ
śīrṇe vikāre'pi na tad viyāsyati ।।55।।
cakṣuśca karṇaśca sunāsikā ca
mukhaṃ radāstvak śravaṇaṃ manaśca ।
jihvā karau pat malamūtramārgau
nābhiśca nāmāni na te hi santi ।।56।।
kṣetrāṇi yadvat khalu mṛttikāyāḥ
sarāṃsi yadvat khalu sajalādyāḥ ।
svargāṇi yadvat khalu tejāadyāḥ
prāṇāśca vātā na hi te tvadīyāḥ ।।57।।
yathā'tra yāne bahumārgagāmini
sacetanastvaṃ surathī pragacchasi ।
tvadātmake divyacidambarā'nasi
tathaiva yantā'sti tamacyutaṃ smara ।।58।।
idaṃ vapurgatvarameva te ca me
pituśca tadvad gatameva tatpituḥ ।
yathaivaṃ bhūtaṃ sadṛśaṃ tu bhāvina-
statolabhasvā'ṅga! vapustu śāśvatam ।।59।।
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa! rādhikāpate!
ramāpate! mādhava! pārvatīpate! ।
lakṣmīpate! bhaktapate! prabhāpate!'
raṭāṃga! yacchāśvatamāpyase tanum ।।1.393.60।।
na te'sti nidrā na ca te'sti tandrā
na te'sti mātā na ca me'stiputraḥ ।
na te'sti bālyaṃ na ca me'sti vṛddhiḥ
kramā'kramau brahmaṇi te na me ca ।।6 1 ।।
ātmeti jānanparamātmasevako
hṛdācitā vā manasā ca vijñayā ।
ānandamagno'nubhave'parokṣake
kārṣṇaṃ rasaṃ cūṣati tṛptimaśnute ।।6 2।।
pṛthvyāṃ yathā santi sudolanāṃghrayo
doloparistaṃbhagatāḥ paṭāṃghrayaḥ ।
paṭāntarāle caraṇau tava sthitau
svadantare yaccaraṇau hi taṃ bhaja ।।63।।
amūrtake mūrta iva sthitaḥ prabhuḥ
saṃrakṣako mokṣada īśvareśvaraḥ ।
sa eva mātā ca pitā viśāladṛga
vikrāntanāmā'pi sa eva taṃ bhaja ।।64।।
ātmā'si mukto'si sadīśvaro'si
brahmā'si divyo'si sadāsukho'si ।
naro'si nārāyaṇarakṣito'si
nijasvarūpo'si bhajā'kṣareśam । ।65 ।।
vidvijñānamityuktaṃ krāntaṃ-kriyā matā tataḥ ।
jñānakriyāyutaścātmā vikrāntaṃ tvaṃ nijaṃ vada ।।66।।
vi-pakṣī tasya vai pakṣau saṃkalpaḥ śaktirityamū ।
saṃkalpaśaktipakṣābhyāṃ krāntastvaṃ svaṃ nijaṃ vada ।।67।।
viśca jñānendriyaṃ proktaṃ kraṃ ca karmendriyaṃ tathā ।
tayorantargataścātmā vikrāntaṃ tvaṃ nijaṃ vada ।।68।।
ātmānaṃ tvaṃ vijānīhi dehagehavilakṣaṇam ।
saccidānandameveśaṃ śokastvāṃ na spṛśet tataḥ ।।69।।
ityevaṃ prathamaṃ putraṃ bodhadānena sā satī ।
muktaṃ kṛtavatī bālye yogirājaṃ kṛtārthakam ।।1.393.70 ।।
vardhamānaṃ sutaṃ nityaṃ navaṃ nūtnaṃ prabodhanam ।
ātmajñānamayaṃ mātā dadātyullāpanādiṣu ।।71 ।।
nirahaṃkāratāṃ prāpto nirmamatvaṃ ca sarvathā ।
ātmabalaṃ paraṃ lebhe jñānaṃ lebhe ca sanmayam ।।72।।
mātā sā jananī saiva yayā bālo'tibodhitaḥ ।
muktimārgagataḥ syācca bandhādbhavācca mucyate ।।73।।
mātṛbhāṣāparibodhe tvātmabodhamavāptavān ।
itthaṃ mātrā sa tanayo janmaprabhatibodhitaḥ ।।74।।
dehasaukhyātigo jāto virāgo viṣayā'hataḥ ।
yauvane'pi na rāgātmā dveṣaścāsya na kutracit। ।।75।।
strīpuṃbhāve kuṇape'trā'nitye duḥkhe vināśini ।
bhogabuddhiranutpannā brāhmarūpeṇa vartinaḥ ।।76 ।।
rūpaṃ rasaṃ tathā gandhaṃ sparśaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ tathā ।
anātmīyaṃ paraṃ matvā na babandhāpi tatra vai ।।77।।
kāye puṣṭe bale jāte balaṃ pāṣāṇavanmatam ।
indriyāṇāṃ golakāni koṣṭhalānīva manyate ।।78।।
evaṃ rāgavihīnaḥ sa nirdvandvaḥ svasvarūpavān ।
cakāra na matiṃ prājño gārhasthyaṃ prati nirmamaḥ ।।79।।
svaśarīre'nahaṃkāro rājye'haṃkāravarjitaḥ ।
kṣetre hastini yāne ca vāhane rāṣṭrake tathā ।।1.393.80 ।।
snehabhāvavihīno'sau bandhanaṃ nā''ptavān kila ।
dāseṣu bhṛtyavargeṣu dāsīṣu nagarīṣvapi ।।8 1 ।।
bhavaneṣu vastrabhūṣā'tibhogyavastukeṣvapi ।
na vai cakre manaḥ kiñcinmuktavaryo yathā'bhavat ।।82।।
bhojane ramaṇe pāne khādye jaihvye'pi sarvathā ।
rasāsvādavihīno'sau yatirāḍiva lakṣyate ।।।83 ।।
ratnahārādibhūṣāsu gandhasugandhivastuṣu ।
dravadravyeṣu tailādau kajjalādau virāgavān ।।84।।
pradarśaneṣu mallānāṃ krīḍāsu vārayoṣitām ।
gītiṣu nartakīnāṃ ca nṛtyeṣu vimanā iva ।।।।85।।।
rājñāṃ samāje cotsāhe prajotsaveṣu keliṣu ।
araṇyādipravāse'pi mṛgayādau virāgavān ।।86 ।।
daṇḍadāneṣu hiṃsreṣu karmasu vyāhṛtau tathā ।
vyavahāreṣu ca krūranirdayeṣu virāgavān ।।87।।
brahmacarye tathā śauce santoṣe tapasi dhruve ।
svādhyāye devapūjāyāṃ sadā protsāhavānabhūt ।।88।।
satye sarvavidhe maune cā'steye mānase bahiḥ ।
aparigrahaṇe cāpi dhairye kāmādivarjane ।।89।।
guroḥ prasevane pitroḥ sevane vṛddhamānane ।
atithisvāgate bhaktadarśane mukta eva saḥ ।।1.393.90।।
śraddhāluḥ sarvadā cāste sarvathā cāstikaḥ kṛtiḥ ।
vivekī ca vimokāḍhyo brahmābhyāsaparaḥ sadā ।।91 ।।
satāṃ sevāparaścāpi sadā harikriyāparaḥ ।
kalyāṇakṛtprāṇināṃ ca harṣodvejanavarjitaḥ ।।92।।
evaṃ sanakatulyaḥ sa vyajāyata śiśutvataḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā sutaṃ mahāmuktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ samam ।।93 ।।
mātā cātīva jahṛṣe pitā'pyānandavānabhūt ।
prajā bhṛtyāstathā cānye menire devameva tam ।।94।।
aṇimā mahimā tvasya garimā laghimā tathā ।
prāptiḥ kāmāvasānā ca vaśiteśitvarūpiṇī ।।95।।
śabdauuhaścādhyayanaṃ duḥkhanāśāstrayastathā ।
suhṛtprāptirjñānadānaṃ tathā tārā sutārikā ।।96।।
sarvā āsan pādayośca siddhaḥ saḥ paramo hyabhūt। ।
apratihatakāmaḥ sa mukto babhau sujātavat ।।97।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye pātāle kṛtadhvajasya madālasālagnitasya pitṝājyaṃ pratyāgamanaṃ, vikramākhyaputrajanma, tasmai madālasākṛtavivekopadeśa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 393 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 393 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 394
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 395 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha lakṣmi! dvitīyaṃ suṣuve putraṃ madālasā ।
abhidhānaṃ pitā tasyā'karot subāhurityataḥ ।। 1 ।।
madālasā jahāsāpi nāmarūpavivarjite ।
nāmarūpaṃ prasahyaiva svārthalokena ropyate ।। 2 ।।
iyaṃ tu brahmavijñā taṃ bālamullāpanādibhiḥ ।
upādideśa nityaṃ vai yathāpūrvaṃ nirañjane ।। 3 ।।
śṛṇu putra! śarīraṃ te bālarūpaṃ vyajāyata ।
pūrvaṃ nāsīt tvadīyaṃ vai kathaṃ svīyaṃ pramanyase ।। 4 ।।
śīryate taccharīraṃ hi muhuḥ śītoṣṇasaṃbhṛtam ।
parādhīnakaraṃ nityaṃ sadā viśvāsaghātakam ।। 5 ।।
pitā pūrvasthitaiḥ klṛptastasya dhātuḥ śarīragaḥ ।
vinirgataḥ sa janmā'bhūd jalātmakasutasya vai ।। 6 ।।
garbhavāse syitastasyāyuṣyaṃ tu daśamāsikam ।
yadi tatra na tiṣṭhedvai tadā''yuṣyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ matam ।। 7 ।।
māsikaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ vā srāve nyūnā'ṣṭamāsikam ।
janmani labdhavatyeva cāyuṣyaṃ daśamāsikam ।। 8 ।।
tato'syā'jñānasaṃyuktaṃ cāyuṣyaṃ mūrchanāmayam ।
tato daśadināntaṃ ca sūtakātmakamucyate ।। 9 ।।
māsānte varṣataḥ pūrvamāyuṣyaṃ pāravaśyagam ।
varṣānte trivarṣapūrvamāyuṣyaṃ mātṛśikṣaṇam ।। 1.394.1 0।।
tataḥ śiśuḥ kumāraścā''dvādaśābdaṃ sa kīrtyate ।
tataḥ saumyastataḥ prauḍho yuvā cintāpradhānakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
vidhuro vā sadhuro bā caikalo dvau tato'dhikaḥ ।
śṛgālavat maṇḍalito'haṃmamatvasamāvṛtaḥ ।। 12।।
śatrumitrakuṭumbādiyaśolābhādisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
atasmiँstadvimantā'bhūddharṣaśokaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 13 ।।
putrapautrādisambaddhaḥ paśukṣetrādicintanaḥ ।
vaṃśavistārapāśena vāsanāmūlaropitaḥ ।। 14।।
jarjaritena dehena vārdhakyaṃ samanuṣṭhitaḥ ।
rogā'śaktyādisampannaḥ śārīrājñāvivarjitaḥ ।। 1 5।।
vātarogādibandhuścā'pathyā'vamānasevakaḥ ।
tiraskārādisammāno gantukāmo'pi rodhitaḥ ।। 16 ।।
mṛtaḥ prajvālitaḥ pretaḥ kvā''sītkutra gataḥ sa vai ।
tasmāt svapnaṃ yathā tadvad dehāyuṣyaṃ vivartate ।। 17।।
matvaivaṃ tvaṃ sadā putra nāmarūpavivarjitaḥ ।
saccidānandasaṃjño'si nityatṛpto nirāśayaḥ ।। 18।।
vartasvānandamātrāyāṃ mā vartasva vivartane ।
asāre nityaśuddhastvaṃ mā'śuddhiṃ mastake vaha ।। 1 9।।
śuklo'si sarvadā putra! mā kṛṣṇatvaṃ vahātmani ।
śuddhadarpaṇatulyo'si kalmaṣaṃ mā niveśaya ।। 1.394.2 0 ।।
ambeti kṛṣṇo janaketi kṛṣṇo-
'grajeti kṛṣṇo'hamameti kṛṣṇaḥ ।
bāleti kṛṣṇaḥ svapareti kṛṣṇaḥ
sarvasvakṛṣṇaṃ bhaja muktimehi ।।26 1 ।।
tejaḥ paraṃbrahma tamaḥ parabrahma
jñāna parabrahma cidambare'rpitam ।
duḥkha parabrahma sukha parabrahma
svaya parebrahmaṇi vartase'rbhaka! ।।22।।
na me'sti kiñcinna ca testi kiñci-
janūttaraṃ mānavakalpitaṃ hi tat ।
asaṃgabālasya na saṃgamāha
tīrṇo'si nityaṃ kuru cātmani śramam ।।23 ।।
śārīrayātrā ca yathā vinirvahet
tāvatparigrāhaka eva saṃbhava ।
tatrāpyasaṃgo bhava miṣṭayojanai-
rhareḥ prasādāmṛtamiṣṭamāvaha ।।24।।
śuddhe nije saccidi saukhyasaṃbhṛte
mā duḥkhayogān viniyuṃkṣva bandhadān ।
yathāsvarūpo viharasva vṛkṣake
samānake tricchidi yāvadastike ।।25।।
na te'sti bhāryā na ca te'sti saudho
na cāsti te hastisubhṛtyavāṭyaḥ ।
na cāsti sainyaṃ na ca rakṣako'nyo
vinā hariṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaṃ vai ।। 26 ।।
tvaṃ dehasaṃge'va satāṃ prasaṃgaṃ
tathā''tmasaṃge'va hareḥ prasaṃgam ।
iṣṭe'tisaṃge'pi prabhuṃ vidhehi
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamābhajasva ।। 27। ।
ityevaṃ sā mahārājñī bālamullāpanādibhiḥ ।
aśikṣayaccātmavidyāṃ so'pi mukto babhūva ha ।। 28 ।।
so'pyamanyata govindaṃ rakṣakaṃ bāhumeva ha ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇalabdhyā subāhu sva hi manyate ।। 29 ।।
natu dehasthabāhubhyāṃ subāhuḥ sa viniścitaḥ ।
mātā'pi taṃ mahāmuktaṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa vai hṛdi ।। 1.394.30 ।।
amanyata mahāsādhvī mātṛtvaṃ sārthakaṃ svakam ।
ātmapramāṇaṃ vijñānaṃ dadau yataḥ sutāya sā ।। 31 ।।
pāpāt pāti pitā bodhyo mātā pramāṃ dadāsi yā ।
tatsarvaṃ vartate rājñyāṃ madālasāyāṃ tṛptikṛt ।। 32 ।।
atha kālāntare tasyā jajñe putrastṛtīyakaḥ ।
rājā prāha ca taṃ putraṃ śatrumardanameva ha ।। 33 ।।
tadā cātiprajāhāsa nāma smṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ ।
taṃ cāpi sa satī mātā śikṣayāmāsa ciddhanam ।। 34।।
pālane ca yadā taṃ sā hyāndolayati sādaram ।
dugdhaṃ stanyaṃ tathā bhakṣyaṃ cośyaṃ lehyaṃ dadāti sā ।। 35 ।।
tadā tadā prasaṃgena śikṣayati sma prokṣaṇam ।
śṛṇu karṇena putra! tvaṃ nahi karṇo'sti cetanaḥ ।। 36 ।।
gṛhāṇedaṃ supeyaṃ tvaṃ mukhena jihvayā tathā ।
na jihvā na mukhaṃ cāsi tvaṃ sadā'si pracetanaḥ ।। 37 ।।
vada śabdaṃ paśya rūpaṃ kuru hāsyaṃ manoramam ।
na tvaṃ śabdo na vai cakṣurna cā'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ hyasi ।। 38 ।।
paśyedaṃ makṣikādaṃśakṛtaṃ daṃśādikaṃ tu yat ।
tad dehe'sti na tvayyasti dehastyadāśrito'sti vai ।। 39 ।।
tatroṣṇaṃ vā paraṃ śītaṃ kharjanaṃ viddhi raktakṛt ।
tvaṃ na raktaṃ na vā dadrurna ca carmā'sthikharjanam ।। 1.394.40 ।।
tvayā sthitena tatsarvaṃ jāyate ca vilīyate ।
na hrāsastena jātena na vā vṛddhirbhavet tvayi ।।41 ।।
pānaṃ peyaṃ kṣudhā tṛṭ ca bhojyaṃ cośyaṃ na vai tvayi ।
tvayā sthitena tatsarvaṃ deho'yaṃ samapekṣate ।।42 ।।
vinā tvāṃ na tanūrnaiva kṣuttṛḍvyāpta pravartanam ।
sarvaṃ layaṃ sameyādvai tasmāt tvaṃ sarvataḥ paraḥ ।।43।।
parārthaṃ gṛhavāṭyādi parārthaṃ jaladhānyakam ।
parārthaṃ cākṣuṣaṃ sarvaṃ yaḥ paraḥ sa tvadātmakaḥ ।।44।।
jananaṃ maraṇaṃ nityaṃ vyavasthaṃ dehavāsitam ।
avasthābhyaḥ parastvaṃ vai paramātmasamāśritaḥ ।।45।।
dehe tvaṃ ca tvayi kaścid yaḥ sa bodhyaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
pareśvarasamastvaṃ vai nityabuddho nirañjanaḥ ।।46 ।।
nityaśuddho nityasiddho nityavijño bhavātigaḥ ।
idaṃ tu pālanaṃ svapnaṃ lālanaṃ svapnamityapi ।।47।।
hasanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ svapnaṃ jāgrato bhava sarvathā ।
yoganidrā hareryoge sadā śāntipradā tava ।।48।।
bhoganindātmikā nidrā māyājālaṃ na sā tvayi ।
aviśuddhiḥ kṣayaścāpi smṛddhāvatiśayaśca yaḥ ।।49।।
asūyāmatsarerṣyādikalmaṣāḍhyā na vai tvayi ।
mukto nityaścātmasattaḥ pūrṇānando'si putraka! ।।1.394.50।।
yathā vastraṃ navaṃ prāptaṃ tyaktaṃ jīrṇaṃ prasahya vai ।
dinaṃ ca nūtanaṃ prāptaṃ gataṃ pūrvaṃ prasahya vai ।।51 ।।
prātargataṃ gataṃ sāyaṃ. gatā cāndramasī niśā ।
amāvasyāniśā māyā tāmasī cāpi te gatā ।।52।।
ghaṭamālānusāreṇa yadi sā te'ntikaṃ bhavet ।
ātmavidyunmaye divyaprakāśe'vatarā''tmavit ।।53 ।।
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho mado'bhimānakam ।
śatravaste nijabodhe tānpramardaya sarvathā ।।54।।
gatān vai mā'nvaśocastvaṃ vartamānān nivartaya ।
anāgatāṃśca mā dehyātithyasatkaraṇaṃ manāk ।।55।।
ātmajñānātikhaḍgena chinnāste cāntarārayaḥ ।
anudbhavāśca vā'puṣṭāḥ śuṣkāyante vinā jalam ।।।56 ।।
dehasya śatravo loke na vai cātmani śatravaḥ ।
ātmano mokṣaṇe vighnāḥ śatravaste prakīrtitāḥ ।।57।।
evaṃ tvaṃ cātmaśatrūṇāṃ bhūtvā sammardakaḥ pure ।
navadvāre praprākāre vartasva śubhavarjitaḥ ।।58।।
tataste sārthakaṃ nāma pitroktaṃ śatrumardanam ।
ityevaṃ bodhitaḥ so'pi mātrā putrastṛtīyakaḥ ।।5 9 ।।
bālyādeva sumukto'bhūd dvandvabhītivivarjitaḥ ।
yāne ca bhojane ramye bhogye bhoge'pyanātaraḥ ।।1.394.60 ।।
niṣtṛṣṇo nityatṛptaśca vartate sma nirantaram ।
gataṃ vighnaṃ gatā dvandvāḥ saṃsāro nāgataśca ke ।।6 1 ।।
hṛdye na samāviṣṭaṃ māyājālaṃ ca gatvaram ।
udayāstamayau nāsya bādhete muktivartini ।।62।।
svaprakāśe svakānande svātmatṛptau hi vartate ।
sanandanasamāno'yaṃ dṛśyate yogirāḍiva ।।6 3।।
dṛṣṭvā mātā prasannā'bhūnmātṛtvaṃ sārthakaṃ kṛtam ।
jalena rañjanāṃ naiti nodvegaṃ yāti vahninā ।।64।।
utsavena śamaṃ naiti viṣeṇa viṣamo na vā ।
sukhaduḥkhasamaḥ putraścāhaṃ dhanyā hi putriṇī ।।65।।
ityānandamayī nityā hariṃ bhajati sā satī ।
muktaṃ putraṃ samālokya muktimārgasthitā'bhavat ।।66 ।।
evaṃ putratrayaṃ lebhe jīvanmuktaṃ madālasā ।
brahmamadena jagati sālasā'bhūnmadālasā ।।67।।
evaṃ putratrayaṃ tvātmasattayā brahmatanmayam ।
kriyāścakāra niṣkāmaṃ na rājārthopakārakam ।।68।।
rājāpi bhaktarāṭ dṛṣṭvā putrān kṛṣṇāśritān śubhān ।
muktān brahmasvarūpāँśca teṣu tutoṣa sarvathā ।।69।।
pativratāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ tutoṣātyantameva ca ।
janmanā kiṃ yadi bandhāḥ putre'pi nihitāstadā ।।1.394.70।।
yastu bandhairāvṛtaśca kathaṃ pitṝn sa tārayet ।
patnī bandhanakartrī yā tayā kiṃ janmanaḥ phalam ।।71 ।।
uddhārayitrī yā bhāryā sā patnī satyatāriṇī ।
kuṭumbatāriṇī saiva tayā gārhasthyamuttamam ।।72।।
putro'pi tārakaḥ proktaḥ patnī tathaiva tārikā ।
satī patnī sutaḥ sādhustau matau bhavatārakau ।।73 ।।
dhanyo'haṃ dhanyarājyaṃ me dhanyā cāpi prajā mama ।
satsaṃgācca satīsaṃgāt tariṣyāmaḥ prajādayaḥ ।।74।।
yatra rājye bhaveyuśca sādhvyaḥ satyaḥ pativratāḥ ।
sutāśca sādhavo muktā vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra vidyate ।।।75।।।
dhigjanaṃ dhūrtabhāryāyāḥ patiṃ tātaṃ śaṭhasya ca ।
dhigrājānaṃ vañcayitryāḥ prajāyāḥ pālakaṃ tathā ।।76 ।।
jayastasya satībhāryāsvāminaḥ sarvadā bhuvi ।
madālasāyāḥ puṇyena vijayo me'sti sarvathā ।।77।।
svargaṃ svargasamaṃ rājyaṃ putrā devasamā mama ।
divyā lakṣmīsamā patnī vaikuṇṭhaṃ me'sti sarvathā ।।78।।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvadā tvāste matputreṣu virāgiṣu ।
śrīrādhā ca sadā madālasāyāṃ vartate nanu ।।79।।।
lakṣmīḥ sadā gṛhe cāste mama cāndhasikeṣu vai ।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ mayi nāsti nyūnaṃ ca me manāk ।।1.394.80।।
yasya pativratā bhāryā yasya putraśca bhaktarāṭ ।
tasya vaiṣṇavayajñānāṃ sahasraṃ nityameva hi ।।81 ।।
yatra nāsti satī bhāryā yatra putro na bhaktarāṭ ।
tasya gṛhaṃ piśācānāṃ pherurājagṛhopamam ।।82।।
ityevaṃ ṛtamevā'sya dhvajavad dṛśyate sadā ।
tenārthavānnabhavat sa ṛtadhvajo'pi pārthivaḥ ।।83।।
athā'yaṃ svasutānāha rājyapālanahetave ।
putrāḥ prāhuśca pitaraṃ kurmo brāhmaṃ hi rājyakam ।।84।।
mātuḥ pituḥ kṛpayaiva vayaṃ samuddhṛtā bhavāt ।
rājyaṃ tu pārthivaṃ sarvaṃ magnabhāvaṃ karoti vai ।।85।।
ātmarājyasamaṃ rājyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।
brahmānandasamaṃ saukhyaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।।86 ।।
nityatṛptiṃ gatasyā'tra rājyānando viṣopamaḥ ।
vitṛṣṇasyā''tmanaḥ saukhyātparaṃ saukhyaṃ na vidyate ।।87।।
ātmani paramātmānaṃ dhyāyante yogino janāḥ ।
santastathā prapaśyanti śrīhariṃ hṛdayāntare ।।88।।
tadyogaṃ tu vayaṃ prāptāḥ pitarmāturdayālavāt ।
tato rājyaṃ na cecchāmo bahiṣṭhaṃ naśvaraṃ kṣayam ।।89।।
śrutvā piteti putrāṇāṃ mumude vai muhurmuhuḥ ।
tārito'smi suputraiśca kartavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।।1.394.90।।
ititṛptasya rājñastu kālāntare sutaḥ śubhaḥ ।
caturtho'pi madālasārājñyāṃ jajñe guṇālayaḥ ।।91 ।।
athā'smai sā mahārājñī provāca suśubhaṃ vacaḥ ।
putra! puṇyena bahunā tava janmātra saṃgatam ।।92।।
ajanmāsi sajanmā tvaṃ jāto'si rājyakāraṇāt ।
arājā'si purupuṇyād rājā bhavasi putraka! ।।93।।
aprajo'si prajāyukto bhavasi rājyakāraṇāt ।
nityamukto'si tadapi baddho'si pitṛtoṣaṇāt ।।94।।
mā sma kleśaṃ prajākārye manyethāḥ mātṛdeśanāt ।
mā sma glānimasatyārthe kālakṣepe'pi savraja ।।95।।
pitroḥ sevā tvayā kāryā jñānaṃ saṃrakṣya vai hṛdi ।
vartasvā''jñākaro bhūtvā nirlepo lepavāniva ।।96।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'tha cikīrṣurnāma bhūpatiḥ ।
dadarśa tāṃ satīṃ bhāryāmīṣaddhāsāṃ madālasām ।।97।।
tāmāha rājā hasatīṃ kiñcitkautuhalānvitaḥ ।
kriyamāṇe mayā nāmni pratyeke nāmakarmaṇi ।।98।।
tava saṃjāyate hāsyaṃ vadātra kāraṇaṃ nu kim ।
vikrāntaśca subāhuśca tṛtīyaḥ śatrumardanaḥ ।।99।।
kṛtānyetāni nāmāni manye tāni śubhāni vai ।
yadvā te'tra navaṃ kiñcidūhamānaṃ prakāśate ।। 1.394.1 00।।
vad sādhvi santyasanti nāmāni kīdṛśāni hi ।
asya caturthaputrasya nāma tvaṃ kuru bhāmini! ।। 101 ।।
madālasā patiṃ prāha karomyākhyāṃ sutasya te ।
alarka iti dharmajñaḥ khyātaḥ suto bhaviṣyati ।। 1 02।।
laḥ layo raśca vivṛddhiḥ ka utpattirna yatra vai ।
alarkaḥ sa tu vijñeyastava putraścaturthakaḥ ।। 1 03।।
ātmā na jāyate kaścinna vardhate na naśyati ।
ajanmavṛddhivilayo'larko'yaṃ tava putrakaḥ ।। 1 04।।
ātmano nāsti śatrurvai yena mardanamācaret ।
evaṃ śatrumardanaṃ tu nāma nirarthakaṃ bhavet ।। 1 05।।
kāmakrodhādiśatrūṇāṃ mardane sārthakaṃ tataḥ ।
bāhurbhujā nātmano'sti subāhuḥ syānnirarthakam ।। 106 ।।
bahuṣu vartate yo'sau bāhuḥ kṛṣṇa udīryate ।
su sammato yasyā'sti subāhuḥ sārthakaṃ tataḥ ।। 1 07।।
krāntiḥ kriyā gatiryatra viśeṣeti nirarthakam ।
vyāpakasyātmano naiva gatistvasti kadācana ।। 1 08।।
athāpi bhagavalloke gatirvidyata ityapi ।
vikrāntaḥ sārthakaṃ nāma bhavatyeva sutasya te ।। 1 09।।
evaṃ putrāstava rājan! tārakā mokṣadāyakāḥ ।
jātā bhāgyavaśānmuktā jīvantu śāśvatīḥ samāḥ ।। 1.394.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye dvitīyasutasubāhutṛtīyaśatrumardanacaturthā'larkākhyaputrebhyo madālasākṛtopadeśanirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।394।।


← adhyāyaḥ 394 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 395
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 396 →

śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca-
atha rājñā yojitā sā madālasā caturthakam ।
putraṃ lakṣmi! pravṛttestu mārge hyupādideśa yat ।। 1 ।।
putra! vardhasva madbharturmano nandaya karmabhiḥ ।
devapitratithīn sarvān karmaṇā toṣamāvaha ।। 2 ।।
brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ putra! gṛhāṇa sopanāyakam ।
tato vidyāṃ rājayogyāṃ nītiṃ gṛhāṇa sadguroḥ ।। 3 ।।
rājyaṃ pitṛpradattaṃ ca dharmārthaṃ vaha putraka! ।
prajā rakṣa kratūn śreṣṭhān kuru vahnau ghṛtādikam ।। 4 ।।
juhudhi brāhmaṇasādhudīnebhyo dehi cārthitam ।
kṣiteḥ saṃpālanāt saukhyaṃ dharmakāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 5 ।।
tena svargaṃ ca devatvaṃ sukhaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam ।
parvasu tīrthake gatvā tarpayethāḥ dharāmarān ।। 6 ।।
pūrayethāḥ mano'bhīṣṭaṃ bāndhavānāṃ samīhitam ।
cintayethāḥ hṛdi sarvajīvānāṃ hitamuttamam ।। 7 ।।
nivartayethāḥ satataṃ cākāryebhyaścāpi pāpataḥ ।
yajñairdānaijapairhomairdevān dvijāँśca prīṇaya ।। 8 ।।
dharmārthakāmasaṃjñaiśca vijayethāḥ pumarthakaiḥ ।
gurun saṃsevayethāśca nandayethāḥ suhṛjanān ।। 9 ।।
sādhūn saṃrakṣayethāśca yajethāḥ suramānavān ।
vrajethāstīrthayātrāyāṃ kārayethāḥ svamokṣaṇam ।। 1.395.10 ।।
gṛhadharmān pālayethāstoṣayethāḥ suyoṣitaḥ
putrānutpādayethāśca śrayethāḥ nyāsasādhutām ।।11 ।।
samarjayethāḥ muktiṃ ca tyajethāḥ pravṛttiṃ tathā ।
vilīyethāḥ pare kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe'kṣarādhipe ।। 12 ।।
iti putra tavārthe vai mayā mārgo nideśitaḥ ।
tatra śreyaḥ śrayethāstvaṃ rāgatyāgobhayātmakam ।। 13 ।।
evamullāpyamānaḥ so'larko mātrā punaḥ punaḥ ।
vavṛdhe vayasā bālaḥ ṛtadhvajasutaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 14।।
kṛtopanayanaḥ prāha mātaraṃ vada me sati ।
mama yadatra kartavyamaihikā''muṣmikaṃ ca yat ।। 15 ।।
madālasā punaḥ prāha jñānayogye vayasyatha ।
vatsa! rājye'bhiṣiktena kartavyaṃ lokarañjanam ।। 16।।
vyasanāni na kāryāṇi rājyanāśyakarāṇi vai ।
ātmā rakṣyo ripubhyaśca mantro rakṣyo viśeṣataḥ ।। 17।।
amātyādīn vijānīyādāsanā''dānabhāṣaṇaiḥ ।
cāraiḥ sarvatra saṃdṛṣṭiṃ kārayet satyavedibhiḥ ।। 18।।
kutrāpi bhūbhṛtā viśvasanīyaṃ naiva sarvathā ।
kāryasādhakatā rakṣyā viśvāsairapi karhicit ।। 1 9।।
deśakālādivijñena rājñā bhāvya guṇādibhiḥ ।
ātmā prākmantriṇaḥ paścād bhṛtyā jeyastataḥ param ।। 1.395.20 ।।
kāmādayo vijetavyāḥ prathamaṃ sarvathā nṛpaiḥ ।
kāmaḥ krodho mado lobho mānaścaite vināśakāḥ ।। 2 1 ।।
kākavacceṣṭayā bhāvyaṃ kokilāvat svareṇa ca ।
bhṛṃgavat sāragrahaṇe mṛgavadbhramaṇe sadā ।। 22।।
vyālavad roṣakaraṇe mayūravat samādare ।
haṃsavattu vivekena kukkuṭavaddhi jāgratau ।। 23 ।।
lohavad dārḍhyabhāvena bhāvyaṃ rājñā hitārthinā ।
kīṭavat kaṭhine śatrau praviśettu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।।24।।
sambhūya ca pipīlikāvadāharet paraṃ nṛpaḥ ।
agnivisphuliṃgavad vai camatkāraṃ pradarśayet ।।25।।
candravat sūryavaccāpi nītyarthe niyamaṃ caret ।
bandhakī tu yathā syādvai nirlepā paśupakṣiṣu ।।26।।
padma jale tu nirlepaṃ hyuparyupari tiṣṭhati ।
śarabhaḥ siṃhavargaśca phalayukpuruṣārthakaḥ ।।27।।
śūlī vedhe na viphalā tathā prajñāṃ samarjayet ।
dadhipātre prasphuṭite gopālikā na śocati ।।28।।
gurviṇīstanato dugdhaṃ sravate na kadācana ।
evaṃ rājñā vartanīyaṃ kartavyaṃ rājyarakṣaṇam ।।29।।
indravattoyamādāya dātavyaṃ samayāgame ।
sūryavattoyamādāya dātavyaṃ ṛtusaṃgame ।।1.395.30।।
yamavat suhṛdi śatrau daṇḍakārye samo bhavet। ।
candravat śāntamanasā bhāvyaṃ kvacinna sarvadā ।।3 1 ।।
vāyuvat sarvavarṇeṣu cārairgopyaṃ samāharet ।
na lobhe kāmavarge vā kṛṣyate sa sukhī sadā ।।32।।
dharmaṃ pālayati svargyaṃ sādhvāśramāँśca rakṣati ।
tasya sukhaṃ pretya paratreha ca śāśvatam ।।33।।
prajāyāṃ dharmasarvasvasthāpanena nṛpasya tu ।
bhāgaprāptirbhavatyeva tena svargaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।।34।।
karmayajñān jñānayajñān bhaktiyajñān pravartayet ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprītyā labheta śāśvataṃ padam ।।35।।
satyaṃ śaucamahiṃsā cā'nasūyā ca tathā kṣamā ।
ānṛśaṃsyamakarmaṇyaṃ caite rakṣyā janairbhuvi ।।36 ।।
vatsa! gārhasthyamādāya janaḥ puṣṇāti vai jagat ।
tatpuṇyena ca lokān sa sañjayatyabhivāñcchitān ।।37।।
surā daityā dānavā vā mānuṣāḥ pitararṣayaḥ ।
munayaḥ kīṭapataṃgā vayāṃsi paśavo drumāḥ ।।38।।
gṛhasthamupajīvanti tena tṛptiṃ prayānti ca ।
mukhaṃ tvasya nirīkṣante hyapi no dāsyatīti vai ।।39।।
gārhasthyaṃ poṣakaṃ sarvādhāraṃ gauḥ sā trayīmayī ।
yatra pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvahetuśca sā matā ।।1.395.40।।
iṣṭāpūrtādikāryāṇi gṛhasthenaiva sarvathā ।
svāhākārasvadhākārau gṛhasthādhārakau matau ।।41।।
vaṣaṭkāro hantakāraścā'hokāro'pi tanmayaḥ ।
gārhasthyocchedakartā yaḥ sa tu pāpakaro'sti vai ।।42।।
gārhasthyaṃ poṣayed vijñaḥ saḥ svargāyopakalpyate ।
rājñā vā dhaninā vatsa! devarṣipitṛmānavāḥ ।।43।।
bhūtāni cānudivasaṃ poṣyāṇi svatanuryathā ।
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ kāle kuryātsamāhitaḥ ।।44।
sumanogandhapuṣpādyairdeśanabhyarcayet tathā ।
dīnā'nāthadaridrebhyo dadyād bhojyādikaṃ gṛhī ।।45।।
śvabhyaśca śvapacebhyaśca vayobhyaścā'vaped bhuvi ।
bubhukṣumāgataṃ śrāntaṃ yācamānamakiṃcanam ।।46।।
bhojyaṃ peyaṃ pradadyāccātithiṃ matvā hariṃ prabhum ।
tasmiँstṛpte nṛyajñotthādṛṇānmucyeta vai gṛhī ।।47।।
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhasthasya nivartate ।
datvā sa duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati ।।48।।
apyambuśākadānena satkriyādatithiṃ gṛhī ।
bhikṣāṃ ca yācatāṃ dadyād yathāśaktiprabhikṣaṇam ।।49।।
āśritān bhojayitvaiva sadā bhuṃjyād gṛhādhipaḥ ।
evamudvahataḥ putra! gārhasthyaṃ copakārakam ।।।1.395.50।।
devāḥ pitaro munayo dīnāścātithibhikṣukāḥ ।
ṛṣayo bāndhavāḥ pakṣipaśavaḥ sūkṣmakīṭakāḥ ।।51 ।।
āśīrvādaparā nityāḥ sukhadāḥ saṃbhavanti vai ।
paraloke'pi sukhadā avighnāśca bhavanti te ।।52।।
evaṃvidhāṃ śubhāṃ gāthāṃ svayamatriragāyata ।
vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitad datvā yuṃjyānna cānyathā ।।53।।
putrajanmani yatkāryaṃ vivāhādau ca yad yathā ।
tathā satāṃ tu sevāyāṃ vyayaḥ kāryo harerdine ।।54।।
annaprakiraṇaṃ yattu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi ।
tena tṛptiṃ piśācādyāḥ paryuṣitena yāntyapi ।।।55।।
yadambu snānavastrādvai bhūmau patati tena vai ।
ye ke ca tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃ tṛptiḥ prajāyate ।।56।।
ye tu dehāṃgalagnā vai patanti jalabindavaḥ ।
bhūgataistaiśca devādau gatāstṛptiṃ prayānti vai ।।57।।
piṇḍānnakaṇikābhiśca tiryañco yānti toṣaṇam ।
ye tu dagdhāstathā bālāḥ kriyāyogyā asaṃskṛtāḥ ।।58।।
vipannāste'nnavikirasammārjanajalāśinaḥ ।
ācullukajalaṃ pītvā tṛptimāyānti te mṛtāḥ ।।59।।
tasmānmahotsave dadyāt śrāddhe dadyācca dānake ।
dadyādeva gṛhasthastu kule kaścinna sīdati ।।1.395.6 0।।
sadācāro gṛhasthena pālanīyo yathāyatham ।
na hyācāravihīnasya sukhamatra paratra ca ।।61 ।।
durācāro hi puruṣo nehā''yurvindati dhruvam ।
sarvapāpaniṣedhārthaṃ dharmaḥ kāryo gṛhārthinā ।।62।।
brāhme muhūrte buddhyeta dharmārthau cāpi cintayet ।
snātvā sandhyāṃ tathā dhyānaṃ prakurvīta surārcanam ।।63।।
asatpralāpamanṛtaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ ca varjayet ।
asadvādaṃ ca nāstikyaṃ naiva kuryātkadācana ।।64।।
vṛddhebhyo namanaṃ kuryāt pūjyapūjā samācaret ।
gurūṇāmāsanaṃ dadyādabhyutthānādi cācaret ।।65।।
guruṃ ca pitarau śreṣṭhaṃ patiṃ samabhivādayet ।
duṣkṛtaṃ na gurorbrūyāt kruddhaṃ tvenaṃ prasādayet ।।66।।
paranindāṃ na śṛṇuyānna ca kuryātkadācana ।
panthā deyo brāhmaṇānāṃ rājño duḥkhāturasya ca ।।67।।
satāṃ viduṣāṃ gurviṇyā bhārārtasya yavīyasaḥ ।
mūkāndhabadhirāṇāṃ ca mattasyonmattakasya ca ।।68।।
satyāśca vairiṇaścāpi bālasya patitasya ca ।
narmā'bhighātamākrośaṃ paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayeta ।।69।।
daṃbhā'bhimānaśāṭhyāni na kuryādvai kadācana ।
paradārā na gantavyā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ samīcchatā ।।1.395.70।।
rajasvalā sadā varjyā sarvaiḥ rātricatuṣṭayam ।
strījanmaparihārārthaṃ pañcamīmapi varjayet ।।71 ।।
tataḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vrajed rātryāṃ putrecchuko hi sarvathā ।
yugmāsu putrā jāyante kanyāstvekāsu rātriṣu ।।72।।
āṣoḍaśarātraṃ vai garbhādhānabalaṃ matam ।
tata ūrdhvaṃ tu kamalaṃ pihitaṃ jāyate'phalam ।।73 ।।
kuryānmaitrī na cā'śīlairna cauryādidūṣitaiḥ ।
na cā'tivyayaśīlaiśca na lubdhairnāpi vairibhiḥ ।।74।।
na tathā balibhirmaitrī na nyūnairnāpi ninditaiḥ ।
na sarvaśaṃkibhiścāpi na vā daivaparaistathā ।।75।।।
atha maitrīṃ prakurvīta sadācāraiśca sādhubhiḥ ।
prājñairapiśunaiḥ śaktaiḥ karmodyogādiśālibhiḥ ।।76 ।।
patidevagurūn prati naiva pādau prasārayet ।
tatra putra! na vastavyaṃ yatra nāsti catuṣṭayam ।।77।।
ṛṇapradātā vaidyaśca śrotrīyaḥ sajalā nadi ।
jitā'mitro nṛpo yatra dharmarakṣaṇakārakaḥ ।।78।।
paurāḥ susaṃyatā yatra yatra sasyavatī mahī ।
yatrā'matsariṇo lokāstatra vāsaḥ sukhodayaḥ ।।79।।
tatra putra! na vastavyaṃ yatraitat tritayaṃ sadā ।
jigīṣuḥ pūrvavairaśca janā udyamavarjitāḥ ।।1.395.80।।
śaucādikaṃ śṛṇu putra! yathā yasyāsti sammatam ।
śakhā'śmasvarṇarūpyāṇāṃ rajjūnāmatha vāsasām ।।81 ।।
śākamūlaphalānāṃ ca tathā vidalacarmaṇām ।
maṇivajrapravālānāṃ ratnamuktāphalasya ca ।।82।।
gātrāṇāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāmambunā śaucamiṣyate ।
sasnehānāṃ tu bhāṇḍānāṃ śuddhiruṣṇena vāriṇā ।।83 ।।
śūrpadhānyā'jinānāṃ ca muśalolūkhalasya ca ।
saṃhatānāṃ ca vastrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇāt sacayasya ca ।।84।।
valkalānāmaroṣāṇāmambunā śuddhiriṣyate ।
tṛṇakāṣṭhauṣadhīnāṃ ca prokṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate ।।85।।
ūrṇā keśādayaḥ śuddhā vāyunā kiraṇena vā ।
śuci bhaikṣaṃ kāruhastaḥ paṇyaṃ yoṣinmukhaṃ tathā ।।86 ।।
yajñaśālā rasaśālāḥ stanandhayasutāḥ striyaḥ ।
śucinyaśca tathā hyāpaḥ sravantyo'gandhabudbudāḥ ।।87।।
bhūmirviśuddhyati kālāt sekāllepātsumārjanāt ।
ullekhanāttathā vṛṣṭermṛttikācchuddhiriṣyate ।।88 ।।
bhasmā'mbugharṣaṇairkāṃsyaśuddhiśca vahninā tathā ।
mṛttoyaiścānyapātrāṇāṃ kṣāreṇa trapusīsayoḥ ।।89।।।
rajo'gniraśvo gauśchāyā raśmayaḥ pavano mahī ।
vipruṣo makṣikādyāśca duṣṭasaṃgādadoṣiṇaḥ ।।1.395.90 ।।
ajāśvau mukhato medhyau na gorvatsasya cānanam ।
mātuḥ prasravaṇaṃ medhyaṃ śakuni phalapātane ।।91 ।।
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ nāvaḥ pathi tṛṇāni ca ।
somasūryāṃśupavanaiḥ śuddhyanti nityameva hi ।।92 ।।
prabhūtopahatādannādagramudbhūpya saṃtyajet ।
śeṣasya prokṣaṇaṃ kuryād vāyunā śuddhireva vā ।।।93 ।।
śavaṃ spṛṣṭvā prakuryādvai snānaṃ śuddhistato matā ।
malatyāge prakurvīta snānaṃ karādiśodhanam ।।94।।
apatyajanmani śaucaṃ māsamekaṃ hi pālayet ।
mṛtaśaucaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ pālayennyūnavarṣavat ।।।95।।
ityevaṃ tvamalarkātrācāraṃ pālaya sarvathā ।
ātmaśuddhiḥ sadā rakṣyā māyābhramavināśanaiḥ ।।।96 ।।
sa evamanuśiṣṭo 3 mātrā tvalarka ādarāt ।
pitrādiṣṭaśca saṃcakre dharmadāraparigraham ।।97।।
rājyaṃ pitrā pradattaṃ ca gṛhāṇā'larka aihikam ।
madālasā svatanayaṃ prāhedaṃ paścimaṃ vacaḥ ।। 98।।
yadā duḥkhamasahyaṃ te priyabandhuviyogajam ।
śatrubādhodbhavaṃ vāpi vittanāśādisaṃbhavam ।।99 ।।
tadā'smāt putra! niṣkṛṣya maddattādaṃgulīyakāt ।
vācyaṃ vai śāsanaṃ tvatra paṭṭe'sti likhitaṃ mayā ।। 1.395.10 0।।
ityuktvā pradadau mātā sauvarṇaṃ sāṃ'gulīyakam ।
āśiṣaścāpi yā yogyā dattā mātrā tataḥ param ।। 101 ।।
pitrā dattā āśiṣaśca rājyaṃ cakre hyalarkakaḥ ।
madālasāṛtadhvajau tapase kānanaṃ gatau ।। 1 02।।
dhyātvā tau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tyaktvā tu bhautikam ।
divyaṃ dehaṃ samāsādya yayaturbrahmadhāma vai ।। 1 03।।
evaṃ madālasā lakṣmi! vaiṣṇavī vai pativratā ।
putrān muktān suniṣpādyā'kṣaradhāma gatā satī ।। 1 04।।
etasya paṭhanādvāpi śravaṇānmuktirāpyate ।
bandhanāni vinaśyeyuḥ sadā saukhyaṃ bhavet priye! ।। 1 05।।
alarko'pi yathānyāyaṃ bandhanaṃ na bhaved yathā ।
tathā'karonnijaṃ rājyaṃ sarvāḥ pramuditāḥ prajāḥ ।। 1 06।।
pālayāmāsa dharmātmā putravad dhārmikīḥ prajāḥ ।
putrāँścotpādayāmāsa tatheyāja mahāmakhaiḥ ।। 1 07।।
ajāyanta sutāstvasya mahābalaparākramāḥ ।
dharmātmāno mahātmāno vimārgaparipanthinaḥ ।। 1 08।।
rājyaṃ kartuṃ samarthebhyo na sutebhyo dadau dhuram ।
vairāgyaṃ nā'sya saṃjajñe bhuṃjato viṣayān bahūn ।। 1 09।।
taṃ tathā bhogasaṃsaktaṃ bhrāntaṃ cā'pyajitendriyam ।
bhrātaraṃ rāganāśāya hyupadeṣṭumanā vanī ।। 1.395.11 0।।
subāhunāmako bhrātā'grajaḥ sanyāsavān yatiḥ ।
āyayau tadgṛhaṃ śīghramupādideśa mokṣaṇam ।। 111 ।।
ātmavidyāṃ bahuvidyāṃ bhrātrāpi kathitāṃ ca tām ।
smāraṃ smāraṃ jagādā'smai bandhanāśārthameva saḥ ।। 11 2।।
tathāpyalarko no mene rājyatyāgaṃ hitaṃkaram ।
tadā bubodhayiṣustaṃ tyājayituṃ ca bandhanam ।। 113 ।।
subāhustu ciraṃ dhyātvā śreyo'manyata saṅgaram ।
tadvairisaṃśrayaṃ kṛtvā yuddhamutpādya colbaṇam ।। 1 14।।
kārayāmi paraṃ śreyo bhrāturvairāgyamuttamam ।
audāsīnyaṃ samutpādayitvā karomi mokṣaṇam ।। 1 15।।
vicāryetthaṃ subāhuḥ saḥ kāśībhūpālamāgamat ।
tena cakre balodyogamalarkaṃ prati pārthivaḥ ।। 1 16।।
dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa rājyaṃ bhrātre pradīyatām ।
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ dūtaṃ pratyuvāca madānvitaḥ ।। 1 17।।
māmevā'bhyetya hārdena yācatāṃ rājyamagrajaḥ ।
nā'krāntyā saṃpradāsyāmi kāśīrājabhayena vai ।। 1 18।।
tataḥ kāśīnṛpeṇāsya yuddhaṃ ghorataraṃ hyabhūt ।
cintāṃ sa paramāṃ prāpya tat sasmārāṃgulīyakam ।। 11 9।।
mātrā dattaṃ tatra patraṃ dadṛśe prasphuṭākṣaram ।
'saṃgaḥ sarvātmanā tyājyaḥ sa cet tyaktaṃ na śakyate' ।। 1.395.120 ।।
saḥ sadbhiḥ saha kartavyaḥ satāṃ saṃgo hi bheṣajam ।
tṛṣṇā sarvātmanā heyā tyaktuṃ cecchakyate na sā ।। 121 ।।
mumukṣayā parityājyā saiva tasyāstu bheṣajam ।
vācayitvā mumukṣāṃ ca gṛhītvā'larkabhūpatiḥ ।। 1 22।।
sādhusamparkamanvicchan rātrau mitaparigrahaḥ ।
dattātreyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ yayau gurumasaṃginam ।। 123 ।।
praṇipatyā'bhisaṃpūjya yathāsarvamabhāṣata ।
kuru prasādaṃ duḥkhādivināśāyetyayācata ।। 1 24।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye'larka madālasā pravṛttidharmānupādideśa, sā sapatikā divyagatimavāpa, alarkasyā''tmajñānārthaṃ subāhoḥ prayāsa ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।3 95 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 395 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 396
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 397 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
samākarṇaya vijñānaṃ dattātreyād yathā'rjitam ।
alarkeṇa mahālakṣmi! yogināmapi durlabham ।। 1 ।।
guruḥ prāha kimarthaṃ te duḥkhaṃ brūhi yathātatham ।
duḥkhāpahāramadyaiva karomi tava pārthiva ।। 2 ।।
śiṣyaḥ prāha subāhurme bhrātā rājyārthameva yat ।
kāśīnṛpeṇa sammīlya vai mayā saha yuddhyati ।। 3 ।।
tadduḥkhaṃ paramaṃ śīghraṃ prāk prātareva nāśaya ।
guruḥ prāha tadetattu tvayi nāsti kadācana ।। 4 ।।
yasyātmani na cāsti tvaṃ tasyāpasaraṇaṃ kutaḥ ।
vicāraṃ kuru rājendra prakāśo'stu ca te hṛdi ।। 5 ।।
matkṛpāto nijaṃ viddhi hyaduḥkhaṃ hyasukhaṃ sadā ।
gṛhāṇedaṃ jalaṃ rājan piba gaṇḍūṣamātrakam ।। 6 ।।
dehi netropari tadvanmastake brahmadarśakam ।
ityuktaḥ sa tathā kṛtvā hyudghāṭitahṛdantaraḥ ।। 7 ।।
bhūtvā vimṛśya cātmānaṃ prahasyedamathā'bravīt ।
prakṛtistriguṇā sarvā nistraiguṇyo'smyahaṃ sadā ।। 8 ।।
prakṛtermamatā jātā tayā jātā'pyahaṃkṛtiḥ ।
tayā miṣṭāni mātrāṇi grāhakāṇi mṛdūnyapi ।। 9 ।।
mātrebhyaḥ sthūlabhogyāni tebhyo deho guṇāśritaḥ ।
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathā mohaḥ sattvaṃ rajastamaśca te ।। 1.396.1 0।।
tatkāryāṇi tādṛśāni teṣu cāyānti tānyapi ।
a tādṛśe hyatasmiँśca mayi nāyānti tāni vai ।। 11 ।।
tataḥ sukhaṃ tathā duḥkhaṃ mohaḥ santi na te mayi ।
nā'murvī na salilaṃ na jyotiranilo na ca ।। 1 2।।
nākāśaṃ ceti gandhādyā dharmā mayi na santi vai ।
nā'haṃ pṛthvīrna me gandho nā'haṃ jalaṃ na me rasaḥ ।। 13 ।।
nā'haṃ jyotirna me rūpaṃ nā'haṃ vāyurna me spṛśiḥ ।
nā'haṃ vyoma na me śabdastaddharmāṃśca kuto mayi ।। 14।।
pañcabhūtāni yuktāni hāniṃ vṛddhiṃ prayānti ca ।
sukhaduḥkhapramohānāṃ hānirvṛddhiśca dṛśyate ।। 15।।
dṛśyavad dṛśyadharmāṃśca ghaṭo rūpādayastathā ।
dṛśyante cakṣuṣā yadvat sukhādyā manasāstathā ।। 16।।
dṛśyasyaiva prakṛteste nātmanaḥ santi naśvarāḥ ।
anaśvarasya nityasya kathamāgantudharmitā ।। 17।।
evaṃ hastena vai grāhyaṃ phalaṃ cāmrādikaṃ jaḍam ।
rūpaṃ tu cakṣuṣā grāhyaṃ raso rasanayā tathā ।। 18।।
gandho nāsikayā grāhyaṃ unmādo manasā tathā ।
āsavādau guṇonmādo mattatā dhūsture khalu ।। 1 9।।
takrādau māndyamevetyādayo grāhyā rasottarāḥ ।
manasā te tu gṛhyante mano'pi tadrasottaram ।।1.396.20।।
aṃśo muktasya cāṇīyānmana eva bhavatyatha ।
manasyavasthitā dharmo jñānaṃ virāgamīśitā ।। 21 ।।
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vimohaste manasyavasthitā yataḥ ।
nā'haṃ mano na me duḥkhasukhamohāḥ kathaṃcana ।।22।।
ahaṃ nā'haṃ, mama nā'haṃ, buddhirnā'haṃ, na vai manaḥ, ।
tatra sthitaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tasyaiva mayi tatkatham ।।23।।
nāhaṃ pṛthivyādimayaṃ śarīraṃ
na vā manaścāntaramindriyaṃ ca ।
nāpi prakarmāśayavāsanā'haṃ
tanmohaduḥkhāni ca kiṃ mamā'tra ।।24।।
rājyaṃ dharitrī janatāḥ samastā-
stacchāsanaṃ buddhikṛtaṃ na tanme ।
buddhiḥ samānā triguṇasya putrī
tacchāsanaṃ rājyamidaṃ na tanme ।।25।।
karotu tacchāsanamasya buddhiḥ
subāhubuddhiśca karotu yadvā ।
nālarkabuddhirna subāhubuddhi-
ryato'bhidhā dehagatā na jīve ।।26 ।।
na yasya hastādikamasti vaśyaṃ
māṃsaṃ na cāsthīni śirāvibhāgaḥ ।
kastasya hastyaśvarathādikoṣaiḥ
svalpo'pi saṃsarga ihāsti puṃsaḥ ।।27।।
tasmānna me'rirna ca me'sti dukhaṃ
na me sukhaṃ pattanamasti mohaḥ ।
na kośanāgāśvadharārthadārā
na tasya nānyasya na me bhavanti ।।।28।।
yadasti tasyaiva sa me'sti śuklo
yadasti me tasya tadeva cāsti ।
dvayoryadastyeva sa śukla ātmā
duḥkhe sukhe kena kṛtaṃ vadātra ।।29।।।
samyak prapaśyataḥ puṃso duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ na kiñcana ।
ātmapradarśinaḥ kvāpi rājyaṃ na harimantarā ।।1.396.3 0 ।।
buddhistathā sthitisthāpyā bahukālakṛtā sadā ।
yatrāsaktā tathā tadvajjāyate guṇarañjitā ।।3 1 ।।
mārjārabhakṣite duḥkhaṃ yādṛśaṃ gṛhakukkuṭe ।
na tādṛṅmatāśūnye cakravāke'tha mūṣike ।।32।।
rakṣaṇe dehaputrādau yathābuddhiḥ pravartate ।
na tathā dehalikṣādāvasti pratyuta māraṇe ।।।33 ।।
ekasyaiva hi dehasya dhātubhirvividhāḥ prajāḥ ।
likṣā kīṭā matkuṇā aurasā vyavāyajāḥ sutāḥ ।।34।।
na sarvatra samā buddhirnakhakeśamaleṣvapi ।
tasmād buddhikṛtaṃ naijaṃ pārakyaṃ nātmanā .kṛtam ।।।35।।
tasmād guro satyabodhe nā'haṃ duḥkhī na vā sukhī ।
na ca mugdho naraḥ kaścid vedmi te'nugrahāt khalu ।।36 ।।
śrutvaitacchiṣyavākyaṃ tu dattātreya uvāca tam ।
evametannaravyāghra! jānāsi tu yathātatham ।।37।।
mūlaṃ mameti duḥkhasya na mameti ca nirvṛteḥ ।
matkṛpātaśca te jñānamutpannamidamuttamam ।।38।।
ādiṣṭaṃ tava mātrā prāṅ smāritaṃ te mayā'dya vai ।
ahamametijāḍyaṃ vai kṣiptaṃ yena vivekataḥ ।।39।।
tasyaiva sarvathā tṛptirbhavatyeva videhinaḥ ।
gṛhakṣetraputradāradhanadhānyasutādayaḥ ।।1.396.40।।
sarve mṛṣā mṛṣābuddhyā anityāḥ śāśvatīkṛtāḥ ।
bhrāntijñānādigarteṣu teṣāmātyantikaṃ kutaḥ ।।41 ।।
sādhusatsaṃgahaṃsasthairjanairyairmamatādayaḥ ।
nikṛntitā gurorvākyaiste gatāḥ paramaṃ padam ।।42।।
prāpya cātmavanaṃ śuklaṃ nidvandvaṃ roṣavarjitam ।
mohahīnaṃ nirupādhi vartasva ca sadā sukhī ।।43।।
na tvaṃ sthūlo na vā sūkṣmo na cāsi kāraṇātmakaḥ ।
na tanmātrātmakaścāsi nā'haṃkṛtimayo'pyasi ।।44।।
tasmātparo'si kṣetrajñaḥ saṃghātādguṇasaṃjñitān ।
śaivālakardamamuñjamatsyamaśakapāthasām ।।45।।
yathaikatve'pi pārthakyaṃ tathā kṣetrātmanornṛpa! ।
nityaśuddho nityabuddho nityamukto nirañjanaḥ ।।46।।
ātmā cāsi paro dehād deharājyādviḍambanāt ।
kṣiteḥ rājyānmamatāyā rājyātpāraṃ gato hyasi ।।47।।
mumukṣuḥ santyajet saṃgaṃ tannāśe mamatālayaḥ ।
tena vairāgyabhāvaḥ syād duḥkhadoṣānudarśanāt ।।48।।
arāge vartate yogī sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ ।
tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasati tadbhojyaṃ yena jīvati ।।49।।
aparigraha evā'sau jīvanmuktaḥ prakāśate ।
muktaye tu bhavejjñānamajñānaṃ bandhakṛd bhavet ।।1.396.50।।
śṛṇvalarka paraṃ mārgaṃ paraṃ padapradaṃ tathā ।
ṛṣayo bahavo yātā tena mārgeṇa mokṣaṇam ।।5 1 ।।
cittavṛttinirodho hi yogo nirvāṇadaḥ sadā ।
pramāṇaṃ paryayaḥ kalpo nidrā smṛtirhi vṛttayaḥ ।।5 2।।
satyaṃ jñānaṃ pramāṇotthaṃ mithyājñānaṃ viparyayaḥ ।
vastuśūnyo vikalpaścā'pratyayo nidrikā matā ।।53 ।।
anubhūtādisaṃskārajanyaṃ tu smaraṇaṃ matam ।
vastuyoge tu saṃskārairjanyate hyabhijñānakam ।।54।।
tadapyatra saṃskārotthāsmṛtireva prakathyate ।
ityevaṃ vṛttayo bodhyā jñātā ajñātakāśca tāḥ ।।55।।
tāsāṃ tu sarvathā rodho yoga ityucyate nṛpa! ।
ātmano brahmaṇo yogo yogaḥ śreṣṭhatamo mataḥ ।।56 ।।
buddhermālinyanāśāya yogo niyujyate sadā ।
avidyā cāsmitā rāgo dveṣo bhayaṃ ca pañca te ।।57।।
kleśā mālinyabhāvāḍhyā tannāśe nirmalaṃ manaḥ ।
tannāśārthaṃ yamāḥ sādhyā niyamāśca punaḥ punaḥ ।।58।।
ahiṃsā pālayet prājñaḥ satyaṃ hitakaraṃ vadet ।
asteyaṃ sarvathā rakṣed brahmacārī bhavettathā ।।59।।
aparigrahavān yaḥ syātsa vai bandhāt pramucyate ।
śaucaṃ tu mānasaṃ kuryācchārīraṃ yogyameva ca ।।1.396.6 0 ।।
santoṣaṃ vardhayennityaṃ yadṛcchālābhamātrataḥ ।
tapaścendriyanigrahātmakaṃ kuryād yathāyatham ।।6 1 ।।
svādhyāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmajapātmakam ।
tanmūrtau ca praṇidhānaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ sadā ।।62।।
evaṃ vai kurvato nityaṃ mānasaṃ doṣavarjitam ।
bhavenmukhyau dveṣarāgau doṣau tattyajanaṃ kuru ।।63 ।।
āsanaṃ susthiraṃ kuryātsvastikādikamuttamam ।
gorakṣāsanamevātra brahmacaryaprarakṣakam ।।64।।
prāṇāyāmān yathāpekṣaṃ kuryād yathābalaṃ sadā ।
prāṇāyāmairdahed doṣān dhāraṇayā ca vāsanām ।।65।।
pratyāhāreṇa viṣayān dhyānenā'nīśvarān guṇān ।
samādhinā hariṃ prāpyā'kṣare dhāmni pramodate ।।66।।
indriyāṇāṃ tu doṣā vai dahyante prāṇanigrahāt ।
laghurdvādvaśasaṃkhyaśca dviguṇaḥ sa tu madhyamaḥ ।।67।।
triguṇaścottamaḥ prokto nityaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ ।
prathamena jayet svedaṃ madhyamena tu vepathum ।।68।।
viṣādaṃ hi tṛtīyena jayed doṣānanukramāt ।
doṣān saḥ sādhito hanti khagān sādhitaśyenavat ।।69।।
cetaso'pakaṣāyatvaṃ prāṇāyāmena jāyate ।
kāmakrodhādayo doṣā dahyante prāṇarodhavat ।।1.396.70 ।।
atītā'nāgataprajñā jāyate doṣasaṃkṣayāt ।
saṃvit saṃjāyate cātmabodhinī prāṇasaṃyamāt ।।71 ।।
manaḥprasannatāsaumyabhāvitā jāyate tathā ।
evaṃ sthitau bhavatyāṃ ca pratyāhāramupakramet ।।72।।
indriyāṇi viṣayebhyaḥ prāṇānmanastathā''ntaram ।
nigṛhyā'ntarvartayecca pratyāhārastadātmakaḥ ।।73।।
ātmavṛttiḥ sadā paśyedindriyavṛttibhirnijam ।
ātmānamātmani tena pratyāhāro'pyupakṛtiḥ ।।74।।
pratyāhārottaraṃ rājan dhāraṇāṃ samupakramet ।
prāṇāyāmā daśa dvau ca sthitiḥ sādhāraṇātmikī ।।75।।
dve dhāraṇe bhaved dhyānaṃ pratyayaikaikatānakam ।
evaṃkṛte harermūrtau naśyanti doṣarāśayaḥ ।।76 ।।
vīkṣate ca paraṃbrahma māyāguṇān pṛthakpṛthak ।
svastho vibhuryathā sarvamātmanyeva prapaśyati ।।77।।
tathā dhyānī sadā svasthaścātmani sarvamīkṣate ।
nābhyāṃ hṛdaye kaṇṭhe ca tālau bhāle ca netrayoḥ ।।78।।
mūrdhni cātmani śrīkṛṣṇe saṃyamaṃ vidadhīta vai ।
evaṃ vai dhāraṇāṃ kurvan prāpnotyakṣarasāmyatām ।।79।।
sthānadhraiḥ kṛtasaṃskārādaiśvaryavismayāttathā ।
sāmarthyaṃ vilayaṃ yāti tasmāttatra nivartayet ।।1.396.80 ।।
striyaḥ kīrtirvivijñānaṃ rājyaṃ dravyaṃ samarthatā ।
devatvaṃ bahuyajñitvaṃ rasāyanaśarīratā ।।81 ।।
ākāśajalavahnyādāvapratihatayānatā ।
ete vighnāḥ prahartavyā manasteṣu na yojayet ।।82।।
brahmasaṃgi manaḥ kurvannupasargānna hanyate ।
prātibhaṃ sarvavijñānaṃ śrāvaṇaṃ divyakarṇatā ।।83 ।।
cākṣuṣaṃ divyadṛṣṭiśca sarvabhāṣā'vabodhitā ।
dūragrāhitvamevādyāḥ siddhayo vighnamūrtayaḥ ।।84।।
ābhiśca siddhibhiḥ putra! devatā bandhane sthitāḥ ।
upasargairmahāvighnairāvartante punaḥ punaḥ ।।85 ।।
tasmād yogakṛtāvāsaḥ prāvṛtya brahmakambalam ।
cintayetparamaṃ brahma sa yāyātparamāṃ gatim ।।86 ।।
dharitrīṃ vilayed vārdhau layed vārīṇi tejasi ।
tejo layettu pavane'nilaṃ layettato'mbare ।।87।।
tān śabde ta tvahaṃkāre taṃ mahatyāṃ pradhānake ।
mahatīṃ buddhiṃ viṣame vaiṣamyaṃ guṇasāmyake ।।88।।
guṇatrayaṃ vibhau caikadeśe layet samakṣare ।
akṣaraṃ brahmarūpaṃ svamātmānaṃ paramātmani ।।89 ।।
paraṃ brahmaṇi saṃyuṃjyāt tadvai tasya paraṃ padam ।
bhūteṣu yasya satkārastasyāsti dhruvabandhanam ।।1.396.9 0 ।।
yasmin yasmiँśca kurute bhūte rāgaṃ jano yadā ।
tasmiँstasmin samāsaktiṃ muhuḥ prāpya vinaśyati ।।9 1 ।।
punarāvartate rājan bhūtayogo vighātakṛt ।
bhūteṣu yasya sārvajñyaudāsīnyaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tu tat ।।9 2।।
aṇimā laghimā caiva mahimā prāptireva ca ।
prākāmyaṃ ca tatheśitvaṃ vaśitvaṃ ca tathā'param ।। 93 ।।
evaṃ kāmāvasāyitvaṃ guṇānetāँstathaiśvarān ।
muktiprasūcakānprāpya hanyate triguṇairna saḥ ।।94।।
nirdagdhadoṣastenaikyaṃ prayāti brahmaṇā saha ।
so'śnute hi sarvān kāmān saha tena vipaścitā ।।9 5 ।।
tathā''tmā sāmyamabhyeti yogīśe paramātmani ।
sālokyaṃ cāpi sārūpyaṃ sāyujyaṃ nityameva ca ।।96 ।।
samaiśvaryādimattvaṃ ca prāpnotyeva kṛpāvaśāt ।
omityekaṃ paraṃbrahma vadan māṃ ca sadā smaran ।।97।।
gṛhaṃ jīrṇaṃ parityajya prayāti matpadaṃ nṛpa! ।
madāśrayaṃ sadā prāpto'larka! vijñānamāptavān ।।98।।
madanugrahataste ca doṣānnaṣṭānavehi ca ।
na tu te bandhanaṃ bhūyād bhūyā nirvāṇabhāk sadā ।। 99।।
ātmanā brahmaṇā nityānandena sukhaśāyinā ।
parabrahmaṇi sammīlya śāśvatānandavān bhava ।। 1.396.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye'larkarājño dattātreyapradattajñānayogavattayā muktatādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 396 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 397
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 398 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
evaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ prāpyā'larko brahmasvarūpatām ।
svātmanyanubhavanprāha bhagavantaṃ guruṃ harim ।। 1 ।।
bhagavan! yoginaścaryāṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvathā ।
brahmavartmanyanugacchan lakṣyate kairvilakṣaṇaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
guruḥ prāha śṛṇu kṣmeśa! lokacaryāvilakṣaṇāḥ ।
caryāstasya bhavantyeva nirmaryādā nirāhatāḥ ।। 3 ।।
mānāpamānau yāvetau prītyudvegakarau nṛṇām ।
tāveva viparītārthau yoginastu viṣāmṛte ।। 4 ।।
maunamālambate prāyo harernāma gṛṇan muhuḥ ।
ātithyayajñayātrādau na gacchennirjanecchukaḥ ।। 5 ।।
vyaste vidhūme aṃgāre sarvasmin bhuktavajjane ।
aṭeta devayātrārthaṃ yadṛcchālābhatoṣavān ।। 6 ।।
yadvā cājagarīṃ vṛttiṃ samāśritya hi vartate ।
phalaṃ mūlaṃ dalaṃ kandaṃ kaṇā bhājā ca yallabhet ।। 7 ।।
tatprayuñjyātsureṣvārpya satāṃ vartma na dūṣayan ।
sārabhūtaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ gṛhṇīyānnādhikaṃ kvacit ।। 8 ।।
vāgdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaśca manodaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ ।
yasya vai niyatāḥ sa syāt tridaṇḍī yogirāṭ paraḥ ।। 9 ।।
kṛṣṇamūrtau sadā yuñjan yogaṃ kṛṣṇeti saṃjapan ।
vartate nityamagno'sau sthitiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ samudvahan ।। 1.397.10 ।।
tārasvareṇa bhagavannāmaraṭanamācaret ।
tatra yuktastu yogīśo bhagavallayamāpnuyāt ।। 11 ।।
śaśāṃkaraśmisaṃyogāccandrakāntamaṇiḥ payaḥ ।
samutsṛjati nā'yuktaḥ sopamā yoginaḥ smṛtā ।। 1 2।।
sūryaraśmisaṃprayogātsūryakānto hutāśanam ।
āviṣkaroti naikākī sopamā yoginaḥ smṛtā ।। 1 3।।
pipīlikā''khunakulagṛhagodhākapiñjalāḥ ।
vasanti svāmivadgehe dhvaste yānti tato'nyataḥ ।। 14।।
duḥkha tu svāmino gehadhvaṃse teṣāṃ yathā na vai ।
tathā tu yoginā bhāvyaṃ duḥkhānāvṛtakena vai ।। 15।।
valmīkakīṭikā mukhāgreṇa cāpi tvaṇīyasā ।
karoti valmīkacayaṃ tathā yogaṃ samarjayet ।। 16।।
paśupakṣimanuṣyādyaiḥ patrapuṣpaphalādikam ।
savṛkṣaṃ lupyate tadvallopyaṃ sarvaṃ tu yoginā ।।17।।
ruruśāvaviṣāṇāgraṃ vardhamānaṃ vilokya ca ।
yogī yoge vardhate ca tadā siddhimavāpnuyāt ।। 18।।
tadgṛhaṃ yatra vasati tadbhojyaṃ yena jīvati ।
yena sampadyate cārthastatsukhaṃ mamatā'tra kā ।। 1 9।।
bhojye miṣṭaṃ ca vā'miṣṭaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ kṣāraṃ ca vā kaṭu ।
na yad vedayate yogī jñātvā'pi na bhaṇatyapi ।।1.397.20।।
sa vai jihvāṃ rasaṃ svādṃ jītavānasti sarvathā ।
komalaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ mṛduḥ snigdhaṃ kharaṃ pṛthu ।।21 ।।
tīkṣṇaṃ prajvālakaṃ jñātvā cāpi duḥkhaṃ na yojane ।
so'yaṃ tvacaṃ sukhaṃ sparśaṃ jītavānasti sarvathā ।।22।।
miṣṭaṃ bhadra svarayuktaṃ gītaṃ cāhlādakaṃ mṛdu ।
narma hāsyapradaṃ roṣakaraṃ vā mānadaṃ tathā ।।23 ।।
jñātvā śabdaṃ na vai tatra sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ hi manyate ।
sa ca vācaṃ tadarthaṃ ca jītavānasti sarvathā ।।24।।
sundaraṃ sughaṭaṃ svarṇasamaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham ।
dhavalaṃ karburaṃ cānyat cikkaṇaṃ tīkṣṇameva vā ।।25।।
rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ yo na manyeta mānase ।
jītavān sarvathā rūpaṃ netraṃ dṛśyaṃ sa yogirāṭ ।।26 ।।
sugandhaṃ samanuprāpya nāsā naiti vikāsatām ।
durgandhaṃ samanuprāpya naspuṭaṃ na ca ruddhyate ।।27।।
sa yogī jītavān gandha nāsikāṃ ca svabhāvataḥ ।
satyapi kharjane prāpte cāṃcalye vā tvaci kvacit ।।28।।
naiva spṛśati karṇaṃ ca karotyeva na tvagjayī ।
padbhyāṃ yāti harerdhāma pradakṣiṇāṃ karoti ca ।।29 ।।
tīrthayātrāṃ sādhuyātrāṃ karoti caraṇojjayī ।
devagurusatāṃ sevāṃ karābhyāṃ prasamācaret ।।1.397.3 0।।
vāṇyā saṃkīrtanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cācaret ।
nṛtyaṃ karoti devāgre kathāṃ karoti sādhuṣu ।।3 1 ।।
gītaṃ karoti bhakteṣu dhyānaṃ karoti mūrtiṣu ।
cintanaṃ vandanaṃ stotraṃ karotyeva parātmani ।।32।।
namanaṃ hasanaṃ cāhvānakaṃ dikṣu karoti ca ।
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ tatra tatra harṣe cāviṣkaroti ca ।।33।।
kvacid vā'dṛśyatāṃ yāti kvacid vṛkṣeṣu vartate ।
kvacijjalapradeśe vā kvacidraṇe'pi vartate ।।34।।
kvacittu gahvare garte kaṇrakādau kvacitkvacit ।
kheṭe nagare grāmādau vane'raṇye ca nirjane ।।35।।
manasā kalpite deśe bhūtale'bbhratale'pi vā ।
vasatyeva yathāceṣṭaṃ yathāsaṃkalpameva ca ।।36।।
mukhe kvacicchilākhaṇḍaṃ dhṛtvā khādati ravādyavat ।
kajjalaṃ kardamaṃ vāpi dhūlīṃ kṣipati gātrake ।।37।।
candanaṃ śītalaṃ matvā jihīrṣati muhurmuhuḥ ।
agamyaṃ dūradeśasthaṃ vastu hastena dhāryate ।।38।।
anyadeśe jāyamānaṃ vṛttāntaṃ janasaṃsadi ।
varṇayatyeva ca yathāyathaṃ kvacit satīśavat ।।39।।
kvacit svapiti mārgeṣu kvacijjaneṣu kūrdati ।
paśuṣvapi vinā cintāṃ bhayaṃ nidrāti mattavat ।।1.397.40।।
dhūlīdhūsaritāṃgaśca modate manasā kvacit ।
digambaraḥ kvacid yāti kvacitparṇāmbaro'pi vā ।।41 ।।
kvacid vṛkṣatvagambaraḥ kvacid bhasmāmbaro'pi vai ।
kvacidvṛṣṭipradhārāsu kvacidātapavahniṣu ।।42।।
kvacicchaityādisalile kardame tiṣṭhati kvacit ।
kvacinmalādiliptāṃgaḥ kvacitsvacchaśarīrakaḥ ।।43।।
kvacinmūtrādidurgandhaḥ ṣṭhīvanādiṣu nirghṛṇaḥ ।
nāsikālālasaṃlagno dehakṣālanavarjitaḥ ।।44।।
ātmārāmo yathā brahmasvarūpo divyavigrahaḥ ।
nirāvaraṇasañcāro naranārīvibhānakaḥ ।।45।।
paśupakṣitṛṇavallīkaṇṭakādiṣu nirbhayaḥ ।
harerbhānena yukto'pi dehabhānādivarjitaḥ ।।46।।
avismartavyamevā'trā'tyaktavyaṃ cāpi yadbhavet ।
na tyajati nāpi vismaratyavadhānavānapi ।।47।।
vartate bālavadvāpi vṛddhavacca kadācana ।
kadāpi vartate kākabakamārjāraghūkavat ।।48।।
kvacit sa vartate premṇi mayūraśukahaṃsavat ।
kvacinmādhukarīṃ vṛttiṃ kvacid vṛttiṃ tu vānarīm ।।49।।
kvacit saiṃhīṃ kvacid dīnāṃ kvacicchyenasamāṃ tathā ।
kvacinmatsyasamāṃ vṛttiṃ samādāya hi vartate ।।1.397.50।।
śrīharau cittayuktatvaṃ cā'nyatra cittavarjitam ।
ahnāṃ nirgamanaṃ tasya bhavati brahmayoginaḥ ।।51 ।।
kvacinmānasapūjāyāṃ hariṃ bhojayati dhruvaḥ ।
jalaṃ datvā namaḥ kṛtvā visarjayati ceṣṭayā ।।52।
kvacid dhūlyāṃ tu paryaṃkaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayati prabhum ।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ dalaṃ parṇaṃ phalaṃ vā kaṃkaraṃ tṛṇam ।।53।।
tulasīṃ kamalaṃ datvā hariṃ raṃjayati kvacit ।
evaṃ yogijanasyaiva ceṣṭā niyantraṇāṃ vinā ।।54।।
divyā divyasvarūpā ca divyagatipravartikā ।
divyatattvamayī sarvā paraśreyaḥpradāyinī ।।55।।
bhavatyeva sadā'larka! yogī jānāti yoginam ।
sanakādyāḥ ṛṣabhādyāḥ śukādyāśca tathā'bhavan ।।56।।
siddhā nāthāstīrthakarā haṃsā aghoravartanāḥ ।
sādhavo yoginaścānye jaḍāśca bhairavādayaḥ ।।57।।
śaṃkaro yoginīcakraṃ cā'vadhūtāstathā'pare ।
satyaḥ sādhvyastathā dāsyo vaiṣṇavyaśca samādhigāḥ ।।।58।।
prāpurvai brahmaparamaṃ lokavilakṣaṇakriyāḥ ।
kimbahunā'tra vācā vai yogī yogena darpitaḥ ।।59।।
nānyat kiṃcidvijānāti brahmabhinnaṃ hṛdantare ।
yasya sarvatra cā''tmā'sti yasmin sarvātmano gṛham ।।1.397.6 0।।
sūtre maṇirmaṇau sūtraṃ tathā yaḥ sthitimāptavān ।
paripūrṇatamānandaṃ prāptavān tanmadānvitaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
tasya yoginaḥ sāmyaṃ ko vimarśayitumarhati ।
ceṣṭayā vartate vyagro buddhyā viśārado yathā ।।62।।
vācā tu vartate sādhurvṛttyā śānto hi vartate ।
hṛdā tu vartate tṛpto dehena vartate'bhayaḥ ।।63 ।।
guṇaistu vartate mūḍhaḥ snigdho mukhena vartate ।
brahmaṇi vartate rāgī māyike vartate saruṭ ।।64।।
nirjane vartate lubdhaḥ saghṛṇo vartate jane ।
daive paitrye hareryoge saśraddho vartate ca saḥ ।।65।।
dehakārye vicitto vai nijakārye tu cittavān ।
pare niḥśreyasi sarvabalayuktaḥ pravartate ।।66।।
vyavahāre vicitto'yaṃ parameśe sacittakaḥ ।
evaṃ lakṣaṇasampanno yogī varteta sarvadā ।।67।।
kvacid darśayati svasmiṃścamatkārān bahūn bahūn ।
kvacid vanyavadevā'yaṃ pradarśayati mūrkhatām ।।68।।।
evaṃvidhaṃ janaṃ jñātvā vicitraceṣṭikaṃ muhuḥ ।
vijānīyānmahāyogeśvaraṃ brahmasvarūpiṇam ।।69।।
atha yogī svayaṃ cihnaṃ jñātvā tyajati vigraham ।
śṛṇu vacmi tvariṣṭāni yenotkrāntau na saditi ।।1.397.70।।
devamārgaṃ dhruvaṃ śukraṃ somacchāyāmarundhatīm ।
yo na paśyati netreṇa mṛtyustasya samāntare ।।71 ।।
sūryasya maṇḍalaṃ raśmihīnaṃ vahniṃ saraśmikam ।
yastu paśyati netreṇa mṛtyustasya samāntare ।।72।।
vānte mūtrapurīṣe ca svarṇatulye prapaśyati ।
svapne'pi yadi paśyati jīvet sa daśamāsikam ।।73 ।।
dṛṣṭvā pretapiśācādīn gandharvanagarāṇi ca ।
vṛkṣān kanakaraṃgāँśca navamāsān sa jīvati ।।74।।
pīnaḥ śuṣkaḥ śuṣkaḥ pīno hyakasmājjāyate muhuḥ ।
śirovāyubhramo yasya tasyā''yuścāṣṭamāsikam ।।75।।
pādanyāse bhuvi pārṣṇeryadvā phaṇe prakhaṇḍitā ।
rajaḥkardamadhūlyādau saptamāsān sa jīvati ।।76 ।।
gṛdhraḥ kapotaḥ kākolo vāyaso vāpi mūrdhani ।
kravyādo vā khago nīlaḥ ṣaṇmāsāyuḥpradarśakaḥ ।।77 ।।
hanyate kākapaṃktyā ca pāṃśuvarṣeṇa svapnake ।
svacchāyāmanyathā draṣṭā catuḥpañca sa jīvati ।।।78।।
anabhre vidyuto draṣṭā dakṣiṇasyāṃ pravāsakṛt ।
rātrāvindradhanurdraṣṭā dvātramāsikajīvanaḥ ।।79।।
ghṛte taile tathā''darśe toye vā nā''tmanastanum ।
yaḥ paśyedaśiraskāṃ vā māsādūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ।।1.397.80।।
yasya bastasamo gandho gātre śavasamo'pi vā ।
tasya vai jīvanaṃ cārdhamāsikaṃ bodhyameva hi ।।8 1 ।।
yasya tu snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ karapādakau ।
pibataśca gale śoṣo daśāhe sa tu jīvati ।।82।।।
yasya vegena vāyośca daṇḍabhedaḥ prajāyate ।
tasyā'ntakaḥ samāyāto muhūrte vai mariṣyati ।।83 ।।
ṛkṣavānarabastoṣṭragardabhajambukādibhiḥ ।
dakṣiṇāṃ yo diśaṃ vāhe tiṣṭhan yāti mariṣyati ।।84।।
raktakṛṣṇāmbaradharā gāyantī hasatī ca yam ।
dakṣiṇāśāṃ nayennārī svapne so'pi na jīvati ।।।85।।
nagnaṃ kṣapaṇakaṃ yadvā rākṣasaṃ kālameva vā ।
hasamānaṃ pravalgantaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ vicārayet ।।86 ।।
ātmānaṃ sarvathā magnaṃ paṃke paśyenmariṣyati ।
keśe vahniṃ bhujagaṃ ca bhasma śuṣkāṃ nadīṃ tathā ।।87।।
svapne dṛṣṭvā daśāhena mariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
karālaiḥ puruṣairāyudhādibhiścopalādibhiḥ ।।88 ।।
māritastāḍitaḥ so'pi mariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ।
dantajāḍyavato mṛtyurbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।89।।
sūryodaye śivā yasya krośantī yāti sammukham ।
viparītaṃ parītaṃ vā sa sadyo mṛtyumṛcchati ।।1.397.90।।
bhuktamātrasya yasyaiva punaḥ saṃbādhate kṣudhā ।
dīpagandhaṃ na yo vetti sa gatāyurna saṃśayaḥ ।।91 ।।
nātmapratikṛtiṃ tvanyacakṣuṣorvai prapaśyati ।
rātrau śakrāyudhadraṣṭā divā grahavilokanaḥ ।।92।।
nāsikā vakritā yasya karṇau ca nimnakonnatau ।
netraṃ vāmaṃ sravatyeva tasyāyurnāsti sarvathā ।।93।।
mukhaṃ raktaṃ bhavejjihvā śyāmā dantāśca kṛṣṇakāḥ ।
nirghoṣā'śravaṇaṃ karṇe cakṣurjyotiḥkṣayaṃ tathā ।।94।।
garte gatasyopalābhirdvāraṃ yasya pidhīyate ।
tasya mṛtyuḥ kṣaṇādūrdhvaṃ svapne'gniveśitasya ca ।।95।।
jalapraveśane bhūtaistāḍane mṛtyurāgataḥ ।
svabhāvavaiparītyaṃ ca prakṛteśca viparyayaḥ ।।96।।
pūjyanindā'vamānādi mṛtyorākāriṇo matāḥ ।
tasmād yogaṃ tadā yuñjyānmṛtyunāśāya taddine ।।97।।
yadvā brahmaṇi yuñjītātmānaṃ nānyatsmaretkhalu ।
