so'yamātyantiko mokṣo mṛtyurātyantiko hi saḥ ।
yogābhyāsaphalaṃ taccā'kṣare pādārcanaṃ hareḥ ।।99।।
jananaṃ sārthakaṃ tasya maraṇaṃ sārthakaṃ tathā ।
sārthakaṃ rājyakaraṇaṃ prāptiḥ kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ ।। 1.397.10 0।।
alarka itisaṃśrutvā nanāma gurupādayoḥ ।
niśāmadhye muhūrte vai jñānayogau lalābha ca ।। 101 ।।
pūjito vandito dattātreyaśca bhagavān muhuḥ ।
uvāca bahusantuṣṭaḥ pulakāṃcitavigrahaḥ ।। 1 02।।
diṣṭyā kāśīpaterbhūribalasainyena tarjitaḥ ।
yannimittamihā''yātaḥ sa bhavatsaṃgado mama ।। 1 03।।
dhanyo bhrātā subāhuśca yena jñāne suyojitaḥ ।
diṣṭyā mātṛkṛtaṃ patra vācitaṃ ca mayā tathā ।। 1 04।।
diṣṭyā tvatpādayugalaṃ sevitaṃ ca mayā tathā ।
diṣṭyā tvaduktayaḥ sarvā mama cetasi susthirāḥ ।। 1 05।।
diṣṭyā jñānaṃ mamotpannaṃ tava sādhoḥ samāgamāt ।
diṣṭyā bhavatā karuṇā kṛtā bhagavatā mayi ।। 1 06।।
so'haṃ tava prasādāgnirnirdagdhāhaṃmamādikaḥ ।
brahmadhāma pragantuṃ vai yatiṣye rājyavartanāt ।। 1 07।।
dattātreyastataḥ śiṣyaṃ prāha gaccha sukhī bhava ।
nirmamo nirahaṃkārastathā cara vimuktaye ।। 1 08।।
evamuktaḥ praṇamyainaṃ jagāma niśithe gṛham ।
yatra kāśīpatiḥ rājā tathā subāhuragrajaḥ ।। 1 09।।
tatra gatvā samuvāca bhujyatāṃ rājyamūrjitam ।
yathā vā rocate tadvat subāhoḥ saṃprayaccha vā ।। 1.397.110 ।।
kāśīrājastadā prāha kiṃ tyaktaṃ yuddhamantarā ।
alarkaḥ prāha guruṇā granthayo nāśitā mama ।। 111 ।।
dattātreyaprasādena bhedabhāvo nirākṛtaḥ ।
mano brahmaṇi sandhāya tajjaye paramo jayaḥ ।। 11 2।।
subāhuḥ prāha yasyārthaṃ tvāmahaṃ yoddhumāgataḥ ।
tanmayā sakalaṃ prāptaṃ na me rājye prayojanam ।। 11 3।।
kāśīrājastathā prāha jñānavairāgyayoḥ kṛte ।
alarka! tava mokṣārthaṃ mayā yuddhaṃ praghoṣitam ।। 1 14।।
tatte jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ samutpannaṃ vrajāmyaham ।
upekṣyate sīdamānaḥ svajano bāndhavaḥ suhṛt ।। 1 15।।
sa na proktaḥ svajanādirvācyaḥ sa tu janairbhavet ।
phaladāyī satāṃ saṃgo mātrā te kathitaḥ khalu ।। 11 6।।
tajanyabodhalābhena yatethāḥ śreyase nṛpa! ।
evamuktvotsavaṃ kṛtvā kāśīrājo yayau tataḥ ।। 1 17।।
subāhurapi siddhārtho yayau svīyavanaṃ punaḥ ।
alarkastu samuttīrṇo gāthāmetāmagāyata ।। 1 18।।
aho kaṣṭaṃ mayā kīdṛg rājyaṃ garveṇa vartitam ।
guroḥ kṛpayā vijñānaṃ yogānnāsti paraṃ sukham ।। 11 9।।
ityuktvā ca nijaṃ putramabhiṣicya narādhipam ।
vanaṃ jagāma santyaktasarvasaṃgaḥ pramuktaye ।। 1.397.1 20।।
tataḥ kālena mahatā brahmanirvāṇamāptavān ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya brahmasāyujyamāpnuyāt ।। 121 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye'larkasya dattātreyopadeśe muktacaryā, yogināṃ mṛtyucihnāni, alarkasya vanavāsaḥ evamādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।3 97।।


← adhyāyaḥ 397 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 398
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 399 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
purā devayuge lakṣmi! nārado munisattamaḥ ।
sumeruśikhare gatvā dadarśa vedhaso gṛham ।। 1 ।।
tasyottare pippaladruṃ yadadho divyamaṇḍapam ।
padmarāgamaṇistaṃbhasahasrairupaśobhitam ।। 2 ।।
kṛtasvastikamāṃgalyaṃ divyatoraṇaśobhitam ।
puṣparāgamahādvāraṃ saptabhūmikagopuram ।। 3 ।।
praviśyā'sau dadarśā'ntardivyabhauktikamaṇḍapam ।
tanmadhye vedikā tatra tuṃgāṣṭapādarājitam ।। 4 ।।
siṃhāsanaṃ ca yanmadhye padmaṃ sahasrapatrakam ।
tatrasamabhyāsīnaṃ ca sundaraṃ puruṣākṛtim ।। 5 ।।
caturbāhuṃ śvetavarṇaṃ varāhāsyaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।
śaṃkhacakrā'bhayavarān bibhrāṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।। 6 ।।
pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ puṇḍarīkāyatekṣaṇam ।
pūrṇendusaumyavadanaṃ kirīṭojjvalakāntikam ।। 7 ।।
sāmadhvaniṃ yajñamūrtiṃ sruktuṇḍaṃ sruvanāsikam ।
śrīvatsavakṣaḥsaṃśubhrayajñasūtravirājitam ।। 8 ।।
kaustubhaśrīsamudyotaṃ svarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitam ।
kaṭakāṃgadakeyūrakuṇḍalojjvalitaṃ harim ।। 9 ।।
nāradastamabhiṣṭūya sthito devasya sannidhau ।
etasminnantare lakṣmi! dharaṇī tatra cāgatā ।। 1.398.1 0।।
ilāyā vai piṃgalayā sakhībhyāṃ hi samanvitā ।
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā yuvatī tu sakhīyutā ।। 11 ।।
nanāma pādamūle śrīharervikīrya mastake ।
puṣpāṇi naikagandhāni kṛtāñjalipuṭā sthitā ।। 1 2।।
tāṃ devīṃ śrīvarāho'pi hyāliṃgyāṃ'ke nidhāya ca ।
papraccha kuśalaṃ tasyāstathā''gamanakāraṇam ।। 13 ।।
pṛthvī prāha bhagavaṃste kṛpayā kuśalaṃ mama ।
śrutaṃ mayā śeṣaśāyinārāyaṇamukhāt khalu ।। 14।।
lakṣmīcchayā bhuvi jale pūrvaṃ vedavatī tu yā ।
tatsthānaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi mādhava ।। 15।।
tacchrutvā nāradaḥ prāha satyaṃ tadvai vasundhare ।
tadetadahamaśrauṣaṃ satye vai munisaṃsadi ।। 16 ।।
evamuktvā hariṃ natvā nārado badarīṃ yayau ।
dharaṇī prāha bhagavaँstasya sthānasya darśanam ।। 17। ।
padminyā darśanaṃ kartumicchāmi te kṛpā yadi ।
tathāstviti varāhastāmuktvā sasmāra pakṣiṇam ।। 18।।
vainateyaḥ samāyāto divyadehena tatpuraḥ ।
dharaṇīṃ saha nītvaiva vārāho bhagavān svayam ।। 19।।
samāruroha garuḍaṃ prājagāma janisthalam ।
vilokya padminīṃ chāyāṃ viyadrājasya kanyakām ।।1.398.20।।
nārāyaṇapuraṃ dṛṣṭvā yayau nārāyaṇācalam ।
yatra śeṣācalaścādriḥ sarvātiśayapāvanaḥ ।।21 ।।
aruṇādrirhastiśailaḥ suvarṇamukharī nadī ।
tasyāśca hyuttare tīre kamalākhyaṃ sarovaram ।।22।।
tattīre bhagavānāste śukasya varado hariḥ ।
sarasaścottare pārśve haricandanaśobhitaḥ ।।23 ।।
śrīveṃkaṭācalo nāma vāsudevālayo giriḥ ।
yojanadvayavistīrṇaḥ śailo'rdhayojanocchritaḥ ।। 24।।
indrādyā devatāvrātā vaśiṣṭhādyā munīśvarāḥ ।
siddhāḥ sādhyāśca maruto vaiṣṇavā bhagavatpriyāḥ ।।25।।
rambhādyā apsaraḥsaṃghā vasanti niyatāḥ sadā ।
tapaścaranti nāgāśca garuḍāḥ kinnarādayaḥ ।।।26 ।।
nārāyaṇagirau lakṣmi! svāmipuṣkariṇī śubhā ।
asyāstu paścime tīre vārāho dharaṇīyutaḥ । । 27।।
garuḍādavatīryaiva nivāsamakaroddhariḥ ।
āste'syā dakṣiṇe tīre śrīnivāso jagatpatiḥ । ।28।।
śrībhūmisahitaścāhaṃ tatra vasāmi padmaje ।
kṛteṃ'janādriṃ tretāyāṃ nārāyaṇagiriṃ jaguḥ ।। 29।।
dvāpare sihaśailaṃ ca kalau śrīveṃkaṭācalam ।
pravadanti surāstaṃ ca paramātmālayaṃ girim ।। 1.398.3 0।।
svāmipuṣkariṇī tīre paścime lokapūjite ।
āste varāhavadano śeṣādrau vṛṣabhācale ।। 21 ।।
tatra viśrāntimāsādya nārāyaṇagirau kṣitiḥ ।
varāharūpiṇaṃ devaṃ sakhībhiḥ saṃyutā dharā ।। 2 2।।
papraccha parayā prītyā lakṣmīchāyāṃ vilokya sā ।
veṃkaṭākhye mahāśaile śrīnivāso jagatpatiḥ ।। 23 ।।
kadā cakṣuṣpathe yāti śrībhūmisahitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
śrīvarāho dharāmāha purāvṛttaṃ śṛṇu priye! ।।24।।
pūrve kṛtayuge tvatra vāyordṛṣṭvā mahattapaḥ ।
āgacchacchrīnivāso hi śrībhūmisahitaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 35।।
dakṣiṇe'smin puṇyatame svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe ।
harirvāyoḥ priyakaro hyānandākhyavimānake ।।36 ।।
ākalpāntamadṛśyo'smin vimāne vartate hariḥ ।
yo'sti vaikuṇṭhadhāmā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।37।।
dharaṇyāha kadā kṛṣṇaḥ kathaṃ dṛśyo bhavediti ।
agastyaṛṣirāṭ taṃ ca yāceta yadi bhāvataḥ ।। 38।।
tadā sarvasya viṣayaścakṣuṣoḥ syāt śriyaḥ patiḥ ।
itiśrutvā dharā'gastyaṃ sasmāra so'pi cāyayau ।।।39।।
ārādhya paramātmānaṃ prīṇayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।
yayāce lokalābhārthaṃ bhavān dṛśyo bhavatviti ।।1.398.40।।
evamukto hṛṣīkeśaḥ śrībhūmisahitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ netraviṣayo hyabhavat sa kṛpālayaḥ ।।41 ।।
munistaddarśanaṃ kṛtvā prītaḥ prāyāt svamāśramam ।
vimānaṃ vidyamānaṃ ca na tu dṛśyaṃ kadācana ।।42।।
tataścaturbhujo devaḥ sadā dṛśyo hi vartate ।
pṛthvī taddarśanaṃ kṛtvā kṛtakṛtyā vyajāyata ।।43।।
atha somakulotpanno mitravarmā mahārathaḥ ।
tuṇḍīramaṇḍale rājā nārāyaṇapure'bhavat ।। 44।।
tasmin śāsati bhūlokaṃ dharmeṇa mitravarmaṇi ।
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī sarvasasyānvitā'bhavat ।।45।।
nirītiko'bhavatsarvo jano bhaktisamanvitaḥ ।
tasya patnī samabhavat pāṇḍyakanyā manoramā ।।46।।
tasya jajñe kulottaṃso viyannāmā sutaḥ śubhaḥ ।
tasya patnī ca dharaṇī nāmnā''sīcchuddhavaṃśajā ।।47।।
viyati rājyamādhāya mitravarmā tu vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
yayau tapovanaṃ puṇyaṃ veṃkaṭādreḥ samīpataḥ ।।48।।
viyannāmā sārvabhaumaścaikapatnīvrato'bhavat ।
dharaṇīlagnacetāḥ sa śodhayāmāsa bhūtalam ।।49।।
yajñārthaṃ ca kāñcanena halena suviśālakam ।
bhūtale kṛṣyamāṇe tu viyatā bhūbhṛtā svayam ।।1.398.50 ।।
bījamuṣṭiṃ vikiratā dṛṣṭā kanyā dharodgatā ।
gahvaraṃ vivaraṃ channaṃ tatrā''sīd bhavanātmakam ।।5 1 ।।
āpyāyanā'nilajuṣṭaṃ sugandhiprasaracchubham ।
dvāroparyupalāyuktaṃ tadadhaḥ kanyakāśritam ।।52।।
sarvasmṛddhimayaṃ sthānaṃ yadabhūt surapūjitam ।
kṛṣyamāṇe hale tatra sītā lagnā halasya vai ।।53।।
upalā cotthitā cāntastejo dṛṣṭaṃ supāṇḍuram ।
padmaśayyopakaraṇānyapi dṛṣṭāni bhūbhṛtā ।।54।।
śayyāyāṃ rājatī putrī suvarṇanirmitā yathā ।
ākāśarājñā saṃdṛṣṭā vismayotphullacakṣuṣā ।।55।।
ādāya tanayāṃ rājā mamaiveyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
jaharṣa taṃ tadā prāha viyadvāṇī vihāyasi ।।56।।
satyaṃ tavaiva tanayā vardhayasva svaputrikām ।
tataḥ prītamanā rājā tāṃ rathe cāvarohayat ।।57।।
abhavat kausumirvṛṣṭirdevoktavijayadhvaniḥ ।
dundubhidhvānasannāditāśāścakruḥ pratidhvanīn ।।58।।
vāṭikābhūmikāṃ tyaktvā viveśa svapuraṃ nṛpaḥ ।
āhūya dharaṇīṃ patnīmidamāha mahīśvaraḥ ।।59।।
devadattāmimāṃ paśya bhūtalādutthitāṃ mama ।
āvayostadaputrayoḥ putrīyaṃ bhavitā dhruvam ।।1.398.60।।
ityuktvā pradadau patnyā haste prītyā viyannṛpaḥ ।
sādhvī rājñī vilokyaiva bālāṃ tarkaṃ karoti vai ।।61 ।।
kimiyaṃ devamātā vā vedamātā ca vā satī ।
śrīrvā lakṣmīḥ śāradā vā'rundhatī pārvatī ca vā ।।62।।
prabhā vā māṇikī gaṃgā śacī vā kiṃ sarasvatī ।
rādhā vā lalitā sītā jayā vā vijayā kimu? ।।63 ।।
ekādaśī jayantī dyauḥ kimvahalyā pativratā ।
kimu brāhmī mahālakṣmīrmadarthaṃ kiṃ samāgatā ।।64।।
evaṃ kṛtavatī tarkān tāvattayā tanau svakam ।
prāviṣkṛtaṃ mahattejo mahāvaikuṇṭhasadṛśam ।।65।।
tatra siṃhāsanaṃ ramyaṃ yatra nārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
caturbhujo yuvā śyāmo rājate tvatisundaraḥ ।।66 ।।
tasya vāme sthitāṃ pārśve putrīṃ dadarśa tāṃ satīm ।
mahālakṣmīsamarūpāṃ caturbhujāṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm ।।67।।
svakarasthāṃ viṣṇupatnīṃ bālāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣitiḥ svayam ।
mumoda tāṃ nicikṣepa pādayormādhavasya vai ।।68।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ tu gṛhītvā yuvatīmayīm ।
punardadau dharaṇyai ca jagād bhagavāna svayam ।।69।।
rakṣayaināmahaṃ tatrāgatya śrīveṃkaṭācalāt ।
udvahiṣye vidhipūrvaṃ tāvatsevāṃ karotu vai ।।1.398.70 ।।
ityuktā sā dharaṇī tāṃ kare kṛtvā pratiṣṭhati ।
tāvattejaśca vaikuṇṭhaṃ sarvaṃ tirobabhūva ha ।।71 ।।
dharaṇistvabhavattuṣṭā jagāda viyate tadā ।
viyadrājā'pi divyāṃ śrīchāyāṃ jñātvā tutoṣa ha ।।72।।
mātā putrīṃ śriyaṃ matvā nityaṃ sevāṃ karoti hi ।
devatāścāpi muktāścā''yānti draṣṭuṃ divāniśam ।।73 ।।
pūjayanti tathā tāṃ ca natvā natvā prayānti vai ।
dharaṇyāśca gṛhaṃ svargādadhikaṃ viśrutaṃ babhau ।।74।।
kanyālābhe samakāle yajñasaṃkalpapuṇyataḥ ।
ākāśarājabhāryā sā dharaṇī garbhamādadhe ।।75।।
viyannṛpaśca suprīto vīkṣya dauhṛdalakṣaṇām ।
uvāca phalitā subhru latā sāntānikī ca me ।।76 ।।
atha kāle gate patnī dharaṇī suṣuve sutam ।
supraśaste muhūrte ca meṣasthe ca divākare ।।77। ।
sutejaskaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ devatulyaṃ tu bālakam ।
dṛṣṭvā tu dharaṇī rājā mumudāte'ti tāvubhau ।।78। ।
dadaturbahudānāni ratnahastigavādikam ।
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭirgṛhe'patat ।।79।।
vavau vāyuḥ sukhasparśastatra putrajanerdine ।
putrasūtipravaktṝṇāṃ dāridryaṃ tena nāśitam ।।1.398.80।।
kapilākoṭidānaṃ ca vṛṣabhāṇāṃ śatā'dhikam ।
suvarṇānāmayutaṃ ca dadāvādye ca ṣaṣṭhake ।।81 ।।
tathaikādaśake prāpte dine nāma cakāra saḥ ।
vasudāna itiramyaṃ saṃskārāँścā'pyakārayat ।।82।।
vasudāno vavṛdhe vai śuklapakṣa ivoḍurāṭ ।
upanīto vinīto'sau gurubhiḥ śikṣitastathā ।।83 ।।
catuṣpādaṃ dhanurvedaṃ sāṃgopāṃgamadhītavān ।
piturastrāṇi sarvāṇi samantrāṇyapyaśikṣata ।।84।।
apradhṛṣyo'jayya āsīd duḥsaho durnirīkṣyakaḥ ।
taṃ tu putraṃ mahābhāgyaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā tu vaiṣṇavīm ।।85।।
samantrāṃ kṛṣṇanāmnā vai dīkṣāṃ dadau bhavāpahām ।
atha putrīṃ padmatulyāṃ padmāmivā'parāṃ śubhām ।।86 ।।
lakṣmītulyāṃ viditvaiva nāmnā cakāra padminīm ।
tāṃ tu yauvanasampannāṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritām ।।87।।
ārāme viharantīṃ ca kīrakokilanādite ।
yadṛcchayā''gatastatra nārado sarvavittamaḥ ।।88।।
vanalakṣmīmivā''lokya lakṣmīchāyāṃ suniścitām ।
nanāma devīṃ papraccha kā'si kasyā'si vai sutā ।।89।।
bhāgyaṃ te bahusampannaṃ manye hastaṃ pradarśaya ।
ityuktā sā sucārvaṃgī svakaṃ paricayaṃ dadau ।।1.398.90 ।।
viyadrājasya kanyā'haṃ dharaṇīpoṣitā'smi ca ।
vardhitā rājabhavane samutpannā kṣitau mune! ।।91 ।।
kiṃ kiṃ jānāsi sarvajña! bhāgyaṃ kīdṛg vadasva me ।
ityukto nāradastasyāḥ śārīraṃ cihnalakṣaṇam ।।92।।
pratyekaṃ saṃvilokyaiva prahṛṣṭo hyavadattadā ।
pādāṅgulinakhā madhyaraktāśconnatiśālinaḥ ।।93।।
pādau pratiṣṭhitau śubhro raktapadmasucihnitau ।
sthalapadmadalaraṃgau mṛdubhāvānvitau śubhau ।।94।।
talayoḥ santi valyādicihnāni susphuṭāni te ।
gulphau gūḍhau samo cāpyujjvalau vartulasūnnatau ।।95 ।।
jaṃghe cā'romaśe ramye kramapuṣṭe'tiśobhane ।
jānunī samasusnigdhe samābūrū kramapṛthū ।।96 ।।
samau hastikarābhyāṃ vai komalau candraśītalau ।
sarvātiśayarūpāḍhyau komalau cikkaṇau tathā ।।97।।
nitambau pṛthulau pīnau samaghaṭṭanakau yataḥ ।
sakthimūle komale ca rūparūpātiśālinī ।। 98।।
jaghanaṃ liṃgarekhāḍhyaṃ madhyaṃ svarṇasamojjvalam ।
nābhiḥ samaṇḍalā nimnā trivalīrekhayānvitā ।।99।।
pārśvau śubhrau medurau ca sthalapadmadalopamau ।
udaraṃ trivalīramyaṃ romarājisuśobhitam ।। 1.398.100 ।।
stanau pīnau ghanau snigdhāvunnatau magnacūcukau ।
karau te raktapadmābhau padmarekhāsamanvitau ।। 101 ।।
susūkṣmau raktasatparvanirantarasamāṃgulī ।
candratulyasuśuklābhau madhyaraktasusaṃbhṛtau ।। 1 02।।
dīrghau ca komalau kanye bhujau te puṣpadaṇḍabhau ।
pṛṣṭhaṃ te vedivad bhāti vilagnamṛjumadhyamam ।। 1 03।।
kaṇṭhaḥ rakto madhuraśca yogyadīrgho'tiśobhanaḥ ।
skandhau cāvanatau te staḥ sihaskandhopamau tathā ।। 1 04।।
mukhaṃ prasannaṃ satataṃ vartulaṃ śubhrakāntimat ।
tejaḥparidhisaṃrājadramyaṃ dṛṣṭiharaṃ śubham ।। 1 05।।
kapolau kanakādarśasadṛśau kuṇḍalojjvalau ।
tilapuṣpasamākārā nāsikā te'sti padmini! ।। 106 ।।
viśālaṃ dhavalaṃ cāru sūjjvalaṃ te lalāṭakam ।
akalaṃkā'ṣṭamīcandranibhaṃ rekhānvitaṃ śubham ।। 1 07।।
nīlālakapramūlaiśca vyañjitarūpabhāsuram ।
samaṃ kammānikollekhyaṃ sarvabhāgyavirājitam ।। 1 08।।
mūrdhā te samavṛttaśca snigdhāyatakacānvitaḥ ।
smitasaṃśobhidaśanaṃ bimbādharasamanvitam ।। 1 09।।
kundakalikāsaṃśobhaddantarājivirājitam ।
mukhaṃ nārāyaṇayogyaṃ tavā'sti tathyameva yat ।। 1.398.11 0।।
nābhiste dakṣiṇāvarttā hṛdayaṃ viṣṇuhastavat ।
rekhāsuśobhitaṃ cāsti lakṣmīrūpā hi dṛśyase ।। 111 ।।
madhye tu stanayoste'sti hṛdi nārāyaṇasya vai ।
caraṇordhvatilakākhyapuṇḍrarekhāpi vidyate ।। 11 2।।
nābhyadho jaghane bhāge te'sti suvarṇapiṃgalā ।
bāṇākṛtisamā rekhā, lalāṭe mukuṭākṛtiḥ ।। 113 ।।
gaṇḍe tu dakṣiṇe cātha lalāṭe madhyadeśake ।
śoṇabinduśca te sudarśanatulyo'sti śobhanaḥ ।। 1 14।।
urasi te caturhastaviṣṇurekhā'sti sūkṣmikā ।
vāme bhuje gadācihnaṃ vāmasakthni tu pādukā ।। 115 ।।
hṛdaye vaijayantyāśca rekhāsti pauraṭī śubhā ।
kamalaṃ ca kare dhṛtvā hastiste'sti kare śubhe ।। 1 16।।
dakṣiṇe te pade'ṅguṣṭhamūlā'dhaḥpheṇake varam ।
śaṃkhacihnaṃ vartate vai lakṣmīrūpaprabodhakam ।। 1 17।।
aṃgulīnāṃ tathā mūle phaṇake suvimānakam ।
kaniṣṭhāmūlasānnidhye nāvaścihnaṃ hi vidyate ।। 1 18।।
gadācihnaṃ mīnacihnaṃ śikharacihnamasti ca ।
te ca pārṣṇau matsyarekhā tathā tāmbūlavallikā ।। 11 9।।
vāmāṃguṣṭhasya mūle te yavacihnaṃ manoharam ।
tathā tatra suprāsādo rekhayā vartate śubhaḥ ।। 1.398.1 20।।
chatracihnamūrdhvarekhā kamalaṃ phaṇake tathā ।
dhvajoṃ'kuśaṃ kumudaṃ ca śrīphalaṃ kalaśastathā ।। 121 ।।
tathā vai sthalakamalaṃ dvitīyācandracihnakam ।
daśacakrāṇi te santi svarṇarekhā phaṇopari ।। 122।।
aṃkānyetāni te kanye dṛśyante'to hareḥ priyā ।
bhāvinīti tu manye'haṃ hṛtsthaṃ patiṃ kuru dhruvam ।। 1 23।।
yasyā yonermukhe madhye garbhe cāntardarīsthale ।
bandhakaṃ valayaṃ kuṇḍalinīrūpaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kramāt ।। 1 24।।
liṃgasya peṣakaṃ susaṃkocavikasiśāli ca ।
bhavet sa padminī nārī viṣṇuyogyā'sti sarvadā ।। 125।।
kasyāścid vidyate tvetad garbhagaṃ valayaṃ dṛḍham ।
patyuḥ svasyāśca saukhyāya sarvāsāṃ nahi tadbhavet ।। 1 26।।
ityuktvā pūjitaḥ sādhvyā nāraḍho'ntardadhe tadā ।
etacchrutvā'tha tatsakhyastamūcuḥ padminīṃ satīm ।। 1 27।।
puṣpārthaṃ phalapatrārthaṃ vanaṃ gacchāma īśvari! ।
puṣpāvacayanaṃ kurmo vasantaḥ samupāgataḥ ।। 1 28।।
ityatastā vanaṃ jagmurākāśatanayāyutāḥ ।
kaṃcid gajendraṃ dadṛśuḥ śubhradantacatuṣṭayam ।। 1 29।।
madaṃ varṣantaṃ gaṇḍābhyāṃ dhavalaṃ kariṇīyutam ।
citkāramugraṃ kurvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā tā vṛkṣamāśritāḥ ।। 1.398.13 0।।
nililyurdrumasaṃghāte tāvadaśvaṃ ca dadṛśuḥ ।
śvetaṃ suvarṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ śaranmeghamivonnatam ।। 131 ।।
tatpṛṣṭhe puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kāmadhanā''bhṛtam ।
padmapatrāyatanetraṃ sūkṣmakauśeyakāmbaram ।। 1 32।।
sadratnamaṇisannaddhahārakeyūrakuṇḍalam ।
divyaśārṅgadharaṃ svarṇaśarayuktaṃ kareṇa vai ।। 1 33।।
pītavastrapraveṣṭitakaṭibhāgaṃ sumadhyamam ।
ratnakaṃkaṇanūpuraraśanāsūtrarājitam ।। 1 34।।
viśālavakṣaḥsaṃśobhidakṣiṇāvartasaṃyutam ।
svarṇayajñopavītena sphuratskandhaṃ manoharam ।। 1 35।।।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarvāḥ sasmitāstasthurādarāt ।
gajo yayau tadā dūraṃ hayārūḍho janastadā ।। 136 ।।
kanyā drumāśritā dṛṣṭvā cāyayau tatsamīpataḥ ।
prāha kanyā! bhavatībhirdṛṣṭaḥ kaścinmṛgo'tra vai ।। 1 37।।
pratyūcustāstu taṃ sarvā dṛṣṭo'smābhirna kaścana ।
kimarthamāgato'smākaṃ vanaṃ gaccha vanādbahiḥ ।। 138।।
atrā'vadhyā mṛgāḥ sarve tvākāśarājarakṣitāḥ ।
evaṃ śrutvā vacastāsāṃ hayādavaruroha saḥ ।। 13 9।।
papraccha kā bhavatyo'tra keyaṃ kanyā ca padminī ।
brūta me'haṃ gamiṣyāmi śrutvā nārāyaṇācalam ।। 1.398.140।।
vasāmyahaṃ sadā nityaṃ vane bhramāmi yāmi ca ।
tadā taṃ dharaṇīputryā preritā prāha śāradā ।। 141 ।।
ākāśarājatanayāṃ vasudhāgarbhasaṃbhavām ।
asmākaṃ śikṣikāṃ nāmnā padminīṃ viddhi bālikām ।। 142।।
dehi tvaṃ svīyanāmādi kiṃjātiko'tra vartase! ।
iti pṛṣṭaḥ sa tā āha sūryavaṃśī jano'smyaham ।। 143 ।।
nāmnāṃ na me prasaṃkhyānaṃ pāvanānāṃ tu kanyakāḥ! ।
varṇato nāmataścāpi kṛṣṇonārāyaṇo'smyaham ।। 144।।
cakraṃ bhayāvahaṃ yasya dharmadviṣāṃ tu dehinām ।
śaṃkhadhvaniryatkṛto dārayatyarisamūhakān ।। 145।।
yasya śārṅgaṃ dhanurnityaṃ sṛṣṭau daityavimohanam ।
padmaṃ hastagataṃ dātṛśriyo lakṣmyāśca vardhakam ।। 146 ।।
so'haṃ veṃkaṭaśailastho mṛgayārthamupāgataḥ ।
mayā'pyanudrutaḥ śveto gajātmā mṛgayūthapaḥ ।। 147।।
ito dhāvan vāyuvego yayāvadṛśyatāmitaḥ ।
samāgacchaṃ samapaśyaṃ subhagāṃ padminīmimām ।। 148।।
mṛgaṃ tyaktvā mṛgīṃ prāpto mayā kiṃ labhyate nviyam? ।
iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā kruddhāstāḥ prāhuraśvinam ।। 149।।
gaccha śīghraṃ vanādasmānmā vadaivaṃ kadācana ।
ākāśarājaḥ śrutvā tvāṃ nigaḍe bandhayiṣyati ।। 1.398.150 ।।
yathānāmaguṇo bhāsi kṛṣṇaścāntarbahiḥ khalu ।
yāhi divyāṃ parakanyāṃ yācase kiṃ na lajjase ।। 151 ।।
sarvā militvā cātraiva bandhayiṣyāma eva hi ।
tāḍayiṣyāma evātra yenā'vocaḥ punarna tat ।। 152।।
tarjitastābhirevaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
hayamāruhya sandṛṣṭvā kaṭākṣeṇa yayau girim ।। 153।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye merau bhūnāradābhyāṃ varāhāvatāradarśanaṃ kṛtam, lakṣmīchāyāyā janmasthalaṃ nārāyaṇapuraṃ garuḍenāgatya dṛṣṭaṃ, pṛthivīgarbhātpadminyā utpattiḥ, viyannāmarājñā sā vardhitā, vasudānaḥ sutaśca jajñe, nāradena cihnairlakṣmīsamā'sītyuktaṃ,
udyāne'śvārūḍho nārāyaṇa āgatya paricayaṃ datvā veṃkaṭādriṃ yayau cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭanavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।398।।


← adhyāyaḥ 398 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 399
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 400 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ divyāṃ ramyāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ śubhām ।
ahaṃ tamaśvamārūḍho gatvā śrīveṃkaṭācalam ।। 1 ।।
hayāttasmādavatīrya viveśa mama maṇḍapam ।
śrīnivāsābhidhaścāhaṃ pañca kakṣā atītya ca ।। 2 ।।
muktāgṛhaṃ samāsādya mañce viveśa tāṃ smaran ।
ahaṃ sa vivaśo bhūtvā śrīnivāso muhurmuhuḥ ।। 2 ।।
sasmāra padminīṃ patnīṃ pūrvāṃ madarthanirmitām ।
śrīnivāsaḥ prabhustatra nidrāṃ lebhe manāṅ na vai ।। 4 ।।
madhyāhnasamaye jāte sakhī bakulamālikā ।
bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ pāyasānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ sugandhamodanam ।। 5 ।।
vyañjanāni sūpatakre pūrikā vaṭikā rasān ।
apūpān vaṭakān pūrṇapolikā dadhi sarpiṣā ।। 6 ।।
miśritaṃ śarkarābhiśca kadalādirasānakam ।
mahatpātre nidhāyaiva devaṃ iṣṭaṃ samāgatā ।। 7 ।।
anyāḥ sakhyaścitrarekhā navaraṃgā ca mālatī ।
kamalā kiṃśukī kalpalatā cānyā jalādikam ।। 8 ।।
tāmbūlaṃ vyajanaṃ naktakottamaṃ candanaṃ phalam ।
gṛhītvā cāyayuryatra śrīnivāso virājate ।। 9 ।।
bakulamālikā kṛṣṇaṃ vavande bhaktibhāvataḥ ।
dhyāyantaṃ cā'pūrvarūpaṃ vyājahāra hariṃ sakhī ।। 1.399.1 0।।
uttiṣṭha devadeveśa! bhoktumāgaccha mādhava ।
kathaṃ vā dṛśyase tvārto yāvadārtiharo hariḥ ।। 11 ।।
vane mṛgayāvyājena dṛṣṭavānasi kiṃ navam ।
avasthā cintayānasya sphuṭaṃ vadati hṛdgatam ।। 1 2।।
kā dṛṣṭā devakanyā vā mānuṣī vā'hiputrikā ।
brūhi no bhagavaँścittasthitāṃ tāṃ cittahāriṇīm ।। 1 3।।
ityākarṇya śrīnivāso niḥśvāsaṃ samarecayat ।
uvāca tāṃ sakhīṃ tatra vihasya puruṣottamaḥ ।। 14।।
purāyuge mahāduṣṭaṃ rāvaṇaṃ hatavānaham ।
tadā vedavatī dāsī sītāsāhāyyadā'bhavat ।। 15।।
sītārūpā'bhavallakṣmīrjanakasya mahītalāt ।
mayā rāmeṇa labdhā sā tataḥ pañcavaṭīvane ।। 16 ।।
rākṣaso rāvaṇastāṃ tu hartuṃ samāyayau yadā ।
tadā'gnideva evaināṃ svāhāyāṃ sannivi śya ca ।। 17।।
tasyāḥ sthāne tatsvarūpāṃ kanyāṃ vedavatīṃ nyadhāt ।
ninye vedavatīṃ rakṣo rāmastaṃ nijaghāna ca ।। 18।।
agnau vedavatīṃ kṣiptvā prāpya satyāṃ tu jānakīm ।
kṛtakṛtyo'bhavaṃstatra tadā vahniruvāca mām ।।1 9।।
iyaṃ vedavatī kanyā sītāyāḥ priyakāriṇī ।
sītārthaṃ rākṣasahaste gatā duḥkhamahārṇave ।।1.399.20 ।।
tasmādenaṃ vareṇaiva prīṇaya sītayā saha ।
iti vahnivacaḥ śrutvā sītā'pi māṃ jagāda ha ।।21 ।।
madarthaṃ duḥkhamāpteyaṃ sakhī vedavatī mama ।
tasmātparāṃ bhāgavatīṃ devaināṃ varaya prabho ।। 22।।
tadā mayā pratijñātaṃ variṣye tava vākyataḥ ।
ākāśabhūpakanyāṃ vai padminīṃ śrīsvarūpiṇīm ।। 23।।
tāvadeṣā śriyo dāsī sakhīrūpā hi vartatām ।
yadā ceyaṃ bhūmiputrī viyatputrī bhaviṣyati ।।re4।।
padminīti ca vā nāmnā loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ।
mama patnī tu sā tarhi padminyeva bhaviṣyati ।।25।।
iti dattavarā pūrvaṃ mayā lakṣmyā ca mālike! ।
adya nārāyaṇapure saṃbhūtā dharaṇītalāt ।।26।।
lakṣmīsamā padmanetrī vane puṣpāṇi cinvatī ।
mayā vane tu sā dṛṣṭā rūpānurūpasundarī ।।27।।
cittaṃ tatra ca me lagnaṃ tasyā yogaṃ hi kāraya ।
gaccha tatra vilokyaiva yogyāṃ madarthamāvaha ।।28।।
ityuktā bakulā prāha gacchāmi yatra sāsti hi ।
mārgaṃ vada ramānātha! kariṣye tava vāñchitam ।।29।।।
nārāyaṇastadā prāha śrīnṛsiṃhaguhā yataḥ ।
tanmārgeṇā'vatīryā'smānnārāyaṇagirestataḥ ।।1.399.30।।
agastyāśramamāsādya suvarṇamukharītaṭe ।
agastyeśaṃ prapūjyaiva gaccha kīravanaṃ tataḥ ।।3 1 ।
agre padmasaro nāma padmaśobhitatattaṭe ।
natvā śukaṃ tapantaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ prapūjya ca ।।।32।।
ādāya svarṇakamalaṃ saraso'smāttataḥ sakhi ।
tīrttvā suvarṇamukharīṃ taṭasthāni vanāni ca ।।33 ।।
araṇitīramāsādya viśramya vai kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
nārāyaṇapurīṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ saṃprayāsyasi ।।34।।
gatvā pūrvottare mārge'raṇinadītaṭasthitām ।
ākāśarājanagarīṃ gatvā tatrocitaṃ kuru ।।35।।
ityādiśya tāṃ visṛjya sa śiṣye śrīsamanvitaḥ ।
vakulā śrīhariṃ natvā raktāśvamadhiruhya ca ।।36 ।।
yayau yathoktamārgeṇa nārāyaṇapurīṃ prati ।
mārge'gastyasamudyāne nadītīre'vatīrya ca ।।37।।
snātvā pītvā viśaśrāma dadarśa padminīsakhīḥ ।
kāmārthaṃ devapūjārthamagastyeśo samāgatāḥ ।।38।।
tāśca papraccha bakulamālikā padminīsakhīḥ ।
kā yūyaṃ yoṣito brūta kiṃkāryārthaṃ samāgatāḥ ।।39।।
tāstu śrutvā samūcustāṃ vayamākāśabhūbhṛtaḥ ।
duhituḥ padminīnāmnyāḥ sakhyo bhavāma eva hi ।।1.399.40 ।।
kimarthaṃ tvaṃ samāyātā kva ca gacchasi no vada ।
ityuktā bakulā prāha kathamāste nu padminī ।।41 ।।
tāstu prāhuḥ puṇyavane dṛṣṭvā sā puruṣottamam ।
aśvatthaṃ mandahāsaṃ satpītāmbaraṃ vibhūṣitam ।।42 ।।
drutahemanibhā sā tu paśya paśyeti sā'bravīt ।
paśyantīnāṃ tadā'smākaṃ gato'ntardhānamāśu saḥ ।।43 ।।
sā sakhī mohitā cāste nṛpo dṛṣṭvedṛśīṃ sthitim ।
papraccha daivayogajñaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ so'pyuvāca tam ।।44।।
uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścidāgataḥ kanyakāṃ prati ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mohiteyaṃ vai tena yogaṃ sameṣyati ।।45 ।।
tenaiva preṣitā kācidāgamiṣyati kanyakā ।
sā tu vakṣyati yadvākyaṃ tadyathārthaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।46 ।।
kārayā'gastyeśapūjāṃ sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktaḥ sa nṛpaścāsmān preṣayāmāsa mandiram ।।47।।
mahāpūjādisaṃbhārānpuṣpādīn cinumo'tra vai ।
vad tvaṃ kā kathamatrāyātā kimicchasi priyam ।।48।।
bakulā prāha tāstatra veṃkaṭādreḥ samāgatā ।
dharaṇīṃ draṣṭukāmā'haṃ draṣṭuṃ śakyā bhavenna vā ।।49 ।।
sakhyaḥ prāhuḥ sahā''gacchāsmābhirvilokayiṣyase ।
bakulā ca yayau tābhinṛpadurgāntaraṃ tataḥ ।।1.399.50 ।।
samākrośaṃ śanaiścakre jyotirvettrī yathā vadet ।
vadāmi satyaṃ śṛṇuta bhūtaṃ bhavan bhaviṣyakam ।।51 ।।
dharaṇī tāṃ tathā śrutvā pṛcchecchukī puraḥsthitā ।
vada rāśiphalaṃ me kiṃ dhanarāśiṃ dadāmi te ।।5 2 ।।
bakulā satyamavadad duhiturdehaśoṣaṇam ।
puruṣadarśanājjātaṃ kāmatāpaprapīḍitam ।।53 ।।
sa tu devādhidevo vai vaikuṇṭhādāgataḥ svayam ।
adya sa śrīveṃkaṭādrau vartate śrīprasevitaḥ ।।54।।
kāmarūpī viharati bhaktābhīṣṭapradaḥ prabhuḥ ।
turaṃgastho vane rājñi! tava kanyāṃ sa dṛṣṭavān ।।55 ।।
sītāchāyātmikāṃ vedavatīṃ te putrīpadminīm ।
patnīṃ kartumicchayā sa preṣayiṣyati te'ntikam ।।5 6 । ।
lalitāṃ sā ca vai sarvaṃ kathayiṣyati tatsphuṭam ।
rameva taṃ sametyaiṣā ramiṣyati sukhaṃ ciram ।।57।।
ityuktvā bakulā maunamāsthitā dharaṇistataḥ ।
gṛhāntare sutāṃ gatvā dadarśā'naṃgamohitām ।।58।।
uvāca putri! kiṃ te'sti priyaṃ karomi yadvad ।
ityuktā sā jātismarā samuvāca tu mātaram ।।5 9 ।।
netrābhirāmaṃ yalloke satāmapi manaḥpriyam ।
tejasāmapi tejasvi devānāmapi daivatam ।।1.399.6 0 ।।
bhaktaiḥ sadbhiriha prāpyamabhaktairna kadācana ।
tatra kṛṣṇe mano mātarmama śaśvat pravartate ।।6 1 ।।
mātā prāha sute bhaktalakṣaṇaṃ brahi vedmi yat ।
padminī prāha jalajacakrapadmagadāṃkitaḥ ।।6. 2।।
bhujayugme tathā bhāle tūrdhvapuṇḍrakacandrakaḥ ।
gale tulasikākaṇṭhī kare tu japamālikā ।।6 3 ।।
jihvāyāṃ śrīharernāma hṛdaye pratimā hareḥ ।
pūjāpāṭhaparā ye ca satyavāco'nasūyakāḥ ।।64।।
anindakā brahmacaryaparāḥ śaucaparāḥ sadā ।
hareḥ prasādabhoktāraḥ sarvabhūtahitaṃkarāḥ ।।65 ।।
dayālavaḥ śravaṇādibhaktiprakārakāriṇaḥ ।
yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭā harerdhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ।।66 ।।
satsaṃginaḥ sadā śāntā vaiṣṇavāste prakīrtitāḥ ।
taireva labhyaṃ tadbrahma tatra me prītirasti vai ।।67।।
janmata eva mātarme tatprāptiṃ kāṃkṣate manaḥ ।
mātaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā'nyatra manaṃ me naiva dhāvati ।।68।।
taṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ smarāmyeva vadāmi cintaye'pi tam ।
tenaiva mātarjīvāmi tadyoge cintyatāṃ vidhiḥ ।।69।।
śrutvā mātā'cintayacca viṣṇuyogārthameva yat ।
bahudhā kalpayāmāsa viṣṇuḥ prītaḥ kathaṃ bhavet ।।1.399.70 ।।
evaṃ vicāryamāṇāyāṃ dharaṇyāṃ tatra dāsikāḥ ।
sarvā eva samājagmuścintāṃ papracchurutsukāḥ ।।71 ।।
kathaṃ cintāmayī cāste vad kurmo hitaṃ sukham ।
dharaṇyā kathitaṃ sarvaṃ putryāścintādikaṃ tadā ।।72।।
prāhuḥ sā bakulā'smabhyo militā vāṭikāsthale ।
prāha no'pi samāyātā veṃkaṭādrerhareḥ sakhī ।।73 ।।
bakulamālikānāmnī nārāyaṇahitaṃkarī ।
svāmī nārāyaṇo'smākamāste śrīveṃkaṭācale ।।74।।
kadāciddhayamāruhya haṃsaśuklaṃ manojavam ।
mṛgayārthaṃ yayau veṃkaṭādrervane samīpataḥ ।।75।।
vane kaṃcidgajaṃ dṛṣṭvā'patat pṛṣṭhe tadā gajaḥ ।
kareṇuyūthago'raṇye dudrāva sa tamanvagāt ।।76।।
tatra vane tapasyantaṃ pūjayantaṃ janārdanam ।
śrībhūmisahitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu bhaktitaḥ ।।77।।
dadarśa śaṃkhaṃ rājānaṃ śaṃkhanāgasarastaṭe ।
turaṃgādavatīryaiva nṛparūpo narāyaṇaḥ ।।78।।
papraccha kiṃ kriyate'tra veṃkaṭādrivane vada ।
śaṃkhaḥ prāha tadā viṣṇumahaṃ haihayadeśajaḥ ।।79।।
rājā'smi śvetanṛpatermahāviṣṇupratuṣṭaye ।
kṛtavānakhilān yajñān darśanārthaṃ harermuhuḥ ।।1.399.80।।
kintu nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī darśanaṃ na dadau mama ।
nirviṇṇo'haṃ tato jātastadā vyomasarasvatī ।।81 ।।
uvāca śāntidā rājannātra me darśanaṃ tava ।
gaccha nārāyaṇagiriṃ tapaḥ kuru japaṃ kuru ।।82।।
mamā''rādhanayā tatra darśanaṃ me bhaviṣyati ।
tatra kaściddhayārūḍho rājā tvāṃ sammiliṣyati ।।83।।
taduktarītyā kṛtvaiva paraṃ mokṣamavāpsyasi ।
ityukto'haṃ parityajya deśamāgatya vaiṃkaṭe ।।84।।
vane nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇamārādhayāmi sarvadā ।
śrībhūmisahitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ bhajāmi vai ।।85।।
iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā nārāyaṇo nṛpaṃ jagau ।
svasti te'stu gaccha nārāyaṇādrau śrīharergṛhe ।।86।।
kuru cārādhanāṃ tatra paścime śikhare sthitaḥ ।
nyagrodhamūle tvāsīnaṃ viśvaksenaṃ praṇamya ca ।।87।।
svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ gatvā snātvā tīre tu paścime ।
aśvatthaṃ drakṣyasi tatra valmīkaṃ drakṣyasi tvapi ।।88 ।।
tayormadhye sthiro bhūtvā haryārādhanamācara ।
tatra śvetavarāhākhyo harirbhramati tatsthale ।।।।89।।
valmīke tvaṃ kvacid draṣṭāsyenaṃ puṇyapratāpataḥ ।
iti śvetaṃ samādiśya samāsādyā'raṇīṃ nadīm ।।1.399.90 ।।
avaruhya hayāttīre vicacāra yadā hariḥ ।
siṣeve pavanaḥ śītasugandhaḥ śramanodanaḥ ।।91 ।।
siṣevire taṃ taravaḥ puṣpaiḥ surasasatphalaiḥ ।
sa ca nāthastadā hastinaṃ sakhīśca vyalokayat ।।92।।
adṛśyo'bhūd vane hastī cāyayau vaḥ pratīśvaraḥ ।
tanvīṃ lakṣmīsamāṃ hemavarṇāṃ vo madhyavartinīm ।।93।।
dṛṣṭvā saktamanāstatra padminyāṃ samabhūddhariḥ ।
tāṃ gṛdhnurāha keyaṃ me karagrāhyā bhavenna vā ।।94।।
yuṣmābhiradhikṣiptaḥ sa viyadrājo balena vai ।
śrutvā drāk hayamāruhya yayau veṃkaṭabhūbhṛtam ।।95।।
tenaiva preṣitā cāsmi dāsī bakulamālikā ।
padminyā haraye prāptyai dharaṇīṃ yāmi sukanyakāḥ ।।96 ।।
ityuktvā sā purataste tvāyātā kṛṣṇadāsikā ।
ayācata tu te kanyāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai ।।97।।
yathocitaṃ kuru mātarvicārya viyadādibhiḥ ।
asti yogyaṃ pradānaṃ tu yogyāyaṃ paramātmane ।।98।।
ramā rāmāya dātavyā padminī padmacakṣuṣe ।
kanyā kāntāya dātavyā kāminī kāmukāya vai ।।99।।
divyā divyāya dātavyā bhaktā bhagavate dhruvam ।
iti tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā papraccha nṛpameva sā ।।1.399.1 00।।
padminīṃ cāpi papraccha punareva kṛpāvaśā ।
rājā prāha mama kanyā tvayonijā'sti devatā ।। 101 ।।
arthitā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇenā'nugrāhaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
pūrṇo manorathaścā'dya me te'nyeṣāmapi dhruvam ।। 102 ।।
sarvaṃ śrutvā jahṛṣuśca procuḥ kulakṛtārthatām ।
bhavatkanyeyamatulā śriyā saha ramiṣyati ।। 1 03।।
dīyatāṃ parameśāya veṃkaṭādrinivāsine ।
ayaṃ vasantaḥ śrījuṣṭaḥ śubhaṃ śīghraṃ vidhīyatām ।। 1 04।।
āhūya dyuguru lagnaṃ vivāhārthaṃ vidhīyatām ।
tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāhā''hvayāmāsa bṛhaspatim ।। 1 05।।
mṛgaśīrṣaṃ tu kanyāyā devasya śravaṇaṃ tu bham ।
janmanastadvicāyaiva gururlagnaṃ samabravīt। ।। 1 06।।
sammatā sukhavṛddhyarthaṃ tayoruttaraphālgunī ।
tasyāṃ vivāho vidhivad vaiśākhe kriyatāmiti ।। 107।।
ityuktvā rājakṛtpūjāmādāya svargururyayau ।
rājā tu preṣayāmāsa dūtīṃ deveśvaraṃ prati ।।1 08।।
śukena sahitāṃ kanyāvāgdānavidhaye tadā ।
śuko dūtaḥ śāradā ca dūtī ca bakulā tathā ।। 1 09।।
tasminneva dine ramye yayuḥ śrīveṃkaṭācalam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ jagatpatim ।। 1.399.1 10।।
praṇamya tvavadan prītāḥ kṛtyaṃ jātaṃ tava prabho ।
māṃgalyavārtā saṃraktaṃ vayamatra samāgatāḥ ।। 111 ।।
tvāṃ pratyāha sutā bhūmermāmaṃgīkuru mādhava! ।
japāmi tava nāmāni smarāmi pratimāṃ tava ।। 1 12।।
dhyāye tava sucihnāni hṛdayādau janārdana! ।
tvāmavismṛtya kāryāṇi sarvāṇi prakaromi ca ।। 11 3।।
tvayā'rthitā tavaivā'smi pitroranumate mama ।
kuru prasādaṃ lakṣmīśa! māmaṃgīkuru mādhava ।। 1 14।।
viyacca dharaṇī caiva pratyāhatuḥ pareśvaram ।
dānapātraṃ svato labdhaṃ śāśvataphaladāyakam ।। 1 15।।
harṣo māti na hṛdaye gṛhṇātu kanyakāṃ hare ।
pradattā vākpradānena śuko nivedayiṣyati ।। 1 16।।
tavā'deśaṃ punaḥ prāpya syāmaścotsāhino vayam ।
bakulā prāha sandeśaṃ prapāṭhaya jagadguro ।। 1 17।।
kuru prasādaṃ me nātha padminyāścāpi keśava ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha gṛhītvā vākpradānakam ।। 1 18।।
kartuṃ kalyāṇamudvāhamāgamiṣyāmi cāmaraiḥ ।
śuka! gaccha vadaivaṃ tānitthaṃ devo'bravīditi ।। 1 19।।
gṛhāṇemāṃ vanamālāṃ svarṇaratnādiśobhitām ।
śukaśca śāradā mālāṃ gṛhītvā yayaturgṛham ।। 1.399.1 20।।
praṇamyā'vadatāṃ sarvān jātaṃ kāryaṃ sutārthitam ।
dadaturmālikāṃ kaṇṭhe padminyā bhāvagarbhitām ।। 1 21।।
nṛpo vai niścite jāte'preṣayallagnapatrikām ।
kuṃkumapatrikāścāpi lekhayitvā'nilaṃ sutam ।। 1 22।।
dadāvindrādyānayane'sṛjat trilokamaṇḍale ।
āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ purālaṃkārayojanāḥ ।। 1 23।।
racayāmāsa bhagavān so'pi kṣaṇād vinirmame ।
indro'sṛjatpuṣpavṛṣṭiṃ nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।। 124।।
avādyanta ca vādyāni mahotsavaśca yoṣitām ।
dhanado dhanadhānyādyaiḥ pūrayāmāsa veśma tat ।। 125।।
yamastu rogarahitān cakāra manujān bhuvi ।
varuṇo ratnajālāni mauktikādīnyapūrayat ।। 126।।
sūryaḥ suvarṇaratnānāṃ bhūṣādīni samārpayat ।
samudraśca tathā śailā ratnavastūni cārpayan ।। 1 27।।
kāmagāvaḥ kāmavṛkṣāḥ kāmavallyaḥ svakaṃ svakam ।
kāmaṃ cintāmaṇayaśca vastūnyapūrayaiṃstadā ।। 1 28।।
nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca dyauḥ rasātalabhūmayaḥ ।
svasvaratnāni peyāni bhojyāni lehyakāni ca ।। 1 29।।
racayāmāsurīśasya śāsanād veṃkaṭācale ।
atha pṛṣvī jalaṃ tejo vāyuścākāśa īśvarāḥ ।। 1.399.1 30।।
viyadrājasya bhavane cakrurvai maṇḍapaṃ śubham ।
daśayojanavistāraṃ yojanocchrāyameva ca ।। 13 1।।
mahīmānanivāsārthaṃ kārayāmāsa pattanam ।
śatayojanavistāraṃ sāmudre dvīpake varam ।। 1 23।।
mohamayaṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ dvitīyaṃ vai divaḥ sthalam ।
yānavāhanaśobhāḍhyaṃ svarṇaśikharalakṣakam ।। 1 33।।
rasaśālāsnānaśālāśṛṃgāraśālikāyutam ।
nṛtyagāyanaśṛṃgārakathā''khyānādimaṇḍalam ।। 1 34।।
dūraṃ śrūyet dṛśyeta vācayeta vimarśayet ।
tathā divyaṃ bhūtasāraṃ gṛhaṃ vidyudvikāsitam ।। 1 35।।
kārayāmāsa rājā'sau candramāhūya bhakṣyakam ।
annaṃ bahuvidhaṃ miṣṭamamṛtaṃ rasasaṃyutam ।। 136 ।।
viṣṇornaivedyayogyaṃ ca paramānnaṃ tathaudanam ।
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca narāṇāmapi sammatam ।। 1 37।।
muktānāṃ ca satāṃ cāpi sādhvīnāṃ sammataṃ tathā ।
caturvidhaṃ sugandhāḍhyamamṛtāṃśaiḥ prapūritam ।। 1 38।।
rasāyanaṃ naikavidhaṃ peyaṃ khādyaṃ navaṃ navam ।
kārayitvā saṃvidhānaṃ dharaṇīsahito nṛpaḥ ।। 1 39।।
vādyānāṃ kārayāmāsa nirghoṣaṃ maṃgalāvaham ।
padminyalaṃkṛtiṃ cakre devāgamanakāṃkṣiṇī ।।1.399.140।।
sarvānalaṃkṛtān kṛtvā dharaṇīsahito nṛpaḥ ।
sabhāyāṃ mantrisahitaḥ samāste prītamānasaḥ ।। 141 ।।
iti lakṣmi! tavacchāyā padminyā bhāgyamuttamam ।
phalitaṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ pāṇigrahaṃ kariṣyati ।। 142।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śrīnivāsabhagavatā bakulamālikā padminīṃ prati preṣitā, sītāyāśchāyā vedavatī padminī jātā,
dharaṇīgṛhe bakulamālikā yayau, śrīkṛṣṇapatnītvaṃ padminyāścihnairuktam, nārāyaṇāya dātavyeti nirṇayaḥ, lagnapatrikāpreṣaṇam, vivāhopakaraṇāraṃbhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikatriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 399 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 399 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 400
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 401 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śrīnivāso veṃkaṭādrau nijāṃ priyām ।
śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā'nyāśca sakhīrāhūya cā'vadat ।। 1 ।।
kiṃ kāryaṃ vada me lakṣmi! śri! sakhījana ityapi ।
ājñāpayasva sarvāśca vivāhārthaṃ tu yadbhavet ।। 2 ।।
kurvantu militāḥ sarvāḥ samutsāhādiśobhanam ।
lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā sakhīḥ sarvāḥ svanodayat ।। 3 ।।
prītiḥ sakhī śriyā''jñaptā sugandhaṃ tailamādadau ।
śrutiḥ sakhī samādāya kṣaumāmbarāṇi cāgatā ।। 4 ।।
smṛtiḥ sakhī vibhūṣāśca samādāya sthitā puraḥ ।
dhṛtiḥ sakhī samādadhre divyādarśaṃ samujjvalam ।। 5 ।।
dadhre śāntiḥ sakhī śreṣṭhaṃ sugandhyaiṇamadṃ tadā ।
hrīḥ sakhī saṃsthitā cāgre gṛhītvā yakṣakardamam ।। 6 ।।
kīrtiḥ sakhī svarṇapaṭṭaṃ saratnaṃ mukuṭaṃ dadhe ।
indrāṇī tu dadhe chatraṃ sarasvatī tu cāmaram ।। 7 ।।
gaurī dadhre cāmaraṃ ca vyajane vijayā jayā ।
śriyā saṃsnāpito devastataḥ śrīparameśvaram ।। 8 ।।
sugandhaṃ tailamādāya devamabhyajya kanyakāḥ ।
udvartitaṃ gandhacūrṇairdevāṃgaṃ parimṛjya ca ।। 9 ।।
ānītān karibhistoyakalaśān kāṃcanān śatam ।
pratyekaṃ taṃ samādāya tvabhyaṣiñcan ramādayaḥ ।। 1.400.10 ।।
keśān saṃdhūpya dhūpena saṃsādhya dntakena ca ।
vakrān caṃcatprāntabhāgān babandha śrīḥ suśobhitān ।। 11 ।।
sugandhenā'nulipyā'ṅgaṃ pītavarṇena piṣṭikām ।
saṃpramṛdya pītavastraṃ dadau kaṭyāṃ sukāñcikām ।।1 2।।
bhūṣayāmāsa bhūṣābhiḥ puṣpahāraistathendirā ।
dhṛtiśca darśayāmāsā''darśaṃ vai maṃgalāyanam ।। 13 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devaścordhvapuṇḍraṃ svayaṃ dadhe ।
evaṃ bhūṣāśobhamāno rājate bhagavān svayam ।। 14।।
atha kṛṣṇagṛhe prāghūrṇikā āyayurīśvarāḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīnārāyaṇo virāṭ sadāśivaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 12 ।।
bhūmā hiraṇyagarbhaśca vāsudevādayastathā ।
brahmā viṣṇurmaheśaśca lokapālādayastathā ।। 16 ।।
pitaro munayo devāḥ ṛṣayo dikprapālakāḥ ।
sūryādayo grahāścāpi vasavo nidhayastathā ।। 16 ।।
diśā rudrāstathā''dityā manavo vāsavādayaḥ ।
nakṣatrāṇi ca tattvāni guṇāśca marutastathā ।। 18 ।।
vālakhilyāḥ kalā nadyo nadāstīrthāni parvatāḥ ।
samudrāśca tathā'khātāścaityā bhvādyā drumādayaḥ ।। 1 9 ।।
pātālā'nalavāyvasthā meghā rātryo dinādayaḥ ।
jaḍāśca cetanā vyāptā nārāyaṇasya lagnake ।।1.400.20 ।।
veṃkaṭādrau mahīmānāḥ koṭyarbudāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
satyo detyaśca muktānya īśānyaḥ surapatnikāḥ ।21 ।।
mānuṣyaḥ kaśyapājjātā nāryastrilokamātaraḥ ।
āgatāḥ śrīnivāsādrau vimānahastihaṃsakaiḥ ।।22 ।।
aśvaiḥ siṃhaistathā pakṣivaryaiśca yogakuṃbhakaiḥ ।
santaśca sādhavo dhīrā vaiṣṇavā vītarāgiṇaḥ ।।।23 ।।
sannyāsino brahmacārivaryāstyāgina āyayuḥ ।
evaṃ viyadgṛhe cāpi caturviṃśatisaṃkhyakāḥ ।।24 ।।
tattvātmakāstu puruṣāḥ pṛthvyādyā devikāstathā ।
vallyo nadyo mahāsthalyo bhūmayo dyauḥ sumūrtayaḥ ।।25 ।।
devā devyaḥ samāyātāḥ sotsukā darśanāturāḥ ।
teṣāṃ bhojanasammānaṃ vāsapānasukhāsanam ।।26 ।।
apekṣitārhaṇadānaṃ cakruścobhayapakṣiṇaḥ ।
maṃgalānyabhavaँstatra veṃkaṭādrau viyadgṛhe ।।27 ।।
āgachanti vivāhe śrīpadminīśrīnivāsayoḥ ।
āruhya garuḍaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīlakṣmīsahito hariḥ ।।28।।
brahmeśavajrivaruṇayamayakṣeśasevitaḥ ।
vaśiṣṭhādimunīndraiśca sanakādyaiśca yogibhiḥ ।।29।।।
bhaktairbhāgavataiḥ sadbhirnāradasanakādibhiḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhūmahiraṇyagarbhavardhitaḥ ।।1.400.3 0 ।।
īśvaraiḥ śobhito viṣṇurnārāyaṇapurīṃ yayau ।
gandharvāśca jaguḥ kīrtiṃ nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
devadundubhayo neduścakrugītiṃ surāṃganāḥ ।
āpuścamatkṛtiṃ nāryo dadṛśurvanadevatāḥ ।।3 2।।
vanānyavākiran puṣpaiḥ pakṣiṇo vijayaṃ jaguḥ ।
japantaḥ svastisūktāni munayaste samanvaguḥ ।।33 ।।
devo devagaṇaiḥ śiṣyairviśvaksenādipārṣadaiḥ ।
sakhībhiḥ syandanahastiyānasthābhiḥ samanvitaḥ ।।34।।
mahīmānaiḥ samastaiśca koṭyādisaṃkhyakairvaraḥ ।
viyadrājasya nagaraṃ tvāsasād svalaṃkṛtam ।।35।।
pattanasya bahirvāṭyāṃ bahuyojanavistarām ।
vyomamārgābhisaṃvyāptāṃ tasthau śrībhagavān kṣaṇam ।।।36 ।।
tāvatā lokarītyaiva puryāḥ pradakṣiṇāya sā ।
padminī hastisaṃrūḍhā gatvā cāgatya gopuram ।। 37।।
ābhimukhyena devasya pratīkṣāyuksthitā'bhavat ।
atha vāṭyodyānataḥ śrīnivāso gopuraṃ yayau ।।38।।
kare mālāṃ samāgṛhṇan garuḍārūḍha īśvaraḥ ।
gajasthā padminī haste mālāṃ kṛtvā'bhyasaṃcarat ।।39।।
mukhonmukhaṃ militvā tau mālādvayaṃ sumūlyakam ।
parasparaṃ dadatuśca kaṇṭhayostau vadhūvarau ।।1.400.40।।
ālokyā''kāśarājo'pi jaharṣa saha bandhubhiḥ ।
viṣṇurmālāṃ svakaṇṭhasthāṃ mumoca padminīgale ।।41 ।।
padminīmallikāmālāṃ viṣṇoḥ kaṇṭhe samārpayat ।
evaṃ trivāraṃ tau kṛtvā yayaturmaṇḍapagṛham ।।।42।।
sthitvā pīṭhe kṣaṇaṃ paścād gṛhaṃ viviśatuḥ śubham ।
viśrāntiṃ jalapānaṃ ca laukikācāramityatha ।।।43 ।।
satkāraṃ pūjanaṃ sākṣatacandrakavibhūṣaṇam ।
varārthe kārayitvā ca maṇḍape vedikāntikam ।।44।।
varaṃ rājā''nayāmāsa pūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
brahmā tatrā'bhavanmukhyo vivāhavidhikārakaḥ ।।45।।
māṃgalyasūtrabandhādisāṃkurā'rpaṇamityapi ।
prakoṣṭhe ca kāmaphalabandhanaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।।46 ।।
vahniṃ prajvālayāmāsā''havanīyaṃ tu padmajaḥ ।
svastivācanamāṃgalyaślokā gīyanta eva ca ।।47।।
padminīṃ varato labdhairvastrābhūṣaṇahārakaiḥ ।
śṛṃgārayitvā tvanayanmaṇḍapaṃ varasannidhau ।।48।।
varaṃ natvā niṣasāda mālāṃ gale samarpya sā ।
vāme sthitvā saha patyā pūjāhomau cakāra ca ।।49।।
varamālā guruṇā sā dvayoḥ kaṇṭhe tadā kṛtā ।
catuḥpradakṣiṇīkṛtya vahniṃ homaṃ pracakratuḥ ।।1.400.50।।
parasparaṃ kṛtavantau kavalaprāśanaṃ tadā ।
raṃgajale suvarṇasyormikāyāḥ khelanaṃ tathā ।।51 ।।
puṣpagulālayoścāpi kṣepaṇaṃ ca parasparam ।
pracakratustato mantrāḥ sahadāmpatyabodhakāḥ ।।52।।
brāhmaṇairāvṛtāstatra sadrāgairvaidikaiḥ śubhāḥ ।
viṣṇoḥ kare karaṃ datvā kanyādānaṃ nṛpo'karot ।।53।।
viṣṇuḥ priyāṃ navāṃ prāpya pulakāñcitaromavān ।
sadyojātastadā kanyāprakoṣṭhaḥ svedavānabhūt ।।54।।
yautakaṃ tu tadā kanyāpakṣaḥ kanyākare dadau ।
varapakṣo varahaste dadau svarṇaṃ dhanaṃ bahu ।।55।।
ratnāni ca maṇīn hārān mauktikān bhūṣaṇāni ca ।
anyānyapi sukauśeyānyambarāṇi rasānapi ।।56।।
daduścānye yathāśaktirdevarṣimānavādayaḥ ।
svasvapradeśaratnāni yānavāhanapātrakam ।।57।।
divyavastu sugandhādi brahmavallyādikā daduḥ ।
evaṃ brahmā sabṛhaspatikastatrāśiṣo dadau ।।58।।
vaivāhikaṃ kārayitvā lājāhomāntamityatha ।
vratādeśaṃ samājñāya śayāte padminīharī ।।59।।
caturthe divase'samāpayat sarvaṃ caturmukhaḥ ।
viyadrājā navaṃ nityaṃ navaṃ pakvānnabhojanam ।।1.400.6 0 ।।
kārayāmāsa sadbhaktyā vaiṣṇavānprāṇato'dhikān ।
yeṣāṃ yeṣāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ yadyad bhojyaṃ nisargajam ।।6 1 ।।
tebhyastebhyastathā datvā parāṃ tṛtimakārayat ।
vividhāni ca peyāni madhurā'mblāni saṃdadau ।।62।।
tāmbūlādimukhaśuddhisādhanāni dadau tathā ।
evaṃ sevāprakāraiśca rājñā tu viyatā hariḥ ।।63।।
harayaḥ koṭisaṃkhyāśca surarṣimunimānavāḥ ।
devā devyo rañjitāśca dāsadāsīprasevakaiḥ ।।64।।
atha brahmā viyadrājamanujñāpya tathā dharām ।
śrīlakṣmīpadminīyuktamāropya garuḍe harim ।।65।।
gantuṃ pracakrame yāvanmahīmānairyutastadā ।
viyadrājā dharaṇī ca vasudānaśca netrayoḥ ।।66 ।।
kanyāviyogajavāriyuktā jātāḥ kṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
padminī jananīpādau spṛṣṭvā kiñcid ruroda ha ।।67।।
āgantavyamiti procya samāśliṣya ca vakṣasi ।
yayau punargaruḍe sā tadā'bhūttu jayadhvaniḥ ।।68।।
vādyaśabdo mahānāsīt sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ।
jayaśabdān pracakruśca nedurdundubhayo'mbare ।।69।।
evaṃ varātikā viṣṇoryayau śrīveṃkaṭācalam ।
gṛhe viśaśramuḥ sarve tarpitā jalabhojanaiḥ ।।1.400.70।।
atha gantumanasaste tuṣṭuvuḥ puruṣottamam ।
śukādayo munivṛndā brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ ।।71 ।।
viyadrājñā preṣitaṃ ca svarṇasihāsanaṃ varam ।
putrīviṣṇvoḥ priyārthaṃ ca svarṇakusūlataṇḍulāḥ ।।72।।
mudgapātrāṇyanekāni ghṛtakuṃbhā'yutāni ca ।
divyāni cūtakadalīnālikeraphalāni ca ।।73 ।।
dhātrīphalāni kūṣmāṇḍarājarambhāphalāni ca ।
śarkarāpeṭikā maṇimuktā gāḥ koṭiśastathā ।।74।।
haṃsenduśuklavājinaścaturdantagajādayaḥ ।
antaḥpuracarā nāryaḥ sevikāścāpyanekaśaḥ ।।75।।
idṃ sarvaṃ maṇḍape yatkanyādānottaraṃ hṛdā ।
saṃkalpitaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ preṣitaṃ tena tatkṣaṇam ।।76 ।।
hṛdā sa varayāmāsa prasannatāṃ hareḥ sadā ।
sevāṃ caraṇayorbhaktiṃ nānyallokasukhādikam ।।77।।
kanyāpakṣāśca ye prāghūrṇikāste bhojitārcitāḥ ।
viyadrājño'numatyā ca yayurlokān svakān punaḥ ।।78।।
atha śrīveṃkaṭanāthaḥ surādikān samarcya vai ।
pūjayitvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhūmnaḥ pareśvarān ।।79।।
virāḍādyānṛṣīnpitṝnmānavān jaḍacetanān ।
svalokagamanāyaivamanumene tataśca te ।।1.400.80।।
jagmurnatvā hariṃ dāsā dāsyaḥ sarvā hi sṛṣṭayaḥ ।
yaśo jagurbhagavataḥ padminībhāgyameva ca ।।8 1 ।।
vedavatī tu yā chāyā sītāṃ prasevya sā khalu ।
apadmā'pyabhavatpadmā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā ।।82।।
yā ye bhaktiṃ prakurvanti prāṇān samarpya sā yathā ।
tāste padmeva jāyante kṛṣṇabhaktā hi śāśvatāḥ ।।83 ।।
gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu padminyā ca śriyā yutaḥ ।
lakṣmyā ca ramayā yukto reme śrībhagavān sadā ।।84।।
āste ca sarvadā kṛṣṇaḥ svāmipuṣkariṇītaṭe ।
veṃkaṭādrau kvacit sākṣād divyālaye bhavatyapi ।।85।।
padminīsahito nāthaḥ kvacicchriyānvitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
kvacillakṣmyā ca sahito ramayā sahitaḥ kvacit ।।86 ।।
bakulamālikādyābhiḥ kvacid veṃkaṭaparvate ।
viharatyeva bhagavān svāminārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।87।।
pativratāśca tāḥ sarvā bhagavatyarpitāḥ sadā ।
patnyaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ prasevante hṛdā dehena karmabhiḥ ।।88।।
padminī padmavāsinyāḥ patiṃ tvāsādya sevate ।
prātaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pūrvaṃ samutthāya prasevate ।।89।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cāṃgamardanaṃ prakaroti ca ।
śayane śrīnivāsaṃ ca toṣayatyeva sevayā ।।1.400.90।।
āśleṣaṃ cūmbanaṃ kāmaṃ dadātyeva patīṣṭadam ।
athotthāya śayanāt saḥ prakṣālya karamānanam ।।91 ।।
jalamuṣṇaṃ karotyeva bhagavatsnānaśuddhaye ।
snātvā dadāti śuddhāpaḥ karānanaviśuddhaye ।। 92।।
dantadhāvanamārdraṃ ca sarasaṃ pāyasaṃ dravam ।
datvā sugandhacūrṇaṃ ca dadāti sajalaṃ ghaṭam ।।93।।
hariḥ śaucādikaṃ kṛtvā prakṣālya ca mṛdā karau ।
gaṇḍūṣān sa vinirvartya snāti suvarṇapaṭṭake ।।94।।
padminī śrīhareraṃgeṣvāmṛdya gandhacūrṇakam ।
tilapiṣṭaṃ puṣpasāraṃ sugandhitailaprabhṛti ।।95।।।
datvā'mṛtairjalairdevaṃ patiṃ snāpayati priyā ।
mārjayati jalaṃ vastrairdhautraṃ dadāti sundaram ।। 96।।
uttarīyaṃ dadātyeva yajñapaṭṭaṃ ca sūtrakam ।
āsanaṃ tvācamanārthaṃ jalaṃ dadāti śārṅgiṇe ।।97।।
dadāti kajjalaṃ netre bhāle puṣṭaṃ sacandrakam ।
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale binduṃ dadāti daṇḍake tathā ।।98।।
keśānprasādhya taile ca datvā kṛtvā sucandanam ।
mukuṭaṃ pradadātyeva hārān suvarṇaratnajān ।।99।।
kaṇṭhe dadāti kṛṣṇasya bāhvoḥ prakoṣṭhayostathā ।
karayoḥ kaṭakau hārau śṛṃkhale valayau tathā ।। 1.400.10 0।।
pradadātyūrmikā aṃguliṣu kaṭyāṃ suśṛṃkhalām ।
pādayornūpure ramye kiṃkiṇīśabdagarjite ।। 101 ।।
vastropānadvarau caraṇayordadāti padminī ।
naktakaṃ ca kare yaṣṭiṃ kānakīṃ mālikāṃ śubhām ।। 1 02।।
chatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ caiva tathā śṛṃgāravastukam ।
dadāti vyajanaṃ cādarśakaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tathā ।। 103 ।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tvabīraṃ cākṣatān puṣpāṇi patrakam ।
dalaṃ jalaṃ phalaṃ bhojyaṃ naivedyaṃ madhuraṃ bahu ।। 1 04।।
yathāruci payo miṣṭaṃ dadhiṃ madhuṃ ca śarkarām ।
tāmbūlaṃ peyamevādibhakṣyaṃ cūrṇādikaṃ śubham ।। 1 05।।
polikāḥ pūrikāścāpi saṃyāvaṃ ghṛtapūrakān ।
parpikān granthakāँścāpi pūpānapūpakāँstathā ।। 1 06।।
bharjakān laḍḍukāँścāpi sukhadāṃ saktukaṃ tathā ।
odanaṃ caṇakāँścāpi mudgān sūpaṃ ghṛtādikam ।।1 07।।
āranālāँstakradugdhadadhiphalarasāँstathā ।
dadāti bhojanārthaṃ sā śrīnivāsāya nityadā ।। 1 08।।
jalaṃ pānārthamanyacca bhakṣyaṃ kandaphalādikam ।
dadāti vastraśuddhyādi karoti kṣālanādikam ।। 109।।
ārārtrikaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavat stavanādikam ।
namaskārān karotyeva madhyāhne'pi tathā niśi ।। 1.400.110 ।।
evaṃ sadā'nuvṛttyā sā sevate śrīḥ ramā yathā ।
yathā lakṣmīḥ sevate ca tathā sevāparāyaṇā ।। 111 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāṃbhareyaṃ pumuttamam ।
śrīnivāsaṃ veṃkaṭeśaṃ padminīsvāminaṃ prabhum ।। 112।।
svayaṃ prasevate dāsīśateṣu satsvapi priyā ।
evaṃ sā janmasāphalyaṃ lebhe padmeva padminī ।। 11 3।।
atha kṛṣṇo bakulāyai varadānamadāt khalu ।
padminīvat variṣye tvāṃ tathā śrīveṃkaṭācale ।। 1 14।।
sakhīmadhye kārayitvā vedīṃ sthitvā ca mādhavaḥ ।
agnau homaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā bakulākaramādade ।। 115।।
padminīprāptisatkāryapratilābhaphalaṃ dadau ।
patnīṃ cakāra bhagavān sakhīṃ bakulamālikām ।। 1 16।।
sāpi pativratā nityaṃ dāsī ca kiṃkarī priyā ।
sevate śrīhariṃ nityānandabhoktrī babhūva ha ।। 1 17।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vedavatyāḥ kathānakam ।
pātivratyaparaṃ yā vai padminī dharaṇīsutā ।। 1 18।।
bhūtvā tvavāpa deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gopālabālakam ।
etadākhyānakaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ satpatiṃ labhet ।। 11 9।।
sampatputrapatiprāptirdhanadhānyāmbarārjanam ।
yaśaḥsattāpratiṣṭhādi śrutvedaṃ prāpyate dhruvam ।। 1.400.1 20।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śrīnivāsabhagavatkṛtaḥ padminyā saha vivāhaḥ, vidhiḥ, yautakaṃ, pātivratyādi ceti nirūpaṇanāmā catuḥśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।40 0।।


← adhyāyaḥ 400 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 401
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 402 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan śrāvitaṃ mahyaṃ samākhyānaṃ sukhapradam ।
vinā tvāṃ kaḥ samartho'sti bhaktecchāpūraṇāya vai । । 1 ।।
pūrvaṃ kena kṛtaṃ te'tra darśanaṃ bhaktibhāvinā ।
kena vā dṛśyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dayālayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vimānaṃ cāpi devārthaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati bhāvini ।
tānme sarvāṃścamatkārān śrīśasya vaktumarhasi ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi camatkārān purāgatān ।
yacchrutvā ca bhaved bhaktirmayi raṃkasya cāpi vai ।। 4 ।।
rājā dīnaḥ paśuḥ pakṣī naro nārī satī sutā ।
yā me bhaktā mahābhāgavatīṃ tāṃ vidadhāmyaham ।। 5 ।।
avaśyaṃ tu bhavitavyaṃ tena madīyakena vai ।
matto yenecchanīyaṃ tu sukhaṃ śāśvatikaṃ priye ।। 6 ।।
bhaviṣyantaṃ suvṛttāntaṃ pravadāmi nibodha me ।
veṃkaṭādrau vasunāmā niṣādo bhaktimānmama ।। 7 ।।
śyāmākakṣetrapālo'sau śyāmākajīvano'bhavat ।
śyāmākataṇḍulān paktvā kṛtvā śarkarayā'nvitān ।। 8 ।।
nivedya śrīnivāsāya śrībhūmisahitāya saḥ ।
bhuṃkte bhāryāsahayutastataḥ kārye pravartate ।। 9 ।।
evaṃ prasādabhakṣyeṇa pavitraḥ sarvadā śuciḥ ।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo jāto bhāryā'pi vaiṣṇavī hyabhūt ।। 1.401.10 ।।
nāmnā citravatī sādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
devaṃ yadvat patiṃ tadvat sevate tadvaśā sadā ।। 11 ।।
snāti pūjāṃ prakaroti japaṃ karoti śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
kṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyati smarati mūrtīḥ śṛṇoti satkathām ।। 12।।
patiṃ devaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā mānayitvā samaṃ sadā ।
ubhayoḥ kiṃkarī -bhūtvā dāsyaṃ karoti sarvathā ।। 13।।
madhyāhne ca niśi sāyaṃ prātarbhojanamīśvare ।
samarpitaṃ jalaṃ puṣpaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhṇāti sā satī ।। 14।।
dhanyā niṣādajātīyā brāhmī divyā hi vartate ।
viprāṇīva sudharmiṣṭhā kulatrayasya tāriṇī ।। 15।।
prāpte kāle putravatī babhūva bhāminī tataḥ ।
vīrarudraitināma cakāra tasya vai pitā ।। 16 ।।
vasuḥ putreṇa sahito bhāryayā bhaktibhaktayā ।
modate svasya bhojyādau santuṣṭo devasevayā ।। 17।।
athaikadā svakaṃ putraṃ śyāmākaṃ pālayeti ca ।
visṛjya kṣetrarakṣārthaṃ patnīyukto vanaṃ yayau ।। 18।।
madhumārgaṇakāryau tāvubhau bhramata ecchikam ।
madhyāhne prāptavantau tau madhu puṣkalameva yat ।। 1 9।।
madhyāhne bālakaḥ pakvaśyāmākaphālikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
gṛhītvā'gnau nidhāyaiva piṣṭvā vṛkṣatale mudā ।।1.401.20।।
parṇe nivedayāmāsa haraye bhojanaṃ jalam ।
naivedyaṃ tatprasādaṃ ca bhojayitvā''sa śāntitaḥ ।।21 ।।
tāvat tatpitarau miṣṭaṃ madhvādāya samāgatau ।
śyāmākān bhakṣitān dṛṣṭvā santarjya sutameva tam ।।22।।
vasurdaṇḍaṃ samudyamya hantuṃ taṃ hastamuddadhe ।
vīrarudrasya hṛdye sthito vai bhagavān svayam ।।23।।
daṇḍaṃ jagrāha hastena cāvirbhūya vasoḥ puraḥ ।
daṇḍo gṛhītaḥ keneti vasuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa ha ।।24।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ divyatejomayaṃ vibhum ।
vasurdaṇḍaṃ parityajya praṇamyovāca taṃ harim ।।25।।
kimidaṃ bhagavan putrarakṣārthaṃ tvaṃ samāgataḥ ।
anena nāśitāḥ paśya pakvaśyāmākaphālikāḥ ।।26।।
daṇḍapātraṃ bhavatyeva punaḥ kuryānna tattathā ।.
itiśrutvā hariḥ prāha putraste bhaktimān mayi ।।।27।।
tvatto'pi me priyatamastasmād rakṣārthamāgataḥ ।
śyāmākā bharjitāścūrṇīkṛtāḥ piṣṭāstataḥ param ।। 28।।
naivedyaṃ me'rpayitvā sa bhuktavān bhaktarāṭ mama ।
śyāmākānāṃ bījabhāvaṃ gatānāmātmanāṃ mayā ।।29।।
kṛtā muktistathā te'pi puṇyaṃ dattaṃ hi śāśvatam ।
yadarpaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ tvatkṛṣīyakaṇādikam ।।1.401.3 0 ।।
atra sarvatra tiṣṭhāmi mama bhaktasya sannidhau ।
rakṣāṃ karomi bhaktasya jāgratau ca suṣuptike ।।3 1 ।।
divāniśaṃ bhaktarakṣākaro'smyeva vaso sadā ।
svāmipuṣkariṇītīre ramye vasāmi sarvathā ।।32।।
ityuktvā bhagavān vasudattaṃ madhu sumiṣṭakam ।
citravatyā'rpitaṃ bṛsyāsanaṃ phalajalādikam ।।3 3।।
gṛhītvā śrīnivāsaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
prahasan vai tirobhūt te trayo vṛkṣatalaṃ śritāḥ ।।34।।
ityeva śrībhagavatā bhaktavaśyena padmaje ।
sākṣāt svadarśanaṃ dattaṃ niṣādāya mahātmane ।।35।।
śṛṇu tvanyāṃ kathāṃ tatra yā jātā samaye tadā ।
tāvat tatra samāyāto yātrikaḥ śūdravarṇakaḥ ।।36।।
mārgeṇa nirgato viṣṇubhaktaḥ pāṇḍyapradeśajaḥ ।
dvādaśavarṣako bālaḥ papraccha vīrarudrakam ।।37।।
mārgo'yaṃ śrīnivāsasya tīrthaṃ gacchati kiṃ na vā? ।
mayā tīrthavidhānārthaṃ gantavyaṃ tatra vidyate ।।38।।
iti pṛṣṭvā śrīnivāsasthānasya vartmanā tu saḥ ।
vīrapradarśitenā'sau gatavān bhāvasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।।39।।
nārāyaṇapurīṃ prāpya śrīvarāhaṃ praṇamya ca ।
hṛdi smṛtvā śrīnivāsaṃ veṃkaṭādrinivāsinam ।।1.401.40 ।।
suvarṇamukharīṃ prāpya snātvā cottīrya tāṃ tataḥ ।
kamale sarasi snātvā tattīrasthaṃ hariṃ balam ।।41 ।।
namaskṛtya vanaṃ prāpya śeṣādriṃ tu yayau hi saḥ ।
jalanirjharaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā kapilāpūjitaṃ śivam ।।।42।।
pūjayitvā cakratīrthe snātvā śrīveṃkaṭācalam ।
śanaiḥ śanairyayau bālaḥ samāruroha parvatam ।।43 । ।
svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ snātvā taṭe ciñcātaroradhaḥ ।
vaikhānasena muninā gopīnāthena pūjitam ।।44।।
ākāśasthaṃ pītanīlākṛtiṃ śrībhūmisevitam ।
śaṃkhacakragadākhaḍgapadmādihetiśobhitam ।।।45।।
sagaruḍaṃ svapakṣābhyāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ vitānakam ।
dadarśa bālaḥ saṃhṛṣṭo babhūvā'tha kṛtārthatām ।।46 ।।
mene tatreva vasituṃ janmasārthakyamityapi ।
evaṃ datvā darśanaṃ śrīnivāso'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।47 ।।
divyavāṇyā vadan putra! mandiraṃ racayātra me ।
śrutvā bālo raṃgadāsastarormūle'vasat sudhīḥ ।।48 ।।
vaikhānasena naivedyaṃ bhikṣāṃ saṃgṛhya viṣṇave ।
samarpyā'tti phalādyaṃ ca naivedye'pyārpayapyatha ।।49। ।
nityaṃ vṛkṣān śanaiśchittvā ciñcābhūruhamantarā ।
ramāyāścampakataruṃ vihāya pārśvagān sthalīm ।।1.401.50 ।।
nirvṛkṣāṃ pracakārā'sau raṃgadāso'tiśobhitām ।
nirmūlāṃ saṃskṛtāṃ kṛtvā bahuvistāramaṇḍalam ।।51 ।।
śilābhittimayadurgarakṣitaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
tatrā'bhitaḥ samudyānaṃ puṣpaphaladrumāśritam ।।52 । ।
cakāra karṇikāmallikābjamandāramālatī ।
kundacampakatulasīḥ kadalīnavaraṃgakāna ।।53 । ।
āmrapanasadrākṣādīn śrīphalādīnavardhayat ।
khanitvā'tisalilaṃ ca kūpaṃ vṛkṣānatarpayat ।।54। ।
ārāmapuṣpamālābhiḥ śrīnivāsamapūjayat ।
evaṃ sevāṃ prakurvan sa tasthau tatraiva taṃ bhajan ।।55 । ।
ekadā tatra sarasi snātuṃ gandharva āyayau ।
kanyābhiḥ sundarībhiḥ suyuvatībhiḥ samaṃ tadā ।।56। ।
jalakrīḍāṃ karoti sma divi nyasya vimānakam ।
paśyan śrīraṃgadāso'pi mumoha kanyakāsu saḥ ।।57।।
mugdhavad darśanaṃ tāsāṃ kṛtvā stabdho'bhavad yataḥ ।
vyasmaranmālyamālādi granthituṃ jaḍavattadā ।।58।।
āmadhyāhnaṃ tathā tasthau mālāṃ puṣpāṇi nā'smarat ।
gandharvo'pi khelayitvā kāntābhiḥ saha tadbahiḥ ।।59।।
vinirgatya vimānena yayau sa dhanadālayam ।
raṃgadāso'pi saṃsnātvā svastho bhūtvā ca mālikāḥ ।।1.401.60 ।।
grathitvā''dāya puṣpāṇi śrīnivāsālayaṃ yayau ।
tatratthapūjakenoktaṃ kimadya cirakāryasi ।।6 1 ।।
na vaddhā mālikā mitra! pūjākālo'pi nirgataḥ ।
evamukto'pi nā'vocadraṃgadāso hi lajjayā ।।62।।
tadā taṃ śrīnivāso vai svayaṃ provāca lajjitam ।
raṃgadāsa! hṛdye te smaryante tāstu kanyakāḥ ।।।63 ।।
mama māyāvimohena mā lajjāṃ vaha bhaktarāṭ ।
gandharvarājavad rājā bhavitā'si mahītale ।।64।।
bhuṃkṣva bhogān bahumatān divyāँstṛptipradāँstataḥ ।
prākāraṃ ca vimānaṃ me mandiraṃ kārayiṣyasi ।।65।।
tato muktiṃ pradāsyāmi bhaktāya sevakāya te ।
atraiva kuru sevāṃ tvamāśarīravimokṣaṇāt ।।66 ।।
ityuktvā śrīnivāsaśca viṣṇurjagrāha mālikām ।
raṃgadāsaḥ pūjayitvā''rāmaṃ punaḥ samāyayau ।।67।।
sāgraṃ śatābdaṃ saṃjīvya sevitvā śrīnivāsakam ।
śarīraṃ tadvihāyaiva jātaḥ somakule nṛpaḥ ।।68।।
jātismaro divyadṛṣṭistoṇḍamāniti nāmataḥ ।
sauvīrākhyanṛpaputro nandinījananībhavaḥ ।।6 9।।
saḥ pañcavarṣakaścāsīd bhagavadbhaktisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।
sarvabhaktipuṣṭidātṛsadguṇādisumaṇḍitaḥ ।।1.401.70 ।।
pāṃḍyasya tanayāṃ cārupadmākhyāṃ sumanoharām ।
upayeme tathā'nyāśca kanyāḥ kāmasvarūpiṇīḥ ।।7 1 ।।
reme nārāyaṇapattanādhipastoṇḍamānnṛpaḥ ।
athaikadā yayau śrīveṃkaṭādrau mṛgayāmanu ।।72।।
dadarśa gajayūtheśaṃ grahītuṃ tamanudrutaḥ ।
suvarṇamukharīṃ tīrtvā śukaṃ natvā ca reṇukām ।।73 ।।
valmīkākāradevīṃ ca natvā sa paścimāṃ yayau ।
kaṃcicchukaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ jighṛkṣustamanudrataḥ ।।74।।
śuko vadan śrīnivāsa iti drāk parvataṃ yayau ।
rājā'pyanudravan kīraṃ vekaṭādriṃ samāruhat ।।75 ।।
agre gacchan haritaṃ sa śyāmākakṣetrameyīvān ।
kṣetrapālastoṇḍamānaṃ jñātvā satkṛtimācarat ।।76 ।।
toṇḍamāno'pi papraccha kṣetrapaṃ kaḥ śuko'sti saḥ ।
kṣetrapaḥ prāha rājendra! śrīnivāsapriyaḥ sadā ।।77।।
pārśvavartī sadā tasya śrībhūmibhyāṃ vivardhitaḥ ।
svāmipuṣkariṇītīre sadā''ste harisannidhau ।।78।।
divā vihṛtyā'drivane sāyaṃ gacchati mandiram ।
grahītuṃ śakyate naiva kenāpi sa śuko nṛpa! ।। 79 । ।
ityuktvā bhūbhṛtā sākaṃ kṣetrapo mandiraṃ yayau ।
snātvā svāmipuṣkariṇyāṃ bilvamūlasthitaṃ prabhum । ।1.401.8 0 । ।
suśṛṃgārisanmūrtiṃ śrībhūyuktaṃ dadarśa ha ।
valmīkagūḍhapādābjamājānupuruṣottamam ।।8 1 ।।
kṣetrapo bhūpatiścobhau vavandatuḥ praṇematuḥ ।
kṣetrapaḥ śyāmākapākaṃ nivedya haraye'rghakam । ।82 । ।
dadau rājñe ca śiṣṭārdhaṃ tataḥ kṣetraṃ punaryayau ।
toṇḍamāno'pyekarātrimuṣitvā reṇukāvanam । ।8 3 ।।
caitraśuklanavamyāmānarca gatvā sa reṇukām ।
haviṣyānnaṃ paramānnaṃ sopaskaraṃ dadau nṛpaḥ ।।84।।
devī tuṣṭā varaṃ rājñe dadau rājyamakaṇṭakam ।
bhavitā tava nāmnā ca rājadhānī mamā'ntike ।।85 ।।
śrīnivāsaprasādasya pātraṃ ciraṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
atha toṇḍī śukaṃ gatvā natvā tasya mukhāttathā ।।86 । ।
māhātmyaṃ padmasarasaḥ śrutavān pāpanāśakam ।
purātra padmayā sākaṃ viṣṇuścakre tapaḥ param ।।87।।
devaiḥ stuto mahāviṣṇurnāma padmāsaro'karot ।
itiśrutvā yayau toṇḍī rājadhānīṃ pituḥ purīm । ।88 ।।
pitrā'bhiṣikto rājye sve vasunā'tha vasustataḥ ।
vārāhavalmīkayātrākaraṇārthaṃ yayau mudā । ।89 ।।
tatra vārāhabhagavān rātrau nirgatya tatsthalāt ।
śyāmākānatti cā'dṛśyo divā viśati tatsthale । । 1.401.90 ।।
kṣetrapaḥ khanayāmāsa valmīkaṃ valmīkaṃ vīkṣya tattathā ।
valmīkād vārāharūpo bhagavānutthito'bhavat । । 91 ।।
kṣetrapasannidhau prāha rājānaṃ mama mandiram ।
kārayātra tava putradvārā'tra nivasāmyaham । । 92 । ।
valmīkaṃ kṛṣṇagokṣīraiḥ kṣālayitvā tadutthite ।
śilātale tu vārāhaṃ cotkṛtya tatra mandire । । 93 ।।
pratiṣṭhāpya ca manmūrtiṃ prapūjaya sadā nṛpa! ।
ityuktvā śrīvarāhastu tiro'bhūt sa vasustataḥ । ।94। ।
gatvā gṛhaṃ toṇḍamānābhidhaṃ prāha sutaṃ kuru ।
mandiraṃ śrīvarāhasya mūrtiṃ sthāpaya tatra ca । । 95 । ।
toṇḍamāno'pi rātrau vai svapne sarvaṃ dadarśa tat ।
prātarutthāya gā nītvā yayau valmīkasannidhau । । 96 ।।
kṣālayāmāsa dugdhaiśca śilāyāṃ ca varāhakam ।
kārayitvā sthāpayitvā mandire taṃ paraṃ prabhum ।।97।।
pūjāṃ vai kārayāmāsa rājadhānīṃ cakāra saḥ ।
svapne dṛṣṭaṃ bilaṃ tena valmīkasannidhau tu yat ।।98।।
bilamantaḥpure kutvā prākāraṃ samakārayat ।
āśīrvaco'nusāreṇa nirmame tatra pattanam ।।99।।
ciñcāṃ ca campakaṃ cāyaṃ rarakṣa durgamadhyataḥ ।
nityaṃ bilena cāgatya devaṃ natvā sa toṇḍamān । । 1.401.10 0।।
rājyaṃ cakāra dharmeṇa pṛthvīṃ jigāya tatsthitaḥ ।
toṇḍamadvaṃśajo rājā nāmnā nārāyaṇaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 101 ।।
vimānaṃ divyamevātra prākāre'kārayacchubham ।
divyamadṛśyamevaitad bhaktamātrā'valokitam ।। 1 02।।
abhajacchrīhariṃ tatra vārāhaṃ divyarūpiṇam ।
gopālabālakaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kāṃbhareyaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।। 103 ।।
śrīraṃgaṃ śrīveṃkaṭeśaṃ cā'bhajannityameva saḥ ।
ityuktaṃ te mahālakṣmi! pūrvākhyānamanuttamam ।। 1 04।।
śrīraṃgā'parajanmasthatoṇḍamatkāritaṃ mahat ।
mandiraṃ yatra bhagavān vārāhaḥ śrīdharāyutaḥ ।। 1 05।।
vartate darśanaṃ cāpi dadāti sāttvatāya saḥ ।
athā'nyadapi sāmarthyaṃ śṛṇu te kathayāmi ca ।। 106 ।।
dākṣiṇātyo dvijaḥ patnīsahitastīrthavāñcchayā ।
samāyāto garbhavatīṃ patnīṃ gantuṃ tadā'kṣamām ।। 1 07।।
vilokya vīraśarmā saḥ rājānaṃ samupāgamat ।
akathayacca tatsarvaṃ tīrthe vighnatamaṃ yathā ।। 1 08।।
śṛṇu rājan mama patnī gurviṇī bhajanonmukhī ।
saṃsthāpyaināṃ gṛhe te ca tīrthaṃ nirvartayāmyaham ।। 1 09।।
tāvattvaṃ rakṣaya svāmivratāṃ lakṣmyabhidhā priyām ।
kāśīprabhṛtitīrthāni kṛtvā yāvannivartaye ।। 1.401.110 ।।
ityuktvā tāṃ visṛjyaiva brāhmaṇo niryayau tataḥ ।
rājñā'nnādi pradāpyaiva vāṭikāyāṃ nivāsitā ।। 111 ।।
viprasyāgamapūrvaṃ sā mṛtā jvareṇa pīḍitā ।
brāhmaṇo'pyakarot padbhyāṃ dīrghakālikayātrikām ।। 11 2।।
navamāsā vyatītā vai yatra yatra gato yathā ।
gaṃgāṃ kāśīṃ prayāgaṃ ca gayāṃ sāketapattanam । । 113 ।।
badarikāśramaṃ śālagrāmaṃ ca puṣkaraṃ tathā ।
sarasvatīṃ kuśasthalīṃ raivataṃ somanāthakam ।। 1 14।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścāpi tapatīṃ narmadāṃ tathā ।
kukumavāpikāṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ gokarṇatīrthakam ।। 1 15।।
gomatīṃ ceti tīrthāni kṛtvā tu caitrake hi saḥ ।
māse śuklaikādaśyāṃ sa rājānaṃ prati cāyayau ।। 116 ।।
brāhmaṇī kuśalā cāstītyuvāca nṛpatiṃ tadā ।
rājā tatra yayau yatra rakṣitā brāhmaṇī mṛtā ।। 1 17।।
dṛṣṭā rājñā mṛtā sā tu śīghraṃ bilena mandiram ।
śrīveṃkaṭeśaṃ gatavān rājā prāha tadā harim ।। 1 18।।
bhagavan! brāhmaṇī vipranyāsarūpā mṛtāsti sā ।
saṃśapsyati sa vipro māṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari ।। 1 19।।
śrīnivāsena saṃproktaṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ prasādajam ।
dvādaśyāmasthisarasi snāpayaināṃ tataḥ khalu ।। 1.401.120।।
prāptajīvā yathāpūrvā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
śavaṃ nītvā nṛpastatrā''yayau yatrā'sthipalvalam ।। 121 ।।
jalenāplāvya kuṇapaṃ rājā sasmāra tāṃ satīm ।
tāvat divyaśarīrā sā nṛparājñyaparā yathā ।। 1 22।।
samutthitā sagarbhā sā prasannā tadavasthikā ।
ānīya śīghraṃ viprāya dadau vismayamāpa saḥ ।। 123 ।।
na garbho galitaḥ so'yaṃ pratāpo'sti hareḥ khalu ।
tato'pare dine tasyāḥ prasūtiḥ samajāyata ।।1 24।।
putro devasamo jāto nītvā māsottaraṃ dvijaḥ ।
rājñā pradattadānādi gṛhītvā svagṛha yayau ।। 1 25।।
ityuktaste camatkāro bhagavadbhaktikāriṇaḥ ।
atha kṛṣṇaḥ śrīnivāso rājānaṃ punarabravīt ।। 1 26।।
naivedyānte pratyahaṃ me'rcanaṃ suvarṇapadmakaiḥ ।
kuru rājan yadyadiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ te vai bhaviṣyati ।। 1 27।।
rājā toṇḍī cakāraivaṃ nityaṃ kamalapūjanam ।
ekadā tulasīpuṣpaṃ tvapaśyatsa tu mṛnmayam ।। 1 28।।
vismitaḥ śrīhariṃ rājā papraccha ko'nuyāti hi ।
hariḥ prāha kulālo me bhakto'rcayati māṃ tathā ।। 129।।
svagṛhe'rcayati kṣmeśa! tadaṅgīkriyate mayā ।
itiśrutvā yayau kurvatpuraṃ draṣṭuṃ kulālakam ।। 1.401.130 ।।
bhīmākhyaṃ taṃ tathābhūtaṃ pūjayantaṃ vilokya ca ।
rājā tu vismayaṃ prāpa kulālastu svabhāryayā ।। 131 ।।
divyarūpo vimānena patnyā viṣṇupadaṃ yayau ।
yadā pūjāprasiddhatvaṃ rājñastvadbhuvanāgamaḥ ।। 1 32।।
tadā muktiriti pūrvaṃ śrīnivāsena bhāṣitam ।
tattathaiva tu saṃjātaṃ varṇayituṃ na śakyate ।। 1 33।।
śrīnivāsacamatkārān bhaktecchāpūrakān priye! ।
paṭhanācchravaṇād baddho mukto bhavati padmaje ।। 1 34।। iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye toṇḍamānanṛpakṛtaṃ śrīvārāhabhūmikāyāṃ
saprākārapattanam, mṛtāyā brāhmaṇyāḥ sajīvanatā, bhīmakulālakṛtamṛttikāpuṣpasvīkārastato bhāryāyuktakulālasya mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikā'dhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।40 1 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 401 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 402
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 403 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha lakṣmi! śṛṇu rājā toṇḍī sutāya rājyakam ।
datvā tapo'rthamagamat tatāpā''rādhanaṃ tapaḥ ।। 1 ।।
tapyamāne hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pratyakṣo'bhavadacyutaḥ ।
garuḍaṃ svaṃ samāruhya śrībhūmipadminīyutaḥ ।। 2 ।।
toṇḍaṃ nṛpaṃ samāgamya prāhā''rādhanayā tava ।
tuṣṭo'smi vada me bhakta! kiṃ karomi tvadarthakam ।। 3 ।।
śrutvā toṇḍanṛpastaṃ vai kṛtvā prāñjalimāha yat ।
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhivarjite tvakṣare tava ।। 4 ।।
loke vastuṃ samicchāmi varamenaṃ pradehi me ।
tāvatkalevaraṃ tyaktvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇekṣaṇaḥ ।। 5 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasāmyadeho bhūtvā sa bhaktarāṭ ।
divyaṃ dhāmapradaṃ śubhraṃ vimānaṃ tvāruroha vai ।। 6 ।।
muktaiḥ saṃstūyamāno'sau sārūpyaṃ prāpya śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
punarāvṛttirahitaṃ mamā'kṣarapadaṃ yayau ।। 7 ।।
svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe nityaṃ vasāmi padmaje ।
puṣkariṇyāṃ kṛtasnānādaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 8 ।।
ātmavidyā bhavet sākṣānmuktiścāpi caturvidhā ।
tulāpuruṣadānasya phalaṃ svāminiṣevaṇāt ।। 9 ।।
gosahasradānapuṇyaṃ svāmitīrthanimajjanāt ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāptiḥ svāmitīrthe pradānakāt ।। 1.402.1 0।।
prajñā lakṣmīryaśaḥ sampaddharmo jñānaṃ viraktatā ।
manaḥśuddhirbhaveyuśca svāmitīrthā'dhivāsataḥ ।। 11 ।।
brahmahatyāsurāpānagurudāragamādikam ।
suvarṇasteyamāṃsādi hiṃsādoṣādikaṃ tathā ।। 1 2।।
naśyatyeva na sandehaḥ svāmitīrthe vratāditaḥ ।
aho maurkhyamaho maurkhyaṃ janānāṃ tadbhavaḥ khalu ।। 1 3।।
svāmitīrthe sthite'nyatra ramate yanmanaḥ khalam ।
aho mohasya māhātmyaṃ gṛhatīrthavināśakṛt ।। 14।।
snātasya svāmitīrthe tu nāntakādbhayamasti hi ।
stuvanti ca praśaṃsanti spṛśanti ca namanti ca ।। 15।।
pibanti snānti paśyanti ye teṣāṃ nāntakād bhayam ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ caitacchrīnivāsakṛtālayam ।। 16।।
śrībhūsevitakṛṣṇādhivāsitaṃ dhāmasadṛśam ।
tatsarvaṃ veṃkaṭaśailadṛṣṭipātabhuvastalam ।। 17।।
puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ nirvāṇapadadṃ sarvato'dhikam ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ cānyāṃ dharmaguptasya bhūbhṛtaḥ ।। 18।।
somavaṃśe nandarājñaḥ putro dharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
dharmagupta iti khyāto'bhavannītiparāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 9।।।
īje bahuvidhairyajñairdadau dānānyanekaśaḥ ।
prajā dharmaparāścāsan pātivratyaparāḥ striyaḥ ।।1.402.20।।
athaikadā'śvamāruhya dharmagupto vanaṃ yayau ।
mṛgayāmanucarato niśā'bhūt sa tato drumam ।।।2 1 ।।
adhiruhya viśaśrāma ṛkṣastatra samāgataḥ ।
anudrutaḥ sa siṃhena ṛkṣo'rohattu pādapam ।।22।।
uvāca bhūpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā maraṇatrāsakampitaḥ ।
mā bhītiṃ yāhi janarāḍ! vatsyāvo rajanīmiha ।।23।।
siṃho bhayaṃkaraścātra vṛkṣamūlamupāgataḥ ।
rātryardhaṃ bhaja nidrāṃ tvaṃ rakṣyamāṇo mayā sukhī ।।24।।
tataḥ prasuptaṃ māṃ rakṣa śarvaryardhaṃ surakṣaka! ।
ityākarṇya dharmagupte supte ṛkṣaṃ harirjagau ।। 25।।
vayaṃ vanecarāḥ sarve catuṣpādā na mānavāḥ ।
kimasmābhirmānavena nṛpo me tyajyatāmayam ।।26।।
te me khādyaṃ prapūrṇaṃ saṃbhaviṣyatyapavarjyatām ।
ṛkṣaḥ prāha tadā siṃhaṃ dharmayuktaṃ sunītimat ।।27।।
viśvāsaghātināṃ loke mahatyadhogatirmatā ।
mānavāḥ paśavaḥ kīṭāḥ pakṣiṇo bālakāḥ striyaḥ ।। 28।।
vanyā grāmyāstathā''raṇyā viśvastā nivasanti vai ।
jīvantyāśrayaviśvastāścatuṣpāttvaṃ na kāraṇam ।। 29।।
dvipāttvaṃ vā sapakṣatvaṃ yāvadviśvāsajīvanam ।
viśvāso hi paro dharmastaṃ kathaṃ nu tyajāmyaham ।।1.402.3 0।।
svārthī viśvāsadharmaṃ tu santyajya ghātakī bhavet ।
na mayā tatprakartavyaṃ gaccha tyaja pratīkṣaṇam ।।3 1 ।।
nahi mitradruhāṃ pāpaṃ naśyed yajñāyutairapi ।
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ kadācinniṣkṛtirbhavet ।।32।।
viśvāsaghātināṃ pāpaṃ vinaśyenna kadācana ।
na merurbhāravāँstāvad yāvad bhāro'sti ghātini ।।33 ।।
hiṃsā paratarā'dharmasvarūpā nāśadāyinī ।
viśvāsahiṃsanaṃ tatra pāpā'tipāpato'dhikam ।।34।।
tasmād gaccha vanādanyadvanaṃ te bhojanaṃ milet ।
ityuktaḥ sa vanarājo maunaṃ kṛtvā vyavasthitaḥ ।।35।।
ardharātrigate kāle prabuddho nṛpanandanaḥ ।
suṣvāpa sukhataḥ ṛkṣaḥ śākhāyāṃ pratyayānvitaḥ ।।36।।
siṃhaḥ prāha nṛpaṃ rājan! kiṃ tavā'nena śākhinā ।
mama bhakṣyaṃ rakṣasi tvaṃ nūnaṃ pāpī bhavasyapi ।।37।।
yathā rājā prajānāṃ tvaṃ tathā vanyanṛpo'smyaham ।
prajāstu sarvathā nītyā bhakṣyā rājñāṃ vinirmitāḥ ।।38।।
ayaṃ vanyamṛgastvadya mama bhakṣya upasthitaḥ ।
tavā''śrayaṃ samāsādyā'rohadvṛkṣaṃ hi ṛkṣakaḥ ।।3 9।।
bhojane me bhavān rājā rodhakṛd vartate'dya vai ।
kiṃ tavā'nena ṛkṣeṇa tyajasva mama bhojanam ।।1.402.40 ।।
anyathā prātarevāpi divā vā bhakṣayāmi tam ।
tvāṃ tathā vai bhakṣayiṣye samāhūyā'nyamadvidhān ।।41 ।।
evamukto'tha siṃhena rājā suptamaśaṃkitam ।
svāṃkanyastaśiraskaṃ tamṛkṣaṃ tatyāja vṛkṣataḥ ।।42।।
tāvat sa bhrāmaṇīṃ kṛtvā śākhāyāmeva pādape ।
puṇyavaśādūrdhvabhāge samāruhya ruroda ha ।
rājā siṃhaśca taṃ papracchatuḥ kasmāddhi rodiṣi ।।43 ।।
bhayaṃ dūraṃ gataṃ te'dya vad vānara! hṛdgatam ।
ṛkṣaḥ prāhobhayaṃ nā'haṃ madarthaṃ rodimi prabho ।।44।।
vane vanyā hi viśvastā vasanti bahuvānarāḥ ।
etādṛśaṃ nṛpaṃ prāpya viśvāsaghātinaṃ śaṭham ।।45 ।।
bhaviṣyanti hatāśceti kṛtvā rodimi kesarin ।
sanmukhaṃ maraṇaṃ bhūyān mā'kasmān mṛtyurastu naḥ ।।46 ।।
ahaṃ na vānaro rājan kintvasmi bhṛguvaṃśajaḥ ।
dhyānakāṣṭhā'bhidhaṣirvai kāmarūpadharo vane ।।47।।
kasmādanāgasaṃ suptamatyākṣīnmāṃ bhavānnṛpa ।
macchāpādati conmatto bhava tvaṃ cara bhūtale ।।48।।
iti śaptvā tataḥ siṃhaṃ prāhārṣistvaṃ purā'nagha ।
kuberasacivo hyāsīḥ sakhījanapuraḥsaraḥ ।।49।।
himādrau viharad daivād gatavān gautamāśramam ।
vivastraṃ tvāṃ vilokyaiva gautamaḥ śāpamāsṛjat ।।1.402.50।।
vivastraḥ paśucaryastvaṃ mamāśramasya sannidhau ।
kathaṃ vai duṣṭa carasi bhava duṣṭo'tihiṃsrakaḥ ।।51 ।।
nagnasiṃho bhava cātra romādivarjitaḥ khalu ।
itiśāpena siṃhastvaṃ tuṣṭāvarṣiṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।।52 ।
sa cāha te yadā rājño dharmaguptasya vṛkṣake ।
dhyānakāṣṭhasya sadbhāgyād darśanaṃ vai bhaviṣyati ।। 53 ।।
tadā śāpāttava mokṣo bhaviṣyatyeva mā śucaḥ ।
bhadranāmā'si bhṛtyastvaṃ dhyānājjānāmyahaṃ hi tat ।।54 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa nanāmainamṛṣiśreṣṭhaṃ nṛpaṃ tathā ।
siṃhatvaṃ ca parityajya drāgabhūd yakṣarūpadhṛk ।।55 ।।
jātismarastadā sarvaṃ vijñāyarṣikṛpāvaśāt ।
āgatena vimānena divyena dyāṃ yayau hi saḥ ।।56 ।।
ṛṣirgato vanaṃ naijaṃ rājā matto'bhavad vane ।
vicacāra paśucaryastamanveṣṭuṃ prajā yayuḥ । 57 । ।
vane bhramantamunmattamāninyurnarmadātaṭam ।
jaiminerantikaṃ prāpya jagaduścāparādhanam ।।58 ।
śrutvā jaiminirāhaitān suvarṇamukharītaṭe ।
veṃkaṭādrau svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe'tipāvane । 59 । ।
snāpayantu nṛpaṃ tena śāpamukto bhaviṣyati ।
evaṃ gatvā kṛtavanto janāstadrājyavāsinaḥ । 1.402.60 । ।
dharmagupto'bhavatsvastho dhanaratnādi saṃdadau ।
dhānyakṣetrāṇi ratnāni veṃkaṭeśasya saṃdadau । ।61 । ।
evaṃ rājā'bhavacchāpānmukto rājyaṃ cakāra ha ।
svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthaṃ vartate evamarthadam । ।62 । ।
dharmadaṃ kāmadaṃ mokṣapradaṃ duḥkhavināśakam ।
bhūtapretapiśācādyunmādā naśyanti tajjalāt । ।6 3 । ।
snānātpānātsparśanācca darśanād vandanādapi ।
naśyanti pātakānyeva smaraṇādapi padmaje । ।64। ।
svāmitīrthaṃ svāmitīrthaṃ svāmitīrthamiti priye! ।
triḥpaṭhanto narāḥ snātāḥ svāmisnānaphalaṃ tathā । ।65 । ।
padaṃ vai brahmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ labhante nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya tatra snānaphalaṃ bhavet । ।66 । ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ tvanyāṃ sumaterbrāhmaṇasya vai ।
mahārāṣṭre yajñadevasutaḥ sumatināmakaḥ । ।67 ।।
gṛhaṃ tyaktvotkalaṃ deśaṃ gato duṣṭasamāgamāt ।
kāṃcit kirātīṃ sa dṛṣṭvā mumoha tadgṛhe sa ca ।।68 । ।
tasthau reme ca bubhuje cauryaṃ cakre papau surām ।
kaṃcidvipraṃ sa niśithe khaḍgena hatavānatha ।।69 ।।
dravyamādāya viprasya kirātībhavanaṃ yayau ।
kṛṣṇavarṇā vrahmahatyā vavalge taṃ bhayaṃkarī ।।1.402.70 ।।
tayonmattaḥ sa sumatiḥ prayayau svagṛhaṃ prati ।
pitaraṃ rakṣa rakṣeti tvākrośan śaraṇaṃ yayau ।।71 ।।
brahmahatyā tajjanakaṃ samuvāca tadā ṛtam ।
asau surāpī steyī ca brahmahā cātipātakī ।। 72।।
mātṛdrohī pitṛdrohī nītityāgī vṛṣojjhitaḥ ।
kirātīsaṃgaduṣṭaśca muñcainaṃ tu durātmakam ।।73।।।
no cet tvāṃ tava bhāryā ca sutamenaṃ tathetarān ।
bhakṣayiṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ ca mā kulaṃ hantumarhasi ।।74।।
ekaṃ tyaktvā kulaṃ rakṣetyuktvā'grahīdgale tu tam ।
tāvat tatra samāyāto durvāsāstu yadṛcchayā ।।75।।
stutastairāha pitaraṃ svāmipuṣkariṇījale ।
saṃsnāpaya pramucyeta hatyāyā nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।76 ।।
sākaṃ durvāsasā so'tha yayau puṣkariṇījale ।
snāto hatyāvinaṣṭā ca pūto babhūva bhūsuraḥ ।।77।।
evaṃprabhāvaṃ tattīrthaṃ pāpavṛkṣakuṭhārakam ।
śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ cāpi vājapeyaphalapradam ।।78।।
veṃkaṭe kṛṣṇatīrthe'pi snātvātpāpātpramucyate ।
pitṝnmātṝrguruँścāvamanyamāno ye khalāśayāḥ ।।79।।
te'pi vai kṛṣṇatīrthe'smin śuddhyanti snānamātrataḥ ।
kṛṣṇanāmā muniḥ kaścidakarodvai tapaḥ śubham ।।1.402.80 ।।
veṃkaṭādrau hariṃ dhyāyan kṛtavāँstīrthamuttamam ।
rāmakṛṣṇābhidhaścānyo munirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tapaścakāra kaṭhinaṃ hyanekaśatavatsarān ।
valmīkākrāntadeho'pi svasthānānna cacāla saḥ ।।82।।
vāsavo meghavṛṣṭiṃ ca cakāra saptavāsarān ।
valmīkasyopariṣṭhādvai nipapāta mahāśaniḥ ।।83 ।।
valmīkaśikharaṃ dhvastaṃ munistvasthyavaśeṣitaḥ ।
mahendreṇa tadā dṛṣṭo rakṣārthaṃ tasya mādhavaḥ ।।84।।
kāṃbhareyo mahāsvāmī gopālabālakaḥ svayam ।
śaṃkhacakrādisaṃyuktaḥ āvirbabhūva cāha tam ।।85।।
uttiṣṭha bhadraṃ te bhakta! tapasā'haṃ pratoṣitaḥ ।
atra tīrthe makarasthādivākare tu yo janaḥ ।।86 ।।
snāti vā paurṇamāsyāṃ vā madāvirbhāvasaddine ।
matpārṣadāḥ koṭisūryaprabhāste yanti matpadam ।।87।।
tvannāmnā ca parāṃ khyātiṃ gamiṣyati sutīrthakam ।
ityuktvā śrīnivāsaśca tatraivāntaradhīyata ।।88।।
rāmakṛṣṇau yayau dhāma śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ hareḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi tīrthaṃ mokṣapradaṃ nvidam ।।89।।
jaladānaṃ cānnadānaṃ vastradānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ।
kartavyaṃ vaiṃkaṭe tīrthe śāśvataṃ vai bhaveddhi tat ।।1.402.90।।
hemāṃgo nāma rājarṣirabhūdikṣvākuvaṃśajaḥ ।
gavāṃ dānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ svarṇadānādikaṃ dadau ।।91 ।।
tenā'dattaṃ jalaṃ tvekaṃ sukhalabhyadhiyā priye! ।
amūlyaṃ sarvato labhyaṃ taddātuḥ kiṃ phalaṃ bhavet ।।92।।
alabhyadāne puṇyaṃ syādityavādītsa yuktitaḥ ।
dīnānānarca sa vyaṃgāndaridrānvṛttikarṣitān ।।9 3 ।।
nā''narca śrotriyānviprānsādhūँśca brahmavādinaḥ ।
prakhyātānpūjayantyeva sarve lokāḥ samutsukāḥ ।।94।।
daridrāṇāṃ gatiścāhaṃ tasmātte maddayāspadāḥ ।
iti duṣṭeṣu pātreṣu dattavān tena tasya vai ।।95 ।।
cātakasya trijanmāni gṛdhrasyaikajanustathā ।
śunaśca saptajanmāni hyabhavaँśca tato gṛhe ।।96 ।।
makṣikākhādayitrī vai gṛhagodhā vyajāyata ।
mithilādipatergehe śrutadevaḥ samāgamat ।।97।।
tena dṛṣṭā hi ṛṣiṇā hyaṣṭāśītisamāmayī ।
śrutadevaṃ prasaṃpūjya rājā taccaraṇāmṛtam ।। 98।।
mūrdhnā'vahat tadopkṣitairbindubhiḥ prokṣitā'pi sā ।
sadyo jātismarā jātā trāhi trāhītyuvāca sā ।। 99 ।।
ahamikṣvākukulajo hemāṃgaśca nṛpo'bhavam ।
pakṣapātaḥ kṛto dāne jalaṃ datta na vai tathā ।। 1.402.10 0।।
tathā pātraṃ samutsṛjya hyapātre pratipāditam ।
jvalantamagnimutsṛjya bhasmanyeva hutaṃ mayā । । 101 ।।
tulasīṃ tu samutsṛjya viṣavallī prasiñcitā ।
paṃgvādyā ye'pyanāthādyā dayāpātraṃ hi kevalam ।। 1 02।।
tapovijñānasadvidyāśrayā viṣṇusvarūpiṇaḥ ।
pūjanīyā jñāninaśca priyā viṣṇoḥ sadaiva te । । 103 ।।
tasmāj jñānī sadā pūjyastasmai deyaṃ phalāptaye ।
pūjyātpūjyataraḥ sopi svargamokṣaprado bhavet ।। 1 04।।
na jalaṃ vai mayā dattaṃ sādhavo vā na sevitāḥ ।
tena me durgatiśceyaṃ jātā svarge gate'pi vai ।। 105 ।।
etacchrutvā veṃkaṭādrestīrthasnānaphalaṃ muniḥ ।
godhāyai dattavān sā cā'pyekadivasapuṇyataḥ ।। 106 ।।
divyarūpadharo divyavimānavarasaṃsthitaḥ ।
stutvā yayau svargalokaṃ jaladānaphalānvitaḥ ।। 1 07।।
jalaṃ svarge tataḥ prāpa tasmājjalādidānakam ।
kartavyameva sadbhaktyā mānavaiḥ satataṃ bhuvi । । 1 08।।
atha kālāntare so'bhūt kakutsthākhyo mahīpatiḥ ।
saptadvīpapatirbhūtvā viṣṇoḥ sāyujyamāptavān ।। 1 09।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pātramāhātmyamuttamam ।
jaladānādikaṃ cāpi śravaṇāccāpi tatphalam ।। 1.402.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye veṃkaṭādrau toṇḍamānnāmarājñaḥ, dharmaguptarājñaḥ ṛkṣaviśvāsaghātinaḥ, sumatināmakaviprasya rāmakṛṣṇarṣeḥ, hemāṃgasya ca muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।402 । ।

adhyāyaḥ 403
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 404 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrīryatrāṃśasvarūpeṇa sītāchāyāsvarūpiṇī ।
vedavatī svayaṃ lakṣmīsvarūpā''virbabhūva yā ।। 1 ।।
tatkṣetrasya sumāhātmyaṃ kena vaktuṃ hi śakyate ।
veṃkaṭādrirbrahmadhāmasvarūpo'sti yadāśrayāt ।। 2 ।।
yatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo rājate vai svayaṃprabhuḥ ।
yatra varāhabhagavān sākṣād bhavati vai muhuḥ ।। 3 ।।
yatra bhaktāśca jāyante vaiṣṇavā lokatārakāḥ ।
yadbhūmeḥ kaṃkarakaṇo'pyasya lokasya tārakaḥ ।। 4 ।।
yadbhūmisthalavāryādya mahāpātakanāśakam ।
brahmadhāmapradaṃ sākṣāt kṛṣṇasvāmipradaṃ śubham ।। 5 ।।
yatra pativratā nāryo vartante muktatāṃ gatāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavyaśca mahāsādhvyaḥ svāmisevāparāyaṇāḥ ।। 6 ।।
patyurbhaktāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyo hi tā matāḥ ।
rādhālakṣmīsamāḥ sarvāḥ pārvatīmāṇikīsamāḥ ।। 7 ।।
prabhāramāsamā jayāvijayādisamā hi tāḥ ।
yaiḥ pūjito ramādyābhiryutaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ ।। 8।।
taiḥ svargaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣasthānamāvṛttivarjitam ।
prāptameva na sandeho mamānugrahaṇāt priye! ।। 9 ।।
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni brahmāṇḍāntargatāni ca ।
veṃkaṭādrau vasantyeva tāni kṛṣṇapadāmbuje ।। 1.403.10 ।।
tasya devasya sevārthaṃ munayaśceśvarāstathā ।
devāśca ṛṣayaḥ siddhā yogino yatayastathā ।। 11 ।।
sādhvyaśca sādhavo dhīrā vijñā deveśvarādayaḥ ।
sakuṭumbā hi sevārthamāyānti prativāsaram ।। 1 2।।
brahmaṇā kārtike veṃkaṭeśadhvajamahotsavaḥ ।
kṛtastadā satyalokeśvarāścāyānti vatsare ।।13 ।।
svāmisarovare tasya dakṣiṇe vaikaṭeśvare ।
tadā puṇyaṃ tīrthakṛtaścāsaṃkhyaṃ jāyate priye! ।। 14। ।
daśavarṣaistu yatpuṇyaṃ kriyate tu kṛte yuge ।
tretāyāmekavarṣeṇa tatpuṇyaṃ sādhyate janaiḥ ।। 15। ।
dvāpare pañcamāsena kalau tu dinamātrataḥ ।
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇakaṃ śrīnivāsasya darśane ।।16 ।।
nimiṣe nimiṣe lakṣmi! jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
rajaḥkaṇena ca muktirjāyate kṛṣṇasannidhau ।। 17।।
śrīnivāsaṃ mahādevaṃ veṃkaṭeśaṃ narāyaṇam ।
kīrtayanti hṛdā ye te mucyante bhavapaṃjarāt ।। 18 । ।
kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ vratairanyatīrthaistapasā cā'dhvaraiḥ ।
kiṃ kāśyā kiṃ ca gayayā prayāgenāpi kiṃ phalam ।। 1 9।।
kiṃ śaṃbhunā viśvasṛjā kiṃ śakreṇā'marādibhiḥ ।
yena nārāyaṇo veṃkaṭeśo dṛṣṭo'tibhaktitaḥ ।।1.403.20 ।।
veṃkaṭeśvaradevasya bhaktimaṣṭavidhāṃ caret ।
tadbhaktajanasatkārapūjādiparitoṣaṇam ।।21 ।।
devapūjanasantoṣastadarthaṃ dehaceṣṭitam ।
tanmāhātmyakathāśrutiścaritraśravaṇaṃ tathā ।।22।।
nṛtyapremāñcitabhāvo veṃkaṭadhyānamityapi ।
veṃkaṭādrinivāsopajīvanaṃ ceti muktidāḥ ।।23 ।।
bhaktirevaṃvidhā bodhyā vedāntaśravaṇaṃ vinā ।
veṃkaṭo veṃkaṭeśaśca nārāyaṇasvarūpiṇau ।।।24।।
veṃkaṭaṃ prārthayetpuṇyanārāyaṇapadapradam ।
tvāṃ bhavantamahaṃ padbhyāmākrameyaṃ nagottama! ।।25।।
tvanmūrdhani kṛtāvāsaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ darśayasva me ।
svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe snātvā'gre pāpanāśane ।।26 ।।
tīrthe tvācamanaṃ kṛtvā snāyāt pāpavināśane ।
āsīcchūdrasamācāro brāhmaṇaḥ sumatiḥ purā ।।27।।
mālinyadoṣabhāvena gṛhīto brahmarakṣasā ।
rudan bhraman skhalanmūḍhaḥ pralapanprahasannasau ।।28।।
śaśvaddhāheti ca vadan medhāṃ puṇyāṃ samatyajat ।
tatpitā taṃ veṃkaṭādrau nītvā snānamakārayat ।।29।।
dinatrayaṃ jalapānaṃ tīrthe pāpavināśane ।
tena tasya sutastatra vimukto brahmarakṣasā ।।1.403.3 0 ।।
bahukālaṃ sukhī bhūtvā dehānte muktimāptavān ।
jalapānaprasaṃgena tīrthena brahmarākṣasaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
api muktiṃ yayau lakṣmi! mama yogena tatsthale ।
evaṃ cānyo'pi dāridryayukto bhadramatirdvijaḥ ।।32।।
śāstrajño dhārmikaścāsīt ṣaṭpatnīsevitaḥ khalu ।
tatputravaṃśīyāścābhavan kṣudhayā'rditāḥ ।।33 ।।
tānpaśyan sa bhadramatirvilalāpā''kulendriyaḥ ।
dhigjanma bhāgyarahitaṃ dhanakīrtivivarjitam ।।34।।
ātithyavarjitaṃ janma dhig jñānācāravarjitam ।
yatnasaukhyayaśobandhukhyātyādirahitaṃ ca dhik ।।35।।
aiśvaryavarjitaṃ bahvapatyavajjanma dhik tathā ।
aho guṇāḥ saumyatā ca vidvattā satkulādikam ।।36।।
dhanahīnasya sarvaitacchreṣṭhamapi na śobhate ।
sutā dārāḥ putraputrā bāndhavā bhrātarastathā ।।37।।
śiṣyā bhṛtyā mātaraśca tyajanti dhanavarjitam ।
cāṇḍālo vā yatirvāpi sadhanaḥ pūjyate bhuvi ।।38।।
kuṇapo gaṇyate riktaḥ saṃbhṛto gaṇyate dhanī ।
aguṇo guṇavān mūrkho paṇḍitatvena gaṇyate ।।3 9।।
dharmaśūnyaḥ sadharmaśca gaṇyate dhanavān janaiḥ ।
tasmād daridratā cāśā duḥkhā duḥkhatarā matāḥ ।।1.403.40।।
āśādāsāḥ sadā kliṣṭā dāsyāśaḥ sukhamedhate ।
ākiṃcanyamahāgrāhagrasto mṛtyumukhāntikaḥ ।।41 ।।
aho duḥkhaṃ kathaṃ cedṃ tarttavyaṃ mādṛśena vai ।
iti cintayatastasya bhāryā kañcanasaṃjñikā ।।42।।
pativratā mahābhāgyā sarvadā patidevatā ।
sarvasādhuguṇairyuktā patiṃ taṃ pratyabhāṣata ।।43 ।।
bhagavan sarvadharmajña sarvārtha jñānaśevadhe! ।
mama kānta sadā pūjya śṛṇu vadāmi tatkuru ।।44।।
suvarṇamukharītīre pāvano veṃkaṭācalaḥ ।
tatra ca paramaṃ tīrthaṃ nāmnā pāpavināśanam ।।45।।
snānamātreṇa pāpānāṃ dāhakaṃ dhanapuṇyadam ।
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvasampatpradāyakam ।।46 ।।
dharmaiśvaryapradaṃ caitannāradaścā'bravītpurā ।
bhūmidānaṃ caret tatra sarvakāmaphalapradam ।।47।।
bhūmidānātparaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।
paraṃ nirvāṇamāpnoti bhūmido nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।48।।
svalpāmapi mahīṃ datvā śrīkṛṣṇāya dvijāya ca ।
sādhave cāgnihotrārthaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate ।।49।।
bhūmidaḥ sarvadaḥ prokto mokṣaṇaṃ tena vai bhavet ।
daśahastāṃ mahīṃ datvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ।।1.403.50।।
satpātre bhūpradātā vai sarvadānaphalaṃ labhet ।
ikṣugodhūmakedārapūgakharjūraśobhitā ।।9 1 ।।
mahī pradīyate yena sa bhaved vaiṣṇavo'kṣare ।
devārthaṃ bhūpradātā tu mukto bhavati śāśvataḥ ।।52।।
gaṃgātīre'śvamedhānāṃ phalabhāg droṇabhūpradaḥ ।
aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ vājapeyaśatātmanām ।।53 ।।
gaṃgātīrakṛtānāṃ vai phalabhāg bhārabhūpradaḥ ।
iti bhāryāvacaḥ śrutvā tadā bhadramatiryayau ।।54।।
suśālīnagarīṃ yatra sughoṣaṃ brāhmaṇottamam ।
yayāce pṛthivīṃ pañcahastāṃ so'pi dadau mudā ।।55।।
uvācā'pi kṛtārtho'haṃ saphalaṃ mama janma ca ।
matkulaṃ puṇyavajjātaṃ vipro'si yasya yācakaḥ ।।56 ।।
pṛthivī vaiṣṇavī puṇyā pṛthivī viṣṇupālitā ।
dīyate śubhapātrāya prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ ।।57।।
so'pi bhakto harestāṃ ca gṛhītvā hi vasundharām ।
tato yayau veṃkaṭādrau yatra svāmisarovaram ।।58।।
tatra snātvā tataḥ śvetavārāhaṃ vasudhādharam ।
natvā yayau veṃkaṭeśaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ pareśvaram ।।59।।
tato yayau paraṃ tīrthaṃ pāpanāśananāmakam ।
snātvā dadau śrotriyāya bhūdānaṃ vaiṣṇavāya saḥ ।।1.403.6 0।।
tatkālaṃ bhagavāँstatra sākṣādāvirbabhūva ha ।
bhadramatiḥstavaṃ cakre namo nārāyaṇāya te ।।6 1 ।।
kāraṇāya prapālāyā'ntakāya nāyakāya ca ।
pāvakāya prasannāya smṛddhidāya ca te namaḥ ।।62।।
śrīśāya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya bhūdharāya ca ।
lakṣmīśāya prabheśāya māṇikīśāya te namaḥ ।।6 3 ।।
pārvatīśāya gopālabālakāya ca te namaḥ ।
kaṃbharāṃkaprajātāya sarvajñāya ca te namaḥ ।।64।।
cakrapadmādicihnāya pumuttamāya te namaḥ ।
kṣīrasāgaravāsāya śrīlakṣmīsevitāya ca ।।65।।
abhīṣṭasukhadātre te yajñavārāharūpiṇe ।
namaste kamalākāntapadmākāntāya te namaḥ ।।66 ।।
padminīpataye bhaktadāridryanāśakāya te ।
sādhurūpāya te kṛṣṇa! bhūyo bhūyo namo namaḥ ।।67।।
iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha tuṣṭo'smi brāhmaṇottama! ।
sarvabhogasamāyukto dehānte muktimāpnuhi ।।68।।
evaṃ varaṃ pradāyaiva tatraivāntaradhīyata ।
pāpanāśanatīrthe sa dvijaḥ snātvā gṛhaṃ yayau ।।69।।
śreṣṭhī svarṇadhanadhānyasmṛddhimānabhavat tataḥ ।
pṛthvīdānapratāpena mahendra iva cāparaḥ ।।1.403.70 ।।
athā'paraṃ mahattīrthaṃ vartate mokṣadaṃ nṛṇām ।
ākāśagaṃgāvikhyātaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ vadāmi te ।।71 ।।
rāmānujo dvijaḥ kaścid viṣṇudhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ।
tapastepe sa paṃcāgnimadhyastho'ṣṭākṣaraṃ japan ।।72।।
vṛṣṭau jale sthitaścāpi dvandvasparśavivarjitaḥ ।
jīrṇaparṇāśano jalāhāro vāyvadanaściram ।।73 ।।
tasthau tapasi śraddhālustuṣṭo'sya bhaktavatsalaḥ ।
prakṣyatāmagāttatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।74।।
svarṇabhūṣāñcitadeho ramārādhādisevitaḥ ।
viśvaksenasunandādyaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīrameśvaraḥ ।।75।।
nāradādiyutaścāpi pītāmbaradharaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sanakādimahāyogisevitadvayapārśvakaḥ ।।76 ।।
veṃkaṭeśaṃ dayāluṃ taṃ tuṣṭāva tāpaso dvijaḥ ।
namo rāmāya cakrādidhāriṇe mahate namaḥ ।।77।।
nityaśuddhasvarūpāya namo bhaktārtihāriṇe ।
paravyūhavibhavāyā'rcādirūpāya te namaḥ ।।78।।
antaryāmisvarūpātmavyāpine te namo namaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇāya mahābhūmne nārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ।।79।।
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya vairājāya ca vedhase ।
sadāśivāya kāntāya viṣṇave brahmaṇe namaḥ ।।1.403.80 ।।
īśvareśāyeśvarāya puṣpavannetriṇe namaḥ ।
nāmajātyādipārāya nāmajātyādirūpiṇe ।।8 1 ।।
kāṃbhareyāya kṛṣṇāya gopīmaṇḍalarāsine ।
gopālajāya gosevāsnigdhāya te namo namaḥ ।।82।।
vedāntanyāyavedyāya bhāṣyāya bhāṣyakāriṇe ।
āgamāntaḥsugataye lokarakṣāya te namaḥ ।।83 ।।
saurāṣṭrā''viḥsvarūpāya raivatācalavāsine ।
aśvapaṭṭakṣitīśāya puṣkarāraṇyaśāline ।।84।।
kāśeśvarāya raṃgādipūjitāya ca te namaḥ ।
iti stutvā śrīnivāsaṃ rāmānuja iyāya śam ।।85।।
veṃkaṭeśaḥ samāliṃgya rāmānujamuvāca ha ।
stotreṇa tapasā tuṣṭo varaṃ vṛṇotu satvaram ।।86 ।।
rāmānujastadā prāha śrīnivāsa hare prabho ।
tvaddarśanāt kṛtārtho'smi kiṃ me'dya darśanāt param ।।87।।
devāḥ pitaro munayo naiṣṭhikāḥ karmaṭhāśca yam ।
yogino jñānakuśalāḥ na paśyanti vidanti na ।।88।।
vedmi paśyāmi taṃ cādya kimasmādadhikaṃ nu me ।
etena tu kṛtārtho'smi muktibījena sarvathā ।।89।।
tvatpādapadmayugale niścalā bhaktirastu me ।
ityāśrutya hariḥ prāha mayi bhaktirdṛḍhā'stu te ।।1.403.90 ।।
atra te tapasaḥ sthāne samāgatya tu ye janāḥ ।
