snāsyantyākāśagaṃgāyāṃ yāsyanti dhāma me param ।।91 ।।
tvaṃ ca prārabdhadehānte matsvarūpamavāpsyasi ।
viyadgaṃgāsnātakāstu sarve bhāgavatottamāḥ ।।92 ।।
lakṣma bhāgavatānāṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu bhāgavatottama! ।
bhagavanmayacaryā ye karmaṇā manasā girā ।।।93 ।।
sarvakāryāṇi kṛṣṇārthe kurvantaḥ kṛṣṇacintakāḥ ।
jñānino niḥspṛhāḥ śāntāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ ।। 94।।
sarveṣu kṛṣṇadraṣṭāraḥ kṛṣṇasya satkathādarāḥ ।
kṛṣṇapādāmbujabhaktā ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ ।।95।।
mātāpitroḥ kṛṣṇatanvoḥ śuśrūṣādiparāyaṇāḥ ।
devārcanaprapūjādiparāmodabharāśca ye ।।96 ।।
sādhusevāparāścāpi sādhvīmānapradāśca ye ।
pareśavṛttayo ye te mahābhāgavatottamāḥ ।।97।।
ātmavatsarvabhūtānāṃ dṛgvadbhāgavatottamāḥ ।
śāstrajñā dharmadhartāraḥ satyavācaḥ saduttamāḥ ।।98।।
kṛṣṇakathāratāḥ kathāvaktari snehabhāvanāḥ ।
tīrthapriyāḥ kāmadhenusevakā vai saduttamāḥ ।।99 ।।
anyodaye prasannāśca kṛṣṇanāmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
kṛṣṇārthaṃ jalakhātāro ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ ।। 1.403.100 ।।
devālayaprakartāro devagāyatrikājapāḥ ।
bhaktiharṣā harau magnā ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ ।। 1 01 ।।
tulasīpūjakā vṛndāṃ namanti tulasīkarāḥ ।
tulasīmālikādhrāśca tulasīcandanāñcitāḥ ।। 102 ।।
tulasīmṛttikādehāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ ।
vedādiṣu hareḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśakāḥ ।। 103 ।।
ātithyādau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva sucintakāḥ ।
jñātatattveṣu vai brahmabodhakāḥ sādhuvṛttayaḥ ।। 1 04।।
sarvaguṇādisadgrāhāste vai bhāgavatottamāḥ ।
ekādaśyādivratinaḥ kṛṣṇārthakarmakāriṇaḥ ।। 1 05।।
rādhāṃ lakṣmīṃ ramāṃ śrīṃ pārvatīṃ prabhāṃ ca māṇikīm ।
mamāṃśāṃ yoṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā namanti vaiṣṇavīṃ tu ye ।। 106 । ।
matsvarūpāṃ mayā'dhiṣṭhitāṃ paśyanti hṛdā sadā ।
bāle ca bālikāyāṃ ca te vai bhāgavatottamāḥ ।। 1 07।।
tathā nṛṣu prapaśyanti yāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ māṃ narāyaṇam ।
tā vai satyo mahābhāgavatyaḥ proktā mayā'nagha ।। 1 08।।
narāḥ sarve kṛṣṇarūpā nāryo rādhāramātmikāḥ ।
iti bhāgavatajñānā ye te bhāgavatottamāḥ ।। 1 09।।
saṃkṣepāttu kathayāmi madarthaṃ sarvathā sthitāḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ paśavo'pi sarve bhāgavatottamāḥ ।। 1.403.110 ।।
rāmānuja! tvamevāsi tathā bhāgavatottamaḥ ।
prasanno'smi tvayi dhrauvyabhaktisthiteḥ sadā priya! ।। 111 ।।
tīrthamākāśagaṃgākhyaṃ tārakaṃ bhavapārakṛt ।
snātṝṇāṃ mokṣadaṃ cāsti bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।। 11 2।।
ityuktvā'ntardadhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhustadā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhaktimokṣaśca hastagaḥ । । 113 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye bhagavatpātivratyapālakānāṃ sumatibhadramatirāmānujānāṃ tīrthottame mokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā
tryadhikacatuḥśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।40 3 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 403 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 404
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 405 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dānapātraṃ sattīrthaṃ kathayāmi te ।
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ deyamasmai tu śārṅgiṇe ।। 1 ।।
sādhave dharmaśīlāya vidyājuṣe mahātmane ।
tyāgine brahmavetre ca dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ।। 2 ।।
sādhvyai bhogaprasaktāyai harikṛṣṇasya yoṣite ।
nārāyaṇyai mahālakṣmyai dattaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ।। 3 ।।
satkarmaniratāyai ca sevikāyai harestathā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyai satyai dattaṃ tu śāśvatam ।। 4 ।।
anāthāyai ca bhaktāyai yoginyai dattamakṣayam ।
bhaktāya brahmarūpāya brahmaṇe vedavedine ।। 5 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtirūpāya deśikāya ca ।
viprāya devaśiṣyāya tathā satkarmakāriṇe ।। 6 ।।
anapekṣitaśāntāya dattaṃ bhavati cā'kṣayam ।
gave bālāya kanyāyai pitṛbhyāṃ dattamakṣayam ।। 7 ।।
patnyai svasre duhitre ca dauhitrāya sukarmiṃṇe ।
svasṛputrāya śiṣyāya dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ।। 8 ।।
gurave gurupatnyai ca guruputrāya vedine ।
dharmapracārakartre ca datta bhavati cākṣayam ।। 9 ।।
vyākhyātre jñānadātre ca śāstriṇe viduṣe tathā ।
vidyādhikāriṇe vidyāpātre dattaṃ hi cākṣayam ।1.404.1 0।।
vṛttiśūnyāya vai deyaṃ daridrāya kuṭumbine ।
devasya pūjakāyā'pi paropakārakāriṇe ।।1 1 ।।
adhyāpakāya dātavyaṃ dātavyaṃ deśa hetave ।
abhyudayārthamevāpi dātavyaṃ rakṣakāya ca ।। 1 2।।
nārāyaṇasya sāmīpye dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ।
vaiṣṇavāya pradātavyaṃ yena tuṣṭo bhavāmi vai ।। 13 ।।
daṃbhācārāya caurāya vidviṣe nindakāya ca ।
paradravyaparadārapare dattaṃ tu niṣphalam ।। 14।।
kṛtaghnasya ca mūrkhasyā'sūyāviṣṭahṛdastathā ।
hiṃsakasya vikrayiṇo dattaṃ bhavati niṣphalam ।। 15 ।।
paropatāpakartuśca nāstikasya jaḍasya ca ।
khalasya chaladharmasya maryādābhedakasya ca ।। 16 ।।
pākhaṇḍinaḥ kitavasya śaṭhasyā'dharmavartinaḥ ।
vivāḍhaśālinaścaṇḍarūpasyāpi tu niṣphalam ।। 17।।
tīrthe cakrapuṣkariṇītīre deyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
dāne puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ cakratīrthamanuttamam ।। 18।।
purā śrīvatsagotrīyaḥ padmanābho dvijarṣabhaḥ ।
cakrapuṣkariṇītīre tapo'tapyata dāruṇam ।। 1 9।।
varṣāṇi katicitso'yaṃ jīrṇaparṇāśano'bhavat ।
kaṃcitkālaṃ jalāhāro vāyvāhāraḥ kiyatsamāḥ ।।1.404.20।।
evaṃ vai dvādaśe varṣe tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
pratyakṣatāmagāttasya śrīrādhākamalāpatiḥ ।। 21 ।।
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ stotuṃ samupacakrame ।
gopālakṛṣṇarūpāya kāṃbhareyāya viṣṇave ।।22।।
namaḥ śeṣādrivāsāya veṃkaṭeśāya te namaḥ ।
nārāyaṇādrivāsāya śrīnivāsāya te namaḥ ।।23 ।।
bhaktipriyāya lakṣmīśapadminīśāya te namaḥ ।
iti stuto ghanaśyāmaḥ śrīnivāsastutoṣa ha ।।24।।
padmanābhaṃ dvijaṃ cāha cakratīrthe'tra sarvadā ।
ākalpaṃ pūjayaँstvaṃ māṃ vasa bhaktottama priya! ।।25।।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇastatraivā'ntaradhīyata ।
padmanābho'vasat tatra kadācittaṃ tu bhakṣitum ।।26 ।।
rākṣasaścāgatastatra jagrāha brāhmaṇaṃ tadā ।
pracukrośa cakrapāṇe! rakṣa rakṣeti vai muhuḥ ।।27।।
veṃkaṭeśa hare kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa! prabho! ।
kāṃbhareya! kṛpānātha rakṣa māṃ rakṣasā dhṛtam ।।28।।
iti stuvatastasyaiva rakṣārthaṃ cakradhārakaḥ ।
svacakraṃ preṣayāmāsa cakrapuṣkariṇītaṭam ।।।29।।
sudarśanaṃ mahājvālaṃ dṛṣṭvā rakṣaḥ pradudruve ।
tasya śiraścakartedama viprastuṣṭāva cakrakam ।। 1.404.30 ।।
viṣṇoścakra! namaste'stu bhaktarakṣaṇadīkṣita! ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇahastapadmabhūṣaṇa! te namaḥ ।। 31 ।।
sarvadā'tra pratiṣṭha tvaṃ rakṣakaṃ bhava matkṛte ।
nārāyaṇasvarūpāya mokṣadāya namo namaḥ ।।3 2 ।।
ityarthitaṃ padmanābhabhaktaṃ prāha sudarśanam ।
cakratīrthaṃ mama nāmnā bodhyaṃ bhakta! tvayā kṛtam ।। 33 ।।
cakratīrthe satataṃ saṃvasāmi tava vāñcchayā ।
itaḥ paraṃ janānāṃ na pīḍā syād rākṣasādijā ।। 34।।
snātāro'tra dhūtapāpā yāsyanti śrīhareḥ padam ।
ityuktvā tāṃ cakrapuṣkariṇīṃ prāviśadujjvalam ।। 35।।
ityevaṃ muktidaṃ bhaktapātivratyaprabhāvataḥ ।
tīrthaṃ cakrāśritaṃ jātaṃ lakṣmi! pāpavināśanam ।। 36 । ।
śṛṇu yathā'bhavat so'pi rākṣaso yo mṛto'dhunā ।
purā śrīraṃgapuryāṃ vai vaśiṣṭhādyāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।37 ।।
upāsāñcakrire śrīraṃganāthaṃ muktikāṃkṣayā ।
kadācit tatra gandharvaḥ sundarākhyaḥ samāyayau ।। 38 ।।
salile yuvatībhirvivastrābhiḥ snānamācarat ।
krīḍāṃ cakāra vividhāṃ vaśiṣṭhastāvadeva hi ।। 39 ।।
snātuṃ gato dadarśainaṃ nagnaṃ śaśāpa nistrapam ।
māṃ dṛṣṭvāpi na vai vāso dhatse tasmāddhi sundara! ।।1.404.40 ।।
yāhi rākṣasatāṃ sadyastato'sau rākṣaso'bhavat ।
yuvatyaḥ śrīvaśiṣṭhaṃ sanatvā kṣamāṃ yayācire ।। 41 ।।
dayāsindho vilokyā'smān kopaṃ mā kartumarhasi ।
patireva hi nārīṇāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ paramaṃ matam ।।42 ।।
patihīnā tu yā nārī śataputrāpi no śubhā ।
vidhavetyamaṃgalā sā tato janma nirarthakam ।।43 ।।
eko'parādhaḥ kṣantavyaḥ prasīdā'smatpriye prabho ।
evaṃ stuto vaśiṣṭhastāḥ prāha śāpo na me'phalaḥ ।।44।।
ṣoḍaśābdāvadhau rakṣaḥ paścād gandharvatāṃ vrajet ।
cakratīrthe padmanābhaviprayoge vimokṣyati ।।45।।
sudarśanena cakreṇa muktirasya bhaviṣyati ।
patirvastridivaṃ bhūyo ramayiṣyati sundaraḥ ।।46 ।।
ityuktvā sa vaśiṣṭho vai yayau śrīraṃgamandiram ।
sundaro rākṣaso jāto mahādaṃṣṭro bhayānakaḥ ।। 47।।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayasaṃvignā jagmū rāmāstriviṣṭapam ।
bhramato rakṣasaścādrau ṣoḍaśābdāni niryayuḥ ।।48 ।।
tato brāhmaṇayogena sudarśanena mocitaḥ ।
sundaraḥ sundaro jāto vimānena divaṃ yayau ।।49 ।।
cakraṃ tatroṣitaṃ śaśvaccakratīrthamato'bhavat ।
yacchrutvā pāpajālānāṃ nāśo bhavati vai dhruvam ।।1.404.50 । ।
jābālitīrthamāhātmyaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi! vadāmi te ।
durācārābhidho vipraḥ kaverītīravāsakṛt ।।51 । ।
sadā'bhūta pāpisaṃsargī naṣṭabrāhmaṇyasatkriyaḥ ।
grasto'bhavadbhīṣaṇena vetālena balīyasā ।।52 । ।
bahukālottaraṃ so'yaṃ bhraman veṃkaṭaparvatam ।
nyamajjat tu jale tāvad vetālena vimocitaḥ ।।53 । ।
yatra jale'bhavanmuktastatra jābāliko muniḥ ।
avasat tanmahattīrthaṃ jābālitīrthamucyate ।।54 । ।
vetālo'pyabhavat pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇo nāstiko mahān ।
nindako devasādhūnāṃ tena vetālatāṃ gataḥ ।।55 ।।
so'pi tīrthaprabhāveṇa punarmānuṣyameṣyati ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! jābālitīrthamuttamam ।।।56 । ।
tumburutīrthamatrāpi kathayāmi śṛṇu priye! ।
pāpino manujāḥ sarve hyamāsu snānti vai muhuḥ ।।।57 ।।
visṛjya pāpajālāni pūtā bhavanti te janāḥ ।
asmākaṃ pāpajālāni kathaṃ naśyanti sarvataḥ ।।58 ।।
evamālocya tīrthāni gatāni veṃkaṭācalam ।
tatra svāmipuṣkariṇījale sasnuśca tumburau ।।59 । ।
tīrthe sasnuruttarāphālgunyāṃ śukle tu parvaṇi ।
teṣāṃ pāpāni naṣṭāni yayustāni yathālayam ।।1.404.6 0 ।।
mahāpāparataṃ krūraṃ dānahīnaṃ kulāntakam ।
paśughnaṃ drohakartāraṃ piśunaṃ cānṛtaṃ janam ।।6 1 ।।
mitradruhaṃ kṛtaghnaṃ ca bhrūṇahaṃ paradāragam ।
parārthasūcakaṃ svāmidrohaṃ devaparāṅmukham ।।62 ।।
śaṭhaṃ ca vañcakaṃ dharmavighnaṃ kulavibhedakam ।
supallavaphalopetavṛkṣodyānavināśakam ।।63 ।।
agnidaṃ garadaṃ cāpi pāpaṃ viśvāsaghātakam ।
gurudveṣakaraṃ duṣṭaṃ dampatyorvirasāvaham ।।64।।
etānsarvāṃśca vai lakṣmi! tumburutīrthamuttamam ।
punāti snānapānādyaiḥ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti ca ।।65।।
tumbururnāmagandharvo bhāryāmuvāca vai purā ।
māghatraye mayā sākaṃ snānaṃ kuru malāpaham ।।66 ।।
māghamāsyudite sūrye gomayālepanaṃ kuru ।
raṃgavallyādibhiḥ śubhrapadmadhātukasvastikaiḥ ।।67।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjāsthalaṃ śuddhaṃ kuru priye! ।
dīpaṃ kuru ghṛtavarttiprakāśitaṃ sugandhakam ।।68।।
dehi pākaṃ śucirbhūtvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya ca ।
pradakṣiṇānamaskārairmayā saha prasevaya ।।69 ।।
devasevāṃ kuru nityaṃ kathāśravaṇamācara ।
nityaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādānnajalaṃ gṛhāṇa vaiṣṇavi! ।।1.404.70।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo kāmbhareya janārdana ।
gopālakṛṣṇagovinda ramārādhāpate prabho ।।71 ।।
śrīlakṣmīpārvatīnātha māṇikośa prabhāpate! ।
antaryāmin muktidātṛ ceti kīrtaya sarvadā ।।72।।
krodhamātsaryalobhādīṃstyaktvā vrata samācara ।
tenaiva jāyate muktirviṣṇuloko hyavāpyate ।।73 ।।
iti bharturvacaḥ śrutvā krodhaṃ kṛtvā tu bhāminī ।
pratyuvāca tadā kāntaṃ śītapīḍāmaye khalu ।।74।।
prāṇahāriṇi māghe vai kiṃ snānaṃ te'tisammatam ।
na karomi pate! snānaṃ mriye ced rakṣako'tra me ।।75 ।।
dharmastāvajjanaiḥ kāryo yāvacchakyo bhavenmṛduḥ ।
duḥkhado nāśakṛddharmo na kāryo na karomi tam ।।76।।
na ca karmāṇi viṣṇvarthaṃ śakyāni ca prage mayā ।
tumbururityuktavatīṃ śaśāpā'priyavādinīm ।।77।।
veṃkaṭādrau ghoṇatīrthe pippaladrumakoṭare ।
tatrāmburahite mūḍhe maṇḍūkī bhava kevalā ।।78।।
śrutvā sā'prārthayat kāntaṃ viśāpamavadat patiḥ ।
kadācinmunibhiḥ sārdhamagastyaste samīpataḥ ।।79।।
sthitvā ghoṇasya māhātmyaṃ kathayiṣyati vai tadā ।
śrutvā tvaṃ dūrato maṇḍūkīdehādvai vimokṣyase ।।1.404.80 ।।
punarāgatya me sthānaṃ mayā sākaṃ ramiṣyasi ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'tha dharmapatnī pativratā ।।81 ।।
bhartṛśāpānmahāghorāṃ maṇḍūkatanumāśritā ।
bahuvarṣe gate kāle'gastyastatra samāyayau ।।82।।
svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ snātvā natvā varāhamīśvaram ।
veṃkaṭeśaṃ śrīnivāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā pippalasannidhau ।।83 ।।
āgatya ghoṇatīrthasya māhātmyamavadajjanān ।
maṇḍūkī sā tadā muktā pūrvarūpavatī babhau ।।84।।
uvāca māṃ dayayā rakṣa pativākyavirodhinīm ।
patiśāpena maṇḍūkī jātā'haṃ mocitā tvayā ।।85 ।।
agastyastāṃ tadā prāha pātivratyavṛṣān śṛṇu ।
tava bhartā sudharmajñastvāṃ śaśāpa ṛtaṃ hi tat ।।86।।
pativākyavirodhinyāṃ śāpo yukto hi sarvathā ।
pativākyamanādṛtya yatheṣṭaṃ vartate tu yā ।।87।।
sā patnī narake kaṣṭe patatyākalpameva yat ।
nāryā vākyaṃ svapatyurvai nollaṃghyaṃ hi kadācana ।।88।।
pātivratyena puṇyena patiśuśrūṣaṇena ca ।
striyo viṣṇupadaṃ yānti na cānyairapi suvrataiḥ ।।89।।
patirmātā patirviṣṇuḥ patirbrahmā patiḥ śivaḥ ।
patirguruḥ patistīrthaṃ patirmokṣaḥ paro mataḥ ।। 1.404.90 ।।
pativākyamapākṛtya yā tu sukṛtakāriṇī ।
na sā phalamavāpnoti naiva śuddhā bhavettathā ।। 91।।
gurvājñāvartamānā'pi patyājñāṃ na karoti cet ।
naiva pūtā navā puṇyā bhavata sā kadācana ।। 92।।
patyājñayā vidadhyāt sā vrataṃ dharmādikaṃ tathā ।
patibuddhyā prakuryācca hareḥ sevādikaṃ sadā ।। 93 ।।
patipādābjatīrthena yā snātā sā haripriyā ।
sā snātā sarvatīrtheṣu gaṃgādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ ।। 94।।
tvayā bhuktaṃ phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ punarjātā'si pūrvavat ।
gaccha tvaṃ tumburorvāsaṃ sukhinī bhava sarvathā ।।95।।
tumburutīrthamevaitat tena yātaṃ prasiddhatām ।
atra snānti paurṇamāsyāṃ te yajñaphalabhāginaḥ ।। 96 ।।
dine dine kapilāgosahasradānajaṃ phalam ।
dine dine ratnakoṭisahasradānajaṃ phalam ।। 97।।
dine hastisahasradānasyā'śvā'yutadānajam ।
phalaṃ vai prāpyate subhru ghoṇatīrthā'vagāhanāt ।। 98।।
kanyākoṭipradānasya phalaṃ ghoṇā'vagāhanāt ।
kurukṣetre suvarṇānāṃ sahasrasya pradānajam ।। 99।।
yatphalaṃ tadāvāpnoti tumburutīrthagāhanāt ।
gurvarthe ca satāmarthe svāmyarthe yastyajettanum ।। 1.404.10 0।।
pativratārthaṃ sādhvyarthaṃ haryarthaṃ yastyajet tanum ।
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ghoṇatīrthā'vagāhanāt ।। 101 ।।
āpannārtiharāṇāṃ ca tīrthasevāparātmanām ।
satyavratānāṃ yatpuṇyaṃ ghoṇatīrthāddhi yadbhavet । । 10 2।।
gaṃgāyāṃ narmadāyāṃ ca sarayūcandrabhāgayoḥ ।
svarṇavatyāṃ yamunāyāṃ yatphalaṃ tadbhavediha ।। 1 03।।
iti śrutvā jalaṃ pītvā yayau sā tumburugṛham ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tumburutīrthamuttamam ।। 1 04।।
yacchrutvā'pi jano yāyād vājapeyaphalaṃ mahat ।
viṣṇulokaṃ paraṃ svargaṃ tathā vai śāśvataṃ padam ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye dānapātraṃ, cakratīrthe jābālitīrthe ca pativratāmāhātmyaṃ, tīrthabalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā
caturadhikacatuḥśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 404 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 404 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 405
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 406 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! veṃkaṭādrau mukhyatīrthāni ṣaṭ tathā ।
svāmipuṣkariṇī caiva viyadgaṃgā tato'dhikā ।। 1 ।।
pāpavināśanaṃ cāpi pāṇḍutīrthaṃ taduttamam ।
kumāradhārikātīrthaṃ tumburutīrthamityapi ।। 2 ।।
kuṃbhalagne paurṇamāsyāṃ maghāyogo yadā bhavet ।
kumāradhārikāṃ yānti tīrthāni sarvato diśaḥ ।। 3 ।।
rājasūyaphalaṃ snānānmuktirviṣṇoḥ pade bhavet ।
annadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ śāśvataṃ phalamāpyate ।। 4 ।।
uttarāphālgunīyuktadhāvalyadalaparvasu ।
mīnasūrye tu tīrthāni tumburuṃ yānti sarvataḥ ।। 5 ।।
aparāhṇe snānamātrātpunarjanma na vidyate ।
yajñopavītakaṃ brahmavrataṃ vivāhalagnakam ।। 6 ।।
dravyaṃ datvā kārayed yastasya puṇyamanantakam ।
meṣasūrye ca citrāyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ hi sarvataḥ ।। 7 ।।
samāyānti viyadgaṃgāṃ tīrthāni pāvanāni vai ।
tatra snātvā śatakratupuṇyaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ।। 8 ।।
svarṇadānaṃ cānnadānaṃ kanyādānaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
pradātavyaṃ paraṃ svargamicchatā gṛhamicchatā ।। 9 ।।
dvādaśyāṃ vṛṣabhārke ca vratādau harivāsare ।
bhaumayukte pāṇḍutīrthaṃ gaṃgāyāṃ yānti sarvataḥ ।। 1.405.10 ।।
snātvā ca gāṃ dogdhrīṃ datvā mucyate pāpakoṭibhiḥ ।
aśvinyarke śuklapakṣe saptamyāṃ sūryavāsare ।। 11 ।।
uttarāṣāḍhayuksūrye tūttarābhādraśālini ।
dvādaśīdivase cāpi tīrthaṃ pāpavināśanam ।। 12।।
śālagrāmaśilādānaṃ kṛtvā snātvā pramucyate ।
dhanurmāse site dvādaśikāyāmaruṇodaye । । 13 ।।
svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe tīrthānyāyānti sarvataḥ ।
yasya janmasahasreṣu puṇyamevā'rjitaṃ bhavet ।। 14।।
tasya snānaṃ bhavet tatra nā'nyasyā'sukṛtasya vai ।
yathāśaktipradātavyaṃ dānaṃ snātvā vimucyate । । 15 ।।
śālagrāmaṃ kāmadhenuṃ dadyāt tatra viśeṣataḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā dānaṃ samācaret ।। 16 । ।
saurāṣṭre'syāḥ pradānena golokaṃ cāpnuyād dhruvam ।
dakṣiṇe'syāḥ pradānena vairājasthānamāpnuyāt ।। 17 ।।
prāgjyotiṣi pradānena sūryalokamavāpnuyāt ।
jālaṃdhare pradānena vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt ।। 18 ।।
uttarakuruṣvasyāstu dānena brahmatāṃ vrajet ।
saptadvīpeṣu dānena saptadvīpapatirbhavet ।। 19 ।।
ye śṛṇvanti kathāṃ viṣṇoḥ sadā bhuvanapāvanīm ।
jīvanmuktāstu te bhaktā mahābhāgavatā matāḥ ।। 1.405.2 0 ।।
muhūrtaṃ vā tadarthaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā veṃkaṭācale ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyā adhyāyameva vā ।। 21 । ।
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā mokṣaṃ śāśvatamāpnuyāt ।
yatphalaṃ sarvayajñeṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam ।। 22 । ।
sakṛt saṃhitāśravaṇāt tatphalaṃ vindate janaḥ ।
saṃhitāśravaṇaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya kīrtanam ।। 23 । ।
ubhe tveva manuṣyāṇāṃ kalpadrupuṇyadāyake ।
amṛtapānakṛlloke syādekaścājarāmaraḥ ।। 24। ।
kṛṣṇakathā'mṛtapānāt kulaṃ syādajarāmaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ vasāmi vaktari sadā ।। 25 । ।
madrūpaṃ vācakaṃ vidyānmanyūrti bodhadāyinīm ।
vaktā'haṃ bhagavān sākṣāt śrotrī lakṣmīrmama priyā ।। 26 । ।
iti matvā'rcayennityaṃ śrotāraṃ vācakaṃ tathā ।
matpraveśaṃ vinā kaḥ syācchaktaḥ śrotā ca vācakaḥ ।। 27 ।।
śrotuṃ vaktuṃ ca vā lakṣmi! divyākhyānāntaraṃgakam ।
yatreyaṃ saṃhitā lakṣmi! tatra divyasvarūpavān ।। 28 । ।
avaśyamupatiṣṭhāmi rādhālakṣmyādisaṃvṛtaḥ ।
pārṣadaiśca samāyuktaḥ kathāpātrairyutastadā ।। 29 ।।
divyadṛśaḥ prapaśyanti na tu carmadṛśo janāḥ ।
kathāyāṃ vidyamānāyāṃ prāṇāँstyajanti tānaham ।। 1.405.30 ।।
nayāmi divyayānena vaikuṇṭhaṃ cā'kṣaraṃ tathā ।
golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ dhāma yathā bhaktasya vāñchitam ।। 31 ।।
bālo yuvā'thavā vṛddho daridro durbhago'pi vā ।
kathāvaktā sadā pūjyaḥ paramātmasvarūpakaḥ । । 32 । ।
saṃhitājñe kṣudrabuddhiṃ na kurvīta kadācana ।
yasyānanodbhavā vāṇī mokṣadā svargadā nṛṇām ।। 33 ।।
anantajanmakṣetrepu bhūtvā bhūtvā'tinaśyatām ।
samarpayati jīvebhyo'bhayadānaṃ kathāvratī ।।34।।
vyāso jñānaprado vyāsāsanasthāt kaḥ paro guruḥ ।
āsamāpteḥ kathāyāśca na namet kasyacit guruḥ ।।।35।।
rājā samrāṭ cakravartī mahācāryo'pi deśikaḥ ।
devo vā sarva evaite nimnā vyāsātprakīrtitāḥ ।।36 ।।
eteṣāmāsanād vyāsāsana tuṅga sadā matam ।
eteṣāmāgame vyāso nottiṣṭhet svāsanāt kvacit ।।37।।
devālaye catuṣkādau pañcaśravaṇabhūsthale ।
gṛhe tīrthe śubhe kṣetre tīrthe puṇyakathāṃ vadet ।।38।।
śraddhālavo bhaktimanto vāgyatāḥ sthiramānasāḥ ।
avyagrāścāstikā dāntāḥ śrotāraḥ puṇyabhājanāḥ ।।39।।
kathāṃ kathāpravaktāraṃ sāmagrībhiḥ prapūjayet ।
teṣāṃ puṇyaphalaṃ śaśvallakṣmīśrīdhīpradaṃ bhavet ।।1.405.40।।
apradāya tu ye lobhākṛṣṭāḥ śṛṇvanti saṃhitām ।
teṣāṃ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ na syād dāridryaṃ syājjanau janau ।।41 ।।
kathāyāṃ vighnakartāro vāvadūkā viḍambakāḥ ।
anyagāthāprakartāro bālakrīḍādibuddhayaḥ ।।42।।
kathādhyānapravikṣepakartāraḥ śrutibhaṃjakāḥ ।
teṣāṃ bhogā vinaśyanti dārā dhanāni sampad ।। 43 ।।
ye ca tuṃgāsanārūḍhā tathā vīrāsanasthitā ।
sihāsanasthitāḥ pādopari pādaniyojakāḥ ।।44।।
śrotāraste tu jāyante vāyasāḥ pādapāstathā ।
apraṇamya ca śrotāro jāyante viṣapādapāḥ ।।45।।
śayānāścāpi śrotāro bhavantyajagarāḥ khalu ।
vaktuḥ samāsanasthāśca nindakāśca duruttarāḥ ।।46।।
janmaśataṃ te śunakā gardabhāḥ kṛkalāsakāḥ ।
śūkarāścāpi jāyante vighnakartāra eva ye ।।47।।
praśaṃsanti kathāṃ ye te padaṃ gacchanti śāśvatam ।
kathānāṃ śrāvakā yānti śāśvataṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam ।।48।।
kambalājīnavāsāṃsi dadyādāsanamuttamam ।
svargalokaṃ sa vai gacched dhanado brahmaṇaḥ padam ।।49।।
pustakasya śubhaṃ vastraṃ dadāti sukhabhāg bhavet ।
mahāpātakinaḥ śuddhā bhavanti jñānalabdhitaḥ ।।1.405.50 ।।
iti śrutvā mahimānaṃ kathāśravaṇakarmaṇaḥ ।
devāśca munayaḥ siddhāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitarastathā ।।51 ।।
dikpālā lokapālāśca nadā nadyo vanāni ca ।
tattvāni pārthivā lokā veṃkaṭādrau śubhālaye ।।52।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ supāvanīm ।
śvetavārāhavaktrāt te śuśruvuryoṣito narāḥ ।।53।।
teṣāṃ bhojanadānārthaṃ veṃkaṭeśvarapācakāḥ ।
miṣṭānnānāṃ kaṭāhāni mahānaseṣvarakṣayan ।।54।।
abhojayannasaṃkhyātān devān devīśca dehinaḥ ।
tattīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ jātaṃ yadvai kaṭāhatīrthakam ।।55।।
mahādevo vijānāti tasya tīrthasya vaibhavam ।
varṇāśramasthitā ye'nye paśupakṣyādayo'pi ca ।।56।।
kaṭāhatīrthavāsena prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ।
aprāyaścittapāpānāṃ dhvaṃsaḥ kaṭāhasevanāt ।।57।।
ārtānāmārtināśaḥ syādasya jalasya sevanāt ।
svāmipuṣkariṇīsnānaṃ varāhaśrīśadarśanam ।।58।।
varāhatīrthe bhojyānnaṃ pānaṃ jalasya tasya ca ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāśca śravaṇaṃ sadā ।।59।।
sādhūnāṃ nityasevā ca ṣaṭkaṃ trailokyadurlabham ।
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāraṃbhe vārāho bhagavān svayam ।।1.405.6 0 ।।
caturbhujaḥ samāyāto bhūkaṭāhāt bahirhariḥ ।
tattīrthaṃ bhūkaṭāhākhyaṃ tatraiva vartate priye ।।6 1 ।।
yajjalaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tena tṛptāḥ śravaṇakārakāḥ ।
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāmagnā na vidyaiste parā'bhavan ।।6 2।।
māsaṃ śrutvā yayuḥ sarve nijasthānāni devatāḥ ।
atha keśavanāmākhyo vipro brāhmaṇaghātakaḥ ।।6 3।।
brahmahatyāsamākrānto yayau kaṭāhatīrthake ।
snātvā pītvā jalaṃ śuddho'bhavattīrthapratāpataḥ ।।64।।।
tuṃgabhadrātaṭe tasya vedagrāme'bhavad gṛham ।
vaidikā brāhmaṇāḥ śāstravijñā hyāsan sahasraśaḥ ।।65।।
agrahāraḥ keśavo'sau kulaṭāpāśavañcitaḥ ।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ tyaktvā bhāryāmapi pativratām ।।66।।
sarvadākulaṭāsakto'bhavat tadgṛhavāsakṛt ।
bahukāle gate tayā rugṇastyakto hi keśavaḥ ।।67।।
sa ca bubhukṣitaścauryaṃ kṛtavān brāhmaṇagṛhe ।
khaḍgena hatavān vipraṃ dhanaṃ nītvā suvarṇakam ।।68।।
yayau sa kulaṭāgāraṃ tayā dhanaṃ pragṛhya ca ।
tāḍito niṣkāsitaśca yayau svapitaraṃ gṛhe ।।6 9।।
brahmahatyāpṛṣṭhalagnā'bhavat sovāca rākṣasī ।
ayaṃ vipraṃ vinihatya kulaṭāyai dadau dhanam ।।1.405.70 ।।
tayā niṣkāsito jāraḥ pitṛmātṛviḍambakaḥ ।
bhāryātyāgī durātmā'sti pitṛgṛhamupāgataḥ ।।71 ।।
yainaṃ putraṃ hi manyethāḥ padmanāma dvijottama ।
tyajainaṃ brāhmaṇahanaṃ na cet tyajasi putrakam ।।72।।
tadbhāryāmasya bhāryāṃ ca tvāṃ ca putramimaṃ dvija ।
bhakṣayiṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ ca tasmānmuñca durātmakam ।।73।।
brahāhatyā svayaṃ cāsmi nainaṃ muñcāmi sarvathā ।
naikasyārthe kulaṃ sarvaṃ vināśayitumarhasi । ।74।।
ityuktvā brahmahatyā sā vavalge keśavaṃ sutam ।
prāṇānattuṃ samudyogā babhūva rākṣasīsamā ।।75।।
kuṭumbinastadā sarve ruruduḥ khinnamānasāḥ ।
tasminnavasare bharadvājastatrā''yayau muniḥ ।।76।।
padmanābho dvijaḥ stutvā yayāce śaraṇaṃ muhuḥ ।
matputraṃ rakṣa kṛṣṇāṃśa! yathā hatyā layaṃ vrajet ।।77।।
eka eva suto me'sti tanmṛto vaṃśanāśanam!
pitṛpiṇḍavilopaśca nārakitvaṃ dvijanmanām ।।78।।
samuddhāraya tad vipra! bahu puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśaḥ sa bharadvājo'bravīt tadā ।।79।।
ayaṃ vipra! tava putro veṃkaṭādrau mahācale ।
śrībhūtalīlāyutanārāyaṇāśraye manohare ।।1.405.80।।
kaṭāhatīrthasalile snāyāt hatyālayaṃ vrajet ।
iti vākyaṃ gṛhītvaiva padmanābho dvijaḥ sutam ।।8 1 ।।
nītvā yayau veṃkaṭādrau sasnau puṣkariṇījale ।
varāhasvāminaṃ natvā śrīnivāsaṃ dadarśa ha ।।82।।
natvā divyavimānaṃ tad yayau kaṭāhatīrthakam ।
papau jalaṃ jale sasnau saputro yāvadeva tu ।।83 ।।
tāvad hatyā layaṃ prāptā bhagavānāvirāsa ca ।
prāhaitattīrthamāgatya ye pāsyanti jalaṃ janāḥ ।।84।।
teṣāṃ bhuktistathā muktiḥ sarvadā vai bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo māhātmyamāha tam ।।85।।
mayā golokadhāmno'yaṃ cānīto veṃkaṭācalaḥ ।
tatra tapasyato'gastyamunerbrahmā sutoṣitaḥ ।।86।।
prāha putra varaṃ brūhi dadāmi yanmanogatam ।
agastyo vedhasaṃ prāha veṃkaṭākhye mahāgirau ।।87।।
mayā gaṃgā samāneyā jagatāṃ pāvanī sadā ।
brahmaṇā ca smṛtā gaṃgā śīghraṃ tatrā''jagāma ha ।।88।।
agastyaḥ śikharādagre jagāmā'nusarid yayau ।
suvarṇavatpradeśaṃ taṃ kurvatī ghoṣakāriṇī ।।89।।
suvarṇamukharīnāmnā vāyunā bodhitā tadā ।
veṃkaṭādriṃ nimnadeśān vyāpya vārdhigatā'bhavat ।।1.405.90।।
agastyastāṃ dvitīyāṃ vai gaṃgāṃśarūpiṇīṃ nadīm ।
mārgaṃ pradarśya tapasaḥ sthānaṃ prāpyā'vasat sukham ।। 91 ।।
yatra śrīveṃkaṭeśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।
śrīrādhāpārvatīlakṣmīpadminīmāṇikīpatiḥ ।।92।।
prabhāramākṣitilīlāpadmāvṛndāpatiśca saḥ ।
nityaṃ snātijalapānaṃ karotyeva sakhīyutaḥ ।।93 ।।
devāstīrthāni muktāśca sādhvyaḥ snānti ca parvasu ।
agastyācalasaṃbhūtā dakṣiṇodadhigāminī ।।94।।
pavitrayati deśān vai nārāyaṇasamāśrayāt ।
jalaṃ niṣkamitaṃ pītaṃ nāśayetpāpaparvatān ।।95।।
nityaṃ smarennamaskuryāt kīrtayenmanasā'rcayet ।
śuddhikṣemaśivāpekṣī suvarṇamukharīṃ smaret ।।96 ।।
āhūtā brahmaṇā gaṃgā'gastyena vāhitā bhuvi ।
mūrtā dvitīyarūpā sā suvarṇamukharīśvarī ।।97।।
asyāstaṭe bhuvo dānaṃ dhanadānaṃ sutārpaṇam ।
kṛtvā tu vidhivad dehī yāti brahma sanātanam ।।98 ।।
japo homastapo dānaṃ pitṛkarma surārcanam ।
kṛtaṃ bhavecchataguṇaṃ suvarṇamukharītaṭe ।।99।।
agastyodayamāse ye snānamasyāṃ prakurvate ।
taiḥ kalpaṃ tu surāvāse sthīyante puṇyabhāgibhiḥ ।। 1.405.100 ।।
sauvarṇāgastyadātāro yānti vai brahmaśāśvatam ।
agastyaḥ kuṃbhasambhūto govardhanasya netṛkaḥ ।। 101 ।।
vindhyasaṃstabhano vārdhiculukīkṛtisiddhimān ।
jalanairmalyasāmarthyaḥ suvarṇamukharovahaḥ ।। 1 02। ।
prītimāpnotu mahatīṃ dānenā'nena me prabhuḥ ।
ityuktvā tu dadenmūrtiṃ jaṭācarmādiśobhitām ।। 103 ।।
daṇḍakamaṇḍaluyuktāṃ svastikāsanasaṃsthitām ।
savalkalāmakṣamālāyukkarāṃ sumanoharām ।। 1 04। ।
nārāyaṇena sahitāṃ dadyāt pāpaviśuddhaye ।
smaret tīrthāni sarvāṇi dānakāle śuṇu priye ।। 1 05।।
agastyatīrthaṃ tanmūle'gastyeśvaraśca śaṃkaraḥ ।
yatra vai vartate tatrottarāyaṇe viśejjalam ।। 108 ।।
agniṣṭomasahasrasya phalaṃ bhavati svargadam ।
adhaḥ krośamitaṃ tīrthaṃ devarṣipitṛnāmakam ।। 1 07।।
tatra snātā ṛṇatrayānmukto bhavati mānavaḥ ।
tato yojanayugale veṇānadyāḥ susaṃgamaḥ ।। 1 08।।
tatra daśāśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ snānena labhyate ।
tato yojanaturye prāgastyeśvaraṃ suliṃgakam ।। 1 09।।
tato'rdhayojane vyāghrapadāyāḥ saṃgamo'sti vai ।
tatra virājate śaṃkhatīrthe śaṃkheśvaraḥ śivaḥ ।। 1.405.110 ।।
śaṃkhena muninā pūrvaṃ sthāpitaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ ।
nimne kalyānadī tatra saṃgatā pāpanāśinī ।। 111 ।।
yatra brahmaśilā ramyā sarinmadhye hi vartate ।
athodicyāṃ yojanārdhaṃ vaiṃkaṭādrirvirājate ।। 11 2।।
krośocchrayasya tasyaivābhitaścānye'pi bhūdharāḥ ।
aṃjano'nanto vṛṣabho nīlo varāhaḥ kesarī ।। 113 ।।
nārāyaṇācale śrīveṃkaṭādrau vāsamācarat ।
vārāhastena bhūbhṛtsa vārāhakṣetramīritaḥ ।। 1 14।।
suvarṇamukharītīre veṃkaṭādrau śriyā yutaḥ ।
bhuvā yutaśca padminyā yutaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ ।। 1 15।।
yuktaśca jayayā lalitayā bakulayā śriyā ।
pārvatyā prabhayā lakṣmyā māṇikyā līlayā ca yuk ।। 116 ।।
sevyate siddhagandharvamunimānavadānavaiḥ ।
tasya smaraṇakartṝṇāṃ siddhyanti vāñchitāni vai ।। 1 17।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tīrthānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ śubham ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya svargaṃ mokṣaśca vai bhavet ।। 1 18।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye veṃkaṭādrau ṣaṭtīrthāni, lakṣmīnārāyaṇa-saṃhitākathākartṛśvetākhyavyāsasya pūjanam, keśavākhya-
viprasya brahmahatyāmokṣaṇam, gaṃgākhyasuvarṇamukharyā ānayanam, anyatīrthānāmuddeśādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikacatuḥśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।405 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 405 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 406
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 407 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
veṃkaṭādrau mahāpuṇye śrīramākamalāpate! ।
kathaṃ prādurabhūḥ pūrvaṃ vada me sarvamadbhutam ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahimānaṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'smi bhūḥ ।। 2 ।।
goloke'haṃ kṛṣṇanāmā vaikuṇṭhe'haṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।
vāsudevo'mṛte dhāmni bhūmā'vyākṛtadhāmani ।। 3 ।।
akṣare tu pare dhāmni bhavāmi puruṣottamaḥ ।
hiraṇyagarbho vairājaḥ sadāśivo bhavāmi ca ।। 4 ।।
sahasraśīrṣā bhagavān mahāviṣṇurbhavāmi ca ।
ekaśīrṣā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhūmau bhavāmyaham ।। 5 ।।
mama bhāsā jagat sarvaṃ bhāsate bhāskaro'smyaham ।
vidyayā mama sṛṣṭirvai vyāprīyate sa cāsmyaham ।। 6 ।।
sarvahṛtsu sannihito'ntaryāmyahaṃ vasāmi vai ।
hariḥ sadāśivo brahmā kāṃbhareyo janārdanaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ahamevā'smi paryāyāḥ sahasrāṇi bhavanti me ।
yadecchāmi śubhaṃ kartuṃ tadā''yāmi bhuvastalam ।। 8 ।।
sṛjāmi rājasenaitat sattyenāpi vahāmi ca ।
harāmi tāmasenaiva nidrayā svapimīti ca ।। 9 ।।
gatāṃ jalatale bhūmimānetuṃ svecchayā mayā ।
rūpaṃ vārāhasadṛśaṃ dhṛtaṃ vai līlayā purā ।। 1.406.10 ।।
kardamabhāvamāpannā mayā daṃṣṭrāgrasiddhibhiḥ ।
piṇḍīkṛtyā''hṛtā jalopari saṃsthānahetave ।। 11 ।।
jalaṃ maryāditaṃ yathā pṛthvīṃ na nāśayettathā ।
ādhārārthaṃ diggajāँśca śeṣaṃ kūrmaṃ nyaveśayam ।। 12।।
mamā''jñayā jagad brahmā yathāpūrvamakalpayat ।
kalpe kalpe ca rakṣārthaṃ viharāmi mahītale ।। 1 3।।
varāharūpadhṛk cāhaṃ prapede veṃkaṭācalam ।
svāmipuṣkariṇītīrthe nyavasaṃ brahmaṇā tadā ।। 14।।
prārthito mūlrarūpāya tadā'dṛśyo'bhavaṃ priye! ।
haihayavaṃśajo rājā śaṃkhanāmā babhūva ha ।। 15।।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo bhakto navadhā bhajane'niśam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāṃ śṛṇoti sadā nṛpaḥ ।। 16।।
tathā'pyasya na sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'bhavat ।
tenā'yaṃ cā'tṛptamanā vicāramakaronmuhuḥ ।। 17।।
kathaṃ nu yāyād bhagavān viṣayaṃ mama netrayoḥ ।
evaṃcintayatastasyovāca śrībhagavān hṛdi ।। 18।।
gaccha śrīveṃkaṭādrau tvaṃ bhaja varṣasahasrakam ।
adṛśyo dṛśyatāṃ yāsye tava cāgastyakasya ca ।। 19।
ārādhya māṃ taponiṣṭhau mama darśanamāpsyathaḥ ।
śaṃkho vajre sute nyasya rājyaṃ śrīveṃkaṭaṃ yayau ।।1.406.20।।
agastyo'pyāsasādainaṃ śailaṃ muniśatāvṛtaḥ ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ cakārainaṃ brahmādidevavāsitam ।।21 ।।
devāḥ sarve sanakādyā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ।
pratīkṣante hareḥ sākṣād darśanaṃ kuṃbhayonivat ।।।22।।
militvā te samājagmuryatra śaṃkho'sti bhaktarāṭ ।
suvarṇamukharītīre'paśyaँste śaṃkhabhūpatim ।।23।।
āsīnāstatra te sarve saṃbhāvyā'nyonyamutsukāḥ ।
govindakīrtanaparāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakāḥ ।।24।।
tṛtīyaniśithe cānte dadṛśuḥ svapnameva te ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ padminīsahitaḥ prabhuḥ ।।25।।
varadānāya samprāpta iti te dadṛśurharim ।
prātaste puṣkariṇyāṃ vai snātvā tuṣṭuvuracyutam ।।26 ।।
jepuraṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ oṃśrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
teṣāmagre prādurabhūdekaṃ tejo mahādbhutam ।।27।।
tatra dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tuṣṭuvurādarāt ।
jaya viṣṇo jaya kṛṣṇa jaya śrīkṛṣṇa keśava ।।।28।।।
jaya bhūdhara govinda veṃkaṭādrīśa vai jaya ।
kṛtārthā nu kṛtāḥ sarve divyadarśanadānataḥ ।।29।।
sadā'tra bhagavan vāsaṃ kuru bhaktakṛpākara ।
suvarṇamukharīṃ cemāṃ kuru trilokapāvanīm ।।1.406.3 0।।
sadā'sminnāsthitaḥ śaile kāṃkṣitārthaprado bhava ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrutvā prāha tathāstviti priyam ।।3 1 ।।
tena kṛṣṇena suvarṇamukharī svāśrayā kṛtā ।
śailo vaikuṇṭhaśailaśca kṛto vāsena nityadā ।।32।।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prado jāto hariḥ priye! ।
śaṃkhamāha hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prīto'smi tava bhaktitaḥ ।।।33।।
ākalpamindralokastho hyapsarogaṇasevitaḥ ।
bhuktvā bahuvidhān bhogāँstato mallokameṣyasi ।।34।।
evaṃ datvā varaṃ devān nityavāsaṃ pradāya ca ।
nārāyaṇaḥ kamaleśastatraivā'ntaradhīyata ।।35।।
evaṃ saumyavapurbhūtvā kṛṣṇo vasati veṃkaṭe ।
nārāyaṇaṃ veṃkaṭādriṃ svāmipuṣkariṇīṃ tathā ।।।36।।
kaṭāhādīni tīrthāni smṛtvā śuddhā bhavanti vai ।
lakṣmīśrībhūpadminīśaṃ prāpnuyuḥ puruṣottamam ।।37।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! purā kācidaṃjanānāmataḥ satī ।
putrahīnā tapaḥ kartuṃ samārabdhā'tivaiṣṇavī ।।38।।
mataṃgākhyo muniḥ kaścit tāmāha tapasi sthitām ।
kimicchasi dāruṇena tapasā vada sundari! ।।39।।
aṃjanā''ha pitā me kesarī jñātīyarākṣasaḥ ।
tapaścakre śivaṃ smṛtvā putrārthaṃ dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ।।1.406.40।।
śivāśivau vṛṣabhasthau samāyātau kṛpākarau ।
śivaḥ prāha ca te nāsmin janmani putradāyakam ।।41 ।।
puṇyaṃ kintu dadāmi tvāṃ putrīṃ lokeṣu viśrutām ।
tasyāḥ putreṇa putrītvaṃ manyethāḥ svaṃ sukhī bhava ।।42।।
iti tasmai varaṃ datvā tatraivāntardadhe haraḥ ।
matpitā rākṣasastuṣṭo gṛhaṃ yātastataḥ param । । 43 । ।
jajñe'haṃ tasya patnyāṃ ca kāle vivāhitā'bhavam ।
kesaryākhyena patinā kiṣkindhākhyamahāpure । ।44 । ।
vratāni māghamāsasya kārtikasya vratāni ca ।
vaiśākhasya vratānyapi cāturmāsyavratāni ca । ।75 । ।
kṛtavatīṃ ca navadhāṃ bhaktiṃ nārāyaṇasya ca ।
śālagrāmānnadānāni godānaṃ dīpadānakam । ।46 । ।
tiladānaṃ vastradānaṃ bhūdānaṃ vāridānakam ।
phalapuṣpapradānaṃ ca satputraphalakāṃkṣayā ।। 47 । ।
śrāvaṇasya ca yatpuṇyaṃ kṛtavatyapi sarvathā ।
putraṃ tathā'pyalabdhvā'haṃ tadarthaṃ tapasi sthitā ।। 48 । ।
atha tāṃ tāpasīṃ sādhvīṃ mataṃgaḥ prāha putradam ।
ito vai dakṣiṇe ghanācalo nṛsiṃhavāsabhūḥ । ।4 9 । ।
daśayojanadūraṃ saḥ tatpūrve daśayojane ।
nadī suvarṇamukharī tadudṅ vṛṣabhācalaḥ । ।1.406.5 0 । ।
tadagre'sti svāmipuṣkariṇī sarasī śobhanā ।
gaccha snāhi vidhānena varāhaṃ paśya keśavam । ।5 1 । ।
veṃkaṭeśaṃ namaskṛtvā viyadgaṃgāṃ prayāhi ca ।
vāyumuddiśya ca tapaḥ kuru tatra hi vaiṣṇavi! ।।।52 । ।
itiśrutvā yayau sā vai veṃkaṭādriṃ tapasvinī ।
cakre tīrthāni vidhivat tapaścakre'tidāruṇam ।।53 । ।
viyadgaṃgātaṭe vāyuḥ prādurāsīttu tatpuraḥ ।
uvāca varadānārthaṃ putraṃ dehīti sā'bravīt । । 54 । ।
putraste'haṃ bhaviṣyāmītyuktvā cāntardadhe'nilaḥ ।
tadā śaṃkaradhātuṃ vai samādāya maharṣayaḥ ।। 55 । ।
samājagmuśca taṃ vāyuḥ kesarīrūpadhṛk tadā ।
jahārā'ñjanīkarṇe taṃ dadau putro'bhavattataḥ ।। 56 । ।
jātamātro yuvā jātismaro vāyubalātigaḥ ।
hanumān so'bhavattasyāstapasvinyāḥ suputrakaḥ । । 57 । ।
meṣasūrye caturdaśyāṃ citrānakṣatrayogake ।
suvarṇamukharītīre prādurāsā'nilaḥ svayam । । 58 । ।
tadātra snānadānādi kṛtaṃ bhavati cā'kṣayam ।
annadānaṃ vastradānaṃ svarṇadānaṃ sutārpaṇam । । 59 । ।
śālagrāmaśilādānaṃ godānaṃ bhūpradānakam ।
prapādānaṃ tiladānaṃ dhānyadānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ।।1.406.6 0 । ।
gandhacampakapuṣpādi. chatravyajanacāmaram ।
tāmcūlaghanasārādi gṛhopakaraṇāni ca ।।6 1 । ।
yo dadāti janastatra divyavastrasahasrakam ।
bhuktvā bhogānanekāँśca svargaloke'pi bhogavān ।।62।
sārvabhaumastato vipro bhūtvā muktiṃ prayāti saḥ ।
iti te kathitā lakṣmi! veṃkaṭādricamatkṛtiḥ ।।63 ।।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam ।
śruṇu tvanyāṃ kathāṃ divyāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritām ।।64।।
kathayāmi tava prītyā pātivratyaparāyaṇām ।
ekadā śrīveṃkaṭādrirmeruṃ gantumacintayat ।।65 ।।
uḍḍīya svīyapakṣābhyāṃ yāvadutpatati kṣiteḥ ।
tāvajjāto mahān kampo vināśo bahudehinām ।।66 ।।
cukruśuḥ prāṇinaḥ sarve varāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।
mṛtāḥ smo bhagavannasyoḍḍayanena vinā''śrayam ।।67।।
kuru no rakṣaṇaṃ kṣmeśa! yathāvat sthāpaya prabho ।
ityarthito varāho vai svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।68।।
jīvānāśvāsayāmāsa sasmārendraṃ savajrakam ।
tāvadupāgataścendro vajramudyamya pakṣahāḥ ।।6 9।।
indraṃ dṛṣṭvā veṃkaṭādristatrāsa kampito'bhavat ।
jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇorvarāharūpiṇastadā ।।1.406.70 ।।
tuṣṭāva maraṇād bhītastamāha bhagavān svayam ।
yadi kadācinmā yāhi pakṣābhyāṃ vyomamārgataḥ ।।71 ।।
tadā rakṣāṃ kariṣyāmi sthiro bhavātra bhūdhara ।
ityuktaḥ so'bhavannatvā niṣkampaḥ susthirastadā ।।72 ।।
adṛśyo'bhūd varāhaśca mahendraḥ svālayaṃ yayau ।
varāhasyāśrayeṇāsya pakṣau nendreṇa kartitau ।।73 ।।
athaikadā sa śailastu kalpayāmāsa vai hṛdi ।
āgato'haṃ hi golokād vasāmyatra ciraṃ samāḥ ।। 74।।
golokadarśanārthaṃ vai gacchāmi kṛṣṇasannidhau ।
iti vicārya sa kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamyāṃ yaśa kṣitau ।।75 ।।
kuśasthalyāṃ hi gomatyāṃ snātuṃ tīrthāni saṃyayuḥ ।
ṛṣayaśca gatāḥ sarve nadā nadyaśca devatāḥ ।।76 ।।
agastyādaya evaite yayurgomatīsaṃgame ।
svaṃ nirjanaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā gantuṃ mano dadhe tadā ।।77।।
cakampe pṛthivī tatra jīvā naṣṭāśca kampanāt ।
tāvat tatrā'bhavadekā tāpasī nirdhanā satī ।।78।।
brāhmaṇī brāhmaṇasevāparā nityaṃ prativratā ।
nāmnā suvarṇarekhā ca hiraṇyā tatsvasā tathā ।।71।।
hiraṇyā'bhūnmahāsādhvī kumārikā tapasvinī ।
suvarṇarekhā sapatikā patirnāmnā narāyaṇaḥ ।। 1.406.80 । ।
nārāyaṇaṃ dvijaṃ prāha pītvā jalaṃ tu pādayoḥ ।
veṃkaṭādriḥ sapakṣo'sti prāguḍḍayane vāritaḥ । ।8 1 । ।
punaruḍḍīyate'smākaṃ mṛtyureva bhaviṣyati ।
yadi patyājñayā cainaṃ jaḍīkaromi sarvathā । ।82 । ।
tadā śrīveṃkaṭeśādyāḥ kruddhā no duḥkhadāḥ khalu ।
bhaviṣyanti tato nātha kartavyaṃ kiṃ vadātra me । ।8 3 । ।
ityuktaḥ saḥ priyāmāha yatheṣṭaṃ kuru bhāmini! ।
yadi te pātivratyaṃ vai dṛḍhaṃ cāsti janāviha । । 84। ।
sarve parābhavamāptā bhaviṣyanti tadagrataḥ ।
mā bhayaṃ kuru sādhvi tvaṃ śikṣāṃ kuru hi parvatam । ।85। ।
iti priyasya vacanaṃ samāsādya satī tadā ।
prāha yadyasmi maddharmasaṃsthitā vai pativratā । ।86 । ।
tadā parvatarājo'tra tava pakṣau bhuvo'ntare ।
jaḍībhūtau sadā stāṃ vai pakṣaśaktiṃ vinākṛtau । ।87। ।
pṛthivyā caikatāṃ prāptau yathā noḍḍayanaṃ punaḥ ।
ityuktamātre tau pakṣī jaḍībhūtāvacaṃcalau । ।88 । ।
abhavatāṃ śaktihīnā bhuvo'ntaraṃ niveśitau ।
veṃkaṭādrirnamratayā yayāce vai kṣamāṃ muhuḥ । ।8 9 । ।
satī prāha sadā cātra nārāyaṇasya me tathā ।
vāso na niścitastasmād yāsyāmo raivatācalam । । 1.406.90 । ।
tvaṃ sadā tiṣṭha niṣkarmā mā bhūḥ caṃcalaparvata! ।
anyathā te punardevo dhruvaṃ nāśaṃ kariṣyati ।। 91 ।।
sapakṣastvaṃ sarvadaivaṃ tiṣṭha noḍḍayanaṃ bhavet। ।
dadāmi pakṣayorjīvaṃ kṛpayā mā śucaḥ punaḥ ।। 92 ।।
śalabhānāṃ śukānāṃ ca koṭayastava pakṣayoḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti saśaktāstā uḍḍayiṣyanti cāmbare ।। 93 ।।
śādvaleṣu vaneṣvatrā'raṇyeṣu śalabhāḥ śukāḥ ।
oṣadhīn bhakṣayitvā te layameṣyanti pakṣayoḥ ।। 94। ।
evaṃ te pakṣayoḥ sajīvanatāṃ te dadāmi vai ।
ityuktvā veṃkaṭaṃ sthirīkṛtvā nārāyaṇo dvijaḥ ।। 95 । ।
pativratā svarṇarekhā yayatū raivatācalam ।
svarṇarekhā nadīrūpā'bhavannityā pativratā ।। 96 ।।
nārāyaṇo hradarūpo'bhavannityo'vasad girau ।
evaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ svarṇarekhā ceti hi dampatī ।। 97 ।।
nivāsaṃ cakratustīrtharūpau divyau hi raivate ।
yatra dāmodareṇāpi patnīvratena viṣṇunā ।।।98 ।।
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ parāṃ tṛptiṃ dadatustau hi cetanān ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! camatkāramayaṃ vṛttam ।। 99।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye veṃkaṭādrāvagastyaśaṃkhadvārā varāhaprādurbhāvaḥ, tatra tapasāṃ'janyāṃ hanumatputralābhaḥ, veṃkaṭādreḥ pakṣayorjaḍīkaraṇam, tvārekhānārāyaṇahṛdayoḥ raivatācale āgamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikacatuḥśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।406 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 406 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 407
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 408 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! jayantyā vai cendraputryāḥ kathā śubhām ।
yā cakāra tapaḥsevāṃ śukrasya pātivratyataḥ ।। 1 ।।
devadānavayuddheṣu devāstu sabalā yadā ।
jetumaśakyā daityaiśca tadā dānavamaṇḍalam ।। 2 ।।
śukrācāryaṃ samastaut tadyathā daityajayo bhavet ।
tadā śukraḥ samayaṃ vai buddhvā devāśrayāvaham ।। 3 ।।
sarvān daityān parityajya śukro devānaḍhaukata ।
tadā daityā devapakṣagataṃ śukraṃ samāhvayan ।। 4 ।।
kiṃ tvaṃ no miṣataścāsmāँstyaktvā devān samāśritaḥ ।
sthātuṃ na śaknumo bhūmau praviśāmo rasātalam ।। 5 ।।
vinā hi rakṣakaṃ tvāṃ tu guru sthāsyāmahe katham ।
evamukto'bravīd daityān viṣaṇṇān sāntvayan girā ।। 6 ।।
mā bhaiṣṭa rakṣayiṣyāmi tatra sthitena tejasā ।
mantrauṣadhivasusiddhirasāstiṣṭhanti vai mayi ।। 7 ।।
kṛtsnaśastaccaturthāṃśaḥ sureṣvasti ca vā na vā ।
madgataṃ vaḥ pradāsyāmi yūyaṃ syustena rakṣitāḥ ।।8 ।।
etadvṛtaṃ suvijñāya devāḥ sarvajighṛkṣayā ।
cakruḥ sammantraṇāṃ netuṃ svavaśaṃ mantraprabhati ।। 9 ।।
adhyayanaṃ samārabdhaṃ devaiḥ śukrasya sannidhau ।
kiṃcit kiṃcid dadau tebhyastadapyapūrṇameva vai ।। 1.407.1 0।।
yāvad daityebhya evā'yaṃ śukro nā'dhyāpayattu tat ।
tāvad daityān surā hatvā pātālaṃ prāpayanti hi ।। 11 ।।
atha daityā dīnabhāvāḥ kāvyamevābhidudruvuḥ ।
tadāpi ca surā daityānniḥśaṃkamabhisañjahuḥ ।। 1 2।।
śukro rakṣāṃ tadā kartuṃ mantrān dātuṃ śaśāka na ।
kintu daityānuvācetthaṃ yuddhaṃ māstviti me matam ।। 1 3।।
devā baliṣṭhāścedānīṃ yūyaṃ tu nirvalā yataḥ ।
kālapratīkṣāṃ kuruta gacchāmi tapase'pyaham ।। 14।।।
yāsyāmyahaṃ mahādevaṃ varārthaṃ vijayāvaham ।
apratīpān śreṣṭhamantrān prāpya devānmaheśvarāt ।। 15।।
yuddhyāmahe yadā devāँstadā prāpsyatha vai jayam ।
atha śāstrāṇi santyajyā'surāḥ prāhuḥ surāँstadā ।। 16 ।।
vayaṃ tapaścariṣyāmaḥ śāntāḥ savalkalā vane ।
iti śrutvā surā api nyavartanta tadardanāt ।। 17।।
atha śukro jagau daityān yūyaṃ yāta rasātalam ।
tapoyuktā hi kāryārthaṃ kiñcitkālamupāsyatha ।। 18।।
ityuktvā sa daityagururyayau śaṃbhuṃ himācalam ।
tapaścakre dāruṇaṃ saḥ pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasrakam ।। 19 ।।
avākśirāśca bhūkuṇḍe kṛtvā pādau vihāyasi ।
brahmacārī tathā bhūtvā tapaścakāra dāruṇam ।।।1.407.2 0 ।।
śivaṃ jajāpa manasā nirāhāro'pi niścalaḥ ।
atha daityāḥ kvacit kāle pṛthvyāṃ sthātuṃ samāgatāḥ ।। 21 ।।
tadā devaistāḍitāste yayuḥ kāvyasya mātaram ।
śaraṇaṃ sā'bravīttāँśca vo'stvabhayaṃ nirantaram ।। 22 ।।
na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ bhayaṃ tyajata dānavāḥ ।
matsannidhau vasatāṃ vo bhayaṃ na syād bravīmyaham ।। 23 ।।
devāstatra gatā daityān tāḍayituṃ balātpunaḥ ।
khyātiḥ kruddhā'bravīd devānmahendraṃ nāśayāmi vaḥ ।। 24 ।।
itikṛtvā vidyayā sā mahendraṃ tu jaḍīkṛtam ।
abhicāreṇa tastambha yoginī sā tapodhanā ।। 25।।
prādravanta tato devā dṛṣṭvā cendraṃ vaśīkṛtam ।
atha viṣṇurmahendraṃ sve rūpe cākṛṣya tatkṣaṇam ।। 26 ।।
nītvā yāvad divaṃ yāti tāvat khyātiḥ ruṣānvitā ।
viṣṇunā rakṣitaṃ dṛṣṭvā khyātistatra vaco'bravīt ।। 27।।।
eṣā tvāṃ viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ dahāmi maghavan balāt ।
tāvadviṣṇuḥ svarakṣārthaṃ cakraṃ jagrāha cāpadi ।। 28 ।।
jñātvā tadānīṃ prāṇāntaṃ krūraṃ khyātyāścikīrṣitam ।
sudarśanena vai khyātyāḥ śiraściccheda tadbhiyā ।।2 9।।
taṃ strīvadhaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā cukrodha bhṛgureva yat ।
śaśāpa viṣṇuṃ bhāryāyāḥ khyātyā vadhakaraṃ tadā ।। 1.407.3 0 ।।
yasmātte jānato dharmamavadhyā strī niṣūditā ।
tasmāt tvamapi kalpādau śirovadhamavāpsyasi ।।31 ।।
ityevaṃ śāpataḥ kṛṣṇo bhūtvā gaṇeśa eva saḥ ।
śaṃkarasya ca hastena cāvāpnoti śirovadham ।।32 ।।
atha bhaguṇā tvaritaṃ kāye śiro niyojitam ।
eṣā tva viṣṇunā devi! hatā tāṃ sañjīvayāmyaham ।।33।।
yadi kṛtsno mayā dharmaḥ patnīvrataḥ prapālitaḥ ।
tena satyena jīvasya yadi satye vadāmyaham ।।34।।
tāṃ samprokṣya śītajalairabhijīveti so'bravīt ।
uttiṣṭheti vyāhṛte khyātiḥ sañjīvitā'bhavat ।।35।।
sādhu sādhviti jagadurdevādyāḥ sarvatodiśam ।
kintvindro nā'labhata śaṃ khyātiśukrabhayāttataḥ ।।36।।
śukratapasi vighnārthaṃ vicāryendraḥ svakanyakām ।
jayantīṃ prāha putri tvaṃ mayā śukrāya cārpitā ।।37।।
gaccha tvaṃ tasya dattā'si prayatnaṃ kuru matkṛte ।
śukraḥ śaṃbhoḥ sādhanārthaṃ tapaścarati dāruṇam ।।38।।
devānāṃ sa vināśārthaṃ mantrārthaṃ yatate bhṛśam ।
gaccha saṃsādhayasvainaṃ śramāpanayanādibhiḥ ।।39।।
taistairmano'nukūlaiśca śayanādyupacārakaiḥ ।
evamuktā jayantī sā piturvacanasaṃsthitā ।। 1.407.40।।
agacchad yatra sa ghore tapasi vartate girau ।
tamadhaḥśirasaṃ kāntaṃ kāvye kanyā hyupasthitā ।।41 ।।
vadhūrasmīti taṃ procya sevāyāṃ cāpyavartata ।
gīrbhiścaivānukūlābhirgātrasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।।42।।
kāle'pekṣitavastvādyaiḥ sevamānā tvacaḥ sukhaiḥ ।
vratacaryānukūlābhiruvāca bahulāḥ samāḥ ।।43।।।
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu pātivratyaparāyāṇā ।
sasmāra śaṃkaraṃ sādhvī kathaṃ tuṣṭo na jāyate ।। 44।।
yadi śaṃbhurna vai tuṣṭastamatra pradahāmi vai ।
śāpeneti ruṣaṃ prāptā tāvattatrāyayau haraḥ ।।45।।
jayantīṃ prāha devānāṃ vināśāya ca te patiḥ ।
karoti tapa ugraṃ vai tasmānnāyāmi darśane ।।46।।
kintu tavā'tibalavatpātivratyena karṣitaḥ ।
āgato'haṃ varaṃ dātuṃ vada yat tatkaromi te ।।47।।
jayantī prāha pitrā me svakāryārthaṃ samarpitā ।
tatkāryaṃ vai prakartavyaṃ patyuḥ kāryamathāpi ca ।।48।।
kanyā yasmai pradattā syāttasya dharmaṃ samācaret ।
taddhitaṃ tasya kalyāṇaṃ tasyā'bhyudayameva ca ।।49।।
patiḥ sarvasvamabalājītānāṃ dharma ucyate ।
tadvirodhe kadācinna nāryāḥ śreyo bhavennanu ।।1.407.50।।
tasmātpatimanā bhūtvā kṛtyaṃ sarvaṃ mayocitam ।
piturhitakarī kanyā patyurduḥkha tu nācaret। ।।51 ।।
kuru śaṃbho yathāyogyaṃ dvayorhitaṃ yathā bhavet ।
mayā sevā kṛtā cāsya kāvyasya bhāvasaṃbhṛtā ।।।52।।
kintu tattapasi brahmacarye vighnaṃ na vai kṛtam ।
yata indreṇa dattā'sya dharmapatnī bhavāmyaham ।।53।।
kathaṃ karomi kāmena vighnamasya tapaḥkṣaye ।
tasmātkāmaṃ vinigṛhya ratiḥ kṛtā na vai mayā ।।54।।
tapaḥsiddhiḥ prajātā'sya macchreyase'pi sā yataḥ ।
pātivratyaṃ pālitaṃ vai mayā'niṣṭaṃ na vai kṛtam ।।55।।
tenaiva pātivratyena kurvasya manasepsitam ।
ityuktā premapātraṃ sā kāvyasya virarāma ha ।।56।।
mahādevaḥ prasannaḥ sannuvāca cakitastadā ।
śukra! caitādṛśī kanyā yasyārthe dattajīvanā ।।57।।
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai pārśve tiṣṭhati nityadā ।
tathāpi na tvayā tyaktaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ tathā ।।58।।
tayāpi pativratayā nigrahītaṃ mano'sthiram ।
sarvadā ṣoḍaśavarṣā hyadyāpi sā hi dīvyati ।।59।।
akṣatā ca tavā'dhīnā dhanyeyaṃ vai pativratā ।
te'pi dhanyapravādo'stu pāraṃ gato'si sarvathā ।।1.407.60 ।।
etadvrataṃ tvayaikena cīrṇaṃ nānyena kenacit ।
tasmādvai tapasā buddhyā śrutena ca balena ca ।।।61 ।।
tejasā ca surān sarvāṃstvameko'bhibhaviṣyasi ।
tava vadhvāḥ pātivratyabrahmacaryaprabhāvataḥ ।।62।।
prapatsyase'bhilaṣitaṃ sarvaṃ vācyaṃ na kasyacit ।
sukhaṃ yātaṃ dampatī ca prajeśatāṃ dhaneśatām ।।63।।
avadhyatvaṃ ca sadvidyāṃ sañjīvanīṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।
ityuktaḥ sa śukradevastuṣṭuve'vākśiraḥsthitaḥ ।।64।।
namostu brahmarūpāya bhaktecchāpūrakāya te ।
namaḥ sadyaḥpratuṣṭāya ciratuṣṭāya te namaḥ ।।65।।
namo'stu nityatṛptāya digambarāya te namaḥ ।
namo bhīmāya rudrāya mahādevāya te namaḥ ।।66।।
nama ugrāya pinākadhāriṇe śaṃbhave namaḥ ।
mṛgavyādhāya yataye kirātāya ca te namaḥ ।।67।।
namastricakṣuṣe candrabhālāya liṃgarūpiṇe ।
sadāśivāya śarvāya bhaveśāya namo namaḥ ।।68।।
saumyāya sākṣiṇe satīsvāmine te namo namaḥ ।
nīlakaṇṭhāya caṇḍāya sadyojātāya śūline ।।69।।
īśānāya piśaṃgāya carmāmbarāya te namaḥ ।
paśūnāṃ pataye tubhyaṃ bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ ।।1.407.70।।
namo'ṣṭavarṣmaṇe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmane namaḥ ।
pārvatīpataye prabhāsvāmine te namonamaḥ ।। 71 ।।
namaste sarvataḥ sarvadikṣu sarvātmasu prabho ।
phaladāyānandakartre tai sarvatra namonamaḥ ।। 72 ।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau śaṃbhuḥ prāha tapastava ।
pūrṇaṃ jātaṃ samuttiṣṭha varaṃ gṛhāṇa vāñchitam । ।73 ।।
tathāpi śukro nottasthe śaṃbhuradṛśyatāṃ yayau ।
jayantī tadvilokyaiva prāptakālaṃ jagāda tam ।। 74।।
kathaṃ nottiṣṭhase nātha kathaṃ copekṣase varam ।
avadhānaṃ kathaṃ śaṃbhorvākye naiva karoṣi vai ।। 75।।
śrutvā patnīkṛtaṃ śabdaṃ yāvaduttiṣṭhati kṣiteḥ ।
tāvacchaṃbhuṃ tirobhūtaṃ na dadarśa hi tāpasaḥ ।।76 ।।
paramaṃ khedamāpanno vidadhe śokamulbaṇam ।
upasthitasya vai tyāge punaryogo hi durlabhaḥ । । 77।।
vyomavāṇyā sa vai kāvyo vijñāpito gṛhaṃ prati ।
gantuṃ nītvā tapaḥpuṇyaṃ jayantīmādarāttathā ।। 78 ।।
patnīṃ gṛhaṃ yayau śukro daśavarṣāṇi sarvathā ।
pracchannaḥ so'bhavat saudhe jayantyā saha bhogavān ।। 79 ।।
tasyāṃ jātā devayānī putrī yayātibhāminī ।
atha kṛtārthaṃ śukraṃ tu jñātvā sarve diteḥ sutāḥ । ।1.407.8 0 ।।
abhijagmurgṛhaṃ tasya guruṃ didṛkṣavaḥ svakam ।
adṛṣṭvā te yayuḥ svasvagṛhaṃ tadā bṛhaspatiḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tuṣṭyarthaṃ daśavarṣāṇi jayantyā hitakāmyayā ।
śukrarūpaṃ samāsādya tvasurān samupāhvayan ।।82।।
āgatānāha vo vidyā dāsyāmi śaṃkaroditāḥ ।
te tu hṛṣṭā daśasamā vidyārthamupapedire ।।8 3 ।।
anyā anyā adhyāpitā vañcitā guruṇā hi te ।
nataḥ kāvyo daśavarṣottaraṃ draṣṭuṃ svayājakān ।।84।।
yayau dṛṣṭā guruṇā svarūpeṇa vañcitāstu te ।
vañcitān kāvyarūpeṇa kāvyo'bravīttu tāँstadā । ।85।।
kāvyaṃ māṃ vo vijānīdhvaṃ nā'yaṃ kāvyo bṛhaspatiḥ ।
bṛhaspatistadā prāha kāvyo'haṃ nā'yameva saḥ ।।86 ।।
ayantu vañcanārthaṃ vo daśavarṣāttaraṃ guruḥ ।
samāgato'sti maddeśānmā kāvyo jñāyatāmayam ।।87।।
etacchrutvā dvayorvākyaṃ sarūpayostu dānavāḥ ।
prekṣantastāvubhau tatra saṃbhrāntāste tadā'bhavan ।।88 ।।
hālareṇa dhṛtaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ maraṇāntaṃ na mucyate ।
na śakyaṃ tvanyathākartuṃ diṣṭaṃ hi balavattaram । ।8 9 ।।
śukreṇa bodhitāścāpi naivā'manyata tadvacaḥ ।
yastu no daśavarṣāṇi satataṃ śāsti vai prabhuḥ । । 1.407.90 ।।
eṣa vai gururasmākaṃ kāvyo nāgantuko hyayam ।
iti niścitya daityāste cirābhyāsena mohitāḥ । । 91 ।।
prāhurgaccha drutaṃ ceto gurustu śikṣako'sti naḥ ।
bhārgavo vā'ṅgirā vāpi bhagavāneṣa no guruḥ । । 92 ।।
tadā śukraḥ kopito'bhūt śaśāpa dānavāँstadā ।
sarve praṇaṣṭabhānā vai mahadduḥkhamavāpsyatha ।। 93 ।।
śukreṇa śaptā asurāḥ kṛtārtho'bhūd vṛhaspatiḥ ।
tirobhavat tataḥ sthānāt tataste hyasurāḥ punaḥ ।। 94। ।
vibhrāntā abhavan lakṣmi! vañcitāḥ smeti cāvadan ।
prahlādamagrataḥ kṛtvā śukrācāryagṛhaṃ yayuḥ ।। 95।।
ūcustaṃ naḥ kṣamasveti prasādaṃ kuru bhārgava! ।
no cet prasādaṃ kuruṣe praviśāmo rasātalam । । 96 ।।
kāvyo vicārayāmāsa yājyānvinā'pyahaṃ mṛṣā ।
tato mayā rakṣaṇīyāḥ śobhe'haṃ sevitaśca taiḥ ।। 97।।
athāhaitānna bhetavyaṃ na gantavyaṃ rasātalam ।
bhāna praṇaṣṭa yadā vo'dya tatpunaḥ pratipatsyatha ।। 98 ।।
devān jitvā tvekavāraṃ pātālaṃ pratipatsyatha ।
ityuktā hyasurā hṛṣṭā surān jetuṃ viniryayuḥ ।। 99 ।।
surāsurāṇāṃ saṃgrāmo hyabhavad dāruṇastadā ।
ajayannasurā devān devāścāpi hyamantrayan ।। 1.407.100 ।।
yajñe cāhūya vai ṣaṇḍāmarkau daityagurū ca tau ।
āśrayāmaḥ pūjayāmo bhajāmo no jayo bhavet ।। 101 ।।
devairāhūya tau proktau tyajetāmasurān dvijau ।
vayaṃ yuvāṃ bhajiṣyāmaḥ saha jitvā tu dānavān ।। 102 ।।
evaṃ sandhāya ca surāścakruryuddhaṃ hi dāruṇam ।
ṣaṇḍāmarkaparityaktā dānavāśca parājitāḥ ।। 103 ।।
kāvyaśāpābhibhūtāśca viviśuste rasātalam ।
evaṃ nirudyamā devaiḥ kṛtāḥ kṛcchreṇa dānavāḥ ।। 1 04।।
jayantī svapatiṃ nityaṃ sevate mohakāriṇī ।
śukrācāryo visasmāra daityābhyudayameva ca ।। 105।।
indrasyaivaṃ kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ jayantyā vijayātmakam ।
daityānāṃ nirbalatvaṃ ca pātivratyārthayā'pi vai ।। 106 ।।
patyuścā'pyapradhṛṣyatvaṃ mahendrāderjayādikam ।
daityānāṃ cāpakṛṣṭatvaṃ sādhitaṃ kanyayā vrataiḥ ।। 107 ।।
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahmā'kṣaradhāmasthito'pi saḥ ।
karoti rakṣaṇaṃ kāle dhṛtvā dharmātmikāṃ tanum ।। 108 ।।
ādye patnīvratākhyo'bhūt kṛṣṇo golokavāsakṛt ।
tato nārāyaṇo jajñe narayukto himācale ।। 109 ।।
punaryajño dharmaputro'bhavat sa eva dhārmikaḥ ।
narasiṃhaḥ sa evābhūt vāmano'pi babhūva ha ।। 1.407.110 ।।
dattātreyo jāmadagnyo rāmādityo babhūva ha ।
vāsudevo vedavyāsaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastathā ।। 111 ।।
kāmbhareyastathā kalkī sa eva bhagavān svayam ।
jāyate yugaparyāye suradharmāvanāya vai ।। 112 ।।
ahameva sa evā'smi madaṃśāśca sahasraśaḥ ।
dine dine prajāyante gūḍharūpāḥ sukhapradāḥ । । 113 ।।
dhanuścakradhvajamatsyasvastikakaracihnitāḥ ।
gulphatrayordhvarekhā'rdhacandracakrapadāmbujāḥ ।। 114।।
yatpādasevanāt santaḥ sādhvyo bhavanti dehinaḥ ।
mokṣadā devasadṛśā muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 115 ।।
iti te kathitā lakṣmi! khyāterjayantyāḥ siddhayaḥ ।
pātivratyakṛtāḥ pāṭhācchravād bhuktimuktipradāḥ ।। 116 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratākhyātikṛtamahendrādijaḍībhāvaḥ, viṣṇukṛtakhyātināśaḥ, bhṛguṇā khyātirujjīvitā, śukrasya tapaścaryā, indreṇa putrī jayantī vighnārthe śukrāya dattā, tatputrī devayānī, taponirodhaḥ, asuraparājayaḥ, pātivratyamahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।407 । ।


← adhyāyaḥ 407 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 408
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 409 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi pātivratyamahābalam ।
upabarhaṇapatnyā vai mālāvatyā pradarśitam । । 1 ।।
brahmā'sṛjad yadā sṛṣṭiṃ vinirmāya tu nāradam ।
prāha sṛṣṭipravāhārthaṃ nāradastannyaṣedhayat ।। 2 ।।
muktidātā pitā prokto mokṣagāmī suto mataḥ ।
bhrātā mātā patiḥ patnī bhaktipradāḥ śubhāḥ sadā ।। 3 ।।
māyābandhanadātāro na bodhyāste kuṭumbinaḥ ।
tva ca brahmā svayaṃ jñānī niyojayasi māyike ।। 4 ।।
nāhaṃ māyāṃ grahīṣyāmi na ca sṛṣṭiṃ karomyapi ।
bhajiṣye brahma paramaṃ tārayiṣye tvadādikān ।। 5 ।।
sārthakayiṣye putratvaṃ mā khedaṃ vaha viśvasṛṭ ।
ityukto roṣatāmrākṣo brahmā śaśāpa nāradam ।। 6 ।
mṛtyuṃ prāpya dārayukto bhava dāsastataḥ param ।
jñānahīnaḥ karmabhāro bhava nārada vai muhuḥ ।। 7 ।।
tadā taṃ nāradaḥ prāha pitā maivaṃ kuru prabho! ।
tvamapyatra hi saṃsāre pūjyatāṃ mā labha kvacit ।। 8 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa tadā brahmā sanakādibhirarthitaḥ ।
putraṃ prāha punastvaṃ vai caturthe māmavāpsyasi ।। 9 ।।
brahmacaryaparastatra sadā putra bhaviṣyasi ।
tāvad dāragṛhavyāpto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 1.408.10 ।।
ityuto nārado naṣṭo mārīco hyabhavat tataḥ ।
gandharvarājasya viśvāvasoḥ putratvamāptavān ।। 11 ।।
upabarhaṇanāmā'sau gandharvo'bhūcca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi viśvāvasuḥ purā kila ।। 1 2।।
tapaścacāra śaṃbhośca putrahīno hi karmaṇā ।
vaśiṣṭhaḥ pradadau tasmai mantraṃ tu dvādaśākṣaram ।। 13 ।।
varṣaśataṃ jajāpainaṃ puṣkare tāvadeva ca ।
prasannāsyaṃ vṛṣabhasthaṃ dadarśa purataḥ śivam ।। 14।।
varaṃ vṛṇuṣveti śivastamuvāca tato hyayam ।
yayāce śrīharerbhaktiṃ putra paramavaiṣṇavam ।। 15।।
śivaḥ prāha prasanno'smi tathā'stu tava maṃgalam ।
kṛtārthastvaṃ varādekādanyaccarvitacarvaṇam ।। 16 ।।
yasya bhaktirharau vatsa sudṛḍhā sarvamaṃgalā ।
sa samarthaḥ sarvaviśvaṃ pātuṃ kartuṃ ca līlayā ।। 17।।
bhaved yasya sukṛtinaḥ putraḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ ।
kulakoṭiṃ tasya te vai hyuddhārayanti līlayā ।। 18।।
caritārthaḥ pumānekād varamirachurvarādaho ।
kiṃ vareṇa dvitīyena puṃsā tṛptirna maṃgale ।। 1 9।।
harerbhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ putraṃ paramavaiṣṇavam ।
cirāyuṣaṃ ca guṇinaṃ śaśvatsusthirayauvanam ।। 1.408.20।।
jñāninaṃ sundaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ gurubhaktaṃ jitendriyam ।
labhasvemaṃ varaṃ ceti hyuktvā śaṃbhustirodadhe ।।2 1 ।।
viśvāvasurgṛhaṃ yātaḥ parvate gandhamādane ।
nāradastasya bhāryāyāṃ lebhe janma śubhāvaham ।।22।।
gururvaśiṣṭhastannāma cakāra copabarhaṇam ।
upaśabdo'dhikārtho'tra pūjye tu barhaṇaḥ pumān ।।23 । ।
pūjyānāmadhiko bālastenopabarhaṇābhidhaḥ ।
upabarhaṇaḥ kālena tepe ca duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।। 24।।
gaṇḍakītīramāsādya taṃ tadā sthirayauvanam ।
gāndharvyo dadṛśustaṃ ca pañcāśad vavrire patim ।।25।।।
gṛhītvā tā yuvā reme dvilakṣavarṣa kāmukaḥ ।
ekadā sa yayau brahmasabhāyāṃ ca jagau kathām । । 26 ।।
tadā raṃbhāṃ sa cālokya caṃcalo hyabhavanmuhuḥ ।
drutaṃ tatyāja saṃgītaṃ mūrchāṃ prāpa sabhātale ।। 27 ।।
uccaiḥ prājahasurdevā brahmā kopācchaśāpa tam ।
vraja tvaṃ śūdrayoniṃ ca gāndharvīṃ tanumutsṛja ।। 28 ।।
kāle vaiṣṇavasaṃsargānmanputrastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
upabarhaṇagandharvaḥ sa jahau tāṃ tanuṃ tadā । । 29 ।।
mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūramanāhatam ।
viśuddhamājñācakraṃ ṣaḍ bhittvā tanvā viniryayau ।। 1.408.30 ।।
yogena brahmasamprāpa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā smaran ।
patnyaśca bāndhavāḥ sarve vilapya rurudurbhṛśam ।। 31 ।।
pañcāśadyoṣitāṃ madhye sādhvī mālāvatī tadā ।
uccaiḥ ruroda sā tīvraṃ kṛtvā kāntaṃ svavakṣasi ।। 32 ।।
citrarathasya kanyāstā rurudustasya yoṣitaḥ ।
mālāvatī vilalāpa kṛṣṇa tvaṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ ।। 33 ।।
nāhaṃ jagadbahistvasmi māṃ na pāsi kathaṃ prabho! ।
are surā yajñabhujo ghṛtaṃ bhoktuṃ kṣamā bhuvi ।। 34।।
kṣaṇenā'yajñabhājaśca kariṣyāmi satītvataḥ ।
nārāyaṇa jagatkānta nāhameva jagadbahiḥ ।। 35।।
pātivratyaṃ mama pūrṇamakhaṇḍitaṃ yadasti cet ।
śīghraṃ jīvaya matkāntamanyathā tvāṃ śapāmyaham ।। 36 ।।
prajāpate! putraśāpāt tvamapūjyo dharātale ।
tavaivā'nadhikāritvaṃ kariṣyāmyatra sarjane ।। 37।।
he śaṃbho jñānalopaṃ te kariṣyāmi śapena vai ।
dharmalopaṃ ca dharmasya kariṣyāmyeva vai kṣaṇāt ।। 38 । ।
yamādhikāraṃ dūre ca kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।
satyaṃ kālaṃ śapiṣyāmi mṛtyukanyāṃ suniṣṭhurām । । 39 । ।
śapāmi sarvānatraiva jarāṃ vyādhiṃ vinā'dhunā ।
vyādhinā jarayā mṛtyurna hyabhūcca patermama । ।1.408.40 । ।
ityuktvā kauśikītīre tvāgacchacchaptumeva tān ।
tāṃ śaptumudyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā śaṃbhupurogamaḥ । ।41 । ।
devatāśca yayustīraṃ kṣīrābdheḥ śaraṇaṃ harim ।
tatra snātvā ca tuṣṭuvuḥ paramātmānamīśvaram । ।42। ।
viṣṇuṃ brahmā jagatkāntamityuvāca ha bhītavat ।
upabarhaṇapatnī sā kanyā citrarathasya ca । ।43 । ।
kāntahetośca mā devān śapet tvaṃ rakṣa mādhava! ।
smaranti sādhavaḥ santo mahāpatsu parameśvaram ।। 44। ।
śaraṇāgatadīnārtaparitrāṇaparāyaṇa! ।
rakṣa rakṣa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa te śaraṇaṃ gatān ।।45। ।
adhikāravihīnaṃ māṃ mālāvatī dadhāti vai ।
sampat sarvā mahābrāhmī yāsyatyevā'dhunā mama ।।46 ।।
śaṃbhuṃ prāha tvayā dattaṃ mahājñānaṃ sudurlabham ।
śatamanvantaratapaḥphalena puṣkare purā ।।47। ।
aiśvaryadhanasāmarthyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā narāyaṇa! ।
mamaitajjñānaratnaṃ vai śāpānniryāti yoṣitaḥ । ।48। ।
aho pativratātejaḥ sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ param ।
tejo'nalena dagdhaṃ māṃ trāhi rakṣa hare prabho । ।49 ।।
dharmaḥ prāha mahāratnaṃ dharma eva sanātanaḥ ।
so'haṃ nāśaṃ sameṣyāmi yoṣitaḥ śāpataḥ prabho! । ।1.408.50 । ।
saptamanvantaratapaḥphalena parameśvara! ।
prāpto dharmastvayā datto'dhunā śāpena naśyati ।।51 । ।
devā ūcuḥ kratau ghṛtabhujo vayaṃ tvayā kṛtāḥ ।
yoṣicchāpena vai sarvaṃ nāśaṃ yāti dayāṃ kuru ।। 52।।
iti stuvanti tāvadvai vāgbabhūvā'śarīriṇī ।
yūyaṃ gacchata tatraiva yāsyāmyahaṃ hi rakṣaṇe ।।53 । ।
śrutvā hṛṣṭāḥ surā mālāvatīṃ yayurhi tatkṣaṇam ।
mālāvatī surān dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma pativratā ।।54। ।
ruroda kāntaṃ saṃsthāpya devānāṃ sannidhau priye! ।
etasminnantare kaścit tatra brāhmaṇabālakaḥ ।।55 ।।
ājagāma śuklavāsāḥ paṃcāṃgapatrasaṃyutaḥ ।
satilakaḥ samāgatya sabhāmadhye hyuvāsa saḥ ।।56 ।।
uvāca kathamatraite surā brahmādayo'pare ।
samāyātā namo vo'stu sraṣṭā svayaṃ kathaṃ sthitaḥ ।।57।।
aho hartā svayaṃ rudro dharmaḥ sākṣī kathaṃ sthitaḥ ।
kathaṃ raviḥ kathaṃ candraḥ kathamatra hutāśanaḥ ।।58।।
kathaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā kathaṃ vātra yamādayaḥ ।
he mālāvati te kroḍe ko'ti śuklaḥ śavo'dhunā ।।59 ।।
iti bruvantaṃ taṃ natvā mālāvatī jagād ha ।
namo viprasvarūpāya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te ।।1.408.6 0।।
akasmād brahmaṇaḥ śāpāt prāṇāँstatyāja matpatiḥ ।
devānuddiśya vilapāmyatha jīvati matpatiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
sarvāndevānahaṃ yāce patidānaṃ mamepsitam ।
yadi dāsyanti devā me kāntadānaṃ yathepsitam ।।62।।
bhadraṃ tadā'nyathā tebhyaḥ saṃśapsyāmi ca dāruṇam ।
durnivāryaḥ satīśāpastapasā kena vāryate ।।63।।
brāhmaṇastāmuvācedaṃ sati kāle phalet kṛtam ।
kāle prāptaṃ bhaveccāpi nāgrahastatra yujyate ।।64।।
yatrādhikāro devānāṃ tattad dadāti nā'param ।
na balaṃ na ca saundaryaṃ naiśvaryaṃ na dhanaṃ sutaḥ ।।65।।
naiva strī na ca satkānto labhyate tapasā vinā ।
prakṛtiṃ sevate yaḥ sa labhet kāntāṃ guṇānvitām ।।66।।
śriyaṃ ca niścalāṃ putraṃ pautraṃ bhūmiṃ dhanaṃ prajām ।
śivārcanāt satīṃ kāntāṃ satpatiṃ labhate sa sā ।।67।।
vidyāṃ jñānaṃ sukavitāṃ putraṃ pautraṃ parāṃ śriyam ।
balaṃ dhanaṃ vikramaṃ ca mahadaiśvaryamityapi ।।68।।
brahmārcanāllabhet siddhīrvidyāṃ śriyaṃ prajāstathā ।
sūyārcanāllabhed vidyāmārogyadhanaputrakān ।।69।।
gaṇeśasyā'rcanād vighnanāśaṃ sarvāgrapūjyatām ।
paramānandamaiśvaryaṃ putraṃ vidyāṃ dhanaṃ prajāḥ ।।1.408.70 ।।
viṣṇostu sevayā muktiṃ tapo dharmaṃ yaśaḥ śriyam ।
dharmasya sevanāt śāntiṃ sukhaṃ dhanaṃ labheta ca ।।71 ।।
yo yaṃ devaṃ bhajedbhaktyā sattvādau labhate tu tam ।
kāle paścāttena sārdhaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ labhet ।।72।।
bhajate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yaḥ prakṛteḥ param ।
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।।73 ।।
sākāraṃ ca nirākāraṃ jyotiḥ svecchāmayaṃ vibhum ।
sarvādhāraṃ ca sarveśaṃ paramānandamīśvaram ।।74।।
nirliptaṃ sākṣirūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahavigraham ।
jīvanmuktaḥ sa satyaṃ vai varaṃ nākāṃkṣati dhruvam ।।।75।।
sa sarvaṃ manute tucchaṃ sālokyādi catuṣṭayam ।
brahmatvamamaratvaṃ ca loṣṭavattucchavat sati! ।।76।।
aiśvaryaṃ loṣṭatulyaṃ ca naśvaraṃ ceti manyate ।
jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ jānātyeva vinaśvaram ।।77।।
dāsyaṃ vinā na yāceta śrīkṛṣṇasya padaṃ param ।
svapne jāgaraṇe vāpi śaśvat sevāṃ hi vāñcchati ।।78।।
paripūrṇatamaṃ brahma sevate yaḥ sthiraḥ sadā ।
ātmanaḥ kulakoṭiṃ sa śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ।।79।
śvaśurasya śataṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya svaṃ hi līlayā ।
dāsaṃ dāsīṃ prasūṃ bhāryāṃ putrādapi paraṃ śatam ।।1.408.80 ।
uddhared kṛṣṇabhakto vai golokaṃ dhāma yāti ca ।
guruvaktrād viṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśatyapi ।।8 1 ।
yamastallekhanaṃ dūraṃ karoti tatkṣaṇe bhiyā ।
madhuparkādikaṃ brahmā tadarthaṃ viniyujya ca ।।82।।
satyaloke'bhito yāti mārgeṇānena yāsyati ।
niḥśaṃko yāti golokaṃ vihāya mānavīṃ tanum ।।83 । ।
purātanaṃ kṛtaṃ karma yadyat tasya śubhāśubham ।
chinatti kṛṣṇaścakreṇa tīkṣṇadhāreṇa santatam ।।84।।
taṃ vihāya jarāmṛtyuryāti cakrabhiyā sati! ।
anyathā śatakhaṇḍaṃ tāṃ kurute tu sudarśanaḥ ।।85 । ।
gatvā divyāṃ tanuṃ dhṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sevate tadā ।
yāvat kṛṣṇo hi goloke tāvadbhakto vaset sadā ।।86 । ।
nimeṣaṃ manute dāso naśvaraṃ brahmaṇo vayaḥ ।
vada vinā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nānyaḥ samarthakaḥ ।।87।।
kena rogeṇa hi mṛto'dhunā sādhvi tava priyaḥ ।
sarvarogacikitsāṃ ca jānāmyahaṃ cikitsakaḥ ।।88 ।।
rājamṛtyuṃ yamaṃ kālaṃ vyādhimānīya te puraḥ ।
nibaddhya dātuṃ śakto'haṃ vyādho badhvā paśuṃ yathā ।।।89 ।।
yo vā yogena khedena dehatyāgaṃ karoti ca ।
tasya taṃ jīvanopāyaṃ jānāmi yogadharmataḥ ।।1.408.90 ।।
vipravākyaṃ satī śrutvā kāntabhaktā hyuvāca tam ।
sarvaṃ kalayituṃ śaktastvaṃ yadi brāhmaṇottama! ।।91 ।।
kālaṃ yamaṃ mṛtyukanyāṃ madabhyāśe samānaya ।
mālāvatīvacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇustānāhvayaँstadā ।।92।।
dadarśa mṛtyukanyāṃ sā prathamaṃ mālikāvatī ।
kṛṣṇavarṇāṃ ghorarūpāṃ raktāmbarapradhāriṇīm ।।।93 ।।
ṣaḍbhujāṃ ca dayāyuktāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭisutānvitām ।
tataḥ kālaṃ ghorarūpaṃ dadarśa purataḥ satī ।।94।।
ṣaḍvaktraṃ ṣoḍaśabhujaṃ caturviṃśatilocanam ।
ṣaṭpādaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca raktāmbaradharaṃ varam ।।95।।
grīṣmasūryasamakāntiṃ sarvasaṃhārarūpiṇam ।
satī dadarśa purato vyādhisaṃghān sudurjayān ।।96 ।।
vayasā'timahāvṛddhān yūno bālāṃśca ghātakān ।
satī dadarśa dharmiṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ yamaṃ tathā ।।97।।
dharmādharmavicārajñaṃ śāstāraṃ pāpināṃ gurum ।
atha mālāvatī yamaṃ papraccha yuktikovidā ।।98 ।।
he dharmarāja dharmiṣṭha kāle hyanāgate'pi me ।
kāntamakāle tu kathaṃ harasi vada me vibho ।।99।।
yamaḥ prāhā'prāptakālo mriyate na kadācana ।
īśvarājñāṃ vinā sādhvi! nā'mṛtaṃ vai nayāmyaham ।। 1.408.100 ।।
ahaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā vyādhayaśca sudurjayāḥ ।
niṣeke nirmitā yasya taṃ harāmo hi tatkṣaṇe ।। 101 ।।
mṛtyukanyā sahavāsā vijñāpayati yatkṣaṇam ।
tatkṣaṇe'haṃ kalayāmi pṛcchaināṃ tvatpatikṛte ।। 102 ।।
mālāvatī tadā prāha mṛtyukanye kathaṃ tvayā ।
mama kānto hṛto'kāle jīvitāyāṃ mayi priye! ।। 103 । ।
mṛtyukanyā ca tāṃ prāha sṛṣṭā viśvasṛjā'tra vai ।
prāṇaviyojanakārye saṃharāmi yathāpalam ।। 1 04।।
kālena preritā cā'haṃ niṣekeṇa sahasthitā ।
nityamāyurharāmyeva nātra me dūṣaṇaṃ priye ।। 1 05 ।।
satī satīnāṃ madhye ca kācittejasvinī yadi ।
māmapi bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamā tadā jagat khalu ।। 106 । ।
mṛtyukanyāvihīnaṃ saccā'mṛtaṃ syānna tvanyathā ।
ahaṃ tiṣṭhāmi garbhe'pi dehināṃ dehatattvake ।। 1 07।।
nityaṃ nityaṃ saṃharāmi jānanti naiva tajjanāḥ ।
adya yajjāyate śvastad vṛddhamityeva vartate ।। 108 ।।
nūtanaṃ jāyate paścājjīrṇa vṛddhaṃ taducyate ।
nityaṃ nityaṃ hi vārdhakyaṃ sarvatra saṃpravartate ।। 109 ।।
janā mūḍhāstu modante yuvā'haṃ bālako'smyaham ।
nāsmi vṛddha ityajñānaṃ jānantyeva na vṛddhatām ।। 1.408.110 ।।
vṛddhirhi vṛddhatā proktā niṣeko vardhate sadā ।
garbhe ca vardhate nityaṃ bālyādau ca vivardhate ।। 111 ।।
vardhate eva nityaṃ na tūno bhavati kaścana ।
kālapraperitā cāha matputrā vyādhayastathā । । 112 ।।
kurmaḥ kāryaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ na no doṣo'sti vai sati! ।
pṛccha kālaṃ mahātmānamucitaṃ sa kariṣyati ।। 113 ।।
satī prāha tadā kālaṃ sākṣin vai karmaṇāṃ prabho! ।
kathaṃ harasi matkāntaṃ jīvitāyāṃ mayi prabho! ।। 11 4।।
śrutvā mālāvatīduḥkhaṃ kālaḥ prāha satīṃ tadā ।
ko vā'haṃ ko yamaḥ kā ca mṛtyukanyā tathā''dhayaḥ ।। 115 ।।
vayaṃ bhramāmaḥ śrīkṛhaṇādeśasya paripālakāḥ ।
mūlā prakṛtiryadvāme yatkukṣau viṣṇuśaṃbhvajāḥ ।। 116 ।।
devatā yannideśasthā dharmo'pi yasya vai vaśe ।
grahāśca rāśayo yasya dikpālādyāśca vai vaśe ।। 1 17।।
tasyaivāṃśo hyayaṃ kālo mṛtyurmṛtyusutā''dhayaḥ ।
ime yatpreritāḥ sarve kurmo yogaviyojane । । 118 । ।
pṛccha kṛṣṇaṃ śāsako tvaṃ kathaṃ svāmī mṛtastava ।
ityuktvā virame kālo brāhmaṇastāmuvāca ha । । 119 । ।
pṛṣṭaḥ kālo yamo mṛtyukanyā vyādhigaṇā api ।
kaste'dhunā ca sandehastaṃ pṛccha kanyake punaḥ । । 1.408.120 । ।
mālāvatī tadā prāha kaṃ pṛcchāmyadhunā dvija! ।
yogena prāṇāँstatyāja matpatiḥ śāpahetunā ।। 121 ।।
adhunā matprāṇakāntaṃ dehi dehi yadi kṛpā ।
natvā vaḥ svāminā sārdhaṃ yāsyāmi svagṛhaṃ prati ।। 1 22।।
kṛṣṇa kva mārgayāmyatra brāhmaṇaḥ kṛṣṇa eva hi ।
brāhmaṇo yatkarotyeva kṛṣṇo'nusarati dvijam ।। 123 ।।
iti dīnavacaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇo devamadhyagaḥ ।
uvāca paramaṃ satyaṃ devānprati dayāvaśaḥ ।। 1 24।।
upabarhaṇabhāryeyaṃ putrī citrarathasya ca ।
yayāce jīvadānaṃ ca svāminaḥ śaraṇāgatā । । 1 25।।
tanmāṃ brūta surāścātra kimanuṣṭheyamarthakṛt ।
śaptukāmā surānsarvān mayā satī nirodhitā ।। 126 ।।
bahubhirvākpralāpaiścā'dhunā kiṃ syād vilambane ।
yuṣmābhirarthito viṣṇuḥ śvetadīpe sa nāgataḥ ।। 1 27। ।
babhūvā''kāśavāṇī ca paścādāyāti keśava ।
viparītaṃ tu tajjātaṃ yato nāyāti keśavaḥ ।। 128 ।।
brahmovāca tadā vipraṃ nārado'yaṃ mamā''tmajaḥ ।
akāle mama śāpena gandharvastūpabarhaṇaḥ ।। 1 29।।
yogena prāṇāँstatyāja kāle'vaśeṣite'pi vai ।
tattu varṣasahasraṃ caivāyurasyāsti sāmpratam ।। 1.408.1 3 0 ।।
dvilakṣaṃ tu gataṃ tasya yaccheṣaṃ pravadāmi tat ।
yathainaṃ na spṛśecchāpo devāśca nirbhayā yathā ।। 131 ।।
hariḥ sarvatra cāstyeva nā''yāto naiva vidyate ।
dṛśyā'dṛśyasvarūpeṇa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'sti saḥ ।। 132 ।।
kṛṣṇaḥ kathaṃ na cāyāti viyadvāgapi vai mṛṣā ।
iti nindaṃ harestasya mā kuru dvija! saṃsadi ।। 133 ।।
kasya śiṣyo munīndrasya kastvaṃ nāmnā ca bho dvija! ।
kva vāsaḥ kuta āyātaḥ kasya vaṃśodbhavo bhavān ।। 1 34।।
viḍambayasi devāṃśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā ।
adhunāpi sabhāṃ viṣṇurnāyāta iti yadvacaḥ ।। 1 35 ।।
tvayoktaṃ tanna śrotavyaṃ nindātmakaṃ parātmanaḥ ।
viṣirvyāptirnuśca yāvat viṣṇuḥ sarvatra vyāpakaḥ ।। 136 ।।
evaṃ sarvatra sattve vai gamanāgamane kutaḥ ।
mahannindā bhavedyatra naiva sādhuḥ śṛṇoti tām ।। 1 37।।
nindakaḥ śrotṛbhiḥ sārdha kuṃbhīpākaṃ vrajed yugam ।
viṣṇunindā trividhā vai mūrtikhaṇḍanarūpiṇī ।। 1 38।।
anastitvarūpiṇī ca jīvasāmyasvarūpiṇī ।
tasyā'tra niṣkṛtirnāsti yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam ।। 1 39।।
gurornindāṃ yaḥ karoti piturnindāṃ narādhamaḥ ।
sa yāti kālasūtraṃ ca yāvaccandradivākarau ।।1.408.140।।
brāhmaṇastu tadākarṇya devānuvāca vai tadā ।
kā kṛtā viṣṇunindā'ho he devā dharmaśālinaḥ ।। 141 ।।
nā''gato hariratreti vyarthā''kāśasarasvatī ।
iti proktaṃ mayā bhadraṃ na tadvai nindanaṃ kṛtam ।। 142 ।।
yūyaṃ vai bhāvukā brūta viṣṇurvyāpaka īśvaraḥ ।
iticet tatkathaṃ yātāḥ śvetadīpaṃ varāya ca ।। 143 ।।
aṃśāṃśinorna bhedaścet parameśatadaṃśayoḥ ।
kalāṃ hitvā niṣevante santaḥ pūrṇatamaṃ katham ।। 144।।
sarvāṃśānāṃ prabhuḥ kṛṣṇo bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।
ūrdhvaṃ ca sarvabrahmāṇḍād vaikuṇṭhaṃ satyameva vai ।। 145।।
caturbhujaśca vaikuṇṭhe lakṣmīkāntaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
tasmādūrdhvaṃ ca golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam ।। 146।।
goloke dvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇo rādhākāntaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
tato'tivyāpako loko'kṣarabrahmātmako'tigaḥ ।। 147।।
paripūrṇatamaṃ brahmaparamaṃ tatra rājate ।
evaṃ tasya kathamatra nāgamo'dya bhaved brūta ।। 148।।
dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ santaḥ sevante divyavigraham ।
yaṃ sevante bhāgavatāḥ santaḥ sādhvyo nirantaram ।। 149।।
yasya vaṃśodbhavo'haṃ ca yasya śiṣyaśca bālakaḥ ।
so'yaṃ vakti dvijo bhūtvā devasaṃghā nibodhata ।। 1.408.150 ।।
śīghraṃ jīvaya gandharvaṃ deveśvara sureśvara ।
vyakte jāte tataḥ kṛṣṇe vāgyuddhe kiṃ prayojanam ।। 151 ।।
ityuktvā bālako vipraścaturbāhuḥ ramāyutaḥ ।
lakṣmīśaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmako'bhavattadā ।। 152।।
atha brahmā kamaṇḍalujalaṃ śave dadau tadā ।
sañcāraṃ manasastasya cakāra sundaraṃ vapuḥ ।। 153।।
jñānadānaṃ dadau śaṃbhurviṣṇurjīvaṃ dadau tataḥ ।
dharmajñānaṃ svayaṃ dharmo vahnirdadau hi jāṭharam ।। 154।।
kāmo dadau surūpatvaṃ vāyuḥ prāṇān dadau tadā ।
sūryo dadau netratejo vāṇīṃ dadau ca śāradā ।। 155।।
śobhāṃ dadau tadā śrīśca devā dadurhi tatkriyāḥ ।
śavastathāpi nottasthau yathā śete jaḍastathā ।। 156।।
brahmovāca tadā sādhvīṃ vayaṃ kṛtamanorathāḥ ।
atha snātvā ca śrīkṛṣṇānārāyaṇaṃ hṛdi smara ।। 157।।
taṃ vinā nojjīvanaṃ vai jīve tiṣṭhati vāstavam ।
brahmaṇo vacanāt sādhvī tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।। 158।।
vande taṃ paramātmānaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ।
vinā yena śavāḥ sarve prāṇino'pi nirarthakāḥ ।।159।।
yadāveśāt sajīvāḥ sakriyāḥ sacetanā yataḥ ।
sevādhyānaṃ na tadapi ghaṭate vigrahaṃ vinā ।। 1.408.160 ।।
tādṛśaṃ divyarūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vibhum ।
tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ koṭigopīgaṇāvṛtam ।। 161 ।।
atīva kamanīyaṃ ca śyāmaṃ paṃkajalocanam ।
mandahāsānanaṃ koṭikandarpasundaraṃ prabhum ।। 162।।
dvibhujaṃ pītavastraṃ ca kiśoraṃ rādhikāpatim ।
lakṣmīśrīpārvatīpadmāpadminīmāṇikīpatim ।। 163।।
pārṣadaiḥ sevitaṃ vande sarvarūpadharaṃ harim ।
prāṇarūpaṃ patiprāṇaṃ vande jīvātumīśvaram ।। 164।।
āyāhi bhagavaँścātra gandharve jeḍacetane ।
ityuktvā sā tu gāndharvī punaḥ prāha ruṣā satī ।। 165।।
yadi nāyāhi bhagavan! kariṣye vai ramādikāḥ ।
matsadṛśīḥ svāmihīnāstvāṃ ca gandharvasadṛśam ।। 166।।
pātivratyaṃ yadi me'sti satyaṃ tadeti yāvatā ।
vaktuṃ yāti tadā tāvat kṛṣṇastatrā''jagāma ha ।। 167।।
mā mā bhetyuktavāँstredhā satīṃ śāpe niṣidhya vai ।
praviveśa ca gandharve tāvatso'bhavadutthitaḥ ।। 168।।
utthāya śīghraṃ vīṇāṃ ca dhṛtvā snātvā ca vāsasī ।
nanāma devān viṣṇuṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tathā ।। 169।।
nanarta ca kṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇa hare govinda vai vadan ।
nedurdundubhayo devāḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ pracakrire ।। 1.408.170।।
sarve yayuḥ svasvadhāma nārado'pi svayoṣitā ।
samaṃ mātrā tathā pitrā yayau gandharvapattanam ।। 171 ।।
mālāvatī ratnakoṭiṃ dadau dhanāni vai satī ।
bhojanāni ca viprebhyaḥ svastivācamakārayat ।। 172।।।
mahotsavaṃ cakārāpi gandharva upabarhaṇaḥ ।
punarjīvanamāsādya pativratāpradāpitam ।। 173 ।।
harerbhaktiṃ harerdāsyaṃ cakāra tūpabarhaṇaḥ ।
yo yā cedaṃ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyād bhāvataḥ priye! ।। 174।।
tasya tasyāḥ prasaubhāgyaprāptirbhavenna saṃśayaḥ ।
bhuktirmuktiścaturvargasiddhirbhavedakhaṇḍitā ।। 175।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
brahmaśāpānnāradasya mṛtyurupabarhaṇākhyagandharvajanmani puna-
rmṛtyustatra tatpatnyā mālāvatyā pātivratyabalena saviṣṇu-
devānāhūya kālādīnāhūya ca svapatirujjīvita
ityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭādhikacatuśśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 408 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 408 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 409
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 410 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi pātivratyaparāyaṇām ।
kathāṃ tvāścaryaparamāṃ pūrvayugānusaṃbhavām ।। 1 ।।
kanyā viśālarājasya vīrā dharmaparāyaṇā ।
viśālena kṛte svayaṃvare rājanyaśobhite ।। re ।।
karandhamasya putro vai jigye'vīkṣit svayaṃvarām ।
atharājanyavargaiḥ sa bahubhirekalo raṇe ।। 3 ।।
parājitaḥ kumārī sā hutā rājakulaistadā ।
śrutvā karandhamo yāyātsainyalakṣasamanvitaḥ ।। 4 ।।
nṛpān hatvā sutaṃ snuṣāṃ nītvā gṛhaṃ yayau punaḥ ।
avīkṣit pitaraṃ prāha kiṃ yaśo me'vaśiṣyate ।। 9 ।।
nāhametāṃ gṛhīṣyāmi na cānyāṃ yoṣitaṃ pitaḥ ।
parairyasyā nirīkṣantyāḥ saṃgrāmehaṃ parājitaḥ ।। 6 ।।
paraiḥ parājito'haṃ yat kātareyaṃ yathā'balā ।
kimatra mānuṣatvaṃ me pāratantrye sthitasya vai ।। 7 ।।
nārīmiṣeṇa me yaśohānirjātā parairiha ।
tasmānnārī na voḍhavyā pāratantryapradāyinī ।। 8 ।।
ityuktavantaṃ kanyā sā'vīkṣitaṃ prāha sundarī ।
bahupārśvasahāyaistu sarve yuddhyanti līlayā ।। 9 ।।
ekena bahūnāṃ yuddhaṃ śauryavyañjakameva tat ।
vikramaste mahān rājan bahubhiḥ saṃparīkṣitaḥ ।। 1.409.1 0।।
ekena saha caikasya yuddhaṃ cet samajāyata ।
ete yamamahīmānā vyajāyanteti dhāraye ।। 11 ।।
ajeyo'yaṃ mahāvīro bahubhirmilitairjitaḥ ।
atrārthastu sphuṭo bhāti yuddhe te'pyakhilā jitāḥ ।। 1 2।।
śauryavikramasaṃyuktamimaṃ sarvamahīkṣitaḥ ।
dharmayuddhamadharmeṇa jitavanto'tra kā trapā ।। 13 ।।
tasmādayaṃ nirmito me nānyo me bhavitā patiḥ ।
yadi rājanya! cenmāṃ tve na gṛhṇāsi pativratām ।। 14।।
kṛtvā tapaśceha divi tvāṃ sampatsye hi viddhi tat ।
varaṃ vṛṇomyahaṃ nātha māṃ bhavānyadi necchati ।। 15।।
tapaso'nyo na me bhartā janmanyasmin bhaviṣyati ।
evamukte'pyavīkṣiti nirmanaske vyalokite ।। 16 ।।
kanyā jagāma tapase vairāgyaṃ paramāsthitā ।
nirāhārāstrimāsā vai gatāścāsyā tataḥ punaḥ ।। 17।।
dehatyāgāya sannaddhā jñātvā devāstadantikam ।
dūtaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsurmātyājyo deha āha tām ।। 18।।
tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi kalyāṇi! jananī cakravartinaḥ ।
putreṇā'rayo hantavyā mlecchā duṣṭāśca dasyavaḥ ।। 1 9।।
pālanīyaṃ bhūtalaṃ ca dharme sthāpyāstataḥ prajāḥ ।
yaṣṭavyaṃ vividhairyajñaiḥ ṣaṭsāhasraiśca saṃkhyayā ।।1.409.20 ।।
satyaṃ vinā patiṃ putraḥ kathaṃ me syāduvāca sā ।
avīkṣitamṛte bhartā nānyo me cātra janmani ।।21 ।।
sa ca necchati māṃ vīro bodhito'pi virāgavān ।
dūtaḥ prāha vane tiṣṭha dehaṃ poṣaya bhāmini! ।।22।।
tapaḥprabhāvāt sarvaṃ te mano'bhīṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā devadūtaḥ sa yayau dehaṃ pupoṣa sā ।।23 ।।
athā'vīkṣitprasūḥ prāha pitā te vṛddhatāṃ gataḥ ।
ekastvaṃ tanayo'vīkṣit! tyaktadāraparigrahaḥ ।।24।।
pitari svargate tyayyaputre ca pṛthivīmimām ।
tavā'ripakṣaḥ putrātra vaṃśakṣaye prabhokṣyati ।।25।।
vaṃśakṣaye ca pitaraḥ śrāddhapiṇḍodakakṣayāḥ ।
patiṣyanti niraye tat kuru pitrupakāritām ।।।26 ।।
pautrasya darśaya sukhaṃ haṭhaṃ sarvaṃ parityaja ।
naiṣṭhikatāṃ parityaja dāradharmaṃ samācara ।।27।।
kulanāśe samāpanne pāpāya brahmacāritā ।
kuloddhārakaraṃ gṛhavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vipadgṛhe ।। 28।।
ityādimātṛvacanaṃ svīcakāra tathāstviti ।
atha yāto vanaṃ tatra mṛgayāmacarad vane ।।29।।
śuśrāva sahasā śabdaṃ trāhi trāhīti yoṣitaḥ ।
mā bhairmā bhairiti vadan rājaputraśca tāṃ yayau ।।1.409.3 0 ।।
sā covāca gṛhītā dānavena bhayavihvalā ।
karandhamasutasyāhaṃ bhāryā sādhvī hyavīkṣitaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
hriyate rakṣasā paśya tāpasī vanavāsinī ।
ityākarṇya tadā'vīkṣit śaravarṣairavākirat ।।32।।
daṇḍairvṛkṣaiśca pāṣāṇairbhallaiścānyāyudhaistadā ।
yuddhaṃ tayorabhūdghoraṃ vīrā vīraṃ samāśritāḥ ।।33।।
tapobhāgaṃ dadātyasmai vijayārthaṃ jalena vai ।
pātivratyaprabhāveṇa satyadārḍhyavṛṣeṇa ca ।।34।।
avīkṣito'vanaṃ sādhvī karoti samare tadā ।
kumāro'pi balaṃ prāptaściccheda daityamastakam ।।35।।।
sā tu hetikṣatadehaṃ siṣeve svāminaṃ satī ।
vane prāha tapaḥ sarvaṃ tathā svapne'pi lokitam ।।36 ।।
parahyo'haṃ sunidrāyāṃ snātuṃ gaṃgāhradaṃ gatā ।
vikṛṣṭā kenacit tatra jalāntarmagnatāṃ gatā ।।37।।
tato rasātalaṃ nītā tatra nāgāstadaṃganāḥ ।
sahasraśastuṣṭuvurmāṃ yayācire surakṣaṇam ।।38।।
aparādhaṃ kariṣyanti sarpāstava sutasya vai ।
kṣantavyaṃ tat nivāryaḥ saḥ prasādaṃ kriyatāmiti ।।39।।
tatheti ca mayā prokte pūjitā prāpitā vanam ।
dṛṣṭo'tra rājaputro'vīvikṣit patiryo hi manmataḥ ।।1.409.40।।
tāvannidrā gatā dṛṣṭaṃ vanaṃ prātaḥ sumaṃgalam ।
nīlakaṇṭhaḥ priyāyuktaḥ samāgatya madantike ।।41 ।।
prātarnṛtyaṃ cakārātra vāmāṃgaṃ me'sphurattadā ।
vāmanitambaguhyādibhāgāścāpyasphuraँstataḥ ।।42।।
śukaḥ śukīsametaścāmṛtapakvaphalaṃ tadā ।
cañcvā gṛhītvā nyakṣipat madaṃke vyomato bruvan ।।43।।
gatahyaśca prage śvetahastī dṛṣṭo'tra kānane ।
kareṇunā ca kalabhairyuktaḥ kamaladhṛk kare ।।44।।
mama pāṇiṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ tavāsmi nāparasya vai ।
ityuktaḥ saḥ prāha bhadraṃ bhavatvevaṃ vidhikṛtam ।।45।।
tadā patiprāṇayā vai tayā saṃsmārito guruḥ ।
tumburustatra cāyāto homaṃ cakre vidhānataḥ ।।46।।
tasyāḥ pāṇigrahaṃ cakre cāvīkṣit vanamadhyataḥ ।
tadā tatra samāyātā devāḥ puṣpāṇi sasṛjuḥ ।।47।।
sasvanurdivyavādyāni nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।
prajagurdevagandharvāḥ prasannā vanadevatāḥ ।।48।।
upajahrustayostatra munigandharvakinnarāḥ ।
bhakṣyānulepanavastrasrakpānādikamuttamam ।।49।।
sa reme sahitastanvyā sā ca tena hyavīkṣitā ।
yayau rājyagṛhe svasya pitrorabhavadutsavaḥ ।।1.409.50।।
dadau dānāni sarvāṇi pautrārthaṃ pitarau tadā ।
atha vyomnā yayau bhāryāsahito meruparvatam ।।51 ।।
tayā ca ramatastasya bhāminyā saha śobhane! ।
gandharvaloke vīrasya putraṃ sā suṣuve satī ।।52।।
babhūva putre sañjāte gandharvāṇāṃ mahotsavaḥ ।
jaguḥ kecittathaivānye mṛdaṃgapaṭahānakān ।।53 ।।
avādayanta vādyāṃśca veṇuvīṇāmayūrakān ।
nanṛtuśca tadutsāhe bahavo'psarasā gaṇāḥ ।।54।।
puṣpavṛṣṭimuco meghā jagarjurmṛdunisvanāḥ ।
dampatībhyāṃ smṛtastatrājagāma tumburuḥ svayam ।।55।।
atiprasanno manasā jātakarmākarottadā ।
cakre svastyayanaṃ tasya bālasya stutipūrvakam ।।56।।
cakravartī mahāvīryo mahābāhurmahābalaḥ ।
svastimān stāt aśeṣāyāḥ kṣiteḥ śāstā satīpatiḥ ।।57।।
ime śakrādayaḥ sarve lokapālāstatharṣayaḥ ।
svasti kurvantu te vīra vīryaṃ cārivināśanam ।।58।।
maruttava śivāyā'stu vāti pūrvo na yo rajaḥ ।
marut te vimalo'kṣīṇo'vaiṣamyāyā'stu dakṣiṇaḥ ।।59।।
paścimaste marud vīryamuttamaṃ te prayacchatu ।
balaṃ yacchatu cotkṛṣṭaṃ marut te ca tathottaraḥ ।।1.409.6 0।।
iti svastyayane gururabravīt maruttaṃ hi tam ।
marutto'yaṃ samabhavat khyātaḥ suto maharṣibhiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
maruttaṃ ca samādāya dampatī svagṛhaṃ gatau ।
gandharvadevamunibhiḥ saha rājñaḥ samīpataḥ ।।6 2।।
bālaṃ nyasya pitustvaṃ ke natvā vṛttaṃ ca sarvathā ।
nivedayāmāsatuśca rājāpi pautradarśanāt ।।63 ।।
sabhāgyo'smītyathā''tmānaṃ praśaśaṃsa punaḥ punaḥ ।
rājñī cāpi putraputraṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoda harṣitā ।।64।।
tataḥ pure mahānāsīdānandaḥ pauraveśmasu ।
rājāpi vasuratnāni go'laṃkārāndadau tadā ।।65 ।।
putraṃ rājye'bhiṣicyaiva sabhāryo vanamāviśat ।
tatra varṣasahasraṃ sa tepe vai dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ।।66 ।।
vihāya dehaṃ nṛpatiḥ śakrasyā''pa salokatām ।
patnī varṣaśataṃ sthitvā tamevāpa patiṃ divi ।।67।।
athā'vīkṣit bahūn yajñān iyāja svāptadakṣiṇān ।
tasyā'pratihataṃ cakramāsīd dvīpeṣu saptasu ।।68।।।
putrastasya marutto'pi cakre yajñān śatāyutān ।
sauvarṇau muñjavānnāma parvataścāhṛtastataḥ ।।6 9 ।।
suvarṇaṃ sarvathā dattaṃ tṛptyā tyaktaṃ ca bhūsuraiḥ ।
prāsādādi samastaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ tasya yatkratau ।।1.409.70।।
viprāṇāṃ pariveṣṭāro devā hyāsaँśca tanmahe ।
yajñabhūmau tadā hyāsan viśve devāḥ sabhāsadaḥ ।।71 ।।
sādhyā maruto vasavo rudrā ādityakāstathā ।
nidhayaḥ ṛṣayaścāsya karmacārāstadā'bhavan ।।72।।
ṛtvik tasya tu saṃvarto babhūvāṃ'girasaḥ sutaḥ ।
bhrātā vṛhaspatervipro devānāmagraṇīstadā ।।73 ।।
athaurvasya ṛṣerāśramottame nāgarāṭ tadā ।
upadravaṃ cakārāsya nāśārthaṃ jagṛhe dhanuḥ ।। 74।।
tathā kopānmahadastraṃ saṃvartakaṃ dadhāra ca ।
marutto nāgarājānāṃ cakre tena ca mardanam ।।75 ।।
samāgacchatpunaḥ svasya rājyaṃ pṛthvyāṃ śaśāsa ca ।
tasya mātā satī vīrā pitā'vīkṣit vanaṃ gatau ।।76 ।।
svargaṃ prāptau pātivratyapatnīvratasamuddhṛtau ।
maruttabhāryā vidarbhatanayā ca prabhāvatī ।।77।।
suvīraputrī sauvīrī dvitīyā'bhūt subhāminī ।
ketuvīryasutā keśī tṛtīyā'bhūt subhāminī ।।78।।
madrarājasutā cāsīt kekayī tu caturthikā ।
sindhurājasutā bhāryāṃ saurandhrī pañcamī hyabhūt ।।79।।
cedirājasutā cābhūd 'bhāryā ṣaṣṭhī sulocanā ।
tāsāṃ pativratānāṃ tu putrā aṣṭādaśā'bhavan ।।1.409.80।।
teṣāṃ pradhāno jyeṣṭhaśca nariṣyanto nṛpo'bhavat ।
ete tu vaiṣṇavāḥ sarve rājñyaḥ satyo'bhavan śubhāḥ ।।81 ।।
mahābhāgavato vaṃśaḥ svasvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
abhajadbhagavantaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।।82।।
dhanadārā na vai bhuṃkte śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamantarā ।
sarvaṃ svātmārpaṇaṃ cakre śrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani ।।83 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devyaḥ patirūpamupasthitam ।
matvā sevāṃ prakurvanti patnīrlakṣmīśca te tathā ।।84।।
evaṃ viṣṇusamāste vai hyāsan pṛthvyāṃ mahīkṣitaḥ ।
patnyo lakṣmīsamāṃścāsan vaiṣṇavyo rājayoṣitaḥ ।।85 ।।
ekadā'bhūnmahāviṣṇoḥ pūjāyāṃ samaruttakaḥ ।
rudrastatra samāyāto dhyānamagne tu rājani ।।88 ।।
satyevaṃ na ca saṃprāptaḥ rudraḥ satkāramityataḥ ।
cukopā'syātivegena hantuṃ śūlaṃ vicikṣipe ।।87।।
hṛdaye lagnamevaitad rājño'sūn hṛd vidārya tat ।
vijahāra tadā sādhvī vaidarbhī tu prabhāvatī ।।88।।
haste jalaṃ samagrāhyovāca yadyahamaṃjasā ।
ājīvanaṃ patisevākartrī cāsmi pativratā ।।89।।
tena satyena rudro'yaṃ mṛtiṃ yātu punaḥ punaḥ ।
yadi devāḥ pūjitāścātithayaścāpi satkṛtāḥ ।।1.409.90 ।।
prasāditaḥ patirnityaṃ śūlaṃ dūraṃ śanairbhavet ।
yadi śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ kṛtā sevā suśraddhayā । ।91 ।।
prasāditaṃ bhartṛkulaṃ patihṛtsandhitaṃ bhavet ।
gṛhadharmaparā nityaṃ patidevā bhavāmi cet ।।92।।
patnīvrataḥ patirme cet sajīvo bhavatu priyaḥ ।
sapatnyaḥ svasṛvannityaṃ mānitāstoṣitā yadi ।।93 ।।
mātṛvatpūjitāścāpi duhitṛvatsurakṣitāḥ ।
tena puṇyena me pāpaṃ rudranāśānna vai bhavet ।।94।।
ityuktavatī ca yathā tathā sarvaṃ vyavartata ।
hāhākāro mahānāsīd rudranāśo'tiduḥsahaḥ ।।95।।
maruttena tadā sādhvī cānunītā'ti bhāminī ।
rudrasyojjīvanārthaṃ vai tadā śāntā'vadatpatim ।।96।।
samujjīvaya deveśaṃ nātha rudraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam ।
avaiṣṇavāśca ye rudrāste tu kalpe prakalpake ।।97।।
brahmamālāsamutpannā nāśameṣyanti vai dhruvam ।
iti śāpo mama rudre kalpādau tu punaḥ punaḥ ।। 18 ।।
krūrarudrasamutsarge tān sprakṣyati muhurmuhuḥ ।
vaiṣṇavastu mahārudraḥ sthāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 99।।
jalamāmantrya bhasmaiva kurvārdraṃ tata eva saḥ ।
marutteśvara īśo'sau samujjīvo bhaviṣyati ।। 1.409.100 ।।
ityukto marutaḥ patnyā gṛhītvā jalameva ca ।
yadyahaṃ tvājīvanaṃ vai patnīvrataparāyaṇaḥ ।। 101 ।।
prajādharmo rājadharmā'cyuto'smi vaiṣṇavaḥ sadā ।
bahucchidrakṛto'dharmo yadi spṛṣṭo na māṃ kvacit ।। 1 02।।
tena puṇyena rudro'yaṃ vaiṣṇavo jīvatāt khalu ।
yadi patnī satī bhāryā prabhāvatī yathā mama ।। 1 03।।
tathā patnyo'parāścāpi pūrṇāḥ pativratāḥ khalu ।
ahaṃ tāsāṃ samavartī pakṣapātaṃ na cācaram ।। 104।।
tena puṇyena rudro'yaṃ satriśūlaḥ prajīvatu ।
ityuktvā pradadau vāri bhasmani yāvadeva tu ।। 105।।
tāvat saumyo mahārudraḥ sajīvo'bhavadagrataḥ ।
vanditaḥ pūjitaḥ so'tha kṣamāpito muhurmuhuḥ ।। 1 06।।
rudreṇāpi satī sādhvī prabhāvatī prasāditā ।
rājā prasāditaścāpi rājñā'rcitaḥ suvanditaḥ ।। 1 07।।
marutteśvararūpeṇa tasthau tadbhavane haraḥ ।
divyarūpeṇa ca yayau kailāsaṃ śaṃkarastadā ।। 1 08।।
māhātmyaṃ pātivratyasya viveda pārvatīṃ jagau ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! mahāpuṇyapradaṃ vratam ।। 1 09।।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya sarvayajñaphalaṃ bhavet ।
kathāyāḥ smaraṇāccāpi bhuktimuktiphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1.409.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye'vīkṣitnṛpapatnyā vīrāyā maruttasya ca patnyāḥ prabhāvatyāśca pātivratyacamatkāre rākṣasanāśo rudranāśasajīvanate cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navā'dhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।409।।


← adhyāyaḥ 409 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 410
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 411 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi śaktipatnyāḥ parākramam ।
vaśiṣṭho'sti brahmaṇoṃ'śo vedadraṣṭā ṛṣiḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 1 ।।
arundhatī satī sādhvī tasya patnī pativratā ।
tasyāṃ vaśiṣṭho bhagavān sutānajanayacchatam ।। 2 ।।
tatra śaktisamākhyo vai jyeṣṭho'bhūd yasya yoṣiti ।
parāśaraḥ ṛṣirjajñe yasyā'haṃ vyāsasaṃjñakaḥ ।। 3 ।।
putro'bhavaṃ mama putro brahma śukasvarūpavān ।
yasya me sarvathā kīrtirgīyate mokṣasiddhaye ।। 4 ।।
rākṣaso rudhiro nāma śaktiṃ vaśiṣṭhaputrakam ।
bhakṣayāmāsa tacchrutvā vaśiṣṭho bahuduḥkhitaḥ ।। 5 ।।
navanavatiputrāśca rudhireṇa prabhakṣitāḥ ।
tacchrutvā'tha vaśiṣṭho'pi martuṃ cakre matiṃ tadā ।। 6 ।।
tadā tasya snuṣā prāha patnī śaktermahāmunim ।
bhagavan brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha! tava dehamimaṃ śubham ।। 7 ।।
pālayasva vibho draṣṭuṃ tava pautraṃ mamātmajam ।
garbhastho mama sarvārthasādhakaḥ śaktijo yataḥ ।। 8 ।।
tadā garbhagato bālaḥ ṛcamāha svareṇa vai ।
tanniśamya vaśiṣṭho'bhūdāścaryavān kathaṃ kutaḥ ।। 9 ।।
tāvannārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sākṣādabhūt tadaṃgaṇe ।
prāha tvatputraputrasyā''nanād ṛco viniḥsṛtāḥ ।। 1.410.1 0।।
matsamastava pautro'sau śaktijaḥ śaktimāniti ।
tena satpautralābhena kulaṃ te saṃtariṣyati ।। 11 ।।
evamuktvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāntaradhīyata ।
vaśiṣṭho dakṣahastena pasparśodaramādarāt ।। 1 2।।
adṛśyantyāḥ śaktipatnyā garbharakṣāṃ cakāra ha ।
adṛśyantī satī sādhvī mahāpativratā tadā ।। 1 3।।
kālaṃ rudraṃ yamaṃ viśvāmitraṃ śaśāpa rākṣasam ।
śakte! śakte! pate! te'haṃ pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।। 14।।
yadi patnyasmi dharmiṣṭhā tvadarthārpitajīvitā ।
śvaśrūścārundhatī cāsti ramātulyā pativratā ।। 15।।
tadā kālaśca rudraśca viśvāmitro yamastathā ।
rākṣasaśceti sarve te bhavantu prastarā jaḍāḥ ।। 1 6।।
yatra yatraiva te santi tatra pāṣāṇarūpiṇa ।
jaḍā niścetanāḥ santu yāvadābhūtasamplavam ।। 17।।
iti śaptāstadā yatra yatrā'bhavaँśca te tadā ।
