haṃsānārāyaṇo'haṃ mañjulānārāyaṇo'smyaham ।
muktānārāyaṇaścā'haṃ sākṣinārāyaṇo'smyaham ।। 125।।
pātivratyaparaṃ brahmakulaṃ cedaṃ smariṣyati ।
śroṣyati muktigo bhāvī yo vā caitatpaṭhiṣyati ।। 1 26।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāt lakṣmyādinaikasatīnāṃ prāvirbhāvapradarśananāmā saptadaśādhikacatuśśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।417।।


← adhyāyaḥ 417 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 418
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 419 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! hṛdayena kathayāmi tavā'grataḥ ।
gopyaṃ naiva mayā kiñcid bhavatyāṃ sarvathā priye ।। 1 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścā'haṃ bhavāmyamoghavīryavān ।
patnīnāṃ me na pāro'sti sarvāstā me pativratāḥ ।। 2 ।।
parakalyāṇakāriṇyo mayi pradattabhāvanāḥ ।
madarthaṃ kṛtanirmāṇā mayā pūrvaṃ prakāśitāḥ ।। 3 ।।
akṣarabrahmadhāmasthāścā'saṃkhyāḥ santi me priyāḥ ।
paraṃdhāmagatā dvādaśasāhasraṃ priyottamāḥ ।। 4 ।।
kāścid golokavāsinyaḥ kāścidvai dvārapālikāḥ ।
śṛṃgāraprakarāḥ kāścit kāścicchayyopakārikāḥ ।। 5 ।।
pārṣadāṇyaḥ priyāḥ kāścicchrīvṛndāvanapālikāḥ ।
govardhananivāsinyaḥ kāścit kuñjavidhāyakāḥ ।। 6 ।।
mannikuñjanivāsinyo'rbudā'rbudā'rbudā'rbudāḥ ।
yamunāyūthagāḥ kāścijjāhnavīyūthagāḥ parāḥ ।। 7 ।।
ramāyūthagatāścānyā madhumādhavīyūthagāḥ ।
virajāyūthagāścāpi lalitāyūthagāstathā ।। 8 ।।
viśākhāyūthagāścāpi māyāyā yūthagāstathā ।
śrutayaśca tathā ārṣyo maithilāḥ kauśalāstathā ।। 9 ।।
sāketinyastathā sītāpulindinyo mama priyāḥ ।
madyogena sadā divyāḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 1.418.1 0।।
tāsāṃ pūrvajanūnāṃ me patnīnāṃ na prasaṃkhyakā ।
smṛtvā tubhyaṃ kathayāmi śrutvā svasṝḥ pramodase ।। 11 ।।
śvetadvīpe ca māṃ nāthaṃ śrutayastuṣṭuvuḥ purā ।
uśatībhirgirābhiśca prasanno'haṃ tadā'bhavam ।। 1 2।।
vṛṇīta yūyaṃ varaṇaṃ manmanovācchitaṃ hi vaḥ ।
śrutayaḥ prāhurānandamātraṃ te yat svarūpakam ।। 13।।
taddivyaṃ darśayā'smākaṃ yadi deyo varo hi naḥ ।
śrutvaitad darśayāmāsa svaṃ lokaṃ brahma cā'kṣaram ।। 14।।
brāhmīpatnīstatra sarvā darśayāmāsa satpatiḥ ।
tanmadhye'kṣaradhāmādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 15।।
darśayitvā ca tāḥ prāha brūta kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ ।
śrutayaśca tadā prāhustvayi dṛṣṭe manāṃsi naḥ ।। 16 ।।
kandarpakoṭilāvaṇye smarakṣiptānyasaṃśayam ।
kāminībhāvanopetā jātāḥ sma svīkuru prabho ।। 17।।
ramaṇaṃ tvāṃ samāsādya bhajāmaḥ saphalīkuru ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha durghaṭo'yaṃ manorathaḥ ।। 18।।
tathāpi trivikramasya brahmāṇḍe yamunātaṭe ।
pṛthvyāṃ vraje mama kṣetre yūyaṃ gopyo bhaviṣyatha ।। 1 9।।
vṛndāvane bhaviṣyāmi rāse preyān patirhi vaḥ ।
sevitvā kāmadharmairmāṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।।1.418.20।।
iti tāḥ śrutayaḥ sarvā mama patnyaḥ pativratāḥ ।
athā'parāḥ śṛṇu lakṣmi! rāmādityayuge purā ।।21 ।।
rāmo'haṃ ca yadā sītāmuvāha balavān yuvā ।
dhanurbhaṃge tathā svayaṃvare tatra tu maithilāḥ ।।22।।
koṭiśaścāyayurnāryo dṛṣṭvā māṃ mumuhuśca tāḥ ।
antaryāmitayā jñātvā tābhyaḥ koṭisvarūpadhṛk ।।23।।
tadaiva darśanaṃ pratipurandhrīṃ saṃdadau bhavan ।
tāśca prāhuḥ purandhryo māṃ bhartā no bhava kāmada ।।24।।
mayā rāmeṇa tāścoktāḥ samācarata matkṛte ।
tīrthaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ kṛcchraṃ japaṃ saṃsmaraṇaṃ muhuḥ ।।25।।
śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā tato'haṃ dvāparottare ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ kānto bhavatīnāṃ manorathān ।।26।।
patirbhūtvā pūrayiṣye vraje gopyo bhaviṣyatha ।
sevitvā kāmadharmairmāṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।।27।।
athā'haṃ tāṃ satīṃ sītāṃ nītvā jitvā ca bhārgavam ।
kosalān prayayau mārge kosalā yoṣitaśca mām ।।28।।
yuvānaṃ sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā manobhirvavrire patim ।
tābhyo me divyasaṃsparśaṃ dattvā koṭisvarūpadhṛk ।।29।।
varaṃ ca dattavān vo'haṃ pūrayiṣye manorathān ।
japaṃ kṛtvā mama bhaktyā vraje gopyo bhaviṣyatha ।।1.418.30।।
sevitvā kāmadharmairmāṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।
atha sāketapuryāṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sāketayoṣitaḥ ।।3 1।।
tatkṣaṇaṃ mohamāpannāstapaścerurdhṛtavratāḥ ।
rāmaprāptirbhavet kāntasvarūpeṇeti niścitāḥ ।।32।।
tāśca rāmo vyomavāṇyā prāha yuṣmanmanorathāḥ ।
satyaḥ pūrṇā bhaviṣyanti dvāparānte yamītaṭe ।।33।।
saṃsevya kāmadharmairmāṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।
athā'ha rāmarūpeṇa vanaṃ yāto yadā priye! ।।34।।
daṇḍakāraṇyagopyaśca mumuhurmayi kāmataḥ ।
kirātyo vananāryo māṃ mumuhurvavrire patim ।।35।।
mayā tābhyo varo datto dvāparānte bhaviṣyatha ।
gopyo manorathān kāmaṃ pūrayiṣye patirhi vaḥ ।।36।।
athā'ha rāmarūpo vai yayau pañcavaṭīṃ tataḥ ।
maddarśanasmararujaḥ pulindyaḥ premavihvalāḥ ।।37।।
rāmapādarajo dhṛtvā''śliṣṭaṃ rāmaṃ samāyayuḥ ।
rāmaḥ patnīvrataṃ svasya prāha tā bhagnamānasāḥ ।।38।।
babhūvuśca punaḥ prāha vṛndāvane manorathāḥ ।
dvāparānte bhavitāro vaḥ prapūrṇāḥ priye mayi ।।39।।
saṃsevya kāmadharmairmāṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।
atha rāmaṃ rāvaṇasya dvīpe dṛṣṭvā dvijāṃganāḥ ।।1.418.40।।
mumuhurbhaktimatyaśca vavrire manasā ca tāḥ ।
tābhyo dadau tadā svapne darśanaṃ samuvāca tāḥ ।।41 ।।
kariṣye yamunātīre kāntarūpeṇa sarvathā ।
manoratho bhavatīnāṃ kāmānandapradastadā ।।42।।
sevitvā kāmadharmairmāṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।
atha sāketapuryāṃ saḥ samāgatya makhān bahūn ।।43।।
cakāra tatra cāyātā nāryo deśavideśataḥ ।
tāśca rāmaṃ samālokya vavrire mānasaṃ patim ।।44।।
tābhyastadā varaṃ rāmo dadau ca gokule priyāḥ ।
bhaviṣyatha mama sarvāḥ pūrayiṣye manorathān ।।45।।
saṃsevya kāmadharmairmā kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।
atha sītāparityāgottaraṃ yajñeṣu kānakī ।।46 ।।
pratiyajñaṃ kṛtā tāsāṃ samūho'bhūd harigṛhe ।
tāścaitanyaghanā bhūtvā rantuṃ rāmaṃ samāgatāḥ ।।47।।
rāma āha na gṛhṇāmi hyekapatnīvrato'smyaham ।
tadocustāḥ kathaṃ nātha na gṛhṇāsi tavā'ṅganāḥ ।।48।।
ardhāgīryajñakāleṣu satataṃ kāryasādhikāḥ ।
karaṃ gṛhītvā tyajasi tataḥ pāpamavāpsyasi ।।49।।
rāmaḥ prāha tadā satyasvarūpā mama kāminī ।
sītā caikā na cānyā vai tacchāyā yūyameva ha ।।।1.418.50।।
tato yuṣmanmanobhāvaṃ pūrayiṣye'nyajanmani ।
dvāparānte yamunāyā vṛndāvane bhaviṣyatha ।।।51 ।।
iti tā gopikā jātā yajñasīśca me priyā ।
atha lakṣmi! śṛṇu cānyā matpatnīḥ pāralaukikīḥ ।।52।।
ramā vaikuṇṭhavāsinyaḥ śvetadvīpasakhījanāḥ ।
ūrdhvavaikuṇṭhavāsinyastathā'jitapadāśritāḥ ।।53 ।।
śrīlokācalavāsinyaḥ śrīsakhyo'pi samudrajāḥ ।
tāśca gopyo bhaviṣyanti vraje mama priyāḥ khalu ।।54।।
athā'nyā devatāḥ sarvā vṛndāvane samāgatāḥ ।
mama patnyaśca tā jātāḥ koṭyarbudaprasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।55।।
oṣadhyo vallikā sarvāstapastepuryamītaṭe ।
tāśca mohaṃ gatā nāryo bhūtvā rāse samāyayuḥ । ।56 ।।
kāmadharmeṇa tāḥ sarvāḥ kṛtakṛtyāstadā'bhavan ।
jālandharyaśca pramadā vṛndāpatiṃ ca māṃ tadā ।।57।।
vilokya vavrire kāntaṃ viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā ca tāḥ ।
vṛndāraṇye striyo bhūtvā māṃ bhajiṣyatha matpriyāḥ ।।।।58।।
samudrakanyāḥ śrīmatsyaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā vimohitāḥ ।
śrīmatsyavaradānāttā gopyo jātā mama priyāḥ ।।59।।
pṛthoḥ rājye pṛthuṃ māṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yā mumuhuḥ striyaḥ ।
tā duduhuḥ patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhuvo gopyo'bhavan priyāḥ ।।1.418.6 0 ।।
kāmasenāmohanārtha nārāyaṇājñayā ca yāḥ ।
nareṇoroḥ prakaṭitā divyā yā apsarogaṇāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
nārāyaṇaṃ varaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāśca mumuhire tadā ।
hariḥ prāha yamunāyāstaṭe gopyo bhaviṣyatha ।।6 2 ।।
sevitvā kāma dharmairmāṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha ।
striyaḥ sutalalokasthā vāmanaṃ vīkṣya mohitāḥ ।।63।
tāśca tasmād varaṃ prāpya gopyo yamītaṭe'bhavan ।
nāgendrakanyakāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā varecchayā ।।64।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ tāśca gopyo yamītaṭe ।
kāmadharmeṇa saṃsevya kṛtakṛtyā mama striyaḥ ।।65।
anyadattakapilādau brahmacāriṇameva mām ।
dṛṣṭvā yā mumuhustāśca dharmapatnyaśca me'bhavan ।।66 ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyaḥ sādhvyaḥ sarvāḥ pativratāḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇayogād divyā rādhā ramā iva ।।67।
pātivratyaparā nityaṃ mama dharmaṃ samāśritāḥ ।
arbudā'rbudakoṭyabjā'rbudā'rbudā'bjakoṭayaḥ ।।68।।
pativratānāṃ patnīnāṃ mama santi priye sadā ।
aṇḍāni cā'saṃkhyakāni vairājaromakūpake ।।69
bhavanti tatra pratyaṇḍaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
matsvarūpā niyuktā vai tathā brahmāṇḍakoṭiṣu ।।1.418.70।।
tatra pratyekalakṣmyaśca koṭiśaḥ santi me priyāḥ ।
paśya divyāṃ parāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ dadāmi te'tra padmaje! ।।71 ।।
iti tasyai mahādivyā'rpitā dṛṣṭiśca viṣṇunā ।
tāvad vilokayāmāsa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ।। 72।।
pratyaṇḍaṃ śrīpatiṃ lakṣmīpatiṃ ramāpatiṃ priyam ।
pārvatīsvāminaṃ prabhāpatiṃ śrīmāṇikīpatim ।।73।।
rādhāpatiṃ hariṃ padmāsvāminaṃ kambharāpatim ।
padmāvatīpatiṃ sarvasatīśaṃ rukmiṇīpatim ।।74।।
māyāpatiṃ prabhuṃ nārāyaṇīśaṃ vaiṣṇavīpatim ।
yatinīśaṃ sāṃkhyayoginīpatiṃ kanyakāpatim ।।75।।
śrutipatiṃ mahārājaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoda sā ।
śīghraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ parāvṛtya patitā kṛṣṇapādayoḥ ।।76 ।।
koṭisatīvilokyaiva māhātmyaṃ svāmino hyavait ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya kṛṣṇadāsyamavāpnuyāt ।।77।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pativratāmāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'saṃkhyapativratāpatnīnāṃ
nirdeśanāmā'ṣṭādaśādhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।418।।


← adhyāyaḥ 418 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 419
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 420 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! satīdharmān svargamokṣapradāँstathā ।
satyā dhāryāḥ sadā svāmidharmāevā''dṛtā bhuvi ।। 1 ।।
vyāghrā'raṇye tu saurāṣṭre hyaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ।
kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sṛṣṭyādau dvijo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vanaṃ yātastapasyārthaṃ tadā pativratā satī ।
tatpatnī kambharālakṣmīḥ svāminaṃ prāṇanamanmudā ।। 3 ।।
patiḥ prāha priye'raṇye tapaḥ kartuṃ prayāmyaham ।
tvamatra parṇakuṭyāṃ vai ṛṣikuṭumbasannidhau ।। 4 ।।
vasa yāvattapasyāto vinivṛtto bhavāmi ca ।
tadā'śrusaṃbhṛtanetrā kambharā sā pativratā ।। 5 ।।
prāha svasvāminaṃ sādhvī vinayena hitaṃ tadā ।
brahmaputra! pitā mātā bhrātā putrastathā snuṣā ।। 6 ।।
svāni puṇyāni bhuñjānāḥ svaṃ svaṃ bhāgyamupāsate ।
bharturbhāgyaṃ tu patnyekā hyavāpnoti vivāhitā ।। 7 ।।
ataścā'haṃ tvayā sākaṃ vane cāyāmi sarvathā ।
na pitā nātmajo vātmā na mātā na sakhījanaḥ ।। 8 ।।
iha pretya ca nārīṇāṃ patireko gatiḥ sadā ।
yadi tvaṃ prasthito durgaṃ vanaṃ tāpasavāsitam ।। 9 ।।
agrataste pragacchāmi marṣitvā kuśakaṇṭakān ।
naya māṃ deva visrabdhaḥ pāpaṃ mayi na vidyate ।। 1.419.1 0।।
prāsādāgre vimānairvā vaihāyasagatena vā ।
sarvāvasthāgatā bhartuḥ pādacchāyā viśiṣyate ।। 11 ।।
sukhaṃ vane nivatsyāmi patyuścaraṇamaṇḍite ।
acintayantī trīṃllokāँścintayantī pativratam ।। 12।।
śuśrūṣamāṇā te nityaṃ niyatā brahmacāriṇī ।
saha raṃsye tvayā brahman! vaneṣu madhugandhiṣu ।। 13 ।।
phalamūlāśanā nityaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।
nate duḥkhaṃ kariṣyāmi nivasantī tvayā sadā ।। 14 ।।
agrataste gamiṣyāmi bhokṣye bhuktavati tvayi ।
abhiṣekaṃ kariṣyāmi tvayā sākamanuvratā ।। 15।।
vyatikramaṃ na vetsyāmi svargo me yatra vai bhavān ।
tvayā vinā mahāsvargaṃ nā'haṃ tadapi rocaye ।। 16 ।।
svargo yatra bhavāṃstatra tvayā vinā gṛhaṃ vanam ।
vanaṃ cāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi duḥsahaṃ susahaṃ mama ।। 17।।
tadaivaṃniścayāṃ sādhvīṃ kambharāṃ dharmabhūsuraḥ ।
na netuṃ kurute buddhiṃ vane duḥkhāni saṃsmaran ।। 18।।
āha patni sadā sādhvi dharme ca nirate priye ।
ihā''carasva dharmaṃ tvaṃ yathā me manasaḥ sukham ।। 1 9।।
vane duḥkhaṃ bahulaṃ vai kaṣṭameva sadā vanam ।
hiṃsrāṇāṃ saṃgamā duḥkhā duṣṭānāṃ prāṇināṃ vane ।।1.419.20 ।।
sagrāhāṇi jalānyeva sapaṃkāḥ saritastathā ।
snāne cottaraṇe duḥkhā varṣāsu ca bhayapradāḥ ।।2 1 ।।
mattagajā mattavanyā rākṣasādyāśca kaṣṭadāḥ ।
latākaṇṭakapāṣāṇā yatra kaṣṭaṃ hi tadvanam ।।।22।
supyate parṇaśayyāsu rātriṣu bhūtale vane ।
kartavyaṃ toṣaṇaṃ parṇaiḥ phalairdalaiśca mūlakaiḥ ।।23।।
upavāso'pi kartavyo bhaved bhakṣyaṃ vinā kvacit ।
jaṭābhāraśca kartavyo valkalāmbaradhāraṇam ।।24।।
śītoṣṇajalayogena snānādau kaṣṭadaṃ vanam ।
yathālabdhena kartavyaḥ santoṣaścārdraśuṣkakaiḥ ।।25।।
atīva vātastimiraṃ bubhukṣā jāyate sadā ।
bhayānyapi mahāntyeva jāyante duḥkhadāni vai ।।26 ।।
sarīsṛpāśca bahavo bahuveṣā vanecarāḥ ।
nadīnilayanā dhūrtāstato duḥkhataraṃ vanam ।।27।।
makṣikā vṛścikāḥ kīṭā daṃśāśca maśakā vane ।
bādhante nityamabale! sarvaṃ duḥkhataraṃ vane ।।।28।।
drumāḥ kaṇṭakinaḥ svalpabadarībarburādayaḥ ।
kuśādyāḥ pādabhedyārastato duḥkhataraṃ vanam ।।29।।
kāyakleśāśca bahavo bhayāni vividhāni ca ।
kāmakrodhau vimoktavyau kartavyā tapase matiḥ ।।1.419.3 0।।
iti gopālakṛṣṇasya śrutvā tu kambharā satī ।
prasaktā'śrumukhī mandamidaṃ vacanamabravīt ।।3 1 ।।
ye tvayā kīrtitā doṣā vane vastavyatāṃ prati ।
guṇānityeva tān vedmi pātivratyapuraskṛtā ।।32।।
mṛgāḥ siṃhā gajā vyāghrāḥ śārdūlāḥ śarabhādayaḥ ।
camarāḥ sṛmarāścānye vanyā hiṃsrāśca mānavāḥ ।। 33 ।।
krūrā vā vighnadāścāpasarpeyurbrahmatejasā ।
tvadviyogena me kṛṣṇa! tyaktavyaṃ syāddhi jīvitam ।।34।।
nahi māṃ tvatsamīpasthāṃ pradharṣayitumīśvaraḥ ।
kaścidapi bhavennātha! pātivratyasurakṣitām ।। 35।।
patihīnā satī nārī na vai śakṣyati jīvitum ।
ata ājñā'tra he nātha! prāptavyā bhavato mukhāt ।।36।।
kṛtādeśā bhaviṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi tvayā saha ।
vanavāsaḥ sadā me'tirocate sukhado bhavet ।।37।।
bhikṣiṇyāḥ śamavṛttāyā mamā'dhikasukhaṃ bhavet ।
bhartāramanugacchantyā bhartā hi paradaivatam ।। 38।।
pretyabhāve'pi kalyāṇaḥ saṃgamo me tvayā vane ।
viprāṇyāstu viśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇīnāṃ sumaṇḍale ।।39।।
iha loke pitṛbhiśca yā strī yasya dvijasya vai ।
adbhirdattā svadharmeṇa pretyabhāve'pi tasya sā ।।1.419.40।।
iti vipra! svakāṃ nārīṃ suvṛtāṃ hi pativratām ।
bhaktāṃ ca sāttvatīṃ dīnāṃ susamāṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ ।।41 ।।
netumarhasi viprendra! samānasukhaduḥkhinīm ।
yadi māṃ svāmisaṃdāsīṃ vanaṃ netuṃ na cecchasi ।।42।।
viṣamagniṃ jalaṃ pāśamāsthāsye mṛtyukāraṇāt ।
dyumatsenasutaṃ vīraṃ satyavantamanuvratām ।।43 ।।
sāvitrīmiva māṃ viddhi vane tvadvaśavartinīm ।
tanmāmanādāya vanaṃ tapasyārthaṃ na te'rhaṇam ।।44।।
tapo vā yadi vā'raṇyaṃ svargo vā syāt tvayā saha ।
hiṃsrāśca prāṇino me syurmahābhāgavatā vane ।।45।।
kaṇṭakāḥ karkarāḥ paṃkabhūmayo me sukhā vane ।
mahāvātādikaṃ sarvaṃ rajaśca candanaṃ vane ।।46।।
śādvalā bhūmayo nātha! tvayā saha sukhā mama ।
patraṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ svalpaṃ cāpi vane bahu ।।47।।
dāsyase svaprasādaṃ me tanme'mṛtaraso bhavet ।
ārtavānyupabhuñjānā sevayiṣye patiṃ sadā ।।48।।
matkṛte na ca te śoko na bhaviṣyāmi śokadā ।
yastvayā saha saḥ svargo nirayo yastvayā vinā ।।49।।
tvayā vinā pramartavyaṃ vastavyaṃ vā tvayā saha ।
iti me nirṇayaḥ sādhvyāḥ prasanno bhava mādhava! ।।1.419.5 0।।
viyogaṃ sahituṃ nātha muhūrtamapi notsahe ।
ujjhitāyāstvayā nātha! paścānme maraṇaṃ varam ।।5 1 ।।
iti śrutvā priyāvākyaṃ samuvāca patiḥ priyām ।
anugacchasva māṃ devi! sahadharmacarī bhava ।।52।।
sarvathā sadṛśaṃ sādhvi! mama svasya kulasya ca ।
vyavasāyamanukrāntā kānte! tvamatiśobhanam ।।53।।
nedānīṃ kaṃbhare! svargastvadṛte me'pi rocate ।
kuru vanārthe prasthānaṃ yatra tatra sumaṃgalam ।।54।।
nahi satyā bhayaṃ kiñcidvane vā'raṇyabhūbhṛtoḥ ।
yatsṛṣṭā'si mayā sārdhaṃ dharmārthāya hi kaṃbhare ।।55।।
na vihātuṃ mayā śakyā pātivratyaparā priyā ।
dharmaḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ ca me ।।56।।
patnīvrataṃ paraṃ prāha tadaṃśa māṃ cakāra saḥ ।
tava yogena deveśi! nāryo dharmaparāyaṇāḥ ।।57।।
vanyā api bhaviṣyanti tāpasyo'tipativratāḥ ।
na satyaṃ dānamānau vā yajño vā'pyāptadakṣiṇaḥ ।।58।।
tathā balakarā yādṛgdharmaḥ patnīvratātmakaḥ ।
svargo dhanaṃ tathā dhānyaṃ vidyāḥ putrāḥ sukhāni ca ।।59।।
pātivratyanurodhena na kiñcid durlabhaṃ ca te ।
devagandharvagolokān brahmalokāṃstathā parān ।।1.419.60 ।।
prāpnuvanti satīnāryaḥ patisevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
anugacchasva māṃ kānte sahadharmacarī bhava ।।61 ।।
ityuktvā sā mahāsādhvī mahālakṣmīstu kaṃbharā ।
yayau svapatinā sārdhaṃ siṃhā'raṇye tapo'rthataḥ ।।62।।।
patnīvrato mahābhāgo dvijo gopālakṛṣṇakaḥ ।
patnyā saha yayau siṃhāraṇye tapaḥprasiddhaye ।।63।।
hiraṇyāyāḥ pūrvataṭe tapastepe sudāruṇam ।
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca nirāhāraḥ sabhāryakaḥ ।।64।।
tadā dhāmnaḥ svayaṃ divyo bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ ।
dharmabhaktisahitaśca lalitāśrījayāyutaḥ ।।65।।
pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ svasya dadau vṛṇu varaṃ jagau ।
tadā jāyāpatī kṛṣṇamūcaturbhagavan yadi ।।66।।
prasanno'si sadā caitādṛśo vartasva nau gṛhe ।
dharmasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā nau sarvathā prabho ।।67।।
pratyakṣo nau sadā kṛṣṇa vartasva sukhado bhava ।
yugadharmānurūpeṇa mā jahīhi ca nau vibho! ।।68।।
ahaṃ patnīvrato vipraśceyaṃ pativratā satī ।
prathamaṃ satyakālaṃ ca vilokya ca tataḥ param ।।69।।
kālahāsaṃ bhāvinaṃ ca yogena ca samādhinā ।
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa tvadanugrahatastathā ।।1.419.70 ।।
cintayāmi kṛpāsindho dharmahāso na me yathā ।
bhavettathā kṛpāsindho! pradehi tapasāṃ phalam ।।71 ।।
tathā'stviti tadā prāha prāha kālakathāṃ tathā ।
śuśruvatuśca tau cādyau dampatī kambharāharī ।।72।।।
kālabhedān kāladharmān dharma hrāsān jagau hariḥ ।
tadā tadā ca rakṣārthaṃ gṛhṇāmi nau suputratām ।73।।।
divyaḥ sadā ca vartiṣye sannidhau yuvayoriti ।
uktvā'dṛśyo'bhavat kṛṣṇo strīpatī veśma jagmatuḥ ।।74।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye kambharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇayostapaścaryārthayāne kambharāyāḥ pātivratyabalena sahayānaṃ tapasi bhagavaddarśanaṃ yuge yuge putrarūpo bhaviṣyāmīti varadānaṃ cetyādivarṇananāmaikonaviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।419 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 419 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 420
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 421 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
ke te dharmāḥ kathaṃ proktāḥ kālahrāsaḥ kathaṃ ca vai ।
kadā kṛṣṇaḥ kadā putro divyo'dṛśyo'bhavatprabhuḥ ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi yānahaṃ coktavāँstadā ।
kālabhedān kāladharmān yathā rakṣā kṛtā mayā ।। 2 ।।
lakṣmi! kṛtayuge lokāḥ satyādidharmasaṃśrayāḥ ।
pṛthvīrasodbhavaṃ nāma tvāhāraṃ cāharanti vai ।। 2 ।।
tāḥ prajāḥ kāmacāriṇyo mānasīṃ siddhamāsthitāḥ ।
dharmā'dharmau na tāvāstāṃ nirviśeṣāḥ prajāstu tāḥ ।। 4 ।।
tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasmin kṛte yuge ।
dharmā'dharmau na tāvāstāṃ kalpādau tu kṛte yuge ।। 5 ।।
svenā svenā'dhikāreṇa jajñire te kṛte yuge ।
catvāri tu sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divyasaṃkhyayā ।। 6 ।।
ādyaṃ kṛtayugaṃ prāhuḥ sandhyānāṃ śatamaṣṭakam ।
tataḥ sahasraśastāsu prajāsu prathitāsvapi ।।7 ।।
na tāsāṃ pratighāto'sti na dvandvaṃ nāpi ca klamaḥ ।
parvatodadhisevinyo hyaniketāśrayāstu tāḥ ।। 8 ।।
viśokāḥ sattvabahulā ekāntasukhitaprajāḥ
tā vai niṣkāmacāriṇyo nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ ।। 9 ।।
sarvakāmasukhaḥ kālo nātyarthaṃ hyuṣṇaśītatā ।
mano'bhilaṣitāḥ kāmāstāsāṃ sarvatra sarvadā ।। 1.420.1 0।।
uttiṣṭhanti pṛthivyāṃ vai tābhirdhyātā rasollatāḥ ।
balavarṇakarī tāsāṃ siddhiḥ sā roganāśinī ।। 11 ।।
asaṃskāryaiḥ śarīraiśca prajāstāḥ sthirayauvanāḥ ।
tāsāṃ viśuddhātsaṃkalpājjāyante mithunāḥ prajāḥ ।। 1 2।।
samaṃ janma ca rūpaṃ ca mriyante caiva tāḥ samam ।
tadā satyamalobhaśca kṣamā tuṣṭiḥ sukhaṃ damaḥ ।। 13 ।।
nirviśeṣāstu tāḥ sarvā rūpāyuḥśīlaceṣṭitaiḥ ।
abuddhipūrvakaṃ vṛttaṃ prajānāṃ jāyate svayam ।। 14।।
apravṛttiḥ kṛtayuge karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ ।
varṇāśramavyavasthāśca na tadā''sanna saṃkaraḥ ।। 1786।।
anicchādveṣayuktāste vartayanti parasparam ।
tulyarūpā''yuṣaḥ sarvā adhamottamavarjitāḥ ।। 16 ।।
sukhaprāyā hyaśokāśca tūtpadyante kṛte yuge ।
nityaprahṛṣṭamanaso mahāsattvā mahābalāḥ ।। 17।।
lābhā'lābhau na tāsvāstāṃ mitrāmitre priyāpriye ।
manasā viṣayastāsāṃ nirīhāṇāṃ pravartate ।। 18।।
na tā lipsanti cānyonyaṃ nānugṛhṇanti caiva vai ।
dhyānaṃ tvāsīt kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamūrjitam ।। 19।।
pravṛttā dvāpare yajñā dānaṃ kaliyuge kṛtam ।
sattvaṃ kṛtaṃ rajastretā dvāparaṃ tu rajastamaḥ ।। 1.420.20 ।।
kalau tamastu vijñeyaṃ yugavṛttavaśena vai ।
kṛtasya siddhayaḥ sarvāḥ pādenonāstadā'bhavan ।। 21 ।।
kṛtasiddhau praṇaṣṭāyāmanyā siddhiravartata ।
apāṃ saukṣmye pratigate tadā meghātmanā bhuvi ।।22।।
meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ vṛṣṭisarjanam ।
sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā saṃyukte pṛthivītale ।।23 ।।
prādurāsastadā tāsāṃ vṛkṣāstu gṛhasaṃsthitāḥ ।
sarvapratyupabhogastu tāsāṃ tebhyaḥ prajāyate ।।24।।
vartayanti hi tebhyastāstretāyugamukhe prajāḥ ।
tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāmeva viparyayam ।।25।।
rāgalobhātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko'bhavat ।
yattad bhavati nārīṇāṃ jīvitānte tadā''rttavam ।।26 ।।
tatastenaiva yogena vartatāṃ mithune tadā ।
tāsāṃ tatkālabhāvitvānmāsi māsyupagacchatām ।।27।।
akāle hyārtavotpattirgarbhotpattirajāyata ।
viparyayeṇa tāsāṃ tu tena kālena bhāvinā ।।28।।
praṇaśyanti tataḥ sarve vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃsthitāḥ ।
tatasteṣu praṇaṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā vyākulendriyāḥ ।।29।।
abhidhyāyanti tāṃ siddhiṃ satyābhidhyāyinastadā ।
prādurbabhūvustāsāṃ ca vṛkṣāste gṛhasaṃsthitāḥ ।।1.420.3 0।।
vastrāṇi ca prasūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca ।
teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhavarṇarasānvitam ।।3 1 ।।
amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu ।
tena tā vartayanti sma sukhe tretāyuge tadā ।।3 2 ।।
hṛṣṭatuṣṭāstayā siddhyā prajā vai vigatajvarāḥ ।
punaḥ kālāntareṇaiva punarlobhāvṛtāstu tāḥ ।।33 ।।
vṛkṣāँstān paryagṛhṇanta madhu vā mākṣikaṃ balāt ।
tāsāṃ tenā'pacāreṇa punarlokakṛtena vai ।।34।।
praṇaṣṭā madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣāḥ kvacit kvacit ।
tasyāmevā'lpaśiṣṭāyāṃ sandhyākālavaśāttathā ।।35।।
prāvartanta tadā tāsāṃ dvandvānyabhyutthitāni tu ।
śītavātātapaistīvraistatastā duḥkhitā bhṛśam ।।36।।
dvandvaistāḥ pīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni ca ।
kṛtvā dvandvapratīkāraṃ niketāni hi bhejire ।।317।।
yathāyogyaṃ yathāprīti niketeṣvavasaँśca te ।
marudhanvasu nimneṣu parvateṣu nadīṣu ca ।।38।।
saṃśrayanti ca durgāṇi dhanvānaṃ śāśvatodakam ।
yathāyogaṃ yathākāmaṃ sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ।।39।।
ārabdhāste niketā vai kartuṃ śītoṣṇavāraṇam ।
tataḥ saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ kheṭāni ca purāṇi ca ।।1.420.40 ।।
grāmāँścaiva yathābhāgaṃ tathaivā'ntaḥ purāṇi ca ।
tāsāmāyāmaviṣkaṃbhān sanniveśāntarāṇi ca ।।41 ।।
cakrustadā yathāprajñaṃ mitvā mitvā''tmano'ṅgulaiḥ ।
mano'rthāni pramāṇāni tadvā prabhati cakrire ।।42।।
yathā te pūrvamāsan vai vṛkṣāstu gṛhasaṃsthitāḥ ।
tathā kartuṃ samārabdhāścintayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।।43।।
vṛkṣaśākhāsu tāḥ śālā hyakurvaṃścāpi śobhanāḥ ।
kṛtvā dvandvopaghātāँstān vārtopāyamacintayan ।।44।।
naṣṭeṣu madhunā sārdhaṃ kalpavṛkṣeṣu vai tadā ।
viṣādavyākulāstā vai prajāstṛṣṇākṣudhātmikāḥ ।।45।।
tataḥ prādurbabhau tāsāṃ siddhistretāyuge'nnadā ।
vārtā'rthasādhikā'pyanyā vṛttistāsāṃ hi kāmataḥ ।।46 ।।
vṛṣṭyudakāni nimnāni srotāṃsi sarito'bhavan ।
nimnagāni sarastaḍāgarūpāṇi tadā'bhavan ।।47।।
sasyapuṣṭikarāṇyeva jātāni tāni sarvadā ।
apāṃ bhūmestadā yogādoṣadhyastāsu cā'bhavan ।।48।।
puṣpamūlaphalinyastu oṣadhyastāḥ prajajñire ।
aphālakṛṣṭāścā'nuptā ṛtupuṣpaphalāgamāḥ ।।49।।
tenauṣadhena vartante prajāstretāyuge tadā ।
tataḥ punarabhūt tāsāṃ rāgo lobhaśca sarvaśaḥ ।।1.420.50।।
tatastāḥ paryagṛhṇanta nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān ।
vṛkṣān gulmauṣadhīṃścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam ।।51 ।।
gṛhṇantyanyasya tāँstatra vartayanti ca duḥkhinaḥ ।
kecicchāntāstathā kecid rūkṣāḥ krūrāstathā'pare ।।52।।
drohijanāḥ karmabhiśca tejasvinaśca nirbalāḥ ।
tejasvināṃ karmacārā abalāśca tadā'bhavan ।।53 ।।
evaṃ vipratipanneṣu prapanneṣu parasparam ।
praṇaṣṭā hriyamāṇāstā oṣadhayastadā'bhavan ।।54।।
tatastāsu praṇaṣṭāsu prajā jagmuḥ prajāpatim ।
vṛttyarthamabhilipsantastretāhrāse hyupasthite ।।55।।
brahmaṇā ca tadā pṛthvyāṃ bījāni mānasāni vai ।
prakṣiptāni vinirmāya tadauṣadhyaḥ prajajñire ।।।56 ।।
kṛṣṭapacyā babhūvuśca sasyāni cāpi sarvathā ।
atha ca brāhmaṇāstābhirvartayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।।57।।
itareṣāṃ kṛtatrāṇān rarakṣuḥ kṣatriyānparān ।
vṛttikarān vaiśyavarṇān sevakān yugasaṃkṣaye ।।58 । ।
kṛtavanto brāhmaṇāste brahmaṇā cānumoditāḥ ।
teṣāṃ karmāṇi dharmāśca brahmā tu vyadadhātpunaḥ ।।59 । ।
prajā api tathādharmān pālayāmāsurādarāt ।
varṇadharmairajīvantyo vyarudhyanta parasparam । ।1.420.6 0 । ।
brahmā tamarthaṃ buddhvā ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaidikam ।
yājanādhyāpane cakre tṛtīyaṃ ca parigraham । ।6 1 । ।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ daṇḍaṃ yuddhamājīvamādiśat ।
pāśupālyaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ kṛṣiṃ caiva viśāṃ dadau ।।62 ।।
śilpājīvaṃ bhṛtiṃ caiva caturthasya vyadhātprabhuḥ ।
karmājīvaṃ tato datvā tebhyaḥ sthānāni vai dadau ।।63 ।।
svasvakarmaratānāṃ vai lokāntareṣu tadyathā ।
prājāpatyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ māhendraṃ kṣatriyasya ca ।।64।।
vaiśyānāṃ mārutaṃ sthāna gāndharvaṃ sevakasya vai ।
athā''śramān svayaṃ brahmā sthāpayāmāsa dharmataḥ ।। 65।।
cāturvarṇyātmakaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhasthaścāśramaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
trayāṇāmāśramāṇāṃ ca pratiṣṭhā yonireva ca ।।66 ।।
dārā'gnayo'thā''titheyaṃ ijyāśrāddhakriyāḥ prajāḥ ।
ityeṣa vai gṛhasthasya samāsāddharmasaṃgrahaḥ ।।67।।
daṇḍī ca mekhalī caiva hyadhaḥśāyī tathā jaṭī ।
guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ vidyārthe brahmacāriṇaḥ ।।68 । ।
cīrapatrājināni syurdhānyamūlaphalauṣadham ।
ubhe sandhye'vagāhaśca homaścāraṇyavāsinām । ।6 9 । ।
madhyāhnottarabhaikṣaṃ ca hyasteyaṃ śaucamityapi ।
apramādo'vyavāyaśca dayā bhūteṣu ca kṣamā । ।1.420.7 0 । ।
akrodho guruśuśruṣā satyaṃ vṛṣo daśātmakaḥ ।
bahiḥ karmāṇi sarvāṇi na siddhyanti janasya vai । ।7 1 । ।
antarbhāvapraduṣṭasya kurvato'pi parākramān ।
sarvasvamapi yo dadyāt kaluṣeṇā'ntarātmanā । ।72 । ।
na tena dharmabhāk sa syād bhāva evātra kāraṇam ।
atha tretottare sarvaṃ sandhyākāle vṛṣādikam । ।73 । ।
punarnaṣṭaṃ prajākleśātparasparaṃ prasahya ca ।
tato rājā ca manavaḥ samrājo niyamāstathā । ।74। ।
sattā vastuṣu lokānāṃ manuṣyapaśupakṣiṣu ।
kṣetreṣu vyavasāyeṣu sarvatra jīvikāsu ca ।।75।।
sarvatra cā'bhavan lakṣmi! dharmāścāpi yathā''grahāḥ ।
satyaṃ dānaॆ dayā yajño japaḥ sarvaṃ tṛtīyakam ।।76 ।।
vartate sma ca pādena dharmāstadā tathā'bhavan ।
adhārmikā asurāśca viśeṣato'pi tāmasāḥ ।।77।।
dvāpare cā'bhavan lakṣmi! prajā yajñapradhānikāḥ ।
smṛtayo niyamāstatrarṣibhiḥ saṃgrathitāḥ sukhāḥ ।।78।।
devānāṃ jīvikā viprajīvikā bhṛtyajīvikāḥ ।
kārvādiśilpivaryāṇāṃ jīvikāstatra nirmitāḥ ।।79।।
nārīṇāṃ ca vivāhādisattāstatra viniścitāḥ ।
putrāṇāṃ caurasānāṃ vai dāyabhāktvaṃ sthirīkṛtam ।।1.420.80।।
śiṣyāṇāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca dāyabhāktvaṃ vibhājitam ।
rājñāṃ bhuvaḥ prajānāṃ ca sāmānyato viśeṣataḥ ।।81 ।।
jīvikāsādhanānyatra vyāpārāśca viniścitāḥ ।
pitṛputrādiśabdānāmarthā vyaktiṣu yojitāḥ ।।82।।
tadyathā śrūyatāṃ lakṣmi! tvayā loke pravartitāḥ ।
bījapradaḥ pitā prokto mātā garbhasya dhāriṇī ।।83 ।।
abījado mātṛpatiścopapitā prakīrtitaḥ ।
agarbhadhrā pitṛpatnī copamātā prakīrtitā ।।84।।
pitāmahaḥ pitṛpitā tatpitā prapitāmahaḥ ।
mātāmahaḥ mātṛpitā tatpitā pramātāmahaḥ ।।85 ।।
pitāmahī piturmātā tacchravaśrūḥ prapitāmahī ।
tacchravaśraśca parijñeyā sā vṛddhaprapitāmahī ।।86 ।।
mātāmahā māturmātā mātṛtulyā ca pūjitā ।
pramātāmahītijñeyā pramātāmahakāminī ।।87।।
vṛddhamātāmahī jñeyā tatpituḥ kāminī tathā ।
pitṛbhrātā pitṛvyaśca mātṛbhrātā tu mātulaḥ ।।88।।
pitṛsvasā piturmātṛṣvasā mātussvasā smṛtā ।
sūnuśca tanayaḥ putro dāyādaścātmajastathā ।।89।।
dhanabhāgvīryajaścaiva puṃsi janye ca vartate ।
janyāyāṃ duhitā kanyā cātmajā parikīrtitā ।। 1.420.90।।
putrapatnī vadhūrjñeyā jāmātā duhituḥ patiḥ ।
patiḥ priyaśca bhartā ca svāmī kānte ca vartate ।।91 ।।
devaraḥ svāmino bhrātā nanāndā svāminaḥ svasā ।
śvaśuraḥ svāminastātaḥ śvaśrūśca svāminaḥ prasūḥ ।।92।।
bhāryā jāyā priyā kāntā strī ca patnī prakīrtitā ।
patnībhrātā śyālakaśca svasāpatnyāśca śālikā ।।93 ।।
patnī mātā tathā śvaśrūstatpitā śvaśuraḥ smṛtaḥ ।
sagarbhaḥ sodaro bhrātā sagarbhā bhaginī smṛtā ।। 94।।
bhaginījo bhāgineyo bhrātṛjo bhrātṛputrakaḥ ।
āvutto bhaginīkānto bhaginīpatireva ca ।।95।।
śyālīpatistu bhrātā ca śvaśuraikatvahetunā ।
śvaśurastu pitā jñeyo janmadātuḥ samo mune ।।96।।
annadātā bhayatrātā patnītātastathaiva ca ।
vidyādātā janmadātā pañcaite pitaro nṛṇām ।। 97।।
janmadātrī dugdhapoṣṭrī jñānadā mātaro nṛṇām ।
annadātuśca yā patnī bhaginī gurukāminī ।।98।।
mātā ca tatsapatnī ca kanyā putrapriyā tathā ।
māturmātā piturmātā śvaśrūpitroḥ svasā tathā ।।99।।
pitṛvyastrī mātulānī mātaraśceti ṣoḍaśa ।
pautrastu putraputre ca prapautrastatsute'pi ca ।। 1.420.100 ।।
tatputrādyāśca ye vaṃśyāḥ kulajāśca prakīrtitāḥ ।
kanyāputrastu dauhitrastatputrādyāśca bāndhavāḥ ।। 101 ।।
bhāgineyasutādyāśca puruṣā bāndhavāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
bhrātṛputrasya putrādyāste punajñātayaḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 1 02।।
guruputrastathā bhrātā poṣyaḥ paramabāndhavaḥ ।
gurukanyā ca bhaginī poṣyā mātṛsamā tathā ।। 103 ।।
putrasya ca gururbhrātā poṣyaḥ susnigdhabāndhavaḥ ।
putrasya śvaśuro bhrātā bandhurvaivāhikaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 1 04।।
kanyāyāḥ śvaśure caiva tatsambandhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।
guruśca kanyākāyāśca bhrātā susnigdhabāndhavaḥ ।। 105 ।।
guruśvaśurabhrātṝṇāṃ gurutulyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।
bandhutā yena sārdhaṃ ca tanmitraṃ parikīrtitam ।। 1 06।।
mitraṃ sukhapradaṃ jñeyaṃ duḥkhado ripurucyate ।
bāndhavo duḥkhado daivānnissambandho'sukhapradaḥ ।। 1 07।।
sambandhāstrividhā loke sarveṣāṃ jagatītale ।
vidyājo yonijaścāpi prītijaśca prakīrtitaḥ ।। 1 08।।
mitraṃ tu prītijaṃ jñeya sa sambandhaḥ sudurlabhaḥ ।
mitramātā mitrabhāryā mātṛtulyā na saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 09।।
mitrabhrātā mitrapitā bhrātṛtātasamau nṛṇām ।
caturtho nāmasambandhaḥ sarvatra jāyate nṛṇām ।। 1.420.110 ।।
jāraścopapatirbandhuduṣṭaḥ saṃbhogakartari ।
upapatnyāṃ navajñā ca preyasī cittahāriṇī ।। 111 ।।
svāmitulyaśca jāraśca navajñā gṛhiṇī samā ।
evaṃ śabdāḥ pravṛttāśca dvāpare vyavahārajāḥ ।। 11 2।।
tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vyavahārā yuge yuge ।
tataḥ kṛṣṇo'bhavaṃ rakṣākaro dvāparavaigame ।। 11 3।।।
dharmarakṣādaityanāśatāpasīhākaro'bhavam ।
kalau dharmā bahukleśāḥ samajāyanta vai yadi ।। 1 14।।
gaṃgādyāḥ saritaścāpi tīrthāni devatāstathā ।
gate catuḥ sahasre vai varṣāṇāṃ tu kalerbhuvi ।। 1 15।।
yāsyanti divyalokaṃ te tadā vai kambharāsutaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dharmaṃ sthāpayiṣyati bhūtale ।। 1 16।।
gopālakṛṣṇaputro'sāvācāryo bhagavān svayam ।
śrīrādhāpadminīkāntaḥ kamalāpārvatīpatiḥ ।। 1 17।।
māṇikīśaḥ prabhālakṣmīramānāthaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
dharmaṃ bhāgavataṃ loke saṃsthāpyaiṣyati vai vanam ।। 1 18।।
brahmadhāma tato dharmaḥ kāle yāte śate śate ।
punarnāśaṃ sameṣyanti sthāpitā dharmasetavaḥ ।। 11 9।।
śālagrāmo harermūrtirjagannāthaḥ kathānakam ।
sahasrādvāntare sarve yāsyanti śrīhareḥ padam ।। 1.420.120।।
vaiṣṇavāḥ saṃhitāgranthāḥ śaṃkhāśca śrāddhatarpaṇam ।
vedoktāni ca karmāṇi yāsyanti layamityapi ।। 121 ।।
hareḥ pūjā harernāma tatkīrtirguṇakīrtanam ।
vedaśāstrāṇi dharmāśca yāsyanti vilayaṃ svataḥ ।। 1 22।।
sattvaṃ satyaṃ sādhutā ca divyatā grāmyadevatāḥ ।
vrataṃ tapasyā'naśanaṃ yāsyanti śrīhareḥ padam ।। 123 ।।
vāmācāraratāḥ sarve mithyākāpaṭyasaṃyutāḥ ।
tulasīvarjitāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param ।। 1 24।।
ekādaśīvihīnāśca sarvadharmavivarjitāḥ ।
kṛṣṇaprasaṃgavimukhā bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param ।। 1 25।।
śaṭhāḥ krūrā dāmbhikāśca mahā'haṃkārasaṃyutāḥ ।
caurāśca hiṃsakāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param ।। 1 26।।
puṃsāṃ bhedastathā strīṇāṃ vivāho vādanirṇayaḥ ।
svasvāmibhedī vastūnāṃ na bhaviṣyatyataḥ param ।। 1 27।।
sarve janāḥ strīvaśāśca puṃścalyaśca gṛhe gṛhe ।
tarjanairbhartsanaiḥ śaśvat svāminaṃ tāḍayanti ca ।। 1 28।।
gṛheśvarī ca gṛhiṇī gṛhī bhṛtyādhiko'dhamaḥ ।
ceṭī bhṛtyāsamā vadhvaḥ śvaśrūśca śvaśurastathā ।। 129।।
puṃścalyo rājyakartryaśca yonisambandhino nṛpāḥ ।
kartāro balino loke yonisambandhibāndhavāḥ ।। 1.420.130 ।।
saṃbhāṣā naiva vidvadbhirmūrkhairāntaramitratā ।
sarvakarmā'kṣayāḥ puṃso yoṣitāmājñayā vinā ।। 13 1।।
yajñasūtraṃ bhāvaluptaṃ jāteḥ paricayo na ca ।
mlecchācārā bhaviṣyanti sarve varṇāśramāstadā ।। 1 32।।
mlecchaśāstraṃ paṭhiṣyanti mlecchabhojanayoginaḥ ।
varṇāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti mlecchānāṃ sevakāstadā ।। 1 33।।
sūpakartryo bhaviṣyanti mlecchikāścarmakārikāḥ ।
satyahīnā janāḥ sarve sasyahīnā ca medinī ।। 1 34।।
phalahīnāśca taravo'patyahīnāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
kṣīrahīnāstathā gāvaḥ kṣīraṃ sarpirvivarjitam ।। 1 35।।
dāmpatyaṃ prītihīnaṃ ca gṛhiṇaḥ sukhavarjitāḥ ।
pratāpahīnā bhūpāśca prajāśca karapīḍitāḥ ।। 136 ।।
jalahīnā nadā nadyo dīrghikāḥ kandarātmikāḥ ।
dharmahīnāḥ puṇyahīnā varṇā avarṇakāstadā ।। 1 37।।
lakṣeṣu puṇyavān ko'pi na tiṣṭhati tataḥ param ।
kutsitā vikṛtākārā narā nāryaśca bālakāḥ ।। 1 38।।
kuvārttāḥ kutsitapathā bhaviṣyanti tataḥ param ।
kecid grāmāśca nagarā nāśaprāyā vidurgakāḥ ।। 1 39।।
naraśūnyāḥ prajāśūnyāḥ svalpakuṭīrakānvitāḥ ।
araṇyāni bhaviṣyanti gomāyūvāsitāḥ kalau ।। 1.420.140 ।।
araṇyavāsinaḥ sarve janāśca karapīḍitāḥ ।
sasyāni tu bhaviṣyanti taḍāgeṣu nadīṣu ca ।। 141 ।।
kṣetrāṇi sasyahīnāni dhanino dravyavarjitāḥ ।
caurā dhaninaḥ prakṛṣṭā baladarpasamanvitāḥ ।। 142।।
prakṛṣṭavaṃśajā hīnā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge ।
alīkavādino dhūrtāḥ śaṭhā vai satyavādinaḥ ।। 143 ।।
pāpinaḥ puṇyavantaścā'pyaśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭa eva tu ।
jitendriyā lampaṭāśca puṃścalyaśca pativratāḥ ।। 144।।
tapasvinaḥ pātakino viṣṇubhaktā avaiṣṇavāḥ ।
hiṃsakāśca dayāyuktāścaurāśca naraghātinaḥ ।। 145।।
bhikṣuveṣadharā dhūrtā nindantyupahasanti ca ।
dehasevāsu nipuṇā janānāṃ mohakāstathā ।। 146।।
pūjitāste bhaviṣyanti vañcakā jñānadurbalāḥ ।

alpāyuṣo jarāyuktā yauvaneṣu kalau yuge ।
dharmaḥ paśusamācāro yonisambandhamukhyatā ।। 148।।
mātṛbhāvo'pi ca lupto bhaviṣyati tadā kalau ।
pañcasahasravarṣāṇāṃ vigame tu punaḥ punaḥ ।। 149।।
ahaṃ vipro bhaviṣyāmi camatkārapure tadā ।
janmasiddho mahāyogī nāmnā bṛhadvrataḥ kalau ।। 1.420.150 ।।
bhaktiṃ bhagavataścāhaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
sthāpayiṣye lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitayā tadā ।। 151 ।।
madupadiṣṭavākyaiśca narā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ।
manāṃsi sāttvikānyeva bhaviṣyanti mamāśrayāt ।। 152।

palitāḥ ṣoḍaśe varṣe mahāvṛddhāstu viṃśatau ।। 153।।।
aṣṭavarṣā ca yuvatī rajoyuktā ca garbhiṇī ।

etāḥ kāścit sahasreṣu vandhyāścāpi gṛhe gṛhe ।
kanyāvikrayiṇaścāpi svakanyāpatayastathā ।। 155।।
mātṛjāyāvadhūnāṃ ca jāropārjanatatparāḥ ।

harernāmnāṃ vikrayiṇaḥ puṇyavikrayiṇastadā ।

devagurubrahmavṛttiṃ prasahyā'pahariṣyati ।

agamyābhrātṛpatnyādigāminaśca kalau yuge ।

gavayīgaruḍīśunīmayūrīgāminastathā ।
sūkarīvānarīvājinyādisaṃgāminaḥ kalau ।। 1.420.16 0।।
svasya nārīṃ parityajya vihariṣyanti sarvataḥ ।
patnīnāṃ nirṇayo nāsti bhartṛṇāṃ ca kalau yuge ।। 161 ।।
prajānāṃ caiva vastūnāṃ grāmāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।
alīkavādinaḥ sarve sarve cauryārthalampaṭāḥ ।। 162।।

nāryaḥ sarvapaśujñātinarasaṃgamitāstadā ।। 163।।
vṛṣalaiḥ pālitāvastraśūnyāścāpi kalau yuge ।
yajñasūtravihīnāśca dhyānaśuddhivihīnakāḥ ।। 164।।
puṃścalī vārdhuṣā'bīrā kuṭṭinī ca rajasvalā ।
sarveṣāṃ randhanāgāre bhaviṣyanti tu pācikāḥ ।। 165।।
annānāṃ nirṇayo nāsti yonīnāṃ nirṇayo na ca ।
putrāṇāṃ nirṇayo naiva sarve mlecchāḥ kalau yuge ।। 166।।
kalau ghore pravṛtte tu tadantasamaye bhuvi ।
tatra pañcasamā kanyā garbhamātā bhaviṣyati ।। 167।।
daśavarṣavayaskā sā vṛddhā mṛtyusamīpagā ।

sampūrṇe tu kalau yāte hrasvaṃ sarvaṃ tadā bhavet ।

varṣadvayāyuṣaḥ sarve varṣāyuṣaścatuṣpadāḥ ।
māsāyuṣo nadā nadyo mārjārā iva hastinaḥ ।। 1.420.170।।
mūṣikā'ñjalitṛptāśca bhaviṣyanti janāḥ kalau ।
mūṣikāgarbhavadbālān janayiṣyanti yoṣitaḥ ।। 171 ।।
pṛthvīvāsā vasatayo gṛhādi nāsti vai tadā ।
vṛṣṭiścā'ṅguṣṭhaparvā ca varṣāsvekā bhaviṣyati ।। 172।।
evaṃ kaleḥ sarvakāle vigate prāntabhāgake ।
viprasya viṣṇuyaśasaḥ putraḥ kalkī bhaviṣyati ।। 173 ।।
so'haṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmi! karavālaṃ kare dadhan ।
kṛṣṇadattaṃ śvetavāhaṃ samāruhyā'mbare vrajan ।। 174।।
pṛthvīṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya trirātreṇa bhuvastalam ।
vāyupramaṇḍalaṃ sarvaṃ svāṃgasparśena vartulam ।। 175।।
kariṣye pāvanaṃ paścānmlecchān kṛtvā sumānasān ।
hatvā tvanyānatiduṣṭān kariṣyāmi ca saṃskṛtān ।। 176।।
kṛtaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyāmi satyayajñārhamānavān ।
kalau gate ca durdharṣe saṃpravṛtte kṛte yuge ।। 177।।
tapassatyasamāyukto dharmaḥ pūrṇo bhaviṣyati ।
tapasvinastadā viprāḥ pūtāste vaiṣṇavāstataḥ ।। 178।।
kalkiśiṣyāśca dharmiṣṭhā vedajñānaprakāśinaḥ ।
pativratāstataḥ satyo nāryaḥ patnīvratā narāḥ ।। 179।।
varṇadharmāḥ punaḥ sthāne prāpsyanti ca prakāśanam ।
yajñā dānāni karmāṇi lajjā ca mānaveṣu vai ।। 1.420.180।।
viṣṇubhaktiratāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।
leśo nāsti hyadharmāṇāṃ dharmapūrṇe kṛte yuge ।। 181 ।।
vyomayānāni sarvatra dūraśravaṇaśaktayaḥ ।
svargagamanayānāni bhaviṣyanti kṛte yuge ।। 182।।
dūradarśanayogāśca vārdhitalābhigāmitā ।
vidyudagnivāyurathā bhaviṣyanti kṛte yuge ।। 183 ।।
bhautikeṣvaṇimādyāśca siddhayaḥ śaktirūpikāḥ ।
layanāśodbhavakartryo bhaviṣyanti kṛte yuge ।। 184।।
bhūloke svargaloke na bhedo bhaviṣyati kṛte ।
nāryo devya ivā''bhāsā narā devāḥ kṛte yuge ।। 185 ।।
mantrā tantrāśca yantrāśca saphalāśca kṛte yuge ।
prabhākulyāḥ jalakulyāḥ śabdakulyāḥ gṛhe gṛhe ।। 186 ।।
aṣṭaṣaṣṭikalāgrāhāḥ pratibimbagrahānalāḥ ।
śārīrabhedavijñānaṃ prasṛtaṃ syāt kṛte yuge ।। 187।।
garbhā'garbhecchuniyamāḥ puṃstrīvivartaśaktayaḥ ।
mṛtajīvanadānādi bhaviṣyanti kṛte yuge ।। 188।।
vānaspatyavidhirdivyo rāsāyanavivartanaḥ ।
drāgecchāpūrakaḥ śakto bhaviṣyati kṛte yuge ।। 189।।
sañjīvanī mahāvidyā tathā'dṛśyaprayojikā ।
devāveśādisaṃcārāḥ bhaviṣyanti kṛte yuge ।। 1.420.1 90।।
śaktitattvādibodhāni bhūtabhautikajāni ca ।
divyamānakarāṇyeva yantrāṇi syuḥ kṛte yuge ।। 191 ।।
evaṃ saṃsthāpya bhagavān dharmaṃ kṛtayugaṃ navam ।
svargavad vasudhāṃ kṛtvā cāntardhānaṃ gamiṣyati ।। 1 92।।
dharmastripācca tretāyāṃ dvipācca dvāpare smṛtaḥ ।
kalau pravṛtte pādātmā sarvalopastataḥ param ।। 193 ।।
lakṣmi! sarvatra me bhaktāḥ pāvanā vicaranti vai ।
teṣāṃ pādarajaḥsparśād bhūḥ sadā tīrtharūpiṇī ।। 194।।
nadyo vṛkṣāḥ parvatāśca madbhaktaiḥ pāvitāśca te ।
kṣālayanti janānāṃ vai pāpāni tīrtharūpiṇaḥ ।। 1 95। ।
sādhavaḥ puṇyadehāśca sādhvyaścāpi hariśritāḥ ।
cetanāni hi tīrthāni pāvayanti dine dine ।। 196 ।।
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pāpāśca mānavādayaḥ ।
devā narāśca paśavo jīvāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ ।। 1 97।।
bhaviṣyanti ca pūtāste madbhaktasparśadarśanāt ।
iti te kathitāḥ sādhvi! yugadharmā bahuprathāḥ ।। 198 ।।
nāryaḥ pativratā yatra bhaviṣyanti yuge yuge ।
tatra svargaṃ sadā saukhyaṃ bhaviṣyati dhanādikam ।। 1 99।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! prasaṃgānmama janma ca ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhaved vaikuṇṭhavāsabhāg ।।1.420.200।।

iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratyamahimani caturyugadharmanirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 420 ।।
