adhyāyaḥ 421
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 422 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! camatkāraṃ tīrtharāje prayāgake ।
bharadvājasya vasatastriveṇyā bhāryayā saha ।। 1 ।।
brahmaputrī mānasī yā jātamātrā mahāsatī ।
śatacandrasamā rūpe yuvatī ca pativratā ।। 2 ।।
brahmasaro'gragaṇyā''sīt trinadyaṃśasamudbhavā ।
bharadvājaṃ lakṣavarṣatapasvinaṃ prayāgake ।। 3 ।।
kuṃbhasnāne brahālokādāgatā taṃ dadarśa sā ।
aho divyo varayogyaḥ ṛṣiścātra virājate ।। 4 ।।
iti sañcintya sevāyāṃ chāyāyāṃ tasya saṃsthitā ।
brahmaṇā kuṃbhakālasya kṛtvā snānaṃ taduttaram ।। 5 ।।
triveṇyā mānasaṃ jñātvā bharadvājāya sā'rpitā ।
gaṃgāyā yamunāyāśca sarasvatyāśca vai kalāḥ ।। 6 ।।
triveṇyai cārpitā nāmnā triveṇīṃ tāṃ ca kanyakām ।
prasaṃsamarpya ṛṣaye brahmā satyasthalaṃ yayau ।। 7 ।।
triveṇī pātivratyena bharadvājaṃ tapasvinam ।
niṣevate sadā bhaktyā pātivratyā'bhivṛddhayā ।। 8 ।।
prātaḥsnānādinā nityaṃ pādā'vamardanena ca ।
pūjāvastupradānena bhojyārpaṇena sarvadā ।। 9 ।।
brahmajñānena ca nityaṃ sandhyāvandanakarmabhiḥ ।
śayyāyāṃ sevanaiścāpi sevate sā pativratā ।। 1.421.10 ।।
kāmadhenuḥ sadā yatra kalpadrurvartate sadā ।
somavallī sadā tatra kare cintāmaṇiḥ sthitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
yatra dharmavatī nārī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
sarvaṃ tatra ca ratnānāmupasthānaṃ pravartate ।। 1 2।।
ekadā bharatastatra sāketakosaleśvaraḥ ।
sasainyenā''gamat tīrthavidhyarthaṃ māghatāpasaḥ ।। 13 ।।
sainyaṃ saṃsthāpya vai dūraṃ jagāma darśanāya saḥ ।
bharadvājasya ṛṣiṣu pravarasya gurostadā ।। 14।।
nanāma bharatastasya pādayordaṇḍavanmudā ।
bharadvājasya patnyāśca pādayoḥ sa nanāma ha ।। 15।।
bharatāya tadā'rghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ datvā phalāni ca ।
ānupūrvyācca dharmajñaḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ kule ।। 16।।
sāketāyāṃ bale kośe mitreṣvapi ca mantriṣu ।
bharato'pi bharadvājaṃ papraccha kuśalādikam ।। 17।।
śarīre'gniṣu śiṣyeṣu vṛkṣeṣu mṛgapakṣiṣu ।
tatheti tu pratijñāya bharadvājo mahāyaśāḥ ।। 18।।
prasannaḥ prāha cātraiva vasā''śrame'tra parvaṇi ।
svāgataṃ te ca satkāraṃ sevāṃ yathāguṇaṃ tathā ।। 1 9।।
kariṣye tīrthavāso'sti yāvatte nṛpapuṃgava! ।
guruvṛttirdamaścaiva sādhūnāṃ cānuyāyitā ।।1.421.20 ।।
santi tvayi guṇāḥ sarve vasā'tra tvāśrame mama ।
ityuktaḥ sa ca bharatastathetyevamuvāca tam ।।21 ।।
kṛtabuddhiṃ nivāsāya tatraiva sa munistadā ।
bharataṃ ṛṣitulyaṃ sa ātithyena nyamantrayat ।।22।।
abravīd bharatastvenaṃ nanvidaṃ bhavatā kṛtam ।
pādyamarghyamathātithyaṃ vane yadupapadyate ।।23 ।।
athovāca bharadvājo bharataṃ prahasanniva ।
jāne tvāṃ prītisaṃyuktaṃ toṣayiṣye yathādhanam ।।24।।
senāyāstava sarvasyāḥ kartumicchāmi satkṛtim ।
mama prītiryathārūpā tvamarho munirāḍ yathā ।।25।।
kimarthaṃ cāpi nikṣipya dūre sainyamihā''gataḥ ।
kasmānnehopayāto'si sabalaḥ priyabhaktarāṭ ।।26।।
bharataḥ pratyuvācedaṃ prāṃjalistaṃ tapodhanam ।
na sainyenopayāto'smi bhagavan bhagavadbhayāt ।।27।।
rājñā hi bhagavannityaṃ rājyā'dhikāriṇā'thavā ।
yatnataḥ parihartavyā viṣayeṣu tapasvinaḥ ।।28।।
vājimukhyā manuṣyāśca mattāśca varavāraṇāḥ ।
pracchādya bhagavan bhūmiṃ mahatīmanuyānti mām ।।29।।
te vṛkṣānudakaṃ bhūmimāśrameṣūṭajāँstathā ।
na hiṃsyuriti tenā'hameka evā''gatastataḥ ।।1.421.3 0।।
ānīyatāmitaḥ senetyājñaptaḥ paramarṣiṇā ।
tathā'nucakre bharataḥ senāyāḥ samupāgamam ।।3 1 ।।
tāvadṛṣiḥ satīṃ bhāryāṃ triveṇīṃ prāha śobhane! ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa viracayya supattanam ।।32।।
kuru rājyasamaṃ cāsya svāgataṃ satkṛtiṃ priye ।
ityuktā sā satī patnī natvā'nugrahakṛtpatim ।।33।।
agniśālāṃ praviśyā'tha pītvā''paḥ parimṛjya ca ।
ātithyasya kriyāhetorviśvakarmāṇamāhvayat ।। 34।।
āhvaye viśvakarmāṇamahaṃ tvaṣṭāramatra vai ।
ātithyaṃ kartumicchāmi tatra me saṃvidhīyatām 35
āhvaye lokapālāँstrīn devānindrapurogamān ।
ātithyaṃ kartumicchāmi tatra me saṃvidhīyatām ।।36।।
prāksrotasaśca yā nadyastiryaksrotasa ityapi ।
pṛthivyāmantarikṣe ca samāyāntvadya sarvaśaḥ ।।37।।
anyāḥ sravantu dugdhādi peyāni madhurāṇi ca ।
aparāścodakaṃ śītamikṣukāṇḍarasopamam ।।38।।
āhvaye devagandharvān viśvāvasuhahāhuhūn ।
tathaivā'psaraso devagandharvāścāpi sarvaśaḥ ।।39।।
ghṛtācīmatha viśvācīṃ miśrakeśīmalaṃbuṣām ।
nāgadattāṃ ca hemāṃ ca somāmadriṃ kṛtasthalīm ।।1.421.40 ।।
śakraṃ yāścopatiṣṭhanti brahmāṇa yāśca bhāminīḥ ।
sarvāstumburuṇā sārdhamāhvaye saparicchadāḥ ।।41 ।।
vanaṃ kuruṣu yaddivyaṃ vāsobhūṣaṇapatravat ।
divyanārīphalaṃ śaśvat tatkauberamihaiva tu ।।42।।
iha me bhagavan somo vidhattāmannamuttamam ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca coṣyaṃ ca lehyaṃ ca vividhaṃ bahu ।।43।।
vicitrāṇi ca mālyāni pādapapracyutāni ca ।
rasādīni ca peyāni khādyāni vividhāni ca ।।44।।
evaṃ samādhiyuktā sā tejasvinī pativratā ।
vahniṃ dhyātvā'smarat sarvān samājagmuśca te pṛthak ।।45।।
candanaparvatau spṛṣṭvā'nilaḥ svedanutaḥ śivaḥ ।
supriyātmā sukhaḥ śānto vavau saurabhapūritaḥ ।।46।।
devaiḥ kṛtāḥ svargapuṣpavṛṣṭayo divyatāpradāḥ ।
ghanāścandanabindubhirabhyavarṣanta vai manāk ।।47।।
devadundubhighoṣāśca maṃgalaśravaṇāstadā ।
śuśruvire tathā bhūmo nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।।48।।
prajagurdevagandharvā vīṇāḥ pramumucuḥ svarān ।
svāgatārthaṃ ca vādyāni hyavādyanta yadā tataḥ ।।49।।
bharataḥ sainyamādāya samāyātaḥ sakautukaḥ ।
dadarśa tasya tatsainyaṃ vidhānaṃ viśvakarmaṇaḥ ।।1.421.50 ।।
kṛtā tatra mahābhūmiḥ samantātpañcayojanam ।
śādvalairbahubhiśchannā nīlavaiḍūryasannibhaiḥ ।। 51 ।।
tatra bilvā kapitthāśca panasā sahakārakāḥ ।
āmalakyaḥ kharjurāśca babhūvuḥ phalabhūṣitāḥ ।।52।।
uttarebhyaḥ kurubhyaśca vanaṃ divyopabhogavat ।
ājagāma nadī vṛkṣavallīphalasamanvitā ।।53 ।।
catuśśālāni śubhrāṇi śālāśca gajavājinaḥ ।
harmyaprāsādasaṃyuktatoraṇāni śubhāni ca ।।54।।
sitameghanibhaṃ cāpi rājaveśma sutoraṇam ।
śuklamālyakṛtākāraṃ divyasugandhamiśritam ।।55।।
caturasramasaṃbādhaṃ śayanāsanayānavat ।
divyaiḥ sarvarateryuktaṃ divyabhojanavastravat ।।56।।
upakalpitasarvānnaṃ dhautanirmalabhājanam ।
klṛptasarvāsanaṃ śrīmatsvāstīrṇaśayanottamam ।।57।।
praviveśa mahābhakto bharato ratnaveśma tat ।
anujagmuśca sainyasya mantriṇaḥ sapurohitāḥ ।।58।।
babhūvuśca vaśiṣṭhādyā dṛṣṭvā veśmamudānvitāḥ ।
tatra rājāsanaṃ divyaṃ vyajanaṃ chatramityapi ।।59।।
bharato mantribhiḥ sārdhamabhyavartata rājavat ।
āsanaṃ śobhayāmāsa divyaṃ devārhameva tat ।।1.421.60 ।।
ānupūrvyā niṣeduśca sarve mantripurohitāḥ ।
tataḥ senāpatiḥ paścātpraśāstā ca nyaṣīdata ।।61 ।।
tāvattatra muhūrtena nadyaḥ pāyasakardamāḥ ।
upātiṣṭhanta bharataṃ triveṇyāścānuśāsanāt ।।62।।
āsāmubhayataḥ kūlaṃ pāṇḍumṛttikalepanāḥ ।
ramyāścāvasathā divyāstriveṇyāḥ samprasādajāḥ ।।63।।
tenaiva ca muhūrtena divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।
āgurviṃśatisāhasrā brahmaṇā prahitāḥ striyaḥ ।।64।।
suvarṇamaṇimuktaiśca pravālaiśca subhūṣitāḥ ।
āgurviṃśatisāhasrāḥ kuberaprahitāḥ striyaḥ ।।65।।
yābhiranugṛhītāśca narāḥ syurdivyavarṣmaṇaḥ ।
āgurviṃśatisāhasrā nandanādapsarogaṇāḥ ।।66।।
nāradādyāśca gandharvāḥ kāntyā sūryasamā yayuḥ ।
te gāndharvakalābhiśca bharatasyā'grato jaguḥ ।।67।।
alambuṣā miśrakeśī puṇḍarīkā'tha vāmanā ।
upānṛtyanta bharataṃ bharadvājasya śāsanāt ।।68।।
yāni mālyāni deveṣu yāni caitrarathe vane ।
prayāge tānyadṛśyanta triveṇyāstejasā tadā ।।6 9।।
bilvā mārdagikā āsan śamyā grāhā vibhītakāḥ ।
aśvatthā nartakāścāsan triveṇyāstejasā tadā ।।1.421.70 ।।
tataśca saralāstālāstilakāśca tamālakāḥ ।
prahṛṣṭāstatra cāyātāḥ kubjā bhūtvā'tha vāmanāḥ ।।71 ।।
śiṃśapā''malakījambūnavaraṃgādayo drumāḥ ।
sevakāḥ phaladā bhūtvā bharadvājā''śrame'vasan ।।72।।
drākṣācirbhaṭikānāgavallīsomādivallikāḥ ।
śarkarāvallikā miṣṭā yāścānyāḥ kānane latāḥ ।।73।।
pramadārūpadhāriṇyo bharadvājāśrame'vasan ।
miṣṭān pibata bho bhṛtyā āsavān vai yathepsitān ।।74।।
pāyasaṃ paramānnāni bhakṣyantāṃ ca bubhukṣitaiḥ ।
phalāni dehyacośyāni bhakṣyantāṃ sainyapuṃgavaiḥ ।।75।।
sakṛtvodvartanaṃ nāryo nadītīreṣu valguṣu ।
snāpayantyekamekaṃ sma naraṃ tāḥ sapta cāṣṭa ca ।।76।।
saṃvāhayantyā utpeturnāryo vipulalocanāḥ ।
pāyayanti karān dhṛtvā madhvādikaṃ varāṃganāḥ ।।77।।
hayān gajān kharānuṣṭrān vṛṣabhān ghoṭakān varān ।
abhojayanvāhanapāsteṣāṃ bhojyaṃ yathāyatham ।।78।।
ikṣūṃśca madhulājāँśca bhojayanti sma vāhanān ।
mattapramattamuditāstadā camūḥ prasaṃbabhau ।।79।।
tarpitāḥ sarvakāmaiśca raktacandanapūjitāḥ ।
apsarobhirvardhitāśca sainyā udairayaँstadā ।।1.421.80।।
aho saudhyānyaho vastūnyaho dāsyaśca sevikāḥ ।
aho kalpalatāścātra svargo'yamiti cābruvan ।।8 1।।
nṛtyantaśca hasantaśca gāyantaścāpi sainikāḥ ।
saṃprahṛṣṭā vineduśca narā nāryaḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।82।।
bharatasyā'nuyātāro mālyopetāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
tṛptāścāścaryasampūrṇā bharadvājaṃ vavandire ।।83।।
dhanyo'yaṃ munirājo'sti triveṇī yasya kāminī ।
sarvasiddhikarā sādhvī yatpratāpādidaṃ śubham ।।84 ।।
yadyapi syādvane vāso yasya patnī pativratā ।
svargaṃ tasya kare cāste kimasya rājyavaibhavaiḥ ।।85।।
yā patnī svapateḥ pādodakaṃ pītvā'nalā'ntike ।
sthitvecchati mahādivyā vibhūtīstāstu tatkṣaṇam ।।86।।
samāyānti kimu svargaṃ paraṃ nāsmāt kadācana ।
tataḥ sarvatra vai santu sādhvyo nāryaḥ pativratāḥ ।।87।।
tathā tāsāṃ svāminaśca bharadvājopamā narāḥ ।
patnīvrataparāḥ santu yeṣāṃ svargaṃ kare sadā ।।88।।
iti vadantaḥ sarve vai sahasraśo hi sainikāḥ ।
lakṣādhimānavāḥ sāketasya viṣayavāsinaḥ ।।89।।
tairthikāḥ koṭiśaścānye kuṃbhaparvaṇi cāgatāḥ ।
svargaṃ divyaṃ bharadvājakṛtaṃ vilokya te tadā ।।1.421.90 ।।
kaṃbharāṃ ca mahālakṣmīṃ gopālakṛṣṇamīśvaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra sthitaṃ patrāsanaṃ prabhum ।।9 1 ।।
triveṇīṃ ca nadīrūpāṃ tathā tīrthāni koṭiśaḥ ।
bharadvājapriyāṃ patnīṃ triveṇīṃ yuvatīṃ tathā ।।92।।
vilokya darśanaṃ kṛtvā pūtāste divyatāṃ yayuḥ ।
tato bhuktavatāṃ teṣāṃ tadannamamṛtopamam ।।93 ।।
divyānudvīkṣya bhakṣyāँścā'bhavat tadbhakṣaṇe matiḥ ।
preṣyāśceṭyaśca vadhvaśca balasthā deśavāsinaḥ ।।94।।
yātrālavaśca kiṃkaryo dāsā dāsyaśca naikaśaḥ ।
babhūvuste bhṛśaṃ prītāḥ sarve nūtnāmbarāstathā ।।95।।
kuñjarāśca kharoṣṭrāśca go'śvāśca mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ।
tṛptā babhūvuste nānyat tṛṇādyaṃ vai tadā''rthayan ।।96।।
nā'śuklavāsāstatrā''sīt kaścidvai kṣudhitastadā ।
phalādisadrasaiḥ sūpaiḥ kvathikābhiśca pāyasaiḥ ।।97।।
pūrṇā hyāsan hradāstatraudanānāṃ parvatāstathā ।
babhūvuścāśrame pārśve kūpāḥ pāyasakardamāḥ ।।98।।
tāśca kāmadughā gāvo drumāścāsan madhucyutaḥ ।
vāpyaścāsavapūrṇāśca svarṇapātrāṇi koṭiśaḥ ।।99।।
rājatāni ca pātrāṇi tāmrāṇāṃ koṭayastadā ।
pātrīṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi sthālīnāṃ niyutāni ca ।। 1.421.10 0।।
nyarbudāni ca pātrāṇi śātakuṃbhamayāni ca ।
sthālyaḥ kumbhyaḥ karambhyaśca dadhipūrṇāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ ।। 101 ।।
haiyaṃgavīnakūṭāni takrāṇāṃ kuṇḍakāni ca ।
hradāḥ pūrṇarasālānāṃ tiktāmblamiṣṭacūrṇakāḥ ।। 1 02।।
parpaṭānāṃ samūhāśca polikānāṃ tathā'drayaḥ ।
miṣṭānnānāṃ mahāśṛṃgāṇyabhavan tatra cāśrame ।। 1 03।।
babhūvurvyañjanānāṃ ca śarkarāṇāṃ ca sañcayāḥ ।
cūrṇāni lepayogyāni snānāni vividhāni ca ।। 1 04।।
dadṛśurbhājanasthāni tīrtheṣu saritāṃ janāḥ ।
śuklānaṃśumataścāpi dantadhāvanasañcayān ।। 1 05।।
śuklāँścandanakalkāँśca sampuṭeṣvavatiṣṭhataḥ ।
darpaṇānuttamāścitravāsasāṃ bahusaṃcayān ।। 1 06।।
mukhavāsān bahuvidhān cūrṇatāmbu+ūlacarvaṇān ।
pādukopānahāṃcaiva yugmānyatra sahasraśaḥ ।। 1 07।।
āṃjanīḥ kaṃkatān kūrcān dantakān chatracāmarān ।
marmatrāṇāni citrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca ।। 1 08।।
pratipānahradān pūrṇān kharoṣṭragajavājinām ।
avagāhya sutīrthāṃśca hradān sotpalapuṣkarān ।। 1 09।।
ākāśavarṇapratimān svacchatoyān sukhāplavān ।
nīlavaidūryavarṇāśca mṛduprā''vāsasaṃcayān ।। 1.421.110 ।।
bhakṣaṇārkṣaṃ paśūnāṃ te dadṛśustatra sarvaśaḥ ।
dolāśca vividhāstatra bhavane bhavane śubhāḥ ।। 111 ।।
vātayantrāṇi ramyāṇi vidyuddīpāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
śītoṣṇajalakuṇḍāni dyūtagṛhāṇi vai tathā 11 2।।
vimānabhavanānyeva svargayānāni tānyapi ।
jalāntaryānavaryāṇi dūraśravaṇayantrikāḥ ।। 113 ।।
dūradarśanapeṭyaścātītakrīḍāpradaśikāḥ ।
naṭanartakacāṭādikrīḍāṃgaṇāni bhūriśaḥ ।। 1 14।।
vyasmayanta manuṣyāste svapnakalpaṃ tadadbhutam ।
dṛṣṭvā''tithyaṃ kṛtaṃ tāvan mahendrādadhikaṃ tadā ।। 1 15।।
bharadvājatriveṇībhyāṃ kṛtaṃ svargaṃ navaṃ hi tat ।
bharadvājāśrame kuṃbhadinarātrirgatā sukham ।। 1 16।।
prātaḥ snānaṃ vidhāyaiva bharatādyāstadā punaḥ ।
bhojanādividhiṃ kṛtvā sampūjyarṣiṃ triveṇikām ।। 1 17।।
datvā dānānyanekāni yayuḥ sāketadhāma te ।
pratijagmuśca te sarve gandharvāśca varāṃganāḥ ।। 1 18।।
sarve ye tatra cāhūtāḥ triveṇyā patyurājñayā ।
pratijagmuḥ kṛtrimaṃ tat sarvamadṛśyatāṃ gatam ।। 11 9।।
iti lakṣmi! pratāpaste pātivratyavṛṣasya vai ।
kathito yaścaturdaśalokeṣu prathitaḥ priye ।। 1.421.120 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye bharatārthaṃ prayāge bharadvājapatnyā triveṇyā navīna-svargaṃ racitamiti tannirūpaṇanāmā ekaviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।42 1 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 421 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 422
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 423 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! śabarī lokapāvanī ।
yā''sīd brahmapriyā nāmnī patnī kṛṣṇasya dhāmani ।। 1 ।।
yadā vai rādhayā lakṣmīrgaṃgā cāpi sarasvatī ।
bhuvaṃ yātuṃ ruṣā proktāstadā brahmapriyā sakhī ।। 2 ।।
rādhāṃ tatpādayornatvā prāha kalyāṇi mā vada ।
kṣamāṃ kuru sapatnīṣu mātaryogyā kṣamā tava ।। 3 ।।
tadā rādhā ca tāmāha gaccha tvaṃ ramayā saha ।
pṛthvyāṃ dāsīvargajanma gṛhītvā vasa bhūtale ।। 4 ।।
tadā tatra sakhī cānyā pampānāmnyabhavaddhareḥ ।
sā nanāma tadā rādhāṃ mā vadetyāha tāṃ ca sā ।। 5 ।।
rādhā prāha prayāhi tvaṃ bhuvi brahmapriyāyutā ।
vasā'raṇye mahāpampe jaḍe yāhi samīpataḥ ।। 6 ।।
ityukte te rādhikāyāścakrāte pādamardanam ।
prasannā'bhūt tadā rādhā provāca śāpamokṣaṇam ।। 7 ।।
kṛṣṇena sākaṃ yāṃ kācit sakhī rādhāṃ vinā yadi ।
vihariṣyati tāḥ sarvāḥ preṣayiṣyāmi bhūtalam ।। 8 ।।
brahmapriye ca pampe ca golokaghaṭikā'vadhim ।
pṛthvyāṃ bahumanūnāṃ vai kālaṃ bhuktvā tataḥ param ।। 9 ।।
rāmarūpaṃ varaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāpyā'trā''yāsyathaḥ punaḥ ।
kariṣyatho brahmavetryau bhaktiṃ tāvaddharerbhuvi ।। 1.422.10 ।।
brahmacāridharmavatyau lokakalyāṇade sadā ।
divyacirāyuṣāṃ yukte devyau bhaviṣyathau bhuvi ।। 11 ।।
ityanugrahamāsādya kṛṣṇājñayā ca te hyubhe ।
lakṣmyā samaṃ samāyāte bhūtale dakṣiṇe sthale ।। 1 2।।
lakṣmīrvedavatī jātā kuśadhvajasya kanyakā ।
sā ca taptvā tapaścograṃ badaryākhyāśrame satī ।। 13 ।।
pṛthvyāṃ ca bālikā sītā jātā janakanandinī ।
kuśadhvajasya dāsaścāṭavīpālo'bhavattadā ।। 14।।
bhīmākhyo vai kulālaḥ śrīveṃkaṭādrinivāsakṛt ।
tasya vai mānasī kanye pampā brahmapriyā hyubhe ।। 15।।
yugale janite divye jātismare hareḥ priye ।
jagmatuste tapo'rthaṃ vai jātamātre vanāntaram ।। 16।।
kraucāraṇyāt samārabhya ṛṣyamūkādriśobhitam ।
mahāraṇyaṃ viviśatuḥ kanyake te hyubhe tataḥ ।। 17।।
cakratustapa ugraṃ te nirjane divyabhāvane ।
tatrā'rkavaṃśajāścāsan vānarāḥ paśavaśca ye ।। 18।।
balinaḥ krūrakarmāṇo dharmāmnāyavivarjitāḥ ।
kvacitkvacidvane tatra tāpasyau kanyake tu te ।। 1 9।।
pīḍayāmāsuratyarthaṃ paśuceṣṭitakrośanaiḥ ।
tadā pampā vicāryaiva puṣkariṇyabhavajjalam ।।1.422.20 ।।
jalarūpā tapaścaryāṃ karoti harilabdhaye ।
brahmapriyā'bhavat tatra jaraṭhā'tikurūpiṇī ।। 21 ।।
asthimātra śarīrā ca śuṣkā dhanurdharā satī ।
krūravarṇā'tinirghṛṇā śabarī sā bhayāvahā ।।22।।
yāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayamāpuste vānarā rākṣasīmiva ।
evaṃ tapaḥ prakurvantyau samāsāte hyubhe priye ।।23।।
patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca te nityamārādhayata ādarāt ।
ṛṣyamūkagiryaraṇye phalivṛkṣātisaṃkule ।।24।।
jambūpriyālapanasairnyagrodhaplakṣatindukaiḥ ।
aśvatthakarṇikāraiśca tilakairnaktamālakaiḥ ।।25।।
nāgavṛkṣaiḥ sahakārairaśokaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ ।
pāribhadraiḥ kadambaiścandanairnāraṃgakhārikaiḥ ।।26।।
kharjūraśrīphalanārīkelaiḥ phalidrumairyute ।
sarvakālaphalāstatra pādapā madhurasravāḥ ।।27।।
sarve ca ṛtavastatra phalapuṣpaprasūsamāḥ ।
śobhante nirjharā yatrā'mṛtakandādayastathā ।।28।।
tādṛśī puṣkariṇī sā pampā jalamayī hyabhūt ।
aśarkarā hyavibhraṃśā samatīrthā hyaśaivalā ।।29।।
sūkṣmasaṃskṛtavālūkā kamalotpalaśobhitā ।
haṃsaiḥ krauṃcairmaṇḍukaiśca kuraraiścātakaiḥ śukaiḥ ।।1.422.3 0।।
menāmayūrakukkuṭairjalīyaiḥ śabditāḥ muhuḥ ।
rātrau kanyā svarūpā sā śabaryā saha modate ।।3 1 ।।
divā pampā jalarūpā śabarī yatra modate ।
prāṇināṃ nidrite kāle kanyake cakraturmudam ।।32।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmyā rādhayā sahitaṃ varam ।
pārvatyā prabhayā yuktaṃ śriyā māṇikyayā yutam ।।33।।
padmāvatyā ca padminyā mālatyā jayayā'nvitam ।
mohinyā vṛndayā sākaṃ tulasyā padmayā yutam ।।34।।
mālatyā durgayā yuktaṃ sarasvatyā ca gaṃgayā ।
lalitayā'nvitaṃ te śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ mudā ।।35।।
pupūjatuḥ śubhairdravyaiḥ prāṇyasambādhake kṣaṇe ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa prakṛtyā sahitaṃ patim ।।।36 ।।
sugandhaścandanānāṃ tu tatra yāti samantataḥ ।
vāditrāṇāṃ svarāstatra jāyante sukhadāstadā ।।37।।
vanadevībhirāgatya gīyante gītikāstadā ।
vṛkṣā vallayastṛṇāḥ stambā mūrtāścāyānti pūjane ।।38।।
phalapuṣpāṇyarpayanti dugdhāni kāmadhenavaḥ ।
devagajāśca dhavalā garuḍāḥ pāṇḍurāstathā ।।39।।
svargahaṃsāḥ svarṇamatsyā mūrtāścāyānti pūjane ।
nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca ratnānyāyānti tatra vai ।।1.422.40।।
kambharākhyā mahālakṣmīrgopālakṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ ।
āgatya ca tayoḥ pūjāṃ saṃgṛhṇīto niśottare ।।41 ।।
lakṣmyādiviṃśatipatnīyukśrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
pūjāṃ kanyādvayakṛtāṃ gṛhītvā''śliṣya vakṣasi ।।42।।
ramayitvā sukhaṃ datvā datvā sarvaṃ prasādajam ।
cumbayitvā harirnityamadṛśyo jāyate tataḥ ।।43।।
pampā jalamayī cānyā jaraṭhā śabarī tadā ।
bhavatīti tapastayonirvighnaṃ jāyate sadā ।।44।।
evaṃ pampāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ nūtanāmṛṣayaḥ khalu ।
śrutvā mataṃgaśiṣyā ye parvatāraṇyavāsinaḥ ।।45।।
āsannivasitāstatra draṣṭuṃ samāyayustadā ।
te ca puṣkariṇīṃ daivīṃ dṛṣṭvā mudānvitāstataḥ ।।46 ।।
pampātīre nyuṣuḥ parṇakuṭīrvidhāya naikaśaḥ ।
teṣāṃ tapaḥprakartṝṇāṃ śarīrāt svedabindavaḥ ।।47।।
ye prapeturmahīṃ tāni babhūvuḥ kusumāni vai ।
svedabindusamutthāni naśyanti kusumāni na ।।48।।
teṣāṃ vāsārhabhūmau sā śabarī pādacāriṇī ।
śramaṇī śabarī nityaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇā ।।49।।
pratīkṣate taṃ samayaṃ kadā sītā miliṣyati ।
kadā rāmo vanaṃ yāsyannau mokṣaṃ prāpayiṣyati ।।1.422.50।।
etasminnantare rāmalakṣmaṇāvupatasthatuḥ ।
tau puṣkariṇyāḥ paṃpāyāstīramāsādya paścimam ।।51 ।।
vanavāse rāvaṇena hṛtāṃ mārgayituṃ priyām ।
samāgatāvapaśyatāṃ śabaryā ramyamāśramam ।।52।।
bahudrumasamākīrṇaṃ pampāśobhitavigraham ।
suramyamabhivīkṣantau śabarīmabhyupeyatuḥ ।।53 ।।
tau dṛṣṭvā tu tadā siddhā samutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ ।
pādau jagrāha rāmasya lakṣmaṇaṃ praṇanāma ca ।।54।।
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca sarvaṃ prādād yathāvidhi ।
tāmuvāca tato rāmaḥ śramaṇīṃ dharmasaṃsthitām ।।55।।
smaryate kiṃ brahmapriye rādhāvākyaṃ tapaḥpradam ।
rāmo'haṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'smi mokṣadastava ।।56।।
pampā tāvat svaraṃ śrutvā bhūtvā kanyā samāyayau ।
rāmasya caraṇe natvā patitvā'muñcadaśruṇī ।।57।।
rāmaḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ svāsthyaṃ vṛttāntapūrvakam ।
kaccid vāṃ nirjitā vighnāḥ kaccid vāṃ vardhate tapaḥ ।।58।।
kaccid vāṃ niyataḥ kopa āhāraśca tapodhane ।
kaccid vāṃ niyamāḥ prāptāḥ kaccidvāṃ manasaḥ sukham ।।59।।।
kaccidvāṃ vṛddhaśuśrūṣā saphalā'tra pravartate ।
rāmeṇa pṛṣṭe tāpasyau siddhe siddhābhivandite ।।1.422.60।।
śaśaṃsatuḥ śabarī vṛddhā pampā rāmāya śobhanam ।
adya prāptā tapaḥsiddhistava saṃdarśanāt prabho ।।6 1 ।।
adya nau saphalaṃ janmā'tithayaścāpi pūjitāḥ ।
adya nau saphalaṃ tapta svargaśca padaśāśvatam ।।62।।
tvayi nāthe samāpanne pūjite cābhivandite ।
sevite bhojite kṛṣṇe sarvaṃ prāptaṃ phalaṃ prabho ।।6 3 ।।
vavā''vāṃ cakṣuṣā nātha pūte ca divyatāṃ gate ।
yāsyāvo naijagolokaṃ tvatprasādāt priyaprabho ।।64।।
citrakūṭaṃ tvayi prāpte vimānairatulaprabhaiḥ ।
itaste divamārūḍhā hyāvābhyāṃ ye'tra sevitā ।।65।।
ukte taiścātidharmajñairmahābhāgavatarṣibhiḥ ।
āgamiṣyati rāmaḥ sa puṇyaṃ vāmimamāśramam ।।66 ।।
sa yuvābhyāṃ sevanīyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sā'nujo'tithiḥ ।
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā svakaṃ lokaṃ golokaṃ yāsyatho yuvām ।।67।।
evamukte mahābhāgaistadā''vāṃ kāntakeśava ।
āvābhyāṃ sañcitaṃ vanyaṃ vividhaṃ ca phalādikam ।।68।।
tavā'rthe kamalākānta paṃpāyāstīrasaṃbhavam ।
paṃpayā ca śabaryā'rghyaṃ samarpitaṃ gṛhāṇa tat ।।6 9।।
ityuktvā te dadatuśca niveśya kuśaviṣṭare ।
pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā tattoyaṃ pāpanāśanam ।।1.422.70 ।।
śirasā''dhārya pītvā ca vanyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pupūjatuḥ ।
phalāni ca supakvāni mūlāni madhurāṇi ca ।।71 ।।
svayamāsvādya mādhuryaṃ parīkṣya paribhakṣya ca ।
paścānnivedayāmāsa śabarī prāṇadāyine ।।72।।
badaryādiprapakvāni bhakṣayāmāsatuśca tau ।
atha rāmaḥ satīṃ dāsīṃ śabarīṃ prāha saṃsmaran ।।73 ।।
dānavāścātra vai pūrve cakruryajñamahotsavam ।
adyāpi vidyate vedī vahnistatra prakāśate ।।74।।
ityāścaryamayaṃ sthānaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi sundari ।
ityuktā sā yayau nītvā rāmaṃ dūre vanāntaram ।।75।।
śabarī darśayāmāsa tāvubhau tadvanaṃ mahat ।
paśya meghaghanaprakhyaṃ mṛgapakṣisamākulam ।।76।।
mataṃgavanamevaitad viśrutaṃ munivāsitam ।
iha te bhāvitātmāno guravo'tra mama priya ।।77।।
juhavāṃcakrire nīḍe mantravanmantrapūjitam ।
iyaṃ pratyaksthalī vedī yatra vai dānavāḥ sadā ।।78।।
puṣpopahāraṃ kurvanti devatābhyo dine dine ।
teṣāṃ tapaḥprabhāveṇa paśyā'dyāpi janārdana ।।79।।
dyotayantī diśaḥ sarvāḥ śriyā vedyatulaprabhā ।
aśaknuvadbhistairgantumupavāsakṛśaiḥ sadā ।।1.422.80 ।।
snānārthaṃ cintitāḥ saptā'bdhayastiṣṭhanti cātra vai ।
kṛtābhiṣekaistairnyastā valkalāḥ pādapeṣviha ।।81 ।।
adyāpi na viśuṣyanti pradeśe'tra vilokaya ।
devakāryāṇi kurvadbhiryānīmāni dhṛtāni vai ।।।82।।
mṛdūnyapi ca puṣpāṇi mlānatāṃ yānti nātra vai ।
ityevaṃ paśyati rāmastāvat te tāpasāstadā ।।83 ।।
divyarūpadharāḥ sarve danuvaṃśasamudbhavāḥ ।
vaiṣṇāvāste mataṃgasya śiṣyāstatra samāyayuḥ ।।84।।
patitāḥ pādayostasya rāmasyā'kṣālayan padam ।
pītavantaśca te sarve munayaḥ prāgbhave tu te ।।85।।
vihāya dānavīṃ yoniṃ vimānamadhiruhya ca ।
nītāśca pārṣadaiḥ sarve jagmurvaikuṇṭhameva te ।।86 ।।
atha dāsī śabaryāha kāntaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
kṛtsnaṃ vanamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrotavyaṃ ca śrutaṃ tvayā ।।87।।
tadicchāmyabhyanujñātā tyakṣyāmyetatkalevaram ।
pampā'pīcchati golokaṃ gantuṃ pūrṇe yuge hare ।।88।।
kvā'sti lakṣmi svasurnau śrīḥ lakṣmīrvada kṛpāṃ kuru ।
śrutvā ruroda rāmaśca te dhairyaṃ dadatustadā ।।89।।
sītāvṛttāntamājñāya cakrire cintanaṃ ca te ।
atha svāsthyaṃ paraṃ prāpya rāmeṇānugraheṇa vai ।।1.422.90।।
dhairyamādāya ca dṛṣṭā dehaṃ tyājayituṃ tadā ।
pampā tatra samāyātā sāpyayācata mokṣaṇam ।।91 ।।
sāpi rāmeṇa tatraiva kṛpayā cāvalokitā ।
uvāca śabarīṃ pampāṃ naiṣṭhikīṃ vṛttimāśritām ।। 92।।
ājīvanaṃ brahmacaryavratasthāṃ śrīharipriyām ।
arcito'haṃ tvayā pampe śabari gaccha me gṛham ।। 93 ।।
tāvattatra samāyātaṃ vimānaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃyutam ।
lakṣmīyuktaṃ pārṣadaiḥ sevitaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।94।।
natvā dhyātvā hṛdi kṛtvā pampā ca śabarī tadā ।
anujñātā tu rāmeṇa pādādudbhāvya cānalam ।।95।।
kṛtvā dehaṃ bhasmasācca gopī golokavāsinī ।
kṛṣṇapriyā yathā cāsītpampā brahmapriyā tathā ।।96।।
jvalatpāvakasaṃkāśe rādhālakṣmīsame hyubhe ।
bhūtvā tu kanyake divye kṛṣṇapārśve niṣedatuḥ ।।97।।
divyābharaṇasaṃyukte divyamālānulepane ।
divyāmbaradhare tatra babhūvatuḥ sudarśane ।।98।।
virājayantyau kṛṣṇasya pārśve vidyullate yathā ।
yayaturnityagolokaṃ kāntayānena te hyubhe ।।99।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! brahmapriyācaritrakam ।
śrutvā paṭhitvā yāyādvai golokaṃ pramadā naraḥ ।। 1.422.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratye golokād brahmapriyāpampayoḥ rādhikāroṣādavataraṇaṃ rāmacandrayogena śabarīpampayoḥ punargolokaprāptiḥ pātivratyaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।422।।


← adhyāyaḥ 422 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 423
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 424 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ cānyāṃ pātivratyaparāyaṇām ।
golokasya kṛṣṇadāsyāścitralekhātvadāyinīm ।। 1 ।।
purā'hamṛṣabho jāto'vatāraḥ sādhutāṃ caran ।
gārhasthyaṃ ca parityajya bharate svātmaje dhuram ।। 2 ।।
nyasyā'vadhūtatāṃ gacchan vṛṣaṃ pāramahaṃsyakam ।
samasthāpayadurvyāṃ cā''yayau vaikuṇṭhameva tu ।। 3 ।।
bharatasyā'bhavatputraḥ śataśṛṃgaḥ pratāpavān ।
tasya putrāṣṭakaṃ caikā putrī ceti navā'bhavan ।। 4 ।।
indradvīpaḥ kaseruśca tāmradvīpo gabhastimān ।
nāgaḥ saumyaśca gandharvo varuṇaśca kumārikā ।।5 ।।
kumārikā'bhavad dāsī goloke śāśvatī sakhī ।
nāmnā sā citralekheti rādhākrodhājjaniṃ gatā ।। 6 ।।
kumārikā'tra nāmnaivā'bhavat khyātā harivratā ।
jātismarā jātamātrā yuvatī brahmavādinī ।। 7 ।।
snānasandhyāparā vedaprasūjapā trivarṣakam ।
śālagrāmā'rhaṇāśraddhāvatī nityaṃ prasevate ।। 8 ।।
vaiṣṇavī tulasī mālāṃ rakṣati sma gale sadā ।
kare vṛndāmālikayā japati sma hariṃ patim ।। 9 ।।
śayane jāgratau kārye viśrāme bhojane'rjane ।
pāne vastvānayane ca snāne śṛṃgārake tanau ।। 1.423.1 0।।
jape prasādhane vilepane prakṣālane'rthane ।
randhane mañjane śuddhāvālasye vādane stutau ।। 11 ।।
śravaṇe kīrtane kāṣṭhāsañcaye mudamānase ।
rāge vilokane vṛttau saṃcāre kramaṇe kṣudhi ।। 1 2।।
pipāsāyāṃ jvare grīṣme śīte samutsave vane ।
vṛkṣe vallyāṃ bhavanādau sakhīnāṃ maṇḍale gṛhe ।। 13 ।।
svāminaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japati dhyāyati ।
hasati nṛtyati rauti dravatyaśrūṇi muñcati ।। 14।।
prāpnoti divyabhāvaṃ ca vyomnā yāti vanāntaram ।
gṛhāntaraṃ kṛṣṇamanupraviśatyahatakramā ।। 15।।
annaṃ vāri phalaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ bījaṃ dravaṃ payaḥ ।
miṣṭaṃ rūkṣaṃ vastramarghyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ samaharṇam ।। 16 ।।
pradāya pataye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya kanyakā ।
bhuṃkte prāsādikaṃ kṛtvā tadanyadbhogavarjitā ।। 17।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo dattaṃ bhuṃkte sākṣāddhi kanyayā ।
ramate tu tayā sārdhaṃ kṣaṇaṃ dyūtaṃ manoharam ।। 18।।
evaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā kumārikā ।
samārādhayati kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ prabhum ।। 1 9।।
tasyāstu vadanaṃ cāsīdajāmukhasamākṛti ।
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ lakṣmi! goloke rādhikā yadā ।।1.423.20।।
roṣaṃ prāptā tadā citralekhayā lambitaṃ mukham ।
oṣṭhau lambau kṛtau cāpi jihvā bāhye vilambitā ।।21 ।।
vikṛtānanamevedaṃ rādhāyai darśitaṃ tadā ।
vikṛtānukaraṇasthaṃ dṛṣṭvā citralikhā''nanam ।।22।।
rādhā''ha tāṃ barkarikāmukhī lambānanī bhava ।
darśayase mukhaṃ cāpi svabhāvaṃ barkarī yathā ।।23 ।।
tasmāt tvaṃ barkarī bhūtvā vihara kṣitimaṇḍale ।
ityuktā sā sakhī rādhāsevikā''ha nayānvitā ।।24।।
sevāphalaṃ mahatīnāṃ dāsyā prāpya mahad bhavet ।
yadi rādhe'si mahatī rājarājeśvarīśvarī ।।25।।
prayaccha ca tadā svānurūpaṃ phalaṃ mahattamam ।
yadyasi kṣudrike yaccha kiṃkaryai kṣudrakaṃ phalam ।। 26।।
pāritoṣikavastvādi dātuḥ śraiṣṭhyakaniṣṭhate ।
prakhyāpayati lokeṣu svānurūpaṃ pradānakam ।।27।।
rādhā śrutvā mahārājñī prasannā'bhūt prahasya ca ।
citralekhāṃ tadā prāha bhava rājeśvarī bhuvi ।। 28।।
kṣaṇaṃ barkarikā bhūtvā kṛṣṇarṣabhasya putrikā ।
bhava tvaṃ bhūbhṛtī vatse hyatrā'gamiṣyati kṣaṇāt ।। 29।।
ityuktā sā citralekhā mahīsāgarasaṃgame ।
avātatāra vai vyomno mārgād divyā tu kanyakā ।।1.423.3 0।।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sāgaraḥ śubhrāṃ cukṣubhe mānase kṣaṇam ।
yuvā ratnadharo bhūtvā tvāyayau saṃgamecchayā ।।3 1 ।।
tāvat sā kanyakā'raṇye'dṛśyā babhūva barkarī ।
samudrastāṃ mahāsiddhiṃ devīṃ cāpsarasaṃ ca vā ।।32।।
vitarkya śāntamanasā praṣṭuṃ pṛṣṭhe yayau yadā ।
tadā sā bhayamāpannā vidudrāva vanāntare ।।33।।।
jāligulmalatākīrṇe stambhatīrthasya sannidhau ।
bhrāntā viklavacittā sā pradeśe tatra duścare ।।34।।
itastato bhramamāṇā kṣutpipāsā'rditā satī ।
vidudrāva mahītīre tadābhimukhataḥ priye ।।35।।
jalasya daśahastādyāyataṃ khātaṃ samāgatam ।
ullaṃghyotplutya ca yāvatpatatyagre sutīrake ।।36।।
jālivṛkṣapraśākhādimaṇḍite tattaṭe tu sā ।
patitā jālikāṣṭhānāṃ madhye guptisamīhayā ।।37।।
kintu tasyāḥ śirastatra śākhāpāśavaśaṃ gatam ।
pṛṣṭhato'pi bhayaṃ tasyā galasyāpi bhayaṃ hyabhūt ।।38।।
kṣutpipāsābhayaṃ cāpi saṃbhogabhayamityapi ।
nūtnadeśaprapātasya bhayaṃ pañcabhayairhi sā ।।39।।
mṛtā kṣaṇena tatraiva śarīraṃ patitaṃ jale ।
mastakaṃ jāliśākhāyāṃ vitastimātramūrdhvake ।।1.423.40।।
tīre cālambate tatra na nimagnaṃ jalāntare ।
mastakaṃ jalahīnaṃ tu deho mahījalāntare ।।41 ।।
iti tīrthaprabhāveṇa śarīreṇa tu kanyakā ।
mānuṣī sundarī jātā mastakaṃ barkarīsamam ।।42।।
śataśṛṃgasya vai rājñaḥ siṃhaleṣvabhavat sutā ।
evaṃ sā barkarīmukhī vyajāyata haripriyā ।।43।।
divyanārī śubhākārā śeṣakāyaṃ babhau śubham ।
jyeṣṭhā rājño'pyaputrasya snigdhā putraśatopamā ।।44।।
putrī jātā pramodena svajanānandavardhinī ।
tāṃ barkarīmukhīṃ dṛṣṭvā rājāno vismayaṃ yayuḥ ।।45।।
viṣādaṃ paramāpanno rājā svāntaḥpurānvitaḥ ।
khinnāḥ prajāstathā lokā ye ye paśyanti tāṃ satīm ।।46।।
tat kimityetadāścaryamūcuḥ sarvatra mānavāḥ ।
kintu sā divyarūpā''sīt candrādhikaprabhāvatī ।।47।।
ajāmukhīṃ mahāmāyāṃ jñātvā pupūjurādarāt ।
ajāmekāṃ raktaśuklakṛṣṇāṃ mūlasvarūpiṇīm ।।48।।
hareḥ śaktiṃ prakṛtiṃ tāṃ jñātvā pupūjurādarāt ।
ajo'pyenāṃ kāmabhāve hyalabdhvā nivṛtto'bhavat ।।49।।
tataḥ sā jātamātrā ca yuvatī vedabodhinī ।
yathā sarasvatī devī tathā'bhūjjñānasatsvaniḥ ।। 1.423.50 ।।
svamukhaṃ darpaṇe dṛṣṭvā smarati nityameva sā ।
tīrthaṃ mahīnadīrūpaṃ mahāsāgarasaṃgatam ।।51।।
golokasthaṃ svakīyaṃ ca citralekhāsvarūpakam ।
mātre pitre prajābhyaśca prāha sā jñānagarbhiṇī ।।52।।
mā yātā''ścaryamevā'tra pūrvajanmārjite phale ।
mamāsti mastakaṃ mahīnadyāṃ jālidrumāntare ।।53।।
tadasti nipatenmahyāṃ mukhaṃ me mānavaṃ bhavet ।
ityuktvā sā tamuddeśaṃ prati yānāya niścitā ।।54।।
pitrā dattāḥ sevakāśca potāni bhojyakāni ca ।
ratnāni dāsikā dravyaṃ dānārthaṃ vividhaṃ tadā ।।55।।
stambhatīrthe tataḥ sā'pi prāpya potārthasaṃyutā ।
bhūri dānaṃ tatra cakre dānaṃ sarvasvadakṣiṇam ।।56।।
jāligulmāntare'nviṣya kapālaṃ śiraso'sthi yat ।
dagdhvā saṃgamasānnidhye cikṣepā'sthyādi tīrthake ।।57।।
tena tīrthaprabhāveṇa pūrṇasāmarthyatejasā ।
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptaṃ mukhaṃ jātaṃ hi mānavam ।।58।।
na tādṛgdevakanyānāṃ na tādṛṅnāgayoṣitām ।
na tādṛṅmartyanārīṇā satyā yādṛṅmukhaṃ śubham ।।59।।
surāsuranarādyāśca tasyā rūpeṇa mohitāḥ ।
bahudhā prārthayantyenaṃ na sā varamabhīpsati ।।1.423.6 0।।
śreṣṭhaṃ tapastayā tatrā''rabdhaṃ cānyapraduṣkaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nāthaḥ pūrṇe jāte hi vatsare ।। 61 ।।
pratyakṣatāṃ gatastasyā varado'smīti cā'bravīt ।
taṃ ca pūrvapatiṃ pūjayitvā''ha kanyakā satī ।। 62 ।।
parituṣṭo'si he nātha yadi deyo varo mama ।
sānnidhyaṃ cara me nātha tato golokamāhara ।।63।।
evamastviti kṛṣṇena prokto hṛṣṭā kumārikā ।
tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā kumāryāha janārdanam ।।64।।
tīrthe tvatrāstu vai svastikaraṃ gaṃgājalātmakam ।
atra mṛtānāṃ dāhaśca barkarīśvarasannidhau ।।65।।
prajāyate tatasteṣāṃ muktirbhavatu mādhava ।
snātvā'rṇavamahītoye muktiṃ yātu jano hare ।।66।।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha yayau cādṛśyatāṃ punaḥ ।
athāścaryaṃ paraṃ śrutvā pātālātsvastikā'bhidhaḥ ।।67।।
nāgarājo bilāttatra darśanārthaṃ samāgataḥ ।
sa ca kūpaḥ svastikākhyastīrthaṃ khyātiṃ tadā'gamat ।।68।।
nāgena tu barkarīśaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ tathā ।
svastikeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ śubham ।।6 9।।
tayā tu kanyayā tatra kārayitvā sumandiram ।
ajāviṣṇuḥ sthāpito vai bhagavān svapatiḥ svayam ।।1.423.70 ।।
sevāyāṃ vartate mūrtyā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya sā ।
kārtike tu caturdaśyāṃ yaḥ snāyāt tatra kūpake ।।71 ।।
tarpayetpūrvajāṃścaiva sa tārayati viṃśatim ।
evaṃ sā kanyakā divyā tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayau gṛham ।।72।।
siṃhale śataśṛṃgāya pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat ।
śrutvā prajāyuto rājā tīrthārthaṃ tatra cāyayau ।।73 ।।
dadau dānāni putryāśca mandire jīvikā dadau ।
putryā khyātiṃ gato rājā dhanyo yasya sutā satī ।।74।।
atha svanagaraṃ gatvā samutsavaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
anicchantyāṃ kumāryā ca varaṃ dravyaṃ ca padmaje ।।75।।
pitā'janābhakhaṇḍaṃ svaṃ navadhaiva vibhajya saḥ ।
dadāvaṣṭau svaputrāṇāmajāyai navamaṃ dadau ।।76 ।।
kanyākumārikākhaṇḍo dakṣiṇe rājyameva yat ।
cakārā'jā mahāsādhvī kumārikā harivratā ।।77।।
kumārī sā mahābhāgā stambhatīrthe mahītaṭe ।
vartate divyarūpeṇa rājye'pi vartate sadā ।।78।।
navakhaṇḍasthā''janābhe ṣaṇṇavatiprakoṭayaḥ ।
dvāsaptatistathā lakṣāḥ pattanānāṃ bhavanti vai ।।79।।
evaṃ sā saṃvidhāyaiva kumārikṣetramuttamam ।
tadrakṣakaṃ mahākālaṃ vidhāpya ca satī tataḥ ।।1.423.80।।
badarikāśramaṃ yātā tapastaptuṃ harergṛhe ।
citralekhā tāpasī sā'bhavadbadarikāśrame ।।8 1 ।।
ahaṃ vṛndāvane kṛṣṇo bhaviṣyāmi yadā rame! ।
tadā'niruddho matputrastūṣāyāḥ patiruttamaḥ ।।82।।
yayā citre lekhayitvā svāpnadṛśyo bhaviṣyati ।
sā tataḥ pañcasāhasre varṣāṇāṃ vigate bhuvi ।।।83 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnī saurāṣṭre saṃbhaviṣyati ।
śrītulyā'dṛśyarūpeṇa sevayitvā hariṃ patim 84।।
yāsyati śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇagolokameva sā ।
iti te kathitā lakṣmi! divyā citralikhā satī ।।85।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya kanyātīrthaphalaṃ labhet ।
dhanakanyāsutadārasampadvān syānna saṃśayaḥ ।।86 ।।
adṛśyā dṛśyatāṃ prāptā citralekhā tu mañjulā ।
smaryate muktidā sāpi yena kṛṣṇasamā priyā ।।87 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne golokād ṛṣabhavaṃśe citralekhādāsyāḥ prāvirbhāvaḥ, tatra- barkararūpasamudramohobarkarīmukhatā, mahīsāgarasaṃgame tīrthe camatkārādipradarśanaṃ kumārikākhaṇḍādiprasiddhiḥ, tasyā mañjulārūpāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।42 3 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 423 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 424
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 425 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! revatādreśchāyāyāṃ vasataḥ purā ।
bhikṣunāmakaviprasya kalahāyāstu yoṣitaḥ ।। 1 ।।
kathāṃ pativirodhinyāḥ svāmimāhātmyabodhinīm ।
karavīrapure hyāsīd dharmadattākhyabhūsuraḥ ।। 2 ।।
snānasandhyātapohomasvādhyāyajapatatparaḥ ।
mahābhāgavato nityaṃ sevate sma sato janān ।। 3 ।।
grāmasthān vai janān sarvān saṃgṛhya bhūmisattale ।
nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ nityaṃ karoti gītipūrvakam । । 4 । ।
nṛtyaṃ karoti kṛṣṇasya sannidhau vakti satkathām ।
utsavāँśca bahūn bhaktiyuktān karoti bhāvataḥ ।। 5 । ।
vratāhādau viśeṣeṇa kārayatyeva śreṣṭhibhiḥ ।
atithīn svāgataiḥ santoṣayatyahaniśaṃ dvijaḥ ।। 6 । ।
kṛpṇanārāyaṇaṃ mālāmaṇibhirjapamācarat ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya oṃ japan sadā । । 7 । ।
yāti nārāyaṇapūjākaraṇārthaṃ ca mandiram ।
brāhme muhūrte nadyāṃ susnātena vastu gṛhṇatā ।। 8 ।।
mandiraṃ vrajatā mārge dṛṣṭā tena hi rākṣasī ।
bhīṣaṇā kṣudhitā krūrā bahirdaṃṣṭrā digambarā ।। 9 ।।
kṛṣṇādrisadṛśī sthūlā lalajjihvā sakharparā ।
khādayāmi bhakṣayāmi vadantī ghargharasvarā ।। 1.424.10 ।।
ativegādutpatantī grahītuṃ lambaduṣkarā ।
dharmadatto'pi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā trastaḥ krośan pradhāvitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
sāpi pṛṣṭhe pradudrāva dhartuṃ bhakṣitumulbaṇā ।
yāvatsā nikaṭaṃ prāptā dharmadattastu vihvalaḥ ।। 1 2।।
prāṇarakṣāparastasyā dūrīkaraṇahetave ।
hare nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa rakṣa govinda mādhava ।।।1 3।।
śrīpate māṇikīsvāmin ramānātha prabhāpate [ ।
lakṣmīrādhāpate pārvatīpate kamalāpate ।। 14।।
jayādayāramācampāpatai muktāpate'va mām ।
mañjulālalitādevīśāntihaṃseśa rakṣa mām ।। 15।।
oṃśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasudarśanā'tra māmava ।
iti gṛṇan nicikṣepa tulasīdalayugjalam ।। 16।।
rākṣasyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa pūjanavastu ca ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin rakṣa rakṣeti saṃvadan ।। 17।।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ vipraṃ rāmasya śapatho'stu te ।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ kṣudre caṇḍikāśapatho'stu te ।। 18।।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ nagne yoginīśapatho'stu te ।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ raṇḍe durgāyāḥ śapatho'stu te ।। 1 9।।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ kṛtye rudrasya śapatho'stu te ।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇasya śapatho'stu te ।। 1.424.20 ।।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ rātre māyāyāḥ śapatho'stu te ।
yadi spṛśasi māṃ duṣṭe kālasya śapatho'stu te ।।।21 ।।
evaṃ vadan sa pāṣāṇaiḥ kṛṣṇanāmnā'hanad ruṣā ।
pūjātulasīpatraiśca jalaiḥ pāpāni cā'dahat ।।22।।।
matiṃ prāpya śubhāṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ saṃsmṛtya pātakam ।
pāpajālāni saṃsmṛtya dharmadattāya cāha sā ।।23।।
pūrvajanmani saurāṣṭre raivatācalasannidhau ।
bhadrātaṭe'vasad bhikṣunāmā viprastu vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।24 ।।
tasya bhāryā niṣṭhurā'hamāsa viruddhavartanā ।
kiṃśīlā kiṃjalpanā kiṃvitaṇḍikā'tikaṣṭadā ।।25 ।।
kalirme hṛdye cāste gālī jihvāgranartinī ।
krauryaṃ ca netrayoḥ śaśvattāmasītvaṃ ca mānase ।।26 ।।
caṇḍabhāvo lalāṭe me mahāruṭ nāsikātaṭe ।
tiraskāraścauṣṭhayorme vāṇyāṃ tu kalahaḥ sthitaḥ ।।27।।
śvāse tvaniṣṭatāvāsaścodvegaḥ karmaṇi sthitaḥ ।
lajjā pṛṣṭhe kṛtā nityaṃ hyagre nirlajjatā dhṛtā ।।28।।
avamānaṃ tāḍanaṃ ca mama hastatale sthitam ।
evaṃ nityaṃ vartamānā nivasāmi dvijagṛhe ।।29।।
saurāṣṭre sarvato deśe yatra yatra gṛhe kvacit। ।
vivādo dampatīmadhye jāyate cet tadā mama ।।1.424.3 0 ।।
smaryate nāma gṛhiṇā kalahā kvā''gatā'tra phaṭ ।
evaṃ nāmnā prasiddhā'haṃ patikleśakarī sadā ।।31 ।।
mannāma smaryate prātarbhojanaṃ nā''pyate tadā ।
evaṃ pāpamayī cā'haṃ bhikṣubhāryā'bhavaṃ purā ।।3 2।।।
kārayāmi svapatinā mama pādāvamardanam ।
vastraprakṣālanaṃ cāpi gṛhamārjanamityapi ।।33 ।।
bhāṇḍamañjanamevāpi kārayāmi ca bhikṣuṇā ।
evaṃvidhā mahāpāpapuñjātmikā'bhavaँstadā ।। 34।।
na dadāmi svapataye bhojanaṃ sukhadaṃ jalam ।
yadarthayati tasmāttu viparītaṃ dadāmi vai ।।।35।।
tadapi gālikāyuktaṃ naṣṭa bhraṣṭaṃ dadāmi ca ।
khāda rasaphala nāryā ityevaṃ jalpayāmi ca ।। 36 ।।
nityaṃ codvejitḥ kānto madhuraṃ cāpi nā'vadam ।
śubhaṃ kiñcit kṛtaṃ naiva matto veśyā'pi saukhyadā ।।37।।
puṃścalī cāpi santoṣapradā na kalahā kvacit ।
itiduṣṭā'bhavaṃ vipra mattaḥ kṛtyā'pi saukhyadā ।। 38 ।।
upapatnyapi sukhadā nā'haṃ tathā vivāhitā ।
ityatiduḥkhito bhikṣurgato vanaṃ tu raivatam ।।39।।
ahaṃ kruddhā duḥkhadātrī tatrā'gacchaṃ vanasthale ।
śikhāyāṃ taṃ dṛḍhaṃ dhṛtvā''nītavatī gṛhaṃ nijam ।।1.424.40 ।।
kāmāturā kāmasvārthā pāśavīṃ ca kriyāṃ śritā ।
tadā'pi na dvijo māṃ vai hanti tāḍayati kvacit ।।41 ।।
atha kvacid dayāyuktā rodimi kalahottaram ।
ekadā tu mayā viprād yācitaṃ jalapānakam ।।42 ।।
paryaṃke divase vyarthaṃ śayānayā'tikruddhayā ।
tena dattaṃ jalaṃ. mahyaṃ karoṣṇaṃ gargarīsthitam ।।43 ।।
mṛtpātraṃ tu hyabhūd riktaṃ śītaṃ jalaṃ na vidyate ।
tadā tu kruddhayā dhṛtvotthāya mūśalameva ha ।।44।।
tāḍitaśca mahāśabdaḥ praśrutaḥ pārśvavāsibhiḥ ।
āgatāste'vadan vipraṃ niddṛkāsaya gṛhādimām ।।45।।
kuru tvanyāṃ supatnīṃ ca bhikṣo kṛtyāṃ parityaja ।
dāsyāmo dravyamevā'pi sukhī saṃbhava bhūsura ।।46।।
vipro'pi niścayaṃ kṛtvā pariṇetuṃ gato'nyataḥ ।
dvitīyāṃ kanyakāṃ pūrvaṃ tadarthaṃ vacane'rthitām ।।47।।
tato mayā viṣaṃ bhuktaṃ prāṇāṃstyaktāstadaiva tu ।
yamadūtaiḥ pāśabaddhā nītā yamālayaṃ prati ।।48।।
bahukaṣṭaṃ tāḍanena vāgbāṇenā'dhvani tadā ।
anubhūtaṃ mayā vahnivālukāgamanodbhavam ।।49।।
kṣuttṛṣāsahanaṃ dehatroṭanaṃ mūrchanādikam ।
evaṃ yamālayaṃ prāptā vadhyamānā punaḥ punaḥ ।।1.424.50।।
vilokya dharmarājo māṃ papraccha citraguptakam ।
asyāḥ pāpaṃ cāsti kīdṛk paśya karma śubhāśubham ।।51 ।।
karmaphalaṃ mahāduṣṭaṃ dṛśyate'syā vilokane ।
citraguptastadā śīghraṃ dṛṣṭvā karmā'tidāruṇam ।।।52।।
raṇḍe kṛtye mahāduṣṭe pāpe sambodhya cāha saḥ ।
pāpayā duṣṭayā'nayā naiva kiñcicchubhaṃ kṛtam ।।53।।
gālīdānaṃ tāḍanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ bhartari sarvadā ।
na tu miṣṭaṃ bhojitaṃ vai bhuṃjānayā'nayā kvacit ।।54।।
kākī bhavatu viṣṭhādā tena pāpena sā punaḥ ।
valgulī bhavatu svasyā viṣṭhādā'dhomukhī sadā ।।55।।
tāḍitastu patistena pāpena gardabhī tathā ।
pākabhāṇḍe bhojikā viṣṭhādā bhavatu sūkarī ।।56।।
sadā patyurdveṣakarī biḍālī cāstu vai tataḥ ।
ātmaghātaḥ kṛtastasmāt pretā'stu marubhūmigā ।।57।।
tataḥ piśācī bhūtvā ca bahupiśācakāminī ।
bhavatvataḥ paraṃ duṣṭā rākṣasī pāpakāriṇī ।।।58।।
evaṃ nyāyaṃ para śrutvā yamarājastu karmabhi ।
yojayitvā ca māṃ tattajjanma pradattavān muhuḥ ।।59।।
tatsarvaṃ pārayitvā'haṃ rākṣasī duḥkhitā'bhavam ।
nāsti me karmanistāro jāyate pāpakaṃ punaḥ ।।1.424.60 ।।
nityaṃ pāpena saṃliptā bhavāmi rākṣasī vane ।
bhakṣayāmi paśūn pakṣivaryāṃśca mānavān vane ।।6 1 ।।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi nānto'sti mama karmaṇām ।
iti śokānvitā kṣudhātṛṣābhyāṃ cātipīḍitā ।।6 2 ।।
vavalge'haṃ vaṇijaṃ vai taccharīre viveśa ha ।
tena saha samāyātā deśaṃ vai dakṣiṇaṃ śubham ।।63 ।।
vaṇik sa tu papau vāri kṛṣṇāveṇyostu saṃgame ।
saṃsthitastatra vai śrāntastāvad devāstaṭasthitāḥ ।।64।।
atāḍayan muhurmāṃ te dūraṃ cāhaṃ palāyitā ।
kṣuttṛḍyuktā mārgayāmi pātraṃ vaṇiksamaṃ punaḥ ।।65।।
tāvad dṛṣṭo'si puṣṭo'si kṣunnivṛttirbhavenmama ।
ityarthaṃ satvaraṃ dhartuṃ samāgatā'smi harṣitā ।।66 ।।
tāvat tvayā śrāvitaṃ vai harernāmātipāvanam ।
siñcitaṃ vāri tulasīdalayuktaṃ sutīrthakam ।।67।।
tvādṛśabhaktavaryasya darśanaṃ pāvanaṃ mama ।
tvatpādapadmarajasā pāvitā ca viśeṣataḥ ।।68।।
me'pi karmāṇi sarvāṇi manye'ntaṃ pragatāni vai ।
pāpaṃ sarvaṃ gataṃ nāśaṃ puṇyaṃ me vardhate'dhunā ।।6 9।।
śāntirme hṛdaye jātā tṛptiśca jalasecanāt ।
bhrāntiḥ sarvaḥ pramādaśca vahnirāntarajo gatāḥ ।।1.424.7 0 ।।
patiduḥkhapradaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthe'tra jaḍacetane ।
naṣṭaṃ manye tava yogāt kuru me mokṣaṇaṃ dvija ।।7 1 ।।
yā'haṃ sā'haṃ kiṃkarī vā cāṇḍālī śvapacī ca vā ।
duṣṭā raṇḍā nikṛṣṭā ca kṛpāpātraṃ tavāsmi vai । ।72।।
kṛpayā tīryate jantunā'tra pāpaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।
satāṃ kṛpā paraṃ puṇyaṃ tanmūlaṃ sarvasukṛtam ।।7 2 ।।
satāṃ kṛpāṃ vinā tvanyat sukṛtaṃ tattu duṣkṛtam ।
kṛpā puṇyaṃ kṛpā mokṣaḥ kṛpā svargaṃ sukhaṃ dhanam । ।74। ।
satāṃ kṛpā patisevā bahupuṇyena labhyate ।
yasyā nāsti kāntasevā santaḥ sevyāḥ sadā tayā । ।75।।
yasyāḥ sevā satāṃ nāsti tayā sarvaṃ vināśitam ।
svāmī sevyaḥ patiḥ sevyaḥ parameśvara eva saḥ ।।76 ।।
antataḥ prārthanīyaḥ kṣamāpanīyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
patireva paraṃbrahma śāśvataṃ puṇyameva saḥ । । 77।।
patiḥ prāṇapradaḥ putraprado lokapradaḥ sadā ।
svargadaḥ sukhadaścānandasya pradaḥ patirhariḥ ।।78 ।।
duḥkhaṃ harati nāryāśca svayaṃ sahate tatsthale ।
kaṣṭāni dehajātāni puṇyaṃ tvardhaṃ dadāti ca ।।79 ।।
svārjitaṃ ca dhanaṃ puṇyaṃ balaṃ bījaṃ dadāti ca ।
ko'nyastasmātparo bodhyaḥ saṃsāre parameśvaraḥ ।।1.424.8 0 ।।
patireva hi nārīṇāṃ paramaṃ daivataṃ tataḥ ।
patiḥ sevyaḥ patiḥ pūjyaḥ patiḥ prāpyastapo'dhikaiḥ । ।8 1 ।।
anyathā rākṣasībhāvo nārīṇāṃ syāditi sthitiḥ ।
ityuktvā''ha punaḥ kṛtyā yathoddhāro bhavenmama ।।82 ।।
avaśiṣṭaprapāpānāṃ vināśo'pi tathā bhavet ।
tathā brahman kuru mokṣaṃ kalyāṇaṃ te bhaviṣyati । ।8 3 ।।
anāthāyāḥ samuddhartuḥ samuddhāro bhaviṣyati ।
ityukto dharmadattaḥ sa dayāvān prahvamānasaḥ ।।84।।
provāca cintayitvā vai kalahāyai sukhapradam ।
śṛṇu ramye vratatīrthadānaiḥ pāpālayo bhavet ।।85।।।
prārabdhasya sañcitānāṃ sukṛtairvilayo bhavet ।
tvaṃ cā'si rākṣasī pretā dīnādau nā'dhikāriṇī ।।86 ।।
pretasya nā'dhikāro'sti tīrthadānavratādiṣu ।
naivā'nyai kṣīyate karma rakṣaḥpretatvasaṃpradam ।।87।।
kintu hareḥ pātivratyaparaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ।
kārtikasya janmato vai tadardhaṃ te dadāmyaham ।।88।।
hareḥ pātivratyapuṇyaṃ tvapātivratyapāpaham ।
ityuktvā jalamādāya dharmadattastu vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।89।।
tulasījalamiśraṃ tat tasyā upari cākṣipat ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya omiti bruvan ।।1.424.90।।
tāvat sā puṇyamādāya pretatvarahitā hyabhūt। ।
kanyā divyā dvādaśābdā sarvasaundaryaśobhitā ।।91 ।।
vahnivastrā candrasamā kāntyā śāntyā virājitā ।
bhūtvā nanāma vipraṃ ca samuvāca praharṣitā ।।92।।
tava viprakṛpāleśāt prasāditā ca saṃskṛtā ।
tāritā ca tvayā kleśādgacchāmi bhagavatpadam ।।।93।।
ityuktau jāyamānāyāṃ vimānaṃ divyamāgatam ।
pārṣadadvayasaṃrājatpārṣadāṇīgaṇānvitam ।। 94।।
pārṣadābhyāṃ samāhūtā kanyā''ruroha satvaram ।
dharmadattena tau kṛṣṇapārṣadau vanditau tadā ।।95।।
pṛṣṭhau kāviti pratyuktiṃ śreṣṭhastaṃ prajagāda ha ।
puṇyaśīlaḥ suśīlenānumataḥ prāgbhavādikam ।। 96।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭre bhikṣupatnyāḥ kalahāyā apātivratyapāpena valgulīgardabhīsūkarībiḍālīpretārākṣasītvaṃ dharmadattavipradvārā nāmajapatulasījalādinā ca pāpanāśe mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 424 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 424 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 425
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 426 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! puṇyaśīlo dvayorvṛttāntamāha yam ।
viṣṇupātivratyaparaṃ pārṣadatvapradaṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
vimānastho viṣṇusevāparaḥ pārṣadapuṃgavaḥ ।
puṇyaśīlo'smyahaṃ vipra! suśīlo'yaṃ dvitīyakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tvayā yuktaṃ kṛtaṃ vipra tāriteyaṃ supuṇyataḥ ।
asyā janmāntaraśatodbhayaṃ pāpaṃ layaṃ gatam ।। 3 ।।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ nīyate sā ca viṣṇudāsī bhaviṣyati ।
tvaṃ ca kārtikavratavān bhāryābhyāṃ saha bhūsura! ।। 4 ।।
kālāntare harerdhāma prayāsyasi supuṇyataḥ ।
harivrataṃ sadā bhaktakṛtaṃ pativratāvratam ।। 5 ।।
bhavatyeva na sandehaḥ puṇyadaṃ mokṣadaṃ vratam ।
bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi puṇyaṃ bhuktvā'tra bhūtale ।। 6 ।।
sūryavaṃśodbhavo rājā daśaratho bhaviṣyasi ।
bhāryābhyāṃ sahitaścaiva ye sto vivāhite tava ।। 7 ।।
iyaṃ tṛtīyā kalahā tava puṇyārdhabhāginī ।
patnī bhavitā ca tadā viṣṇuryāsyati te gṛham ।। 8 ।।
devakāryakaro bhūtvā prayāsyati svakaṃ padam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so'yaṃ rāmanāmā bhaviṣyati ।। 9 ।।
ye tu rāmasya śaraṇaṃ yāsyanti bhūtale janāḥ ।
te'pi muktiṃ prayāsyanti vāsudevapratāpataḥ ।। 1.425.10 ।।
bhāvanā prema bhaktiśca snehaścā''rdratvamityapi ।
viśiṣyate harau kriyātmakāt kāṇḍāditi sthitiḥ ।। 11 ।।
karmaṇo jñānamutkṛṣṭaṃ jñānād dhyānaṃ tathottamam ।
dhyānācca bhāvanā śreṣṭhā bhāvataḥ sneha uttamaḥ ।। 3 2।।
sakāmasnehataḥ śreṣṭho niṣkāmaḥ sneha eva yat ।
snehācchreṣṭhaḥ prahvībhāvastadrūpaṃ tadrasātmatā ।। 1 3।।।
na tato'dhikamevā'sti kiñcid vipra! harau sadā ।
śṛṇu tatra kathāṃ ramyāṃ dānād bhāvo viśiṣyate ।। 1 4।।
kāñcīpuryāṃ purā rājā colanāmā'bhavad vratī ।
vaiṣṇavo dānakṛd rakṣākaraḥ prajāsu vanditaḥ ।। 1 5।।
devapūjākaro nityaṃ yadrājye sukhinī prajā ।
tāmraparṇītaṭe yena yajñāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ ।। 1 6।।
vimānena sa nṛpatirlokāntaraṃ prayāti ca ।
evaṃ vimānamāruhya yayau śvetākhyadhāma saḥ ।। 1 7।।
tataḥ kṣīrābdhiśayanaṃ dhāma yogena saṃyayau ।
anantaśayanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tu nidritam ।। 18।।
cakāra daṇḍavattāvannārāyaṇaḥ samutthitaḥ ।
śrīpatiṃ pūjyāmāsa maṇiyuktāphalādibhiḥ ।। 1 9।।
supatraiśca suvarṇasya kusumairhīrakādibhiḥ ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyairvastrairvibhūṣaṇaistathā ।। 1.425.20 ।।
divyaiḥ ratnāyutaiścāpi pupūja parameśvaram ।
evaṃ sampūjya sannatvopaviṣṭaḥ sannidhau hareḥ ।।2 1 ।।
tāvattasyaiva rājyasya brāhmaṇo viṣṇudāyakaḥ ।
tulasīṃ ca jalaṃ puṣpaṃ nītvā pūjārthamāgataḥ। ।।22।।
tenāpi śrīhareḥ pūjā kṛtā patrādivastubhiḥ ।
hīrakādyāstayā channāḥ patrapuṣpādibhiḥ khalu ।।।23।।
ācchādināṃ svakṛtpūjāṃ vilokya nṛpatistadā ।
vipraṃ prāha kathaṃ svarṇamāṇikyādisuśobhitā ।।24।।
pūjā kṛtā mayā vipra tvayā vai chāditā dalaiḥ ।
gauravaṃ naiva jānāsi na jānāsi prapūjanam ।।25।।
mūlyaṃ nāpi gaṇayasi śraiṣṭhyaṃ karoṣyanuttamam ।
patrādikaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ tu karoṣi tūttamaṃ dvija ।।26 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa dvijastatra caulaṃ prāha subhāvavān ।
rājan viṣṇoḥ sadā pūjā bhāvanāsahitā priyā ।।27।।
garvayuktā'haṃkṛtisthā na priyā jāyate'nagha ।
tvayā tu kriyate pūjā ratnasvarṇādipuṣpakaiḥ ।।28।।
mayā'pi kriyate saiva tulasīdalavāribhiḥ ।
mama pūjā tava pūjā bhāvanāto viśiṣyate ।।29।।
vada rājan nṛpalakṣmyā tvayā kiṃkiṃ kṛtaṃ vratam ।
mayā kṛtaṃ na vai kiñcid vad tvaṃ cet kṛtaṃ mahat ।।1.425.3 0।।
tadā caulaḥ sagarvastu prāha vipraṃ kṛtaṃ tu yat ।
mayā kṛtaṃ svarṇadānaṃ ratnahīrakadānakam ।।3 1 ।।
godānāni hyanantāni yajñāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ ।
pūjane śrīharernityaṃ samarpayāmi hīrakān ।। 32।।
nirdhanasya tava bhaktyā mama bhaktirviśiṣyate ।
tvayā yajñaḥ kṛto naiva devālayo na vā kṛtaḥ ।।33 ।।
mayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ vipra paśya yajñāntaraṃ punaḥ ।
kariṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi sākṣātkāraṃ hareḥ purā ।।34।।
viprā jñāsyanti ye bhaktiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tadaiva nānyathā ।
pūrvaṃ sākṣātkaraṇārthaṃ viṣṇuyāgaṃ karomyaham ।।35।।
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā yayau caulapradeśakān ।
caulaḥ samārabhad yajñaṃ kṛtvā''cāryaṃ tu mudgalam ।।36 ।।
satyalokāttata ūrdhvād vairājā brahmacāriṇaḥ ।
munayaḥ ṛṣayo vṛddhāḥ pitaraśca surāstathā ।।37।।
yajñāśca devagandharvā mānavāścāpi bhūsurāḥ ।
nadā nadaśca tīrthāni taravo vallikāstathā ।।38।।
puryaḥ kṣetrāṇi caityāni pātālabhūgatāni ca ।
tārakāṇi prakṛṣṭāni vaiṣṇavā devatāstathā ।।39।।
devyaḥ sarvāḥ sarvadhāmanivāsā muktanāyakāḥ ।
ākāritā nṛpatinā vaiṣṇave svakṛte kratau ।।1.425.40।।
svarṇaṃ dravyaṃ hīrakādi sarvaṃ tatra samarpitam ।
vastrānnapeyabhogyāni samarpitāni sarvaśaḥ ।।41 ।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ vedasaṃghoṣā hyāsaṃstatra mahādhvare ।
viprāṇāṃ mūrtayastatra santuṣṭā hyabhavanmakhe ।।42।।
vahnayastṛptimāpannā muktā devāḥ pratoṣitāḥ ।
muditāścā'bhavan satyo devyo brahmāṇḍayoṣitaḥ ।।।43 ।।
kṛto yajño mahān sarvalokeṣu khyāta eva saḥ ।
kintu garvāt kṛto naiva niṣkāmabhāvataḥ kṛtaḥ ।।44।।
spardhayā yatkṛtaṃ cāpi matsareṇā'pyatherṣyayā ।
tatsarvaṃ na phalavat syād yathā niṣkāmajaṃ phalam ।।45।।
viṣṇudāso harerdevālaye cakāra sevanam ।
śarīreṇa ca bhāvena hareḥ saṃsnapanaṃ tathā ।।46।।
prabodhanaṃ pūjanaṃ ca śṛṃgāraṃ dhūpadīpanam ।
tulasīpatradānaṃ ca jalābhiṣekamarcanam ।।47।।
puṣpapatraphalārghyānāmarpaṇaṃ candanārpaṇam ।
akṣatakuṃkumadānaṃ śrīphalādyarpaṇaṃ tathā ।।48।।
nīrājanaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ stutiṃ daṇḍavadādikam ।
kṣamāyācanamevāpi kīrtanaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā ।।49।।
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ guṇapragānaṃ ca nivedanam ।
tāmbūlakaṃ jalaṃ sugandhivaddravyārpaṇaṃ tathā ।।1.425.50 ।।
vyajanena pavanasya dānaṃ cāmaradhāraṇam ।
chatrasandhāraṇaṃ cāpi yathartusevanādikam ।।51 ।।
puṣpavāṭīṃ tathā kṛtvā puṣpahārādikaṃ śubham ।
tulasīvāṭikāṃ kṛtvā haryarthaṃ jalasecanam ।।52।।
evaṃ snehena bhāvena divāniśaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ ।
pātivratyaparāṃ bhaktimakarod viṣṇudāsakaḥ ।।53।।
ekādaśyādidivasān japayuktān vratāni ca ।
saṃyamena mahābhaktyā kṛṣṇasaṃsmaraṇena ca ।।।54।।
pūjayā ṣoḍaśavastukṛtayā nṛtyagītibhiḥ ।
bhāvātisevayā sannirgamayatyeva sarvathā ।।55।।
paśyan śṛṇvan spṛśan jighran rasayan saṃvadannapi ।
gṛhṇan gacchan śayānaśca stavan dhyāyan viniścayan ।।56 ।।
cintayan mānayaँścāpyanubhavan bhāvayaँstathā ।
smaran saṃpratyabhijānan saṃśayāno viparyayan ।।57 ।।
tarkayan cetayan cecchan viṣṇumeva hi vartate ।
sarvatrātmakṛtāvāsaṃ vidan viṣṇumacintayat ।।58।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya oṃ namonamaḥ ।
evaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṇārṇaṃ gṛṇan viṣṇumayo hyabhūt। ।।59।।
brāhmaṇasya sadā sevāṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam ।
rājño yajñaṃ hutadravyaṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavān svayam ।।1.425.6 0।।
brāhmaṇasyā'bhavad dṛśyo rājñastvadṛśya īśvaraḥ ।
bhāvā'bhāvau tathā garvā'garvau tatra hi kāraṇe ।।6 1 ।।
ekadā viṣṇudāsena nityamiva mahānase ।
kṛto miṣṭānnapākaścā'hastvaṃ ko'pyalakṣitaḥ ।।62।।
pūjāvighnaṃ ca madhyāhne punaḥ pāke bhavediti ।
vicārya na punaḥ pākaḥ kṛto na bubhuje svayam ।।63 ।।
phalaṃ jalaṃ ca naivedye'rpitavān śārṅgiṇe hi saḥ ।
dvitīye'pi dine tadvat kṛtaṃ pākaṃ jahāra ha ।।64।।
tṛtīye'pi dine tadvat pākaṃ jahāra mādhavaḥ ।
evaṃ saptadinānyeva pākaṃ jahre'rpaṇaṃ vinā ।।65।।
cintāturo dvijastasthau rakṣārthaṃ pākasannidhau ।
pākaṃ kṛtvā gṛhakoṇe kāṣṭhapāṣāṇahastakaḥ ।।66।।
upoṣitaśca saptāhaṃ dadarśa pākahāriṇam ।
cāṇḍālaṃ malinaṃ kaṃcit kṣudhitaṃ śuṣkadehakam ।।67।।
dvijo dṛṣṭvā dayāyukto jātastasmin hariṃ smaran ।
uvāca tiṣṭha mā rūkṣaṃ bhuṃkṣva ghṛtaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ।।68।।
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ vipra dṛṣṭvā dudrāva bhītitaḥ ।
patito mūrchitastatra taṃ gatvā viṣṇudāsakaḥ ।।69।।
jalaṃ dadau pavanaṃ ca vastrāntena vyamūrchayat ।
tāvat sa utthito viṣṇuścaturbhujadharo'bhavat ।।1.425.70।।
sākṣāt śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ caturbhujaṃ harim ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakaustubhādivirājitam ।।71 ।।
pratyakṣaṃ śrīhariṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇudāso'tigadgadaḥ ।
babhūva premapūrṇaśca stotuṃ vaktuṃ na cā'śakat ।।72।।
atha yajñe sthitā devāḥ kratuṃ tyaktvā samāyayuḥ ।
caularājñā tu te pṛṣṭhāḥ kva gamyate sureśvaraiḥ ।।73 ।।
te prāhurviṣṇudāsāya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sākṣātkāraṃ darśanaṃ vai dadau tatra hi sannidhau ।।74।।
pragacchāmo darśanārthaṃ āyāsyāmaśca satvaram ।
ityuktvā te yayustatra yatra caturbhujo hariḥ ।।75।।
devāścakrustavaṃ tasya gandharvā'psaraso jaguḥ ।
nanṛturdevagandharvā āśiṣaḥ ṛṣayo daduḥ ।।76 ।।
gītavāditramodāḍhyaṃ sthānaṃ tattvabhavattadā ।
yajñāḥ sarvadevādyāścaturdaśabhuvāṃ janāḥ ।।77।।
sarve samāyayustatra tīrthādyā vahnayo'pi ca ।
yajñasthānaṃ tadā riktaṃ jātaṃ devairvinā kṣaṇam ।।78।।
devālayasya nikaṭe viṣṇuḥ prāheśvarādikān ।
bhaktyā ca sevayā snehabhāvayā premapūrayā ।।79।।
tuṣṭo'haṃ viṣṇudāsasyā'garvasya kiṃkarasya me ।
sākṣātkāro mama tasya śīghraṃ jāto'sti devatāḥ ।।1.425.80 ।।
nā'haṃ bahuvidhairdravyaiḥ sagarvasyā'ntikapragaḥ ।
sākṣātsvadarśanaprado bhavāmīti viniścayaḥ ।।81 ।।
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇurāśliṣya viṣṇudāsakam ।
samāropya vimāne sve nināya dhāma śāśvatam ।।82।।
caularājo dadarśainaṃ yāntaṃ śrīviṣṇumandiram ।
śīghraṃ tadā''hvayāñcakre guruṃ mudgarameva saḥ ।।83।।
jagāda ca muniṃ tatra yadarthaṃ yajñamārabhe ।
yatspardhayā sarvadravyaṃ yajñe mayā samarpitam ।।84।।
sa tu pūrvaṃ hariṃ prāpya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva ha ।
tvayā yajñaḥ karmakāṇḍātmako naiva hi pāryate ।।।85।।।
kartavyasya phalaṃ naiva mayā prāgatra cārjitam ।
tasmād dhanaṃ kraturdānaṃ sarvaṃ na toṣayeddharim ।।86।।
haristu bhāvabhaktyaiva bhajanena japena ca ।
smaraṇena prasannaḥ sa bhavatīti viniścitam ।।87।।
kuru yajñasyetibhāvaṃ gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇāṃ guro! ।
yāhi gṛhaṃ samāyātān prasthāpya dattadakṣiṇān ।।88।।
ahaṃ gacchāmi ca paścāt samārādhanahetave ।
bhaktyā tuṣyati bhakteśo na yajñairdānavistaraiḥ ।।89।।
prasādane harereṣo vipro jāto nidarśanam ।
ityuktvā rājyabhāraṃ ca bhāgineye visṛjya ca ।।1.425.90।।
yayau yajñaṃ hariṃ samārādhayituṃ janādhipaḥ ।
vahnikuṇḍāgrataḥ sthitvā dadau havanadravyakam ।।91 ।।
viṣṇo bhaktiṃ sadā dehi manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ ।
uccaistrivārametadvai samuccārya hariṃ smaran ।। 92।।
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ rājā vāhnikuṇḍe'patattadā ।
hāhākāro mahān jāto viṣṇuścāvirabhūttadā ।। 93 ।।
nṛpaṃ caturbhujaṃ kṛtvā samādāya vimānake ।
vaikuṇṭhamanayadbhūpaṃ pārṣadatvaṃ dadau hariḥ ।।94।।
pātivratyaparayā ca bhaktyā tuṣṭo hariḥ svayam ।
mayi tuṣṭo nṛpe tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।95।।
dharmadatta sa evā'haṃ viṣṇudāso'smi pārṣadaḥ ।
puṇyaśīlābhidhānaśca rājā suśīlanāmakaḥ ।।96।।
āvāṃ tvatrā''gatau netuṃ kalahāṃ rāmakāraṇāt ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tāṃ tava puṇyānnītvā te rājajanmani 97।
daśarathā'bhidhāne ca kalahā kaikayī tadā ।
bhaviṣyati tṛtīyā te patnī dharmāṃśabhāginī ।।98।।
rathacakranābhimadhye hastaṃ nikṣipya yāsyati ।
pātivratyaparāṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṃ tu mohaṃ gamiṣyasi ।।99।।
varadānāya sā coktā bhaviṣyatkālayogi tat ।
yathecchaṃ dānameveyaṃ nyāsavat kārayiṣyati ।।1.425.1 00 ।।
prāpte rāmasyā'bhiṣeke rākṣasānāṃ vināśane ।
preritā viṣṇunā rāme vanyatvamarthayiṣyati ।। 101 ।।
rāvaṇādivināśaśca sītāchāyāmiṣeṇa vai ।
bhaviṣyati tatastvaṃ ca punarvaikuṇṭhameṣyasi ।। 1 02।।
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bhāvivṛttāntavartanam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya vaikuṇṭhe gamanaṃ bhavet ।। 103 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! caularājye'bhiṣiktasya nṛpasya tu ।
paṭṭarājñyāśca nā'dyāpi putre rājyābhiṣecanam ।। 1 04।।
svasrīyasyeva tadrājye jāyate nvabhiṣecanam ।
kalau prajāyāḥ śāstau ca pradhānaḥ svasṛjo bhavet ।। 1 05।।
athāpi śṛṇu kalyāṇi! bhaktaścaulanṛpo yadā ।
svasyaiva hananaṃ cakre viprāstadā tu mudgalam ।। 1 06।।
jahasuśca tiraścakrurdhikkāraṃ ca dadustadā ।
asāmarthyaṃ jagaduśca rājahatyākaraṃ jaguḥ ।। 1 07।।
śrutvā śrutvā mudgaro'pi kraddhaḥ prajvalitāntaraḥ ।
yāvatpravartate kuṇḍe patirtu tāvadeva tu ।। 1 08।।
bhūsuraiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ samyag dhṛto nyāyena vāritaḥ ।
rājñyā tadyoṣitā cānyaiḥ ruddho balātprayatnakaiḥ ।। 1 09।।
tadā krodhena hastābhyāṃ svajaṭāmudapāṭayat ।
śikhāṃ jaṭāṃ samutpāṭyā''juhāva vahnimaṇḍale ।। 1.425.11 0।।
tena cādyāpi tadgotre viśikhāḥ santi bhūsurāḥ ।
atha te niṣkṛtiṃ cakruryayuḥ sarve nijālayam ।। 111 ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne harau pātivratyena colarājaviṣṇudāsayoḥ suśīlapuṇyaśīlanāmakaviṣṇupārṣadarūpatā, saurāṣṭrīyakalahāyāḥ kaikeyīrūpatā, dharmadattasya daśarathajanmādivṛtāntakathananāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।425।।
