adhyāyaḥ 431
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 432 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi śreṣṭhaṃ pativratāvṛṣam ।
patirnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇastadvrataṃ tat pativratam ।। 1 ।।
patyarthaṃ vṛtyate yāvad buddhisādhanakarmabhiḥ ।
patiryathā praśasyeta tathā patnyā vidhīyate ।। 2 ।।
aguṇo vā saguṇo vā durguṇo'pi praśaṃsyate ।
īśavat sarvathā nāryā gīyate jihvayā dhiyā ।। 3 ।।
tadvrataṃ prathamaṃ lakṣmi! pātivratyottamaṃ matam ।
praśaṃsā sarvathā sarvaprāṇināṃ śarkarāsamā ।। 4 ।।
atimiṣṭā miṣṭatamā sarvatrā'pyanubhūyate ।
putrapraśaṃsayā pramodate tatpitarau yathā ।। 5 ।।
pitṛpraśaṃsayā putrāḥ pramodante'tiharṣitāḥ ।
patnīpraśaṃsayā svāmī pramodate'ti cāntare ।। 6 ।।
śreṣṭhipraśaṃsayā bhṛtyo rājñaḥ praśaṃsayā prajāḥ ।
vṛṣapraśaṃsayā vṛṣavāhako'pi pramodate ।। 7 ।।
śiṣyapraśaṃsayā gururguroḥ praśaṃsayā'nugaḥ ।
deśapraśaṃsayā deśī śāstrapraśaṃsayā''stikaḥ ।। 8 ।।
yatprati yasya sadbhāvastatpraśaṃsā tu bhāvinaḥ ।
modapramodasaṃsthānaṃ samutsāhotsavāvahā ।। 9 ।।
bhavatyeva sadā lakṣmi! patikīrtisugarbhitā ।
videśasthasya kāntasya vārtā śrutvā pativratā ।। 1.431.1 0।।
putrotsavā'dhikā''nandavatī bhavati tatkṣaṇam ।
tadvrataṃ mānasagamyaṃ pātivratyaṃ mudāvaham ।। 11 ।।
hārdaṃ snehaṃ na cānye vai prajānanti parātmanaḥ ।
parātmano guṇā naiva sākṣād bhavanti sarvathā ।। 12।।
svātmamanaḥsaṃyogasya hetostatrā'nupasthiteḥ ।
āveśādikriyāyoge paramparābhiyogataḥ ।। 13।
pratyakṣamiva cānyeṣāmābhāsante na vāstavam ।
pātivratyaṃ sadā snigdhaṃ hyakāraṇaṃ sakāraṇam ।। 14।।
svārthaṃ yadvā parārthaṃ vā svārthamevā'nubhūyate ।
mama svāmī kathaṃ khyāto bhavedityāgrahaḥ striyāḥ ।। 15।।
pātivratyānvayitvaṃ vai satataṃ bodhyameva hi ।
patyuḥ kathāśrave yadvat te'sti pramoda āgrahaḥ ।। 16।।
tadvat kṛṣṇakathābodhe yasyā'styāgraha utkaṭaḥ ।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇe vāpi kīrtane ca praśaṃsane ।। 17।।
puṃso bhaktasya nāryāśca bhaktimatyāḥ sadā hareḥ ।
sataḥ satyāstato nityaṃ pātivratyaṃ prakāśate ।। 18।।
dāsyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pātivratyaṃ śubhaṃ prasannatāpradam ।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ pātivratyaṃ tato'dhikaṃ matam ।। 1 9।।
kathāyāḥ kīrtanaṃ pātivratyaṃ tato'pi cottamam ।
patyuḥ svasvāminaḥ kīrtergānaṃ nityaṃ hi durlabham ।।1.431.20।।
patyuśca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'bhedabhāvataḥ ।
sarvadā guṇagānaṃ tatpātivratyaṃ paraṃ striyāḥ ।।21 ।।
hareḥ kathātmakaṃ pātivratyaṃ satpatilokadam ।
śroturvakturna sandehaḥ santuṣṭo'haṃ janārdanaḥ ।।22।।
nayāmi taṃ mahatsvargaṃ satīlokaṃ satīṃ tathā ।
niṣkāmānāṃ ca maddhāma matpadaṃ preṣayāmi vai ।।23।।
matkathābhirhi lokānāṃ hṛdayeṣu nirantaram ।
madbhaktirnihitā yena lakṣāṇāṃ koṭidehinām ।।24।।
mama dāsyaṃ kathādvā'ṅkuritaṃ yena dehiṣu ।
mama vrataṃ mama sevā mama pūjā mamā'rhaṇam ।। 25।।
mama jāpo mama bhaktirmama smṛtirmamā''śrayaḥ ।
mamecchā mama vijñānaṃ mama dhyānaṃ mamehanam ।।26।।
mama yogo mama vāñcchā mamārpaṇaṃ mama grahaḥ ।
maddhāraṇā mayi nyāso mayi vāso mamārthanā ।।27।।
mayyabhedo mayi sneho mayi kāmo ratirmayi ।
mama sarvasvadānaṃ ca madarthaṃ jīvanaṃ mṛtiḥ ।।28।।
upārjanaṃ madarthaṃ ca madarthamupakāritā ।
paropakārādi dānaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ madarthakam ।।29।।
matpade gamanaṃ tvante matsevāgrahaṇaṃ sadā ।
kathābhiḥ kāritaṃ yena lokānāṃ hṛdayeṣu vai ।।1.431.3 0।।
tādṛśo me kathāvaktā śāstrajñānapradaśca me ।
manmahimnaḥ puṣṭikartā madbhaktipoṣakaśca yaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
tasya lakṣmi! pātivratyaṃ mayi koṭiguṇaṃ matam ।
śreṣṭhācchreṣṭhatamaṃ pātivratyaṃ vakturhi śāśvatam ।।32।।
kathāvācanapuṇyasya pāraṃ prāpnomi nā'pyaham ।
asaṃkhyajīvajātānāṃ kulānāṃ vaiṣṇavīdhiyā ।।3 3 ।।
uddhārako bhavatyeva kathāyā vācako guruḥ ।
matsyarūpo na sandehastvattaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa padmaje ।। 34।।
piturdaśaguṇī mātā māturdaśaguṇo guruḥ ।
pitā bījapradatvena jananī janmadatvataḥ ।।35।।
gururmokṣapradatvena śreṣṭhaḥ sarvebhya ucyate ।
patiḥ śreṣṭho guruḥ śreṣṭhastayoḥ śreṣṭhataro guruḥ ।।36।।
pitā patirguruḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamo guruḥ ।
ātmā śreṣṭho hariḥ śreṣṭhastayoḥ śreṣṭhatamo hariḥ ।।37।।
ātmā harirguruḥ śreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ śreṣṭhatamo guruḥ ।
yadāśrayāddhareḥ prāptiryaṃ vinā durlabho hariḥ ।।38।।
pṛthvīdātā vṛttidātā jīvadātā sadottamāḥ ।
teṣāmapekṣayā mokṣadātā jñānad uttamaḥ ।।39।।
kṛṣṇajñānaṃ pātivratyaṃ tatpradaḥ supatiḥ smṛtaḥ ।
kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ svāmidharmastatpradaḥ supatiḥ sadā ।।1.431.40।।
nāmadhāraḥ patistvanyo yathārtho bhaktidaḥ patiḥ ।
evaṃ jñātvā hareḥ pātivratyaṃ dhāryaṃ sadā priye ।।41 ।।
harerguṇānāṃ gānaṃ ca harermūrteśca cintanam ।
hareḥ kathāyā vyākhyānaṃ pātivratyaṃ taduttamam ।।42।।
yatra kathā tatra bhaktā devāstīrthāni cācyutaḥ ।
devyaḥ ṛṣayaḥ pitaro muktirbhaktirvṛṣādayaḥ ।।43।।
siddhā yatayaḥ satyaśca sādhavo yoginastathā ।
yugāḥ śāstrāṇi vedāśca kṣetrāṇi ca vanāni ca ।।44।।
vyāsāstattvāni muktāśca kathāpātrāṇi yāni ca ।
āgatya tāṃ kathāṃ bhāvaplutāḥ śṛṇvanti sarvadā ।।45।।।
kecinmūrtā amūrtāścā'dṛśyā dṛśyāstathā'pare ।
pātivratyaparāḥ sarve kathāṃ śṛṇvanti vai hareḥ ।।46।।
svasvayaśo hareḥ kīrtiṃ bhaktānāṃ ca kathānakam ।
śrutvā śrutvā pramodante dadatyāśiṣa eva te ।।47।।
vācakāya gurave te namaskurvanti vai tathā ।
śrotāraḥ śiṣyavargā vai namaskurvanti vācakam ।।48।।
tasmācchrāvayitā śreṣṭhaḥ sarvebhyo gurubhaktidaḥ ।
nārāyaṇasamo bodhyaḥ pātivratyasya bodhakaḥ ।।49।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā kathāṃ śrutvā hareḥ śubhām ।
sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti kṛṣṇapadaṃ param ।।1.431.50।।
purā godāvarītīre sampannaṃ sukathānakam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ pārāyaṇaṃ hyabhūt। ।।51 ।।
pāpaghnaṃ pāvanaṃ svargapradaṃ jñānadamokṣadam ।
durvāsaso muneḥ śiṣyo yatiḥ satyavratā'bhidhaḥ ।।52।।
brahmaniṣṭho nirapekṣo bhikṣāmātraprajīvanaḥ ।
guhāvāsakarastatrā'parigrahavratānvitaḥ ।।53।।
tulasīmālikāyuktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ japan ।
karotisma kathāṃ nityaṃ sāyaṃ pratidinaṃ priye! ।।54।।
dhyātvā smṛtvā smārayitvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ।
namaḥ kṛtvā kārayitvā kṛṣṇakathāṃ karoti saḥ ।।55।।
śrotṝṇāmapyabhāve ca vyākhyātṛṇāmanāgame ।
satyavratastu satataṃ karoti śrīhareḥ kathām ।।56।।
nityakarma svakaṃ kṛtvā karotyeva hareḥ kathām ।
śrotā cedasti yaḥ kaścit tasmai vyākhyātyaharniśam ।।।57।।
yadi nāsti sthale śrotā rikte'pi kurute kathām ।
anyo vyākhyāti kaścidvā hareḥ puṇyāṃ kathāṃ tadā ।।58।।
svakarmāṇi parityajya śṛṇoti śrīhareḥ kathām ।
hareḥ pātivratyaparaḥ kathāyāḥ śravaṇe rataḥ ।।59।।
tīrthāni devatānāṃ cā'gārāṇyapi vihāya saḥ ।
kathāvirodhakānyanyakarmāṇyapi vihāya saḥ ।।1.431.6 0।।
kathāṃ divyā saṃśṛṇoti sati vaktari- sarvadā ।
vaktaryasati svayaṃ ca vyākhyāti kṛṣṇasatkathām ।।6 1 ।।
kathāṃ vinā na jānāti pātivratyaṃ paraṃ vṛṣam ।
catvare ca gṛhe naije svayaṃ vyākhyāti bhāvataḥ ।।62।।
āvaśyakāni kāryāṇi kathāto nā'dhikāni vai ।
āvaśyakottamaṃ kārya kathārūpaṃ pradhānakam ।।63।।
kathāyā viratau cānyakāryaprādhānyameva ha ।
kathāṃ lakṣmi! śyāvatastu karmabandho na vidyate ।।64।।
jñānadīpaḥ pradīptaḥ syād viratiśca vivardhate ।
sattvaśuddhistathā śāntiḥ śṛṇvataḥ saṃpravartate ।।65।।
harau prītiḥ sadā śṛṇvatā kathāṃ dārḍhyamāpyate ।
kṛṣṇe prītyā mahāratyā kṛṣṇohṛdyavarudhyate ।।66।।
yeṣu kṛṣṇasteṣu cāsya sauhārdaṃ satsu jāyate ।
sādhurūpo haristvasya pratyakṣo bhavati dhruvam ।।67।।
tato divyaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ ।
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ jñātvā divyadarśanado bhavet ।।68।।
puṃsā nāryā tataḥ kṛṣṇakathā śravyā yathābalam ।
kathāṃ vinā na vai jñānaṃ tadvinā śāntireva na ।।69।।
duḥkhāvartte bhave tvasmin śāntikṛt kṛṣṇakīrtanam ।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasya smārakaṃ param ।।1.431.70।।
sattvaśuddhikaraṃ cāpi śuddhyā dhyānaṃ prajāyate ।
bahudhā śravaṇaṃ tasya mananaṃ dhyānamuttamam ।।71।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipatiprāptikaraṃ matam ।
yatra kṛṣṇakathā naiva yatra santi na sādhavaḥ ।।72।।
gaṃgātaṭamapi tyājyaṃ vinā patiṃ na tat priyam ।
yatra vai tulasī nāsti na yatra harimandiram ।।73।।
yatra hare pātivratyaparo bhakto na vartate ।
yatra viṣṇoḥ kathā nāsti grāmaḥ śmaśānasadṛśaḥ ।।74।।
tatra mṛto jano yāti yamarājatamaḥsthalīm ।
iti vicārya munirāṭ satyavrataḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।75।।
brahmavidyāparo viṣṇusmṛtimātraparāyaṇaḥ ।
hareḥ kathāparo nityaṃ manute cātmakarma tat ।।76।।
na kiñcidadhikaṃ jātu manute śravaṇātparam ।
kathāyāḥ kathanādvāpi paraṃ dharmo na tasya vai ।।77।।
nityaṃ sāyaṃ niścite vai samaye vyāsapaṭṭikām ।
samāgatya niyamena kathāṃ karoti yatra vai ।।78।।
ekadā tatra rājñaśca sainyaṃ vai pārśvato gatam ।
janāḥ sarve niruddhāśca vyāso'pi ruddha eva ha ।।79।।
mārge kenāpi naivātra gantavyaṃ sainyamadhyataḥ ।
iti mārge niruddhaḥ sa kathārodho'pi tena vai ।।1.431.80।।
devādyā ye śravaṇārthaṃṃ tvāyātāstatsthale ca te ।
pratīkṣante sma vaktuścāgamanaṃ taddiśādṛśaḥ ।।81।।
satyavrato na cāyāto vyatyeti samayastadā ।
satyavratasvarūpaṃ ca dhṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।82।।
svayaṃ kathāṃ śrāvayituṃ niṣasādā''sane tadā ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākathāmakaroddhariḥ ।।83।।
devāḥ śṛṇvanti bhāvena sainyaṃ krāntaṃ pathastadā ।
satyavrataḥ samāyāto dṛṣṭvā vyāsaṃ svarūpiṇam ।।84।।
mahadāścaryamāpanno vijñāya smarato harim ।
nanāmā'nyairyathā dṛśyo na bhaved viṣṇunā kṛtaḥ ।।85।।
āgatya tvāsane viṣṇormūrtau līno'bhavattadā ।
kathā vicchedarahitā yathā tatra pravartate ।।86।।
viṣṇunā sandhitastatra svasmin satyavrataḥ priyaḥ ।
kṛṣṇastvadṛśyatāṃ prāptaḥ kathā tadvatpravartate ।।87।।
satyavrataḥ samuvāca ślokaṃ viṣṇuvirāmitam ।
tāvatsvarasya śravaṇe mādhuryaṃ bhinnatāṃ gatam ।।88।।
ākarṣaṇaṃ divyatā ca pūrvato'nyavidhāṃ gatā ।
devādibhistadā jñātaṃ dhyānibhiryogavṛttibhiḥ ।।89।।
svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kathāṃ cakre satyavratā'nupasthitau ।
aho dhanyā vayaṃ kṛṣṇamukhātkathāśravaṃ gatāḥ ।।1.431.90।।
ityāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve śṛṇvanti ca kathāṃ punaḥ ।
tāvat tatra samāyātaḥ śiṣyo durvāsaso'paraḥ ।।91 ।।
tapovratākhyaḥ karmaṭhaḥ kathā'nādarakṛt sadā ।
kathāṃ mṛṣāṃ manyamānaḥ śrotṝn vaktṛँśca narmakṛt ।।92।।
prajahāsa kathāṃ śrutvā vitaṇḍāṃ pracakāra ha ।
jalpayitvā kathañcicca vyājahāra durāgrahī ।।93।।
vaktā pratārayatīmānime tu paśavo yathā ।
pratāraṇājālabaddhāḥ kathayā mṛṣayā muhuḥ ।।94।।
ityuktvā prayayau hitvā vācyamānāṃ kathāṃ tadā ।
na vyākhyāti svayaṃ kvāpi na śṛṇoti kadāpi ca ।।95।।
tapaḥ kāryaṃ paraṃ matvā gṛhakāryādikaṃ śubham ।
karotyeva sadā tadvai kathānindāṃ karoti vai ।।96।।
evaṃ tvāyuḥkṣaye prāpte nindāpāpena vai vane ।
piśāco'bhūcchamīvṛkṣe nirjale chinnakarṇakaḥ ।।97।।
nirāhāro mahāduḥkhī śuṣkakaṇṭhauṣṭhatālukaḥ ।
svakṛtaṃ cintayānaḥ sa mattonmatta ivā'bhramat ।।98।।
prāptaṃ jalaṃ vahnitulyaṃ phalapuṣpādikaṃ viṣam ।
vāyurvahnisamastvasya jāyate pāpakarmaṇaḥ ।।99।।
na nirvṛttiṃ na vā tṛptiṃ labhate karmaṭho vane ।
sādhuśūnye kathāśūnye'raṇye kṣudhā''kulo rudan ।। 1.431.1 00।।
satyavratena daivādvai dṛṣṭo mārgeṇa gacchatā ।
pṛṣṭhaḥ ko''sīdṛśīṃ kasmād daśāṃ prāpto'si me vada ।। 101 ।।
iti pṛṣṭhaśchinnakarṇastapovrata uvāca tam ।
durvāsasaḥ suśiṣyo'haṃ tapovratasunāmadhṛk ।। 1 02।।
kathānindotthapāpena piśāco'smi suduḥkhitaḥ ।
adya te darśanānmokṣo bhaviṣyati mamātra vai ।। 103 ।।
kṣamasva tvaṃ cāparādhān mama vaitaṇḍikādikān ।
ityuktvā sa rudan mokṣaṃ samicchan pṛthivīṃ spṛśan ।। 1 04।।
papāta pādayoḥ satyavratasya - trāhi māṃ gṛṇan ।
satyavrataḥ salilaṃ svakare dhṛtvā hariṃ smaran ।। 1 05।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
iti mantraṃ dadau karṇe jalaṃ cikṣepa mastake ।। 1 06।।
datvā pādaṃ tasya pṛṣṭhe pāpaṃ prajvālya śaktitaḥ ।
samarpyaikadivasīyakathāyāḥ puṇyamuttamam ।। 1 07।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitādhyāyasya kathodbhavam ।
jñānaṃ pradāya ca kṛtvā muktaṃ piśācadehataḥ ।। 1 08।।
divyadehadharaṃ kṛtvā sasmāra śrīhariṃ prabhum ।
tāvat kṛṣṇaḥ samāyāto rādhālakṣmīprabhānvitaḥ ।।1 09।।
pārvatīmāṇikīnāthaḥ padmāramājayāpatiḥ ।
lalitāśrīpatiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sapārṣadaḥ ।। 1.431.11 0।।
koṭisūryātisaṃśobhivimānavarasaṃsthitaḥ ।
satyavratena bhagavān nato'rcitaḥ stuto muhuḥ ।। 111 ।।
tapovrataṃ vimāne sve netuṃ samprārthito muhuḥ ।
prajahāsa haristatra bhaktecchāpūrakaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 11 2।।
prāha golokavāsārhaṃ puṇyaṃ vai nāsya vidyate ।
satyavratastadā prāha gurumantreṇa dīkṣitaḥ ।।1 13।।
vaiṣṇavo'sti mayā tvatra kṛto'yaṃ puṇyavān kṛtaḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitaikādhyāyasya sukṛtam ।। 1 14।।
dattamasmai mayā kṛṣṇa dadāmi tulasīsrajam ।
tava pādajalaṃ cāsmai punardadāmi keśava ।। 1 15।।
tava prasādaṃ naivedyaṃ dadāmyasmai kṣaṇena ca ।
tena puṇyena bhakto'yaṃ tavā'nugrahamātrataḥ ।।1 16।।
golokaṃ te yātu dhāma bhaktecchāpūrako bhavān ।
ityuktaḥ sa hariḥ satyavrataṃ tathā'stu cāha yat ।। 1 17।।
tapovrato muniṃ natvā vimānaṃ tvacyutājñayā ।
samāruroha prayayau golokaṃ viṣṇunā saha ।। 1 18।।
durvāsāśca tadā tatrā''jagāma divyadṛṣṭimān ।
praśaśaṃsa svakaṃ śiṣyaṃ satyavrataṃ kathākaram ।।1 1 9।।
satīrthyamokṣadaṃ śāntaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhavatārakam ।
punaḥ punastadovāca durvāsā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।।1.431.1 20।।
aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tāritaḥ karmaṭho'paraḥ ।
aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tāritaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ।। 121।।
aho hyekena śiṣyeṇa tārito'haṃ gurustathā ।
ayo hyekena śiṣyeṇa śiṣyavānasmi sāmpratam ।। 122।।
satsu daśasahasreṣu śiṣyeṣvapi suśiṣyavān ।
satyavratena jāto'smi kṛṣṇakathāprasevinā ।। 1 23।।
yatra kṛṣṇakathāpūrapravāho vahate sadā ।
tatra vāsakṛtāṃ muktirdāsīva karapātragā ।। 124।।
iti te śrāvito lakṣmi! kathāpativratāvṛṣaḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya kṛṣṇadhāmapadaṃ labhet ।। 125।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsasaḥ śiṣyasya pātivratyaparāyaṇasya satyavratanāmakasyaikadivasīyakathāpuṇyadānena tapovratasya piśācatvamokṣaṇaṃ dhāmaprāptiśca, satyavratasya kathākāle'nupasthitau bhagavān satyavratarūpadhṛk kathāmavācayadityādi-
nirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।43 1 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 431 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 432
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 433 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! pātivratyaparāyaṇām ।
divyāṃ camatkṛtiṃ vakṣye pāpatāpavināśinīm ।। 1 ।
pāñcāladeśe saurāṣṭre hemantākhyo'bhavannṛpaḥ ।
śaśāsa rājyaṃ dharmeṇa paścime puṇyalālasaḥ ।। 2 ।।
pūrvaṃ dānaṃ kṛtaṃ tena ratnānāṃ kanakasya ca ।
jalaṃ mūlyātmakaṃ nāsti jaladānaṃ tu nā'karot ।। 3 ।।
tena doṣeṇa rājño vai liptasya ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
sampaddhānirjāyate sma gajāśvā rogapīḍitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
gomahiṣyādi yacchreṣṭhaṃ naṣṭaṃ paśudhanaṃ hi tat ।
ajāvikaṃ samastaṃ ca vanyaṃ mṛgādikaṃ tathā ।। 5 ।।
rogaprapīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ vināśamagamacchanaiḥ ।
anāvṛṣṭirabhūttasya nirmānuṣyavidhāyinī ।। 6 ।।
deśaḥ śuṣkastato jātaḥ prajā deśāntaraṃ yayuḥ ।
rājyakośādikaṃ jātaṃ śūnyaṃ riktaṃ ca nirbalam ।। 7 ।।
jñātvā tvanye nṛpāḥ pañca militvā yānamācaran ।
taṃ jetuṃ sulabhaṃ matvā samājagmuḥ samantataḥ ।। 8 ।।
pāñcālarājaṃ yuddhena jigyurninyuśca sampadaḥ ।
hemantaḥ svapativratāpatnyā yuktastu raivate ।। 9 ।।
dhātrībhṛtyādisahito viveśa girigahvaram ।
māninyā bhāryayā yukto vanyairyātrāṃ carannṛpaḥ ।।1.432.1 0।।
cintayāmāsa bahudhā badarījambvaraṇyake ।
phalakandakṛtāhāraḥ kimetad dukhaḥmāgatam ।। 11 ।।
mayā dānaṃ pradattaṃ vai bahudhā pratiparvaṇi ।
mātṛpitṛhitaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtavānasmi sevakaḥ ।। 12।।
guravastoṣitā nityaṃ brāhmaṇāścāpi rakṣitāḥ ।
dharmaḥ surakṣitaḥ śaśvad devāścāpi prapūjitāḥ ।। 13।।
indriyāṇāṃ vaśe nāhaṃ nāhaṃ vyasanalampaṭaḥ ।
na cauryapāradāryādikartṛsaṃgī kadācana ।।14।।
tathāpi vai kathaṃ cedaṃ dāridryaṃ samupāgatam ।
parājayo mahān jāto viruddhā bāndhavādayaḥ ।। 15।।
ye'nukūlāstu te sarve'dhunā''ptāḥ pratikūlatām ।
kasya vā karmaṇaścedaṃ phalamāptaṃ mayā prabho ।। 16।।
evaṃ cintayatastasya raivatādrivane'niśam ।
yātrārthaṃ tvāgatastatra tadgururyājakābhidhaḥ ।। 17।।
prāptaśca satkṛto vanyaistṛpto nataśca pādayoḥ ।
papraccha duḥkhaprāpteḥ sa pāñcāleśastu kāraṇam ।। 18।।
dāridryaṃ kośanāśaśca śatrubhiḥ saṃparājayaḥ ।
rājyanāśo vane vāso bāndhavā vimukhāḥ katham ।। 19।।
mama deśe'pyanāvṛṣṭiḥ kathametad guro! vad ।
iti pṛṣṭo gururdhyātvā vijñāya pūrvajanmajam ।।1.432.20।।
karma tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tasmai cāha śṛṇu nṛpa! ।
purā'raṇyanivāsī tvaṃ vyādhaḥ prāṇivihiṃsakaḥ ।।21 ।।
niṣṭhuraścauryakuśalo dharmakarmavivarjitaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmno japakāryavirodhyapi ।।22।।
kṛṣṇasmaraṇahīnaśca praṇāmavarjitaḥ sadā ।
śastrajīvī mārgalabdhaprajāpīḍākaraḥ śaṭhaḥ ।।23।।
bālāpatyamṛgāṇāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ hatyākarasya te ।
apatyāni na jāyante jātasya garbhapātatā ।।24।।
viśvāsaghātakatvena bāndhavā naiva sodarāḥ ।
mārgapīḍākaratvena mitrasuhṛdvivarjitaḥ ।।।25।।
sādhūnāṃ ca tiraskārāt śatrubhiste parābhavaḥ ।
kadā'pyadattadoṣeṇa dāridryaṃ te hyupasthitam ।।26 ।।
pravāsināṃ kaṣṭadastvaṃ kaṣṭamudvejanaṃ tava ।
sarvāvamānakartā tvaṃ cāvamānaṃ gato mahat ।।27।।
jalādīnāmadānena vane tvaṃ jalapīḍitaḥ ।
nirāhāro bhavasyeva pūrvakarmavipākataḥ ।।28।।
atha rājaँtvayā'raṇye sukṛtaṃ rājyadaṃ kṛtam ।
śṛṇu kaścinmunistatra karṣaṇākhyaḥ samāgataḥ ।।29।।
brahmacaryavratī kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāyaṇaḥ ।
tadā tvaṃ dhanurādāya mārgaṃ ruddhvā puraḥ sthitaḥ ।।1.432.3 0 ।।
pṛṣṭavān ceddravyamasti dīyatāṃ me vanecara! ।
muniḥ prāhā'vyayaṃ dravyaṃ madagre vartate śaṭha! ।।3 1 ।।
yadīcchasi pradāsye'haṃ pātraṃ gṛhāṇa cedasi ।
śrutvā taṃ viḥsmitastatra kīdṛk pātraṃ dhanaṃ ca kim ।।।32।।।
vicāryaṃ proktavānenaṃ dehi cedasmi pātrakam ।
karṣaṇastasya vacasā tutoṣa prāha re śaṭha! ।।33 ।।
kati hatyā kṛtāścātra vada niṣkapaṭaṃ purā ।
vyādhaḥ prāha mayā'raṇye pāre sahasra ghātitāḥ ।।34।।
paśavaḥ. pakṣiṇaścānye svalpā vai mānavā api ।
karṣaṇaḥ prāha pāpī tvaṃ pāpakṣālanamicchasi ।।35।।
tadā pāpānyahaṃ te'tra kṣālayāmi yadīcchasi ।
vyādhaḥ prāha samicchāmi pāpānāṃ kṣālanaṃ mama ।।36।।
karṣaṇaḥ prāha prathamaṃ snātvā''yāhi madāntike ।
vyādhaḥ snātvā''yayau paścāt tulasīdalamiśratam ।।।37।।
kṛṣṇaprāsādikaṃ vāri tasmai pānārthamarpitam ।
apibat sa jalaṃ śiṣṭaṃ mastake dhṛtavāँstataḥ ।।38।।
guroścaraṇau prakṣālyā'pyapibat salilaṃ punaḥ ।
karṣaṇena tadā tasya karṇe dakṣe punaḥ punaḥ ।।39।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
vāratrayaṃ mahāmantraḥ śrāvitastāvadeva tu ।।1.432.40।।
taccharīrālomakūpebhyaśca pāpāni sarvaśaḥ ।
nirgatāni mūrtimanti hatyādīni sahasraśaḥ ।।41 ।।
rurudustāni sarvāṇi dīnāni vikṛtāni ca ।
bhayaṃkarāṇi sarvāṇi prāhustaṃ karṣaṇaṃ tadā ।।42।।
asmākaṃ ko'styaparādhaḥ kathaṃ ca muninā tvayā ।
niṣkāsitānyasya dehād dayāṃ kuru kṛpāṃ kuru ।।43 ।।
dehi vāsaṃ tvayi yadvā tasmin yadvā sthalāntare ।
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vanāntare ।।44।।
karṣaṇastu tadā prāha kṛṣṇanāmnā tvaghāni vai ।
prajvalantyājanmajāni yuṣmākaṃ tādṛśī gatim ।।45।।
kariṣyāmi kṣaṇenaiva tato dūraṃ pragacchata ।
na matsāmye sthitirvo'sti dūraṃ gacchata sarvathā ।।46 ।।
ityuktāni tu pāpāni mūrtimanti gatāni vai ।
dāmodarasya tīrthasya parvate saṃbhramanti hi ।।47।।
atha vyādhena vanyaiśca phalaiḥ saṃbhojito guruḥ ।
sarojalaṃ samānīya tṛṣā tasya nivāritā ।।48।।
sugandhīni supuṣpāṇi kundānyānīya yatnataḥ ।
mālādikaṃ racayitvā kaṇṭhe śirasi pūjitaḥ ।।49।।
pādāvanejanaṃ tasya dehāvamardanaṃ tathā ।
kṛtaṃ vyajanapavanaḥ śītalo vījitastadā ।।1.432.50।।
evaṃ sādhoḥ kṛtā pūjā karṣaṇarṣerhi bhāvataḥ ।
kṛṣṇapūjopahārāṇi samānītāni tena ca ।।51 ।।
prasādo bhakṣito vāri pītaṃ prāsādikaṃ tathā ।
evaṃ vyādhena bhaktena paricaryā kṛtā tadā ।।52।।
puṇyaṃ jātaṃ mahattatrāśīrvādā guruṇā'rpitāḥ ।
rājyavān dhanavān lakṣmīpūrito bhava pārthiva! ।।53।।
ityuktvā satkṛtiṃ labdhvā yayau tīrthāntaraṃ guruḥ ।
vyādho himaprabhāveṇa rātrāveva mṛtiṃ gataḥ ।।54।।
sa ca tvaṃ bhūriyaśasaḥ saurāṣṭranṛpatergṛhe ।
kumāro'si janiṃ prāptaḥ sādhusevā kṛtā tvayā ।।55।।
tena puṇyena rājā'bhūḥ puṇyaṃ sarvaṃ tu bhakṣitam ।
puṇyanāśaṃ vilokyaiva dāmodarasya sannidhau ।।56।।
raivatādrau tu te'ghāni yāni vidrāvitāni vai ।
tāni saṃpaśya sarvāṇi punastvāṃ vai vavalgire ।।17।।
teṣāṃ balena cedṛk te bhramaṇaṃ patanādikam ।
jātaṃ rājan yatastāni pāpāni prāgbhave tava ।।58।।
ṛṣiṇā dayayā naiva prajvālitāni sarvathā ।
sajīvanāni yātāni tāni punarvavalgire ।।।59।।
tasmāt kṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ।
harekṛṣṇa parabrahma vāsudeva ramāpate ।।1.432.60।।
śrīpate rādhikākānta kamaleśa prabhāpate ।
māṇikīśa jayālakṣmīpate śrīpārvatīpate ।।61 ।।
satāṃ pate kṛpāsindho bhaktapate sumuktide ।
sāvitrīśa tulasīṣṭa gaṃgāsarasvatīpate ।।62।।
yogipatipate siddhāsādhvīpativratāpate ।
antarātman mamā'ghāni prajvālaya vināśaya ।।63।।
dāso'haṃ kiṃkaraste'smi sevā'rhaṃ pāvanaṃ kuru ।
rakṣaya māṃ pādadāsye kaiṃkarye pātivratyake ।।64।।
ityarthanāṃ kuru bhūbhṛt sarvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
maṃgalānāṃ prade kṛṣṇe tuṣṭe sarvaṃ nirāmayam ।।65।।
ahaṃ vai yājakaste'smi gururyājakanāmataḥ ।
tava kalyāṇakṛccāsmi vada kiṃ karavāṇi te ।।66।।
yadīcchasi sukhaṃ rājyaṃ dhanadhānyādisampadaḥ ।
svargāpavargau yadi vā sāyujyaṃ vā hareḥ padam ।।67।।
kimicchasi vada rājan kṛtakṛtyo bhavā'tra me ।
śrutvā jagāda hemanto harṣavihvalamānasaḥ ।।68।।
rājyaṃ cecchāmi nirvighnaṃ śatrūṇāṃ garvabhañjakam ।
tataśca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya caraṇe sadā ।।69।।
pātivratyaparāṃ bhaktiṃ samicchāmi sadā dvija ।
śrutvā taṃ yājakastvāha yuktān dharmān nibodha me ।।1.432.70।।
dānena labhate rājyaṃ svargaṃ sampad dhanāni ca ।
sevayā labhate tvāyurbhāgyaṃ bhogyaṃ sutādikān ।।71।।
bhaktyā labhate govindacaraṇaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।
satsaṃgena mahāśāntiṃ sukhaṃ cānandaśevadhim ।।72।।
etaccatuṣṭayaṃ rājan yathāśakti samācara ।
gāṃ dehi pṛthivīṃ dehi svalpāmapi dvijāya vai ।।73।।
tena lakṣmīṃ ca pṛthivīṃ punaḥ prāpsyasi satvaram ।
śayyāchatrādikaṃ dehi rājyaṃ prāpsyasi vai punaḥ ।।74।।
svarṇaṃ raupyaṃ dhanaṃ dehi tena prāpsyasi sampadaḥ ।
nārāyaṇahrade snātvā dāmodaraṃ samarcaya ।।75।।
vāmanaste punarjayaṃ kārayiṣyatyasaṃśayam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtidānaṃ kuru gurau śubham ।।76।।
jaladānaṃ prapādānaṃ kuru cātra vanāntare ।
putrān prāpsyasi rājendra tvātmatulyaparākramān ।।77।।
yannāsti tattu saṃkalpād dehi jalasya sākṣitaḥ ।
paścātprāpte pradātavyaṃ kāryaṃ śāṭhyaṃ na karhicit ।।78।।
sevāṃ sādhujanānāṃ ca kuru prāpsyasi cāyuṣam ।
bhogyaṃ vastuprajātaṃ ca dārāḥ sutānavāpsyasi ।।79।।
pātivratyaṃ kuru kṛṣṇe satīvat sarvathā'nagha ।
sevanaṃ pūjanaṃ tasmai sunaivedyaṃ jalārpaṇam ।।1.432.80।।
yathartusnānaśṛṃgāraṃ samutsāhamahotsavam ।
vratamudyāpanaṃ cānyad yatkiñcicchakyameva tat ।।8 1 ।।
kuru dāsyaṃ ca kaiṃkaryaṃ dhyānaṃ ca bhajanaṃ japam ।
sarveṣāṃ sukhado bhūtvā prāpsyasi dhāma cākṣaram ।।82।।
rādhākṛṣṇaṃ ramākāntaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
śivāśivaṃ pārvatīśaṃ śrīpatiṃ kamalāpatim ।।83।।
māṇikīśaṃ prabhākāntaṃ jayeśaṃ lalitāpatim ।
padminīśaṃ ca padmeśaṃ durgeśaṃ tulasīpatim ।।84।।
devīpatiṃ hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svāminaṃ śrīnarāyaṇam ।
kambhareśaṃ rukmiṇīśaṃ parabrahmātmanāṃ patim ।।85।।
satāṃ patiṃ sarvanāthaṃ bhajā'ntaryāmiṇaṃ gurum ।
rādhādivat sadā pātivratyaṃ pālaya keśave ।।86।।
gṛhāṇemāṃ gale kaṇṭhīṃ tulasīmālikāṃ śubhām ।
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇakṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo'stu te ।।87।।
ityuccārya hariṃ natvā dhyātvā kāntaṃ manoharam ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।।88।।
evaṃ japaṃ kuru rājannaṣṭottaraśataṃ dine ।
tena muktiṃ paraprāptisvarūpāṃ tvaṃ labhiṣyasi ।।89।।
satāṃ divyajanānāṃ tvaṃ kuru saṃgaṃ supuṇyadam ।
sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca darśanaṃ kuru vai satām ।।1.432.90।।
sevāṃ pūjāṃ pādacaryāṃ kaiṃkaryaṃ dāsavat kuru ।
vaha teṣāṃ pādarajāṃsyapi svaśirasā sadā ।।91 ।।
caraṇāmṛtameteṣāṃ piba snāne niyojaya ।
satyaśca sādhavo rājannānakhādāśiro'vadhim ।।92।।
divyāḥ pavitrāḥ puṇyāśca bhāgatyāgavivarjitāḥ ।
tānprasevaya yadvat śrīṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca narāyaṇam ।।93।।
sadā niṣkāmabhāvena prasevaya śriyāḥ patim ।
tena te sakalā lokā bhaviṣyanti vaśānugāḥ ।।94।।
pratyakṣo bhavitā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastava gṛhe ।
pratyakṣā bhavitā lakṣmīstava sampadvivardhinī ।।95।।
taveyaṃ mahiṣī rājannityaṃ śrīpūjanaṃ prage ।
karotu śrīvṛkṣapatre kuṃkumena virājitām ।।96।।
rekhābhiḥ sudṛśyarūpāṃ caturbhujāṃ haripriyām ।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalapuṣpaphalādibhiḥ ।।97।।
pūjayatu snehabhaktyā prasannā sā bhaviṣyati ।
dāsyatyabhīṣṭamevā'syai pātivratyena sevayā ।।98।।
sarvaṃ te vāñchitaṃ hṛdyaṃ tūrṇaṃ prāptaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā yājakastasmai datvā śubhāśiṣastataḥ ।।99।।
yayau vanāntaraṃ lakṣmi! hemantaḥ snānamācarat ।
cakre dānaṃ pūjanādi sevāṃ raivatavāsinām ।। 1.432.10 0।।
yogināṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca satsaṃgaṃ cakāra ha ।
kathāṃ dāmodarakṛṣṇadevālaye'śṛṇot śubhām ।। 101 ।।
dhyānaṃ sumananaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya cākarot ।
śubhānyasya svāpnadarśanānyabhuvan niśāvyaye ।। 1 02।।।
hastimāruhya sacchatro yāti rājyaṃ suvardhitaḥ ।
vandito devalokasthaiḥ prajayā tvabhiveṣṭitaḥ ।। 1 03।।
apsarobhiḥ puṣpamālā''bhūṣaṇairabhivardhitaḥ ।
lakṣmyā''gatya kalaśādbhiḥ saṃsnāpitaśca so'bhavat ।। 1 04।।
gāyakairdevagandharvaigītaiḥ saṃśrāvitaḥ sa ca ।
guruvargaiśca mātṛbhistilakaiḥ sā'kṣatairyutaḥ ।। 1 05।।
lalāṭe śobhitaśchatracāmarādibhirarthitaḥ ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sa svapnaṃ mumoda prāha yoṣite ।। 1 06।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadṛṣṭyā rājyaṃ punarmiliṣyati ।
śubhaṃ śakunaṃ vijaye vilokya dhvajadarśanam ।। 1 07।।
yātrāṃ cakāra nagarīṃ rājyaṃ jigāya vai svakam ।
jigāyā'nyānmahāśatrūn kāṃścijjagrāha vai vaśān ।। 1 08।।
rājñāṃ kośagajā'śvāँśca svayaṃ jagrāha vīryavān ।
karadā bhagnasaṃkalpā bhūbhṛtaśca babhūvire ।। 1 09।।
ekacchatramabhūd rājyaṃ saurāṣṭraviṣayeṣu vai ।
putrastasyā'bhavad dhṛṣṭadyumnaścātipratāpavān ।। 1.432.11 0।।
hemanto bhaktasādhūnāṃ sevāṃ cakre dine dine ।
kathāṃ śuśrāva kṛṣṇasya nityaṃ rājyagṛhe mudā ।। 111 ।।
prajāśca vaiṣṇavī jātā pātivratyaparā hareḥ ।
yathā''tmani tathā kṛṣṇe bhaktiṃ pracakrire sadā ।।1 12।।
santuṣṭaśca svayaṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ।
akṣayāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ pratyakṣaḥ samajāyata ।। 11 3।।
lakṣmīyukto garuḍastho divyabhūṣādibhūṣitaḥ ।
nirīkṣya harṣāt pronmatto nanarta pulakāñcitaḥ ।। 1 14।।
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā prāñjaliḥ premapūritaḥ ।
jalaṃ pādāvavanijya dadhāra mukhamastake ।। 1 15।।
arcayāmāsa sadvastuṣoḍaśakena pārthivaḥ ।
vavande sarvadānena purāṇapuruṣaṃ harim ।। 1 16।।
vande dhṛtvā hṛdaye te padaṃ tīrthāspadaṃ prabho ।
yasya sādhoḥ prasaṃgena tārito'haṃ tvayā hare! ।। 1 17।।
sādhusevāratasyā'yaṃ saṃsāro goṣpadāyate ।
satsaṃgena hare kṛṣṇa tvayi jātā matirmama ।। 1 18।।
rājyanāśo'bhavanme te'nugraho yatphalaṃ bhavān ।
tathā sevāṃ smṛtiṃ dāsyaṃ pātivratyaṃ pradehi me ।। 11 9।।
manaste pādayorastu vacaste guṇakīrtane ।
netre ca darśane te stāṃ śrotre tava kathāśrave ।। 1.432.1 20।।
rasanā tvatprasāde'stu ghrāṇaṃ tvanmūrtisaurabhe ।
carmā'stu sparśane te'tra hastau mandiramārjane ।। 121 ।।
pādau tvatkṣetragamane cānye tvadarthayojite ।
mūrdhā te vandane cāstu kāmastvadarthameva ca ।। 1 22।।
buddhiste nirṇaye cāstu cittaṃ te cintane sadā ।
ahaṃbhāvo'stu kānte me cāyurme tvayi cārpitam ।। 1 23।।
santu dināni sādhūnāṃ sevāyāṃ premabhāvataḥ ।
satsaṃgaste satāṃ cāstu muktiste pādasevanam ।। 1 24।।
nā'nyāṃ śriyaṃ prakāṃkṣe'haṃ kvacicchrīpatimantarā ।
itistutaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmañjaleśvaraḥ ।। 1 25।।
hasan prāha varaṃ tasmai tvāyuṣyaṃ cāyutaṃ param ।
bhaktiṃ kṛtvā mama dāsyaṃ pātivratyaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 126।।
mama sāyujyameva tvamāpsyasi svakuṭumbayuk ।
tṛtīyāyāmakṣayāyāṃ tvamiva me prapūjanam ।। 1 27।।
kariṣyanti janāste'pi yāsyanti matpadaṃ dhruvam ।
snānaṃ dānaṃ mama pūjāṃ kariṣyanti tu yāḥ prajāḥ ।। 1 28।।
narānnārīrnayiṣye'haṃ tvakṣaraṃ mama dhāma vai ।
iti datvā varaṃ kṛṣṇastatraivā'ntaradhīyata ।। 1 29।।
rājā cakre satāṃ madhye vāsaṃ śuśrāva satkathām ।
pātivratyaparāṃ bhaktiṃ kṛṣṇasya svakuṭumbayuk ।। 1.432.13 0।।
bhuktvā rājyamayutānte yayau tvante hareḥ padam ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya yāsyanti śrīhareḥ padam ।। 131 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭre pañcāladeśīyahemantanṛpateḥ prākkṛtakarmabhiḥ rājyanāśādiḥ, gurūpadiṣṭaśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyadāsyadharmeṇa punā rājyaprāptiḥ, śrīharidarśanamokṣādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 432 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 432 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 433
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 434 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi! naranārāyaṇātprabhoḥ ।
urvaśī yā samutpannā pātivratyaprabhāvataḥ ।। 1 ।।
pūrvaṃ sā'bhūt śunī tataḥ pūrvatarā tu brāhmaṇī ।
duṣṭā kāśmīradeśīyā patidveṣakarī śaṭhā ।। 2 ।।
devavratasutā nāmnā mālinīti surūpiṇī ।
satyaśīlā'bhidhaviprapatnī patipriyā na vai । । 3 ।।
tayā saha patirdeśaṃ yāvanaṃ tu yayau kvacit ।
sā tu patyau krodhayuktā vaśīkaraṇalampaṭā ।। 4 ।।
yavanībhyastu bahvībhyaḥ papraccha vaśyabheṣajam ।
tābhistu darśitā dhūrtā kācidoṣadhakāriṇī ।। 5 ।।
dāsyati bheṣajaṃ yena bhavitā dāsavat patiḥ ।
brāhmaṇī cāpi dhūrtāyā gṛhaṃ yayau salālasā ।। 6 ।।
dṛṣṭavatī kuṭīṃ tasyāḥ khapparādisamanvitām ।
bahūnāmoṣadhānāṃ ca supātraiścullikādibhiḥ ।। 7 ।।
śobhitāṃ mantravidyānāṃ sādhanā''sanarājitām ।
yantrairmantrairbhasmagranthinīlavastraiḥ suśobhitām ।। 8 ।।
asthibhirvedikābhiśca yogasādhanagarbhitām ।
sajaṭābhiśca dīrghābhiḥ śiṣyābhiḥ śubhadīpitām ।। 9 ।।
dhūpakuṇḍayutāṃ vīkṣya kuṭīṃ sadaṇḍadhūrtikām ।
bahvībhirduḥkhitābhiścārādhitāṃ kāryalabdhaye ।। 1.433.1 0।।
bhasmāvaguṇṭhitāṃ dehe yogivat tilakānvitām ।
nanāma parayā bhaktyā brāhmaṇī śaṭhayoginīm ।। 1 1।।
duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa tataḥ sā śaṭhadhūrtikā ।
mayūrapatramārjanyā cakre tasyāḥ pramārjanam ।। 12।।
saṃskaraṇaṃ taccharīre phutkṛtena ca bhasmanā ।
candrakaṃ bhasmanā cakre bhāle kare jalaṃ dadau ।। 1 3।।
kṛṣṇaḍorakarudrākṣamālāṃ skandhe pradāya ca ।
śrāvayāmāsa viprāṇyai vaśyamantraṃ trivārakam ।। 14 ।।
namaḥ kāmākṣikādevyai patiṃ vaśaṃ kuru svāhā ।
iti mantraṃ dadau tasyai dadau dravyāṃgulīyakam ।। 15।।
raktaṃ māṇikyakhacitaṃ kānakaṃ vaśyakārakam ।
aurṇaṃ raktaṃ cāpi sūtraṃ bhujābandhanakaṃ dadau ।। 16।।
dadāvoṣadhamevāpi cūrṇaṃ rakṣānvitaṃ śubham ।
prāha caitanmahāvaśyakaraṃ cūrṇaṃ hi vartate ।। 17।।
asya prayogato vāyusadṛśā balino hyapi ।
vaśyā bhavanti satataṃ svāmino vānarā iva ।। 18।।
cūrṇaṃ bhartari bhojyādau bhoktavyaṃ svalpakaṃ sadā ।
rakṣāṃ ca dorakaṃ cāpi gale tvaṃ svīkuru dhruvam ।। 19।।
raktaṃ tu dorakaṃ tvaṃ svabhuje bandhaya bhāmini! ।
bhaviṣyati patirvaśyo mantraṃ svaśayane japa ।।1.433.20।।
mantritaṃ bhojanaṃ dehi mantritaṃ jalamityapi ।
mantritaṃ śayanaṃ dehi sarvaṃ dehi sumantritam ।।21 ।।
svalpakālena te svāmī tava vaśyo bhaviṣyati ।
yadi kiñcid bhavet kāryaṃ samāgaccha drutaṃ tu mām ।।22।।
ityuktā dakṣiṇāṃ datvā viprāṇī svagṛhaṃ yayau ।
oṣadhaṃ yojitaṃ dugdhe bhojane pataye'rpitam ।।23।।
mantritaṃ ca jalaṃ vastraṃ śayanaṃ svāmine dadau ।
evaṃ dine dine cūrṇaṃ dadau yathā yathā tathā ।।24।।
patiḥ śvāsena kāsena kaphena ca kṣayeṇa ca ।
pīḍito'bhavadatyantaṃ mūtrādāvuṣṇatā'dhikā ।।25।।
dehe praphullikā raktā prāvartantā'tikharjanāḥ ।
dinaiḥ katipayaiḥ svāmī parādhīna ivā'bhavat ।।26।।
aśakto rogaduḥkhī ca mṛtyuśaṃkāsamanvitaḥ ।
hatatejāstato bhartā viprāṇīṃ prāha vihvalaḥ ।।27।।
tavāsmi dāsavattvatra trāhi māṃ rakṣa śobhane ।
nānyāṃ vai kāmaye kāṃcinnārīṃ tvāmantarā priye।।28।।
vartiṣye'pi tavā''jñāyāṃ tava dāso'dhunā sadā ।
tava kārye prakartavye na kariṣye virodhanam ।।29।।
tataḥ sā kāminī patyurjīvane svārthaśālinī ।
sati patyau bhūṣaṇādi dhāryaṃ bhogyaṃ niḥsaṃśayam ।।1.433.3 0।।
iti tūrṇaṃ gatā śāṭhyayoginīṃ bhītavattadā ।
patirme vaśamāpannaḥ kintu dhruvaṃ mariṣyati ।।3 1 ।।
mama svārthavināśaḥ syāttasmājjīvaya taṃ śubhe ।
iti nyavedayatsarvaṃ dhūrtā vijñāya cāparam ।।32।।
dadāvoṣadhamevā'syai duḥkhadāhādināśakam ।
datte tu bheṣaje tasmin svastho'bhūt tatkṣaṇātpatiḥ ।।33 ।।
sā'bhūtprasannā tvatyarthaṃ vaśye'pi vartate patiḥ ।
anyeṣāṃ saṃgame tvasyai na ca vakti manāgapi ।।34।।
tiṣṭhatyupapatirgehe gṛhakāryāpadeśataḥ ।
bhartā naiva vadatyeva kiñcidapi kathañcana ।।35।।
atha sā brāhmaṇī duṣṭā patidveṣakarī śanaiḥ ।
rogavyāptā'bhavad dehe kṛmayaḥ saṃprajajñire ।।36 ।।
tena pañcatvamāpannā gatā narakayātanāḥ ।
pratapte tāmrakuṇḍe sā nikṣiptā bahuvatsaram ।।37।।
tataḥ śunī śatavāraṃ dadrurogaprapīḍitā ।
klināvayavā khañjā ca tāḍitā'pi gṛhe gṛhe ।।38।।
antime padmabandhvākhyadvijasya bhavane tu sā ।
jātā sauvīradeśe vai dāsyāḥ śunī surogiṇī ।।39।।
kṛmipūrṇā'vayavā sā dvijagṛhāṃgaṇe yadā ।
pādaprakṣālanaśilāmadhiruhya sthitā'bhavat ।।1.433.40।।
tadā daivād dvijaputraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaran ।
gāyatrīṃ prajapan kṛṣṇapūjāṃ kṛtvā kamaṇḍalau ।।41 ।।
prasādajaṃ jalaṃ viṣṇusnāpitaṃ tulasīyutam ।
nītvā gṛhe samāyātaḥ sopānairyāvadeva hi ।।42।।
gṛhāṃgaṇaṃ tūcchritaṃ vai pañcasopānamātrakam ।
samāruroha tāvattvantime sopānake padā ।।43।।
skhalitaḥ patito hastātkamaṇḍalurjalānvitaḥ ।
pārśve nimne śilābhāge sthitāyāṃ daivayogataḥ ।।44।।
kamaṇḍalujalaṃ śunyāṃ patitaṃ sarvameva yat ।
śunī snātavatī pītavatī bhāgyavaśāttadā ।।45।।
miṣṭaṃ prasādaṃ patitaṃ bhāgyād bhuktavatī tadā ।
tena puṇyena sā lakṣmi! dhvastapāpā babhūva ha ।।46।।
jātismarā janavācā samuvāca dvijaṃ kṣaṇāt ।
bho bhūdeva! mahāpāpāṃ trāhi māṃ trāhi māṃ dvija ।।47।।
ahamāsaṃ purā viprā patidveṣakarī sadā ।
patyurviṣapradātrī ca vaśyamantrakarī tathā ।।48।।
duḥkhadātrī mahāduṣṭā paraprasaṃgakāriṇī ।
tena pāpena tāmrāṇāṃ kuṇḍeṣu pātitā yamaiḥ ।।49।।
śatavāraṃ tu jātā'smi śunī dadrumayī dvija ।
antimo'yaṃ mama dehastvayā jalena saṃskṛtaḥ ।।1.433.50 ।।
daivājjātismarā jātā smaryate śatajanmajam ।
atiduḥkhaṃ mayā bhuktaṃ varṇane pāryate na vai ।।51 ।।
patidveṣakarī nārī pacyate taptatāmrake ।
durācārā taptasūrmyā''śliṣyate kāmibhistadā ।।52।।
bhartā nātho gururbhartā bhartā daivatamuttamam ।
tasya drohaṃ vidhāyaiva kathaṃ sā sukhinī bhavet ।।।53।।
tiryagyoniśataṃ yāti kṛmivyāptaṃ bhayaṃkaram ।
tasmānnāryā sadā kāryā bhartuḥ sevā vaco'nvitā ।।54।।
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ puṇyaṃ vai patisevanam ।
patyau hariḥ svayaṃ tvāste strīnistāraṇahetave ।।।55।।
khañjaḥ kāṇastathā vṛkṇaḥ kekarākṣo'ṣṭavakrakaḥ ।
kajjalasundaro dehe badhiro vāmanaḥ kṛśaḥ ।।56।।
rugṇaḥ kuṣṭhī vicittaśca krūraḥ kāmātivegavān ।
viṣayī vyasanī vāvadūko'nṛtaparo'pi vā ।।।57।।
patnyarthaṃ nirmitastādṛk kṛṣṇāṃśo brahmaṇā svayam ।
tenaiva patnyā uddhāro nānyena sūryavarcasā ।।58।।
yādṛśastādṛśo nīlaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kajjalarūpavān ।
kāmena kāryamāsādya sevanīyaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ ।।।59।।
patiḥ kāmena santṛpto ratidānena ced yadi ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāt tṛptastasyā iti vṛṣaḥ ।।1.433.60।।
evaṃ tasya sadā bhūtvā sevanīyaḥ striyā patiḥ ।
rugṇe sevā sukhe śāntā vipattau dhairyadā tathā ।।61 ।।
kṣudhite bhojyadā tṛṣṇe tṛptidā śayane priyā ।
kārye sahāyadā yāne sahagā bhavane satī ।।62।।
vyavahāre sakhī saṃrakṣaṇe māteva vartate ।
yā strī sā svargamayutaṃ bhuṃkte nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ।।63।।
yadyapyasminbhave nāsti surūpaścetpatistadā ।
patibhaktyā devatulyaṃ kartuṃ śaktā satī bhavet ।।64।।
kālī himagireḥ putrī gaurī sā tapasā hyabhūt ।
kubjā kṛṣṇaprasaṃgena rādhātulyā'bhavat purā ।।65 ।।
śabarī rāmayogena caturbhujā'bhavattathā ।
yavanī svāmiyogena muktā divyā'bhavatpurā ।।66।।
jaṭāyūḥ rāmayogena caturbhujo'bhavacchubhaḥ ।
gajagrāhau viṣṇuyogānmuktau divyau babhūvatuḥ ।।67।।
arundhatī śvapacī tu ṛṣipatnī gavāśrayāt ।
saramā devaśunikā muktā surabhisevanāt ।।68।।
vṛndā tulasī vṛkṣāśca kṛṣṇayogāt tadātmakāḥ ।
jaḍāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasambandhād bhavanti cetanā iva ।।6 9।।
sūtaḥ paurāṇiko divyo brahmapūjyo babhūva ha ।
indratiraskṛtaṃ puṣpaṃ lakṣmīnāśakaraṃ hyabhūt ।।1.433.70।।
punastadarpitaṃ tasya smṛddhidaṃ kṣīrasāgare ।
evaṃ vastu naro nārī yadyamanoharaṃ bhavet ।।71 ।।
tapasā ramaṇīyaṃ tajjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
durguṇaṃ sadguṇaṃ cāpi jāyate tapasā sadā ।।72।।
kubjā kubjo'thavā pālyā pālyaśca bhagavaddhiyā ।
sevanīyau svatapasā svāmibhaktyā satīdhiyā ।।73 ।।
evaṃ kṛtvā hariṃ matvā satīṃ matvā ca dampatī ।
seveyātāṃ sukhaprāptyā sahanaṃ ca kṣamāṃ gatau ।।74।।
mayā vipra! sevito na tiraskṛto vaśīkṛtaḥ ।
duḥkhitaḥ pīḍitastena duḥkhitā bhavasāgare ।।75।।
samuddharā'dhunā brahman kṛṣṇapūjāphalārpaṇaiḥ ।
anyathā me punarjanma duṣṭayoniṣu dṛśyate ।।76 ।।
ityuktaśca tadā vipraḥ karuṇāṃ pravidhāya ca ।
ekādaśyāḥ phalaṃ cāpi dvādaśyāḥ pūjanādikam ।।77।।
sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ dadāvasyai yadakṣayaphalaṃ matam ।
taptaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ yacca kṛtaṃ devārcanādikam ।।78 ।।
kṛṣṇapātivratyarūpaṃ sarvaṃ tvasyai dadau dvijaḥ ।
uvāca tāṃ mahāduṣṭe dayāpātraṃ na vidyase ।।79।।
patidveṣakarī sādhu dveṣiṇī devanindikā ।
kṛpāpātraṃ na vai proktaṃ tathāpi svāśritā yataḥ ।।1.433.80।।
kṛpā mayā kṛtā te'sti dīnā jñātvā tu kiṃkarīm ।
svapoṣyā ye hi vartante gṛhasthasya mahātmanaḥ ।।81 ।।
teṣāmuddharaṇaṃ kāryamiti kṛtvā samuddhṛtā ।
caṇḍālā vāyasāścāpi sārameyāśca kiṃkarāḥ ।।82।।
dāsā dāsyastathā bhṛtyā nakulāḥ śukasārikāḥ ।
śaśakā hariṇo haṃsā ye cānye balibhojinaḥ ।।83।।
gṛhasthānāṃ dayāpātraṃ hyanāthā bālabālikāḥ ।
adhavāstu striyastadvad rugṇā nirāśrayāḥ sadā ।।84।।
poṣyā bhavanti te sarve samuddhāryāḥ prayatnataḥ ।
gṛhastho noddharetpoṣyaṃ so'dhaḥpatenna saṃśayaḥ ।।85।।
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ patyurājñā patiḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī tadājñā poṣyarakṣaṇam ।।86।।
poṣyarakṣāṃ parityajya paraklṛptyāṃ pravartate ।
patidrogdhā bhavet so'tra kīnāśagṛhamṛcchati ।।87।।
paropakāro dharmo'sti vṛṣaḥ kiṃkaramokṣaṇam ।
mokṣadānaṃ mahaddānaṃ kṛṣṇaprāptiparāyaṇam ।।88।।
prasannatā harestatra jāyate svāminaḥ sadā ।
paro mokṣastasya samyagupādānaṃ pativratam ।।89।।
paropakāro mokṣo'tra jñāninā deya eva saḥ ।
bhaktimatā tathā deyaścānyasmai patyurājñayā ।।1.433.90।।
śaśī sūryo'tha pavano divā rātrirjalaṃ kṣitiḥ ।
candanaṃ pādapāḥ santaḥ paropakaraṇe sthitāḥ ।।91 ।।
dadhīcinā kṛtaṃ tvasthidānaṃ devebhya eva yat ।
śibinā tvarpitaṃ māṃsaṃ kapotāya svadehajam ।।।92।।
jīmūtavāhanenāpi rājñā pūrvaṃ dayālunā ।
garuḍāyā'rpitaṃ svasya jīvitaṃ cirajīvanam ।।93।।
dharmāṃgadena mohinyai vratārthaṃ tu śiro'rpitam ।
sṛṣṭyarthaṃ vedhasā dehāḥ punaḥ punaḥ samarpitāḥ ।।94।।
lokānāṃ mokṣaṇārthāya gaṃgādyāḥ sarito'bhavan ।
viṣṇuḥ śālagrāmaśilā śaṃkaro liṃgarūpakaḥ ।।।95।।
lakṣmīstu tulasīrūpā lokamokṣaṇahetave ।
kṛṣṇo gopālatāṃ prāptastathā matsyādirūpavān ।।96 ।।
paropakṛtaye sarvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ kṛtam ।
parjanyaścandramāḥ sūryaḥ samāḥ sarveṣu jantuṣu ।।97।।
tathā tvayā tu kiṃkaryā śunyāṃ puṇyaṃ dayālunā ।
samabhāvayujā dattaṃ nirdhūtā'khilakalmaṣā ।।98।।
jātedānīṃ guro santu tvādṛśā mokṣadā bhuvi ।
paropakāraśīlāśca sādhavo hi pativratāḥ ।।99।।
dehyājñāṃ me harerdhāma gantuṃ yāmi sukhālayam ।
ityukto brāhmaṇaḥ prāha tasyai mantraṃ harermuhuḥ ।। 1.433.1 00।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇoddhara kukkurīm ।
gaccha kṛṣṇasya golokaṃ śuni! puṇyavatī bhava ।। 101 ।।
evaṃ śrutvā tu sā pūrṇaṃ jātā divyā surūpiṇī ।
śvadehaṃ tu parityajya śubhā''dityasamā'bhavat ।। 102 ।।
tāvattatrāgataṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ sūryalaukikam ।
tatrārūḍhā dyotayantī vyomamaṇḍalamūrdhvataḥ ।। 103 ।।
divyā devyabhavaccandrānanā''bharaṇabhūṣitā ।
kalpaṃ vāsaṃ divi kṛtvā bhuktvā bhogān mahītale ।।1 04।।
naranārāyaṇāddevādurvaśīnāma nāmataḥ ।
varāṃganā samutpannā vaiṣṇavī devatāpriyā ।। 1 09।।
apsarodharmayuktā'pi sadā kṛṣṇapativratā ।
pātivratyaparā jātā''śritamokṣapradāyinī ।। 1 06।।
āmrapuṣpāṇi saṃgṛhya nareṇorau pramardane ।
udbhāvitā mahādivyā mahendrasainyamohinī ।।1 07।।
yadā''gato naranārāyaṇatapaḥsu vighnakṛt ।
indro nārāyaṇadeśādindrabhavanaṃ sā sthitā ।। 1 08।।
vaiṣṇavī sā mahābhāgyavatī tatra pravartate ।
nityaṃ sā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ prasevate ।। 1 09।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।
pātivratyaparaṃ sarvaṃ mokṣadaṃ tārakaṃ śubham ।। 1.433.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne patidveṣṭryāḥ kāśmīrīyabrāhmaṇyāḥ śatajanmaśunītvaṃ tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyapareṇa sauvīradeśīyavipreṇa śunyāḥ pramokṣaṇaṃ devītvaṃ, tato naranārāyaṇasyororurvaśītvamiti nirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।433।।

adhyāyaḥ 434
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 435 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
punarlakṣmyadbhutaṃ kiñcit prabravīmi niśāmaya ।
vasurvidhūmanāmā cā'tsarovaryā tvalambuṣā ।। 1 ।।
brahmaśāpātpurā prāptau pṛthivyāṃ vai manuṣyatām ।
śrīkṛṣṇapātivratyena brahmaśāpādvimocitau ।। 2 ।।
purā sudharmasaṃjñāyāṃ sabhāyāṃ satyalokagaḥ ।
brahmā samājaṃ mahatāṃ cakre viṣṇudinotsave ।। 3 ।।
tatra madhyāsane ramye niṣasāda caturbhujaḥ ।
sāvitryā ca sarasvatyā pārśvayoḥ saṃvirājitaḥ ।।4।।
gāyatryā ca caturvedairmohinyā cāpi śobhitaḥ ।
sanatsanandanasanātanasanakanāradaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
dakṣādyairvālakhilyaiśca dharmādyaiḥ pitṛbhistathā ।
meghairmunibhirdevībhiḥ sahitaḥ prapitāmahaḥ ।। 6 ।।
indrādibhirlokapālairdikpālairgrahatārakaiḥ ।
siddhibhiśca vasubhiśca nidhibhiḥ ṛṣibhistathā ।। 7 ।।
diśābhiḥ rudradevaiścā''dityaiḥ kāmasya maṇḍalaiḥ ।
manubhistithibhiścāpi kalābhiḥ sevitastathā ।। 8 ।।
tattvairnakṣatravaryaiśca surā'suragaṇairapi ।
guṇairmarudbhirvarṇaiśca bhogaistīrtheḥ susevitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
kāmābhirnāḍikābhiśca khanibhirvandito hyajaḥ ।
vāyavīyaiḥ pārthivaiśca pātālikaiśca dehibhiḥ ।। 1.434.1 0।।
vyomagairjalajaiścāpi vandito vai pitāmahaḥ ।
kinnaraiḥ kimpuruṣaiśca sādhyairgandharvabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 11 ।।
urvaśībhirmahānṛtyakalāvidbhiśca vanditaḥ ।
apsarasāṃ manohāri nṛtyaṃ vāditrasaṃyutam ।। 1 2।।
vīkṣamāṇaḥ svayaṃ brahmā rājate tatra saṃsadi ।
kramaśaśca suranāryo nanṛturnandayan sabhām ।। 13।।
vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgānāṃ dhvaniśca madhuro'bhavat ।
svarāśca vividhā miṣṭā niragacchan dyuyoṣitām ।। 14।।
alambuṣā madayantī nanartātīva sundaram ।
mukhyā'ṅgāni muhuścittā''karṣakāṇi samakṣipat ।। 15।।
mandaṃ mandaṃ smitaṃ tatrā'karot vyalokayanmuhuḥ ।
premanibhṛtanetrābhyāṃ kaṭākṣe cā'pyamocayat ।। 16।।
vyakampayat stanamātraṃ mandaṃ nitambamātrakam ।
kapolamātrakaṃ cāpi sakthimātrakameva ca ।। 17।।
evaṃ vai nartanaṃ tasyā vilokya tu muhurmuhuḥ ।
vidhūmākhyo vasustasyāṃ kāmanāvān mumoha tu ।। 18।।
darśayan kāmanāṃ tasyai prajahāsa punarmuhuḥ ।
netrābhyāṃ connimeṣābhyāṃ vāraṃvāraṃ prakāmanām ।। 1 9।।
pāriṣadeṣu paśyatsu darśayāmāsa vai vasuḥ ।
brahmā vijñāya cāñcalyaṃ vidhūmasya tu tatra vai ।।1.434.20।।
prāha vaso na te yuktaṃ cāñcalyaṃ nartanasthale ।
sabhāyāṃ naiva yogyaṃ tvaṃ kṛtavānasi sarvathā ।।21 ।।
nṛtyabhaṃgo raṃgabhaṃgo vikṣepo jāyate yataḥ ।
tena doṣeṇa gaccha tvaṃ mānuṣo bhava bhūtale ।।22।।
cañcalā manuṣāḥ pṛthvyāṃ pāśarajjuvivarjitāḥ ।
teṣu vāso'stu te martyaloke gaccha tataḥ param ।। 23।।
alambuṣā tu te bhāryā bhavitā gaccha mā ciram ।
ityājñapto vidhūmastu brahmaṇaścaraṇe'patat ।।24।।
prārthayacchāpanāśārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ svasya vai muhuḥ ।
tato brahmā''ha satyaṃ te sarvaṃ bhāvi na saṃśayaḥ ।।25।।।
tvaṃ kauśāmbīnagaryāṃ vai śatānīkasya bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
pativratāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ viṣṇumatyāṃ kumārakaḥ ।।26।।
bhūtvā rājā tato bhūtvā'lambuṣāyāṃ suputrakam ।
janayitvā ca taṃ rājye'bhiṣicya dakṣiṇodadheḥ ।।27।।
cakratīrthe patnīyuk tvaṃ snāsyasi tāvadeva tu ।
patnīyuk tvaṃ devarūpaḥ svaṃ lokaṃ pratipatsyase ।।28।।
ityukto vasurevā'yaṃ pṛthvyāṃ papāta satyataḥ ।
śatānīkagṛhe jātaḥ kumāro'tivicakṣaṇaḥ ।।।29।।
śāṇḍilyo nāma cakre'sya sahasrānīkamityamum ।
alambuṣā hyayodhyāyāṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ kṛtavarmaṇaḥ ।। 1.434.3 0।।
gṛhe mṛgāvatī kanyā jajñe devīguṇānvitā ।
janmataḥ sā vaiṣṇavī ca kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇā ।।3 1 ।।
yuvatyapi jñānavatī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
karoti śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmno japaṃ muhuḥ ।।।32।।
athendreṇa śatānīko daityairyoddhuṃ nimantritaḥ ।
divaṃgato mṛto yuddhe tatputrāya śavo'rpitaḥ ।। 33।।
sahasrānīka evā'sya śavasaṃskāramācarat ।
viṣṇumatī śavaṃ labdhvā vilalāpa jagāda ca ।।34।।
he nātha he prāṇanāthā''gaccha prāṇā'dhikapriya! ।
prāṇādhiṣṭhātṛdeveha prāṇā yānti tvayā vinā ।। 35।।
strīgarvaḥ patisaubhāgyād vardhate tu dine dine ।
sukhī ced vibhavo yasmāt taṃ saṃbhajeta dharmataḥ ।। 36।।
patirbandhuḥ kulastrīṇāmadhidevaḥ sadā gati ।
paraṃ sampatsvarūpaśca sukharūpaśca mūrtimān ।।37।।
dharmadaḥ sukhadaḥ śaśvatprītidaḥ śāntidaḥ sadā ।
sammānado mānadaśca mānyo vai mānakhaṇḍanaḥ ।।38।।
sārātsārataraḥ svāmī bandhūnāṃ bandhuvardhanaḥ ।
na vai bhartuḥ samo bandhuḥ sarvabandhuṣu dṛśyate ।।39।।
bharaṇādeva bhartā'yaṃ pālanātpatirucyate ।
śarīreśācca sa svāmī kāmadaḥ kānta eva saḥ ।।1.434.40।।
bandhuśca sukhabandhādvai prītidānāt priyaḥ paraḥ ।
aiśvaryadānādīśaśca prāṇeśātprāṇanāyakaḥ ।।41।।
ratidānātsa ramaṇaḥ priyo nāsti priyātparaḥ ।
putrastu svāminaḥ śukrājjāyate tena sa priyaḥ ।।42।।
śataputrātparaḥ svāmī kulajānāṃ priyaḥ sadā ।
asatkulaprasūtā vai kāntaṃ vijñātumakṣamā ।। 43।।
snānaṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dakṣiṇam ।
prādakṣiṇyaṃ pṛthivyāśca sarvāṇi ca tapāṃsi vai ।।44।।
sarvāṇyeva vratādīni mahādānāni yāni ca ।
upoṣaṇāni puṇyāni yānyanyāni ca sarvaśaḥ ।।45।।
gurusevāviprasevādevasevādikaṃ ca yat ।
svāminaḥ pādasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ।।46।।
guruvipreṣṭadeveṣu sarvebhyaśca patirguruḥ ।
vidyādātā yathā puṃsāṃ kulajānāṃ tathā priyaḥ ।।47।।
mama bhāgyaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ śiraśchatraṃ gataṃ mama ।
ityuktvā sā patiṃ dehaṃ tatra dadhyau subhaktitaḥ ।।48।।
satī pativratā bhāryā viṣṇumatī satītvataḥ ।
pādāṅguṣṭhāt samutpādya vahniṃ natvā mahājanān ।।49।।
tenaiva vahninā dagdhā sahaivānumamāra sā ।
putraḥ sahasrānīkastatpretakāryaṃ vyavartayat ।।1.434.50।।
rājyaṃ cakāra vidhivat sahasrānīkako vasuḥ ।
ekadendreṇa vai svarge nandanasya mahotsave ।।51।।
nimantritaḥ sahasrānīkaḥ kumāro yayau divam ।
tatrendrabhavane svasya vasutvaṃ cā'śṛṇot tathā ।।।52।।
alambuṣāyāḥ svapatnītvaṃ vasuścā'śṛṇot tataḥ ।
pṛthvyāmāgatya cāyodhyānṛpaputrīmalambuṣām ।।53।।
mṛgāvatīṃ pariṇīya mumude tu tayā saha ।
sā tasmād garbhamādhatta pīyūṣakṣālitā babhau ।।54।।
puṣpadolotsave rājñī rājā ca kuṃkumānvite ।
kesarādiyute rakte raṅgāḍhye salile hrade ।।55।।
sasnatustu pariśrāntau pārśve pārśve hi tasthatuḥ ।
raktavarṇau svarṇavarṇau sundarau cātirañjitau ।।56।।
rājā śrameṇa suṣvāpa kṣaṇanidrāṃ gatastadā ।
rājñī snānāya tu punaḥ pārśve raṅgasya kuṇḍake ।।57।।
jale snānasya tṛptyarthaṃ sukhāyā'vātarat satī ।
raktavarṇā raṃgajale snānaṃ sādaramātanot ।।58।।
tatastāṃ raṃgatoyārdrāṃ sañcāriṇīṃ jalāntare ।
matsyāṃ mahattamāṃ jñātvā''miṣabuddhyā tadāmbarāt ।।59।।
papāta vegataḥ kaścit suparṇakulasaṃbhavaḥ ।
mahāravikaṭaḥ pakṣī cañcvā dhṛtvā'mbaraṃ yayau ।।1.434.60।।
jñātveyaṃ mānuṣī kāciditi tāmudayācale ।
kandare saṃvihāyaiva gato'nyatra vihāyasā ।।61 ।।
sā tu ruroda bhītā vai muhuraśrūṇyavartayat ।
hā nātha mandabhāgyā'haṃ snānaṃ cakre patiṃ vinā ।।62।।
tena pāpena tūrṇaṃ vai tvadviyogena pīḍitā ।
kā gatiḥ kva nu gacchāmi drakṣyāmi tvanmukhaṃ kadā ।।63।।
ityuktvā gajasiṃhānāṃ puro'bhūnmṛtyukāṃkṣiṇī ।
sarvaiḥ krūraiḥ parityaktā tatra no nidhanaṃ gatā ।।64।।
āpatkāle na vai naṝṇāṃ maraṇaṃ maitryamicchati ।
rudatīṃ vanavṛkṣeṣu jamadagneḥ suputrakaḥ ।।65।।
kāruṇikastu tāṃ nītvā munaye tāṃ nyavedayat ।
muninā''śvāsitā rājñī poṣitā rakṣitā''śrame ।।66।।
suṣuve bālakaṃ kāle nāmnā hyudayanā'bhidham ।
vavṛdhe sa jamadagneḥ śiṣyo babhūva vedavit ।।67।।
ekadā vanavāsī vai vyādhaḥ kaścitsamāgataḥ ।
āśrame jamadagneśca peṭikāyāṃ bhujaṃgamam ।।68।।
dharan bhikṣārthamevāsau ramayāmāsa sarpakam ।
bhikṣāṃ datvā kaṃkaṇaṃ sā datvā sarpaṃ vyamocayat ।।69।।
rā×Vr̤M×jñyāstatkaṃkaṇaṃ vikretuṃ tu vyādho yayau nṛpam ।
sahasrānīkamevā'tha rājā svanāmakaṃkaṇam ।।1.434.70।।
dṛṣṭvā papraccha vṛttāntaṃ vyādhaḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat ।
vyādhāya tu dhanaṃ datvā yayau rājā tadāśramam ।।71 ।।
tapasyantaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā śirasā praṇanāma saḥ ।
āśīrvādena sa muniḥ pratijagrāha taṃ nṛpam ।।72।।
vidhivatpūjayāmāsa pādyārghyācamanīyakaiḥ ।
samuvāca mahīpālaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ ।।73।।
naranātha! mṛgāvatyāṃ jāto'yaṃ tanayastava ।
bhaviṣyati diśāṃ jetā nāmnā hyudayanaḥ kṛtaḥ ।।74।।
iyaṃ mṛgāvatī bhāryā pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktimatī bhāgavatī satī ।।75।।
sehe tvadarthaṃ duḥkhāni śuddhā sā reṇukā yathā ।
saputrāṃ tāṃ mahārāja! pratigṛhṇīṣva mā ciram ।।76।।
śrutvā rājā muniṃ natvā tāṃ gṛhītvā''rpayad dhanam ।
priyāsahāyo nṛpatirāyayau svapurīṃ prati ।।77।।
smaran śakrasya vacanaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma kutsayan ।
mahīmudayanāyaiva dadau putrāya dhīmate ।।78।।
mṛgāvatyā samaṃ rājā cakratīrthaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
udadhestu taṭe sthitvā snānaṃ cakre yathāvidhi ।।79।।
vanavṛkṣeṣu vāsaṃ ca vanyairnirvāhameva ca ।
cakre rājā vidhūmaḥ sahasrānīko munirbhavan ।।1.434.80।।
mṛgāvatī ca sā'raṇye patisevāparāyaṇā ।
ekabhuktā phalabhuktā nānyadbhaktā kadācana ।।81 ।।
patipādodakapānā nānyatpānā kadācana ।
patipārśve kṛtā''vāsā nānyadvāsā kathaṃcana ।।82।।
patipādodakasnānā nānyatsnānā kadācana ।
patirūpaharidhyānā nānyaddhyānā hi sā satī ।।83।।
patyaṃgamardanā sādhvī nānyasparśā pativratā ।
patikṛṣṇakṛtānandā nā'nyā''nandā bhramādapi ।।84।।
patipūjāparā nityaṃ svāmisevāparāyaṇā ।
svayaṃ vairāgyamāpannā patyarthaṃ maṃgalapriyā ।।85।।
matvā vedakṛtāṃ vāṇīṃ patyājñāṃ pārameśvarīm ।
vacovad vartate sādhvī hyapsaro nā'psaro yathā ।।86।।
cāñcalyaṃ mokṣaviṣayaṃ tadanyallīnatāṃ gatam ।
sakāmatvaṃ tu naiṣkāmye paryavartata mokṣakṛt ।।87।।
sadehatvaṃ videhatve rājñyāśca parivartitam ।
carmacakṣurdivyacakṣurbrahmarūpaṃ babhūva ha ।।88।।
viṣayāśca nirāhārā yātrāmātrā avikṛtāḥ ।
samabhavan mṛgāvatyāḥ patikṛṣṇasukhāvahāḥ ।।89।।
nityaṃ sā bhajate kṛṣṇaṃ yathā patiṃ tathā harim ।
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ kṛtvā patyau juhoti satkriyāḥ ।।1.434.90।।
karmakāṇḍaṃ japakāṇḍaṃ dhyānakāṇḍaṃ harau hi sā ।
dehakāṇḍaṃ cendriyāṇāṃ vṛttikāṇḍaṃ janārdane ।। 91 ।।
nārāyaṇe harau nityaṃ svāminyeva juhoti sā ।
evaṃ dhyātvā hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ prasevya ca ।।।92।।
cakratīrthe harestīrthe snātvā ca patitīrthake ।
patiṃ tu snānamātreṇa divyaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ tathā ।।।93।।
divyā bhūtvā śatacandrasamā rūpe manoharā ।
devayānena ca svargaṃ patiyuktā yayau hi sā ।।94।।
tatrā'yutasamāḥ sthitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।
svāminaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tvārādhya sarvadā ।।95।।
cakratīrthe tu ye tīrthayātrārthaṃ vai samāgatāḥ ।
narā nārījanā ye'pi bhagavadbhaktikarmakāḥ ।।96।।
tebhyaḥ sarvebhya eveyaṃ mahābhāgavatī satī ।
śuśrāva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।।97।।
kaṇṭharaveṇa ca tālīvādanena muhurmuhuḥ ।
atiharṣeṇa saṃyutā śrāvayāmāsa kīrtanam ।।98।।
evaṃ bhāgavatān kṛtvā janānasaṃkhyadehinaḥ ।
yayau sā patinā sārdha satyaṃ vai vedhasaḥ puram ।।99।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! divyākhyānaṃ supuṇyadam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya brahmalokaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1.434.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vidhūmavasoralambuṣā'psarasaśca brahmaṇo vacanāt pṛthivyāṃ sahasrānīkābhidhanṛpatvaṃ rājñīmṛgāvatītvaṃ ca, jamadagneḥ śiṣyatottaraṃ pātivratyena dharmeṇa punaḥ svargādiprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ।।434।।


← adhyāyaḥ 434 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 435
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 436 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tvaṃ manasā sārdhaṃ bravīmyatyadbhutāṃ kathām ।
ajñā api pramodante yāṃ śrutvā padmaje priye ।। 1 ।।
marubhūmau girau deśe purā vai gālavo muniḥ ।
parabrahma harikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaran sadā ।। 2 ।।
tapastepe girau svasyāśrame vṛkṣajalānvite ।
putrī tasyā'tisaubhāgyā nāmnā kāntimatī satī ।। 3 ।।
kṛṣṇapativratā bhaktā sādhvī pūtā'tivaiṣṇavī ।
tulasīmālikāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ kaṇṭhe dhārayati dhruvām ।। 4 ।।
kare ca mālikāṃ dhṛtvā kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti sarvadā ।
japaṃ karoti sā sādhvī rūpayauvanaśālinī ।। 5 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ hitvā patiṃ nānyaṃ hi vāñchati ।
patiṃ satyaṃ paraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ jñātvā kṛṣṇapativratā ।। 6 ।।
śayane bhojane yāne bhramaṇe cāśrame drume ।
pāne dehādikārye'pi na vismarati taṃ patim ।। 7 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇastāṃ rahasye vai pratyakṣo hyabhavat kvacit ।
athaikadā parīkṣāṃ vai kṛtavān bhagavān svayam ।। 8 ।।
yathā nityaṃ ca sā bālā vedisammārjanādikam ।
balyarthaṃ ca muneḥ puṣpāharaṇaṃ samidhāṃ tathā ।। 9 ।।
ānayanaṃ karotyeva tathā sā divase satī ।
pūjāyāṃ kṛṣṇabalyarthaṃ puṣpāṇyāhartumudyatā ।। 1.435.10 ।।
āśramasya samīpe sā puṣpastambake kanyakā ।
gatvā puṣpāṇi ramyāṇi samāhṛtya ca peṭake ।। 11 ।।
kṛtvā nivavṛte yāvat tāvattā puṣṭayauvanām ।
vyomayānena nirgacchan vidyādharakumārakaḥ ।। 1 2।।
sudarśanābhidho dṛṣṭvā kāmamohavaśaṃgataḥ ।
tayā riraṃsukāmaḥ sa vimānāgrādavātarat ।। 1 3।।
kanyāṃ prāha nijasnehaṃ darśayan snigdhayā girā ।
yadi kanye! parakīyā nāsi cet tvāṃ prakāmaye ।। 14।।
gāndharveṇa vidhinā'tra yadi yogyaṃ hi manyase ।
sukaṇṭhanāmadheyasya vidyādharasuto'smyaham ।। 15।।
sudarśanābhidhastvaṃ ca vada svasyā manogatam ।
parigṛhṇīṣva māṃ bhadre bhajamānamupasthitam ।। 16 ।।
tadā kāntimatī prāha kanyā'haṃ gālavasya vai ।
anūḍhā vaiṣṇavī śuddhā pitṛsevāparāyaṇā ।। 17।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntaśuśrūṣaṇaparāyaṇā ।
nānyaṃ patiṃ samicche'haṃ pitā kopaṃ vidhāsyati ।। 18।।
kusumānāṃ vilambena vidyādhra gaccha mā ciram ।
kanyā tu pituradhīnā na svatantrā kadācana ।। 1 9।।
nā'haṃ kāṃkṣe patiṃ cāpi viṣṇubhaktā tapasvinī ।
ityuktaḥ sa tu vidyādhro gatvā pārśve prakāmataḥ ।।1.435.20।।।
jagrāha tāṃ tu keśeṣu tāvad bālā samuccakaiḥ ।
cakranda sahasā vidyādharājjanaka trāhi mām ।।21 ।।
tāvadeva kṣaṇāttatra pārśvasthā gālavādayaḥ ।
śrutvā tūrṇaṃ samājagmurdadṛśustaṃ sudarśanam ।।22।।
sutāṃ tyaktvā bhayācchīghraṃ palāyamānaṃ cāmbare ।
gālavastāṃ śaśāpaivaṃ duṣṭastvaṃ mānuṣo bhava ।। 23।।
vyomamārgātpatatvatra dharṣaṇasya phalaṃ vraja ।
ciraṃ kālaṃ yāhi nindāṃ tato vetālatāṃ vraja ।।24।।
māṃsaśoṇitabhoktā tvaṃ bhava duḥkhī mahāvane ।
ityuktasya tadā tadvai vimānaṃ patitaṃ kṣitau ।।25।।।
vidyādhraḥ patitastasmād vimānaṃ tu divaṃ gatam ।
karmavaśād yamunāyāstaṭe ciranivāsinaḥ ।।26।।
govindasvāminaḥ patnyāṃ vidyādhro bālako'bhavat ।
vijayadattasaṃjñāṃ ca tasya cakre pitā dvijaḥ ।।27।।।
jātismaro hyabhūt so'pi pūrvakarma smaratyapi ।
yuvā putro'bhavad yāvad yātrārthaṃ kāśikāṃ purīm ।।28।।
saputrabhāryo govindasvāmī yayau śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
mārgā''gate prayāge ca kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tataśca saḥ ।।29।।
tatratyaṃ yoginaṃ kaṃcit kapālamālinaṃ śrutam ।
dṛṣṭvā śrutvā taduktaṃ yat putradhvaṃso'cirāttava ।।1.435.3 0।।
evamākarṇya govindasvāmī kāśīṃ prati drutam ।
yayau mārge hyakasmācca himavāyuḥ samutkaṭaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
vavau putraśca śaityenā''vṛto vahnirna cāpyate ।
grāmīṇāstu janāstatrā'ntike gaṃgātaṭe śavam ।।32।।
dagdhuṃ samāgatāstvanyamṛtasya grāmavāsinaḥ ।
tasya citāgninā śaityaṃ dūrīkartuṃ suto yayau ।।33।।
pārśve vijayadattaḥ sa sthitvā gṛhṇāti tāpakam ।
asminnavasare vaṃśaṃ gṛhītvā dāhakaḥ śavam ।।34।।
śirobhāgaṃ ca dāhārthaṃ vaṃśenā'gnau samākṣipat ।
tāvadvaṃśena tu dvedhā śirastat samabhūttataḥ ।।35।।
vahniyogena ca vegād raktaṃ vijayadāttike ।
mukhe cāgatya saṃlagnaṃ tāvadevātibhraṣṭatām ।।36।।
prāpto vijayadattaḥ sa vetālaḥ samajāyata ।
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro mahākāyo babhūvā'tibhayaṃkaraḥ ।।।37।।
śavavasāṃ lelihānaścāpibattatra tāṃ muhuḥ ।
tasyā'ṭṭahāsaghoṣeṇa vetālanartanena ca ।।38।।
diśaḥ pradiśo vidiśaḥ sphuṭitā hyabhavanniva ।
atha svapitaraṃ cānyān hantuṃ dadhāva cāmbarāt ।।39।।
bhītāḥ sarve śmaśānādvai palāyitāḥ samantataḥ ।
vetālaḥ sa śavaṃ jagdhvā babhūva balavāँstataḥ ।।1.435.40।।
śmāśānikaistu vetālairmilitvā vāsamācarat ।
vetālānāṃ kadācidvai gandharvaiḥ saha yodhanam ।।41 ।।
vindhyācale hyabhūd ghoraṃ tatrā'yaṃ jayamāptavān ।
vetālarājā sampanno rājyavān vindhyaparvate ।।42।।
atha vetālarūpaṃ taṃ tyaktvā putraṃ dvijastataḥ ।
pravavṛte sabhāryaśca jagāma kāśikāpurīm ।।43 ।।
tatrā'bhavatsutastasya dvitīyo vajravadvapuḥ ।
kāśyāṃ vāsaṃ saputraḥ saḥ cakre kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।।44।।
atrāntare narapatiṃ pratāpamukuṭābhidham ।
kāśideśābhidhaṃ mallaḥ kaścidabhyāyayau balī ।।45।।
kāśīrājopadeśena vajradeho dvijastu tam ।
mallayuddhe mahāmallamahanat prāṇatastadā ।।46।।
kāśīrājena viprāya grāmāḥ pañca samarpitāḥ ।
kadācit kāśikārājo dvijaputreṇa saṃyutaḥ ।।47।।
sandhyāyāṃ vijane deśe cacāra tāvadeva tu ।
saṃśuśrāva kaṣṭamayīṃ dīnāṃ vāṇīṃ tu dūrataḥ ।।48।।
aho kaṣṭamaho kaṣṭaṃ kāśīrājasya śāsane ।
svalpāparādhe śūle vai samāroṣo'tidāruṇaḥ ।।49।।
aho prāṇā na viyanti tṛṣā māṃ bādhate tvati ।
iti śrutvā kāśikeśastūrṇaṃ yayau sabhūsuraḥ ।।1.435.50।।
jalamādāya taṃ pātuṃ vajrāṃgo yāti yāvatā ।
tatra tasya gṛhapatnī sthitā dṛṣṭā dvijena vai ।।51 ।।
sāpi pativratā mṛtaṃ cānuyātuṃ tadā sthitā ।
prāhainaṃ ca jalaṃ dātuṃ hrasvā'haṃ pārayāmi na ।।52।।
vajrāṃgaśca dayāyuktastāṃ vadhūmabravīttadā ।
mātarmatskandhamāruhya dehyasmai śītalaṃ jalam ।।53।।
ityuktā sā tu vetālī vajrāṃgaskandhamāsthitā ।
jalaṃ gṛhītvā vetālaṃ śūlasthaṃ māyikākṛtim ।।54।।
mṛṣāśūlasthitaṃ patnī jalaṃ taṃ samapāyayat ।
athā'pṛcchad dvijaputraḥ kāsi ko'yaṃ ca te'sti vai ।।55।।
kathaṃ daṇḍaṃ samāpannaḥ satyaṃ brūhi śubhānane ।
vaitālī prāha me svāmī bhavatyayaṃ purā dvijaḥ ।।56।।
govindasvāminaḥ putro vijayadattasaṃjñakaḥ ।
tataḥ pūrvaṃ hyabhūccāyaṃ vidyādharaḥ sudarśanaḥ ।।57।।
gālavasya satīṃ putrīṃ tvadharṣayat kṣaṇaṃ vane ।
tāvad gālavamuninā śapto'yamīdṛśīṃ gatim ।।58।।
gato'sti tasya bhāryā'haṃ vaitālī nau samuddhara ।
uddhārārthaṃ kṛtaṃ tvetacchūlyādikaṃ mṛṣātmakam ।।59।।
jalaṃ prāptaṃ tava hastācchūlīmiṣeṇa pāvanam ।
tenā'yaṃ pāvito bhūtaḥ bhūtā'haṃ pāvitā tathā ।।1.435.6 0।।
kuru nau mokṣaṇaṃ vipra sarvadānaphalaṃ bhavet ।
rājasūye vājapeye gomedhe naramedhake ।।61 ।।
aśvamedhe lāṃgale ca viṣṇuyajñe yaśaḥkratau ।
dhanade bhūmide phalgau putreṣṭau gajamedhake ।।62।।
lohayajñe svarṇayajñe paṭalavyādhikhaṇḍane ।
śanuyajñe rudrayajñe śakrayajñe ca bandhake ।।63।।
iṣṭau varuṇayajñe ca kanduke vairimardane ।
śuciyāge dharmayāge recane pāpamocane ।।64।।
bandhane karmayoge ca maṇiyāge subhadrake ।
śyenayāge vājapeye sāvitre kamalakratau ।।69।।
japayajñe jñānayajñe kathāyajñe ca yatphalam ।
tatphalaṃ te dhruvaṃ bhāvi vaitālānāṃ vimokṣaṇāt ।।66।।
śrutvā dvijaḥ svarājānaṃ prāhaite pretarūpiṇaḥ ।
tava rājye kāśirājye vartante nṛpa dukhinaḥ ।।67।।
gaṃgātoyapradānena kartavyaṃ tadvimokṣaṇam ।
rājā prāha tava bhrātā vetālo'yamabhūt purā ।।68।।
tvayā jalaṃ pāyitaṃ ca pāpanāśo'sya vidyate ।
tasya mokṣakaraṃ tvanyatkartavyaṃ yadbhaveddhi tat ।।69।।
ityuktvā bhūpatistasmai pṛṣṭhavān śūlavartine ।
vad pramokṣaṇaṃ kena karmaṇā te bhavediha ।।1.435.70।।
pretaḥ prāha ṛṣeḥ śāpānmokṣaṇaṃ nānyato bhavet ।
ṛṣereva prasādena mokṣaṇaṃ me bhaviṣyati ।।71 ।।
kāśirājastathā govindasvāmī me pitā'nujaḥ ।
mātā ceti bhavanto vai gacchantu gālavaṃ munim ।।72।।
mama duḥkhasya nistārastaduktavidhinā bhavet ।
atha śrutvā tu te sarve gatā yatra sa gālavaḥ ।।73 ।।
kanyāyutaṃ muniṃ natvā vavandire punaḥ punaḥ ।
satkṛtā gāvalenātha procurvṛttāntameva tam ।।74।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha satī sādhvī kanyā me pārameśvarī ।
sarvasiddhimayī mahābhāgavatī ca vaiṣṇavī satī ।।75।।
śaraṇāgatajīvānāṃ rakṣayitrī dayāvatī ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktimatī tvaiśvaryaśālinī ।।76।।
divyā nārāyaṇalagnā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ।
brahmacaryavratayuktā kṛṣṇātmakapativratā ।।77।।
kṣaṇena dagdhuṃ śaktā sā pāpānāṃ meruśālinām ।
koṭivetālabhūtānāṃ muktiṃ dātuṃ tatheśvarī ।।78।।
anantabrahmaṇāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ prakṛtirīśvarī ।
vaiṣṇavī kamalāṃ'śā'sti prasādayantu tāṃ satīm ।।79।।
sā vai tuṣṭā mahālakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇakāntā sukāntinī ।
tārayiṣyati vetālān kṛṣṇamantrapradānataḥ ।।1.435.80।।
ityuktāste kāśirājādayaḥ sarve kumārikām ।
mātaraṃ jagatāṃ lakṣmīṃ kāntimatīṃ haripriyām ।।8 1 ।।
nemustuṣṭuvuḥ śaraṇaṃ nipetuśca vavandire ।
tebhyo vṛttāntamājñāya vetālamokṣaṇakṛte ।।82।।
kanyā kṛṣṇavratadharmān prāha sarvasukhapradān ।
sukha duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ harṣaṃ maṃgalamityapi ।।83 ।।
sampattiśca vipattiśca sarvaṃ bhavati karmabhiḥ ।
karmaṇā brahmaputrī ca vaṃśahīnaśca karmaṇā ।।84।।
karmaṇā rūpavāṃścaiva rogī śaśvatsvakarmaṇā ।
karmaṇā sūtaputraśca karmaṇā cirajīvinaḥ ।।85।।
karmaṇā guṇavantaśca karmaṇā tvaṃgahīnatā ।
karmaṇā bhūtavetālā devatāḥ karmaṇā narāḥ ।।86।।
kṛte śubhe śubhā lokā aśubhe nyakkṛtā janāḥ ।
śubhena tena saṃprāptaṃ vidyādharatvamityapi ।।87।।
aśubhatvaṃ ca tenaiva duṣṭabhāvakṛtena vai ।
satyāṃ pativratāyāṃ ca kanyāyāṃ śuddhayoṣiti ।।88।।
duṣṭacakṣuḥprayoktāro jātyandhāḥ saṃbhavanti vai ।
kuṣṭhāḥ kāṇāstathā khañjā vṛkṇāḥ kuṇṭhā bhavanti ca ।।89।।
duṣṭabhāvanayā duṣṭāḥ karmaphalaiśca duḥkhinaḥ ।
satībhāvanayā sattvaguṇinaḥ sukhabhāginaḥ ।।1.435.90।।
niyamānāṃ tu yo bhaṅgo dharmabhaṃgo hi niścitaḥ ।
aniyamena yātāro daṇḍyā rājño bhavanti vai ।।91 ।।
ta eva yamadaṇḍyāśca kṛṣṇadaṇḍyā bhavanti ca ।
sarvadaṇḍyāśca te loke nānyaḥ panthāstadanyakaḥ ।।92।।
patnīvrataṃ paro dharmaḥ sukhadaḥ śāntidaḥ sadā ।
śrīkṛṣṇena purā patnīvrataścotpādito dvijaḥ ।।93।।
tadvaṃśīyāḥ sarvaviprāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā ।
patnīvrataparāḥ sarve gṛhabrahmavratānvitāḥ ।।94।।
taranti tārayantyanyān niyamārpitavartanāḥ ।
dhātavo bhojanotpannā dehināṃ dehasaṃsthitāḥ ।।95।।
niyamitā brahmacaryaṃ dharmarūpāḥ sukhāvahāḥ ।
aniyame dharmalopo garbhavāsādiduḥkhadaḥ ।।96।।
ātmānandaṃ parityajya kharjanānandamāśritaḥ ।
bhuṃkte sa kharjanaṃ duḥkhaṃ brahmānandena vañcitaḥ ।।97।।
dadrucandre kharjanaṃ vai paścāttu jvalanaṃ sadā ।
anyāyakāmabhoge ca yāmye prajvalanaṃ dhruvam ।।98।।
tasmānniyamitaḥ kāmo vivāhena vimarśitaḥ ।
sparśo niyamitaścāpi dṛśyaṃ vācyaṃ niyāmitam ।।99।।
kasyāḥ kasya tu kiṃ bhogyaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvairniyāmitam ।
niyamo dharma evā'sti patnīvrataḥ sa yauvane ।। 1.435.1 00।।
pativrataśca tadvat saḥ sarvadā sukhadaḥ khalu ।
anena lopitaḥ so yat kanyāyā dharṣaṇaṃ kṛtam ।। 101 ।।
anicchantyā api sparśo vivartate'nalātmakaḥ ।
sa tu śānto bhavettasya kṛṣṇarpaṇena kalpita ।। 1 02।।
yūyaṃ cet tasya bhūtasya muktimicchatha satvaram ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ।। 1 03।।
iti mantraṃ gṛhītvā ca dhṛtvā tulasīmālikām ।
kṛṣṇapūjāprasādaṃ ca jalaṃ svannaṃ dalādikam ।। 1 04।।
matto nītvā tatra yāntu yatra vetālapuṃgavaḥ ।
taṃ ca vetālasāhasrayutaṃ nayata vāridhim ।। 1 05।।
dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre cakratīrthasya sannidhau ।
vetālamuktikṛttīrthe vetāloddhārakaṃ param ।। 1 06।।
snāpayadhvaṃ jale tatra vetālān vai sahasraśaḥ ।
tatastān vai mayoktaṃ ca mantraṃ saṃtriḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 1 07।।
prasādajaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ patraṃ samarpya bhojane ।
kurutaiṣāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca nānyaḥ panthāḥ sukhapradaḥ ।। 1 08।।
iti śrutvā tu te sarve kāntimatyāstadaiva hi ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ।। 1 09।।
iti mantraṃ gṛhītvā ca gṛhītvā'nnaṃ jalādikam ।
tayā dattaṃ dalaṃ cāpi nītvā stutvā yayuśca tam ।। 1.435.11 0।।
vetālaṃ prati gatvaite vetālāṃśca sahasraśaḥ ।
nītvā yayuścakratīrthād dakṣiṇe tūdadhestaṭe ।। 11 1।।
vetāloddhārake tīrthe snapayitvā ca tāstadā ।
jalamannaṃ kṛṣṇaprāsādikaṃ ca tulasīṃ daduḥ ।। 11 2।।
ghorāṃ vetālatāṃ tyaktvā divyarūpāṇyavāpya ca ।
prasādapuṇyato labdhvā caturbhujasvarūpatām ।। 11 3।।
vimāneṣu samārūḍhā vaiṣṇavāste sahasraśaḥ ।
viṣṇorvai pārṣadā bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayustu te ।। 1 14।।
evaṃ vetālajātīnāṃ kṛtvā mokṣaṃ nṛpādayaḥ ।
yayuḥ kāśīṃ yamīṃ cāpi yathāsthānaṃ tu te punaḥ ।। 11 5।।
ityetatkathitaṃ lakṣmi! sutāyā gālavasya vai ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyaiśvaryaṃ paraṃ mahat ।। 1 16।।
śrutvā smṛtvā paṭhitvā'pi pātivratyaphalaṃ labhet ।
patnīvrataphalaṃ labdhvā naro muktimavāpnuyāt ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gālavarṣikanyāyāḥ kṛtāvahelanena sudarśanavidyādharasya mānuṣajanmottaraṃ vetālatvaṃ kāśīrājadvārā gālava-
kanyāyāḥ kṛṣṇapātivratyabalena mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 435 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 435 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 436
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 437 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ tvayi lakṣmi! suvartate ।
tvaṃ yathā'si mama svāmivratā nānyāsti tādṛśī ।। 1 ।।
yā madvakṣaḥsthale nityaṃ vartase tvaṃ mama priyā ।
tvāṃ vinā tu mama mūrtirniḥśrīkā śuṣkakāṣṭhavat ।। 2 ।।
bhavatyeva na sandehastvayā ramyā prakāśate ।
pare'kṣare mama dhāmni pumuttamasya tatra me ।। 3 ।।
jayākhyā lalitākhyā tvaṃ vartase mama kāminī ।
goloke me kṛṣṇanāmno rādhā durgā sarasvatī ।। 4 ।।
gaṃgā padmā pañcarūpā tataḥ koṭisvarūpiṇī ।
vartase tvaṃ mama patnī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।। 5 ।।
vaikuṇṭhe me vartase tvaṃ nārāyaṇasya kāminī ।
lakṣmīrūpā mama sādhvī koṭisvarūpadhāriṇī ।। 6 ।।
amṛtākhye pade bhūmno nārāyaṇasya me priyā ।
caturvidhe ca vaikuṇṭhe mahālakṣmīstvamīśvarī ।। 7 ।।
sītā prabhā māṇikī tvaṃ pārvatī maṃgalā satī ।
vartase me pātivratyaparāyaṇā mahāsatī ।। 8 ।।
vahneḥ patnī mama svāhā vahnyātmake mayi sthitā ।
tvāṃ vinā bhojanaṃ naiva hutaṃ gṛhṇāmi vai kvacit ।। 9 ।।
devānāmapi tvaddhastātprāpyate hutamanvaham ।
pitaṇāṃ mama rūpāṇāṃ svadhā tvaṃ vartase satī ।।1.436.1 0।।
havye kavye tarpaṇe ca tvāṃ vinā nā''pyate'rpitam ।
yajñasya me sadā pātivratyadharmā'si dakṣiṇā ।।1 1 ।।
vinā tu dakṣiṇāṃ nā'haṃ pūrṇo bhavāmi vai kratuḥ ।
yajñe vinā dakṣiṇāṃ tu phalaṃ putro na janyate ।।1 2।।
phalaṃ vinā kṛtaṃ sarve śramamātraṃ vyayātmakam ।
mama kārtikarūpasya devasenā'bhidhānikā ।। 13 ।।
tvamevā'si mahālakṣmi! tvāṃ vinā vijayo na vai ।
tvaṃ sā mātṛsvarūpā'si ṣaṣṭhīdevī dayāvatī ।। 14।।
dhātrī tvaṃ bālakānāṃ tu rakṣiṇī ṣaṣṭhikā sadā ।
sā tvaṃ cāpatyadātrī cāpatyarakṣāvidhāyinī ।।15।।
apatyapuṣṭidātrī ca ratā vighnanivāraṇe ।
sā tvaṃ vai mānasī devī jaratkārvīsvarūpiṇī ।। 16।।
nāgamātā''stīkamātā viṣād rakṣākarī sadā ।
jaratkārusvarūpasya mama patnī pativratā ।। 17।।
manasā nāginī sarpajātīnāṃ parameśvarī ।
kanyā bhagavatī sā tvaṃ kaśyapasya hi mānasī ।। 18।।
triyugaṃ tu tapastaptvā kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ।
jaratkāruśarīraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śrīpuṣkare hariḥ ।। 1 9।।
gopīpatirahaṃ nāma jaratkārurdadhe tava ।
jaradgaurī viṣṇubhaktā pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।।1.436.20 ।।
jaratkārurjaradgaurī manasā siddhayoginī ।
vaiṣṇavī nāgabhaginī śaivī nāgeśvarī tathā ।।2 1 ।।
jaratkārupriyā''stīkamātā viṣaharīti ca ।
mahājñānayutā cāpi tvaṃ devī sarvapūjitā ।।22।।
tava nāmnāṃ pāṭhakasya nāgabhītirna vidyate ।
jaratkārumunīndrāya kaśyapastvāṃ dadau purā ।।23।।
ayācito muniśreṣṭho jagrāha brāhmaṇājñayā ।
kṛtvodvāhaṃ mahāyogī viśrāntastapasā ciram ।।24। ।
suṣvāpa devyā jaghane vaṭamūle tu puṣkare ।
jagāmā'staṃ dinakaraḥ sandhyākālaśca gacchati ।।।25।।
vinā sandhyāṃ mama patyurbrahmahatyāvalepanam ।
bhavedataḥ sudharmiṣṭhā bodhayāmāsa taṃ patim ।।26।।
kintu buddhvā'bhavad ruṣṭo jagāda kopagarbhitam ।
nidrābhaṃgo mama sādhvi! kathaṃ vada kṛtastvayā ।।27।।
vyarthaṃ vratādikaṃ tasyā yā bhartustvapakāriṇī ।
tapastvanaśanaṃ cāpi vyarthaṃ dānādikaṃ vratam ।।28।।
yayā patiḥ pūjitaśca śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pūjitastathā ।
pativratāvratārthaṃ ca patirūpī hariḥ svayam ।।29।।
sarvadānāni yajñāśca yāvattīrthāni dakṣiṇāḥ ।
tapāṃsi copavāsāśca vratāni devapūjanam ।।1.436.3 0 ।।
svāmisevākalāṃśasya na yānti samatāmapi ।
patisevāparā patnī vaikuṇṭhe svāminā saha ।।3 1 ।।
modate śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktiparāyaṇā ।
vipriyaṃ kurute bharturvipriyaṃ vadati priyam ।।32।।
kumbhīpākaṃ vrajetsā tu cāṇḍālī jāyate tataḥ ।
iti śrutvā satī patyuḥ pādayoḥ patitā''ha ca ।।33।।
sandhyālopabhayenaiva nidrālopaḥ kṛtastava ।
kuru kṣamāṃ priyā'jñāyāṃ duṣṭāyāṃ mayi suvrata ।।34।।
śṛṃgārā''hāranidrāṇāṃ yā tu bhaṃgaṃ karoti sā ।
pravrajet kālasūtrākhyaṃ nirayaṃ sevikā hyapi ।।39।।
ityuktvā pādayoḥ patyuḥ papāta tāvadeva tu ।
sūryaḥ svaṃ śaptumudyantaṃ jaratkāruṃ vilokya vai ।।36।।
sandhyayā saha bhagavān bhāskarastvājagāma ha ।
sūryaṃ dṛṣṭvā jaratkāruradhyakṣipat kathaṃ rave! ।।37।।
mama sandhyāṃ vinā deva cā'staṃ gantuṃ samicchasi ।
vinā sandhyāṃ mama nidrābhaṃgo jātaḥ prapaśyasi ।।38।।
sūryaḥ prāha śṛṇu vipra! nā'hamastaṃgatastadā ।
tava sandhyāṃ vinā cāhaṃ kathaṃ gacchāmi cāstatām ।।39।।
kṣamasva bhagavan brahman māṃ śaptuṃ nocitaṃ mune! ।
viprakrodhe jagannāśo vipre tuṣṭe jagat sthiram ।।1.436.40।।
brāhmaṇaḥ saḥ kṛṣṇabhakto bhāvayellokamaṃgalam ।
evaṃ śrutvā dvijaḥ śānto dadāvāśiṣameva ca ।।41 ।।
sūryo yayau nijasthāne jaratkārustataḥ param ।
patnīṃ tu bandhanaṃ matvā vṛddhasya taruṇī viṣam ।।42।।
vicārya manasāṃ bhāryāṃ tatyāja śokaduḥkhitām ।
sā sasmāra guruṃ śaṃbhumiṣṭadevaṃ hariṃ vidhim ।।43।।
kaśyapaṃ janmadātāraṃ samājagmustu te drutam ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa bhaktyā te tu samāyayuḥ ।।44।।
jaratkārustadā''ścaryaparo bhūtvā nanāma tān ।
kathamāgamanaṃ tvatretyevaṃ praśnaṃ cakāra saḥ ।।45।।
brahmā prāha mahāsarpa! neyaṃ sādhāraṇī priyā ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa śaktā sṛṣṭiṃ surakṣitum ।।46 ।।
iyaṃ cāsti mahālakṣmīkalā dharmaparāyaṇā ।
vṛthā sā kathayet tadvat tvayā kāryaṃ na cā'nyathā ।।47।।
na tyaktavyā dharmapatnī dharmiṣṭhā patidharmiṇī ।
asyāstyāge tava dharmalopaḥ śaśvadbhaviṣyati ।।48।।
tena tvaṃ narakaṃ gantā paralokaṃ vicāraya ।
kuruṣvā'syāṃ sutotpattiṃ dharmarakṣaṇahetave ।।49 ।।
yatirvā brahmacārī vā bhikṣurvanacaro'pi vā ।
jāyāyāṃ susutotpattiṃ kṛtvā paścād bhavenmuniḥ ।।1.436.50 ।।
akṛtvā tu sutotpattiṃ virāgī yastyajet priyām ।
sravet tapastatpuṇyaṃ ca cālinyāṃ tu yathā jalam ।।51 ।।
vṛkṣo'pi vallikāṃ stambe lagnāṃ dūrīkaroti na ।
nā''tmā buddhiṃ svīyapatnīṃ dūrīkaroti vai kvacit। ।।।52।।।
divā rātriṃ na tyajati śabdaḥ śakti kṣiṇoti na ।
bhāskaro dyāṃ na tyajati jaratkāruḥ kathaṃ priyām ।।53।।
ityuktaḥ sa jaratkārurjagrāha brahmaṇo vacaḥ ।
na tatyāja priyāṃ paścād devāste prayayurdivam ।।54।।
atha prāha jaratkārvī svapatiṃ jñānaśālinam ।
varaṃ tyāgo viṣayāṇāṃ dampatyorapi sarvathā ।।55।।
patyuḥ patnyā na vai ślāghyastyāgastayoḥ parasparam ।
yadi necched viṣayāँśca saha sthitvā sukhaṃ vaset ।।।56।।
svāminā yastiraskāraḥ patnyāḥ syānmaraṇāya saḥ ।
svāminā yā parityaktā mānahīnā tu sā bhuvi ।।।57।।
sarvatirakṛtipātrabhūtā sarvasaubhāgyavarjitā ।
bindukajjalakabarīyogyā'pi na bhavettataḥ ।।।58।।
tiraskṛtāyā nāryāstu jīvanaṃ vyarthameva yat ।
tasmānnātha jaratkāro! yadicchasi tapaḥ param ।।।59।।
tadā saṃkalpamātreṇa dehi me mānasaṃ sutam ।
tavā''jñayā sadā'haṃ ca tapaḥ karomi sannidhau ।।1.436.60 ।।
sevāṃ kariṣye kāntasya viṣayān parihāya ca ।
yadvā kāntā''jñayā yatra vāso me yogya iṣyate ।।6 1 ।।
tatra vasāmi kāntasyā''jñayā'raṇye'ntike'thavā ।
yatra vartāmi tatraiva tavaiva sattayā prabho ।।62।।
kāntasattāvihīnā na vastumicchāmi prāṇada ।
tvadīyā'haṃ na cānyasya tvāṃ vinā kva vasāmyaham ।।63।।
dūre tvāṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā vasiṣye parvate vane ।
nikaṭe tvāṃ hṛdi kroḍe kṛtvā sthāsye kṛpāṃ kuru ।।64।।
ityuktaḥ sa jaratkāruḥ śuddhāṃ patnīṃ vicārya ca ।
cakre tannābhisaṃsparśaṃ yogādvai putralabdhaye ।।65।।
muneḥ karasparśamātrāt sadyo garbho babhūva ha ।
patiḥ prāha manase! te śreṣṭhaḥ putro bhaviṣyati ।।66 ।।
jitendriyāṇāṃ pravaro dharmiṣṭho vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ ।
tejasvī ca tapasvī ca yaśasvī ca guṇānvitaḥ ।।67।।
varo vedavidāṃ cāpi yogināṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ।
viṣṇubhakto dhārmikaśca kuloddhārakaraḥ paraḥ ।।68।।
pativratā suśīlā tvaṃ supriyā priyavādinī ।
dharmiṣṭhā putramātā tvaṃ kulajā kulapālikā ।।69।।
bhava tādṛśaputrasya jananī lokapūjitā ।
kā mātā? kṛṣṇasambandhabodhinī, nā'parā, sati! ।।1.436.70 ।।
kaḥ putro? yo hariprāptisahāyo, nā'paraḥ, priye! ।
ko bandhuryo haribhaktiprado na ca paraḥ śubhe ।।71 ।।
yo bandhachit sa syāt pitā harervartmapradarśakaḥ ।
sā garbhadhāriṇī yā vai garbhavāsavimocinī ।।72।।।
kṛṣṇadhāmapradātā yaḥ sa gururviṣṇubhaktidaḥ ।
patiḥ sa yo muktipālaḥ kṛṣṇo vā vaiṣṇavo'thavā ।।73।।
sa eva tu guruḥ sādhvi! jñānadaḥ kṛṣṇa eva saḥ ।
jñānado mokṣadaḥ kṛṣṇamantradaśca patirguruḥ ।।74।।
dattaṃ jñānaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ tvayā datto vṛṣo mayi ।
jñānaṃ dharmaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya sevāto na viśiṣyate ।।75।।
jñānadaḥ satyadaḥ svāmī jñānādbandho viśīryate ।
bandhanāśāya kṛṣṇasya bhaktido jñānado guruḥ ।।76।।
sa patiḥ saḥ ṛtaḥ svāmī nāthaḥ kānto narāyaṇaḥ ।
sa ripuḥ śiṣyaghātī ca yo na bandhād vimocayet ।।77।।
jananīgarbhajāt kleśād yamatāḍanaduḥkhataḥ ।
na mocayed yaḥ sa kathaṃ guruḥ patiśca bāndhavaḥ ।।78।।
madājñayā bhaja sādhvi! śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vrataśālinī ।
parabrahmā'cyutaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sumokṣadam ।।79।।
mayā chalena tvaṃ tyaktā doṣo me kṣamyatāṃ priye ।
matto'pyadhikā dharme ca sauśīlye bhajane jape ।।1.436.80।।
jñāne bhaktau virāge ca vartase tvaṃ pativrate ।
tvayā me janmasāphalyaṃ mokṣo me karagastathā ।।81 ।।
triloke vijayaścāpi tvayā satyā mamā'sti yat ।
kariṣye puṣkare cāhaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam ।।82।।
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhoje dhṛtvā buddhīndriyādikam ।
dhananārīgṛheṣvāsthā pravṛttipathagāminām ।।83।।
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇe tvāsthā nivṛttinispṛhārthinām ।
vada devi! sahavāse kvacinme mānasaṃ calam ।।84।।
saṃkṣobhaṃ prāpsyate tasmād dampatyorekabhūtale ।
sadā''vāso bandhanaṃ syād viyogau guṇatāṃ vrajet ।।85।।
tasmād viyogo yogyo vai yadvai śreṣṭhaṃ tadācara ।
sahavāse dūravāse prasanno'smi sadā tvayi ।।86।।
ārye kuru yathā''tmanorbandhacchedaśca mokṣaṇam ।
jaratkāruvacaḥ śrutvā mānasī kamalākalā ।।87।।
yogyaṃ mene viyogaṃ vau saṃyogaṃ viṣabandhanam ।
api patnī sadā pārśve ṛtudharmaṃ samāśritā ।।88।।
patiṃ saṃyojayet kāme patirvā vegataḥ kvacit ।
tasmātjñānavatoścātra dampatyormokṣakāṃkṣiṇoḥ ।।89।।
jñātvā viyojanaṃ yuktaṃ bhayaṃ yatra na vidyate ।
pātivratyaṃ patyurājñā dūre vā nikaṭe'pi vā ।।1.436.90 ।।
patnīvrataṃ tu patyarthaṃ śreyaskāmaḥ sadā patiḥ ।
kāmo doṣo na vai śreyaḥprado bhavati nārakaḥ ।।91 ।।
tasmānmokṣecchukayordampatyorviyojanaṃ varam ।
mayā gantavyamevā'dya satīpārvatīsannidhau ।।92।।
kailāse kāntavacasā prāptavyo mokṣa eva hi ।
iti vicārya tu satī mānasī nāganandinī ।।93 ।।
śokā'śrunetrā vinayāduvāca prāṇavallabham ।
śreyo'rthaṃ vai tvayā nātha viyogo manyate sukhaḥ ।।94।।
yathā prasanno bhagavān taccikīrṣāmi nānyathā ।
gacchāmyahaṃ tu kailāsaṃ pārvatīcaraṇe'niśam ।।95।।
kariṣye bhajanaṃ tatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
yadā smarāmi bandho tvāṃ tadā māmāgamiṣyasi ।। 96।।
bandhubhedaḥ kleśataśca putrabhedastataḥ paraḥ ।
prāṇeśabhedaḥ prāṇānāṃ vicchedakastato'dhikaḥ ।।97।।
patiḥ pativratānāṃ tu śataputrādhikaḥ priyaḥ ।
sarvasmāttu priyaḥ strīṇāṃ priyastenocyate suraiḥ ।। 98।।
putre yathaikaputrāṇāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā harau ।
netre yathaikanetrāṇāṃ tṛṣitānāṃ yathā jale ।।99।।
yathā parasve caurāṇāṃ kāmukānāṃ yathā striyām ।
viduṣāṃ ca yathāśāstre vāṇijye vaṇijāṃ yathā ।। 1.436.10 0।।
tathā śaśvanmanaḥ kānte sādhvīnāṃ yoṣitāṃ prabho ।
kiṃ karomi yathā kāntaḥ prasanno vṛṣa eva me ।। 101 ।।
ityuktvā sājaratkārvī papāta svāminaḥ pade ।
uvāca māṃ tu kailāsaṃ samprāpaya kṛpānidhe ।। 1 02।।
śaṃkarāya ca pārvatyai nivedaya tapaḥ param ।
kāraṇaṃ yena niḥśaṃkā mānyā syāṃ tatra sādarā ।। 1 03।।
ityuktastu jaratkārustathāstvityabhidhāya tām ।
kṣaṇaṃ cakāra kroḍe tāṃ premṇā dadarśa tanmukham ।। 1 04।।
pasparśa pāṇinā kāntāṃ viyogāya kṛpānidhiḥ ।
netrodakena manasāṃ snapayāmāsa tāṃ satīm ।। 1 05।।
sā'śrubhiśca muneḥ kroḍaṃ siṣedha bhedakātarā ।
tato jñānena tau dvau ca viśokau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ।। 1 06।।
jagmatustau tu kailāsaṃ nematuḥ pārvatīṃ śivam ।
jaratkāruḥ svavṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa śaṃbhave ।। 1 07।।
śaṃbhuścāpi prasanno'bhūt pārvatī ca tato'dhikā ।
viyogaduḥkhaṃ naivā'sti yogināmīdṛśī gatiḥ ।। 1 08।।
śaṃbhuṃ ca pārvatīṃ datvā jaratkārvīṃ svayoṣitam ।
jagāma tapase vipraḥ puṣkaraṃ tvarbudācale ।। 1 09।।
mānasī tu guruṃ śaṃbhuṃ gurvīṃ prāpya ca pārvatīm ।
mumude tapasā nityaṃ vavṛdhe mandire guroḥ ।। 1.436.11 0।।
atha kāle gate sādhvī suṣuve bālakaṃ śubham ।
nārāyaṇāṃśaṃ ca mahājñānināṃ yogināṃ gurum ।। 111 ।।
saṃskārān kārayāmāsa śaṃkaro'sya tataḥ param ।
vedādīn pāṭhayāmāsa jñāna brahmaparaṃ tathā ।। 11 2।।
bhaktirāste svakānte cā'bhīṣṭe deve harau gurau ।
yasyāstena ca tatputraḥ śrīhareṇā''stikaḥ kṛtaḥ ।। 11 3।।
tadā smṛto jaratkāruḥ putradarśanahetave ।
samāgatya sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāśīrbhiḥ saṃprayujya ca ।। 1 14।।
śaṃbhuṃ natvā priyāṃ datvā mānasaṃ puṣkaraṃ yayau ।
āstiko'pi yayau pitrā samaṃ śrīpuṣkaraṃ tadā ।। 1 15।।
divyaṃ varṣatrilakṣaṃ tu tapastaptvā śivaṃ prabhum ।
jananīṃ svāṃ namaskartuṃ kailāsaṃ tvāyayau tataḥ ।। 116 ।।
āstīkaḥ svajananyā'nugato hi kaśyapaṃ yayau ।
tāṃ saputrāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā kaśyapo mudamāptavān ।। 1 17।।
sā saputrā ca suciraṃ tasthau tātālaye satī ।
kṛṣṇabhaktiparā sādhvī mokṣamārgaparāyaṇā ।। 1 18।।
putrayuktā mānasā sā sarpasatre hyupasthitā ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa tathā''stīkabalena ca ।। 11 9।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā rarakṣa bhogino'khilān ।
seyaṃ lakṣmi! mānasī tvaṃ nāginī manasā hyabhūḥ ।। 1.436.120 ।।
tvameva tripuradīnāṃ nāśe maṃgalacaṇḍikā ।
surāṇāṃ maṃgaladā ca daityānāṃ caṇḍanāśikā ।। 121 ।।
hyabhūstvaṃ surabhirjātā dugdhadātrī ca dehinām ।
nārāyaṇī jaganmātā kambharā tvamabhūrbhuvi ।। 1 22।।
padminī tulasī vṛndā prabhā pārvatī bhārgavī ।
mādhavī tvamabhūrnaikā matpativratapālikā ।। 1 23।।
tvaṃ haṃsā maṃjulā campā dayā muktā ca devikā ।
śāntiḥ śāntā ca savitā rukmiṇī śrīrjayā'nilā ।। 1 24।।
hemnī ca mauktikā svarṇā sītā padmāvatī prathā ।
rādhā gaurī kasturikā nalinī vijayā mudā ।। 1 25।।
hariṇī lalitā candrā kumudā ca sarojinī ।
bahudhā vartamānā tvaṃ yuge yuge prasevase ।। 1 26।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।
kṛṣṇapativrataṃ śrāvātpāṭhānmuktirbhavetsukham ।। 1 27।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmyā anekāvatāreṣu jaratkārvīpativratāyāṃ svapatijaratkārostapaḥprasthāne kailāse vāsa āstīkākhyaputraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍtriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 436 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 436 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 437
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 438 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
lakṣmi! somakule rājā manojavo'bhavatpurā ।
ayaṣṭa sa surān yajñairbrāhmaṇānannasaṃcayaiḥ ।। 1 ।।
pitṝँśca tarpayāmāsa kavyena sevayā harim ।
ahaṃkāro'bhavattasya dhanaputrādināśakṛt ।। 2 ।।
ahaṃkāro mado lobho hiṃsā kāmaśca ruṭ ratiḥ ।
ete sarve savayasyāḥ sampadāṃ nāśahetavaḥ ।। 3 ।।
tasya rājño'bhavallobho vipradravyakarā'rjane ।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca viprāṇāṃ jahāra kila lobhataḥ ।। 4 ।।
devānāṃ cāpi vittāni lobhācca jagṛhe nṛpaḥ ।
kṣetrāṇi jīvikāścāpi jahāra rāgataḥ sa hi ।। 5 ।।
atha puṇyavināśena krūrakarmavipākataḥ ।
puraṃ tasya mahāsainyaiḥ rurodha golabho ripuḥ ।। 6 ।।
ṣaṇmāsān tau yuyudhāte golabhasya jayo'bhavat ।
manojavaḥ putradārayukto vanāntaraṃ yayau ।। 7 ।।
yatrānnaṃ prāpyate naiva phalānyapi kvacitkvacit ।
tatra bālaḥ kṣudhitaścā'yācatā'nnaṃ hi mātaram ।। 8 ।।
amba mennaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ kṣudhā me bādhate bhṛśam ।
pitarbhakṣyaṃ dehi kiñcidanyathā me mṛtirdhruvā ।। 9 ।।
śrutvā pitā sumitrākhyāṃ bhāryāṃ prāha śanaistadā ।
sumitre! kiṃ karomyadya kva yāmyannārjanāya tu ।। 1.437.10 ।।
mariṣyatyacirādeṣaḥ sā'vayorapi vai gatiḥ ।
kathaṃ brahmā sasṛje vai durbhāgyaṃ māṃ nirarthakam ।। 1 1।।
nā'nnadānaṃ pradattaṃ vai pūrvasmin saṃbhave mayā ।
na vā śaṃbhurharikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prapūjitaḥ ।। 12।।
sūryavahnivaruṇādyā devā api na pūjitāḥ ।
na jīvikāḥ pradattā vai pūrvajanmani sundari! ।। 13 ।।
anyadattaṃ tvapahṛtaṃ vitarkaye gate janau ।
tena pāpena cāsmin vai janmanyahaṃ pragarvitaḥ ।। 14।।
ahaṃkāreṇa vai devaviprakṣetrāṇyapāharam ।
vittaṃ cā'pāharaṃ daivaṃ vaipraṃ dhārmikamityapi ।। 15।।
evaṃ me duṣkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ yatphalaṃ rājyanāśanam ।
parājayo vane vāso yatrā'nnādi na labhyate ।। 16।।
kṣudhitāḥ putradārāśca tṛṣitāśca yathā vane ।
kṣudhātṛṣābhibhūtena vilokyante tu hā gatiḥ ।। 17।।
pūrvaṃ dāne jalaṃ cānnaṃ naiva dattaṃ bhaved yataḥ ।
na hutaṃ na kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ ca no bhavet ।। 18।।
atithiḥ pūjito naiva jñātibhojanameva na ।
bālānāṃ bhojanaṃ cāpi gavāṃ cāpi tṛṇādikam ।। 19।।
sādhvīnāmāśrayaścāpi sevā satāṃ na vai kṛtā ।
jantūnāṃ kaṇapiṣṭādi dattaṃ naiva bhavet priye ।।1.437.20।।
anyathā vai kathaṃ cedṛk kaṣṭaṃ mama samāpatet ।
phalaṃ jalaṃ dalaṃ kando mūlaṃ puṣpaṃ ca pāduke ।।21 ।।
tāmbūlaṃ candanaṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ cānulepanam ।
vastraṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ yānaṃ vāhanaṃ kiñcidityapi ।।22।।
antatastakrame'vāpi pradattaṃ na bhavediti ।
tena pāpena sarvasvaduḥkhā'drirme samāgataḥ ।।23।।
nā'śvatthaścāmravṛkṣo vā kapitthastintiḍī tathā ।
amṛtādiphalivṛkṣā ropitāḥ siñcitā nahi ।।24।।
nārīkelāmalakīnāṃ taravo ropitā nahi ।
adhvagānāṃ tairthikānāṃ viśrāntibhavanāni na ।।25।।
dharmaśālāśca vā naiva kāritāḥ syuḥ purā priye ।
devālaye mayā sevā mārjanalepanādikā ।।26 ।।
na kṛtā kāritā naiva taḍāgādyā na khānitāḥ ।
puṣpodyāno na ropitaśca na kṛtaṃ tulasīvanam ।। 27।।
tena pāpena sarvasvaduḥkhā'drirme samāgataḥ ।
na kṛtāḥ kratavaścāpi dakṣiṇāścāpi nārpitāḥ ।।28।।
upoṣaṇaṃ vratānāṃ na kṛtaṃ nānyena kāritam ।
śreṣṭhamāse ca varṣāsu devapūjā na kāritā ।।29।।
naivedyaṃ jalapānādi mayā nīrājanādi na ।
decotsavaḥ kīrtanaṃ codyāpanaṃ kāritaṃ na ca ।।1.437.3 0।।
tulasīmālikā nāpi dhṛtā kaṇṭhe supāvanī ।
kṛto naiva japaścāpi kārito na kadācana ।।3 1 ।।
tena pāpena sarvasvaduḥkhā'drirme samāgataḥ ।
evaṃ sa vilapan rājā duḥkhamūrchāmupāyayau ।।32।।
sumitrā vilalāpā'thā''liṅgya sā patidevatā ।
aho nātha na yāto'si duḥkhāt kaccinmṛtiṃ vane ।।33।।
māmanāthāṃ sasutā tvaṃ vihāya vijane vane ।
mṛto'si yadi rājendra nirdhavā'nuvrajāmyaham ।।34।।
candrakāntaḥ sutaścāpi pitaraṃ parirabhya ca ।
ruroda tāvad yogīndraḥ parāśaramahāmuniḥ ।।346।।
yadṛcchayā''jagāmā'tra dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu pativratā ।
sumitrā tatsutaścāpi vavandāte samutthitau ।।36।।
āśvāsitau tau muninā prāhatuśca muniṃ tadā ।
golabhena hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vanāgamakṣudhādikam ।। 37।।
sarva paricayaṃ rājño mūrchāṃ ceti yathārthakam ।
śaktiputrastu tacchrutvā parāśaraḥ pativratām ।।38।।
sumitrāṃ prāha mā bhīste bhūyādatra mamā''game ।
aśubhaṃ vai vinaṣṭaṃ yat yat sādhorme darśanaṃ tava ।।39।।
sambodhayāmi rājānaṃ paśya kṛṣṇapratāpataḥ ।
ityuktvā munirāṭ haste jalaṃ kṛtvā''ha mantrakam ।।1.437.40।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
pasparśa ca kareṇainaṃ śavatulyaṃ narādhipam ।।41 ।।
tāvanmanojavo rājā hyutthitaśca nanāma tam ।
provāca bhagavan rakṣa kaṣṭādasmāddhi dāruṇāt ।।42।।
parāśaraḥ satīṃ putraṃ prāha mantraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
pāpaṃ prajvālayāmāsa bhaktān bhāgavatān vyadhāt ।।43।।
dadau vanyaphalānāṃ subhojanaṃ jalamuttamam ।
akṣayaṃ ca phalaṃ rājñyai pradadau sa munīśvaraḥ ।।44।।
prātaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrtiṃ jalena vai ।
vidhāya pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ phalaṃ mūrtyā sahāpi ca ।।45।।
pūjanīyaṃ kusumādyaistasmāt phalāni ṣoḍaśa ।
amṛtāni janiṣyante prātaḥ sāyaṃ ca ṣoḍaśa ।।46 ।।
tānyeva bhakṣaṇīyāni yāvadvyasananāśanam ।
ityuktvā ca sumitrāṃ sa pātivratyaṃ jagāda ha ।।47।।
śṛṇu sumitre! nityaṃ tvaṃ tvaraṇye prātareva yat ।
susaṃskṛtya śarīraṃ svaṃ deśakālānusārataḥ ।।48।।
patiṃ sampūjya vidhivat phalaṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ ।
vahniṃ prajvālya samidho datvā puṣpaphalāni ca ।।49।।
svapatyurvijayārthaṃ ca śatrūṇāṃ nāśanāya ca ।
tava mastakataḥ keśaṃ tvekamutpāṭya nā'param ।।1.437.50।।
juhudhi pāvakaṃ sādhvi! sāyaṃ prātaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ।
'śatrunāśakāya rudrāgnaye svāheti vai vada ।।51 ।।
catvāriśaddinaṃ homaṃ kuru brahmavratā'nvitā ।
brahmacaryavatī sādhvi! vijayaste bhaviṣyati ।।52।।
prayogo'yaṃ setubandhe gandhamādanaparvate ।
abdhitaṭe maṃgalākhyatīrthe samācareḥ sati! ।।53।।
ityuktā sā yayau rājñā sutena sahitā satī ।
parāśaraṃ namaskṛtyā phalāhārā pativratā ।।54।।
bhojayitvā sutaṃ nāthaṃ tīrthe snātvā'tha sā satī ।
yathoktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantraṃ jajāpa ca ।।55।।
vahnau homādikaṃ datvā keśaṃ juhāva mantrataḥ ।
catvāriṃśattame sāyāhne sā juhāva keśakam ।।56।।
taddhūmāddrāksamutpanna dhanurlokabhayaṃkaram ।
akṣayāviśudhī cāpi khaṅgaṃ ca kanakatsarū ।।57।।
ekaṃ carma gadā tvekā śaktiśca muśalo mahān ।
śaṃkho ratho'śvasahitaḥ sapatākaḥ sasārathiḥ ।।58।।
abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ senāpatiḥ sainyānvitastathā ।
astraśastrāṇi bahūni yānāni vāhanāni ca ।।59।।
bhojanādīni sarvāṇi phalājjātāni padmaje! ।
divyavastrāṇi bhūṣāśca rājasampannavottamā ।।1.437.60।।
oṣadhāni tathā vāhāḥ sarvaṃ tasmādupasthitam ।
ākāśavāṇī tāmāha bhadre! sādhvi! jayo'stu te ।।61 ।।
