smāritaśca tathā pūjyo mahāmuniparāśaraḥ ।
sasmito drāg vipravaryaścāyayau tatpuraḥsthitaḥ ।।62।।
parāśarastadā rājñe brahmādyastraṃ samantrakam ।
sā'ṅgaṃ ca sarahasyaṃ ca sotsargaṃ sopasaṃhṛtim ।।63।।
upādiśattadā rājā jagrāheśvararāḍabhūt ।
muninā prerito natvā cāruroha rathaṃ tataḥ ।।64।।
rājñīṃ samādiśattatra rathamadhye sthirā bhava ।
yāvad yuddhaṃ ca vijayo rathānmā tvamavātara ।।65।।
tava mastakakeśānāṃ sainyaṃ cāmarameva yat ।
patiścāpi sunirvighno yāvatte'sti rathe sthitiḥ ।।66।।
tvayi rathasthitāyāṃ vai mṛtasya jīvanaṃ bhavet ।
pātivratyabalenā'sya rājño nirvighnatā bhavet ।।67।।
putraṃ pārśve tadā kṛtvā rathe tiṣṭha sadā sati! ।
yāvatsvarājyabhavane catvare te gatirbhavet ।।68।।
rājyāṃgaṇe tvayā tāvat stheyaṃ rathe tataḥ param ।
tavā'varohātpūrvaṃ tvaṃ putraṃ patiṃ suvastukam ।।69।।
avarohayeḥ prāgeva tatastvaṃ bhūmigā bhava ।
tāvadeva rathaḥ sainyaṃ keśajaṃ layameṣyati ।।1.437.70।।
gaccha sādhvi! yāhi rājan kumāra rājyamāpnuhi ।
ityuktvā tilakaṃ binduṃ candraṃ kṛtvā tiro'bhavat ।।71 ।।
sārdhaṃ patnyā ca putreṇa sasainyo vijayāya saḥ ।
gatvā svīyapuraṃ rājā dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।।72।।
golabho niryayau tūrṇaṃ yuddhāya sainyasaṃyutaḥ ।
dinatrayamabhūd yuddhaṃ naṣṭaṃ sainyaṃ tu gaulabham ।।73।।
caturthe divase rājā golabho'pi vināśitaḥ ।
tataḥ saputrabhāryaśca kṣmeśo manojavaḥ svake ।।74।।
bhavane saṃpraviveśa te'vateruḥ rathāttataḥ ।
tāvatsainyaṃ rathaḥ śastraṃ phalādīni tiro'bhavan ।।75।।
rājyaṃ cakre hataśatruṃ nā'haṃkāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।
dharmaṃ yajñaṃ japaṃ dānaṃ puṇyaṃ cakre nirantaram ।।76।।
devabrāhmaṇasādhvīnāṃ satāṃ sevāṃ sadā'karot ।
atithīn pūjayāṃcakre dānadharmān bahūn vyadhāt ।।77।।
khātadharmān satradharmān yajñadharmāṃstathā''carat ।
vṛkṣasecanadharmāṃśca śrāddhadharmāṃstathā'karot ।।78।।
jīvikāvṛttidharmāṃśca karakṣamāpanādikān ।
gorakṣādikadharmāṃśca vratadharmān samācarat ।।79।।
prajārakṣākarān dharmān devapūjādikān svayam ।
akarot kārayāmāsa kathājñānādidharmakān ।।1.437.80।।
drohanindādikaṃ tyaktvā cāhiṃso nirato'bhavat ।
rājñī cāpi satīdharmān pālayāmāsa sundarī ।।81 ।।
pūrvatastu viśeṣeṇa yathā sā tāpasī śivā ।
nityaṃ dhyānaparā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe svasvāmini ।।82।।
kānte sevāparā nityaṃ brahmacaryaparā tathā ।
devāpūjāparā kṛṣṇavratakartrī nirañjanī ।।83।।
triṣavaṇasnāyinī ca patikṛṣṇaparāyaṇā ।
ekabhuktā japayajñaparā sādhuprasevikā ।।84।।
abhavacca sadā tīrthapānā munyarhabhojanā ।
evaṃ svasvāminaṃ dāsī kiṃkarīva prasevate ।।85।।
rājā'pyahiṃsānirataḥ sadā dharmaparo'bhavat ।
prajāḥ sarvā vaiṣṇavīdīkṣitāstena vidhāpitāḥ ।।86 ।।
viśeṣatastu sādhūnāmāhūya maṇḍalāni ca ।
kārayāmāsa satataṃ nāmasaṃkīrtanaṃ hareḥ ।।87।।
ṛṣīn gṛhe vāsayitvā vedaśāstrakathāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sakuṭumbaśca śuśrāva sevayāmāsa sāttvatān ।।88 ।।
sahasravatsarānevaṃ rarakṣa sa manojavaḥ ।
tato rājye sutaṃ cābhiṣicya tapase saṃyayau ।।89।।
dhyāyan kṛṣṇamacireṇa golokaṃ prayayau nṛpaḥ ।
sumitrā'pi tapase sā patyuśchāyāsthitā'bhavat ।।1.437.90 ।
patidehaṃ samāliṃgya vahnimutpādya dehajam ।
anvāruhya citāṃ tasya prāpa dhāmā'kṣaraṃ hareḥ ।।91 ।
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pātivratyaparāyaṇam ।
yaḥ śṛṇuyātpaṭhedvāpi sarvadharmaphalaṃ labhet ।।92।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne manojavanṛpaternāstikatvena golabhadvārā rājyādināśaḥ parāśaroktamantrahavanādibhaktyā tatpatnīsumitrāyāḥ pātivratyena havanādyutthitadivyasainyadvārā punaḥ rājyaprāptirmokṣādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।437।।


← adhyāyaḥ 437 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 438
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 439 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śruṇu lakṣmi! camatkāraṃ tava jātaṃ purābhavam ।
mayā bhaktaparīkṣārthaṃ tvayā preṣitayā kṛtam ।। 1 ।।
purā puṇyanidhirnāma somavaṃśodbhavo nṛpaḥ ।
māthuramaṇḍalarājyaṃ śaśāsa bhaktimān harau ।। 2 ।।
sa tvekadā setubandhaṃ tīrthārthaṃ prayayau nṛpaḥ ।
sarvādhikaṃ setutīrthaṃ gandhamādanagarbhitam ।। 3 ।।
śrutvā śāstrebhya ādāya parivāraṃ hariśritam ।
dhanuṣkoṭyāditīrtheṣu sasnau rāmeśvaraṃ sadā ।। 4 ।।
siṣeve sakuṭumbaḥ sa yajñaṃ tatrā'karonmudā ।
viṣṇuyāgā'vasāne sa mudā'vabhṛthakautukī ।। 5 ।।
sasnau tīrthe dhanuṣkoṭau sadāraḥ saparicchadaḥ ।
tatra śrīhariṇā lakṣmīrnṛpabhaktiṃ parīkṣitum ।। 6 ।।
vaikuṇṭhātpreṣitā cāṣṭavarṣavayaḥsvarūpiṇī ।
dhanuṣkoṭau samāgatya tasthau sā kamalālayā ।। 7 ।।
rājā snātvā ca dānāni kṛtvā dadarśa tāṃ satīm ।
atīva rūpasampannāṃ kanyāṃ cāruvilocanām ।। 8 ।।
saravaśobhāmayī candrakāntaparidhirājitām ।
puṇyanidhistāṃ papraccha kā tvaṃ kasyā'si kanyakā ।। 9 ।।
atrā''gamaḥ kathaṃ kanye! vada sarvaṃ yathātatham ।
kanyā śrutvā'bhavad dīnā prāha taṃ nṛpasattamam ।। 1.438.10 ।।
na me mātā pitā rājan vidyete tīrthavāñcchayā ।
bhramāmyanāthā nṛpate! hyupārjayāmi bhojanam ।। 11 ।।
rājā prāha tadā kanye! samāgaccha mayā saha ।
kanyā prāha pitā bhūtvā yadi rakṣasi cennṛpa! ।।1 2।।
tadā tvayā samaṃ rājan sutā bhūtvā nirantaram ।
tvadgṛhe'haṃ nivatsyāmi tātaṃ tvāṃ paśyatī sadā ।।1 3।।
vinā madicchāṃ kaścinme mā gṛhṇātu karaṃ nṛpa ।
tadā te mandire rājan vatsyāmi pitṛsevikā ।। 14।।
rājā prāha sute! me vai nāsti putrī yato mama ।
bhava putrī sadā kanye me'styeka eva putrakaḥ ।। 15।।
tava yasmin rucirbhadre tvāṃ tasmai pradadāmyaham ।
madbhāryāyāḥ sutā bhūtvā mama cāntaḥpure vasa ।। 16।।
kanyā prāha yadi rājan haṭhāt kaścit kareṇa mām ।
grahīṣyati hyanāthāṃ ca jñātvā tadā tvayā nṛpa ।। 17।।
śāsanīyaḥ sa eva syātputro mitraṃ ca bāndhavāḥ ।
yato hi rājagarveṇa kumārā udvivartanāḥ ।। 18।।
dharṣayanti deśakālavaiṣamye tadbibhemyaham ।
tadbhayaṃ me tava pārśve kadācittvapi mā bhavet ।। 1 9।।
ityuktaḥ sa nṛpaḥ prāha tathā'stviti tataḥ sutām ।
rājā svabhāryāhaste tāṃ pradadau cā'bravīcca tām ।। 1.438.20 ।।
rakṣemāṃ sarvathā sādhvīṃ puruṣāntarataḥ priye ।
ityādiśya saha nītvā rājā svagṛhamāgataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
pālitāṃ poṣitāṃ kanyāṃ nyavātsīt sukhapūrvakam ।
atha viṣṇuḥ parīkṣārthaṃ naro bhūtvā samāyayau ।।।22।।
sakhībhiḥ kanyakā yatra puṣpāṇyavacinoti hi ।
puṣpodyāne tīrthavāsī vipro bhūtvā samāyayau ।।23 ।।
tīrthajalaṃ kanyakābhyaḥ pradadau tulasīdalam ।
śanaiḥ paścātkaraṃ tasyā haṭhājjagrāha bhūsuraḥ ।।24।।
tadā cukrośa sā kanyā cukruśuścānyakanyakāḥ ।
mālākārastu tadvṛttaṃ kathayāmāsa bhūbhṛte ।। 25।।
rājā samāyayau yatra tūrṇaṃ sabhaṭavāhanaḥ ।
kanyābhirdarśito vipro haṭhātkarapradharṣakaḥ ।।26।।
rājñā tu nigṛhītaḥ sa badhvā nigaḍapāśitaḥ ।
kārāgāre preṣitaśca kanyāstā bhavanaṃ yayuḥ ।।27।।
rājā rātrau tu nidrāyāṃ svapne vipraṃ dadarśa tam ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣitam ।।28।।
sakaustubhaśrīvatsāṃkoraskaṃ pītāmbaraṃ harim ।
navīnajaladaśyāmaṃ garuḍādipravanditam ।।29 ।।
susmitaṃ kundakalikādantaṃ suvarṇakuṇḍalam ।
pārṣadairmunibhirlakṣmīramāprabhādipūjitam ।।1.438.3 0।।
tasya pārśve kamale śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyām ।
svaputrīṃ kamalārūpāṃ dadarśa divyarūpiṇīm ।।3 1 ।।
dhṛtapaṃkajahastāṃ ca nīlakuñcitamūrdhajām ।
diggajairabhiṣiktāṃgīṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām ।।32।।
mahālakṣmīṃ dadarśā'sau viṣṇupatnīṃ svakāṃ sutām ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā cotthito rājā vicārya ca ।।33।।
kanyāgṛhe jagāmā'sau niḥśabde maunamāśritaḥ ।
kanyā kanyāgṛhe cāste na vā ceti parīkṣitum ।।34।।
yadvā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā svapnaṃ satyaṃ vā'nṛtameva vā ।
satyaṃ sā kamalā viṣṇoḥ śayane vartate navā ।।35।।
yadvā viṣṇurniśāmadhye rājate kiṃ tayā saha ।
yadvā vipraḥ svayaṃ viṣṇurnigaḍe vartate navā ।।36।।
yadvā viṣṇusvarūpo'yaṃ śete kiṃ kanyayā saha ।
iti sarvaṃ viniścetuṃ rājā cā'vidito janaiḥ ।।37।।
śanaiḥ śanairmadhyarātrau kanyāgṛhamavāpa ca ।
tathaiva dṛṣṭavān kanyāṃ yathā svapne dadarśa tām ।।38।।
atha rājā maunameva dūrād dṛṣṭvā hariṃ śriyam ।
yayau śīghraṃ nijapatnīṃ jagāda divyadarśanam ।।39।।
tadaiva nigaḍasthānaṃ samāruhya tu vājinam ।
yayau draṣṭuṃ tadā tatra brāhmaṇo na vilokitaḥ ।।1.438.40।।
avāpā''ścaryamadhikaṃ punaḥ rājñīgṛhaṃ yayau ।
patnīyukto mahāścaryamavāpa mumude hyati ।।41 ।।
śriyā sākaṃ hareḥ rātrau vidhnaṃ mā śayane bhavet ।
iti vicārya vai rājā putrīgṛhaṃ yayau na vai ।।42।।
athodite bhāskare sa yayau kanyāgṛhaṃ śuciḥ ।
dadarśa viṣṇusevāyāṃ pūjāyāṃ svasutāṃ tadā ।।43 ।।
rājā samāgataśceti vijñāya tu sutā hareḥ ।
ājñāṃ gṛhītvā drāgeva rumābahiḥ samāyayau ।।44।।
praṇamya pitaraṃ lakṣmīrnināya svagṛhāntare ।
tāvadviṣṇurabhūd viprarūpadhṛg bhikṣuko yathā ।।45।।।
rājā viṣṇustu viprarūpaṃ tuṣṭāva premavihvalaḥ ।
namaste me sutānātha! prasīda kamalāpate ।।46।।
viprarūpa namastubhyamaparādhaṃ kṣamasva me ।
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa cakrapāṇe śriyaḥpate ।।47।।
namaḥ śrīvatsacihnāya namaḥ kaustubhadhāriṇe ।
pārvatīpataye tubhyaṃ lakṣmīśāya namonamaḥ ।।48।।
māṇikīpataye prabhānāthāya viṣṇave namaḥ ।
śrīnivāsāya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ।।49।।
padmeśāya padmāvatīsvāmine haraye namaḥ ।
padminīśāya kṛṣṇāya bhārgavīśāya te namaḥ ।।1.438.50 ।।
nārāyaṇāya rāmāya sītāyāḥ pataye namaḥ ।
sarasvatīpataye te gaṃgāyāḥ svāmine namaḥ ।।51 ।।
virajāyāḥ pataye te śrīdurgāpataye namaḥ ।
matsutāpataye haṃsāmañjulāpataye namaḥ ।।।।52।।।
kṛṣṇaviprātmane tubhyaṃ hṛdantarātmane namaḥ ।
dayāmūrte namastubhyaṃ kambharāpataye namaḥ ।।53।।
namodhvajadhanurmatsyaśūlahastāya te namaḥ ।
svastivaradahastāya kāntarūpāya te namaḥ ।।54।।
mayā nigaḍapāśābhyāṃ baddhastvaṃ parameśvara ।
ajānataste bhaktasya tvaparādhān kṣamasva me ।।55।।
evaṃ stutvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
pādayoḥ patitaḥ paścāllakṣmīṃ tuṣṭāva vaiṣṇavīm ।।।56।।
namaḥ kṛpāsvarūpāyai svalabdhāyai namonamaḥ ।
namaḥ sutāsvarūpāyai divyadevyai namonamaḥ ।।57।।
gūḍhatanvyai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyai ca te namaḥ ।
viṣṇuvakṣonivāsāyai kamalāyai namo namaḥ ।।।58।।
rādhāyai ca sarasvatyai padminyai te namonamaḥ ।
durgāyai ca mahālakṣmyai śāradāyai ca te namaḥ ।।59।।
gaṃgāyai ca tulasyai ca vṛndāyai te namo namaḥ ।
padmāvatyai ca bhārgavyai kambharāyai ca te namaḥ ।।1.438.6 0।।
siddhyai puṣṭyai svadhāyai ca svāhāyai satataṃ namaḥ ।
dakṣiṇāyai maṃgalāyai pārvatyai ca śriyai namaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
māṇikyāyai prabhāyai ca lalitāyai ca te namaḥ ।
jayāyai jānakīdevyai dropadyai te namo namaḥ ।।62 ।।
nārāyaṇyai ca sandhyāyai ṣaṣṭhyai devyai namo namaḥ ।
mātṛkāyai ca kṛṣṇāyai mañjulāyai namo namaḥ ।।63।।
śraddhāmedhābhūtidhātrīhaṃsākhyāyai ca te namaḥ ।
dharaṇyai sarvavidyāyai buddhyai gopyai namo namaḥ ।।64।।
prakṛtyai te jaganmātaḥ putryai bhūyo namo namaḥ ।
putrībhāve mayā cādhikṣiptaṃ vā śāsanaṃ kṛtam ।।65।।
tvaṃkārakaraṇaṃ lakṣmi! kṣamasva mama sarvathā ।
lokā vāṃ śiśavaḥ sarve jagatāṃ pitarau yuvām ।।66।।
sutāparādhaḥ kṣantavyaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ ca prasīdatam ।
iti samprārthitau devau viṣṇuḥ puṇyanidhiṃ nṛpam ।।67।।
prāha rājanna vai bhīśca tvayā kāryā kadācana ।
tvayā yajñaḥ kṛtaḥ setubandhe tadā hyahaṃ hariḥ ।।68।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।
abhavaṃ suprasannaśca preṣitā kamalā mayā ।।69।।
tava yajñe prapūrtyarthaṃ sā dṛṣṭā'vabhṛthe tvayā ।
tvayā sākaṃ tadā sā tu vartate'tra madājñayā ।।1.438.70।।
bhaktyā'haṃ tava vaśyo'smi bhaktipāśena yantritaḥ ।
bhaktāparādhaṃ satataṃ kṣamāmyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।71।।
tava bhaktiṃ sadā jñātuṃ sā lakṣmīste gṛhe sthitā ।
tvayā saṃrakṣitā nityaṃ poṣitā matpriyā ramā ।।72।।
tenā'haṃ cātituṣṭo'smi matsvarūpā tviyaṃ satī ।
lakṣmyāṃ yo bhaktimān loke sa madbhakto'bhidhīyate ।।73।।
asyāṃ yo vimukho rājan sa me dveṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ ।
tvaṃ ramāṃ bhaktisampannaḥ sadā pūjitavānasi ।।74।।
mama pūjā kṛtā jātā lakṣmyabhinno'smyahaṃ yataḥ ।
atastvayā nā'parādhaḥ kṛto'sti nigaḍādijaḥ ।।75।।
lakṣmīrakṣā kṛtā yasmād lakṣmyā vacanapālanāt ।
ramāparādhakartāraṃ nigaḍe dhṛtavān yataḥ ।।76 ।।
tenā'pyatiprasanno'smi matpatnī rakṣitā tvayā ।
tadrakṣatāṃ kurvatā rājan saṃketo'kāri yatpurā ।।77।।
tatsaṃketaḥ pālitaḥ sā sevā mama kṛtā tvayā ।
sā priyā mama rājendra sevā sā'pi mama priyā ।।78।।
iyaṃ lakṣmīstava sutā tvayā satye kṛtaṃ sadā ।
ityuktaḥ sa puṇyanidhiḥ sāśrunetro babhūva ha ।।79।।
atha lakṣmīstamuvāca pitaḥ prītā'smi sevayā ।
rakṣitā'smi sadā cāhaṃ svatantrā'pi sadā tvayā ।।1.438.80।।
tava bhakteḥ prapuṣṭyarthamahaṃ viṣṇurihā''gatau ।
bhaktyā prasevayā cāvāṃ santuṣṭau svaḥ sukhī bhava ।।8 1 ।।
āvayoḥ kṛpayā rājan lakṣmīste bhavatāt tathā ।
mahadbhūmaṇḍalaiśvaryaṃ sadā te bhavatu dhruvam ।।82।।
āvayoḥ pādayugale bhaktirbhavatu te dhruvā ।
dehānte cāvayordhāmaprāptiste'stu ca śāśvatī ।।83 ।।
sadā kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā bhaktistavāstviti ।
evamuktvā mahālakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe priye ।।84।।
tirobabhūva sahasā garuḍaścāpyadṛśyata ।
pārṣadāśca vyadṛśyanta hyāśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ ।।85।।
vindhyāvalī rājapatnī śrīkṛṣṇasya ca darśanāt ।
pārṣadānāṃ darśanācca mumude premavihvalā ।।86।।
yadā jñātavatī divyā lakṣmīḥ putrāṃ mamā'bhavat ।
mayā sā sevitā nityaṃ lālitā pālitā sadā ।।87।।
rāmitā hasitā sādhvī śāsitā bhojitā muhuḥ ।
snāpitā ca samudyāne vihāritā mayā saha ।।88।।
pāyitā marditā śiraḥprasādhitā'tiharṣitā ।
āvāhitā ratnasiṃhāsane niṣāditā mayā ।।89।।
ākāritā sute putri kanyake ca kumārike ।
śobhane tātike mātarduḥkhe sāntvayitā muhuḥ ।।1.438.90 ।।
spṛṣṭā śṛṃgāritā nityaṃ sakhībhiḥ saha preṣitā ।
ānanditā mahodyāne rañjaneṣu ca rañjitā ।।91 ।।
anukūleṣu cārthyeṣu pradatteṣu prasāditā ।
evaṃ bhāgyāt samālabdhā svapne'pi na viyojitā ।।92।।
na ca dūrīkṛtā putrī mama pārśvāt kadācana ।
aho bhāgyaṃ ca sāphalyaṃ mama nāryāḥ saduttamam ।।93।।
yasyāḥ sevākṛto lābho mayā nāryā samarjitaḥ ।
mama gṛhaṃ ca bhavanaṃ śayyāstaraṇavastukam ।।94।।
pātrāṇi cāsanādīni yānāni vāhanāni ca ।
prasādāni ca divyāni pūjāni mokṣadāni vai ।।95।।
mama gṛhaṃ tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyaṃ jātaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
sarvaṃ yadyat sutayā me spṛṣṭaṃ lakṣmyā nibhālitam ।।96।।
tatsarvaṃ divyatāṃ prāptaṃ kiṃ bhāgyaṃ varṇayāmi me ।
aho lakṣmi! mama mātaḥ sute putri punaḥ sukṛt ।।97।।
yadi me bhaktirasti śrīmatyāṃ tvayi sanātanī ।
yadi me pātivratyaṃ ca kṛṣṇe patyau narāyaṇe ।।98।।
tadā me darśanaṃ sādhvi! prāṇeśi dehi me sute! ।
kathamadṛśyatāṃ prāptā kathaṃ me nahi dṛśyase ।।99।।
ityuktvā netrasalilaṃ saharṣā pramumoca sā ।
tāvallakṣmīḥ smitahāsyā''nanā caṃdrasamujjvalā ।। 1.438.100 ।।
nirgatya śrīharervakṣaḥsthalāt kroḍā''gatā sthitā ।
mātustuvakṣasi luptā kṣaṇaṃ snehena putrikā ।। 101 ।।
aṃkasthitāyāḥ śirasaṃ jighrāti sma nṛpapriyā ।
uvāca putri yatrā'si śrīkṛṣṇamandire sute ।। 1 02।।
dehānte māṃ patiyuktāṃ nayethāḥ kṛṣṇavallabhe ।
omityuktvā miṣṭajalaṃ pītvā vilokya cānanam ।। 103 ।।
śīghraṃ tirodadhe lakṣmīrnārāyaṇastiro'bhavat .।
pārṣadāśca garuḍaśca tiro'bhavan kṣaṇāt priye ।। 1 04।।
tvāṃ samādāya garuḍe vaikuṇṭhamahamāptavān ।
rājā vairāgyamāpannaḥ putre dhuraṃ nidhāya ca ।। 1 05।।
punaḥ puṇyaṃ setumādhavākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ jagāma ha ।
patnīyukto hariṃ dhyāyan śeṣaṃ kālaṃ nināya saḥ ।। 106 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyātvā dehānte muktimāptavān ।
vindhyāvalī ca tatpatnī tamevā'numamāra sā ।। 1 07।।
pativratā patiprāṇā lakṣmīkṛṣṇaparāyaṇā ।
samutpādya satī vahniṃ pādāṅguṣṭhāccitopari ।। 1 08।।
yāvaddagdhuṃ samārebhe tāvallakṣmīnarāyaṇau ।
āyayaturdampatīṃ tu netuṃ vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।। 1 09।।
vimāne tau samārohayitvā bhaktau harivratau ।
pativratau divyadehau ninyaturdhāma vaiṣṇavam ।। 1.438.11 0।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tavaiva caritaṃ śubham ।
etatpaṭhanvā śṛṇvanvā vaikuṇṭhe labhate gatim ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puṇyanidhinṛpateḥ setubandharāmeśvare yajñakaraṇena putrīrūpeṇa lakṣmīprāptiḥ, lakṣmīkṛtaparīkṣaṇe paramabhāgavatasabhāryakanṛpaternārāyaṇā'nugraho brāhmaṇarūpeṇāgamanam, divyadarśanam, vaikuṇṭhanayanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭātriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।438।।


← adhyāyaḥ 438 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 439
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 440 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mama piturdharmadevasya vai purā ।
upadeśaṃ tu vardhinyai cā'psarase tapaḥsthale ।। 1 ।।
purā dharmaḥ svayaṃ tepe tapo vai dāruṇaṃ mahat ।
prajānāṃ śreyase dharmāraṇye varṣasahasrakam ।। 2 ।।
dharmopari vaṃśavṛkṣastambā valmīkamūlakāḥ ।
abhavaँste mahendrādyā jñātvā jagmurbhayaṃ bhṛśam ।। 3 ।।
yadi cedvai tapaścograṃ dharmadevaḥ kariṣyati ।
tadutthenā'nalenedṃ jagadbhasma bhaviṣyati ।। 4 ।।
taporodhāya devādyairmilitvā vardhinī tadā ।
apsaraḥ preṣitā dharmāraṇye rūpaguṇānvitā ।। 5 ।।
sā gatvā vṛddhapitaraṃ vavande dhūlikā''vṛtam ।
niḥsārya vaṃśavalmīkaṃ subhānaṃ dharmamāha sā ।। 6 ।।
kiṃhetukaṃ tapaste'sti dharmaḥ prāha dyuvāsinām ।
bhūsthānāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca tapaḥ karomi dāruṇam ।। 7 ।।
kathaṃ tvaṃ cā''gatā'raṇye yuvatī sundarī satī ।
sā tu prāha mahendrādyāstapasā bhavataḥ pitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
bhītā māṃ preṣayāmāsustapaḥkāraṇavittaye ।
jñātaṃ vai kāraṇaṃ pūjya ! kalyāṇaṃ na bhayaṃ yataḥ ।। 9 ।।
kathayiṣye surendrādīn bhaviṣyanti nirāmayāḥ ।
kintu cette'parādhaścejjāto me'nugrahaṃ kuru ।। 1.439.10 ।।
ahaṃ paravaśā nārī preṣitā puṇyaśālinī ।
vṛddhapiturdarśanaṃ me jātaṃ jātā'smi pāvanī ।। 11 ।।
rocate me na vai vighnaṃ kartuṃ kasyāpi sukṛte ।
kintu devavaśā tasmāt preryate tatra yāmi vai ।। 1 2।।
kalyāṇaṃ bhavedyena śādhi cenmāṃ pitāmaha ।
mahendrāya tapohetuṃ nivedyā''yāmi vai punaḥ ।। 13 ।।
apsaratvaṃ pitarme na rocate nartanādikam ।
preṣyatvaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sarvasukṛtānāṃ vināśakam ।। 14।।
yatra vai niyamo nāsti svāmināṃ kiṃkarībhave ।
kaiṃkaryaṃ bahupāpānāṃ nārīṇāṃ jāyate pitaḥ ।। 15।।
parahastagatatvaṃ ca parabhogyatvamityapi ।
sukṛtānāṃ pratirodhi na me saṃrocate pitaḥ ।। 16 ।।
śrutvaitasyā vaco dharmabhṛtaṃ dharmastutoṣa tām ।
uvāca tvaṃ mahendrāya tapohetuṃ nivedya ca ।। 17।।
śīghramāyāhi satputri! kariṣye tava śobhanam ।
vardhini! tvaṃ bhayaṃ tyaktvā samāyāhi ca mā ciram ।। 18।।
ityuktā sā vṛṣaṃ natvā prasannā tvaritā yayau ।
mahendrādīn tapohetuṃ nivedyaiva prajā'vanam ।। 1 9।।
śīghraṃ dharmaṃ pratidharmāraṇyaṃ prāptā satī śubhā ।
natvā dharmaṃ ca sā valmīkāntaḥsthaṃ paramādarāt। ।। 1.439.20।।
siṣeve tu divārātrau phalamūlāśanā satī ।
vaṃśānutpāṭayāmāsa valmīkasthāँśca sā śanaiḥ ।।2 1 ।।
mṛttikāśca śanairdūrīcakāra dharmadehataḥ ।
asthimātrā'vaśiṣṭaṃ taṃ dehaṃ tīrthajalena sā ।।22।।
snāpayāmāsa kuśalā dehaḥ pallavatāṃ gataḥ ।
tatra divyasvarūpaśca śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ ।। 23।।
dharmo babhūva saṃkalpād dadarśa sevikāṃ satīm ।
vardhinī patitā dharmapādayoścārpayajjalam ।।24।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalādyaṃ ca samārpayad vṛṣāya sā ।
samapracchannijaṃ śreyaścakre pādāvanejanam ।।25।।
prasannaḥ śrīdharmadevastāmāha śāśvatān vṛṣān ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān sasarja jaḍacetanān ।।26।।
narānnārīśca sarvātmā dharmarakṣaṇahetave ।
patnīvrataṃ purā vipraṃ sasarja bhagavān svayam ।।27।।
pativratāṃ ca tatpatnīṃ sasarjā''ha ca tadvṛṣān ।
śṛṇu sādhvi sāttvike te kathayāmi tu tān vṛṣān ।।28।।
pālitairyaiśca nārīṇāṃ paraṃ śreyo bhavet sati! ।
yāvatkanyā bhavettāvat kumārikāvṛṣāँścaret ।।29।।
mātāpitṛprasevāṃ vai kuryācca gurusevanam ।
brahmacaryaparā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ samarcayet ।।1.439.3 0।।
vivāhitā tu sā nārī pātivratyaṃ prapālayet ।
no ced vivāhitā brahmacāriṇī vartate yadi ।।3 1 ।।
kṛtabhogā kṣatapūrvā vidhavā cā'dhavā'pi ca ।
brahmacaryaparaṃ paraṃśreyaḥpradaṃ cecchedyadi dhruvam ।।32।।
kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā jāyeta brahmacāriṇī ।
vartate sarvadā dharme kṛṣṇakānte pativratā ।।33।।
patyau kānte kṛṣṇakānte pātivratyaparā yathā ।
santiṣṭhettān vṛṣān putri te vakṣyāmi hitāvahān ।।34।।
vāṅmanaḥkāyaśuddhā syāt pūjyapūjāparāyaṇā ।
alaulyā cāstikā kṛṣṇasvāmibhaktimatī bhavet ।।35।।
kṛṣṇaḥ svāmī patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇārthaṃ vratamāsthitā ।
patyarthaṃ vratasampannā kīrtitā sā pativratā ।।36।।
pativratā tu sā nārī patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā ।
patyau kānte tathā kṛṣṇamūtau vratavatī bhavet ।।37।।
śrutvaitad vardhinī prāha dharmadevaṃ tu padmaje! ।
pativratānāṃ sarvāsāṃ lakṣaṇa kīdṛśaṃ vada ।।38।।
dharmadevastadā prāha prajābodhāya vistarāt ।
pativratā gṛhe yasya saphalaṃ tasya jīvanam ।।39।।
yasya sā'ṅgasamā chāyāsamā sevāparāyaṇā ।
nityaṃ puṇyapradā yasyāḥ kathā'pi puṇyakāriṇī ।।1.439.40।।
bhuṃkte bhukte svāmini santiṣṭhati tvanutiṣṭhati ।
vinidrite yā nidrāti prathamaṃ paribuddhyati ।।41।।
analaṃkṛtamātmānaṃ kānte deśāntaraṃ gate ।
kāryārthaṃ proṣite tāvad bhavenmaṇḍanavarjitā ।।42।।
bharturnāma na gṛhṇīyādāyuṣo vṛddhikāmyayā ।
ākruṣṭā'pi ca nā''krośet tāḍitā'pi prasīdati ।।43।।
kāryā''jñāyāṃ kṛtaṃ svāminniti vakti karoti ca ।
āhūtā svāminā śīghraṃ yāti tyaktvā'nyakāryakam ।।44।।
vada kānta karomyadya sevikā te'smyupasthitā ।
evaṃ miṣṭaṃ vadetsarvaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ yadādiśet ।।45।।
nakāraṃ na vaded brūyāt prasādo me vidhīyatām ।
svāmī yathā bhavettṛptaḥ prasannaścācarettathā ।।46।।
gṛhadvāre parānnaiva sthitvā paśyennarāँściram ।
adātavyaṃ na vai dadyādanyasmai patyasannidhau ।।47।।
snānapūjopakaraṇādyanuktā sādhayet svayam ।
patrapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ yathākālaṃ prasādhayet ।।48।।
udvignā na bhavet kvāpi hṛṣṭā seveta vai patim ।
pratīkṣamāṇā satprītiṃ bhartāraṃ saṃpratoṣayet ।।49।।
bhartrā bhuktaṃ prasādaṃ ca bhuṃkte'nyadvarjayet sadā ।
samājotsavayātrādi vivāhaprekṣaṇādiṣu ।।1.439.50 ।।
vinā kāntaṃ na vai gacched vardhini! yā pativratā ।
patyājñayā pragacchedvai svāmidharmaparāyaṇā ।।51 ।।
suptamāsīnamutsthaṃ ca krīḍantaṃ kāryatatparam ।
svārthārthaṃ ca satī vopasthāpayed vighnamantarā ।।52।।
rājasvalye tu samprāpte trirātraṃ malinā satī ।
aśuddhiṃ pālayed gṛhād bahirgacchenna sarvathā ।।53।।
atejaskaṃ mukhaṃ svasyā darśayenna bahiḥ satī ।
śabdaṃ na śrāvayettvanyān gṛhādbahiḥ pativratā ।।54।।
caturthe divase snātvā śuddhā bhavati bhāminī ।
turyarātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ devārcanādiyoginī ।।55।।
śuddhā bhavati sevārhā kuryāt svasvāmidarśanam ।
yadvā svasvāminaṃ smṛtvā kuryātsūryasya darśanam ।।56।।
ayugmāsu bījalābhe prasūyeta hi kanyakām ।
yugmāsu garbhalābhe tu prasūyeta hi putrakam ।।57।।
āṣoḍaśaniśaṃ garbhakamalodghāṭanaṃ sadā ।
tataḥ paraṃ pihītaṃ syād vyarthā bhavanti dhātavaḥ ।।।58।।
rajasvalāyāṃ rugṇāyāṃ kācidanyā tu bhāminī ।
dvādaśavāraṃ pratyekaṃ spṛṣṭvā snātvā punaḥ punaḥ ।।59।।
pūrvadhṛtāni vastrāṇi tasyā dūre prakārayet ।
jalena prokṣayedante rajasvalā praśuddhyati ।।1.439.60।।
vivāhe cotsave yāne samāje vāhane pathi ।
pravāse tīrthayātrāyāṃ yajña dāne vipatsthale ।।।6 1 ।।
saṃgrāme satkathākhyāne jñāne dīkṣāvidhau vane ।
tyāgabhāve yogabhāve camatkāre tapaḥsthitau ।।62।।
anāśraye parādhīne kārāgāre ca nirjane ।
asahāye karmabhṛtyabhāve vicittakasthitau ।।63 ।।
atyāvaśyakakārye ca śavayoge ca sūtake ।
pravāse paragehādau brahmacarye vrate kratau ।।64।।
vidyārjane copavāsavidhau cāndrāyaṇādike ।
bhrātṛsutajanakādyairāvaśyake tu kāryake ।।65।।
snātvā tvekopavāsena śuddhyatyeva rajasvalā ।
dharmamūrtiḥ svayaṃ kāntaḥ kṛṣṇamūrtiḥ svayaṃ patiḥ ।।66 ।।
patirdharmaḥ patiḥ karma patiḥ śuddhirhi nānyathā ।
patiyoge bhavecchuddhā tāvadeva rajasvalā ।।67।।
cāturmāsye yathā nadyaḥ sarvadaiva rajasvalāḥ ।
vārdhiyoge tu śuddhāḥ syustadayoge rajasvalāḥ ।।68।।
tasmātpatyurvaśe śuddhiḥ patiyoge hi śuddhikṛt ।
patividveṣiṇīṃ nārīṃ prabhāṣenna satī kvacit ।।69।।
haridrāṃ kuṃkumaṃ binduṃ sindūraṃ kajjalaṃ tathā ।
śirovastraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ māṃgalyā''bharaṇāni ca ।।1.439.70।।
keśasaṃskārakaraṇaṃ kaṃkaṇādisubhūṣaṇam ।
bharturāyuṣyamicchantī dūrayenna patipriyā ।।71 ।।
naikākinī bahirgacchenna nagnā snānamācaret ।
ratikārye kuśalā syānmānā''lasyavivarjitā ।।72 ।।
yatra yathā rucirbhartustathā tatra sakhī bhavet ।
dharmo vrataṃ japaḥ sevā pūjā patiprasādanam ।73 ।।
matvā kuryād bhartṛtoṣe sarvaṃ bhavati sukṛtam ।
na kaṇḍanyāṃ na peṣaṇyāṃ na cullyāṃ muśale na ca ।।74।।
na darvyāṃ na mahāsthālyāṃ na dehalyāṃ na yantrake ।
na śilāyāṃ piṣṭaloṣṭe sādhanādāvupāviśet ।।75।।
nirdhanaṃ rūpahīnaṃ ca klībaṃ jaraṭhaṃ rogiṇam ।
rāgahīnaṃ kāmahīnaṃ śaktihīnaṃ ca duḥsthitim ।।76 ।।
kṛṣṇasamaṃ patiṃ jñātvā śaktā'pi na vilaṃghayet ।
sarpirlavaṇatailādikṣaye'pi sukhato yathā ।।77।।
prāptiḥ syāttattathā vācyaṃ kleśayenna kadācana ।
loṣṭhapātre bhojayennocchiṣṭaṃ svasyāḥ prabhojayet ।।78।।
patipādodake tīrthe snāyāt pibed vasetsadā ।
śivādviṣṇoḥ pañcadevebhyo'dhikaḥ svapatiḥ striyāḥ ।।79।।
patimullaṃghya sā naiva vratopoṣaṇamācaret ।
uktā kaṣṭottaraṃ naiva dadyātsādhvī kadācana ।।1.439.80।।
patyuradhikṣepakartrī krodhitā kleśadāyinī ।
saramā jāyate grāme śṛgālī nirjane vane ।।8 1 ।।
bhartuḥ pādau prapūjyaiva kuryātprasādabhojanam ।
bharturuccāsane naiva niṣīdenna vrajedbahiḥ ।।82।।
paragṛhasthitimatī bhavennaiva kadācana ।
kliṣṭapāruṣyavākyāni brūyānnaiva kadācana ।।83 ।।
gurūṇāṃ sannidhau noccairvadennarma na cā''caret ।
sajane tu sthale kāntaṃ svareṇa nā''hvayet satī ।।84 ।।
yasyāḥ svaśayane kānto na rocate sā durmatiḥ ।
ulūkī cakravākī ca jāyate vṛkṣavāsinī ।।85 ।।
patyustāḍanakartrī ca vyāghrī mārjārikā bhavet ।
kaṭākṣayitrī kāntānyaṃ kāṇākṣī sā bhaved dhruvam ।।86।।
patiṃ vinā yā miṣṭādā sūkarī valgulī bhavet ।
patyustvaṃkārayitrī sā mūkā totalikā bhavet ।।87।।
sapatnyā īrṣyayitrī tu muhuḥ rugṇabhagā bhavet। ।
anyasmai mukhadarśikā kurūpā kumukhī bhavet ।।88।।
anyaṃ praharṣayed bhāvairanyaṃ saṃdarśayettanum ।
anyaṃ spṛśecca sā godhā raṇḍā veśyā tato bhavet ।।89।।
kāryaṃ pariśramaṃ kṛtvā samāyāntaṃ vilokya sā ।
jalāsanaiśca tāmbūlaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ ।।1.439.90 ।।
vyajanaiḥ phaladānaiśca miṣṭavāṇyā prasannayet ।
patyurevaṃ prīṇayitrī śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute ।।9 1 ।।
pitā mātā suto bhrātā svalpadā mitadā matāḥ ।
amitasya tu sarvasya dātā kāntaḥ striyāḥ sadā ।।92।।।
iṣṭo devo guruḥ śreṣṭhastīrthaṃ pātraṃ patirmataḥ ।
dharmaḥ puṇyaṃ vrataṃ kṛcchraṃ sarvaṃ patyau tamarcayet। ।।।93।।
vinā''tmānaṃ śavaṃ vyarthaṃ patnī kāntaṃ vinā tathā ।
susnātā gandhitā'laṃkāritā'pyaśucireva sā ।।94।।
dhavaḥ sthānaṃ maṃgalānāṃ taṃ vinā maṃgalāni na ।
dhavaṃ vinā suduṣṭā'pi mātā putrasya maṃgalā ।।95।।
mahābhāgavatī sādhvī bhaktā sarvasya maṃgalā ।
raṇḍā muṇḍā tyāgavatī vahnivastrā tu maṃgalā ।।96।।
vaiṣṇavī vidhavā kṛṣṇadhavā śaśvaddhi maṃgalā ।
priyā patnīkṛtā yā kā jārasyāpi tu maṃgalā ।।97।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśāṭīdhāriṇī maṃgalā sadā ।
kṛṣṇapativratā kṛṣṇādhārā yā kā'pi maṃgalā ।।98।।
tulasīmālikā kaṇṭhe kare bhāle tu puṇḍrakam ।
lakṣmībinduśca yasyāḥ sā maṃgalā kṛṣṇabhāminī ।।99।।
gurumantrapradātrī ca jñānadātrī ca maṃgalā ।
raṇḍā muṇḍā vyaṃgaṣaṇḍhā vaiṣṇavī maṃgalā sadā ।। 1.439.1 00।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃkasthāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyāḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāntā divyāḥ sarvā hi maṃgalāḥ ।। 101 ।।
kanyādāne vācayanti viprāḥ prativratāvṛṣān ।
bhartuḥ sahacarī bhūyā jīvato'jīvato'pi vā ।। 1 02।।
śmaśānaṃ yā gṛhādbhartuḥ śavasyā'nuprayāti sā ।
pade pade'śvamedhasya puṇyavatī citā'nugā ।। 1 03।।
yamahastātpatimākṛṣya sā svargaṃ vrajet satī ।
satīṃ vīkṣya palāyante hitvā patiṃ yamānugāḥ ।। 1 04।।
sūryo vahnirvāḍavāgnirvidyuttārāgrahādayaḥ।
pātivratyamahaso'gre kampante devakoṭayaḥ ।। 1 05।।
pativratāvarṣmaromasaṃkhyā yāvatī tāvatām ।
koṭyayutavatsarāṇāṃ svargāyuṣyavatī satī ।। 1 06।।
bhartrā divyasukhaṃ bhuṃkte tato muktiṃ vrajettataḥ ।
sudhanyau tasyāḥ pitarau patirdhanyaḥ kuṭumbakam ।। 1 07।।
pitṛvaṃśyāḥ mātṛvaṃśyāḥ pativaṃśyāstrayastrayaḥ ।
pativratāyāḥ puṇyena svarge yānti tayā saha ।। 1 08।।
pativratāyāścaraṇo bhūmiṃ tīrthīkaroti vai ।
sūryaḥ somaśca gandharvāḥ spraṣṭuṃ bibhyati vai satīm ।। 1 09।।
pativratāpādayogaṃ vāñcchanti salilānyapi ।
gāyatryā yasya pāpasya nāśo naiva bhavediha ।। 1.439.11 0।।
pātivratyena tannāśaṃ karotyeva pativratā ।
saṃsāro rūpalāvaṇyagarvitastrīmayo na kim ।। 11 1।।
paraṃ satī kvacitpativratā labhyeta vaiṣṇavī ।
gṛhaṃ pativratāpatnī tayā gṛhastha ucyate ।। 1 12।।
patnīmūlaṃ gṛhadharme dharmaphale sukhe sute ।
paraloke ceha pitratithidevasamarhaṇe ।। 1 13।।
gṛhaṃ syātpāvanaṃ svāmivratayā gaṃgayā'thavā ।
kulaṃ syātpāvanaṃ bhaktyā pativratayā vā striyā ।। 1 14।।
vivāhitaḥ patiryasyāstayā patiprasevayā ।
svargo mokṣaḥ sādhanīyau śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇau tathā ।। 1 15।।
yasyāḥ patiryayau svargaṃ sagarbhā bhaktitatparā ।
vaidhavyavṛṣaśaktā sā bhavet kṛṣṇapativratā ।। 116 ।।
kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpūjayennityaṃ bhojayellālayeddharim ।
sevayet sarvathā nārī kṛṣṇaṃ kṛtvā patiṃ nijam ।। 1 17।।
kṛṣṇaṃ svaśayane smṛtvā nidrāṃ labhet pativratā ।
kṛṣṇaṃ codvartayed gandhadravyaṃ kṛṣṇāya cārpayet ।। 1 18।
bhartāraṃ śrīharau smṛtvā dadyāt kuśatilodakam ।
patiṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyetprapūjayet ।। 11 9।
patyuriṣṭaṃ yadāsīttaddadyātkṛṣṇāya sarvadā ।
snānaṃ dānaṃ tīrthayātrāṃ kathāśravaṇamarcanam ।। 1.439.1 20।
vaiśākhe jalakuṃbhāṃśca kārtike ghṛtadīpakān ।
māghe dhānyatilādyāँśca patikṛṣṇāya cārpayet ।। 121 ।
vaiśākhe tu prapāṃ dadyācchive dadyādgalantikām ।
uśīraṃ vyajanaṃ chatraṃ sūkṣmavāsāṃsi candanam ।। 1 22।
sakarpūraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ puṣpadānaṃ subhojanam ।
jalapātraṃ piṣṭadānaṃ drākṣārambhādi satphalam ।। 123 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇāya pradeyādvai patirme prīyatāmiti ।
kārtike'nnāni sarvāṇi śākāni śimbikāstathā ।। 1 24।।
ghṛtādikaṃ kambalādi pradadyātkṛṣṇatuṣṭaye ।
ghaṇṭāṃ śayyāṃ ghṛtapātraṃ dhanaṃ dhenuṃ payasvinīm ।। 1 25।।
dīpadānaṃ pradadyācca patikṛṣṇapratuṣṭaye ।
kumārikā'thavā yā cā'dhavā vā pativarjitā ।। 1 26।।
tathā kṛṣṇasvāmidharmāḥ pālanīyā hi sarvathā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pūjyaḥ sevanīyo hṛdi prabhuḥ ।। 127।।
ityuktā dharmadevena vardhinī brahmacāriṇī ।
dharmāraṇye sadā sthitvā kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇā ।।1 28।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe kānte pātivratyaparā satī ।
bheje nityaṃ mūrtirūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।। 1 29।।
tapasyantaṃ dharmadevaṃ siṣeve pitṛsevikā ।
atha tuṣṭo hariḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ samāyayau ।। 1.439.130 ।।
tāṃ kṛtvā divyadehāṃ ca nināya nijamandiram ।
dharmadevaṃ tathā datvā varadānaṃ yathepsitam ।। 131 ।।
prajāyā rakṣaṇaṃ śaśvat kariṣye tapasā'pyaham ।
tapaso nivṛttiḥ kāryā cetyukto vṛṣa eva saḥ ।। 1 32।।
nivavṛte tapasaśca yayau satyaṃ hyajasthalam ।
nārāyaṇaḥ satīṃ nītvā vardhinīṃ svālayaṃ yayau ।। 1 33।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vardhinīpātivratyakam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svargaṃ muktiṃ labhejjanaḥ ।। 1 34।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dharmāraṇye dharmatapasyābhaṃgārthaṃ samāgatāyā indrapreṣitavardhinyā atsarāyāḥ dharmakṛtapātivratyabodhena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 439 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 439 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 440
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 441 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha lakṣmi! vṛṣāraṇye brāhmaṇādiprarakṣikāḥ ।
pativratāmahāsatyo viṣṇusthāpitamātaraḥ ।। 1 ।।
tāstu nārāyaṇabhaktāḥ sadā lokasya rakṣikāḥ ।
pātivratyaparā devīrvakṣyāmi śṛṇu sādaram ।। 2 ।।
sopākhyānāṃ kathāṃ tatra viprāṇāṃ yā purā'bhavat ।
tāmapi saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu dharmodbhavāṃ śubhām ।। 3 ।।
purā golokadhāmni śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
patnīvrataṃ sutaṃ vipraṃ svasmāt prāviścakāra ha ।। 4 ।।
sa tu vipraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā'tra golake ।
ājagāma nijapatnyā pativratayā saṃyutaḥ ।। 5 ।।
dharmāraṇye sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrāsyaḥ sahasrapāt ।
patnīvrataḥ kṛtavān svasvarūpāṇi sahasraśaḥ ।। 6 ।।
ta ete brāhmaṇāḥ sarve sadācārāḥ śubhavratāḥ ।
aśeṣadharmakuśalāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ ।। 7 ।।
tapojñāne mahākhyātā brahmayajñaparāyaṇāḥ ।
uṣitāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve trikālajñāḥ pratāpinaḥ ।। 8 ।।
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmajāḥ ।
caturviṃśatigotrāṇi prāvartantā'tra vai purā ।। 9 ।।
bhāradvājastathā vatsaḥ kauśikaḥ kuśa ityapi ।
śāṇḍilyaḥ kaśyapaścāpi gautamaḥ śāndhanastathā ।। 1.440.1 0।।
jātūkarṇyastathā vātsyo vasiṣṭho dhāraṇastathā ।
ātreyo bhāṇḍilaścāpi kṛṣṇāyanaśca laukikaḥ ।। 11 ।।
upamanyuśca gārgyaśca mauṣako mudgalastathā ।
gāṃgāsanaśca kauṇḍinyaḥ puṇyāsanaḥ parāśaraḥ ।। 1 2।।
caturviṃśatiścaitāni prāvartanta purā yuge ।
āṃgīrasaḥ śaunakaśca kāśyapaḥ jāmadagnyakaḥ ।। 13।
laugākṣasaśca māṇḍavyo babhūvurgotriṇastataḥ ।
pravarāṇi tu jātāni tānyapi me niśāmaya ।। 14।।
bhāradvājasagotreyāḥ pravaraiḥ pañcabhiryutāḥ ।
āṅgīraso bārhaspatyo bhāradvājaśca sainyasaḥ ।। 15।।
gārgyaścaiveti pravarāḥ pañca te vaiṣṇavā dvijāḥ ।
vatsagotre dvijā lakṣmi! pravarāḥ pañca te yathā ।। 16।।
bhārgavaścyavanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ ।
kauśikavaṃśe ye jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।। 17।।
viśvāmitro'ghamarṣī ca kauśikaśceti te trayaḥ ।
kuśikagotre ye jātāḥ pravaraistribhiranvitāḥ ।। 18।।
viśvāmitro devarāta audalaśceti te trayaḥ ।
śāṇḍilyagotre ye jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।। 1 9।।
asito devalaścāpi śāṇḍilyaśceti te trayaḥ ।
kaśyapā brāhmaṇā lakṣmi! pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।।1.440.20।।
kāśyapaścāpavatsāro naidhruvaśceti te trayaḥ ।
gautamagotrajā ye tu pravarāḥ pañca eva te ।।21 ।।
kautso gārgyo pravahaścā'sito devala ityamī ।
śāndhanasya tu naivāsīt svatantraḥ pravaraḥ sati! ।।22।।
jātūkarṇyasyāpi tathā svatantraḥ pravaro na vai ।
vātsyagotre bhavā viprāḥ pravaraiḥ pañcabhiryutāḥ ।।23।।
bhārgavacyavanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ ।
atha vaśiṣṭhagotrotthāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।।24।।
vasiṣṭho bhāradvājaśca indrapramada ityamī ।
atha dhārīṇasagotre pravarāstraya eva te ।।25।।
agastirdarviśvetā ca dadhyavāhana ityamī ।
ātreyagotre ye jātāḥ pañcapravarasaṃyutā ।। 26।।
ātreyo'rcanānasaḥ śyāvāśva āṃgīraso'trikaḥ ।
bhāṇḍīlasya tu naivāsīt svatantraḥ pravarastadā ।।27।।
tathā kṛṣṇāyanasyāpi svatantraḥ pravaro na vai ।
laukikasyāpi ca tathā svatantraḥ pravaro na vai ।। 28।।
upamanyusagotreyāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।
vasiṣṭhaśca bharadvājastvindrapramada ityamī ।।29।।
gārgyasya gotrajānāṃ tu pravarāstraya eva tu ।
aṅgirāścāmbarīṣaśca yauvanāśvastṛtīyakaḥ ।।1.440.3 0।।
mauṣakasya tu naivāsīt svatantraḥ pravarastadā ।
mudgalasyāpi ca tathā svatantraḥ pravaro na vai ।। 31 ।।
gāṃgāsanasya tu gotre pravarāḥ pañca eva tu ।
bhārgavaścāvanāpnuvānaurvāśca jāmadagnyakaḥ ।। 32।।
ātreyo'rcanānasaśca śyāvāsyaśca trayo'pi te ।
gāṃgāsane bhavantyete trayo'pi pravarāḥ kvacit ।। 33 ।।
kauṇḍinyasya ca puṇyāsanasya parāśarasya ca ।
gotre svatantrāḥ pravarā nāsan lakṣmi! tadā purā ।।34।।
athā'nyāँste kathayāmi jāmadagnyasya pañca tu ।
bhārgavyaścyavanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ ।।35।।
māṇḍavyasya sagotre tu pravarāḥ pañca te yathā ।
bhārgavaścyāvano'triścāpnuvānaurvasta eva hi ।।36।।
vātsyāyanasagotreyāḥ pravaraiḥ pañcabhiryutāḥ ।
bhārgavaścyāvanāpnuvānaurvaśca jamadagnikaḥ ।।37।।
kaśyape gotrake cānye pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।
kāśyapaścāpavatsāro raibhyaśca viśrutāstrayaḥ ।। 38।।
śonakaseṣu ye jātāḥ pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।
bhārgavaḥ śaunahotraśca gārtsyamada ititrayaḥ ।। 39।।
jātā āṃgīrasagotre pravaratrayasaṃyutāḥ ।
āṅgiraso'mbarīṣaśca yauvanāśca iti trayaḥ ।।1.440.40।।
atha patnīvratagotre devānīko dasāyakaḥ ।
santakaśceti pravarā mahādānaparāyaṇāḥ ।।41 ।।
teṣāṃ śākhāḥ praśākhāśca putrapautrādayo dvijāḥ ।
jajñire bahavo loke nūtnaśākhāvalambinaḥ ।।42।।
dharmasāvarṇigotrīyāḥ pravarā hyabhavaँstrayaḥ ।
vaitahavyaḥ sāvetaso bhāradvājaśca te hyamī ।।43।।
etān visṛjya ca viprā nūtnapravaramārgagāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti gate kāle sarvaṃ kālaviḍambanam ।।44।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! dvijānetān dharmāraṇye'nyabhūtale ।
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācādyā udvejayanti vai tadā ।।45।।
jṛmbhako nāma yakṣo'bhūd dharmāraṇyasamīpataḥ ।
udvejayati nityaṃ sa dharmāraṇyanivāsinaḥ ।।46 ।।
tadduḥkhaṃ tairdvijāgryaiśca devebhyo viniveditam ।
patnīvrataṃ puraḥ kṛtvā surā vedhaḥsabhāṃ yayuḥ ।।47।।
brahmā yayau tu golokaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tajjagāda ha ।
śrīkṛṣṇena tadā gopyo lakṣaśastatra preṣitāḥ ।।48।।
tāstu divyāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ kṛṣṇājñāvartanāḥ priyāḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapātivratyadharmāvagāhitāḥ ।।49।।
satyaḥ prasannā divyāṅgyaścāyayurvedhaso gṛham ।
brahmājñayā ca tāḥ sarvā āyayuḥ kanyakā divam ।।1.440.50।।
tatra viśvāvasukanyāḥ mānasyaścā'bhavan kṣaṇāt ।
jātismarā yuvatyaśca sutāḥ sarvāṃgasundarāḥ ।।51 ।।
brahmacaryadharmaparāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ kumārikāḥ ।
rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi viprāṇāṃ lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā ।।52।।
yoginyo devagandharvaiḥ sthāpitā dharmabhūmiṣu ।
gotrān pratitathaikaikā sthāpitā yoginī satī ।।53।।
yasya gotrasya yā śaktiḥ pālane rakṣaṇe kṣamā ।
sā tasya kuladevīti sākṣāttatra babhūva ha ।।54।।
śrīmātrādyāḥ śṛṇu lakṣmi! tāḥ sarvā dvādaśā'bdikāḥ ।
śrīmātā, tāraṇī, āśāpurī, cecchā''rtināśinī ।।।55।।
pippalī, vikarāvaśā, jaganmātā, tu saptamī ।
mahāmātā, tathā siddhā, bhaṭṭārikā, kadambikāḥ ।।56।।
vikarā, miṣṭā, suparṇā, mātaṃgī, vasujā, tathā ।
mahādevī, tathā vāṇī, bhadrī, ca mukureśvarī, ।।57।।
saṃhārī, ca mahāśakti,rmahābalā, tathā punaḥ ।
cāmuṇḍā tu mahādevī, ityetā gotramātaraḥ ।।58।।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyaiḥ sthāpitā viprarakṣaṇe ।
tāḥ pūjayanti viprendrā vaiṣṇavīrbhagavatsatīḥ ।।59।।
atha yajñeṣu gavyārthaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।
sasmāra kāmadhenuṃ tu kāmadhenuḥ samāyayau ।।1.440.60।।
brahmā tāṃ kathayāmāsa gavyārthaṃ tu pratidvijam ।
ekaikāṃ kāmadhenuṃ ca dehi mātaḥ prasīda me ।।6 1 ।।
tathetyuktvā kāmadhenuḥ prāviścakāra putrikāḥ ।
nandinyo lakṣaśaḥ śvetāḥ prāvirbhūtāḥ suyauvanāḥ ।।62।।
saṃkalpamātrāt savatsā dogdhryo gavyapradāḥ śubhāḥ ।
prāvartanta śubhā yajñā devāstṛptāḥ supāyasaiḥ ।।63।।
atha brāhmaṇavarṇānāṃ sevakāśca dvijātayaḥ ।
brāhmaṇairmānasāstatrotpāditā vaṇijo'yutāḥ ।।64।।
sopavītāḥ saśikhāśca sarvatattvaviśāradāḥ ।
dvijabhaktāḥ sadācārā yuvānaśca taponvitāḥ ।।65।।।
ekaikasmai dvijāyaivā'rpitaṃ hyanucaradvayam ।
vāḍavasya tu yadgotraṃ gotraṃ cānucarasya tat ।।66।।
brahmaṇā śiṣyatā tebhyaścopadiṣṭā hitāya hi ।
kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ tveṣāṃ dadadhvaṃ ca yadicchitam ।।67।।
samitpuṣpakuśādīni hyānayadhvaṃ dine dine ।
anujñayaiṣāṃ vartadhvaṃ mā'vajñāṃ kuruta kvacit ।।68।।
ityevaṃ te vartamānā brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ ।
sevante brāhmaṇān sarve vaiṣṇavā vrataśālinaḥ ।।69।।
parigrahārthaṃ teṣāṃ vai vedhasā ca vṛṣeṇa ca ।
gandharvakanyakā ramyā dārāstatropakalpitāḥ ।।1.440.70 ।।
viśvāvasoḥ kanyakāstā vipravadhvaḥ pativratāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭikanyāsahasrāṇi snuṣārūpāstadā'bhavan ।।71 ।।
śvaśrūrūpāstathā cānyā mātaro viprayoṣitaḥ ।
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi kanyānāmabhavan priye ।।72।।
śreṣṭhādevyo'tha yoginyo mātṝūpāśca rakṣikāḥ ।
dharmāraṇye lakṣaśastāḥ striyaḥ kṛṣṇapativratāḥ ।।73 ।।
evaṃ gṛhasthā abhavan putrapautrādivistarāḥ ।
sarvāḥ pativratā nāryaḥ patnīvratāśca pūruṣāḥ ।।74।।
evaṃ gṛhasthavipreṣu vasamāneṣvaraṇyake ।
upadravaṃ paraṃ cakre rākṣaso lolajihvakaḥ ।।75।।
mahādaṃṣṭro mahākāyo vidyujjihvo bhayaṃkaraḥ ।
taṃ tu nāśayituṃ devyo viprarakṣaṇatatparāḥ ।।76 ।।
triśūlavaradhāriṇyaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāyutāḥ ।
kaśākhaṅgayutāścānyāḥ pāśāṃkuśayutāstathā ।।77।।
kāścit paraśuhastāśca divyāyudhadharāśca tāḥ ।
yuyudhuḥ rākṣasenātra sasmaruśca narāyaṇam ।।78।।
viṣṇurāgatya cakreṇa mārayāmāsa rākṣasam ।
viprāstu saṃhatāścaikanagare vāsamācaran ।।79।।
dharmāraṇyaṃ purā yattu satyamandirapattanam ।
nagaraṃ vipravāsaṃ sudivyaṃ svargasamaṃ hyabhūt ।।1.440.80 ।।

anyā nagararakṣārthaṃ yoginyaḥ sthāpitā yathā ।
madārikāyāṃ śrīmātā, śāntā nandāpure tathā ।।81 ।।
sāvitrī, jñānajā cāpi, gātrāyī, pakṣiṇī tathā, ।
chatrajā, cūṭikā, dvāravāsinī, pippalā tathā ।।82 ।।
śīhorī, śāpurī, cetā, raktavastrā, bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
ānandā ca, tathauṃkārā, tathā ca dharmaputrikā, ।।83।।

śyāmalā, ceti tā rakṣāṃ kurvanti dharmadeśitāḥ ।
atha karṇāṭanāmā'bhūd rākṣaso viprapīḍakaḥ ।।84।।
yogamālinī taṃ vidrāvayāmāsa ca dakṣiṇām ।
tannāmnā so'bhavad deśaḥ karṇāṭaka itiprathaḥ ।।85।।
tayā tūtpāditāḥ krūrā brahmacāriṇya eva tāḥ ।
śākinī ḍākinī cāpi kākinī hākinī tathā ।।86।।
ekinī lākinī caitāḥ śaktayo daityanāśikāḥ ।
dharmāraṇye prarakṣārthaṃ dharmadevena vāsitāḥ ।।87।।
etāḥ pativratāḥ sarvā rudrakāntasya sevikāḥ ।
viprāṇāṃ rakṣikā nityaṃ satīvaṃśasya rakṣikāḥ ।।88।।
tayā cotpāditā lakṣmi! tadanyāśca pativratāḥ ।
rudravratā mahādevyo dharmāraṇyakṛtāśrayāḥ ।।89।।
tā etā brahmacāriṇyaḥ kanyakāḥ kuladevatāḥ ।
rakṣyante sarvadā yābhirviprakulāni bhūtale ।। 1.440.90।।
bhaṭṭārikī tathā chatrā auvikā jñānajā tathā ।
bhadrakālī ca māheśī siṃhorī dhanamardinī ।।91।।
gātrā śāntā śeṣadevī vārāhī bhadrayoginī ।
yogeśvarī mohalajjā kuleśī śakulācitā ।।92।।
tāraṇī kanakānandā cāmuṇḍā ca sureśvarī ।
dārabhaṭṭāriketyādyāḥ pratyekāḥ śatadhā punaḥ ।।93।।
utpannāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvā dharmāraṇyādikāśrayāḥ ।
atha dharmapitā cakre dharmāraṇye mahākratum ।।94।।
tatra devāśca pitaraḥ ṛṣayo munayo narāḥ ।
manavādyāścaturdaśabhuvaneśāḥ samāyayuḥ ।।95।।
tatrācāryaṃ tvāṃgirasaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
atriṃ ca kaśyapaṃ cāpi hotāraṃ samakalpayat ।।96।।
jamadagniṃ gautamaṃ ca adhvaryuṃ samakalpayat ।
bharadvājaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ ca pratyadhvaryuṃ prakalpayat ।।97।।
nāradaṃ cāpi vālmīkiṃ preritāramakalpayat ।
brahmāsane tu brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa dharmarāṭ ।।98।।
krośacatuṣkamātrāṃ suvedīṃ kṛtvā suraistataḥ ।
dvijāḥ sarve samāhūtā jāpakāḥ pāṭhakāstathā ।।99।।
dvārapālā gaṇeśaskandendrajayantakāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
tato rakṣoghnamantreṇa hūyate havyavāhane ।। 1.440.10 0।।
juhuvuste tadā devā vedamantrairhi padmaje ।
tilāṃśca yavamiśrāṃśca madhvājyena sumiśritān ।। 101 ।।
āghārāvājyabhāgau ca hutvā cāpi tataḥ param ।
drākṣekṣupūganāriṅgajambīraṃ bījapūrakam ।। 10 2।।
uttarato nārikelaṃ dāḍimaṃ ca yathākramam ।
madhvājyaṃ payasā yuktaṃ kṛśaraṃ śarkarāyutam ।। 103 ।।
taṇḍulaiḥ śatapatraiśca kṛtvā yajñaṃ sadakṣiṇam ।
uttamaṃ ca śubhaṃ stomaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca jagustadā ।। 1 04।।
avāritā'nnamadadaddīnāndhakṛpaṇeṣvapi ।
pāyasaṃ śarkarāyuktaṃ sājyaśākasamanvitam ।। 1 05।।
maṇḍakā vaṭakāḥ pūpāstathā vai veṣṭikāḥ śubhāḥ ।
sahasramodakāścāpi pheṇikā ghurghurādayaḥ ।। 106 ।।
odanaśca tathā dālī āḍhakyādikṛtadravā ।
tathaiva mudgadālīṃ ca parpaṭā vaṭikā tathā ।। 1 07।।
sapippalīlavaṃgamarīcāni lohyakāni ca ।
kulmāṣā vellakāścāpi komalā vālakāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1 08।।
karkariṭāścārdrakāśca maricena samanvitāḥ ।
vividhāni suśākāni bhājāśca vidhidhāstathā ।। 1 09।।
pāyasāni caikṣavāni godhūmāni sahasraśaḥ ।
miṣṭānnāni caṇakānāṃ bhojayitvā dvijān vṛṣaḥ ।। 1.440.110 ।।
aṣṭādaśapralakṣāँśca tathā'nyān koṭiśo janān ।
kṛtvā'vabhṛthakaṃ snānaṃ yajñaphalamavāpa saḥ ।। 111 ।।
yajñaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ sarve svasvasthānāni dehinaḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya viṣṇuyāgaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 11 2।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dharmāraṇye śrīkṛṣṇadāsīnāṃ pativratānāṃ gāndharvībhūtānāṃ kuladevīmaṇḍalatvaṃ, tathā viprādīnāṃ gotrapravarādiḥ, devīkṛto lolajihvarākṣasanāśaḥ, yoginīnāṃ sthāpanā, dharmadevakṛtayajñaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 440 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 440 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 441
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 442 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! yathā strīṇāṃ kṛṣṇasyā''rādhanaṃ tathā ।
yena muktirbhaveccāpi taṃ dharmaṃ pravadāmyaham ।। 1 ।।
dharmoḍhā yā bhavet patnī daśadoṣavivarjitā ।
aklībā'vyaṅginī śastā mahārogādyadūṣitā ।। 2 ।।
aninditā śubhakalā cakṣūrogavivarjitā।
bādhiryahīnā capalā kanyā madhurabhāṣiṇī ।। 3 ।।
dūṣaṇairdaśabhirhīnā yathoktavidhinā naraiḥ ।
vivāhitā tu sā patnī gṛhiṇī khyāyate satī ।। 4 ।।
puṇyakāryeṣu sarveṣu prathamā sā pratiṣṭhati ।
tayā suvihito dharmaḥ sampūrṇaphalado bhavet ।। 5 ।।
kāryaṃ strībhiḥ sadā kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsmṛtya pañcayajñakam ।
snānaṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ cāpi vahnihomo'cyutā'rcanam ।। 6 ।।
atitheḥ satkṛtiśceti pañcayajñānna saṃtyajet ।
pañcayajñaistu santuṣṭā bhavanti pitṛdevatāḥ ।। 7 ।।
striyāḥ pativratāyāstu patiśuśrūṣayā mudā ।
patyātmake harau tuṣṭā bhavanti pitṛdevatāḥ ।। 8 ।।
pativratāyā dehe tu sarve devā vasanti hi ।
atastayā svāminā yuktayā dharmasya cāgamaḥ ।। 9 ।।
ubhayormānase caikye santuṣṭāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ ।
sarvakāryaprasiddhiśca phalaṃ sampadyate śubham ।। 1.441.10 ।।
samānajātisaṃbhūtā patnī vivāhitā bhavet ।
tasyā bhartā'rdhabhāgī syād dharmakāryeṣu sarvathā ।। 11 ।।
ardhadehādhikāro'syāstena dharmārdhadhāriṇī ।
patirdharmārdhadhārī ca dvayoḥ śubhe'śubhe'pi ca ।। 12।।
yā'nugacchati bhartāraṃ mṛtaṃ sutapasā priye! ।
sādhvī mahāsatī jñeyā yayā tūddhriyate kulam ।। 13 ।।
yaṃ kaṃcidvā patiṃ mṛtaṃ dhṛtā vā'tha vivāhitā ।
vaiśvānarasya mārgeṇa sā tamuddharate patim ।। 14।।
yathā tu tārako majjantaṃ samuddharate jalāt ।
tathā coddharate sādhvī bhartāraṃ yā'nugacchati ।। 15 ।।
yā kanyā svayamudyamya pitrā dattā varāya sā ।
vivāhavidhinodūḍhā pitṛdevārthasādhinī ।।16 ।।
vivāhā daśadhā. proktāstadanyatamameva yā ।
avalambya patiṃ prāptā sā samuddharate kulam ।। 17।।
punarvivāhitā sā'pi satī cet kulatāriṇī ।
krayakrītā bhaved dāsī kintu cet sā vivāhitā ।। 18।।
satī proktā dharmavatī sā samuddharate kulam ।
pavitrakulajā raṅkā dharmoḍhā yadi sādhvikā ।। 1 9।।
sā punāti kulaṃ sarvaṃ pātivratyaprabhāvataḥ ।
prājāpatyastathā brāhmo daivā''rṣau te saduttamāḥ ।।1.441.20।।
gāndharvaścāsuraścāpi rākṣasaśca piśācakaḥ ।
prātibho ghātakaśceti vivāhāḥ kathitā daśa ।।21 ।।
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaścāpi datta kṛtrima ityapi ।
gūḍhotpanno'paviddhaśca kānīnaśca sahoḍhajaḥ ।। 22
krītaḥ paunarbhavaścāpi putrāste daśadhā matāḥ ।
evaṃ sutasutādārapatipitṛkuṭumbinaḥ ।। 23 ।।
pātivratyena tīryante satībhiḥ kṛṣṇasevayā ।
devavad divi dīvyanti striyaḥ satyaḥ pativratāḥ ।। 24।।
sarvāsāṃ yoṣitāṃ lakṣmi kṛṣṇabhaktiḥ sadā śubhā ।
śuddhyarthaṃ sadguroḥ sevā gurupūjā sadoditā ।। 25।।
svargārthe svāminaḥ sevā patipūjā sadoditā ।
mokṣārthe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpaṇaṃ tu yoṣitām ।।26।।
evaṃ dharme samāśritya śūdraḥ paijavanaḥ purā ।
sādhvyā svabhāryayā sākaṃ kṛṣṇalokaṃ yayau purā ।।27।।
āsīt sa dharmanirato viṣṇubrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ ।
nyāyā''gatadhane tuṣṭaḥ strīyutaḥ sevakaḥ satām ।। 28 ।।
satyavādī vaiṣṇāvo'bhūt tasya bhāryā ca sundarī ।
dharmoḍhā tūktavidhinā samānakulajā śubhā ।। 2 9।।
pativratā mahābhāgā devadvijahite ratā ।
kāśyāṃ sambandhitā kanyā vaijayantyāṃ vivāhitā ।।1.441.3 0 ।।
sā dharmācaraṇe dakṣā vaiṣṇavavratadhāriṇī ।
bhartāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā prasevate ।। 31 ।।
arthāptiḥ sukṛtapuṇyairvardhate'syā gṛhe sadā ।
vāṇijyena saphalena vyāpāreṇa satīpateḥ ।। 3 2 ।।
evamarthaśca bahudhā saṃjāto dharmadarśinaḥ ।
putradvayaṃ ca sañjātaṃ putryaśceti ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 33 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāḥ pitṛsevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
pitroḥ śuśrūṣaṇe raktāḥ patnī pativratā sadā ।। 34।।
sarve saṃpūjyapūjāṃ saṃkurvanti sevanādikam ।
kṛpṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā pūjayantyatithīṃstathā ।। 31।।
ṛddhimadbhavanaṃ teṣāṃ dhanadhānyasamanvitam ।
gṛhāgato na vimukho yeṣāṃ yāti kadācana ।। 36 ।।
śītakāle dhanaṃ prāduruṣṇakāle jalā'nnadāḥ ।
varṣākāle vastradāśca babhūvānnapradāḥ sadā ।। 37।।
vāpīkūpataḍāgādiprapādevagṛhāṇi ca ।
kārayantyucite kāle kṛṣṇabhaktivratasthitāḥ ।। 38।।।
paṃktibhedo gṛhe naiṣāṃ samabhāgena toṣiṇaḥ ।
evaṃ vai vartamānānāṃ gṛhe śrīgālavo muniḥ ।।3 9।।
samājagāma bahubhirbhaktaśiṣyaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ।
sundarīsahitaḥ paijavanaḥ putrādisaṃyutaḥ ।।1.441.40।।
svāgataṃ kṛtavāँstasya cābhyutthānāsanādibhiḥ।
atiharṣaṃ gatastatra pādayorjalamāpiban ।।41 ।।
kṛtārthaṃ mānayan naijaṃ kuṭumbaṃ samuvāca saḥ ।
adya me saphalaṃ janma jātaṃ jīvitamuttamam ।।42।।
adya me saphalo dharmaḥ sakulaścoddhṛtastvayā ।
mama pāpasahasrāṇi dṛṣṭyā dagdhāni te mune! ।।43।।
harirnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo gālavo me gṛhāgataḥ ।
gṛhaṃ mama gṛhasthasya kṛṣṇena pāvitaṃ tvayā ।।44।।
iti śrutvā mahābhaktyā gatamārgapariśramaḥ ।
prasanno gālavaḥ śūdraṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ bahu ।।45।।
kaccitte kuśalaṃ saumya mano dharme pravartate ।
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvāḥ kaccitte dārabālakāḥ ।।46।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe kaccidbhaktiste dānapūrvikā ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu sasnehaṃ mānasaṃ tu vai ।।47।।
viṣṇupādodakaṃ nityaṃ śirasā dhāryate nu kim ।
satīyaṃ sarvathā kṛṣṇakāntasevāparā nu kim ।।48।।
satyā vai dhāryate sarvaṃ satyā saṃrakṣyate tathā ।
satyā nistīryate duḥkhāt satī sukhādisādhanam ।।49।।
sa ityuktaḥ paijavanaḥ pratyuvāca kṛpā tava ।
yanme sarvaṃ tathā tvāste viśeṣo'nugrahastava ।।1.441.50।।
śādhi māṃ sevakaṃ matvā sevikā tu satīmimām ।
sevakāँśca sutān sutāḥ prastutāgamakāraṇam ।।51 ।।
gālavastān samuvāca yasya bhaktiḥ sadā'cyute ।
yasya bhāryā satī sādhvī patikṛṣṇapativratā ।।52।।
yasya putrā harerdāsā dāsyaḥ putryaḥ sato hareḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ bāndhavādyāśca vaiṣṇavā yasya pāvanāḥ ।।53 ।।
eteṣāṃ saṃgame tīrthe muktiḥ kvāpi na durlabhā ।
kuṭumbaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yaddhi brahmapiṇḍamidaṃ śubham ।।54।।
yasya saṃdarśanādeva pūto bhavati cāghavān ।
nirguṇasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yogatastava ।।55।।
sarvaṃ nirguṇatāṃ prāptaṃ bhaktiyug dāsadharmataḥ ।
strīṇāmapi ca sādhvīnāṃ bhaktiyug dāsadharmatā ।।।66।।
premadharmo ballavīnāṃ śabaryāśca harāvabhūt ।
piṅgalāyāḥ premadharmo muktidaḥ pāvano'bhavat ।।57।।
kṛṣṇaśvetagireḥ putryāḥ premadharmo'bhavacchive ।
tena varṣasahasrānte samprāpa sā maheśvaram ।।58।।
pārvatyāśca prabhāyāśca lalitāyāstathā priye! ।
lakṣmyā jayāyā māṇikyāyāśca sneho'tikāṣṭhagaḥ ।।59।।
abhavacchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe'vāpuśca tāḥ patim ।
vṛndāyāśca tulasyāśca vivāhaḥ snehamūlagaḥ ।।1.441.60 ।।
tulasīpatrakaiḥ kṛṣṇārcayā mokṣo bhaved dhruvam ।
snehamūlo harau mokṣaḥ satyāḥ patyau tathā mataḥ ।।61 ।।
vṛndādyā api lokānāṃ tārakāścā'bhavan kṣitau ।
śṛṇu bhaktaikadā sarve pitaro hi purā yuge ।।62।।
yayurbhojanatṛptyarthaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ tadā ।
tṛptyarthaṃ salilaṃ yadyad varuṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ śubham ।।63।।
vinā tu tarpaṇairnaiva grāhyaṃ no pitṝṇāṃ yataḥ ।
kenāpi dīyamānaṃ tad grāhyaṃ bhavati tṛptikṛt ।।64।।
tasmādasmatpratṛptyarthaṃ kiñcidvidhehi pūrvaja ।
ityarthitastadā brahmā śrīkṛṣṇaśaraṇaṃ yayau ।।65।।
prārthayāmāsa tṛptyarthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu jalāptaye ।
tadā bhagavatā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena vai ।।66।।
kṣaṇaṃ vicārya kathitaṃ sarvātmā bhagavānaham ।
sarveṣāṃ tṛptikṛccāsmi nānyo bhavati tādṛśaḥ ।।67।।
tasmānmayā yathā teṣāṃ tṛptiḥ syāt kāryameva tat ।
sarve janāśca māṃ kutra prāpsyanti divyarūpiṇam ।।68।।
tasmānmayā śubhaṃ rūpaṃ jalatarpaṇahetave ।
dhāraṇīyaṃ jagatprāṇidattakalyāṇakṛdbhavet ।।69।।
vicāryetthaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo'śvattharūpo babhūva ha ।
pippalo mūrtimān bhūtvā divyadeho janārdanaḥ ।।1.441.70।।
revatādrau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāmodarasthale ।
dvābhyāṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra nārāyaṇe hrade ।।71 ।।
tasthau tadā plakṣamūle kṛṣṇadvayena mantrataḥ ।
jalaṃ pradattaṃ tīrthasya tṛptāste pitarastataḥ ।।72।।
evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
plakṣā'vatāraṃ dhṛtavān raivatādrau purā yuge ।।73।।
atharṣibhirjaladānaṃ pippalasya sadā kṛtam ।
pippale'rpitasalilaṃ trailokyāṃ prāpyate gataiḥ ।।74।।
atha devā mahendrādyāḥ śivādyā vaiṣṇavāstathā ।
kṛṣṇaṃ lokayituṃ tatra yayurnārāyaṇe hrade ।।75।।
svarṇarekhānadītīre vane kṛṣṇaḥ pramārgitaḥ ।
anveṣyamāṇo'pi hariḥ kaiścittatra hi māyayā ।।76।।
vṛkṣarūpo hi bhagavān vijñāto naiva naiva ca ।
tato devā bṛhaspatiṃ prāhurvai bhagavān hariḥ ।।77।।
drumatā saṃgataḥ so'yaṃ kathaṃ draṣṭuṃ hi śakyate ।
tadā bṛhaspatiḥ prāha vṛkṣaśced draṣṭumīṣyate ।।78।
vṛkṣanetrairvṛkṣarūpo hariḥ pratyakṣatāṃ vrajet ।
ityuktāste surāḥ sarve nārāyaṇahradā'ntike ।।79।।
vṛkṣarūpadharā jātāstadā kṛṣṇaṃ pravīkṣitum ।
śrīstatra tulasīrūpā pārvatībhālabindujaḥ ।।1.441.8 0 ।।
mahātarurbilvasaṃjñaḥ pārvatī bilvarūpiṇī ।
jātā tatra tadā brahmā vaṭarūpo babhūva ha ।।8 1 ।।
sāvitrī tilagulmākhyā satilā saṃbabhūva ha ।
mahendro yavavṛkṣo'bhūccūtavṛkṣāḥ prajeśvarāḥ ।।82।।।
gandharvā malayavṛkṣā aguruśca gaṇādhipaḥ ।
samudrā vaitasavṛkṣā yakṣāḥ punnāgabhūruhāḥ ।।83 ।।
nāgavṛkṣāstadā nāgāḥ siddhāḥ kaṃkolakadrumāḥ ।
guhyakāḥ panasavṛkṣāḥ kinnarā maricadrumāḥ ।।84।।
yaṣṭimadhudruḥ kandarpo vahniḥ raktāṃjanadrumaḥ ।
yamo bibhītakavṛkṣo nirṛtirbakuladrumaḥ ।।85 ।।
varuṇaḥ kharjurīvṛkṣaḥ pūgavṛkṣastu mārutaḥ ।
dhanado'kṣoṭakavṛkṣo rudrāstu badarīdrumāḥ ।।।86।।।
saptarṣayo mahātālā elādrumāḥ pare surāḥ ।
jambūvṛkṣāstadā meghā aśokā vidyuto'bhavan ।।87।।
priyālā vasavo jātā ādityāstu japādrumāḥ ।
madanau tu tadā'śvinīkumārakau babhūvatuḥ ।।88 ।।
viśvedevāstu madhukā rākṣasā gugguladrumāḥ ।
sūryastvarkadrumaścātha palāśaścandramā'bhavat ।। 89।।
maṃgalaḥ khadiro jātaścāpāmārgo budho'bhavat। ।
bṛhaspatistadā'śvatthaḥ śukro hyudumbaro'bhavat ।। 1.441.90 ।।
śanaiścaraḥ śamīvṛkṣo rāhurdurvātmako'bhavat ।
keturdarbhasvarūpo'bhūttathā phaladrumo'pi saḥ ।। 91 ।।
satyastā devapatnyo babhūvurvallayastadā ।
viṣṇuḥ śālasvarūpo'bhūt hyapāmārgo'sya vāhanaḥ ।। 92।।

śrīvatsaḥ.śrīvatso'bhūt kalpavṛkṣaḥ kārtikaścampako hyabhūt ।
nārado'bhūtpārijāto gaurī vṛndā'bhavattadā ।। 93 ।।
lakṣmīstu mālatī jātā dhātrī sarasvatī hyabhūt ।
atha sthalāntare'raṇye tatraiva bahurūpadhṛk ।।94।।
aśvattharūpī bhagavān viṣṇurjātaḥ surūpadhṛk ।
vaṭarūpo'bhavadrudro brahmā palāśarūpadhṛk ।। 99।।
dhavaladrustadā nandī śaṃbhurbilvasvarūpadhṛk ।
indraḥ śirīṣarūpo'bhūnnimvavṛkṣaḥ prabhākaraḥ ।।96।।
śivāśivau bilvavṛkṣau śivā vṛndāsvarūpiṇī।
brahmārudrau vaṭavṛkṣau brahmā palāśarūpavān । ।। 97 ।।
candramāśca palāśo'bhūnnimbārkau sūryarūpiṇau ।
aśvattharūpau vipṇubṛhaspatī ceti vai dvidhā । । 98 ।।
tattadvṛkṣe'vāntarajātīyakau tau matau tadā ।
ete kṛṣṇaṃ drusvarūpā drunetraistaṃ vyalokayan ।। 99 ।।
mahatpatrānvito'śvattho dṛṣṭo nārāyaṇe hrade ।
kṛṣṇastena svarūpeṇa jalā''dānasya hetave । । 1.441.100 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ tṛptilābhāya vartate sma kṛpālayaḥ ।
tanmūle brāhmaṇaiścāpi nārāyaṇadvayena ca । । 101 ।।
patnīvratena devenārpitaṃ svarṇanadījalam ।
tatsarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitaṃ tu pitṛṣu । । 102 । ।
prāptaṃ tṛptipradaṃ jātaṃ tasmāt pippalamarcayeta ।
tadvaśāścāpi te vṛkṣāḥ sthāsyanti pitumokṣadāḥ ।। 103 ।।
yāvatkṛṣṇaḥ pippaladruḥ sthāsthatyāpralayaṃ kṣiteḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ mokṣadāścaite devadrumāḥ supūjitāḥ ।। 108 । ।
strīṇāṃ tathā'nyavarṇānāṃ mokṣadāḥ sevanāddhi te ।
ityuktvā jalamādāya datvā pitṛbhya eva saḥ । । 1 09। ।
kṛṣṇo yayau nijaṃ lokaṃ mūlrarūpeṇa gosthalam ।
devāḥ svaṃ svaṃ yayurlokaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇāḥ । । 106 ।।
gālavasya mukhāttvetat paijavanastriyā śrutam ।
sundaryā ca tadā saṃkalpitaṃ pativrataṃ muhuḥ । । 10 7 । ।
yathā vai gālavaścāyaṃ prakāśayati devatāḥ ।
yadi tāḥ satyarūpāḥ syurdrumātmānaḥ surādayaḥ ।। 108 ।।
tadvā me darśanaṃ bhūyātteṣāṃ tattatsvarūpataḥ ।
yadyahaṃ patidharmā'smi pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।। 109 । ।
iti saṃkalpite lakṣmi! sarve devāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
vṛkṣavallīsvarūpāśca tayā dṛṣṭāstathātmakāḥ ।। 1.441.11 0 । ।
punaḥ saṃkalpitaṃ tatra sundaryā syāṃ pativratā ।
tadā gālavaśiṣyāṇāṃ bhojanāni bhavantviti ।। 111 । ।
tāvat tatra sumiṣṭānnaparvatāstvabhavan priye ।
saśiṣyo gālavo bhuktvā yayau svāśramaṃ priye । । 112 । ।
devatā svasvarūpāśca satkṛtāḥ svasthalaṃ yayuḥ ।
tadārabhya satīnāryaḥ pūjayanti drumān muhuḥ । । 113 ।।
yajñe pavitrarūpāste devadrumāḥ supuṇyadāḥ ।
hūyante svargadā mokṣapradāḥ sampatpradāśca te । । 1 14।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! strīṇāṃ vṛkṣādipūjanam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi svargamokṣasupuṇyadam ।। 115।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gālavapradarśitānāṃ strīmokṣapradasaralopāyānāṃ madhye tulasyādivividhavṛkṣāṇāṃ devatādyavatāratvaṃ tatpūjanādinā mokṣaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।441 ।।


ṭippaṇī
1.441.93 śrīvatso'bhūt kalpavṛkṣaḥ iti
sītopaniṣadi 35 kathanamasti yat icchāśakteḥ trayaḥ rūpāḥ santi - yogaśaktiḥ śrīvatsaḥ, bhogaśaktiḥ kalpavṛkṣādi evaṃ vīraśaktiḥ kalpavṛkṣasya mūle sthitā caturbhujā lakṣmīdevī


← adhyāyaḥ 441 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 442
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 443 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! patikṛṣṇavrataṃ mokṣapradāyakam ।
pāvanaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktaṃ tu suyajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ param ।। 1 ।।
brahmaṇastu sutaḥ svāyaṃbhuvo manurbabhūva ha ।
uttānapādastatputrastatputro dhruvanāmakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
dhruvaputra utkalo'bhūnnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।
sahasraṃ rājasūyānāṃ puṣkare sa cakāra ha ।। 3 ।।
tasya nāma svayaṃ brahmā suyajñaṃ pracakāra ha ।
sa cānnadātā ratnānāṃ dātā ca sarvasampadām ।। 4 ।।
daśalakṣaṃ gavāṃ cāpi ratnaśṛṃgaparicchadam ।
gavāṃ dvādaśalakṣaṇāṃ dadau nityaṃ mudānvitaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ṣaṭkoṭīrbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojayāmāsa nityaśaḥ ।
coṣyaiścarvyairlehyapeyairatitṛptaṃ dine dine ।। 6 ।।
vipralakṣaṃ sūpakāraṃ bhojayāmāsa tatparam ।
dine suyajñayajñānte ṣaṭtriṃśallakṣakoṭayaḥ ।। 7 ।।
cakruḥ subhojanaṃ viprāścātitṛptāśca sundari ।
gṛhītāni tu ratnāni svagṛhaṃ voḍhumakṣamāḥ ।। 8 ।।
yebhyaḥ kebhyo daduścāpi bahuśaḥ pathi tatyajuḥ ।
viprānyebhyo'pi sarvebhyo bhojanāni daduśca te ।। 9 ।।
tathāpyurvaritaṃ tatra tvannarāśisahasrakam ।
evaṃ yajñaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā suyajño rājasaṃsadi ।। 1.442.10 ।।
samuvāsa mahāratnaklṛpte siṃhāsane śubhe ।
paṭṭavastraiḥ śobhite sucandanādisugandhite ।। 11 ।।
śākhāyuktaiḥ pūrṇakuṃbhaiḥ ramāvṛkṣaiḥ suśobhite ।
candanā'gurukasturīghanasindūrasaṃskṛte ।। 12 ।।
vasuvāsavacandrendrarudrādityasamanvite ।
munināradamanvādibrahmaviṣṇuharānvite ।। 13 ।।
etasminnantare tatra vipra ekaḥ samāyayau ।
rūkṣo malinavāsāśca cakre nṛpaṃ śubhāśiṣaḥ ।। 14।।
rājā taṃ praṇanāmā'pi nottasthau svavarāsanāt ।
sabhāsado'pi nottasthurmanāg jahasustaṃ prati ।। 15'।।
tena kruddho dvijastatra śaśāpa nṛpatiṃ yathā ।
rājyabhraṣṭo galatkuṣṭhī buddhihīno bhavā'dhunā ।। 16।।
tāvatsabhāsado nemuruttasthustena bhūsuraḥ ।
tatyāja roṣaṃ rājā'pi pādayoḥ patitastataḥ ।। 17।।
ṛṣayastatra taṃ vipraṃ daduḥ śreṣṭhaṃ śubhāsanam ।
pulahaśca pulastyaśca pracetā bhṛguraṅgirāḥ ।। 18।।
marīciḥ kaśyapaścāpi vaśiṣṭhaḥ kraturityapi ।
śukro bṛhaspatiścāpi durvāsā lomaśastathā ।। 1 9।।
gautamaśca kaṇādaśca kaṇvaḥ kātyāyanaḥ kaṭhaḥ ।
pāṇinirjājaliścāpi ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।।1.442.20।।
taittiriścāpyāpiśalirmārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ ।
sanakaśca sanandaśca voḍhuḥ pailaḥ sanātanaḥ ।। 21 ।।
sanatkumāro naro nārāyaṇaśca parāśaraḥ ।
patnīvrato jaratkāruḥ saṃvarttaḥ karabhastathā ।। 22।।
bharadvājaśca vālmīkiraurvaśca cyavanastathā ।
agastyo'trirutathyaśca saṃkartā''stīka āsuriḥ ।।23।।
śilālirlāṃgaliścāpi śākalyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ ।
gargo vatsaḥ pañcaśikho jamadagniśca devalaḥ ।।24।।
jaigiṣavyo vāmadevo vālakhilyāśca lakṣaśaḥ ।
śaktirdakṣaḥ kardamaśca praskannaḥ kapilastathā ।।25।।
viśvāmitraśca kautsaścāpyṛcīko'pyaghamarṣaṇaḥ ।
svayaṃprakāśo brahmiṣṭhaḥ śatānandaśca suvrataḥ ।।26।।
ete tvanye ca munayaḥ pitaro'gnihaviḥpriyāḥ ।
dikpālā devatāḥ sarvāḥ samūcurbrāhmaṇaṃ kramāt ।।27।।
tava śāpena viprendra rājño lakṣmyā layo bhavet ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu hṛdayaṃ komalaṃ tapasā sadā ।।28।।
kṣamasvā''śiṣamādhatsva tadgṛhaṃ pāvanaṃ kuru ।
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivartate ।।29।।
pitarastasya devāśca vahniḥ prayāntyatoṣitāḥ ।
paśyanti ye vakradṛṣṭyā tvatithiṃ gṛhamāgatam ।।1.442.3 0।।
datvā svapāpaṃ tasmai tatpuṇyamādāya gacchati ।
rājā svagarvadoṣeṇa nottasthau tatkṣamāṃ kuru ।।3 1 ।।
rājyaśriyā vidyayā vā brāhmaṇaṃ yo'vamanyate ।
śriyāhīno bhavet sadyo vratanaivedyavarjitaḥ ।।32।।
dīkṣā vyarthā bhavettasya dhanaputrādihīnatā ।
bhāryāhīno bhaveccāpi kṣamasvā'syā'parādhakam ।।33।।
atithiṃ pitarau devaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ gurum ।
avamanyeta yaḥ so'tra bhaktibhraṣṭo bhaveddhruvam ।।34।।
atithiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā nā'bhyutthānaṃ karoti yaḥ ।
prāpnoti kauṃjarīṃ yonimaraṇye saptajanmasu ।।35।।
śīghraṃ dayāṃ vidhāyaiva rājñe dehyāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥ ।
guruṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi devatāpratimāmapi ।।36।।
dṛṣṭvā śīghraṃ na praṇamet sa bhavet sukaro bhuvi ।
kṣamasva sarvamasmākaṃ cātithyagrahaṇaṃ kuru ।।37।।
strīghnagoghnakṛtaghnānāṃ gurustrīgāmināṃ tathā ।
brahmaghnānāṃ pāpabhāk syādatitheravamānakṛt ।।38।।
ityārṣavācaḥ saṃśrutvā rājā papraccha tānmunīn ।
strīghnādīnāṃ tu kiṃ pāpaṃ brūta māṃ yogināṃ varāḥ ।।39।।
vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha rājendra śṛṇu govadhajaṃ hi tat ।
kāmato govadhe rājan varṣaṃ tīrthaṃ bhramennaraḥ ।।1.442.40।।
yavayāvakabhojī ca kareṇa tu jalaṃ pibet ।
tato dhenuśataṃ divyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadakṣiṇam ।।41 ।।
datvā muñcati pāpāttu bhojayitvā śataṃ dvijān ।
prāyaścitte tu vai cīrṇe sarvapāpānna mucyate ।।42।।
pāpāvaśeṣād bhavati duḥkhī cāṇḍāla eva saḥ ।
gohatyādviguṇaṃ pāpaṃ strīhatyāyāṃ bhaveddhruvam ।।43।।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi kālasūtre vaseddhi saḥ ।
tato bhavet sūkaraśca sarpaśca saptajanmasu ।।44।।
strīhatyādviguṇaṃ pāpaṃ brahmahatyākṛto bhavet ।
lakṣavarṣaṃ mahāghore kubhīpāke vaseddhi saḥ ।।45।।
viṣṭhākṛmiḥ śatābdaṃ ca sarpaśca saptajanmasu ।
doṣaḥ kṛtaghne rājendra brahmahatyācaturguṇaḥ ।।46।।
niṣkṛtirnāsti rājendra kṛtaghnānāṃ vinirmitā ।
kṛtaghnāḥ ṣoḍaśavidhāḥ santi rājendra niścitāḥ ।।47।।
kṛte satye ca puṇye ca svadharme tapasi sthite ।
pratijñāyāṃ ca dāne ca svagoṣṭhīparipālane ।।48।।
gurukṛtye devakṛtye kāmyakṛtye dvijārcane ।
nityakṛtye ca viśvāse paramadharmapradānayoḥ ।।49।।
etān yo hanti pāpiṣṭhaḥ sa kṛtaghna iti smṛtaḥ ।
vividhānāṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ narakā vividhā api ।।1.442.50।।
kṛtvā śapatharūpaṃ ca satyaṃ hanti na pālayet ।
saḥ kṛtaghnaḥ kālasūtre vasatyeva caturyugam ।।51 ।।
saptajanmasu kākaśca saptajanmasu pecakaḥ ।
tataḥ śūdro mahāvyādhiḥ saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।।52।।
kṛtvā puṇyaṃ vadatyeva kīrtivardhanahetunā ।
sa kṛtaghnastaptakuṇḍe vasatyeva yugatrayam ।।53 ।।
pañcajanmasu maṇḍūkastriṣu janmasu karkaṭaḥ ।
tato mūko mahārugṇo daridro'pi tataḥ śuciḥ ।।54।।
kṛtvā svadharmaṃ yo hanti sandhyādharmavighātakaḥ ।
viṣṇupūjāmantrajāpanaivedyavratanindakaḥ ।।55।।।
devavratādihīnaśca pitṛkṛtyādivarjitaḥ ।
kṛtaghnaḥ sa kuṃbhīpāke vasatyākalpameva yat ।।56।।
saptajanmasu cāṇḍālo gṛdhnaśca śatajanmasu ।
sūkaraḥ śatajanmā ca tataścāṇḍālako bhavet ।।57।।
punaśca rauravaṃ gatvā gardabhaḥ pañcajanmasu ।
mārjāro maṇḍūkaḥ pañcajanmasu ca tataḥ punaḥ ।।58।।
vṛṣāṇāṃ vāhako vipro bhūtvā duḥkhāni vindati ।
bhṛtyadvārā svayaṃ vāpi yo vipro vṛṣavāhakaḥ ।।59।।
sa kṛtaghna iti bodhyaḥ puṇyahā sa yato mataḥ ।
brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tannityaṃ vṛṣatāḍane ।।1.442.60।।
vṛṣapṛṣṭhe bhāradānātpāpaṃ taddviguṇaṃ bhavet ।
sūryā''tape vāhayed yaḥ kṣudhitaṃ tṛṣitaṃ vṛṣam ।।61 ।।
brahmahatyāśataṃ pāpaṃ labhate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।
lālākuṇḍe vasatyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ।।62।।
viṣṭhābhakṣyaṃ mutrajalaṃ tatra tasya bhavet sadā ।
trisandhyaṃ tāḍayettaṃ tu śūlena yamakiṃkaraḥ ।।63।।
ulkāṃ dadāti mukhake sūcyā kṛntati santatam ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate kṛmiḥ ।।64।।
tataḥ kākaḥ pañcajanmasvathaivaṃ baka ityapi ।
pañcajanmasu gṛdhraśca śṛgālaḥ saptajanmasu ।।65।।
tato daridraḥ śūdraśca mahārugṇaḥ śucistataḥ ।
satīnāryā dharmalopī kṛtaghnaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ।।66।।
vṛṣalīśaḥ puṃścalīśaḥ kṛtaghnaḥ sa mato dvijaḥ ।
kṛmidaṃṣṭre vaset so'pi yāvadindrāścaturdaśa ।।67।।
pratimāṃ tāṃ taptalauhīmāśleṣayati nityaśaḥ ।
tataḥ śūdro bhaved duḥkhī tathā varṣasahasrakam ।।68।।
kṛtvā tapāṃsi puṇyānāṃ hantā kṛtaghna ucyate ।
anyācaritatapasāṃ hantā kṛtaghna ucyate ।।69।।।
vrataghnasya kṛtaghnasya kuṃbhīpāko'yutābdikaḥ ।
kṛtvā pratijñāṃ kāryasya datvā viśvāsamuttamam ।।1.442.70 ।।
karoti svapratijñāyā bhaṃgaṃ kṛtaghna eva saḥ ।
lohatapte tu taṃ kuṇḍe prajvālayati kalpakam ।।71 ।।
dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ yattad yo nāśayati śāṭhyataḥ ।
vāgdānaṃ vastudānaṃ ca kanyājñānapradānakam ।।72।।
hanti yaḥ sa vaset kālasūtre'yutayugā dhruvam ।
kṛtvā datvā svavacanaṃ goṣṭhīṃ vā hanti yo janaḥ ।।73।।
kāryahā goṣṭhīghna eva pāśakuṇḍe'yutābdikaḥ ।
gurukāryavihantā vai gurutāḍayitā ca yaḥ ।।74।।
gurughnaḥ sa kṛtaghno vai vahnikuṇḍe'yutābdikaḥ ।
devakṛtye devavṛttiharaḥ kṛtaghna ucyate ।।75।।
svadattāṃ paradattāṃ vā devādivṛttihārakaḥ ।
romavarṣasahasraṃ sa śūlaprote pratiṣṭhati ।।76 ।।
taptāṃgāraṃ ca tadbhakṣyaṃ pānaṃ vai taptamūtrakam ।
taptāṃgāreṣu śayanaṃ tāḍito yamakiṃkaraiḥ ।।77।।
tato viṣṭākṛmirbhūtvā varṣaṣaṣṭisahasrakam ।
tato daridraḥ kṛpaṇo bhūmiprajāvihīnakaḥ ।।78।।
rugṇo nindyo bhavecchūdraḥ kālāntare tataḥ śuciḥ ।
kāmyakṛtyavineṣṭā ca svaparasvarvināśakaḥ ।।79।।
hanti yaḥ parakīrtiṃ ca svakīrtiṃ ca narādhamaḥ ।
sa kṛtaghnaḥ kāmyakeṣṭāpūrtādināśakaḥ sa ca ।।1.442.80।।
andhakūpe mahāghore vasedākalpameva hi ।
nakulagṛdhrakīṭādyairbhakṣitastaptakṣārapaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
saptajanmasvataḥ sarpaḥ kākaḥ pañcasvataḥ śuciḥ ।
dvijārcanasya yo hantā kṛtaghnaḥ sa mahānmataḥ ।।82।।
brahmasvaṃ vā gurusvaṃ vā devasvaṃ vā'pi yo haret ।
avaṭode vasetso'pi kṛtaghnaḥ kalpameva yat ।।83।।
tato bhavet surāpaśca tataḥ śūdrastataḥ śuciḥ ।
nityakṛtyasya yo hantā sa kṛtaghno mahattaraḥ ।।84।।
pitṛmātṛgurūṃścāpi bhaktihīno na pālayet ।
na namecca sadā prātarvācāpi tāḍayenmuhuḥ ।।85।।
tathā svasvāminaṃ vācā tāḍayet kulaṭā tu yā ।
pūjyapūjāviloptāraḥ kṛtaghnāste prakīrtitāḥ ।।86 ।।
vahnikuṇḍe vasantyeva yāvaccandradivākarau ।
tato bhavejjalaukāśca saptajanmasvataḥ śuciḥ ।।87।।
viśvasya ghātanaṃ kuryāt kṛtaghnaḥ sa mahattamaḥ ।
mithyāsākṣyaṃ yo dadāti kāmāt krodhād bhayāttathā ।।88।।
sabhāyāṃ pākṣikaṃ vakti puṇyahantā kṛtaghnakaḥ ।
sarvatrāpi ca sarveṣāṃ kṛtasya sukṛtasya vai ।।89।।
bhogakṛtaṃ ca hantṛtvaṃ kṛtaghnatā prakīrtitā ।
puṇyahāḥ kṛtahāḥ proktaḥ puṇyaṃ tu naśvaraṃ sadā ।।1.442.90 ।।
tasmāt kṛṣṇaprasādākhye śāśvate na kṛtaghnatā ।
śāśvataṃ puṇyārthyaṃ vai naśvaraṃ nārthyameva tu ।।91।।
mithyāsākṣī pākṣikādirviśvāsahāśca puṇyahāḥ ।
yāvadindrasahasraṃ sa sarpakuṇḍe vased dhruvam ।।92।।।
sarpaistu bhakṣito bhuṃkte tadviṇmūtraṃ hi tāḍitaḥ ।
maṇḍūkaḥ kṛkalāsaśca saptajanmasu jāyate ।।93।।
tato'raṇye śālmalidrurmūkaśūdrastataḥ śuciḥ ।
paradāragamanādi paradharmāvamelanam ।।94।।
paradharmācaraṇaṃ vai kṛtaghnatve tu gaṇyate ।
svayogyakarmaṇāṃ rodhaḥ parārhakarmasaṃśrayaḥ ।।95।।
kṛtaghnatā bhavatyeva tadvāँścāṇḍālasadṛśaḥ ।
kuṃbhīpāke vasetso'pi kalpaparyantameva yat ।।96।।
agamyāgamakaḥ paścād bhavennapuṃsakastataḥ ।
galatkuṣṭhī saptajanmā śūdraḥ syācca tataḥ śuciḥ ।।97।।
lohasūrmyāṃ pateccāpi tato bhavennapuṃsakaḥ ।
cāṇḍālastu tato bhūtvā śūdro bhūtvā tataḥ śuciḥ ।।98।।
prakṛṣṭadānaṃ kanyādidānaṃ svarṇādikā'rpaṇam ।
kṛtvā taddhanti dānaṃ yaḥ kṛtaghnaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ ।।99।।
kṛtakāryasya nāśaśca kṛtaṃ jānāti naiva ca ।
kṛtaghnaḥ sa ṣoḍaśadhā kathito bhūpa sarvathā ।। 1.442.100 ।।
atitheravamānena jāyate tu kṛtaghnatā ।
taddoṣasya nivṛttyarthamatithiḥ pūjyatāṃ tvayā 101 ।।
gṛhe nītvā pūjyatāṃ ca tatpādābje prasevyatām ।
gṛhyatāṃ tatprasādaśca pajjalaṃ saṃnipīyatām ।। 1 02।।
arjyatāṃ cātitherāśīrdoṣaḥ pramārjyatāṃ tathā ।
tato vanaṃ gamyatāṃ ca punaḥ śrīḥ prāpyatāṃ śubhā ।। 103 ।।
smaryatāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmī śriyāḥ patiḥ ।
dāsyati te punarbhadrāṃ sampattiṃ mokṣamacyutaḥ ।। 1 04।।
ityuktvā munayaḥ sarve yayuḥ svasthānameva ca ।
suyajñastaṃ nanāmādau gṛhaṃ saṃprā''payad dvijam ।। 1 05।।
papraccha nāmagotrādi prasādya pūjayā muhuḥ ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha svakaṃ nāma sutapā iti viśrutam ।। 1 06।।
tatpitā virūpanāmā viśvarūpaśca tatpitā ।
tvaṣṭā tasya pitā cāpi tasya pitā ca kaśyapaḥ ।। 1 07।।
tatpitā ca marīcistatpitā tu viśvasṛṭ svayam ।
brahmaṇaḥ saptamaścāhaṃ puruṣo'smi bhuvaḥ pate! ।। 1 08।।
mahādevo mama gururvidyādātā sumantradaḥ ।
abhīṣṭadevaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 09।।
taccintayāmi pādābjaṃ na me vāñcchā'sti sampadi ।
sālokyasārṣṭisārūpyasāmīpyaṃ rādhikāpateḥ ।। 1.442.11 0।।
tena dattaṃ na gṛhṇāmi vinā tatpādasevanam ।
śrutvā suyajñayajñe te munīnāmāgamaṃ nṛpa ।। 111 ।।
lālasāṃ viṣṇubhaktiṃ te samprāpayitumāgataḥ ।
kevalānugṛhītastvaṃ nahi śapto mayā'dhunā ।। 11 2।।
samuddhṛtaśca patito ghore nimne bhavārṇave ।
na hyammayāni tīrthāni na devā mṛcchilāmayāḥ ।। 11 3।।
te punantyurukālena kṛṣṇabhaktāstu darśanāt ।
rājannirgamyatāṃ gehād dehi rājyaṃ sutāya tu ।। 1 14।।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhaja rādheśaṃ tadanyannaśvaraṃ tyaja ।
macchāpena mahadrājyaṃ parityaja sadā'nagha ।। 1 15।।
galaccharīraṃ tapasā kau kṣitau sthitimat kuru ।
rājyā''ḍambaramāyāḍhyabuddhyā saṃvirato bhava ।। 116 ।।
rājā viprājñayā śāntiṃ jagrāha viratiṃ tathā ।
papraccha tīvrasaṃvegaṃ golokā''ptiprakāraṇam ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyagīyasaṃhitāyāṃprathame kṛtayugasantāne suyajñarājño rājasūyānte'satkṛtasutapoviprakṛtaśāpaḥ, punastatkṛtakṛṣṇapativratopadeśe'tithimahimā, ṣoḍaśavidhakṛtaghnatā, ṛṣikṛtopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 442 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 442 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 443
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 444 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! suyajñaḥ sutapasaṃ prāha yattadā ।
he mune! naśvaraṃ sarvaṃ kadā kathaṃ vadā'tra me ।। 1 ।।
sādhanaṃ ca tathā tīvraṃ mokṣasya vad tatparam ।
iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā sutapāḥ prāha tattvavit ।। 2 ।।
śṛṇu rājan prakṛtijaṃ sarvaṃ naśvarameva yat ।
pātraṃ ṣaṭpalasaṃbhūtaṃ gabhīraṃ caturaṅgulam ।। 3 ।।
svarṇamāṣakṛtacchidraṃ daṇḍaiśca caturaṃgulaiḥ ।
yāvajjalaplutaṃ pātraṃ tatkālaṃ daṇḍa ityayam ।। 4 ।।
daṇḍadvayaṃ muhūrtaṃ ca yāmastasya catuṣṭayam ।
vāsarastvaṣṭabhiryāmaiḥ pakṣastairdaśapañcabhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
māso dvābhyāṃ ca pakṣābhyāṃ varṣaṃ dvādaśamāsakaiḥ ।
māsena vai narāṇāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ tadaharniśam ।। 6 ।।
kṛṣṇapakṣe dinaṃ proktaṃ śukle rātriḥ prakīrtitā ।
vatsareṇa narāṇāṃ vai devānāṃ tu divāniśam ।। 7 ।।
ayanamuttaramaho rātrirvai dakṣiṇāyanam ।
yugakramānurūpaṃ ca narādīnāṃ vayo nṛpa ।। 8 ।।
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti caturyugam ।
catvāri trīṇi dve caikaṃ sahasrāṇi kṛtādikam ।। 9 ।।
aṣṭaṣaṭcaturdviśatānyeṣāṃ sandhyāṃśakāni vai ।
varṣāṇi dve sahasre te dvādaśābdasahasrakam ।। 1.443.1 0।।
caturyugaṃ tato manvantaraṃ yugaikasaptatiḥ ।
divase brahmaṇaste tu manavaḥ syuścaturdaśa ।। 11 ।।
yathā divā tathā rātrau samayo vyeti vedhasaḥ ।
aṣṭāviṃśatimanavo'harniśaṃ brahmaṇo yataḥ ।। 12।।
ādyo manurbrahmaputraḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'bhavannṛpa ।
saṃprāpya śaṃkarād jñānaṃ kṛṣṇamantraṃ sudurlabham ।। 1 3।।
samprāpya kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ ca golokaṃ vai jagāma saḥ ।
svārociṣo manuścāpi dvitīyo vahninandanaḥ ।। 14।।
priyavratasutau manū tau tṛtīyacaturthakau ।
pañcamo raivato jātaścākṣuṣaḥ ṣaṣṭha īritaḥ ।। 15।।
śrāddhadevaḥ sūryasuto vaiṣṇavaḥ saptamo manuḥ ।
sāvarṇiḥ sūryatanayo vaiṣṇavo manuraṣṭamaḥ ।। 16।।
navamo dakṣasāvarṇirviṣṇuvrataparāyaṇaḥ ।
daśamo brahmasāvarṇirbrahmajñānaviśāradaḥ ।। 17।।
tataśca dharmasāvarṇirmanurekādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
jñānī ca rudrasāvarṇirmanustu dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 18।।
dharmātmā devasāvarṇirmanureṣastrayodaśaḥ ।
caturdaśo mahājñānī candrasāvarṇirantimaḥ ।। 1 9।।
yāvadāyurmanūnāṃ syādindrāṇāṃ tāvadeva tu ।
caturdaśendrāvacchinnaṃ brahmaṇo dinamekakam ।।1.443.20 ।।
tāvatī brahmaṇo rātriḥ sā ca brāhmī niśā nṛpa ।
tasyāṃ brahmaniśāyāṃ tu kṣudraḥ pralaya ucyate ।।21 ।।
devāśca manavaścātra lokā naśyanti vai daśa ।
evaṃ triṃśaddivārātrairbrahmaṇo māsa eva tu ।।22।।
varṣaṃ kalpasahasraṃ tu brahmaṇo jāyate nṛpa ।
evaṃ śatābdaparyaṃtaṃ paramāyuḥ prajāpateḥ ।।23।।
brahmaṇastu nipāte syād vairājakalpa ekakaḥ ।
vairājasya śatavarṣamāyustato'sya nāśanam ।।24।।
dinaṃ tattu mahāviṣṇoḥ sopi varṣaśatasthitiḥ ।
tato naśyati pradhānapuruṣasya dinaṃ tvidam ।।25।।
tasya varṣaśate yāte prakṛtipuruṣasya vai ।
dinaṃ bhavati vāpi śatavarṣottaraṃ layaḥ ।।26 ।।
akṣare brahmaṇi līno jāyate māyayā saha ।
prākṛtiko layaḥ so'yaṃ rādhā prakṛtirucyate ।।27।।
ātyantiko layo mokṣaḥ sa cātidurlabho nṛpa ।
etacchrutvā suyajñaśca papraccha sādhanaṃ drutam ।।28।।
mokṣadaṃ kiṃ yena yāmi golokaṃ dhāma śāśvatam ।
sutapāḥ prāha suyajña! bhaja rādhāṃ haripriyām ।।29।।
kṛṣṇapremamayīṃ yasyā vacaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi manyate ।
śīghraṃ yāsyasi golokaṃ tadanugrahasevayā ।।1.443.30।।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tu samārādhya cireṇa yānti godivam ।
kṛpārādhāṃ tu saṃsevya bhaktā yāntyacireṇa vai ।।3 1 ।।
rādhāṃśā tava patnī ca nāmnā rāseśvarīti yā ।
pativratā mahābhāgā gūḍhā rādhā'sti sā'tra te ।।32।।
patnīvrataṃ paraṃ kṛtvā pālayitvā tu tadvṛṣān ।
vijeṣyasi mahāmṛtyuṃ rādhāṃśāyāḥ pratāpataḥ ।।33।।
rājan kathayituṃ caitat tvāgamo me viśeṣataḥ ।
rāseśvarīṃ tava patnīṃ rādhāṃśāṃ dharmato bhaja ।।34।।
sā hyeṣā vartate sādhvī paśya divyena cakṣuṣā ।
ityuktvā nṛpaternetre pasparśa tāvadeva saḥ ।।35।।
dadarśa rādhikārūpāṃ satīṃ patnīṃ pativratām ।
āścaryacakito bhūtvā rādhāmantramavāpa saḥ ।।36।।
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ rāseśvaryai rādhikāyai svāhā iti ।
atha patnīvratadharmān śuśrāva sutapomukhāt ।।37।।
yathā kṛṣṇastathā rādhā rādhāṃśāḥ kṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ।
pātivratyaṃ yathā kṛṣṇe nārīdehasya sammatam ।।38।।
tathā patnīvratadharmaḥ kṛṣṇarādhāṃśasaṃbhave ।
prātarutthāya sadbhaktaḥ saṃsmared rādhikāṃ muhuḥ ।।39।।
saṃsnāpayetpūjayecca śṛṃgārayet subhojayet ।
sevayettoṣayediṣṭapradānaiḥ rañjayenmuhuḥ ।।1.443.40।।
nīrājayet saṃstuvīta svāpayet samavāhayet ।
eva rādhāṃ sadā patnīvrataḥ kṛṣṇātmikāṃ bhajet ।।41 ।।
na gṛhaṃ gṛhamityuktaṃ gṛhiṇī gṛhamucyate ।
rādhāṃśayā tayā smṛddhaṃ satejaskaṃ praśobhate ।।42।।
gṛhiṇī gṛhalakṣmīrvai tāṃ vinā gahvaraṃ gṛham ।
gṛhiṇyā tu tamovyāptamapi prakāśate gṛham ।।43।।
api śvā gṛhiṇīyukto grāmasiṃhaḥ prajāyate ।
api raṃkaḥ sabhāryastu kuṭumbitvena gaṇyate ।।44।।
api rājā priyāśūnyo nirvāsyate striyāḥ gṛhāt ।
kiṃkaro'pi gṛhamadhye rakṣyate gṛhiṇīyutaḥ ।।
yasya nāsti satī bhāryā gṛheṣu priyavādinī ।
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।।46 ।।
suśīlā sundarī bhāryā nāsti yatra gṛhe hyaho ।
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathā'raṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।।47।।
yasya pativratā nāsti patisādhyā suśāsitā ।
priyāhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ śuṣkaṃ pūrṇaṃ baṃdhudhanairapi ।।48।।
bhāryāśūnyā vanasamāḥ sabhāryāsti gṛhā gṛhāḥ ।
gṛhiṇī tu gṛhe daive paitrye karmaṇi puṇyadā ।।49।।
bhāryāmūlaḥ kriyāḥ sarvā bhāryāmūlā gṛhāstathā ।
bhāryāmūlaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ gṛhe nṛpa! ।।1.443.50 ।।
bhāryāmūlāḥ sadā harṣo bhāryāmūlaṃ ca maṃgalam ।
bhāryāmūla ca saṃsāro bhāryāmūlaṃ ca saurabham ।।51 ।।
sarvaratnapradhānaṃ tu strīratnaṃ gṛhamedhinām ।
yathā jalaṃ vinā padmaṃ, tathā bhāryā vinā gṛham ।।52।।
sā tu patnī tava saudhe rādhāṃśā vidyate nṛpa ।
pativratā suśīlā ca satī bhogavatī priyā ।।53 ।।
patnīvratena dharmeṇa rādhā kṛṣṇena pūjitā ।
stutā tathā bhavāँścāpi pūjāṃ karotu sādaram ।।।54।।
sā tuṣṭā hyacirāt svargaṃ mokṣaṃ dhāma pradāsyati ।
suyajñaḥ prāha bahudhā śrutaḥ pativratāvṛṣaḥ ।।55।।
patnīvratavṛṣaḥ kīdṛk śrotumicchāmi me vada ।
sutapāścāha rājendra patnīṃ vibhāvya caiśvarīm ।।56 ।।
prātaḥ patnīṃ smarennityaṃ dhyāyetpatnīṃ haripriyām ।
prātaḥ patnīmukhaṃ paśyet paścādanyān vilokayet ।।57।।
patnyāḥ snānaṃ tviṣṭajalaiḥ kārayecca suveṣayet ।
keśaprasādhanaṃ tasyāḥ kārayed dāsikādibhiḥ ।।58।।
yadvā patiḥ svayaṃ tasyāḥ keśādīn samprasādhayet ।
śṛṃgārayet sugandhādyaiḥ saubhāgyarūpamarpayet ।।59।।
sandhārayed vibhūṣāśca binduṃ kajjalamarpayet ।
bhojayejjalapānādi dadyāttāmbūlamarpayet ।।1.443.60।।
yadyadiṣṭaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ pradadyād rañjayet sadā ।
śarīramardanaṃ kuryāt śramaṃ niḥsārayet striyāḥ ।।6 1 ।।
prakṣālayettu mālinyaṃ tathā gātrāṇi vāhayet ।
miṣṭā''khyānakathāśrāvairjñānaṃ tasyai prakāśayet ।।62।।
kārayennavadhā bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya parātmanaḥ ।
śayyāṃ sukhakarīṃ dadyād ratyā saṃsukhayed satīm ।।63 ।।
anyayā na prabhāṣeta nānyāṃ kvacit samaspṛśet ।
anyāmukhaṃ na vai paśyennānyāvārtāṃ samācaret ।।64।।
nānyāṃ saṃcintayet kvāpi nānyāsaktamanā bhavet ।
gṛhṇīyānnā'parāgandhaṃ śṛṇuyānnā'parāsvaram ।।65।।
anyācaritanṛtyādi patnīvrato na lokayet ।
anyādehastanādyaṃ tu na paśyedvai kadācana ।।66।।
anyādattaṃ jalānnādi gṛhṇīyānna kadācana ।
anyāspṛṣṭasvavastrāditailādi naiva dhārayet ।।67।।
anyā'rpitaṃ supuṣpādi dugdhādyapi na saṃgraset ।
anyayā saha yānādau niṣīdenna kadācana ।।68।।
anyayā saha mārgādau caletsārthatayā'pi na ।
kṣetrodyānā''paṇādau tvanyayā sākaṃ na saṃviśet। ।।69।।
kāryaṃ nā'pyanyayā sārdhaṃ kuryāt patnīvrato janaḥ ।
samājotsavaśālādau parāyogaṃ na vai caret ।।1.443.70।।
parādattaṃ na vai kiñcidupabhuñjyāt kadācana ।
pārakyānāṃ maṇḍaleṣu tiṣṭhennaiva kadācana ।।71 ।।
pārakyāsnānabhūmyādau snānādyarthaṃ na sañcaret ।
pārakyārūpasaundaryaṃ na paśyenna vicintayet। ।।72।।
parayā randhitaṃ bhojyaṃ na saṃgraset kadācana ।
na ca rātrau bahirgacchennā'nyāgṛhagato bhavet ।।73।।
nārīmārgādiṣu rājanna tiṣṭheccatvarādiṣu ।
vādyaṃ nākarṇayennāryā vāditaṃ parayotsave ।।74।।
nānyāṃ kaṭākṣayet kvāpi saṃketaṃ jñāpayenna ca ।
nānyāṃ praśaṃsettasyāśca guṇagānaṃ na cācaret ।।75।।
evaṃ vai sarvathā tyāgaṃ svīyā'nyāyāḥ samācaret ।
tadvai patnīvrataṃ puṣṭiprāptaṃ bhavati mokṣadam ।।76।।
svapatnīṃ krūrayennaiva tāḍayenna kadācana ।
krūraṃ saṃśrāvayennaiva ruṣā'vamānaṃ nācaret ।।77।।
pariśrameṇa yatnena vyāpāreṇā'nyakarmaṇā ।
kṛṣyā kaiṃkaryakāryeṇa dravyamutpādya naitikam ।।78।।
sampoṣayennijāṃ patnīṃ bhakṣye bhedaṃ na cācaret ।
vilāse raṃjane dāsye krīḍāyāṃ tāṃ sutoṣayet ।।79।।
patnyā dattaṃ jalānnādi premṇā praśaṃsya bhakṣayet ।
kṣārādhikyādidoṣāँstu gaṇayenna kadācana ।।1.443.80।।
amṛtaṃ ceti matvaiva gṛhṇīyānnā'vamānayet ।
akāmāṃ balayennaiva cārtavīṃ na parityajet ।।81 ।।
suptāṃ prabodhayennaiva sakāmāṃ na tiraścaret ।
tṛṣṇayā vā prasahyāpi nodvejayetkadācana ।।82।।
yathā yathā prasannā syāttathā tathā samācaret ।
gṛhavastu ca niḥśeṣaṃ patnyai samarpayed vratī ।।83।।
ātmānaṃ cārpayettasyai sadā sammānamācaret ।
mānaṃ rakṣet suṣṭhu patnyāstvaṃkāreṇa na vai vadet ।।84।।
svabhāvaiḥ pīḍayennaiva nā'nyāyena hyadhikṣipet ।
nā''krośellaṃghayennaiva patnīvacaḥ kadācana ।।85।।
nityaṃ patnīṃ mahādevīṃ matvā kuryānnamaḥkṛtim ।
viṣayān sarvato dadyānnāstīti saṃvadenna vai ।।86 ।।
sevādharme cākramādau na nirmanaskatāṃ vrajet ।
yathā nārāyaṇo lakṣmīṃ vinā bhuṃkte na vai kvacit ।।87।।
yathā kṛṣṇaḥ satīṃ rādhāṃ vinā bhuṃkte na vai kvacit ।
tathā patnīṃ vinā kiñcit kvacid bhuṃjyānna vai vratī ।।88।।
svameḍhrādi vinā patnīṃ nānyayā''lokitaṃ bhavet ।
anyayā cumbitaṃ na syāt svakapolā''nanādyapi ।।89।।
nā''kṛṣṭaṃ hṛd bhavet kvā'pyanyayā varteta vai tathā ।
svapne'pi na spṛśedanyāṃ tathā'nyāṃ nā'valokayet ।।1.443.90 ।।
dharmakāryādikaṃ daivaṃ paitryaṃ patnyā sahā'caret ।
na gopayed gṛhakāryaṃ patnyāṃ patnīvrataḥ kvacit ।।91 ।।
patnyai nivedya yāvadvai kāryaṃ kuryānna caikalaḥ ।
patnyāstu sammatiṃ tyaktvā dharmavratādi nācaret ।।92।।
patnītantro bhavennityaṃ śreyo'rthaṃ narakāya na ।
mokṣārthaṃ tadadhīnaḥ syānnarakārthaṃ tu na kvacit ।।93।।
saukhyārthaṃ mānayennityaṃ na kleśārthaṃ kadācana ।
viśvāsapātrikāyāṃ viśvasenna kulaṭādiṣu ।। 94।।
prāṇān dhanāni ratnādi kuryāt tatkarasāt patiḥ ।
patnīṃ tvardhaṃ sadā patyuḥ patnyāstvardhaṃ tathā patiḥ ।।95।।
patistasyā darīkukṣau putrarūpaḥ prajāyate ।
bhuktā patnī prasavitrī prasūḥ poṣṭrī tataśca mā ।।96।।
sadā pālyā sadā poṣyā sadā rakṣyā suvastubhiḥ ।
patnyāṃ kāmasya santoṣaḥ śaucaṃ tasyāṃ nu mehataḥ ।।97।।
patnyāḥ sevā tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tayā vārtā kathā'mṛtam ।
īśvariṇyā rūpamātre praṇidhānaṃ priyasya vai ।।98।।
ahiṃsanaṃ tadadrohaḥ satyaṃ tasyāmagopanam ।
patnyāmekahṛdayyatvamasteyaṃ naiva vañcanam ।।99।।
patnyāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kāmārtho brahmacaryaṃ gṛhāśritam ।
patnyarthaṃ sarvavastūnāmādānaṃ cā'parigrahaḥ ।। 1.443.1 00।।
suptāyāṃ tu prasuptaḥ syājjāgṛtāyāṃ prabodhavān ।
snātāyāṃ cāplave tuṣṭo bhuktāyāṃ bhojanapriyaḥ ।। 10 1।।
pītāyāṃ pānaraktaśca krīḍitāyāṃ prakrīḍakaḥ ।
śṛṃgāritāyāṃ śobhāḍhyo duḥkhitāyāṃ suduḥkhavān ।।1 02।।
asvacchāyāṃ nātiśubhraḥ sukhitāyāṃ sukhānvitaḥ ।
rugṇāyāṃ tu manomāndyaḥ protphullāyā praphullitaḥ ।। 103 ।।
sasmitāyāṃ susmitaśca tṛptāyāṃ tṛptimān patiḥ ।
cintitāyāṃ bhagnamanā vratasthāyāṃ vratānvitaḥ ।। 1 04।।
tapaḥsthāyāṃ tapoyuktaḥ sukṛtāyāṃ susukṛtī ।
mṛtāyāṃ cānumaraṇaścitāyāṃ tvanusaṃjvalet ।। 1 05।।
evaṃ patnīvratavyāptaḥ patiḥ santārayet kulam ।
ekottaraṃ śataṃ svasya patnyāścoddharate tathā ।। 1 06।।
bhaja rāseśvarīṃ patnīṃ rādhikāṃśāṃ sadā nṛpa ।
oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇyai patnyai namo'stu te ।। 1 07।।
evaṃ naman mahāsārvabhaumapatnīvrataṃ caran ।
jagaduddhārayan sarvaṃ yātyante brahma cākṣaram ।। 1 08।।
patnīhastajalaṃ pītvā svargaloke mahīyate ।
patnīpātragataṃ putraṃ prāpya pitṝṇavarjitaḥ ।। 1 09।।
patnīyānaṃ paraṃ prāpya paraṃ padamavāpyate ।
yāvanti jalatīrthāni bhūmyaraṇyādrijāni vai ।। 1.443.11 0।।
tāni sarvāṇi patnyāṃ vai pativratāyāṃ śerate ।
dharmo vrataṃ tapo homo japaḥ svādhyāya ānatiḥ ।। 111 ।।
dānaṃ puṇyaṃ copakṛtiḥ sevā cāśiṣaḥ ityapi ।
sarvaṃ patnīśarīre'sti sevitā bhāvato yadi ।। 11 2।।
sā patyustārikā proktā patistasyāśca tārakaḥ ।
dvau tau kulasya sarvasya tārakau bhavabandhanāt। ।। 113 ।।
tasmāt patnīvrataṃ pālyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tadeva yat ।
brahmaprāptikaraṃ śaśvatsukhadhāmapradaṃ yataḥ ।। 1 14।।
sarve devāḥ samunayo devyaḥ sādhvyaḥ pativratāḥ ।
patnīdehe vasantyeva brahma vasati tatra ca ।। 1 15।।
patnīvrataśca puruṣo viṣṇurūpo na saṃśayaḥ ।
yathā kṛṣṇo nirguṇaśca sarvajīvādhidevatā ।। 116 ।।
sarveṣāṃ tārako nirlepaśca karmabhireva saḥ ।
tathā patnīvratastvanyoddhārakaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।। 1 17।।
agnayastaṃ vilokyaiva pratyuttiṣṭhanti bhāvataḥ ।
siddhayo yogasāmarthyamaiśvaryāṇi hyaśeṣataḥ ।। 1 18।।
tatsaṃkalpe saphalāni jāyante kṛṣṇavatsadā ।
patnīvrataḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo vasatyeva satīvrate ।। 119 ।।
rāseśvarīṃ satīṃ rājan bhaja rādhāṃśajāṃ priyām ।
yathā'bhajad dharmadevaḥ patnīṃ mūrtiṃ priyāvrataḥ ।। 1.443.120।।
śatarūpāṃ manuryadvat patnīvratastathā bhaja ।
ityuktvā virarāmāsau sutapāḥ kamale! priye! ।। 121 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne suyajñasya nṛpateḥ sutapaḥṛṣikṛtapatnīvratadharmopadeśādi nirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 443 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 443 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 444
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 445 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
suyajñaḥ sa kathaṃ japtvā stotraṃ patnīvrato nṛpaḥ ।
kimātmakaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā mokṣamavāpa tadvad! ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
patnīvrataḥ suyajñaḥ sa rādhikā mantramāpa yam ।
jajāpa sa puṣkare gatvā patnīyuktastapaḥpriyaḥ ।। 2 ।।
'oṃ rādhāyai svāhā' mantraṃ sadā jajāpa bhūpatiḥ ।
dhyānaṃ cakāra rādhāyāḥ pūjāṃ cakre samādarāt ।। 3 ।।
śvetacampakavarṇābhāṃ koṭicandrasamaprabhām ।
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanām ।। 4 ।।
pakvabimbā'dharāṃ muktādantapaṃktivirājitām ।
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ ratnamālādibhūṣitām ।। 5 ।।
vahniśuklāṃśukādhānā bhaktānugrahamaṇḍitām ।
ratnakeyūravalayāṃ ratnamañjīrarañjitām ।। 6 ।।
ratnakuṇḍalasaṃśobhārājatkarṇasubhūṣaṇām ।
sūryaprabhābhagaṇḍābhāṃ tejaḥparidhirājitām ।। 7 ।।
ratnagraiveyakairyuktāṃ kirīṭamukuṭojjvalām ।
ratnāṃgulīyakaśobhāṃ ratnapāśakaśobhitām ।। 8 ।।
mālatīmālyagrathitakabarībhāraśobhitām ।
rūpānurūpāvayavāṃ sarvottamāṃgarājitām ।। 9 ।।
bindutilakabhālāṃ ca pūjitāṃ candanādibhiḥ ।
kṛṣṇasaubhāgyasaṃśobhāṃ kṛṣṇaprāṇasvarūpiṇīm ।। 1.444.1 0।।
kṛṣṇabhaktipradāṃ śāntāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ kṛṣṇasnehitām ।
ratnasiṃhāsane rāse sthitāṃ rāseśvarīṃ bhaje ।। 11 ।।
iti dhyātvā dadau tāṃ vai copacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।
āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ gandhānulepanam ।। 12।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ supuṣpaṃ ca snānīyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam ।
ṣaṭpañcāśatsunaivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ vāsitaṃ jalam ।। 1 3।।
madhuparkaṃ ratnatulyamupacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ।
tathā dadāvaṣṭottaraśataṃ bhāvena bhaktarāṭ ।। 14।।
kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ dehi me kṛṣṇapūjite ।
evaṃ cakre parīhāraṃ nanāma parameśvarīm ।। 15।।
kārtikīpūrṇimāyāṃ tu tāṃ sampūjya pareśvarīm ।
acalāṃ śriyamāpnoti rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ।। 16।।
nārī tāṃ cintayed bhaktyā svāmisaubhāgyagā bhavet ।
sā prayāti ca golokaṃ mucyeta bhavabandhanāt ।। 17।।
evaṃ nityaṃ suyajño vai jajāpa ca pupūja ca ।
tuṣṭāva dadhyau nāmāni tadarthāṃścintayanmuhuḥ ।।18।।
rāṃ tu smṛddhiṃ dadātyeva dhāṃ dhṛtiṃ pādayorvrajet ।
bhuktimuktipradāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ namāmītyabhyacintayat ।। 1 9।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ bhuktvā tepe tapaḥ suduṣkaram ।
sarvaṃ rādhāmayaṃ cakre śatavarṣaṃ narādhipaḥ ।।1.444.20।।
rādhā tuṣṭā nṛpateśca pratyakṣā saṃbabhūva ha ।
prāha taṃ tu tadā rāseśvarīyuktaṃ suyajñakam ।।21 ।।
patnīvrataṃ tvayā rājan kṛṣṇavat pālitaṃ sadā ।
mama sevā kṛtā nityaṃ bhaktyā cātīva toṣitā ।।22।।
pūjitā vanditā nityaṃ dhyātā rāseśvarī sadā ।
