patnīvratamakhaṇḍaṃ saṃpālitaṃ kṛṣṇavattvayā ।।23।।
saukumārye sadā puṣpasamāṃ matvā hyapālayaḥ ।
vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgāradravyādibhiḥ sutoṣitā ।।24।।
bhojyapeyasubhogyādidānaiḥ śaśvatprapoṣitā ।
gurviṇyavasthāmālakṣya sveṣṭadānaiḥ prapālitā ।।25।।
sūtakādiṣvavasthāsu nirvighnena nibhālitā ।
rājasādau tu bhāveṣu sarvabhāvaiḥ surañjitā ।।26।।
tamovṛttau kṣamāṃ dhṛtvā kroḍe kṛtvā prasāditā ।
jvarādyavasthāsānnidhye kṣaṇaṃ naiva viyojitā ।।27।।
āpatsvapi tvayā rājan dūrīkṛtā na pārśvataḥ ।
soḍhvā vai sarvamatyugraṃ na cāpadā suyojitā ।।28।।
āśaucādau tvayā dharmāccyāvitā na kadācana ।
sagarbhāyāṃ tvayā naiva vyarthakāmena yojitā ।।29।।
sabālāyāṃ kadācinna vinā vastu tvayā kṛtā ।
kṣudhite tṛṣite kānte na prayāse nipātitā ।।1.444.30।।
vibhrame bahucintāyāṃ na samudvejitā kvacit ।
yathākālaṃ yathādravyaṃ sarvabhāvena pūjitā ।।3 1 ।।
vanditā toṣitā viśvak sukhadānaiḥ prasāditā ।
mamaivaṃ sevayā rājan tuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।32।।
tenaiva preṣitā cāhaṃ rādhā tvāṃ netumāgatā ।
ahaṃ rāseśvarī rādhā pannīvrataphalapradā ।।33 ।।
madarthaṃ kāritaṃ yadyat kṛtaṃ vā tatphalapradā ।
sattvena rajasā yadvā tamasā'pi madarpitam ।।34।।
sarvaṃ tannirguṇaṃ vidhāpayāmi kṛṣṇayogataḥ ।
kāmo roṣastathā svādaḥ sneho lobho madādayaḥ ।।35।।
madarthaṃ tvarpitā jātāḥ kṛtā api tu nirguṇāḥ ।
yato'haṃ nirguṇā patnī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।।36।।
tato madyogamāpannaṃ patnīvratasya nirguṇam ।
kṛṣṇasya krīḍayā sarvaṃ jagat sakriyameva tu ।।37।।
yadi kṛṣṇo naiva kuryāt kriyāhīnaṃ jagadbhavet ।
dampatyostu kriyāḥ sarvā rādhākṛṣṇodbhavā yataḥ ।।38।।
sadṛśyo'pi bhavantyeva nirguṇā bandhanāśikāḥ ।
brahma brāhmyāyutaṃ pūrvaṃ karotyeva jagattathā ।।39।।
divā rātriṃ vinā nāsti cātmā buddhiṃ vinā na vai ।
brahma brāhmīṃ vinā nāsti kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇāṃ vinā na vai ।।1.444.40।।
śabdaḥ śaktiṃ vinā nāsti dharmāṃ bhaktiṃ vinā na vai ।
kṛṣṇo rādhāṃ vinā nāsti sat cit nā''nandamantarā ।।41 ।।
mama vratena rājendra pūtastvaṃ sarvathā yataḥ ।
āgaccha kṛṣṇagolokaṃ vimānena sabhāryakaḥ ।।42।।
tvayā prasāditā cāhaṃ sarvairvratairnṛpottama ।
yadā rāseśvarī ceyaṃ jvareṇā'bhibhavaṃ gatā ।।43।।
purā māsaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gṛhītaṃ na tayā tadā ।
tvayā'pi māsamekaṃ tu jalānnaṃ bhuktameva na ।।44।।
svasthenāpi tvayā patnīvratena rakṣitaṃ vratam ।
prasavādau yadā yadyat patnyā tyaktaṃ subhojanam ।।45।।
anyaccāpi subhogyādi tvayā'pi tyaktameva tat ।
samāyāṃ viṣamāyāṃ vā sthitau kvāpi tvayā nṛpa ।।46।।
patnīṃ vihāyā'narpitvā kiṃcana nopayuktavān ।
sādhuvad vartase rājan sarvaṃ patnyāṃ nidhāya ca ।।47।।
akṣayaṃ dānapuṇyādi patnīdvārā kṛtaṃ tvayā ।
mayā tat śāśvataphalaṃ kṛtaṃ tvadarthameva hi ।।48।।
cāturmāsyavrataṃ patnyā rāseśvaryā kṛtaṃ yadā ।
tadā tasyai na nivedya tvayā bhuktaṃ na vai kvacit ।।49।।
kārtike śrāvaṇe māghe vaiśākhe ca vratāni vai ।
yāni yāni tava patnyā kṛtāni kṛcchrakāṇi vai ।।1.444.50 ।।
tatra tatra ca yat tyaktaṃ rāseśvaryā tvayā'pi tat ।
kadācinna gṛhītaṃ vai patnīvratena sarvathā ।।51 ।।
yamāśca niyamā ye ye tava patnyā hyanuṣṭhitāḥ ।
te te tvayā'pi tāvantastāvatkālamanuṣṭhitāḥ ।।52।।
snānadānajapahomāstayā kṛtāstvayā kṛtāḥ ।
tayā saṃkalpitaṃ yadyat sarvaṃ tvayā'pi niścitam ।।5 3 ।।
nānyā nārī tvayā spṛṣṭā kāmato na vilokitā ।
dāsyaśca karmacāriṇyaḥ putrīvad rakṣitāstvayā ।।54।।
prajāḥ kanyā yuvatyaśca śiṣyā iva vilokitāḥ ।
snuṣā patnyo mātaraśca devya iva prapūjitāḥ ।।55।।
sādhvyaḥ satyo yogavatyaḥ śivāvad vanditāstvayā ।
bhikṣukyo vidhavā nirāśrayāḥ pitreva pālitāḥ ।।56।।
nartakyo nāyikā bahurūpiṇyo dharmataḥ smṛtāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavyaḥ sāṃkhyayoginyo gurupatnya ivā'rcitāḥ ।।57।।
vidyārthinyaḥ sadā sarasvatītulyā vilokitāḥ ।
dṛṣṭā vai brahmacāriṇyo gaṃgāvat tīrthapāvitāḥ ।।58।।
evaṃ suyajña sarvāstā brahmātmabhāvabhāvitāḥ ।
tvayā vilokitā rājan patnīvratena bhūbhṛtā ।।19।।
ṛṇamuktāḥ kṛtāścānyā āpattibhyaḥ sutāritāḥ ।
kaṣṭād dūrīkṛtāścānyā nāryaśca vaiṣṇavīkṛtāḥ ।।1.444.60 ।।
dhanyo'si tvaṃ sadā rājan dhanyā rāseśvarī priyā ।
dhanyaṃ cāṃśasvarūpaṃ me yatprāptyā muktatāṃ gatam ।।61 ।।
viśvāsaṃ varaṇaṃ nyāsaṃ kārpaṇyaṃ matisthiratām ।
ānukūlyaṃ prātikulyavarjitaṃ kṛtavān mayi ।।62।।
naitādṛśaṃ paraḥ kaścinmadvrataṃ pālayiṣyati ।
patnīvrataṃ vrataṃ me tanmokṣadaṃ pālitaṃ tvayā ।।63।।
pitarastāritā rājan prajāśca tāritāstvayā ।
sarvaṃ vai tāritaṃ rājye'raṇye'pi jaḍacetanam ।।64।।
ityuktvā rādhikā devī rāseśvarīṃ suyajñakam ।
vimāne divyadehau tau nītvā golokamāyayau ।।65।।
iti patnīvrataṃ lakṣmi! kathitaṃ sphuṭameva te ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya golokamāpnuyād vratī ।।66 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne suyajñaṃ patnīvratadharmapālakaṃ rājānaṃ rāseśvarīṃ patnīṃ ca vimāne nītvā rādhā golokaṃ yayāvityādipatnīvratamāhātmyakathananāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।444।।


← adhyāyaḥ 444 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 445
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 446 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! gurupatnīṃ tārāṃ patiparāyaṇām ।
apyakāmā candrabhuktā pātivratyān papāta na ।। 1 ।।
atristu brahmaṇaḥ putrastasya putro niśākaraḥ ।
sa ca kṛtvā rājasūyaṃ candramāḥ saṃbabhūva ha ।। 2 ।।
ekadā candramāḥ sampanmatto'gājjāhnavītaṭe ।
dadarśa sa gurorbhāryāṃ tārāṃ dharmapativratām ।। 3 ।।
susnātāṃ sundarīṃ ramyāṃ pīnonnatapayodharām ।
tanumadhyāṃ surūpāṃ sudatīṃ komalavigrahām ।। 4 ।।
sūkṣmavastraparīdhānāṃ yuvatīṃ svarṇabhūṣaṇām ।
kastūrībindunā sārdhamadhaścandanabindunā ।। 5 ।।
sindūrabindunā cāruphālamadhyasthalojjvalām ।
candraśvetāṃ kanakābhāṃ raktākṣīṃ kāmasaṃbhṛtām ।। 6 ।।
śaratpārvaṇacandrāsyāṃ pakvabimbā'dharāṃ satīm ।
gacchantīṃ svagṛhaṃ snātvā mattavāraṇagāminīm ।। 7 ।।
nirjane tāṃ vilokyaiva śaśyabhūnmanmathā'rditaḥ ।
lajjāṃ vihāya saṃruddhya mārge tāṃ samuvāca ha ।। 8 ।।
namaste sundari vipre surūpe brahmarūpiṇi! ।
kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha variṣṭhe! te pādayoḥ praṇamāmyaham ।। 9 ।।
tvādṛśīnāṃ satīnāṃ vai yogātpātakanāśanam ।
bhāgyodayo bhaveccāpi jānīhyantargataṃ manaḥ ।। 1.445.1 0।।
kartuṃ sakhīṃ samicchāmi rajanyāṃ śayanasthitām ।
yadi me mānasaṃ sādhvi! kāmodvelatvamāgatam ।। 11 ।।
ratidānena śāntaṃ tvaṃ kartuṃ śaktā'si vai sakṛt ।
tadā tvāṃ saṃparityajya gamiṣyāmi tathā kuru ।। 1 2।।
yadi cenna raterdānaṃ dadāsi tvāṃ nayāmyaham ।
prasahyā'paharaṇaṃ vai kṛtvā yāmīti niścitam ।। 1 3।।
aho tapasvinā devaguruṇā tvaṃ niyojitā ।
kiṃ sukhaṃ saurataṃ tena tava śāntikaraṃ bhavet ।। 14।।
ahaṃ candro mama rājyaṃ svarge sākṣād vilokyate ।
āgaccha vā bhava tatra śaptaviṃśatimānitā ।। 15।।
niṣphalaṃ yauvanaṃ yāti vṛddhena svāminā tava ।
svapne jāgaraṇe cāpi dhyāyannāste bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 16।।
anyaśca tvanmanaḥkāmo guroranyaccikīrṣitam ।
yayostu bhinnau viṣayau kā prītiḥ saṃgame tayoḥ ।। 17।।
vāsantīpuṣpatalpe vā gandhacandanacarcite ।
bhavatī yuvatī bhāgyavatī tatraiva modatām ।। 18।।
ityuktvā madanonmattaḥ papāta caraṇe punaḥ ।
niruddhamārgā candreṇa provāca taṃ pativratā ।। 1 9।।
śiṣyastvaṃ gurupatnī te tārā bhavāmi mātṛvat ।
vaktuṃ na lajjase kāmin kathamandho vijāyase ।।1.445.20।।
nā'smyahaṃ kāminī candra! satī cāhaṃ tapasvinī ।
pavitrā pāvanī mātā te bhavāmi kuputraka ।।21 ।।
saptaviṃśatināryaste santi kimvadhikaṃ mayi ।
mano yaccha sukhaṃ gaccha kiṃ sādhvyā te prayojanam ।।22।।
atrerabhāgyāttvaṃ jāto vyarthaṃ te janma jīvanam ।
dhik tvāṃ parapriyātṛṣṇaṃ vyarthaṃ te sarvasukṛtam ।।23।।
ahaṃ tapasvinī duṣṭa! tapasvināṃ samāśritā ।
yogyaḥ sa yogirāḍ bṛhaspatirme muktidāyakaḥ ।।24।।
tvādṛśo jārakarmā ca kṣudrakāmajito yadi ।
satītvaṃ me nāśayasi yakṣmagrasto bhaviṣyasi ।।25।।
duṣṭānāṃ darpahā kṛṣṇo darpaṃ te nihaniṣyati ।
tyaja māṃ prati saṃkalpa satyaṃ te śaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।26।।।
ityuktvā pārśvatastārā yāvad yāti śaśī tu tām ।
prasahya ca kare dhṛtvā rathe nītvā yayau divam ।।27।।
rurodā''krandanaṃ tārā cakāra sākṣiṇaṃ ravim ।
dharmaṃ vāyuṃ dharāṃ vahniṃ vyomā'jaṃ jalamacyutam ।।28।।
kalaśasthaṃ jalaṃ tārā kare kṛtvā pativratā ।
satī candraṃ bhasma kartuṃ yāvad yatate roṣataḥ ।।।29।।।
tāvad vyomagirā ruddhā mā bhasmīkartumarhasi ।
sarvaḥ karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte tathā te phalamāgatam ।।1.445.30।।
śṛṇu sādhvi sati bāle kṛtaṃ cā'jñātayā tvayā ।
yadā tvaṃ daśavarṣīyā pitṛgehasthitā tadā ।।3 1।।
śvadampatīmithunasthau cāliṅgitau tavā''śrame ।
tvayā dṛṣṭau tadā yaṣṭyā pāṣāṇenāpi tāḍitau ।।32।।
aprāptau kāmanirvṛttiṃ viyojitau vidrāvitau ।
kāmā'tṛptyā tadā śunyā śaptā tvaṃ tadvibhāṣayā ।।33।।
aho duṣṭe! yathā patyurviyogaṃ tvaṃ karoṣi me ।
tathā tavāpi patyuśca viyogaste bhaviṣyati ।।34।।
anyaḥ śvā ca yathā mayi phaliṣyati tathā tvayi ।
anyaśvāvad apatiste phaliṣyati tvayi dhruvam ।।35।।
kāmāsaktau kṣudrakīṭau yadvā paśū patatriṇau ।
mānavau vā'nyajātīyau viyoktavyau na karhicit ।।36।।
kāmatṛptimanālabdhau dhārmikau vā'pyadhārmikau ।
kāmatṛptipravidvadbhirviyoktavyau na karhicit ।।37।।
rativighnakṛtāṃ bhāryānāśo vāṃ bhartṛnāśanam ।
viyogo vā mahārogo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।38।।
kāmā'tṛptau samuttho'gnirbhasmīkaroti vighnadam ।
tathā tvayā kṛtaṃ karma tāre! bhuṃkṣva phalaṃ hi tat ।।39।।
anyathā te ca tatkarma bhaviṣyati na sukṛtam ।
yo dadāti parasmai ca duḥkhameva tu sarvataḥ ।।1.445.40 ।।
tasmai dadāti duḥkhaṃ tu śāstā nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
anyacchṛṇu tathā tāre! svāminā te kṛtaṃ purā ।।41 ।।
buhaspatirutathyaśca saṃvartaśca trayo'pi te ।
putrāścāṃgirasaḥ sarve vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ ।।42।।
saṃvartāya kaniṣṭhāya dāyabhāgaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।
kiṃcidapi dadau naiva saṃvarto bhikṣuko'sti yat ।।43।।
tasya niḥśvāsadagdheyaṃ gṛhalakṣmīrbṛhaspate ।
tvatsvarūpā pareṇāpi nīyate mā śuco'tra vai ।।44।।
madhyamasyotathyakasya satīṃ bhāryāṃ ca gurviṇīm ।
jahāra kāmatastāṃ sa bhrātṛjāyāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।।।45।।।
yo hared bhrātṛjāyāṃ tu kāmī kāmādakāmukīm ।
brahmahatyāsahasraṃ sa labhate maraṇādanu ।।।46।।
kuṃbhīpākaṃ sa yātyeva yāvatkalpaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ।
varṣakoṭisahasrāṇi viṣṭhākṛmiḥ prajāyate ।।47।।
yonikīṭastato gṛdhraḥ śatajanmāni kukkuraḥ ।
tataśca sūkaro bhūtvā mānavaḥ strīvihīnakaḥ ।।48।।
nā'bhuktaṃ kṣīyate prāptaṃ karma soḍhavyameva yat ।
bṛhaspaterutathyasya patnīharaṇapātakam ।।49।।
kāraṇaṃ te haraṇe'sti mā bhasmīkuru candrakam ।
evaṃ kṛte dvitīyaṃ te brahmahananapātakam ।।1.445.50।।
bhaviṣyati tatastāre! yathābhāgyaṃ śamaṃ kuru ।
ityuktā''kāśavāṇyā sā virarāma śaśāpa na ।।51 ।।
satī pativratā sādhvī candraṃ prasahya śiśriye ।
akāminyāṃ prasahyaiva reme niśāpatirmuhuḥ ।।।52।।।
svarge sukhamaye ramye puṣkare puṣpakānane ।
pṛthvyāṃ merau nade nadyāṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kurvatostayoḥ ।।।53 ।।
gataṃ varṣaśataṃ harṣānmānavaṃ svarmuhūrtakam ।
garbhaṃ dadhāra sā tārā candrādamoghamuttamam ।।54।।
atha candraścātibhīto daityeṣu śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।
śukrācāryagṛhe tasthau tārayā saha satkṛtaḥ ।।55।।
abhayaṃ tu dadau tasyai śukrācāryo'tigarvitaḥ ।
guruṃ jahāsa devānāṃ suvipakṣaṃ bṛhaspatim ।।56।।
sabhāyāṃ jahasurdaityā bhītāyā cābhayaṃ daduḥ ।
satīsatītvadhvaṃsena pāpiṣṭhacandramaṇḍale ।।57।।
babhūva śaśarūpaṃ ca kalaṃkaṃ nirmale malam ।
śukraścandramasaṃ prāha tvayā yogyaṃ na vai kṛtam ।।58।।
tvamaho brahmaṇaḥ pautro'pyatrerbhagavataḥ sutaḥ ।
durnītaṃ karma te putra nīcavanna yaśaskaram ।।59।।
rājasūyaphale svacche'mṛtasāgarake divi ।
kalaṃkarūpo madirābindustvayā samarjitaḥ ।।1.445.60।।
tyaja devaguroḥ patnīṃ prasūmiva mahāsatīm ।
tathyaṃ vācyaṃ ripau mitre satyaṃ vijayate sadā ।।61 ।।
śatrorapi guṇā vācyā doṣā vācyā gurorapi ।
saḥ śatrurme suragururdharmo vācyo hi saṃsadi ।।62।।
yato dharmastataḥ kṛṣṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ ।
gaurekaṃ pañca ca vyāghrī siṃhī saptaprasūyate ।।63।।
hiṃsakāḥ pralayaṃ yānti dharmo rakṣati dhārmikam ।
devāśca guravo viprāḥ śaktā yadyapi rakṣitum ।।64।।
tathāpi nahi rakṣanti dharmaghnaṃ pāpinaṃ janam ।
dharmaṃ cara mahābhāga brāhmaṇīṃ tyaja sāmpratam ।।65।।
upāyena tu te pāpaṃ tūrṇaṃ dūrībhaviṣyati ।
bhīto dīnaḥ śaraṇārthī rakṣaṇīyaḥ sudhārmikaḥ ।।66।।
adhārmikasya rakṣāyāṃ vinipātaḥ samantataḥ ।
āgaccha candra gaṃgāyāṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ samācara ।।67।।
ityuktvā taṃ daityagururmandākinyāṃ nināya ca ।
snāpayāmāsa ca hareḥ kārayāmāsa pūjanam ।।68।।
kṛṣṇapādābjayuktaṃ ca tannaivedyaṃ supāvanam ।
tulasīdalamiśraṃ sa bhojayāmāsa candrakam ।।69।।
pāpaṃ prakṣālayāmāsa kuśahasto hariṃ smaran ।
śukrācāryaḥ kṛpāṃ kṛtvā samuvāca punaḥ punaḥ ।।1.445.70।।
yadyasti me tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ pūjāphalaṃ hareḥ ।
satyaṃ vrataphalaṃ cāpi satyaṃ satyavacaḥphalam ।।71 ।।
tīrthasnānaphalaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ dānaphalaṃ yadi ।
upavāsaphalaṃ satyaṃ śiṣyabhakto'smyahaṃ yadi ।।72।।
vaiṣṇavaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktaśca pāpānmuktaḥ śaśī bhavet ।
vipraṃ viprakarmahīnaṃ patiṃ svastrīpravañcakam ।।73।।
pativañcanaśīlāṃ ca devaprasādavarjitam ।
svīyaślāghāprakartāraṃ parasya nindakaṃ tathā ।।74।।
poṣyavargā'poṣakaṃ ca kulaṭāsaṃgataṃ tathā ।
vratā'pālanakaṃ pāpaṃ satīśīlavināśakam ।।75।।
aśvatthatulasībilvacchettāraṃ viṣṇunindakam ।
sādhūnāṃ drohakartāraṃ sādhvīnāṃ dveṣiṇaṃ tathā ।।76।।
mātāpitṛduḥkhadaṃ ca devādivṛttināśakam ।
goviprādiprahantāraṃ yātu tān candrapātakam ।।77।।
candrapāpena te yāntu dāruṇāṃ ghorayātanām ।
svapāpena saha te vai sahantāṃ yamayātanām ।।78 ।।
iti candraṃ śuciṃ kṛtvā samuvāca punaśca tam ।
tārā garbhavatī jātā tava yogena candraka ।।79।।
tvaṃ tu śuddhīkṛtaścātra mā tārāṃ spṛśa vai punaḥ ।
akāmena ca kāmena mātaraṃ mā spṛśa kvacit ।।1.445.80।।
iti candraṃ śuciṃ kṛtvā samuvāca tu tārakām ।
tyaktvā candraṃ mahāsādhvi gaccha kāntaṃ bṛhaspatim ।।81 ।।
prāyaścittaṃ vinā pūtā tvameva śuddhamānasā ।
akāmā'pi baliṣṭhena bhuktā strī naiva duṣyati ।।82।।
prāpte tu māsike rājasvalye nārī praśuddhyati ।
ityeva muktvā śukrastu candraṃ ca tārakāṃ satīm ।।83 ।।
āśiṣaḥ pradadau samyak satkāraṃ mānamācarat ।
athaitasminnavasare bṛhaspatistaponidhiḥ ।।84।।
śiṣyaṃ papraccha mātaste kathaṃ snāne vilambate ।
paśya yāhi kathaṃ snātvā yathākālaṃ na cāgatā ।।85।।
śiṣyo'nviṣya na saṃprāpya śrutvā'paharaṇaṃ śukān ।
rudannāgatya tārā'paharaṇaṃ prāha gīṣpatim ।।86 ।।
śrutvā buhaspatistārā candreṇā'pahṛtāṃ priyām ।
rurodoccairvilalāpa saśiṣyo dūyatā hṛdā ।।87।।
provāca prākkṛtaṃ karma kāle pakve'bhibādhate ।
utathyabhāryāharturme bhāryā candreṇa vai hṛtā ।।88।।
saṃvartāya dhanā'dātuḥ sarvasvaṃ me hṛtaṃ gṛham ।
duḥkhaṃ dharmaviruddho yaḥ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ।।89।।
bhāvānuraktā suśīlā suśāsitā pativratā ।
gṛhādhiṣṭhātṛdevī ca gatā yasya gṛhādaho ।।1.445.90।।
bhāryāmūlaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ svargo mokṣaśca nirgatāḥ ।
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyaṃ yathāraṇyaṃ tathā gṛham ।।91 ।।
iti vilapya bahudhā purandaragṛhaṃ yayau ।
sa guruḥ pūjitastena tvāthityena marutvatā ।।92 ।।
tamuvāca svavṛttāntaṃ hṛdi śalyamivā'param ।
bṛhaspativacaḥ śrutvā ruṣā prajvalitāntaraḥ ।।93 ।।
mahendraḥ preṣayāmāsa cārakarmaṇi devatāḥ ।
prāha guruṃ tyaja cintāṃ kasya śrīrvipadaṃ vinā ।।94।।
dūtāścandraṃ śakrasaudhe taṃ prapannaṃ nirāmayam ।
dṛṣṭvā satārakaṃ bhītaṃ kathayāmāsurindrakam ।।95।।
śrutvendraḥ śokamāpanno hṛdayena vidūyatā ।
prāha candro baliṣṭhasyā''śraye'jayyo hi vartate ।।96।।
asmābhiḥ racanīyaṃ vai cakraṃ tasmānmahattamam ।
gaccha śīghraṃ brahmalokamasmābhiḥ sārdhameva hi ।।97।।
brahmaṇā saha yāsyāmaḥ kailāse śaṃkaraṃ vayam ।
ityeyaṃ te gatāḥ satyaṃ praṇemurvedhasaṃ tathā ।।98।।
procuste sarvavṛttāntaṃ śrutvā brahmā'pyuvāca tān ।
yo dadāti parasmai tu duḥkhaṃ vṛthā hi sarvataḥ ।।99।।
tasya duḥkhaṃ samāyāti nyāyālayāddhi śāsituḥ ।
saṃvartotithyagurava ātreyāstraya eva te ।। 1.445.10 0।।
saṃvartāya kaniṣṭhāya na dāyaṃ pradadau guruḥ ।
madhyotathyasya gurviṇī bhāryā tu guruṇā hṛtā ।। 101 ।।
tatphalaṃ tu guruḥ prāptaḥ kṛtaṃ bhogena naśyati ।
tathāpyatra yatiṣyāmo gatvā śrīśaṃkaraṃ śivam ।। 1 02।।
śaṃkaraḥ kṛṣṇaputro'sti guruḥ kṛṣṇavarodbhavaḥ ।
aṃgiraso muneḥ patnyāmato bhrātā hi gaṇyate ।। 1 03।।
dakṣayajñe satī dagdhā śaṃbhurvicittatāṃ gataḥ ।
āṃgirāstaṃ dadau jñānaṃ śiṣyaścāṃgirasaḥ śivaḥ ।। 1 04।।
evaṃrītyā'pi sa bhrātā śivo bṛhaspaterbhavet ।
śukro mṛtyuñjayamātrād bibheti nānyataḥ kvacit ।। 1 05।।
śivastasmai nītimuktvā tārāṃ pradāpayiṣyati ।
iti sarve gatāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kailāsaṃ śaṃkarālayam ।। 1 06।।
dṛṣṭvā bṛhaspatiṃ śaṃbhurudatiṣṭhat kuśāsanāt ।
brahmādibhyo dadau siṃhāsanānyuvāca gīṣpatim ।। 1 07।।
kathamevaṃ vidho bhrātarmlānāsyo lakṣyase vada ।
kiṃ vā tapasyā naṣṭā te kiṃ vā sandhyāvivarjitaḥ ।। 1 08।।
kiṃ vā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasevāvivarjitaḥ ।
kiṃ vā pitroriṣṭadeve bhaktihīno gurau ca kim ।। 1 09।।
kiṃ vā śaraṇamāpannaṃ rakṣituṃ śakyate na vai ।
kiṃ vā'tithayo vimukhāḥ poṣyāste kiṃ bubhukṣitāḥ ।। 1.445.11 0।।
kimu vā te cā'vaśā strī putro nā''jñākaraśca kim ।
śiṣyabhṛtyādayaḥ ki te prattyuttarapradā nanu ।। 111 ।।
kiṃ vā lakṣmīrhāsajuṣā kiṃ vā ruṣṭo gurustava ।
vaiṣṇavā vāḍavāścānye ruṣṭāḥ kiṃ prabalo ripuḥ ।। 11 2।।
kiṃ vā kuṭumbavicchinno nirdhano vā praśocasi ।
kiṃvā khalaiḥ kṛtaḥ kliṣṭastyakto'si bāndhavaiśca kim ।। 1 13।।
kiṃ vā tīrthaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ puṇyaṃ nītaṃ hi rākṣasaiḥ ।
kiṃ vā nindā śrutā sākṣād gurornindā'dhikā mṛteḥ ।। 1 14।।
kiṃ vā te pāpakṛtkarma babhūva mlānakārakam ।
vada vipadgataṃ tejastyajatyapi divākaram ।। 115।।
ityāpṛṣṭo guruḥ śaṃbhuṃ vṛttāntamāha duḥkhadam ।
tārāpaharaṇaṃ śrutvā namrāsyo'bhūt kṣaṇaṃ śivaḥ ।। 1 16।।
uvāca tu kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā kṛtakarmaphalaṃ tvidam ।
yadā guro phalaṃ svasya karmaṇaḥ prāpyate tadā ।। 1 17।।
niṣkāsitaṃ tāḍitaṃ ca dūraṃ bhavati naiva tat ।
kārye parākrame smṛddhau kīrtau vaṃśe kuṭumbake ।। 1 18।।
jale putre pratāpe ca bhūmau dhane sute harau ।
svabhāve vacane buddhau cāśrame cāvalambane ।। 11 9।।
vyavahāre tathā''cāre caritre dānakarmaṇi ।
prākkṛtasyā'nurūpaṃ vai jāyate hṛdayaṃ nṛṇām ।। 1.445.120 ।।
candrasya hṛdayaṃ tādṛk tava karmapraperitam ।
yādṛg yeṣāṃ pūrvakṛtyaṃ tādṛk teṣāṃ tu mānasam ।। 121 ।।
svayaṃ tu karmajanakaḥ karma daivasya kāraṇam ।
daivaṃ svabhāvahetuśca svabhāvāt pratijanmani ।। 1 22।।
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ kāluṣyaṃ svasya jāyate ।
aho'niṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ mātṛgāmitvaṃ śaśinā tvidam ।। 1 23।।
śivamastu tu sādhūnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ sadā ।
asatāṃ pāpaniṣṭhānāmaśivaṃ syāt pade pade ।। 1 24।।
anyeṣāṃ duḥkhakartā yo vighnastasya pade pade ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛtimanonairmalyakāraṇam ।। 1 25।।
aho śrīkṛṣṇa bhaktasya kīdṛk hṛdayaṃ nirmalam ।
hṛtabhāryamapi candraṃ na śaśāpa bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 1 26।।
gururyasya vaśiṣṭho'pi dhārmikaḥ sāttvikaḥ sadā ।
śataputraprahantāraṃ viśvāmitraṃ śaśāpa na ।। 127।।
niḥśvāsādvai bṛhaspaterbhasmībhūto bhavecchaśī ।
tārāyā api śāpena kṛṣṇalauho bhavecchaśī ।। 1 28।।
tathāpi taṃ kṣepaturna tapodhvaso na yad bhavet ।
varṇeṣu brāhmaṇāḥ śraiṣṭhyaṃ prāptā vai kṣamayā kila ।। 129 ।।
vipṇubhaktivihīnebhyo dvijebhyaḥ śvapaco varaḥ ।
paripakvā apakvā vā vaiṣṇavāḥ sādhavaśca te ।। 1.445.130 ।।
satataṃ pāti tāँścograṃ viṣṇucakraṃ sudarśanam ।
vāyuśca pavano vahniḥ sūryo brahmā'pyahaṃ haraḥ ।। 131 ।।
śeṣo dharmaḥ sarvasākṣī vāñcchāmo vaiṣṇavāśrayam ।
candro'pi durbalo bhītaḥ sudarśanābhirakṣitam ।। 1 32।।
daityaguruṃ bhāgavataṃ taṃ śukraṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।
taṃ jetuṃ ke'pi śaktā na yatiṣye tattathāpi vai ।। 133 ।।
bhaja satyaṃ paraṃ brahma patnīṃ prāpsyasi līlayā ।
tāvad bhavettu bhogecchā strīsukhecchā nṛṇāmiha ।। 1 34।।
yāvad gurumukhāmbhojānna prāpnoti manuṃ hareḥ ।
saṃprāpya durlabhaṃ mantraṃ vitṛṣṇo hi bhavennaraḥ ।। 1 35।।
tato necchati viṣayān mokṣaṃ vā dāsyamantarā ।
yadīcchati ced viṣayān viṣamatti na saṃśayaḥ ।। 136।।
ahaṃ brahmā ca viṣṇuśca dharmo'nantaśca kaśyapaḥ ।
kapilaśca kumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī ।। 1 37।।
svāyambhuvo manuścāpi prahlādaśca parāśaraḥ ।
bhṛguḥ śukraśca durvāsā vaśiṣṭhaḥ kraturaṃgirāḥ ।। 1 38।।
baliśca vālakhilyāśca varuṇaśca hutāśanaḥ ।
vāyuḥ sūryaśca garuḍo dakṣo gaṇapatirdharā ।। 139।।
sarve kṛṣṇasya dāsāḥ smaḥ kalāṃśā garvavarjitāḥ ।
bhaja oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।। 1.445.140।।
paṭha-oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya śrīpataye namaḥ ।
vayaṃ yāmo yatra śukraścandrastārā vasanti vai ।। 141 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne candrakṛtabṛhaspatipatnīpativratātārā'paharaṇaṃ, bhayāccandrasya śukrācāryaśaraṇagamanam, śuddhatā dvayordarśitā, bṛhaspaterutathyākhyānujastrīharaṇasya phalamidam, tārāprāptyarthaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśendrabṛhaspatīnāṃ mantraṇā cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।445।।


← adhyāyaḥ 445 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 446
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 447 →

śrīnārāyāga uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! haravākyaṃ śrutvā bṛhaspatiḥ svayam ।
mahābhāgavato bhakto vairāgyeṇa jagāda yat ।। 1 ।।
jñānaṃ prāpya viṣaṇṇaḥ sa bhavābdhau haramāha vai ।
ājñāṃ kuru kṛpāsindho yāmi taptuṃ harestapaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tārā tiṣṭhatu tatraiva na tayā me prayojanam ।
ajñānaṃ bādhate mūḍhaṃ līnaṃ me kṛpayā tava ।। 3 ।।
naro bhūtvā hariṃ prāpsye nāryā kiṃ me prayojanam ।
amṛtaṃ dṛśyate bāhyaṃ viṣaṃ sarvaṃ vinā harim ।। 4 ।।
śaraṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yāmi parātparam ।
ityuktavantaṃ taṃ śaṃbhurvihasyā''ha bṛhaspatim ।। 5 ।।
paragrastāṃ striyaṃ tyaktvā na praśasyaṃ tapo mune ।
saṃbhāvitasya duścaryā maraṇādatiricyate ।। 6 ।।
svastrīṃ śatrukaragrastāṃ samāsādya tataḥ param ।
yatkartavyaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ gārhasthyaṃ vā tapo mune! ।। 7 ।।
vayaṃ yāmo yatra śukrastatra sarve dhurandharāḥ ।
sūryo dharmo'nantaśeṣo naro nārāyaṇo hyajaḥ ।। 8 ।।
kratuḥ sanatkumāraśca vasiṣṭho'pi marīcikaḥ ।
sanātanaḥ sanandaśca voḍhā pañcaśikhastathā ।। 9 ।।
patnīvrataśca kapilastathā'ṅgirasa ityapi ।
ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve śukrāśramaṃ śivānvitāḥ ।। 1.446.10 ।।
śukraḥ praṇamya tānsarvān pūjayāmāsa sādaram ।
bhītāḥ praṇemustāndevān tadānīṃ ditinandanāḥ ।। 1 1।।
śukraḥ sapulakaḥ sāśrunetraḥ provāca vai tadā ।
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam ।। 1 2।।
svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavān sākṣād dṛṣṭaḥ svamandire ।
sākṣād dṛṣṭāśca tatputrā bhagavantaḥ sanātanāḥ ।। 1 3।।
tuṣṭaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'dya mayi sarvathā ।
svayaṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatirmadgṛhamāgataḥ ।। 14।।
brahmarūpaḥ svayaṃ śaṃbhurmokṣadāśca samāgatāḥ ।
kṛtārthaṃ kartumīśā māṃ kṛpayā nvāgatā mayi ।। 15।।
svātmārāmeṣu kuśalaṃ praśnarūpaṃ viḍambanam ।
putraṃ pavitraṃ kartuṃ vai nūnamatra samāgatāḥ ।। 16।।
aparaṃ brūtha kiṃ vā'pi śāsta naḥ karavāṇi tat ।
śrutvaitad viśvasṛṭ prāha kuśalaṃ te sadā'stu vai ।। 17।।
udvignaściravicchedāt tvāṃ pautraṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ ।
kuśalaṃ sakuṭumbasya tava pautra! nirāmayam ।। 18।।
śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ nityaṃ kuśalaṃ te tu vartate ।
svaguroḥ sevanaṃ cāpi kuśalaṃ te nu jāyate ।। 1 9।।
guroḥ kṛṣṇasya pitrośca vṛddhānāṃ cāpi pūjanam ।
sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ puṇyaṃ bhāvisampatsurakṣakam ।।1.446.20।।
abhīṣṭadevaḥ santuṣṭo gurau tuṣṭe bhavediha ।
iṣṭadeve tu santuṣṭe santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।।21 ।।
gururvipraḥ suro ruṣṭo yeṣāṃ pātakināmiha ।
teṣāṃ tu kuśalaṃ nāsti vighnastasya kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।।22।।
tava tuṣṭo guruścā'haṃ tadā tuṣṭo hariḥ svayam ।
harau tuṣṭe sarvadevāstuṣṭāḥ kṣemaṃ bhavettava ।।23।।
sāmprataṃ śṛṇu me dhīmannatrā''gamanakāraṇam ।
kṛṣṇavarajaputrasya sādhvīṃ tārāṃ bṛhaspateḥ ।।24।।
apahṛtya niśānāthastavaiva śaraṇā''gataḥ ।
dehi tārāṃ nyāyamārgāt sarvaṃ te kuśalaṃ bhavet ।।25।।
pūrvaṃ jñātaṃ tvayā candraḥ śuddhīkṛto'sti dharmataḥ ।
tārā śuddhā satī cāsti nityaśuddhā yataḥ striyaḥ ।।26।।
candre daṇḍaṃ na yokṣyāmastadbhayaṃ tyaja sarvathā ।
adāne yadi yuddhaṃ syānnāśastūbhayapakṣayoḥ ।।27।।
tārāṃ bhuṃkte śaśī yadvā gururyadvā vināśanam ।
koṭisaṃkhyakamūrdhanyadevadaityādipakṣayoḥ ।।28।।
anyāyaṃ tu parāsūya nyāyaḥ kāryastvayā'dhunā ।
vināśakāraṇaṃ yuddhamubhayordevadaityayoḥ ।।29।।
susāmnā''caraṇaṃ pautra! sarvamaṃgalakāraṇam ।
tārāṃ bhikṣāṃ dehi mahyaṃ bhikṣukāya tu vedhase ।।1.446.3 0।।
dehi tārāṃ mahābhāga! candraṃ prāṇādhikaṃ tathā ।
svakīrtiṃ rakṣa suciraṃ prārthayāmaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
śukraḥ saṃprāha tacchrutvā tridevān prapitāmahān ।
tārā garbhavatī tvāste candrayogena sā satī ।।32।।
deyā vā nā'dya deyā vā pramāṇaṃ prapitāmahāḥ ।
brahmā prāha pradeyaiva nā'tra kāryā vicāraṇā ।।3 3 ।।
garbhaprasavamaiśvaryāt kārayiṣyāma eva tu ।
ānayā'tra niśānāthaṃ tārāṃ ca gurviṇīṃ suta ।।34।।
ityuktaḥ satvaraṃ śukrastārāṃ candramasaṃ tadā ।
samāhūya dadau tebhyo mahadbhyaścātilajjayā ।।35।।
datvā tārāṃ vidhuṃ śukraḥ praṇanāma vidheḥ pade ।
brahmā dadarśa tārāṃ tu praṇatāṃ svapade satīm ।।36।।
lajjayā namravaktrāṃ surudatīṃ gurviṇīṃ śubhām ।
candraṃ saṃpraṇataṃ dhātā kroḍe kṛtvā'bhayaṃ dadau ।।37।।
uvāca gurviṇīṃ tārāṃ kātarāṃ prapitāmahaḥ ।
saubhāgyayuktā svapatau bhaviṣyasi bhayaṃ tyaja ।।38।।
durbalā balinā grastā niṣkāmā na cyutā bhavet ।
manaḥkhedena śuddhā sā rājasvalyena vā punaḥ ।।39।।
tataḥ svakāntayogena na strī jāreṇa duṣyati ।
sakāmā kāmato jāraṃ bhajate svasukhāya yā ।।1.446.40।।
prāyaścittādapi śuddhā na sā svāmivivarjitā ।
tvaṃ tu satī sadā śuddhā vahnirivā'tipāvanī ।।41 ।।
bṛhaspateḥ karmayogāt tadbhāryā''haraṇaṃ hyabhūt ।
tavāpi karmayogācca tavātra haraṇaṃ hyabhūt ।।42।।
kintu tattvaṃ kimatrā'sti jānantyeva na devatāḥ ।
vinā tridevān guptaṃ tad rahasyaṃ paśya madbalāt ।।43।।
yadā candro'harat tvāṃ vai tadā spraṣṭuṃ śaśāka na ।
pativratā satīṃ devīṃ spraṣṭuṃ śaknoti ko'pi na ।।44।।
kintu sūryaprabhā mūrtimatī tvāgatya tatra vai ।
dvitīyāṃ nirmame tārāchāyāṃ tārāpratikṛtim ।।45।।
satyāṃ tārāṃ tirodhāya ninye sūryasya maṇḍale ।
sā'dyā'vadhi mahādivyā satī śuddhā virājate ।।46।।
sā tvaṃ paśya nijāṃ mūlāṃ prabhā''nītāṃ yathātathām ।
imāṃ chāyāṃ tathā paśya sagarbhāṃ candrasevitām ।।47।।
ityuktvā viśvasṛk dvedhā darśayāmāsa tārakām ।
mūlāṃ tārāṃ dadau devagurave'nyāṃ tatastu te ।।48।।
prāhustāre! tyaja garbhaṃ pakvaṃ tvasmatprabhāvataḥ ।
ityuktā sā drutaṃ tvantargṛhe gatvā suṣāva tam ।।49।।
jātamātro yuvā svarṇavarṇo'bhūt śaśinā samaḥ ।
jātakarmādikaṃ tatra kṛtavāṃścandramāḥ svayam ।।1.446.50 ।।
brahmājñayā tadā tārāchāyā'dṛśyā babhūva ha ।
adṛśyāṃ tāṃ sūryaprabhā jagrāha nijaputrikām ।।51 ।।
sā tu sūrye sadā kṛṣṇaṃ bhajamānā babhūva ha ।
prabhādāsī sadā dāsyaṃ kṛṣṇasyaiva cakāra sā ।।52।।
puruṣottamamāse tu prabhayā saha sā satī ।
yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya dhāma cākṣaram ।।53।।
divyā nityamahāmuktā jātā kṛṣṇapriyā satī ।
mūlā tārā patiṃ prāpya babhūva nirbhayā punaḥ ।।54।।
brahmā tasyai satīdharmānāpatkālakṛtān mudā ।
pātivratyaparān prāha kṛte yuge pravartitān ।।55।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi yaistu nāryo'pyadūṣitāḥ ।
svāminastvājñayā nārī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।।56 ।।
anyamuktā na sā dūṣyatyataḥ svāmivaco vṛṣaḥ ।
patiryasmai kṣaṇikaṃ vā śāśvataṃ dānamārpayat ।।17।।
tena bhuktā'pi sā nārī naiva dūṣyati vai kvacit ।
dāne grahītuḥ svatvaṃ yat tato nārī na duṣyati ।।58।।
nirjanādāvabalā yā bhuktā prasahya kenacit। ।
akāmā ca parādhīnā naiva duṣyati vai kvacit। ।।59।।
yogādisiddhapuruṣairbhuktā praviśya svāmini ।
bhuktā kṛtrimarūpeṇa sā'pi naiva praduṣyati ।।1.446.60।।
nidrāṃ mūrchāṃ gatā yā tu vicittā mādakādane ।
anyabhuktā'pi sā tatra naiva duṣyati padmaje ।।61 ।।
patyuḥ pituḥ sutabhrātrorāyatkāle'tidāruṇe ।
teṣāṃ prāṇā'vanārthaṃ cet parabhuktā na duṣyati ।।62।
apatyārthe gavāmarthe kuṭumbārthe parā''dṛtā ।
akṣatakanyakārthe ca kumāryarthe na duṣyati ।।63।।
āpatkāle prāṇahare deśagrāmādiviplave ।
anyabhuktā parādhīnā tadā naiva praduṣyati ।।64।।
gāndharvavidhinā yoge parabhuktā na duṣyati ।
rājasvalyasya vigame patyayoge ṛtorvṛṣe ।।65।।
anyayogagatā nārī duṣyatyeva na vai kvacit ।
svāminaḥ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ parabhuktā na duṣyati ।।66।।
tapasvinastapasyāyā vighnārthaṃ tvapsarogaṇaḥ ।
svāmīndrapreṣitaścānyabhuktā'psaro na duṣyati ।।67।।
dāsyaḥ kṛtvā bhūbhṛtastu sevāyāṃ cārpitāstu yāḥ ।
parabhuktāśca tāḥ kvāpi naiva duṣyanti sevikāḥ ।।68।।
paṇyastrītvaṃ samāpannā vipannāśārthameva yā ।
parabhuktā cā'gatitve tāvanmātraṃ na duṣyati ।।69।।
apatikā nṛtyagītikuśalā kvāpi mohitā ।
gāndharveṇa parāyattā parabhuktā na duṣyati ।।1.446.70।।
prāṇarakṣaṇakāryārthaṃ parabhuktā na duṣyati ।
tejasviyogamāsādya śāpādibhayakātarā ।।71 ।।
duḥkhasya parihārārthaṃ parabhuktā na duṣyati ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśādyairbhuktā satī na duṣyati ।।72।।
tulasyā tu viṣṇuyogaḥ patiprāśastyabodhakaḥ ।
anyayoge tathā nārī patihantrī bhavecca vā ।।73।।
svavaṃśatantusandhātṛputralābhārthameva tu ।
parabhuktā satī nārī na kadāpi praduṣyati ।।74।।
divyadevādibhirbhuktā satī naiva praduṣyati ।
ahalyāyāstvindrayoge śilātvaṃ svāmiruṭphalam ।।75।।
svapne tvanyena yā bhuktā sā satī naiva duṣyati ।
bhūtapretādibhirbhuktā vāyvaṃśairnahi duṣyati ।।76 ।।
pitṛbhyāṃ saṃpradattā yā yasmai tena na duṣyati ।
anāthā yuvatī prāptā patnīkṛtā na duṣyati ।।77।।
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmo dūṣaṇaṃ svecchayā pare ।
patīcchayā parārthatvaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ patidharmataḥ ।।78।।
prasahyatve baliṣṭhasya dūṣaṇaṃ na tu tat striyāḥ ।
nodanālakṣaṇo dharmaścānartho na bhaved yadi ।।79।।
anarthe tu phalaṃ duḥkhaṃ soḍhavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam ।
ityevaṃ sarvadā'smābhirdevairdharmo viniścitaḥ ।।1.446.80।।
tasmāt tārā sadā śuddhā punarbhūvat pativratā ।
candraścāpi phalaṃ bhuṃjan devatā sthāsyati dhruvaḥ ।।81 ।।
rājasvalye māsike vai nāryaśuddhirvinaśyati ।
pavitrā pāvanī snātvā sādhvī pṛthvīsamā satī ।।82।।
kṣetraṃ proktaṃ bījakośo bījādhānāya nirmitaḥ ।
pākaṃ datvā śaityakāle grīṣme tāpāt pratāpyate ।।83 ।।
varṣāyāṃ jaladānena śuddhaḥ kaṇān dadāti saḥ ।
kṣetraṃ nārī bījapātraṃ bījādhānāya nirmitam ।।84।।
pākottaraṃ sadā śītaṃ rājasvalye pratapyate ।
niṣekavarṣādānena śuddhaṃ bālān dadāti tat ।।85।।
tasmāt kṣetraṃ prativarṣaṃ śuddhameva bhavedyathā ।
tadvannāryātmakaṃ kṣetraṃ pratimāsaṃ praśuddhyati ।।86।।
iti tasyai pātivratyaṃ datvā sarve surādayaḥ ।
sādhvīṃ tārāṃ tu gurave datvā'bhayaṃ ca sarvathā ।।87।।
devā yayuḥ svabhavanaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ ।
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ pālayāmāsa sā satī ।।88।।
patnīvrataṃ vṛṣaṃ cāpi pālayāmāsa gīrpatiḥ ।
atha tārāsuto budhaścandrajanmā graho'bhavat ।।89।।
sa eva nandanavane citrāṃ prāpya satīṃ priyām ।
ghṛtācīgarbhasaṃbhūtāṃ kuberasya tu retasā ।।1.446.90।।
tāṃ gāndharvavivāhena jagrāha candramassutaḥ ।
tatputrastvabhavaccaitraḥ saptadvīpakṣitīśvaraḥ ।।91 ।।
tasya putro'dhirathākhyastasya surathanāmakaḥ ।
putrastapasyayā jāto manvantaraḥ sa cā'ṣṭamaḥ ।।92।।
sāvarṇiritināmnā vai vaiṣṇavaḥ paramo hi saḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pātivratyaphalaṃ bhavet ।।93 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantānetārāyā bṛhaspataye'rpaṇaṃ, budhajanma, āpatsamāḥ strīdharmāḥśuddhiśca, pātivratye'dūṣaṇāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।446 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 446 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 447
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 448 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
guravo nirmalāḥ śāntāḥ sādhavo hitakāriṇaḥ ।
ebhiḥ kāruṇyato datto nāmamantraḥ prasiddhyati ।। 1 ।।
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṛṣṇanāmnā dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ।
siddhīraiśvaryasarvārthacamatkāraprado bhavet ।। 2 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ rājavatyā vaiṣṇavikāstriyāḥ ।
yathā siddhistayā prāptā divyā bhaktyā ca sevayā ।। 3 ।।
āsīd rājā mathurāyāṃ dāśārho nāma dhairyavān ।
vadānyaścā'pradhṛṣyaśca nayavān śāstrakovidaḥ ।। 4 ।।
sa vai kalāvatī kāśīrājakanyāṃ pativratām ।
upayeme satīṃ sādhvīṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dharmasaṃyutām ।। 5 ।।
kalāvatī sadā''bālyāt kṛṣṇaṃ bheje sanātanam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin māmuddhara bhavārṇavāt ।। 6 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo śrīpate kamalāpate ।
ityevaṃ prārthanāṃ cakre nityaṃ bhaktiparāyaṇā ।। 7 ।।
patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīrādhikāpatiḥ ।
ahaṃ rādhā hyahaṃ lakṣmīrahaṃ śrīranapāyinī ।। 8 ।।
ityaikātmyaṃ harau cātmanyavāptā yogadarśinī ।
patyau kṛṣṇaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā paśyatyeva divāniśam ।। 9 ।।
evaṃ sthitiṃ samāpannāṃ yuvatīṃ yoginīṃ satīm ।
kṛtodvāhastu dāśārhaḥ prāpayitvā svamandiram ।। 1.447.1 0।।
śṛṃgāraśayane patnīṃ saṃgamāya samāhvayat ।
sā cā''gatyanamaścakre śīghraṃ bhayād vinirgatā ।। 11 ।।
yuvatīṣu ca vṛddhāsu madhye śiṣye sukhena sā ।
rājā'yaṃ cintayāmāsa kimatra kāraṇaṃ bhavet ।। 12 ।।
yuvatyapi na sā kāntaṃ yuvānaṃ māṃ samicchati ।
yadvā tadvā bhavatvatra śanairvai jñāsyate ṛtam ।। 13।।
kṣamāṃ kṛtvā ca dāśārhaḥ śānto ninye niśāṃ tu tām ।
evaṃ nityaṃ sa dāśārhaḥ samāhvayati kāmukaḥ ।।14।।
sā tvāgatya namaskṛtya niniryāti tu satvaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo svāmiँste'stu namo muhuḥ ।। 15।।
ityuccārya viniryāti yoṣitsu pratitiṣṭhati ।
naikalā tu kvacittatra pativratā sā tiṣṭhati ।। 16।।
naikāntaṃ rocate tasyai rājā tvekāntamicchati ।
ratyarthaṃ yuvatī rājñā bahuvāraṃ niveditā ।। 17।।
tataḥ svasyā manaścakre dṛḍhaṃ niṣkāmavartane ।
sā svabhartrā samāhūtā bahuśaḥ prārthitā satī ।। 18।।
na babandha manastasminna cāgacchattadantikam ।
saṃgamāya yadā''hūtā nā''gatā sā vivāhitā ।। 19।।
balādāhartukāmastāmudatiṣṭhanmahīpatiḥ ।
tadā sā prāha rājānaṃ mā māṃ spṛśa mahīpate ।।1.447.20।।
mā sāhasaṃ mayi kārṣīrvrate'smi hetugarbhite ।
darśayiṣye tu taṃ hetuṃ yenā'haṃ vratamāsthitā ।।21 ।।
tvaṃ ca dharmaṃ vijānāsi gūḍhādgūḍhataraṃ nṛpa ।
bhuktasya pariṇāmaścedapriyaḥ kaṣṭavardhanaḥ ।।22।।
dampatyoḥ prītiyogena saṃgamaḥ sukhavardhanaḥ ।
prītiryadā me jāyeta tadā saṃgo'stu te mayi ।।23।।
kā prītiḥ kiṃ sukhaṃ puṃsāṃ balād bhogena yoṣitām ।
aprītāṃ rogiṇīṃ kanyāmantarvatnīṃ dhṛtavratām ।।24।।
rajasvalāmakāmāṃ ca na kāmyeta balātpumān ।
prīṇanaṃ lālanaṃ puṣṭiṃ rañjanaṃ mārdavaṃ dayām ।।25।।
ākarṣaṇaṃ manāikya śreyobhāvaṃ ca bhāvanām ।
kṛtvā vadhūmupagacched yuvatīṃ premavān patiḥ ।।26।।।
tatrāpi dhārmikaḥ svāmī vyarthaṃ bhogaṃ na cācaret ।
bhrūṇahatyātmakaṃ pāpaṃ vyarthabījasya mehane ।।27।।
nāryāmṛtu samālakṣya bhogena bījamarpayet ।
vyarthaṃ kāmā''grahaṃ rājan mā kurvatra vṛṣaṃ cara ।।।28 ।।
ityukto'pi tayā sādhvyā dāśārhaḥ smaravegavān ।
balādākṛṣya yuvatīṃ parirebhe riraṃsayā ।।।9।।
sā ca oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ।
ityuktvā ca patiṃ natvā kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti cāvadat ।।1.447.3 0।।
tāvat tasyāḥ śarīre vai nigūḍho'gnirbabhūva ha ।
cakṣuṣā dṛśyate yo na dahatyeva tu kevalam ।।3 1।।
tāṃ spṛṣṭamātrāṃ sahasā taptā'yaḥpiṇḍasannibhām ।
nirdahantīmivā''tmānaṃ tatyāja bhayavihvalaḥ ।।32।।
rājā viveda tāṃ devīṃ camatkāramayīṃ satīm ।
prāhā'ho mahadāścaryamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tvayi priye ।।33।।
kathamagnimayaṃ jātaṃ vapuḥ kusumakomalam ।
kṣamasva sāhasaṃ me'tra kariṣye na punastathā ।।34।।
evaṃ jagāda bhītaḥ saḥ tamuvāca pativratā ।
rājan satī dharmavatī ṛtāvicchati saṃgamam ।।35।।
nā'nyeva kāmakāreṇa kṣudreva viṣayārthinī ।
prāgbhave'pi brahmacaryaṃ mayā tathaiva pālitam ।।36।।
asmin janmanyapi tathā samīhe vratamuttamam ।
agniḥ sākṣānmama rakṣāṃ karoti dharmayoṣitaḥ ।।37।।
akāle spṛśasi cenmāṃ tvāṃ sa bhasmīkariṣyati ।
pūrvapālitasauśīlyabalenaitajjanau mama ।।38।।
durvāsā munirāṭ kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ ।
dattavān śrīkṛṣṇamantraṃ pāvanaṃ me surakṣakam ।।39।।
ābālyādahamevainaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ sadā ।
japāmi satataṃ cātha dvitīyaṃ tu mahāmanum ।।1.447.40।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ।
ṣoḍaśarṇaṃ ca tenā'haṃ guptāsmyanalaśālinā ।।41 ।।
tena mantrānubhāvena mamāṃge kaluṣojjhitam ।
spraṣṭuṃ na śakyate pumbhiḥ sapāpaidaivavarjitaiḥ ।।42।।
tvayā rājan sadā dāsyaḥ kiṃkaryaḥ kulaṭāstathā ।
gaṇikādyā niṣevyante madirā''miṣabhojanāḥ ।।43 ।।
tena pāpena nistejā vartase kṣatriyo'pi san ।
prāptāyā api yogyo na duṣkṛtaṃ kimataḥ param ।।44।।
vivāhitā'pi yā patnī nirbhoktuṃ naiva śakyate ।
vyarthaṃ vai jīvanaṃ tasya pūrvapāpādribhoginaḥ ।।45।।
na snānaṃ kriyate nityaṃ na mantro japyate tvayā ।
nā''rādhyate patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kathaṃ māṃ spraṣṭumarhati ।।46।।
patnīvrataṃ tvayā rājan kadācinnahi pālitam ।
tena pāpena te rājan sāmarthyaṃ vilayaṃ gatam ।।47।।
kāmabhogena kiṃ rājan sukhaṃ yanna saha vrajet ।
ātmanā saha nityaṃ yatsukhaṃ tat samupārjayet ।।48।।
yonilubdho yonijanma labhate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।
kṛṣṇalubdho harerdhāma prāpnoti nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।49।।
ahaṃ vivāhitā kṛṣṇadharmasaktā'smi sarvathā ।
na cā''saktā kāmadharme tasmāt kāmaṃ sadā tyaja ।।1.447.50।।
kāmo nirayarūpo'tra yonau liṃge ca tiṣṭhati ।
kathaṃ tasmiṃstu niraye lubdhavyaṃ vai vijānatā ।।51 ।।
yonikuṇḍaṃ sadā bhraṣṭaṃ mūtradurgandhasaṃbhṛtam ।
śuddhaḥ kathaṃ prasajjeta tatra viṭmātrake sthale ।।52।।
tatra paktāstatra yānti punaḥ pācanahetave ।
ajñāstatra prasahyaiva yānti patanahetave ।।52।।
vijñaiḥ kathaṃ nu gantavyaṃ mṛtyukuṇḍe punaḥ punaḥ ।
tyaja lobhaṃ yonikuṇḍe brahmakuṇḍe nimajja vai ।।54।।
ātmakuṇḍaṃ pare kṛṣṇe samarpaya vimuktaye ।
bahvyo dāsyastvayā bhuktāḥ sarvāḥ samā vilokitāḥ ।।55।।
api tvāṃ bādhate tṛṣṇā kiṃ pāpaṃ syādataḥ param ।
jihvayā bhojanaṃ grastaṃ tadāntrānalabharjitam ।।56।।
rasātmakaṃ hyadhoyātaṃ coṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ jalātmakam ।
kharjanaṃ jāyate tena smaryate mūtrakuṇḍakam ।।57।।
dhik tadidaṃ bhojanaṃ ca yat kṛṣṇasmārakaṃ na vai ।
dhik tamimaṃ kāmabhāvaṃ yastu na kṛṣṇadāsyadaḥ ।।58।।
dhik taṃ tāṃ ca patiṃ patnī yau na kṛṣṇāya kalpitau ।
bhaja rājan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vicārya ceti vai ।।।59।।
patnīvrataṃ hi tatproktaṃ yena kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate ।
pātivratyaṃ ca sa dharmo yena kṛṣṇo hyavāpyate ।।1.447.6 0।।
ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājā'vāpya jñānaṃ svayoṣitaḥ ।
virāgaḥ san satīṃ prāha vada mantraṃ mamāpi tam ।।6 1 ।।
japavidhvastapāpo'haṃ tvayecchāmi susaṃgatim ।
mamā'jñānakapāṭaṃ tu tvayā cotpāṭitaṃ priye ।।62।।
rājñī prāha patiṃ pūjya nā'haṃ yogyo'smi tatkṛte ।
nā'haṃ tavopadeśaṃ vai kuryāṃ mama gururbhavān ।।6 3।।
upātiṣṭha guruṃ rājan gargaṃ mantravidāṃ varam ।
itisaṃbhāṣamāṇau tau dampatī gargasannidhim ।।64।।
prāpya taccaraṇau mūrdhnā vavandāte kṛtāñjalī ।
atha rājā guruṃ prītamabhipūjya punaḥ punaḥ ।।65।।
saṃjagāda vinītātmā rahasyātmamanoratham ।
kṛtārthaṃ māṃ kuru guro samprāptaṃ śaraṇāgatam ।।66।।
mokṣadātrīṃ parāṃ vidyāmupadeṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi ।
anājñātaṃ yadajñātaṃ yatkṛtaṃ rājakarmaṇā ।।67।।
śuṣkaṃ cārdraṃ mahat svalpaṃ pāpaṃ māyābalodbhavam ।
tatsarvaṃ yena śuddhyeta tanmantraṃ dehi me guro! ।।68।।
vinā satāṃ prasaṃgena pāpināṃ pāpanāśanam ।
ātmanaḥ śodhanaṃ cāpi naiva syāddhi kadācana ।।69।।
narā nāryaḥ sadā pāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ yuge yuge ।
sevante sādhupuruṣān yato mokṣo yato hariḥ ।।1.447.70।।
bhojitā vanditā dṛṣṭāḥ spṛṣṭāścaraṇe marditāḥ ।
śarīre sevitāḥ samyak prapunanti prasevinaḥ ।।71 ।।
yadyatpriyaṃ bhavet svasya deyaṃ tatsādhave sadā ।
sādhavo nirguṇāścaturarthāḥ śrīkṛṣṇamūrtayaḥ ।।72।।
kṛṣṇasevāphalaṃ sādhusevayā labhyate'dhikam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprāptipradāste sādhavo'naghāḥ ।।73 ।।
yathā kāmena kāminyāṃ kānte snehaḥ prajāyate ।
yathā jale tṛṣitasya yathā'nne kṣudhitasya ca ।।74।।
yathā śaityābhibhūtasya vahnau snehaḥ prajāyate ।
yathā ceṣṭau satṛṣṇasya putre pituśca sadguṇe ।।75।।
yathauṣadhe'tirugṇasyā'patye māturyathā tathā ।
sādhujane kṛtaḥ snehastārayatyeva niścitam ।।76।।
yathā śilādyāḥ pratimā jaḍā api sacetanāḥ ।
sādhurūpāstathā divyacetanāḥ pratimā hareḥ ।।77।।
tatra dattaṃ hutaṃ kṣiptaṃ samarpitaṃ śubhā'śubham ।
sarvaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sampatpradaṃ sveṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇām ।।78।।
yeṣāṃ yāsāṃ na cādhāraḥ kaścittasya tu sādhavaḥ ।
ādhārāstārakāścātmarakṣakā bhagavajjanāḥ ।।79।।
tasmādvai garga me śuddhiṃ kuru mantrapradānataḥ ।
evamabhyarthito rājñā gargo vaiṣṇavapuṃgavaḥ ।।1.447.80।।
tau nināya mahāpuṇyaṃ yamunāyāstaṭaṃ śubham ।
tatra vṛndātaroḥ pārśve niṣaṇṇo'tha guruḥ svayam ।।8 1 ।।
yamītīrthajalasnātaṃ dāśārhaṃ samupoṣitam ।
prāṅmukhaṃ copaveśyaiva natvā kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ।।82।।
tanmastake karaṃ nyasya mantraṃ kṛṣṇātmakaṃ dadau ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ।।83।।
śrīkṛṣṇāya namaśceti mantraṃ dadhāra karṇataḥ ।
tanmanvadhāraṇādeva tadgurorhastasaṃgamāt ।।84।।
niryayustasya vapuṣo vāyasāḥ śatakoṭayaḥ ।
te dagdhapakṣāḥ krośanto nipatanto mahītale ।।85।।
bhasmībhūtāstataḥ sarve dṛśyante sma sahasraśaḥ ।
rājā rājñī ca tad dṛṣṭvā gargaṃ gurumapṛcchatām ।।86।।
bhagavannidamāścaryaṃ kimetanme śarīrataḥ ।
nirgataṃ vāyasavrātaṃ dagdhaṃ ceti vada sphuṭam ।।87।।
gargaḥ prāha tvayā janmasahasreṣu pradhāvatā ।
sañcitāni hi pāpāni durantānyapyanekaśaḥ ।।88।।
puṇyavaśānnararājā saṃbhūto'si ca tatra vai ।
kriyante cātipāpāni tānīmānyadhunā tava ।।89।।
mantragrahaṇamātreṇa nirgatāni śarīrataḥ ।
ta ime vāyasāḥ sarve tamaḥpāpasvarūpiṇaḥ ।।1.447.90।।
dṛśyante sma dahyamānāstava pātakakoṭayaḥ ।
iti śuddho'si rājendra bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ sanātanam ।।91 ।।
tadā kṛṣṇasya tejobhiryuktastvaṃ vai bhaviṣyasi ।
tatastvaṃ cā'nayā tejasvinyā sārdhaṃ sadārtave ।।92।।
kāle yogye mite puṇye rantuṃ yogyo bhaviṣyasi ।
anyathā te satīvahniḥ kākavat pradahiṣyati ।। 93।।
ityuktvā sa munirgargo labdhvā satkāramarcanam ।
yayau nijāśramaṃ rājā rājñyā svabhavanaṃ yayau ।।94।।
vaiṣṇavau dampatī tau ca rejatuḥ sma mahādyutī ।
atha mantrapratāpena lakṣajāpottaraṃ nṛpaḥ ।।95।।
patnīsparśasya satpātramabhūd divyaśarīravān ।
tadā dṛḍhaṃ samāśliṣya patnīṃ candanaśītalām ।। 96।।
santoṣaṃ paramaṃ lebhe cārtave samaye tathā ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya vrataṃ satyā puṇyadaṃ varṣameva tu ।।97।।
pālitaṃ vai tayā rājñyā brahmacaryaṃ hyakhaṇḍitam ।
rājā'pi vatsarānte saṃśuddho'bhūd vahnisannibhaḥ ।।98।।
tato dadāvṛttau bījaṃ putraprāptiphalātmakam ।
gateṣu navamāseṣu putraṃ prāpa suvaiṣṇavam ।।99।।
iti lakṣmi! camatkāraḥ kṛṣṇapativratodbhavaḥ ।
kathitaste śravāt pāṭhāt tādṛśaṃ labhate phalam ।। 1.447.1 00।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dāśārharājñaḥ pāpamayyavasthāyāṃ kṛṣṇapātivratyaparāyaṇapatnyāḥ sparśe vahnidāhastataḥ kṛṣṇamantragrahaṇe pāpadāhe śuddhyuttarasparśayogyatetyādicamatkāranirūṇanāmāsaptacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।447।।


← adhyāyaḥ 447 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 448
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 449 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
lakṣmi! mayā sadāśivasvarūpaṃ saṃdhṛtaṃ purā ।
tyāgavairāgyarūpaṃ tat sarvasaṃhārakāraṇam ।। 1 ।।
mama śivasya rūpasya somavāre'rcakaḥ purā ।
āryāvarte nṛpaścitravarmā''sīddhārmikaḥ paraḥ ।। re ।।
sugoptā dharmasetūnāṃ yaṣṭā yajñādikarmaṇām ।
puṇyānāmāśrayo dātā bhaktaḥ śivamukundayoḥ ।। 3 ।।
bahuputrottaraṃ tasya patnyāṃ kanyā vyajāyata ।
prāgjanmanāṃ tu karmāṇi jātamātrā pravakti sā ।। 4 ।।
jātismarā satī sādhvī kṛṣṇadharmaparāyaṇā ।
sadā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaratā śuciḥ ।। 5 ।।
pātivratyaparā kṛṣṇe nānyaṃ smarati nityadā ।
ekadā bhūbhṛtā kṛṣṇasādhavo bhojitā gṛhe ।। 6 ।।
viprāḥ sahasraśo bālā naiṣṭhikā bālikāstathā ।
jyotirvido bhāgyavido rekhāvidaśca yoginaḥ ।। 7 ।।
teṣāṃ tāmbūladānārthaṃ kanyā sevāparā hyabhūt ।
daivajñāstāṃ vilokyaiva bhinnaṃ bhinnaṃ phalaṃ jaguḥ ।। 8 ।।
eko'bravīt tava kanyā nāmnā sīmantinī nṛpa ।
pārvatīva sumāṃgalyavatī rādheva rūpiṇī ।। 9 ।।
śāradeva kalābhijñā lakṣmīriva mahāguṇā ।
suprajā devamāteva satī kṛṣṇe dhṛtavratā ।। 1.448.1 0।।
māṇikyeva harau lagnā prabheva kṛṣṇamāśritā ।
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi saha bhartrā pramodinī ।। 11 ।।
aṣṭatanayamāteyaṃ bhaviṣyati sukhānvitā ।
athā'nyo'pi dvijaḥ prāha rekhābhirnirbhayastadā ।। 1 2।।
eṣā caturdaśe varṣe vaidhavyaṃ pratipatsyati ।
atha kāyākalparūpaṃ patiṃ punaravāpsyati ।। 1 3।।
rājā vajrasamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā śuśoca sā tvapi ।
kintu daivakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ matvā tatyāja śocanam ।। 14।।
bālā sīmantinīnāmnī bhāvivaidhavyaśaṃkitā ।
yājñavalkyamuneḥ patnīṃ maitreyīṃ paryapṛcchata ।। 15।।
mātastvaṃ brahmaveditrī kṛṣṇātmārpaṇavaiṣṇavī ।
jñānādhiśevadhiśreṇī sarvāpannāśinī hyasi ।।16।।
mātastvaccaraṇāmbhojaṃ prapannā'smi bhayārditā ।
vaidhavyaṃ brāhmaṇāścāhurme'tra kiṃ bhāvi tad vada ।। 17।।
punastasyaiva patyuśca prāptirme'stītyapyūcire ।
ataḥ saubhāgyavṛddhyarthaṃ sukṛtaṃ vada me'naghe! ।। 18।।
ityuktā tāṃ tu maitreyī prāha śrīpārvatīvratam ।
somavāre pūjayasva śivaṃ gaurīṃ śriyāḥ patim ।। 1 9।।
upoṣitā ca susnātā virajo'mbaradhāriṇī ।
kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā prātaḥ pūjāṃ prakalpaya ।।1.448.20।।
pāpakṣayo'bhiṣekeṇa sāmrājyaṃ pādapūjanāt ।
saubhāgyamakhilaṃ saukhyaṃ gandhamālyā'kṣatā'rpaṇāt ।।21 ।।
dhūpadānena saugandhyaṃ kāntirdīpapradānataḥ ।
naivedyaistu mahābhogā lakṣmīstāmbūladānataḥ ।।22।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca puṣpāṃjalinamo'rpaṇāt ।
aṣṭaiśvaryāṇi siddhyādyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇātmasamarpaṇāt ।।23।।
homena sarvakāmāśca saphalāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ।
sarve devāḥ pratuṣyanti viprāṇāṃ bhojanāt satām ।।।24।।
itthamārādhaya kṛṣṇayutāṃ śivaśivāṃ sute ।
ghorāddhoraṃ bhayaṃ putri! tariṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।।25।।
ityuktā kanyakā tāṃ maitreyīṃ sampūjya vastubhiḥ ।
gṛhaṃ gatvā cakāraitad vrataṃ saubhāgyavardhanam ।।26 ।।
sā tenā'bhūt siddhiyuktā pārvatīśrīsamā satī ।
atha kanyāpitā citravarmā candrāṃgadāya tām ।।27।।
dadau nalasya putrāya indrasenasutāya vai ।
tadudvāhe mahīpānāṃ samavāyo mahānabhūt ।।28।।
mahotsave sunirvṛtte jāmātā śvaśuragṛhe ।
uvāsa katicinmāsān kanyāyāḥ snehakāraṇāt ।।29।।
ekadā yamunāṃ tartuṃ tarīmāruhya bālakāḥ ।
yayurmadhye daivayogādāvarttābhihatā tarī ।।1.448.30।।
mamajjuḥ salile te tu mamrire sukumārakāḥ ।
nā'dṛśyanta kumārāste majjitā hi mahājale ।।3 1 ।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīd rājā rājñī prajāstathā ।
sīmantinī tathā sakhyo nāyakāśca purohitāḥ ।।32।।
vilepurmantriṇaścendraseno'pi vilalāpa ha ।
yamunāyā mahāpūre śavā api layaṃ gatāḥ ।।33।।
citravarmā prakārayāmāsaurdhvadaihikaṃ vidhim ।
sā tu sīmantinī sādhvī yoginī yogivattadā ।।34।।
vidadhe saṃyamaṃ saudhe sthitvā patyarthameva sā ।
samādhau saṃgatā tūrṇaṃ jalāntare tale satī ।।35।।
bahurūpadharā sādhvī bahusāmarthyayoginī ।
yamunāṃ tāṃ tadā pītavatī svāṃjalibhiḥ satī ।।36।।
śuṣkā'bhavattadā tveṣā yamunā kṣetrasadṛśī ।
mṛtāḥ śavā adṛśyanta sā nināya taṭaṃ tu tān ।।37।।
brahmarandhragatān yāँśca yamalokagatāँstathā ।
ājuhāva muhuḥ satyaparāste'tra samāyayuḥ ।।38।।
jīvitā eva ye sarve patitatra bhū dṛśyate ।
candrāṃgadaḥ pannagībhiḥ kanyābhirdṛṣṭa eva yat ।।39।।
sakāmābhiḥ sujātābhiḥ pātālaṃ prāpito'bhavat ।
takṣakasya puraṃ nītaścendrasvargā'dhikaṃ śubham ।।1.448.40।।
rūpayauvanamādhuryavilāsagatiśobhinā ।
nāgakanyāsahasreṇa samantātparivāritaḥ ।।41 ।।
takṣakastaṃ rājaputraṃ dadarśa kanyakāyutam।
papraccha sarvavṛttāntaṃ kanyāstvāhuryathātatham ।।42।।
atha candrāṃgadaścāpi śivakṛṣṇeti saṃjapan ।
takṣakeṇa śruto dṛṣṭaḥ preṣṇoktaśca sumānataḥ ।।43 ।।
parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ stāt tava bhaktiyutasya vai ।
bālo'pi yaṃ śivaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ japasyeva nirantaram ।।44।।
eṣa ratnamayo loka etāścārudṛśo'balāḥ ।
ete kalpadrumāḥ sarve vāpyo'mṛtarasāṃbhasaḥ ।।45।।
yatheṣṭaṃ- vihareteṣu bhuṅkṣva bhogān yathocitān ।
iti śrutvā rājaputraḥ provācā'haṃ vivāhitaḥ ।।46 ।।
pativratā mama kāntā satī sādhvī śivavratā ।
kṛṣṇapātivratyaparā matvā māṃ tu mṛtaṃ tataḥ ।।47।।
vaidhavyaṃ sarvacihnaistu grahīṣyati tato'thavā ।
agnau pravekṣyati sādhvī satī sā vidyate yataḥ ।।48।।
ato mayā bahutithaṃ nātra stheyaṃ kathañcana ।
tameva lokaṃ kṛpayā māṃ prāpayitumarhasi ।।49 ।।
ityuktavantaṃ candrāṃgaṃ takṣako nāgakanyakāḥ ।
bhavanāni subhogyāni vāhanānyamṛtāni ca ।।1.448.5 0।।
dadau kanyāpratuṣṭyarthaṃ ramaṇārthaṃ samastakam ।
athā'tra tatsatī bhāryā'navalokya priyaṃ patim ।।5 1 ।।
samudraṃ tvāhvayāmāsa satyena ca vratena vai ।
yadyahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktā'smi sarvathā ।।52।।
yadyahaṃ svapatiprāṇā pativratā'smi sarvathā ।
yadyahaṃ ca śivāyuktaśivatuṣṭyai vratānvitā ।।53।।
tadā samudrastvatraiva samāyātu samīpataḥ ।
ityuktvā svahastagataṃ jalaṃ mumoca sā bhuvi ।।54।।
tāvat samudraḥ sabhayaḥ sumūrto vai samāyayau ।
nanāma tu satīṃ ratnapradānaiḥ samatoṣayat ।।55।।
uvācaināṃ mayā naiva patiste'pahṛto'sti vai ।
pātāle takṣakakanyā ninyuste sundaraṃ varam ।।56।।
āgamiṣyati śīghraṃ saḥ toṣayitvā supannagīḥ ।
evamuktvā yayau tvabdhiḥ sīmantinī suharṣitā ।।57।।
kintvajñaiḥ rājamukhyaiḥ sā purohitādibhistathā ।
vaidhavyacihnayuktaiva tatra prasahya kāritā ।।।58।।
atha kanyāstoṣayitvā rathaṃ ratnāni bhūriśaḥ ।
nāgakanyāḥ śubhāḥ sarvā''bhūṣāvastrādiśobhitāḥ ।।59।।
takṣakenā'rpitā nītvā yamunāyāṃ samāyayau ।
satī sīmantinī svapne tvāgataṃ yamunājale ।।1.448.60।।
dṛṣṭvotthāya yayau pūjāpātraṃ nītvā sakhīyutā ।
sā dadarśa nadītīre viharantaṃ patiṃ priyam ।।61 ।।
divyaratnasamākīrṇaṃ divyamālāvataṃsakam ।
divyagandhena dehenā'pūrvākṛtiṃ samujjvalam ।।62।।
vilokya jaḍavad rājñīṃ tasthau tannyastalocanā ।
tāṃ ca candrāṃgado vīkṣya mumoha kṣaṇameva tu ।।63।।
nirmuktakaṇṭhābharaṇāṃ kaṇṭhasūtravivarjitām ।
asaṃyojitadhammilāmaṃgarāgavivarjitām ।।64।।
kiñcidvaidhavyadharmāktāṃ tāmāhūyā'bravīdidam ।
kimidaṃ dṛśyate sādhvi! śokasyā''vedakaṃ tava ।।65।।
iti snehena saṃpṛṣṭā nā'bravīdaśrulocanā ।
sakhī prāha prasahyaināṃ vaidhavyaṃ kāritaṃ janaiḥ ।।66 ।।
vinā patiṃ hi kṣantavyamanāthāyāstu sā gatiḥ ।
somavāravrataṃ naiva tyaktaṃ na ca pativratam ।।67।।
kṛṣṇasevā na vā tyaktā sarvaṃ tathaiva vidyate ।
munipatnīdarśitasya vratasya phalameva tu ।।68।।
prāptaṃ te priyayā rājan! gṛhāṇaināmaninditām ।
ityuktaḥ sa nijāṃ patnīṃ cakre vakṣasi pīḍitām ।।6 9।।
atha paurajanāstatra dṛṣṭvā''gataṃ nṛpātmajam ।
gatvā rājñe drutaṃ procuḥ rājā rājñī ca nāgarāḥ ।।1.448.70 ।।
pratyudgamya pariṣvajya tamāninyurnijālayam ।
rājaputraḥ śvaśurau tu vavande bāṣpamutsṛjan ।।71 ।।
prajāstaṃ mānayāmāsurvardhayāmāsurāśiṣā ।
teṣāṃ madhye samāsīnaḥ svavṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ ।।72।।
rājñe nivedayāmāsa takṣakasya sumitratām ।
dattaṃ ratnādikaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ rājñe nyavedayat ।।73।।
saumāṃgalyamayī vārtā patnīrāṣṭre'bhavattadā ।
tathā svasya pituḥ rāṣṭre mānavaiḥ kathitā kathā ।।74।।
pitarau ca prajāḥ sarvā niṣadhasyā'tiharṣitāḥ ।
tadutsavo mahānāsīd rāṣṭragrāmapurādiṣu ।।75।।
sīmantinī patiṃ prāpya tyaktavaidhavyalakṣaṇā ।
vahniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saubhāgyamaṃgalā'bhavat ।।76।।
candrāṃgadaḥ svahastena sindūrādi samārpayat ।
binduṃ parasparaṃ tau tu cakrāte sākṣataṃ śubham ।।77।।
mālāṃ parasparaṃ tau cārpayāmāsaturaiśvarīm ।
tāmbūlakaṃ dadatuśca dānāni vividhānyapi ।।78।।
athā'yaṃ śvaśurau natvā patnīyuto nijaṃ gṛham ।
niṣadhaṃ saṃyayau pitroḥ pādayorapatat tataḥ ।।79।।
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi sīmantinyā svabhāryayā ।
sārdhaṃ candrāṃgado rājā bubhuje viṣayān bahūn ।।1.448.8 0।।
prāsūta tanayānaṣṭau kanyāmekāṃ varānanām ।
reme sīmantinī bhartrā dhyāyamānā hariṃ haram ।।8 1 ।।
dine dine tu saubhāgyaṃ prāpa caivenduvāsarāt ।
evaṃ lakṣmi sadā pātivratyaṃ vijayate bhuvi ।।82।।
svarge satye brahmaloke pātāle pramadājane ।
pātivratyaṃ rakṣitaṃ cet sarvasiddhikaraṃ bhavet ।।83 ।।
patiṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ tu matvā dhyātvā sadā satī ।
kalpavṛkṣasamaṃ dharmaṃ pātivratyaṃ samācaret ।।84।।
parādhīnā'balānāṃ vai kāmapratimayoṣitām ।
dehāḥ pāpāśrayāḥ santi tato'pyadhikapuṇyadāḥ ।।85।।
pāpaṃ tu kāmātiśayaḥ, puṇyaṃ sevā pade pade ।
patisevā kṛṣṇasevā vratadānādisevanam ।।86 ।।
atitheśca satāṃ sevā gavāṃ sevā pade pade ।
niṣpāpānāmapatyānāṃ sevā brahmasvarūpiṇām ।।87।।
gṛhasaṃrakṣaṇaṃ sevā vahnāvannādipācanam ।
vaiśvadevātmikā sevā hyanāthaśvādibhojanam ।।88।।
annasatrātmikā sevā bālasya kalabhāṣaṇam ।
vidyādānātmikā sevā sahanaṃ sādhubhūṣaṇam ।।89।।
patyadhīnā nirīhā ca sadgaṇādisuśobhanam ।
ityeva sevayā puṇyamanantakaṃ striyāḥ sadā ।।1.448.90 ।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ tasmāt pātivratyaṃ samācaret ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svargo mokṣaḥ kare sthitau ।।91 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne candrāṃgadasya kṛṣṇapativratayā sīmantinīnāmnyā patnyā pātivratyabalacamatkārairyamunāmagnaḥ patiḥ pātāle nāgakanyābhirnīto'pi punaḥ prāpta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 448 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 448 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 449
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 450 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha sīmantinīsatyāścamatkāraṃ vadāmi te ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyāḥ patiyoṣitaḥ ।। 1 ।।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa sadā kṛṣṇaḥ pratuṣyati ।
patnī lakṣmīsvarūpā'sti patirnārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
iti buddhyā praseveta parasparaṃ pramucyate ।
dampatyoḥ kṛtasakalpāḥ siddhyanti nahi niṣphalāḥ ।। 3 ।।
vidarbhaviṣaye vipro vedamitro'bhavat sudhīḥ ।
tasya putraḥ sumedho'bhūddharmācāraparāyaṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
anyaḥ sārasvatākhyaśca vipro'bhūttasya pattane ।
tasya putraḥ somavāँścā'bhavaddharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 5 ।।
sumedhaḥ somavāँścobhau mitravaryau samākṛtī ।
sarvavidyākuśalinau samavidyau babhūvatuḥ ।। 6 ।।
tāvekadā svatanayau dvijāvavocatāṃ hitam ।
he putrakau yuvāṃ bālye kṛtavidyau suvarcasau ।। 7 ।।
vaivāhiko'yaṃ samayo vartate yuvayoḥ samam ।
imaṃ vidarbharājānaṃ prasādya prāpya vai dhanam ।। 8 ।।
śreṣṭhakulajakanyābhyāṃ kṛtodvāhau bhaviṣyathaḥ ।
evamuktau sutau gatvā samatoṣayatāṃ nṛpam ।। 9 ।।
dhanārthamarthito rājā prāha tau daivanoditaḥ ।
mama putrī niṣadheśapatnī sīmantinī satī ।। 1.449.1 0।।
somavāre pūjayitvā śrīpatiṃ pārvatīpatim ।
patnīyuktān dvijān vedavido dhanaṃ dadātyalam ।। 11 ।।
ato'tra yuvayoreko nārīvibhramaveṣadhṛk ।
ekastasyāḥ patiśceti jāyethāṃ vipradampatī ।। 12।।
gatvā tatra dhanaṃ labdhvā punaryātaṃ mamāntikam ।
yadi nyūnaṃ bhaveccet tad dāsye'haṃ tvadhikaṃ dhanam ।। 1 3।।
ityuktau prāhatuḥ rājan kartuṃ tajjāyate bhayam ।
devatāsu gurau pitroḥ siddhe yogini bhūbhṛti ।।14।।
kauṭilyamācaran sadyo daṇḍapātraṃ vinaśyati ।
gopyamānaṃ tu nau chadma kadācit khyātimeṣyati ।। 15।।
tadārjitā guṇāḥ sarve naśiśyanti kṣaṇānnṛpa ।
pāpaṃ nindā bhayaṃ vairaṃ tiṣṭhanti chadmani dhruvam ।। 16।।
ato dhūrtajanācāraṃ nāśrayāvaḥ kadācana ।
śrutvaitannṛpatiḥ prāha devatāpitṛyoginām ।। 17।।
nollaṃghyaṃ śāsanaṃ pālyaṃ sadgurusiddhabhūbhṛtām ।
śubhāśubhaṃ tadādiṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ śreyase bhavet ।। 18।।
ityuktau tau tathetyuktvā sāmavān rūpavāँstadā ।
strīveṣaṃ śāṭikāṃ bhūṣā añjanaṃ keśasādhanam ।। 1 9।।
aṃgarāgaṃ spṛhaṇīyaṃ dadhāra yuvatī yathā ।
evaṃ tau dampatī bhūtvā jagmatustāṃ sīmantinīm ।।1.449.20।।
sā rājñī tvarcayāṃcakre patnīyuktān yathāvratam ।
tau tu viprasutau dṛṣṭvā prāptau kṛtakadampatī ।।2 1 ।।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa tathā kṛṣṇasya sevayā ।
harabhaktyā vivedainaṃ kumāraṃ kanyakākṛtam ।।।22।।
jñātvā kiṃcid vihasyā'tha pitrā saṃpreṣitāviti ।
mene gaurīmaheśau ca lakṣmīnārāyaṇāviti ।।23।।
śivakṛṣṇātmakān viprān gaurīśrīrūpayoṣitaḥ ।
āvāhya gandhamālyādyairdhūpadīpairapūjayat ।।24।।
pāyasaṃ modakān miṣṭapolikāḥ śaṣkulīstathā ।
śākāni bhakṣyabhojyāni viprānabhojayat satī ।।25।।
tāmbūlaṃ dakṣiṇā dhenūrhiraṇyaṃ ratnalakṣakam ।
pratyekaṃ vastrabāhulyaṃ datvā natvā vyasarjayat ।।26 ।।
sīmantinyā śivāṃ lakṣmīṃ tvāvāhya sāmavān dvijaḥ ।
pūjitaḥ kalpitā kanyā satyaṃ kanyā vyajāyata ।।27।।
nārīcihnāni sarvāṇi paryavartanta varṣmaṇi ।
tau tu dhanaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai prāpya yayatuḥ svaṃ gṛham ।।28।।
sā tu vismṛtapuṃbhāvā mitre jātaspṛhā'bhavat ।
karābhyāṃ vipramābaddhya kandarpavivaśā'bravīt ।।29।।
ayi kānta kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭha vane ramye supuṣpite ।
tvayā vihartumicchāmi priyā te'smi gṛhāṇa mām ।।1.449.3 0।।
pariṣvajasva māṃ kāntāṃ pāyayasva navā'dharam ।
nā'haṃ gantuṃ samarthā'smi smarā''vegaprapīḍitā ।।3 1 ।।
itthamaśrutapūrvāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā niśamya śaṃkitaḥ ।
papraccha stanayuktāṃ tāṃ kimevaṃ bhāṣase sakhe ।।32।।
narmavākyaṃ vṛthā naivaṃ vaktavyaṃ kṛtrimā'bale ।
kanyāveṣaṃ parityajya kumāraveṣamāvaha ।।33।।
ityājñaptā prasannā sā vastrāṇi dūrato'karot ।
tāvat sā satyadhammilā jaghanastanaśobhinī ।।34।।
yoniyuktā liṃgahīnā dṛṣṭā sumedhasā priyā ।
sā tu jagrāha vipraṃ taṃ suratāya navapriyā ।।35।।
sumedhāḥ prāha tāṃ kanyāṃ śāṭikādīni dhāraya ।
na praśastaṃ viduṣorvaiṃ jāradharmaniṣevaṇam ।।36।।
vañcayitvā''tmapitarau dhūrtarājā'nuśāsanāt ।
ayaṃ svayaṃkṛto'nartha āvābhyāṃ yadviceṣṭitam ।।37।।
yastvaṃ viprātmajo bālaḥ prāptaḥ strītvaṃ vigarhitam ।
kāmabhogo hyanarthāya kumārayorviṣaṃ phalam ।।38।।
evaṃ vivekamāśritya tūṣṇīmehi svayaṃ gṛham ।
devadvijaprasādena strītvaṃ nāśaṃ sameṣyati ।।39।।
athavā daivayogena strītvameva bhavettava ।
pitrā dattā mayā sākaṃ raṃsyase varavarṇini ।।1.449.40 ।।
ityuktāpi kāmadāvānalavyāptā vadhūstadā ।
balena taṃ samāliṃgya cucumbā'dharapallavam ।।41 ।।
dharṣito'pi tayā dhīraḥ sumedhāḥ sparśamātrataḥ ।
śāntiṃ tasyāścakāraiva bahiḥ sparśaḥ pradāya ca ।।42।।
akṣatā kanyakā tṛptā kāmadāho nivavṛte ।
śuddhiṃ kṛtvā jalādyaiśca yayaturnṛpamandiram ।।43।।
rājā jñātvā'tha tadvṛttamavāpa vismayaṃ tataḥ ।
āhūya pitarau viprau jagāda svaviceṣṭitam ।।44।।
śrutvā sārasvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ dhūrtaceṣṭitam ।
are rājan mama putrastavā''jñayā tu kānyakam ।।45 ।।
veṣaṃ dhṛtvā'bhavat kanyā strītvaṃ bhuṃkte jugupsitam ।
adya mamaikaputrasya vaṃśo naṣṭastathā mama ।।46 ।।
nirāśāḥ pitaraḥ sarve luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ ।
vadā'tra kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ daṇḍyo'styadya bhavān khalu ।।47।।
rājā sarvān samāhūya maharṣīnāha dīnavat ।
asyāḥ puṃstvaṃ yathā syāt kurvantu mayi prasādanam ।।48।।
te'bruvan śrīpateḥ satīpaterlabhyaṃ prasādanam ।
tadbhaktānāṃ prasādaśca labhyasteneṣṭamāpnuyāt ।।49 ।।
atha rājā bharadvājaṃ samāhūya mahāmunim ।
pūjanaṃ kārayāmāsa śrīpateḥ pārvatīpateḥ ।।1.449.5 0।।
viprā rājā tathā kanyāścaite sarve hyupoṣitāḥ ।
trirātraṃ pūjanaṃ cakruḥ ṣoḍaśādisuvastubhiḥ ।।5 1 ।।
akhaṇḍaṃ bhajanaṃ cakrurmahotsavamakārayan ।
jaya lakṣmi jaya cāmbe śrīpate pārvatīpate ।।52।।
iti tadbhajanaṃ cākhaṇḍitaṃ bādyasamanvitam ।
cakrustena susantuṣṭau śrīpatiḥ pārvatīpatiḥ ।।53।।
āyayaturvāhanasthau patnī yuktau kṛpālayau ।
tau cāhatuśca rājānaṃ kiṃ te brūhi samīhitam ।।54।।
so'pyāha puṃstvametasya dīyetāṃ kṛpayā mayi ।
tāvāhatustadā rājannasmadbhaktaistu yat kṛtam ।।55।।
śakyate nā'nyathākartuṃ varṣāyutaśatairapi ।
sīmantinī mahābhaktā satī kṛṣṇapativratā ।।56।।।
naikasiddhiyutā devī yamunājalapāyinī ।
svabharturjīvarakṣāyāḥ kartrī yogasamādhinā ।।57।।
yathā saṃkalpayet sādhvī satī kṛṣṇāpativratā ।
tathā tatkalpanārūpaṃ vastu pariṇataṃ bhavet ।।58।।
kanyāveṣo'bhavad bālastayā'rcitā tu kanyakā ।
kanyeyaṃ pārvatī lakṣmīriti saṃkalpya pūjitā ।।59।।
sumedhasaḥ supatnīyamiti saṃkalpya sādaram ।
sumedhāśca patirasyāḥ somavatyāśca kalpitaḥ ।।1.449.6 0।।
tat tathaiva hi sañjātaṃ yogināṃ sabalā gatiḥ ।
nānyathā kriyate kaiściditi rājan nibodha vai ।।6 1 ।।
vayaṃ bhaktavaśāḥ sarve bhaktakṛtaṃ mataṃ hi naḥ ।
gacchantu ca bhavanto vai sīmantinyāḥ prapannatām ।।62।।
yadi kṛpāyutā rājñī yuṣmadiṣṭaṃ vidhāsyati ।
kanyeyaṃ kṛpayā tasyāḥ punaḥ puṃstvamavāpsyati ।।6 3 ।।
ityuktā vimanasaste yayuḥ sīmantinīgṛham ।
puṃstvārthaṃ prārthayāmāsuḥ prāha sīmantinī tu tān ।।64।।
kṛtaṃ karmaphalaṃ bhuṃkte mānavo bhuvi sarvathā ।
asyā mātrā vrataṃ puṇyakākhyaṃ kṛtaṃ purā yadā ।।6 5।।
putrecchayā kṛtaṃ cāpi varṣānte dakṣiṇāvidhau ।
putrī syānme tadā śreṣṭhamiti vai kalpitaṃ phale ।।66 ।।
evaṃ dvedhā vratapūrṇāhūtau saṃkalpitaṃ yataḥ ।
tataḥ putraḥ samutpannaḥ sa eva yauvanaṃ gate ।।67।।
kanyārūpā prajātā'sti vratena karmaṇāpi ca ।
tasmānneyaṃ punaḥ puṃstvaṃ gamiṣyati kadācana ।।68।।
kintu punastatsvarūpastatpitroḥ susutaḥ śubhaḥ ।
sarvalakṣaṇasampanno dīrghajīvī ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।69।।
mameṣṭadevasaṃkalpād bhaviṣyati hi niścitaḥ ।
eṣā sāmavatī nāma sutā tasya dvijanmanaḥ ।।1.449.70।।
bhūtvā sumedhasaḥ patnī kāmabhogena yujyatām ।
yatsaṃkalpena yajjātaṃ prāgbhave cātra vā bhave ।।71 ।।

phalaṃ saṃskārajanyaṃ tat samāpatati kālataḥ ।
asminneva bhave tveṣā nārīveṣadharā satī ।।72।।
patiṃ matvā sumedhaṃ taṃ vāmapārśve sthitā'bhavat ।
pativratāyā hastena pūjanaṃ sarvasākṣikam ।।73।।
sañjātaṃ devatulyena rājñā samanumoditam ।
satsarvaṃ tīvrasaṃvegaṃ karma tvasyāḥ phalātmakam ।।74।।
pākaṃ prāptaṃ śakyate nā'nyathākartuṃ tu kenacit ।
kaṇvasya vacanāt kṛṣṇakuṭumbasya vināśakam ।।75।।
sāmbagarbhasamābaddhaṃ mūśalaṃ suvyajāyata ।
tasmācchoko na kartavyaḥ prāpte phale tu karmaṇaḥ ।।76।।
kanyātve'pi parau lābhaḥ putraste syād dvitīyakaḥ ।
evaṃ matvā sukhaṃ yāntu sarve santu nirāmayāḥ ।।77।।
ityuktvā sā satī putrīṃ sīmantinī śubhāśiṣā ।
yojayāmāsa bahudhā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ tu te ।।78।।
sārasvato dvijaḥ putrīṃ dadau tasmai sumedhase ।
alabhad dvitīyaṃ putraṃ sutābhūtasutottamam ।।79।।
evaṃ satīpratāpena tvatarkyamapi jāyate ।
tatrāpi kṛṣṇabhaktāyā iṣṭaṃ drutaṃ vivartate ।।1.449.80।।
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi sarvaṃ tapaḥprabhāvanam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya yatheṣṭaṃ labhate janaḥ ।।81।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sārasvataviprasya sāmavānnāmakasutasya vivāhavyayārthaṃ vidarbharājato dhanecchayā gatasya kanyāveṣeṇa bhikṣukasya sāmavataḥ pativratayā sīmantinyā kanyāṃ matvā pūjitasya sāmavatīkanyātvaṃ tatpituḥ putrāntaraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।449।।


← adhyāyaḥ 449 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 450
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 451 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! sutārthaṃ vai pārvatyāḥ pātivratyakam ।
satyā svayaṃ suramadhye vratānte samprakāśitam ।। 1 ।।
himālayo dadau kanyāṃ pārvatīṃ śaṃkarāya tu ।
saṃreme narmadātīre śayyāyāṃ śivayā haraḥ ।। 2 ।।
tayorbabhūva śṛṃgāro yoginorbahuvāsarān ।
devā daityārditāḥ śaṃbhuputraṃ daityavināśakam ।। 3 ।।
ayonijaṃ samicchanto yayustayoḥ ratergṛham ।
vīryasrāvasya nikaṭe prākkṣaṇe dvāri te sthitāḥ ।। 4 ।।
ājuhuvurmahādevaṃ devāste ratibhaṃjakāḥ ।
uttiṣṭhato maheśasya bhūmau vīryaṃ papāta ha ।। 5 ।।
tadvai tatra suvarṇaṃ ca rajataṃ ca vyajāyata ।
atha vīryaṃ na vai garbhe prāptaṃ satyāḥ śuśoca sā ।। 6 ।।
yato devaiḥ kṛtaṃ vighnaṃ tato devā api sadā ।
rati bhaṃgakarāḥ sarve vyarthavīryā bhavantviti ।। 7 ।।
ityuktvā śaṃkaraṃ prāha rativicchedaduḥkhitā ।
ratibhaṃgo duḥkhamekaṃ dvitīyaṃ vīryapātanam ।। 8 ।।
duḥkhātirekiduḥkhaṃ tu tṛtīyamanapatyatā ।
tataḥ putrau+o yathā me syāttathā kurvatra śaṃkara! ।। 9 ।।
śrutvā tāṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha harerbhaktyanvitā sadā ।
vrataṃ tu puṇyakaṃ nāma varṣamekaṃ kuru priye ।। 1.450.1 0।।
tena putraphalaṃ te'tra niścitaṃ vai bhaviṣyati ।
vrataṃ tat sukhadaṃ puṇyaṃ vāñcchākalpadrumātmakam ।। 11 ।।
jāhnavī saritāṃ madhye surāṇāṃ śrīhariryathā ।
ahaṃ vaiṣṇavabhaktānāṃ yathā tvaṃ devayoṣitām ।। 12।।
lakṣmīśca sampadāṃ yadvat suvarṇaṃ dravyanāminām ।
śīlavrataṃ vratānāṃ ca tadvat puṇyavrataṃ tvidam ।। 13 ।।
varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yadvat tīrthānāṃ badarīvanam ।
pārijātaṃ kusumānāṃ dalānāṃ tulasīdalam ।। 14।।
ekādaśī tithīnāṃ ca vārāṇāṃ tu yathā raviḥ ।
mārgaśīrṣaśca māsānāmṛtūnāṃ ca vasantakaḥ ।। 15।।
samvatsaraśca varṣāṇāṃ yugānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ yathā ।
vidyāguruśca pūjyānāṃ gurūṇāṃ jananī yathā ।। 16 ।।
satī patnī yathā''ptānāṃ viśvastānāṃ tu hṛd yathā ।
yathā ratnaṃ dhanānāṃ ca priyāṇāṃ ca yathā patiḥ ।। 17।।
yathā sutaśca bandhūnāṃ kalpadruḥ śākhināṃ yathā ।
āmraphalaṃ phalānāṃ deśānāṃ saurāṣṭrako yathā ।। 18।।
vṛndāvanaṃ vanānāṃ ca rādhikā yoṣitāṃ yathā ।
purīṇāṃ ca yathā kāśī lakṣmīnāṃ kaṃbharā yathā ।। 1 9।।
tejasvināṃ yathā tvarkaḥ khaṇḍānāṃ tvajanābhakam ।
rātrīśānāṃ yathā candro mohakānāṃ ca manmathaḥ ।।1.450.20।।
vidyānāṃ tu yathā vedāḥ sādhūnāṃ kapilo yathā ।
vānarāṇāṃ hanūmāँśca kṣetrāṇāṃ ca satāṃmukham ।।21 ।।
netrāṇāṃ ca yathā vidyā vāsanā balināṃ yathā ।
manoharāṇāṃ kāvyaṃ ca vyāpakānāṃ viyad yathā ।।22।।
aṃgānāṃ locanaṃ yadvat sādhyānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ yathā ।
vaibhavānāṃ kṛṣṇakathā sukhānāṃ tṛṣṇikālayaḥ ।।23।।
sparśānāṃ putrasaṃsparśo hiṃsakānāṃ khalo yathā ।
yathā mithyā ca pāpānāṃ pāpināṃ mātṛgo yathā ।।24।।
puṇyānāṃ svārpaṇaṃ yadvat kāryāṇāṃ sādhusevanam ।
aikāgryaṃ tapasāṃ yadvallābhānāṃ harisevanam ।।25।।
gavyānāṃ ca ghṛtaṃ yathā vṛkṣastapasvinām ।
amṛtaṃ bhojyavastūnāṃ sasyānāṃ vrīhayo yathā ।।26 ।।
pavitrāṇāṃ yathā vāri śodhakānāṃ yathā'nalaḥ ।
strīrūpaṃ sarvarūpāṇāṃ miṣṭānāṃ supriyaṃ vacaḥ ।।27।।
vainateyaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ ca airāvataśca dantinām ।
sanatkumāro yogināṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ ।।28।।
gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho gururbuddhimatāṃ yathā ।
kavīnāṃ tu yathā śukraḥ kāvyānāṃ saṃhitā yathā ।।29।।
srotasvatāṃ yathā tvabdhiḥ kṣamiṇāṃ ca kṣitiryathā ।
phalānāṃ ca yathā muktiḥ śāntiśca sampadāṃ yathā ।।1.450.30।।
pāvanānāṃ vaiṣṇāvāśca varṇānāṃ praṇavo yathā ।
kṛṣṇamantraśca mantrāṇāṃ poṣṭṝṇāṃ prakṛtiryathā ।।3 1 ।।
sarasvatī viduṣīṇāṃ gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā ।
yathā kuberaḥ śreṣṭhistho nāgānāṃ vāsukiryathā ।।32।।
śayyānāṃ ca yathā śeṣo layānāṃ nidrikā yathā ।
niṣkriyāṇāṃ yathā''lasyaṃ śailānāṃ meruparvataḥ ।।33।।
gavāṃ ca surabhiryadvat tṛṇānāṃ ca yathā kuśaḥ ।
vedānāṃ sāmavedaśca mano vai vegināṃ yathā ।।34।।
sukhadānāṃ yathā lakṣmīrakṣarāṇāmavarṇakaḥ ।
hitārthināṃ yathā tāto hetīnāṃ kavacaṃ yathā ।।35।।
śālagrāmaśca mūrtīnāṃ paśūnāṃ kesarī yathā ।
dehināṃ mānavo yadvadindriyāṇāṃ tu hṛd yathā ।।36।।
mandāgniśca rujāṃ yadvacchaktiḥ śaktimatāṃ yathā ।
sthūlānāṃ ca virāḍ yadvat sūkṣmāṇāṃ paramāṇukaḥ ।।37।।
ādityānāṃ yathā viṣṇurdevānāmindra eva ca ।
daityānāṃ ca baliryadvad dātṝṇāṃ ca dadhīcikaḥ ।।38।।
prahlādaścaiva sādhūnāṃ cakrāṇāṃ ca sudarśanam ।
brahmāstraṃ ca yathā'strāṇāṃ rāmādityaśca bhūbhṛtām ।।39।।
dhanvināṃ ca naro yadvat kṛṣṇo hṛdayavāsinām ।
prasevyānāṃ gururyadvad vratānāṃ puṇyakaṃ tathā ।।1.450.40 ।।
kartavyaṃ sevanīyaṃ ca pālanīyaṃ suputradam ।
harermantraṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ vrataṃ putrapradaṃ kuru ।।41 ।।
māghaśuklatrayodaśyāṃ vratāraṃbhaḥ śubhaḥ priye ।
upoṣya pūrvadivase dvitīye vratamācaret ।।42।।
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ ṣoḍaśavastusūpacāraiḥ prapūjayet ।
āsanaṃ svāgataṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam ।।43।।
snānīyaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।
sugandhi puṣpadhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ naivedyacandanam ।।44।।
yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dravyāṇyetāni ṣoḍaśa ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ praṇāmādīn kṣamā cātha visarjanam ।।45।।
nityaṃ kuryād vrataṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ putraphalapradam ।
ṣaṇmāsāँśca haviṣyānnaṃ māsān pañca phalādikam ।।46।।
haviḥ pakṣaṃ jalaṃ pakṣaṃ vratameva samāpayet ।
deyā vratasamāptī ca dakṣiṇā homapūrvikā ।।47।।
kṛṣṇāṃśo vai bhavetputro vratakartryā na saṃśayaḥ ।
priyavratottānapādau lebhe śatarūpā vratāt ।।48।।
devahūtirvratāllebhe kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kapilaṃ sutam ।
arundhatī vratāllebhe kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaktikaṃ sutam ।।49।।
sāvitrī ca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vedān suputrakān ।
śaktikāntā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe putraṃ parāśaram ।।1.450.50।।
satyavatī vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vyāsaṃ sutaṃ harim ।
vratena kaṃbharā prāpa sutaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।51 ।।
aditiśca vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe vāmanakaṃ sutam ।
mahendrāṇī vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe jayantakaṃ sutam ।।52।।
uttānapādapatnī ca lebhe dhruvaṃ vratāt sutam ।
kuberāṇī vrataṃ kṛtvā lalābha nalakūbaram ।।53।।
sūryapatnī śrāddhadevaṃ manuṃ lebhe ca raivatam ।
anasūyā vrataṃ kṛtvā lebhe candraṃ śubhaṃ sutam ।।54।।
lebhe cāṃgirasaḥ patnī vratāt। sutaṃ bṛhaspatim ।
khyātirlebhe vrataṃ kṛtvā śukrācāryaṃ sutaṃ kavim ।।।55।।
ete nārāyaṇāṃśā vai jātā vrataprabhāvataḥ ।
vratasyāsya prabhāveṇa svayaṃ gopīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।।56।।
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tava putro bhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā saha jāhnavīm ।।57।।
tasyai dadau harermantraṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ śubham ।
snātvā vratasya saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā yayā gṛhaṃ nijam ।।58।।
ānīya sarvadravyāṇi samārebhe vrataṃ tataḥ ।
sanatkumāro bhagavānabhūt tatra purohitaḥ ।। 59।।
brahmādyā devatāḥ sarve manavo yatayastathā ।
ṛṣayo vālakhilyāśca dakṣādyā bhūbhṛtastathā ।।1.450.60।।
dikpālā lokapālāśca cirajīvina āyayuḥ ।
pūjitāḥ śaṃbhunā prāhuḥ karotu puṇyakaṃ śivā ।।61 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇaśca sutastasyā bhaviṣyati purā yathā ।
evaṃ kramo mahādeva! kalpe kalpe'sti sarvathā ।।62।।
ityuktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ sanatkumāreṇa niveditām ।
pārvatīdvārikāṃ kṛṣṇapūjāṃ śreṣṭhāmakārayat ।।63।।
saṃsthāpya ratnakalaśaṃ śukladhānyopari sthitam ।
āmrapallavasaṃyuktaṃ phalākṣatasuśobhitam ।।64।।
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumādisamarcitam ।
munīn satī pūjayitvā saṃpūjya svapurohitam ।।65।।
puraḥ saṃsthāpya dikpālān devān samarcya vai tataḥ ।
svastivācaṃ vācayitvā''vāhya kṛṣṇaṃ ghaṭe tataḥ ।।66 ।।
sampūjya ṣoḍaśadravyairupahāraṃ cakāra sā ।
tilasarpiṣā havanaṃ trilakṣaṃ pracakāra sā ।।67।।
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa pradadau dakṣiṇāṃ parām ।
purohitaḥ śivāṃ prāha dehi me patidakṣiṇām ।।68।।
patirūpāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tu śrutvā śuśoca pārvatī ।
śivaḥ prāha śive! dakṣiṇayā karmaphalaṃ bhavet ।।69।।
yatkarma dakṣiṇāhīnaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet ।
tanmuhūrte vyatīte tu dakṣiṇā dviguṇā bhavet ।।1.450.70।।
caturguṇā dinātīte pakṣe śataguṇā bhavet ।
māse pañcaśataguṇā ṣaṇmāse taccaturguṇā ।।71 ।।
samvatsare vyatīte tu karma tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet ।
putrapautradhanaiśvaryakṣayaḥ syāttu tataḥ param ।।72।।
dharmo naṣṭo bhavettasya dharmahīne tu karmaṇi ।
viṣṇuḥ prāha sati! rakṣa phaladaṃ rakṣakaṃ vṛṣam ।।73 ।।
brahmā prāha sati! dharme naṣṭe kartā vinaśyati ।
dharmaḥ prāha śive! kāntaṃ datvā māṃ rakṣa yatnataḥ ।।74।।
rakṣite ca mayi sādhvi! sarvaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati ।
devā ūcuḥ rakṣa dharmaṃ kuru pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ sati! ।।75।।
vayaṃ tava vrate pūrṇe kurmastvāṃ pūrṇamānasām ।
ūcustāṃ munayaḥ śaṃbhuṃ dehi viprāya dakṣiṇām ।।76 ।।
sthiteṣvatmatsu dharmajñe nā'bhadraṃ te bhaviṣyati ।
prāha sanatkumārastvaṃ me śivaṃ dehi dakṣiṇām ।।77।।
no ced vrataphalaṃ sarvaṃ tyaja prāpsyāmyahaṃ phalam ।
śivā prāha patiryatra hriyate tu purodhasā ।।78।।
kiṃ me syāt tadvratenāpi kiṃ me dakṣiṇayā surāḥ ।
kiṃ putreṇa ca dharmeṇa sarvasvaṃ yatra nīyate ।।79।।
kutaḥ phalaṃ kuto vṛkṣo yadi bījaṃ na vidyate ।
bhūmiḥ sā niṣphalā bījaṃ vinā sasyapradā na vai ।।1.450.80।।
kṛṣiśca viphalā sarvā bījaṃ vinā tu vārṣikī ।
prāṇaṃ tyaktvā prayatnena varṣmaṇā kiṃ prayojanam ।।81 ।।
dṛṣṭiśaktivihīnena cakṣuṣā kiṃ prayojanam ।
śataputrādhikaḥ svāmī sādhvīnāṃ tu sureśvarāḥ ।।82।।
yadi bhartā vrate deyaḥ kiṃ vratena sutena vā ।
bharturvaṃśo hi tanayo bhartumūlo bhavetsadā ।।83।।
yatra mūlaṃ bhaved bhraṣṭaṃ tadvyāpārastu hānidaḥ ।
viṣṇuḥ prāha satīṃ tatra putrāt svāmī paraḥ sadā ।।84।।
svāminaśca paro dharmastannāśe svāminā'pi kim ।
brahmā prāha sati putri dharmo vai svāminaḥ paraḥ ।।85।।
dharmātparaṃ satyakāryaṃ vrataṃ satyaṃ paraṃ matam ।
satyaṃ sadakṣiṇaṃ karma na tu bhraṣṭaṃ kuru vratam ।।86।।
śivā prāha ca vedeṣu svaśabdo dhanavācakaḥ ।
tad yasyā'stīti sa svāmī dhanavān sa samucyate ।।87।।
dhanitaḥ śreṣṭha evātra dharmastato vrataṃ ṛtam ।
tebhyo'dhikaḥ patiḥ svāmī svāmitvaṃ tatra śāśvatam ।।88।।
āgantukaṃ dhanavatāṃ tasmāt। svāmī patiḥ paraḥ ।
tasyā'haṃ dhanamevā'smi pitrā'haṃ cārpitā purā ।।89।।
dānarūpā śivasvatvavatī cāhaṃ na me śivaḥ ।
svatvaṃ vinā kathaṃ dānaṃ vadantyatra surādayaḥ ।।1.450.90।।
dharmaḥ prāha sadā patnī svāmino'rdhāṃganā matā ।
dampatīmūrtirekaiva svena svaṃ śakyate'rpitum ।। 91 ।।
satī prāha mayi svāmyaṃ svāmitvaṃ ceti cāgatam ।
svāmitvavigamaṃ svāmyaṃ vinivogakṣamaṃ bhavet ।।92।।
tato yogyā na varte'trā'rpayituṃ tu patiṃ mama ।
patirdāne striyā datta iti sṛṣṭau na vai śrutam ।। 93।।
kanyādānaṃ śrutāvuktaṃ jāmātre jagatāṃ kramaḥ ।
varadānaṃ varārthinyai jyeṣṭhapitre kutaḥ kramaḥ ।।14।।
devāḥ prāhuḥ sati! naiva buddhimanto vayaṃ tvayi ।
puṇyake kalpitāṃ svāmidakṣiṇāṃ dharmamācara ।।95।।
śrutau śrutaḥ sa vai dharmo viparīto hyadharmakaḥ ।
satī prāha vinā lokācāraṃ vedo'tinirbalaḥ ।।96 ।।
vede prakṛtipuṃsostu garīyān puruṣo'dhipaḥ ।
adhipaṃ nu kathaṃ dāsye bālā'haṃ kathayāmi kim ।।97।।
bṛhaspatistadā prāha sargaścobhayanirmitaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaścobhayasraṣṭā samau prakṛtipūruṣau ।।98।।
satī prāha pumān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśa eva saḥ ।
nāryastu mūlaprakṛteraṃśāstataḥ pumān guruḥ ।।99।।
pumāँstvatra parabrahma sadāśivaḥ patirmama ।
mayā kathaṃ patirdeyo vadantvatra hi devatāḥ ।। 1.450.10 0।।
itivāde pravṛtte'tra vimānaṃ svarṇabhāsvaram ।
āgataṃ śrīpatirnārāyaṇaścaturbhujastataḥ ।। 10 1।।
avatīrya sabhāmadhye sthitaḥ sarvaiḥ prapūjitaḥ ।
prāha gaurīṃ sati! tvayā nyāyyameva samucyate ।। 1 02।।
dakṣiṇā yajñapatnī ca yajamānena dīyate ।
viprāya tatra mūlyaṃ vai dīyate na kratupriyā ।। 1 03।।
parapatnī pareṇa dīyate parāya na kvacit ।
tannimittaṃ svarṇaraupyaṃ dīyate dhanameva yat ।।1 04।।
patnīdāne putradāne svasya dāne patyarpaṇe ।
gopradānaṃ vidhāyaiva karma pūrṇaॆ prajāyate ।। 105।।
viṣṇudehā yathā gāvo viṣṇudehastathā śivaḥ ।
viṣṇudehā dakṣiṇā ca mūlyātmikā pradīyate ।। 1 06।।
vrataṃ pūrṇe kuru śive! śivaṃ datvā tu dakṣiṇām ।
punaḥ samucitaṃ mūlyaṃ datvā nāthaṃ grahīṣyasi ।। 1 07।।
ityuktā sā havanānte śivaṃ 3 dakṣiṇāṃ dadau ।
svastītyuktvā tu jagrāha kumāro devasaṃsadi ।। 108।।
satī prāha gṛhāṇaitad gavāṃ lakṣaṃ dhanaṃ ca vā ।
dehi matsvāminaṃ vipra dāsye dānāni vai tataḥ ।। 1 09।।
patiṃ vinā na vai karma tvanyat kartuॆ kṣamā yataḥ ।
sanatkumāraścovāca me gavāṃ na prayojanam ।।1.450.1 1 0।।
ratnānāṃ ca dhanānāṃ ca sādhorme kiṃ prayojanam ।
prayojanaṃ me śiṣyasya tyāgino'vadhūtasya ca ।। 111 ।।
sa tu prāpto mayā tvatto na dāsye śaṃkaraṃ tava ।
karturevepsitaṃ karma svasya dravye svatantratā ।।1 12।।
anye vadantu yatkiñcid gobhirna me prayojanam ।
digambaraṃ puraḥ kṛtvā bhramiṣyāmi jagattrayam ।। 11 3।।
bālakānāṃ bālikānāṃ samūhasmitakāraṇam ।
ityuktvā tu śivaṃ pārśve vāsayāmāsa vai sanat ।। 1 14।।
pārvatī tu tadottasthau jagāda śokavihvalā ।
punarlabdhaḥ patirnaiva na prāptaṃ tu phalaṃ vrate ।।1 15।।
eṣā satī bhavāmyatra vahnimutpādya dehataḥ ।
hāhākāro'bhavat tatra śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam ।। 1 16।।
jhaṭityenāṃ samāśliṣya vārayāmāsa mūrtimān ।
satyā dṛṣṭaśca bhagavān vimānādavatīrya saḥ ।। 1 17।।
rarāja vinivāryaiva sabhāmadhye vilokitaḥ ।
devauḥ supūjite kṛṣṇaṃ pārvatī tuṣṭuve hṛdā ।। 1 18।।
tvayā'haṃ jīvitā kṛṣṇa punarjīvaya śaṃbhunā!
śaṃbhuṃ dehi phalaṃ dehi putraṃ bhavādṛśaṃ prabho ।।1 1 9।।
ityuktaḥ śrīhariḥ satyai dāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram ।
purodhase dadau dravyaṃ viprebhyo dakṣiṇāstathā ।। 1.450.1 20।।।
vrataṃ samāpya sā sarvān bhojayitvā tataḥ param ।
bubhuje svāminā sārdhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca dadau tataḥ ।। 121 ।।
devādyāḥ pūjitāḥ sarve yayuḥ svargaṃ tataḥ satī ।
śayyāyāṃ śaṃbhunā reme tāvad brāhmaṇarūpadhṛk ।। 1 22।।
kṛṣṇastatra samāyāto vṛddho bhikṣuka āha ca ।
mātarbhikṣāṃ tu me dehi punaḥ punaruvāca ha ।।123।।
śaṃbhurutthāya tu śīghraṃ vīryamutsṛjya śāyane ।
bahiḥ śīghraṃ tvājagāma tat satyāḥ śarīre'lagat ।। 124।।
vīryaṃ yattatkṛtaḥ piṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇastasmin vyalīyata ।
tūrṇaṃ bālo'bhavat satyā kṛṣṇatulyo vilokitaḥ ।। 125।।
evaṃ prāpto gaṇeśaḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svayameva tu ।
pātivratyena sā durgā patiṃ tatyāja na kvacit ।। 1 26।।
patirdevaḥ patiḥ poṣṭā paralokapradāyakaḥ ।
putrapautrādivaṃśasya mūlaṃ patiḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 127।।
prāṇānāṃ vigame cāpi na tyājyaḥ svapatiḥ priyaḥ ।
dakṣiṇārthaṃ gṛhīto'pi gṛhīto na visarjitaḥ ।। 1 28।।
evaṃ patipriyā sādhvī labhate kṛṣṇasadṛśam ।
suputraṃ kṛpayā patyuḥ kimu vācyaṃ nu padmaje ।। 129।।
satīvratasamākhyānaṃ patidānasamāgraham ।
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi putraṃ saubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।। 1.450.1 30।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyāḥ puṇyakavrate śaṃbhudakṣiṇānimittapātivratyabalaṃ saṃvādo gaṇeśaputraprāptiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।450।।


← adhyāyaḥ 450 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 451
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 452 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi śabaryāstu pativratam ।
camatkārabharaṃ sarvaṃ patyarthaṃ kiṃ na jāyate ।। 1 ।।
yā satī sarvathā svāmisantoṣādiparāyaṇā ।
jayatyeva sadā loke dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
āsīt pāñcālarājasya siṃhaketostu kiṃkaraḥ ।
caṇḍakākhyastu śabaro yasya gehe pativratā ।। 3 ।।
śabarī patibhaktā''sīt patiṃ matvā paraṃ prabhum ।
patiṃ bheje sadā bhaktyā yathā santoṣamāpnuyāt ।। 4 ।।
bhojanādau vihārādau vyavasāyādikarmasu ।
kaiṃkarye vā gṛhakārye kleśaṃ naiva karoti sā ।। ।9 ।।
sarvadā suprasannā''ste smitānanā ca kiṃkarī ।
śuṣkaṃ rūkṣaṃ paryuṣitaṃ snigdhaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca vātulam ।। 6 ।।
tiktaṃ dagdhamapakvaṃ vā bharjitaṃ pācitaṃ ca vā ।
saṃskṛtaṃ bāṣpitaṃ yadvā yādṛk tādṛg bhavedapi ।। 7 ।।
śabaro na ruṣaṃ yāti śabarī na vidūyate ।
śabaro nityamevā'syāḥ premapātraṃ suśāntidaḥ ।। 8 ।।
śabarī svāmivaśagā datvā kāntāya khādati ।
kāntaṃ viṣṇuṃ sadā matvā karoti sevanaṃ satī ।। 9 ।।
śūdradharmaṃ puraskṛtya vartete dampatī sadā ।
niṣkapaṭau śāṭyahīnau satyamārgaparāyaṇau ।।1.451.1 0।।
sādhūnāṃ sevakau nyāyamārgalabdhasujīvanau ।
kaiṃkaryeṇa ca yallabdhamannādyaṃ tatra tuṣyataḥ ।। 11 ।।
kārye prāpte śabaraśca pṛṣṭvā bhāryāṃ karoti tat ।
śabaryapi patiṃ pṛṣṭvā kāryaṃ yogyaṃ karoti sā ।। 12।।
yadyapi syātprāṇanāśaḥ pativākyaṃ na muñcati ।
śabaro'pi niṣiddhaṃ yacchabaryā na karoti tat ।। 1 3।।
śabaryapi niṣiddhaṃ yat svāminā na karoti tat ।
yatra vai manasoraikyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ svargameva tat ।। 14।।
yatra satyaṃ niṣkāpaṭyaṃ parasparaṃ sumānanam ।
tatra nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo viṣṇu śivaḥ śivā śriyāḥ ।।15।।
smṛddhayaśca śubho lābhaḥ siddhiḥ rakṣā nirāmayam ।
ekadā siṃhaketuḥ saḥ kṣātradharmaṃ samāśritaḥ ।। 16।।
jagāma mṛgayārthaṃ sabhṛtyo vanaṃ mṛgānvitam ।
śabaraḥ sa vane jīrṇaṃ dadarśa devatālayam ।। 17।।
tatra liṃgaṃ bhagnapīṭhe viyuktaṃ svalpamityapi ।
dṛṣṭvā''dāya nṛpaṃ prāha paśyainaṃ ruciraṃ śivam ।। 18।।
tamenaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi yathāvibhavamādarāt ।
pūjārītiṃ mama brūhi prītaḥ syācchaṃkaro yathā ।। 19।।
iti pṛṣṭho nṛpaḥ prāha prahasyainaṃ yathātatham ।
kaṭhinaṃ pūjanaṃ tvasya tvayā tannahi pāryate ।।।1.451.20।।
saṃkalpena sadā kuryādabhiṣekaṃ navā'mbhasā ।
upaveśyā''sane śuddhe śubhairgandhā'kṣatairnavaiḥ ।।21 ।।
vanyaiḥ patraiśca kusumairdhūpairdīpaiśca pūjayet ।
citābhasmopahāraṃ ca prathamaṃ parikalpayet ।।22।।
ātmopabhogyenānnena naivedyaṃ kalpayet sadā ।
punaśca dhūpadīpādīnupacārānprakalpayet ।।23।।
nṛtyavāditragītādīn thathāvat parikalpayet ।
namaskāraṃ prakuryācca prasādaṃ dhārayet tataḥ ।।24।।
eṣa sādhāraṇaḥ proktaḥ śivapūjāvidhistava ।
citābhasmopahāreṇa sadyastuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ ।।25।।
namaḥ śivāya ca vadet pārvatīpataye namaḥ ।
evamuccārayan devaṃ pūjayet sakuṭumbakaḥ ।।26।।
ityuktaścaṇḍako bhīlo mūrdhnā jagrāha tadvacaḥ ।
atha svabhavanaṃ prāpya liṅgarūpaṃ sadāśivam ।। 27।।
catuṣke pippalamūle saṃsthāpya vaidikopari ।
pratyahaṃ pūjayāmāsa citābhasmopahārakṛt ।।28।।
yattvātmanaḥ priyaṃ vastu patnyāścāpi priyaṃ tu yat ।
gandhapuṣpā'kṣatādyaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ kaṇameva vā ।।29।।
nivedya śaṃbhave nityamupāyuṃkta tataḥ svayam ।
evaṃ sadāśivaṃ bhaktyā saha patnyā'bhyapūjayat ।।1.451.30।।
āśutoṣastutoṣā'smai dadau sukhaṃ dhanādikam ।
annaṃ vastraṃ gṛhaṃ dravyaṃ gauśca dogdhrī yaśastathā ।।3 1 ।।
rājyataḥ prāpyate sarvaṃ vetanaṃ dāsyadharmataḥ ।
satyādhāraṃ śivādhāraṃ sukhaṃ prāptaṃ kuṭumbinā ।।32।।
yathā yathā'bhavad bhīlaḥ sukhī sādhanavāँstathā ।
pūjanaṃ prākaronnityaṃ niyamenā'rhaṇaṃ muhuḥ ।।33।।
svayaṃ gatvā śmaśānādāvādāya śavabhasma saḥ ।
śivasya pūjanaṃ cakre vṛṣṭyādāvapi nityadā ।।34।।
ekadā śivapūjāyai pravṛttaḥ śabarottamaḥ ।
na dadarśa citābhasma pātre yad rakṣitaṃ ca tat ।।35।।
vṛṣṭyā rātrau jaladhārā pātre papāta chidrataḥ ।
bhasma prakṣālitaṃ sarvaṃ pravāheṇa samaṃ gatam ।।36।।
iti vilokya riktaṃ tatpātraṃ yatra ca nā'ṇvapi ।
bhasma lebhe tato dūraṃ śmaśānaṃ prayayāvapi ।।37।।
vṛṣṭyā prakṣālitatvāttu citābhūmermanāgapi ।
bhasma lebhe na vai tatra paritaḥ saṃbhramannapi ।।38।।
tataḥ śrānto riktahasto gṛhamāgānnirāśakaḥ ।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi bhasmārtha cādya bhūtale ।।39।।
vṛṣṭiḥ sarvatra bahulā jātā prajāyate'tigā ।
grāmāntare'pi sarvatra kṣālitā pherurāṭkṣitiḥ ।।1.451.40।।
bhasma prāpyeta naivādya pūjā jāyeta naiva ca ।
bhojanādyaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ bhavennādya tu me khalu ।।41 ।।
vṛṣṭervirāme saṃjāte kasyacinmaraṇottaram ।
māsānte vā miled bhasma tadā nītvā haraṃ prabhum ।।42।।।
pūjayiṣye tato bhakṣyaṃ gṛhīṣyāmi kuṭumbayuk ।
itivicārya cāhūya patnīṃ bhīlo'bravīt priye! ।।43।।
na prāpā'haṃ citābhasma kiṃ karomi vada priye! ।
harapūjāmahāvighnaṃ jātaṃ me tvadya dustaram ।।44।।
prāptavānna citābhasma vṛṣṭyā dhautaṃ śmaśānakam ।
upāyaṃ nātra paśyāmi pūjopakaraṇārjane ।।45।।
pūjāṃ vinā kṣaṇārdhaṃ vā nā'haṃ jīvitumutsahe ।
upavāsā bhaveyurme vinā bhasmaprapū'janam ।।46।।
itivyākulitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā satī śabarāṃganā ।
cintayāmāsa satataṃ śivena sukhino vayam ।।47।।
śivaḥ sukhaprado - lakṣmīprado mokṣapradastathā ।
nahi śivasya bhaktānāmaśivaṃ saṃbhavet kvacit ।।48।।
śivārthaṃ kriyate yadyat tatsarvaṃ śivadaṃ bhavet ।
dhanaṃ gṛhaṃ yaśo vastraṃ bhojanaṃ jalamityapi ।।49।।
śivārthaṃ kalpitaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ śivakaraṃ bhavet ।
śivena sundaro dehaḥ pradattastena poṣitaḥ ।।1.451.50।।
patyarthaṃ ca śivārthaṃ me nārīdeho bhavecchubhaḥ ।
ko lābhastatparaścātra yena mokṣo bhavenmama ।।51।।
evaṃ vicārya śabarī mā bhaiḥ kāntamuvāca ha ।
idameva gṛhaṃ dagdhvā jīrṇakāṣṭhopabṛṃhitam ।।52।।
ahamagniṃ pravekṣyāmi citābhasma bhavet tataḥ ।
pūjāṃ tena kuru kānta nārī kāryā'parā tvayā ।।53।।
ahaṃ prāpsye ca kailāsaṃ tava dehaviyojane ।
netuṃ cāhaṃ tvāgamiṣye śaṃbhunā saha mā śucaḥ ।।54।।
priyāvākyaṃ samākarṇya śabarastāmuvāca ha ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dehaḥ paramasādhanam ।।55 ।।
kathaṃ tyajasi taṃ dehaṃ sukhadaṃ navayauvanam ।
adhunā tvanapatyā tvaṃ bhogayogyā punaḥ punaḥ ।।56।।
dṛḍhā puṣṭā baliṣṭhā ca kathaṃ dagdhumihecchasi ।
śabarī prāha re kānta sāphalyaṃ jīvitasya me ।।57।।
prāṇatyajanaṃ patyarthe śivārthaṃ kimuta svayam ।
kinnu taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ kiṃ vā dattaṃ mayā purā ।।58।।
kiṃ vā'rcanaṃ kṛtaṃ śaṃbhoḥ pūrvajanmaśatāntare ।
kiṃ vā puṇyaṃ mama pituḥ kā vā mātuḥ kṛtārthatā ।।59।।
yacchivārthe samiddhā'gnau tyajāmyetatkalevaram ।
śabaryā me prāptakālo mokṣasyā'yaṃ pravartate ।।1.451.60।।
anekajanmabhiryo na prāpyate bhīlayoṣitā ।
kathaṃ taṃ niṣphalaṃ kartuṃ mohe patāmi śūdrikā ।।61 ।।
sarve yajñāḥ pradānāni tīrthāni ca tapāṃsi ca ।
mama jātāni manye'haṃ madbhasma śaṃkare'rpitam ।।62।।
itthaṃ sthirāṃ matiṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyā bhaktiṃ ca śaṃkare ।
śabaro'pi svasya bhasma kartuṃ dātuṃ mano dadhe ।।63।।
uvāca śabarīṃ patnīṃ jīva kānte śataṃ samāḥ ।
mama bhasma vidhāyaiva mokṣaṃ yāsye'tidurlabham ।।64।।
naikajanmanāṃ pāpena śabaro'haṃ mahā'dhamaḥ ।
prāptaṃ mokṣasya saddvāraṃ kathaṃ tyaktuṃ samutsahe ।।65।।
tvayā śaṃbhuḥ pūjanīyo sadā madbhasmanā priye ।
yadvā satī priyaṃ kāntaṃ jīvayapyeva bhasmataḥ ।।66।।
sāvitrī satyavantaṃ saṃjīvayāmāsa vai purā ।
yadvā satī svayaṃ vahnimutpādya svāminā saha ।।67।।
divaṃ vrajet tathā kāryaṃ tvayā me priyayā priye ।
ityuktā sā patiṃ prāha nātha te maraṇottaram ।।68।।
niścitaṃ maraṇaṃ me'sti satīrītyā hi sarvathā ।
dvayormṛtyvapekṣayā'tra mamaiva maraṇaṃ varam ।।69।।
patidṛṣṭyā satī nārī patihastena yā mṛtā ।
patyarthaṃ ca śivārthaṃ ca janmasāphalyamṛcchati ।।1.451.70 ।।
ekottaraśatavaṃśoddhārayitrī tu sā bhavet ।
tallābho me'tra saṃprāpto bhavatvevaṃ mayi kṛpā ।।71 ।।
itthaṃ sthirāṃ matiṃ dṛṣṭvā nyāyyaṃ tasyā hitaṃ vacaḥ ।
tatheti dṛḍhasaṃkalpaḥ śabaraḥ pratyapūjayat। ।।72।।
sā bhartāramanujñāpya snātvā śuciralaṃkṛtā ।
gṛhamādīpya taṃ vahniṃ bhaktyā cakre pradakṣiṇam ।।73।।
namaskṛtvā''tmagurave dhyātvā patiṃ tathā śivam ।
agnipraveśā'bhimukhī kṛtāṃjaliridaṃ jagau ।।74।।
mamendriyāṇi puṣpāṇi santu dhūpo'gururvapuḥ ।
hṛdayaṃ supradīpo'stu prāṇā havīṃṣi santu ca ।।75।।
karaṇānyakṣatāḥ santu śaṃbho tvāṃ pūjayāmyaham ।
na vāñcchāmi mahārājyaṃ svargaṃ vā paramaṃ padam ।।76।।
tava sevāṃ saha patyā sadā tvicchāmi śaṃkara ।
cittaṃ tvayi sadā tvastu hṛdayeśa namo'stu te ।।77।।
itiprasādya deveśaṃ śabarī muditānanā ।
viveśa jvalitaṃ vahniṃ bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt ।।78।।
śabaro'pi tu tadbhasma yatnena parigṛhya ca ।
cakre dagdhagṛhopānte harapūjāṃ samāhitaḥ ।।79।।
atha sasmāra pūjānte prasādagrahaṇocitām ।
dayitāṃ nityamāyāntīṃ prāṃjaliṃ vinayānvitām ।।1.451.80।।
smṛtamātrāṃ tadā'paśyadāgatāṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ sthitām ।
pūrvarūpāṃ yathāyogyāṃ bhaktinamrāṃ surūpiṇīm ।।81 ।।
tāṃ vīkṣya śabaraḥ patnīṃ hāsyayuktāṃ kṛtāṃjalim ।
tathā bhasmīkṛtaṃ dehaṃ yathāpūrvamavasthitam ।।82।।
kṣaṇamāścaryamāpannastarkayāmāsa vai hṛdi ।
