agnirdahati tejobhiḥ sūryo dahati raśmibhiḥ ।।83।।
rājā dahati daṇḍena brāhmaṇo manasā dahet ।
śatrurdahati hānyādyaiḥ kulaṭā vākpratāḍanaiḥ ।।84।।
viṣaṃ dahati coṣṇatvād duṣṭā dahanti darśanāt ।
cintā dahati phalgutvāddhimaṃ dahati śaityataḥ ।।85।।
tṛṣṇā dahati cā'tṛpteḥ satī dahati śāpataḥ ।
sādhurdahati pāpāni sparśamātrānna saṃśayaḥ ।।86।।
kathaṃ ceyaṃ na vai dagdhā dṛśyate'tra yathāyatham ।
kimayaṃ svapna āhosvit kiṃvā māyendrajālikā ।।87।।
iti vismayasaṃbhrāntastāṃ patnīṃ samapṛcchata ।
ayi tvaṃ tu kathaṃ cāsse bhasmībhūtā'pi javasi ।।88।।
pradagdhaṃ bhavanaṃ bhūyaḥ kathaṃ pūrvavadāsthitam ।
śrutvā prasannasumukhī pativratā''ha taṃ priyam ।।89।।
yadā gṛhaṃ samuddīpya praviṣṭā'haṃ hutāśane ।
tadātmānaṃ na jānāmi na paśyāmi hutāśanam ।।1.451.90 ।।
tadā paśyāmi pīṣūṣāktaṃ śaṃbhuṃ mama pārśvagam ।
pāyayantaṃ sudhāṃ me saṃspṛśantaṃ svakareṇa mām ।।9 1 ।।
na tāpaleśo'pyāsīnme praviṣṭāyā ivodakam ।
suṣupteva kṣaṇārdhena prabuddhā'smi punaḥ kṣaṇāt ।।92।।
tāvad bhavanamadrākṣamadagdhamiva susthitam ।
adhunā devapūjānte prasādaṃ labdhumāgatā ।।93।।
dehi prasādaṃ me kānta tvānayāmi suvastu kim! ।
ityuktā jalamādāya dadau phalaṃ tathā'kṣatān ।।94।।
evaṃ pratidinaṃ tau tu pūjayāmāsurādarāt ।
lakṣaśo manujāḥ śrutvā camatkāraṃ tathā'dbhutam ।।95।।
darśanārthaṃ samājagmustayośca śaṃkarasya ca ।
evaṃ parasparaṃ premṇā dampatyorvartamānayoḥ ।।96।।
śaṃkarasya kṛpaleśāt sukhaṃ lakṣasamā gatāḥ ।
putrapautradhanāgārakṣetragodāsayoṣitaḥ ।।97।।
vaiṣṇavāḥ śaṃkarānmantraṃ prāpya jātāḥ kuṭumbinaḥ ।
dehānte tu tayorbhaktadampatyordivyamadbhutam ।।98।।
prādurāsīdvimānaṃ ca tatra sthitvā tu dampatī ।
śivadūtakarasparśād divyadehau sarūpiṇau ।।99।।
bhūtvā śivālayaṃ dhāma yayaturvai parātparam ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pātivratyaṃ paraṃ vratam ।। 1.451.100 ।।
patnīvrataṃ tathā śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ śaṃbhvārpaṇaṃ vratam ।
ātmārpaṇaṃ vrataṃ sarvavratebhyo vai viśiṣyate ।। 101 ।।
yo'pi śūdraḥ paṭhedvāpi śṛṇuyādvā kathāmimām ।
śivalokaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ bhaktyā yāyānna saṃśayaḥ ।।1 02।।
patnīvrataṃ pātivratyaṃ vijñāyā'pi tathā''caret ।
tato'pi sarvathā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ cānte labhet priye ।। 10 3।।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śabaradampatīkṛtaśivapūjārthaṃ pativratāśabarīcitābhasmārpaṇe śabaryāḥ punarjīvanamityādipātivratyacamatkāranirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।451 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 451 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 452
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 453 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! camatkāraṃ pātivratyasya vai punaḥ ।
patirdevo gururdevaḥ śivo devastrayo yayā ।। 1 ।।
pūjitāḥ sevitā nityaṃ vanditāḥ kṛṣṇakāntayā ।
tasyā mṛṣāpi satyaṃ syād viparītaṃ ca satphalam ।। 2 ।।
duḥkhaṃ cāpi bhavet saukhyaṃ vandhyātvaṃ ca sāpatyakam ।
vaidhavyaṃ sadhavātvaṃ durbhāgyaṃ śreṣṭhabhāgyakam ।। 3 ।।
adaivaṃ cāpi saubhāgyaṃ viruddhaṃ sānukūlakam ।
vipat samyatsvarūpā syāt tuṣṭe patyau gurau śive ।। 4 ।।
ānartaviṣaye kaścinnāmnā vedaratho dvijaḥ ।
camatkārapure tvāsīt sutadārakuṭumbavān ।। 5 ।।
tasya kanyā śāradākhyā kamaleva satī sadā ।
janmataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।। 6 ।।
iti prāgbhavasaṃskārāt sadā vadati vai sphuṭam ।
śrutvā janā mahāścaryaṃ prāptā vavandire satīm ।। 7 ।।
kṛṣṇaṃ śivaṃ hāṭakeśaṃ guruṃ ca pitarau satī ।
nitya prātarnamaskṛtya tato'nyat prākarot sadā ।। 8 ।।
evaṃ sā bhajanānandā'bhavad dvādaśahāyanā ।
tāṃ yayāce padmanābho brāhmaṇo nṛpamānitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
mahādhanasya śāntasya tāṃ kanyāṃ pradadau pitā ।
kṛtodvāho dvijaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyāṃ kartuṃ yayau nadīm ।। 1.452.1 0।।
mārge daṣṭo bhujaṃgena sa mamāra dvijastataḥ ।
cukruśurbāndhavā kṛtvā śvaśurāvasya kāminī ।। 11 ।।
kṛtaṃ tu bāndhavairaurdhvadaihikaṃ śāradā tataḥ ।
brāhmaṇī prāptavaidhavyā piturevā''laye sthitā ।। 12।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
vadatyeva sadā bālā namaḥ kṛṣṇāya cā'japat ।।13।।
kṛṣṇa eva patirnānyo jñātvā'rcayāte mādhavam ।
pitarau sevate nityaṃ śivāśivasvarūpiṇau । 14।।
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ nāryāṃ nare paśyati yoginī ।
śivaḥ svāmī patiḥ kṛṣṇo gururdevaḥ pitā hariḥ ।। 15।।
mātā lakṣmīḥ sakhī devī kuṭumbaṃ sādhumaṇḍalam ।
bhaktiḥ śayyā ratiḥ kṛṣṇe dhyānaṃ mūrtau śivā sukham ।।16।।
bhāgyaṃ dharmaḥ kṛtiḥ sevā viśrāntirbhagavatsmṛtau ।
yasyā bhāgavatī sarvā kriyā divyā satīmayī ।। 17।।
vaidhavye'pyabhavatpūrvārjitapuṇyabalācchubhā ।
kṛṣṇaḥ kānto dhavo yasyāḥ sevā satāṃ ca mātṛkā ।।18।।
tatra saubhāgyamevā'sti vaidhavyaṃ parivartate ।
evaṃ vai vartamānāyāstasyāḥ pituśca mandire ।। 1 9।।
ekadā naidhruvo nāma sādhurvṛddhaḥ samāgataḥ ।
andhaḥ śiṣyakaragrāhī bhikṣāṃ dehīti cā'vadat ।।1.452.20।।
sādhuṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā viṣṇuṃ dadau sā''sanamuttamam ।
svāgataṃ te mahāpūjya pīṭhe'sminnu hyupāviśa ।।21।।
ityuktvā bhaktimāsthāya kṛtvā pādāvanejanam ।
vījayitvā jalaṃ datvā'pūjayat puṣpacandanaiḥ ।।22।।
śreṣṭhamiṣṭavarānnaiśca bhojayāmāsa sādaram ।
tṛptastvandhamunistasyai suprītaḥ paramāśiṣam ।।23।।
vihṛtya bhartrā sukhinī labdhvā sutaṃ guṇādhikam ।
kīrtiṃ ca mahatīṃ prāpya bhava devakṛpāvatī ।।।2।।।
sādhūktaṃ sā samākarṇya vismitā pratyuvāca tam ।
sādho tvadvacanaṃ satyaṃ mandāyā me katham ṛtam ।।25।।
śilāgryāmiva sadvṛṣṭiḥ śunakyāmiva satkriyā ।
viphalā vidhavāyāṃ vai śubhāśīḥ sādhudā'pi tu ।।26।।
ahaṃ vidhavā jātā'smi tvadāśīḥpātratā katham ।
sādhuḥ prāha ca tāṃ devīṃ mayoktaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ।।27।।
sādhūnāṃ vacane kṛṣṇaḥ svayameva virājate ।
śaṃbhurdevāḥ sahāyāśca bhavanti vacane satām ।।28।।
balāllakṣmyā ca śivayā prerito'haṃ samāgataḥ ।
tava bhaktyā sati! putri! saubhāgyaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।।29।।
nahi bhaktimatī bālā duḥkhinī syāditi prabhuḥ ।
viṣṇuścāhaṃ sādhurūpastvadarthaṃ vai samāgataḥ ।।1.452.30।।
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ śivaṃ lakṣmīṃ śivāṃ ca pitarau sadā ।
kuru tvekavrataṃ putri! hyumāmāheśvarābhidham ।।3 1 ।।
yathoktaṃ tu mayā sarvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।
vaidhavyaṃ mama bhaktāyāḥ kathaṃ sahe suputrike ।।12।
āgaccha tava pitarau kathayāmi yathātatham ।
ityuktvā sādhuviṣṇustāmānayat pitṛsannidhau ।। 33।।
dattāśīrvādavṛttāntaṃ saubhāgyaṃ ca vrataṃ hariḥ ।
jagāda bhāvi yatsarvaṃ tataścāntaradhīyata ।।34।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! vrataṃ comāmāheśvaraṃ subhāgyadam ।
mayā tadā śāradāyai kathitaṃ cākarot tu sā ।।35।।
caitre vā mārgaśīrṣe vā śuklapakṣe śubhe dine ।
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmubhayoḥ parvaṇorapi ।।36।।
gurvājñayā vratāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta satī śubhā ।
saṃkalpaṃ vidhivat kṛtvā prātaḥ snānaṃ samācaret ।।37।।
santarpya pitṛdevādīn maṇḍapaṃ racayecchubham ।
tanmadhye paṃcaraṃgānāṃ cūrṇaiḥ padmaṃ samullikhet ।।38।।
caturdaśadalairbāhyairdvāviṃśadbhistadantare ।
tadantare ṣoḍaśabhiraṣṭabhiśca tadantare ।।39।।।
caturasraṃ tataḥ kuryādantarvartulamityapi ।
madhye kūrcaṃ tatparito vrīhitaṇḍularāśikama ।।1.452.40।।
kṛtvā kūrce vāripūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ sthāpayettataḥ ।
vastraṃ citraṃ kalaśe ca tatra vinyasya vai śivam ।।41 ।।
śivāṃ ca sthāpayed dravyaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ prapūjayet ।
paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca jalena snāpayettataḥ ।।42।।
rudraṃ tvekādaśavāraṃ samuccārya śatāṣṭakam ।
śivāya nama ityuktvā pīṭhe mūrtiṃ samarcayet ।।43।।
prāṇāyāmān yathāśakti kṛtvā saṃkalpayet tataḥ ।
pūrvajanmīyapāpānāṃ nāśārthaṃ tvāṃ samarthaye ।।44।।
saubhāgyavijayā''rogyadharmaiśvaryābhivṛddhaye ।
putrasampatsvargamokṣasiddhyarthaṃ vāṃ prapūjaye ।।45।।
aṃganyāsāँstataḥ kṛtvā dhyāyedīśaṃ ca pārvatīm ।
yoginaṃ śaṃkaraṃ dhyāye satīṃ dhyāye pativratām ।।46।।
sajaṭaṃ ca sakeśāṃ ca tryambakaṃ tryambikāṃ tathā ।
sasarpabhūṣaṇaṃ kāntaṃ svarṇabhūṣānvitāṃ satīm ।।47।।
nīlakaṇṭhaṃ miṣṭakaṇṭhāṃ dvibhujaṃ dordaśā'ṣṭakām ।
dhyānamagnaṃ tvaṃkamagnāṃ śvetaṃ raktāṃ vicintaye ।।48।।
iti dhyātvā pratimāyāmāvāhanādi cārabhet ।
āvāhanaṃ tathā'rghyaṃ ca gandhaṃ puṣpāṇi cākṣatān ।।49।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ jalaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ dadet ।
śivāya namo mantreṇa juhuyādaṣṭakaṃ śatam ।।1.452.50।।
tato nīrājanaṃ kuryānnamaskāraṃ kṣamāpanam ।
athā'bhyarcyopacāreṇa bhojayed bhaktadampatīm ।।51।।
evaṃ sāyaṃ prakuryācca pūjāṃ bhuñjīta pāyasam ।
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kuryāt tata udyāpanaṃ caret ।।52।।
śatarudrādhyāyapāṭhaṃ kārayitvā prapūjayet ।
vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ kalaśaṃ pratimāṃ gurave'rpayet ।।53।।
sādhūn viprān bhojayecca dadyācca svarṇadakṣiṇām ।
tataḥ prasādaṃ gṛhṇīyād godānādikamācaret ।।94।।
evaṃ vratasya kartā vā kartrī sveṣṭasukhaṃ labhet ।
vaṃśaṃ saubhāgyamarthaṃ ca sampadaṃ muktimāpnuyāt ।।55।।
ante mokṣaṃ śivapadaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ prapadyate ।
mahāvratamidaṃ tena sādhunoktaṃ kṛtaṃ tayā ।।56।।
sādhvyā saṃvatsarasyānte tadudyāpanamarjitam ।
upoṣitā tu sā bālā jajāpa mantramanvaham ।।57।।
śivā śivaḥ samāyātau divyarūpadharau śubhau ।
viṣṇunā kathitaṃ yadvat sarvaṃ saubhāgyameva tat ।।58।।
bhavatvatraiva dehe te patisaukhyaṃ labhasva ca ।
ityāśīrvacanairbālāṃ samarañjayatāṃ hyubhau ।।59।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha priye bāle pitarau bāndhavādikān ।
samāhvayā'tra tān vaktumicchāmi te purābhavam ।।1.452.60।।
ityuktā śāradā sarvānāhvayat śivasannidhau ।
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ śaṃbhuḥ śāradāmāha putrike ।।6 1 ।।
drāviḍe prāgbhave viprapatnyau tvaṃ cāparā hyubhe ।
āstāṃ tatra tvayā nityaṃ patistvayi pramohitaḥ ।।62।।
jyeṣṭhāyai te sapatnyai ca tvayā kāntakṛtaṃ sukham ।
kadācinnārpitaṃ tena jyeṣṭhā duḥkhena vai mṛtā ।।63 ।।
tena pāpena vidhavā tvaṃ tvidānīṃ pravidyase ।
yāḥ kurvanti striyo loke jāyāpatyostu vipriyam ।।64।।
tāsāṃ kaumāravaidhavyaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
tvayā tvārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇo vrataṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ śubham ।।65।।
tena puṇyaṃ mahajjātaṃ tena puṇyena te patiḥ ।
pūrvabhavīyavipro'sau svapne ratiṃ pradāsyati ।।66।।
tena putro viṣṇutulyaścātraiva saṃbhaviṣyati ।
eṣaḥ sa vipravaryo'sti śaṃbhuryāvajjagāda tām ।।67।।
tāvat tatra prākpatiḥ saḥ samadṛśyata vai yuvā ।
sarvairdṛṣṭaḥ śivavākyāt tayā mālā samarpitā ।।68।।
kāntena cārpito bhāle keśe sindūracūrṇakaḥ ।
prakoṣṭhayoḥ pradatte ca kaṃkaṇe netrakajjalam ।।69।।
sarvasaubhāgyadravyāṇi datvā prāgbrāhmaṇaḥ patiḥ ।
pāṇinā tacchirastatra pasparśa yāvadeva tu ।।1.452.70।।
tāvat keśāḥ kṛṣṇarūpāḥ prarohitāḥ prasādhitāḥ ।
dhammilaśca kṛtastena śāṭikā svarṇatārikā ।।71 ।।
kṛtā tatraiva hastasya sparśenā''śīḥ prayuñjitā ।
evaṃ hasan kṣaṇaṃ tasthau śaṃbhurdatvā śubhāśiṣaḥ ।।72।।
adṛśyaścābhavatso'pi patiścā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।
utsavaḥ samabhūttasyāḥ kanyāyā vratapuṇyataḥ ।।73।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! vratadātā sādhurviṣṇurabhūt svayam ।
sa eva śaṃbhunā cātrā''hūto viṣṇurvaro'bhavat ।।74।।
kanyāyāḥ pratyayārthaṃ ca tadvat kuṭumbināṃ tathā ।
prāgbhavīyasya kāntasya rūpaṃ dadhāra mādhavaḥ ।।75।।
sa eva bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ patirbhūtvā sadā niśi ।
bhaktāyā mānase nityaṃ kāmatṛptiṃ dadāti saḥ ।।76।।
kvacit kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ ca kvacid viprasvarūpakam ।
kvacicchivasvarūpaṃ ca kvacitsādhusvarūpakam ।।77।।
gṛhṇāti bhagavānasyā bhavane ramate sadā ।
sā'pi śrīriva saubhāgyatejobhirdīvyatāṃ yayau ।।78।।
ātmānaṃ muktigaṃ mene prakāśaṃ nā'karot satī ।
evaṃ dineṣu gacchatsu sā bālā tu pratikṣaṇam ।।79।।
bhartuḥ samāgamaṃ lebhe rātrau sukhavivardhanam ।
śivayorvaradānena śāradā viśadavratā ।।1.452.80।।
dadhāra garbhaṃ svapne'pi kṛṣṇasaṃgānubhāvataḥ ।
ajñātāstu janāḥ kanyāṃ garbhiṇīṃ jāriṇīṃ jaguḥ ।।8 1 ।।
tairajñātaiḥ kṛtastatra samājo grāmavāsinām ।
daṇḍadānāya vidvāṃsaḥ pṛṣṭāstatra samāgatāḥ ।।82।।
teṣu madhye svayaṃ kṛṣṇo vipro bhūtvā'pi cāyayau ।
śivastatra supaṇḍito bhūtvā kāśyāṃ samāgataḥ ।।83।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śāradāyāḥ kṛte kiṃ kimabhūttadā ।
antarvatnīṃ samāhūya śāradāṃ vṛddhamānavāḥ ।।84।।
papracchuśca kuto garbhaḥ śāradāpitarau tadā ।
pratyūcatuḥ prāgbhavīyakāntayogād vratārjitāt ।।85।।
svapne bījasya lābhena garbho'yaṃ nahi doṣavān ।
jahasuśca tadā sarve tiraskṛtya kuṭumbakam ।।86।।
atarjayan susaṃkruddhāḥ kecidāsan parāṅmukhāḥ ।
sarve sammantrayāmāsuḥ kiṃ kurma itibhāṣiṇaḥ ।।87।।
kecidāhuḥ pāpinīyaṃ kuladvayavināśinī ।
kṛtvā'syāḥ keśavapanaṃ chitvā karṇau ca nāsikām ।।88।।
nirvāsayantu ca bahirgrāmāt svagotrato bahiḥ ।
atha viṣṇuḥ paṇḍitastu tatrā''ha sarvamānavān ।।89।।
mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ comāmāheśvaraṃ vrataṃ kṛtam ।
anayā tena puṇyena prāptaḥ svāpnaḥ patiḥ sadā ।।1.452.90।।
svapne garbho na bhavati saṃśayo garbhiṇīkṛte ।
nā'syai daṇḍaḥ pradātavyaḥ sucaritreyamaṃganā ।।91 ।।
kucāritryaṃ tu vadatāṃ jihvā dvedhā bhaviṣyati ।
śrutvā prajahṛṣustasyā jananījanakādayaḥ ।।92।।
tataḥ kṣaṇaṃ grāmavṛddhā maunaṃ bhayāt prajagṛhuḥ ।
tatra kecidaviśvastā mithyā svapnamavādiṣuḥ ।।93।।
teṣāṃ jihvā dvidhā bhinnā vavamuste tu raktakam ।
bhītāḥ sarve na cocurvai viparītaṃ tataśca te ।।94।।
atha śaṃbhuḥ paṇḍitaśca tadāha viṣṇupaṇḍitam ।
svapne garbho'pi bhavati daivānāmīdṛśī gatiḥ ।।95।।
māyāmayamidaṃ viśvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate ca yat ।
kiṃ bhāvyaṃ kimabhāvyaṃ vā saṃsāre kṛṣṇanirmite ।।96।।
anirūpyamabhūtārthaṃ kadācijjāyate ṛtam ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya vaśe sarvaṃ tasya ko veda ceṣṭitam ।।97।।
yūpaketostu rājarṣeḥ śukraṃ nipatitaṃ jale ।
saśukraṃ tajjalaṃ pītvā dāsī garbhaṃ dadhau kila ।।98।।
munervibhāṇḍakasyāpi śukraṃ pītvā sahāmbhasā ।
hariṇī garbhiṇī bhūtvā ṛṣyaśṛṃgamasūyata ।।99।।
saurāṣṭrasya tathā rājñaḥ karaṃ spṛṣṭvā mṛgāganā ।
tatkṣaṇād garbhiṇī bhūtvā muniṃ prāsūta tāpasam ।। 1.452.1 00।।
tathā satyavatīnārī śapharīgarbhasaṃbhavā ।
tathaiva mahiṣīgarbho jāto vai mahiṣāsuraḥ ।। 101 ।।
phalasya bhojanenāpi garbhavatyaḥ striyaḥ purā ।
manasā kalpitā nāryo babhūvuḥ putramātaraḥ ।। 1 02।।
sāmbasya jaṭharājjātaṃ musalaṃ muniśāpataḥ ।
yuvanāśvasya garbho'bhūnmunīnāṃ mantragauravāt ।। 1 03।।
bījaṃ nāryāṃ nare vāpi vidyate sarvathā janāḥ ।
pariṇāmo yogināṃ tu vacanena vijāyate ।। 1 04।।
ahalyā copalā jātā gautamasyaiva vākyataḥ ।
rāmasparśena sā jātā yuvatī ceti dṛśyate ।। 1 05।।
indrahetikṛtā jātā maruto bahavastathā ।
rādhāyā vacanād gaṃgā jalarūpā vyajāyata ।। 1 06।।
samudramathanāllakṣmīḥ kṣiteḥ sītā hyajāyata ।
evaṃ vai bahudhā sṛṣṭiryogināṃ vai prajāyate ।। 1 07।।
vasudevasya kṛpayā rohiṇyāṃ garbha āsthitaḥ ।
śaṃkarasya jaṭātaśca vīrabhadro'pyajāyata ।। 1 08।।
nūnameṣāpi kalyāṇī vratasya balatastathā ।
sādhoḥ sevāpratāpena kṛṣṇasya śaraṇāgateḥ ।। 10 9।।
āśīrvādātmakaṃ bījaṃ dhatte garbhamaninditā ।
ityuktastu sabhāśreṣṭhāḥ śaśaṃsurjñātibāndhavāḥ ।। 1.452.11 0।।
sādhusādhviti jagadurmumucurnetrato jalam ।
kulastriyaḥ pramuditāstāmuddiśya samāśvasan ।। 111 ।।
tathāpi mānavānāṃ vai sandehasya nivṛttaye ।
viprau tau tatra sañjāto kṣaṇamātraṃ śivo hariḥ ।। 11 2।।
viṣṇurviprasvarūpo'bhūt kroḍe kṛtvā tu śāradām ।
tān sarvān darśayāmāsa kāntaṃ svaṃ śāradāṃ priyām ।। 1 13।।
dampatīrūpiṇau dṛṣṭvā''vāpurvismayamuttamam ।
tato vyalīyata kṛṣṇaḥ śivo'pyantaradhīyata ।। 1 14।।
satī tāṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ śrīrūpiṇīṃ tadā janāḥ ।
camatkārapurāvāsā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ।। 1 15।।
atha kāle śubhe putramasūta śāradā satī ।
śāradeyā'bhidhaḥ so'pi vidvān kṛṣṇasamo'bhavat ।। 1 16।।
śāradā bahuvarṣāṇi kṛṣṇasevāṃ vidhāya ca ।
vaṃśaṃ loke sthāpayitvā śrīkṛṣṇena samaṃ satī ।। 1 17।।
divyayānena golokaṃ yayau padaṃ hi śāśvatam ।
ityetat puṇyamākhyānaṃ śāradāyāḥ pravarṇitam ।। 118।।
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ samyag bhuktimuktiphalapradam ।
strīṇāṃ maṃgalasaubhāgyasantānarddhyāyuṣā pradam ।। 11 9।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ānartadeśe camatkārapurīyaśāradāyā vaidhavye sādhorāśīrvādena punaḥ kṛṣṇātmakaviprarūpapatitaḥ saubhāgyaṃ putralābho janānāṃ viśvāsārthaṃ viprarūpakṛṣṇadarśanaṃ golokaprāptiścetyādipātivratyacamatkāranirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 452 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 452 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 453
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 454 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi bhaktāyā vārayoṣitaḥ ।
nārāyaṇamanaskāyāścamatkāramayīṃ kathām ।। 1 ।।
nandigrāme purā tvāsīnmahānandābhidhā hare ।
bhaktimatī tu vanitā śṛṃgāralalitākṛtiḥ ।। 2 ।।
kuṭumbarahitā svecchātantrā śivasya kiṃkarī ।
yadyapi vāravanitā kintu kṛṣṇamayī satī ।। 3 ।।
nityaṃ snāti hare viṣṇuṃ pūjayatyatibhāvataḥ ।
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ cāpi karoti devasannidhau ।। 4 ।।
nṛtyagāyanatālādau ye tvāyānti tu darśakāḥ ।
tebhyaḥ prāsādikaṃ vāri phalaṃ tulasīmiśritam ।। 5 ।।
pāvitryārthaṃ dadātyeva kṛṣṇārthasarvasaṃbhavā ।
nityaṃ bhajati govindaṃ kṛṣṇabhāvanayā naram ।। 6 ।।
kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ vidhāyaiva dehakāryaṃ karoti sā ।
chatraṃ pūrṇendusaṃkāśaṃ yānaṃ svarṇavirājitam ।। 7 ।।
cāmarāṇi sudaṇḍāni pāduke tu hiraṇmaye ।
ambarāṇi vicitrāṇi paryaṃkaśca hiraṇmayaḥ ।। 8 ।।
candraraśminibhāṃ śayyāṃ kṛṣṇārthaṃ parirakṣati ।
gāvo mahiṣyo dogdhryaśca dīpāṃgadāsadāsikāḥ ।। 9 ।।
tasyā vacanaviśvastāḥ pūjayanti haraṃ harim ।
bhūṣaṇāni parārdhyāṇi navaratnojjvalāni ca ।। 1.453.1 0।।
gandhakuṃkumakastūrīkarpūrā'gurulepanam ।
citramālyāvataṃsaśca yatheṣṭaṃ mṛṣṭabhojanam ।। 11 ।।
nānācitravitānākhyaṃ nānādhānyabhṛtaṃ gṛham ।
bahuratnasahasrāḍhyaṃ svarṇarūpyādikaṃ dhanam ।। 12।।
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ harārthaṃ ca haryarthaṃ ca tayā sadā ।
evaṃ savibhavā vāravanitā satyadharmiṇī ।। 1 3।।
bhaktasevāparā kṛṣṇaśivapūjāparāyaṇā ।
sadā śāstrakathāśrotrī nāmajāpaparāyaṇā ।। 14।।
vinodahetordevāgre nāṭyamaṇḍapamadhyataḥ ।
rudrākṣairbhūṣayitvaikaṃ markaṭaṃ caikakukkuṭam ।। 15।।
karatālaiśca gītaiśca sadā nartayati svayam ।
rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtakeyūrakarṇābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ।। 16।।
markaṭaḥ śikṣayā tasyāḥ sadā nṛtyati bālavat ।
śikhāyāṃ baddharudrākṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ kapinā saha ।। 17।।
ciraṃ nṛtyati nṛtyajñaḥ paśyatāṃ citramāvahan ।
ekadā bhavanaṃ tasyāḥ kaścid vaṇik sabhṛtyakaḥ ।। 18।।
nṛtyasya darśanārthaṃ sadbhaktaḥ sakarakaṃkaṇaḥ ।
tatprakoṣṭhasthitaṃ ratnakaṃkaṇaṃ vīkṣya cāha tam ।। 1 9।।
mahāratnakhacito'yaṃ kaṃkaṇaste karasthitaḥ ।
mano harati me bhakta divyastrībhūṣaṇocitaḥ ।।1.453.20 ।।
iti tāṃ saspṛhāṃ vīkṣya vaṇik prāha ca tāṃ tadā ।
yadi te rocate cāyaṃ kaṃkaṇo mama bhūṣaṇam ।।21 ।।
bhadramādatsva madbhūṣāṃ mūlyamasya dadāsi kim ।
tadā vihasya sā vāravanitā sphuṭamāha tam ।।22।।
āgantukasya dehena sevādharmo'sti me sadā ।
nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ tvāṃ matvā sevāṃ karomi vai ।।23 ।।
yadyetadratnakhacitaṃ dadāsi karabhūṣaṇam ।
dinatrayamahorātraṃ tava patnī bhavāmyaham ।।।24।।
niyatasya na patnītvaṃ sarvadā vārayoṣitām ।
ekaniyatapatnītvaṃ yathā nā'psarasāṃ divi ।। 25।।
tathāstviti vaṇik prāha pramāṇaṃ śaśibhāskarau ।
kṛtvā satyaṃ trivāraṃ ca spṛṣṭvā'nyonyasya vakṣasi ।।26।।
dinatrayamahorātraṃ bhūtvā''vāṃ dampatī hyubhau ।
sahadharmaṃ carāvaścetyāhaturhadayaspṛśau ।।27।।
atha tasyai vaṇikśreṣṭhī pradadau ratnakaṃkaṇam ।
ninyatustau sukhaṃ rātriṃ kāmadharmeṇa dampatī ।। 28।।
dvitīyāyāmatha rātrau nāṭyamaṇḍapikāntare ।
akasmādutthito vahnirdīpavarttiprasaṃgataḥ ।।29।।
markaṭakukkuṭau muktau bandhanānnirmatāvubhau ।
anye dāsāśca dāsyaśca gomahiṣyādayo'pi .ca ।।1.453.30।।
nirbandhanā vinirgatā tau cāpi nirgatau tataḥ ।
śivaliṃgaṃ harimūrtirvahnau bhasmā'bhavat tadā ।।3 1 ।।
smṛtvā tad dampatī tau ca durantaṃ duḥkhamāpatuḥ ।
vaṇik prāha mama yoge sarvaṃ te jvalitaṃ priye ।।32।।
śivo viṣṇurmūrtirūpo jvalito mama cāgamāt ।
mahatpāpaṃ mayā cātrā''gatyā'rjitaṃ durantakam ।। 33 ।।
na vai śarma labhe sādhvi! mriye duḥkhā'sahāt priye ।
ityuktvā prāṇamāhṛtya papāta dharaṇau vaṇik ।। 34।।
yuvatī tridinaṃ tasya dharmapatnī hyabhūd yataḥ ।
atīva duḥkhitā bhūtvā smṛtvā dharmaṃ susākṣikam ।। 25।।
sarvānāhūya sā tatra babhāṣe karuṇaṃ vacaḥ ।
ratnakaṃkaṇamādāya sākṣye ca śaśisūryayoḥ ।।36।।
dinatrayamahamasya patnī jātā'smi dharmataḥ ।
yayā tasya citāyāṃ vai praveṣṭavyaṃ hi dharmataḥ ।।37।।
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā vaṇigbhṛtya uvāca tām ।
maivaṃ maivaṃ vada saumye patirnā'yaṃ vivāhitaḥ ।।38।।
vivāhitena patinā vahninā sākṣiṇā ca yā ।
gṛhītā karagrāhā ca sā patnīti prakīrtyate ।।3 9।।
tvaṃ tu naitādṛśī patnī vyabhicāraparāyaṇā ।
kaṃkaṇārthaṃ mahālobhāt patnīnāmnā prakatthase ।।1.453.40।।
tvayā sahā'sya dahane narakaṃ jīvato yathā ।
vyavāyasya gṛhe naṣṭo vyavāyinīkareṇa ca ।।41 ।।
vyavāyinyā samaṃ dāhaḥ śreyasāṃ na pradāyakaḥ ।
gaccha dūraṃ sadā dhūrte puṃścali saṃpratārike! ।।।42।।
mama svāmiśavasyā'haṃ kariṣye dahanaṃ tathā ।
pravekṣye svāmicitāyāṃ mariṣye bhṛtyadharmataḥ ।।43।।
bhṛtyo'haṃ bahukālīnaḥ sevayāmi nirantaram ।
vinā vai svāminaṃ prāṇāḥ sthātuṃ śaktā na me'tra vai ।।44।।
annadātā vṛttidātā rakṣako jñānadāyakaḥ ।
niṣekī mantrado vipannāśakaḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ।।45।।
vinā pitaraṃ loke'smin bhṛtyo mṛta iva smṛtaḥ ।
svāminaṃ nāśayitvā'haṃ darśayiṣye kathaṃ mukham ।।46 ।।
bhṛtyo'haṃ putratulyo'haṃ poṣyo'haṃ dharmataḥ sadā ।
dāhaṃ dāsye hyahaṃ paścātpravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ।।47।।
mama lokā bhaviṣyanti śāśvatāḥ svāminā saha ।
ityuktvā sa citāṃ cakre kāṣṭhānyādāya sarvathā ।।48।।
vaṇijastu dhanaṃ kiñcittathā'nyacchṛṃkhalādikam ।
dadau dānaṃ supātrebhyaḥ śavaṃ nyasya citānale ।।49।।
praveṣṭuṃ yāti yāvaddhi tāvat sā vārakāminī ।
pradhāvya jagṛhe hastaṃ mā mā meti jagāda tam ।।1.453.50।।
maivaṃ bhṛtya tvayā kāryaṃ putra jīva sadā bhuvi ।
ityukto'pi janaiḥ sarvairvārito'pi viveśa ha ।।51 ।।
citāyāṃ patite bhṛtye tato nikaṭadharmiṇī ।
satī tvāha samājasya śṛṇvato'sya gṛhiṇyaham ।।52।।
sadharmacāriṇī tvasya dinatrayaṃ susammatā ।
madgehe mama yogena mṛto'yaṃ vai patiḥ kṛtaḥ ।।53।।
tasmādahaṃ pravekṣyāmi sahā'nena hutāśanam ।
satyena prītimāyānti devāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ ।।54।।
satyātmā vai paro dharmaḥ satye sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ।
satyena svargamokṣau ca nā'satyena parā gatiḥ ।।55।।
tasmāt satyaṃ samāśritya pravekṣyāmi hutāśanam ।
bhaktayogena pūtā'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi ca pāvanī ।।56।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaviṣṇo śiva maṃgalakṛdbhava ।
oṃnamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।।57।।
namaḥ śivāya kṛṣṇāya śrīrādhāpataye namaḥ ।
iti śrīkṛṣṇabhajanaṃ cakre dānaṃ dadau bahu ।।58।।
sarvasvaṃ sādhubhaktebhyo datvā dhyātvā haraṃ harim ।
natvā sarvān patiṃ dhyātvā patyuścitā'nalaṃ satī ।।59।।
tadbhaktā triḥ parikramya praveśābhimukhī sthitā ।
tāṃ patantīṃ samiddhā'gnau svapadārpitamānasām ।।1.453.6 0।।
vārayāmāsaturdevau prādurbhūtau śivā'cyutau ।
vīkṣya sā tau devadevau koṭisūryādhikaprabhau ।।6 1 ।।
stabdheva jāyamānā sā bhīteva jaḍavat sthitā ।
tāmūcatuḥ samāśvāsya bhagavantau kṛpānidhī ।।62।।
satyaṃ dharmaṃ ca te dhairyaṃ bhaktiṃ narātmake prabhau ।
śivakṛṣṇapratimāyāṃ draṣṭuṃ śivācyutāvubhau ।।63।।
māyayā'gniṃ samutpādya dagdhavantau sumaṇḍapam ।
dagdhaṃ kṛtvobhapratime bhṛtyaḥ śivaḥ svayaṃ mudā ।।64।।
bhṛtyabhaktiṃ darśayituṃ praviṣṭo'tra hutāśanam ।
vaṇigrūpo'pyahaṃ nārāyaṇakṛṣṇa patistava ।।65।।
parīkṣituṃ samāyātaścāntimaṃ sevanaṃ tava ।
veśyāḥ kaitavakāriṇyaḥ svairiṇyo janavañcakāḥ ।।66।।
sā tvaṃ satyamanusmṛtya praviṣṭā'gniṃ sahā'nugā ।
ataste vāñcchitaṃ dāsye vada śreṣṭhottamottamam ।।67।।
śrutvā sā''ha na me vāñchā bhoge tvatpādavarjite ।
ete bhṛtyāśca dāsyaśca ye tvanye mama bāndhavāḥ ।।68।।
sarve tvadarcanaparāstvayi sannyastavṛttayaḥ ।
sarvānetān mayā sārdhaṃ nītvā tavā'kṣaraṃ padam ।।69।।
śāśvatānandasampūrṇasevāyāṃ rakṣa sarvadā ।
tatheti tasyā vacanaṃ pratinandya narāyaṇaḥ ।।1.453.70।।।
tān sarvāṃśca tayā sārdhaṃ nināya padamavyam ।
kālena nidhanaṃ prāptau yau tu kukkuṭamarkaṭau ।।71 ।।
kukkuraḥ kāśmīrarājyakumāraḥ puṇyato'bhavat ।
markaṭastatpradhānasya kumāraścā'bhavat tadā ।।72।।
śivaviṣṇumahābhaktau kṛtvā rājyaṃ ciraṃ ca tau ।
dehānte cā'kṣaraṃ dhāma yayaturyatra sā satī ।।73।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! mahāpāpāpramokṣaṇam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya pāpapradhvaṃsanaṃ bhavet ।।74।।
pāpinyapi vāranārī śravaṇāt karaṇāttathā ।
sādhusaṃsevanāt sadyo muktā'nyā mucyate tathā ।।75।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāravanitāyāḥ sarvasvārpaṇabhaktyā śivācyutau bhṛtyavaṇijau bhūtvā pātivratyā'nalaparīkṣāṃ cakraturmokṣaṃ pradadatuścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 453 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 453 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 454
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 455 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu priye mahālakṣmi! pātivratyaṃ janātigam ।
dharmādharmau svāmivaco mukhyaṃ nānyaditi dhruvam ।। 1 ।।
patyurvacasi cenmāndyaṃ satī kuryāt sudhānibham ।
svāmivākyaṃ bhavet hiṃsraṃ kuryāt puṇyanibhaṃ satī ।। 2 ।।
kāntokte ced bhavet। stainyaṃ nyāyyaṃ matvā''caret satī ।
bhartrājñaptaṃ vyavāyaṃ ca dharmaṃ matvā''caret satī ।। 3 ।।
patireva parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
śubhaṃ samādiśed yadvā'śubhaṃ satī samācaret ।। 4 ।।
satī tasya vacovaśyā pātivratyaphalaṃ labhet ।
patiścedaśubhaṃ samādiśet sa phalabhāg bhavet ।। 5 ।।
nā'trā'śubhe vaco'dhīne kārye tadbhāginī satī ।
pratyutā'śubhakāryaṃ sā sāmarthyāt śubhadaṃ caret ।। 6 ।।
aniṣṭaṃ duḥkhadaṃ sā tu sukhadaṃ parivartayet ।
satyāḥ saṃkalpamātreṇa mṛtyuḥ kālo yamo bhayam ।। 7 ।।
adharmaḥ kleśadāḥ sarve sukhadāḥ saṃbhavanti vai ।
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ pātivratyaṃ paraṃ balam ।। 8 ।।
pātivratyavṛṣāgre tu pāpaṃ puṇyapradaṃ bhavet ।
duḥkhaṃ sukhasvarūpaṃ syāt patikṛṣṇapratoṣaṇāt ।। 9 ।।
atrārthe tu purā vṛttaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ।
pativākyaṃ samādṛtya vyavāyasthasvayoṣitaḥ ।। 1.454.1 0।।
sarvaṃ puṇyātmakaṃ jātaṃ devatoṣakaraṃ yathā ।
dakṣiṇāpathamadhye vai grāme bāṣkalanāmake ।। 11 ।।
prajā asaṃskṛtā āsan jñānavairāgyavarjitāḥ ।
narā nāryaḥ kṛṣikāryā āraṇyakaprajīvanāḥ ।। 1 2।।
tatraiko viduro nāma dharmācāravivarjitaḥ ।
dvija āsīt kṛṣigoptā śūdrādimitratāṃgataḥ ।। 13 ।।
kṛṣikārye karmacāriṇībhiḥ pravartate'niśam ।
paranārīprasaṃgādidoṣaṃ jānāti naiva saḥ ।। 14।।
śūdrayā saha kāryādau kāmena saṃgataḥ kvacit ।
viduraṃ kṛpaṇā sā ca yācate bhojanaṃ dhanam ।। 15 ।।
viduraḥ kṛpayā''viṣṭaḥ kāmabhāvanayā tathā ।
nirvāhārthaṃ tu śūdrāyai dadātyeva kvacitkvacit ।। 16 ।।
sadāro'pi satīṃ bhāryāṃ bandulāṃ nātimanyate ।
gṛhasthitaṃ dhanaṃ cānnaṃ śūdrāyai pradadāti saḥ ।। 17।।
bandulā sahate sarvaṃ patyarthaṃ navayauvanā ।
dhanaṃ cānnaṃ kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ śūdrāyai svāminā'rpitam ।। 18।।
vidurastu satīṃ patnīṃ yācate dehi me dhanam ।
annaṃ dehyambaraṃ dehi śūdryartha dehi me priye ।। 1 9।।
ityuktā sā satī prāha gṛhe yadyaddhi vidyate ।
tatsarvaṃ nīyatāṃ nātha tvadadhīnaṃ gṛhaṃ sadā ।।1.454.20।।
tvayi nāthe prasanne ca sarvaṃ me sukhadaṃ bhavet ।
madagre tu dhanaṃ nāsti yadāttha tatkaromyaham ।।21 ।।
vidurastāṃ satīmāha gacchā'nyasevanaṃ kuru ।
narān dhaninaḥ saṃsevya dhanamānaya dehi me ।।।22।।
satī tvājñākarī patyau viśvastā ceśvare yathā ।
kaiṃkarya kasyacit kṛtvā dāsyaṃ patītvameva vā ।।23।।
dhanamānayati patyājñayā tasmai dadāti ca ।
patireva paro dharmaḥ pativākyaṃ sukhāvaham ।। 24।।
itimatvā parapuṃsāṃ kāmasevāparā'bhavat ।
evaṃ tayostu dampatyordurācārapravṛttayoḥ ।। 25।।
grāme kaścit kathākāro brāhmaṇo daivayogataḥ ।
samāyayau saṃhitāyāḥ kathāṃ cakāra dharmataḥ ।।26।।
grāmīṇā śuśruvuḥ sarve prācīnāṃ dharmasaṃhitām ।
kumārgaṃ saṃparityajya dharmamārgaṃ samāśritāḥ ।। 27।।
jagṛhurvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ pūjayāmāsuracyutam ।
brāhmaṇaṃ tvarcayāmāsurvihāyā'satkriyāṃ janāḥ ।। 28।।
paścāttāpaṃ svakṛtyānāṃ cakruste sasmarurharim ।
vidureṇa parityaktaḥ śūdrāsaṃgastataḥ param ।।29।।
atīva dhārmiko jātaścaikabhuktaṃ karoti ca ।
snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ naivedyaṃ devadarśanam ।।1.454.3 0।।
kṛtvā bhuṃkte sadā tvevaṃ patnī cāpi tathā'karot ।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya vidurasyā''yuṣaḥ kṣaye ।।3 1 ।।
āyātā yamadūtāstaṃ netuṃ yamapuraṃ tadā ।
cukrośa dṛṣṭvā tāndūtān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti saḥ ।।32।।
patnī prāha ca taṃ śrutvā kathamākrośanaṃ priya ।
sa cāha tāṃ yamadūtā netuṃ māṃ vai samāgatāḥ ।।33 ।।
patnī jalaṃ kare kṛtvā samuvāca satī tadā ।
yadi patyuḥ priyā bhāryā patyuḥ priyakarī sadā ।। 34।।
patyājñāyāṃ vartamānā patikṛṣṇaparāyaṇā ।
tena satyena dūtāste dūraṃ yāntu yamālayam ।। 35।।
ityuktvā tajjalaṃ patyuḥ pārśve cikṣepa tāvatā ।
dūrātpalāyitā dūtā avaplutya sthalāttataḥ ।।36 ।।
patiḥ svasthastadā jāto vṛttāntamāha tattathā ।
patnī prāha punaḥ kāntaṃ svāmisevākṛtaṃ phalam ।।37।।
tubhyaṃ dadāmi me kānta sadgatirastu tena te ।
tāvadvai vaiṣṇavā viṣṇoḥ pārṣadāstvāyayurmudā ।।38।।
patnyā dṛṣṭā pātivratyadharmaphalena tatkṣaṇam ।
pūjitā vanditāścāpi patiṃ ninyuḥ paraṃ padam ।।39।।
bandulā tu patiṃ kṛtvā kroḍe ruroda vai kṣaṇam ।
atha saṃcintayāmāsa yadyahaṃ kāntarañjinī ।।1.454.40।।
tadā kāntena sākaṃ me prāṇāḥ prayāntu tatkṣaṇam ।
tāvanmūrchāṃ gatvā sādhvī prāṇāँstyaktvā tu tatkṣaṇam ।।41 ।।
svāminā divyadehena saha yātā surūpiṇī ।
divyadehā vimānasthā viṣṇupārṣadasatkṛtā ।।42।।
tattejaśca vimānaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ śrotṛbhirujjvalam ।
brāhmaṇaḥ sa tu sadbhaktaistayorvai cordhvadaihikam ।।43।।
kārayāmāsa vidhinā bhojayāmāsa vaiṣṇavān ।
dadau kṛṣṇopadeśaṃ ca dharmaṃ patnīvrataṃ dadau ।।44।।
pātivratyaṃ tathā dharmaṃ dadau prajāḥ svayaṃ dvijaḥ ।
sarve'pi vaiṣṇavāstvāsan narā nāryaḥ samantataḥ ।।45।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
iti mantraṃ tu te labdhvā bhejire kṛṣṇamacyutam ।।46।।
kathāṃ śuśukarīśasya cakruśca bhajanaṃ sadā ।
kathāyā vācako vipraḥ svapne svadarśanaṃ dadau ।।।47।।
narebhyo vanitābhyaśca nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ ।
hārakeyūramukuṭapītāmbarasudarśanaiḥ ।।48।।
sahitaḥ sevito lakṣmyā'dṛśyata vai manoharaḥ ।
kathānte pūjitaḥ sarvaiḥ svīkṛtya pūjanaṃ tataḥ ।।49।।
upādideśa tān sarvān bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ ।
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ bandulāyā vilokya tu ।।1.454.50।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇastasyāḥ kalyāṇārthaṃ dvijātmakaḥ ।
samāyātaḥ kathākāraścoddhṛtā yūyamityapi ।।51 ।।
kathāṃ śrutvā vaiṣṇavāśca jātāstatsevanaṃ mama ।
pūjayadhvaṃ ca māṃ nityaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ ca kathāṃ hareḥ ।।52।।
naraiḥ patnīvrataṃ pālyaṃ nārībhiśca pativratam ।
ubhābhyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavrataṃ ca tārakam ।।53।।
satkathāśravaṇaṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ param ।
kṛṣṇasya kathayā ceto viśuddhiṃ paramāṃ vrajet ।।54।।
kathayā siddhyati dhyānaṃ dhyānāt kaivalyamuttamam ।
sarveṣāṃ śreyasāṃ bījaṃ satkathāśravaṇaṃ matam ।।55।।
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca madamānādayaḥ pare ।
adharmasya sutā yānti dūraṃ kathāśravāddhareḥ ।।56।।
gurutalpaḥ surāpānaṃ tathā'kāmāprasaṃgakaḥ ।
kāmasya tanayāstvete yānti dūraṃ kathāśravāt ।।57।।
pitṛvadho mātṛvadho brahmahatyā ca nāśanam ।
krodhasya tanayāścaite dūraṃ yānti kathāśravāt ।।28।।
devasvaharaṇaṃ viprasvahāraḥ svarṇamoṣaṇam ।
lobhasya tanayāstvete dūraṃ yānti kathāśravāt ।।29।।
aśraddhā cāpi durmedhā avidyāyāḥ sute hyubhe ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakathāśravād dūraṃ pragacchataḥ ।।1.454.60।।
kathā saṃsṛtibaddhānāṃ sadyo muktipradā śubhā ।
strīṇāṃ pāṃsulapādānāṃ dāsānāṃ dāsayoṣitām ।।61 ।।
ajñānatimirāndhānāṃ dīparūpā hareḥ kathā ।
bhavarogābhibhūtānāṃ susevyaṃ paramauṣadham ।।62।।
mahāpātakaśailānāṃ kathā vajranibhā matā ।
bharjanaṃ karmabījānāṃ sādhanaṃ sarvasampadām ।।63।।
śṛṇvatāṃ śrīharergāthāṃ tathā kīrtayatāṃ satām ।
teṣāṃ pādarajāṃsyaiva tīrthāni munayo jaguḥ ।।64।।
muhūrtamapi śṛṇuyādaśakto'pi dine dine ।
ghaṭikāṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā kṣaṇaṃ vā pāvanīṃ kathām ।।65।।
sthūlakāryaprasaktānāṃ sthūlabuddhimatāṃ kathā ।
kalpavṛkṣasamo nānyaḥ panthāḥ kathetaraḥ sukhaḥ ।।66।।
pibannevā'mṛtaṃ yatnādekaḥ syādajarāmaraḥ ।
pītaṃ kathāmṛtaṃ kuryāt kulamevā'jarāmaram ।।67।।।
kathāvaktā hariḥ sākṣād gurūṇāṃ yāvatāṃ guruḥ ।
mokṣadaḥ puṇyado jñānapradīpaḥ paro guruḥ ।।68।।
ye kathāṃ tatpravaktāraṃ praśaṃsanti janā api ।
aśṛṇvanto'pi te yānti śāśvataṃ paramaṃ padam ।।69।।
kathāśravaṇasāhāyyaṃ ye kurvanti janā bhuvi ।
kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ tiṣṭhanti brahmaṇaḥ padam ।।1.454.70।।
satkathābodhalābhena smaraṇaṃ me harerbhavet ।
sadāsmaraṇayogena vāsanānāṃ kṣayo bhavet ।।71 ।।
tathā satī virāgaḥ syād rāgābhāve paraṃ sukham ।
tṛṣṇākṣayasukhaṃ tvātmānandodbhave sahāyakṛt ।।72।।
rāge naṣṭe pratidvandvī dveṣo'pi naśyati dhruvam ।
rāgadveṣau yasya naṣṭau doṣau tasya pravartanam ।।।73 ।।
śubhā'śubhaṃ na vai janmamṛtyupradaṃ prajāyate ।
pravṛtterapyabhāvena bhogābhāvo bhavet sadā ।।74।।
nityānandaṃ cidānandaṃ sadānandaṃ nijātmakam ।
bhuṃkte bhaktirase magnaḥ śrīkṛṣṇātmakabhāvataḥ ।।75।।
nityatṛpto mama mūrtau nityamagno madātmani ।
brahmānandamayo dhāmni mamo'śrute'kṛtaṃ sukham ।।76।।
evaṃ kathāśruteḥ puṇyaṃ phalaṃ mokṣapradaṃ bhavet ।
ahaṃ tuṣṭo bhavāmyeva yatra me'sti kathāmṛtam ।।77।।
vajralepādipāpāni kathātmamatprayogataḥ ।
madārādhanavijñānāt bhasmībhavanti sarvaśaḥ ।।78।।
satyā patiguṇāḥ śravyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
patiścāhaṃ parabrahma matkathāṃ śṛṇuyācchubhām ।।79।।
dānaṃ yajñaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ dravyaṃ vyayaiḥ samutsavam ।
kartumaśaktabhaktena kathā śravyā mama dhruvam ।।1.454.80।।
kīrtanaṃ me svāminaśca nityaṃ kāryaṃ prage niśi ।
pūjā kāryā madarthe ca grasitanyaṃ niveditam ।।81 ।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ khādyaṃ sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ graset ।
tena sattvapraśuddhiḥ syātsmṛtirdevasya śāśvatī ।।82।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasmṛtyā dhruvo mokṣo'pyavāpyate ।
smṛtau tu sarvathā hetuḥ śrīkṛṣṇayaśasāṃ śravaḥ ।।83।।
kṣitedanijapuṇyena svargaprāptirna vai dhruvā ।
kathāśravaṇabhaktyā tu śāśvataॆ dhāma gamyate ।।84।।
svarṇakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ dānāccāpyadhikā kathā ।
rājasūyasahasrebhyaścottamā śrīhareḥ kathā ।।85।।
vratebhyo niyamebhyaśca japebhyaḥ śreyasī kathā ।
yatra me mama sādhūnāṃ bhaktānāṃ yogayoṣitām ।।86 ।।
sādhvīnāṃ ca satīnāṃ ca camatkārā nirūpitāḥ ।
caritrāṇi sudivyāni dyumanti varṇitāni ca ।।87।।
tāni sarvāṇi dātṝṇi sampadāṃ mokṣaṇasya ca ।
bhavatāṃ mokṣaṇārthāya satyāḥ sadbhāvasevayā ।।88।।
yuṣmākaṃ tāraṇārthaṃ vai viprarūpo bhavāmyaham ।
athā'haṃ yāmi vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhavantaḥ sādhusevanam ।।89।।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityaṃ kurvantu dhyānameva me ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ mama sevāṃ yūyaṃ sarve gamiṣyatha ।।1.454.90।।
ityuktvā vācako vipro vimānena sutejasā ।
yayau nārāyaṇo bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhaktasevitaḥ ।। 91 ।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! kāntājñāpālane phalam ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhaved dhruvam ।।9 2।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pātivratyaparāyā bandulāyā vidurākhyaviprasya svasvāminaḥ ājñāpālane vyavāyasyā'doṣatve bhagavatkathāprāptilābhena bhagavaddhāmaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 454 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 454 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 455
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 456 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
agastyasya priyapatnyāḥ pratāpaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu priye ।
pativratottamālopāmudrāyā divyayoṣitaḥ ।। 1 ।।
kadācinnārado lakṣmi! snātvā śrīnarmadāmbhasi ।
vindhyaṃ vilokayāñcakre vrajan śrībadarīśvaram ।। 2 ।।
rasālayaṃ drumavallīstambasasyādiśobhitam ।
vardhamānaṃ mahākāśe lokayantaṃ samantataḥ ।। 3 ।।
dṛṣṭvā kṣaṇaṃ nāradaḥ sa tasthau vyomnyeva kautukāt ।
vindhyo'pi sūryasaṃkāśaṃ nabhasi dyotitāmbaram ।। 4 ।।
nāradaṃ dṛṣṭavān premṇā dūrāt pratyujjagāma tam ।
santaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaṭhino'pi dhatte mṛdulatāṃ yataḥ ।। 5 ।।
natvā muniṃ dadau pādyamarghyaṃ cāsanamarhaṇam ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre babhāṣe'vanato giriḥ ।। 6 ।।
adya te pādarajasā naṣṭaṃ rajastamo mama ।
dharādharatvaṃ kuliṣu mānyaṃ me syāttavā''gamāt ।। 7 ।।
śrutvaitannāradaḥ kiñciducchvasya sthitavāँstataḥ ।
vindhyādrirāha munirāḍucchvāsakāraṇaṃ vad ।। 8 ।।
himādrīn parvatānnāhaṃ gaṇaye bhūdharāniti ।
vada kāryaṃ tu te kiñcit kariṣye sevayā yutaḥ ।। 9 ।।
nāradastaṃ tadā prāha merustvāmavamanyate ।
ityuktvā nāradastasmād yayau badarikāśramam ।। 1.455.1 0।।
vindhyādristvāpa mahatīṃ 'cintāṃ dhigjīvanaṃ mama ।
jñātiparājitasyātrodyamavivarjitasya ca ।। 11 ।।
kathaṃ bhunakti sa divā kathaṃ rātrau svapityaho ।
rahaḥ śarma kathaṃ tasya yasya jñātiparābhavaḥ ।। 1 2।।
yuktamuktaṃ purāvidbhiścintā kṛtyā bhayaṃkarī ।
nopāyaiḥ śāmyati ghorā nidrāṃ balaṃ haratyapi ।। 1 3।।
cintājvaro mahātīvraḥ pratyahaṃ navatāṃ vrajet ।
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kathaṃ meruṃ jayāmyaham ।। 14।।
viśveśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāyāṃ sa me buddhiṃ pradāsyati ।
iti vicārya mahati tvambare vardhate giriḥ ।। 15।।
dakṣiṇe sūryamārgaṃ sa niruddhya samavasthitaḥ ।
sūryāśvāstvagrato gantuṃ na śekurvai tadā'ruṇaḥ ।। 16।।
prāha sūryaṃ mahāvindhyo niruddhya gaganaṃ sthitaḥ ।
spardhate meruṇā prepsustvaddattāṃ tu pradakṣiṇām ।। 17।।
rāhubāhugrahavyagro yaḥ kṣaṇaṃ nā'vatiṣṭhati ।
yojanānāṃ sahasre dve, dve śate, dve ca yojane ।। 18।।
yojanasya nimeṣārdhād yāti so'pi ciraṃ sthitaḥ ।
tat sūryasya gatistambhāt stambhitaṃ tannimittakam ।। 19 ।।
kālamānaṃ tathā kāryaṃ rurudurdudruvuḥ prajāḥ ।
tato devādayaḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ।। 1.455.20।।
namaścakrustuṣṭuvuśca rakṣa rakṣeti cā'bruvan ।
vilokya duḥkhitān brahmā pratyuvāca divaukasaḥ ।।21 ।।
dāsyāmi sakalān kāmān śṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam ।
svasthāstiṣṭhata bho yūyaṃ kathaṃ satye samākulāḥ ।।22।।
ete vedāḥ sarvavidyāḥ satyaṃ dharmastapaḥ kratuḥ ।
brahmacaryaṃ bhāratīyaṃ śrutayaḥ smṛtayastathā ।।23।।
brahmaniṣṭhāstāpasāśca vratinaścopavāsinaḥ ।
pātivratyaparā nāryo ye cānye brahmacāriṇaḥ ।।24।।
mātāpitroḥ sadā bhaktā gobhaktā devasevakāḥ ।
patnīvratā atithīnāṃ pūjakā dānasukṛtāḥ ।।25।।
sarve me satyaloke'tra santi te sukhinaḥ sadā ।
vadantu bhavatāṃ ceṣṭaṃ karomi sukhakṛddhruvam ।।26।।
devāḥ prāhurvindhyaśailaḥ spardhate meruṇā divi ।
sūryamārgaṃ niruddhyaiva vardhate tvadgṛhaṃ prati ।।27।।
sūryādhārāḥ kriyā ruddhāstato layo bhaviṣyati ।
sūryamārgamato rodharahitaṃ kuru sarvathā ।।28।।
śrutvaitad viśvasṛṭ prāhā'gastyanāmā mahāmuniḥ ।
kāśīkṣetre tapatyugraṃ yācadhvaṃ taṃ muniṃ surāḥ ।।29।।
mitrāvaruṇaputraḥ sa lopāmudrāpatiḥ ṛṣiḥ ।
vidhāsyati sa vaḥ kāryaṃ vātāpīlvalabhakṣakaḥ ।।1.455.30।।
ityuktāstu surādyāste yayuḥ kāśīmagastyakam ।
maṇikarṇyāṃ surāḥ snātvā dadṛśuḥ kāśikāṃ purīm ।।3 1।।
vidvajjanapralakṣaiḥ satsādhulakṣairadhiṣṭhitām ।
tīrthavāsijanavrātakoṭimaṇḍalacañcalām ।।32।।
devālayaistrikoṭibhirgṛhasthālayakoṭibhiḥ ।
sahasrodyānasatkṣetraiḥ rājasaudhasahasrakaiḥ ।।33।।
vāranārīpralakṣaiśca devanārīpralakṣakaiḥ ।
brahmacārikoṭibhiśca naikadeśīyamānavaiḥ ।।34।।
tīrthakoṭiśatalakṣairgaṃgādyunadikānadaiḥ ।
vimānairvāhanairyānairmahāpustakapattanaiḥ ।।35।।
dhanvantaryādiśālābhirannasatrasahasrakaiḥ ।
suśobhitā bhikṣukaiśca dīnā'nāthaiḥ sahasrakaiḥ ।। 36।।
evaṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛtvā tīrthānyanekaśaḥ ।
viśvanāthaṃ cānnapūrṇāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tathā ।।37।।
śrībindumādhavaṃ dharmadevaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya te ।
sampūjya caraṇau prakṣālayitvā''gṛhya cāmṛtam ।।38।।
jagmuḥ paropakārārthamagastiryatra tiṣṭhati ।
agastīśvaraliṃgaṃ ca kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā tadagrataḥ ।।39।।
śatarudrīyasūktena japanmunirvirājate ।
tejasā sūryasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṣmiyire surāḥ ।।1.455.40।।
aho ho sarvatejāṃsi śritvemāṃ brāhmaṇīṃ tanum ।
śīlayanti paraṃ dhāma śāntaṃ śāntapadāptaye ।।41 ।।
yasyā''śrame'tra dṛśyante hiṃsrā api samantataḥ ।
sattvāśritāḥ sarvasattvāstyaktvā vairaṃ nisargajam ।।42।।
saha sarve nivasanti krūrāḥ śāntāśca rājasāḥ ।
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve mṛgāḥ sarīsṛpāstathā ।।43।।
ityāśramacarān dṛṣṭvā tiraśco'pi munīniva ।
abodhi vibudhaiḥ sarvaḥ prabhāvo'gastibhūmijaḥ ।।44।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāstu mūrtā yatra caranti hi ।
itipaśyanto gīrvāṇā dadṛśustūṭajaṃ muneḥ ।।45।।
homadhūpasugandhāḍhyaṃ baṭubhirbahubhirvṛtam ।
brahmacaryaratābhiśca brahmā'dhyayanatejasā ।। 46 ।।
candrābhābhirmunikanyābhiśca saumyamalaṃkṛtam ।
sārdravalkalakaupīnairvṛkṣaśākhāvalambibhiḥ ।।47।।
sūcayat sanmunivāsān sattvaprasādakāritān ।
pativratāśiroratnalopāmudrāṃ'ghrimudrayā ।।48।।
mudritaṃ vīkṣya te nemuḥ parṇaśālā'ṅgaṇaṃ surāḥ ।
visarjitasamādhiṃ ca dhṛtakarṇā'kṣimālikam ।।49।।
adhiṣṭhitabṛsīpṛṣṭhaṃ vedhasā sadṛśaṃ śriyā ।
puro'gastyaṃ samālokya devāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ ।।1.455.50।।
prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ procuḥ proccairjaya jayeti ca ।
muniḥ sarvānupāveśya papracchāgamakāraṇam ।।51 ।।
devagurustamuvāca devāgamanakāraṇam ।
dhanyo'si kṛtakṛtyo'si mānyo'si mahatāmapi ।।52।।
pratyāśramaṃ pratinagaṃ pratyaraṇyaṃ tapodhanaḥ ।
kinna santaḥ santyagastye kācidanyaiva te sthitiḥ ।।।53 ।।
tapolakṣmīstvayīhāsti brāhmaṃ tejastvayi sthiram ।
puṇyaśrīśca tvayi śreṣṭhā camatkārāstvayi sthitāḥ ।।54।।
pativrateyaṃ kalyāṇī lopāmudrā sadharmiṇī ।
tavāṃ'gacchāyayā tulyā yatkathā puṇyakāriṇī ।।55।।
arundhatī ca sāvitrī śāṇḍilī śrīḥ satī tathā ।
anasūyā mahālakṣmīḥ śatarūpā ca menakā ।।56 ।।
sunītiḥ kamalā svāhā saṃjñā ceti pativratāḥ ।
yā yāstāsu yathaiṣā varṇyate śreṣṭhā tathā na tāḥ ।।57।।
bhuṃkte bhukte tvayi mune tiṣṭhati tvayi tiṣṭhati ।
sunidrite tu nidrāti prathamaṃ pratibudhyati ।।58।।
nā'laṃkṛtaṃ nijātmānaṃ tava darśayati kvacit ।
gate bhavati kāryārthaṃ na dhatte maṇḍanāni tu ।।5 9 ।।
tavā''yuṣyavivṛddhyarthaṃ na gṛṇātyabhidhāṃ tava ।
kṛṣṇaṃ vinā'nyapunnāma naiva vadati karhicit ।।1.455.60।।
ākruṣṭā daṇḍitā cāpi nā''krośati prasīdati ।
idaṃ kuru samājñaptā śīghraṃ karoti tatkṣaṇam ।।6 1 ।।
kariṣyasīti samproktā'vaśyaṃ kānteti vakti ca ।
tvayā''hūtā'nyakāryāṇi tyaktvā tvāyāti satvaram ।।62।।
ājñāpaya kṛpāsindho vakti kṛtaṃ pramanyatām ।
na catuṣkasya mārgasyā'ṅganasya dvāri tiṣṭhati ।।63।।
anāpṛṣṭvā bhavantaṃ sā vastumātraṃ tṛṇaṃ hyapi ।
tvayā nānumataṃ kiñcit kasmaicinna dadātyapi ।।64।।
svayamāharati pūjāsāmagrīrnoditā'pi ca ।
jalaṃ darbhān phalapatrapuṣpāṇi cākṣatādikān ।।65 ।।
sādhayatyeva samaye vinā''jñāmapi sā satī ।
nodvignā bhavati kvāpi nodvejayati cāparān ।।66 ।।
yathākālaṃ yathāyogyamupasthāpayatīkṣate ।
bhuṃkte bhartuḥ prasādaṃ ca jalamannaṃ phalādikam ।।67।।
matvā mahāprasādaṃ tat svāmidattaṃ samīhate ।
devapitratithipoṣyānāthasatīsataḥ sadā ।।68।।
dāsagobhikṣukān datvā'śnāti vibhajya naijakam ।
saṃyatopaskarā prātardṛṣṭā vyayaparāṅmukhī ।।6 9।।
yathāpekṣavyayakartrī yogyaśaśvatparigrahā ।
tavā''deśaṃ vinā neyaṃ karotyapoṣaṇaṃ vratam ।।1.455.70।।
vinā''jñāṃ te na yātīyaṃ draṣṭuṃ samājamutsavam ।
pradarśanaṃ mallayuddhaṃ nṛtyaṃ nāṭya kalālayam ।।71 ।।
tīrthayātrāṃ vivāhaṃ te vinā''jñāṃ draṣṭumeti na ।
āsīnaṃ ramamāṇaṃ ca suptaṃ patiṃ sukhena sā ।।72 ।।
atyāvaśyakakārye'pi tvāṃ notthāpayati kvacit। ।
akāmaṃ tvāṃ ca rajasā svārthārthaṃ nāpi sevate ।। 73 ।।
rājasvalye mukhaṃ naiva darśayati dinatrayam ।
śrāvayati svavākyaṃ na pūrvaṃ snānādiśuddhitaḥ ।।74।।
paśyati turyadivase bharturmukhaṃ raviṃ harim ।
dhyāyatīyaṃ kāntarūpaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ pativratā ।।75 ।।
nityaṃ saubhāgyacihnāni dhārayatyeva tvadratā ।
keśasaṃskārakabarīkarakarṇādibhūṣaṇam ।।76 ।।
haridrāṃ kuṃkumacandraṃ sindūraṃ netrakajjalam ।
kaṃcukīṃ natthikāṃ tantrīṃ nūpuraṃ baṃgiḍīṃ tathā ।।77।।
śṛṃkhalāṃ cormikāṃ hāraṃ svarṇairaṇe ca śāṭikām ।
viṣṇutailaṃ sugandhaṃ ca dhārayatyeva tvadratā ।।78।।
na ca saṃgaṃ karotyeṣā nāstikāyāstu yoṣitaḥ ।
nā'spṛśyāyā na puṃścalyāḥ pākhaṇḍinyāśca yoṣitaḥ ।।79।।
nā'śuddhāyāśca kāminyā dharmavarjitayoṣitaḥ ।
bhartṛvidveṣiṇīṃ nārīṃ naiṣā saṃbhāṣate satī ।।।1.455.8 0।।
naikākinī bahiryāti vivastrā snāti na kvacit ।
niṣīdati sadā nimne na same bhartṛsannidhau ।।8 1 ।।
kaṇḍanyāṃ na ca peṣaṇyāṃ na cūllyāṃ jalakuṃbhake ।
gargaryāṃ na kaṭāhādau mūśale na śilātale ।।82।।
cūrṇayantre na mārjanyāṃ caṭṭanīpeṣake na hi ।
na dehalyāṃ puṇyapātre kṛtvā pṛṣṭhaṃ guruṃ patim ।।83 ।।
niṣīdati kvacicchāṭīmuttāryā'pi na tvadratā ।
stanaṃ jaghanaṃ kaścinna saṃpaśyed vartate tathā ।।84।।
vinā vyavāyasamayaṃ prāgalbhyaṃ samarakṣati ।
bharturyatra yathā tṛptiḥ rucistatra pravartate ।।85।।
paraṃ dharmaṃ vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devapūjanamuttamam ।
pālanaṃ pativākyasya matvollaṃghanameti na ।।86।।
bālamaśaktamakāmaṃ vyādhitaṃ duravasthakam ।
klībaṃ vratasthaṃ vṛddhaṃ vā rugṇaṃ patiṃ pativratā ।।87।।
susthitaṃ duḥsthitaṃ vāpi vyasanāḍhyaṃ daridrakam ।
cauraṃ kāmātisaktaṃ vā sevate sarvadā satī ।।88।।
tāpasaṃ cāpi niṣkāmaṃ tvāṃ sadā sevate tviyam ।
hṛṣṭā sadā tvayi hṛṣṭe viṣaṇṇe śokagarbhitā ।।89।।
sampatsu caikarūpā te vipatsvapi tava priyā ।
gṛhe bhojyasya vastūnāṃ veṣavārasya ca kṣaye ।।1.455.90 ।।
sampādayati cājñayā nāstīti na bravītyapi ।
tīrthecchayā te caraṇāmṛtaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ।।91 ।।
viṣṇornārāyaṇācchaṃbhoradhikaṃ manute patim ।
bhartṛcaraṇapūjātmaniyamaṃ tu prarakṣati ।। 92।।
satrapaṃ cāpavāde ca kaṣṭadaṃ kalikārakam ।
mṛṣā hasanaṃ cākrośaṃ neyaṃ gṛṇāti vai kvacit ।।93।।
devaṃ guruṃ vrataṃ tīrthaṃ dharmaṃ jānāti sā patim .।
tava chāyāsamā ceyaṃ vartate kiṃkarī tava ।।94।।
dhanyo'si munivarya tvaṃ dhanyau te pitarau tathā । ।
asyāstu pitarau dhanyau yataśceyaṃ pativratā ।।95।।
pativratāyāścaraṇo yatra bhūmau spṛśatyapi ।
sā bhūmiḥ sarvadā tīrthaṃ pāvanaṃ tārakaṃ bhavet। ।।96।।
parameśvarabhaktyaiva labhate strī pativratā ।
gṛhasthastvaṃ yathārtho'si yasya te'sti pativratā ।।97।।
pativratāyā dṛṣṭyā'pi pātakī pāvano bhavet ।
na gaṃgayā tayā bhedo yā nārī patidevatā ।।98।।
gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ tvetad yajjātaṃ tava darśanam ।
tava patnyā darśanaṃ ca jātaṃ no bahupuṇyataḥ ।।99।।
praṇavastvaṃ śrutiśceyaṃ kṣamaiṣā tvaṃ svayaṃ tapaḥ ।
satkriyeyaṃ phalaṃ tvaṃ ca dhanyo'si tvaṃ mahāmune! ।। 1.455.100 ।।
idaṃ pativrataṃ tejo brahmatejo bhavānparam ।
tatrā'pyetattapastejaḥ kimasādhyatamaṃ tava ।। 101 ।।
tava nā'viditaṃ kiñcittathāpi pravadāmyaham ।
yadarthamāgatā devāstanmune'tra niśāmaya ।। 1 02।।
ayaṃ śatamakhaḥ śrīmānayamagnirjagatprabhuḥ ।
dharmarājo varuṇaśca vāyuḥ śrīśaśivādayaḥ ।। 1 03।।
samabhyarthayitāro'mī tvaṃ yācyaśca jagatkṛte ।
vāṅmātrodyamasādhyaṃ tat tava viśvopakārakam ।। 1 04।।
vindhyādrirvardhate meroḥ spardhayā tvaṃ nivāraya ।
sūryamārgamavaruddhyedānīmūrdhvaṃ pragacchati ।। 1 05।।
ye tu niṣṭhuranaisargā ye ca mārgāvarodhakāḥ ।
ye spardhante ca vṛddhyarthaṃ tadvṛddhirhānidā sadā ।। 1 06।।
śrutvā dhyātvā kṣaṇaṃ tathetyuktvā'gastirmahāmuniḥ ।
visṛjya devatāḥ prāha lopāmudrāmidaṃ vacaḥ ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kutayugasantāne vindhyādriṇā vardhamānena sūryamārgā'varodhe devānāmagastimuniṃ prati yānaṃ lopāmudrāyāḥ pātivratyadharmavarṇanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 455 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 455 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 456
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 457 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
dhyāne sarvaṃ samālocyā'gastiḥ svasya pativratām ।
lopāmudrāmuvācedaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi! jagaddhitam ।। 1 ।।
api paśya varārohe! kimetatsamupasthitam ।
kva tatkāryaṃ kva ca vayaṃ munimārgā'valambinaḥ ।। 2 ।।
kāśīkṣetre nivasatāṃ vighnā bhavanti bhāgyataḥ ।
kāśīkṣetraṃ na moktavyaṃ sarvathaiva mumukṣubhiḥ ।। 3 ।।
upasthito'yaṃ kalyāṇi! so'ntarāyo mahānmama ।
tathāpi devakāryārthaṃ yāsyāmi śrīśivo'vatāt ।। 4 ।।
ityuccārya śivaṃ natvopaspṛśyā'sijalaṃ śubham ।
lopāmudrāsahāyaḥ sa yogena tapasā muniḥ ।। 5 ।।
vyomamārgeṇa divyena nimeṣārdhena vai divam ।
jagāmā'gre dadarśādriṃ vindhyaṃ ruddhāmbaronnatam ।। 6 ।।
cakampe tvacalastūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvaivā'grasthitaṃ munim ।
tamagastiṃ priyāyuktaṃ vātāpīlvalavairiṇam ।। 7 ।।
govardhanaṃ kare dhṛtvā'sthāpayad yo yamībhuvi ।
tamagnisadṛśaṃ vindhyo bhūtvā kharvataro bhayāt। ।। 8 ।।
ājñāprasādaḥ kriyatāṃ kiṃkaro'smīti cā'bravīt ।
agastiḥ prāha vindhya! tvaṃ māṃ vijānāsi tattvataḥ ।। 9 ।।
punarāgamanaṃ cenme tāvat kharvataro bhava ।
ityuktvā priyayā sākaṃ dakṣiṇāśāṃ yayau muniḥ ।। 1.456.10 ।।
vindhyaḥ paśyati sotkaṇṭho na śapto yadagastinā ।
na mayā sadṛśo dhanya iti matvā tutoṣa ha ।। 11 ।।
adya śvo vā paraśvo vā'pyāgamiṣyati vai muniḥ ।
iti cintāmahābhārairgirirhrasvastathā sthitaḥ ।। 1 2।।
no'dyāpi munirāyāti nādyāpi giriredhate ।
aruṇo'pi ca tatkāle kālajño'śvānakālayat ।। 1 3।।
jagatsvāsthyamavāpoccaiḥ pūrvavad bhānusañcaraiḥ ।
vivardhiṣati yo nīcaḥ parā'sūyā samudvahan ।। 14।।
dūre tadvṛddhivārtā''stāṃ prāgvṛddherapi saṃśayaḥ ।
manorathā na siddhāḥ syuḥ siddhā naśyantyapi dhruvam ।। 15।।
avijñāyā'nyasāmarthyaṃ svasāmarthyaṃ pradarśayet ।
upahāsasamavāpnoti tathaivā'yamihā'calaḥ ।। 16।।
atha godāvarītīraṃ yayāvagastirīśvaraḥ ।
dadarśā'gre mahālakṣmīṃ sahāsyāṃ suciraṃ sthitām ।। 17।।
tāṃ tu stutvā bhagavatīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ haripriyām ।
patnīyuktaḥ praṇanāma sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṇḍavanmuniḥ ।। 18।।
lakṣmī prāha muniṃ lopāmudrāṃ cāpi pativratām ।
prasannā'haṃ tvāṃ pravīkṣya vṛṇu yatte hṛdi sthitam ।। 1 9।।
rājaputri! mahābhāge! tvamihopaviśā'male ।
koladaityavināśārthamahamatra samāgatā ।।1.456.20।।
tvadaṃgalakṣaṇairebhiḥ supavitraiśca te vrataiḥ ।
nirvāpayitumicchāmi daityā'straistāpitāṃ tanum ।।21 ।।
ityuktvā munipatnīṃ tāṃ samāliṅgya haripriyā ।
alaṃcakāra suprītyā bahusaubhāgyamaṇḍanaiḥ ।।22।।
lopāmudrā'pi tāṃ lakṣmīṃ sevayāmāsa suspṛśaiḥ ।
dehasaṃvāhanaṃ cakre tāpaḥ śaśāma ca śriyaḥ ।।23।।
lopāmudrā śriyāḥ pādau dhṛtvā nanāma sādaram ।
vavande stavanaṃ cakre tava lakṣmiḥ tadā satī ।।24।।
śṛṇu tatstavanaṃ yena stāvakāḥ syurdhanāśrayāḥ ।
naikasampatsamāyuktāstvayā prasannayekṣitāḥ ।।25।।
mātarnamāmi kamale! padmā''yatasulocane ।
śrīviṣṇuhṛtkamalasthe viśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।26।।
kṣīrasāgarasatputri padmagarbhābhasundari ।
lakṣmi prasīda satataṃ viśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।27।।
mahendrasadane tvaṃ śrīḥ rukmiṇī kṛṣṇabhāminī ।
candre jyotsnā prabhā sūrye viśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।28।।
smitānane jagaddhātri śaraṇye sukhavarddhini ।
jātavedasi dahane viśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।29।।
brahmaṇi tvaṃ sarjanā'si viṣṇau tvaṃ poṣikā sadā ।
śive saṃhārikā śaktirviśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।1.456.3 0।।
tvayā śūro guṇī vijño dhanyo mānyaḥ kulīnakaḥ ।
kalāśīlakalāpāḍhyo viśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।3 1 ।।
tvayā gajasturagaśca straiṇastṛṇaṃ saraḥ sadaḥ ।
devo gṛhaṃ kaṇaḥ śreṣṭhā viśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।32।।
tvayā pakṣī paśuḥ śayyā ratnaṃ pṛthvī naro vadhūḥ ।
śreṣṭhāḥ śuddhā mahālakṣmi! viśvamātarnamo'stu te ।।33।।
lakṣmi! śri kamale padme rame padmodbhave sati ।
abdhije viṣṇupatni tvaṃ prasīda satataṃ priye ।।34।।
iti stutā prasannā ca śrīruvāca pativratām ।
lopāmudre mune jāne vāṃ yat hṛttāpakāraṇam ।।35।।
sacetanaṃ dunotyeva kāśīviśleṣajo'nalaḥ ।
yuvāṃ vārāṇasīṃ prāpya siddhiṃ prāpsyatha īpsitām ।।36।।
ye paṭhiṣyanti matstotraṃ tāpadāridryanāśakam ।
iṣṭasampatpradaṃ teṣāṃ jayasantatikārakam ।।37।।
mama sānnidhyadaṃ bālagrahādivyādhināśanam ।
bhaviṣyati mama sārūpyādipramokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।।38।।
iti labdhvā dampatī śrīpradāśiṣaḥ praṇamya tām ।
yayaturnātidūrasthaṃ śrīśailaṃ kamalāśrayam ।।39।।
patnīyuktaḥ sa saṃvīkṣya parāṃ mudamavāpa ha ।
paropakaraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ jāgarti hṛdaye satām ।।1.456.40।।
naśyanti vipadasteṣāṃ sampadaḥ syuḥ pade pade ।
tīrthasnānairna sā śuddhirbahudānairna tatphalam ।। 41।
tapobhirugraistannā'pyamupakṛtyā yadāpyate ।
nopakārātparo dharmo nā'pakārādaghaṃ param ।।42।।
upakāraphalaṃ lakṣmīdarśanaṃ śailadarśanam ।
lopāmudrāmunibhyāṃ śrīveṃkaṭādrirvilokitaḥ ।।43।।
uvāca vacanaṃ patnīṃ tadā prītamanā muniḥ ।
ākarṇaya varārohe tattvaṃ te kathayāmi vai ।।44।।
muktisthānānyanekāni bhavanti bhūtale sati ।
prayāgaṃ tīrtharājaṃ vai kurukṣetraṃ ca naimiṣam ।।45।।
avantikā haridvāramayodhyā mathurā purī ।
dvārikā cāmarāvatī tathā kuṃkumavāpikā ।।46।।
sarasvatī sindhusaṃgo gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamaḥ ।
kāñcī ca tryambakaṃ cāpi saptagodāvarītaṭam ।।47।।
kālaṃjaraṃ prabhāsaśca badrikāśramaraivatau ।
mahālayastathauṃkārakṣetraṃ ca pauruṣottamam ।।48।।
gokarṇo bhṛgukacchaśca bhṛgutuṅgaśca puṣkaram ।
śrīparvato mānasaṃ ca dhārātīrthaṃ ca bhautikam ।।49।।
ādhyātmikāni tīrthāni dayāsnehādikānyapi ।
etāni muktidānyeva nā'trā'sti saṃśayo manāk ।।।1.456.50।।
satyaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣamātīrthaṃ tīrthamindriyanigrahaḥ ।
sarvabhūtadayātīrthaṃ tīthamārjavamityapi ।।51 ।।
dānaṃ tīrthaṃ damastīrthaṃ santoṣastīrthamucyate ।
brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthaṃ ca priyavāditā ।।52।।
jñānaṃ tīrthaṃ dhṛtistīrthaṃ tapastīrthamudāhṛtam ।
sarvatīrthaparaṃ tīrthaṃ śuddhiryā mānasī sadā ।।93।।
na jalena viśuddhirvai manaḥśuddhi satī sadā ।
na śarīramalatyāgācchuddhirdeho na nirmalāḥ ।।54।।
aihikasukhalabdhyarthaṃ vāñcchā vai mānaso malaḥ ।
tatra tatra virāgastu sunairmalyamudāhṛtam ।।55।।
bhāve tu nirmale jāte kāmādyā api nirmalāḥ ।
doṣāśca guṇatāṃ yānti sattvaprakarṣasaṃśrayāt ।।56 ।।
nigṛhītendriyagrāmo yatra kvāpi vasejjanaḥ ।
tatra tasya kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca ।।57।।
dhyānapūte jñānajale rāgadveṣamalāpahe ।
yaḥ snāti mānase tīrthe sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।।58।।
etatte mānasaṃ proktaṃ tīrthaṃ sādhuprasevanam ।
bāhya bhaumaṃ jalīyaṃ ca śṛṇu tīrthaṃ kathaṃ hi tat ।।59।।
śārīrā brahmarandhrādyā bhāgā medhyatamā yathā ।
tathā bhūjalabhāgāśca medhyāstīrthāni tāni vai ।।1.456.6 0।।
svayaṃjātāni puṇyāni kānicid devajāni ca ।
kānicitsatpūruṣāṇāṃ nivāsādyaiḥ kṛtāni ca ।।61 ।।
pativratānāṃ vāsādyaiścamatkāraiḥ satāmapi ।
satīnāṃ cāpyanugrahaiḥ sādhvīnāṃ tapasā tathā ।।62।।
patnīvratānāṃ kāryādyaistīrthāni saṃbhavanti hi ।
ātmatīrthaṃ mahat proktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo mahato mahān ।।63।।
śuddhaṃ buddhyātmakaṃ tīrthaṃ nirmalānīndriyāṇyapi ।
bhautikāni śarīrāṇi tapobhiḥ pāvanāni ca ।।64।।
asthi carmādikaṃ cāpyaśuddhaṃ satāṃ tu pāvanam ।
tīrthaṃ vai jāyate kṛṣṇatapoyogāt sudivyakam ।।65।।
kathātmakaṃ sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthottamottamam ।
bhāvātmakaṃ mahattīrthaṃ snehatīrthaṃ ca sukṛtam ।।66।।
vṛddhābhivandanaṃ tīrthaṃ brahmalokapradaṃ matam ।
yajñabhūmirmahattīrthaṃ gotīrthaṃ tulasīkṣatiḥ ।।67।।
ekādaśyādikaṃ tīrthaṃ tārayatyeva bandhanāt ।
śraddhātmakaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyadaṃ phaladaṃ tathā ।।68।।
tasmādbhaumeṣu tīrtheṣu jalīyeṣu tathā priye ।
yathā divyatvabuddhirvai tathā kṛtvā tu dehiṣu ।।69।।
devālayeṣu deveṣu mūrtiṣu pratimāsu ca ।
satsu sādhvīṣu satkāryaṃ sukṛtaṃ tvarjayet sadā ।।1.456.70।।
āntareṣu ca bāhyeṣu tīrtheṣu snāti yo janaḥ ।
kṛṣṇasaṃghagatau bhakto vindati paramāṃ gatim ।।71।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homastarpaṇaṃ vapanaṃ kṛtam ।
hareḥ satāṃ sevanaṃ ca darśanaṃ tvakṣayaṃ bhavet ।।72।।
kāśī kāñcī ca māyākhyā tvayodhyā dvāravatyapi ।
mathurā'vantikā caitā mokṣadā bhagavadbhuvaḥ ।।73।।
tathāpi kāśikā sarvadevavāsena yādṛśī ।
mānase me rocate'dya na tathā'nyā pativrate ।।74।।
tārakaṃ jñānamantrādi dadāti śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
nityaṃ bhikṣukarūpeṇa bhramatyeva gṛhaṃ gṛham ।।75।।
mahāvaiṣṇavarājo'yaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāmṛtaṃ tathā ।
golokaṃ cāpi kailāsaṃ bhaktān preṣayati prabhuḥ ।।76।।
yamamārgaḥ sadā ruddhaḥ kāśīvāsakṛtāṃ priye ।
avimuktaṃ mahākṣetraṃ śivādīnāṃ parātparam ।।77।।
tadvāsārthaṃ rocaye'haṃ yāvastāṃ kāśikāṃ purīm ।
satīnāṃ kāśikāvāsād brahmalokā''ptireva vai ।।78।।
satīlokātparaṃ lokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti tāḥ striyaḥ ।
etacchrutvā muniṃ lopāmudrā papraccha sādaram ।।79।।
nārīṇāṃ cāpsarasāṃ ca satīnāṃ kvā'sti tatpuram ।
vada me jīvaneśā'tra syāṃ ca niḥsaṃśayā yathā ।।1.456.80 ।।
omityuktvā satīlokamagastiḥ prāha yoṣite ।
śṛṇu sādhvi bhūmilokātparo vāyustaraḥ smṛtaḥ ।।81।।
piśācādinivāsaḥ sa tato guhyakamaṇḍalam ।
guhyakānāṃ tu devānāṃ lokaḥ sa smṛddhisaṃbhṛtaḥ ।।82।।।
tato gāndharvalokaśca yatra gandharvacāraṇāḥ ।
tato vaidyādharo loko vidyādhrā yatra santi hi ।।83।।
tato dharmapurī ramyā dhārmikāḥ svargavāsinaḥ ।
tataḥ svargaṃ mahatpuṇyabhājāṃ sthānaṃ sadāsukham ।।84।।
tataścā'psarasāṃ lokaḥ svarge cordhve vyavasthitaḥ ।
apsaraso mahāsatyo yajñabhājāṃ priyaṃkarāḥ ।।85।।
vasanti cāpsaroloke lokapālānusevikāḥ ।
yuvatyo rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyanidhayaḥ śubhāḥ ।।86।।
dṛḍhagranthinitambinyo divyālaṃkāraśobhanāḥ ।
divyabhogapradā gītinṛtyavādyasupaṇḍitāḥ ।।87।।
kāmakelikalābhijñā dyūtavidyāviśāradāḥ ।
rasajñā bhāvavedinyaścaturāścocitoktiṣu ।।88।।
nānā''deśaviśeṣajñā nānābhāṣāsukovidā ।
saṃketodantanipūṇāḥ svatantrā devatoṣikāḥ ।।89।।
līlānarmasu sābhijñāḥ supralāpeṣu paṇḍitāḥ ।
kṣīrodasya sutāḥ sarvā nārāyaṇena nirmitāḥ ।।1.456.90 ।।
urvaśī menakā raṃbhā candralekhā tilottamā ।
vapuṣmatī kāntimatī līlāvatyupalāvatī ।।91 ।।
alambuṣā guṇavatī sthūlakeśī kalāvatī ।
kalānidhirguṇanidhiḥ karpūratilakorvarā ।।92।।
anaṃgalatikā vidyullatā madanamohinī ।
cakorākṣī candrakalā maṇiprabhā manoharā ।।93।।
grāvadrāvā tapodveṣṭrī cārunāsā sukarṇikā ।
dārusañjivanī suśrīḥ kratuśulkā śubhānanā ।।94।।
tapaḥśulkā tīrthaśulkā dānaśulkā himāvatī ।
pañcāśvamedhikā vidyā rājasūyārthinī prabhā ।।95।।
aṣṭāgnihomikā mādhvī vājapeyaśatodbhavā ।
acchodā mohinī campā lalitā ca jayā ramā ।। 96।।
vardhinī padminī mañjukeśī hemnī ca mañjulā ।
miśrakeśī devikā śāntikā ṣaṣṭisahasrakam ।। 97।।
apsarasāṃ vasatyanyā striyo loke'tra santyapi ।
sadā'skhalitalāvaṇyāḥ sadā'skhalitayauvanāḥ ।।98।।
divyāmbarā divyamālā divyagandhānulepanāḥ ।
divyabhogaiḥ susampannāḥ svecchāvidhṛtavigrahāḥ ।। 99 ।।
kṛtvā māsopavāsāni skhalanti brahmacaryataḥ ।
sakṛdeva dvikṛtyo vā triḥkṛtvo daivayogataḥ ।। 1.456.100।।
tā imā divyabhoginyo rūpalāvaṇyasampadaḥ ।
nivasantyapsaroloke sarvakāmasamanvitāḥ ।। 101 ।।
kṛtvā vratāni sāṃgāni kāmikāni vidhānataḥ ।
bhavanti kāmacāriṇyo devabhogyā ihā''gatāḥ ।। 1 02।।
pativratadharānāryo balena balinā dhṛtāḥ ।
bhartṛbuddhyā ramante ta kadācittā imāḥ priyāḥ ।। 10 3।।
bhartari proṣite yāstu brahmacaryavratāḥ sadā ।
viplavante sakṛd daivāt tā etā vāmalocanāḥ ।। 1 04।।
svarṇaṃ sugandhaṃ sahasraṃ śayyāṃ bhūṣāśca bhojanam ।
bahukautukavastūni samarcya dvijadampatīm ।। 1 05।।
saṃkrāntau vā vyatīpāte dadyāt yā varavarṇinī ।
kāmarūpadharo devaḥ prīyatāmiti vādinī ।। 1 06।।
ko'dāt kasmā adāt kāmo'dāt kāmāya tvadāttathā ।
kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigṛhītā kāma te idam ।। 1 07।।
itimantreṇa saṃdātrī yathāśakti sakāmanā ।
sā śreṣṭhā'psarasāṃ madhye vaset kalpamihāṃ'ganā ।। 1 08।।
kanyārūpadharā kācid vyābhuktā kenacit kvacit ।
devarūpeṇa taṃ kālamārabhya brahmacāriṇī ।। 1 09।।
vṛttaṃ tad dhyāyamānā sā nidhanaṃ yāti kālataḥ ।
divyarūpadharā seha jāyate divyabhogabhāk ।। 1.456.11 0।।
ityāvedya striyai kuṃbhajanmā mitrāvaruṇajaḥ ।
lopāmudrā'bhidhapatnyai tūṣṇīmāsa mahāmuniḥ ।। 11 1।।
atha kāśyāṃ śivā durgā devyo brahmavratapriyāḥ ।
yayuḥ prātaragastyasyāśramaṃ devīṃ pativratām ।। 11 2।।
devīpūjyāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ lopāmudrāṃ pravīkṣitum ।
adṛṣṭvā tāmanivṛttāṃ riktaṃ cāśramamaṇḍalam ।। 11 3।।
dhyātvā jñātvā veṃkaṭādrau sthitāṃ draṣṭuṃ drutaṃ yayuḥ ।
nemurāśleṣayāmāsuḥ kathāḥ prāhuḥ parasparam ।। 1 14।।
devībhirarthitā sādhvī tābhiḥ sākaṃ nijāśramam ।
agastinā saha sādhvī samājagāma kāśikām ।। 1 15।।
pativratāṃ mahāsādhvīṃ satīṃ prāpya surastriyaḥ ।
kāśīsthā sukhamāpannā durlabhaḥ satsamāgamaḥ ।। 116 ।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vindhyasyā'vardhanaṃ tathā ।
agastyasya camatkāro lopāmudrāsatīśatā ।। 1 17।।
yā kanyā śṛṇuyāccedaṃ paṭhedvā sā pativratā ।
satī sādhvī śrīsamānā bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 18।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
vindhyācalasya sūryamārgamavaruddhya sthitasyā'gastyena nirodhaḥ kṛtaḥ, agastyasya mahālakṣmīdarśanaṃ, mahālakṣmīstotraṃ, tīrthavividhatā, tīrthapraśaṃsā, apsarasāṃ lokaḥ, apsarobhāvaprāptikāraṇāni, kāśīdevibhirlopāmudrāgastyayoḥ kāśīṃ pratyānayanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikacatuśśata-
tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।456।।


← adhyāyaḥ 456 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 457
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 458 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
datrātreyasya sacchiṣyaḥ kārtavīryā'rjuno nṛpaḥ ।
pativratayā tatpatnyā manoramākhyayā muhuḥ ।। 1 ।।
rakṣito'pi bodhito'pi na mene svapriyāvacaḥ ।
anādṛtya gato yuddhe jāmadagnyasya sannidhau ।। 2 ।।
tadā dehaḥ parityakto manoramākhyayoṣitā ।
tato mṛtaḥ kārtavīryaḥ śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ tu tām ।। 3 ।।
māhiṣmatyā nagaryāḥ sa rājā'bhūdarjuno mahān ।
ekadā kārtavīryaḥ sa jagāma mṛgayāṃ vane ।। 4 ।।
rātrau bubhukṣitaḥ śrānto jamadagnyāśramaṃ yayau ।
kāmadhenupratāpena sasainyo bhojito nṛpaḥ ।। 5 ।।
jamadagniṃ mārayitvā kāmadhenuṃ jahāra saḥ ।
yayāvanu satī vahnau praviśya reṇukā patim ।। 6 ।।
parśurāmaḥ krodhamāptaḥ pratijñāṃ pracakāra ha ।
triḥsaptakṛtvo nirbhūpāṃ kariṣyāmi mahīmimām ।। 7 ।।
brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ datvā brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha ।
pratijñāṃ kathayāmāsa brahmaṇe'tha tamāha saḥ ।। 8 ।।
śivalokaṃ gaccha vatsa śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja ।
śrīkṛṣṇamantrakavacagrahaṇaṃ kuru śaṃkarāt ।। 9 ।।
durlabhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tejaḥ śaivaṃ śāktaṃ vijeṣyati ।
śrutvā natvā vedhasaṃ saḥ śivalokaṃ jagāma ha ।। 1.457.10 ।।
nanāma mūrdhnā śaṃbhuṃ sa vṛttāntaṃ samuvāca tam ।
prasannaḥ śaṃkarastasmai dadau śrīkṛṣṇasanmanum ।। 11 ।।
trailokyavijayaṃ varma tathā stotraṃ hareḥ śubham ।
trailokyavijayasyā'sya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ।। 1 2।।
ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo rāseśvaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
trailokyavijayaprāptau viniyogaḥ sadā mataḥ ।। 13 ।।
praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ sadā ।
pāyāt kapālaṃ 'kṛṣṇāya svāhā' pañcākṣarātmakaḥ ।। 14।।
kṛṣṇeti pātu netre ca kṛṣṇaḥ svāheti tārakam ।
haraye nama ityevaṃ bhrūlatāṃ pātu me sadā ।। 15।।
oṃ govindāya svāheti nāsikāṃ pātu sarvadā ।
gopālāya namo gaṇḍau pātu me sarvataḥ prabho ।। 16।।
oṃ namo gopāṃganeśāya karṇau pātu sadā mama ।
oṃ kṛṣṇāya namaḥ śaśvatpātu me'dharayugmakam ।।17।।
oṃ govindāya svāheti dantaughaṃ me sadā'vatu ।
pātu kṛṣṇāya dantā'dho dantordhvaṃ klīṃ sadā'vatu ।। 18।।
oṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti jihvikāṃ pātu me sadā ।
rāseśvarāya svāheti tālukaṃ pātu me sadā ।। 1 9।।
rādhikeśāya svāheti kaṇṭhaṃ pātu sadā mama ।
namo gopāṃganeśāya vakṣaḥ pātu sadā mama ।।1.457.20।।
oṃ gopeśāya svāheti skandhaṃ pātu sadā mama ।
namaḥ kiśoraveśāya svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।।21 ।।
udaraṃ pātu me nityaṃ mukundāya namaḥ sadā ।
auṃ hrīṃ klīṃ kṛṣṇāya svāhā karau pātu sadā mama ।।22।।
oṃ viṣṇave namo bāhuyugmaṃ pātu sadā mama ।
oṃ hīṃ bhagavate svāhā nakharaṃ pātu me sadā ।।23।।
oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya nakharandhraṃ sadā'vatu ।
auṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ padmanābhāya nābhiṃ pātu sadā mama ।।24।।
oṃ sarveśāya svāheti kakālaṃ pātu me sadā ।
oṃ gopīramaṇāya svāhā nitambaṃ pātu me sadā ।।25।।
oṃ gopīramaṇanāthāya pādau sadā'vatu mama ।
oṃ hīṃ klīṃ rasikeśāya svāhā sarvaṃ sadā'vatu ।।26।।
oṃ keśavāya svāheti mama keśān sadā'vatu ।
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya svāheti brahmarandhraṃ sadā'vatu ।।27।।
oṃ mādhavāya svāheti me lomāni sadā'vatu ।
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ ralikeśāya svāhā sarvaṃ sadā'vatu ।।28।।
paripūrṇatamaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prācyāṃ māṃ sarvadā'vatu ।
svayaṃ golokanātho māmāgneyyāṃ diśi rakṣatu ।।29।।
pūrṇabrahmasvarūpaśca dakṣiṇe māṃ sadā'vatu ।
nairṛtyāṃ pātu māṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paścime pātu māṃ hariḥ ।।1.457.3 0।।
govindaḥ pātu māṃ śaśvad vāyavyāṃ diśi nityaśaḥ ।
uttare māṃ sadā pātu rasikānāṃ śiromaṇiḥ ।।3 1।।
aiśānyāṃ māṃ sadā pātu vṛndāvanavihārakṛt ।
vṛndāvanīprāṇanāthaḥ pātu māmūrdhvadeśataḥ ।।32।।
sadaiva mādhavaḥ pātu balihārī balādhikaḥ ।
jale sthale cāntarikṣe nṛsiṃhaḥ pātu māṃ sadā ।।33।।
svapne jāgaraṇe śaśvat pātu māṃ mādhavaḥ sadā ।
sarvātmā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo māṃ pātu sarvataḥ ।।34।।
iti trailokyavijayaṃ varmoktaṃ te mahā'dbhutam ।
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau dhāraṇād vijayaḥ sadā ।।35।।
sa bhavet siddhakavaco daśalakṣaṃ japettu yaḥ ।
daśāṃśahomaḥ kartavyo yatheṣṭasiddhimicchatā ।।36।।
oṃ śrī namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya paripūrṇatamāya svāhā ।
siddhaḥ syāt pañcalakṣaistu mantraḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥ ।।37।।
atha stotraṃ śṛṇu divyaṃ sadyastuṣṭikaraṃ param ।
divyaṃ śrīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vedhasoditam ।। 38।।
sūkṣmatamaṃ cākṣareśaṃ nirguṇaṃ saguṇaṃ harim ।
nirākāraṃ ca sākāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।39।।
sarvādhāraṃ svatantraṃ ca kamanīyaṃ vibhuṃ harim ।
sākṣiṇaṃ karmaphaladaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।1.457.40।।
jagajjanmādikartāraṃ saccidānandamarthagam ।
strīpuṃnapuṃsakātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।41 ।।
tārakaṃ dhārakaṃ sarvakāraṇānāṃ tu kāraṇam ।
bījaṃ vipraṃ raviṃ candraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।42।।।
śaṃkaraṃ śeṣarūpaṃ ca brahmāṇaṃ kapilaṃ munim ।
sanatkumāraṃ rādheśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।43।।
viṣṇuṃ devīṃ manuṃ bhaktaṃ vasantaṃ mārgaśīrṣakam ।
ekādaśīṃ sāgaraṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।44।।
himālayaṃ kṣitiṃ vṛndāṃ candanaṃ kalpapādapam ।
dhānyaṃ ca pārijātaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।45।।
airāvataṃ vainateyaṃ kāmadhenuṃ tathāmṛtam ।
suvarṇaṃ ca yavaṃ siṃhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।46 ।।
bṛhaspatiṃ kuberaṃ ca vedamindraṃ sarasvatīm ।
akāraṃ jāhnavīṃ manaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।47।।
sudarśanaṃ brahmatejaḥ kāntaṃ kālaṃ balaṃ gurum ।
mātaraṃ viśvakarmāṇaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।। 88।।
pativratāṃ pitaraṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ sutaṃ nṛpam ।
sāmavedaṃ vṛṣaṃ śaityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।49।।
gandhaṃ śabdaṃ rājasūyaṃ gāyatrīṃ pāvakaṃ payaḥ ।
sucitrasthaṃ stutiṃ darbhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।1.457.50 ।।
śāntiṃ vibhuṃ matiṃ citraṃ śyāmalaṃ gopikāpatim ।
divyabhūṣādharaṃ kāntaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ praṇamāmyaham ।।51 ।।
vihāriṇaṃ ca rasikaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam ।
lakṣmīśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nityaṃ namāmyaham ।।52।।
iti stotreṇa trailokye sarvadā vijayo bhavet ।
gaccha sādhaya saṃkuru pratijñāntaṃ jayastava ।।53।।
rāmo gatvā puṣkare saṃsādhya yuddhāya nirgataḥ ।
dadarśa maṃgalānyeva śuśrāva jayasūcakam ।।54।।
hariśabdaṃ siṃhaśabdaṃ ghaṇṭādundubhivādanam ।
ākāśīyasvaragītiṃ jayaste bhaviteti vai ।।55।।
naveṅgitaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ meghaśabdaṃ jayāvaham ।
dadarśa purato viprabandidaivajñabhikṣukān ।।।56।।
puro dadarśa dīpaṃ ca patiputravatīṃ satīm ।
śivaṃ śivāṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ cāpaṃ ca nakulaṃ tathā ।।57।।
kṛṣṇamṛgaṃ gajaṃ siṃhaṃ turagaṃ gaṇḍakaṃ dvipam ।
camarīṃ rājahaṃsaṃ ca cakravākaṃ śukaṃ pikam ।।58।।
mayūraṃ khañjanaṃ śaṃkhacillaṃ tathā cakorakam ।
pārāvataṃ balākaṃ ca kāraṇḍaṃ cātakaṃ caṭam ।।59।।
saudāminīṃ śakracāpaṃ sūryaṃ sūryaprabhāṃ śubhām ।
sadyomāṃsaṃ sajīvaṃ ca matsyaṃ śaṃkhaṃ suvarṇakam ।।1.457.60।।
māṇikyaṃ rajataṃ muktāṃ maṇīndraṃ ca pravālakam ।
dadhi lājān śukladhānyaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ ca kuṃkumam ।।61 ।।
parṇaṃ patākāṃ chatraṃ ca darpaṇaṃ śvetacāmaram ।
dhenuṃ vatsayutāṃ nṛpaṃ rathasthaṃ hetisaṃyutam ।।62।।
dugdhamājyaṃ ca pūgaṃ cāmṛtaṃ ca pāyasaṃ śubham ।
śālagrāmaṃ phalaṃ pakvaṃ svastikaṃ śarkarāṃ madhu ।।63।।
mārjāraṃ ca vṛṣaṃ śvetaṃ meṣaṃ parvatamūṣikam ।
meghācchannasya ca raverudayaṃ candramaṇḍalam ।।64।।
kastūrīṃ vyajanaṃ toyaṃ haridrāṃ tīrthamṛttikām ।
siddhārthaṃ sarṣapaṃ dūrvāṃ viprabālaṃ ca kanyakām ।।65।।
mṛgaṃ veśyāṃ ṣaṭpadaṃ ca karpūraṃ pītavāsasam ।
gomūtraṃ gopurīṣaṃ ca godhūliṃ gopadā'ṅkitam ।।66।।
goṣṭhaṃ gavāṃ vartma ramyāṃ gośālāṃ gogatiṃ tathā ।
bhūṣaṇaṃ devamūrtiṃ ca jvaladagniṃ mahotsavam ।।67।।
tāmraṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ vandyaṃ sindūraṃ mālyacandanam ।
gandhaṃ ca hīrakaṃ ratnaṃ dadarśa dakṣiṇe muniḥ ।।68।।
sugandhipavanā''ghrāṇaṃ prāpya viprāśiṣaḥ śubhāḥ ।
kārtavīryā'rjunā'bhyāśe yayau śrīnarmadātaṭam ।।69।।
tatrā'kṣayavaṭā'dhastād rātrau nidrāṃ jagāma ha ।
niśātīte dadarśāyaṃ svapnāni vividhāni ca 1.457.70।।
na cintitaṃ yanmanasā vāyupittakaphaṃ vinā ।
gajāśvaśailaprāsādagovṛkṣaphaliteṣu ca ।।7 1 ।।
āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ rudantaṃ kṛmibhakṣitam ।
āruhyamāṇamātmānaṃ naukāyāṃ candanokṣitam ।।72।।
puṣpamālāṃ dhṛtavantaṃ pītavastraiḥ suśobhitam ।
viṇmūtrokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ vasāpūyasamanvitam ।। 73 ।।
vīṇāṃ varāṃ vādayantamātmānaṃ sa dadarśa ha ।
vistīrṇapadmapatrāḍhyaṃ svaṃ dadarśa sarittaṭe ।।74।।
dadhyājyamadhusaṃyuktaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca pāyasam ।
bhuktavantaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ labhantaṃ vrāhmaṇāśiṣam ।।75।।
phalapuṣpapradīpaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha ।
paripakvaphalaṃ kṣīramuṣṇānnaṃ śarkarānvitam ।।76।।
svastikaṃ bhuktavantaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ śvetacūrṇajam ।
śarkarāyugvāripānaṃ kurvantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।।77।।
jalaukasā vṛścikena mīnena bhujagena ca ।
bhakṣitaṃ bhītamātmānaṃ palāyantaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।।78।।
tato dadarśa cātmānaṃ maṇḍale śaśisūryayoḥ ।
patiputravatīṃ nārīṃ dadarśa sasmitāṃ tataḥ ।।79।।
suveṣayā kanyayā sasmitena ca dvijena ca ।
dadarśa śliṣṭamātmānaṃ tuṣṭena parituṣṭayā ।।1.457.80 ।।
phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ devatāpratimāṃ nṛpam ।
gajasthaṃ ca rathasthaṃ ca paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।।81 ।।
pītavastraparīdhānāṃ ratnālaṃkārabhūṣitām ।
viśantīṃ brāhmaṇīṃ gehaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।।82।।
śaṃkhaṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ śvetamālāṃ muktāṃ ca candanam ।
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnaṃ paśyantaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।।83।।
gajaṃ vṛṣaṃ ca sarpaṃ ca śvetaṃ ca śvetacāmaram ।
nīlotpalaṃ darpaṇaṃ ca parśurāmo dadarśa ha ।।84।।
rathasthaṃ navaratnāḍhyaṃ mālatīmālyabhūṣitam ।

padmaśreṇīṃ padmakuṃbhaṃ dadhi lājān ghṛtaṃ madhu ।
parṇacchatraṃ chatriṇaṃ ca rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।86।।
bakapaṃktiṃ haṃsapaṃktiṃ kanyāpaṃktiṃ vratānvitām ।
pūjayantī ghaṭaṃ śubhraṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।87।।
maṇḍapasthaṃ dvijagaṇaṃ pūjayantaṃ haraṃ harim ।
jayo'stvityuktavantaṃ taṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।88।।
sudhāvṛṣṭiṃ parṇavṛṣṭiṃ phalavṛṣṭiṃ gavāgamam ।
puṣpacandanavṛṣṭiṃ ca rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।89।।
sadyomāṃsaṃ jīvamatsyaṃ mayūraṃ śvetakhañjanam ।
sarovaraṃ ca tīrthāni rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।1.457.90।।
pārāvataṃ śukaṃ cāpaṃ śaṃkhaṃ cillaṃ ca cātakam ।
vyāghraṃ siṃhaṃ ca surabhīṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।91 ।।
gorocanāṃ haridrāṃ ca śukladhānyacayaṃ śubham ।
jvaladagniṃ tathā dūrvāṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।92।।
devālayasamūhaṃ ca śivaliṃgaṃ ca pūjitam ।
arcitāṃ mṛnmayīṃ śaivāṃ rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।93।।
yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni ca ।
bhuktavantaṃ muhuḥ svaṃ ca rāmaḥ svapne dadarśa ha ।।94।।
divyavastravibhūṣāḍhyā nārīḥ svapne sa bhuktavān ।
agamyāgamanaṃ svapne cakāra paraśupradhiḥ ।।95।।
dadarśa nartakīṃ veśyāṃ rudhiraṃ ca surāṃ papau ।
rudhirokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ svātmānaṃ sa dadarśa ha ।।96।।
pakṣiṇāṃ pītavarṇānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca padmaje ।
māṃsāni bubhuje rāmo hṛṣṭaḥ svapne'ruṇodaye ।।97।।
akasmānnigaḍairbaddhaṃ kṣataṃ śastreṇa svaṃ punaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ bubughe prātaḥ samuttasthau hariṃ smaran ।।98।।
manasā bubudhe sarvaṃ vijeṣyāmi ripūn dhruvam ।
kārtavīryārjuno rātrāvaniṣṭāni dadarśa ha ।। 99।।
tailā'bhyaṃgitamātmānaṃ dadarśa gardabhopari ।
auḍhapuṣpasya mālyaṃ ca bibhrataṃ raktacandanam ।। 1.457.1 00।।
raktavastraparīdhānaṃ lohālaṃkārabhūṣitam ।
krīḍantaṃ ca hasantaṃ ca nirvāṇāṃgārarāśinā ।। 101 ।।
bhasmacchannāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ jayāpuṣpānvitāṃ bhuvam ।
rahitaṃ candrasūryābhyāṃ raktasandhyānvitaṃ nabhaḥ ।। 1 02।।
muktakeśāṃ ca nṛtyantīṃ vidhavāṃ chinnanāsikām ।
raktavastraparīdhānāṃ dadarśa cāṭṭahāsinīm ।। 1 03।।
saśarāmagnirahitāṃ citāṃ bhasmasamanvitām ।
bhasmavṛṣṭimasṛgvṛṣṭimagnivṛṣṭiṃ dadarśa saḥ ।। 1 04।।
pakvatālaphalākīrṇāṃ pṛthivīmasthisaṃbhṛtām ।
karparaughaṃ dadarśā'pi chinnakeśanakhānvitām ।। 1 05।।
parvatāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca rāśībhūtaṃ kapardakam ।
cūrṇānāṃ caiva tailānāṃ dadarśa kandaraṃ niśi ।। 106 ।।
dadarśa puṣpitaṃ vṛkṣamaśokakaravīrayoḥ ।
tālavṛkṣaṃ ca phalitaṃ dadarśa saḥ patatphalam ।। 1 07।।
svakarātpūrṇakalaśaḥ papāta ca babhañja ca ।
dadarśā'pi ca gaganāt sampatatsūryamaṇḍalam ।। 1 08।।
evaṃ dadarśa gaganāt sampataccandramaṇḍalam ।
ulkāpātaṃ dhūmaketuṃ grahaṇaṃ candrasūryayoḥ ।। 1 09।।
vikṛtākārapuruṣaṃ vikaṭāsyaṃ digambaram ।
āgacchantaṃ tvagratastaṃ svapne dadarśa cārjunaḥ ।। 1.457.11 0।।
bālā dvādaśavarṣīyā vastrabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।
saṃruṣṭā yāti svagehādevaṃ svapne dadarśa saḥ ।। 111 ।।
manoramā nijapatnī yācate kānanaṃ prati ।
gamanāyaikalā ceti svapne dadarśa cārjunaḥ ।। 11 2।।
ruṣṭo vipro māṃ śapate sanyāsī ca yatirguruḥ ।

gṛdhraiḥ kākairmahiṣaiśca pīḍitaṃ svaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।
pīḍitaṃ tailayantreṇa bhrāmitaṃ tailakāriṇā ।। 1 14।।
dhṛtaṃ nagnaiḥ pāśahastairātmānaṃ sa dadarśa ha ।

vivāhaṃ paramānandaṃ ramato lokanāyakān ।

moṭakāni ca piṇḍāni śmaśānaṃ śavasaṃyutam ।। 1 17।।
raktavastraṃ śuklavastraṃ dadarśa cārjuno niśi ।
kṛṣṇāmbarā kṛṣṇavarṇā vivastrā muktamūrdhajā ।। 1 18।।
vidhavā''śliṣyati svaṃ tat svapne'rjuno dadarśa ha ।

nakhairvidāritaṃ vakṣaḥ svapne'rjuno dadarśa ha ।

cakraṃ bhramantaṃ bhūmau ca kulālasya dadarśa saḥ ।

pūrṇamānaṃ kabandhaṃ ca svapne'rjuno dadarśa ha ।

atīva ghoradaśanān bhūtapretān bhayaṃkarān ।
