kṣuvaँśca śayanād yātaḥ praskhalan svapativratām ।। 128।।
manoramāṃ niśi dṛṣṭaduṣṭasvapnātiduḥkhitām ।
satī sādhvī priyā nāthaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā pativratā ।। 1 29।।
siṣeve tvantimāṃ sevāṃ kroḍe kṛtvā patiṃ svakam ।
śataputrādhikaḥ premṇā satīnāṃ vai patiryataḥ ।। 1.457.13 0।।
kintu duṣṭāpaśakunairjñātvā bhāvivināśanam ।
patirme śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśena dvijena vai ।। 131 ।।
yoddhuṃ yāti ca vijñāya prāṇān sarvān niruddhya sā ।
ṣaṭacakrāṇi bhedayitvā brahmarandhraṃ jagāma sā ।। 1 32।।
tvaritaṃ divyarūpā sā satīlokaṃ tu prāg yayau ।
athā'rjuno yayau yoddhuṃ dadarśā'maṃgalāni saḥ ।। 133 ।।
satī divyaśarīreṇa svāminā saha saṅgaram ।
rathamāruhya pārśvasthā'dṛśyā sahacarī yayau ।। 1 34।।
dadarśa dvāri vidhavāṃ chinnanāsāṃ kurūpiṇīm ।
arjunaḥ kṛṣṇavastrāḍhyāṃ rudatīṃ muṇḍinīṃ khalām ।। 1 35।।
mukhaduṣṭāṃ yoniduṣṭāṃ vyādhiyuktāṃ ca kuṭṭinīm ।
patiputravihīnāṃ cā'parāṃ dadarśa puṃścalīm ।। 136 ।।
kuṃbhakāraṃ tailakāraṃ vyādhaṃ sarpopajīvinam ।
kucailamatirūkṣāṃgaṃ nagnaṃ kāṣāyavāsasam ।। 1 37।।
citādagdhaṃ śavaṃ bhasma nirvāṇāṃgāramityapi ।
vasāvikrayiṇaṃ cāpi kanyāvikrayiṇaṃ tathā ।। 1 38।।
sarpakṣataṃ naraṃ sarpaṃ godhāṃ ca śaśakaṃ viṣam ।
śrāddhapākaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ ca moṭakaṃ ca tilāṃstathā ।। 1 39।।
śūdrānnabhojakaṃ vipraṃ devalaṃ grāmayājakam ।
kuśaputtalikāṃ caiva śavadāhanakāriṇam ।। 1.457.140।।
śūnyakuṃbhaṃ bhagnakuṃbhaṃ tailaṃ lavaṇamasthi ca ।
kārpāsaṃ kacchapaṃ cūrṇaṃ kukkuraṃ śabdakāriṇam ।। 141 ।।
dakṣiṇe tu śṛgālaṃ ca kurvantaṃ bhairavaṃ ravam ।
kapardakaṃ ca kṣauraṃ ca chinnakeśaṃ nakhaṃ malam ।। 142।।
kalahaṃ ca vilāpaṃ ca tathā kleśakaraṃ janam ।
amaṃgalaṃ rudantaṃ ca rudantaṃ śokinaṃ janam ।। 143।।
mithyāsākṣyapradātāraṃ cauraṃ ca naraghātinam ।
puṃścalīpatiputrau ca puṃścalyodanabhakṣakam ।। 144।।
devatāguruviprāṇāṃ vastuvittāpahārakam ।
dattāpahāriṇaṃ dasyuṃ hiṃsakaṃ sūcakaṃ khalam ।। 145।।
pitṛmātṛviraktaṃ ca dvijā'śvatthavighātinam ।
satyaghnaṃ ca kṛtaghnaṃ ca kṣataṃ viśvāsaghātinam ।। 146।।
gurudevadvijānāṃ ca nindakaṃ svāgahīnakam ।
napuṃsakaṃ kuṣṭhinaṃ ca kāṇaṃ badhiramityapi ।। 147।।
pulkasa chinnaliṃgaṃ ca khalvāṭaṃ śmaśruhīnakam ।
surāmattaṃ surāṃ raṇḍāmuṣṭera mahiṣagardabha1 ।। 148।।
kṣiptaṃ vamantaṃ rudhiraṃ lūkaṃ kākaṃ dadarśa saḥ ।
mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ rūkṣiṇaṃ nṛkapālakam ।। 149।।
caṇḍavātaṃ raktavṛṣṭiṃ kuvādyaṃ vṛkṣapātanam ।
vṛkaṃ ca sūkara gṛdhraṃ śyenaṃ kaṃkaṃ ca bhallukam ।। 1.457.150 ।।
nigaḍaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca vāyasaṃ gandhakaṃ tathā ।
abhicāropajīvaṃ kuvaidya tuṣaṃ tathauṣadham ।। 151 ।।
raktapuṣpaṃ mṛtavārtā vipraśāpaṃ kṣuvaṃ tathā ।
yaṣṭimukuṭapatanaṃ kārtavīryo dadarśa ha ।। 152।।
vāmāṃgaspandanaṃ dehajāḍya rathāśvapaścanam ।
rathacakrakrūrarāvo hṛdi trāsaśca jajñire ।। 153।।
tathāpi rājā niḥśaṃkaḥ praviveśa raṇājiram ।
praṇamya paraśurāmaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam ।। 154।।
raṇatūryāṇyavādyanta sannāho'bhūcca sainyayoḥ ।
parśurāmo'rjunamāha nyāyyaṃ yat sarvaśpṛṇvatām ।। 155।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāmadhenuharaṇamiṣegā jamadagnināśaḥ, reṇukāyāḥ satītvaṃ, parśurāmasya śakarāt śrīkṛṣṇamantrakavacastotralābhaḥ, svapne jāgaraṇe parśurāmasya śakunāni, sahasrārjunasyā'paśakunāni, pativratāyāḥ manoramāyāḥ pātivratyena satītvaṃ, raṇāgamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptapañcāśadadhikacatuśśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।457।।


← adhyāyaḥ 457 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 458
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 459 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mādhavāṃśaḥ parśurāma uvāca tam ।
kārtavīrya raṇamadhye dharmabhṛtaṃ vaco yathā ।। 1 ।।
śṛṇu rājendra! dharmiṣṭha candravaṃśasamudbhava ।
viṣṇoraṃśasya śiṣyastvaṃ dattātreyasya dhīmataḥ ।। 2 ।।
kathe durbuddhimāptastvamahano vṛddhabhūsuram ।
brāhmaṇī śokasantaptā bhartrā sārdhe gatā satī ।। 3 ।।
kiṃ bhaviṣyati te bhūpa paratraivā'nayorvadhāt ।
kva gatā kapilā sā te kīdṛk kūlaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 4 ।।
yat kṛtaṃ tu tvayā rājan hāliko na kariṣyati ।
satkīrtiścātha duṣkīrtiḥ kathāmātrā'vaśeṣitā ।। 5 ।।
tvayā kṛto ghoratarastvanyāyastatphalaṃ labha ।
uttaraṃ dehi rājendra samāje raṇamūrdhani ।। 6 ।।
kārtavīryā'rjunaḥ śrutvā pravaktumupacakrame ।
śṛṇu rāma hareraṃśastvamapyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 7 ।।
sadbuddhyā karmaṇā brahmabhāvanāṃ karoti yaḥ ।
svadharmanirataḥ śuddho brāhmaṇaḥ sa prakīrtyate ।। 8 ।।
antarbahiśca mananāt kurute phaladāṃ kriyām ।
maunī śaśvad vadet kāle hitakṛnmunirucyate ।। 9 ।।
svarṇe loṣṭe gṛhe'raṇye paṃke susnigdhacandane ।
rāmavṛttiḥ samabhāvo yogī yathārtha ucyate ।। 1.458.1 0।।
sarvajīveṣu yo viṣṇuṃ bhāvayet samatādhiyā ।
harau karoti bhaktiṃ ca haribhaktaḥ sa ucyate ।। 11 ।।
tapodhanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ munīnāṃ yogināṃ tathā ।
haribhaktasya viprasya tapasyāḥ kāmadhenavaḥ ।। 1 2।।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ sadaiśvarye spṛhā ratneṣu sarvadā ।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu tapasi spṛhā'tīvā'praśaṃsitā ।। 13 ।।
brāhmaṇānāṃ vivāde ca spṛhā'tīva vininditā ।
rāgī rājasikaṃ kāryaṃ kurute karmarāgataḥ ।। 14।।
rāgāndho yo rājasikastena rājā prakīrtyate ।
rāgataḥ kāmadhenustu mayā vai yācitā mune ।। 15।।
tava pitrā tu sainyāni kṛtānyayaṃ vyatikramaḥ ।
kṛta eva vada vipra ko doṣo rāgiṇo'tra me ।। 16 ।।
triṃśadakṣauhiṇīsenā hatyā nāśayituṃ ca mām ।
udyatasya tu hanane na doṣo hyātatāyinaḥ ।। 17।।
tvaṃ cāpi tāpaso bhūtvā vipradharmavivarjitām ।
pratijñāṃ kṛtavān so'yamanyāyaḥ kiṃ na me vada ।। 18।।
pitrordvayoḥ kṛte tvaṃ tu kartuṃ pṛthvīṃ niḥkṣatriyām ।
triḥsaptakṛtvo yattat kiṃ nyāyyaṃ vada bhūsuraḥ ।। 1 9।।
iti śrutvā garvavākyaṃ parśurāmā'tiruḍbharaḥ ।
kṣaṇāt ṭaṃkārayitvā svaṃ dhanurmumoca sāyakān ।। 1.458.20।।
bāṇaughaiśchādayāmāsā'rjunaṃ rathaṃ tathā'mbaram ।
manoramā sthitā divyā rathe pativratā satī ।।2 1 ।।
mahālakṣmīyutā devī rarakṣa svapatiṃ tadā ।
tāvad rājā'pi bāṇaughāँściccheda nijasāyakaiḥ ।।22।।
rāmasya bhrātaraḥ sarve catvāro'nye praśiṣyakāḥ ।
nijaghnurarjunasainyaṃ tīkṣṇaśastrā'sipāṇayaḥ ।।23 ।।
śarajālena rājendro vārayāmāsa tānapi ।
cicchiduḥ śarajālaṃ ca jamadagnisutāstadā ।।24।।
rājā cikṣepa divyāstraṃ munayaścicchidustu tat ।
divyāstreṇaiva munayaścicchiduḥ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।।25।।
rathaṃ ca sārathiṃ caiva rājñaḥ sannāhamityapi ।
manoramā divyarūpā rarakṣa svapatiṃ satī ।।26।।
nyastraśastraṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā munayo harṣavihvalāḥ ।
jagṛhuḥ śūlinaḥ śūlaṃ matsyarājajighāṃsayā ।।27।।
śūlanikṣepasamaye vāgbabhūvā'śarīriṇī ।
śūlaṃ tyajata viprendrā śivasyā'vyarthameva tat ।।28।।
śivasya kavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvāvayavarakṣakam ।
matsyarājagale'styetat kavacaṃ yācata nṛpam ।।29।।
śrutvā rāmo yatirbhūtvā yayāce kavacaṃ nṛpam ।
rājā dadau tu kavacaṃ brahmāṇḍavijaye tataḥ ।।।1.458.3 0।।
rāmo jaghāna śūlena mūrchāṃ jagāma cārjunaḥ ।
manoramā satī satyavratena yogasiddhibhiḥ ।।।3 1 ।।
svasvāmihastadā prāṇān mūrghni rarakṣa bhāminī ।
sā tadā''kāśavat sādhvī samuvāca nṛpān satī ।।।32।।
bṛhadbalaṃ somadattaṃ vidarbhaṃ mithileśvaram ।
niṣadhādhipatiṃ cāpi magadhādhipatiṃ tathā ।।33।।
praśṛṇvantu prāṇatulyāḥ prāṇasya me'vanaṃ tvaham ।
karomi yātu bhavanto raṇaṃ kurvantu colbaṇam ।।34।।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ raṇo dharmo raṇe mṛtyurna garhitaḥ ।
raṇe svāhā brāhmaṇānāṃ loke vede viḍambanā ।।35।।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ śastraṃ vyāpārastu balaṃ viśām ।
bhikṣābalaṃ bhikṣukāṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sevanaṃ balam ।।36।।
bhaktirdāsyaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe bhaktabalaṃ hariḥ ।
tapo balaṃ tāpasānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ balam ।।37।।
balaṃ veṣastu nārīṇāṃ yauvanaṃ gṛhayoṣitām ।
balaṃ sainyaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vai vālānāṃ rodanaṃ balam ।।38।।
satāṃ satyaṃ balaṃ bhaktiḥ sādhūnāṃ tu balaṃ kṣamā ।
mithyā balaṃ cā'satāṃ tu dhairyaṃ sāhasināṃ balam ।।39।।
vidyā balaṃ paṇḍitānāṃ dhanaṃ tu dhanināṃ balam ।
balaṃ vivekaḥ śreṣṭhānāṃ prajānāṃ balamekatā ।।1.458.40।।
guṇo balaṃ tu guṇināṃ satīnāṃ patisevanam ।
pūjā devabalaṃ proktaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ gurusevanam ।।41 ।।
balaṃ patnī gṛhasthānāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ svāmitoṣaṇam ।
tyāgināṃ nispṛhatvaṃ tu balaṃ brahmavrataṃ mahat ।।42।।
puṇyaṃ balaṃ sukṛtīnāṃ jalajānāṃ jalaṃ balam ।
śāntirbalaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ balam ।।43।।
sasainyāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve yuddhaṃ kurvantu bhūsuraiḥ ।
ityuktvā sā satī manoramā'rjunaṃ vimūrchitam ।।44।।
paricacāra vividhairupacāraiḥ suśaktidaiḥ ।
yadyahaṃ prāṇanāthasya pativratā'smi sarvathā ।।45।।
prāpnotu cetanāṃ svāmī samuvāca pativratā ।
tāvat sa cetanāṃ prāptaḥ samutthito raṇāya ca ।।46।।
atha rāmastriśūlena somadattaṃ jaghāna ha ।
bṛhadbālaṃ tu gadayā vidarbhaṃ tomareṇa ca ।।47।।
maithilāṃ mudgareṇāpi śaktyā tu naiṣadhaṃ tathā ।
māgadhaṃ tīkṣṇanārācairastrajālaiśca sainyakān ।।48।।
nihatya nikhilān bhūpān dudrāva cā'rjunaṃ prati ।
tāvat satī samīpasthā manoramā vyavasthitā ।।49।।
rāmarāmā'dhamavipra bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi ।
yadi tvanyāyamālambya mannāthaṃ mārayiṣyasi ।।1.458.50 ।।
śrutvā satīṃ puro dṛṣṭvā bhayād rāmo nyavartata ।
kānyakubjāḥ śataśastu saurāṣṭrāḥ śataśastathā ।।51 ।।
rāṣṭrīyāḥ śataśaścāpi mahārāṣṭrāśca vaṃgajāḥ ।
gaurjarāśca kaliṃgāśca rāmeṇa vyasavaḥ kṛtāḥ ।।52।।
dvādaśākṣauhiṇīḥ rāmo jaghāna tridivāniśam ।
tāvadrājā kārtavīryaḥ śrīlakṣmīkavacaṃ kare ।।53।।
baddhvā śastrāstrasampanno rathamāruhya cāyayau ।
yuyudhe vividhairastrairjaghāna brāhmaṇān bahūn ।।54।।।
parśurāmaḥ saparaśurdadhāva kālarūpadhṛk ।
śiro nikṛntituṃ tāvad viṣṇurviprasvarūpadhṛk ।।55।।
mā yāhīti karaṃ dhṛtvā rurodha prāha tatkṣaṇam ।
kavacaṃ śrīmahālakṣmyā bāhau tena dhṛtaṃ yataḥ ।।56।।
na mariṣyati bhūpālo yayāce taṃ sthiro bhava ।
viṣṇurviprasvarūpastad yācituṃ nṛpamāyayau ।।57।।
vipro bhūtvā ca kavacaṃ yayāce bhagavān svayam ।
manoramā tadā trāsaprāpede patipakṣiṇī ।।58।।
arjuno ditsati tāvanmanoramā nyavārayat ।
rājan lakṣmīkavacaṃ te bāhau yāvaddhi vartate ।।।59।।
tāvallakṣmīsvarūpā'haṃ śaknomi tvāṃ prarakṣitum ।
mā dehīti muhuḥ proktastathāpi pradadau nṛpaḥ ।।1.458.60।।
kṣaṇaṃ manoramālakṣmīḥ patiṃ natvā ruroda vai ।
athā'śaktā kavacena samaṃ yātuṃ ca tatparā ।।6 1 ।।
abhūd viṣṇuparīkṣāṃ ca karoti sma tadā satī ।
viṣṇuḥ kavacamādāya rāmaṃ prati samāyayau ।।62।।
dadau samantraṃ paraśurāmāya tacchṛṇu priye ।
oṃ śrīkamalavāsinyai svāhā mantraṃ dadau tataḥ ।।6 3 ।।
prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiryasya chandaśca bṛhatī tathā ।
devī padmālayā yasya caturvargaṃ niyojanam ।।64।।
oṃ śrīkamalavāsinyai svāhā me pātu mastakam ।
oṃ śrī kapālaṃ me pātu locane śrīṃśriyai namaḥ ।।65।।
o śrīṃśriyai svāheti vai karṇayugmaṃ sadā'vatu ।
oṃśrīṃklīṃ mahālakṣmyai svāhā me pātu nāsikām ।।66।।
oṃ śrīṃ padmālayāyai ca svāhā dantān sadā'vatu ।
auśrīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāyai ca dantarandhrān sadā'vatu ।।67।।
oṃ śrīnārāyaṇeśāyai mama kaṇṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।
oṃśrīṃ keśavakāntāyai mama skandhaṃ sadā'vatu ।।68।।
oṃśrīṃ padmanivāsinyai svāhā nābhiṃ sadā'vatu ।
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ saṃsāramātre mama vakṣaḥ sadā'vatu ।।69।।
oṃśrīṃmo kṛṣṇakāntāyai svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadā'vatu ।
oṃhrīṃśrīṃśriyai svāhā ca mama hasto sadā'vatu ।।1.458.70।।
oṃśrīnivāsakāntāyai mama pādau sadā'vatu ।
oṃśrīṃhrīṃklīṃ śriyai svāhā sarvāṃgaṃ me sadā'vatu ।।71 ।।
prācyāṃ pātu mahālakṣmīrāgneyyāṃ kamalālayā ।
padmā māṃ dakṣiṇe pātu nairṛtyāṃ śrīharipriyā ।।72।।
padmālayā paścime māṃ vāyavyāṃ pātu mā svayam ।
uttare kamalā pātu caiśānyāṃ sindhukanyakā ।।73।।
nārāyaṇī ca pātūrdhvamadho viṣṇupriyā'vatu ।
santataṃ sarvataḥ pātu viṣṇuprāṇādhikā mama ।।74।।
itisarvaiśvaryapradaṃ varma bāhau sudhāraya ।
devendraiścāsurendraiścā'vadhyo bhavasi niścitam ।।75।।
ityuktvā kavacaṃ datvā yayau vaikuṇṭhamacyutaḥ ।
tāvanmanoramā lakṣmīkalā'rjunaṃ vihāya vai ।।76।।
yayau tu viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ viṣṇunā hṛtā ।
arjunaḥ prāha re patni tyaktvā māṃ yāhi mā priye ।।77।।
manoramā tu taṃ prāha sambandhaḥ sāntatāṃ gataḥ ।
paraśurāmaśastreṇa hato māmanuyāsyasi ।।78।।
śīghraṃ brāhmaṇahastena hataḥ prāpsyasi mokṣaṇam ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvatkṛte rājan niścitaṃ yatra me sthitiḥ ।।79।।
ityuktvā sā yayau devī rājā yuyodha dāruṇam ।
dvilakṣasainyaṃ yuyudhe brāhmaṇaiḥ saha padmaje ।।1.458.80।।
rājā cikṣepa śastrāṇi rāmaśiṣyāḥ palāyitāḥ ।
cikṣepa rāmastvāgneyaṃ babhūvā'gnimayaṃ raṇe ।।81 ।।
nirvāpayāmāsa rājā vāruṇena mahaujasā ।
cikṣepa rāmo gāndharvaṃ śailasarpādikoṭikam ।।82।।
vāyavenārjunastadvai vārayāmāsa dāruṇam ।
cikṣepa rāmo nāgāstraṃ rājā cikṣepa gāruḍam ।।83।।
rāmaścikṣepa māheśaṃ rājā cikṣepa vaiṣṇavam ।
brahmāstraṃ cikṣipe rāmo rājā brahmāstramākṣipat ।।84।।
tāvat dhyāto'rjunagururdattātreyaḥ samāgataḥ ।
dadau śūlaṃ hi rāmasya nāśārthaṃ kṛṣṇavarma ca ।।85।।
jagrāha rājā śūlaṃ taścikṣepa rāmakandhare ।
mūrchāmavāpa rāmaḥ saḥ papāta śrīhariṃ smaran ।।86।।
brāhmaṇaṃ jīvayāmāsa śaṃbhurnārāyaṇājñayā ।
cetanāṃ prāpya ca rāmo'grahīt pāśupataṃ yadā ।।87।।
dattātreyeṇa dattena siddhā'streṇā'rjunastu tam ।
jaḍīcakāra tatraiva stambhito rāma eva vai ।।88।।
śrīkṛṣṇarakṣitaṃ bhūpaṃ dadarśa kṛṣṇavarma ca ।
dadarśā'pi bhramatsudarśanaṃ rakṣākaraṃ ripoḥ ।।89।।
etasminnantare tatra vāgbabhūvā'śarīriṇī ।
kṛṣṇasya kavacaṃ rājño bāhāvasti taduttamam ।।1.458.90।।
rakṣati tannṛpaṃ śaṃbhuryācatu bhikṣayā tu tat ।
tadā hantuṃ nṛpaṃ śakto bhārgavo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।91 ।।
atha śaṃbhuḥ siddhamantrairdatvā cetanameva tu ।
apohya staṃbhanaṃ rāmo jagrāha paraśuṃ svakam ।।92।।
pāśupataṃ kare dhṛtvā paraśuṃ ca tathā kare ।
sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tāvat sa āyayau ।।93।।
śaṃbhurvipraḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā yayāce'rjunameva tat ।
kavacaṃ nṛpasaṃdattaṃ rāmāya śaṃbhurārpayat ।।94।।
sudarśanaṃ ca kavacaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastrayaḥ ।
rāmapārśve samāgatya prāhurjeṣyasi sāmpratam ।।95।।
śaṃbhoḥ pāśupataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ harereva sudarśanam ।
ete pradhāne sarveṣāmastrāṇāṃ tu jagattraye ।।96 ।।
kavacaṃ rakṣakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhārayitvā''ha taṃ dvijaḥ ।
rājan kuru raṇaṃ śīghraṃ kālabhede jayā'jayau ।।97।।
tvayā'dhītaṃ bahudattaṃ śāsitā ca vasundharā ।
saṃgrāme'haṃ tvayā jaḍīkṛto'traiva sumūrchitaḥ ।।98।।
jitāḥ sarve'pi bhūpālā rāvaṇo līlayā jitaḥ ।
jito'haṃ dattaśūlena śaṃbhunā jīvito'smyaham ।।99।।
śīghraṃ kuru kṣaṇaste'yaṃ śrutvaivaṃ pratyuvāca saḥ ।
aho rāma kimadhītaṃ ki dattaṃ kā ca śāsitā ।। 1.458.1 00।।
gatāḥ katividhā bhūpā macchreṣṭhāḥ kālabhakṣitāḥ ।
buddhistejo vikramaśca jayaśca vijayastathā ।।1 01।
śrīraiśvaryaṃ matirdānaṃ pratiṣṭhā paramaṃ tapaḥ ।
vidyā garvastathā mānyaṃ sārvabhaumatvamityapi ।। 1 02।।
sarvaṃ manoramāsaṃge gatameva mama kṣaṇāt ।
sā ca lakṣmī kalā sādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।। 1 03।।
mṛtā yāvad rakṣikā me tayā sārdhaṃ gataṃ mama ।
tvaṃ kiṃ vipra prathamaṃ vai yuddhaṃ paśyasi kevalam ।। 1 04।।
mama yuddhāni pūrvāṇi nekṣitānīti śocanā ।
prathamā'tha dvitīyā'pi maraṇaṃ brāhmaṇena me ।। 1 05।।
vṛddhadampatīnāśena śocanā cātiniṣṭhurā ।
kāle siṃhaḥ śṛgālaṃ ca sṛgālaḥ siṃhameva vā ।। 1 06।।
kāle vyāghraṃ hanti mṛgo gajendraṃ hariṇastathā ।
mahiṣaṃ makṣikā kāle garuḍaṃ ca tathoragaḥ ।। 1 07।।
nṛpaśca kiṃkaraṃ stauti mahendro mānavaṃ tathā ।
sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ vipra kālo hi duratikramaḥ ।। 1 08।।
brāhmaṇasya ca hananaṃ sarvaṃ nāśakaraṃ mama ।
pativratāyā maraṇaṃ brāhmaṇīnāśakṛtphalam ।। 1 09।।
pativratāyā maraṇe mṛto'haṃ sarvathā dvija ।
lakṣmīrūpā mṛtā prāgvai saṃketo'cyutakṛddhi saḥ ।। 1.458.110 ।।
yāce tvāṃ ca tathā devān gurūn sarvāṃśca bhāvataḥ ।
kṣamadhvaṃ cāparādhānye mā bhūnme nārakaṃ puraḥ ।। 111 ।।
ityuktvā ca dhanuṣṭaṃkārayitvā sāyakān muhuḥ ।
kālakāla iva bhūtvā vavarṣa lakṣaśo bahūn ।। 11 2।।
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇavadan rājā manorameti saṃvadan ।
ardhacandrāँstathā śaktīrbhallān khaḍgān sahasraśaḥ ।। 113।
cikṣepa dhanuṣā tatra brāhmaṇeṣvāyuṣaḥkṣaye ।
rāmo rūpadvayaṃ kṛtvā yuyudhe tena bhūbhṛtā ।। 1 14।।
kṛtrimeṇa tu rūpeṇa dhṛtvā kuṭhārakaṃ kare ।
dadhāva taṃ puro gatvā ciccheda bhujamaṇḍalam ।। 1 15।।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa jagrāhā'straṃ maholbaṇam ।
pāśupataṃ samantraṃ ca cikṣepa līlayā nṛpe ।। 1 16।।
hāhākāro mahānāsīt kārtavīryārjuno hataḥ ।
anye ye jīvasaṃgrāhāste'pa viprairhatā raṇe ।। 1 17।।
vidudruvustathā cānye svasvarājyāni cakrire ।
māhiṣmatīṃ tadā rāmo dadau viprāya dakṣiṇām ।। 1 18।।
anyeṣāṃ cāpi rājyāni dadau viprāya dakṣiṇāḥ ।
devāśca munayo devyaḥ siddhagandharvakinnarāḥ ।। 11 9।।
sarve cakruḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ rāmamūrdhni ca padmaje ।
svarge dundubhayo nedurharṣaśabdo babhūva ha ।।1.458.1 20।।
evaṃ triḥsaptakṛtvaśca cakre pṛthvīṃ niḥkṣatriyām ।
yaśasā cāpi paraśurāmasyā''pūritaṃ jagat ।। 121 ।।
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau rāmo rājyāni virarāma ca ।
hatāstu kṣatriyāḥ sarve garbhasthā bālakāstathā ।। 1 22।।
yuvāno jaraṭhā vṛddhāḥ stanaṃdhayā api priye ।
kāścana kṣatriyanāryaḥ pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ ।। 123 ।।
devyo divyagatikāśca guptā yayurhimālayam ।
kandarāsu vasantyaśca pupuṣurbālakān svakān ।। 1 24।।
tadvaṃśāḥ kṣatriyā jātāḥ punā rājyāni cakrire ।
parśurāmaḥ pratijñāṃ svāṃ pūrayitvā kurusthale ।। 1 25।।
syamantapañcakān kuṇḍān kṣatriyarudhirā'ñcitān ।
kṛtvā raktaiḥ piturmāturbrāhmaṇānāṃ jalāṃjalīn ।। 126 ।।
śrāddhaṃ dadau tadā tṛptiṃ cakāra pitṛdevatāḥ ।
tato jalaṃ tathā'nnaṃ ca bubhuje śāntitaḥ svayam ।। 1 27।।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ vināśe tu nirbalā ye hyasupriyāḥ ।
mṛṣā vadanto jīvānāṃ cakrurvai rakṣaṇaṃ tu te ।। 1 28।।
anyā anyā jātayaśca jātā varṇā vibhinnakāḥ ।
akṣātrāste kṣātrakarmahīnā dasyava eva vai ।। 1 29।।
vyāpārakārakāścānye dāsyakṛṣyādikārakāḥ ।
vartante sma bhuvi lakṣmi! guptakṣatriyajātayaḥ ।। 1.458.13 0।।
atha pratijñāṃ sampūrṇāṃ kṛtvā rāmo yayau gurum ।
śivaṃ pūjayituṃ divye kailāse tatra gopure ।। 131 ।।
gaṇeśena niruddhaḥ saḥ krudhā gaṇapatiṃ tadā ।
rāmo jaghāna dante taṃ parśunā tu gaṇādhipam ।। 13 2।।
danto bhagnastataścaikadanto gaṇeśa ucyate ।
āmūlād bhagnadantena kṛtvā śūṇḍhaṃ sudīrghakam ।। 1 33।।
gaṇeśena dhṛtaḥ śūṇḍhe śūṇḍhaśca vardhito bahuḥ ।
trailokye bhrāmayitvā taṃ rāmaṃ cikṣepa vāridhau ।। 1 34।।
jaḍībhūtaṃ punardhṛtvā goloke vinipātitaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃbhoje pātakānāṃ viśuddhaye ।। 1 35।।
tataḥ śuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ rāmamutthāpya śrīgaṇeśvaraḥ ।
cikṣepa paraśurāmaṃ śaṃkarasya hi sannidhau ।। 1 36।।
dadarśa śaṃkaraṃ prāpyā''śīrvādaṃ cāpyanugraham ।
śaṃkarasya śivāyāśca prasādya śrīgaṇeśvaram ।। 1 37।।
cakre stutiṃ śivaṃ śivāṃ taṃ tu śivā''ha maṃgalam ।
amaro bhava he putra! vatsa susthiratāṃ vraja ।। 1 38।।
sarvaprasādāt sarvatra jayo'stu tava santatam ।
sarvāntarātmā bhagavāँstuṣṭaḥ syāt santataṃ hariḥ ।। 1 39।।
bhaktirbhavatu te kṛṣṇe śivade ca śive gurau ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā śiṣya ciraṃjīvo bhava dhruvaḥ ।। 1.458.140 ।।
tataḥ paraśurāmo'sau jagāma tapase bhuvam ।
mahendraparvate sthitvā tapaḥ karoti śāśvatam ।। 141 ।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! kārtavīryasya nāśanam ।
manoramāyāḥ kathitaṃ pativratabalaṃ tathā ।। 142।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya patisevābalaṃ labhet ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ kṛṣṇasevāṃ labhet kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ ।। 143 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parśurāmeṇa saha yuddhe manoramayā divyayā pativratayā sahasrārjuno rakṣitaḥ, lakṣmīkavacaviyoge manoramāviyogastato'rjunasya maraṇaṃ, gaṇeśasyaikadantatvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭapaṃcāśadadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 458 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 459
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 460 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
indralokātpare tvarciṣmatīnāmnī śubhā purī ।
vītihotrasya nagarī svargottame'sti padmaje ।। 1 ।।
jātavedasi yā bhaktāstā vasantyatra suvratāḥ ।
agnipraveśaṃ yāḥ kuryurdṛḍhasattvā jitendriyāḥ ।। 2 ।।
vahnisnānā narā nāryaḥ sarvāstā vahnibhāsurāḥ ।
agnihotraratā viprāstathā'gnibrahmacāriṇaḥ ।। 3 ।।
pañcāgnivratino bhaktā brāhmaṇāścāgnipūjakāḥ ।
samididhmāgniṣṭikānāṃ dātāro vahnirūpiṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
yajñasya kāriṇo vahnerarciṣmatyāṃ vasanti vai ।
dhūpapradīpanaivedyapayodadhighṛtaikṣavam ।। 5 ।।
vahnibhuktaṃ niṣevante sarvavidhā divaukasaḥ ।
viśvānarasya viprasya narmadātaṭavāsinaḥ ।। 6 ।।
narmapurādhidevasya brahmayajñaratasya ca ।
brahmatejasaḥ śāṇḍilyagotrasyā'bhūt sucintanam ।। 7 ।।
caturṇṇāmapyāśrayāṇāṃ ko'tīva śreyase satām ।
iti vicārya gārhasthyaṃ viśvānaraḥ śaśaṃsa ha ।। 8 ।।
sarvādhāro gṛhastho vai dehibhirupajīvyate ।
paradāraparityāgāt svadāraparituṣṭitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
ṛtukālābhigāmitvād brahmacārī gṛhī sadā ।
evaṃ niścitya sa viśvānaro vipraḥ pativratām ।। 1.459.10 ।।
uduvāhavidhānena svocitāṃ kulakanyakām ।
agniśuśrūṣaṇarataḥ pañcayajñaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 11 ।।
devapitratithyanāthagavādiparipūjakaḥ ।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya kālo bahutitho gataḥ ।। 1 2।।
bhāryā śuciṣmatī nāma suvratā svāmisevikā ।
apaśyantyaṃkuramapi santateḥ svargasādhanam ।। 13 ।।
patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ viṣṇuṃ matvovāca pativratā ।
bhagavan durlabhaṃ nāsti kiñcittava dayālavāt ।। 14।।
maheśasadṛśaṃ putraṃ dehi vaṃśavivardhanam ।
śrutvā provāca tāṃ patnīmekapatnīvrate sthitaḥ ।। 1 5।।
tathāstviti tato vipro jagāma tapase drutam ।
prāpya vārāṇasīṃ snātvā gaṃgāyāṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaram ।। 16 ।।
yatra niścalatāmeti tapastanayakāmyayā ।
tatra vīreśvarabhūmau gatvā jagrāha sadvratam ।। 1 7।।
ekāhāro'bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ naktāśano'bhavat ।
ayācitā'śano māsaṃ māsaṃ tyaktāśanastathā ।। 18।।
payovrato'bhavanmāsaṃ māsaṃ śākaphalāśanaḥ ।
māsaṃ muṣṭitilāhāro māsaṃ pānīyabhojanaḥ ।। 1 9।।
pañcagavyāśano māsaṃ māsaṃ cāndrāyaṇavratī ।
māsaṃ kuśāgrajalabhuk māsaṃ śvasanabhakṣaṇaḥ ।। 1.459.20 ।।
atha trayodaśe māse snātvā gaṃgājale dvijaḥ ।
pratyūṣa eva vīreśaṃ yāvadāyāti bhūsuraḥ ।। 21 ।।
tāvalliṃgāntare bālaṃ dadarśā'ṣṭasamaṃ śubham ।
piṃgajaṭaṃ dīrghanetraṃ śvetaṃ vibhūtibhūṣitam ।।22।।
tamālokya stutiṃ cakre viśvānaro'timodavān ।
ekamevā'dvitīyaṃ yat paraṃbrahma parātparam ।। 23 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasaṃjñaṃ śivadaṃ śiva te namaḥ ।
kartṛ poṣṭṛ ca saṃhartṛ tejo vividhatāṃ gatam ।। 24।।
yanmūrterekabhāgasthamaiśvaryaṃ jvalanādikam ।
saurabhyādi yato bhūmau tasmai bālāya te namaḥ । ।25। ।
yad gṛhītṛ gantṛ draṣṭṛ dhātṛ niyantṛ cāntaram ।
sarvakāmapradātṛ tat tasmai bālāya te namaḥ । । 26 । ।
stutveti pādayostasya viśvānaraḥ papāta ha ।
bālo varaṃ vṛṇīhīti provāca hasitānanaḥ ।। 27। ।
viśvānaraḥ pratyuvāca bhavān sarvaprado yataḥ ।
putraṃ dehi tvādṛśaṃ te praṇato'smi punaḥ punaḥ । । 28 ।।
bālaḥ prāha tathāstvityacireṇa te manorathaḥ ।
śuciṣmatyāmahaṃ putro bhaviṣyāmi phaliṣyati ।। 2 9।।
khyāto gṛhapatirnāmnā śuciḥ sarvāmarapriyaḥ ।
tava putro bhaviṣyāmītyuktvā cāntaradhīyata ।। 1.459.30 ।।
viśvānarastatastūrṇamājagāma nijaṃ gṛham ।
śuciṣmatyai jagādaitat svalpakālena bhāminī ।। 31 ।।
garbhaṃ dadhāra suṣuve kālena putrameva sā ।
garbhādhānādayaḥ sarve saṃskārā guruṇā kṛtāḥ ।। 3 2।।
putrajanmani devādyā vavṛṣuḥ kusumādikān ।
devadundubhayo neduḥ protsavo hyabhavanmahān ।। 33 ।।
apsarasāṃ sunṛtyāni tvabhavan vipramandire ।
vidyādharyaśca kinnaryastathā'maryaḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 34।।
gandharvoragavṛkṣāṇāṃ suvāsinyaśca kanyakāḥ ।
maṇiratnopadā nītvā saśṛṃgārasuśobhanāḥ । 3 5।।
savādyā maṃgalavastusahitāścandrasatprabhāḥ ।
gāyanto lalitaṃ gītaṃ jagmurviśvānaragṛham ।। 36 ।।
marīcādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca śataśo'pi tu tadgṛham ।
lokapālā munayaśca samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 37।।
viṣṇvādyāśca surāḥ sarve nāgāśca mānavādayaḥ ।
tīrthakṣetrāṇi sarvāṇi cājagmuḥ pitarastathā ।। 38 ।।
sthāvarā jaṃgamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā''yātāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।
jātakarma svayaṃ cakre tasya devaḥ pitāmahaḥ ।। 39 ।।
śrutiṃ vicārya tadrūpāṃ nāmnā gṛhapatistvayam ।
iti nāma dadau tasmai deyamekādaśe'hani ।।1.459.40 ।।
gṛhapatirgārhapatyaḥ prajāyā vasuvittamaḥ ।
agne gṛhapate āyacchasvā'nnaṃ me yaśo balam ।।4 1 ।।
ajo nāma itikṛtvā stutvā satyaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
devādyāstu yayuḥ sarve śaṃsantaḥ putramujvalam ।।42 ।।
ataḥ putraṃ samīhante gṛhasthāśramavāsinaḥ ।
putreṇa lokān jayati bhaktenāpi viśeṣataḥ ।।43 ।।
aputrasya gṛhaṃ śūnyamaputrasyā'rjanaṃ vṛthā ।
aputrasyā'nvayaśchinno nā'pavitraṃ hyaputrataḥ ।।44। ।
na putrātparamo lābho na putrātparamaṃ sukham ।
na putrātparamaṃ mitraṃ paratreha ca kutracit ।।45।।
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaḥ krīto dattaḥ prāptaḥ sutāsutaḥ ।
āpatsu rakṣitaḥ śiṣyaḥ putrāste tvaṣṭadhā matāḥ ।।46 ।।
viśvānaraḥ sutaṃ tvadhyāpayāmāsa yathocitam ।
navame vatsare vaiśvānaraṃ jagāma nāradaḥ ।।87 ।।
papraccha kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ putrasya munirāḍ yathā ।
viśvānara mahābhāga śuciṣmati śubhavrate ।। 48।।
kurute yuvayorvākyaṃ kaccid gṛhapatiḥ śiśuḥ।
nānyattīrthaṃ na vā devo na gururna ca satkriyā ।।49
vihāya pitrorvacanaṃ nānyo dharmaḥ sutasya vai ।
garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ mātā piturgarīyasī ।।1.459.50
pitā vandyo yatirvandyaḥ sanyāsī vandya ityapi ।
taiḥ sarvaistu gururvandyasteṣāṃ vandyāḥ prasūḥ sadā ।।51
idameva tapo'tyugramidameva paraṃ vratam ।
ayameva paro dharmo yat pitroḥ paritoṣaṇam ।।52
pitṛvratamidaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣṇamiva prasevayet ।
mātṛvratamidaṃ proktaṃ lakṣmīmiva prasevayet ।।53
vaiśvānara samabhyehi mamotsaṃge niṣīda bho ।
lakṣaṇāni parīkṣe'haṃ pāṇiṃ darśaya dakṣiṇam ।।54।
ityuktaḥ sa gṛhapatirnāradāṃ'ke hyupāviśat ।
munirdṛṣṭvā bālakasya tālujihvādvijānatha ।।55।
ānīya kuṃkumā''raktaṃ sūtraṃ ca triguṇīkṛtam ।
mamau samastakād bālamāpādatalamucchrayam ।।56 ।
tiryagūrdhvaṃ samo māne yo'ṣṭottaraśatāṃgulaḥ ।
sa bhavet pṛthivīpālo yathā'yaṃ bālako'pi ca ।।57।
pañcasūkṣmaḥ pañcadīrghaḥ saptaraktaḥ ṣaḍunnataḥ ।
tripṛthu laghugambhīro dvātriṃśallakṣaṇo'styayam ।।58।।।
tvakkeśāṃgulidaśanaparvāṇyaṇūni pañca ca ।
santyasya khalu sūkṣmāṇi dikpālapadabhāg bhavet ।।5 9 ।
bhujau netre hanurjānū nāsā dīrghāṇi cāsya vai ।
tenāyaṃ tu bhaved dīrghāyuṣko brahmāṇḍasañcaraḥ ।।1.459.6 0 ।
pāṇyo stale ca netrānte tālujihvā'dharauṣṭhakam ।
saptā'ruṇaṃ ca sanakhamasya rājyasukhapradam ।।6 1 ।।
vakṣaḥkukṣyalakaṃ skandhaṃ karaṃ vaktraṃ ṣaḍunnatam ।
dṛśyate'sya bhaveccāyaṃ mahadaiśvaryabhāk khalu ।।6 2।।
lalāṭakaṭivakṣobhiḥ pṛthurayaṃ bhavennṛpaḥ ।
grīvājaṃghāmehanaiśca hrasvo'yaṃ bahubhogavān ।।6 3 ।।
svareṇa hṛdā nābhyā ca gambhīraḥ sukhabhāk sadā ।
kamaṭhīpṛṣṭhakaṭhinau patravatkomalau karau ।।6 4।।
rājyahetūśiśorasya pādau padmasukomalau ।
acchinnā tarjanīṃ vyāpya tathā rekhā'sya vartate ।।6 5 ।।
kaniṣṭhāpṛṣṭhaniryātā dīrghāyuṣyaṃ nivedayet ।
pādau sumāṃsalau raktau samau sūkṣmau suśobhanau ।।6 6 ।।
samagulphau svedahīnau snigdhāvaiśvaryasūcakau ।
svalpābhiḥ kararekhābhirāraktābhiḥ sadā sukhī ।।67।।
liṃgena kṛśahastena rājarājo bhaviṣyati ।
utkaṭāsanagulphasphignābhirasyāpi vartulā ।।68।।
dakṣiṇāvarttamaruṇaṃ mahadaiśvaryasūcikā ।
dhāraikā mūtrayatyasmin dakṣiṇāvartinīti sā ।।6 9।।
gandhaśca mīnamadhunorguptavīrye'sya vartate ।
vistīrṇau māṃsalau snigdhau sphicāvasya sukhocitau ।।1.459.70 ।।
vāmāvartau supralambau doṣau digrakṣaṇocitau ।
śrīvatsavajracakrā'bjamatsyakodaṇḍadaṇḍabhṛt ।।7 1 ।।
tathā'sya karagā rekhā yathā syāt tridivaspatiḥ ।
dvātriṃśaddaśanaścāyaṃ karakambuśirodharaḥ ।।71।।
krauṃcadundubhihaṃsā'bhrasvaraḥ sarveśvarā'dhikaḥ ।
madhupiṃgalanetro'sau nainaṃ śrīstyajati kvacit ।।।72।।
pañcarekhalalāṭastu tathā siṃhodaraḥ śubhaḥ ।
ūrdhvarekhāṃkitapado niḥśvasanpadmagandhavān ।।74।।
acchidrapāṇiḥ sunakho mahālakṣaṇavānayam ।
tathāpi dvādaśe varṣe pratyūho vidyudagnitaḥ ।।75।।
asya viśaṃke bhagavan rakṣaṇīyaḥ prayatnataḥ ।
ityuktvā'rcāṃ gṛhītvaiva nārado nirjagāma ha ।।76।।
dampatī kṣaṇamātraṃ tu śuśucaturmumudatuḥ ।
atha bālaścirāyuṣko bhavitu pitarau tadā ।।77।।
prāha pratijñāṃ śṛṇutaṃ yadi vāṃ tanayo hyaham ।
kariṣye'haṃ tapastādṛk vidyunmattastrasiṣyati ।।78।।
mṛtyuñjayaṃ kālakālaṃ samārādhayituṃ sutaḥ ।
pitroranurajñāṃ samprāpya yayau sa kāśikāṃ purīm ।।79 ।।
sasnau gaṃgājale śaṃbhuṃ dadarśa cānnapūrṇikām ।
matsyodaryāṃ kṣitau gatvā tasthau kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ param ।।1.459.80।।
nirvighne tu sthale sthāpya ligaṃ cakre tapaḥ sutaḥ ।
saṃsnāpya pratyahaṃ śaṃbhuṃ datvā nīlotpalāni vai ।।8 1 ।।
japati sma namaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśivāya te ।
tapaścacāra ṣaṇmāsaṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ ।।82।।
śīrṇaparṇāśanastadvat ṣaṇmāsāँstapa ācarat ।
ṣaṇmāsaṃ vāyubhakṣo'bhūt ṣaṇmāsaṃ jalabindubhuk ।।83 ।।
evaṃ varṣadvaye yāte janmato dvādaśe gate ।
vighnaṃ satyaṃ kariṣyan vai cābhyagāt kuliśāyudhaḥ ।।84।।
varaṃ brūhīti taṃ prāha sutaḥ śrutvā''ha vāsavam ।
nāhaṃ vṛṇe varaṃ tvattaḥ śaṃkaro varado'sti me ।।85।।
gacchā''halyāpate'sādho śratvā kruddhaḥ svavajrakam ।
cikṣepa yāvacchaṃbhustajjagrāha līlayā kare ।।86।।
pratyakṣaḥ śaṃkaro jāto mahendraśca yayau divam ।
śaṃbhustaṃ tu dadau ciraṃjīveti varamuttamam ।।87।।
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ mukhaṃ bhavā'gnirūpakaḥ ।
jāṭharo bhava bhūtānāṃ digīśo rājyamāpnuhi ।।88।।
malliṃgaṃ tvatsthāpitaṃ tad bhavatvagnīśvarābhidham ।
ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhurdatvā mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।।89।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
vaiśvānaro yayau svasya gṛhaṃ mātā pativratā ।।1.459.90।।
arciṣmatī sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumude janako'pi ca ।
utsavaṃ tu mudā cakre samāhūya surādikān ।।91 ।।
indraṃ tatra samāyātaṃ dṛṣṭvā cukrodha vahnirāṭ ।
punarvajraṃ pracikṣepa vaiśvānaroparīndrakaḥ ।।92।।
mūrchāṃ jagāma bālastanmātā svāṃke nidhāya tam ।
pātivratyaṃ bhavenme cedindraḥ patatu bhūtale ।।93।।
pativratā dṛḍhā syāṃ cedindravajraṃ nirarthakam ।
sarvathā sarvathā cāstu putro me cetano bhavet ।।94।।
evamukte tayā vajraṃ kṛṣṇakardamatāṃ gatam ।
indraḥ patito dharaṇau bubudhe tvaṃkajaḥ sutaḥ ।।95।।
hāhākāro mahān jātaḥ pātivratyabalena vai ।
mahendraprārthitā devī kṣamārthaṃ karuṇāparā ।।96 ।।
uvāca taṃ mahendraṃ sā samuttiṣṭha sthiro bhava ।
gṛhāṇa vajraṃ mā vahnau kadācit tvaṃ niyojaya ।।97।।
mātṛpitṛgurukṛṣṇadrohiṣu satīdrohiṣu ।
vajraṃ te preritaṃ vidyudrūpaṃ bhavatu madvarāt ।।98।।
kṛṣṇabhakteṣu pitrośca gurorbhakteṣu tāpase ।
satībhakteṣu te vajraṃ kardamatvamavāpnuhi ।।99।।
ityuktaḥ sa satīṃ natvā natvā vaiśvānaraṃ tathā ।
viśvānaraṃ punarnatvā yayau svargaṃ surā yayuḥ ।। 1.459.10 0।।
arciṣmatyāḥ prabhāveṇa pātivratyavṛṣasya ca ।
āsannamaraṇaścāpi rakṣitaḥ śaṃbhvanugrahāt ।। 101 ।।
yāvadbrahmā bhavettāvad vaiśvānaro bhaviṣyati ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vṛttaṃ bhuktisumuktidam ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvānaraviprasya putrasya gṛhapatyākhyasyatapasā cirajīvitvaṃ, mātuḥ pātivratyabalenendrakṛtavajradvārakamṛtyuvighnavināśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।459।।


← adhyāyaḥ 459 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 460
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 461 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! camatkāraṃ jñānodasya vadāmi te ।
anādisiddhe saṃsāre purā devayuge sati ।। 1 ।।
īśānākhyo diśāpālaścaran bhūmiṃ samāyayau ।
tadā saṃkalpamātreṇa satyadharmāḥ kṛte yuge ।। 2 ।।
na varṣanti yadābhrāṇi na prāvartanta nimnagāḥ ।
yadā jalābhilāṣā na snānapānādikarmasu ।। 3 ।।
pṛthivyāṃ munisañcāre vartamāne kvacit kvacit। ।
ānandakānanaṃ kṣetramūṣaraṃ praviveśa saḥ ।। 4 ।।
āluloke brahmatejomayaṃ liṃgaṃ yadakṣarāt ।
kiraṇākhyaṃ samāyātaṃ yadā viṣṇośca vedhasaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ahamahamiko bhāvaḥ śreṣṭhatvetvabhavattadā ।
īśānena tadā svalpamūṣare tvavalokitam ।। ।।
svarṇasamaṃ surūpaṃ projjvalaṃ divyaṃ sumohakam ।
īśānasyā'bhavadicchā snāpayāmi jalaistu tat ।। 7 ।।
cakhāna ca triśūlena dakṣiṇāśopakaṇṭhataḥ ।
kuṇḍe tatra jalaṃ divyaṃ tadā nārāyaṇāṃgajam ।। 8 ।।
jalāvaraṇasambaddhaṃ prāvirāsā'tipāvanam ।
tairjalaiḥ snāpayāñcakre liṃgaṃ suvarṇasadṛśam ।। 9 ।।
pīyūṣavat svādutarairaspṛṣṭairanyadehibhiḥ ।
adṛṣṭapūrvalokānāṃ manonayanahāribhiḥ ।। 1.460.1 0।।
sahasradhāraiḥ kalaśaiḥ sa īśāno digīśvaraḥ ।
sahasrakṛtvaḥ snapayāmāsa tuṣṭastato haraḥ ।। 11 ।।
proce vṛṇu varaṃ matto dadāmi te'tidurlabham ।
īśānaḥ prāha viśveśaṃ tvannāmnā tīrthamastviti ।। 12 ।।
viśveśvarastadā prāha tathāstviti sumūrtimān ।
bhūtvā liṃgasvarūpaḥ sa varivarti maheśvara. ।। 13 ।।
līnamarthaṃ gamayati liṃgaṃ jñānapradaṃ tu tat ।
raśmiṃ vinā tadādhāraṃ saṃbhavenna kadācana ।। 14।।
ādhārastu parabrahma bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।
tasya jñānapradaṃ cihnaṃ liṃgaṃ tat kiraṇaṃ matam ।। 15 ।।
tasya suvarṇarūpasya vāpī snānārthameva yā ।
jñānavāpī jñānajalaṃ jñānodaṃ tīrthameva tat ।। 16 ।।
jñānaṃ dravasvarūpaṃ ca jñānodaṃ śaṃkarālayam ।
asya sparśanapānācamanasnānokṣaṇādibhiḥ ।। 1 7।।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pitṛtṛptiṃ yatheṣṭaṃ ca phalaṃ labhet ।
jñānarūpo'hamevātra dravamūrti vidhāya ca ।। 18।।
jāḍyavidhvaṃsanaṃ kuryāṃ kuryāṃ jñānopadeśanam ।
iti datvā varaṃ śaṃbhurliṃge cāntaradhīyata ।। 19।।
īśānaśca gato natvā svadiśāṃ prati padmaje ।
athā''nandavane tatra harisvāmīti bhūsuraḥ ।।1.460.20।।
āsīttasyā'bhavatputrī śīlarūpaguṇānvitā ।
kalākalāpakuśalā miṣṭasvarā'tisundarī ।।21 ।।
kṛṣṇabhaktā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipradevatā ।
suśīlā nāma sā nityaṃ snātvā jñānodatīrthake ।।22।।
viśveśvarālaye saṃmārjanādi kurute satī ।
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇetikṛṣṇeti śivaśaṃbho jagau mudā ।।23।।।
sulocanāpi sā kanyā paśyatyāsyaṃ na kasyacit ।
suśravā hyapi sā bālā nā''datte kasyacid vacaḥ ।।24।।
suśīlā śīlasampannā rahastadgatamānasaiḥ ।
prārthitā'pi kṛṣṇavratā nābhilāṣāṃ babandha sā ।।25।।
dhanaistasyāstu janako yuvabhiḥ prārthito bahuḥ ।
nā'śakattāṃ suśīlāṃ sa dātuṃ śolorjitaśriyam ।।26।।
jñānodatīrthabhajanāt suśīlā sā kumārikā ।
bahirantastadā'drākṣīt sarvaṃ kṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat ।।27।।
atha vidyādharastatra śaṃbhordidṛkṣayā''gataḥ ।
rūpalāvaṇyasampannāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ cakame tu saḥ ।।28।।
gāndharveṇa vivāhena gṛhītvā sa yayau satīm ।
sāpi prasevate nityaṃ malayādrau tu taṃ patim ।।29।।
pātivratyaparā sādhvī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ।
sasmāra sarvadā tatra svāmini tviṣṭadevatām ।।1.460.3 0 ।।
atha kadācinmalaye bhramantaṃ ta patiṃ mahān ।
nijaghāna triśūlena hyakasmād vyomamārgataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
pativratayā ca tayā śīghraṃ jalaṃ dhṛtaṃ mukhe ।
tatyājā'sūn rākṣasaṃ ca bhasmīcakāra sā satī ।।32।।
athā'sya śavamādāya kṛtvā citāṃ tu sundarī ।
kṛṣṇaṃ patiṃ tadā dhyātvā cakre citāgnisāt tanum ।।3 3 ।।
dampatī tau svargalokaṃ bhuktvā vai lakṣavatsarān ।
vidyādhraḥ sa januḥ prāpa rājño malayaketutaḥ ।।34।।
vaiṣṇavaḥ paramodāraḥ satāṃ sevāparāyaṇaḥ ।
suśīlā sā janurlebhe karṇāṭe nagare satī ।। 35।।
suto malayaketostāṃ kālena pariṇītavān ।
jātismarau dampatī tau kṛṣṇabhaktiparāyaṇau ।।36।।
nāmnā tau samavikhyātau mālyaketuḥ kalāvatī ।
kalāvatī mālyaketuṃ patiṃ prāpya pativratā ।।37।।
apatyatritayaṃ lebhe divyabhogasamṛddhibhāk ।
ekadā kaścidaudīcyo mālyaketuṃ nareśvaram ।।38।।
citrakṛccitrapaṭikāṃ citrāṃ darśitavānatha ।
tāṃ tu citrapaṭīṃ rājā kalāvatyai samārpayat ।।3 9।।
sā'ṅgulyā prāṅnivāsasya sthānaṃ smṛtvā viveda tat ।
gaṃgāmudagvahāṃ smṛtvā smṛtvā ca maṇikarṇikām ।।1.460.40 ।।
pañcagaṃgāṃ ca goghāṭaṃ tathā prahlādakeśavam ।
balikeśavanāmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ nāradakeśavam ।।41 ।।
ādikeśavanāmānaṃ kṛṣṇamādityakeśavam ।
bhīṣmakeśavanāmānaṃ tathā vāmanakeśavam ।।।42।।
bhṛgukeśavanāmānaṃ naranārāyaṇau tathā ।
gopīgovindanāmānaṃ yajñavārāhakeśavam ।।।।43।।
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhanāmānaṃ śeṣamādhavanāmakam ।
śaṃkhamādhavanāmānaṃ sasmāra sā pativratā ।। 44।।
śrībindumādhavaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣāllakṣmīpatiṃ patim ।
tathā śrīmaṃgalāgaurīṃ sasmāra dharmakūpakam ।।45।।
daśāśvamedhikaṃ tīrthaṃ jñānavāpīṃ priyāṃ parām ।
viśveśvaraṃ tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeśvaraṃ harim ।।46।।
kalāvatī citrapaṭīṃ paśyantītthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ ।
punardadarśa jñānodaṃ śrīviśveśvarabhūtale ।।47।।
harṣavāṣpāmbukalile jāte tasyāḥ sulocane ।
tastambha gātralatikā mukhaṃ praphullatāṃ gatam ।।48।।
svaro'tha gadgado jāto jñānavāpīṃ vilokya vai ।
dṛṣṭvā rājā satīṃ prāha kiṃ priye smarasi sthalam ।।49।।
sā tu namrā'bhavat kṣipraṃ lajjayovāca vai tataḥ ।
nātha dharmārthakāmāśca mokṣaśceti pumarthakāḥ ।।1.460.50।।
sādhanīyā manuṣyeṇa mokṣo mukhyaḥ pumarthakaḥ ।
tadvihīnā janirapi jalabudbudavanmatā ।।51 ।।
yatrā''nukūlyaṃ dampatyostrivargastatra vardhate ।
madvidhānāṃ tu dāsīnāṃ bāhulyaṃ te'sti mandire ।।52 ।।
tathāpi nitarāṃ prema svāmino mayi dṛśyate ।
tava dāsyapi bhogāḍhyā kimutā'ṅkasthalīcarī ।।53।।
tatrā'pyananyasampattistatra svādhīnabhartṛtā ।
vipaścitsaṃcayedarthāniṣṭāpūrtāya karmaṇe ।।54।।
tapo'rthamāyurnirvighnaṃ dārāँścāpatyalabdhaye ।
sarvaṃ te nṛpa saṃbhūtaṃ vairāgye'tha manaḥ kuru ।।55।।
bhakṣyavikārakāmānāṃ nā'ntosti maraṇaṃ vinā ।
jñānena maraṇaṃ kāryaṃ dehasya maraṇaṃ na tat ।।56।।
ānandakānanayātrāṃ kartumicchāmi mokṣadām ।
pūraṇīyo'bhilāṣo me mānuṣyaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ।।57।।
śrutvā rājā ca tāmāha yogyaṃ kāle susmāritam ।
saiva patnī satī sādhvī lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ sā hareḥ priyā ।।58।।
pativratā'pi sā yā smārayedante hariṃ patim ।
na rājyaṃ rājyamityohuḥ rājyaśrīryā pativratā ।।59।।
saptāṃgamapi sāmrājyaṃ tayā hīnaṃ tṛṇāyate ।
yadi patnī svayaṃ bhūtvā patiṃ pātayati vṛṣāt ।।1.460.60 ।।
mokṣācca sā na vai patnī kṛtyā māyā tu rākṣasī ।
svayaṃ yātyeva nirayaṃ nayatyapi patiṃ sutān ।।61 ।।
kulānyapi tu pāpādyaiḥ pātayatyeva sā divaḥ ।
yā na smārayati bhaktiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।।62।।
sādhvī nārī tu sā proktā sati dravye ca sampadi ।
dharmaṃ tīrthaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ dānaṃ saṃsmārayeddharim ।।63 ।।
tīrthaṃ samutsavaṃ pūjāṃ guroḥ pitrośca śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
satāṃ sevāṃ harerdāsyaṃ kārayatyeva sā priyā ।।64।।
priyāt priyatarastvātmā tasya priyatamo'cyutaḥ ।
mokṣaḥ priyatamaścāti smārayettaṃ pativratā ।।65।।
tava balānmayā sādhvi bhuktaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam ।
hṛṣīkārthāḥ kṛtārthāśca dharmaścāpi kṛto'tulaḥ ।।66।।
apatyānyapi jātāni kiṃ kartavyamihā'sti me ।
avaśyameva gantavyā''vābhyāṃ vārāṇasī purī ।।67।।
iti niścitya rājā svaṃ putre rājyaṃ nidhāya ca ।
datvā dānāni bahūni kāśīṃ prati pratasthivān ।।68।।
dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ jñānavāpīṃ nijapurābhuvam ।
jahṛṣatuśca tau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapadārthinau ।।69।।
snātvā dadau vividhāni dānāni kanakāni ca. ।
suvarṇarūpyakalaśān gāśca dogdhrīrdadau mudā ।।1.460.70 ।।
dukūlāni vicitrāṇi pūjopakaraṇāni ca ।
yayau bhāryāyuto muktimaṇḍapaṃ tatra vā citām ।।7 1।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ śuśrāva satkathām ।
dakṣiṇāṃ saddhanaṃ datvā pūjāṃ sāyaṃ śivasya saḥ ।।72 ।।
kārayāmāsa vidhinā jñānavāpīṃ yayau tataḥ ।
nṛpaḥ sārdhaṃ kalāvatyā tatra sasnau prahṛṣṭavat ।।73 ।।
tatra piṇḍān sa nirvāpya santarpya śraddhayā pitṝn ।
dīnā'nāthasatīsādhūn datvā dānāni vai tataḥ ।।74।।
bubhujāte dampatī ca bhojanaṃ pravibhajya tu ।
tataḥ kalāvatī kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ mudā muhuḥ ।।75।।
jajāpa parayā bhaktyā tapaścakre tapasvinī ।
ekāntaropavāsaiśca kadācittu tryahovrataiḥ ।।76 ।।
ṣaḍahobhojanaiścāpi pakṣārdhaniyamairatha ।
pakṣāntaropavāsaiśca māsopavasanādibhiḥ ।। 77 ।।
cāndrāyaṇavrataiḥ kṛcchrairbhartuḥ śuśruṣaṇairapi ।
nināya kṣaṇavatkālamāyuḥśeṣasya sā satī ।।78 ।।
ekadā jñānavāpyāṃ tu prātaḥ snātvopaviṣṭayoḥ ।
āgatya jaṭilaḥ kaścidāśīrbhirabhinandya ca ।।79 ।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
mantraṃ datvā prasannāsyastulasīmālikādharaḥ ।।1.460.80 ।।
uttiṣṭhataṃ prakurutaṃ mokṣārthaṃ mānasaṃ param ।
tāvad vimānamāpannaṃ sukvaṇatkiṃkiṇīgaṇam ।।8 1 ।।
caturbhujairharerbhaktairdivyaiḥ sappārṣadairyutam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇamūrtitaijovyāptaṃ suśobhitam ।।8 2 ।।
svayaṃ lakṣmīstvavatīrya datvā jñānaṃ parātparam ।
tārakaṃ mokṣadaṃ tau ca nināya divyavigrahau ।।8 3 ।।
vimānena mahālakṣmyā saha nārāyaṇena tau ।
caturbhujau divyadehau kṛṣṇadhāma gatau priye ।।84 ।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! kalāvatyāvrataṃ śubham ।
mokṣadaṃ paṭhanādvāpi śravaṇātsarvathā sati! ।।85।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ānandavanakṣetre jñānodamahimani suśīlāyāḥ sādhvīvratasthāyāḥ gāndharvavivāhottaraṃ dampatyorjanmāntare rājyaprāptiḥ pātivratyaprabhāveṇa mokṣaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṣṭyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 460 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 460 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 461
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 462 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
pātivratyaṃ paro dharmaḥ śruto jñātaśca te mukhāt। ।
nārīdehasya pāvitryaṃ śāśvataṃ kṛtrimaṃ ca vā ।। 1 ।।
yadvā saṃskārasamprāpyaṃ yadvā vaivāhikaṃ matam ।
yathārthaṃ vada me kānta dharmakāryādipuṣṭikṛt ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
striyaḥ pavitrāḥ satataṃ naitā duṣyanti kenacit। ।
māsi māsi rajastāsāṃ duṣkṛtānyapakarṣati ।। 3 ।।
pūrvaṃ striyaḥ surairbhuktāḥ somagandharvavahnibhiḥ ।
bhuṃjate mānuṣāḥ paścānnaitā duṣyanti kenacit ।। 4 ।।
strīṇāṃ śaucaṃ dadau somaḥ pāvakaḥ sarvamedhyatām ।
kalyāṇavāṇīṃ gandharvāstena medhyāḥ sadā striyaḥ । । 5 । ।
kanyāṃ bhuṃkte rajaḥkāle'gniḥ śaśī lomadarśane ।
stanodbhedeṣu gandharvāstatprāgeva pradīyate । । 6 । ।
kanyāmabhuktāṃ somādyairdadaddānaphalaṃ bahu ।
kanyādānaphalaprepsustasmāddadyādayauvanām । । 7 ।।
rajoromastanodbhedā yauvanasya pradarśakāḥ ।
aṣṭavarṣā bhaved gaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī ।। 8 ।।
daśavarṣā bhavet kanyā hyata ūrdhvaṃ rajo'nvitā ।
kanyādānaṃ śubhaṃ proktaṃ caturdaśasamāya vai । । 9 ।।
śayanāsanayānāni kuṇapaṃ strīmukhaṃ kuśāḥ ।
yajñapātrāṇi sarvāṇi na praduṣyanti vai kvacit ।। 1.461.10 । ।
vatsaḥ prasravaṇe medhyaḥ śakuniḥ phalapātane ।
nāryo ratiprayogeṣu śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ । । 11 । ।
ajā'śvayormukhaṃ medhyaṃ gāvo medhyāstu pṛṣṭhataḥ ।
brahmajñāḥ pādato medhyāḥ striyo medhyāstu sarvataḥ । । 12 । ।
balātkāropabhuktā vā corahastagatā'pi vā ।
na tyājyā dayitā nārī medhyā'jena vinirmitā । । 13 ।।
sādhavo gairikāpūtā rajaḥpūtāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
kṛṣṇapūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ dampatyudvāhapāvanau ।। 1 4।।
garbhapūtaṃ sadā vīryaṃ janmapūtaṃ tu bālakam ।
mantrapūtāḥ sadā śiṣyā dīkṣāpūtāḥ śarīriṇaḥ । । 1 9' । ।
vratapūtāḥ sadā santaḥ patipūto vadhūjanaḥ ।
jīvapūtaṃ sadā dugdhaṃ sthānapūtā radādayaḥ । । 16 ।।
bhāvapūtā sadā kanyā yuvatī jaraṭhā'thavā ।
āpaḥ svabhāvato medhyā medhyo vahniḥ svabhāvataḥ । । 17 । ।
vahnirāpo'nilo nārī medhyā vaṃśodbhavāḥ sadā ।
tadabhyarcyāḥ suvāsinyo bhūṣaṇācchādanā'śanaiḥ ।। 18 । ।
bhūtikāmairnarairnityaṃ satkāryeṣūtsaveṣu ca ।
ramante devatāstatra syustatra saphalāḥ kriyāḥ ।। 19 ।।
yatra tuṣyati bhartrā strī striyā bhartā ca tuṣyati ।
tatra veśmani kalyāṇaṃ sampadyeta pade pade । । 1.461.20 ।।
prātikūlye kalatraṃ cennarakeṇāpi kiṃ tataḥ ।
dakṣā prajāvatī sādhvī priyavāṇī vaśaṃvadā । । 21 ।।
patiprāṇā bhāgavatī sā śrīḥ strīrūpadhāriṇī ।
sadā gṛhī sukhaṃ bhuṃkte strī lakṣaṇavatī yadi ।। 22 ।।
vapurāvartagandhāśca chāyā sattvaṃ svaro gatiḥ ।
varṇaścetyaṣṭadhā bodhyā nārīlakṣaṇabhūmayaḥ ।। 23 ।।
ṣaṣṭiḥ ṣaḍuttarā yoṣidaṃgalakṣaṇasatkhaniḥ ।
ādau pādatalaṃ rekhāstato'ṅguṣṭhāṃ'gulīnakhāḥ ।। 24 । ।
pṛṣṭhaṃ gulmadvayaṃ pārṣṇī jaṃghe romāṇi jānunī ।
ūrū kaṭirnitambasphigbhago jaghanabastike ।। 25 ।।
nābhiḥ kukṣidvayaṃ pārśvodaramadhyavalitrayam ।
romālī hṛdyaṃ vakṣo vakṣojadvayacūcukam । । 26 । ।
jatruskandhāṃ'sakakṣādormaṇibandhakaradvayam ।
pāṇipṛṣṭhaṃ pāṇitalaṃ rekhā'ṅguṣṭhāṃ'gulīnakhāḥ ।। 27 । ।
pṛṣṭhiḥ kṛkāṭikā kaṇṭhe cibukaṃ ca hanudvayam ।
kapolo vaktramadharottarauṣṭhau dvijajihvikāḥ । । 28 ।।
ghaṇṭikātāluhasitaṃ nāsikā kṣutamakṣiṇī ।
pakṣmabhrūkarṇabhālāni maulisīmantamaulijāḥ ।। 29 । ।
eteṣvaṃgeṣu nāryo vai parīkṣyante śṛṇu priye! ।
strīṇāṃ pādatalaṃ snigdhaṃ māṃsalaṃ mṛdulaṃ samam । । 1.461.30 ।।
asvedamuṣṇamaruṇaṃ bahubhogocitaṃ smṛtam ।
rūkṣaṃ vivarṇaṃ paruṣaṃ khaṇḍitapratibimbakam । । 31 । ।
śūrpākāraṃ viśuṣkaṃ ca duḥkhadaurbhāgyasūcakam ।
cakrasvastikaśaṃkhābjadhvajamīnā''tapatravat ।। 32 ।।
yasyāḥ pādatale rekhāḥ sā bhavedvai nṛpāṃganā ।
madhyāṃgulīgatācordhvarekhā bhogātibhogadā । । 33 । ।
sarpamūṣakarekhāstu dāridryaduḥkhadāyikāḥ ।
puṣṭonnataḥ śubho'ṅguṣṭho vartulo bahubhogadaḥ । । 3 4।।
hrasvavakracipiṭastvaṃguṣṭhaḥ saubhāgyanāśakaḥ ।
vidhavā vipulāṃguṣṭhā dīrghāṃguṣṭhā tu durbhagā ।। 35 । ।
mṛdūnnataghanavṛttāṃgulayaḥ sampadāṃ pradāḥ ।
dīrghāṃgulayaḥ kulaṭā kṛśāṃgulayo nirdhanāḥ । । 36 ।।
hrasvāṃgulyo hasvajīvā bhugnāṃgulyaḥ śaṭhā matāḥ ।
cipiṭāṃ'gulayo dāsyo daridrā viralāṃguliḥ ।। 37 । ।
parasparasamārūḍhapādāṃgulyastu yoṣitaḥ ।
anekavāraṃ vidhavāḥ paranāryaśca tā matāḥ । । 38 । ।
yasyāḥ pathi calantyāstu pṛṣṭhe dhūlī samucchalet ।
sā pitrośca tathā patyuḥ kulanāśakarī bhavet । । 39 । ।
yasyāḥ kaniṣṭhikā bhūmiṃ gacchantyā na parispṛśet ।
sā nihatya patiṃ yoṣā dvitīyaṃ kurute patim । । 1.461.40 ।।
anāmikā tu gacchantyā yasyā bhūmiṃ tu na spṛśet ।
patidvayaṃ nihatyaiva tṛtīyaṃ kurute patim ।। 41 । ।
madhyamāṃgulikā yasyā yāntyā bhūmiṃ na vai spṛśet ।
patitrayaṃ nihatyaiva caturthaṃ kurute patim ।।40 ।।
anāmikā madhyamā'tihrasvā pativiyoginī ।
pradeśinī sadāṃguṣṭhasaṃyuktā kulaṭākarī ।।।43।।
snigdhāḥ samunnatāstāmrā vṛttāḥ pādanakhāḥ śubhāḥ ।
unnataṃ cet pādapṛṣṭhaṃ masṛṇaṃ mṛdu māṃsalam ।।44।।
asvedamaśirāḍhyaṃ ca rājñī bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ।
madhyanamraṃ pādapṛṣṭhaṃ sadā dāridryasūcakam ।।45।।
śirālaṃ tvadhvagatidaṃ romāḍhyaṃ kiṃkarīkaram ।
nirmāṃsaṃ cet sudurbhāgyapradaṃ bodhyaṃ hi yoṣitaḥ ।।46।।
gūḍhau gulphau tu sukhadau vartulau cā'śirālakau ।
nīcaiḥsthau śithilau bāhyo durbhāgyadau hi yoṣitaḥ ।।47।।
samaḥ pārṣṇiḥ suśubhadaḥ pṛthuḥ pārṣṇistu durbhagaḥ ।
unnataḥ kulaṭāpārṣṇiḥ pārṣṇirdīrghaḥ suduḥkhadaḥ ।।48।।
nīrome viśire jaṃghe snigdhe ca kramavartule ।
manohare suraktake rājapatnyā mate śubhe ।।49।।
rājñī bhavedekaromā dviromā sukhabhāginī ।
triromā romakūpeṣu vidhavā syānna saṃśayaḥ ।।1.461.50।।
vṛtte sumāṃsale puṣṭe jānunī dharmayoṣitaḥ ।
nirmāṃse svairacāriṇyā daridrāyāstu viślathe ।।51 ।।
kadalīkarabhākārau masṛṇau dhavalau ghanau ।
ūrū vṛttau mṛdū romarahitau viśirau śubhau ।।52।।
bhūpastrī sudhanāḍhyastrī viduṣī syāt pativratā ।
saromoruyutā syādvai vidhavā paragā tathā ।।53 ।।
durbhāgyā syāccipiṭorumatī duḥkhamayī sadā ।
sachidroruyutā duḥkhabhāginī saśirorukā ।।54।।
kaṭhinatvagūrumatī dāridryavyāpinī sadā ।
caturviṃśatyaṃgulā yā kaṭirvartulamānagā ।।55।।
samunnatanitambā ca caturasrā kaṭiḥ śubhā ।
nimnā natā cipiṭā ca śuṣkā dīrghā tu duḥkhadā ।।56।।
kaṭiḥ saromā hrasvā tu vidhavātvaprasaṃjikā ।
nitambau tūnnatau puṣṭau pṛthū kaṭhinamāṃsalau ।।57।।
kapitthaphalavadvṛttau ratibhogavivardhanau ।
yoniḥ kacchapavistārā gajakuṃbhonnatā śubhā ।।58।।
vāmonnatā tu kanyādā dakṣonnatā tu putradā ।
ākhuromanibharomā guptamadhyā ca vistṛtā ।।59।।
dṛḍhabandhā dṛḍhataṭonnatā plakṣadalā''yatā ।
padmavarṇā svalpaśuṣkā śreṣṭhā saubhāgyavardhinī ।।1.461.6 0।।
mṛgādikhurarūpāyā vartulā cullikāsamā ।
saromā vivṛtāsyā ca lambaśukā'dhamā matā ।।6 1 ।।
śaṃkhāvartasamā garbhadhṛtiyogyā na jāyate ।
cipiṭā kharparākārā kiṃkarīkāriṇī sadā ।।62।।
vaṃśavetasapatrābhā dīrghocchraromasaṃyutā ।
atyunnataśukāḍhyā tu yonirnaiva śubhapradā ।।63 ।।
dṛḍhonnatataṭā svaccharaktābhā svalpamadhyikā ।
antarvalayayuktā tu yoniḥ saukhyapradā sadā ।।64।।
māṃsacchannordhvā'sthiguptā nimajjadasthirakṣitā ।
parito'ntarmāṃsalā tu yoniḥ saukhyapradā sadā ।।65।।
vikaṭā kuṭilā lambā viśālā śithilāṃ guhā ।
kandarā muktamāṃsārdrā sukhadā na kadācana ।।66।।
bhagabhālaṃ jaghanaṃ tu viśālaṃ tuṃgamāṃsalam ।
mṛdulaṃ mṛduromāḍhyaṃ dakṣiṇāvartamuttamam ।।67।।
vāmāvartaṃ ca nirmāṃsaṃ vakraṃ vaidhavyasūcakam ।
jaghanaṃ garbhiṇītulyaṃ lambodaraṃ na śāntidam ।।68।।
śuṣkaṃ saṃkucitaṃ nimnaṃ jaghanaṃ sāsthi duḥkhadam ।
jaghanapārśvagā bastirmṛdvī vipulakomalā ।।69।।
kiñcicca pronnatā śreṣṭhā yānavāhanadāyinī ।
romaśā ca śirālā sā rekhāṃkā naiva śasyate ।।1.461.70।।
gambhīrā dakṣiṇāvartā nābhiḥ syāt sukhasampradā ।
vāmāvarttā samuttānā vyaktagranthirna śasyate ।।71 ।।
vistṛtakukṣikā sūte sutān bahūn hi bhāminī ।
maṇḍukodaravat kukṣiḥ sūtre putraṃ nṛpaṃ satī ।।72।।
ūrdhvakukṣirbhaved vandhyā valikukṣiḥ satī bhavet ।
sāvartakukṣikā dāsī bhavedājanmakiṃkarī ।।73 ।।
samamāṃsalamṛdulamagnāsthipārśvaśālinī ।
saubhāgyā''nandasuguṇaiśvaryasaukhyavatī bhavet ।।74।।
saromonnatasaṃdṛśyanāḍikākṛśapārśvalā ।
duḥśīlā nirapatyā ca sā bhaved duḥkhasāgarā ।।75।।
svalpaṃ viśiraṃ mṛdutvagudaraṃ bhogabodhakam ।
kuṃbhamṛdaṃgakūṣmāṇḍodaraṃ duṣpūrameva hi ।।76।।
lambodarī śvaśuraghnī nirapatyā pṛthūdarī ।
tanumadhyā tu subhagā valitrayā ratipradā ।।77।।
ṛjvī tanvī ca romālī yasyāḥ sā śarmanarmadā ।
piṃgā vakrā sthūlachinnā romālī dhavavarjitā ।।78।।
nirlomonnatahṛdayā patisnehapradā sadā ।
viśālahṛdayā nārī puṃścalī nirdayā bhavet ।।79।।
udbhinnaromahṛdayā patihā bhavati ghruvam ।
aṣṭādaśāṃgulatatamuro yasyāstu pīvaram ।।1.461.80।।
unnataṃ sukhadaṃ proktaṃ māṃsalaṃ śobhanaṃ varam ।
duḥkhadaṃ tu bhavet tadvai romaśaṃ viṣamaṃ pṛthu ।।8 1 ।।
ghanau vṛttau dṛḍhau pīnau samau śastau payodharau ।
sthūlāgrau viralau śuṣkau komalau nahi śarmadau ।।82।।
dakṣinonnatadārḍhyāḍhyakucā putravatī bhavet ।
vāmonnatakucā kanyāṃ sūte saubhāgyasundarīm ।।83।।
araghaṭṭaghaṭītulyau kucau dauḥśīlyasūcakau ।
pīvarāsyau sāntarālau pṛthūpāntau na śobhanau ।।84।।
mūle sthūlau kramakṛśau tīkṣṇāgrau yau payodharau ।
prathamaṃ sukhadau paścācchokadau duḥkhakāriṇau ।।85।।
sundare kaṭhine śyāme vartule cūcuke śubhe ।
antarmagne ca vā dīrghe kṛśe kleśasya sūcake ।।86।।
pīvarābhyāṃ tu jatrubhyāṃ tu dhanadhānyavatī vadhūḥ ।
ślathā'sthibhyāṃ tu nimnābhyāṃ viṣamābhyāṃ daridriṇī ।।87।।
abaddhāvanatau skandhāvadīrghāvakṛśau śubhau ।
vakrau sthūlau ca romāḍhyau preṣyavaidhavyasūcakau ।।88।।
nigūḍhasandhī srastāgrau śubhāvaṃsau susaṃhatau ।
vaidhavyadau samuccāgrau nirmāṃsāvatiduḥkhadau ।।89।।
kakṣe śaste sūkṣmarome tuṃge snigdhe sumāṃsale ।
na praśaste svedayukte gambhīre ca śirālake ।।1.461.90 ।।
hastau raktau māṃsalau niśśirau gūḍhāsthikomalau ।
viromāṇau śubhratāmrau saralau satyayoṣitām ।।91 ।।
vaidhavyaṃ sthūlaromāṇau hrasvau daurbhāgyakārakau ।
dṛśyaśirau tathā rūkṣau kṛṣṇau kleśapradau matau ।। 92।।
abhbhojamukulākāramaṃguṣṭhāṃgulisammukham ।
hastadvayaṃ satīnāṃ tu bahubhogaprasūcakam ।।93।।
mṛdu madhyonnataṃ raktaṃ talaṃ pāṇyorarandhrakam ।
śastarekhānvitaṃ śastaṃ svalparekhaṃ śubhaśriyam ।। 94।।
vidhavā bahurekhābhiścā'rekhā tu daridraṇī ।
saśire bhikṣukī pāṇyostale vairāgyabodhake ।। 95।।
virome viśire pāṇyoḥ pṛṣṭhe śaste samunnate ।
sarome māṃsarahite saśire vidhavāstriyaḥ ।।96 ।।
raktā vyaktā gabhīrā ca snigdhā pūrṇā ca vartulā ।
kararekhā bhāgyarekhā praśastā yoṣitāṃ matā ।।97।।
matsyena subhagā sādhvī svastikena dhanapradā ।
padmena bhūpateḥ patnī nṛpamātā bhavettu sā ।।98।।
cakravartistriyāḥ pāṇī+au dakṣiṇāvartasvastikaḥ ।
śaṃkhātapatrakamaṭhadhvajacchatrāṇi vāmake ।।99।।
tulārekhā vaṇikpatnī baddhakośā vaṇikpriyā ।
gajavājivṛṣā vāme prāsādaśakaṭe tathā ।। 1.461.10 0।।
yugacihnaṃ tu vāme ced vaiśyapatnī hi sā bhavet ।
cāmarāṃ'kuśakodaṇḍaiḥ rājapatnī samīritā ।। 101 ।।
aṃguṣṭhamūlānnirgatya rekhā yāti kaniṣṭhikām ।
sā syānnārī patihantrī ghātinī duḥkhakāriṇī ।। 1 02।।
triśūlā'sigadāśaktidundubhyākṛtirekhayā ।
dānakartrī bhavet sā strī kīrtimatī pativratā ।। 1 03।।
kaṃkajambūkamaṇḍūkavṛkavṛścikabhoginaḥ ।
rāsabhoṣṭrabiḍālāḥ syuḥ karasthā duḥkhadāḥ striyāḥ ।। 1 04।।
kṛṣṇā danteṣu dīrghā yā miñjarīmukhatastu yā ।
rorūyamāṇavadanā khañjāgamanatiryagā ।। 1 05।।
kṛṣṇacāmpalacaraṇā hanulambamukhī ca yā ।
pṛṣṭhabhagnodaraghaṭā kīrtisthānavināśinī ।। 106 ।।
śubhakṛt saralo'ṅguṣṭho vṛtto vṛttanakho mṛduḥ ।
aṃgulyaśca suparvāṇyo dīrghā vṛttāḥ kṛśāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1 07।।
tāścipiṭā rūkṣaśuṣkāḥ pṛṣṭharomayujo'śubhāḥ ।
atihrasvāḥ kṛśā vakrā viralā raugahetukāḥ ।। 1 08।।
bahuparvasametāṃgulayo duḥkhapradā sadā ।
aruṇāḥ saśikhāstuṃgā vartulāśca nakhāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1 09।।
nimnā vivarṇāḥ śuktyābhāḥ pītā dāridryasūcakāḥ ।
nakheṣu bindavaḥ śvetāḥ svairiṇītvaprasaṃjakāḥ ।। 1.461.11 0।।
antarnimagnapṛṣṭhāsthiḥ pṛṣṭhiśca māṃsalā śubhā ।
romayuktā yadi pṛṣṭhirvaidhavyabodhikā tu sā ।। 111 ।।
bhugnā natā suśirā ca pṛṣṭhirduḥkhapradāyinī ।
ṛjvī kṛkāṭikonnatā samāṃsā śobhanā sadā ।। 11 2।।
śuṣkāśirālā romāḍhyā viśālā kuṭilā'śubhā ।
māṃsalo vartulaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ praśastaścaturaṃgulaḥ ।। 113 ।।
śastā grīvā trirekhāṅkā cā'vyaktāsthiḥ susaṃhatā ।
nirmāṃsā cipiṭā dīrghā śuṣkā nāsti śubhapradā ।। 1 14।।
sthūlagrīvā tu vidhavā vakragrīvā tu kiṃkarī ।
vandhyā syāccipiṭagrīvā hasvagrīvā tu niḥsutā ।। 1 15।।
cibukaṃ dvyaṃgulaṃ śastaṃ vṛttaṃ pīnaṃ sukomalam ।
sthūlaṃ dvidhā vibhaktaṃ saromā''yataṃ na śobhanam ।। 116 ।।
hanuścibukasaṃlagnā nirlomā sughanā śubhā ।
vakrā sthūlā kṛśā hrasvā romaśā na śubhapradā ।। 11 7।।
pīnau vṛttāvunnatau śastau kapolau supūritau ।
nimnau paruṣau romāḍhyau nirmāṃsau sukhadau nahi ।। 1 18।।
janetṛvadanacchāyaṃ svāmodaṃ vartulaṃ samam ।
snigdhaṃ ramyaṃ sumāṃsaṃ prapūrṇaṃ mukhaṃ satīstriyāḥ ।। 119 ।।
surakto vartulaḥ snigdho madhye rekhāvibhūṣitaḥ ।
adharo rājyado madhyādāprāntaṃ kramaśastanuḥ ।। 1.461.120 ।।
kṛśaḥ pralambaḥ sphuṭito rūkṣo daurbhāgyabodhakaḥ ।
sthūlaḥ kapiśo vaidhavyakleśadaścā'dharauṣṭhakaḥ ।। 121 ।।
kiñcinmadhyonnato'romā cikkaṇo bhogado'dharaḥ ।
kodaṇḍākārarekhaśca lakṣmīdaścottarādharaḥ ।। 122 ।।
śuklā dāḍimabījābhāḥ snigdhāścobhayataḥ samāḥ ।
stokaṃ samunnatā dantāḥ satīnāṃ dharmayoṣitām ।। 123 ।।
pītāḥ syāvāḥ sthūladīrghāḥ śuktyābhā viralā radāḥ ।
mūlarūkṣā asamā dvipaṃktayo bhāgyavarjitāḥ ।। 1 24।।
adho'dhikaradā nārī mātṛnāśakarī matā ।
vikaṭadantā vidhavā kulaṭā ca pṛthakdatī ।। 1 25।।
śoṇā mṛdvī sitā jihvā miṣṭeṣṭabhojanā bhavet ।
madhye saṃkucitā cāgre vistṛtā duḥkhadā bhavet ।। 126 ।।
sitā jalamṛtidātrī śyāmā kalahakāriṇī ।
māṃsalā dāridryadā ca lambā tvabhakṣyabhakṣiṇī ।। 127 ।।
viśālā rasanā nityapramādabodhinī matā ।
susnigdhaṃ bhūpadmaraṃgaṃ tālu mṛdu praśasyate ।। 128 ।।
site tāluni vaidhavyaṃ pītaṃ saṃnyāsināṃ bhavet ।
kṛṣṇe'patyavihīnā ca rūkṣe bahukuṭumbinī ।। 1 29।।
kaṇṭhāntarvartinī ghaṇṭī tīkṣṇā raktā ca vartulā ।
apralambā śubhā'sthūlā sthūlakṛṣṇā tu duḥkhadā ।। 1.461.130 ।।
hāsya cā'dṛśyadanta ca kiñcitphullakapālakam ।
animīlitanetraṃ ca smitaṃ nāryāḥ praśasyate ।। 131 ।।
samavṛttapuṭā nāsā laghucchidrā śubhāvahā ।
sthūlāgrā madhyanimnā connatā nāpi praśasyate ।। 132 ।।
śukacañcusamavakraprāntā nāsā tu cottamā ।
hrasvāgrā raktavarṇāntā nāsā vaidhavyakāriṇī ।। 133 ।।
cipiṭā kiṃkarīnāsā hrasvā dīrghāṃ kalipriyā ।
lalanālocane śastaṃ raktānta kṛṣṇatārake ।। 1 34।।
dhavale dalavaddīrghe susnigdhe kṛṣṇapakṣmaṇī ।
ucchrayākṣirna dīrghāyurvṛttākṣī kulaṭā matā ।। 1 35।।
meṣākṣī mahiṣākṣī ca cipiṭākṣī na śasyate ।
gopiṃgākṣī kāmavegā bahubhogāśrayā bhavet ।। 136 ।।
pārāvatākṣī duḥśīlā raktākṣī bhartṛghātinī ।
duṣṭā gahvaranayanā gajanetrā na śasyate ।। 1 37।।
puṃścalī vāmakāṇākṣī vandhyā dakṣiṇakarṇikā ।
ramaṇī madhupiṃgākṣī dhanadhānyasamṛddhibhāg ।। 138 ।।
pakṣmabhiḥ sughanaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ snigdhaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ subhāgyabhāk ।
kapilairviralaiḥ sthūlainindyakāryakarī matā ।। 139 ।।
bhruvau suvartule snigdhe kṛṣṇakaṭe pṛthaksthite ।
praśaste mṛduromāṇau sutīkṣṇe kārmukākṛtī ।। 1.461.140 ।।
khararomā vistṛtā ca dīrgharomā ca piṃgalā ।
saṃhatā ca vikīrṇā ca bhrūrna śastā varastriyāḥ ।। 141 ।।
karṇau lambau śubhāvartau komalau sukhadau striyāḥ ।
śaṣkulīrahitau nindyau śirālau kuṭilau kṛśau ।। 142 ।।
bhālaḥ śirāvirahito nirlomā'rdhendusannibhaḥ ।
animnastryaṃgulo nāryāḥ saubhāgyārogyasaukhyadaḥ ।। 143 ।।
spaṣṭasvastikarekhaṃ tu lalāṭaṃ rājyadṃ bhavet ।
pralambamastakā nārī bhaved devaraghātinī ।। 144।।
śirālocconnamaṇimastakā rogiṇī matā ।
sīmantaḥ saralaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭho mauliḥ samunnataḥ ।। 145 ।।
gajakuṃbhanibhau vṛttaḥ saubhāgyaiśvaryasūcakaḥ ।
ghaṭamūrdhā tu vidhavā lambaśīrṣā tu puṃścalī ।। 146 । ।
viśālamūrdhā dvimūrdhā durbhāgyā bhavatīha vai ।
keśāḥ kṛṣṇā mṛdusūkṣmāḥ snigdhā''kuṃcitasāgrakāḥ ।। 1 47।।
dīrghāḥ saralā bhāsvarāḥ pātivratyasya sūcakāḥ ।
paruṣāḥ sphuṭitāgrāśca piśaṃgā laghurūkṣakāḥ ।। 948 ।।
viralāḥ sthūlakaṭhinā duḥkhadāridryadāyakāḥ ।
bhruvorantarlalāṭe vā maśako rājyado mataḥ ।। 149 ।।
vāme kapole maśakaḥ śoṇo miṣṭānnapānadaḥ ।
tilakaṃ dakṣiṇāvarto mālā vā bhramaro'pi vā ।। 1.461.15 0 ।।
tilaścandro maśako vā lakṣaṇaṃ rājyabhāgyadāḥ ।
dakṣakuce raktabindustilo vā sā prasūrbhavet ।। 1 5 1 ।।
kanyācatuṣṭayasyāpi putratrayasya vai satī ।
vāme kuce tilaḥ śoṇaḥ putraikajananī tu sā ।। 152 ।।
tato vaidhavyamāpnoti dharmavatī tu sā satī ।
guhyadakṣe tilavatī rājamātā bhavet satī ।। 153 ।।
nāsāgre maśakaḥ śoṇo yasyāḥ sā nṛpabhāminī ।
sa cet kṛṣṇaḥ sā patighnī puṃścalī ca bhavet khalu ।। 1 54।।
nābhyadho maśakaścihnaṃ tilaḥ pativratāstriyāḥ ।
gulphadeśe tilaścihnaṃ maśakaśca daridrakṛt ।। 155 ।।
savye kaṇṭhe kare karme kapole vā tilo'thavā ।
maśako vā bhaveccihnaṃ prathamaṃ putradaṃ bhavet ।। 156 ।।
bhāle triśūlarekhā cedācāryāṇī bhavennṛpī ।
suptā jalpati dantāँśca kaṭāyate kulakṣaṇā ।। 157।।
kare romṇāṃ dakṣiṇāvartastu dharmakaraḥ sadā ।
vāmāvarto duḥkhadaḥ syāt kare romṇāṃ striyā api ।। 158।।
nābhau karṇe hṛdi dakṣāvartaḥ praśasta eva saḥ ।
pṛṣṭhasya dakṣiṇe dakṣovarto mahāsukhapradaḥ ।। 159।।
pṛṣṭhadaṇḍe nimnadakṣāvartaścāyusutapradaḥ ।
yonestu mastake dakṣāvarto rājñītvasūcakaḥ ।। 1.461.160 ।।
sa cet syācchakaṭākāro bahvapatyādisaukhyadaḥ ।
bhagārabdhaḥ kaṭiśrāntaścet putrapatināśakaḥ ।। 161 ।।
udarapucchakau pṛṣṭhāvartau lambau na śāntidau ।
ekaḥ sa patihantā syādanyaḥ sa puṃścalīkaraḥ ।। 16 2।।
kaṇṭhastho dakṣiṇāvarto mato vaidhavyaduḥkhadaḥ ।
keśāraṃbhe lalāṭe saḥ kabaryāṃ vā'tikaṣṭadaḥ ।। 163 ।।
kṛkāṭikāyāṃ kūpe vā yasyā romabhramo bhavet। ।
savyāvarto'thavā dakṣāvartaḥ sā vidhavā bhavet ।। 164।।
mastake vāmabhāge syādeko dvau vā tadā tu sā ।
ādaśāhaṃ patighnī syāt kaṭyāvartā tu puṃścalī ।। 165।।
pṛṣṭhāvartā tu bhartṛghnī nābhyāvartā pativratā ।
kulakṣaṇā'pi sadbhaktā devabhaktā satī matā ।। 166 ।।
tīrthavratatapohomajapadānaparāyaṇāḥ ।
satāṃ hareśca kṛpayā pativratāḥ sulakṣaṇāḥ ।। 167।।
sulakṣaṇāḥ satīnāryaḥ svalpāyuṣkamapi priyam ।
dīrghāyuṣaṃ prakurvanti tārayanti kulāni ca ।। 168।।
sarvalakṣaṇamūrdhanyaṃ pātivratyaṃ paro vṛṣaḥ ।
tadbhaveccellakṣaṇāni sarvāṇi sukhadāni vai ।। 169।।
lakṣaṇāni mayoktāni sukhāya gṛhiṇāṃ priye ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya svajñānaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ।। 1.461.170 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne strīpāvitryastrītanusthaśubhā'śubhādisūcakacihnarekhā'ṅgapratyaṃgādiphalanirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhika-
catuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।46 1 ।।
