saṃkaṭe'smin vidheyaṃ kiṃ vadeti pratyuvāca tam ।
vaśiṣṭho hitakṛt tathyaṃ puṇyadaṃ sarvasammatam ।।।63।।
dvādaśyāṃ samatītāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam ।
upavāsaphalaṃ hatvā vratinaṃ hanti niścitam ।।64।।
na bhojayitvā mūḍhaścedatithiṃ samupasthitam ।
sa trastaḥ kṣudhito bhuṃkte kuṃbhīpāke vrajed dhruvam ।।65।।
śatavarṣaṃ tatra tiṣṭhan naraścāṇḍālatāṃ vrajet ।
vyādhiyukto daridraśca bhavejjanmani janmani ।।66।।
ato'tisūkṣmaṃ te brūmo'dhunā paramasaṃkaṭe ।
rakṣāṃ kuru dvayordharmaṃ samālokya vadāmi te ।।67।।
upavāsaphalaṃ rakṣa kṛṣṇasya caraṇodakam ।
bhuktvā śīghramapo rājāँstadbhakṣaṇamabhakṣaṇam ।।68।।
ityukto bubhuje rājā kiñcidvāri hariṃ smaran ।
etasminnantare tatrā''jagāma krodhano muniḥ ।।69।।
ciccheda kopāt sarvajñaḥ svajaṭāṃ nṛpateḥ puraḥ ।
tataḥ samutthitaḥ khaḍgahasto naro'gnisannibhaḥ ।।1.476.70।।
rājendraṃ hantumāyāntaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā cakramācyutam ।
ciccheda kṛtyāpuruṣaṃ chettuṃ durvāsasaṃ prati ।।71 ।।
gataṃ cakraṃ vilokyaiva vipro dudrāva bhītavat ।
brahmāṇḍakramaṇe cakraṃ paścāddhāvatsudarśanam ।।72।।
dṛṣṭvā trāhītyabhigṛṇan brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।
brahmā prāha harerdāsaṃ śaptuṃ gataḥ kathaṃ mune ।।73।।
rakṣitā yasya bhagavāँstaṃ ko hanti jagattraye ।
kṣudrāṇāṃ mahatāṃ cāpi bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya tu ।।74।।
rarakṣa satataṃ cakraṃ śrīharirbhaktavatsalaḥ ।
yo mūḍha vaiṣṇavaṃ dveṣṭi viṣṇuprāṇasamaṃ janam ।।75।।
tasya dveṣṭuḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'ntamācaret ।
śīghraṃ sthānāntaraṃ gaccha vatsa trāṇaṃ na vā'dhunā ।।76।।
anyathā tvāṃ mayā sārdhaṃ haniṣyati sudarśanam ।
kiṃ brahmalokaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dagdhuṃ śaktaṃ kṣaṇena yat ।।77।।
tejasā viṣṇutulyaṃ yat kenā'nyena nivāryate ।
iti śrutvā pradudrāva jagāma śaraṇaṃ śivam ।।78।।
kṛpānidhāna māṃ rakṣetyuvāca śaṃkaraṃ bhiyā ।
na taṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ kailāsastho'pi śaṃkaraḥ ।।79।।
saṃhartā jagatāṃ śaṃbhustūrṇamuvāca vai bhiyā ।
pautrastvaṃ jagatāṃ dhāturatrestu tanayo mune! ।।1.476.80।।
mamāṃśo vedavijño'si mūrkhatulyaṃ tu karma te ।
vayaṃ yasmāt samutpannāstadbhaktaṃ haṃsi vai katham ।।81।।
ahaṃ brahmā ca kamalā durgā vāṇī ca rādhikā ।
prabhā lakṣmīḥ pārvatī ca māṇikī śrīḥ ramā jayā ।।82।।
nahi bhaktātparāḥ sarve bhakto'smabhyaḥ paro yataḥ ।
kṣudrāँśca mahato bhaktān śaśvad rakṣati yatnataḥ ।।83।।
cakreṇa bhagavān bhaktaṃ rakṣati duḥsahena vai ।
durnivāryaṃ yadā cakraṃ na pratītaṃ surakṣaṇe ।।84।।
tadā caturbhujaḥ śrīmān svayaṃ gacchati rakṣitum ।
bhaktakṛte bhramatyeva chāyeva satataṃ hariḥ ।।85।।
kāntā prāṇādhikā śaśvannahi loke tato'dhikaḥ ।
bhaktān dveṣṭi svayaṃ sā cet tūrṇaṃ tyajati tāṃ prabhuḥ ।।86 ।।
sarveṣāṃ tu priyā viprāḥ svaśarīrādapi hareḥ ।
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ priyā bhaktāḥ sādhavaḥ prāṇataḥ priyāḥ ।।87।।
viprebhyaḥ sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sadā'cyutasugotrakāḥ ।
sādhudharmaśīlarakṣākarāste sarvataḥ priyāḥ ।।88।।
ayaṃ rājāpi sādhūnāṃ dharmān rakṣati mādhave ।
bhaja brāhmaṇa govindaṃ smara tasya padāmbujam ।।89।।
vraja śīghraṃ tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ tava ।
cakraṃ kailāsavāsāँstu pradahat tatra vartate ।।1.476.90।।
pārvatī tu tadā prāha satyaṃ cenme pativratam ।
tejaḥ satyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ yadi ceccirasañcitam ।।91 ।।
kailāsasthāstathā cāyaṃ sarve bhavantu vijvarāḥ ।
mamāśiṣā harerbhaktyā brāhmaṇaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ।।92।।।
durvāsā vaiṣṇavo bhaktaḥ śīghraṃ bhavatu vijvaraḥ ।
ityevamuktvā kṛpayā virarāma śivā, śivaḥ ।।93 ।।
sudarśanaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhat pratīkṣate muniṃ muhuḥ ।
muniḥ praṇamya tau devau vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।।94।।
dṛṣṭvā sudarśanaṃ paścāt papāta pādayorhareḥ ।
trāhi māṃ kamalākānta trāhi māṃ karuṇānidhe ।।95।।
dīnabandho mahāviṣṇo trāhi māṃ saṃkaṭārṇave ।
bhagavannava māṃ bhītaṃ rakṣa māṃ bhavasāgare । ।96।।
kiṃ staumi pāhi māṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo'stu te ।
ityuktvā netranīraiḥ saṃsiseca caraṇāmbuje ।।97।।
nārāyaṇastu taṃ prāha samuttiṣṭha sthiro bhava ।
śṛṇu me vacanaṃ bhadraṃ bhaviṣyati sukhaṃ tava ।।98 ।।
anyeṣāṃ bhavati jñānaṃ śrutvā śāstraṃ satāṃ mukhāt ।
manmūrtayastu śāstrāṇi santastu śāstramūrtayaḥ ।।99।।
mūrtimanti tu śāstrāṇi santo me vicaranti hi ।
taduktaṃ śāstramevā'sti maduktaṃ taddhṛdi hyaham ।। 1.476.100 ।।
brāhmaṇebhyaśca vedebhyaḥ santaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ sadā mama ।
matto'pi sādhavaḥ śreṣṭhāstān bhajāmi sadā hṛdi ।। 101 ।।
ahaṃ prāṇo vaiṣṇavānāṃ mama prāṇāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ ।
tān dveṣṭi yaḥ sa māṃ dveṣṭi mama prāṇasya hiṃsakaḥ ।। 1 02।।
putrān pautrān kalatrāṇi rājyaṃ lakṣmīṃ vihāya ca ।
dhyāyante satataṃ ye māṃ ko me tebhyaḥ paraḥ priyaḥ ।। 103 ।।
parā bhaktānna me prāṇā nahi lakṣmīrna śaṃkaraḥ ।
na bhāratī na vai brahmā na durgā na gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 1 04।।
na brāhmaṇā na vedāśca na vedajananī parā ।
na rādhā nahi gopālā na gopyaḥ prāṇataḥ priyāḥ ।। 1 05।।
yathā priyā mama santaḥ sarvapūjyā mamāpi ca ।
mayaitat kathitaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ sāraṃ ca vāstavam ।। 1 06।।
na praśaṃsāparaṃ teṣāṃ te me prāṇādhikāḥ priyāḥ ।
ye dviṣanti tu madbhaktān prāṇānāmadhikaṃ priyān ।। 107।।
teṣāṃ śāstā tvahaṃ pūrṇastūrṇaṃ daṇḍapradaḥ prabhuḥ ।
svatantraḥ sarvatattveṣu paratantrastu sādhuṣu ।। 1 08।।
goloke vā'tha vaikuṇṭhe dvibhujaṃ vā caturbhujam ।
akṣare śāśvataṃ rūpaṃ rūpamātraṃ hi tanmama ।।1 09।।
prāṇāstu sarvathā bhakte satsu vasanti me'nagha ।
jalānnaṃ bhaktadattaṃ ca bhakṣaṇīyaṃ hi tanmama ।। 1.476.11 0।।
abhakṣyaṃ dravyamanyena dattaṃ cedamṛtopamam ।
ambarīṣaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ nirīhaṃ tamahiṃsakam ।।1 11 ।।
kathaṃ haṃsi dayāśīlaṃ santaṃ prāṇihite ratam ।
dayāṃ kurvanti ye santaḥ satataṃ sarvajantuṣu ।।1 12।
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā madbhāgyāśca mayi sthitāḥ ।
tān dviṣanti tu ye mūḍhāsteṣāṃ hantā'hameva vai ।। 11 3।।
bhaktānāṃ hiṃsakaṃ śatrumahaṃ rakṣitumakṣamaḥ ।
ambarīṣālayaṃ gaccha sa tvāṃ rakṣitumīśvaraḥ ।।1 14।।
karotu pāraṇaṃ tatra rājñaḥ saṃprītaye bhavān ।
pūrṇaṃ varṣaṃ bhavān bhīto bhramatyeva sthale sthale ।। 1 15।।
upavāsī sa rājendraḥ sabhāryaḥ praśucā'nvitaḥ ।
tato'hamupavāsī ca bhaktopavāsakāraṇāt ।। 1 16।।
mamā''śiṣā tu durvāso vijvarastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
pathi hiṃsāṃ ca maccakraṃ tava naiva kariṣyati ।। 1 17।।
ahamadya ca niścintaḥ sukhaṃ bhokṣyāmi niścitam ।
bhaktadattaṃ pāraṇāyāṃ prītyā kṛtvā sudhaupamam ।। 1 18।।
lakṣmīdattamapi dravyaṃ nāhaṃ bhoktumapīśvaraḥ ।
yāvadbhakto mama tvāste hyupavāsī mama priyaḥ ।। 1 19।।
gaccha śīghraṃ tvambarīṣaṃ kuru tvaṃ bhojanaṃ mune! ।
ityuktaḥ prayayau śīghraṃ sacakraḥ krodhano muniḥ ।। 1.476.120।।
upoṣya vatsaraṃ rājā pratīkṣate munīśvaram ।
dadarśa tvāgataṃ natvā bhojayitvā'nnamuttamam ।। 121।।
svayaṃ rājā tu bubhuje cakraṃ prāpūjayattataḥ ।
tuṣṭo vipro'pi yuyuje nṛpasya paramāśiṣam ।।।122।।
jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ praśaśaṃsa punaḥ punaḥ ।
māhātmyaṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāmaho ।। 122।।।
atha kālāntare taptvā tapaśca krodhano muniḥ ।
ekānaṃśāṃ prāpa patnīṃ vasudevasutāṃ punaḥ ।। 1 24।।
pativratayā durvāsāḥ sevitaḥ sattvakāmyayā ।
patnīyutaḥ satyaloke rājate krodhano muniḥ ।। 125।।
etasya śravaṇāllakṣmi! pātivratyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhavet ।
bhaktasevāṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ jñātvā bhaktā bhavet satī ।। 126।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktā bhūtvā kṛṣṇapativratā ।
nā'parādhaṃ prakurvīta bhaktānāṃ svāminaḥ satī ।। 127।।
patyuḥ saheta sarvasvaṃ kṣamāvatī yathā kṣitiḥ ।
śītā bhavet kadalīvat svāminaṃ sukhayet satī ।। 128।।
kandalyāstu samākhyānaṃ śrāvitaṃ bodhanāya vai ।
mama bhavantu tathā nāryo gālīdā kandalī yathā ।। 1 29।।
mā bhavantu narāścāpi durvāsāśca yathā saruṭ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya bhuktirmuktirbhavet priye! ।। 1.476.130 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsaso baṭuviprarūpanārāyaṇadarśanaṃ, kandalyāḥ kadalīvṛkṣatvaṃ, durvāsasaḥkardamātmakadurvāsatvaṃ, aurvasya śāpenā'mbarīṣāparādhajanyamahadbhayāgamaḥ, pātivratyadārḍhyaṃ, vasudevasutayā ekānaṃśayā durvāsaso vivāha-
ścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।476।।


← adhyāyaḥ 476 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 477
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 478 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm ।
viśvakarmā gurorbhaktiṃ cakāra tatphalaṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
pātivratyaṃ pitṛvrataṃ mātṛvrata guruvratam ।
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cānyadīpsitasya pradaṃ dhruvam ।। 2 ।।
viśvakarmā'bhavat pūrvaṃ brahmaṇastvaparā tanuḥ ।
tvaṣṭuḥ prajāpateḥ putro nipuṇo buddhimān svataḥ ।। 3 ।।
kṛtopanayano bālo gurukule vasan vratī ।
cakāra guruśuśrūṣāṃ bhikṣānnakṛtabhojanaḥ ।। 4 ।।
ekadā taṃ guruḥ prāha madarthamūṭajāṃ kuru ।
yathā śaityaṃ jaladhārā tāpo na bādhate mama ।। 5 ।।
yathā na jīrṇatā tasyā vināśo na yathā bhavet ।
parivartanamapyasyāḥ kadācinna bhavet tathā ।। 6 ।।
sarvartusukhadāṃ śālāṃ kuru putra madarthikām ।
tathāstviti guruṃ prāha kariṣye tvatprasādataḥ ।। 7 ।।
athā'yaṃ gurupatnyā'pi samājñaptaḥ kuru prabham ।
kaṃcukaṃ mama yogyaṃ vai sūryavahnisamaṃ mṛdu ।। 8 ।।
na gāḍhaṃ na ślathaṃ cāpi vālkalaṃ sumanoharam ।
yasya dhṛtau na cānyāmbaradhṛtiḥ samapekṣate ।। 9 ।।
omityapi ca tāmāha tataḥ sa sevakaḥ śubhaḥ ।
guruputreṇa cājñapto mamārthaṃ pāduke kuru ।।1.477.1 0।।
carmādibandhanirmukte nityaśliṣṭe sukhaprade ।
yadārūḍhasya me caryā paṃke vārṣu sthale'nile ।। 11 ।।
omityapi ca taṃ prāha tato gurusutā''ha tam ।
bhūṣaṇe me karṇayogye karayogye tu kaṃkaṇe ।।12।।
kumārīkrīḍanīyāni dantidantamayānyapi ।
gṛhopakaraṇānyatra mūsalolūkhalādi ca ।। 1 3।।
pīṭhāni cāpi pātrāṇi sthālikā ujjvalāstathā ।
yathā'ṅgulyo na dahyante pāko yatra śubho bhavet ।। 14।।
ekastambhamayaṃ saudhaṃ vāyvādhāraṃ ca vastukam ।
omityāhāpi tāṃ tadvad vayasyā api taṃ jaguḥ ।। 15।।
svasveṣṭavastunirmāṇaṃ kartuṃ tāँścauṃ jagāda saḥ ।
tatheti saṃpratijñāya sarveṣāṃ purataḥ priye ।। 16।।
kiñcit kartuṃ na jānāti tena cintāparo'bhavat ।
aṃgīkṛtya gurorvākyaṃ na kuryānnirayī bhavet ।।17।।
guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ sadā'sti brahmacāriṇām ।
gurūṇāṃ vākyakaraṇāt siddhyanti hi manorathāḥ ।। 18।।
evaṃ vicintya sa yayau vanaṃ dadarśa tatra vai ।
tapasvinaṃ sa papraccha ko bhavāniti te namaḥ ।। 19।।
tāpasaḥ prāha taṃ tvāṣṭraṃ yo'smi, kiṃ te, vadātra me, ।
tvāṣṭraḥ prāha kalāśailpyaṃ vettuṃ jānāmi te mukhāt ।।1.477.20।।
tāpasaḥ prāha viśveśaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tapasā bhavān ।
tuṣṭaṃ karotu te śaṃbhurdāsyati mānasepsitam ।।21 ।।
ityuktvā'dṛśyatāṃ yātastāpasaśca tataḥ param ।
tbāṣṭrastrihāyanaṃ cograṃ tapaścacāra bhāvataḥ ।।22।।
tāvat prasanno bhagavān śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīpatiḥ ।
āvirbabhūva sahasā varaṃ dadau kalāmayam ।।23।।
sarvakalāstava buddhau prayāsyanti vikāsanam ।
gṛhāṇa mantraṃ śuddhyarthaṃ pātratārthaṃ ca manmukhāt ।।24।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
itimantraṃ sadā tvāṣṭra japa sampatpradaṃ śubham ।।25।।
kaṇṭhe kare ca tulasīmālāṃ gṛhāṇa puṇyadām ।
bhāle binduṃ gṛhāṇainaṃ kalātmakaṃ śubhāspadam ।।26।।
iti datvā haraḥ prāha vijñānaṃ ca tavepsitam ।
śrīkṛṣṇakṛpayā tvastu navakauśalyabṛṃhitam ।।27।।
tvaṃ suvarṇādidhātūnāṃ dārūṇāṃ dṛṣadāmapi ।
maṇīnāmapi ratnānāṃ puṣpāṇāṃ vāsasāmapi ।।28।।
karpūrādisugandhīnāṃ dravyāṇāmapyapāmapi ।
kandamūlaphalānāṃ ca tvaksārāṇāṃ tvacāmapi ।।29।।
sarveṣāṃ vastujātānāṃ śailpyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pravetsyasi ।
svāmināṃ rucyanusāraṃ ceṣṭaṃ kartuṃ pravetsyasi ।।।1.477.3 0।।
nepathyaracanāḥ sarvāḥ sarvāḥ sūpādisaṃskṛtīḥ ।
tauryatrikādikaṃ cāpi sarvaṃ jñāsyasi tattvataḥ ।। 31 ।।
yantrāyudhajalāvāsadurgatantukalādikam ।
aindrajālaṃ manojñānaṃ lokāntarakalādikam ।।32।।
atilokottaraṃ cāpi sarvaṃ vetsyasi mūlataḥ ।
bhaja kṛṣṇaṃ sadā tvāśu sa te jñānaṃ pradāsyasi ।।33।।
viśvakarmeti te nāma bhagavāँstvāṃ vadiṣyati ।
yadā tu rājā bhavitā divodāso vidhervarāt ।।34।।
tadā''nandavane tvaṃ me prāsādaṃ saṃkariṣyasi ।
rājā dravyavyayaṃ kṛtvā kārayiṣyati mandiram ।।35।।
viśvakarman vraja gurorājñāyāṃ tiṣṭha tat kuru ।
ityuktvā'ntarhitaḥ śaṃbhustvāṣṭro yayau gurorgṛham ।।36।।
omityuktāśca ye yatra śailpye te tena toṣitāḥ ।
pradāya tānyabhīṣṭāni gṛhītvā ca tadāśiṣaḥ ।।37।।
rañjayāmāsa tānsarvān kalākauśalyakarmabhiḥ ।
atha sāhāyyadāḥ kāntāḥ sasmāra kṛṣṇasannidhau ।।38।।
śrīkṛṣṇastvāvirāsīcca svamūrterdivyaśaktayaḥ ।
kṛṣṇecchayā vāmabhāgādutpannāḥ kanyakāstadā ।। 39।।
catuṣṣaṣṭikalā divyāḥ surūpā navayauvanāḥ ।
pātivratyaparāḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tvāṣṭraṃ pravavrire ।।1.477.40।।
patiṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ taṃ tvāṣṭraṃ tāḥ samprasevire ।
japaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ ।।41 ।।
dhyānaṃ prapūjanaṃ sevāṃ tvāṣṭre kṛṣṇasya cakrire ।
kṛṣṇaḥ prādurabhūttāsāṃ sannidhau ca samāntare ।।।42।।
kāntabhaktyā pratuṣṭaḥ sa tā dadurvaradānakam ।
atra sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā sṛṣṭyante māṃ prayāsyatha ।।43।।
bhavatīnāṃ na cānyo'sti dharmaḥ kāntasya sevanāt ।
kānte cā'haṃ kāntastvasmi mayā kāntaḥ prakīrtyate ।।44।।
yatra nā'haṃ na sa kānto na sā kāntā mayā vinā ।
tasyānmatpātivratyena kānte mokṣamavāpsyatha ।।45।।
indrādayo lokapālā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ।
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā vidyādharoragāḥ ।।46।।
ṛṣayo'psaraso yakṣā gandharvāḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ।
sarve madātmakāḥ santi viśvakarmā'hameva ca ।।47।।
tatpatnyo mā svāmirūpaṃ samārādhya ca māṃ sadā ।
kalpe kalpāntake muktiṃ yānti maccharaṇaṃ śubhāḥ ।।48।।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇaścāntardhānaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
tāstu kalātmikā divyāḥ patiṃ tvāṣṭraṃ siṣevire ।।49।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya kalākauśalamāpnuyāt ।
kathitaṃ te guroḥ patyurbhakte lakṣmi phalaṃ śubham ।।1.477.50 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tvaṣṭuḥ putrasya gurubhaktyā śaṃbhuvareṇa kalākauśalyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktyā catuḥṣaṣṭikalātmakapatnīlābhaḥ, tāsāṃ pātivratyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।477।।


tu. skandapurāṇam .4.2.86


← adhyāyaḥ 477 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 478
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 479 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi vyāsasya caritaṃ śubham ।
ānandakānane nityaṃ vasataḥ śāstraśevadheḥ ।। 1 ।।
babhāṣe tvekadā śiṣyān ślokaṃ paṭhantvimaṃ hi saḥ ।
vidyānāṃ tvāśrayaḥ kāśī kāśī lakṣmyāḥ parāśrayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
muktikṣetramidaṃ kāśī kāśī sarvā trayīmayī ।
kaśca brahmā śaśca śaṃbhuraśca viṣṇustrayo'tra vai ।। 3 ।।
brāhmī brahma parabrahma trayaḥ kāśyāṃ vasanti hi ।
bhogo mokṣastathā dāsyaṃ labhyante'tra trayo'pi ca ।। 4 ।।
karma jñānaṃ ca bhaktiṃ ca vindate mānavo'tra vai ।
etādṛśe vane tatra vyāsaḥ śrutvā pavitratām ।। 5 ।।
bhikṣārthaṃ kāśikāyāṃ sa babhrāma sarvatodiśam ।
na lebhe sa yadā bhikṣāṃ kopācchaśāpa kāśikām ।। 6 ।।
yato bhikṣāṃ na dadati garviṣṭhāścātra vai janāḥ ।
mābhūt traipūruṣī vidyā mābhūt traipūruṣaṃ dhanam ।। 7 ।।
mābhūt traipūruṣī muktirjaneṣu kāśivāsiṣu ।
datvā śāpaṃ parikṣipya bhikṣāpātraṃ ca niryayau ।। 8 ।।
atha gacchan mahādevyā gṛhadvāri niṣaṇṇayā ।
prākṛtastrīsvarūpiṇyā bhikṣāyai prārthito'tithiḥ ।। 9 ।।
bhagavān bhikṣukāstāvadadya dṛṣṭā na kutracit ।
asatkṛtyā'tithiṃ nātho na me bhokṣyati karhicit ।। 1.478.10 ।।
vaiśvadevādikaṃ kṛtvā pratīkṣate'tithiṃ sadā ।
tato'tithirbhavānadya bhava me svāmino dvija ।। 11 ।।
vinā'tithiṃ gṛhastho yastvannameko niṣevate ।।
bhuṃkte pāpaṃ gṛhapatiḥ sahitaḥ svapitāmahaiḥ ।। 12।।
tasmādāgaccha viprendra kuru me patyurīhitam ।
gārhasthyaṃ mama patyuśca bhikṣayā saphalaṃ kuru ।। 1 3।।
śrutvā savismayo vyāsaḥ papraccha tāṃ dayāparām ।
bhadre kā tvaṃ dharmamayī mūrtiḥ śāntipradā'tra vai ।। 14।।
tvāṃ vilokyā'ntarātmā me prasīdati śivā'si kim ।
yadvā lakṣmīḥ kamalasthā rohiṇī vā śaśisthitā ।। 15।।
kiṃ vā vārāṇasī cā''sse muktidevī ca vidyase ।
karuṇā vā svayaṃ yadvā madbhāgyaṃ pramadātmakam ।। 16।।
bhaktiryadvā bhavapatnī tvaṃ cānnadātrī haripriyā ।
sarvathaiva na nārī tvaṃ tvamasyabhīṣṭadevatā ।। 17।।
keyaṃ cintā'thavā me'tra kācit tvaṃ bhava sundari ।
yadi cet kathayeḥ svasyā bhikṣāṃ gṛhṇāmi bhāvataḥ ।। 18।।
ityuktā prāha gṛhiṇo'tratyasyaivā'smi kāminī ।
nityaṃ carantaṃ paśyāmi tvāṃ tu śiṣyagaṇairvṛtam ।। 1 9।।
tvameva māṃ no jānīṣe jāne tvāmahameva yat ।
tapasvin me svāminastvayātithyaṃ saphalīkuru ।।।1.478.20 ।।
vyāsaḥ prāhā'sti me kaścinniyamaḥ pūrito bhavet ।
ekabhikṣāṃ tadā'haṃ vai kariṣye nānyathā'dhikām।।21 ।।
satī prāhā'viśaṃkaṃ tvaṃ vada nyūnaṃ yato'tra na ।
vyāsaḥ prāhā'yutaśiṣyaiḥ saha paṃktimahaṃ vṛṇe ।।22।।।
satī prāhā'vilambena saśiṣyo bhava paṃktiśaḥ ।
siddhaṃ sarvaṃ mama patyuḥ pratāpād vartata'danam ।।23।।
ahaṃ na tādṛṅmahilā bhartṛyaśovighātikā ।
āyātyatithirbhavanaṃ tāvat siddhyati bhojanam ।। 24।।
paripūrṇāḥ sarvaśālāḥ paripūrṇamanorathāḥ ।
paripūrṇa gṛhe sarvaṃ patyuḥ pādaprasādataḥ ।। 25।।
ityuktaśca prahṛṣṭaśca saśiṣyaḥ paṃktiśo'bhavat ।
tāvatpātreṣu bhojyāni jalapātrāṇi candanam ।। 26।।
vyomatastvekakālena sthāpitāni vidhānataḥ ।
bhoktuṃ tvārebhire sarve vidhinā pariveṣitān ।।27।।
taddivyapākasaṃbhārān bhuktvā tṛptiṃ sulebhire ।
ācāntāḥ pūjitāstvete yāvad gantuṃ pracakramuḥ ।। 28।।
tāvat satī taṃ papraccha tīrthasthasya vṛṣo'tra kaḥ ।
yathā tadanusāreṇa tīrthe vartāmahe vayam ।।29।।
śrutvovāca satīṃ vyāso dharmāṃstīrthanivāsinām ।
sa eṣa dharmo nānyo'sti yastvayā paricaryate ।। 1.478.30 ।।
tvameva dharmaṃ jānāsi patiśuśrūṣaṇe ratā ।
yenaiṣa toṣamāyāti tava bhartā cirantanaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
satī prāha sa vai dharmaḥ pālyate'harniśaṃ mayā ।
sādhāraṇāni dharmāṇi sampṛcche tāni me vada ।।32।।
vyāsaḥ prāha śṛṇu sādhvi! nodvegaṃ janayet kvacit ।
manasā vacasā vā'tha kriyayā prāṇinaṃ sadā ।।33।।
parotkarṣaṃ vilokyaiva kāryā prasannatā hṛdi ।
vicārya sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ yena syādudayaḥ śubhaḥ ।।34।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā vyāsaṃ tvayyeṣu ko'sti tadvada ।
tvayā śāpaḥ pradatto yaḥ kāśīnivāsiṣu krudhā ।।35।।
udvegajanakaṃ tattu parotkarṣo na sahyate ।
vicārya na kṛtaṃ taddhi yena syādudayaḥ śubhaḥ ।।36।।
tvayokto niyamo bhagnastvayaiva śāpadānataḥ ।
evaṃ vai vartamānasya kāśī yogyā na vai tava ।।37।।
bahirgaccha sadā vyāsa mā'tra vāso'sti te kṛte ।
ityuktaḥ sa yayau pūrvarodhasi sarito'ntikam ।।38।।
kṛtvāśramaṃ śubhaṃ vyāso nityaṃ tiṣṭhati tatra vai ।
yatra vyāso gatastatra yayau devī sarasvatī ।। 39।।
kāśyāṃ muktā janā jātā ābālavṛddhamānavāḥ ।
viṣṇurūpāṇi sarvāṇi munayo vedapāragāḥ ।।1.478.40 ।।
yayuḥ sarvāṇi śāstrāṇi vyāsāśramaṃ śubhāśrayam ।
śaṃkarādyāstadā sarve mūkā āsan kṣaṇāt khalu ।।41 ।।
jñātvā tu kāraṇaṃ tatra vyāsaniṣkāsanātmakam ।
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīyukto yayau vyāsāśramaṃ tadā ।।42।।
natvā vyāsaṃ pūjayitvā cakāra stavanaṃ haraḥ ।
kṣamasva vyāsa maddoṣaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ।।43।।
garvanāśaka deveśa mūkā me nagarī yataḥ ।
vinā sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ vinā śāstrāṇi sarvathā ।।44।।
yatra santi na vai vedā yatra śāstraṃ na vidyate ।
yatra mantrā na vidyante mūkāstatra tu bhūsurāḥ ।।45।।
yatra sarasvatī nāsti na santi yatra paṇḍitāḥ ।
tatsthale layamityuktaṃ kāśīśūnyā'dya vidyate ।।46।।
tamobhāvena buddhervā garveṇā'vadamacyuta ।
kṣamasva tatkṛpānātha tvayā kṛṣṇena jīvavān ।।47।।
tvayā vyāpakadevena vasāmi śāśvate pure ।
samāgaccha kṛpāsindho mūkatvaṃ dūragaṃ kuru ।।48।।
ityarthitastadā vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ ।
śaṃkaraṃ pārvatīṃ prāha mūkatvaṃ tu tadā vrajet ।।49।।
sarasvatīnivāsaṃ cet karotu tava sannidhau ।
yadi tvaṃ sagaṇaḥ śaṃbho pūrṇāyāṃ prātimāsikam ।।1.478.50 ।।
prātastvatra samāgatya kuru me pūjanaṃ mahat ।
tadā sarasvatī tatrā''gamiṣyati mamā''jñayā ।।51 ।।
mandiraṃ tu sarasvatyāḥ pūrvasyāṃ tava sannidhau ।
prakāraya ca tatreyaṃ nityadā saṃnivatsyati ।।52।।
ityuktaḥ śaṃkarastvāha tathaumiti śivāyutaḥ ।
atha vyāsaḥ suśāstrāṇi vedāḥ sarasvatī tathā ।।53।।
yayuśca munayo viprāḥ kāśyāmūṣuryathāsthalam ।
sarvaṃ nirmūkatāṃ prāptaṃ viśveśvaro'pi modate ।।54।।
śaṃkareṇā'rpite saudhe tasthau mātā sarasvatī ।
vyāso nirmūkatāṃ datvā yayau naijāśramaṃ punaḥ ।।55।।।
śaṃbhuḥ śivā tathā devāḥ pūrṇāyāṃ prātimāsikīm ।
yātrāṃ kurvanti tatraiva yatra vyāsāśramo'sti vai ।।56 ।।
śaṃkareṇa saha sarve devāstīrthāni bhūtayaḥ ।
gacchanti vyāsapūjārthaṃ nirmūkatvasya siddhaye ।।57।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! sāmarthyaṃ śaṃkarasya vai ।
pārvatyāstatpātivratyaṃ vyāsasyaiśvaryamuttamam ।।58।।
śaṃkarasya sadā kṛṣṇe pātivratyaṃ paraṃ tathā ।
sarveṣāmapi devānāṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyane ca tat ।।59।।
pātivratyaṃ paraṃ yasya śravaṇātpaṭhanāttathā ।
bhuktirmuktirbhavellakṣmi! svepsitaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ।।1.478.6 0 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vyāsasya kāśyāṃ bhikṣāyā alābhe śāpastataḥ pārvatīkṛtā'tithisatkāraḥ, śaṃbhunā vyāsasya bahirvāsakaraṇam, vyāsena sarasvatyādyāhṛtaṃ, kāśīprajāyā mūkatā, śaṃbhurgatvāvyāsādīnānināya,mūkatānivṛttiḥ, pūrṇimāyāṃ vyāsatīrthaṃ kartavyamityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭasaptatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 478 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 478 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 479
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 480 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravadāmi kathāṃ vai vālmikeḥ śubhām ।
āsīt sumatināmā tu vipro bhṛgukulodbhavaḥ ।। 1 ।।
rūpayauvanasampannā tasya kāntā ca kauśukī ।
tasyāṃ putraḥ samutpannastvagniśarmeti nāmakaḥ ।। 2 ।।
sa pitrā procyamāno'pi vedābhyāsaṃ karoti na ।
athaikadā tvanāvṛṣṭyā lokāḥ saṃpīḍitāstvati ।। 3 ।।
sumatiḥ sakuṭumbo vai vane kṛtvā'śramaṃ sthitaḥ ।
ābhīrairdasyubhiḥ sārdhaṃ saṃgo'bhūdagniśarmaṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vane mārgeṇa tenā'tra ye niryānti janāstu tān ।
agniśarmā krūrakarmā hanti harati taddhanam ।। 5 ।।
saptarṣayaḥ pathā tena suvratāḥ samupasthitāḥ ।
agniśarmā hartukāmastāँstu sapta vilokya ca ।। 6 ।।
prāha vastrāṇi chatrāṇi pattrāṇādīni yāni vai ।
sarvāṇīmāni muñcadhvamanyathā mārayāmi vaḥ ।। 7 ।।
iti śrutvā'sya vacanamatriḥ prāhā'gnināmakam ।
asmatpīḍākaraṃ pāpaṃ brāhmaṇe vai kathaṃ tvayi ।। 8 ।।
samutpannaṃ vayaṃ tīrthayāyinaḥ smastapasvinaḥ ।
agniśarmā tadā prāha mama mātā pitā svasā ।। 9 ।।
bhāryā sutāḥ kṣudhitā vai vartante poṣayāmi tān ।
vinā'pahāraṃ kasmādvai poṣaṇaṃ syād vane'tra vai ।। 1 0।।
tasmāt karomi pāpaṃ tvavigaṇayya śubhā'śubham ।
atriḥ prāhā'gniśarmāṇaṃ śṛṇu tathyaṃ hitaṃ śubham ।। 1 1।।
pitrādīnanupṛccha tvaṃ svakarmopārjitaṃ prati ।
yuṣmadarthaṃ kriyate yatpāpaṃ tat kasya kathyatām ।। 1 2।।
cenna te kathayanti sma svīkurvanti na ced yadi ।
brūyustavaiva pāpaṃ cen mā mṛṣā prāṇino'vadhīḥ ।। 1 3।।
agniśarmā tadā prāha mayā pṛṣṭā na te kvacit ।
yuṣmadvacasā pṛcchāmi gatvā bhāvaṃ kuṭumbinām ।। 14।।
jānāmi tu yathā yūyaṃ tiṣṭhadhvamatra yāvatā ।
āgacchāmi punastvatretyuktvā''śu pitaraṃ yayau ।। 15।।
papraccha dharmaghātena prāṇihiṃsādikarmaṇā ।
mumahajjāyate pāpaṃ kasyaitat kathyatāṃ mama ।। 16।।
mātaraṃ cāpi papraccha pitarau prāhatuśca tam ।
tavaiva pāpaṃ putra syānnāvayoriti vai tataḥ ।। 17।।
tvayā kṛtaṃ tvayā bhogyaṃ bharaṇaṃ tvāvayoḥ kuru ।
atha bhāryāṃ jagādaivaṃ sā''ha pāpaṃ tavaiva tat ।।। 18।।
atha putrānsutāmāha svasāraṃ prāha te'pi tam ।
ūcuḥ pāpaṃ tavaivā'sti nā'smākaṃ tanmanāgapi ।। 19।
evaṃ svārthitvamājñāya vairāgyeṇa samanvitaḥ ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ pādayornatvā śocannuvāca tān dvijaḥ ।।1.479.20।
na me mātā na ca pitā na bhāryā na ca me sutaḥ ।
sutā svasā na me tvasti yataste svārthamātrakāḥ ।।21 ।
bhavantaḥ śaraṇāyātaṃ tatpāpāt trātumarhatha ।
atristaṃ prāha vṛkṣā'dhaḥ sthitvā dhyānaṃ samācara ।।22।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamūrteḥ pāpapuñjaṃ praṇāśaya ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।। 23।।
japa tvaṃ śraddhayā śaśvat tulasīmālayā kare ।
śrīkṛṣṇo hi svayaṃ tvatra tavoddhāraṃ kariṣyati ।।24।।
ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve so'pi dhyānaparo'bhavat ।
taddhyānastho'bhavad yogī vatsarāṇi trayodaśa ।।25।।
dhyāne sthitaḥ sadā mantraṃ jajāpa sasvaraḥ sa vai ।
vamrībhistu kṛtastasyopari valmīka ucchrayaḥ ।।।6।।
so'pi tatra niścalaḥ san dhyāyan jajāpa tattathā ।
notthito na.jalaṃ vānyat papau cakhāda vā kvacit ।।27।।
athaite ṛṣayastena pathā niryayurantikāt ।
śuśruvustaddhvaniṃ mantrajapasya vismayaṃ gatāḥ ।।28।।
dṛṣṭvā valmīkamevaite tadantaḥsthaṃ jaḍaṃ yathā ।
gaṃgājalena saṃskṛtyotthāpayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।।29।।
sa cotthitaḥ śanaistasmānnamaścakre munīśvarān ।
prāhā'haṃ tāritaḥ pāpāt saṃsārād ghorakarmaṇaḥ ।।1.479.30।।
japāmi taṃ kṛṣṇamantraṃ samuddhṛtaḥ kṛpālubhiḥ ।
prasādād bhavatāṃ jñānaṃ mayā tathyaṃ samarjitam ।।3 1 ।।
ante mokṣagatiṃ yāyāṃ kurvantvanugrahaṃ mayi ।
ityuktvā municaraṇaprakṣālanajalaṃ papau ।।32।।
munayastaṃ jagaduśca vālmīkiriti nāmataḥ ।
yayuste munayaḥ satyaṃ vālmīkistu hariṃ bhajan ।।33।।
trikālajñānamāsādya rāmakāvyaṃ cakāra ha ।
yenoddhāraṃ gamiṣyanti dehino'saṃkhyasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।34।।
yāvajjīvaṃ brahmavrataṃ paścādrakṣan sa bhaktarāṭ ।
pālayāmāsa kṛṣṇasya pātivratyaṃ hi śāśvatam ।।35।।
prātaḥ snānaṃ cakārā'sau sandhyāṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ ।
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇapatiṃ pārvatīṃ tvanalaṃ ravim ।।36 ।।
rāmādityaṃ saptadevān pupūja pratyahaṃ ṛṣiḥ ।
ṣoḍaśottamavastusaṃyuktabhāvaiḥ śubhā''ntaraiḥ ।।37।।
vanyaiḥ phalaistathā kandaiḥ patrairbījādibhiḥ sadā ।
naivedyaṃ tvarpayāmāsa jalaṃ kūpodakaṃ tathā ।। 38।।
vanyacandanakāṣṭhaiśca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
valkalādīni vastrāṇi dadau rāmāya pūjane ।।3 9।।
vallītantūpanītaṃ dadau puṣpāṇi bhāvataḥ ।
miṣṭaṃ madhu dadau kṣaudraṃ tatkālīnaṃ phalādikam ।।1.479.40।।
akṛṣṭapacyamṛṣyannaṃ sūryapakvaṃ dadau mudā ।
vahnipakvāni śiṅgvādibījāni pradadau tathā ।।41 ।।
mṛgāśca pakṣiṇaścānye paśavo bhayavarjitāḥ ।
rāmanāmaśravāstatra samāyānti mumukṣavaḥ ।।42।।
tiṣṭhanti sthairyabhāvena yāvatpūjā pravartate ।
rātrau vasanti tatraiva rāmanāmaśravotsukāḥ ।।43 ।।
tebhyo rāmaprasādaṃ sa patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ jalam ।
kandaṃ kaṇādikaṃ datvā tato bhuṃkte'tiharṣataḥ ।।44।।
vanyā atithayaḥ kvāpi samāgacchanti daivataḥ ।
kṛṣṇarūpāँstu tānmatvā sevate paramādarāt ।।45।।
na vismarati raṭanaṃ rāmarāmeti vai kṣaṇam ।
jātā'sya japasāmarthyād vāksiddhiranyadurlabhā ।।46 ।।
upatiṣṭhanti ratnāni vālmīkyabhīpsitāni vai ।
ekadā sa grīṣmakāle vane śuṣke'titāpane ।।47।।
phalapatradalahīne na labdhvā vai phalādikam ।
śuśoca śrīharernityanaivedyārthaṃ karomi kim ।।48।।
nāsti patrādikaṃ bhakṣyaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ dadāmi kim ।
iti sañcintya manasā tiṣṭhatyūṭajasannidhau ।।49।।
karoti śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarāmaharevibho ।
bhāvanāṃ me grasitvā'dya santuṣṭo bhava keśava ।।1.479.50।।
evaṃ vadati tatraiva kaścid gopāla āgataḥ ।
dogdhryā gavā yuto vatsatarāsaṃyuktathā'ntikam ।।।51 ।।
tamuvāca mune tvatra sthātumicchāmi vai kṣaṇam ।
yāsye vanāntaraṃ kṣaṇa viśramya tava cāśrame ।।।52।।
ityuktvā'śvatthachāyāyāṃ sthitaḥ kṣaṇaṃ gavā yutaḥ ।
dudoha parṇapuṭe tāṃ dugdhaṃ tasmai dadau mudā ।।53।।
vālmīkastvatisaṃhṛṣṭo jagrāha pūjanāya tat ।
devebhyastvarpayitvā tat prāsādikaṃ vibhajya ca ।।54।।
kṛṣṇanaivedyasaṃpūtaṃ papau tasmai dadau tathā ।
tāvattaddhṛdaye jātaḥ prakāśo'kṣarabrahmaṇaḥ ।।55।।
divyaṃ cakṣuḥ samudbhūtaṃ nirāvaraṇasatprabham ।
gopālaṃ taṃ dadarśā'sau śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhikāpatim ।।।56।।
kāmadhenuyutaṃ bhaktanaivedyārthaṃ samāgatam ।
punargopālamevainaṃ dadarśa māyayā hareḥ ।।57।।
atyāścaryabharaścā'yaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।
nityatṛptistathā jātā dugdhenā'sya hi śāśvatī ।।58।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāvadadṛśyo'bhūt kṣaṇāntare ।
vālmīkastaṃ divyarūpaṃ smāraṃsmāraṃ nanarta ha ।।59।।
nityaṃ sasmāra taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ divyaṃ bhaktadayākaram ।
sa eva rāmarūpeṇa valmīkena vyaloki vai ।।1.479.6 0।।
bhaviṣyaccaritaṃ sarvamadarśi karagaṃ yathā ।
nityaṃ sa rāthayāmāsa rāmādityasya cintanam ।।6 1 ।।
ante yayau harerdhāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ śāśvataṃ padam ।
nahi pāpakṛtāṃ cāpi kṛṣṇabhaktāvasadgatiḥ ।।62 ।।
anyoddhāramapi kartuṃ samarthā bhagavajjanāḥ ।
kāmaḥ krodho manojīvaścendriyāṇi ca vāsanāḥ ।।6 3 ।।
ta eva santi tadrūpāḥ kintu kṛṣṇasamāgamāt ।
jāyante divyarūpāste sarveṣāṃ muktidāyakāḥ ।।6 4।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'gniśarmaṇaḥ pātivratyatapasā vālmīkitvaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ muktiśca, saptarṣiyogād ṛṣitvaṃ, gopāladhenurūpeṇa kṛṣṇadarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।479।।


← adhyāyaḥ 479 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 480
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 481 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu pṛthvyāṃ śubhaṃ tīrthamavantīnagaraṃ ramam ।
yatrāste tvāpagā śiprā tāṃ yayau rāma ekadā ।। 1 ।।
satīyaḥ salakṣmaṇaśca tarpayāmāsa pūrvajān ।
lakṣmaṇaṃ tu tataḥ śiprājalamānetumuktavān ।। 2 ।।
lakṣmaṇastadanādṛtyovāca sītāṃ vadā'dhunā ।
yadyahaṃ vārānayeyaṃ sītā kiṃ te kariṣyati ।। 3 ।।
rāma nāhaṃ dāsabhāvaṃ sarvakālaṃ karomi te ।
iyaṃ supuṣṭā sudṛḍhā matto'pi pīvarā hyataḥ ।। 4 ।।
vada rāghava sītāṃ tvamanayā kiṃ kariṣyasi ।
lakṣmaṇoktamapūrvaṃ tacchrutvā rāmaśca jānakī ।। 5 ।।
saṃtasthaturvimanasau sītā vai jalamādade ।
tatra pītvā'tha bhuktvā ca mahākāleśvaraṃ yayu ।। 6 ।।
tatra vibhāvarīṃ nītvā rāmaḥ prāhā'nujaṃ prage ।
uttiṣṭha vatsa saumitre vrajāmo'nyasthalaṃ vanam ।। 7 ।।
saumitrirabravīd ruṣṭo nā'haṃ gantā kathaṃcana ।
vraja tvamanayā sārdhaṃ bhāryayā priyayā tava ।। 8 ।।
nāhamagraṃ vanaṃ yāmi na vā'yodhyāṃ kadāpi vai ।
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ saumitrimuvāca bhagavān svayam ।। 9 ।।
śanairāyāhi saumitre sītayā saha me'nuja ।
kathaṃ vai vartase roṣe kathaṃ vā saha nirgataḥ ।। 1.480.10 ।।
yatastvayā pragantavyaṃ śanaiḥ śanaistapasvinā ।
lakṣmaṇaḥ prāha yadyevaṃ kariṣye na vacastava ।। 11 ।।
kaiṃkaryaṃ na kariṣye te tadā yāmi vanaṃ saha ।
tathāstviti prāha rāmo lakṣmaṇastu śanairyayau ।। 12।।
athā'bravīt punarnā'haṃ gantā'smi vai tvayā vanam ।
ityuktvā niṣasādā'sau rāmo yāti puraḥ puraḥ ।। 1 3।।
athotthāya dhanuḥ kṛtvā sajyaṃ tatra niyojya ca ।
śaraṃ vicārayāmāsa rāmaṃ hatvā'tha jānakīm ।। 14।।
vaśaṃ karomi cāraṇye tāpasaḥ sarvadā sukhī ।
rāmaḥ śīghraṃ prayātyeva sītā'pi yāti vegataḥ ।।15।।
lakṣmaṇaḥ saśaraṃ cāpi kṛtvā moktuṃ śaśāka na ।
aho bhrātā kathaṃ vadhyo mātā'tra jānakī hi me ।। 16।।
pūjyā kathaṃ vaśaṃ neyā kā me bhrāntiriyaṃ nvaho ।
punaścaivaṃ vicāryā'pi śarā'dhīnamanāḥ punaḥ ।। 17।।
punardayāluhṛdayastāvat plakṣataruṃ puraḥ ।
rāmo dadarśa taṃ gatvā niṣasād hi tadbhuvi ।। 18।।
sītā'pyāgatya viśrāntā lakṣmaṇo'pi śanairyayau ।
rāmaḥ prāha kathaṃ bhrātaḥ kṛtaṃ vai saśaraṃ dhanuḥ ।। 1 9।।
lakṣmaṇo vrīḍayā namraḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ babhūva ha ।
antargataṃ viditvaiva rāmaḥ provāca bhūsthitim ।।1.480.20।।
na te lakṣmaṇa! doṣo'sti kṣetrasyā'sya hi ceṣṭitam ।
asmin kṣetre na saubhrātraṃ sarvo hi svārthatatparaḥ ।।21 ।।
parasparaṃ na manyante svārthaniṣṭhaikahetavaḥ ।
na śṛṇvanti pituḥ putrāḥ putrāṇāṃ ca tathā pitā ।।22।।
na ca śiṣyo gurorvākyaṃ gururvā śiṣyasevanam ।
svārthānubandhinī prītirna kaścit kasyacit priyaḥ ।।23।।।
etādṛśaṃ balaṃ tvasyā bhūmerasti mamā'nuja ।
na ca te tatra doṣo'sti mā vrīḍāṃ vraja cā'nagha ।।24।।
śrutvā natvā''ha saumitriḥ kathaṃ tvetādṛśaṃ sthalam ।
saṃjātaṃ yajjaḍamapi cetanān naḥ prabādhate ।।25।।
rāmaḥ prāha purā tvatra ghorakhanakanāmakaḥ ।
rākṣaso'bhūnmahāpuṣṭaḥ saptatālapramāṇavān ।।26।।
kāmarūpadharo vyomnā nagareṣu gṛheṣu ca ।
avātarāte coḍḍīya balād bhakṣyaṃ janādikam ।।27।।
apāharati krauryeṇa bālānnārīśca govṛṣān ।
ekagavyūtibhūmau sa vane kṛtvā''śramaṃ khalaḥ ।।28।।
adṛśyarūpaścarati pakṣyādikāṃśca khādati ।
kvacid bhavati śārdūlo mṛgo vā gavayaḥ kvacit ।।29।।
kvacid rājā kvacid vipraḥ kvacinnārī surūpiṇī ।
kvacit sarpaḥ kvacit kīśaḥ kvacid rūkṣo bhavatyapi ।।1.480.3 0।।
yathā yasya bhaved yogyaṃ rūpaṃ tadvān bhavatyasau ।
militvā cāpyuṣitvā ca sahayānaṃ vidhāya ca ।।3 1 ।।
karoti hiṃsanaṃ teṣāṃ viśvasya tān prakhādati ।
kvacittu kṛtrimaṃ ramyaṃ pattanaṃ nagaraṃ śubham ।।32।।
pradarśayati prajayā śobhitaṃ tvaindrajālikam ।
yatrā''paṇeṣu vaṇijāṃ dṛśyante hyudyamā navāḥ ।।33 ।।
kumārāṇāṃ śubhāḥ śālā udyānāni vanāni ca ।
mandirāṇi suramyāṇi rājasainyaṃ mahattamam ।।34।।
evaṃ gāndharvanagaraṃ vidhāpayati vai kvacit ।
athaikadā śrīgopālaḥ kambharābhāryayā punaḥ ।।35।।
tīrthayātrākṛte tena pathā divyā vinirgataḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śrīgopālo lakṣmyaṃśā kambharā satī ।।36।।
dṛṣṭau ghorakhananena mārgagau rakṣasā vane ।
atitejasvinau śāntau suprabhau sūryavarcasau ।।37।।
tāvattu sa manaścakre viśvāsya yogyakarmaṇā ।
rakṣasā cintitaṃ tvetau devabhāgyau yato mayā ।।38।।
daivajuṣṭaṃ sunagaraṃ sotsavaṃ saṃvidhāya ca ।
ātitheyena vidhinā sanmānyau bhakṣyakottamau ।।39।।
iti vicārya kṛtavān nagaraṃ divyamānavam ।
divyarājopakaraṇaṃ yajñaśālādiśobhitam ।।1.480.40।।
nagareśaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā nītvā'rghyaṃ ca tayoḥ puraḥ ।
yayau dūraṃ susatkāraṃ kṛtvā''nināya tau gṛham ।।41 ।।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ tau tu prāpaturdampatī tadā ।
pūjitau bhojitau pādasaṃvāhitau pratoṣitau ।।।42।।
viśrāntau viśramitau nidritāviva babhūvatuḥ ।
tāvat sa rākṣaso yāto grahītuṃ hetimulbaṇam ।।43।।
dampatyorviśasanārthaṃ tatkṣaṇe kambharāṃ satīm ।
prāha gopālakṛṣṇaḥ sa paśya kapaṭasevakam ।।44।।
ānetuṃ kambharālakṣmi! gato'sau karavālakam ।
rākṣaso'yaṃ mahāduṣṭo bahūnatti chalād vane ।।45।।
tasya nāśo mayā kāryastadarthaṃ tvahamāgataḥ ।
svasthā bhava kṣaṇaṃ sādhvi! paśya kāryaṃ kṣaṇaṃ mama ।।46।।
yāvadevaṃ hi bhagavān nivedayati patnikām ।
tāvat saṃgṛhya sutīkṣṇaṃ karavālaṃ samāgataḥ ।।47।।
athotthāya tadā tūrṇaṃ gopālakṛṣṇa eva tam ।
adṛśyena svarūpeṇa patnyā saha sthalāntaram ।।48।।
apasṛtaśca śayyāyāṃ dṛṣṭau tathā yathā purā ।
karavālena śayyāyāṃ matvā jaghāna yāvatā ।।49।।
karavālaṃ tadā śayyāghaṭṭitaṃ ca dvidhā'bhavat ।
ardhaṃ hastagataṃ rakṣaḥpādayoḥ patitaṃ ca sat ।।1.480.50।।
padāgrau chedayāmāsa yadardhaṃ tvagrabhāgakam ।
tattu proḍḍīya ca gale tīkṣṇāgraṃ lagnamulbaṇam ।।51 ।।
galo bhinnaścotpatito rākṣasaḥ kṣaṇamūrchitaḥ ।
dayāyukkaṃbharālakṣmīrjalaṃ pātuṃ ca taṃ yayau ।।52।।
tāvaddadhāra bāhubhyāṃ mumurṣurvairabhāvataḥ ।
bhakṣyecchayā nijagrāsaṃ kartuṃ yāvat samicchati ।।53।।
tāvat tayā'bhiśaptaḥ sa maraṇaṃ yāhi rākṣasa ।
etādṛśe'tra nagare śāṭhyaṃ karoṣi sarvathā ।।54।।
vañcayasicchaladharmā tasmātte bhūmikā sadā ।
chalātmikā vañcayitrī kāpaṭyakrūratāyutā ।।55।।
sadaiva bhavatu krūradharmaṇaste nivāsataḥ ।
anye'pyatra bhuvo yogācchalakrauryādidharmiṇaḥ ।।56।।
bhaviṣyanti na sandeho mitrāṇi śatravo yathā ।
svakīyāḥ parakīyāśca saṃgadoṣāddhi rākṣasāḥ ।।57।।
tena pāpena tu punarnārakā duḥkhabhoginaḥ ।
tava bhūmigatā sarve bhaviṣyanti janā'dhamāḥ ।।58।।
itiśapto yadā devyā rākṣasastāvadeva tu ।
prāṇāँstatyāja sa krūro nagaraṃ vilayaṃ gatam ।।।59।।
bhūmiraraṇyarūpā sā samabhūt kevalā sthalī ।
tadā sā kambharālakṣmīrviśeṣāścaryasaṃplutā ।।1.480.60।।
abhavad devadevāya papraccha jālakaṃ nu kim ।
gopālakṛṣṇaḥ provāca rākṣasasyaindrajālikam ।।61 ।।
sarvamāsīnmayā pūrvaṃ jñātameva hi sundari ।
rākṣaso'yaṃ mṛtaḥ svasya hastenaiva yataḥ punaḥ ।।62।।
yāsyati rākṣasīṃ yoniṃ rāmahastena vai punaḥ ।
āvayordarśanasevāphalena sa mariṣyati ।।63।।
tadā yāsyati muktiṃ sa so'tha dvīpe tu dakṣiṇe ।
vartiṣyate yadā rāmo gamiṣyati haniṣyati ।।64।।
ityuktyā tau yayatuśca sā bhūmiḥ rākṣasī purā ।
śaptā'sti tena yogena lakṣmaṇā'tra manastava ।।65।।
kuvicāraṃ tu kṛtavannātra doṣo manāṅ tava ।
deśaḥ kālaḥ kriyā saṃgo mantro dhyānaṃ ca dakṣiṇam ।।66।।
guruścaite yādṛśāḥ syustathā phalanti śiṣyake ।
rākṣasasya nivāsena bhūmiḥ sā śāpitā hyabhūt ।।67।।
bhūmeryogena saumitre krūraṃ te mānasaṃ hyabhūt ।
gatā bhūmistu sā bhrātaḥ svastho bhava sukhānvitaḥ ।।68।।
sītāyāḥ pātivratyasya balena mānasaṃ na vai ।
vikṛtiṃ tu samāpannaṃ mamāpi mānasaṃ na vai ।।69।।
yeṣāṃ patnīvrataṃ nityaṃ pātivratyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ tathā ।
teṣāṃ manasi bhūmyādi prasaṃgo naiva rohati ।।1.480.70।।
tvaṃ cāpi vartase bhrātarbrahmacārī sutāpasaḥ ।
ataste dhairyamadyāpi susthitaṃ vikṛte hṛdi ।।71 ।।
anye tu kalahaṃ kuryuravaśyamīdṛśasthale ।
vināśaphalamāpnuyurnāsti tatra hi saṃśayaḥ ।।72।।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa bhavanti sukhino janāḥ ।
patiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ parabrahma nārāyaṇo hariḥ prabhuḥ ।।73।।
sītā pativratā yasmādahaṃ vane'pi modavān ।
tādṛśaśca vratadhartā bhrātā me'tra vacaskaraḥ ।।74।।
nāsti ḍuḥkhaṃ mahāraṇye trayāṇāmekavartinām ।
svargaṃ mokṣo gṛhaṃ rājya sahaivāsti vane mama ।।75।।
ityetatkathitaṃ tvatra bhūbalaṃ prāk suśāpitam ।
atrā'smākaṃ pādasparśo jātastasmācchanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।।76।।
bhūbalaṃ krūratā rūpaṃ layameṣyati kālataḥ ।
bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ tīrthamavantīmaṇḍalaṃ mahat ।।77।।
ityuktvā prayayuragre vaneṣu vanacāriṇaḥ ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pativratāpraśāpanam ।।78।।
pātivratyabalaṃ cāpi deśādyanabhibhāvitam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya matistu vimalā bhavet ।।79।।
deśakālādisamprāptaḥ parābhavo na duḥkhayet ।
dharme matirbhavetpuṣṭā vratādau vimalā bhavet ।।1.480.80।।
yatheṣṭaphaladaṃ tvasya smaraṇaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet ।
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi śāśvatānandadaṃ bhavet ।।81 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne avantīyātrāyāṃ lakṣmaṇasya manaḥparivartanottaraṃ bhuvi tatra ghorakhanakarākṣasavāsena gopālakṛṣṇakṛtatannāśena ca śāpitabhūmi tathā lakṣmaṇamānasaduṣṭatā sītāyāḥ pātivratyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'śītyadhikacatuśśtatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 480 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 480 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 481
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 482 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
bhūyastu saṃpravakṣyāmi ṛṣipatnīkṛtaṃ vratam ।
tacchṛṇuṣva mayā''khyātaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam ।। 1 ।।
saptarṣīṇāṃ tu yā bhāryāḥ saptapatnyaḥ pativratāḥ ।
tāstu gaṃgāṃ gatāḥ snātuṃ dṛṣṭvā vahniṃ kuśasthale ।। 2 ।।
śaityena vepitāstaptuṃ gatāstā vahnisannidhau ।
vāstavo'gniḥ sa naivā''sīt kintu kṣiptaḥ sa gaṃgayā ।। 3 ।।
tejasvī śaṃkarasyā''sīddhāturve vahnisadṛśaḥ ।
śarastambe vahnitulyo vahninā'psu samarpitaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vahnimiśraḥ sa vai dhāturdṛṣṭvā snātapativratāḥ ।
tāsu praviṣṭaśca tadā vahninā preritaḥ kṣaṇāt ।। 5 ।।
garbhavatyastu tā jātā vijñātāḥ ṛṣibhistu tāḥ ।
evaṃ daivaparibhraṣṭā dūṣitā pāvakena vai ।। 6 ।।
ṛṣibhiḥ parityaktāstā babhramuśca vanādvanam ।
evaṃ bahugate kāle nārado vaiṣṇavaḥ paraḥ ।। 7 ।।
tāsāṃ śubhaṃ samicchan vai samāyāto vanāntare ।
tābhiḥ sa satkṛtastatra dhṛtavrato mahāmuniḥ ।। 8 ।।
samāsīnastā uvāca deśakālocitaṃ vacaḥ ।
kimidaṃ kriyate jāto bhavatīnāṃ parābhavaḥ ।। 9 ।।
kasmādvai ṛṣibhistyaktā lokamātṛpativratāḥ ।
tā ūcurhi vayaṃ tyaktāḥ kārtikeyaprasaṃgataḥ ।। 1.481.1 0।।
śaṃkarasya mahadvīryaṃ vahnāvāsīt kuśopari ।
vahniṃ jñātvā vayaṃ snātvā taptuṃ tatra gatā yadā ।। 11 ।।
agniḥ spṛṣṭvā guptarūpaḥ praviṣṭo no hi varṣmasu ।
dhātuścāsmadgarbhabhāge saṃlagno yonimaṇḍale ।। 1 2।।
tena jātāḥ sagarbhāśca vayaṃ duṣṭā iti sthitiḥ ।
yajñakāryakaraistaiśca vayaṃ tyaktāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ।। 13 ।।
lokāpavādajaṃ kiñcijjāta diṣṭavaśādagham ।
kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ kiṃ tapaḥ kā ca devatā ।। 14।।
yasyā''rādhanapuṇyena vrajāmaḥ pūtatāṃ punaḥ ।
etanniścitya vai brahmannatrā'smān vada tattvataḥ ।। 15।।
iti pṛṣṭo nāradastu dhyātvovāca hitāvaham ।
śrūyatāṃ bhostapaḥśreṣṭhaṃ bhavatīnāṃ sukāraṇam ।। 16।।
gayātīrthaṃ mahāśreṣṭhaṃ mahākālavanasthitam ।
tatrā'kṣayavaṭaṃ gatvā dhūtapāpā bhaviṣyatha ।। 17।।
bhādraśuklasya pañcamyāmupoṣaṇaparāyaṇāḥ ।
saṃkuruta vrataṃ jāgaraṇānvitaṃ supāvanam ।। 18।।
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣipatnyaḥ suharṣitāḥ ।
mahākālavanaṃ jagmuryatra tīrthaṃ gayābhidham ।। 1 9।।
tatra vaṭaṃ vilokyātha snātvā dānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ।
kṛtavatyastu tāḥ puṇyā bhādrasya dhavale dale ।। 1.481.20।।
pañcamyāṃ tāḥ samupoṣya jāgaraṃ tvaikanaiśikam ।
cakrustāḥ parapuṃsparśadoṣahīnāstadā'bhavan ।।।21 ।।
bhartṛkopavinivṛttāḥ sadyo yayurgṛhaṃ svakam ।
ṛṣibhiḥ svāgataṃ dattaṃ pūrvavadṛṣidṛṣṭibhiḥ ।।22।।
tadāprabhṛti loke'tra sā tithiḥ ṛṣipañcamī ।
nārīṇāṃ vratalābhāya kṛtā nārāyaṇena vai ।।23।।
lakṣmyā ca rādhayā gauryā prabhayā jayayā tathā ।
pārvatyā padmayā maṃjulayā māṇikyayā tathā ।।24।।
sāvitryā saṃjñayā śacyā menayā nāradānanāt ।
śrutvā vrataṃ kṛtaṃ tadvai ṛṣipañcamikātmakam ।।।25।।
parapuṃsaḥ sparśajanyaṃ māseṣu dvādaśasvapi ।
kāmā'kāmādisaṃsargajanyaṃ pāpaṃ ca yat striyāḥ ।।26।।
svalpaṃ vāpi mahaccāpi bhogā'bhogakṛtaṃ tu yat ।
rajasvalāhaḥsaṃsparśajanyaṃ vā sūtakādikam ।।27।।
aśuddhiḥ sparśajanyā yā gṛhopakaraṇādiṣu ।
jalabhojanapātreṣu sthale sarvatra vastuṣu ।।28।।
rājasvalyakṛto doṣaḥ sparśajanyaśca yo bhavet ।
bālakeṣu ca vṛddheṣu parādhīneṣu vāpi yaḥ ।।29।।।
dehasaṃsargajā doṣā kāmasaṃsargajāstathā ।
sarve naśyanti nārīṇāmṛṣipaṃcamikāvratāt ।।1.481.3 0।।
vratena ṛṣipañcamyāḥ śuddhyanti sarvathā striyaḥ ।
pavitrāstā bhavantyeva rājasvalyena sarvathā ।।3 1 ।।
nīvārāhārakaṃ kuryācchucirbhūtvā'balā naraḥ ।
na tayorjāyate kañcidāpadduḥkhaṃ kadācana ।। 32।।
durbhagatvaṃ na nārīṇāṃ na viyogaśca bhartṛbhiḥ ।
putrato dhanato vāpi na viyogo bhaviṣyati ।। 33 ।।
avantyāmīdṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate pāpanāśakam ।
atra dānādikaṃ kṛtvā labhate puṇyamakṣayam ।।34।।
yo vai niyamamāśritya kathāmetāṃ śṛṇoti ca ।
parve vā satataṃ so'pi hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।।35।।
pātivratyaphalaṃ patnī labhet paṃcamīpālanāt ।
akṣayaṃ ca harerdhāma saha patyā labhettataḥ ।। 36 ।।
sadhavā vā'pyadhavā vā kuryādetadvrataṃ param ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatiṃ santoṣṭuṃ śuddhikāmyayā ।। 37।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān śodhayitvā satījanam ।
rakṣiṣyati kṛpāluḥ sa pādayornijasevane ।।38।।
vrataṃ nārāyaṇe yena yathā vā'rpitamañjasā ।
tayoḥ kṛṣṇaḥ patiḥ svāmī bhaviṣyatyavitā dhruvam ।।39।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saptarṣipatnīnāṃ kārtikeyaprasaṃgenā'nalasparśajanyadoṣavāraṇārthamṛṣipañcamīvratamabhihitam, pātivratyamahimadarśanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 481 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 481 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 482
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 483 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kṛṣṇadvaipāyanavyāsasya ceṣṭitam ।
narmadāyāstaṭe'bhīṣṭārthanāṃ cāpi sumuktidām ।। 1 ।।
āsīt pūrvaṃ mahāśreṣṭhaḥ ṛṣirnāmnā parāśaraḥ ।
tena cograṃ tapastaptaṃ gaṃgāmbhasi samā daśa ।। 2 ।।
kuṃbhakaṃ prāṇaniyamaṃ kṛtvā sa jāhnavījale ।
praviṣṭaśca tataḥ pūrṇe dvādaśābde viniryayau ।। 3 ।।
bhikṣārthe sa gato grāmaṃ nāvi tatraiva saṃsthitā ।
tena dṛṣṭā śubhā bālā'kṣatā sudṛḍhayauvanā ।। 4 ।।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manmathā''viṣṭa uvāca madhurākṣaram ।
mā ramasvā'dya subhru tvaṃ mama cittapramāthinī ।। 5 ।।
ityuktā sā muniṃ natvovāca kvā'haṃ hi dhīvarī ।
kva tvaṃ munirmahānsādhuḥ saṃgamo yujyate na no ।। 6 ।।
ṛṣirdhyātvā'bravīt kanyāṃ na tvaṃ kaivartaputrikā ।
rājaputrī bhavasi tvaṃ śṛṇu janma vadāmi te ।। 7 । ।
vasunāmā tu rājā'bhūt somavaṃśe pratāpavān ।
jambūdvīpādhipaḥ kanye bahupatnīpatiḥ sa hi ।। 8 ।।
vaiṣṇavaḥ sa gurorbhakto rājyaṃ karoti dharmataḥ ।
mlecchāstasya virodhena śākadvīpanivāsinaḥ ।। 9 ।।
teṣāṃ sa vijayārthaṃ vai yayau sabhṛtyaputrakaḥ ।
saṃgrāmastu mahāñjāto vasunā hyavanibhṛtā ।। 1.482.1 0।।
jitā mlecchāḥ karadāste kṛtāḥ sakhaṇḍabhūbhṛtaḥ ।
tasya pradhānā mahiṣī svasyā saudhe rajasvalā ।। 11 ।।
jātā tayā preṣito vai dūto rājasamīpagaḥ ।
dūtaḥ sa śukarūpo vai pāṭhitaṃ mānavo yathā ।। 1 2।।
cañcvā gṛhītvā likhitaṃ patraṃ yayau vihāyasā ।
tvāṃ vinā paṭṭarājñīyaṃ ṛtukāle'pi jīvati ।। 1 2।।
ityevaṃ likhitaṃ tvāsīd bhūrjapatraṃ śubhākṣaram ।
gataḥ pakṣī yatra vasuḥ satyabhāmāsupreṣitaḥ ।। 14।।
lekhaṃ dadau śuko rājā vācayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।
svīyaṃ vīryaṃ samutpādya kṛtvā ca puṭikāṃ dṛḍhām ।। 15।।
śukāya cārpayāmāsa gaccha rājñīṃ pradehi tat ।
nṛpaṃ praṇamya cañcvā saṃgṛhya sa bījapuṭṭikām । । 1 6।।
utpapāta samudrasyopari tvāyāti vegataḥ ।
śukaṃ sāmiṣaṃ saṃkalpya śyenastatrāpi dhāvitaḥ ।। 17 ।।
hataścañcuprahāreṇa vīryapātraṃ papāta ha ।
jale matsyena gilitaṃ tatrā'patye babhūvatuḥ ।। 18 ।।
dāśairmatsyo gṛhītaścotpāṭitastāvadeva ca ।
yamalaṃ dadṛśurgarbhe śaśisūryasamaprabham ।। 19 ।।
harṣitāste dhīvarāstu dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ ca bālikām ।
putraṃ rājñe pradāyaiva putrīṃ te pratyapālayan ।। 1.482.20 ।।
sā tvaṃ kanye varārohe na hi kaivarta kanyakā ।
evamuktā tu sā datvā''tmānaṃ parāśarāya vai ।। 21 ।।
yadyahaṃ rājakanyā'smi matsyagandho nivartyatām ।
parāśareṇa tatraiva tapasā surabhīkṛtā ।। 22 ।।
jalayāne ca tāṃ muniḥ pasparśa divase yadā ।
sā prāha vrīḍitā lokāḥ prapaśyantyāvaraṃ kuru ।। 23 ।।
tadā parāśareṇāpi saṃdhyātā tāmasī satī ।
andhakārasvarūpā ca nihāravārisaṃbhṛtā ।। 24।।
jātā samantatastatra yatra naurnaiva dṛśyate ।
bālā'pyatiprasannā'bhūd reme brahmarṣiṇā saha ।। 25।।
bījadānottaraṃ tatrā'patyaṃ sā suṣuve kṣaṇāt ।
bālakaṃ tatra jaṭilaṃ subhagaṃ daṇḍadhārakam ।। 26 ।।
kamaṇḍaludharaṃ śāntaṃ mekhalākaṭibhūṣaṇam ।
dhṛtopavītakaṃ skandhe māyāguṇavivarjitam ।। 27 ।।
sā taṃ divyaṃ sutaṃ tatra parāśarasya saṃdadau ।
parāśareṇa sā bālā śubhāśīrbhirniyojitā ।। 28 ।।
mama yoge'pi kanyā tvaṃ nāmnā satyavatī satī ।
śantanornṛpateḥ patnī bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 29।।
prathamā mahiṣī tasya somavaṃśavibhūṣaṇā ।
ityuktvā sva sutaṃ nītvā parāśaramuniryayau ।। 1.482.30 ।।
natvā putraṃ parābhaktyā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇayena ca ।
taṃ prayāntamathā''lokya satyavratyabravīt sutam ।। 31 ।।
varo deyastvayā'bhīṣṭaḥ snehāste yadi mātari ।
kimapyupādiśa tvaṃ māṃ yena siddhimavāpnuyām ।। 32।।
putra uvāca mātastvamārādhaya hariṃ sadā ।
sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ sāraṃ śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu yat ।। 33 ।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
itijāpaṃ kuru mātarmokṣaste saṃbhaviṣyati ।।34।।
matsyagandhā tadā prāha kariṣyāmi tathā suta ।
parantu jananīnāṃ vai sutasya virahānalaḥ ।।35।।
sarvadā duḥkhadaḥ syāttu tasmānmā gaccha vatsala ।
tvadviyogādahaṃ putra pañcatvaṃ yāmi nā'nyathā ।।36।।
nāsti putrasamaḥ sneho nāsti bhrātṛsamaṃ balam ।
nāsti putrasamaṃ sthānaṃ viśrāntervṛddhatā''game ।।37।।
vyāsaḥ prāha viṣādaṃ mā mā kuru māṃ smara prabhum ।
paśya me yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ mokṣadaṃ divyamaiśvaram ।।38।।
ityuktvā darśayāmāsa tejaḥ koṭiśaśiprabham ।
tatra caturbhujaṃ rūpaṃ sakirīṭasukuṇḍalam ।।39।।
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śaratpaṃkajalocanam ।
īṣaddhāsyānanaṃ ramyaṃ tejaḥ paridhiśobhitam ।।1.482.40।।
satilakaṃ raktagaṇḍaṃ bimbauṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍaśābdikam ।
śrīvatsacihnaśobhāḍhyaṃ vanamālāvirājitam ।।41 ।।
raktacaraṇakarayostalaiḥ sukomalairyutam ।
candranibhanakharājirājitaṃ raśanāyutam ।।42।।
sakiṃkiṇīnaddhabhūṣādivyāmbaravirājitam ।
lakṣmīprabhājayāpadmāpārvatīmāṇikīyutam ।।43।।
nandasunandapārṣadagaṇasevitapatkajam ।
anantadāsadāsībhirjayaśabdaiḥ suvardhitam ।।।44।।
etādṛśaṃ divyarūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā satyavatīrūpam ।
mene nārāyaṇaṃ putraṃ mokṣadaṃ kṛpayā''gatam ।।45।।
tāvat tatrā''gataṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ koṭipārṣadaiḥ ।
sevitaṃ śrīramārādhālakṣmīdāsīvirājitam ।।46।।
mātaraṃ prāha mokṣaṃ te karomi bhavabandhanāt ।
rūpaṃ dvayaṃ kuru mātarmatprabhāvād yatheṣṭakam ।।।47।।
rūpeṇaikena maddhāma prayāhi pārṣadaiḥ saha ।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa kanyā'tra vasa mānavī ।।48।।
śantanostvaṃ bhāvinī vai gṛhiṇī rājyabhoginī ।
vaikuṇṭhe me viyogaste kadāpi naiva jāyate ।।49।।
ityuktvā jalamādāya gāṃgaṃ cikṣepa tattanau ।
sadyo dvayasvarūpā sā'bhavanmātā tadā kṣaṇāt ।।1.482.50।।
vyāsā''jñayaikarūpeṇā''ruroha tadvimānakam ।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa naukāyāṃ sā sthitā'bhavat ।।51 ।।
atha vyāsaḥ svarūpaṃ svaṃ divyaṃ tiraścakāra ha ।
yayau vimānaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ nītvā satyavatīṃ prasūm ।।52 ।।
naukāsthā māyayā tasya mohitā prārthayat satī ।
rakṣā kāryā mama putra pradeyaṃ darśanaṃ sadā ।।53।।
vyāsaḥ prāha tvayā mātarviṣādaḥ kārya eva na ।
āpatkāle tvayā'haṃ vai smartavyaḥ kāryasiddhaye ।।54।।
āpadastārayiṣyāmi kṣamyatāṃ mātarātmaje ।
yadā yadā tu smartavyaḥ sākṣād bhavāmi te puraḥ ।।।55।।
ityuktvā tu yayau vyāsaḥ parāśareṇa saṃyutaḥ ।
parāśaro yayau svasya kuṭyāṃ tapaḥparaḥ punaḥ ।।56 ।।
parāśarasutastatra niṣaṇṇo vanamadhyataḥ ।
nāradena samākhyātaṃ devebhyo vyāsajanma ca ।।।57।।
gaṃgātaṭe samājagmurbrahmādyā devatāstadā ।
bhānuḥ pitāmahaḥ śakraḥ sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ ।।58।।
dakṣādyāśca samājagmurnāradādyāśca gāyakāḥ ।
manavaḥ pitaro vedāḥ śāstrāṇyapi samāyayuḥ ।।59।।
devyaḥ sarasvatīlakṣmīśāradādyāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
nārāyaṇaḥ śivaḥ satyā sahitastvāyayau tadā ।।1.482.60 ।।
pitaro mānavā divyā divyadehāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
tīrthānyapi hradāścāraṇyāni vanāni cāyayuḥ ।।6 1 ।।
puṣpaiḥ saṃvardhito vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ ।
āśīrvādān pṛthag datvā sādhusādhvitibhāṣitaḥ ।।62।।
pitāmahena bālo'sau garbhādhānādisaṃskṛtaḥ ।
dvaipāyano dvīpajanmā pārāśaryaḥ parāśarāt ।।63।।
kṛṣṇarūpaḥ kṛṣṇanāmnā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ prabhuḥ ।
viriñcinā'bhiṣikto'sāṛṣisaṃghaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।।64।।
āśīrvādairvardhitaśca sarasvatyādibhistathā ।
stuto vedaiḥ prarakṣārthaṃ vyāsārthaṃ vyāsa saṃbhava ।।65।।
sarvaiḥ svatejasā dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
natvā sarvān śubhaṃ vavre sarvebhyo mānasaṃ tathā ।।66 ।।
ātmīya jñānamārgīyaṃ nirbandhanaṃ ca mokṣadam ।
tathāstviti tadā sarve procuścakrurmahotsavam ।।6 7।।
puṣpavṛṣṭirbabhūvā'sya mastake nanṛtuḥ striyaḥ ।
vedā mantrāṃstadā kṛṣṇavarṇakāṃśca jagurmudā ।।6 8।।
sarasvatīramālakṣmyādibhirmiṣṭānnabhojanaiḥ ।
bhojitāstatra cāyātāstāmbūlādibhirarcitā ।।69 ।।
vidhāturājñayotsavasamāhāraṃ pracakrire ।
svasvasthānaṃ yayuḥ sarve vyāsastīrtheṣu saṃyayau ।। 1.482.70 ।।
gaṃgā'vagāhitā tena kedāraṃ badarīsthalam ।
haradvāraṃ puṣkaraṃ ca nārāyaṇasarovaram ।। 71 ।।
dvārikāgomatīsnānaṃ camatkārapuraṃ tathā ।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastathā ।।72।।
nadīṃ bhadrāvatīṃ snātvā yayau vāmanasaṃsthalīm ।
raivatādriṃ dadarśāgre svarṇarekhā'vagāhanam ।।73।।
dāmodarasya ca nārāyaṇahrade'vagāhanam ।
balikhātabhuvaṃ gatvā somanāthasya darśanam ।।74।।
gopīnāthaṃ tathā natvā sābhramatīṃ pragāhya ca ।
narmadāṃ cāpi tapatīṃ vigāhya tryambakeśvaram ।।75।।
ujjayinīṃ tathā coṃkāreśvaraṃ sa praṇamya ca ।
tāmraparṇīṃ candrabhāgāṃ setubandhaṃ yayau tataḥ ।।76 ।।
punarāvya tīrthāni śrīśailādīni cādarāt ।
kṛtvā yayau jagannāthapuraṃ kāmākṣiṇīmapi ।।77।।
brahmaputrāṃ yayau paścāt kālīṃ kapilatīrthakam ।
gayāṃ kāśīṃ tathā'yodhyāṃ gaṇḍakīṃ ca prayāgakam ।।78।।
naimiṣaṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatīṃ yayau tataḥ ।
yamunāyāmavagāhya yayau vai narmadātaṭam ।।79।।
sāhlādaṃ narmadāṃ dṛṣṭvā cittaṃ viśramya śāntidam ।
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ ।।1.482.80 ।।
grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsu sthaṇḍileśayaḥ ।
sārdravāsāstu hemante dhyāyamāno hariṃ prabhum ।।81 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastasya pratyakṣo'bhūt kṣaṇāntare ।
dadāvāśīrvacanāni śukī patnyabhavattadā ।।82।।
śukaḥ putro'bhavaccāpi tvāgatāḥ ṛṣisattamāḥ ।
vyāsāśrame sthitāste tu vyāsena kṛtasatkriyāḥ ।।83 ।।
āraṇyāni suśākāni phalānyāraṇyakāni ca ।
tāni dāsyāmi sarveṣāṃ vyāsenaiva sabhājitāḥ ।।84।।
evamuktvā śucirbhūtvā narmadātaṭamāśritaḥ ।
tuṣṭāva narmadāṃ sā'pi pratyakṣā hyabhavat kṣaṇāt ।।85।।
narmadā prāha vacanaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ।
vyāso vavre yadi tuṣṭā yadi deyo varo mama ।।86 ।।
ātithyamuttare kūle mama dātuṃ tvamarhasi ।
narmadā prāha me mārgo dakṣiṇābhimukho yataḥ ।।87।।
kūlaṃ kathaṃ bhaveduttarastvaṃ svayaṃ vicāraya ।
tadā vyāsaḥ svayamagre cacāla mārgayādiśan ।।88।।
narmadā tatpathā yātā cakruḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ surāḥ ।
vyāsāśramaḥ kṛtastatra vyāsatīrthaṃ tato'bhavat ।।89।।
tatraiva narmadā sākṣānmūrtimatī sthitā'bhavat ।
vyāsaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sevate sā pativratā ।।1.482.90।।
vyāsoktena tu mārgeṇa yātā sā prathamaṃ satī ।
vyāsaṃ nityaṃ snāpayati nijanirmalavāriṇā ।। 91 ।।
naivedyajalapuṣpāditāmbūladhūpadīpakaiḥ ।
sevate satataṃ vyāsaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ satī ।। 92।।
evaṃ pātivratyaparā vartate narmadā sadā ।
tatra snānaṃ janāḥ kṛtvā pūjayitvā hariṃ satīm ।।93।।
pātivratyaphalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāpsyanti niścitaṃ rame ।
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccāpi labhettattīrthajaṃ phalam ।।94।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parāśarād vyāsasya janma, matsyagaṃdhāyā janmavṛttāntaḥ, vyāsasya tīrthabhramaṇaṃ narmadātīre vāso narmadāyāḥ pātivratyaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 482 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 482 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 483
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 484 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi tvanasūyāṃ pativratām ।
atrirnāmnā'bhavattasyāḥ patirvai brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ ।। 1 ।।
agnihotrarato nityaṃ devatā'tithipūjakaḥ ।
anasūyā'pi tatprāṇā patikāryahite ratā ।। 2 ।।
pativratā patiṃ bheje kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yathā ।
evaṃ kāle gate'patyaṃ dampatyornā'bhavattadā ।। 3 ।।
sukhāsīnau pravadataḥ sukhaduḥkhāni karmabhiḥ ।
atriḥ prāha priye kānte trailokye sacarācare ।। 4 ।।
na tvayā sadṛśī loke sarvadā me hite ratā ।
patiputrapriyā nārī lokāñjayati dustarān ।। 5 ।।
putreṇa lokāñjayati putreṇa paramā gatiḥ ।
nāsti putrasamo bandhuḥ pṛthivyāṃ cātra dṛśyate ।। 6 ।।
asipatravane yāmye patantaṃ yo'bhirakṣati ।
durbhikṣeṣvapi dainyādau vṛddhakāle'pi satsutaḥ ।। 7 ।।
putraṃ vinā tu kiṃ bhadre yatirvāpi sutaḥ priye ।। 8 ।।
lokalajjāpreritaśca tārayet pitarau hi saḥ ।
putrahīne kathaṃ saukhyamiha loke paratra ca ।। 9 ।।
divāniśaṃ cintayānaḥ śuṣyāmi śarma no labhe ।
anasūyā'pi taṃ śrutvā prāhā'haṃ śocayāmi tat ।। 1.483.1 0।।
tavodvegakaraṃ yacca māmudvejayati prabho ।
yena putrā bhaveyurme yena tuṣyet prajāpatiḥ ।। 11 ।।
atriḥ prāha mayā bhadre tapastaptaṃ sudāruṇam ।
vratopavāsairniyamaiḥ śākāhārādibhiḥ priye ।। 1 2।।
kṣīṇaṃ dehamaśakto'haṃ janmaprabhṛti tāpasaḥ ।
vārdhakyaṃ dṛśyate dehe prasthānaṃ pāralaukikam ।। 1 3।।
nā'tidūraṃ dṛśyate'tra tathyaṃ tubhyaṃ niveditam ।
anasūyā'ha taṃ bhartarnārī pativratā'smi te ।। 14।।
trivargasādhanā cā'smi patiputravivardhinī ।
bhavatastvājñayā taptvā bhaviṣyāmi sutaprasūḥ ।। 15।।
japastapastīrthayātrāputrejyāmantrasādhanam ।
pativratāṃ vadantyeva guravo lokarakṣakāḥ ।। 16।।
anujñātā ca duḥkhe'haṃ tapastapsyāmi dāruṇam ।
putrārthinī bahudinānyahaṃ viṣṇuṃ prayāmi ca ।। 17।।
atriḥ prāha samīcīnaṃ mama santoṣakārakam ।
anujñātā mayā bhadre putrārthaṃ tapa ācara ।। 18।।
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niyojayet ।
devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṇāmanṛṇaṃ kuru ।। 1 9।।
na bhāryāsadṛśaṃ potaṃ tārakaṃ tvaparaṃ matam ।
nahi devāḥ praśaṃsanti sadbhāryārahitaṃ gṛham ।।।1.483.20।।
śuṣkaṃ bhavati vai cānyad bhāryayā rahitaṃ sukham ।
sammukhe sammukhā''yāti vilome tu parāṅmukhī ।।21 ।।
ato bhāryā praśaṃsāyā āspadaṃ gṛhamedhinām ।
pativrate mahābhāge sarvadā hitakāriṇi ।।22।।
tapaścarasva saphalaṃ putrapradaṃ mamā''jñayā ।
patyājñā viṣṇuvacanaṃ saphalaṃ syāt priye tvayi ।।23।।
tavecchā vartate sāpi drāk saphalayatu prabhuḥ ।
evaṃ prasannatāṃ patyuḥ samāgṛhya pativratā ।।24।।
svakārye sabalā bhūtvā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇatā'bravīt ।
tvatprasādena viprendra sarvametadavāpnuyāt ।।।25।।
āśīrvādairyojitā cānasūyā vai pativratā ।
haṃsalīlāgatitīvrā prāptā'sau narmadātaṭam ।।26।।
narmadottaratīre sā'bhavatparṇāśanā tathā ।
niyamasthā'bhavannityaṃ śākāhārā kvacit kvacit ।। 27।।
stotraparā hṛdā devān śubhaiḥ stotraiśca saṃyatā ।
grīṣmeṣu sā'bhavanmadhye pañcāgnitejasāṃ divā ।।28।।
varṣāyāṃ sā'varṇyacca cāndrāyaṇaṃ bahiḥ sthitā ।
hemante jalavāsā cā'karot triṣavaṇaṃ satī ।।29।।
devānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ samarcanaṃ ca havanaṃ tathā ।
naivedyaṃ sotsavaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ stotraṃ kṣamārthanam ।।1.483.3 0।।
akarot sā vane nityahariṇyādisahāyinī ।
evaṃ varṣaśate yāte viṣṇurudrapitāmahāḥ ।।3 1।।
kṣutkṣāmāṃ tāpasīṃ putrārthinīṃ jñātvā samāyayuḥ ।
dvijarūpeṇa te devā eraṇḍyāḥ saṃgamasthale ।। 32।।
āgatya vedamantrāँścoccārayanti tapaḥsthale ।
śrutvā vedasya mantrāँścā'nasūyā premapūritā ।।33।।
īkṣamāṇā muhustāṃ tu diśāṃ samutthitā sthalāt ।
dṛṣṭvā''śramagatān viprānatithīnarghyamādadau ।।34।।
teṣāṃ caraṇānprakṣālya papau śirasi cā'karot ।
adya me saphalaṃ janma viprāṇāṃ darśanena vai ।।35।।
adya me saphalaṃ kāryaṃ tapo viprapradarśanāt ।
adya me bhūmikā ceyaṃ saphalā brāhmaṇāgamāt ।।36।।
ityuktvā pādayornatvā cakre pradakṣiṇaṃ muhuḥ ।
punaḥ sāṣṭāṃganamanaṃ kṛtvā satkāramabravīt ।।37।।
kandamūlaphalairdivyairadyāhaṃ tarpayāmi vaḥ ।
parṇakuṭyāṃ ca viśrāntiṃ yāta darbhāsanādiṣu ।।38।।
iti śrutvā tu te viprā ūcustāṃ tāpasīṃ satīm ।
tapasā cātitīvreṇa tava satyena suvrate ।।39।।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa tṛptāḥ sma tava darśanāt। ।
asmākaṃ kautukaṃ jātaṃ kimarthaṃ tapyate tvayā ।।1.483.40 ।।
svargaṃ vā lokasampattiṃ mokṣaṃ vā cānyadeva vā ।
kimiṣyate tvayā sādhvi! tapasā duṣkareṇa vai ।।41 ।।
tapasā siddhyati svargastapasā tu parā gatiḥ ।
tapasā sarvakāmānāṃ siddhirbhavati puṣkalā ।।42।।
yauvane tu sadā bhogā bhoktavyā manasepsitā ।
tāँstu sarvān vihāyā'tra kuto hetorviśuṣyasi ।।43।।
anasūyā tu tacchrutvā provāca surapuṃgavān ।
yuvatve tu tapaḥ kāryaṃ yuvatve paramā gatiḥ ।।44।।
yuvatve ca sutotpattirvṛddhatve sarvamapriyam ।
ityuktā devavaryāste sādhu sādhviti cā'bruvan ।।45।।
viprarūpāṇi vivṛtya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।
trayaḥ sākṣāttu te bhūtvā varaṃ vṛṇviti cā'bruvan ।।46।।
yattvayā cābhilaṣitaṃ dadmaḥ sarvaṃ vadādhunā ।
caturbhujo vāsudevaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ।।47।।
garuḍena sahitaśca śriyā ca sahito'bhavat ।
prasannavadano brahmā caturvadanaśobhitaḥ ।।48 ।।
haṃsasāvitrikāyuktaścā'kṣamālākaro'bhavat ।
vṛṣabhaṃ tu samārūḍhaḥ pārvatīsahitaḥ śivaḥ ।।49।।
pañcavaktrastrinetraśca daśabāhusamanvitaḥ ।
ityetān pūjanīyāँśca devān dṛṣṭvā ca tāpasī ।।1.483.50।।
ānanditā'bhavat tūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā natvā hyuvāca tān ।
kiṃvyāpārāśca ke yūyaṃ viṣṇurudrapitāmahāḥ ।।51 ।।
tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi vadatātra dayādavaḥ ।
brahmovāca sati! prāvṛṭkālo'haṃ ca jalaṃ tathā ।।52।।
megho'haṃ ca pravarṣāmi sandhyā'haṃ pūrvadaiśikī ।
viṣṇuruvāca hemantaścāhaṃ puṣṇāmi sarvathā ।।53।।
pālanīyaṃ jagat sarvaṃ mamā'sti kāryamuttamam ।
rudraḥ prāha sati! cāhaṃ grīṣmakālaḥ kṣayaṃkaraḥ ।।।54।।
śoṣayāmi jagatsarvaṃ rudrarūpastapasvini! ।
evaṃ vayaṃ trayo devāstrayaḥ kālāstrayo'gnayaḥ ।।।55।।
tisraḥ sandhyā bhavāmaśca nityamekatvamāgatāḥ ।
varaṃ dadmaśca te bhadre yatte manasi vartate ।।56।।
anasūyā samuvāca vandhyā'smi kiṃ vṛṇe surāḥ ।
mama putrā bhavatā'tra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।।57।।
viṣṇuruvāca tāṃ devīṃ bhadre na varadāḥ sutāḥ ।
bhavanti kintu tattulyā bhavanti varadānataḥ ।।58।।
bhadre dadāmi tānputrān devatulyaparākramān ।
pitṛtulyaguṇopetān somayājibahuśrutān ।।59।।।
anasūyā ca tānprāha dātavyamīpsitaṃ mama ।
varadānakṛte yogyā yadyasti yāta putratām ।।1.483.60 ।।
nānyathā tattu kartavyaṃ vasatā'dya mamodare ।
viṣṇuruvāca tāṃ devīṃ garbhavāse na vai vayam ।।6 1 ।।
āyāmaḥ kintu vāyuste garbhe sthāsyati garbhavat ।
sagarbhamudaraṃ te tu vāyuḥ pradarśayiṣyati ।।62।।
navamāsottare kāle prasūteśca gṛhe vayam ।
āgamiṣyāma aiśvaryasahitāstvadgṛhe śubhe ।।63।।
vāyorniḥsaraṇe kāle vayaṃ bālasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
traya eva bhaviṣyāmaścā'yonisaṃbhavāḥ sutāḥ ।।64।।
yonivāsaṃ tu vai devā naiva yānti śubhāśrayāḥ ।
ityuktvā bālarūpāste'dṛśyanta vai kṣaṇaṃ tadā ।।65।।
atha yayuḥ svakaṃ dhāma divyavāhanasaṃśritāḥ ।
prāptā varaṃ tu sā devī kṣīṇadehā yayau gṛham ।।66 ।।
śilātale niṣaṇṇaṃ sā'paśyat kāntaṃ mahāvratam ।
nanāma praṇatā tasya pādau prakṣālya sā papau ।।67।।
kuśalaṃ pṛṣṭhā provāca kṛpayā te phalānvitā ।
nirvighnā varamādāya sevāyāmāgatā'smi vai ।।68 ।।
patipuṇyena sādhyāśca phalanti tviṣṭapādapāḥ ।
putratrayaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśākhyaṃ mayā'rjitam ।।69।।
bhagavatpādasevāyāḥ phalaṃ prāptaṃ cireṇa vai ।
asādhyaścānyanārīṇāṃ varaḥ prāptaḥ sudurlabhaḥ ।।1.483.70।।
tenā'haṃ te prayacchāmi putrānṛṣitapodhanān ।
ityuktā harṣitā samyakkāntasevāparā'bhavat ।।71 ।।
sā'lokayat patiṃ kāntaṃ kāntena sā'valokitā ।
darśanādeva sañjātaṃ lalāṭe maṇḍalaṃ prabham ।।72।।
amūlaṃ dīrghamūlaṃ ca triraṃgaṃ golakaṃ śubham ।
tejomayaṃ sahasrādiraśmijālasamāvṛtam ।।73 ।।
tasya madhye trayo devā hyabhāsanta kṣaṇāntare ।
devairājñāpito vāyurgarbhasthāne'vasat sadā ।।74।।
anasūyā garbhavatī tejasā tvabhavacchubhā ।
atha māseṣu navasu yāteṣu daśame yathā ।।75।।
yogye tu samaye sādhvī sūtikāgṛhamāviśat ।
vāyurgarbhānniḥsasārā'bhavan devāstu bālakāḥ ।।76।।
hemavarṇaḥ pūrvaputro brahmā'bhavat pitāmahaḥ ।
candramāḥ ṣoḍaśakalaḥ somaḥ poṣaṇadāyakaḥ ।।77।।
sa cā'yaṃ prathamaḥ putro'nasūyāyāstu nandanaḥ ।
dvitīyastu mahābhāgaḥ svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ ।।78।।
sṛṣṭisaṃhārakaḥ soṃ'śo durvāso nāmato'bhavat ।
tṛtīyastvabhavatputro viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।79।।
dattātreyo mahāyogī bhagavān śrīpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
jagadvyāpī jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ devo janārdanaḥ ।।1.483.80 ।।
evaṃ prāpya satī pativratā putratrayaṃ varam ।
kṛtakṛtyā'bhavat sā hi muniratristathaiva ca ।।8 1 ।।
trayaste jātamātrāstu yuvānaścābhavan priye ।
satī lakṣmīśca sāvitrī divyāstatra samāgatāḥ ।।82 ।।
ravasvapatīnāṃ sevārthamanasūyāṃ praṇamya tāḥ ।
vadhvaḥ siṣevire devān jalabhojanacandanaiḥ ।।83।।
trayaste darśanaṃ daduḥ pitrordivyasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
sarvasmṛddhimayaṃ tvatrergṛhaṃ tairvai kṛtaṃ sadā ।।84 ।।
devāśca munayaḥ siddhāḥ ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ।
devyaśca pārṣadā gaṇā nityamāyānti dṛṣṭaye ।।।85।।।
atrerāśramamākīrṇaṃ vartate devakoṭibhiḥ ।
nityaṃ yajñāḥ pravartante tathotsavā dine dine ।।86 ।।
atha devāstrayastvete pitarāvāhurādarāt ।
tapastaptuṃ samicchāmo yāsyāmo'to vanāntaram ।।87।।
mātā śrutvā śokamagnā hyabhavat putragardhinī ।
uvāca putrāḥ saukhyārthaṃ tapastaptaṃ mayā yataḥ ।।88 ।।
lālanārthaṃ pālanārthaṃ saukhyārthaṃ traya eva hi ।
darśanārthaṃ ca sevārthaṃ mayā devā sutīkṛtāḥ ।।89।।
kathaṃ te'smān vihāyaiva tapase yāsyathā'cyutāḥ ।
sahiṣyate viyogo na tasmād gantavyameva naḥ ।।1.483.90।।
śrūtvā devāstrayo māturdadhū rūpadvayaṃ tataḥ ।
divyarūpairyayuḥ tapaḥkaraṇārthaṃ sthalāntaram ।।91 ।।
durvāsāḥ saṃyayau naijaṃ kailāsaṃ śivasannidhau ।
candramāḥ satyalokaṃ ca datto dvīpāntaraṃ yayau ।।92।।
atha bālasvarūpāste trayo bhūtvā gṛhe nije ।
māturaṃke ramamāṇā vartante prākṛtā iva ।।93।।
pituraṃke ramamāṇā āśrame viharanti te ।
hariṇānāṃ bālakaiste mṛgapakṣibhirityapi ।।94।।
tāpasaiḥ saha vartante prākṛtā bālakā iva ।
bālakhelanakairdevapūjanaiḥ pitṝañjanaiḥ ।।95।।
yāpayanti divasāँste mātāpitṛsukhapradāḥ ।
evaṃ vai tapasā prāptāstrayo devāḥ ṛṣeḥ sutāḥ ।।96 ।।
yajñopavītamāgṛhya vedādhyayanamācaran ।
yajñakāryāṇi nityaṃ te cakruratreḥ purastrayaḥ ।।97।।
atrereva gṛhītaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।
mantraśca tulasīmālā taistu vaiṣṇavapuṃgavaiḥ ।।98।।
ciraṃjīvāstrayaste ca sarvalokagatikṛtaḥ ।
vartante tārakā divyā vaiṣṇavāḥ kulatārakāḥ ।।99।।
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi! divyākhyānaṃ paraṃ śubham ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ matam ।। 1.483.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'treḥ patnyā'nasūyayā tapasā brahmaviṣṇumaheśāḥ somadattadurvāsasaḥ putrā labdhāḥ pātivratyabalaṃcetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 483 ।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! ca rohiṇyā purā kṛtatapaḥparam ।
yenā''ptā candrapatnīnāṃ maurdhanyaṃ sarvadā satī ।। 1 ।।
abhīṣṭā sarvanārīṇāṃ bhartuścāpi viśeṣataḥ ।
ekadā niścayībhūtā tapase sā pativratā ।। 2 ।।
gatvā tu narmadātīre cakāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ ।
ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ ca ṣaḍ dvādaśa tathā'paraiḥ ।। 3 ।।
pakṣamāsopavāsaiśca kṛśīkṛtakalevarā ।
ārādhanaparā nityaṃ nārāyaṇagurorhareḥ ।। 4 ।।
snātvā snātvā jale nityaṃ narmadāyā harau ratā ।
pūjayati sma govindaṃ nārāyaṇīpatiṃ prabhum ।। 5 ।।
prasanno bhagavānnārāyaṇīsvāmī narāyaṇaḥ ।
uvācā'haṃ prasanno'smi vratena niyamaiśca te ।। 6 ।।
dadāmyabhīpsitaṃ te'dya varaṃ vṛṇu mahāsati! ।
evaṃ śrutvā vacastasya natvā saṃpūjya bhāvataḥ ।। 7 ।।
pādayostu jalaṃ pītvā bhūtvā darśanapāvanī ।
varaṃ vavre rohiṇī sā dāsyaṃ te caraṇāmbuje ।। 8 ।।
prathamaṃ tadvaraṃ dehi bhaktistvayi viśeṣiṇī ।
atha dvitīyaṃ ca varaṃ loke candragṛhe sadā ।। 9 ।।
sarvāsāṃ tu sapatnīnāmadhikā śaśinaḥ priyā ।
yathā bhavāni hyacirāt tvatprasādāttathā kuru ।। 1.484.1 0।।
hariḥ prāha svarūpe dve dhārayā'smatprasādataḥ ।
ekena yāhi vaikuṇṭhaṃ dvitīyenātra saṃvasa ।। 11 ।।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa bhava tvaṃ śaśinaḥ priyā ।
bhāryā pativratā sarvasapatnīnāṃ samagraṇīḥ ।। 1 2।।
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yayau svakam ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tāṃ satīṃ nītvā vimānena vihāyasā ।। 1 3।।
sā tu dvitīyarūpā ca yayau candramaso gṛham ।
tata ārabhya sā jātā mūrdhanyā sarvayoṣitām ।। 14।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tapasaḥ phalamuttamam ।
svargamokṣapradaṃ ramyaṃ mamā''rādhanarūpakam ।। 15।।
athā'nyatte pravakṣyāmi muktidaṃ caritaṃ mama ।
dakṣasya duhitā tvāsīt kumudā nāma viśrutā ।। 16।।
somāya datvā tān dakṣo paramaṃ maudamāptavān ।
tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa putramamṛtanāmakam ।। 17।।
atha jñātvā surā yajñaphalārthino yayuśca tam ।
amṛtaṃ pītavantaste jñātvā daityāstato yayuḥ ।। 18।।
candramasaṃ ca te prāhurdehi no'mṛtamuttamam ।
pānārthaṃ tvanyathā tvāṃ vai bhakṣayiṣyāma eva yat ।। 1 9।।
cando neyeṣa dātuṃ tvamṛtaṃ tebhyastato hi te ।
taṃ candraṃ jagṛhuḥ svargātpātayāmāsurambarāt ।।1.484.20 ।।
hāhākāro mahān jātaḥ kumudā tasya kāminī ।
pātivratyena dharmeṇa jalaṃ kṛtvā kare tadā ।।।21 ।।
uvācā'haṃ patidharmā pativratā patisthitā ।
pātivratyabalenaite dānavā yāntu saṃkṣayam ।।22।।
ityuktvā vāri cikṣepa dānaveṣu tatastu te ।
bhasmībhūtāstadā jātāḥ śeṣāḥ śukraṃ guruṃ prati ।। 23।।
yayurnivedayāmāsurdaityānāṃ bhasmabhāvanam ।
śukrastatra samāgatya jīvayāmāsa cāsurān ।।24।।
nanāma kumudāṃ śukro daityā nemuryayurgṛham ।
candraḥ kumudayā svasāmarthyenotthāpito bhuvaḥ ।।25।।
atha brahmamaheśādyairāgatya viśramīkṛtaḥ ।
punaḥ saṃsthāpitaḥ svarge devā babhūvurajvarāḥ ।।26।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pātivratyabalaṃ mahat ।
sarvasampatkaraṃ vighnaharaṃ saubhāgyavardhanam ।।27।।
athā'nyamapi vakṣyāmi camatkāraṃ śṛṇu priye ।
narmadāyāṃ catūsaṃge vartate yajñaparvataḥ ।।28।।
svayaṃbhuvā purā tasminniṣṭaḥ sautrāmaṇirmakhaḥ ।
tatraiveṣṭaṃ maghavatā hayamedhena padmaje ।।29।।
niṣkrāntā parvatāttasmāccatūnāmamahānadī ।
patitā narmadāyāṃ sā saṃgame yajñaparvate ।।1.484.30 ।।
ṛṣiḥ suparṇo yatrā''sījjābālirbrahmabījajaḥ ।
puruhūtā tasya patnī dharmapatnī pativratā ।।3 1।।
pramādya tvabravīdvākyaṃ puruhūtā nijaṃ patim ।
ṛtukāle parvaṇi māṃ bhajasva tvaṃ mahāmune ।।32।।
jāyate me yathā putraḥ sarvasantānapāvanaḥ ।
putreṇa lokān jayati tṛpyanti pitṛdevatāḥ ।।33।।
aputrasya gatirnāsti tasmātputramajījanaḥ ।
śrutvovāca suparṇastāmamāvāsyā'dya vidyate ।।34।।
kāmadevaḥ sadā patni! varjanīyo hi parvaṇi ।
akartavyaṃ vrate puṇye dine pitṛtithāvapi ।।35।।
gamanaṃ dampatībhyāṃ vai ṛtukāle'pi bhāmini ।
pitarastasya tanmāṃsaṃ bhuñjate ṛtugāminaḥ ।।36।।
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu taptaṃ me duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।
tacca sarvaṃ pravinaśyet parvaṇi saṃgamāttava ।।37।।
paśya snātvā kṣaṇamātrāccāṇḍālaṃ saṃgame'tra vai ।
yāntaṃ vimānamārgeṇa svarge dhikkṛtya māṃ priye ।।38।।
tapaḥ karomi satataṃ dhikkārastena vai katham ।
kṛto bhavediti cintāparo bhavāmi supriye ।।39।।
vadā'tra kāraṇaṃ sādhvi! dhikkṛtastena vai katham ।
paścātte saṃpradāsyāmi dharmaṃ cenmanyase sati! ।।1.484.40।।
ṛtudānaṃ parvakāle yadi dharmo bhavet priye ।
tāvat kācitsamāyātā niṣādī narmadātaṭe ।।41 ।।
dhikkāraṃ sā śrutavatī tadarthaṃ tvāha taṃ ṛṣim ।
ahaṃkāravimūḍhātmā tvatsamo nāsti tāpasaḥ ।।42।।
na snānaṃ na japo homo na svādhyāyo'cyutārcanam ।
na ca vā bhajanaṃ ceṣṭamantrasya vihitaṃ tvayā ।।43।।
niṣphalaṃ kleśamāpanno vāyubhakṣo nirāśrayaḥ ।
tvattapodhyānayogaśca niṣphalaṃ svargadaṃ na vai ।।44।।
uvāca tāṃ niṣādīṃ ca tadā namragirā muhuḥ ।
kā'si tvaṃ tīrthamāyātā niṣādīrūpamāśritā ।।45।।
umā sarasvatī gaṃgā māṃ jijñāsitumāgatā ।
anugrahamimaṃ manye vada dharmaṃ sanātanam ।।46।।
niṣādyuvāca taṃ harṣāttadā dharmaṃ sanātanam ।
viprāṇyahaṃ ca vipro me bhartā''sīnnaimiṣe vane ।।47।।
saṃsthitastapasi nityaṃ māṃ na spṛśati māsike ।
kāmārtayā mayā ṛtusnātayā prārthitaḥ sa hi ।।48। ।
amāvāsyādine putralabdhaye yācitaḥ patiḥ ।
akāle yācamānā'haṃ tena śaptā mahātmanā ।।49।।
adharmaṃ yācamānā tvaṃ bhava śūdrā niṣādajā ।
mayā śapto bhava tatra cāṇḍālo yatra cāpyaham ।।1.484.50।।
iti śāpābhibhūtau vai dampatī narmadābhavam ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasahitāyāḥ śrutvā kathānakam ।।51 ।।
māhātmyamuttamaṃ divyaṃ tārakaṃ snānamātrataḥ ।
samāgato patirme saḥ cāṇḍālaḥ svargamāptavān ।।।52।।
ahaṃ niṣādī viprāṇī snātvā yāsyāmi mokṣaṇam ।
tasmāttvaṃ bhaja govindaṃ tapasā saha sarvadā ।।53।।
sārthakaṃ te bhavet sarvamanyathā niṣphalaṃ tava ।
haryarthaṃ kuru karmāṇi homajapyādikāni vai ।।।54।।
yāsyase tvaṃ tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritam ।
ityuktvā narmadānīre snātvā svargaṃ yayau hi sā ।।55।।
yena mārgeṇa tadbhartā yayau sā tena saṃyayau ।
etacchrutvā tu jābāliṃ suparṇaṃ svapatiṃ satī ।।56 ।।
puruhūtā praṇamyaiva yayāce vai kṣamāṃ tadā ।
dharmaṃ sanātanaṃ jñātvā parvaṇyapi ṛtāvapi ।।57।।
maithunaṃ dampatīnāṃ vai yogyaṃ nāstyeva sarvathā ।
evaṃ dharmaṃ paraṃ jñātvā dampatī tau tu vaiṣṇavau ।।58।।
bhajanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
kṛtvā nityaṃ ca japanaṃ patnīvratapativratau ।।59।।
yayau kālena vaikuṇṭhaṃ japadharmaparāyaṇau ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi dharmajñānaṃ muneḥ striyāḥ ।।1.484.60 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rohiṇyāḥ kumudāyāstapaḥ, puruhūtāyāśca narmadāsnānena mokṣaṇaṃ, parvaṇi ṛtudānā'dānaṃ dharma ityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 484 ।।

śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca--
anyattvākhyānakaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu lakṣmi purātanam ।
sakuṭumbo gato mokṣamṛṣirdīrghatamā mahān ।। 1 ।।
kāśīrājo'bhavaccitrasenā''khyastasya pattane ।
kāśyabhidhe sa vasate munirdīrghatamāḥ sadā ।। 2 ।।
kāśyā uttaradigbhāge mandārārāmanāmakam ।
sthalaṃ drumalatākīrṇaṃ tatra dīrghatamā ṛṣiḥ ।। 3 ।।
tapastapati cātyarthaṃ tiṣṭhati dāraputrayuk ।
śuśrūṣayanti te sarve sutāḥ pañca tathetare ।। 4 ।।
tasya putraḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgaḥ kanīyānapi tāpasaḥ ।
yogī ca brahmacārī ca vedādhyayanatatparaḥ ।। 5 ।।
kandamūlaphalāhārastiṣṭhati mṛgarūpadhṛk ।
mṛgamadhye vasannityaṃ pitrornamaḥ kriyākṛte ।। 6 ।।
prātaḥ sāyaṃ samāyāti punaryāti mṛgeṣu saḥ ।
atha kāśīpatiścitraseno nṛpo janaiḥ saha ।। 7 ।।
mṛgayārthaṃ gataścāśvārūḍho mandārapādapān ।
tatra rājā mṛgayūthapaśyadvai mahattamam ।। 8 ।।
adhāvaँśca mṛgā daśa diśo bhayānnṛpo'pi ca ।
ekākī prayayau pṛṣṭhe mṛgāṇāṃ gahane vane ।। 9 ।।
madhyāhno'pi prasaṃjāto digbhramo'pi ca bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
kṣuttṛṣārto'bhavacchāyāmāśritya sarasastaṭe ।। 1.485.1 0।।
sthitaḥ kṣaṇaṃ jale snānaṃ cakāra kumudāni ca ।
gṛhītvā tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā papau vāri yathepsitam ।। 1 1।।
mṛgamadhye sthito yogī ṛṣyaśṛṃgo mahātapāḥ ।
mṛgabhakṣaṇakāmaśca rājā vṛkṣamūlāśritaḥ ।। 1 2।।
cāpaṃ dhṛtvā karāgreṇa prākṣipattaccharaṃ mṛge ।
ṛṣyaśṛṃgaḥ śaraviddhaḥ kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti saṃvadan ।। 1 3।।
kasyaiṣā durmatirjātā mṛgamadhye sthitau'pyaham ।
kenā'haṃ pātitastvatra na kiñcidaparādhavān ।।14।।
vācaṃ tāṃ mānuṣīṃ śrutvā rājā tannikaṭaṃ yayau ।
dṛṣṭvā taṃ ghātitaṃ vipraṃ hāhākṛtvā ruroda ha ।। 15।।
vipraḥ prāha na te siddhirmama nāśe tu bhūmipa! ।
tavaiva vihitā hatyā tvayā tatpratiphālinī ।। 16।।
jananī me pitā vṛddhau bhrātarau me tapasvinaḥ ।
mama nāśaṃ tu te śrutvā mariṣyanti yadi nṛpa! ।। 17।।
etā hatyā bhaviṣyanti kathaṃ śuddhirbhavet tava ।
upāyaṃ te kathayāmi kuru tad yadi manyase ।। 18।।
māṃ gṛhītvā''śramaṃ puṇyaṃ yatra tī+au pitarau mama ।
āvedayasva cātmānaṃ putrahantāramāgatam ।। 1 9।।
tau dṛṣṭvā māṃ kariṣyete kāruṇyaṃ vai tavopari ।
upāyaṃ vā kariṣyete yena śāntirbhaviṣyati ।। 1.485.20।।
citrasenastu tacchrutvā skandhe kṛtā tu bhūsuram ।
mūrchitaṃ nīyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā mārge vyasuṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 21 ।।
nyagrodhamūlake vipraṃ dāhayāmāsa tadvane ।
snānaṃ kṛtvā'tiśokārto ruroda ca mumoda ca ।।22।।
ṛṣyaśṛṃgasya cāsthīni gṛhītvā''śramasannidhau ।
gatavantaṃ nṛpaṃ vīkṣya munirdīrghatapāstu tam ।।23 ।।
āsanaṃ madhuparkādi dadau snehena bhūpatim ।
rājā''ha nārghayogyo'haṃ pāpavānasmi bhūsura ।।24।।
mṛgamadhye sthito vipra tava putro mayā hataḥ ।
putraghnaṃ śādhi māṃ vipra tīvradaṇḍena daṇḍaya ।।25।।
mṛgabhrāntyā hato vipro duṣkṛtaṃ tanmayā prabho ।
iti śrutvā tu mātrāyā rurudurbāndhavādayaḥ ।। 26।।
dīrghatapā vicāryaiva rudan yayau tu tatsthalam ।
jagāda nṛpatiṃ rājan buddhiḥ karmānusāriṇī ।।27।।
jāyate hi manuṣyāṇāṃ tathā te'pi matirmatā ।
hatyāṃ tvaṃ kṛtavān rājan! kintu sā te na vai bhavet ।।।28।।
vayaṃ pitā tathā mātā bhrātaraśca kuṭumbakam ।
ṛṣyaśṛṃgasya śokena yogena ca tanutyajaḥ ।।29।।।
bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṣaṇād rājannasthīnyādāya nārmadam ।
śūlabhedaṃ gaccha tīrthaṃ kṣipā'sthīni ca tajjale ।। 1.485.3 0।।
mucyase sarvapāpebhyo mama vākyānna saṃśayaḥ ।
ādeśaṃ te kariṣyāmītyāha taṃ nṛpasattamaḥ ।। 31 ।।
ṛṣyaśṛṃgasya śokena yogadhāraṇayā dvijāḥ ।
kuṭumbaṃ vyasutāṃ prāptaṃ dagdhvā tad brāhmaṇairjanaiḥ ।।32।।
rājā'sthīni ca saṃgṛhya śuddho bhūtvā tu narmadām ।
yayau svalpena kālena pṛṣṭvā tīrthaṃ ca tannṛpaḥ ।।3 3।।
narmadādakṣiṇe kūle śūlabhedaṃ supāvanam ।
āgatyā'sthīni saṃdhṛtvā bhūmau snātvā tataḥ śuciḥ ।।34।।
tilamiśreṇa toyena tarpayitveṣṭadevatāḥ ।
nikṣipyā'ntarjale'sthīni yāvatpaśyati cāmbare ।।35।।
tān dadarśa tataḥ sarvān devamūrtiṃdharān śubhān ।
divyavastraiśca saṃvītān divyābharaṇabhūṣitān ।।36।।
vimānaiḥ kāñcanairdivyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṣārṣadasevitaiḥ ।
utpatataḥ samālokya rājā harṣamupāgataḥ ।।37।।
ṛṣirvimānamārūḍhaścitrasenamathā'bravīt ।
bhobho rājaँstvatprasādād gatirdivyā mamā'dya vai ।।38।।
madīyavacanād rājan niṣpāpastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve muktiṃ dīrghatapojanāḥ ।।39।।।
rājā śaṃbhuṃ smaran prāṇāँstyaktaṃ tatra samudyataḥ ।
śaṃkarastu samāgatya taṃ rurodha nṛpaṃ haṭhāt ।।1.485.40।।
adyāpi tvaṃ yuvā rājan na yu×Vr̤M×ktaṃ maraṇaṃ tava ।
svasthānaṃ yāhi rājyaṃ saṃbhukṣva kālāntare tataḥ ।।41 ।।
kāśīrājyaṃ ciraṃ kṛtvā dhyātvā śrīśaṃkaraṃ tu mām ।
nandirnāmā gaṇo me tvaṃ dehānte saṃbhaviṣyasi ।।।42।।
ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhuḥ rājā kāśīpurīṃ yayau ।
dehānte śaṃkaraṃ dhyātvā nandirnāmā gaṇo'bhavat ।।43।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pāvanaṃ caritaṃ śubham ।
yacchrutvā vilayaṃ yānti pātakāni nṛṇāṃ priye! ।।44।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ṛṣyaśṛṃgasya mṛgarūpasya kāśīrājacitrasenaśareṇa mṛtyūttaraṃ tatpitṛdīrghatapaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ narmadājale'sthinikṣepānmuktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।485।।


← adhyāyaḥ 485 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 486
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 487 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ānartadeśe saurāṣṭre camatkārapurāntike ।
nadī nāgamatīnāmnā vartate pūrvataḥ śubhā ।। 1 ।।
yasyāṃ snānād vimucyante muktā bhavanti mānavāḥ ।
tatra lakṣmi! mṛgī kācit vyādhabāṇaprapīḍitā ।। 2 ।।
avātatāra salile prāṇāँstatyāja vāriṣu ।
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ madhyāhne'ryamadaivate ।। 3 ।।
sūryavāre ca tatpuṇyānmenakā nāma sā'bhavat ।
apsarāstridaśendrasya surūpā patidharmiṇī ।। 4 ।।
ekadā tatra munirāḍ viśvāmitraḥ samāyayau ।
tīrthārthaṃ nāganadyāṃ sa sasnau nagarapūrvataḥ ।। 5 ।।
yatra sā menakā nityamāyāti snānakāmukī ।
snāntaṃ surūpaṃ divyaṃ ca puṣṭaṃ muniṃ vilokya sā ।। 6 ।।
yauvanasthaṃ patiṃ kartumīyeṣa kāmapīḍitā ।
sānandā suratārthāya samīpaṃ samupāgamat ।। 7 ।।
nanāma caraṇe vākyaistuṣṭāva sumanoharaiḥ ।
sadhairyaḥ sa munistāṃ vai mene nāgarikīṃ striyam ।। 8 ।।
āśīrvādān pradāyaiva prahṛṣṭenā'ntarātmanā ।
uvāca devīṃ tāṃ pṛcchan strīdharmāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ।। 9 ।।
śubhalābho'stu te kaccinmanasā karmaṇā girā ।
bhaktiḥ saṃvartate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe ca śāśvatī ।। 1.486.10 ।।
kaccittvaṃ vartase bāle patiṃpādaparāyaṇā ।
cāritravinayopetā sadā madhurabhāṣiṇī ।। 11 ।।
kaccittvaṃ sarvadā'bhīṣṭā patyurdānaistathā'rcasi ।
bandhūn svamitravargaṃ ca tatpuraḥ pṛṣṭhato'pi vā ।। 12।।
kaccid bhartari saṃsupte tvaṃ nidrāvaśameṣyasi ।
utthānamaprabuddhena karoṣi brāhmakālike ।। 13।।
kaccit prātaḥ samutthāya karoṣi patisevanam ।
tato gṛhaṃ mārjayitvā karoṣi maṇḍanādikam ।। 14।।
kaccit snātvā snāpayitvā patiṃ saṃpūjya bhāvataḥ ।
bālāpatyāni saṃbhālya vartase bhaktiyoginī ।। 15।।
kacciddevānnamaskṛtya guruṃ gāṃ ca patiṃ tathā ।
karoṣi tvaṃ prāṇayātrāṃ dattvā'nnaṃ śaktito jalam ।। 16।।
kaccinmadhyāhnavelāyāmatithīn sevase'nnakaiḥ ।
kaccid gṛhāgatanirāśritāyānnaṃ dadāsi vai ।। 17।।
kaccidastaṃ gate sūrye nā'nnamaśnāsi bhāmini! ।
adattvā nijabhṛtyebhyaḥ sādhubhyaśca viśeṣataḥ ।। 18।।
kaccit pibasi pānīyaṃ vastrapūtaṃ surā'rpitam ।
kaccid dayāvatī bhūtvā gātrakleśakarānapi ।।19
yūkāmatkuṇadaṃśādīn putravatparirakṣasi ।
kaccit sādhujanānnityaṃ kṛṣṇadharmaṃ subhaktitaḥ ।। 1.486.2 0।।
śṛṇoṣi bhaktito bhadre bhaktiṃ karoṣi sādarām ।
kaccichrutvā dinaṃ puṇyaṃ prakaroṣi vratādikam ।। 21 ।।
gurumācāryamīśaṃ vā''gataṃ karoṣi pūjitam ।
śāstrasya vācakasyāpi vyākhyātuśca viśeṣata ।। 22 ।।
kañcicchāstrāṇi ramyāṇi sādhubhyaḥ saṃprayacchasi ।
śrutvā kathāṃ niṣkrayaṃ ca vācakāya prayacchasi ।। 23 ।।
kaccit kṛṣṇālaye nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ vādyaṃ sukīrtanam ।
balipūjopahārāँśca tva karoṣi svaśaktitaḥ ।। 24।।
kaccitprāvaraṇaṃ vastraṃ sādhubhyaḥ samprayacchasi ।
vṛthā paryaṭanaṃ nānyagṛhe karoṣi bhāmini ।।25।।
kaccinnā'śnāsi pūrvaṃ tvaṃ svabhartaribubhukṣite ।
ājñābhaṃgaṃ kadācicca bhartuḥ karoṣi naiva tu ।।26।।
kaccit prakupite kānte kopaṃ na yāsi sadvrate ।
kaccit tvaṃ kupitā bhartre nottarāṇi prayacchasi ।।27।।
athā'parādhaśāntyarthaṃ priyaṃ hṛdyaṃ prajalpasi ।
kaccittvaṃ proṣite kānte malināmbaradhāriṇī ।। 28।।
dīnā vivarṇavadanā kaccid bhavasi vā kṛśā ।
kaccinmandiramālinyaṃ dūrīkaroṣi sevayā ।।।29।।
kaccidbhinnaṃ tathocchiṣṭaṃ pātraṃ dhatse na vai gṛhe ।
kaccid vrajasi rātryādau notsaveṣu sthalāntare ।।1.486.3 0।।
kaccinna kuruṣe maitrīṃ puṃścalībhiḥ kadācana ।
kaccid dadhāsi saubhāgyacihnāni patiraṃjanī ।।3 1 ।।
kaccitte pātivratye vai vighno nāyāti kaścana ।
patiputravatī sādhvī kaccid bhavasi bhāmini ।।32।।।
ityuktā sā ṛṣiṃ prāha pātivratyopadeśakam ।
anyāstā yoṣito vipra yāsāṃ dharmāstvayoditāḥ ।।33 ।।
vayaṃ svargasyā'psarasaḥ svecchācāriṇya eva vai ।
apatikāḥ svatantrāśca munimānasamohikāḥ ।।34।।
akṣatāḥ sarvadā śuddhāḥ premasevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
navarūpadharāḥ kanyāḥ sevārasaparāyaṇāḥ ।।346।।
kāmadharmeṇa satsevāṃ kurmo yatitapasvinām ।
sādhūnāṃ vā gṛhasthānāmasmatsatkāravedinām ।।36 ।।
rañjayitvā subahudhā tadāśīrvādamāpnumaḥ ।
tena puṇyena vai svargaṃ nityamasmatkṛte'sti hi ।।37।।
kāmasevāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ nānyanmanyāmahe vayam ।
kāmabhaṃgasamaṃ pāpaṃ nānyacchāpapradaṃ bhuvi ।।38।।
sukhabhaṃgo mahatpāpaṃ sarvasvadāhakaṃ ṛṣe ।
sukhadānaṃ mahādānaṃ bhojanasevanāmbaraiḥ ।।39।।
aṃgānāṃ mardanaiḥ pādasaṃvāhanādibhiḥ sadā ।
nartanaiḥ kīrtanaiḥ praśaṃsanaiḥ puṇyamavāpyate ।।1.486.40।।
yaiḥ pare rañjitāsteṣāṃ pare lokāḥ sukhapradāḥ ।
yaiḥ pare duḥkhitāsteṣāṃ pare lokāstu duḥkhadāḥ ।।41 ।।
paralokasya saukhyārthaṃ sevayāmo vayaṃ janān ।
paropakāraṃ kurmo vai yatheṣṭasarvadānakaiḥ ।।42।।
dhanaṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ ca bhojanaṃ dehamityapi ।
sarvaṃ dadmaḥ prasaukhyārthaṃ yatphalaṃ punarāpnumaḥ ।।43।।
bhojanaṃ jihvayā tvātmatṛptyarthaṃ dīyate janaiḥ ।
sparśanaṃ tu tvacā tvātmatṛptyarthaṃ dīyate tathā ।।44।।
śravaṇaṃ gītikānāṃ tu dīyate karṇatṛptikṛt ।
darśanaṃ rūpaśṛṃgārādīnāṃ cakṣusukhapradam ।।45।।
evamanyendriyaiścāpi tvātmatṛptyarthamuttamam ।
dānaṃ sandīyate'smābhiḥ puṇyārthaṃ haritoṣaṇam ।।46।।
ātmatoṣe harestoṣastena cātmaniveditā ।
pālyate sarvadā'smābhiḥ phalaṃ kṛṣṇārpitaṃ mahat ।।47।।
vidhātrā trividhāḥ sṛṣṭā nāryaḥ saṃsārasevikāḥ ।
vivāhitāśca sāmānyā brahmacaryaparāstathā ।।48।।
vivāhitānāṃ dharmāstu patisevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
ye tvayoktāstu satpraśnamiṣeṇa yugmavāhakāḥ ।।49।।
dvitīyā yāstu sāmānyā apsarasaśca tā vayam ।
asmaddharmāstato bhinnāḥ sarvasevāparāyaṇāḥ ।।1.486.5 0 ।।
tṛtīyāstu brahmacaryaparāḥ sādhvyo bhavanti tāḥ ।
kāmadharmaparityaktāḥ sādhuśīlaparāyaṇāḥ ।।।51 ।।
svadharmasthā divaṃ yānti paradharmā bhayāvahāḥ ।
vayaṃ sevāparā bhṛtyāḥ kiṃkaryaḥ sarvadā smṛtāḥ ।।52।।
dāsyo vā hyupapatnyaśca devyo divyā yato vayam ।
tvādṛśāsāmṛṣīṇāṃ sevayā kṛtārthabhāvanāḥ ।।।53।।
vada tvaṃ kṣatriyavarastāpaso hṛdayaṃgamaḥ ।
mama mānasatoṣārthaṃ tava dharmo'sti cenmune ।।54।।।
bhajasva māṃ samāyātāṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇām ।
tvāṃ tu nārāyaṇaṃ matvā sevayiṣye na dūṣaṇam ।।55।।
viśvāmitrastadā prāha hitaṃ tāpasadhārmikam ।
ahaṃ vratadharaḥ subhru brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ ।।56 ।।
sarveṣāṃ vratināṃ mūlaṃ brahmacaryamudāhṛtam ।
āstāṃ dūraṃ tava saṃgaḥ saṃsparśo bhāṣaṇaṃ tathā ।।57।।
gaccha dūraṃ svargadevi na me tvayā prayojanam ।
vratināṃ pramadāgrāhaḥ pāpadaḥ puṇyanāśakaḥ ।।58।।
saṃsārabhramaṇaṃ nārī vivāhamaṇḍape gatāḥ ।
vahnerbhramaṇavyājena patiṃ darśayati dhruvam ।।59।।
tasmāt strībhiḥ same saṃgaṃ sparśaṃ yogaṃ ca varjayet ।
aṃgārasadṛśī nārī ghṛtakuṃbhasamaḥ pumān ।। 1.486.60 ।।
asparśād dṛḍhatāmeti tatsaṃparkād vilīyate ।
striyo mūlamanarthānāṃ nirodhaḥ svargagāminām ।।6 1 ।।

kulīnā vīravatyaśca nāthavatyo'pi yoṣitaḥ ।
ekasminneva bhartari santuṣṭāḥ svargagāstu tāḥ ।।62।।
strīṇāṃ saṃgaṃ samāsādya saṃsāre bhramate naraḥ ।
nṛṇāṃ saṃgaṃ samāsādya saṃsāre bhramate'balā ।।63।।
mayā tyaktau hi saṃsārastadbījaṃ tvamupasthitam ।
mamāpi yamalokānāṃ duḥkhaṃ te'pi tvayā bhavet ।।64।।
tasmānmayā na vai grāhyā gacchā'nyatra priyā bhava ।
ityuktā menakā prāha viśvāmitravacaḥ śṛṇu ।।65।।
himācale pratapato naranārāyaṇasya vai ।
tapaścograṃ paraṃ jñātvā mahendrastvapsarogaṇaiḥ ।।66।।
kāmavasantabāṇaiśca sahitaḥ saṃyayau drutam ।
tapobhaṃgavidhānāya prāraṃbhannṛtyagītikām ।।67।।
nārāyaṇo naraṃ prāha cūtapuṣpāṇi cānaya ।
sakthni saṃmardaya samutpādaya tvapsarovarām ।।68।।
naraḥ sammṛdya puṣpāṇyutpādayāmāsa corvaśīm ।
atirūpavatīṃ yasyā agre sarvāstamastvacaḥ ।।6 9।।
adṛśyantā'tsarasastā mahendrasya tadendrakaḥ ।
sāścaryaṃ samuvācedaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tu divaukasām ।।1.486.70।।
śataśo me'psarasaśca mayā kāntyā'ndhakī kṛtāḥ ।
tasyāḥ prabhuṃ kathaṃ śaktaḥ pātayituṃ bhavāmyaham ।।71 ।।
iti garvaṃ vihāyaiva patitaḥ pādayorhareḥ ।
yayāce tūrvaśīṃ nārāyaṇānnārāyaṇo dadau ।।72।।
tadā narasya putrī sā prārthayāmāsa mādhavam ।
bhagavan kanyakā cāhaṃ naranārāyaṇasya vai ।।73 ।।
ayonijā satī sādhvī brahmacaryaparāyaṇā ।
tāpasī bhagavatputrī kathaṃ yāmi divaṃ prabho ।।74।।
sāmānyā'haṃ kathaṃ bhūtvā vartiṣye tānsurānprati ।
apsarasāṃ tu ke dharmāstānme śrāvaya tattvataḥ ।।75।।
ityuktaḥ śrīharistasyai śrāvayāmāsa tadvṛṣān ।
dāsīvat sarvadā stheyaṃ surānprati divisthitān ।।76।।
nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ sevanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ devayoṣitā ।
sarve devāḥ samāḥ sevyāḥ patirūpeṇa vai divi ।।77।।
mānavā vā munayo'pi tāpasāḥ patirūpiṇaḥ ।
sevanīyā bhaviṣyanti gaccha tiṣṭha yathāsukham ।।78।।
ūrvaśī prasamākarṇya pitaraṃ prāha sadvratā ।
parapuṃsāṃ prasaṃgena narakaṃ yātanāmayam ।।79।।
prabhoktavyaṃ bhavet tasmānmayā svargaṃ na ceṣyate ।
nārāyaṇastadā prāha svargasyā'psarasāṃ kṛte ।।1.486.80।।
tava kṛte tathā putri nāsti vai yamayātanāḥ ।
apsaraso devapuṇyāt sasṛje viśvasṛṭ svayam ।।81 ।।
tāsāṃ pāpaṃ na caivāstītyāha brahmā tathā purā ।
tavāpi putri devānāmasaṃkhyānāṃ prasevayā ।।।82।।
kāmadharmeṇa yuktāyā api pāpaṃ na vai bhavet ।
ityapāpaṃ purā prāha brahmā nārāyaṇastathā ।।।83 ।।
asmākaṃ sarvathā devakiṃkarīṇāṃ hi yoṣitām ।
tasmād bhajasva māṃ viśvāmitra haṭhaṃ parityaja ।।84।।
paṇyastriyo vayaṃ yāvad vācāṃ bandhanamasti vai ।
tāvatpativratāḥ smaśca patirbhava sadā mama ।।85।।
ityuktvā saṃsthitā tatra nikaṭe sanmukhe haṭhāt ।
viśvāmitraḥ sthalaṃ tyaktvā'nyatra yayau tadā tu sā ।।86।।
śaśāpa taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ kāmakhaṇḍanapīḍitā ।
adyaiva bhava durbuddhe valīpalitajarjaraḥ ।।87।।
evamukto'bhavat tādṛk śāpane jarayā yutaḥ ।
muniḥ prāha na te pāpaṃ mama pāpaṃ tu saṃbhavet। ।।88।।
tasmād vihāya cānyatra prayāmi tena rocate ।
tasmād bhava tvamapyāśu jarājarjaritāṃgakā ।।89।।
sāpi tadvacanāt sadyastādṛgrū'pā vyajāyata ।
tataḥ krodhasya śāntyarthaṃ nāgavatyāṃ tu sā satī ।।1.486.90।।
sasnau tāvatpūrvarūpā yathāvad yuvatī priyā ।
samabhavat tato viśvāmitraḥ sasnau nadījale ।।91 ।।
so'pi pūrvarūpo'bhūt śāpau naṣṭau parasparam ।
etādṛśaṃ mahattīrthaṃ nāganadyāṃ pravartate ।।।92।
yatra snātvā narā nāryo bhavanti yauvanānvitāḥ ।
svargadevīsamā nāryo narāḥ svargasurā iva ।।93।।
tataḥ sā menakā muniṃ natvā svargaṃ yayau svataḥ ।
ṛṣistapaḥ paraṃ cakre nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।।94।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi gūḍhadharmapravartanam ।
yadvijñānena vratino labhante svargamokṣaṇe ।।95।।
