śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi mahendragarvabhaṃjanam ।
camatkārapure jātaṃ niśāmaya matipradam ।।96 ।।
purā śatamakho darpāt kṛtvā śatamakhān mudā ।
babhūva sarvadevānāmadhyakṣaḥ sampadā yutaḥ ।।97।।
dine dine tadaiśvaryaṃ vardhate tapasāṃ phalāt ।
dadau mantraṃ siddhidaṃ vai bṛhaspatistu puṣkare ।।98।।
sa jajāpa namo rādheśvarāya oṃ namo namaḥ ।
śatasavatsaraṃ japtvā jātaḥ pūrṇamanorathaḥ ।।99।।
brahmasvarūpāṃ prakṛtiṃ sampanmūḍho na manyate ।
prakṛtirjaḍadivyā ca taṃ śaśāpa tataḥ param ।। 1.486.10 0।।
guruṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya na nanāma mudānvitaḥ ।
guruḥ śaśāpa taṃ kopād yātu sampaddhareriti ।। 101 ।।
evaṃ bhraṣṭamatirindrastvahalyāṃ paripaśya ca ।
cakame gautamarūpaṃ dhṛtvā reme tayā saha ।। 1 02।।
dadarśa gautamastaṃ ca dhikkṛtya taṃ śaśāpa ha ।
yonīnāṃ tu sahasraṃ vai tava gātre bhavatviha ।। 10 3।।
pūrṇavarṣaṃ ca satataṃ yonigandhaṃ tvamāpnuhi ।
tataḥ sūryaṃ samārādhya sahasrākṣo bhaviṣyasi ।। 104 ।।
mama śāpād guroḥ śāpad bhraṣṭaśrīrbhava sāmpratam ।
athendraḥ prayayau tīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ tapase tataḥ ।। 1 05।।
niṣkṛtiṃ saṃvidhāyā'tha gṛhaṃ yayau tataḥ punaḥ ।
indrastyaktagururdaivādbrahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ।। 1 06।।
tadājñayā viśvarūpaṃ pracakāra purohitam ।
daityadauhitramevainaṃ jñātvā daityābhipakṣiṇam ।। 1 07।।
yajñe daityebhya evainaṃ dadataṃ havyamuttamam ।
praciccheda śirastasya tīkṣṇabāṇena vai tataḥ ।। 1 08।।
viśvarūpapitā tvaṣṭā śrutvā sadyaścukopa ha ।
indraśatro vivardhasvetyuktvā cakre kratuṃ param ।। 1 09।।
yajñakuṇḍāt samuttasthau vṛtro nāma mahāsuraḥ ।
indro jaghāna vajreṇa vṛtraṃ vai devakaṇṭakam ।। 1.486.11 0।।
brahmahatyā raktavastrā saptanālocchrayā tathā ।
īṣāpramāṇadaśanā khaḍgahastā babhūva ha ।। 111 ।।
dhāvantaṃ dhāvamānā sā mahendraṃ taṃ jagāma ha ।
dudrāvendraḥ saṃviveśa mānasākhyasarovare ।। 1 12।।
mṛṇālasūkṣmasūtre vai sāpi vaṭe taṭe sthitā ।
nahuṣastvabhavattvindro yayāce kāmataḥ śacīm ।। 1 13।।
śacī gurorhi śaraṇaṃ yātā rarakṣa tāṃ guruḥ ।
bṛhaspatistato yāto mānasākhyasaraḥ svayam ।। 114 ।।
rakṣaṇāya svaśiṣyasya cājuhāva śacīpatim ।
svaraṃ vṛhaspaterjñātvā bahiḥ samāyayau gurum ।। 1 151।।
natvā tuṣṭāva ca guruṃ pādayoḥ patitastadā ।
kṣamasva bhagavan doṣaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānidhe ।। 1 16।।
bhṛtyāparādhaṃ satataṃ na gṛhṇāti sadīśvaraḥ ।
svabhāryāsu svaśiṣyeṣu svabhṛtyeṣu suteṣu ca ।। 1 17।।
iti śrutvā guruḥ prāha gaccha rājyaṃ divaḥ kuru ।
hataśatrurmatprasādād gatvā paśya satīṃ śacīm ।। 1 18।।
saṃsāravijayaṃ varma gṛhāṇedaṃ tataḥ param ।
brahmahatyāṃ bhasmasācca kuru gaccha mayā saha ।। 11 9।।
evaṃ kṛtvā mahendrastu yayau svargaṃ tadā punaḥ ।
daityairvināśitāṃ svasya rājadhānīṃ punarnavām ।। 1.486.120 ।।
kārayāmāsa racitāṃ nāmnā'marāvatīpurīm ।
viśvakarmakṛtāṃ vīkṣya na tutoṣa sureśvaraḥ ।। 121 ।।
viśvakarmā gṛhaṃ gantuṃ na śaśāka vinā''jñayā ।
viśvakarmā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sasmāra kamalāpatim ।। 122।।
nārāyaṇo viprarūpaṃ dhṛtvā''jagāma tāṃ purīm ।
atikharvo vaiṣṇavaśca yuyuje śakramāśiṣam ।। 123।।।
madhuparkādikaṃ datvā śakraḥ satkāramācarat ।
papracchā''gamanaṃ kasmād vadeti viprabālakam ।। 124 ।।
viprabaṭustu taṃ prāha nūtanāṃ nagarīṃ tava ।
samādraṣṭumāgato'smi praṣṭuṃ vacanamīpsitam ।। 1 25।।
citraṃ nagaranirmāṇaṃ samākarṇyā'dbhutaṃ tava ।
kativarṣāṇi nirmāṇe bhavān saṃkalpito yathā ।। 1 26।।
katicit tāṃ viśvakarmā nirmāṇaṃ vā kariṣyati ।
evaṃbhūtaṃ vinirmāṇaṃ na kenendreṇa nirmitam ।। 127।।
naivaṃvidhaṃ sunirmāṇe viśvakarmā paraḥ kṣamaḥ ।
bālakasya vacaḥ śrutvā jahāsa sa surendrakaḥ ।। 1 28।।
sampanmadātimattaśca punaḥ papraccha bālakam ।
katīndrāṇāṃ samūhaśca tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ śruto'thavā ।। 1 29।।
viśvakarmā katividhastaṃ ye brūhi śiśo'dhunā ।
śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā viprabaṭuruvāca tam ।। 1.486.1 30।।
jānāmi kaśyapaṃ tava tāta prajāpatiṃ tathā ।
muniṃ marīciṃ jānāmi tattātaṃ vedhasaṃ tathā ।। 131 ।।
kalpaṃ ca pralayaṃ katividhaṃ jānāmi sarvathā ।
brahmajanakaṃ vairājaṃ tatpitaraṃ hiraṇmayam ।। 1 32।।
jānāmyaṇḍaṃ katividhaṃ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān ।
brahmāṇḍeṣu katividhānidrān jānāmi sarvaśaḥ ।। 133।।
yadi saṃkhyā'sti reṇūnāṃ dharāyāṃ tu sureśvara ।
tathāpi saṃkhyā śakrāṇāṃ nāstyeva kiṃ vadāmi te ।। 134 ।।
śakrasyā''yuścādhikāro yugānāmekasaptatiḥ ।
aṣṭāviṃśatiśakrāṇāṃ patane'harniśaṃ vidheḥ ।। 1 35।।
vidheraṣṭottaraśatamāyureva pramāṇataḥ ।
surendrāṇāṃ tu kā saṃkhyā nāsti saṃkhyā vidherapi ।। 136।।
mahāviṣṇorlomakūpe vairājāḥ santyanekaśaḥ ।
vairājasya romakūpe brahmādyāḥ santyanekaśaḥ ।। 1 37।।
evaṃ lomnaḥ pramāṇena brahmāṇḍāḥ santyasaṃkhyakāḥ ।
brahmāṇḍe ca katividhāḥ surāḥ santyeva tvatsamāḥ ।। 1 38।।
viprabaṭau vadatyevaṃ pārśvato nirgataṃ tadā ।
pipīlikāsamūhaṃ ca vyāyataṃ dhanuṣāṃ śatam ।।1 39।।
kramaśastān sannirīkṣya jahāsoccairdvijārbhakaḥ ।
novāca kiñcinmaunī ca gaṃbhīraḥ sagaṇo yathā ।। 1.486.140।।
indraḥ prāha kathaṃ vipravaṭo hasasi me vada ।
viprabaṭuruvācendraṃ dṛṣṭāḥ pipīlikāstvayā ।। 141 ।।
sṛṣṭaḥ pipīlikāsaṃgha ekaikaḥ kramaśo mayā ।
sarve te kramaśastvāsannindrāḥ pūrvātprapūrvajāḥ ।। 142।।
idānīṃ te tu samprāptā bhūtajātiṃ pipīlikām ।
karmaṇā kramaśo yānti jīvāḥ kīṭanṛdevatāḥ ।। 143।।
karmaṇā drumatāṃ yānti yakṣatāṃ nāgatāṃ tathā ।
pakṣitvaṃ ca paśutvaṃ ca nārītvaṃ naratāṃ tathā ।। 144।।
pretatvaṃ ca suratvaṃ ca ṛṣitvaṃ karmaṇā tathā ।
brahmatvaṃ surarājatvaṃ karmaṇā prāpyate'pi tu ।। 145।।
mṛtyustu mastakasthāyī sarveṣāṃ vidyate sadā ।
jalabudvudavatsarvaṃ śakra naśyati nityaśaḥ ।। 146।।
mūḍhā muhyanti loke'tra muhyanti naiva paṇḍitāḥ ।
ityuktvā sa viprabaṭustatatra tasthau ca sasmitaḥ ।। 147।।
vismitastridaśādhyakṣo garvahīno babhūva ha ।
etasminnantare tatrā''jagāma tāpaso janaḥ ।। 148।।
ativṛddho mahāyogī jaṭādhārī mṛgājinī ।
sarvaṃ vakṣaḥsthalaṃ tasya romacakrābhisaṃbhṛtam ।।149।।
madhye kiñcidromahīnaṃ samutpāṭitalomakam ।
mastake ca vartulaṃ saṃdadhan kaṭaṃ samāyatam ।। 1.486.150।।
āgatya madhye tasthau sa vipraputramahendrayoḥ ।
mahendro vṛddharūpaṃ taṃ madhuparkādikaṃ dadau ।। 151 ।।
praṇanāmā'tha papraccha kuta āgamyate tvayā ।
kinnāmā tvaṃ gṛhaṃ kutra kathamāgamanaṃ tava ।। 152।।
karaṃ kathaṃ mastake te lomacakraṃ ca vakṣasi ।
madhyadeśe riktabhāgo lomotpāṭanajaḥ katham ।। 153।।
vṛddhaḥ prāha ca vaikuṇṭhādadya tvāgamyate mayā ।
lomaśo'haṃ ṛṣirnāmnā tīrthārthaṃ gamanaṃ mama ।। 154।।
alpāyuṣā mayā cendra kutrāpi na kṛtaṃ gṛham ।
na vivāhaścopajīvyaṃ bhikṣopajīvinā'dhunā ।। 155।।
varṣaṇā''tapaśāntyarthaṃ mastakasthaṃ kaṭaṃ mama ।
vakṣoromāṇi yāvanti tāvatkalpāyurasmyaham ।। 156।।
kalpaike'pagate cendra lomaikotpāṭanaṃ mama ।
utpāṭitaromasaṃkhyāḥ kalpā naṣṭā mamāgrataḥ ।। 157।।
jātaṃ tvaṃgulamātraṃ tad vartulaṃ romahīnakam ।
vakṣolomāni yāvanti pratikalpaikaromakam ।। 158।।
bhaviṣyantyutpāṭitāni tadā me maraṇaṃ bhavet ।
daśādhikaśate yāte brahmā'bdānāṃ mṛtirmama ।। 159।।
asaṃkhyavidhayaḥ sṛṣṭau mariṣyanti mṛtā api ।
kalatreṇa ca putreṇa gṛheṇa kiṃ prayojanam ।। 1.486.160।।
vairājapatane cakṣurnimeṣastu harerbhavet ।
śrīhareścaraṇaṃ nityaṃ cintayāmi sthale sthale ।। 161 ।।
durlabhaṃ śrīharerdāsyaṃ bhaktirmuktergarīyasī ।
svapnavat sarvamaiśvaryaṃ tadbhaktivyavadhāyakam ।। 162।।
evamuktvā vṛddhavipraścāntardhānaṃ jagāma ha ।
śiśuviprastataścendraṃ kṛtvā garvavihīnakam ।। 163।।
adṛśyatāṃ gatastūrṇamindro vairāgyamāptavān ।
sarvaṃ vinyasya putre tu tyaktvā rājyaśriyaṃ śacīm ।। 164।।
utsuko'bhūdaraṇyaṃ vai harerbhaktyarthamādarāt ।
bṛhaspatiḥ svakaṃ śiṣyaṃ bodhayāmāsa vai tadā ।। 165।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
iti nityaṃ japaṃ dhyānasahitaṃ kuru śārṅgiṇaḥ ।। 166।।
tena muktiśca te bhāvyā mā yāhi vanamanyathā ।
ityukto bhajamānaḥ sa bhūtvā ca vaiṣṇavo mahān ।। 167।।
cakāra rājyaṃ dharmiṣṭhaścānte muktiṃ jagāma ha ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya jñānavān jāyate janaḥ ।। 168।।
śraddhā suvardhate bhakto bhaktau garvo naśyati sarvathā ।
vṛthā mānaṃ yāti dūraṃ yāti tvante hareḥ padam ।। 169।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham ।
vijñānaṃ garvanāśārthaṃ bhaktervṛddhyarthameva ca ।। 1.486.170 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne menakāṃ prati viśvāmitrapṛṣṭapātivratyapraśre'psarasāmanyadharmaparatve parasparaśāpena jarā, nāgamatīnadyāṃ snānena śāpanivāraṇaṃ cetyādi । tathā indrasya garvanāśārthaṃ prakṛteḥ śāpaḥ, guroḥ śāpaḥ, gautamaśāpaśca, gurorapamānācchāpena sampannāśaḥ, vṛtranāśaḥ, brahmahatyā, guroḥ kṛpayā brahmahatyānāśaḥ, navīnaprāsādanirmāṇaṃ, viśvakarmanirodhaḥ, nārāyaṇasya viprabaṭurūpeṇā''gamanaṃ pipīlikāsamūhadarśanaṃ, lomaśasyāgamanaṃ, tadāyurlomakṣaraṇe niścityendrasya vairāgyaṃ viśvakarmaṇo nirbandhatendragarvanāśaścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 486 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 486 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 487
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 488 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha dhanvantarerdarpabhaṃgaḥ pūrvaṃ yathā kṛtaḥ ।
tadākhyānaṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu lakṣmi sureśvari! ।। 1 ।।
nārāyaṇāṃśo bhagavān svayaṃ dhanvantarirmahān ।
purā samudramathane samuttasthau mahodadheḥ ।। 2 ।।
sarvavedeṣu niṣṇāto mantratantraviśāradaḥ ।
garuḍasya suśiṣyo vai śaṃkarasyopaśiṣyakaḥ ।। 3 ।।
śiṣyāṇāṃ sa sahasreṇa yāti vaikuṇṭhamekadā ।
dadarśa takṣakaṃ mārge lelihānaṃ bhayānakam ।। 4 ।।
lakṣanāgaiḥ parivṛtaṃ pātālāttu samāgatam ।
tīrthecchayā mahīloke vicarantaṃ śubhāśayam ।। 5 ।।
dhanvantarirgarvayukto viṣamantrān mumoca ha ।
takṣakaḥ krodhasaṃyukto bhoktuṃ dudrāva vaidyakam ।। 6 ।।
tāvad dhanvantareḥ śiṣyo dambhināmā jajāpa ha ।
viṣamantraṃ mahāghoraṃ saṃcakre takṣakaṃ vaśe ।। 7 ।।
mantreṇa jṛmbhitaṃ kṛtvā nirviṣaṃ taṃ cakāra ha ।
amūlyaṃ maṇiratnaṃ jahāra tanmastakasthitam ।। 8 ।।
kareṇa bhrāmayitvā tu kṣepayāmāsa dūrataḥ ।
patito mṛtavattasthau takṣakastadgaṇāstadā ।। 9 ।।
cakrurnivedanaṃ vāsukaye vāsukirāyayau ।
sarpān viṣolbaṇānnītvā pañcamukhān sahasraśaḥ ।। 1.487.10 ।।
droṇakālīyakarkoṭapuṇḍarīkadhanañjayān ।
dhanvantareḥ śiṣyagaṇā bhayamāpurvilokya tān ।। 11 ।।
nāgaviṣairdaṃśitāste śerate pṛthivītale ।
dhanvantarirmantrāmṛtairjīvayāmāsa sevakān ।। 12।।
cakāra jṛmbhitaṃ mantraiḥ sarpasaṃghaṃ ruṣā jvalan ।
vāsukistu tadā gaurīṃ sasmāra manasā'bhidhām ।। 13 ।।
manase! tvaṃ samāgaccha nāgān rakṣā'tisaṃkaṭāt ।
jagattraye mahābhāge pūjā tava bhaviṣyati ।। 14।।
manasā drāk samāgatyovāca yāmi raṇāṃgaṇe ।
taṃ śatruṃ saṃhariṣyāmi prajeṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ।। 15।।
gururme bhagavān śeṣo dattavān kavacaṃ mama ।
saṃsāraṃ bhasmasāt kṛtvā punaḥ sraṣṭumahaṃ kṣamā ।। 16।।
śiṣyā'haṃ mantraśāstreṣu śaṃbhorbhagavastathā ।
śaṃbhoḥ śiṣyaṃ garuḍaṃ na gaṇayāmi manāgapi ।। 17।।
dhanvantaristacchiṣyāṇāmekaḥ kiṃ gaṇayāmi tam ।
ityuktvā śrīhariṃ śeṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ smṛtvā praṇamya ca ।।18।।
yatra dhanvantaristvāste tatrājagāma tatkṣaṇam ।
mantraiśca jṛmbhitān sarpān jīvayāmāsa līlayā ।। 19।।
viṣamantraiḥ śatruśiṣyānniśceṣṭāṃśca cakāra sā ।
yatnato'pi dhanvantarirnotthāpayitumīśvaraḥ ।।1.487.20।।
prahasya manasā prāha tyaja siddhābhimānitām ।
vada jānāsi kiṃ siddha śiṣyo'si garuḍasya vai ।।21 ।।
ahaṃ ca garuḍaścāpi śiṣyau śaṃbhorhi viśrutau ।
adhītaṃ kalpaparyantaṃ tatra kā gaṇanā tava ।।22।।
mantritaṃ kamalaṃ cedaṃ prerayāmi sthiro bhava ।
ityuktvā prākṣipat padmaṃ mantritaṃ sūryasadṛśam ।।23।।
dhanvantaraistu phutkārairbhasmasāt tat tadā'bhavat ।
devī jagrāha mantrāḍhyāṃ śaktiṃ paramadāruṇīm ।।24।।
dhanvantaristriśūlena babhaṃja kaṇaśastu tām ।
manasā nāgapāśaṃ pracikṣepa mantritaṃ tadā ।।।25।।
nāgalakṣānvitaṃ ghoraṃ dhanvantariśca tatkṣaṇāt ।
gāruḍaṃ prerayāmāsa tena nāgāstrabhakṣaṇam ।।26।।
kṛtaṃ vai līlayā tāvanmanasā śūlamādade ।
śivadattaṃ ca saphalaṃ pralayāgnisamaprabham ।।27।।
tāvad brahmā tathā śaṃbhuḥ rakṣārthamāgatau drutam ।
devau nanāma manasā garuḍo vaidyakastathā ।।28।।
brahmā prāha manasāyāḥ pūjāṃ kurviti vaidyakam ।
dhanvantare! nahi sāmyaṃ raṇaṃ te durgayā saha ।।29।।
trailokyaṃ bhasmasāt kartuṃ śūleneyaṃ prabhāvatī ।
kuru stotraṃ manasāyāstuṣṭā varaṃ pradāsyati ।।1.487.3 0।।
dhanvantariḥ śucirbhūtvā śuklapuṣpairapūjayat ।
cārucampakavarṇābhāṃ sarvāṃgaśumanoharām ।।3 1 ।।
nāgendravāhinīṃ devīṃ sarvavidyāviśāradām ।
dhyātvā datvā ṣoḍaśavastūni stotraṃ cakāra ha ।।32।।
'namaḥ siddhisvarūpāyai varadāyai namo namaḥ ।
namaḥ kaśyapakanyāyai śaṃkarāyai namo namaḥ ।।33।।
bālānāṃ rakṣaṇakartryai nāgadevyai namo namaḥ ।
nama āstīkamātre te jaratkārvyai namo namaḥ ।।34।।
tapasvinyai ca yoginyai nāgasvasre namo namaḥ ।
sādhvyai tapasyārūpāyai śaṃbhuśiṣye! ca te namaḥ' ।।35।।
iti stutā ca manasā bhūtvā śāntā sukhapradā ।
svastītyuktvā yayau natvā gṛhaṃ brahmamaheśvarau ।।36।।
devā vaidyo garuḍaśca sarpā yayurnijālayān ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! manasāyā balaṃ mahat ।।37।।
dhanvantarerdarpabhaṃgaḥ śravaṇāt sarpabhīrna vai ।
vaṃśajānāṃ nāgabhayaṃ nāsti śravaṇamātrataḥ ।।38।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāgeṣu dhanvantarermantraprayogāḥ, manasādevyā mantraprayogairdhanvantarergarvonāśitaścetinirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 487 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 487 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 488
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 489 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi śāradaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagopīlīlāmayaṃ niśāmaya ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tatte pravakṣyāmi rāsaramaṇamuttamam ।
gopībhirnavalakṣābhirnavalakṣaiśca mādhavaiḥ ।। 2 ।।
śaraccandrapūrṇimāyāṃ kiśoraḥ sa yuvā'bhavat ।
yuvatībhiryuvānaśca śrīkṛṣṇā remire priye ।। 3 ।।
vicārya śrīharirnaktaṃ vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ yayau ।
śubho, candrodaye sarvagopīsaṃkalpapūrtaye ।। 4 ।।
cakāra tatra kutukād vinodamuralīravam ।
tacchrutvā rādhikā viniḥsasāra ca drutaṃ gṛhāt ।। 5 ।।
trayastriṃśadvayasyāśca suśīlādyā yayurmudā ।
samā veṣeṇa vayasā rūpeṇa ca guṇena ca ।। 6 ।।
yayustvanyā navalakṣagopyastyaktvā gṛhādikam ।
sarvā babhūvurekatra mālāhastāstu kāścana ।। 7 ।।
cārucandanahastāśca śvetacāmarahastakāḥ ।
kāścit kastūrikākarāḥ kāścit kuṃkumavāhikāḥ ।। 8 ।।
kāścit tāmbūlapātrāśca kāścit kāṃcanabhāmbarāḥ ।
kṛṣṇakṛṣṇavadantyaśca dadṛśū rāsamaṇḍalam ।। 9 ।।
sunirjanaṃ kusumitaṃ vāsitaṃ puṣpavāyubhiḥ ।
śuśruvustā dvirephāṇāṃ kokilānāṃ madhudhvanim ।। 1.488.10।।
rādhā gopyaḥ praviviśuḥ śobhitaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ।
rādhāṃ gopīśca saṃvīkṣya hasan kṛṣṇo'pyadṛśyata ।। 11 ।।
navayauvanasampanno ratnābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ।
kandarpakoṭilāvaṇyarūpojjvalo manoharaḥ ।। 1 2।।
vakralocanakoṇena dadarśa gopikā muhuḥ ।
gopīnāṃ navalakṣāṇi kṛṣṇānāṃ ca tathaiva hi ।। 13।।
lekṣāṇyaṣṭādaśa yugalāni vai rāsamaṇḍale ।
rāsaṃ reme kīrtanaiḥ sattālaiśca kūrdanairmuhuḥ ।। 14।।
hastānāṃ melanaistālīdānairvakravibhaṅgibhiḥ ।
daṇḍaiśca skandhasaṃyogaiścumbanaiḥ karapīḍanaiḥ ।। 1 5।।
evaṃ vai rāsamākrīḍya śrāntā niṣedurunmukhāḥ ।
pupūjustāḥ priyaṃ kāntaṃ dadustāmbūlamuttamam ।। 16 ।।
jagṛhurmukhatāmbūlaṃ parasparaṃ smarānvitāḥ ।
kāmarūpaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo jñātvā tanmānasāni vai ।। 17।।
kāmabhāvena tāḥ sarvā jagrāha ca cucumba ca ।
śṛṃgārā'ṣṭaprakāraṃ ca saṃyogaṃ tvaṃgayostathā ।। 18 ।।
nakhadantakarāṇāṃ ca prahāraṃ vai yathocitam ।
cumbanāṣṭavidhaṃ cāpi cakāra rasikeśvaraḥ ।। 19 ।।
aṃgairaṃgāni pratyaṃgaiḥ pratyaṃgāni yuyoja ca ।
cakārāśleṣaṇaṃ tāsāṃ kāmukīnāṃ sukhāvaham ।। 1.488.20 ।।
navalakṣasthale kṛṣṇaḥ kāntāsakto virājate ।
tāsāṃ datvā ratitṛptiṃ tūrdhvaretāḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ ।। 21 ।।
sthalakrīḍāṃ tathā kṛtvā jalakrīḍārthamāyayau ।
navalakṣayugalāni remire yamunājale ।। 22 ।।
savastrāśca vivastrāśca ramante kāmatṛptaye ।
cucumbuḥ svāminaṃ mūrchāṃ prāpurānandavāridhau ।। 23 ।।
samāśliṣurdṛḍhaṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi varṣmaṇi ।
evaṃ tṛptiṃ dadau kṛṣṇo jale'pi suciraṃ prabhuḥ ।। 24।।
atha nirgatya vastrāṇi dhārayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।
tataśca khelanaṃ cakre bhinnaṃ bhinnaṃ surañjanam ।। 22 ।।
śṛṃgāraṃ ca vividhaṃ tāścakre kṛṣṇasya garvitāḥ ।
kṛṣṇastāsāṃ kabaryādiśṛgāraṃ tvasṛjannavam ।। 26 ।।
kācit kāntaṃ puraḥ kṛtvā cakāra keśasādhanam ।
kācid dadau tu cūḍāyāṃ mayūrapicchamuttamam ।। 27।।
kācid dadau cakṣuṣostu kajjalaṃ bhālakuṃkumam ।
guñjāmālyaṃ ca cūḍāyāṃ veṣṭayāmāsa kācana ।। 28 ।।
kācid vastraṃ dadau sūkṣmaṃ svāmine cottarīyakam ।
kācid dadau kusumānāṃ mālāṃ kaṇṭhe manoharām ।। 2 9।।
kāciccakāra tilakaṃ candrakaṃ kācidādadhat ।
kācidalaktakaṃ hastapādatalanakheṣvadāt ।। 1.488.30 ।।
kācid vaṃśī dadau haste kācittāmbūlakaṃ dadau ।
anyā sudarpaṇe ramyaṃ darśayāmāsa cānanam ।। 3 1 ।।
parā cakāra kṛṣṇasya pādasaṃvāhanaṃ mudā ।
anyā jalaṃ dadau kācid dadau satpavanaṃ śanaiḥ ।। 32 ।।
kāciccandanalepaṃ ca cakāra kṛṣṇavarṣmaṇi ।
aparā hastamādāya granthisphoṭaṃ cakāra ha ।। 33 ।।
itarā jaṃghayoḥ sakthnormardanaṃ pracakāra vai ।
nanṛtuśca jaguḥ kāścit kāściccucumburutsukāḥ ।।34।।
kācit kṛṣṇaṃ samādāya nikuṃje prajagāma ha ।
anyā taṃ śayane kṛtvā''dade ratisukhaṃ mudā ।।35।।
nartanaṃ kārayāmāsa taṃ tu kācid balena vai ।
so'pi kasyāścitkabaryāḥ sunirmāṇaṃ cakāra ha ।।36।।
sindūraṃ pradadau bhāle kastūrīṃ bindubhiḥ saha ।
atisūkṣmaṃ candanenduṃ kautukāt tadadho dadau ।।37।।
patrāvalīṃ sulalitāṃ sukapole cakāra ha ।
pādayormañjire datvā'laktakaṃ sundaraṃ dadau ।।38।।
bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayāmāsa lopayāmāsa candanam ।
pradade nāsikāmadhye durlabhaṃ gajamauktikam ।।39।।
evaṃ kṛṣṇā navalakṣaṃ navalakṣaṃ ca gopikāḥ ।
anyonyaṃ bhūṣayāmāsuḥ rame! kāmāticeṣṭitāḥ ।।1.488.40।।
bahumūrtīḥ saṃvidhāya yogināṃ paramo guruḥ ।
punaścakāra śṛṃgāraṃ gopīnāṃ kāmasaukhyadam ।।41 ।।
mūrchāmavāpuḥ satataṃ kāmānandapariplutāḥ ।
evaṃ rāmā ramayitvā kṛtvā ṣāṇmāsikīṃ niśām ।।42।।
nidrāṃ dīrghāṃ bhuvi kṛtvā kṛtvā'rkasya sthirāṃ gatim ।
kāmatṛptiṃ parāṃ datvā'pyūrdhvaretāḥ pareśvaraḥ ।।43।।
apraskhalitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo babhūva kāmagarvahṛt ।
punarjagāma rāsasya maṇḍape rāsakhelanam ।।44।।
cakāra bahubhramaṇairvividhaiḥ kīrtanaistadā ।
sarve devādayo vyomni sthitāḥ patnīprajāyutāḥ ।।45।।
cikṣipuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ ca dadṛśū rāsamaṇḍalam ।
kastūrīcandanādīnāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ cakrurmunīśvarāḥ ।।46 ।।
jayakāraṃ stutiṃ kṛtvā yayuste yamunātaṭe ।
śrīkṛṣṇo ramayāmāsa viśramya tu punaśca tāḥ ।।47।।
vijahārā'pi sarvatra nirjaneṣu yatheṣṭakam ।
puṣpodyāneṣu ramyeṣu sarasāṃ sutaṭeṣvapi ।।48।।
kandare kandare ramye nadeṣu ca nadīṣvapi ।
vāñcchiteṣu pramadānāṃ trayastriṃśadvaneṣvapi ।।49।।
bhāṇḍīre śrīvane ramye kadambakānane tathā ।
tulasīkānane kundavane campakakānane ।।1.488.50।।
nimbāraṇye madhuvane jambīrakānane tathā ।
nālikeravane pūgavane ca kadalīvane ।।5 1 ।।
badarīkānane bilvavane nāriṃgakānane ।
aśvatthakānane vaṃśavane dāḍimakānane ।।5 2।।
mandārakānane tālavane cāmravane tathā ।
ketakīkānane'śokavane kharjūrakānane ।।53 ।।
āmrātakavane jambūvane śālasukānane ।
kaṭādikānane padmavane jātivane tathā ।।54।।
nyagrodhagahane ramye tathā śrīkhaṇḍakānane ।
prakṛṣṭakesaravane reme ṣāṇmāsikīṃ niśām ।।55।।
kāminīnāṃ yathā kāmaḥ śṛṃgāreṇa vivardhate ।
tathā tathā harī reme tāsāmānandadāyakaḥ ।।56।।
tathāpi mānasaṃ pūrṇaṃ kāminīnāṃ babhūva na ।
āprātarevaṃ rāseṣu dadau kāmasukhaṃ hariḥ ।।57।।
sarvāsāṃ ca yadā kāmatṛptirjātā mumoca tāḥ ।
tato yamyāṃ gatā vārṣu krīḍanārthaṃ tataḥ param ।।58।।
kṛṣṇastvadṛśyatāṃ yāto gopyo yayurnijālayān ।
etā gopāṃganāḥ sarvā neśvaraṃ menire patim ।।59।।
kāmukyaḥ kāmabhāvena ratiśūraṃ hi manvate ।
tathāpi tanmanaskāstāḥ prāpurdivyagatiṃ priyāḥ ।।1.488.6 0।।
divyayogājjaḍaṃ cāpi divyabhāvaṃ vrajatyapi ।
kṛṣṇaṃ loṣṭaṃ vahniyogād vahnibhāvaṃ hi ṛcchati ।।6 1 ।।
atha rāsasya vai śreṣṭhānmaṇḍapān kṛtrimān śubhān ।
viśvakarmakṛtān divyān śatayojanavistṛtān ।।6 2।।
navalakṣāsanān ramyānparyaṃkānnavalakṣakān ।
viśvakarmā tirohitāँścakāra kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।।6 3 ।।
athaikalaḥ kiśoro'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ svagṛhaṃ prati ।
yāvadgacchati mārge taṃ dadarśa munipuṃgavaḥ ।। 64।।
aṣṭāvakraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo digambaro jaṭānvitaḥ ।
nakhaśmaśrusudīrghaśca śāntaḥ praṇatakandharaḥ ।।6 5 ।।
sa vai praṇamya govindaṃ tuṣṭāva munipuṃgavaḥ ।
prāṇāँstatyāja yogena nipatya caraṇāmbuje ।।66 ।।
tattejastu samuttasthau saptatālapramāṇakam ।
sudivyaḥ puruṣo bhūtvā tasthau kṛṣṇasamīpataḥ ।।67।।
dṛṣṭvā mṛtaṃ muniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskāraṃ kartumudyataḥ ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi nirāhāro'bhavanmuniḥ ।।6 8।।
raktamāṃsā'sthihīnaṃ tadvarṣma bhasmabhṛtaṃ hyabhūt। ।
taduddhṛtya dadau kṛṣṇaścitāyāṃ bhasma miśritam ।।6 9 ।।
etasminnantare vyomnaḥ syandanaḥ prasamāyayau ।
pārṣadapravarairyuktaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasadṛśairvaraiḥ ।।1.488.70।।
pārṣadāḥ śrīhariṃ natvā nītvā taṃ divyapūruṣam ।
aṣṭāvakraṃ muktadehaṃ jagmurgolokamuttamam ।।71 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! brahmaṇastu pracetāstasya cā'sitaḥ ।
sutaḥ saputravihīnastapastepe sahasrakam ।।72।।
abdānāṃ sakalatro'pi na lebhe ca yadā sutam ।
tadā prāṇān vihātuṃ so'bhavadudyamito'tha vai ।।73।।
taṃ samboddhuṃ babhūvā'tha satyā vāgaśarīriṇī ।
kathaṃ tyajasi prāṇāँstvaṃ gaccha śaṃkarasannidhim ।।74।।
siddhaṃ kuru gṛhītvā tu mantraṃ śaṃkaravaktrataḥ ।
vareṇā'bhīṣṭadevyāśca putraste bhavitā dhruvam ।।75।।
śrutvā yayau sa kailāsaṃ sakalatra uvāca tam ।
mahādeva kṛpāsindho dehi putraṃ namāmyaham ।।76।।
haraḥ prāha bhavitā te putro madaṃśamatsamaḥ ।
japa mantraṃ 'rādhikāyai śrīkṛṣṇāya namo'stu te' ।।77।।
rādhā mantreṇa pratyakṣā śatavarṣottaraṃ hyabhūt। ।
putravān bhava cetyuktvā'dṛśyā babhūva rādhikā ।।78।।
asitasya tataḥ putro devalākhyo babhūva ha ।
suyajñanṛpateḥ kanyāṃ ratnamālāvatībruvām ।।79।।
jagṛhe sa vivāhena śatavarṣottaraṃ sa ca ।
viraktaḥ śayane tyaktvā tāṃ svayaṃ tu vanaṃ yayau ।।1.488.80।।
tapase parvate gandhamādane'bdasahasrakam ।
tapaścacāra divyo'bhūd dehena sūryavad dvijaḥ ।।81 ।।
raṃbhā taṃ devalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvekadā kāmamohitā ।
tapobhaṃgārthamāgacchajjagrāha devalo na tām ।।82।।
ruṣṭā śāpaṃ dadau kopādantarduḥkhānvitā satī ।
kāmaduḥkhena duḥkhārtā yato māṃ svīkaroṣi na ।।83।।
bhava kubjaścāṣṭavakro jarjaro nīlavikṛtaḥ ।
tapohīnaḥ kurūpaśca kāminījanagarhitaḥ ।।84।।
rambhā śaptvā yayau svargamṛṣirnāmnā'ṣṭavakrakaḥ ।
devalaḥ sa prasiddho'bhūt prayayau malayācalam ।।85।।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapaḥ punaścakāra saḥ ।
so'yaṃ jñātvā rāsakhelaṃ darśanāya samāgataḥ ।।86।।
dhyānamagno dīrghasūtrī na prāpto rāsadarśanam ।
kṛṣṇayogād yayau dhāma golokaṃ bhaktimān muniḥ ।।87।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuryayau nandagṛhaṃ tataḥ ।
prātaḥ smaranti sarvāstā vikṛtāḥ kṛṣṇatanmayāḥ ।।88।।
iti lakṣmi! kathitaṃ te rāsamaṇḍalamuttamam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya kṛṣṇaprāptirbhaveddhruvam ।।89।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne rāsamaṇḍale gopībhiḥ kāmabhāvena kṛṣṇasya caritram, devalasya raṃbhāyāḥ śāpenā'ṣṭāvakratvaṃ, tasya mokṣaṇaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāśītyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।488।।


← adhyāyaḥ 488 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 489
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 490 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ ramyāṃ camatkārapurodbhavām ।
satyadharmaparāṃ tiryagyonimokṣakarīṃ śubhām ।। 1 ।।
nāganadyāstaṭe tatra dakṣiṇe yojanadvaye ।
āste sarovaraṃ dīrghaṃ pañcayojanavistṛtam ।। 2 ।।
kasyacittvatha kālasya snātvā tatra sarovare ।
durvāsā munirāḍ rājñaḥ kalaśasya gṛhaṃ yayau ।। 3 ।।
camatkārapureśaṃ taṃ kalaśaṃ prāha satvaraḥ ।
cāturmāsyavratastho'haṃ pāraṇaṃ kartumutsahe ।। 4 ।।
tasmād yatkiṃcidannaṃ te siddhamasti gṛhe nṛpa ।
tad dehi bhojanārthaṃ me bubhukṣā'tīva vardhate ।। 5 ।।
kalaśākhyo mahārājaḥ siddhānnaṃ yadupasthitam ।
miṣṭānnaṃ vyañjanaṃ coṣyaṃ peyaṃ khādyaṃ tathā''miṣam ।। 6 ।।
sarvaṃ bhojyakṛte tasmai pradadau svayameva vai ।
athā'sau bubhuje vipraḥ sūpaṃ māṃsarasānvitam ।। 7 ।।
ajñātabhojano vipro jñātvā'nnaṃ māṃsamiśritam ।
vratabhaṃgasya doṣeṇa cukopa taṃ śaśāpa ca ।। 8 ।।
yato māṃsānvitaṃ datvā vratabhaṃgaḥ kṛto mama ।
tasmāttvaṃ cāmiṣāhāro bhava vyāghro vanādiṣu ।। 9 ।।
rājā pradīnavacanaḥ provācā'nugrahaṃ kuru ।
ājñāṃkitasya dāsasya bhaktasya vinatasya ca ।। 1.489.1 0।।
durvāsāstaṃ tataḥ prāha yadā dhenustu nandinī ।
śaṃbhorbāṇaṃ bhūtalasthaṃ darśayiṣyati te nṛpa ।। 11 ।।
bhaviṣyasi tadā muktaścetyuktvā. prayayau muniḥ ।
babhūva rājā bhayakṛd vyāghrākṛtirvanecaraḥ ।। 1 2।।।
atha kālena ca gavāṃ kulaṃ tṛṇārthamāgatam ।
yatrāsīnnandinī dhenurhaṃsavarṇā ghaṭasravā ।। 1 3।।
sā tṛṇārthaṃ nikuṃjānte gatā liṃgaṃ tu śūlinaḥ ।
dadarśa tṛṇadhānyādicchannaṃ gulmādimadhyagam ।। 14।।
tatastasyopari sthitvā susrāva sumahatpayaḥ ।
tatra daivāt sa vai vyāghro bhramaँstvarita āyayau ।। 15।।
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ nandinīṃ vyāghraḥ prajagrāha tatastu sā ।
goṣṭhe baddhaṃ svakaṃ vatsamatṛṇādaṃ payaḥparam ।। 16।।
saṃsmṛtya duḥkhitā dīnā karuṇaṃ paryadevayat ।
aho'haṃ kena pāpena tyaktvā vālaṃ tu goṣṭhagam ।। 17।।
maraṇārtha vyāghramukhe patitā śaṃkaro'vatu ।
yena satyena bhaktyā tai snapanāya tṛṇāya ca ।। 18।।
āgatā tena satyena bhūyānme sutasaṃgamaḥ ।
vyāghraḥ śrutvā tāmuvāca tyaja vṛthā pralāpakān ।। 1 9।।
iṣṭadevaṃ svargadaṃ tvaṃ smara saukhyaṃ tato bhavet ।
avaśyaṃ maraṇaṃ te'sti yato'sti vaśagā mama ।।1.489.20।।
dhenuḥ prāha śṛṇu vyāghra nātmānaṃ vilapāmyaham ।
śaṃbhupūjāṃ vidhāyaiva mṛtyurme mokṣado yataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
vatso me gokule baddhaḥ smaramāṇo madāgamam ।
santiṣṭhate payovṛttiḥ kathaṃ syāt sa mayā vinā ।।22।।
tasmānmuñca mahāvyāghra māmadya sutavatsalām ।
sakhījanasya taṃ datvā samāgacchāmi te'ntikam ।।23।।
vyāghra uvāca yā mṛtyormukhānniṣkramya yāti sā ।
punarnaiva samāgacchet tasmāt tvāṃ bhakṣayāmi ।।24।।
nandinyuvāca śapathairāgamiṣyāmi te'ntikam ।
yatpāpaṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ mātāpitrośca vañcane ।।25।।
guroḥ sādhorvañcane ca patyuḥ sādhvyāśca vañcane ।
tena pāpena lipyāmi nā''gacchāmi punaryadi ।।26।।
viśvāsaghātināṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaghnānāṃ ca yadbhavet ।
vratabhaṃgaprakartṝṇāṃ devakhaṇḍanakāriṇām ।।27।।
nindakānāṃ jīvikāhāriṇāṃ pāpaṃ ca yadbhavet ।
tena pāpena lipyāmi nā''gacchāmi punaryadi ।।28।।
evaṃ śapathān vyāghraḥ sa śrutvā vismayato'bravīt ।
yadyevaṃ tadgṛhaṃ gaccha vīkṣayasva nijātmajam ।।29।।
sakhīnāmarpayitvā'tha bhūya āgamanaṃ kuru ।
ityuktā raṃbhamāṇā sā yayau vatsaṃ tvarānvitā ।।1.489.3 0।।
athā'kālā''gatāṃ dṛṣṭvā raṃbhamāṇāṃ svamātaram ।
vatsaḥ prapaccha kasmāt tvamadyā'kāle samāgatā ।।3 1 ।।
udbhrāntamānasāḥ kasmād bāṣpaklinnānanā kutaḥ ।
mātā prāha payaḥpānaṃ kuru paścād vadāmi te ।।32।।
vatsaḥ papau payaḥ pūrṇaṃ mūrdhnyāghrātastayā muhuḥ ।
ālīḍhaśca śanairukto vyāghravṛttānta eva ca ।।33।।
ahaṃ gatā vane tvadya vyāghreṇāsāditā balāt ।
sa mayā prārthito vyāghro bhakṣamāṇo nakhāyudhaḥ ।।34।।
śapathairāgamiṣyāmi goṣṭhe saṃvīkṣya bālakam ।
sā'haṃ tena vinirmuktā tavārthaṃ śapathaiḥ suta ।।35।।
atha tatra gamiṣyāmi datvā tvāmanyadhenave ।
sukhī jīva priya vatsa bhojito dṛṣṭabhāṣitaḥ ।।36।।
vatsā''hāhaṃ ca tatraiva yāsyāmi yatra gacchasi ।
ślāghyaṃ hi maraṇaṃ samyaṅ māturagre mamā'dhunā ।।37।।
ekākinā'pi martavyaṃ tvayā hīnena vai mayā ।
tvadagrato hi martavyaṃ svargadaṃ me bhaviṣyati ।।38।।
yadi mātastvayā sārdhaṃ vyāghro māṃ sūdayiṣyayi ।
yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ sā me nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।39।।
athavā śapathaiścāhaṃ yāmi tvamatra tiṣṭha vai ।
nāsti mātṛsamo bandhurbālānāṃ kṣīrajīvinām ।।1.489.40।।
nāsti mātṛsamo nātho nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ ।
nāsti mātṛsamaḥ pūjyo nāsti mātṛsamaḥ sakhā ।।41 ।।
nāsti mātṛsamo devastviha loke paratra ca ।
evaṃ sevā sadā mātuḥ kartavyā bhaktiruttamā ।। 42।।
mātṛsevāṃ paraṃ dharmamanutiṣṭhanti ye sutāḥ ।
gatiṃ te paramāṃ yānti mātrāśīrvādalakṣitāḥ ।।43।।
tasmādahaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvaṃ tu tiṣṭhā'tra goṣṭhake ।
ātmaprāṇaistava prāṇān rakṣayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam ।।44।।
putravākyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ śrutvovāca tu nandinī ।
mamaiva vihito mṛtyurna te putrā'dya vāsare ।।45।।
tatkathaṃ mama jīvaṃ tvaṃ rakṣasyasubhirātmanaḥ ।
māturvākyamanuṣṭhāya pramādaṃ mā samācara ।।46 ।।
lobhāt saṃjāyate nāśastviha loke paratra ca ।
lobhātpramādādviśvāsājano vai badhyate tribhiḥ ।।47।।
tasmāllobhastvayā putra mā kāryo gamanāya vai ।
ātmā putra tvayā rakṣyaḥ sarvadaiva prayatnataḥ ।।48।।
naikākinā pragantavyaṃ yūthaṃ tyaktvā nijaṃ kvacit ।
evaṃ saṃbhāṣya taṃ lakṣmi! muhustamavalihya vai ।।49।।
śokabāṣpasamāyuktā sakhīmadhye'bhavat kṣaṇam ।
uvāca bahule! campe! vasudhāre! ghaṭasrave! ।।1.489.50।।
haṃsanāde! śriyānande । śubhakṣīre! mahodaye! ।
tathā'nyā dhenavaḥ sarvāḥ śrutvā kurvantu madvacaḥ ।।51।।
adya vyāghreṇa nikaṭe bhakṣyārthaṃ gṛhītā'smyaham ।
prāptā yuṣmaddarśanārthaṃ sutasya darśanāya ca ।।52।।।
śapathaiḥ kṛcchrāccāyātā duṣṭaḥ putraḥ subhāṣitaḥ ।
śāsito bhavatīnāṃ ca pradattaḥ putrako mayā ।।53।।
jñānā'jñānakṛtaṃ yadvai bhavatīnāṃ tu duṣkṛtam ।
kṣāntvā'nāthodugdhapo me bālo rakṣyaḥ sadā priyāḥ ।।54।।
mātṛśokābhisantaptaḥ pālyaḥ sarvābhireva saḥ ।
ahaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi sa vyāghro yatra vartate ।।55।।
apaścimaḥ praṇāmo'yaṃ sarvāsāṃ vihito mayā ।
śrutvā tad dhenavaḥ prāhurna gantavyaṃ hi nandini! ।।56।।
āpaddharme śapathastu mṛṣā kartavya eva yat ।
pāpaṃ nāsti mṛṣāvaktaḥ prāṇanāśe hyupasthite ।।57।।
vivāhe narmaṇi nāryāṃ prāṇāpadi dhanāpadi ।
anṛtaṃ nahi pāpāya dharmaḥ proktaḥ sa rakṣakaḥ ।।58।।
pālayasva nijaṃ putraṃ vrajā'smābhirnijaṃ gṛham ।
śrutvā tā nandinī prāha paraprāṇasya rakṣaṇe ।।59।।
pañcā'nṛtaṃ śubho dharmo na svaprāṇasya rakṣaṇe ।
sādhūnāṃ satyamevā'sti dharmastāraṇakārakaḥ ।।1.489.60 ।।
satye pratiṣṭhito loko dharmaḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
viṣṇave pṛthivīṃ datvā baliḥ satye vyavasthitaḥ ।।61।।
pratijñāya vihanyāccet sarvaghātī bhaveddhi saḥ ।
dhenavo'tha tadā prāhurnamaskāryā'si sarvathā ।।62।।
satyadharmavatī prāṇān gaṇayasyeva naiva yat ।
kiṃ vakṣyāmo vṛṣe satye sthitāṃ tvāṃ devavanditām ।।63।।
tasmād gaccha mahāpuṇye na śocyaḥ putrakastvayā ।
śubhaste vijayaścāstu dharmo rakṣatu nandinīm ।।64।।
ityuktvā nandinī sakhījanān natvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।
vanādhidevatāḥ sarvā rakṣantu mama putrakam ।।65।।
evaṃ pralapamānā sā yayau vyāghrasthalaṃ tu gauḥ ।
vyāghro vyāttānanaścāste tasyā mārgāvalokakaḥ ।।66।।
nandinī prāha taṃ natvā tvāgatā'haṃ vanecara ।
satyamālambya dharma vai kuru tṛptiṃ prabhakṣaya ।।67।।
vyāghraḥ prāha sati! satye sthitā vighnavivarjitā ।
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā'haṃ mahāpuṇyo bhavāmyadyā'tipāvanaḥ ।।68।।
nahi satyavatāṃ kiñcidaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit ।
ahaṃ bhadre durācāro hiṃsakaḥ pāpaśevadhiḥ ।।69।।
tvāṃ dharmiṣṭhāṃ ghātayitvā prāpsyāmi khalu kāṃ gatim ।
tasmāt tvaṃ me jñānadānaprasādaṃ kartumarhasi ।।1.489.70।।
satsaṃgaṃ saphalaṃ labdhvā gatirme śubhadā bhavet ।
dhenuḥ prāha tapaḥ satye, tretāyāṃ dhyānameva tu ।।71 ।।
dvāpare yajñadānaṃ ca, dānamekaṃ kalau śubham ।
kalyante tu harernāma tārakaṃ kevalaṃ bhavet ।।72।।
sarvadānottamadānaṃ hyabhayasya pradānakam ।
hiṃsrāṇāṃ tu bhavet tanna tasmācchrīharikīrtanam ।।73।।
sevanaṃ śrīharervāpi śaṃbhorvā rādhikāpateḥ ।
karma mokṣakaraṃ syācca tvaṃ sadā tatsamācara ।।74।।
gahane'tra vane vyāghra vartate'tra harasthalam ।
tṛṇacchannaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ nityaṃ prātaḥ prapūjaya ।।75।।
pradakṣiṇāṃ praṇāmādi kuru muktirbhaviṣyati ।
ityuktvā darśayāmāsa liṃgaṃ vyāghrasya nandinī ।।76।।
vyāghro dṛṣṭvā satvaraṃ vai yathā rājā'bhavat purā ।
durvāsaḥśāpamukto'bhūt smṛtvā prāha ca nandinīm ।।77।।
nṛpaḥ kalaśanāmā'haṃ haihayā'nvayasaṃbhavaḥ ।
durvāsaso muneḥ śāpād vyāghratve samupāgataḥ ।।78।।
nandinīdhenuyogena śāpamuktirbhaviṣyati ।
śaṃkarasya darśanena punā rājā bhaviṣyasi ।।79।।
ityahaṃ pūrvavṛttāntaṃ smarāmyadya śucitvade! ।
ityuktvā sa praṇamyaiva gāṃ śivaṃ taṃ nanāma ca ।।1.489.80 ।।
pupūja parayā bhaktyā snapayāmāsa gauḥ śivam ।
dugdhena tu tadā śaṃbhurāvirbhūya jagāda ha ।।81 ।।
mama bhaktau sadā śuddhau muktyarthaṃ kṛṣṇameva vai ।
bhajatāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ hariṃ mudā ।।82।।
ityuktau 'śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
mantraṃ gṛhītvā yayaturnijaṃ nijaṃ gṛhaṃ tataḥ ।।83।।
kuṭumbādikamubhayorānandaṃ cāptavat tadā ।
kālena muktimāpanno kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśritau ।।84।।
vimānena sudivyena yayatuḥ kṛṣṇadhāma tau ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vṛṣaṃ labhet ।।85।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkārapurīyakalaśākhyanṛpasya durvāsasaḥ śāpād vyāghratvaṃ, nandinīdhenuyogācchivadarśanānmuktiḥ, satyavratasya prabhāvaścetinirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।489।।


← adhyāyaḥ 489 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 490
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 491 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ tvanyāṃ sadbhāgyasampadāṃ pradām ।
āsīd rājā vṛko nāma somavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ।। 1 ।।
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
tayoḥ paścimavarṣeṣu kanyā tvekā'bhavat tadā ।। 2 ।।
jyotirvido janmalagnaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāhurnṛpaṃ nṛpīm ।
citrāsaṃsthe ravau tithau caturdaśyāṃ niśākare ।। 3 ।।
yā kanyā prāpnuyājjanma sā bhaved viṣakanyakā ।
tasyāḥ pāṇergrāhakaḥ ṣaṇmāseṣu nidhanaṃ vrajet ।। 4 ।।
yadgṛhe janma cāpannā tat syād vaibhavavarjitam ।
seyaṃ rājaँstava putrī tādṛśī viṣakanyakā ।। 5 ।।
paitṛkaṃ śvaśurīyaṃ ca haniṣyati gṛhadvayam ।
rājaँstyaktvā tatastāṃ tvaṃ sadā rājye sukhī bhava ।। 6 ।।
yadvā sā ca bhavet sādhvī yatinī sāṃkhyayoginī ।
tadā kuladvayoddhāraṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 7 ।।
abhāgyānāmapi bhāgyaṃ tyāgitve parivartate ।
bhasmacchanno yatiścūrṇamoṣadhaṃ śreyase yataḥ ।। 8 ।।
yatra kvāpi samutpanno yatirmaṇiśca mauktikam ।
svarṇaṃ kanyauṣadhaṃ sarve divyatāṃ yānti dīkṣayā ।। 9 ।।
tasmād yatheṣṭaṃ kartavyaṃ rocate yacca te nṛpa ।
ityukto'pi sa rājarṣirmatvā bhāgyaṃ svapūrvakṛt ।। 1.490.1 0।।
mārjayitumaśakyaṃ tāṃ na vai tatyāja vatsalaḥ ।
yena yena śarīreṇa yadyat karma karoti yaḥ ।। 11 ।।
yasyāṃ yasyāmavasthāyāṃ yādṛśādvegataśca yat ।
tena tasyāṃ ca tadbhuṃkte nā'kṛtaṃ prāpyate kvacit ।। 1 2।।
pañcaitānīha sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ ।
āyuḥ karma ca vittaṃ ca vidyā nidhanameva ca ।। 13 ।।
yathā vṛkṣeṣu vallīṣu phalāni kusumāni ca ।
svaṃ kālaṃ nātivartante tadvatkarma purākṛtam ।। 14।।
yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vidanti mātaram ।
tathaiva koṭimadhyasthaṃ kartāraṃ karma vindati ।। 1 5।।
svena pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma na kaścid dehavān bhuvi ।
balena prajñayā vāpi samarthaḥ kartumanyathā ।। 16।।
svakṛtānyupatiṣṭhanti sukhaduḥkhāni dehinām ।
ahaṃkāramamatvābhyāṃ sajjate yaḥ sa baddhyate ।। 17।।
suśīghramabhidhāvantaṃ nijaṃ karmā'bhidhāvati ।
śete saha śayānena tiṣṭhantamanutiṣṭhati ।। 18।।
yena yatrāpi bhoktavyaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukhaḥmeva vā ।
naraḥ sa baddho rajjveva balāttatraiva nīyate ।। 1 9।।
jāgratāṃ svapatāṃ vāpi prajalpatāṃ pragacchatām ।
karma siṣādhayiṣūṇāṃ pratipādayitāmapi ।।1.490.20।।
sarvasvārpaṇakartṝṇāmavaśyamupatiṣṭhati ।
tailakṣaye yathādīpo nirvāṇamadhigacchati ।।2 1 ।।
karmakṣaye tvāśayānāṃ kṣaye nirvāṇamṛcchati ।
kleśamūlā vāsanā sā karmāśayā nigadyate ।।22।।
tadutpannaphalaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭajanmani vedhate ।
na mantrā na tapo dānaṃ na tīrthaṃ na ca vā''śrayaḥ ।।23 ।।
samarthā rakṣituṃ jantuṃ pūrvakarmapravāhataḥ ।
annapānāni jīryanti bhojanāni divāniśam ।।24।।
tasminnevodare garbhaḥ kathaṃ nāma na jīryate ।
tasmād garbhasamaṃ karma bhoge vinā na naśyati ।।25।।
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ svakṛtaṃ prāpyate janaiḥ ।
tadvadiyaṃ mama putrī yathākarma samāgatā ।।26।।
viṣakanyā mama bhāgye likhitā pūrvakarmabhiḥ ।
tattathā'stu daivadattaṃ helanīyaṃ na karhicit ।।27।।
upasthitaṃ tu bhogārthaṃ samāgacchatu māṃ prati ।
vaibhave bahavo bhogā tannāśe tāpasī sthitiḥ ।।28।।
ubhayatrāpi lābho me nirvāṇaṃ ca nisargataḥ ।
daivadattaṃ mileccedvai ko lābhastata uttamaḥ ।।29।।
putrī nimittarūpā me vairāgye'pi bhaviṣyati ।
mama muktau ca tasyāśca muktirapi bhaviṣyati ।। 1.490.3 0।।
arakṣaṃ tiṣṭhati daivād daivānnaśyati rakṣitam ।
daivājjīvatyanātho'pi daivānnaśyati nāthavān ।।3 1 ।।
ativārdhakyasaukhyārthaṃ putrī tvālambanaṃ mama ।
saviṣā vā sarvanāśā kathaṃ tyajāmi cātmajām ।।32।।
anāthāmabalāṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ syāṃ bhrūṇahā bhuvi ।
poṣyatyāgaṃ vidhāyaiva bhaveyaṃ yāmyagaḥ katham ।।33।।
ātmā putrī putratulyā tadarthe pṛthivīṃ tyajet ।
saiva lakṣmī mama bālā mama bhāgyādupāgatā ।।34।।
ete svārthaparāḥ sarve vadantu manasepsitam ।
mayā putrī rakṣaṇīyā vairāgyāya nivṛttaye ।।35।।
kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ bahusamaṃ dṛṣṭā bhogā anantakāḥ ।
putrīmiṣeṇa nirbandhaḥ kariṣye bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।36।।
sarvaṃ naśyatu me śīghraṃ svārthā naśyantu vighnadāḥ ।
bhaktirmuktiḥ sutā śāntiḥ sadvṛttirmā vinaśyatu ।।37।।
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā nā''tyajat kanyakāṃ nijām ।
sāpi śarmavatī nityaṃ vairāgyeṇa hi vartate ।।38।।
tasmāt śarmavatī nāmnā kṛtā pitrā sukhapradā ।
atha sā yauvanaṃ prāptā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā ।।39।।
bhajati sma prage snātvā namati sma pituḥ padam ।
sevate sma prasūṃ sādhvī matvā puṇyamanuttamam ।।1.490.40 ।।
atha pūrvakṛtād daivād vṛkasya nṛpateḥ purīm ।
śatravaḥ parito vṛttvā tvayuddhyan bahuvāsarān ।।41 ।।
vṛko yuddhe hato daivād dine tu daśame yadā ।
tadā lokāstadevocuranayā viṣakanyāyā ।।42। ।
rājño rājyaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ rājā'pi nihato raṇe ।
ukto jyotirvidā pūrvaṃ nṛpastatyāja naiva tām ।।43 ।।
adhunā vadhyatāṃ tveṣā niryāsyatāṃ purāditaḥ ।
avaśiṣṭasya rakṣā syādanyathā nāśa eva hi ।।44।।
kanyā śrutvā prajāvāṇīṃ niryayau niśithe satī ।
hāṭakeśvaraśaṃbhośca kṣetraṃ gatvā kṣaṇaṃ sthitā ।।।45।।।
natvā śaṃbhuṃ śokamagnā cintayāmāsa vai mṛtim ।
atha tasyāḥ smṛtirjātā pūrvajanmasamudbhavā ।।46।।
caṇḍālatve mayā pūrvaṃ gaurekā vitṛṣīkṛtā ।
tatpuṇyena nṛpaputrī sañjātā'smi vṛkālaye ।।47।।
pūrvadehe bahuputrā tvāsaṃ caṇḍālabhāminī ।
vigarhitā ca dāridryakadarthitā kṣudhārditā ।।48।।
tṛṣārditā'pyahaṃ dadau jalaṃ gave supuṣkalam ।
tena puṇyena saṃjātā kanyā'haṃ bhūbhṛtaḥ khalu ।।49।।
kintu caṇḍālaputrītve tadā gaurīṃ tu kānakīm ।
corayitvā ca pāṣāṇairbabhaṃja khaṇḍaśaśca tām ।।।1.490.50।।
devālayād vinirgatya vikrayārthaṃ mahāpaṇam ।
yāvadgatavatī tāvaddhṛtā rājabhaṭairaham ।।51 ।।
tāḍitā daṇḍitā kārāgāre kṣiptā tato mṛtā ।
pārvatīmūrtibhaṃgena sañjātā viṣakanyakā ।।52।।
mama karma mayā'vaśyaṃ bhoktavyamaghameva tu ।
kintu jalapradānasya puṇyaṃ prāptaṃ mayā śubham ।।53 ।।
atha tatroṭajāṃ kṛtvā karomi tapa uttamam ।
jaladānaṃ phaladānaṃ yathāśakti ca sevanam ।।54।।
satāṃ yatīnāṃ sādhunāṃ gavāṃ dharmiṣṭhayoṣitām ।
bālānāṃ devabhaktānāṃ sevayā mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।।55।।
iti kṛtvā tapastepe gaurīṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ ।
vrataṃ kṛtavatī gauryāḥ snātvā pūjādi cācarat ।।56।।
ekāntaropavāsaiśca nṛtyagītairmanoharaiḥ ।
toṣayāmāsa nityaṃ sā grīṣme pañcāgnisādhanā ।।57।।
śiśire jalamadhyasthā varṣāyāṃ jalavṛṣṭiṣu ।
sthitā pūrvaṃ phalāhārā patrāhārā tataḥ param ।।58।।
śuṣkaparṇādinī paścājjalāhārā babhūva sā ।
vāyvāhārā tato jātā cātmārāmā tataḥ param ।।।59।।
ākāśaśayanā tyaktakuṭīrā ca digambarā ।
babhūva dhūlikāmagnā bhūtale bhūtalaṃ yathā ।।1.490.60।
bahukālo gatastasyā yoginyā yogadharmataḥ ।
mukhaṃ valibhirākrāntaṃ palitairaṅkitaṃ śiraḥ ।।6 1 ।
kanyābhāve'pi vartantyā gaurī tuṣṭā babhūva ha ।
atha tasyāḥ parīkṣārthaṃ śacī bhūtvā tu pārvatī ।।62।।
śvetaṃ gajaṃ samāruhya mahārājñī samāyayau ।।.
dadhatī mukuṭaṃ mūrdhni sevyamānā'psarogaṇaiḥ ।।6 3।।
prasannavadanā śarmavatīṃ provāca sādaram ।
varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ te dadāmi tāpasi priye ।।64।।
ahaṃ bhāryā sureśasyendrāṇī bhavāmi nāmataḥ ।
svayaṃ prāptā dayāṃ kṛtvā dātuṃ tava tapaḥphalam ।।65।।
bhavānī niṣṭhurā kanye nā'dyāpi tvāṃ prapaśyati ।
iti śrutvā rajo dehāduddhūlya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ ।।66।।
namaskṛtyā''ha nā'haṃ tvatprasādaṃ cintaye śaci ।
varaṃ tvattastu necchāmi nā'nyāsāṃ devayoṣitām ।।67।।
yā devī śivakāntā'sti varaṃ tasyā vṛṇomyaham ।
yayā varṣasahasrāṇi śivārthaṃ taptameva yat ।।68।।
kṛṣṇavāmāṃgasaṃbhūtā prakṛtiryā sadāśivā ।
yayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā varaṃ vṛṇomyaham ।।69।।
śacyuvāca tanayā kanyāmahaṃ vajradharī śacī ।
svāminyahaṃ tu devānāṃ devīnāmīśvarī satī ।।1.490.70 ।।
mayā dattairvaraiḥ sarvā devyo bhavanti kanyake ।
tvaṃ kathaṃ naiva gṛhṇāsi varaṃ mattaḥ kutāpasi! ।।7 1 ।।
tannūnaṃ vajraghātena cūrṇayiṣyāmi te śiraḥ ।
iti śrutvā dhairyayuktā kanyā prāha sureśvarīm ।।72।।
svāminī tvaṃ surāṇāṃ ca devīnāmapi tadṛtam ।
yasyāḥ prāptaṃ tavaiśvaryaṃ parāṃ tāṃ toṣayāmyaham ।।73।।
svāgataṃ te mātṛtulyaṃ pūjye'rcayāmi satphalaiḥ ।
svalpamapyaparādhaṃ te na karomi maheśvari ।।74।।
tathāpi vadhayogyāṃ māṃ manyase nikṣipā''yudham ।
evamuktvā śivāṃ dhyātvā'vātatāra hṛdambare ।।75।।
cintayāmāsa ca hṛdi maraṇaṃ vā ca darśanam ।
ekaṃ labdhavyamevā'tra śacyā vā śivayoṣitaḥ ।।76 ।।
anyathā jvalanaṃ yogyaṃ sevayiṣyāmi cānalam ।
tāvat tvairāvato jātastadā siṃhasvarūpakaḥ ।।77।।
śacī jātā śivārūpā hyapsarasastu sevikāḥ ।
rudrāṇyo bhālacandrāśca śūlahastāḥ śubhānanāḥ ।।78।।
śuklāṃ śuklavṛṣasthāṃ pārvatīṃ śuklāmbarāṃ hṛdi ।
dṛṣṭvā śarmavatī cakṣurudghāṭyā'gre vyalokayat ।।79।।
viṣakanyā stutiṃ cakre praṇipatya sagadgadā ।
'namaste śāṃkari rakṣākari prāṇātivallabhe ।।1.490.80 ।।
sarvakāmaprade satye bhaktāyā hṛdayaṃgame ।
namasteṣṭaguṇaiśvaryavatyai satyai namo namaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
dhyāyanti yoginastvāṃ cārcayanti snehavastubhiḥ ।
samyagbhāvātmakaiḥ puṣpairarcayāmi maheśvari' ।।82।।
ityuktvā praṇanāmātha pārvatī tāmuvāca ha ।
parituṣṭā'smi te putri varaṃ prārthaya vāñchitam ।।83।।
viṣakanyā tadovāca sarvaṃ jānāsi ceśvari ।
bharturarthe mayā sarvaḥ kṛto'yaṃ tapaudyamaḥ ।।84।।
tatkiṃ tena kariṣyāmi sāmprataṃ jarayā''vṛtā ।
vasā'tra pārvati nityaṃ kanyānāṃ śubhadā bhava ।।85।।
ityuktā pārvatī tathāstviti prāha tataḥ param ।
pasparśa pāṇinā kanyāṃ cakāra navayauvanām ।।86।।
uvāconaṣoḍaśābdāṃ divyā campakasadṛśīm ।
vada kanye varārohe kimiṣyate tataḥ param ।।87।।
kanyā''ha mātaḥ śaṃbhorme darśanaṃ kāraya prabhoḥ ।
satī prāha samāgaccha kailāsaṃ siṃhasaṃsthitā ।।88।।
ityuktā sā śarmavatī yayau kailāsameva tu ।
dṛṣṭvā ca śaṃkaraṃ sādhvī labdhvā mantraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam ।।89।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
kaṇṭhe ca tulasīmālāṃ gṛhītvā sāttvatī tadā ।।1.490.90।।
abhavad vaiṣṇavī kanyā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā ।
ante nārāyaṇaṃ labdhvā patiṃ muktiṃ jagāma sā ।।91 ।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! śarmavatyāḥ śubhāvaham ।
tāpasyāḥ śuklacaritaṃ viṣakanyātapaḥ param ।।92।।
pārvatīniṣṭhayā bhaktyā labdhvā śaṃbhośca darśanam ।
vaiṣṇavī paramā bhūtvā yayau viṣṇostu mandiram ।।93।।
bhāgyahīnā gṛhahīnā karmahīnā'pi yā bhavet ।
tapasā''rādhanayā ca bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheta tu ।।94।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tādṛśīṃ sadgatiṃ labhet ।
bhāgyarekhāṃ surekhāṃ ca kṛtvā dāsyaṃ harervrajet ।।95।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭrīyavṛkarājñaḥ śarmavatyā viṣakanyāyāḥ pitṝājyanāśottaraṃ tapaḥ, pūrvajanmādismṛtiḥ, gaurīśaṃbhvorārādhanā, parīkṣā, varadānam, śivāśivadarśanam, kailāsagamanam, tato nārāyaṇabhaktyā vaikuṇṭhe mokṣaṇaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā
navatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 490 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 490 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 491
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 492 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! camatkārapure nāganadītaṭe ।
muṇḍīre tu vare tīrthe camatkāraṃ vadāmi te ।। 1 ।।
samudrakhāḍikāprānte viṭaṃkākhye pure śubhe ।
kuṣṭhavyādhiyuto vipraḥ śarākhyo yauvane'bhavat ।। 2 ।।
śarabhāryā'bhavat sādhvī sudhāmnī śīlaśālinī ।
svāmisevāparā nityamindriyairnahi cañcalā ।। 3 ।।
kuṣṭhitaṃ svāminaṃ cāpi paśyatyeva yathāsmaram ।
sevate dāsikārītyā patnīrītyā mudā mudā ।। 4 ।।
auṣadhāni vicitrāṇi mahārghyāṇyapi cādade ।
tadarthamupalepāँśca pathyāni vividhāni ca ।। 5 ।।
tathā bhiṣagvarānnityamānayitvā ca sādaram ।
tadarthena guṇastasya yathā syāt sā hyakārayat ।। 6 ।।
yathā yathā sa gṛhṇāti bheṣajāni tathā tathā ।
pūrvakarmavipākena rogo vyāpnoti varṣmaṇi ।। 7 ।।
ekadā tasya cāyāto'tithirvipro'timārgagaḥ ।
taṃ śrāntaṃ ca gṛhaprāptaṃ dṛṣṭvā tasya priyā satī ।। 8 ।।
ajñātaṃ taṃ gṛhibhaktyā bhojanādyairatoṣayat ।
kṛtāhāraṃ suviśrāntaṃ taṃ papraccha śaro dvijaḥ ।। 9 ।।
kuta āgamyate vipra! kutra yāsi sthalāntare ।
pānthaḥ prāha camatkārapurādāyāmi sāmpratam ।। 1.491.1 0।।
yāmi kāntīpurīṃ yatra nivāso me sadā dvija ।
tatrā'hamabhavaṃ kuṣṭhī pūrvakarmavipākataḥ ।। 11 ।।
auṣadhāni vividhāni sevitānyapi sarvadā ।
kuṣṭho na naśyati kiṃcid vardhate tu dine dine ।। 12।।
śrutaṃ cāpi mayā vaidyāccamatkārapure śubhe ।
sūryātīrthaṃ śubhaṃ tvāste kuṣṭhavyādhivināśakam ।। 13 ।।
muṇḍīrasvāminaḥ sthāne sūryadevasya mandiram ।
tatra gacched vrataṃ kṛtvā snāyāt sūryaṃ prapūjayet ।। 14।।
tena kuṣṭho bhavellīnaścamatkāro'sti daivikaḥ ।
athā'ha dravyamādāyā'gacchaṃ tīrthaṃ ravisthalam ।। 15।।
nityaṃ prātaḥ samutthāya snātvā paśyāmi bhāskaram ।
pūjayāmi yathāśakti praṇamāmi smarāmi ca ।। 16।।
sūryavāre viśeṣeṇa nirāhāro bhavāmi ca ।
karomi jāgaraṃ rātrau gītavāditrakīrtanaiḥ ।। 17।।
evaṃ pūjāṃ vrataṃ kurvan yāvatsamvatsaraṃ sthitaḥ ।
tataḥ samvatsarasyā'nte svapne mā bhāskaro'bravīt ।। 18।।
prasanno'smi tava bhaktyā tataḥ kuṣṭhaṃ prayātu te ।
pūrvajanmani devasya yataḥ svarṇaṃ hṛtaṃ tvayā ।। 1 9।।
kuṣṭhī tvamatra saṃjātaḥ pāpaṃ līnaṃ ca tat tava ।
oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ saḥ sūryāya namo rogavināśine ।
evamuktvā ravistatra jalenā'snāpayacca mām ।।1.491.20।।
tāvannidrā mama naṣṭā'paśyaṃ dehaṃ nirogakam ।
ahaṃ vai vismayaṃ prāpto dṛṣṭvā māṃ vyādhivarjitam ।। 21 ।।
tasmāt tvaṃ yāhi viprendra camatkārapuraṃ śubham ।
sūryatīrthaṃ samāśritya vatsaraṃ sūryamarcaya ।
mantraṃ proktaṃ japa mālāvartanena divāniśam । । 22 ।।
sarvavyādhipraṇāśaste sūryasevākṛto bhavet ।
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi svagṛhaṃ tvatra toṣitaḥ ।। 23 ।।
ityuktvā sa yayau vipraścā'tha dvijaḥ sa kuṣṭhabhāg ।
vīkṣāṃcakre nijapatnyā vaktre dīno jano yathā ।। 24।।
patnī pativratā sādhvī pānthoktaṃ cānvamanyata ।
gantavyaṃ nātha tattīrthaṃ yatra sūryo'sti kuṣṭhahā ।। 25।।।
ahaṃ tvayā samaṃ tatra śuśrūṣāniratā sadā ।
sthāsyāmi kaḥ paro lābhaḥ svāminaḥ sevanaṃ vinā ।। 26।।
evamuktaḥ patirvipraḥ sādhvyā vittena saṃyutaḥ ।
hāṭakaśvaraje kṣetre samprāptaḥ sūryamandiram ।। 27।।
dṛṣṭvā sūryagrahakṣetraṃ viśālaṃ tāpasā'nvitam ।
tapomanaścakārā'yaṃ vairāgyaṃ puṇyato yayau ।। 288।।।
sudhāmnīṃ sa tataḥ prāha dhanyo'haṃ tvaṃ tathā priye ।
tīrthakṣetraṃ tāpasāśca ravirdṛṣṭāḥ supuṇyataḥ ।। 29।।
muktirjātā priye'smākaṃ puṇyakṣetrāgamāt khalu ।
māyāmohād viniṣkrāntā bhajiṣyāmo hariṃ sadā ।। 1.491.30 ।।
bhikṣāvṛttiṃ kariṣyāmo jīviṣyāmo yathātatham ।
rogo yātu ca mā yātu janmarogo bhaviṣyati ।। 31 ।।
bhaja śāntiṃ hariṃ sādhvi śāntirme vartate'dhunā ।
tavāpi sarvadā śāntirastu mā khinnatā vraja ।। 32।।
ahaṃ nirvedamāpannaḥ puṇyakṣetrāgamāt priye ।
tvaṃ yadi cecchasi kānte gṛhaṃ gantuṃ vrajā'dhunā ।। 33 ।।
ahaṃ tīrthe svakaṃ dehaṃ tyaktvā yāsyāmi mokṣaṇam ।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rakṣeti vai gṛṇan ।। 34।।
vipraścakāra bhajanaṃ patnī prāha ca taṃ tadā ।
abhukte tvayi no bhuktaṃ kadācit kānta vai mayā ।। 35।।
ekānte'pi mahābhāga na suptaṃ jāgrati tvayi ।
vinā kāntasya caraṇaṃ nāsti tvanyatra mānasam ।। 36 ।।
sukhaṃ sarvaṃ kāntasevāṃ vinā nānyattu me hṛdi ।
kāntena sahitā kāntā sadā bhāgyavatī tviyam ।। 37।।
kāntapuṇyena puṇyā'haṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā vrajāmyaham ।
paralokāya sārthaṃ tvāṃ tyaktvā yāmi kathaṃ gṛham ।। 38 ।।
na gṛhaṃ vai śilājanyaṃ kintu vivāhamālayā।
prāptaṃ vai paralokāya cetanaṃ tvaṃ gṛha mama ।। 3 9।।
bhoktuṃ viśramituṃ rantuṃ tāpaṃ śamayituṃ tathā ।
gṛhaṃ sat kāntarūpaṃ vai satyā nāryāḥ sadā'sti yat। ।।1.491.40।।
ātmano manasastanvāścendriyāṇāṃ sukhāptaye ।
gṛhaṃ krītaṃ prāṇadravyārpaṇena svāmināmakam ।।41 ।।
tatra gatā'smi nityaṃ vai gantavyaṃ nā'vaśiṣyate ।
agṛhiṇī kathaṃ yāmi tvayā hīnā gṛhāntaram ।।।42।।
tasmāt tvayā samaṃ nātha kariṣye tīrthasevanam ।
dehayātrāṃ yathālabdhaiḥ kariṣye tava sevane ।।43।।
dharmapāśavinirbaddhāḥ satyenātmānamālabhe ।
sahadharmavṛtā patnī sahaiva tu gamiṣyati ।। 44।।
evaṃ tasyā viditvā sa brāhmaṇo niścayaṃ dṛḍham ।
atīva tuṣṭo dhanyo'haṃ yasyedṛśī satī priyā ।। 45।।
athaivaṃ vartamānau tau dampatī haritatparau ।
śrāvaṇe nāganadyāstu taṭe tatra mahotsave ।।46 ।।
lakṣādhikamanuṣyāṇāṃ samāje sūryadarśanam ।
kartuṃ yayatuḥ pūjāṃ ca śubhāṃ viśeṣavastubhiḥ ।। 47।।
janānāṃ bahusammardaṃ vipro'bhūddhārṣatastadā ।
patito janasammarde'pyaśakto notthitaḥ punaḥ ।। 48 ।।
aśaktā tvabalā netumūrdhvaṃ sammardakarṣitā ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।।49 ।।
iti jāpaṃ kṛtavatī satī sādhvī pativratā ।
'oṃ savitre namaḥ sākṣirūpiṇe paramātmane' ।।1.491.50 ।।
itijāpaṃ kṛtavān sa bhakto vipro virāgavān ।
tāvat tayoḥ prarakṣārthe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo raviḥ ।। 51।।
samāyātāvekakāle hastenādāya tāvubhau ।
ambare divyahastena kṛtvā sammārjya tāvubhau ।। 52 ।।
kuṣṭhahīnaṃ dvijaṃ kṛtvā satīṃ ca divyarūpiṇīm ।
kṛtvā cobhau śubhaṃ bhūyāt paśyatāṃ tīrthavāsinām ।। 53।।
ityāśīrbhirvardhayitvā dadaturvaradānakam ।
sukhinau tu sadā bhūtvā ciraṃ sthitvā bhuvastale ।।।54।।
ante dhāma tu vaikuṇṭhaṃ dampatī saṃprayāsyathaḥ ।
ityuktvā vai śubhāṃ pūjāṃ tābhyāṃ samarpitā tadā ।।55 ।।
gṛhītvā divyayānābhyāṃ tato nārāyaṇāvubhau ।
yayaturnijalokaṃ tau brāhmaṇaśca priyāyutaḥ ।।56 ।।
navayauvanarūpāḍhyaścābhavad devavattadā ।
jagmurāścaryamatyarthaṃ lokā nagaravāsinaḥ ।।57।।।
lakṣaśo mānavāstatra dampatyoḥ pūjanādikam ।
cakruḥ pūtāḥ samabhavan tīrthaphalamavāpya ca ।।58।।
viprayogena sūryasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ca ।
labdhvā tu darśanaṃ divyaṃ camatkārapure śubhe ।।59।।
sūryakṣetre sūryagṛhe kṛtakṛtyā vipāpmakāḥ ।
saṃbabhūburharerbhaktā bhejire śrīhariṃ sadā ।।1.491.6 0।।
evaṃ pativratā sādhvī kuṣṭhipatiṃ prasevya ca ।
yātā tvante harerdhāma camatkārapure purā ।।6 1।।
etasya paṭhanāccātha śravaṇāt kīrtanādapi ।
bhuktiḥ śuddhiśca muktiśca bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।62।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭrīyasya viṭaṃkapurasya kuṣṭhiśarākhyaviprasya devadravyacaurasya camatkārapure nāgamatīnadyāṃ sūryagṛhatīrthakaraṇāt sūryasya nārāyaṇasya ca darśanāt pativratāsudhāmnīpatnyā saha mokṣaṃ ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 491 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 491 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 492
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 493 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkārapure pakṣau nipetatuḥ ।
garuḍasya pativratānindayā tad vadāmi te ।। 1 ।।
punastasyāḥ prasādena saṃlagnau ca vadāmi te ।
purā''sīd brāhmaṇo mitraṃ garuḍasya bhṛgūdvahaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tasya kanyā mādhavīti nāmnā'bhūd guṇamaṇḍitā ।
atha tasyā varārthāya provāca garuḍaṃ dvijaḥ ।। 3 ।।
mama kanyāsuyogyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ sāttvataṃ śubham ।
sadṛśaṃ varamanvīkṣa yena tasmai dadāmyaham ।। 4 ।।
garuḍastu tadā prāha samastakṣitimaṇḍale ।
mama pṛṣṭhe sutā tvāṃ ca kṛtvā saṃbhramayāmyaham ।। 5 ।।
tatastasyāḥ kumāryā vai sadṛśaṃ ca guṇānvitam ।
svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā varaṃ tasmai dehi bhavāmi sādhanam ।। 6 ।।
evamukto'tha vipraḥ sa tatkṣaṇāt kanyayā saha ।
ārūḍho gāruḍaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yayau draṣṭuṃ varaṃ śubham ।। 7 ।।
yaṃ yaṃ vipraṃ kumāraṃ sā kanyā paśyati vai hṛdā ।
tadā na tasyāścitte sa vartate sma kathaṃcana ।। 8 ।।
kulavān yo virūpaḥ sa rūpāḍhyo na kulottamaḥ ।
rūpakulānvitaḥ kaścid guṇahīno vilokitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
guṇayukto na dhanavān sadhano na guṇādimān ।
sarvoktyukto'pi kaścid dṛṣṭo vyaṃgo vicittakaḥ ।। 1.492.1 0।।
avyaṃgaścoktaguṇavān dṛṣṭo vyavāyamārgagaḥ ।
evaṃ kāle gate dīrghe bhramatāṃ bhūtale'nvaham ।। 11 ।।
teṣāmāsīnmanovāñcchā draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
yayuḥ śvetaṃ dvīpadhāma yayuśca badarīvanam ।। 12।
kṣīrābdhiṃ tu yayuḥ paścād vaikuṇṭhaṃ te yayurmudā ।
baligṛhaṃ yayuścāpi yayuḥ kuṃkumavāpikām ।। 1 3।।
bhṛgukṣetraṃ yayurvṛndāvanaṃ śrīraṃgaparvatam ।
mahendraṃ gandhamādaṃ ca meruṃ svargaṃ yayustathā ।। 14।।
satyalokaṃ yayustaistu dṛṣṭo vai nārado muniḥ ।
sāntvapūrvaṃ sa ca pṛṣṭo viṣṇuṃ brahmasanātanam ।। 15।।
kva devaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sāmprataṃ vartate mune! ।
viṣṇoḥ sthānāni sarvāṇi vīkṣitāni samantataḥ ।। 16।।
asmābhiḥ saṃprahṛṣṭābhirna dṛṣṭastatra keśavaḥ ।
nāradaḥ prāha sarvatra vartate bhagavān sadā ।। 17।।
aśuddhaiśca bhavadbhistu na dṛṣṭastatra keśavaḥ ।
yanmano vāsanāhīnaṃ nirguṇaṃ divyatāṃ gatam ।। 18।।
taireva dṛśyate viṣṇuḥ sakāmairnahi vīkṣyate ।
tato mānasaśuddhyarthaṃ saṃvāsaṃ kuruta kṣitau ।। 1 9।।
camatkārapure divye hāṭakeśvaratīrthake ।
tatraiva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vaḥ sammiliṣyati ।।1.492.20 ।।
tatprāptyarthaṃ camatkāranagaraṃ yāta mā ciram ।
mahāsarovare tatra cāturmāsye janārdanaḥ ।। 21 ।।
nāganadyāṃ jalaśāyī vartate sma narāyaṇaḥ ।
athā''yātāstrayastatra jalaśāyisarovare ।।22।।
brāhmaṇaṃ ca sutāṃ kṣetre'vatārayitvā śobhane ।
garuḍaḥ prāha tapasā prāpsyate bhagavān svayam ।। 23।।
kurutāṃ tapasā śuddhiṃ japena pūjayā vratāt ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।।।24।।
ityevaṃ satataṃ jāpācchuddhiḥ syād vāsanākṣaye ।
ityuktvā garuḍastatra yayau nārāyaṇāntikam ।। 25।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ' ।
japannāste jalamadhye nirāhārastathā ca tau ।।26।।।
putrī pitā nirāhāro tepāte tapa uttamam ।
garuḍo bahuvarṣānte dadarśa pādasevikām ।। 27।।
pādasaṃvāhanāsaktāṃ lakṣmīṃ tvāṃ tanmukhekṣaṇām ।
aparāṃ ca tathā vṛddhāṃ lakṣmīpārśve niveśitām ।।28।।
dhyānasthāṃ ca kṛśāṃgīṃ ca śāṇḍilīṃ brahmacāriṇīm ।
anyāṃ suyauvanāṃ tasyāḥ pārśve dadarśa pakṣirāṭ।।29।।
anekajanmapāpānāṃ hāriṇīṃ narmadāṃ satīm ।
aparaṃ puruṣaṃ vṛddhaṃ śāntaṃ kṛśaṃ ca tāpasam ।।1.492.30 ।।
dadarśa garuḍastatra mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahāmunim ।
tāśca taṃ ca praṇamaँstaiḥ satkṛto garuḍaḥ śanaiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
dadarśa viṣṇumunnidraṃ smerāsyaṃ bhaktavatsalam ।
pṛcchantaṃ kuta āyātaḥ kuśalaṃ prāha pakṣirāṭ ।।।32।।
mamāsti dayitaṃ mitraṃ brāhmaṇo bhṛguvaṃśajaḥ ।
tasyāsti mādhavī nāma kanyā vai brahmacāriṇī ।।33।।
na tasyāḥ sadṛśaḥ kāntaḥ prāptastrailokyamaṇḍale ।
tasyāstu puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ patiḥ sarvaguṇairyutaḥ ।।34।।
sadṛśaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣyā mama citte vyavasthitaḥ ।
tasmāt pāṇigrahaṃ tasyāḥ svīkuruṣva narāyaṇa ।। 35।।
śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha lakṣmyaṃśā sā'sti kanyakā ।
śṛṇu vaikuṇṭhajaṃ pūrvākhyānaṃ vadāmi te'nagha ।।36।।
ekadā sā mahālakṣmīrgarvaṃ kṛtavatī satī ।
na mayā sadṛśī tvanyā nārāyaṇo'pi naiva ca ।।37।।
mayā kṛtvā samṛddhyā ca sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā suśobhate ।
māṃ vinā ca bhavedrūkṣaṃ tasmācchreṣṭhā'smi sarvathā ।।38।।
adya mayā na gantavyaṃ nārāyaṇasya sannidhau ।
āvaśyake svayaṃ nārāyaṇaścātra mama gṛhe ।। 39।।
āgamiṣyati paśyāmi snehamīkṣāmi kīdṛśam ।
iti matvā na ca lakṣmīryayau nārāyaṇagṛham ।।1.492.40 ।।
jayaṃ ca pārṣadaṃ nārāyaṇo jñātvā hyuvāca ha ।
lakṣmīrgarvayutā tvadya vidyate māninī yathā ।।41 ।।
yadyāgacchenmama dvāre deyaḥ praveśa eva na ।
atha nārāyaṇaṃ jñātvā divyadṛṣṭyā parāṅmukham ।।।42।।।
cirakāle gate lakṣmirmānaṃ hitvā samāyayau ।
jayastu pārṣadaḥ prāha mātarnā''jñā'sti vai hareḥ ।।43।।
harerdāsastava dāsaḥ sadā'smi kintu śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
ājñā pālyā mayā tvatra tasya dvāre pratiṣṭhatā ।।44।।
yasya dvāre niyukto'smi tadājñā mukhyato matā ।
yathaṣṭaṃ kuru mātastvaṃ nirodhaḥ svāminā kṛtaḥ ।।45।।
ityuktvā patitastasyāḥ pādayoḥ praṇayānvitaḥ ।
nivāritā sā dvārācca tena dauvārikeṇa vai ।।46 ।।
tadā''tmanastiraskāraṃ matvā satī ca māninī ।
smṛtvā hareḥ pādapadmaṃ dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā ।।47।।
tadā ruṣṭā trilokyāṃ vai gṛhalakṣmīḥ sthale sthale ।
jñātvā brahmā maheśaśca viṣṇurdharmaśca bhāskaraḥ ।।48।।
candraḥ kāmaḥ kuberaśca vahnirvighneśvaro'nilaḥ ।
ṛṣayo munayaścāpi manavaśca maheśvaraḥ ।।49।।
samāyayū rudantaste padmāyā puratastadā ।
tuṣṭuvuśca mahālakṣmīṃ satīṃ dīnāṃ harīśvarīm ।।1.492.50।।
kṣamasva bhagavatyamba kṣamāśīle parātpare ।
śuddhasattvasvarūpe ca kopādiparivarjite ।।51 ।।
upame sarvasādhvīnāṃ devīnāṃ devapūjite ।
tvayā vinā jagat sarvaṃ mṛtatulyaṃ ca niṣphalam ।।52।
sarvasampatsvarūpā tvaṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvarūpiṇī ।
rāseśvaryadhidevī tvaṃ tvatkalāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ।।।53।।।
kailāse pārvatī tvaṃ tu kṣīrode sindhukanyakā ।
svarge ca svargalakṣmīstvaṃ martyalakṣmīśca bhūtale ।। 54।।
vaikuṇṭhe tu mahālakṣmīḥ sarvānane sarasvatī ।
gaṃgā tvaṃ tulasī tvaṃ ca prabhā tvaṃ tvaṃ ca pārvatī ।।55।।
sāvitrī māṇikī tvaṃ ca padmā tvaṃ padminī satī ।
mañjulā tvaṃ bhārgavī ca kambharā manasā satī ।।56।।।
vṛndā haṃsā ca rādhā ca mūlaprakṛtirīśvarī ।
kṛṣṇapriyā tvaṃ bhāṇḍīre candrā candanakānane ।। 57।।
virajā campakavane śataśṛṃge tu sundarī ।
padmāvatī padmavane mālatī mālatīvane ।।58।।
kundadantī kundavane suśīlā ketakīvane ।
kadambamālā durgā tvaṃ kadambānāṃ tu kānane ।।59।।
rājalakṣmī rājasaudhe gṛhalakṣmīrgṛhe gṛhe ।
prasīda jagatāṃ mātarmā mṛtiṃ gaccha padmaje ।।1.492.6 0।।
iti devastutiṃ śrutvā tyaktvā tu rodanaṃ satī ।
uvāca suprasannāstāँste'pi śuśruvurādarāt ।।6 1 ।।
tyajāmi dehaṃ na krodhānna vairāgyeṇa sāmpratam ।
kintu nvidaṃ samālocya yadasti maraṇottaram ।।62।।
yasmin sadīśe mahati sarvasāmye ca nirguṇe ।
sarvātmani sadānande samatā tṛṇaśailayoḥ ।।6 3 ।।
bhrūbhaṃgalīlayā lakṣmīlakṣaṃ sraṣṭumalaṃ tu yaḥ ।
bhṛtye striyāṃ yatsamatā kiṃ kāryaṃ tasya sevayā ।।64।।
tatpatnīnāṃ pradhānā'haṃ nirastā dvāriṇā'dhunā ।
tadbhṛtyabhṛtyabhṛtyena paripūrṇena nepsitā ।।65।।
tyakṣyāmi jīvanamahamasaubhāgyā ca svāmini ।
vahnau tu kāmanāṃ kṛtvā yathā bhadraṃ bhavettathā ।।66 ।।
yā strī bharturasaubhāgyā sā'saubhāgyā hi sarvataḥ ।
śayane bhojane tasyā na sukhaṃ jīvanaṃ vṛthā ।।67।।
yasyā nāsti priyaprema tasyā janma nirarthakam ।
tatkiṃ putre dhane rūpe sampattau yauvane'thavā ।।68।।
yadbhaktirnāsti kānte ca sarvapriyatame pare ।
sā śucirdharmahīnā ca sarvakarmavivarjitā ।।69।।
patirbandhurgatirbhartā daivataṃ gurureva saḥ ।
sarvasmācca paraḥ svāmī na guruḥ svāminaḥ paraḥ ।।1.492.70।।
pitā mātā suto bhrātā kliṣṭā dātumidaṃ dhanam ।
sarvasvadātā svāmī vai mūḍhānāṃ yoṣitāṃ surāḥ ।।71 ।।
kācideva tu jānāti mahāsādhvī patiṃ prabhum ।
atisadvaṃśajātā hi suśīlā kulapālikā ।।72।।
vrataṃ cārādhanaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ puṇyaṃ tapaściram ।
patibhaktivihīnāyā bhasmībhūtaṃ nirarthakam ।।73।।
ataḥ kiñcinna vakṣyāmi niṣṭhuraṃ patimīśvaram ।
bhṛtyā'parādhairdevasya prāṇāँstyakṣyāmi niścitam ।।74।।
patidoṣe mahāsādhvī patiṃ cā'niṣṭhuraṃ vadet ।
yadi soḍhumaśaktā ca prāṇāँstyajati dharmataḥ ।।75।।
patisevā vrataṃ strīṇāṃ patisevā paraṃ tapaḥ ।
patisevā paro dharmaḥ patisevā surārcanam ।।76।।
patisevā paraṃ satyaṃ dānatīrthā'nukīrtanam ।
sarvadevamayaḥ svāmī sarvadevamayaḥ śuciḥ ।।77।।
sarvapuṇyasvarūpaśca patirūpī janārdanaḥ ।
yā satī bharturucchiṣṭaṃ bhuṃkte pādodakaṃ sadā ।।78।।
tasyā darśamupasparśaṃ nityaṃ vāñcchanti devatāḥ ।
tataḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni punanti pāpino hyaghāt ।।79।।
ityuktvā sā mahāsādhvī ruroda vai muhurmuhuḥ ।
uvāca brahmā bhītaśca bhaktinamrātmakandharaḥ ।।1.492.8 0।।
bhaviṣyati na bhadraṃ ca jayasya dvārarakṣituḥ ।
vijayo'pi sahayogī tavā'parādhakarmaṇi ।।81 ।।
tvayā na śaptau tau mūḍhau priyā'parādhabhītayā ।
bhaviṣyato rākṣasau tau sanakādivinindayā ।।82।।
sāparādhaṃ tu dharmiṣṭhaḥ kṣamayā na śaped yadi ।
sarvanāśo bhavettasya niścitaṃ mā ciraṃ sati! ।।83।।
yadi śaptuṃ na śaktaśca na daṇḍaṃ kartumīśvaraḥ ।
sāparādhe'pi puruṣe dharmo daṇḍaṃ karoti hi ।।84।।
sarvaṃ kṣamasva he mātargaccha gaccha priyāntakam ।
māṃ ca tvatsvāmino bhaktaṃ niyojyaṃ sṛṣṭikarmaṇi ।।85।।
ityuktvā tāṃ puraskṛtya sārdhaṃ devairmunīndrakaiḥ ।
śīghraṃ jagāma saṃstotuṃ nārāyaṇāntikaṃ hyataḥ ।।86।।
bhagavan devadevānāṃ tathā'nyeṣāṃ sukhāvaha ।
bhogasampatpradātastvaṃ gṛhāṇa kamalāṃ satīm ।।87।।
yayā sarve vayaṃ smṛddhā yāṃ vinā prastarā yathā ।
kimvadhikaṃ hi stotavyaṃ gṛhāṇa lokahetave ।।88 ।।
brahmaṇaḥ stavanaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā lakṣmīṃ puraḥsthitām ।
rudatīṃ namravadanāṃ provāca kamalodbhavam ।।8 9 ।।
sarvaṃ jānāmi sarvajñaḥ sarvātmā sarvapālakaḥ ।
sarvaśāstā sarvakarmaphaladātā'smi padmaja ।। 1.492.90 । ।
bhakte kalatre bandhau ca sarvatra samatā mama ।
viśeṣato'timadbhaktaḥ kalatrātpara eva saḥ । । 91 । ।
madbhaktau tava putrau ca dvārapālau durantakau ।
kṣama māmaparādhaṃ ca tayośca bhaktipūrṇayoḥ । । 92 । ।
madbhaktipūrṇo balavān daityebhyo na bibheti ca ।
rakṣito mama cakreṇa bhaktimādhvīkadurmadaḥ । । 93 । ।
kintu mayā tava sraṣṭāvāgantavyaṃ tava stavāt ।
mayā saha prabalayormama pradāsayorapi । । 94। ।
jīvānāṃ guṇagānārthaṃ jayasya vijayasya ca ।
prajanmā''vaśyakaṃ tasmānnimittaṃ hi mayā kṛtam । । 95 । ।
atha kālāntare sanakādiroṣād bhaviṣyati ।
śṛṇu tvanyat pṛthivyāmānartadeśe'bdhisannidhau । । 96 । ।
camatkārapure vipro nāmnā śāṇḍilyasaṃjñakaḥ ।
mamāśaḥ sa tapastepe putryarthaṃ bhāryayā yutaḥ । । 97। ।
sahasravatsarānte'hamabhavaṃ sannidhau sthitaḥ ।
prasannavadanastaṃ ca varadānāya prāha ca । । 98 । ।
tasya bhāryā sutāṃ vavre lakṣmītulyāṃ guṇānvitām ।
tathāstviti mayā proktaṃ tato'hamagamaṃ layam । । 99 । ।
śāṇḍilyaḥ sa sutāprāptiṃ pratīkṣate priyāyutaḥ ।
nimittaṃ tvetadevā'tra lakṣmīdvārā mayā kṛtam । । 1.492.100 । ।
seyaṃ lakṣmīmānayuktā chāyārūpā prayātu tām ।
pātivratye manāk doṣaṃ lakṣmyāṃ necchāmi sarvadā । । 101 । ।
sadoṣaṃ ca śarīraṃ vai lakṣmyāḥ chāyāsvarūpakam ।
yātu śāṇḍilyabhāryāyāṃ putryarthaṃ varadānakam ।। 10 2।।
ityuktāśca surāḥ sarve lakṣmīrāścaryamāpnuyuḥ ।
nārāyaṇasya hārdaṃ vai naiva jānanti kecana ।। 103 ।।
atha śāntāśca tacchrutvā lakṣmīstuṣṭā babhūva ha ।
patyājñayā yayau śīghraṃ chāyārūpeṇa mādhavī ।। 1 04।।
seyaṃ śāṇḍilyaputrī ca mādhavīti pravartate ।
lakṣmīṃ divyena rūpeṇa jagrāha tatra śrīhariḥ ।। 1 05।।
mādhavī ca brahmacaryaparā svasadṛśaṃ patim ।
māmevecchati lakṣmīśaṃ nānyaṃ patiṃ samicchati ।। 1 06।।
garuḍa tvaṃ kathāṃ cemāṃ naiva jānāsi māyayā ।
ānaya tvaṃ tāṃ samīpe mādhavīṃ me pativratām ।। 1 07।।
lakṣmyaṃśāṃ mānadehāṃ ca ṛṣeḥ putrīṃ mama priyām ।
yāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ paścāt prakaromi yathocitam ।। 1 08।।
evamukto garuḍastāmānayāmāsa sannidhau ।
viprastūvāca natvā taṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam ।। 1 09।।
gṛhāṇa kanyāṃ bhagavaँstvāmevecchati sā sadā ।
bhagavāँstvaṃ samāyāhītyuvāca tāṃ suśṛṇvatām ।। 1.492.11 0।।
lakṣmīvannyaviśatpārśve kanyā prasannamānasā ।
śayyaikānte samāviṣṭā dakṣiṇe muravidviṣaḥ ।। 111 ।।
atha kopaparītāṃgī mahiṣīdharmamāśritā ।
lakṣmīruvāca tāṃ kanyāṃ sapatnīti vicintya ca ।। 11 2।।
yasmānme purataḥ pāpe kāntasya mama harṣitā ।
śayyāyāṃ tvaṃ samāviṣṭā lajjāṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ ।। 11 3।।
tasmād vṛddhamukhī nūnaṃ vikṛtā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
śrūtvā śokaṃ tadā kanyā tatpitā'pi pracakratuḥ ।। 1 14।।
svayaṃ viṣṇurhariḥ prāha maivaṃ lakṣmīrbhaviṣyasi ।
jñāne vṛddhā vṛddhamukhī matā me jñānavardhinī ।। 1 15।।
brahmajñānaparā madhuvidyā sā mādhavī tathā ।
śaṇḍilyavidyā'dhiṣṭhātrī jñānavṛddhā bhaviṣyati ।। 116 ।।
ityuktā śāṇḍilī bhūtvā mādhavī sā haripriyā ।
kṣīrode vartate nityaṃ lakṣmīrūpā subhāginī ।। 1 17।।
brahmacaryaparā nārāyaṇasevāparāyaṇā ।
śāṇḍilyaśca sutāṃ datvā kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha ।। 1 18।।
garuḍaḥ śrīhariṃ tatra papraccha saṃśayānvitaḥ ।
nārīṇāṃ brahmacaryaṃ vai saṃśayāspadameva tu ।। 1 19।।
viśeṣād yauvanāvasthāprāptāyāṃ śraddadhāmi na ।
avaśyaṃ yauvanasthena tiryagyonigatena ca ।। 1.492.120।।
vikāraḥ khalu kartavyo nā'vikārāya yauvanam ।
evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śāṇḍilī brahmacāriṇī ।। 121 ।।
maunavratadharā kiñcinnovāca vaiṣṇavī satī ।
sādhvyā nāryā nindayā ca pakṣināthasya tatkṣaṇāt ।। 1 22।।
ubhau pakṣau gatau nāśaṃ ruṇḍhākāro'tha so'bhavat ।
aśaktaśca tathā gantuṃ padamātramapi kvacit ।। 1 23।।
hariḥ prāha garuḍa! tvatpakṣau naṣṭau hi nindayā ।
dūṣitaṃ brahmacaryaṃ yat śāṇḍilyāṃ saṃśayena vai ।। 124।।
tasmāt tvaṃ śāṇḍilīṃ natvā prasādaya sukhī bhava ।
garuḍastāṃ pratuṣṭāva nanāma ca punaḥ punaḥ ।। 125।।
tuṣṭā satī śāṇḍilī ca dvijaṃ pasparśa pāṇinā ।
tato'sya pakṣa sañjātau tatkṣaṇādeva yojitau ।। 1 26।।
garuḍaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca śāṇḍilīm ।
tatratyośca praṇipatya śāṇḍilyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā ।। 127।।।
pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā yayau kṣetraṃ camatkārapuraṃ śubham ।
vinyasya taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca garuḍaḥ prayayau divam ।।1 28।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pātivratyaparāyaṇam ।
lakṣmyāste pūrvavṛttāntaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।। 129।।
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād yadvā vācayecchrāvayettathā ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheddhāmni dāsyabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ।। 1.492.1 30।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkārapurīyaviprakanyāyā mādhavyā bhagavato bhāryātvaṃ, lakṣmyā avatārarūpāyāstasyāḥ śāṇḍilītvaṃ nārīṇāṃ brahmacaryavrate śaṃkitasya garuḍasya pakṣayoḥ patanaṃ, śāṇḍilīprasādena pakṣasahitatvaṃ, lakṣmyāḥ avataraṇārthaṃ bhagavatkṛtā'vamānanam,
evamādinirūpaṇanāmā dvinavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।4 92।।


← adhyāyaḥ 492 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 493
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 494 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! payo'bdhau tu śāṇḍilī kamalā hyubhe ।
nārāyaṇasya me sevāṃ cakrāte pādamardanam ।। 1 ।।
lakṣmyā dakṣaścaraṇo me śāṇḍilyā vāmako dhṛtaḥ ।
lakṣmīstu vāmapādārthaṃ jagāda śāṇḍilīṃ tadā ।। 2 ।।
dehi me vāmapādaṃ vai sevikāyāḥ paraṃ dhanam ।
vāmā vāmāṃganā vāmaprabhāgā priyabhoginī ।। 3 ।।
gṛhāṇa tvaṃ dakṣapādṃ vāmabhāgo hi me'sti yat ।
nāryā vāmasvarūpatvaṃ narasyārdhāṃgarūpakam ।। 4 ।।
tathaiva vartamānāyāḥ saubhāgyaṃ vardhate'niśam ।
śāṇḍilyāha na dāsye'haṃ dakṣaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā dhṛtaḥ ।। 5 ।।
svadhṛtastvaṃ kathaṃ tyaktumarhasi dakṣapattalam ।
vāmasevā mayā kāryā na dāsye tvāṃ kathaṃcana ।। 6 ।।
lakṣmīḥ kruddhā'bhavat tāṃ cā'śapattvāśvamukhī bhava ।
śāṇḍilyapyaśapallakṣmīṃ tvaṃ vai gajamukhī bhava ।। 7 ।।
tādṛśyau te hyubhe jāte kṣīrode viṣṇusannidhau ।
śokaṃ jagāma bhagavān kathamevaṃ kṛtaṃ priye ।। 8 ।।
ayogyaśāpau saṃjātau parasparaṃ sudustarau ।
atha te duḥkhite viṣṇuṃ śeṣaśāyinamāhatuḥ ।। 9 ।।
bhagavan śāpamokṣo nau yathā syācca tathā kuru ।
nārāyaṇastadā prāha jāto madicchayaiva hi ।। 1.493.1 0।।
śāpastanmokṣaṇaṃ cāpi bhaviṣyati madicchayā ।
ahaṃ pṛthvyā bhāranāśārthaṃ gamiṣye bhuvastalam ।। 11 ।।
tatreyaṃ śāṇḍilī me vai bhaginī saṃbhaviṣyati ।
aśvamukhī tvaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ hastimukhī bhaviṣyasi ।। 12।।
tatrā'haṃ devakīputro bhaviṣyāmi prabhurhariḥ ।
atha yā suprabhānāmnī vasudevapriyā'parā ।। 1 3।।
tasyāṃ mādhavī jajñe'śvavaktrarūpā tu śāṇḍilī ।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtākārāṃ sutāṃ jātāṃ ja suprabhā ।। 14।।
vasudevasamāyuktā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatā ।
sā jātā yauvanopetā sutā tādṛṅmukhānvitā ।। 15।।
na kaścidvarayāmāsa vājivaktrāṃ vilokya tām ।
atha tāṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇaścamatkārapuraṃ prati ।। 16।।
preṣayāmāsa tapase tayā taptaṃ tapastadā ।
tatastuṣṭiṃ gato brahmā varārthaṃ tāmuvāca ha ।। 17।।
sā tu vavre mukhaṃ nāryā bhadraṃ saumyaṃ surūpakam ।
brahmā tathāstviti prāha sā'bhavadvai śubhānanā ।। 18।।
subhadrā nāma vikhyātā vīrasūḥ pativallabhā ।
upayeme sutaḥ pāṇḍoryāṃ pārthaḥ kṛṣṇapārśvagaḥ ।। 1 9।।
tasyāṃ jajñe suto vīro yo'bhimanyuriti smṛtaḥ ।
punaryātā harerdhāma kālānte vai pativratā ।।1.493.2 0।।
atha lakṣmīrgajavaktrā yayāvānartadeśagam ।
hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñaṃ satkṣetraṃ tapaścakāra sā ।।21 ।।
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa tapasā dāruṇena vai ।
tāmuvāca tato brahmā varṣānte tuṣṭi māgataḥ ।।22।।
varaṃ prārthaya deveśi! yatte manasi vartate ।
lakṣmīruvāca vaktraṃ me prabho! pūrvānanaṃ vṛṇe ।।23 ।।
brahmā prāha tathāstvevaṃ mahālakṣmīrbhaveti ca ।
evaṃ varaṃ samāgṛhya yayau sā ca śubhānanā ।।24।।
mahālakṣmīḥ surūpā ca kṣīrodaśāyinaṃ prati ।
evaṃ sā mādhavī cāpi mahālakṣmīrapīśvarī ।।25।।।
sthāpite nagarakṣetre candrabhāryābhirādarāt ।
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā mahālakṣmīṃ ca mādhavīm ।।26 ।।
sā bhaviṣyati saubhāgyayuktā putravatī satī ।
yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tāvattvekabhaktāśanā'yanā ।।27।।
akṣāralavaṇāśā yā nārī māṃ pūjayiṣyati ।
na tasyāḥ patijaṃ duḥkhaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vā bhaviṣyati ।।28।।
kintu saubhāgyamatulaṃ sarvaṃ samyag bhaviṣyati ।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca sauvarṇaṃ saudhaṃ godhanamāpyate ।।29।।
śucirbhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā vācayecchrāvayecca vā ।
śṛṇuyādvā naro nārī susaubhāgyamavāpnuyāt ।।1.493.3 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne aśvamukhyā mādhavyā gajamukhyā lakṣmyāśca kālāntare subhadrātvaṃ mahālakṣmītvaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā trinavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।493।।


← adhyāyaḥ 493 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 494
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 495 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
athā'nyāṃ ca kathāṃ divyāṃ hāṭakeśvarabhūmijām ।
camatkāramayīṃ lakṣmi! śṛṇu brahmavratānvitām ।। 1 ।।
camatkārābhidhaścāsīnnṛpo yannāmaśobhitam ।
camatkārapuraṃ nāgavatīnadyāstaṭe'karot ।। 2 ।।
tasya purasya rakṣārthaṃ devatāstena nirmitāḥ ।
sthāpitā vidhinā tāśca śubhā rakṣanti tatprajāḥ ।। 3 ।।
atha tasya mahīpasya ambānāmnyabhavat sutā ।
anyā vṛddhā'bhidhā putrī hyubhe te guṇamaṇḍite ।। 4 ।।
kāśīrājaścopayeme hyubhe viprāgnisannidhau ।
kasyacittvatha kālasya yavanaistūttarasthitaiḥ ।। 5 ।।
saṃgaro'bhūnmahān kāśīrājaśca nidhanaṃ gataḥ ।
athā'mbā cāpi ca vṛddhā vaidhavyaṃ prāpya duḥkhadam ।। 6 ।।
pitṛgṛhaṃ yayatuste hāṭakeśvarabhūmigam ।
yāvadvarṣaśataṃ cograṃ kṛtavatyau tapaḥ param ।। 7 ।।
durgāyāḥ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ cakraturhomapūrvakam ।
nāśārthaṃ patiśatrūṇāṃ kintu durgā tutoṣa na ।। 8 ।।
tato vairāgyamāsādya vāñcchantyau svatanukṣayam ।
mantrairātharvaṇairvipraiḥ kṣurikāsūktasaṃbhavaiḥ ।। 9 ।।
chitvā chitvā svamāṃsāni mantrapūtāni bhaktitaḥ ।
kāritavatyau homaṃ tu susamiddhe hutāśane ।। 1.494.1 0।।
agnikuṇḍāttatastasmāccaturhastā śubhānanā ।
śvetavastrā viniṣkrāntā dhāmnā bālārkasadṛśī ।। 11 ।।
tathā'nyā cā'ṣṭanetrāsyā taptahāṭakasannibhā ।
tasmāt kuṇḍād viniṣkrāntā dhṛtakhaḍgā bhayāvahā ।। 12।।
aparā'pi tathārūpā śaktiḥ paramadāruṇā ।
tāstu procurvarārthaṃ ca kāśīrājapriye tataḥ ।। 13 ।।
ūcatuśca patirnau hi kāśīrājo hato raṇe ।
yavanairhi tatasteṣāṃ kṣayaṃ vṛṇīmahe yataḥ ।। 14।।
tathā'stviti varaṃ prāhustadā kuṇḍāt sahasraśaḥ ।
niṣkrāntāḥ saṃkhyayā'pārā mātaro naikarūpikāḥ ।। 15।।
ekā gajamukhā tatra tathā'nyā turagānanā ।
sārameyamukhā cānyā pakṣirājamukhā parā ।। 16।।
tiryagvapuḥsvarūpā'nyā vaktrairmānuṣasaṃbhavaiḥ ।
triśīrṣāḥ pañcaśīrṣāśca saptaśīrṣāstathā'parāḥ ।। 17।।
jaṃghāmukhā jaghanāsyā hṛdānanā nirānanāḥ ।
pārśvānanāḥ paścimāsyāḥ pṛṣṭhāsyāḥ kāścanāpi ca ।। 18।।
ekahastā dvihastāśca daśahastā vihastakāḥ ।
anyā viṃśatihastāśca bahupādā vipādikāḥ ।। 1 9।।
ekapādā ūrdhvapādā ekanetrā dvinetrakāḥ ।
bahunetrā gajārūḍhā hayārūḍhā vṛṣasthitāḥ ।।1.494.20।।
naravānarasiṃhājagardabhavyāghrasaṃsthitāḥ ।
sarpagodhā''khumakarakūrmakukkuṭasaṃsthitāḥ ।।21 ।।
vihagādisamārūḍhā nṛtyantyo hāsyaśobhitāḥ ।
ūrdhvakeśā vikeśāśca gātrakeśāśca bhūriśaḥ ।।22।।
lambakeśā vājikeśā hrasvadantyastathā'parāḥ ।
vidantyo dīrghadantyaśca gajadantyo vibhīṣaṇāḥ ।।23।।
lohadantyo lambakarṇo vikarṇyaḥ śūrpakarṇikāḥ ।
śaṃkukarṇyaḥ kukarṇyaśca bahukarṇyaḥ sukarṇikāḥ ।।24।।
carmavastrā vivastrāśca romavastrāstathā'parāḥ ।
khaḍgahastāḥ kuntahastā bāṇapāśadhanurdharāḥ ।।25।।
śūlamudgarabhūśuṇḍiprāśatomarabhūṣitāḥ ।
prayayustā vināśārthaṃ yavanānāṃ kulāni vai ।।26।।
bālavṛddhasamopetaṃ teṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ durātmanām ।
strībhiśca sahitaṃ tābhirdevatābhiḥ prabhakṣitam ।।27।.।
evaṃ nirvāsya tadrāṣṭaṃ tvāgatāḥ punareva tāḥ ।
camatkārapuraṃ prāhuryavanānāṃ vināśanam ।।28।।
tābhyāṃ tā vidhavābhyāṃ ca pūjitāḥ sthāpitāśca tāḥ ।
athocustā dīyatāṃ naścāhāro vāsa ityapi ।।29।।
mahādevī tadā tābhyo dadau vāsaṃ ca bhojanam ।
martyaloke'tra yā nāryo garbhavatyaḥ svapanti ca ।।1.494.3 0।।
sandhyākāle prabhāte ca kāmāsaktā bhavanti ca ।
snānaṃ naiva prakurvanti tadgarbho vo'stu bhojanam ।।3 1 ।।
rudantyo yā viniryānti catvareṣu vaneṣu ca ।
tāsāṃ garbhastu yuṣmākaṃ sampadattaḥ prabhujyatām ।।32।।
ucchiṣṭā yāḥ prasarpanti ramante ca svapanti ca ।
tāsāṃ garbhaḥ samastānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ bhojanāya vai ।।33।।
na ṣaṣṭhījāgaro yasya bālakasya bhaviṣyati ।
sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।34।।
na saṃyāsyati vā yatra pāvakaṃ sūtikāgṛhe ।
sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ bālarūpadhṛk ।।35।।।
māṅgalyaiḥ samparityaktaṃ yadbhavet sūtikāgṛham ।
tasminyastiṣṭhate bālaḥ sa yuṣmākaṃ prakalpitaḥ ।।36।।
sandhyāyāṃ bālakā ye vā svapantyākāśadeśagāḥ ।
te sarve bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ sanniveditāḥ ।।37।।
yasya janmadine prāpte varṣānte kriyate na ca ।
māṃgalyaṃ tasya tadgātraṃ yuṣmākaṃ parikalpitam ।।38।।
tailābhyaṃgaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā yaśca snānaṃ karoti na ।
sa datto bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।39।।
ucchiṣṭo yaḥ pumāँstiṣṭhed yo vā catvaramadhyagaḥ ।
bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa sarvābhirnirvikalpena cetasā ।।1.494.40 ।।
rajasvalāṃ vrajan yo vā puruṣaḥ kāmamohitaḥ ।
nagnaḥ śete tathā snāti bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa vo mataḥ ।।41 ।।
dakṣiṇā'bhimukhaḥ śete niśithe dadhibhakṣakaḥ ।
yuṣmadamantā puruṣo bhakṣaṇīyo viśeṣataḥ ।।42।।
ityevaṃ krūradevīnāṃ sthānāni bhakṣaṇāni ca ।
teṣāṃ gṛhe pradattāni tatastāstoṣamāgatāḥ ।।43 ।।
tāśca rakṣanti nagaraṃ kṣetraṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram ।
atha pitrā prajānāṃ ca camatkāreṇa bhūbhujā ।।44।।
mandiraṃ kāritaṃ ramyaṃ viśālaṃ saritastaṭe ।
ambā pādaprahāreṇa bhūmiṃ cakre guhātmikām ।।45।।
tasyāṃ svapāduke nyaste tvambayā rājakanyayā ।
vṛddhayā sthāpite tatra guhāyāṃ svakareṇa vai ।।46 ।।
ambā prāha tataḥ sarvā devīrvinayasaṃyutāḥ ।
ime matpāduke divye guhāmadhye gate sadā ।।47।।
sarvābhiḥ sevanīye ca na netavye bahiḥ kvacit ।
yā kācit pāduke dhṛtvā niṣkramiṣyati mohataḥ ।।48।।
sā divyabhāvanirmuktā śṛgālī saṃbhaviṣyati ।
atrā''gatya pādukayorarcanaṃ yogino janāḥ ।।49।।
kariṣyanti tathā baliṃ bhavatībhyo mudānvitāḥ ।
dāsyanti ye ca te siddhimavāpsyanti sudurlabhām ।।1.494.50।।
tataḥ sarvāśca tā devyo guhāmadhye vyavasthitāḥ ।
parivārya mandire te pāduke mokṣadāyike ।।51।।
te prapūjya ca nāryo vā narā vā dūrataḥ śubhe ।
tāśca devīrnamaskṛtya prāpsyantīṣṭamanorathān ।।52।।
prayāsyanti parāṃ siddhiṃ janmamṛtyuvivarjitām ।
śaṃbhunā dhyāyamānena tṛtīyanetrataḥ purā ।।53।।
śvetāmbaradharā śubhrā kanyā prakāśitā khalu ।
sā cāmbāsthāpitapādukārcane niyatā kṛtā ।।54।।
ambā prāha tu tāṃ kanyāṃ tava śiṣyāparamparā ।
kanyakā dīkṣitā devīsvarūpaiva na mānavī ।।55।।
kaumārabrahmacaryeṇa yuktā syāt pūjikā'nayoḥ ।
tato dadau ratnadaṇḍacāmarau chatramujjvalam ।।56।।
mantraṃ pūjāvidhiṃ śāṭīṃ kaṇṭhasūtraṃ dadau satī ।
mantragrahaṇakartrī yā kanyakā sā paramparā ।।57।।
kanyāvaṃśodbhavaḥ sarvā bhaviṣyanti hi mantrataḥ ।
'oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ ambāyai nārāyaṇyai svāhā namaḥ om ।।58।।
itimantreṇa śiṣyā vai kanyakāvaṃśa ucyate ।
tadanvayasamutthāyāḥ kanyakāyāḥ kareṇa tu ।।59।।
pādukayornaro nārī pūjāyāḥ kārakaḥ khalu ।
kanyāpūjākārakaśca bhavedatisukhānvitaḥ ।।1.494.60।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne camatkāranṛpateḥ ambāvṛddhākanyayostapobhirambāvṛddhāpādukāpūjanaṃ kumārikāvaṃśakṛtamevetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikacatuśśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 494 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 494 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 495
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 496 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayiṣye kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm ।
agnitīrthasamudbhūtāṃ camatkārapure purā ।। 1 ।।
somavaṃśe'bhavadrājā pratīpo nāmato balī ।
tasya putradvayaṃ jyeṣṭho devāpiḥ śantanustataḥ ।। 2 ।।
rājā ca nidhanaṃ prāpto devāpistapase yayau ।
prajābhiḥ śantanuḥ rājye satvaraṃ viniyojitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
evaṃ vyatikrame jāte śakro vavarṣa naiva tu ।
tena kṛcchraṃ gato lokaḥ sarvo'pi kṣutprapīḍitaḥ ।। 4 ।।
santyaktāḥ patibhirnāryaḥ putrāśca pitṛbhirnijaiḥ ।
mātaraśca tathā putrairlokeṣvanyeṣu kā kathā ।। 5 ।।
evaṃ varṣatraye jātaṃ mriyante mānavādayaḥ ।
daivayogāt kvacit kiñcit kasyacid yadi dṛśyate ।। 6 ।।
sasyaṃ siddhamasiddhaṃ vā hriyate balibhiḥ paraiḥ ।
śuṣkāḥ sarve drumā jātā āpagāśca jalāśayāḥ ।। 7 ।।
vastuhīno janaḥ sarvo yajñahīno'tināstikaḥ ।
vratahīnā dharmahīnā narā nāryo'bhavaँstadā ।। 8 ।।
kṣudhayā pīḍitāḥ sarve ṛṣayastu viśeṣataḥ ।
etasminnantare'raṇye viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ।। 9 ।।
carmāsthiśeṣasarvāṃgo bubhukṣārta itastataḥ ।
paribhramaँstataḥ prāpya kaṃcidgrāmaṃ vinodakam ।। 1.495.1 0।।
mṛtamartyodbhavairvyāptamasthiśeṣaiḥ samantataḥ ।
mṛtānāṃ ca śavānāṃ ca māṃsādasya niveśanam ।। 11 ।।
caṇḍālasya gṛhaṃ tvāsīd durgandhena samāvṛtam ।
tatrā'paśyatsārameyaṃ mṛtaṃ śuṣkaṃ ciroṣitam ।। 1 2।।
samādāya tatastaṃ ca hyāpaddharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
śuṣkaṃ daṇḍena santāḍya kṛtvā khaṇḍāni tāni ca ।। 13 ।।
nītvā yayau yatra deśe jalaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ ca labhyate ।
prakṣālya salile tāni śrapayāmāsa cānale ।। 14।।
ādāya pitṝn tarpitvā yāvadagnau juhoti saḥ ।
tāvad vahniraśuddhestu bhayenā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।। 15।।
sarvatra pṛthivyāmagniśālāyāṃ havanasthale ।
citte kopaṃ tathā kṛtvā śakropari viśeṣataḥ ।। 16।।
athāgnivigame home naṣṭe devaprabhojanam ।
niruddhaṃ tena devarṣibrahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ ।। 17।।
vahneranveṣaṇārthāya babhramurdharaṇītalam ।
athā'raṇye gajo dṛṣṭaḥ prapacchustaṃ himālaye ।। 18।।
vahnirhavyaprabhoktā cet tvayā dṛṣṭo'tra no vada ।
gajaḥ prāhā'tra saṃkīrṇe vaṃśastambe pravartate ।। 1 9।।
gupto bhūtvā praviṣṭaḥ sa dagdhastenā'hamāgataḥ ।
ityuktāste yayustatra vahniryatra hi vartate ।। 1.495.20 ।।
tāvadvahniḥ śaśāpainaṃ gajaṃ nirdeśakārakam ।
guptaṃ me tvaṃ nivedayasyato jihvā sadā tava ।।21 ।।
viparītā bhavatvevetyuktvā stambād viniryayau ।
devaiḥ stambe na vai dṛṣṭo lagnāḥ pṛṣṭhe didṛkṣayā ।।22।।
atha dṛṣṭaḥ śuko devairbhramamāṇo himālaye ।
pṛṣṭaśca śuka! vahniṃ tvaṃ dṛṣṭavānatra ced vada ।।23 ।।
śukaḥ prāha kulāyo me śamyāmatra hi vartate ।
vartante śiśavo me'pi vahnistatra samāgataḥ ।।24।।
tena dagdhā vayaṃ sarve kṛcchrādeva vinirgatāḥ ।
tatra śamyāṃ guptarūpaścāste vahnirvidantu tam ।।25।।
evamuktastato vahniḥ kruddhaḥ śukaṃ śaśāpa ha ।
ahaṃ yasmāt tvayā pakṣin devānāṃ viniveditaḥ ।।26।।
tasmācchuka na te vāṇī vispaṣṭā saṃbhaviṣyati ।
evaṃ śaptvā śukaṃ vahniḥ suraiḥ śamyāṃ sumārgitaḥ ।।27।।
tāvat tato'dṛśyabhāvaṃ kṛtvā deśāntaraṃ yayau ।
puṣkaraṃ tīrthamāsādya jalamadhye tale sthitaḥ ।।28।।
devā dhyānena vai dṛṣṭvā matsyaṃ papracchurutsukāḥ ।
vahniratrāgataḥ kutra vartate vada naḥ surān ।।29।।
matsyaḥ prāha tale cātra puṣkare vartate hi saḥ ।
tena dagdhā vayaṃ tīre tiṣṭhāmo duḥkhitā hyati ।।1.495.30।।
ityuktavantaṃ matsyaṃ sa śaśāpa krodhito'nalaḥ ।
svajñātibhakṣakā matsyā bhavantu sarvabhakṣakāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
iti śaptvā tataḥ sthānād dudrāva bahuvegataḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥ prāpya saurāṣṭre cā''sthito'nalaḥ ।।32।।
surā jñātvā dhyānavṛttyā yayuḥ kuṃkumavāpikām ।
sarastīragataṃ kūrmaṃ papracchuḥ vahirāgataḥ? ।।33।।
cedatra vada naḥ kūrma! sa prāhā'tra jale tale ।
praviṣṭo vahnirāgatya dagdhā vayaṃ bahirgatāḥ ।।34।।
devāstaṃ draṣṭumutkaṇṭhāyuktāstatra tadā'nalaḥ ।
kūrmaṃ śaśāpa te vaṃśo vṛddhiṃ naiva gamiṣyati ।।35।।
evaṃ śaptvā tataḥ sthānād devā'darśanavāñcchayā ।
hāṭakaśvaraje kṣetre nāganadyāṃ yayau tataḥ ।।36।।
jalāśayaṃ sugambhīraṃ praviṣṭastatra cā''śritaḥ ।
tatra vahnipraveśena dagdhā matsyāśca dardurāḥ ।।37।।
tīraṃ nirgatya yanti ca devā gatvā ca darduram ।
papracchustaṃ vahniratra vartate vā naveti vai ।।38।।
bhekaḥ prāhātra gambhīre jale vahnirupāgataḥ ।
tena vai jalamadhyasthā dagdhā bhūrijalaukasaḥ ।।39।।
ahaṃ kṛcchreṇa nirgatya jīvāmi devasaṃśrayāt ।
tacchrutvā taṃ jale devā mārgayāmāsurutsukāḥ ।।1.495.40।।
vahniḥ śaśāpa taṃ bhekaṃ devebhyo yanniveditaḥ ।
tasmāt tvaṃ bhava vai nyūnaṃ vijihvo'tra dharātale ।।41 ।।
evaṃ muktvā tataḥ sthānād yāvadvahnirvinirgataḥ ।
tāvat sa brahmaṇā prokto bho bho vahne sthiro bhava ।।।42।।
kathaṃ dhāvasi guptātmā devān dṛṣṭvā pratisthalāt ।
tvamādyaścaiva sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ vartase mukham ।।43।।
tvayyāhutirhutā samyagādityamupatiṣṭhati ।
ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ ।।44।।
tasmād dhātā vidhātā ca tvameva jagatāṃ mataḥ ।
santuṣṭe dhriyate viśvaṃ tvayi ruṣṭe vinaṣyati ।।45।।
sarve yajñā rasāḥ sarve pākāḥ sarve tvayi sthitāḥ ।
tavāśrayeṇa jīvāni jīvanti cāntaraścara ।।46 ।।
brūhi kasmāt praguptastvaṃ jāyase sukhado bhava ।
vahniḥ śrutvā hyajaṃ prāha śṛṇu guptestu kāraṇam ।।47।।
anāvṛṣṭyā mahendrasya sañjātaścauṣadhikṣayaḥ ।
tato'smyahaṃ tu māṃsena viśvāmitreṇa yojitaḥ ।।48।।
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇādbhīto gupto bhavāmi nānyathā ।
brahmā''karṇyā''ha deveśaṃ kimarthaṃ naiva varṣasi ।।49।।
indraḥ prāhā'grajaṃ tyaktvā devāpiṃ bhrātaraṃ prajāḥ ।
cakrire'nujaniṃ pṛthvīpatiṃ śantanumutpadam ।।1.495.50 ।।
tatpāpena na varṣāmi kramalaṃghanakāraṇāt ।
brahmā prāha ca tatpāpaṃ bhuktaṃ śantanunā yataḥ ।।51 ।।
akālamṛtyavaḥ sarve durbhikṣamaraṇāḥ pare ।
śantanu kṣudhitaścāste pāpaṃ bhuktaṃ tu tena vai ।।52।।
vṛṣṭiṃ kuru mahendra tvaṃ mama vākyāt prajākṛte ।
ityuktaḥ puṣkarāvartānmeghān samādideśa saḥ ।।53 ।।
vavṛṣuśca mahāmeghāḥ pūrayāmāsurammayam ।
brahmā vahniṃ tataḥ prāha pratyakṣo bhava pāvaka ।।54।।
agnihotreṣu yajñeṣu viprāṇāṃ havaneṣu ca ।
varaṃ vṛṇu yatheṣṭaṃ te dadāmi hitakāmyayā ।।55।।
yatra yatrā'bhavo guptastattat tīrthaṃ tvadātmakam ।
vahnitīrthaṃ prasiddhaṃ ca pāvanaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।।56 ।।
vahniḥ prāha ca bhagavan! varṣatrayaṃ hi bhojanam ।
nāptavānasmi kutrāpi dehi me bhojanaṃ tataḥ ।।57।।
brahmā viprān samāhūya vahnestṛptyarthameva tu ।
vasordhārāpradānena ghṛtasya dhārayā mudā ।।58।।
tarpayantvanalaṃ cetyuvāca te cakrire tathā ।
vasordhārāpradānena varṣaparyantameva ha ।।59।।
tatastuṣṭiṃ parāṃ prāpya parāṃ puṣṭiṃ gato'nalaḥ ।
yasmād bhavati sampūrṇaṃ pūrṇāhutyā ca dhārayā ।।1.495.60।।
evaṃ vahniṃ samprakāśya vṛṣṭiṃ kratuṃ vidhāya ca ।
brahmādyā devatāḥ svargaṃ yayustato gajādayaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
ṛṣyāśrameṣu vanyeṣu dṛṣṭvā vahniṃ prakāśitam ।
yayuḥ pāvakaśaraṇaṃ prārthayāmāsurīśvaram ।।62।।
yatra yatrā'bhavad vahniryena yatrā'valokitaḥ ।
gajādyā analaṃ prāhuḥ prabho śāpaṃ nivāraya ।।63 ।।
vahniḥ prāha gajendraṃ te jihvā kāryakṣamā'stu vai ।
nṛpavāhanarūpaśca miṣṭānnaṃ bhakṣayiṣyasi ।।64।।
śukaṃ prāha ca te jihvā nṛpapraśaṃsikā'stu vai ।
bhekaṃ prāha ca te jihvā vṛṣṭisūcanadā'stviti ।।65।।
matsyaṃ prāha ca te vaṃśaścaikasmācchatako'dhikaḥ ।
sahasrāntaścaikasmin prasave prasave'stu vai ।।66 ।।
kacchapaṃ prāha te cāyuḥ śatavarṣaparaṃ sthiram ।
bhavatvapi bhavadvaṃśe bhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ।।67।।
kāryavaśājjanma labdhvā tārayiṣyati vaṃśajān ।
matsyaḥ kūrmo'bhavat sākṣādbhagavān śrīhariḥ svayam ।।68।।
gaṇeśaśca gajāsyo vai tathā lakṣmīrgajānanā ।
jātau śrīkṛṣṇarūpau tau vyāsaputrātmakaḥ śukaḥ ।।69।।
saṃjāto darduro rājā kāmarūpadharo hariḥ ।
saurāṣṭre devanagare yenā''sīd vaiṣṇavaṃ jagat। ।।1.495.70।।
devanagararājaḥ sa babhūva vaiṣṇavaḥ paraḥ ।
jājaliścā''gamat someśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tu caikadā ।।71 ।।
tataśca raivataṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā dvāravatīṃ yayau ।
tato yayau camatkārapuraṃ nāganadītaṭe ।।72।।
suṣvāpa svapnadoṣeṇa dhātuḥ praskhalito'bhavat ।
kaupīnaṃ ca samutthāya tena prakṣālitaṃ jale ।।73।।
bheko taṃ bhakṣyarūpeṇa nigīlitavatī drutam ।
tasyāṃ putraḥ samabhavat tīre bhekī prapīḍitā ।।74।।
samāgatya mṛtiṃ prāptā dhovareṇa dhṛtā hi sā ।
udarasya pradeśaśca tasyā āsīt praphāṭitaḥ ।।75।।
tatra dṛṣṭaḥ śubho bālaḥ śvasan saṃgṛhya taṃ sutam ।
dhīvarastu dadau sūryasamaṃ rājavarāya tam ।।76 ।।
camatkāreṇa rājñā sa vardhito gaurjareśvaraḥ ।
rājā'bhavan mahābhakto vaiṣṇavo viṣṇurūpavān ।।77।।
yasya rājye'bhavan sarve vaiṣṇavā mānavādayaḥ ।
dardureṇa samudrasya taṭe dardurakaṃ puram ।।78।।
sthāpitaṃ suviśālaṃ ca rājadhānīsvarūpakam ।
mohamayaṃ divaḥ sāmye dakṣiṇe smṛddhipūritam ।।79।।
atha bhekāya vahniḥ sa dvitīyaṃ tu varaṃ dadau ।
cirañjīvā tava jātirbhavatvevaṃ navaṃ punaḥ ।।1.495.80।।
prativarṣaṃ nūtanaṃ vai śarīraṃ prāgbhavād bhavet ।
punarbhūstena varṣāyāṃ jāyate bheka eva ha ।।81।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sāmarthyaṃ vahisaṃsthitam ।
viśvāmitraśca taṃ vahniṃ luptaṃ jjva tu tatkṣaṇam ।।82।।
dūrīcakāra māṃsaṃ tatsārameyamaśuddhakam ।
upavāsaṃ tadā cakre tāvat tatra mahājanaḥ ।।83।।
vrīhīn traivārṣikān bhūmeḥ khanitvā bhūdarasthitān ।
samādāya yayau daivāt dadau tasmai maharṣaye ।।84।।
snātvā śuddhiṃ parāṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā homaṃ cidambare ।
ākāśavapuṣi kṛṣṇe bubhuje daivabhālitam ।।।85।।
