tyāgāccenmuktirutkṛṣṭā daridrāṇāṃ ca sā bhavet ।।।55।।
vyāsaḥ prāha gṛhasthādikrameṇa satpathāśrayaḥ ।
ihā'mutrānandadātā tena mokṣaḥ phalātmakaḥ ।।56 ।।
śukaḥ prāha gṛhaiḥ sakto moharāgavaśaṃgataḥ ।
vāsanābandhabaddhaśca yamamārgaṃ phalaṃ labhet ।।57।।
vyāsaḥ prāha vinā rāgaṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ prasādhayet ।
śukaḥ prāha vinā bhaktiṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ pratārayet ।।58।।
vyāsaḥ prāha gṛhe bhaktiṃ paitryaṃ daivaṃ sadā kuru ।
śukaḥ prāha nijātmā me gṛhaṃ tatra karomyaham ।।19।।
vyāsaḥ prāha vinā putraṃ puṃnāmanarako dhruvaḥ ।
putreṇa tasya taraṇaṃ tasmātputraḥ praśasyate ।।1.504.60।।
śukaḥ prāha tathaiva cet kharavānarasūkarāḥ ।
putravantastariṣyanti ko viśeṣo'tra mānuṣe ।।6 1 ।।
vyāsaḥ prāha yadi jñānaṃ teṣāmapi ca mokṣaṇam ।
śukaḥ prāha pitastadvai garbhādevā'rjitaṃ mayā ।।6 2।।
gamiṣyāmi samāyātaṃ mokṣaṃ bhaktyā ca keśavam ।
prāptaṃ cintāmaṇiṃ tyaktvā kaṃkaraṃ kathamāvahet। ।।63।।
prāggrāse'mṛtamutsṛjya makṣikāṃ vai kathaṃ graset ।
prāpte svarṇarase cāgre kardamaṃ mardayet katham ।।64।।
sūryasya darśanaṃ tyaktvā rāhuṃ kathaṃ vilokayet ।
divyadīpaṃ parityajya dhūmrolkāṃ kathamarjayet ।।65।।
ekakārāgāramuktau dvitīye vai kathaṃ patet ।
brahmamārge cāvagate kṣudrasṛtyā kathaṃ saret ।।66।।
śreṣṭhaṃ copasthitaṃ tyaktvā kaniṣṭhaṃ nāvalambayet ।
satyaṃ prāptaṃ parityajya kṛtrimaṃ cāśliṣet katham ।।67।।
akke cenmadhuvindeta kimarthaṃ parvataṃ vrajet ।
iṣṭasyā'rthasya saṃsiddhau ko vidvān yatnamācaret। ।।68।।
ityuktvā pitaraṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ hṛdi sthitam ।
mātaraṃ ceṭikāṃ kṛṣṇaśaktiṃ praṇamya sādaram ।।69।।
yayau vanaṃ sadā'vanaṃ yatrātmanā bhavatyapi ।
vyāsaḥ śokaṃ ceṭikā ca duḥkhaṃ jagāma vai kṣaṇam ।।1.504.70 ।।
śukī vyāsaṃ tataḥ prāha cariṣyāmi tapaḥ punaḥ ।
putrārthaṃ yena vaṃśasya vardhako me bhavet sutaḥ ।।71 ।।
vyāsājñāṃ sā samāsādya tapastepe pativratā ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ' ।।72।।
iti mantraṃ dadau vyāso jajāpa sā divāniśam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra tvāyayau hṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।।73।।
varado'smīti tāṃ prāha varaṃ varaya suvrate ।
śukī prāha sutaṃ dehi mama vaṃśavivardhanam ।।74।।
tathā'stviti hariḥ prāha yayāvadarśanaṃ tataḥ ।
ceṭikā susutaṃ lebhe kapiñjalamiti śrutam ।।75।।
kapiñjalo mahāyogī pitroścaiva samājñayā ।
gārhasthyaṃ svīcakārā'sau bharadvājīṃ sukanyakām ।।76 ।।
pariṇeme tato bhāradvājaḥ putro babhūva ha ।
bharadvājasya taittiraḥ kāmarūpadharaḥ sutaḥ ।।77।।
saca prāgjyotiṣadeśe yayau parvatabhūstare ।
tataḥ punaḥ samāgatya navalakṣābhidhe'cale ।।78।।
nivāsaṃ svīcakārā'sau kāmākṣīṃ cā'bhajat satīm ।
kāmarūpo mahāyogī parvatīyo maheśvaraḥ ।।79।।
parvatīyaprajānāṃ vai guruḥ rājā tapobalāt ।
abhavat tena girayaḥ kāmarūpābhidhāstataḥ ।।1.504.80।।
abhavaँśca narāḥ svalpā nāryo bahvyaḥ satīcchayā ।
bhajanti smaikapuruṣaṃ śataṃ śataṃ hi yoṣitām ।।81 ।।
atha bālavayogīndro brahmaputrātaṭe vasan ।
tapaścacāra kaṭhinaṃ bālavanmohavarjitaḥ ।।82।।
te tāḥ samprārthayāmāsurnarāṇāṃ vṛddhaye tataḥ ।
sarvāḥ putraprasavābhimukhyo bhavantu madvarāt ।।83।।
yādṛksaṃkhyāḥ kanyakānāṃ narāṇāṃ santu tāḥ samāḥ ।
sāmyottaraṃ sāmyabhāve kanyākumāramātaraḥ ।।84।।
bhaviṣyatha yathāyogyā iti tāśca tathā'bhavan ।
evaṃ te kathitaṃ lakṣmi purāvṛttaṃ yuge yuge ।।85।।
navaṃ navaṃ punaḥ sañjāyate nirmāṇavad bhave ।
kāmarūpaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ bālavākuṇḍakaṃ tathā ।।86।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paṭhanācchravaṇādapi ।
yatheṣṭadāyakaṃ mantrasiddhipradaṃ hi vidyate ।।87।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanavyāsasya śukyāṃ śukakapiñjalau sutau, kapiñjalasya bharadvājastasya taittiraḥ sutaḥ, bālavayogivaradānāt kāmarūpadeśe narāṇāṃ nārīsamasaṃkhyākotpattirityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।504।।


← adhyāyaḥ 504 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 505
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 506 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
nārāyaṇa parabrahma bhagavan karuṇānidhe ।
dhyātvā rūpaṃ tava bhaktā bhuktiṃ muktiṃ prayānti ca ।। 1 ।।
sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanandaśca sanātanaḥ ।
sanatsujātaḥ pañcaite tvatsamā bhuktimuktidāḥ ।। 2 ।।
vaiṣṇavānāmagraṇīśca śaṃkaro lomaśastathā ।
mārkaṇḍeyo yājñavalkyo dharmaḥ śeṣo vṛṣastathā ।। 3 ।।
vedāśca vaiṣṇavā nityā balirbāṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।
hanumān jāmbavānaśvatthāmā prahlāda āsuriḥ ।। 4 ।।
voḍhuḥ pañcaśikho divodāsastathā'mbarīṣakaḥ ।
uddhavaśca śaśī sūryo'nilaścāpi hutāśanaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ete bhaktāstava nityaṃ tvājñāvahāḥ sutāstava ।
tava dhyānaṃ sadā kṛtvā ciraṃ tiṣṭhanti jīvinaḥ ।। 6 ।।
śaṃkaraśca tava putraḥ kathaṃ pañcaśirā hyasau ।
tvatsvarūpādvibhinnaśca kimatra kāraṇaṃ vada ।। 7 ।।
ekamastakadevasya pañcamastakaputrakaḥ ।
tadidaṃ mahadāścaryaṃ saṃśayaṃ me nirāsaya ।। 8 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
pūrvaṃ bhagavatā'jena kṛtvā sṛṣṭiṃ tu vistṛtām ।
caturvidhāṃ bahukālaṃ naranārīmayīṃ śubhām ।। 9 ।।
tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa nārīrūpāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
mohasthānāni ramyāṇi kṛtānyapi tato'pi ca ।। 1.505.1 0।।
nārīṇāmapi yatra syānmohastādṛśaputtalīm ।
racayāmīti saṃkalpya rūpasañcayasaṃyutām ।। 11 ।।
ekāmapsarasaṃ divyāṃ devībhyo'pi ca taijasīm ।
sarveṣāṃ dyusadāṃ tejaḥ samādāya tilaṃ tilam ।। 1 2।।
rūparūpātirūpāḍhyāṃ camatkṛtiṃ sa nirmame ।
yāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣobhamāpannaḥ svayameva pitāmahaḥ ।। 1 3।।
tatastāṃ preṣayāmāsa yoginaḥ śaṃkarasya vai ।
dhairyasya samparīkṣārthaṃ sā'pi kailāsamāyayau ।। 14।।
apaśyacchaṃkaraṃ kṛṣṇadhyānamagnaṃ ca nirjane ।
nityaṃ tatra sthitā bhaktā yathā dhyānakarī satī ।। 15।।
samīpasthā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇajāpaṃ cakāra sā ।
tasyā dehāt koṭicandratulyaṃ miṣṭaṃ ca śītalam ।। 16।।
kānakaṃ prasasārograṃ tejomaṇḍalamadbhutam ।
tattejo vartulākāraṃ gatvā śaṃkarapakṣmaṇoḥ ।। 17।।
lagnaṃ prakāśarūpaṃ ca netrāntaḥ praviveśa ha ।
raśmidvārāgataṃ cāntarhṛdayaṃ yatra yogirāṭ ।। 18।।
tiṣṭhatyātmani cātmānaṃ saṃyujya tejasāṃ khanau ।
tatra śaṃbhuśca tattejo dadarśa kamanīyakam ।। 1 9।।
dvedhā vṛttiḥ samādhau ca jātā satyā mṛṣā samā ।
mṛṣāṃ lokayituṃ cehā babhūva śaṃkarasya vai ।।1.505.20।।
satyāṃ visṛjya cāyāto bahiḥ kimiti kautukāt ।
netramuddhāṭya ca yāvat puraḥ paśyati sundarīm ।।21।।
visasmāra satīṃ mūrtiṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ।
vṛttyā tallīnayā jñātvā mugdhaṃ darśanalālasam ।।22।।
sāpi tṛtīyanetrasyodghāṭane bhasmatābhayāt ।
mugdhaṃ vilokayantaṃ taṃ hitvā pūrvasthalīṃ tataḥ ।।23 ।।
pradakṣiṇāyā vyājena sā praṇamya kṛtāṃjaliḥ ।
dakṣiṇaṃ sā gatā pārśvaṃ śaṃbhuniścalamastakaḥ ।।24।।
draṣṭukāmaśca tāṃ hṛdā samīyeṣā'tirāgataḥ ।
tāvadvai dakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ nirgataṃ tatkṣaṇaṃ śubham ।।25।।
atha sā bhayasampannā yayau paścimatodiśam ।
śaṃbhustasyāḥ svarūpākṛṣṭāntarbhāvo'pi paścimam ।।26 ।।
vadanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cakre darśanārthaṃ navaṃ śubham ।
atha sā bhayamāpannottarabhāgaṃ gatā tataḥ ।।27।।
tāṃ draṣṭuṃ cottaraṃ vaktraṃ nirmāya sā dadarśa tām ।
athā''kāśe gatā sā ca tāṃ draṣṭuṃ pañcamaṃ śiraḥ ।।28।।
vyomagaṃ śaṃkarastatra cakāra ca dadarśa tām ।
jahāsa ca mudhā premṇā rūpalīno babhūva ha ।। 21।।
grīvāṃ na cālayāmāsa yogābhyāsabalānvitaḥ ।
etasminnantare devo nāradaḥ pārvatīṃ prati ।।1.505.3 0।।
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa prāha śaṃkaraceṣṭitam ।
dṛṣṭvā rūpavatīṃ nārīṃ kṛtavān sa navaṃ navam ।।3 1 ।
mukhaṃ tenā'bhavad vaktrapañcaka śaṃkarasya vai ।
ahaṃ jānāmi nāstyanyā nārī tvatsadṛśī kvacit। ।।3 2 ।।
patiste ca kathaṃ mugdho hāsyāspado bhaviṣyati ।
hāsyasya padavīṃ tvaṃ ca gamiṣyasyadya pārvati ।। 33 ।।
yena kāmo bhasmarūpaḥ kṛto yogīśvaraḥ svayam ।
sa cādya māyayā viṣṇormohaṃ yāto divaḥ striyām ।।34।।
sarvāsāṃ devapatnīnāṃ pūjyā tvaṃ tvatpatiśca saḥ ।
taccittaṃ snigdhatāṃ yātaṃ devadāsyāṃ vilokaya ।। 35।।
drāgeva tāṃ samādāya nijāṃke sthāpayiṣyati ।
tava mūlyātparaṃ mūlyamapsarasaḥ kariṣyati ।।36 ।।
kuru śīghraṃ nirodhaṃ vai yāvadaṃke karoti na ।
iti śrutvā nāradasya dṛṣṭvā pañcamukhaṃ patim ।।37।।
vikṛtaṃ taṃ samālokya netreṣu praviveśa sā ।
sarvanetrāṇi vai śaṃbhoḥ rodhayāmāsa yoginī ।।38।।
etasminnantare sarvatejāṃsyapi hatāni ca ।
andhakāramayaṃ sarvaṃ puṣpavantau vitejasau ।।39 ।।
pralayasya samutthānaṃ kālarātreḥ samāgamaḥ ।
bhūkampāśca tadā jātā bhayabhītāśca dehinaḥ ।।1.505.40।।
evaṃ jāte sarvasṛṣṭikṣobhe nandyādayo gaṇāḥ ।
sarve satīṃ namaskṛtya stutvā cāpi punaḥ punaḥ ।।41 ।।
muñca muñca suraśreṣṭhe śaṃbhornetrāṇi muñca vai ।
paśyantu haranetrāṇi jagadāndhyaṃ prasarpatu ।।42।।
evamuktāpi sā devī na netrāṇi mumoca sā।
tāvaddhareṇa bhālasthaṃ visṛṣṭaṃ locanaṃ param ।।43 ।।
kṛpāviṣṭena lokānāṃ yena rakṣā prajāyate ।
vārayituṃ na śakto'smi devīṃ prāṇagarīyasīm ।।44।।
atha devī tato netrayogaṃ vihāya susthirā ।
harasya sannidhau tilottamāmuvāca vai ruṣā ।।45।।
yasmānme dayitaḥ pāpe tvayā rūpādviḍambitaḥ ।
tasmāttvaṃ rūpahīnā ca śīrṇakeśā mahodarī ।।46।।
cipiṭākṣī bṛhaddantī bhava vai bhagnanāsikā ।
atha jātā tatkṣaṇena tilottamā kurūpiṇī ।।47।।
tuṣṭāva pārvatīṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ kṣamāṃ yasma yācate ।
nāsti me'trā'parādho vai dāsyā darśanayoṣitaḥ ।।48।।
devasya tava kiṃkaryāḥ prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ।
pārvatī ca tadā prāha samāgaccha mayā saha ।।49।।
śaṃkarāt tvaṃ gṛhāṇātra mantraṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye namaḥ' ।।1.505.50 ।।
tato yāhi mayā sārdhaṃ tīrthaṃ śrīhāṭakeśvaram ।
nāganadyāṃ rūpatīrthe snāhi śāpanivṛttaye ।।51 ।।
evaṃ mantraṃ gṛhītvā ca gṛhītvā tulasīsrajam ।
nāgamatyāṃ yayau sasnau surūpā sā babhūva ha ।।52।।
pūrvamāsīd yathārūpā tathārūpā viśeṣataḥ ।
babhūva pārvatī natvā yayau satye pitāmaham ।।53 ।।
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa pañcavaktrādirohaṇam ।
brahmā prāha pratisṛṣṭiṃ tathā bhavati putrike ।।54।।
tvāṃ nimittaṃ samāsādya haraḥ pañcamukho muhuḥ ।
jāyate ca tava kīrtiḥ sadā loke bhaviṣyati ।।55।।
ityuktvā tāṃ dadāvāśīrvādān sṛṣṭau sthirā bhava ।
devakāryakarī satyaloke vāsakarī bhava ।।56।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tilottamānimittena śaṃkarasya pañcamukhavattā, tilottamāyāḥ pārvatīśāpaḥ, nāgavatyā snānena śāpanivṛttirityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।5 05।।


← adhyāyaḥ 505 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 506
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 507 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! sarasvatyā raktasalilavāhitā ।
yathā jātā purā tāṃ te pravakṣyāmi ca pāvanīm ।। 1 ।।
viśvāmitrasya ca vaśiṣṭhasyā''sīd vimanaskatā ।
brahmaṇā brāhmaṇaiścokto viśvāmitraḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 2 ।।
brāhmaṇo'yaṃ brāhmaṇo'yaṃ brahmarṣiḥ kṣatriyo'pi vai ।
vaśiṣṭhena tu naivoktaḥ śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ priye ।। 3 ।।
āsīt purā ṛcīkākhyo bhṛguputro mahāmuniḥ ।
vratādhyayanasampannastapasvī caikadā tu saḥ ।। 4 ।।
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yayau bhojakaṭaṃ puram ।
kauśikī ca nadī yatra yatra gādhirmahīpatiḥ ।। 5 ।।
tasyāṃ snātvā prasantarpya pitṛdevān jajāpa saḥ ।
tāvat tīre tatra caikā snānārthaṃ rājakanyakā ।। 6 ।।
yuvatī rūpasampannā sarvāvayavaśobhanā ।
samāyātā ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā munirmumoha kāmataḥ ।। 7 ।।
kasyeyaṃ kanyakā ceti lokān papraccha, te janāḥ ।
prāhuḥ gādhisutā cāsti gaurīpūjanalālasā ।। 8 ।।
īhamānā subhartāraṃ vrataṃ karoti kāntadam ।
atra brahma japitvā ca pūjayitvā yathākramam ।। 9 ।।
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ gauryai datvā karoti gāyanam ।
nṛtyaṃ ca vādanaṃ cāpi nityaṃ gaurīpratuṣṭaye ।। 1.506.1 0।।
śrutvā sa munirāṭ gādhiṃ pratiyayau sulālasaḥ ।
ṛcīkaṃ tvāgataṃ vīkṣya rājā satkāramācarat ।। 11 ।।
kṛtvā'rhaṇāṃ ṛṣiṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ papraccha bhāvataḥ ।
nispṛhasyāpi te vipra kimāgamanakāraṇam ।। 1 2।।
yatheṣṭaṃ me samācakṣva prayacchāmi ca te'khilam ।
ṛcīko mohabhāvena yayāce tāṃ sukanyakām ।। 1 3।।
brāhmaṇena vivāhena tāṃ me dehīti cābravīt ।
sā mayā vī kṣitā gaurīpūjāyāmiti cā'bravīt ।। 14।।
tacchrutvā bhayasantrasto gādhirbuddhimatāṃ varaḥ ।
daridraṃ jaraṭhaṃ matvā provāca nītisaṃbhṛtam ।। 15।।
asmākaṃ kanyakādāne śulkamasti dvijottama ।
tacced yacchasi kanyāṃ tāṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃśayam ।। 16।।
ṛcīkaḥ prāha rājaँstvaṃ kanyāśulkaṃ vadātra me ।
drutaṃ yacchāmi te sarvaṃ durlabhaṃ cāpi golake ।।17।।
gādhiḥ prāhaikataḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ vājināṃ dvija ।
śatāni sapta me dehi śvetānāṃ caiva sarvataḥ ।। 18।।
sa tatheti pratijñāya ṛcīkastapasojjvalaḥ ।
gaṃgātīraṃ yayau cāpovohleti ca jajāpa vai ।। 1 9।।
catuḥṣaṣṭiṛcāsūktaṃ vāruṇaṃ niyuyoja ha ।
tāvat pūrṇe jape devo varuṇastatra cāyayau ।।1.506.20 ।।
tena sārdhaṃ vājinaśca niṣkrāntāḥ salilāt tadā ।
sarve śvetāḥ suvegāśca śyāmaikaśravaṇāḥ śubhāḥ ।।21 ।।
śatāni saptasaṃkhyāni tāvatsaṃkhyairnarairyutāḥ ।
ṛcīko'pi samādāya natvā taṃ varuṇaṃ tadā ।।।22।।
aśvān gṛhītvā puruṣairgādhiṃ jagāma vai drutam ।
tasmai nivedayāmāsa kanyārthe tān hayottamān ।।23।।
gādhistu tān samāgṛhya sarvān vājimakhasya ca ।
kanyāṃ tasmai dadau vipravahnisākṣye vidhānataḥ ।। 24।।
ṛcīko dharmapatnyā ca niṣkāmaḥ samapadyata ।
kālāntare satīṃ prāha sevamānāṃ pativratām ।।25।।
ahaṃ tapase yāsyāmi varaṃ vṛṇu dadāmi te ।
sāpi svārthavihīnasya śrutvā vākyamṛṣestataḥ ।।26।।
svasyā jananīṃ provāca vṛttāntaṃ śokadharṣitā ।
jananī tāṃ sutāṃ prāha putrārthaṃ vṛṇu putrike ।।27।।
brāhmaṇyena yutaṃ putraṃ tvadarthaṃ vṛṇu putrike ।
kṣātreṇa tejasā yuktaṃ madarthaṃ ca sutaṃ vṛṇu ।।28।।
sā patiṃ sampraṇamyā''ha jananyuktaṃ savistaram ।
ṛcīko yajñadevārthaṃ pracakāra carudvayam ।।29।।
putreṣṭiṃ vidhivat kṛtvā caruṃ dvedhā vibhajya ca ।
ekasmin yojayāmāsa brāhmyatejo'khilaṃ yaśaḥ ।।1.506.3 0 ।।
anyasmin yojayāmāsa kṣātraṃ tejo'khilaṃ tataḥ ।
bhāryāyai pradadau brāhmyatejoyuktaṃ caruṃ hi saḥ ।। 31 ।।
abravīt prāśaya tvenamaśvatthā''liṅganaṃ kuru ।
tataḥ prāpsyasi satputraṃ brahmatejaḥsamanvitam ।।32।।
dvitīyaṃ ca caruṃ patnyā mātre dadau sutārthakam ।
kṣātratejomayaṃ datvā prāha prāśya caruṃ tvimam ।। 33 ।।
nyagrodhāliṅganaṃ kṛtvā prāpsyasi kṣatriyaṃ sutam ।
atha mātā sutāṃ prāha rahasye bhāvinoditā ।। 34।।
sarvalokasya vai svārthe śraiṣṭhyaṃ kṣaudryaṃ parārthake ।
maccarvapekṣayā putri tvaccarau śreṣṭhatā bhavet ।। 35।।
śrutvā putrī mātṛvatsā bhrātṛśraiṣṭhyābhilāṣiṇī ।
akarod vyatyayaṃ vṛkṣe carau cāpi hi padmaje ।। 36।।
tataḥ puṃsavane snāne te śubhe premavihale ।
dadhāte garbhamekā tu sutā kṣātreṇa tejasā ।। 37।।
bhūtvā garbhavatī nityaṃ rājyabhoge mano dadhe ।
yuddhavārtāstathā cakre hastyaśvārohaṇādijāḥ ।।38।।
raktavastrottamabhūṣāḥ kaisaraṃ ca vilepanam ।
piturgṛhāt samānīya śṛṃgāraṃ ca karoti sā ।। 39।।
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ patnyāḥ ṛcīkaḥ prāha tāṃ tadā ।
kiṃ priye vyatyayaścarvoḥ kṛto vā vṛkṣayostathā ।।1.506.40।।
ceṣṭayā te jñāyate'tra bhāvinaṃ ko vilaṃghayet ।
dvijācāravihīnaste dhruvaṃ putro bhaviṣyati ।।41 ।।
tava mātā ceṣṭayā ca kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ vinā sadā ।
dṛśyate nu śamasthā ca japahomaparāyaṇā ।।42।।
tīrthayātrā kathāśrāve saśraddhā ten te'nujaḥ ।
bhaviṣyati brāhmaṇasya tejasā brahmaṇā samaḥ ।। 43।।
yādṛśā daurhṛdāḥ santi sagarbhāṇāṃ tu yoṣitām ।
tādṛśāni lakṣaṇāni putre vasanti yoṣitām ।।44।।
pitrorniṣekasamaye sagarbhāyāṃ striyāṃ tathā ।
yādṛśī vartate ceṣṭā sā garbhe pratibimbate ।।45।।
atha patnī ṛṣiṃ prāha kṣamasva tāṃ kṣatiṃ mama ।
vyatyāso yaḥ kṛto nātha punardayāṃ kuru prabho ।।46 ।।
brāhmaṇo me bhavet putro manmātuḥ kṣatriyaḥ sutaḥ ।
ṛcīkaḥ prāha naivaṃ syād gataṃ jātaṃ tathaiva tat ।।47।।
kintu putragaṇāḥ kṣātrāḥ pautre yāsyanti madvarāt ।
ityevaṃ vai dayāṃ kurve putraste brāhmaṇo'stu vai ।।48।।
ityevaṃ varadānena jamadagniḥ suto'bhavat ।
jamadagneḥ sutaḥ parśurāmaḥ kṣātrakramo'bhavat ।। 49।।
ekaviṃśatidhā bhūmau cakre raṇaṃ tu rājabhiḥ ।
atha gādhergṛhapatnī dadhe garbhaṃ tataḥ param ।।।1.506.50।।
brāhmaṇīvat samācārā suṣuve putramuttamam ।
brāhmaṇaṃ karmaṇā yogasandhyādhyānaparāyaṇam ।।51 ।।
viśvāmitraitikhyātaṃ kṣātradharmavirāgiṇam ।
yadā rājyakṣamo jāto gādhinā yojitaśca saḥ ।।52।।
pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ gṛhāṇa vedamārgagaḥ ।
putre datvā so'pi rājyaṃ viśvāmitro vane sthitaḥ ।।53।।
sakalatro devaviprapūjāparāyaṇaḥ śuciḥ ।
tāpasaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇadhyānaparaḥ sadā ।।54।।
ekadā vanamadhye'yaṃ mṛgayārthaṃ bhraman yayau ।
vasiṣṭhasyā''śramaṃ ramyaṃ mṛgadruśiṣyaśobhitam ।।55।।
vaśiṣṭhastaṃ samāyāntaṃ pratyutthāyonmukhaṃ yayau ।
datvā tasmai tadā'rghaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ yathocitam ।।56।।
abravīd rājayogyaṃ ca svāgataṃ te mahīpate ।
vada kṛtyaṃ karomyadya satkāraṃ te yathocitam ।।57।।
viśvāmitrastadā prāha sainyaṃ me nikaṭe sthitam ।
mṛgayārthaṃ samāyāto jalaṃ pītvā prayāmi ca ।। 58।।
bubhukṣiteṣu bhṛtyeṣu yaḥ svāmī kurute'śanam ।
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tasmād yāsyāmi vai drutam ।।59।।
vaśiṣṭhaśca tadā prāha sarvānānaya tāniha।
asti me nandinī dhenurvāñcchitaṃ yā prayacchati ।।1.506.60।।
tasyā balena sarvān vai tṛptiṃ dāsyāmi cottamām ।
bhūtvaivaṃ tvānayāmāsa sainyaṃ mahīpatistataḥ ।।61 ।।
vaśiṣṭhaḥ kāmadhenuṃ tāmuvāca svāgatāya vai ।
viśvāmitrasya rājarṣeryāvadbhojanalabdhaye ।।62।।
kuruṣva tṛptiparyantaṃ khādyapeyādikaṃ śubham ।
aśvānāṃ ca gajādīnāṃ yavasādikamityapi ।।63।।
tato viśrāmalabdhyarthaṃ gṛhopakaraṇādikam ।
dhenurbāḍhaṃ samuvāca sasṛje tatkṣaṇaṃ bahu ।।64।।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ lehyacośye peyaṃ lepyaṃ ca bhogyakam ।
dāsāyutaṃ tathā dāsīdaśasāhasramityapi ।।65।।
te dāsā dāsikā viśvāmitrāya ca balāya ca ।
daduḥ śīghraṃ subhojyāni śarkarāghṛtavanti ca ।।66।।
dadhi dugdhaṃ madhu miṣṭaṃ peyaṃ suśītalaṃ jalam ।
evaṃ gavā nṛpaḥ sainyayutastṛptiṃ vidhāpitaḥ ।।67।।
viśvāmitraḥ kautukaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ jagāma ha ।
aho citraṃ gavā tṛptiṃ nītā vayaṃ sahasraśaḥ ।।68।।
tasmātsannīyatāmeṣā svagṛhaṃ dhenuruttamā ।
tataḥ prāha vaśiṣṭhāya tava dāsyāmi cepsitam ।।69।।
varān rathāṃśca hastyaśvān gā anyāśca sahasraśaḥ ।
dehi me nandinīṃ rājye yogyāṃ vaśiṣṭha sarvathā ।। 1.506.70।।
vaśiṣṭhastu tadā prāha homadhenuriyaṃ nṛpa ।
asmatkāmapradā daivī hyadeyā gaudvijanmanām ।।71 ।।
sarvakāmapradā ceyaṃ tāpasānāṃ kṛte sthitā ।
adeyā sarvathā gauśca vikraye mātṛvikrayaḥ ।। 72।।
na sāmnāṃ naiva bhedena na dānena prasahya na ।
na vikrīya na vā cānyairupāyaistvāṃ samarpaye ।।73 ।।
tasmād gaccha mahārāja svasthānaṃ ca sukhī bhava ।
viśvāmitrastataḥ prāha rājyasya sattayā munim ।।74।।
yatkiñcid vidyate ratnaṃ pārthivasya kṣitau hi tat ।
sarvaṃ syād rājakīyaṃ vai nītiśceyaṃ mune sadā ।।75।।
tasmānnayāmi dhenuṃ vai nṛpaterdhanameva tat ।
ityuktvā''jñāpayāmāsa bhṛtyavargaṃ tataśca te ।।76।।
bhṛtyā dhenuṃ nigṛhyaiva raśminā ninyurulbaṇāḥ ।
atha gacchati sā naiva tvaśrupūrṇā babhūva ha ।।77।।
daṇḍaprahāraiste ninyuḥ prasahyā''kṛṣya bhṛtyakāḥ ।
lokayantaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ sā papraccha duḥkhakarṣitā ।।78।।
kiṃ dattā'smi muniśreṣṭha tvayā'haṃ cā'sya bhūpateḥ ।
vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha dheno tvaṃ na dattā'si mayā śubhe ।।79।।
prāṇā yāntu mama mātarmā yāhi tvaṃ mayi sthite ।
tadrakṣasva svayaṃ dheno hyātmānaṃ matprabhāvataḥ ।।1.506.80।।
ityuktā kopamāpannā cakre huṃkāragarjanāḥ ।
huँkārebhyaśca phenebhyo romebhyaḥ svedamaṇḍalāt ।।81 ।।
niṣkrāntāḥ sāyudhā mlecchāḥ pulindāḥ śabarāḥ khasāḥ ।
yoddhāro vyomamārgasthā acchedyā apradhṛṣyakāḥ ।।82।।
asaṃkhyātā ahanaँste viśvāmitrasya tān mahān ।
tataḥ kopaparītātmā viśvāmitraḥ svayaṃ dhanuḥ ।।83 ।।
sajyaṃ kṛtvā ca maraṇe niścito'tiyuyodha ha ।
tathāpi sainikā aśvā gajā bhaṭāḥ padātayaḥ ।।84।।
viśvāmitrasya vai sarve hatā dhenūdbhavairbhaṭaiḥ ।
viśvāmitraṃ parityajya śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ nipātitam ।।85।।
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vaśiṣṭhastu nandinīmidamabravīt ।
rakṣa nandini bhūpālaṃ mlecchairetaiḥ samāvṛtam ।।86 ।।
rājā hi yatnato rakṣyo rājā nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ ।
sanmārge vartate sarvo rājadaṇḍabhayād yataḥ ।।87।।
iti śrutvā nandinī sā mlecchān vārayituṃ yayau ।
tāvadrājā ruṣā tāṃ gāṃ prahartumupacakrame ।।88।।
vaśiṣṭhaste samālokya goprahāraṃ nṛpakṛtam ।
taṃ bāhuṃ stambhayāmāsa saheti tasya bhūpateḥ ।।89।।
jaḍībhūto nṛpo lajjāyukto vaśiṣṭhamāha ca ।
rakṣa vaśiṣṭha māṃ mlecchairvadhyamānaṃ jaḍīkṛtam ।। 1.506.90 ।।
mamā'parādhānnaṣṭaṃ me sarvaṃ sainyamanantakam ।
tasmād yāsyāmyahaṃ harmyaṃ na yuddhena prayojanam ।।91 ।।
evamukto vaśiṣṭhaśca stambhadoṣavivarjitam ।
viśvāmitrasya tu karaṃ cakārā''ha sukhāvaham ।।92।।
gaccha rājan vimukto'si mā virodhaya bhūsuraiḥ ।
rājā yayau svabhavanaṃ pralāpamakaronmuhuḥ ।।93 ।।
dhigbalaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu dhigvīryaṃ dhikprajīvitam ।
ślāghyaṃ brahmabalaṃ caikaṃ brāhmyaṃ tejo hi kevalam ।। 94।।
tacca karma mayā kāryaṃ yathā syād brāhmaṇaṃ balam ।
tapasā''rādhanayā ca cariṣyāmi mahātapaḥ ।।95।।
atha viśvasahaṃ putraṃ rājye saṃsthāpya bhūpatiḥ ।
himavantaṃ yayau tatra tapaścakre sudāruṇam ।।96।।
śatavarṣatrayaṃ phalāhāro babhūva kevalam ।
varṣāsvākāśasaṃsthaśca grīṣme pañcāgnitāpanaḥ ।।97।।
śaitye śītajalāvāso babhūva ca tataḥ param ।
śatavarṣatrayaṃ śuṣkaparṇāhāro babhūva saḥ ।।98।।
śatavarṣatrayaṃ tato jalāhāro'bhavannṛpaḥ ।
atha varṣaśate vāyvāhāro babhūva tatparam ।।99।।
indro bhayena saṃgamyovāca taṃ tāpasaṃ nṛpam ।
tuṣṭo'smi tava rājendra varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ।। 1.506.10 0।।
viśvāmitrastadā prāha dehi brāhmaṇyameva me ।
tadarthaṃ vai tapaścaryāṃ karomi nānyakāmyayā ।। 101 ।।
indraḥ prāha kṣatriyasyā'nena dehena vai kutaḥ ।
saṃskārairjāyate cāṣṭācatvāriṃśadbhireva yat। ।। 1 02।।
brāhmaṇyaṃ tad bhaved rājannanyaṃ varaṃ tato vṛṇu ।
rājā prāha na brāhmaṇyādanyat samprārthayāmyaham ।। 10 3।।
parityakṣyāmyahaṃ dehaṃ prāpsye vā vipratāṃ vraja ।
indro divaṃ yayau śrutvā rājā tepe'tiduṣkaram ।। 1 04।।
punarvarṣasahasraṃ vai vyatikrāntaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ।
ājagāma svayaṃ brahmā puṇyairdevarṣibhiḥ saha ।। 1 05।।
brahmā prāha pratuṣṭo'smi varaṃ varaya cepsitam ।
rājā prāha ca vipratvaṃ dehi me nānyadīpsitam ।। 1 06।।
brahmā prāha dharāpṛṣṭhe vipratvaṃ kṣatriyasya na ।
kṣatriyeṇa prajātasya vipratvaṃ jāyate katham ।। 1 07।।
rājā prāhā'samarthaśced yāhi svaṃ bhavanaṃ pitaḥ ।
dehaṃ tyakṣyāmi vā prāpsye vipratvaṃ tapasā bhuvi ।। 1 08।।
athā'bravīdṛcīko'tra brāhmyairmantrairmayā pitaḥ ।
yojitaśca carustatrā'mitaṃ brāhmaṇyamarpitam ।। 1 09।।
kṣatriyāt kṣātradharmā'pi brāhmaṇo bhavituṃ hyayam ।
arhatyeva niṣeke brāhmaṇatvaṃ tvasya miśritam ।। 1.506.110 ।।
tataścainaṃ kīrtayasva brahmarṣiṃ tvaṃ pitāmaha ।
brāhmyadharmasamācāro vartate'yaṃ sadā śuciḥ ।। 111 ।।
śrutvā brahmā kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā jñātvā yathārthakāraṇam ।
brahmarṣistvamiti prāha sarve prāhustathaiva tam ।। 11 2।।
vasiṣṭhastu ruṣā prāha nā'haṃ vakṣyāmi taṃ tathā ।
kṣatriyasya sutaṃ kasmād vipraṃ vakṣyāmi bodhavān ।। 11 3।।।
ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ vasiṣṭho hāṭakeśvaram ।
kṣetraṃ tepe tapastatra viśvāmitro'pi cāyayau ।। 1 14।।
vaśiṣṭhasya vadhārthaṃ vai cintayāmāsa saṃvasan ।
viśvāmitro devavatīnadyāḥ sthāne'bhicārakam ।। 1 15।।
cakāra dāruṇairmantrairjuhvāno jātavedasam ।
tato vahnestu niṣkrāntā śaktirvānaravāhanā ।। 1 16।।
bhayānakā''yudhahastā viśvāmitreṇa sā tadā ।
yojitā tu vasiṣṭhasya vadhārthaṃ sā yayau drutam ।। 1 17।।
athā''śrame vaśiṣṭhasya tatkālaṃ durnimittakam ।
adṛśyata papātolkā nihatya ravimaṇḍalam ।। 1 18।।
raktavṛṣṭirasthimiśrā vyajāyata kṣaṇāntare ।
śivā prācīṃ samuddiśya ruroda dīrghanādataḥ ।। 11 9।।
evaṃ jāte mahāśaktirvahneḥ parvatasadṛśī ।
adṛśyata samāyāntī kṛtyārūpā sacetanā ।। 1.506.120 ।।
sāmavedoktamantraiḥ sā vaśiṣṭhena nirodhitā ।
mahāmantraiḥ punastatra stambhitā''tharvaṇodbhavaiḥ ।। 121 ।।
tato nārīsvarūpā sā provāca munipuṃgavam ।
sāmavedaḥ supramāṇaṃ tavāpi jagatāmapi ।। 122
tenā'haṃ vidhinā sṛṣṭā preritā muninā tathā ।
mā kuruṣvā'pramāṇaṃ taṃ prahāraṃ saha me ṛṣe ।। 123 ।।
rakṣayiṣyāmi te prāṇān svalpasparśena sārthikā ।
vaśiṣṭhaḥ prāha yadyevaṃ kuru sparśaṃ dayāvati ।। 124।।
mayā tvātharvaṇā mantrāḥ saṃhṛtā marma mā spṛśa ।
ityuktā sā vaśiṣṭhaṃ vai spṛṣṭvā papāta bhūtale ।। 1 25।
sā ca śaktirdevadhārā nāmnā tatraiva tiṣṭhati ।
pūjanācchravaṇāttvasyā bhaktiṃ muktiṃ ca saṃlabhet ।। 126 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvāmitravasiṣṭhayoḥ kāmadhenunimittakakleśaḥ, ṛcīkasya gādhisutayā śyāmakarṇāśvavinimayena vivāhaḥ, mātṛputryorvyatyāsena putrārthacaruprāśanam, pautrayorvyatyāsaguṇāḥ, gādherviśvāmitraḥ, ṛcīkasya jamadagniḥ, viśvāmitrasya tapo brāhmaṇyaṃ ca, viśvaṃsahaḥ sutaḥ, viśvāmitrapreritaśaktisahaviśvāmitrastaṃbhanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 506 ।।



← adhyāyaḥ 506 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 507
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 508 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! sā ca śaktirdhārānāmnī kumārikā ।
brāhmaṇasyā'bhavatputrī devaśarmaṇa īśvarī ।। 1 ।।
kanyārūpā tapastepe'rundhatīmitratāṃ gatā ।
arundhatyāśrame vāsaṃ tataścakāra śobhanā ।। 2 ।।
ekadā'rundhatī prāha sarasvatyāstaṭe śubham ।
mamāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ tatra tiṣṭha mayā saha ।। 3 ।।
tataḥ sā kanyakā dhārā tayā sārdhaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
śaktirūpā sthitā devī sarasvatyāstaṭe śubhā ।। 4 ।।
divyā brahmasvarūpā ca vasiṣṭho'pi mahāmuniḥ ।
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ tyaktvā sarasvatītaṭe ।। 5 ।।
svāśramaṃ prayayau tatra tapastepe sukhāvaham ।
viśvāmitreṇa vijñātaṃ śaktirme tatra saṃgatā ।। 6 ।।
vaśiṣṭhasya gṛhe cāste tāpasī brahmaputrikā ।
vasiṣṭho'pi sarasvatyāstaṭe cāste nijāśrame ।। 7 ।।
jñātvā cukopa cātyarthaṃ śaśāpa ca sarasvatīm ।
bhava raktajalā yatra vasiṣṭho na vaset kvacit ।। 8 ।।
ātharvaṇena mantreṇa viśvāmitrābhicārataḥ ।
sarasvatī tadā tūrṇaṃ jātā raktajalā yataḥ ।। 9 ।।
apeyaṃ tajjalaṃ jātaṃ daivānāṃ karmavarjitam ।
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ peyaṃ jñātvā vihāya tat ।। 1.507.10 ।।
tattīrasthā yayurdūraṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ puṣkaraṃ yayau ।
dhārā śaktirdevatā ca vāsaṃ cakāra sarvadā ।। 1 1।।
sarasvatyā vasiṣṭhaścā''vedito jalaśuddhaye ।
raktatāyā layārthaṃ ca puṣkare'rbudaparvate ।। 12।।
vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha raktasya śuddhyarthaṃ tava sarvathā ।
yatiṣye gaccha deveśi sarvaṃ te sukhadaṃ yathā ।। 13 ।।
vasiṣṭho yogamāsthāya cāvatīrya dharātale ।
plakṣavṛkṣasya mūle vai sarasvatyā jalānvite ।। 14।।
kṛtvā samādhiṃ netrābhyāṃ lokayāmāsa cāntare ।
tāvatpṛthvītalācchuddhaṃ jalaṃ paramapāvanam ।। 15 ।।
pravāharūpaṃ sambhūtaṃ sarasvatyāṃ yuyoja tat ।
tajjalaṃ sarvathā pūrṇaṃ sarasvatyāṃ babhūva ha ।। 16 ।।
niṣkāsya salilaṃ raktaṃ vegena ca bahirbahiḥ ।
śuddhaṃ jalaṃ sarasvatyāstanmūlātsarvadā'sti hi ।। 17।।
śuddhavāryoghabalato raktaṃ niḥsāritaṃ jalam ।
pravāhaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ tat kṛtvā yātaṃ sthalāntaram ।। 18।।
udvelaṃ sambhramadgacchadyātaṃ nimnasthalīṃ prati ।
sā tu sābhramatīnāmnī nadī jātā tadutthitā ।। 1 9।।
athaikadā ṛṣiryājñavalkyaḥ sābhramatītaṭe ।
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena niryayau bhaginīyutaḥ ।।1.507.20।।
kaṃsārikā'bhidhā sā ca bālyādvai brahmacāriṇī ।
tāpasī saṃyamaprāptā jñānānandamayī satī ।।2 1।।
yājñavalkyasya bhāginī vaiṣṇavī cārtavavṛṣā ।
ṛtudharmaṃ samāpannā yātrāyāṃ tena hetunā ।।22।।
yājñavalkyaḥ sthitiṃ cakre saptāhaṃ saritastaṭe ।
vṛkṣo'dhaḥparṇaśālāyāṃ bhaginī tvaparoṭaje ।।23 ।।
yājñavalkyasya daivāddhi svapnadoṣo babhūva ha ।
retoyuktaṃ paridhānaṃ samuttārya bahiḥsthale ।। 24।।
sthāpayitvā punā rātrau supto nidrāṃ jagāma ha ।
atha kaṃsārikā mūtraśaucārthaṃ tu kṣaṇāntare ।। 29।।
ūṭajādbahirāyātā dadarśa patitā'mbaram ।
mūtraśaucaṃ vidhāyaivā'mbaraṃ saṃgṛhya coṭaje ।।26 ।।
suṣvāpa śayane sādhvī cottānā ca tataḥ punaḥ ।
klinnayonyantaraṃ bhāgaṃ praveśitā'mbareṇa sā ।।27।।
savīryakā'jñānavatī mārjayāmāsa vai muhuḥ ।
vastraretaso yogena yoniḥ klinnā viśeṣataḥ ।।28 ।।
punastenaiva vastreṇa mārjayāmāsa vai muhuḥ ।
svayonestu malaṃ matvā mārjayāmāsa cāntaram ।। 29।।
evaṃ tvamogharetastad bhagamadhye'nvasaṃcarat ।
rajasā miśritaṃ garbharūpaṃ babhūva tattadā ।। 1.507.30 ।।
atha prātaḥ samutthāya yājñavalkyo'mbaraṃ nijam ।
anveṣayāmāsa bahiḥ prāptaṃ naivā'mbaraṃ yataḥ ।। 31 ।।
papraccha bhaginīṃ dhautraṃ jñātaṃ prāptaṃ nu vā tvayā ।
sā prāhā'tra mayā bhrātaḥ rakṣitaṃ śayane mama ।।32।।
bhrātā prāha mayā tena snātavyaṃ dehi me svasaḥ ।
svasā prāha nayiṣye'haṃ kṣālanārthaṃ nadītaṭam ।।3 3 ।।
yāhi tvaṃ cāmbaraṃ nītvā cāyāmyeva kṣaṇāntare ।
ityuktaḥ sa yayau nadyāṃ sāpi śaṃkitamānasā ।। 34।।
dadarśa dhautraṃ vistārya śeṣaṃ dhātuṃ tadantare ।
śuṣkāyamānaṃ saṃvīkṣya jātaśaṃkā babhūva ha ।। 35।।
cintayāmāsa satataṃ mayā yonyantare muhuḥ ।
klinnabhāvasya nāśārthaṃ vastraṃ praveśitaṃ tadā ।।36 ।।
yonirviśeṣataḥ klinnā saṃbabhūva punaḥ punaḥ ।
rajo me niḥsṛtaṃ cāpi dhātuyogena vai dhruvam ।।37।।
idānīṃ jñātamevaitatkāraṇaṃ gopyameva tat ।
yadi garbho bhavenme'tra daivaṃ hi balavattaram ।। 38।।
itijñātvā saṃvicārya śokaṃ cakāra bhāminī ।
gopayāmāsa māsāntaṃ tataḥ prāha sahodaram ।। 39 ।।
mayā kāryaṃ vrataṃ bhrātargantavyaṃ ca nijāśramam ।
mithilāviṣaye yatra vrataṃ vai pūrṇatāṃ vrajet ।।1.507.40 ।।
ityuktvā prayayau nijaṃ cāśramaṃ tadvane śubhe ।
gaurīṃ sampūjayāmāsa vratenā'naśanena vai ।।41 ।।
saptāhe saṃvyatīte tu gaurī sākṣāt samāyayau ।
kaṃsāriktā jagādedaṃ garbho me bhrātṝetasaḥ ।।42।।
manye tiṣṭhati hyudare daiva tadbalavattaram ।
tasya vṛddhiṃ mānasīṃ ca kuru saubhāgyasundari ।।43 ।।
yathā nānye ca jānīyustathā janma samarpaya ।
gaurī tathā'stviti prāha pasparśa pāṇinodaram ।।44।।
garbhaḥ pakvaḥ kṣaṇājjāto bālaḥ sampūrṇa eva ca ।
suṣuve bālakaṃ gaurīsannidhau tatkṣaṇāt satī ।।45।।
nālacchedaṃ svayaṃ gaurī cakāra śuddhiprabhṛti ।
kaṃsārikā vratavyājānna niḥsasāra vai bahiḥ ।।46।।
gauryuktarītimāśritya rātrau śānte vane ca sā ।
veṣṭitaṃ sūkṣmavastreṇa bālaṃ nītvā ravidyutim ।।47।।
nātidūraṃ yayau śreṣṭhamaśvatthaṃ vijanasthale ।
tasyā'dhastādvimucyātha vākyametaduvāca ha ।।48।।
aśvattha viṣṇurūpo'si tvaṃ deveṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
tasmād rakṣasva me putraṃ sarvatastvaṃ vanaspate! ।।49।।
eṣa te śaraṇaṃ prāpto mama putrastu bālakaḥ ।
salajjāyā nirdayāyāstasmād vṛkṣa prapoṣaya ।।1.507.50 ।।
evamuktvā sutasnehād ruroda cā'prakāśitam ।
tāvattatrā''gatā ṣaṣṭhīdevī yā manasā'bhidhā ।।5 1 ।।
bālānāṃ rakṣikā yā sampreṣitā śivayoṣitā ।
prāhaināṃ mā rurodā'tra kariṣye tvasya rakṣaṇam ।।52।।
gaccha maunaṃ svāśramaṃ tvaṃ dāsye bālaṃ prapoṣitam ।
tubhyaṃ mā khida sādhvi tvaṃ sukhaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।53 ।।
tathāpi śaṃkamānā tāṃ rākṣasīṃ praruroda sā ।
tāvadākāśajā vāṇī sañjātā meghaniḥsvanā ।।54।।
mā tvaṃ śokaṃ kuruṣvāsya bālakasya kṛte śubhe ।
eṣa śāpādutathyasya jyeṣṭhabhrāturbṛhaspateḥ ।।55।।
avatīrṇo tava kukṣau bṛhaspatiḥ svayaṃ guruḥ ।
eṣa cātharvaṇaṃ vedaṃ śatakalpaṃ savistaram ।।56।।
saptabhedaṃ ca navadhā pañca kalpaṃ kariṣyati ।
janmayogī pippalasya rasaṃ saṃbhakṣayiṣyati ।।57।।
ayaṃ vai pippalādeti nāmnā khyāto bhaviṣyati ।
eṣā ṣaṣṭhī mahādevī rakṣāṃ tvasya kariṣyati ।।18।।
ityuktā prayayau tatra yatra svasyā''śramaḥ śubhaḥ ।
atha sā cintayā nityaṃ putrapragatamānasā ।।59।।
samayaṃ nirjanaṃ labdhvā muhuryāti sutaṃ prati ।
rakṣitaṃ hasamānaṃ ca puṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoda ha ।।1.507.60 ।।
cumbanaṃ stanyapānādi kṛtvā datvā prayāti vai ।
atha vanyajanaiḥ putraścāvalokita eva saḥ ।।6 1 ।।
ṛṣyāśrameṣu sā vārtā prasasāra bahusthale ।
daivaputraḥ pippalādaḥ plakṣavṛkṣe hi vartate ।।62।।
ṛṣisaṃghāstu taṃ draṣṭuṃ prayānti pippalasthitam ।
kaścicced grahītuṃ yāti bālaḥ prayātyadarśanam ।।63।।
ṣaṣṭhīdevī karotyevā'ntardhānaṃ bālakasya vai ।
śrutvā''ścaryaṃ yājñavalkyo yayau taddarśanāya vai ।।64।।
ekākyeva ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā svānurūpaguṇāśrayam ।
kathaṃ cāyaṃ mama rūpaṃ prāptavānityacintayat ।।65।।
bālaḥ prāha pitaste'stu namaskāro mama prabho! ।
jātismaro'sti tvadvīryādutpanno'haṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ।।66।।
kaṃsārikā ca mātā me svāpnavastrasya yogataḥ ।
suṣuve māṃ pārvatīvākyācca pippalavṛkṣake ।।67।।
poṣaṇārthaṃ dhṛtavatī ṣaṣṭhī rakṣati māṃ sadā ।
tāvatkātyāyanī prāptā maitreyī jñānaśevadhiḥ ।।68।।
sakhyastvanyā vananāryaścāgatāstatra saṃbhramāḥ ।
kaṃsārikā'pi cāyātā bālaṃ draṣṭuṃ suharṣitā ।।69।।
sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bālaḥ pippalādo hi yogirāṭ ।
jajāpa paramaṃ mantraṃ pippalaskandhamāśritaḥ ।।1.507.70।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
śrutvā kaṃsārikā putraṃ prārthayāmāsa mānase ।।71 ।।
mama muktiṃ kuru putra kṛtakṛtyā bhavāmi ca ।
vṛthā vai lokanindāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ me na yad bhavet ।।72।।
putraḥ sasmāra ca jñātvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
āyayau śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vimānaśobhitaḥ ।।73।।
kaṃsārikā sutaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasyatha cucumba ca ।
stanyaṃ dadau tatastena varṣmaṇā divyatāṃ gatā ।।74।।
tenaiva divyadehena vimānavaramāsthitā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇamantraṃ gṛhītvā vaiṣṇavī tataḥ ।।75।।
sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ vyomnā golokaṃ prajagāma ha ।
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ dṛṣṭvā yājñavalkyo mahāmuniḥ ।।76।।
ṣaṣṭhīdevyā mukhāt sarvaṃ viditvā vṛttameva tat ।
niścikāya sutaṃ svasya gopayāmāsa tadvṛttam ।।77।।
yayau naijāśramaṃ putraṃ dattvā''śīrvādamuttamam ।
kasyacittvatha kālasya nārado munisattamaḥ ।।78।।।
nirgatastena mārgeṇa dṛṣṭvā sūryābhabālakam ।
papraccha vismayā''viṣṭa ekākī ko bhavāniha ।।79।।
kva te mātā pitā cāpi kimarthaṃ tviha tiṣṭhasi ।
nivatsyasi kathaṃ cātra sarvaṃ me vistarād vada ।।1.507.80।।
pippalāda uvācainaṃ kā mātā kaḥ pitā mataḥ ।
nāradaḥ prāha garbhasya dhāriṇī janmadāyinī ।।81।।
kṣetraṃ mātā matā bījādhāyakastu pitā mataḥ ।
bālaḥ prāhā'jñabālasya bhānaṃ kṣetrasya vai katham ।।।82।।
bījasyāpi kathaṃ bhānaṃ pitrorbhānaṃ tu bāndhavaiḥ ।
na ca me bāndhavāḥ santi vṛkṣo'yaṃ me samāśrayaḥ ।।83।।
pippalo'yaṃ pitā me'sti ṣaṣṭhī manasā mātṛkā ।
ityevamātraṃ saṃvedmi vada māṃ ko bhavāniha ।।84।।
nāradastu tadā prāha yājñavalkyasya retasā ।
kaṃsārikāyāṃ jāto'si pitarau te tato matau ।।85।।
bālaḥ prāha kathaṃ cātra tiṣṭhāmīti vadā'tra me ।
nāradaścāha devānāṃ gurustvaṃ vai bṛhaspatiḥ ।।86।।
utathyabhāryāsaṃhartā utathyaśāpadoṣataḥ ।
jāto'syatra bālarūpaḥ pippalādo mahāmuniḥ ।।87।।
atharvavedo yaścaiṣaḥ śataśākho'sti mānave ।
śatakalpaśca gūḍhārtho rājñāmadhyayanāya vai ।।88।।
navaśākhaḥ pañcakalpaḥ prasannārthasukhāgamaḥ ।
tvayā samyak pariṣkṛto vyākhyātaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।।89।।
tadarthaṃ te'tra janmā'sti mātā te mokṣaṇaṃ gatā ।
pitā te yājñavalkyo'sti tatpārśvaṃ tvamito vraja ।।1.507.90।।
ahaṃ vai nāradaścā'smi brahmaputraḥ suvaiṣṇavaḥ ।
gṛhāṇa vaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ mālāṃ ca tulasīkṛtām ।।91 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
ityuktvā pradadau mantraṃ mālāṃ cāpi dadau ca tam ।।92।।
bālaḥ prāha vane vāsaḥ kathaṃ me duḥkhahetukaḥ ।
kathaṃ mātṛviyogo me vadā'tra kāraṇaṃ mune ।।93।।
nāradaḥ prāha janmasthaḥ śaniste tena cedṛśīm ।
avasthāṃ tvaṃ gato'sīti nānyat tatra hi kāraṇam ।।94।।
bālaḥ śrutvā ruṣā cordhvaṃ taṃ dadarśa śanaiścaram ।
tasya dṛṣṭinipātena nyapatat tatkṣaṇācchaniḥ ।।95।।
nāradaśca śaniṃ prāha mā tvaṃ vīkṣaya bālakam ।
hāniṃ viśeṣataste'yaṃ kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।।96।।
bālaṃ prāha prakopaṃ tvaṃ saṃharā'tra śanaiścare ।
grahā gāvo narendrāśca santaśca brāhmaṇāstathā ।।97।।
pūjitāḥ pratipūjyante nirdahantyavamānitāḥ ।
śaninā vīkṣitau svasya pādau janmakṣaṇe tadā ।।98।।
dagdhāvubhau tataścā'nyaṃ bhasmarāśiṃ karotyayam ।
yadi paśyati netrābhyāṃ tādṛśo raudranetrakaḥ ।।99।।
pūjanīyo na ca bāla! hyavamānyaḥ kadācana ।
śrutvaivaṃ pippalādaḥ saḥ stutiṃ cakre śubhāvahām ।। 1.507.100 ।।
namaste krūranetrāya piṃgalāya namo'stu te ।
namaste kṛṣṇavarṇāya bhasmakartre namo'stu te ।। 101 ।।
namaste raudradehāya sauraye te namonamaḥ ।
namaste mandavārāya śanaiścara namo'stu te ।। 1 02।।
śrutvā stutiṃ śaniḥ prāha parituṣṭo'smi sarvathā ।
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te mamāpi bhadramastu ca ।। 1 03।।
pippalādo varaṃ vavre bālānāṃ pīḍanaṃ tvayā ।
adyaprabhṛti vai kvāpi na kāryaṃ dehi me varam ।।1 04।।
yāvadaṣṭatamaṃ varṣaṃ bāle te pīḍanaṃ nahi ।
stotuḥ pīḍā na te'pyastu vāre pūjayituśca te ।। 1 05।।
tathā te na ca pīḍā'stu tailābhyaṃgavidhāyinaḥ ।
yastvāṃ lohamayaṃ kṛtvā tailamadhye tvadhomukham ।। 1 06।।
dhārayet tena tailena tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ।
tasya pīḍā na kartavyā deyo lābho mahībhuje ।। 1 07।।
sārdhasaptī tava yasya sa tilān lohasaṃyutān ।
dadāti tava vāre yastasya kāryaṃ na pīḍanam ।। 1 08।।
kṛṣṇagodānakartuśca kāryaṃ na pīḍanaṃ tvayā ।
śamīsamidbhirhomasya kartuste mā'stu pīḍanam ।। 1 09।।
kṛṣṇapuṣpānulepaiśca kṛṣṇatilaiśca guggulaiḥ ।
kṛṣṇavastraiśca te pūjākarturmā'stu prapīḍanam ।। 1.507.11 0।।।
evamuktaḥ śanistena bāḍhamuktvā tataḥ param ।
bālaṃ hyuvāca gatyarthaṃ punarna patanaṃ yathā ।। 111 ।।
bālaḥ prāha yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ gaccha saurya nijālayam ।
ityuktaḥ sa yayau svargaṃ nārado bālakena ca ।। 112।
pūjitaśca yayau satyalokaṃ tataḥ sa bālakaḥ ।
ṣaṣṭhīdevyā samānīto yājñavalkyasya sannidhau ।। 1 13।।
arpitaścopanītaśca yājñavalkyena bālakaḥ ।
pippalādaścamatkārī yogīndro vedavidṛṣiḥ ।। 1 14।।
samabhavanmahāvīryo lokakalyāṇakārakaḥ ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! vṛttaṃ pāpavināśanam ।। 1 15।।
yaścaitatpuṇyamākhyānaṃ paṭhedvā śṛṇuyācca vā ।
agamyāgamanaṃ pāpaṃ śamaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ ।। 116 ।।
upasargabhaye jāte tasya caughaḥ praśāmyati ।
śanaiḥ śanairasandigdhaṃ pippalādavacobalāt ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sābhramatyā utpattiḥ, yājñavalkyasya bhaginyāṃ pippalādotpattiḥ, bṛhaspatiḥ pippalādo jātaḥ, śanaiścarapūjādicetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।507।।


← adhyāyaḥ 507 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 508
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 509 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tvayā pūrvaṃ gaurī vai pañcapiṇḍikā ।
pūjitā tena saṃlabdhaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ।। 1 ।।
gauryā darśanamātreṇa nārī saubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।
jyeṣṭhe śukle vṛṣabhasthe ravau tāṃ jalamarpayet ।। 2 ।।
jalamantreṇa yā nityaṃ sā saubhāgyaṃ śubhaṃ labhet ।
na sā vandhyā pratiṣṭheta kākavandhyā'pi naiva ca ।। 3 ।।
na daurbhāgyaṃ labhet kvāpi saptajanmāntarāṇi ca ।
pṛthivyāpaśca tejaśca vāyurākāśamityapi ।। 4 ।।
pañcabhiḥ racayed gaurīṃ sā proktā pañcapiṇḍikā ।
sahasraguṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ pañcapiṇḍāprapūjane ।। 5 ।।
kāśīrājaḥ purā cāsījjayasenaḥ pratāpavān ।
tasya patnīsahasraṃ tu hyāsīt tatra priyottamā ।। 6 ।।
amānāmnī madrarājaviśvaksenasutā'bhavat ।
amā prage samutthāya snātvā gaṃgātaṭe śubhām ।। 7 ।।
pañcapiṇḍātmikāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā kardamasaṃbhavām ।
tataḥ sampūjayāmāsa satī ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ।। 8 ।।
tato visṛjya tāṃ devīṃ datvā dānāni sā gṛham ।
prayātyeva sma sadā ca saubhāgyaṃ vardhate sadā ।। 9 ।।
rūpaṃ ca yauvanaṃ kāntaprītiśca dhanyamānyatā ।
vardhante'syā vilokyaitat sapatnyo duḥkhitāstadā ।। 1.508.1 0।।
tanmūlaṃ pūjanaṃ gauryā jñātvā draṣṭuṃ ca tā yayuḥ ।
yatra pūjayati gaurīṃ sā kṛtvā pañcapiṇḍikām ।। 11 ।।
amā cotthāya tāstatra mānayitvā''sanaṃ dadau ।
tāḥ papracchuramāṃ nityasaubhāgyavṛddhikāraṇam ।। 12।
amā prasannamanasā sapatnīḥ prāha pūrvakṛt ।
ahamāsaṃ purā śūdrā vīrasenasya kanyakā ।। 13।।
kusume nagare cāpi vivāho me'bhavat tadā ।
vipramukhānmayā gaurīpūjā saubhāgyadā śrutā ।। 14।।
gaurīpūjāṃ vinā kvāpi pātavyaṃ na jalaṃ tvapi ।
yena saṃprāpyate'bhīṣṭaṃ pūjā puṇyena cepsitam ।। 15।।
tatastatra janau pūjā kṛtā mayā tu nityadā ।
pūjayitvā piṇḍagaurīṃ prakṣipāmi jale sadā ।। 16 ।।
atha kāntaśca me yātastīrthārthaṃ dvārikāṃ prati ।
saha nītvā ca māṃ prāpto nirjalaṃ marumaṇḍalam ।। 17।।
sūryastapati raudre ca vṛṣasthe'titṛṣāprade ।
sārthastṛṣāturo jāto jalaṃ marumarīcijam ।। 18 ।।
mṛṣā vai dṛśyate satyaṃ jalaṃ prāptaṃ na tatsthale ।
ahaṃ tṛṣākulā jātā smṛtā gaurī mayā tadā ।। 1 9।।
pañcabhirmuṣṭibhistaptavālukābhiḥ sunirmitā ।
gaurī prapūjitā vācā hṛdā tato mṛtā hyaham ।।1.508.20।।
tatpuṇyena daśārṇādhipateḥ kanyā'bhavaṃ śubhā ।
bhavatīnāṃ kaniṣṭhā'smi jyeṣṭhā'smi gaurikārcanāt ।।21 ।।
jātismarā'smi saṃjātā tatsmṛtvā cātra nityadā ।
pūjayāmi kardamena kṛtvā tāṃ pañcapiṇḍikām ।।22।
tenā'tra vardhate nityaṃ saubhāgyaṃ vividhaṃ mama ।
puṇyaṃ ca vardhate divyaṃ divyabhāvapradāyakam ।।23।
sarvā mama bhaginyaḥ stha īrṣyādharmo na me'sti ca ।
pūjayantu bhavatyo'pi saubhāgyaṃ lapsyatha dhruvam ।।24।
satyenā'nena me gaurī mamā'bhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatu ।
prayacchatu bhavatīnāmabhīṣṭaṃ sā harapriyā ।।25।
ityuktāstāḥ sapatnyaśca pupūjurgaurikāṃ tataḥ ।
pūjāmantrāstayā sādhvyā dattāstābhyaśca tatkṣaṇe ।।26।
ye tvayā tu mahālakṣmi hyuccāritāḥ purā'rcane ।
namaḥpṛthivyai kṣāntīśi nama āpomaye śubhe ।। 27.
tejasvini namastubhyaṃ namaste vāyurūpiṇa ।
ākāśarūpasampanne pañcarūpe namonamaḥ ।।28
ebhirmantraistvayā lakṣmi pūjitā pañcapiṇḍikā ।
tena vaikuṇṭharājyaṃ tvaṃ prāptavatī sudurlabham ।।29
evaṃ yā pūjayennārī gaurikāṃ pañcapiṇḍikām ।
ṣoḍaśopakaraṇaiḥ sā sadyaḥ syāt pativallabhā ।।1.508.3 0
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataścāmā cintayāmāsa vai hṛdi ।
saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labdhaṃ durlabhaṃ sarvayoṣitām ।।31
na cā'patyaṃ mama jātaṃ tena dahyāmi vai muhuḥ ।
athaivaṃ vartamānāyāṃ durvāsāścāyayau drutam ।।32
jayaseno nṛpaścake svāgataṃ cāsanaṃ dadau ।
datvā'rghaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca tataḥ papraccha taṃ munim ।। 33
śiṣyaṃ kṛtvā kṛpāpātraṃ pavitrīkṛtavānasi ।
adya dhanyatamo jātaḥ sakuṭumbastavā''gamāt ।। 34
tad brūhi kiṃ karomyadya gṛhā''yātasya te mune ।
durvāsāḥ prāha rājaँste mandire saṃvasannaham ।।35
cāturmāsyavidhānaṃ saṃkariṣye sukhapūrvakam ।
mṛttikāgrahaṇaṃ yāvacchuśrūṣā kriyatāṃ mama ।।36'
bāḍhamityevamuktvā tacchuśrūṣā kṛtavānnṛpaḥ ।
amā nityaṃ susevāyāṃ vartate'ti nṛpājñayā ।।37
cāturmāsyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ yadā saṃprasthito muniḥ ।
tadā provāca santuṣṭo rājan kiṃ karavāṇi te ।।38
rājñā sa ṛṣirāṭ proktaścāmā'patyaṃ vinā mune ।
dahatyeva sadā tasmāt kuru tāṃ putramātaram ।। 39 ।।
muniḥ prāha śṛṇu kṣmeśa tvayaṃ vai pūrvajanmani ।
mṛtyukāle taptavālukānāṃ gaurīṃ vidhāya tām । । 1.508.40 । ।
pūjayāmāsa tenātra rājyaṃ prāptavatī satī ।
gaurī yattāpasaṃyuktavālukābhiḥ kṛtā'nayā ।। 41 ।।
tatphalaṃ ca vinā putramudvego'syā hi sarvadā ।
na devo vidyate kāṣṭhe pāṣāṇe mṛttikāsu ca ।। 42 । ।
bhāve hi vidyate devo mantrabhaktyādibhiryute ।
saiṣā gaurīṃ kardamena kṛtvā vai pañcapiṇḍikām । । 43 ।।
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre gatvā saṃpūjayed yadi ।
vṛṣasthe bhāskare dadyājjaladhārāmakhaṇḍitām ।। 44।।
tataḥ kṣetrabalāccāpi puṇyodayo bhaviṣyati ।
yathā yathā jalād gauryāḥ śītabhāvo bhaviṣyati ।। 45। ।
tathā tathā'syā dāho'pi śāntiṃ yāsyatyaharniśam ।
dāhānte bhavitā garbhastataḥ putramavāpsyati ।। 46 ।।
athā'sti ca vrataṃ puṇyaṃ gaurītuṣṭikaraṃ param ।
yena cīrṇena vai nārī devatātvamavāpnuyāt ।। 47।।
gomayākhyā mahādevī kartavyā gomayena vai ।
bhādre kṛṣṇe tṛtīyāyāṃ prātardantān viśodhayet ।।48 ।।
upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyād gaurikāṃ smaran ।
niśāgame mṛnmayaṃ vai kāryaṃ gaurīcatuṣṭayam ।। 49 ।।
ekā gaurī prakartavyā pañcapiṇḍā yathoditā ।
prahare prahare prāpte tāsu pūjāṃ samācaret ।। 1.508.50 ।।
himācalagṛhe jātā devi tvaṃ śaṃkarapriye ।
menāgarbhasamudbhūtā pūjāṃ gṛhāṇa te namaḥ । । 51 । ।
dhūpaṃ karpūrakaṃ raktavartikaṃ ghṛtadīpakam ।
jātīpuṣpāṇi naivedyaṃ modakānarghamarpayet ।। 5 2 ।।
mātuluṅgakusumāḍhyamarghaṃ gṛhāṇa te namaḥ ।
dvitīye praharānte'rdhanārīśvarīṃ prapūjayet। ।। 53 ।।
agurucandanaṃ dhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ guḍamarghakam ।
dadennārīkerayuktamarghaṃ vai mantratastadā ।। 54। ।
argho me gṛhyatāṃ devau pārvatīparameśvarau ।
tṛtīye prahare prāpte śatapatryā prapūjayet ।। 55 ।।
gugguladhūpaṃ naivedyaṃ sajātīsalilārghakam ।
granthicūrṇena dhūpaṃ ca svarghaṃ madanajaṃ phalam ।। 56 ।।
dadyātpunastataḥ prāpte caturthe prahare tvatha ।
gaurīṃ tāṃ pañcapiṇḍāṃ vai bhṛṃgarājena pūjayet । । 57 ।।
pañcabhūtamayī gaurī gṛhṇātvarghaṃ mayā'rpitam ।
naivedyaṃ dhūpadīpādi puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet ।।58।।
kuryānnīrājanaṃ sveṣṭaprārthanāṃ jāgaraṃ caret ।
nṛtyaṃ vādyaṃ kīrtanaṃ sotsavaṃ kuryāt prayatnataḥ ।।59।।
prabhāte viprayugalaṃ snātvā prapūjayed vratī ।
kareṇuṃ vaḍavāṃ vā''rohayed gaurīcatuṣṭayam ।।1.508.60।।
savādyotsavaśabdena nadyādau tāṃ parikṣipet ।
āhūtā'si mayā devī pūjitā'si mayā śubhe ।।6 1।।
mama saubhāgyadānāya yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāmiti ।
evaṃ lakṣmyā kṛtā pūrvaṃ pūjā gauryā viśeṣataḥ ।।62।।
bhādrakṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ caturṣu prahareṣu ca ।
prātargauryaṃstayā dṛṣṭā ratnaprabhāvibhūṣitāḥ ।।6 3।।
tāścocustāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ mā no jale pravāhaya ।
mandiraṃ kārayitvā'tra hāṭakeśvarakṣetrake ।।64।।
sthāpayā'smān vratārthaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ sukhakāriṇīḥ ।
iti tāḥ sthāpitāstatra lakṣmyā bhāgyasutapradāḥ ।।65 ।।
seyaṃ rājaँstava patnī gaurīcatuṣṭayaṃ tathā ।
gaurīṃ ca gomayīṃ cāpi pañcapiṇḍātmikāṃ tathā ।।66 ।।
kṛtvā saṃpūjayet tena putrasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt ।
tathā prāpyeta ca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ svayam ।।67।।
ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ durvāsāścātha sā satī ।
amānāmnī yayau kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ।।68।।
kṛtvā sarvaṃ vidhānena babhūva putramātṛkā ।
bahukālottare cā'mā lakṣmīrūpā babhūva ha ।।6 9।।
divyadehā gatā viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhe dāsikā'bhavat ।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi tavā'māyāśca tadvratam ।।1.508.70।।
yā tvetatpaṭhate bhaktyā gaurīpūjāphalaṃ labhet ।
na sā lakṣmyā viyujyeta na ca daurbhāgyamāpnuyāt ।।71 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kāśīrājapatnyā amayā kṛtaṃ pañcapiṇḍikāgaurīvrataṃ tena putrasaubhāgyaprāptirlakṣmītvaprāptiścetinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭā'dhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 508 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 508 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 509
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 510 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmyaikadā satye brahmāṇaṃ prati nāradaḥ ।
darśanārthaṃ yayau bhrāntvā lokatrayaṃ nanāma tam ।। 1 ।।
brahmā papraccha ca kutaḥ putra āgamyate, vada ।
nāradaḥ prāha martyānāṃ maṇḍalāni vilokya ca ।। 2 ।।
tava pūjāvidhānāya vijñāpayituṃ hṛdgatam ।
samāgato'smi ca pitaḥ śrutvā kuru yathocitam ।। 3 ।।
daityānāṃ hi balaṃ loke sarvatrā'sti pravartitam ।
yajñāśca satyadharmāśca satkarmāṇi ca sarvathā ।। 4 ।।
prasahya tairvināśyante devā bhaktāśca duḥkhinaḥ ।
tasmād yatheṣṭaṃ bhagavan kalyāṇaṃ kartumarhasi ।। 5 ।।
ityevaṃ vinivedyaiva natvā sampūjya saṃyayau ।
brahmā vai cintayāmāsa yajñārthaṃ śubhabhūtalam ।। 6 ।।
nirvighnaṃ tatsthalaṃ kvāstītyājñātuṃ padmapuṣpakam ।
karasthaṃ sa samuvāca pata sthale tu pāvane ।। 7 ।।
tataścikṣepa puṣpaṃ tad bhrāntvā lokān samantataḥ ।
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sampapāta supāvane ।। 8 ।।
etasminnantare prāptaḥ paścāt tasya pitāmahaḥ ।
kṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā prasanno'bhūd yajñārthaṃ prapitāmahaḥ ।। 9 ।।
ādideśa tato vāyuṃ samānaya purandaram ।
ādityairvasubhiḥ sārdhaṃ rudraiścaiva marudgaṇaiḥ ।। 1.509.10 ।।
gandharvairlokapālaiśca siddhairvidyādharaistathā ।
ye ca me syuḥ sahāyāstaiḥ samaste yajñakarmaṇi ।। 11 ।।
vāyuścendraṃ devagaṇairyutaṃ samānināya ca ।
brahmā prāha mahendraṃ ca vaiśākhyāmagniṣṭomakam ।। 1 2।।
yajñaṃ kartuṃ samīhe'tra sambhārānāharasva vai ।
brāhmaṇāँśca tadarhān vai yogyopaskārakāँstathā ।। 1 3।।
indrastānānayāmāsa saṃbhārāँśca dvijottamān ।
ārebhe ca tato yajñaṃ vidhivat prapitāmahaḥ ।। 14।।
śaṃbhurdevagaṇaiḥ sārdha tatra yajñe samāgataḥ ।
devān brahmā samuvāca svasvasthāneṣu tiṣṭhata ।। 15।।
viśvakarman kuru yajñamaṇḍapaṃ yajñavedikāḥ ।
patnīśālāḥ sadaścāpi kuṇḍānyāvaśyakāni ca ।। 66।।
yajñapātrāṇi ca gṛhān camasāँśca caṣālakān ।
yūpān śayanagartāṃśca sthaṇḍilāni prakāraya ।।17।।
hiraṇmayaṃ supuruṣaṃ kāraya tvaṃ surūpiṇām ।
bṛhaspate tvamānīhi yajñārhānṛtvijo'khilān ।। 18।।
yāvat ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyākān śuśrūṣāṃ kuru devarāḍ ।
kubera ca tvayā deyā dakṣiṇā kālasaṃbhavā ।।1 9।।
tvayā vidhe vidhau kāryaṃ kṛtyā'kṛtyaparīkṣaṇam ।
lokapālāḥ prarakṣantu tvaindryādikā diśastathā ।।।1.509.20।।।
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ praveśo daityarakṣasām ।
mā bhūdityatha yajñena dīyatāṃ dānamuttamam ।।21 ।।
ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ ।
bhavantu pariveṣṭāro bhoktukāmajanasya tu ।।22।।
yajñārhā brāhmaṇā vṛttāstiṣṭhantu yajñamaṇḍape ।
maitrāvaruṇaścyavano'tharvāko gālavastathā ।।23।।
marīcirmārkavaścaite sarvakarmaviśāradāḥ ।
prasthānakartā cādhvaryuḥ pulastyastatra tiṣṭhatu ।।24।।
raibhyo munistathonnetā tiṣṭhatu yajñamaṇḍape ।
brahmā bhavatu nārado gargo'stu satravīkṣakaḥ ।। 25।।
hotāro'gnīdhrabharadvājaparāśarāstrayaḥ ।
bṛhaspatistathā''cārya udgātā gobhilo muniḥ ।।26।।
śāṇḍilyaḥ pratihartā ca subrahmaṇyastathā'ṅgirāḥ ।
asya yajñasya siddhyarthaṃ santvṛtvijastu ṣoḍaśa ।।27।।
brahmā tān pūjayāmāsa dīkṣitastaistu viśvasṛṭ ।
yajamāno'bhavad yajñakāryaṃ tataḥ pravartitam ।।28।।
brahmā ca nāradaṃ prāha sāvitrīṃ kṣipramānaya ।
vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu siddhakinnaraguhyakaiḥ ।।29।।।
gandharvairvādyasaṃyuktairuccāraṇaparairdvijaiḥ ।
araṇiṃ samupādāya pulastyo vākyamabravīt ।।1.509.3 0।।।
patnīpatnītiviprendrāḥ proccaistatra vyavasthitaḥ ।
brahmā punarnāradaṃ saṃjñayā karasya vai drutam ।।3 1 ।।
gṛhaṃ sampreṣayāmāsa patnī cānīyatāmiti ।
so'pi gatvā''ha sāvitrīṃ pitrā sampreṣito'smyaham ।।32।।
āgaccha maṇḍapaṃ devi yajñakāryaṃ pravartate ।
paramekākinī kīdṛgrūpā sadasi dṛśyase ।।33।।
ānīyantāṃ tato devyastābhirvṛttā prayāsyasi ।
ityuktvā prayayau yajñe nārado'jamuvāca ha ।।34।।
devībhiḥ saha sāvitrī samāyāsyati sukṣaṇam ।
punastaṃ preṣayāmāsa brahmā'tha nārado yayau ।।35।।
mātaḥ śīghraṃ samāyāhi devībhiḥ parivāritā ।
sāvitryapi tadā prāha yāmi keśān prasādhya vai ।।36।।
nārado'jaṃ prāha keśān prasādhyā''yāti vai tataḥ ।
somapānamuhūrtasyā'vaśeṣe satvaraṃ tadā ।। 37 ।।
pulastyaśca yayau tatra sāvitrī tvekalā'sti hi ।
kiṃ devi sālasā bhāsi gaccha śīghraṃ kratoḥ sthalam ।।38।।
sāvitryuvāca taṃ brūhi muhūrtaṃ paripālyatām ।
yāvadabhyeti śakrāṇī gaurī lakṣmīstathā'parāḥ ।।39।।
devakanyāḥ samāje'tra tābhireṣyāmi saṃhitā ।
so'pi gatvā drutaṃ prāha somabhārā'rditaṃ vidhim ।।1.509.40।।
sā māṃ prāha ca devībhiḥ sahitā''yāmi vai makhe ।
ahaṃ yāsyāmi sahitā na tvekalā kathaṃcana ।।41 ।।
evaṃ jñātvā suraśreṣṭha kuru yatte surocate ।
atikrāmati kālaśca yajñapānakṣaṇātmakaḥ ।।42।।
śrutvā brahmā mahendraṃ ca prāha sā śithilātmikā ।
nā''yātyevā'nyayā patnyā yajñaḥ kāryo bhavatviti ।।43।।
brahmājñayā bhramamāṇāṃ kanyāṃ kāṃcit sureśvaraḥ ।
candrāsyāṃ gopajāṃ tanvīṃ kalaśavyagramastakām ।।44।।
yuvatīṃ sukumārīṃ ca papraccha kā'si kanyake ।
gopakanyeti sā prāha takraṃ vikretumāgatā ।।45।।
parigṛhṇāsi cet takraṃ dehi mūlyaṃ drutaṃ mama ।
indro jagrāha tāṃ takrasahitāṃ gopakanyakām ।।46।।
gorvaktreṇā''veśayitvā mūtreṇā''karṣayat tataḥ ।
evaṃ medhyatamāṃ kṛtvā saṃsnāpya salilaiḥ śubhaiḥ ।।47।।
suvāsasī dhārayitvā nītvā dhṛtvā'jasannidhau ।
ānīteyaṃ tvadarthaṃ vai brahman sarvaguṇānvitā ।।48।।
gavāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kulamekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam ।
ekatra mantrastiṣṭhanti havirekatra tiṣṭhati ।।49।।
gorudarād viniṣkrāntā prāpiteyaṃ dvijanmatām ।
pāṇigrahaṃ kuruṣvāsyā yajñapānaṃ samācara ।।1.509.50 ।।
rudraḥ prāha ca goyantraniṣkrānteyaṃ tataḥ khalu ।
gāyatrīnāmapatnī te bhavatvatra makhe sadā ।।51 ।।
brāhmaṇāstu tadā prāhureṣā'stu brāhmaṇīvarā ।
gopajātivarjitāyāstvaṃ pāṇigrahaṇaṃ kuru ।।52।।
brahmā pāṇigrahaṃ cakre samārebhe śubhakriyām ।
gāyatryapi samādāya mūrdhni tāmaraṇiṃ mudā ।।53।।
vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu samprāptā yajñamaṇḍapam ।
vidhiścakre svakeśānāṃ kṣaurakarma tataḥ param ।।54।।
viśvakarmā tu gāyatrīnakhacchedaṃ cakāra ha ।
audumbaraṃ tato daṇḍaṃ paulastyo brahmaṇe dadau ।।55।।
eṇaśṛṃgānvitaṃ carma samantraṃ pradadau tathā ।
patnīṃ śālāṃ gṛhītvā ca gāyatrīṃ maunadhāriṇīm ।।56।।
mekhalāṃ nidadhe tvanyāṃ kaṭyāṃ mauñjīmayīṃ śubhām ।
tato brahmā ca ṛtvigbhiḥ saha cakre kratukriyām ।।57।।
karmaṇi jāyamāne ca tatrā''ścaryamabhūnmahat ।
jālmarūpadharaḥ kaścid digvāsā vikṛtānanaḥ ।। 58।।
kapālapāṇirāyāto bhojanaṃ dīyatāmiti ।
niṣidhyamāno'pi vipraiḥ praviṣṭo yajñamaṇḍapam ।।59।।
sadasyāstu tiraścakruḥ kastvaṃ pāpaḥ samāgataḥ ।
kapālī nagnarūpaścā'pavitrakharparānvitaḥ ।।1.509.6 0।।
yajñabhūmiraśuddhā syād gaccha śīghramito bahiḥ ।
jālmaḥ prāha kathaṃ cāsmi hyaśuddho bhikṣuko vratī ।।61 ।।
brahmayajñamimaṃ jñātvā śuddhaḥ snātvā samāgataḥ ।
gopālakanyā nityaṃ yā śūdrī tvaśuddhajātikā ।।62।।
sthāpitā'tra nu sā śuddhā vipro'haṃ pāvano na kim ।
tāvat tatra samāyāto brāhmaṇo vṛddharūpavān ।।63।।
śrīkṛṣṇo vai tamuvāca pratyuttaraṃ śṛṇu priye ।
jālma naiṣā'sti śūdrāṇī brāhmaṇī jātito'sti vai ।।64।।
śṛṇu jānāmi tadvṛttaṃ nānye jānantyatadvidaḥ ।
purā sṛṣṭe samārambhe śrīkṛṣṇena parātmanā ।।65।।
svāṃśarūpā hi sāvitrī svamūrteḥ prakaṭīkṛtā ।
atha dvitīyā kanyā ca pativratā'bhidhā kṛtā ।।66।।
kumāraśca kṛtaḥ patnīvratākhyo brāhmaṇastataḥ ।
brahmā vairājadehācca kṛtastasmai samarpitā ।।67।।
sāvitrī śrīhariṇaiva goloke eva sannidhau ।
atha yajñapravāhārthaṃ brahmā yajñaṃ kariṣyati ।।68।।
pṛthivyāṃ martyarūpeṇa tatra mānuṣavigrahā ।
patnī yajñasya kāryārthamapekṣitā bhaviṣyati ।।69।।
hetunā'nena kṛṣṇena sāvitryājñāpitā tadā ।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa tvayā gantavyameva ha ।।1.509.70।।
prāgeva bhūtale kanyārūpeṇa brahmaṇaḥ kṛte ।
sāvitrī śrīkṛṣṇamāha kau tatra pitarau mama ।।7 1 ।।
śrīkṛṣṇastāṃ tadā sandarśayāmāsa śubhau tu tau ।
imau patnīvrato vipro viprāṇī ca pativratā ।।72।।
madaṃśau matsvarūpau cā'yonijau divyavigrahau ।
pṛthvyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vai kṣetre'śvapaṭṭasārase ।।73 ।।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe viprarūpau vartiṣyete'tipāvanau ।
vaiśvadevādiyajñādihavyādyarthaṃ gavānvitau ।।74।।
saurāṣṭre ca yadā brahmā yajñārthaṃ saṃgamiṣyati ।
tatpūrvaṃ tau gobhilaśca gobhilā ceti saṃjñitā ।।72।।
gavā prapālakau bhūtvā''nartadeśe gamiṣyataḥ ।
yatrā''bhīrā nivasanti tatsamau veṣakarmabhiḥ ।।76।।
daityakṛtārdanaṃ tena pracchannayorna vai bhavet ।
itiḥhetoryajñapūrvaṃ daityakleśabhiyā tu tau ।।77।।
śrīharerājñayā''narte jātāvābhīrarūpiṇau ।
gavāṃ vai pālakau viprau pitarau ca tvayā hi tau ।।78।।
kartavyau gopaveṣau vai vastuto brāhmaṇāvubhau ।
madaṃśau tatra sāvitri! tvayā dvitīyarūpataḥ ।।79।।
ayonijatayā putryā bhāvyaṃ vai divyayoṣitā ।
dadhidugdhādivikretryā gantavyaṃ tatsthale tadā ।।1.509.80।।
yadā yajño bhavet tatra tadā smṛtvā suyogataḥ ।
mānuṣyā tu tvayā nūtnavadhvā kratuṃ kariṣyati ।।81 ।।
sahabhāvaṃ gato brahmā gāyatrī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
brāhmaṇayoḥ sutā gūḍhā gopamadhyanivāsinoḥ ।।82।।।
brahmāṇī ca tato bhūtvā satyalokaṃ gamiṣyasi ।
brāhmaṇāstvāṃ japiṣyanti martyalokagatāstataḥ ।।83।।
ityevaṃ jāyamānaiṣā gāyatrī brāhmaṇī sutā ।
vartate gopaveṣīyā nā'śuddhā jātito hi sā ।।84।।
evaṃ pratyuttaritaḥ sa jālmaḥ kṛṣṇena vai tadā ।
tāvat tatra samāyātau gobhilāgobhilau mudā ।।85।।
asmatputryā mahadbhāgyaṃ brahmaṇā yā vivāhitā ।
āvayostu mahadbhāgyaṃ daityakaṣṭaṃ nivāryate ।।86।।
yajñadvāreṇa devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ satāṃ tathā ।
ityuktvā tau gopaveṣau tyaktvā brāhmaṇarūpiṇau ।।87।।
pitāmahau hi viprāṇāṃ paricitau mahātmanām ।
sarveṣāṃ pūrvajau tatra jātau divyau ca bhūsurau ।।88।।
brahmādyāśca tadā nemuścakruḥ satkāramādarāt ।
yajñe ca sthāpayāmāsuḥ sarvaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ surādayaḥ ।।89।।
brahmāṇaṃ mālayā kuṃkumākṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ ।
vardhayitvā sutāṃ tatra dadaturyajñamaṇḍape ।। 1.509.90।।
vṛddho vai brāhmaṇastatra kṛṣṇarūpaṃ dadhāra ha ।
sarvaiśca vanditaḥ sādhu sādhvityāhuḥ surādayaḥ ।।91 ।।
jālmaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā gāyatrīpitarau tathā ।
dṛṣṭvā nanāma bhāvena prāha bhikṣāṃ pradehi me ।।92।।
bubhukṣito'smi viprendrā garhayantu na māṃ dvijāḥ ।
dīnāndhaiḥ kṛpaṇaiḥ sarvaistarpitairiṣṭirucyate ।। 93 ।।
anyathā syādvināśāya kraturyuṣmatkṛto'pyayam ।
annahīno dahed rāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnastu ṛtvijaḥ ।।94।।
yājñikaṃ dakṣiṇāhīno nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇaśca tadā prāha jālme dadatu bhojanam ।।95।।
viprāḥ prāhuḥ khapparaṃ te tvaśuddhaṃ vidyate tataḥ ।
bahirniḥsara dāsyāmo bhikṣāṃ pārśvamahānase ।।96।।
etasyāmannaśālāyāṃ bhuñjanti yatra tāpasāḥ ।
dīnāndhāḥ kṛpaṇāścaiva tathā kṣutkṣāmakā dvijāḥ ।।97।।
aśuddhaṃ te kapālaṃ vai yajñabhūmerbahirnaya ।
gṛhāṇā'nyacchuddhapātraṃ dūraṃ prakṣipya khapparam ।।98।।
evamuktaśca jālmaḥ sa roṣāccikṣepa khapparam ।
yajñamaṇḍapamadhye ca svayaṃ tvadṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।99।।
sarvepyāścaryamāpannā viprā daṇḍena khapparam ।
cikṣipustadbahistāvad dvitīyaṃ samapadyata ।। 1.509.10 0।।
tasminnapi parikṣipte tṛtīyaṃ samapadyata ।
evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi samapadyanta vai tadā ।। 101 ।।
pariśrāntā brāhmaṇāśca yajñavāṭaḥ sakhapparaḥ ।
samantatastadā jāto hāhākaro hi sarvataḥ ।। 1 02।।
brahmā vai prārthayāmāsa sannatvā tāṃ diśaṃ muhuḥ ।
kimidaṃ yujyate deva yajñe'smin karmaṇaḥ kṣatiḥ ।। 103 ।।
tasmāt saṃhara sarvāṇi kapālāni maheśvara ।
yajñakarmavilopo'yaṃ mā bhūt tvayi samāgate ।। 1 04।।
tataḥ śabdo'bhavad vyomnaḥ pātraṃ me medhyamasti vai ।
bhuktipātraṃ mama tvete kathaṃ nindanti bhūsurāḥ ।। 1 085।।
tathā na māṃ samuddiśya juhuvurjātavedasi ।
yathā'nyā devatāstadvanmantrapūtaṃ havirvidhe ।। 1 06।।
ato'tra māṃ samuddiśya viśeṣājjātavedasi ।
hotavyaṃ havirevātra samāptiṃ yāsyati kratuḥ ।। 107।।
brahmā prāha tadā pratyuttaraṃ vyomni ca taṃ prati ।
tava rūpāṇi vai yoginnasaṃkhyāni bhavanti hi ।। 1 08।।
kapālaṃ maṇḍape yāvad vartate tāvadeva ca ।
nātra camasakarma syāt khapparaṃ pātrameva na ।। 1 09।।
yajñapātraṃ na tatproktaṃ yato'śuddhaṃ sadā hi tat ।
yadrūpaṃ yādṛśaṃ pātraṃ yādṛśaṃ karmaṇaḥ sthalam ।। 1.509.11 0।।
tādṛśaṃ tatra yoktavyaṃ naitatpātrasya yojanam ।
mṛnmayeṣu kapāleṣu haviḥ pācyaṃ kratau matam ।। 111 ।।
tasmāt kapālaṃ dūraṃ vai nīyatāṃ yat kraturbhavet ।
tvayā rūpaṃ kapālin vai yādṛśaṃ cātra darśitam ।। 1 12।।
tasya rūpasya yajñe'smin puroḍāśe'dhikāritā ।
bhavatveva ca bhikṣāṃ saṃgṛhāṇa tṛptimāpnuhi ।। 11 3।।
adyaprabhṛti yajñeṣu puroḍāśātmakaṃ dvijaiḥ ।
tavoddeśena deveśa hotavyaṃ śatarudrikam ।। 1 14।।
viśeṣāt sarvayajñeṣu japyaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ ।
atra yajñaṃ samārabhya yastvā prāk pūjayiṣyati ।। 1 15।।
avighnena kratustasya samāptiṃ pravrajiṣyati ।
evamukte tadāścaryaṃ jātaṃ śṛṇu tu padmaje ।। 1 16।।
yānyāsaँśca kapālāni tāni sarvāṇi tatkṣaṇam ।
rudrāṇyaścānnapūrṇā vai devyo jātāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 1 17।।
sarvāstāḥ pārvatīrūpā annapūrṇātmikāḥ striyaḥ ।
bhikṣādātryo vinā yābhirbhikṣā naivopapadyate ।। 1 18।।।
tāvacchrīśaṃkaraścāpi prahṛṣṭaḥ pañcamastakaḥ ।
yajñamaṇḍapamāsādya saṃsthito vedisannidhau ।। 11 9।।
brāhmaṇā munayo devā namaścakrurharaṃ tathā ।
rudrāṇīḥ pūjayāmāsurārebhire kratukriyām ।। 1.509.1 20।।
sahasraśaḥ kratau devyo niṣeduḥ śivayoṣitaḥ ।
śivena sahitāścānyāḥ koṭiśo devayoṣitaḥ ।। 121 ।।
evaṃ śaṃbhuḥ kratau bhāgaṃ sthāpayāmāsa sarvadā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya yajñasya phalamāpnuyāt ।। 122।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇā yajñārthaṃ hāṭakeśvarakṣetre nāgavatyāstīre devādidvārā sasāmagrīmaṇḍapādiracanā kāritā, jālmarūpeṇa śaṃkarāgamanam, gāyatryā brāhmaṇījātīyatāvṛttāntaḥ, kapālānāṃ annapūrṇādevyātmakatvaṃ, śaṃkarasya yajñe sthānaṃ, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navā'dhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।509।।


← adhyāyaḥ 509 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 510
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 511 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi yajataśca brāhmaṇo vai kratau tadā ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ koṭirāyātā dakṣiṇāpathavāsinām ।। 1 ।।
siṃhāraṇyasthitānāṃ ca naimiṣāraṇyavāsinām ।
khaṇḍāntarasthitānāṃ ca koṭayaḥ saṃgatāstadā ।। 2 ।।
śrutvā paitāmahaṃ yajñaṃ kautukena samanvitāḥ ।
kīdṛśo bhavitā yajño dīkṣito yatra padmajaḥ ।। 3 ।।
rūpatīrthe nāganadyāṃ snātvā divyasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
ṛṣayaste yajñabhūmiṃ gatvā nemuḥ pitāmaham ।। 4 ।।
upaviṣṭāḥ pariśrāntāḥ svāgatena prapūjitāḥ ।
cakruste vai kathā divyā yajñakarmasamudbhavāḥ ।। 5 ।।
somapānasya sambandhe vādaṃ cakruḥ parasparam ।
udgātuśca tathā'dhvaryoḥ tattvavādo babhūva ca ।। 6 ।।
bhuktavantastataḥ sarve ninyurniṃśāṃ sukhena te ।
dvitīye divase prāpte dvādaśyāṃ makhakarmaṇi ।। 7 ।।
ṛtvigbhiśca samārabdhe kautukaṃ śṛṇu padmaje ।
baṭuḥ kaścinnarmakārī jalasarpaṃ sadaḥsthale ।। 8 ।।
cikṣepa prahasan śīghraṃ vidhātuḥ sannidhau tataḥ ।
ḍuṇḍubhaḥ sa bhramamāṇo hotuḥ pārśvamupāyayau ।। 9 ।।
hotāraṃ veṣṭayāmāsa bhṛguṃ tathāpi vai bhṛguḥ ।
na cacāla nijasthānāt prāyaścittabibhīṣayā ।। 1.510.1 0।।
tadodvegaśca sarveṣāṃ kṣobho manāk babhūva ha ।

tasmād bhava drutaṃ sarpaḥ śrutvā'thā''ha baṭustu tam ।

na hotāraṃ samuddiśya kasmācchāpaṃ dadāsi me ।
iti pravadan sarpatvamāpannaḥ sa kṣaṇāntare ।। 14।।
sanātanaṛṣeḥ putro baṭuḥ śuśoca vai muhuḥ ।

śaptastava sutenā'smi cyavanena mahātmanā ।। 16।।

śrutvā bhṛguḥ kṛpāviṣṭaścyavanaṃ prāha re suta! ।। 17।।
ayuktaṃ vihitaṃ tvetad yacchapto'yaṃ baṭustvayā ।

kimpunarjalasarpo'yaṃ nirviṣo rajjusannibhaḥ ।
śāpamokṣaṃ kuruṣvā'sya viprabaṭuḥ sukhībhavet ।। 1 9।।
cyavanaḥ prāha śāpo me mithyā naiva bhavet pitaḥ ।
brahmā śrutvā tadā prāha jātaṃ sarvaṃ madicchayā ।।1.510.20।।
purā saṃsṛṣṭukāmo'haṃ nāgānāṃ navamaṃ kulam ।

tava vaṃśaḥ savistāro martyaloke nivāsakṛt ।।।22।।।

evaṃ pravadato'jasya yajñe nāgāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
nimantritāśca vāsukistakṣakaśca kṛṣīharaḥ ।।24।।
puṇḍarīkaḥ kambalāśvatarau kālaparo balaḥ ।
śeṣaścānye praṇamyocuryajñe devaṃ pitāmaham ।।25 ।।

nāgatīrthe nivasantu yajñe yeṣāṃ ca duṣṭatā ।

etatkṛtyatamaṃ nāgā mama yajñasya rakṣaṇam ।

sanātanasutopetāḥ sanātanasya vaṃśakṛt ।।29।।
pariṇeme sutāṃ karkoṭakasya navayauvanām ।
tadvaṃśaḥ sarvathā bhūmau vistṛtaścā'bhavattataḥ ।।1.510.30।।
yatphaṇāsu binduyuktaṃ tilakaṃ caturasrakam ।
upari daṇḍaśūnyaṃ ca te sanātanavaṃśajāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
vaiṣṇavā bahurūpāśca śuklāḥ piṃgāśca pāṇḍurāḥ ।

dīyatāṃ dīyatāṃ tviṣṭaṃ bhujyatāṃ bhujyatāṃ bahu ।

etasminnantare tatra kaścijjñānī samāgataḥ ।।38।।
trikālajño namaskṛtya brahmāṇaṃ niṣasāda ha ।

ṛtvijastaṃ papracchuḥ svabhūtakarmāṇi kautukāt ।
sa tāni kathayāmāsa tenā''ścaryānvitāśca te ।।1.510.40।।

tasyā'pyantaḥpure cāsīt piṃgalā nāma nāyikā ।

anyāstu śataśo bhāryā rajanyāṃ kāmavāñcchayā ।
āharanti śubhān dhūpān lepāँśca kusumāni ca ।।45।।
vilepanāni mukhyāni sūkṣmāṇi cāmbarāṇi ca ।

ekā jānāti māṃ śayyāṃ nūnamevā''hvayiṣyati ।
anyā jānāti māṃ caiva tṛtīyā māṃ ca nā'parām ।।47।।
spardhayanti prapaśyanti pratīkṣanti nṛpaṃ tadā ।
tāsāmekāmāhvayati dvitīyāṃ vā tṛtīyakām ।।48।।
caturthīṃ vā pañcamīṃ vā daśa vā tu kvacinniśi ।
śeṣāḥ śokaṃ samāsādya niḥśvasya prasvapanti ca ।।49।।
āśāduḥkhagatā naiva labhanti nidrikālavam ।
āśā hi paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ nairāśyaṃ paramaṃ sukham ।।1.510.50 ।।
āśāṃ nirāśāṃ kṛtvā ca sukhaṃ svapiti piṃgalā ।
na karoti ca śṛṃgāraṃ na spardhāṃ ca kathaṃcana ।।51 ।।
na vyākulatvamāpede sukhaṃ svapiti piṃgalā ।
antaḥpurasya sevāyāṃ niyuktena mayā sadā ।।52।।
vilokitaṃ tataścāhaṃ tyaktvā''śāṃ prasvapimyapi ।
ye svapanti sukhaṃ rātrau teṣāṃ jāṭharajo'nalaḥ ।।53 ।।
idhyate bhojanaṃ pūrṇaṃ gṛhṇāti yāti puṣṭatām ।

śrūyatāṃ kurarāllabdhaṃ jñānaṃ yathā vadāmi tat ।
mamā''sīd draviṇaṃ bhūri pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat ।।55।।

yasyā'haṃ na prayacchāmi sa māṃ nityaṃ prabādhate ।
ekastu yatate prāṇān hartuṃ nityaṃ mamāntike ।।57।।
aparo daṇḍayuktaśca bhayaṃ datvā prayācate ।

anyo bhedena ca tathetaro jayapradānakaiḥ ।

evaṃ nāhaṃ kvacit saukhyaṃ teṣāṃ pārśvāllabhāmi vai ।
divārātrau sukhaṃ nidrāṃ śāntiṃ labhāmi naiva ca ।।1.510.60 ।।
athaikasmin dine dṛṣṭaḥ kuraro māṃsasaṃyutaḥ ।

māṃsaṃ cañcvā patitaṃ tadanupetuḥ khagāśca te ।
kuraraśca sukhī jātaḥ pakṣibhistaiḥ samujjhitaḥ ।।62।।
āmiṣasya parityāgāt kuraraḥ sukhamedhate ।
mayā putrādikān dravyaṃ vibhajyā'rpitameva ha ।।63 ।।
tataḥ prabhati tairmuktaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭhāmi puṣṭimān ।
arthasampad vimohāya vimoho narakāya ca ।।64।।
tasmādarthamanarthaṃ tu mokṣārthī dūratastyajet ।
yathā''miṣaṃ jale matsyairbhakṣyate śvāpadairbhuvi ।।65।।
ākāśe pakṣibhiścaiva tathā sarvatra vittavān ।

mukhe tu kaṭukaṃ nityaṃ dhanināṃ jvariṇāmiva ।

janitāramapi tyaktvā niḥsvaṃ yānti sutā api ।
tāvat niṣṭhati maitrī vai yāvannārthaprayogitā ।।1.510.70 ।।
sambandhe'rthasya saṃjāte vairaṃ sampadyate svayam ।

kośakāramivā''tmānaṃ veṣṭitaṃ naiva buddhyate ।

yatra kvāpi vasennityaṃ sattāvarjyaṃ drumāśraye ।

dhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ japet kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sadā ।
rāgadveṣau na vai kāryau śatrutā mitratā na ca ।।8 1 ।।
loṣṭā'śmakāñcanānāṃ ca tulyatā'mānamānayoḥ ।

athāpi bhramarāllabdhaṃ jñānaṃ vadāmi sārajam ।।।86।।

samādāya nikete sve niyojayati nityadā ।

tena tṛptiṃ prayātāśca bahavo madhupāḥ pare ।

racitāni suśāstrāṇi tāni gṛhṇa'nti mānavāḥ ।

na. vai dṛṣṭo mayā''tmā tu tato vairāgyavānaham ।।97।।

bahubhiḥ kalaho nityaṃ dvābhyāṃ saṃgharṣaṇaṃ tathā ।। 1 23।।
ekākī vicariṣyāmi kumārīvalayaṃ yathā ।
tato dārā''sutaputrīḥ parityajya bhramāmyaham ।। 1 24।।
yatrā'stamitaśāyī ca yallabdhakṛtabhojanaḥ ।
smarāmi sarvadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vibandhanaḥ ।। 1 25।।
evaṃ labdhaṃ mayā jñānaṃ tebhyastebhyo vicintanāt ।
yasmād yasmād bhavejjñānaṃ sa syād gurustathā ca te ।। 126।।
ebhirlokāntarajñānaṃ mayā''tmajñānameva ca ।
labdhaṃ tacchrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇānugrahato'dhikam ।। 1 27।।
etasya śravaṇāccāpi labhate jñānamīdṛśam ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau jñānī yajñā'tithistadā ।। 128।।
aśvapaṭṭasaraḥstho vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
yajñe'tithiśca satkāryaḥ ityādeśārthamāgataḥ ।। 129।।
vijñāya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhyānena ṛtvijaiḥ ।
satkṛtaḥ śrīharirvipraḥ ṛtvikṣu niṣasāda ha ।। 1.510.13 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yajñe sanātanasutasya baṭurūpeṇa sarpakṣepaṇārthamāgamanam, tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'tithirūpeṇa svagurvādijñānapradānārthamāgamanam, jñānanirūpaṇaṃ cetyādipradarśananāmā daśādhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।510 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 510 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 511
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 512 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataścainamatithiṃ śrīnarāyaṇam ।
viprarūpaṃ papracchuste brāhmaṇā maṇḍapasthitāḥ ।। 1 ।।
gṛhaṃ tyaktvā gatastvaṃ kva kiyān kālo gatastava ।
vada yogyaṃ yajñakārye sametānāṃ tapasvinām ।। 2 ।।
atithiśca tadā prāha bhrānto'haṃ bhuvanatrayam ।
brahmalokaṃ ceśalokaṃ jīvalokaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।। 3 ।।
khaṇḍānāṃ pṛthivīnāṃ ca golokānāṃ śatāni ca ।
sahasrāṇi cāyutāni lakṣāṇi cārbudāni ca ।। 4 ।।
yatrā'stamitaśāyyasmi kṛtāptadehayātrakaḥ ।
nivasāmi yathādehe prāyastattveṣu vai tathā ।। 5 ।।
yajñe vasāmi sarvatra pralaye'pi vasāmi ca ।
saṃkhyayā rahitānyeva varṣāṇāṃ me gatāni ca ।। 6 ।।
yugānāṃ saṃkhyakā nāsti tvāyurme śāśvataṃ matam ।
yatra gacchāmi tīrthāni bhavantyeva mamāgamāt ।। 7 ।।
tāni kṛtvā'pyanantāni tvāgato'smi surakratau ।
dvīpān khaṇḍān bhramitvā ca tīrthāni sakalānyapi ।। 8 ।
dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvajyotiṣkaṃ himaśailaṃ tathottarān ।
śvetadvīpaṃ kṛṣṇadeśaṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ ca raivatam ।। 9 ।।
kṛtvā sārasvataṃ gāṃgaṃ vārāṇasīṃ ca puṣkaram ।
śrutvā kratuṃ sārvabhaumaṃ pitāmahasya paścime ।।1.511.1 0।।
samāgato'smi cātithyaṃ grahītuṃ dīyate yadi ।
brahmādyāste kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāhurvaraṃ vṛṇu ।। 11 ।।
yatheṣṭaṃ ca tathā''tithyaṃ gṛhāṇā'dhyātmikaṃ ca vā ।
avaśyaṃ tat pradāsyāmo jñānine tvantarātmane ।। 12।।
atithiḥ prāha me'pekṣyā nityamātmaniveditā ।
prapannānāṃ śaraṇyaṃ ca sarvārpaṇaṃ tathepsitam ।। 1 3।।
adatvā me tu ye kuryurbrahmādyā api vai kratum ।
adatvā'tithaye naiva prāpnuyuḥ phalamīpsitam ।। 14।।
yajñabhāgaṃ devabhāgaṃ divyatvaṃ prārthayāmi ca ।
āntaratvaṃ ca bāhyatvaṃ prayacchantu tathā mama ।। 15।।
ityuktā devatāḥ prāhurdūrāt samāgato'tithiḥ ।
satyātraṃ cāsi viprendra sarvaṃ te dīyate kratau ।। 16।।
ya eṣaḥ kriyate yajñastasya nātho hariḥ smṛtaḥ ।
etasmāt kāraṇāt proktaḥ sa devo yajñapūruṣaḥ ।। 17।।
vartase kuṃkumavāpyāṃ kṣetre kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇasya kambharā kamalā priyā ।। 18।।
tapasā mānasaṃ lebhe tvātmasthaṃ cātmajaṃ tu yam ।
sa tvaṃ lakṣmīpatirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīpārvatīpatiḥ ।। 19।।
prabheśo māṇikīśaśca jayeśaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam ।
vartase yajñakarmātman karmaṇāṃ phaladāyakaḥ ।।1.511.20।।
manaseśo maṃgaleśo rādheśaścākṣareśvaraḥ ।
rameśaścāpi mukteśaḥ paramātmā''ntarasthitaḥ ।। 21 ।।
tava nāmnā sadā deyaṃ pūrṇaṃ yajñe phalaṃ bhavet ।
śrāddhe paitrye tathā daive yo vai tvāṃ pūjayiṣyati ।। 22।।
viṣṇunāmasamopetaṃ bhaviṣyati tadakṣayam ।
kṛṣṇe tuṣṭiṃ gate sarve surāstuṣṭā bhavanti vai ।।23।।
ityuktvā brahmalakṣmīśadharmaśeṣaśivādayaḥ ।
dadāvatithaye sarvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai ।।24।।
tataḥ prabhṛti sañjātā pūjā tvatithisaṃbhavā ।
tasmāllakṣmi! sadā pūjā'titheḥ kāryā śubhe kṣaṇe ।।।25।
gṛhasthānāṃ paro dharmo nānyo'styatithipūjanāt ।
atitherna paro devo devaṃ nātikramet kvacit ।। 26।।
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinivartate ।
tad datvā duṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati ।।27।।
satyaṃ vrataṃ tapo'dhītaṃ dattamiṣṭaṃ śataṃ samāḥ ।
tasya sarvaṃ bhavennaṣṭamatithiṃ yo na pūjayet ।।28।।
yasya gehe'tithayo vai sutṛptāśca bhavanti hi ।
sa gṛhasthastadanye tu bhavanti gṛharakṣiṇaḥ ।।29।।
purā sukṛtapuṇyānāṃ janānāmiha bhūtale ।
trīṇyetāni prapadyante śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ śubhā giraḥ ।।1.511.3 0।।
tuṣṭe'tithau gṛhasthasya santuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।
vimukhe vimukhāḥ sarvā bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
apyātmanaḥ pradānena toṣayitavya eva saḥ ।
nārāyaṇo devatāśca devyaścā'tithayo guruḥ ।।32।।
sādhvī kanyā hyanāthā ca bhikṣukī hyatithirmatāḥ ।
pitṛśrāddhe bhojanasya samaye yo'bhiyāti ca ।।3 3।।
dūrādhvādita āśrānto madhyāhne yo'bhiyāti ca ।
kṛte tu bhojane cā'hni rātrau vā yo'bhigacchati ।।34।।
ta ete'tithayaḥ proktā nā'tithiḥ pūrvamāgataḥ ।
priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyo mūrkho vā paṇḍito'thavā ।।35।।
tasya śaktyā pradātavyamannaṃ vai gṛhamedhinā ।
āsanaṃ ca jalaṃ bhāvaḥ suvāṇī snehavīkṣaṇam ।।36।।
etāni tu satāṃ gehe nocchidyante kadācana ।
atitheḥ svāgatāt tṛptā bhavanti pitaraḥ khalu ।।37।।
atitherāsanāt tuṣṭirbrahmaṇo jāyate tathā ।
argheṇa śaṃbhoḥ pādyena devānāṃ toṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।।38।।
bhojyadānena viṣṇośca tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī ।
yathāśakti sadā pūjyo bhojanīyo viśeṣataḥ ।।3 9।।
ityuktvā yajñakāryasya vidhiṃ kṛtvā surāstataḥ ।
parihāraṃ vidhāyaiva bhojayāmāsurīśvarān ।।1.511.40।।
rātriṃ ninyurutsavaiśca vyākhyānaiḥ pārameśvaraiḥ ।
caturthe divase yajñakarmārambhaṃ yathāvyadhuḥ ।।41।।
somapānādikaṃ sarvaṃ homadravyādikaṃ tathā ।
prāvartata yathāyogyaṃ tāvat tatra samāgataḥ ।।42।।
yuvā vai brāhmaṇaḥ kaścid bubhukṣitastṛṣāyutaḥ ।
homadravyaṃ śubhaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhakṣayāmāsa sotsukaḥ ।।43।।
prasthātā taṃ bhakṣyamāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā śaśāpa dhig vadan ।
homārthadravyaṃ duṣṭa tvaṃ rakṣovadatra khādasi ।।44।।
rākṣasānāmidaṃ karma rākṣaso bhava mā ciram ।
ityuktaḥ so'bhavat tatra ūrdhvakeśo'tibhairavaḥ ।।45।।
lamboṣṭho vikarālāsyo rākṣasaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇakaḥ ।
śaṃkukarṇaśca raktākṣo dṛṣṭamātrabhayaṃkaraḥ ।। 46।।
rākṣasaṃ taṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhītā vitresurīśvarāḥ ।
rakṣoghnāni ca sūktāni jajapuśca punaḥ punaḥ ।।47।।
rākṣaso'pi bhayaṃ tyaktvā pitāmahamupāgamat ।
uvācā''tmānamuddiśya kṛtāñjaliḥ praṇamya ca ।।48।।
pautro'haṃ vai tava brahman pulastyasya suto dvijaḥ ।
nīto rākṣasatāmadya prasthātrā śāpataḥ pitaḥ ।। 49।।
ahaṃ viśvāvasurnāma paulastyo'smi kṛpāṃ kuru ।
bhakṣitaṃ yanmayā cātra homārthaṃ yatprakalpitam ।।।1.511.50।।
aparādhaṃ kṣamayitvā rākṣasatvaṃ nirākuru ।
tadā brahmā pratiprasthātaraṃ prāha dayāyutaḥ ।।51 ।।
bālo'yaṃ mama pautrastu kṛtyā'kṛtye na vetti ca ।
tasya rākṣasabhāvo vai tvayā hartavya eva ha ।।52।।
śrutvā tacca muniḥ prāha pulastyasya tu vaṃśajāḥ ।
devakāryavirodhitvād bhaviṣyanti hi rākṣasāḥ ।।53।।
nā'sya rākṣasabhāvo vai hartuṃ kenāpi śakyate ।
satyapi mānave bhāve kṛtamucchiṣṭameva yat। ।।54।।
yajñadravyaṃ svabhāvo'yaṃ naiṣekaḥ kena vāryate ।
syācca vā śītalo vahniryadi syāduṣṇaguḥ śaśī ।। 55।।
tanme syādanyathā vākyaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ prapitāmaha ।
tasmādayaṃ sadā cāstu rākṣasaḥ rakṣasāṃ patiḥ ।।56 ।।
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tasya vidhirviśvāvasuṃ tadā ।
jagāda pautra cānena rūpeṇa tiṣṭha sarvadā ।।57।।
camatkārapurasyā'sya paścimasthānamāśritaḥ ।
paścime rākṣasāḥ santi kūṣmāṇḍakāḥ piśācakāḥ ।।58।।
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca tānnivāraya sarvathā ।
tadgaccha putra tatra tvaṃ sarveṣāmadhipo bhava ।।59।।
rākṣasānāṃ mayā dattaṃ tava rājyaṃ ca sāmpratam ।
rākṣasaḥ prāha rājye ca mayā bhoktavyameva kim ।।1.511.60 ।।
rājñā caiva mayā deyaṃ bhṛtyānāṃ bhojanaṃ ca kim ।
na karoti ca yo rājā bhṛtyaprajāprapoṣaṇam ।।61 ।।
tasyāpi narakaprāptistato dehi prabhojanam ।
brahmā prāha tilairdarbhaivihīnaṃ śrāddhameva te ।।।62।।
rajasvalayā saṃdṛṣṭaṃ śūkareṇā'valokitam ।
śunā khareṇa ca dṛṣṭaṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca te'rpitam ।।।6 3 ।।
kuṣṭhī kunakhī mahiṣo vā bhuṃkte yatra te'rpitam ।
asnātaiśca kṛtaṃ tailābhyaṃgavadbhirmalāmbaraiḥ ।।64।।
bhuṃkte ca śyāmadanto vā vṛṣalīpatireva vā ।
vedahīnena ca kṛtaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vinā kṛtam ।।65
devakāryavihīnaṃ ca tatte sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
pratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ takraṃ vikṛtaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।।6 6
yajamāno dvijo vā'tha brahmacaryavivarjitaḥ ।
bhoktāpi tādṛśo yatra tatsarvaṃ te bhaviṣyati ।।67
āyasena tu pātreṇa yat pāvitryavivarjitam ।
dattamannaṃ sadā te'stu mantraśuddhivivarjitam ।।68
ityukto rākṣaso natvā dattaṃ bhuktvā yayau tataḥ ।
yajñakārye ca sampanne parihāraḥ kṛtastathā ।।6 9
tataśca pañcame tvahni pulastyena prabodhitāḥ ।
śvetadhautāmbarāḥ snātāścakruḥ karmāṇi tatkratau ।।1.511.70
sāmavedasya gānena tūdgātrā karmayojitam ।
śaṃkubhiḥ kriyate yacca tatkṛtaṃ susamāhitam ।।71
devairāgatya sānandaṃ kṛtaṃ vai somabhakṣaṇam ।
home pradīptavahnau ca jāyamāne punaḥ punaḥ ।।72
prārabdhe somabhakṣye'tha gīte codgātṛnirmite ।
āgatā kanyakā tvekā sāmagītisamutsukā ।।73
śaṃkukarṇaṃ nijaṃ citte vāñcchamānā vicakṣaṇā ।
chandogasya sutā śreṣṭhā devaśarmābhidhasya sā ।।74
udumbarītināmnā sā sāmaśravaṇalālasā ।
udgātāraṃ ca sadasi vacanaṃ vyājahāra vai ।।75 ।
yathā tathā pravartante śaṃkavaḥ sāmasūcitāḥ ।
dakṣiṇāgnau kṛte home pāpanāśo bhavediti ।।76।
evaṃ tayā darśitaśca homaḥ kṛto dvijairiti ।
tataḥ papracchurete tāṃ kuta āyāsi kanyake ।।77।
udumbarī samuvāca parvatasya ṛṣeḥ sutā ।
jātismarā'bhijātā'smi śāpād gandharvalokataḥ ।।78
gāyane svarabhaṃgo vai nāradasyā'nvapadyata ।
tadā ca hasitastatra nārado gāyane mayā ।।79।
tataḥ sa kupito mahyaṃ mithyā'haṃ hasitastviti ।
tena nāradaśāpo'bhūnmānuṣī bhava kanyake ।।1.511.80।।
mayā prasāditaḥ stotraiḥ śāpāntārthaṃ tadā ca saḥ ।
prāha māṃ mānuṣī śreṣṭhavipragṛhe bhaviṣyasi ।।8 1 ।।
devaśarmagṛhe jātā tenā'haṃ kanyakā'dhunā ।
satyabhāmā mama mātā vartate ca pativratā ।।82।।।
nāradena tadā coktaṃ brahmā yajñaṃ kariṣyati ।
tatra tadā ca samaye śaṃkoścāpi viparyaye ।।83 ।।
tadā tatra tvayā vācyaḥ sthāne śaṃkuḥ samāhitaḥ ।
dakṣiṇāgnau kṛte home pāpanāśo bhavediti ।।84।।
tāvattadā ca te mokṣo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
imā kāntiṃ mama paśya vimānaṃ tvāgataṃ tathā ।।85।।
ahaṃ yāsyāmi me svargaṃ gāndharvasthānamadya hi ।
udgātā ca tadā prāha yajñe kṣaternivārike ।।86।।
tuṣṭo'haṃ tvaṃ varaṃ brūhi na vṛkṣā darśanaṃ mama ।
udumbarī tadā prāha dehi me devasannidhau ।।87।।
yajñe yajñe samāje ca madhyasthā bhuktireva me ।
tato matpuratastatra kāryaṃ śaṃkupracāraṇam ।।88।।
mattejaḥkarmaṇā tuṣṭiḥ svargasthānāṃ bhavet tathā ।
evaṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā udgātā tāmathā'bravīt ।।89।।
yajñe sadasi madhye tvāṃ vinyasya samprapūjya ca ।
vastrabhūṣāgandhapuṣpalepanaiśca tataḥ param ।। 1.511.90 ।।
śaṃkupracāraṇaṃ sarve kariṣyanti tvadagrataḥ ।
kalyāṇaṃ te sadā cāstu santoṣaṃ tvaṃ paraṃ vraja ।। 91 ।।
tvayā virahitaṃ karma niṣphalaṃ bhāvi sarvathā ।
yā nārī sadaso madhye phalaistvāṃ pūjayiṣyati ।।92।।
sā phalaṃ prāpsyati pūrṇaṃ yajñasya śreya ityapi ।
vastrabhūṣādibhiḥ pūjākartrī te yajñapuṇyabhāg ।। 93।।
ityevaṃ devavaryaiśca tathodgātā ca bhūsuraiḥ ।
uktā devī tato vyomni divyā vimānagā'bhavat ।। 94।।
vimāne tvambare tasyāḥ pūjāṃ kartuṃ janāḥ striyaḥ ।
sahasraśaścāgatāstaiḥ pūjitā bahuvastubhiḥ ।।95।।
śrutvaivaṃ devaśarmā'pi putrīṃ draṣṭuṃ samāgataḥ ।
patnīyuto namaścakre putrīṃ vimānagāṃ satām ।।96।।
putrī prāha pitarmā tvaṃ mā namaskāramācara ।
prāptā svargagatirme vai puṇyahrāsād vinaṃkṣyati ।।97।।
tiṣṭhā'tra svāṃganāyuktaḥ svargaṃ neṣyāmi vai saha ।
tatastau harṣitau tasyāḥ pitarau susthitau tadā ।। 98।।
putryāṃ pūjāṃ prapaśyantau manyamānau svadhanyatām ।
anye kuṭumbinaścāpi dhanyān matvā'tra saṃsthitāḥ ।।99।।
tāvadbhṛguḥ samāyāto brahmāṇaṃ sadaso bahiḥ ।
prāha kanyāṃ yajñakārye gṛhītvā nityadā punaḥ ।। 1.511.10 0।।
udgātrā vedamārgo'yaṃ kṛtaścā'vaidikaḥ prabho ।
devītvaṃ cārpitaṃ tasyai mānuṣyai devasannidhau ।। 101 ।।
somapānaṃ tayā sākaṃ yajñe naḥ sampravartitam ।
etadyogyaṃ na vai jātaṃ tasmād yogyaṃ vicāraya ।। 1 02।।
ityukto viśvasṛṭ prāha naiṣā vai mānuṣī satī ।
kintu gāndharvaputrī sā devī hyudambarī sadā ।। 1 03।।
yajñe nāradaśāpādvai muktā śaṃkumiṣeṇa sā ।
yajñīyā devatā ceyaṃ sarvadā sthāsyati dhruvam ।। 1 04।।
atha tāvacca kailāsādāgatā mātaraḥ kratau ।
aṣṭaṣaṣṭisaṃkhyayā vai hṛṣṭāḥ procuśca vedhasam ।। 1 05।।
āmantritāḥ pavanena tava yajñe samāgatāḥ ।
udumbarī yajñamadhye labdhavatī prapūjanam ।। 1 06।।
bhāgaṃ ceti samākarṇya cāgatāstat pitāmaha ।
bhāgaṃ sthānaṃ yajñasadomadhye dehi ca śāśvatam ।। 1 07।।
brahmaṇā tvaṣṭaṣaṣṭirvai sthānāni tvarpitāni hi ।
teṣu tāḥ susthitā yajñe pūjitā balibhistadā ।। 1 08।।
tarpitāḥ saṃsthitā maunaṃ sāvitrī tata āgatā ।
dvijaiḥ sā'bhihitā yajñe mā gaccheti nivāritā ।। 1 09।।
brahmaṇā pariṇītā'sti gāyatrīti varāṃganā ।
itiśrutvā vajratulyaṃ mene śuśoca vai ruṣā ।। 1.511.11 0।।
sūryastvastaṃgatastāvat parihāraḥ kratorabhūt ।
yājñikānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ tattvavādo'bhavanniśi ।। 111 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'tithidattavaradānaṃ, pulastyaputraviśvāvasunā homadravyabhakṣaṇaṃ, rākṣaso bhaveti śāpaḥ, parvatarṣiputryā udumbaryā āgamanaṃ kratau pūjāsthānaṃ ca, aṣṭaṣaṣṭimātṛkāgaṇā''gamaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekādaśādhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 511 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 511 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 512
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 513 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi tvaṣṭaṣaṣṭidevyo yāstatra saṃsthitāḥ ।
yajñakṣetre tu tāstatra pattanasthaiḥ prapūjitāḥ ।। 1 ।।
kuladevyo'bhavan nivāsitā nagaravāsibhiḥ ।
yajñe bhūmau ca tāḥ śrutvā sāvitrī tāḥ śaśāpa ha ।। 2 ।।
mamā''gamanapūrvaṃ vai yajñe sthānaṃ kṛtaṃ yataḥ ।
sapatnyā saha militā asmāँstyaktvā tataḥ sadā ।। 3 ।।
nagarasthakṛtā pūjā yuṣmākaṃ na phaliṣyati ।
aprāsādāḥ śītavarṣā''tapakliṣṭā bhaviṣyatha ।। 4 ।।
ākāśagatiśūnyāśca dīnā yūyaṃ bhaviṣyatha ।
iti śaptāśca tāḥ sarvā udumbarī samāyayuḥ ।। 5 ।।
śāpaṃ taṃ śrāvayāmāsuḥ pūjānaiṣphalyameva yat। ।
tataśca prārthayāmāsuḥ śāpasyāpi nivāraṇam ।। 6 ।।
udumbarī ca tāḥ prāha sāvitrīvacanaṃ na vai ।
mṛṣā kartuṃ samarthā'haṃ kintu varaṃ dadāmi yat ।। 7 ।।
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu gotreṣu nagarasthairniyojitāḥ ।
pitāmahasya kṛpayā tatra pūjā phaliṣyati ।। 8 ।।
bhojyaṃ pānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca gotrasthairdāsyate tataḥ ।
tatra tṛptirbhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati sukhāsanam ।। 9 ।।
adṛśyahāsyakartrīṇāṃ dātrīṇāṃ ca balestathā ।
puradvāre pūjikānāṃ tṛptiṃ dānena yāsyatha ।। 1.512.1 0।।
evaṃ tā nāganadyā vai paritaḥ sthāpitāḥ śubhāḥ ।
athodumbarījanako devaśarmā hyupasthitaḥ ।। 11 ।।
patnīyuktaḥ satī divyāṃ putrīṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa saḥ ।
sa evā''sītpurānāmnā gandharvaḥ parvato divi ।। 1 2।।
udumbaryā prārthitaḥ saḥ pitrarthaṃ bhūtale muhuḥ ।
nāradena yadā śaptā mātrarthaṃ ca tadaiva ha ।। 1 3।।
mātaḥ pitaryuvāṃ pṛthvyāmāgacchata mayā saha ।
bhavataṃ mama pitarau mānuṣau mānuṣī tvaham ।। 14।।
yuvayostu sutā tatra bhaviṣyāmi tataśca tau ।
devaśarmā ca tatpatnī jātau vai mānuṣau tayoḥ ।। 15।।
sutā hyudumbarī jātā yā vimāne'tra tiṣṭhati ।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devaśarmā'pi tanuṃ tyaktvā priyāyutaḥ ।। 16।।
babhūva divyadeho vai yānaṃ samāruroha saḥ ।
patnīyuktaḥ sutāyukto niśāṃ nināya cāmbare ।। 17।।
evaṃ yātaṃ dinaṃ rātriḥ pañcamī ca kratorgatā ।
pratyūṣe ca tato jāte'vabhṛthasnānamityapi ।। 18।।
vidhibodhyaṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ kāryaṃ bhavediti ।
tataḥ svargaṃ devatābhiḥ samaṃ yāsyāma eva ha ।। 1 9।।
iti vicārya ca trayaste ca vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ।
dakṣiṇāṃ ca kratoḥ parihāraṃ cāvabhṛthaṃ tathā ।। 1.512.20 ।।
pratīkṣante'tha vai brahmā sadaḥsthān brāhmaṇān munīn ।
dakṣiṇāṃ pradadau tatra puṣkaraṃ ca sarovaram ।।।21 ।।
tīrtharūpaṃ pāvanaṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa paścime ।
kārtike dhavale pakṣe tvekādaśīta eva vai ।।22।।
pūrṇimāntaṃ ca pañcāhaṃ tīrthānyanyāni cāpi vai ।
sthāsyantyatra sarasyeva sarvayugeṣu bhūsurāḥ ।।23।।
pañcarātrasya madhye'tra yaśca snānaṃ kariṣyati ।
dānādikaṃ japaṃ cāpi tadakṣayaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 24।।
atha te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve puṇyadānaprapūrikām ।
anujñāṃ pradadustuṣṭā yajñasya phalasiddhaye ।।25।।
pūrṇaṃ ca havanaṃ jātaṃ dakṣiṇā bahulā'rpitā ।
tuṣṭāśca brāhmaṇāḥ santastathā'nye prāpya vai dhanam ।।26 ।।
pulastyaḥ prāha ca tatra yajñaḥ sampūrṇadakṣiṇaḥ ।
prāyaścittairvirahitaḥ sampanno jāyatāt sadā ।।27।।
ataḥ paraṃ karmaśeṣaṃ varuṇeṣṭiṃ japaṃ tathā ।
karomi ca tataḥ sarvaiḥ prakartavyaṃ phalapradam ।।28।।
avabhṛthākhyaṃ snānaṃ ca tvayā mayā'psu vai śubham ।
evamuktvā saha sarvairyayau puṣkaratīrthakam ।।29।।
nāganadyāṃ tu ṛtvigbhiḥ sā''cāryā'gnīdhrahotṛbhiḥ ।
brahmaṇā saha vipraiśca sadasyairbahubhistadā ।। 1.512.30 ।।
yathā vahnau tathā toye sarvaistatra haviḥ śubham ।
hūyate saṃvidhānena yajñapātraiḥ samanvitam ।। 31 ।।
varuṇasya pratuṣṭyarthaṃ viviśuste tato jalam ।
ṛtvigbhirbrahmaṇā sarvaiḥ sarvā'niṣṭapraśāntaye ।। 32।।
avabhṛthasthale snānaṃ yaḥ kaścid vai kariṣyati ।
sarvatīrthamaye martyo vipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati ।।33 ।।
yāni kāni ca tīrthāni trailokye vai bhavantyapi ।
vāruṇīmiṣṭimāsādya tānyāyānti ca sannidhau ।।34।।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena dīkṣitena samanvitaiḥ ।
tatra snānaṃ prakartavyaṃ jalamadhye tu sārthibhiḥ ।।35।।
atha brahmā mahendraṃ ca prāha lokahitāya vai ।
janānāṃ bahusammarde janā jñāsyanti naiva mām ।।36।।
snānaṃ jale kṣaṇe tatra tatastvaṃ gajamāsthitaḥ ।
haste vaṃśe kṛṣṇasāramṛgaṃ dhṛtvā tadā'mbare ।।37।।
sarveṣāṃ snānakālasya jñānāya tat jale kṣipa ।
yena lokasamasto'yaṃ jñātvā snāsyati tatkṣaṇam ।। 38।।
snānaṃ yaḥ kurute śreyaḥ samprāpnoti yathoditam ।
dūrastho'pi suvṛddho'pi bālo'pi yoṣito'pi ca ।।3 9 ।।
snānajaṃ labhate śreya indraḥ śrutvā tathā'karot ।
tatkṣaṇe devatā viprāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā ।।1.512.40 ।।
santaśca mānuṣā divyā gandharvā guhyakādayaḥ ।
caturdaśabhuvāṃ vāsakṛtaḥ sasnuḥ samāhitāḥ ।।41 ।।
brahmā śakraṃ tadā prāha varaṃ vṛṇu dadāmi te ।
indraḥ prāhātra vai tīrthe prativarṣaṃ tu yo nṛpaḥ ।।42।।
mṛgacarmavinikṣipyā'vabhṛthaṃ ca kariṣyati ।
gaje sthitvā kratorante saḥ syātpāpavivarjitaḥ ।।43 ।।
ajeyaḥ sarvaśatrūṇāṃ snātāraḥ pāpavarjitāḥ ।
prajāḥ sukhabharāstadvannīrogāḥ syurmamā''śiṣā।।44।।
kārtike pañcadivasaiḥ kṛtvā kratuṃ vratādikam ।
pratipaddivase prāte kutupe snāyino janāḥ ।।45।।
bhaviṣyanti vijayino varṣapāpavivarjitāḥ ।
ādhivyādhivinirmuktāste bhaviṣyantyasaṃśayam ।।46।।
etasminnantare prāpto yakṣmākhyo dāruṇo gadaḥ ।
acikitsyo'pi devānāṃ tathā dhanvantarerapi ।।47।।
nīlāmbaro raktajihvaḥ śuṣkapārśvaśca susvaraḥ ।
kṣut kurvan śleṣmaṇā śuṣkaṃ pāde'śaktaṃ uvāca ha ।।48।।
dūrācchrutvā tava yaśaṃ pitāmaha upāgataḥ ।
dakṣeṇā'haṃ purāsṛṣṭaścandrārthaṃ kupitena vai ।।49।।
rohiṇīpakṣapātasya phalātmako'hamasmi ca ।
candreṇa śaṃkaro devastapasā toṣitastataḥ ।।1.512.50 ।।
śaṃbhurmahyaṃ dadau pakṣamekaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ na cāparam ।
tatra bhojyaṃ mama kutra bhavellabhyaṃ pitāmaha ।।51 ।।
pūrṇimāyāṃ yajñasatre bhuktvā brūyurdvijā yadi ।
tṛptāḥ sma iti tena syāt pūrṇaṃ yajñaphalaṃ vibho ।।5 2।।
yajñasatre yadi naiva tarpitā yena bhūsurāḥ ।
tasmin vāso mama deyo yajñapuṇyavināśakṛt ।।53 ।।
tava yajñe mama tṛptiryathā syāt tattathā kuru ।
brāhmaṇo'haṃ dakṣaputro mama tṛptirvidhīyatām ।।54।।
brahmā prāha kṛtau vipravacanaṃ tṛptikṛnna cet ।
yajamāne tvayā tatra stheyaṃ puṇyakṣayātmanā ।।55 ।।
kiṃ ca viprairvaiśvadevasyā'nte deyo balistava ।
tena te dvitīyapakṣe tṛptiḥ pūrṇā bhaviṣyati ।।56 ।।
balidāturgṛhe vaṃśe tvayā stheyaṃ na karhicit ।
ityuktaḥ prāha yakṣmā saḥ tṛpto'smi dehi bhūtalam ।।57।।
vasāmi tapase cātrā''kalpāntaṃ vai pitāmaha ।
brahmaṇā ca tato dattaṃ bhūtalaṃ tvāśramāya tam ।।58।।
yakṣmā tūttarabhāge ca nāganadyāḥ samīpataḥ ।
sāmudrasaṃgamaṃ prāpya cakre naijāśramaṃ sa vai ।।5।।।
yo dadāti vaiśvadevasyā'nte baliṃ tu yakṣmaṇe ।
tasya kuṭumbināṃ yakṣmā paśvādīnāṃ na jāyate ।।1.512.6 0।।
na tasya bheṣajāni syurna mantrā na cikitsakāḥ ।
ityuktaḥ sa yayau yakṣmā bhojyaṃ nītvā'bdhisannidhau ।।6 1 ।।
