nāmnā sanatkumāro'smi janaloke vasāmyaham ।। 9 ।।
bhavataḥ pitṛtṛptyādikarmabhistṛpta eva te ।
dhanyavādapradānārthamāgato'smi tavā'ntikam ।। 1.527.1 0।।
dhanyo'si sarvadā vatsa brahmaṇaḥ kulavardhanaḥ ।
vedānāśritya ca pitṝn prīṇāsi sarvadā'nagha ।। 11 ।।
mantravratajapyahomairgayāyāṃ piṇḍadānakaiḥ ।
pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidāḥ putrāstadanye sūtakā yataḥ ।। 12।।
śṛṇu raibhya! viśālākhyo nṛpo babhūva vai purā ।
putrārthaṃ ca dvijān śreṣṭhān papraccha matimān hi saḥ ।। 13 ।।
viprāḥ prāhurgayāṃ gatvā pitṝn tarpaya bhāvataḥ ।
annadānairjalaiḥ piṇḍairgodānaiścānyadānakaiḥ ।। 14।।
dhruvaṃ sutaste bhavitā sukhadātā kṣitīśvaraḥ ।
viśālanagareśaḥ sa viśālaḥ prayayau tataḥ ।। 15 ।।
gayāṃ maghāsu pitṝṇāṃ kṛtavān piṇḍadānakam ।
tāvad viyati puruṣāstrayastatra samāgatāḥ ।। 16 ।।
dṛṣṭvā sitaṃ ca raktaṃ ca kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tṛtīyakam ।
nanāma tān samuvāca gṛhṇantvimān supiṇḍakān ।। 17।।
upekṣyate bhavadbhiḥ kiṃ śaṃśantu me kutūhalam ।
tatasteṣu sitaḥ prāha putra te janako'smyaham ।। 18।।
nāmnā vṛttena ca śvetaḥ karmaṇā'pi kulena ca ।
ayaṃ tu me pitā rakto nṛśaṃsakṛcca viprahā ।। 1 9।।
tasya pitā kṛṣṇavarṇo nāmnā vṛttyā ca karmabhiḥ ।
kṛṣṇavarṇena ṛṣayo bahavastu purā hatāḥ ।।1.527.20।।
etau mṛtāvavīcyākhyaṃ prapannau narakaṃ ciram ।
ahaṃ puṇyaiḥ samāpannaḥ śakrāsanaṃ sudurlabham ।।21 ।।
tvayā mantrairgayāyāṃ saṃdattāḥ piṇḍā vidhānataḥ ।
tenaitau narakāt samākṛṣyānītau suyojitau ।।22।।
pitṝn pitāmahāँścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahān ।
prīṇayāmīti tattoyaṃ tvayā dattaṃ suputraka ।।23।।
tenā'smadyugapadyogo jāto'tra tava sannidhau ।
gṛhṇīmaḥ piṇḍadānaṃ ca jalaṃ tṛptāḥ sma sarvathā ।।24।।
tīrthaprabhāvād gacchāmi pitṛlokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ।
atra piṇḍapradānena hyetau tava pitāmahau ।।25।।
durgatāvapi saṃśuddhau puṇyavantau babhūvatuḥ ।
tīrthaprabhāva eṣo'sti brahmaghnasyā'pi tatsutaḥ ।।26।।
pituḥ piṇḍapradānena kuryāduddharaṇaṃ punaḥ ।
etasmāt kāraṇād rājan sito'haṃ janakastava ।।27।।
kiñcidadhikaṃ te vacmi yena mokṣo bhaveddhi naḥ ।
śṛṇu sāṃsārikaṃ jñānaṃ yena yāsyasi mokṣaṇam ।।28।।
nityaṃ ca prātarutthāya rātrivastraṃ vihāya ca ।
abhīṣṭadevaṃ hṛtpadme brahmarandhre guruṃ tathā ।।29।।
vicintya manasā prātaḥkṛtyaṃ sarvaṃ samācara ।
snāne śauce kriyāyāṃ ca hariṃ smara muhurmuhuḥ ।।1.527.30।।
dhautavastre nidhāyaiva parameśaṃ prapūjaya ।
śālagrāme maṇau yantre pratimāyāṃ jale'pi ca ।।3 1।।
saṃpūjaya gavi vipre guruṣveva viśeṣataḥ ।
ghaṭe'ṣṭadalapadme ca pātre candanacarcite ।।32।।
śālagrāme ca manasi pūjaya śrīpatiṃ sati ।
dehi ṣoḍaśadravyāṇi bhajanaṃ ca muhuḥ kuru ।।33।।
lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ durgāṃ rādhāṃ gaṃgāṃ ca tulasīm ।
nārāyaṇaṃ hyajaṃ śaṃbhuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vināyakaṃ gurum ।।34।।
prapūjaya sadā prītyā'tithiṃ sūryaṃ hutāśanam ।
pitarau brāhmaṇaṃ sādhuṃ sūryaṃ pūjaya bhāvataḥ ।।35।।
adṛśyāँste kathayāmi darśanīyā na te kvacit ।
viṣṭhāṃ na paśyet satprājño vyādhibījasvarūpiṇīm ।।36।।
mūtraṃ ca vyādhibījaṃ ca tathā narakakāraṇam ।
liṅgaṃ yoniṃ pāpaduḥkhavyādhidāridryadāyinīm ।।37।।
nāryaṃgaṃ yad vināśasya kāraṇaṃ nāvalokayet ।
atibhogān varjayecca rogāṇāṃ kāraṇāni yat ।।38।।
astakāle raviṃ candraṃ na paśyed vyādhikāraṇam ।
khaṇḍaṃ samuditaṃ candraṃ na vīkṣetā''dhikāraṇam ।।39।।
jalasthaṃ ca raviṃ candraṃ dṛṣṭvā śokaṃ vrajennaraḥ ।
ekasya śayanasthānaṃ bhojanaṃ ca gatiṃ tathā ।।1.527.40।।
na kuryāt pāpinā sārdhaṃ sarvaṃ nāśasya kāraṇam ।
ālāpād gātrasaṃsparśācchayanāśrayabhojanāt ।।41।।
sañcaranti dhruvaṃ vyaktau pāpānyanyakṛtānyapi ।
hiṃsrajantusamīpaṃ ca na gacched duḥkhakāraṇam ।।42।।
khalena sārdhaṃ milanaṃ na kuryācchokakāraṇam ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ cāpi vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ tathā ।।43।।
na kuryāddhiṃsanaṃ hāniṃ sarvanāśasya kāraṇam ।
devadevalaviprāṇāṃ satīnāṃ ca satāmapi ।।44।।
vittaṃ vastu dhanaṃ naiva harennāśasya kāraṇam ।
dakṣiṇāṃ tu drutaṃ dadyādanyathā nāśakāraṇī ।।45।।
jīvānāṃ hiṃsanaṃ kṛtvā vaṃśahānirbhaveddhruvam ।
devaṃ guruṃ na named yaḥ pāpabhāṅ narakaṃ vrajet ।।46।।
yā strī mūḍhā durācārā svapatiṃ harirūpiṇam ।
na paśyettarjanaṃ kṛtvā kuṃbhīpāke patettu sā ।।47।।
vāktarjanād bhavet kāko hiṃsanāt sūkaro bhavet ।
sarpo bhavati kopena darpeṇa gardabho bhavet ।।48।।
kukkurī ca kuvākyenā'pyandhā ca viṣadarśanāt ।
pativratā tu vaikuṇṭhe patyā saha vrajed dhruvam ।।49।।
śivaṃ durgāṃ gaṇapatiṃ sūryaṃ vipraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ putraṃ satīṃ bhāryāṃ guruṃ patim ।।1.527.50।।
anāthāṃ bhaginīṃ kanyāṃ vinindya narakaṃ vrajet ।
śālagrāmajalaṃ kṛṣṇaprasādaṃ ye tu bhuṃjate ।।51।।
tīrthaṃ punanti te santaḥ śataṃ puṃsāṃ vasundharām ।
viṣṇuprasādabhojī tu labhate'śvakratoḥ phalam ।।52।।
pradīptaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca śālagrāmaṃ maṇiṃ tathā ।
pratimāṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca suvarṇaṃ śaṃkhamityapi ।।53।।
hīrakaṃ ca tathā muktāṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ ghṛtam ।
śālagrāmaśilātoyaṃ bhūmau tyaktvā vrajedadhaḥ ।।54।।
daridraḥ kṛpaṇaḥ kuṣṭhī vaṃśahīno'pyabhāryakaḥ ।
bhūmihīnaḥ prajāhīno bandhuhīnaśca kutsitaḥ ।।55।।
andhaḥ paṃgurvā kharvaśca khañjaścāpyaṃgahīnakaḥ ।
bhavet krameṇa pāpātmā hyetān bhūmau tyajettu yaḥ ।।56।।
mṛdbhasmagośakṛtpiṇḍaistathā vai vālukādibhiḥ ।
kṛtvā liṃgaṃ sakṛtpūjya vaset kalpaśataṃ divi ।।57।।
yeṣāṃ ca darśane puṇyaṃ kathayāmi niśāmaya ।
subrāhmaṇānāṃ tīrthānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ satāṃ tathā ।।58।।
devatānāṃ tathā pitroḥ patyurdarśanamuttamam ।
sūryasya ca satīnāṃ ca yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।।59।।
sanyāsināṃ gavāṃ vahnergurorgajasya vājinaḥ ।
siṃhasya kokilasyāpi khañjanasya śukasya ca ।।1.527.6 0।।
haṃsānāṃ ca mayūrāṇāṃ cāṣāṇāṃ śaṃkhapakṣiṇām ।
vatsaprayuktadhenūnāmaśvatthānāṃ maṇestathā ।।6 1।।
patiputravatīnāṃ ca janānāṃ tīrthayāyinām ।
pradīpānāṃ suvarṇasya muktānāṃ - hīrakasya ca ।।62।।
māṇikyānāṃ tulasyāśca śvetapuṣpasya darśanam ।
pāpanāśakaraṃ puṇyaṃ maṃgalasya pradaṃ matam ।।63।।
phalāni śukladhānyāni ghṛtaṃ dadhi madhūni ca ।
pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca lājāँśca śarkarāṃ darpaṇaṃ jalam ।।64।।
mālāṃ ca śuklapuṣpāṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ vrajejjanaḥ ।
gorocanaṃ ca karpūraṃ rajataṃ ca sarovaram ।।65।।
puṣpodyānaṃ puṣpitāṃ ca śukle candramasaṃ navam ।
pīyūṣaṃ candanaṃ devotthānaṃ devālayaṃ dhvajam ।।66।।
kastūrīṃ kuṃkumaṃ devakhātaṃ vaṭaṃ ca dundubhim ।
patākāṃ ca devaghaṭaṃ sugandhipavanaṃ tathā ।।67।।
śaṃkhaṃ śuktiṃ pravālaṃ ca rajataṃ sphaṭikaṃ kuśam ।
tāmraṃ gaṃgāmṛdaṃ viṣṇuṃ pustakaṃ ratnamakṣatān ।।68।।
tapasvinaṃ ca vidvāṃsaṃ samudraṃ kṛṣṇasārakam ।
yajñaṃ mahotsavaṃ dugdhaṃ gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ tathā ।।69।।
godhūliṃ goṣpadaṃ goṣṭhaṃ pakvasasyāṃ ca bhūmikām ।
rucirāṃ padminīṃ śyāmāṃ suveṣāṃ kanyakāṃ satīm ।।1.527.70।।
karaṃ gandhaṃ ca siddhānnaṃ dṛṣṭvā puṇyaṃ labhejjayam ।
datvā viṣṇupade piṇḍān viṣṇuṃ yastu prapūjayet ।।71 ।।
pitṝṇāṃ svātmanaścāpi karoti janmamokṣaṇam ।
etatte kathitaṃ rājan sānandaṃ puṇyavardhakam ।।72।।
evaṃ puṇyaprabhāveṇa suśuddhā jāyate matiḥ ।
pitṝṇāṃ ca tathā bhaktirhṛdi tasya pravardhate ।।73।।
sito viśālaṃ sandiśya prāha kṛṣṇaṃ sadā bhaja ।
dehi tvekādaśīpuṇyaṃ kārtikasya vratāni ca ।।74।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjāphalaṃ dehi vimuktaye ।
akhaṇḍamātrikāpuṇyaṃ dehi cāsmadvimuktaye ।।75।।
ityuktaḥ sa viśālākhyo nṛpaḥ puṇyaṃ tathā dadau ।
kare jalaṃ gṛhītvaiva mumoca pṛthivītale ।।76।।।
tāvadviṣṇoḥ pārṣadāśca vimānasthāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
mantram oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।।77।।
daduḥ prāhurvimāne'tra catvāro'pi ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।
ārohantu ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ samāyāntu ca pārṣadāḥ ।।78।।
ityuktāste yayurdhāma pārṣadaiḥ saha tatkṣaṇam ।
etasmāt kāraṇād raibhya! bhavān dhanyo mayocyate ।।79।।
sakṛt gayābhigamanaṃ sakṛt piṇḍapradānakam ।
durlabhaṃ tvaṃ punarnityamatraivā'si vyavasthitaḥ ।।1.527.80।।
kimanu procyate raibhya tava puṇyamidaṃ prabho ।
yena sākṣād gadāpāṇirdṛṣṭo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।81 ।।
sanātanarṣiścoktvaiva tatraivāntaradhīyata ।
raibhyaḥ stutiṃ hareścakre premagadgadayā girā ।।82।।
sitaṃ kṛte trītayuge'ruṇaṃ nīlaṃ tu dvāpare ।
kalau yuge'lipratimaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śraye ।।83।।
akṣare parame dhāmni goloke'tha vikuṇṭhake ।
yo'sti sa śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo me hṛdaye'pi ca ।।84।।
taṃ tvāṃ lomaśavāsasthaṃ sarvagaṃ parameśvaram ।
namāmi cāśrayāmyadya saṃsārataraṇāya vai ।।85।।
matsyādīni makhādyāśca santaste cā'ṅgavaibhavāḥ ।
tathā māṃ kuru cādyaiva siddhamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ ।।86।।
evaṃ stutastadā viṣṇuḥ prādurbabhūva sundaraḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇirgaruḍastho viyadgataḥ ।।87।।
uvāca raibhya! tuṣṭo'smi samāgaccha mayā saha ।
raibhyo garuḍamāruhya yatra te sanakādayaḥ ।।88।।
tatra gatvā ca tānnatvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ hariṇā saha ।
jagāma divyadehena lakṣmi! tvatkāntasannidhau ।।89।।
etad raibhyasya caritaṃ tathā viṣṇorgadābhṛtaḥ ।
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccāpi bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheta saḥ ।।1.527.90।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśālarājño haribhajanānmuktiḥ, raibhyasyāpi tattvajñānena bhaktyā ca muktiḥ, gayāyāṃ raibhyasya sanatkumāradarśanamupadeśādi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 527 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 527 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 528
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 529 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi ṛṣiśreṣṭha āvaṭyastvekadā girim ।
raivataṃ kārtike māsi pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca ।। 1 ।।
māsatrayaṃ samuvāsa lomaśasyā''śrame tadā ।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇālaye ।। 2 ।।
śivarātrau niśāyāṃ ca pupūja lomaśeśvaram ।
prātarbrāhmamuhūrtaṃ ca kṣaṇaṃ nidrā'bhavad yadā ।। 3 ।।
svapnaṃ tatra dadarśā'sāvṛṣirāvaṭyanāmakaḥ ।
divyayānena sa yayau satyalokaṃ tataḥ param ।। 4 ।।
viṣṇulokaṃ mahāviṣṇorlokaṃ kailāsamāyayau ।
vaihāyasena yānena vaikuॆṭhaṃ sa yayau tataḥ ।। 5 ।।
golokaṃ sa yayau paścād yayāvakṣaradhāma saḥ ।
yayau ca paramaṃ dhāmā'nantaṃ parātparātparam ।। 6 ।।
sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ brahmalokaṃ gatvā dadarśa pūruṣam ।
divyaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muktā'kṣareśvaram ।। 7 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muktābhivanditam ।
sthitaḥ sa śrīharistasmāyāvaṭyāya jagāda ha ।। 8 ।।
vada lokeṣu sarvatra kiṃ tvayā cā'valokitam ।
āvaṭyaḥ prāha bhagavan atra yadvai vilokyate ।। 9 ।।
tādṛśaṃ sukhasāmrājyaṃ kutrāpi nāvalokitam ।
nā'kṣare na ca goloke na vaikuṇṭhe'mṛte'pi ca ।। 1.528.10 ।।
na ca satye tathā bhūmau te sukhāṃśo na vidyate ।
vilakṣaṇaṃ sukhaṃ te'sti nityānandasutṛptidam ।। 1 1।।
akṣare muktabāhulyaṃ goloke rādhikādayaḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhe śrīramādyāśca satye devādayaḥ sthitāḥ ।। 1 2।।
tadanyatra tu kā vārtā sarvā vai bhogabhūmayaḥ ।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ kailāsaṃ cākṣaraṃ padam ।। 1 3।।
catvāryetāni te kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya bhūmikāḥ ।
bhaktānāṃ ramaṇārthaṃ ca tvayā vai śāśvatīkṛtāḥ ।। 14।।
ye tu bhaktā yathecchanti sevārthaṃ tāँstathā tathā ।
tṛptiṃ dadāsi dāsyatve premṇā snehena kāmataḥ ।। 15।।
ātmānandastava mūrteḥ paradhāmni viśiṣyate ।
sevā''nando'kṣare dhāmni tadanyebhyo viśiṣyate ।। 16 ।।
dāsyānandaśca goloke sakhyānando vikuṇṭhake ।
pūjā''nandaḥ satyaloke yathāyogyaṃ viśiṣyate ।। 17।।
anyatra viṣayānandaḥ kleśamiśro viśiṣyate ।
mayā dṛṣṭo'tra bhagavan sa evā'kṣaradhāmani ।। 18।।
mayā cā''lokitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'kṣarā'dhipaḥ ।
goloke tvaṃ rādhikeśaḥ kṛṣṇanrāyaṇa īkṣitaḥ ।। 1 9।।
vaikuṇṭhe tvaṃ lakṣmīśaśca dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
kailāse tvaṃ lokitaśca vairāgyānandasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 1.528.20।।
yogī jñānī yatiścāpi śivāpatiḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ।
satyaloke tvamevā'si sāvitrīśvara eva ha ।।2 1 ।।
so'yaṃ sūrye mayā dṛṣṭo hiraṇmayaḥ pumān bhavān ।
pṛthvyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca gopālakṛṣṇabālakaḥ ।।22।।
vartase kambharālakṣmīputraḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
lomaśasyāśrame tatra mandire vartase prabho ।।23।।
rādhāṃ kvacit kvacillakṣmīṃ kvacicca pārvatīṃ satīm ।
kvacicca māṇikīṃ devīṃ kvacit prabhāṃ ramāṃ kvacit ।।।24।।
padmāṃ jayāṃ ca lalitāṃ haṃsāṃ ca mañjulāṃ kvacit ।
padmāvatīṃ satīṃ vṛndāṃ tulasīṃ ca sarasvatīm ।।25।।
śivāṃ pārśve prapaśyāmi mūlaprakṛtikāṃ kvacit ।
kvacinmuktāṃ devikāṃ ca campāṃ haimīṃ ca śāntikām ।।26।।
kvacittu yoginaṃ sādhuṃ vidvāṃsaṃ ca sanātanam ।
vīkṣe rūpāṇi te kṛṣṇa dṛṣṭvā pāraṃ na yāmyaham ।।27।।
adya me saphalaṃ janma mokṣapāraṃ gato yataḥ ।
anekakalpapuṇyena na te darśanamāpyate ।। 28।।
kṛpayā'dya mayā labdhaṃ darśanaṃ te śriyaḥ pate ।
ityucyamāne nidrā sā naṣṭā''vaṭayasya tatkṣaṇam ।।29।।
purataḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dadarśa sasmitam ।
praṇipatya ṛṣiḥ prāha svapnaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ mayā prabho ।। 1.528.30 ।।
vada me tatphalaṃ tvadya kiṃ me syācchāśvataṃ phalam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha śṛṇu tvāvaṭya tatphalam ।।3 1 ।।
śīghraṃ te bhāvinī muktirlomaśasya tu sannidhau ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca kṣetrasyā'sya prabhāvataḥ ।।32 ।।
śivarātrervratapuṇyāttathā'trāgamanānmune ।
gṛhāṇa mantraṃ ye tvatra sannaddhau mokṣaṇe bhava ।।3 3 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
gṛhāṇa tulasīmālāṃ kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhīṃ gṛhāṇa ca ।।34।।
vad cānyattu te'bhīṣṭaṃ dadāmyatra na saṃśayaḥ ।
āvaṭyastu tadā prāha muktiṃ dehi pare'kṣarāt ।।35।।
sarvalokahitārthaṃ ca svapnajñānaṃ vadātra me ।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।36।।
prāha jñānaṃ tadā''vaṭyāṃ ya svapnānāṃ śṛṇu priye ।
susvapnadarśanaṃ puṇyaṃ yadi nīcaṃ na vakti ca ।।37।।
kāśyapaṃ durbhagaṃ nīcaṃ śatrumajñāninaṃ striyam ।
tyaktvā rātriṃ ca divase vakti vipraṃ supaṇḍitam ।।38।।
devālaye ca devaṃ cāpyaśvatthatulasīvaṭam ।
uktvā tad dviguṇaṃ puṇyamaprakāśyaṃ caturguṇam ।।39।।
susvapnadarśane prājño gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ।
arthaṃ vittaṃ ca bhāryāṃ ca bhūmiṃ putraṃ labheta saḥ ।।1.528.40।।
mokṣaṃ ca paramaiśvaryaṃ labhate sarvavāñchitam ।
svapnastu prathame yāme saṃvatsare phalapradaḥ ।।41 ।।
dvitīye cāṣṭabhirmāsaistribhirmāsaistṛtīyake ।
caturthetvardhamāsena svapnaḥ svātmaphalapradaḥ ।।42।।
daśāhe phaladaḥ svapno'pyaruṇodayadarśane ।
prātaḥ svapnastuphaladastatkṣaṇaṃ yadi bodhitaḥ ।।43 ।।
cintāvyādhisamāyukto naraḥ svapnaṃ tu paśyati ।
tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ divā svapnaṃ ca niṣphalam ।।44।।
jaḍo mūtrapurīṣeṇa pīḍitaśca bhayākulaḥ ।
digambaro muktakeśo na labhet svapnajaṃ phalam ।।45।।
svapnottaraṃ punarnidrāṃ prayāto na labhet phalam ।
svapnaṃ rātrau yaśca vakti na tasya jāyate phalam ।।46।।
uktvā kāśyapagotraṃ tu vipattiṃ labhate janaḥ ।
durgate durgatiṃ yāti nīce vyādhiṃ prayāti ca ।।47 ।।
rātrau bhayaṃ ca labhate mūrkhe ca kalahaṃ labhet ।
kāminyāṃ dhanahāniḥ syād rātrau caurabhayaṃ bhavet ।।48।।
nidrāyāṃ labhate śokaṃ paṇḍite vāñchitaṃ phalam ।
na prakāśyaśca sa svapno budhena kāśyape kvacit ।।49।।
gavāṃ hayānāṃ śailānāṃ prāsādānāṃ ca hastinām ।
drūṇāmārohaṇaṃ svapne dhanadaṃ parikīrtitam ।।।1.528.50।।
bhojanaṃ rodanaṃ vīṇāvādanaṃ dṛśyate yadi ।
pratigṛhṇāti vā svapne sasyāḍhyāṃ bhūmimālabhet ।।।51 ।।
śastrāstreṇa yadi viddho vraṇena kramiṇā tathā ।
viṣṭhayā rudhireṇāpi svapne lipto dhanī bhavet। ।।52।।
svapne'pyagamyāgamano bhāryālābhaṃ karoti hi ।
mūtrasiktaḥ pibecchukraṃ narakaṃ ca viśatyapi ।।53 ।।
nagaraṃ praviśed raktaṃ samudraṃ vā sudhāṃ pibet ।
sa cāpnoti śubhāṃ vārtāṃ vipulaṃ ca dhanaṃ labhet ।।54।।
gajaṃ nṛpaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca vṛṣabhaṃ dhenumityapi ।
dīpamannaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ kanyāṃ chatraṃ rathaṃ dhvajam ।।55।।
dṛṣṭvā kuṭumbaṃ labhate kīrtiṃ ca vipulāṃ śriyam ।
pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ dvijaṃ vahniṃ puṣpatāmbūlamandiram ।।56।।
śukladhānyaṃ naṭaṃ veśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt ।
gavāṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā cārthaṃ puṇyadhanaṃ labhet ।।57।।
pāyasaṃ padmapatre ca dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu ।
miṣṭānnaṃ svastikaṃ bhuktvā dhruvaṃ rājā bhavediti ।।58।।
pakṣiṇāṃ vā manuṣyāṇāṃ bhuṃkte māṃsaṃ naro yadi ।
bahvarthaṃ śubhavārtāṃ ca labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam ।।59।।
chatraṃ khaḍgaṃ pādukāṃ ca labdhvā dhānyaṃ ca gacchati ।
jale tarettu yaḥ svapne pradhāno jāyate dhruvam ।।1.528.60।।
phalitaṃ bhūruhaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ prāpsyati niścitam ।
sarpeṇa daṣṭo manujo dhanasya lābhavān bhavet ।।6 1।।
sūryaṃ candraṃ ca saṃvīkṣya svapne vyādhirvinaśyati ।
vaḍavāṃ kukkuṭīṃ krauṃcīṃ dṛṣṭvā patnīṃ labhejjanaḥ ।।62।।।
svapne yo nigaḍairbaddhaḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca sutaṃ labhet ।
padmapatre nadītīre bhuṃkte padmapuṭe tathā ।।63।।
dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ svapne sa syād rājā na saṃśayaḥ ।
jalaukasaṃ vṛścikaṃ ca sarpaṃ svapne papraśyati ।।64।।
dhanaṃ putraṃ ca vijayaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca prapadyate ।
śṛṃgibhirdaṃṣṭribhiḥ kolairvānaraiḥ pīḍito yadi ।।65।।
svapne śirasi mukuṭaṃ dhārayed bhūpatirbhavet ।
dhanaṃ vā vipulaṃ yadvā pradhānaṃ ca padaṃ labhet ।।66।।
matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ mauktikaṃ ca śaṃkhaṃ candanahīrakam ।
sphaṭikaṃ rajataṃ dṛṣṭvā vipulaṃ dhanamāpnuyāt ।।67।।
sutaṃ ca rudhiraṃ svarṇaṃ bhuktvā viṣṭhāṃ dhanaṃ labhet ।
pratimāṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ jayaṃ labhet ।।68।।
phalitaṃ puṣpitaṃ bilvamāmraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanaṃ labhet ।
jvaladvahniṃ prasamīkṣya dhanaṃ buddhiṃ śriyaṃ labhet ।।69।।
āmalakaṃ ca kamalaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca dhanavān bhavet ।
devatāśca dvijā gāvaḥ pitaraḥ sādhavo guruḥ ।।1.528.70।।
patnī patiśca nṛpatiḥ satī kanyāḥ pativratāḥ ।
yad dadāti nijaṃ svapne tadvastu prāpsyate dhruvam ।।71 ।।
śuklāmbaradharā nāryaḥ śuklamālyānulepanāḥ ।
samāśliṣyanti yaṃ svapne tasya śrīḥ sarvataḥ sukham ।।72।।
pītāmbaradharāṃ nārīṃ pītamālyānulepanām ।
avagūhati yaḥ svapne kalyāṇaṃ tasya jāyate ।।73।।
śuklaṃ sarvaṃ praśastaṃ bhasmā'sthikārpāsamantarā ।
kṛṣṇaṃ duṣṭaṃ hastivājigodvijadevamantarā ।।74।।
divyā strī sasmitā viprā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।
yasya gṛhaṃ samāyāti sa priyaṃ labhate dhruvam ।।75।।
svapne tu brāhmaṇo devo brāhmaṇī devakanyakā ।
brahmacāriṇī santuṣṭā sasmitā ca pativratā ।।76।।
phalaṃ dadāti yasmai ca tasya putro bhaviṣyati ।
yaṃ svapne brāhmaṇāḥ santaḥ prakurvanti śubhāśiṣam ।।77।।
yadvadanti ca tadvastu tasyaiśvaryaṃ ca tadbhavet ।
parituṣṭo dvijo yasya gṛhamāyāti tasya vai ।।78।।
sampattistasya cāyāti yaśaśca vipulaṃ sukham ।
pade pade sukhaṃ tasya sa mānaṃ gauravaṃ labhet ।।79।।
akasmādapi tu svapne labhate surabhiṃ yadi ।
bhūmilābho bhavettasya patnī cāpi pativratā ।।1.528.80।।
kareṇa kṛtvā hastī yaṃ mastake sthāpayed yadi ।
rājyalābho bhavettasyā''cāryapadaṃ guroḥ padam ।।81 ।।
svapne vipraḥ pratuṣṭaḥ san samāśliṣyati yaṃ janam ।
tīrthasnāyī śriyā yuktaḥ susampanno bhavettu saḥ ।।82।।
dvijaḥ svapne tu kusumaṃ yasmai dadāti saṃhasan ।
jayayukto dhanayukto yaśasvī ca sukhī bhavet ।।83।।
svapne vilokya tīrthāni saudharatnagṛhāṇi ca ।
tīrthasnāyī dhanavāṃśca jayayukto bhaveddhi saḥ ।।84।।
svapne yaṃ pūrṇakalaśaṃ kaścit kasmai dadāti cet ।
putralābho grahītuḥ syāt sampadaścākṣayāstathā ।।85।।
haste dhṛtvā kuḍavaṃ cāḍhakaṃ vā vārasundarī ।
yasya gṛhaṃ samāyāti sa lakṣmīṃ vipulāṃ labhet ।।86।।
divyā strī yadgṛhaṃ gatvā purīṣaṃ visṛjed yadi ।
arthalābho bhavettasya dāridryaṃ tu prayātyapi ।।87।।
yasya gṛhaṃ samāyāti brāhmaṇo bhāryayā saha ।
pārvatyā saha śaṃbhurvā lakṣmyā nārāyaṇo'thavā ।।88।।
sādhuḥ sādhvī gururgurvī svapne yasmai dadāti vai ।
dhānyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ svarṇaṃ tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī ।।89।।
muktāhāraṃ puṣpamālyaṃ candanaṃ brāhmaṇo'rpayate ।
yasmai tasya gṛhe lakṣmīstathā śrīḥ sarvatomukhī ।।1.528.90।।
gorocanaṃ patākāṃ ca haridrāmikṣudaṇḍakam ।
siddhānnaṃ ca labhet svapne tasya śrīḥ sarvatomukhī ।।91।।
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇī vāpi dadāti yasya mastake ।
chatraṃ puṣpaṃ śukladhānyaṃ sa ca rājā bhaved dhruvam ।।92।।
svapne rathasthitaḥ śuklamālyalepanaśobhitaḥ ।
bhuṃkte dadhi dugdhapākaṃ sa vai rājā bhavediti ।।93।।
svapne vipro'thavā viprā yasmai sudhāṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ।
dadāti svarṇapātrādi so'pi rājā bhaved dhruvam ।।94।।
kumāro cāṣṭavarṣīyā ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitā ।
yasya tuṣṭā bhavet svapne sa bhavet kavipaṇḍitaḥ ।।95।।
dadāti cet pustakaṃ sā sa syādvai paṇḍiteśvaraḥ ।
māteva cetpāṭhayati syātsārvabhaumapaṇḍitaḥ ।।96 ।।
piteva pāṭhayed vipro yaṃ so'pi syād bṛhaspatiḥ ।
prāpnoti pustakaṃ svapne sa khyātaḥ paṇḍito bhavet ।।97।।
svapne vipro yaṃ sumantraṃ dadāti pratimāṃ tathā ।
yasmai sa mantrasiddhimān guṇavān dhanavān bhavet ।।98।।
vipro viprāśiṣaṃ labdhvā kavirnṛpo dhanī bhavet ।
viprastuṣṭaḥ sasyayuktāṃ sadhānyāṃ pṛthvīṃ jane ।।99।।
svapne dadāti sa vai syādavaśyaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
svapne vipro rathe kṛtvā svargādikaṃ pradarśayet ।। 1.528.10 0।।
yaṃ sa bhavetu dīrghāyuściraṃjīvī dhanādhipaḥ ।
viprāya vipraḥ santuṣṭo yasmai kanyāṃ dadāti ca ।। 10 1।।
svapne sa tu bhavennityaṃ dhanāḍhya_ pṛthivīpatiḥ ।
svapne sarovaraṃ cābdhiṃ nadīṃ nadaṃ pravīkṣya ca ।। 1 02।।
śvetasarpaṃ śvetaśailaṃ dṛṣṭvā śriyamavāpnuyāt ।
yaṃ paśyati mṛtaṃ svapne sa bhaveccirajīvanaḥ ।। 1 03।।
arogī rogiṇaṃ duḥkhī sukhinaṃ vīkṣya syāttathā ।
divyā strī yaṃ pravadati mama svāmī bhavāniti ।। 1 04।।
svapne dṛṣṭvā ca jāgarti sa ca rājā bhaved dhruvam ।
svapne tu kālikāṃ dṛṣṭvā labdhvā sphaṭikamālikām ।। 1 05।।
indracāpaṃ śakravajraṃ sa pratiṣṭhāṃ labhed dhruvām ।
svapne viprastu yaṃ vakti mama dāso bhaveti ca ।। 1 06।।
haridāsyaṃ sa bhaktiṃ ca labdhvā suvaiṣṇavo bhavet ।
svapne vipro hariḥ śaṃbhurbrahmāṇī kamalā śivāḥ ।। 1 07।।
śuklā strī devamātā vā jāhnavī vā sarasvatī ।
gopālikā satī sādhvī kanyakā ca pativratā ।।1 08।।
dṛśyate suprasannā ca tathāśīrvādadāyinī ।
draṣṭā bhaved devatulyo nṛpo vā''cāryasattamaḥ ।। 1 09।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ te'trā''vaṭya! susvapnajaṃ phalam ।
dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ māṃ ca svapne mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।। 1.528.11 0।।
āvaṭyaḥ prāha bhagavan! daśa kalpā gatā mama ।
lomaśasya pratāpena tava yogakṛtaṃ phalam ।। 111 ।।
samāsādya prayāmyadya tava dhāma sanātanam ।
ityuktvā divyadehena kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayam ।।1 1 2।।
divyayānaṃ samāruhya yayāvakṣaradhāma saḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāllakṣmi jīvanmukto bhavejjanaḥ ।। 1 13।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āvaṭyākhyaṛṣeḥ svapne'nekadhāmadarśanottaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena susvapnānāṃ phalānyabhihitāni śrutvā''vaṭyo muktiṃ jagāmetyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāviṃśatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।528।।


← adhyāyaḥ 528 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 529
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 530 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-.
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi pāpaṃ yeṣāṃ tu darśane ।
duḥsvapnaṃ pāpabījaṃ ca kevalaṃ vighnakāraṇam ।। 1 ।।
goghnaṃ ca brāhmaṇaghnaṃ vā kṛtaghnaṃ kuṭilaṃ tathā ।
devaghnaṃ pitṛmātṛghnaṃ pāpaṃ viśvāsaghātinam ।। 2 ।।
mithyāsākṣipradātāraṃ tathā''tithyavivañcakam ।
devavipradravyahārikṣetrahāriṇamityapi ।। 3 ।।
aśvatthaghātinaṃ vṛndāghātinaṃ devanindakam ।
sādhuvidveṣiṇaṃ serṣyamanācāraṃ ca devalam ।। 4 ।।
chinnanāsāṃ patibhaktihīnāṃ ca vyabhicāriṇīm ।
vidhavāṃ krodhitaṃ duṣṭamṛṇagrastaṃ ca jārajam ।। 5 ।।
cauraṃ mithyāvādinaṃ ca rāhugrastaṃ vidhuṃ ravim ।
dṛṣṭvā snānaṃ prakuryāccāpyaṣṭottaraśataṃ japān ।। 6 ।।
naṣṭacandro na dṛśyo'sti bhādre māsisitā'site ।
caturthyāmuditaścandro na dṛṣṭavyaḥ kadācana ।। 7 ।।
candrastārāpaharaṇaṃ kalaṃkamatidurvaham ।
tasmai dadāti sandraṣṭre kāmato yadi paśyati ।। 8 ।।
akāmato naro dṛṣṭvā mantrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya cā'kalaṃkine ।। 9 ।।
candrakalaṃkasaṃhartrai tārāśuddhipravādine' ।
itimantreṇa saṃpūtaṃ jalaṃ sādhu pibet tadā ।। 1.529.1 0।।
śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
rāhugrastaḥ kathaṃ sūryo na dṛṣṭavyaḥ śaśī tathā ।
sandehaṃ nāśaya me'tra karuṇāvaruṇālaya ।। 11 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ekadā jamadagniśca mahākautūhalānvitaḥ ।
reṇukāsahitastuṣṭo jagāma narmadātaṭam ।। 1 2।।
nirjane ca divā patnyāḥ kāmabhogaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
patnīcchayā na tu svayecchayā tasyāḥ pratuṣṭaye ।। 1 3।।
atha sūryo dharmasākṣī ṛṣiṃ provāca dharmavit ।
svayaṃ jñātā dharmakartā prapautrau brahmaṇo bhavān ।। 14।।
mahātapasvī tejasvī brahmacārī ca suvratī ।
divā saṃgaṃ striyāḥ kurvan dharmaṃ tyajati vai katham ।।15।।
ahaṃ ca dharmiṇāṃ sākṣī tena tvāṃ kathayāmi te ।
uvāca sūryaṃ tāmrākṣaḥ krodhamātrāṃ samāśritaḥ ।। 16।।
tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo yathā ।
tvayā saṃjñā vaḍavā sā divā cāliṃgitā katham ।। 17।।
yena nāsāvivarāccā'śvinī putrau babhūvatuḥ ।
kāmadagdhā bhajamānā yuvatī yadi cecchati ।। 18।।
tasyāḥ kāmānalaḥ śāmya iti patyurvṛṣo mahān ।
kastvaṃ dharmapravaktā me yāhi svasthānameva ca ।। 1 9।।
adya me nirjane sthāne kāmabhaṃgastvayā kṛtaḥ ।
mama śāpāt pāpadṛśyo rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi ।।1.529.20।।
svatejasā kṛtagarvāt hatatejā bhaviṣyasi ।
meghācchannaḥ svalpatejāḥ pāpadṛśyastathā bhava ।।21 ।।
iti śapto raviḥ prāha brāhmaṇam ṛṣipuṃgavam ।
kṣamasva vaiṣṇavaḥ śuddhaḥ svadharmaṃ ca samācara ।।22।।
ahaṃ yathā tvayā śapto mayā śapto bhavāँstathā ।
parābhūtaḥ kṣatriyeṇa bhaviṣyasi dvijeśvara ।।23।।
maraṇaṃ kṣatriyāstreṇa bhavataśca bhaviṣyati ।
jamadagniḥ raviṃ prāha śaṃbhunā tvaṃ patiṣyasi ।। 24।।
śāpanistāraṇaṃ tatra cakāra viśvasṛṭ svayam ।।25।।
jamadagne! ṛṣimadhye sthānaṃ svarge vadhe'pi te ।
bhaviṣyati madāyustvaṃ śānto bhava sukhī bhava ।।26।।
sūryaṃ prāha tato brahmā kutracid divase prage ।
ghanācchanno'pi sadyastvaṃ dṛśyo mukto bhaviṣyasi ।।27।।
nyūnātiriktavarṣe ca rāhugrasto bhaviṣyasi ।
astakāle ghanācchanne madhyāhnasthe jale'pi ca ।।28।।
ardhodite ca samaye pāpadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi ।
anyathā sarvakālena puṇyadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi ।।।29।।
mālīsumālīyuddhena śaṃbhunā tvaṃ parājitaḥ ।
punaḥ svargaṃ gataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ jayamāpsyasi mā śucaḥ ।।1.529.3 0 ।।
jamadagniṃ punaḥ prāha maraṇe'pi ca te suta ।
nārāyaṇo nijāṃśena tava putro bhaviṣyati ।।3 1 ।।
tasya parākrameṇāpi yaśaste śāśvataṃ bhavet ।
ityuktvā tau visṛjyaiva brahmā satyaṃ samāyayau ।।32।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi sūryasyā'darśanaṃ tadā ।
candro bhādre caturthyāṃ ca tārāṃ jahāra kāmataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
śaśāpa tārā kopena niṣkāmā sā pativratā ।
adya tvayā gurupatnī spṛṣṭā tasmācca taddine ।।34।।
pāpadṛśyo hi sarveṣāṃ kalaṃkado bhaviṣyasi ।
rāhugrasto ghanagrastaḥ pāpadṛśyo bhaviṣyasi ।।35।।
kalaṃkī bhava cetyevaṃ proktvā kāmaṃ jagāda sā ।
tejasvinā kenacit tvaṃ bhasmībhūto bhaviṣyasi ।।36।।
ataścandrastadārabhya pāpadṛśyo'sti tattithau ।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! pāpadṛśyatvakāraṇam ।।37।।
duḥsvapnaṃ te kathayāmi yadvai duṣṭaphalapradam ।
svapne hasati yo harṣād vivāhaṃ yadi paśyati ।। 38।।
nartanaṃ gītamiṣṭaṃ ca vipattistasya niścitā ।
dantā yasya vipīḍyante vicarantaṃ ca paśyati ।।39।।
dhanahānirbhavettasya pīḍā cāpi śarīrajā ।
kanyā ghaṭaṃ samādāya yasya gṛhāt pragacchati ।।1.529.40।।
svastrī vā krodhasampannā svasyā''layātprayātyapi ।
svapne draṣṭurbhavellakṣmīnāśo dāridryamityapi ।।41 ।।
abhyaṃgitastu tailena yo gacched dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ।
kharoṣṭramahiṣārūḍho mṛtyustasya na saṃśayaḥ ।।42।।
svapne karṇe japāpuṣpamaśokaṃ karavīrakam ।
lavaṇaṃ paśyati tailaṃ vipattistasya vai bhavet ।।43।।
nagnāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ chinnanāsāṃ bhṛtyāṃ vā vidhavāṃ ca vā ।
kapardakaṃ tālaphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śokamavāpnuyāt ।।44।।
svapne ruṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca brāhmaṇīṃ krodhitāṃ tathā ।
dṛṣṭvā bhaved vipattiśca lakṣmyā nirgamanaṃ tathā ।।45।।
vanapuṣpaṃ raktapuṣpaṃ palāśaṃ puṣpitaṃ tathā ।
kārpāsaṃ śuklavastraṃ ca dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।।46।।
gāyantīṃ ca hasantīṃ ca kṛṣṇavastrānvitāṃ striyam ।
svapne kṛṣṇāṃ vidhavāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।।47।।
devatā yatra nṛtyanti gāyanti ca hasanti ca ।
āsphoṭayanti dhāvanti tasya vai maraṇaṃ bhavet। ।।48।।
vāntaṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca vaidyaṃ raupyaṃ suvarṇakam ।
pratyakṣamathavā svapne jīved draṣṭā daśāhakam ।।49।।
kṛṣṇavastrā kṛṣṇamālā kṛṣṇalepādimaṇḍitā ।
upagūhati yaṃ nārī tasya mṛtyurdhruvo bhavet ।।1.529.50।।
mṛtavatsaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ ca mṛgasya ca narasya ca ।
asthimālāṃ vindate yastasya vipattiracyutā ।।51 ।।
rathaṃ kharoṣṭrasaṃyuktamekākī yo'dhirohati ।
tatrastho'pi ca jāgarti mṛtyustasya daśāhake ।।52।।
abhyaṃgitastu haviṣā kṣīreṇa madhunā'pi ca ।
takreṇāpi guḍenāpi tasya pīḍā bhavedati ।।53।।
raktavastrā raktamālā raktalepādimaṇḍitā ।
upagūhati yaṃ svapne vyādhistasya bhaved dhruvaḥ ।।54।।
nakhakeśāṃśca patitān bhasmānvitacitāṃ tathā ।
dṛṣṭvā nirvāṇakāṅgārān mṛtyumāpnoti niścitam ।।55।।
śmaśānaṃ śuṣkakāṣṭhaṃ ca loṣṭhaṃ śuṣkatṛṇāni ca ।
kiṃcitkṛṣṇaṃ vājinaṃ ca śamīṃ dṛṣṭvā'tiduḥkhabhāg ।।56।।
pādukāṃ phalakaṃ raktaṃ puṣpamālyaṃ bhayānakam ।
māṣaṃ masūra mudgaṃ vā dṛṣṭvā sadyo vraṇī bhavet ।।57।।
kaṭakaṃ saraṭaṃ kākaṃ bhallūkaṃ vānaraṃ gavam ।
pūyaṃ gātramalaṃ svapne paśyati vyādhimān bhavet ।।58।।
bhagnabhāṇḍaṃ kṣataṃ śūdraṃ galatkuṣṭhaṃ ca rogiṇam ।
raktāmbaraṃ ca jaṭilaṃ sūkaraṃ mahiṣaṃ kharam ।।59।।
mahāghoraṃ cāndhakāraṃ mṛtaṃ jīvaṃ bhayapradam ।
yoniliṃgaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā svapne vipattimāpnuyāt ।।1.529.60।।
kuveṣarūpaṃ mlecchaṃ ca yamadūtān bhayānakān ।
pāśaśastrānvitahastān dṛṣṭvā mṛtyuṃ labhed drutam ।।61 ।।
vipro viprā suto bālaḥ sutā bālā ruṣā yadi ।
vilāpaṃ kurute svapne draṣṭā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।।62।।
kṛṣṇaṃ kusumaṃ tanmālāṃ sasyaṃ śastrāstradhāriṇam ।
mlecchāṃ ca vikṛtākārāṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।।63।।
tyaktaprāṇaṃ mṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā śavaṃ mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।
matsyādi dhārayed yo hi tadbhrāturmaraṇaṃ bhavet ।।64।।
vādyaṃ ca nartanaṃ gītaṃ gāyanaṃ raktavāsasam ।
mṛdaṃgaṃ vādyamānaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।।65।।
chinnaṃ vāpi kabandhaṃ vā vikṛtaṃ muktamūrdhajam ।
kṣipraṃ nṛtyaṃ prakurvantaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt ।।66।।
mṛto vāpi mṛtā vāpi kṛṣṇamlecchā bhayānakā ।
upagūhati yaṃ svapne svayaṃ tāṃ vopagūhati ।।67।।
svasya śavaṃ tathā vīkṣya kṣipraṃ mṛtyuṃ pradhārayet। ।
yasya dantāḥ prabhagnāśca keśā yasya patanti ca ।।68।।
dhanahānirdehapīḍā bhavettasya pade pade ।
upadravanti yaṃ svapne śṛṃgiṇo daṃṣṭriṇastathā ।।69।।
bālakā mānavāścāpi gṛhasya ca kuṭumbinaḥ ।
anye bhṛtyāstathā tasya bhaved rājakulād bhayam ।।1.529.70।।
vṛkṣaṃ chinnaṃ patantaṃ ca śilāvṛṣṭiṃ tuṣaṃ kṣuram ।
raktāṃgāraṃ bhasmavṛṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamavāpnuyāt ।।71 ।।
gṛhaṃ patantaṃ śailaṃ vā dhūmaketuṃ bhayapradam ।
bhagnaskandhaṃ naraṃ vāpi dṛṣṭvā duḥkhī bhavejjanaḥ ।।72।।
vṛkṣācchailādrathādgehādgorgajātturagācca khāt ।
bhūmau yaḥ patati svapne vipattistasya niścitā ।।73।।
uccaiḥ patanti garteṣu bhasmāṃgārayuteṣu ca ।
kṣārakuṇḍeṣu cūrṇeṣu mṛtyusteṣāṃ bhaved dhruvam ।।74।।
balād gṛhṇāti duṣṭaśca chatramuṣṇīṣameva kāt ।
piturnāśo bhavettasya gurorvāpi nṛpasya vā ।।75।।
surabhiryasya gehāttu yāti trastā savitsakā ।
prayāti gṛhatastasya lakṣmīḥ kṣitiśca māninī ।।76।।
yamapāśanibaddho yo yamadūtaiśca nīyate ।
mlecchaiścauraistathā'nyairvā tasya mṛtyuḥ samīpagaḥ ।।77।।
gaṇako brāhmaṇo vāpi brāhmaṇī vā guruḥ satī ।
sādhurvā śapati ruṣṭo vipattistasya bhāvinī ।।78।।
śatravaḥ kukkuṭāḥ kākā bhallukāśca virodhinaḥ ।
patantyāgatya yadgātre tasya mṛtyurhi niścitaḥ ।।79।।
mahiṣā bhallukā uṣṭrāḥ sūkarā gardabhāstathā ।
ruṣṭā dhāvanti yaṃ svapne sa rogī niścitaṃ bhavet ।।1.529.80।।
raktacandanakāṣṭhāni ghṛtāktāni juhoti yaḥ ।
gāyatryāśca sahasreṇa tena śāntirvidhīyate ।।81 ।।
yadaniṣṭaṃ bhavet svasya svapne dṛśyeta ced yadi ।
aniṣṭakārakaṃ tasyādiṣṭaṃ syādiṣṭakārakam ।।82।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇanāmnāṃ japānniṣpāpatāṃ vrajet ।
duḥsvapnastatphalaṃ dātuṃ samartho na bhavettadā ।।83।।
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca śrīhariṃ śivam ।
śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ rādhikāṃ jānakīṃ prabhāṃ ca pārvatīm ।।84।।
japan dvādaśa duḥsvapnaḥ satphaladaḥ prajāyate ।
'oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīṃ duḥkhahantryai durgāyai te namaḥ svāhā' ।।85।।
mantraṃ vai daśadhā japtvā duḥsvapnaḥ śubhado bhavet ।
śatalakṣajapātsiddhaḥ siddhiṃ dadāti vāñchitām ।।86।।
oṃ namo mṛtyuñjayāya svāheti lakṣadhā japet ।
dṛṣṭvā'pi maraṇaṃ svapne śatāyurjāpako bhavet ।।87।।
pūrvottaramukho bhūtvā svapnaṃ prājñe śucau dvije ।
gurau deve divyajane phaladaṃ syāt prakāśayet ।।88।।
aśvatthe gaṇake vipre pitṛdevā''saneṣu ca ।
ārye ca vaiṣṇave mitre patyau svapnaṃ prakāśayet। ।।89।।
kāśyape durgate nīce devasadvipranindake ।
mūrkhe jaḍe'nabhijñe ca krūre svapnaṃ na varṇayet ।।1.529.90।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! lokānāmupakārakam ।
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ paṭhanāchravaṇādapi ।।91 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kvacit sūryacandrayoradarśane śāpavarṇanaṃ duṣṭasvapnatatphalatannivāraṇādivarṇanamitinirūpaṇanāmaikonatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 529।।



← adhyāyaḥ 529 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 530
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 531 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
mānavānāṃ vividhānāmitikartavyatāvratam ।
upakārāya me brūhi yathā mokṣodayo bhavet ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ahiṃsā sarvato jyeṣṭhā sarveṣāṃ puṇyadaṃ vratam ।
ātmane tuṣṭidānaṃ ca paraṃ puṇyapradaṃ matam ।। 2 ।।
yathākathañcijjīvānāṃ deyaṃ sukhaṃ ca toṣaṇam ।
kāyena manasā vācā kriyayā vastubhistathā ।। 3 ।।
āśīrvādāśca labhyante śreyo mokṣaśca sampadaḥ ।
snānaṃ dhyānaṃ mama pūjā naivedyaṃ sevanaṃ tathā ।। 4 ।।
paropakāraḥ santoṣaḥ kartavyāni sadā janaiḥ ।
viṣṇuprasādabhojī ca jīvanmukto bhavejjanaḥ ।। ।5 ।।
viṣṇumantraṃ gṛhītvā ca kṛtvā vai gurusevanam ।
dhyātvā kṛṣṇapadāmbhojaṃ mokṣasthānamavāpnuyāt ।। 6 ।।
gurūṇāṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ kartavyaṃ poṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ pitā svasya mahān guruḥ ।। 7 ।।
pituḥ śataguṇā mātā mātuḥ śataguṇaḥ suraḥ ।
surasya mantradaścaturguṇo gururhi mokṣadaḥ ।। 8 ।।
mokṣadasya śataguṇo jñānamokṣaprado guruḥ ।
guruḥ pratyakṣa īśeśo gururnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 9 ।।
uddeśe dīyate tasmai surāya gurave śruteḥ ।
pratyakṣabhoktā svaguruḥ svayaṃ dehī janārdanaḥ ।। 1.530.1 0।।
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgurureva svayaṃ śivaḥ ।
śrīgurau sarvadevā vai tiṣṭhanti satataṃ mudā ।। 11 ।।
gurau tuṣṭe haristuṣṭastena tuṣyanti devatāḥ ।
vaiṣṇavaḥ śrīhareprāptikaro gururnarāyaṇaḥ ।। 12।।
brāhmaṇo vaiṣṇavo nityaṃ gururmuktaḥ suraiḥ samaḥ ।
tasya pādodakaṃ pītvā śuddhyanti prāṇino hyaghāt ।। 1 3।।
viṣṇuprasādabhojī tu pavitrāṃ kurute mahīm ।
vaikuṇṭhe modate so'nte pārṣado hariṇā saha ।। 14।।
tadāśrayaḥ prakartavyo grāhyo mantrastato'pi ca ।
mantragrahaṇamātreṇa jīvanmuktaḥ prajāyate ।। 15।।
puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ sa līlayā tūddharet śuciḥ ।
kriyā viṣṇupade yasya saṃkalpāśca tadarpitāḥ ।। 16।।
sa eva śrīharirbodhyo na me tasmātparaḥ priyaḥ ।
mantraṃ kvāpi na gṛhṇīyāt daridrād bhaktivarjitāt ।। 17।।
āmiṣaṃ sarvathā bodhyaṃ mama naivedyavarjitam ।
yadyapi syāt sudhātulyaṃ tadabhakṣyaṃ prakīrtitam ।। 18।।
dharmavyādhena vai putrīṃ purā jñātvā śuciṃ dvijam ।
mataṃgaputraṃ mātaṃgaṃ tasmai dattā yataḥ khalu ।। 1 9।।
pavitrasya gṛhe putryāḥ paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati ।
iti vicārya dattā sā kintvekasmin dine punaḥ ।।1.530.20।।
śvaśrūraḥ snuṣāṃ jagādedaṃ vyādhaje! hiṃsakātmaje! ।
kiṃ jānāsi dharmakṛtyamaśuddhe! kalahaṃkari! ।।21 ।।
iti śrūtvā tu sā kanyā yayau svajanakaṃ prati ।
prāha māṃ vyādhaje! ceti śvaśrūḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ ।।।22।।।
vyādho jagāma jāmāturgṛhaṃ prāha sukhodayam ।
bhojanaṃ pradadau śvaśrūrvinā devaniveditam ।।23।।
na tatra devapūjāpi nā'nnaśuddhirvilokitā ।
vaiśvadevaḥ kṛto naiva nā'tithiḥ pūjitastathā ।।24।।
jalaṃ na gālitaṃ cāpi vahnau ghṛtaṃ na cārpitam ।
vyāhṛtirna kṛtā tatra snānaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na vai gṛhe ।।25।।
gogrāso bhūtasaṃgrāso na jāmātrā kṛtopi hi ।
na devakīrtanaṃ cāpi na sūryanamanaṃ tathā ।।26।।
śvaśrṛ'gṛhe tadīyaistu daivaṃ paitryaṃ na vai kṛtam ।
tatsarvaṃ vīkṣya kanyāyāḥ pitā prabhojanā''sane ।।re7।।
sthitvā prāha mayā tvedad grāhyaṃ naiva bhavedyataḥ ।
tasyānnaṃ tvāmiṣaṃ proktaṃ yad devāya na cārpyate ।।28।।
jalaṃ ca vāruṇītulyaṃ devapādāmṛtaṃ vinā ।
tasmānmayā na bhoktavyaṃ bhavadīyaṃ prabhojanam ।।29।।
mayā putrī yato dattā jñātvā dharmagṛhaṃ śubham ।
mokṣārthaṃ sā pradattā vai na tu pāpādanāya vai ।।1.530.3 0।।
yatra sandhyā japo dhyānaṃ devārcanaṃ samarpaṇam ।
kiñcinnāsti tadannaṃ cāmiṣaṃ vāri surāsamam ।।3 1 ।।
mayā tvajānatā putrī sākṣānnarake pātitā ।
tvadgṛhānme śuddhirasti devanaivedyajā sadā ।।32।।
vinā devārpaṇaṃ nāhaṃ bhunajmi tu kadācana ।
vyādhaputrīti vai proktā na tattathyaṃ vacastava ।।33।।
harenaiṃvedyahīno vai vyādhaḥ satyatayocyate ।
tasmādvyādho mataṃgastvaṃ brahmakarmavivarjitaḥ ।।34।।
ahaṃ jātyāpi cedvyādhaḥ karmaṇā naiva naiva ca ।
tvaṃ karmaṇā mahāvyādhatulyo bhavasi nityadā ।।35।।
nā'haṃ putrīṃ preṣayiṣye gṛhaṃ te punarāgame ।
ityuktvā prayayau vyādho vaiṣṇavo bhaktarāḍa gṛham ।।36।।
kṛtvā kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sarvaṃ bubhuje'nnajalādikam ।
tasmāllakṣmi! sarvavarṇairarpitaṃ me śubhaṃ bhavet ।।37।।
divyaṃ pramokṣadaṃ tvannaṃ jalaṃ patraṃ dalādikam ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ sadā bhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca nirāmiṣam ।। 38।।
āmiṣasya parityāgāt sūryavattejasā bhavet ।
anivedya prabhoktā tu surāmiṣāśano bhavet ।।3 9।।
śrāddhaṃ dadyāt sadā toyaṃ dadyādvai pitṛdaivataḥ ।
mātā pitā gururbhāryā śiṣyaḥ putraḥ svasā sutā ।।1.530.40।।
anāthā pitṛvaṃśīyā nityaṃ poṣyā gurupriyā ।
tāsāṃ vai poṣaṇāt kṛṣṇaścāntarātmā prasīdati ।। 41 ।।
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya yatkiñcinnāhaṃ kartā'smi karmaṇām ।
karmaṇā manasā vācā satataṃ cintayettathā ।।42।।
sarvārpaṇaṃ bhavet karma pūrvakarmanikṛntanam ।
bhakṣyā'bhakṣyaṃ vicāryaiva kartavyaṃ karmakṛntanam ।।43।।
ayaspātre payaḥpānaṃ gavyaṃ siddhānnamityapi ।
bhrāṣṭrādikaṃ guḍaṃ madhu nālikerodakaṃ tathā ।।44।।
phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca yatkiñcidayaḥpātre na bhakṣayet ।
dagdhānnaṃ cātitaptaṃ cocchiṣṭaṃ paryuṣitaṃ tathā ।।45।।
mādakaṃ jīvahiṃsotthamabhakṣyaṃ ca parasya yat ।
nālikerodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmrapātre sthitaṃ madhu ।।46।।
gavyaṃ ca tāmrapātrasthaṃ sarve madyaṃ vinā ghṛtam ।
dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ madhumiśraṃ tailaṃ guḍaṃ ghṛtam ।।47।।
pītaśeṣajalaṃ māghe mūlakaṃ bhādrake dadhi ।
hastāddhastagṛhītāni rasāni naiva bhakṣayet ।।48।।
karpūraṃ raupyapātrasthaṃ bhraṣṭaspṛṣṭaṃ na bhakṣayet। ।।
hiṃsrakīnāṃ sūkarīṇāṃ camarīṇāṃ vanaukasām ।। 4 9।।
hariṇīnāṃ vānarīṇāṃ bhallukīnāṃ payastathā ।
vājinyuṣṭrīkareṇūnāṃ kharīṇāṃ gavayībhavam ।।1.530.50।।
geṇḍīnāṃ citrakīnāṃ ca dugdhādi naiva bhakṣayet ।
agālitaṃ payo vāri takraṃ tailaṃ ghṛtādikam ।।51 ।।
anivedyaṃ hareścāpi sarvamabhakṣyameva yat ।
pipīlikāmiśritaṃ ca madhu gavyaṃ guḍaṃ rasam ।।52।।।
pakṣibhakṣyaṃ kīṭabhakṣyaṃ śuddhaṃ pakvaphalādikam ।
kākabhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dravyamityapi ।।53।।
ghṛtapakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ pakvaṃ kevalavahninā ।
sūryapakvaṃ kālapakvaṃ bhakṣyaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaved yadi ।।54।।
sarveṣāmaśucīnāṃ ca jalamannaṃ parityajet ।
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇe śuddhiṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇajapaṃ vratam ।।55।।
śubhā'śubhaṃ tu yatkarma vinā bhogaṃ kṣayo'sya na ।
na naṣṭaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kvāpi jāyate sukṛtena vai ।।56 ।।
na naśyati sukṛtaṃ ca duṣṭakṛtenāpi karmaṇā ।
kintu puṇyena pāpasya balaṃ kṣīṇaṃ prajāyate ।।57।।
utpadyate balāt puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ kvacit parasparam ।
śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇabhāve tu navaṃ bhogyaṃ na jāyate ।।।58।।।
svargaṃ tu sukṛtenaiva nirayo duṣṭakṛtena ca ।
karmaṇā nahi mokṣaśca sa tu syānmama sevayā ।।59।।
jñānāgnau havanaṃ yasya karmaṇastattu bhasmasāt ।
mayi vā havanaṃ yasya tattu mokṣaphalaṃ dadet ।।1.530.60।।
śṛṇu pāpena lokānāṃ yathā janma prajāyate ।
yāmyadaṇḍottaraṃ janma jāyate kathayāmi tat ।।6 1 ।।
goghnaḥ syād dandaśūkaśca gauśca cāṇḍāla ityapi ।
brahmaghno viṭakṛmirbhūtvā mlecchaścāndho bhavetattaḥ ।।62।।
strīghnaḥ syād yakṣmaṇā grastaḥ śvā daridraśca sarvathā ।
garbhaghnaḥ śvā bhavetpaścād ghoṭakaśca bhavettathā ।।63।।
naraghnaśca gajendraḥ syāt tato bhavet kirātakaḥ ।
kukkuṭaḥ kukkuraḥ syānmārjāraghno viḍālakaḥ ।।64।।
sarpahā ca bhavet sarpo hastī ca ghoṭako'pi ca ।
kṣudrajantuvadhakartā kṣudrajantuḥ prajāyate ।।65।।
aśvatthaghnaḥ śālmaliḥ syāt tataḥ śūdro bhavet punaḥ ।
mithyāsākṣyapradātā ca kṛtaghno'tikṛtaghnakaḥ ।।66।।
viśvāsaghātī mitraghno bhaved gṛdhraḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
sūkaraḥ śvāpado bhūtvā tataḥ śūdraḥ prajāyate ।।67।।
vastrahārī gavyahārī raupyamuktāpahārakaḥ ।
bako bhūtvā śūdrajātistataḥ kuṣṭhī bhavediti ।।68।।
kośahārī phalahārī dravyahārī tu yakṣakaḥ ।
bhūtvā tu cāṣapakṣī syāttataḥ śūdro bhavediti ।।69।।
pakvadravyāpahārī ca kastūrīmṛgajanmabhāk ।
dhānyahartā kṛpaṇaḥ syāt svarṇahartā tu kuṣṭhavān ।।1.530.70।।
krodhī mṛtaḥ kharo maṃkoḍakaḥ sarpaśca vāyasaḥ ।
lauhacaurastu nirvaṃśo maṣīcaurastu kokilaḥ ।।71 ।।
śuko'pyañjanacaurastu miṣṭacauraḥ kṛmirbhavet ।
vipradveṣī gurudveṣī śirasāṃ sa kṛmirbhavet ।।72।।
raktadravyāpahārī ca raktadoṣānvito bhavet ।
ācārahīno mlecchaḥ syāt khañjo bhavati hiṃsakaḥ ।।73 ।।
ahaṃkārī karṇahīno badhiraḥ śāstranindakaḥ ।
vākyahartā tu mūkaḥ syāt hiṃsakaḥ keśavarjitaḥ ।।74।।
mithyāvādī śmaśruhīno durvākyo dantahīnakaḥ ।
jihvāhīnaḥ satyahārī granthacauro jaḍo bhavet ।।75।।
aśvagrāhī tvaśvacauraḥ punaścāśvaḥ prajāyate ।
tato vai ghoṭakaḥ kṣudro gajacauro gajo bhavet ।।76।।
chāgacauro bhavecchāgo dānahā mleccha eva ca ।
ekākī miṣṭabhoktā syānmakṣikā ca pipīlikā ।।77।।
tailacaurastailakāro rasacauro haridrakaḥ ।
asadoṣadhadātā ca vyālagrāhī bhavejjanaḥ ।।78।।
puṃścalī syād godhikā ca śṛgālī bhallukī tathā ।
taḍāgahā nakrajātiḥ kacchapo matsyako bhavet ।।79।।
citravastrāpahārastu mayūraḥ syād vanādiṣu ।
tejaḥpātrāpahārī ca bhavet kāraṇḍavaściram ।।1.530.80।।
surāṇāṃ pratimācauraścāndhaḥ syādvai punaḥ punaḥ ।
pitṛdevārcanahantā śṛgālaḥ śavabhug bhavet ।।81 ।।
gurudveṣī daridraḥ syād devadrohī ca dāṃbhikaḥ ।
dīpanirvāṇakartā tu khadyotaḥ syādvane vane ।।।82।।
goṇīhartā kapotaḥ syānmālāhartā vihaṃgamaḥ ।
carako dhānyacauraḥ syānmāṃsacauraśca kuṃjaraḥ ।।83।।
viduṣāṃ dukhadaḥ syāttu maṇḍuko vai punaḥ punaḥ ।
kāvyadveṣī nakulaḥ syāt kṛkalāsastataḥ param ।।84।।
kanyāvikrayakārī ca vyādhaḥ syādvai punaḥ punaḥ ।
dharmahīnaḥ paśuḥ syācca tailakārastataḥ param ।।85।।
mithyākalaṃkavaktā ca rajako mūka ityapi ।
abhicāraprakartā syād hiṃsakaḥ preta ityapi ।।86।।
mithyāvaktā ca daivajño vānaro bhāṇḍa ityapi ।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! mukhyaṃ vipākajaṃ phalam ।।87।।
yasya rāgaśceṣṭabhoge dveṣo'sti viparītake ।
tasya janma bhavet karma punaḥ punarvipākajam ।।88।।
rāgadveṣau gatau yasya buddhiryasya na lipyate ।
dharmādharmaparityāgī karmaṇā nahi badhyate ।।89।।
nendriyāṇi pravartante matvā svaviṣayān prati ।
ātmanyevā'rpaṇakartā badhyate nahi karmabhiḥ ।।1.530.90।।
nāryahaṃ vā naro'haṃ vetyevaṃ yo nābhimanyate ।
ātmabhāve sadā magnastasya karma na lipyate ।।91 ।।
duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ dve yasya samatāṃ gate ।
parasvabhāvanālopastasya karma na lipyate ।।92।।
brahmarūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā kurvan brahmārthameva cet ।
pravṛtto vartate mayyacyute muktiṃ gato bhavet ।।93।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! karmanirbandhanaṃ mayā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya karmanikṛntanaṃ bhavet ।।94।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne manuṣyasya kartavyaṃ, vyādhakanyāmiṣeṇa hareranaivedyabhojināṃ vyādhatvam, abhakṣyanirdeśaḥ pāpaphalātmakakarmavipākajanmādidarśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā triṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।53 0।।


← adhyāyaḥ 530 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 531
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 532 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā ramye tvaśvapaṭṭasarovare ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre ṛṣayaścāyayurmudā ।। 1 ।।
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīṃ kartuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।
jayantyā utsave tvanye raivatācalavāsinaḥ ।। 2 ।।
vyomamārgeṇa saśiṣyā jvalanto brahmatejasā ।
pulahaśca pulastyaśca kratuśca bhṛguraṅgirāḥ ।। 3 ।।
pracetāśca vaśiṣṭhaśca durvāsāḥ kaṇva ityapi ।
kātyāyanaḥ pāṇiniśca kaṇādo gautamastathā ।। 4 ।।
sanakaśca sanandaśca tathā ṛṣiḥ sanātanaḥ ।
kapilaścāsuriścāpi vāyuḥ pañcaśikhastathā ।। 5 ।।
viśvāmitro vālmīkiśca kaśyapaśca parāśaraḥ ।
vibhāṇḍako marīciśca śukro'triśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 6 ।।
gārgyo vātsyo vātsyāyano vyāsaśca jaiministathā ।
mitavāgṛṣyasaṃgaśca yājñavalkyaśca maṃkaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
saubhariḥ śuddhajaṭilo bharadvājaḥ subhadrakaḥ ।
mārvaṇḍeyo bagadāda āsuriśca viṭaṃkaṇaḥ ।। 8 ।।
aṣṭāvakraḥ śatānando vāmadevaśca bhāguriḥ ।
saṃvartaścāpyutathyaśca naraśca nāradastathā ।। 9 ।।
jābāliḥ parśurāmaścāpyagastyaḥ paila ityapi ।
śālāyano gauramukho'pyupamanyuḥ śrutaśravāḥ ।। 1.531.10 ।।
maitreyaścyavanaścāpi vararuciḥ suparṇakaḥ ।
svayaṃprakāśo viśvātmā sāyaṇaḥ pippalāyanaḥ ।। 11 ।।
ete cānye pramūrdhanyāḥ samājagmurmahotsave ।
tān dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya namaskṛtya puṭāṃjaliḥ ।। 1 2।।
kuśāsaneṣu ramyeṣu vāsayāmāsa lomaśaḥ ।
pūjayāmāsa vidhivat kuśalapraśnapūrvakam ।। 1 3।।
etasminnantare vyomni tejorāśiḥ prakāśayan ।
diśaḥ sarvāḥ paritaścāvatatāra sanātanaḥ ।।14।।
tejaso'myantare ramyaḥ kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ ।
yathaiva pañcavarṣīyaḥ sabhāmadhye samāgataḥ ।। 15।।
praṇemurmunayaḥ sarve lomaśo nāradādayaḥ ।
cakruśca svāgataṃ bhrātuḥ sarvajyeṣṭhasya yoginaḥ ।। 16।।
bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāgatamācarat ।
sanatkumāro bhagavānuvāca tānṛṣīṃstadā ।। 17।।
bhadraṃ vo munayaḥ śaśvattapasāṃ phalamīpsitam ।
niṣphalaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe kuśalapraśnakaḥ ।। 18।।
sāmprataṃ kuśalaṃ vaśca darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ ।
bhārāvataraṇāyaiva cāvirbhūtasya sāmpratam ।। 1 9।।
uvāca śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastaṃ yoginaṃ munim ।
dehinaḥ śrīhareścāpi kuśalapraśnamīpsitam ।।1.531.20।।
sanatkumāro bhagavān prāha kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
śarīre prākṛte nāthā'kuśalasya hi saṃbhavaḥ ।।21 ।।
tatra vai kuśalapraśnaṃ yujyate dehināṃ sadā ।
nityadehe kṣemamūrtau sukhapraśnamanarthakam ।।22।।
raktabindūdbhavā dehā jīvānāṃ kṛtakarmaṇām ।
na tu vai śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'kṛtakarmaṇaḥ ।।23।।
prakṛtīśasyā'kṣarādhipaternityasvarūpiṇaḥ ।
sarveṣāmavatārāṇāṃ kāraṇasya hareḥ katham ।।24।।
nityānandaravanestasya kuśalapraśnamucyate ।
raktavīryāśrito dehastava nāsti kadāpi vai ।। 25।।
bhaktānugrahamātreṇa dṛśyase divyavigrahaḥ ।
yasyāśrayeṇa jīvānāṃ kuśalaṃ sarvadā bhavet ।।26।।
yatsparśena ca bhaktānāṃ divyatvaṃ tvādṛśaṃ bhavet ।
satvaṃ dhanyo'si bhagavan mānyo'si jagatāmapi ।।27।।
sarveśvareśvaro'si tvaṃ tvatparo nāsti viśvataḥ ।
iti kṛtvā punarnatvā cārcayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ।।28।।
śrīpatiṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cākṣaradhārakam ।
etasminnantare brahmā sāvitryā saha cāyayau ।।29।।
pārvatyā saha śaṃbhuśca dharmo mūrtyā sahā''yayau ।
ananto nāginīyuktaḥ sūryaḥ saṃjñāsamanvitaḥ ।। 1.531.3 0।।
śaśī ca rohiṇīyuktaḥ śacyā yuktaḥ sureśvaraḥ ।
ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālādyāśca devatāḥ ।।3 1।।
sahasā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścotthāya bhaktitaḥ ।
madhuparkādikaṃ datvā satkāraṃ susamācarat ।।32।।
praṇemuḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve devānṛṣīṃstataḥ surāḥ ।
ānarcuḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 33।।
athā''sane sthitaḥ sanatkumāraḥ prāha saṃsadi ।
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ paraṃdhāma na dṛṣṭaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।।34।।
dhāmā'kṣaraṃ lokitaṃ ca na dṛṣṭaścākṣarādhipaḥ ।
mayā dṛṣṭastu goloko na dṛṣṭo rādhikāpatiḥ ।।35।।
tato dṛṣṭaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ na dṛṣṭaḥ śrīramāpatiḥ ।
tato dṛṣṭaśca dugdhābdhirnāsti tatra hariḥ svayam ।।36।।
pariśrāntaviṣaṇṇena snātaṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe ।
vistīrṇe tatra kamaṭho dṛṣṭo vai naikayojanaḥ ।।37।।
dhanyo'sīti mayoktaḥ sa nāhaṃ dhanya uvāca mām ।
kṣīrodaḥ sāgaro dhanyo jantavo yatra madvidhāḥ ।।38।।
tato mayā sāgarāya dhanyavādaḥ praśrāvitaḥ ।
samudraḥ prāha māṃ nāhaṃ dhanyavādasya pātrakam ।।39।।
dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu pṛthivī lokadhāriṇī ।
yatra saptābdhayo nityaṃ vasanti ca vitastike ।।1.531.40 ।।
tato mayā pṛthivyai ca dhanyavādaḥ pravarṇitaḥ ।
pṛthivyāha ca māṃ nāhaṃ dhanyavādasya pātrikā ।।41।।
dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu śeṣo'nanto mamā''sanam ।
yatrā'nantāni cāṇḍāni phaṇāyāṃ santyaṇuryathā ।।42।।
tato mayā hyanantāya dhanyavādaḥ samarpitāḥ ।
anantaḥ prāha māṃ nā'haṃ dhanyavādasya pātrakam ।।43।।
dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu kūrmo mamāśrayo mahān ।
yasya pīṭhe mādṛśā vai śeṣā vasantyasaṃkhyakāḥ ।।44।।
tato mayā kacchapāya dhanyavādaḥ samīritaḥ ।
kacchapaḥ prāha māṃ nā'haṃ dhanyavādasya bhūmikā ।।45।।
dhanyavādasya vai bhūmirāpo yatra vasāmyaham ।
apsu santi mādṛśā vai kacchapāḥ koṭiśo mune ।।46 ।।
tato mayā mahādbhyaśca dhanyavādaḥ pravartitaḥ ।
āpaḥ prāhustu māṃ dhanyavādārhā na vayaṃ mune ।।47।।
dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu mahātejo jalāśrayam ।
tato mayā mahātejomūrtaye dhanyatā'rpitā ।।48।।
mahātejaśca māṃ prāha mahāvāyorhi dhanyatā ।
yogyā'sti ca mayā vāyurdhanyavādena yojitaḥ ।।49।।
yatrā'nantāni vai sṛṣṭimaṇḍalāni taranti hi ।
vāyuḥ prāha ca māṃ nā'haṃ dhanyavādārha īśvaraḥ ।।1.531.50।।
dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu vyomākāśo hi vartate ।
mayā vyomne'rpito dhanyapravādo vyoma cāha mām ।।।51 ।।
nā'haṃ dhanyo jaḍākāśaścotpattināśavānaham ।
dhanyavādasya pātraṃ tu cidākāśo yato mama ।।52।।
samutpattirvināśaśca sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau prajāyate ।
ahaṃ yasyaikadeśe'smi mayi brahmā haro hariḥ ।।53।।
vairājaromabhūmisthā vartante śatavārṣikāḥ ।
ahaṃ tato dadau cidākāśāya dhanyatāṃ muhuḥ ।।54।।
cidākāśaśca māṃ prāha nā'haṃ dhanyasya pātrakam ।
dhanyasya pātratā śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe prabhau ।।55।।
akṣareśe'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇe pumuttame ।
yujyate parameśāne'vatārāṇāṃ vidhāyake ।।56।।
anantapāre sarveśe yasmātsarve pravartate ।
yasyaikaromakiraṇāccidākāśā anantakāḥ ।।57।।
yatra golokadhāmādyāḥ prakāśante sthale sthale ।
tādṛkcaitanyagaganavrātā yatkiraṇāt khalu ।।58।।
tamrā'nādiśrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇe hi dhanyatām ।
dehi sanatkumāra tvaṃ sarvadhanyatamāśraye ।।59।।
yatra muktā nivasanti yato'vatārakoṭayaḥ ।
yato vyūhā vāsudevaprabhṛtayo bhavanti ca ।।1.531.60।।
yato dharmo yato vedā yatrā'ntaryāmitā sthitā ।
vyāpakaścānvayī yaśca sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktimān ।।6 1 ।।
yato yajñāḥ karmakāṇḍāḥ pravṛttiścātmanāṃ yataḥ ।
yatra cānte nivṛttiśca karmaphalaṃ yato bhavet ।।62।।
phaladātā karmahetuḥ sarvādiḥ sarvakārakaḥ ।
dhanyavādena yoktavyo nānyo dhanyāśrayo mune ।।63।।
ityukto'haṃ pare loke'kṣaralokātpare sthite ।
yogaśaktyā gato draṣṭuṃ dātuṃ ca dhanyavādakān ।।64।।
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ taṃ pravīkṣituṃ svadhāmani ।
so'haṃ tatratyamuktānāṃ divyatejobhirāvṛtaḥ ।।65।।
draṣṭuṃ śakto'bhavaṃ naiva santaṃ ca divyavigraham ।
gantuṃ tu śakyate yogād draṣṭuṃ śaktaṃ tvanugrahāt ।।66।।
adṛṣṭvā taṃ muktavṛndaṃ pṛṣṭvā kva bhagavāniti ।
jñātvā virājate tvaśvapaṭṭasaro'ntike śubhe ।।67।।
kṣetre kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vai lomaśāśramaśobhite ।
gehe ca kambharālakṣmyā gopālakṛṣṇamandire ।।68।।
divyā'divyākṣibhiḥ sarvairdṛśyo'nādinarāyaṇaḥ ।
gaccha tvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ paśya kṣitau mune ।।69।।
ityājñāya samāyāto'smyahaṃ darśanahetave ।
dhanyavādān pradātuṃ ca tasmai yo'tra virājate ।।1.531.70।।
bālaḥ śrīkambharālakṣmyā gopālakṛṣṇanandanaḥ ।
vasanti yatra vedāśca parāvidyā'tra vartate ।।71 ।।
sarvānandā muktayaśca yasyā'kṣikoṇake sthitāḥ ।
sarve devāśca ṛṣaya īśvarā yanmanobhavāḥ ।।72।।
tasmāyanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya vai namaḥ ।
svāmine bālarūpāya vallabhāya ca te namaḥ ।।73 ।।
muktānāṃ pataye dhāmnāṃ pataye te namonamaḥ ।
avatāravṛndadhartre īśvareśāya te namaḥ ।।74।।
rādhālakṣmīsvāmine te jayāyāḥ pataye namaḥ ।
lalitāmāṇikīpadmāpārvatīśāya te namaḥ ।।75।।
prabhāvṛndātulasīśrīpadmāvatīśa te namaḥ ।
mañjulākānta haṃseśa yogīśeśa ca te namaḥ ।।76।।
kamalākānta siddhīśa te pratyakṣa namonamaḥ ।
namohṛdayavāsātha sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ।। 77।।
namaḥ mayūrapicchāḍhyamukuṭadhāriṇe namaḥ ।
namaḥ kaustubhasaṃśobhadvakṣaḥsthalāya te namaḥ ।।78।।
namaḥ kuṇḍalakarṇāya svarṇahārāya te namaḥ ।
sarvaśaktisvarūpāya kāmakāmāya te namaḥ ।।79।।
naikāsuravināśāya bhaktatrāṇāya te namaḥ ।
bhaktavāñcchitadātre te śrīkṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ ।।1.531.80।।
dhanyeyaṃ kuṃkumavāpī dhanyo'yaṃ lomaśo muniḥ ।
aśvapaṭṭasaro dhanyaṃ dhanyaṃ vyāghravanaṃ śubham ।।81।।
dhanyā ime ca ṛṣayo dhanyā drutṛṇabhūruhāḥ ।
dhanyāḥ pakṣagamā jīvā dhanyā bhūvāsakāriṇaḥ ।।82।।
dhanyā narāstathā nāryo dhanyaṃ carācaraṃ tvidam ।
yatra vai bālarūpastvaṃ vartase puruṣottamaḥ ।।83।।
dṛśyase sarvaviṣayo gamyase jñānibhiḥ khalu ।
adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma puṇyaṃ naḥ pāravarjitam ।।84।।
sṛṣṭisañcālakairyo na prāpyate dṛśyase'tra naḥ ।
anekajanmaśuddhānāṃ darśanaṃ te'tra yujyate ।।85।।
asmākaṃ cātra sañjātaṃ puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam ।
śaraṇyaṃ yatpadaṃ labdhaṃ pratyakṣaṃ sevanocitam ।।86।।
ityevaṃ stavanaṃ kṛtvā bālaveṣaṃ pumuttamam ।
pupūjuḥ parayā bhaktyā śṛṃgāritaṃ jagatprabhum ।।87।।
upadāḥ pradaduḥ sarve cakruśca tilakaṃ śubham ।
ārārtrikaṃ pracakruśca nemustuṣṭuvurādarāt ।।88।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakruśca naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ daduḥ ।
devā devyaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇasya mūrdhani ।।89।।
mahotsave koṭiśo vai bhuvanānāṃ nivāsinaḥ ।
samāyātā jayantyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te ।।1.531.90।।
darśanaṃ ca prasādaṃ ca caraṇāmṛtamityapi ।
śubhāśiṣaśca saṃgṛhya yayurnijālayaṃ mudā ।।9 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaitat stavaṃ śubham ।
paramaiśvaryajanakaṃ sukhadaṃ sampadāpradam ।।92।।
nirvāṇamokṣadaṃ lakṣmi! haribhaktipradaṃ param ।
akṣareśapadadātṛ sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam ।।93 ।।
lobhamohakāmakrodhakarmamūlanikṛntanam ।
balabuddhipradaṃ caiva janmamṛtyuvināśanam ।।94।।
dhanaputrapriyābhūmipatisampatpradaṃ nṛṇām ।
śokaduḥkhaharaṃ yaśca paṭhedvā śṛṇuyācca vā ।।95।।
bandhanānmucyate duḥkhī bhīto mucyeta vai bhayāt ।
rogādvimucyate rogī daridraśca dhanī bhavet ।।96 ।।
dasyugrasto ripugrasto hiṃsrajantusamāvṛtaḥ ।
stotreṇā'nena vai lakṣmi! kalyāṇaṃ labhate janaḥ ।।97।।
sanatkumāro bhagavān dadau śrīlomaśāya yat ।
lomaśaśca dadāvanyaṛṣibhyo mokṣahetukam ।। 98।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhaktāya sarvathā ।
dāsabhaktāya dātavyaṃ viduṣe ca mumukṣave ।।99।।
aśvamedhasahasrācca pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇāt ।
snānācca sarvatīrthānāṃ stotrametattu puṇyadam ।। 1.531.100 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśāśrame'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya jayantyāṃtithau dhanyavādā''śīrvādapradānārthamāgatena sanatkumāreṇa kramaśo dhanyavādārhaparākāṣṭhāśrayā'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ṛṣivrātāya kathita
mahimādinirūpaṇanāmaikatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 531 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 531 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 532
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 533 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi camatkāraṃ munergauramukhasya vai ।
āsīt kṛtayuge rājā supratīko balādhikaḥ ।। 1 ।।
tasya bhāryādvayaṃ vidyutprabhā kāntimatī tathā ।
aputrastoṣayāmāsa citrakūṭe tu sevayā ।। 2 ।।
durvāsasaṃ varaṃ tasmāllebhe 'suputravān bhava' ।
rājā vidyutprabhāyāṃ durjayākhyaṃ prāptavān sutam ।। 3 ।।
kāntimatyāṃ sudyumnākhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ prāptavān sutam ।
durjayasya dadau vārāṇasīrājyaṃ nṛpastataḥ ।। 4 ।।
svayaṃ tu citrakūṭādriṃ tapo'rthaṃ prajagāma ha ।
durjayaścintayāmāsa rājyavṛddhiṃ prati prabhuḥ ।। ।9 ।।
triṃśadakṣauhiṇīsainyayutaḥ sa uttarāṃ diśam ।
jitvā kiṃpuruṣaṃ harivarṣaṃ romāvrataṃ kurum ।। 6 ।।
bhadrāśvaṃ merumadhyaṃ ca jitvā jetuṃ divaṃ yayau ।
meruparvatamāruhya yāvat prayāti tāvatā ।। 7 ।।
nārado durjayajayaṃ devarājāya coktavān ।
indraḥ sainyaṃ samādāya prati yuddhaṃ cakāra ha ।। 8 ।।
śaṃkarasya triśūlena durjayena parājitaḥ ।
indrastadvaśatāṃ yātaḥ surāḥ sarve vaśaṃgatāḥ ।। 9 ।।
durjayo lokapālāँstu vihāyaiva bhuvaṃ yayau ।
tatra dvāvasurau vidyutsuvidyunnāmakau tataḥ ।। 1.532.1 0।।
āgatya durjayaṃ cobhau prāhatuḥ śṛṇu bhūpate ।
lokapālānavijitya sukhaṃ na syāt kadācana ।। 11 ।।
āvāṃ jeṣyāva evaitān dehi svargaṃ ca nau yadi ।
omityuktvā dadau tābhyāṃ dyurājyaṃ tatsuhṛdvarau ।। 1 2।।
hetuprahetṛnāmānau bahusainyaparicchadau ।
manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ putrau kanye dve dadaturhiṃ te ।। 1 3।।
hetukanyā sukeśī tu miśrakeśī prahetṛjā ।
durjayaste hyubhe labdhvā nijaṃ rāṣṭraṃ jagāma ca ।। 14।।
sukeśyāḥ prabhavākhyaśca miśrakeśyāḥ sudarśanaḥ ।
putrau dvau durjayasyā''stām mahābalaparākramau ।। 15।।
evaṃ rājā vardhamānastvekadā sa himālayam ।
araṇyeṣu jagāmā'sau mṛgayārthaṃ sasainyakaḥ ।। 16।।
grīṣmakālamaraṇyeṣu nināya bahusainyakaḥ ।
hāstine nagare yasya rājadhānī tadā'bhavat ।। 17।।
araṇye vāsite tenā'kṣauhiṇīpañcakaṃ balam ।
pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ hāstine nagare dhṛtam ।। 18।।
durjayo himabhūmīnāmaraṇye vicaraँstadā ।
dadarśāraṇyake deśe nāmnā gauramukhaṃ munim ।। 1 9।।
anekarṣisusañjuṣṭaṃ mahābhāgavatottamam ।
yatra vedān pāṭhayanti kumārān vai maharṣayaḥ ।।1.532.20 ।।
kanyakābhyo munibhiśca pāṭhyante vedakāṇḍikāḥ ।
durjayo darśanārthaṃ vai gatastvāśramamaṇḍalam ।। 21।।
cakāra svāgataṃ rājñastadā gauramukho muniḥ ।
jagāda ca yathāśaktyā te sānugasya bhojanam ।। 22।।
kariṣyāmi pramucyantāṃ sādhu vāhā vane'bhitaḥ ।
rājā prasannastadbhaktyā''śramasyāntikameva saḥ ।। 23 ।।
pañca cākṣauhiṇīsainyaṃ vāsayāmāsa satvaram ।
ṛṣiḥ saṃsmṛtya manasā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।।24।।
kiṃ mayā bhojanaṃ cāsya deyamiti vicārya ca ।
gaṃgājale praviśyā'yaṃ tuṣṭāva śrīnarāyaṇam ।।25।।
namaste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyākṣaradhāmine ।
namaste cādyarūpāya vīṇādhṛkdvibhujāya ca ।।26।।
śaṃkhacakrānvitalakṣmīpataye'rthadhṛge namaḥ ।
sarvapradāya divyāya bhaktagoptre ca te namaḥ ।। 27।।
pañcabhūtasthitāyā'tra hṛdayasthāya te namaḥ ।
āpūrakāya sarveṣāmakṣayāya ca te namaḥ ।।28।।
brahmavratadharāyā'bdhau śeṣasthāya ca te namaḥ ।
tvatto bhūtamidaṃ sarvaṃ sarvadātre ca te namaḥ ।।29।।।
tvatto yajñastathā havyaṃ kavyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vāri ca ।
sarvaṃ cāsti śarīraṃ te tasmai bhojyaṃ pradehi vai ।।1.532.30।।
mamā'tra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa rājā hi durjayaḥ ।
āgato'bhyāgatastasya cātithyaṃ kuru mādhava ।।3 1 ।।
ahaṃ ca tava dāso'smi kuruṣvannādisañcayam ।
yaṃ yaṃ spṛśyāmi hastena yaṃ ca paśyāmi cakṣuṣā ।।32।।
kāṣṭhaṃ vā tṛṇakandaṃ vā tattadannaṃ caturvidham ।
tathā peyaṃ jalaṃ miṣṭaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtādikam ।।33।।
tatsarvaṃ siddhyatāṃ mahyaṃ yaddhyātaṃ manasā mayā ।
tavaiva tu pratāpena bhavedātithyamacyuta ।।34।।
iti stutaḥ prasannātmā sākṣādbabhūva sannidhau ।
śrīyutaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo garuḍasaṃsthitaḥ ।।35।।
śaṃkhacakradhanurvajradhvajaśūlakaraṃ harim ।
dṛṣṭvā taṃ sa munirnatvā kṛtāñjalirathā'bravīt ।।36।।
idānīmeṣa nṛpatiryathā sabalavāhanaḥ ।
mamāśrame kṛtāhāraḥ śvaḥ prayātā svakaṃ gṛham ।।37।।
tathā kuru mahārāja! kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।।38।।
ityuktaḥ śrīharistasmai cittaśuddhiṃ dadau purā ।
tataścintāmaṇiṃ divyaṃ dadau tasmai mahāprabham ।। 39।।
taṃ datvā'ntardadhe kṛṣṇaḥ sa tu gauramukho muniḥ ।
maṇiṃ spṛṣṭvā mahāsaudhaṃ cintayāmāsa connatam ।।1.532.40।।
himavacchikharākāraṃ gṛhaṃ vai śatabhūmikam ।
śaśāṃkaraśmisaṃvyāptaṃ svarṇarājatavastukam ।।41 ।।
tādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi lakṣalakṣāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।
gṛhāṇi nirmame vipro viṣṇormaṇeḥ prabhāvataḥ ।।42।।
prākārāṇi tathopānte tallagnodyānakāni ca ।
kokilāhaṃsamenāsārasamayūravanti ca ।।43।।
campakāśokapunnāganāgakesaravanti ca ।
vṛkṣavallīstambapuṣpanānādvijayutāni ca ।।44।।
hastināṃ hastiśālāśca turagāṇāṃ ca mandurāḥ ।
uṣṭrāṇāṃ ca gavayānāṃ vṛṣabhāṇāṃ ca śālikāḥ ।।45।।
racayāmāsa saṃkalpāccakāra bhakṣyasañcayān ।
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ tathā lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ pānaṃ saśarkaram ।।46।।
cakārā'nnā'dyaviṣayaṃ śākāni vyañjanāni ca ।
haimarājatapātrāṇi phalāni vividhāni ca ।।47।।
evaṃ kṛtvā sa viprastu rājānaṃ bhūritejasam ।
uvāca sarvasainyāni svasvanāmā'ṅkitagṛhān ।।48।।
praviśantu sukhaṃ tatra vasantu muditāni ca ।
daśayojanavistāraṃ triṃśadyojanadīrghakam ।।49।।
sainyāni viviśurdivyaṃ nagaraṃ sūryasannibham ।
rājā svabhavanaṃ tvadripronnataṃ praviveśaha ।।1.532.50।।
gauramukho'tha saṃgṛhya maṇiṃ rājānamāha yat ।
majjanā'bhyavahārārthaṃ dāsān vilāsinīstathā ।।51 ।।
preṣayāmi ca saṃprocya maṇiṃ spṛṣṭvā jagāda saḥ ।
dāsā dāsyo navāvasthā bhavantyasya prabhāvataḥ ।।52।।
niśceruryoṣitastāvad rājñastasya prapaśyataḥ ।
sukumārāṃgarāgādyā divyāśca navayauvanāḥ ।।53।।
sukapolāḥ sucārvaṃgyaḥ sukeśāntāḥ sulocanāḥ ।
svarṇacampakavarṇābhāḥ kumārā lakṣaśastathā ।।54।।
surūpāśca samārabdhayauvanā devasadṛśāḥ ।
kāścit sauvarṇapātrīśca gṛhītvā sampratasthire ।।55।।
evaṃ sarvāḥ kumāryaśca kumārāśca prasevakāḥ ।
rājñaḥ sainyasya ca kṛte cakruḥ siddhaṃ hi bhojanam ।।56।।
paridhānaṃ parāścakruḥ snāpayāmāsuranyakāḥ ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruranyā āstaraṇaṃ vyadhuḥ ।।57।।
tāmbūlāni daduścānyā miṣṭaṃ jalaṃ dadustathā ।
vījayāmāsuraparāścakruḥ parāstu gāyanam ।।58।।
bhṛtyā yathā'bhyapekṣaṃ ca cakruḥ sevāṃ janasya vai ।
nānāvidhāni tūryāṇi tatrā'vādyanta bhūriśaḥ ।।59।।
majjato nṛpatestasya nanṛtuścānyayoṣitaḥ ।
evaṃ divyopacāreṇa snātvā rājā mahābalaḥ ।।1.532.60।।
vibidhānnaṃ tu vidhinā bubhuje sainyamityapi ।
yathā rājñastathā bhṛtyajanasyāpi prapūjanam ।।6 1।।
gajāśvādipaśūnāṃ ca mānanaṃ cottamottamam ।
cakāra munirāṭ svīyadāsadāsībhiruttamam ।।62।।
atha rātriḥ samāyātā candrakāntisamanvitā ।
pradarśanāni ramyāṇi muninā darśitāni ca ।।63।।
nṛtyānyapi ca nārīṇāṃ mahotsavāśca darśitāḥ ।
mallānāṃ carayuddhāni darśitāni śubhānyapi ।।64।।
saṃgītāni ca daivāni vādyāni cottamāni ca ।
gāndharvarāgarāgiṇyo darśitā maṇimūlikāḥ ।।65।।
vyākhyānāni rañjanāni hāsyānyapi kṛtāni ca ।
dyūtānyapīndrajālāni naṭanartanakāni ca ।।66।।
dṛṣṭibandhāni cānyāni darśitāni niśārdhake ।
atha teṣāṃ śayaneṣu ratnasvarṇamayeṣu ca ।।67।।
puṣpānviteṣu mṛduṣu nāryaḥ sevāṃ pracakrire ।
rājā divyāṃganābhiśca sevyate śayanottame ।।68।।
evaṃ sumanasastasya ṛṣermaṇeḥ prabhāvataḥ ।
rājā sainyāni ca sukhaṃ hṛṣṭāḥ prasuṣupustataḥ ।।6 9।।
prātarutthānakāryārthaṃ vādyāni vividhāni ca ।
avādyanta kumārīṇāṃ gāyanaiḥ saha sarvaśaḥ ।।1.532.70 ।।
snātvā rājā jalapānaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣyaṃ vidhāya ca ।
sasainyastvarito gauramukhasya pūjanāya vai ।।71 ।।
āyayau parṇaśālāyāṃ yatrāste tu maṇirmuniḥ ।
tataḥ kumāryo bhṛtyāśca sarvāṇyapi gṛhāṇi ca ।।72।।
gṛhopaskaraṇādīni bhojyapeyāni sarvaśaḥ ।
antardhānaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṇād vanaṃ babhūva tat ।। 73।।
sa rājā vismayāpannaścintayāmāsa vīkṣya tat ।
kathamevaṃ maṇirmahyaṃ bhavatīti punaḥ punaḥ ।।74।।
cintāmaṇimimaṃ tvasya harāmīti vicintya saḥ ।
natvā''śramabahirbhāge gatvā tūvāca mantriṇam ।।75।।
virocana! muniṃ yāhi yācanāṃ kuru vai maṇeḥ ।
sa tamṛṣiṃ samāgatya maṇiṃ yācitumudyataḥ ।।76।।
ratnānāṃ bhājanaṃ rājā maṇiṃ tasmai pradīyatām ।
amātyenaivamuktastu kruddho gauramukho'bravīt ।।77।।
rājā dātā bhavennityaṃ pratigrāhī tu bhūsuraḥ ।
tvaṃ ca rājā svayaṃ bhūtvā yācase dīnavat katham ।।78।।
ayogyastvaṃ maṇeḥ pātraṃ nāsi mā yācanāṃ kuru ।
trailokyaṃ yasya vaśagaṃ svargaṃ pātālamityapi ।।79।।
meruḥ ratnākarāścāpi tathāpyaho daridratā ।
brāhmaṇasya dhane vāñchāṃ karoṣi nyāyavarjitām ।।1.532.80।।
atṛptasyā'jñāninastu sarve syurviṣayā gṛhe ।
tathāpi tṛṣṇayā śāntiṃ nādhigacchati pāpavān ।।81 ।।
evaṃ brūhi durācāraṃ rājānaṃ durjayaṃ svayam ।
gaccha drutaṃ ca yāvatte vighnaḥ kaścinna jāyate ।।82।।।
dūto jagāma rājānaṃ proktavāँśca yathocitam ।
krudhā nīlākhyasāmantaṃ rājā''ha gaccha mā ciram ।।83।।
viprasya maṇimāhṛtya tūrṇamehi mamāntikam ।
nīlo yayau tathā śīghraṃ maṇeḥ kuṭyāṃ pragacchati ।।84।।
tāvanmaṇestu nirjagmuḥ koṭiśaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ ।
yoddhāraḥ sarathāścānye sadhvajāścāsicarmiṇaḥ ।।85।।
sadhanustūṇīrabāṇāḥ śaktibhūśuṇḍikānvitāḥ ।
pañcadaśākṣauhiṇyaśca pañcadaśa ca nāyakāḥ ।।86 ।।
nāmabhiḥ suprabho dīptitejāśca śubhadarśanaḥ ।
sukāntiḥ sundaraḥ sundaḥ pradyumnaḥ sumanāḥ śubhaḥ ।।87।।
suśīlaḥ sukhadaḥ śambhuḥ sudāntaḥ soma ityapi ।
suraśmiśceti te sarve yodhayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ ।।88।।
bhūśuṇḍikāstathā śūlāḥ khaḍgāni ca dhanūṃṣi ca ।
patanti ca gadā vajrāḥ śaktayaśca suyodhinām ।।89।।
ratho rathaṃ parivārya tasthau gajo gajaṃ tathā ।
hayo hayaṃ padātiśca padātiṃ prasasāra vai ।।1.532.90।।
raṇe tvavirate tatra nadī raktasamutthitā ।
rājñaḥ sacivo visaṃjñaḥ sasainyaśca hato raṇe ।।91 ।।
durjayastu svayaṃ tatra maṇijaiḥ saṃyuyodha ha ।
avaśiṣṭasya sainyasya sarvaṃ kadanamābabhau ।।92।।
atha hetṛprahetṛbhyāṃ śruto jāmeḥ raṇo mahān ।
yudhyatastau sahāye'sya camvaḥ pañcadaśolbaṇāḥ ।।93।।।
nāyakāḥ pañca ca daśa preṣitā raṇamūrdhani ।
ye punarnotthitā naṣṭā nāmatastān prakarṇaya ।।94।।
praghaso vighasaścāpi saghasaścāśaniprabhaḥ ।
vidyutprabhaḥ sughoṣaśca pronmattākṣaḥ pratardanaḥ ।।95।।
agnidanto'gnitejāśca bāhuḥ śakro virodhakaḥ ।
bhīmakarmā vipracittiḥ, daiteyāḥ paramāyudhāḥ ।।96।।
mahāmāyā yuyudhuste maṇijairyodhṛpuṃgavaiḥ ।
pañcadaśākṣauhiṇyaśca daiteyānāṃ hatāstu tāḥ ।।97।।
tāvat hetā prahetā cāyayatuḥ sainyakoṭibhiḥ ।
vidyut suvidyuśca tāvat svargeśāvasurāvubhau ।।98।।
triṃśadakṣauhiṇīyuktau śrutvā yuddhe sahāyadau ।
āyayaturhimadeśe kampitā'bhūdvasundharā ।।99।।
raktavāhā nadī tatra tvabdhiṃ prāptuṃ drutaṃ gatā ।
atha gauramukho dṛṣṭvā'nantaṃ sainyaṃ tu rakṣasām ।। 1.532.10 0।।
sasmāra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ maṇipatiṃ prabhum ।
śrīhariḥ puratastasya pītavāsāḥ khagāsanaḥ ।। 101 ।।
samāgatya samuvāca vada kiṃ kāryamatra me ।
ṛṣiḥ provāca bhagavan jahīmaṃ durjayaṃ nṛpam ।। 102।।
daiteyāँśceti vai śrutvā cakraṃ mumoca daityahā ।
koṭisūryasamaṃ cakraṃ bhasmīcakāra durjayam ।। 1 03।।
sainyānyapi ca rakṣāṃsi naiko'pyatrā'vaśiṣyate ।
uvāca nimiṣeṇedaṃ nihataṃ dānavaṃ kulam ।। 1 04।।
araṇye'smiṃstatasvetannamiṣāraṇyasaṃjñitam ।
bhaviṣyati yathārthaṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ sanniveśanam । । 1 05।।
ahaṃ ca yajñapuruṣa etasmin vanagocare ।
nāmnā yājyāḥ sadā ceme pañcadaśa ca nāyakāḥ ।। 106 ।।
kṛte yuge kramādete syurnṛpā maṇijā ime ।
evamuktvā maṇiṃ nītvā devo'ntardhānamāgataḥ ।। 1 07।।
dvijo'pi svāśrame tasthau mudā paramayā yutaḥ ।
sainyānyapi ca sarvāṇi śrīviṣṇau līnatāṃ yayuḥ ।। 1 08।।
durjayaḥ śrīharau tatra līno babhūva yogataḥ ।
cakrahatāni sainyāni svargaṃ gatāni yogataḥ ।। 1 09।।
evaṃ nārāyaṇasyāṃśā uktā maṇyudbhavāḥ priye ।
paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsya muktiḥ syāt svargamityapi ।। 1.532.11 0।।
atha gauramukho vipra ārirādhayiṣurharim ।
yuddhadurītanāśārthaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāyayau ।। 111 ।।
saurāṣṭre raivatī bhūmau snātvā dāmodarāhvaye ।
kuṇḍe nārāyaṇahrade samudre gomatīyute ।। 1 12।।
prācyāṃ cāpi sarasvatyāṃ cāśvapaṭṭasaro yayau ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśasyāśrame śubhe ।। 113 ।।
tatrā''jagāma ṛṣirāṭ mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ।
lomaśaṃ prathamaṃ natvā mārkaṇḍeyaṃ nanāma saḥ ।। 1 14।।
maṇeḥ samarpayitāraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
pratyakṣaṃ vartamānaṃ taṃ gopālakṛṣṇanandanam ।। 1 15।।
ātmānaṃ ca kṛtārthaṃ vai mene gauramukho muniḥ ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।। 1 16।।
itimantraṃ japan devaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ papraccha saḥ ।
mṛtānāṃ mokṣaṇārthaṃ ca durītakṣayakārakam ।। 1 17।।
mayā'tra kimanuṣṭheyaṃ śādhi mamātra tīrthake ।
mārkaṇḍeyaśca taṃ prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।1 18।।
sarveṣāmeva devānāmādyo'tra vartate prabhuḥ।
pratyakṣaṃ taṃ bhaja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śriyaḥ patim ।।1 19।।
tena muktiśca sarveṣāṃ durītānāṃ ca nāśanam ।
bhaviṣyatyeva kṣetre'smin śrāddhāni kuru cātra vai ।। 1.532.120।।
ityuktaḥ sa muniḥ śrāddhāni cakre mokṣakāṃkṣayā ।
yuddhe mṛtāśca ye teṣāmuddhāraṃ kṛtavān svayam ।। 121 ।।
vimānaiste gatāḥ sarve'kṣaraṃ dhāma parātmanaḥ ।
ayaṃ gauramukhaḥ pūrve janmanyāsīd bhṛguḥ svayam ।। 1 22।।
tadanvayātmajastveṣo mārkaṇḍeyo munīśvaraḥ ।
śrāddhena bodhayāmāsa putrastaṃ pitaraṃ punaḥ ।। 123।।
atha gauramukhastatra jñātvā kṛtvā ca tarpaṇam ।
sasmāra sarvajanmāni smṛtvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇe ।। 1 24।।
sarvātmanā'rpito bhūtvā yayau dhāmā'kṣarā'bhidham ।
layaṃ jagāma sarveśe cā'punarbhavasaṃjñite ।। 125।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durjayasya trilokarājyaṃ, gauramukhāśrame śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇārpitamaṇinā susvāgataṃ, cintāmaṇyarthe yuddhaṃ, durjayādivināśaḥ, gauramukhasya prabhāsā''gamanaṃ, muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।532।।


← adhyāyaḥ 532 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 533
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 534 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! ca devānāṃ vivāde'dhyātmasaṃjñitam ।
jñānaṃ pūrve varāhaḥ śrībhagavānāha yad bhuve ।। 1 ।।
cintāmaṇisamutpannaḥ suprabho nāma bhūpatiḥ ।
prajāpālo'sya nāmāpi dvitīyaṃ sārthakaṃ tvabhūt ।। 2 ।।
sa tvekadā yayau ṛṣyāśramān draṣṭuṃ mudā ṛṣīn ।
yatra mahātapā nāma ṛṣiḥ kalpāyurasti ca ।। 3 ।।
tapastapatyanāhāro japan brahmasanātanam ।
yatra vṛkṣāstathā vallyaḥstambāstṛṇāni pakṣiṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
paśavaśca mṛgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ santi mumukṣavaḥ ।
rāgadveṣavihīnāśca ṛṣivattapāasthitāḥ ।। 5 ।।
tānpaśyan sa prajāpālo mahātapasa āśramam ।
praviveśa mudā taṃ ca ṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoda ca ।। 6 ।।
nanāma parayā bhaktyā cakāra daṇḍavanmudā ।
kuśāsanasthitasyāsya ṛṣervai darśanāttadā ।। 7 ।।
matiṃ māyāmayīṃ tūrṇaṃ visasmāra jaganmayīm ।
muneḥ sānnidhyato rājā cakāra dharmamānasam ।। 8 ।।
ātmajñānasya jijñāsāṃ mokṣopāyāgamaṃ tathā ।
munistaṃ ca nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā cakārā'bhyāgatakriyām ।। 9 ।।
'asanaṃ svāgataṃ pānaṃ bhojanaṃ kuśalaṃ vacaḥ ।
tataḥ papraccha taṃ śāntaṃ muniṃ vinayavān nṛpaḥ ।। 1.533.1 0।।
bhagavan duḥkhasaṃsāramagnaiḥ puṃbhirjigīṣubhiḥ ।
yatkāryaṃ tanmamāśaṃsa praṇatasya sukhāvaham ।। 11 ।।
mahātapāstu tacchrutvā prāha rājannibodha me ।
saṃsārārṇavamagnaiśca potaḥ sthiro dhruvo dṛḍhaḥ ।। 12।।
kāryaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
pūjā dānāni yajñāśca dhyānaṃ sarvārpaṇaṃ tathā ।। 13।।
dāsyaṃ cemāni divyāni sopānāni matāni vai ।
teṣāṃ niḥśreṇikāṃ bhaktiṃ gṛhītvā''rohaṇaṃ kuru ।। 14।।
pārāvārasyāpi pāraṃ gamiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ ।
nṛpaḥ prāha kathaṃ pūjā kartavyā tasya vai hareḥ ।। 15।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha hareḥ pūjā kāryā yathā vadāmi te ।
dhātvādīnā pratimāyāṃ śālagrāme śive'thavā ।। 16।।
sādhujaneṣu sādhvīṣu gauḥṣu gurau janārdanam ।
bhāvayet svāmini pitrāḥ pativratāyāṃ bhāskare ।। 17।।
vahnau vipre kanyakāyāṃ bāle'nāthe nirāśrite ।
caityavṛkṣe tulasyā ca bhāvayet puruṣottamam ।। 18।।
mānasaṃ hṛdaye dhyāyedindriyādau ca varṣmaṇi ।
devaṣu cātmāna dhyāyet pūjayecchrīpatiṃ tathā ।। 1 9।।
puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ tathā kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdati ।
ime sarve samutpannā harereva harastanuḥ ।। 1.533.20।।
agnistathā'śvinau gaurī gaṇeśaśca bhujaṃgamaḥ ।
kārtikeyastathā''dityā mātaraścāpi durgikāḥ ।। 21 ।।
diśaḥ kubero viṣṇuśca yamo rudraḥ śaśā tathā ।
pitaraśceti saṃbhūtā nārāyaṇasya mūrtitaḥ ।।22।।
ta ete pūjanīyā vai nārāyaṇasamanvitāḥ ।
mūrtayaste bhavantyeva nārāyaṇasamudbhavāḥ ।।23।।
rājā prāha mayā kutra prāptavyāstāḥ sumūrtayaḥ ।
yenā'haṃ pūjayāmyeva sūpacāraiśca gocarān ।।24।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan! teṣāṃ dvedhā hi mūrtayaḥ ।
divyā devasvarūpāśca pratyakṣā na bhavanti tāḥ ।।25।।
ādityāste śarīre'tra vasantyeva ca gocarāḥ ।
ta ete ca bhavantyeva sadā tattvāṃśarūpiṇaḥ ।।26।।
ekadā te pṛthakpṛthak prāptā garvaṃ samantataḥ ।
ahaṃ yogyo'smyahaṃ śreṣṭhaścā'haṃ yājyaḥ sadā tanau ।।27।।
nānyo matsadṛśaścātra dehe bhavati kaścana ।
evaṃ teṣāṃ hi tattvānāṃ vivādaḥ samajāyata ।।28।।
teṣāṃ vivadamānānāṃ nirṇayārthaṃ tu yuktitaḥ ।
hiraṇyagarbho bhagavān provāca tānprati prabhuḥ ।।29।।
yuṣmākaṃ yadvinā cedaṃ na syāttadvai mahattamam ।
evamukte prathamaṃ tu vahnirutthāya pārthiva! ।।1.533.30 ।।
uvācā'haṃ mahānasmi māṃ yajadhvaṃ mamāśraye ।
vināśamupagacchedvai śarīraṃ madvinā kṛtam ।।3 1।।
evamuktvā jāṭharo'gnirvaiśvānaro viniryayau ।
tyaktvā dehaṃ varṣamātramuvāsā'nyatra vai tataḥ ।।32।।।
nirgate'pi tu tasmiँstaccharīraṃ nahi śīryate ।
tadā jñātaṃ vahninā vai nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaḥ punaḥ ।।33।।
tato'śvinau mūrtimantau prāṇāpānasvarūpiṇau ।
āvāṃ pradhānāvityevamūcaturdevamaṇḍale ।।34।।
evamuktvā śarīraṃ saṃvihāya kvacidāsthitau ।
varṣamātraṃ śarīraṃ tu tadvināpi sthitaṃ yathā ।।35।।
vāyuvyāpārahīnaṃ ca susthiraṃ kuṃbhakena vai ।
tayorjñānaṃ tadā jātaṃ nā''vāṃ śreṣṭhatamau yataḥ ।।36 ।।
tato vāgabravīd gaurī prādhānyaṃ mama vartate ।
sā'pyevamuktvā kṣetrāttu niścakrāma bahiḥ śubhā ।।37।।
tayā vināpi tatkṣetraṃ vāgūnaṃ vyavatiṣṭhata ।
maunaṃ tena tayā jñātaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamā yataḥ ।।38।।
tato gaṇapatirvākyamākāśākhyo'bravīttadā ।
na mayā rahitaṃ kiñciccharīraṃ sthāyi vatsaram ।।39।।
mahānahaṃ samuccārya so'pi niṣkramya dehataḥ ।
pṛthagbhūtastathāpyetaccharīraṃ nāpyanīnaśat ।।1.533.40।।
vināśākhyamapi tena vinā naiva viśīryate ।
suṣiraistu vihīnaṃ tad yathāpūrvaṃ vyavasthitam ।।41 ।।
tena vyomno'bhavad bodho nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamo yataḥ ।
atha vai dhātavaḥ sarve sthūlabhūtādayopi ca ।।42।।
prāhurasmadvihīnasya śarīrasya na dhāraṇam ।
vayaṃ śreṣṭhā iti coktvā jahurdehaṃ śarīrajāḥ ।।43।।
tairvyapetamapi kṣetraṃ puruṣeṇa prapālyate ।
na ca naṣṭaṃ kintu śuṣkaṃ jātaṃ sacetanaṃ hyapi ।।44।।
tena jātaṃ hi dhātūnāṃ jñānaṃ śreṣṭhā vayaṃ nahi ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā cā'bravīt skandaḥ so'haṃkārasvarūpavān ।।45।।
mayā vinā śarīrasya saṃbhūtirapi neṣyate ।
tasmācchreṣṭhatamaścāhaṃ nānyo'sti sadṛśo mayā ।।46।।
evamuktvā śarīrāttu sa vyapetaḥ pṛthaksthitaḥ ।
vatsaraṃ ca vinā tena dehaṃ muktavadāsthitam ।।47।।
na śīrṇaṃ na mṛtaṃ cāpi śāntaṃ tiṣṭhati pūrvavat ।
tena tasyā'bhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamo yataḥ ।।48।।
atha cakṣurbhānurūpaṃ kupitaṃ tvarayā'bravīt ।
mayā vinā na vai kṣetraṃ kṣaṇaṃ cāpi pravartate ।।49।।
evamuktvā'tha yātaṃ tat, śarīraṃ tu na śīryate ।
āgatya ca yathāpūrvaṃ sthitaṃ dadarśa varṣma tat ।।1.533.50।।
tena tasyā'bhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ yataḥ ।
tataḥ kāmādidoṣāṇāṃ tanmātrāṇi ca mātaraḥ ।।51 ।।
śabdādyāśca samūcurvai vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā iti ।
nā'smābhirvyatiriktasya śarīrasya vyavasthitiḥ ।।52।।।
uktvā mātrāgaṇo varṣaṃ bahiryayau tataḥ punaḥ ।
śarīraṃ śīryate naiva pūrvavadeva saṃsthitam ।।53।।
mātrāṇāmabhavajjñānaṃ na naḥ śreṣṭhyaṃ tataḥ khalu ।
mūlamāyā triguṇātmā durgā'bravīd ruṣā satī ।।54।।
na mayā'sya vinā bhūtistasmācchreṣṭhā'smi sarvataḥ ।
ityuktvā'ntardadhe varṣaṃ punareva samāgatā ।।55।।
dṛṣṭvā dehaṃ yogabhāvamāpannaṃ cetanena vai ।
yathāpūrvamabhūnnaiva śīrṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ mṛtaṃ na vā ।।56।।
cetanasya pratāpena tattathaiva vyavasthitam ।
tatastasyāḥ samabhavajjñānaṃ śreṣṭhā na cāpyaham ।।57।।
tato diśaḥ samuttasthurūcuścedaṃ vaco mahat ।
nāsmābhī rahitaṃ kāryaṃ bhavatīti vicārya tāḥ ।।58।।
śrotrayuktā gatā varṣaṃ śarīraṃ na hi śīryate ।
yathāpūrvamabhūttattu kārṇaśravaṇavarjitam ।।59।।
tena tāsāmabhūjjñāna vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā na vai ।
atha dhanañjayo vāyurdhaneśaḥ prāha sarvathā ।।1.533.60।।
prāṇe yāte'pyahaṃ sthātā tryahaṃ śaveṣu cāntataḥ ।
māṃ vinā na śarīraṃ syād durgandhaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt ।।61 ।।
tataḥ śreṣṭhatamaścāsmītyuktvā dūragato'bhavat ।
tathāpi cetanayuktaṃ yathāvadvai sutiṣṭhati ।।62।।
tena tasyā'bhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaḥ khalu ।
tato viṣṇurmanaḥ prāha nā'yaṃ deho mayā vinā ।।63।।
tasmācchreṣṭhatamaṃ cāhamityuktvā'ntardadhe'pi ca ।
amananaṃ śarīraṃ tu pūrvavadeva saṃsthitam ।।64।।
dṛṣṭvā tasmā'bhavajjñānaṃ nāhaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ yataḥ ।
tato dharmaḥ kṛtaṃ karmābravīccāhaṃ mahattamam ।।65।।
ahaṃ pālitavān dehaṃ tasmācchreṣṭho'smi sarvathā ।
idānīṃ mayyapagate kathametad bhaviṣyati ।।66।।
evamuktvā gatau dharmādharmau karmātmakāvubhau ।
tathāpi cātmanā yuktaṃ śarīraṃ nahi śīryate ।।67।।
āgatya dvau niścayaṃ hi cakraturna mahattamau ।
athā'bravīnmahādevo mahattattvaṃ mahattamam ।।68।।
ahameva mahānasmi mayā hīnaṃ na tiṣṭhati ।
evamuktvā gataḥ śaṃbhurmahattattvaṃ śarīrataḥ ।।69।।
varṣamātraṃ tathāpyetaccharīraṃ śīryate na vai ।
tatastasyā'bhavajjñānaṃ nāmamātraṃ mahān mama ।।1.533.70 ।।
vastuto na mahānasmi mṛṣā me śreṣṭhatā khalu ।
athātra pitaraścocurindriyārthāḥ mahattamāḥ ।।71 ।।
śabdādyāśca vayaṃ sthūlā asmābhirdehajīvanam ।
tato vayaṃ tu sarvebhyo baliṣṭhāśca mahattamāḥ ।।72।।
vinā'smākaṃ ca vai śīghraṃ śarīraṃ sampraśīryate ।
evamuktvā tu taddehaṃ tyaktvā'ntardhānamāgatāḥ ।।73।।
tathāpi na śarīraṃ tad viśīrṇaṃ vai manāgapi ।
tatasteṣāmabhūjjñānaṃ vayaṃ śreṣṭhatamā na vai ।।74।।
atha bhujaṃgikā yā tu vāsanā samuvāca sā ।
ahaṃ śreṣṭhatamā māṃ tu vinā dehaṃ na tiṣṭhati ।।75।।
sāpi varṣaṃ gatā dūraṃ punareva samāgatā ।
dṛṣṭvā pūrvaṃ yathā varṣma viveda nottamā'pyaham ।।76।।
atha sarve'pi sambhūya dehaṃ tyaktvā bahiryayuḥ ।
agniḥ prāṇastathā'pāno vyoma sarve ca dhātavaḥ ।।77।।
ahaṃkāro mano bhānuḥ kāmādyāśca gaṇāstathā ।
kāṣṭhā vāyurviṣṇudharmau śaṃbhuścāpīndriyārthakāḥ ।।78।।
etairmuktamapi kṣetraṃ muktāviva susaṃsthitam ।
somena cātmanā yogaiśvaryeṇarakṣitaṃ yataḥ ।।79।।
pālyamānaṃ na viśīrṇaṃ tena teṣāṃ gaṇasya ca ।
garvo naṣṭo na vai śreṣṭhaḥ samudāyo'pi naḥ khalu ।।1.533.80।।
atha somasya jīvasya garvo'bhavanmahattamaḥ ।
mayā vai pālyate dehastato'haṃ sarvathottamaḥ ।।81 ।।
evaṃ vai niścite some ṣoḍaśātmanyathā'kṣare ।
tvaṃ mahāniti jānīmaḥ kintu tatsaṃśayāspadam ।।82।।
yadvinā na śarīraṃ vai santiṣṭheta hi tanmahat ।
tvaṃ cāpyatra parīkṣāṃ saṃkuru cātman nijasya hi ।।83।।
vijñāsyāmastatastetra śraiṣṭhyaṃ divyaṃ hi nānyathā ।
evamukto hi jīvātmā niryayau dehatastadā ।।84।।
babhrāma ca bahirvarṣaṃ sarvānādāya cāmbare ।
nityaṃ tyaktaṃ śarīraṃ ca paśyatyeva bahiḥ sthitaḥ ।।85।।
kintu nārāyaṇastatra tasthau śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
jīvātmano garvanāśaṃ kartuṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।86।।
śarīraṃ cetayāmāsa rakṣayāmāsa sādaram ।
svaiśvaryeṇa guṇaiḥ svīyairvinā'pyātmānamāntaram ।।87।।
prāgavasthaṃ śarīraṃ tu dṛṣṭvā sarvajñapālitam ।
tābhiśca devatattvaiśca jīvātmā punarāyayau ।।88।।
tena sa jñātavānnā'haṃ śreṣṭho'tra saṃbhavāmi vai ।
atha tā devatāḥ prāhurvayaṃ sthāsyāma eva hi ।।89।।
gaccha tvamekalaścātman jīvāmo vā na vai vayam ।
ityukto jīvavarmā'sau tāṃstyaktvā niryayau bahiḥ ।।1.533.90।।
jaḍatulyo'bhavattatra bahirnārāyaṇaṃ vinā ।
acetana iva jātaḥ suṣupta iva sarvathā ।।91।।
atejaska iva jāto'prakāśa iva dhūmrakaḥ ।
mṛta ivā'bhavattatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ vinā ।।92।।
śarīre tu sthitā vahnyādayo hi jīvamantarā ।
api śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā'nvayataḥ khalu ।।93।।
divyayogād divyabhāvaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ samāsthitāḥ ।
parabrahmaṇo yogena brahmabhāvaṃ prapedire ।।94।।
jaḍā api ca te jātāścetanā muktasadṛśāḥ ।
śrīhareranyathākartuṃ samarthasya prasaṃgataḥ ।।95।।
tāḥ kṣetradevatāḥ sarvā vailakṣyabhāvamāsthitāḥ ।
sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca śarīratrayamityapi ।।96।।
nārāyaṇasya yogena nārāyaṇātmakaṃ tadā ।
prāptaṃ nārāyaṇarūpaṃ divyaṃ brahmātmakaṃ yataḥ ।।97।।
tadā jīvātmano garvo naṣṭaḥ sarvastadā'bhavat ।
tasyāpi cā'bhavajjñānaṃ nā'haṃ śreṣṭhatamo yataḥ ।।98।।
śreṣṭhaḥ pūjyaḥ sadā dhyeyaḥ smartavyaḥ śrīhariṃ sadā ।
yena jātāni jīvanti vahnyādyāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।।99।।
yenā''śrito'pyahaṃ jīvo jīvāmi nānyathā kvacit ।
tadyogena pathā divyaścātmā bhavāmi sarvathā ।। 1.533.1 00।।
tadyogena tathaitāni tattvānyapi ca sarvathā ।
divyānyeva hi jātāni yāni pūrvaṃ jaḍānyapi ।।1 01।।
māṃ vinā'pi ca divyā vai muktāḥ syuste ca dhāmasu ।
yadīcchenmāṃ vihāyaiva jaḍā divyā bhavantviti ।।1 02।।
sarvaṃ kartuṃ samarthasya vivṛtiṃ ko nivārayet ।
tasmānnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaśreṣṭhatayā mataḥ ।। 1 03।।
tato devāstuṣṭuvustaṃ sarvasthaṃ parameśvaram ।
svasvasthāne sthitāḥ prāhuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ muhuḥ ।। 1 04।।
tvamagnistvaṃ tathā prāṇastvamapāno bhavasyapi ।
tvaṃ vāṇī cāmbaraṃ tvaṃ ca dhātavastvaṃ śarīragāḥ ।। 1 05।।
ahaṃbhāvastvamevā'si tvamevāsi ca netrakam ।
tvaṃ śabdādīni mātrāṇi tvaṃ māyā triguṇātmikā ।। 106।।
tvaṃ śrotraṃ vartase dhanaṃjayo'pi tvaṃ manastathā ।
tvaṃ dharmastvaṃ mahattattvamindriyārthāstvameva ca ।। 1 07।।
tvaṃ ca sadvāsanātmā ca jīvātmā tvaṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।
sarvātmā tvaṃ vinā tvāṃ vai naite sattāmayaḥ kvacit ।। 1 08।।
satā tvayā vayaṃ santaḥ sarveśastvaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
svāmī patiḥ poṣakaśca jīvātuḥ rakṣakastathā ।। 1 09।।
asmābhirapayātaistu kathametad bhaviṣyati ।
evamatra śarīraṃ tu tyaktamasmābhireva tu ।। 1.533.110 ।।
tvayā vai rakṣitaṃ divyaṃ tatsthānnastvaṃ prapālayeḥ ।
sthānabhaṅgo na naḥ kāryastavādhīnā vayaṃ sadā ।। 111 ।।
evaṃ stutastato devasteṣāṃ toṣaṃ paraṃ yayau ।
uvāca caitān krīḍārthaṃ bhavantaśca kṛtā mayā ।। 1 12।।
bhavaddvārā prakrīḍāmi nānyadasti prayojanam ।
varaṃ vṛṇuta devā vai tuṣṭo'smi ca dadāmi ca ।। 113 ।।
tadā devā vavrire vai dvedhā svarakṣaṇaṃ sadā ।
śarīreṣu yathāvasthaṃ divyabhāvena cāparam ।। 1 14।।
śrīharistāṃ tadā prāha dve dve pratyekaśo'dhunā ।
rūpe dhṛtvā kṛpayā me tiṣṭhantu kathayāmi ca ।। 1 15।।
bhūtakāryeṣvamūrtena tattvarūpeṇa sarvathā ।
devaloke tu mūrtena tiṣṭhadhvaṃ mama sevakāḥ ।। 1 16।।
pralaye ca layaṃ mayi tvāviśata drutaṃ surāḥ ।
abhidhānāni devānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca karomyaham ।। 1 17।।
agnirvaiśvānaro devaḥ prāṇāpānau tathā'śvinau ।
vāṇī gaurī himaputrī vyoma padmāvatīpitā ।। 1 18।।
śarīradhātavaśceme nānābhūtāni caiva ha ।
ahaṃkāraḥ svayaṃ skandaḥ kārtikeyo bhaviṣyati ।। 1 19।।
netre sūryaśaśirūpe svargadevau bhaviṣyataḥ ।
śabdādīni ca mātrāṇi gajavaktro bhaviṣyati ।। 1.533.120 ।।
śarīramāyā durgā ca kāraṇānte bhaviṣyati ।
śrotraṃ digbhāvamāpannaṃ devarūpaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।121 ।।
dhanaṃjayo dhaneśo vai kuberaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
idaṃ mano viṣṇunāmā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।। 122।।
dharmo'pi yamanāmā ca yāmyadevo bhaviṣyati ।
mahattattvaṃ ca bhagavān mahādevo bhaviṣyati ।। 123।।
indriyārthāśca pitaro bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।
vāsanā ca ratirūpā bhaviṣyati tu kāminī ।। 124।।
jīvātmā me nararūpaḥ pārśvasthaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
kvacicca candramā bhūtvā'mṛtādhāro bhaviṣyati ।। 1 25।।
evaṃ varapradānena jātāste sṛṣṭidevatāḥ ।
hiraṇyagarbhatattvasthā dehe'pi tāni cāpi hi ।। 1 26।।
parabrahma tu yaḥ proktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
sa eva devatārūpaḥ sṛṣṭau vai vartate prabhuḥ ।। 127।।
sa eva tattvarūpaśca śarīre'tra vasatyapi ।
tasmād rājan bhaja devāṃstathā tattvāni varṣmaṇi ।। 128।।
śarīre tvaṃ pūjayaitānabhedena harau sadā ।
sa eva tu tvayā svasmin labdho'styanyatra mā vraja ।। 129।।
evaṃ vedāntapuruṣaḥ prokto nārāyaṇātmakaḥ ।
evaṃprabhāvo devo'sau vedavedyo janārdanaḥ ।। 1.533.1 30।।
śrīpatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'nādyanta eva saḥ ।
kathito nṛpate tubhyaṃ prajāpāla hi taṃ bhaja ।। 13 1।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau mahātapā munistadā ।
vārāhaḥ prāha pṛthivīṃ tvayyapi santi te surāḥ ।। 1 32।।
tān devān bhaja deveśi yena mokṣo bhaved dhruvam ।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi pratyakṣākhyānamaiśvaram ।। 133।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya tathoktānāṃ prapūjanāt ।
tattvānāṃ brahmavijñānānyukto bhavati mānavaḥ ।। 134।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ parā siddhiḥ prajāyate ।
evamekātmatāṃ jñātvopāsate ṛṣayo harim ।। 1 35।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prajāpālarājño mahātapānāmakaṛṣipradattaśārīratattvātmakavedāntapuruṣajñānopāsanādinirūpaṇanāmā trayastriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।533।।


← adhyāyaḥ 533 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 534
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 535 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā śaṃbhurāsīno'bhūd varāntikam ।
kailāse dhyānamagnastu kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaran ।। 1 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।
vyāghrāraṇyaṃ mahāramyaṃ siṃhāraṇyaṃ ca raivatam ।। 2 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ bhadrāṃ śatruṃjitāṃ nadīm ।
lomaśaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhaktaṃ viṣṇuṃ gopālakṛṣṇakam ।। 3 ।।
devīṃ ca kambharālakṣmīṃ smaran dhyāne hyabhūt sthiraḥ ।
tasyotsaṃge samāgatya taptakāṃcanasaprabhā ।। 4 ।।
śrīdevī pārvatī yogasiddhidā mokṣadāyinī ।
niṣasāda mukhaṃ śaṃbhorvilokya sasmitā'bhavat ।। 5' ।।
uvāca devī madhuraṃ premapūritalocanā ।
kaṃ dhyāyase'harniśaṃ tvaṃ nā'to viramase kvacit ।। 6 ।।
evamuktvā'tibhāvena saṃjātā'srā''vilekṣaṇā ।
śaṃbhurdhyāna parityajya prāha bhaktāṃ maheśvarīm ।। 7 ।।
kathaṃ hyasrāvilanetrā premṇā śucā'thavā priye ।
vada sarvamabhīṣṭaṃ te karavāṇi sadā priye ।। 8 ।।
tvaṃ me hṛdayaṃ deveśi tathā'haṃ hṛdayaṃ ca te ।
ahaṃ tavāsmi sarvasvaṃ tvaṃ ca sarvasvameva me ।। 9 ।।
śrutvā vai pārvatī devī babhūva svasthamānasā ।
punaḥ papraccha kāntaṃ taddhyānamagnasya kāraṇam ।। 1.534.1 0।।
kimidaṃ dhyāyasi nātha vada me śāśvataṃ yadi ।
sanātanaṃ svarūpaṃ cellokamokṣapradaṃ tathā ।। 11 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha sati! nāsya dhyānasthasya harermayā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātra pāraṃ gantuṃ hi śakyate ।। 1 2।।
sa sadā''lokyate dhyāne cintyate sa rameśvaraḥ ।
pūjyate kamalākānto'rcyate śrīmāṇikīpatiḥ ।। 13 ।।
sevyate sa prabhākānto lakṣmīpatirnarāyaṇaḥ ।
pārvatīśvara evā'yaṃ yo mayā dhyāyate sati ।। 14।।
ahamasmātsamutpanno nā'tmyahaṃ tu pṛthak tataḥ ।
taṃ dhyāyāmi tvanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sati ।। 15।।
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca tīrthāni yatra vai harau ।
sadā tiṣṭhanti sarveśi taṃ smarāmi śriyaḥ patim ।। 16।।
tvāṃ smarāmi hareḥ pārśvasthitāṃ lakṣmīsvarūpiṇīm ।
ātmānaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakaṃ smarāmyaham ।। 17।।
lomaśasyāśramo yatra yadbhūmau raivatācalaḥ ।
prabhāsaṃ mama tīrthaṃ ca yatra deśe surāṣṭrake ।। 18।।
yatra śatruṃjitā, bhadrā, yatra kuṃkumavāpikā ।
aśvapaṭṭasaro yatra tatra gopālanandanam ।। 1 9।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sthitaṃ smarāmyaham ।
asadbhāvānvitāḥ kṣetraṃ naiva jānanti śāśvatam ।।1.534.20।।
sadbhāvabhāvitā devi jānantyetat sanātanam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaitat prākaṭyasya sthalaṃ śubham ।।21 ।।
