kṣetrasyā'syā'bhidhānāni kalpe kalpe pṛthakpṛthak ।
jāyante yugabhedena janā jānanti naiva tat ।।22।।
pūrvaṃ nāmnā maṇikṣetramabhūt surāṣṭramaṇḍalam ।
pādmakṣetraṃ tataścā'bhūnnāmnā khyātaṃ tadeva tu ।। 23 ।।
vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetramevaitannāmnā jātaṃ tataḥ param ।
tato vai lomaśakṣetraṃ nāmnā'bhūt khyātameva tat ।।24।।
tataḥ patnīvratakṣetraṃ nāmnā jātaṃ prasiddhimat ।
tata indradyumnanāmakṣetraṃ tatsamajāyata ।।25।।।
tato vai nārasiṃhākhyaṃ kṣetraṃ tatsamajāyata ।
tato vyāghrāraṇyanāmakṣetraṃ vai samajāyata ।।26।।।
tato rukmāṃgadakṣetraṃ nāmnā khyātamajāyata ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ tataḥ khyātamajāyata ।।27।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthaṃ tato nāmnā hyajāyata ।
tataḥ prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ nāmnā proktaṃ bhaviṣyati ।। 28।।
tataḥ someśvaraṃ kṣetraṃ tataḥ kaṃkābhidhaṃ punaḥ ।
tataḥ somapadaṃ kṣetraṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।29।।
tataḥ kṣetraṃ girināraṃ kālāntare bhaviṣyati ।
kalpe madhye surāṣṭraṃ ca mama yogānusārataḥ ।। 1.534.30 ।।
ṛṣeryogāttathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya yogataḥ ।
tava yogāttathā kāle pṛthaṅnāmāni sarvathā ।।3 1 ।।
bhaviṣyanti sati tāni jānāmyahaṃ hi yogataḥ ।
tādṛśaṃ puṇyakṛtkṣetraṃ mokṣadaṃ sarvadehinām ।।32।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāsātmakaṃ sadā ।
yatra vai vāmato viṣṇuryatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।33 ।।
talasvāmī tathā yatra gopīnātho'pi yatra ca ।
yatra siddheśvaraścāhaṃ yatra bhadreśvarastathā ।।34।।
someśvarastathā cāsmi yatra tvaṃ bhadrikā sati ।
yatra madhyabhuvi tvasti lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।35।।
rājadhānyāṃ yatra sādhvyo bahvyo vai kṛṣṇayoṣitaḥ ।
yatrā''nartodbhavaṃ rājyaṃ yatra gopālakṛṣṇajaḥ ।।36।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣād vasatyapi ।
tādṛśaṃ tadviśālaṃ ca kṣetraṃ vai śatayojanam ।।37।।
prāyaḥ samudrato vyāptaṃ tripārśve prāgbhuvā'nvitam ।
darśanādapi lokānāṃ pāpatāpanivārakam ।।38।।
yatra satāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ kulāni ca ।
mahatāṃ sāttvatānāṃ ca bhuvāṃ rakṣaṇakāriṇām ।।39।।
jñānināṃ ca tapasyāyāṃ ratānāṃ brahmacāriṇām ।
kulāni lokakalyāṇakāriṇāṃ pravasantyapi ।।1.534.40।।
nārīṇāṃ sādhubhaktānāṃ sādhunāthārthadehinām ।
sarvasvārpaṇabhaktānāṃ svāminārāyaṇasevinām ।।41।।
yatra viṣṇoḥ kalāṃśāśca prajāyante vibhūtayaḥ ।
tatkṣetraṃ cāsanaṃ devi purātanaṃ hi me'sti yat ।।42।।
tat smarāmi mahatkṣetraṃ śāntiṃ yāmi purātanīm ।
tvāṃ smarāmi yadā devi bahiścāyāmi vai kṣaṇāt ।।43।।
evaṃ me vallabhaṃ kṣetraṃ kalpānte kārṣṇavāllabham ।
nāmnā khyātaṃ pārvataṃ ca tava yogādbhaviṣyati ।।44।।
tasmin kṣetre mahādevi hyekānte'bdhitaṭe sadā ।
nivasāmi mayā guptaṃ kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ mamārthavat ।।45।।
yuge yuge tu tīrthāni jāyante ca viyanti ca ।
aśāstravācakānāṃ tu kṣetrasaṃgopanaṃ varam ।।46।।
pāpā nindanti māhātmyamajñātvā bhūtale harim ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ surāṣṭrajaṃ prabhum ।।47।।
idaṃ tīrthamidaṃ tīrthaṃ bhramanti jñānahīnakāḥ ।
gṛhatīrthaṃ na jānanti mīnaśūladhanurdhvajaiḥ ।।48।।
vajrasvastikacakraiśca nārāyaṇaṃ hi gocaram ।
rādhikāpārvatīlakṣmīmāṇikīsuprabhāpatim ।।49।।
sarveṣāṃ khalu tattvānāṃ svāminaṃ vallabhaṃ patim ।
ahaṃ devi bhajāmyenaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।।1.534.50।।
pare dhāmni sthitaṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarastaṭasthitam ।
lomaśasyāśrame kāntaṃ koṭigopīpatiṃ prabhum ।।51 ।।
yasya vāsaḥ sadā tatra kalpe kalpāntare'pi ca ।
tato'haṃ nityadā devi taṃ smarāmi purātanam ।।52।।
anyeṣu tīrthavaryeṣu me mano na sthirāyate ।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe sarvātmanā sthirāyate ।।53।।
tato nityaṃ sahajena smaryate manasā hi tat ।
yāvatsmarāmi tatkṣetraṃ tāvat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ ।।54।।
prahasan māṃ prati tveti yathā mitraṃ purātanam ।
anekairdivyabhāvaiśca līlābhiḥ sa manoharaḥ ।।55 ।।
kalpāntarānurūpābhiḥ ramayatyeva māṃ priye! ।
yathā me mānasaṃ tasmin grathitaṃ na viyujyate ।।56 ।।
tathā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇo māṃ sve prakarṣati ।
naiva muñcati bhiyaṃ māṃ nirodhayati māṃ nije ।।।57।।
etādṛśaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ smara kānte maheśvari ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smara mama priye ।।58।।
ityuktā pārvatī devī brahmānandapariplutā ।
kṣetrasya śravaṇādeva babhūva brahmatanmayī ।।59।।
tāvattasyāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svahṛdaye'sphurat ।
divyarūpadharo bālaḥ koṭikandarpasundaraḥ ।।1.534.60।।
prāha mātarmama kṣetraṃ kathaṃ nāyāsi vai kvacit ।
ityuktvā pārvatīṃ natvā tejomaṇḍalamadhyagaḥ ।।61 ।।
koṭikāntākāntasevitaḥ sākṣād darśanaṃ dadau ।
yuvā'kṣarākhyalokasya muktairjuṣṭastataḥ param ।।62।।
golokastho dvibhujaśca gopīgopagaṇārcitaḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhasthaścaturbāhuḥ ramāśrīkamalārcitaḥ ।।63।।
kailāsastho nāgasūtro himojjvalo dṛḍho yuvā ।
jaṭājūṭaśirāścorau satī yasyāsti so'bhavat ।।64।।
evaṃ datvā darśanaṃ svaṃ punaścāntaradhīyata ।
satī tu pārvatī devī mahadāścaryamāsthitā ।।65।।
jajāgāra samādheḥ sā prāha śrīśaṃkaraṃ patim ।
dṛṣṭaṃ kṣetraṃ mayā kānta dṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।66।।
idānīṃ kṛtakṛtyā'haṃ jātā dṛṣṭvā'cyutaṃ patim ।
yaśca saṃvartate dhāmni pare'kṣarāt pumuttamaḥ ।।67।।
sa eva śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'śvapaṭṭatīrthake ।
goloke cāpi vaikuṇṭhe kailāse'pi sa eva saḥ ।।68।।
patirme vartase caivaṃ mayā hṛdi vilokitam ।
vada kṣetraṃ viśālaṃ me śravānandaḥ prajāyate ।।69।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam ।
adya jñātaṃ mayā śaṃbho! māhātmyaṃ kathayasva me ।।1.534.70।।
japaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre kva kasmiṃścā'kṣayaṃ bhavet ।। 71 ।।
kṣetrasya vartulaṃ sīma kṣetrasāraṃ ca me vada ।
tava hastā''malakavad dṛśyaṃ bhavati sarvathā ।।72।।
śaṃkaraḥ prāha deveśi saurāṣṭraṃ tu priyaṃ mama ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ kṛṣṇasya mama ca priyam ।। 73।।
prabhāsād raivatādreśca śatruṃjitānadīmataḥ ।
camatkārapurāccāpi tatkṣetraṃ supriyaṃ mama ।। 74।।
yatra sannihito nityamacyuto bhagavān svayam ।
yatra vai lomaśo brahmā yatrā'haṃ nivasāmi ca ।।75।।
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ saurāṣṭramaṇḍalam ।
maṇijanyaṃ tu taddivyaṃ mokṣadaṃ prāṇināṃ sadā ।।76।।
paścime raivataṃ pīṭhaṃ pūrve śanuṃjidāhvayam ।
uttare ca camatkāraṃ dakṣiṇe somanāthakam ।।77।।
antaḥpīṭhaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasaraḥ kuṃkumavāpikā ।
yatra bhadrā hiraṇyā ca svarṇarekhā hyujasvatī । ।78।।
hariṇyunmattagaṃgā ca śatruṃjitā sarasvatī ।
nāganadī gomatī ca kṛṣṇā divyā hareḥpriyāḥ ।।79।।
āpagā bhavatāriṇyaḥ saurāṣṭre santi sarvadā ।
nyaṃkumatī vajriṇī ca māheśvarī mahāsatī ।।।1.534.80।
siṃhāraṇyasthitānyeva santi tīrthāni tānyapi ।
saurāṣṭre yāni tīrthāni kṛṣṇanārāyaṇecchayā ।।81 ।8
vāpī kūpataḍāgāni pallavāni hradādayaḥ ।
sarāṃsi cāpagāścāpi devānāmālayāstathā ।।82।
satāṃ nivāsā grāmāśca medhyāḥ pāpaharā hi te ।
saurāṣṭre madhyadeśe śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ।।83।
uttare śrīvāsudevo golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ ।
paścime vāmano devo dakṣiṇe somanāthakaḥ ।।84।
pūrve śrīgopikānātho vartante bhavatārakāḥ ।
madhyabhāge vased yastu yadi naiṣkṛtiko naraḥ ।।85।।
yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho mucyate sarvapātakāt ।
madhyabhāge sadā devi! tvayā saha vasāmyaham ।।86।।
tatra brahmādayaḥ santi nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ ।
yoginaḥ sādhavastatropāsate lomaśaṃ munim ।।87।।
yatkiṃcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānavabuddhinā ।
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāyātkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayāt ।।88।।
gopāleśvaranāmā'haṃ madhye tiṣṭhāmi tatra vai ।
asaṃkhyatvāttu kalpānāṃ janā jānanti naiva mām ।।89।।
snehācca tava bhaktyā ca mayā te'tra niveditam ।
ahaṃ vai vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā madhye vasāmi sarvadā ।।1.534.90।।
yajñadānajapairhomaiḥ svādhyāyaiḥ pitṛtarpaṇaiḥ ।
cāndrāyaṇaiścopavāsaistīrthādigamanaistathā ।।91।।
yatpadaṃ labhyate devi tataḥ śreṣṭhaṃ padaṃ hareḥ ।
akṣarākhyaṃ mahaddhāma prāpyate madhyasaṃśrayāt ।।92।।
tiryagyonigatā ye ca paśupakṣimṛgādayaḥ ।
kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyā jalasthalanivāsinaḥ ।।93।।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāścānye bālā vṛddhā narāḥ striyaḥ ।
cāṇḍālāḥ puṣkasāścāpi kutsitā vimatāstathā ।।94।।
viyonijā dehinaśca mucyante madhyavāsataḥ ।
lomaśo nārasiṃhaśca sanakādyāścirāyuṣaḥ ।।95।।
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ pañcaśikho voḍhurāsurirityapi ।
dattātreyo hanumāँśca gaṇeśo vyāsa ityapi ।।96 ।।
jāmbavān kapilaścānye yatra kṣetre vasanti ca ।
teṣāṃ pratāpato jīvā mucyante madhyavāsataḥ ।।97।।
daśārbudasahasrāṇi koṭitritayamityapi ।
saurāṣṭre ṛṣayo nityaṃ tiṣṭhantyadṛśyarūpiṇaḥ ।।98।।
meroḥ śakyā guṇā vaktuṃ samudrāṇāṃ ca bindavaḥ ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyātra divyakṣetrasya vai sati! ।।99।।
śakyā naiva guṇā vaktuṃ varṣakoṭiśatairapi ।
ityāha śaṃkaro devīṃ tataśca virarāma ha ।। 1.534.10 0।।
evaṃ lakṣmi! tava patyuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya me ।
kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ paraṃ śrutvā sasmāra pārvatī harim ।। 101 ।।
dhyāne sthitā ca sā nityaṃ prāptaḥ smarati bhāvataḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṣetraṃ sumuktidam ।। 102 ।।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccā'sya smaraṇādvandanādapi ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṣetraṃ jīvānāṃ sampadāṃ pradam ।। 1 03।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpītīrthakṣetramahimnaḥ pārvatīṃ prati śaṃkarakṛtaṃ varṇanamitinirūpaṇanāmā catustriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।534।।


← adhyāyaḥ 534 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 535
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 536 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato devī pārvatī śaṃkaraṃ patim ।
tuṣṭāva prārthayāmāsa smṛtvā svāpnaṃ harervacaḥ ।। 1 ।।
prāṇeśa! śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
prāha mātarmama kṣetraṃ kathaṃ nāyāsi vai kvacit ।। 2 ।।
ityevaṃ kathitā cā'haṃ svapne bhagavatā priya! ।
tatkṣetraṃ draṣṭumicchāmi gopāleśvaramaṇḍitam ।। 3 ।।
yatra śrībhagavān viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।
vartate muktakoṭyādyairdraṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 4 ।।
yattantraṃ lokacakraṃ vai yattantraṃ layacakrakam ।
sa yatra vartate devo draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 5 ।।
yadadhīnaṃ hi lokānāṃ gopāyanaṃ pravartate ।
sa kṛṣṇo vartate yatra draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 6 ।।
mahābhūtāni sarvāṇi yena dhṛtāni varṣmaṇi ।
sa dhṛto yena deśena draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 7 ।।
yasmānmatsyastathā kūrmo vārāho narasiṃhakaḥ ।
kapilaśca hariścāpi vāsudevaḥ pṛthustathā ।। 8 ।।
dattātreyastathā haṃsaḥ ṛṣabho vāmanaḥ prabhuḥ ।
parśurāmastathā yajñanārāyaṇaḥ kumārakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
sanakādyāstathā rāmo hayagrīvaśca nāradaḥ ।
vyāso buddhastathā kalkirhaṃsaśca mohinī tathā ।। 1.535.1 0।।
viṣṇuścaite hyavatārā jāyante lokarakṣakāḥ ।
sa rājate yatra deśe draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 1 1।।
rādhā ramā satī lakṣmīḥ padmā padmāvatī prabhā ।
pārvatī lalitā kṛṣṇā jayā māṇikī tūlasī ।। 12।।
vṛndā śrīḥ kamalā sītā rukmiṇī draupadī śivā ।
gaṃgā sarasvatī haṃsā śāradā maṃjulā ratiḥ ।। 13।।
mūrtiśca mānasā sandhyā gāyatrī mūlaprakṛtiḥ ।
sāvitrī devikā muktiḥ śāntirbhaktiśca yoṣitaḥ ।। 14।।
yasmājjātā mātaraśca lokānāṃ sukhadāyikāḥ ।
sa rājate yatra deśe draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 15।।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāmāśrayo bhagavāँstu yaḥ ।
pralayasya punaḥ sṛṣṭerdraṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 16।।
sahasrakramaṇo devaḥ sahasrajñānaraśmivān ।
sahasrakaṃdharo yatra draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।। 17।।
yannābhau kalpanāmātrājjātaṃ paitāmahaṃ gṛham ।
yallalāṭāddharmabindorjātaḥ śivāpatiḥ prabhuḥ ।। 18।।
yasya vai hṛdayāllakṣmīpatiḥ sambhūta eva ca ।
so'pi yasmāt samutpannastasya praprapitāmahaḥ ।। 19।।
yatra saṃrājate śaṃbho draṣṭumicchāmi tatsthalam ।
dugdhābdhau śayanaṃ cakre śeṣaparyaṃkamāsthitaḥ ।।1.535.20।।
yaḥ sa yasmātsamutpannastasyāpi cāvatāriṇam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇamicchāmi vīkṣitum ।।21 ।।
havyādaiścāpi kravyādairbhāvādairamṛtādanaiḥ ।
anadanaistathā yo vai ramate hyanurūpataḥ ।।22।।
bālarūpaṃ svapnadṛṣṭaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi taṃ prabhum ।
trayāṇāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca yo gatiḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।23।।
pañcānāṃ ṣoḍaśānāṃ ca draṣṭumicchāmi taṃ prabhum ।
tejāṃsi yaṃ śrayante ca tapāṃsi cārpaṇāni ca ।।24।।
kratavastyāgasanyāsāḥ śrayante yaṃ pareśvaram ।
kāntakāntaṃ ca taṃ śaṃbho! draṣṭumicchāmi satvaram ।।25।।
ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro devo bhaktiṃ vilokya yoṣitaḥ ।
uvāca madhuraṃ devīṃ smaran kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।26 ।।
dhanye mānye sadā pūjye kṛṣṇapriye pativrate ।
hṛṣyāmi tvadvacaḥ śrutvā''pyāyitaṃ bhaktivāriṇā ।।27।।
dhanyo'haṃ yadgṛhe patnī nārāyaṇe dṛḍhavratā ।
bhaktimatī sveṣṭadeve jagaduddhārakāriṇī ।।28।।
na mayā sadṛśo devi! bhāgyavān bhuvaneṣvapi ।
yatpatnī śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadāsyābhirañjitā ।।29।।
mamāpi vartate sādhvi! draṣṭumicchā hi tatsthalam ।
vahukālo gato yasmātpunaryāsyāmi vai tvayā ।।1.535.30।।
saubhāgyaṃ vardhatāṃ kānte prasannayasi yanmanaḥ ।
vyomamārgeṇa yāsyāvo bahupūjopacārakaiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vidhinā'rcanam ।
kariṣyāvaḥ kārtike vai sthāsyāvastatra śobhane ।।32।।
śivarātriṃ kariṣyāvastatra vai raivatācale ।
tato'kṣayatṛtīyāyāṃ snāsyāvaḥ somanāthake ।।33।।
śrāvaṇaṃ ca kariṣyāvo gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇapattane ।
navarātraṃ camatkāre kṛtvā kailāsameva tu ।।34।।
āyāsyāvo mahādevi! vada nandīśvaraṃ tathā ।
gaṇeśaṃ kārtikeyaṃ ca yoginīmaṇḍalaṃ vada ।। 35।।
durgānāṃ maṇḍalaṃ cāpi rudrānekādaśāpi ca ।
gaṃgāṃ ca vīrabhadraṃ ca caṇḍaṃ pracaṇḍamityapi ।।36।।
śṛṃgiṃ bhṛṃgiṃ ca rīṭiṃ kirīṭiṃ ceśānamityapi ।
agniṃ ca maṃgalaṃ candraṃ kālaṃ bhairavamityapi ।।37।।
durvāsasaṃ tathā lābhaṃ toṣaṃ siddhīśca vai vada ।
ṛddhiṃ ca hanumantaṃ ca tathā'nyān mama sevakān ।।38।।
tavāpi sevikā devīrvada yātrārthamutsukān ।
sarvān vāhanasāmagrīrupadā''gṛhya yāntviti ।।39।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkarāllabdhvā samājñāṃ pārvatī satī ।
suprasannā samutthāya ghoṣayāmāsa sarvathā ।।1.535.40।।
sannahyantāṃ suyātrārthaṃ drutaṃ saurāṣṭramaṇḍale ।
yatrāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।।41।।
somanātho vāmanaśca bhaveśo gopikāpatiḥ ।
tatra yātrākṛte sarvairgantavyaṃ vyomagāmibhiḥ ।।42।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetraṃ cāśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca lomaśaṃ munim ।।43 ।।
mātaraṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīṃ pitṛgopālakṛṣṇakam ।
dṛṣṭvā'rcayitvā sevitvā yāsyāmaḥ kṛtakṛtyatām ।।44।।
evaṃ kailāsavāsāste bahuratnādisaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
ūrjakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ yātrāṃ cakrarmudānvitāḥ ।।45।।
dundubhayo hyavādyanta prājñāyanta jayeraṇāḥ ।
prāvartantā'mbare sarve tvāyayurghaṭikāntare ।।46।।
vyomni koṭigaṇadevīvāhanaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ ।
mahādevastu taiḥ pṛṣṭhaḥ samuvāca sthale sthale ।।47।।
ayaṃ kedāranātho'haṃ dakṣeśvarastathā hyaham ।
arbude puṣkaraṃ cedaṃ siddhakṣetramidaṃ tathā ।।48।।
raṇeśvaraṃ ca me kṣetraṃ saurāṣṭraṃ cedamāgatam ।
sāleśo'yaṃ mahāviṣṇurbhadrā ceyaṃ mahāpagā ।।49 ।।
śatruñjitā nadī ceyaṃ gorakṣasya ca dhūnikā ।
aśvapaṭṭasaraścedaṃ paścimottarasetumat ।।1.535.5 0।।
madhyadvīpe mandiraṃ ca yatra kuṃkumavāpikā ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇālayo'yamuttamaḥ ।।2 1 ।।
dakṣiṇe vṛkṣavistāre lomaśasyāśramo hyayam ।
vyāghrāraṇyaṃ tathā dūraṃ dīrghaṃ cedaṃ vilokyate ।।52।।
paścime raivataścāyaṃ pañcayojanataḥ paraḥ ।
ityuktvā śaṃkarādyaiśca pārvatīyuktatadgaṇaiḥ ।।13।।
sākṣatāḥ puṣpāṃjalayaścandanadravamiśritāḥ ।
vyomamārgādarpitāśca sāptabhaumālayopari ।।54।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vijayatetarām ।
itiśabdairdhvanibhiśca diśo'pūryanta sarvataḥ ।।55।।
lomaśaḥ kaṃbharālakṣmīrgopālakṛṣṇa ūrdhvagān ।
ṛṣayaśca vilokyaitānabhijagmustadā'mbare ।।56।।
jayaśabdā namaḥśabdā dhanyaśabdāstadā'bhavan ।
militvā cā'vateruśca paścime setumaṇḍale ।।57।।
terunāmnāpradeśaḥ so'bhavatpaścimadigbhavaḥ ।
setunā ca kṛtaṃ tairvai pūrve gatvā pradakṣiṇam ।।58।।
ujjvalaḥ sa pradeśo'bhūt tataḥ pūrvaṃ gatāśca te ।
amarāṇāṃ gateryogādamarā bhūmikā'bhavat ।।59।।
dundubhiravayogena dunduravā'bhavacca bhūḥ ।
vyāghrāraṇyamukhe gatvā setunā te ca devatāḥ ।।1.535.6 0।।
dakṣiṇapaścimasetuṃ samāgatya tataśca te ।
vāpīdvīpaṃ sāptabhaumaṃ mandiraṃ, jagmurutsukāḥ ।।61 ।।
lomaśādyāḥ ṛṣayaśca svāgataṃ śubhamānanam ।
cakrurdevādhidevasya śaṃbhoḥ satyāḥ supūjanam ।।62।।
kauśāsanāni pradadurarghaṃ jalaṃ phalāni ca ।
saudhāntaḥsthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ yayustataḥ ।।63।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo yatra virājate ।
ciraṃjīviśatairyukto ' muktakoṭibhirarcitaḥ ।64।।
avatāraiḥ śobhitaśca devaiḥ saṃsevitaḥ prṝbhuḥ ।.
ūrjakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ niśāyāṃ pūjitaśca taiḥ ।।65।।
rādhāramādipatnībhirasaṃkhyābhirabhiṣṭutaḥ ।
śaṃkarādyairvedamantrairvarṇitaḥ ṣoḍaśādibhiḥ ।।66।।
nīrājitastataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śṛṃgāritaḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
pārvatyā kastūrikayā bindurbhāle sakuṃkumaḥ ।।67।।
kṛtaḥ sākṣataśobhaśca śaṃbhunā tilakaṃ śubham ।
candanena kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ pārvatyā tu tataḥ punaḥ ।।68।।।
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyabhṛtaṃ harikapolakam ।
sacandrakaṃ kṛtaṃ tvārdrakuṃkumena punaḥ punaḥ ।।69।।
rañjayāmāsa deveśī dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ manoharam ।
upadā vividhā ratnasauvarṇādīni cārpayat ।।1.535.70।।
daṇḍavat kṛtavantaste saṃbhāṣāṃ vidadhurmithaḥ ।
gopālanandano bālaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।71।।
pūjottaraṃ svayaṃ svasyā''sanādutthāya satvaram ।
nanāma pādayoḥ śaṃbhoḥ pārvatyāśca pareśvaraḥ ।।72।।।
ātithyavidhinā pādau prakṣālya salilaṃ papau ।
saṃkalpena ca sainyānāṃ nivāsārthaṃ tu lomaśaḥ ।।73।।
cakārā''raivataṃ yāvannagaraṃ vartulaṃ mahat ।
pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyākayojanānāṃ bhuvontare ।।74।।
vāsayāmāsa tān sarvān bhojyapānā''śramādibhiḥ ।
sevayāmāsa sarvāṃśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।75।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca śaṃbhuṃ prāhā''śrunetrakaḥ ।
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ maddhāma pāvitaṃ tvayā ।।76।।।
sarvavandyeṣu mūrdhanyaṃ padaṃ dattaṃ tvayā ca me ।
ete pareśvarāścānye yanmamāśramamāgatāḥ ।।77।।
dhanyeyaṃ pṛthivī śubhrā yāvadaṇḍaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
tāvacca pāvanī tīrtharūpā khyātā bhaviṣyati ।।78।।
kaṃbharākhyā mahālakṣmī pārvatīṃ prāha śobhanam ।
lokamātuḥ kimu vācyaṃ pāvitā'haṃ tvayā sati! ।।79।।
tvayā duḥkhavihantryā ca vardhito mama bālakaḥ ।
tapobhiryā na dṛśyā'sti sā dṛṣṭā'dya mayā sati । ।।1.535.80।।
pūrveṣāṃ saṃbhavānāṃ prasmāritaṃ puṇyamatra vai ।
svāgataṃ sarvathā haimi śāṃbhavi śāntimāvaha ।।81।।
ahaṃ dāsīsametā ca sevāṃ karomi śaṃ vaha ।
uktvaivaṃ kambharālakṣmīḥ pādasaṃvāhanaṃ tadā ।।82।।
pārvatyāstvatithirītyā cakre'nyasevanādikam ।
paryaṃkeṣu sudivyeṣu kailāsādadhikeṣu ca ।।0।।।
vibhāntiṃ labdhavantaste śaṃkarādyāstu devatāḥ ।
bhojanāni supānāni tāmbūlakāni bhāvataḥ ।।।5।।
daduḥ kṛṣṇajanāḥ sarve saṃjagṛhuḥ sukhāstu te ।
suṣupuḥ śaṃkarādyā vai kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastadā ।।85।।
pārvatīṃ mātaraṃ prāha madvākyaṃ pālitaṃ sati ।
svāgataṃ te prakurvanti ramādyā mama cāṃganāḥ ।।।86।।।
iyaṃ me pārvatīnāmnī prabheyaṃ tatsahāyinī ।
māṇikīyaṃ mama kāntā lakṣmīriyaṃ pativratā ।।।87।
rādheyaṃ lalitā ceyaṃ jayeyaṃ kamalā tviyam । ।
padminī bhārgavī ceyaṃ mukteyaṃ devikā tviyam ।।88।।
campeyaṃ hemabheyaṃ ca śānteyaṃ vājinī tviyam ।
mauktikeyaṃ maṃjuleyaṃ haṃseyaṃ saguṇā tviyam ।।89।।
evamanyāḥ sahasrāṇi vidyante tā ime'tra vai ।
tava sevāṃ prakurvantu yāmyahaṃ nijamandiram ।।1.535.90।।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagāma mandiram ।
suṣvāpa ca sukhaṃ prātastūryāṇi vividhāni ca ।।91 ।।
avādyanta hi divyāni prabodhaṃ lebhire janāḥ ।
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamī ceyaṃ jayantī śrīharermama ।।92।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyā''sīttataśca tai ।
śaṃkarādyā nityakāryaṃ kṛtvā sajjāḥ suśobhanāḥ ।।93।।
prātaḥ pūjāṃ cābhiṣekaṃ kartuṃ mandiramāyayuḥ ।
devatāḥ śaṃkarendrādyā munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā ।।94।।
pitaraḥ kaśyapāścānye brāhmaṇā mānavāstathā ।
muktā devyaḥ surakanyā nāgakanyāśca bhoginaḥ ।।95।।
gandharvāḥ kinnarā guhyā santaḥ kiṃpuruṣādayaḥ ।
sādhvyaḥ pativratā brahmavratinyo yogayoṣitaḥ ।।96।।
mātaro vanadevyaśca nadyaḥ puryaśca dhenavaḥ ।
gopyaścaitāḥ payaḥkulyā dadhikulyā ghṛtāni ca ।।97।।
madhukulyāḥ śarkarāḥ saṃgṛhya tīrthajalāni ca ।
sauvarṇakalaśānnītvā phalā'kṣatasamanvitān ।।98।।
jalayātrādividhayā kṛtvā mūrdhasu gītikāḥ ।
āyayuḥ sarvanāthādhiśritaṃ divyasumandiram ।।99।।
puṣpamālāścandanāni kastūrīścā'kṣatāstathā ।
puṣpasārarasāँścāpi sugandhitelakāni ca ।। 1.535.10 0।।
mṛdyadravyāṇi ramyāṇi raktapātāni yāni ca ।
tā ādāya samājagmuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ।। 101 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svaṇāmbaraṃ śubham ।
paridhāya sarastīre svarṇasiṃhāsane vare ।। 1 02।।
niṣasādātha daivādyairbṛhaspatyādibhistadā ।
bhūtaśuddhiṃ kārayitvā pradāyā''camanāni ca ।। 103 ।।
arghaṃ datvā jalasnānaṃ kārayitvā tataḥ param ।
dugdhakuṃbhe dugdhasnānaṃ kāritaṃ śubhadarśanam ।। 1 04।।
dhanavo vyomamārgeṇa payāṃsi mumucustadā ।
gopyo devyādikāḥ kṛṣṇe vavṛṣurdadhi picchalam ।। 1 05।।
devā ghṛtāni mumucurmadhūni .vanadevatāḥ ।
pṛthvyādyāḥ pradadustasmin śarkarāsnānamujjvalam ।। 106 ।।
abdhayaḥ saritastīrthottamānyadurjalāni ca ।
abhiṣekaṃ śubhaṃ cakrustataścandanatailajam ।। 1 07।।
lepaṃ sammardanaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā'mbarāṇi ca ।
dadurdivyāni devāśca bhūṣāśca dhanadā daduḥ ।। 1 08।।
śrāṃgārikaṃ tathā'nye'nyāḥ sarvaṃ mahottamaṃ daduḥ ।
mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale hārānūrmikāḥ śṛṃkhalādikāḥ ।।1 09।।।
chatraṃ sucāmare kṛṣṇaṃ dhārayitvā tu devatāḥ ।
vaidikairmukhyasūktādyairnīrājanaṃ vyadhurmudā ।। 1.535.11 0।।
kṣamāṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ datvā bhojanaṃ purato nyadhuḥ ।
bhagavān bubhuje pānaṃ papau dadau samāgatān।। 111 ।।
prasādaṃ kānake pātre'kṣayyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ yataḥ ।
atha tān bhojayāmāsurgālavādyā maharṣayaḥ ।। 11 2।।
sāyaṃ praṇartanaṃ cakrurgāyanaṃ kīrtanāni ca ।
dānāni vividhānyevā'saṃkhyakāni dadau hariḥ ।। 11 3।।
rātrau nīrājanaṃ cakrurjuhuvuśca hutāśane ।
utsavasya parihāraṃ kṛtvā suṣupurīśvarāḥ ।। 1 14।।
sarve śāntā yoganidrāṃ gatā yugalakoṭayaḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasya tadyātrāphalabhāgbhavet ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dhyānasthaśaṃkarāt jñātvā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ jigamiṣusagaṇaśaṃkarapārvatīśaktisatīdevadevītīrthadivyeśvarādisamastavibhūtidehibhiḥ samāgatyorjakṛṣṇāṣṭamījayantyā
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'rcanaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।535।।

adhyāyaḥ 536
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 537 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha prātarnavamyāṃ prājāyanta tūryaniḥsvanāḥ ।
jajāgaruśca devādyāḥ snātvā veṣāṃśca dadhrire ।। 1 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadarśanahetave ।
ājagmuste pupūjuśca gopālakṛṣṇanandanam ।। 2 ।।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇaśca tathā śrīlomaśo muniḥ ।
patnīvratādyāścakruḥ saṃpūjāṃ teṣāṃ suvaidikīm ।। 3 ।।
avatārārcanaṃ cakrurmunayastatra vāsinaḥ ।
tāni tīrthāni jātāni koṭiśo'tra sarovare ।। 4 ।।
viṣṇoḥ śaṃbhorbrahmaṇaścārcanaṃ cakāra lomaśaḥ ।
śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇastu śaṃbhoḥ pūjanamācarat ।। 5 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha sadā cā'haṃ vasāmi kṛṣṇasannidhau ।
gopāleśvaranāmā'haṃ khyātiṃ yāsyāmi cātra vai ।। 6 ।।
satī prāha sadā cāhaṃ kambharākamalārcitā ।
vatsyāmi śakarapārśve kambharākamaleśvarī ।। 7 ।।
khyātā divyasvarūpeṇa bhaviṣyāmi ramecchayā ।
gaṇeśaḥ kārtikeyaśca mama putrau mayā saha ।। 8 ।।
śukaśuṇḍho bhagavāँśca kramānnāmnā bhaviṣyataḥ ।
santuṣṭā ca satī cāhaṃ brahmacaryaparāyaṇā ।। 9 ।।
santoṣadurgānāmnī ca bhaviṣyāmi prabhoḥ puraḥ ।
evaṃ nandivīrabhadraprabhatayo gaṇāḥ sadā ।। 1.536.1 0।।
tattannāmnā nivatsyanti śrīkṛṣṇamandirāgrataḥ ।
atha viṣṇorbrahmaṇaśca patnīyuktasya pūjanam ।। 11 ।।
cakāra vidhinā śrīmadgopālakṛṣṇa ādarāt ।
tābhyāṃ tatra nivāso'pi kṛto divyena varṣmaṇā ।। 12।।
tāni tīrthāni jātāni surāṇāṃ koṭikāni hi ।
devā gaṇāstathā'nye'pi vṛkṣā nadyaśca vallikāḥ ।। 1 3।।
gandharvāḥ kinnarā anye kāśyapā divyadṛṣṭayaḥ ।
divyadehā nivāsān vai cakrire kṛṣṇasannidhau ।। 14।।
saurāṣṭre sarvathā kṣetre kṛṣṇanārāyaṇājñayā ।
yeṣāṃ yatrā'bhavat hārde tatra te nyavasaँstadā ।। 15।।
atha bhojanapānāni kṛtavantaśca te surāḥ ।
devā devyo yayurnatvā nivāsanagare mudā ।। 16।।
evaṃ vai devatāstatra nyuṣurmāsacatuṣṭayam ।
kiṃ bhāgyaṃ varṇaye bhūmerna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।। 17।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathāḥ kramāttadā ।
dattātreyo mahārājo vācayāmāsa nityadā ।। 18।।
śuśruvuḥ parayā bhaktyā nityaṃ devyaśca devatāḥ ।
jaḍadāśca cetanāścāpi caturdaśabhuvāṃ prajāḥ ।। 19।।
sendriyā māghaparyantaṃ divyanagarasaṃsthitāḥ ।
śivarātryāṃ yayuḥ sarve raivatācalaparvatam ।।1.536.20 ।।
dattātreyo bhagavāṃstu śṛṃge vāsaṃ vyadhād dṛḍham ।
ambā bhavastathā viṣṇuḥ svasvasthānāni bhejire ।।21 ।।
gaṇā devāstathā devyo yatheṣṭaṃ vāsamādadhuḥ ।
śivarātrivrataṃ tatra raivatādrau vidhāya ca ।।22।।
somanāthaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ te yayustataḥ ।
taiḥ prabhāse kṛtā'kṣayyatṛtīyā tatra vai śubhā ।। 23।।
pārvatī prāha bhagavan prabhāsaṃ kṣetramityapi ।
nāmnā samucyate kasmād vada me'rthaṃ yathārthakam ।।24।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha śṛṇu kānte! bhāsate mama yogataḥ।
prakṛṣṭaṃ tatprabhāsaṃ vai vetraṃ nāmnā prakīrtyate ।।25।।
candramasaḥ prabhā āsan mamaiva varadānataḥ ।
kṣayasyā'pagame kānte prabhāsaṃ tena kīrtyate ।। 26।।
sūryaputrī prabhā bhūmau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇapriyā ।
yatra tvāsa purā martyarūpā ramyā kumārikā ।।27।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prāptā tapasyayā ।
prabhāyā āsanaṃ yatra prabhāsaṃ tena kīrtyate ।।28।।
devairyatra prabhālabdhā tapobhirugrakairyataḥ ।
prathamaṃ bhāsamānaṃ tat sarvatīrtheṣu vartate ।।29।।
yatra śrīrbhāratī vahniṃ vāḍavaṃ sāgare'kṣipat ।
tadā vai bhāsamānaṃ tat prabhāsaṃ samajāyata ।।1.536.30।।
saurāṣṭrasya navamo yo bhāgo vibhāsate kṣitau ।
kīrtyā prabhāsaḥ proktaḥ saḥ prabhā jñānaṃ ca tatpradaḥ ।।31 ।।
prakṛṣṭā bhā bhāratī ca āsa vipramukheṣu yā ।
vedātmikāṃ prabhāsaṃ tatkṣetraṃ vai brāhmaṇapriyam ।।।32।।
pratyakṣaṃ bhāskaraścārkadrumajanmasvarūpataḥ ।
yatra vai vartate tasmātprabhāsaṃ surabhāṣitam ।।33।।
sūryasyāsītpurā tejo duḥsahaṃ viśvakarmakaḥ ।
śāṇollīḍhaṃ raviṃ kṛtvā sahyatejaskamācarat ।। 34।।
śāṇocchinnāni tejāṃsi vyabhajacchastrahetave ।
āyudhāni tejasāṃ ca kṛtāni viśvakarmaṇā ।। 35।।
tathāpi śiṣyate tejastadatra sāgarāntike ।
sthāpitaṃ yacchanaiḥ śāntamabhavat tatprabhāsakam ।।36।।
tejasaḥ ṣoḍaśo bhāgaḥ sūryasya maṇḍale'bhavat ।
yattasya ṛṅmayaṃ tejastatprabhāse sthirīkṛtam ।।37।।
dyauḥ saṃpuṣṭiṃ prāpitā ca yajurmayena tejasā ।
svargaṃ prapoṣitaṃ sāmnā tejasā viśvakarmaṇā ।।38।।
anyena nirmitaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇorharasya śūlakam ।
dhanadasya ca śibikā daṇḍaḥ pretapatestathā ।।39।।
kārtikasya tathā śaktirgadā hanumatastathā ।
karavālaṃ tathā devyā mahākālasya .pāśakaḥ ।।1.536.40।।
pāśupataṃ tathā nārāyaṇāstraṃ tvaṃśataḥ kṛtam ।
anyānyapi tathāstrāṇi yathāyogyaṃ kṛtāni hi ।।41 ।।
evaṃ sūryasya vai tejaḥ sāgarāntikamāsthitam ।
prabhāsaṃ tanmahatkṣetra mama devi! nivāsabhūḥ ।।42।।
māheśvaryā dakṣiṇaṃ ca nyaṃkumatyāḥ kṛtasmaram ।
adriṃ vyāpya yojanānāṃ dvādaśā'bhiprabhāsakam ।।43।।
tatrā'rkavṛkṣatāṃ yātaḥ sūryo vaṃśānuvaṃśataḥ ।
arkavṛkṣaṃ pūjayet yaḥ kuṣṭhastasya vinaśyati ।।44।।
someśvarād vahnikoṇe siddheśvaro'hamāsthitaḥ ।
jaigīṣavyena siddhena tapo varṣasahasrakam ।।।45।।
kṛtvā'haṃ sthāpitaḥ siddheśvaro bhavāmi śailaje ।
vālakhilyāstatra siddhiṃ jagmurvai tapasā parām ।।46।।
kṛtasmarāt samārabhya yāvadarkasthalaṃ sati! ।
siddhayo'ṣṭau nivasanti mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ ।।47।।
brāhmī caiva hiraṇyā ca nadyau vai brahmaṇaḥ sute ।
maṃkīśarṣistathā santi sunandādyāśca mātaraḥ ।।48।।
kṛtasmaraṃ mahādriṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tu ṛṣayo dvijāḥ ।
asmābhiśca saha yātrākarā vāsāni cakrire ।।49।।
atrirvasiṣṭhaḥ pulahaḥ kraturbhṛguḥ pulastyakaḥ ।
marīciḥ kaśyapo bhāradvājo yamoṅgirā manuḥ ।।1.536.50 ।।
āpastambo'tha sāṃvartaḥ kāvyaḥ kātyāyanastathā ।
gautamaḥ śaṃkhalikhitau vācaspatistathā'ruṇiḥ ।।51 ।।
jāmadagnyo yājñavalkyaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṇḍakaḥ ।
gārgyaḥ śaunakadālbhyau ca vyāsa uddālakaḥ śubhaḥ ।।52।।
nāradaḥ parvataścaiva durvāsā ugratāpasaḥ ।
śākalyo gālavaścāpi jābālirmudgalaḥ ṛbhuḥ ।।53।।
viśvāmiśraḥ kauśikaśca jahnurviśvāvasustathā ।
dhaumyaścaiva śatānandaḥ śākaṭāyana ekataḥ ।।54।।
dvitastritastathā cānye ye cāsaँśca samāgatāḥ ।
te yatheṣṭaṃ nijaśālāścakruścātra prabhāsake ।।55।।
jvalantastapasā sarve saṃsthitāḥ kṛtaparvate ।
somanāthaṃ somavāre pūjayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ।।56।।
snātvā sandhyādikaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā narāyaṇam ।
yogye vai maṇḍape ramye nyasya kuṃbhaṃ suśobhanam ।।57।।
cūtapallavaśobhāḍhyaṃ candanākṣatapūjitam ।
kuṃkumacandanaiḥ kṛtvā ghaṭārdhaṃ pratimānvitam ।।58।।
umādehārdhasaṃyuktaṃ śaṃkarārdhasamanvitam ।
yathābhūṣāśobhitaṃ ca yathāvastrādimaṇḍitam ।।59।।
umayā sahitaṃ śaṃbhuṃ pupūjustatra te dvijāḥ ।
dvividhairbhakṣyabhojyaiśca phalaiḥ pānairvilepanaiḥ ।।1.536.60।।
dhūpadīpottamairnīrājanaiḥ stutibhirīśvarāḥ ।
ānarcuryācayāmāsuḥ kṣamāṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ daduḥ ।।61।।
gāyanaṃ kīrtanaṃ cakrurnartanaṃ jāgarānvitam ।
yaḥ kaścit ṣomavārāṇāṃ navakaṃ bhāvataścaret ।।।62।।
śivatulyo bhavet so'pi jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ।
samprāpte navame vāre kuryādudyāpanaṃ mahat ।।63।।
maṇḍalaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kuṇḍaṃ kārayet supariṣkṛtam ।
vedikāṃ kārayedramyāṃ caturasrāṃ sucitritām ।।64।।
padmaṃ ca kārayenmadhye dhānyasya maṇḍalasya ca ।
kalaśānaṣṭadigbhāge sahiraṇyān pṛthakpṛthak ।।65।।
navadurgāḥ pūjayecca madhye someśvaraṃ haram ।
rukmaśayyāsamārūḍhaṃ hemajaṃ pūjayed vratī ।।66।।
gandhasragdhūpanaivedyairvastrālaṃkāradarpaṇaiḥ ।
chatracāmaratāmbūlairdīpaghaṇṭāvitānakaiḥ ।।67।।
toṣayitvā haraṃ paścād dānaṃ śrīgurave dadet ।
homaṃ ca kārayed dadyātpāyasānnaṃ baliṃ śubham ।।68।।
rātrau ca jāgṛyāt pañcagavyaṃ pītvā haraṃ smaret ।
prabhāte tu tataḥ snātvā dhyāyet somaṃ kṣaṇaṃ punaḥ ।।69।।
tataḥ prapūjya someśaṃ kṣīrakhaṇḍādinirmitaiḥ ।
bhakṣyabhojyairanekaiśca naivedyaṃ śaṃbhave dadet ।।1.536.70।।
brāhmaṇān bhojayed devān ṛṣīn pitṝँśca tarpayet। ।
atithīn pūjayeccāpi kanyāḥ saṃbhojayettathā ।।71।।
vastradānaṃ kārayecca godānaṃ ca prakārayet ।
āśīrvādāँśca gṛhṇīyāt parihāraṃ samācaret ।।72।।
evaṃ cīrṇavrataṃ samyak labhate puṇyamakṣayam ।
dhānyadhanādisamṛddhiṃ putradārādikāँstathā ।।73।।
na vandhyātvaṃ bhavettasyā dāridryaṃ nāśamāpnuyāt ।
ṛṣibhiśca suraiḥ somavāravrataṃ kṛtaṃ tathā ।।74।।
dānāniṃ pradadustadvadudyāpanaṃ dadhustathā ।
śaṃkaraḥ prāha deveśi! doṣāँstyaktvā svabhāvajān ।।75।।
tīrthaṃ kuryājjanastena labhate śāśvataṃ phalam ।
tīrthānugamanaṃ padbhyāṃ tapaḥ paraṃ phalapradam ।।76।।
chatropānadvihīnastu tairthiko'ghāni nāśayet ।
pārakyānnaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ pārakyameva na ।।77।।
devatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca mātāpitroḥ satāṃ tathā ।
kuṭumbasya smaraṇaṃ ca tīrthe kāryaṃ mumukṣuṇā ।।78।।
tīrthe doṣānna gṛhṇīyād vajralepā bhavanti yat ।
luṭhillā luṇṭhayettatra nṛtyan gāyan hasaँstathā ।।79।।
dhūlīdhūsarasarvāṃgo bhavettīrthe hariṃ smaret ।.
oṃ namaḥ somanāthāya pārvatīpataye namaḥ' ।।1.536.80।।
japenmantraṃ somanāthe sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।
dhyāyet someśvaraṃ māṃ ca tvayā sārdhaṃ maheśvari ।।81 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
ityevaṃ śrāvayellokān kārayedbhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।82।।
vaiṣṇavān praṇamenmārge śrīpatiṃ hṛdi dhārayet ।
nāsti saurāṣṭrasadṛśo deśo vai jagatītale ।।83।।
somanāthasamaṃ tīrthaṃ me nāsti bhuvi pārvati! ।
pāpināṃ pāpaśamanaṃ vratināmīpsitapradam ।।84।।
abhāgyānāṃ bhāgyakaraṃ brahmalokapradāyakam ।
tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca tathā brahmāṇḍadānakam ।।85।।
pṛthivīkṣetradānaṃ ca kalpapādapadānakam ।
hiraṇyasya kāmadhenorgajāśvānāṃ ca dānakam ।।86।।
rathānāṃ ca gṛhāṇāṃ ca ratnānāṃ dānakāni ca ।
kalaśānāṃ ca kanyānāṃ vidyānāṃ dānakāni ca ।।87।।
kalpalatānāṃ dānāni jīvadānaṃ jalārpaṇam ।
vṛttidānaṃ tathodyānadānaṃ cāraṇyadānakam ।।88।।
samudratīradānaṃ ca parvatānāṃ pradānakam ।
gomahiṣīpradānaṃ ca vanavāṭīpradānakam ।।89।।
jñānadānaṃ muktidānaṃ svargadānaṃ phalārpaṇam ।
sarvasvārpaṇadānaṃ ca punaḥ prāptyai samācaret ।।1.536.90।।
kūpavāpīsarodānaṃ pāṣāṇakāṣṭhadānakam ।
yānayantraśibikādidānaṃ madhurasārpaṇam ।।91 ।।
kartavyaṃ ca yathāśakti saurāṣṭre mama tīrthake ।
prāsādaṃ dhavalaṃ saudhaṃ kārayejjīrṇamuddharet ।।92।।
tīrthamabhyuddharejjīrṇaṃ paropakṛtimācaret ।
paropakārakartṝṇāṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ bhavet sati! ।।93।।
keciddānaprabhāveṇa kecit snānena mānavāḥ ।
kecid dhyānaprabhāveṇa kecidyogena vā janāḥ ।।94।।
kecijjñānena vā kecijjapena sevayā'pare ।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇenāpi kecit kīrtananartanaiḥ ।।95।।
pūjanaiścāpare tīthairvandanaiḥ stavanaiḥ pare ।
anye sannyasanairbhaktyā dāsyenā'nye japena ca ।।96।।
sarvathā'rpaṇabhāvena tīrthasthā yānti sadgatim ।
indriyairhīna evāpi tīrthapūto bhavet priye ।।97।।
prabhāse nidhanaṃ prāpto bhavenmama parigrahaḥ ।
evaṃ prabhāsaṃ dhyātvaiva samāśrayenmamā'nugaḥ ।।98।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! śaṃbhunā somatīrthake ।
pārvatyai sārarūpaṃ ca cakrurvāsāni devatāḥ ।।99।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya deśāntaranivāsinaḥ ।
tīrthayātrāphalaṃ syācca bhuktimuktistathā bhavet ।। 1.536.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarādīnāṃ raivatācala( giranāra) tīrthe somanāthatīrthe ca yātrākaraṇaṃ, prabhāsanāmaniruktiḥ, arkavṛkṣātmakatā'rkasya, somanāthapūjā, dānādi, mahimā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।536।।


← adhyāyaḥ 536 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 537
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 538 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tathā'nyāni tīrthāni kathitāni ca ।
śaṃbhunā himavatputryai tānyapi kathayāmi te ।। 1 ।।
vāḍavāgnikṣepatīrthaṃ samudre vartate sadā ।
tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta vahnivat pāvano bhavet ।। 2 ।।
padmakaṃ ca tato gacched vapanaṃ tatra kārayet ।
hṛdi smaran somanāthaṃ keśāँstatra viniḥkṣipet ।। 3 ।।
pāpāni keśasaṃsthāni vilīyante tathākṛte ।
sabhartṛkā'ṅgulamātraṃ pṛṣṭhakeśān hi chedayet ।। 4 ।।
ācamanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā snāyāt sāmudrake jale ।
'te'gniryoniriḍā deho retodhā'mṛtasya nābhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
tasmai te ratnagarbhāya namo'vagrahe te jale' ।
iti snātvā tilamiśrajalaiḥ pitṝँśca tarpayet ।। 6 ।।
purā devairdīrghasatraṃ prārabdhaṃ ca prabhāsake ।
sarvasvaṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ prabhāsavāsināṃ daduḥ ।। 7 ।।
dānaṃ devāstadā cāyan dvijā dūratarā api ।
dakṣiṇādānavāñcchāśca tāvad devāḥ savāsavāḥ ।। 8 ।।
sarvasvadānato riktāḥ prārthanābhaṃgabhītitaḥ ।
praṇaṣṭā brāhmaṇān dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāścānuvavrajuḥ ।। 9 ।।
surāḥ samudramāviśyodare tatra vyavasthitāḥ ।
samudro mūrtimān bhūtvā satkārārthaṃ taṭasthitaḥ ।। 1.537.1 0।।
kṛtrimaṃ bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ viprebhyo matsyamiśritam ।
dadau ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bubhujuḥ svarṇabhājane ।। 1 1।।
na vyajānan guptamāṃsaṃ bhakṣitaṃ ceti vai tataḥ ।
pūrvamākāśagantāro hyāsaँste brāhmaṇāḥ khalu ।। 12।।
bhojanottaramevaite patitāḥ sahasā bhuvi ।
savismayāḥ samūcuste kimatra kāraṇaṃ bhavet ।। 13।।
tatraiko yogavṛttyā ca jñātavān vāridheḥ kriyām ।
vañcitā iti vai jñātvā śepurviprāstu vāridhim ।। 14।।
tvayopaguptamasmākaṃ māṃsamannena saṃyutam ।
dattaṃ vai bhojane tasmādaspṛśyo bhava sarvadā ।। 15।।
tato varṣasahasraṃ tu aspṛśyo'bhūttu vāridhiḥ ।
tato duḥkhena cātmānaṃ śoṣayāmāsa vai jalam ।। 16।।
sthalākāro'bhavad yāvad devā yayuḥ pitāmaham ।
sāmudrajalayogena vṛṣṭyā sasyāni bhūtale ।। 17।।
jāyante ca prajāḥ sarvāḥ puṣyanti tena sarvathā ।
samudrasya jalaṃ rakṣa yathā śoṣaṃ na gacchati ।। 18।।
iti te prārthayāṃcakrurbrahmā śrutvā taṭaṃ yayau ।
aspṛśyatāvāraṇārthaṃ prārthayāmāsa bhūsurān ।। 1 9।।
brāhmaṇāḥ pratigṛhṇantu ratnāni vāridhestathā ।
vāridhiṃ śāpamuktaṃ ca prakurvantu kṣamāyutāḥ ।।1.537.20।।
brāhmaṇāḥ prārthayāmāsurbrahmāṇaṃ tvaṃ tathā kuru ।
brahmā prāha tadā'bdhiṃ ca tridhā medhyo bhaviṣyasi ।।21 ।।
parvakāleṣu ca nadīsaṃgameṣu tathā sadā ।
taṭatīrtheṣu medhyastvaṃ sparśasnānaprado bhava ।।22।।
pūjyaśca sarvadā tatrā'nyatrāpi devapūjane ।
abhiṣeke tava vāri sadā medhyaṃ bhavediti ।।23।।
evamaspṛśyatānāśaṃ cakrire brāhmaṇādayaḥ ।
ratnāni jagṛhuḥ sarve prayayurnijaketanam ।।24।।
tataḥ snāsyati yaḥ samyak sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi ।
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpsyati cātra saḥ ।।25।।
śrīsomeśasamudrasyā''ntare ye tu mṛtā janāḥ ।
pāpino'pi gamiṣyanti svargaṃ nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ ।।26।।
evaṃ vai sajalastvabdhiḥ pavitratvaṃ purā gataḥ ।
someśādākṛtasmaraṃ kṣetraṃ sāgarasannidhau ।। 27।।
koṭitīrthamayaṃ sarvaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ param ।
evaṃ snātvā somanāthaṃ gacched draṣṭuṃ vratī tataḥ ।।28।।
snāpayitvā vidhānena japettu śatarudrikām ।
snāpayetpayasā dadhnā ghṛtena madhunā'pi ca ।।29।।
ikṣurasena ca tataḥ kuṃkumena vilepayet ।
karpūrośīramiśreṇa mṛganābhiyutena ca ।।1.537.3 0।।
candanena sugandhena dhūpairdīpaistathā'mbaraiḥ ।
naivedyaistarpayitvā taṃ nīrājayennamettathā ।।3 1 ।।
stutimaṣṭāṃganatyādi gītaṃ vādyaṃ ca nartanam ।
pradakṣiṇaṃ kathāṃ kuryācchṛṇuyātpārameśvarīm ।।32।।
vipratapasvidīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyo dadet dhanam ।
bhojanaṃ svambaraṃ cāpi dāpayet bhāvayet vratī ।।33।।
evaṃ someśvaratīrthaॆ yaḥ karoti vidhānataḥ ।
dhanāḍhyaḥ saptajanmāni tataḥ kailāsamāvrajet ।।34।।
sāndhyamārārtrikaṃ kuryāttasya mokṣo bhaved dhruvam ।
atha lakṣmi! pañcanadyastīrthaṃ tatra tu mokṣadam ।।35।।
hariṇī brahmiṇī nyaṃkuḥ kapilā ca sarasvatī ।
prabhāse saṃvartate vai pañcasrotā sarasvatī ।।36।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! purā sā'tra yathā''gatā sarasvatī ।
purā cendrādayo jitvā daityān pṛthvīṃ samāgatāḥ ।।37।।
dadhīcerāśramaṃ dṛṣṭvā dadṛśurdadhīcimṛṣim ।
āyudhāni vimucyā'gre rakṣemānīti vai daduḥ ।।38।।
deyāni syuḥ punastāni śatrubhiryadi no raṇaḥ ।
muktvā'strāṇi yayuḥ svargaṃ śatavarṣottaram ṛṣiḥ ।।39।।
jalena ca sahā'strāṇi pītvā yayau himālayam ।
pippaladrumamadhye saḥ cacāra paramaṃ tapaḥ ।।1.537.40।।
tato devaiḥ samāgatyā'strāṇyarthitāni sarvaśaḥ ।
dadhīciḥ prāha dehe me'sthirūpāṇi vasanti vai ।।41 ।।
golokād gāḥ samānīya karkaśajihvikādibhiḥ ।
nandāṃ subhadrāṃ surabhiṃ suśīlāṃ sumanāṃ tathā ।।42।।
ājñāpayantu me'sthnāṃ saṃprāptyarthaṃ lehane tu tāḥ ।
devā evaṃprakāreṇa prāpurasthīni vai tataḥ ।।43।।
devaspṛṣṭāstu tā gāvaḥ śuddhāḥ pūjyā yathāsthitāḥ ।
mukhamekaṃ paraṃ tāsāṃ na spṛṣṭaṃ raktalepitam ।।44।।
asthnāmastrāṇi kṛtvaiva devā niryayurambaram ।
dadhīcestu subhadrāyāṃ jāto bālaḥ suplakṣakaḥ ।।45।।
uvāca mātaraṃ kvāsti pitā me janani! tataḥ ।
sā prāha nidhanaṃ prāpto devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye ।।46।।
bālaścacāra ca tapo himācale tataḥ khalu ।
tasya ūroḥ samutpannā ūruryā vaḍavābhidhā ।।47।।
sāpi tejomayī jātā tejo'pi niḥsṛtaṃ bahiḥ ।
aurvo'yaṃ vāḍavo'gnistadvanaṃ dadāha dāruṇaḥ ।।48।।
devāḥ sarasvatīṃ prāhurdevi! hyenaṃ praśāmaya ।
sarasvatī tu taṃ nītvā bālarūpaṃ prabhāsake ।।49।।
samāgatya pracikṣepa samudre vaḍavānalam ।
kumārikākarabālo bubhuje lavaṇodakam ।।1.537.50।।
pupoṣa tatra vai tiṣṭhannādyāpyabdhiṃ pramuñcati ।
yatra tāpo'bhavattasyāḥ kṣaṇaṃ sā'dṛśyatāṃ gatā ।।।51 ।।
punaḥ śītā samāgṛhya nayati sameti bhūtale ।
naikasthaleṣu guptā sā naikasthāneṣu gocarā ।।52।।
evaṃ kṛtvā yayau cābdhiṃ nikṣipyovāsa vai ciram ।
prācī sarasvatī sā tu prabhāse vartate sadā ।।53 ।।
tatra vai ṛṣayaścāsaँścatvāro viṣṇusadṛśāḥ ।
hiraṇyaścātha vajraśca nyaṃkuḥ kapila ityapi ।।54।।
pṛthakpṛthaksamāhūtāḥ snānārthaṃ taiḥ sarasvatī ।
sāgaro'pi tadā tasyāḥ sammukhaḥ sahasā sthitaḥ ।।55।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ sevanārthaṃ sā pañcarūpā babhūva ha ।
hariṇī vajriṇī nyaṃkvī kāpilī sāgarī tathā ।।।56 ।।
pañcāpi pāpahantryastāḥ pāvanyaḥ pāpināṃ sadā ।
māṃsamadyastainyanārībhogadoṣādināśinī ।।57।।
kṛtasmaro rodhakartā dagdho'dristena vahninā ।
śvetopalāstu tā jātā rāsanyaḥ saudhakārikāḥ ।।58।।
cākṣuṣasyā'ntare vahnirdādhīco vāḍavānalaḥ ।
vaivasvatāntare aurvo bhārgavo vaḍavānalaḥ ।।59।।
śaṃkarasya lalāṭāgniryaḥ sa evā'yamucyate ।
tīrthe cātra sarasvatyā gūheśvaraṃ sutīrthakam ।।1.537.6 0।।
āmardakīnadīyoge saṃgameśvaratīrthakam ।
govatsakaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ jhillītīrthaṃ paraṃ śubham ।।61 ।।
kūṣmāṇḍasya muneḥ sthānaṃ kūṣmāṇḍeśvarasaṃjñitam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatra samāgatya sarasvatīm ।।62।।
svāgataṃ kārayāmāsa kūṣmāṇḍamuninā tadā ।
śramaṃ ca nāśayāmāsa vāḍavānalabhārajam ।।6 3 ।।
tāpaṃ ca śamayāmāsa svakarasparśamātrataḥ ।
kumārī sā'rthayāmāsaikākinyā ca mayā prabho ।।64।।
kanyayā cātra vai kathaṃ vastavyaṃ rakṣakaṃ vinā ।
pātā rakṣayitā nāsti mama cātra vane hare! ।।65 ।।
tasmāt pātā mama tvatra bhava tvaṃ puruṣottama ।
yadvā kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vā cāśvapaṭṭasarovare ।।66 ।।
tava gṛhe samāgatya tatra tiṣṭhāmi pādayoḥ ।
ityuktvā'śrāvilanetrā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ।।67।।
dīneva cā'pyanātheva kṣaṇaṃ jātā kumārikā ।
tataḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastāṃ gṛhya pāṇinā ।।68।।
śokaṃ vai dūrayāmāsa sā'pi kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
kaṇṭhalagnā'bhavat sādhvī vavre nārāyaṇaṃ patim ।।69।।
sumanomālikāṃ kṛṣṇakaṇṭhe dadau sarasvatī ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagrāha bhāvataḥ ।।1.537.70।।
sanāthāṃ tāṃ tathā kṛtvovācā'tra tvaṃ sthirā bhava ।
nadīrūpeṇa deveśi! lokoddhārasya hetave ।।71 ।।
sarasvatī tadā prāha nāthā'haṃ svāminaṃ vinā ।
sthātuṃ śakyā kathaṃ tasmāttvamatra mokṣado vasa ।।72 ।।
ityuktaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
sarasvatīpatiḥ sākṣāt pippalasya drumo'bhavat ।। 73 ।।
akṣayaḥ pippalavṛkṣo vartate yatra sā priyā ।
mūle saṃgaṃ samāsādya nityaṃ tvāste sarasvatī ।।74।।
yatrā'haṃ kṛṣṇarūpeṇa lakṣmi layaṃ gataḥ sadā ।
vartāmyeva na jānanti janā māṃ netragocaram ।।।75।।।
pitṝṇāṃ sarvadā mokṣaṃ tatra karomi piṇḍataḥ ।
lakṣmīḥ sadā ca mūle me tvāste'pavādamantarā ।।।76 ।।
atha kālāntare cāha naikasāhasrayoṣitām ।
pariṇītānāṃ ca patirlayaṃ yāsyāmi tatsthale ।।77।।
evamuktvā satīṃ patnīṃ jalarūpāṃ vidhāya ca ।
dvitīyaṃ yuvatīrūpaṃ saha nītvā mama priyam ।।78।।
navoḍhāsahitaścāhaṃ tvaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
mamā''layaṃ hyagamaṃ ca vasāmi tu tayā saha ।।79।।
tatra sarasvatī devī sadā''ste caraṇe mama ।
lokānāṃ vacane cāpi jayadā hi virājate ।।1.537.80 ।।
evameṣā brahmaṇastu putrī satyanivāsinī ।
kumārī haimaśailasthā kurukṣetre samāgatā ।।8 1 ।।
bhadrāvarte puṣkare ca śrīsthale siddhabhūtale ।
pāñcāle'śvapaṭṭasarovare svarṇapure tathā ।।82।
raivate ca prabhāse ca tathā bahusthale punaḥ ।
kālabhedena bhaktānāmupāsanabalena ca ।।83 ।।
prayāgādau tathā tīrthottamādau daivakāryataḥ ।
prasaṃgena gatā seyaṃ prabhāse ca mama priyā ।।84।।
svarganiḥśreṇisaṃbhūtā prācī sarasvatī satī ।
vartate jīvakalyāṇakarī mama vacaḥsthitā ।।85।।
devāste na manuṣyāste nadī tisraḥ pibanti ye ।
candrabhāgāṃ ca gaṃgāṃ ca tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm ।।86 ।।
yamunāṃ ca gaṇḍakīṃ ca svarṇarekhāṃ ca vā nadīm ।
yathā kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvakālaphalapradāḥ ।।87।।
cintāmaṇisamāstisro nadyastāḥ kāmapūrikāḥ ।
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munīnāmūrdhvaretasām ।।88 ।।
yatra sthitāni tīrthe vai tasmāt kimadhikaṃ bhavet ।
nārāyaṇena sahito naro loke yugāntare ।।89।।
kalyavatārarūpasya tathā tatsahayāyinām ।
saṃhartā doṣanāśārthaṃ snāsyatyatra punaḥ punaḥ ।। 1.537.90 ।।
prācī sarasvatī doṣān hatyājān kṣālayatyapi ।
trirātropoṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātavyaṃ doṣaśāntaye ।।91 ।।
sarasvatyuttare tīre tanuṃ tyaktvā prayāti vai ।
brahmalokaṃ śāśvataṃ sa hyapunarbhavamārakam ।।92।।
śrāddhakartuścaikaviṃśatikuloddharaṇaṃ bhavet ।
yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya prāṇaprayāṇamāpyate ।।93 ।।
sa tadbhāvasamāyukto yātā bhavati mānavaḥ ।
purā nāmnā'bhavad rājā bṛhadratha iti śrutaḥ ।।94।।
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī nāmnā tvindumatī satī ।
ekadā tadgṛhaṃ prāptaḥ ṛṣiḥ kaṇva iti śrutaḥ ।।95।।
rājā tatsvāgataṃ cakre papraccha kuśalādikam ।
tato dharmakathāṃ cakre sa ṛṣirnṛpasannidhau ।।96 ।।
indumatī ṛṣiṃ natvā papraccha prāgbhavaṃ svakam ।
rājyaṃ saukhyaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ devopamaḥ patirmama ।।97।।
sukhaṃ mānyaṃ ca sampattiḥ kasya prāptaṃ phalaṃ mayā ।
kaṇvaḥ prāha śṛṇuḥ rājñi! mā roṣaṃ kuru māṃ prati ।।98।।
tvamāsīranyadehe tu hyābhīrī śīlavarjitā ।
saurāṣṭraviṣaye yātā snātuṃ prabhāsake tadā ।।99।।
tvayā hastāt kaṃkaṇaṃ ca hemnastatrārpitaṃ śubham ।
tīrthe mahātmyamājñāya brāhmaṇānāṃ mukhāttataḥ ।। 1.537.1 00।।
tena puṇyena dāśārṇanṛpateḥ kanyakā bhuvi ।
bṛhadrathena voḍhā'si rājñī jātā'si cottamā ।। 101 ।।
iti prabhāsamāhātmyaṃ śrutvā sā punareva ca ।
tīrthaṃ kṛtvā samudre ca kaṃkaṇaṃ prākṣipat punaḥ ।। 1 02।।
tato devī svargavāsā kalpāyuṣkā'bhavacchubhā ।
ityevaṃ lakṣmi! māhātmyaṃ prabhāsābdhijalasya vai ।। 1 03।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena yojitam ।
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatī sarvāḥ kathāḥ prāha punaḥ punaḥ ।। 1 04।।
pārvatī kaṃkaṇaṃ tatra dadau cābdhau tu kānakam ।
śaṃkaro'bhūt prasannaśca devyo'pi tāni saṃdaduḥ ।। 1 05।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vahnitīrthaṃ samudrapāvitryaṃ, dadhīcaplakṣakavaḍavānalasarasvatīvṛttāntam, pañcasrotomayīsarasvatī, pippaladrumakūṣmāṇḍatīrthaṃ, samudre kaṃkaṇadānenā''bhīryā rājñītvaṃ, dānamahimā, cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।537।।।


← adhyāyaḥ 537 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 538
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 539 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ prāha satīṃ tu pārvatīm ।
varāhākhyo mahāviṣṇuḥ somatīrthe pratiṣṭhati ।। 1 ।।
tathā brahmā gaṇeśaśca herambanāmataḥ sthitaḥ ।
tathā kapardināmāpi kṣetrarakṣākaraḥ sthitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
atastatra mahātīrthe kapardīśrīgaṇādhipaḥ ।
pūjanīyastathā viṣṇurvarāho'rcyaḥ sadā janaiḥ ।। 3 ।।
āsīd rājā purā devi! śaśabinduritismṛtaḥ ।
sa tu sākaṃ bhāryayā vaihāyasena pathaikadā ।। 4 ।।
vimānena yayau tīrthaṃ kartuṃ prabhāsamuttamam ।
phālgune kṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ niśāmukhe ।। 5 ।।
atha someśvarakṣetre vratino'tra samāgatān ।
apaśyanmunivaryāṃśca tadvā jāgaraṇe sthitān ।। 6 ।।
somanāthaṃ munīn natvā kaṃcit kedārakaṃ prati ।
yayau tatra sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ pupūja paramādarāt ।। 7 ।।
ṛṣayaste ca papracchuḥ kathaṃ muktvā tu somakam ।
kedāraṃ pūjitaṃ rājan! vadātra kāraṇaṃ tu naḥ ।। 8 ।।
rājā prāha purā cāhaṃ saurāṣṭre śūdravarṇajaḥ ।
abhavaṃ bhāryayā sākaṃ kṣetre cātra samāgataḥ ।। 9 ।।
hariṇīsariti tatra kamalāni mayā tadā ।
dṛṣṭāni tāni nītāni vikrayārthaṃ mayā tadā ।। 1.538.1 0।।
somanāthasamīpaṃ ca vikrayārthaṃ sthito divā ।
astaṃgate'pi ca ravau krītāni kenacinna vai ।। 11 ।।
tato'haṃ kṣudhayā vyāpto gato liṃgasamīpataḥ ।
tatra kācidanaṃgākhyā śivarātrivratasthitā ।। 12।।
svatantrā strī jāgaraṇe gītanṛtyotsave ratā ।
mayā dṛṣṭā tathā pṛṣṭā kimetat kriyate tvayā ।। 1 3।।
sā māmuvāca hi tadā śivarātrivrataṃ prati ।
vratakartā duḥkhahīno jāyate sampadā yutaḥ ।। 14।।
bhayarogāriṣṭanāśo jāyate'sya pade pade ।
atha śrutvā mama buddhirutpannā tadvrataṃ prati ।। 15।।
upavāsaḥ sahajato jātaḥ padmasthale mama ।
snātvā taiḥ kamalairdevo rudreśaḥ pūjitastadā ।। 16।।
jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ patnyā sākaṃ kalyāṇavāñcchayā ।
tatpuṇyena ca rājā'smi rājñī ceyaṃ mama priyā ।। 17।।
jātismaraḥ sabhāryo'smi tato rudreśvaraṃ khalu ।
kedāre saṃsthitaṃ tvatra pūjayāmi purā'rcitam ।। 18।।
ato rudreśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ rājyapradaṃ prapūjanāt ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ pradaṃ śāntipradaṃ sukham ।। 19।।
svatantrā yā pramadā ca pūjayitrī tadā'bhavat ।
sā tu raṃbhānāmasvargāpsarā jātā manoharā ।।1.538.20।।
evaṃ kedārarudreśaṃ tīrthaṃ tatra pravartate ।
tataḥ saṃpūjayet tatra śvetaketvīśvaraṃ haram ।।21 ।।
śvetaketunṛpeṇā'tra purā kṛtvā tapaḥ param ।
muktirlabdhā tatra śaṃbhuḥ śvetaketvīśvaro'bhavat ।।22।।
athā''dityeśvaraṃ preyāt pūrvasyāṃ saṃsthitaṃ haram ।
atha śaṃbhustripurasya vināśāya svanetrataḥ ।।23।।
aśru mumoca krodhena sa bhaumo maṃgalo'bhavat ।
tena vai pūjitastatra bhaumeśvaro'bhavaddharaḥ ।।24।।
evaṃ navagrahatīrthaṃ tatra 3 vartate priye ।
jñānakriyecchāḥ śaktayastisro nārāyaṇasya yāḥ ।।25।।
maṃgalā ca viśālā ca catvarā tāḥ sthitāḥ sadā ।
tāsāṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ cātra prabhāse śāntidāyakam ।।26।।
viśālākṣī tathā viṣṇoḥ samutpannā purā yudhe ।
daityānāṃ tu vināśārthaṃ tattīrthe caṃ prabhāsake ।।27।।
lakṣmi! sākaṃ tvayā cāhaṃ gatavān vai purā yuge ।
lakṣmītīrthaṃ tathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya tīrthakam ।।28।।
vartate somasatkṣetre darśanānmuktidaṃ śubham ।
kāmatīrthaṃ ratitīrthaṃ vartate ca prabhāsake ।।29।।
gaurītīrthamiṣātīrthaṃ pāpahantu vibhāsate ।
nāradastvekadā cakre puṇḍarīkaṃ kratuṃ purā ।।1.538.3 0।।
nāradakratutīrthaṃ tad vartate tu prabhāsake ।
gautamo'pi munistatra purā yātrārthamāgataḥ ।।3 1 ।।
cāturmāsaṃ tapaścakre gautamaṃ tīrthamucyate ।
ādau kṛte yuge daityo mahān vai meghavāhanaḥ ।।32।।
abhūnmahāśarīraḥ sa yojanāyatavistṛtaḥ ।
pāduke dve samāruhya ādinārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।33।।
jaghāna taṃ mahādaityaṃ pādukātīrthamucyate ।
pādukayā hato daityastāḍitayā tu vakṣasi ।।34।।
pādukāsanasaṃstho'haṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
tiṣṭhāmi somake tīrthe mokṣado'suranāśakaḥ ।।35।।
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! māhātmyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam ।
athaikādaśarudrāṇāṃ tīrthāni santi tatra vai ।।36।।
ajaikapādahirbudhno virūpākṣo'tha raivataḥ ।
haraśca bahurūpaśca tryambakaśca sureśvaraḥ ।।37।।
prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaścodāno vyānaśca vāyavaḥ ।
nāgaśca kūrmaḥ kṛkalo devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ ।।38।।
ātmā ceti kramājjātā rudrā hyekādaśaiva te ।
amūrtā mūrtimāpannāstattīrthaṃ ca prabhāsake ।।39।।
nandinā'pi tapastaptaṃ mṛtyuñjayaharopari ।
nanditīrthaṃ tu tattatra vartate bahupuṇyadam ।।1.538.40।।
dhenūrbhūtvā purā pṛthvī tīrthārthaṃ tatra cāgatā ।
someśaṃ snapayāmāsa satī dugdhasya dhārayā ।।41 ।।
tataḥ snātvā vilīnā'bhūd yatra gotīrthameva tat ।
pāpatāpaharaṃ jātaṃ pṛthivyā yogataḥ priyam ।।42।।
atha pūrvaṃ samudre'bhūd virāvo nāma rākṣasaḥ ।
manuṣyādo hatastatra sudarśanena viṣṇunā ।।43।।
tadidaṃ paścime jātaṃ virāvalayanaṃ sthalam ।
viṣṇucakraprapūtaṃ ca tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam ।।44।।
cakrapāṇirahaṃ pūjyastatra virāvalīnake ।
pūjako me paraṃdhāma yāsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।45।।
atha dvādaśasūryāśca viṣṇordarśanahetave ।
prabhāsaṃ prathamaṃ yānti tato'śvapaṭṭasārasam ।।46।।
kṣetraṃ yānti darśanārthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya te ।
viṣṇurdhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā maitrendrau varuṇo'ryamā ।।47।।
vivasvavānaṃśumāँstvaṣṭā parjanyo dvādaśaiva te ।
svasvamāsāntake kāle snātvā yānti prabhāsake ।।48।।
viṣṇuḥ saṃsnāti vai caitre vaiśākhe tvaryamā tathā ।
vivasvān jyeṣṭhamāse'tha cāṣāḍhe tvaṃśumāँstathā ।।49।।
parjanyaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi bhādre tu varuṇastathā ।
indraścāśvayuji māsi dhātā saṃsnāti kārtike ।।1.538.50।।
mārgaśīrṣe tathā mitraḥ pūṣā pauṣe prayāti ca ।
māghe bhagastathā tvaṣṭā snāti tatra ca phālgune ।।51 ।।
ete vai naijamāsānte taptvā snātvā prayānti ca ।
ityādityasthalaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāse vartate śubham ।।52।।
athā'ṣṭavarṣako brahmā somanāthasya tūtsave ।
āgato'bhūt pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pūrvasyāṃ tasya cāsanam ।।53।।
brahmatīrthaṃ tu tatproktaṃ snānātpāpavināśakam ।
brahmāṇamaṣṭavarṣaṃ ca rathe saṃsthāpya śobhite ।।54।।
sāvitrīsahitaṃ māse kārtike pūrṇimādine ।
vāhayet kārayed yātrāṃ somanāthaṃ prati dhruvam ।।55।।
pūjayed bhaktibhāvena ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ ।
rathaṃ tu karṣayet tasya caturmukhasya sarvathā ।।56।।
punaḥ saṃsthāpayettasya mandire vādyanartanaiḥ ।
rāṣṭrasya śreyamanvicchan rathayātrāṃ prakārayet ।।57।।
ahaṃ lakṣmi! kathayāmi yatra yatra pitāmahaḥ ।
vartate bhūtale sṛṣṭau kalpe kalpāntare'pi vā ।। 58 ।।
kālenā'staṃ sthalaṃ cāpi smaraṇīyaṃ sukhapradam ।
puṣkare sa suraśreṣṭho gayāyāṃ prapitāmahaḥ ।।59।।
vedagarbhaḥ kānyakubje bhṛgukacche caturmukhaḥ ।
sṛṣṭikartā ca kauberyāṃ nandigrāme bṛhaspatiḥ ।।1.538.6 0 ।।
aṣṭavarṣaḥ prabhāse ca kāśyāṃ surapriyo hi saḥ ।
caturvedo dvārikāyāṃ vaidiśe bhuvanādhipaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
pauṇḍrake puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ pītākṣo hastināpure ।
vijayākhyo jayantyāṃ sa jagannāthe jayantakaḥ ।।62।।
vādyadeśe padmahastastamolau ca tamopahāḥ ।
ahicchatre janānandaḥ kāñcyāṃ janapriyo hyajaḥ ।।63।।
karṇāṭake ca vai brahmā ṛṣyaśṛṃge munīśvaraḥ ।
śrīkaṇṭhe śrīnivāsākhyaḥ kāmarūpe śubhākaraḥ ।।64।।
uḍḍīsāyāṃ devakatāṃ sraṣṭā jālandhare tathā ।
mallikāyāṃ ca sa viṣṇurmahendrādau tu bhārgavaḥ ।।65।।
gohaste sthaviro brahmā ujjayinyāṃ pitāmahaḥ ।
kauśāmbyāṃ ca mahādevaḥ sākete'rkapitāmahaḥ ।।66 ।।
citrakūṭe virañciśca vandhye vārāhaviśvasṛṭ ।
haridvāre sureśaśca himādrau haṃsavāhanaḥ ।।67।।
haihikāyāṃ vedahasto'rbudādrau padmahastakaḥ ।
vṛndāvane padmanetro naimiṣe kuśahastakaḥ ।।68।।
gopakṣetre gocaro'yaṃ sucandro yamunātaṭe ।
gaṃgātīre padmabhūśca janasthāne jalodbhavaḥ ।।69।।
dakṣiṇe setupālaśca uttare haṃsavāhanaḥ ।
arbude vāsakṛdbrahmā utkale nāradādhipaḥ ।।1.538.70।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre parameṣṭhī pitāmahaḥ ।
prayāge ca yajurnāthaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ raivatācale ।।71 ।।
kacche nārāyaṇamadhurbrahmavāhe asupriyaḥ ।
aṃkulake brahmagarbho vidarbhāyāṃ dvijapriyaḥ ।।72।।
nārāyaṇarṣirgomante indraprasthe durāsadaḥ ।
sudarśanaśca pampāyāṃ surūpe rāṣṭravardhanaḥ ।।73।।
virajāyāṃ mahārūpo devādhyakṣaḥ samasthale ।
kadambe kelanādhyakṣaḥ supīṭhe jaladeśvaraḥ ।।74।।
kailāse devagaṃgādhraḥ śrīśaile ca trinetradhṛk ।
tryambake tripurāriśca naimiṣe cakradhṛk tathā ।।75।।
śṛṃgaveradhure śūro nandipuryāṃ virūpakaḥ ।
gotameśaḥ svacchapāde mālavān hāstine pure ।।76 ।।
vācikṣetre dvijeśo'yaṃ svarge diveśvarastathā ।
bhūtikāyāṃ pureśaśca candrāyāṃ haṃsavāhanaḥ ।।77।।
campāyāṃ gāruḍo brahmā mahāyakṣo mahodaye ।
suyajñaḥ pūjakāraṇye dharmāraṇye vṛṣātmakaḥ ।।78।।
pūrvadeśe śuklavarṇo vibhāvaryāṃ supadmajaḥ ।
devadāruvane keśī mātṛbhūmau vināyakaḥ ।।79।।
alakāyāṃ dhaneśeśastrikuṭe yogirāḍajaḥ ।
pātāle nāgabhūrbrahmā kovidāre yugādikṛt ।। 1.538.80।।
strīrājye suratādhyakṣaḥ saḥ paurṇādrau prabhogadhṛk ।
śālmalau takṣakeśaśca ambiṣṭhāyāṃ sudarśakaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
naravīthyāṃ mahāvīraḥ kāntāre durganāśakaḥ ।
padmāvatyāṃ padmagraho gagane mṛgarūpadhṛk ।।82।।
samudre meghavāhaśca raṇeṣu kṣārabhūḥ sadā ।
cakreṣu mūlabījaśca lalāṭe ca gurustathā ।।83 ।।
satyaloke prapitādirdarbhastṛṇeṣu vai tathā ।
yajñeṣu mukhyavipraśca vairāje kamalodbhavaḥ ।
mero cājasvarūpaśca pitṛloke ca pitṛkaḥ ।।84।।
camatkārapure chinnaśirāḥ kurau ca vājapaḥ ।
bhāgyadeveṣu vedhāśca vidhātā sṛṣṭikūṭake ।।851।।
śāstreṣu vaidharūpaścāṣṭottaraśatarūpakaḥ ।
brahma vai vartate sṛṣṭau janakaḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।86।।
prabhāse bālarūpaṃ taṃ pūjayet parameṣṭhinam ।
aṣṭottaraśataviśvasṛjāṃ pūjāphalaṃ bhavet ।।87।।
āgneyaṃ tu yadā ṛkṣe kārtikyāṃ ced bhavet kvacit ।
prājāpatyaṃ bhaveccedvā sā tithistatra puṇyadā ।। 88।।
viśākhāsu yadā sūryaḥ kṛttikāsu ca candramāḥ ।
sa yogaḥ padmako nāma prabhāse kārya eva saḥ ।।89।।
atha lakṣmi! śṛṇu cānyad dakṣo dharmāya kanyakāḥ ।
purā daśa dadau tāsāmekā viśvā tu nāmataḥ ।। 1.538.90।।
sā dharmāttu mahāviśvā cāṣṭāvajanayat sutān ।
āyo bhavaśca sāmaśca dharaścaiva nalo'nilaḥ ।। 91 ।।
pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭau vṛṣātmajāḥ ।
teṣāṃ madhye saptamaśca putrecchayā prabhāsakam ।। 92 ।।
samāyayau pratyūṣaḥ sa tape varṣaśataṃ param ।
somanāthaḥ prasannaḥ san sutaṃ tasmai hi devalam ।। 93 ।।
dadau pratyūṣakastatra yalliṃgaṃ samapūjayat ।
pratyūṣeśvara ityukto mahādevaḥ sutapradaḥ ।। 94।।
athā'nilo'pi tatraivā''rādhayāmāsa śaṃkaram ।
manojaveti vikhyātaṃ tasmai cāpi sutaṃ dadau ।।95।।
anileśvara ityevaṃ khyātiṃ jagāma śaṃkaraḥ ।
prabhāsena tathā liṃgaṃ prabhāseśvaramāhitam ।।96।।
bṛhaspatestu bhaginī bhuvanā tasya kāminī ।
viśvakarmā'bhavattasyāṃ sutaḥ prabhāsato balī ।। 97।।
prabhāseśvarasaṃjñaḥ sa mahādevo'bhavat khalu ।
prabhāsena sthāpito vai phālgune tāmase dale ।।018।।
trayodaśyāṃ śivarātrau tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ hyabhūt ।
atha tatra mahātīrthaṃ vāmanasvāmināmakam ।।99।।
baliṃ badhvā sarvarājyaṃ yācitvā balikhātakai ।
yatra pādaṃ prathamaṃ ca nyastaṃ tattīrthamuttamam ।। 1.538.10 0।।
viṣṇutīrthamitikhyātaṃ vartate sāgarāntike ।
viṣṇunā vihato yatra purā śaṃkhāsurastaṭe ।। 101 ।।
śaṃkhatīrthaṃ hareryogādvartate dhvānakārakam ।
vīrabhadreśvaraṃ cāpi tīrthaṃ tatrāsti śāṃkaram ।। 1 02।।
athaikadā tvanādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
bahugopīsamāyukto'śvapaṭṭasaraso yayau ।। 1 03।।
prabhāsaṃ paramaṃ kṣetraṃ rantuṃ raivatake tadā ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeśaṃ ca gopīśvaraṃ dvitīyakam ।। 1 04।।
bāṇaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ tena śubhraṃ tattīrthamuttamam ।
athaikadā candrakalā āyayuḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tāḥ ।। 1 5।।
kaleśvaraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ cakruḥ snātvā prabhāsake ।
lambinī candrikā kāntā kūṭā śāntā mahodayā ।। 1 06।।
bhīṣaṇī nandinī caiva suparṇā vimalā'kṣayā ।
śubhadā śobhanā puṇyā haṃsā sītā kalāḥ kramāt ।। 1 07।।
kalādityaḥ sthāpitaśca sūryo'pi tīrthamācarat ।
athaikadā catuṣṣaṣṭiyoginyastatra saṃyayuḥ ।। 1 08।।
raivatācalapaścimayoginyadrita eva tāḥ ।
yoginīśvaramevaitāḥ sthāpayāmāsurīśvaram ।। 1 09।।
tāsāṃ nāmāni vai lakṣmi! śṛṇu yāḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ ।
ādau mukhyā mahālakṣmīrnandā kṣemakarī tathā ।। 1.538.11 0।।
śivadūtī mahābhadrā bhrāmarī candramaṇḍalā ।
revatī harasiddhiśca durgā viṣamalocanā ।। 111 ।।
sahajā kulajā kubjā māyāvī śāṃbhavī kriyā ।
ādyā sarvagatā śuddhā bhāvamānyā manotigā ।। 1 12।।
vidyā'vidyā mahāmāyā suṣumṇā sarvamaṃgalā ।
okārātmā mahādevī vedārthajananī śivā ।। 11 3।।
purāṇā''nvīkṣikī dīkṣā cāmuṇḍā śaṃkarapriyā ।
brāhmī śāntikarī gaurī brahmaṇyā brāhmaṇapriyā ।। 1 14।।
bhadrā bhagavatī kṛṣṇā grahanakṣatramālinī ।
tripurā tvaritā nityā sāṃkhyā kuṇḍalinī dhruvā ।। 115।।
kalyāṇī śobhanā nityā niṣkalā paramā kalā ।
yoginī yogasadbhāvā yogagamyā guhāśayā ।। 1 16।।
kātyāyanī umā śarvā aparṇā tā harastriyaḥ ।
yugāntare tathā'nyāścopāsanābalataḥ priyā ।। 1 17।।
yoginyo'pi prajāyante koṭiśaḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ ।
etāsāṃ somanāthasya sannidhau tīrthamuttamam ।। 1 18।।
vartate pāpanāśārthaṃ pāvanaṃ sukhadaṃ sadā ।
etāsāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryamaṣṭakāsu sadā janaiḥ ।। 1 19।।
devatvaṃ sāttvikā yānti sāttvikīṃ bhaktimāsthitāḥ ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham । । 1.538.1 20।।
māhātmyaṃ somatīrthasya prabhāsasya ca te puraḥ ।
kathitaṃ yacchaṃkaroktaṃ pārvatyai tu prabhāsake ।। 121 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'nekaprasiddhatīrthāni, brahmā bhinnasthaleṣu bhinno bhinno varṇitaḥ, vasavo'ṣṭau, sūryā rudrāḥ catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginyaśca kathitā iti nirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭātriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 538 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 538 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 539
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 540 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi । tathā'nyāni tīrthāni kathayāmi te ।
yānyuktāni mahādevyai mahādevena vai tadā ।। 1 ।।
vāmadevasya sāvarṇeraghorasya tathā param ।
kapilasya śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate tu prabhāsake ।। 2 ।।
tathā śrīmukhasaṃjñaṃ ca vanaṃ lakṣmyā virājate ।
yatra vai vaiṣṇavā yogisiddhā vasanti sarvadā ।। 3 ।।
sagareṇa purā''dityaḥ sthāpito yatra bhāsakaḥ ।
sāgarādityatīrthaṃ tad vidyate tu prabhāsake ।। 4 ।।
antyajasya sutā cā'kṣamālā'bhūd yuvatī purā ।
pūrvajanmani śūdrā sā rajasvalā hi śaṃkaram ।। 5 ।।
pasparśa tena doṣeṇa kanyā'ntyajasya cā'bhavat ।
vasiṣṭhena tapoyogād gṛhītā janakārpitā ।। 6 ।।
bahuvarṣe purā devo na vavarṣa tadā tu te ।
himabhūmau dadasvā'nnaṃ samayācanta cāntyajam ।। 7 ।।
tena putryā sahānnaṃ vai dattaṃ tadā vasiṣṭhakaḥ।
āpaddharmaṃ samālocyovāca tatrā'ntyajaṃ yathā ।। 8 ।।
jīvarakṣārthamāgṛhṇan nahi pāpena lipyate ।
ajīgartaḥ sutaṃ hantumupāsarpad bubhukṣitaḥ ।। 9 ।।
bhāradvājaḥ kṣudhārtastu upajagrāha gāḥ purā ।
kṣudhārto hyabhyagād gāṃ tu viśvāmitro'pi vai purā ।। 1.539.10 ।।
ityuktvā tāmakṣamālāṃ jagrāha sa vasiṣṭhakaḥ ।
annaṃ bhuktvā cāyayuste prabhāse tvabdhisannidhau ।। 11 ।।
akṣamālā tapaścakre'rundhatī sā vyajāyata ।
tayā'kṣamālikeśaśca sthāpitaḥ śaṃkarastadā ।। 12 ।।
atha tatra siddhalakṣmītīrthaṃ vai vartate śubham ।
tathā tīrthaṃ mahākālīkṛtaṃ cāpi virājate ।। 13 ।।
puṣkarāvartakānāmnī nadī kamaladā śubhā ।
vartate śubhatīrthe ca prabhāse sadgatipradam ।। 14।।
atha mitrābhidhaḥ kaścit kāyastho'bhūd dharātale ।
tasya putro'bhavaccitraścitrā kanyā'bhavattathā ।। 156।।
pitrormṛtyau bālakau tau prabhāsaṃ yayatustataḥ ।
tuṣṭuvatustatra sūryaṃ tapasā bahuvāsarān ।। 1 6।।
citrasya tu prasanno'bhūt sūryaḥ prāha varaṃ vṛṇu ।
sa vavre sarvakāryeṣu prauḍhatvaṃ rucimattvakam ।। 17।।
tathāstviti raviḥ prāha dharmarājaśca taṃ tathā ।
kuśalaṃ tu paraṃ jñātvā kṛtavān lekhakaṃ nijam ।। 18।।
sūryo'pi cā'bhavattatra citrāditya iti prathaḥ ।
citrā'bhavaddharmarājagṛhiṇī tapasaḥ phalāt ।। 19 ।।
citreśvarīti sā tatra devī saṃrājate tathā ।
tīrthaṃ cāpi śubhaṃ jātaṃ rogadoṣanivārakam ।।1.539.2 0 ।।
athātra śītalā devī vartate duḥkhanāśinī ।
visphoṭakapraśāntyarthaṃ mayūrāँstatra kūrdayet ।।2 1 ।।
visphoṭaṃ carcikā cāpi bālānāṃ praśamo bhavet ।।
karpūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ cāpi candanaṃ kusumāni ca ।।।2।।
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tāṃ naivedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam ।
mālāṃ bilvamayīṃ dadyād rogā naśyanti dūrataḥ ।।23 ।।
śītalātīrthamevaitaduktaṃ bālasukhādikṛt ।
citrā yā yamapatnī sā citrapathā saridvarā ।। 24।।
dvitīyena svarūpeṇa jātā prabhāsake sthale ।
tadvai tīrthaṃ pāpatāpapraśāntyarthaṃ samucyate ।। 25।।
dharmarājakṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāse vartate tathā ।
brahmaṇā nirmitaḥ kuṇḍaḥ kāyākalpakaro'sti vai ।।26।।
nāradena kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ vidyate svarabhāsitam ।
yajñakuṇḍo mahattīrthaṃ brahmādikasuraiḥ kṛtam ।। 2 7।।
hiraṇyāyāstaṭe svarṇadānādi puṇyadaṃ hi tat ।
vainateyaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ sarpabhītinivārakam ।। 28।।
raivantakaṃ mahattīrthaṃ sūryaputrasya vartate ।
aśvasya taṃ pūjayitvā ravāvāpad vinaśyati ।।29।।
svargavaidyakṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ sāvitrītīrthamityapi ।
tapasā jāyamānaṃ tad vidyate vai prabhāsake ।। 1.539.30 ।।
talasvāmītitīrthaṃ ca uṣṇajalānvitaṃ tathā ।
siṃhāraṇye vartate ca pāvanaṃ svargadaṃ śubham ।। 31 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! purā tatra siṃhāraṇye talodbhavam ।
āsīnmahendranāmā tu dānavastapaso balāt ।।32।।
jigye devān śaṃkarāt saḥ prārthayāmāsa saṃgaram ।
yuyudhe śaṃkareṇā''dau brahmāṇḍakṣayakārakaḥ ।। 3 3।।
tataḥ kopācchivadehājjvālā bahvyo'bhavaँstadā ।
tāsāṃ madhye talo dagdho dudrāva ca vanāntare ।। 34।।
śivaḥ someśvaraṃ gatvā susthitaḥ sa talastataḥ ।
mahendraṃ pīḍayāmāsa badhāna kakubhāṃ patīn ।।35।।
talo vismayamāpanno harṣanṛtyamathā'karot ।
cakampe tasya nṛtyena sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṃgamam ।। 36 ।।
kṣubhitā girayaḥ sarve vidruto lavaṇārṇavaḥ ।
trailokyaṃ vyākulībhūtaṃ tadā vai lomaśo muniḥ ।।37।।
prabhāsaṃ tu samāgatya śaṃkaraṃ prāha rakṣa naḥ ।
talaṃ nāśaya deveśa mā ciraṃ ca drutaṃ kuru ।।38।।
rudra uvācā'vadhyo me talaḥ putrasamaḥ sthitaḥ ।
kintu uṣṇavane ramye taptodakasamīpataḥ ।। 3 9।।
durvāsā vartate taṃ ca prārthayadhvaṃ surādayaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo guptaprayāgake ।।1.539.40।।
śatruṃjayācale tvaśvapaṭṭasaṃjñasarovare ।
saurāṣṭre mahati kṣetre vartate bhagavān svayam ।।41 ।।
durvāsasā stūyamāno lomaśādibhirādarāt ।
devaiḥ samprārthyamānaśca talaṃ vināśayiṣyati ।।42।।
kalpe kalpe pūrvabhūmau vyāghrāraṇye sthitaḥ prabhuḥ ।
siṃhāraṇyagataṃ daityaṃ talaṃ hanti punaḥ punaḥ ।।43।।
evamukto lomaśaḥ saḥ uṣṇodakasamīpataḥ ।
gatvā durvāsasaṃ devānnītvā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।44।।
svasthānaṃ pāvanaṃ gatvā prāha kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
bhagavan rākṣasaścogro harā'vadhyo hi vartate ।।45।।
bhavatā nāśanīyaḥ sa suramānuṣaduḥkhadaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo gatvā sacakrakaḥ ।।46।।
vyāghrāraṇye talaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoca vai sudarśanam ।
talo dudrāva ca siṃhāraṇyamuṣṇodagahvaram ।।47 ।।
tatra cakreṇa tu dvedhā'bhavad daityo mamāra ca ।
durvāsasā pūjitaśca mārkaṇḍeyena cārcitaḥ ।।48 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ saṃjñāṃ talasvāmīti cāpa yat ।
talasvāmī mahat tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāśrayam ।।49।।
nityamuṣṇodakakuṇḍatrayamakṣayamasti ca ।
pāpakṣālanakaṃ svargapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā ।।1.539.50 ।।
tatra tīrthaṃ tu sāvitryāstapaḥsthānaṃ pravidyate ।
athā'nyadasti tīrthaṃ ca bhūtamātṛkasaṃjñakam ।।51 ।।
bhūtapretagaṇānāṃ ca sthānāni santi tatra ca ।
bhūtānāṃ mātaraṃ tatra pūjayed bhayavāriṇīm ।।।52।
cākṣuṣasyā''ntare lakṣmi! purā kṛtayuge satī ।
śaṃkaraṃ saṃvivāhyaiva ramate sma ca kānane ।।53 ।।
pārvatyāṃ kāmabhāvena tṛpto'bhūcchaṃkarastataḥ ।
pārvatī kānane tatra kailāse snānamācarat ।।54।।
pārvatyāḥ snānamātreṇa nirgatā jalakardamāt ।
mātaro bhūtikā bhīmā asaṃkhyā rūpavarjitāḥ ।।55।।
kṛṣṇāḥ karālavadanāḥ piṃgākṣyo muktamūrdhajā: ।
kapālamālābharaṇā baddhamuṇḍārdhapiṇḍikāḥ ।।56।।
kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharā muṇḍamālādharāstathā ।
dvīpicarmāmbaradharā raṇatkiṃkiṇimekhalāḥ ।।57।।
ḍimaḍḍamarukārāvāścitkārāpūritāmbarāḥ ।
daśakoṭyaḥ susañjātāścatasro'tra hi nāyikāḥ ।।।58।।।
raktakarṇī mahājihvā kṣayā ca pāpakāriṇī ।
etāsāmanvaye jātā bahavo brahmarākṣasāḥ ।।59।।
śleṣmāntakasta vṛkṣe te prāyaśaśca vasanti te ।
uttālāścapalāścaite nṛtyanti ca hasanti ca ।।1.539.6 0 ।।
vṛkṣe kaṇṭakite raudre vasantyapi vane vane ।
śaṃkaro'pi tadā snānaṃ cakre tajjalakardamāt ।।6 1 ।।
bhūtā asaṃkhyāḥ sañjātā vikarālā bhayaṃkarāḥ ।
dvau mukhyau tādṛśāveva tadrūpābharaṇau narau ।।62।।
kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharau jātau carmāvaguṇṭhitau ।
anugamyamānau bahubhūtairmahābhayānakaiḥ ।।63 ।।
siṃhaśārdūlādimukhairbhīṣaṇasvarakarmabhiḥ ।
tau ca kṣudhāyutau śivāṃ śivaṃ tadāhaturmuhuḥ ।।64।।
bhojanaṃ bhojanaṃ ceti śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā ca tau ।
yuvayorhastasaṃparkānmāṃsāsṛgādi jāyatām ।।65।।
naktāhāravihārau ca divāsvapnāvabhāginau ।
putravad rakṣataṃ lokān dharmaṃ pālayataṃ sadā ।।66।।
ityuktau tau gaṇau bhūtamātṛnāyakasevitau ।
ekībhūtau kṣaṇenaiva sahodarau sahāyakau ।।67।।
āvayoḥ khalu śaucena jātau vai malinau sadā ।
ābhyāṃ vāsaśca dātavyo dūraṃ paścimabhūtale ।।68।।
siṃhāraṇye vane vāso somanāthasamīpataḥ ।
sihavyāghrapaśukṣetre saurāṣṭre jāyatāmiti ।।69।।
yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā rūkṣā raṇapradeśakāḥ ।
kuḍyādau citritā yatra mañjaryaśca bhavanti vai ।।1.539.70।।
bhāryā yatra punarbhūśca valmīkaśca śamī tathā ।
yatra gṛhe narāḥ pañca yatra vā strītrayaṃ bhavet ।।71 ।।
yatra vā gotrayaṃ tatra tadgṛhe vasatiśca vaḥ ।
andhakāre bhūvivare gahvare dhanapūrite ।।72।।
ekacchāgaṃ dvigardabhaṃ gotrayaṃ pañcamāhiṣam ।
ṣaḍaśvaṃ vā saptagajaṃ tadgṛhe vasatirhi vaḥ ।।73।।
yatra gṛhe ca kuddālo dātṛkaṃ peṭikā tathā ।
sthālyādibhājanaṃ yatra tatraivāsti viśīrṇakam ।।74।।
kṣiptaṃ sthale sthale nāsti vyavasthā śuddhirityapi ।
musalolūkhalayośca dehalyāṃ strīḥ niṣīdati ।।75।।
śakṛnmūtraṃ ca yatrāsti malaṃ yatra ca kaccaram ।
laṃghyante yatra dhānyāni pakvāpakvāni veśmani ।।76।।
laṃghyante yatra śāstrāṇi tadgṛhe vasatirhi vaḥ ।
manuṣyāsthi gṛhe yasya sevatīvallikā tathā ।।77।।
rohitaśca jaṭī yatrā''gastyako bandhujīvakaḥ ।
karṇikā ca bhaved yatra sthalapadmaṃ ca yatra vai ।। 78।।
mallikā ca yatra harmye tatra vai vasatirhi vaḥ ।
tālaṃ tamālaṃ bhallāvaṃ ciñcāvṛkṣāśca yatra vai ।।79।।
bakulaḥ kadalīṣaṇḍaṃ kadambaḥ khadiro'pi vā ।
nyagrodho'śvattha āmra udumbaraḥ panasastathā ।।1.539.80।।
aśoka oḍravṛkṣaśca tatra bhūtaniveśanam ।
devārcanaṃ yatra nāsti yatra nāsti japādikam ।।8 1 ।।
kṛṣṇabhaktiryatra nāsti bhūtānāṃ vasatirhi sā ।
malināsyāśca ye martyā malināmbaradhāriṇaḥ ।।82।।
maladantā gṛhasthāśca bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ sadā ।
dīpo nāsti yatra gehe jano nāsti samāntare ।।83।।
malayuktā nālikādyāstatra bhūtādiveśanam ।
snānahīnā narā nāryo vasatirbhavatu dhruvam ।।84।।
madyamāṃsāśanā lokā vāsārhāḥ santu vaḥ sadā ।
catvare gocare grāmagopurāgre śmaśānake ।।85।।
mṛtaśāvikabhūbhāge caitye drume ca prastare ।
malabhūmau nālikādau bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ sadā ।।86।।
mantramāntrikadehe ca mantrite ca kaṇe tathā ।
mantrasya viṣaye dehe bhūtānāṃ vasatirbhavet ।।87।।
ākasmikamṛterbhūmau taḍāgasya taṭe'nile ।
duṣṭe'pavitrabhūmau ca bhūtānāṃ vasatiḥ sadā ।।88।।
amāyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe kārtike tathā ।
balidānāṃ pūjakānāṃ gṛhe mā nivasantu vai ।।89।।
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śiva rādhe ramāpate ।
viṣṇo śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇa śrīkamalāpate ।।1.539.90।।
prabhānātha mahālakṣmīpate śrīmāṇikīpate ।
pārvatīśvara padyeśa muktadhāmādhisatpate ।।91 ।।
akṣareśetyādirūpaṃ bhajanaṃ svāmino hareḥ ।
pūjanaṃ yatra devānāṃ tatra mā nivasantu vai ।।92।।
yatra śuddhistathā dharmaḥ kalaho yatra nāsti ca ।
mālinyaṃ yatra vai nāsti tatra mā nivasantu vai ।।93।।
yatra syādāntare śuddhistatra bhūto na tiṣṭhatu ।
upāsanābalaṃ yatra bhūtamātā na tatra vai ।। 94.।।
vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe ca pañcadaśadineṣvapi ।
bhūtamātuḥ prapūjā ca kartavyā prokṣaṇīyakaiḥ ।। 95।।।
prokṣaṇairjalasecaiśca grīvāṃ sindūrakaistathā ।
puṣpairdhūpairarcayecca baliṃ daded yathocitam ।।96।।
māṣādikṛṣṇabhojyaṃ vai tena tuṣṭaḥ prajāpate ।
na śākinyo gṛhe tasya na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ ।। 97।।
na bhūtādyāḥ pīḍayanti vaṃśaḥ sukhaṃ vivardhate ।
bhojayet kṣīrasaṃyāva kṛsaraiḥ pūyapāyasaiḥ ।। 98।।
tena putrapaśusmṛddhiṃ śarīrārogyamāpnuyāt ।
ekādaśyāṃ navamyāṃ ca prakṣālya kuḍyakaṃ tataḥ ।।019।।
mukhabimbāni citrāṇi kārayed raktakajjalaiḥ ।
mātṝṇāṃ caṇḍikānāṃ ca rākṣasīnāṃ tathaiva ca ।। 1.539.10 0।।
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ śākinīnāṃ tathaiva ca ।
mukhāni kārayet tatra hāvabhāvayutāni ca ।। 101 ।।
amāyāṃ pūjayettāni rātrau dīpena saṃyutaḥ ।
mastake ca nije dhṛtvā suhṛnmitrasamanvitaḥ ।। 1 02।।
grāmānte ca śmaśānānte vīrabhramaṇamācaret ।
sa dīpaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sādhako balavān bhavet ।। 1 03।।
nityaṃ ca bhrāmayed dīpaṃ rātrau grāme śmaśānake ।
pañcadaśyāṃ prakurvīta bhūtamāturmahotsavam ।। 1 04।।
pūjayedbhojayennamet kṣamayitvā gṛhaṃ vrajet ।
evaṃ pūjāprakartuśca bhūtavighno na jāyate ।। 1 05।।
atha tasyā bhūtamātuḥ śarīrāt pañcakoṭayaḥ ।
piśācāḥ svedabindubhyo jātāḥ sarve bhayānakāḥ ।। 1 06।।
dhamanīsantatāḥ śuṣkāḥ śmaśrūlāścarmavāsasāḥ ।
ulūkhalābharaṇāśca śūrpacchatrāḥ kharasvarāḥ ।। 1 07।।
pāṇipātrāḥ śirohārā bubhukṣitāḥ kurūpiṇaḥ ।
nakhajvālitakeśebhyaścāṃgārānudgiranti te ।।1 08।।
ākarṇadāritāsyāśca lambabhrūsthūlanāsikāḥ ।
pṛṣṭhataḥ pāṇipādāśca pṛṣṭhagāśca vipādagāḥ ।।1 09।।
ākrośantaśca dīnāsyāḥ sūtikāgṛhavāsanāḥ ।
taiḥ khādyaṃ cārthitaṃ śaṃbhoḥ śaṃbhurvaraṃ dadau tadā ।। 1.539.11 0।।
antardhānaṃ prajāsveva kāmarūpatvamityapi ।
ubhayoḥ sandhyayoścāro bhagnagṛheṣu cāsanam ।। 111 ।।
anācāragṛhāṇyeva bhagnānyāyatanāni ca ।
rājamārgoparathyāśca catvarāṇi ca vedikāḥ ।। 11 2।।
upalāśca tathā koṇān rathyānāṃ nirgamāṃstathā ।
caityavṛkṣādikāṃścāpi śṛṃgāṇi cocchrayāṃstathā ।। 11 3।।
sthānāni ca piśācānāṃ nivāsāya dadau haraḥ ।
adharmikān janāँścāpi madyamāṃsāśinastathā ।। 1 14।।
malamūtrabharāṃścāpi nivāsāya dadau haraḥ ।
teṣāṃ vighnavināśāya baliṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ ।। 115।।
pūpairharidrakṛśarairmadhunā tilacūrṇakaiḥ ।
odanaṃ sā''savaṃ dadyāt tilabhaktaṃ guḍaudanam ।। 1 16।।
kṛṣṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi dhūmāḥ sumanasastathā ।
evaṃ kṛtvā ca santuṣṭā vighnān haranti sarvadā ।। 1 17।।
evaṃ hareṇa bhūtānāṃ piśācānāṃ ca mātaraḥ ।
sarvaputragaṇopetāḥ preṣitāśca prabhāsakam ।। 1 18।।
siṃhāraṇyaṃ nivāsārthaṃ dattaṃ vai śatayojanam ।
yatra khādyaṃ miletteṣāṃ paścime sāgare sadā ।। 11 9।।
te kailāsaṃ parityajya siṃhāraṇyaṃ samāgatāḥ ।
upadravānakurvaṃśca prajāsvāgatya vai punaḥ ।। 1.539.120।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hantuṃ ca tāँstadā ।
sudarśanaṃ mumocā'trā'raṇye dudruvurambare ।। 121 ।।
bhūtāḥ piśācakādyāśca mātaraśceti paścimam ।
pāresamudraṃ jagmuste kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ piśācakāḥ ।। 1 22।।
kadrūpā abriktadeśe vasatiṃ tatra cakrire ।
koṭiśaste tato jātāḥ kāmarūpā hi mānavāḥ ।। 123 ।।
ye tu cakreṇa nihatāste devā malināstadā ।
siṃhāraṇye nivasanto dehāntarāṇi jagṛhuḥ ।। 124।।
somanāthasya śaṃbhoste śiṣyāḥ prajāḥ suputrakāḥ ।
putryaḥ sutāśca śiṣyāśca siṃhāraṇye vasanti vai ।। 125 ।।
uṣṇodakasya kuṇḍasyā'bhito'driṣu vaneṣu ca ।
tāmasānāṃ kṛte lakṣmi tāmasā devatāḥ sadā ।। 126 ।।
tīrtharūpā bhavantyeva svabhāvaguṇabhāvanaiḥ ।
teṣāṃ tīrthaṃ mahattadvai siṃhā'raṇye'sti tāmasam ।। 1 27।।
bhūtamātuḥ piśācānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca nivāsanam ।
cakreṇa sīdamānāḥ saṃsīdamānā hi jātayaḥ ।। 1 28।।
paścimāyāṃ kṣitau jātāḥ piśācasadṛśāstu te ।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devyai śaṃbhunā ca prabhāsake ।। 1 29।।
kailāsajanyaṃ vṛttāntaṃ tīrthamiṣeṇa somake ।
mayā te kathitaṃ lakṣmi! talatvāmī tvahaṃ purā ।। 1.539.13 0।।
talanāśārthamabhavaṃ tathā'nyacchruṇu pāvanam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya pāpahāniḥ prajāyate ।। 131 ।।


itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prabhāsakṣetre tīrthavrātavarṇane'rundhatīpūrvajanmavṛttāntaḥ, citrāyāḥ pūrvajanmākhyānaṃ, śītalāyāstīrthaṃ, talasvāmitīrthākhyānaṃ, bhūtamātṛtīrthākhyānaṃ, bhūtānāṃ vāsasthānāni, abriktadeśādau sīdamānānāṃ vāsaḥ, ityādinirūpaṇanāmaikonacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।539।।


← adhyāyaḥ 539 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 540
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 541 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! śaṃbhurdevyai tathottaram ।
tīrthe ca yad yaduvāca kathayāmi kramāttathā ।। 1 ।
puṣpadanteśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā māṇḍavyatīrthakam ।
tapaso vai tayoḥ sthānaṃ māṇḍavyapuṣpadantayoḥ ।। 2 ।
pañcaprabhāsān saṃpaśyenmukhyaṃ prabhāsake taṭe ।
dakṣiṇe cāpprabhāsaṃ ca paścimaṃ ca prabhāsakam ।। 3 ।
uttaraṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca pūrvaṃ prabhāsamityapi ।
yamo varuṇo dhanado mahendraśceti sarvataḥ ।। 4 ।
bhāsayanti prabhāsaṃ ca tataścaturvidhaṃ hi tat ।
jāmadagnyeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tathā tatra hi vartate ।। 5 ।
kṛtasmaraṃ mahattīrthaṃ parvatātmakameva tat ।
smaraṃ dagdhvā punaḥ kṛtvā pārvatyā yuyuje haraḥ ।। 6 ।।
yatra kāmaḥ śaṃkareṇa kṛtaḥ sajīvanaḥ purā ।
kṛtasmaraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ parvataḥ śaṃkarāśritaḥ ।। 7 ।।
kāmakuṇḍaśca tatrāsti yatra kāmo hi vidyate ।
snātvā tatra trayodaśyāṃ subhago rūpavān bhavet ।। 8 ।।
puṇyaṃ sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ yena jīvanti somake ।
anyāni sarvatīrthāni śubhe sāmudrasaṃgame ।। 9 ।।
puṇyakṛllabhate tatra vaiśākho somasaṃyutām ।
amāṃ somayutāṃ cāpi kiṃ tadā parvakoṭibhiḥ ।। 1.540.10 ।।
bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ karṇikāṃ mālatīṃ tathā ।
dhattūrakaṃ campakaṃ cā'śokaṃ śrīphalamakṣatān ।। 11 ।।
śarkarāṃ candanaṃ miṣṭaṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ saṃgame'rpayet ।
sarasvatyāṃ manuṣyaiśca dhyātavyo vai harirharaḥ ।। 12 ।।
tasmai deyā supūjā ca muktidā bhuktidā ca sā ।
tatrā'sthiṃ mṛtadehasya kṣepaṇīyaṃ vimuktaye ।। 1 3।।
yāvadasthi manuṣyasya tiṣṭhet sārasvate jale ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svarge loke sa tiṣṭhati ।। 14।।
svarganiḥśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāsasthā sarasvatī ।
darśanenā''camanena rājasūyaphalapradā ।। 15।।
tatra śrāddhena pitaro muktiṃ yānti sutarpitāḥ ।
ahno muhūrtā vikhyātāḥ pañcadaśa ca tatra ca ।। 16।।
prātaḥkāle muhūrtāstrīn saṃgavaṃ trimuhūrtakān ।
madhyāhnaṃ ca muhūrtāstrīnaparāhnaṃ tathaiva trīn ।। 17।।
sāyāhnaṃ ca muhūrtāṃstrīn vidyāttatra ca śrāddhakṛt ।
sāyāhno rākṣasī velā tatra śrāddhaṃ na kārayet ।।18।।
divā'ṣṭamo muhūrto yaḥ saḥ kālaḥ kutupaḥ smṛtaḥ ।
sa cā'nantaphaladātā madhyāhnaḥ kutupātmakaḥ ।।1 9।।
pāpaṃ ca kutsitaṃ tasmāt kuto pālanaṃ rakṣaṇam ।
kutupaḥ sa samādiṣṭaḥ kutupā aṣṭarūpiṇaḥ ।।1.540.20।।
madhyāhno geṇḍukapātraṃ rajataṃ goghṛtaṃ tathā ।
darbhastilāni dhenuśca dauhitraḥ kutupāśca te ।।21।।
ūrdhve muhūrtātkutupād yanmuhūrtaṃ catuṣṭayam ।
muhūrtapañcakaṃ caiva svadhābhavanamiṣyate ।।22।।
viṣṇordehātsamutpannāḥ kuśāḥ kṛṣṇāstilāstathā ।
tilodakā'ñjalirdeyā sadarbhā sthalavartibhiḥ ।।23।।
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraṃ kutupastilāḥ ।
dauhitro geṇḍukaḥ paśurlalāṭe śṛṃgavān hi saḥ ।।24।।
tasya śṛṃgasya yatpātraṃ tad dauhitramiti smṛtam।
kṣīriṇī yā savatsā gaustatkṣīrād yadghṛtaṃ bhavet ।। 25।।
tad dauhitramiti proktaṃ daive paitrye ca karmaṇi ।
duhituśca sutaḥ śreṣṭho dauhitraḥ śrāddhabhojane ।। 26 ।।
darbhāgraṃ daivamityuktaṃ satilāgnaṃ tu paitṛkam ।
tatrā'valambino ye tu te kuśāḥ kutupāḥ smṛtāḥ ।। 27।।
śuklanyāyārjitadrvyaistṛpyanti pitaraḥ surāḥ ।
anyāyārjitadravyaiśca tṛpyanti puṣkasādijāḥ ।। 28।।
bhūkṣiptānnena ca tṛptā bhavanti ca piśācajāḥ ।
snānavastrajalenāpi tṛpyanti nīcayonijāḥ ।। 29।।
sugandhāmbukaṇaistṛptā bhavanti devatāṃgatāḥ ।
piṇḍoddhṛtai'nnakaṇakaistṛpyanti ca vipadbhavāḥ ।। 1.540.30 ।।
bhuktvā cā''camanenaiva tṛpyanti paśuyonijāḥ ।
viprāḥ śrāddhe śrotriyaśca yogī sāmagavaidikau ।। 31 ।।
triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgnistrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṃgavit ।
dauhitrakaśca jāmātā svasrīyaścottamastathā ।। 32 ।।
pañcāgnikarmaniṣṭhaśca taponiṣṭho'tha mātulaḥ ।
mātuśca pitaraścaiva śiṣyasambandhibāndhavāḥ ।। 33 ।।
vedārthavit pravaktā ca brahmacārī sahasradaḥ ।
cirāyuścaiva vijñeyāḥ satpuruṣāśca pāvanāḥ ।। 34।।
bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā bandhugaṇānapi ।
nātikramennaraścaitān mūrkhānapi ca padmaje ।। 35 ।।
jalaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ dadyād dadyāt piṇḍāṃśca pāyasam ।
miṣṭaṃ ca śarkarāṃ dadyād dadyādiṣṭatamaṃ sadā ।। 36 ।।
dravyapātrādilābho ca dadyāt tṛtikaraṃ hi tat ।
puṇyāheṣu pradadyācca nitye naimittike tathā ।। 37।।
nirṇītadivase dadyād vatsare vatsare dhruvam ।
amāyāṃ sarvathā dadyāt prāpnuvanti dhruvaṃ mṛtāḥ ।।30।।
mahādānāni ca dadyānnārāyaṇālaye tathā ।
jalāttīraṃ yāvadārdraṃ yadvā hastacatuṣṭayam ।। 39 ।।
tatra nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī nānyālayaḥ sa ucyate ।
gāvaḥ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnāni ca sarasvatī ।।1.540.40 ।।
tilaṃ kanyā gajo'śvaśca śayyā vastraṃ tathā mahī ।
dhānyaṃ payaśca chatraṃ ca gṛhaṃ dānāni ṣoḍaśa ।।41 ।।
satyaṃ damastathā śaucaṃ santoṣo naiṣṭhyamārjavam ।
jñānaṃ śamo dayā dānametatpātraṃ praśasyate ।।42 ।।
avithipriyaśāntāya sīdate cāhitāgnaye ।
śrotriyāya tathaikā'pi gaurdeyā mokṣadā hi sā ।।43 ।।
bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śaraṇaṃ striyaḥ ।
prāsādā yatra sauvarṇā rūpyaratnaujjvalāḥ śubhāḥ ।।44 ।।
varāścāpsaraso yatra tatra gacchanti gopradāḥ ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vasati bhūmidaḥ ।। 45 ।।
evaṃ sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ kṛtvā mārkaṇḍatīrthakam ।
yāyād yatra sthito dīrghaṃ yugānāṃ tapase muniḥ ।।46 ।।
tato yāyād yatra kṛṣṇakulanāśasthalī matā ।
golokadhāmadā divyā cādyayugaraṇāṃgaṇā ।। 47 ।।
yadā raṇāṃgaṇo jātastadā'paśakunāni ca ।
teṣāṃ jātāni ca lakṣmi! śṛṇu vināśakāni ca ।।48 ।।
kālasteṣāṃ gṛhāṇyeva parikrāmyati dṛśyate ।
karālo vikaṭo muṇḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṃgalaḥ ।।49 ।।
sammārjanīmahāketurjapāpuṣpāvataṃsakaḥ ।
kṛtakṛkalāsahāraḥ kākaiśca kṛtabhūṣaṇaḥ ।।1.540.50 ।।
gṛhāṇyavekṣya kārṣṇānā nādṛśyata punargataḥ ।
suptānāṃ dadṛśuḥ keśān nṝṇāṃ yuvatayo niśi ।।5 1 ।।
bhinnakaṭakaprākoṣṭhāḥ utkocayanti sarvaśaḥ ।
menā cīcītikūcīti rauti gṛheṣu nityadā ।।।52।।
kharāśca vāyavo rūkṣā vavuḥ kaṃkaravāhakāḥ ।
ajāḥ śivānāṃ ca rutamanukurvanti vai tadā ।।53 ।।
pāṇḍurā raktapādāśca vihagāḥ kālanoditāḥ ।
kapotāśca tathā yūkā gṛheṣu vicaranti hi ।।।54।।
vyajāyanta kharā goṣu vṛṣāścāśvatarīṣu ca ।
śunīṣvapi biḍālāśca mūṣakā nakulīṣu ca ।।55 । ।
bhāryāḥ patīn vañcayanti patnīśca puruṣāṃstathā। ।
vibhāvasuḥ prajvalito vāmaṃ viparivartate । ।56 ।।
nīlalohitamāñjiṣṭhān visṛjan svārciṣaḥ pṛthak ।
udayāstamane nityaṃ viparyasto divākaraḥ ।।57।।
vyadṛśyatā'sakṛjjanaiḥ kabandhaiḥ parivāritaḥ ।
mahāsaneṣu siddhānne saṃskṛte'tīva bhāsure ।।58।।
uccāryamāṇe kṛmayo dṛśyante bhojanālaye ।
parasparaṃ ca nakṣatraṃ hanyamānaṃ vyadṛśyata ।।5 9 ।।
aniveditadevāgre'śrūyanta rāsabhasvarāḥ ।
trayodaśī rāhuṇā ca grastā nāśakarī sadā ।।1.540.6 0 ।।
kālī strī pāṇḍurairdantaiḥ praviśya nagarīṃ niśi ।
striyaṃ svānteṣu muṣṇāti nagarīṃ prati dhāvati ।।6 1 ।।
kurvanti bhīṣaṇaṃ nādaṃ kukkuṭāstu raṇājire ।
kurūpā dviśirā raudrāścaturbāhava eva ca ।।6 2 ।।
strīṇāṃ garbheṣvajāyanta rākṣasā guhyakāstathā ।
alaṃkārāṇi chatrāṇi dhvajāśca kavacāni ca ।।63।।
hriyamāṇāni dṛśyante rakṣobhiśca bhayānakaiḥ ।
evaṃ jātāni vijñāya viśakunāni mādhavaḥ ।।64।।
kulānyādāya somāḍhyaṃ prabhāsaṃ samupāyayau ।
sāntaḥpureṇa kṛṣṇena airakāhetibhistadā ।।65।।
svakulāni saṃhṛtāni parasparajighāṃsayā ।
kārṣṇanirvāṇabhūmiḥ sā paraṃ tīrthaṃ samucyate ।।66।।
airakāpatrajātāni tṛṇānyapi viparyaye ।
āsan muśalībhūtāni khaḍgībhūtāni vai tadā ।।67।।
sarvaṃ līnaṃ yatra bhūmau citā gavyūtibhūmigā ।
tatra yātrā prakartavyā mahāvairāgyadā priye ।।68।।
tato yāyād hiraṇyāṃ ca nadīṃ snāyāt supuṇyadam ।
tato yāyād rurukṣetraṃ yatra devī kumārikā ।।69।।
rurodaityasya nāśārthaṃ devānāṃ tejasā'bhavat ।
sā sthitā vartate tatra pārvatīṃ vai kumārikām ।।1.540.70।।
pūjayed vandanāṃ kuryācchāṭikāṃ cārpayecchubhām ।
tato yāyād ṛṣitīrthaṃ purā yatra maharṣayaḥ ।।।75।।।
cāturmāsye nivāsaṃ vai satrārthe cakrurīśvarāḥ ।
yatra trinetramatsyānāṃ vaṃśo vasati śāśvataḥ ।।72।।
aṃgirā gautamo'gastyo viśvāmitro bṛhaspatiḥ ।
saṃvartaścyavano raibhyo durvāsāḥ kaśyapo manuḥ ।।73।।
mārkaṇḍeyo jamadagniruśanā kaṇvagālavau ।
nāradaḥ parvataścāpi bharadvājo'tha bhāguriḥ ।।74।।
medhātithiryavakrītastathā'nye vaiṣṇavāḥ śubhāḥ ।
viṣṇuyāge pravṛtte ca vṛṣādarbhinṛpastadā ।।75।।
āha pratigrahaṃ matto gṛhṇīdhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ ।
mudgān māṣāँśca vrīhīṃśca tathā ratnāni kāñcanam ।।76।।
ṛṣayastu tadā prāhurna gṛhṇīmaḥ pratigraham ।
rājyadravyaṃ mahādoṣayuktaṃ gṛhṇīma eva na ।।77।।
daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajī ।
daśadhvajisamā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ ।।78।।
rājño dānaṃ mahāghoraṃ pācayituṃ na śakyate ।
anyebhyo dīyatāṃ rājan kuśalaṃ te'stu sarvathā ।।79।।
śrutvā rājā yayau naijaṃ gṛhama paścācca guptakam ।
dānaṃ dātuṃ hemagarbhāṇyudumbarāṇyakārayat ।।1.540.80 ।।
vyakiran mantriṇastasya yatra te ṛṣayaḥ sthitāḥ ।
aṃgirāḥ prāha ṛṣayo mā gṛhṇantu phalāni vai ।।81 ।।
guptadānāni santyeva vṛṣādarbhinṛpasya vai ।
dhanasya sañcayastapaḥsaṃcayasya vināśakaḥ ।।82।।
nahi sañcayavān kaścid dṛśyate nirupadravaḥ ।
apratigrahaśīlānāṃ tejo nityaṃ vivardhate ।।83।।
akiñcanatvaṃ rājyaṃ ca tulayā saha tolane ।
akiñcanatvamadhikaṃ rājyādapi dhanādapi ।।84।।
artho hyanartharūpo'sti śreyasāṃ bhraṃśakārakaḥ ।
śokamohapradaścāpi taṃ sukhī dūratastyajet ।।85।।
dharmārthamiti matvā'pi dravyasaṃgaṃ na vai caret ।
prakṣālanāddhi paṃkasya paṃkasyā'sparśanaṃ varam ।।86।।
jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ ।
cakṣuḥśrotre ca jīryaṃte tṛṣṇaikā nahi jīryati ।।87।।
anantapārā sā tṛṣṇā dhanāśā duḥkhadā sadā ।
adharmabahulā cāpi tasmāttāṃ dūrayet sadā ।।88।।
asantuṣṭā vinaśyanti dravyalobhena saṃkaṭaiḥ ।
santuṣṭamānasatvaiva sarvatra sukhaśevadhiḥ ।।89।।
upānadgūḍhapādasya yathā carmāvṛtaiva bhūḥ ।
santoṣāmṛtatṛptānāṃ śāntiḥ sukhamanantakam ।। 1.540.90।।
lubdhānāṃ tṛṣṇayā nāśaḥ kutaḥ śāntiḥ kutaḥ sukham ।
kāmaḥ kāmayamānasya pūryate naiva karhicit ।।91।।
athainamaparaḥ kāmo bhūyo vidhyati bāṇavat ।
upabhogena kāmastu kadācinnahi śāmyati ।।92।।
pratyuta vardhate puṣṭo ghṛtayogena vahnivat ।
kāmānabhilaṣan janturlubdhaḥ sukhaṃ na vindati ।।93।।
catuḥsamudrasahitā bhuṃkte'pi pṛthivī nṛpaḥ ।
na tathāpi kṛtārthaśca vitṛṣṇo jāyate kvacit ।।94।।
apratigṛhṇatāṃ lokāḥ śāśvatānandadāyakāḥ ।
vināpi tapasā teṣāṃ tapo bhavati lakṣadhā ।।95।।
santānatantustṛṣṇā'sti dehasthā raktaśoṣiṇī ।
dustyajā rākṣasīrūpā jīryato'pi na jīryati ।।96।।
tṛṣṇā prāṇāntako rogastaṃ tyajet sa sukhī sadā ।
lokatṛṣṇā vittatṛṣṇā putratṛṣṇā ca kāmanā ।।97।।
etāstṛṣāḥ prāṇabhakṣā bibhyastābhyo maheśvarāḥ ।
tasmādudumbarāṇyeva bhavantu nṛpateḥ sadā ।।98।।
ityuktvā hemagarbhāṇi tyaktvodumbarakāṇi ca।
satraṃ cakruḥ svastharūpāstāpasāḥ pārameśvarāḥ ।।99 ।।
teṣāṃ puṇyasthalaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāse vartate priye ।
lakṣmi! tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ tat kartavyaṃ mokṣadāyakam ।। 1.540.10 0।।


iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prabhāsacatuṣṭayatīrthāni, tīrthaśateṣu sārasvatatīrthaṃ, kutupasamayādayaḥ, dauhitrādīnāmarthāḥ, mārkaṇḍatīrtha kṛṣṇakulanāśatīrtham, raṇādāvaniṣṭasūcakāni, vṛṣādarbhikṛtāni guptasuvarṇagarbhodumbarāṇi, aṃgiraso dānā'graham, anyānyatīrthāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।540 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 540 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 541
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 542 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! nandatīrthaṃ śaṃkareṇa yathoditam ।
pārvatyai te kathayāmi nando bhāgavato hyabhūt ।। 1 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
itimantro vaśiṣṭhādvai gṛhītastena bhūbhujā ।। 2 ।।
mahābhāgavato hyāsīnnārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।
na durbhikṣaṃ na cā vyādhirnā'kāle maraṇaṃ nṛṇām ।। 3 ।।
na caurā na ca kāpaṭyaṃ na cā'vṛṣṭyādikaṃ bhayam ।
tasmin śāsati rājendre prajāścāsan sukhāḥ sadā ।। 4 ।।
vimānaṃ tasya tuṣṭena dattaṃ vai viṣṇunā svayam ।
vyacaran sarvalokān sa vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ।। 5 ।।
ekadā vyacaran bhūmau mānasaṃ tu saro yayau ।
devādisevitaṃ padmasugandhaparivāsitam ।। 6 ।।
divyavārisamāyuktaṃ śītatṛptipradaṃ śubham ।
tatrā'paśyacchubhaṃ padmaṃ vikasitaṃ ca pāṇḍuram ।। 7 ।।
tatrā'pyaṃguṣṭhamātraṃ ca sthitaṃ puruṣasattamam ।
apaśyaccā'kathayat svasārathiṃ gaccha vai jalam ।। 8 ।।
yadidaṃ dṛśyate padmaṃ puruṣeṇa virājitam ।
ratnahārāliśobhena pītavastrādidhāriṇā ।। 9 ।।
dvibhujena sudivyena madhyabhāge hyadhiṣṭhitam ।
tadidaṃ kamalaṃ śīghraṃ samānaya mamāntikam ।। 1.541.1 0।।
dhārayiṣyāmi śirasi bhaviṣyāmi kṛtārthakaḥ ।
evamuktaḥ sārathistu vimānādavaruhya ca ।। 11 ।।
vyomnā vāyusamādhāraścāvātatāra padminīm ।
adhomastakasthityaiva hastaṃ prasārya yāvatā ।। 12।।
vyomnaiva gṛhītuṃ yāti tatpadmaṃ nālasaṃsthitam ।
yāvatā spṛśati tāvad dhūmrastasmādajāyata ।। 13।।
andhakāramaye tatra vyomni mamāra sārathiḥ ।
nando vimānamadhye ca kṛṣṇavarṇo babhūva ha ।। 14।।
balavīryavihīnaśca medhāśaktivivarjitaḥ ।
unmatta iva sañjāto mlānaśuṣkānanastathā ।। 15।
kajjalapiṇḍavaddehaṃ dṛṣṭvā śuśoca bhūpatiḥ ।
