kimidaṃ me tu sañjātaṃ mṛtaśca sārathirmama ।। 16।।
kopo'yaṃ kasyacijjāto vasiṣṭho māṃ prarakṣatu ।
ityuktamātrastu gururvasiṣṭhastatra cāyayau ।। 17।।
yogabalena ca yāne samāgatyā''ha bhūpatim ।
mā bhayaṃ yāhi rājendra kuśalaṃ śaṃ tavā'stu vai ।। 18।।
rājā vasiṣṭhaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca viśokaḥ samapadyata ।
namaskāraṃ vidhāyaiva dīnavannijagāda tam ।। 1 9।।
eṣa me bhagavan jātaḥ kṛṣṇo dehaviparyayaḥ ।
sārathirmama naṣṭaśca kamalasya prabhāvataḥ ।।1.541.20।।
kimidaṃ vada me brahman nistāraṃ kārayā'sya vai ।
vasiṣṭhaḥ prāha rājendra mānase'tra sarovare ।।21 ।।
etad brahmodbhavaṃ nāma kamalaṃ padmajātikam ।
nārāyaṇasya nābhervai yadā brahmā vyajāyata ।।22।
sanālakamale tadvai padmametannigadyate ।
tajjātīyaṃ tu kamalaṃ mānase'tra sarovare ।।23 ।।
vaṃśarūpeṇa bhagavān rakṣatyeva paramparām ।
etadīyasusantāne kamale sarvadā hyajaḥ ।।24।।
aṃguṣṭhamātrapratimo brahmā tatra virājate ।
yāvanti kamalānyatra tasya santānajāni hi ।।25।।
tāvanti brahmaṇā cādhivāsitāni bhavanti vai ।
nānye paśyanti caitāni puṇyahīnā hi dehinaḥ ।।26।।
supuṇyā mokṣagantāraḥ paśyantyetattu padmakam ।
dṛṣṭamātreṇa cānena dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ ।।27।।
etadvai dṛśyate dhanyairbrahmabhāgavatairjanaiḥ ।
mahābhāgavatairlokairyat tvayā dṛṣṭameva hi ।।28।।
etasmin dṛṣṭamātre tu jalasparśe ca vai kṛte ।
sarvaśokavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyāt ।।29।।
sārathistava rājendra dadarśa kamalaṃ tathā ।
pasparśa ca jalaṃ nālaṃ muktiṃ jagāma tāvatā ।।1.541.3 0।।
ahaṃ nityaṃ darśanārthaṃ tvāyāmi vyomamārgataḥ ।
na spṛśāmi jalaṃ kintu natvā taṃ pitaraṃ hyajam ।।3 1 ।।
punargacchāmi me sthānaṃ puṣkaraṃ cārbudācalam ।
tvaṃ tu mahāvaiṣṇavo'si dṛṣṭavānasi tena vai ।।।32।।।
savedhasaṃ ca kamalaṃ tava puṇyaṃ hi śāśvatam ।
jalaṃ na spṛṣṭvāँstena rājan jīvasi vardhase ।।33।।
kintu padmaṃ ca hartuṃ te vāñcchā jātā nṛpeśvara ।
tena kārṣṇyaṃ tava jātaṃ doṣeṇa nīlavarṇatā ।।34।।
vāñchanti devatā nityaṃ munayaḥ ṛṣayastathā ।
mānase brahmapadmaṃ tu drakṣyāmastat kadā vayam ।।35।।।
prāpsyāmaśca paraṃ brahma yadgatvā na nivartanam ।
evaṃ tejoviśiṣṭaṃ tat hartuṃ kāmena paṃkajam ।।36।।
apahārapradoṣaśca tvayā labdho hyajānatā ।
tato rājan padmasaṃsthaṃ bedhoyuktaṃ narāyaṇam ।।37।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇakṣetre gatvā''rādhaya somake ।
prabhāse śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ ca vedhasā yutam ।।38।।
svarṇapadme kārayitvā samārādhaya tāpasaḥ ।
tatastvaṃ nīlatādoṣānmokṣyase nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।39।।
vaśiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā nandabhūpo jagāma ha ।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetramaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।।1.541.40।।
tatra snātvā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā ca lomaśam ।
raivatādrau vāmanaṃ ca yayau natvāprabhāsakam ।।41।।
tatra vai kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ padmasthāṃ brahmaṇāyutām ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇarūpāṃ nidhāya ca ।।42।।
pūjayāmāsa vividhairupacārairdivāniśam ।
tapaścakāra bhagavatsamārādhanapūrvakam ।।43।।
viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ gaṇapatiṃ pārvatīṃ ca divākaram ।
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā śrīhariṃ pañcadevatāḥ ।।44।।
māheśvaryāstaṭe ramye tapaḥsthānaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
tasya tapastathā bhaktiṃ vilokya devatāstathā ।।45।।
brahmā kṛṣṇastathā lakṣmīrdarśanaṃ pradadustadā ।
prasannāḥ sma iti prāhurvaraṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ।।46।।
rājā prāha harerbhakto naiva vāñchati caihikam ।
mokṣaṃ dehi satāṃ saṃgaṃ pradehi śāśvataṃ padam ।।47।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prāha hasaँstadā ।
rājan tattu tvadarthaṃ vai mayā prāgeva niścitam ।।48।।
na me bhaktasya vai bhuktau muktau vā rodhanaṃ bhavet ।
prasanno'smi ca rājaँste kṛṣṇatā padmadoṣajā ।।49।।
yā jātā'si layaṃ yātu bhava campakavarṇakaḥ ।
divyadehastathā bhūtvā bhaja māṃ puruṣottamam ।।1.541.50।।
atrā''gatya jano yo māṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
vedhasaṃ pañcadevāँśca sūryādīn pūjayiṣyati ।।51 ।।
sa ca loke nirogī syād yāsyatyante parāṃ gatim ।
evaṃ harirvaraṃ datvā kṛtvā suvarṇavarṇakam ।।52।
tatra tīrthaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā tataścāntaradhīyata ।
nandīghaṭṭe naraḥ snātvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।।।।53।।
nandatīrthaṃ tathā kṛtvā na punarmartyatāṃ vrajet ।
nandatīrthasya pārśve ca tritakūpākhyamuttamam ।।54।।
pāvanaṃ vartate tīrthaṃ kartavyaṃ puṇyalabdhaye ।
purā saurāṣṭraviṣaye vipra ātreyasaṃjñakaḥ ।।55।।
babhūva tasya putrāścaikato dvitastritastrayaḥ ।
tritaḥ sarvaguṇopeto mūrkhau jyeṣṭhau babhūvatuḥ ।।56।।
gate svarge tu pitari dhuraṃ jagrāha vai tritaḥ ।
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā kathaṃ yajñaṃ karomyaham ।।87।।
sa nimantrya dvijaśreṣṭhān yajñakarmaṇyadhiṣṭhitān ।
yajñārthaṃ dravyalābhāya pravāsaṃ prajagāma ha ।।58।।
gṛhītvā bhrātarau jyeṣṭhau gavārthaṃ prasthitastritaḥ ।
yasya yasya gṛhe yāti grāmeṣu bhrātṛsaṃyutaḥ ।।59।।
tatra tatra parāṃ pūjāṃ lebhe gāśca supuṣkalāḥ ।
evaṃ dravyaṃ puṣkalaṃ ca godhanaṃ vipulaṃ tathā ।।1.541.6 0।।
gṛhītvā gṛhamāyāti bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitaḥ sa ca ।
trito gavāṃ puro yāti pṛṣṭhato bhrātarau ca tau ।।61 ।।
atha taṃ godhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūridānārthamāhṛtam ।
jyeṣṭhayostu matirjātā pāpaprāyā'tilobhataḥ ।।6 2।।
parasparamūcatustau bhrātarau pāpacetasau ।
trito yajñeṣu kuśalo vedeṣu kuśalastathā ।।63।।
mānyaḥ pūjyaśca sarveṣāmāvāṃ mūrkhau nirarthakau ।
etacca godhanaṃ sarvaṃ trito dāsyati dānake ।।64।।
asmākaṃ na bhavet kiñcit pratyuta yatpiturdhanam ।
tasmādapi pradātavyaṃ bhaviṣyati kratau tadā ।।65।।
yajñe lokāśca dāsyanti dhanāni ca bahūnyapi ।
tritasya tāni sarvāṇi nāvayorvai kapardikā ।।66।।
tasmādāvāṃ dhanahīnau trito dhanāḍhya eva ca ।
bhaviṣyati tato hetorvadhastritasya yujyate ।।67।।
evaṃ vicārya tau jyeṣṭhau yāntaṃ tritaṃ puraḥ puraḥ ।
āhvayāmāsatuḥ kūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā jalārthinau yathā ।।68।।
jalapānaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ samāgacchā'tra bho trita! ।
tritaḥ śrutvā samāyāto dvābhyāṃ kṣipto hi kūpake ।।69।।
tatastau godhanaṃ nītvā dravyaṃ nītvā ca puṣkalam ।
prasthitau svagṛhaṃ hṛṣṭamānasau lobhakāriṇau ।।1.541.70 ।।
kūpe ca patito vipraścintayāmāsa mānase ।
viprā yajñārthamāhūtāḥ kraturmayā kṛto nahi ।।7 1।।
tasmāt yadbhāvi tajjātaṃ kūpe'tra mānasaṃ kratum ।
karomi yāvajjīvāmi jalena manasā tathā ।।72।।
iti vicintya sūktāni proktvā proktvā jalena vai ।
añjalinā ca havanaṃ cakāra kardamena saḥ ।।73।।
śraddhayā tasya dadato bhūyastṛptāstu devatāḥ ।
āgatya brāhmaṇaṃ procurvipra santarpitā vayam ।।74।।
tuṣṭāḥ sma mānasairbhāvairvada dāsyāma īpsitam ।
tritaḥ prāha mayā yajño bhāvayajño'tra vai kṛtaḥ ।।75।।
dravyayajñaṃ gṛhe gatvā karomi tattathā mama ।
svāsthyaṃ kuruta deveśā kūpānniḥsaraṇaṃ mama ।।76 ।।
ityuktāśca surā vipraṃ nītavanto jalādbahiḥ ।
gṛhe gatvā kratuṃ kṛtvā bhrātṛbhyāṃ pūjitaśca saḥ ।।77।।
dakṣiṇā vividhā datvā punaḥ kūpaṃ yayau tritaḥ ।
tapaścacāra vipulaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smaran ।।78।।
jagāma śrīharerdhāma divyayānena śāśvatam ।
sa kūpastritakūpo'sti devatīrthaṃ tu pāvanam ।।79।।
jalapānād bhavenmuktistritasya smaraṇādapi ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya vaikuṇṭhaṃ labhate janaḥ ।।1.541.80।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne
nandarājñaḥ sāratheḥ mānasasarasi brahmakamaladarśane grahaṇārthaṃ
gatasya muktiḥ, nandasya manasā grahaṇapāpasya phalaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇatā, nandītīrthasnānācchubhravarṇatā, tritaviprasya bhrātṛdvayakṛtakūpanikṣepastatra jalayajñe devatābhiḥ kṛtoddhārastapaścaryā muktiśceti tritatīrtham, ityādi nirūpaṇanāmaikacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।541 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 541 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 542
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 543 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahāpuṇyaṃ vṛttāntaṃ prāgbhavaṃ śubham ।
śravaṇātpāpahaṃ yacca dhāraṇānmokṣadaṃ param ।। 1 ।।
ahaṃ tuṣyāmi bhāvena śraddhayā sevayā tathā ।
dāsyena premavṛttyā ca bhakteṣṭakṛd bhavāmi hi ।। 2 ।।
bhāvasādhyo'smyahaṃ devi! na vittairna japairaham ।
bhaktānāṃ tu madarthaṃ vai kāyakleśo bhavet kvacita ।। 3 ।।
karmaṇā manasā vācā maccitto yo jano bhavet ।
ahiṃsāṃ satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ samācaret ।। 4 ।।
ekabhaktaṃ tathā naktamupavāsādika caret ।
mama saṃkīrtanaṃ sādhusmaraṇaṃ cā'pyanindanam ।। 5 ।।
bhajanaṃ ca prakuryādvai mama pratuṣṭaye rame ।

purā''sīd brahmaṇaḥ putra āruṇirnāma nāmataḥ ।। 6 ।।
so'raṇyamagamat kiñcittapo'rthaṃ dvijasattamaḥ ।
tapastepe dāruṇaṃ cāpyupavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
nāganadyāstaṭe ramye tvāvasathaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
snānārthamekadā nadyāṃ yayau snātvā taṭe sthitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
dadarśa tatra cāyāntaṃ vyādhaṃ dhanuśśarānvitam ।
taṃ dvijaṃ hantumāyāt sa vyādho valkalakāṃkṣayā ।। 9 ।।
ṛṣistu jñātavān divyacakṣuṣā vyādhamānasam ।
śuśoca sa hṛdi yadvai vyādho'yaṃ bahupāpakṛt ।। 1.542.1 0।।
mama hatyākṛtaṃ pāpamaho tasyā'dhikaṃ bhavet ।
evaṃ vai pāpakartuśca kadoddhāro bhaviṣyati ।। 11 ।।
tasmād vinā dvijahatyāṃ gṛhṇātu valkalāni saḥ ।
iti kṛtvā'rpitānyeva yāvanti valkalāni hi ।। 12।।
dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tasthau maunaṃ tu bhūsuraḥ ।
taṃ dṛṣṭvā suvrataṃ vipraṃ cāntargataharimṛṣim ।।13।।
dayāluṃ śāntahṛdayaṃ parapāpanivārakam ।
vyādhasya mānasaṃ tatra krūratāṃ tu vihāya vai ।। 14।।
sāttvikaṃ dharmayuktaṃ ca vyāvartata kṣaṇāntare ।
vyādho vihāya cāpaṃ ca śarāṃśca vākyamabravīt ।। 15।।
hantumicchannahaṃ vipra! bhavantamiha cāgataḥ ।
idānīṃ darśanātte'tra hiṃsābuddhirgatā mama ।।16।।
brāhmaṇā bahavo nāryo mayā hatā hi pāpinā ।
kāṃ gatiṃ pratipatsyāmi brahmaghno'haṃ dvijottama ।। 17।।
idānīṃ taptumicchāmi tapo'haṃ tvatsamīpataḥ ।
upadeśādidānena prasādaṃ kartumarhasi ।। 18।।
evamukto'pyasau vipro nottaraṃ pratyapadyata ।
pāpinā tu sahā''lāpe pāpaṃ saṃkramate yataḥ ।।19।।
anukto'pi sa dharmecchrurvyādhastatraiva tasthivān ।
yathā viprastathā vyādhastapastepe taroradhaḥ ।।1.542.20।।
athaikadā nadītīre siṃhaḥ kaścit samāgataḥ ।
bubhukṣitaśca taṃ vipraṃ dṛṣṭvā khāditumīśvaram ।।21 ।।
vipraṃ yāvat taṭe siṃho jighṛkṣati ca tāvatā ।
vyādhena śaraghātaiśca śīghraṃ siṃho vināśitaḥ ।।22।।
ṛṣiḥ oṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
ityuktvā jalamagno'bhūjjalādho niṣasāda ca ।।23।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nāma śrutvā siṃho mamāra ca ।
bhūtvā niṣpāpakastasmād divyapumān samutthitaḥ ।।24।।
śrutamātre jahau prāṇān divyadeho'bhavattataḥ ।
uvāca yāmi taddeśaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।25।।
tvatprasādād dvijaśreṣṭha! vipāpmā mokṣabhāgaham ।
śrutvedaṃ ca jalā'ntaḥstho brāhmaṇo bahirāyayau ।।26।।
papraccha taṃ tadā siṃhapuruṣaṃ ko'si vai vada ।
siṃhapumān dvijaṃ prāha prāgāsaṃ vaidiko'pyaham ।।27।।
dīrghabāhuritikhyāto kriyākāṇḍaparāyaṇaḥ ।
sarvaṃ vedmi kratukāryaṃ nānyā'pekṣā ca me tataḥ ।।28।।
ahaṃ jānāmi vedāँśca vedmyahaṃ ca śubhāśubham ।
brāhmaṇairnaiva me kāryaṃ kiṃ vastu brāhmaṇā iti ।।29।।
mamaivaṃvādino viprāḥ sarve krodhasamanvitāḥ ।
ūcuḥ śāpaṃ durādharṣaṃ krūraḥ siṃho bhaviṣyasi ।।1.542.3 0।।
jñānaṃ te ca vinaṣṭaṃ syānmātyarthaṃ smaraṇaṃ tava ।
mṛtyukāle kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ nāma hi śroṣyasi ।।31 ।।
tadā muktirbhavitā te hyāruṇeḥ sannidhau paśo! ।
tvayā yadṛcchayā bhakṣyaṃ ṣaṣṭhakāle samāgatam ।।32।।
paśunṛpakṣijātīyaṃ yatte sthāsyati sannidhau ।
yadeṣughātaṃ labdhvā tu prāṇaiḥ kaṇṭhagatairbhavān ।।33।।
śroṣyati śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ brāhmaṇavaktrataḥ ।
tadā mokṣagatiste vai bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।34।।
paravaktragataṃ cāpi viṣṇornāma śrutaṃ mayā ।
kṛtadoṣo'pi vipro me mokṣadātā babhūva ha ।।35।।
yasya darśanamātreṇa pratyakṣo'bhavadacyutaḥ ।
yaḥ punaḥ svamukhenaiva gṛhṇāti śrīnarāyaṇam ।।36।।
prāṇaprayāṇasamaye mukto bhavati vai dhruvam ।
satyaṃ satyaṃ punaḥ satyamutkṣipya bhujamucyate ।।37।।
jaṃgamā brāhmaṇā devāstatrasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।
brāhmaṇasyā''ruṇeryogād gacchāmi śāśvataṃ padam ।।38।।
ityuktvā''ruṇimāpūjya yayau brahmākṣaraṃ padam ।
āruṇiśca tato vyādhaṃ samuvāca prasannahṛt ।।39।।
jighṛkṣormṛgarājasya yat tvayā rakṣito'smyaham ।
tat putra! tuṣṭaste dadmi varaṃ varaya suvrata ।।1.542.40।।
vyādhaḥ prāha varaścāyaṃ yastvaṃ māṃ bhāṣase sa hi ।
putratā tava santoṣaḥ kimasmādaparo varaḥ ।।41 ।।
ataḥ paraṃ vareṇā'haṃ kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā vyādha! prārthito'haṃ tapo'rthinā ।।।42।।
mayā kiñcittadā noktaṃ yataścāsīdaghī bhavān ।
idānīṃ tava pāpāni tapasā mama rakṣayā ।।43।।
tathā me darśanenāpi kṛṣṇanāmaśrutena ca ।
naṣṭāni śuddhadeho'si sāmprataṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।44।।
tapaḥ kuruṣva sādho tvaṃ mokṣamevamavāpsyasi ।
vyādhaḥ prāha bhavatoktaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।45।।
sa kathaṃ prāpyate pāparatervai mādṛśairguro ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha tamuddiśya sarvaṃ kuryāt samarpaṇam ।।46 ।।
saḥ paraṃ tamavāpnoti bhaktyā vratena karmaṇā ।
evaṃ jñātvā ca tadbhaktyā sarvaṃ vrataṃ samācara ।।47।।
na bhakṣayedanaivedyaṃ na vadedanṛtaṃ kvacit ।
japaṃ kuryāt sadā tasya dhyānaṃ kuryāddharestathā ।।48।।
etatte vratamādiṣṭaṃ mayā vyādha tathā kuru ।
atraiva tapasā yuktastiṣṭha tvaṃ yāvadicchasi ।।49।।
evamuktvā muniḥ punaḥ salilā'ntarviveśa ha ।
vyādho guruṃ smaraṃstepe tapastvāhāravarjitaḥ ।।1.542.50।।
kṣudhākāle śīrṇaparṇānyabhakṣayat kvacit kvacit ।
śanaiḥ śanaistyaktavāँśca parṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ tadā ।।51 ।।
nirāhārastapastepe smaran gurumatandritaḥ ।
evaṃ tapasyatastasya durvāsā abhyagānmuniḥ ।।52।।
dadarśa śuṣkadehaṃ ca saprāṇaṃ vyādhameva saḥ ।
tapastejo'nvitaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇe sthitaṃ hṛdā ।।53।।
jñātvā ṛṣiṃ sa ca vyādho natvā ca śirasā munim ।
uvāca taṃ kṛtārtho'smi bhagavan darśanāt tava ।।54।।
idānīṃ tvamatithirme prāpto'si daivataṃ mama ।
śīrṇaparṇādibhiḥ kṛtvā prīṇayāmi dvijottamam ।।55।।
durvāsā api taṃ śuddhabhāvapūtaṃ jitendriyam ।
jijñāsustattapaḥśraiṣṭhyamidamuccairuvāca ha ।।।56।।
yavagodhūmaśālīnāmannaṃ miṣṭaṃ susaṃskṛtam ।
dīyatāṃ me kṣudhārtāya tvāmuddiśyā''gatāya me ।।57।।
bhaktavyādho'yamityuktaścintāṃ paramikāṃ gataḥ ।
kasmādāneyametādṛk kathaṃ tat saṃbhaven mama ।।58।।
evaṃ cintayatastasya smarataśca narāyaṇam ।
gurośca kṛpayā vyomnaḥ pātraṃ saṃpatitaṃ śubham ।।59।।
sauvarṇaṃ siddhisaṃyuktaṃ tajjagrāha kareṇa saḥ ।
tad gṛhītvā muniṃ prāha pratīkṣasva kṣaṇam ṛṣe ।।1.542.60 ।।
atraiva sthīyatāṃ yāvadbhikṣāṭanaṃ karomi ca ।
tāvanmayi prasādaṃ tvaṃ guro vidhātumarhasi ।।61 ।।
evamuktvā sapātraḥ sa bhikṣāṃ yācitumeva ca ।
nātidūreṇa nagaraṃ vṛkṣavallyādiśobhitam ।।62।।
lakṣyīkṛtya prayāti sma mārgavṛkṣādivallayaḥ ।
tasya tatra prayātasya cāgrataḥ sarvaśobhanāḥ ।।63।।
vṛkṣebhyo niryayuḥ kanyā hemapātrāgrapāṇayaḥ ।
vanadevyaśca sundaryaḥ pakvānnāni śubhāni ca ।।64।।
vyañjanāni ca peyāni coṣyāṇi bhojyakāni ca ।
bhakṣyāṇi śubhalehyāni madhūni surasāṇi ca ।।65।।
dugdhāni ghṛtamiśrāṇi śarkarāpāyasāni ca ।
vyañjanāni vividhāni tiktamiṣṭāmblakāni ca ।।66।।
ṣaṭpañcāśadvidhānyeva dadustā vanadevatāḥ ।
sa ca kṛtārthamātmānaṃ matvā punarathāśramam ।।67।।
ājagāma ṛṣiṃ prāha bhikṣā prāptā yathepsitā ।
brahman kṣālaya pādau tvamupaviśyā''sane śubhe ।।68।।
imāṃ gṛhāṇa bhikṣāṃ ca kuru māṃ puṇyabhājanam ।
evamuktaḥ sa jijñāsustapo balaṃ punarmuniḥ ।।69।।
prāha bhaktaṃ ca taṃ vyādhaṃ nāsti pātraṃ jalasya me ।
nadīṃ gantuṃ na śaknomi pātraṃ te'pi na vidyate ।।1.542.70।।
kathaṃ prakṣālanaṃ vyādha! pādayorme bhavediti ।
ityukto vyādhabhaktaḥ saḥ punaścintāparo'bhavat ।।71 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā guruṃ tathā ।
smṛtvā jagāma śaraṇaṃ tāṃ tu nāganadīṃ tadā ।।72।।
uvāca praṇato bhūtvā sarit! tvaṃ śaraṇaṃ mama ।
vyādho'smi pāpakarmā'smi brahmahā'smi saridvare! ।।73।।
tathāpi māṃ bhaktamatra pāhi te śaraṇāgatam ।
devatāṃ naiva jānāmi na mantraṃ na tathā'rcanam ।।74।।
āruṇerme guroḥ pādau dhyātvā paśyāmi vai śubham ।
evaṃ bhaktasya me devi! kṛpāṃ kuru saridvare! ।।75।।
ṛṣerāsannatāṃ yāhi pādaśaucārthamāpage! ।
evamuktvā nāganadī jalapravāharūpataḥ ।।76।।
ājagāma yatastasthau durvāsā vṛkṣamāśritaḥ ।
tad dṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ durvāsā vismayaṃ yayau ।।77।।
prakṣālya hastapādau ca bhikṣānnaṃ śraddhayā ṛṣiḥ ।
vubhuje paramaprītastathā''camya hasanmuhuḥ ।।78।।
taṃ vyādhaṃ śuṣkadehaṃ ca kṣudhā durbalatāṃ gatam ।
varaṃ dadau te vedā vai sāṃgā sārthapadakramāḥ ।।79।।
brahmavidyāstathā sarvāḥ pratyakṣā vai bhavantu hi ।
tvaṃ ca nāmnā satyatapā ṛṣiragryo bhaviṣyasi ।।1.542.80।।
vyādhaḥ prāha kathaṃ śūdro vedādhyayanavānaham ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha śarīraṃ te gataṃ pāpamayaṃ dhruvam ।।81।।
tapomayaṃ śarīraṃ te dvitīyaṃ vartate'dhunā ।
prāgajñānaṃ gataṃ nāśamidānīṃ jñānamāgatam ।।82।।
evaṃ tvaṃ śuddhakāyo'si satyametad bravīmi te ।
dīkṣayā tapasā bhaktyā deho vai parivartate ।।83।।
tena vedādhyayanādi pratibhāsyati te'dhunā ।
prāgavasthamadharmākhyaṃ parijñānavivarjitam ।।84।।
gataṃ te vyādhaśarīraṃ, paraṃ dharmavratādimat ।
idānīṃ vai samāpannaṃ bhaktipūtaṃ dvitīyakam ।।85।।
yastu bhāvaḥ purā hyāsīt prāṇino nighnatastava ।
tatpāpākhyaṃ śarīraṃ te pāpasaṃjñaṃ gataṃ khalu ।।86।।
idānīṃ śubhasadvṛtti tapāarjavabhaktimat ।
dvitīyāṃ dharmarūpaṃ tu śarīraṃ te vyavasthitam ।।87।।
vyādhaḥ prāha ṛṣiṃ nārāyaṇo vai sādhanaṃ vinā ।
kathamārādhanīyaścā'parigraheṇa yoginā ।।88।।
durvāsāḥ prāha manasā pūjanaṃ sarvathā''caret ।
na dhanaṃ vā kulaṃ tatra sampadvā samapekṣyate ।।89।।
bhāvena bhagavān nityaṃ tuṣyatyeva janārdanaḥ ।
snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ nityaṃ mānasairupacārakaiḥ ।।1.542.90।।
pūjayed bhāvayennīrājayet kṣamāpayettathā ।
puṣpāṃjaliṃ jalamarghaṃ dadyād dadyācca mānasam ।।91 ।।
ātmārpaṇaṃ prakuryācca tena tuṣyejjanārdanaḥ ।
sadhanainirdhanaiścāpi prāpyate parameśvaraḥ ।।92।।
api koṭiśreṣṭhadānairbhaktihīnairna tuṣyati ।
sabhaktestu patramātradānenā'pi pratuṣyati ।।93।।
jalena candanenāpi puṣpamātreṇa tuṣyati ।
tritasya khalu bhāvena kardamenāpi cārcitāḥ ।।94।।
jalena vai surāḥ sarve santuṣṭā hi nidarśanam ।
prahlādasya japenaiva tuṣṭaḥ śrībhagavān hariḥ ।।95।।
gopīnāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastuṣṭo hṛdarpaṇāt ।
lakṣmyā dāsyena santuṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।96।।
pārvatyāśca tvaparṇāyāḥ santuṣṭaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
ambarīṣasya bhagavāṃstuṣṭo bhāvena pūjayā ।।97।।
evaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'kṣarādhipaḥ prabhuḥ ।
bhāvabhaktyā prasannaḥ syānna vinā bhāvamacyutaḥ ।।98।।
devatā guravaḥ santaḥ pitaro dharma īśvaraḥ ।
mokṣaḥ phalaṃ sadityetacchraddhāgamyaṃ hi bhāvitam ।।99।।
bhaktiḥ sevā vyavahāraścopārjanaṃ ca melanam ।
arthaḥ siddhiḥ sukhaṃ caitat kriyāsādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam ।। 1.542.1 00।।
mantro vidyā ca kalaho gāyanaṃ japa āhvanam ।
upadeśo'rthavādaśca vāṇīsādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam ।। 101 ।।
gṛhāṇi ca striyo ramyāḥ putrāścājñākarāḥ kṣitiḥ ।
yaśo mānaṃ patiḥ pārśvāḥ puṇyasādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam ।। 1 02।।
śāntistṛptirvirāgaśca śreyaḥ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।
nivṛttiścopakāraśca jñānasādhyaṃ tadaṣṭakam ।। 1 03।।
pṛthvī prāha purā devo vārāho jalamagnikān ।
jalaplutāṃ mahīṃ dadyānnārāyaṇāya bhāvataḥ ।। 1 04।।
tathāpyahaṃ prasannaḥ syāṃ pṛthvyāṃ raso'smi vai yataḥ ।
tvayā devi smṛtaścāhaṃ jalena pūjitastathā ।। 1 05।।
tvadrakṣārthaṃ samāyāto vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ ।
evaṃ me bhāvayuktena manasā śaraṇaṃ vrajet ।। 1 06।।
tasyā'haṃ sarvathā tuṣṭo mokṣaṃ dadāmi tadvaśaḥ ।
dvādaśyāṃ ca prage pūjāṃ yaḥ karoti tu bhāvataḥ ।। 1 07।।
tasyā'haṃ brahmalokaṃ ca dadāmi śāśvataṃ kṣite! ।
ityuktvā pṛthivīṃ kroḍa uddadhāra jalopari ।। 1 08।।
ityevaṃ pārvatīṃ lakṣmi! śaṃbhuḥ prāha prabhāsake ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya brahmalokaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1 09।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āruṇeḥ sannidhau siṃhasya muktiḥ, vyādhakṛtā viprarakṣā tapaścaryā ca, vaidikasya dīrghabāhorviprāṇāmavamānāt siṃho bhaveti śāpaḥ, tapasyato vyādhasya prārthanayā''ruṇeḥ pādaprakṣālitavatī nāgamatī nadī, vyādhasya pāvitryaṃ
satyatapānāmaṛṣitvaṃ, durvāsasā kṛtajñānopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvācatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 542 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 542 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 543
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 544 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi! prabhāse vai pārvatī śaṃkaraṃ varam ।
saṃpapraccha tithisvāminaśca vadāmi te yathā ।। 1 ।।
yathā sṛṣṭeḥ samāraṃbhe brahmā yasmai dadau tithim ।
tatte lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi tithīnāṃ devatādikam ।। 2 ।।
brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ vidhātuṃ ca mano dadhe tu puṣkare ।
yadā kiñcinnādhyagacchat tadā roṣo'sya cā'bhavat ।। 3 ।।
lalāṭād roṣarūpo vai gharmabindustadā'kṣarat ।
vahnijātiḥ sa patitaḥ kṣudhito bhojyamārthayat ।। 4 ।।
brahmaṇā ca kratau havyaṃ jāṭhare bhuktamityapi ।
pṛthvyādau khanijaṃ khādyaṃ tredhā bhojyaṃ purā'rpitam ।। 5 ।।
havanīyo jāṭharaścākarajaśceti vai tridhā ।
ādyaṃ pratipaddivase vyabhajad viśvarūṭ ca tam ।। 6 ।।
sā tithiḥ prathamā tasmai cārpitā pūjanādikam ।
vahneḥ pratipadi brāhme muhūrte kāryameva tat ।। 7 ।।
atha sūryasya vai patnī saṃjñā tejo'sahā satī ।
aśvinīrūpamāsthāya yayau haimottaraṃ purā ।। 8 ।।
sūryastvaśvasvarūpeṇa lebhe saṃgaṃ tayā saha ।
aśvinībālakau jātau prāṇāpānau bhiṣagvarau ।। 9 ।।
dvitīyāyāṃ ca tajjātau sā tābhyāṃ brahmaṇā purā ।
pūjanādau tithirdattā rogavyādhivināśinī ।। 1.543.10 ।।
atha vāṇīṃ samutpādya brahmā gaurīsvarūpiṇīm ।
tṛtīyāyāṃ śaṃkarāya dadau vivāhakarmaṇā ।। 11 ।।
sā gauryai vai tithirdattā saubhāgyādivivardhinī ।
atha gauryā gaṇeśastanmātrātmakaḥ suto'bhavat ।। 1 2।।
śrīkṛṣṇastu svayaṃ prātaścaturthyāṃ gaṇanāyakaḥ ।
jātastasya pūjanārthaṃ tasmai caturthikā'rpitā ।। 1 3।।
atha kadrvāḥ sutānāṃ tu nāgānāṃ garuḍena vai ।
bhakṣaṇārthaṃ vare prāpte brahmāto nijarakṣaṇam ।। 14।।
nāgāśca prārthayāmāsurbrahmā tadrakṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
pūjanaṃ pañcamīdaine dadau sā nāgapañcamī ।। 15।।
tatra dugdhatilaistṛptā daṃśanti naiva mānavān ।
atha vai kārtikasvāmī ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jātaḥ satīgṛhe ।। 16।।
ahaṃkārātmakastasmai ṣaṣṭhī tithiḥ samarpitā ।
atha netraṃ samutpādyā'dityākhyaṃ prathame yuge ।। 17।।
tejo'rpaṇaṃ vidhāyaiva lokatejaḥpralabdhaye ।
vyomni taṃ sthāpayāmāsa saptamyāṃ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ 18।।
saptamī sā tithistasmai pradattā parameṣṭhinā ।
athā'ndhakākhyadaityasya nāśanārthaṃ suraiḥ purā ।।1 9।।
devyastvaṣṭau nirmitā vai mātaro yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।
śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandho'tha kāmanā ।।1.543.20 ।।
ahaṃkṛtistathā bhrāntiramūrtā mūrtayo'bhavat ।
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho moho madaśca matsaraḥ ।।21।।
paiśunyaṃ cā'nasūyā ca mūrtayastvabhavan purā ।
kāmaṃ yogeśvarīṃ viddhi krodhaṃ māheśvarīṃ tathā ।।22।।
lobhaṃ tu vaiṣṇavīṃ viddhi brahmāṇīṃ madameva ca ।
mohaṃ svāyaṃbhavīṃ viddhi kaumārīṃ matsarodbhavām ।।23 ।।
paiśunyaṃ yamadaṇḍīṃ cā'pyasūyāṃ viddhi mātṛkāḥ ।
etā raktapraśoṣiṇyo bhavanti dehagehajāḥ ।।24।।
andhakasya śoṣitaṃ ca rudhiraṃ sarvameva yat ।
tena raktodbhavāścānye koṭiśo'pyandhakāstadā ।।25।।
naṣṭā eva hi tābhyaśca dattā'ṣṭamī tu vedhasā ।
tatra pūjyāśca tā rakṣāṃ kurvantyanudinaṃ śubhāḥ ।।26।।
atha tvāṣṭrasya vetrasya vināśārthaṃ tu vedhasā ।
śarīramāyā durgā ca svāccharīrāt prakāśitā ।।27।।
sāyudhā mānasī kanyā sā ca durgā'ṣṭasadbhajā ।
siṃhāsthitā jaghāne yaṃ vetrāsuraṃ tataśca sā ।।28।।
himālaye sthitā tasyāḥ prākaṭyaṃ navamītithau ।
brahmā tasyai navamīṃ ca dadau pūjādihetave ।।29।।
atha sarvāṇi tattvāni purā vai vedhasaṃ prati ।
prārthayāmāsuratyarthamāśrayaṃ nijamadbhutam ।। 1.543.3 0।।
tadā tu brahmaṇā karṇadeśād daśa ca kanyakāḥ ।
utpāditā diśastāstu pūrvā ca dakṣiṇā tathā ।।3 1 ।।
paścimā cottarā cordhvā hyadhogā mukhyataśca ṣaṭ ।
īśā hyagnirnairṛtiśca vāyavī ceti tā daśa ।।32।।
tābhyaḥ kāryasvarūpābhyo'vakāśaṃ karma saṃdadau ।
avakāśasvarūpābhyaḥ patayaśca samarpitāḥ ।।33।।
pūrvāmindrāya dakṣāṃ ca yamāya kuberāya tu ।
uttarāṃ paścimāṃ varuṇāyordhvāṃ brahmaṇe svayam ।।34।।
adhogāṃ phaṇine caiśāṃ ceśāyāgniṃ tu vahnaye ।
nirṛti nirṛtaye ca vāyavīṃ vāyave tathā ।।35।।
dadau brahmā ca daśamīṃ tithiṃ tābhyo'rcanāya ca ।
athaikādaśikāyāṃ ca kuberamasṛjat prabhuḥ ।।36।।
dhanaṃ jayākhyādvāyostu tasmai tāṃ ca tithiṃ dadau ।
nārāyaṇasya tejobhiḥ kanyā tvekā hyajāyata ।।37।।
ekādaśendriyāṇāṃ sā vrataṃ tvekādaśī matam ।
dvādaśyāṃ ca samutpannaḥ parānnārāyaṇāt khalu ।।38।।
padmanābho manorūpo mūrto viṣṇuḥ prapoṣakaḥ ।
tasmai dadau harikṛṣṇo dvādaśīṃ mokṣadāyinīm ।।39।।
atha vai brahmaṇo vakṣaḥsthalād dharmo hyajāyata ।
yugāraṃbhe catuṣpāt sa śvetavarṇo'bhavat khalu ।।1.543.40 ।।
dravyaguṇakriyājāticatuṣpadyuk prakīrtitaḥ ।
triśṛṃgaśca smṛto vede sasaṃhitapadakramaḥ ।।41 ।।
tathā ādyanta oṃkāradviśirāḥ saptahastavān ।
dānaṃ dayā damo dharmo'rthaḥ kāmo mokṣa ityamī ।।42।।
hastā atha udāttāditribhirbaddho vyavasthitaḥ ।
kṛto vai brāhmaṇastatra catuṣpāt ṣaṭkriyātmakaḥ ।।43।।
tretā ca kṣatriyastatra tripādo gauṇa eva saḥ ।
dvāparo vaiśya evātra dvipādaśca pragauṇakaḥ ।।44।।
kaliḥ śūdrastatra caikāṃśena dharmo vyavasthitaḥ ।
sa dharmaḥ pīḍitaḥ sṛṣṭerādau kṣattreṇa pādataḥ ।।45।।
candreṇā'pahṛtā tārā guroḥ patnī pativratā ।
dharmastena mahāghorāraṇyaṃ saṃpraviveśa ha ।।46 ।।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu dharmo vai līnatāṃ gataḥ ।
asurāśca surāścāpi hyadharmeṇā''vṛtāstadā ।।47।।
jighṛkṣantaḥ paraukāṃsi parastrīdhanasampadaḥ ।
babhramuḥ parasaudheṣu nirmaryādāstadā'bhavan ।।48।।
yuyudhurapajahruśca parakīyaṃ parasparam ।
brahmā vināśamālakṣya dharmaṃ prāha sanātanam ।।49।।
tvāṃ vinā tu jagatsarvaṃ vināśaṃ prasameṣyati ।
candrastyajatu vai tārāṃ dharmastiṣṭhatu sarvathā ।।1.543.50 ।।
tvayaiva pālyate pṛthvī trailokyaṃ ca tvayaiva hi ।
janastapastathā satyaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ tu pālyate ।।51 ।।
na tvayā rahitaṃ kiñcijjagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ।
vidyate tvadvihīnaṃ cet sadyo naśyet tato jagat ।।52।।
tvamātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ satāṃ sattvasvarūpavān ।
rājasīnāṃ rajastvaṃ ca tāmasīnāṃ tamomayaḥ ।।53।।
tvayā hīnā ime devāḥ sarve tūnmārgavartinaḥ ।
unmārgaṃ yaccha mūḍhānāṃ tvaṃ putra paramā gatiḥ ।।54।।
evaṃ stuto vṛṣaḥ śāntacakṣurbhyāṃ devatādikān ।
apaśyad dṛṣṭamātrāste babhūvurdharmamānasāḥ ।।55।।
kṣaṇena gatasammohā asurā api dhārmikāḥ ।
samabhavan dharmayuktāḥ sarve ca ṛtavastathā ।।56 ।।
vṛkṣā vallyo narā nāryaścetanāni jaḍāni ca ।
sarve svadharmayuktāśca śītoṣṇādyāstathā'bhavan ।।57।।
evaṃ dharmāya ca dattā tithistasya trayodaśī ।
dharmo yatrā'bhavadgupto dharmāraṇyaṃ hi tatsmṛtam ।।58।।
brahmādharmaṃ samādiśya sṛṣṭeragryaṃ padaṃ tataḥ ।
yayau vai satyalokaṃ ca jagat svasthamabhūttathā ।।59।।
tato mūrtasvarūpeṇa yamarājo'bhavaddhi saḥ ।
atha rudro brahmaṇastu lalāṭātsamajāyata ।।1.543.60।।
caturdaśyāṃ tithau tasmai yajñabhāgo'pi cārpitaḥ ।
dakṣayajñe haradvāre ṛṣibhirmunibhistathā ।।61।।
sā tithiḥ śivarātryākhyā rudrāya sarvathā'rpitā ।
dharmasya śvaśuro dakṣo, dakṣakanyāśataṃ tvabhūt ।।62।।
tāśca sṛṣṭeḥ suvṛddhyarthaṃ surebhyaḥ pradadau pṛthak ।
satīṃ dadau śaṃkarāya daśa dharmāya vai dadau ।।63।।
śraddhā medhā dhṛtirmūrtiḥ kṣamā lajjā śuciḥ smṛtiḥ ।
śaktiḥ śrutistadetāsu mūrternārāyaṇo'bhavat ।।64।।
hariḥ kṛṣṇo naraśceti catvāro mūrtibhaktijāḥ ।
dve bhārye kāmadevāya ratiḥ prītistathaiva ca ।।65।।
ekāṃ svāhāṃ dadau vahneḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhāṃ tataḥ ।
saptaviṃśatikanyāstu nakṣatrāṇi niśāpateḥ ।।66।।
aśvinī bharaṇī cāpi kṛttikā mṛgaśirṣikā ।
ārdrā punarvasuḥ puṣyā cāśleṣā ca maghā tathā ।।67।।
pūrvāphālgunikā cordhvaphālgunī hastinī tathā ।
citrā svātirviśākhā'nurādhā jyeṣṭhā ca mūlikā ।।68।।
pūrvāṣāḍhottarāṣāḍhā śravaṇā ca dhaniṣṭhikā ।
śatabhīṣā pūrvabhādrapadordhvabhādrikastathā ।।69।।।
revatī ceti candrasya patnyo'bhavaँśca rohiṇī ।
kaśyapāya dadau dakṣaḥ śubhāḥ kanyāstrayodaśa ।।1.543.70।।
aditiśca ditiścāpi danuḥ kāṣṭhā irāvatī ।
vinatā cāpi kadrūśca siṃhikā suprabhā tathā ।।71 ।।
īrṣyā māyā tathā hiṃsā nirṛtiśceti tāḥ khalu ।
varuṇāyā'rpitāḥ pañca gauḍī vastrā ca vārtikā ।।72।।
sādhvī sumālikā ceti varuṇānyastu tāḥ smṛtāḥ ।
kuberāya dadau pañca bhadrā ca madirā tataḥ ।।73।।
vidyā dhanyā dhanā ceti kuberāṇyaśca tā iti ।
rudrāya daśa kanyāstā jayā ca vijayā tathā ।।74।।
irāvatī madhucchandā supriyā janakā tathā ।
kāntā subhadrā dharmālī śubhā ca rudrayoṣitaḥ ।।75।।
ādityebhyo dadau dakṣo dvādaśa kanyakāśca tāḥ ।
prabhāvatī subhadrā ca vimalā nirmalā vṛtā ।।76।।
tīvrā dakṣā hmaruṇā ca vidyā ca dvārapālinī ।
varvasā ca prabhā ceti sūryasya yoṣitaśca tāḥ ।।77।।
viśvadevebhyaśca dakṣo dadāvaṣṭau hi kanyakāḥ ।
yoganidrā vibhūtiśca śiṃśapā śaramā guhā ।।78।।
mālā vaṃśā tathā jyotsnā tā viśvadevayoṣitaḥ ।
aśvinyāśca sutābhyāṃ dve suveṣā bhūṣaṇā tathā ।।79।।
ekā śvāsā vāyave ca sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇe tathā ।
lakṣmīṃ ca viṣṇave dakṣo dadau tāḥ śatakanyakāḥ ।।1.543.80।।
sṛṣṭerādau yuge caivaṃ kanyādānaṃ babhūva ha ।
tena kanyāpradānasya rītiḥ sarveṣu cāgatā ।।81 ।।
tābhyaḥ prapūritaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvarajaṃgamam ।
atha vai pitaraḥ sarve brahmaṇaścānanāt purā ।।82।।
dhūmrarūpāḥ samutpannā ūrdhvānanāstathordhvagāḥ ।
amāvāsyā ca pitṛbhyo'rpitā vai prathame yuge ।।83।।
candramase pūrṇimā ca kalānāṃ nidhaye'rpitā ।
brahmaṇo manase jāya śītadevāya vedhasā ।।84।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tithīnāmarpaṇaṃ tava ।
dīpotsavī tathā te'tra dhanatrayodaśī śubhā ।।85।।
lakṣmi! samarpitā tubhyaṃ śāradāyaiva sarvathā ।
mūlanakṣatrayogaśca śravaṇasya tathā punaḥ ।।86।।
sarasvatyai pūjanārthaṃ cārpito hariṇā mayā ।
evaṃ vividhavārāśca tattadutpattināmataḥ ।।87।।
saptadevebhya evādau yuge samarpitā mayā ।
tatra teṣāṃ pūjanena tadīyaṃ sarvathā balam ।।88।।
dhanaṃ saukhyaṃ samaiśvaryaṃ dadatyeva hi devatāḥ ।
vighnānāṃ śamanaṃ tadvad dāridryasya vināśanam ।।89।।
ādhivyādhivināśādi jāyate devapūjanāt ।
evaṃ lakṣmi! sadā deve pratimāyāṃ tithau tithau ।।1.543.90।।
nivasāmi svayaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ ।
bhāvena suprasanno'smi bhaktyā dāsyena sarvathā ।। 91 ।।
karomi śreya eteṣāṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya phalaṃ bhavati śāśvatam ।।92।।
tattattithisurāṇāṃ tvarcanajaṃ ca phalaṃ bhavet ।
evaṃ prāha svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ śivarātryāṃ prabhāsake ।।93।।
pārvatyai tanmayā lakṣmi! tubhyaṃ sarvaṃ niveditam ।
viśeṣeṇeṣṭa devaṃ tu dhyāyedvai devatāsvapi ।।94।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pañcadaśatithīnāṃ tattaddevānāṃ ca sahetukavarṇananāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।543 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 543 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 544
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 545 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu tīrthāni cānyāni śaṃkaroktāni padmaje ।
nyaṃkumatī devikā ca nadīdvayaṃ tu mokṣadam ।। 1 ।।
purā saṃvarttarṣiputrāḥ pañcāśanmṛgaveṣiṇaḥ ।
mṛgacarmaparīdhānāḥ siṃhāraṇye nyuṣuḥ sadā ।। 2 ।।
tāpasā rāgahīnāśca tapo'rthaṃ pitṛnoditāḥ ।
puṇye prabhāsake kṣetre tṛṇapatrādibhojinaḥ ।। 3 ।।
brahmacaryaparā nityaṃ triḥsnānādividhāyinaḥ ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।। 4 ।।
japanta iti govindaṃ vṛkṣo'dhovāsino'bhavan ।
athaikadā vīradhanvā rājā prabhāsamāyayau ।। 5 ।।
vane dṛṣṭvā mṛgān tāँśca vivyādha sāyakairyadā ।
brāhmaṇāste mṛtā hatyā rājño jātā hi duḥkhadāḥ ।। 6 ।।
rājā cintāturo yāto devarātāśramaṃ tadā ।
vijñāpya brahmahatyāśca rurodā'tīva duḥkhitaḥ ।। 7 ।।
sa ṛṣirdevarātastu dayāluḥ prāha bhūbhṛtam ।
mā rodihi gaccha pārśve vartate devikānadī ।। 8 ।।
tapaḥ kuru taṭe tasyā ārabhasva makhaṃ tataḥ ।
prāyaścittāni kṛtyaiva śuddho rājan bhaviṣyasi ।। 9 ।।
ityāśrutya ca taṃ natvā yayau tāṃ devikāṃ nadīm ।
devarātaṃ saha nītvā viṣṇuyāgaṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 1.544.1 0।।
sahasraśo brāhmaṇāṃśca bhojayāmāsa sādaram ।
pūjayāmāsa devāṃśca tarpayāmāsa pitṝkān ।। 11 ।।
toṣayāmāsa miṣṭānnairdānaiśca bhikṣukāँstataḥ ।
yajñasya parihāre'tra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1 2।।
lomaśaśca munistatra mṛgau bhūtvā prajagmatuḥ ।
maṇḍapavedikāṃ gatvā nirbhayau dhṛtadhūmrakān ।। 1 3।।
ghrāṇena ca muhustatrā''karṣayāmāsaturhyubhau ।
rājā devau tu tau matvā nanāmotthāya pādayoḥ ।। 14।।
tāvat kṣuvadbhyāṃ tābhyāṃ ca nāsikāmalato nṛpaḥ ।
śleṣmāvṛtaḥ kṛtastatra nairmalyamāptavānnṛpaḥ ।। 15।।
rājño dehāttadā kanyāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇā hi sarvaśaḥ ।
vinirjagmustadā kuṇḍe nipetustāḥ prajajvaluḥ ।। 16।।
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ tvetajjātaḥ kolāhalāstadā ।
mṛgau tau nararūpau ca mānuṣau saṃbabhūvatuḥ ।। 17।।
divyadeho lomaśaśca kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'pi ca ।
ūcatustaṃ nṛpaṃ rājan! yajñena toṣitau tvayā ।। 18।।
dṛṣṭāvatra kṛpayā nau brahmahatyāḥ pradāhitāḥ ।
śuddho'si devikākṣetre mama bhaktyā gurūktitaḥ ।। 19।।
yāhi rājyaṃ kuru maivaṃ punarhiṃsāmanarthikām ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprākaṭyakālikam ।।1.544.20।।
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrūpaṃ vrataṃ kuru bhajasva mām ।
evaṃ kṛtvā mokṣamārgaṃ yāsyasyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।21 ।।
kṛtaṃ tena yathoktena jayantīkālikaṃ vratam ।
nārāyaṇaḥ prasannaḥ sannāyātaśca punaḥ punaḥ ।।22।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrādvimānena vihāyasā ।
mṛtyukāle'gamat svargamindralokaṃ sa pārthivaḥ ।।23।।
tasyendrastvarghamādāya pratyutthānena cāyayau ।
vimānasthāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasyaiva tu pārṣadāḥ ।।24।।
utthānaṃ ca prakurvantaṃ rājānaṃ prāhurīśvarāḥ ।
pratyutthānaṃ tvayā rājan naiva kartavyamatra yat ।।25।।
devāstvatto hīnapuṇyā bhavān puṇyena vardhate ।
bahupuṇyayutaḥ svalpapuṇyavantaṃ prati prabhuḥ ।।26।।
pratyutthānaṃ prakaroti svalpapuṇyavatastadā ।
svalpaṃ puṇyaṃ vinaśyettu tasmānmotthānamācara ।।27।।
evaṃ ye ye diśāṃ pālāḥ satkārārthaṃ samāgatāḥ ।
te te svalpavṛṣāścainaṃ rājānaṃ paripūjya ca ।।28।।।
yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketaṃ ca rājā notthita eva hi ।
evaṃ sa satyalokāntaṃ gato rājā vimokṣaṇam ।।29।।
apunarmārake loke dāhapralayavarjite ।
adyāpi tiṣṭhate devaiḥ stūyamāno jalopari ।।1.544.30।।
dvitīyarūpe vaikuṇṭhe śāśvataṃ sukhamāptavān ।
prasanne yajñapuruṣe durlabhaṃ kinnu cottamam ।।।3 1।।
iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurārogyasampadaḥ ।
dadātyeva ramānāthaḥ parāṃ muktiṃ ca durlabhām ।।32।।।
evaṃ muktiṃ gato rājā devikāyāstaṭe śubhe ।
devarātakṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ yajñanārāyaṇātmakam ।। 33।।
mṛgatīrthaṃ tathā tatra devikāyāṃ hi vartate ।
snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ smṛtvā'vaśyaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।34।।
śivastu pārvatīṃ prāha nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe purā ।
cyavanaśca ṛṣiḥ patnīsahitastīrthavāñcchayā ।।34।।
padbhyāṃ samāgato nyaṃkumatyā sthito hi vatsaram ।
vatsaraṃ somanāthe ca vatsaraṃ lomaśāśrame ।।36।।
vatsaraṃ raivatādrau caṃ vatsaraṃ tvarbudācale ।
evaṃ kṛtvā sutīrthāni yayau badarikāśramam ।।37।।
śrīpārvatī tadā'pṛcchat kā tadbhāryā'bhavat satī ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha śṛṇu sādhvi! cyavanasyā'pi satkathām ।।38।।
pūrvataṭe hiraṇyāyāḥ kadācittapasi sthitaḥ ।
sūryastotraṃ cakārā'sāvaṣṭottaraśatātmakam ।।39।।
sūryastadā prasannaḥ san samāyātastu sannidhau ।
uvāca tamṛṣiṃ brūhi varaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi te ।।1.544.40।।
cyavanaḥ prāha lokānāṃ cakṣustvaṃ parameśvara ।
aṣṭottaraśatarūpairaṣṭottaraśatasthale ।।41।।
mūrtimān vasa saurāṣṭre mandireṣu mahatsu ca ।
hiraṇyasiṃho rājā te kariṣyatyālayān śubhān ।।42।।
lokarakṣārthamevātra saurāṣṭre sarvato vasa ।
tathāstviti raviḥ prāha kṛtvā'ṣṭottaraśātakam ।।43।।
rūpāṇāṃ ca ravistasthau saurāṣṭre vai yathāruci ।
tāni nāmāni te devi! kathayāmi yathāyatham ।।44।।
'oṃ sūryo'ryamā bhagastvaṣṭā pūṣā'rkaḥ savitā raviḥ ।
gabhastimānajā''dityo dhātā''dityaḥ prabhākaraḥ ।।45।।
kṣityādityo vanādityaḥ prabhādityaḥ khakheśvaraḥ ।
prāṇādityaśca somārko gurvādityo divākaraḥ ।।।46।।
śukrārko'ṅgārakāditya indrārko bodhabhāskaraḥ ।
dīpāṃśuśca vivasvāँśca śucyarkaścarabhāskaraḥ ।।47।।
brahmādityaśca raudrārko viṣṇuḥ skandārka ityapi ।
śravaṇārko yamārkaśca vaidyutārko divaspatiḥ ।।48।।
vaiśvānarārkaścāgnyarkaścendhanāditya īśvaraḥ ।
dharmādityaśca vedārko vācārkaḥ kṛtabhāpatiḥ ।।49।।
tretādityo dvāparārkasturyādityaḥ kalīśvaraḥ ।
kalādityaśca kāṣṭhārko muhūrtāditya ityapi ।।1.544.50।।
cakrādityo vatsarārkastigmaraśmirvibhāvasuḥ ।
puruṣārko hiraṇyārko yogādityaḥ sadīśvaraḥ ।।51 ।।
lokādityaḥ prajādityo viśvādityastamonudaḥ ।
vāruṇārkaḥ sāgarārko jīmūtārkaḥ pratāpanaḥ ।।52।।
bhūtārko nirmalārkaśca lolārkastigmadīdhitiḥ ।
kuṣṭhahāditya īśārko bhānuḥ kāmārka ityapi ।।।53।।
jayādityaśca bhadrārko raivatādityakāntimān ।
saṃjñeśaśca suvarṇārkaḥ śatruṃjidarka ādidṛk ।।54।।
kapilāṃśuścāṃśumālin kaṃkādityaśca bhāspatiḥ ।
vanādityaśca saptāśvaścāruṇārkastriviṣṭapaḥ ।।55।।
nārāyaṇo haritāśvaḥ sandhyeśo bhagavān prabhaḥ ।
grahādityaścā'mareśaḥ kaṃthaḍeśaḥ karādhipaḥ ।।56।।
vedādityaḥ surāṣṭrarko nṛpādityaḥ satīśvaraḥ ।
dyumaṇiḥ savitā dhātā vidhātārketi te namaḥ' ।।57।।
ityevaṃ khalu saurāṣṭre pṛthak pṛthagvasanti hi ।
sūryā lokaprarakṣārthaṃ tattīrthaṃ lokapāvanam ।।58।।
hiraṇyāyāstaṭe ramyaṃ vidyate kṣatrapūjitam ।
sūryodaye paṭhed yastu sa putraratnasaṃcayān ।।59।।
jātismṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ cārogyaṃ svargaṃ ca vindati ।
hiraṇyaṃ ca gajān rājyaṃ rāmāśca divyasampadaḥ ।।1.544.60।।
evaṃ cyavanasāmarthyāt sūryanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
aṣṭottaraśatadhā san samuvāsa surāṣṭrake ।।61 ।।
cyavanāśrama evāpi hiraṇyāyāstaṭe śubhe ।
tīrthaṃ vai vidyate tatra lokakalyāṇakārakam ।।62।।
cyavanasya satī bhāryā śaryāterduhitā'bhavat ।
kadācittu gate kāle tapastepe ṛṣirvane ।।63।।
bhagoḥ putraścyavanaḥ sa pṛthvyāṃ dīrghaṃ sthiro'bhavat ।
kālena mahatā devi! samākīrṇaḥ pipīlakaiḥ ।।64।।
sarvato mṛttikāpiṇḍairabhivyāpto latādibhiḥ ।
valmīkena samāchannastapasyeva vyavasthitaḥ ।।65।।
atha kasyāpi kālasya śaryātirnāma bhūpatiḥ ।
vane samājagāmā'sau yatra ṛṣeḥ śubhāśramaḥ ।।66।।
rājñaḥ kanyā sukanyākhyā sakhībhiḥ parivāritā ।
caṃkramyamāṇā valmīkaṃ cyavanasya samāsadat ।।67।।
supuṣpāṇi vicinvantī valmīke ṛṣicakṣuṣī ।
dṛṣṭvā kiṃ nviti sāścaryā kaṇḍakena bibheda sā ।।68।।
raktaṃ netravivarābhyāṃ niryātaṃ sā bhayaṃ gatā ।
ṛṣeḥ kopena śaryāteḥ sainyasya nṛpatestathā ।।69।।
samāruddhe śakṛnmūtre paryatapyata pārthivaḥ ।
kanyovāca pitaścātrā'parāddho vai ṛṣirmayā ।।1.544.70।।
rājā ṛṣiṃ samavadat kanyāṃ kṣantuṃ tvamarhasi ।
cyavanaḥ prāha me kanyāṃ dehi doṣaṃ kṣamāmi vai ।।71 ।।
rājā dadau tadā kanyāṃ ṛṣiśca prasasāda ha ।
sainyaṃ svasthaṃ samabhavat siṣeve kanyakā ṛṣim ।।72।।
ṛṣiṃ vṛddhaṃ devavaidyau samājagmaturīśvarau ।
sukanyāṃ tāvūcatuśca vṛddhayogyā na sundarī ।।73।।
sā tvaṃ cyavanamutsṛjya varayasvaikamāvayoḥ ।
kanyā prāha patirdevo vṛddho vā yadi vā kṛśaḥ ।।74।।
devavaidyau kurutaṃ me patiṃ yuvānamīśvaram ।
vaidyau tau kṛtavantau taṃ svasadṛśaṃ mahāmunim ।।75 ।।
rūpatrayaṃ samānaṃ vai jātaṃ yathā pṛthaṅ na vai ।
kanyā vicārayāmāsa ko'tra me'sti patiḥ khalu ।।76 ।।
pātivratyena vai cāntaḥsamadhinā svakaṃ patim ।
vijñāya taṃ kare gṛhya pādayoḥ patitā satī ।।77।।
vaidyāvaścaryamāpannau satyeyaṃ vai pativratā ।
tau vaidyau cyavanaṃ tatrāhaturyajñeṣu sarvathā ।।78।।
bhāgau syātāmāvayośca tathā tvaṃ kuru bhārgava ।
ṛṣiryajñe bhāgavantau kṛtavāँstau bhiṣagvarau ।।79।।
athaikadā tu śaryātiḥ kanyāyāḥ sukhamuttamam ।
draṣṭuṃ samāgatastatrāśrame kanyāṃ dadarśa saḥ ।।1.544.80।।
yuvānaṃ sevamānāṃ tāṃ papraccha kanyakāṃ nṛpaḥ ।
ko'yaṃ kanye! sevito'sti paraḥ kaścicca me bhramaḥ ।।81।।
kanyā prāha pitarme'sti patiḥ śrīcyavano muniḥ ।
aśvinīsutayogena yauvanaṃ svāminā'rjitam ।।82।।
rājā śrutvā prasanno'bhūt ṛṣiṃ prāha karomi te ।
sevāṃ vada ṛṣe cātra ṛṣiḥ prāha makhaṃ kuru ।।83।।
tataḥ paramasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātistu kratoḥ kṛte ।
kārayāmāsa saṃbhārān yājayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ ।।84।।
suravaidyau bhāgavantau cyavanena kṛtau tadā ।
indrastaṃ vārayāmāsa naitau bhāgārhaṇau yataḥ ।।85।।
bhiṣajau karmaṇā caitau janmanā cāpi garhitau ।
ṛṣirindramanādṛtya dadau bhāgau bhiṣagdvaye ।।86।।
indro vajram ṛṣiṃ hantuṃ jagrāhordhvakaro'bhavat ।
ṛṣistaṃ staṃbhayāmāsa mahendraḥ śaraṇe'patat ।।87।।
bhāgaṃ tayordadau paścāt staṃbhanaṃ praśaśāma ha ।
evaṃ pratāpavān vipro hiraṇyāyāstaṭe śubhe ।।88।।
kuṭīṃ kṛtvā varṣamātraṃ bhāryayā tu sukanyayā ।
saha tepe tapaścograṃ saurāṣṭre vai prabhāsake ।।89।।
tadāśrame vaikhānasāḥ ṛṣayo'pi vasanti vai ।
tattīrthaṃ bhāvataḥ kuryāt sāmarthyaiśvaryasampadām ।।1.544.90।।
dhanaputrasutārogyasmṛddhīnāṃ sampradaṃ param ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ।।91 ।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaro lakṣmi! pārvatīṃ prajagāda ha ।
śaryāteścyavanasyāpi kathāṃ paramapāvanīm ।।92।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nyaṃkumatyāṃ devikāyāṃ ca nadyāṃ devarātatīrthe'ṣṭottaraśatanāmasahitasūryatīrthacyavanatīrthānāṃ tadākhyānasahitānāṃ kathananāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।544।।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! śaṃkaraśca pārvatīṃ prāha pāvanam ।
agastyādikatīrthānāṃ varṇanaṃ pravadāmi te ॥ 1 ॥
nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe divyamagastyāśramamuttamam ।
ā+āsīt pūrve kṛte varṣamātraṃ tapaścakāra saḥ ।। 2 ।।
agastyarṣiḥ kadācidvai yayau tīrthasamīhayā ।
dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi tatra vātāpe+irupaśāmitaḥ ।। 3 ।।
ilvalo nāma tadbhrātā'grajaḥ kāpaṭyasaṃbhrataḥ ।
nagaryāṃ maṇimatyāṃ sa cāsa vātāpireva tu ॥ 4 ॥

prāha me bhagavan putraṃ dehi mahendrasadṛśam ।। 9 ।।
agastyastaṃ cā'suraṃ tu dātuṃ naicchat sutaṃ tataḥ ।

tīrthayātrāṃ kurvataścāgastyasya mārgamadhyataḥ ।
vātāpiḥ phalarūpo'bhūt kāliṃgaraṃ supakvakam ॥ 7 ॥
kāmarūpastṛtīyaścātāpiḥ parṇagrahaṃ śubham ।
babhūva śobhanamṛṣyāśramarūpaṃ savedikam ॥ 8 ॥
ilvalastvāgatānāṃ vai vāṭagānāṃ samarhaṇam ।
phalabhojanadānādyaiścakāra nityameva ca || 9 |}

jalaṃ pibati yāvadvai tāvadilvala āsuraḥ ॥1.545.10॥
āhvayatyudarasthaṃ taṃ vātāpiṃ satphalātmakam ।
he vātāpe bahiryāhityevaṃ śrutvodaraṃgataḥ ॥11॥
sajīvastūdaraṃ bhittvā niryātyeva hi tatkṣaṇam ।
trayaste bhrātaro hṛṣṭā militvā taṃ mṛtaṃ janam ॥12॥
khādanti nityaśastvevaṃ kurvanti ṛṣihiṃsanam ।
tena pathā hyagastyaśca nirgato yāvadeva ha ॥13॥
ā+ātāpiḥ parṇaśālā'bhūd vātāpistu phalaṃ hyabhūt ।
ilvalastaṃ tadā'gastyamatithiṃ prāha harṣataḥ ॥ 14॥
ṛṣe bhāgyaṃ mama dhanyaṃ grahāṇa phalabhojanam ।
abhyāgatasya sevā vai karoti mokṣaṇaṃ param ॥15॥
agastyastaṃ tathetyāha niṣasāda gṛhāntare ।
ilvalastatphalaṃ dvedhā caturdhā pravibhajya va ॥16॥
agastyaṃ bhojayāmāsā''hvayāmāsā'nujaṃ punaḥ ।
pratyuttaraṃ na cā'vāpa pācayāmāsa tam ṛṣi: l| 17||

tadā bhayaँ samāpanna ilvalastatsthalāttadā ।। 18॥

tau muniḥ krodhadṛṣṭyaiva bhasmīcakāra tatkṣaṇāt ॥19॥
tato'gastirdehaśuddhiṃ kartuṃ tīrtheṣu vai caran ।
samāgato'tra vai nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe sthiro'bhavat ।।1.545.20।।
varṣamātraṃ tapaścakre'gastyatīrthamidaṃ hi tat ।

kiṃ kāryaṃ prāṇanāśaḥ syāddhanahetorna tadvaram ॥25॥
matvaivaṃ tu nṛgaḥ prāhṛ gṛhṇantvetattu puṣkalam ।
ātmānaṃ rakṣayet prājño dhanairdāraistathārjavaiḥ ll26ll

kintu mokṣakarī yātrā na me syāditi hānitaḥ li28॥

dhanaṃ dātuṃ hi caurebhyastāvadrājñaḥ śarīrataḥ ll1.545.30॥
ekā nārī saśastrā vai samutpannā'tiroṣiṇī ।

sā tu śīghraṃ punā rājño dehe praveśamāsthitā ॥32॥
tato rājā yayau prātarmārgaṃ prabhāsakasya saḥ ।

upoṣitā dvādaśī ca tatpuṇyaṃ tvayi saṃsthitam ॥36॥

kanyā caikādaśī sā ca hetayo dvādaśī tithiḥ ॥37॥

evaṃ vātra paratrā''dyaṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ prayāti hi ॥38॥
sakhā puṇyaṃ cātmani sthaṃ sahrāyaṃ sarvadā'sti tat । ।
tasmāttīrthaṃ vrataṃ dānaṃ kartavyaṃ mānave bhave ॥39॥
ityukto jñātavān sarvaṃ nṛgastuṣṭo babhūva ha ।
vāmadevamṛṣiṃ natvā saṃpūjya copadā dadau ॥1.545.40॥
tattīrthaṃ vāmadevasya mṛgasyāpi prakīrtitam ।
saurāṣṭre somake kṣetre rakṣakaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā ॥41॥
somanāthaṃ prasampūjya yayau harmyaṃ nijaṃ tataḥ ।
athā''sīd devaśarmākhyo dvijaḥ prabhāsatīrthajaḥ ।42।।
nyaṃkumatyāstīre vāsaṃ cakāra sa ca nirdhanaḥ ।
dhanārthe grāmamutsṛjya cauryaṃ kāryaṃ cakāra saḥ ॥43॥
tasya putro'bhavannāmnā duḥsahaścaura eva saḥ ।
vyasanoparato'raṇye jīrṇadevālaye vasan ||44||

prajopadravakṛnmūrkho dharmakāryabahiṣkṛtaḥ ॥46॥
śivālayasya saṃskārācchivabhakto'bhavaddhi saḥ ।
puṣpasragdhūpanaivedyagandhādibhiḥ śivaṃ sadā ||47]]
anyāṃścāpyarcayatyeva surān dīpapradānakaiḥ ।
yatra yatrāśrame daive prayātyeva sa pāthai+ivaḥ ॥48॥
dīpadānaṃ karotyeva devālayeṣu sarvadā ।
ekadā sa ca tīrtheṣu vicaran raivatācale ॥49॥

nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe prāpa nidhanaṃ kālayogataḥ ॥1.545.50॥

tattīrthe tu nijākhyādiyutaṃ kuberaśaṃkaram ॥53॥
kṛtavāँśca śivaṃ tatra tuṣṭāva śubhramānasaḥ ।

sakhyaṃ dhanādhipatyaṃ ca dikpālatvaṃ divaukasām ।
kubereśaṃ tatra gatvā bhaktyā yaḥ pūjayiṣyati ॥55॥
tadgṛhe saptapuruṣāvadhi lakṣmī nivatsyati । ।
atha kaivartako matsyaghātī svārociṣe'ntare ॥56॥
samudrasya taṭe jālaṃ jalaklinnaṃ śivālaye ।
nītvā dhvajasya daṇḍe tajjāळṃ dorakanirmitam ॥57॥

tatpuṇyena sa kaivarto janmāntare tu bhūpatiḥ ।

oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti japan sadā ॥1.545.60॥

mūlacaṇḍīśatīrthe sā prapūrvābhimukhī tataḥ ॥81॥
bhuktimuktipradā ramyā kathitā śaṃkareṇa vai ।
pārvatyai sā mayā lakṣmi ! kathitā te samāsataḥ ॥l82||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'gastyāśramasya ātāpīvātāpīlvalavināśasya vāmadevanṛgakuberatīrthānāṃ kratudhvajamokṣasya devakulaṛṣitoyāditīthīnāṃ sopākhyānavarṇananāmā pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ॥ 545 ॥


← adhyāyaḥ 545 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 546
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 547 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! pravakṣyāmi viśālanṛpateḥ purā ।
jātaṃ divyaṃ caritraṃ yat pārvatyai prāha śaṃkaraḥ ।। 1 ।।
pūrvaṃ rājā viśālo'bhūt kāśīpūryāṃ mahābalaḥ ।
gotrajairhṛtarājyo'sau gandhamādanamāyayau ।। 2 ।।
tasya droṇyāṃ badarīṃ ca śubhāṃ prāpya nṛpottamaḥ ।
tapaścakre bhajamānaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।। 3 ।।
kadācidāgatau tatra purāṇāvṛṣisattamau ।
naranārāyaṇau devau dharmaputrau himāśritau ।। 4 ।।
tau dṛṣṭvā sutapasyantaṃ badarīsthaṃ nṛpaṃ śubham ।
dhyāyantaṃ paramaṃ brahmaviṣṇurūpaṃ janārdanam ।। 5 ।।
naranārāyaṇaṃ prītau dṛṣṭvā taṃ kṣīṇakalmaṣam ।
ūcaturvaradau rājan vṛṇīṣva varamīpsitam ।। 6 ।।
rājā prāha bhavantau kau na jānāmi kathaṃ varam ।
ajñātābhyāṃ pragṛhṇāmi dātuṃ śaktau ca kaṃ varam ।। 7 ।।
ārādhayāmi yaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ jagadgurum ।
tasmād varaṃ grahīṣyāmi nānyasmāditi bhūsurau ।। 8 ।।
evamuktāvāhatustau kamārādhayase prabhum ।
kaṃ vā varaṃ vṛṇoṣi tvaṃ kathayasva kutūhalāt ।। 9 ।।
evamukto nṛpaḥ prāha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
ārādhayāmi satataṃ tatastāvūcatuḥ punaḥ ।।1.546.1 0।।
rājaँstasyaiva devasya prasādādāvayorvaram ।
gṛhāṇa tvaṃ varaṃ brūhi kaste manasi vartate ।। 11 ।।
yathā yajñeśvaraṃ devaṃ yajñairvividhadakṣiṇaiḥ ।
yaṣṭuṃ samarthatā me syāttathā me dadataṃ varam ।। 1 2।।
tadā nārāyaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ sampradarśya vai ।
naraḥ prāha ca rājānaṃ śṛṇu rājan sanātanam ।। 1 3।।
ayaṃ me pūrvajo bhrātā lokānāṃ mārgadarśakaḥ ।
mayā saha tapaḥ kurvannāste badarikāśrame ।। 14।।
ayaṃ matsyo'bhavat pūrvaṃ tataḥ kūrmo'bhavatpunaḥ ।
varāhaścā'bhavat so'yaṃ narasiṃhastato'bhavat ।।15 ।।
vāmanaśca tato jātastataḥ paraśurāmakaḥ ।
tato rāmaśca buddhaśca kṛṣṇaḥ kalkistato hyayam ।। 16 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so'yaṃ parātparaḥ ।
rājate kuṃkumavāpītīrthe saurāṣṭrabhūtale ।। 17।।
so'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāllakṣmīpatiḥ ramāpatiḥ ।
śrīpatiḥ kamalākāntaḥ pārvatīpatirīśvaraḥ ।। 18।।
kṛṣṇo rādhāpatiḥ prabhāpatiśca māṇikīpatiḥ ।
bhaktapatirmuktapatiḥ satīpatiḥ pumuttamaḥ ।। 1 9।।
matsyaṃ rājannupāsīta vedajñānasya labdhaye ।
kūrmaṃ rājannupāsīta śārīrabalapuṣṭaye ।।1.546.20।।
kroḍaṃ rājannupāsīta pṛthvīrājyādilabdhaye ।
narasiṃhamupāsīta pāpiśatrunivṛttaye ।।21 ।।
vāmanaṃ samupāsīta sārvabhaumatvasiddhaye ।
parśurāmamupāsīta krūraśatrunivṛttaye ।।22।।
rāmādityamupāsīta sadā dharmasya vṛddhaye ।
buddhaṃ sādhumupāsīta tvātmajñānasya labdhaye ।।23।।
kṛṣṇaṃ kāntamupāsīta golokādikalabdhaye ।
kalkiṃ rājannupāsīta rāgadveṣādihānaye ।।24।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tvakṣaramuktaye ।
yugalaṃ samupāsīta bhuktimuktisamṛddhaye ।।25।।
evamuktvā narastasya harervāsarajaṃ vratam ।
kuru rājan sadā tvekādaśyāmupoṣaṇaṃ tathā ।।26 ।।
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ ca samartho yajane bhava ।
ityuktvā tau yayatuśca badarīṃ nṛpatistataḥ ।।27।।
vrataṃ cakāra vidhivat sāmarthyaṃ cāpa vai punaḥ ।
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ tasmai prasannena tu viṣṇunā ।।28।।
arpitaṃ tat samādāya yayau rājyaṃ nijaṃ punaḥ ।
śatrūn vijitya ca rājā cakravartīṃ babhūva saḥ ।।29।।
tena ca tapasaḥ sthānaṃ himālaye kṛtaṃ purā ।
tatra vai nagarī parṇaśālāḍhyā ṛṣiyojitā ।।1.546.3 0।।
tāpasānāṃ kṛte tena rājñā nāmnā svakena vai ।
viśālākhyā nirmitā sā badarī cāśramātmikā ।। 31 ।।
viśālanṛpaternāmnā viśālākhyā'bhavacchubhā ।
naranārāyaṇāvāsā ṛṣīṇāṃ sukhavāsadā ।32।।
tatra tīrthaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā paraṃ dhāmā'bhigacchati ।
tatra janmani rājā'sau rājye sthitvā punaḥ punaḥ ।। 33।।
yajñaiśca vividhairiṣṭvā prasannamakaroddharim ।
athaikadā satīrthārthaṃ yayāvarbudapuṣkaram ।।।34।।
tato vai lomaśakṣetraṃ tataśca raivatācalam ।
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya somanāthaṃ vilokya ca ।।35।।
guptaprayāgaṃ gatvā ca cakāra vaiṣṇavaṃ kratum ।
tataḥ śrīkuṃkumavāpīkṣetre natvā tu lomaśam ।।39 ।।
yayau rājyaṃ tato hitvā saṃsāraṃ badarīṃ yayau ।
bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ prāpya yayau dhāma paraṃ hareḥ ।।37।।
anena rājñā yajñastu yatra guptaprayāgake ।
kṛtaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tārakaṃ taddhi vidyate ।।38।।
śṛṇu cānyaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ yannāmnā tīrthamuttamam ।
bhadreśvaraṃ jayantyākhye saṃbhūtaṃ bhadrikātaṭe ।।39।।
āsīt kṛtayuge rājā bhadrāśvo nāma bhaktarāṭ ।
yasya nāmnā'bhavad varṣaṃ bhadrāśvaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ।।1.546.40 ।।
tasyā'gastyaḥ kadācittu gṛhamāgatya sattamaḥ ।
uvāca saptarātraṃ tu vasāmi bhavato gṛhe ।।41 ।।
taṃ rājā śirasā natvā sthīyatāmityabhāṣata ।
tasya kāntimatīnāmnī bhāryā''sīcca pativratā ।।42।।
tasyāstejaḥ samabhavaccandrakāntisamaṃ bhuvi ।
śatāni pañca nṛpateścānyāḥ patnyo'bhavannapi ।।43 ।।
tā dāsya iva karmāṇi kurvantyasyāstapobalāt ।
mahābhāgā kāntimatī bhāryā sarvottamā'sti ca ।।44।।
sapatnyaśca bhayāttasyā dāsyaṃ kurvanti nityadā ।
tāmagastyastadā dṛṣṭvā rūpatejonvitāṃ śubhām ।।45 ।।
rājānaṃ tatra lubdhaṃ ca harerbhaktyā vivarjitam ।
kāntimatīṃ bhaktihīnāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca munirabravīt। ।।46 ।।
prathame divase dṛṣṭvā lokayantaṃ priyāmukham ।
sādhu sādhu jagannāthetyāhā'gastyaḥ praharṣitaḥ ।।47।।
dvitīye divase'pyevaṃ rājñīṃ nṛpaṃ vilokya ca ।
aho muṣṭamaho muṣṭaṃ jagadetaccarācaram ।।48।।
ityagastyo'vadad dhunvan śiro nṛpasya śṛṇvataḥ ।
tṛtīye'hani bhūpaṃ ca rājñīṃ dṛṣṭvā śucā'vadat ।।49।।
aho mūḍhā na jānanti dātāraṃ parameśvaram ।
ya ekena dinenaiva rājñastuṣṭaḥ pradattavān ।।1.546.50।।
caturthe divase hastāvutkṣipya punarabravīt ।
sādhu sādhu jagannātha strī śūdrāḥ sādhu sādhviti ।।51 ।।
dvijāḥ sādhu nṛpāḥ sādhuvaiśyāḥ sādhu punaḥ punaḥ ।
sādhu bhadrāśca sādhu tvaṃ sādhu bho'gastya sādhu te ।।52।।
sādhu prahlāda sādhu tvaṃ dhruvaḥ sādhu mahāvrataḥ ।
evamuktvā nanartoccairagastyo rājasannidhau ।।53।।
evambhūtaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā patnīyukto nṛpottamaḥ ।
kiṃ harṣakāraṇaṃ brahman! yenetthaṃ nṛtyate tviha ।।54।।
kiṃ ca saṃbhāṣase vidvan parānandena cetasā ।
agastyastaṃ ca bhadrāśvaṃ tathā rājñīmuvāca ha ।।55।।
aho mūrkhaḥ kurājā tvaṃ mūrkhī ceyaṃ priyā tava ।
mūrkhāśca mantriṇaḥ sarve aho mūrkhāḥ purohitāḥ ।।56।।
sarvaṃ maurkhyānvitaṃ rājan dṛśyate tava maṇḍalam ।
saralaṃ viditārthaṃ ca ye na jānanti me matam ।।57।।
evamukte punā rājā kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata ।
na jānīmo vayaṃ brahman tavoktaṃ bhāvapūritam ।।58।।
vivecaya mahāvidvan yadyanugrahakṛd bhavān ।
agastyaśca tadā prāha vṛttāntaṃ prāgbhavaṃ yathā ।।59।।
āsīd vaiśyo haradattanāmā nagarapattane ।
tasya bhṛtyo bhavānāsīcchūdravarṇo'tibhaktimān ।।1.546.60।।
iyaṃ rājñī tava patnī vaiśyabhṛtyā tadā'bhavat ।
sa vaiśyo'śvayuji māsi dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ sthitaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
gṛṇan viṣṇvālayaṃ gatvā puṣpadhūpādibhirharim ।।62।।
abhyarcayati nityaṃ vai ciraṃ dhyānaṃ karoti ca ।
devālaye bhavantau ca kṛtvā sa rakṣapālakau ।।63 ।।
saṃsthāpya dvau pradīpānāṃ jvālanārthaṃ tataḥ sa vai ।
prayāti svagṛhaṃ vaiśyo bhavantau tu harergṛhe ।।64।।
sammārjanaṃ jaladānaṃ puṣpatulasīyojanam ।
āgatānāṃ ca satkāraṃ kṛtvā nityaṃ hareḥ puraḥ ।।65।।
divāniśaṃ bhavantau ca dīpānāmapyakhaṇḍatām ।
āstāṃ saṃrakṣayantau vai punaḥ prajvālya saṃsthitau ।।66।।
tena puṇyena bhavatoḥ pāpāni tvāyuṣā saha ।
vilīnāni prabhātāyāṃ rajanyāṃ ca yuvāṃ tadā ।।67।।
śrīhareḥ kṛpayā śūdradehau tyaktvā mṛtiṃ gatau ।
tato rājaँstava janma priyavratagṛhe'bhavat ।।68।।
iyaṃ kāntimatī saiva tava patnī sahā''gatā ।
pārakyasyā'pi dīpasya jvālitasya harergṛhe ।।69।।
sevābhaktidāsyabhāvaiḥ prasāditasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ।
rājyaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhavadbhyāṃ ca prasādenedamarjitam ।।1.546.70 ।।
yaḥ punaḥ svena vittena viṣṇoragre pradīpakān ।
jvālayet tasya yatpuṇyaṃ tat saṃkhyātuṃ na śakyate ।।71 ।।
mārjanaṃ lepanaṃ prakṣālanaṃ pātrapraśodhanam ।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ vastrakṣālanaṃ stavanaṃ tathā ।।72।।
jīrṇoddharaṇamijyāṃ ca puṣpatulasīyojanam ।
naivedyaṃ salilaṃ patraṃ phalamārārtrikādikam ।।73।।
candanā'kṣatakuṃkumā'bīrasugandhacarcanam ।
nityaṃ kuryāttasya puṇyapāraṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate ।।74।।
tena rājaँstava puṇyaṃ smṛtvā prākkṛtameva ca ।
sādhu sādhu jagannāthetyuktaṃ harṣeṇa vai mayā ।।75।।
kṛte varṣeṇa yatpuṇyaṃ tretāyāṃ tat ṣaṇmāsikaiḥ ।
dvāpare ca tribhirmāsaiḥ kalāvekadinena tat ।।76।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyeti vadan janaḥ ।
bhaktyā saṃpūjayan kṛṣṇaṃ sarvaṃ tallabhate phalam ।।77।।
evaṃ sthite'piloke'smin prāpte kalau janāḥ khalu ।
bhajiṣyante na vai kṛṣṇaṃ dvāpare triyuge'pi vā ।।78।।
muṣṭāste karmabhiḥ svaiśca vañcitāḥ syuśca sarvathā ।
tvaṃ ca rājan rataścātra kāntāyāmeva sarvadā ।।79।।
na tvaṃ neyaṃ smarasyatra kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
etatsarvaṃ vilokyaiva mayoktaṃ cāpare dine ।।1.546.80।।
aho muṣṭamaho muṣṭaṃ jagadetaccarācaram ।
śrīharerbhāryayā muṣṭaṃ vañcitaṃ vai carācaram ।।81।।
bhajante na hariṃ sampaddātāraṃ puruṣottamam ।
atha pārakyadīpasyotkarṣādapi phalaṃ mahat ।।82।।
rājyaṃ labdhaṃ tathāpi śrīharernāma gṛṇanti na ।
na rājā na ca vā rājñī smaratyapi narāyaṇam ।।83।।
mamāgame'pi naivaitau bhajete puruṣottamam ।
satsaṃgena hi sarvatrā'bhaktā api kṣaṇaṃ khalu ।।84।।
bhaktiṃ kurvanti kṛṣṇasya na tu mūrkhāḥ kadācana ।
suyoge'pi bhaktihīnā mūḍhā eva na saṃśayaḥ ।।85।।
rājā mūḍhastasya rājñī mūḍhatameti bhāti me ।
atastṛtīyadivase yuvāṃ dṛṣṭvā mayeritam ।।86।।
aho mūḍhā na jānanti govindaṃ parameśvaram ।
etatsarvaṃ sukhaṃ cāpi harerdīpakriyāphalam ।।87।।
ekasyaiva divasasya phalaṃ rājyottamottamam ।
caturthe divase rājan hastāvutkṣipya vai mayā ।।88।।
vicāryaiva śrāvitaṃ vāṃ bhaktāḥ sarve hi sādhavaḥ ।
bhagavatā dvijā ye ca rājāno ye ca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।89।।
yajante vividhairyajñaistena te sādhavaḥ smṛtāḥ ।
ye na bhajanti deveśaṃ satyapi smṛddhisādhane ।।1.546.90।।
nirdhano'pi tataḥ śreṣṭho yo vai bhajati keśavam ।
ahaṃ yadyapyaraṇyastho nirdhano niḥkuṭumbakaḥ ।।91 ।।
tathāpi sādhurevā'smi sasmṛddhīnāmapekṣayā ।
yamahaṃ na vismarāmi kadāpi puruṣottamam ।।92।।
tena sādho agastyeti mayoktaṃ māṃ prati dhruvam ।
sā strī dhanyā sa śūdraśca tathā dhanyataro mataḥ ।।93।।
śuśrūṣāṃ svāmino nārāyaṇatmakasya sarvathā ।
kānte ca svāmini nityaṃ parokṣo harirasti vai ।।94।।
matvā karoti yena syāt kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sukarma tat ।
sā strī dhanyā tathā śūdro dvijaśuśrūṣaṇe rataḥ ।।95।।
dvijājñayā harerbhaktiṃ sādhū tau yat karoti hi ।
dvijāste sādhavaḥ proktā harerbhaktiyutāśca ye ।।96।।
nṛpāste sādhavaḥ proktā hariṃ bhajanti nityadā ।
āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritya prahlādaḥ puruṣottamam ।।97।।
muktvā cānyaṃ na jānāti tenā'sau sādhurucyate ।
uttānapādaputraśca dhruva eva tu bālakaḥ ।।98।।
vane viṣṇuṃ samārādhya prāpa sthānaṃ mahattamam ।
tena sādhurdhruvaścāpi mayoktaṃ rājasattama ।।99।।
sarvaṃ sādhu bhaved rājan śrīkṛṣṇaḥ smaryate hṛdi ।
asādhu yāvadevaitacchrīkṛṣṇo vismṛto yadi ।। 1.546.10 0।।
tvayā rājan paraṃ prāptaṃ rājyaṃ viṣṇustu vismṛtaḥ ।
tasmādbhajā'tra govindaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।। 101 ।।
ityuktau dampatī natvā smṛtvā prāgbhavajaṃ phalam ।
bhejāte śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ phalapradam ।। 1 02।।
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyāllakṣmi! mokṣastasyā'pi saṃbhavet ।
pārvatīṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha yattanmayeritaṃ tava ।। 103 ।।
bhadrāśvaḥ sa yayau tīrthayātrārthaṃ ca prabhāsake ।
saurāṣṭre tena bhadrāyāstaṭe vai paścime śubhe ।। 1 04।।
jayantākhye pattane ca śāṃkaraṃ tīrthamāsthitam ।
bhadreśvaraṃ ca tannāma śravaṇātpāpanāśanam ।।1 05।।
punā rājā dadau tatrā'gastyāśramaṃ tapomayam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca taṭe brahmarṣisevitam ।। 106 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśālanṛpakṛtaviśālātīrthabhadrāśvanṛpakṛta bhadre tīrthā'gastyakṛtopadeśaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 546 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 546 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 547
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 548 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato'gastyo bhadrāśvaṃ nṛpatiṃ śubham ।
ātmajñānaṃ yathā prāha vacmi te lokamokṣadamam ।। 1 ।।
śaṃkareṇa prabhāse vai proktaṃ satyai purā hi tat ।
bhadrāśvaḥ samapapracchā'gastyaṃ mokṣapradaṃ varam ।। 2 ।।
jñānaṃ vada mahāprājña! yena mokṣaṃ prayāmi vai ।
agastyaḥ prāha rājānaṃ guruṃ vinā gatirna vai ।। 3 ।।
gururbrahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śaṃbhurnārāyaṇo guruḥ ।
gurureva parabrahma pratyakṣo bhagavān hariḥ ।। 4 ।।
taṃ prasādya bhavenmokṣayogyatā dehinaḥ purā ।
ātmaprasādastasyaivāśībhirjāyata eva hi ।। 2 ।।
vrataṃ kuryādarcanaṃ ca prasādanaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
jñānamantrapradātā ca tārayed bhavasāgarāt। ।। 6 ।।
gurave bhojanaṃ dadyād vaiṣṇavo yajña ucyate ।
kuryāttu vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñaṃ yajed yogīśvaraṃ harim ।। 7 ।।
yo hareḥ sarahasyaṃ tu sumantraṃ copapādayet ।
tasmai dadyāttu sarvasvaṃ priyaṃ cātmārpaṇādikam ।। 8 ।।
phalaṃ tasmai pradattasya koṭikoṭiguṇottaram ।
sukhaṃ rājyaṃ mahānandaḥ svargaṃ mokṣaśca śāśvataḥ ।। 9 ।।
gurau sati tu yaścānyamāśrayet pūjayet kudhīḥ ।
sa na phalamavāpnoti dattamasya tu niṣphalam ।। 1.547.10 ।।
prayatnena gurau pūrvaṃ paścādanyasya dāpayet ।
avidyo vā savidyo vā gurureva janārdanaḥ ।। 11 ।।
mārgastho vā'pyamārgastho gurureva parā gatiḥ ।
pratipadya guruṃ yastu paścād vipratipadyate ।। 1 2।।
gurvaparādhapātraṃ sa duḥkhī syāt puruṣādhamaḥ ।
gurau nārāyaṇaścāste taṃ prasādya sukhī bhavet ।। 1 3।।
mūrtirnārāyaṇasyaiva cetanā gurureva ha ।
jāgarti snāti vastrāṇi dhārayatyeva candanam ।। 14।।
kuṃkumādi sugandhādi gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam ।
puṣpaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ bhojyaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ tathā ।। 15।।
jalaṃ bhūṣāṃ kajjalādi gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam ।
āsanaṃ vāhanaṃ yānaṃ paryaṃkaṃ pādukādikam ।। 16 ।।
jalaṃ saubhāgyadravyādi gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam ।
mano bhāvaṃ prema bhaktiṃ sevāṃ vastu tathārpitam ।। 17।।
pādasaṃvāhanaṃ peyaṃ maitrīṃ hāsyaṃ prasannatām ।
namaskāraṃ dehasevāṃ gṛhṇāti sa janārpitam ।। 18 ।।
śiṣyaduḥkhaṃ dayālurvai gṛhṇāti vārayatyapi ।
sāhāyyaṃ kurute śaśvajjñānaṃ dadāti śāntidam ।। 1 9।।
pāpaṃ prajvālayatyeva puṇyaṃ dadāti puṣkalam ।
naijaṃ sarvaṃ dadātyeva gurureva janārdanaḥ ।। 1.547.20 ।।
gurureva patiḥ putraḥ satī sādhvī pativratā ।
pitā mātā tathā bhāryā sarvasvaṃ gurureva ha ।। 21 ।।
rakṣakaḥ poṣakaścāpi tārakaścāvabodhakaḥ ।
harerdhāmnaḥ prāpakaśca gurureva hariḥ svayam ।। 22।।
bhrātā caikaguṇo mānyaḥ pitā daśaguṇastataḥ ।
mātā śataguṇā mānyā sahasraguṇako guruḥ ।। 23 ।।
apāraguṇakaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ ।
akṣarā'dhipatiḥ śrīmān bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ ।। 24।।
evaṃ pratyakṣamūrtiṃ vai guruṃ sampūjayet sadā ।
divyamūrtirguruḥ sākṣāddharerdivyasya yogataḥ ।। 25।।
śiṣyasya divyatāsampādako divyahariḥ sa vai ।
evaṃ matvā sadā rājan guruṃ dhyāyīta cārcayet ।। 26 ।।
paraṃ kalyāṇadaṃ pātraṃ śiṣyaḥ samarjayed gurum ।
bhadrāśvaḥ svagurorvākyaṃ śrutvā mumoda cātmani ।। 27 ।।
sarvaṃ prāptaṃ guruḥ prāptaḥ pūrṇatāṃ manyate'pi ca ।
lokānāṃ bodhalābhāya natvā prapaccha vai punaḥ ।। 28 ।।
guro! prāptaṃ mayā sarvaṃ prāptavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ।
tathāpi vada me mokṣadharmān lokahitāvahān ।। 29।।।
bhagavan karmaṇā kena chidyate bhavasaṃsṛtiḥ ।
kiṃvā kṛtvā na śocanti mūrtā'mūrtopapattiṣu ।। 1.547.30 ।।
kiṃ kṛtvā ca parabrahmamayo bhavati mānavaḥ ।
iti rājño vacaḥ śrutvā'gastyaḥ prāha pramodavān ।। 31 ।।
śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāṃ dūrāsannavyavasthitām ।
dṛśyādṛśyavibhāgotthāṃ samāhitamanā bhava ।। 32 ।।
āsīd rājyaṃ purā cāpi vartamāne bhaviṣyati ।
apāraṃ ca tathā'sīmaṃ yatra sūryo na candramāḥ ।। 33 ।।
na rātrirna ca divaso diśo naiva na bhūstathā ।
na dyaurdevā na vā cāsan divyaṃ rājyaṃ tathā hi tat। ।। 34।।
tatra samrāṭ muktapālo rājā śāśvatajīvanaḥ ।
pālayāmāsa divyān vai muktān saṃkhyāvivarjitān ।।39।।
prajāstaṃ mānayāmāsa sarvātmabhāvanārpaṇāḥ ।
prajānāṃ bhojanaṃ miṣṭaṃ rājā sarvaṃ dadāti vai ।।36।।
na ca śaityaṃ nātapaśca siddhiyuktāśca tāḥ prajāḥ ।
vinindrāḥ śāśvatānandā nityatṛptā nirāśayāḥ ।।37।।
sarve saṃkalpasatyāśca rājā''nandapariplutāḥ ।
vartante ca prajāḥ sarvāstasyaiva cakravartinaḥ ।।38।।
yatra nānyat khaṇḍarājyaṃ sāmyavādaścaturvidhaḥ ।
sālokyaṃ sarvamuktānāṃ sārṣṭitā sarvadehinām ।।39।।
sārūpyaṃ sarvatattvānāṃ sāyujyaṃ sarvayoginām ।
bhojane ramaṇe yāne vāhane kalpane ratau ।।1.547.40।।
jñāne bhaktau vedane copakārye'pi samānatā ।
evaṃ rājyaṃ mahad yatra satyameva na cānṛtam ।।41 ।।
yatra nyāyālayo nāsti nāsti doṣādhikāritā ।
yatra cauryaṃ vaimanasyaṃ śātravaṃ vartanaṃ na vai ।।42।।
yatrā'śuddhistathā nāsti kṣayo yatra na vidyate ।
yatra cātiśayo nāsti kuto dveṣaśca rāgakaḥ ।।43।।
tādṛśaṃ rājyasarvasvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ karapātravat ।
dūradṛśyaṃ dūraśrāvo dūracintanamityapi ।।44।।
sarvaṃ sākṣāccātmatantraṃ sādhanaṃ cātmajaṃ hi tat ।
tadrājyaṃ pāvanānāṃ tu prajānāmadhivāsanam ।।45।।
apāvanānāṃ yātrāpi tatra naiva hi jāyate ।
sīmā yā cā'pāvanānāṃ tadūrdhvaṃ tadagrāhyakam ।।46।।
apāvanānyaraṇyāni vartante paritastataḥ ।
sa cātmapālako rājā''raṇyaṃ vihartumāyayau ।।47।।
araṇyāni samudrāṃśca parvatān kṣetrabhūmikāḥ ।
yāni divyamahārājyādadhastaṭe bhavanti ca ।।48।।
dāsyai dattaṃ ca tadrājyaṃ bhṛtyāya pūrvameva ha ।
didṛkṣuḥ kṛpayā rājā paścimaṃ taṭamāyayau ।।49।।
ūrdhvaṃ tīraṃ samudrasyā'nantapārasya śāśvatam ।
bhavābdhau yatra vai dvīpe dvīpe vasanti dhīvarāḥ ।।1.547.50 ।।
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madaśca pañca te ।
aṣṭau drumāstathā yatra vartante kāmavarṣiṇaḥ ।।51 ।।
dharmo'dharmastathā jñānamajñānaṃ ca caturthakam ।
aiśvaryaṃ cāpyanaiśvaryaṃ rāgo vairāgyamityamī ।।52।।
nadī tīryag yatra yāti manovahābhidhā'niśam ।
adhaścordhvaṃ babhramuśca pañca mukhyāśca nāyakāḥ ।।53।।
śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca nāmataḥ ।
eko mukhyapradhānaśca prāṇākhyo vartate sadā ।।54।।
ekā strī vartate dāsī yathā rājñī balādhikā ।
triguṇā sā buddhināmnī rājendra sevate sadā ।।।55।।
sā strī sve vakṣasi nityaṃ mahendraṃ rakṣati dhruvam ।
sahasrasūryapratimaṃ lakṣacandrasamā ca sā ।।56।।
tasyā'dharastrivikāro hāsyamāścaryamugratā ।
tasyā varṇastrirūpaśca śveto raktastamomayaḥ ।।57।।
yuvatī sarvadā ramyā nūtaneva vrajasthitā ।
vinā ca puruṣaṃ mlānā tūṣṇībhūtā mṛtā yathā ।।58।।
divyaṃ taṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyāntaṃ taṭā'ntigam ।
sāśā sajīvanā yadvajjātā jaḍā'pi cetanā ।।59।।
nṛpo'pi tāṃ kṛpayaiva vilokya ca muhurmuhuḥ ।
samudraṃ ca vanaṃ tasyāḥ kṣetrāṇi saṃviveśa ha ।।1.547.6 0।।
tasmin praviṣṭe nṛpatau strīrājyasthāḥ prajāstadā ।
pradhānādyāśca sambhūya tatsvāgatārthamāyayuḥ ।।61 ।।
kecinnamrā jalaṃ pātramāninyurāsanādikam ।
bhayādaikyaṃ gatavantaḥ kṣaṇena copadānvitāḥ ।।62।।।
taistadādhīvarairnyāyavarjitairveṣṭito nṛpaḥ ।
kāmādibhistathāpyeṣastebhyo na hṛdayaṃ dadau ।।63।।
athā'yaṃ nṛpatistāँścoddhatān jñātvā vaśecchayā ।
ekaṃ vai mānasaṃ putraṃ cintayāmāsa nāyakam ।।64।।
yadadhīnā ime sarve bhaveyurna ca syuryathā ।
tāvat sā strī nirapatyā sāpatyecchāvatī hyabhūt ।।65।।
prārthayāmāsa rājānaṃ kuru sāpatyakāṃ ca mām ।
tathā'stviti nṛpaḥ prāha suṣuve strī svakaṃ sutam ।।66।।
trivarṇaṃ puruṣaṃ śvetaṃ raktaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca sadṛśam ।
jātamātraḥ so'pyuvāca mama nāma pradehi vai ।।67।।
mahāniti tataścakre mukhyaṃ nāma sutasya saḥ ।
rājā tena prasanno'bhūt putro'pi taṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ।।68।।
dharṣayāmāsa vegena kintu nṛpo mahābalaḥ ।
dharṣaṇaṃ tasya nāpede tato'sau putrakāmyayā ।।69।।
tuṣṭāva taṃ nṛpaṃ tena dattastatsadṛśaḥ sutaḥ ।
so'pi tredhā'bhavattasya mahān prāhā'hameva ha ।।1.547.70।।
asmītināmataḥ khyāto'haṃkāraḥ pitṛsadṛśaḥ ।
evaṃ putraṃ praputraṃ ca labdhvā strī cātiharṣitā ।।71 ।।
tadbalena tataḥ sā strī taṃ rājānaṃ rurodha ha ।
tathāpi na niruddhaḥ sa yadā vai balavattamaḥ ।।72।
tadā naijaṃ balaṃ matvā nyūnaṃ sainyaṃ ca sā punaḥ ।
vavre putrān pañca cānyān ahaṃkārasya bālakān ।।73।।
rājā dadau ca tān pañca tanmātrātmakabālakān ।
te'pi cāgatya ca sarve saṃbhūya rurudhurnṛpam ।।74।।
tathāpi bhūpatiḥ siddho ruddho naiva ca naiva ca ।
tadā vavre tu sā nārī daśa pañca ca bālakān ।।75।।
tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha dadau daśendriyāṇi ca ।
pañcaprāṇān dadau te ca sambhūya rurudhurnṛpam ।।76।।
tathāpyayaṃ na ruddho'bhūt tataste'nyāśrayaṃ yayuḥ ।
svarājyasthaṃ mahendraṃ te saṃveṣṭya saṃsthitāstadā ।।77।।
indraścātmā mahendraḥ sa ruddho dasyubhireva ha ।
indreṇa saha te sarve hyekībhūya hi dasyavaḥ ।।78।।
rājānaṃ ca tato hantuṃ baddhuṃ vā manthituṃ ca vā ।
udyatāḥ sahasā tatra tathāpi baddha eva na ।।79।।
atha sarvān vihāyaiva rājā gantuṃ samīhate ।
tāvat sendrāstadā sarve babhūvuśca mṛtā yathā ।।1.547.80।।
punaḥ sarvaiḥ prārthitaśca jīvānārthaṃ ca taiḥ punaḥ ।
melayituṃ maṇḍale sve vartayituṃ sadā saha ।।8 1 ।।
tadā dayālurbhagavān divyarājyakaraḥ prabhuḥ ।
svasthāne kāryakartāraṃ baddhamivā'nugāminam ।।82।।
puruṣaṃ janayāmāsa yathā karmānurūpiṇam ।
hiraṇyavarṇaṃ nirliptaṃ nṛpājñālepamāsthitam ।।83।।
striyā mahatā'haṃkṛtyā kāmādyairabhivāñcchitam ।
śabdādyaiḥ śravaṇādyaiśca prāṇādyairabhisatkṛtam ।।84।।
janayitvā dadau tebhyo ruddhaḥ saṃveṣṭitaśca saḥ ।
jaḍacetanagranthiśca hiraṇmayo naraśca saḥ ।।85।।।
sadṛśān janayāmāsa romasaṃkhyākabālakān ।
suśobhamānān vairājāँste'pi tṛṣṇākulāstataḥ ।।86।।
asaṃkhyabālakān svalpān sasṛjurnābhideśataḥ ।
tebhyo dattā mahātṛṣṇā pratyekaṃ ca pravartikā ।।87।।
kāryakāṇḍaprayoktrī ca vāsanā cā'parā'rpitā ।
ubhābhyāṃ ramate brahmā janayatyaparāḥ prajāḥ ।।88।।
etat sarvaṃ paraṃ kāryakaraṃ kuṭumbameva saḥ ।
striyai dattvā yayau naijaṃ deśaṃ divyaṃ nṛpaśca saḥ ।।89।।
tāvallīnāni sarvāṇi kuṭumbāni śubhāni vai ।
tairlīnairnṛpateścendro nirāśrayo babhūva ha ।।1.547.90।।
ruroda pāparuddhaḥ sa vāsanākramavāsitaḥ ।
punaḥ kṛpālurbhūpālastadarthaṃ sukhamāśrayam ।।91 ।।
dadau vyoma tato vāyuṃ tejo jalaṃ bhuvaṃ tathā ।
līnebhyo vyaktarūpāṇi dattavān bhūpatiḥ sa vai ।।92।।
sāvakāśāni pañcaikyabhāvāpannāni kāryataḥ ।
saṃyuktāni mahendrasyā''śrayāṇyālambanāni ca ।।93।।
tāvattāni ca līnāni samudbhūtāni vai punaḥ ।
jīvitāni svakāryeṣu samāgatya sthitāni ca ।।94।।
mahendro dasyubhirvyāpto navadvāre pure śubhe ।
rājyaṃ ca kārayāmāsa pracakāra svayaṃ tathā ।।95।।
mahendrādyā babhramuśca digbhrame cāti pīḍitāḥ ।
tadā taṃ nṛpatiṃ prāhurdehi mārgapradarśakam ।।96।।
prārthanāṃ paramāṃ śrutvā rājā kanyāṃ subodhinīm ।
dadau mahendrasaṃjñāya yathā divyanṛpālayaḥ ।।97।।
pradṛśyate tayā sākaṃ mahendraḥ sukhavānabhūt ।
amūrtā iva te sarve nyūṣurāyatane śubhe ।।98।।
navadvāre pure tvekastambhe sarvakakubpathe ।
nadīsahasrasaṃkīrṇe sarvakāryasamāśrite ।।99।।
mahendraṃ tvekalaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakhāyaṃ nṛpatiśca saḥ ।
āvartamānaṃ mugdhaṃ ca naṣṭamiva sthitaṃ ca tam ।। 1.547.100 ।।
saṃsūcya vācakān śabdān vedānaśikṣayacchubhān ।
niyamāṃśca yamāँścāpi śikṣayamāsa vai tadā ।। 101 ।।
tena moho vinaṣṭo vai sasmāra bhūpatiṃ punaḥ ।
kintu bandhairveṣṭitaḥ sa na nirgantuṃ śaśāka ha ।। 1 02।।
śastraṃ tvaicchattadā devānnṛpateḥ śīghrameva tu ।
bhūpaḥ śastramasaṃgaṃ ca dadāvasmai suvajrakam ।। 1 03।।
chitvā tadā mahendraśca bandhanāni nṛpālayam ।
yayau nityasukhānandānvito'bhūt kṣaṇamātrataḥ ।। 1 04।।
mahendrāḥ sarva evaite pūrvakarmānusārataḥ ।
kāyānagararājāno bhavanti bhavasāgare ।। 1 05।।
caturviṃśaticauraiśca baddhyante madhyasaṃsthitāḥ ।
upāsanayā buddhyā ca bhaktyā dāsyena yogataḥ ।। 1 06।।
anyatamena śastreṇa bhittvā bandhanameva ca ।
yāti divyanṛparājyaṃ punaryatra na bandhanam ।। 1 07।।
āgateyaṃ kathā rājan sarvasya viṣaye sthitā ।
tvaddehe mama dehe ca sarvajantuṣu sadṛśī ।। 1 08।।
māyārājyaṃ vihāyaiva divyabhūpāśrayaṃ caret ।
tenamuktasthitiṃ prāpya śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute ।। 1 09।।
pravṛttaṃ maṇḍalaṃ hitvā nivṛttaṃ padamāpnuyāt ।
pārvatyai śaṃkaraścaiva prāha lakṣmi! mayoditam ।। 1.547.11 0।।
agastyaśca samuvāca bhadrāśvāya nṛpāya ca ।
so'yaṃ rājā ca saurāṣṭre prāpya jñānamanuttamam ।। 11 1।।
yayau rājyaṃ svakaṃ tatra samārādhya narāyaṇam ।
māhendramaṇḍalaṃ hitvā bhaktyā nārāyaṇasya saḥ ।। 11 2।।
yayau mokṣapadaṃ divyanṛpatervāsarūpakam ।
paṭhed yaḥ śṛṇuyāccāpi labhetātmavisarjanam ।। 1 13।।
bhavapāraṃ paraṃ pāraṃ māyābdhervāsanākṣayam ।
purātanaṃ mahāmitraṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 14।।
sakāmasya dhanaṃ putro'patyāni sampadastathā ।
bhaveyuśca sadārogyaṃ tattvajñānaśravāt priye ।। 1 15।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhadrāśvarājñe'gastyapradattātmajñānagurumahimādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।547।।


← adhyāyaḥ 547 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 548
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 549 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! prabhāsasya pūrvasyāṃ śaṃkaroditam ।
pārvatyai sumahattīrthaṃ prāṇyuddhārakaraṃ śubham ।। 1 ।।
guptaprayāgastatrā'sti devo'sti mādhavastathā ।
jāhnavī yamunā devī sarasvatī ca tatra vai ।। 2 ।।
anyānyapi ca tīrthāni vasanti tatprayāgake ।
śṛgāleśvaratīrthaṃ ca sannidhau vartate tathā ।। 3 ।।
triḥsaṃgamo nadīnāṃ ca tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ śubham ।
brahmakuṇḍo viṣṇukuṇḍo rudrakuṇḍastathā śubhaḥ ।। 4 ।।
kuṇḍamadhyād vinirgatya gaṃgā yamīṃ sugacchati ।
anayorantare sūkṣme guptā cāste sarasvatī ।। 5 ।।
atra māghe snānakartā prayāgasnānajaṃ phalam ।
tīrtharājaphalatulyaṃ labhati nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 6 ।।
tasmiṃstīrthe mātaraśca rakṣikāḥ saṃvasanti hi ।
bhūtādibhayanāśāya tā mātṛḥ saṃprapūjaye ।। 7 ।।
vṛṣabhastatra dātavyo yātrāphalopalabdhaye ।
viṣṇukuṇḍe janaḥ snātvā yastu mādhavamarcayet ।। 8 ।।
sa tu yāsyati vaikuṇṭhaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam ।
śṛgāleśvaranāmeśakṣetraṃ krośārdhamityapi ।। 9 ।।
gavāhatā dvijahatā ye daṃṣṭripaśubhirhatāḥ ।
ātmaghātakarā ye ca sarpadaṣṭāśca ye mṛtāḥ ।। 1.548.10 ।।
śayyāmṛtāḥ śaucahīnāsteṣāṃ śrāddhaṃ tadatra vai ।
kārayet tena muktā syurduḥkhaśokavivarjitāḥ ।। 11 ।।
tatra siddheśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ devaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ purā ।
aṇimādikamaiśvaryaṃ smṛddhiṃ vindet prapūjanāt ।। 1 2।।
tato vai nāradādityaṃ tīrthaṃ gacched ravergṛham ।
ekadā tu pṛthivyāṃ vai tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ ।। 1 3।।
nāradastvāgatastasya sūryakriyāprasaṃkramāt ।
śaithilyaṃ samabhūd dehe yathā jarākṛtaṃ bhavet ।। 14।।
svargaṃ satyaṃ tato gantuṃ notsāhaṃ kurute muniḥ ।
yato virūpatāṃ prāpto yauvanādivivarjitaḥ ।। 15।।
vijātīyādibhāvena satye loke vaset katham ।
evaṃ cintayatastasya sūryaḥ sākṣāt babhūva ha ।। 16।।
vada nārada kā cintā jāyate tava mānase ।
martyaloke ca ye'pyanye bahu bhramanti te khalu ।। 17।।
īśvarā vā ca devā vā ṛṣayo yogino'pi vai ।
mama kriyābhirvyāptāśca yānti vai jīrṇatāṃ dhruvam ।। 18।।
yathā martyāstathā te'pi mama kālaprabhāvataḥ ।
grasyante mānavaistulyā vṛddhā bhavanti sarvaśaḥ ।। 1 9।।
vada tvaṃ ṣoḍaśābdaśca dṛśyase satyalokagaḥ ।
kintu cā'dya kṣitau jāto jarayā grasta eva yat ।।1.548.20।।
mā tvaṃ cintāṃ kuru brahman yuvā san vicariṣyasi ।
na prabhāvaḥ kiraṇānāṃ tavopari bhaviṣyati ।।2 1 ।।
ityukto nāradastatra sudṛḍhaḥ ṣoḍaśābdikaḥ ।
yathāpūrvaṃ hi saṃjātaḥ sūryaścādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।22।।
nāradena tadā tatra nāradādityanāmakaḥ ।
sūryadevaḥ sthāpitaśca tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ ca pāvanam ।।23।।
saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ।
tasya rogabhayaṃ na syāt prasādād dyumaṇeḥ raveḥ ।।24।।
anyat tīrthaṃ tatra cāste'paranārāyaṇāśrayam ।
phālgunā'malapakṣe tu hyekādaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ ।।25।।
pūjayet puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ।
atha gaṃgā śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ tatreśānyāṃ hi vartate ।।26 ।।
yatra trinetrakā matsyā vasanti rudracihninaḥ ।
śṛṇu gaṃgāgamaṃ tatra matsyānāṃ ca trinetratām ।।27।।
yadā rudro vivastraḥ san kadācidṛṣimaṇḍale ।
āśrameṣu tu bhikṣārthaṃ vicacāra tadā ca taiḥ ।।28।।
kruddhaistaiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ śapto hyajānadbhirmaheśvaraḥ ।
gajavad bhramase loke lajjāhīnaḥ paśuryathā ।।29।।
tasmād bhava gajastvaṃ cā'raṇyavāsīti śaṃkaraḥ ।
drāgeva ca gajo bhūtvā'raṇyaṃ viveśa śaṃkaraḥ ।।1.548.30।।
tatra bhṛguryogadṛṣṭyā viditvā śaṃkaraṃ ca tam ।
nirānandaṃ jagat sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāha ṛṣīn parān ।।3 1।।
ayaṃ tu śaṃkaraścāsīd gajarūpo'pi so'bhavat ।
aparādho mahān jāta iti matvā ca śaṃkaram ।।32।।
dhyāyantaḥ prārthayāmāsuratyarthaṃ ca prabhāsake ।
kṣetre śṛgālanāmnyeva yatra guptaprayāgakaḥ ।। 33।।
tatra prāptāśca te sarve taponiṣṭhāstapoghanāḥ ।
bhṛguratristathā maṃkiḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇva ityapi ।।34।।
gautamaḥ kauśikaścāpi kuśikaśca mahātapāḥ ।
jātūkarṇyo vasiṣṭhaśca satyatapāḥ parāśaraḥ ।।35।।
śāṇḍilyaśca pulastyaśca vatsaḥ sāvastirityapi ।
śūkaro'pi bharadvājo bhārgavo dīrghatāpasaḥ ।।36।।
ete cānye'pi bahavo'gastyādyāḥ ṛṣayo hi te ।
tapaḥ kṛtvā haraṃ dhyātvā tallīnāste tadā'bhavan ।।37।।
śaṃbhustadā tu sākṣādvai samājagāma tānprati ।
uvāca varadānārthaṃ te ca sveṣṭaṃ pravavrire ।।38।।
yadi prasanno deveśa gaṃgāmānaya prāgiha ।
abhiṣekaṃ tatra kṛtvā'rcayitvā tvāṃ tataḥ param ।।39।।
ajñānātte pradrogdhāro yāsyāmaḥ pūtatāṃ tataḥ ।
dvābhyāṃ vayaṃ ca netrābhyāṃ na jñātaḥ śaṃkaro bhavān ।।1.548.40।।
tena jātaste'parādhaḥ punaḥ syānna tathā ca naḥ ।
dehi śaṃbho tṛtīyaṃ ca netraṃ divyaṃ yathā tava ।।41।।
harerharasya cānyeṣāṃ pratyakṣaḥ syāt pramāṇadhṛk ।
paricayastathā cakṣurāntaraṃ dehi śaṃkara ।।42।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathā'stveva yūyaṃ pāvanapāvanāḥ ।
trinetrāśca sadā santu gaṃgā ceyaṃ samāgatā ।।43।।
ityuktvā śaṃkarastūrṇaṃ tatsthānād vigato'bhavat ।
ṛṣayaḥ pāpamuktāśca śaṃkarasya prasādataḥ ।।44।।
yajñaṃ cakruvaiṣṇavaṃ ca tatra kṣetre dināṣṭakam ।
brāhmaṇā devatāścānye tīrthānyaraṇyadevatāḥ ।।45।।
samājagmustasya yajñe nārāyaṇaprasādajam ।
annaṃ bhuktvā parāṃ tṛptiṃ gatā vai prāṇino'pare ।।46।।
jalajāḥ sthalajāḥ sarve tṛptāstatra śubhe kratau ।
matsyāḥ prāhurmunīn sarvān yathā vai dhīvarā hi naḥ ।।47।।
jighāṃsavo na hanyurvai tathā''śīrdīyatāṃ hi naḥ ।
ṛṣayaśca tadā prāhustrinetrāśca bhavantu vai ।।48।।
tṛtīyaṃ divyanetraṃ ca dūradarśanakārakam ।
śāṃkaraṃ rūpamevaitad bhavatāṃ jāyatāṃ sadā ।।49।।
dhīvarebhyaśca ṛṣibhiḥ śāṃkarāste pradarśitāḥ ।
trinetrā vai śubhā matsyā na hantavyāḥ kadācana ।।1.548.50 ।।
trinetratve kāraṇaṃ ca proktaṃ gaṃgā''game tathā ।
tatra kuṇḍe samāgatya snātvā matsyān vilokayet ।।51 ।।
tebhyo dadyāccaṇakādīn hemaṃ viprāya cārpayet ।
gāśca vastraṃ tilān dadyāt trinetraḥ sa bhaved dhruvam ।।52।।
ṛṣitoyājale snātvā kuṇḍe taptodake tathā ।
śaṃkaraṃ pūjayettatra sa bhaved bhuvanādhipaḥ ।।53।।
tatra caturmukhaścāste vināyako mahābalaḥ ।
somavāre pūjayitvā sveṣṭakāmān labhejjanaḥ ।।54।।
tato gacchet paraṃ tīrthaṃ gopālasvāminaṃ harim ।
sarvapāpaughaśamanaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam ।।55।।
bakulasvāminaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapūjayet ।
uttarārkaṃ tato gacchet sarvarogapraṇāśanam ।।56।।
samudrasya taṭe tatra ṛṣitīrthaṃ hi vidyate ।
pāṣāṇākṛtayastatra dṛśyante ṛṣayaḥ sadā ।।57।।
maruddevīṃ tato yāyānmarudbhiḥ pūrvapūjitām ।
kṣemādityaṃ tato gacchecchabarasthānamadhyagam ।।58।।
tato gacchenmahādevīṃ śubhrāṃ kaṇṭakaśodhinīm ।
ṛṣitoyātaṭe yajñaṃ cakruḥ purā maharṣayaḥ ।।59।।
dhūmaiḥ samāvṛtaṃ vyoma yajñahomāgnihotrajaiḥ ।
ghrātvā daityāḥ samudrasya madhyāttatra samāyayuḥ ।।1.548.6 0।।
māyāvino mahākāyāḥ śyāmavarṇā mahodarāḥ ।
lambabhrūśmaśrunāsāgrā raktākṣaraktamūrdhajāḥ ।।6 1।।
upadravaṃ ca te cakruryajñavidhvaṃsahetave ।
etān dṛṣṭvā ṛṣayaśca dudruvurbhayakātarāḥ ।।62।।
patnīśālāṃ samāviṣṭāḥ keciddharyayutā drutam ।
agnihotrahaviṣyaṃ ca havirvinyasya mantrataḥ ।।63।।
susamiddhe juhuvuśca rakṣasāṃ nāśahetave ।
hutamātre samutpannā śaktiṃrlokabhayaṃkarā ।।64।।
khaḍgaśaktitriśūlāsicarmahastā mahojjvalā ।
tayā te nihatā daityāḥ samastā atha tā tadā ।।65।।
tuṣṭuvuḥ ṛṣayaḥ sarve prasannā sā'pyuvāca tān ।
varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ munayo dadāmyatra yathepsitam ।।66।।
munayo vavrire devakaṇṭakānāṃ viśodhinī ।
kaṇṭakaśodhinīnāmnī sthāne'tra vasa rakṣa naḥ ।।67।।
evamastu samuvāca tatraiva ca sthitā tataḥ ।
aṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ ca pūjayettāṃ hitāvahām ।।68।।
rākṣasebhyaḥ piśācebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate ।
prāpnuyād yajñasiddhiṃ ca phalaṃ kratūdbhavaṃ tathā ।।69।।
tato gacchedunnatākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ cottarabhūsthitam ।
brahmeśvaraṃ pūjayecca tathā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।1.548.70 ।।
ṛṣitoyātaṭe pūrvaṃ tepurvai brāhmaṇāstapaḥ ।
atyugraṃ tena bhikṣuśca bhūtvā nārāyaṇo yayau ।।71 ।।
tataḥ śaṃbhurvṛṣo bhūtvā cacāra ṛṣisannidhau ।
trikāladarśibhistatra dṛṣṭo nārāyaṇo haraḥ ।।72।।
dṛṣṭamātro virarāma śaṃkaro vṛṣarūpavān ।
tatra śaṃbhurliṃgarūpaḥ saṃjātaścaṇḍikeśvaraḥ ।।73।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmi! tadā taiḥ prārthito bahuḥ ।
rakṣaṇārthamāsurebhyastadā mayā niveditam ।।74।।
atra kuruta nagaraṃ nivāsāya mahāprabham ।
hūyantāmagnihotrāṇi devatāḥ sarvadā dvijāḥ ।।75।।
ijyantāṃ vividhairyajñaiḥ kriyatāṃ cāpi pūjanam ।
ātithyaṃ jāyatāṃ nityaṃ bhaktirmama ca niścalā ।।76।।
mama prasādataścānte muktirvaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
ṛṣayaste tadā prāhurnagarā'vanadurbalāḥ ।।77।।
nagareṇeha kiṃ kurmastava bhaktimabhīpsavaḥ ।
mokṣaṃ dehi mahārāja! rakṣaṇaṃ naḥ sadā kuru ।।78।।
hariḥ prāha sadā rakṣāṃ kariṣye bhavatāmaham ।
sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ viśvakarmā samāyayau ।।79।।
yatra caṇḍīśvaraḥ śaṃbhustāṃ bhūmiṃ caturasrikām ।
aṣṭayojanavistīrṇāṃ jagrāha nagarārthikām ।।1.548.80।।
pūrve tu śaṃkaraḥ śrīmān paścime nyaṃkumatyapi ।
uttare svarṇanandā ca dakṣiṇe sāgarāvadhim ।।81 ।।
madhye nāgnaharakṣetraṃ nagaraṃ connataṃ param ।
kārayitvā haristebhyo viprebhyo vāsakāraṇāt ।।82।।
dadau nyūṣustatra viprā homayajñakriyāparāḥ ।
unnato vighnarājaśca tatra rakṣaṇahetave ।।83 ।।
sthāpitaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇena śaṃmusannidhau ।
pūjito dhanadaḥ putrasampadāṃ ca pradaḥ sadā ।।84।।
kāmāँśca muktiṃ ca pradāsyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
vāstukārye gaṇeśaṃ ca śaṃkaraṃ śrīnarāyaṇam ।।85।।
pupūjurviśvakarmāṇaṃ mātṛgaṇāँśca bhūsurān ।
kalaśaṃ saṃpupūjuśca tadā śaṃbhuḥ samāyayau ।।86।।
pratyakṣaḥ kalaśāgre vai kalaśeśastato'bhavat ।
yatra sthale pupūjuśca tatra sthaleśvaro'bhavat ।।87।।
māghamāse'bhavat sarvaṃ nagaraṃ pūjanaṃ tathā ।
tato jātaṃ connatākhyaṃ nagaraṃ vipratīrthakam ।।88।।
viśvakarmeśvaraṃ cāpi liṃgaṃ tatraiva pūjitam ।
brahmā bālasvarūpaśconnatākhye nyavasattataḥ ।।89।।
raivate vāmano bālaḥ prabhāse bālako haraḥ ।
unnate'jo bālarūpo vartate tat trayaṃ samam ।।1.548.90।।
bālarūpe na māyā'sti kāpaṭyaṃ na ca vāsanā ।
mokṣadaṃ bālarūpaṃ vai pūjyaṃ ramyaṃ nirāmayam ।।91।।
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho mohādyā bālarūpiṇi ।
nirmūlā eva notpannā vidyante naiva janmataḥ ।।92।।
saṃgadoṣācca jāyante saṃskārādvā tataḥ param ।
satyaṃ vrataṃ sadā tatra bālake cā'pyahiṃsanam ।।93 ।।
asteyaṃ vartate tatra brahmavadvartanaṃ tathā ।
aparigraha evāpi viśvāso mātṛnodite ।।94।।
rāgeṇa hīnatā cāpi santoṣaṃ udaraṃbharaḥ ।
śuddhiścātmani nirdveṣṭā tapaḥ poṣakadhīnatā ।।95।।
vidyādhyāyaśceśabhāvaḥ sarve santi hi bālake ।
saṃsārasya ca yadrūpaṃ viṣayābhigatipradam ।।96।।
tattatra bālake nāsti tasmād viṣṇurhi bālakaḥ ।
sarpo'pi bālakaṃ matvā prasṛpya bālakopari ।।97।।
nirbhayaśca prayātyevā'jātaśatrukabālatā ।
yasya kasyāpi vā'patyaṃ sadayaṃ lokyate sadā ।।98।।
sarvayonigatairjīvaiḥ premṇā saṃlokyate tathā ।
nārāyaṇasvarūpatvaṃ tadeva bālake matam ।।99।।
dhruvaṃ bālaṃ ca prahlādaṃ sanakādīṃstathā śukam ।
bālaṃ kṛṣṇasvarūpaṃ cārādhya mokṣaṃ gatāḥ purā ।। 1.548.10 0।।
yauvane vārdhake vāpi nare nāryāṃ napuṃsake ।
syād yadi bālabhāvaśced doṣā'saṃkramaṇaṃ tathā ।। 101 ।।
pūjyate devavat so'pi nirdoṣo bālako yataḥ ।
doṣahīnaṃ ca vārdhakyaṃ doṣahīnā ca bālatā ।। 1 02।।
dvayoḥ sāmyaṃ ca nairmalye pāvitryasya sthale hyubhe ।
bālaṃ namanti vai candraṃ bālaṃ paśyanti mātaraḥ ।। 103।।
bālāṃ kanyāmudvahanti bālaṃ gṛhṇantyavaṃśinaḥ ।
balaṃ nārāyaṇīyaṃ ca svacchaṃ yatrāsti sargajam ।। 1 04।।
tadvān bālaḥ sampradiṣṭastasmādbālo narāyaṇaḥ ।
vidyādānaṃ bālakebhyo bhojyadānaṃ sahāyatām ।। 1 05।
samarpayanti janatāstasmād bālaḥ praśasyate ।
brahmacaryaṃ sadā bāle brahmaṇo rūpameva yat ।। 1 06।
tasmād bālo brahmacārī brahmalokā'dhikāravān ।
brahmamokṣapradaścāpi yathā kṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 07।।
gaurīṃ ca bālikāṃ saumyāṃ saṃpūjya labhate phalam ।
pārvatīpūjanasyāpi lakṣmyarcanasya cāpi vai ।। 108 ।।
arajaskāḥ sadā devyo divi vasanti bālikāḥ ।
sāvitrī cāpi gāyatrī śrīśca lakṣmīśca bālikāḥ ।। 109।।
tasya svāmī sadā bālo brahmā kṛṣṇo harastathā ।
lokāḥ svānugatairbhāvaiḥ kalpayanti suyauvanam ।। 1.548.110 ।।
svavad vikṛtakākārān divyānapyatyadivyakān ।
doṣahīnān sadā śuddhān daityā gṛhṇanti doṣitān ।। 111 ।।
sadoṣe vai kathaṃ mokṣo nirdoṣe vāsanā katham ।
tasmānnirdoṣakā devā bālā mokṣapradāḥ sadā ।। 112।।
bālā nityāḥ sadā muktā rājante brahmadhāmani ।
sadā kiśorā divyāśca praśastā bālakāstataḥ ।। 11 3।।
ityevamuktavān śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyai connatādikam ।
tīrthaṃ mayā ca te lakṣmi! kathitaṃ mokṣadaṃ śravāt ।। 1 14।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne guptaprayāgatīrthaśṛgāleśvarakṣetrā'paranārāyaṇatīrthatrinetratīrthonnatanagarasthāneśvarādinaikatīrthanirūpaṇaṃ bālatātparyārthanirūpaṇaṃ cetyādināmā'ṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 548 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 548 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 549
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 550 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyai prāha vacmi tat ।
tīrthaṃ mokṣakara smṛddhipradaṃ connatamaṇḍale ।। 1 ।।
durgādityaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ vināyakasutīrthakam ।
yatra gajasvarūpadhṛg vināyako'bhavatpurā ।। 2 ।।
mahākāleśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ mahat ।
mahodayaṃ paraṃ tīrthamṛṣitoyājalasthitam ।। 3 ।।
talasvāmyabhidhe tīrthe kṣetrapaḥ kālameghakaḥ ।
vartate vanarakṣārthaṃ siṃhāṇyanivāsakṛt ।। 4 ।।
nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śaṃkhāvartatīrthaṃ hi śobhanam ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇagṛhād dakṣiṇe goṣpadaṃ varam ।। 5 ।।
tīrthaṃ cānantanāgena rakṣitaṃ viṣṇubhoginā ।
snātā śrāddhasya ca kartā tārayedekaviṃśatim ।। 6 ।।
kulānāṃ ca svayaṃ mokṣaṃ svargaṃ samprāpnuyācchubham ।
pade pade'śvamedhasya phalavān syācca tīrthakṛt ।। 7 ।।
guptagayā'pi sā proktā viṣṇunā svayameva tat ।
gandhadānena gandhādi saubhāgyaṃ puṣpadānataḥ ।। 8 ।।
dhūpadānena rājyāptirdīptyāptirdīpadānataḥ ।
dhvajadānātpāpahāniryātrayā brahmalokabhāk ।। 9 ।।
goṣpadaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ tatra vṛttaṃ purā śṛṇu ।
aṃgarājño'bhavatputro veno nāma prajāpatiḥ ।। 1.549.1 0।।
sa mātāmahadoṣeṇa kālakanyāsutaḥ khalu ।
sudharmān pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā pāpabuddhirajāyata ।। 11 ।।
sthitimutthāpayāmāsa vedaśāstroditāṃ hi saḥ ।
āsīdiyaṃ matistasya vināśe pratyupasthite ।। 12।।
ahamīḍyaśca pūjyaśca sarvayajñaiśca sarvadā ।
mayi yajñā vidhātavyā mayi hotavyamityapi ।। 1 3।।
ṛṣayaste tadā prāhurmā hyadharmaṃ kuru nṛpa ।
venaḥ prāha mayā sṛṣṭo dharmaścādharma ityapi ।। 14।।
bhavanto māṃ mānayantu śrotavyaṃ kasya vai mayā ।
vīryaśrutatapaḥsatyairmayā ko'nyaḥ samo bhuvi ।।15 ।।
itibruvāṇaṃ munayo'nunetuṃ prabhavo na vai ।
jātāstataścātiruṣṭā jaghnustaṃ tu mahābalam ।। 16 ।।
ātharvaṇena mantreṇa hatvā'sya vāmabāhutaḥ ।
nirmathyotpādayāmāsurniṣādān kṛṣṇavarṇakān ।। 17।।
tumbarāँśca khasān vaindhyān dhīvarān venapāpajān ।
punarmaharṣayaste'tha pāṇiṃ venasya dakṣiṇam ।। 18।।
mamanthuśca tadutpannaḥ pṛthurvai sūryasannibhaḥ ।
dhanurdhvajaṃ tathā śūlaṃ matsyaṃ cakraṃ kare dadhan ।। 19।।
cihnarekhātmakaṃ cāpi bāhyaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca vartma ca ।
tasmin jāte nadā nadyaḥ samudrā bhūdharādayaḥ ।।1.549.20।।
saratnāścābhiṣekāya pṛthuṃ taṃ copatasthire ।
brahmā viṣṇuścāmarāśca ṛṣayo mānavā drumāḥ ।।21 ।।
sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ sarve siṣicustaṃ narādhipam ।
pṛthunā tāḥ prajāḥ sarvā dharmamārgaiḥ sunanditāḥ ।।22।।
akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī siddhantyannāni cintayā ।
sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ puṭake puṭake madhu ।।23 ।।
evaṃ pratāpinaḥ pṛthoryaśogānaṃ tu māgadhaiḥ ।
sūtaiśca bandibhistatra kṛtaṃ bhāvi vicārya ca ।।24।।
bhaviṣyatsarvavṛttāntaṃ vijñāya tu pṛthuḥ svayam ।
tadrītyā dhanurāgṛhya vasudhāmardayad yadā ।।25 ।।
gaurbhūtvā ca mahī tasya śaraṇaṃ tvanvapadyata ।
rājñā jagaddhitārthaṃ sā dugdhā naikapayaḥ prati ।।26।।
pṛthorduhitṛtāṃ prāptā pṛthivī sā'bhavat prathā ।
