venasya sadgatiṃ kartuṃ pṛthuryajñaṃ cakāra ha ।।27।।
nāradaśca tadā prāha veno mleccho'dya vartate ।
pūrvapāpena vai janma marau deśe'sti tasya vai ।।28।।
tamuddhartuṃ tīrthayātrāṃ kuru mokṣo bhaviṣyati ।
pṛthurgato marundeśān nināya pitaraṃ gṛham ।।29।।
tato yayau kurukṣetraṃ mlecchaṃ tatra ca tīrthake ।
snāpayāmāsa vidhinā pāpaṃ tathāpi tiṣṭhati ।।1.549.3 0।।
tīrthaṃ prāha ca veno'yaṃ pūrvapāpātikoṭibhiḥ ।
vyāpto'sya pāpapuñjāni kṣālayituṃ na śakyate ।। 31 ।।
eṣa ghorairmahāpāpairatīva pariveṣṭitaḥ ।
prabhāsaṃ tīrthamāsādya tatra śuddho bhaviṣyati ।।32।।
tatra sarasvatī puṇyā pañcasrotā pravartate ।
tasyā yat pañcamaṃ sroto nyaṃkumatī nigadyate ।।33 ।।
tasyāstaṭe sthitaṃ tīrthaṃ goṣpadaṃ nāma nāmataḥ ।
tatra pretaśilā cāste pretānāṃ muktidāyinī ।।34।।
yatra pretāḥ purā muktā aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ ।
nandinī kāmadhenuryā padaṃ dhṛtvā purā'tra vai ।।35।।
pretānāṃ muktaye tatra sthitā goṣpadameva tat ।
sā prāha me padaṃ pretāḥ pāpahaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā ।। 36 ।।
atrā''gatya jano yaśca snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati ।
gayāsaptaguṇaṃ tasya phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।37।।
ityuktvā pretamokṣaṃ ca kṛtvā'ntardhānamāśu sā ।
yātā pretā api muktiṃ gatāstatra tu goṣpade ।।38।।
tataḥ pṛthuryayau tatra goṣpade mlecchasaṃyutaḥ ।
agre kṛtvā brāhmaṇān sa yayau nyaṃkumatītaṭam ।।39।।
vilokya goṣpade kṣetre padaṃ pretaśilāsthitam ।
cakāra kuṇḍān vedīśca maṇḍapān yajñasiddhaye ।।1.549.40।।
tatra yajñaḥ samārabdho vidhivad bhūridakṣiṇaḥ ।
pratyakṣaṃ pitarastasya babhūvurjvalanaprabhāḥ ।।41 ।।
tṛptāścāhurvayaṃ tṛptāḥ santuṣṭāḥ svargabhāginaḥ ।
rājan dhanyo'si puṇyo'si vayaṃ dhanyatarāstrayaḥ ।।42।।
pitṛṣu caivamukteṣu mleccho venastadā drutam ।
mlecchadehaṃ parityajya divyadeho babhūva ha ।।43।।
uvāca pāpanirmukto gacchāmi tridaśālayam ।
gaccha rājyaṃ sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva putravācyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā ।।44।।
evaṃ śrutvā pṛthuścātimumude ca nanāma tān ।
brāhmaṇān harṣayāmāsa svarṇabhūdhanadānakaiḥ ।।45।।
atha guptaprayāgaṃ ca kṛtvā someśvaraṃ tathā ।
raivatādriṃ parikramya yayau bhadreśvaraṃ tataḥ ।।46।।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthamaśvapaṭṭasarovaram ।
lomaśasyā''śramaṃ dṛṣṭvā'rcayitvā kambharāramām ।।47।।
dṛṣṭvā gopālakṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayitvā pumuttamam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।48।।
siddhakṣetraṃ yamīṃ snātvā nijā''vāsaṃ yayau pṛthuḥ ।
īśvaro bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇāṃśa eva yaḥ ।।49।।
pṛthuḥ sa venavanmuktiṃ yayau cānte hi śāśvatīm ।
śrāddhakāle kathā ceyaṃ śrotavyā saṃhitātmikā ।।।1.549.50।।
tato gacchecchubhaṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇagṛhaṃ param ।
goṣpadād dakṣiṇe cābdhitaṭe tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ ।।5 1।।
kvacijjanārdanastatra kvacicca madhusūdanaḥ ।
kvacit sa puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kvacinnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।।52।।
mahāsurān vinihatya viśrāntiṃ yāti tatra vai ।
kuberatīrthaṃ bālārkaṃ bālārkeśvaramityapi ।।53।।
ambikāsthānamityetat sarvapāpāni nāśayet ।
tato gacched devikāyāstaṭe jāleśvaraṃ śubham ।।54।।
śṛṇu tatra bhavaṃ divyamitihāsaṃ purātanam ।
nābhāgasya ca saṃvādamāpastambataponidheḥ ।।55।।
āpastambaḥ ṛṣiḥ pūrvaṃ vivastraḥ salile vasan ।
prabhāsatīrthe cograṃ vai tapaścakāra mīnavat ।।56।।
śaivālenā'bhavadvyāpto dehaḥ kāṃcanasadṛśaḥ ।
dhīvarā matsyasaṃgrāhā jālena jalamadhyataḥ ।।57।।
matsyaiḥ saha ṛṣiṃ taṃ ca jagṛhurdaivayogataḥ ।
vilokya taṃ maharṣiṃ ca mānavaṃ brahmanandanam ।।58।।
aparāddhamiti matvā nemuḥ śirobhireva tam ।
ūcurajñānajaṃ doṣaṃ dayālo kṣantumarhasi ।।59।।
sevāṃ darśaya dāśānāṃ prasanno bhava suvrata ।
ṛṣiḥ sa kṣamayā yukto dāśān provāca duḥkhitaḥ ।।1.549.60।।
eteṣāṃ jalamatsyānāṃ kadanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ mahat ।
kaivartaiśca militvaiva kāryaṃ matsyaprarakṣaṇam ।।61।।
yato jale nivāsānme matsyā vai bāndhavā yathā ।
svārthaṃ sarve prakurvanti parārthaḥ khalu durlabhaḥ ।।62।।
jñānināmapi ceccetaḥ svārthamātre rataṃ yadi ।
ajñānināṃ tadā kiṃ syād vailakṣaṇyaṃ tu dakṣakaiḥ ।।63।।
jñānino dhyānayogasthāstyajantyajñānino yadi ।
ajñāstu jantavo loke kva prāpsyanti sukhaṃ tataḥ ।।64।।
same duḥkhe samāyāto'balāँstyajati ced balī ।
kiṃ balaṃ svārthapoṣaṃ tadvyarthaṃ pāpaṃ taducyate ।।65।।
śaktaścānyasya duḥkhāni vārayed vai yathābalam ।
paraduḥkhavihantā vai nārāyaṇāṃśa ucyate ।।66।।
pāpātpāpataraṃ taṃ hi pravadanti purātanāḥ ।
sāmarthye sati nānyeṣāṃ duḥkhanāśaṃ karoti yaḥ ।।67।।
mamā'gre syādupāyastu vinā matsyavimocanam ।
nā'haṃ bhoktuṃ samicchāmi yathā matsyāstathānvaham ।।68।।
khādantu māṃ sukhaṃ dāśāḥ saha matsyairyatheṣṭakam ।
tyajantu vā ca tān matsyān mayā saha samāvṛtān ।।6 9।।
jīvo yeṣāṃ ca matsyānāṃ nirgatasteṣu yogataḥ ।
praviśyā'ntarjīvayiṣye tapobhirjīvadānataḥ ।।1.549.70।।
yanmamā'sti śubhaṃ kiñcittaddīnānupagacchatu ।
yat kṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ taistu tadaśeṣamupaitu mām ।।71।।
dhīvarāṇāṃ ca yadduḥkhaṃ me syāttadapi sāmpratam ।
antaḥ praviṣṭaḥ sattvānāṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvaduḥkhabhāk ।।72।।
dṛṣṭvā'ndhān kṛpaṇān vyaṃgānanāthān rogiṇastathā ।
dayā na jāyate yasya sa rakṣa iti me matiḥ ।।73।।
prāṇasaṃśayamāpannān prāṇino bhayavihvalān ।
yo na rakṣati śakto'pi sa pāpaṃ samupāśnute ।।74।।
paropakāreṇā''rtānāṃ sukhaṃ yadupajāyate ।
tasya svargo'pavargo'pi ṣoḍaśārho'pi naiva tu ।।75।।
tasmādetānahaṃ hīnāँstyaktvā bhītān suduḥkhitān ।
varjayitvā na yāsyāmi padamātramito'pi ca ।।76।।
dāśebhyaścaivamevaitadṛṣiṇā viniveditam ।
matsyānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ hitvā na me rakṣā bhaviṣyati ।।77।।
ahaṃ rakṣyo yadi dāśā matsyān muñcantu vai drutam ।
yadvā me tyajane duḥkhaṃ matsyatyāgātmakaṃ yadi ।।78।।
bhavatāṃ jāyate tarhi mūlyaṃ dadātu bhūpatiḥ ।
bhavanto dravyayuktāḥ syuḥ prayatnaphalabhāginaḥ ।।79।।
ahaṃ matsyaiśca sahito bandhaśūnyo bhavāmi ca ।
śrutvā tu dhīvaraiḥ sarvaṃ nābhāgāya niveditam ।।1.549.80।।
nābhāgaścāyayau tatra yatrā''pastambakamatsyakāḥ ।
sa samyak pūjayitvā taṃ devakalpaṃ muniṃ nṛpaḥ ।।81।।
provāca bhagavan brūhi kiṃ karomi tavā''jñayā ।
āpastambo dayāyukto rājānaṃ prāha satvaram ।।82।।
śrameṇa mahatā''viṣṭān kaivartān duḥkhajīvinaḥ ।
śramamaulyaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ madyogyaṃ yaddhi manyase ।।83।।
nābhāga āha dāśebhyaḥ śatasāhasramudrikāḥ ।
suvarṇānāṃ dadāmyatra mūlyaṃ tulyaṃ ca te yadi ।।84।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā nā'haṃ śatasāhasrakairnṛpa ।
niyamyaḥ sadṛśaṃ me'tra mūlyaṃ pradīyatāṃ param ।।85।।
rājā''ha koṭimūlyaṃ vai niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā nāhaṃ niyamyaḥ koṭibhirnṛpa ।।86।।
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha cintaya ।
rājā''ha rājyamardhaṃ vai niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām ।।87।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha samastaṃ vai rājyaṃ me sadṛśaṃ na vai ।
sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamṛṣibhiḥ saha cintaya ।।88।।
maharṣaistadvacaḥ śrutvā nābhāgo'bhūd viṣādavān ।
etasminnantare tatra lomaśastu mahātapāḥ ।।89।।
kuṃkumavāpikākṣetrād āpastambaṃ samāyayau ।
jñātvā vṛttāntamāścaryakaraṃ nābhāgamabravīt ।।1.549.90।।
mā viṣādaṃ gaccha rājan mūlyam ṛṣerna kānakam ।
kintu viprāstathā gāvo divyāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayaṃbhuvā ।।91 ।।
ekasmādeva tattvād vai divyād divyāśca te ca tāḥ ।
divyaṃ divyasya mūlyaṃ gaurmūlyamasyai pradīyatām ।।92।।
śrutvā rājā saharṣo'bhūt provāca jālagaṃ munim ।
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhagavan gavā krīto mayā mune ।।93।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha tvayā samyak krīto'smi vai gavā nṛpa ।
godvayaṃ mama mūlyaṃ vai pavitraṃ paramaṃ śuci ।।94।।
gāvaḥ pradakṣiṇīkāryāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ ।
maṃgalāyatanā divyāḥ sṛṣṭā hyetāḥ svayaṃbhuvā ।।95।।
sthānāgārāṇi viprāṇāṃ devatāyatanāni ca ।
yadgomayena śuddhyanti kimasmādadhikaṃ punaḥ ।।96।।
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpistathaiva ca ।
gavāṃ pañca pavitrāṇi punanti sakalaṃ jagat ।।97।।
gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ santu ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ।
gāvo me hṛdaye'gre ca gomadhye ca vasāmyaham ।।98।।
tenā'gnayo hutāḥ samyak pitaraścāpi tarpitāḥ ।
devāśca pūjitāstena yo dadāti gavāhnikam ।।99।।
saurabheyī jagatpūjyā devī viṣṇupade sthitā ।
sarvametanmayā dattaṃ mayā dattaṃ pratīcchatu ।। 1.549.10 0।।
rakṣaṇād dhenuputrāṇāṃ gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaistathā ।
kṣīṇārttarakṣaṇāccāpi janaḥ svarge mahīyate ।। 101 ।।
ādau gāvo bahiścāpi madhye cānte prakīrtitāḥ ।
rakṣanti tāstu devānāṃ kṣīrājyamamṛtaṃ sadā ।। । 10 2।।
tasmād gāvaḥ pradātavyāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ ।
svargasya saṃgamāyaitāḥ sopānamiva nirmitāḥ ।। 1 03।।
etacchrutvā ṛṣervākyaṃ niṣādā api satvaram ।
gomāhātmyaṃ vidantaśca natvā''pastambamabruvam ।। 1 04।।
saṃbhāṣā darśanaṃ sparśaḥ kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā ।
pāvanāni kilaitāni sādhūnāṃ yogināṃ sadā ।। 1 05।।
vayaṃ hi pāvitāstasmānnābhāgād godvayaṃ śubham ।
bhavanmū.ṃ gṛhītaṃ yat pūjayiṣyāma eva gām ।। 1 06।।
bhavānmuktastathā matsyā muktā muktaṃ ca godvayam ।
vayaṃ muktāśca nābhāgo muktaḥ sādhusamāgamāt ।। 107।।
bhavān pūjyastathā matsyāḥ pūjyāḥ pūjyaṃ ca godvayam ।
vayaṃ pūjyāśca nābhāgaḥ pūjyaḥ sādhu samāgamāt ।। 108।।
ṛṣiḥ prāha mayā mūlyaṃ mamaiva godvayaṃ kṛtam ।
lomaśasyopadeśena prasanno'smi tataḥ punaḥ ।। 10 9।।
karomi śubhasakalpa matsyā bhavantu jīvitāḥ ।
godvayasya pradānena matsyā yāsyanti jīvanam ।। 1.549.11 0।।
tasmād goyugalaṃ devaṃ brāhmaṇāya mahātmane ।
tena matsyāḥ prajīveyuryūyaṃ syurdoṣavarjitāḥ ।। 111 ।।
tadā śrutvā dhīvaraistad godvayaṃ munaye tadā ।
āpastambāya tatraivā'rpitaṃ nidoṣatā'rjitā ।। 1 12।।
ṛṣiḥ prasannastānprāha paśyantu mīnamaṇḍalam ।
godvayasya pradānena jīvitaṃ punareva hi ।। 1 13।।
tathokte jīvitā matsyā yayuḥ sāmudravāriṣu ।
vyaṃgīkṛtāśca ye matsyāstathā vai śātitāśca ye ।। 1 14।।
teṣāṃ muktyarthamāpastambarṣiḥ prāha punarvacaḥ ।
eṣa vaḥ pratigṛhṇāmi gāmimāṃ tapprapuṇyataḥ ।। 1 15।।
niṣādā gacchata svarga saha matsyairanagakaiḥ ।
prāṇināṃ prītimutpādya ninditenāpi karmaṇā ।। 1 16।।
narakaṃ yadi prāpsyāmi paśyāmi svargameva tat ।
yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiñcinmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ ।। 1 17।।
kṛtaṃ tenaiva duḥkhārtāḥ sarve yāntu śubhāṃ gatim ।
tatastasya prasādena niṣādāḥ sahamatsyakaiḥ ।। 1 18।।
divaṃ gatāśca tān vīkṣya nābhāgaḥ samuvāca ha ।
sevyāḥ śreyo'rthibhiḥ santaḥ puṇyatīrthajalopamāḥ ।। 119।
kṣaṇopāsanamapyatra na yeṣāṃ niṣphala bhavet ।
sadbhiḥ sahā''sanaṃ kārya sadbhiḥ kurvīta satkathām ।। 1.549.120।
satāṃ vṛttena varteta nāsadbhiḥ kiñcidācaret ।
satāṃ samāgamādeva samatsyā matsyajīvinaḥ ।। 121 ।।
triviṣṭapamanuprāptā yathā'śvamedhayājinaḥ ।
āpastambo munistatra lomaśaśca mahāmuniḥ ।। 122।।
varaistaṃ vividhairiṣṭaiśchandayāmāsa bhūpatim ।
ṛṣistaṃ kārayāmāsa yajñasaṃkalpamādarāt ।। 1 23।।
tatheti cokte vai prītyā''pastambaḥ praśaśaṃsa tam ।
aho dhanyo'si rājendra dharme te vartate matiḥ ।। 124।।
ājñāṃ gṛhṇāsi viprasya dhanyaṃ kuṭumbamityapi ।
rājānastu madāviṣṭāḥ prāyo gṛhṇanti naiva ca ।। 125।।
brāhmaṇānāṃ vaco nityavyasanā''hatabuddhayaḥ ।
dhruvaṃ janma dhruvo moho dhruvo narako bhūbhṛtām ।। 1 26।।
rājyaṃ te bahumantāro viyantyāsurajaṃ kulam ।
manīṣiṇastu paśyanti rājyādi narakopamam ।। 1 27।।
paralokaṃ sādhayanti śāśvatīṃ gatimātmanaḥ ।
evamuktvā mahātmānau jagmatuḥ svaṃ svamāśramam ।। 1 28।।
nābhāgo'pi varaṃ prāpya yayau svaṃ nagaraṃ prati ।
kratuṃ cakāra vidhivat śatruṃjitātaṭe śubham ।। 129।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīkamalāpatim ।
samijya ca yayāvante brahmā'kṣarapadaṃ param ।। 1.549.130।।
jālasthale tu ṛṣiṇā sthāpitau viṣṇuśaṃkarau ।
jāleśvaraṃ ca tatkṣetraṃ prakhyātaṃ samabhūt purā ।। 131 ।।
devikāyāstaṭe tatra nābhāgo matsyajīvinaḥ ।
āpastambo lomaśaśca matsyā nārāyaṇastathā ।। 132।।।
smṛtamātrā muktidāste bhavanti muktigā yataḥ ।
caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ jātaṃ vṛttāntameva yat ।। 1 33।।
śrāddhaṃ yātrāṃ dhenudānaṃ kuryāttatra jano yadi ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhetātra paratrāpi yathepsitam ।। 1 34।।
śaṃbhuḥ satīṃ yathā prāha lakṣmi! te kathitaṃ mayā ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi svargamokṣapradaṃ bhavet ।। 1 35।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durgādityagoṣpadavenanṛpaśuddhimuktinārāyaṇagṛhajāleśvaratīrtha nābhāgā''pastambarṣicaritrādivarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।549।।


← adhyāyaḥ 549 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 550
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 551 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatyai samuvāca yat ।
tīrthavaryaṃ kathayāmi te'pi svargādidāyakam ।। 1 ।।
devikāyāstaṭe tvāsīt tuṇḍīnāmā ṛṣiḥ purā ।
kūpastatrā'bhavattvekaḥ ṛṣeryogātsa muktikṛt ।। 2 ।।
hariṇāḥ patitāstatra jalapānārthamugragāḥ ।
mṛtāste muninā sarve jīvitāstapaso balāt ।। 3 ।।
jalaṃ hūṃkāramātreṇa pūritaṃ kūpagaṃ tadā ।
taṭoparito vahati camatkārakaraṃ yataḥ ।। 4 ।।
tatra tuṇḍīśvaro devaḥ sthāpitastena tīrthakam ।
tatra tīrthaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā hyāśāpuraṃ gaṇeśvaram ।। 5 ।।
gacchennaivedyamādhāya dānaṃ dadyāttu kānakam ।
tato gacchet kāpilaṃ tu tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham ।। 6 ।।
kapilau raivataṃ gacchan yatrovāsa hi vatsaram ।
kapilā sā nadī tatra tīrtharūpā vyajāyata ।। 7 ।।
prauṣṭhapadyasite pakṣe ṣaṣṭhyāṃ bhaumo bhaved yadi ।
vyatīpātaśca rohiṇyāṃ sā ṣaṣṭhī kapilā matā ।। 8 ।।
kapilāsaṃgame ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kapilāyāṃ samāhitaḥ ।
snātvā śrīkapilaṃ viṣṇuṃ pūjayedarkabhūsthitam ।। 9 ।।
kapilā kapilo viṣṇuḥ rakṣatāṃ ceti cārthayet ।
kapilāṃ gāṃ pradadyācca vājimedhaphalaṃ bhavet ।। 1.550.1 0।।
hāṭakeśaṃ tatastīrthaṃ prakuryāt pāvanaṃ param ।
tato gacchedagastyasyāśramaṃ vatsarasevitam ।।1 1 ।।
kālakeyāḥ purā daityāḥ samudrāntarnivāsinaḥ ।
rātrau pṛthvyāṃ samāgamya suptān viprādikān muhuḥ ।। 1 2।।
bhakṣayanti sma tān jñātvā kālakeyān vihiṃsakān ।
agastyaḥ saṃyayau tatra samudrasya taṭaṃ prati ।। 13 ।।
tapaścakāra vidhivad varṣamātraṃ taṭe sthitaḥ ।
caturthyāṃ phālgune māsi naktāhāraṃ vidhāya saḥ ।। 14।।
pañcamyāṃ tilapiṣṭaṃ ca bhuktvā homaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
evaṃ caturṣu māseṣu kṛtvaikabhojanaṃ tataḥ ।। 15।।
nirāhāraḥ samabhavannirvighnavratamuttamam ।
varṣottaraṃ sa munirāṭ lokarakṣāṃ vyacintayat ।। 16।।
paśyadhvaṃ kautukaṃ devāḥ samīnamakarādikam ।
añjalinā pibāmyenaṃ śoṣayāmi mahārṇavam ।। 17।।
evamuktvā hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā brahmāṇamāntaram ।
gaṇḍūṣamakarot sarvaṃ samudraṃ saritāṃ patim ।।18।।
kālakeyā vinaṣṭāśca pācitaṃ jalamityapi ।
tataśca meghavarṣairvai samudrāḥ sajalāḥ punaḥ ।। 1 9।।
ityāgastyāśramaṃ ramyaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ।
lopāmudrāsahitaṃ māṃ yaścā'trā''gatya pūjayet ।।1.550.20।।
hāṭakeśo mayā nītastaṃ vidhinā prapūjayet ।
ayane cottare martyo golakṣaphalamāpnuyāt ।।21।।
bhadrāśvo nṛpatistatrā'gastyadarśanakāṃkṣayā ।
samājagāma cānarca papraccha kuśalaṃ prati ।।22।।
āścaryaṃ yadi te kiñcid viditaṃ dṛṣṭameva vā ।
tanme kathaya dharmajña tato yāmi prabhāsakam ।।23।।
agastyastaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha śvetadvīpodbhavāṃ kathām ।
āścaryarūpo bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।।24।।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthe rājate puruṣottamaḥ ।
tasyāścaryāṇi dṛṣṭāni bahūni vividhāni ca ।।।25।।।
so'yaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ śete śvetadvīpe'pi sarvadā ।
nāradaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā surāṣṭrake ।।26।।
māthure śrīrādhikeśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tataḥ param ।
himādrau śrīnaranārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yayau muniḥ ।।27।।
śvetadvīpaṃ tatra so'yaṃ dadarśa samarūpiṇaḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmānpuruṣāँstigmatejasaḥ ।।28।।
sadṛśān sadṛśākārān sadṛśaguṇavaibhavān ।
kiśorān rūpasampannān sughaṭāṃśca manoharān ।।29।।
ayaṃ viṣṇurayaṃ viṣṇureṣa viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ ।
cintā'bhūttasya tān dṛṣṭvā ko'smin viṣṇuriti prabhuḥ ।।1.550.30।।
kasmai natvā tato'nyāँśca paśyāmi khalu bhāvataḥ ।
nyūnasya prathame pūjye pūjyapūjāvyatikrame ।।3 1 ।।
āyuryaśojñānahāniḥ pratyavāyo'dhiko bhavet ।
evaṃ cintayatastasya cittaṃ kṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।32।।
cintā yuktaṃ mudhā jātaṃ kathamārādhayāmi tam ।
yena vedmi paraṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ karomi kim ।।33।।
evaṃ saṃcintya dadhyau sa taṃ devaṃ parameśvaram ।
dhyātastasya kāṃbhareyaḥ paritoṣaṃ jagāma ha ।।34।।
uvāca sa prasannaḥ san sākṣād bhūtvā narāyaṇaḥ ।
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te dṛṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ mama tvayā ।।35।।
ye'tra loke samāyānti sārūpyādicatuṣṭayam ।
teṣāṃ bhavati tvatraiva brūhi kiṃ te dadāmyaham ।। 36।।
nāradaḥ prāha te prāptiryathā syāt tacca me vada ।
nārāyaṇastadā prāha pauruṣaṃ sūktameva me ।।37।।
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣo yatrā'haṃ varṇito mune ।
tadāsthāya janā ye māṃ prayakṣyanti narāyaṇam ।।38।।
te māṃ prāpsyanti satataṃ saṃhitā'dhyayanena ca ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitoktamārgeṇa ye janāḥ ।।39।।
pūjayiṣyanti māṃ bhaktāste prāpsyanti vai dhruvam ।
mama kṣetraṃ gamiṣyanti me kariṣyanti darśanam ।।1.550.40।।
sevāṃ satāṃ kariṣyanti te māṃ prāpsyanti niścitam ।
mannāma vihitaṃ bhinnaṃ sarveṣāṃ raṭanāya vai ।।41।।
vinā pūjāṃ nāmabhaktyā'vaśyaṃ prāpsyanti māṃ janāḥ ।
sarvaṃ jñānaṃ tava mune prakāśaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ।।42।।
mama darśanayogyaṃ ca muktadarśanayogyakam ।
sarvaṃ vivekajaṃ jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati ca te mune ।।43।।
ityuktvā bhagavāँsteṣu sadṛśeṣu ca viṣṇuṣu ।
yayau punarnāradaśca jñātavānnaiva taṃ prabhum ।।44।।
matvā cā'darśanaṃ viṣṇoḥ samāneṣu ca viṣṇuṣu ।
tāṃ diśaṃ praṇipatyaiva nāradastu divaṃ prati ।।45।।
yāsyan yatra surāṣṭre cā'gastyo'haṃ nivasāmi vai ।
tatrā''gatya kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā yayau vaihāyasaṃ puram ।।46।।
tadvai nāradatīrthaṃ ca sthalaṃ jñānapradaṃ śubham ।
bhadrāśvo'pi muniṃ natvā yayau prabhāsakaṃ prati ।।47।।
ityevaṃ śvetabhūmisthaṃ jñātvā nārāyaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
viśālāsthaṃ yāmunasthaṃ kuṃkumavāpikāsthitam ।।48।।
akṣarāt pararūpaṃ ca jñātvā mokṣaṃ hi vindati ।
smaran viṣṇuṃ paṭhanvedān dadan dānaṃ yajan harim ।।49।।
sādhūn santoṣayan bhakto mokṣabhāṅ nā'tra saṃśayaḥ ।
tīrthaṃ sādhumayaṃ sādhvīmayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pramokṣadam ।।1.550.50।।
tato gacched bhīmanāthatīrthe bhītinivārakam ।
suparṇeśīṃ tataḥ paśyet suparṇaṃ ca narāyaṇam ।।51।।
kaubereśīṃ tato gacchettato bhallaṃ sutīrthakam ।
bhallatīrthe sadā viṣṇurvartate gaṃgayā saha ।।52।।
gaṃgā ca vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ pāvanaṃ mūrtimad yataḥ ।
vallakena niṣādena viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sanātanaḥ ।।53।।
bhallaṃ dhanuṣi sandhāya hṛto golokago'bhavat ।
vallako'pi mṛgabhrāntyā plakṣadrustambasaṃsthitam ।।54।।
viṣṇuṃ jaghāna bhallena gatvā paśyati mādhavam ।
tuṣṭāva ca tataḥ khinnaḥ prāptavāँstadanugraham ।।55।।
yayau tatraiva golokaṃ viṣṇunā saha dhīvaraḥ ।
bhallakṣetraṃ hi tatproktaṃ viddhaḥ pādatale hariḥ ।।56।।
mokṣadaṃ svargadaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ janmamaraṇavedhakṛt ।
tato gaccheddhiraṇyāyā uttare raivataṃ prati ।।57।।
kauśikaṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ tato vastrāpathātmakam ।
dāmodaraṃ raivatakaṃ bhavamindreśvaraṃ tathā ।58।।
cakrodyānaṃ revatītīrthakaṃ vāsiṣṭhakāśramam ।
śṛṇu cāsyā bhūmerlakṣmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm ।।59।।
gajo nāmā'bhavadrājā bhāryayā saha pārthivaḥ ।
gaṃgājalābhiṣekārtha yayāvuvāsa tatra ca ।।1.550.60।।
bhadro nāma munistasyā''jagāma purataḥ kvacit ।
taṃ gajaḥ prāha mokṣārthaṃ jñānaṃ dehi mune mama ।।61 ।।
bhadraḥ prāha svayaṃ cātmā tīrthaṃ sarveṣu pāvanam ।
tatrā''ste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastīrthottamottamam ।।62।।
tasya jñānaṃ smṛtirūpaṃ paraṃ jñānamihocyate ।
anyat sarvaṃ jñānamātraṃ medhābhārakaraṃ nṛpa ।।63।।
tīrthāni toyapūrṇāni devāḥ pāṣāṇamṛnmayāḥ ।
ātmasthaṃ yena paśyanti te na paśyanti taṃ param ।।64।।
santi tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ।
puṇyatoyāḥ pavitrāśca sāgarāḥ saritastathā ।।65।।
jñānaṃ teṣāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ jñānottamottamaṃ matam ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ narāyaṇam ।।66।।
matsyaṃ varāhaṃ nṛvyāghraṃ vāmanaṃ kacchapaṃ harim ।
rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।67।।
hariṃ śrīkapilaṃ dattātreyaṃ buddhaṃ ca raiṇukam ।
vāsudevaṃ pṛthuṃ haṃsamṛṣabhaṃ ca kumārakān ।।68।।
nāradaṃ ca kratuṃ cāśvagrīvaṃ vyāsaṃ janārdanam ।
mohakaṃ rājarājaṃ ca kalkaghnaṃ ca pumuttamam ।।6 9।।
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śvetadvīpapatiṃ prabhum ।
śeṣasthaṃ padmanābhaṃ ca jagannāthaṃ raṇasthitam ।।1.550.70।।
nāmāni tasya vāsāni smṛtvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।
gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva nadī godāvarī śubhā ।।71 ।।
śatadruśca tathā vindhyā payodhā varadā tathā ।
carmaṇvatī ca sarayū gaṇḍakī caṇḍapāpahā ।।72।।
candrabhāgā vipāśā ca śoṇā brahmasutā tathā ।
etāścānyāśca yā bahvyo himāśrayādayo'drayaḥ ।।73।।
nāmoccāreṇa yeṣāṃ hi pāpaṃ yāti vināśanam ।
aśvapaṭṭasarasaśca mānasasarasastathā ।।74।।
nārāyaṇasarasaśca puṣkarasarasastathā ।
indradyumnasarasaśca smaraṇādeva mokṣyate ।।75।।
kānyakubje mārgaśīrṣe hyuṣitvā svargamāpnuyāt ।
arbude pauṣapūrṇāyāṃ māghyāṃ gayāsutīrthake ।।76।।
phālgunyāṃ himavatpṛṣṭhe caitryāṃ vaset prabhāsake ।
aśvinyāṃ kuṃkumavāpyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ cāpyavantike ।।77।।
jyeṣṭhyāṃ trikūpake caiva śrāvaṇyāṃ pūrvasāgare ।
bhādryāṃ sārasvate caiva kārtikyāṃ raivatācale ।।78।।
kāpile ca tathā dvīpe śālagrāme'pi bhūtale ।
dīpotsavyāṃ cāndrabhāge śrāddhaṃ snānaṃ japaṃ caret ।।79।।
goloke'kṣaradhāmni vaikuṇṭhe kailāsake'thavā ।
yathābhaktiṃ bhaved vāso vratināṃ tīrthaśālinām ।।1.550.80।।
māsānāṃ kārtikaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kārtike bhīṣmapañcakam ।
tatrāpi dvādaśī śreṣṭhā rājan dāmodare jale ।।81 ।।
somanāthasya sānnidhye udayānto girirmahān ।
tasya paścimabhāge tu raivatādriḥ smṛto mahān ।।82।।
nadī tatra ca vahati suvarṇarekhikā śubhā ।
dhātavastatra tu raktāḥ śvetā nīlā vicitrakāḥ ।।83।।
pāṣāṇā kuṃjarākārāḥ svarṇagairikasannibhāḥ ।
vṛkṣā vallyaśca gulmāśca kāñcanānāṃ samudbhavāḥ ।।84।।
tatra nadyāṃ svarṇalekhānāmnyāṃ nārāyaṇo hradaḥ ।
dāmodarahradaścāpi rādhāderīti cāpi vai ।।85।।
tatra snātvā jalaṃ pītvā yānti muktiṃ hi dehinaḥ ।
hariścandreṇa balinā śibinā nahuṣeṇa ca ।।86।।
nalena ca mahādānānyarpitāni hi raivate ।
gatāste viṣṇubhavanaṃ śāśvataṃ ca nirāmayam ।।87।।
ityevaṃ bhadravacanaṃ śrutvā gajo janādhipaḥ ।
samāyayau raivatasya prabhāsasya ca tīrthake ।।88।।
datvā dānānyanekāni havirhutvā hutāśane ।
ūrdhvapādaḥ sthito bhūtvā'pibaddhūmamadhomukhaḥ ।।89।।
anye tena sahā''yātāstapaḥ kurvanti vai tathā ।
sarvairvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tatra dhyeyo dāmodaro girau ।।1.550.9 0।।
sakṛduccaritaṃ yena harirityakṣaradvayam ।
baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣopagamanaṃ prati ।।9 1।।
sa rājā ṛṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ yāvat tiṣṭhati tatra vai ।
vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇi tāvattatrā'gatāni vai ।।9 2।।
yeṣu devyo ramādāsyo nārāyaṇasya pārṣadāḥ ।
muktāścānye samabhavan śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ।।93।।
sarvaiścānucaraiḥ sārdhaṃ sa rājā bhāryayā saha ।
gato vimānamārūḍho yadakṣarapadaṃ varam ।।94।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ' ।
iti mantrasya coddhoṣo vimāneṣvakhileṣvapi ।।95।।
satāliko'bhavad vyomni yena svargādivāsinaḥ ।
darśanārthaṃ vimānānāṃ muktānāṃ mārgamadhyagāḥ ।।96।।
avasthāya ca rājānaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ pareśvaram ।
samabhilokayāmāsuḥ pūjayāmāsurīśvarān ।।97।।
evaṃ pitṛmunīnāṃ ca lokān bhittvā'ṇḍakād bahiḥ ।
yayurmokṣapadaṃ sarve kṛtvā tīrthaṃ tu raivatam ।।98।।
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha kṣetrasyaivaṃvidhāṃ kathām ।
mayā lakṣmi! cābhihitā tubhyaṃ mokṣakarī śubhā ।।99।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāttvasyāḥ kathāyāḥ pāpanāśanam ।
svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ paraṃ dhāmā'kṣaraṃ labhet ।। 1.550.10 0।।
idaṃ śrutvā tathā bhaktyā modayitvā praśaṃsayet ।
sarvapāparahitaḥ san paraṃbrahmādhisaṃvrajet ।। 101 ।।
kā mayā procyate lakṣmi! saurāṣṭrasya pavitratā ।
svayaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya maṇirūpiṇaḥ ।। 1 02।।
deśaḥ saurāṣṭraityākhyo mokṣado'sti pade pade ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pūrve'sti sarvadā ।। 1 03।।
paścime vāmano devo dakṣiṇe somanāthakaḥ ।
uttare ca camatkāranagaraṃ dvārikā śubhā ।। 1 04।।
śatruṃjitā svarṇarekhā bhadrā coṣṇā hiraṇyakā ।
devanadī nyaṃkumatī sarito mokṣadāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1 05।।
yatra santi raivataśca śatruṃjayo varāṭakaḥ ।
śālamālo navanītaścānye parvatapuṃgavāḥ ।। 1 06।।
maharṣayaśca bhagavatsvarūpā yatra santi hi ।
satyo lakṣmīsamā yatrā'kṣatā devyo vasanti ca ।। 1 07।।
candro yanmukhamālokya kṣaṇaṃ stabdho bhavatyapi ।
tādṛśyo divyadevyaśca sūryatulyāśca bālakāḥ ।।1 08।।
yatra vasanti śīlasthāḥ sākṣānnārāyaṇo'pi ca ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya gopikāstathā ।। 1 09।।
lakṣaśo yatra saurāṣṭre bhaktā vasanti sevikāḥ ।
sarvo brahmamayo deśo lakṣmi! vaikuṇṭhavanmama ।। 1.550.11 0।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃkaroditameva ṭe ।
pāṭhakāḥ śrāvakāḥ śrotujanā muktā bhavanti ca ।। 111 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tuṇḍīśvarakapilātīrthā'gastyanāradacamatkārabhīmanāthatīrtha- bhallakṣetraraivatatīrthagajanṛpamokṣādīnāṃ sopākhyānavarṇanaṃnāmā pañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 550 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 550 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 551
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 552 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha tīrthāntarāṇi yānyapi ।
saurāṣṭre tāni te vacmi lakṣmi! nibodha me priye! ।। 1 ।।
unnabillaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ gṛhātmakaṃ ca śāṃbhavam ।
gaṃgeśvaraṃ paścime vai raivatād bhāti śobhanam ।। 2 ।।
yakṣeśvarīmahātīrthaṃm upalāttvaṃ ca śobhanam ।
vastrāpathe mahākṣetre nagare vāmane purā ।। 3 ।।
putraśokābhisantapto vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ ।
ājagāma tapastaptuṃ svarṇarekhānadītaṭe ।। 4 ।।
īśānakoṇe nagarāt svarṇarekhānadījale ।
vāsiṣṭhaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ vartate bhuktimuktidam ।। 5 ।।
balikhātaṃ makhatīrthe kṛtasmarasya sannidhau ।
vartate mokṣadaṃ nāthatīrthaṃ lokasya śāntidam ।। 6 ।।
vastrāpathasya vāyavye divyaṃ cāsti sarovaram ।
apsarasāṃ parītālaṃ devāḥ snānti vihāriṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
jālīgahanaśaṃbhuśca devī triśūlinī tathā ।
herambākhyo gaṇeśaśca vartante tīrthavāsinaḥ ।। 8 ।।
paścime sāgare tatra makarālayapattanam ।
kundanākhyaṃ puraṃ cāpi maṇibhadraṃ śubhāśrayam ।। 9 ।।
śrīdāmapuramutkṛṣṭaṃ dvārikākṣetramuttamam ।
evaṃ tīrthāni sāmudre taṭe vasantyanekaśaḥ ।।1.551.1 0।।
evamuktvā mahādevaḥ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm ।
kṛtvā prābhāsikaṃ yajñaṃ śrāvaṇe samupasthite ।। 11 ।।
yayau koṭigaṇairyukto dvārikāṃ nagarīṃ prati ।
śrīkṛṣṇādyāstīrthadevāḥ satkāraṃ cakrurīśvarāḥ ।। 12।।
māsaṃ nītvā kṛṣṇabhūmau camatkārapuraṃ yayuḥ ।
tatra devyaścā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭisaṃkhyā hareṇa pūjitāḥ ।। 1 3।।
navarātravrate sarvāḥ prāpya śrīśaṃkaraṃ patim ।
nimagnāḥ sukhavistāre brahmānandātmasāgare ।। 14।।
āśvine ca yayuḥ sarve parvataṃ tvarbudācalam ।
gaganasthaṃ puṣkaraṃ tu yatra saṃrājate'niśam ।। 15।।
dvitīyaṃ parvataśṛṃge tṛtīyaṃ bhūtale sthitam ।
vasiṣṭhādimaharṣīṇāmāśramā yatra śobhanāḥ ।। 16।।
parvate cākacakyādirūpāśca vālukāḥ śubhāḥ ।
vṛkṣāśca vallikāḥ stambāstāpasā iva bhānti ca ।। 17।।
araṇyānyapi ramyāṇi devodyānāni vai tathā ।
yajñānāṃ bhūmayo yatra tāpasānāṃ ca vedikāḥ ।। 18।।
satīnāṃ sunivāsāśca sādhūnāmāśramāstathā ।
vidyante brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ śubhālayāḥ ।। 1 9।।
sārasvatāni tīrthāni nadā nadyaśca pāvikāḥ ।
meghānāṃ śikharāvāsā vāyūnāṃ gandhamiśritāḥ ।।1.551.20।।
dhenūnāṃ devakoṭīnāṃ vāsā yatra bhavanti ca ।
yogināṃ siddhajīvānāṃ maṇḍalāni vasanti ca । । 2 1 ।।
puṣkare śikhare vāsaṃ tatra cakruḥ śivādayaḥ ।
puṣkarādīni tīrthāni vasiṣṭhādyā maharṣayaḥ । । 22 ।।
brahmādyā devatāścānye cakruḥ śaṃkaramānanam ।
jalaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ cārghaṃ naivedyaṃ sevanādikam । । 23 ।।
daduḥ śrīparameśāya pārvatīpataye surāḥ ।
vaśiṣṭhena kṛtā pūjā viśiṣṭā ca nijālaye । । 24। ।
suviśrāntiṃ tataścakruḥ śāṃka?ratvarbudācale ।
arbudo'yaṃ divyamūrtiḥ satkāraṃ kṛtavān bahum । । 25 ।।
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha niśāyāṃ svāsane kathām ।
śṛṇu tvasya kathāṃ divyāṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm । । 26 ।।
gautamo'bhūnmunīnāṃ vai mānyo dhanyo mahānṛṣiḥ ।
śataśṛṃge nivāsaṃ sa kṛtvā tapaścacāra ha । । 27 ।।
ahalyā tasya bhāryā'pi tāpasī brahmavādinī ।
daṇḍakāraṇyavāstavyā gautame kiṃkarī sadā । । 28 । ।
atithīnāṃ pūjanaṃ sā sadā karoti bhāminī ।
ekadā'vagrahe jāte pṛthvyāmannāni santi na । । 29 ।।
viprā vicārayāmāsurbhojanaṃ kva miliṣyati ।
gautamo'sti samarthaḥ sa pūjayatyatithīn sadā । । 1.551.30 ।।
tadgṛhaṃ samagacchāma ityāyayuḥ samantataḥ ।
gautamastadvilokyaiva brahmāṇaṃ prapitāmaham । । 31 ।।
sasmāra subahu brahmā pratyakṣaḥ sambabhūva ha ।
varaṃ vṛṇu samuvāca gautamaḥ prāha bhūtale । । 32 । ।
jalaṃ godhūmadhānyāni yavāśca kaṇiśādayaḥ ।
prātarārabhya jāyantāṃ madhyāhne tatkaṇānvayam । । 33 ।।
gṛhṇīyo nityamityevaṃ teṣāṃ pakvaṃ ca bhojanam ।
vaiśvadevaṃ śubhaṃ śrāddhaṃ naivedyaṃ devatāsu ca । । 34 । ।
ātitheyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kurmo yayā tathāstu me ।
brahmā tvāśrutya ca tathāstviti prāha yayau tataḥ । । 3 '9। ।
nityaṃ dhānyaṃ navaṃ prātarjāyate tacca pacyate ।
sahasrāṇāṃ nityameva viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ tathā । । 36 ।।
bhavatyevaṃ vatsaraṃ vai brāhmaṇā bhojitāstayā ।
pātivratyaprabhāveṇā'halyā karoti sevanam । । 37 । ।
saṃkalpayati nityaṃ sā prātaḥ kāntasya pādayoḥ ।
natvā patitvā cā'ṅguṣṭhe prakṣālyā'rghaṃ vidhāya ca । । 38 । ।
yadyahaṃ svāmibhāryā'smi svāmibhaktā pativratā ।
tadā tvatra prajāyantāṃ lakṣapātrāṇi nityaśaḥ । । 39 ।।
dāsā dāsyaḥ sevakāśca dhenavo rasavadaghradāḥ ।
khādyapeyāni sarvāṇi kriyantāṃ hutabhuk svayam ।।1.551.40 ।।
devāśca pariveṣṭāro bhavantu daṇḍake mama ।
evaṃ nityaṃ susaṃkalpya kṛtvā mahānasāni ca ।।41 ।।
pācayitvā navānnāni kṛtvā viśvasurārpaṇam ।
gogrāsān jantubhāgāँśca vikīrya pitṛpiṇḍakān ।।।42 ।।
viprān lakṣamitān nityaṃ bhojayatyadhikānapi ।
atha varṣottare kāle suvṛṣṭirbhūtale'bhavat ।।43 ।।
annāni sarvadeśeṣu jātānyeva samantataḥ ।
viprāḥ prāhurvayaṃ deśāntarāṇyeṣyāma eva vai ।।44।।
gautamastāँstadā prāha vasatā'traiva bhūsurāḥ ।
tadā te brāhmaṇāḥ prāhuḥ svatantrāḥ smo vayaṃ mune! ।।45 ।।
tvayā'nnāni pradattāni rakṣitāśca vayaṃ sadā ।
yasyā'nnaṃ tasya vai deho'dhīnatā tasya cottamā ।। 86 ।।
tadvākyaṃ sarvathā pālyaṃ kintu jigamiṣā dhruvā ।
ityuktvā cintayāmāsurgantuṃ te miṣamadbhutam ।।47।।
eko vipro rodhanākhyaḥ prāṇāyāmaṃ vidhāya ca ।
saṃyamena viveśā'ntarhṛdaye gautamasya hi ।।48 ।।
anyaiścaikā tu gaustatra nirmitā māyayā śubhā ।
sā gatā gautamaścaiva śālāyāṃ tṛṇasannidhau ।।49।।
gautamo'pi sthitastatra prāṇāyāme sthiro hyataḥ ।
gaurgatā parṇaśālāyāṃ gautamastāṃ vilokya ca ।।।1.551.5 0 ।।
rodhanā'ntaḥpraveśena prāṇaruddhā bhavā'tra gauḥ ।
evamuccārayāmāsa prāṇaruddhā'bhavattu gauḥ ।।5 1 ।।
patitā mūrchitā cāpi viprāḥ prāhustadā muhuḥ ।
goghno vai gautamo nā'syā''śrame stheyaṃ tu bhūsuraiḥ ।।52 ।।
gautamastān muhuḥ stutyā tuṣṭāva pūjyabhūsurān ।
neyaṃ mṛtā'sti mūrchāyāṃ mūrchā naśyettu vā katham ।।53 ।।
prāyaścittaṃ karomyatra mā yāntu bhūsurā gṛhāt ।
ityuktā brāhmaṇāḥ prāhuḥ prāyaścittaṃ na jīvite ।।54।।
mūrchite vā prakartavyaṃ mūrchā dūrīkarotu vai ।
gaṃgājalaṃ samānīya samāplāvaya gāmimām ।।55।।
vimūrchā sthāsyati drāg vai vayaṃ yāmo vanāntaram ।
ityuktvā prayayuḥ sarve viprā daṇḍakabhūmitaḥ ।। 56।।
gautamo vyomamārgeṇa yayau śrīśaṃkara prati ।
śaṃkaraḥ svāgataṃ tatra kailāse kṛtavān purā ।। 57।।
gautamastu haraṃ natvā yayāce gāṃgakaṃ jalam ।
śaṃkaraḥ svaṃ jaṭākhaṇḍaṃ samutpāṭya dadau tadā ।। 58।।
sagāṃgaṃ taṃ nināyātra datvā godehamastake ।
tadutpannajalenaināṃ plāvayāmāsa gautamaḥ ।।।59।।
gaurjātā svasthahṛdayā vimūrchā tvāśrame sthitā ।
gaṃgā sā gautamī jātā godānasya vareṇa hi ।।1.551.6 0।।
godāvarīti vikhyātā daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinī ।
atha tān brāhmaṇānāha gautamarṣiḥ palāyitān ।।61 ।
sarve bhavantu kāpaṭyadharmābhāsā yugāntare ।
raudrāḥ kapālasaṃgāśca bhojyadānāṃ vinindakāḥ ।।62।
ityevaṃ sati! te cāsya gautamasya prabhāvanam ।
kathitaṃ sucamatkāramayaṃ godāvaraṃ sthalam ।।62।
tatra godāvare tīrthe gautamasyā'bhavacchubhaḥ ।
śiṣyastūttaṃkanāmā yo vedānadhītya yāvataḥ ।।64।
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dātuṃ prārthanāṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
gurupatnī tadā prāha dakṣiṇāṃ maṇimālikām ।।65।
saudāsasya gṛhe rājñī madayantī svavakṣasi ।
dhārayatyeva nityaṃ sā tvānetavyā pradehi tām ।।66।।।
ityukto gurupatnyā sa prasthitaḥ satvaraṃ tadā ।
sudāsasya gṛha prāyāt sudāsaṃ vyāghrarūpiṇam ।।67।
dadarśa tvabhiyāntaṃ svaṃ bhakṣayituṃ sa bhūsuraḥ ।
vipraḥ prāha yatheṣṭaṃ tvaṃ khāda māṃ tadanantaram ।।68।।
atithiste samāyāto maṇimālā pradehi me ।
guruve'rpayya caiṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃ tvabhivāñcchitām ।।69।।
rājā prāha śubhaṃ vipra! yācyatāṃ mahiṣī mama ।
ityukto bhūsuro rājñīṃ yayāce mālikāṃ prati ।।1.551.70।।
rājñī prāha tvamānīhi cābhijñānaṃ nṛpasya vai ।
sa gatvā tvaritaṃ bhūpamabhijñānamayācata ।। 71 ।।
saudāsaścāha vākyaṃ yadabhijñānaṃ yato bhavet ।
yairvinā sugatirnāsti durgatiṃ yena yānti ca ।।72।।
gatvaivaṃ brūhi tāṃ sādhvīṃ śrutvā dāsyati mālikām ।
sā dadau bhūsurāyaināṃ mālikāṃ divyasatprabhām ।।73 ।
uvāca tvasurastatra raṇāntike pratiṣṭhati ।
atalāt sa samāgatya mālāmicchati me śubhām ।।74।।
ajāmṛto'suro nāmnā khātayāmāsa tattalam ।
bhūgarbhe vāsayāmāsa rākṣasān sa nijānugān ।।75।
tena vai vivaraṃ pṛthvyāṃ cātidīrghaṃ kṛtaṃ yataḥ ।
āharenna yathā''gatya tathā rakṣa prayāhi vai ।।76।
ityuktaḥ so'pyutaṃkaśca maṇihāraṃ samādade ।
āyātaḥ svaguroḥ patnyai dadau hīrakahārakam ।।77।.
guruṃ papraccha vākyasya śubhārthaṃ sa jagād ha ।
prasāditā dvijā dānairdāsyanti sugatiṃ parām ।।78।।
asantuṣṭā dvijā yasya durgatistasya sarvadā ।
ityarthaṃ cāpi vijñāya mumude bhūsurastadā ।।79।।
āśīrvādān gurorgurvyāḥ samādāya mahānṛṣiḥ ।
uttaṃkaḥ puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ ramyaṃ nijālayaṃ yayau ।।1.551.8 0।।
uttaṃkatīrthamatrā'sti pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।
athaitad vivaraṃ dīrghamāyataṃ cāsuraiḥ kṛtam ।।।81 ।।
tatraikadā vaśiṣṭhasya kāmadhenuḥ papāta ha ।
vaśiṣṭho nijayogena homadhenuṃ nijāṃ tadā ।।82।।
bahirniṣkāsayāmāsa tata ārabhya sarvadā ।
pūrtiṃ vicārayāmāsa vivarasya mahādriṇā ।।83 ।।
himālayaṃ yayau śīghraṃ vaśiṣṭho hi vihāyasā ।
arthayāmāsa tatputraṃ vivarasya prapūrtaye ।।84।।
nandivardhaṃ sutaṃ prādād vaśiṣṭhastaṃ nināya ca ।
vivare sthāpayāmāsa nandivardhananāmakam ।।85।।
arbudena ca nāgena dhṛtastatra yathāyatham ।
arbudācalamevaitannāmakhyātiṃ gataṃ tataḥ ।।86 ।।
bhādraśuklasya pañcamyāṃ tvāyātaḥ parvato yataḥ ।
tīrthānyapi vaśiṣṭhena cānītāni bahūnyapi ।।87।।
asya śṛṃge nāgatīrthaṃ vaśiṣṭhasyā''śramastathā ।
śaṃkarasya tathā vāsastatra snātvā ca nirjhare ।।88।।
dhanasampatsukhasvargaputralakṣmyādi cāpyate ।
vandhyā snātvā putravatī bhavedeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 89।।
śrāddhaṃ tatra kariṣyanti pitarastasya sarvathā ।
muktiṃ svargāt prayāsyanti kartā'pi muktigo bhavet ।। 1.551.90 ।।
vaśiṣṭhaścānayāmāsa gautamīṃ ca sarasvatīm ।
gaṃgāṃ mandākinīṃ tatrā'caleśvaraṃ ca śaṃkaram ।। 91 ।।
gautamī brāhmaṇī kācidanapatyatvaduḥkhitā ।
sādhvī tīrthaṃ nāgatīrthamāyayāvarbudācale ।। 92।।
atha sā cintayāmāsa dhiṅ māṃ putravivarjitām ।
iti cintāparā snātuṃ nāgatīrthaṃ viveśa sā ।। 93 ।।
snātvā sā nirgatā tasmāt salilād yāvadeva hi ।
vināpi bhartṛsaṃyogaṃ sadyo garbhavatī hyabhūt ।।94।।
prasannā sā ca śuśrāva gāṃ tadā cā'śarīriṇīm ।
yo yadvāñcchati citte'tra jalamadhye vyavasthitaḥ ।। 95।।
cintitaṃ tadavāpnoti nārī vā'tha naro'pi vā ।
tvayā tvatra jalesthitvā putravāñcchā kṛtā hṛdi ।।96 ।।
ato garbhayutā jātā putrastava bhaviṣyati ।
śrutvā''kāśagatā vāṇīṃ devadūtena bhāṣitām ।। 97।।
dṛṣṭvā patiṃ vinā garbhaṃ vākyametaduvāca sā ।
aho tīrthaprabhāvo'yamapūrvaḥ pratibhāti me ।। 98।।
yatra saṃjāyate garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ śukraṃ rajo vinā ।
tato gṛhaṃ gatā sā ca suṣuve sutamuttamam ।। 99 ।।
sakāmā ye cātra tīrthe snānti teṣāṃ manorathāḥ ।
phalantyeva na sandeho yathā sā gautamī tathā ।। 1.551.100 ।।
gomatī cāhṛtā kuṇḍe vaśiṣṭhena mahātmanā ।
tatra snātvā paraṃ svarge vindate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 101 ।।
śṛṇu devi! camatkāramacaleśvarasannidhau ।
śukaścāsīt kṛtanīḍaḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ karoti saḥ ।। 10 2 ।।
uḍḍīyoḍḍīya ca nīḍe viśrāmyati punaḥ punaḥ ।
kālena ca mṛto rājā veṇunāmā'bhavaddhi saḥ ।। 103 ।।
jātismarau vabhūvā'sau rājā smṛtvā śukasthitim ।
acaleśvaramāsādya pradakṣiṇamathā'karot ।। 1 04।।
nānyat kiñcit karotyeva karotyeva pradakṣiṇam ।
nāradādyāḥ ṛṣayastu dṛṣṭvā bhūpaṃ tathāvidham ।। 1 05।।
papracchuḥ kevalaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kathaṃ vidhīyate? ।
naivedyaṃ phalapuṣpādi kathaṃ nārpayase vad ।। 106 ।।
veṇuḥ prāha purā pakṣī śukaścāsaṃ sthito'tra tu ।
devaṃ tatra sthitaṃ kurvan pradakṣiṇamaharniśam ।। 1 07।।
kṛpayā tatprabhāvācca jātismaro'dhunā'bhavam ।
karomi tanmahāpuṇyaṃ smṛtvā devapradakṣiṇam ।। 1 08।।
anantapuṇyalābhārthaṃ karomyeva pradakṣiṇam ।
ṛṣayo nṛpateḥ śrutvā sādhu sādhviti cā'bruvan ।। 10 9।।
rājā kālena mahatā harabhaktyā tataḥ param ।
oṃ namaḥ śrokṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।। 110 ।।
iti mantraṃ harāllabdhvā bhaktyā vaikuṇṭhamāyayau ।
satyai śaṃbhūditaṃ vṛttaṃ lakṣmi! te tu mayoditam ।। 111 ।। itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarādīnāṃ dvārikācamatkārapurā'rbudācalādigamana, gautamavṛttāntaṃ, saudāsottaṃkavṛttāntaṃ, nāgatīrthamahimā, veṇunṛpamokṣaḥ, arbudānayanavṛttāntaṃ, cetyādi-
nirūpaṇanāmaikapañcāśadadhikapañca-
śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।55 1।।


← adhyāyaḥ 551 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 552
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 553 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śaṃkaraṃ tvāgataṃ śrutvā'rbudācale ।
agastyastaddarśanārthaṃ dakṣiṇāt samupāgataḥ ।। 1 ।।
natvā śaṃbhuṃ pūjayitvā sukhāsīnaḥ śubhāsane ।
śaṃbhunā satkṛto'gastyaḥ papraccha śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ ।। 2 ।।
ciraṃjīvitvamevā'tra kathaṃ syānme vada prabho! ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhaja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ।। 3 ।।
saurāṣṭre vartamānaṃ vai kāmbhareyaṃ ramāpatim ।
vinā bhaktiṃ hareḥ kvāpi divyatvaṃ naiva jāyate ।। 4 ।।
vinā ca divyabhāvena ciraṃjīvo na jāyate ।
kālakṣayādikaṃ divye spṛśatyeva na karhicit ।। 5 ।।
divyayogaṃ vinā divyabhāvo naiva kadācana ।
divyo nārāyaṇo viṣṇurbhūtabhāvana īśvaraḥ ।। 6 ।।
tasmin dehe praviṣṭe ca divyatā syād viśeṣataḥ ।
siddhayastatra vartante yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ahaṃ vai śaṃkaro brahmā viṣṇuścānye divaukasaḥ ।
divyā nārāyaṇāṃśena tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ।। 8 ।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
japa nitya mahāmantraṃ dhyānaṃ kuru hareḥ sadā ।। 9 ।।
juhudhi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।
prasannaḥ san yatheṣṭaṃ te dāsyatyeva sa divyatām ।। 1.552.1 0।।
ityukto'gastyamunirāḍ dhyānaṃ cakāra pūjanam ।
vandanaṃ smaraṇaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।। 11 ।।
lomaśasyā''śrame gatvovāsā'śvapaṭṭake tadā ।
athaikadā sa munirāṭ tīrthārthaṃ kāśikāṃ yayau ।। 1 2।।
vyomnā himagiriṃ gatvā prayayau mānasaṃ saraḥ ।
kacchapaṃ mānase divyaṃ dadarśa munipuṃgavaḥ ।। 1 3।।
kamalāni sudivyāni dadarśa kānakāni ca ।
kacchapenā'rpitaṃ divyaṃ kamalaṃ svāgate śubham ।। 14।।
tāvat sa munirāṭ tatra babhūva divyadṛṣṭimān ।
uḍḍīya kacchapaṃ natvā yayāvilāvṛtaṃ tataḥ ।। 15।।
meroḥ pārśvasthite khaṇḍe dadarśa susarovaram ।
tasya taṭe śubhā tena dṛṣṭā kācinmahākuṭī ।। 1 6।।
tatropavāsaśithilo dṛṣṭastena hi tāpasaḥ ।
asthicarmāvaśeṣaśca cīravalkalakāmbaraḥ ।। 17।।
pṛṣṭaśca pratipattyarthaṃ kastvaṃ ceti mahātmanā ।
sa tvagastyaṃ samuvāca sthīyatāṃ sthīyatāṃ dvija ।। 18।।
ātithyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ brahman praviśyatāṃ sthalaṃ mama ।
iti śrutvā saṃpraviṣṭo'gastyaḥ parṇakuṭīṃ ca tām ।। 19 ।।
tāvaddadarśa puruṣaṃ vipraṃ jvalantamīśvaram ।
bhūmau śubhāsanasthaṃ prājapantaṃ brahma śāśvatam ।। 1.552.20 ।।
svakare mālikāṃ yuñjan lalāṭe tilakaṃ dadhan ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।। 21 ।।
homamevaṃ prakurvantaṃ pratyekaṃ maṇimāpya ca ।
vadantaṃ mālikānte ca pauruṣaṃ sūktamuttamam ।। 22 ।।
etādṛśaḥ sa puruṣo lakṣmīsūktamuvāca ha ।
sūktottaraṃ tu tatkuṭyāṃ kuṇḍādvai pañcakanyakāḥ ।। 23 ।।
niryayuḥ kāñcanaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tvekā dadau tadā ।
dvitīyā jalapātreṇa pādaprakṣālanaṃ vyadhāt ।। 24 । ।
tṛtīyā vyajanaṃ dhṛtvā munaye pavanaṃ dadau ।
caturthī pañcamī dhṛtvā cāmare pakṣayoḥ sthite ।। 25 ।।
punaḥ śrīsūktamuccārya kuṭyāṃ sa tāpaso muhuḥ ।
homaṃ cakāra vai tāvat kanyāstu śataśaḥ śubhāḥ । । 25 ।।
hemakuṃbhakarāstatrotpannāḥ pārśve sarovaram ।
vāruṇena ca homena śīghraṃ tatraiva nirmitam । । 27 ।।
tāstu jalāni cānīya snāpayāmāsuretya tam ।
vastreṇa mārjanaṃ cakruścālaṃkārān dadustataḥ । । 28 । ।
vastrāṇi ca dduḥ pūjāṃ cakrurnaivedyamuttamam ।
jalaṃ dadustatastāścā'ntardhāna prayayuḥ kṣaṇāt। ।। 29 । ।
athā'gastyaḥ samālokyā''ścaryaṃ dhyānaṃ cakāra ha ।
netre sammīlite yāvat tāvanmerugirau nijam ।। 1.552.30 । ।
uccaśṛṃge sthitaṃ mūrdhni paśyatyātmānamātmanā ।
paśyati sāgarānsapta tathaiva kulaparvatān ।। 31 ।।
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ ddarśa merusaṃsthitaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ punardhyānaṃ cakārā'gattyako muniḥ ।। 32 ।।
bhuvarlokaṃ tathā svargaṃ janaṃ satyaṃ ddarśa ha ।
brahmasabhāṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ ddarśa tatra vai sthitaḥ ।। 33 । ।
tatra dadarśa puruṣaṃ caturbāhuṃ janārdanam ।
unmīlya netre yāvacca bahiḥ paśyati tāvatā ।। 3 4।।
na vai merurna vai divyā kuṭī naiva sarovaram ।
mānasaṃ na saraścāpi kāśikā'pi na vidyate ।। 35 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre lomaśasyā''śrame śubhe ।
agastyaḥ svaṃ dadarśaiva naije parṇagṛhe tadā । । 36 ।।
tadārabhyā'tra loke cāgastyasya divyatā yathā ।
ciraṃjāvitvamatyarthamaiśvaryāṇyatigāni ca ।। 37 ।।
jātānyeva ca taddeśaṃ kadā prāpsye punaḥ śubham ।
ityeva cintayāno'sau śaṃbhuṃ draṣṭuṃ himācalam । । 38 ।।
naranārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ muhuryāti narāyaṇam ।
draṣṭuṃ cāpi śvetabhūmiṃ satyalokaṃ punaḥ punaḥ । । 39 । ।
tathāpi ca punarnaiva jāyate tasya darśanam ।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tāvadeva ca ।।1.552.40 । ।
punaragastirāyāto darśanārthaṃ tamārbudam ।
natvā śaṃbhuṃ praṇamyaivovāca jijñāsitaṃ tadā ।।41 ।।
bhagavan divyalokasya purā dṛṣṭasya vai mayā ।
vrataṃ tapo vā dharmo vā prātyarthaṃ sādhane vada ।। 42।।
śaṃkaraḥ prāha tacchrutvā yatte lakṣmi! vadāmyaham ।
anārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā tallokāptirna vai bhavet। ।। 43 । ।
ārādhite harau lokā bhaveyurvai kare'khilāḥ ।
yo yajñe tvijyate devo yasmāt sarvamidaṃ jagat ।।44। ।
utpannaṃ sarvadā yasmin līnaṃ bhavati sāmaram ।
anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devaḥ parātparaḥ । । 45 । ।
akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān pūrṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
paripūrṇatamaḥ so'yaṃ bhajanīya sadā janaiḥ ।।46 । ।
sakāmairvāpi niṣkāmaiḥ savārthadaḥ sa vai prabhuḥ ।
caturdhātmā'bhavatpūrvaṃ sa eva puruṣottamaḥ । । 47 । ।
goloke śrīkṛṣṇarūpo vaikuṇṭhe sa narāyaṇaḥ ।
vāsudevo'vyākṛte ca haime naranarāyaṇaḥ ।। 48 । ।
punaścā'yaṃ caturdhā cā'bhavacchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
satyalokottare viṣṇurviṣṇuśca kṣīrasāgare ।। 49 । ।
śvetadvīpe tathā vipṇurviṣṇurādityako divi ।
punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha । । 1.552.50 । ।
sadāśivaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ mahākālaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha । । 51 । ।
aniruddhaṃ ca pradyumnaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha । ।52 । ।
brahmāṇaṃ rājasaṃ rūpaṃ sāttvikaṃ viṣṇumeva ca ।
tāmasaṃ rudrarūpaṃ ca sṛṣṭipuṣṭivinaṣṭikṛt ।। 53 ।।
eka eva hi bhagavān kalpe kalpe prajāyate ।
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau golakeṣu sa evā'saṃkhyarūpadhṛk । ।54।।
yo viṣṇuḥ sa svayaṃ brahmā yo brahmā'sau maheśvaraḥ ।
catvāro vā trayaścaite tattvaṃ tvekaṃ sanātanam ।। 55 ।।
mokṣadaṃ pararūpeṇa kāryarūpeṇa bhūtidam ।
sattvenātmā śuddhyati śrīnārāyaṇānubhāvataḥ ।। 56 ।।
śuddhyā vai mu×Vr̤M×cyate jantuḥ śuddhirnāryaṇāśrayā।
nārāyaṇaśca bhagavān yajñarūpī vivartate ।।57।।
kṛte nārāyaṇaḥ śuddhaḥ sūkṣmarūpa upāsyate ।
tretāyāṃ yajñarūpeṇa kathābhirdvāpare'rcanaiḥ ।।58।।
karmabhirbahubhiḥ kalke kalpitairapi pūjyate ।
ijyate ced dveṣabuddhyā caiteṣu rūpadhāriṣu ।।।59।।
bhedabuddhyā jñāyate cenna muktistasya vai kvacit ।
ekaṃ jñātvā bhajed yaḥ sa muktaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।।1.552.6 0 ।।
bhedaṃ kṛtvā bhajeccekaṃ paraṃ naiva dviṣīta cet ।
pātivratyaparasyā'sya muktirbhavenna saṃśayaḥ ।।61 ।।
bhedaṃ kṛtvā bhajeccaikaṃ nindedanyaṃ tu yo janaḥ ।
sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavettasya durgatiṃ sa samāpnuyāt ।।।62।
idaṃ ca śṛṇu me'gastya! gadataḥ prāktanaṃ yathā ।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe harerbhaktā hyabhavan sṛṣṭivāsinaḥ ।।63 ।।
sarvajñā iva te sarve dharmasthā mokṣabhāginaḥ ।
caturdaśastarasthā vai yaṣṭvā śrīpuruṣotamam ।।64।।
mokṣaṃ kramāt prayānti sma tato brahmā hariṃ prabhum ।
sasmāra śrīhariścāpi prādurbhūto hi sarvagaḥ ।।65।।
uvāca brūhi kiṃ kāryaṃ brahmovāca hari tataḥ ।
devadeva! janaḥ sarvo muktimārge vyavasthitaḥ ।।।66 ।।
kathaṃ sṛṣṭirhi bhavitā svargādiṣu ca ko vaset ।
nārakeṣveṣu lokeṣu keṣāṃ vāse mano bhavet ।।67।।।
evamuktastadā śrīmannārāyaṇo jagād tam ।
yugāni trīṇi bahavo māmupeṣyanti bhāgataḥ ।।68।।
antye yuge praviralā bhaviṣyanti mahāśayāḥ ।
eṣa mohaṃ sṛjāmyāśu yaḥ sarvān mohayiṣyati ।।69।।
rudraśca bahurūpāṇi tāmasāni punaḥ punaḥ ।
bhairavādīni cānyāni pārvatyapi parāṇi ca ।।1.552.70 ।।
daityānāṃ nāśanārthāya ghorāṇi dhārayiṣyati ।
madyamāṃsādilubdhāśca mohitā vai śarīriṇaḥ ।।71 ।।
tāni cāśritya vai sattvamārgahīnā vimārgagāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti tathā vedaṃ tyaktvā tāmasamohataḥ ।।72।।
tantrāṇi tāmasānyeva hiṃsāḍhyāni yathāruci ।
kariṣyanti ca tānyāśritya ye dveṣaparāstadā ।।73 ।।
bhaviṣyanti na vai teṣāṃ muktirnirayagāminām ।
athā'ha brahmaṇā proktaḥ kuru mohavacāṃsi vai ।।74।।
yānyāśritya janā loke janmabhāgā bhavantu hi।
tasmādārabhya kālāttu mayā'gastya! kṛtānyapi ।।779 । ।
tāmasāni ca tantrāṇi sakāmānāṃ priyāṇi hi ।
teṣu cābhirato loko bāhulyena vyavasthitaḥ ।।76 । ।
pravahatyeva saṃsāre mṛtau janmani vai muhuḥ ।
kalke yuge janāḥ prāya āśrayiṣyanti mānuṣān ।। 77 । ।।
matvā tān paramātmānaṃ nindiṣyanti śivādikān ।
tena pāpena te sarve yāsyanti nirayān dhruvān ।।78 ।। ।
guravo vañcayiṣyanti svayaṃ mugdhā hi mānavān ।
nindārāgaiśca vidveṣairmamā'haṃkāradūṣaṇaiḥ ।।79 ।।
kāpaṭyacauryaviśvāsaghātaiḥ svārthairnirantaram ।
tena pāpena guravo yāsyanti nirayān bahūn ।।1.552.8 0 । ।
śvavat mānyā bhaviṣyanti lokeṣu guravo janāḥ ।
yamamārgā yāmyalokāḥ kāśiṣyante ca tadbalāt ।।8 1 ।।
tasmādagastya! loko'yaṃ kāmyena karmaṇā mayā ।
bahudhā pūritaścāste mokṣagastu kvacit kvacit ।।82। ।
ya evaṃ vetti viprarṣe paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
sarvātmānaṃ paraṃbrahma tathā naścā'parān bahūn ।।83- । ।
mukhyato guṇataścāpi mohastasya na bādhate ।
paśyā'gastya! mayi brahāparaṃ rūpaṃ sanātanam ।।84।।
evamukto'gastimunirdadarśa śaṃkaraṃ yadā ।
tatra dadarśa vrahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇyantarnarāyaṇam । ।85 । ।
nārāyaṇe paraṃbrahmā'nādinaṃ puruṣottamam ।
jvaladbhāsvaravarṇābhaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram । ।86 । ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā'gastiviprastuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।
bhavān viṣṇuḥ paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇanārāyāga prabho ।।87। ।
viśa-praveśane dhātustatra snupratyayādanu ।
viṣṇuḥ sa vyāpakaḥ sarvadevādau parameśvaraḥ ।।88 । ।
kvacid brahmā kvacid rudro bhavāneva parātparaḥ ।
viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhurbrahmā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।89 । ।
ebhiśca nāmabhirbrahmaparaṃ proktaṃ sanātanam ।
nāsti bhedo'vatārāṇāmekasminnavatāriṇi ।। 1.552.90 ।।
yo'nyathā bhāvayedetat te bodhyāḥ kalidharmiṇaḥ ।
te yānti narakaṃ ghoraṃ nindakāḥ pāpapūruṣāḥ ।।9 1 । ।
etādṛśā bhaviṣyanti bhedakā hi kalau yuge। ।
mohakā vaṃcakā loke jñānagoṣṭhyā viḍambakāḥ ।। 92 । ।
vadiṣyanti vayaṃ sujñā jānīmaḥ paramaṃ prabhum ।
nānye jānanti tattattvamavatārādicintakāḥ ।।93 ।।
ityeteṣāṃ nindakānāṃ haryavatāradrohiṇām ।
kṣetrāṇi dharmarājasya nagaryāṃ kāritāni vai ।।94।।
tena bāhyavrate śubhrā hṛdi kṛṣṇā vinindakāḥ ।
drohiṇaścāvamantāro yāsyanti narake dhruvam ।। 95।।
brahmaṇā'haṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ proktaśca sṛja vai prajāḥ ।
avijñānasamartho'haṃ nimagnaḥ salile tadā ।। 96 ।।
tatrā'paśyaṃ supuruṣaṃ divyaṃ tvaṃguṣṭhamātrakam ।
kiśoraṃ meghasaṃkāśaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam ।। 97।।
tamahaṃ pṛṣṭavān kastvaṃ kathaṃ jātaḥ prakathyatām ।
sa māmāha tvamevā'haṃ brahmā'haṃ viṣṇurasmyaham ।। 98।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devo jalaśāyī sanātanaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhavāmi dhāmani ।। 99।।
divyaṃ te'stu netramatra paśya māṃ yatnato hara ।
evamuktastadā tena yāvatpaśyāmyahaṃ ca tam ।। 1.552.100 ।।
tāvat pare'kṣare divye dhāmni dṛṣṭo mayā prabhuḥ ।
sa eva vīkṣitaścāpi goloke'pi vikuṇṭhake ।। 101 ।।
mahāviṣṇurjale dṛṣṭo virāḍrūrūpo'pi vīkṣitaḥ ।
tannābhau paṃkajaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ brahmā tatra vilokitaḥ ।। 102 ।।
tatpārśve'haṃ mayā dṛṣṭo dṛṣṭvā'haṃ harṣamāgataḥ ।
tapasā tadguṇān smṛtvā'stauṣaṃ śrīparameśvaram ।। 103 ।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāhā'gastyaṃ vai tvarbudācale ।
tanmayā te'tra kathitaṃ lakṣmi! mokṣapradaṃ vacaḥ ।। 1 04।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mokṣo bhavet pare'kṣare ।
sakāmānāṃ gṛhalakṣmīdhanaputrādikaṃ bhavet ।। 105 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne''gastyasya divyatā cirajīvitvādiprāptiḥ, arbudācale rudrasya camatkāraḥ, satyetarayugīyamānavānāṃ tridevaviṣayaka- parasparadrohakāriṇāṃ saṃsārapravāhasajīvanatetyādi-
nirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 552 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 552 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 553
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 554 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śaṃkaraṃ tvāgataṃ śrutvā'rbudācale ।
agastyastaddarśanārthaṃ dakṣiṇāt samupāgataḥ ।। 1 ।।
natvā śaṃbhuṃ pūjayitvā sukhāsīnaḥ śubhāsane ।
śaṃbhunā satkṛto'gastyaḥ papraccha śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ ।। 2 ।।
ciraṃjīvitvamevā'tra kathaṃ syānme vada prabho! ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhaja kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ।। 3 ।।
saurāṣṭre vartamānaṃ vai kāmbhareyaṃ ramāpatim ।
vinā bhaktiṃ hareḥ kvāpi divyatvaṃ naiva jāyate ।। 4 ।।
vinā ca divyabhāvena ciraṃjīvo na jāyate ।
kālakṣayādikaṃ divye spṛśatyeva na karhicit ।। 5 ।।
divyayogaṃ vinā divyabhāvo naiva kadācana ।
divyo nārāyaṇo viṣṇurbhūtabhāvana īśvaraḥ ।। 6 ।।
tasmin dehe praviṣṭe ca divyatā syād viśeṣataḥ ।
siddhayastatra vartante yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ahaṃ vai śaṃkaro brahmā viṣṇuścānye divaukasaḥ ।
divyā nārāyaṇāṃśena tasmānnārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ।। 8 ।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
japa nitya mahāmantraṃ dhyānaṃ kuru hareḥ sadā ।। 9 ।।
juhudhi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।
prasannaḥ san yatheṣṭaṃ te dāsyatyeva sa divyatām ।। 1.552.1 0।।
ityukto'gastyamunirāḍ dhyānaṃ cakāra pūjanam ।
vandanaṃ smaraṇaṃ nityaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।। 11 ।।
lomaśasyā''śrame gatvovāsā'śvapaṭṭake tadā ।
athaikadā sa munirāṭ tīrthārthaṃ kāśikāṃ yayau ।। 1 2।।
vyomnā himagiriṃ gatvā prayayau mānasaṃ saraḥ ।
kacchapaṃ mānase divyaṃ dadarśa munipuṃgavaḥ ।। 1 3।।
kamalāni sudivyāni dadarśa kānakāni ca ।
kacchapenā'rpitaṃ divyaṃ kamalaṃ svāgate śubham ।। 14।।
tāvat sa munirāṭ tatra babhūva divyadṛṣṭimān ।
uḍḍīya kacchapaṃ natvā yayāvilāvṛtaṃ tataḥ ।। 15।।
meroḥ pārśvasthite khaṇḍe dadarśa susarovaram ।
tasya taṭe śubhā tena dṛṣṭā kācinmahākuṭī ।। 1 6।।
tatropavāsaśithilo dṛṣṭastena hi tāpasaḥ ।
asthicarmāvaśeṣaśca cīravalkalakāmbaraḥ ।। 17।।
pṛṣṭaśca pratipattyarthaṃ kastvaṃ ceti mahātmanā ।
sa tvagastyaṃ samuvāca sthīyatāṃ sthīyatāṃ dvija ।। 18।।
ātithyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ brahman praviśyatāṃ sthalaṃ mama ।
iti śrutvā saṃpraviṣṭo'gastyaḥ parṇakuṭīṃ ca tām ।। 19 ।।
tāvaddadarśa puruṣaṃ vipraṃ jvalantamīśvaram ।
bhūmau śubhāsanasthaṃ prājapantaṃ brahma śāśvatam ।। 1.552.20 ।।
svakare mālikāṃ yuñjan lalāṭe tilakaṃ dadhan ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।। 21 ।।
homamevaṃ prakurvantaṃ pratyekaṃ maṇimāpya ca ।
vadantaṃ mālikānte ca pauruṣaṃ sūktamuttamam ।। 22 ।।
etādṛśaḥ sa puruṣo lakṣmīsūktamuvāca ha ।
sūktottaraṃ tu tatkuṭyāṃ kuṇḍādvai pañcakanyakāḥ ।। 23 ।।
niryayuḥ kāñcanaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tvekā dadau tadā ।
dvitīyā jalapātreṇa pādaprakṣālanaṃ vyadhāt ।। 24 । ।
tṛtīyā vyajanaṃ dhṛtvā munaye pavanaṃ dadau ।
caturthī pañcamī dhṛtvā cāmare pakṣayoḥ sthite ।। 25 ।।
punaḥ śrīsūktamuccārya kuṭyāṃ sa tāpaso muhuḥ ।
homaṃ cakāra vai tāvat kanyāstu śataśaḥ śubhāḥ । । 25 ।।
hemakuṃbhakarāstatrotpannāḥ pārśve sarovaram ।
vāruṇena ca homena śīghraṃ tatraiva nirmitam । । 27 ।।
tāstu jalāni cānīya snāpayāmāsuretya tam ।
vastreṇa mārjanaṃ cakruścālaṃkārān dadustataḥ । । 28 । ।
vastrāṇi ca dduḥ pūjāṃ cakrurnaivedyamuttamam ।
jalaṃ dadustatastāścā'ntardhāna prayayuḥ kṣaṇāt। ।। 29 । ।
athā'gastyaḥ samālokyā''ścaryaṃ dhyānaṃ cakāra ha ।
netre sammīlite yāvat tāvanmerugirau nijam ।। 1.552.30 । ।
uccaśṛṃge sthitaṃ mūrdhni paśyatyātmānamātmanā ।
paśyati sāgarānsapta tathaiva kulaparvatān ।। 31 ।।
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ ddarśa merusaṃsthitaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ punardhyānaṃ cakārā'gattyako muniḥ ।। 32 ।।
bhuvarlokaṃ tathā svargaṃ janaṃ satyaṃ ddarśa ha ।
brahmasabhāṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ ddarśa tatra vai sthitaḥ ।। 33 । ।
tatra dadarśa puruṣaṃ caturbāhuṃ janārdanam ।
unmīlya netre yāvacca bahiḥ paśyati tāvatā ।। 3 4।।
na vai merurna vai divyā kuṭī naiva sarovaram ।
mānasaṃ na saraścāpi kāśikā'pi na vidyate ।। 35 ।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīre lomaśasyā''śrame śubhe ।
agastyaḥ svaṃ dadarśaiva naije parṇagṛhe tadā । । 36 ।।
tadārabhyā'tra loke cāgastyasya divyatā yathā ।
ciraṃjāvitvamatyarthamaiśvaryāṇyatigāni ca ।। 37 ।।
jātānyeva ca taddeśaṃ kadā prāpsye punaḥ śubham ।
ityeva cintayāno'sau śaṃbhuṃ draṣṭuṃ himācalam । । 38 ।।
naranārāyaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ muhuryāti narāyaṇam ।
draṣṭuṃ cāpi śvetabhūmiṃ satyalokaṃ punaḥ punaḥ । । 39 । ।
tathāpi ca punarnaiva jāyate tasya darśanam ।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tāvadeva ca ।।1.552.40 । ।
punaragastirāyāto darśanārthaṃ tamārbudam ।
natvā śaṃbhuṃ praṇamyaivovāca jijñāsitaṃ tadā ।।41 ।।
bhagavan divyalokasya purā dṛṣṭasya vai mayā ।
vrataṃ tapo vā dharmo vā prātyarthaṃ sādhane vada ।। 42।।
śaṃkaraḥ prāha tacchrutvā yatte lakṣmi! vadāmyaham ।
anārādhya hariṃ bhaktyā tallokāptirna vai bhavet। ।। 43 । ।
ārādhite harau lokā bhaveyurvai kare'khilāḥ ।
yo yajñe tvijyate devo yasmāt sarvamidaṃ jagat ।।44। ।
utpannaṃ sarvadā yasmin līnaṃ bhavati sāmaram ।
anādi śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo devaḥ parātparaḥ । । 45 । ।
akṣarādhipatiḥ śrīmān pūrṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
paripūrṇatamaḥ so'yaṃ bhajanīya sadā janaiḥ ।।46 । ।
sakāmairvāpi niṣkāmaiḥ savārthadaḥ sa vai prabhuḥ ।
caturdhātmā'bhavatpūrvaṃ sa eva puruṣottamaḥ । । 47 । ।
goloke śrīkṛṣṇarūpo vaikuṇṭhe sa narāyaṇaḥ ।
vāsudevo'vyākṛte ca haime naranarāyaṇaḥ ।। 48 । ।
punaścā'yaṃ caturdhā cā'bhavacchrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
satyalokottare viṣṇurviṣṇuśca kṣīrasāgare ।। 49 । ।
śvetadvīpe tathā vipṇurviṣṇurādityako divi ।
punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha । । 1.552.50 । ।
sadāśivaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ mahākālaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha । । 51 । ।
aniruddhaṃ ca pradyumnaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca śāśvatam ।
punaścāyaṃ sa bhagavān tridhātmānaṃ sasarja ha । ।52 । ।
brahmāṇaṃ rājasaṃ rūpaṃ sāttvikaṃ viṣṇumeva ca ।
tāmasaṃ rudrarūpaṃ ca sṛṣṭipuṣṭivinaṣṭikṛt ।। 53 ।।
eka eva hi bhagavān kalpe kalpe prajāyate ।
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭau golakeṣu sa evā'saṃkhyarūpadhṛk । ।54।।
yo viṣṇuḥ sa svayaṃ brahmā yo brahmā'sau maheśvaraḥ ।
catvāro vā trayaścaite tattvaṃ tvekaṃ sanātanam ।। 55 ।।
mokṣadaṃ pararūpeṇa kāryarūpeṇa bhūtidam ।
sattvenātmā śuddhyati śrīnārāyaṇānubhāvataḥ ।। 56 ।।
śuddhyā vai mu×Vr̤M×cyate jantuḥ śuddhirnāryaṇāśrayā।
nārāyaṇaśca bhagavān yajñarūpī vivartate ।।57।।
kṛte nārāyaṇaḥ śuddhaḥ sūkṣmarūpa upāsyate ।
tretāyāṃ yajñarūpeṇa kathābhirdvāpare'rcanaiḥ ।।58।।
karmabhirbahubhiḥ kalke kalpitairapi pūjyate ।
ijyate ced dveṣabuddhyā caiteṣu rūpadhāriṣu ।।।59।।
bhedabuddhyā jñāyate cenna muktistasya vai kvacit ।
ekaṃ jñātvā bhajed yaḥ sa muktaḥ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।।1.552.6 0 ।।
bhedaṃ kṛtvā bhajeccekaṃ paraṃ naiva dviṣīta cet ।
pātivratyaparasyā'sya muktirbhavenna saṃśayaḥ ।।61 ।।
bhedaṃ kṛtvā bhajeccaikaṃ nindedanyaṃ tu yo janaḥ ।
sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ bhavettasya durgatiṃ sa samāpnuyāt ।।।62।
idaṃ ca śṛṇu me'gastya! gadataḥ prāktanaṃ yathā ।
sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe harerbhaktā hyabhavan sṛṣṭivāsinaḥ ।।63 ।।
sarvajñā iva te sarve dharmasthā mokṣabhāginaḥ ।
caturdaśastarasthā vai yaṣṭvā śrīpuruṣotamam ।।64।।
mokṣaṃ kramāt prayānti sma tato brahmā hariṃ prabhum ।
sasmāra śrīhariścāpi prādurbhūto hi sarvagaḥ ।।65।।
uvāca brūhi kiṃ kāryaṃ brahmovāca hari tataḥ ।
devadeva! janaḥ sarvo muktimārge vyavasthitaḥ ।।।66 ।।
kathaṃ sṛṣṭirhi bhavitā svargādiṣu ca ko vaset ।
nārakeṣveṣu lokeṣu keṣāṃ vāse mano bhavet ।।67।।।
evamuktastadā śrīmannārāyaṇo jagād tam ।
yugāni trīṇi bahavo māmupeṣyanti bhāgataḥ ।।68।।
antye yuge praviralā bhaviṣyanti mahāśayāḥ ।
eṣa mohaṃ sṛjāmyāśu yaḥ sarvān mohayiṣyati ।।69।।
rudraśca bahurūpāṇi tāmasāni punaḥ punaḥ ।
bhairavādīni cānyāni pārvatyapi parāṇi ca ।।1.552.70 ।।
daityānāṃ nāśanārthāya ghorāṇi dhārayiṣyati ।
madyamāṃsādilubdhāśca mohitā vai śarīriṇaḥ ।।71 ।।
tāni cāśritya vai sattvamārgahīnā vimārgagāḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti tathā vedaṃ tyaktvā tāmasamohataḥ ।।72।।
tantrāṇi tāmasānyeva hiṃsāḍhyāni yathāruci ।
kariṣyanti ca tānyāśritya ye dveṣaparāstadā ।।73 ।।
bhaviṣyanti na vai teṣāṃ muktirnirayagāminām ।
athā'ha brahmaṇā proktaḥ kuru mohavacāṃsi vai ।।74।।
yānyāśritya janā loke janmabhāgā bhavantu hi।
tasmādārabhya kālāttu mayā'gastya! kṛtānyapi ।।779 । ।
tāmasāni ca tantrāṇi sakāmānāṃ priyāṇi hi ।
teṣu cābhirato loko bāhulyena vyavasthitaḥ ।।76 । ।
pravahatyeva saṃsāre mṛtau janmani vai muhuḥ ।
kalke yuge janāḥ prāya āśrayiṣyanti mānuṣān ।। 77 । ।।
matvā tān paramātmānaṃ nindiṣyanti śivādikān ।
tena pāpena te sarve yāsyanti nirayān dhruvān ।।78 ।। ।
guravo vañcayiṣyanti svayaṃ mugdhā hi mānavān ।
nindārāgaiśca vidveṣairmamā'haṃkāradūṣaṇaiḥ ।।79 ।।
kāpaṭyacauryaviśvāsaghātaiḥ svārthairnirantaram ।
tena pāpena guravo yāsyanti nirayān bahūn ।।1.552.8 0 । ।
śvavat mānyā bhaviṣyanti lokeṣu guravo janāḥ ।
yamamārgā yāmyalokāḥ kāśiṣyante ca tadbalāt ।।8 1 ।।
tasmādagastya! loko'yaṃ kāmyena karmaṇā mayā ।
bahudhā pūritaścāste mokṣagastu kvacit kvacit ।।82। ।
ya evaṃ vetti viprarṣe paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ।
sarvātmānaṃ paraṃbrahma tathā naścā'parān bahūn ।।83- । ।
mukhyato guṇataścāpi mohastasya na bādhate ।
paśyā'gastya! mayi brahāparaṃ rūpaṃ sanātanam ।।84।।
evamukto'gastimunirdadarśa śaṃkaraṃ yadā ।
tatra dadarśa vrahmāṇaṃ brahmaṇyantarnarāyaṇam । ।85 । ।
nārāyaṇe paraṃbrahmā'nādinaṃ puruṣottamam ।
jvaladbhāsvaravarṇābhaṃ koṭikandarpasundaram । ।86 । ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā'gastiviprastuṣṭāva parameśvaram ।
bhavān viṣṇuḥ paraṃbrahma kṛṣṇanārāyāga prabho ।।87। ।
viśa-praveśane dhātustatra snupratyayādanu ।
viṣṇuḥ sa vyāpakaḥ sarvadevādau parameśvaraḥ ।।88 । ।
kvacid brahmā kvacid rudro bhavāneva parātparaḥ ।
viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ śaṃbhurbrahmā kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।89 । ।
ebhiśca nāmabhirbrahmaparaṃ proktaṃ sanātanam ।
nāsti bhedo'vatārāṇāmekasminnavatāriṇi ।। 1.552.90 ।।
yo'nyathā bhāvayedetat te bodhyāḥ kalidharmiṇaḥ ।
te yānti narakaṃ ghoraṃ nindakāḥ pāpapūruṣāḥ ।।9 1 । ।
etādṛśā bhaviṣyanti bhedakā hi kalau yuge। ।
mohakā vaṃcakā loke jñānagoṣṭhyā viḍambakāḥ ।। 92 । ।
vadiṣyanti vayaṃ sujñā jānīmaḥ paramaṃ prabhum ।
nānye jānanti tattattvamavatārādicintakāḥ ।।93 ।।
ityeteṣāṃ nindakānāṃ haryavatāradrohiṇām ।
kṣetrāṇi dharmarājasya nagaryāṃ kāritāni vai ।।94।।
tena bāhyavrate śubhrā hṛdi kṛṣṇā vinindakāḥ ।
drohiṇaścāvamantāro yāsyanti narake dhruvam ।। 95।।
brahmaṇā'haṃ purā sṛṣṭaḥ proktaśca sṛja vai prajāḥ ।
avijñānasamartho'haṃ nimagnaḥ salile tadā ।। 96 ।।
tatrā'paśyaṃ supuruṣaṃ divyaṃ tvaṃguṣṭhamātrakam ।
kiśoraṃ meghasaṃkāśaṃ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇam ।। 97।।
tamahaṃ pṛṣṭavān kastvaṃ kathaṃ jātaḥ prakathyatām ।
sa māmāha tvamevā'haṃ brahmā'haṃ viṣṇurasmyaham ।। 98।।
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo devo jalaśāyī sanātanaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhavāmi dhāmani ।। 99।।
divyaṃ te'stu netramatra paśya māṃ yatnato hara ।
evamuktastadā tena yāvatpaśyāmyahaṃ ca tam ।। 1.552.100 ।।
tāvat pare'kṣare divye dhāmni dṛṣṭo mayā prabhuḥ ।
sa eva vīkṣitaścāpi goloke'pi vikuṇṭhake ।। 101 ।।
mahāviṣṇurjale dṛṣṭo virāḍrūrūpo'pi vīkṣitaḥ ।
tannābhau paṃkajaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ brahmā tatra vilokitaḥ ।। 102 ।।
tatpārśve'haṃ mayā dṛṣṭo dṛṣṭvā'haṃ harṣamāgataḥ ।
tapasā tadguṇān smṛtvā'stauṣaṃ śrīparameśvaram ।। 103 ।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāhā'gastyaṃ vai tvarbudācale ।
tanmayā te'tra kathitaṃ lakṣmi! mokṣapradaṃ vacaḥ ।। 1 04।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya mokṣo bhavet pare'kṣare ।
sakāmānāṃ gṛhalakṣmīdhanaputrādikaṃ bhavet ।। 105 ।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne''gastyasya divyatā cirajīvitvādiprāptiḥ, arbudācale rudrasya camatkāraḥ, satyetarayugīyamānavānāṃ tridevaviṣayaka- parasparadrohakāriṇāṃ saṃsārapravāhasajīvanatetyādi-
nirūpaṇanāmā dvipañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 552 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 553 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 554
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 555 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! haraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tīrthamaṇḍalam ।
viśvāvasustapastepe siddhaḥ śivaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 1 ।।
tutoṣa nṛpatestasya śaṃbhurdarśanamāyayau ।
varaṃ vṛṇu samuvāca siddhiṃ vavre harācca saḥ ।। 2 ।।
siddheśvaraṃ ca talliṃgaṃ tīrtharūpaṃ vyajāyata ।
śukreśvaraṃ ca śukreṇa sthāpitaṃ tīrthamucyate ।। 3 ।।
śukraḥ śrīśaṃkarāt prāptastapastaptvā'tra duṣkaram ।
vidyāṃ sañjīvanīṃ mṛtyuñjayāṃ sandhāyinīṃ tathā ।। 4 ।।
tatrā'sti nirjharaṇaṃ ca jalasya pāvanaṃ śubham ।
tatra kuṇḍe janaḥ snātvā'lpamṛtyubhayamutsṛjet ।। 5 ।।
tato gacched vālakhilyatapaḥsthānaṃ supāvanam ।
tatra kuṇḍe janaḥ snātvā divyarūpadharo bhavet ।। 6 ।।
kirātavanitā tatra kurūpā'pi tṛṣānvitā ।
jalaṃ pātuṃ yayau dṛṣṭvā snānārhaṃ jalamuttamam ।। 7 ।।
snātvā yāvadbahiryāti divyā devī tadā'bhavat ।
tasyāḥ patistu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā papraccha kā'si sundari! ।। 8 ।।
mama patnī samāyātā kuṇḍe'tra jalavāñcchayā ।
tvayā dṛṣṭā kṛṣṇavarṇā ced yadi vada devike ।। 9 ।।
sā covāca nijaṃ kāntaṃ tavaiva dayitā'smyaham ।
kuṇḍasnānaprabhāveṇa jātā'smi devakanyakā ।। 1.554.10 ।।
svāmistvaṃ snāhi kuṇḍe'tra devatulyo bhaviṣyasi ।
ityuktaḥ snānamakarot tāvannaṣṭānyaghāni vai ।। 11 ।।
dehaṃ tyaktvā mṛtiṃ yāto vanitāpi pativratā ।
punaḥ snātvā tanuṃ tyaktvā vimānena suvarcasā ।। 1 2।।
devakanyābhirājuṣṭā svāminā saha sundarī ।
namaskṛtvā śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ prayayau tridivaṃ prati ।। 13 ।।
maṇikarṇā'bhidhā yatra kirātī mokṣaṇaṃ gatā ।
māṇikarṇeśvaraḥ kuṇḍaṃ liṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ hi tanmatam ।। 14।।
vālakhilyāstatra nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti kutupe śubhe ।
tatra sūryagrahe snānaṃ kurukṣetrasya puṇyadam ।। 1 5।।
snāne yatsmaraṇaṃ syāt tatprāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
athā'paraṃ paṅgutīrthaṃ paṅguvipreṇa saṃsthitam ।। 16 ।।
cyavanasyā'nvaye paṅgunāmā vipraḥ kadācana ।
śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samāyāto'rbude sārthasya yogataḥ।।17।।
ekaṃ nirjharamāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam ।
śivabhaktiparo vāyubhakṣo homajapakriyaḥ ।। 18।।
tasya tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ sākṣāttatra samāyayau ।
caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ varadānaṃ dadau haraḥ ।। 1 9।।
yāhi mokṣaṃ paṅgubhāvaṃ vihāya divyadehavān ।
sa ca mokṣaṃ gato natvā paṅgutīrthaṃ hi tanmatam ।।1.554.2 0 ।।
yatromāsahitaḥ śaṃbhū rājate nirjharāntike ।
snātvā pītvā jalaṃ yāti mokṣaṃ śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
atha citrāṃgado rājā purā pāpaparo'bhavat ।
mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yāto'rbude hradasamīpataḥ ।।22।।
jalapānāya ca yātaḥ snātastatra hrade tathā ।
akasmātsa dhṛto rājā grāheṇa bhakṣito'pi ca ।।23।।
-228cchraṣṭapucchra yamarājaśca tān prāhā'rbude mattīrthake sthale ।।।24।।
mṛto'yaṃ vai hrade puṇye nā'yaṃ daṇḍārha eva yat। ।
yātu svargaṃ sahasrāṇi yugānāṃ tvekaviṃśatiḥ ।।25।।
yatra pūrvaṃ mayā taptaṃ tapastatra mṛto hyasau ।
tatra tīrthe janaḥ snātā svargaṃ prāpsyati niścitam ।।।26।।।
yamatīrthaṃ hi tatproktaṃ citrāṃgadavimuktidam ।
puṇḍrodaṃ ca tatastīrthaṃ gacchet pāpapraṇāśakam ।।27।।
purā puṇḍrodako nāma vipro vairāgyamāsthitaḥ ।
arbude nirjhare ramye martukāmaḥ samāyayau ।।28।।
ekasminneva kāle tu tatraiva ca sarasvatī ।
vīṇāvinodasaṃyuktā vivikte pathi saṃsthitā ।।29।।
uvāca brāhmaṇaṃ devī vada kiṃ te'sti vāñchitam ।
sa prāha nāsti me buddhirūpādhyāyaistiraskṛtaḥ ।।1.554.30।।
na me sarasvatī mātā jihvā'gre vartate yataḥ ।
martumicchāmi cātraiva yena śreyo bhaviṣyati ।।31।।
mātā prāha prasādānme vāṇī te'stu sadottamā ।
vidyā vedādijanyāste trāsantāṃ tarkaśobhanāḥ ।।32।।
adyaprabhṛti vāgmī tvamatra loke bhaviṣyasi ।
sārasvataṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇḍrodākhyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।।।3 3।।
trayodaśyāṃ snānakartā vidvān samyag bhaviṣyati ।
evamuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata ।।।34।।।
puṇḍrodako hi sarvajño bhūtvā tvante divaṃ yayau ।
tato gacchennalatīrthaṃ śrīmātā yatra rājate ।।।25।।
nalākhye śikhare tatra bāṣkalirnāma dānavaḥ ।
purā'bhavanmahāghorastadvināśāya pārvatī ।।36 ।।
śrīmātā rūpiṇī jātā hitāya jagatāṃ satī ।
bāṣkaliṃ ca jīvagrāhaṃ gṛhītvā mṛtyuvarjitam ।।37।।
parvatasya mahacchṛṃgaṃ natvā tasyopari svayam ।
niviṣṭā sā jaganmātā vasatyālokarakṣiṇī ।।38।।
tatraiva pāduke divye tayā nyaste śubhe tataḥ ।
karoti taddarśanaṃ yaḥ saṃsāraṃ sa na paśyati ।। 39।।
matpādukābharākrānto bāṣkalirdaityapuṃgavaḥ ।
nā'smāt sthānād bahiḥ kvāpi nirgatyordhvaṃ gamiṣyati ।।1.554.40 ।।
caitre caturdaśīrātrau pādukāpūjanaṃ mama ।
kartavyaṃ gahvare tatra nivatsyāmyaṇurūpiṇī ।।41 ।।
atra tīrthaṃ kariṣyanti yai te kailāsavāsinaḥ ।
bhaviṣyanti na sandehaścetyuktvā'dṛśyatāṃ gatā ।।42।।
tato gacchecchuṃbhanāśakarīṃ vindhyācalīṃ satīm ।
arbude divyarūpeṇa rājate sā śivājñayā ।।43।।
guhāmadhyaṃ samāsādya vivikte durgame sthale ।
yastāṃ paśyati bhāvena sarvamīpsitamāpnuyāt ।।।44।।
atha pūrve tapastaptaṃ maṃkinā brāhmaṇena vai ।
pūrvaṃ vipro mahāmūrkhaḥ parvate mahiṣīṃ śubhām ।।45।।
dugdhadāṃ rakṣayāmāsa tathā'nyā mahiṣīḥ punaḥ ।
tāśca vikrīya bhūkṣetraṃ vṛṣadvayaṃ ca jagṛhe ।।46।।
vṛṣau kvacid dhuri nyastau tāvaduṣṭraḥ samāgataḥ ।
āghrāya tau dhurākāṣṭhe grīvāṃ protāṃ cakāra saḥ ।।47।।
athoṣṭraḥ sa bhayayukto gale prālagnagodhuraḥ ।
goyugena hi grīvāyāṃ lambamānena vai tadā । ।48।।
dudrāva tena tu vṛṣau viprāṇo vai mṛtau tataḥ ।
maṃkirvairāgyamāpanno nirjhare cārbudācale ।।49।।
samāśritya tapo ghoraṃ cakāra prajapan harim ।
maṃkiḥ piṇḍārakaḥ so'yaṃ ddarśa śaṃkaraṃ puraḥ ।।।1.554.50।।।
tuṣṭāva taṃ tathā muktiṃ jagāma śaṃkarecchayā ।
maṃkeḥ piṇḍārakasyaitat sthalaṃ piṇḍārakaṃ tataḥ । । 51 ।।
khyātaṃ piṇḍārakaṃ tīrthe snātavyaṃ tvaṣṭamītithau ।
deyaṃ gomahiṣīdānaṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhet tataḥ ।।52।।
raktābandhaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchet tato'rbudācale ।
purā''sīt pārthivo nāmnā indraseno mahābalaḥ ।।53 ।।
tasya patnī sunandā''sīt pātivratyaparāyaṇā ।
rājā yayau raṇe yoddha jītvā śatrūn samāgataḥ ।।54।।
dūtaṃ sa preṣayāmāsa rājñīṃ prati parīkṣayā ।
sunandāṃ brūhi gatvā tvam indraseno hato raṇe ।।55। ।
śrutvā karoti kāṃ ceṣṭāṃ viditvākārameva tu ।
maraṇāya yadi yatnaṃ kuryād rakṣyā prayatnataḥ ।।56।।
ityuktaḥ sa gato dūtaścovācāpi yathoditam ।
sunandā''karṇya śīghraṃ svaprāṇān jahau niruddhya vai ।।57। ।
hatyāpāpaṃ nṛpe lagnaṃ hāsyaparīkṣayotthitam ।
rājño gurutaraṃ kāyaṃ sālasyaṃ samapadyata ।।58।।
tejohīnaṃ vivarṇaṃ ca prasannatā vivarjitam ।
gṛhamāgatya rājā sa jñātvā tat paryadevayat। ।।59। ।
strīhatyāyā vināśārthaṃ tatastīrthāya niryayau ।
prāptau raktānubandhākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ cārbudaparvate । ।1.554.6 0। ।
tatra snātvā viniṣkrānto yāvannijaṃ prapaśyati ।
tāvanna dṛśyate chāyā yā lagnā strīvadhodbhavā ।।6 1 ।।
surūpo vīryavān jātastejovṛddhiḥ parā'bhavat ।
tatra tīrthe tapastaptvā visṛjya varṣma yogataḥ ।।62।।
āruhya divyayānaṃ ca kailāsaṃ prayayau drutam ।
prāṇināmanuraktānāṃ tāraṇaṃ prakaroti tat ।।63।।
tīrthaṃ raktoddhārakaṃ tannāmnā khyātaṃ tataḥ sadā ।
vināyakaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ kuryād vighnapraśāntaye ।।64।।
tataḥ pārśveśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ gacchet pāpapraṇāśanam ।
devalasyā'bhavatpatnī pārthā'bhidhā pativratā ।।65।।
tayā taptaṃ tapastatra vandhyātvanāśahetave ।
sā'tra dadarśa śaṃbhuṃ vai putravaraṃ lalābha ca ।।66।।
putraśataṃ tataḥ prāptaṃ śaṃkarasya varāt tayā ।
yatrā'sti nirmalaṃ toyaṃ girigahvaraniḥsṛtam ।।67।।
tīrthasyā'sya vidhānena dāraputrādikaṃ labhet ।
māṃmuñcahradatīrthaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mokṣakāṅkṣiṇā ।।68।।
mudgalarṣiḥ purā tatra tapastepe'tidāruṇam ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇeti japan sadā ।।69।।
arbude triṣavaṇaśca babhūva kṣīṇakalmaṣaḥ ।
taṃ tu netuṃ mahāsvargaṃ devadūtaḥ samāgataḥ ।।1.554.70।।
vimānastho muniṃ prāhā''ruhaitad gamyatāṃ diviṃ ।
indreṇa preṣitaścā'smi śīghramāgaccha mā ciram ।।71 ।।
papraccha mudgalastaṃ vai guṇān doṣān divastathā ।
śrutvā yāsyāmi cenmanye kṣamaṃ svargaṃ śubhaṃ mama ।।72।।
dūtaḥ prāha svakaiḥ puṇyaiḥ prāpyate svarjanai mune! ।
muniḥ prāha yarthārthaṃ tatphalaṃ śrāvaya me'nuga ।।73।।
aśrutaistairna gaccheyamiti me hṛdi niścitam ।
cariṣye ca tapo bhūri pūjayiṣye narāyaṇam ।।74।।
dūtaḥ prāha guṇān sarvān yauvanaṃ sarvathā samam ।
nandanādīni ramyāṇi divyadevavanāni ca ।।75।।
ananyasadṛśā bhogāḥ sadā tṛptipradāḥ sukhāḥ ।
bubhukṣā naiva na tṛṣṇā nā''lasyaṃ nā'pi nidrikā ।।76 ।।
devyo ramyāścaikarūpā bhogayogyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ।
gāndharvā gāyanaṃ nityaṃ śrāvayanti ca vādyajam ।।77।।
ramayanti gṛhe rāmā gītanṛtyaprahāsanaiḥ ।
na ca rogāḥ śarīreṣu puṣṭistvamṛtasaṃbhavā ।।78।।
vīryaṃ dehe pūrṇatattvaṃ hrāso yasya na vidyate ।
bhojyaṃ cāmṛtamevā'sti bahudhā svecchayā kṛtam ।।179।।
vātapittakaphādīnāṃ saṃsargo devatāsu na ।
durgandhādi na vidyeta rūpaṃ tvekapramāṇakam ।।1.554.80।।
vṛddhihrāsau tvacāṃ nāsti malaṃ cāpi na vidyate ।
divyadṛṣṭirdivyabhogā divyāmbarāṇi santi ca ।।81 ।।
vyomamārge gatimantaḥ surādyā viharanti hi ।
vimānānyapyasaṃkhyāni maṇiratnāni hīrakāḥ ।।82।।
divyāstejomayāḥ sarve saudhe dīpā nisargajāḥ ।
candrakāntisamā''vyāptaṃ bhavanaṃ pratidaivatam ।।83।।
dāsā dāsyaḥ sahasrāṇi peyarasāśca kāmadāḥ ।
kāmacārāḥ kāmabhogā mānasāḥ sṛjirūpiṇaḥ ।।84।।
sahasrayugaparyantaṃ parā''yuśca tato'dhikam ।
puṇyānurūpaṃ svargaṃ saṃbhujyate bhogadehinā ।।85।।
yāvatpuṇyakṣayastāvat paścāt pātamavāpnuyāt ।
evaṃ guṇāḥ pravartante nodarārthaṃ hi bhṛtyatā ।।86।।
nūtanaṃ puṇyakaṃ svarge jāyate na kathaṃcana ।
tena pāto bhavet tasmāt puṇyakṣaye divaukasām ।।87।।
ayameva mahān doṣaḥ patanaṃ vai bhayaṃkaram ।
karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahman bhogabhūmirdivaṃ matam ।।88।।
yadatra kriyate śreṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ tatropabhujyate ।
dānavānāṃ bale jāte kvaciddharanti dānavāḥ ।।89।।
gṛhaṃ dārāścopavastūnyapi sarvāṇi vai balāt ।
tadidaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ cāpi parabhuktāḥ striyo'pi ca ।।1.554.90।।
tathā koṭiguṇitān vai dṛṣṭvā puṇyaprabhāviṇaḥ ।
bahusmṛddhānalpapuṇyaḥ paścāttāpaṃ karotyapi ।।9 1।।
na ca yaiḥ sukṛtaṃ bhūri kṛtaṃ te'lpāḥ suduḥkhinaḥ ।
yanna martye pradattaṃ tatsvarge na prāpyate kvacit ।।92।।
tad duḥkhaṃ tu mahat proktaṃ mānave pūrvakarmavat ।
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ guṇadoṣātmakaṃ divam ।।93।।
āgaccha sumune! śīghraṃ yadvepsitaṃ vadā'tra me ।
śrutvā vicārya tatsarvaṃ martyavat prāha mudgalaḥ ।।94।।
yathā cātra tathā tatra dhanadāragṛhādikam ।
kleśasya bhājanaṃ cāsti patanasya bhayaṃ tathā ।।95।।
puṇyahāniḥ sadā tvāste vardhanaṃ na hi jāyate ।
tena svargeṇa me dūta! naiva kāryaṃ kathañcana ।।96।।
vācyastvayā mamā''deśād devarājaḥ sphuṭaṃ vacaḥ ।
kṣamyatāmaparādho me na svargīyā spṛhā mama ।।97।।
tatkarmā'haṃ kariṣyāmi yena syāt patanaṃ na vai ।
sādhayiṣyāmi tān lokān ye sadā bhayavarjitāḥ ।।98।।
evaṃ śrutvā mudgalaṃ taṃ sa dūtaḥ svarganispṛham ।
yayau śīghraṃ mahendraṃ samprāha vistārapūrvakam ।।99।।
śakraḥ śrutvā'tha taṃ prāha balādānaya taṃ munim ।
svargabhogārthakaṃ puṇyaṃ nā'bhuktvā kṣayameṣyati ।। 1.554.1 00।।
dūtaḥ śrutvā yayau tatra yatra tiṣṭhati mudgalaḥ ।
vilokya mudgalaḥ śīlaṃ jalaṃ viveśa yogataḥ ।। 101 ।।
dūtaḥ sa jaḍavajjāto munerdṛṣṭyā viceṣṭakaḥ ।
indraḥ smṛto'tha dūtena samāyātaḥ sureśvaraḥ ।। 1 02।।
vajrahastaḥ sthito vyomni muniṃ netuṃ samīhate ।
stambhayāmāsa cendraṃ taṃ dṛṣṭipātena mudgalaḥ ।। 1 03।।
tadā śakraḥ stutiṃ cakre bhagnotsāhaśca muñca mām ।
svarge vā yadi vā martye tiṣṭha tvaṃ muñca māṃ mune ।। 1 04।।
mudgalaḥ prāha devendra! durlabhaṃ darśanaṃ tava ।
yāhi svargaṃ sadūtastvaṃ sthāsyāmyatraiva cā'nagha ।। 1 05।।
bhajiṣye śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ yāsye'kṣaraṃ padam ।
māṃ muñceti tvayā proktaṃ tīrthaṃ māṃmuñcanāmakam ।। 1 06।।
bhavatvidaṃ sadā prakhyaṃ tava śabdena vajrabhṛt ।
phālgune pūrṇamāsyāṃ ye snāsyantyatra hrade janāḥ ।। 1 07।।
tarpayiṣyanti pitṝँśca yāsyanti mokṣaṇaṃ hi te ।
śrutvaivaṃ prayayau svargaṃ dūtamādāya vajrabhṛt ।। 1 08।।
mudgalo'pi paraṃbrahma cintayaँstatra saṃsthitaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dhvātvā'kṣaraṃ yayau ।। 1 09।।
ityāha śaṃkaro lakṣmi! pārvatīṃ tvarbudācale ।
mayā te kathitaṃ tadvai mokṣadaṃ lokapāvanam ।। 1.554.11 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne siddhatīrthaśukratīrthamaṇikarṇatīrthapaṃgutīrthayamatīrthapuṇḍrodatīrthaśrīmātṛvindhyācalīmaṃkipiṇḍārakaraktoddhārapārthāmudgalamāṃmuñcatīrthānāṃ sopākhyānānāṃ varṇanaṃ svargasya guṇadoṣanirūpaṇaṃ cetyādināmā catuḥpañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।554।।


← adhyāyaḥ 554 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 555
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 556 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prāha cārbude ।
tīrthānyanyāni te vacmi pāpanāśakarāṇi hi ।। 1 ।।
tatrā''ste caṇḍikātīrthaṃ vipraiścaṇḍī samarcitā ।
sthāpitā vedamantraiśca mahiṣāsuranāśinī ।। 2 ।।
arbude jāhnavīkuṇḍaṃ śikhare vidyate śubham ।
yatra gaṃgā śaṃkareṇa labhate vatsarāntare ।। 3 ।।
sahayogaṃ tu sevāyāṃ varadānena cārbude ।
athā'caleśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ śaivaṃ tatra ca vidyate ।। 4 ।।
yatra pūrve pāpacāraḥ kuṣṭhakṣāmatanurnaraḥ ।
bhikṣārthamāgatastatra saktūbhikṣāmavāpa saḥ ।। 5 ।।
kuḍave nyasya rātrau sa suptastatra kṣaṇaṃ yadā ।
tāvat śvā prasamāgatya bhakṣayāmāsa saktukam ।। 6 ।।
anye śvānaḥ samāgatya śunā kurvanti vigraham ।
unnidraḥ so'bhavacchrutvā saktūnāśaṃ dadarśa ca ।। 7 ।।
tato vai kevalaṃ vāri pītvā snātvā drumāntike ।
suṣvāpa ca tataḥ prātaśconnidraḥ sa babhūva ha ।। 8 ।।
yāvat paśyati cātmānaṃ devagandharvasannibham ।
jalasnānaprapānādeḥ pratāpaṃ jñātavāँśca saḥ ।। 9 ।।
atha kālāntare daivavaśāt sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ ।
tato jātismaro jāto vidarbhādhipatergṛhe ।। 1.555.1 0।।
bhīmo nāma nṛpaśreṣṭho damayantīpitā hi saḥ ।
śune saktūpradānasya phalaṃ rājyamavāpa saḥ ।। 11 ।।
gatvā tatra dadātyeva saktūn vai prativāsaram ।
papracchurgālavādyāstaṃ kathaṃ saktūn dadāsi vai ।। 12।।
hastyaśvarathadānāni dīyante na kathaṃ tvayā ।
sa tadā kathayāmāsa prāgbhavasyā'dbhutaṃ phalam ।। 13।।
saktūdānaprabhāveṇa rājyaṃ prāptaṃ yato mayā ।
saktavo mama vai tīrthe śvabhistatra hi bhakṣitāḥ ।। 14।।
mayā snānaṃ tathā pītaṃ jalaṃ puṇyapradaṃ tataḥ ।
kṣīṇapāpo'bhavaṃ rājā karomi saktudānakam ।।15।।
jñātvā dānena saktūnāṃ phalaṃ me śāśvataṃ bhavet ।
tīrthe'tra muktisaṃyukte bhaktyā saktūn dadāmi hi ।। 16।।
śrutvā te munayaḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ।
sādhu sādhu paraṃ rājannityabruvan punaḥ punaḥ ।। 17।।
etasya paṭhanādvāpi śravaṇādapi bhūpatiḥ ।
bhavedatra paratrāpi śāśvataṃ sukhamāpnuyāt ।। 18।।
kulasantāraṇaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate cārbudācale ।
purā tvāsīt pāpakarmarataścā'prastutābhidhaḥ ।।1 9।।
nṛpaḥ satkāraśūnyaśca jñānadānavivarjitaḥ ।
nyāyato'nyāyato vāpi karoti dhanasaṃgraham ।।1.555.20 ।।
tato vārdhakyamāpanno vṛddhairanyaiśca bodhitaḥ ।
kuru rājan dharmakāryaṃ maraṇādau śubhaṃ bhavet ।।21 ।।
rājā prāha balaṃ dharmo balena ca kṛtaṃ mayā ।
dhanaṃ rājyaṃ dāragṛhaṃ tathā'nyattvarjitaṃ bahu ।।22।।
nā'smāccā'sti paro dharma indriyatṛptidāt paraḥ ।
ityuktā maunamādāya yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ।।23।।
athā'nte tasya pitaro duḥkhitā ūcureva tam ।
vayaṃ śuddhasamācārā dānadharmaparāḥ purā ।।24।।
puṇyaiḥ svargaṃ gatāścādya kuputreṇa nipātitāḥ ।
tvaṃ tu kuputraḥ sañjāto dharmakāryavivarjitaḥ ।।25।।
tataścoddhara naḥ sarvān kṛtvā kiñcicchubhārjanam ।
karmabhistava pāpātman vayaṃ narakamāśritāḥ ।।26।।
narakaṃ daśa yāsyanti bhaviṣyāśca tvayā yutāḥ ।
śrutvā rājā paraṃ duḥkhamavāpa prāha yoṣitam ।।27।।
patnī prāha tathā śrutvā pitṝnuddhara śobhanaiḥ ।
rājā viprān samāhūya pitṛmedhaṃ cakāra ha ।।28।।
tīrthayātrāṃ tathā cakre cārbude'pi samāgataḥ ।
kulasantāraṇaṃ prāpya snānaṃ tatra cakāra saḥ ।। 29।।
jalāñjalīn dadau smṛtvā pitṝn pitāmahādikān ।
vimuktāḥ pitaro raudrānnarakātsupraharṣitāḥ ।।1.555.3 0।।
tato divyavimānasthā divyamālāmbarānvitāḥ ।
tamūcustāritāḥ sarve vayaṃ putra tvayā'dhunā ।।3 1 ।।
yasmāt kulaṃ tvayā putra tīrthe'smiँstāritaṃ tataḥ ।
kulasantāraṇaṃ nāma tīrthametad bhaviṣyati ।।32।।
āgaccha tvaṃ svaputrāya vasave'rpayya bhūdhuram ।
divaṃ pratīti saṃśrutvā'prastutaṃ svadhuraṃ sute ।।33।।
datvā pitṛvimānaṃ ca samāruhya gato divam ।
eṣaḥ prabhāvastīrthasya mayā te kathitaḥ priye ।।34।।
tato gacchet paraṃ tīrthaṃ parśurāmāśramātmakam ।
tapastaptaṃ yatra tena prāptānyastrāṇi śaṃkarāt ।।35।।
rāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।
tatra vārihrade snātvā bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ।।36।।
tato gacched brahmapadaṃ tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam ।
purā brahmā'rthito viprairmokṣadaṃ dehi vastu naḥ ।।37।।
brahmā prāha dadāmyeva padaṃ me tasya pūjanāt ।
janānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ syāccaraṇāravindasevanāt ।।38।।
spṛśantu ṛṣayaḥ sarve devāścāpi padaṃ mama ।
pūjayiṣyanti saṃprāpte kārtike pūrṇimādine ।।39।।
toyaiḥ phalaiśca kusumairgandhabhojyānulepanaiḥ ।
te yāsyanti na sandeho mama lokaṃ sudurlabham ।।1.555.40।।
pitāmahapadaṃ cārcya bhuktimuktipradaṃ hi tat ।
tatra vai vartate mukhyaṃ puṣkaraṃ trividhaṃ priye ।।41 ।।
padmajasya sadā'bhīṣṭaṃ brahmaṇā ca purā kṛtam ।
vaśiṣṭhādyā ṛṣayo vai purā satraṃ samācaran ।।42।।
brahmā tu satyalokādvai yajñe tatra samāgataḥ ।
trisandhyārthaṃ pragantavyaṃ satyaloke punaḥ punaḥ ।।43 ।।
brahmaṇā munibhiścāpi vicāryaiva ca lāghavam ।
satyalokāt samānītaṃ puṣkaraṃ cārbudācale ।।44।।
yāvat satraṃ cārbude vai sandhyā teṣāṃ babhūva ha ।
tatrā'nyāni puṣkarāṇi samājagmustadā bhuvi ।। 45।।
uttamaṃ puṣkaraṃ vyomni madhyamaṃ śikharopari ।
tṛtīyaṃ tu pṛthivyāṃ vai sarovaramabhūttathā ।।46।।
kārtike pūrṇimāyāṃ ye snānaṃ kurvanti bhāvataḥ ।
teṣāṃ lokāḥ śāśvatāśca svargādyā api bhogadāḥ ।।47।।
tatrottare ca sāvitrīkuṇḍaṃ vai pāpanāśanam ।
brahmaṇaḥ pratimā ramyā darśanānmokṣadāyinī ।।48।।
dhundhumāro'bhavat pūrvaṃ bhaktaḥ śrīśaṃkarasya ha ।
umāmaheśvarastena sthāpito bhavanāśanaḥ ।।49।।
taṃ devaṃ paripūjyaiva nimitīrthaṃ samācaret ।
yatra vai niminā rājñā vārdhakye cārbudācale ।।1.555.50।।
lomaśo'pi tadā tatra bahvarṣibhiḥ samāgataḥ ।
brahmayajñaḥ kṛtastatra viṣṇuyāgaśca vartitaḥ ।।51 ।।
rudrayāgaḥ kṛtaścāpi saṃhitāyāḥ kathā kṛtā ।
mahotsave samastāni jambūdvīpagatānyapi ।।52।।
tīrthāni tvāyayustatrā'vabhṛthārthaṃ jalāśaye ।
jambūtīrthaṃ tu tajjātaṃ pratyayārthaṃ drumastathā ।।53।।
jambūvṛkṣo'bhavattatra divyo drāk saṃvyajāyata ।
tatra snānaṃ nimiścakre sarvatīrthamaye tataḥ ।।54।।
sadehaḥ sa gataḥ svargaṃ divyo bhūtvā suropamaḥ ।
etat sarvaṃ tvarbudasya māhātmyaṃ pārvati! tava ।।55।।
samākhyātaṃ mama sthānamayaṃ puṇyapradaṃ priye ।
arbudastu svayaṃ tīrthaṃ tatra tīrthāni koṭiśaḥ ।।56।।
vasanti ca nivatsyanti guṇakarmādibhiḥ satām ।
pārvati! te prasaṃgena śraddhayā ca mayā'pi vai ।।57।।
kṛtāni bahutīrthāni dhanyo'haṃ vai tvayā priye! ।
yasya patnī devaparā bhaktimatī pareśvare ।।58।।
dharmakārye samutsāhā saśraddhā puṇyakarmaṇi ।
ātithye'tiprasannā ca satsevāyāṃ śubhādarā ।।।59।।।
ātmakārye'tivegā ca jñāne premavatī sadā ।
yaśasyevā'nusandhānavatī japaparāyaṇā ।।1.555.60।।
tapaḥśaucādisaṃyuktā homayajñaparāyaṇā ।
bhartṛdevā pitṛdevā bhṛtyarakṣākarī tathā ।।6 1 ।।
gobhūbrāhmaṇasādhūnāṃ sādhvīnāṃ mānakāriṇo ।
sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya nārāyaṇasya kiṃkarī ।।62।।
kṣamayā pṛthivītulyā vairāgye vṛkṣasadṛśī ।
sauśīlye brahmatulyā ca sevane snehapātrikā ।।6 3 ।।
sahāye stambhavannityaṃ dāne cātmasamarpiṇī ।
paraloke sahāyā ca dhanyastasya gṛhāśramaḥ ।।64।।
sa eva sādhuratrokto yasya patnī pativratā ।
yasya nāsti tathā patnī na sa sādhuḥ sa pāpavān ।।65।।
yasya patnī kaṭu vakti krūraṃ cakṣuḥ karoti ca ।
karoti roṣavad vaktraṃ mānasaṃ na dadātyapi ।।6 6।।
dhik tasya jīvanaṃ loke nirayaścātra tasya vai ।
yasya gṛhe na vai puṇyaṃ nāsti sevā tu śārṅgiṇaḥ ।।67।।
nāsti bhojyasamutsāho nāsti vastrādi śobhanam ।
nāsti premamayī vāṇī nāsti snehāvalokanam ।।68।।
nare nāryāṃ ca vā'patye tasya janma nirarthakam ।
dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ yasyedṛśī satī priyā ।।69।।
tvayā'smi sarvadā dhanyo virakto raktayā saha ।
udvegaṃ strīkṛtaṃ labdhvā yānti tvanye vanāntaram ।।1.555.70।।
na teṣāṃ vanavāsena siddhirbhavati tādṛśī ।
yādṛśī strīprasādena gṛhasthasyā'pi saṃbhavet ।।7 1।।
abalānāmanāthānāṃ bālānāṃ rogiṇāṃ tathā ।
daridrāṇāṃ kṣudhitānāṃ tṛṣitānāṃ vivastriṇām ।।72।।
nirāśrayāṇāṃ lokānāṃ satāṃ satīnāṃ yoginām ।
āśīrvādāḥ phalantyatra drutaṃ siddhipradā hi te ।।73 ।।
yatra devyo ramaṇyaśca modante gṛhamedhinām ।
tatra lakṣmīḥ sampadaśca svargaṃ mokṣo'sti dharmiṇām ।।74।।
yatra sarvavidhā śāntirnirvṛttirvidyate'niśam ।
tatra mokṣo bhavatyeva dhanyo'haṃ tādṛśo gṛhī ।।75।।
yo gṛhastho divārātraṃ dhanaṃ tvarjayati dhruvam ।
bhāravāhī na jānāti rakṣaṇaṃ strīkuṭumbinām ।।76।।
bhojanaṃ cāsanaṃ vastuyojanaṃ tūtsavādikam ।
dhanaṃ tasya nirarthaṃ vai niḥśvāsadagdhameva tat ।।77।।
yaddhanaṃ naiva devānāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ kuṭumbinām ।
vaṃśyānāṃ ca nijānāṃ ca bhogyaṃ tanmṛttikāsamam ।।78।।
yaḥ patirna prasanno'sti hāsyānano na dṛśyate ।
prasannaśabdaḥ premāḍhyaḥ snehanetro na dṛśyate ।।79।।
samānahṛdayo nāsti nāsti bhāvayutastathā ।
nā'nugrahaṃ vidhatte ca na cā''vaśyakatāṃ caret ।।1.555.80 ।।
na rameta ramayedvā na ca dhyānaṃ karoti ca ।
na cāhvayati miṣṭena nā''kārayati vai hṛdā ।।81 ।।
na vā miṣṭaṃ bhojayedvā pāyayenmadhuraṃ na ca ।
madhu sammelayennaiva milatyeva na nirjane ।।82।।
na ca spṛśati saukhyārthaṃ smarennaiva śubhasthale ।
na pṛcched gṛhiṇībhāvaṃ mānasaṃ na ca rañjayet ।।83।।
kiṃ tena patinā loke vṛthā tasyā janurbhuvi ।
tasmād devi! tvayā rakṣyo vairāgye saṃsthito'pyaham ।।84।।
tvayaiva mama gārhasthyaṃ prakāśameti sarvathā ।
tvayā pūrvaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā mama mūlyaṃ pravardhitam ।।85।।
tvayā dagdhvā satīdehaṃ devatvaṃ mama vardhitam ।
tvayā daityāँstathā hatvā svāmiśraiṣṭhyaṃ prakāśitam ।।86।।
tvayā putrau gaṇaskandau dattvā me pūjyatā kṛtā ।
tvayaiva devi gārhasthyaṃ svarge mokṣo vane'pi me ।।87।।
tvayaiva devi tīrthāni kṛtānyadya mayā bhuvi ।
gamiṣyāmo'dhunā naijaṃ kailāsaṃ vada kiṃ param ।।88।।
yadyat te rocate haimi! vada sampādayepsitam ।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।।89।।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tubhyaṃ cārbudatīrthakam ।
pāpatāpaharaṃ mokṣakaraṃ śāntikaraṃ param ।।1.555.90।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'rbudācale caṇḍikātīrthajāhnavīkuṇḍā'caleśvarabhīmatīrthakulasantāraṇatīrthaparśurāmatīrthabrahmapadatīrthatripu-
ṣkarasāvitrīkuṇḍanimitīrthānāṃ sopākhyānaṃ varṇanaṃ, śivakṛtā satīpraśaṃsā cetinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 555 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 555 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 556
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 557 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śaṃkarādyāḥ kṛtvā tīrthāni cārbude ।
vyomayānairyayurvyomni paśyanto bhūtalādikān ।। 1 ।।
satī ca pārvatī dṛṣṭvā suśobham ṛkṣaparvatam ।
papraccha śaṃkaraṃ namrā ko'yaṃ prakāśate giriḥ ।। 2 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mahānāste ṛkṣākhyaḥ parvato hyayam ।
yatra vai ṛṣayaḥ santi tāpasā vanavāsinaḥ ।। 3 ।।
oṃkārākhyo vasāmyatra tvayā sākaṃ hi ṛkṣake ।
śrutvaivaṃ pārvatī prāha śaṃbho'tra bhūtale punaḥ ।। 4 ।।
himālayāt samārabhya samudraṃ prati parvatāḥ ।
kati tvadāśrayāḥ santi kati nadyaśca me vada ।। 5 ।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha śṛṇu haimi! saptā'tra kulaparvatān ।
mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣaparvataḥ ।। 6 ।।
vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca hyete vai kulaparvatāḥ ।
anye tu mandaraḥ śāraḥ kailāso dardurastathā ।। 7 ।।
maināko vaidyuto vārandhamaḥ pāṇḍurakastathā ।
tuṃgaprasthaḥ kṛṣṇagirirjayanta ṛṣyamūkakaḥ ।। 8 ।।
airāvataśca gomantaścitrakūṭaḥ śrīparvataḥ ।
cakorakūṭaḥ śrīśailaḥ śatruṃjitaḥ kṛtasmaraḥ ।। 9 ।।
raivatādrirbaradādaḥ śālamālādayo'pi ca ।
vartante pāvanāstīrthabhūmayastārakāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1.256.1 0।।
himācalo mahānāste pitā te'yutaśṛṃgavān ।
tasmānnadyo nirgatā yāḥ svasārastava tāḥ śṛṇu ।। 11 ।।
gaṃgā sindhuḥ śatadruśca vitastā ca sarasvatī ।
vipāśā candrabhāgā ca sarayūryamunā tathā ।। 1 2।।
irāvatī devikā ca kuhūrgomatī bāhudā ।
dhūtapāpā dṛṣadvatī nisvīrā kauśikī tathā ।। 1 3।।
cakṣuṣmatī gaṇḍakī ca lohitā brahmaputrakaḥ ।
yāḥ samudraṃ yathānimnaṃ mimīluḥ puṇyapāvanāḥ ।। 14।।
pāriyātrodbhavāścāpi samākarṇaya śobhane । ।
vedasmṛtirvedavatī sindhuparṇā carmaṇvatī ।। 15।।
candranābhā rohipārā nāśadā''cāranāmikā ।
vedatrayī vidiśā ca vapantī tāḥ samudragāḥ ।। 16 ।।
nadīḥ ṛkṣaprasūtāśca śṛṇu tvaṃ pāvanīḥ śubhāḥ ।
śoṇo jyotīrathā cāpi narmadā surasā tathā ।। 17।।
