mandākinī daśārṇā ca tamasā pippalā tathā ।
citrakūṭā karatoyā citrotpallā piśācikā ।। 18।।
viśālā vaṃjukā vāluvāhinī virajā tathā ।
śuktimatī paṃkinī ca rātrī tāḥ ṛkṣaputrikāḥ ।। 19।।
vindhyapādodbhavāścāpi śṛṇu pāpavināśinīḥ ।
śubhā tāpī payoṣṇī ca maṇijālā kumudvatī ।।1.256.20।।
veṣṇā pāśā vaitaraṇī śīghrādā'ntyā girā tathā ।
durgā toyā vaidipālā vindhyaparvatajāśca tāḥ ।।2 1 ।।
sahyapādodbhavāścāpi śṛṇu nadīḥ samudragāḥ ।
godāvarī bhīmarathī kṛṣṇā veṇī ca vañjrulā ।।22।।
tuṃgabhadrā suprayogā bāhyakāverīti smṛtā ।
malayācalajā nadyastāmraparṇyutpalāvatī ।।23।।
puṣpāvatī śatamālā etāścāpi samudragāḥ ।
mahendratanayā nadyastriyāmā ikṣulā tathā ।।24।।
ṛṣikulyā trivindālā vaṃśavarā ca mūlinī ।
atha śuktimatī nadyaḥ palāśinī ca lūtasī ।। 25।।
ṛṣikā mandagāmā ca samudragāstu tā api ।
etā mahattamā nadyastathā gomatī bhadrikā ।।26 ।।
ojasvatī svarṇarekhā nāganadī ca devikā ।
sābhramatī hiraṇyā ca nyaṃkumatī śatruṃjitā ।।27।।
manoramā candrakalā nārāyaṇī māheśvarī ।
etāścānyā bhavantyeva pāpaghnyo mokṣadāyikāḥ ।।।28।।
śrutvā caivaṃ satī śaṃbhuṃ samuvāca tataḥ param ।
etāsu nātha kutra tvaṃ samūrto vartase vad ।।29।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha ca revāyāṃ varte'haṃ liṃgamūrtikaḥ ।
narmadākaṃkarāḥ sarve śaṃkarā iti me sthitiḥ ।। 1.256.30 ।।
pārvatī prāha me vāñchā jāyate narmadātaṭam ।
draṣṭuṃ darśaya revāṃ me yasmāt sā nirgatā tathā ।।3 1 ।।
yatra praviṣṭā cābdhau sā sarvāṃ darśaya me śiva ।
tathāstviti haraḥ prāha ṛkṣe cāvātarat tadā ।।3 2।।
pārvatyā sahitaḥ śaṃbhustathā svagaṇakoṭibhiḥ ।
revā yasmānniḥsasāra tatraivā'vātatāra ha ।।3 3 ।।
ṛkṣe ca parvate sarve nyūṣu sasnurviśaśramuḥ ।
jalaṃ papurbhojanāni cakrustataśca pārvatī ।।34।।
gaṇānāṃ tu sabhāmadhye śaṃkaraṃ samapṛcchata ।
revodbhavaṃ mama brūhi tathā tīrthāni cāṃjasā ।।35 ।
śaṃkarastāṃ narmadāyā āgamaṃ nijagāda ha ।
śṛṇu haimi! purā daityo hiraṇyakaśipurmahān ।।36 ।।
devādīnardayāmāsa devā nārāyaṇaṃ yayuḥ ।
viṣṇuṃ vijñāpayāmāsurdaityaduḥkhaṃ sudāruṇam ।।37।।
viṣṇurnṛsiṃharūpeṇa hatavān dānaveśvaram ।
tato devairarthiteyaṃ pāvanārthaṃ harergṛhāt ।।3 8।।
vaikuṇṭhātpāvanī mūrtiḥ revā divyasvarūpiṇī ।
nārāyaṇasya bhaktā yā divyā dāsī susevikā ।।3 9 ।।
jalarūpā svayaṃ bhūtvā devaiḥ saha samāyayau ।
svarge sā devaloke vai tasthau ca vahuvatsarān ।।1.256.40 ।।
atha rājā'bhavat pṛthvyāṃ hiraṇyatejānāmataḥ ।
somavaṃśodbhavaḥ so'yaṃ tvekadā tapase vane ।।41 ।।
yayau tapaścacārāti brāhmaṇānāṃ samājñayā ।
mahādevasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ hitāya dehadhāriṇām ।।42।।
narmadāyā bhuvi tvānayanārthaṃ sa janādhipaḥ ।
mahādevaṃ cā'parokṣaṃ dadarśa nṛpatistadā ।।43।।
vavre varaṃ narmadāyāḥ pṛthvyāmāgamanaṃ śubham ।
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ yena samuddhāro bhavediti ।।44।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathā'stvetat tvayā samyag vicāritam ।
sasmāra narmadāṃ sāpi śaṃkarāgre hyupasthitā ।।45।।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhuvaṃ yāhi reve mokṣasya hetave ।
janakalyāṇadā tatra bhava pāpapraṇāśinī ।।46।।
revā prāha nirādhārā kutra tiṣṭhāmi śaṃkara! ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha nagaścāste tūdayācalanāmakaḥ ।।47।।
sa tvāṃ dhārayituṃ śaktastacchṛṃge'vatara priye ।
tataḥ sā narmadā svargādavātatāra vai śanaiḥ ।।48।।
hiraṇyatejāstasyāstu salilaiḥ samatarpayat ।
pitṝn pitāmahādīṃśca tilodakāni vai dadau ।।49।।
uddhṛtāḥ pitaraḥ sarve yayuḥ svargaṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।
so'yaṃ nārmadavārbhiśca pavitro'sti pade pade ।।1.256.50।।
narmadā varṇyate seyaṃ saptakalpānugāminī ।
te deśāḥ parvatāḥ puṇyāste grāmāste'pi cāśramāḥ ।।5 1।।
yatra yātrā saricchreṣṭhā narmadā saptakalpagā ।
tribhiḥ sārasvataṃ puṇyaṃ saptāhena tu yāmunam ।।52।।
sadyaḥ punāti gāṃgeyaṃ darśanādeva narmadā ।
revātaṭeṣu ye vṛkṣāḥ patitāḥ kālaparyaye ।।53।।
narmadātoyasaṃspṛṣṭāste yānti paramāṃ gatim ।
revāyā yatra kutrāpi saṃgame ca taṭe'pi vā ।।54।।।
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛpūjūnam ।
devabhaktirmahādīkṣā nyāso dehavisarjanam ।।55।।
yatkiñcit syānmanuṣyāṇāmanantaphaladaṃ bhavet ।
nārmade mūlatīrthe tad vājimedhaphalapradam ।।56।।
kulānāṃ śatamāgāmi samatītaṃ tathā śatam ।
uddharedātmanā sārdhaṃ revātīrthāvagāhanāt ।।57।।
bhūdānasya pradātrā'tra rājyaprāptiṃ labhed dhruvam ।
narmadātoyapānasya snānasya prekṣaṇasya ca ।।58।।
api cāndrāyaṇaśatādadhikaṃ phalamasti vai ।
prātaryo narmadāṃ puṇyāṃ smarenmokṣaṃ labhettu saḥ ।।59।।
udayādristhitāṃ tāṃ cānināya bhūtale punaḥ ।
purūravākhyarājarṣiḥ somavaṃśe babhūva yaḥ ।।1.256.6 0।।
candrapurīmahārājyaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
nirābādhāḥ prajāstasya bhavaddāridryavarjitāḥ ।।61 ।।
cirāyuṣo janāścāsan kāmadughāśca dhenavaḥ ।
kauśeyapaṭṭavastrāśca narā nāryo vibhūṣitāḥ ।।62।।
vṛkṣe vṛkṣe rasadhārā dharaṇiḥ sasyaśālinī ।
evaṃ rājñā kṛte rājye sarvaṃ siddhimayaṃ hyabhūt ।।63।।
tena sūryagrahe hastivājigobhavanāni ca ।
svarṇarūpyakaratnāni dāne dattāni bhūriśaḥ ।।64।।
atarpayat pitṝँścāpi havyakavyena bhūpatiḥ ।
tadāścaryamabhūd rājño pitṝṇāṃ darśane śṛṇu ।।65।।
atikaṣṭena pitaro jalaṃ pibanti vīkṣitam ।
kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhatālvoṣṭhān kaśmalāँśca mṛdaṃbhasā ।।66।।
nagnān malinavastrāँśca śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā purūravā rājā natvā pitṝnuvāca ha ।।67।।
ke yūyaṃ vikṛtākārāḥ pretabhūtā bubhukṣitāḥ ।
kathayadhvaṃ yathā mokṣo bhavetpretasvarūpataḥ ।।68।।
pitarastu nṛpaṃ prāhurvayaṃ vai tava pūrvajāḥ ।
sadiddhīnamidaṃ kṣetraṃ dharmakarmavivarjitam ।।69।।
na vai tīrthaṃ vinā muktistīrthaṃ cānaya bhūmiṣu ।
ityuktvā te yayuryāmyāṃ diśaṃ rājāpi tatkṣaṇāt ।।1.256.70।।
putre rājyadhuraṃ nyasya yayāvudayaparvatam ।
kandamūlaphalāhāraḥ śivapūjāparāyaṇaḥ ।।71 ।।
bhaktiṃ cakāra paramāṃ tayā tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ।
pratyakṣo'bhūduvācainaṃ bhūpaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu nṛpa ।।72।।
rājā vavre saptakalpavahāṃ śrīnarmadāṃ nadīm ।
pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇārthaṃ vai bhūmiṣu tvavatāraya ।।73।।
śaṃbhunā bhaktatuṣṭyarthamāhūtā narmadā nadī ।
makarāsanamārūḍhā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ।।74।।
projjvalā yuvatī kanyā nārāyaṇāṃgasaṃbhavā ।
sarvasaubhāgyasampannā kṛṣṇakuntalaśobhanā ।।75।।
āgatya śaṃkaraṃ natvovāca kathaṃ nu saṃsmṛtā ।
śivaḥ prāha tvadarthaṃ vai caturdaśasahasrakam ।।76 ।।
varṣāṇāṃ nṛpatistepe hiraṇyataijaso nṛpaḥ ।
bhāvāt pitṛpramokṣārtham ṛkṣādrau tvaṃ prayāhi vai ।।77।।
pretarūpān sarvapitṝn narakasthān samuddhara ।
ityuktvā vyomamārgeṇa revā ṛkṣādrimāyayau ।।78।।
śaṃbhustasyai dadāvagryaṃ sudṛḍhamṛkṣaparvatam ।
gaganāt pracyutā revā papāta parvatopari ।।79।।
purūravāḥ sa rājarṣirnarmadāṃ tvidamabravīt ।
anugrahaḥ kṛto devi! pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇāya me ।।1.256.80।।
rājñā tatastatra nadyāṃ snātvā surāḥ sutarpitāḥ ।
pitarastarpitāścāpi piṇḍādyaistoṣitāstathā ।।81 ।।
narakāduddhṛtāḥ sarve devayānapathe sthitāḥ ।
kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyāḥ pakṣiṇaścāṇḍajāśca ye ।।।82।।
eṣo'vatāraśca puna ādikalpe kṛte yuge ।
evaṃ sā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāmāṃgajā satī ।।83।।
kanyā śrīnarmadādevī devaiḥ svargaṃ samāhṛtā ।
svargādudayaśikharaṃ nītā hiraṇyatejasā ।।84।।
udayādreḥ ṛkṣaśailaṃ purūravā nināya ca ।
tato bhūbhāgamāpannā pāvanī cābdhigā'bhavat ।।85।।
snānāvagāhanātpānātsmaraṇātkīrtanādapi ।
anekabhavajaṃ ghoramaghaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyati ।।86।।
atha prāpte prathame ca kalau nadyaśca sarvaśaḥ ।
pañcasāhasrasaurānte yayuḥ svargaṃ tadā punaḥ ।।87।।
prāpte kṛte'bhavad rājā purukutsaḥ pratāpavān ।
tapastepe narmadāyā avatārāya vai punaḥ ।।88।।
mayā tuṣṭena tasmai ca varo'rpitastatastu sā ।
smṛtā revā samāyātā mamā''jñayā bhuvaṃ prati ।।89।।
paryaṃkaparvate ramye veṇustambe hyavātarat ।
paryaṃkānniḥsṛtā vegād vāruṇīṃ diśamabdhigā ।।1.256.90।।
purukutsaṃ patiṃ kṛtvā śāpāt samudratāṃ gatā ।
vartate pāvanī loke svargasopānapaddhatiḥ ।।91 ।।
ye'pyadharmaratā loke narmadāyāṃ mṛtā yadi ।
te'pi rudratvamāyānti revātoyaprasaṃgataḥ ।।92।।
tatra vaiṇyeśvaraṃ devaṃ veṇumūle vyavasthitam ।
ādyaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ taddhi pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।।93।।
revodgamottare bhāge'nantapuraṃ supattanam ।
ṛṣyāśramātmakaṃ tvāste divyaṃ muktipradaṃ sadā ।।94।।
vyāsāśramaṃ purā tatra sadāsītpāvanaṃ param ।
śaivakṣetraṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ vidyate śāśvataṃ śubham ।।95।।
utpalāvarttanāmā ca mādhavo yatra tiṣṭhati ।
sahasramastako viṣṇurvartate pāvane sthale ।।96।।
krośamātraṃ harikṣetraṃ narmadāyāṃ prakathyate ।
revāyā uttare kūle kapilātīrthamuttamam ।।97।।
tripurītīrthamatrā'sti śaṃkarastatsvarūpadhṛk ।
krośadvayapramāṇaṃ tad vidyate svargadaṃ śubham ।।98।।
tripuraṃ vinihatyaiva viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ haraḥ ।
tīrthaṃ tatpāvanaṃ svargamokṣadaṃ snānamātrataḥ ।।99।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ narmadāsakhīm ।
mayoktaṃ tu purā vṛttaṃ lakṣmi! te manasepsitam ।। 1.256.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne narmadāyā brahmalokādudayācalāgamastataḥ ṛkṣādryāgamastatobhūtalāvatarastato veṇutīrthā'nantapuratīrthādītihāseṣu purūravaso nṛpasya revāvatāreṇa pitruddhārādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭapaṃcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।।256।।


← adhyāyaḥ 556 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 557
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 558 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prāha pāvanam ।
ākhyānaṃ tat kathayāmi tvādikalpe kṛte yuge ।। 1 ।।
manurnāmā'bhavadrājā sūryavaṃśo mahābalī ।
sāketā tasya nagarī pradhānā''sīttadā bhuvi ।। 2 ।।
avadhyā dānavaistasmādavadhyā nāmato'bhavat ।
saptaprākārarakṣāḍhyā parikhāsaptavartulā ।। 3 ।।
daśayojanavistīrṇā sarayūmanusaṃsthitā ।
navakhaṇḍāṃ medinīṃ sa śaśāsaikapriyāvrataḥ ।। 4 ।।
ekadā sa mahārājo vasiṣṭhaṃ pratyabhāṣata ।
yajño mayā prakartavyo dūraṃ cāraṇyakasthale ।। 5 ।।
pāvanaṃ tādṛśaṃ sthānaṃ pradarśaya yathāruci ।
vasiṣṭhaścāpi tacchrutvā gṛhītvā viprasammatim ।। 6 ।।
ṛkṣe vai parvate'raṇye yato revā pravartate ।
tatra yajñaṃ kuru rājannityājñāṃ pradadau purā ।। 7 ।।
hayamedhaṃ mahāyajñaṃ gatvā tatra cakāra saḥ ।
bhūgosuvarṇaratnāni yajñe dadau sa bhūpatiḥ ।। 8 ।।
daśayojanaparyantaṃ yajñakāryārthamaṇḍapam ।
akārayacca revāyāstīre yajñaparo nṛpaḥ ।। 9 ।।
āhūya devatāḥ sarvā devendram pākaśāsanam ।
atarpayat tvarghapādyairmadhuparkaiśca viṣṭaraiḥ ।। 1.557.1 0।।
atarpayad bhūmidevān sādhūṃśca bhojanādibhiḥ ।
hārakeyūrakaṭakaiḥ kaṇṭhābharaṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 1 1।।
bhojanānāṃ praśālāsu paṃktiṣvapi samāgatāḥ ।
vayāṃsi pakṣiṇaścānye kīṭā vā vanacāriṇaḥ ।। 12।।
yajñocchiṣṭeṣu lulitā jātāḥ sarve hiraṇmayāḥ ।
evaṃ nivartito yajño narmadāyāstaṭe mahān ।। 1 3।।
avabhṛthe stutā revā rājñā toṣaṃ gatā nadī ।
svargasopānabhūtā'si pitṝṇāṃ mokṣakāriṇī ।। 14।।
pāpahā sarvalokānāṃ mātā cātigarīyasī ।
divaṃ naya mahāsādhvi! pāpatāpapraṇāśini! ।। 15।।
stotraṃ śrutvā mahābhāgā manornṛpasya sā tataḥ ।
pratyuvāca nṛpaṃ tuṣṭā makarāsanasaṃsthitā ।। 16।।
sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyā candrakāntinibhānanā ।
kanyārūpā hāsyayuktā varaṃ vṛṇu hṛdīpsitam ।। 17।।
rājā prāha sadā loke tīrtharūpā'si tāriṇī ।
tārayā'tra śubhe tīrthe yajñabhūmau sadā sati ।। 18।।
mama rājye tathā nadyo vasantu bhavatārikāḥ ।
yugāni śāśvatānīha prajākalyāṇahetave ।। 19।।
āgaccha ca mayā sākaṃ rūpāntareṇa narmade ।
sāketāyāṃ nagaryāṃ me sarayvā saha saṃvasa ।।1.557.20।।
tathā'stvityāha taṃ revā yayau rūpāntareṇa sā ।
sāketāyāṃ nagaryāṃ ca revākuṇḍe'vasattataḥ ।।2 1 ।।
yajñabhūmau mahattīrthaṃ yajñasthānaṃ tu ṛkṣake ।
snānāt tatra divaṃ yānti dehinaḥ puṇyaśālinaḥ ।।22।।
athā''ste bhagavān viṣṇurbrahmakuṇḍaṃ supāvanam ।
revā cottaravāhā'tra snātvā mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।23।।
haṃsatīrthaṃ tataścāste haṃsā yatra divaṃ gatā ।
tataścāgre siddhatīrthaṃ siddhā vasanti tāpasāḥ ।।24।।
tato gaṃgāyamunāsaṃgamo revājale śubhaḥ ।
mataṃgarṣiḥ purā gaṃgāṃ yamunāṃ ca samāhvayat ।।25।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ mahīmānānāṃ snānārthaṃ prātareva ha ।
mūrtā gaṃgā yamunā ca samāyayau jale tadā ।।26 ।।
jalarūpā'bhavat tīrthaṃ trisaṃgamātmakaṃ śubham ।
atha ramyaṃ yogatīrthaṃ tathā ṛkṣeśvaraṃ param ।।27।।
tīrthamāpsarasaṃ nāma vartate śāpavārakam ।
purā tvindrasabhāyāṃ cāpsaraso nṛtyamācaran ।।28।।
kāmaḥ svayaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā tatra samāyayau ।
nartakyastaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā mumuhurvismayānvitāḥ ।।29।।
tālagītisvaranyāsanṛtyakramān visasmaruḥ ।
tadā tvindraścukopā'ti nartakīstāḥ śaśāpa ha ।।1.557.3 0 ।।
campake sīmapa'nāme keśini cāpi bhāmini ।
kaumudi suprabhe tathotpale mahodaye'sime ।।3 1 ।।
lokapālā virājante sabhāyāmatra ceśvarāḥ ।
yathāṃgaṃ nartanaṃ prāptaṃ vikramaṃ ca pramādataḥ ।।32।।
tato niṣādayoniṃ saṃyāntu tacchikṣaṇaṃ hyalam ।
narmadāyāṃ tataḥ snātvā kuṃbhayoge punaḥ punaḥ ।।3 3।।
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ nirāhārāśca nirjalāḥ ।
gaurīṃ śaṃbhuṃ tvarcayitvā divaṃ punaravāpsyatha ।।34।।
ityuktāstā niṣādyaśca tathā bhūtvā tu nārmade ।
jale snātvā yayurmuktiṃ tīrthaṃ cāpsarasaṃ hi tat ।।35।।
atha tīrtha paraṃ dattātreyānadī ca revayā ।
saṃgatā tatra saṃsnātvā pūjayitvā ca keśavam ।।36।।
nirdhūya sarvapāpāni yātyante śrīhareḥ padam ।
tato gāṃjālabhedākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ kāryaṃ pramokṣadam ।। 37।।
somavaṃśe nṛpaścāsīd devānīka itiprathaḥ ।
tadātmajaścakravartī harikeśaḥ sa nāmataḥ ।।38।।
kanyāpure'bhavat tasya rājadhānī parātparā ।
tuṃgabhadrātaṭe tena makhāśca bahavaḥ kṛtāḥ ।।39।।
harikeśo dadau dānaṃ dogdhrīṇāmekalakṣakam ।
sūryagrahe ca niṣkāṇāṃ sahasraṃ pratibhūsuram ।।1.557.40।।
dadāvatha punarvedavidyāyāṃ vijayāya vai ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ sabhā tatra cakāra mahatīṃ punaḥ ।।41 ।।
yo vai tatra vijayeta tasmai gaurekavatsikā ।
dogdhrī suvarṇabhūṣāḍhyā hīrakasraksuśobhitā ।।42।।
dātavyeti viniścitya praśnaṃ rājā cakāra ha ।
atra rāhusūryayoge snāne prayāgajaṃ phalam ।।43।।
snānaṃ prārabdhajaṃ kiṃ vā vinā prārabdhamīyate ।
sumukhyaṃ kāraṇaṃ kinnu kiṃ bhavedvā prayojakam ।।44।।
prayāgabhūmirnā'trā'sti saṃyogo nāsti tadbhuvaḥ ।
kathaṃ tajjaṃ phalaṃ syācca hetuṃ vinā na janyatā ।।45।।
iti praśne kṛte rājñi paṇḍitāḥ ṛṣayastadā ।
kecidāhustvarthavādaṃ tadā prāśastyabodhakam ।।46।।
anye prāhurvinā bhūmiṃ prayāgasya na tatphalam ।
apare ca tadā prāhuḥ prayāgasadṛśaṃ phalam ।।47।।
snānaṃ prayāgasnānena sadṛśaṃ jagaduḥ pare ।
snānaṃ prārabdhajaṃ cānye pare prārabdhamantarā ।।48।।
prayatnena bhavatyeva snānaṃ puṇyaṃ vināpi ca ।
mukhyaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ tatra mumukṣā vā bubhukṣatā ।।49।।
icchā'sti kāraṇaṃ mukhyaṃ yā kācidvā bhaveddhi sā ।
sārthavāhastadecchāyā uttejako bhavatyapi ।।1.557.50।।
prayojikā tu jijñāsā śāstrajanyā punaḥ punaḥ ।
śāstrayoge kāraṇaṃ tu kṛpā guroḥ sadā matā ।।51 ।।
evaṃvidhā bhaveyuśca hetavo bhinnarūpiṇaḥ ।
evaṃ vādaḥ pravṛttaśca naikenāpi nirūpitam ।।52।।
mukhyaṃ tu kāraṇaṃ tatra puṇyadaṃ yad hṛdi sthitam ।
parabrahma svayaṃ dātṛ phalasyaiveti vismṛtam ।।53।।
tena kaiścinna vijitā dhenuḥ svarṇamayī tadā ।
vivāde vijayārthaṃ ca pravṛtte'pi na nirṇayaḥ ।।।54।।।
brāhmaṇānāṃ vivāde ca tatrā''sīdekabhūsuraḥ ।
nāmnā raudrāyaṇo'tharvamantravid vādakārakaḥ ।।55।।
vivāde jāyamāne'pi vijayaṃ naiva labdhavān ।
ruṣṭaḥ sa cā'nale rājñā kārayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।।56।।
homaṃ raudrairmahāmantraiḥ sutejasairajānatā ।
rājñā kṛtena homena yugāntāgnisamaprabhaḥ ।।57।।
tatkuṇḍādutthito vahnirjvālāmālābhayaṃkaraḥ ।
dagdho hi maṇḍapastena maṇḍapasthāśca pūruṣāḥ ।।58।।
bhasmībhūtaṃ tathā cānyat sāmagryupasuvastukam ।
rājā prāhā'tra hatyānāṃ dagdhānāṃ niṣkṛtistu me ।।59।।
yathā bhavettathā viprā! dīyatāṃ tvācarāmi tām ।
brāhmaṇāśca tadā prāhuḥ kalpagrāmaṃ prayāhi vai ।।1.557.60।।
bhṛgvādyāḥ ṛṣayastatra praṣṭavyā niṣkṛtau tvayā ।
evamukto yayau rājā pādacārī sukalpakam ।।61 ।।
maharṣīn sa praṇamyaiva sambhāṣāṃ pracakāra ha ।
tato nivedayāmāsa kratau hatyāghamulbaṇam ।।62।।
śrutvā tam ṛṣayaḥ prāhurgāyatrīdaśalakṣakam ।
tīrthe tīrthe japa rājan yāhyaṣṭaṣaṣṭitīrthakam ।।63।।
gohiraṇyapradānaṃ ca kuru homāyutaṃ tathā ।
dehi sadbhyaśca viprebhyaḥ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam ।।64।।
evaṃ pāpasya muktiḥ syāt kuru tīrthāni bhāvataḥ ।
ye mṛtā vahnidagdhāśca teṣāmasthipravāhaṇam ।।65।।
narmadāyāṃ kuru rājaँstena muktirbhaviṣyati ।
narmadodakasamparkād divi devatvamāpyate ।।66।।
tilodakapradānena teṣāṃ muktirbhaved dhruvam ।
narmadāyāstaṭe ramye śubhaṃ yajñaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।।67।।
samācara punaryatra mokṣaṇaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ।
ityuktaḥ sa tu rājarṣiḥ punaḥ śrīnarmadāṃ prati ।।68।।
yayau yajñaṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca cakre tatra taṭe śubhe ।
pravāho nirgatastatra narmadāyāṃ samāviśat ।।69।।
sa gāñjāletivikhyāto narmadāsaṃgamo'bhavat ।
harikeśena pitaro mṛtā dagdhāśca ye kṛtau ।।1.557.70।।
sarve te tāritāstatra tṛptāḥ procurnṛpaṃ tataḥ ।
tvatprasādānmahābhāga! vayaṃ devatvamāgatāḥ ।।71।।
divyayānasamārūḍhā yāsyāmo vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ।
harikeśo nṛpaḥ śrutvā parayā ca mudā yutaḥ ।।72।।
saptakalpasthirāṃ revāṃ natvā cakre stutiṃ tataḥ ।
namastestu saricchreṣṭhe! saptakalpanivāsini ।।73।।
snātvā tvayi janaḥ kvāpi sarvatra muktimṛcchati ।
tvatprasādānmahādevi! muktirjātā bhavārṇavāt ।।74।।
pitṝṇāṃ vahnidagdhānāṃ jaya devi dayāvati! ।
narmadā tadvacaḥ śrutvā mūrtā kanyā babhūva sā ।।75।।
varaṃ vṛṇu nṛpaṃ prāha rājā vavre varaṃ tadā ।
yadi me varadā sādhvi! pūtaṃ māṃ kuru pāvani! ।।76।।
snānā'vagāhanātpānātsmaraṇātkīrtanādapi ।
saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ sadya eva vinaśyatu ।।77।।
revovāca tathā'stveva tataścāntaradhīyata ।
harikeśaścakravartī natvā punaśca tāṃ diśam ।।78।।
kāmikaṃ yānamāruhya yayau sāketapattanam ।
tattīrthaṃ nārmadaṃ hatyānāśakṛnmokṣadaṃ śubham ।।79।।
harikeśaṃ ca gāñjālaṃ hatyāpāpavināśanam ।
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham ।।1.557.80।।
atha yāmyāṃ diśi nāmnā tīrthaṃ vālukaśāṃkaram ।
yatra kanyānarmadāsaṃgamo jāto hi mokṣadaḥ ।।81 ।।
tataścā'gre samākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ pūrṇamanoratham ।
harivarmā purā cāsīd virāṭanagarādhipaḥ ।।82।।
kṛtastena kratustatra golakṣaṃ tatra saṃdadau ।
devāḥ sutarpitāstatra viprāḥ santaśca pūjitāḥ ।।83।।
athā'nyadapi sattīrthaṃ revāmatsyāsamāgamaḥ ।
yatrā''po nirmalāḥ pānāt snānānmuktipradāḥ sadā ।।84।।
revāyā uttare kūle kapilāsaṃgamātparam ।
narmadāpuramatrā''ste yatra viprāstu tāpasāḥ ।।85।।
koṭiśo vai virājante jamadagnyāśramāntike ।
jamadagnirmahograṃ ca tapaścacāra śāṃkaram ।।86 ।।
sākṣādabhūcchivastasya varaṃ vṛṇu jagāda tam ।
ṛṣirvavre kāmadhenuṃ golokāt sā samāyayau ।।87।।
dharmakarmaśubhārthe ca śivapūjāsutarpaṇe ।
pitṛkārye devakārye gāvaḥ puṇyatamāḥ sadā ।।88।।
kāmadhenoḥ sakāśācca jamadagniravāpa ha ।
sarvān kāmān dharmarūpānsampatpradān divaḥpradān ।।89।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi nityaṃ bhojayate dvijaḥ ।
jamadagnermahākīrtiḥ pṛthvyāṃ vyāptā gavā tadā ।।1.557.90।।
vipracittyākhyadaityasya kanyā māhiṣmatī tu yā ।
tasyā nāmnā sa nagarīṃ māhiṣmatīṃ vinirmame ।।91 ।।
yatsannidhau mahāraṇye jamadagnirnyuvāsa ha ।
yayau sakhībhirvyomnā sā vīkṣituṃ mandarācalam ।।92।।
tapantaṃ cā'svarasaṃjñaṃ tatra dadarśa tāpasam ।
dṛṣṭvā''śramapadaṃ ramyaṃ cintayāmāsa bhāminī ।।93।।
bhīṣayitvā'hamenaṃ tu tiṣṭhāmyatrāśrame svayam ।
kāmarūpadharā sā'pi bhūtvā'raṇyanivāsinām ।।94।।
ṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau yātā mahiṣīrūpadhāriṇī ।
ṛṣibhiḥ khalu śaptā sā mahiṣyastu śataṃ samāḥ ।।95।।
mahiṣaṃ putramāsādya tataḥ svasthā bhaviṣyasi ।
evaṃ śaptā yayau sā tu narmadātīrthamuttamam ।।96।।
yatra tepe tapo ghoraṃ sindhudvīpo mahātapāḥ ।
sindhudvīpasya vai vīryaṃ pracaskanda śilātale ।।97।।
jalā'nvitaṃ sugandhaṃ tat papau sā mahiṣī tadā ।
tataḥ sā suṣuve vipravīryajanyaṃ sutaṃ dṛḍham ।।98।।
mahiṣākhyā'suraṃ krūraṃ yaṃ jaghāna hi śāṃkarī ।
nārāyaṇī mahāśaktistato māhiṣmatī nijām ।।99।।
māhiṣmatīṃ purīṃ gatvā jamadagnyāśramāntike ।
kālena sā mṛtā prāptā svargamṛṣeḥ pratāpataḥ ।। 1.557.100 ।।
tīrthaṃ tajjāmadagnyaṃ vai māhiṣmataṃ suśobhanam ।
viśokairaṇḍikā caiva tṛtīyā pāvanī matā ।। 101 ।।
caturthī narmadā tāsāṃ saṃgame kapilā śilā ।
tīrthaṃ puṇyatamaṃ tvāste yatra piṇḍapradānataḥ ।। 102 ।।
pitaro mokṣaṇaṃ yānti parśurāmeṇa tāritāḥ ।
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi! purā satyai śivoditam ।। 103 ।।
śravaṇātkīrtanāccā'sya divi devatvamāpyate ।
bhuktirmuktirlabhyate'pi jāmadagnyāśrame śubhe ।। 1 04।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ṛkṣaparvate manukṛtayajñatīrthaṃ viṣṇubrahmakuṇḍahaṃsatīrthaṃ trisaṃgama yogatīrthaṃ āpsarasatīrthaṃ dattātreyāsaṃgamaḥ gāṃjālabhedatīrthaṃ vālukaṃ pūrṇamanorathatīrthaṃ kanyānarmadāsaṃgamaḥ matsyāsaṃgamonarmadāpuraṃ jāmadagnyatīrthamityādīni sabījāni nirūpitānītināmā saptapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 557 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 558
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 559 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! mahādevena bhāṣitam ।
pārvatyai nārmadaṃ cānyat tīrthaṃ tat kathayāmi te ।। 1 ।।
ṃatsyāyāśca tathā tāpyāḥ saṃgamo mokṣadāyakaḥ ।
kalahaṃsābhidhaḥ pūrvaṃ devarṣirdhyānatatparaḥ ।। 2 ।।
tatra kṛtvā''śramaṃ ramyaṃ tapastepe sudāruṇam ।
śākamūlaphalāhāro hyatiṣṭhattvekapādataḥ ।। 3 ।।
śivadhyānaparasyā'sya tapasā devarāṭ svayam ।
bhīto brāhmaṇarūpeṇa vañcayituṃ samāyayau ।। 4 ।।
uvāca kalahaṃsa! tvaṃ kimarthaṃ kuruṣe tapaḥ ।
ṛṣiḥ prāha kathaṃ cendra! māṃ viḍambayase dvijam ।। 5 ।।
jānāmi tvāṃ turāṣāḍhaṃ nendrarājyaṃ prakāmaye ।
ārādhayāmyahaṃ śaṃbhuṃ kuru rājyaṃ yathepsitam ।। 6 ।।
indraḥ prāha varaṃ vipra! vṛṇu drakṣyasi śaṃkaram ।
kalahaṃsastadovāca nānyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇomyaham ।। 7 ।।
śaṃbhau bhaktiḥ sadā me syāditi śakto'si dehi cet ।
tathā'stviti sureśaśca yayāvuktvā triviṣṭapam ।। 8 ।।
śaṃkarastu drutaṃ tatra sākṣāt hasan samāyayau ।
kalahaṃso namaścakre stotuṃ samupacakrame ।। 9 ।।
namo bhaktakṛpāyukta mahādeva namo'stu te ।
namaḥ śivāya bhaktānāmiṣṭapradāya te namaḥ ।। 1.558.10 ।।
bhavasāgaramagnānāmuddhārakāya te namaḥ ।
parabrahmasvarūpāya vaiṣṇavāgryāya te namaḥ ।। 11 ।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇātmakāya te namaḥ ।
pārvatīpataye prabhāsvāmidevāya te namaḥ ।। 12।
nārāyaṇīśarūpāya jayādhyakṣāya te namaḥ ।
sarvabījasvarūpāya kāraṇāya namo namaḥ ।। 1 3।।
śaṃbhuḥ stotraṃ śubhaṃ śrūtvā varaṃ vṛṇu jagāda tam ।
kalahaṃseśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ vavre ca ṛṣisattamaḥ ।। 14।।
tatra prāṇairviyuktānāṃ mokṣaṃ vavre śubhaṃ varam ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathaivā'stu cānte muktistavā'stu ca ।। 15।।
antardhānaṃ yayāvuktvā kalahaṃso'pi sarvathā ।
bhajitvā nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ cānte brahmapadaṃ yayau ।। 16।।
matsyātāpīsaṃgame tatkalahaṃsaṃ sutīrthakam ।
pāpaghnaṃ svargadaṃ mokṣapradaṃ vartata aiśvaram ।। 17।।
anyat tīrtha bṛhatyāśca narmadāyāśca saṃgamaḥ ।
vindhyaparvataśobhāḍhyaṃ vidyate tāpasāśritam ।।18।।
raktadharmābhidhaḥ kaścinniṣādastatra cāyayau ।
bharaṇāyātmavargasya vanyakandaphalādibhiḥ ।। 19।।
prātaḥ sa revāsalilaṃ śivāya vai samāharat ।
ajñānabhaktigarbhastu snāpayitvā phalaṃ dadau ।।1.558.20।।
athottarāyaṇe prāpte pupūja kusumaiḥ sadā ।
bilvādi cārpayāmāsa śaṃkarāya sa bhāvataḥ ।। 21 ।।
niṣādaḥ sa dadarśaikasmin dine śaṃkaraṃ gṛhe ।
tṛtīyamīkṣaṇaṃ tatra mūrternaiva sa paśyati ।।22।।
tadā tu cintayāmāsa kenā'pyapahṛtaṃ hi tat ।
vicārya vāmanetraṃ svaṃ tīkṣṇabāṇena tatkṣaṇam ।।23।।
lalāṭe devadevasya samutkṛtya nyavedayat ।
na kampo na ca kārpaṇyaṃ na viṣādo na devanam ।।24।।
tena tuṣṭo mahādevo niṣādaṃ prāha saṃhasan ।
varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhakta yadiṣṭaṃ manasepsitam ।।25।।
niṣādo vacanaṃ śrutvā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca ।
varaṃ vavre niṣādāstu sarve pakṣigaṇaiḥ saha ।।26।।
saputradārapaśavo ye cānye pāpadehinaḥ ।
tvatprasādādvaradānānmuktilokaṃ prayāntu te ।।27।।
evaṃ varaṃ vṛṇe yogyaṃ bhūtānāṃ mokṣakāmyayā ।
śaṃbhuḥ śrutvā prasannaḥ sannuvācā'stu tathā varaḥ ।।28।।
sarvasaṃkalpakāmāptiṃ matprasādāt tvamāpsyasi ।
sarve muktiṃ prayāsyanti yathā saṃkalpitaṃ tvayā ।।29।।
ityuktvā sa mahādevastatraivā'ntaradhīyata ।
tataḥ kāle vimānastho niṣādo'nucarādibhiḥ ।।1.558.30।।
dhṛtasvarṇātapatrastu vījyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ ।
divyābharaṇavastrāḍhyo divyacandanapūjitaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
paśupakṣigaṇaiḥ sākaṃ yayau muktipadaṃ yataḥ ।
tadidaṃ kathitaṃ haimi! śivanetrahradātmakam ।।32।।
tīrthaṃ vai pāvanaṃ sarvasmṛddhidaṃ muktidaṃ tathā ।
athā'nyatparamaṃ tīrthaṃ nārmade cottare taṭe ।।33।।
vidyate kratavo yatra tīrthayātrāgatena ca ।
janakena kṛtāstatra dakṣiṇātoṣitā dvijāḥ ।।34।।
dharmarājastathā cā'nye diśāṃ pālāḥ samāyayuḥ ।
dharmarājo janakaṃ saṃprāhārghādi dadan nṛpam ।।35।।
tapasā dhyānayogena dānadevārcanairapi ।
śivarevāprasādena jitā lokāstvayā'khilāḥ ।।36।।
janako dharmarājaṃ ca papraccha vinayena vai ।
ke deśāḥ parvatāḥ puṇyāḥ kā nadyaścāśramāśca ke ।।37।।
kāni tīrthāni loke'smin yatra dattaṃ hutaṃ tapaḥ ।
na kṣīyate manuṣyāṇāṃ tanme kathaya tattvataḥ ।।38।।
dharmaḥ prāha śṛṇu rājan śaṃkarasya mukhācchrutam ।
kalmāṣapādo rājā''sīnmāthure maṇḍale purā ।।39।।
nābhāgākhyaśca rājā''sīt sāketamaṇḍale purā ।
nābhāgasya vimānaṃ tu vyomni copari gacchati ।।1.558.40।।
kalmāṣapādayānaṃ tu bhūtale yāti nā'mbare ।
iti hetoḥ śivaṃ natvā kalmāṣapādabhūpatiḥ ।।41 ।।
papraccha śṛṇvatāṃ sarvagaṇānāṃ saṃśayaṃ svakam ।
puṣkare daśayajñāśca vidhattāśca mayā hara! ।।42।।
gaṃgāyāṃ naimiṣāraṇye prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇe ।
prayāgarāje kāśyāṃ ca pratyeke śatakaṃ tathā ।।43।।
iṣṭaṃ sāgraṃ kratūnāṃ tu mayā tatra maheśvara ।
adho yāti vimānaṃ me nābhāgasyā'mbaropari ।।44।।
kathamevaṃ nyūnatā me puṇye'haṃ yena nimnagaḥ ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā taṃ vai kalmāṣapādabhūpatim ।।45।।
lakṣamedhaṃ nāmatīrthaṃ revāyā uttare taṭe ।
śaṃkaro lakṣamedheśo rājate tatra nityaśaḥ ।।46।।
cakāra tatra nābhāgo yajñamekaṃ suvaiṣṇavam ।
tena puṇyena yānaṃ vai nābhāgasyā'mbare sthitam ।। 47।।
tvayā revātaṭe naiva yajñaḥ kṛto mahāphalaḥ ।
tena nimnapradeśe te vimānaṃ yāti nā'mbare ।।48।।
narmadāyāḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tato naiva hi vidyate ।
iti śrutvā ca kalmāṣacaraṇo nṛpatistataḥ ।।49।।
prayayau narmadātīraṃ daśayajñān cakāra ha ।
vaiṣṇavaṃ cātha raudraṃ ca vājimedhaṃ ca vai kratum ।।1.558.50।।
kārīriṃ vājapeyaṃ ca viśvajitaṃ mahākratum ।
puṇḍarīkaṃ naramedhaṃ gomedhaṃ vaiśvadaivatam ।।51 ।।
evaṃ yajñāँścakārā'yaṃ jñānayajñaṃ tathā punaḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyajñaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।।52।।
tato yānaṃ svayaṃ vyomni samutthāya samūrdhvagam ।
yathākāmaṃ satyalokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca yayau tataḥ ।।53।।
nābhāgasya vimānādvai hyuparyupari yāti tat ।
evaṃ kalmāṣapādo vai kṛtvā brahmasamarpaṇam ।।54।।
jīvaddehena vaikuṇṭhaṃ gantuṃ yogyo'bhavattataḥ ।
yasya kratau svayaṃ viṣṇurlakṣmyā sākamupasthitaḥ ।।55।।
viṣṇunā cārpitā mālā divyā kaṇṭhe'sya bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
tena yogena vaikuṇṭhaṃ yātyāyāti kvacit kvacit ।।56।।
evaṃ rājā samartho'bhūt śrīviṣṇoḥ samprasādataḥ ।
tattīrthaṃ jānakaṃ cānyat kālmāṣapādikaṃ tathā ।।57।।
vidyate narmadākūle pāvanaṃ mokṣadaṃ param ।
athā'nyad vidyate ramyaṃ saptasārasvataṃ śubham ।।58।।
saptasārasvato nāma gandharvaḥ śivakiṃkaraḥ ।
kailāse gāyanaṃ kṛtvā prayayau raivatācalam ।।59।।
vinā''jñāṃ śaṃkarasyā'tha tvāyayau sucireṇa saḥ ।
nandī śaśāpa taṃ kopād vraja cāṇḍālatāṃ kṣitau ।।1.558.60।।
narmadāyāṃ vyatipāte snātvā yāsyasi mokṣatām ।
ityevaṃ sa tu gāndharvaścāṇḍālayonitāṃ gataḥ ।।61।।
jātismaro'bhavat pṛthvyāṃ babhrāma nārmade taṭe ।
snātvā revājale śaṃbhuṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ।।62।।
cāṇḍālayonisammukto gāndharvatāṃ yayau punaḥ ।
saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ mokṣadaṃ tatprakīrtitam ।।63।।
narmadādakṣiṇe tīre tvaśokavanikāsu ca ।
aśokajananākhyaṃ sattīrthaṃ tvaparamuttamam ।।64।।
aghamarṣaṛṣestatrāśramo brāhmaṇaśobhitaḥ ।
ṛṣayo yatra brahmiṣṭhā vicinvanti pramokṣaṇam ।।65।।
aghamarṣāśramaṃ dharmo vaiśyarūpeṇa cā''gamat ।
jijñāsārthaṃ kīdṛśā vai ṛṣayo'tra vasanti nu ।।66।।
sa vaiśyo'tra tapaścakre brāhmaṇātiśayaṃ tataḥ ।
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sa pradadau mṛgacarmāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।।67।।
kaupīnāni tathā bhikṣāṃ tato nāśikamāyayau ।
varṣamekaṃ vyatītaṃ ca vaiśyasya tāpasaiḥ saha ।।68।।
na bhogo na ca kārpaṇyaṃ na māno na ca matsaraḥ ।
na doṣā dveṣarāgādyā jitaṃ sarvaṃ viśā tataḥ ।।69।।
saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ nārmadaṃ tvāgamaddhi saḥ ।
snātvā pupūja viṣṇuṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।।1.558.70।।
tathā śaṃbhuṃ bāṇarūpaṃ pūjayāmāsa sādaram ।
hariḥ pratyakṣatāṃ prāpya prāha tvaṃ vṛṣa eva yaḥ ।।71 ।।
tathāpi siddhatāṃ prāptastapasā ca viśeṣataḥ ।
idaṃ vimānamāruhya divyabhogasukhaṃ kuru ।।72।।
putradārasnuṣopeto viṣṇulokamito vraja ।
dharmaḥ prāha tadā viṣṇo! ṛṣayo narmadātaṭe ।।73।।
atra daśasahasrāṇi vidyante ye tapodhanāḥ ।
te sarve mama tapasā viṣṇulokaṃ prayāntu vai ।।74।।
imaṃ varamahaṃ manye śrīharereva nānyataḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ ṛṣayaḥ sarve sā'bhimānā'hamānvitāḥ ।।75।।
tiraścakrurhi taṃ vaiśyaṃ procuścāpi parasparam ।
mahatāṃ bhūsurāṇāṃ vai vaiśyaḥ karoti lāghavam ।।76।।
vaiśyasya tapasā viprā yātā vaikuṇṭhamityapi ।
loke darśayituṃ so'yaṃ varaṃ vṛṇoti śāṭhyataḥ ।।77।।
vaiśyasya śreṣṭhatāṃ loke jñāpayan sa vṛṇoti hi ।
na vayaṃ tapasā tasya gacchāmo vai divaṃ prati ।।78।।
brāhmaṇasyā'vamānena vaiśyo'yaṃ va tariṣyati ।
ityuktvā ṛṣayastaṃ ca vaiśyaṃ prāha prayāhi bhoḥ ।।79।।
vaiśyadharmaṃ gṛhāṇāpi kṛṣiṃ kuru gṛhe sthitaḥ ।
na yogyastvaṃ tapaḥ kartuṃ jātyabhimānavānasi ।।1.558.80।।
gaccha gaccha gṛhaṃ mā cā''yāhi tvaṃ vai dvijāntikam ।
ityuktaḥ sa dvijān dṛṣṭvā sābhimānakrudhānvitān ।।81 ।।
vimuktanāmakaṃ vipraṃ prajagāda sa karṣukaḥ ।
brāhmaṇānāṃ paro dharmaḥ krodhābhāvaḥ praśāntatā ।।82।।
ahaṃmamatārāhityaṃ tadvān yaḥ sa ca bhūsuraḥ ।
krodhāhaṃmamatāyukto brāhmaṇo naiva vidyate ।।83।।
tādṛśasya tapaḥ sarvaṃ śrāddhaṃ vā'pi ca niṣphalam ।
daivatairapi durjñeyo gahano jātinirṇayaḥ ।।84।।
brahmakarmasamācāraṃ vaiśyaṃ brāhmaṇamucyate ।
vrahmakarmavihīnaṃ ca vipraṃ vaiśyaṃ samucyate ।।85।।
niṣṭhuraṃ nirghṛṇaṃ krūraṃ kṛtaghnaṃ dīrghakopinam ।
dvijaṃ vivādaśūraṃ ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet ।।86।।
ityuktvā vaiśyavaryaḥ sa virarāma kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।
viprāḥ papracchurenaṃ tvaṃ ko'si vaiśyasvarūpadhṛk ।।87।।
vaiśyaḥ prāha ca dharmo'smi parīkṣārthaṃ samāgataḥ ।
kīdṛśā brāhmaṇā yūyaṃ narmadātaṭavāsinaḥ ।।88।।
ahaṃmamate visṛjya tapaḥ kuruta cottamam ।
roṣaṃ tu sarvathā tyaktvā bhajadhvaṃ parameśvaram ।।।89।।
evaṃ vrahmavratenā'tra yūyaṃ muktiṃ gamiṣyatha ।
atha te śamayāmāsurdharmād doṣānnijāँstataḥ ।।1.558.90।।
dharmaṃ prapūjayāmāsurnirdoṣāḥ ṛṣayo'bhavan ।
atha divyavimānāni tvāgatāni vṛṣāntike ।।91 ।।
vṛṣājñayā hi te sarve samāruhyā'ghamarṣaṇaḥ ।
api dharmeṇa sārdhaṃ ca viṣṇunā ramayā saha ।।92।।
saptasārasvataṃ natvā yayurvaikuṇṭhameva ca ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi bhuktimuktipradaṃ hi tat ।।93।।
ityuktvā śaṃkaro devyai virarāma ca padmaje! ।
mayā tubhyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ saptasārasvatātmakam ।।94।।
kathitaṃ muktidaṃ mokṣapradaṃ snāturviśeṣataḥ ।
anekayajñaphaladaṃ putradāradhanapradam ।।95।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne matsyātāpī saṃgama-kalahaṃseśa bṛhatīnarmadāsaṃgamaśivanetrahṛda-lakṣamedhaḥsaptasārasvatāditīrthāni setihāsacamatkārabhūtāni nirūpitānītināmā'ṣṭapañcāśadadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 558 ।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ prāha cottamam ।
śāṇḍilyākalpagāyogaṃ tīrthaṃ cānyad vadāmi te ॥ 1 ॥
yatra janma sahṛsrā'rjunākhyasya bhūpaterabhūt ।
tatra śāḍilyakauṇḍinyamāṇḍavyā nyavasan mudā ॥ 2 ॥
śāṇḍilyasyā''śramastvāste śāṇḍilyārevikāyuji ।
śāṇḍilyapuramityevaṃ prasiddhaṃ tatpurā'bhavat ॥ 3 ll
niśāyāṃ mūṣakaḥ kaścidaṭamāna itastataḥ ।
prabhakṣito biḍālena tāvad vṛkaḥ samāgataḥ ॥ 4 ॥
kiñciccheṣaṃ mūṣakaṃ taṃ tyaktvā dudrāva cākhubhuk ।
tadā meghe prasañjāte pravāhastatra nirgataḥ ॥ 5 ॥
asthipravahaṇaṃ svākho: prasaṃjātaṃ jale tataḥ ।
tīrthasyā'sya prabhāveṇa yakṣo'bhavat sa unduruḥ ॥ 6 ॥
bṛhadvṛndasamākhyāto yakṣāyutasamāvṛtaḥ ।
haṃsayuktavimānena yakṣeśvaro divaṃ yayau ॥ 7 ॥
yakṣaloke'dhipo jātastīrthasyaiva prabhāvata: ।
tato gacchenmahātīrthe kubjārevāsamāgamam ll 8 ॥
rantidevena vai yatra yajña: kṛto'tiśobhanaḥ ।
avadhyāyā nṛpaścāsīd rantidevā'bhidhaḥ purā ॥ 9 ॥
vasiṣṭhasyā'numatyā sa revātīre kratuṃ śubham ।
kartuṃ cājñāpayāmāsa bhṛtyāmātyapurodhasaḥ ॥1.559.10ll
yajñopaskārasaṃbhāraḥ śīghrameva vidhīyatām ।
dhenūśca daśalakṣāṇi savatsāḥ supayasvinīḥ ॥11॥
hemabhārairbhūṣitāśca kāmadughāḥ sumaṃgalā: ।
ānayantu lakṣamaśvānāmayutaṃ sudantinām ll12ll
maṇimāṇikyaratnānāṃ yatrā''nantyaṃ yathā bhavet ।
anekāni sahasrāṇi vimānānāṃ syurambare ॥13॥
pṛthvīyānānyanekāni cānayantvatra tīrthake ।
ājñāpyaivaṃ svayaṃ yāne vyomage sanniṣadya vai ॥14॥
narmadāyāstaṭe gatvā sāntaḥpuraparicchadḥ ।
viśaśrāma suvarṇasya yūpān kuṇḍāँśca maṇḍapān ॥15॥
kārayāmāsa bhakṣyāँśca bhojyān pakvānnaparvatān !
kṛtavān ratnabhūṣābhirbrāhmaṇān samalaṃkṛtān ॥16॥
yajñadīkṣāṃ prajagrāha patnyā saha narādhipaḥ ।
yajñe pravartite havyavāhana: sarvagocaraḥ ॥17॥
pratyakṣo jagṛhe havyaṃ mūrtimān svāhayā saha ।
brahmaśakrādayo devā lokapālā marudgaṇāḥ ॥18॥
viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca vasavaścandrabhāskarau !
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāḥ sarvatīrthāni cāpagāḥ ॥19॥
mātaraḥ siddhagandharvāḥ sayakṣoragarākṣasāḥ ।
umayā sahito rudro viṣṇurnārāyaṇīyutaḥ ॥1.559.20॥
āyayuryajñabhāgāँśca teṣāṃ pṛthagakalpayat ।
vedadhvaniṃ pravṛttaṃ ca śrutvā dānavapuṃgavāḥ ॥21॥
mahābāhusubāhvādyā: krauṃcapuranivāsinaḥ ।
āyayurnarmadātīre sabhṛtyabalavāhanāḥ ॥22॥
pracakrire kratau vighnaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi sthitāḥ ।
uvāca rantidevaṃ tu brahmā bhayāt pravihvalaḥ ॥23॥
vighnaṃ vāraya rājendra ! yajñaḥ kramād yathā bhavet ।
brahmiṣṭho rantidevastacchrutvovāca hariṃ smaran ॥24॥
yadi me vidyate satyaṃ brahmabhaktau parā matiḥ ।
daityarākṣasaduṣṭādyā layaṃ yāntu vinā mṛdham ॥25॥
evamuktvā sa rājarṣi: sasmāra viṣṇumīśvaram ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhārī sākṣādupāgataḥ ॥26॥
viṣṇoścakraṃ kuśāgre'tra tiṣṭhatu rākṣasārdanam ।
evamuktvā nārmade sujale tvāplāvya taṃ kuśam ॥27॥
preṣayāmāsa rakṣārthaṃ dakṣiṇasyāँ diśi dhruvam ।
uttare'pi tathā cānyat preṣayāmāsa darbhakam ॥28॥
devamantreṇa ghoreṇa rakṣāṃ vidhāya sarvataḥ ।
pūrvasyāṃ paścimāyāṃ ca preṣayāmāsa vai kuśau ॥29॥
mūrtimantastu te jātāścakrurdurgān samantataḥ ।
agninā jvalamānāśca rākṣasānāṃ pradāhakā: ||1.559.30||
durgāste vyomacārā vai yatra yatra ca rākṣasāḥ ।
tatra tatrā'bhigatvaiva dadhustān sahṛsraśaḥ ॥31॥
athā'gnau ca juhāvā'yaṃ rājā bilvā''mravetasam ।
tasmāt samutthitaṃ liṃgaṃ jvalatkālānalaprabham ॥32॥
nemuryajñīyabhūmisthāḥ sarve kuṇḍasthamīśvaram ।
rantidevasya vai sarve camatkāraṃ vilokya ca ॥33॥
dhanyavādān dadustatra devādyā api bhāvata: ।
dānavā dudruvuḥ sarve bhayād darbhānalotthitāt ॥34॥
krauṃcadvīpaṃ yayuryajñaḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ gatastathā ।
liṃgaṃ bilvāmrakaṃ natvā pūjayitvā surādayaḥ ॥35॥
yayuḥ svargaṃ praśaṃsanto nṛpaṃ tīrthe camatkṛtim ।
sāketaṃ va yayau yānaṃ samāruhya ca bhūpatiḥ ॥36॥
tatra tīrthe kṛtasnānā yānti brahma sanātanam !
darśanādapi pāpānāṃ prajvālakaṃ pramokṣadam ॥37॥
kubjāyāṃ cā'paraṃ tīrthaṃ hārikeśākhyamastyapi ।
harikeśa iti khyātaḥ śālagrāme dvijo'bhavat ॥38॥
śiloñcchavṛttirdhamātmā tasya patnī pativratā ।
suvratākhyā'bhavad yasyāṃ śataṃ putrāḥ prajajñire ॥39॥
kapilāpuramāśritya harikeśo divāniśam ।
śilānāmarjanenaiva prasthamannaṃ samṛcchati |l1.559.40ll
bālā api ca te putrā yathākathaṃcideva tu ।
vartayanti prabhikṣādyaiḥ pūrṇamannaṃ na yanti hi ॥41॥
sthitiṃ tu tādṛśīṃ dṛṣṭvā mātā śuśoca vihvalā ।
patiṃ prāha suduḥkhārtā garhamāṇāṃ nijāṃ daśām ll42॥
vṛddhau ca mātāpitarau sādhvī bhāryā sutaḥ śiśuḥ ।
bharaṇīyā: prayatnena dharma eṣaḥ sanātanaḥ ॥43॥
tasmāt pratigrahaṃ kṛtvā bhartavyaṃ svakuṭumbakam ।
putreṇa lokaṃ jayati putreṇa sukhamedhate ॥44॥
putreṇa sukhamāpnoti pitṝṇāṃ ca suto gatiḥ ।
ambarīṣo mahṛ+ārājaścāyodhyādhipati: kila ||45||
prakaroti kratuṃ yāhi kurukṣetre dvijottama ।
gatāśca brāhmaṇāstatra pratigrahajighṛkṣayā !!46||
gā: kāñcanaṃ dhanaṃ labdhaṃ śālagrāmanivāsibhiḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ bhāminīvākyaṃ gṛhītvā ca kuṭumbakam ||47||
kurukṣetre yayau yajñe praviṣṭaścā'dhvare dvijaḥ ।
ambarīṣo vilokyainaṃ cārghapādyairapūjayat ॥48॥
uvācā''tithyarūpeṇa yācayasva yathepsitam ।
vipraḥ prāha dhanaṃ varṣaśataṃ yāvadbhavenmama ॥49॥
paryāptaṃ sakuṭumbasya tāvad dehi nṛpottama ।
dhenūrdehi pratiputra hemabhārapariṣkṛtāḥ ॥1.559.50॥
ābharaṇāni vastrāṇi kṣetrodyānagṛhāṇi ca ।
dāridyaṃ me yathā na syāttathā bhikṣāṃ pradehi me ॥51॥
ambarīṣaḥ prasanno'ti dadau sarvaṃ yathepsitam ।
śālagrāme śubhe kṣetre vipro rājeva modate ॥52॥
kālāntare tataḥ prāpte vipro mṛtyuvaśaṃ yayau ।
marudeśe nirudake brahmarakṣastvamāgataḥ ll'93ll
rājapratigrahāccāpi tathā brāhmaṇyalopata: !
viṣayavāsanāvattvād dhanādivāsanādinā ||54||
iha vṛkṣā: prarohanti dāvadagdhā ghanāgame ।
rājapratigrahadagdhāḥ prarohanti na karhicit ॥55॥
narake raurave ghore tasya vai patanaṃ bhavet ।
vipro'yaṃ rākṣasaḥ preto bhūtvā sutān priyāṃ tathā ॥56॥
āgatyā''gatya ca grahe rudan prāha punaḥ punaḥ ।
mamoddhāraṃ prakurvantu rākṣaso'haṃ pratigrahāt ।।'97||
jāto'smi me mahānārāyaṇabaliṃ dadatvapi !
tatastasya sutairnārāyaṇabaliḥ prasaṃkṛtaḥ ॥58ll
vyomavāṇyā sutebhyaśca kathitaṃ yāntu narmadām ।
kubjāyā: saṃgame tatra bilvāmrake sutīrthake ॥59॥ ।
tatra snātvā bhavatyeva brahmarakṣovimokṣaṇam ।
labhate brahmalokaṃ ca pāpatāpapraṇāśanāt ॥1.559.60॥
śrutvā sādhvī sutairyuktā yayau bilvāmrakasthalam ।
rākṣaso'pi kuṭumbena sahā'dṛśyo yayau tadā ॥61॥
samprāptaḥ sumudāyuktaḥ kubjārevāsamāgamam।
snātvā śaṃbhuṃ prapūjyaiva nārāyaṇaṃ samarcya ca ॥62॥
dhyāne tasthustadā vyomnā vimānaṃ tvāyayau śubham ।
viṣṇupārṣadayuktaṃ ca samāruhya mahojjvalam ॥63॥
tatkṣaṇād divyadehāste brahmalokaṃ tadā yayuḥ ।
evaṃ kubjāsaṃgamasya revāyāṃ pāpanāśanam ॥64॥
mokṣaṇaṃ harikeśasya jātaṃ kuṭumbinastadā ।
sarve yayurhi te muktiṃ tathā yāsyanti mānavāḥ ।।65॥
atha suvarṇanāmnaśca gandharvasya priyā satī ।
hemagarbheti vikhyātā putrī tasyāḥ prasundarī ॥66॥
sukāmā nāmataḥ sā ca dhanadena vivāhitā ।
tasyāṃ putraḥ ketumālī rājā vaidyādhare pure ॥67॥
babhūva tasya patnī ca śaśirekhetināmata: ।
dve kanye janayāmāsa ratiṃ prītiṃ manorame ॥68॥
dadau sa kāmadevāya pāṇigrahaṇapūrvakam ।
anyāśca kanyakā bahvīrdāsīrūpā tadā dadau ॥69॥
tāśca kanyā niyamaṃ vai jagṛhuḥ śivapūjanam ।
kṛtvā jalādikaṃ grāhyaṃ nānyathā tu kadācana ॥1.559.70॥
athaikadā yayuḥ sarvā devanadyāṃ vigāhitum ।
citrāṃgadaśca gandharvo dṛṣṭvā tāstatra cāyayau ॥71॥
kāmarūpadharo bhūtvā rūpānurūpaśobhita: |
sasnau jale yadā tasmin mohitāstāstu kanyakāḥ ॥72॥
remustenaiva sākaṃ ca visasmarurharārcanam ।
evaṃ vai divase yāte sāyaṃ saṃsmṛtya śaṃkaram ॥73॥
ā+āyayuḥ pūjanārthaṃ ca bhuktvā pītvā'nnavāri ca ।
pārvatī kupitā dṛṣṭvā śaśāpa sāyameva tāḥ ।।74।।
dharmasya niyamaṃ hitvā cā'pūjya śaṃkaraṃ ca mām ।
jalānnaṃ bhuktavatyaśca tato doṣānvitāḥ khalu ||75|।
mama śāpena vai sarvā bhavantu kubjikāstathā ।
vāmanyaśca martyaloke hīnāṃgā vanabhīllikāḥ ॥76॥
evaṃ śaptāstu tāḥ sarvā martyalokaṃ samāgaman ।
babhramustā vane'raṇye bhīlikāḥ śāpaduḥkhitāḥ ॥77॥
ekadā ca kubero vai tena mārgeṇa cāmbare ।
nirgato divyayānena dṛṣṭvā tā duḥkhitāstataḥ ॥78॥
yayau śīghraṃ pārvatīṃ ca prati kailāsameva saḥ ।
natvā ruroda ca tadā satī prāha kathaṃ tviha ॥79॥
rodiṣi vada me tvatra kāraṇaṃ prakaromi yat ।
kuberaḥ kanyakāśāpanirvṛtiṃ prārthayat tadā ॥1.559.80॥
śrutvaitat pārvatī prāha yāntu sarvā hi narmadām ।
yajñapākāśramaṃ gatvā bilvāmrakaṃ sutīrthakam ॥81॥
kṛtvā śāpāttato muktā bhaviṣyanti drutaṃ tu tāḥ ।
yatra vai saṃgame kubjā gāndharvyo bhīllayonitaḥ ॥82॥
muktāḥ khātvā jalaṃ pītvā kubjātīrthaṃ taducyate ।
kubjānadī ca sā proktā narmadāsaṃgatā ca yā ॥83॥
tatra snātāḥ śāpamuktā gāndharvyo yānasaṃsthitāḥ ।
yayuḥ sarvāḥ kuberoktyā svarge punarnijālayam ॥84॥
aneke jalapānādyaistatra siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanād vāpi mucyante bhavabandhanāt ॥85॥
athānyattatra vai tīrthaṃ māheśvarapurātmakam ।
raudraṃ vāruṇamāsādya krośamātrapramāṇata: ॥86॥
śivakṣetre'tra ye snātāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo'pi ca ।
api kīṭapataṃgādyā mṛtā yānti divaṃ param ॥87॥
sālaṃkāyanamuninā kṛto yajño mahān purā ।
ayodhyādhipati: sālaṃkāyanā'khyo nṛpo'bhavat ॥88॥
anāvṛṣṭau prajātāyāṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ mahāmunim ।
paryapṛcchat kāraṇaṃ ca mārkaṇḍeyo jagād tam ॥89॥
gaṃgāsāgarasaṃbhede tava rājye narādhipa ।
adhikāravihīnā vai sakāmā phalavāñcchanāḥ ॥1.559.90॥
sāmprataṃ saptacāṇḍālā ūrdhvapādā adha:śikhāḥ ।
kaṇadhūmaṃ pibantyeva tapaḥ kurvanti tena vai ॥91॥
tapasyanadhikārāṇāṃ pāpaṃ tapasi jāyate ।
taddaśāṃśastvayi rājannāste tato'pyavagrahaḥ ll92ll
tasmāttān daṇḍaya rājan taporodhaṃ ca kāraya !
yajñe ca nārmade kṣetre samācara mahāmakham ll93ll
vṛṣṭistena va sarvatra bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ।
mucyatāṃ pāpadoṣeṇa rājyaṃ svargamavāpsyasi ||94ll
śrutvā rājā tvādideśa bhṛtyān sambhārasiddhaye ।
saptarātrābhyantarato yathā yajñaḥ pravartate ll99ll
rājā rājyaprajāścāpyamātyā rājakumārakāḥ । ।
ṛṣayo munayo viprā rājñyo devāḥ sureśvarāḥ ||96||
āyayustatra vai tīre revāyāśca nimantritāḥ । ।
arbudā'rbudasaṃkhyākāḥ svarṇamudrāśca saṃdadau ।।97।।
koṭigogajavājyādidānaṃ cakāra bhūpatiḥ ।
hiraṇmayā mahāstambhāḥ sruvādyā api kānakāḥ ।।98।।
bhakṣyabhojyarasādyāścā'pūrvā divyarasā'nvitāḥ । ।
vartante tatra bhūbhāge viṣṇuḥ sākṣāt samāyayau ।।99।।
rudraścāgniḥ svayaṃ brahmā tattaddevyaḥ samāyayuḥ । ।
yajño nirvartitaḥ pūrṇo'vabhṛthaṃ narmadājale ॥1.559.100॥
cakruḥ sarve mahāvṛṣṭiḥ saṃjātā kṣitimaṇḍale ।
devādyāḥ pūjitā rājñā brāhmaṇāśca pratoṣitāḥ ॥101॥
tādṛśaṃ tanmahattīrthe yajñīyaṃ nārmadaṃ śubham ।।
sañjātaṃ tāpasā rājñā niruddhāstapasastathā ।। 102॥
ye cāṇḍālāstapasyāsan tena vṛṣṭirbabhūva ca ।
ityevaṃ ca kratuṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ।। 103॥
tata ārabhya tattīrthaṃ yajñatīrthaṃ hi kathyate ।
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraḥ prāha pārvatīṃ tīrthamaṇḍalam ।। 104॥
mayoditaṃ ca te lakṣmi ! pāpatāpapraṇāśanam ।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi muktidaṃ nārmadaṃ jalam ।। 105॥
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śāṇḍilyākalpagātīrtha rantidevatīrtha harikeśatīrthā'mbarīṣatīrtha bilvāmrakatīrtha sālaṃkāyanatīrthādīni sacamatkāra nirūpitānīti nāmaikonaṣaṣṭayadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ॥559॥
