śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tathā'nyāni yāni tīrthāni śaṃbhunā ।
pārvatyai cābhidhattāni kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।। 1 ।।
camatkārapure nāganadītīre purā'ruṇiḥ ।
ṛṣirāsa tadā tatra kaścidvyādhaḥ samāgataḥ ।। 2 ।।
ṛṣeryogācchuddhamanā vyādhastapaścacāra ha ।
dvijatvaṃ karmaṇā prāpto nāmnā satyatapā hyabhūt ।। 3 ।।
sa tu satyatapā durvāsasā cāśīḥsuyojitaḥ ।
yayau kubjānarmadāyāḥ saṃgamaṃ snānakāraṇāt ।। 4 ।।
snātvā pītvā jalaṃ puṇyayuto himācalaṃ yayau ।
himādreruttare pāde puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe ।। 5 ।।
citraśilāṃ samadhyāsya bhadranyagrodhasannidhau ।
tapaścakāra tatrā'pi bhajan vai śrīnarāyaṇam ।। 6 ।।
sa kadācit kuṭhāreṇa ciccheda samidhaḥ kila ।
ciccheda cāṃgulīmekāṃ vāmatarjanikāṃ tataḥ ।। 7 ।।
bhasmacūrṇaṃ viniṣkrāntaṃ na māṃsaṃ na ca lohitam ।
aṃgulī sandhitā tena pūrvavaccā'bhavattadā ।। 8 ।।
etadāścaryamekena kinnareṇa vilokitam ।
ākāśe gacchatā tena kinnareṇa divaṃ tataḥ ।। 9 ।।
gatvā tvindrasabhāyāṃ cā'pūrvamāścaryamīritam ।
tadyathā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ mayā tāpasadarśitam ।। 1.560.1 0।।
puṣpabhadrānadītīre satyatapāstu tāpasaḥ ।
tapasā śuṣkadehaśca dehe bhasmaiva vartate ।। 11 ।।
tacchrutvā sahasā śukro'nujaṃ viṣṇuṃ samabravīt ।
āgaccha viṣṇo gacchāmo himavatpārśvamuttamam ।। 12।।
tatrāścaryamapūrvaṃ me kathitaṃ kinnareṇa vai ।
evamuktastato viṣṇurvārāharūpamagrahīt ।। 13।।
mṛgayuśca tathaivendro jagmatustamṛṣiṃ prati ।
viṣṇurvārāharūpeṇa ṛṣidṛṣṭipathe sthitaḥ ।। 14।।
bhūtvā dṛśyopyadṛśyo'bhūtpunareva ca dṛśyate ।
tāvadindro dhanuṣpāṇistīkṣṇasāyakadhṛg vane ।। 15।।
āgatya satyatapasamṛṣimenamuvāca ha ।
bhagavanniha dṛṣṭaste varāhaḥ pṛthulo mahān ।। 16 ।।
yena taṃ hanmi bhṛtyānāṃ poṣaṇāya mahāmune ।
śrutvā muniścakitaḥ san cintayāmāsa tatkṣaṇāt ।। 17।।
yadi taṃ darśayāmyasmai varāhaṃ sa haniṣyati ।
no cet kuṭumbaḥ kṣudhayā sīdatyasya na saṃśayaḥ ।। 18।।
ubhayathāpi me pāpaṃ bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
varāhaḥ śaraṇaṃ yāto mamāśrame'vanāya vai ।। 19।।
vyādhaścāpi hi māṃ prāpto vīkṣya māṃ satyavādinam ।
asatyavacane doṣo viśvāsaghātanaṃ param ।।1.560.20।।
anyatarasya hiṃsā ca dūṣaṇaṃ sarvathā bhayam ।
evaṃ gate'tra kiṃ vācyamathā'sau cintayan harim ।।21।।
kṣaṇaṃ sākṣiṇi dhairyaṃ ca sthairyaṃ prāpa tadā drutam ।
rakṣātmikā subuddhiśca kṣaṇāttasya vyajāyata ।।22।।
netraṃ paśyati no vakti vakti jihvā na paśyati ।
paśyatyanyo vadatyanyo dvayornāstyekakāryatā ।।23।।
draṣṭā mūko vaktā cāndhaḥ ko dadyāduttaraṃ vada ।
evaṃ śrutvā paraṃ tuṣṭāvindraviṣṇu kṣaṇāntare ।।24।।
svarūpe darśayantau ca vākyametat samūcatuḥ ।
brūhi tuṣṭau ca nau te'tra vṛṇu caikaṃ varaṃ param ।।25।।
tacchrutvā'sau satyatapā uvāca saṃprasannahṛt ।
nānyo varaḥ pṛthivyāṃ me paro viṣṇostu darśanāt ।।26।।
yena kṛtārthatā me'sti durlabhaṃ tava darśanam ।
tathāpyatra puṣpabhadrājale vaṭāntike tu ye ।।27।।
snātvā dhyātvā hariṃ smṛtvā vaseyurmāsamekakam ।
teṣāṃ pāpāni naśyantāṃ muktiṃ tebhyaḥ pradehyapi ।।28।।
tathetyuktvā tu tau devau datvā tasya varaṃ tathā ।
vimānasthau vyomamārge tiṣṭhatastāvadeva ca ।।29।।
gurustasya samāyātaścāruṇiḥ samadṛśyata ।
durvāsāśca samāyātaḥ smṛtau satyena vai tadā ।।1.560.30 ।।
pūjitau satyatapasā jñātvā śiṣyaṃ kṛtārthakam ।
siddhaṃ ca tapasā dagdhakilbiṣaṃ purataḥ sthitam ।।3 1 ।।
āruṇiḥ prāha siddho'si brahmabhūto'si sarvathā ।
idānīmātmanā sārdhaṃ muktikālo mato'sti te ।।22।।
uttiṣṭhā''gamyatāṃ putra mayā sārdhaṃ vimānake ।
nārāyaṇena cendreṇa tathā durvāsasā saha ।।33।।
yāsyāmo nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ kubjāmrakaṃ śubham ।
evamuktvā cāruṇiścātreyaḥ satyatapāstrayaḥ ।। 34।।
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ cāruruhurvimānakam ।
bhaktānāṃ vāñcchayā nārāyaṇaścendro'pi nārmadam ।।35।।
yājñīyaṃ tīrthamāsādya snātvā svargaṃ yayustataḥ ।
tato muktiṃ jagāmā'sau satyatapāḥ paraṃ padam ।।36।।
anye ciraṃjīvinaśca svasvasthānāni vai yayuḥ ।
durvāsādyāstu kailāsādikaṃ yacchāśvataṃ matam ।।37।।
athā'nyatte pravadāmi tīrthaṃ vai nārmade jale ।
maṇḍapeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca tīrthaṃ tatra hi rājate ।। 38।।
yatra snātvā tanuṃ tyaktvā rājā vaidyādhare pure ।
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।39।।
mānasau brahmaṇaḥ putrau bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau ।
vanasthau ca prati rājā hyajāpālo yayau kvacit ।।1.560.40 ।।
avadhyādhipatirnatvā papraccha madhuram ṛṣī ।
pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇārthāya dānaṃ deyaṃ mayā'tra vai ।।41 ।।
ke grahīṣyanti ṛṣayaḥ samāyāntu madantikam ।
tadā dvau varjayitvā tu bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau ।।।42।।
anye rājñā pradattāni dānāni jagṛhustadā ।
gajānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam ।।43।।
prādād viprebhyaśca dhanaṃ maṭhān hemamayāँstathā ।
kalaṃjaragiriṃ rājā cakāra triḥpradakṣiṇam ।।44।।
namaskṛtvā ṛṣīn sarvān jagāma svapuraṃ prati ।
gate tasmin mahīpāle ṛṣayo dhanamohitāḥ ।।45।।
sukhaṃ ca paramaṃ prāptā rājadravyeṇa rājasāḥ ।
tapasaḥ patitā bhoge saktā babhūvureva te ।।46।।
puṇyakṣayeṇa ca mṛtāḥ ṛte bādaraśākaṭau ।
rājapratigraho ghoro raudraḥ pāpo bhayāvaraḥ ।।47।।
ṛte brahmasvarūpaṃ vai kaḥ soḍhuṃ śaktimān bhavet ।
kāmakrodhaparā bhūtvā mṛtāste brāhmaṇāstataḥ ।।48।।
śvayoniṃ samanuprāptā jātā amedhyabhakṣakāḥ ।
atha pratigrahayuktavipreṣu vāsakāraṇāt ।।49।।
saṃgadoṣeṇa jātau śvamukhau bādaraśākaṭau ।
dṛṣṭvā''nanaṃ śvatulyaṃ ca cintayāmāsatuśca tau ।।1.560.50।।
saṃgadoṣeṇa vai pāpaṃ lagnaṃ rājapratigrahe ।
iti sañcintya tau satyaṃ yayatuḥ parameṣṭhinam ।।51 ।।
abhivādya prāhatuśca vṛttāntaṃ vikṛtānanau ।
śrutvā brahmā niṣkṛtiṃ ca prāha vai nārmade jale ।।।52।।
snānena śuddhirbhavitā yāntu vai maṇḍapeśvaram ।
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā bādarāyaṇaśākaṭau ।।53।।
śvabhiḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sahitau narmadā yayatustadā ।
snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tatra pāpahīnāstu te'naghāḥ ।।54।।
yayuḥ svargaṃ divyayānairevaṃ tīrthaṃ taduttamam ।
śravaṇātkīrtanāccāpi hayamedhaphalaṃ bhaveta ।।55।।
tato gacchet paraṃ tīrthaṃ śvetakiṃśukasaṃjñakam ।
narmadādantivanikāsaṃgame snānamācaret ।।56।।
tīrthaṃ kapiśilākhyaṃ ca kuryāt tataḥ śubhapradam ।
śaśabhīnarmadāyogaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchet tataḥ param ।।।57।।
rājatīrthaṃ tato gacched rāmalakṣmaṇasevitam ।
uttīrya narmadāṃ rāmo yayau vanāntare purā ।।58।।
daśāśvamedhatīrthaṃ ca tato gacchetparaṃ śubham ।
pipīlikoddhāratīrthaṃ tato gacchet pramuktidam ।।।59।।
vandhyārevāsamāyogaṃ tato gacchecchubhapradam ।
śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet svargamokṣapradaṃ varam ।।1.560.60।।
rāsabhīnarmadābhede snātvā mokṣo bhaved dhruvam ।
havirdhānastu rājarṣiḥ samartho'bhūt purā yuge ।।।61 ।।
ātreyasya sutaścāsīt harikeśābhidhānakaḥ ।
agniputrī sutejāśca pāṇigrahaṇadharmataḥ ।।62।।
havirdhānāya dattā sā sutejānāmikā tataḥ ।
havirdhānastu rājarṣiḥ ṛtuṃ buddhvā gato hi tām ।।63।।
kadācittu yuvā tatrā''yayau vai harikeśakaḥ ।
so'pi vai kāmabhāvena tasyā jagrāha vai karam ।।6 4।
agnihotrasya śālāyāṃ jagrāha kāmadharmataḥ ।
harikeśastayā sākaṃ reme yatheṣṭakāmataḥ ।।65।।
havirdhānaśca dadṛśe yugalaṃ surate sthitam ।
āsīd viṣaṇṇavadano hyavadhyo brāhmaṇo yataḥ ।।66।।
patnī cāpi hyavadhyā vai yataḥ strījātireva sā ।
vicāryetthaṃ śanairvipraṃ havirdhāna uvāca ha ।।67।।
mātaraṃ gurupatnīṃ ca svasāraṃ ca sutāṃ tathā ।
gatvā tu praviśedagniṃ tataḥ śuddhyati mānavaḥ ।।68।।
guruṃ ca guruputraṃ ca gatvā strī saṃviśeccitām ।
evaṃ kartuṃ samarthau na bhavantau bhavato yataḥ ।।।69।।
gardabhastvaṃ bhava vipra sutejā gardabhī bhava ।
varṣaśataṃ tathā'raṇye jātau tau gardabhau tataḥ ।।1.560.70।।
jātismarau kadācittāvagastyā'śramamīyatuḥ ।
papracchatuśca śāpasya nivṛttyarthaṃ tapo vratam ।।71 ।।
agastyaḥ prāha yātaṃ vai havirdhānaṃ prati hyubhau ।
tau tataśca havirdhānāśramaṃ yayaturādarāt ।।72।।
kṣamāṃ yācitavantau ca nematuḥ pādayostadā ।
havirdhānaśca tau prāha yātaṃ vai narmadātaṭam ।।।73 ।।
snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tasyāstapasā kṣīṇakalmaṣau ।
yāsyathaḥ paramāṃ muktiṃ phalaṃ mānuṣajanmanaḥ ।।74।।
evamuktau yayatuśca narmadāṃ ceratustapaḥ ।
śuddhau tau gardabhīṃ yoniṃ tyaktvā divyau babhūvatuḥ ।।75।।
kāmikaṃ yānamārūḍhau sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitau ।
yayatustau divaṃ tatra nyuṣaturyugasaptatiḥ ।।76 ।।
athā'nte yayatuḥ śrīmannārāyaṇapadaṃ ca tau ।
tatra tīrthaṃ harikeśa sutejaskaṃ pramokṣadam ।।77।।
havirdhāneśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ revāgardabhīsaṃgame ।
vartate paramaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanāt pāpanāśanam ।।78
tato gacchet karamardātīrthaṃ puṇyapradaṃ param ।
maitreyasyā''śramaṃ rājā kuśadhvajaḥ samāyayau ।।79
narmadāyāstaṭe ramye śrāddhaṃ cakāra bhāvataḥ ।
tatra dānaṃ dadau rājā gavāṃ daśā'yutāni vai ।।1.560.80
savatsānāṃ suvarṇānāṃ ghaṇṭā''bharaṇaśobhinām ।
bhojayitvā tataḥ śrāddhe brāhmaṇāँstānnṛpottamaḥ ।।81
yayau rājā nijaṃ gehaṃ viprāstatra vyavasthitāḥ ।
tān dhenūścāgatā jagdhuṃ rākṣasāścaikadā vane ।।।82
dhenavo viviśurvārau kāściddivaṃ yayustadā ।
viprān vai bhakṣituṃ tatra dudruvū rākṣasāstataḥ ।।83
sasmarurbrāhmaṇāḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ।
lakṣmīpatiṃ prabhānāthaṃ pārvatīśaṃ narāyaṇam ।।।84
māṇikīśaṃ ca haṃseśaṃ mañjuleśaṃ hṛdisthitam ।
tāvad viṣṇuḥ samāyātaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ।।।85
cakreṇa karamardena nāśayāmāsa rākṣasān ।
brāhmaṇān saṃrarakṣāpi gāvastatrā''gatāḥ punaḥ ।।86
karamardeśvaraḥ śaṃbhurviṣṇucakrādvinirgataḥ ।
karamardeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ paraṃ rakṣākaraṃ matam ।।87।।
atha kālāntare viṣṇurviprān gāśca vimānake ।
ārohayitvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ nītavānmokṣamālayam ।।88।
tatra snātā divaṃ yānti mṛtāśca na punarbhavāḥ ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanāccāpi gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet ।।89।
ityāha pārvatīṃ śaṃbhurmayā lakṣmi! ca te puraḥ ।
uditaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇacakrapratīrthakam ।।1.560.90 ।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āruṇiśiṣyasatyatapaso mokṣaḥ, maṇḍapeśvaratīrthaṃ, bādarāyaṇaśākaṭāyanayoḥ śvamukhatānivṛttiḥ, narmadādantivanikāsaṃgamaḥ, rāsabhīnarmadātīrthavṛttāntaḥ, karamardatīrthaṃ cetyādisetihāsanirūpaṇanāmāṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 560 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 560 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 561
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 562 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śaṃkaraśca pārvatyai prāha tīrthakam ।
jvāleśvaraṃ suvikhyātaṃ kathayāmīha te'naghe ।। 1 ।।
baleḥ putraṃ tripuraṃ vai bāṇaṃ bāṇena śaṃkaraḥ ।
nijaghāna tataścāstraṃ jvālāmālāsamanvitam ।। 2 ।।
patitaṃ kalpagāvārṣuṃ jvālā śāntā tadā'bhavat ।
jvāleśvaraṃ hi tatproktaṃ pāparākṣasanāśanam ।। 3 ।।
atha revācarusaṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ vai rājate param ।
naimiṣāraṇyake kṣetre purā''sīnnagarī śubhā ।। 4 ।।
hiraṇyānāmataḥ svarṇasāptabhaumairgṛhairyutā ।
hiraṇyavegānāmnī ca nadī cāste purīyutā ।। 5 ।।
hiraṇyabāhusaṃjñaśca rājā ceyeṣa vai kratum ।
naimiṣe sa ṛṣīn sarvān papraccha yajñabhūmikām ।। 6 ।।
te tu prāhurmahākṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ makhayogyakam ।
tasminniṣṭaṃ hutaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet। ।। 7 ।।
rājā prāha kraturme puṣkare niṣpādyatāṃ śubhaḥ ।
tato jagāma rājarṣiḥ puṣkaraṃ sarvasaṃbhṛtaḥ ।। 8 ।।
gavāṃ ca daśalakṣāṇi sārdhaṃ lakṣaṃ tu vājinām ।
dvipañcāśatsahasrāṇi gajendrāṇāṃ rathā'yutam ।। 9 ।।
maṇimāṇikyaratnāni vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca ।
teṣāṃ saṃkhyā tvasaṃkhyaiva kuberasya dhanaṃ yathā ।। 1.561.1 0।।
bhakṣyabhojyāni pānāni pravartante divāniśam ।
pravartitastato yajñaścāhūto yatra viśvasṛṭ ।। 11 ।।
śukraścāpi tadāhūto nānye devā hi bhūsuraiḥ ।
anyadevaiśca kiṃ kāryaṃ dvābhyāṃ sarvaṃ prapūjitam ।। 1 2।।
na viṣṇuśca na cādityā na candro varuṇo na ca ।
na rudro na marutaśca nā'nye diśyā na pālakāḥ ।। 1 3।।
yajñe pravartite yajñacchidrānveṣaṇatatparāḥ ।
vighnaṃ kartuṃ samāyātā hyasurā devakaṇṭakāḥ ।। 14।।
sarvaśo dānavā daityā bhūtavetālarākṣasāḥ ।
pibanti somaṃ yajñāṃgaṃ bhakṣayanti sma bhūsurān ।। 15।।
agnirvināśito yajñayūpaśca maṇḍapo hataḥ ।
brahmā śakro devatāśca vīkṣyā''kasmikanaṣṭatām ।। 16 ।।
adṛśyatāṃ gatāstasmāt sthānād vighnamayāttataḥ ।
hiraṇyabāhuḥ kupito brāhmaṇān prati vai tadā ।। 17।।
yajñe jyeṣṭhānanāhūya devān viprā hi bhikṣukāḥ ।
apalāyanta me yajñaṃ tyaktvā svārthaparā yataḥ ।। 18।।
atha daityāḥ prasaṃgṛhya saṃbhārān prayayurgṛhān ।
rājā'vicārayannā'yaṃ pauruṣasya kṣaṇo mama ।। 19।।
na kopasya na yuddhasya ruṣṭe devādimaṇḍale ।
ekākī hayamāruhya sahapatnyā vrajāmyaham ।। 1.561.20 ।।
yatrā''dityā na na viṣṇurna rudro na ca candramāḥ ।
tathā'nye na diśāpālāḥ kathaṃ yajñaḥ susiddhyati ।।2 1 ।।
lolupā brāhmaṇāḥ sarvajihirṣavo na rakṣakāḥ ।
kintu te dhvaṃsakā jātā lobhamūlā aśaktakāḥ ।।22।।
yadi me vidyate satyaṃ bhavantu brahmarākṣasāḥ ।
sakaṇṭake nirudake pradeśe naṣṭacetanāḥ ।।23।।
śāpaṃ śrutvā ca vai vipraiḥ śapto rājā'pi dūrataḥ ।
arakṣitā tvaṃ yajñasya kṣatriyādhama eva ca ।।24।।
anaghānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śāpado bhava vai kharaḥ ।
vane dvādaśavarṣāṇi babhūvuḥ khararākṣasāḥ ।।25।।
atha kāle gate'raṇye devarṣirnārado muniḥ ।
ājagāma dadarśaitān kharaṃ ca rākṣasāँstathā ।।26।।
kharo nanāma devarṣiṃ papraccha mokṣakāraṇam ।
nāradastu tadā prāha nārmadaṃ jalamuttamam ।।27।।
revācarukasambhede snātvā muktiṃ prayāsyasi ।
brāhmaṇā rākṣasāścāpi snātvā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ।।28।।
ityuktāste yayū revāṃ revācarukasaṃgame ।
snātvā muktiṃ gatāḥ sarve narmadājalasaṃgamāt ।।29।।
brahmayānasamārūḍhāḥ stūyamānāśca bandibhiḥ ।
yayurdivyaṃ brahmalokaṃ narmadāvārisaṃgamāt ।।1.561.30।।
yatra viṣṇustathā rudro sūryo nārāyaṇastathā ।
tatra śrīrvijayaścaiva bhuktirmuktiśca śāśvatī ।।3 1।।
yatra bhaktirgurau cāste yathā deve tathā gurau ।
tasya kāmāḥ prasiddhyanti gurvātmakaharerbalāt ।।32।।
śravaṇāt kīrtanādasya smaraṇāt sevanādapi ।
vandanāddhāraṇādvāpi mucyate bhavabandhanāt ।।33।।
athā'tiśreṣṭhatīrthaṃ cā'marakaṇṭakamucyate ।
tadārabhya giriśreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ puṇyatamaṃ smṛtam ।।34।।
yāvadvai saṃgatā revāṃ caturnāmnī mahānadī ।
uttare vartate yajñaparvataḥ pāvano mahān ।।35।।
svayaṃbhuvā purā tasminnaṣṭaḥ sautrāmaṇirmakhaḥ ।
tatraiveṣṭaṃ maghavatā hayamedhena vai purā ।। 36।।
dadhīcinā'tha devaiśca tatraiveṣṭaṃ mahāmakhaiḥ ।
sa yāvat sagamo nadyāḥ sa yāvadyajñaparvataḥ ।।37।।
rajaḥ sarvaṃ pavitraṃ vai vartate mokṣadāyakam ।
brahmaputraḥ suparṇaśca ṛṣiryatrā'bhavatpurā ।।38।।
saṃgame vāsakṛd vidvān sarvaśāstravicakṣaṇaḥ ।
puruhūtā tasya bhāryā dharmapatnī pativratā ।।39।।
ekadā tvabravīd vākyaṃ saṃprasādya nijaṃ patim ।
ṛtukāle yathāyogye māṃ bhajasva mahāmune ।।1.561.40।।
jāyate me yathāputraḥ sarvasantānapāvanaḥ ।
putreṇa lokān jayati tṛpyanti pitṛdevatāḥ ।।41 ।।
aputrasya gatirnāsti tasmātputramajījanaḥ ।
brāhmaṇastu tadā prāhā'māvāsyā varjitā priye! ।।42।।
nā'tra saṃgaḥ prakartavyaḥ pitṝṇāmapi bādhakaḥ ।
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu taptaṃ me duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ।।43।।
tadvināśo yathā syānna tathā'nyatra dine tava ।
garbhalābhāya ca priye yatiṣye mā śucaṃ vraja ।।44।।
ityuktā sā tadovāca patnī ṛṣiṃ suparṇakam ।
paśyātra nārmade tīrthe snānamātreṇa pāpataḥ ।।45।।
mukto bhūtvā hi cāṇḍālo vimānena divaṃ yayau ।
na taptaṃ na hutaṃ tena na japtaṃ na yamāḥ kṛtāḥ ।।46।।
niyamān sa na jānāti tathāpyasau divaṃ gataḥ ।
vrataṃ naiva kṛtaṃ tena rājasvalyaṃ na pālitam ।।47।।
na kṛtāni vratāhāni tathāpi sa divaṃ gataḥ ।
tīrthasyā'sya tu māhātmyaṃ paramaṃ tādṛśaṃ mune ।।48।।
snānamātreṇa pāpānāṃ nāśo bhavati sarvathā ।
tasmād bhogaṃ bhajasvā'tra māṃ gṛhāṇa kṛpānidhe! ।।49।।
bhāryāvākyaṃ kvacit pālyaṃ tadā dharmo na lupyate ।
ṛtusnātā yadā bhāryā'patyecchā prabalā yadā ।।1.561.5 0।।
bhāryāyā jāyate tatrā'vaśyaṃ pālyaṃ striyā vacaḥ ।
putro'vaśyaṃ prajāyeta ṛtudānena vai tadā ।।51 ।।
tatra vrataṃ vihātavyaṃ parvā'pi cotsavo'pi ca ।
anutsāhahate kāle na garbho'patyadāyakaḥ ।।52।।
vatsarāṇāṃ sahasre ca vinā saṃgena vai gate ।
etādṛśe sthale dharmaḥ priyāvākyaṃ na cetaraḥ ।।53।।
nā'pavādo na vā bādho na vā doṣo'tra vidyate ।
dāvānale mahāraṇye kiyanmātraṃ tṛṇādikam ।।54।।
amṛtānāṃ samudreṣu kiyanmātraṃ viṣatṛṇam ।
madhyāhnasūryavelāyāṃ kiyanmātraṃ gṛhe tamaḥ ।।55।।
puṇyaparvatasaṃsthāne kiyanmātraṃ hyamādinam ।
tasmādadyaiva māṃ nātha bhajā'tipremabhāvataḥ ।।56 ।।
agrahe yadbhavetpāpaṃ nā'māpuṇyaṃ hi tatsamam ।
ityuktaśca patistatra bhāryā jagrāha kāmataḥ ।।।57।।
dadau putrasya garbhaṃ saḥ putro'bhūd bhāskaropamaḥ ।
amāśrāddhe ca pitaro bhuktvā ye tṛptimāgatāḥ ।।58।
tairāgatya niśāyāṃ ca prahasya kathitaṃ tadā ।
adya garbhapradānasya prāyaścittaṃ drutaṃ kuru ।59
narmadāyāṃ punaḥ snātvā homaṃ japaṃ punaḥ kuru ।
vayaṃ tṛptāḥ prasannāḥ sma santānasandhihetave ।।1.561.6 0।।
bhāryayā cārthitastvaṃ tāṃ putrārthaṃ yad gṛhītavān ।
nārmadaṃ salilaṃ cātra pāvanaṃ pāpanāśanam ।।6 1 ।।
brahmahatyābālahatyāgurustrīhananodbhavam ।
vratanāśādijaṃ pāpaṃ vyavāyādisamudbhavam ।।62।।
snānamātreṇa revāyāṃ naśyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।
ityuktvā pitarastasya yayuḥ prasannamānasāḥ ।।63 ।।
anapatyaviniśvāsahatā garbheṇa jīvitāḥ ।
atha kālāntare tatra suparṇau+o bhāryayā saha ।।64।।
vimāne cojjvale sthitvā yayau brahmapuraṃ param ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ gatastatra suparṇaḥ saṃgamottame ।।65।।
atha vai paścime nīlagaṃgāyā narmadottare ।
vyatīpāteśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ paramaśobhanam ।।66।।
sāvitryāśca tapastaptaṃ sāvitrīkuṇḍamasti ca ।
indradyumno'bhavad rājā yajñaṃ kartuṃ samīhate ।।67। ।
papraccha ca maharṣīn sa dharmāraṇyasthitāँstadā ।
mārkaṇḍādyāśca taṃ prāhurnārmadaṃ kṣetramuttamam ।।68।।
rājā tūdghoṣayāṃcakre gantuṃ revāṃ prajājanam ।
gavāṃ ca trīṇi lakṣāṇi savatsānāṃ payomucām ।।69।।
aśvānāṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sapādaṃ lakṣameva ca ।
dantināmayutaṃ cāpi ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam ।।1.561.70।।
sahasrāṇi ca catvāri yānānāṃ kāmacāriṇām ।
lakṣaṃ tu karabhāṇāṃ vai maṇimāṇikyalakṣakam ।।7 1 ।।
agniśaucāni vastrāṇi pātrāṇi kānakāni ca ।
nānābhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni pānāni vividhāni ca ।।72।।
lakṣaṃ karmakarāṇāṃ ca tiladarbhādikaṃ tathā ।
saṃgṛhya brāhmaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ rājā vimānamāśritaḥ ।।73 ।।
mudā paramayā yuktaḥ sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ ।
dharmāraṇyaṃ yayau rājā yatra sā narmadā nadī ।।74।।
yātrā'drirvartate ramyo vaidūryamaṇiśobhitaḥ ।
oṃkāreśastathāśaṃbhurvirājate mahāprabhaḥ ।।79।।
oṃkārasannidhau revākoṭitīrthaṃ virājate ।
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ ceṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ hyanantakam ।। 76।।
sarvadā sarvakāryeṣu narmadā koṭipuṇyadā ।
triṃśadyojanaparyantaṃ yajñayūpāँśca maṇḍapān ।।77।।
kārayāmāsa rājā'sau kuṇḍāni vividhāni ca ।
vedadhvanitanirghoṣā divaṃ bhūmiṃ samaspṛśan ।। 78।।
nirdhūmaścā'bhavad vahnirjagrāha ghṛtahavyakam ।
brahmāṇaṃ ca tathā viṣṇuṃ śaṃkaraṃ ca samāhvayat ।।79।।
rudrā ekādaśa tatra tathā''dityāśca dvādaśa ।
viśvedevā stathā sādhyā maruto vasavastathā ।।1.561.80 ।।
lokapālāḥ samudrāśca nadyaḥ śailāḥ supādapāḥ ।
dikpālā bhūtapālāśca tīrthāni pitarastathā ।।8 1 ।।
siddhakinnaragandharvā nāgarākṣasaguhyakāḥ ।
vidyādhrāścāraṇāścāpyāyayustatra kratūtsave ।।82।।
ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo dadhipāyasakardamāḥ ।
babhūvurjalapānāni rasapānāni sarvaśaḥ ।।83।।।
bhakṣyabhojyaiśca vividhaiḥ kāmyayānādibhistathā ।
tṛptā devāśca munayo bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham ।।84।।
evaṃ nirvartito yajño'vabhṛthaṃ narmadājale ।
babhūva dakṣiṇātṛptiḥ sarveṣāṃ yajñabhāginām ।।85।।
oṃkāreśaṃ svayaṃ rājā pupūja hemaratnakaiḥ ।
maṇimāṇikyahīrādyaiḥ karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ ।।86।।
gandhapuṣpaiśca vividhairdhvajacchatravimānakaiḥ ।
cāmarairvyajanaiścāpi pūjayitvā haraṃ harim ।।87।।
tuṣṭāva mokṣadātre te oṃkārāya namonamaḥ ।
sākṣād rudro babhūvā'tha mūrtimān tasya sannidhau ।।88।।
prāha varaṃ vṛṣṇīṣveti cendradyumna uvāca tam ।
āvāsaṃ kuru droṇyāṃ vai sarvadā yajñaparvate ।।89।।
mṛtānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ syācca pāpināmapi cātra vai ।
parvataṃ veṣṭayed yastu sūtreṇaikena parvaṇi ।।1.561.90।।
pṛthivī veṣṭitā tena saśailavanakānanā ।
tena puṇyena tasyātra mokṣo brahmapadaṃ bhavet। ।। 91 ।।
tathā'stviti haraḥ prāha tatraivā'ntaradhīyata ।
brahmā prāha ca rājānaṃ varadānārthameva ca ।।92।।
rājā prāhā'tra vai brahman liṃgamūrtidharo bhava ।
tathāstviti procya tatra brahmā cāntaradhīyata ।।93।।
rājā viṣṇuṃ pratuṣṭāva sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca ।
keśavaṃ mādhavaṃ viṣṇuṃ govindaṃ madhusūdanam ।।94।।
padmanābhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ śrīdharaṃ ca trivikramam ।
dāmodaraṃ vāsudevaṃ śrīhariṃ kambharāsutam ।।95।।
gopālabālaṃ rādheśaṃ śrīśaṃ rameśvaraṃ prabhum ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।96।।
maṃjuleśaṃ pārvatīśaṃ prabheśaṃ māṇikīpatim ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ haṃsājayānāthaṃ namāmyaham ।।97।।
śakhacakragadāśārṅgavanamālāvibhūṣaṇam ।
lokanāthaṃ jagannāthaṃ śrīnātha praṇamāmyaham ।।98।।
akṣareśa ca mukteśa laliteśa namo'stu te ।
avatāreśa deveśa vyūheśa ca namo'stu te ।।99।।
īśvareśa ca māyeśa durgeśa jāhnavīpate ।
jīveśā'nantayajñeśa yajñādhipa namo'stu te ।। 1.561.100 ।।
vedātmakāya kāntāya dharmaputrāya te namaḥ ।
brahmavratadharāyā'triguṇāya ca namo'stu te ।। 101 ।।
prakṛtīśāya śāntāya vaikuṇṭhasthāya te namaḥ ।
nṛsiṃhamatsyavārāhakūrmarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 1 02।।
sādhuveṣadharāyādikāraṇāya ca te namaḥ ।
sahasraśirase vedyapuruṣāya ca te namaḥ ।। 1 03।।
asurāṇāṃ damanārthaṃ dhṛtarūpāya te namaḥ ।
hiraṇyagarbharūpāyā'mṛtadhāmne ca te namaḥ ।। 1 04।।
sarvagarbhāya kṛṣṇāyā'ntarātmane ca te namaḥ ।
sraṣṭre'vitre ca saṃhartre kāryarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 1 05।।
sarvadikpālarūpāya lokapālātmane namaḥ ।
ardhanārīsvarūpāya tridevāya ca te namaḥ ।। 1 06।।
anantā''nandanidhaye brahmadhāmne ca te namaḥ ।
karmaphalapradātre te cā'ntaḥsthāya namo namaḥ ।। 1 07।।
saurāṣṭrakṛtavāsāya śrīkṛṣṇāya parātmane ।
koṭigopīkānta tubhyaṃ sukhadāya namo namaḥ ।। 1 08।।
brāhmatejase kṣatrāṇāṃ vīryarūpāya te namaḥ ।
viśāṃ sampatsvarūpāya śaraṇyāya ca te namaḥ ।। 10 9।।
pātivratyasvarūpāya patnīvṛṣāya te namaḥ ।
sadordhvaretase kṛṣṇa mokṣadāya ca te namaḥ ।। 1.561.11 0।।
sādhuṣu sarvadā sthātre bālarūpāya te namaḥ ।
namo bhaktamanaḥkāmapūrakāya namo namaḥ ।। 111 ।।
jñānadāya tathecchāsaṃpradāya yatnadāya ca ।
kriyādātre phaladātre bhoktre bhogyāya te namaḥ ।। 11 2।।
prakāśāya pareśāya jīvasthāya ca te namaḥ ।
sarvadehinivāsāya śaktiyogyāya te namaḥ ।। 113 ।।
acintyaguṇadhāmne te divyadehāya te namaḥ ।
apāraiśvaryadhātre te dṛśyarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 1 14।।
adṛśyarūparūpāya nityajñāya ca te namaḥ ।
sarvatattvasvarūpāya maṇḍapāya ca te namaḥ ।। 1 15।।
pañcāgnikṛtarūpāya vratasthāya ca te namaḥ ।
puṇyadāya maheśāya sarveśāya ca te namaḥ ।। 116 ।।
sarvaduḥkhavināśitre vahnirūpāya te namaḥ ।
namo'stu sruksruvādyātmayajñapātrāya te namaḥ ।। 1 17।।
dakṣiṇāpataye tubhyaṃ cāśīrvādāya te namaḥ ।
tṛptaye śāntirūpāya rasarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 1 18।।
sarvendriyanivāsāya satyakāmāya te namaḥ ।
ādityādisvarūpāya vṛṣarūpāya te namaḥ ।। 11 9।।
namaskārasya pātrāyā'rpaṇapātrāya te namaḥ ।
tvatprasādāt kṛpāsindho yajñasiddhirmamā'bhavat 1.561.120 ।।
karaṃ gṛhāṇa me viṣṇo yathā patnīkaraṃ varaḥ ।
dehi me caraṇe vāsaṃ nānyaṃ vṛṇomi keśava! ।। 121 ।।
viṣṇuḥ śrutvā paraṃ stotraṃ prasannaḥ prāha bhūpatim ।
varaṃ vṛṇu varaṃ rājan yatte manasi vartate ।। 1 22।।
dadāmi te na sandeho yajñasiddhirbhaviṣyati ।
indradyumnastadovāca oṃkāranāthasannidhau ।। 1 23।।
vaidūryaparvate kṛṣṇa nivāsaṃ kuru sarvadā ।
yena mokṣo bhavettatra cāgatānāṃ tavā'rcanāt ।। 1 24।।
darśanād vandanāccāpi sevanādavagāhanāt ।
prāṇatyāge dehināṃ ca gamanaṃ te pade bhavet ।। 1 25।।
pitṝṇāmannadānena yāntu te vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ।
api kīṭapataṃgādyā yāntvatra paramāṃ gatim ।। 126 ।।
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha cāvātatāra tatra ca ।
tīrthānyapi sthitānyatra nārāyaṇapadāmbuje ।। 1 27।।
avateruśca tīrthāni narmadāyāṃ kratukṣitau ।
nīlagaṃgāsaṃgame ca vartante mokṣadāni vai ।। 128।।
rājā revāṃ pratuṣṭāva saptadhārāmayī bhava ।
ityevamarthayāmāsa sāpi saptapravāhiṇī ।। 129।।
sañjātā mokṣadā revā sarvatīrthamayī satī ।
dānaṃ hutaṃ japastaptaṃ sarvamatrā'kṣayaṃ bhavet। ।। 1.561.130 ।।
ityevaṃ vai kratuṃ kṛtvā cendradyumno hi narmadām ।
viṣṇuṃ devān tathauṃkāraṃ namaskṛtya yayau gṛham ।।1 31 ।।
devādyā mānavādyāśca yajñe tṛptā yayurgṛham ।
śravaṇātkīrtanādasya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ।। 1 32।।
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha mokṣaścātra bhavet priye! ।
lakṣmi! tīrthaṃ mayoktaṃ te bhuktimuktipradaṃ param ।। 1 33।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jāleśvaratīrthaṃ hiraṇyabāhurājño gardabhatāmuktiḥ, revācarukasaṃbhedatīrtham, amarakaṇṭakatīrthaṃ, yajñaparvataḥ, suparṇakathā, oṃkāratīrthamityādinirūpaṇanāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।561।।


← adhyāyaḥ 561 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 562
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 563 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śaṃbhunā kīrtitāṃ kathāmaghāpahām ।
pārvatyai ṛkṣakādrau tāṃ kathayāmi prapāvanīm ।। 1 ।।
vasudāno'bhavad rājā'vadhyāyāḥ sārvabhaumakaḥ ।
īje yāgasahasreṇa hayamedhena mādhavam ।। 2 ।।
sapādalakṣamadhikaṃ sarvā jīvanti tatprajāḥ ।
tadā daityāśca revāyāstaṭe vai dakṣiṇe śaṭhāḥ ।। 3 ।।
ketumālī suketuśca sumukho dundubhistathā ।
dharmavighnaprakartāro'bhavan yajñavibhaṃjakāḥ ।। 4 ।।
amarakaṇṭake yajñān kartuṃ vāñcchati ko'pi na ।
tadā rājā yayau revāṃ yajñaṃ kartuṃ mahābalaḥ ।। 5 ।।
brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito vidvān ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ ।
gavāṃ ca pañcalakṣāṇi savatsānāṃ payomucām ।। 6 ।।
sapādalakṣamaśvānāṃ dantināmayutaṃ tathā ।
maṇimāṇikyaratnāni hemarūpyavasūni ca ।। 7 ।।
vividhaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca ājyaṃ vrīhitilāṃstathā ।
maṇḍapān yajñayūpāँśca samādāya sa bhūpatiḥ ।। 8 ।।
gatvā saṃśodhayāmāsa bhūmiṃ cakāra maṇḍapān ।
vedikā yajñakuṇḍāँśca sthāpayāmāsa cānalam ।। 9 ।।
juhāvā''jyāni havyāni toṣayāmāsa mādhavam ।
devān pitṝnṛṣīn viprāँstarpayāmāsa bhojanaiḥ ।। 1.562.1 0।।
dakṣiṇādipradānaiśca jīvān kaṇatṛṇādibhiḥ ।
asurāṇāṃ samavāyo vighnārthaṃ cāyayau tadā ।। 11 ।।
rājñā divyāstrasandhānairhato vidrāvitaśca saḥ ।
evaṃ pravartito yajño nirvighno vāsudānakaḥ ।। 1 2।।
āvabhṛthyodakaiḥ klinnā vasudhā hemanirmitā ।
babhūvurlulitā ye tu kardame mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ ।। 13 ।।
te hemavarṇakāstatra babhūvuḥ puṇyayogataḥ ।
yugapajjaladhārābhirbrahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 14।।
pūjitāstajjalaṃ caikībhūya prasravaṇātmakam ।
tathā snānodakaṃ sarvadevānāmṛṣibhiḥ kṛtam ।। 15 ।।
tatpravāho'pi militastatra prasravaṇe tadā ।
gavāṃ mutrapravāhāśca lakṣāṇāṃ tatra saṃgatāḥ ।। 16 ।।
bhakṣyabhojyādiśiṣṭānāṃ kṣīrājyānāṃ ca nirjharāḥ ।
homaprasādabhūtānāṃ dugdhānāṃ ca pravāhakāḥ ।। 17।।
militā yajñanimne te pravāhā āpagātmakāḥ ।
kapilā nāma vai citrajalā saritprapāvanī ।। 18।।
narmadāṃ saṃgatā so'yaṃ rudrāvartaḥ pradeśakaḥ ।
devarṣimunibhiścitrajalānyālokya sā nadī ।। 1 9।।
kapileti kṛtā nāmnā dakṣiṇātoṣaṇottaram ।
varaṃ daduste rājñe vai kapilāsaṃgame ca ye ।।1.562.20 ।।
narmadāyāṃ prasnāsyanti drakṣyanti ca maheśvaram ।
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇa te'tra divyānaiḥ paraṃ padam ।।2 1 ।।
yāsyanti cāpi kīṭādyā ye mariṣyanti cātra vai ।
evaṃ varaṃ paraṃ datvā sarve yayurnijālayān ।। 22।।
vasudānaḥ kratuṃ kṛtvā'vadhyāyāṃ samupāgataḥ ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanādasya mucyate bhavabandhanāt ।।23 ।।
athā'bhūd viśravā rājā mathurāyā mahābalī ।
arundhatīprasūtāyā dākṣāyaṇyāḥ suto hi saḥ ।।24।।
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yayāvamarakaṇṭakam ।
snātvā dhyāne sthito rājā narmadāyāstaṭe yadā ।।25।।
tāvat paśyati madhyāhne pratīcyādityamaṇḍalāt ।
dvau sūryau pūrvadigbhāge gatau dvau dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ।।26।।
dvau pātālaṃ tathā cordhvaṃ dvau sūryau caṇḍarūpiṇau ।
kālaḥ saṃvartako vahniḥ prajajvālā'mbare tadā ।।27।।
raudrāśca dāruṇā vātā vavurvikṣobhakāriṇaḥ ।
digdāho bhūmikampaśca ulkāpātāśca dāruṇāḥ ।। 28।।
samabhavan tadā pṛthvyāṃ rājā dhyānādajāgarīt ।
tṛṣārto dāhasantapto jalaṃ pātuṃ tu narmadām ।। 29।।
yayau yāvattu tāvadvai jalaṃ kiñcinna vidyate ।
pravāho vilayaṃ yāto jalaṃ lebhe na kutracit ।।1.562.3 0।।
jalaṃ vinā'dya maraṇaṃ dhruvaṃ me cetyacintayat ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ sasmāra vai tadā ।। 31 ।।
oṃkāranāthaṃ sasmāra tāvad dadarśa puṣpitam ।
phalitaṃ patraśobhāḍhyaṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ suśākhinam ।।32।।
taddṛṣṭvā śītalāṃ chāyāṃ prāpya rājā sthiro'bhavat ।
śarīramamṛtaṃ jātaṃ tṛṣātāpo nyavartata ।।33।।
jīvitāśā'bhavat tasya tato rājā dadarśa ha ।
śayānaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ chāyāyāṃ dīptatejasam ।। 34।।
kubhāḥ pārśve ca catvārastasya tiṣṭhanti sodakāḥ ।
taṃ praṇamya sthito rājā viṣṇurūpaṃ dadarśa tam ।।35।।
suptaṃ dadarśa puruṣaṃ dvitīyaṃ tryambakaṃ śivam ।
tāvad dadarśa rājā'nyān surān devān munīṃstathā ।।36 ।।
tato dadarśa nārīṃ codvignāṃ rudhirasaṃplutām ।
vikīrṇamūrdhajāṃ kaṭyāṃ kanyāṃ bālaṃ nidhāya ca ।।37।।
sā covāca nṛpaṃ rājan stanyaṃ piba tṛṣāṃ tyaja ।
asmyahaṃ pṛthivī devī bālo me viśvasṛṭ hyajaḥ ।।38।।
kanyeyaṃ narmadā cāste ghaṭāste santi sāgarāḥ ।
kalpavṛkṣo vaṭaścāste vayaṃ sarve ciraṃsthirāḥ ।।3 9।।
akṣayāḥ pratikalpasthāḥ piba pānīyamādarāt ।
ityuktvā vilayaṃ yātā rājā dadarśa narmadām ।।1.562.40।।
sajalāṃ ca papau vāri viśravāstṛptimāgataḥ ।
kṛtvā tīrthaṃ yayau naijāṃ nagarīṃ mathurāṃ punaḥ ।।41 ।।
evaṃvidhaṃ nityatīrthaṃ vidyate nārmadaṃ jalam ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanāccāsya mucyate bhavabandhanāt ।।42।।
narmadādakṣiṇe tīre kapilāyāśca paścime ।
viṣṇostatra purī ramyā tīrthaṃ mokṣakaraṃ śubham ।।43।।
daityā vināśitāḥ pūrve viṣṇunā ca tataḥ param ।
tatrāgatya purī ramyā nirmitā viṣṇunā śubhā ।।44।।
kapilā paścimāyāṃ tu nīlagaṃgā pravidyate ।
tadantarā cakratīrthaṃ vāmanaṃ ca yugandharam ।।45।।
sudarśanaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ daityasūdanamityapi ।
viṣṇvāvartaṃ śivāvartaṃ lakṣmyāvartaṃ tathaiva ca । ।46।।
tatra snānena dānena hyanantaphalamaśnute ।
krośamātrapramāṇaṃ tad viṣṇukṣetraṃ prakīrtitam । ।47।।
tatra śrāddhena pitarastṛpyanti yānti mokṣaṇam ।
tatra japtaṃ tapastaptaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ।।48।।
śravaṇe dvādaśī puṇyā rohiṇyāmaṣṭamī śubhā ।
tatropoṣya jano bhakto viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।।49।।
kārtike vā'tha vaiśākhe hyupavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ ।
daśakoṭyupavāsānāṃ phalaṃ tatra labhejjanaḥ ।।1.562.50 ।।
pativratā tu yā nārī bhaktā nārāyaṇasya vai ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra prapūjayet ।।5 1 ।।
tasyāḥ śrībhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ saubhāgyaṃ śāśvataṃ divi ।
dhāmni dadāti lakṣmyāśca samaṃ tvānandapūritam ।।।52।।।
atra tīrthe dharmarājastairthikānāṃ samādare ।
arghadānāya cāyāti dharmatejovapurdharaḥ ।।53।।
pativratānāṃ caivāgre sthitvā pādau pravandate ।
pradṛśya vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ tataḥ paścānnivartate ।।54।।
dharmarājaṃ tadā pratyāgataṃ satye ca tāpasāḥ ।
brahmaṇo mānasāḥ putrā apṛcchannṛṣayaḥ khalu ।।55।।
kasmācca kāraṇāddharmapādacārī gataḥ svayam ।
prahasya dharmarājaśca prāha tān paramādbhutam ।।56।।
pativratānāṃ dīptiṃ ca dīptiṃ māsopavāsinām ।
vartate devatābhyaśca viśeṣā tena vai svayam ।।57।।
darśanārthaṃ gataścāsam aśaktāḥ kiṃkarā mama ।
sthātuṃ ca sannidhau teṣāṃ tataścāsaṃ gato'pyaham ।।58।।
evaṃ nārāyaṇasthalaṃ pāvanaṃ mokṣadaṃ sadā ।
vartate tatra deveśi! śravaṇādapi mokṣadam ।।59।।
śākalyasyā''śramaṃ yajñaparvatānnārmadaṃ taṭam ।
abhivyāpya vartate ca niḥsṛtā carukā nadī ।।1.562.60।।
tatrākhyātaṃ dāruvanaṃ gīyate sarvadaivataiḥ ।
śakreṇeṣṭaṃ purā tatra bṛhaspatipurodhasā ।।6 1 ।।
liṃgaṃ vyāghreśvaraṃ tatra vartate pāpanāśanam ।
babhrurnāma purā cāsīd rājā paramadhārmikaḥ ।।62।।
puṇḍravardhanavāsī ca cintayāmāsa vaiṣṇavaḥ ।
pituḥ kṣayāhe samprāpte śrāddhakāle tu vaiṣṇavam ।।63।।
śrāddhānnabhojinaṃ vipraṃ nā'vāpa sa ca bhūpatiḥ ।
saṃcintya viprabhojyārthaṃ pākamapsu vyanikṣipat ।।64।।
ṛgvedo mūrtimān vākyaṃ tadā prāha ca bhūpatim ।
gaccha rājan bharadvājaṃ yācasva brāhmaṇaṃ śubham ।।65।।
rājā yayau ca tacchrutvā bhāradvājāśramaṃ param ।
so'bhivādya namaskṛtya muniṃ prāha manogatam ।।66।।
maharṣe śrāddhakālo'yaṃ pitṝṇāṃ mama vartate ।
bhojaye'haṃ yathā vipraṃ tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi ।।67।।
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājo'bravīd vacaḥ ।
maharṣīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi tuṣṭānāmūrdhvaretasām ।।68।।
haṃsalomaśamukhyānāṃ yadi bhojayituṃ kṣamaḥ ।
kuru śrāddhaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ vai bhojayiṣyāma eva ca ।।69।।
dadyā hemamayaṃ pīṭhaṃ dadyā dhānyaṃ tathā vasu ।
madhudhenuṃ tathā divyāṃ payodhenuṃ tathaiva ca ।।1.562.70।।
dadhidhenuṃ ghṛtadhenuṃ śarkarādhenumityapi ।
guḍadhenuṃ vastradhenuṃ dhānadhenuṃ tathāpi vai ।।71 ।।
jaladhenuṃ svarṇadhenuṃ dvidalādhenumityapi ।
kārpāsadhenuṃ ca kapilāṃ savatsāṃ dhenumityapi ।।72।।
kaupīnaṃ cāgniśaucasya vastrasyāpi pradehi ca ।
bhāradvājavacaḥ śrutvā svīcakāra ca bhūpatiḥ ।।73।।
patnyai sarvaṃ gṛhe gatvā nyavedayacca bhāvataḥ ।
āmiṣaṃ kalpayitvā tu pitṛkāryaṃ pravartaye ।।74।।
śuddhena cāmiṣeṇaiva tarpayāmāsa tān pitṝn ।
āmiṣam ṛṣayo dṛṣṭvā kupitāścābruvaṃstadā ।।75।।
abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā karīṣāgnau viśed dvijaḥ ।
āmiṣasya prasaṃgena mūlanāśastvayā kṛtaḥ ।।76।।
babhruruvāca vedoktaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ na cānyathā ।
gomedho hayamedhaśca naramedhastathā'paraḥ ।।77।।
kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhaved yajño mayā dharmeṇa vai kṛtam ।
rājñastadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhāradvājo'bravīdidam ।।78।।
pitṝṇāṃ bhojane rājaँstvayā viprā nimantritāḥ ।
viprāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ santyāmiṣaṃ draṣṭuṃ ca notsukāḥ ।।।79।।
tasmāt tvayā'tra vai śrāddhe yogyaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ yataḥ ।
māṃsādo bhava pāpena vyāghro vyāghrī ca te priyā ।।1.562.80।।
vane varṣasahasraṃ tu vasudhāṃ vicariṣyathaḥ ।
evaṃ śrutvā rājapatnī sudharmākhyā'bravīd vacaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
kṣatradharmānugantā me yataḥ śaptaḥ patistvayā ।
pativratā ca nirdoṣā dharmiṣṭhā'haṃ tathaiva ca ।।।82।।
tato mayā'pi viprebhyo dīyate śāpa ulbaṇaḥ ।
bhaviṣyatha mahāghorā yūyaṃ vai brahmarākṣasāḥ ।।83।।
nirjale marudeśe ca tṛṣākṣudhātiduḥkhitāḥ ।
bhāradvājastadā śīghraṃ yayau brahmāṇameva ca ।।84।।
sarvaṃ nyavedayat tatra śāpakāraṇamityapi ।
brahmā prāha ca vedoktaṃ jātyuktaṃ cāpi karma yat ।।85।।
na syāccellokasammānyaṃ naiva kuryāt kadācana ।
vedoktaṃ lokasammānyaṃ hṛdgamyaṃ cāpi yadbhavet ।।86।।
tatkāryaṃ sukhadaṃ syādvai na tvekānugataṃ sukham ।
astu jātaṃ tu tajjātaṃ nistāraṃ vacmi putraka ।।87।।
vyāghrarūpo'pi rājarṣiḥ rājñī viprāśca rākṣasāḥ ।
prayāntu narmadātīraṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ muniṃ prati ।।88।।
ityukto munirāḍ bhāradvājo nītvā ca bhūsurān ।
vyāghraṃ vyāghrīṃ rākṣasāṃstān yayau mārkaṇḍakaṃ munim ।।89।।
tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā prītyā jagaduḥ śāpakāraṇam ।
muktyarthaṃ prārthayāmāsustaṃ muniṃ pitaraṃ yathā ।।1.562.90।।
tvaṃ pitā no guruścāpi harirdhātā svayaṃ śivaḥ ।
pāpāduddhara ghorācca janmato ghorayonitaḥ ।।9 1 ।।
mārkaṇḍeyastadovāca śākalyasyā''śramo'sti vai ।
vaidūryātpaścime bhāge yatra yajñāstvanekaśaḥ ।।92।।
jātāstatra ca pāvanyāṃ bhūmau yāntu maheśvaram ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ cāpi pūjayantu vratasthitāḥ ।।93।।
japadhyānaparā nityaṃ tapaścograṃ tapantvapi ।
kandamūlaphalāhārāḥ santiṣṭhantu tathā sati ।।94।।
narmadāsnānaniratā devapūjāparāyaṇāḥ ।
śīghraṃ śāpavinirmuktā bhavantaḥ saṃbhavantviti ।।95।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
japantu cākṣaraṃ mantraṃ śīghraṃ bhavantviti ।।96।।
ityuktāste yayustatra jāpaṃ cakrurmuhurmuhuḥ ।
sasnuste narmadātoye papustepuḥ paraṃ tapaḥ ।।97।।
māsāntare ca tatraiva divyayānasthito hariḥ ।
āyayau śāpanāśārthaṃ divyalakṣmīyutaḥ prabhuḥ ।।98।।
vyāghrarevāsaṃgame ca viprān vimucya śāpataḥ ।
vyāghraṃ vyāghrīṃ tathā śāpād vimucya bhagavān svayam ।।99।।
yayau naijaṃ paraṃ dhāma rājā rājñī ca bhūsurāḥ ।
yayurnaijān gṛhān paścāt kālāntare ca te yayuḥ ।। 1.562.10 0।।
vaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ dhāma muktā mantraprabhāvataḥ ।
śravaṇātkīrtanādasyā'pyaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 101 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kapilārevāsaṃgama-viśravātīrtha-viṣṇupurīcakratīrtha-dāruvanavyāghreśatīrthānāṃ setihāsaṃnirūpaṇanāmā dvāṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 5.162 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 562 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 563
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 564 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
bhagavan madhudhenvādi kathaṃ deyaṃ ca me vada ।
kiṃ puṇyaṃ ko vidhistatra godānaṃ ca kiyad bhavet ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi purā rājā'bhavanmahān ।
vinītāśveti vikhyāto bahuyāgakaraḥ prabhuḥ ।। 2 ।।
sa sarvamedhamārebhe tena gāvo dvipā vasu ।
svarṇaṃ sarvaṃ ca viprebhyo dattāni bhavanāni ca ।। 3 ।।
nā'nnaṃ tena tadā dattaṃ svalpaṃ matvā jalaṃ tathā ।
atha gaṃgātaṭe mṛtvā sa kālena yayau divam ।। 4 ।।
tasya deho mṛttikāyāṃ nikṣipto gahvare dvijaiḥ ।
puṇyāṃ gaṃgāmṛdaṃ jñātvā pṛthvyāṃ nihita eva ha ।। 5 ।।
athā'yaṃ bhūpatiḥ svarge kṣudhitastṛṣitastathā ।
divyavimānavāso'pi pṛthvyāṃ bhojyārthamāyayau ।। 6 ।।
yatra kalevaraṃ naijaṃ tat khanitvā cakhāda saḥ ।
hotānāmnā tadā rājñaḥ purohito dadarśa tam ।। 7 ।।
khādantaṃ nijadehaṃ ca papraccha kiṃ karoṣi vai ।
rājā prāha na me svarge bhojanaṃ copatiṣṭhati ।। 8 ।।
vadā'tra kāraṇa me kiṃ śrutvā hotā hyuvāca tam ।
hotā prāha tvayā pūrvaṃ jalānnānāṃ pradānakam ।। 9 ।।
svalpaṃ matvā kṛtaṃ naiva tenā'mṛtaṃ na cāpyate ।
atra karmakṣitau yadyat kṛtaṃ dattamavāpyate ।। 1.563.1 0।।
na dattaṃ nopatiṣṭheta tasmād dehi jalānnakam ।
tiladhenuṃ śubhāṃ dehi jaladhenuṃ ca satama ।। 11 ।।
ghṛtadhenuṃ rasadhenuṃ dadhidhenuṃ pradehi ca ।
dugdhadhenuṃ madhudhenuṃ śarkarādhenumityapi ।। 12।।
annadhenuṃ vrīhidhenuṃ svarṇagāṃ ca pradehi vai ।
vastradhenuṃ kapilāṃ ca savatsāṃ saṃpradehi ca ।। 1 3।।
evamanyāni dānāni dehi tatphalamāpnuhi ।
annadānena ca svarge kṣudhayā varjito bhaveḥ ।। 14।।
vidhānaṃ tiladhenośca tvaṃ śṛṇuṣva narādhipa ।
caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiścātra prastha ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ।। 15।।
dhenuḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kāryā caturbhirvatsikā bhavet ।
nāsā gandhamayī tasyā jihvā guḍamayī śubhā ।।16।।
pucchaṃ sūtramayaṃ tasyā vastrayugmaṃ tu śullarī ।
netre muktāmaye dantā phalātmakāśca kambalam ।। 17।।
galakambalarūpaṃ ca navanītamayāḥ stanāḥ ।
svarṇaśṛgīṃ raupyakhurāṃ ghaṇṭā''bharaṇabhūṣitām ।। 18।।
kāṃsyadohāṃ caturthāṃśavatsikāsahitāṃ śubhām ।
kṛṣṇājīnayutāṃ sarvaratnayuktā ca nanditām ।। 1 9।।
sarvauṣadhisamāyuktāṃ mantrapūjāṃ tu dāpayet ।
annaṃ me jāyatāmanyatpānaṃ sarvarasāstathā ।।1.563.20।।
sarvaṃ sampādayā'smākaṃ tiladheno namo'stu te ।
śarkarāsahitāṃ tvāṃ pradadāmi vipramūrtaye ।।21।।
evaṃ dattāṃ vidhānena gṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇottamaḥ ।
haste pucchaṃ jalaṃ cāpi puṣpaṃ tandulamityapi ।।22।।
gandhaṃ gṛhītvā netre ca saṃspṛśya gā samarpayet ।
gomayaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā dātā dadyād vidhānataḥ ।।23।।
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ kṛtvā dadyād dvijātaye ।
dvijo'haṃ tvāṃ pragṛhṇāmi kuṭumbārthaṃ subhaktimān ।।24।।
bhajasva kāmān māṃ devi tiladheno namo'stu te ।
dātre sarvaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ pānādi dehi yatra saḥ ।।25।।
evaṃ dhenuḥ pradātavyā tena bhuktiśca mokṣaṇam ।
hotā prāha tathā dehi jaladhenuṃ vidhānataḥ ।। 26।।
gocarmamātraṃ bhūbhāgaṃ gomayenopalepayet। ।
tatra vāripūritaṃ taṃ ghaṭaṃ pūjyā'kṣatādibhiḥ ।।27।।
taṃ dhenuṃ kalpayitvaiva durvāsragbhirvibhūṣitam ।
pañcaratnayutaṃ kṛtvā saptadhānyayutaṃ tathā ।। 28।।
godhūmāstaṇḍulāścāpi yavāśca caṇakāstathā ।
māṣā mudgāśca kaṃgvaśca saptadhānyamiti nyaset ।। 29।।
ghṛtapātraṃ dadhipātraṃ madhupātraṃ ca śarkarām ।
sthāpayedvai caturdikṣu tathā cāsye suvarṇakam ।।1.563.3 0।।
muktāphale cakṣuṣī ca śṛṃge candanakāṣṭhaje ।
tāmrapṛṣṭhaṃ kāṃsyadohaṃ darbhān romāṇi kalpayet ।।3 1।।
tāmrapatraśravaṇe ca pucchaṃ sutramayaṃ tathā ।
kambale puṣpamālāṃ ca guḍāsyāṃ śuktidantikām ।।32।।
jihvāṃ śarkarayā kṛtvā navanītena ca stanān ।
ikṣupādāँstathā kṛtvā gandhapuṣpopaśobhitām ।।33।।
kṛṣṇājinopari nyasya vastreṇā''cchāditāṃ tu tām ।
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya pūrvamukhāṃ samarpayet ।।34।।
sādhuviprāya rājendra śrotriyāyā''hitāgnaye ।
tapovṛddhāya pātrāya dātavyā ca kuṭumbine ।। 35।।
yo dadāti naro rājan yaḥ paśyati śṛṇoti ca ।
pratigṛhṇāti yo vipro mucyate sarvapātakāt ।।36।।
brahmahā pitṛhā goghnaḥ surāpo gurutalpagaḥ ।
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaistu viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ।।37।।
jaladhenvā vatsikāṃ ca kalaśe kalpayecchubhām ।
jalāhārastvekadinaṃ tiṣṭhedvai jaladhenudaḥ ।। 38।।
grāhako'pi trirātraṃ ca tiṣṭhejjalena dharmavān ।
yatra kṣīravahā nadyo madhupāyasakardamāḥ ।।3 9।।
yatra tvapsarasāṃ gītaṃ tatra yānti jalapradāḥ ।
yadvā pāpavinirmuktā viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyuḥ ।।1.563.40।।
atha dadyād rasadhenumaikṣavasya rasasya vai ।
ghaṭaṃ prapūrya saṃpūjya pūrvavad vatsikāṃ tathā ।। 41 ।।
caturthāṃśā kalpayitvā saptavrīhisamanvitām ।
sarvopaskarasaṃyuktāṃ tilapātrādisayutām ।।42।।
dātā ca grāhakaścāpi tvekakālayabhojanaḥ ।
somapānaphalaṃ tasya paśyato'pi tathā phalam ।।43।।
daśa pūrvān parāṃścāpi svātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam ।
prāpayetparamaṃ sthānaṃ svargānnāvartate punaḥ ।।44।।
dadasva ca mahārāja paraṃ sthānamavāpnuhi ।
guḍadhenuṃ tathā kṛtvā savatsāṃ kāṃsyadohinīm ।।45।।
sauvarṇaṃ mukhaśṛṃge ca dantāśca maṇimauktikaiḥ ।
grīvā ratnamayī tvasyā ghrāṇaṃ gandhamayaṃ tathā ।।46 ।।
śṛṃge tvagurukāṣṭhena pṛṣṭhaṃ tāmramayaṃ tathā ।
pucchaṃ kṣaumamayaṃ tasyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ।।47।।
ikṣupādāṃ raupyakhurāṃ kambalaṃ paṭṭasūtrakam ।
ācchādya paṭṭasūtreṇa ghaṇṭācāmaraśobhitām ।।48।।
praśastapatraśravaṇāṃ navanītastanīṃ vratī ।
phalaiḥ saṃśobhayitvā ca dadyād viprāya bhāvataḥ ।।49।।
gandhapūṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā dattvā chatraṃ ca pāduke ।
guḍadheno pradattā tvaṃ sarvasampatpradā bhava ।।।1.563.50।।
dānādasmācca me mātarbhakṣyabhojyaṃ prayaccha vai ।
vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasā yad vicintitam ।।51 ।।
mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāgo'rthe hyudāhṛtam ।
anṛtaṃ nāśamāyātu guḍadheno dvijārpitā ।।52।।
guḍadhenoḥ pradānāttu saubhāgyamakhilaṃ labhet ।
daśa dvādaśasāhasrā daśa cāṣṭau ca janmasu ।।53।।
na śokaduḥkhadaurgatyaṃ tasya saṃjāyate kvacit ।
tadvaśca śarkarādhenuṃ dehi bhāracatuṣṭayam ।।54।।
savatsikāṃ vibhūṣāḍhyāṃ prapūjya pūrvavad vratī ।
gāṃ pūrvābhimukhīṃ kṛtvā vatsāmuttarato nyaset ।।55।।
haste tu dakṣiṇāṃ datvā gandhapuṣpāḍhyacandanām ।
dhenuṃ samarpayet tasya mukhaṃ ca na vilokayet ।।56 ।।
ekāhaṃ śarkarāhāro brāhmaṇastridinaṃ vaset ।
sarvakāmasamṛddhastu jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।57।।
madhudhenuṃ pravakṣyāmi sapātakanāśinam ।
dhenuṃ madhumayīṃ kṛtvā sampūrṇaghaṭaṣoḍaśām ।।58।।।
caturthena tathāṃśena vatsikā parikalpayet ।
pūrvoktāṃgaiḥ samāyuktāṃ saptadhānyānvitāṃ tathā ।।।59।।
tilapātracatuṣṭyenānvitāṃ puṣpapūjitām ।
dravyabrāhmaṇasampattiṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ pratipādayet ।।1.563.60।।
prīyantāṃ pitaro devā madhudheno namo'stu tai+e ।
ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ devi kuṭumbārthe namo'stu te ।।6 1 ।।
datvā dānaṃ pāyasena madhunā ca dinaṃ nayet ।
yatra nadyo madhuvahāstatra gacchanti dhenudā ।।62।।
daśapūrvān daśa parānātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam ।
nayate viṣṇusāyujyaṃ madhudhenupradānataḥ ।।63।।
kṣīradhenuṃ ca te vacmi tāṃ nibodha pradehi ca ।
gomayairliptabhūbhāge kuśeṣu mṛgacarmaṇi ।।64।।
gorekhāṃ paritaḥ kṛtvā kṣīrakuṃbhaṃ nyasecchubham ।
vatsākhyaṃ kalaśaṃ cāpi pūrvoktāṃgāni sarvathā ।।65।।
vastūni nyasya dhānyāni tilapātrāṇi dikṣu ca ।
vinyasya pūjitāṃ dadyāt kṣīradhenuṃ dvijāya vai ।।66।।
dīyamānāṃ prapaśyanti te'pi yānti parāṃ gatim ।
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasraṃ tu cendraloke mahīyate ।।67।।
pitrādibhistu sahito brahmaṇo bhavanaṃ vrajet ।
tato yāti paraṃdhāma viṣṇurūpadharo bhavan ।।68।।
dadhidhenuḥ pradātavyā dadhikuṃbhātmikāṃ śubhām ।
saptadhānyānvitāṃ vatsāyutāṃ śṛṃgāritāṃ tathā ।।69।।
pūjitāṃ maṇḍitāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya daded vratī ।
ekāhārī vratī syāt tridinaṃ tiṣṭhettu vai dvijaḥ ।।1.563.70।।
dadhnā tena paraṃ lokaṃ yāti dātā'rthitā'pi ca ।
navanītamayīṃ dhenuṃ dadyād vatsāyutāṃ śubhām ।।7 1 ।।
pūrvavatsarvaśobhāḍhyāṃ sarvāṃgaparikalpitām ।
pūjitāṃ dhānyayuktāṃ ca brāhmaṇāya samarpayet ।।72।।
purā devāsuraiḥ sarvaiḥ sāgarasya tu manthane ।
utpannaṃ divyamamṛtaṃ navanītamidaṃ śubham ।।73।।
āpyāyanaṃ tu bhūtānāṃ navanīta! namostu te ।
lavaṇadhenuṃ vakṣyāmi dātavyā śubhamicchatā ।।74।।
ṣoḍaśaprasthamānāṃ gāṃ vatsāṃ caturthapādikām ।
sarvaśṛṃgārasaṃyuktāṃ pūrvoktāṃgaprapūritām ।। 75।।
grahanakṣatrapīḍāyāṃ brāhmaṇāya pradāpayet ।
imāṃ gṛhāṇa bho vipra rudrarūpāṃ namo'stu te ।।76।।
kāmaṃ pūraya me devi! rūdrarūpe! namo'stu te ।
dinaṃ vratī lavaṇāśī trirātraṃ brāhmaṇo bhavet ।।77।।
atha kārpāsakīṃ dhenuṃ dadyāt sukhapraśāntidām ।
grahapīḍāsu cogrāsu duḥsvapne'riṣṭadarśane ।।78।।
puṇyeṣvāyataneṣveva dadyāt prāgvat subṛṃhitām ।
caturbhāramitenaiva kalpitāṃ vatsikāyutām ।।79।।
pūjitāṃ sopakaraṇāṃ sarvāṃgāṃ vai samarpayet ।
rakṣāṃ kuru mahādevi paratrā'tra namostu te ।।1.563.80 ।।
dhānyadhenuḥ pradātavyā vrīhidhenustathā śubhā ।
aṃgāni pūrvavat kṛtvā pūjāyitvā ca tāṃ tataḥ ।।8 1 ।।
dīpaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā prīyatāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ।
sarvalakṣmīmayīdheno dhānyarūpe namo'stu te ।।82।।
evamuccārya tāṃ dhenuṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ।
yāvacca pṛthivī sarvā vasuratnāni bhūpate ।।83।।
tāvatpuṇyaṃ samadhikaṃ vrīhidhenośca tatphalam ।
iha loke ca saubhāgyamāyurārogyavardhanam ।।84।।
vimānenā'rkavarṇena cānte yāti harergṛham!
athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kapilāṃ dhenumuttamām ।।85।।।
yatpradānājjano yāti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam ।
pūrvoktena vidhānena dadyād dhenuṃ savatsikām ।।86।।
sarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktāṃ sarvaratnādimaṇḍitām ।
kapilāyāḥ śiro grīvā sarvatīrthāni bhūpate ।।87।।
kapilā śiraso vāri prātaryo vandati sa ca ।
dagdhatriṃśajjanmapāpo bhavatyeva supuṇyavān ।।88।।
kalya pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryād bhūpradakṣiṇapuṇyadam ।
pradakṣiṇaikyaṃ nirdahed daśajanmotthapāpakam ।।89।।
kapilāmūtrasaṃsnāto yāvattīrthāpluto bhavet ।
gosahasreṇa tulyaṃ vai kapilādānamucyate ।। 1.563.90।।
mṛtabhasma ca jighrāti kapilā yāvadeva ha ।
tāvatpreto mahāpuṇyaiḥ pūryate divivāsakṛt ।। 91 ।।
gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ rakṣā gośatārpaṇasadṛśam ।
tṛṇodakādikaṃ dattaṃ gomedhaphaladaṃ matam ।। 12।।
suvarṇakapilā caikā dvitīyā gaurapiṃgalā ।
tṛtīyā cāpi raktākṣī caturthī guḍapiṃgalā ।।93।।
pañcamī bahuvarṇā syāt ṣaṣṭhī ca śvetapiṃgalā ।
saptamī śvetapiṅgākṣī tvaṣṭamī kṛṣṇapiṃgalā ।।94।।
navamī pāṭalā bodhyā daśamī pucchapiṃgalā ।
ekādaśī kṣuraśvetā tvetāsāṃ cottamā matā ।।95।।
kapilā hyagnihotrārthe yajñārthe ca surakṛte ।
uddhṛtya sarvatejobhirbrahmaṇā nirmitā purā ।।96।।
dānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ nidhīnāṃ hyetadakṣayam ।
hotavyānyagnihotrāṇi sāyaṃ prātardvijātibhiḥ ।। 7।।
kapilāyā ghṛteneha dadhnā kṣīreṇa sarpiṣā ।
nirvṛtyante'tithipūjādīni hūyanta iṣṭakāḥ ।।98।।
agnihotrāṇi mantraiśca vividhairbrahmavedibhiḥ ।
kapilā yā piṃgalākṣī sarvasaukhyapradāyinī ।।99।।
siddhibuddhipradā dhenuḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā ।
sarvāstāstārayantyeva dattā nadyoḥ samāgame ।। 1.563.1 00।।
agnipucchā cāgnimukhī cāgnilomā'nalaprabhā ।
tathā''gnāyī śvetakhurā suvarṇā nāma sā matā ।। 101 ।।
āsannaprasavāṃ dhenuṃ dānārthaṃ pratipālayet ।
jāyamānasya vatsasya mukhaṃ yonyāṃ pradṛśyate ।। 1 02।।
tāvat sā pṛthivī jñeyā yāvadgarbhaṃ na muñcati ।
kapilā'rdhaprasūtā sā dātavyā vaiṣṇavāya vai ।। 1 03।।
dhenvā yāvanti romāṇi savatsāyā bhavanti ca ।
tāvatyo varṣakoṭyastu brahmaloke vasanti te ।। 1 04।।
brāhmaṇasya kare datvā suvarṇaṃ pucchamityapi ।
udakaṃ ca kare datvā vācayet pradadet tathā ।। 1 05।।
samudravasanā tena saśailagrāmaśobhanā ।
ratnapūrṇā kṣitirdattā bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।। 1 06।।
dātā prayāti pitṛbhirviṣṇvākhyaṃ ca paraṃ padam ।
yaścobhayamukhīṃ dadyāt sarvapāpanivṛttaye ।। 10 7।।
taddine pāyasāhāro jalāhāro'thavā vaset ।
dadyādvai sudhanaṃ cāpi vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet ।। 1 08।।
imāṃ gṛhṇobhayamukhīmubhayatra śamastu vai ।
dade vaṃśavivṛddhyarthaṃ sadā svastikarī bhava ।। 10 9।।
pratigṛhṇāmi tvāṃ dheno kuṭumbārthe viśeṣataḥ ।
śubhaṃ bhavatu me nityaṃ devadhātri namo'stu te ।। 1.563.11 0।।
me nityaṃ svasti bhavatu viṣṇurūpe namo'stu te ।
oṃ dyaustvāṃ dadātu bhūmiṃ svayaṃ pratigṛhṇātvapi ।। 11 1।।
oṃ ka idṃ kasmai adāt brahma idaṃ brahmaṇe'dāt ।
ityuktvā vidhinā vipraṃ goyuktaṃ vai samarcayet। ।। 11 2।।
praṇamedanuyāyācca tāṃ dhenuṃ tadgṛhaṃ nayet ।
evaṃ dānena pṛthivīdānaṃ bhavenna saṃśayaḥ ।। 11 3।।
śrāddhakāle paṭhettasya pitaro'śnanti bhāvataḥ ।
amāyāṃ paṭhane varṣaśataṃ tṛpyanti pūrvajāḥ ।। 1 14।।
śrotuścāpi varṣakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyati dūrataḥ ।
māghaśukladvādaśyāṃ ca dvādaśyāṃ śrāvaṇe site ।। 1 15।।
kātikyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ vā dvādaśyāṃ vā viśeṣataḥ ।
sarvadā vā yathāyogyaṃ dānaṃ śrīgurave'rpayet ।। 1 16।।
brahmāṇḍodarabhūtāni tāni dattāni tena vai ।
athavā pīḍyase'tyantaṃ kṣudhayā tṛṣayā nṛpa ।। 1 17।।
vada te vaṃśajaṃ yaśca dānaṃ dadyāt tathāvidham ।
annānāṃ ca jalānāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ।। 1 18।।
dhenūrdadyācca teneva svargaṃ te bhojanaṃ bhavet ।
hotā caivaṃ tamuktvā ca badaryāśramamāyayau ।। 1 19।।
rājā nāmnā vinītāśvaḥ svavaṃśaṃ vaktumudyataḥ ।
yayau tataśca dānādi vaṃśajena kṛtāni vai ।। 1.563.1 20।।
tena muktiṃ gato rājā śāśvate brahmaṇaḥ pade ।
śaṃkareṇa tathā lakṣmi! pārvatyai kathitā kathā ।। 121 ।।
mayā te'troditā samyag bhuktimuktipradā yataḥ ।
paṭhanāchravaṇāccāsyā gopradānakṛtaṃ phalam ।। 122।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvādaśarasādidhenukapilādhenudānādividhiśravaṇaṃ vinītāśvenarājā kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 563 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 564
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 565 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ! śaṃkareṇoditāni narmadātaṭe ।
kapilāmarayormadhye narmadoṃkāramadhyataḥ ॥ 1 ॥
koṭitīrthāni santyeva yatra kvāpi janaścaret।
rājānaste prajāyante śubhe vaidyādhare pure ॥ 2 ॥
dīyate koṭitīrthe yad guṃjāmātraṃ hiraṇyakam ।
tasya saṃkhyā na vidyeta yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ॥ 3 ॥
sūtreṇa veṣṭayed yastu yajñaśailaṃ ca parvasu ।
sūtrayugasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ॥ 4 ॥
putriṇī bhartṛsaṃyuktā nārī tadveṣṭinī bhavet।
kauśeyaṃ paṭṭasūtraṃ ca kārpāsaṃ va mahojjvalam ॥ 5 ॥
navatantuṃ ca yaḥ kuryād daśadvādaśatantukam ।
aṣṭādaśaguṇaṃ vāpi caturviṃśatitantukam ॥ 6 ॥
nyagrodhe bandhayet sūtram ṛṇāpākaraṇaṃ bhavet ।
oṃkāraṃ veṣṭayedvā yaḥ kailāsaṃ vindate hi saḥ ॥ 7 ॥
saphala: sūtrayāgaḥ syād yatīn saṃbhojayet tataḥ ।
yaḥ śārīreṇa kaṣṭena paryaṭecchivaparvatam ।। 8 ॥
pade pade yajñaphalaṃ tasya syācchaṃkaro'bravīt ।
kariṇīrūpamāsthāya svayaṃ sarasvatī sarit ।। 9 ॥
snātumāyāti tu koṭitīrthe snātvā prayāti ca ।
kāverīsaṃgamād yāvadudadheḥ saṃgamo'sti hi ॥1.564.10॥
atrāntare tīrthakoṭyo narmadāyāṃ vasanti vai ।
kāverīparyaṃkaśailamadhye tu daśalakṣakam ।। 11 ।।
narmadāyāṃ samāsādya jamadagnermahāśramam ।
śrīkaṇṭhaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ ca kanyātīrthe pravartate ॥12।।
sūryapiṃgalaliṃgaṃ ca nārāyaṇasya mandiram ।
lakṣmītīrtha satītīrthe vartate pāpanāśanam ॥13॥
mokṣado vai giriḥ puṇyaḥ sarvato'marakaṇṭakaḥ ।
kāveryāṃ snānamātreṇa janā yānti parāṃ gatim ।।14।।
kuberatapasā yā vai kauberī nāmato'bhavat ।
sā kāverīti saṃproktā pitruddhārakarī nadī ॥15॥
nānāmukhasahasraistu kāverī tāriṇī matā !
narmadā dakṣiṇe kūle vārāhe vindhyaparvate ॥16॥
payoṣṇī nirgatā candraputrī śītā'tipāvanī ।
vārāhaśarīrājjātā somagaṃgā ca tāriṇī ॥17॥
tatra snātvā jano bhaktyā bhave vai na punarbhavat ।
payoṣṇīsaṃgame tatra somāvarttaḥ pradeśakaḥ ॥18॥
tatra snānasya dānasya saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate ।
tāpīpayoṣṇīsaṃbheda: kurukṣetrācchatādhikaḥ ॥19॥
phaladaḥ śrīhrariryatra śrīpati: puruṣottamaḥ ।
virājate praśastaṃ tadviṣṇukṣetraṃ prakīrtyate ॥1.564.20॥
kārtikyāṃ dīpadāne tu cakravartī bhavennṛpaḥ ।
revāṃ bhittvā caṇḍavegānāmnī nadī viniḥsṛtā ॥21॥
tatra snātvā brahmahatyādikapāpaṃ vinaśyati ।
caṇḍeśvaro mahādevastatra tiṣṭhati pāpahrā ॥22ll
candrasenaḥ somavaṃśī purā''sīt pāpakṛnnṛpaḥ ।
paradārarataścauro madirāpānakṛddhi sa: {{23||
naimiṣāraṇyavāsasya śāṇḍilyasya tu bhāminīm ।
nāmnā saudāminīṃ rūpayauvanādyanvitāṃ satīm ।24।।
candraseno dadarśaināṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇīm |
uvāca me bhava patnī bhuṃkṣva bhogāṃśca puṣkalān ll25ll
śrutvā saudāminī prāha yācasva me patiṃ nṛpa ।
śāṇḍilyaṃ paripapraccha rājā tasyāṃ sumohitaḥ ॥26॥
yauvanasthāṃ ca patnīṃ te cedadya tvaṃ dadasva me ।
maulye dadāmi te dravyamasyāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ॥27॥
ṛṣiḥ prāha striyo rājan chalamūlā hi sarvaśaḥ ।
na ca tāsāṃ priyaḥ kaścid yathecchasi tathā kuru ॥28॥
kāmāndhaśca tadā rājā kare jagrāha tāṃ satīm ।
sā tu kopānnṛpaṃ prāha bhavāmyadya rajasvalā ॥29॥
mama sparśādadya dine caṇḍālastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
prathame'hani cāṇḍālīsamā raja:plutā matā ॥1.564.30ll
ityukto'pi haṭhāttāṃ vai pasparśa sva kare punaḥ ।
tāvāccāṇḍālatāṃ prāpto rājā sarvabhayāvahaḥ ॥31॥
rūparaṃgavihīnaśca kṛṣṇavarṇo'bhavat kṣaṇāt ।
rājā tāṃ ca satīṃ tyaktvā yayau svanagaraṃ prati ।।32।।
avadhyāvāsinaścāhuḥ rājaputraḥ kathaṃ vane ।
gataścāṇḍālatāṃ prāpta ityāścaryaparā mithaḥ ॥33॥
vasiṣṭhastu nṛpaṃ prāha yāhi tāṃ prati vai punaḥ ।
kṣamāṃ yācasva gatvaiva sarvaṃ śāntaṃ bhaviṣyati ॥34||
rājā jagāma tāṃ natvā ṛṣiṃ natvā punaḥ kṣamām ।
yācayāmāsa ca muhustadā cāhaturdampatī ॥35॥
rājan śīghraṃ prayāhi tvaṃ caṇḍavegāsamāgamam ।
caṇḍeśvaraṃ hariṃ tatrā'bhyarcya snātvā hyavāpsyasi ॥36॥
pāpasya mokṣaṇaṃ ceti śrutvā rājā yayau nadīm ।
caṇḍavegāṃ ca rekhāṃ va tatra snātvā haraṃ harim ॥37॥
pupūja parayā bhaktayā niṣpāpaśca babhūva saḥ ।
ante mukto babhūvā'pi caṇḍavegāprabhāvataḥ ॥38॥
divyayānasamārūḍho yayau vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanāñcāpi ghorapāpaṃ vinaśyati ॥39॥
atha tīrthaṃ paraṃ cānyaderaṇḍīnarmadāgamaḥ ।
eraṇḍīśvaraliṃgaṃ ca vartate pāpanāśanam ॥1.564.40॥
kuṃkumena samālipya gandhapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ।
divyavarṣasahsraṃ tu modate śivasannidhau ॥41॥
bhadrarudrau purā kalpe sugandharvau babhūvatuḥ ।
tamabhyarcya vidhānena gatau vaidyādharaṃ puram ।42॥
bhadreśvaraṃ tathā rudreśvaraṃ saṃsthāpya svargatau ।
atha pitṛpratṛptyarthe durvāsā munirāṭ kvacit ॥43॥
babhrāma sarvatīrthāni tato gayāmupāyayau ।
piṇḍān dadau tathā vāri dadau phalāni vai rasān ॥44॥
dadau kuśatilaॉstatra kintu vai pitarastadā ।
na dṛṣṭā tena muninā tadā prāha munīn svayam ॥45॥
kare grahṇanti pitaraḥ piṇḍānīha mayā śrutam ।
tadadya bho na paśyāmi tīrthayātrā nirarthikā ॥46॥
śrutvā tanmunayaḥ prāhuḥ pratīkṣā'mādinaṃ mune ।
kare grahṇanti pitaraḥ piṇḍān darśe prakalpitān ||47।।
durvāsā darśaparyantaṃ tasthau tatra hi śraddhayā ।
avāsṛjattataḥ piṇḍāँstathāpi pitaraḥ khalu ||48ll
mūrtimanto nā''yayuśca durvāsāstu tadā punaḥ ।
eraṇḍanāmakaṃ tatra tapantaṃ prāha vai munim ॥49॥
nā'tra te syādarthasiddhirāgaccha vai mayā saha ।
ityuktvā munimeraṇḍaṃ saha nītvā ca nārmade ॥1.564.50॥
tīre tasthau samāgatya ऑkāre'marakaṇṭake ।।
tatra sasmāra ca pitṝn brahmā sākṣāt samāyayau ॥51।।
gṛhāṇā'rpitamevā'tra piṇḍaṃ tuṣṭo'bhavattadā ।
dadau vāri svayaṃ brahmā tṛpto nārmadvāriṇā ॥52॥
brahmāṇā'rpitavārthaiva durvāsā।
eraṇḍako muniścāpi dadhāra śirasā tadā ॥53॥
brahmakamaṇḍaluvāri eraṇḍamastakād bhuvi ।
patitaṃ tatpravāhaśca narmadāyā jale gataḥ ॥54॥
amāyāṃ somavāre cairaṇḍarevāsamāgame ।
tīrthe parva mahajjātaṃ pitruddhārakaraṃ param ॥55॥
brahmā tuṣṭo varadānaṃ dadāveraṇḍikātaṭe ।
adṛśyāḥ pitarastṛptiṃ darśe yāsyanti śāśvatīm ॥56॥
gayāyāmapi cādṛśyāstṛptiṃ yāsyanti śāśvatīm ।
vaiṣṇavebhyaḥ pavitrebhyo brahmavratebhya ityapi ॥57॥
niṣpāpebhyo mānavebhyaḥ śuddhahaddhayastu sarvadā ।
dṛṣṭipathaṃ prayāsyanti pitarau nānyathā kvacit ॥58॥
evameraṇḍikātīrtha revāsaṃgamagaṃ hyabhūt ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanādasyoddhāraḥ syāt pitṛtīrthinaḥ ॥59॥
tatastīrthaṃ paraṃ cānyad revāśakhyaviśalyayoḥ ।
bharatena kṛto yajño yatra śalyā viśalyakā ॥1.564.60॥
nadīdvayaṃ samudbhūtaṃ viveśa nārmadaṃ jalam ।
āsurā vighnakartāro yuyudhurbharatena vai ॥61॥
bharatenā''surā bāṇairnāśitā bahavastadā ।
bharatasya bhaṭānāṃ ca śalyapīḍānivṛttaye ॥62॥
yūpamūlānnadī jātā viśalyā śalyakarṣiṇī ।
tatra snātvā bharatādyā yajñanārāyaṇehayā ॥63।।
vipīḍāste viśalyāśca babhūvuḥ sarvaśo'naghāḥ ।
tena śalyā viśalyā ca nadīdvayaṃ prakīrtyate ॥64॥
pravāhadvayarūpaṃ tannarmadāyāṃ samāhatam |
etattīrthaṃ paraṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanaṃ nārmade taṭe ॥65॥
svāyaṃbhuve'ntare prāpte tvādikalpe kṛte yuge ।
dānavairnirjitā devā narmadātīramāśritāḥ ॥66॥
te devā brahmasahitā īśvaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ।
bṛhaspatistataḥ prāha brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam ॥67॥
iṣṭiṃ kuru mahāraudrīṃ dānavānāṃ kṣayaṃkarīm ।
etasminnantare devā yayuste nārmadaṃ taṭam ॥68॥
bhitvā bhuvaṃ tadā liṃgaṃ samutthitaṃ mahojjvalam ।
auṃkāraṃ saṃvadat tatra bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca kīrtayat ॥69॥
parvatādutthitaṃ so'pi auṃkāragirirucyate ।
uvāca vacanaṃ śaṃbhuḥ sākṣād bhūtvā pitāmaham ॥1.564.70॥
iṣṭiṃ kuru mahāraudrīṃ daityānāṃ prakṣayaṃkarīm ।
tato brahmā cakāreṣṭiṃ devānāṃ śāntikāriṇīm ॥71॥
ityādyāstadbhayād bhagnā jagmuste tu rasātalam ।
oṃkārasya prabhāveṇa devā jātāśca nirbhayāḥ ।।79॥
oṃkāraṃ śaṃkaraṃ prārcya yayurdivaṃ surādayaḥ ।
kalpāntagaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ parvatāgre virājate ॥73॥
pañcabrahma pañcavaktraṃ navaśaktisamanvitam ।
śaṃkhakundendusaṃkāśaṃ sadyo vaktraṃ tu paścimam ॥74॥
ṛgvedo nirgato yasmād brahmā tatrādhidevatā ।
uttaraṃ vāmadevaṃ tu pītābhaṃ sumanoharam ।।75।।
yajurvedodbhavaṃ viddhi viṣṇustatrā'dhidevatā ।
aghoraṃ meghavarṇābhaṃ yāmyāṃ diśi samasthitam ॥76॥
sāmavedodbhavaṃ viddhi sūryakālādaivatam ।
pūrve tatpuruṣaṃ jñeyaṃ kuṃkumāruṇasannibham ॥77॥
atharvaṃ nirgataṃ turyamāpastatrā'dhidevatāḥ ।
īśānestavavaktraṃ tu pañcavarṇaṃ mahātanum ॥78॥
śrutisiddhāntasaṃgītaṃ somaṃ tatrādhidevatā ।
ṣaṣṭhaṃ sadāśivaṃ nāma nirbhāgaṃ ca nirāmayam ॥79॥
etatte kathitaṃ sarvamoṃkārasya tu varṇanam ।।
oṃkāradakṣiṇāmūrtiṃ pūjayenmokṣamāpnuyāt ॥1.564.80॥
dadyād gṛhasya sāmagrī: pūjopakaraṇāni ca ।
jīrṇoddhārādikaṃ dhvajadaṇḍaghaṇṭādi kārayet ॥81॥
vastrabhūṣāmṛdaṃgādi dadyādoṃkāramūrtaye ।
udyānavāṭikākṣetrādīni tasmai nivedayet ॥82॥
tasya dānaphalasyeha saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate ।
dātā bhuktiṃ tathā muktiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ ॥83॥
dhundhumāro'bhavadrājā devatā'tithipūjakaḥ ।
yayau vindhyācalaṃ revāvanaṃ viveśa tatra ca ॥84॥
vārāhaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ sa garjantaṃ pradadarśa ha ।
hantuṃ taṃ yāvad yatate tāvat kroḍo'pi tatkṣaṇam ॥l85ll
viveśa jalamadhye ca koṭitīrthe'tha taṃ tathā ।
praviśyantaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nujagāma so'pi bhūpatiḥ ॥86॥
tāvat kroḍo divyadeho bhūtvā vimānamāsthitaḥ ।
taṃ ca tathāvidhaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā papraccha kāraṇam ।।87॥
divyarūpadharo devo varāhaścāha bhūbhṛtam ।
ahaँ śaṃbhugaṇo nāmnā hyaṃgado'smi sugāyakaḥ ॥88॥
dṛṣṭvorvaśīṃ ca raṃbhāṃ cā'pyabhūvaṃ kāmamohitaḥ ।
vyāharan śūkarīṃ vāṇīṃ kāmakrīḍāmayo'bhavam ॥89॥
nandī śaśāpa māṃ dṛṣṭvā śūkaro'raṇyake bhava ।
mayā prasādito nandī śāpāntaṃ varamādiśat ।।1.564.90।।
darśanād dhundhumārasya koṭitīrthaniṣevaṇāt ।
tyaktvā tu saukarīṃ yoniṃ kailāsaṃ cāgamiṣyasi ॥11॥
evamuktvā svasti te'stu samucārya yayau gaṇaḥ ।
rājā śilātale tatra niṣasād kṣaṇaṃ tataḥ ।।92।।
rājño hayo narmadāyā jalapānaṃ samākarot ।
tāvat so'pyabhavad divyo vimānastho'mbare'bhavat ll93ll
dvijo bhūtvā'bravīd bhūpaṃ gālavo'haṃ purā'bhavam ।
brahmarṣiḥ kaurave kṣetre vājidānapratigrahāt ॥94॥
dagdho vājitanuṃ prāpya revāyogena mokṣaṇam ।
prāpto'smi yāmi vai satyaṃ brahmalokaṃ mamālayam ॥95॥
mayā rājan purā rājño dumatsenāt pratigraha: ! (drumatsenāt, dyumatsenāt)
gṛhītaḥ kāraṇavaśācchṛṇu tatkathayāmi te ॥96॥
rājā madhyapradeśasya gajavājirathādikam ।
svarṇaratnāmbarābhūṣādikaṃ nītvā ravigrahe ।ll97ll
kurukṣetraṃ samāyāto dānārpaṇāya sarvathā ।
kintu viprā vimṛśyaiva rājño ghoraṃ pratigraham ॥98॥
na jagṛhustadā rājā sthānaṃ viprān nininda ca ।
abrahmaṇyamidaṃ sthānaṃ brahmahīnaṃ na yājanam ॥99॥
līnaṃ brahmabalaṃ sarvaṃ dānapātraṃ na vidyate ।
ā+ākarṇya nṛpatervākyaṃ mayā balaṃ pradarśitam ॥1.564.100॥
gālavo'haṃ dehi dānaṃ grahīṣye vidyate balam ।
rājā rājyopayogyāni dadau vastūni me tadā ॥101॥
ahaṃ rājasamo jāto rājyabhogasamanvitaḥ ।
rājā yayau tataścāhaṃ tyaktvā'gnihotra prabhṛti ।।102।।
vyacaraṃ bahubhogeṣu mṛtvā vāśvo'bhavaṃ tava ।
so'haṃ revājalenā'dya mukto'smyastu ca te śubham ।। 103॥
evamuktvā gālavastu yayau satyaṃ nijālayam ।
rājā vicārayāmāsa vinā'śvaṃ yāmi kutra vai ॥104॥
tāvat trinetrā yuvatī sākṣādāgatya cāha tam ।
asmyahaṃ kapilā nāmnī sarinnārmadavārigā ।।105॥
tvaṃ ca rājan mama vārṣuṃ snātvā jalaṃ pibā'tra me ।
rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ yāhi sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ ।106॥
yaṃ yaṃ cintayase kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoṣi suvrata ।
evamuktvā yayau cāntardhānaṃ sā kapilā nadī ॥107॥
praṇipatya ca bhūpastāṃ svapuraṃ prati saṃyayau ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanādastha mucyate bhavabandhanāt ॥ 108॥
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ tīrthamāhātmyaṃ śaṃkareṇa vai ।
śivāyai tanmayoktaṃ te lakṣmi ! mokṣapradaṃ param ।। 109।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne koṭitīrthe sūtraveṣṭanaṃ sūryapiṃgalaliṃgaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇālayaḥ, kāverīpayoṣṇīsomagaṃgācaṇḍavegāsaṃgamāḥ, candrasenasya caṇḍālatāmuktiḥ, eraṇḍīsaṃgamaḥ, śalyāviśalyāsaṃgamaḥ, dhundhumārasya vārāhatāmuktiḥ, gālavasya vājitāmuktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā vatu:ṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 1.564 ।।
