śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kena kena vidhānena janaḥ karmāṇi kārayet ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ gṛhastho'pi yena sāphalyamāpnuyāt ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu sarvaṃ kathayāmi gṛhastho'pi kriyāparaḥ ।
kāmalobhādiyukto'pi janmasārthakyamāpnuyāt ।। 2 ।।
mayi cittaṃ samāsthāya mamatā'haṃvivarjitaḥ ।
māṃ pradhārya sadā bhogye bhoktaryapi kṣamāparaḥ ।। 3 ।।
phalamūlāni śākāni payovratādi sañcaran ।
ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamī hyamāvāsyā tūbhayatra caturdaśī ।। 4 ।।
vratāhāni parvakālo dvādaśī śrāddhapūjanam ।
maithunaṃ nābhiseveta teṣu nimittakeṣvapi ।। 5 ।।
sarvaṃ kuryācca māṃ smṛtvā madarthaṃ cetkaroti vai ।
mayi yogavidhānena karma kuryād dṛḍhavrataḥ ।। 6 ।।
pūtātmā dharmasaṃyukto mayi snehaparāyaṇaḥ ।
na mlānirna jarā tasya na moho rāgamatsarau ।। 7 ।।
vyavadhānakarā yasya mamalokaṃ sa gacchati ।
ājīvanaṃ mama pūjāṃ kṛtvā dhāmni mahīyate ।। 8 ।।
etacchrutvā punarlakṣmīḥ papraccha puruṣottamam ।
kasmin kāle tava pūjā kathaṃ kāryā vadā'tra me ।। 9 ।।
kāle kāle ca deveśa kīdṛśaṃ karma te kṛte ।
kathaṃ saṃsthāpanaṃ te'trāvāhanaṃ ca visarjanam ।। 1.565.1 0।।
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ ca gṛhṇāsi vada me hare! ।
kathaṃ pādyaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca gṛhṇāsyapi vilepanam ।। 11 ।।
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ kandamūlaphalāni ca ।
kathaṃ gṛhṇāsi bhagavan kīdṛśaṃ cārpitaṃ śubham ।। 12।।
śaradi kīdṛśaṃ karma śiśire karma kīdṛśam ।
vasante kīdṛśaṃ karma grīṣme kiṃ karma te matam ।। 1 3।।
prāvṛṭkāle ca kiṃ karma varṣānte kīdṛśaṃ caret ।
yāni tatropabhogyāni puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca ।। 14।।
arcāyāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ te sthāpanaṃ kīdṛśaṃ matam ।
parimāṇaṃ kiyat tasyā upavāsaśca kīdṛśaḥ ।। 15।।
pītaṃ raktaṃ pāṭalaṃ vā'mbaraṃ gṛhṇāsi kīdṛśam ।
teṣāṃ hitakaraṃ vastraṃ kiṃrūpaṃ tava sammatam ।। 16।।
keṣu dravyeṣu sammiśraṃ madhuparkaṃ ca te matam ।
madhuparkasya dānasya puṇyaṃ guṇāśca kīdṛśāḥ ।। 17।।
keṣu lokeṣu gacchanti madhuparkasya bhakṣakāḥ ।
kimpramāṇaṃ pradātavyaṃ madhuparkādikaṃ purā ।। 18।।
kāni śākāni cānnāni peyānyapi priyāṇi te ।
kena mantravidhānena prāśanaṃ te pradīyate ।। 19।।
vrate tvāṃ pūjayitvā ca yathā syānnāparādhakaḥ ।
kathaṃ tathā vartitavyaṃ pūjāyāṃ sparśane tathā ।।1.565.20।।
kāni karmāṇi kurvīta tava bhaktasya bhojane ।
prāpaṇaṃ te kathaṃ kāryaṃ pātraṃ kīdṛśamucyate ।।21 ।।
prasādaṃ te ca ke loke bhuñjanti pāvanaṃ param ।
ye ca ekāśino bhaktā arcayanti ca keśavam ।।22।।
smaranti satataṃ tvāṃ ca tava bhakteṣu vāsinaḥ ।
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva tava bhaktiṃ prakurvatām ।।23।।
kṛcchrasāntapane raktā vāyvāhārāśca vā vrate ।
kṛṣṇasparśaṃ prakurvanti prapadyante ca kāṃ gatim ।।24।।
akṣāralavaṇā ye ca tava kāryaparāyaṇāḥ ।
payovratāśca ye bhaktāste prayānti ca kāṃ gatim ।।25।।
godugdhādisamāhārā gavāṃ sevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
uñcchavṛttiparā bhaktāḥ prayānti kīdṛśīṃ gatim ।।26।।
bhikṣopajīvino ye ca gṛhasthadharmamāśritāḥ ।
mādhave sarvadā saktāḥ kāṃ prayānti gatiṃ tu te ।।27।।
tava kṣetreṣu tīrtheṣu prāṇān muñcanti ye janāḥ ।
pañcāgnīnāṃ prataptāraḥ kāṃ gatiṃ nātha yānti te ।।28।।
pañcātape mṛtā ye ca bhṛgupāte mṛtāstathā ।
kaṭaśayyāprasuptāro vyomaśayanamāsthitāḥ ।।29।।
govraje śāyinaścāpi tava bhaktipathe sthitāḥ ।
tava darśanakartāraḥ kāṃ gatiṃ yānti keśava ।।1.565.3 0 ।।
śākāhāraṃ kaṇāhāraṃ gavyāhāraṃ yavādanam ।
saktvāhāraṃ ca kurvanti bhajante tvāṃ nirantaram ।।3 1।।
payaḥpānaparā vāpi kāṃ gatiṃ yānti te'nugāḥ ।
śirasā dīpakaṃ dhṛtvā ye'bhiyanti tavā''layam ।।32।।
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ dhṛtvā ca mastake ।
tava sevāṃ prakurvanti kāṃ gatiṃ yānti te'nugāḥ ।। 33।।
aśmāśanaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā prapadyante tu nityaśaḥ ।
patrāhārāḥ pradakṣiṇaparāyaṇāśca te janāḥ ।।34।।
svadharmacāriṇaḥ sādhvīsādhusevāparāyaṇāḥ ।
jānubhyāṃ ca prasarpantastava kṣetraṃ prayānti ye ।।35।।
daṇḍavannamanaiścāpi ye prayānti tavā''layam ।
teṣāṃ tu kā gatirdeva! tava loke bhaviṣyati ।।36।।
uttānaśayanaṃ kṛtvā dīpaṃ te dhārayanti ye ।
avāṅmukhāstu bhūtvā vā prayānti tava mandiram ।।37।।
putradāragṛhān muktvā ye tvāṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ ।
teṣāṃ tu kā gatiḥ siddhā kathayasva narāyaṇa ।।38।।
tvāṃ bhajaँśca gate jīve madhuparkasamanvite ।
vahnidāhe jalavāhe kṣityāśraye ca varṣmaṇi ।।39।।
sāṃkhyayogasuvijñānaḥ prapadyate ca kāṃ gatim ।
tvatkṣetrā'rpitadehāśca tyāgamārgamupāśritāḥ ।।1.565.40 ।।
tava nāmaparā nityaṃ namo nārāyaṇāya ca ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā ।।41 ।।
iti jāpaparā ye ca narā nāryo'pi sarvathā ।
tava dharmaparāsteṣāṃ kīdṛśī tu gatirmatā ।।42।।
raṇe śastrahatā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa gṛṇanti ca ।
nāmaprakīrtanātteṣāṃ kīdṛśī tu gatirbhavet ।।43।।
akasmānmaraṇaṃ prāptā āveśena mṛtā api ।
tava smṛtiparā ye ca kāṃ gatiṃ yānti mādhava! ।। 44।।
ahaṃ śiṣyā ca dāsī ca tava bhaktyā vyavasthitā ।
bhāṣito'si mayā hyevaṃ sarvalokasukhāvaham ।।।45।।।
rahasyaṃ dharmasaṃyuktaṃ tava bhaktisamanvitam ।
sañcintya lokalābhārthaṃ tadbhavān vaktumarhati ।।43 ।।
nārīṃ vinā narā ye ca yāśca nāryo narān vinā ।
kāmatṛptiṃ gatā naiva tava bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।।47।।
atṛptāśca mṛtā loke bhogyecchāsahitā janāḥ ।
kāṃ gatiṃ te prapadyante tyāgino vidhavādikāḥ ।।48।।
aprāptakāmabhogāśca kumāramaraṇānvitāḥ ।
tava dāsyaparā nāryo narā yānti ca kāṃ gatim ।।49।।
tava dīkṣāparāścāpi tava bhikṣādanāḥ sadā ।
tava bhakteṣu bhaktāsu ratāḥ kāmāvasāyinaḥ ।।1.565.50।।
tavaiva premapātreṣu premamātraparāyaṇāḥ ।
nānyatra gamanā ye ca narā nāryaśca vaiṣṇavāḥ ।।।51 ।।
tava prāptīcchayā nānyaṃ vāñcchanti hṛdye kvacit ।
evaṃvidhā mahābhaktāḥ sarvasvārpaṇakārakāḥ ।।52।।
gatiṃ kāṃ te prapadyante tanmamācakṣva mādhava ।
guravo lokarājāno gṛhasthā bhogasaṃvṛtāḥ ।।53।।
viṣayeṣu nimagnāśca kāṃ gatiṃ yānti te'nugāḥ ।
yadyapi paramaṃ guhyaṃ mama prītyā vadasva tat ।।54।।
ityukto bhagavān viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ।
lakṣmīmuvāca tān dharmān nijadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।।55।।
yat tvayā pṛcchyate lakṣmi! tacchṛṇuṣva sukhāvaham ।
yathākathaṃcid vṛttirme bhakto duḥkhaṃ na yānti vai ।।56।।
nāhaṃ dānasahasreṇa nā'haṃ yajñaśatairapi ।
nāpi vittena tuṣyāmi tuṣyāmi premamātrataḥ ।।57।।
mayi cittaṃ samādhāya yo māṃ bhajati mādhavi! ।
nityaṃ tuṣyāmi tasyā'haṃ bhaktaṃ me bahudoṣakam ।।58।।
ye namasyanti māṃ bhaktyā nāryo narāśca madratāḥ ।
ardharātre'ndhakāre vā madhyāhne vā'parāhṇake ।।59।।
yaccittaṃ nānyamādhatte mama mūrtau vyavasthitam ।
matprāṇā madratau saktā mallomāmatkṣudhāparāḥ ।।1.565.6 0।।
mattṛṣā matsahavāsā madanaṃgaparāyaṇāḥ ।
mama tāmbūlabhogāśca mama cūmbanakāriṇaḥ ।।6 1 ।।
mama pārśve prasūptāśca mamārohaṇatatparāḥ ।
madaṃgasaṃgakṛddhyānā mama nirvṛttidhāraṇāḥ।।62।।
te māmeva prapaśyanti mayi karmaparāyaṇāḥ ।
labdhalābhā guṇajñāśca mama bhaktau vyavasthitāḥ ।।63 ।।
mama loke vasantyete mama pārśve mamāśritāḥ ।
macchayyāyāṃ ramante te narā nāryo mamānugāḥ ।।64।।
svalpakena na gamyante mamā''nandā mama priye! ।
kṣaṇabhaktakṛte lakṣmi! duṣprāpyo'haṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।।65।।
mama karmāṇi kurvanti māṃ prapaśyanti mādhavi! ।
vyavasthitāśca me bhaktau svārthe'pi tādṛśāśca ye ।।66 ।।
tebhyo dadāmi bhogārthaṃ lokān svargādikān priye ।
dvādaśyāmupavāsaṃ ca kṛtvā bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।।67।।
tīrthajalāñjaliṃ prātaścādityāya samarpayet ।
namo nārāyaṇāyeti sūryaṃ vyomni vilokayet ।।68।।
yāvanto bindavaḥ sūkṣmāḥ patantyevāñjalerjalāt ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ।।6 9।।
śvetapuṣpaiḥ pūjayanti dvādaśyāṃ māṃ tu ye janāḥ ।
mṛṣṭairdhūpairdhūpayanti hṛdi kṛtvā smaranti mām ।।1.565.70।।
namo'stu viṣṇave gṛhṇa prīyatāṃ bhagavanmama ।
namo'stu bhojanaṃ gṛhṇa prīyatāṃ ca jalaṃ piba ।।71 ।।
evaṃ māṃ pūjayetpremṇā śāstrāṇi śṛṇuyānmama ।
mama lokaṃ sa gacchedvai jāyetāpi caturbhujaḥ ।।72।।
śyāmākaṃ godhūmakaṃ ca mudgaṃ śāliṃ yavaṃ tathā ।
nīvāraṃ kaṅgukaṃ caitanmunnyannaṃ sāttvikaṃ sadā ।।73 ।।
mama naivedyakaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīta matparāyaṇaḥ ।
yāni karmāṇi kurvīta mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।।74।।
ṣaṭkurmanirataścāpi mamā'haṃkāravarjitaḥ ।
lābhā'lābhau parityajya bhikṣāhāro jitendriyaḥ ।।75।।
mama karmasamāyuktaḥ paiśunyena vivarjitaḥ ।
śāstrānusārimadhyastho na vṛddhaśiśucetanaḥ ।।76 ।।
brāhmaṇo'pi tathābhūto yāti māṃ parame'kṣare ।
mama sārūpyamāpyaiva bhogān bhuṃkte mayā saha ।।77।।
kṣatriyo dānaśūraśca yathādharme vyavasthitaḥ ।
yajñeṣu kuśalaḥ śuddho mama karmasu yogavān ।।78।।
mamā'haṃkāraśūnyaśca guṇajñau madhyasaṃsthitaḥ ।
alpabhāṣī guruvidyo'nasūyo nindyavarjitaḥ 79।।
abhyutthānādikuśalo nityaṃ bhāgavatapriyaḥ ।.
paiśunyaśāṭhyarahito yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ ।।1.565.80।।
bhajate māṃ ca yo nityaṃ mama dhāma pragacchati ।
vaiśyo'pi mama bhaktistho nityakarmaparāyaṇaḥ ।।81 ।।
lābhālābhasamaḥ śānto mamā'haṃmohavarjitaḥ ।
ṛtukālābhigāmī ca sadā bhakteṣu vatsalaḥ ।।82।।
gurusampūjako nityaṃ mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ ।
tasyā'haṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati ।।83 ।।
śūdro dāso mama bhūtvā karoti karma kiṃkaraḥ ।
dampatī mama bhaktau sto mama karmaparāyaṇau ।।84।।
ubhau bhāgavatau bhaktau madbhaktau karmaniṣṭhitau ।
deśakālau ca jānīto rajasā tamasojjhitau ।। 85।।
ahaṃmamatāśūnyau ca śraddhāvinayaśobhitau ।
pūtātmānau lobhamohahīnāvatithipūjakau ।।86।।
namaskāraparau nityaṃ mama sevāparāyaṇau।
bhajamānau ca māmeva devadarśanakāriṇau ।।87।।
mama dhyānaparau nityaṃ dāsyabhāvā'nvitau mayi ।
evaṃ śūdraśca vā śūdrī mama karma samācaret। ।।88।।
tyaktvā ṛṣisahasrāṇi śūdraṃ bhaktaṃ bhajāmyaham ।
tyaktvā lābhamalābhaṃ ca mohaṃ kāmaṃ visṛjya ca ।।89।।
śītoṣṇābhyāṃ viprayukto nityaṃ māṃ yo vicintayet ।
na tikte ca kaṭau miṣṭe cāmble kṣāre kaṣāyake ।।1.565.90।।
spṛhā rasye lehyacoṣyabhakṣyapeyādiṣu kvacit ।
bhāryāṃ putraṃ kuṭumbaṃ ca poṣayan matparāyaṇaḥ ।।91 ।।
dhṛtiśraddhāparo nityamanyakāryajugupsakaḥ ।
bālyayauvanavārdhakyavāsanāvarjitaḥ sadā ।। 92।।
svalpabhogī dehayātrānirvāhamātrasadgrahaḥ ।
kāruṇyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ pratyutthānaparastathā ।।93।।
maunaṃ viśeṣato dhṛtvā'rcayatyeva ca māṃ sadā ।
anyabhojanadānādyuttaraṃ bhojanavān vratī ।।94।।
anuṣṭhānaparaścāpi mama pārśve manaścaraḥ ।
kāle mūtrapurīṣāṇi visṛjya snānatatparaḥ ।।95।।
puṣpe dhūpe ca gandhe ca mama kārye sadā rataḥ ।
kandamūlaphalāhāro yavasaktuparāśanaḥ ।।96।।
ṣaṣṭhakāle navakāle daśame pakṣake'danī ।
evaṃ madarthaṃ karmāṇi saptajanmāni vindati ।।97।।
madarthaṃ tyaktasambandhāstyāgamātraparāyaṇāḥ ।
santaḥ sādhvyastyāgaraktā mama sevārthajīvanāḥ ।।98।।
ye bhavanti mahādīkṣāvanto narāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
tānprapaśyaṃti prātaśca nityaṃ yogijanā api ।।99।।
evamuktavidhānena yastu karmāṇi vartayet ।
tamahaṃ mama pārśve vai rakṣāmi tvāṃ yathā priyām ।। 1.565.1 00।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sarveṣāṃ mahābhāgavatīkriyābhiḥ lakṣmīkṛtapraśnānusāreṇa taduttarakarmanaiṣkarmyātmikābhiḥ śrīharidhāmavāsādikathananāmā pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 565 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 565 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 566
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 567 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ pūjā kāryā kathaṃ kadā ।
ityādisarvapraśnānāṃ kathayāmi vidhānakam ।। 1 ।।
prātarbrāhme muhūrte ca madhyāhne sāyamityapi ।
mama pūjā prakartavyā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ ।। 2 ।।
snapanaṃ bhojanaṃ cārārtrikaṃ vibhūṣaṇādikam ।
jalapānaṃ tāmbūlakaṃ puṣpāñjalyādikaṃ caret ।। 3 ।।
śītakāle kambalādi coṣṇodakādi cārpayet ।
mṛṣṭāni bhojanādīni balapuṣṭikarāṇi ca ।। 4 ।।
varṣākāle hyanuṣṇaṃ cā'śitaṃ jalaṃ tathā'mbaram ।
madhyapuṣṭikaraṃ bhojyaṃ dātavyaṃ me priye! tadā ।। 5 ।।
ātapasya ca samaye śītaṃ sugandhavajjalam ।
sūkṣmavastrādi dātavyaṃ pacyaṃ bhojyaṃ phalādikam ।। 6 ।।
sthāpanaṃ ca tadā vācyaṃ samāgaccha prabho priya ।
svarṇādyāsanamāsādya gṛhāṇa mama pūjanam ।। 7 ।।
āgaccha bhagavan svāmin nārāyaṇa pate prabho ।
pūjāṃ gṛhītvā gantavyaṃ nijā''vāse na cānyathā ।। 8 ।।
kāṣṭhādicūrṇasampādyaṃ sugandharasamiśritam ।
dhūpaṃ gṛhāṇa bhagavan kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho ।। 9 ।।
ghṛtadīpaṃ saumyaguṇaṃ gṛhāṇa parameśvara ।
ghṛtadīpaṃ candanasya dhūpaṃ gṛhṇāmi bhāvataḥ ।। 1.566.10 ।।
tīlatailasya dīpaṃ ca guggulasya ca dhūpanam ।
yadvā gṛhṇāmi kāle'pi puṣpasāraṃ sugandhakam ।। 1 1।।
tīrthajalāni saṃgṛhya kṣālanaṃ pādayormama ।
kartavyamṛtvanusāraṃ gṛhṇāmi pādaśodhanam ।। 12।।
snapanaṃ tīrthasalilairdadhnā dugdhena sarpiṣā ।
madhunā śarkarayā ca tailena ca pramardanam ।। 1 3।।
nairmalyāpādakaṃ cūrṇaṃ snigdhaṃ śāntikaraṃ sitam ।
dātavyaṃ mañjanaṃ me ca gātre yogye viśeṣataḥ ।। 14।।
candanaṃ puṣpasārādi viṣṇutailādi lepanam ।
gṛhṇāmi nityadā bhaktapradattaṃ bhāvataḥ priye! ।। 15।।
svarṇasiṃhāsanādyaṃ ca gṛhṇāmi kambalāsanam ।
paṭṭikāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃbhūtāṃ cādhyāsya cābhiṣecanam ।। 16।।
gṛhṇāmi bhāvato lakṣmi! dattaṃ nareṇa yoṣitā ।
paryaṃke genduke ramye mṛdau sāstaraṇe pṛthau ।। 17।।
pārśvakābhyāṃ yute gaṇḍamaśrukābhyāṃ samanvite ।
kaśipuśobhite daṃśavārācchadanasañcite ।। 18।।
guptadorakayukte ca svapimi kamale sadā ।
yānaṃ haṃsayutaṃ cāśvayutaṃ gajādiśobhitam ।।1 9।।
svarṇanirmāṇarūpaṃ ca vyomagāmi mahattamam ।
garuḍaṃ vā māṇikīṃ vā rathaṃ divyaṃ vahāmi vā ।। 1.566.20।।
kandamūlaphalādīni sugandharasavanti ca ।
pakvāni ṛtujātāni gṛhṇāmi bhaktabhāvataḥ ।।21 ।।
svarṇapātre premapātre saṃskṛtaṃ cārpitaṃ śubham ।
śaratkāle yathā svasya śiśire'pi yathā svakam ।।22।।
vasante ca yathā svasya grīṣme cāpi yathā svakam ।
prāvṛṣyapi ca varṣānte yathā svasyaiva rocate ।।23।।
bhogyaṃ dhāryaṃ tathā peyaṃ khādyaṃ vastraṃ vibhūṣaṇam ।
jalaṃ yānaṃ vāhanādi vāyurdolā vanādikam ।।24।।
bhavanaṃ svapanaṃ vāri śayanaṃ sevikādikam ।
tathā sarvaṃ mama kalpyaṃ tathā deyaṃ na cānyathā ।।25।।
yathā dehe tathā deve kartavyaṃ cārpaṇaṃ priye ।
arcā ṣaḍaṃgulādūrdhvapramāṇā ca śubhā matā ।।26।।
catuḥṣaṣṭyaṃgulaṃ yāvat tato dīrghā na śasyate ।
pratiṣṭhānaṃ mandire ca netravṛttiḥ samā bhavet ।।27।।
dvāre ūrdhvaṃ caturthāṃśai netrarekhāsamasthalī ।
yathā bhavet tathā mūrteḥ pratiṣṭhānaṃ mataṃ mama ।।28।।
mūrtyadhaḥ svarṇaratnādi sthāpyaṃ siṃhāsanāntare ।
garbhe tatra ca saṃsthāpyā pratimā śrīhareḥ priye! ।।29।।
dakṣiṇe tu patiḥ sthāpyo vāme śrīḥ rādhikā śivā ।
lakṣmīśca māṇikī haṃsā prabhā pārvatī maṃjulā ।।1.566.30।।
jayā ca lalitā śāntā manasā ca sarasvatī ।
durgā gaṃgā ca kamalā sāvitrī virajā tathā ।।3 1 ।।
anyā api yatheṣṭā syād bhaktasya śrīhareḥ priyā ।
saṃsthāpyā karṇanimnā vai yathāśobhaṃ tu darśanam ।।32।।
pūrve'hani bhavennaktaṃ naktaṃ sūryāstapūrvakam ।
dvitīye'hani kāryaṃ na prāśanaṃ ca divāniśam ।।33।।
patrapuṣpaphalānnāderupoṣaṇaṃ ca tatsmṛtam ।
ekahāraḥ phalāhāro jalāhāro na bādhakaḥ ।।34।।
vasante śvetavastrāṇi phālgune kesarāṇi ca ।
kausuṃbhāni tathā''ṣāḍhe svarṇavarṇāni cāśvine ।।35।।
citravarṇānyutsavādau caikavarṇāni nityadā ।
svarṇatārādiśobhāḍhyaṃ dhāryate ca mayā priye! ।।36 ।।
lohatāraṃ vinā vastraṃ sarvaṃ śreyaskaraṃ matam ।
raktaṃ sampatkaraṃ vastraṃ pītaṃ lakṣmīpradaṃ matam ।।37।।
śvetaṃ jñānakaraṃ śaśvaccitraṃ bhogapradaṃ matam ।
nīlaṃ niṣiddhamevā'tra dhāryaṃ naiva kadācana ।।38।।
madhuparko guḍājyasva śarkarājyasya vāpi ca ।
śarkarākṣīramiśrasya khaṇḍādadhnostathā mataḥ ।।39।।
madhumiṣṭādipeyasya miṣṭapeyasya vā mataḥ ।
yadgṛhe jāṭhare śāntirbhavet tat madhuparkakam ।।1.566.40।।
āmrarasādau sarpiśca śarkarā cetyapi trayam ।
miṣṭaphaleṣu miṣṭaṃ ca miśritaṃ madhuparkakam ।।41 ।।
mahyaṃ deyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ śītalaṃ guṇakṛnmama ।
madhuparkapradānena svarge cātra vibhūtayaḥ ।।42।।
dāturbhavanti satataṃ cānnapānādipuṇyadāḥ ।
ghṛtakulyā madhukulyā dadhikulyāśca tadgṛhe ।।43।।
kṣīrakulyāstakrakulyā jalakulyā bhavanti ca ।
yatra loke ca tāḥ kulyāstatra yānti madhupradāḥ ।।44।।
yāvajjāṭharaśāntiḥ syāttāvatpramāṇakaṃ madhu ।
deyaṃ tṛptipradaṃ miṣṭaṃ yena lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ।।।45।।।
dāturamṛtadāḥ sarve rasadāśca bhavanti vai ।
sāttvikānyeva śākāni kūṣmāṇḍādīni sarvathā ।।46 ।।
vṛntākāni dugdhavatīgillikādīni yānyapi ।
tāndūlādīni patrāṇi sārṣapādidalāni ca ।।47।।
karkaṭīkāravellāni cirabhaṭṭāni yāni ca ।
saumyāni kandamūlāni santi priyāṇi me priye! ।।48।।
śrīkhaṇḍapāyasādīni kvathitāni śubhāni ca ।
kvathikā rājikārāddhamāranālāni yānyapi ।।49।।
garmarīmarcikātiktakaravīrāmrakāṇi ca ।
evaṃvidhāni ramyāṇi santi priyāṇi me sadā ।।1.566.50।।
bhuṃkṣva kāmaṃ miṣṭamiṣṭaṃ śanaiḥ pūrṇaṃ praśāntidam ।
yathāruci prabho bhuṃkṣva pakvānnādīni keśava ।।51 ।।
ityevaṃ bhojayenmāṃ ca vījayetpavanaṃ tadā ।
punaḥ premṇā mama pātre bhaktaḥ sampariveṣayet ।।52।।
evaṃ vai bhojayennityaṃ svarṇāsane nidhāya mām ।
svarṇapātre jalaṃ bhṛtvā svarṇasthālyādipātrake ।।53।।
premṇā sarvaṃ pariveṣayitvā jalaṃ ca pāyayet ।
tāmbūlakaṃ śubhaṃ dadyāt kuryācca pādamardanam ।।54।।
pūjāyāṃ cāparāddhā me yathā na syustathā bhavet ।
māmaśuddhaśarīro na spṛśet snānaṃ vinā kvacit ।।55।।
mūkavannaiva yāyācca mandirasthaṃ ca māṃ prati ।
prabodhayenna vai mūko vinā ghaṇṭādivādanam ।।56।।
akāle cā'niyamena prabodhayenna māṃ kvacit ।
śreṣṭhimānuṣarājārthaṃ jāgaraṃ kārayenna mām ।।57।।
svārthārthaṃ pūjayennaiva pṛṣṭhaṃ naiva pradarśayet ।
kṣuvanaṃ vādakaraṇaṃ maryādātyajanaṃ na vā ।।58।।
aśuddhavastrasahito na yāyānmama mandiram ।
aśuddhavastu saṃspṛśya vinā prakṣālya vai karau ।।59।।।
na māṃ spṛśenna māmakīnāni vastūni saṃspṛśet ।
kaṇḍūyanaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā na māṃ spṛśet kadācana ।।1.566.60।।
duṣṭasaṃkalpamevāpi madgṛhe na hi kārayet ।
matpūjāyāṃ svayaṃ nā'dyānna peyāśca jalādyapi ।।61 ।।
mūkavatpūjayennaiva vinā me raṭaṇaṃ tadā ।
manmālyaśiṣṭasāmagrīdūrīkṛtya punaḥ karam ।।62।।
aprakṣālya spṛśennaiva nūtanāni ca vastūni ।
thūtkārā'pānavāyvādi visarjayenna mandire ।।63।।
mūtrādikaṃ kriyāccedvai snānaṃ kṛtvā spṛśettu mām ।
mama pūjāmadhyavartī nānyakāryaparo bhavet ।।64।।
anyamanā bhavennāpi durgandhibhakṣako na ca ।
aśuddhapāno na syācca na ca hiṃsāparo bhavet ।।65।।।
vastrabhūṣādyarpaṇe māṃ prasahya naiva dhārayet ।
śītoṣṇādau yathā svasya tathā syānme'nukūlakṛt ।।66।।।
mukhaprakṣālanaṃ tailamardanaṃ candanārpaṇam ।
yathāyogyaṃ prakuryācca nā'dhikaṃ duḥkhakṛd yathā ।।67।।
śaitye vahnerupasthānaṃ nātyutkṛṣṭaṃ kriyānmama ।
vastrāṇāṃ dhāraṇe nityaṃ kuryād vinimayaṃ mama ।।68।।
bhūṣāṇāṃ dhāraṇe cāpi kuryādvai parivartanam ।
na gālīṃ pravadennānyanindāṃ grāmyakathāṃ vadet ।।69।।
na svapenmandiramadhye nagno bhavenna mandire ।
niṣīdenna ca māṃ kṛtvā pṛṣṭhe janamukhaṃ prati ।।1.566.70 ।।
vinā pādau samprakṣālya na gacchenmandirāntare ।
ārātrivartikāṃ dīpaṃ spṛṣṭvā vinā jalena ca ।।71 ।।
karaprakṣālanaṃ māṃ vai spṛśennaiva ca vastukam ।
nānyaṃ praveśayet kaṃcit kāṃcicca mandirāntare ।।72।।
ucchiṣṭānanahastādi praviśennaiva mandire ।
mālāpuṣpādi cottārya vinā cottāraṇakṣaṇam ।।73।।
dadyānnānyajanāyeti yadyapi syānmahīpatiḥ ।
pūrvadinasya cottārya rakṣayecca dadettadā ।।74।।
haste samarpya vā dadyāt tātkālikaṃ prasādanam ।
āvaraṇapaṭaṃ naiva punarmadhye samucchrayet ।
na pātayettathā madhye darśakānāṃ hyapasthito ।।75।।
śaṃkhaṃ jalena bhatvaiva dīpaṃ prajvālya vai śubham ।
vastraṃ mārjanayogyaṃ ca dhṛtvā pātre sugandhibhṛt ।।76।।
ghaṇṭāṃ saṃvādayitvaiva tataścārārtrikaṃ caret ।
nagnamūrteḥ samaye me dvāraṃ noddhāṭayet kvacit ।।77।।
vastrabhūṣādhāraṇādau dvārapidhānamācaret ।
dhūlīṃ rajo jantujālaṃ dūrayedvai pratikṣaṇam ।।78।।
rātrau ca śayanādūrdhvaṃ cā''prātarmadhyakālikam ।
mandiroddhāṭanaṃ naiva kuryādāpadamantarā ।।79।।
madhyāhne'pi tathā naivoddhāṭayet kaṣṭamantarā ।
bhojyakāle vaded bhojyakīrtanaṃ vādyasaṃyutam ।।1.566.80 ।।
asaṃskṛtamaśuddhaṃ cā'sāttvikaṃ cāmbarādikam ।
vibhūṣaṇaṃ ca hārādyanirmalaṃ cānnamityapi ।।81 ।।
jalaṃ cānyadāyudhādi na dhārayenna cārpayet ।
bhāvanāṃ śailaviṣayāṃ dhāturūpāṃ na cācaret ।।82।।
divyo'haṃ sarvathā varte vyāpakaścāntarātmakaḥ ।
sarvajñaḥ sarvasaṃsthaśca paśyāmi mūrtisaṃsthitaḥ ।।83।।
cittaikāgryaṃ hi pūjāyāṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ।
sarvendriyāṇāṃ vṛttīnāṃ mama mūrtau viśeṣataḥ ।।84।।
bhaktasya bhojane deyaṃ miṣṭaṃ prāsādikaṃ mama ।
yathā mamātisatkārastathā kāryo janasya me ।।85।।
bhojanīyo viśeṣeṇa tatra bhuñjāmyahaṃ priye ।
prāpaṇaṃ godhūmakaṅkuyavādīnāṃ saduttamam ।।86 ।।
madarthaṃ śubhapakvānnaṃ nirmāya deyameva ha ।
pātraṃ svarṇādidhātūnāṃ nūtanaṃ deyameva me ।।87।।
matkṛpāpātratāmāptā bhaktā bhāgavatā mama ।
prasādāśanayogyāste tulasīmālikāyutāḥ ।।88।।
mahāmantrayutāścāpi dīkṣitā narayoṣitaḥ ।
ātmanivedibhaktāśca naivedyaprāśane'rhakāḥ ।।89।।
mamaikāntikabhakteṣu vāsināṃ bhaktiyoginām ।
mama loke gatiḥ sāmyā caturbāhusvarūpiṇī ।।1.566.90।।
kṛcchrādivratakartāro yadi bhogecchavo janāḥ ।
te tu yānti mahatsvargaṃ vairājaṃ lokamityapi ।।91 ।।
akṣāralavaṇā ye ca vratino matkriyāparāḥ ।
satyalokaṃ prayāntyeva yadi bhogecchavaḥ sadā ।।92।।
gavāṃ sevāparā bhaktā mahābhāgavatā yadi ।
tadā yānti ca golokaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma me janāḥ ।।93 ।।
uñcchavṛttiparā bhaktāḥ paraṃ vaikuṇṭhameva te ।
prayānti rāgahīnāśca yātrāmātraparāyaṇāḥ ।।94।।
bhikṣāhārā gṛhasthāśca madratāḥ sādhavaśca te ।
yānti me śāśvataṃ dhāmā'kṣaramamṛtamavyayam ।।95।।
mama gṛhe'ntike kṣetre cālaye mandire'pi ca ।
prāṇairviyujyate yaḥ sa yātyakṣaraṃ padaṃ mama ।।96।।
agnitāpā mama bhaktāḥ sākāṃkṣā yānti vai divam ।
sauralokaṃ tāpasāste prayāntīndrabhuvaṃ tathā ।।97।।
śākādyāhārakartāro mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।
mama lokaṃ tvamṛtākhyaṃ prayāntyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।98।।
dīpadānaparā ye ca tapaḥparā mamāśritāḥ ।
patrapuṣpādidātāro yānti me paramaṃ padam ।।99।।
dharmiṣṭhāśca satāṃ sevāparā yānti hi madgṛham ।
jānuyānā mama bhaktā yānti dhāmā'kṣaraṃ param ।। 1.566.10 0।।
uttānaśayanādyāśca yānti divyaṃ paraṃ padam ।
sarvatyāgā mama santo matsvarūpā bhavanti vai ।। 101 ।।
yatra kvāpi dhṛte dehe mayi sandhṛtamānasāḥ ।
ātmanā yānti mallokaṃ rādhālakṣmyāśritaṃ padam ।। 1 02।।
tyāginaḥ sāṃkhyayogāśca caturbhujā hi viṣṇavaḥ ।
bhavantyeva na sandeho muktā madrūpadhāriṇaḥ ।। 1 03।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāyetijapānvitāḥ ।
narā nāryo'kṣarādūrdhvaṃ paraṃ dhāma prayānti me ।। 1 04।।
śastrahatā api nāmaparā me bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ।
pārṣadā mama jāyante'kṣare dhāmni hi śāśvatāḥ ।। 1 05।।
akasmānmaraṇaṃ prāptā yadi maccittavarttinaḥ ।
kṣaṇamātraṃ smaranto māṃ prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।। 1 06।।
atṛptā naravargā vā nāryo vā me'nuvartinaḥ ।
prayānti caiśvarān lokān koṭikanyāprasevitān ।। 1 07।।
mama dīkṣāparā yānti pare dhāmni mahātmatām ।
gṛhasthāḥ kāmabhogāḍhyā bhaktāśced yānti vaikṛtam ।। 1 08।।
māyāyāśca pradhānāyā lokeṣu vigatajvarāḥ ।
tyāgino vidhavādyāśca bhaktāḥ kāmābhilāṣiṇaḥ ।। 1 09।।
jāyante viṣṇurūpāśca ramārūpāśca dhāmani ।
koṭikalpāni saukhyāni bhuñjate te vikuṇṭhake ।। 1.566.110 ।।
mayi snehaparā bhaktā narā nāryo'tikāmukāḥ ।
mama patnyo bhavantyeva śāśvatīṃ muktimāśritāḥ ।। 111 ।।
guravo'pi gṛhasthāśca kṛṣṇarūpā bhavanti te ।
goloke sarvabhogāśca śāśvatānandamodinaḥ ।।1 1 2।।
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi tava pṛṣṭaṃ mayā'naghe ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya labhedvai śāṃkarīṃ gatim ।। 1 13।।
brāhmīṃ vā vaiṣṇavīṃ vāpi sthitiṃ labhenna saṃśayaḥ ।
kathayiṣye'nyadevā'pi pārvatyā śaṃkarāya yat ।। 1 14।।
narmadāmūlake ṛkṣe pṛṣṭaṃ yat tacchubhāvaham ।
duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ manomātravikalpanam ।। 1 15।।
mayā dhāmānyasaṃkhyāni golokādīni cā'kṣare ।
prānte bhaktāprabhogārthaṃ nirmitāni sukhāni hi ।। 1 16।।
bhaktabhaktāyugalāni mama bhaktiparāṇi ca ।
madicchayaiṣu tiṣṭhanti yāvadbhogavirāmitā ।।1 17।।
bhogatṛptisukhānāṃ vai virāme'kṣaradhāmani ।
yānti tāni yugalāni matsvarūpaparāṇi hi ।। 1 18।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīlakṣmīkṛtānāṃ vividhapraśnānāṃ bhaktikṛjjanagatisamādhānādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 566 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 566 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 567
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 568 →

śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! ca duḥkhāni vinā bhaktiṃ janasya vai ।
tathā sukhāni vakṣyāmi mama yogena sarvathā ।। 1 ।।
anekacittavibhrānto mamā'haṃkārasaṃvṛtaḥ ।
ajitendriya āśāsthastato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 2 ।।
asantuṣṭaścātitṛṣṇa udvegakleśakārakaḥ ।
vāsanākṛṣṭahṛdayastato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 3 ।।
apūtātmā dharmahīno dayādānavivarjitaḥ ।
lakṣmībhogavihīnaśca tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 4 ।।
rogo moho jarā glāniḥ saśastraḥ paravañcakaḥ ।
paraduḥkhapradātā cet tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 5 ।।
mamā'rcanakriyāhīnaḥ satāṃ sevāvivarjitaḥ ।
gṛhe kleśakaraḥ syāccet tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 6 ।।
nāsti devo na vai dharmo paraloko na vidyate ।
manyate na punarjanma tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 7 ।।
ucitenopacāreṇa dravye satyapi mānavaḥ ।
yo māṃ naiva prapadyeta tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 8 ।।
sarvabhakṣī sarvavastuvikretā nativarjitaḥ ।
yo na māṃ pratipadyeta tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 9 ।।
abhyāgataṃ cātithiṃ cā'datvā bhuṃkte nijānapi ।
pākabhedaprakartā cet tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 1.567.10 ।।
paropatāpyasantuṣṭo mandātmā devadūṣakaḥ ।
karmahīno hrāsamūle tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 11 ।।
ātmaśreyo hyanāsādya cā'kṛtvā pāpadāhanam ।
mṛtyukālavaśaṃ prāptastato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 1 2।।
rājye satyapi yāmyānāṃ haste gatvā prasahya vai ।
dūtaduḥkhaṃ samāpnoti tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 13।।
hastyaśvarathayānāni sainyāni bhṛtyavargakān ।
vihāyā'nyavaśo yāti tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 14।।
aśnanti mādakaṃ kecit kecicchālighṛtādikam ।
śuṣkānnaṃ kecidaśnanti kecit kandaphalānyapi ।। 15।।
varavastrāvṛtāṃ śayyāṃ sevante samabhūṣitām ।
tṛṇeṣu śerate kecit kurvanti nātmasādhanam ।। 16 ।।
maraṇaṃ sarvasāmānyaṃ naikaṃ tyajati nā'param ।
jñātvaivaṃ na bhajante māṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 17।।
surūpo dṛśyate kaścit kaścid virūpakubjakaḥ ।
saguṇo nirguṇaḥ kaścit sāmyaṃ codarapoṣaṇam ।। 18।।
vidvān mūkastathā kaścinna kaścicchāśvato'tra vai ।
jñātvaiva māṃ na bhajate tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।। 19।।
vidyamāne dhane kecit kṛpaṇā bhogavarjitāḥ ।
dātā satyapi dāridrye bahuvyayaparāyaṇaḥ ।।1.567.20 ।।
evaṃ satyapi varṣānte riktaṃ gṛhaṃ dvayorapi ।
kiṃ phalaṃ dhaninastasya kiṃ phalaṃ nirdhanasya ca ।। 21 ।।
dānayajñādirāhitye tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।
dvibhāryo bahubhāryo vā tadā sampadyate janaḥ ।।22।।
yadā caikatrā'santuṣṭaścāparāṃ sa praśaṃsati ।
ekā tu durbhagā tatra sadā śāpaparāyaṇā ।।23 ।।
bhoge śāpānulepaśca paralokavināśakṛt ।
jñātvaivaṃ bhajate māṃ na tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।।24।।
sadgṛhe dhṛtajanmāno sarvasādhanasaṃbhṛtāḥ ।
kurvanti pāpakarmāṇi tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।।25।।
labdhvā tu mānuṣīṃ saṃjñāṃ sarvajñānasamanvitām ।
māmeva na prapadyante tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।।26।।
kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ karma svārthamātraparāyaṇaḥ ।
viparītamatiṃ yāti sa duḥkhāyopajāyate ।।27।।
duḥkhaṃ svecchāviruddhaṃ syāt sukhaṃ svecchānukūlatā ।
ātmanaśca paraṃ duḥkhaṃ nityānandavihīnatā ।।28।।
mṛtyuttaraṃ ca yallabhyaṃ mānavena hi varṇyate ।
karmaṇā śāśvataṃ saukhyaṃ taccennāptaṃ vṛthājanuḥ ।। 29।।
jīvan duḥkhasamāyukto mṛto'pi duḥkhabhāk punaḥ ।
tasya vyarthaṃ gataṃ janma tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim ।।1.567.3 0 ।।
māṃ pūjayitvā naivedyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ parikalpya ca ।
śeṣamannaṃ samaśnāti tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।। 31 ।।
trikālaṃ me prepadyante paśyanti pratimāṃ mama ।
bhaktiṃ kurvanti me premṇā tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।32।।
devatātithimartyānāṃ gavāṃ cānnaṃ vibhajya ca ।
āśritānāṃ tataḥ paścāt samaśnāti gṛhādhipaḥ ।।33।।
te nirāśā na gacchanti santuṣṭā yānti dānataḥ ।
yasyaivaṃ vartamānasya tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।34।।
māsi māsyekadivasastvamāvāsyeti yocyate ।
pitaro yasya tṛpyanti tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।35।।
bhojanādau ca sādhubhyaḥ pāyasānnaṃ dadāti yaḥ ।
abhinnamukharāgeṇa tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।36 ।।
bahvīṣvapi svapatnīṣu yasya buddhirna bhidyate ।
samaṃ saukhyaṃ dadātyeva tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।37।।
ahiṃsanaṃ vrataṃ śuddhāntaro rakṣed ruṣaṃ tyajan ।
surūpaṃ bhogyavastvādi dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭiṃ dadāti na ।।38।।
śāntātmā kāmanāhīno mohahīnaḥ samantataḥ ।
loṣṭhavat paśyati svarṇaṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।39।।
pūjāyāṃ vartamāne ca yadi prāṇaḥ pragacchati ।
devārthaṃ maraṇaṃ syāccet tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।1.567.40 ।।
kutsitaṃ naiva kuryācca kuryādevātmamokṣaṇam ।
lābhā'labdhāvapi tuṣṭastataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।41।।
bhartā vrataṃ sadā strīṇāṃ sākṣānmūrtaṃ pravidyate ।
bhartāraṃ samanusṛtya vartate yā pativratā ।।42।।
patnīvrataṃ tathā patyuḥ sākṣānmūrtiḥ pativratā ।
patnīṃ santuṣya ca patirvartate sukhadāyakaḥ ।।43 ।।
dampatī premapūrṇau cet tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।
vibhavāḍhyo jano yaśca vidhāvinayavāँstathā ।।44।।
nigṛhītendriyaḥ syāccet tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।
sahate cā'vamānāni vyasane durmanāḥ sadā ।।45।।
mama bhaktau cātisaktastataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim ।
jalaṃ milati nirmūlyaṃ bhikṣayā cānnamāpyate ।।46 ।।
na cintā dravyarakṣāyāstataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim ।
śarīraṃ rogahīnaṃ ca pācanāgniḥ samujjvalaḥ ।।47।।
pakvā'pakvaṃ pacatyeva tataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim ।
śītaṃ na bādhate cāti auṣṇyaṃ nābhibhavatyapi ।।48 ।।
vṛkṣavāyukṛtāvāsastataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim ।
lokāḥ kuṭumbaṃ sarvatra ādhāraḥ parameśvaraḥ ।।49।।
cintanaṃ śrīharernityaṃ tataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim ।
gṛhaṃ yasya tu pārakyaṃ guhāprakhyaṃ nirāmayam ।।1.567.50।।
poṣaṇaṃ parabhṛttulyaṃ bhojanaṃ śukavattathā ।
bhajanaṃ sahajaṃ yasya tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।51 ।।
sakāmo vā hyakāmo vā mamālayanivāsakṛt ।
yastu prāṇād viyujyeta tataḥ sukhataraṃ nu kim ।।52।।
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ bhāryāṃ guruṃ devaṃ ca bālakān ।
devatāmiva paśyed yastataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।53।।
śāntirjñānaṃ vicāraścā'nudvegaśca vivekitā ।
dhairyaṃ sthairyaṃ nispṛhatvaṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।54।।
pūjayed devadeveśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
nipated daṇḍavad bhūmau jñānī bhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ।। 55।।
śirasā cāṃjaliṃ kṛtvā prasīdeti vadeddharim ।
kṣamāpayeddhariṃ nityaṃ tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।56।।
abhyañjanaṃ ca me dadyād dadyād vā tailamardanam ।
sarvaṃ śarīraṃ cā'bhyajyād ghṛtenāpi ca mastakam ।।57।।
ājyamānamapi tathā yāvantastailabindavaḥ ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ।।58।।
tataḥ puṇyakṛtāँllokān sukhān vindati mānavaḥ ।
tataḥ paraṃ pumāṃsaṃ māṃ vindatyakṣarasaṃjñake ।।59।।
udvartanaṃ ca me dadyācchuddhyantyaṃgāni yena me ।
pippalikā madhukaśca aśvaparṇaśca karkaṭaḥ ।।1.567.60 ।।
eteṣāṃ tu śubhaṃ cūrṇaṃ mama gātrasukhāvaham ।
evamudvartanaṃ kṛtvā gharṣayitvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
nairmalyaṃ me prakuryācca bhaktaḥ kareṇa sarvathā ।
tata āmalakaṃ caiva sugandhacūrṇamuttamam ।।62।।
tena me sarvagātrāṇi mardayitvā dṛḍhavrataḥ ।
yadvā kṣārasnehagandhagūṭikābhiḥ pramārjanam ।।63।।
snapanaṃ jaladhārābhiḥ kārayenmāṃ sukhāvaham ।
paścād gandhaṃ pradadyācca puṣpasārādikaṃ tathā ।।64।।
karmaṇyānyapi mālyāni puṣpāṃñjaliṃ pradāpayet। ।
paścād dhūpaṃ ca me dadyāt sugandhadravyamiśritam ।।65।।
paścād vastraṃ ca me dadyāt kṣaumaṃ śuklaṃ ca pītakam ।
paścād bhūṣāṃ mama datvā tvāsanaṃ copakalpayet ।।66।।
paścādvai bhojanaṃ datvā prasādaṃ saṃgraset tataḥ ।
paścājjalaṃ sutāmbūlaṃ dadyānme śayanādikam ।।67।।
evaṃ bhaktiṃ prakuryānme pādasaṃvāhanaṃ caret ।
rañjayenmāṃ kathālāpairhāsayecca hasettathā ।।68।।
ānandaṃ kārayenmāṃ ca tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।
bhakto bhaktā ca vā kṛṣṇe sarvasvārpaṇamācaret ।।69।।
phalaṃ tasya ca goloke kṛṣṇaḥ sarvaṃ dadāti vai ।
evaṃ mukteḥ pare lābhe tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।1.567.70।।
rādhāvat sevane kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīvacca narāyaṇam ।
pārvatīvacchaṃkaraṃ ca prabhāvadbhāskaraṃ prabhum ।।71 ।।
māṇikyāvat svāminaṃ cānādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।
sevate sarvathā dhāmni tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।72।।
ya etena vidhānena yakṣyante khalu māṃ priye ।
prāpsyanti te parāṃ siddhiṃ mama dhāmagatāṃ dhruvām ।।73।।
ahameva varārohe sarvabhūtasanātanaḥ ।
adhaścordhvaṃṃ ca tiryak ca koṇeṣūpari saṃsthitaḥ ।।74।।
nare nāryāṃ kumāryāṃ ca vidhavāyāṃ jarāyute ।
dehe dehinyapi cāsmi bāle yuni ca garbhage ।।75।।
evaṃ māṃ yo vijānīyād bhajanmāṃ sarvabhāvanaḥ ।
saṃsāre vijayastasya tataḥ saukhyataraṃ nu kim ।।76।।
yena garbhaṃ na gacchedvai tacchṛṇuṣva samudraje ।
kṛtvāpi vipulaṃ karma cātmānaṃ na praśaṃsati ।।77।।
karoti sarvakarmāṇi śuddhenaivā'ntarātmanā ।
aiśvaryayukto bhavati samartho'nugrahādike ।।78।।
kāryā'kārye vijānāti kṛṣṇadharme viniṣṭhitaḥ ।
śītoṣṇavātavarṣādikṣutpipāsāsahastathā ।।79।।
kṛṣṇadhano nirālasyaḥ satyavāganasūyakaḥ ।
brahmacaryaparo nityaṃ svadāraniratastathā ।।1.567.80।।
satyācāro viśuddhātmā nityaṃ ca bhagavatpriyaḥ ।
saṃvibhajya viśeṣajñaḥ sādhubhaktasuvatsalaḥ ।।81।।
priyabhāṣī prabhaktānāṃ mama sevāparāyaṇaḥ ।
evaṃ yo me bhavedbhaktaḥ kuyoniṃ nahi gacchati ।।82।।
nābhilaṣati svargādīn mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ।
jīvahiṃsānivṛttaśca sarvabhūtahitakaraḥ ।।83।।
sarvatra samatāyuktaḥ samaloṣṭhāśmakāñcanaḥ ।
bālye sthito'pi vayasi kṣānto dāntaḥ śubhe rataḥ ।।84।।
pareṇāpakṛte naiva gaṇayatyeva mānase ।
mama sevāṃ saṃsmarecca mama satyaṃ ca jalpati ।।85।।
vyalīkād vinivṛtto yastathyetikṛtaniścayaḥ ।
nityaṃ maunaviśeṣasthaḥ parokṣe'pi na cākṣipet ।।86 ।।
ṛtukāle striyaṃ gacchedapatyārthī na kāmataḥ ।
īdṛśāstu janā bhadrā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।।87।।
garbhavāsaṃ na te yānti yanti vāsaṃ mamāśraye ।
ātmanā niścitaṃ kuryāt sākṣiṇaṃ māṃ pradiśya ca ।।88।।
paravādaṃ na kurvīta śāṭhyadhaurtyaṃ vivarjayet ।
na nindeddharmakāryāṇi mama dharmapathe sthitaḥ ।।89।।
ebhirguṇaiḥ samāyukto mama sevāṃ karoti cet ।
māmeva sa samāpnoti tataḥ saukhyatamaṃ nu kim ।। 1.567.90 ।।
punaranyattu vakṣyāmi kamale śṛṇu me priye ।
taranti puruṣā yena garbhasaṃsārasāgaram ।।9 1।।
jitendriyā jitakrodhā lobhamohavivarjitāḥ ।
ātmopakārakā nityaṃ devā'tithigurupriyāḥ ।।92।।
kapilāpūjakā nityaṃ tīrthayātrākarāstathā ।
sādhusādhvīpūjakāśca vṛddhasanmānakārakāḥ ।।93।।
anāthān pālayed yaśca bhedabhāvaṃ karoti na ।
sarveṣāmapi putrāṇāṃ viśeṣaṃ na karoti yaḥ ।।94।।
saṃkruddhaṃ svaguruṃ dṛṣṭvā yastu tatra prasādayet। ।
pūjayet kapilāṃ bhaktyā pālayet strīṃ pativratām ।।95।।
agniṃ nahi kramet padbhyāṃ mehayenna jale kvacit ।
gurubhakto bhavennityaṃ jñānavānna ca jalpakaḥ ।।96।।
evaṃ dharmeṇa saṃyukto yo nu māṃ pratipadyate ।
sa ca garbhaṃ na gacchedvai mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ।।97।।
bhuktvā parasya cānnāni yaścaiva na vikutsati ।
bālye vayasyapi ca yo mama nityamanuvrataḥ ।।98।।
yena kenāpi santuṣṭo mātāpitṛprapūjakaḥ ।
dātā bhoktā nyāyataśca svatantro nityasaṃyataḥ ।।99।।
vikarma nābhikurvīta kaumāravratamāsthitaḥ ।
sarvabhūtadayāyuktaḥ sattvena ca samanvitaḥ ।। 1.567.10 0।।
matyā ca nispṛho'tyantaṃ parārtheṣvaspṛhaḥ sadā ।
īdṛgbhakto mama śiṣyo mama lokaṃ pragacchati ।। 101 ।।
imaṃ guhyaṃ varārohe devairapi durāsadam ।
tvaṃ me śiṣyā ca dāsī ca bhaktā patnīti kīrtitam ।। 1 02।।
ityevaṃ śaṃkarastatra pārvatīm ṛkṣaparvate ।
mama bhaktiṃ purā prāha tairthabhāve ca nārmade ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sukhabhāvo duḥkhabhāvaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjā sarvakarmasamarpaṇatādiphalaṃ janmābhāvaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।567।।


← adhyāyaḥ 567 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 568
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 569 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mama bhaktiparāṇāṃ cottamāṃ matim ।
yadyapi syānmama tīrthe dhūlīdhūsaratā yadi ।। 1 ।।
tathāpyahaṃ mahārājyaṃ pradadāmi mṛtasya vai ।
pūrvaṃ kokābhidhe tīrthe vārāhāvatarāśraye ।। 2 ।।
kaścillubdho vihiṃsan vai cāyayau kokamaṇḍale ।
tatra dṛṣṭvā jale matsyaṃ baḍiśenā''jahāra saḥ ।। 3 ।।
tasya hastāttu balavān matsyastūrṇaṃ vinirgataḥ ।
atha śyenaśca taṃ vīkṣya padbhyāṃ jagrāha satvaram ।। 4 ।।
uḍḍīno'pi mahābhāraṃ voḍhuṃ nirbala eva saḥ ।
tataḥ padbhyāṃ viyuktaḥ san matsyaḥ kokāmukhe'patat ।। 5 ।।
mamāra rajasā spṛṣṭo rājaputro'bhavacchuciḥ ।
atha kālena tasyaiva mṛgavyādhasya cāṃganā ।। 6 ।।
gṛhītvā mūrdhni māṃsāni padbhyāṃ prayāti tatra vai ।
ekā cillī māṃsakṣubdhā māṃsaṃ hartuṃ samāyayau ।। 7 ।।
vyādhapatnyā tāḍitā sā śareṇa patitā mṛtā ।
jātā candrapure rājñaḥ kanyā tīrtharajaḥśrayāt ।। 8 ।।
yuvatyapi naraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jugupsati na cecchati ।
saumyaṃ surūpaṃ puruṣaṃ sarvānapi jugupsati ।। 9 ।।
atha kāle gate tayoḥ sambandho'bhūdvivāhataḥ ।
tathā ca dampatī nityaṃ dharmaṃ pālayataḥ sthitau ।।1.568.1 0 ।।
madhyāhne jāyate patyuḥ śirorugatipīḍinī ।
vaidyauṣadhaiḥ sahasraiḥ sā pīḍā naiva nyavartata ।। 1 1।।
kadācid dayitā naijaṃ bhartāramidamabravīt ।
kā nviyaṃ vedanā svāmin cikitsābhirna gacchati ।। 1 2।।
punaḥ punaḥ pṛcchyamānaḥ priyāmuvāca vai patiḥ ।
muñcatvaṃ mānuṣaṃ bhāvaṃ tāṃ jātiṃ smara paurvikīm ।। 13 ।।
yadi jñātuṃ tavecchā'sti gṛhāṇā''jñāṃ tu vṛddhayoḥ ।
mātāpitrormama gantuṃ tīrthaṃ kokāmukhaṃ prati ।। 14।।
tatra gatvā kathayiṣye mā mohaṃ kuru bhāmini ।
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa śvaśrūśvaśurakau vadhūḥ ।। 15 ।।
prāha kokāmukhe gantumicchāvastīrthayogataḥ ।
kāryagauravabhāvena na niṣiddhau kathaṃcana ।। 16 ।।
adya yāvat kimapi vāṃ yācitaṃ na mayā kvacit ।
purastād yuvayostanme yācitaṃ dātumarhataḥ ।। 17।।
śirovedanayā yuktaḥ sadā tava suto hyayam ।
madhyāhne mṛtakalpo vai jāyate cātipīḍitaḥ ।। 18।।
kokāmukhaṃ vinā kaṣṭaṃ na nivṛttaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
tvaritaṃ gantumicchāvo viṣṇostatparamaṃ padam ।।19।।
iti snuṣāvacaḥ śrutvā rājā prāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ ।
gṛhāṇa putra ratnāni dāsān dāsīḥ rathādikān ।।1.568.20।।
dānārhāṇi ca vastūni dhanāni vipulāni ca ।
kuru tīrthaṃ sukhātputra putri rakṣa patiṃ tava ।।21 ।।
anujajñe śako rājā dampatī vaṇijādibhiḥ ।
yayatustatra gatvā ca kokāmukhaṃ hariṃ tathā ।।22।।
devān dṛṣṭvā jale snātvā dānāni dadatustataḥ ।
rajanī saṃvyatītā ca prātaḥ snātau tu dampatī ।।23।।
praṇamya śirasā viṣṇuṃ patiḥ patnīṃ mṛdantare ।
asthīni darśayāmāsa mīnasya pūrvajanmanaḥ ।।24।।
etāni mama cāsthīni pūrvadehodbhavāni hi ।
ahaṃ purābhavaṃ matsyaḥ kokeṣu vicaran jale ।।25।।
vyādhena nigṛhīto'haṃ baḍiśena jalecaraḥ ।
taddhastānnirgatastatra balena patito bhuvi ।।26 ।।
śyenenāmiṣalubdhena nakhairviddho'bhavaṃstadā ।
nītaṃ ākāśamārgeṇa tasmācca patito'tra vai ।।27।।
tena cātiprahāreṇa jātā śirasi vedanā ।
ahameva vijānāmi smarāmi vedanāṃ hyati ।।28।।
tena duḥkhaṃ na me śāntaṃ madhyāhne jāyate hyati ।
śrutvaivaṃ tasya bhāryā'pi prāha pūrvabhavaṃ svakam ।।29।।
ahaṃ pūrvabhavaṃ ca cillī kṣuttṛḍyutā drume ।
samāsīnā tadā bhakṣyaṃ vicinvānā tadantare ।।1.568.3 0 ।।
atha kaścinmṛgavyādhaḥ priyayā saha taddrume ।
hatvā mṛgān samāyāto māṃsān rarakṣa bhūtale ।।3 1 ।।
tāvanmayā māṃsapiṇḍo viddho vajrasamairnakhaiḥ ।
vyādho dadarśa māṃ tatra jaghāna ca śareṇa mām ।।।32।।।
apātayacca bhūmau māṃ patitā'haṃ mṛtiṃ gatā ।
etatkṣetraprabhāveṇa jātā'smi tvatpriyā nṛpī ।।33।।
etāni yasya cāsthīni śeṣāṇi ca mamāpi ca ।
galitānyalpaśeṣāṇi smarāmi sarvameva tat ।।34।।
atha cātra prakartavyaṃ dharmakāryaṃ pramokṣadam ।
itiniścitya tau tatra viṣṇuloke sukhāvaham ।।35।।
cakraturbhajanādyaṃ ca dravyaratnādidānakam ।
dadatuḥ paramaprītau pātrebhyaḥ svāni śeṣataḥ ।।36।।
tatra sthitvā varārohe mama sevāvyavasthitau ।
tasmāt sthānād vapustyaktvā śvetadvīpamupāgatau ।।37।।
śuklāmbaradharau divyabhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitau ।
divyarūpadharau bhaktau mama bhāgavatau sadā ।।38 ।।
dīptimantau surūpau ca svarṇavacchubhadarśanau ।
caturbhujau yathā lakṣmīviṣṇū sāmarthyaśobhitau ।।39।।
tayoryo'bhūtparijanaścamatkāraṃ pravīkṣya saḥ ।
mama sevāparaścā'bhūt mama karmavyavasthitaḥ ।।1.568.40।
mānuṣaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya mama lokamupāgataḥ ।
sarvaśo dyutimāँstatra matsānnidhyamupāgataḥ ।।41 ।।
mama bhaktāḥ striyo lakṣmi tvatsvarūpo bhavanti vai ।
tejasā dīptimatyaśca śuddhasattvavibhūṣitāḥ ।।42।।
navayauvanapūrāśca sarvāścotpalagandhikāḥ ।
cārucampakavarṇābhā muktāḥ sarvāḥ priyavratāḥ ।।43।।
prasādānmama suśroṇi nityayauvanapūritāḥ ।
nityānandabhṛtāḥ sarvāḥ sarvasiddhisamanvitāḥ ।।44।।
eṣa dharmaśca kīrtiśca śaktiścāpi mahadyaśaḥ ।
karmaṇāṃ paramaṃ karma tapasāṃ ca mahattapaḥ ।।45।।
kathānāṃ paramaṃ cāpi kṛtīnāṃ paramā kṛtiḥ ।
vṛṣāṇāṃ paramo dharmo yanmamāśrayaṇaṃ param ।।46 ।।
mama dharmaṃ samāśritya rajo dhṛtvā ca mastake ।
prasādaprāśanaṃ kṛtvā mama loke mahīyate ।।47।।
mama pādajalaṃ pītvā snātvā mattīrthavāriṣu ।
mama sādhoranuvṛttiṃ pālayitvā muhurmuhuḥ ।।48।।
satāṃ sevāṃ sadā kṛtvā kṛtvā bhāgavatārcanam ।
śrutvā ca saṃhitāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃjñitām ।।49 ।।
janā yānti parāṃ muktiṃ cillīmatsyau yathā purā ।
etanmaraṇakāle'pi smṛtvā mucyeta bandhanāt ।।1.568.50।।
viśeṣeṇāpi te lakṣmi kathayāmi śubhakṣaṇam ।
kumudaṃ mārgaśīrṣaṃ ca vaiśākhaṃ śrāvaṇaṃ tathā ।।51 ।।
mamātimodapātrāṇi māsāścaite mamārcane ।
kārtike dvādaśīkāle navānnairnavapuṣpakaiḥ ।।52 ।।
pūjayennavavārbhiśca sa me lokāya kalpate ।
gate meghāgame kāle prasannaśaradāśraye ।।53।।
ambare vimale jāte vimale śaśimaṇḍale ।
nātiśīte na cātyuṣṇe kāle haṃsavirāviṇi ।।54।।
kumudotpalakalhārapadmasaurabhanirbhare ।
kumudasya tu māsasya bhavedyā dvādaśī śubhā ।।55।।
tasyāṃ māmarcayed yastu vrataṃ kuryāttathā mama ।
prabodhinīṃ pālayecca sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।।56।।
śiśire'pi mārgaśīrṣe dvādaśyāṃ kusumairnavaiḥ ।
mamārcanaṃ prakuryād yaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ।।57।।
māsaṃ mārgaśiraṃ yadvad vaiśākhaṃ cāpi me priyam ।
tatra puṣpādibhiścā'hamarcanīyo vrate dine ।।58।।
navavarṣasahasrāṇi navavarṣaśatāni ca ।
tiṣṭhate mama loke sa yo dadāti ca me'rcanam ।।59।।
ekekagandhapatrasya dānametanmahatphalam ।
kaumudasya tu māsasya mārgaśīrṣasya vai tathā ।।1.568.60।।
vaiśākhasya tu māsasya dvādaśyāṃ dhavale dale ।
ekabhaktiparo bhūtvā vanamālāṃ vibhūṣitām ।।6 1 ।।
puṣpāṇāṃ ca vibhūṣāśca gandhapuṣpāṇi yo nyaset ।
varṣāṇi dvādaśaiveha tena pūjā kṛtā bhavet ।।62।।
śālapuṣpaṃ sugandhi kaumudyāṃ candanamarpayet ।
utpalaṃ candanaṃ cāpi dadyānmārgaśire śubham ।।63।।
vaiśākhyāṃ sthalakamalaṃ jalaṃ śītaṃ saśarkaram ।
ikṣurasaṃ pradadyānme śāntidaṃ puṣṭidaṃ tathā ।।64।।
prāpnoti pradadānastu mama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca tataḥ param ।।65।।
paraṃ padaṃ sa me yāti puṇyasyā'nto na vidyate ।
na janmamaraṇe tasya na glānirna kṣudhā tṛṣā ।।66 ।।
evaṃvidhaṃ paraṃ lokaṃ prāpnuyānmama pūjakaḥ ।
phālgunasya tu māsasya śukladvādaśikātithau ।।67।।
ramyavāsantikaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayenmāṃ subhāvataḥ ।
śvetaṃ pāṇḍurakaṃ cāpi sugandhaṃ śobhanaṃ bahu ।।68।।
na sa gacchati saṃsāraṃ mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ।
vaiśākhyāṃ śālapuṣpāṇi śubhāni taruṇāni ca ।।69।।
datvā mahyaṃ ca bhaktebhyo jano mokṣāya kalpyate ।
prapūjya śrībhāgavatān sthāpayitvā'grataśca mām ।।1.568.7 0।।
pūjayet parayā prītyā naro nārī subhāvataḥ ।
sastuvantyṛṣayo mantrairbhaktāḥ stavaiḥ striyo hṛdā ।।71 ।।
gandharvā'psaraścāpi gītanṛtyaiḥ savādanaiḥ ।
stuvanti devalokāśca purāṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।।72।।
siddhā vidyādharā yakṣāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ ।
stuvanti devaṃ sarveṣāṃ māṃ śrīkṛṣṇanarāyaṇam ।।73।।
ādityā vasavo rudrā aśvinau ca marudgaṇāḥ ।
stuvanti devadeveśaṃ yugānāṃ saṃkṣaye'pi ca ।।74।।
pṛthvī vāyuśca viśve ca tejaḥ sūryādayo grahāḥ ।
samanvitāḥ stuvantyenaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।।75।।
svayaṃ brahmā ca somaśca śakraścāgniścidambaram ।
stuvanti śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ lokamaheśvaram ।।76।।
nāradaḥ parvatāścāpyasitaśca devalo muniḥ ।
pulahaśca pulastyaśca bhṛguścāṃgira ityapi ।।77।।
ete cānye ca bahavo mitrāvasuparāvasū ।
stuvanti māṃ rameśaṃ vai yogināṃ paramaṃ gurum ।।78।।
satyalokanivāsāścāṣṭāvaraṇadhṛtāśrayāḥ ।
vairājā īśvarāścāpi māṃ bhajante hiṃ mādhavi! ।।79।।
pitarastvaryamādyāśca yāmyāḥ śravaṇasaṃjñakāḥ ।
saṃvatsarāśca kālākhyā māṃ stuvanti tu nityaśaḥ ।।1.568.80।।
ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve dikpālā lokapālakāḥ ।
nidhayaḥ kṛttikāḥ kāṣṭhā anaṃgo manavastathā ।।8 1 ।।
kalāśca tithayaḥ sarvāstattvānyapi stuvanti mām ।
nakṣatrāṇi surāḥ sarve guṇā varṇā bhajanti mām ।।82।।
bhogāśca bhoginaḥ sarve yoginyaścāpsarogaṇāḥ ।
tīrthāni ca nadā nadyo nāḍikāḥ khanikāstathā ।।83 ।।
vālakhilyāḥ piśācādyā bhūtāḥ pretāḥ stuvanti mām ।
kūṣmāṇḍāścaṇḍikāḥ sarvā vetālāśca vināyakāḥ ।।84।।
ḍākinyaścāpi śākinyastathā kṛtyā bhajanti mām ।
jarāyūjā aṇḍajāśca svedajāḥ pārthivāṃkurāḥ ।।85।।
mānavā jalajāścāpi sthalajā dehinaśca mām ।
stuvanti duḥkhyavasthāyāmāśramasthā nirantaram ।।86।।
gṛhadevā grāmadevā vanāraṇyādidevatāḥ ।
vanāni parvatādyāśca taḍāgāni sravāṇi ca ।।87।।
akhātāni ca khātāni cābdhayo'pi stuvanti mām ।
ālayā grāmasaṃsthānāścetanā vai bhajanti mām ।।88।।
yamalokakṛtāvāsāḥ karmiṇastu muhurmuhuḥ ।
māṃ smaranti kṛpānāthaṃ samuddhārāya duḥkhataḥ ।।89।।
ārtāḥ stuvanti māṃ śaśvajjijñāsavaḥ kvacit kvacit ।
arthārthī yāvadarthasya lābho bhavati tāvatā ।।1.568.90।।
majjñā nityaṃ smarantyeva stuvanti ca bhajanti ca ।
sūtāśca māgadhāścāpi bandinaścāraṇādayaḥ ।।91 ।।
stāvakāḥ kathakāḥ sarve paṇḍāvanto bhajanti mām ।
nyāyadāḥ śāsakāścāpi caurāścāpaharāstathā ।।92।।
tāmasāḥ sāttvikā yadvā rājasāśca stuvanti mām ।
bhāṭṭā gāndharvakuśalāḥ kinnarāḥ kiṃpumarthakāḥ ।।93 ।।
sādhyāḥ sādhvyastathā satyo brahmacāriṇya ityapi ।
ābhicāriṇya evāpi māṃ stuvanti bhajanti mām ।। 94।।
nāgāḥ sarpā uragāśca sarīsṛpā mṛgādayaḥ ।
dharme nije vartamānāḥ sarve bhajanti māṃ khalu ।।95।।
yathābhāvaṃ dadāmyebhyaḥ phalaṃ karmānusāri vai ।
muktā bhajanti satataṃ hṛdi vāsaṃ pradāya me ।।96।।
tebhyo dadāmi hṛdayaṃ bhaktebhyo mama te yathā ।
evaṃ lakṣmi sadā sarve jīvāḥ protā mayi dhruvam ।।97।।
māṃ vinā naiva tiṣṭhanti kampante naiva māṃ vinā ।
prakāśaṃ naivāpnuvanti māṃ vinā hṛdayasthitam ।।98।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ pareśvaraḥ ।
kāmbhareyo mahārājaḥ saṃrāje sarvadehiṣu ।।99।।
mama bhāsā prabhāsante sarveṣāṃ hṛdayāni vai ।
mama śaktyā prakurvantīndriyāṇi grahaṇāni ca ।। 1.568.100 ।।
mamānvayena saṃsāro yāti viyāti vartate ।
mamopasthānahetvaitat sarvamānandabhūmikam ।। 101 ।।
ato lakṣmi! sadā sevyo nārāyaṇaḥ parātparaḥ ।
sarvartujanyasaddravyairmānasairbhavanaistathā ।। 1 02।।
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya jāgrato na svapimyapi ।
na me nidrā hi bhaktārthaṃ naudāsīnyaṃ madāśrite ।। 1 03।।
na cālasyaṃ svāvanārthe na mūrtiḥ premaśūnyake ।
iti jñātvā ye bhajanti stuvanti ca smaranti mām ।। 1 04।।
ta eva mokṣabhāgā vai narā nāryaḥ priye'bdhije ।
pāṭhakāḥ śrāvakāścāpi śrotāro mananārthinaḥ ।।1 05।।
sarve bhāvabharāḥ syuścet prayānti paramaṃ padam ।
sarvayajñaphalaṃ teṣāṃ mama vākye'nuvartinām ।। 1 06।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viṣṇostīrtharajomāhātmyaṃ śvetadvīpamuktāḥ kārtikamārgaśīrṣavaiśākhādidvādaśīṣu kṛtabhagavatpūjāphalaṃ sarvabhūtaprāṇimātrakṛtastutyādibhirbhagavatprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।568।।


← adhyāyaḥ 568 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 569
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 570 →


śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi! śaṃbhuḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ ।
pārvatīṃ prāha māhātmyaṃ mama tīrthādisaṃbhavam ।। 1 ।।
candradvīpaḥ prabhāsetustāmrapārṇeya ityapi ।
gabhastimān nāgadvīpaḥ saumyo gandharva ityapi ।। 2 ।।
vāruṇaḥ kaumārikeyaścaite deśā hi nārmadāḥ ।
narmadājalasiktāste tadvāripānakāriṇaḥ ।। 3 ।।
dehinaḥ puṇyayogena svarge mokṣe prayānti ca ।
jīvāḥ karmaphalaṃ sveṣāṃ prāpnuvanti śubhāśubham ।। 4 ।।
śreyo'rthaṃ ca tapo homaṃ dānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūjanam ।
kāruṇyaṃ narmadāsnānaṃ kartavyaṃ śubhalabdhaye ।। 5 ।।
ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam ।
kuvalayāśvo rājarṣiḥ purā kṛtayuge'bhavat ।। 6 ।।
anekāni sahasrāṇi dānāni vividhāni ca ।
dattāni tena rājñā vai sarvatīrtheṣu bhāvataḥ ।। 7 ।।।
iṣṭāśca kratavastena varjayitvā tu narmadām ।
rājā kuvalayāśvaḥ sa dānadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 8 ।।
rāhusūryasamāyoge kurukṣetraṃ yayau kila ।
lakṣamekaṃ hayānāṃ ca dantināmayutaṃ tathā ।। 9 ।।
hemamāṇikyaratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca ।
śraddhayā parayā yukto brāhmaṇebhyo dadau grahe ।। 1.569.1 0।।
śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ ca tatkṣetre sarvaṃ kaṃkaravannṛpaḥ ।
añjalinā pratisthalaṃ vikīrya snānamācarat ।। 11 ।।
tato jagāmā'vadhyāyāṃ nije rājye'bhajaddharim ।
atha rājā mucukundo viṣṇubhakto jitendriyaḥ ।। 1 2।।
daityānāmadhipaścāsīt sa ca sūryagrahe yayau ।
narmadāmoṃkāranāthaṃ vaidūryasiddhaparvatam ।। 1 3।।।
narmadākapilāyoge koṭitīrthe'vasacca saḥ ।
lakṣamekaṃ tu dogdhrīṇāmayutaṃ vājināṃ tathā ।। 158।।
sahasraṃ dantināṃ caiva rathānāṃ ca sahasrakam ।
kāmikānāṃ tu yānānāṃ sahasraṃ hemamālinām ।। 15।।
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvāsāṃsi ratnāni vividhānyapi ।
snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāyogyaṃ viprebhyaḥ pradadau tadā ।। 16।।
dadāvoṃkāranāthāya dakṣiṇāṃ ca śatāyutam ।
yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ tasmai sa prayacchati ।। 17।।
evaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ tīrthe svālayaṃ punarāyayau ।
atha kālāntare bhūpau svasvapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ ।। 18।।
svargaṃ prāptau cāpsarobhiḥ sevitāvindrasadṛśau ।
mucukundarathastūrdhvaṃ sadā prayāti vai divi ।। 1 9।।
kuvalayāśvayānaṃ tu tadadho yāti sarvadā ।
ubhau niveditau dūtairdharmarājasya dhīmataḥ ।। 1.569.20 ।।
kuvalayāśvo rājarṣirmucukundo mahābalaḥ ।
lokāntaramubhāvetau vimānasthau samāgatau ।।21 ।।
tāvadutpatitaṃ yānaṃ mucukundasya copari ।
yojanānāṃ sahasreṇa hyuparyupari vartate ।।25।।
avadhyā'dhipateryānamadhobhāge pravartate ।
śrutvā taddharmarājo'pi papraccha citraguptakam ।।23।।
kataraṃ pūjaye rājñorvad me'rghādikarmabhiḥ ।
puṇyabalaṃ dvayorvīkṣya prāha vai citraguptakaḥ ।। 24।।
mucukundaṃ prathamaṃ prārcaya revāpratāpataḥ ।
saptarṣīnapi papraccha te'bruvan citraguptavat ।। 25।।
mucukundaṃ samāsādya tvarghapādyena pūjaya ।
dānena kāpilenejyo dānavendro'tipuṇyavān ।।26।।
evamukto dharmarājo dānavendramupāśrayat ।
añjaliṃ tu tato baddhvā yānasyā'gre vyavasthitaḥ ।।27।।।
kuśalaṃ te'dya daityendra sarvadharmānvitau bhavān ।
nirjitāste trayo lokā dānenā'nena bhūtale ।। 28।।
oṃkāradakṣiṇasyā'nte mūrtau kāpilasaṃgame ।
saptakalpavahātīre puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate ।।29।।
evamuktvā pūjayitvā darśayāmāsa mārgakam ।
viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhalokasya mucukundo jagāma ha ।।1.569.30।।
athā''sādya tato bhūpaṃ kuvalayāśvameva tu ।
dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ prāha svāgataṃ te karomi vai ।।3 1 ।।
rājā prāha virodho vai devadānavayoḥ sadā ।
tvaṃ devo vai kathaṃ daityaṃ prāk prapūjitavānasi ।।32।।
māṃ tyaktvā dānavendraḥ sa pādyārghyeṇa tvayā'rcitaḥ ।
viparītaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ dharmarāja kṛtaṃ katham ।।33।।
yamaḥ prāha yathākarma kartavyaṃ me'vaśiṣyate ।
viṣādaṃ tyaja rājendra gahanā karmaṇāṃ gatiḥ ।।34।।
kurukṣetrādadhikaṃ vai puṇyaṃ syānnārmade sthale ।
kalāṃ nārhanti tīrthāni sārdhaṃ kalpagayā kvacit ।।35।।
karmasākṣī tu sarveṣāṃ yathānyāyaṃ karomi hi ।
sa rājā vismayāpanno drutaṃ natvā yameśvaram ।।36।।
narmadāṃ snātukāmaśca kapilāsaṃgamaṃ prati ।
āyayau saṃgame sasnau divyayānaṃ hi bhūbhṛtaḥ ।।37।।
tadā tūrdhvaṃ gataṃ pūrṇe viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam ।
etādṛśaṃ paraṃ puṇyapradaṃ tīrthaṃ hi nārmadam ।।38।।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ pāpakṣālakaṃ kamale priye! ।
janā pāpā api yānti muktiṃ revājalāplavāt ।।39।।
tīryate viṣṇudharmeṇa saṃsārābdhiḥ sudustaraḥ ।
raktā mūḍhāśca lokā vai pravartante'tipāpake ।।1.569.40 ।।
te nātmānaṃ vijānanti na kṛṣṇaṃ nahi devatāḥ ।
na śṛṇvanti paraṃ śreyaḥ sati cakṣuṣi nekṣate ।।41 ।।
same pathi śanairyānto plavante sma pade pade ।
yamamuktā api jīvā na jānanti prabodhitāḥ ।।42।।
kliśyante te vṛthā nānārāgalobhavaśā narāḥ ।
dṛṣṭvā garbhakhaniṃ kaṣṭāṃ pratyakṣāṃ trāsabodhinīm ।।43 ।।
mokṣamārgaṃ na buddhyanti teṣāṃ revā vimuktidā ।
pretabhūtā prajāḥ sarvā yamalokādhikārikāḥ ।।44।।
śivaḥ prāha śaṇu śaile! purākhyānaṃ vadāmi te ।
sūryeṇa kathitaṃ tvāsītpurākhyānaṃ tu nārmadam ।।45 ।।
yamāya nijaputrāya lokatāraṇahetave ।
āśrayennarmadāṃ devīṃ saptakalāvahāṃ satīm ।।46 ।।
snānāvagāhanātpānāt tathā dānakriyādibhiḥ ।
dhāmadā mokṣadā svargapradā śreyaḥpradā hi sā ।।47।।
dhyāyamānā narmadā pāpināṃ pāpavināśinī ।
saṃsmṛtā kīrtitā nāmnā svargadā yāmyavāriṇī ।।48।।
narmade narmade coktvā pāpo yāmyaṃ na paśyati ।
narakastho'pi revāṃ sa hariṃ haraṃ smared yadi ।।49।।
mucyate yamadūtaiḥ sa tatkṣaṇānnātra saṃśayaḥ ।
vaidūryaparvataḥ ṛkṣastathā cāmarakaṇṭakaḥ ।। 1.569.5 0 ।।
oṃkāro narmadā caite bhuktimuktiphalapradāḥ ।
siddheśvaraṃ ca yajñeśaṃ madhyasthaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam ।।5 1 ।।
kapileśaṃ caturthaṃ tacchivakṣetraṃ pramuktidam ।
teṣāṃ pūjāṃ prakurvanti puṣpadhūpā''rttitarpaṇaiḥ ।। 7। 2 ।।
śivalokaṃ tu ye yānti śāśvataṃ padamaiśvaram ।
godānaṃ hemadānaṃ ca tiladānaṃ tathaiva ca ।।23 ।।
annadānaṃ payodānaṃ sarvopaskaramityapi ।
prāsādā''rāmadānaṃ ca dadānā yānti mokṣaṇam ।।54।।
yamalokaṃ na te yānti bhaktā bhagavato nanu ।
loko vicāraṇīyo'yaṃ miśrito vartate sadā ।। 515।।
sanmānaṃ cāpamānena viyoge neṣṭasaṃgamaḥ ।
yauvanaṃ jarayā grastaṃ saukhyaṃ kaṣṭādupadrutam ।।56 ।।
balibhiḥ palitaiścāpi jarjarīkṛtavigrahaḥ ।
strīpuṃsoryauvanaṃ rūpaṃ yadanyonyaṃ priyaṃkaram ।। 57 ।।
tadeva jarayā grastamubhayorapi na priyam ।
apūrvavattathātmānaṃ śaithilyena samanvitam ।।58 ।।
yaḥ paśyanna virajyeta ko'nyastasmādacetanaḥ ।
jarā'bhibhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ patnīputrādibāndhavaiḥ ।।59।।
aśaktatvād durācārairbhṛtyaiśca paribhūyate ।
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ na jarayā yutaḥ ।।1.569.6 0 ।।
śaktaḥ sādhayituṃ tasmācchīghraṃ dharma samācaret ।
vātapītakaphādīnāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ vyādhimaṇḍalam ।।6 1 ।।
dehe tiṣṭhati nityaṃ vai bahuduḥkhakaraṃ muhuḥ ।
duḥkhāni svātmavedyāni kiṃ tatra vedyate paraiḥ ।।62।।
ekottaraṃ mṛtyuśataṃ he nityaṃ pravartate ।
tatraikaṃ kālarūpaṃ ca śeṣāstvāgantukāḥ smṛtāḥ ।।63 ।।
kālaḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ dehaṃ kṣapayatyeva śāntimān ।
āgantukāḥ kṣapayanti tattvāni hi pratikṣaṇam ।।64।।
āgantukā mṛtyavastu nātyantaṃ mārayanti vai ।
bheṣajādipratisparddhisādhanairvidravanti te ।।65।।
kālamṛtyuḥ kṣaṇādyātmā mahākālātmakastathā ।
japahomapradānādyairbhaiṣajaiśca na śāmyati ।।66 ।।
apamṛtyustu dehasya viṣamadyādisaṃbhavaḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ jalapātādivahnipātādisaṃbhavaḥ ।।67।।
kṣayaṃ karoti vṛṣṭyādi kīṭānāṃ jalapūrataḥ ।
jñātā'yaṃ puruṣo nityamapamṛtyorbibheti ca ।।68।।
vividhā vyādhayaḥ kaṣṭāḥ sarpādyāḥ prāṇino'pi ca ।
viṣāṇino'bhicārāśca mṛtyordvārāṇi dehinām ।।69।।
āvṛtaṃ rogasarpādyairapi dhanvantariḥ svayam ।
svasthaṃ kartuṃ na śaknoti kālagrastaṃ hi dehinam ।।1.569.70 ।।
nauṣadhaṃ na tapo dānaṃ na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ ।
paritrātuṃ samarthā no kālagrastaṃ pravāsinam ।।71 ।।
nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti mṛtyusamo ripuḥ ।
nāsti mṛtyusamaḥ kālo dehināṃ sukhamāninām ।।72 ।।
sadbhāryāsutamitrāṇi rājyaiśvaryasukhāni ca ।
mṛtyuśchinatti sarvāṇi vāryamāṇo'pi vegataḥ ।।73 ।।
idṃ tai kathitaṃ putra dharmarāja mayā'rthavat ।
pariṇāme bhavet sarvaṃ sarvathā kālabhojanam ।।74।।
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena sevyā nārāyaṇī sṛtiḥ ।
sarvaduḥkhaharā revā sarvaśokavināśinī ।।75।।
yān yān kāmayate kāmān tāṃstān revā prayacchati ।
jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ cādhyayanaṃ revāsevanameva tat ।।76।।
yajño dānaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ lakṣmi! revāmbusevanam ।
brahmakūrcasahasrāṇi revātoyasamāni na ।।77।।
godānaṃ tatra vai dattaṃ gomedhāyutapuṇyadam ।
śaśāṃko'bhūt purā rājā narmadātīramāśritaḥ ।।78।।
dānaṃ yajñaṃ tapaścakre parvate'marakaṇṭake।
dadau cārdhaprasūtāṃ gāṃ brāhmaṇāya mahātmane ।।79।।
dānasyā'sya prabhāveṇa divyūrdhvayāyānago'bhavat ।
yāvadvatsasya pādau dvau mukhaṃ yonau pradṛśyate ।।1.569.80 ।।
tāvadgauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā saśailavanakānanā ।
svarṇaśṛṃgī rūpyakhurī savatsā kāṃsyadohanā ।।8 1 ।।
narmadāsnānayuktā ca sakuśā tilasaṃyutā ।
oṃkārā'marayormadhye koṭitīrthe śaśāṃkakaḥ ।।82।।
etāḥ sahasrasaṃkhyākā brāhmaṇebhyo hyakalpayat ।
sa rājā dānapuṇyena divyayānena vai divi ।।83 ।।
rājate tu tadā nedurdevadundubhayo divi ।
tatkṣaṇe yānamārūḍho hariścandro'pi bhūpatiḥ ।।84।।
kurukṣetre gosahasraṃ datvā yānena cāyayau ।
dhṛtasvarṇātapatrastu vījyamānaśca cāmaraiḥ ।।85।।
yojanānāṃ sahasreṇa hariścandro hyadhaḥsthitaḥ ।
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā nimnabhāvaṃ jagāmā'jaṃ sa satvaram ।।86 ।।
viṣaṇṇavadano'pṛcchat pitāmahaṃ tu kāraṇam ।
mayā tu kaurave kṣetre dānaṃ dattamanantakam ।।87।।
śaśāṃkena tu revāyāṃ dānaṃ dattamanantakam ।
kathaṃ puṇyaṃ nārmadaṃ tu kurukṣetrād viśiṣyate ।।88।।
yenā'hamasmi nimnastho hariścandraḥ samūrdhvagaḥ ।
śrutvā brahmā hariścandraṃ prāha mā khedamāvaha ।।89।।
śaśāṃkena purā sūryagrahe'dryamarakaṇṭake ।
anekāni sahasrāṇi kṛtānīṣṭāni bhūpate ।। 1.569.9 0।।
anyataḥ sarvatīrthāni caikato'marakaṇṭakam ।
tolitaṃ ca mayā pūrvamamareśo viśiṣyate ।। 011 ।।
sevyatāṃ kalpagā devī yadicchetparamaṃ padam ।
hariścandrastato natvā yayāvamarakaṇṭakam ।। 92।।
narmadāyāstaṭe dravyaṃ dhanaṃ gāśca dadau tadā ।
atha puṇyodayenā'sya vimānaṃ cordhvagaṃ hyabhūt ।। 93 ।।
tadā santoṣamāpannaḥ kṛtvā rājyaṃ ciraṃ tataḥ ।
yayau vaikuṇṭhamevā'yaṃ narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।। 94।।
yadyapyanena dattāni kaurave ca bahūnyapi ।
dānāni tatphalaṃ naiva nārmadena samaṃ hyabhūt ।। 95।।
evaṃ vai nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvaśreyaskaraṃ param ।
bhuktidaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi koṭitīrthasamanvitam ।। 96।।
etatsarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ śivāyai śaṃkareṇa ha ।
mayā tubhyaṃ mahālakṣmi! proktaṃ tannārmadaṃ phalam ।। 97।।
yaḥ śṛṇoti jano lakṣmi gosahasraphalaṃ labhet ।
paṭhanācchravaṇātsmṛterlabhedvai tādṛśaṃ phalam ।। 98।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kuvalayāśvamucukundavimānavaiṣamye hariścandraśaśāṃkavimānavaiṣamye narmadāmarakaṇṭakamāhātmyādhikyādikathananāmaikonasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।569 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 570
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 571 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śrutaṃ vai nārmadaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ cāmareśvare ।
koṭitīrthodbhavaṃ kṛṣṇa! kurukṣetrāt sahasragam ।। 1 ।।
kathamevaṃ tvayā nātha racitaṃ māyayā purā ।
kvacitpuṇyaṃ kṛte sāmye kvacinnyūnaṃ tathā'dhikam ।। 2 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
sarvaṃ me racanālabhyaṃ narmadā saptakalpagā ।
sāptakālpikadevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca satāṃ tathā ।। 3 ।।
yogānmamā'vatārāṇāṃ narmadā sarvato'dhikā ।
nityaṃ ca pralaye revā kṣīrode ca mamāntikam ।। 4 ।।
pādasevāparā bhūtvā tiṣṭhate mama bhāminī ।
mama yogānmama māyā divyā bhavati cottamā ।। 2 ।।
śṛṇu māyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ mayā yādṛk prakalpitam ।
tat sṛṣṭvā'nupraviśāmi mama yogena śiṣyate ।। 6 ।।
śṛṇu māṃ na vijānanti rudrendrāḥ sapitāmahāḥ ।
mayā nārāyaṇenaiva kṛtā api sureśvarāḥ ।। '7 ।।
sarve tīrthamayāḥ santi mama vāsena sundari ।
parjanyau varṣati deśe deśo jalena pūryate ।। 8 ।।
vyoma nirjalatāṃ yāti māyā matkṛtirūpiṇī ।
punarjalaiḥ samāvṛttaṃ vyoma vai dṛśyate kṣaṇāt ।। 9 ।।
punarvṛṣṭiḥ punā riktaṃ māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā ।
pāvanaṃ tu jalaṃ sarvaṃ mama vāsena bhāmini! ।। 1.570.1 0।।
saṃkalpitaṃ viśeṣeṇa pāvanaṃ vai viśeṣataḥ ।
nirjharāṇāṃ jalaṃ sādhusevitaṃ pāvanaṃ yathā ।। 11 ।।
tato devaiḥ sevitaṃ pāvanataraṃ bhavatyapi ।
mayā prasevitaṃ tatpāvanatamaṃ prajāyate ।। 1 2।।
kiṃ muhuḥ sevitaṃ tacca tatrāpi pratikalpagam ।
mayā prasevitā revā kṣīrode matsamā tataḥ ।। 1 3।।
pāvanī pāvanānāṃ ca māṃgalyānāṃ ca maṃgalā ।
mokṣadānāṃ paramokṣapradā manmāyayā hi sā ।। 14।।
somo yatkṣīyate pakṣe pakṣe punarvivardhate ।
amāyāṃ dṛśyate naiva māyeyaṃ madvinirmitā ।। 15।।
hemante salilaṃ kūpe coṣṇaṃ bhavati sundari ।
jāyate śītalaṃ grīṣme māyeyaṃ ca mayā kṛtā ।। 16।।
bhāskaraścaikamārgeṇa sadā yāti na cānyathā ।
udeti pūrvato nityamastameti ca paścime ।। 17।।
nimnatāṃ mṛdutāṃ śaitye cordhvaṃ tu tigmatāṃ tataḥ ।
prayāti klṛptivaicitryānmāyeyaṃ mama sundari ।। 18।।
śukraṃ ca śoṇitaṃ bhinnaṃ bhinnadehe prajāyate ।
tayoryoge bhavedgarbho nānyathā tu kadācana ।। 1 9।।
sajātīye ca jāyeta na vaijātye prajāyate ।
garbhe praviśya jīvastu sukhaduḥkhe hi vindati ।।1.570.20।।
vinā dehaṃ na vai duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā cātmanaḥ kvacit ।
jātaśca vismared garbhaṃ māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā ।।21 ।।
yathākarma bhavejjanturbhinnadeho'pi jīvati ।
yathākarma bhavenmū+ṛtyurdehasthito'pi gacchati ।।22।।
śukraśoṇitasammiśre garbhe karkandhusadṛśe ।
aṅgulyaścaraṇau cāpi bhujau śīrṣaṃ kaṭistathā ।।23 ।।
pṛṣṭhaṃ tathodaraṃ cāpi dantauṣṭhapuṭanāsikāḥ ।
karṇau netre kapālau ca lalāṭaṃ jihvikā tathā ।।24।।
māyayā me bhavantyete jāyante jantavastataḥ ।
tasyaiva jīryate bhuktamagninā pītameva ca ।।25।।
adhastu sravate mūtraṃ māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā ।
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathā'pare ।।26।।
bhūtādyā mānasādyāśca prāṇādyā dhātavo'pi ca ।
pravartante'nnatattvādvai māyaiṣā nirmitā mayā ।।27।।
sarvartuṣu sahasreṣu gateṣvapi ciraṃ sthitaḥ ।
navartuṃ naiva jānāti svāsthyānukūlamityapi ।।28।।
bhojanādīni vastūni naiva jānāti tattvataḥ ।
kasmāt kīdṛgbhavellābho māyaiṣā mama sundari ।।29।।
āpo divyā mayā sṛṣṭā adṛśyād dṛśyarūpikāḥ ।
bhaumā nadyo bhavantyeva dṛṣṭau bahūdakāśca tāḥ ।।1.570.30।।
grīṣme śuṣyanti sarvāstāḥ punaścakraṃ tathaiva tat ।
udbhavanti praśuṣyanti māyaiṣā prativatsaram ।।3 1 ।।
ākāśaṃ śūnyarūpaṃ vai vāyuścāpi pravāhakaḥ ।
himālayaṃ samāsādya himātmako bhavatyapi ।।32।।
śilātmakaṃ himaṃ śṛṃgād dravatyeva śanaiḥ śaneḥ ।
gāṃgatā jāyate sā tu gaṃgā deśasukhāvahā ।।33।।
meghā vahanti salilamuddhṛtya lavaṇārṇavāt ।
varṣanti madhuraṃ loke kṣaraṃ vārdhau kṛtaṃ mayā ।।34।।
kvacittu kaṭurūpaṃ tat kvacinmiṣṭaṃ jalaṃ matam ।
bhinnaguṇaṃ jāyate tanmāyaiṣā mama padmaje ।।356।।
roganāśakaraṃ vīryamoṣadhe nikṣipāmyaham ।
oṣadhe dīyamāne vā kālo bhūtvā harāmyaham ।।36।।
garbho bālo yuvā vṛddhau jaraṭhaḥ śaktivarjitaḥ ।
bījamaṃkurakaṃ patraṃ kāṇḍaṃ nālaṃ ca puṣpakam ।।37।।
phalaṃ rasādi tṛptiśca bījād bījasahasrakam ।
kvacittu niṣphalaṃ bījaṃ māyaiṣā matkṛtā priye ।।38।।
matsṛṣṭāstu narā nāryo bhavanti śataputrakāḥ ।
mama te ca na putro'sti māyaiṣā mama padmaje ।।39।।
ekasmādeva dehācca jāyante jantukoṭayaḥ ।
mastake kīṭakā likṣā vastreṣu matkuṇādayaḥ ।।1.570.40 ।।
romakūpeṣu kīṭāśca svedād yūkādayastathā ।
aṃge chinne māṃsamadhye kṛmayaśca bhavantyapi ।।41 ।।
mūtre kīṭāḥ sūkṣmarūpā bhavantyeva nalādiṣu ।
vīryajanyāstathā garbhā jāyante'patyarūpiṇaḥ ।।42।।
ekasmādeva dehādvai jāyante bhinnasṛṣṭayaḥ ।
sarve putrāḥ svasya bālāḥ svasmājjātāstu te yataḥ ।। 43 ।।
visadṛśāstu kīṭādyāsteṣu sneho na vidyate ।
sadṛśe piṇḍake putre sneho bhavati dehinām ।।44।।
sarveṣu jantuṣu tveṣā mayā māyā nidhāpitā ।
ekatra śatrutā kīṭe'nyatra putre'tiraktatā ।।।45।।।
kīṭāraktapibā eva putrāḥ sarvapibā api ।
garbhe raktapibā mātuścāṃke dugdhapibāstathā ।।46।।
bālye dravyapibāścāpi yauvane sampadāmpibāḥ ।
vicittatve mṛtau śāntipibā asupibā api ।।47।।
evaṃ sarvapibe sneho māyaiṣā mama bhāmini! ।
nare nāryā bhavet sneho nāryā sneho narasya ca ।।48।।
nāryośca narayorvā na tādṛṅa māyā mamedṛśī ।
jale pṛthvyāṃ rase dehe vṛṣṭau bīje ca bhakṣite ।।।49।।
tatrā'mṛtaṃ visṛjāmi kṣudhāyāṃ tadvibhāvyate ।
akṣudhāyāṃ viṣaṃ tatsyānmāyaiṣā mama sundari ।।1.570.50।।
loka evaṃ vijānāti garuḍo vahate'cyutam ।
kintvahaṃ garuḍaṃ nītvā prayāmi cāntarasthitaḥ ।।51 ।।
lokāḥ sarve vijānanti devā nityaṃ makhāśinaḥ ।
kintvahaṃ makharūpeṇa yakṣyāmi tridivaukasaḥ ।।52।।
sarvelokā vijānanti gururdadāti dīkṣaṇam ।
kintvahaṃ tu gurau dīkṣārūpastiṣṭhāmi māyayā ।।53।।
sarve lokā vijānanti varuṇaḥ pāti sāgaram ।
kintvahaṃ varuṇe sthitvā rakṣāmi sāgarān sadā ।।54।।
sarve lokā vijānanti kubero dhanarakṣakaḥ ।
kintvahaṃ dhanarūpeṇa rakṣāmyasya kuberatām ।।55।।
sarve lokā vijānanti vṛtraḥ śakreṇa sūditaḥ ।
kintvahaṃ māyayā śakre sthitvā vṛtraṃ vyanāśayam ।।56।।
evaṃ lokā vijānanti sūryo nārāyaṇo mahān ।
kintvahaṃ sūryamāviśya prakāśayāmi yogyataḥ ।।57।।
dhruve dhrauvyaṃ mayā dattaṃ merau mādhyasthyamityapi ।
abdhau vāḍavarūpo'smi megheṣu vāyurūpavān ।।58।।
ākāśe tiṣṭhate vāri naiva paśyanti vai janāḥ ।
devā api na jānanti hyamṛtaṃ kutra tiṣṭhati ।।59।।
auṣadhaṃ māyayā sṛṣṭaṃ vane tiṣṭhati sarvathā ।
vīryaṃ tatrā''dadhāmyeva roganāśakaraṃ sadā ।।1.570.6 0।।
loko hyevaṃ vijānāti rājā pālayati prajā ।
kintvahaṃ nṛpamāviśya pālayāmi prajā mama ।।6 1।।
sṛṣṭau sāyaṃkālarūpo rātrau pralayarūpavān ।
prātargarbhasvarūpo'haṃ māyayaiva bhavāmi ca ।।62।।
sūryaḥ pācayati sarva māyayā'haṃ ravau sthitaḥ ।
vahniḥ pācayati sarvaṃ māyayā cānale sthitaḥ ।।63।।
sūryāśurūpavānasmi prakāśayāmi golakam ।
māyāṃ pralayakālinīṃ kṛtvā saṃhṛtya vai jagat ।।64।।
śeṣe śaye'pi śeṣaśca śete me māyayā tadā ।
paśya māyābalaṃ me tvaṃ strīrūpā vartase sadā ।।65।।
kathaṃ na jāyase lakṣmi puṃsvarūpā vadātra me ।
seyaṃ māyā mama lakṣmi strīrūpe te'sti ceṣṭatā ।।66।।
mamā'sti puṃsvarūpe ceṣṭatā māyā mamāsti sā ।
prajāpatiṃ haraṃ viṣṇuṃ sṛjāmi jalamadhyataḥ ।।67।।
te'pi māṃ nahi jānanti mama māyāvimohitāḥ ।
ṛṣirvipraḥ purākalpe somaśarmā'bhidho mama ।।68।।
bhakto'pi māyayā channo na viveda nijaṃ param ।
māyā mama viśālākṣi! rohiṇī lomaharṣiṇī ।।69।।
kvacidindriyalaulyena prabadhnātyapi yoginam ।
somaśarmā māyayā me karśitaḥ strītvamāpa ha ।।1.570.70।।
nāsīt tādṛk tasya karma nāparādhaḥ kṛtastathā ।
mamā''rādhanayukto'pi niṣādījanma cāptavān ।।71।।
nityaṃ cintayate mūrtiṃ mama lakṣmi! manoharām ।
atha dīrghena kālena tuṣṭo'haṃ bhaktikarmabhiḥ ।।72।।
tapobhiścāpi satataṃ pratyakṣatāmahaṃ gataḥ ।
varārthaṃ sa mayā proktastuṣṭo'smīṣṭaṃ dadāmi te ।। 73 ।।
ratnāni kāñcanaṃ gāśca sāmrājyaṃ cāpyakaṇṭakam ।
athavecchasi svargaṃ ca yatra saukhyaṃ varāṅganāḥ ।।74।।
dhanaṃ yānaṃ vāhanāni sainyānyapi ca sampadaḥ ।
hemabhāṇḍāni saudhāni kānakāni dyumanti ca ।।75।।।
akṣayāni ca pātrāṇi vividhānyamṛtāni ca ।
bhogān divyānaiśvarāṃśca vadā'rpayāmi te dvija ।।76 ।।
dadāmi te varaṃ vipra yāvatte cittacintitam ।
śrutvā madvacanaṃ vipro natvovāca śanairhi mām ।। 77।।
cenna prakupyate nātha varaṃ samanuyācate ।
yat tvayā bhāṣitaṃ deva sarvaṃ deyaṃ mama tvayā ।।78।।
evaṃ lakṣmi subhakto'pi yayāce lālasānvitaḥ ।
mayoktaḥ kathametadvai sarvaṃ vai yācase'nagha ।।79।।
bandhanaṃ mama bhaktasya mama khedāya jāyate ।
tadā''ścaryadarśanecchurmama māyādidṛkṣukaḥ ।।1.570.80 ।।
māṃ prāha madhuraṃ vākyaṃ virāgaṃ rāgamiśritam ।
nāhaṃ svarṇaṃ gāśca ratnaṃ rājyaṃ svargaṃ varāṃganāḥ ।।81।।
aiśvaryaṃ cā'kṣayaṃ pātraṃ cāmṛtaṃ yānavāhanam ।
bhoktumicchāmi bhagavan necchāmi divyatāṃ prabho ।।82।।
tathā svargasahasrāṇāmekaṃ vāpi na rocaye ।
kintu me vartate cecchā kathaṃ kṛtvā vikrīḍasi ।।83।।
nidarśanārthaṃ deveśa svalpaṃ draṣṭuṃ vṛṇomyaham ।
māyā vai dṛśyate satyā mithyocyate maharṣibhiḥ ।।84।।
kīdṛśīyaṃ veditavyā dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ pradarśaya ।
tatastasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa mayā tatra bhāṣitaḥ ।।85।।
te kiṃ me māyayā vipra bhaktiṃ kuru sukhaṃ labha ।
devā api na jānanti māyayā me vimohitāḥ ।।86।।
tvaṃ tu naiva vijānāsi māyāyāṃ patito'pi san ।
jijñāsasi hyayogyaṃ vai kṛtakāryo'pi vai punaḥ ।।87।।
bhavituṃ cā'kṛtakāryaḥ kathaṃ cecchasi śocanam ।
evamukto'pi mugdhaḥ sa māyayā māmuvāca ha ।।88।।
yadi tuṣṭo'si me kṛṣṇa bhaktyā vā tapasā mama ।
māyāṃ darśaya me svalpāṃ yathā jānāmi tādṛśam ।।89।।
sarva saṃsāracakraṃ vai punarbaddho bhavāmi na ।
tato mayoditaṃ tasmai yāhi kubjāmrakaṃ sthalam ।।1.570.90।।
gaṃgātīraṃ mahādivyaṃ tatra sarvamavāpsyasi ।
śrutvā madvacanaṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ ca māṃ tataḥ ।।9 1 ।।
yayau kubjāmrakaṃ tīrthaṃ prātarmāyābhilāṣukaḥ ।
tataḥ kanthāṃ vaṃśadaṇḍaṃ jalapātraṃ ca kañcukam ।।92।।
pātheyaṃ ca taṭe nyasya natvā gaṃgāṃ punaḥ punaḥ ।
jalamādhāya śirasi kṛtvā''camanamityatha ।।93।।
pītvā jalaṃ ca māṃ smṛtvā snātuṃ viveśa vāriṣu ।
tāvanme māyayā vipro jale cā'dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।।94।।
pārśve niṣādasadane tatstrīgarbhagato'bhavat ।
hṛdaye'cintayattatra garbhakleśena pīḍitaḥ ।।95।।
aho kaṣṭaṃ mayā prāptaṃ kasyacid duṣkṛtasya ha ।
yo'haṃ niṣādikāgarbhe vasāmi narakātmake ।।96।।
dhik tapo dhik ca me karma dhik phalaṃ dhik ca jīvitam ।
yo'haṃ niṣādagarbhe'tra tiṣṭhāmi mūtrasaṃkule ।।97।।
durgandhe duḥsahe vātapittaśleṣmarajovahe ।
alaṃ kiṃ bhāṣaṇenā'tra naṣṭe kiṃ rodanena vai ।।98।।
māyājijñāsayā mūtrakedārikāṃ praveśitaḥ ।
kuto viṣṇuḥ kutaścāhaṃ kvāste gaṃgājalaṃ hi tat। ।।99।।
kvā'yaṃ niṣādikāgarbhaḥ kvā'yaṃ mūtrahradastathā ।
garbhasaṃsāraniṣkrāntaḥ paścādāpsyāmi śāntatām ।। 1.570.10 0।।
evaṃ cintayamānasya navamāsātmakaṃ kṣaṇam ।
vyatītaṃ daśame māsi pūrṇe garbhādbahirgataḥ ।। 101 ।।
bhūmyāṃ tu patatastasya naṣṭaṃ garbhe vicintitam ।
ajāyata ca sā kanyā niṣādaputrikā tataḥ ।। 1 02।।
vipratvaṃ vismṛtaṃ sarvaṃ tayā māyāvimugdhayā ।
atha pitrā kṛtodvāhā yuvatī dhīvarapriyā ।।1 0 3।।
ṣaṭ putrān suṣuve kanyā sapta varṣadvayāntare ।
bhakṣyā'bhakṣyaṃ khādati sma peyā'peyaṃ pibatyapi ।। 1 04।।
śaśādīn ghātayitvā cāmiṣāhāraṃ karotyapi ।
kāryā'kāryaṃ na jānāti vācyāvācyaṃ na vetti sā ।। 1 05।।
gamyāgamyaṃ na jānāti māyājālāvṛtā yataḥ ।
pañcāśadvarṣake kāle mayā sā preritā hṛdi ।। 106 ।।
ghaṭaṃ gṛhītvā viṭliptavastrakṣālanakāraṇāt ।
yayau snātuṃ tu tatraiva yatra nyastaṃ purā'mbaram ।। 1 07।।
tīre niḥkṣipya vastrāṇi ghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpya sā taṭe ।
prasvedagharmasantaptā saśiraḥsnānamicchukī ।। 1 08।।
snātuṃ viveśa gaṃgāyāṃ tāvajjātaḥ sa bhūsuraḥ ।
somaśarmā'bhidho vipraḥ sasmāra pūrvavṛttakam ।। 1 09।।
bahistvāgatya vai kūle prātaḥkāle dhṛtāँśca yān ।
vastradaṇḍakalaśāँścā'paśyanmadhyāhnake kṣaṇe ।। 1.570.11 0।।
pārśve tatraiva nāryā ca dhṛtā viḍvastragargarīḥ ।
apaśyattu mahāścaryaṃ prāpa madhyandine tadā ।। 11 1।।
vipraḥ sa dhīvarīvastrādikaṃ tyaktvā tataḥ purā ।
tyaktaṃ dhautraṃ ca jagrāha dhārayāmāsa lajjayā ।। 11 2।।
śuśocāti tadā smṛtvā niṣadya samavāluke ।
mayā kiṃ karma pāpena kṛtaṃ nindyaṃ suduḥkhadam ।। 11 3।।
yenā''cārāt paribhraṣṭo gataścaitādṛśīṃ daśām ।
niṣādī hyabhavaṃ bhakṣyā'bhakṣyaṃ naivā'vicārayam ।। 1 14।।
jīvānaghātayaṃ sarvāñjalasthalādivāsinaḥ ।
peyā'peyaṃ kṛtavāँścā'gamyāgamanamācaram ।। 1 15।।
vācyāvācyaṃ na vai dṛṣṭaṃ cauryādikaṃ muhuḥ kṛtam ।
putrā duhitaraścāpi niṣādājjanitā mayā ।। 1 16।।
vartante bālakāḥ stanyapānārhāśca gṛhe mama ।
pratīkṣante tvāgamaṃ me jātaścāhaṃ naro'tra vai ।।1 17।।
kiṃ kāryaṃ kimakāryaṃ vai māyāmohaṃ tarāmi na ।
apatyaśokasaṃvyāpto vipratāsmaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।। 1 18।।
vipro bhūtvā'tilajjāvān maunaṃ ca niṣasāda saḥ ।
etasminnantare tatra niṣādo bālakāstathā ।। 11 9।।
cirakālagatatvena mārgayituṃ tadā''yayuḥ ।
tatra tāṃ te mṛgayanti bhārye mātaśca rodinaḥ ।। 1.570.120 ।।
pṛcchati sma ca taṃ vipraṃ niṣādo bālakairyutaḥ ।
tvayā dṛṣṭā'sti me patnī dvijā'tra snātumāgatā ।। 121 ।।
bālā duhitarastasyā rudanti karuṇaṃ gṛhe ।
stanyapānaṃ vinā cāpi madhyabhojanamantarā ।। 1 22।।
kinnu paśyatha bho viprā anye narāśca yoṣitaḥ ।
mama bhāryāṃ jalaṃ netuṃ vastraṃ kṣālayituṃ tathā ।। 123 ।।
snātuṃ samāgatāṃ cātra yadi ced vadathā'tra me ।
ghaṭamādāya hastena tvāgatā bhālitā yadi ।। 1 24।।
kintu pratyuttaraṃ nāptvā ruroda sa tadā punaḥ ।
janāḥ paśyanti taṃ vipraṃ daṇḍakalaśasaṃyutam ।। 1 29।।
na paśyanti ca tāṃ nārīṃ dadyuḥ pratyuttaraṃ katham ।
bhīlo duḥkhena santapto dṛṣṭvā kuṃbhapaṭādikam ।। 1 26।।
apaśyaṃśca svakāṃ patnīṃ karuṇaṃ paryavedayat ।
api grāheṇa kenāpi snāyamānā dhṛtā kimu ।। 1 27।।
na cā'priyaṃ mayā'styuktā kadācittvapi karmasu ।
svapne'pi noktapūrvā'sti nātmaghātaḥ prasaṃbhavet ।। 1 28।।
kintu krūrapiśācena bhakṣitā vāpi rakṣasā ।
yadvā prasahya kenāpi nītā deśāntaraṃ bhavet ।। 1 29।।
kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkataṃ pūrvaṃ mayā karma hi kaṣṭadam ।
yena matpurato bhāryā'lpā''yuṣye vigatiṃ gatā ।। 1.570.130 ।।
ehi me subhage kānte mama cittānuvartini ।
paśyaitān bālakān kanyā rudataḥ kṣudhitāṃstathā ।। 131 ।।
kāmaṃ māṃ kṣudhitaṃ cāpi jñāsyase tvaṃ pipāsitam ।
yadi daiva śṛṇoṣyatra dharmeṇa dehi me priyām ।। 1 32।।
eva vilapamānasya niṣādasya tvitastataḥ ।
savrīḍaṃ bhāṣate vipro niṣādaṃ gaccha nāsti sā ।। 1 33।।
yathā karma gatā sā te sarvathā hyanivṛttaye ।
bālāँstān parirakṣasva gaccha kiṃ kliśyase vṛthā ।। 1 34।।
kāruṇyātte kathayāmi tavā'haṃ sā priyā'bhavat ।
snānamātreṇa tu muniḥ pūrvavanmāyayā'bhavam ।। 1 35।।
niṣādaḥ prāha taṃ vipraṃ strītvaṃ prāpto'si vai katham ।
puṃstvaṃ cāpi kathaṃ prāpta etadācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ।। 1 36।।
vipraḥ prāha harirbhaktyā mayā sākṣātkṛtastadā ।
vareṇa chandayāmāsa mayā'pi cepsitaṃ tadā ।। 1 37।।
māyāṃ me darśaya nātha kīdṛśī sā bhavediti ।
tato'haṃ tena cāpyukto gaccha kubjāmrake jale ।। 1 38।।
tatra drakṣyasi cetyuktvā tvantardhānaṃ jagāma saḥ ।
ahamāgatya gaṃgāyāṃ snātvā niṣādabālikā ।। 139 ।।
niṣādīgarbhasaṃbhūtā tava patnyabhavaṃ tataḥ ।
adya snātvā punarjāto brāhmaṇo vai yathāpurā ।। 1.570.140।।
śrutvaivaṃ sa niṣādaśca bālakāśca tiro'bhavan ।
ahaṃ tvāsaṃ ca tadrūpo lakṣmi! māyāpradarśakaḥ ।। 141।।
madhyāhne cāgatā viprāḥ snātuṃ te somaśarmakam ।
prāhuḥ kathaṃ nu pūrvāhṇaścā'dya tīre prayāpitaḥ ।। 142।।
prātarārabhya caivātrā''madhyāhnaṃ tiṣṭhase katham ।
dinārdhe darśitā māyā pañcāśadvārṣikī priye! ।। 143।।
athā'ha darśayitvā svaṃ tamavocaṃ purākṛtam ।
bhavāntare tvayā bhaktāḥ sādhavo nābhivāditāḥ ।। 144।।
tatpāpādīdṛśo bhogo māyāmiṣeṇa te'bhavat ।
gaccha vipra paraṃ dhāma śvetadvīpaṃ sukhī bhava ।। 145।।
vipro yayau tato dhāma nārāyaṇastiro'bhavat ।
māyātīrthamidaṃ lakṣmi! mokṣadaṃ vartate bhuvi ।। 146।।
śravaṇāt kīrtanāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavet khalu ।
pārvatyai śaṃkaraḥ prāha nārmade kṣetrake purā ।। 147।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavatkṛtamāyāracanā, somaśarmaviprasya māyādarśane niṣādīstrītvaṃ, dvādaśā'patyamātṛtvaṃ, punarjalanimajjane vipratvaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ, māyātīrthamāhātmyaṃ ceti-
nirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 570 ।।
