adhyāyaḥ 571
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 572 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi jaṃgamaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।
ye tu bhāgavatāḥ śuddhāste nūnaṃ mama mūrtayaḥ ।। 1 ।।
tānsādhūnye namasyanti te māmeva namanti vai ।
vidito'smīha kamale tairahaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ।। 2 ।।
mama darśanakāmā ye te me bhaktā dvijādayaḥ ।
śuddhā bhāgavatāḥ pūjyā draṣṭavyāḥ sarvadā nṛbhiḥ ।। 3 ।।
viśeṣeṇa kṣitau sādhudvijarūpeṇa cāsthitaḥ ।
tasmāt sādhusevakā ye te me bhaktā na saṃśayaḥ ।। 4 ।।
yo māṃ prāptamihecchedvai paraṃ mokṣaṃ tataḥ sa ca ।
ananyamānaso bhūtvā sa madbhaktān pratoṣayet ।। 5 ।।
māṃ yathā ca tathā sādhūn sādhvīḥ pratoṣayet sadā ।
sevayā cānuvṛttyā ca yatheṣṭasampradānataḥ ।। 6 ।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi purākalpakathāṃ yathā ।
raibhyo nāma maharṣirvai jalamadhye tale vasan ।। 7 ।।
mamaivārādhane yukto nirvāṇakarmaniṣṭhitaḥ ।
yogī jitendriyaścāsīt tāpaso divyavigrahaḥ ।। 8 ।।
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi cordhvabāhuḥ sthito'bhavat ।
sahasraṃ cāmbubhakṣo'bhūt tāvacchaivalabhakṣaṇaḥ ।। 9 ।।
bhūmivāsaṃ tatastyaktvā jale'yutamuvāsa saḥ ।
bhaktyā tu parayā tenarṣiṇā cārādhito hyaham ।। 1.571.1 0।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
mantraṃ japan ca māṃ dhyāyan sa cāste jalamadhyagaḥ ।। 11 ।।
tena prīto'bhavaṃ tasya raibhyasya sannidhau jale ।
gaṃgāyāmagamaṃ sākṣājjalaṃ śuṣkāyitaṃ mayā ।। 1 2।।
raibhya utthāya ca tīre āmradruṃ samupāyayau ।
viśālo'pi tadā cāmraḥ kubjabhāvaṃ gato'bhavat ।। 13 ।।
ṛṣimācchādya tu yathā chatravat tiṣṭhate drumaḥ ।
ahaṃ kubjastathā bhūtvā'pyāmrasyā'dho gato'bhavam ।। 14।।
kubjāmrakaṃ hi gaṃgāyāṃ tīrthaṃ tatkathyate bhuvi ।
māṃ vīkṣya śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pratyakṣamāgatam ।। 15।।
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā māṃ tuṣṭāva rameśvaram ।
namaskṛtya sthitaṃ taṃ ca mama bhaktaṃ purātanam ।। 16।।
vareṇa chandayāmāsa tvahaṃ tasya dayākaraḥ ।
so'pyuvācātra he nātha nivāsaṃ kuru sarvadā ।। 17।।
tvayi bhaktiḥ sadā bhūyānmamāpyatra sthale prabhau ।
anyabhaktirmama vibho rocate na kadācana ।। 18।।
nityaṃ tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi drakṣyāmyatrāpi bhāgyataḥ ।
nivatsyāmi tvayā sārdhaṃ yathā hyakṣarasaṃsthitaḥ ।। 1 9।।
upendra yadi tuṣṭo'si mamā'yaṃ dīyatāṃ varaḥ ।
mayā bāḍhaṃ varo datto nivāsaṃ tatra cā'labham ।। 1.571.20 ।।
evaṃ bhaktavaśaścā'smi bhakto'haṃ mayi bhaktarāṭ ।
abhedastvāvayorlakṣmi! yathā śrīśrīśayoḥ sadā ।।2 1 ।।
tatra kubjāmrake bhadre sthānaṃ tu mama rocate ।
puṇḍarīkākṣanāmā'haṃ tatra tiṣṭhāmi sundari! ।।22।।
mama vāsālaye vṛttaṃ purāścaryaṃ mahādbhutam ।
mama nirmālyotkare vai vyālī tiṣṭhati nirbhayā ।।।23।।।
gandhamālyopahārāṇi bhakṣayantī yadṛcchayā ।
athaikadā nakulo vai sthalāntarāt samāgataḥ ।।24।।
tena dṛṣṭā sarpiṇī sā tayoryuddhaṃ tadā'bhavat ।
māghe śukle dvādaśyāṃ tu madhyāhne mama mandire ।।25।।
vyālyā daṣṭo nakulaḥ sa nakulenāpi sarpiṇī ।
ubhau kṣataistīvravaraistadā pañcatvamāgatau ।।26।।
vyālī prāgjyotiṣe jātā rājaputrī tu roṣiṇī ।
kosalādhipateḥ putro'bhavattu nakulaḥ saruṭ ।। 27।।
avardhatāṃ ca tau pūrvasaṃskārasaṃyutāvubhau ।
sā kanyā nakulaṃ dṛṣṭvā sadyo hantuṃ pradhāvati ।। 28।।
vyālīṃ dṛṣṭvā rājaputraḥ sahasā hantumeti ca ।
tayorvivāho bhāgyācca pūrvabandhānusārataḥ ।।29।।
sañjātaśca dvayoḥ prītirabhūdvai jatukāṣṭhavat ।
evaṃ tayorgataḥ kālo varṣāṇāṃ saptasaptatiḥ ।।1.571.3 0।।
viharantau samudyāne tvekadā śādvale sthale ।
dṛṣṭvā vyālīṃ rājaputrastāṃ vihantumupādravat ।।3 1 ।।
patnyā'tivāryamāṇo'pi vyālī jaghāna jīvataḥ ।
tadā sā roṣagā rājñī hṛdi duḥkhamavāpa ha ।।32।।
tasyāmeva ca velāyāṃ rājaputryagrato bilāt ।
nakulo daivayogādvai vinirgatya prayāti hi ।।33 ।।
dṛṣṭvā taṃ rājaputrī sā nakulaṃ śubhadarśanam ।
krodhājjaghāna daṇḍena vāritā'pyatibhūbhṛtā ।।34।।
nakulaṃ ghātitaṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃgalyaṃ rājabhūṣaṇam ।
kupito rājaputraśca rājaputrīmabhāṣata ।। 35।।
strīṇāṃ bhartā sadā mānyastaṃ māmullaṃghya niṣṭhure ।
darśanīyaḥ priyo rājñāṃ māṃgalyaḥ śubhasūcanaḥ ।।36।।
ghātito nakulaḥ kasmānmayā vai vāryamāṇayā ।
iti bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca nṛpātmajā ।।37।।
asakṛd vāryamāṇo'pi vyālī ghātitavān yataḥ ।
tasmānmayā'pi nakulo ghātitaḥ sarpaghātakaḥ ।।38।।
rājaputraśca tāṃ prāha yuktiyuktaṃ hi tarjayan ।
sarpastīvraviṣaḥ patni! yaddaṃśānmriyate janaḥ ।।39।।
tasmānmayā hato duṣṭo'hitakārī viṣoddhataḥ ।
prajāpālo nṛpaḥ prokto daṇḍayāmyapathe sthitān ।।1.571.40।।
sādhūn ye cāpi hiṃsanti hyaparādhavivarjitān ।
striyaṃ caivāpi hiṃsanti te daṇḍyā rājadharmataḥ ।।41।।
mayaivaṃ rājadharmo vai kartavyastena sā hatā ।
vada tvaṃ cāparāddhaṃ kiṃ nakulena tavā'tra kim ।।42।।।
darśanīyaśca māṃgalyo rājñāṃ yogyo gṛheṣvapi ।
dyūte'pi kuśalaḥ so'yaṃ nakulaḥ kiṃ tvayā hataḥ ।।43।।
mayā nivāryamāṇā'pi prāṇānnītavatī yataḥ ।
tato mama na bhāryā'si na cāhaṃ te patiḥ sthitaḥ ।।44।।
kiñca tena na hanmi tvāṃ striyo'vadhyāḥ sadaiva yat ।
ityuktvā tāṃ tadudyāne tyaktvā gṛhaṃ yayau nṛpaḥ ।।45।।।
evaṃ krodhaṃ samādāya naṣṭasnehau babhūvatuḥ ।
atha vārtā prajāyāṃ sā'prasarat karṇakarṇataḥ ।।46।।
śrutvā rājakumārasya pitarau kosaleśvarau ।
vṛddhau snuṣāṃ kumāraṃ cā''hvayāmāsaturantike ।।47।।
vadhūputrau tato dṛṣṭvā pitā vacanamabravīt ।
putra! kutra gataṃ prema yuvayoḥ kāraṇaṃ nu kim? ।।48।।
atisnigdhau sadā yuvāṃ viruddhācaraṇau katham ।
putra! dakṣo'si dharmiṣṭhāṃ naināṃ tyaktuṃ tvamarhasi ।।49।।
apriyaṃ noktapūrvaṃ tu yayā neṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ tava ।
sadā tvattoṣaṇe dakṣā tvayā tyaktuṃ na yujyate ।।1.571.50।।
gṛhadharmo rājadharmaḥ sadā yoṣitkṛtaḥ khalu ।
vaṃśadharmo yajñadharmaḥ strībhya eva pravartate ।।51 ।।
evaṃ pitṛvacaḥ śrutvā kumāraḥ pratyabhāṣata ।
doṣo na vidyate tāta! snuṣāyāṃ ko'pi kutracit ।।52।।
kiṃ mayā vāryamāṇā'pi nakulaṃ me'grato'hanat ।
tato'bhavanmama krodho mayeyaṃ paribhāṣitā ।।53 ।।
mama bhāryā na bhavatī na cāhaṃ tava vai patiḥ ।
putrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vadhvāḥ śuśrāva bhūpatiḥ ।।54।।
śirasā praṇatiṃ kṛtvā sedaṃ vacanamabravīt ।
aparādhavihīnā ca bhītā sā sarpiṇī nṛpa ।।।55।।
mayā'tivāryamāṇena rājaputreṇa ghātitā ।
tato'haṃ krodhasantaptā maunamāsthāya saṃsthitā ।।56 ।।
tāvaddṛṣṭo nakulaśca mayā krodhena tāḍitaḥ ।
vāryamāṇā kumāreṇa punardaṇḍena tāḍitaḥ ।।57।।
anyonyapratispardhitvānmayā vai nakulo hataḥ ।
atra nyāyaṃ kuru rājan dehi daṇḍaṃ karomi tat ।।58।।
vadhūputravacaḥ śrutvā rājā''ha nipuṇaṃ vacaḥ ।
tiryañcoḥ kāraṇe kasmād yuvāṃ viśleṣamāpnuthaḥ ।।59।।
hate tu nakule putra kiṃ te krodhasya kāraṇam ।
rājaputri hatāyāṃ sarpiṇyāṃ krodhaṃ karoṣi kim ।।1.571.6 0।।
alpahetorbahunāśaṃ kathaṃ svīkurutho vṛthā ।
piturvacaḥ śubhaṃ śrutvā jātismaraḥ kumārakaḥ ।।61 ।।
pratyuvāca hi pitaraṃ prāksvabhāvaḥ pravartate ।
prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigraho'tra na vidyate ।।62।।
svalpe'pi kāraṇe vairaṃ prāgjanmīyaṃ pravartate ।
evaṃ śrutvā putravākyaṃ pitā prāha sutaṃ tadā ।।63।।
brūhi putra yathānyāyaṃ prītivicchedakāraṇam ।
prāgjanīyaṃ bhaved yad tadubhayoriha kathyatām ।।64।।
pitṛpṛṣṭaṃ tu ced guptaṃ na gopāyanti satsutāḥ ।
satyaṃ vā'satyamevā'pi cenna bruvanti putrakāḥ ।।65।।
patanti narake te vai raurave taptavāluke ।
pitrā pṛṣṭhaṃ tu ye brūyuḥ śubhaṃ vā'śubhameva ca ।।66।।
divyāṃ tu te gatiṃ yānti yā gatiḥ satyavādinām ।
śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ putraḥ pitaraṃ prāha sādaram ।।67।।
kubjāmrakaṃ ca yattīrthaṃ tatra gatvā mahīpate! ।
tadguptameva vaktavyaṃ prītivicchedakāraṇam ।।68।।
bāḍhaṃ tvāha tadā rājā rājñī prāha tathaiva ca ।
athā'mātyān gurūn rājā cāhūya samuvāca tān ।।69।।
kubjāmrakaṃ śubhaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchāmastasya sādhanam ।
śīghraṃ sampādyatāṃ cāpi yujyantāṃ gajavājinaḥ ।।1.571.70।।
gajāśvapaśuyānādikārṣāpaṇakadhenavaḥ ।
suvarṇaratnavastrāṇi tvannāni vividhānyapi ।।71 ।।
atha rājā sutaṃ prāha deśakālocitaṃ tadā ।
rājyaṃ śūnyaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmo vayaṃ suta! ।।72।।
jyeṣṭhaputraḥ sa covāca kanīyase pradehi tat ।
rājā prāha tathā syācced dharmalopo bhaved yataḥ ।।73।।
kathaṃ deyaṃ kaniṣṭhāya vidyamāne'graje sute ।
jyeṣṭhaḥ prāhā'nujānāmi tātā'smai dehi medinīm ।।74।।
na syād dharmavilopo'tra mamā'stitvaṃ na vai bhavet ।
nā'haṃ kubjāmrakaṃ gatvā nivartiṣye punargṛham ।।75।।
etatsatyavaco matvā kanīyāṃsaṃ pradehi vai ।
śrutvaivaṃ bhūpatiḥ rājye kaniṣṭhamabhyaṣecayat ।।76।।
rājā tīrthaṃ yayāvantaḥpuravargādinā saha ।
tatastīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।।77।।
annavastrasuvarṇāni gohastyaśvagṛhāṇi ca ।
tato rātryāṃ vyatītāyāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ sutaḥ snuṣāyutaḥ ।। 78।।
snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā natvā gurūn punaḥ punaḥ ।
pituḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā mātaraṃ cābhivādya ca ।।79।।
nirmālyakūṭaṃ yatrā''sīnmandirasyā'ntike dhruvam ।
gatvā tatrāha pitaraṃ nakulo'haṃ purābhavam ।।1.571.80।।
kadalīnāṃ samudyāne cātra vāso'bhavanmama ।
atra cāśīviṣā sarpī mayā dṛṣṭā hi sannidhau ।।8 1।।
māghaśukladvādaśikādine prātastadā''vayoḥ ।
yuddhyatorjātivaireṇa tīkṣṇaṃ sandaśatordvayoḥ ।।82।।
samakāle'bhavanmṛtyuḥ kubjāmrake sutīrthake ।
devāśraye ca tatpuṇyādahaṃ tava suto'bhavam ।।83।।
snuṣā te sarpiṇī seyaṃ prāgjyotiṣasutā'bhavat ।
evaṃ prāgbhavasaṃskārāt sarpyāṃ ca nakule dvayoḥ ।।84।।
vairaṃ pravartate nau ca tacca vicchedakāraṇam ।
athā''vayormahārāja pūrṇamāyuḥ kṣayaṃ gatam ।।85।।
tīrthe'tra spaṣṭavāṇyā vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāva eva ca ।
ityuktvā tau hariṃ natvā puṇḍarīkākṣameva ca ।।86।।
pitarau ca tathā'mātyān dehaṃ tyaktvā kṣaṇāntare ।
divyau bhūtvā vimānena caturbhujadharāvubhau ।।87।।
śvetadvīpaṃ yayaturvai viṣṇupārṣadayānagau ।
rājādyā vismayaṃ prāpuḥ rājā'pi bhaktimāँstadā ।।88।।
putraśokena santapto vrataṃ tapaścakāra ha ।
svalpakālena saṃsādhya siddhiṃ vai tāpasīṃ parām ।।89।।
yayau patnyā saha dehaṃ tyaktvā vaikuṇṭhameva ca ।
divyaṃ vai paramaṃ dhāma yatra devo janārdanaḥ ।।1.571.90 ।।
mamā'tīva prasādena tapasaśca balena ca ।
kṛtvā madbhajanaṃ tatra mamā''kṣarapadaṃ yayau ।।91 ।।
yo'sau parijanastasya kṛtvā so'pi ca sukṛtam ।
kubjāmrake parāṃ siddhiṃ prāptvā maddhāma saṃyayau ।।92।।
evaṃ kubjāmrakaṃ tīrthaṃ raibhyena tu vivardhitam ।
puṇḍarīkākṣa vāsāḍhyaṃ rājaputravimuktidam ।।93।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛtṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
japan snānaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā pānaṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ tathā ।।94।।
darśanaṃ mama mūrteśca kṛtvā nārī naro'pi vā ।
prakṣālya sarvapāpāni prayāti paramāṃ gatim ।।95।।
uktamantraḥ paro jāpyaścāturvarṇyena sarvadā ।
sarvakarmasu mukhyārthaḥ kāmbhareyo'tra devatā ।।96 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo rādhāprabhāpatiḥ ।
pārvatīmāṇikīnātho lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।97।।
mañjuleśaśca haṃseśaḥ saguṇeśaḥ svayaṃprabhuḥ ।
dayānāthaḥ śāntināthaścampāhaimījayāpatiḥ ।।98।।
tejasāṃ yo mahattejastapatāṃ yo mahattapaḥ ।
taṃ bhajitvā bhavenmukto golokādhipateḥ puraḥ ।।99।।
śāśvatena sukhenā'tra pūryate kṛṣṇavattadā ।
ya etatpaṭhati lakṣmi! kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ ।। 1.571.10 0।।
tārayet sa svakulajān daśapūrvān daśā'parān ।
etattu paṭhamāno vai yastu prāṇān vimuñcati ।। 10 1।।
caturbhujaḥ sa jāyeta mallokeṣu pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
śravaṇādapi muktaḥ syācchaṃbhuḥ prāha satīṃ tadā ।। 1 02।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kubjāmrake haridvāre bhaktamāhātmye raibhyasya camatkāraḥ, nakulasarpiṇyoḥ rājakule janmottaraṃ mitho vaireṇa prāgjanmasthale gatvā muktiścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaika-
saptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 571 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 571 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 572
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 573 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahātīrthaṃ kubjāmrakaṃ pramokṣadam ।
narmadāyāṃ samāgatya kubjārevāsamāgame ।। 1 ।।
vyavasthitaṃ dhruvaṃ sāptakalpaṃ vai śaṃkaro'vadat ।
pārvatyai tīrthayātrāyāmṛkṣaparvatasaṃsthitaḥ ।। 2 ।।
athānyānyapi tīrthāni kathayāmi niśāmaya ।
māhiṣmatyāḥ paścime vai tīrthaṃ śokavināśanam ।। 3 ।।
aśokavanikākhyātaṃ mātaṃgāśramaśobhitam ।
tatra yā pūjayed gaurīṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ pativratā ।। 4 ।।
kanyā labhet patiṃ sveṣṭaṃ dravyarūpabalānvitam ।
mātaṃgo nāma devarṣistapastepe'tra duṣkaram ।। 5 ।।
prāgjanmani niṣādaḥ sa jātismaro hyabhūt sadā ।
pāpanāśakare sthāne maharṣīṇāṃ samāgamāt ।। 6 ।।
dharmajñātā'bhavacchreṣṭho rāgahīnaśca bodhavān ।
narmadāsevanāccāpi puṇyavānabhavaddhi saḥ ।। 7 ।।
nirviṇṇaśca jaṭāvalkalā'mbaraḥ śvapaco'pi ha ।
aśokavanikāsaṃsthaḥ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ ।। 8 ।।
varṣāṇāṃ sa sahasraṃ vai tapastepe'tidāruṇam ।
evaṃ vai tapatastasya jaṭāgrebhyo viniḥsṛtāḥ ।। 9 ।।
yakṣiṇyaḥ śyāmavarṇāśca tejasvinyo vibhūṣitāḥ ।
ekāśītisahasrāṇi sasnustā narmadājale ।। 1.572.1 0।।
snānamātreṇa tāḥ prāpuryakṣalokān suvāhanaiḥ ।
mantrayantravihīno'pi namaḥ śivāya saṃgṛṇan ।। 11 ।।
siddhimānabhavattasya puraḥ śaṃkara āyayau ।
bhaktaṃ prāha varaṃ sveṣṭaṃ vṛṇīṣva śaṃkaro'smyaham ।। 12।।
mātaṃgaḥ prāha mannāmnā tīrthaṃ khyātamidaṃ bhavet ।
cāṇḍālāḥ śvapacāścarmakārā ye pāpayonayaḥ ।। 13 ।।
atrā''gatya pavitrāśca muktimāpnuyureva ca ।
mātaṃgeśvaraliṃgaṃ ca natveyurmokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।। 14।।
enaṃ varaṃ pradehyatra yadyahaṃ te'smi bhaktimān ।
śrutvā tacchaṃkaraḥ prāha tathā'stviti punastataḥ ।। 15।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।
ityenaṃ japa mātaṃga! muktiste vaiṣṇavī parā ।। 16।।
bhaviṣyati na sandehastathā tvajjātivartinām ।
asya mantrasya yogena vaikuṇṭhe mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।। 17।।
dehi mantraṃ mayoktaṃ ca kuru sarvāṃśca vaiṣṇavān ।
ityuktvā śaṃkaraścāntardhānaṃ yayau tataḥ param ।। 18।।
mataṃgo nijavarṇebhyo dehibhyaḥ pradadau manum ।
preṣayāmāsa sa bahūn cāṇḍālān vaiṣṇavān purā ।। 19।।
golokaṃ śrīharerdhāma svayaṃ yānaṃ ca kāmikam ।
samāruhya yayau caitre mokṣaṃ vai paramaṃ śubham ।।1.572.20।।
aśokavanikaṃ caitanmātaṃgatīrthamucyate ।
tilapiṣṭādidānena saktūdānena tarpaṇe ।।।21।।।
pitaro jalapānena muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ ।
tatraiva dakṣiṇe bhāge tīrthaṃ mṛgavanābhidham ।।22।।
tatra snātvā'rcayed viṣṇuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam ।
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ pūjayet parameśvaram ।।23।।।
pativratā patiṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prapūjayet ।
snānadānaprabhāveṇa lokaṃ prāpnoti vaiṣṇavam ।।24।।
vyādhaḥ kaścid durācāro nirdayaśca purā'bhavat ।
sadhanuṣko mṛgāँstatra jaghāna ca tṛṣākulaḥ ।।25।।
vinā jala drumacchāyāmāśritya kṣaṇamāsthitaḥ ।
nidrāṃ yayau ca tatpaścād vanasaṃgharṣajo'nalaḥ ।।26।।
utthitaśca dadāhā'sau vanaṃ vyādhamṛgānvitam ।
atha māsāntare varṣā jātā bhasmāsthikhaṇḍakāḥ ।।27।।
narmadāyāṃ gatāḥ sarve vṛṣṭipūreṇa vāhitāḥ ।
mṛgāste narmadāyogād gāndharvā devakoṭayaḥ ।।28 ।।
abhavaँśca sa vai vyādho rājā'bhavaddhi bhūtale ।
tadanye prāṇinaścāpi narmadājalayogataḥ ।।29।।
yakṣādyā abhavan devā daśavarṣasahasrakam ।
svargaṃ bhuktvā tataste'pi tathā rājā'sya gāyakāḥ ।।1.572.3 0।।
vaiṣṇavenaiva yānena saṃprāptā vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ।
avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi prāṇāँstyajati nārmade ।।3 1 ।।
divyavarṣasahasraṃ sa viṣṇuloke pramodate ।
aṅgārāvartasaṃbhedo gosahasraphalapradaḥ ।।32।।
aṅgāreśvaradevaśca tatra tiṣṭhati saṃgame ।
snānamātro narastatra gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt ।।33।।
caturthyāṃ maṃgale vāre hiraṇyapuruṣaṃ śubham ।
kṛtvā raktena vastreṇa veṣṭayet saghṛtaṃ tathā ।।34।।
gūḍhaṃ dadyād brāhmaṇāya maṃgalaṃ puruṣaṃ dadet ।
dānatīrthaprabhāveṇa śakrārdhāsanabhāgbhavet ।।35।।
yuvanāśvaḥ purā rājā kosalāyā hyabhūnmahān ।,
cakravartī kṛtayuge sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ।।36।।
abhivādya vaśiṣṭhaṃ sa samuvāca purohitam ।
kasmin sthāne yajed yajñaṃ tīrthe deśe surālaye ।।37।।
vaśiṣṭhastaṃ samuvāca naimiṣaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।
saphalo hayamedhaśca koṭikoṭiguṇottaraḥ ।।38।।
matsyena viṣṇunā coktaṃ sūryeṇāpi tathoditam ।
manuputrāya yajñārhaṃ yuvanāśva! tavoditam ।। 39।।
śrutvā rājā gurorvākyaṃ samādideśa mantriṇaḥ ।
yajñopaskaramādāya samāgacchata satvaram ।।1.572.40।।
ghoṣaṇā ca kṛtā loke āhūtāśca surāḥ kratau ।
brahmā viṣṇuḥ sureśaśca skando vaiśravaṇastathā ।।41 ।।
śaṃbhuśca vasavaścāpi rudrā ādityakāstathā ।
aśvinau ca diśāṃ pālā lokapālāśca sarvaśaḥ ।।।42।।
dhenūnāṃ daśalakṣāṇi hemaratnānvitāni hi ।
lakṣamekaṃ vājināṃ saddantināmayutatrayam ।।43।।
maṇimāṇikyamuktāśca hiraṇyaṃ cāpyanantakam ।
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvaśaḥ ।।44।।
yajñadravyaṃ ca yaccānyat tatsarvasahito nṛpaḥ ।
nānāsahasrayānaiśca nānāvādyasahasrakaiḥ ।।।45।।
vedaghoṣeṇa mahatā gītikairnādayan divam ।
viveśa naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra śrīharidarśanam ।।46 ।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tato nṛpaḥ ।
dīnānāmayutāyā'sau dadau suvarṇalakṣakam ।।47।।
bhūṣaṇāni dadau snātvā rūpyakāṇyamitāni tu ।
oṃ namo viṣṇave proktvā jaladarbhau nidhāya vai ।।48।।
saṃkalpya svarṇapātre sa yajñavāṭamakārayat ।
daśakośamitāṃ bhūmiṃ yajñayūpamayīṃ nṛpaḥ ।।49।।
hemayūpasuśobhādyāmakārayacca maṇḍapān ।
vedikā yajñakuṇḍāni mukhyakuṇḍānvitāni ca ।।1.572.50।।
tato nirvartito yajño vaśiṣṭhapramukhairdvijaiḥ ।
muditā devatāḥ sarvā jayaśabdān vadanti vai ।।51 ।।
yajñaṃ samāpya ca rājā sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ ।
yāvad yānaṃ samāruhya niḥsṛto naimiṣād vanāt ।।52।।
tāvat kaścid vānarastvāgatyovāca nṛpaṃ muhuḥ ।
tiṣṭha tiṣṭha śṛṇu rājan mithyāhaṃkāravān bhavān ।।53।।
kiṃ te yajñavidhānena phalaṃ manye na cādhikam ।
purā'mareśvare yajñe satyadharmasya bhūpateḥ ।।54।।
varjayitvā mukhaṃ me'bhūt kaṇṭhā'dho hemavarṇakam ।
asmākaṃ śiśavaḥ sarve tatrā'bhavan hiraṇmayāḥ ।।55।।
kapilānarmadāyoge yajñatoyaprabhāvataḥ ।
snānā'vagāhanātpānālluṇṭhanātkardame kratoḥ ।।56 ।।
gandharvalokaṃ samprāpto bhūtagrāmaścaturvidhaḥ ।
athā'haṃ lulito yajñe tava naimiṣasaṃbhave ।।57।।
paṃkena liptaṃ gātraṃ me kṣālitaṃ yajñavāriṇā ।
na kiñcit phalamāsīnme na gātraṃ svarṇatāṃ gatam ।।58।।
ahaṃkāragato yajñastava sarvo nirarthakaḥ ।
gavāṃ tvayā'yutaṃ dattaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyamanantakam ।।59।।
svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ tathā dattaṃ kintu sarvaṃ nirarthakam ।
etatte kathitaṃ rājan kratuste nahi tādṛśaḥ ।।1.572.60 ।।
satyadharmasya nṛpateryathā'bhūnnarmadātaṭe ।
svasti vo'stu gamiṣyāmi narmadāṃ svarṇarūpadām ।।6 1 ।।
śrutvā tvadīyaṃ yajñaṃ vai naimiṣāraṇyamāgataḥ ।
nirāśo'haṃ pragacchāmi nā'bhūnme kāṃcanaṃ mukham ।।6 2।।
vānarasya vacaḥ śrutvā yuvanāśvo'bravīt tadā ।
ko'si vānararūpastvaṃ vada me śreyasāṃ nidhe ।।63।।
kapiḥ prāha kadambākhyo jābāliputra ātmavit ।
jātismaraḥ phalacauryād vānaratvamupāgataḥ ।।64।।
kṛtāni sarvatīrthāni veṣeṇānena bhūpate ।
na śreyo me'bhavat kiṃcittīrtheṣu tvalpamityapi ।।65।।
kevalaṃ nārmade kṣetre satyadharmamakhottame ।
vapurhiraṇmayaṃ sarvaṃ mukhavarjaṃ mamā'bhavat ।।66।।
vānarasya vacaḥ śrutvā rājā tu naimiṣaṃ punaḥ ।
yayau śrīparameśaṃ taṃ hyādidevaṃ vibhuṃ harim ।।67।।
tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā bhagavantaṃ narāyaṇam ।
bhagavannaimiṣe kṣetre mayā yajñaḥ prasādhitaḥ ।।68।।
atrānte śrāvayāmāsa hyeko vānararūpadhṛk ।
na yajñe te mama lābho vṛthā yajñastatastava ।।69।।
sa tvicchati mukhaṃ svasya hiraṇmayaṃ kratūttaram ।
hiraṇmayaṃ mukhaṃ tasya yathā syāt tat tathā kuru ।।1.572.70।।
śrutvā śrībhagavānāha mūrtistho yuvanaṃ nṛpam ।
narmadāyāṃ punaryajñaṃ satyadharmaḥ kariṣyati ।।71 ।।
tatra tasya mukhaṃ svarṇaṃ bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ ।
vadainaṃ vānaraṃ yāhi rājaँstvaṃ kosalāṃ purīm ।।72।।
rājā śrutvā tu naimiṣaṃ hariṃ natvā purīṃ yayau ।
vānaraśca yayau revākapilāsaṃgamaṃ punaḥ ।।73।।
tatra gatvā satyadharmaṃ naimiṣākhyānamāha saḥ ।
satyadharmaśca tacchrutvā harervacaḥ pramāṇayan ।।74।।
pracakāra punaryajñaṃ vānaro'vabhṛthottaram ।
kardame svamukhaṃ luṇṭhan prāveśayanmuhurmuhuḥ ।।75।।
hemībhūtavapurjāto mukhaṃ sarvaṃ ca kānakam ।
abhavacca tadā tyaktvā śarīraṃ vānarasya saḥ ।।76।।
devadundubhinādena satkṛtaścāpsarāṃ gaṇaiḥ ।
haṃsayuktena yānena yayau vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ ।।77।।
tatra yajñe śvāpadādyāḥ kaṇaṃ bhuktvā divaṃ gatāḥ ।
evaṃ vai nārmadaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvopari pravartate ।।78।।
śravaṇātkīrtanāccāsya gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet ।
śaṃkaraḥ pārvatīṃ prāha mayā lakṣmi! tavoditam ।।79।।
svadravyeṇa tu yo yajñaṃ karoti nārmade taṭe ।
bhuktvā sa puṣkalān bhogān viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।।1.572.80 ।।
dhātrīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya prakalpayet ।
narmadātīramāśritya viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।।8 1।।
pratyakṣadhenuṃ yo dadyāddhemaratnavibhūṣitām ।
ghṛtadhenuṃ guḍadhenuṃ śarkarādhenumityapi ।।82।।
revākapilayoryoge viṣṇuloke mahīyate ।
śṛṇu cānyāṃ kathāṃ cāpi pāpatāpapraṇāśinīm ।।83।।
vīraṇasya tu rājarṣermaitreyo'bhūtpurohitaḥ ।
tena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha ।।84।।
kāritaṃ narmadātīre svargakalaśaśobhitam ।
tadāyatanapuṇyena narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।।85।।
modate vaiṣṇave loke maitreyo vai caturbhujaḥ ।
athā'yaṃ vīraṇo rājā śuśrāva devadūtataḥ ।।86 ।।
rājaँstava guruḥ svargaṃ nimnīkṛtya gato hareḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhaṃ tvaṃ kathaṃ naiva yāsyasi darśanāya vai ।।87।।
devadūtasya tacchrutvā papraccha ca kathaṃ gatiḥ ।
devadūtastadā prāha yajñamācara nārmade ।।88।।
taṭe ramye hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ toṣayitvā prayāsyasi ।
vīraṇo'pi kratuṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pracakāra ha ।।89।।
devāstatra samāyātā maitreyo'pi narāyaṇaḥ ।
lakṣmyādyā mātaraścāpi rājā sarvā hyatoṣayat ।।1.572.90।।
athā'vamṛthakaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā dattvā ca dakṣiṇāḥ ।
vīraṇo divyayānena bhūtvā divyo hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।91 ।।
caturbhujābhiḥ kanyābhirvījyamāno'tisundaraḥ ।
caturbāhudharaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ raṭan muhuḥ ।।92।।
devaiśca pārṣadairmārge vardhitaḥ svāgatīkṛtaḥ ।
yayau viṣṇoḥ paraṃ dhāma vaikuṇṭhaṃ nityaśāntidam ।।93।।
rantidevo'pi rājarṣiḥ kṛtvā yajñāँśca nārmade ।
kṣetre bilvāँstathā''mrāँśca samarpya parameśvaram ।।94।।
toṣayitvā hariṃ devān tīrthaṃ bilvāmrakaṃ tadā ।
kṛtvā cājñāṃ samādāya nārāyaṇasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ।।95।।
prajāśca vaiṣṇavīrbhaktāḥ kāścinnītvā sahāpi ca ।
taṭe cānte harerdhāma yayau sakulabāndhavaḥ ।।96।।
dadhīcirnāma rājarṣiravantīnṛpatiḥ purā ।
narmadāyāstaṭe gatvā datvā cendrāya pṛṣṭhagam ।।97।।
vaṃśāsthi ca tato bhaktyā yayau nārāyaṇaṃ padam ।
yadasthijātaśastrairvai devā jigyurmahāsurān ।।98।।
amāsomasamāyoge snātvā bilvāmrake priye ।
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ janā yānti nārmadakṣetrayogataḥ ।। 99।।
viśve devāḥ parāṃ siddhiṃ bilvāmrake samāpnuyuḥ ।
pāṭhakāḥ śrāvakāścāpi yāsyanti paramāṃ gatim ।। 1.572.10 0।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne'śokavanikāyāṃ mātaṃgāśramaḥ, aṃgāreśvaram, satyadharmasya yajñe nakulasya svarṇarūpatā, vīraṇasya mokṣaḥ, ityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikapañca-
śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 572 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 572 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 573
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 574 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
ākarṇaya mahālakṣmi! śaṃkaroditamuttamam ।
suvarṇadvīpatīrthaṃ ca narmadājalamadhyataḥ ।। 1 ।।
hārīto vai maharṣistu purā kṛtayuge'tapat ।
tatra haritavarṇasya kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ha ।। 2 ।।
darśanaṃ jāyate ramyaṃ tapatāṃ yogināṃ tathā ।
atha revottare kūle paryaṃko nāma parvataḥ ।। 3 ।।
tatra pāpaharo viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tiṣṭhati mādhavaḥ ।
krośamātrapramāṇaṃ tat harikṣetraṃ prakīrtitam ।। 4 ।।
tatra snātā mṛtāścāpi prayānti paramāṃ gatim ।
narmadāyāmyabhāge ca māṇḍavyāśramamuttam ।। 5 ।।
vibhāṇḍakaḥ ṛṣyaśṛṃgastathā'nye nyavasanpurā ।
viśokānarmadāsaṃgo'śokeśvaraśca śaṃkaraḥ ।। 6 ।।
śobhane nimnage tatra narmadāvindhyasaṃgamaḥ ।
nivasanti mokṣadāśca devyastatra samāgame ।। 7 ।।
harṣasiddhā ca sāvitrī devamātā'ditistathā ।
devayānī brahmatanvī rohiṇī kambharāyaṇī ।। 8 ।।
lopāmudrā tathendrāṇī dākṣāyaṇī prabhā dhruvā ।
ratnāvalī tathā saṃjñā tārā siddhiśca pārvatī ।। 9 ।।
lakṣmīḥ rādhā maṇikī ca haṃsā ca maṃjulā'mṛtā ।
maṃgalā saguṇā'śokā svasvasvāmiyutāstu tāḥ ।। 1.573.1 0।।
dayā jayā ca lalitā mauktikī hemacampikā ।
kastūrikā ca savitā vasanti vindhyanārmade ।। 11 ।।
saṃbhede'śokavanikākṣetre gauryā varaḥ kṛtaḥ ।
āśvine dhavale caturdaśyāṃ vratavatī ca yā ।। 1 2।।
aputriṇī tathā vandhyā durbhagā bhartṛvarjitā ।
pañcaratnaphalaiḥ snātā divyavastubhirarcayet ।। 13।।
snāpayecca jalaiḥ saṃbhojayet kumārikāstathā ।
akhaṇḍasaubhāgyayutā putriṇī mānitā bhavet ।। 14।।
ādau kṛte raviścandraḥ kāñcīpurapatirnṛpaḥ ।
somavaṃśasamudbhāvo narmadātīravāsinam ।। 15।।
maitrāvaruṇikaṃ vipramagastyaṃ prati saṃyayau ।
śāṇḍilyena samaṃ rājā purohitena tena vai ।
nanāmā'gastikaṃ vipraṃ pādau jagrāha tasya ca ।। 16।।
agastiḥ kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ papraccha cāsanaṃ dadau ।
rājā prāha tapataste darśanāt kilbiṣaṃ gatam ।। 17।।
adya me saphalaṃ janma rājyaṃ jīvanamityapi ।
kasmin sthāne yaje yajñaṃ yathā saṃsiddhyate kratuḥ ।। 18।।।
surāṇāṃ cā'kṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet ।
muniḥ prāha kratoryogyā narmadā saptakalpagā ।। 19 ।।
aśokavanikā yajñabhūmiḥ khyātā surārcitā ।
tatra yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tvaṃ vidhehi pārameṣyasi ।।1.573.20 ।।
rājā'gastiṃ saha nītvā yayāvaśokikāṃ sthalīm ।
revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle yajñayūpāँśca maṇḍapam ।।21।।
daśakrośānābhivyāpya kārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ।
saptarṣayastathā vālakhilyāścānye'pi bhūsurāḥ ।।22।।
brahmadṛśyo lomaśaśca kuṃkumavāpikāsthitaḥ ।
surāśca brāhmaṇāścānye yayuryajñaḥ pravartitaḥ ।।23।।
tṛptāstu devatāḥ sarvā viprāḥ saṃlabdhadakṣiṇāḥ ।
tatastatra samāyāto durvāsā munirāṭ krudhā ।।24।।
uvāca nātra me sthānaṃ vaivasvatasya nāsti ca ।
nāradaḥ parvato nāsti kālo mṛtyurna vidyate ।।25।।
citraguptastathā nāsti kathaṃ yajñaḥ pravartitaḥ ।
durvāsasaṃ raviścandro natvā prāha tadā vacaḥ ।।26 ।।
ko me samartho vighnāya surāsuragaṇeṣvapi ।
aśokeśvaradevasya narmadāyāḥ prasādataḥ ।।27।।
mayā nirvartito yajño yajñe pūjyāḥ samāgatāḥ ।
bhavanto'pi mama pūjāṃ gṛhṇantu dakṣiṇāstathā ।।28।।
dadāmi vo na sandeho durvāsā nāradādayaḥ ।
yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ tasmai pradadāmyaham ।।29।।
āgatāḥ prastutāstatra nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ ।
toṣitā bhūbhṛtā te ca yatheṣṭādipradānataḥ ।। 1.573.30 ।।
durvāsasā tataḥ punastvarthitaṃ śṛṇu padmaje ।
pūrvaṃ pārvatīśāpena pāṭalīputravāsinaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
śaptā vai brāhmaṇāḥ śvāno bhūtvā bhramanti vai kṣitau ।
teṣāṃ muktiṃ ca rājaँstvaṃ kuru puṇyapradānakaiḥ ।।32।।
rājā prāha kathaṃ te vai śāpaṃ prāptā vadasva me ।
durvāsāḥ prāha te viprāḥ purā valkaladhāriṇaḥ ।। 33 ।।
nepāle vai paśupatiṃ pūjayituṃ yayustadā ।
pupūjuḥ śaṃkaraṃ bhaktyā gauryā virahitaṃ ca te ।।34।।
ardhanārīśvare nārībhāgaṃ hitvā puṃmātrakam ।
candanādyaiḥ samānarcuḥ pārvatī krodhatastadā ।।31।।
śaśāpa brāhmaṇāँstāँśca nāryardhabhedakāriṇaḥ ।
varṣasahasraṃ sarve vai śvayoniṃ tu gamiṣyatha ।।36 ।।
atha śāpena te sarve śvayoniṃ pragatāstadā ।
vartante tānmocaya tvaṃ vanādāhūya cātra vai ।।37।।
atha rājñā preṣitāśca kiṃkarāstadvanaṃ prati ।
śvāno jātismarāḥ śīghraṃ kiṃkaraiḥ saha cāyayuḥ ।।38।।
aśokavanikābhūmiṃ prāha tānnṛpatirmudā ।
aśokeśvaradevasya narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ ।।3 9 ।।
mama dānaprabhāveṇa maharṣīṇāṃ prasādataḥ ।
tyaktvā śvayoniṃ munayo brahmalokaṃ prayāntu vai ।। 1.573.40 ।।
yuṣmatpāpaṃ śāparūpaṃ mayi sarvaṃ viśāmyatu ।
tatkṣaṇānmuktaśāpāste kāmikaṃ yānamāsthitāḥ ।।41 ।।
bhūtvā maharṣayo divyā raviścandraṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ ।
tvaṃ mātā tvaṃ pitā'smākaṃ tvaṃ gururmokṣadāyakaḥ ।।42 ।।
evamuktvā yayuḥ svargaṃ satyalokātmakaṃ śubham ।
durvāsādyāḥ ṛṣayo'pi praśaśaṃsurnṛpaṃ tadā ।।43 ।।
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga! tvaṃ tu yajñataponidhiḥ ।
nānyastvayā samaḥ kaścit somavaṃśodbhavo nṛpaḥ ।।44।।
prāṇatyāgo hi sukaraḥ puṇyatyāgo'ti duṣkaraḥ ।
puṇyaṃ pradāsyasi kṣmābhṛt phalaṃ tvasyā'sti śāśvatam ।। 45 ।।
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate ।
rājā''ha mama puṇyena janā durbuddhayo'pi ca ।।46 ।।
prāpnuvantu paraṃ lokaṃ vara eṣa mama priyaḥ ।
durvāsādyāḥ ṛṣayo'pi tathā'stvityabhidhāya vai ।।47।।
antardhānaṃ yayuḥ sarve tato dharmaḥ samāgataḥ ।
prasannaḥ san dharmarājo varaṃ dadāmi cāha tam ।।48।।
yamaloko jito rājan devaloko jitastvayā ।
yajñapuṇyapradānena śvāno muktāḥ kṛtāstvayā ।।49।।
pṛthivyāṃ duṣkaraṃ karma yajñapuṇyapradānakam ।
varayogyo'si rājendra vṛṇuṣva ca yathepsitam ।।1.573.50।।
raviścandrastadā prāha yamalokagatāśca ye ।
pāpino duḥkhabhoktāro nārakā yātanārditāḥ ।। 51 ।।
mama yajñaśatenaiva dānena tapasā tathā ।
prayāntu tvatprasādena svargaṃ satyaṃ sukhāvaham । । 52 ।।
yamaḥ prāha tathaivā'stu puṇyaṃ te vardhate bahu ।
paroddhāre'rpitaṃ puṇyaṃ sahasraguṇitaṃ bhavet ।। ।53 ।।
tena puṇyena rājendra yāhi tvaṃ brahmapattanam ।
śāśvataṃ dhāma yannityānandabhṛtaṃ parākṣaram । । 54 । ।
yatastvayā kaśmalādvai mocitāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ।
kṣatriyāḥ śataśo rājan anye cāpi sahasraśaḥ ।।55 ।।
evamuktvā dharmarājo datvā rājñe japāya vai ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ । । 56 ।।
ṣoḍaśākṣaramantraṃ ca yayau svabhavanaṃ mudā ।
rājā kālena divyo'bhūd yayāvakṣarataḥ param । । 57 ।।
brahmadhāmottaraṃ dhāma paraṃ pumuttamasya yat ।
śravaṇāt kīrtanādasya gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet । । 58 ।।
atha tīrthaṃ vāgurevāsaṃgamākhyaṃ tataḥ param ।
brahmadatto'bhavad rājā kośalānāṃ praśāsakaḥ । । 59 ।।
sūryavaṃśī kratuṃ revāvāguyoge cakāra ha ।
daśayojanaparyantā yajñabhūmirabhūttadā । । 1.573.60 ।।
asya yajñe cātitṛptāḥ pretā muktiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ ।
śṛṇu pretāḥ kathaṃ jātāḥ ke'bhavaँste purā yathā । । 61 ।।
kārtikyāṃ puṣkare tīrthe purā maharṣayo yayuḥ ।
ayogandhaḥ svayaṃbhūśca puṇḍarīkākṣa ityapi ।। 62 ।।
brahmā kāvyastathā hotā sadano vedagarbhakaḥ ।
kṛtadhvanaḥ svastikaśca sāvitro vāmadevakaḥ ।।6 3 ।।
aghamarṣo brahmatejāstathā'nye brāhmaṇā yayuḥ ।
sarve gārhasthyadharmasthāstṛṣṇāhīnā hi vaiṣṇavāḥ ।। 64।।
teṣāṃ bhāryāḥ patidharmā bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ ।
cīravalkaladhāriṇyaḥ śākaśyāmākabhakṣikāḥ ।। 65 ।।
dāridryadoṣasantaptā viṣaṇṇāścaikadā tu tāḥ ।
viprasthitiṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ cādhyāpanaṃ tathā । । 66 ।।
adhyayanaṃ tathā dānaṃ pratigrahaṃ vyagarhayan ।
ṣaṭsveteṣu viprakarmasvatikaṣṭaṃ vilokyate । । 67 ।।
bhūṣaṇaṃ rājasaṃ kiñcinnāpyate brāhmaṇagṛhe ।
evaṃ vyagarhayaँstāsāṃ śrutvā viprā maharṣayaḥ ।। 68 ।।
viṣaṇṇavadanāstāsāṃ pūrayituṃ manogatam ।
sastrīputrā yayuḥ sūryagrahe kṣetre ca kaurave ।।6 9 ।।
yatra dānaṃ dadāti sma hariścandro ravergrahe ।
pratigrahecchayā samāgatān dṛṣṭvā sa bhūpatiḥ ।।1.573.70।।
prasannavadano dānasāphalyaṃ praśaśaṃsa ha ।
dhanyā me saphalā yātrā kurukṣetre'dya vartate ।।71 ।।
kṣudhārtā duḥkhitāścāpi bālā vṛddhāḥ kṛśā''turāḥ ।
valkalājinavastrāśca durbalā me hyupāgatāḥ ।।72।।
evamuktvā namaskṛtyaikaikasya ca pṛthakpṛthak ।
lakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ hiraṇyasya tathā gāvaḥ sahasraśaḥ ।।73।।
sahasraṃ turagāṇāṃ ca dantināṃ śatamityapi ।
sāptabhaumān gṛhānramyān hemaprākāratoraṇān ।।74।।
yānavāhanadāsāँśca dāsīstathā samārpayat ।
rājapratigrahaṃ prāptāḥ pāpabhoktāra eva te ।।75।।
ṣaṭkarmāṇi parityajya vilāseṣvabhavan hṛtāḥ ।
kālāntare mṛtā jātāḥ pretarūpā bhayāvahāḥ ।।76।।
pratigrahaprabhāvo'yaṃ viprasya patanaṃ yataḥ ।
te ca jātismarāḥ sarve dānadagdhāḥ sabāndhavāḥ ।।77।।
duḥkhinastvāgatāstīrthaṃ puṣkaraṃ yatra nāradaḥ ।
badarīṃ prati saṃyāsyannirgatastatpradeśataḥ ।।78।।
pretarūpān munīn dṛṣṭvā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ।
papraccha ca kathaṃ pretā jātā iti tataśca te ।।79।।
ūcurvayaṃ hariścandranṛpatervai pratigraham ।
kurukṣetre labdhavanto lobhena tatphalaṃ gatāḥ ।।1.573.80।।
pretabhāvaṃ samāpannā mokṣo'smākaṃ vidhīyatām ।
śrutvā tānnāradaḥ prāha narmadāṃ yāta pāvanīm ।।8 1 ।।
vāgīśaṃ ca puraṃ tatra narmadātaṭamāśritam ।
adhvare brahmadattasya mokṣaṇaṃ vo bhaviṣyati ।।82।।
ityuktvā nārado nārāyaṇāśramaṃ yayau tataḥ ।
pretā yayustamuddeśaṃ vāgīśapuramuttamam ।।83।।
snātvā sūryaṃ hariṃ śaṃbhuṃ pūjayitvā yayurmakham ।
makhaprāsādikaṃ prāśya pāpahīnāḥ surūpiṇaḥ ।।84।।
babhūvustān vilokyaitān vimalān sūryavarcasaḥ ।
brahmadattādayo natvā papracchuryūyamatra ke ।।85।।
kathaṃ pretatvamāpannā babhūva muktatā katham ।
atha tairnijavṛttāntastebhyastatra niveditaḥ ।।86।।
cakruścopari rājñaste puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ divaṃgatāḥ ।
brahmayānaṃ samāruhya brahmalokaṃ yayustataḥ ।।87।।
rājānaṃ śaṃśamānā vai makhaṃ ca nārmadaṃ jalam ।
devā viprā yayurnaijaṃ deśaṃ yajñe pratoṣitāḥ ।।88।।
śravaṇātkīrtanādasya gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet ।
anyaccāpi sahasrāvartakaṃ tīrthaṃ pravidyate ।।89।।
tatra snātasya vidhivad vṛṣotsargaphalaṃ bhavet ।
karāvanaṃ tathā tīrthaṃ saugandhikaṃ vanaṃ tathā ।। 1.573.90।।
tatra sarasvatī cāste pitruddhārakarī śubhā ।
triśūlākhyaṃ tathā'nyacca tīrtha gaṇeśatāpradam ।। 91।।
brahmodaṃ cāparaṃ tīrthaṃ saptarṣisnānakāritam ।
kapiñjalo muniśreṣṭho havyavāhaśca devatā ।।92।।।
bhagavān devayānaśca viśvāvasurmahāmuniḥ ।
asya tīrthasya māhātmyād brahmalokamupāgatāḥ ।।93।।
vasvāśramaṃ tathā ramyaṃ tīrthaṃ paramamasti ca ।
saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।94।।
sākṣād virājate brahmā stutiṃ tasya cakāra ha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo bhavatu me gatiḥ ।।95।।
akṣarādhipatirmuktapatiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
rādhāpatiśca lakṣmīśaḥ pārvatīśo'stu me gatiḥ ।।96।।
jayāpatirlaliteśo māṇikīśo'stu me gatiḥ ।
vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ svāmī nārāyaṇo'stu me gatiḥ ।।97।।
bhūmā viṣṇurmahākṛṣṇo vairājeśo'stu me gatiḥ ।
upendro haṃsanāthaśca bhūśrīśo'stu ca me gatiḥ ।।98।।
prabhāpatirmaṃjuleśo haṃseśaḥ saguṇāpatiḥ ।
kāṃbhareyaśca bhagavān harikṛṣṇo'stu me gatiḥ ।।99।।
hṛṣīkeśo mādhavaśca devīnātho'stu me gatiḥ ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmāyudhaḥ śrīgaruḍāsanaḥ ।। 1.573.10 0।।
sarvāvirbhāvamūlaṃ ca janārdano'stu me gatiḥ ।
paramātmā parabrahma gopālabālakaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 10 1।।
viśvātmā cāntarātmā ca hṛdayastho'stu me gatiḥ ।
bhaktasya bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ prīyatāṃ savitāpatiḥ ।। 102।।
sītāramāprapuṣpeśo bhaktapatiḥ prasīdatu ।
janmaprabhṛti yatkiñcidarjitaṃ me tvadarpitam ।। 103 ।।
nānyaḥ puṇyataro devo nāsti viṣṇuparaṃ tapaḥ ।
nāsti svāmiparaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ svāmimayaṃ jagat ।। 1 04।।
etatstavaraveṇāpi janā yāsyanti mokṣaṇam ।
śravaṇātkīrtanādasya hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet ।। 105 ।।
brahmā stutvā jale snātvā kārtikyāṃ yānamāsthitaḥ ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ raṭan yayau divam ।। 106 ।।
etat tīrthaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇodaṃ mokṣadaṃ smṛtam ।
śaṃbhūditaṃ ca yatsatyai mayā lakṣmi! tavoditam ।। 1 07।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā' prathame kṛtayugasantāne suvarṇadvīpatīrthaṃ viśokānarmadāsaṃgamaḥ, aśokeśvare raviścandrayajñe pretoddhāraḥ, vāgurevāsaṃgamaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatīrthādi cetinirūpaṇanāmā trisapta-
tyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।573।।


← adhyāyaḥ 573 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 574
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 575 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato gacchettīrthaṃ devamayaṃ śubham ।
satīṃ śaṃbhurjagādaivaṃ nārmade codbhave sthitaḥ ।। 1 ।।
sahasrayajñaṃ tīrthaṃ ca janārdanādhivāsitam ।
kṛtvā yāmyāṃ ca nagarīṃ naiva paśyet kadācana ।। 2 ।।
śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvatīrthamayaṃ param ।
tena śuklīkṛtā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।। 3 ।।
tīrthānāṃ koṭayastatra śuklatīrthe vasanti vai ।
indraḥ śaṃbhuṃ snāpayitvā bilvapatraiḥ samārcayat ।। 4 ।।
dikpālaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇastatraiva pūjitaḥ ।
kaśyapasyā''śramaṃ puṇyaṃ yatrāyutarṣimaṇḍalam ।। 5 ।।
munīnāṃ koṭayaścāpi śukleśvaramupāsate ।
sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ hi tat ।। 6 ।।
pitāmahena yatreṣṭo yajñe yajñeśvaraḥ purā ।
sarvapāpāni naśyanti tasyā bhūmerniṣevaṇāt ।। 7 ।।
agatyā tu mṛtānāṃ tanmuktidaṃ śuklatīrthakam ।
yayātirnāma dharmātmā cakravartyabhavannṛpaḥ ।। 8 ।।
iyāja sa mahāyajñaiḥ revāmadhumatīyujau ।
yatra madhyeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ mādhavo'haṃ narāyaṇaḥ ।। 9 ।।
tatra snātā divaṃ mokṣaṃ yānti te na punarbhavāḥ ।
yayātinā brāhmaṇaiścaikadā yajñaḥ pravartitaḥ ।। 1.574.1 0।।
yatra nāsti hareḥ sthānaṃ śaṃbhoḥ sthānaṃ na vai tathā ।
jaṭāsurastadā daityaśchidraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyupāyayau ।। 11 ।।
asurairdhvaṃsito yajño yūpāśca vinipātitāḥ ।
bhukto hutapuroḍāśaḥ somapānaṃ ca taiḥ kṛtam ।। 1 2।।
aṣṭottaraśataṃ devā mṛgarūpeṇa nirgatāḥ ।
rājā'straṃ pratijagrāha smṛtvā hariṃ haraṃ tadā ।। 13 ।।
jaghāna dānavān yuddhe āhūtāśca punaḥ surāḥ ।
punaḥ pravartito yajño haraviṣṇuprasādataḥ ।।14।।
hariṇā śaṃbhunā tatra pratyakṣeṇa svatejasā ।
śuklīkṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yathā golokamakṣaram ।। 15।।
yayātinā vareṇāpi chanditau tu haro hariḥ ।
tiṣṭhataṃ nityamatraiva divyarūpeṇa ceśvarau ।। 16।।
tāvadārabhya tau śvetau dīpyamānau haro hariḥ ।
vartete bhaktakalyāṇakarau tīrthe hi śuklake ।। 17।।
yajñadānādikaṃ sarvamakṣayaṃ tatra jāyate ।
ye ke'pi dehinastatra jalaṃ pāsyanti vā kvacit ।। 18।।
te sarve dhāma yāsyanti śuklatīrthaprabhāvataḥ ।
kāmayante tu yān kāmān tāँstān prāpsyanti mānavāḥ।। 1 9।।
yayātistu gṛhaṃ tatra kārayitvā sumandiram ।
tatra devau pratiṣṭhāpya nijarājyamupāgataḥ ।। 1.574.20।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।
japan dhāma yayau cānte śrotā vaktā'pi mokṣagaḥ ।। 21 ।।
dvīpeśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ narmadāyāstaṭe sthitam ।
tato gacchettu kārtikyāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।।22।।
nābhāgena stuto viṣṇuryatra pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ।
tato gacchenmeghanādābhidhaṃ śrīśaṃkaraṃ priye! ।।23।।
purā vai rāvaṇo rakṣaḥ paryaṭan pṛthivīmimām ।
yayau devagirau yatra mayo nāmā'sti dānavaḥ ।।24।।
paulastyastaṃ mayaṃ prāha keyaṃ kanyā'sti kasya ca ।
kinnāmadheyā tapati tapa ugraṃ tavā''śrame ।।25।।
mayaḥ prāha mama patnyāṃ tejovatyāṃ suputrikā ।
janma prāpa ca patyarthaṃ tapate dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ ।।26।।
nāmnā mandodarīṃ viddhi gṛhāṇa svāgataṃ śubham ।
rāvaṇastu tadā prāha rājā'haṃ dehi me'tra tām ।।27।।
mayo dadau sutāṃ tasmai vidhinā rāvaṇastataḥ ।
yayau svaṃ siṃhalaṃ dvīpaṃ yatra sā suṣuve sutam ।।28।।
jātamātreṇa bālena ravaḥ kaṇṭhāt prakāśitaḥ ।
meghavat tena nāmnā'sau meghanāda itikṛtaḥ ।। 29।।
meghanādaḥ śaṃkarasya bhakto'bhavad yathā pitā ।
bhāvayāmāsa deveśaṃ pārvatyā saha śaṃkaram ।।1.574.30।।
tapobhiścopavāsādyaiḥ kliśyate tatkalevaram ।
meghanādastvekadā vai yayau kailāsaparvatam ।। 31 ।।
liṃgaṃ pāṣāṇakaṃ nītvā prayayau nārmadaṃ taṭam ।
meghanādena salile sthāpitaṃ pūjitaṃ tathā ।।32।।
meghāravākhyo grāmaśca garjanākhyastathā'paraḥ ।
meghanādasamākhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ taccā'bhavattataḥ ।।33।।
śaṃkarastapasā tasya tatra pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ।
tato muktiṃ gataḥ kālāntareṇa viṣṇughātitaḥ ।। 34।।
atha dāruvanaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate puṇyadāyakam ।
mātaliśca mahendrasya dārukākhyaḥ purā'bhavat ।।35।।
sa cāgatya jale tatra revāyāṃ sutapo'tapat ।
abhajatparayā bhaktyā śaṃkaraṃ dārukeśvaram ।।36।।।
śaṃbhustutoṣa pradadau varaṃ mantraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।। 37।।
aṃśā'vataraṇe viṣṇoḥ sārathistvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
toṣayitvā jagannāthaṃ tato yāsyasi sadgatim ।।38।।
tataḥ śaṃbhustirodhānaṃ yayau divaṃ ca mātaliḥ ।
vāsudevasutaḥ kālāntare'bhavatsa mātaliḥ ।। 29।।
kṛṣṇayogena vai muktiṃ gato golokadhāmani ।
athā'nyad vartate tīrthaṃ karañjeśvaramuttamam ।।1.574.40।।
kaśyapāttu danoḥ putraḥ karañjastvabhavatpurā ।
tapaścacāra yatrā'yaṃ karañjeśvarameva tat ।।41 ।।
mahādevaḥ prasanno'bhūd dadau tasmai varaṃ śubham ।
atra karañjaśaṃbhurvai nivatsyāmi sutīrthake ।।42।।
tato yayau divaṃ so'pi karañjaḥ śaṃbhvanugrahāt ।
atha vai pippaleśasya tīrthaṃ muktipradaṃ śubham ।।43।।
pippalādakṛtaṃ cāste gantavyaṃ tatra vai tataḥ ।
guhyatīrthaṃ tato gacched bālahatyāvināśanam ।।44।।
govindākhyo'bhavadviprastasya bhāryā pativratā ।
tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa putramekaṃ susundaram ।।45।।
kadācid brāhmaṇaḥ so'pi kāṣṭhānyānetumutsukaḥ ।
vanaṃ yātastato nītvā kāṣṭhabhāraṃ gṛhāgataḥ ।।46।।
gṛhe tamasi bālastu supto'bhūd yatra pārśvake ।
kāṣṭhabhāraṃ nicikṣepa vipraścā'jñāta eva saḥ ।।47।।
bālo mamāra bhāreṇa dvijo jānāti naiva tat ।
brāhmaṇyapi kṣaṇādūrdhvaṃ jñātavatī tathāpi tam ।।48।।
na śaśaṃsa bhayāttasya so'pi punarvanaṃ gataḥ ।
tataḥ sā vilalāpā'tha govinde tvāgate punaḥ ।।49।।
maunamāsthāya ca dadau bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ dadau ।
rātrau svapantaṃ kāntaṃ sā kṛmivyāptaṃ dadarśa ha ।।1.574.50।।
bālahatyātmakāḥ sarve kṛmayastaṃ vavalgire ।
brāhmaṇī svapatiṃ rātrau pāpakṛmisamāvṛtam ।।51 ।।
śuśoca vīkṣya manasā bahirnaivā'prakāśayat ।
atha prātarbrāhmaṇo'pi śīghramutthāya narmadām ।।52।।
pratyaraṇyaṃ yayau kāṣṭhānyānetuṃ tṛṣito'bhavat ।
jalaṃ pītvā vanadāruṇyādāya niśithe gṛham ।।53।।
āyayau bhojanaṃ jagdhvā śayane nidrito'bhavat ।
punarviprā kṛmiśūnyaṃ dṛṣṭvā dehaṃ svasvāminaḥ ।।54।।
kathanīyaṃ svāmine me sutasya maraṇaṃ prage ।
vicāryetthaṃ ca suṣvāpa prātaścāha patiṃ tataḥ ।।55।।
putro'yaṃ ghātitaḥ kāṣṭhabhārairnātha tvayā tu tat ।
gatehni pātakaṃ ghoraṃ kṛmirūpaṃ tanau tava ।।।56।।
lokitaṃ pūrvaniśithe nātra rātrau kva tadgatam ।
vada puṇyaṃ kṛtaṃ kiñcit kiṃ vā jātaṃ śubhaṃ prabho ।।57।।
vipraḥ prāha mayā pītaṃ jalaṃ nārmadamatra yat ।
tadā mayā'pi te dṛṣṭāḥ kīṭā dehādviniḥsṛtāḥ ।।।58।।।
kimidaṃ kimidaṃ caitanmatvā cāhaṃ mumoha ca ।
kintu nātyavadhāryaṃ tanmatvā tubhyaṃ na voditam ।।59।।
īśvarecchā sukhaduḥkhapravāhe kāraṇaṃ priye! ।
ehi putraṃ nidhāyaiva gacchāvo narmadātaṭam ।।1.574.60।।
snāpayitvā kariṣyāvaḥ saṃskāraṃ jalavāhanam ।
iti nirṇīya tau putraśavamādāya maunataḥ ।।6 1 ।।
yayaturnarmadātīraṃ snāpayāmāsatuḥ śavam ।
sasnatuśca tadā tau dvau tāvatputraḥ sacetanaḥ ।।62।।
saprāṇastvabhavacchīghraṃ brahmahatyā'pi bhūsurān ।
vinirgatya drutaṃ naṣṭā jajvāla vahninā tadā ।।63।।
ityāścaryaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā tutuṣaturdvijau sutam ।
gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ tuṣṭau yayaturnārmadād balāt ।।64।।
jīvanākhyaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ bālahatyāpraṇāśanam ।
tatra snātvā parāṃ siddhiṃ labhennātra vicāraṇā ।।65।।
atha tīrthaṃ viśvarūpānarmadāsaṃgamātmakam ।
tatra pūrvaṃ mahendrasya śāpādapsarasāṃ varā ।।66 ।।
viśvarūpā sārikā cā'bhavaccūtanivāsinī ।
śaṃkaraṃ sā samupāsya pratyakṣaṃ prākaroddharam ।।67।।
yatra prādurbhūta īśastatra sā mokṣaṇaṃ gatā ।
sārikārūpamutsṛjyā'psaro rūpavatī śubhā ।।68।।
jātā tatra nadī cāpi viśvarūpā'bhidhānikā ।
śaṃkarasya prasādena saṃjātā narmadāṃgatā ।।69।।
tattīrthe śāpanāśārthaṃ snātavyamṛddhimicchatā ।
śāpasya kāraṇaṃ citrāṃgadaṃ gandharvamuttamam ।।1.574.70 ।।
nartane devasadasi kāmayāmāsa vai hṛdā ।
nṛtyaṃ kṣatiṃ tadā prāpat tena doṣeṇa śāpitā ।।71 ।।
sā ca svargaṃ punargatvā yayau kailāsamityapi ।
atha rājā dharmasenaḥ sārikātīrthamāyayau ।।72।।
kailāsādhipatirbhakto vaiṣṇavo vājirājitaḥ ।
narmadāyāṃ jale svāśvaṃ samāplāvya jalaṃ papau ।।773 ।।
tāvadaśvo'bhavattatra caturbhujo manoharaḥ ।
divyayānasamārūḍho yayau vaikuṇṭhameva saḥ ।।74।।
viṣṇudūto nṛpaṃ prāha rājaँste pṛṣṭhamāgatā ।
śunī ceyaṃ jalaṃ pītvā snātvā cāyāti paśya tām ।।75।।
ityukto nṛpatiryāvacchunīṃ paśyati tāvatā ।
śvadehaṃ sā parityajyā'psarovarā babhūva ha ।।76।।
vimāne tatra saṃruhya yayau vaikuṇṭhameva sā ।
vyomavāṇī ca rājānaṃ tadovāca dhṛtiṃ vaha ।। 77।।
śarīrajena kaṣṭena tapaḥsādhyā vibhūtayaḥ ।
pādacārī hi gaccha tvaṃ parapādaiḥ samāgataḥ ।।78।।
pādacārī samāyād yastasya muktirdhruvā'tra bho ।
bhūyo yātrāṃ prakuruṣe padbhyāṃ svanagarānnṛpa ।।79।।
tadā muktistu te syādvai puṇyamādāya yāhi bho ।
śrutvā rājā dharmaseno yayau tataḥ punargṛham ।।1.574.80।।
trayodaśyāṃ pādacārī narmadāyāmupāgamat ।
caturdaśyāṃ prage snātvā sārikeśaṃ dadarśa ha ।।8 1 ।।
viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sākṣāt kṛtvā smaran harim ।
yayau vimānamāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ pārameśvaram ।।।82।।
atha tīrthaṃ candramatyā narmadāyāṃ samāgamam ।
candreśvaraḥ sadāśaṃbhurvirājate'tra sarvadā ।।83 ।।
atha tīrthaṃ hāriṇaṃ ca lubdhakena mṛgaḥ purā ।
hato madhyandine śreṣṭhaḥ kuraṃgo narmadātaṭe ।।84।।
patito gatajīvaśca divyadehadharo'bhavat ।
vimānena tu divyena brahmalokaṃ jagāma saḥ ।।85।।
dṛṣṭvā vairāgyamāpanno lubdhako maraṇāya ha ।
nirṇayaṃ kṛtavāँstatra salile nimamajja ha ।।86 ।।
tatkṣaṇād divyadeho'sau gandharvapuramāyayau ।
hariṇeśvaramevaitalliṃgaṃ lubdheśvaraṃ tathā ।।87।।
tīrthaṃ bāṇeśvaraṃ cāpi dhanurīśvaramityapi ।
rameśvaraṃ pañcamaṃ ca tīrthaṃ muktipradaṃ hi tat। ।।88।।
tatra devāya bhāvena pradadyādaṣṭapuṣpakam ।
vārijaṃ saumyamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ tathā ।।89।।
vānaspatyaṃ prājāpatyaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ tathā'ṣṭamam ।
vārijaṃ salilaṃ jñeyaṃ saumyaṃ madhuyutaṃ payaḥ ।।1.574.90।।
āgneyaṃ dhūpadīpādi vāyavyaṃ candanādikam ।
pārthivaṃ kandamūlādi vānaspatyaṃ phalādikam ।।91 ।।
prājāpatyaṃ śubhā'nnādi śivapuṣpamupāsanam ।
ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ dvitīyamindriyagrahaḥ ।।।92।।
tṛtīyaṃ tu dayāpuṣpaṃ caturthaṃ smaraṇaṃ hareḥ ।
pañcamaṃ sadguroḥ sevā ṣaṣṭhaṃ vai pitṛpūjanam ।।93।।
saptamaṃ svāminaḥ sevā'ṣṭamaṃ nārāyaṇāśrayaḥ ।
ebhirvai prāpyate'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ।।94।।
rādhā vai prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ lakṣmīḥ puṣpaṃ dvitīyakam ।
tṛtīyaṃ pārvatī puṣpaṃ prabhā puṣpaṃ caturthakam ।।95।।
pañcamaṃ māṇikī puṣpaṃ jayā puṣpaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhakam ।
lalitā saptamaṃ puṣpaṃ maṃjulā puṣpamaṣṭamam ।।96।।
etā me puṣparūpā vai santi puṣpeṣu saṃsthitāḥ ।
vinā tā naiva gṛhṇāmi puṣpāṇi padmaje kvacit ।।97।।
haṃsā puṣpaṃ ca saguṇā puṣpaṃ campā supuṣpakam ।
dayā puṣpaṃ devikā saṃpuṣpaṃ muktā supuṣpakam ।।98।।
ṣoḍaśeṣūpacāreṣu sahasrāṇyapi ṣoḍaśa ।
kalā me saṃpraviṣṭā hi santi gṛhṇāmi tāṃstadā ।।99।।
vastunā matsvarūpeṇa pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi nityadā ।
evaṃ viṣṇumayo bhūtvā pūjayet sa gatiṃ labhet ।। 1.574.1 00।।
kṛtvā vai hariṇaṃ tīrthaṃ tato yāyāttu bhārgavam ।
tīrthottamaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ yatra kailāsavāsinaḥ ।। 101 ।।
andhakāsuramāhatya śaṃkareṇa samaṃ surāḥ ।
narmadāyāṃ yadā snātuṃ tīrthārthaṃ samupāyayuḥ ।। 1 02।।
uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlamavagāhya prayatnataḥ ।
gatvā tu dakṣiṇe kūle parvataṃ bhṛgusaṃjñitam ।। 1 03।।
haro bibheda śūlena tena bhinnaṃ rasātalam ।
pātālānniḥsṛtā gaṃgā nāmnā bhogavatī hi sā ।। 1 04।।
tatra tīrthaṃ samutpannaṃ śūlabhedābhidhaṃ tathā ।
tatra brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śivastiṣṭhanti sarvadā ।। 105।।
yatra gaṃgā ca yamunā narmadā ca sarasvatī ।
saṃgatā divyarūpeṇa śūlabhede vyavasthitāḥ ।। 1 06।।
cakratīrthaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tatra vai vartate sadā ।
sarvatīrthamayaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthādhikaṃ param ।। 1 07।।
sarvapuṇyādhikaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnamuttamam ।
bhṛgutīrthaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yatra lakṣmīrhi bhārgavī ।। 1 08।।।
viṣṇave bhṛguṇā dattā vivāhavidhinā purā ।
vaikuṇṭhasadṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ bhṛgutīrthaṃ taducyate ।। 1 09।।
kanyādānaṃ pūjanaṃ śrīhareḥ kāryaṃ hi tatsthale ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāsya dānapūjāphalaṃ labhet ।। 1.574.110 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sahasrayajñatīrthaśuklatīrthadvīpeśvaratīrthameghanādatīrthadāruvanatīrthakaraṃjeśvaratīrthajīvanatīrthaviśvarūpārevāsaṃgamacandrāvatīnarmadāsaṃgamahariṇeśvarādiśūlabhedabhṛgu-
kṣetrāditīrthanirūpaṇa nāmā catuḥsaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 574 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 574 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 575
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 576 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kanyādānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ dātavyaṃ mama pituḥ sthale ।
vada me śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmin kṛpāṃ kuru ।। 1 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
svavittenā'nukartavyaṃ kanyodvāhanamuttamam ।
yasyāgre naiva vittaṃ syāttena kanyā suśobhitā ।। 2 ।।
vastrādyaistulasīpatraṃ saṃspṛṣṭvā vahnisannidhau ।
kanyā deyā jalasākṣye viprasākṣye ca maṇḍape ।। 3 ।।
varamālāṃ gṛhītvā ca kanyā taṃ varayed varam ।
bhojanādyaṃ yathāśakti protsāhaśced dadecchubham ।। 4 ।।
yogyaṃ hṛdyaṃ varaṃ labdhvā pradadyād vikrayaṃ vinā ।
vikrayo dhanamāhṛtya dīyate pātakaṃ mahat ।। 5 ।।
abhigamya pradātavyā cottamaṃ tārakaṃ tu tat ।
āhūya tu pradātavyā madhyamaṃ tārakaṃ tu tat ।। 6 ।।
prasahya ca pradātavyā tvadhamaṃ dānameva tat ।
kiṃkarīvatpradātavyā niṣphalaṃ dāsikāsamam ।। 7 ।।
kanyādāne jāyamāne kuryuḥ śrīharikīrtanam ।
nāryaḥ kuṭumbināṃ tatra maṇḍape vādyaghoṣite ।। 8 ।।
nirvartite ca taddāne pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ hareḥ ।
kuryātāṃ dampatī paścād viśetāṃ nijamandiram ।। 9 ।।
pūjanādi prakuryātāṃ nityaṃ prātaḥ suvastubhiḥ ।
upacāraiḥ śreṣṭhatamaiḥ kuryātāṃ nā'parāddhakam ।। 1.575.1 0।।
pūjāparādhakartṝṇāṃ pāpamevopajāyate ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi vacmi doṣān prāyaścittayutān yathā ।। 11 ।।
mama bhakto mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ sadā bhavet ।
gṛhe devagṛhaṃ svalpaṃ pṛthak kṛtvā'rcayennu mām ।। 1 2।।
mūrtiṃ yathepsitāṃ nyasya snānāmbarasucandanaiḥ ।
patrapuṣpajalairbhojyairdhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ ।। 1 3।।
pradakṣiṇā''rtikaraṇaiḥ stutikṣamāvisarjanaiḥ ।
nityaṃ prapūjayed datvā dhyānaṃ vai matparāyaṇaḥ ।। 14।।
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kuryāt kīrtanaṃ copadeśanam ।
nartanaṃ vādanaṃ kuryādutsavaṃ sumanoharam ।। 15।।
śṛṇu tattvena me lakṣmi! mama dharmaṃ sanātanam ।
devā etanna jānanti yogajñāḥ sāṃkhyavedinaḥ ।। 16।।
vinā bhāgavatīṃ dīkṣāṃ pūjanaṃ me nirarthakam ।
lakṣeṣu labhate kaścid dīkṣāṃ mama sukhāvahām ।। 17।।
mayi śāntaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā tvabhigacched guruṃ prati ।
tadājñāṃ tu puraskṛtya prārthayet śādhi māṃ guro! ।। 18।।
guruṇā darśitān dīkṣādravyādīn samupāharet ।
lājā madhu kuśāँścāpi ghṛtaṃ cāmṛtamityapi ।। 1 9।।
dugdhaṃ dadhi gavāṃ mūtraṃ śakṛccāpi suśarkarām ।
yajñopavītaṃ gandhaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ cākṣatāṃstathā ।।1.575.20।।
puṣpāṇi tulasīṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyakaṃ phalam ।
jalaṃ mālāṃ ca kaṇṭhīṃ ca kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca dhotrakam ।।21।।
daṇḍaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ vāsaṃ uttarīyaṃ ghaṭaṃ tilān ।
pāduke'rghapātraṃ carusthālīṃ vrīhīṃśca darvikām ।।22।।
yavāṃśca guḍadhānāँśca phalāni bhojanāni ca ।
bhakṣyabhojyā'nnapānāni karmaṇyāni ca sarvaśaḥ ।। 23।।
yāni kāni ca bījāni ratnāni vividhāni ca ।
kācapātrāṇi kalaśaṃ cāmrapātrāṇi dorakam ।।24।।
aśokasya supatrāṇi paṭṭikāsanamityapi ।
tribhāṇaṃ cācamanīyaṃ homapātraṃ sruvādikam ।।25।।
homakāṣṭhāni sarvāṇi pippalodumbarāṇi ca ।
khādiraṃ bilvakāṣṭhaṃ cāpāmārgaṃ cārkamityapi ।।26 ।।
āmalakaṃ ca tulasīṃ candanaṃ ca vaṭaṃ tathā ।
śālaṃ ca madhukaṃ ceti kāṣṭhāni samupāharet ।।27।।
snātvā maṃgalasaṃyukto vediṃ kuryāt suśobhanām ।
brāhmaṇaścaturasrāṃ ṣoḍaśahastāṃ samantataḥ ।। 28।।
tatra dhānyairmaṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ prakārayet ।
navaṃ jalaghaṭaṃ madhye puṣpapallavaśobhitam ।।29।।
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ sthāpayed ratnagarbhagam ।
tasyopari tilaiḥ pūrṇāṃ sthālīṃ nyasya vidhānataḥ ।।1.575.3 0।।
pūjayenmāṃ parabrahma guruṃ cāpi suvastubhiḥ ।
vedimadhye sudravyāṇi sthāpayet saṃskṛtāni vai ।।3 1 ।।
caturaḥ kalaśān dadyāccatuḥpārśveṣu sundari ।
vāripūrṇānnūtnapatrayuktān phalairvibhūṣitān ।।32।।
sarvataḥ śuklavastraiśca veṣṭitānāmraśobhitān ।
upaspṛśyā'vasathe ca maṇḍape gurusannidhau ।।33 ।।
pūrvamukhād gurormantraṃ śiṣyaścottarasanmukhaḥ ।
vāmakarṇena gṛhṇīyānmantraṃ bhāgavataṃ param ।।34।।
'anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'stu śaraṇaṃ mama' ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya pataye svāhā' ।।35।।
etau mantrau guruḥ sarvān śrāvayet strīrnarānapi ।
dīkṣāṃgo mantra evā'sti jñānātmako harirhi saḥ ।।36।।
eṣa bhāgavato jātaḥ śiṣyo mantraprabhāvataḥ ।
etān bhāgavatān dṛṣṭvā cābhyutthānaṃ prakārayet ।।37।।
mānanīyā yathā'haṃ vai tathā bhāgavatā janāḥ ।
yastu bhāgavatān dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ bhāgavataḥ śuciḥ ।।38।।
abhyutthānaṃ na kurvīta tenā'haṃ tu prahiṃsitaḥ ।
kanyāṃ datvā tu bhaktāya punastāṃ preṣayenna yaḥ ।।3 9।।
aṣṭau pitṛgaṇāstena hiṃsitā nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
bhāryāṃ priyasakhīṃ yastu sādhvīṃ hinasti nirghṛṇaḥ ।।1.575.40।।
satīṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ gṛhasya devatām ।
punastenaiva pāpena nāpnoti sa striyaṃ kvacit ।।41 ।।
strīṇāṃ duḥkhaprakartāro bhavanti duḥkhinaḥ sadā ।
bilvavṛkṣodumbarau tūlasī cchakṣastathā'mrakaḥ ।।42।।
aśoko bakulaścāpyāmalakī karṇikā tathā ।
daivataravaḥ karmaṇyā na chettavyā hi mūlataḥ ।।43।।
dīkṣitena tathā lakṣmi tvabhakṣyaṃ varjyameva ha ।
apeyaṃ ca tathā varjyaṃ nindā varjyā ca hiṃsanam ।।44।।
paiśunyaṃ stainyamāvarjyaṃ kāryaṃ cātithyapūjanam ।
vyavāyaḥ sarvathā tyājyo brahmacaryaṃ ca nigrahaḥ ।।45।।
rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena guroḥ sevanamityapi ।
dṛṣṭvā parasya bhāgyāni dravyāṇi sampadādikam ।।46 ।।
dāridryaṃ cātmano dṛṣṭvā kāryaṃ nodvejanaṃ kvacit ।
evaṃ vai niyamān dadyānmātāpitrośca sevanam ।।47।।
niyamena pradadyācca śrīharerbhajanaṃ sadā ।
atha vedyāṃ sthāpayedaudumbarasya daladvayam ।।48।।
jalapātraṃ kṣuraṃ cāpi tata āvāhayecca mām ।
āgaccha bhagavaँścātra mūrtau vedyāṃ ca sannidhau ।।49।।
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ gṛhāṇaitat tataḥ svavapanaṃ śubham ।
kārayenmaṇḍapapārśve romapāpāni yānti yat ।।1.575.50।।
nīromaṃ ca śikhāyuktaṃ śoṇitena vivarjitam ।
kṣauraṃ prakārayitvā ca snātvā vastraṃ ca dhautrakam ।।51 ।।
uttarīyaṃ tathā dhṛtvā namaskuryād guruṃ harim ।
prajvālya vahnidevaṃ ca homapātreṇa cānale ।।52।।
ghṛtena madhumiśreṇa lājākṛṣṇatilādibhiḥ ।
datvā homaṃ saptavārān viṃśatiṃ ca tilodanam ।।53।।
tataḥ satyasvarūpaṃ tvāṃ vahniṃ namāmi saṃvadet ।
tisraḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ kṛtvā devaṃ bhāgavataṃ gurum ।।54।।
gurupādau prasaṃgṛhya prārthayet sadguruṃ tadā ।
gurudevaprasāden labdhā dīkṣā yadṛcchayā ।।55।।
yaccaivā'pakṛtaṃ kiñcid gururmarṣayatāṃ mama ।
ityuktavate śiṣyāya dadyād yajñopavītakam ।।56।।
kamaṇḍaluṃ tathā dadyājjalapātraṃ tu śuddhaye ।
candanaṃ viṣṇave cāpi gandhaṃ tailaṃ ca vaiṣṇavam ।।57।।
madhuparkaṃ tathā dadyācchiṣyaḥ pūjākramāgatam ।
vastraṃ bhūṣāṃ puṣpamālāṃ nārāyaṇāya cārpayet ।।58।।
tataḥ kaṇṭhīṃ taulasīṃ ca śiṣyakaṇṭhe gururdadet ।
tilakaṃ candrakayutaṃ lalāṭe'sya dadettathā ।।59।।
nāma nārāyaṇanāmnā kuryādācāryatānvitam ।
dāsyānvitaṃ ca vā kuryāttathā veṣaṃ yathocitam ।।1.575.60।।
yathāvyakti pradadyācca dānaṃ cāpi yathābalam ।
homavahniṃ tathā devaṃ guruṃ natvā ca vaiṣṇavān ।।6 1 ।।
dakṣiṇāṃ bhojanaṃ vastraṃ tebhyo datvā gṛhaṃ saret ।
kṛṣṇasārasya carmā'trāsanaṃ vipraḥ samarthayet ।।62।।
pālāśaṃ daṇḍamevā'yaṃ brāhmaṇo rakṣayet sadā ।
kṣatriyastvāyudhaṃ tyaktvā dīkṣāṃ proktavidhānataḥ ।।63 ।।
gṛhṇīyācchāgacarmā'pi plakṣadaṇḍaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।
vedikāṃ dvādaśahastāṃ kārayitvā ca pūrvavat ।।64।।
sarvamanyat pragṛhṇīyād dīkṣāyāṃ gurutaḥ śubham ।
niyamān dhārayennāhaṃ śastraṃ spṛśāmi hiṃsakam ।।65।।
dīkṣāṃ pūrvoktavidhinā prāpya bhāgavatīṃ tataḥ ।
śuddhān bhāgavatān sarvān bhojayed dānamarpayet ।।66 ।।
atha vaiśyaḥ sarvavastūnyāhṛtya vedikāṃ śubhām ।
daśahastāṃ kārayecca lepayed gomayena tām ।।67।।
chāgacarma dhārayecca daṇḍamaudumbaraṃ tathā ।
anyat sarvaṃ pūrvavacca kārayed dīkṣito bhavet ।।68।।
devābhivādanaṃ kṛtvā puro bhāgavateṣu ca ।
sādhūbhyo bhojanaṃ dadyādaparādhān kṣamāpayet ।।69।।
śūdro'pi gṛhṇīyād dīkṣāṃ bhāgavatīṃ śubhāvahām ।
sarvasaṃskāradravyāṇi mayā pūrvoditāni vai ।।1.575.70।।
tāni prakalpayed vedyāṃ vedī cāṣṭakarānvitā ।
kartavyā tatra vidhinā pūrvavat pūjayeddharim ।।71 ।।
carma nīlasya chāgasya daṇḍaśca vaiṣṇavo'sya vai ।
evaṃ dīkṣāṃ ca gṛhṇīyācchūdro bhāgavato bhavet ।।72।।
bhojayed vaiṣṇavān sādhūn sādhvīścāpi yathā ghanam ।
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ chatramācāryavedakam ।।73 ।।
brāhmaṇe pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ kṣatriye raktameva ca ।
vaiśye pītaṃ tathā śūdre nīlaṃ guruḥ pradāpayet ।।74।।
dīkṣitānāṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣmi vadāmi te'tra vai ।
sarvathā cintanīyo'haṃ gomukhyāṃ mālayā priye ।।75।।।
gaṇanā kārikā mālā taulasī sā gaṇāntikā ।
eṣā gaṇāntikā nāma dīkṣāṃgabījarūpiṇī ।।76।।
tayā me bhajanaṃ kāryaṃ dīkṣāyāḥ syānmahāphalam ।
guptāṃ guṇāntikāṃ kṛtvā cintayenmāṃ budhottamaḥ ।।77।।
kārtike mārgaśīrṣe ca vaiśākhe śuklapakṣake ।
ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro dvādaśyāṃ prātareva ha ।।78।।
dīkṣāṃ pragṛhṇīyāccedvai mucyate bhavabandhanāt ।
keśaprasādhanārthaṃ me dadyādvai kaṅkatīṃ śubhām ।।79।।
aṃjanaṃ darpaṇaṃ dadyāt tathā dadyācca mālikām ।
nocchiṣṭaḥ saṃspṛśenmālāmākāśe sthāpayeddhi tām ।।1.575.80।।
sandhyāṃ kuryānmama bhaktaḥ samyag dhyānātmikā tu sā ।
muhūrtaṃ dhyānamābadhya mama mantraṃ japenmuhuḥ ।।81 ।।
mamāgre dīpakaṃ kuryāttejorāśivivardhanam ।
mallalāṭe tilakaṃ sacandraṃ vai kārayettathā ।।82।।
dhūpaṃ sugandhaṃ me dadyādimaṃ ślokamudīrayet ।
sugandhāni tavā'ṅgāni svabhāvenaiva keśava ।।।83 ।।
amunā śubhadhūpena dhūpitāni gṛhāṇa tam ।
dīpaṃ dadyād ghṛtajanyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tārakaṃ śubham ।।84।।
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kāṃsyaṃ pātraṃ mama praśasyate ।
tāni tyaktveha sarvāṇi tāmraṃ hi mama rocate ।।85।।
śṛṇu tattvena me lakṣmi yena tāmraṃ mama priyam ।
pūrvaṃ kamalapatrākṣi guḍākeśo mahāsuraḥ ।।86 ।।
tāmrarūpaṃ samādāya mamaivārādhane rataḥ ।
varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi caturdaśa suniścalaḥ ।।87।।
tasya tāmrāśramaṃ cāhaṃ yayau prasannatāyutaḥ ।
caturbāhuṃ sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇanāma sa vai muhuḥ ।।88।।
mayoktaṃ te prasanno'smi varaṃ brūhi hṛdīpsitam ।
guḍākeśastadā prāha viśuddhenāntarātmanā ।।89।।
janmanāṃ tu sahasrāṇi tvayi bhaktirdṛḍhā'stu me ।
cakreṇa vadhamicchāmi tvayā muktena mādhava ।।1.575.90 ।।
mama cakrahatasyaitadvasāmāṃsādikaṃ ca yat ।
tāmraṃ nāma bhaved deva pavitrīkaraṇaṃ śubham ।।91 ।।
tāmrapātre'rpite te'stu prītiḥ sarvādhikā prabho ।
bāḍhamiti mayoktaḥ sa yāvallokasya saṃsthitiḥ ।।92।।
tāvattāmrasvarūpastvaṃ mama pātraṃ bhaviṣyasi ।
tattāmrabhājane mahyaṃ dīyate yat supuṣkalam ।।93 ।।
maṅgalyaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca mayā tāmraṃ kṛtaṃ tadā ।
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣasya dvādaśyāṃ madhyage ravau ।।94।।
cakrādvadhamabhīpsan vai śubhaṃ kurvan madarthakam ।
viṣṇusaṃstho bhaviṣyāmi kadā'hamiti cintayan ।। 95।।
mama pūjāṃ tadā kṛtvā prārthayāmāsa māṃ prati ।
muñca muñca prabho cakramapi vahnisamaprabham ।। 96 ।।
ātmā me nīyatāṃ śīghraṃ nikṛttyā'ṅgāni sarvaśaḥ ।
mayā cakreṇa ca hataḥ prāpto māṃ parameśvaram ।।97।।
tāmraṃ tanmāṃsamasrakva kataṃ mayā yathoditam ।
tāmre prāpaṇakaṃ dadyāt pūjābhojanaprabhṛti ।।98।।
sikthe sikthe phalaṃ tasya śatāśvamedhajaṃ bhavet ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni mama dhāmani ।।99।।
modate sa tato dhāma paraṃ yāti paraṃ padam ।
evaṃ māṃ bhojayitvaiva tāmrapātre ca kānake ।। 1.575.100 ।।
rājate'pi ca tāmbūlaṃ datvā visarjanaṃ caret ।
ityevaṃ mama bhakto vai dīkṣito'rcanamācaret ।। 101 ।।
nityaṃ nityaṃ priye lakṣmi satyaitacchaṃbhunoditam ।
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi mama dhāmagato bhavet ।। 1 02।।
naro nārī tathā'nyaśca dīkṣāṃ labdhvā vidhānataḥ ।
māṃ bhajedātmano mokṣaṃ labhejjanmaphalaṃ hi tat ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛyugasantāne kanyādānaṃ bhāgavatīdīkṣāvidhānaṃ guḍākeśākhyāsurasya cakreṇa nāśottaraṃ tadvasā'sṛkprabhṛtīnāṃ tāmradhātutvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 575 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 575 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 576
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 577 →

śrīlakṣmīrubāca-
ahaṃ dīkṣāṃ śubhāṃ śrutvā nārāyaṇa mukhāttava ।
tava māhātmyabodhā ca jātā'smi vimalā prabho ।। 1 ।।
aho devasya māhātmyaṃ cāturvarṇyasukhāvaham ।
dīkṣādānena vai jñātaṃ tathā'nyad bhaktakāraṇāt ।। 2 ।।
pṛcchāmi cāparādheṣu kiṃ phalaṃ kiṃ nivāraṇam ।
tava pūjāparāṇāṃ tvaṃ śuddhiṃ vada janārdana ।। 3 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi cāparādhaviśodhanam ।
śuddho bhāgavato bhūtvā mama pūjāparāyaṇaḥ ।। 4 ।।
āpadgato'pi rājānnaṃ bhuṃkte yaḥ pāpasaṃbhṛtam ।
niraye tena pāpena vāsastasya prajāpate ।। 5 ।।
rājā pravartate kurvan karma tāmasarājasam ।
dāruṇaṃ garhitaṃ tasya cānnaṃ pāpabharaṃ mahat ।। 6 ।।
dhārmikena na bhoktavyaṃ rājānnaṃ narakapradam ।
yadvā rājñāṃ tu bhoktavyaṃ bhojyaṃ bhāgavatairnaraiḥ ।। 7 ।।
sthāpayitvā tu māṃ lakṣmi! nivedya māṃ ca sarvaśaḥ ।
dhanyadhānyasamṛddhāni datvā māṃ svīkaroti cet ।। 8 ।।
siddhaṃ bhāgavatairbhaktairmama śeṣaprasādikam ।
bhuñjānasya na vai pāpalepastatra prajāyate ।। 9 ।।
aprasādaṃ ca rājānnaṃ bhuṃkte tasya tu padmaje ।
cāndrāyaṇena śuddhiḥ syānmama bhaktasya vai tathā ।। 1.576.1 0।।
dantakāṣṭhamacarvitvā cā'kṛtvā mukhaśodhanam ।
snātvā spṛśati māṃ cet sa durgandhimukhavān yataḥ ।।1 1 ।।
puṇyahīno bhaved bhakto mamā'parādhatastataḥ ।
manuṣyaḥ kilbiṣī lakṣmi kaphapittamalānvitaḥ ।। 12।।
pūyaśoṇitadurgandhi mukhamasya yataḥ sadā ।
śuddha vāyuṃ samācamya durgandhaṃ ca vimuñcati ।। 1 3।।।
tena me mūrtisāmīpye'parādhastasya jāyate ।
dantakāṣṭhena śuddhiḥ syātsugandhyadhadravyayojanāt ।।14।।
aparādhe tathā jāte vyomaśāyī dinadvayam ।
bhavet mamā'tibhajanaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ।। 15।।
śatamālājapaṃ kuryādaparādho na vidyate ।
atha kṛtvā maithunaṃ cā'snātaḥ śavātmako hi saḥ ।। 16।।
tadaparādhapākaśca lālākhye niraye patet ।
manuṣyasya paro dharmaḥ snānaṃ dhyānaṃ ca pūjanam ।।17।।
asnāto malamūtrāḍhyo malākhye niraye patet ।
prāyaścittaṃ tasya kāryaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā ।। 18।।
yāvakaṃ vā ca piṇyākaṃ bhakṣayedvai dinatrayam ।
turyaṃ copavaset tena śuddhirbhaktasya jāyate ।।19।।
atha spṛṣṭvā śavaṃ gatvā śmaśānaṃ snāti naiva yaḥ ।
tasyā'śuddhasya pitaraḥ patanti so'pi vai patet ।।1.576.20।।
śmaśāne jambukā bhūtvā bhavanti śavabhakṣakāḥ ।
prāyaścittaṃ tasya kāryaṃ mama bhaktena cāṃjasā ।।21 ।।
ekāhāro dinaikyaṃ ca dinaikyaṃ cāpyupoṣitaḥ ।
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā śuddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।22।।
nārīṃ rajasvalāṃ spṛṣṭvā yo māṃ spṛśati nirghṛṇaḥ ।
tena pāpena bhakto'pi yāmye yāti rajomaye ।।।23।।
andhastataḥ prajāyeta daridro buddhivarjitaḥ ।
śuddhistasyāparādhasyopoṣaṇaṃ tvekameva ha ।।।24।।।
ākāśaśayanaṃ snānaṃ savastraṃ gavyaprāśanam ।
kṛtvā mucyedaśuddheḥ sa mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ।।।25।।
spṛṣṭvā tu mṛtakaṃ lakṣmi! yo matkṣetreṣu tiṣṭhati ।
na snāti māṃ spṛśatyeṣaścāṇḍālajanma cāpnuyāt ।।26।।
andhaḥ sa jāyate paścānmaṇḍuko makṣikā bhavet ।
ṭiṭṭibho vā maśakaśca kṛkalāsaḥ kharo'thavā ।।27।।
mārjāro vānaro vāpi jāyate tvaparādhavān ।
śudyarthaṃ tādṛśo bhakto mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ।।28।।
ekāhāraṃ pañcadaśadināni vartayettataḥ ।
pañcagavyaṃ prāśayecca śuddhyatyevā'parādhataḥ ।।29।।।
spṛśamānena māṃ laśmi muñcatyapānavāyukam ।
tena doṣeṇa jāyeta makṣikā mūṣakastathā ।।1.576.3 0।।
śvā vā kūrmaḥ prajāyeta tataḥ sa mānavo bhavet ।
ato naktaṃ trīṇyahāni vartayet tena śuddhyati ।।31 ।।
śatamālājapaṃ kuryāt snāyād bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।
purīṣaṃ mucyate yastu vātena saha doṣataḥ ।।।32।।
mama pūjāsthito vāpi mamānyakarmatatparaḥ ।
purīṣanarake yāmye patet tena tataḥ param ।।33।।
manuṣyo jāyate lakṣmi mama karmaparāyaṇaḥ ।
prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ jale śayanamityapi ।।।34।।
ākāśaśayanaṃ cāpi dinaikyaṃ prasamācaret ।
śatamālājapaṃ kuryādaparādhātpramucyate ।।35।।
snātvā'pi yadi mārgeṣu malineṣu pragacchati ।
aprakṣālitapādādyo yo hi māmupasarpati ।।36।।
so'pyaśuddhaḥ pāpavān syānmama vipriyakārakaḥ ।
tena dattaṃ gandhamālyaṃ na vai gṛhṇāmi bhāvataḥ ।।37
tena prakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā pādayoḥ karayostathā ।
ācamya ca yathānyāyaṃ śuddhaḥ san māmupaspṛśet ।।38
malatyāgaṃ tathā kṛtvā saptavāraṃ tu mṛttikām ।
prakṣālanendriye datvā karayośca tathā dadet ।। 39
pādayoḥ pañcavāraṃ ca tataḥ pātraṃ parimṛjet ।
gaṇḍūṣān sapta kṛtvā ca tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ।।1.576.40
madbhakto vai bhavecchuddhaḥ pūjako nānyathā priye ।
gandhāṃśahastayuktaścetspṛśenmāṃ doṣabhāgbhabet ।।41 ।
prāṇāyāmaṃ cācamanaṃ kṛtvā prakṣālayet karau ।
evaṃ śuddhirbhavellakṣmi nā'parādhastadā bhavet ।।42
yastu krodhasamāyukto mama bhakto'pi mānavaḥ ।
praspṛśenmama gātrāṇi sa tadā doṣabhāgbhavet ।।43
tena pāpena cillī syāt tataḥ śyeno bhavet sa ca ।
mṛtkaṭiko bhavet kīṭaḥ krodhena kṛṣṇavarṇavān ।।44
kruddhena na ca kartavyaṃ lobhena tvarayā na ca ।
matpūjanaṃ vidhānena kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ hiṃ tat ।।।45
snātvā mālāśataṃ kuryāt krodhaśuddhistato matā ।
akarmaṇyena puṣpeṇa yo māmarcayate bhuvi ।।46।
mūrkho bhāgavataścāpi vānaro jāyate tataḥ ।
mārjāro vā balīvardaḥ chāgo bā grāmakukkuṭaḥ ।। 47.
mahiṣo vā bhavet puṣpadātā yanme na rocate ।
tacchuddhyarthaṃ caikabhojī bhavedvai dinasaptakam ।।48।
sarvapāpapramuktaḥ syānmama loke gatirbhavet ।
rudhirāktāmbarayukto yadi māmupasarpati ।।49।
rajasvalārajoyuktavastrāḍhyo māṃ ca sarpati ।
tena doṣeṇa jāyeta śvapaco nātra saṃśayaḥ ।।1.576.50।।
māsamekānnabhojī syānmālāsahasrakaṃ japet ।
antime tu dine kuryādupavāsaṃ sa śuddhyati ।।51।।
andhakāre vinā dīpaṃ spṛśate māṃ sa doṣabhāk ।
andhajanma bhavet tasya prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi ca ।।52।
ekāhāraṃ pañcadinaṃ netrācchādanapūrvakam ।
kuryānmālāśataṃ cāpi japecchuddho bhavettadā ।।53।।
kṛṣṇavastraṃ na vai dhāryaṃ pūjāyāṃ mama sarvathā ।
tena doṣeṇa nakulaḥ kacchapo vā bhavettataḥ ।।54।।
pārāvato bhavedvāpi prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi te ।
saptāhaṃ caikabhojī syānmālāśataṃ prakārayet ।।55।।
tataḥ śuddhirbhavettasya mama lokagato bhavet ।
vāsasā cā'pyadhautena yo me karmāṇi cācaret ।।56।।
sa ca hastī tathoṣṭro vā hayo vā jambuko'thavā ।
sāraṃgo vā bhavettasmācchuddhiḥ kāryā prayatnataḥ ।।57।।
upavāsaṃ caredekaṃ japecca śatamālikāḥ ।
athocchiṣṭaṃ śunau yattad dadyāccenme ca karmaṇi ।।58।।
sārameyo bhavetso'pi gomāyurghūka eva vā ।
śuddhiḥ kāryā śākamūlaphalāśinā dinatrayam ।।59।।
pañcagavyaṃ caturthe ca pibedupavasettathā ।
aparādho vinaśyedvai mama lokagato bhavet ।।1.576.60।।
dīpaprakāśane kṛṣṇakajjalā cāṅgulirbhavet ।
dagdhavartigandhayuktā kṣālanīyā prayatnataḥ ।।61 ।।
karasyā'kṣālane sparśe mama syādaparādhanam ।
kuṣṭhī tena bhavedrogī tasmāddhastaṃ viśodhayet ।।62।।
aparādhe saṃjāte śatamālājapaṃ caret ।
sopavāsaṃ tena śuddhirbhavet karmaṇyako bhavet ।।6 3।।
śmaśānaṃ yo jano gatvā tvasnātvaiva tu māṃ spṛśet ।
jambuko gṛdhrako vā sa jāyate vā piśācakaḥ ।।64।।
tataścopavaseccaikadinaṃ mālāsahasrakam ।
japettena bhavecchuddhirnānyathā snānamātrataḥ ।।65।।
śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
śmaśānaṃ tvapavitraṃ cecchaṃbhurbhāgavatottamaḥ ।
tava bhaktaḥ kathaṃ cāste śmaśāne doṣabhāgyathā ।।66 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi purāvṛttaṃ śaṃbhoste kathayāmyaham ।
śmaśānaṃ nāsti śuddhaṃ vai yadaśuddhaṃ sadā matam ।।67।।
kenacittu nimittena śaṃbhurvāsamarocayat ।
prāyaścittasvarūpaṃ taṃ vāsaṃ na manute sadā ।।68।।
yadyapi śaṃkaro bhaktottamo me vartate mahān ।
śmaśāne vasatastasya gṛhṇāmi nā'rcanādikam ।।69।।
prāyaścittottaraṃ sarvaṃ gṛhṇāmi nānyathā kvacit ।
śaṃkaro nāśayāmāsa tripurāṇi tathā'suram ।।1.576.70।।
bālān vṛddhāँstathā strīśca tripure vāsinastataḥ ।
tena pāpena saṃlipto naṣṭaiśvaryaśca śaṃkaraḥ ।।71 ।।
naṣṭayogabalo naṣṭamāyābalo babhūva ha ।
vivarṇavadano bhūtvā na śaknoti viceṣṭitum ।।72।।
mṛtaprāyo'bhavacchāpairāsurastrīsamarpitaiḥ ।
naṣṭasaṃjño hatajñāno naṣṭānando yathā'balaḥ ।।73 ।।
tato'haṃ taṃ samāpanno vilokya śaṃkaraṃ tataḥ ।
avocaṃ mā śucaḥ śreyaḥ kariṣye tava vai drutam ।।74।।
mayā dṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaraśca tadā divyena cakṣuṣā ।
tāvadrudrasya sāmarthyaṃ prakāśamagamatpunaḥ ।।75।।
mayoktaṃ tava pāpasya nāśārthamahamāgataḥ ।
śrutvovāca haro māṃ ca pāpasantaptalocanaḥ ।।76 ।।
he viṣṇo tvatprasādena hatastripurakā'suraḥ ।
nihatā dānavāstatra garbhiṇyaśca nipātitāḥ ।।77।।
bālavṛddhā hatāścāpi dagdhāni tripurāṇi ca ।
tatpāpasya prabhāveṇa na śaknomi viceṣṭitum ।।78।।
praṇaṣṭaiśvaryamāyaśca naṣṭajñānātmasadbalaḥ ।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā viṣṇo pāpāvasthena sāmpratam ।।79।।
viṣṇo tattvena māṃ brūhi pāpasyā'sya viśodhanam ।
evaṃ prārthayamānasya mayā rudrasya bhāṣitam ।।1.576.80।।
kapālamālāṃ sandhārya samalo vihara kṣitau ।
śaṃbhuḥ papraccha māṃ kīdṛk samalatvaṃ prakīrtyate ।।81 ।।
mayoktaṃ vai śmaśānaṃ ca malaṃ pūtikamucyate ।
śmaśāne vāsa evā'tra samalatvaṃ prakīrtyate ।।82।।
tatrā''dāya kapālāni rama tatraiva śaṃkara ।
bhūtapretādibhṛtyaiśca sārdhaṃ vasa samāśatam ।।83।।
tāvatpūjā mama naiva kartavyā bāhyataḥ kvacit ।
mānasaṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ nāparādho bhaviṣyati ।।84।।
pūrṇe varṣaśate yāte gautamasyāśramaṃ vraja ।
prasādād gautamamunerbhavitā gatakilbiṣaḥ ।।85।।
tataḥ pāpavināśena śarīraśuddhimācara ।
varṣamātraṃ vrataṃ payovrataṃ gṛhāṇa śuddhikṛt ।।86 ।।
brahmakūrcaṃ ca vā śreṣṭhaṃ vrataṃ māsikamityapi ।
kariṣyasi tathā śuddhaḥ pūjanārho bhaviṣyasi ।।87।।
paścāt tvayā śmaśāne na vastavyaṃ karhicicchava! ।
yadīcchasi mama pūjāyogyatvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vṛṣam ।।88।।
rudrāyaivaṃ varaṃ datvā tatraivā'ntarhito'bhavam ।
rudropi bhramate varṣaśataṃ śmaśānake sthale ।।89।।
vinā tu kṛtasaṃskāro mamādeśaparāyaṇaḥ ।
varṣaśate gate rudro yayau vai gautamāśramam ।।1.576.90।।
gautamena tadā tasyopadeśaḥ samprakīrtitaḥ ।
rūpadvayaṃ sadā rudra pradhāraya kriyāvaśāt ।।91।।
pāpaṃ sarvaṃ gataṃ te'tra śuddho'si vaiṣṇavo mahān ।
mahābhāgavataṃ rūpaṃ sadā gṛhāṇa sāttvikam ।।92।।
kailāse sarvadā tiṣṭha bhakteṣvapi ca sāttvikaḥ ।
chāyātmakaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca rūpaṃ dhāraya bhairavam ।।13।।
bhūtapretapiśācānāmupāsyaṃ samalaṃ ca tat ।
śmaśānavāsayogyaṃ ca tāmasānāṃ sadāśrayam ।।94।।
ityuktaḥ śaṃkaro dhṛtvā rūpadvayaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ।
śmaśānastho na me bhakto na vā vaiṣṇava ityapi ।।95।।
kailāsastho hi me bhaktaḥ pūjārho vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ।
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi! śmaśānaṃ samalaṃ sadā ।। 96।।
śmaśānasthāḥ samalā vai na vai śuddhāḥ śavasthale ।
paścād rudrasya bhūtādyaistāmasaistādṛśairjanaiḥ ।।97।।
śaṃkarasya tu kailāsaṃ śmaśānaṃ ceti varṇyate ।
vastuto naivamevā'sti śmaśānaṃ śaṃkarapriyam ।।98।।
śmaśānaṃ naiva kasyāpi lakṣmi vai bhavati priyam ।
devānāṃ tu kathaṃ tat syāt priyaṃ sattvakriyāvatām ।।99।।
iti te kathitaṃ tattvaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi te ।
pañcagavyaṃ prāśanīyaṃ sopavāsaṃ dinaikake ।। 1.576.1 00।।
savastraṃ snānamāptavyaṃ tulasīpatrabhojanam ।
vimuktastena pāpena mama karmārhaṇo bhavet ।। 101 ।।
madyapānaprakartā tu bhraṣṭo bhavati dehataḥ ।
brahmakūrcavratenā'sya śuddhirbhavati sarvathā ।। 102।।
ulūkaḥ syādanyathā saḥ kīṭo bhavati vai punaḥ ।
brahmakūrcavrataṃ vacmi śṛṇu lakṣmi! praśodhakam ।। 1 03।।
māsaṃ vā pakṣakaṃ vā tat kartavyaṃ dehadhāriṇā ।
payasyāmalakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ palāśapatramityapi ।। 1 04।।
śarkarāṃ tulasīpatraṃ kvāthayecca pibed dine ।
yathāpacyaṃ bhavet tadvad vikṛtaṃ na yathā bhavet ।। 1 05।।
anyat kiñcid bhakṣayenna jalaṃ pibettu śāntaye ।
brahmakūrcavrataṃ tvetat pākṣikaṃ māsikaṃ ca vā ।। 1 06।।
yāni kāni ca patrāṇi pāvanāni hi śākhinām ।
kvāthayecca pibennityaṃ pālāśaṃ tatra niścitam ।।1 07।।
pañcagavyaṃ pibedvāpi pākṣikaṃ māsikaṃ ca vā ।
brahmakūrcasamaṃ tacca sarvapāpapraśodhakam ।। 1 08।।
kāyākalpakaraṃ tvetanmokṣadaṃ maraṇe sati ।
śarīradhātuśuddhyarthaṃ recanaṃ kvāthanaṃ tu tat ।। 1 09।।
brahmabhaktyā kṛtaṃ tadvai mokṣaṇārthaṃ prakalpyate ।
prāyaścittīkṛtaṃ tadvai pāpakṣālanakaṃ bhavet ।। 1.576.11 0।।
roganāśakṛte cettaddhātuśuddhikaraṃ bhavet ।
apacyaṃ cet kvacittadvai maraṇāya prakalpyate ।। 111 ।।
palāṇḍuśākapatrādibhakṣakaḥ syāddhi sūkaraḥ ।
śvā bhavejambuko vāpi mamāparādhakṛnnaraḥ ।। 1 12।।
brahmakūrcavrataṃ kṛtvā śatamālājapāṃścaret ।
tena śuddhirbhavettasya mama karmārhaṇo bhavet ।। 11 3।।
yaḥ pārakyena vastreṇa na dhautenāpi māṃ spṛśet ।
mṛgajanma hyavāpnoti hīnapādaikako bhavet ।। 1 14।।
māghamāse jale tiṣṭhetpraharadvayameva ha ।
tena śuddhiḥ śatamālā japed bhavati nirmalaḥ ।। 1 15।।
navānnaṃ yo nā'rpayenme svayaṃ bhuṃkte rasāhṛtaḥ ।
pāpabhoktā bhavettena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam ।। 1 16।।
śatamālājapaścāpi tena śuddhyati mānavaḥ ।
adattvā gandhamālyāni yo me dhūpaṃ prayacchati ।। 1 17।।
yātudhāno bhavettena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam ।
śatamālājapaścāpi tena śuddhyati vaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 1 18।।
vahannupānahau padbhyāṃ yastu māmupasaṃkramet ।
carmakāraḥ sa jāyeta tataḥ śvā sūkaro bhavet ।। 1 19।।
pākṣikaṃ caikabhuktaṃ ca śatamālāḥ samācaret ।
tena śuddhirbhavet tasya mama bhaktasya padmaje ।। 1.576. 120।।
vinā ghaṇṭādiśabdaṃ tu yo vai māṃ pratibodhayet ।
badhiro jāyate tena kartavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam ।। 121 ।।
śatamālājapaścāpi mama bhaktaḥ sa śuddhyati ।
annaṃ bhuktvā bahutaramajīrṇena pariplutaḥ ।। 122।।
udgāreṇa samāvṛtto'snātaścāpyupasarpati ।
vānaro vā śṛgālaḥ śvā chāgo vā jāyate hi saḥ ।। 123।।
tridinaṃ copavāsī syānmālāśataṃ ca vartayet ।
ya etena vidhānena prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ।। 1 24।।
na sa lipyeta pāpena mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ।
yastu bhāgavato nityaṃ kalyamutthāya vācayet ।। 1 25।।
paṭhedvā śṛṇuyāccāpi mama lokaṃ sa gacchati ।
śaṃbhunoktaṃ hi yat satyai mayoktaṃ tava padmaje ।। 1 26।।
ārogyāṇāṃ mahārogyaṃ mokṣāṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ param ।
śodhanānāṃ parā śuddhiḥ prasannānāṃ ca pātratā ।। 1 27।।
tapaḥ paramaṃ tapasāṃ bhaktyātmakaṃ mayoditam ।
mama bhaktena kartavyaṃ rakṣasāṃ na vicāraṇā ।। 1 28।।
mumukṣūṇāṃ yogināṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca satāmapi ।
mama bhaktiyutānāṃ ca kṛte mayātra kīrtitam ।।1 29।।
garbhaviṣaprasaktānāṃ vāsanāsaṃhṛtahṛdām ।
nāstikānāṃ kṛte naitanmayoktaṃ lakṣmi! śodhanam ।। 1.576.1 30।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhagavatpūjane'parādhā ye te teṣāṃ śuddhiḥ śarīrāntarayonyantarāptirvā cetyādi, śaṃkarasya śmaśānapriyatvākhyānamaśmaśānavāsitā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 576 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 577
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 578 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! śṛgālyāśca gṛdhrasya ca mṛteranu ।
tīrthasparśaprasaṃgena rājyalabdhiśca mokṣaṇam ।। 1 ।।
akāmā yā mṛtā tīrthe babhūva rājaputrikā ।
śṛgālyapi viśālākṣī catuḥṣaṣṭikalānvitā ।। 2 ।।
tatra mṛtastathā gṛdhraḥ so'pi rājā babhūva ha ।
aho tīrthaprabhāvo vai tiryañcau divyatāṃ gatau ।। 3 ।।
haimadeśe brahmadatto'bhavat kāmpilyabhūpatiḥ ।
tatkumāraḥ somadattaḥ śrāddhārthaṃ pravicintya ca ।। 4 ।।
pitrarthe mṛgayāṃ yāto mṛgalipsurvane tadā ।
na tatra labhate kiñcicchṛgālī tena vīkṣitā ।। 5 ।।
śareṇa tena viddhā sā gaṃgājalamupāgatā ।
tīre pītvā jalaṃ śīghraṃ tīrthe prāṇān mumoca ha ।। 6 ।।
tāvad vaṭe kumāraḥ sa gṛdhraṃ dadarśa saṃsthitam ।
śareṇa pātayāmāsa gṛdhraṃ rājakumārakaḥ ।। 7 ।।
mṛtaḥ so'pi jalatīre patitvā puṇyamāptavān ।
somadatto dvayaṃ nītvā yayau gṛhaṃ tataśca tau ।। 8 ।।
gṛdhraḥ kaliṃgarājasya suto babhūva śobhanaḥ ।
sṛgālī sā tathā jajñe kāñcīrājasya putrikā ।। 9 ।।
dvayostīrthaprabhāveṇa sambandho'jāyata svataḥ ।
vivāhitau sukhaṃ kālaṃ ninyatuścātibhāvukau ।। 1.577.1 0।।
premṇā vyāptau na cānyonyaṃ sehāte virahaṃ kvacit ।
athaikadā vadhūḥ prāha svāminaṃ praṇayānvitā ।। 11 ।।
mayaikaṃ hi vrataṃ kāryaṃ deyā'nujñā tvayā priya! ।
mama snehāt priyaṃ cet te'nujñāṃ dātumihā'rhasi ।। 1 2।।
satyaṃ mūlaṃ prajānāṃ ca viṣṇuḥ satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
satyamūlaṃ sadā rājyaṃ vrataṃ satyena vardhate ।। 13।।
ityuktastu patiḥ prāha vijñāpaya kuru priye ।
yayeṣṭaṃ cara sarvaṃ tad dāsye sāhāyyamuttamam ।। 14।।
sā'pi bhartṛvacaḥ śrutvā saviśrambhā hyuvāca tam ।
ekā svapitumicchāmi madhyāhnehaṃ tathāvidhā ।।15।।
yathā kaścinna māṃ paśyet svalpakālaṃ tu nityadā ।
śvaśuro yadi vā śvaśrūḥ patiścānyo'pi vā janaḥ ।। 16 ।।
suptāṃ māṃ naiva paśyet sa vratametanmuhūrtakam ।
śrutvā bāḍhamuvācaināṃ patnīṃ rājakumārakaḥ ।।17।।
saudhaṃ svataṃtraṃ tasyai sa dadau yatra na vai janaḥ ।
kaścidapi drakṣyate na śayanīye mahāvratām ।।18।।
evaṃ vai samayaṃ kṛtvā vartate sa kumārakaḥ ।
pitrā dattaṃ tu tadrājyaṃ bubhuje praśaśāsa saḥ ।। 19।।
tasyā'bhavan pañca putrā jyeṣṭhāya rājyamādadat ।
atha svayaṃ yathā patnī tathā vratamupāśritaḥ ।।1.577.20।।
ekākī svapate yatra kaścijjano na paśyati ।
saptasaptativarṣāṇi vyatītānyasya vai tataḥ ।।21।।
aṣṭasaptatike varṣa hyekānte sa narādhipaḥ ।
tameva cintayannarthaṃ madhyasaṃsthe divākare ।।22।।
vaiśākhasya tu māsasya śukle dvādaśikādine ।
buddhiḥ pravartitā tasya priyādarśanalālasā ।।23।।
ko'rcyastat kiṃ vrataṃ tvasyā eṣā svapiti nirjane ।
na suptāyā vrataṃ kiñcit sampadyate supuṇyakṛt ।।24।।
na kenacit kṛto dharmaḥ suptavyaṃ vratameva tat ।
bhuktvā tu kāmabhogān vai bhuktvā tu piśitodanam ।।25।।
tāmbūlaṃ kṣaumavastrādi vibhūṣaṇāni mālikāḥ ।
śṛṃgārādikasarvāṇi sugandharañjanāni ca ।।26।।
vrataṃ kasmād bhavedatra suptā karoti yadvratam ।
avaśyameva draṣṭavyā kīdṛśaṃ carati vratam ।।27।।
kupyetā'pi tu sandṛṣṭā kupyatveva tathāpi vai ।
yadvā gacchati kruddhā sā yatra gacchatu rocate ।।28।।
yadvā hānirbhavet kācit sāpi cāstu tathāpi sā ।
draṣṭavyaivaṃ cintayato vyoma prāpto divākaraḥ ।।29।।
snātaḥ sa vidhinā cātha kṣaumābhyāmupasaṃvṛtaḥ ।
bhūtvā cotsārayāmāsa sarvān bhṛtyān samīpataḥ ।।1.577.30।।
adya vrate mayā stheyaṃ nāgantavyaṃ janairgṛham ।
rājabhavanadvāraṃ vā nareṇāpi ca yoṣitā ।।3 1।।
yadyāgamiṣyati kaścinmama vadhyo bhaviṣyati ।
evamājñāpayitvā tu rājā saudhāntaraṃ gataḥ ।।32।।
paryaṃkasya tale rājñyā gupto babhūva chādanaiḥ ।
rājñī madhyāhnavelāyāṃ samāyātā tadāsane ।।33।।
rujārtā rurude tatra śirovedanapīḍitā ।
kiṃ mayā tu kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yatphalaṃ vedanātmakam ।।34।।
bhartā'pi māṃ na jānāti pīḍāyuktāṃ svamastake ।
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ me martavyaṃ bhavet khalu ।।35।।
bhartā pṛcchati naivātra kiṃ vrataṃ kīdṛśaṃ ca te ।
mayā tasmai kathitavyaṃ nānyathā'nto bhaviṣyati ।।36।।
kathane maraṇaṃ me syād vaktavyaṃ nāśakṛd bhavet! ।
akathane sadā duḥkhaṃ soḍhavyaṃ na nivartate ।।37।।
tasmānmayā pragantavyaṃ bhartrā saha ca tatsthalam ।
yatrā'haṃ duḥkhamāpannā kathayiṣye tataḥ patim ।।38।।
iti priyāvacaḥ śrutvā samutthāya tato nṛpaḥ ।
dorbhyāmāliṃgya vai bhāryāṃ dhairyeṇovāca sundarīm ।।39।।
kimidaṃ bhāṣase bhadre svātmānaṃ pīḍitaṃ prati ।
bhiṣajaḥ santi bahavo nāśayiṣyanti pīḍanam ।।1.577.40।।
tvayā pūrvaṃ vratamiṣād vedaneyaṃ sugopitā ।
yena vai kliśyase bhadre śirasyasukhapīḍitā ।।41 ।।
yā tvaṃ ca bhāṣase bhadre yatra vai duḥkhapīḍitā ।
pūrvaṃ jātā tatra gatvā kathayiṣye ca me patim ।।।42।।
bhadre kiṃ tat sthalaṃ brūhi yātrāṃ te rocate yadi ।
avaśyaṃ tatra saṃyāhi mayā sākaṃ sukhaṃ labha ।।43।।
kimidaṃ gopyate devi patyagre tvaṃ pativrate ।
bhartā dharmo yaśo bhartā bhartaiva priyamātmanaḥ ।।44।।
bhartre vācyaṃ gopyamapi dharmaḥ pativratoditaḥ ।
ityuktā sā patiṃ prāha kathane'tra vināśanam ।।45।।
bhavettasmānna vaktavyaṃ tava pīḍākaraṃ prabho ।
sukhe hi vartase nityaṃ mahārājo'si sundaraḥ ।।46।।
bahvyo matsadṛśībhāryāstiṣṭhantyantaḥpure tava ।
sukhaṃ bhuṃkṣva mahārāja māmekāṃ parihāya ca ।।47।।
gacchāmyahaṃ mama sthānaṃ tato mṛtyurhi me dhruvaḥ ।
rājase devavad rājan na māṃ tatpraṣṭumarhasi ।।48।।
tvaṃ me devo guruḥ sākṣād bhartā yajñaḥ sanātanaḥ ।
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca yaśaḥ svargaśca mānadaḥ ।।49।।
pṛṣṭayā me hitaṃ vācyaṃ tathyaṃ satyaṃ priyaṃ tava ।
pativratānāṃ sarvāsāmeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ।।1.577.50।।
na saṃśaye niyoktavyaḥ sukhastho hi patiḥ striyā ।
etanniścitya me pīḍāṃ na praṣṭuṃ tvamihā'rhasi ।।51 ।।
patiḥ prāha śṛṇu bhadre śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham ।
avaśyameva vaktavyaṃ pṛṣṭayā patinā striyā ।।52।।
api guptānyaguptāni gopayanti na satstriyaḥ ।
gopāyanti tu yā guptaṃ bhartragre sā na vai satī ।।53।।
patnī prāha priyaṃ vākyaṃ sārthaṃ dharmānvitaṃ nṛpam ।
devo rājā gurū rājā somo rājeti paṭhyate ।।54।।
rājāgre nā'nṛtaṃ vācyaṃ gacchāvaḥ saukaraṃ sthalam ।
tīrthe tatra kathayiṣye kṛpāṃ viśeṣataḥ kuru ।।55।।
bāḍhamāha tato rājā''jñāpayāmāsa mantriṇaḥ ।
tīrthaṃ saukaravaṃ gantuṃ badaryāśramanimnagam ।।56।।
hastyaśvarathalakṣāṇi gāvo dogdhryo'yutāni ca ।
dhanadhānyāni ratnāni bhūṣāmbarāṇi vai tathā ।।।।57।।
dānārthaṃ saha nītvā ca prajayā vṛddhayā yutaḥ ।
yayau gaṃgātmakaṃ tīrthaṃ nyuvāsa māsaṣaṭakkam ।।58।।
atha tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā dadau dānāni sarvaśaḥ ।
upoṣya tau trirātraṃ ca dampatī niyamānvitau ।।59।।
praṇamya bhūṣitau viṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim ।
sthitau cāgre harestatra patiṃ prāha satī priyā ।।1.577.60।।
ehyehi nātha gacchāvaḥ paśya gopyaṃ manīṣitam ।
sṛgālī pūrvamevā'haṃ tiryagyonivyavasthitā ।।61।।
viddhā'tra somadattena bāṇena mastake purā ।
yasya doṣeṇa me'pyeṣa rujā śirasi saṃsthitā ।।62।।
kāñcīrājakule janma pitrā dattā tava priyā ।
kṣetraprabhāvānme saiṣā jātā siddhirnamo'stu te ।।63।।
śrutvā rājā'pi sasmāra pūrvajātamudantakam ।
ahaṃ gṛdhro mahābhāge vaṭe'tra vanacāriṇā ।।64।।
somadattena viddhaśca mṛto'tra tīrthapuṇyataḥ ।
jāto'smi ca kaliṃgānāṃ rājā tava patiḥ priye ।।65।।
akāmamaraṇenā'pi paśya kṣetrasya satphalam ।
te ca bhāgavataśreṣṭhāstathā nārāyaṇapriyāḥ ।।66।।।
paurajānapadāstatra hyāsan ye sahasaṃgatāḥ ।
sarve'pi vismayaṃ prāptāścakruste bhajanaṃ hareḥ ।।67।।
rājā rājñī śarīre sve vihāya divyamūrtikau ।
bhūtvā vimānamāruhya brahmalokaṃ caturbhujau ।।68।।
yayaturdevapūjyau tau nedurdundubhayo divi ।
prajāḥ sahagatāstāśca sarvasaṃgaṃ vihāya ca ।।69।।
tatraiva maraṇaṃ prāpurnārāyaṇaprasādataḥ ।
caturbhujāśca te sarve brahmalokaṃ yayurmudā ।।1.577.70।।
sarve śaṃkhagadāpadmamaṇidhrāḥ pārṣadā narāḥ ।
nāryaścaturbhujāyuktāḥ sarvabhogasamanvitāḥ ।।71।।
pārṣadāṇyo brahmaloke pramodante harergṛhe ।
evaṃ tīrthaprabhāveṇa muktiṃ te śāśvatīṃ gatāḥ ।।72।।
janmāntarakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ yatsvalpamapi vā bahu ।
tatkadācit phalatyeva yena tīrthāgamo bhavet ।।73।।
yadalpamapi jāyeta tanmahattvāya kalpate ।
ya etatpaṭhate subhru śṛṇuyācchrāvayecca vā ।।74।।
tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi pūjanaṃ me kṛtaṃ bhavet ।
śaṃbhuḥ satyai purā prāha lakṣmi te kathitaṃ mayā ।।75।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārāhatīrthamahimnā śṛgālyā gṛdhrasya ca maraṇottaraṃ rājagṛhe janma, vṛttāntaprakāśottaraṃ muktirmastakarogādikāraṇakathanaṃ cetinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 577 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 577 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 578
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 579 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ tvanyāṃ tīrthānāṃ pāpanāśinīm ।
śaṃkaroktāmṛkṣakādrau pārvatyai te vadāmyaham ।। 1 ।।
gāyamānasya me kṣetre mandire mama sannidhau ।
puṇyaṃ vādayamānasya nṛtyato jāgratastathā ।। 2 ।।
godāturannadātuśca jaladātuśca yatphalam ।
mārjayiturlepayiturgandhapuṣpapradāyituḥ ।। 3 ।।
dhūpadīpasunaivedyapradātuścāpi yatphalam ।
japayajñādikartuśca yatphalaṃ caihikaṃ tathā ।। 4 ।।
pāralaukikamevāpi jāyate tad vadāmi te ।
śṛṇu pūrvaṃ khañjarīṭaḥ pakṣī gaṃgātaṭe'bhavat ।। 5 ।।
kīṭān bahūn prabhuktvā sa hyajīrṇātiprapīḍitaḥ ।
gaṃgāyāṃ patitastatra jale mṛtyumupāgataḥ ।। 6 ।।
tena puṇyena vaiśyasya koṭyadhisvāmino gṛhe ।
dhanaratnamahāsmṛddhe'jāyata pravibhaktimān ।। 7 ।।
mānaṃ karoti satataṃ devāgre mandire mama ।
ekakīrtanajaṃ puṇyaṃ saptajanmāghanāśanam ।। 8 ।।
iti matvā karotyeṣo gāyanaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau ।
dvādaśābde gate varṣe pitarau prāha harṣataḥ ।। 9 ।।
matpriyaṃ yadi kartavyameko me dīyatāṃ varaḥ ।
na cāhaṃ vāraṇīyo vai pitrā mātrā kathaṃcana ।। 1.578.1 0।।
satyaṃ vrataṃ samāsthāya tīrthayātrā mayeṣyate ।
śrutvā taṃ pitarau tuṣṭāvūcaturvada cepsitam ।। 11 ।।
gāvastriṃśatsahasrāṇi sarvā vai śubhadohanāḥ ।
yadyatra rocate dānaṃ dehi tvamavicāritam ।। 12।।
lakṣakoṭyātmakaṃ dravyaṃ dāne pradīyatāṃ dhanam ।
dhanadhānyāni ratnāni dehi putra hyavāritaḥ ।। 1 3।।।
kanyā vai ramaṇīyāḥ su samudvaha vidhānataḥ ।
yajñairyaṣṭaṃ samicchā te yaja devaṃ janārdanam ।। 14।।
yāvadbhojanatṛptān vā sādhūnicchasi tarpitum ।
sarvaṃ nijecchayā putra kartumarhasi sāmpratam ।। 15।।
naya sārdhaṃ tvayā putra tīrthayātrākṛte'pi ca ।
śubhaṃ vai cintitaṃ putra tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇāśramam ।। 16 ।।
adya mātṛstanau dhanyau tvayā putreṇa sārthakau ।
āyānti ca punaryānti gatā gacchanti cāpare ।। 17।।
dṛśyate ca kṣaṇe naṣṭo punarbhavati naśyati ।
tasmādbhaktirharestīrthaṃ kartavyaṃ vai suputrakaiḥ ।। 18।।
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca ।
janmajanmani vartante kasya te kasya vā vayam ।। 1 9।।
tasmāt putra tvayā cādya śubhakāryeṇa tāritāḥ ।
pitaraḥ pitaraścāpi vayaṃ dhanyāḥ suputrataḥ ।।1.578.20।।
kintu vada viśeṣaṃ ced guptaṃ rahasyamasti cet ।
vairāgyaṃ vā gṛhaudāsīnatā te vartate kimu ।। 21 ।।
guptaṃ cennaiva goptavyaṃ pitarau prati putraka ।
iti śrutvā dvayorvākyaṃ natvā prāha śubhaṃ sutaḥ ।।22।।
tatrā'haṃ kathayiṣyāmi tīrthe śrīharisannidhau ।
bāḍhamityeva taṃ putraṃ dampatī procatustadā ।।23 ।।
gamane kṛtasaṃkalpā yayuḥ saukaravaṃ prati ।
yattu kiṃcidgṛhe cāsti kṛtaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prati ।। 24।।
vaiśākhadvādaśikāyāṃ tīrthakṣetramupāgatāḥ ।
snātāḥ santṛpya viṣṇuṃ vai dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ।।25।।
ṣaṇmāsā vigatāsteṣāṃ kṛṣṇalagnahṛdāṃ tataḥ ।
kaumude kārtike śukle hyekādaśyāṃ vratānvitāḥ ।।26 ।।
dvādaśyāṃ ca sutaḥ pṛṣṭhaḥ pitṛbhyāṃ smārakaṃ prati ।
putrastaccaraṇau spṛṣṭvā pitarau samabhāṣata ।।27।।
khañjarīṭo hyahamāsaṃ pakṣī cātra sthale purā ।
ajīrṇena mṛtastvatra tena puṇyena vāṃ sutaḥ ।। 28।।
jāto'smi bhaktimān jātismaraścā'tha namāmi vām ।
prakāśe gopanīyasya mamā''yuryāti pūrṇatām ।।29।।
gamiṣye bhagavaddhāma gāyamānasya me phalam ।
ityuktvā ca jalaṃ pītvā natvā ca pitṛpādayoḥ ।।1.578.3 0।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
ityevaṃ gāyamānaḥ sa bhūtvā divyavapurdharaḥ ।।3 1 ।।
caturbāhuḥ pārṣadaiśca vimāne sandhṛtaśca saḥ ।
mukto bhūtvā yayau dhāmā'kṣaraṃ prakṛtipāragam ।।32।।
tato mātā pitā cānye dṛṣṭvā''ścaryamanuttamam ।
te'pi bhaktiṃ parāṃ cakruścānye ye ca samāgatāḥ ।।33।।
svalpenaiva ca kālena mama muktimupāgatāḥ ।
sarve hi yoginastatra dhāmni cotpalagandhinaḥ ।।34।।
modante tu yathābhāvaṃ prasādāt kṣetrajānmama ।
evaṃ vai gāyamānasya muktirbhavati me'nadhe ।।35।।
śṛṇu tattvena me dehi limpamānasya yatphalam ।
