mṛttikāyuggomayena mama veśmopalepayet ।।36।।
nyastāni tatra yāvanti padāni tu vilimpatā ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni divi modate ।।37।।
sakāmaśced bhaved rājā divyavarṣasahasrakam ।
bhaktau vyavasthitaḥ paścānmama dhāmā'bhigacchati ।।38।।
samīpe vā yadi dūre gatvā nayati gomayam ।
yāvanti tatpadānyasya tāvadvarṣasahasrakam ।।39।।
gomayānāṃ ca netā sa svargaloke mahīyate ।
tataśca rājā bhavati padavarṣasahasrakam ।।1.578.40।।
mama bhaktiṃ sadā kṛtvā tvante maddhāma yāti hi ।
upalepane snāne vā salilaṃ yo dadāti saḥ ।।41 ।।
yāvanto bindavastatra pānīyasya bhavanti hi ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate ।।42।।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rājā bhūtvā tataḥ param ।
māṃ prasādya guṇairbhakto mama dhāmābhigacchati ।।43।।
sammārjanaṃ mandirasya karoti strī naro'pi vā ।
yāvantaḥ pāṃsavo bhūmeruḍḍīyante tu mārjitāḥ ।।44।।
tāvadvarṣaśatānyāśu svargaloke mahīyate ।
tāvadvarṣaśatānyatra rājā bhūtvā tataḥ param ।।45।।
mama bhaktyā mama dhāma prayāti matsvarūpavān ।
gāyanaṃ ye prakurvanti mama sevāparāyaṇāḥ ।।46।।
pratyakṣaraṃ tu varṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ divi modate ।
sarvasevāguṇayukto nityadā mama pūjakaḥ ।।47।।
tato bhūmau bhaved rājā vaiṣṇavo vaiṣṇavaiḥ saha ।
gāyanmama yaśo nityaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ।।48।।
matprasādādāyuṣo'nte mama dhāmā'bhigacchati ।
cāṇḍālo hyabhavat kaścid vane manmūrtisannidhau ।।49।।
gāyati sma sadā gītiṃ dūramāgatya caikadā ।
dhṛtaḥ sa rakṣasā tūrṇaṃ khādituṃ tu tadā hi saḥ ।।1.578.50 ।।
uvāca rākṣasaṃ gītyuttaraṃ māṃ khāda nirbharam ।
idānīṃ tu kṣaṇaṃ muñca vratapuṇyaṃ karomyaham ।।5 1।।
viṣṇorvai toṣaṇārthaṃ ca mayā gītiḥ pragīyate ।
jāgaraṃ caryate rātrau prātarbhukṣvā''gataṃ ca mām ।।52।।
asnātānāṃ gatiṃ yāsye yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ ।
brahmaghnānāṃ surāpānāṃ stenānāṃ piśitāśinām ।।53।।
vyavāyināṃ gatiṃ yāsye yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ rakṣasā mukto gītiṃ ca jāgaraṃ tathā ।।54।।
caṇḍālaḥ pracakārā'tha prātarharistu bhūsuraḥ ।
bhūtvā samāyayau prāha mā gaccha rākṣasaṃ prati ।।55।।
jivitārthāya satyasya tyajane dūṣaṇaṃ na vai ।
śrutvā taṃ śvapacaḥ prāha satyaṃ me niścitaṃ vratam ।।56 ।।
satyamūlaṃ jagatsarvaṃ hyātmā satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ।
nā'haṃ mithyā cariṣyāmi gaccha vipra namo'stu te ।।57।।।
evamuktvā śvapākastu gato yatra sa rākṣasaḥ ।
prāha śīghraṃ khāda māṃ ca mokṣo te me bhaved drutam ।।58।।
rakṣaḥ prāha prasanno'smi satyādhāraṃ ca pālitam ।
brahma satyadhṛtiḥ proktaṃ tvayā tadrakṣitaṃ yataḥ ।।।59।।
necchāmi bhakṣituṃ tvāṃ ca dehi me gītijaṃ phalam ।
yena mokṣaṃ pragacchāmi tvayā sākaṃ subhaktiman ।।1.578.60।।
caṇḍālena tadā dattaṃ rakṣase gītikāphalam ।
rakṣo dehaṃ parityajya yayau vaikuṇṭhamuttamam ।।61 ।।
caṇḍālo'pi harerbhakto yayau yānena dhāma ca ।
tatra caturbhujo bhūtvā siṣeve parameśvaram ।।62।।
evaṃ vai gītikāpuṇyaṃ svargamokṣādidāyakam ।
pāpaghnaṃ divyatāsampādakaṃ kīrtanameva me ।।63।।
vādyavādayituḥ puṇyaṃ vadāmi yaddhi jāyate ।
pratisvaraṃ śatavarṣaṃ svarge loke mahīyate ।।64।।
paścāt saṃjāyate rājā daśavarṣasahasrakam ।
tato yāti mama bhakto mama dhāma parātparam ।।65।।
nṛtyato matsannidhau ca lakṣmīsthānaṃ hi niścitam ।
narasyāpi yoṣito'pi yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmyaham ।।66।।
dhāmni me nartako mukto bhavatyeva caturbhujaḥ ।
nṛtyaṃ vai śāśvatānandaṃ dadāmyasmai hi dhāmani ।।67।।
jāgrato mama mūrteśca sannidhau divyamuttamam ।
sārvajñyaṃ cāparokṣyaṃ ca dadāmi ca yathā mama ।।68।।
godātre mama golokaṃ dadāmi muktimaṇḍalam ।
annadātre'mṛtaṃ svargaṃ dadāmyakṣatabhojanam ।।69।।
jaladātre'mṛtalokaṃ dadāmyakṣatatṛptidam ।
gandhapuṣpapradātre ca dadāmi divyavarṣma yat ।।1.578.70।।
śāśvataṃ cā'pūrakaṃ ca tattvānāṃ sukhalabdhaye ।
lakṣaiśvarībhiḥ ramate īśvaro bhogapūritaḥ ।।71 ।।
dhūpadasya ca saugandhyaṃ manmūrteriva jāyate ।
dīpadasya sadā divyaṃ cakṣurbhavati sūryavat ।।72।।
ante svargādikaṃ bhuktvā mukto maddhāma yāti ca ।
naivedyasya phalaṃ tasmai vaikuṇṭhaṃ pradadāmyaham ।।73।।
brahmarājyaṃ sadā bhuṃkte sadā naivedyado mama ।
japayajñādikartre ca sārvabhaumasthalaṃ mahat ।।74।।
pradadāmi pṛthivyāṃ vai tataḥ svargaṃ tataḥ param ।
vairājaṃ padamevāpi tato mokṣaṃ dadāmi ca ।।75।।
sakāmānāṃ kāmapūrān lokān yacchāmi sarvathā ।
akāmānāṃ mama dhāma prayacchāmi ca śāśvatam ।।76।।
narāṇāṃ yoṣitāṃ vāpi yatheṣṭaṃ pradadāmi vai ।
devatvaṃ vāpi devītvaṃ svargādau vitarāmyaham ।।77।।
īśatvaṃ ceśvarītvaṃ vā vairājādau dadāmi ca ।
muktānītvaṃ ca muktatvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ prakaromyaham ।।78।।
brāhmītvaṃ brahmatāṃ cāpi dadāmi tadabhīpsitam ।
kṛṣṇatvaṃ cāpi kṛṣṇātvaṃ dadāmi ca tadīpsitam ।।79।।
nārāyaṇītvaṃ ca yadvā nārāyaṇatvamityapi ।
avatāratvamevā'pyavatāriṇītvamityapi ।।1.578.80।।
yathābhakti yathādāsyaṃ yathāpuṇyaṃ dadāmyaham ।
parameśvaratā me'sti sā tu nānyasya kasyacit ।।8 1 ।।
so'haṃ cānādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'smi cākṣarāt ।
dhāmnaḥ pare mama dhāmni vartāmi puruṣottamaḥ ।।82।।
ityetat kathitaṃ lakṣmi! tava jijñāsitaṃ mayā ।
śaṃbhunā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ satyai tīrtheṣu tiṣṭhatā ।।83।।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktirmuktirbhavettathā ।
mama dāsyaṃ durlabhaṃ bhaktānāṃ dadāmi śāśvatam ।।84।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gāyamānasya khañjarīṭasya muktiḥ, vādayamānasya nṛtyato jāgrato godāturannadāturjaladātuḥ sammārjayiturlepayiturgandhapuṣpādidāturdhūpadīpasunaivedyadāturjapayajñādikartuśca phalaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭasaptatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।578।।


← adhyāyaḥ 578 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 579
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 580 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathayāmi ravitīrthasya yatphalam ।
pārvatyā prārthitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ samuvāca satīpuraḥ ।। 1 ।।
ekadā ṛṣayo yājñavalkyādyāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ ।
ādityeśaṃ samāyātā narmadākacchake purā ।। 2 ।।
praviśya ṛṣayaḥ sarve vane puṣpaphalākule ।
vanānte dadṛśuḥ śubhrāṃ striyaṃ raktāmbarānvitām ।। 3 ।।
raktamālyāṃ suśobhāḍhyāṃ raktacandanacarcitām ।
raktābharaṇasaṃvyāptāṃ śaśihastāṃ bhayapradām ।। 4 ।।
tasyāḥ samīpataḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca nirdayam ।
mahākāyaṃ pāśahastaṃ piṃgākṣaṃ dīrghajihvikam ।। 5 ।।
tīkṣṇadṛṃṣṭā'tikruddhaṃ ca vikarālasvarūpiṇam ।
ṛṣibhiśca vīkṣitau tau saṃpṛṣṭau pāpakarmiṇau ।। 6 ।।
kau bhavantau vikṛtau vai tīrthasthau pāparūpiṇau ।
tāvūcatustadā viprān jarā'haṃ kālaputrikā ।। 7 ।।
ahaṃ yamaḥ svayaṃ daṇḍapradātā pāpināṃ sadā ।
yūyaṃ dharmacarā viprā dharmaṃ carata nārmade ।। 8 ।।
kacche tīrthe sampraviśya sukhaṃ tiṣṭhata vaiṣṇavāḥ ।
na cāvāṃ tān pīḍayāvo ye tu nārmadasevakāḥ ।। 9 ।।
narmadānindakānatra hariṣyāmo yamālayam ।
te śrutvā vacanaṃ tatra kacche ca nārmade drutam ।। 1.579.1 0।।
bhṛguṇā'dhyasite cakrurvāsaṃ mokṣapradaṃ śubham ।
tāvattatra narāścānye pañca dṛṣṭā maharṣibhiḥ ।। 11 ।।
snānadevārcanairyuktāḥ puruṣāste mahābalāḥ ।
tairuktaṃ bhūsurebhyaḥ prasnātaṃ tīrtheṣu vai kṣiteḥ ।। 1 2।।
na tatpāpaṃ tu no naṣṭaṃ yannaṣṭaṃ tvatra cāplavāt ।
ekenā'smatsu ca gurordārāḥ pūrvaṃ pradūṣitāḥ ।। 13 ।।
dvitīyena suvarṇaṃ vai mitrasya saṃhṛtaṃ purā ।
tṛtīyena brahmahatyā kṛtā ghorā bhayaṃkarī ।। 14।।
caturthena kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ surāyā madyapānakam ।
pañcamena gavāṃ hatyā kṛtā te ca vayaṃ nvime ।। 15।।
narmadāyāṃ bhṛgukṣetre snātvā śuddhāśca nirmalāḥ ।
natvā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrībhārgavīpatim ।। 16।।
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ bhaktyā tyaktvā prāṇān divaṃgatāḥ ।
brāhmaṇaiste tadā dṛṣṭā ravitīrthe vimānagāḥ ।। 17।।
yamena kālaputryā ca na niruddhāśca te tadā ।
pratyuta vai namaskārāḥ kṛtā dvābhyāṃ hṛdā muhuḥ ।। 18।।
athā'nyatte pravakṣyāmi tvagastyeśvaratīrthakam ।
ānandeśvaratīrthaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ vartate tathā ।। 19।।
līneśvaraṃ tathā tīrthaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cāpi vartate ।
ekadā kālabāṣpākhyo dānavo duścaraṃ tapaḥ ।।1.579.20।।
ādau kṛtayuge revājale cacāra tasya tu ।
prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ sākṣād babhūva ca jagāda ha ।।21 ।।
varaṃ brūhi yatheṣṭaṃ te dadāmīti ca vai tataḥ ।
dānavaḥ sa parivavre dehi me'tra maheśvara! ।।22।।
hastaṃ śirasi yasyaiva dāsyāmi sa mṛtiṃ vrajet ।
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tvadiṣṭaṃ yattattathaiva bhaviṣyati ।।23।।
itiśrutvā vaco daityaḥ śaṃbhumevā'bhidudruve ।
hastaṃ te mūrdhni dāsyāmi na tatsatyaṃ vacastava ।। 24।।
rudraḥ palāyitastena keśavaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।
nivedya keśavaṃ śaṃbhustatra jale nyalīyata ।।25।।
bhaktaduḥkhavināśāyā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
strīrūpaṃ tatra dhṛtvaiva daityasammukhamāgataḥ ।।26।।
kumārīṃ yuvatīṃ ramyāṃ candrojjvalāṃ ca nirjane ।
dṛṣṭvā''rebhe parirabdhuṃ dānavo mohavihvalaḥ ।।27।।
uvāca bhava me patnī tadā pratyāha keśavaḥ ।
yadi māṃ manyase bhāryāṃ pratyayaśced bhavenmama ।।28।।
nṛtyaṃ kuru mayā sārdhaṃ jaye te syāṃ hi kāminī ।
tathāstviti dānavaḥ sa nṛtye samyagavartata ।।29।।
hastāvuddhṛtya śirasi mayūrakalayā tadā ।
nṛtyaṃ cakāra bhagavān dānavo'pi tathā'karot ।।1.579.30 ।।
śanairhastau sammilitau paspṛśatuḥ śiraḥ svakam ।
dānavaḥ sa nṛtyamohādbhasmībabhūva tatkṣaṇāt ।।3 1 ।।
śaṃkarastatparijñāya jalād bahirbabhūva ha ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ natvā sthiro'bhavat ।।32।।
tattīrthaṃ narmadāyāṃ vai līneśvaraṃ samucyate ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇeśaṃ ca tīrthaṃ tad vaiṣṇavaṃ param ।।33।।
kṛtvā yayau ca bhagavānadṛśyatāṃ haro'pi ca ।
snātvā tatra labhenmartyo bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathonnatim ।।34।।
dakṣiṇe narmadātīre tīrthaṃ gopālakeśvaram ।
kāmadhenustapastatra putrārthaṃ pracakāra ha ।।35।।
dhyāyamānā parābhaktyā devadevaṃ maheśvaram ।
tuṣṭastasyā jagannāthaḥ kapilāyā maheśvaraḥ ।।36।।
kapilādehamadhyādvai niḥsṛtaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam ।
tuṣṭo'smīti samuvāca varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam ।।37।।
surabhiḥ prāha putraṃ me dehi divyaguṇairyutam ।
tathā'stviti haraḥ prāha dharmaḥ putro babhūva ha ।।38।।
catuṣpād vṛṣabhātmā vai vṛṣo lokasya rakṣakaḥ ।
gopāleśaḥ śaṃkaro'yaṃ surabhyā samudīritaḥ ।।39।।
tattīrthe kārtike cāpi vaiśākhe pūrṇimātithau ।
vṛṣotsargaṃ kārayecca śaṃkarasya pratuṣṭaye ।।1.579.40 ।।
vṛṣabhe romasaṃkhyā tu sarvāṃgeṣu ca yāvatī ।
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate ।।41 ।।
tato yāyād brahmalokaṃ mahābhāgavato yadi ।
yadvā rājā bhaved bhūmau punarmokṣamavāpnuyāt ।।।42।।।
atha tīrthottamaṃ ramyaṃ parāśarābhidhaṃ tathā ।
yatra taptaṃ tapaścograṃ parāśareṇa vai purā ।।43।।
tasya tuṣṭā mahālakṣmīrvaraṃ dadau sutārthakam ।
parāśaraḥ sutaṃ lebhe nārāyaṇāṃśamuttamam ।।44।।
atha tīrthaṃ bhayaghnaṃ vai bhīmeśvaraṃ śubhaṃ tathā ।
tadvat tīrthaṃ nāradeśaṃ yatra yogopalabdhaye ।।45।।
nārado vai tapastepe śaṃbhuṃ nidhāya cāntare ।
śaṃbhuḥ sākṣād babhūvā'smai yogasiddhiṃ dadau parām ।।46 ।।
hanūmadīśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ tato gacchet sukhāvaham ।
rāvaṇaṃ tvajayadrājā sahasrārjunasaṃjñakaḥ ।।47।।
kārtavīryaṃ vijigāya jāmadagnirmahāprabhuḥ ।
jāmadagniṃ jitavośca dāśarathirmahāprabhuḥ ।।48।।
dāśarathiṃ labdhatī sītā pūrvābhipuṇyataḥ ।
sītāṃ nītavatastasya rāvaṇasya vadhaḥ kṛtaḥ ।।49।।
rāmeṇa tasya bhaktaśca hanūmān vānarottamaḥ ।
laṃkādāhottaraṃ hatyādoṣaśāntyarthameva saḥ ।।1.579.50।।
narmadāyāṃ bhṛgukṣetre samāgatya sthiro'bhavat ।
hanūmadīśvaraṃ nāma tīrthaṃ tatparamaṃ smṛtam ।।51 ।।
camatkāraṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi! purā tatrā'bhavatparam ।
suparṇo nāma rājarṣirbabhūva vasudhātale ।।52।।
śatabāhurbabhūvā'sya kumāro vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ।
vicaran sa yayau vindhyācalaṃ yadṛcchayā kvacit ।।53।।
vane dṛṣṭvā kumāro'yaṃ piṃgalaṃ caikalaṃ dvijam ।
papraccha tvaṃ kathaṃ cāste bhramase'tra sapustakaḥ ।।54।।
vipraḥ prāha samāyātaḥ kānyakubjādito vane ।
preṣito rājaputryā ca śreṣṭhavarā'bhikāṃkṣayā ।।55।।
rājā nāmnā śikhaṇḍī yastvaputraścākarottapaḥ ।
kanyāṃ sa prāptavān tasyā vivāhaṃ sa samīhate ।।56।।
kanyā sā pitaraṃ prāha narmadāyāstaṭe purā ।
mayūrī cā'bhavaṃ tatra mayūreṇa samanvitā ।।57।।
tatrāgataḥ kadācittu vyādhastena śarairmuhuḥ ।
hatā nipātitā sārdhaṃ svāminā'haṃ mṛtā tadā ।।58।।
pracchidya mastakaṃ me sa dehaṃ vahnau prapacya ca ।
bhakṣayāmāsa cārdhaṃ tu cārdhaṃ cikṣepa vai jale ।।59।।
narmadāyāstena puṇyabalenā'haṃ tava gṛhe ।
jātā'smi rājaputrīti saśikhā dehasundarī ।।1.579.60।।
jātismarā smarāmyetatsthalaṃ puṇyapradaṃ pitaḥ ।
tatra preṣaya vipraṃ ca hanūmadīśvare sthale ।।61।।
piśaṃgapatratriśākhavaṭasyā'dhaḥ piśaṃginī ।
śilā vai vartate tatra patrāṇyasthīni me tadā ।।62।।
kṣiptāni santi pāṣāṇakūṭe jīrṇāni santi ca ।
narmadāyā jale tāni nikṣiptavyāni sarvathā ।।63।।
tena muktirbhavenme vai nārāyaṇaṃ patiṃ prati ।
ityājñayā nṛpateśca mārgaṇāya dvijo'pyaham ।।64।।
samāyāto'smi likhitaṃ vācayāmi sthalaṃ hi tat ।
ityuktvā tatsthalaṃ labdhvā prāpyā'sthīni yathātatham ।।65।।
nicikṣepa jale viprastāvat kanyā mṛtā'bhavat ।
śatabāhustu tatraiva smṛtvā nijāṃ mayūratām ।।66।।
śuśoca tatra vai tīrthe mṛtaḥ so'pi ca tatkṣaṇam ।
divyaṃ yānaṃ samāyātaṃ sthitastatra tataḥ sa ca ।।67।।
yayau mṛtā ca sā yatra rājaputrī ca tatsthalam ।
sāpi divyasvarūpā ca devī bhūtvā vimānakam ।।68।।
samāruroha ca tadā yānaṃ yayau ca narmadām ।
tāvad vipraḥ prasasmāra vyādhaṃ svaṃ pūrvajanmani ।।69।।
jalaṃ pītvā narmadāyā mamāra tatra tīrthake ।
divyadehasvarūpaḥ san samāruroha yānakam ।।1.579.70।।
yayuste ca trayaḥ svargaṃ natvā śrīhanumantakam ।
narmadāyāḥ pratāpo'yaṃ hanūmattīrthake'bhavat ।।71 ।।
svargamokṣaprado lakṣmi! pāpatāpapraṇāśanaḥ ।
mayūrī ca mayūraśca vyādhaśceti trayaḥ khalu ।।72।।
revājalaṃ prapītvā ca yayurmuktiṃ tataḥ param ।
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ lakṣmi! puṇyākhyānaṃ haroditam ।।73।।
pārvatyā śrūyamāṇaṃ tat paṭhanācchravaṇādapi ।
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ saṃsārabhramavārakam ।।74।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ādityeśatīrthaṃ līneśvaratīrthaṃ gopāleśvaratīrthaṃ parāśaratīrthaṃ hanumadīśvaratīrthaṃ cetyādisopākhyānatīrthanirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 579 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 579 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 580
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 581 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
bhṛgukṣetre somatīrthaṃ yatrā''ścaryamabhūt purā ।
śambaro nāma rājā'bhūttasya putrastrilocanaḥ ।। 1 ।।
trilocanasutaḥ kaṇṭhaḥ pāpaniṣṭho babhūva ha ।
vane vibhramatastasya mṛgayūthamadṛśyata ।। 2 ।।
śaraistān hatavāँsteṣu dvijo mṛgasvarūpadhṛk ।
hatastena ca pāpena brahmahatyātmakena saḥ ।। 3 ।।
kaṇṭhaḥ kṣitiṃ bhramanprāpto narmadānāgasaṃgamam ।
snāto revājale vāri papau cātha mṛgādanaḥ ।। 4 ।।
vṛkṣacchāyāṃ samāśritya suptastataḥ kṣaṇāntare ।
tatra someśvaraṃ bāṇaṃ samānarca jalādibhiḥ ।। 5 ।।
tāvat kaścid brāhmaṇo vai samāyāti ca mārgagaḥ ।
raktavastradharā nārī mārge tamāha bho dvija ।। 6 ।।
mama bhartā somatīrthe tiṣṭhatyenaṃ ruṣā vada ।
tava patnī tvadarthaṃ sā vaṭasthā tvāṃ samīkṣate ।। 7 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa brāhmaṇastu kaṇṭhamāgatya cāha tat ।
mayā vaṭe sthitā dṛṣṭā pāśahastā bhayaṃkarā ।। 8 ।।
tava bhāryā tvāha māṃ tvaṃ bhartāraṃ preṣayā'tra me ।
saṃgamādardhakrośe sā dūre tiṣṭhati bhāminī ।। 9 ।।
kaṇṭhaḥ svaṃ preṣayāmāsa bhṛtyaṃ yatra sthitā hi sā ।
gatvā bhṛtyaḥ papracchaināṃ kā'si kathaṃ ca tiṣṭhasi ।। 1.580.1 0।।
stryuvāca taṃ kaṇṭhabhṛtyaṃ brahmahatyā mṛgodbhavā ।
mṛgaghnaṃ sampratīkṣe'tra tadarthaṃ codbhavo mama ।। 11 ।।
gururātmavatāṃ śāstā rājā śāstā durātmanām ।
iha pracchannapāpānāṃ śāstā vaivasvato yamaḥ ।। 12।।
narmadānāgasaṃge'tra taṭe krośārdhamātrake ।
na saṃviśed brahmahatyā tena tiṣṭhāmi cātra vai ।। 1 3।।
gaccha tvaṃ preṣayeḥ śīghraṃ mayā muktaṃ patiṃ mama ।
bhṛtya āgatya rājānaṃ kaṇṭhamāha tathaiva ca ।। 14।।
rājā śokaṃ jagāmā''śu papāta dharaṇitale ।
uvāca prāṇasantyāgaṃ karomyatra tu saṃgame ।। 15।।
śīghramānīyatāṃ vahnirindhanāni bahūnyapi ।
ānītaṃ yatkṣaṇāt sarvaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ rājā tu saṃgame ।। 16 ।।
snātvā vahniṃ prasaṃjvālya natvā śrīsomanāthakam ।
triḥpradakṣiṇakaṃ kṛtvā hṛdi kṛtvā janārdanam ।। 17।।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā ।
japan viveśa viṣṇuṃ śrīpatiṃ dhyāyan caturbhujam ।। 18।।
smarannārāyaṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sugatiṃ me kuru tviti ।
tāvad vimānaṃ divyaṃ vai viṣṇupārṣadasevitam ।। 1 9।।
āgataṃ taṃ camatkāraṃ dṛṣṭvā bhṛtyā api dhruvam ।
kṛtvā ca niścayaṃ mokṣe viviśuste hutāśanam ।।1.580.20।।
vimānasthā divyarūpā bhūtvā te pārṣadottamāḥ ।
yayurdivyaṃ hareḥ sthānaṃ lakṣmīmāṇikyaśobhitam ।।21।।
prabhāpārvatīsaṃjuṣṭaṃ haṃsāmaṃjulikāśritam ।
campādayāramāhaimīmuktādevīsamarcitam ।।22।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tāstu sevante brahmadhāmagāḥ ।
somatīrthaprasaṃge deyāni dānāni bhāvataḥ ।
pitarastasya tṛpyanti vaṃśo muktiṃ prayāti ca ।।23।।
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ gurudāraniṣevaṇam ।
bhrūṇahā 'śuddhyati tatra hyevameva na saṃśayaḥ ।।24।।
ṛṇamocanasaṃjñaṃ ca tīrthaṃ gacchettataḥ param ।
divyaiḥ paitryairmānuṣaiśca ṛṇairātmakṛtairiha ।।25।।
mucyate tatsthale snātvā svarge devaḥ pramodate ।
athottare taṭe vārau vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam ।।26।।
jalaśāyīti vai nāmnā viṣṇurāsa purā'tra vai ।
nalameghaḥ purā daityo babhūva surakaṣṭadaḥ ।।27।।
devā jagmurhariṃ prāhurdaityanāśāya mādhavam ।
bhagavān garuḍārūḍhaścakraṃ nītvā samāyayau ।।28।।
nalameghasakhā dhundhumāro yuddhāya nirgataḥ ।
himālayasya vai droṇyāṃ viṣṇunā ghātitaśca saḥ ।।29।।
athāyayau mahāruṣṭo nalamegho hariṃ pratiṃ ।
yuyudhe bahudhā tatra viṣṇunā so'pi ghātitaḥ ।।1.580.3 0।।
sudarśanena cakreṇa dṛṣṭastatra tadālayaḥ ।
mahāguhāntare kanyā divyā daityeṇa rakṣitāḥ ।।3 1 ।।
mānuṣyaścātha devyaśca gāndharvyaḥ śailya ityapi ।
caturdaśasahasrāṇi hatvā hatvā janān bahūn ।।32।।
tā dṛṣṭā viṣṇunā tatra daityasya kāminī tathā ।
nāmnā sā maṃgalādevī rurodāti muhurbhṛśam ।।33।।
śrutvā daityavadhaṃ bhaktā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ patim ।
vavre ca vavrire kanyāḥ sarvāḥ śrīmāṇikīpatim ।।34।।
akṣarādhipatiṃ satāṃ patiṃ tā garuḍasthitāḥ ।
samānītā narmadāyāṃ snāpitā viṣṇunā tataḥ ।।35।।
tīrthaṃ kṛtvā jalaśāyisvarūpaṃ bhagavān svayam ।
narmadāyāṃ svīcakāra tāḥ sarvāḥ śayane kṣaṇam ।।36।।
atha kuṃkumavāpyāṃ sa bhagavān garuḍasthitaḥ ।
sarvābhiḥ saha patnībhiḥ samāyayau nijasthalam ।।37।।
lomaśena ca tāḥ sarvā upanītavatīkṛtāḥ ।
nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti tā viṣṇoḥ pārśve dhāmni kṣitāvapi ।।38।।
aśvapaṭṭasarastīrthe prāsādeṣu haripriyāḥ ।
muktāḥ syuste ca śṛṇvanti ya imāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ kathām ।।39।।
te dhanyā mānuṣe loke puṇyāḥ puṇyatamāḥ khalu ।
yeṣāṃ bhavati saṃyogaḥ sākṣāt kṛṣṇasya bhūtale ।।1.580.40 ।।
divyāste vai prajāyante narā nāryaḥ sthiraṃ caram ।
brahmāśraye jale divye snātvā divyā bhavanti te ।।41।।
atha tīrthaṃ paraṃ candrādityākhyaṃ pāvanaṃ caret ।
caṇḍamuṇḍau purā tvāstāṃ dānavau narmadātaṭe ।।42।।
sutapaśceratustatra dhyāyato bhāskaraṃ ca tau ।
sūryaḥ pratoṣitaḥ prāha vṛṇutaṃ sadvaraṃ tadā ।।43।।
ajeyau sarvadevānāṃ varaṃ vṛṇvaḥ pradehi tat ।
tathāstviti raviḥ prāha tābhyāṃ saṃsthāpito raviḥ ।।44।।
candraḥ saṃsthāpitaścāpi candrādityaṃ tattīrthakam ।
vyāsatīrthaṃ tato gacched vyāsamūrtiṃ prapūjayet ।।45।।
siddhaśaṃbhuṃ pūjayecca dvīpeśvaraṃ samarcayet ।
mārkaṇḍeyeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ saṃkarṣaṇeśvaraṃ tathā ।।46।।
śrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā sārdhaṃ balenāpi virājate ।
eraṇḍīnāmakaṃ tīrthaṃ tato gacchettu pāvanam ।
atreḥ patnī cānasūyā hyaputrā tvāsa bhāminī ।।47।।
tapastepe yatra revātaṭe eraṇḍisaṃgame ।
gate varṣaśate tasyā viṣṇurudrapitāmahāḥ ।।48।।
dadurāgatya ca varaṃ nijatulyasutārthakam ।
putrāstasyā atritulyā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ।।49।।
babhūvuste candradattadurvāsaśca vai trayaḥ ।
tattīrthaṃ pāpatāpānāṃ śāmakaṃ putramokṣadam ।।1.580.50।।
dhūmapātaṃ tato gacchet tataḥ sāgarasaṃgamam ।
arghaṃ dadāti revāyai nityadā saritāṃ patiḥ ।।51 ।।
narmadā vadati tatra madīye saṃgame janāḥ ।
snātvā pitṝn tarpayiṣyantyeṣāṃ saptakulānyaham ।।52।।
tārayiṣyāmi bhaktāँśca mokṣayiṣyāmi saṃkaṭāt ।
ahaṃ vai narmahāsyādi dadāmi śārṅgiṇe muhuḥ ।।53।।
ramayāmi hariṃ nityaṃ mamotsaṃge tadātmikā ।
nṛ-narāṇāṃ ma-mokṣa ca da-dadāmīti narmadā ।।54।।
evaṃ sā narmadā devī mokṣadā vartate parā ।
narmadāyāstava sakhyā lakṣmi māhātmyamuttamam ।।55।।
ṛkṣādrāvuditaṃ satyai śaṃbhunā tanmayoditam ।
bhaktyā śrutvā janaḥ sarvo mama dhāma prayāti ca ।।56।।
satī śrutvā śaṃkarātsā vimānavaramāsthitā ।
koṭiguṇaiḥ sevitā ca śaṃkareṇa samanvitā ।।57।।
śastāni ca tīrthāni kartuṃ yayau mudānvitā ।
āsamudraṃ gatā śailī pupūja tīrthadevatāḥ । ।58 ।।
koṭiratnādidānāni dadau paścāt svayaṃ satī ।
bhārgavīṃ ca bhṛgukacche militvā vyomamārgataḥ ।।59।।
kailāsaṃ prayayau sādhvī śaṃkarānumatā priyā ।
tīrthajalāni pradadau kailāsavāsino'pi ca ।।1.580.6 0 ।।
evaṃ yātrā kṛtā caiṣā śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā ।
lokānāṃ pāvanārthaṃ vai svayaṃ brahmātmako yataḥ ।।6 1 ।।
mahābhāgavato bhaktaḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ śaṃ-pradātā sa kailāse haimaparvate ।।62।।
vartate mama pūrve sa yatra tapaḥ karomyaham ।
badarīvṛkṣamāśritya bahuvarṣavyatikramāt ।।63।।
ekaikena phalenaiva badaryāṃ nirvahāmyaham ।
tatrā'haṃ daśa koṭyaśca daśavarṣaṃ daśārbudam ।।64।।
daśa bhūmestathā'nyāni padmāni tapasi sthitaḥ ।
daivā māṃ naiva paśyanti kathaṃ ca manujāḥ khalu ।।65।।
ahaṃ paśyāmi tānsarvān tapaḥsthitaḥ samāgatān ।
toṣayantastataḥ stotrairmadicchayaiva te ca mām ।।66।।
puraḥsthitaṃ prapaśyanti yāvatkāryaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam ।
śrībadaryāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ yatra bhaktaḥ sthitaḥ smaret ।।67।।
sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma rādhālakṣmyādisevitam ।
mama yogarato bhakto me muktiphalabhāg bhavet ।।68।।
yo'vagacchati tīrtheṣu māṃ prabhuṃ sa ca mucyate ।
lakṣmīḥ prāha vacaḥ śrutvā nārāyaṇasya vai tadā ।।69।।
dāsyāṃ me praṇayaṃ kṛtvā vijñāpyaṃ śṛṇu keśava ।
mṛdunā susvabhāvena vakṣyāmi tvāṃ janārdana ।।1.580.70 ।।
alpaprāṇabalā nāryo bhogakṣetrāṇi yoṣitaḥ ।
mālinyena sadā yuktā dharmācāravivarjitāḥ ।।71 ।।
parādhīnā patyadhīnā apatyavaśavartikāḥ ।
malamūtrakṣālanādāvaśuddhāḥ sarvadā striyaḥ ।।72।।
aśuddhau tava pūjādi kathaṃ syāttacca me vada ।
rājasvalye tava pūjā kathaṃ syāttacca me vada ।।73।।
nārāyaṇastadā prāha sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā'naghe ।
bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ saukhyapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ tathā ।।74।।
bālakṣālanasaktānāṃ saktānāṃ vastrakṣālane ।
patisevāparāṇāṃ ca sthitānāmṛtudharmake ।।75।।
gṛhā'śuddhyādisaṃskāraśodhanādikakarmasu ।
prasaktānāṃ na vai nityaṃ śuddhiryasmād vilokyate ।।76।।
tāsāṃ vai mama bhaktānāṃ yoṣitāṃ tu kṛte mayā ।
manomūrtirmayā coktā mānase nivasāmyaham ।।77।।
striyaḥ svabhāvataḥ śuddhā nirmitā brahmaṇā purā ।
kṣetraṃ vai sarvathā śuddhaṃ tena bhettavyameva na ।।78।।
śuddhatve'pi nimitteṣvaśuddhakāryeṣu satsvapi ।
kṛteṣu snānamātreṇa striyaḥ śuddhā bhavanti vai ।।79।।
yadvā sucitramūrterme darśanaṃ dūrataḥ sadā ।
yāvadrajasvalādharmastāvaddinacatuṣṭayam ।।1.580.80 ।।
kartavyameva nānyattu cānyaccenmānasaṃ caret ।
tenā'haṃ saṃpratuṣṭo'smi nāryuddhāraparāyaṇaḥ ।।81 ।।
dahakāryaṃ sadā śuddhāvaśuddhāvapi sundari! ।
cittaṃ nyasya mayi kuryānmama bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ।।82।।
na sā lipyati doṣeṇa mamā'nugrahakāraṇāt ।
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tathā'nyaccaśuddho'haṃ sarvadā prabhuḥ ।। 83।।
na cā'śuddhirlaukikī māṃ spṛśatīha kadācana ।
madyogāddivyatāṃ yānti sarvāścāpi hyaśuddhayaḥ ।।84।।
kintvācāraprarakṣārthaṃ śuddhyādikaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ।
puruṣā vā striyo vāpi na pumāṃso na vā striyaḥ ।।85।।
indriyāṇi nigṛhyaiva cittaṃ mayyanuveśya ca ।
mayi sannyāsayogena śuddhyantyeva na saṃśayaḥ ।।86 ।।
mama mūrtau sadā nyastaṃ cittaṃ yena vivekataḥ ।
yasyāṃ kasyāmavasthāyāṃ puṃsā ṣaṇḍhena vā striyā ।।87।।
sa ca śuddho bhavatyeva pūjādi svayamācaret ।
svātantryeṇā'caretpūjāmaraṇye nirjane'thavā ।।88।।
asahāye caretpūjāṃ gaṇayāmi na dūṣaṇam ।
mano buddhiśca cittaṃ ca ātmādhīnāḥ śarīriṇām ।।89।।
mayi saṃyujya satpremṇā na vai limpanti mānavāḥ ।
cittaṃ manaśca buddhiśca matsaṃsthaṃ ca samaṃ yadi ।।1.580.90।।
yatkiñcitkurvataḥ karma padmapatramivāṃ'bhasi ।
saṃyogānna ca lipyeta samatvādeva nānyathā ।।91।।
bhaktā divāniśaṃ cātra kurvantaḥ karmasaṃkaram ।
te'pi yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ yadi cittaṃ mayi sthitam । ।92।।
jāgrataḥ svapato vāpi śṛṇvataḥ paśyato'pi ca ।
yo māṃ citte cintayati maccittasya tu kiṃ bhayam । ।93 ।।
durvṛttamapi cāṇḍālaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vāpi tādṛśam ।
manmānasaṃ praśaṃsāmi nānyacittaṃ kadācana ।।94।।
yajantaḥ sarvadharmāṇaṃ māṃ ca jñānena saṃskṛtāḥ ।
mayi sanyastacittāśca mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।।95।।
ye matsevāṃ prakurvanti hṛdi māṃ rakṣayanti ye ।
te cet svapanti bhuñjanti ramante kāmayantyapi ।। 96।।
pravartante nivartante te sarve lakṣmi me priyāḥ ।
yataḥ praśāntacittāste - mayyeva kṛtaniścayāḥ ।। 97।।
cittanāśo hi lokasya saṃsārasya ca mokṣaṇam ।
tasmāccittaṃ mayi nyasya māṃ spṛśantu striyaḥ sadā ।।98।।
maccittaḥ satataṃ yo māṃ bhajeta premapūritaḥ ।
manṛpārśvaṃ prāpya paramaṃ madbhāvāyopapadyate ।।99।।
rājasvalye pañcame'hni ṛtudānena śuddhyati ।
śuddhyarthaṃ ca sutārthaṃ ca dātavyamṛtudānakam ।। 1.580.1 00 ।।
ṛtukālā'bhigamanaṃ brahmacaryaṃ mayā kṛtam ।
evaṃ sthite'pi gacchenna syānnaiṣphalyamṛtostadā ।। 10 1।।
viraktayoḥ kṛte nā'yaṃ niyamaḥ saṃgamārthakaḥ ।
sakāmayoḥ kṛte yogaḥ ṛtau gamaḥ praśasyate ।। 1 02।।
mahābhāgavato bhaktaḥ śuddhiṃ rakṣan yathoditām ।
mama sevāṃ prakurvīta dāsyabhāvena bhāmini ।। 1 03।।
dāsībhāvena bhaktā ca yā me sevāṃ karoti ca ।
narā nāryaśca te snigdhā nityaṃ te me hṛdi sthitāḥ ।। 1 04।।
ajñāte rajaso doṣe mama sparśādikaṃ bhavet ।
tadā snātvā ca māṃ snāpayitvā'pi pañcame dine ।। 1 05।।
yadvā cānyaḥ snāpayenmāṃ mālāśataṃ japenmama ।
rajasvalā kṣamāṃ tatra prārthayed bhagavan prabho ।। 106 ।।
ajānantyā kṛtaḥ sparśaḥ kṣamyatāṃ karuṇākara ।
ityuktvā śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ namet praśuddhyati ।। 1 07।।
evaṃ duṣyati no lakṣmi nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā ।
tataḥ kurvanti karmāṇi te yathāvanmama priyāḥ ।। 1 08।।
parvāṇyanudinaṃ bhadre mama cittānusāriṇaḥ ।
karmāṇi mama sevāsu kurvantu narayoṣitaḥ ।। 1 09।।
avaśyaṃ tānnayiṣye'haṃ mama lokaṃ parātparam ।
mātāpitṛsahasrāṇi putradāraśatāni ca ।। 1.580.11 0।।
cakravatparivartante yanmohānmāṃ na jānate ।
ajñānenāvṛto loko mohena ca vaśīkṛtaḥ ।। 111 ।।
saṃgaiśca bahubhirbaddhastena māṃ na ca vindati ।
gacchatyanyatra mātā vai pitā cānyatra gacchati ।। 1 12।।
putrāścānyatra gacchanti pramadā'nyatra gacchati ।
jāyate cātmanāṃ sthāne svasvakarmasamudbhave ।। 11 3।।
jñānamūḍhā janā lakṣmi saṃsāre santi mohitāḥ ।
alpakālaṃ paraṃ matvā baddhyante naśvare'pi ca ।। 1 14।।
bhaviṣyanti punaste tu na me mūrtyā sahā''sate ।
yasyaitadviditaṃ lakṣmi! brāhmaṃ jñānaṃ madātmakam ।।1 15।।
mayi nyasya svamātmānaṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ।
ya etacchruṇuyānnityaṃ kalyamutthāya mānavaḥ ।।1 16।।
puṣkalāṃ labhate siddhiṃ mama lokānuyāyinīm ।
lakṣmirūpāḥ sarvanāryo narā madvad bhavanti ca ।। 1 17।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne somatīrthe kaṇṭhasya brahmahatyānāśaḥ, jalaśāyitīrthe nalameghadānavanāśaścaturdaśasahasrakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnītvaṃ, candrādityatīrtham, āsamudrāntatīrthāni, śaṃkarasya kailāsagamanam, aśuddhanaranārīṇāṃ mokṣopāyakathanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā'śītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 580 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 580 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 581
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 582 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi mama mūrtirmanmayī cāhameva sā ।
etadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ mūrtiścā'haṃ pumuttamaḥ ।। 1 ।।
puruṣottamasaṃjño'haṃ vasāmi puruṣottame ।
kṣetre vai jagatāṃ nātho divyarūpadharaḥ pumān ।। 2 ।।
puruṣottamākhyaṃ divyaṃ kṣetraṃ paramapāvanam ।
yatrā'smi dāravatanuḥ śrīpatiḥ puruṣottamaḥ ।। 3 ।।
jyotiḥprakāśo bhagavān sākṣānnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
lokānāṃ cākṣuṣo bhūtvā divyo'pi dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।। 4 ।।
śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
kathaṃ dārupratimastvaṃ vartase tatra mādhava ।
śrotumicchāmi bhagavan lokānāṃ hitakāraṇāt ।। 5 ।।
kadā kasmāt kathaṃ tatra bhavānāste ca kīdṛśaḥ ।
kṛpayā'nugraheṇā'pi bhaktāṃ śrāvaya te kathām ।। 6 ।।
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahāpuṇyapradaṃ rahasyamuttamam ।
yasya saṃkathanāccāpi kṣīyate cāntaraṃ tamaḥ ।। 7 ।।
ahaṃ cāsmi jagannāthaḥ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ
tathāpyetanmama kṣetraṃ vapurbhūtaṃ ca me param ।। 8 ।।
svayaṃ vapuṣmāँstatrā'smi mannāmnā khyāpitaṃ mayā ।
daśayojanavistāra vālukārāmaṇīyakam ।। 9 ।।
nīlācalena mahatā parvatena virājitam ।
sṛṣṭvā carācaraṃ brahmā cintayāmāsa vai purā ।। 1.581.1 0।।
dehināṃ mokṣaṇārthaṃ vai viṣṇuṃ stoṣye pareśvaram ।
ahaṃ tu mama mokṣārthaṃ bhajiṣye puruṣottamam ।। 11 ।।
vicāryetthaṃ pratuṣṭāvā'nādiśrīkṛṣṇamacyutam ।
oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine namaḥ ।। 1 2।।
akṣareśāya muktānāmadhipāya namo namaḥ ।
rādhālakṣmīprabhāhaṃsāmāṇikīśāya te namaḥ ।। 1 3।।
pārvatīśāya saguṇāmaṃjuleśāya te namaḥ ।
śrīkṛṣṇastvaṃ parabrahma nārāyaṇastvameva ca ।। 14।।
bhūmā viṣṇurmahāviṣṇurvairājastvaṃ pravartase ।
antaryāmī prakāśaśca gocaro'gocarastathā ।। 15।।
tattvātmakaśca prakṛtivikṛtijñastvameva ca ।
kośasaṃsyaścāṇusūkṣmo mahīyānmahatāṃ bhavān ।। 16।।
dravyaṃ guṇaśca karma tvaṃ bhāvo'bhāvastvameva ca ।
māyā ca kāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tvamevā'si namo'stu te ।। 17।।
saṃsāre tvātmalubdhānāṃ sāramātmā tvameva ca ।
asāraścāpi te dṛṣṭyā sārarūpaḥ prajāyate ।। 18।।
so'haṃ rāgaṃ parityajya bhaviṣye tvāṃ pareśvaram ।
kimasārasvarūpāṇāṃ tuṣāṇāmavaghātanāt ।। 1 9।।
yatra cānte bhavecchūnyaṃ tannārabheta buddhimān ।
mayā sṛṣṭiḥ śūnyakāntā kartavyā naiva keśava ।।1.581.20।।
prasīdā'dya pramokṣaṃ ca pradehi mama cecchataḥ ।
evaṃ vai brahmaṇā cāhaṃ stutaḥ śrīgaruḍadhvajaḥ ।।21।।
caturbhujaḥ koṭisūryaprakāśaḥ śrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
āvirāsaṃ vivikṣustaṃ prahasya coktavāँstataḥ ।।22।।
kathaṃ brahman jātamātro vairāgyaṃ labdhavānasi ।
kuru cājñāṃ vaha sṛṣṭiṃ dhyānaṃ mama vidhehi ca ।।23।।
anādyavidyā sudṛḍhā duśchedyā karmabandhanaiḥ ।
tvayā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma parameṣṭhitvadāyakam ।।24।।
vinā bhogaṃ na naśyettannūtanānāṃ prasaṃjakam ।
tasmin sati kathaṃ sṛṣṭau hriyete mṛtijanmanī ।।25।।
tathāpi bhaktimārge te yadyasti mānasaṃ dṛḍham ।
yatra me mānasaṃ cāsti tatra te'stīti dhāraya ।।26।।
evaṃ matvā hyabhinnaṃ māṃ kuru sarvaṃ mayoditam ।
hṛdaye'haṃ tava brahman pratiṣṭhāmi ca sarvadā ।।27।।
nirdiśāmi mama karma tathā kuru hṛdoditam ।
sāgarasyottare tīre mahānadyāstu dakṣiṇe ।।28।।
sarvatīrthaphalade tvaṃ pradeśe yāhi vai kṣitau ।
tatra janmā'yutalabdhapuṇyapuñjāstu mānavāḥ ।।29।।
prapadyante nivāsaṃ vai nā'bhaktā nā'lpapuṇyakāḥ ।
ekāmrakānanād yāvad dakṣiṇodadhitīrabhūḥ ।।1.581.30।।
padātpadātparo divyaḥ pradeśo vartate mama ।
tatra matkaṇṭhasaṃsthaśca maṇirnīlamasaṃjñitaḥ ।।3 1।।
samuttārya mayā saṃsthāpitaḥ sa nīlaparvataḥ ।
brahmovāca tadā śrutvā kathaṃ nīlamaṇistadā ।।32।।
tvayā saṃsthāpitastatra vada me kāraṇaṃ prabho ।
hariḥ prāha śṛṇu brahman purā tu madhukaiṭabhau । ।33।।
brahmāṇḍanāśakau daityo mayā cakreṇa nāśitau ।
mama bhaktau mayā sārdhaṃ yuddhamugraṃ pracakratuḥ ।।34।।
gadayā tūgrayā māṃ ca tāḍayāmāsaturhṛdi ।
mayā dhṛto maṇiśreṣṭho hṛdayādapahāya saḥ ।।35।।
yāvadyuddhamabhūt tāvat tatpradeśe nidhāpitaḥ ।
tatra bhaktā mama cogrā pṛthvī bhītā sthitā'bhavat ।।36।।
kanyakā trāsamāpannā maṇyādhārā pratiṣṭhati ।
rakṣitā'nena maṇinā pratīkṣate mamāgamam ।।37।।
hatvā daityau tadā cāhamagamaṃ netumeva tam ।
tadā tu kanyayā pṛthvyā stuto'haṃ parameśvaraḥ ।।38।।
tvaṃ rakṣākārakaścā'si pātā dhātā'si me prabho ।
pṛthvīpatistvamevā'si prāṇado'si mama prabho ।।39।।
sadaiva rakṣa māṃ svāminnārāyaṇa hare prabho ।
pāpanāśaṃ ca me bhāraṃ nāśaya tvaṃ hare prabho ।।1.581.40।।
ityukto'hamavocaṃ tāṃ varaṃ brūhi dadāmi te ।
sā''ha nīlamaṇiṃ cātra sadā rakṣitumarhasi ।।41।।
yena muktirbhaved dehipāpanāśena cātra vai ।
mama rakṣā bhaveccāpi kṛṣṇābhūṣaṇadhāraṇāt ।।42 ।।
śrutvaivaṃ bhagavāँścāha tāmuktavāँstathāstviti ।
bhūṣārūpo maṇiścāyaṃ nīlo mayā samarpitaḥ ।।43।।
pṛthvyā dhṛtaḥ sa vai kaṇṭhe nityaṃ dhārayati dhruvam ।
kaṇṭhātmakaṃ paraṃ kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamātmakam ।।44।।
punaścāhaṃ yadā tasmātsthānājjigamiṣustadā ।
punaḥ sā prārthayāmāsa tvayā''gantavyamatra ca ।।45।।
stheyaṃ cātra maduddhārapareṇa prabhuṇā sadā ।
tathā'stviti mayā coktaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ gatavānaham ।।46।।
tatrājñā ca tadā prāptā mayā'kṣarapateḥ prabhoḥ ।
nīlaparvatabhūmau vai samicchāmi pumuttamaḥ ।।47।।
puruṣottamasaṃjño'haṃ vāsaṃ bhaktakṛpāvaśaḥ ।
evaṃ vai bhagavāँstatrā'nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।।।48।।
svayaṃ vasati sarvātmā puruṣottamabhūtale ।
sindhutīre rājate sa nīlādrirdyotayan diśaḥ ।।49। ।
pṛthivyāṃ gopitaṃ sthānaṃ tava cā'viditaṃ śubhe ।
surā'surāṇāṃ durjñeyaṃ māyayā chāditaṃ mama ।।1.581.50।।
sarvaiśvaryasamāyuktastatra tiṣṭhāmi dehavān ।
kṣarā'kṣarāvatikramya varte'haṃ puruṣottame ।।51 ।।
layena na samākrāntaṃ kṣetraṃ me puruṣottamam ।
yathā'haṃ cāsmi me dhāmni sarvāyudhadharaḥ pumān ।।52।।
pārameśvaracihnāḍhyastatra māṃ drakṣyase tathā ।
tatra nīlācalabhūmau kalpavaṭasya mūlake ।।53।।
rauhiṇākhyakuṇḍataṭe vasantaṃ drakṣyase tu mām ।
tatra yāhi prakāśaṃ māṃ dhyāyataste hi yāsyate । ।54।।
ityādiśya ca brahmāṇaṃ tataḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
paśyato brahmaṇastasya tatraivāntaradhīyata । ।55।।
brahmā cābhyāyayau tatra yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ ।
adrākṣīttaṃ tathārūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam ।।56।।
pratyabhijñānasaṃhṛṣṭo babhūva jñānasāgaraḥ ।
neme tuṣṭāva ca brahmā tadā śrīpuruṣottamam ।।57। ।
tāvattatra vāyasastu kaścid vyomnaḥ samāyayau ।
jalaṃ pātuṃ papātaiva kuṇḍe mamajja daivataḥ । ।58।।
kuṇḍāttu brahmaṇā tena bahirniṣkāsitaśca saḥ ।
pṛthvyāṃ luṇṭhan vilokyāpi nīlakāntiṃ pareśvaram । ।59।।
kākadehaṃ parityajya śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ।
divyadeho babhūvātra kṛṣṇapārśve vyavasthitaḥ ।।1.581.60।।
kākasya tu gatiṃ divyāṃ dṛṣṭvā yogīndradurlabhām ।
brahmā''ścaryaṃ jagāmā'tha cintayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam ।।6 1 ।।
aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ vinā'pi sādhanaṃ gataḥ ।
tāmaso'pi nikṛṣṭo'pi caturbhujatvamāptavān ।।62।।
manuṣyo'dhikṛto muktau khago'pi muktimāpa ha ।
na kiṃcid durlabhaṃ tatra yatra śrīpuruṣottamaḥ । ।63। ।
pātrāpātre na vai tatra yatra kṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ ।
purāṇapuruṣo yatra nāmnā saṃkīrtyate janaiḥ ।।64। ।
tacchrotāro'pi vai muktiṃ yānti draṣṭustu kā kathā ।
dhyātuḥ sevayituścāpi muktistatra karaṃgatā ।।65।।
sākṣātkṛto hi bhagavān datte bhaktāya muktikām ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñakasya mahimā cādbhuto'sti yat ।।66 ।।
yatra kāko'pi tu hariṃ sākṣātprāptaścaturbhujaḥ ।
kiṃ punaḥ satataṃ kṛṣṇadhyānayogaparāyaṇāḥ ।।67।।
tatra nīle divyaśaile puruṣottamakṣetrake ।
api kīṭapataṃgādyā muktiṃ prayānti sarvaśaḥ ।।68।।
tad dṛṣṭvā yamarājo vai tūrṇaṃ tatra samāgataḥ ।
brahmā dadarśa taṃ vaivasvataṃ dharmaṃ hatāśakam ।।69।।
niḥśvasantaṃ ca dīnaṃ ca svādhikāranirarthakam ।
yamarājā'pi nīlādrau śrīhariṃ praṇipatya ca ।।1.581.70।।
tuṣṭāva śrījagannāthaṃ svādhikāradṛḍhasthitau ।
namaste caikatattvāya dvaitāyā'nantakāya ca ।।7 1 ।।
svaprotasarvarūpāya dhṛtipuṣṭikarāya ca ।
sarvābhāsādhidevāya namaste sarvayonaye ।।72।।
viśvāsāya gurave sākṣiṇe te namonamaḥ ।
kāruṇyasindhave tubhyaṃ parātītāya te namaḥ ।।73।।
janmamṛtyuprahartre te namo'stu dīnabandhave ।
māyādhiṣṭhātrātmane te pītakauśeyavāsase ।।74।।
māyācakrakartanāya cakriṇe te namonamaḥ ।
daṇḍadātre'dhikartre te parameśāya vai namaḥ ।।75।।
nīlameghasuvapuṣe nīlādrivāsitāya ca ।
namaste puṇḍarīkākṣiśobhitāya gadābhṛte ।। 76।।
śrīvatsakaustubhaśobhābhāsatsamūḍhavakṣase ।
nīlavarṇaṃ nīlaśailaguhāvāsaṃ kṛpālayam ।।77।।
āśritānāṃ tu duḥkhaghnaṃ praṇamāmi parātparam ।
yatpādayorāśraye saṃllubdhā śrīranapāyinī ।।78।।
vartate śāśvatī lakṣmīrbhaktaiśvaryapradāyinī ।
yā prakṛtiḥ parādhīnā pareśa tava vāñcchayā ।।79।।
tvāmāvṛttya vikāsaṃ samprayāti bandhamuktaye ।
bhuktabhogāya cārpayati nirvāṇatāṃ tvadicchayā ।।1.581.80।।
tvameva tu parabrahma brahmarūpeṇa vartase ।
bhūmarūpeṇa ca vyūharūpeṇa vartase tathā ।।81 ।।
yamarūpeṇa ca rudrarūpeṇa vartase vibho ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇa viṣṇo kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ।।।82 ।।
kāmbhareyamahārāja kṛpālo te namo muhuḥ ।
prabhānārāyaṇa pārvatīśanārāyaṇa prabho ।
haṃsanārāyaṇa maṃjūnārāyaṇa namo'stu te ।।8 3।।
saguṇeśa tava patnīṃ duḥkhahartrīṃ namāmyaham ।
putracintāvārayitrīṃ dhārayitrīṃ namāmyaham ।।84।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau yamastāvattu padmajā ।
dharmastavapratuṣṭena nārāyaṇena deśitā ।
kṛpāmayī svayaṃ bhūtvā lakṣmīrdharmamuvāca ha ।।85।।
yamarāja yadarthaṃ tvaṃ saṃstauṣi tattu durlabham ।
kṣetraṃ caitacchrīharervai puruṣottamaśārṅgiṇaḥ ।।86 ।।
sarveṣāṃ mokṣadaṃ cāsti yāmyaṃ paśyanti naiva te ।
darśakāścāsya tīrthasya na yāsyanti yamālayam ।।87।।
atyājyaṃ ca tathā kṣetramāvayoḥ puruṣottamam ।
brahmādisarvapālānāṃ svāmitvaṃ nātra śasyate ।।88।।
neha karmaparipākā dehināṃ saṃbhavanti hi ।
atra vāsena kīṭānāmapi karma suduṣkṛtam ।।89।।
vilayaṃ yāti māhātmyātpuruṣottamapādayoḥ ।
karmapāśaprabaddhānāṃ bandhanaṃ nātra vidyate ।। 1.581.90 ।।
duṣkarmiṇāṃ daṇḍadātā tvaṃ yamo vihito'si yat ।
puruṣottamabhūvāsidehināṃ tvaṃ na śāsakaḥ ।। 91 ।।
atra śrīmān parabrahma kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svayam ।
svāmī me rājate sākṣānnīlādrikṛtaketanaḥ ।।92 ।।
dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ vai mucyante pāpino yataḥ ।
tava daṇḍo na vai teṣu tvanyatra tvaṃ prabhuryama ।।93 ।।
mā samiccha jagannāthāśritānāṃ śāsanaṃ yama ।
brahmā'pyayaṃ vāyasasya muktiṃ vīkṣya smayaṃ gataḥ ।। 94।।
garvaṃ jahau hi karmotthadehisaṃsārasaṃbhavam।
tvaṃ cāpi ca tathā garvaṃ parityajya praśādhi tān ।।95।।
puruṣottamatīrthātiriktasthān sarvadehinaḥ ।
atra sthitā na te'dhīnā mama svāmivaśā hi te ।।96।।
atra vasanta evaite jīvanmuktāścaturbhujāḥ ।
tasmātteṣāṃ tava hastagatatvaṃ naiva naiva tu ।।97।।
yāhi kuru manaḥsvāsthyamadhikāraṃ nirvartaya ।
etadvāsasvahastā'nāgatatvaṃ mā śuco yama ।।98।।
evaṃ lakṣmīsvarūpeṇa viṣṇunā bodhito yamaḥ ।
khidan lakṣmīṃ punarnatvā smṛtvā hariṃ jagāda tām ।।99।।
mātaryatra bhavecchrīmānanādiśrīnarāyaṇaḥ ।
tatkṣetrasya mahimānaṃ nā'śṛṇavaṃ purā hyaham ।। 1.581.10 0।।
abhāgyahatadevo'haṃ kathaṃ vedmi harerbalam ।
parameśvaravāñcchā vai niraṅkuśā pravartate ।। 101 ।।
anyatra bandhadā saiva yā'tra mokṣapradaiva sā ।
etatkṣetraṃ kiyaddīrghaṃ yajjīvā na mamaspṛśāḥ ।। 1 02।।
etatkṣetrasthiteḥ kīdṛk phalaṃ tadapi me vada ।
yenā'haṃ samanujñāya vicarāmi pṛthakpadam ।। 1 03।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrīpuruṣottamakṣetre nīlamaṇirūpanīlaparvatakathā, rauhiṇakuṇḍataṭe śrīpuruṣottamamūrtiḥ kākasya vedhasaḥ paśyato muktiḥ, yamarājasya tatrāgamanaṃ, lakṣmīkṛtanīlasthalīyajīvānāṃ yamadūtā'sparśanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 581 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 581 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 582
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 583 →

śrīlakṣmīruvāca-
yamarāja! śṛṇu tattvaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ hitakaraṃ tava ।
kṣetraṃ phalaṃ ca kathaye tathā'nyanmokṣadaṃ śubham ।।1 ।।
yathāhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapārśvagatā purā ।
āsaṃ tataśca pralaye tadvakṣaḥsthalamāsthitā ।। 2 ।।
dadṛśe ca jagatyasmin pralīne mama sarvathā ।
ahaṃ caitat sukṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamasaṃjñakam ।। 3 ।।
dvayaṃ tvāsīd divyarūpaṃ tadā mārkaṇḍako muniḥ ।
saptakalpāyurevātra nimagno pralayārṇave ।। 4 ।।
jalārṇave bhramamāṇaḥ puruṣottamakṣetrake ।
puruṣottamarūpe sa nīlādrestu samāśraye ।। 5 ।।
sāmudre sutaṭe kṣetre divyaṃ vaṭaṃ samaikṣata ।
tatrā'nādikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ dadarśa sūjjvalam ।। 6 ।।
hasantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca śoḍaśābdaṃ caturbhujam ।
yasya vakṣasi kṣetraṃ tat kṣetre taṃ cāpi miśritam ।। 7 ।।
vadantaṃ kiṃ jale snāsi mārkaṇḍeya sthiro bhava ।
ehi cātra vaṭacchāyāsthale pārśve mamā'ntikam ।। 8 ।।
tacchrutvā vismayaṃ lebhe dṛṣṭvā kṣetraṃ vaṭaṃ harim ।
vāribhiḥ klidyate naitad dahyate na ca vahninā ।। 9 ।।
saṃvartakādibhiścaitacchośuṣyate na cālyate ।
ekārṇave yathā nauśca kṣetraṃ tathā hi dṛśyate ।। 1.582.10 ।।
īkṣyate ca vaṭo divyo viśāla īśitustanuḥ ।
mahāpralayavātena patraṃ tvasya na kampate ।। 11 ।।
tatrā'yaṃ bhagavānāste nyagrodhe pralaye'pi ca ।
kathaṃ bhuvaḥ pradeśo'yaṃ pralaye'pi sthiro'sti vai ।। 12।।
cintayanniti munirāṭa kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prati ।
yayau māṃ tasya vakṣasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā svaṃ prajagāma ha ।। 1 3।।
'namo namaste puruṣottamāya lakṣmīdvitīyāya namo namaste ।
jalā'rṇave me'kṣisugocarāyanyagrodhavāsāya namo namaste ।। 14।।
divyādhivāsāya jagannivāsakṛte'travāsāya namo namaste ।
laye kṛpāleśasamanvitāya nimagnatārāya muhurnamo'stu ।। 15।।
paraṃ padaṃ cākṣaradhāma cāmṛtaṃ
vaikuṇṭhagolokahiraṇmayādikam ।
sarvaṃ bhavān yatra kṛtāśrayo bhuvi
divyaṃ na caitatpralayo'pi khādati ।। 16।।
sarvatragaṃ śrīpuruṣottamasthaṃ bṛhatsvarūpaṃ vaṭarūpasaṃsthitam ।
māyāparaṃ brahmaparaṃ layotthaṃ layasthitaṃ tvāṃ praṇamāmi viṣṇum ।। 17।।
ekārṇave jagatyatra keyaṃ bhūḥ pārameśvarī ।
yatra sākṣāt trāṇakartā rājase matkṛpākaraḥ ।। 18।।
trāhi viṣṇo jagannātha ghorātsaṃsārasāgarāt ।
na tvaṃ pṛthag yathākāle mārkaṇḍeyād vilokyase ।। 19।।
yathā lakṣmīstathā cāyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyastavānugaḥ ।
kathaṃ māṃ tyaktavānāste bhavān bhavārṇave laye ।। 1.582.20 ।।
māṃ gṛhāṇa prabho tvatra dehi vāsaṃ vaṭāśraye ।
tava sevāṃ kariṣye'tra śāśvatīṃ cā'napāyinīm' ।।2 1 ।।
ityukto bhagavānāha samāgaccha mune iha ।
tiṣṭha cātra vaṭe lakṣmyā sākaṃ sārdhaṃ mayā tathā ।। 22।।
prātaḥ sarvā mama sṛṣṭīḥ punaḥ pūrvāḥ pradrakṣyasi ।
mayā te darśitaṃ kṣetraṃ divyaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 23 ।।
kuru parṇapraśālāṃ saṃvasā'tra vaṭamaṇḍale ।
ahaṃ tava nimittena vasāmyatra yataḥ sthiraḥ ।।।24।।।
mārkaṇḍeyena muninā śrutvā''jñāṃ pārameśvarīm ।
kṛtā vaṭajaṭājūṭe parṇaśālā śubhā tadā ।।25।।
viveśa cāntastāvat sa dadarśāntarhariṃ sthitam ।
tanmūrtau sa pralīnaśca dadarśā'ṇḍāni koṭiśaḥ ।।26।।
atrāṇḍe dadṛśe vipro bhuvanāni caturdaśa ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādīn dikpālān lokarakṣakān ।।27।।
siddhagandharvadaityāṃśca rākṣasān suramānavān ।
nāgān pitṝँśca śailāँśca sāgarān saṃstarāँstathā ।।28।।
jagatāṃ dhāriṇaṃ śeṣaṃ sahasraphaṇaśobhitam ।
śeṣādhāraṃ kacchapaṃ ca jalaṃ tejo dadarśa ca ।। 29।।
vāyuṃ vyoma mahākāśottaraṃ sarvaṃ dadarśa ca ।
cidākāśe ca golokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa dadarśa ha ।।1.582.3 0।।
atha divyaprakāśaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma dadarśa saḥ ।
yatrāste śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇo lakṣmīpatiḥ svayam ।।3 1 ।।
tatra vaṭaṃ dadarśā'tha parṇaśālāṃ svanirmitām ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ tatra dadarśa saḥ ।।32।।
nijaṃ mṛkaṇḍatanayaṃ kṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam ।
divyā'bdhiṃ nīlaśailaṃ ca dadarśa munirāṭ param ।।33।।
tato drāgeva bhagavadvāñacchayā tu kṣaṇāntare ।
punarmayā'bhisaṃkocaṃ gamitaścāntare tadā ।।34।।
harau svaṃ parṇaśālāyāṃ hṛdi lakṣmīyutaṃ prabhum ।
śrīhariṃ pūrvavad vīkṣya paramaṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ ।।35।।
tuṣṭāva parayā bhaktyā śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ।
parameśa mameṣṭo'si kimāścaryaṃ pradarśitam ।।36।।
tvayā cātra sthale kasmād vada me śrīhare prabho ।
bhagavāँstaṃ tadā prāha puruṣottamabhūtalam ।।37।।
mama dhāmaiva bhūmo vai mayā saṃsthāpitaṃ sadā ।
divyaṃ dvitīyarūpaṃ tat savaṭaṃ puruṣottamam ।।38।।
mandiraṃ parṇaśāleyaṃ rājate sādhuvāsinī ।
tvaṃ me tvakṣaradhāmā'si mārkaṇḍeyo'paraḥ pumān ।।39।।
nityatvaṃ cāsya dhāmno me darśitaṃ te kṣitāvapi ।
puruṣottamasaṃjñaṃ vai kṣetraṃ dhāma mamā'sti tat ।।1.582.40 ।।
tasmāt kṣetramidaṃ ramyaṃ śāśvataṃ me vibhāvaya ।
na sṛṣṭipralayāvatra vidyete na ca saṃsṛtiḥ ।।41 ।।
nityaṃ pumuttamaṃ cātra māṃ jñātvā puruṣottamam ।
kṣetraṃ viśati śuddhātmā sa yāti mama dhāma vai ।।42।।।
nā'sya janma punarbhāvi sāndre sukhe gato yataḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ mṛkaṇḍatanayastatra vāsamarocayat ।।43 ।।
prahṛṣṭahṛdayaḥ prāha śraddhābhaktiprapūritaḥ ।
anugṛhṇīṣva bhagavan kṣetre'smin puruṣottame ।।44।।
yathā sthito mṛtyuvaśaṃ na vraje puruṣottama ।
tava dhāmni śāśvate te sukhe magno bhavāmi yat ।।45।।
yamarāja tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśca taṃ munim ।
provācā'haṃ tvayā sākaṃ lakṣmyā sākaṃ vasāmi ca ।।46।।
nivatsyāmi na sandeho lokakalyāṇahetave ।
yāvadābhūtanāśaṃ ca punaśca pralaye'pi ca ।।47।।
pralayānte punaḥ sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭyante'pi vasāmi ca ।
nivatsyāmi sadā cātra vasa tvaṃ parṇapattane ।।48।।
atra vai parṇanagarī prasiddhā sā bhaviṣyati ।
puruṣottamapuryākhyā jagannāthapurī tathā ।।49।।
kalpe kalpe nāmakhyātiṃ gamiṣyati nivatsyati ।
tvaṃ ca mṛtyuharo bhūtvā sthāsyasyatra na saṃśayaḥ ।।1.582.50 ।।
ityuktvā'ntardadhe kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jagatpatiḥ ।
mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmunistatrā''vāsamarocayat ।।51 ।।
vaṭavāyavyakoṇe ca gartamāsthāya pāvanam ।
taptena tapasā mṛtyuṃ jitavān cā'kṣaraḥ svayam ।।52।।
mārkaṇḍeyāśramastatra vartate pāvano yataḥ ।
pañcakrośamidaṃ kṣetraṃ samudrāntarvyavasthitam ।।53।।
abdhitīre dvikrośaṃ ca militvā krośasaptakam ।
nīlaparvataśobhāḍhyaṃ svarṇavālukasaṃstṛtam ।।54।।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇavāsāśritaṃ param ।
sarvatīrthaḥ samudro'pi tīrtharājatvamāptavān ।।55 ।।
tattīre bhagavān lakṣmīrvirājaṃte yameśvara ।
sā'haṃ ca kambharādevī brahmānandapariplutā ।।56।।
yā vai kuṃkumavāpyāṃ ca saurāṣṭre'pi virājate ।
gajānanā camatkāre kāśyāṃ sā kārṣṇavāllabhī ।।57।।
jayā sā tvakṣare dhāmni goloke rādhikā hi sā ।
vaikuṇṭhe sā ramā hiraṇyaye prabhā vinodinī ।।58।।
śvetākhye māṇikī lakṣmīḥ kailāse pārvatī ca sā ।
satye haṃsā maṃjulā mervadrau bhvāṃ saguṇā priyā ।।59।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyaḥ saha sthitāḥ ।
pūrvasmin śrījagannāthaḥ paścime dvārikādhipaḥ ।।1.582.6 0 ।।
uttare tu naranārāyaṇo dakṣe janārdanaḥ ।
svāmino me svarūpāṇi kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vai ।।61 ।।
jagannāthe tvahaṃ lakṣmīrdvārikeśe prabheśvarī ।
nārāyaṇe māṇikī ca janārdane tu pārvatī ।।62।।
sarveṣāmādikalpe'tra babhūvā'haṃ pativratā ।
kalpāntare tathā prāvirbhāvāntare'pi sā'pyaham ।।63।।
anekanāmarūpāḍhyā bhavāmi kṛṣṇavāñcchayā ।
svābhīṣṭaṃ mama dharmaḥ sa pātivratyaṃ tathā mama ।।64।।
bahūni mama nāmāni rūpāṇi ca vibhūtayaḥ ।
avatāriṇya evāpi bhaviṣyanti striyo hareḥ ।।65।।
lakṣārbudāni vai nāryo mama patyurbhavanti vai ।
apraskhalitavīryasyā'khaṇḍitabrahmacāriṇaḥ ।।66।।
avyayasattvayuktasya saṃkhyāvarjyāḥ striyo hareḥ ।
tasyā'prameyakāntasya kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।67।।
śaṃkhākāraṃ pūrvapaścaṃ paścime vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ।
pūrve śaṃkhamukhe nīlakaṇṭho devo virājate ।।68।।
śaṃkhasyodarabhāgastu - samudrodakasaṃplutaḥ ।
abdhikulīnamārabhya divyanyagrodhakā'vadhim ।।6 9।।
dṛśyate bhagavāँstatra bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ ।
yasyā'yaṃ bhagavān dṛṣṭipathaṃ yāti sa muktibhāg ।।1.582.70।।
maraṇānmama dhāmasthaḥ snānātsvargagatastathā ।
smaraṇātpātakairhīno jāyate mānavo'sya vai ।।71।।
nābhideśe tu śaṃkhasya sthitāḥ kuṇḍo vaṭo hariḥ ।
vimalā tu mahāśaktirvartate tatra muktidā ।।72।।
pralayasya bhakṣayitrī mahāpralayarodhinī ।
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamed yaḥ sa bhogānaśnāti śāśvatān ।।73।।
vaṭābdhimadhyamaṃ kṣetraṃ kīṭāderapi muktidam ।
antarvedī bhāgavataḥ kṣetraṃ madhyagataṃ hi sā ।।74।।
tasyāṃ sthitā bhavantyeva śaṃkhacakrābjadhāriṇaḥ ।
sārdhatrikoṭisaṃkhyānāṃ tīrthānāṃ puruṣottamaḥ ।।75।।
rājā vai muktido yasmāt tīrtharājo'yamucyate ।
rohiṇākhye divyakuṇḍe kāruṇyākhye jale janāḥ ।।76।।
ye snāsyanti narā nāryaste syurnārāyaṇā dhruvam ।
tasmād yameśa te cintā mā'stvetasya sthalasya vai ।।77।।
mokṣādhikāriṇāmatra neśvarastvaṃ paretarāṭ ।
evamādiśya dharmeśaṃ lakṣmīrbrahmāṇamāha ca ।।78।।
kāmākhyaḥ kṣetrapālo'tra sadā nārāyaṇājñayā ।
vartate tapasā yukto bhajate śrīnarāyaṇam ।।7 9।।
nṛsiṃho'yaṃ ca bhagavān dakṣiṇe vartate hareḥ ।
nṛhareḥ sannidhau prāṇatyāge mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ ।।1.582.8 0 ।।
darśanādapi nṛharerbhuktimuktī karaṃgate ।
dānaṃ japādikaṃ cātra koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ।।8 1 ।।
nṛsiṃhaśca vaṭaścaitāvubhau nārāyaṇau yataḥ ।
tacchāyā mokṣadā tasyāmavidyā nāśameti ca ।।82 ।।
vārāṇasyāmavimukte mumukṣoḥ karṇamūlake ।
śaṃbhurdiśati bodhasyopāyāṃ mantraṃ tataḥ param ।।83।।
samabhyasya kramānmokṣo jñāna tasya bhaved yadi ।
atra tu prāṇahānau tatkṣaṇaṃ eva tu mokṣaṇam ।।84 ।।
sārūpyaṃ labhate yo'pi ko'pi vijñānamantarā ।
snāyādabdhidṛśā kṛṣṇacchāyāyāṃ vaṭavṛkṣake ।।85।।
kṣetre dhūlyā'bdhivārbhiryastanmuktirmaraṇe'tra vā ।
antarvedīrakṣaṇārthaṃ śaktayo'ṣṭau mayā kṛtāḥ ।।86।।
maṃgalā vaṭamūle tu paścime vimalā'sti ca ।
śaṃkhasya pṛṣṭhabhāge tu saṃsthitā sarvamaṃgalā ।।87।।
uttare lambikā dakṣe kālarātriśca saṃsthitā ।
kālarātryā pṛṣṭhabhāge caṇḍarūpā vyavasthitā ।।88।।
pūrve marīcikā tvāste vaiṣṇavyo nāthadāsikāḥ ।
aṣṭānāṃ darśanātpāpadhvaṃso'śvamedhajaṃ phalam ।।89।।
atha bhaktaśca rudro'pi mahābhāgavataḥ prabhuḥ ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।1.582.90 ।।
mantraṃ japan bhavaँścā'trā'ṣṭadhopāste pumuttamam ।
ārādhya tapasā kṛṣṇaṃ prārthayad varamuttamam ।।9 1 ।।
yatra tvaṃ nātha tatrā'haṃ vaseyaṃ tvāṃ bhajan sadā ।
tvāmṛte kamalākānta nānyannirvāṇakāraṇam ।।92 ।।
antaryāmī prabhurme tvaṃ tvāṃ vinā vigrahaḥ kutaḥ ।
nirmalāmbarasaṃkāśaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ।।93 ।।
ityuktau bhagavān kṛṣṇo bhaktaṃ rudraṃ vinirmame ।
kṣetrapāleśvaraṃ tatrā'ṣṭadhā bhaktottamottamam ।।94।।
kapālamocaneśaṃ ca kṣetrapeśaṃ yameśvaram ।
mārkaṇḍeśaṃ tatheśānaṃ bilveśaṃ nīlakaṇṭhakam ।।95।।
vaṭeśaṃ ceti tānaṣṭau sthāpayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ।
etān dṛṣṭvā tathā spṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā vimucyate ।।96।।
atra kṣetre mṛtānāṃ taddhetoryamo na śāsakaḥ ।
tadarthaṃ tvāgataścettvaṃ tadanyatra prasādhaya ।।97।।
sudarśanaṃ hareścakraṃ māyāyāḥ kartanaṃ param ।
nātra māyā bhaved yena dehī tvaddhastago bhavet ।।98।।
ityukto yamarājastu bhagavantaṃ prapūjya ca ।
lakṣmīṃ natvā yayau yāmyālayaṃ tuṣṭo hariṃ bhajan । ।99।।
śrīruvāca tataścā'jaṃ parameṣṭhipadasthitam ।
indradyumno mahārājo yajñā''hartā suvaiṣṇavaḥ ।। 1.582.100 ।।
bhaviṣyatyacireṇaiva satyayuge sa bhaktagaṭ ।
atrā''gatya mahābhaktiṃ kariṣyati divāniśam ।। 101 ।।
bhagavatprītaye tvatra vājimedhasahasrakam ।
kariṣyati tathā brahmaँstava prītyarthamityapi ।। 10 2।।
tadā kṛpālurbhagavān tadanugrahakāraṇāt ।
ekadārusamutpannaścaturdhā saṃbhaviṣyati ।। 1 03।।
dāravīpratimā viśvakarmā praghaṭṭayiṣyati ।
pratiṣṭhāpayitā tvaṃ ca indradyumnaprasāditaḥ ।। 1 04।।
bhaviṣyasi tadā brahmannatra śrīpuruṣottame ।
asmādṛśyaḥ pratimāstā nāṇumātramapi prabho ।। 1 05।।
visadṛśya iti tāśca tvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyasi ।
gacchedānīṃ satyalokaṃ brahman kṣetraṃ pumuttamam ।। 1 06।।
punaścāyāhi ca mayā devenā'pi smṛto yadā ।
ityukto viśvasṛṭ satyaṃ yayau lokaṃ prapūjya tau ।। 1 07।।
nārāyaṇo'pi bhagavān lakṣmīṃ prāha dayānidhiḥ ।
evameva tvaduktaṃ vai sarvamatra bhaviṣyati ।। 1 08।।
carmacakṣuṣmatāṃ kāṣṭharūpaṃ bhāsiṣyate mama ।
divyacakṣuṣmatāṃ divyo bhāsiṣye ca tvayā saha ।। 1 09।।
nīlācalaguhā'ntaḥstho nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ ।
bibhrad dārumayaṃ varṣma śaṃkhacakragadādimān ।। 1.582.11 0।।
saṃkarṣaṇo mayā sākaṃ subhadrā tvaṃ mamā'ntike ।
sudarśanaṃ tathā cakraṃ nivatsyanti mayā saha ।। 111 ।।
bahavo hyavatārā me divyā jaḍāśca mānuṣāḥ ।
tiryañco jalajātāśca teṣāṃ divyāḥ kriyottamāḥ ।। 11 2।।
tadvadatra dārumayo me'vatāro mato mama ।
dyati saṃsāraduḥkhāni dadāti sukhamavyayam ।। 113 ।।
tasmād dārumayaścā'haṃ parabrahma vasāmi ca ।
nahi kāṣṭhamayī mokṣaṃ dadāti pratimā kvacit ।। 1 14।।
kṛtenā'kṛtatā lakṣmi! kadācinnopalabhyate ।
akṛto hyapavargaḥ sa kṛtādvā dārutaḥ katham ।। 1 15।।
adhiṣṭhānaṃ vinā brāhmyamaiśvaryaṃ na prakāśate ।
adhiṣṭhānaṃ pratimānaṃ mama nārāyaṇasya tat ।। 1 16।।
alaukikamapi kṛtvā laukikaṃ tatra vartaye ।
kutra śrutaṃ ca vā dṛṣṭaṃ pratimā vyāharediti ।। 1 17।।
indradyumnāya sa varaṃ dadau kāṣṭhavapurdharaḥ ।
dīnānāthaikaśaraṇaṃ taraṇaṃ bhavavāridheḥ ।। 118 ।।
mokṣaṇaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ nīlādriśaraṇaṃ harim ।
māmeva śaraṇaṃ lakṣmi! ye tvāyāsyanti mānavāḥ ।। 11 9।।
teṣāṃ doṣānanālakṣya hyaparādhaśatānyapi ।
kṣamiṣye svalpabhaktyā'pi divyadāruvapurdharaḥ ।। 1.582.1 20।।
ityuktvā virarāmā'sau vaṭe śrībhagavān svayam ।
lakṣmyā sākaṃ nijaṃ rūpaṃ dhyāyan nīlādrimaṇḍale ।। 121 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mārkaṇḍeyāya śrīpuruṣottamakṣetrasya śāśvatikatāpradarśanaṃ tatkṣetrapramāṇaṃ śaṃbhoraṣṭarūpaiḥ pārvatyāścāṣṭarūpaiḥ kṣetrapālatvādi, vaṭasya divyatā, indradyumnena bhāvimūrtipratiṣṭhāpanādi, cetinirūpaṇanāmā dvyaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 582 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 582 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 583
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 584 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
atha te'tra camatkāraṃ kathayāmi śṛṇu priye ।
mūrtirūpo'smyahaṃ divyo mokṣadaḥ sukhadaḥ śubhaḥ ।। 1 ।।
yathā pṛthvyāditattvāni jīvātmano hi mūrtayaḥ ।
amūrtasya gṛhaṃ mūrtaṃ tathā me pratimā gṛham ।। 2 ।।
ekatattvātmakaṃ cātmasvarūpaṃ carmacakṣuṣā ।
vīkṣyate na tataścā'haṃ mūrtyātmā dṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ।। 3 ।।
pṛthvīśarīrakaścā'haṃ vāriśarīrakastathā ।
tejaśarīrakaścāpi vāyuśarīrakastathā ।। 4 ।।
ākāśamūrtikaścāhaṃ tanmātrāmūrtikastathā ।
manobuddhyādiśarīraścātmeśvaraśarīrakaḥ ।। 5 ।।
brahmaśarīrakaścā'haṃ muktaśarīrakastathā ।
sarvaśarīrakaścāhaṃ sarvaṃ divyaṃ madāśrayāt ।। 6 ।।
divyatve vedamantrādikarmakāṇḍaḥ prayojakaḥ ।
pratiṣṭhā kāraṇaṃ tatra mukhyaṃ mama praveśane ।। 7 ।।
tato'haṃ taccharīreṇa sarvaṃ karomi dehivat ।
yadyevaṃ māṃ vijānīyānmukto bhavati macchritaḥ ।। 8 ।।
niśceṣṭo dāruvarṣmā'pi divyalīlāvilāsakṛt ।
kṣame'haṃ svalpabhaktyā'pi bhaktā'parādhakoṭikam ।। 9 ।।
kurukṣetre purā tvāstāṃ brāhmaṇakṣatriyāvubhau ।
sakhāyau dharmahīnau ca vṛttacyutau vimohitau ।। 10 ।।
paṇyayoṣitsahavāsau svadhāsvāhāvivarjitau ।
pāralaukikacintā tu tayoḥ svapne'pi nāgatā ।। 11 ।।
ekadā tu kurukṣetre viṣṇuyāgo vyavartata ।
agacchatāṃ yajñavāṭamapaśyatāṃ kriyāvidhim ।। 12 ।।
śṛṇvānau vaidikān mantrān pāpaṃ tayornyavartata ।
dharme matistayorjātā puṇḍarīkā'mbarīṣayoḥ ।। 13 ।।
viveko'pi samudbhūtastarituṃ vai bhavārṇavam ।
kṛtapāpaprapuñjānāṃ kṣālanārthaṃ ca bhūsurān ।। 14।।
apṛcchatāmabhivādya vijñāpya kalmaṣaṃ nijam ।
surāmiṣavyavāyādi cauryaṃ nāryādihiṃsanam । । 15 । ।
tacchrutvā vaiṣṇavaśreṣṭho mahābhāgavato dvijaḥ ।
divyakriyāparaścaitāvuvāca bhaktisaṃbhṛtam । । 16 । ।
bho dvija kṣatradāyāda pāparāśeḥ sudāruṇāt ।
muktiṃ ced vāñcchatastūrṇaṃ gacchataṃ puruṣottamam ।। 17 ।।
kṣetrottamaṃ dārumayo yatrāste puruṣottamaḥ ।
tamārādhya jagannāthaṃ lakṣmīrādhāprabhāpatim । । 18 ।।
pāpakṣayaṃ tathā muktiṃ prayasyathā'kṣare pade ।
tanmā vilambaṃ kuruta prayātaṃ tatra satvaram । । 19 ।।
utkale nīlaśaile ca vāridheḥ sannidhau taṭe ।
ityuktau tau ṛṣīnnatvā yayatuḥ puruṣottamam । । 1.583.20 । ।
dhyāyantau manasā viṣṇuṃ śuddhāhāravratāvubhau ।
gatvā snātvā sarvatīrthāśrayābdhau mandiraṃ prati । । 21 ।।
dvāri kṛtvā daṇḍavacca tiṣṭhantau darśanecchayā ।
bhagavantaṃ nirīkṣantau nā'paśyatāṃ yadā hi tau ।। 22 । ।
nirāśau tu tadā bhūtvā''rabhete'naśanaṃ vratam ।
kīrtayantau harernāmā'bhavatāṃ līnamānasau । । 23 । ।
atha tṛtīyarātrau tau jyotirekamapaśyatām ।
punarlayaṃ gataṃ jyotistau copavasatāṃ sthirau । । 24।।
madhye saptamarātreśca tau śrīharimapaśyatām ।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 25 ।।
caturbhujaṃ sāyudhaṃ ca ratnāḍhyapādukāsthitam ।
kamalākṣaṃ hāsyamukhaṃ vāme lakṣmīṃ svabāhunā ।। 296 । ।
pārśve cākarṣayantaṃ ca gṛhṇantaṃ śrīkarācchubham ।
tāmbūlakaṃ mukhe cākṣṇoḥ premapravāhapūritam ।। 27 ।।
tejaḥparidhisaṃvyāptaṃ sakhībhiḥ parivāritam ।
ratnavetrakarābhiśca tathā cāmarapāṇibhiḥ ।। 28 । ।
dhṛtagandhapradīpābhirbhūṣitābhirvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ।
ratnachatraṃ dhṛtavatyā śobhitaṃ puruṣottamam ।। 29 । ।
dhūpapātraṃ dhṛtavatyā dhūpitaṃ puruṣottamam ।
kāṃcit sahāsāṃ paśyantaṃ hasantaṃ sumanoharam ।। 1.583.30 । ।
tathā stuvato devāṃśca siddhāṃśca sanakādikān ।
nāradādyāँśca gandharvān prahlādādīṃśca vaiṣṇavān । । 31 ।।
nṛtyantaṃ ca prasādārthamagrato'psaraso gaṇam ।
evaṃ sarvaṃ ca tau dṛṣṭvā divyajñānau babhūvatuḥ । । 32 ।।
triḥ parikramya taṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ kṛtāñjalī ।
tuṣṭuvāte muhustau ca hṛdayasthaṃ dṛśoścaram ।। 33 ।।
āvāṃ kāmārthalubdhau ca pāpamātrābhicāriṇau ।
ṛṣīṇāṃ kṛpayā cātra śaraṇaṃ te hyupāgatau ।।34।।
anukampaya nau nātha sudīnau śaraṇāgatau ।
mūḍhau duṣkṛtakarmāṇau patitau bhavasāgare ।।35।।
ko'nyastvatsadṛśo bandhurmahābhayanivārakaḥ ।
svārthaśūnyaḥ parāthaikadhyeyo'nāthapatiḥ prabhuḥ ।।36 ।।
nārāyaṇeti tvannāma caturvargaikasādhanam ।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।।37।।
mantraste mokṣadaścātipāpināṃ pāvako'sti hi ।
japto bhavān paraṃ pāraṃ prāpayatyeva tena hi ।।38।।
tannau prasīda deveśa dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ pradehi nau ।
ghorād dustarakhātācca samuttāraya keśava ।।39।।
indriyāṇi mano buddhistava mūrtau vasantu naḥ ।
ātmā saṃskārasahitaścārpitastava pādayoḥ ।।1.583.40 ।।
prasīda deva sarvātmannasaṃkhyeyaśirobhuja ।
asaṃkhyaghrāṇanayanapāṇipāda namo'stu te ।।41 ।।
ṣaṅviṃśastvaṃ cāntarātman niṣprapaṃcaḥ pravartase ।
catuṣpumarthamūrtistvaṃ jagannātha namo'stu te ।।42।।
tvadārādhanayā kṛṣṇa bhavanti sarvasiddhayaḥ ।
yogābhyāsaṃ vinā cāsmai kṛṣṇāya te namonamaḥ ।।43 ।।
bhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ pradehyāvāṃ nāstyanyatprārthanīyakam ।
yāvatprāṇāndhārayāvastāvadbhaktirdṛḍhā tvayi ।।44।।
tataḥ pāre'pi te bhaktiṃ dehi nārāyaṇaprabho ।
agādhabhavapaṃke'tra nimagnayoḥ parāyaṇam ।।45।।
dāsyaṃ nātha sadā dehi cānukampaya nau vibho ।
itistuvantau tau bhaktau petaturdaṇḍavat kṣitau ।।46।।
prasīdeti vadantau ca muhuścakraturdarśanam ।
divyadṛṣṭyā vilokyaivaṃ nematuśca muhurmuhuḥ ।।47।।
tāvadadṛśyatāṃ yāto lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ patiḥ ।
tāvubhau carmanetrābhyāṃ puṇḍarīkāmbarīṣakau ।।48 ।।
māyayā darśanaṃ divyaṃ svapnadṛṣṭamabudhyatām ।
tataḥ siṃhāsanasthaṃ śrīpatiṃ dadṛśatuḥ punaḥ ।।49।।
kāṣṭharūpaṃ divyakalgiśobhāḍhyamukuṭānvitam ।
lalāṭaphalake svarṇavarṇabindūrdhvapuṇḍrakam ।।1.583.50 ।।
navajīmūtasaṃkāśaṃ phullapadmāyatekṣaṇam ।
sadratnasārajaḍitasauvarṇakuṇḍalojjvalam ।।51 ।।
raktādharaṃ tilapuṣpanāsikaṃ vanamālinam ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmāyudha cāyatavakṣasam ।।।52।।
mandahāsyānanaṃ divyasvarṇakaṭakabāhukam ।
śrīvatsakaustubhamauktikādihārāḍhyavakṣasam । । 53 । ।
ājānuyugalaṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalāḍhyaprakoṣṭhakam ।
sadratnakhacitormikāśobhitāṅgulikākaram । । 54 । ।
abhayaṃ darśayantaṃ ca kareṇa mālikānvitam ।
kṣaumapiśaṃgadhautraṃ ca divyacandanacarcitam । । 55 । ।
puṣpahārālisaṃśobhadvakṣaḥsthalasthitaśriyam ।
puṣpagucchānvitakaraṃ suvartulakapolakam ।
dhanuḥkammānikākārā'dharadvayamanoharam । । 56। ।
īṣadgocaraśmaśrusatsūkṣmarekhā'dharānvitam ।
kāmakoṭipralāvaṇyapremā'bdhikaṃjalocanam । । 57 । ।
āhvayantaṃ kaṭākṣeṇa jñāpayantaṃ ca hṛcchrayam ।
saptaviṃśatihārālisauvarṇaraśanākaṭim । । 58 । ।
mañjīrakiṃkiṇījālaśabditacaraṇadvayam ।
alaktakādisaṃlagnaśoṇarūpāḍhyapattalam । । 59 । ।
sūkṣmacandrakṛtāvāsonnatavartulasannakham ।
dhanurdhvajatriśūlasvastikamatsyādihastakam । । 1.583.60 । ।
ūrdhvarekhā'rdhacandrādivajrāॆkuśādipattalam ।
navayauvanapūrasthaṃ cittacauraṃ patiṃ prabhum । । 61 । ।
adrāṣṭāṃ ca tau subhaktau śrīsvāmipuruṣottamam ।
tau śrīharerdakṣabhāge dadṛśāte halāyudham । । 62 । ।
saṃkarṣaṇaṃ prabhuṃ śeṣaṃ naikabrahmāṇḍasatphaṇam ।
taṃ balaṃ yatsahasrādiphaṇāmaṇḍalabhūṣitam । । 63 । ।
dhavalaṃ samukuṭaṃ ca sauvarṇakuṇḍalāñcitam ।
divyamālādharaṃ nīlāmbaraṃ paṃkajanetrakam । । 64 । ।
pronnatapīnavakṣaḥsthamaṇihārālirājitam ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmamūśalahaladhāriṇam । । 65 । ।
atha madhye tayoḥ saumyāṃ bhadrāṃ campakasūjjvalām ।
dadṛśāte ca tau ramyāṃ samārabdhasuyauvanām । । 66 । ।
kuṃkumāruṇabindvāḍhyalalāṭaphalakojjvalām ।
sauvarṇatantikārājadbhāvakesaracandanām । । 67 । ।
kabarībhāraśobhāḍhyāṃ dhammilākarṣaṇānvitām ।
karṇanāsāgalabāhuprakoṣṭhakaṭibhūṣaṇām । । 68 । ।
vidyutprabhojjvalaśāṭīkañcukīghargharīyutām ।
sarvalāvaṇyasahitāṃ lakṣmīṃ kṛṣṇapriyāṃ dhruvām । । 69। ।
tāmbūlakamalādyaiśca śobhitāṃ vyajanānvitām ।
divyanepathyasaundaryasauratānandavāsinīm । । 1.583.70 । ।
adrāṣṭāṃ ca śatasūryasamaikārasudarśanam ।
sahasrāra ca bhaktānāṃ rakṣākaraṃ pramuktidam ।। 71 ।।
dārvagranirmitaṃ cakraṃ hariṃ bhadrāṃ balaṃ tathā ।
caturdhā'vasthitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā tau viprabāhujau ।।172 ।।
vismayaṃ jagmatuḥ prātaḥ śraddadhatuśca divyatām ।
na dārupratimā ceyaṃ sākṣād brahma prakāśate ।। 73 ।।
dārumiśreṇa bhagavān tīrtharājataṭe sthitaḥ ।
vaṭamūle divyarūpo yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate janaḥ ।।74।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
kṣitau yadāvatarati catūrūpaḥ prakāśate ।।75 ।।
jagannāthasya nikaṭe cāvāṃ sthāsyāva eva tu ।
iti niścitya bhaktau dvau kṛṣṇe bhaktiparāyaṇau ।।76 ।।
tatra sthitau ciraṃ saṃprajayantau kṛṣṇamānasau ।
divyau bhūtvā yayau śrīmatkṛṣṇanārāyaṇākṣaram ।।77।।
muktipadaṃ paraṃ dhāmā'punarāvṛttilakṣaṇam ।
evaṃ ye bhajamānāstamanādiśrīnarāyaṇam ।।78 ।।
vāsaṃ yāsyanti puruṣottamapuryāṃ narāḥ striyaḥ ।
divyāścaturbhujā bhūtvā prayāsyanti mamā'kṣaram ।।79 ।।
api kīṭapataṃgādyā viyujyante'subhiśca ye ।
te'pi kṛṣṇasya sāmarthyāt prayāsyanti paraṃ padam ।।1.583.8 0 ।।
sakāmāḥ svargameṣyanti lokān vairājasaṃjñakān ।
aiśvarāँsteṣu vai divyān bhogān bhuktvā tataḥ param ।। 81 ।।
prayāsyanti mama lokaṃ cākṣarādapi tūttamam ।
ityāha bhagavān lakṣmīṃ cotkale puruṣottame ।। 82 ।।
dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre vasanti vaiṣṇavā mama ।
narā nāryo dharmayuktā mama bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ ।।83 ।।
ṛṣikulyāṃ samāsādya dakṣiṇodadhigāminīm ।
svarṇarekhāmahānadyormadhye deśaḥ sa utkalaḥ ।।84।।
bhūsvarga eṣa evā'sti deśaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ prado nārāyaṇāśrayāt ।।85।।
nāryaḥ pativratā yatra narā patnīvratasthitāḥ ।
sadā kṛtayugo yatra madbhakteṣu pravartate ।।86 ।।
teṣāṃ tu darśanāllakṣmi! muktirbhavati śāśvatī ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāsya bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labhejjanaḥ ।।87।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrījagannāthapuryāṃ viprakṣatriyayorbhagavatsākṣātkāreṇa muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā tryaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 583 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 583 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 584
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 585 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! kathāṃ mama purātanīṃ yathodbhavām ।
pūrve kṛte babhūvā'sāvindradyumno mahānṛpaḥ ।। 1 ।।
mārkaṇḍeyo na jānāti taṃ kālaṃ yatra cāsa saḥ ।
na bakarṣirna gṛdhrarṣirna cendrādyā vidurhi tam ।। 2 ।।
kintu kūrmo mānasastho jānāti taṃ purātanam ।
lomaśo'pi vijānāti cendradyumnaṃ purābhavam ।। 3 ।।
sraṣṭuḥ sa pañcamo vaṃśo vaiṣṇavāścā''sa bhūtale ।
adhyātmavidbhāgavataḥ sarveṣu brahmadarśanaḥ ।। 4 ।।
sarvavidyaḥ suśīlaśca yaṣṭā brahmaṇya ityapi ।
rājasūyaṃ vājimedhasahasrakamiyāja saḥ ।। 5 ।।
mahākālavane'vantīrājadhānīsthito'bhavat ।
manovākkarmabhiḥ kṛṣṇasvāmibhaktiṃ cakāra saḥ ।। 6 ।।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthasthitaḥ śrībhagavān svayam ।
śrīsvāmiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānnṛpasya tu ।। 7 ।।
pūjāvasaramāsādya gatvā gṛhṇāti pūjanam ।
naivedyaṃ samprabhuktvā ca nṛpaṃ bodhayati svayam ।। 8 ।।
yāhi rājanmama kṣetraṃ puruṣottamasaṃjñakam ।
tatra kāraya me saudhaṃ prāsādaṃ raivatopamam ।। 9 ।।
ityuktaḥ sa ca bhūpo'pi omityāha narāyaṇam ।
haristasyā'rpitāṃ pūjāṃ prāpyā'dṛśyo bhavatyapi ।। 1.584.1 0।।
atha rājñā sabhāyāṃ svapurohito niveditaḥ ।
yatra sākṣājjagannāthaḥ kṣetraṃ didṛkṣurasmi tat ।। 11 ।।
vimānena ca yāsyāmo vidvadbhiḥ kavibhiḥ saha ।
daivajñaiḥ śrotriyaiḥ sārdhaṃ dāsadāsyādibhistathā ।। 1 2।।
ityabhideśamādāya purohitasya pārśvagaḥ ।
tairthiko brāhmaṇastatra rājānaṃ pratyabhāṣata ।। 13 ।।
yo'bhūt patnīvratākhyo vai nāmnā brahmāṇḍagocaraḥ ।
sa prāha rājan jānāmi paśyāmi karagaṃ yathā ।। 14।।
kṣetra tadvai jagannāthāśrayamoḍhrapradeśake ।
utkale nīlaśailasyābhito dakṣiṇasāgare ।। 15 ।।
jale sthale ca tatkṣetraṃ nāmnā śrīpuruṣottamam ।
yatrāste kalpakavaṭo yatra rauhiṇakuṇḍakam ।। 16 ।।
tatrāste prāgdiśi harernīlendramaṇinirmitā ।
tanuḥ kṛṣṇasya divyā sā sārūpyamuktidāyinī ।। 17।।
paścime śabarāṇāṃ vai grāmaḥ śabaradīpakaḥ ।
vartate tasya mārgo'pi yena viṣṇvālayaṃ vrajet ।। 18।।
tatra nīlamaṇimūrtiḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo'sti vai ।
tatroṣitaṃ mayā rājan varṣaṃ śrīpuruṣottame ।। 19।।
tuṣṭyarthaṃ devadevasya vratinā divyacakṣuṣā ।
dṛṣṭvā devāśca munayaḥ pratirātraṃ samāgatāḥ ।।1.584.20।।
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya darśanāya ye ।
mahimaiṣa na kutrāpi purā dṛṣṭo mayā nṛpa ।। 21 ।।
saṃhitānāṃ kathāstatra śrutā kalpāntarārthagāḥ ।
tatsthānaṃ darśanārhaṃ vai vidyate nṛpasattama ।। 22।।
yathā vai raivatībhūmistathā nīlagiristhalam ।
kṣetradvayaṃ purā paścānna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ।।23।।
tvaṃ yasmād viṣṇubhakto'si tadgatvā śrīdharaṃ bhaja ।
evamuktvā sa vai vipraścāntardhānaṃ jagāma ha ।।24।।
avāpya vismayaṃ rājā purohitamuvāca yat ।
amānuṣamidaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvedānīṃ purohitaḥ ।।25।।
buddhistvarayate tatra gantuṃ yatra jagatprabhuḥ ।
mama dharmārthakāmāśca tvadāyattāḥ purohita ।।26 ।।
idānīṃ tvaṃ puro yāhi mameṣṭaṃ sādhitaṃ bhavet ।
śrutvā bāḍhaṃ vipra āha rājan drakṣyasi keśavam ।।27।।
yayā tvaṃ tattathā cāhaṃ kariṣyāmi tavārthakam ।
tatra vayaṃ tataḥ sarve vatsyāmaḥ puruṣottame ।।28।।
sāphalyaṃ kimato loke paraṃ yaddharidarśanam ।
tatra kṣetre bhagavataḥ sannidhiṃ rocate mama ।। 29।।
prathamaṃ me'nujo yātu taddeśaṃ cārasaṃyutaḥ ।
vidyāpatirjagannāthaṃ nīlādriṃ ca vaṭaṃ tathā ।।1.584.30।।
bhūpradeśaṃ prasamīkṣya pramīya ca vasundharām ।
samāyātu vijānan tatkṣetraṃ nārāyaṇāśrayam ।।3 1 ।।
śrutvaivaṃ cendrako rājā tathāstviti dideśa tam ।
purohito'pyanujaṃ svaṃ kathayāmāsa tattathā ।।32।।
prasthāpayāmāsa taṃ ca kṛtasvastyayanaṃ dvijaiḥ ।
vimāne puṣpake sthitvā provāca sahayāyinaḥ ।।33 ।।
aho naḥ saphalaṃ janma sukalyā śarvarī ca naḥ ।
drakṣyāmo yadbhagavato mukhapadmaṃ pramokṣadam ।।34।।
yaṃ paśyanti hṛdi nityaṃ yoginaḥ pārameśvarāḥ ।
taṃ nīlācalavāsaṃ śrīpatiṃ drakṣyāma eva ca ।। 35।।
adṛśyaṃ saṃvilokyaiva tariṣyāmo bhavāmbudhim ।
yatsmṛtiḥ pādarajakī drakṣyāmastaṃ janāyanam ।।36।।
sarūpamuktidaṃ nāthaṃ kariṣyāmo dṛśāṃcaram ।
adyā'ho prākpuṇyapuñja utthito bhagavatpradaḥ ।।37।।
vayaṃ sarve carmadṛbhirlokayiṣyāmahe harim ।
itthaṃ vadan yayau vyomnā dinārdhe puruṣottamam ।।38।।
oḍhradeśaṃ samudraṃ ca vaṭaṃ ca nīlaparvatam ।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadhāriṇo dadṛśe janān ।।39।।
atyadbhutāṃ suvasatiṃ sākṣāttanubhṛto hareḥ ।
atha nīlādrinikaṭe sthale divye'tiśobhite ।।1.584.40 ।।
vimānaṃ svaṃ kṣitau tatrā'vatārayat samasthale ।
upatyakāyāmārūḍho mukundālokanotsukaḥ ।।41 ।।
tatra śuśrāva bhagavadbhaktyālāpān girau muhuḥ ।
abhiyātaśca vai tatra dadarśa śabarālayān ।।46 ।।
śabaradīpakaṃ cāpi viṣṇubhaktāṃśca cihnitān ।
dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā tasthau yāvat savidyakaḥ ।।43।।
tāvad viśvāvasurnāma śabaraḥ parameśvaram ।
pūjayitvā samāyātastaṃ papraccha savidyakaḥ ।।44।।
atrāste bhagavān viṣṇurjagannātho mahāprabhuḥ ।
tadarthaṃ cāgato dūrād darśanaṃ kārayātra me ।।45।।
indradyumnasya nṛpateravantīpuravāsinaḥ ।
purohitā'nujaścā'haṃ vidyāpatyabhidhānakaḥ ।।46।।
preṣitastena rājñā'tra jijñāsunā yiyāsunā ।
hariṃ didṛkṣuṇā mārgaṃ draṣṭuṃ prāṅanīlamādhavāt ।।47।।
dṛṣṭvā sarvāṃ narapatervārtāṃ neṣyāmi so'pyaham ।
nirāhāro dhruvaṃ sādho tanmāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pradarśaya ।।48।।
śrutvaivaṃ śabaraḥ so'pi prāk śrutāṃ saṃhitākathām ।
sasmāra tatra yadrājā cendradyumno hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।49।।
samāgatyā'tra deveśaṃ caturdhā sthāpayiṣyati ।
vājimedhasahasraṃ ca bhūmāvatra kariṣyati ।।1.584.50।।
pṛthivyantargate līne mādhave nīlamādhave ।
punā rājā tamāgatya dāravaṃ sthāpayiṣyati ।।51 ।।
so'yaṃ kālaḥ samāyāto gāthā satyā bhaved yadi ।
nīlamaṇimayo nāthaścādṛśyatāṃ gamiṣyati ।।52।।
antardhānaṃ bhagavataḥ sannidhāne upasthitam ।
tadenaṃ darśayāmyeva nīlendramaṇimacyutam ।।53।।
iti vicārya śabaro brāhmaṇaṃ prāha hṛdgatam ।
asmābhiḥ śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā saṃśrutā ।।54।।
tatrodantaḥ samāyātaścendradyamno mahīpatiḥ ।
jagannāthe mahākṣetre vāsaṃ naijaṃ kariṣyati ।।55।।
nīlapāṣāṇamūrteste darśanaṃ vipra jāyate ।
bhāgyavāँstvaṃ tataścendradyumnasyā'pekṣayā'tra vai ।।56।।
rājñastvasya nīlamaṇiprabhorna darśanaṃ bhavet ।
cakṣurbhyāṃ paśya taṃ nīlamādhavaṃ nīlaśailagam ।।57।।
nīlamaṇivapuṣaṃ tamehi yāmo hyadhityakām ।
ityuktvā taṃ kare dhṛtvā gahanena ca vartmanā ।। 58।।
uparyuparyupāruhya śilākaṇṭakaśālini ।
ekaikanaragamye ca durgame nirjane sthale ।।59।।
vṛkṣacchāyātamaḥprāye samānīya sa śābaraḥ ।
darśayāmāsa rauhiṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ supāvanam ।।1.584.6 0।।
tasyā'tra pūrvabhāge'sau kalpachāyāvaṭo mahān ।
etayorantare brahmannikuṃjābhyantare sthitam ।।6 1 ।।
paśya kṛṣṇaṃ jagannāthaṃ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam ।
ityevaṃ darśayāmāsa nīlapāṣāṇakaṃ harim ।।6 2।।
sa tu viprastatra kuṇḍe snātvā sarvātmanā harim ।
praṇamya dūrataścaikamanāstuṣṭāva cāntare ।।63।।
akṣarātītabhagavattakṛṣṇanārāyaṇaprabho ।
mukteśajīvahṛdayaparātpara namo'stu te ।।64।।
sarvakarmasamārādhyayogasādhya namo'stu te ।
premapāśaviṣayātmaँstīrthātmaँste namonamaḥ ।।65।।
namastejaḥsvarūpāya pāvanāya namonamaḥ ।
hutāśanāya devāya hṛcchrayāya ca te namaḥ ।।66।।
mantrasthāya jīvanāya nirvāṇāya ca te namaḥ ।
sarvānandapradātre te brahmeśāya namonamaḥ ।।67।।
māyine tattvine mūrtimate viśvāsasākṣiṇe ।
jiṣṇave bahuśirase kamaleśāya te namaḥ ।।68।।
māmuddhara kṛpāsindho trāhi vāsanayā'nvitam ।
indradyumnanṛpasyāpi kuru saṃkalpapūraṇam ।।69।।
iti vidyāpatiḥ stutvā omityevaṃ jajāpa ha ।
tataḥ sa śabaraḥ prāha kṛtārthastvaṃ tu sāmpratam ।।1.584.70।।
gṛhaṃ yāvaḥ kṣudhito'si vāso'raṇyena cocitaḥ ।
hiṃsrāṇāṃ pādacāro'yaṃ pradeśo'sti bhayapradaḥ ।।71 ।।
ityuktvā śabaro naijaṃ gṛhaṃ nināya bhūsuram ।
mārge'pi viṣame nā'sya śramo yat kṛṣṇadarśanam ।।।72।।
śabaro bhojyapānādyairatiyiṃ samapūjayat ।
uvāca kaccit tṛpto'si śābarairvastubhirdvija ।।73।।
tava pratoṣaṇādindradyumnastuṣṭo bhaviṣyati ।
vipraḥ prāhā''ścaryametat tvadgṛhe divyavaibhavāḥ ।।74।।
rājyātivartinaścaite kuta ete vadātra mām ।
śabaraḥ prāha devādyā nityamāyānti vai hareḥ ।।75।।
divyopacārānādāya pūjanāya jagatpateḥ ।
stutvā samarcyā'rpayitvā nartayitvā prayānti ca ।।76।।
tānīmāni hi divyāni sarvopakaraṇāni vai ।
tairvayaṃ kṣīṇarogāśca nivasāmo'rbudāyuṣaḥ ।।77।।
viṣṇuprasādabhogena pāpakṣayaṃ ca divyatām ।
śrutvā''ścaryaparo vipraḥ kṛtārthaṃ svamamanyata ।।78।।
aho tvatraiva vastavyaṃ bhagavaccharaṇe sadā ।
yādṛśo vipṇubhakto'yaṃ mayā bhāvyaṃ tathaiva ca ।।79।।
kiṃ gatvā svagṛhe me'sti vicāryetthaṃ jagāda tam ।
kṛṣṇadāsye mayā vṛttyaṃ mayi te cedanugrahaḥ ।।1.584.80 ।।
kimanyasevayā loke vidhāsye svāmisevanam ।
yadi puṇyaṃ bhavetpaurvaṃ labhate svāmisevanam ।।8 1 ।।
sādhu mitra tvayā sārdhaṃ puṇyānme saṃgamo'sti yat ।
sādhusaṃgena saṃsāraṃ tariṣye dustaraṃ viṣam ।।82।।
sārātsārataraṃ puṇyaṃ vaiṣṇavena sahāsanam ।
śabarastu tadā prāha tathāstviti paraṃ śṛṇu ।।83।।
indradyumnaṃ samādāya vāsaṃ cātra kuru dvija ।
nīlaśailakṛtā mūrtistāvatā layameṣyati ।।84।।
imāṃ prācīnamūrtiṃ ca naiva drakṣyati bhūpatiḥ ।
hariracirādbālukāsvantardhānaṃ gamiṣyati ।।85।।
sa cāgatya nṛpo'dṛṣṭvā śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ।
prāyopaveśanasthaśca svapne drakṣyati mādhavam ।।86 ।।
haryādeśād dārumayaṃ harermūrticatuṣṭayam ।
vedhodvārā pratiṣṭhāpya pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ।।87।।
kārayiṣyati devasya prāsādaṃ gaganocchrayam ।
āvayoḥ sthāsyati vaṃśo yāvanmūrtistu dāravī ।।88।।
nīlendrāśmamayaṃ smṛtvā snātvā sindhau tataḥ param ।
indradyumnaṃ prayāhi tvaṃ samānayā'tra taṃ nṛpam ।।89।।
ityukto brāhmaṇaḥ snātvā natvā vimānamāsthitaḥ ।
sāyaṃ jagāma cāvantīṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭamavarṇayat ।।1.584.90 ।।
jagannāthe tadā kṣetre vāyuścaṇḍagatirvavau ।
sāyāhne'rcanavelāyāmabhitaḥ svarṇavālukāḥ ।।9 1 ।।
uḍḍīyante sma pavanāt tābhiśchannaḥ sa mādhavaḥ ।
rauhiṇakuṇḍaśchanno'pi vālukāparvato'bhavat ।।9 2।।
devādyā vālukārāśiṃ dadṛśuste na mādhavam ।
rauhiṇaṃ ca tathā kuṇḍaṃ na dadṛśuḥ kṣaṇāntare ।।9 3 ।।
sarve te prārthayāmāsuḥ svāparādhakṣamāṃ prati ।
kathaṃ naḥ sevakāँstyaktvā yugapannahi dṛśyase ।।94।।
yeṣāmarthe'tra dhṛtavān mūrtirūpaṃ kalevaram ।
tānanāthān parityajya kathaṃ pṛthvyāṃ tirohitaḥ ।।95।।
na prāsādo na ca sthānaṃ na mārgo na bhavānapi ।
na kuṇḍaṃ dṛśyate cātra kathaṃ kopastavedṛśaḥ ।।96।।
asmāँścāpyatra pralaye vikarṣaya tvayā saha ।
surāṇāṃ śocatāmevaṃ vyomavāṇī babhūva ha ।।97।।
bho surā mā praśocantu madicchā vilaye dhruvā ।
tato me darśanaṃ līnaṃ parivartanamiṣyate ।।98।।
brahmā vadiṣyati sarvamavatārāntaraṃ mama ।
śrutvā devā yayuḥ svargaṃ śabarāḥ śokamāpnuvan ।।99।।
nīlādrirvālukāvyāpto babhūva dṛśyate'bhitaḥ ।
nīlamādhavavāñccheyaṃ yatastiro'bhavat svayam ।। 1.584.10 0।।
amanyanta ca śabarā atha vidyāpatirdvijaḥ ।
vimānenā'vantikāyāmindradyumnālayaṃ yayau ।। 10 1।।
nirmālyamālāṃ nīlākhyamādhavasya dadau nṛpe ।
rājā tutoṣa nirmālyamālāṃ śirasi dhārayan ।। 1 02।।
mālātmakaṃ prapaśyāmi nīlamādhavamatra vai ।
namāmi mālikāṃ divyāṃ bhaktamānasapūraṇīm ।। 103 ।।
ityuktvā viprahastena mālāṃ kaṇṭhe hyadhārayat ।
mālātmikāṃ śriyaṃ rājā tuṣṭāva pārameśvarīm ।। 1 04।।
naya māṃ tvaṃ mahālakṣmi yatrāste bhagavān patiḥ ।
ityuktvā nyaṣīdadrājā samāje'vantivāsinām ।। 1 05।।
vipraḥ pṛṣṭo'tha vṛttāntaṃ puruṣottamakṣetrajam ।
saprakāśaṃ hi sadasi varṇayāmāsa vistarāt ।। 106 ।।
bhilladvīpā'valokaṃ ca samudrasnānamityapi ।
nīlādrirohaṇaṃ nīlamādhavasyā'bhidarśanam ।। 1 07।।
susnānaṃ rauhiṇe kuṇḍe divyavaṭasya darśanam ।
śabarāṇāmāvasathān varṇayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।। 1 08।।
nīlendramaṇimūrteśca varṇanaṃ ca yathātatham ।
nīlendramaṇipāṣāṇamayī mūrtiḥ purātanī ।। 1 09।।
āraseyī cākacakyamayī prapūjitā suraiḥ ।
mālā tasyai cārpiteyaṃ surairmlāyati yā na hi ।। 1.584.11 0।।
ricyate na ca gandhena seyaṃ tvatkaṇṭhagā nṛpa ।
tatratyaṃ te varṇayiṣye pūjanādi pradivyakam ।। 111 ।।
bhuktirmuktiśca vai rājan dve tatra yugapatsthite ।
na jarārogaśokādiduḥkhaṃ tatra hi vidyate ।। 1 12।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnasya sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamadarśanaṃ, purohitabhrāturvidyāpaterjagannāthakṣetre preṣaṇam, āgatya yathāvilokanatadvarṇanam, jhanjhāvātena vālukāsu nīlamādhavalayaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 584 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 584 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 585
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 586 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! tato vidyāpatiḥ prāha sabhāsthale ।
divyatāṃ tasya kṣetrasya yathāvat kathayāmi te ।। 1 ।।
vipraḥ prāha ca madhyāhne divyagandho vavau marut ।
surā naivedyadānārthaṃ vyomamārgātsamāyayuḥ ।। 2 ।।
vādanāni gāyanāni surastrīṇāṃ tadā'bhavan ।
sahasramupacārāṇāṃ devaistasmai samarpitam ।। 3 ।।
sampūjya jayapūrvāste yayuḥ svargaṃ surāstataḥ ।
viśvāvasuḥ śabaro me mādhavasya prasādanam ।। 4 ।।
bhojyaṃ mālyaṃ dadau pūtaṃ yadatrā'pahṛtaṃ mayā ।
prasādaḥ śarkarātmā ca dīyatāṃ sadase nṛpa ।। 5 ।।
samantād gahanākīrṇaṃ kṣetraṃ nīlādrināmikam ।
tīrtharājasya velāyāṃ svarṇavālukayā vṛtam ।। 6 ।।
vicitradṛśyaṃ devānāṃ mānavānāṃ tu kā kathā ।
adreḥ śṛṃge kalpajīvī mahānucco vaṭo'sti ca ।। 7 ।।
dīrghāyataḥ puṣpaphalavarjitaḥ pallavojjvalaḥ ।
tatpaścād rauhiṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tatpūrve vedikāsthitaḥ ।। 8 ।।
nyagrodhacchāyayā śītaścendranīlamayo hariḥ ।
cakragadādharaścāste svarṇapadmopari prabhuḥ ।। 9 ।।
ekāśītyaṅgulamito mandahāsyasphuranmukhaḥ ।
rājīvasaumyanetraścā'mṛtapūrṇānanaḥ prabhuḥ ।। 1.585.1 0।।
vapuṣo'śmamayatve'pi candrojjvalaḥ smitādharaḥ ।
hāsasaṃphullagaṇḍābhyāṃ ruciraṃ cibukaṃ hanuḥ ।। 1 1।।
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca rājad vakṣaśca mālayā ।
graiveyakaiśca sauvarṇaiḥ ratnāñcitaiḥ samujjvalaiḥ ।। 12।।
pīnāyataskandhayugajānudīrghacaturbhujaḥ ।
ākarṇāntāyatakoṇavakranetrakaṭākṣakam ।। 1 3।।
sakaustubhaṃ kaṃkaṇormikā'ṅgulīyakabhūṣitam ।
nimnanābhidharaṃ cādhastanuromālimañjulam ।। 14।।
suratnamekhalārājatkaṭikauśeyadhautrakam ।
sakiṃkiṇīmañjirāḍhyaraktatalāśripatkajam ।। 15।।
jaghanaṃ sundaraṃ divyaṃ kāmāśrayaṃ ca sundaram ।
liṃgaṃ tejomayaṃ ramyaṃ sarvākarṣaṇabhājanam ।। 16।।
sarvāśādyotako devo nīlādrerupari sthitaḥ ।
vāmapārśvagatā lakṣmīrāśliṣṭā padmapālinā ।। 17।।
vallakīvādanaparā bhagavanmukhalocanā ।
sarvalāvaṇyaśobhāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। 18।।
sarvālaṃkṛtitejaskā prodbhinnanavayauvanā ।
chatrībhūtaphaṇāvṛndaḥ śeṣaḥ paścād vilokitaḥ ।। 1 9।।
agre vyavasthitaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vapurbibhratsudarśanam ।
kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ tasya paścād garuḍamāsthitam ।।1.585.20 ।।
sajīvā iva te bhaktānugrāhakā vilokitāḥ ।
tatra ceto mama rājannatyantamabhidhāvati ।।2 1 ।।
anekajanmasāhasrapuṇyapāko hi paśyati ।
sarvasādhanalabhyaṃ taddarśanātprāpyate'kṣaram ।।22।।
tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ yena vīkṣitaḥ ।
tvaṃ ca rājaँstvarayaiva vilokaya jagatprabhum ।।23।।
na jāne śvaḥ sūryadraṣṭā bhaviṣyasi na veti ca ।
śvaḥ kāryamadya kartavyaṃ mokṣārthaṃ pārameśvaram ।।24।।
ityuktaścendradyumnastu harṣamavāpa puṣkalam ।
kṛtakṛtyo'smīti cāha prasādamālikāgrahāt ।। 25।।
tayā darśanapātratvaṃ prāptaṃ cādya mayā hareḥ ।
sarvātmanā ca rājyena saha gantavyameva ca ।। 26 ।।
tatrāvāsaṃ sadā kṛtvā kariṣye hayamedhakān ।
sarvopacāraiḥ śrīnāthaṃ pūjayiṣye dine dine ।।27।।
dāsyena sevayā kṛṣṇaṃ prīṇayiṣye ramāpatim ।
evaṃ rājā samuvāca tāvadāyāddhi nāradaḥ ।।28।।
pūjito vandito rājñā rājānaṃ samuvāca saḥ ।
avatīrṇau naraṃ draṣṭuṃ badaryāṃ ca narāyaṇam ।।29।।
tava kīrtiṃ devatābhyaḥ śrutvā satye samāgataḥ ।
śrījagannāthagamane vyavasāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ।।1.585.30।।
tava jñātvā prasanno'smi jātastaṃ yāhi sevaya ।
sahasrajanmābhyāsaiśca bhaktirbhavati mādhave ।।3 1।।
brahmā cārādhya taṃ nāthaṃ lebhe paitāmahaṃ padam ।
tatputro'haṃ tadvaṃśastvaṃ bhaktyā śobhā sadā hi naḥ ।।32।।
anādyavidyānāśāya samarthā bhaktiruttamā ।
tarirbhaktibhavābdhau sā janmarogasya bheṣajam ।।33।।
māṃteva rakṣati bhaktān santaḥ puṣyanti vai tayā ।
brāhmyaṃ padaṃ tayā muktirlabhyate tadanugrahāt ।।34।।
bahvyānāṃ śalabhānāṃ dāvatulyā haripriyā ।
sarvatīrthaphaladātrī tārayitrī nimajjatām ।।35 ।।
tapāṃsi yajñā dānāni vratāni dharmasatkriyāḥ ।
eṣāṃ sāhasrakoṭyaśca na bhakterayutāṃśakaḥ ।।36 ।।
sā tridhā guṇabhedena turīyā nirguṇā matā ।
svārthā'bhicārayuktā sā tāmasī bhaktirīritā ।।37।।
svārthaparārthasammiśrā rājasī bhogavāñcchayā ।
parārthamātrasandheyā sāttvikī sukhabhājanā ।।38।।
phalehārahitā sā nirguṇā śrīpuruṣottame ।
nirguṇā muktaye proktā premasevātmikā hareḥ ।।39।।
sāttvikyā brahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ rājasyā śakralokatām ।
tāmasyā pitṛlokādīn yānti punaśca bhūjanum ।।1.585.40।।
uttamāmuttamāṃ kuryāt tena muktirbhavet kvacit। ।
kulācārādihīno'pi bhaktimān saṃpraśasyate ।।41 ।।
sarvavidyādhivāso'pi bhaktihīno vinindyate ।
yayā vetti parabrahma parā vidyā tu sā matā ।।42 ।।
yena prīṇāti bhagavān satkriyā sā prakīrtitā ।
tābhyāṃ yukto bhaved bhakto bhāgavatottamo hi saḥ ।।43।।
tatpādapāṃsunā viśvaṃ pūyate sacarācaram ।
vāsudeve tathā bhakte sāmyaṃ sañjāyate sadā ।।44।।
tayoraiśvaryarūpādibhedo naiva ca naiva ca ।
śāntacittastathā saumyo jitendriyo hyahiṃsakaḥ ।। 45।।
adrogdhā kṛpayāyuktaścāste yaścā'vinindakaḥ ।
guṇagrāhī sadācāraḥ parasaukhyasukhānvitaḥ ।।46।।
sarvatra śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇadraṣṭā vimatsaraḥ ।
dīnānukampo hitakṛddharau koṭyadhipremavān ।।47।।
satāṃ sevāparo devapūjakaḥ pitṛtarpakaḥ ।
sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jānan samaṣṭivyaṣṭimityapi ।।48।।
abhedenaiva paśyaँśca dāsyaṃ karoti vai hareḥ ।
svāmisevakabhāvena sevako vartate ca yaḥ ।।49।।
hariṃ bhāvayati kīrtayati namaḥkaroti ca ।
bhajatyeva prabhuṃ nityaṃ nānye'vadhānamācaret ।।1.585.50।।
śilāsvarṇadravyaloṣṭastrīkūṭakaṇṭakādiṣu ।
mitraśatrubandhubhinnādiṣu sāmyasamādhimān ।।51 ।।
nāmadhyānaparo viṣṇorjayavāṇīrataḥ sadā ।
devacihnapriyaḥ khyāto bhakto bhāgavatottamaḥ ।।52।।
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmacandratilakaśobhitaḥ ।
kaṇṭhīmālāyuto vṛndādalamālyavibhūṣitaḥ ।।53।।
rāgadveṣamadamānavihīnastṛṣṇikākṣayaḥ ।
bhakto bhavati kāmādivarjito vāsanākṣayaḥ ।।54।।
ityuktaścendradyumnaśca prītimān nāradaṃ prati ।
uvāca sādhusaṃgo me bhāgyādadya upasthitaḥ ।।।55।।
tadāvāṃ yānamāsthāya paśyāvo nīlamādhavam ।
evaṃ niścitya pañcamyāṃ budhe jyeṣṭhasya cārjune ।।56।।
pakṣe puṣye cendradyumnaḥ kārayāmāsa ghoṣaṇām ।
yathāvibhavataḥ sainyaiḥ prajābhirbāndhavādibhiḥ ।।57।।
nīlādrigamanaṃ kāryaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ samarpya ca ।
yā vṛttidīryate cātra tayā tatrāpi jīvatu ।।58।।
rājānaḥ sāvarodhāśca sāmātyāḥ saparicchadāḥ ।
rathairgajaisturagaiśca koṣaiḥ saha padātibhiḥ ।।59।।
sajjā vrajantu vai tatra brāhmaṇāḥ sāgnihotriṇaḥ ।
vaṇijaḥ sahabhāṇḍaiśca sapaṇyāḥ paṇyajīvinaḥ ।।1.585.60 ।।
nṛtyagāyanavāditrajyotirvidyāsubuddhayaḥ ।
vaidyāśca kathakā bhaṭṭāḥ santaśca vārayoṣitaḥ ।।61 ।।
gāvaḥ śakuntapāścāpi śākunikāśca sevakāḥ ।
dāsā dāsyastathā yāntu kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।।62।।
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ svayaṃ ca māṃgalyaṃ kārayāmāsa yātrikam ।
snātvā tīrthajalaiḥ rājā nāndīmukhānakārayat ।।63 ।।
havanaṃ ca tataḥ kṛtvā cakre vahniṃ pradakṣiṇam ।
tato māṃgalyanepathyavidhānamupacakrame ।।64।।
hemapīṭhe hariṃ prārcya tatprasādasya mālikām ।
dadhāra prathamaṃ rājā dhyāyan śrīpuruṣottamam ।।65।।
yātrārthaṃ ca vinirdiśya dakṣiṇaṃ pādamuddadhau ।
dakṣiṇāḥ pradadau viprebhyo vāme gaṇikeḍitaḥ ।।66।।
śvetāśvakuṃjarapārāvatahaṃsasumālikāḥ ।
sacūtapallavaṃ pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ paśyan yayau nṛpaḥ ।।67।।
nṛsiṃhamandiraṃ gatvā pūjayitvā hariṃ satīm ।
dvāramāgatya ca yānaṃ vaihāyasaṃ mahattamam ।।68।।
samāruroha samuniḥ sāntaḥpurastathā'pare ।
anyaiḥ sahasrairyānaiśca pratasthire purīṃ prati ।।69।।
jayaśabdāstūryaśabdā babhūvuḥ puṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ ।
nānāyānasamārūḍhāḥ koṭiśaśca janāstataḥ ।।1.585.70।।
sasaṃbhārāḥ sakuṭumbā yayuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
divasārdhena te sarve prāpurutkalabhūmikām ।।71 ।।
sīmni sthito carcikākhyāṃ devīṃ pupūjurīśvarīm ।
citrotpalāṃ nadīṃ gatvā jalapānādi cācaran ।।72।।
svādubhojyāni ca bubhujire sarve yathārhataḥ ।
viśaśramurnadītīre sainyā''vāsādi tatra ca ।।73।।
cakruḥ sāyaṃvidhiṃ cāpi rātrau vinodamādadhuḥ ।
prātaḥ snātvā nityapūjāṃ jalāhārādikaṃ tathā ।।74।।
kṛtvā tasthustadā tāvadoḍhrarājasya sevakaḥ ।
indradyumnaṃ samāyātaḥ samuvāca namo'nvitaḥ ।।75।।
utkaleśanṛpaścātra bhavantaṃ draṣṭumicchati ।
vijñāya sārvabhaumaṃ ca devaṃ bhavantamāgatam ।।76 ।।
sopāyano nadītīre pratīkṣate nideśanam ।
śrutvā tadvacanaṃ rājā''hvayāmāsoḍhabhūpatim ।।77।।
vaiṣṇavaiḥ sacivairyuktaṃ papraccha kuśalaṃ śubham ।
oḍhrapatirnanāmainamupadāḥ purato nyadhāt ।।78।।
parasparaṃ sukuśalaṃ svāgataṃ cakratustataḥ ।
praśaṃśaturvaiṣṇavau yajjanmasāphalyamityapi ।।79।।
athoḍhrarājastaṃ prāha dakṣiṇā'bdhitaṭe hariḥ ।
nīlādrau kānane cāste lokasañcāravarjite ।।1.585.80 ।।
dvitīye'hni vātyayā vālukāchannaḥ sa parvataḥ ।
channaśca rauhiṇakuṇḍaśchannaśca nīlamādhavaḥ ।।8 1 ।।
chinnabhinnāni jātāni śabarāṇāṃ gṛhāṇyapi ।
kopo'yaṃ cintanādūrdhvaṃ jāto'parādhataḥ kvacit ।।82।।
mama rājyaṃ bhavato'sti yathājñāṃ prakaromyaham ।
svāgataṃ bhojanādyaṃ ca preṣayāmi janādibhiḥ ।।83।।
ityuktvā cāśiṣo labdhvoḍhrapatirmaunamāsthitaḥ ।
indradyumno nāradaṃ ca prāhā''gamastu niṣphalaḥ ।।84।।
nīvyādhavadevasya darśanaṃ naiva ced yadi ।
kariṣye'naśanaṃ tvatra mariṣye mokṣaṇaṃ prati ।।85।।
nāradastaṃ tadā prāha vaiṣṇavecchāṃ na niṣphalām ।
karoti bhagavāṃstaṃ tvaṃ prekṣase pārthivaṃ prabhum ।।86।।
dhairyamāvaha bhagavān svatantro'stīti viddhi bhoḥ ।
kevalo bhaktivaśago bhaktyā te vaśameṣyati ।।87।।
vaiṣṇavastvaṃ padmayoneḥ pañcamaḥ puruṣo'si vai ।
pitāmaho'pyatra kārye bhavato māṃ niyuktavān ।।88।।
sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi nīlaparvatasannidhau ।
śrutvā rājā prahṛṣṭaśca mene bhāgyaṃ pravardhitam ।।89।।
yanmāṃ pitāmahaścāpi sahāyaṃ pradadāti vai ।
atha sarvān nīlaśailaṃ gantuṃ tvājñāṃ cakāra ha ।।1.585.90।।
oḍhradeśādhipo yāne niṣasāda ca bhūbhṛtā ।
saha sarve vyomamārgairmahānadīṃ vihāya ca ।। 91 ।।
ekāmravanakaṃ kṣetraṃ prāpuḥ kṣaṇāntare tataḥ ।
gandhavahāṃ nadīṃ tyaktvā koṭiliṃgeśvaraṃ haram ।। 92।।
pūjāvāditranirghoṣānvitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa nāradam ।
papracchā''raṇyakaṃ vīkṣya manyamāno hi mādhavam ।। 93 ।।
nīlādriśikharāvāsaḥ prāptaḥ kiṃ parameśvaraḥ ।
muniḥ prāha sa nīlādrirvartate yojanatraye ।। 94।।
ayantu śaṃkarāvāsaḥ koṭiliṃgeśvarātmakaḥ ।
śaṃbhurbhītaḥ śaraṇaṃ śrīhareḥ purā'tra cāgataḥ ।। 95 ।।
pārvatīṃ saṃvivāhyeśo haimavāsaṃ cakāra saḥ ।
menakāṃ pārvatīṃ prāha bahukāle gate śubham ।। 96 ।।
patiste nirguṇaḥ putri! gṛhadvāravihīnakaḥ ।
kiyanmama gṛhe vāsaṃ kariṣyati vinā gṛham ।। 97। ।
vinā bhūṣā samṛddhiṃ ca śobhase naiva putrike ।
vada saudhaṃ tu nirmātuṃ pṛthak sthātuṃ svakālaye ।। 98 ।।
ityuktā śaṃkaraṃ prāha pārvatī namramānasā ।
bhagavaँściravāso vai śvaśurasya gṛhe'guṇaḥ ।। 99 ।।
parādhīnanivāsastu vivāsasadṛśastataḥ ।
kṣaudrīyasāmapi tadvanmahatāmapi dukhadaḥ ।। 1.585.100 ।।
