ityuktaḥ śaṃkarastūrṇaṃ kāśīṃ vāsāya nirmame ।
pūrvasāgaragāminyā gaṃgāyā uttare taṭe ।। 101 ।।
vārāṇasyāṃ pañcakrośamitāyāṃ ratnamaṇḍape ।
tayā reme paśupatirbahukālaṃ pure svake ।। 102 ।।
atha rājā divodāsaḥ sarvān devān hi kāśitaḥ ।
visarjayāmāsa rājyaṃ cakāra vaiṣṇaveṣu ca ।। 103 ।।
koṭiliṃgāni saṃsthāpya śaṃbhuḥ kailāsakaṃ yayau ।
rājāno bahavaḥ paścājjātā vārāṇasībhuvi ।। 1 04।।
kāśīrājetināmā'pi śaṃkaropāsako'bhavat ।
tapasā śaṃkarāllebhe varaṃ cā'saṃbhavaṃ purā ।। 105 ।।
jetā'si kaṃsahartāraṃ saṃgrāme tvamarindama ।
tavā'rthe'haṃ tadā yotsye viṣṇunā saha sarvathā ।। 106 ।।
śrīharistadvaraṃ jñātvā cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ raṇe ।
kāśīrājasūdanāya prāhiṇot tacca cakrakam ।। 1 07।।
kāśīrājaśiraśchitvā purīṃ dadāha sarvathā ।
tacchrutvā kupitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pāśupatāstrakaṃ harau ।। 108 ।।
mumoca niṣphalaṃ tacca cakāra bhagavān hariḥ ।
tadā bhayaṃ samāpannastuṣṭāva śaṃkaro harim ।। 109 ।।
aparādhaṃ kṣamasvā'dya te bhaktasya hare prabho ।
sṛṣṭo'haṃ tāmaso nātha trāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam ।। 1.585.110
tadā cakraṃ nivṛttaṃ śaṃkarāt kṛṣṇo babhūva tat ।
prasannavadanaḥ prāha lakṣmīyuto hasan hariḥ ।। 111 ।
kālenaitāvatā śaṃbho durbuddhiḥ kathamāgatā ।
hetornṛpatikīṭasya mayā yoddhumupasthitaḥ ।। 11 2।
tvāṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca me cakraṃ nāśayet krodhamantritam ।
dayāṃ karomi me bhakta yāhi śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 113 ।
yadi vāñcchasi rantuṃ vai ciraṃ satyā samaṃ tadā ।
daśayojanavistīrṇe tatra virajamaṇḍale ।। 1 14।।
citrotpalāṃ nadīmārabhya yāvaddakṣiṇodadhiḥ ।
śreṣṭho nīlācalastatra caturdhā'haṃ vyavasthitaḥ ।। 1 15।।
nīlamaṇipratimohaṃ taduttare vanaṃ mahat। ।
ekāmrakāhvayaṃ tatra nivāsaṃ nirbhayaṃ kuru ।। 1 16।।
me puruṣottamakṣetraṃ tvameva paripālaya ।
ityādiṣṭo yayau śaṃbhustatra vai vāsamācarat ।। 1 17।।
brahmaṇā sthāpitaḥ koṭiliṃgeśvaro'yamasti saḥ ।
śrutvā rājā vimānāccā'vātatāra haraṃ prati ।। 1 18।।
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā dadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ।
bindutīrthe tatra snātvā śrīśaṃ sampūjya tatra ca ।। 11 9।।
tasthau dadhyau ca taṃ śaṃbhuṃ śaṃbhuḥ sākṣāduvāca tam ।
indradyumna! mahābhāgavato na tvādṛśo bhuvi ।। 1.585.120 ।।
durghaṭā'pi ca te vāñcchā śīghraṃ pūrṇā bhaviṣyati ।
nārade punarādehaṃ yadādiṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ।। 121 ।।
tat kalpaya pratiṣṭhānaṃ vājimedhapuraḥsaram ।
antarhitaḥ khalvidānīṃ nīlaratnatanurhariḥ ।। 122 ।।
tatra śrīnarasiṃhasya kṣetraṃ kuru ca sannidhau ।
vājimedhasahasreṇa yajatāṃ bhūpatirdhruvam ।। 123 ।।
tadante kalpanyagrodhaṃ pradarśayā'sya bhūpateḥ ।
brahmarūpatarostasmāccatasraḥ pratimāḥ śubhāḥ ।। 1 24।।
ghaṭiṣyate viśvakarmā'jaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayiṣyati ।
brahmaṇo varadānācca prayāte'bdasahasrake ।।1 25 ।।
indradyumno hariṃ sākṣānmūrtau vilokayiṣyati ।
dāravīṃ tanumāsthāya sthitaṃ divyaṃ narāyaṇam ।। 126 ।।
bhaja nārada! rājā'sau bhajatāṃ svāminaṃ harim ।
ityuktvā'ntardadhe śaṃbhū rājā vināmago'bhavat ।। 1 27।।
yayau puraḥ kapoteśasthalīmāsedivānnṛpaḥ ।
senāniveśayogyāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā senāṃ nyaveśayat ।। 128।।
bilveśvarakapoteśau pūjayitvā ca nāradam ।। 1 29।।
papraccha tau kathaṃ jātau bilveśvarakapotakau ।
vada naḥ śrīpatiprāptikarīṃ kathāṃ suśāntidām ।। 1.585.130 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇāyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne indradyumnasya vidyāpativarṇitaśravaṇottaraṃ jagannāthaṃ prati gamane nirṇayaḥ, nāradāgamaḥ, prayāṇam, citrotpalātaṭe utkaleśābhigamaḥ, ekāmrakavane koṭiliṃgeśapūjanam, ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcāśītyadhika pañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 585 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 585 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 586
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 587 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
śṛṇu lakṣmi nāradastaṃ nṛpaṃ prāha kathāṃ śubhām ।
bilveśasya kapoteśvarasya te kathayāmyaham ।। 1 ।।
purā kuśasthalī sā''sīt tīkṣṇakuśaiḥ samāvṛtā ।
tatra taptvā tapaḥ śaṃbhuḥ pūjyaḥ syāmiti vāñcchayā ।। 2 ।।
'oṃ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇāya svāmine svāhā' ।
japan sa toṣayāmāsa hariṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 3 ।।
kapota iva sūkṣmo'bhūdaṣṭamūrtirapi dvijaḥ ।
kapoteśvaratāṃ yātastatra sampūjyatāṃ gataḥ ।। 4 ।।
tasya saṃpūjakā yānti śrīpatiṃ puruṣottamam ।
athaikadā dānavāstu bhakṣayanti janān bahūn ।। 5 ।।
pātālādvai samāgatya tatra śrīnīlamādhavaḥ ।
vivaraṃ pūrayāmāsa bilvaphalaṃ tadantare ।। 6 ।।
nikṣipya drumamakarot sthāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram ।
tena dānavarodhaśca jātastatra bileśvaraḥ ।। 7 ।।
śaṃkaraḥ samabhūttasyā'rcanād yāti paraṃ padam ।
atha rājā vimānena yayau śrīpuruṣottamam ।। 8 ।।
tadā'bhūd durnimittaṃ ca spando vāmā'kṣihastayoḥ ।
papraccha nāradaṃ rājā cāpaśakunakāraṇam ।। 9 ।।
nāradaḥ prāha tṛtīye sāyaṃ vālukayā''vṛtaḥ ।
nīlamādhavadevo'trā'dṛśyatāṃ ca gato bhuvi ।। 1.586.10 ।।
śrutvā rājā śokamagno babhūva tu kṣaṇottaram ।
prāha purohitaṃ yāhi matsutaṃ cābhiṣecaya ।। 1 1।।
mālaveṣu sadā'thā'tra nivatsyāmi yugāntaram ।
prāṇānna dhārayiṣyāmi na drakṣyāmi yadā harim ।। 1 2।।
āyuḥśeṣaṃ kariṣyāmi saphalaṃ kṣetramāsthitaḥ ।
iti dravantaṃ rājānaṃ nāradaḥ prāha dhairyataḥ ।। 1 3।।
harermāyā tādṛśī vai mā mohaṃ yāhi tatra vai ।
māmuvāca svayaṃ brahmā gacchendradyumnakaṃ prati ।। 14।।
jagannāthaḥ prayātyeṣaḥ na ca drakṣyati mādhavam ।
na śokastatra kartavyo vācya evaṃ sa bhūpatiḥ ।। 15।।
tatkṛte paramātmānaṃ prasādya puruṣottamam ।
śvetadvīpānnayiṣyāmi sahasrānte mahākratoḥ ।। 1 6।।
indradyumno'śvamedhānāṃ sahasreṇa yajan harim ।
tiṣṭhatu ca tadante sa drakṣyati dāravīṃ tanum ।। 17।।
so'vatāro hareḥ punastena khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ।
purā sma maṇimūrtistu caturdhā'vasthito hariḥ ।। 18।।
divyadāruvapurbhūyaścaturdhā'vatariṣyati ।
āyāhi rājan paśyāvo vālukādiśamaiśvarīm ।। 1 9।।
nīlādrau vartate devo nṛsiṃho vighnanāśakaḥ ।
paśyāmastaṃ mahograṃ sa vighnanāśaṃ kariṣyati ।।1.586.20।।
nīlamādhavaśailaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yāsyāva eva tām ।
kapoteśasthalīṃ tasyāṃ śālāṃ sahasravārṣikīm ।। 21।।
vinirmāyā'śvamedhena yaja śrīpuruṣottamam ।
nṛsiṃhapratimāṃ tatra yajñe pūjaya nityadā ।।22।।
vighnanāśo bhaved yena taveṣṭaṃ sa kariṣyati ।
ityuktaścendradyumnastāṃ diśa natvā yayau puraḥ ।।23।।
tadā nāradasaṃsargād viditvā tu gireḥ śiraḥ ।
divyasiṃhavapuścāste kṛṣṇāgurutaroradhaḥ ।।24।।
vyāttāsyo bhīmadaśanaḥ piṃgasaṭākulo hariḥ ।
hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣo dārayan nakharaiḥ prabhuḥ ।।25 ।।
aruṇābho lalajjihvaḥ śaṃkhacakradharo hariḥ। ।
kirīṭamukuṭāḍhyaśca sphāranetrabhayaṃkaraḥ ।।26 ।।
dṛṣṭvā rājā prajāḥ sarve ānarcustaṃ harīśvaram ।
tato yayurnīlamaṇimādhavasya sthalaṃ śubham ।।27।।
nyagrodhaṃ vipulāyāmaṃ śailasānnāhamucchritam ।
vālukābhiḥ pūritaṃ ca drumaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ।।28।।
tathā sthānaṃ yatra devaḥ svarṇasaikatasaṃvṛtaḥ ।
nārado darśayāmāsa naman smaran muhuḥ prabhum ।।29।।
vaṭamūlāt pratīcyāṃ hi nṛsiṃhasyottare nṛpa ।
atiṣṭhan mādhavo yatra caturmūrtidharaḥ prabhuḥ ।।1.586.3 0 ।।
anugrahītuṃ tvāmeva punaratrodbhaviṣyati ।
pure paureḥ sthāpitā'nyā mādhavasya pratikṛtiḥ ।।3 1 ।।
sāpi muktipradā cāste kā kathā brahmasthāpitā ।
āvirbhāvatirobhāvau prajāyete yuge yuge ।।32।।
anugrahārthaṃ bhaktānāṃ sthito'tra karuṇālayaḥ ।
iti sandarśitaṃ sthānamindradyumno nanāma tat। । । 33 ।।
tuṣṭāva parayā prītyā dhyātvā bhūgarbhasaṃsthitam ।
sarve'pyupāyā bhagavan bhavanti tava darśane ।। 34 ।।
tvayi dṛṣṭe prabhidyante vāsanākulakoṭayaḥ ।
tvameva śaraṇe dīnamanugṛhṇīṣva māṃ vibho ।। 35 । ।
carmakṛccakṣuṣā paśyāmīśa tvāṃ tatprayojanam ।
itibruvantaṃ cākāśavāṇī jagāda taṃ nṛpam ।। 36 ।।
mā cintāṃ vraja bhūpāla vrajiṣye tvaddṛśoḥ patham ।
paitāmahaṃ vacaḥ prāha nārado yatkuruṣva tat। ।। 37।।
athā''ha nāradastaṃ ca śraddadhānaṃ nṛpaṃ tadā ।
vyavasāye sukṛtīnāṃ devā yānti sahāyatām ।। 38 ।।
tad gaccha rājaṃstatraiva nīlakaṇṭhasya sannidhau ।
sthāpayāmi nṛsiṃhaṃ ca yāgaṃ kuru ca tatpuraḥ ।। 39 ।।
dakṣiṇe nīlakaṇṭhasya dhanuḥśatāntare drumaḥ ।
candanasya vartate'sya paścime bhūmikā śubhā । । 1.586.40 ।।
vājimedhasahasrasya kṣetraṃ divyaṃ bhaviṣyati ।
viśvakarmasutastatra prāsādaṃ ghaṭṭayiṣyati ।।4 1 ।।
gaccha tvamahamatraiva sthāsyāmi dinapañcakam ।
ārādhyainaṃ divyasiṃhaṃ sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamam । । 42 ।।
pratyarcāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prāṇendriyamanoyutam ।
nayiṣye tatra vai rājaँścandanadrumasannidhau ।। 43 ।।
sannidhāvasya yāgastu phalātiśayavān bhavet ।
ityukto nṛpatistatra yayau dhyāne muniḥ sthitaḥ ।। 44। ।
tāvanmanuṣyarūpeṇa putro vai devaśilpinaḥ ।
samāyayau tvaṣṭṛsuto viśvakarmā tu satvaram ।। 45 ।।
prāsādaṃ narasiṃhasya paścimānanamuttamam ।
caturthe divase śīghraṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra śobhanam ।। 46 ।।
tataḥ prabhāte vimale nāradaḥ suramaṇḍalaiḥ ।
devībhiḥ saha nṛtyaiśca vāditrairjayaghoṣaṇaiḥ ।। 47 । ।
suśobhitāṃ vimānasthāṃ maṇiratnādyalaṃkṛtām ।
mālāsugandhaliptāṃ ca tejaḥparidhiśobhitām । । 48 ।।
ramyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaprāṇāṃ devībhirabhivāritām ।
ādāya narasiṃhasya pratyarcāṃ pratyupasthitaḥ । । 49 ।।
rājādyāstaṃ praṇipatya sthāpayāmāsa mandire ।
dharāramābhyāṃ sahitāmindradyumno'tituṣṭuve ।। 1.586.50 ।।
hayamedhasahasrānte yathā tvāṃ carmacakṣuṣā ।
divyarūpaṃ prapaśyāmi tathā'nukrośaya prabho । । 51 ।।
yathā cejyasahasraṃ me nirvighnaṃ tatsamāpyate ।
yajñeśa tvatprasādānme tathā sānnidhyamastu te' ।। 52 ।।
iti stutvā virarāmā''rārtrikaṃ pracakāra saḥ ।
jyeṣṭhaśukladvādaśī yā svātīnakṣatrasaṃyutā । ।53 ।।
tasyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ kṣetre divyasiṃho maharṣiṇā ।
pūjayitvā vājimedhasahasraphalamāpnuyāt ।। 54।।
pañcāmṛtairvā kṣīreṇa nārīkelarasena vā ।
sapāyasairupacārairjapāpuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet ।।55।।
sarvopacāraiḥ santuṣya nṛsiṃhadhāma cāpnuyāt ।
vaiśākhasya caturdaśyāṃ śanerdine svātyṛkṣake ।। ।56 ।।
ādyāvatāro nṛhareḥ sandhyāyāṃ taṃ prapūjayet ।
atha yajñe samāyātāḥ surāḥ ṛṣayo vaiṣṇavāḥ । ।57 ।।
pitaro vedayajñādikuśalā bhūsurāstathā ।
trailokye ye ca rājānaḥ siddhā vidyādharādayaḥ ।। 58 ।।
kinnarā devagāndharvāścāraṇā vaiṣṇavāśca ye ।
samāyātā maṇḍapaśca yojanadvayabhūtale ।। 59 ।।
kṛtaśca vedikā krośe kuṇḍo madhye viśālakaḥ ।
kṛtaḥ krośadvaye viprā yajñīyāstatra saṃsthitāḥ ।।1.586.6 0 ।।
madhye nṛpāṇāṃ devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca śacīpatim ।
purodhasā samaṃ pūrvamarcayāmāsa ṛddhibhiḥ ।।6 1 ।।
tataḥ siddhān devamunīndevān rājñaśca vaiṣṇavān ।
viprādīn pūjayāmāsa prāha yāntu prasannatām ।। 62 ।।
mahendra! cānujānīhi prayakṣye yajñapūruṣam ।
hayamedhasahasreṇa yāvattatpūrṇatāṃ vrajet ।।6 3 ।।
tāvattvaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ sadomadhyagato vasa ।
nīlamādhavaprāptyarthaṃ yajāmi nendratā''ptaye ।। 64।।
punaḥ prakāśite kṛṣṇe śreyo vo'pi bhaviṣyati ।
śrutvā devāstadā prāhurvayaṃ sānumatāstava ।।65।।
sukhaṃ yajasva rājendra vaikuṇṭhaṃ bhaktavatsalam ।
vayaṃ tāvannararūpā bhajiṣyāmo'tra vai harim । ।66 ।।
atha yajñasamārambhe bhagavantamapūjayat ।
pitṝn viprān varayitvā sapatnīka upasthitaḥ ।।6 7।।
svastivācyaṃ dvijān śuddhān puṇyāhaṃ vṛddhikarma ca ।
nirvartya varayāmāsa ṛtvijaste'pi taṃ nṛpam ।। 68 ।।
sapatnīkaṃ dīkṣayitvā vedyāmāhavanīyakam ।
prajvalantaṃ praṇīyā'tha mumoca prokṣitaṃ hayam ।।6 9 ।।
tataḥ sa dīkṣito rājā vāgyato rauravīṃ tvacam ।
adhiṣṭhāya sadaḥsthaśca bhuktyarthaṃ sandideśa ha ।।1.586.7 0 ।।
sarvān sarvavidhānyeva bhojyāni samadāpayat ।
caturdaśasu lokeṣu yāni bhojyāni santi ca ।।71 ।।
yajñārhāṇi vicitrāṇi sātvikāni hyadāpayat ।
kāmagāvaḥ kalpavṛkṣāścintāmaṇayaḥ sarvaśaḥ ।।72।।
kalpalatāḥ siddhyaśca yatheṣṭaṃ racayanti tat ।
lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ sthitā tatra sarvasmṛddhisubhogadā ।।73।।
na nyūnaṃ cābhilaṣitaṃ tadyajñe cā'bhavattadā ।
caturdaśanivāsānāṃ vaibhavāḥ sadṛśāstadā ।।74।।
vairājānāṃ yathā tadvad āsan svāmipratāpataḥ ।
yatrakriyāstathā mantrā viṣayaśca kramāḥ svarāḥ ।।75।।
yathārthā eva tatrā''san na vai karmopaghātakam ।
evaṃ pravartate yajño viratau tu hareḥ kathāḥ ।।76 ।।
pravartante brahmavidyāḥ sadbhiḥ satībhirīḍitāḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ kathā prajāyate ।।77।।
agnimukhāḥ surāstṛptā nā'smarantā'marāvatīm ।
pātālavāsinaḥ sarve tṛptāstadbhojanaiḥ sadā ।।78।।
sarve cetanamūrtāśca tattadbhojanapānakaiḥ ।
yathā tṛptāḥ punargantuṃ gehaṃ necchāṃ vyadhurnijam ।।79।।
itthaṃ pravartito yajñaścendradyumnasya bhūbhṛtaḥ ।
trailokyatṛptidaḥ kṣetre hyapūrvaḥ puruṣottame । ।1.586.80।।
jagadīśaprasādāya pitāmahanideśataḥ ।
ekonaṃ kramaśaḥ saṃsthā avāpa pṛthivīpatiḥ ।।81।।
sahasraṃ hayamedhasya, nṛpatirdivyatāṃ vrajet, ।
somābhiṣekataḥ pūrvaṃ saptamī yā ca rātrikā ।।82।।
tasyāsturīyaprahare svapne rājā dadarśa ha ।
pratyakṣaṃ śvatadvīpaṃ ca kṣīrasāgaramadhyagam ।।83।।
tatra sanmaṇḍape divye varasiṃhāsanasthitam ।
dadṛśe śaṃkhacakrādidharaṃ śrīparameśvaram ।।84।।
meghavarṇaṃ vanamālādharaṃ lāvaṇyaśobhitam ।
saundaryaśrīniketaṃ ca sarvadivyavibhūṣaṇam ।।85।।
dakṣapārśve sthitaṃ śeṣamanantaṃ śvetavarṇakam ।
phaṇāsahasrakaiśchatrīkṛtā yena vitānikā ।।86।।
sakuṇḍalaṃ nīlavastraṃ halādiyukcaturbhujam ।
hārakeyūravalayamudrikābhiralaṃkṛtam ।।87।।
dakṣapārśvasthitāṃ bhadrāṃ lakṣmīṃ dadarśa vai tadā ।
varā'bhayā'bjahastāṃ ca kuṃkumābhāṃ sulocanām ।।88।।
trailokyayuvatīvṛndadṛṣṭāntādbhutavigrahām ।
padmāsanāṃ lāvaṇyādiguṇāḍhyāṃ suvibhūṣitām ।।89।।
pitāmahaṃ ca dadṛśe purato'sya kṛtāñjalim ।
vāmapārśvasthitaṃ cakraṃ nānāmaṇivibhūṣitam ।।1.586.90।।
sanakādyairmunīndraiśca stūyamānaṃ vilokya saḥ ।
svapnād bahiḥ samāgatya namaścakāra vai muhuḥ ।।91 ।।
mene sahasraṃ saphalaṃ yajñānāṃ svakṛtārthatām ।
śaśaṃsa nāradasyā'gre yathā svapno'nvabhūyata ।।92।।
tatphalaṃ nāradaḥ prāha daśāhe haridarśanam ।
pratyakṣaṃ syāt tato yajñaṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru yathārthataḥ ।।93।।
tataḥ pravavṛte sutyā nṛpatervājimedhikā ।
dīyante sarvadānāni sutyā'bhūt kalpavallikā ।।94।।
tanmadhye'vabhṛthe snātuṃ kṛto yatra hrado mahān ।
dakṣiṇe taṭabhūdeśe bilveśvarasamīpataḥ ।।95।।
niyuktāḥ sevakāstatra dṛṣṭvā vaṭaṃ sasaṃbhramāḥ ।
nyavedayanta nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭo vṛkṣastaṭe mahān ।।96।।
sāmudre ca jale mūlaṃ śākhāḥ snānagṛhā'bhigāḥ ।
śaṃkhacakrāṃkitaḥ so'sti sarvatra sūryasannibhaḥ ।।97।।
sugandho devabhūvṛkṣo vipṇurvyājena cāgataḥ ।
nāradaḥ prahasan prāha pūrṇāhutiḥ prajāyatām ।।98।।
svapne viṣṇustvayā dṛṣṭo dṛṣṭo vaṭastathā'nugaiḥ ।
samāpyā'vabhṛthaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvotsavaṃ taṭe tathā ।।99।।
mahāvedyāṃ sthāpayā'tra yajñeśaṃ tarurūpiṇam ।
vicāryetthaṃ yayatuśca drumaṃ bhūpatināradau ।। 1.586.100 ।।
dṛṣṭvā vṛkṣaṃ catuḥśākhaṃ caturbhujaṃ jalād bahiḥ ।
ākarṣayitvā manujaiḥ pūjayāmāsatuśca tau ।। 101 ।।
gītavāditranirghoṣairvedamantrādibhiḥ saha ।
sraggandhā'laṃkṛtaṃ vṛkṣaṃ mahāvedīṃ vininyatuḥ ।। 1 02।।
sahasrairupacāraiśca vedyāṃ pupūja bhūpatiḥ ।
kena mūrtiḥ kathaṃ kāryetyuvāca nāradaṃ nṛpaḥ ।। 1 03।।
tāvadākāśavāṇī cā'bhavattatra śubhāvahā ।
pracchādyatāṃ mahāvedī taruyuktā śubhā'mbaraiḥ ।।1 04।।
pañcadaśadinānyeva svayaṃ mūtirbhaviṣyati ।
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tatra vṛddhavardhakirūpadhṛk ।। 1 05।।
upasthitaḥ sa vai vṛddhaḥ śastrapāṇiḥ kalānvitaḥ ।
enamantaḥpraviśyaiva dvāraṃ badhnantu yatnataḥ ।। 1 06।।
bahirvādyāni kurvantu yāvattu ghaṭanā bhavet ।
śruto hi ghaṭanāśabdo bādhiryā'ndhatvadāyakaḥ ।।1 07।।
santānanāśakaścāpi rāṣṭrasya nāśako'pi ca ।
nā'ntaḥpraveśanaṃ kuryānna paśyecca kadācana ।। 1 08।।
niyuktadanyaḥ paśyecced rājño rāṣṭrasya caiva ha ।
draṣṭuścāpi mahābhītirandhatā cakṣuṣordvayoḥ ।। 1 09।।
tasmānnā'vekṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ yāvatpratimanirmitiḥ ।
nirvyūḍhastu svayaṃ devaḥ kṛtyānte saṃvadiṣyati ।। 1.586.11 0।।
varddhakirghaṭayiṣyāmītyuktvā cāntardadhe tadā ।
vedyāṃ nārāyaṇaḥ kāṣṭhe vastrā'dho na vyadṛśyata ।। 111 ।।
vedīṃ rājā bandhanaiśca rakṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ।
yaduvāca girāṃ devī tadvatparicacāra ha ।। 1 12।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bilveśakapoteśakathā, rājño'paśakunāni, divyanṛsiṃhādidarśanam, kapoteśasthalyāṃ yajñamaṇḍapādikaraṇam, avabhṛthā'nte vyomavāṇyā kathitavaṭavṛkṣasya vedyāmācchādanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 586 ।।


← adhyāyaḥ 586 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 587
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 588 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca--
tato lakṣmi! yathājātaṃ śṛṇu mūrtipraghaṭṭanam ।
evaṃ dine dine yāte divyagandho'nubhūyate ।। 1 ।।
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ vṛṣṭiryā martyadurlabhā ।
divyasaṃgītanādāśca gītikā rucirāstathā ।। 2 ।।
śvetavāribindavaśca candanānāṃ ca bindavaḥ ।
airāvatādivāraṇendrāṇāṃ madā babhūvire ।। 3 ।।
adṛśyadevatāsaṃghaiḥ pūjyate vyomamārgataḥ ।
upāsāṃcakrire devā divyacihnāni jajñire ।। 4 ।।
prāpte pañcadaśāhe ca svayaṃ pūrṇo babhūva ha ।
divyasiṃhāsanasaṃstho vedikāyāṃ vyadṛśyata ।। 5 ।।
caturmūtirjagannātho balo bhadrā sudarśanam ।
sarvābharaṇaśobhādisampūrṇaṃ vai catuṣṭayam ।। 6 ।।
bhadrā ceyaṃ svayaṃ lakṣmīḥ sarvacaitanyarūpiṇī ।
tvamāsīḥ me priye bhedastava kvacinna yujyate ।। 7 ।।
kṣaṇaṃ na sahase tvaṃ māṃ moktuṃ līlāvatāriṇam ।
evaṃ tu mūrtayastena catasro vai prakāśitāḥ ।। 8 ।।
vyomavāṇyabhavattatra rājan raṃge prakāraya ।
nīlaṃ viṣṇuṃ, balaṃ śvetaṃ, raktaṃ cakraṃ, pracitraya ।। 9 ।।
bhadrāmaruṇāṃ ca nānālaṃkāraśobhitāṃ tathā ।
vinā vai citrakāraṃ tu nānyaḥ kaścid vilokayet ।। 1.587.1 0।।
gopanīyā prayatnena paṭaniryāsavalkalaiḥ ।
varṣe varṣe'pi saṃskāryāḥ pūrvasaṃskāramocanāt ।। 11 ।।
valkalalepasahitā mūrtirdivyā cirantanī ।
valkalalepanāśe tu durbhikṣaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā ।। 1 2।।
santateśca kṣayaḥ syādvai nekṣyāstā apavāraṇāḥ ।
pramādānmānavaiścāpi dṛṣṭāḥ syurbhayahetavaḥ ।। 1 3।।
tasmāt sacitrā draṣṭavyā bahuśṛṃgāracitritāḥ ।
nīlādrau kalpavṛkṣasya vāyavyāṃ śatahastataḥ ।। 14।।
uttare ca nṛsiṃhasya sahasrakaramucchrayam ।
prāsādaṃ śikharāḍhyaṃ ca sudivyaṃ sudṛḍhāyatam ।। 15।।
kārayitvā pratiṣṭhāpya tatraitā viniveśaya ।
nīlamādhavasevākṛcchabaro vaiṣṇavottamaḥ ।। 16।।
viśvāvasuḥ purā mitraṃ purohitasya te'bhavat ।
śabarasya tathā tvapurohitasya ca santatiḥ ।। 17।।
niyujyatāṃ ca pūjāyāṃ sadā sarvotsavādiṣu ।
itiśrutvā vyomavācaṃ bhūpastvāvṛtivastrakam ।। 18।।
kṣaṇaṃ cottārya mūrtīstāḥ pūrṇā dadarśa śobhanāḥ ।
ratnasiṃhāsasthāśca tejovyāptāḥ suvartulāḥ ।। 1 9।।
kṛṣṇaṃ padmasthitaṃ nīlaṃ pārśve ca dhavalaṃ balam ।
phaṇāmaṇḍalavistīrṇaṃ madhye bhadrāṃ tayoḥ śubhām ।।1.587.20।।
viṣṇorvāmasthitāṃ kṛṣṇahaste sudarśanaṃ tathā ।
kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭāstathā sarvaiḥ punarvastreṇa cāvṛtāḥ ।।21 ।।
sarve nemustataścitraśilpī raṃgādi cākarot ।
tataśca vedavidhinā pūjāṃ sūktairakārayat। ।।22।।
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena kṛṣṇaṃ rājā hyapūjayat ।
lakṣmīsūktena ca bhadrāṃ dvādaśārṇena vai balam ।।23।।
sudarśanaṃ saudarśanyāṃ tato dānānyadāpayat ।
aśvamedhā'ṅgabhūtāśca koṭiśo gā dadau dhanam ।।24।।
tāsāṃ khuroddhṛteryogād garto'bhūtpāvanaḥ paraḥ ।
dānā'mbunāpi saṃsṛṣṭastīrthaṃ cendrasaro hi tat ।।25।।
babhūva tārakaṃ pitruddhārakaṃ jaladānataḥ ।
snānātsvargapradaṃ pānādvaikuṇṭhadhāmadaṃ tathā ।।26।।
dānātsmṛddhipradaṃ vāsānmokṣadaṃ maraṇādapi ।
tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ khyātaṃ sara indradyutikṛtam ।।27।।
tataḥ prāsādaghaṭanāmupacakrāma bhūpatiḥ ।
pūrṇe tu mandire jāte sauvarṇakalaśānvite ।।28।।
śubhe kāle muhūrte ca viprān prapūjya devatāḥ ।
svastivācaṃ ca karmarddhiṃ vācayitvā nṛpastataḥ ।।29।।
arghyaṃ dadau jagannātha saudhasthityai ciraṃ kṣitim ।
samprārthya śilpino'bhyarcya vāstuyāgaṃ vidhāya ca ।।1.587.30 ।।
kṛtvā mahotsavaṃ pūjāṃ dadau dānāni bhojanam ।
rājā sabhāyāmagadad yanmayopārjitaṃ dhanam ।।3 1 ।।
jagannāthālayārthaṃ tatsarvaṃ dadāmi muktaye ।
kalevaramidaṃ kṣetraṃ yatrā'haṃbhāvavān vibhuḥ ।।32।।
tatsevayā ca rājyarddhiḥ saphalā me'stu tatpade ।
eṣa dāruvapurviṣṇuḥ sukhado dhāmabāndhavaḥ ।।33।।
atha mūrteḥ pṛṣṭhadeśādāgatyā'cyutanāmakaḥ ।
vipro jagāda rahasi tejomaṇḍalaśobhitaḥ ।।34।।
paradhāmā'kṣaradhāmā'mṛtadhāmā'vyākṛtam ।
goloṃka cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ kṣīrodaṃ śvetadvīpakam ।।35।।
badarīṃ cānyadhāmāni yadi gantuṃ samiṣyate ।
atra stheyaṃ tadā kṣetre divye śrīpuruṣottame ।।36।।
parabrahmā'kṣarabrahmamuktabrahmā'vatārakān ।
vyūhān divyān vibhavāँśca tadaṃśān draṣṭumiṣyate ।।37।।
puruṣottamamūrteśca kartavyaṃ darśanaṃ tu taiḥ ।
īśalokān satyalokān vairājān svargasaṃjñakān ।।38।।
mānuṣān divyapātālān yadi bhoktuṃ samiṣyate ।
dānaṃ snānaṃ pūjanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tvasya tairiha ।।39।।
aiśvaryāṇi samagrāṇi vidyāśca sakalāḥ kalāḥ ।
gugān sāmarthyasattādi yadi prāptuṃ samiṣyate ।।1.587.40।।
tadā'yaṃ śrījagannāthaḥ sevyatāṃ yāvadarpaṇaiḥ ।
idaṃ dārumayaṃ brahma bhuktimuktipradāyakam ।।41 ।।
saccidānandakaivalyamuktidaṃ darśanādapi ।
nāṇvapyatra prabhedo'sti dhāmni śrīpuruṣottame ।।42।।।
tasmād rājannatra vāsaṃ kuru mokṣaṃ prasādhaya ।
vidvattamo'si bhaktaśca sāṃgopāṃgamamuṃ bhaja ।।43।।
patrapuṣpajalakandakaṇavastrasucandanam ।
jalamaṇvapyarpitaṃ syādabjaguṇa jagatprabhau ।।44।।
lakṣmīrmātā ṛddhidā sā bhogān dāsyati bhaktake ।
dātre dāsyāmi sarvaṃ me nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ।।45।।
ityuktvā'dṛśyatāṃ yāto vipro mūrtau harestataḥ ।
sarveṣāṃ samabhūd divyamāścaryaṃ gocaro hariḥ ।।46।।
ātmanā vartate mūrtau premṇā'śrūṇi hyavāsṛjan ।
nāradaḥ sthiratāṃ yāto dhyānamudrāmanaimiṣīm ।।47।।
kurvan samādhiprajaḍaḥ premamagno'bhavat kṣaṇam ।
ānandaḥ prāsarattatra goloke iva tatkṣaṇam ।।48।।
kāryaṃ pūrṇaṃ tvadya jātaṃ proktvā nārada āha tam ।
enamārādhya tiṣṭhā'tra bhūpa yāmi pitāmaham ।।49।।
prāsādaṃ kuru bhūpāla dhanena mahatā tataḥ ।
nṛsiṃhaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpya vimucyase sukhī bhava ।।1.587.50।।
kṛtaṃ nivedayiṣyāmi brahmāṇaṃ tava dāsatām ।
indradyumnaśca taṃ prāha nivasā'tra mayā saha ।।51 ।।
mandiraṃ kārayitvā ca yāsyāvo nau pitāmaham ।
āvāṃ vijñapayiṣyāvaḥ saḥ samāgatya vai svayam ।।52।।।
mahotsavaṃ bhagavataḥ prāsāde'tra kariṣyati ।
omityaṅgīcakāraiva nāradaścā'tha bhūpatiḥ ।।53।।
yiyāsustvaritaṃ karma mandirasyā'nvacālayat ।
sahasraśastataḥ śilpivaryāṃstatra nyayojayat ।
vittavyayastu koṭīnāṃ na saṃkhyātuṃ praśakyate ।।54।।।
nṛpateḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā sattvabhāvena śrīrapi ।
prasannā mandiraṃ kartuṃ tadā sāhāyyamācarat ।।55।।
garbhapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhivat kṛtvā dhṛtvā ca tāmrajām ।
vajrapātādivighnaghnāṃ nyasya pārśve supaṭṭikām ।।56।।
śikharasya ghaṭṭanārthaṃ cājñāpyā'mātyakottamān ।
giriśṛṃgopamaṃ kartuṃ śikharaṃ gaganaṃgamam ।।57।।
rājā śṛṇvan devagāthāṃ prāsādaviṣayāṃ śubhām ।
bhūpaterdurlabhaṃ kiṃ syātsahāyo yasya nāradaḥ ।।58।।।
brahmā viṣṇustathā lakṣmīḥ kā cātra nimnatā bhavet ।
prāsādaḥ kāryate tādṛṅ na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ।।59।।
nedṛg vai vartate cordhvaṃgamaḥ pṛthvyāṃ sthalāntare ।
iti śṛṇvannanāmā'sau nāradaṃ cāha nāradaḥ ।।1.587.60।।
tīrthairmantrairjapairdānaiḥ kratubhirbhūridakṣiṇaiḥ ।
vratairadhyayanairbhūpa tapobhiśca yadarjitam ।।6 1 ।।
na śakyaṃ tava rājendra bhaktyā tatkaramāgatam ।
ataḥ paraṃ na śocasva bhaktiyoge'tirekiṇi ।।62।।
pitāmahaṃ draṣṭukāmo gantā cedantikaṃ vibhoḥ ।
upadekṣyati so'pyasya yātrāstāstā mahotsavāḥ ।।63।।
svayaṃ ca bhagavāneva tubhyaṃ varaṃ pradāsyati ।
pratiṣṭhāpite prāsāde tasmin kāle svayaṃbhuvā ।।64।।
ahamapyāgamiṣyāmi tadā saptarṣibhiḥ saha ।
tadāvāṃ tatra gacchāvo brahmalokamakalmaṣam ।।65।।
ityuktvā nārado bhūpo natvā kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ satīm ।
anujñāṃ prārthayāmāsa brahmalokagatiṃ prati ।।66।।
ubhau divyavimānena brahmāṇaṃ prati jagmatuḥ ।
nārado bhaktiyogena cendradyumno'pi vaiṣṇavaḥ ।।67।।
caturdaśabhuvanāni jigyatuḥ kṛpayā hareḥ ।
rājā'pyacintayad yāne brahmaloke kṣaṇaṃ ca yat ।।6 8 ।।
pṛthvyāṃ yugaśataṃ yāti prāsādasya tu kiṃ bhavet ।
punarāgamane me tu layaṃ yāsyati matkṛtam ।।69 ।।
kathaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ saṃvīkṣya gamiṣyāmi kṛtārthatām ।
iticintāparaṃ bhūpaṃ nāradaḥ prāha mā śucaḥ ।।1.587.7 0 ।।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svāmī kālasya dairghyakārakaḥ ।
hrasvatādhāyakaḥ so'pi kṣaṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kariṣyati ।।7 1 ।।
satyabhūlokayoḥ kāle tvadarthaṃ samatāṃ prabhuḥ ।
svecchayā saṃvidhāyaiva nijakāryaṃ kariṣyati ।।72 ।।
yasya kāryeṣu bhagavān sahāyo'sti caturmukhaḥ ।
tatra kālakṛtaṃ dravyakṛtaṃ vighnaṃ na jāyate ।।73 ।।
paśyā'grataścandrakoṭyāhlādakaṃ tejasāṃ cayam ।
vijānīhi brahmaṇaśca sadmanastaṃ samāgatam ।।74।।
paśya brahmapuraṃ tvetat sabhāṃ paśya suśobhanām ।
tataḥ paraṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ jalopari hi vartate ।।75 ।।
tataḥ paraṃ ca vairājaṃ dhāma tasmātpare'mṛtam ।
paravaikuṇṭhakaṃ cāpi golokaṃ cāpi tatparam ।।76 ।।
tatparaṃ cākṣaraṃ dhāma tatparaṃ paramaṃ padam ।
puruṣottamadhāmā'sti yatparaṃ nānyadasti vai ।। 77।।
indradyumnaṃ vadannitthaṃ nāradasya vimānakam ।
brahmasabhottaradvāraṃ samāsādya sthiraṃ hyabhūt ।। 78 ।।
nṛpaṃ ca nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma dvārapālakaḥ ।
brahmājñāṃ ca samāgṛhya prāveśayacca tau sabhām ।।79 ।।
brahmāṇaṃ praṇaman dūre sāvitrīśāradānvitam ।
rājā tasthau kṣaṇaṃ tāvad brahmā bhūpaṃ samāhvayat ।।1.587.8 0 ।।
ehi rājan svāgataṃ te sākṣāt tvaṃ bhagavatpriyaḥ ।
nāradasya tu yogena samāyāto'si durgame ।।8 1 ।।
gṛhāṇa cāmṛtaṃ bhojyaṃ piba svādvāmṛtaṃ rasam ।
vada kiṃ cāgamane te kāraṇaṃ hṛdayaṃgamam ।।82।।
ityukto nṛpatiḥ prāha prāsādaḥ kṛpayā tava ।
jāto'sti tatra cāgatya pratiṣṭhāpaya mādhavam ।।83 ।।
āgatya śrījagannāthaṃ sthāpayiṣyasi cet pitaḥ ।
tvadanugrahaḥ saphalo bhavenmayi pitāmaha ।।84।।
prasīda māṃ kuruṣvedaṃ jagannāthastvameva yat ।
itistutastadā brahmā prāha bhūpaṃ tu sādaram ।।85।।
rājan kṛtastvayā satyaṃ prāsādo bhagavatsthitau ।
nāsmin kāle tava rājyaṃ na vā tvatsantatirnṛpa ।।86।।
atrā''gatasya te kālaḥ pṛthvyāṃ bhūyān gato nṛpa ।
manvantarādhikaḥ kālo yugānāṃ śatakaṃ gatam ।।87।।
tava vaṃśo'pi vicchinnaḥ koṭiśaḥ kṣitipā gatāḥ ।
kintu rājan divyakṣetre nāmnā śrīpuruṣottame ।।88।।
kālasya hrāsaśaktiryā kālaśca saṃhṛtau mayā ।
śrīkṛṣṇasya nideśena yāvanmandirapūrṇatā ।।89।।
satyalokasamāstatra kṣaṇā deśāśca tatprajāḥ ।
kṛtā mayā''jñayā harestatra santi ta eva vai ।।1.587.90।।
śrīsvāminā mukuṭasya maṇirvyomni raviḥ kṛtaḥ ।
satyalokasamaṃ cāharnirmāti divyatāṃ nayan ।।9 1 ।।
tasmād gaccha mahārāja! tavā'nupadameva ha ।
āyāmyeva pratiṣṭhārthaṃ saṃbhārān kuru cocitān ।।92।।
pūrve parārdhe bho rājan kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
nīlā'śmavapurāsthāya na tatyāja janārdanaḥ ।।93 ।।
sāmprataṃ me dvitīyaṃ tu parārdhaṃ samupasthitam ।
dārumūrtirayaṃ devo madāyuḥ sthāsyate punaḥ ।।94।।
śvetadvīpasthakṛṣṇasya romāṇi kalpapādapāḥ ।
tanmadhyād vaṭavṛkṣastu dārumūrtyarthamāhṛtaḥ ।।95 ।।
svayamutpatitaḥ sindhoḥ salile satyapūruṣaḥ ।
ghorasaṃsāranāśārthaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ prayācitaḥ ।।96 ।।
anekabhaktabhaktyā ca dāruvarṣmā janārdanaḥ ।
śrutvaivaṃ brahmavacanaṃ praṇipatya pitāmaham ।।97।।
vimānena nāradenā''jagāmendradyutirbhuvam ।
mandiraṃ subhagaṃ divyaṃ pūrṇaṃ vīkṣya jaharṣa saḥ ।।98।।
nanāma daṇḍavadbhūmau śrīnṛsiṃhaṃ nanāma ca ।
śilpyādīn prāha bhūpaśca svayaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ ।।99।।
etatpratiṣṭhānavidhau suraiḥ sahā''gamiṣyati ।
tāvat padmanidhistatra brahmaprerita āgataḥ ।। 1.587.10 0।।
rājā satkārapūjādi cakre svāgatamācarat ।5
nāradaḥ sarvavastūnyālikhya sañcayapatrake ।। 101 ।।
pratiṣṭhārthaṃ dadau padmanidhaye so'pi satvaram ।
sampādanaṃ suvastūnāmakārayattathā śubhām ।। 1 02।।
śālāṃ svarṇamayīṃ tadvannagaraṃ naikayojanam ।
maṇḍapaṃ ca tathā kuṇḍaṃ kārayāmāsa satvaram ।। 103 ।।
kārayāmāsa ca rathatrayaṃ sauvarṇamuttamam ।
rathaṃ ṣoḍaśacakraṃ ca viṣṇorvai garuḍadhvajam ।। 1 04।।
padmadhvaje subhadrāyā varaṃ dvādaśacakrakam ।
balasya ca caturdaśacakrakaṃ darpaṇadhvajam ।। 105।।
athavā sīriṇaḥ kāryaḥ sīradhvajaḥ samuttamaḥ ।
sthito hastatale nityaṃ nirmalastasya darpaṇaḥ ।। 106 ।।
talasthatvādasau tālastena tālāṅkito balaḥ ।
hastaṣoḍaśavistāro rathaścakradharasya vai ।। 1 07।।
caturdaśa balasyāpi subhadrāyāstu dvādaśa ।
na vāsitavyo devo'sāvapratiṣṭhe rathe yataḥ ।। 1 08।।
prāsāde maṇḍape vāpi pure tanniṣphalaṃ bhavet ।
rājā rathapratiṣṭhāṃ ca kārayāmāsa satvaram ।। 1 09।।
rathasyeśānadigbhāge śālāṃ kṛtvā suśobhanām ।
tanmadhye maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā vedīṃ tatra ca nirmalām ।। 1.587.110 ।।
caturasrāṃ caturhastamitāṃ hastocchritā tathā ।
prakārayet pūrvarātrāvuttarataḥ śubhe kṣaṇe ।। 111 ।।
svasti pravācya cāṃkurārpaṇaṃ prakārayettataḥ ।
dvātriṃśaddevatābhyaśca baliṃ dadyād yathāvidhi ।। 11 2।।
prātarvedyāṃ maṇḍale svastike kuṃbhaṃ nidhāpayet ।
pañcapādapakvāthena puṇyatoyaiśca pallavaiḥ ।। 113 ।।
ratnagandhauṣadhigaṇaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ prapūrayet ।
pūjayed veṣṭayed vastrāmāvāhayecca taṃ harim ।। 1 14।।
taṃ pūjayecca vidhinā vāyavyāṃ samidhastathā ।
ājyaṃ caruṃ mantrayitvā'ṣṭasāhasraṃ hunet tataḥ ।। 11 5।।
sampātānprāpayet kuṃbhe rathaṃ śaṃgārayettataḥ ।
sugandhayed dhūpayecca dhvaje nyasya samīraṇam ।। 1 16।।
prapūjya garuḍaṃ prārthya rathamūrdhni niveśayet ।
taṃ kuṃbhaṃ secayet plāvayedrathaṃ garuḍopari ।। 1 17।।
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ datvā dakṣiṇāṃ bhūyasīṃ dadet ।
bhojayecca janān balarathaṃ prapūjayettataḥ ।। 118 ।।
dvādaśākṣaramantreṇa lakṣmīsūktena śrīratham ।
prārthayet kamalaṃ kṛṣṇanābhestvaṃ cāsanātmakam ।। 11 9।।
jātaṃ cā'si ca devānāmābodhārthaṃ sthiraṃ bhava ।
iti padmadhvaje cordhvaṃ samucchrayennamettataḥ ।। 1.587.120 ।।
rathe pratiṣṭhite caivaṃ devānāropya sarvaśaḥ ।
manuṣyaiśca naraiḥ strībhirgajāśvavṛvabhādibhiḥ ।। 121 ।।
netavyāste rathā grāme bhrāmayitvā surālayam ।
rathe sthitvā vipravaryairbalirdātavya uttamaḥ ।। 122।।
baliṃ gṛhṇantu bho devā ādityā vasavo grahāḥ ।
marutaścāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagādayaḥ ।। 1 23 ।।
asurā yātudhānāśca rathadevā vināyakāḥ ।
dikpālā lokapālāścarṣayaḥ kurvantu svasti ca ।। 1 24।।
avighnamācarantvete mā santu paripanthinaḥ ।
saumyā bhavantu tṛptāśca daityā bhūtagaṇādayaḥ ।। 1 25।।
tato vaidikasūktaiśca cālayet tān rathān śanaiḥ ।
tatrotpātān śṛṇu lakṣmi! hānidā ye bhavanti 3 ।। 1 16।।
īṣābhaṃge dvijabhayaṃ bhagne'kṣe kṣatriyakṣayaḥ ।
tulābhaṃge vaiśyanāśaḥ śamyā śūdrakṣayastathā ।। 117।।
dhurābhaṃge tvanāvṛṣṭiḥ pīṭhabhaṃge prajābhayam ।
cakrabhaṃge pararājyaṃ dhvajapāte'nyabhūpatiḥ ।। 1 28।।
mūrtibhaṃge maraṇaṃ ca paryaste deśaviplavaḥ ।
adhomukhe rathe jāte sarvajānapadakṣayaḥ ।। 129।।
evaṃ jāte balikarma śāntihomaṃ prakārayet ।
pūrvottare ca digbhāge rathasyā'gniṃ prakalpayet ।। 1.587.130 ।।
samidbhirghṛtamadhvājyamūlāgrābhiśca homayet ।
śāntivācaṃ svastivācaṃ bhagnāṃge havanaṃ caret ।। 131 ।।
svasti bhavatu bhaktebhyaḥ svasti puṃstrībhya ityapi ।
gopaśubhyaḥ svasti cāstu jagataḥ svasti cāstu vai ।। 1 32।।
śāntirastu śivaṃ cāstu sarvataḥ svasti cāstu naḥ ।
svāminātha jagannātha rakṣāṃ śāntiṃ karotu naḥ ।। 133 ।।
iti lakṣmi! kārayettu śāntigrahārcanādikam ।
rājñā tatkāritaṃ sarvaṃ nāradenarṣiṇā tadā ।। 1 34।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne catuḥpratimānāṃ sampūrṇatā, pūjanaṃ, mūrtyarthaṃ prāsādanirmāṇam, indradyumnanāradayorbrahmāṇaṃ prati gamanam, pratiṣṭhārthaṃ padmanidherāgamanam, rathānāṃ nirmāṇaṃ, pūjā, dhvajādiḥ, rathe vighnaphalam, śāntikarmādi ceti nirūpaṇanāmā saptāśītyadhikapañca-
śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।। 587 ।।

adhyāyaḥ 588
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 589 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi yadā cendradyumnaḥ satyaṃ jagāma ha ।
tadā khaṇḍeśarājā vai niyukto'bhūnnirīkṣaṇe ।। 1 ।।
gālo nāma mahīpālaścotkalelāprabhūpatiḥ ।
oḍhrarājaḥ sa vai proktastena mādhavamūrtikā ।। 2 ।।
sthāpitā svalpakālārthaṃ nityadarśanahetave ।
apasārya ca tāṃ mūrtiṃ siṃhāsanavarāṇi ca ।। 3 ।।
kārayāmāsa nṛpatiḥ prāsāde madhyame sthale ।
tāni saṃśobhayāmāsa rājā cendradyutistadā ।। 4 ।।
tāvadvyomni sandadṛśe vimānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ śubham ।
haṃsavāhyaṃ sāvitryādiśobhitaṃ tejasā'nvitam ।। 5 ।।
brahmā cā'vātatārā'smād gaṃgājalasamanvitaḥ ।
jayaśabdā harṣaśabdā namaḥśabdāstadā'bhavan ।। 6 ।।
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ dehināṃ darśanecchayā ।
sammardaśca mahānāsīdahaṃpūrvikayā tadā ।। 7 ।।
brahmāṇaṃ vardhayāmāsurlājākusumakā'kṣataiḥ ।
brahmā kṛṣṇarathaṃ gatvā nanāma ca dadarśa ca ।। 8 ।।
tato balarathaṃ paścād bhadrārathaṃ jagāma ca ।
nanāma ca pratuṣṭāva pupūja divyavastubhiḥ ।। 9 ।।
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya śeṣāya lakṣmyai cakrāya vai namaḥ ।
viṣṇurāmasubhadrāṇāmabhedāya namo namaḥ ।। 1.588.10 ।।
ajñānanāśakartre ca sudarśanātmane namaḥ ।
evaṃ praṇamya vivṛtya nāradādiṣṭapatsṛtiḥ ।। 11 ।।
nīlācalasthaprāsādaṃ vīkṣituṃ samupāgamat। ।
mandiraṃ maṇḍapaṃ vedīṃ śālāṃ dṛṣṭvā tutoṣa ha ।। 12।।
brahmāsane kānane ca hyupaviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ hyajaḥ ।
devā ṛṣayo viprāśca niṣedustatra maṇḍape ।। 13 ।।
ṛtvigādyā yathāsthānaṃ sthitā brahmājñayā tataḥ ।
bhāradvājaḥ samārebhe kartuṃ śāntikapauṣṭike ।। 14।।
trailokyavāsināṃ pūjā cakāra nṛpatistadā ।
kalevaraṃ bhagavataḥ prāsādaṃ ca manoharam ।। 1 5।।
pratiṣṭhāpya bharadvājaḥ samucchritamahādhvajam ।
vyajñāpayat pratiṣṭhāyai prāṇānāṃ tu pitāmaham ।। 16।।
kṛtasvastyayano brahmā ṛṣibhirbrāhmaṇāribhiḥ ।
saha gatvā rathān vādyaghoṣairjayaravaiḥ saha ।। 17।।
stutvā'vatārayāmāsuḥ rathāt sopānavartmanā ।
bhaktā bhāgavatā ninyuḥ śanaiḥ prāsādasannidhim ।। 18 ।।
tūlikāsu sthitāsvāsu puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūnmuhuḥ ।
jaya tvaṃ jagatāṃ nātha jaya kṛṣṇanarāyaṇa ।। 1 9।।
jaya saṃkarṣaṇa bhadre jaya saukhyaṃ vidhehi naḥ ।
ityuddhoṣaiḥ samāninyuḥ prāsādadvāri maṇḍape ।। 1.588.20 ।।
vāsayitvā'bhiṣekāya sammukhā''darśamaṇḍale ।
adhivāsitakuṃbhaiśca tīrthavāryupasaṃbhṛtaiḥ ।।2 1 ।।
sūktābhyāṃ śrīpuruṣayoścakārā'jo'bhiṣecanam ।
tato hyalaṃkṛtān devān gandhamālyopaśobhitān ।। 22।।
viprā stān saṃpracakruvaiṃ siṃhāsanagatān prabhūn ।
brahmā śalākayā netre tvaṃjayāmāsa nimnadṛk ।। 23 ।।
nyāsāँścakāra vidhivad divyaśṛṃgāraśobhitān ।
bhāvayāmāsa divyāṃstān mūrtisthān saṃpracetanān ।। 24।।
tato nīrājayitvā tān prārthayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ ।
sarvajagatpratiṣṭha tvaṃ mūrtāvatra sthiro bhava ।। 25।।
tvayi pratiṣṭhite devā vayaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitāḥ ।
divyamūrtimayo bhūtvā prāsāde'tra sthiro vasa ।।26।।
tvadājñayā pratiṣṭheyaṃ pūrṇā''stāṃ tvatprasādataḥ ।
ityuktvā hṛdayaṃ spṛṣṭvā jajāpa mantramācyutam ।। 27।।
bhogān nivedayāmāsa bhojayāmāsa dehinaḥ ।
dāpayāmāsa dānāni parihāraṃ cakāra saḥ ।।28।।
vaiśākhasyā'male pakṣe cāṣṭamyāṃ puṣyayogataḥ ।
kṛtā pratiṣṭhā ca gurau brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā ।। 29।।
taddine ca kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ japādikam ।
tapo vrataṃ pūjanaṃ ca sarvamakṣayatāṃ vrajet ।।1.588.3 0।।
taddine tatra gatvā ca kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ ca bhadrikām ।
sudarśanaṃ ca paśyanti muktāste mama dhāmagāḥ ।। 31 ।।
atha lakṣmi! dine tasmin kṛṣṇamūrtāvadṛśyata ।
sāyaṃ nṛsiṃho bhagavān sarvairadbhutadarśanaḥ ।।32।।
atha kṣaṇāntare matsyastathā'dṛśyata kacchapaḥ ।
vārāho'dṛśyata kṣaṇāntare haṃso'pyadṛśyata ।।33।।
hayagrīvo'dṛśyatā'pi kapilo'dṛśyatā'pi ca ।
hariścāpyadṛśyatā'pi vāsudevo'pyadṛśyata ।।34।।
pṛthuradṛśyata tatra dattātreyo'pyadṛśyata ।
ṛṣabho'dṛśyata paścād vāmano'thāpyadṛśyata ।।35।।
paraśurāmo'dṛśyata yajñanārāyaṇastataḥ ।
rāmādityo'dṛśyatātha kumārāḥ sanakādayaḥ ।।36।।
adṛśyanta nārado'dṛśyatā'pi rājarājakaḥ ।
vyāso buddhastataḥ svāmikṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ punaḥ ।।37।।
vairājo'dṛśyata tatra lakṣmīnārāyaṇo'pi ca ।
naranārāyaṇaścaite'dṛśyantā'pi kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ।।38।।
atyāścaryaṃ gatāḥ sarve jñātavantaśca vai tadā ।
avatārā hareḥ sarve puruṣottamasaṃbhavāḥ ।।39।।
asmādeva prajāyante bhaktānurūpadarśanāḥ ।
prajahṛṣurnṛpādyāśca dṛṣṭvā hariṃ hi tādṛśam ।।1.588.40।।
saṃśayā nāśamāpannā avatārā'vatāriṇoḥ ।
sarvarūpamayo mūlaṃ sākṣāt yat puruṣottamaḥ ।।41 ।।
ārādhyate yathā yena tathā tasya phalapradaḥ ।
yasya yāvāँstu viśvāsastasya siddhistu tāvatī ।।42।।
atha brahmā jagannāthaṃ prārthayāmāsa gadgadaḥ ।
bhagavan indradyumnasya sahasrāṇi tu janmanām ।।43।।
tava bhaktiṃ kurvato'tra vyatītāni purā purā ।
adya janmani bhakteśca phalaṃ prāptastavecchayā ।।44।।
bhaktiyogena rājā tvāṃ samarcayitumicchati ।
upadeśaṃ pradehyenaṃ vratotsavān samādiśa ।।85।।
ityarthito brahmaṇā''ha kāṣṭhamūrtirhasan hariḥ ।
indradyumna prasanno'smi tava bhaktyā'tibhāvayā ।।46।।
varaṃ dadāmi te bhūpa mayi bhaktiḥ sthirā'stu te ।
utsṛjya vittakoṭīstu yanmamā''yatanaṃ kṛtam ।।47।।
bhaṃge'pyetasya rājendra naitat tyakṣye kadācana ।
anena dāruvapuṣā sthāsyāmyatra parārdhakam ।।48।।
dvitīyaṃ padmayonestad yāvatparisamāpyate ।
atha nyagrodhottarasthakūpasya ye jalena mām ।। 49।।
rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ snāpayeyuste mallokamavāpnuyuḥ ।
snānasthitaṃ tu māṃ paśyet sa yāyāt paramaṃ padam ।।1.588.5 0।।
caturdaśyāṃ svarṇakuṃbhairuddhareyurdvijā jalam ।
jyeṣṭhyāṃ prātarmañcake māṃ rāmaṃ bhadrāṃ tu maṇḍape ।।51।।
aiśānīsthe sthāpayitvā snāpayitvā punarnayet ।
dakṣiṇābhimukhaṃ yāntaṃ saṃpaśyenmāṃ sa mucyate ।।52।।
tataḥ pañcadaśāhāni sthāpayitvā tu māṃ nṛpa ।
virūpamabhirūpaṃ vā na paśyettu kadācana ।।53।।
jyeṣṭhasnānamidaṃ datvā kṛtvā mucyai+eta bandhanāt ।
atha māghasya pañcamyāmaṣṭamyāṃ caitraśuklake ।।54।।
guṇḍicayātrāṃ kuryācca mokṣadā sukhadā hi sā ।
āṣāḍhasya dvitīyā puṣyarkṣayutā'pi mokṣadā ।।55।।
ṛkṣābhāve tithau yātrotsavaḥ kāryoḥ mama nṛpa ।
tasyāṃ rathe samāropya rāmaṃ māṃ bhadrikāṃ tathā ।।56 ।।
guṇḍicāmaṇḍapaṃ nāma yatrā'hamajanaṃ sthalam ।
aśvamedhasahasrasya vedī yatra tvayā kṛtā ।।57।।
tatra yātrā prakartavyā mama sthāne dharāgate ।
dināni nava yāsyāmi taḍāgaṃ cendradyumnakam ।।58।।
tataḥ paraṃ mama devālayaṃ yāsyāmi vai punaḥ ।
tadā draṣṭuḥ pratipadaṃ tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet। ।।59।।
mamotthānaṃ mama svāpaṃ matpārśvaparivartanam ।
mārgaprāvaraṇaṃ cāpi puṣyasnānamahotsavam ।।1.588.6 0।।
phālgunyāṃ krīḍanaṃ kuryād dolāyāṃ sumahotsavam ।
caitre sitatrayodaśyāṃ kuryāt karmaprapūraṇam ।।6 1 ।।
caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ damanairme prapūjanam ।
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīye lepayeccandanaiśca mām ।।62।।
ityutsavāḥ prakartavyāstvayendradyumna sarvadā ।
bhuktimuktipradā me te prasādasanmukhā yataḥ ।।63।।
brahman satyaṃ yāhi devāḥ svargaṃ yāntu nṛpo'tra ca ।
tiṣṭhatu cātra sthāsye'haṃ brahmāyuḥpūrṇimāvadhim ।।64।।
ityuktāḥ prayayuḥ sarve kṛṣṇo mūrtirbabhūva ha ।
brahmā satyaṃ yayau paścād rājā cakāra cotsavān ।।65।।
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi jyeṣṭhasnānaṃ śubhāvaham ।
jyeṣṭhaśukladaśamyāṃ ca vrataṃ saṃkalpya vāgyataḥ ।।66।।
ekādaśe prage yāyānmārkaṃḍeyā'vaṭaṃ tataḥ ।
ācamya śaṃkaraṃ natvā snātvā vṛṣaṇayorvṛṣam ।।67।।
spṛṣṭvā'ṅguṣṭhena liṃgaṃ ca muṣṭinā śaktimityapi ।
pūjayitvā tato yāyānnārāyaṇamanāmayam ।।68।।
nyagrodhaṃ praṇamet kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ namettataḥ ।
garuḍaṃ praṇameccātha praviśet kṛṣṇamandiram ।।69।।
taṃ triḥpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā'rcayet kuryācca darśanam ।
upadāḥ sampradāyaivograsenamanujñāpya ca ।।1.588.70 ।।
svargadvārasya mārgeṇa yāyāt snātuṃ samudrakam ।
ācamya prāṅmukho likhenmaṇḍalaṃ nyāsamācaret ।।71 ।।
prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā baghnīyātkavacaṃ dṛḍham ।
'pūrve māṃ pātu govindo vārijākṣastu dakṣiṇe ।।72।।
pradyumnaḥ paścime pātu hṛṣīkeśastathottare ।
āgneyyāṃ narasiṃhaśca nairṛtyāṃ madhusūdanaḥ ।।73 ।।
vāyavyāṃ śrīdharaḥ pātu aiśānyāṃ ca gadādharaḥ ।
ūrdhvaṃ trivikramaḥ pātu tvadho vārāharūpadhṛk ।।74।।
sarvatra pātu māṃ svāmī manaḥ kṛṣṇo narāyaṇaḥ ।
cittaṃ pātu garuḍastho buddhyahaṃ tu janārdanaḥ ।।75।।
indriyāṇi sadā pātu śrīmān patiḥ prabhāpatiḥ ।
iti varma dhārayitvā ṣoḍaśādyupacārakaiḥ ।।76 ।।
maṇḍale pūjayettatra śrīsvāmipuruṣottamam ।
antaḥśuddhyarthamācāmed bāhye darbhajalaṃ kṣipet ।।77।।
samudre ca triḥsnāyācca sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet ।
tilakaṃ bindukaṃ kuryād vastre dhṛtvā'rcayeddharim ।।78।।
maṇḍale śrīdharāyuktamāvāhayed bṛsīṃ dadet ।
pādyamarghyamācamanaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathā''plavam ।।79।।
vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhānulepanam ।
puṣpamālāṃ dhūpanaṃ ca dīpaṃ miṣṭānnapānakam ।।1.588.80 ।।
tāmbūlaṃ cārārtrikaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ stavanādikam ।
kṣamā'parādhanaṃ visarjanaṃ kuryāt kramārcanam ।।81 ।।
dhyānaṃ dānaṃ tapo jāpyaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca surapūjanam ।
sindhurāje kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ।।82।।
abdhiṃ ca mandiraṃ natvā yāyādindradyuteḥ saraḥ ।
narasiṃhamanuprārthya tatra snāyād yathāvidhi ।।83।।
paścimābhimukhaṃ tato yāyānnṛsiṃhamarcayet ।
samudre snapanaṃ kṛtvā prapaśyet puruṣottamam ।।84।।
evaṃ kuryāt pañcatīrthī dhruvaṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt ।
jyeṣṭhaśuklapūrṇimāyāṃ jyeṣṭhāgaśca śaśī guruḥ ।।85।।
tadā tīrthāni gacchanti kṣetraṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ।
jyeṣṭhapaṃcakasaṃjñaṃ ca vratamudyāpanaṃ caret ।।86।।
kṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ ca bhadrāṃ cakraṃ prapūjayet ।
nīlamādhavaṃ garuḍaṃ pūjayet puruṣottamam ।।87।।
svarṇakalaśe daśamīdine'rcayettu mādhavam ।
nārāyaṇaṃ tvekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ yajñasūkaram ।।88।।
trayodaśyāṃ ca pradyumnaṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu nṛharim ।
pūrṇimāyāṃ sarvadevān pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ।।89।।
nityaṃ vā pūrṇimāyāṃ vā naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ dadet। ।
miṣṭānnāni supeyāni phalādyāni samarpayet ।।1.588.90 ।।
homaṃ cāṣṭottaraśataṃ hunet sādhūn prabhojayet ।
gavāṃ dānāni kuryācca yatheṣṭaphalabhāgbhavet ।।91 ।।
evaṃ yātrādikaraṇānmokṣamavāpnuyād dhruvam ।
paṭhanācchravaṇāllakṣmi tadyātrāphalabhāg bhavet ।।92।।
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇa āgamanaṃ, jagannāthādiprāṇapratiṣṭhā, svamūrtau avatārāṇāṃ darśanam, utsavāḥ, rathayātrā, rathayātrāphalāni, pañcatīrthī, tadvidhirityādinirūpaṇanāmā'ṣṭāśītyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।588।।


← adhyāyaḥ 588 lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā - khaṇa़×Vr̤M×ḍaḥ 1 (kṛtayugasantānaḥ)
adhyāyaḥ 589
[[lekhakaḥ :|]] adhyāyaḥ 590 →

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
śṛṇu lakṣmi! mahāvedīmahotsavaṃ vadāmi te ।
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyātithau tu varayed dvijam ।। 1 ।।
takṣāṇaṃ vṛṇuyāccāpi vanayāgāya vai vanam ।
gatvā vṛkṣamadhyabhuvi vahnāvaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ।। 2 ।।
hutvā''jyaṃ vṛkṣamūle'pi baliṃ datvā ca kṣetrape ।
vṛkṣamūle dvijaḥ kiñcicchindyāt tatastu vardhakiḥ ।। 3 ।।
kāṣṭhānyādāya ca rathaṃ kuryād gaṇeśamarcayet ।
dvāviṃśatikarocchrāyaṃ caturdvāraṃ rathaṃ hareḥ ।। 4 ।।
ṣoḍaśacakrasaṃyuktaṃ garuḍadhvajaśobhitam ।
caturdaśāraṃ śeṣasya bhadrāyā dvādaśārakam ।। 5 ।।
evaṃ sāṃgān kārayitvā cākacakyāyecca tān ।
bṛṃhayet satpaṭaiḥ śṛṃgārayet sadratnakaiśca tān ।। 6 ।।
āṣāḍhaśukladvitīyoruṇodaye'rcayeddharim ।
tato yātrāṃ kārayecca guṇḍikāmaṇḍapaṃ prati ।। 7 ।।
rājyopacāraiḥ racayedutsavaṃ lakṣamānavaiḥ ।
nātaḥ parataraṃ viṣṇoryāntrātaramavekṣyate ।। 8 ।।
cāturmāsye sthāpayecca kārtike'nnāni cārpayet ।
viṣṇoḥ prasādaṃ bhuñjīta tatpāvitryaṃ śriyā kṛtam ।। 9 ।।
naivedyānnaṃ jagadbharturgāṃgaṃ vāri samaṃ dvayam ।
api kukkuracāṇḍālaspṛṣṭaṃ divyaṃ jalānnakam ।। 1.589.10 ।।
yātrā dvādaśa vai kāryā mokṣadā jagadīśituḥ ।
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīye rathanirmāṇayātrikā ।। 11 ।।
jyeṣṭhe yātrāṃ pañcatīrthī padbhyāṃ gatvā samācaret ।
jyeṣṭhe kāryā guṇḍikābhigatirvai rathayātrikā ।। 1 2।।
jyeṣṭhe prāsādābhigatisturyā dakṣiṇayātrikā ।
āṣāḍhe śayanīyātrā kartavyā māścatuṣṭayī ।। 13 ।।
bhādra pārśvaparivṛttiryātrā pūjanarūpiṇī ।
kumude bodhinīyātrā mahotsavasvarūpiṇī ।। 14।।
mārge prāvaraṇayātrā aurṇavastrādidhāraṇam ।
pauṣe puṣyasnānayātrā tapaḥsnānātmikā śubhā ।। 1 5।।
pauṣe sūryottarayānayātrā puṇyātmikā matā ।
māghe vasantayātrā ca pūjotsavātmikā matā ।। 16 ।।
phālgune puṣpadolāyā dolāyāḥ śrāvaṇe'thavā ।
evaṃ mahotsavāḥ kāryā mokṣadā jagadīśituḥ । । 17।।
jagannāthapure divye jātibhedo na vidyate ।
naranārīprabhedo'pi tatra kāryo na sarvathā ।। 18।।
sarve caturbhujā divyā dṛśyante tu dvihastakāḥ ।
vasanti sarve muktā me puṇyapuñjapradāyakāḥ ।। 1 9।।
sarvaṃ prāsādikaṃ me'sti divyaṃ doṣavihīnakam ।
golokaṃ cāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ mayā pṛthvyāṃ samāhitam ।। 1.589.20 ।।
nāryo lakṣmyo narā nārāyaṇā me jagadīśituḥ ।
kṛpayā ca pratāpenā'nugraheṇa matā mama ।। 21 ।।
bhojyā'nnapānavastrādi nā'śuddhaṃ tatra vidyate ।
ekādaśīmayā tatrā'nnāśane tu vaśīkṛtā ।। 22।।
matprasādānnabhojyairna dūṣaṇaṃ kintu bhūṣaṇam ।
sādhusevā gurusevā mama sevā'tra muktidā ।।23।।
mayā gopīvihārairdīyate śaśvaddhi darśanam ।
divyā krīḍā kāmarūpā saṃśayātmavināśinī ।।24।।
divyabhāvātmanāṃ mokṣānandasandohadāyinī ।
evaṃ svātmani vijñāya divyatāṃ yānti dehinaḥ ।। 25।।
ahaṃ gopīpatirvṛndāvane kuṃkumavāpike ।
puruṣottamabhūmau ca durgabhūmau prasiddhimān ।।26।।
yasmai yasmai prasannaḥ syāṃ nānyattasyā'vaśiṣyate ।
ānandadātā vai cāsmi yathā yairmatta iṣyate ।।27।।
lakṣmi! kṣetre mokṣade me sthāpanaṃ jagadīśvare ।
darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ dūrasmaraṇaṃ cāpi mokṣadam ।।28।।
tubhyaṃ mayā kathito'yaṃ kṛtasantānakhaṇḍakaḥ ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ prathamakottamaḥ ।।29।।
atrā''rambhe nāradasya vaikuṇṭhe dravatā harau ।
muktādīnāṃ dravamuktiḥ sākāratvaṃ pare'kṣare ।।1.589.3 0।।
golokasya pranirmāṇaṃ rādhārthaṃ kṛṣṇarūpataḥ ।
vaikuṇṭhasya ca nirmāṇaṃ lakṣmyarthaṃ cākṣareśituḥ ।।3 1 ।।
vāsudevātsamārabhya parameṣṭhyantasarjanam ।
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāmanekatvaṃ tataḥ param ।।32।।
avyākṛtasya ca badrikāśramasya ca divyatā ।
brahmaṇā vīkṣitā sṛṣṭirnārāyaṇatanau dhiyai ।।3 3 ।।
brahmaviṣṇvormahattve ca vivādaḥ kavacādikam ।
brahmatejomayaśaṃbhuliṃgāvirbhāvakīrtanam ।।34।।
liṅgāntavīkṣaṇe mṛṣāvādī brahmā ca ketakī ।
apūjyatāṃ sadā prāptau viṣṇośca pūjyateti ca ।।35।।
aṇvaṇḍānāṃ samutpattirāvaraṇeṣu vāsinaḥ ।
kṣaṇādikamahākālagaṇanā ca tataḥ param ।।36।।
brahmaṇā ca guṇā'jñānā'dharmādyā mānasāḥ kṛtāḥ ।
dharmarudrakṛtāntānāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ rudralayastathā ।।37।।
sāttvikarudrarudrāṇīdāsadāsīprasarjanam ।
sanakādiśāntasṛṣṭirvedaprākaṭyamityapi ।।38।।
māhātmyaṃ ca satāṃ divyagītādisṛṣṭirityapi ।
upaniṣatkanyakānāṃ sṛṣṭirvidyāprasarjanam ।।39।।
brahmapriyādigāyatrīsarasvatīprasarjanam ।
ekādaśījayantyādibhaktyārādhanasarjanam ।।1.589.40।।
mahālakṣmīramārādhāsatīgaṃgādisarjanam ।
sādhvīnāṃ divyanārīṇāṃ divyacihnaguṇādikam ।।41 ।।
nārāyaṇāvatārātmanaranārīpracihnakam ।
pativratāyā utpattiḥ sāmarthyaṃ ca tataḥ param ।।42।।
kuṃkumā'kṣatatāmbūlanārikelarasādikam ।
raktagairikadhātvādi yathotpannaṃ tathoditam ।।43।।
kāmadhenusamutpattiḥ kāmadevādisarjanam ।
patnīvratadvijotpattiḥ pitṛsevāmahattvakam ।।44।।
patnīvratasya māhātmyam ṛṇānubandhiputratā ।
garbhe niṣeke prābalyaṃ kāladeśādijaṃ tathā ।।45।।
niṣekasamayo rajodoṣāpaharaṇaṃ vratam ।
ādye dine brahmaṇastu brāhmaṇānāṃ prasarjanam ।।46 ।।
satyaloke mānasī carṣīṇāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ prakāśitā ।
maharjanatapaḥsveva pitṝṇāṃ sarjanaṃ tathā ।।47।।
pitṛbhyo deyamannādi havyavṛkṣādikaṃ tathā ।
sūryotpattirhiraṇyādi dhāma candrodbhavastathā ।।48।।
rohiṇyāṃ pakṣapātena candrasya kṣayarugṇatā ।
saurāṣṭre somanāthasya sthāpanāt kṣayahīnatā ।।49।।
devamānuṣabhūtādidaityadānavajaṃgamāḥ ।
yathā sṛṣṭā uditāste yugavarṣādisiddhayaḥ ।।1.589.5 0।।
siddhihrāso nagarādyauṣadhivarṇāśramādikam ।
viśvarūpasya hatyāyāścaturdhādānamityapi ।।5 1 ।।
dadhyañcāsthikṛtavajraṃ vṛtranāśo'śvamedhakaḥ ।
varāhasyā'vatāraśca pṛthoścā'vatarastathā ।।52।।
mithunīsṛṣṭisañcāraḥ svapnaṃ mṛtyupradaṃ tathā ।
cakravartipracihnāni hiṃsāpakṣiprapātanam ।।5 3 ।।
dvāparasya svabhāvāśca raivataṃ nāradāgamaḥ ।
tattvoddeśo vivaraśca bhuvo vivarapūraṇam ।।54।।
raivatasya candrabhāvo maṇyaṃśo raivataḥ svayam ।
khadvāṃgasya tapaścā'śvapaṭṭasarasi varṇitam ।।55।।
kuṃkumavāpikātīrthaṃ gopālakṛṣṇakodbhavaḥ ।
kambharāyā mahālakṣmyāḥ prādurbhāvaḥ samīritaḥ ।।56 ।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇajanma barhiṣāṃgadakodbhavaḥ ।
pannīvratarṣeśca gale mṛtasarpaprasañjanam ।।।57।।।
ṛṣeḥ putrasya śāpena kuhakadaṃśa ityapi ।
prāyopaveśanaṃ rājñaḥ kathāyāḥ sthāpanaṃ tathā ।।58।।
mūrtidhyānaṃ vratadāyāstaṭe dhanvantarergamaḥ ।
sarpasatre rakṣaṇaṃ ca sūryasyāpi vivāhanam ।।5 9 ।।
sūryapatnyāstu saṃjñāyā rūpadvayasya dhāraṇam ।
śrāddhadevayamayamījananaṃ ca tataḥ param ।।1.589.6 0।।
chāyāyāmaśvinīvaidyādyutpattiśca tataḥ param ।
yāmyamārgapurāṇāṃ varṇanaṃ nārakavarṇanam ।।6 1 ।।
nārakāṇāṃ phalaṃ karma janmacihnādikaṃ tathā ।
śārīradaivacihnāni śriyāścihnāni yoṣitām ।।62।।
śavaurdhvadaihikaṃ pretapīḍā tasyā nivāraṇam ।
pretatā pretabhojyādi sūtakaṃ piṇḍakārpaṇam ।।63 ।।
dānaphalaṃ piṇḍabrahmāṇḍaikyaṃ niṣekanirmitiḥ ।
mṛtānāṃ dānakāryādyairgatayo muktisādhanam ।।64।।
nārāyaṇabaliścāpi dhanvantareḥ kathā tathā ।
somajanma gurupatnyā apahṛtirbudhodbhavaḥ ।।65।।
dhanvantaritrayajanma divodāsakathānakam ।'
śaṃbhorvārāṇasītyāgo divodāse savighnatā ।।66 ।।
yoginyarkavidhātṛśrīgaṇeśasvapnavartanam ।
viṣṇornāstikyakaraṇaṃ rājñaḥ pratāpanāśanam ।।67।।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāḥ saptāhavācanam ।
viśveśvarapratiṣṭhā ca rājño bhaktivivardhanam ।।68।।
indrasadasi ca guroravamānaṃ durvāsasaḥ ।
mālāyā avamānaṃ ca śrīhrāso'bdhipramanthanam ।।69।।
ratnotpattiramṛtārthe daityānāṃ vañcanaṃ tathā ।
surāsuraraṇaḥ paścāt pārvatyai mantrayojanam ।।1.589.70।।

daridratābubhukṣākalahādīnāṃ nivāsanam ।

śabarīpampayoḥ rāmayogena mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।
citralekhācamatkārā mahīsāgarasaṃgame ।। 191 ।।
kalahāyā rākṣasītvaṃ tataśca mokṣaṇaṃ param ।
colarājaviṣṇudāsakathā kaikayījanma ca ।। 1 92।।
gokulakanyakāmokṣo gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇamelanam ।

kālindyā uddhavasyāpi cānyāsāṃ pativartanam ।
dānakanṛpateryātrā nārakāṇāṃ ca mokṣaṇam ।। 1 94।।
saṃhitāyāḥ kathāśrāvāt piśācatvavimokṣaṇam ।

patidveṣṭryāḥ śunītvaṃ corvaśītvaṃ ca tataḥ param ।

vidyādharasudarśasya vetālatvanivāraṇam ।

puṇyanidheḥ sutā lakṣmīḥ nārāyaṇakṛpādikam ।
tapato dharmadevasya vardhinī sevikā'bhavat ।। 1 98।।
gāndharvīṇāṃ kuladevītvādikaṃ vipragotrakam ।
strīṇāṃ mokṣaḥ tulasyādivṛkṣāṇāṃ devatātmatā ।।1 99।।
suyajñarājasūye ca kṛtaghnānāṃ vivecanam ।
suyajñasya tatpatnyāśca golokagamanaṃ tathā ।।1.589.20 0 ।।
tārāyā haraṇaṃ candrarakṣaṇaṃ dharmabodhanam ।

sīmantīnyā jale magnaḥ svapatiścopajīvitaḥ ।

puṇyakena vratenāpi gaṇeśaputralābhanam ।

śāradāyāḥ kṛṣṇabhaktyā kṛṣṇapatipramelanam ।
śivā'cyutau cakraturvāravanitāpramokṣaṇam ।।204।।
bandulāyāḥ samuddhāro vindhyādrervardhanaṃ tathā ।

gaṇeśasyaikadantatvaṃ gṛhapatyasya rakṣaṇam ।

strīṇāṃ pavitratā śreṣṭhacihnānyapi bahūnyapi ।

vinatāyāśca dāsītvaṃ garuḍena vināśitam ।।209।।
līlāvatyāstathā mokṣo dhūtapāpā pativratā ।
dharmadevaṃ patiṃ prāptā kalāvatyāścamatkṛtiḥ ।।1.589.21 0।।
gāndharvī kṛṣṇayogena golokadhāmagā'bhavat ।

surasā nāminī kṛṣṇabhaktyā saubhāgyamāgatā ।

abhijinnṛpateḥ putraprāptirgolokamokṣaṇam ।

ambarīṣādbhayaṃ tasya vāraṇaṃ bhaktasevanam ।

kāśyāṃ vyāsacamatkāraḥ pārvatīmahimā tathā ।

avantyāṃ lakṣmaṇasyā'pi manomālinyamityapi ।

puruhūtāmokṣaṇaṃ ca ṛṣyaśṛṃgavighātanam ।

mādhavyāḥ kṛṣṇapatnītvaṃ śāṇḍilyāśca camatkṛtiḥ ।। 221 ।।
ambāvṛddhākanyayoḥ pādukāpūjanamityapi ।
jyeṣṭhe rājyābhiṣikte ca vṛṣṭyabhāvena cānale ।।222।।
viśvāmitrakṛtaścāmiṣahomo'gnistiro'bhavat ।

dānaṃ jagṛhurviprāśca vyomno nipetureva te ।

yājñavalkyacamatkāro vāstupuṃsaḥ kathānakam ।

tilottamānimittena śaṃbhoḥ pañcā''syatoditā ।।227।।

pañcapiṇḍikātmagaurīvrataṃ saubhāgyadaṃ śubham ।

śrīkṛṣṇasyā''gamastatra viśvāvasuśca rākṣasaḥ ।
aṣṭaṣaṣṭimātṛgaṇāgamaśca kuladevatāḥ ।।1.589.230।।
rājaputrīvipraputryormokṣaṇaṃ kṛṣṇayogataḥ ।

ṣaṇḍhotpattirhiṃgulājādīkṣayā mokṣaṇaṃ tathā ।। 232

indradyumnasya ca kathā lomaśāśrama ityapi ।।233.

brāhmīvidyā janmadivyaṃ lomaśasya purābhavaḥ ।।234।
kapilasya ca vijñānaṃ naikā'vatārarūpatā ।
vasośca dharmavyādhatvaṃ vaiśālaraibhyamokṣaṇam ।। 235।.
āvaṭyasya camatkāraḥ svapnādiphalavarṇanam ।

jayantyāṃ mahimā proktaḥ sanatkumārakeṇa ca ।

mahātapābhihitaṃ ca vedāntajñānamityapi ।
kuṃkumavāpikāśraiṣṭhyaṃ pārvatyai śaṃbhunoditam ।।238।.
ūrjakṛṣṇajayantyāṃ kailāsavāsisamāgatiḥ ।
raivate somanāthe ca talaśyāme prabhāsake ।।239।.
uṣṇagrāme ca tīrthāni siṃhamuktistathoditā ।
nyaṃkumatyāṃ devikāyāṃ sūryatīrthāni rāṣṭrake ।। 1.589.240 ।।
cyavanā'gastivaiśālabhadrāśvatīrthakāni ca ।
guptaprayāgonnatādibhīmanāthādayastathā ।।241 ।।
dvārikā ca camatkārapuraṃ cārbudamityapi ।
agastyadivyatā maṃkaṇakatīrthādi cārbude ।।242।।

bilvāmrakāditīrthāni satyatapaso mokṣaṇam ।

samudrasya taraṃgāṇāṃ saṃkhyāḥ kartuṃ na śakyate ।

kathārthānāṃ vācanena smaraṇena śraveṇa ca ।

ahaṃ divyasvarūpo'smi kṛtasantānamūrtikaḥ ।।298।।

ślokaistu pañcapañcāśatsāhasraiḥ keśarūpibhiḥ ।।299। ।
mastakaṃ me hi boddhavyaḥ kaṇṭhordhvaṃ cāyameva hi ।
brahmarandhraṃ mama lakṣmi vidyate, tvayi cātra te ।।।1.589.3 00 ।।
saubhāgyapuṇyamūrdhā'sti sarvathā sarvamaṃgalaḥ ।
tvāṃ māṃ kṛtaṃ bhajeta yaḥ sarvārthānāpnuyāddhruvam ।।3 01 ।।
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mahāvedī (sthanirmāṇa) mahotsavaḥ, dvādaśayātrāḥ, kṛtasantānoktakathānirdeśāḥ, granthavaktṛpūjādimahimetinirūpaṇanāmaikonanavatyadhikapañcaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ।।589।।

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca-
ataḥ paraṃ mama vakṣo lakṣmi! tavaiva vakṣasi ।
vartamānaṃ divyaṃ tretāsantānakaṃ hi vidyate ।। 1 ।।
mayā śrīkṛṣṇarūpeṇa rādhāyai te kathāḥ śubhāḥ ।
goloke kathitāstāśca santi tretāpratānake ।। 2 ।।
purāyuge'vatāro me tvayā sākaṃ surāṣṭrake ।
ūrjakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrātryāṃ babhūva prathame dale ।। 3 ।.
saurāṣṭre tvāśvinakṛṣṇadalaṃ jānanti tat sadā ।
pūrvārdhakāle tatsarvaṃ vyavartata mama priye ।। 4 ।।
kṛtadevāḥ kṛtapālāḥ kṛtabhaktāḥ kṛtapriyāḥ ।
kṛtadharmāḥ kṛtātmānaḥ pāntu kṛtādhivāsinaḥ ।। 5 ।।
satyasatyaḥ satyadevyaḥ satyavratāḥ satīstriyaḥ ।
satyāntarātmavidhṛtāḥ pāntu satyasamarpitāḥ ।। 6 ।।
yaścā''sekṣaṇakaḥ svavidrutimanu drāvaṃ gataścātmavān ।
yuksaṃjñāmabhigṛhya lakṣmapadharo dvedhā'bhavannarāyaṇaḥ ।।
rālakṣmādhipatirgirāṃ manujanau kṛṣṇārabhṛd gāṃgataḥ ।
so'haṃ jyarthamavaimi bhaktisubhṛtaiste yantu maddvyarthakam ।। 7 ।।
pūrṇabrahmatadīyadivyatanavo nārāyaṇāḥ śrīḥ śriyaḥ ।
īśā īśanikāśca tattvavibhavo devarṣipitrāsurāḥ ।।
caityā'caityavibhūtayastaligaṇāstiryagbhavāḥ santvamī ।
kṛtsantānakṛte madarpaṇavidhau pṛthvyo mithaḥ śreyasām ।। 8 ।।
ye vai kāśyapagotrajāstaditare maddhastasaṃsparśagā,
ye vā maddhṛdayaṃgamā mama satāmāśīrvacobhūmayaḥ ।।
yā māmarpaṇayājikā nijaguṇaiḥ sampadya sarvātmanā ।
brāhmīṃ bhūmimitāstadīyakulajānmokṣaṃ nayāmyakṣare ।। 9 ।।
kecinmāṃ prayajanti yajñanikarairanye prasevādibhi-
rnityaṃ saṃsmaraṇaiḥ pare taditare sarvārpaṇaiḥ saṃyamaiḥ ।।
raktā māṃ ratimārgaṇairapi ruṣā ruṣṭā vṛṣasthā vṛṣai-
ste kānte mayi divyaśāśvatapade majjantu cānanditāḥ ।। 1.590.10।।
atha lakṣmi! kuru śāntiṃ kathayiṣye punaḥ kathāḥ ।
dharmārthakāmamokṣāḍhyāḥ satyottaramupasthitāḥ । 11 ।।
satye! satyavidhānajñe! satyavratadhare! sati! ।
satyasantānakaścātra tvayi satyāṃ samāpyate ।। 12।।
śvetavyāsaścādimo'haṃ vyāso vyāsāśraye harau ।
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitā''dyasantānamarpaye ।। 13 ।।
pratyakṣaḥ śrīhariḥ svāmisvarūpaḥ śreyase nṛṇām ।
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo nityapratyakṣo jayatīha vai ।। 14।।
dehendriyā'ntaḥkaraṇātmasu guṇeṣu karmasu ।
vyāpako mūrtirūpaḥ śrīharirjayatu sarvadā ।। 15।।
pañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇyapi pañcaśatānyapi ।
saptaviṃśatiścaślokā ādyakhaṇḍasya santi hi ।। 16।।

itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇasahitāyāṃ prathamaḥ kṛtasantānakhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ
śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyarpaṇamastu


yaḥ, īkṣaṇakaḥ āsa, svasya vidrutiṃ vivṛttirūpāṃ sṛṣṭim, anu drāvaṃ praveśaṃ gataḥ । ātmavān antaryāmī । yuk saṃjñām yugalasaṃjñām । abhigṛhya । lakṣmapadharaḥ-lakṣmīpatināmadhṛk । śrāyaṇaḥ-rādhāpatināmabhāk । rālakṣmādhipatiḥ - rādhāpatiḥ lakṣmīpatiḥ । giram manubhāve । kṛṣṇārabhṛt-kṛṣṇaḥ nārāyaṇaśceti । gāṃ vāṇīṃ gataḥ । sa evā'haṃ bhaktibhṛjjanaiḥ । jyartham-jaya jayeti prāpnomi । te bhaktāḥ । matto'pi dvyarthaṃ dviguṇaṃ jayaṃ yantu ।। 7 । ।

323. śrīpuruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmadevasya tatpatnīnāṃ tatputrāṇāṃ nirdeśastato brahmādikṛtamāsāntavratena prasannaśrīhariṇā sakuṭumbena brahmādibhyo darśanaṃ varadānaṃ ca dattamiti । 762
324. jālaṃdharavṛndākhyāne goloke kṛṣṇapatnyā vṛndāyāḥ rādhākṛṣṇaratyasahāyā golokādavataraṇaṃ kālanemiputrītvaṃ ca, vṛhaspatimahendrau śaṃkaradarśa- nārthamāgatau, rūpāntarasthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ 'kvā'sti śaṃkara' iti praśnottaram alabdhvā udyatavajrahastakendrastaṃ- bhanottaraṃ śaṃkaralalāṭanetrotthakrodhānalasajala- piṇḍasya samudre kṣepājjālaṃdharotpattiḥ, tena saha vṛndāyā vivāhaśca । 765
325. āṣāḍhapūrṇimāyāṃ śukrācāryapūjakā'surasaṃgheṣu rāhuṃ viśirasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkāraṇaṃ samudramathane'mṛtapāne pakṣapātādi vijñāya suraviṣṇuprabhṛtināśārthaṃ yuddhe suraparājaye vaikuṇṭhaviṣṇustavanādi । 768
326. yuddhe mṛtānāmujjīvanaṃ, jalaṃdharaviṣṇvoryuddhaṃ, prasannena viṣṇunā jalaṃdharagṛhevāsātmakavaradānam, devānāṃ duḥkham, śaṃkarāya nivedanam, nāradasya jalaṃdharagṛhe gamanam, surūpabhāryāyāḥ pārvatyā ānanāya jalaṃdharasya mohanam । 770
327. jalaṃdhareṇa rāhurdūtaḥ śaṃkaraṃ prati preṣitaḥ, kīrtimukhagaṇena sa vidrāvitaḥ, jalaṃdharasainyena kailāse ghorayuddham, kṛtyayā yonau śukrācāryo nikṣiptaḥ । 774
328. dvandvayuddhaṃ jalaṃdharavīrabhadrayuddhaṃ, jalaṃdharaśaṃkarayuddhaṃ, gāndharvī māyāmutpādya jalaṃdharo rudrarūpeṇa pārvatīṃ chalayituṃ jagāma । 777
329. vṛndāyā viṣṇupradarśitā'śubhasvapnam, sūryodayādāvapaśakunāni, viṣṇunā jālaṃdhararūpeṇa vṛndāyāṃ ratikaraṇam, vṛndāyāḥ citāpraveśaḥ, vṛndātmakatulasībhavanam । viṣṇoḥ duḥkhitvaśāpaḥ । 779
330. jālaṃdhareṇa māyayā kapaṭagaurīnāśadarśanam, māyayā yuddhaṃ, śaṃkaracakradvārā jālaṃdharanāśaḥ, vṛndāyā varaṇayāñcā kedāranāthaputrītvaṃ ca, viṣṇunā tulasīvivāhaḥ, vṛndāvane gaurīlakṣmīramāṃśā dhātrīmālatīvṛndāvṛkṣāḥ,lakṣmyā varbarītvamapi ca । 781
331. dhruvapautrakedāraputryā vṛndāyā vṛndāvane tapaścaryā, dharmakṛtaparīkṣā, dharmeṇa dharṣitā, mriyasveti śaśāpa, dharmojjīvanam, vṛndāyāstulasīrūpeṇa sthitiḥ । vṛndārūpeṇa vaikuṇṭhagatiśca । 784
332. goloke śrīkṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ ratinimittaparasparaśāpena dvedhā bhūtvā gaṃgāsarasvatīlakṣmīnāṃ saridrūpatā, lakṣmyāstulasīrūpatā । 787
333. lakṣmīrūpapadmāvatīnadyā yauvanavegena yuvatīrūpa- dharāyā gaṇeśaṃ prati yānaṃ, patyarthamabhyarthanam, gaṇeśakṛto 'vṛkṣarūpiṇī bhava daityapatnī bhave'tiśāpaḥ, tulasīmāhātmyam । 789
334. manuvaṃśīyavṛṣadhvajasya sūryaśāpaḥ, vaikuṇṭhe prārthanayā tadvaṃśe kuśadhvajaputrī sītākhyā lakṣmīrabhavat, dharmadhvajaputrī tulasyākhyā lakṣmīrabhavat । badaryāṃ tulasyāstapastatsiddhiśca ।
335. tulasyāḥ svapne śaṃkhacūḍātmakasya sudāmno darśa- nam, śaṃkhacūḍasya badaryāṃ gamanam, tulasīśaṃkha- cūḍayoḥ saṃvādo gāndharvavivāhaśca, śaṃkhacūḍapīḍitadevā vaikuṇṭhaṃ jagmuḥ, nārāyaṇena virajāsudāmarādhānāṃ parasparaṃ śāpakathanam, sudāmā śaṃkhacūḍo jātaḥ, śaṃkhacūḍanāśārthaṃ harāya triśūlapradānam । 794
336. triśūlayuktaḥ śaṃkaraḥ puṣpavantaṃ dūtaṃ śaṃkhacūḍaṃ prati preṣayāmāsa, śaṃkhacūḍatulasyorjñānaṃ, śaṃkhacūḍasya prātaryuddhārthaṃ śaṃkaraṃ prati yānam, kaśyapasya trayodaśapatnīnāṃ vaṃśe tvaṃ dānavaḥ śaṃkhacūḍa iti sudāmānaṃ smāritam । upadeśaḥ । 798
337. śaṃkaraṃ prati dānavavacanam, skandarāhutatsainyayoryuddham, mahākālyā astrādikṛtayuddhaṃ, viprarūpaviṣṇukṛtadānavakavacabhikṣā, śaṃkhacūḍarūpaviṣṇukṛtaṃ tulasyāṃ vīryādhānaṃ śaṃbhudvārā śaṃkhacūḍamaraṇaṃ, tulasyāḥ śālagrāmo bhava viṣṇośca gaṇḍakī tulasīvṛkṣikā ca bhaveti śāpau, yuddhe mṛtānāmujjīvanam, vṛndāvanā''gamanaṃ ca । 801
338. tulasīśālagrāmasvarūpamāhātmyapūjāstotrādi । 804
339. vṛndāvane yamunātaṭe dvādaśyāṃ viśrāmamaṇḍapādikaraṇaṃ, khāṇḍavavane viṣṇupitṛśibiraṃ, tulasīvane tulasīpitṛśibiraṃ, kuṇḍamaṇḍapādividhānaṃ, mahīmānā''gamaḥ, varavāhapakṣāṇāṃ janavāhavāhinyāgamaḥ, kārtikapūrṇimāyāṃ tulasīkanyādānaṃ, vivāhaḥ, tulasīvivāhakaraṇaśravaṇādiphalam । 807
340. gaṇḍakīśālagrāmanāmārthabodhakaprāgvṛttāntaḥ, sālaṃkāyanarṣikṛtatapaḥ, tatputrarūpaviṣṇuḥ, tasya tatraiva śilārūpeṇa sthitiḥ, revānadyāṃ liṃgarūpeṇa śaṃbhoḥ sthitiḥ, śālavṛkṣe tapasyato viṣṇorgaṇḍasthalāt pravāhasya gaṇḍakīsaṃjñā, sā tulasī nadīrūpā, gajendramokṣārthaṃ kṣiptacakrasya ghaṭṭanena pāṣāṇakīṭakṛtena ca cakracihnāni । 811
341. śālagrāmakṣetrasthāni sālaṃkāyanasomeśvaragaṇḍakībāṇagaṃgātriveṇīdevikābrahmaputrīgajagrāhatīrthajaleśvaradhārikatīrthahaṃsatīrthaśālatīrthacakrasvāmitīrtha-
viṣṇupadaśaṃkhaprabhagadākuṇḍā'gniprabhasarvāyudhadevaprabhavidyādharaikadhāradevahradatriśūlagaṃgāhariharakṣetrāditīrthāni । 813
342 rurukṣetraṛṣīkeśagoniṣkramaṇapañcapadabrahmapadakoṭivaṭa- viṣṇusaraḥstutasvāmivarāhakṣetrapañcārumabhṛgukuṇḍama-
ṇikuṇḍalohārgalapañcasaronāradavaśiṣṭhasaptarṣiśarabhaṃgāgnibṛhaspativaiśvānarakārtikeyomāmaheśvarabrahmakuṇḍāditīrthāni । 816
343. mathurākṣetramāhātmye bhagavadavatārāṇāmānantyaṃ, prathamadvāpare kṛṣṇāvatāraḥ, viśrāntitīrthaprayāgakanakhalatindukasūryadhruvatīrtharājarṣimokṣa koṭivāyuprāvatāratīrthādimahimā । 819
344. śivakuṇḍatīrthaṃ,saṃyamanatīrthe mṛtasya niṣādasya saurāṣṭrarājyaprāptiḥ, kāśīrājaputryā vivāhaḥ, tayorjātismarayormathurāyāṃ maraṇam, yamuneśvaramāhātmyam । 821
345. nāgatīrthaghaṇṭābharaṇakabrahmasomasarasvatīdaśāśvamedha-
tīrtharājavighnarājakoṭiśivakṣetrasudhanatīrthānāṃ sudhana- vaṇikpradattena mandire nṛtyāṃśasya phalena ca brahmarākṣasasya muktirityādi । 823
346. vatsakrīḍanakabhāṇḍīrakavṛndāvanahariviśrāmasūrya-
tīrthamalayārjunabahulabhāṇḍahradārkakuṇḍavimalakūpavīra- sthalakuśasthalagopīśvarasaptasāmudravasuphālgunakavṛṣa- bhāṃjanakatālavanasapīṭhakavimalodakakuṇḍānāṃ nirdeśaḥ, mathurāpradakṣiṇe vidhiḥ, tatratyatīrthānāṃ kramaḥ, viśrāntighaṭṭārambhaṇasamāptyādiḥ vanāni ca । 826
347. cakratīrthe kalāpagrāmavāstavyaviprasya brahmahatyāpā- takanāśākhyānaṃ muktiśca, vaikuṇṭhatīrthe mithilāyā viprasya brahmahatyāpātakanāśākhyānaṃ, kapilabhaga- vatā manasotpāditavārāhasya paramparayā mathurāyāṃ pratiṣṭhānam । 829
348. govardhanā'nnakūṭatadanyatīrthapradakṣiṇam, pretabhūtasya suśīlavaiśyasyoddharaṇam।vārāhabhagavatā vimaternṛpasya nāro'sikuṇḍaṃ vārāhakṣetraṃ ca । 832 349. ujjayinīpurīvāsibhraṣṭācāraviprasya rākṣasatvamupa- gatasya viśrāntisnānaikaphaladānānmuktiḥ, śaṃbhukṛta- kṣetrasaṃrakṣaṇam, garuḍasya māthurarūpakṛṣṇā'paricaye stavanena divyadarśanaṃ, pannīvrataviprātmakakṛṣṇa- nārāyaṇakṛtaḥ viśrāntijalaprokṣaṇena ḍākinī- śākinīśatottaramokṣaḥ । 834
350. saurāṣṭradeśīyasubhadranāmakaviprasya mathurāyāṃ- gokarṇeśvaradarśanādinā putraprāptiḥ, tannāma gokarṇa iti tena śatruṃjitānadītaṭe gokarṇeśvaraḥ sthāpitaḥ, gokarṇasya dhanārthaṃ vāmanasthalīṃ purīṃ gatasya raivatādrau śukaprāptiḥ, punargṛhamāgatya dhanārthaṃ kacchaṃ gatasya nārāyaṇasarasi vanadevatānāṃ darśanam, gaurjararājñā bhagnasyodyānasya kuṃkumavāpyāṃ navīkara- ṇam, tīrthasthā vṛkṣavallikā dhāmnāṃ pārṣadāḥ pārṣadāṇyaścaiveti mahimā । 837
351. śukoktyā gokarṇasya mathurāyātrā, śukamokṣaḥ, śukeśvarasthāpanā, mārge parāvṛttasya gokarṇasya pañcapretasamāgamaḥ, puṣkare pretatvā'pretatvakāraṇa- vivecanam, bhādraśukladvādaśyāṃ vāmanapūjā, snānapuṇyadānena pretānāṃ mokṣaśca । 840
352 saurāṣṭrīyasya varapattanavāsinaḥ pāṃcālaviprasya tilottamākhyabhaginyā saha mathurāyām ajānatorjātasya vyavāyabhāvasya vyomavāṇyā sumantvarṣiṇā ca niṣpāpatā, pañcatīrthakṛṣṇagaṃgātīrthaprabhāveṇa darśitā । - 843
353. dvārikāyāṃ sāmbarūpadarśanena kṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ manaḥkṣobhāt kṛṣṇadattaśāpena jātakuṣṭhasāmbasya mathurāyām ādityopāsanayā kuṣṭhanivṛttiḥ, ṣaḍādityasthāpanam, kāyikavācikamānasikā''parādhāstannivāraṇaṃ ca । 845
354. dhruvatīrthe samāgatakoṭipitṛtṛptyuttaraṃ trikālajñā'bhidharṣiṇā kṣudhite ekasmin pitari dṛṣṭe tadvaṃśe candrasenanṛpatidāsīrūpāṃ putrīṃ vijñāya taddvārā śrāddhaṃ kārayitvā pitṛmuktidānaṃ śrāddhavidhirmahimā ca । 848
355. niminṛpatinā śrīmānnāmno mṛtaputrasyā'rthe śrāddhaṃ kṛtam, paścāt kalpitakarmā'pratiṣṭhitamiti jñātvā śokaṃ kurvate nimaye nāradena śrāddhaṃ purātano dharma ityupadiṣṭam, śrāddhakriyākramaścoktaḥ । 851
356 śrāddhabhoktuḥ prāyaścittena śuddhiḥ, avantyā medhātithirājñaḥ kupātraviprabhojane pitṝṇāṃ pātityaṃ, supātre śrāddhadāne punaḥ svargitvam, pituḥ pitāmahasya prapitāmahasya brahmaviṣṇumaheśagātrotpannatā, somapitṛhutāśanāḥ sādhau vipre ca sahabhojinaḥ । nīlavṛṣadānam, madhuparkadānam, śāntipāṭhaścetyādiḥ । 855
357. yamunāpratāpena yamapurīriktatā, punaḥ karmibhiḥ sā prapūritā, nāciketasaḥ svapituḥ śāpena yamasadana- gamanaṃ, yamāśīrvādātmadarśanayamapurāvalokanottaraṃ svadehe punarāgamanaṃ, tatra kiṃ kiṃ dṛṣṭamiti ṛṣipraśnāḥ । 859
358. yāmyacakre mārge dṛṣṭāḥ pāpinaḥ, yamarājasya puraṃ, bhavanaṃ, prākāraḥ, gopurāṇi, kṛtāntakālamṛtyukṛtyākiṃkarādīnāṃ rūpādyākṛtayaḥ । 862
359. nāciketasā kṛtā yamarājastutiḥ, vividhanirayā'valokanāya yamarājā''jñā, duḥkhadanirayayātanā'valokanam, yātanāvarṇanam, nāciketasā saha dūtānāṃ citraguptaṃ pratyāgamanamityādi । 865
360. pāpināṃ daṇḍadānāya citraguptājñayā mandehādirākṣasakṛtapīḍanādi । 868

362. yāmyacakre pativratāmāhātmye mithināmajanaka- patnyāḥ rūpavatyāḥ pātivratyaprabhāveṇa vane'pi sūryadvārā phalānnajalasvarṇādisarvasmṛddhiprāptiḥ, pativratādharmakathanaṃ cetyādiḥ । 874
363. yamarājoktaṃ śubhā'śubhapravṛttikāraṇaṃ, pāpamocanopāyaḥ, dhenusevaikādaśyādivratasādhucaraṇāmṛtapānasevanādibhiḥ paramaṃ śreyaḥ, śrutvā nāciketā virarāma, ṛṣayo badrikāśramaṃ jagmuḥ । 876
364. pativratāmāhātmye sāvitryāṃ nāradasya trivedātmakatridevadarśanaṃ, vedhasaḥ sāvitrīpātivratyabalena muhuḥ śarīravattvamiti । 880

380 brahmaṇaḥ putryā hariṇyā vedasūriṇā saha vivāhaḥ, mṛgīmṛgadehe pātivratyapatnīvratatāpālanam, vṛṣṭiṃ vinā'pi vanasya haritīkaraṇam, dāvānalapraśamanam, hiṃsrapaśunāśāya śivasya śarabharūpeṇā''gamanam, parśurāmadarśanam, puṣkare prāgvṛttāntakathanam, hariṇayormuktiśceti । 929

525. kapilenā'śvaśirase rājñe jñānadāne saṃyamanadvija-niṣṭhurakavyādhanidarśanena karmaṇā sarvasamarpaṇātmakena mokṣaḥ pradarśitaḥ, kapilasya jaigīṣavyasya cā'nekavibhūtirūpatvaṃ cetyādi । 1340
526. kāśmīranṛpasya vasoḥ prāgjanma, mṛgarūpabrahmahatyāyā bhaktibalena niḥsṛtāyā dharmavyādhajanmatā, vasostato muktiścetyādi । 1343
527. viśālarājño haribhajanānmuktiḥ, raibhyasyāpi tattvajñānena bhaktyā ca muktiḥ, gayāyāṃ raibhyasya sanatkumāradarśanam upadeśādi ceti । 1346
528. āvaṭyākhyaṛṣeḥ svapne'nekadhāmadarśanottaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminā susvapnānāṃ phalānyabhihitāni, śrutvā''vaṭyo muktiṃ jagāmetyādi । 1348
529. kvacit sūryacandrayoradarśane śāpavarṇanaṃ duṣṭasvapnāni, tatphalatannivāraṇādīni ca । 1351
530. manuṣyāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ, vyādhakanyāmiṣeṇa hareranaivedyabhojināṃ vyādhatvam, abhakṣyavarṇanam, pāpaphalātmakakarmavipākajanmādidarśanaṃ cetyādi । 1354
531. kuṃkumavāpikākṣetre lomaśāśrame'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya jayantyāṃ tithau dhanyavādā''śīrvādapradānārthamāgatena sanatkumāreṇa kramaśo dhanya-
vādārhaparākāṣṭhāśrayā'nādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāminaḥ ṛṣivrātāya kathitamāhātmyādi । 1357
532. durjayasya trilokarājyaṃ, gauramukhāśrame śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇā'rpitacintāmaṇinā susvāgataṃ, cintāmaṇyarthaṃ yuddham, durjayādivināśaḥ, gauramukhasya prabhāsāgamanaṃ, muktiścetyādi । 1359
533. prajāpālarājño mahātapānāmakarṣipradattaśārīra-tattvātmakavedāntapuruṣajñānopāsanādiḥ । 1363
534. saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpītīrthakṣetramahimnaḥ pārvatīṃ prati śaṃkarakṛtaṃ varṇanamiti । 1366
535. kailāse dhyānasthaśaṃkarāt jñātvā kuṃkumavāpīkṣetraṃ jigamiṣusagaṇaśaṃkarapārvatīśaktisatīdevadevītīrthadivyeśvarādisamastavibhūtidehibhiḥ samāgatyorjakṛṣṇāṣṭamījayantyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmyarcanaṃ kṛtamityādi । 1369
536. śaṃkarādīnāṃ raivatatīrthe (giranāraparvate), somanāthatīrthe ca yātrākaraṇaṃ, prabhāsanāmaniruktiḥ, arkavṛkṣātmakatā'rkasya, somanāthapūjā, dānādimahimā cetyādiḥ । 1372
537. vahnitīrtha, samudrapāvitryaṃ, dadhīcaplakṣakavaḍavānalasarasvatīvṛttāntaḥ, pañcasrotomayī sarasvatī, pippaladrumakūṣmāṇḍatīrthaṃ, vāḍavāgniḥ, samudre kaṃkaṇadānenā''bhīryā rājñītvaṃ, dānādimahimā cetyādiḥ । 1379
538. anekā'nekaprasiddhatīrthāni, brahmā bhinnasthaleṣu bhinno bhinno varṇitaḥ, vasavo'ṣṭau, sūryāḥ, rudrāḥ, catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginyaśca kathitāḥ । 1378
539. prabhāsakṣetre tīrthavrātavarṇane'kṣamālātīrthaṃ siddhalakṣmītīrthamarundhatīpūrvajanmavṛttāntaḥ, citrāyāḥ pūrvajanmākhyānaṃ, śītalāyāstīrthaṃ, talasvāmitīrthākhyānaṃ, bhūtamātṛtīrthākhyānaṃ, bhūtānāmutpatyādinivāsasthānāni, abriktadeśādau sīdamānānāṃ vāsāśceti । 1381
540. prabhāsacatuṣṭayatīrthāni, tīrthavrāteṣu sārasvatatīrthaṃ, kṛtasmaratīrthaṃ sarasvatītīrthaṃ, kutupasamapādapaḥ, dauhitrādīnāmarthāḥ, mārkaṇḍatīrthaṃ, kṛṣṇakulavilayatīrthaṃ, apaśakunāni, kārṣṇasthalītīrthaṃ satratīrthaṃ vṛṣādarbhikṛtāni guptasuvarṇagarbhodumbarāṇi, aṃgiraso dānā'grahaṇam, anyānyatīrthānyapi ca । 1385
541. nandarājñaḥ sāratheḥ mānasasarasi brahmakamaladarśane grahaṇārthaṃ gatasya muktiḥ, nandarājño manasā grahaṇapāpasya phalaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇatā, nandītīrthasnānācchubhravarṇatā, tritaviprasya bhrātṛdvayakṛtakūpanikṣepastatra jalayajñe devatābhiḥ kṛtoddhārastapaścaryā muktiśca tritatīrthaṃ cetyādi । 1388
542. āruṇeḥ sannidhau siṃhasya muktiḥ, vyādhakṛtā viprarakṣā tapaścaryā ca, vaidikasya dīrghabāhorviprāṇāmavamānāt siṃho bhaveti śāpaḥ, tapasyato vyādhasya prārthanayā''ruṇeḥ pādau prakṣālitavatī nāgamatīnadī, vyādhasya pāvitryaṃ satyatapānāmaṛṣitvaṃ, ṣaṭapaṃcāśadbhogaiḥ sanmānitadurvāsasā kṛtajñānopadeśaśceti । 1390
543. pañcadaśatithīnāṃ tattaddevānāṃ ca sahetukā''divṛttāntanirūpaṇamiti । 1393 544. nyaṃkumatyāṃ devikāyāṃ ca nadyāṃ devarātatīrthā'ṣṭottaraśatanāmasahitasūryālayatīrthāni, cyavanatīrthaṃ ceti tattadākhyānasahitānīti । 1395
545. agastyāśramasya ātāpīvātāpīlvalavināśasya vāmadevanṛgāśramakuberatīrthānāṃ ṛtudhvajamokṣasya devakulaṛṣitoyāditīrthānāṃ sopākhyāna-
varṇanāni । 1398
546. viśālanṛpakṛtaviśālātīrthabhadrāśvanṛpakṛtabhadreśatīrthā'gastyakṛtopadeśaścetyādiḥ । 1400
547. bhadrāśvarājñe'gastyapradattā''tmajñānagurumahimādiḥ । 1403
548. guptaprayāgatīrthaśṛgāleśvarakṣetrā'paranārāyaṇatīrtha-trinetratīrthonnatanagarasthāneśvarādinaikatīrthāni, bālaśabdatātparyārthaśceti । 1406
549. unnatakṣetre durgādityagoṣpadatīrthavenanṛpaśuddhi-muktinārāyaṇagṛhatīrthajāleśvaratīrthanābhāgā''pastambarṣicaritrādivarṇanāni । 1409
550. tuṇḍīśvarakapilātīrthā'gastyanāradacamatkāra-bhīmanāthatīrthabhallakṣetraraivatatīrthagajanṛpamokṣādīnāṃ sopākhyānavarṇanāni । 1413
551. śaṃkarādīnāṃ dvārikācamatkārapurā'rbudācalādigamanam । gautamasaudāsottaṃkavṛttāntāḥ, nāgatīrthamahimā, veṇunṛpamokṣaḥ, arbudānayanavṛttānta-
ścetyādiḥ । 1416
552. agastyasya divyatācirajīvitvādiprāptiḥ,arbudācale rudrasya camatkāraḥ, satyetarayugīyamānavānāṃ tridevaviṣayakaparasparadrohakāriṇāṃ saṃsārapravāhasajīvanatetyādi । 1419
553. arbudācale śaṃkarakṛtanārāyaṇastutiḥ, bhadrakarṇahradatīrthaṃ, kedārakuṇḍaṃ, maṃkaṇakatīrthaṃ, koṭīśvaratīrthaṃ, rūpatīrtham, ambarīṣatīrtham, ṛṣīkeśatīrthaṃ ceti sopākhyānaṃ nirūpitāni । 1422
554. arbude siddhatīrthaśukratīrthamaṇikarṇatīrthapaṃgutīrthayamatīrthapuṇḍrodatīrthaśrīmātṛvindhyācalīmaṃ-
kipiṇḍārakatīrtharaktoddhāratīrthapārthātīrthamudgalamāṃmuñcatīrthādīnāmupākhyāni । svargasya guṇadoṣanirūpaṇaṃ ceti । 1425
555. arbude caṇḍikātīrthajāhnavīkuṇḍā'caleśvarabhīma-tīrthakulasantāraṇatīrthaparśurāmatīrthabrahmapadatīrthatripu-ṣkarasāvitrīkuṇḍanimitīrthādīnāmupākhyānāni । 1428
556 narmadāṃ draṣṭuṃ pārvatyā āgrahe tatra gatvā śaṃkaraḥ prāha-narmadāyā brahmalokādudayācalāgamaḥ, tataḥ ṛkṣādryāgamaḥ, tato bhūtalāvatāraḥ, tato veṇu-tīrthā'nantapuratīrthādītihāseṣu purūravaso nṛpasya revāvatāreṇa pitruddhārādivarṇanam । 1430
557. ṛkṣaparvate manukṛtayajñatīrthaṃ viṣṇubrahmakuṇḍahaṃsatīrthaṃ trisaṃgamo yogatīrtham, āpsarasatīrthaṃ, dattātreyāsaṃgamaḥ, gāṃjālabhedatīrthaṃ, vālukaṃ pūrṇamanorathatīrthaṃ, kanyānarmadāsaṃgamaḥ, matsyāsaṃgamaḥ, narmadāpuraṃ, jāmadagnyatīrthaṃ cetyādīni । 1433
558 matsyātāpīsaṃgama kalahaṃseśa-bṛhatīnarmadāsaṃgama-śivanetrahrada lakṣamedha saptasārasvatāditīrthānāmitihāsacamatkārāḥ । 1436
559. śāṇḍilyā kalpagātīrtha rantidevatīrtha harikeśatīrthā'mbarīṣatīrtha bilvāmrakatīrtha kubjātīrthasālaṃkāyanakratutīrthānāṃ sacamatkāretihāsaṃ nirūpaṇam । 1439
560. āruṇiśiṣyasatyatapaso mokṣaḥ, maṇḍapeśvaratīrthaṃ, bādarāyaṇaśākaṭāyanayoḥ śvamukhatānivṛttiḥ, narmadādantivanikāsaṃgamaḥ, rāsabhīnarmadātīrtha-vṛttāntaḥ, karamardātīrthaṃ ceti setihāsāni kathitāni । 1441
561. jāleśvaratīrthaṃ, hiraṇyabāhurājño gardabhatāmuktiḥ, revācarukasambhedatīrtham, amarakaṇṭakatīrtham, yajñaparvataḥ, suparṇakathā, oṃkāratīrthādīni ca । 1444
562. kapilārevāsaṃgamaviśravātīrthaviṣṇupurīcakratīrthaṃdāruvana vyāghreśatīrthādīnāṃ setihāsanirūpaṇam । 1448
563. dvādaśarasādidhenu kapilādhenu-dānādividhiśravaṇaṃ vinītāśvena rājñā kṛtamiti । 1450
564. koṭitīrthaṃ sūtraveṣṭanaṃ sūryapiṃgalaliṃgādi, lakṣmīnārāyaṇālayaḥ, kāverīpayoṣṇīsomagaṃgācaṇḍāvegāsaṃgamāḥ, candrasenasya caṇḍālatāmuktiḥ,
eraṇḍīsaṃgamaḥ, śalyāviśalyāsaṃgamaḥ, dhundhumārasya vārāhatāmuktiḥ,gālavasya vājitāmuktirityādi। 1454
565. sarveṣāṃ mahābhāgavatīkriyābhiḥ lakṣmīkṛtapraśnānusāreṇa taduttarakarmanaiṣkarmyātmikābhiḥ śrīharidhāmavāsādikathanam । 1457
566. śrīlakṣmīkṛtānāṃ vividhapraśnānāṃ bhaktikṛjjanagatisamādhānādi । 1459
567. duḥkhabhāvaḥ, sukhabhāvaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapūjā, sarvakarmasamarpaṇatādiphalaṃ, janmābhāvaścetyādayaḥ । 1463
568. viṣṇostīrtharajomāhātmyaṃ, śvetadvīpamuktāḥ, kārtika- mārgaśīrṣavaiśākhādidvādaśīṣu kṛtabhagavatphalaṃ,
sarvabhūtaprāṇimātrakṛtastutyādibhirbhagavatprāptirmuktirityādiḥ । 1465
569. kuvalayāśvamucukundavimānavaiṣamye hariścandraśaśāṃkavimānavaiṣamye narmadā'marakaṇṭakamahātmyādhikyādikathanam । 1468
570. bhagavatkṛtamāyāracanā, somaśarmaviprasya māyādarśane niṣādīstrītvaṃ dvādaśā'patyamātṛtvaṃ, punarjalanimajjane vipratvaṃ, mokṣaṇaṃ, māyātīrthamāhātmyaṃ ceti । 1471
571. kubjāmrake haridvāre bhaktamāhātmye raibhyasya camatkāraḥ, nakulasarpiṇyoḥ rājakule janmottaraṃ mitho vaireṇa prāgjanmasthale gatvā sphuṭīvacane muktiśceti । 1479
572. nārmade kṣetre'śokavanikāyāṃ mātaṃgāśramaḥ, aṃgāreśvaraḥ, satyadharmasya yajñe nakulasya svarṇarūpatā, vīraṇasya mokṣaśceti । 1478
573. suvarṇadvīpatīrthaṃ, viśokānarmadāsaṃgamaḥ, aśokeśvare raviścandrayajñe pretoddhāraḥ, vāgurevāsaṃgamaḥ, śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇatīrthaṃ ceti । 1481
574. sahasrayajñatīrthaśuklatīrthadvīpeśvaratīrthameghanādatīrtha-
dāruvanatīrthakaraṃjeśvaratīrthajīvanatīrthaviśvarūpārevāsaṃgamacaṃdrāvatīrevāsaṃgamahariṇeśvarādiśūlabhedabhṛgukṣetrāditīrthāni । 1484
575. kanyādānaṃ bhāgavatīdīkṣāvidhānaṃ guddhākeśākhyāsurasya cakreṇa nāśottaraṃ tadvasā'sṛkprabhṛtīnāṃ tāmradhātutvamiti । 1487
576. bhagavatpūjane'parādhānāṃ prāyaścittādiśuddhiḥ, śarīrāntarayonyantarāvāptirvā daṇḍaḥ, śaṃbhoḥ śmaśānapriyatvākhyānaśmaśānavāsitā cetyādiḥ । 1497
577. vārāhatīrthamahimnā śṛgālyā gṛdhrasya ca maraṇottaraṃ rājagṛhe janma, vṛttāntaprakāśottaraṃ, mastakarogādikāraṇakathane muktiśceti । 1493
578. gāyamānasya khañjarīṭasya muktiḥ, vādayamānasya nṛtyato jāgratogodāturannadāturjaladātuḥ sammārjayiturlepayiturgandhapuṣpādidāturdhūpadīpasunaivedyadāturjapayajñādikartuśca phalaprāptyādivarṇanam । 1495
579. ādityeśatīrthaṃ līneśvaratīrthaṃ gopāleśvaratīrthaṃ parāśaratīrthaṃ hanumadīśvaratīrthaṃ cetyādīni sopākhyāni varṇitāni । 1498
580. somatīrthe kaṇṭhasya brahmahatyānāśaḥ jalaśāyitīrthe nalameghadānavanāśaḥ, caturdaśasahasrakanyānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnītvaṃ, candrādityatīrtham, āsamudrāntatīrthāni, śaṃkarasya kailāsagamanam, aśuddhanaranārīṇāṃ mokṣopāyakathanamityādi । 1500
581. śrīpuruṣottamakṣetre nīlamaṇirūpanīlaparvatakathā, rauhiṇakuṇḍataṭe śrīpuruṣottamamūrtiḥ, kākasya vedhasaḥ paśyato muktiḥ, yamarājasya tatrā''gamanaṃ, lakṣmīkṛtaṃ nīlasthalīyajīvānāṃ yamadūtā'sparśanaṃ cetyādi । 1503
582. mārkaṇḍeyāya śrīpuruṣottamakṣetrasya śāśvatikatāpradarśanam, tatkṣetraparīṇāhaḥ, śaṃbhoraṣṭarūpaiḥ pārvatyāścā'ṣṭarūpaiḥ kṣetrapālatvādi, vaṭasya divyatā, indradyumnena bhāvimūrtipratiṣṭhāpanādi ceti । 1506
583. śrījagannāthapuryāṃ viprakṣatriyayoḥ bhagavatsākṣātkārottaraṃ muktirityādi । 1509 584. indradyumnasya sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamadarśanam, purohitabhrāturvidyāpateḥ jagannāthakṣetre preṣaṇam, āgatya yathāvilokanatadvarṇanam, jhanjhāvātena vālukāsu nīlamādhavalayaścetyādiḥ । 1512
585. indradyumnasya vidyāpativarṇitaśravaṇottaraṃ jagannāthaṃ prati gamane nirṇayaḥ, nāradāgamaḥ, prasthānam, citrotpalātaṭe utkaleśābhigamaḥ, ekāmrakavane koṭiliṃgeśapūjanaṃ cetyādi । 1515
586. vilveśakapoteśakathā, rājño'paśakunāni, divyanṛsiṃhādidarśanam, kapoteśasthalyāṃ yajñamaṇḍapādikaraṇam, avabhṛthā'nte vyomavāṇyā kathitavaṭavṛkṣasya vedyāmācchādanamityādi । 1518
587. catuḥpratimānāṃ sampūrṇatā, pūjanaṃ, mūrtyarthaṃ prāsādanirmāṇam, indradyumnanāradayorbrahmāṇaṃ pratigamanam, pratiṣṭhārthaṃ padmanidherāgamanam, rathānāṃ
nirmāṇaṃ pūjā dhvajādayaḥ, rathe vighnānāṃ phalāni, śāntikarmādi ceti । 1521
588. brahmaṇa āgamanaṃ, jagannāthādiprāṇapratiṣṭhā, svamū×Vr̤M×rtau avatārāṇāṃ darśanāni, utsavāḥ, rathayātrā,rathayātrāphalāni, pañcatīrthī,tadvidhiśceti । 1525
589. mahāvedī( rathanirmāṇa mahotsavaḥ, dvādaśayātrāḥ, kṛtasantānoktakathāsaṃkṣiptaparicayāḥ, granthavaktṛpūjādimahimā ceti । 1527
